places.name: 祇園 又吉 (Gion Matayoshi)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a kaiseki course of about 13 dishes seasoned with soy sauce and miso, with sushi, fried dishes and a hot pot (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kaiseki built on dashi, with sweet sea bream, mackerel, sea urchin, crab and Ishigaki beef (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 and dinner 18:00–21:00, Tue–Sun and the day before a holiday; closed Monday and the day after a holiday, and irregularly (Tabelog). Reservation only; first-time guests book online only (official site), through TableCheck or TABLEALL. Parties of two or more; the counter takes 2–3, groups of 4 or more use private rooms (Tabelog). One drink per person; proxy bookings may be refused (Tabelog). Children from sixth grade in private rooms only (Tabelog). No shorts, slippers or sandals (Tabelog). 24 seats: 8 at the counter and 16 in private rooms (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX); a service charge is added (Tabelog). 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site). Opened 10 February 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, just off Hanamikoji, through a lattice door and a stone path — about 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kaiseki in the spirit of the tea meal, about 13 dishes, on tableware made to order by a pottery studio (official site; Tabelog) · lunch ¥20,000 at the counter, ¥22,000 in a tatami room; dinner ¥36,000 at the counter, ¥38,000 in a tatami room (Tabelog, from 1 June) plus service · January 2025: a hassun of kombu-cured flounder, dried persimmon with cheese, fried abalone, sesame tofu and salmon roe with yam; kinmedai with daidai, sesame and miso; anago chumaki sushi with sansho · February 2026: a crab-only sushi roll · March 2026: glutinous rice with clams; spicy chirimen with the rice, also sold as a souvenir · October 2026: new chestnuts; three sashimi including white sweet sea bream; a soup of red sweet sea bream; autumn mackerel with a liver sauce; fried fig dengaku with sesame miso and sea urchin; a hot pot of Ishigaki beef with tofu and greens; Niigata Koshihikari rice with Lake Biwa eel tsukudani · sake centred on Aramasa; good hojicha
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a tea-kaiseki counter with a big heart] Through a lattice door off Hanamikoji and along a stone path: a calm counter of eight and private rooms. The owner-chef, who ran the kitchen of a long-established inn before opening here in 2015, cooks about thirteen courses in the spirit of tea kaiseki on made-to-order pottery — a crab-only sushi roll, mackerel with its own liver sauce, Ishigaki beef in a hot pot, rice with Lake Biwa eel. Tabelog says it has held two Michelin stars since 2016. Diners find the chef imposing at first and warm once you settle; the staff chat and send you off with walking tips. Bookings are for two or more, and first-timers must book online. Lunch from ¥20,000. A casual sister, また吉, serves lunch, shaved ice and Italian nearby.

chef_bio.chef_name: Matayoshi (surname only, from the shop name and an August 2026 review: "Mr. Matayoshi"; Tabelog's English also writes "Matakichi"; no given name in a source)
roles: Owner-chef (official site: "老舗旅館で料理長を務めた店主")
chef_bio.origin: Not settled: Tabelog speaks of the chef's Okinawan roots, and a regular's October 2022 visit notes touches from the chef's hometown, Okinawa; an August 2026 reviewer says the chef hails from Kyushu.
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the owner was head chef of a long-established ryokan and cooks with the spirit of tea kaiseki; the room has a stone approach from the lattice door. Tabelog: two Michelin stars continuously since 2016; calligraphy of the shop name by 石川九楊 (as Tabelog's English gives it: Ishikawa Kyōyō); custom tableware from a pottery studio. The official site also announces a casual sister shop, また吉, opened 1 August 2021 at 祇園町南側570-120 (lunch, natural-ice kakigori, Italian at night), and New Year osechi. A February 2026 regular writes of being intimidated at first, then finding it the most relaxing place. Tabelog Award Bronze 2019–2026; Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023, 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Ichigo ichie: dishes born from the day's conversation with guests, keeping the heart of tea kaiseki (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Tea-kaiseki courses; crab sushi roll; hot pot of Ishigaki beef.

anecdotes.text: "During my first visit, I was a bit intimidated by the atmosphere and the chef's presence, but once I got used to it, it became the ultimate relaxation spot." — February 2026, a fifth visit.
"On my way out, they recommended a charming street in Kyoto, so I took a leisurely walk back." — March 2026.
"The hot pot was simply prepared with Ishigaki beef briefly dipped in broth, yet it was exquisite." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-matayoshi.com): 祇園又吉、茶懐石のこころを大切に、季節の粋を集め、その日そのときお客様との会話から生まれる一期一会の味わい、祇園花見小路、格子戸を開けると石畳、老舗旅館で料理長を務めた店主、祇園町南側570-123、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、初めての方は WEB 予約のみ、御節七寸三段86,400円、姉妹店「また吉」(2021年8月1日開店、祇園町南側570-120 万治ビル1階、昼ごはん、天然氷のかき氷、夜は和の器でイタリアン)。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理、2名から、カウンターは2〜3名、4名以上は個室、1ドリンク制、代理予約は断る場合あり、6月1日から昼20,000円 (カウンター)・22,000円 (座敷)、夜36,000円・38,000円、サービス料あり、小学6年生以上は個室で、24席、2015年2月10日オープン、The Tabelog Award Bronze 2019〜2026、日本料理 WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2025。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 蟹だけの巻き寿司、Ishigaki の牛の鍋、Aramasa を中心とした日本酒、気さくなスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: First visits book online (TableCheck, TABLEALL); parties of two or more; many overseas guests (February 2026).

places.neighborhood: Shimogamo, beside the Tadasu no Mori woods of Shimogamo Shrine — about 10 min on foot from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Traditional Kyoto kaiseki in the tea-ceremony style: about 13 dishes from ingredients the chef buys at the market from 4 a.m., opening with a cup of sake as a welcome and soups whose lid is sprinkled with dew (Tabelog; official site) · course ¥44,000 (March 2026); diners report ¥15,000–19,999 at lunch and ¥40,000–49,999 at dinner; plus 10% service · spring 2025: a white soup with pickled cherry blossoms, a crab-and-shiso dumpling soup, sushi of fatty tuna and the collar, a steamed sushi wrapped in egg and eel; gori simmered in soy · November 2025: Matsutake as dobin-mushi, grilled and simmered; crab; takikomi rice; matcha · March 2026: "Sakura-yu", a white broth with salted cherry blossoms; crab shinjo soup with wasabi flowers · May 2026: sea bream rice; tuna served as sashimi and then as sushi · sake
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Shimogamo, a master's tea-style kaiseki by the Tadasu no Mori] Beside the ancient woods of Shimogamo Shrine, a 455 m² compound with counter seats, three private rooms and a tea room, "Suishoan", moved here from a 1935 building, all hung with scrolls and flowers chosen by the owner. Owner-chef Yoshimi Tanigawa (谷河吉巳), born in Hyogo in 1951, started cooking at 15, learned from some fifty teachers in tea, flowers, incense and poetry as well as food, was head chef at an Arashiyama ryotei at 26, and opened Kichisen in 1983; the site lists two Michelin stars in 2010–2013 and three in 2014–2019, and a win on Iron Chef in 1999. Meals are tea-style kaiseki of about thirteen dishes, still cooked by the owner, who goes to market at 4 a.m. Dinner around ¥44,000 plus service; book ahead.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yoshimi Tanigawa (谷河吉巳; romaji from Tabelog, which also writes the shop as "Yoshizumi")
roles: Owner-chef (official site: "亭主 谷河吉巳")
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: found the joy of cooking at 9 and came to Kyoto at 15; did not train at a famous ryotei but met some 50 teachers, learning tea, flower arrangement, incense, calligraphy and poetry, with influences including 福富雪底 of Daitokuji, 寛海 of Jukoin, the chef 竹端寅一 and 菅田宗匠 of Omotesenke; head chef of an Arashiyama ryotei at 26; opened Kichisen in a hotel in 1983 at 31 and built the present Shimogamo house two years later; featured in The New York Times in 1986; won a hamo battle against 森本正治 on Iron Chef in 1999; two Michelin stars 2010–2013 and three 2014–2019; has worked on ceremonial knife cooking, kaiseki for diabetics, and promoting Kyoto cuisine abroad; appeared on television about strict but warm training. Tabelog adds the chef still cooks, goes to market at 4 a.m. with an apprentice, and has trained over 60 apprentices; the tea room "Suishoan" was moved from a 1935 site. Tabelog Award Bronze 2017, 2019–2022, 2026, Silver 2018; Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023.
chef_bio.philosophy: Gochisō — gathering the season's best from across Japan as hospitality; dashi of kombu and bonito as the life of Kyoto cooking (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Tea-style kaiseki; dew-sprinkled soups; tuna sushi.

anecdotes.text: "I have been coming to this restaurant for nearly 40 years." — March 2025.
"The hanging scroll by Jakuchu is also authentic, which is quite rare to find." — August 2026, a tenth visit.
"The head chef had a powerful presence yet was very kind." — November 2025, Matsutake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kichisen-kyoto.com): 京懐石 吉泉、茶懐石の流れを汲んだ伝統的なもてなし料理、日本中から旬の食材、糺の森、亭主 谷河吉巳: 9歳で調理する歓びを知り15歳で京へ、50人の師との出会い (茶道、華道、香道、書、詩歌)、26歳で嵯峨嵐山の料亭の料理長、1983年31歳でホテルの一角に「吉泉」、2年後に下鴨に「京懐石 吉泉」、1986年 NewYorkTimes、1999年「料理の鉄人」の鱧対決で森本正治氏に勝利、2010〜2013年ミシュラン二ツ星、2014〜2019年三ツ星、献立は酒一献から、お椀の蓋に茶筅で露を打つ、昆布と鰹の出汁。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理、下鴨森本町5、昼12:00入店のみ、夜18:00入店のみ、不定休、17席、個室あり、お子様メニューあり、サービス料10%、The Tabelog Award Bronze・Silver 2018、日本料理 WEST 百名店 2021・2023。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年8月、英語): Sakura-yu、マグロの寿司、Matsutake、Jakuchu の掛け軸。

cultural_comfort.note: Set kaiseki with fixed entry times; the official site has English, Chinese and Korean pages; book ahead.

places.name: カルバドール (Calvador)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A Calvados bar: apple and pear brandies and cocktails are the mainstay; the only food the 2026 reviewers mention is Calvados chocolate.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Spirits and cocktails may suit; the chocolates are not described.
places.hours_raw: 19:00–23:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday (Tabelog); a May 2026 regular was told of a special Thursday opening. Reservations accepted (Tabelog); an April 2026 diner says it has been very hard to get in for about ten years, and diners phone ahead (2026 reviews). 8 seats at the counter (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Table charge ¥1,000 (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). Second floor, with no sign outside (2026 reviews). About 313 m from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 28 April 2004 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Kyoto City Hall, second floor of 若林ビル, with no sign outside — about 313 m from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: A bar devoted to Calvados, the Normandy apple brandy — over 500 bottlings, according to a May 2026 review, including old vintages and single casks bottled for the bar · examples: Toutain 34-year single cask for Bar CALVADOR, Lauriston 1963, Pays d'Auge 1973, Adrien Camut, a 52-year-old Calvados, a Calvados of 90% pear (2026 reviews) · cocktails: Jack Rose, a Calvados Manhattan, a long drink of Calvados and apple juice · Ichiro's Malt made for the bar, also as a highball · Calvados chocolates made with the Kyoto patisserie Assemblage Kakimoto · diners spend about ¥3,000–19,999; table charge ¥1,000
places.notes: [Bar · Kyoto City Hall, the Calvados specialist] Up to the second floor of an unmarked building near Kyoto City Hall, eight counter seats and a list of over 500 apple brandies. Master Takayama, said by 2026 regulars to know more about Calvados than anyone in Japan, travels to France to source it; there are single casks bottled for the bar and vintages such as a Lauriston 1963. Start with a Jack Rose, then let the master pour a 34-year single cask or a pear-heavy rarity, perhaps with Calvados chocolates from Assemblage Kakimoto. Regulars say it has been hard to get into for a decade, so phone first. Smoking allowed; ¥1,000 charge. Closed Wednesdays and Thursdays.

chef_bio.background: Opened 28 April 2004 (Tabelog). Per 2026 reviews: the master is said to be the most knowledgeable person about Calvados in Japan and goes to France to source it (February); has single casks bottled for the bar, such as a 34-year Toutain (2026 reviews); greets returning guests by name (February); the bar holds over 500 kinds of Calvados (May). Selected for Tabelog Bar "Tabelog 100" 2022. The official website address returned a hosting placeholder page in November 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Calvados, including old vintages and the bar's own single casks; Jack Rose.

anecdotes.text: "The moment I made eye contact with Master Takayama, he smiled and said, 'Ah, it's you, Mr. XX,' which instantly eased my tension." — February 2026.
"In the past, I could walk in without a reservation, but for about the last 10 years, it has become extremely difficult to get a table at this bar." — April 2026.
"When paired with Calvados chocolate, it felt like I was drowning in a giant baked apple pie." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カルバドール、バー、中京区妙満寺前町446 若林ビル 2F、京都市役所前駅から313m、月・火・金〜日 19:00〜23:00、水・木休み、予約可、カウンター8席、喫煙可、チャージ1,000円、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners) と楽天ペイ可、2004年4月28日オープン、バー 百名店 2022。口コミ (2026年2〜5月、英語): カルヴァドス専門、500種類以上、マスターの Takayama さん、ジャックローズ、熟成のシングルカスク、Assemblage Kakimoto とのチョコレート、看板のない2階、予約が取りにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: An eight-seat counter; the master recommends from a long list; phone ahead.

places.name: Bar Rocking chair (ロッキングチェア)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail bar: spirits and fresh-fruit cocktails are the likelier choices; the food includes fresh pasta (June 2026), and the table charge includes a small snack.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Fruit cocktails and spirits may suit; the pasta seen in 2026 came with oil sardines.
places.hours_raw: Daily except Tuesday 17:00–1:00 (last order 24:00); also closed on 9 and 16 November 2026 (official site). Bookings only for arrivals between 17:00 and 18:00, from the start of each month; after that, phone 30 minutes ahead and a free seat is held for 30 minutes (official site); groups of up to 4 (official site). 24 seats: 9 at the counter and 5 tables, plus two rocking chairs by the fireplace (Tabelog; June 2026). Smoking allowed, cigars available; no minors (Tabelog). Table charge ¥880 including a snack (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). The fireplace is lit for the season on 19 November 2026, with inoko-mochi for guests (official site). Opened 2 February 2009 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Miyukimachi-dori south of Bukkoji, a Kyoto machiya through a small garden — a few minutes south of Shijo-Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: A classic cocktail bar in a machiya, with seasonal fresh-fruit cocktails (official site; 2026 reviews) · examples: watermelon salty dog ¥2,200 (July 2026); Black Manhattan ¥1,980 and a Kamikaze (October 2026); a Delaware-grape gin and tonic (August 2026); gin sling, Old Fashioned, martini (September 2026); gin and tonic with Fever-Tree, mojito; cassis parisienne · "The Best Scene", the cocktail with which bartender Kato won a national bartender competition (August 2026) · food such as fresh pasta with oil sardines and Kujo green onion (June 2026) · cigars · table charge ¥880 with a snack; diners spend about ¥2,000–9,999
places.notes: [Bar · Shijo-Kawaramachi, cocktails by the fire in a Kyoto townhouse] Through a small garden off Miyukimachi-dori, a warm wood-lined machiya bar with a long counter, tables, and two rocking chairs in front of a fireplace that is lit each November with the season's first inoko-mochi. Owner-bartender Kenji Tsubokura runs a team whose bartender Kato won a national competition with the cocktail "The Best Scene"; seasonal fruit drinks such as a watermelon salty dog sit beside sharp classics. It is popular: you can book only for 17:00–18:00, otherwise phone half an hour ahead and a seat is held for you. Smoking and cigars allowed, so no minors; ¥880 charge with a snack. Open to 1:00, closed Tuesdays.

chef_bio.chef_name: Kenji Tsubokura (坪倉健児; official site: "Kenji Tsubokura, Owner Bartender")
roles: Bartender Kato, winner of a national bartender competition (August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 2 February 2009 (Tabelog). The official site, signed by the owner, posts monthly hours and holidays, explains the booking rules (bookings only for 17:00–18:00; later a 30-minute seat hold by phone), and announces the yearly lighting of the fireplace with inoko-mochi, a sweet said to ward off fire. A June 2026 diner found it through a book by Kazuhiko Ota. Selected for Tabelog Bar "Tabelog 100" 2022.
chef_bio.philosophy: A glass to enjoy slowly as the seasons change (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fruit cocktails; the fireplace and rocking chairs.

anecdotes.text: "True to its name, there are two rocking chairs placed in front of the fireplace." — June 2026.
"I ordered the championship-winning cocktail, 'The Best Scene.' I was warned that it was on the stronger side." — August 2026.
"The seats were fully booked, but they said they would contact me when one became available." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (bar-rockingchair.jp): Bar Rocking chair、11月は毎週火曜日と、9日と16日の月曜日が休業、営業時間は全日17:00〜01:00 (L.O.24:00)、営業開始から18:00までは事前に電話で予約可、1グループ4名まで、11月19日の木曜日に暖炉開き、火難を避ける謂われのある亥の子餅、予約は基本的に17:00〜18:00のみ、それ以降は来店30分前に電話で空きを確認し30分間仮確保、満席で電話に出られないことも、坪倉健児。食べログ: バー、下京区御幸町通仏光寺下る橘町434-2、24席 (カウンター9、テーブル5)、喫煙可、葉巻も、未成年不可、チャージ880円 (お通し込)、カード可、2009年2月2日オープン、バー 百名店 2022。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): ロッキングチェアと暖炉、スイカのソルティドッグ、受賞カクテル、季節の果物のカクテル。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has an English notice page; book for 17:00–18:00 or phone 30 minutes ahead.

places.name: 京趣味 菱岩 (Kyoshumi Hishiiwa)
places.gf_detail: Ask when ordering. No gluten information; set boxes of about 20 Kyoto dishes, simmered and grilled, with sushi and a fried item (official site; 2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Kyoto cooking on dashi, with duck breast, eel, fish and shrimp (2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Orders and pickup 11:30–18:00; closed Sunday and the second and last Monday, and irregularly (official site; Tabelog lists 11:30–20:30). Bento by advance order only, by phone (075-561-0413) up to the day before; two days ahead is safer (April 2026 review); a day's numbers are limited (official site). Collect on the day and eat the same day (official site); delivery to nearby wards such as Higashiyama and Nakagyo (official site). June–September: sales generally stop for hygiene, except for bento eaten within about an hour of pickup (official site). No eating in (Tabelog), but in August–September 2026 the shop served a limited lunch, a hamo mabushi set, in a private room, booked by phone after an Instagram notice (2026 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog; November 2025 review). On Shinmonzen-dori, 7 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; April 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Shinmonzen-dori, Higashiyama, just past the Tatsumi Bridge — 7 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto shidashi (catering) since 1829: boxed bento of Kyoto dishes to order (official site) · 梅 ¥3,780; 月 ¥4,860 (adds duck breast and bamboo-leaf sushi); 花 ¥6,480 (about 20 dishes, the best-loved); 松 ¥8,100; two-tier 白川 ¥11,880 (chirashi sushi, for about two), 八坂 ¥14,040 and 東山 ¥21,600 (for 3–4), limited numbers; 半月弁当 with a seasonal soup ¥4,320–5,940; 松花堂弁当 ¥7,020 and ¥8,640 (official site, tax included) · October 2025: sea bream sushi in bamboo leaf, dashi omelette, simmered shrimp, grilled Spanish mackerel, eel rolled Hachiman-style, roast duck breast, chicken matsukaze, sweet ayu with sansho, ginkgo · August–September 2026, limited lunch: hamo mabushi on rice with a fresh dashi omelette, shrimp shinjo soup, pickles and a grape jelly, ¥4,000–5,999
places.notes: [Bento · Shinmonzen, Kyoto's benchmark bento since 1829] A caterer of nearly two hundred years, whose boxed bento are, to many reviewers, the best in Japan: some twenty small dishes — duck breast, a perfect dashi omelette, sushi in bamboo leaf, eel, simmered vegetables each seasoned on its own — that still taste right cold. There is no dining room: order by phone by the day before, collect on Shinmonzen-dori (or have it delivered nearby), and eat it the same day, at Minami-za, on the Shinkansen or in your hotel. From ¥3,780; the two-tier boxes feed two or more. Cash only, closed Sundays, and bento mostly pause June–September. In late summer 2026 it also served a limited sit-down lunch of hamo on rice.

roles: Catering house, run by the current head of the family (official site: "現当主", no name given)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in the first year of Tenpō (1829) as a neighbourhood caterer, carrying fish bought at market to nearby homes on a shoulder pole; the third-generation master, 松之助, created the half-moon 半月弁当; the house sees itself as "the customer's kitchen". The Tabelog Award 2020 Bronze (Tabelog). Reviewers note deliveries to the Minami-za theatre (December 2025) and sales through Takashimaya and Isetan by reservation (October 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Traditional Kyoto cooking made for the customer's pleasure, with the spirit of "the customer's kitchen" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Boxed bento (折詰弁当); half-moon bento.

anecdotes.text: "Even after some time and carrying it around, I was surprised that everything inside was perfectly intact!" — October 2025.
"They even deliver to Minami-za Theatre." — December 2025, eaten on the Shinkansen.
"Since I was in a private room, I could enjoy my meal in peace and quiet." — August 2026, the limited lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hishiiwa.com): 天保初年 (1829年) 創業の仕出し料理専門店、「お客様の台所」の心構え、3代目主人松之助が半月弁当を考案、折詰弁当は梅3,780円・月4,860円・花6,480円・松8,100円・白川11,880円・八坂14,040円・東山21,600円 (税込、白川・八坂・東山は数量限定)、半月弁当4,320〜5,940円、松花堂弁当7,020円・8,640円、注文は全て電話で前日までの完全予約制、販売・予約受付11:30〜18:00、当日中に食べる、東山区・中京区などへ配達、6〜9月は衛生を考え基本的に販売中止、日曜と第2・最終月曜定休。食べログ: 弁当、東山区西之町213、店内飲食不可、カード不可、The Tabelog Award 2020 Bronze。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年9月、英語): 日本一の仕出し弁当、Minami-za への配達、期間限定の昼の hamo mabushi。

cultural_comfort.note: Orders by phone only, by the day before; the official English page says there are no English-speaking staff and suggests booking through your hotel concierge.

places.name: ぎをん 遠藤 (Gion Endo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. An à la carte menu of some 70 dishes, so sashimi, grilled fish and salt-grilled dishes can be chosen; the famous horse mackerel fry, fried oysters and tempura are breaded or battered (Waraku 2024; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-centred kappo; vegetable dishes such as dashi-soaked eggplant rely on dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–24:00 Mon–Sat; closed Sunday (Tabelog); Waraku (2024) also gives public holidays as closed. Booking needed (Waraku 2024), by phone 075-551-7271 (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 at tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). Inside the 楽宴小路 alley off Hanamikoji, 381 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 November 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, inside the 楽宴小路 alley just off Hanamikoji — about 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: A counter kappo of seasonal fish, ordered à la carte from a handwritten menu of about 70 dishes, from sashimi, grilled and simmered fish to salads, omelettes, rice bowls and fried rice (Waraku 2024; 2026 reviews) · signature: a thick, rare-fried horse mackerel fry with Worcester sauce and mayonnaise (Waraku 2024; 2025–2026 reviews) · sashimi of Akashi sea bream, striped jack and tuna; white-grilled anago; braised sea bream head · winter: drunken Matsuba crab in sake (January and March 2026), koppe crab and fried oysters (December 2025) · spring 2026: braised baby octopus with roe, Omba bamboo shoots, sake-steamed sea bream head, beef cutlet, ginger pork, sea urchin and salmon roe rice bowl, grilled rice ball · sake list · diners spend about ¥15,000–39,999; Waraku gave ¥10,000–15,000 a head in 2024
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion, the à la carte fish counter] Down a narrow alley off Hanamikoji, a calm counter where you order what your appetite wants from a handwritten board of about seventy dishes. Owner-chef Kouta Endo comes from a family of fishmongers who supply Kyoto's famous restaurants, so the fish is outstanding: Akashi sea bream and striped jack as sashimi, a thick horse mackerel fry still rare in the middle that diners call the best anywhere, drunken Matsuba crab in winter, and a grilled rice ball to finish. Regulars come as a first stop or a late second one; it is open to midnight. Book by phone; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.chef_name: Kouta Endo (遠藤功太; reading こうた per Waraku; romaji from a June 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Waraku (April–May 2024 issue, web reprint November 2024): opened in Gion in 2011 as a counter kappo of fish dishes where you eat what you like, as much as you like; the family business is a fish shop that supplies famous restaurants; the motto is to make the most of the finest ingredients quickly and deliciously. A June 2026 review adds that the family fish shop is now run by a brother and that simmered dishes are cooked first and seasoned after. Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2020, 2025, 2026; Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: To make the most of the finest ingredients, quickly and deliciously (Waraku 2024).
chef_bio.specialty: Horse mackerel fry; sashimi; drunken crab in season.

anecdotes.text: "The friendly owner creates a warm and inviting atmosphere." — January 2026.
"Here, the dilemma isn’t about “what to choose” but rather “what to give up.”" — October 2025.
"It’s fantastic that we can enjoy such high-quality fish a la carte until late at night." — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 和樂 (2024年4・5月号、web 2024年11月): ぎをん 遠藤、2011年に祇園にオープン、魚料理を中心に好きなものを好きなだけ楽しめるカウンター割烹、店主の遠藤功太 (こうた) さん、実家は有名店御用達の魚店、「最強の食材を活かすべく、手早くおいしく」がモットー、旬の魚のお造りや焼き物、煮物、サラダにオムレツ、丼からチャーハンまで70種ほど、「最強のアジフライ」はウスターソースとマヨネーズで、穴子の白焼き、明石の鯛のお造り、鯛のあら炊き、ひとり10,000〜15,000円が目安、18時〜、要予約、日曜・祝日休み。食べログ: 日本料理、祇園町北側347-118 楽宴小路内、月〜土18:00〜24:00、日曜休み、16席 (カウンター8、テーブル8)、カード可、2011年11月25日オープン、The Tabelog Award Bronze 2017〜2020・2025・2026、日本料理 WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年8月、英語): アジフライ、Matsuba crab の酔っ払い蟹、気さくな大将。

cultural_comfort.note: A handwritten Japanese menu ordered dish by dish; book by phone.

places.name: 祇園 きだ (Gion Kida)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a long omakase with soy-seasoned sushi, fried dishes and, at times, ramen or crab noodles (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dashi-based kaiseki of crab, fugu, tuna, eel and beef (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Dinner from 18:00; closed irregularly (Tabelog); the Michelin Guide page gives 18:00–22:00. Reservation only, by phone 075-551-3923 (Tabelog); hard to book (October 2026 review). Omakase course ¥35,000 before tax and service (Tabelog); diners report ¥40,000–79,999 with drinks. Courses run over three hours (June 2025 review). Each December the shop turns into "Izakaya Kida", an à la carte month of about 84 dishes (December 2025 reviews). 14 seats: a counter of 8 and a private counter of 6 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). Photos allowed, but posting them online is not encouraged (Tabelog, May 2025). About 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 17 June 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, a hideaway in the 祇園町南側 lanes east of Hanamikoji — about 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: A generous Kyoto omakase with nigiri sushi, built on the idea of 因縁果, cause, condition and result (Michelin Guide; June 2025 review) · omakase ¥35,000 plus tax and service (Tabelog) · October 2026: Jin Goemon sweet potato with crab sauce, sweet sea bream from Yahatahama with Nara Matsutake soup, Miyazu sea bream, Kesennuma bonito, marinated tuna from Matsumae, Sakai anago, salmon roe and Muscat sushi, Kagoshima beef shabu-shabu, eel, mocha ice cream with Mont Blanc · November 2025: koppe crab omelette, fugu sashimi, eel and cucumber roll, crab hot pot in white miso, Matsuba crab fried rice, ¥59,000 with drinks · March 2026: sardine sushi, grilled eel · December only, "Izakaya Kida": oden, sashimi, sushi, grilled and fried dishes à la carte (¥32,800 for 19 dishes and 8 drinks, December 2025) · sake and wine
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a Sasaki alumnus's generous counter] Yasuo Kida spent 27 years beside Hiroshi Sasaki at Gion Sasaki and was first head chef of its offshoot 楽味 before opening Gion Kida in 2016. Dinner is a long, lavish omakase — crab, fugu, Matsutake, marinated tuna sushi, Kagoshima beef — with portions diners call generous and a pace of three hours or more; each December the room turns into "Izakaya Kida", an à la carte feast of oden and sushi. Regulars praise the chef's warmth. Reservation only and hard to book; around ¥35,000 plus tax and service, more with drink.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yasuo Kida (木田; romaji from a June 2025 review, surname in kanji from Retty reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per a June 2025 review: trained for 27 years under Hiroshi Sasaki of 祇園 さゝ木 and was the first head chef at 楽味, a restaurant Sasaki founded; opened Gion Kida in 2016; the review says it won a Michelin star in the Kyoto-Osaka guide. Retty reviews (2018–2019) call the chef the long-time right hand and first apprentice of Gion Sasaki who went independent after 楽味. Tabelog: opened 17 June 2016; Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023. The Michelin Guide page describes the 因縁果 approach of cooking each day's ingredients.
chef_bio.philosophy: 因縁果: the producer's land and care (cause), the season, technique and meeting with guests (condition), and the flavour that results (June 2025 review; Michelin Guide).
chef_bio.specialty: Crab dishes in season; marinated tuna sushi; December "Izakaya Kida".

anecdotes.text: "Mr. Kida's warm personality makes every meal enjoyable." — June 2025, an eighth visit.
"Gion Kida opens its limited-time Izakaya Kida every December!!" — December 2025.
"An incredibly popular restaurant that's hard to book" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Retty (祇園 きだ): 東山区祇園町南側570-192、2018年の口コミ「祇園さゝ木で長年右腕として働いていた木田さんが、楽味を経て一昨年独立して出されたお店」、2019年の口コミ「祇園ささきの一番弟子の木田さん」。ミシュランガイド (日本語ページ): 日本料理、一年の旬を七十二候に分ける、因縁果、18:00〜22:00。食べログ: 日本料理、予約のみ、18時から、不定休、おまかせコース35,000円 (税・サービス料別)、14席 (カウンター8、個室カウンター6)、カード可、写真は可だがネット掲載は好まれない (2025年5月時点)、2016年6月17日オープン、日本料理 WEST 百名店 2021・2023。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年10月、英語): 佐々木浩さんのもとで27年、楽味の初代料理長、量の多いおまかせ、12月の「Izakaya Kida」、予約が取りにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Set omakase at the counter; booking by phone only, so a hotel concierge may help.

places.name: ひつじ (Hitsuji)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-dough donuts, including a whole-wheat donut (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Natural-yeast donuts in kinako, brown sugar and hojicha; no ingredient list is published, and the cream and chocolate-custard donuts are filled (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Thu and Fri 11:30–18:00, Sat 11:00–18:00; closed Mon–Wed and Sun, plus occasional breaks including summer, announced on Facebook (Tabelog). A numbered-ticket system: on Saturdays people queue from before 9:30 and tickets for 15-minute slots are handed out from about 10:00; later in the day slots can run hours ahead (July–October 2026 reviews). Up to five donuts per ticket, made to order (October 2026 review). A small eat-in counter for about 3–4 (July 2026 reviews), though Tabelog notes the café closed in 2015. Electronic money accepted, no cards (Tabelog). About 7 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 September 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ebisugawa-dori near the Kyoto Imperial Palace, a white awning marked ひつじ — about 7 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Natural-yeast donuts fried to order, served warm (2026 reviews) · since September 2026 the donuts are all round, with brown sugar in place of wasanbon (October 2026 review) · examples: Tanba black bean kinako ¥330–367, Hateruma brown sugar ¥330, Ippodo hojicha ¥350–378, cinnamon, chocolate ¥410–442, cream donut ¥500, chocolate custard ¥529, whole-wheat kinako (July–October 2026 reviews) · drinks for the counter: café latte, tea, coffee ¥500 · Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018–2020, 2022, 2023
places.notes: [Sweets · near the Imperial Palace, Kyoto's queued-for donuts] A small white-awninged shop where owner Takahiro Shimomura, once of the bakery Hohoemi, makes natural-yeast donuts: chewy, light, gently sweet, rolled in Tanba black bean kinako, brown sugar or hojicha, and best eaten warm. It is a numbered-ticket affair: on Saturdays the line starts before 9:30, tickets go out around 10:00 for timed slots, and each ticket buys up to five donuts, fried to order. A few counter seats let you eat one hot with a latte. Open Thursday to Saturday only; from about ¥330.

chef_bio.chef_name: Takahiro Shimomura (October 2026 review: "the owner, Mr. Takahiro Shimomura")
roles: Owner, makes the donuts (October 2026 review: "all processes managed by the owner")
chef_bio.background: Per October 2026 reviews: the owner previously ran a bakery called "Hohoemi", now closed, and opened Hitsuji in September 2011; the name stands for something fluffy, gentle, warm and happy. In September 2026 the menu was renewed: round donuts only, brown sugar instead of wasanbon, and donuts made to order per ticket (October 2026). Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023 (Tabelog). A September 2026 diner notes the shop Assemblage Plus next door.
chef_bio.specialty: Natural-yeast donuts; Tanba black bean kinako.

anecdotes.text: "With one ticket, you can purchase up to five donuts." — October 2026.
"There are only four counter seats for dining in, so you might have to wait a bit." — July 2026.
"The freshly made ones are the best, so I recommend eating them soon after purchase." — August 2026.

places.name: 森林食堂 (Shinrin Shokudo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Spice curries on multigrain rice, but the daily line-up changes and some plates carry fried or battered toppings such as hamo tempura (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The 2026 curries were meat- or fish-based (chicken, pork, duck, wild boar, bonito soup), with egg salad on the plate; no vegan curry is mentioned.
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 and dinner 18:00–20:00 (Tabelog); open irregularly, also closing for catering jobs — check the business calendar on the official site, where a blank day means closed (official site; Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Queues are common and food takes time, so allow extra (2026 reviews). 22 seats: a counter of 4, tables for 8, and a private tatami room for about 10 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). About 10 min on foot from Nijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 24 March 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishinokyo, a quiet residential street north of Nijo Stn, behind a front full of plants — about 10 min on foot
places.cuisine: Spice curry: a daily set of two or three curries on one big plate with multigrain rice, pickles and side dishes, written up in a handwritten booklet (2026 reviews) · examples: grape-fed pork keema with spinach and a bonito soup curry ¥1,950; Kyushu chicken keema with lotus root and bamboo shoots; a hamo curry with hamo tempura; squid-ink duck keema; salmon, mushroom and eggplant; wild boar; black wagyu beef tendon; three-curry plates ¥2,050–2,450 (August–October 2026 reviews) · daily toppings such as tandoori chicken, braised pork belly or marinated bonito · peach lassi about ¥900; collaboration beers with a brewery, ¥850–900 · diners spend about ¥2,000–3,999
places.notes: [Curry · Nijo, Kyoto's forest of spice curry] A travelling curry caterer that put down roots in 2012, in a house near Nijo whose front is a thicket of plants and whose room is full of greenery, dried flowers and folk craft. The menu changes daily: two or three curries share a long plate with multigrain rice and a crowd of small sides — perhaps pork keema with spinach, a coconut bonito-soup curry, and the house squid-ink duck keema. Expect a queue and a wait for plates that look like artwork. Opening days are irregular (it closes for catering jobs), so check the online calendar first. About ¥2,000–2,500; cash only.

roles: Run by an owner who is not named in the sources (2026 reviews mention "the female owner" and friendly staff)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "the travelling curry caterer that became a shop", now nearly 14 years as a shop; a list of events from 2006–2010 at galleries and live houses in Kyoto, Osaka, Shiga and Kobe; the concept is to pour the spirit of making things into the spices, the way an artist wrestles with material. Tabelog: opened 24 March 2012; Curry "Tabelog 100" 2017, 2018, 2022 and Curry WEST 2019, 2020, 2023, 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: To make a one-of-a-kind, beloved curry with the maker's spirit poured in with the spices (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Multi-curry plates; squid-ink duck keema.

anecdotes.text: "The interior is surrounded by plants and folk crafts, creating a friendly and calming atmosphere—very nice." — September 2026.
"However, the operating hours are quite irregular. It is essential to check the website for business days and hours before visiting." — September 2026.
"Waiting time melts away with smiles at this forest restaurant." — October 2026.

places.name: VELROSIER
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the booking page says the restaurant does not offer gluten-free menus; the courses include gyoza and spring-roll wrappers and house noodles of seven kinds of domestic wheat (TableCheck; 2026 reviews). Allergies must be declared at booking; no changes on the day (TableCheck).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the booking page says no vegan, vegetarian or pescatarian menus are offered (TableCheck).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (enter by 13:00) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (enter by 19:00); closed Wednesday (official site); further closing days are posted each month — November 2026: 3, 4, 11, 12, 18, 25 (Tabelog). Reservation only, online through TableCheck (official site); parties of 9 or more by phone, 075-744-6984 (TableCheck). Same-day cancellation is charged in full (TableCheck). Children only if they can eat the full course seated like adults (TableCheck). Lunch ¥11,000 or ¥20,000, dinner ¥22,000, tax included, plus 10% service; shark-fin courses ¥30,000 (lunch) and ¥32,000 (dinner) (official site; TableCheck). 16 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). GOOD NATURE STATION 2F, 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi, second floor of GOOD NATURE STATION just south of Shijo — 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Innovative Chinese omakase built on "add on" cooking — combining ingredients to create new tastes (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews) · lunch ¥11,000 or ¥20,000, dinner ¥22,000, shark-fin courses ¥30,000/¥32,000, tax included, +10% service (official site; TableCheck) · a drink pairing of Shaoxing wine, sake, champagne and wine (May and July 2026; a small pairing ¥9,000) · signatures: foie gras monaka with physalis (hozuki) jam; a deconstructed gyoza of chive chawanmushi under "chive snow"; Cantonese char siu with fried bonito; soup xiao long bao; almond tofu (2026 reviews) · autumn 2026: Matsutake soup dumplings, tuna and caviar spring roll, Shanghai crab with flat noodles of seven domestic wheats, pork loin with lotus root cake and flower buns
places.notes: [Chinese · Kawaramachi, two-star creative Chinese behind a cell-like door] Through a barred, jail-like entrance off a Kawaramachi complex into a dark, sleek room with an open kitchen: owner-chef Yuji Iwasaki, ten years in hotel Chinese kitchens, opened in Ashiya in 2014 and moved here in 2019, and an October 2026 diner notes two Michelin stars since 2023. The chef's "add on" style layers flavours: foie gras monaka with hozuki jam, a gyoza rebuilt as chive custard under chive snow, char siu with fried bonito, almond tofu many call the best they've had. Portions are big. Lunch from ¥11,000 plus 10%; book on TableCheck. No vegetarian or gluten-free menus.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yuji Iwasaki (岩崎祐司; official site: "YUJI IWASAKI")
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: ten years at a hotel Chinese restaurant, then opened VELROSIER in Ashiya-Kurakuen in 2014 and moved it to Kawaramachi, Kyoto in 2019. An October 2026 review adds that it earned a second Michelin star in 2023, the first Chinese restaurant in Kansai to do so; the Tabelog shop text calls it "Kansai's first Chinese restaurant with two Michelin stars". Tabelog Chinese WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023, 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Add on": building new tastes by combining ingredients, judging their compatibility, components and textures; traditional Chinese cooking seen from a Japanese perspective (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Foie gras monaka; deconstructed gyoza; almond tofu.

anecdotes.text: "The entrance of the restaurant resembles a jail cell, perhaps suggesting that once you enter, you won't want to leave!" — July 2026.
"I think my favorite was the foie gras monaka." — August 2026.
"With baked meringue, chocolate powder, and various textures, this is the most delicious almond tofu I have ever had." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (vel-rosier.com): 岩崎祐司 (YUJI IWASAKI)、10年間ホテルの中華料理店で研鑽した後、2014年に芦屋・苦楽園で VELROSIER を開業、2019年に京都河原町に移転、昼12:00〜15:00 (13:00までに入店)、夜18:00〜22:00 (19:00までに入店)、定休日は毎週水曜日、Dejeuner 11,000円・20,000円、Diner 22,000円 (税込、サービス料10%)、紹興酒・ワイン・中国茶。TableCheck: フカヒレ付きの昼30,000円・夜32,000円、アレルギーは予約時に全員分を明記、当日の変更不可、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・ペスカタリアン・グルテンフリー向けのメニューは提供していない、子どもは大人と同条件で、当日キャンセルは全額。食べログ: 中華・イノベーティブ、GOOD NATURE STATION 2F、16席、車椅子可、中国料理 WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2024・2026。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): ミシュラン二つ星、フォアグラの monaka、「add on」、量が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Online booking on TableCheck and an English page on the official site; dishes are explained as they arrive (October 2026).

places.name: 焼鳥 京都橘 (Yakitori Kyoto Tachibana)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking: skewers are salt-grilled, but the course ends with chicken-broth ramen and includes a kombu-cured chicken nigiri (official site; 2026 reviews). The site has no allergy note and asks guests to phone ahead.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken omakase from sashimi to skewers and ramen.
places.hours_raw: From October 2026, two dinner seatings daily (closing time not given; stored to 22:30 as on Tabelog's earlier weekend second seating): 18:00 (full course) and 20:30 (shorter course, irregular, booked gradually; grilled by someone other than head chef Sakata); closed irregularly, posted on Instagram (Tabelog; official site). Reservation only, on TableCheck or by phone 075-741-6666; same-day seats by phone 11:00–15:00 (official site). Cancellation fees from 10 days before (30%, then 50% and 100%); no proxy bookings; no strong perfume; children if they can eat the adult course (official site). 10 counter seats; private hire for 8–10 (official site; Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); service charge 10% (Tabelog). Basement of バインオークAiina, 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (official site). Opened November 2021 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Oshikoji-dori near Kyoto City Hall, in a basement — 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori omakase of Takasaka chicken (高坂鶏), a premium bird the official site says can be eaten raw: starter, sashimi, nine skewers, five small dishes, a palate cleanser, rice and dessert, ¥16,500 tax included (official site), plus 10% service (Tabelog) · dishes named on the site: chicken-broth chawanmushi, house pickles, kombu-cured breast nigiri, white-liver pâté, seasonal clay-pot rice, chicken-broth ramen · October 2026: white liver sashimi with sesame oil, sashimi of thigh, breast and gizzard, breast with kinome, negima, tsukune with Grana Padano, wings, tail, chicken soboro rice and ramen · liver and heart as extras (August 2026) · wine (mostly crisp whites) and seasonal sake
places.notes: [Yakitori · Kyoto City Hall, Takasaka chicken by a former kaiseki cook] A spotless ten-seat basement counter where owner 坂田知紀, who trained in sushi and kaiseki before falling for Takasaka chicken, grills one long omakase: raw white liver as creamy as cheese, chicken sashimi, nine skewers with crisp skin and moist meat, a kombu-cured breast nigiri and a finish of chicken ramen. A smokeless grill keeps your clothes clean. Diners call the chef warm; one was seen off at the door. Two seatings, 18:00 and a shorter 20:30. ¥16,500 plus 10% service; book on TableCheck.

chef_bio.chef_name: 坂田知紀 (official site: "店主 坂田 知紀"; reviews give the surname as Sakata; no romaji for the given name)
roles: Owner-chef, at the grill (official site; October 2026 review: "Grill Master: Sakata")
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: trained for years in sushi and kaiseki restaurants before turning to yakitori after falling for Takasaka chicken; opened in Nakagyo-ku in November 2021; Tabelog Yakitori WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023–2025; Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2025 selected restaurant. A September 2026 diner reports the grill is smokeless so guests can wear nice clothes.
chef_bio.specialty: Takasaka chicken skewers; white liver; chicken ramen.

anecdotes.text: "On the way out, the owner kindly saw us off, making for a heartwarming experience." — August 2026.
"They use a smoke-free grill because they want women to feel comfortable wearing nice clothes." — September 2026.
"The first surprise was the white liver sashimi. It was incredibly creamy!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyototachibana.com): 焼鳥 京都橘 (やきとり きょうとたちばな)、店主 坂田知紀、鮨や懐石の店で修業を重ね、高坂鶏に惚れ込み焼鳥へ、2021年11月に中京区で開業、焼き鳥 WEST 百名店 2023〜2025、ミシュランガイド京都・大阪2025 セレクテッドレストラン、京都高坂鶏おまかせフルコース16,500円 (税込): 先付け、お造り、串9本、一品5品、お口直し、〆のご飯もの、デザート、鶏出汁の茶碗蒸し、ささみの昆布締め握り、白肝レバーパテ、季節の土鍋ご飯、鶏出汁ラーメン、完全予約制、TableCheck と電話、当日は11:00〜15:00に電話、キャンセルは11日前まで、代理予約不可、強い香水は控えて、押小路通御幸町西入橘町612 バインオークAiina B1F。食べログ: 焼鳥、10月から毎日18:00と20:30 (ショートコース、坂田以外が焼く)、不定休は Instagram、10席、サービス料10%。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 白肝の刺身、ぱりっとした皮、煙の出ない焼き台、見送る大将。

cultural_comfort.note: Set omakase at the counter; book on TableCheck; mention allergies by phone beforehand.

places.name: 実伶 (Mirei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dishes are ordered one by one from about 50, so sashimi, grilled fish or a dobin-mushi can be chosen; fried dishes and handmade soba are also on the menu (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Kyoto kappo built on dashi and fish; vegetable dishes such as dashi-simmered ones use dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30), two seatings: 17:00–19:00 and 19:30 to closing; closed Wednesday and about one other day a month (Tabelog). Reservation only, by phone 075-251-2007 (Tabelog); a September 2026 diner found bookings relatively easy. Counter only, 9 seats; no lunch, no private room (Tabelog). Guests 20 and over at the counter; no very casual clothes (Tabelog). Charge ¥4,000 before tax, including the appetiser (Tabelog). Same-day cancellation fee ¥10,000 (à la carte) or ¥20,000 (course); a no-show after 20 minutes is cancelled (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 3 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 8 May 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takeyamachi-dori by Karasuma-Marutamachi, in a townhouse — 3 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kappo ordered à la carte from about 50 dishes a day, in the portions you want; courses on request (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews) · charge ¥4,000 including the appetiser (Tabelog) · seasonal: white sweet sea bream from Yawatahama and Wakayama, Matsutake in autumn, Matsuba crab in winter (Tabelog shop text) · June 2026: hamo, guji, young Lake Biwa ayu, Kuwana clams, Kamo eggplant with kinome miso, fried horse mackerel and rock oysters, hamo rice, soba to finish · autumn 2026: Matsutake dobin-mushi with white sweet sea bream, new-season sanma, handmade soba, ayu kara-age, fried oysters, beef cutlet, grilled anago · sake and a short wine list · diners spend about ¥15,000–29,999
places.notes: [Kappo · Marutamachi, kaiseki-grade cooking à la carte] A nine-seat counter in a quiet townhouse where you build your own meal from some fifty dishes on an artfully written menu — a little sashimi, a dobin-mushi of Matsutake and sweet sea bream in autumn, a fried horse mackerel, handmade soba to finish — in half portions if you like. Chef Yuuzou Nakao cooks with a small team; diners call the chef young, unpretentious and easy to talk to. Book by phone for one of two seatings (17:00 or 19:30); a ¥4,000 charge covers the opening dishes, and most spend ¥20,000–30,000. Adults only.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yuuzou Nakao (Tabelog shop page; no kanji in a source)
roles: Head chef (Tabelog shop page; January 2026 review: "The head chef is quite young")
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog page: about 50 à la carte dishes a day, because the chef believes customers can enjoy dishes that match the day's mood in the portions they want, and it is easy to order sashimi or a grilled dish late with a drink; classical and modern Kyoto cooking; a room inspired by the simplicity of Millet's paintings. Opened 8 May 2016; lunch and private-room service ended; Tabelog Award 2022 Bronze; Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Let guests choose dishes for the day's mood, in the amount they want (Tabelog shop page).
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte Kyoto kappo; fried sweet sea bream; handmade soba.

anecdotes.text: "The head chef is quite young and, in a good way, lacks the typical “head chef” demeanor, making him easy to talk to." — January 2026.
"Orders at each table are varied, but the appetizers are served first, so it’s best to arrive on time for your reservation." — June 2026, a tenth visit.
"The chef's unpretentious service adds to the comfortable atmosphere." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 実伶、日本料理、中京区竹屋町通室町東入亀屋町143-2、丸太町駅から徒歩約3分、17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、2部制 (17:00〜19:00、19:30〜)、水曜と月1回ほど休み、予約のみ、カウンター9席のみ、昼の予約と個室は終了、チャージ (先付込み) 4,000円税別、当日キャンセルは一品料理10,000円・コース20,000円、20分連絡がなければキャンセル扱い、カウンターは20歳以上、ラフすぎる服装は不可、2016年5月8日オープン、The Tabelog Award 2022 Bronze、日本料理 WEST 百名店 2021、毎日約50品の一品料理、料理長 Yuuzou Nakao。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): 好きなものを好きなだけ、Matsutake の dobin-mushi、手打ちの soba、若く気さくな料理長、2部制。

cultural_comfort.note: A menu of about 50 dishes ordered one by one; booking by phone.

places.name: 出町ふたば (Demachi Futaba)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-cake sweets (mochi with red peas, black soybeans or chestnuts, dusted with rice flour) and red rice, but no ingredient list is published; the Mont Blanc has a chestnut paste and other items vary (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Bean-paste rice cakes and red rice; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 8:30–17:30; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). October 2026 reviewers report the shutters opening at 8:00. Takeaway only; sweets are to be eaten the same day (Tabelog). Long queues, often stretching across the street; some items can be reserved by phone (075-231-1658) and collected without queuing, e.g. black-bean daifuku and chestnut mochi a week ahead, but the autumn chestnut Mont Blanc cannot be reserved and sells out early, with a limit of three per person (2025–2026 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog). 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn across the Kawai and Demachi bridges (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Demachi, on Kawaramachi-dori just west of the Kamo River bridges — 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Traditional Kyoto rice-cake sweets to take away (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · the famous mame mochi with red peas and bean paste ¥290; chestnut mochi with two whole chestnuts ¥390 (October 2026) · seasonal: black-bean daifuku and chestnut red rice in autumn; the "Mochiya Chestnut Mont Blanc" with a Tanba chestnut, bean paste and mochi under chestnut paste made without cream (October 2026); hon-warabi mochi, mizore mochi and inaka mochi with yomogi (May 2026); fukumame daifuku with sweet potato (2025–2026) · three-colour dango, red rice
places.notes: [Sweets · Demachi, Kyoto's mame mochi queue] A takeaway counter by the Demachi bridges where the line regularly runs across Kawaramachi-dori for the famous mame mochi: soft rice cake studded with salty red peas around smooth bean paste, about ¥290. In autumn come chestnut mochi with two whole chestnuts, black-bean daifuku, chestnut red rice and a chestnut Mont Blanc that sells out soon after opening. Eat everything the same day, ideally on the Kamo riverbank a minute away. Some items can be reserved by phone to skip the queue. Cash only; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Shop staff; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022 and Japanese sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023, 2026 (Tabelog). 2026 reviewers describe longer queues each year, mostly of visitors.
chef_bio.specialty: Mame mochi; autumn chestnut sweets.

anecdotes.text: "As always, there was an incredible line, and I was really glad I made a reservation!" — October 2026, an eleventh visit.
"I arrived at the store at 7:00. There were already about 15 people in line." — October 2026, for the Mont Blanc.
"I did get to enjoy one bean rice cake right away, and it was definitely the best I've ever had!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 出町ふたば、和菓子・大福、上京区出町通今出川上ル青龍町236、出町柳駅から徒歩7分、月・木〜日 8:30〜17:30、火・水休み、持ち帰りのみ、消費期限は当日、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018・2019・2020・2022、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 名物の mame mochi、kuri mochi、kuromame daifuku、栗のモンブランの早朝の行列、電話で予約できる品も。

places.name: ASSEMBLAGES KAKIMOTO (アッサンブラージュ カキモト)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Mostly wheat-based cakes, pies and baked goods; chocolates and plated desserts may differ, but no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Cakes and plated desserts use cream, cheese and mousse (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Shop 12:00–19:00 and café 12:00–17:00, Mon and Thu–Sun; dinner from 18:00 by reservation only; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). The official site gives takeaway 12:00–19:00, eat-in from 12:00, dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 20:00) at ¥15,800 before tax, and closing on Tuesday and the second and fourth Wednesday. Café: choose your cake and pay at the entrance first; a drink alone is not accepted (October 2026 reviews). 10 counter seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payment (Tabelog). 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 21 April 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takeyamachi-dori by Teramachi, a converted townhouse just south of the Imperial Palace — 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Cakes, chocolates and plated desserts from a chef who is pâtissier, chocolatier and cook at once; dinner courses by reservation (official site) · the signature "Assemblages" cake of chocolate mousse layered with banana, lemon, mango and caramel creams, about ¥900 (October 2026) · Mont Blanc ¥918 on a crisp pie base with lemon-scented fromage (October 2026) · plated "Le Jardin": a chocolate sphere melted with flaming strawberry brandy over shiso and pistachio ice cream and raspberries, ¥2,300 + tax (October 2026) · Zen, coffee mousse with mochi (September 2026) · baked goods: financier, madeleine, Florentine, Engadiner, blue-cheese sablé, caramel pie; orangettes and a chocolate saucisson · coffee and teas from ¥750 · dinner ¥15,800 before tax (official site)
places.notes: [Sweets · Imperial Palace south, the pâtissier-chocolatier-cook's townhouse] Behind a discreet machiya front near Teramachi, a stylish modern counter where the chef — pâtissier, chocolatier and cook in one, per the shop — puts flavours together: the layered "Assemblages" chocolate cake, a Mont Blanc on crisp pastry, and plated desserts such as a chocolate sphere melted at the counter with flaming strawberry brandy. Choose and pay at the door, then take one of ten seats with tea or coffee; chocolates and baked goods go home well. In the evening it serves a dessert-led dinner by reservation. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday; cakes sell out by evening.

chef_bio.chef_name: Kakimoto (垣本; official site: "パティシエ垣本"; no given name in a source read)
roles: Owner, pâtissier, chocolatier and cook (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a chef with three faces — pâtissier, chocolatier and cuisinier — whose "assemblages" of flavours are served with drinks; dinner courses by the pâtissier. Tabelog: opened 21 April 2016; Sweets "Tabelog 100" 2017 and Sweets WEST 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2026. Reviews of the bar Calvador (kyoto_calvador_bar, May 2026) mention Calvados chocolates made with Assemblage Kakimoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: Combining tastes — "assemblages" — to be enjoyed with drinks (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Assemblages cake; plated chocolate desserts.

"It seems that ordering drinks alone isn’t allowed; you must order a drink along with another item." — October 2026.
"This is my number one cake in life" — September 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask. French-style cakes and baked goods, mostly with flour; a meringue cake was on sale in 2026, but no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Cream, fromage blanc and mousse cakes (2026 reviews); no vegan item is mentioned.
places.hours_raw: 13:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Wednesday and Thursday; may close early once the fresh cakes sell out (official site; Tabelog lists 12:30). 2026 reviewers find the case nearly empty by about 15:00–15:30, and a short queue at opening. No reservations (Tabelog). A few counter seats, tables and a terrace (September 2026 review); order and pay first (October 2026). Cards, e-money and PayPay accepted (Tabelog; September 2026). On Rokkaku-dori, about 10 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (October 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Rokkaku-dori between Karasuma and City Hall, ground floor of ウェルスアーリ天保 — about 10 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: The café branch of Patisserie S, whose main shop on Takatsuji-dori is takeaway only (official site; 2026 reviews) · signature cake "S": fromage blanc with lemon and grapefruit over raspberries and cranberry, ¥806 · other cakes: Chocolat Framboise, Saint-Marc, Masala, Seduir, a meringue cake, éclair, cream puffs; mille-feuille at the main shop on weekends · baked goods and "CSS" crunchy caramels · tea such as Earl Grey ¥750, iced coffee ¥682 · diners spend about ¥1,000–1,999
places.notes: [Sweets · Rokkaku-dori, the sit-down branch of Patisserie S] Kyoto's much-loved Patisserie S sells only takeaway at its main shop, so this small antique-styled salon is where you can sit with the cakes: the signature "S", a light fromage blanc cake bright with lemon and grapefruit around red fruit, with an Earl Grey, or a Chocolat Framboise on the little terrace. It opens at 13:00 and the case is often nearly empty by mid-afternoon, so come early. Order and pay at the counter first. Cake and tea around ¥1,500. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Shop staff; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: two shops — the main shop at 下京区高辻通室町西入繁昌町300-1 (11:00–19:00) and this salon — both closed Wednesday and Thursday, both closing early when the fresh cakes run out. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: The "S" cake; seasonal cakes with tea.

anecdotes.text: "I learned that they open at 1 PM and sell out by 3:30 PM." — September 2026.
"The atmosphere has a lovely British vibe." — September 2026.
"They were delicate, light, and perfectly balanced—truly a work of art." — October 2026.

places.name: ぎをん 福志 (Gion Fukushi)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a kaiseki course with soy- and miso-seasoned dishes, fried items and, at times, a soba course (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dashi-centred kaiseki with fish, quail and beef (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Dinner only, all guests starting together at 18:00 — please arrive by then; closed Sunday and irregularly (Tabelog). No closing time is published, so no hours are stored; a 2025 meal took about three hours. Reservation only, by phone (Tabelog); 100% cancellation charge from five days before (Tabelog, prices changed from 1 October). Seven counter seats; private hire for up to 8 (Tabelog). Children from junior-high age (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); service charge 10% (Tabelog). About 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 December 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, a quiet lane just off Hanamikoji — about 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki at a seven-seat counter, centred on dashi and fine tableware (2026 review) · diners report ¥30,000–39,999 · February 2026: hassun with red clam, sweet shrimp and sea urchin, Tanba black soybeans; a clear soup of kinmedai and cod milt; Akashi sea bream and Awaji squid; grilled karasumi with daikon; grilled quail; grilled managatsuo; fried ebiimo with yuba sauce; beef simmered with seri; sea bream takikomi gohan; summer-orange jelly; matcha · 2025 courses included a hanasansho hot pot and a soba course · sake, shochu, wine
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a seven-seat counter with English-speaking staff] Down a quiet lane off Hanamikoji, a soft, calm counter of seven where owner-chef Takuji Fukushi, from Aomori, serves a dashi-led Kyoto kaiseki on beautiful tableware: clear soups, Akashi sea bream, grilled karasumi and quail, sea bream rice, and matcha whisked at the end. A February 2026 diner notes many overseas guests and staff fluent in English. Everyone starts at 18:00, so be on time; allow about three hours. Around ¥30,000–40,000 a head with service. Book by phone; closed Sundays.

places.name: コリス (Korisu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Much of the menu is breaded, battered or in béchamel (gratin, fries, cutlets, hamburg steak with demi-glace), but there are risottos, salads and grilled beef tagliata (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat, seafood and cheese menu; even the salad carries ham and egg (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–19:00; closed Tuesday, and every year from 25 January to 25 February (Tabelog). Reservations open at the end of each month for the following month, by phone (Tabelog); 2026 diners describe calling from 8:00 and getting through after hundreds of attempts (October 2026), so the booking route is persistence by phone, 075-561-9281. À la carte, best shared among 4–5 (September 2026). 12 seats at tables; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). Bringing wine generally not allowed except by arrangement for celebrations (Tabelog). On Matsubara-dori, about 7–9 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Matsubara-dori near Rokuharamitsu-ji, a brown-brick house — about 7–9 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Yoshoku and bistro dishes à la carte, refined over two generations (2026 reviews) · starters: garlic-potato and shirasu canapés, a hearty baguette with tapenade and tomato, smoked salmon with mango, peach with finger lime and mimolette · thick pumpkin, butternut or beet soups · the house salad with ham, egg and tomato · signatures: macaroni gratin, hamburg steak with a fry (salmon, hamo, scallop or shrimp), clubhouse sandwich, pork chop, beef tagliata, porcini or blue-cheese risotto, tiramisu (2026 reviews) · wine, with a sommelier (Tabelog) · diners spend about ¥4,000–9,999; four sharing five dishes paid ¥6,075 each with drinks (July 2026)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Matsubara-dori, Kyoto's hardest Western table] In a brown-brick house near Rokuharamitsu-ji, a dozen seats where a family carries on a couple's yoshoku: a bubbling macaroni gratin, a round hamburg steak beside a crisp fry, pumpkin soup so thick the spoon stands in it, a famous clubhouse sandwich and tiramisu. Portions are generous, so come as four or five and share. Getting in is the hard part: bookings open by phone at the end of each month for the next, and 2026 diners report hundreds of calls. Around ¥5,000–8,000 a head; cash only; closed Tuesdays and from late January to late February.

roles: Family-run: once a couple, now "a mother and her daughters" in chef's whites (September 2026 review); no names in a source
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a long-established yoshoku restaurant carried on from the previous generation; Michelin Bib Gourmand, per an October 2026 review; now reservation-only and among the hardest tables in Kyoto to book. Tabelog Yoshoku "Tabelog 100" 2020, 2023 and Yoshoku WEST 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Macaroni gratin; hamburg steak with a fry; pumpkin soup.

anecdotes.text: "Originally run by a couple, the restaurant is now managed by a mother and her daughters." — September 2026.
"After calling about 500 times, I finally managed to get through and make a reservation." — October 2026.
"this soup was so thick that the spoon left a mark, almost like a firm custard." — October 2026, the pumpkin soup.

places.name: 弧玖 (Kokyu)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a seasonal kaiseki with soy-seasoned dishes and sushi (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dashi-based kaiseki with fish, beef and duck (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch starts at 12:00 and dinner at 18:00, everyone together; closed Monday and occasionally other days (official site; Tabelog). No closing times are published, so no hours are stored. Reservation only, by phone (075-746-4375; easiest 9:00–11:00, 14:30–17:30, 20:30–23:00) by the day before, or online via TableCheck; guests from abroad are asked to book through their hotel (official site). Cancellation 50% the day before, 100% on the day; no strong perfume; children under 10 in the private room only; non-smoking (official site). 9 counter seats and one private room for up to 6 (official site). Cash only (Tabelog). 5 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (official site). Opened 21 October 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Demachi, where the Kamo and Takano rivers meet, near Shimogamo Shrine — 5 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Traditional Kyoto kaiseki from the day's best ingredients, every dish and arrangement carrying a meaning (official site) · lunch course ¥16,500 tax included (February 2026); the official site lists an omakase from ¥14,000 and says prices are not fixed — ask by phone · February 2026: sardine with sweet potato sushi; Awaji flounder with Shogoin turnip; white sweetfish soup; Miyagi chutoro and Shizuoka fugu; an assortment with karasumi and anko liver; root-celery hot pot with oysters and duck; rice with dashi omelette · September 2026: a Matsutake course with mackerel and fig on a bowl of Mie ice, Awaji anago soup with a full-moon tofu, a hassun with seasonal flowers · July 2026: an ayu course · sake list
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Demachi, a Sakurada-trained counter where the rivers meet] Near the confluence of the Kamo and Takano rivers, a clean, quiet nine-seat counter where owner-chef Sho Maeda, ten years at the celebrated kaiseki house Sakurada, cooks one course that tells the season in taste, presentation and tableware — Japanese ceramics alongside French plates — and explains every dish as it comes. A September 2026 Matsutake menu brought mackerel and fig on a bowl of ice and anago draped over a full-moon tofu. A March 2025 diner was welcomed by the couple who run it. Reservation only and hard to get; overseas guests should book through their hotel. Lunch around ¥16,500; cash only.

chef_bio.chef_name: Sho Maeda (February 2026 review; no kanji in a source)
chef_bio.background: Per a February 2026 review: trained for ten years, from the twenties, at the renowned kaiseki restaurant Sakurada (桜田) and went independent two or three years before it closed. Per the official site: seasonal Kyoto cooking that lets guests feel the season and Japanese culture, in a calm spot near Shimogamo Shrine and the Imperial Palace Park. A March 2025 diner was welcomed by "the couple running the restaurant". Tabelog: opened 21 October 2015; Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: Each dish and its arrangement has a meaning: seasonal ingredients, much handwork, and the seasons and Japanese culture made visible (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; hassun with flowers.

anecdotes.text: "The owner, Sho Maeda, trained for 10 years at the renowned kaiseki restaurant “Sakurada” since his twenties." — February 2026.
"Watching the chef fillet the eel right in front of me was a delightful experience" — September 2026.
"The couple running the restaurant made me feel very welcomed." — March 2025.

places.name: KOKE
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a set course of about 20 dishes, including kombu cookies (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the course starts with a broth of island-pork cheek and kombu and uses fish throughout (August 2026 review).
places.hours_raw: Dinner Tue–Thu; lunch and dinner Fri–Sat; lunch Sunday; closed Monday (official site). Lunch seatings 12:00 or 12:30, closing 14:30; dinner seatings 18:00 or 18:30 (official site); Tabelog gives dinner to 22:00. Reservation only, online or by phone 12:00–17:00 (Tabelog). Lunch ¥15,000, dinner ¥29,000, tax included, plus 15% service and fuel charge (official site; Tabelog); an alcohol or non-alcohol pairing brought one August 2026 dinner to ¥45,000. No children under 12; smart casual (Tabelog). 12 seats: a counter of 6 and two tables of up to 4 (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). IDO KYOTO 1F, 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog). Opened 14 April 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma-Oike, ground floor of IDO KYOTO around a moss garden — 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Innovative course blending Okinawan food culture with Spanish technique and wood fire, cooked with well water drawn from the garden (official site; 2026 reviews) · lunch ¥15,000, dinner ¥29,000 (about 20 dishes), tax included, +15% service (official site; Tabelog) · in-house alcohol and non-alcohol pairings, the latter by Madame Sachiko (August 2026) · 2026 dishes: a broth of island-pork cheek and kombu in spring water; a "Ryukyu plate" of small bites with house jimami tofu and sukugarasu on kombu cookies; firewood and Hanase binchotan cooking; dishes named in the Okinawan language · natural wines and sake
places.notes: [Innovative · Karasuma-Oike, Okinawa meets Spain by a moss garden] On the ground floor of IDO KYOTO, a calm, stylish room facing a moss garden, where owner-chef 中村有作 (Yusaku Nakamura), from Okinawa and trained at Ca Sento in Kobe, cooks over firewood and charcoal with water drawn from the garden well. Over about twenty dishes, Okinawan ingredients and island classics are rebuilt with Spanish technique — jimami tofu, sukugarasu on kombu cookies, a broth of island-pork cheek. Madame Sachiko's non-alcoholic pairing is a highlight. English is spoken. Dinner ¥29,000 plus 15%; lunch ¥15,000 from Friday to Sunday. Book ahead; no children under 12.

chef_bio.chef_name: 中村有作 (Yusaku Nakamura; kanji from the official site, romaji from 2026 reviews)
roles: Madame 中村瑳智子 (Sachiko), non-alcoholic pairings (official site; August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a message from 福本伸也 of Ca Sento (カセント) announcing that 中村有作 would open independently in Kyoto after training there, joined by sommelier 大山達也; KOKE sits on the ground floor of IDO KYOTO, whose shops use spring water drawn from the garden well. Per 2026 reviews: trained at Edition Koji Shimomura in Tokyo and for a long time at Ca Sento; in recent years the menu has turned much more Okinawan; Madame Sachiko, who worked with the chef at Malta in Chofu, creates the non-alcoholic pairings and launched the brand "nona". Tabelog: opened 14 April 2021; Innovative "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Hospitality born from water: spring water from the garden well and cooking that values the essentials (IDO KYOTO official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Okinawan-Spanish tasting course; non-alcoholic pairing.

anecdotes.text: "This is what happens when Spanish cuisine fuses with Okinawan court cuisine" — May 2026.
"Few places in Japan offer such well-crafted pairings made in-house, which is impressive." — September 2026.
"Dinner consists of 20 dishes for JPY 29,000." — August 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Classic French with butter and cream sauces, bread and pastry desserts such as savarin (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: classic French courses of seafood, foie gras, duck and lamb (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:30) Tue–Sat; dinner 18:00–22:00 (last entry 19:00) Tue, Thu and Sat only, since 2022; closed Sunday and Monday, with seasonal breaks in January and August; year-end: Christmas menus 19–25 December 2026, open to lunch on 25 December, reopening with lunch on 6 January (official site). Book by phone (075-255-2277) during opening hours, or online on Ikyu (official site). Lunch ¥6,655 or ¥7,865, special course "天上の晩餐" ¥21,780 at lunch or dinner, tax and service included (official site). 24 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 10 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Founded 1983 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Yanaginobanba-dori near Rokkaku, in a townhouse in central Kyoto — 10 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Classic French since 1983 — butter and cream sauces, generous plates (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · lunch A ¥6,655 (starter, soup, fish or meat, dessert, coffee), lunch B ¥7,865, special 8-course "天上の晩餐" ¥21,780 at lunch or dinner, tax and service included (official site) · autumn 2026 dinner: snow crab and sea urchin in a fruit-and-vegetable jelly; braised abalone with grilled eggplant and caviar; Kumamoto guinea fowl, foie gras and plum terrine with chestnut cream; pan-roasted sea bream with sherry-vinegar sauce; roast duck with seared foie gras and fig; French cheeses (official site) · 2026 lunches: lobster bisque, crab gratin, red-wine-braised beef cheek, savarin, blancmange with peaches · wine list of Bordeaux, Burgundy, grower Champagne and Alsace (November 2025) · takeaway baked goods, duck roast and a New Year deli set (official site)
places.notes: [French · Central Kyoto, a 1983 classic in new hands] A calm, old-school French dining room near Rokkaku that has served butter-and-cream classics since 1983 — snow crab in jelly, lobster bisque, roast duck with foie gras and fig, savarin to finish — with a well-priced cellar of Bordeaux, Burgundy and grower Champagne. Founding chef 田島福廣 retired in March 2026, and 熊﨑隆一・香 took over in April, keeping the classic style. Lunch is the popular choice, from ¥6,655 with tax and service; dinner only on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday. Book by phone or Ikyu. Tabelog's English page calls it "Les Chandelles"; the shop's own name is Les Champs d'Or.

chef_bio.chef_name: 熊﨑隆一・香 (owners since April 2026; official site; no romaji in a source)
roles: Founded in 1983 by chef 田島福廣 and manager 奥田孝雄 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the name means "golden fields", a land at harvest; founded in 1983 by chef 田島福廣 and manager 奥田孝雄, serving orthodox French cooking for over forty years; taken over from April 2026 by 熊﨑隆一・香. A March 2026 review marks Chef Tajima's retirement at the end of that month. Tabelog Award Bronze 2021–2025; French WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023, 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Orthodox French cooking that brings out the ingredients, firm in flavour, with delicacy and dignity (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Classic French; snow crab jelly; roast duck.

anecdotes.text: "As I was leaving, Chef Tajima came out to greet us, and I even asked for a commemorative photo." — March 2026, before the chef's retirement.
"In a world where innovative and fusion cuisines dominate, it was refreshing to savor traditional French dishes once again." — November 2025.
"The interior is sophisticated, and the atmosphere of a high-end French restaurant from the Showa era is quite nostalgic!" — January 2026.

places.cuisine: Kyoto confectioner of the Yasaka Shrine approach since the mid-Edo period, with a tea room behind the shop (official site; 2026 reviews) · the signature kuzukiri: kudzu noodles made to order, in iced water in a two-tier box, dipped in black or white syrup, ¥1,600 (October 2026) · warabi mochi in kinako; kibi mochi zenzai ¥1,400; hot or cold matcha; hojicha and a small sweet served on arrival (October 2026) · to take away: Kagimochi (firm warabi mochi in kinako) and seasonal wagashi (2026 reviews) · diners spend about ¥1,000–1,999
places.notes: [Sweets · Gion, the Edo-era kuzukiri house on Shijo-dori] A confectioner that has stood by the approach to Yasaka Shrine since the mid-Edo period. Past the showcase of wagashi is a calm tea room facing a small courtyard, where the house kuzukiri arrives in a two-tier box: glossy kudzu noodles made to order, floating in iced water, to dip in dark kuromitsu or white syrup — light, cool and slippery. Warabi mochi in deep kinako and matcha are the other draws; Kagimochi makes a good gift. No reservations, so expect a short queue at weekends. Around ¥1,600 for kuzukiri. Closed Mondays.

roles: Long-established confectioner; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: since the mid-Edo period, Kagizen Yoshifusa has walked with Gion beside the gate of Yasaka Shrine; the Shijo honten and the 高台寺店 serve the famous kuzukiri, keeping an Edo tradition, and seasonal wagashi; the company also runs ZEN CAFE and the ZENBI art museum with its shop. Tabelog Sweets "Tabelog 100" 2017, Sweets WEST 2018–2020, 2022 and Japanese sweets WEST 2023, 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kuzukiri; Kagimochi.

anecdotes.text: "The kuzukiri (starch noodles) were light and delicious, especially when dipped in the rich black syrup, making them smooth and slippery." — October 2026.
"When asked if I wanted black syrup or white syrup, I inquired, “Which one is better?” and was told, “If you like sweet things, black syrup is sweeter.”" — October 2026.
"On a weekday at 12:15, there was no line." — October 2026; by 12:45 about 15 people were waiting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kagizen.co.jp): 江戸中期より八坂神社の門前で祇園とともに歩んできた鍵善良房、四条本店や高台寺店では江戸の伝統を守る名物「くずきり」と四季の和菓子、ZEN CAFE、ZENBI 鍵善良房 KAGIZEN ART MUSEUM、ミュージアムショップ Zplus、11月・12月の営業時間に変更なし (2026年10月のお知らせ)。食べログ: 甘味処・和菓子・カフェ、東山区祇園町北側264、菓子販売9:30〜18:00、喫茶10:00〜18:00 (L.O.17:30)、月曜定休 (祝日の場合は翌日)、喫茶は予約不可、62席、カード・WAON・PayPay 可、スイーツ百名店 2017、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018〜2020・2022、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2026年10〜11月、英語): くずきり、黒蜜と白蜜、わらび餅、抹茶、Kagimochi、週末の行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue, then order kuzukiri (black or white syrup) at the table; no reservations.
