places.name: grains de vanille (グラン・ヴァニーユ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. French cakes, pastries and breads, mostly with flour; mousses and a meringue cake are on sale but no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Cream, mousse and butter pastries; many cakes contain alcohol, and staff check this at the counter (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:30–18:00, café last order 16:30; closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog); the official site points to Instagram and Facebook for closing days. Cakes sell out through the afternoon (September 2026). Choose at the showcase, pay first, then say takeaway or eat-in (October 2026 reviews). Reservations for cakes in person only, not by phone (Tabelog). 18 seats at tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). 4 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn exit 1 (Tabelog). Opened 6 February 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 間之町通 south of Nijo, in a narrow lane near Karasuma-Oike — 4 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: French pâtisserie with about 20 cakes in the case, breads and an eat-in room with a view of the kitchen (official site; 2026 reviews) · cakes ¥880 in 2026: Meringue Groseille, Café Escargot, Marron et Passion, Praline Cassis, Montmorency (pistachio and cherry), Unique (cheese and orange); a Japanese-chestnut Mont Blanc finished to order; caramel cream puff; crème vanille · Sablé Vanille ¥800 · croissants; breads from about ¥300, cakes from about ¥500 (September 2026) · drinks such as seasonal muscat granita ¥750 · diners spend about ¥1,000–2,999
places.notes: [Sweets · Karasuma-Oike, Kyoto's patisserie of small, layered cakes] In a narrow lane near Karasuma-Oike, a clean, modern shop whose glass case holds about twenty petite French cakes, many with a touch of alcohol: Marron et Passion, a meringue-and-kirsch Groseille, a Mont Blanc piped to order. Pick at the case, pay, then take a table in the eat-in room with a window onto the kitchen; croissants and breads go home well. Cakes around ¥880; cash only. Closed Sunday and Monday, and the case thins out by late afternoon. An October 2026 regular, who rates the cakes the best in Kyoto, reported hurried, irritable service at the register and showcase, and on two visits saw the owner scold employees loudly enough to be heard across the shop.

roles: Owner-pâtissier; not named in the sources read
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the name means "vanilla seeds" in French, chosen to evoke a sweet shop; no fixed concept, but a sense of the season, made for the customer's "that was delicious". An October 2026 review says the shop has ties to the pâtissier Idemi Sugino. Tabelog Sweets "Tabelog 100" 2017, Sweets WEST 2018–2020, 2022, 2023, 2026; opened 6 February 2011, eat-in from 1 April 2011 (Tabelog). An October 2026 regular reports hurried, irritable service at the register and showcase and, on two visits, the owner reprimanding employees in a harsh tone heard throughout the store.
chef_bio.philosophy: No set concept: seasonality, and a customer's "that was delicious" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Petite French cakes; Mont Blanc.

anecdotes.text: "The French pastries are all petite, yet each one features multiple layers of flavors that are delicate and made with high-quality ingredients" — October 2026.
"The staff often ask, “Is it okay that it contains alcohol?” when customers choose cakes from the showcase" — October 2026.

"Personally, I consider this shop to be the highest-rated among Kyoto’s patisseries." — October 2026, a regular who also reported hurried service and, on two visits, the owner scolding employees in front of customers.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (grainsdevanille.com): grains de vanille、フランス語でバニラの種という意味のグラン・ヴァニーユ、お菓子屋さんをイメージできるようにこの名前に、コンセプトを作らず季節感を大切に、お客様からの美味しかったの一言の為に、中京区間之町二条下ル鍵屋町486、定休日等はインスタグラムまたはフェイスブックで。食べログ: ケーキ・カフェ、火〜土 10:30〜18:00 (L.O.16:30)、日・月休み、電話予約不可・店頭で予約可、18席、カード不可、2011年2月6日オープン、スイーツ百名店 2017、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018〜2020・2022・2023・2026。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): 小ぶりで層の重なるケーキ、イートイン、アルコール入りのケーキが多い、慌ただしい接客と、客の前で従業員が叱られる場面を残念がる常連も (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the case, pay first, then choose takeaway or eat-in.

places.name: DODICI (ドーディチ)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking: courses include house-made tagliatelle and other pasta, bread and fried dishes; allergies must be stated precisely when booking, no changes on the day, and some bookings may be declined if the restrictions are many (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses of fish, eel, Omi beef, pork and venison (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:00) and dinner from 18:00 (last entry 19:00), Tue–Sat and public holidays; closed Sunday and Monday (official site; Tabelog). Dinner closing: Tabelog says 22:00; the official site footer says 20:00. Reservation only, online or by phone, by the day before (official site); a 17:30 start can be arranged (official site). All-omakase: lunch ¥11,000 (8 dishes), dinner ¥19,800 (10 dishes), tax included, plus 10% service; the menu changes monthly (official site). About 500 wines and a pairing by the manager-sommelier (official site). 20 seats, private rooms for 2–8 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 12 December 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 麩屋町通 north of Oike, opposite 白山神社 — 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Italian omakase that changes every month — "DODICI" means twelve — using organic vegetables from 石割農園, duck and venison from 亀岡, and Omi beef from 中川畜産 (official site) · lunch ¥11,000 (8 dishes), dinner ¥19,800 (10 dishes), tax included, +10% service (official site) · sample autumn dinner: flounder carpaccio with lotus root and ginkgo; ginger consommé with winter melon; charcoal-grilled wild eel risotto with ume; foie gras flan; baked barracuda with a bagna cauda of house fish sauce; venison roast with grape sauce; Matsutake and surf clam spaghetti; pear soup; fig kataifi (official site) · 2026 reviews: a welcome of cold-brewed hojicha in the ground-floor lounge; a self-rolled piadina; Kyoto red chicken; olive-oil ice cream · about 500 wines; pairings
places.notes: [Italian · City Hall, a monthly-changing omakase in a luxe townhouse] Opposite the small shrine 白山神社, guests start with cold-brewed hojicha in a garden-view lounge before going up to a high-ceilinged dining room in gold, silver and navy. Head chef 尾本寛, who has cooked Italian food for over thirty years and went to Italy at 28, sends out a course that changes every month with Kyoto vegetables, venison, Omi beef and charcoal-grilled eel; manager 中島丈晶, a sommelier certified in two countries, pairs from about 500 wines. 2026 reviewers call it Michelin-starred. Lunch ¥11,000, dinner ¥19,800, plus 10%; book by the day before.

chef_bio.chef_name: 尾本寛 (head chef; official site; no romaji in a source)
roles: Head chef (official site: "料理長 尾本寛")
Manager and sommelier 中島丈晶 (official site: JSA and AIS certified)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the head chef has cooked Italian food for over thirty years, went to Italy at 28 and lists a one-starred and a two-starred ristorante there; the manager trained at famous Kyoto restaurants and holds sommelier qualifications in two countries; the concept is "overwhelming hospitality and Kyoto's finest Italian cooking in a luxurious space"; the name means twelve, for a menu that changes each month. 2026 reviews call it Michelin one-starred. Tabelog: opened 12 December 2020; Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Bring out each ingredient's own flavour, and let guests find something new every month (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly Italian omakase; eel risotto with ume.

anecdotes.text: "Upon entering, I was served cold, water-extracted hojicha in the stylish waiting room on the first floor." — August 2026.
"The explanation of the Italian wines was thorough, making it easy for someone like me, who isn't well-versed in wine, to understand." — August 2026.
"The menu only listed the ingredients instead of the dish names, making it fun to imagine what each plate would look like as we waited." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (dodici-kyoto.jp): 「ラグジュアリーな空間で圧倒的なホスピタリティと京都随一のイタリア料理を」、ゴールド・シルバー・ダークネイビーの内装、イタリア料理歴30年越えの料理長 尾本寛 (28歳で渡伊、リストランテ ドラーダ、リストランテ ペルッベッリーニ)、支配人 中島丈晶 (JSA・AIS 認定ソムリエ)、DODICI はイタリア語で12、毎月コースを変更、石割農園の無農薬野菜、亀岡の京鴨や鹿肉、中川畜産の近江牛、約500本のワイン、ランチ11,000円 (全8品)、ディナー19,800円 (全10品)、税込・サービス料別、アレルギーは予約時に、当日の変更不可、予約は前日まで、麩屋町通御池上ル上白山町239 白山神社前、ランチ12:00〜 (13:00最終入店)、ディナー18:00〜20:00 (19:00最終入店)、日・月定休。食べログ: イタリアン、火〜土・祝 12:00〜15:00・18:00〜22:00、予約のみ、20席、個室2〜8名、サービス料10%、2020年12月12日オープン、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 1階の待合で水出しのほうじ茶、2階の高い天井、ワインの丁寧な説明、ミシュラン一つ星。

cultural_comfort.note: Set omakase; the official site has an English page; online booking.

places.name: 阿闍梨餅本舗 京菓子司 満月 本店 (Mangetsu Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No ingredient list was read; the 阿闍梨餅 is a chewy skin around bean paste (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No ingredient list was read (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 9:00–18:00 daily, closing early if sold out; closed some Wednesdays (Tabelog). Mostly takeaway, with a few benches; at the main shop the 阿闍梨餅 can be had warm and freshly made (2026 reviews). Shelf life 5 days (Tabelog). Phone 075-791-4121; reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). Parking in front (Tabelog). 4 min from the Hyakumanben bus stop, 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 鞠小路通 north of Imadegawa, near Hyakumanben — 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto confectioner of the 阿闍梨餅: a moist, chewy skin around sweet red bean paste (official site; 2026 reviews) · a pack of five about ¥700 (October 2026) · also 蜜漬京納言, 京銘菓最中 and 眞菓満月 (official site); the 満月 sweet, white bean paste in a firm pastry, sold for a limited time (October 2026) · warm, freshly made 阿闍梨餅 at the main shop (September–October 2026)
places.notes: [Sweets · Hyakumanben, the home of 阿闍梨餅] The main shop of the confectioner behind one of Kyoto's best-known gifts, the 阿闍梨餅: a soft, chewy round of skin wrapped around just-sweet red bean paste. It is sold at Kyoto Station and department stores, but here you can ask for one warm and freshly made and eat it on a bench, which 2026 visitors say is chewier and better. A pack of five is about ¥700 and keeps five days. Open daily 9:00–18:00 (some Wednesdays closed), closing early when sold out; cash only.

roles: Long-established confectioner; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 阿闍梨餅本舗 京菓子司 満月, making the registered 京銘菓 阿闍梨餅, 蜜漬京納言, 京銘菓最中 and 眞菓満月. 2026 reviews describe a shop dating from the late Edo period and the 阿闍梨餅 as created in Taisho 12 (1923) in honour of the monks of Mount Hiei; the sweets are also sold at Kyoto department stores. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018–2020, 2022 and Japanese sweets WEST 2023, 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Ajari mochi (阿闍梨餅).

anecdotes.text: "The Ajari Mochi from the main store is almost freshly made, so it’s still slightly warm and has a nice fluffy texture." — October 2026.
"As soon as you order, they bring you a warm one right away." — September 2026.
"I purchased a pack of five for about JPY 700 as a gift for my family. The shelf life is five days." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ajyarimochi.com): 阿闍梨餅本舗 京菓子司 満月、取扱商品は京銘菓阿闍梨餅 (登録商標)、蜜漬京納言、京銘菓最中、眞菓満月。食べログ: 和菓子、左京区鞠小路通今出川上ル、9:00〜18:00、売り切れ次第閉店、一部の水曜休み、ベンチ数席、持ち帰り、阿闍梨餅の賞味期限は5日、カード不可、駐車場あり、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018〜2020・2022、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): 本店では温かい作りたての阿闍梨餅、5個入り約700円、期間限定の満月。

cultural_comfort.note: Point and buy; ask for a warm one to eat on the spot.

places.name: 大極殿本舗 六角店 (Daigokuden Honpo Rokkaku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The signature Kohaku Nagashi is agar jelly with a monthly syrup, and warabi mochi comes with kinako and syrup, but toppings change and no ingredient list is published; the shop is also known for castella (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Agar, syrups, warabi mochi and bean-paste zenzai; monthly toppings vary (Tabelog lists a white-miso and a honey syrup among them) and no ingredient list is published.
places.hours_raw: 10:00–18:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No reservations; when full, write your name for the waiting list (Tabelog); a 30-minute wait on a holiday lunchtime (September 2026). 22 seats: 16 at tables, 6 on tatami (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB) (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). On Rokkaku-dori, 5 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Rokkaku-dori east of Takakura, a late-Edo machiya with a tea room at the back — 5 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: A confectioner founded in 1885 and credited with bringing castella to Kyoto, with a tea room behind the shop (October 2026 review) · signature Kohaku Nagashi: smooth agar jelly with a syrup and toppings that change every month — grape with wine jelly and raisins in September, chestnut and azuki zenzai in October, persimmon in November (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) — ¥950–980, or ¥1,450 with mini warabi mochi (2026 reviews) · very soft warabi mochi with kinako ¥980; zenzai with three kinds of mochi ¥1,500; 相生ぜんざい with white azuki (November 2026); kakigori such as Uji milk (September 2026) · cold hojicha in place of water; matcha · to take away: castella "Harunoya"
places.notes: [Sweets · Rokkaku-dori, the monthly Kohaku Nagashi] Behind a confectioner's shopfront in a late-Edo townhouse — the house dates from 1885 and is credited with bringing castella to Kyoto — a quiet tea room looks onto a small garden. People come for the Kohaku Nagashi: trembling, glass-clear agar under a syrup that changes each month, grape in September, chestnut zenzai in October, persimmon in November. The warabi mochi is so soft it barely holds on the chopsticks. Write your name on the list when it is full; holiday waits run about half an hour. Around ¥1,000; cards accepted; closed Wednesdays.

roles: Long-established confectioner; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: founded in 1885 and known for introducing castella to Kyoto; the Rokkaku shop occupies a late-Edo machiya with a tea room at the back overlooking a small garden. Tabelog lists the Kohaku Nagashi syrup for each month of the year. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018–2020, 2022 and Japanese sweets WEST 2023, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Kohaku Nagashi; warabi mochi; castella.

anecdotes.text: "I often stop by here after work on Saturdays to enjoy the Amber Jelly, usually once a month." — October 2026, the Kohaku Nagashi.
"The warabi mochi was so soft and wobbly that I could barely pick it up with chopsticks." — September 2026.
"The staff were engaged in casual conversations with each other and occasionally overlooked customers." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 大極殿本舗 六角店、甘味処・和菓子、中京区六角通高倉東入ル南側堀之上町120、烏丸駅から徒歩5分、月・火・木〜日 10:00〜18:00、水曜休み、予約不可、満席時は記名順、22席 (テーブル16、座敷6)、カード可、子ども可、毎月変わる Kohaku Nagashi の蜜、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018〜2020・2022、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2026年9〜11月、英語): 1885年創業、京都にカステラを伝えた店、江戸末期の町家の奥の甘味処と坪庭、Kohaku Nagashi、柔らかなわらび餅、相生ぜんざい、かき氷、休日は待ち時間。

cultural_comfort.note: Write your name on the list at the door when full; order at the table.

places.cuisine: The Kyoto Station outlet of Housendo, an azuki-bean confectioner of Shimogamo that buys top Tanba black soybeans and Tanba dainagon azuki each year and avoids preservatives (official site) · tea room: dainagon zenzai and white-azuki zenzai with grilled mochi ¥1,400; seasonal chestnut shiruko; chestnut kinton with matcha; matcha float ¥1,300; hojicha served alongside (October 2026) · to take away: chestnut kinton ¥490 (Tanba chestnuts and trehalose only), Kamo Aoi with Tanba dainagon azuki (October 2026)
places.notes: [Sweets · Kyoto Station, an azuki tea room inside the Shinkansen gates] The station outlet of Housendo, the Shimogamo bean specialist whose owner travels to Tanba every year for the best black soybeans and dainagon azuki. Behind the souvenir counter is a tea room dressed in Kyoto style, calm despite the crowds: a bowl of dainagon or white-azuki zenzai with grilled mochi, chestnut kinton with matcha in autumn, or a matcha float. Staff check whether you are in a hurry for your train. It is inside the Shinkansen gates, so only for travellers holding a Shinkansen ticket. Zenzai about ¥1,400; open daily.

roles: Housendo outlet; the owner is not named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Housendo (あずき処 宝泉堂) makes its sweets in Shimogamo; the owner goes to the growing areas each year to secure the best Tanba black soybeans and Tanba dainagon azuki, and the sweets are made without preservatives or unnecessary additives; its outlets are the 本店, the tea house 茶寮 宝泉, this station shop (renovated in summer 2020, inside the Shinkansen gates) and 下鴨神社 さるや. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018–2020, 2022 and Japanese sweets WEST 2023, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Care in every single bean: drawing out the flavour of the best Tanba beans without preservatives (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Zenzai; chestnut kinton.

anecdotes.text: "It's also nice that they check if you're in a hurry since it's within the Shinkansen area." — October 2026.
"I enjoyed the Dainagon Zenzai (JPY 1,400)." — October 2026, before the train home.
"The Kurikinton is made solely from Tanba chestnuts and trehalose" — October 2026.

places.name: 祇園 末友 (Gion Suetomo)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Tabelog lists gluten-free options, and the official site says dishes are changed for allergies, religious reasons or dislikes; the standard kaiseki uses soy sauce and miso (official site; Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: A course with no animal ingredients is offered for vegan guests — request it when booking (official site). The standard kaiseki is built on dashi and fish.
places.hours_raw: Lunch with entry 12:00–13:00 and dinner with entry 17:00–19:30; closed irregularly, open through the New Year (official site); Tabelog gives 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:30. Reservation only, by the day before, by phone (075-496-8799), Ikyu or Tabelog (official site). Cancellation 100% on the day or the day before (official site). Lunch: 八坂懐石 ¥12,100 or kaiseki ¥36,300 / ¥72,600; dinner: kaiseki ¥36,300 / ¥72,600, and from 7 November to 20 March a crab omakase ¥60,500 / ¥72,600 (official site); no service charge (Tabelog). 8 counter seats and 4 private rooms, about 33 seats in all (official site; Tabelog). Foreign-language menus (official site). Maiko entertainment by reservation (official site). Non-smoking (official site). Cards incl. UnionPay; Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). By taxi, ask for Kenninji's south gate on Yasaka-dori (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yasaka-dori in Gion, facing the south gate of Kenninji — tell a taxi "Kenninji south gate"
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki of about eight dishes with monthly menus, cooked with "Yasaka water" drawn from 40 m underground; a sakizuke on a seasonal word and a hassun on Kyoto culture; the grilled course is cooked in front of you even in private rooms (official site) · lunch 八坂懐石 ¥12,100; kaiseki ¥36,300 or ¥72,600 at lunch and dinner; winter crab omakase ¥60,500 / ¥72,600 (official site) · a vegan course without animal ingredients on request (official site) · July 2026 lunch: grilled eggplant; a Gion Matsuri hassun with sea-bream sushi in bamboo leaf; abalone soup; grilled turban shell, ayu, oysters and abalone; hamo shabu-shabu with Matsutake; ginger rice · April 2026: rice porridge with ume, temari sushi, charcoal-grilled anago · sake, shochu, wine
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a sukiya house facing Kenninji] At the foot of Yasaka-dori, opposite Kenninji's south gate, owner-chef Hisashi Suetomo (末友久史) — trained at a famous ryotei and first head chef of a Gion restaurant — opened in 2009 in a sukiya-style house the owner designed, with a tatami counter, a detached eight-mat room and an upstairs room looking onto the temple. Monthly kaiseki is cooked with deep-well "Yasaka water", the grilled course finished in front of you. Unusually, a fully plant-based course can be arranged, and maiko can be booked to entertain. Lunch from ¥12,100, kaiseki ¥36,300; book by the day before. Reviewers in 2026 range from rapt to lukewarm on value.

chef_bio.chef_name: Hisashi Suetomo (末友久史; official site: "主人 末友久史 Hisashi Suetomo")
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: trained at famous ryotei and became the first head chef of a Gion restaurant; after leaving, prepared for over a year and opened Gion Suetomo, named for the owner, in 2009, in a building designed to Japanese aesthetics, seeing "the house as part of the cuisine"; renovated at ten years to four private rooms; cooks with "Yasaka water" from 40 m underground; sources produce by visiting farms; the spirit of the tea ceremony's 和敬清寂; open through the New Year. Tabelog: opened 11 February 2009; Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2022; Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Gentle on the body and gentle on the heart"; conveying good Japanese culture that is being lost (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly kaiseki; grilled course at the table; vegan course.

anecdotes.text: "The red ume paste in the center enhances the umami of the Yasaka water and dashi." — April 2026.
"There was a tsukubai with flowing water, and the walls were adorned with countless uchiwa fans, creating a true Gion ambiance." — July 2026.
"The atmosphere of the restaurant and the room was excellent, but the food was just average." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gionsuetomo.kyoto): 祇園 末友、名料亭で腕を磨いた末友久史が2009年にオープン、「構えも料理の一つ」、自ら設計した数寄屋造り、地下40mから汲み上げる「八坂の水」、季語の先付と京文化の八寸の全8品の懐石、個室でも目の前で焼く焼物、和敬清寂、10周年の改装で個室4部屋、舞妓さんとのお座敷遊び (要予約)、アレルギーや宗教上の理由で料理を変更、ヴィーガン向けの動物性食材を使わないコース、外国語メニュー、昼は八坂懐石12,100円・懐石36,300円・72,600円、夜は懐石36,300円・72,600円、季節料理〜蟹〜 (11月7日〜3月20日) 60,500円・72,600円、前日までに予約、昼12:00〜13:00入店、夜17:00〜19:30入店、不定休、キャンセルは前日・当日100%、全面禁煙、大和大路四条下る四丁目 小松町151-73 建仁寺南門前。食べログ: 日本料理・寿司、33席、チャージなし、グルテンフリー・ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン対応、2009年2月11日オープン、The Tabelog Award Bronze 2017〜2022、日本料理 WEST 百名店 2021。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 八坂の水の白粥、祇園祭の八寸、評価の分かれる値ごろ感。

cultural_comfort.note: Foreign-language menus and a site in four languages; dietary changes and a vegan course on request when booking.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Chinese dishes with soy-based sauces, dumplings, fried rice and fried dishes; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of seafood, pork, chicken and shark fin; mapo tofu with meat (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 and dinner 17:30–21:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and recommended for the 11 seats (a counter of 7 and one table for 4); phone 14:30–17:00 (Tabelog); online booking was used for lunch in 2026 (August 2026). No table charge (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). Children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). 1 min from the Umamachi bus stop; about 10 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 20 March 2018 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Kyoto-leaning Chinese — a "new sensation of Chinese cuisine" (Tabelog shop text) — with set lunches and dinner courses (2026 reviews) · lunch A ¥2,500: appetiser salad of bang bang chicken, seared sea bream and jellyfish with nuts; two dim sum (xiaolongbao and shrimp dumplings); Sichuan mapo tofu; rice; dessert (August–September 2026); B and S lunches with steamed shark-fin soup or black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork; an XO fried rice set · dinner "Seiryu" course ¥10,000: Chinese-style sea bream sashimi, shark fin, Peking duck, sweet sea bream, beef with Matsutake, fried rice with crisp rice, fried almond jelly (October 2026) · Shaoxing wine, sake, shochu, wine
places.notes: [Chinese · Higashiyama, a hideaway counter by the National Museum] A stylish, dim, jazz-playing room of eleven seats just north of the Kyoto National Museum, serving Chinese food with a Kyoto touch. Lunch is the bargain: for ¥2,500, a bang bang chicken salad with seared sea bream and jellyfish that one diner called the best ever, xiaolongbao and shrimp dumplings, and a fiery Sichuan mapo tofu. Dinner courses run to shark fin, Peking duck and a Chinese-style sea bream sashimi (the Seiryu course, ¥10,000). Small and popular, so book. In October 2026 one diner liked the food but found the mostly part-time floor staff left dishes unexplained and plates uncleared. Closed Tuesdays.

roles: Chef-run counter; no person is named in the 2026 sources
chef_bio.background: Tabelog: Chinese, dim sum and Sichuan; opened 20 March 2018; Chinese WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023, 2024, 2026; the shop text promises a "new sensation of Chinese cuisine" with Kyoto-style dishes in a hidden spot for adults. A September 2026 diner says it is featured in the Michelin Guide.
chef_bio.specialty: Bang bang chicken with sea bream; mapo tofu; Chinese-style sea bream sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "It's the best Bang Bang Chicken I've ever had in my life." — September 2026.
"The quality for JPY 2,500 was amazing!" — August 2026, lunch set A.
"The staff, who were mostly part-timers, didn’t provide explanations or clear the plates." — October 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. A Chinese course with soy and fermented-bean seasonings, dumplings, spring rolls and noodles; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of seafood, soft-shell turtle, duck, pork and shark fin (2026 reviews).

places.cuisine: Cantonese-based Chinese courses that change each visit, from a team trained in hotel Chinese kitchens (2026 reviews) · six-dish course ¥9,000 before tax at lunch and dinner (October 2026) · autumn 2026: an appetiser platter (Shaoxing-marinated sweet shrimp, steamed chicken with scallion oil, jellyfish, yuba-wrapped mushrooms, honey char siu); Jinhua-ham soups; dried abalone with shark fin; Matsutake xiaolongbao; Shanghai-crab spring rolls; soft-shell turtle; grouper with yellow chives; chestnut sticky rice · à la carte extras: mapo tofu with rice, hot-and-sour noodles and black-vinegar sudachi cold noodles ¥1,600, kadaif shrimp, almond tofu · gin, vodka, wines
places.notes: [Chinese · Mototanaka, a ten-seat Cantonese course counter] In a little enclave of Chinese restaurants by Mototanaka Station on the Eiden line, a chef and madam trained in hotel Chinese kitchens run ten seats and one ever-changing six-dish course: a lavish appetiser platter, Jinhua-ham soups, dried abalone with shark fin, Matsutake xiaolongbao, Shanghai-crab spring rolls. Regulars add mapo tofu or hot-and-sour noodles at the end. The course is ¥9,000 before tax at lunch and dinner — good value, so tables go within a minute of opening on TableCheck a month ahead. Closed Wednesdays; check Instagram for days.

places.notes: [Bakery · Karasuma-Oike, the queue-worthy bread shop] A stylish bakery a few minutes from Karasuma-Oike whose counters run from ¥149 salt bread to truffle salt bread, cheese France, croque monsieur and a chili dog, with coffee and a few seats at the back for eating in. places.cuisine: Small bakery known for chewy bagels — more than ten kinds — plus hard breads, danishes and sweet buns, made with domestic and imported wheat and its own natural yeast (October 2026 review) · examples: chocolate bagel with black cocoa and 65% cacao chips; cheese bagel ¥280; pumpkin bagel with salted butter ¥280; white fig bagel; banana croissant with custard ¥260; heart-shaped cream bun ¥150; blue-cheese croissant; anpan; mentaiko French bread (October 2026) · diners spend under ¥1,000
places.notes: [Bakery · Karasuma-Oike, the early-opening bagel shop] A tiny takeaway bakery on Oshikoji-dori, open from 7:00, that has been turning out chewy bagels for about 22 years — chocolate with black cocoa, cheese, pumpkin with salted butter, white fig — alongside croissants, danishes and a heart-shaped ¥150 cream bun. Only four or five people fit inside, so expect a short line, and the bagels sell out by lunchtime. Most items are ¥150–300. Cards, IC cards and PayPay accepted; closes at 16:00 on Sundays.

roles: Bakery staff; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: open for about 22 years; breads made with a blend of domestic and high-quality imported wheat and the shop's own natural yeast; over ten kinds of bagel, classic and seasonal. Tabelog Bread "Tabelog 100" 2017–2019 and Bread WEST 2020, 2022, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Bagels; cream bun.

anecdotes.text: "When you're feeling frustrated, eat this. Cream buns bring a comforting and gentle feeling." — the shop's sign for the heart-shaped cream bun, quoted in an October 2026 review.
"I went around lunchtime specifically for their popular bagels, but by that time, most of them were already sold out." — October 2026.
"Grateful for the early opening!" — October 2026, before work.

places.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Wednesday and irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, by phone (075-771-7818), easiest 15:00–16:45 (Tabelog); bookings fill fast — a July 2026 diner booked a month and a half ahead. 30 seats: counter and tables on the ground floor, tables (a tatami room) upstairs (Tabelog; July 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). On Kawabata-dori at Nijo, about 7 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawabata-dori at Nijo, a spacious old townhouse — about 7 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal yakitori over Kishu binchotan, ordered by the skewer, with Takasaka chicken and other breeds (2026 reviews) · a Takasaka chicken omakase of five cuts; neck, chicken-and-leek, skin, shiso rolls, tsukune, heart, gizzard, wings, liver comparisons between breeds; Kyoto duck loin (2026 reviews) · sides: free refills of cabbage with ponzu; chicken breast with yam and ume; steamed chicken with sansho sauce; potato salad; fried tofu; Kobe caciocavallo cheese · to finish: yakitori rice bowl, onigiri with sansho and chicken soup · sake, shochu, wine, cocktails · diners spend about ¥4,000–9,999
places.notes: [Yakitori · Kawabata-Nijo, the hard-to-book binchotan grill] In a roomy old townhouse on Kawabata-dori, owner Tomoki Hitomi grills over Kishu binchotan, skewer by skewer: a five-cut Takasaka chicken omakase, crisp-skinned wings, neck and liver tasted side by side from two breeds, and a Kyoto duck loin. Free refills of cabbage with ponzu come first; onigiri with sansho and chicken soup finish. Diners describe a humble, attentive owner who remembers regulars. Prices are reasonable for the quality, so bookings go fast — phone between 15:00 and 16:45. Cash only; open to 23:00; closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.chef_name: Tomoki Hitomi (June 2026 review: "the owner, Tomoki Hitomi"; no given-name kanji in a source)
chef_bio.background: Per a June 2026 review: a yakitori specialist opened in 2005, among the hardest restaurants in Kyoto to book, grilling Takasaka chicken and other breeds over Kishu binchotan. Tabelog Yakitori "Tabelog 100" 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022 and Yakitori WEST 2023–2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Takasaka chicken omakase; liver; duck loin.

anecdotes.text: "I was humbled by the polite and humble service from the owner, Tomoki Hitomi, which heightened my expectations." — June 2026.
"Even though it had been a while, the master remembered me, which made me happy." — September 2026.
"I made a reservation a month and a half in advance and was really looking forward to it!" — July 2026.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef course.
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:30 (last food order 21:30), Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun and holidays; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, on Tabelog or by phone; one July 2026 diner booked 62 days ahead, others got same-day seats on weekdays (2026 reviews). places.cuisine: Course-only yakiniku of top-grade beef, grilled yourself at counters divided into pairs (2026 reviews) · omakase ¥13,500 tax included (2026) · signatures: a yukhoe shaped like a cow with egg yolk and a sweet sauce; thick tongue fresh enough to serve rare; a shabu-shabu of strip loin with Kujo negi; white tripe sashimi; skirt steak, including with miso sauce; kimchi and namul (2026 reviews) · finish with curry or cold noodles in three sizes, then milk pudding
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Shijo-Karasuma, course yakiniku from a Kyoto restaurant family] A sister of the Kyoto restaurant Tomikoji Yamagishi, run by the founder's brother according to an October 2026 review, serving one omakase yakiniku course at counters split into private pairs. It opens with a yukhoe shaped like a little cow, then thick tongue, a strip-loin shabu-shabu with Kujo negi, tripe sashimi and skirt steak, ending with curry or cold noodles and milk pudding. ¥13,500 including tax is good value, and diners say the seasoning lets the meat speak. Book on Tabelog; closed Wednesdays.

roles: Sister restaurant of Tomikoji Yamagishi, run by the founder's brother (October 2026 review); no names in a source
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a sister restaurant of the Kyoto restaurant Tomikoji Yamagishi (one June 2026 review says the Washoku Yamaki group); course only; opened 2 April 2021. Tabelog Yakiniku WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021–2023, 2025 and Grill WEST 2024, 2026. A long-standing regular (41 visits by July 2026) praises the improving sauces.
chef_bio.specialty: Cow-shaped yukhoe; thick tongue; skirt steak.

anecdotes.text: "The first dish served was a cute beef-shaped yukhoe." — August 2026.
"The counter has dividers for every two seats, reminiscent of Ichiran style." — September 2026.
"Honestly, it didn’t resonate with me at all." — October 2026, on the ¥13,500 course.

places.name: オテルドゥオガワ (Hotel De Ogawa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. À la carte izakaya dishes include fried chicken, Matsutake fry, pasta and fried rice alongside sashimi and simmered dishes; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kaiseki-trained izakaya built on dashi, fish and chicken (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 14:00–22:00 (last order 21:00), Tue–Sun; closed Monday (Tabelog). No reservations and no waiting line: walk in and take a seat if one is free; no groups (Tabelog; September 2026). Opening at 14:00 is the best chance (2026 reviews). 8 counter seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). The blackboard menu shows no prices (August 2026). On the ground floor of a hotel on Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Shijo, 177 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened May 2024 (October 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Shijo, unsigned on a hotel's ground floor — a short walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: À la carte izakaya cooking with kaiseki technique, from a blackboard menu without prices (2026 reviews) · signatures inherited from the parent shop: bone-in fried chicken with yuzu pepper, dashimaki, jako fried rice (October 2026) · also karasumi mochi, chicken wings, duck ham, sashimi platters and anago sashimi, Matsutake fry, fried guji, squid shumai, mackerel sushi, boiled octopus, simmered tofu, mentaiko pasta and the chef's own "My Napolitan" (August–October 2026) · shochu, sake, draft beer · diners spend about ¥4,000–9,999
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi, the walk-in spin-off of a hard-to-book kappo] Right next to the hard-to-book Shokudo Ogawa, its sister has eight counter seats, no sign, no reservations and no queue: arrive (ideally at the 14:00 opening) and sit if there is room. Chef Hiroto Haeo, seven years under Shintaro Ogawa, cooks the parent shop's classics — bone-in fried chicken, dashimaki, jako fried rice — alongside karasumi mochi, Matsutake fry and a ketchupy Napolitan. The blackboard shows no prices; most spend ¥5,000–9,000. Cash only; closed Mondays.

chef_bio.chef_name: Hiroto Haeo (October 2026 review; no kanji in a source)
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: opened in May 2024 next to its parent Shokudo Ogawa on Nishi-Kiyamachi, on the ground floor of a hotel (hence the French "Hôtel"); the kitchen is run by Hiroto Haeo, who trained for seven years under Shintaro Ogawa of Shokudo Ogawa, and keeps the parent shop's fried chicken, dashimaki and jako fried rice. Tabelog Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Bone-in fried chicken; jako fried rice; karasumi mochi.

anecdotes.text: "Hotel De Ogawa is an izakaya that does not accept reservations or allow waiting in line." — September 2026.
"A restaurant that couldn’t take reservations has now opened one that doesn’t accept them at all." — October 2026.
"For JPY 6000, I had a draft beer, karasumi mochi, a three-piece sashimi platter, half a serving of Japanese sake, and fried matsutake mushrooms, which seems a bit pricey overall." — August 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Courses include house pasta, raviolone and bread; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of fish, shellfish, wagyu and pork (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch with last entry at 12:00–13:00 on Mon, Tue, Sat, Sun and holidays; dinner from 17:30 with last entry 21:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No closing times are published, so no hours are stored. Reservation only, by phone (075-255-8757) or Pocket Concierge (Tabelog). Lunch course ¥12,000 and dinner course ¥24,000 including tax and service (Tabelog remarks, undated); a March 2026 dinner with wine pairing came to about ¥36,000. 26 seats: a counter of 10 on the ground floor and two private rooms for up to 8 upstairs (Tabelog). Non-smoking; ashtray outside (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 6 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 20 December 2016 (January 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Near Karasuma-Marutamachi, a century-old townhouse with a garden — 6 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Italian courses built on Kyoto ingredients — "what if there were a state called Kyoto in Italy?" — with wine or non-alcohol pairings by the sommelier (January 2026 review) · lunch ¥12,000, dinner ¥24,000 tax and service included (Tabelog) · June 2026 dinner: new-onion capellini with torigai; striped jack tartare; fried young Lake Biwa ayu with burrata; seared sirloin carpaccio with summer truffle; hairy crab and sea urchin tagliolini; corn risotto with chorizo; Omi beef fillet; "Sun Egg" pudding with milk gelato · also raviolone with oozing yolk in the colder months, clam and edamame gratin, truffles shaved at the table, house grissini and bread · a cellar of wine by the door
places.notes: [Italian · Marutamachi, Kyoto as an Italian region] In a hundred-year-old townhouse near Karasuma-Marutamachi, chef Daiki Hayakawa, from the Kyoto Italian Il Ghiottone, cooks as if Kyoto were a region of Italy, and sommelier Yoji Ikemoto pairs from a cellar you walk past on the way in. Ten seats at a single-slab counter face a small garden; two private rooms are upstairs. Expect dishes like fried young Lake Biwa ayu with burrata, hairy-crab tagliolini and Omi beef, finished with the "Sun Egg" pudding. 2026 reviewers call it Michelin-starred. Lunch ¥12,000, dinner ¥24,000 all in; book by phone or Pocket Concierge; closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.chef_name: Daiki Hayakawa (January 2026 review: "Chef Daiki Hayakawa"; no kanji in a source)
chef_bio.background: Per a January 2026 review: opened in December 2016 by chef Daiki Hayakawa, trained at the Kyoto Italian Il Ghiottone, with sommelier Yoji Ikemoto, on the concept "what if there were a state called Kyoto in Italy?", in a 100-year-old townhouse. 2026 reviews call it Michelin one-starred. Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023, 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: "What if there were a state called Kyoto in Italy?" (January 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto-Italian courses; raviolone; "Sun Egg" pudding.

anecdotes.text: "This year, I've been to Italian restaurants about 90 times, but this place left the most lasting impression on me." — September 2026.
"With a spacious counter overlooking a traditional town house garden, the ambiance is truly top-notch." — March 2026.
"Everything was delicious, and the performance of shaving truffles right in front of us was truly impressive." — December 2025.

places.neighborhood: Gion, on Nawate-dori just south of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Creative teppan kaiseki: a Japanese base with Western touches, cooked on the griddle before you (2026 reviews) · omakase ¥30,000 before tax, up to ¥10,000 more in some seasons (Tabelog) · October 2026: ikura sticky rice; caramelised black fig with truffle; rare Spanish mackerel with caviar and ginkgo; beef tongue in white miso; steamed abalone with sea urchin; Matsutake fried noodles; a hamburg of tenderloin and foie gras with wasabi; tenderloin steak · earlier in 2026: Ise lobster in chili sauce, grilled milt yakisoba, kombu-cured firefly-squid yakisoba, Omi beef with bamboo shoots in white miso, sukiyaki, garlic rice, house ice cream · champagne and wine pairings
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Gion, a couple's teppan kaiseki counter] Just off Shijo on Nawate-dori, eight seats face the griddle run by a husband-and-wife team, where owner-chef Seki cooks a long omakase — teppan as kaiseki, a Japanese base with Western touches: Spanish mackerel with caviar, beef tongue in white miso, Matsutake fried noodles, Ise lobster in chili sauce, a tenderloin-and-foie-gras hamburg and garlic rice. Portions are generous; you are asked your appetite at the start. ¥30,000 before tax, more in some seasons, and drinks add up. Book by phone; closed Thursdays.

chef_bio.specialty: Teppan kaiseki; firefly-squid yakisoba; tenderloin and foie gras hamburg.

places.name: 喫茶葦島 (Kissa Ashijima)
places.gf_detail: The Sanjo cheesecake is made with rice flour and described as gluten-free (October 2026 review), and Tabelog lists gluten-free options and allergy information; staff ask about allergies when you order (October 2026). Other cakes and the curry are not described — ask.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and tea suit; the cakes are dairy cheesecakes and chocolate cakes, and the curry has meat (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 12:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); Tue 12:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); Sat and Sun 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30) (official site; Tabelog). No reservations (official site). 20 seats: a counter of 8 and two tables of 6 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Cards, QUICPay, PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). Decaf available; the only food is curry (Tabelog). Fifth floor of the Bunmeido building at the south-east corner of Sanjo-Kawaramachi; 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (official site; Tabelog). Opened 15 May 2010 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-Kawaramachi, fifth floor of the 文明堂ビル on the south-east corner — 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Coffee roasted in-house over direct flame in small batches, brewed cup by cup, with cakes chosen to pair (official site; 2026 reviews) · examples: Ashijima Blend ¥880; the house medium-roast "Hyakunen Coffee"; Mocha G1; Mandheling Aceh ¥1,200; iced café latte · cakes ¥750: the gluten-free Sanjo cheesecake of rice flour, a half-frozen Asamiya sencha cheesecake, cinnamon chocolate cake, matcha cheesecake · curry, the only meal · iced milk tea, decaf · diners spend about ¥1,000–1,999
places.notes: [Kissaten · Sanjo-Kawaramachi, a calm coffee room above the crowds] Take the lift to the fifth floor of a busy Sanjo-dori building and step into a white, jazz-playing room hung with wire art made for the café by Koichiro Tokumochi. The coffee is roasted in-house over direct flame and brewed cup by cup: the Ashijima Blend or the house medium-roast "Hyakunen Coffee", with a cake chosen to match — the rice-flour Sanjo cheesecake is gluten-free. Staff ask about allergies and serve with bar-like polish. Coffee and cake about ¥1,600; no reservations; open daily.

roles: Owner-roaster; not named in the sources read
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: coffee roasted in small batches on a direct-flame roaster to suit every taste, from bitter to acidic to strong; the group runs 喫茶葦島, 葦島珈琲 (a café in Kyoto Takashimaya S.C.), the takeaway shop 葦 and the café das, and sells beans and cheesecakes online. An October 2026 review notes wire art by Koichiro Tokumochi made for the café. Tabelog Kissaten "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022, 2026; opened 15 May 2010.
chef_bio.philosophy: Coffee that pursues the beans' own flavour, in a calming space (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: House-roast coffee; Sanjo cheesecake.

anecdotes.text: "Only high-quality domestic ingredients, including rice flour, are used to carefully express the goodness of the materials. It is gluten-free." — October 2026, the Sanjo cheesecake.
"The staff kindly checked for any allergies." — October 2026.
"Although Sanjo is a lively street, once you reach the 5th floor, a tranquil space unfolds" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ashijimacoffee.com): 葦島珈琲、自家焙煎珈琲と厳選スイーツ、直火式焙煎機で少量ずつ焙煎、喫茶葦島・葦島珈琲 (京都髙島屋 S.C.)・葦 (テイクアウト専門)・das (カフェ)、喫茶葦島は平日12:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、火曜12:00〜17:00 (L.O.16:30)、土日11:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、予約不可、中京区大黒町37 文明堂ビル5階。食べログ: 喫茶店・カフェ・ケーキ、20席 (カウンター8、テーブル6×2)、禁煙、車椅子可、カード・QUICPay・PayPay・Alipay 可、アレルギー表示・グルテンフリー対応、デカフェあり、食事はカレーのみ、2010年5月15日オープン、喫茶店百名店 2021・2022・2026。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): 米粉のグルテンフリーの Sanjo cheesecake、Hyakunen Coffee、店のためのワイヤーアート、アレルギーの確認。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the table; staff ask about allergies.

gf_cross_contamination.text: No source describes how the gluten-free cheesecake is made or stored alongside the wheat cakes; the curry is not described. Celiac diners should ask.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Staff checked for allergies when taking the order (October 2026); Tabelog lists allergy information and gluten-free options.

positives.text: The Sanjo cheesecake is made with domestic ingredients including rice flour and is described as gluten-free (October 2026).

places.name: en boca Kyoto (エンボカ 京都)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pizza is the focus (wheat dough), but the oven-roasted vegetable platters, prosciutto and salads are popular starters (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Oven-roasted vegetables are a signature, and the lotus-root pizza with pesto is made without cheese (September 2026); pesto may contain cheese, so check.
places.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–22:00 (last food order 21:00) on Mon, Thu and Fri; lunch 11:30–15:00 (last food order 14:00) on Sat and Sun; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations recommended; call before coming without one; same-day cancellation ¥3,000 (Tabelog). Lunch courses for two or more, à la carte also possible (September–October 2026). One drink per person at dinner (Tabelog). 6 counter seats in front of the wood oven and 27 at tables; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 7 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Opened 12 December 2010 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishinotoin-dori south of Rokkaku, a high-ceilinged renovated machiya — 7 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Wood-oven pizza topped with Japanese seasonal vegetables, and oven-roasted vegetable platters, in a renovated machiya (2026 reviews) · the popular lotus-root pizza with pesto; beef tendon and burdock; Manganji pepper and chirimen sansho; eggplant; autumn salmon and sanma; Margherita; quattro formaggi; dessert pizza; half-and-half to share (2026 reviews) · roast vegetables such as pumpkin, Kamiyama shiitake, zucchini, eggplant and sweet potato; Jamón Serrano and Iberico; octopus terrine; caprese · lunch course of appetisers, roast vegetables, soup, pizza and dessert (October 2026) · wine, sake, cocktails · diners spend about ¥3,000–7,999
places.notes: [Pizza · Karasuma, vegetable pizza from a wood oven] The Kyoto branch of a pizzeria from Karuizawa, in a high-ceilinged, softly lit renovated townhouse. Sit at the counter in front of the wood-fired oven and watch dough stretched and slid in a metre away. Start with the platter of oven-roasted vegetables — the zucchini drips juice — then share half-and-half pizzas: the cult lotus root with pesto (no cheese), beef tendon and burdock, or Manganji pepper with chirimen sansho. Lunch at weekends, dinner Monday, Thursday and Friday; book ahead. About ¥4,000–6,000 a head.

roles: Branch of en boca; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: the Kyoto branch of a pizzeria whose main shop is in Karuizawa; a Yoyogi-Uehara branch in Tokyo has closed; set in a renovated machiya with a wood-fired oven. Tabelog Pizza "Tabelog 100" 2017–2019, 2021, 2023, 2025; opened 12 December 2010.
chef_bio.specialty: Lotus-root pizza; oven-roasted vegetables.

anecdotes.text: "Even though it was a pizza without cheese, the dough was surprisingly tasty" — September 2026, the lotus-root half.
"Right in front of me, the wood crackles and burns, and I watched as they added logs to the oven" — October 2026, at the counter.
"It is the Kyoto branch of a place that has its main store in Karuizawa." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: エンボカ 京都 (en boca Kyoto)、ピザ・野菜料理・肉料理、中京区西洞院六角下ル池須町406、烏丸駅から徒歩7分、月・木・金 17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、土・日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)、火・水休み、予約可 (当日キャンセルは3,000円)、予約なしの場合は電話を、ディナーは1ドリンク制、カウンター6席・テーブル27席、貸切20〜50名、カード・交通系 IC・PayPay 可、2010年12月12日オープン、ピザ百名店 2017〜2019・2021・2023・2025。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 軽井沢が本店、町家を改装、薪窯、蓮根のピザ、窯焼き野菜、ハーフ&ハーフ。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte or a lunch course; half-and-half pizzas to share.

places.name: 呑小路 やま岸 (Nominokoji Yamagishi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A Japanese izakaya with soy- and miso-based dishes, fried items and shumai; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi, fish and meat throughout (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: From 16:00, Mon, Tue, Thu–Sat and holidays, last food order 23:30 (Tabelog says 16:00–23:30); Sunday is listed with a last food order of 23:00 but no opening time; closed Wednesday and irregularly (Tabelog). Because Sunday has no opening time and the closing time after last order is not given, no hours are stored. Reservations accepted, by phone or online; more than an hour late counts as a cancellation (Tabelog). A course of four omakase dishes for ¥8,800, then à la carte; the menu shows no prices (October 2026). 12 seats: a counter of 10 and a table for 2 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 28 July 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Kyoto City Hall, south of Oike — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: The casual, open-kitchen izakaya of Tomikoji Yamagishi: ingredients chosen by 山岸隆博, cooked with kappo technique (official site) · start with four omakase dishes (¥8,800, October 2026), then order freely: appetiser, sashimi, a main and a vegetable dish · 2026: steamed lotus root with white miso; sea bream and tuna; Densuke anago; ikura rice; grilled Spanish mackerel with miso; white sesame tofu with figs and chestnuts; fried Matsutake; oden; mackerel sushi; shrimp mayonnaise; shumai; simmered fried tofu with Kujo negi · wide sake list and wine · diners spend about ¥10,000–19,999
places.notes: [Izakaya · City Hall, the casual side of a celebrated kappo] The open-kitchen izakaya of Kyoto's Tomikoji Yamagishi: ten counter seats where you start with four omakase dishes (¥8,800) and then order whatever you like — grilled Densuke anago, ikura rice, Spanish mackerel with miso, fried Matsutake, autumn oden, shumai. The sake list is long and the staff will scale portions for a light appetite. Many guests are from overseas. The menu shows no prices, so ask before ordering wine by the glass. About ¥10,000–19,999 with drinks; open late; closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.chef_name: 山岸隆博 (owner of the Kyoto Yamagishi group; official site; no romaji in a source)
roles: Owner of the group; selects the ingredients (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "a gourmet izakaya produced by Tomikoji Yamagishi", à la carte, with real ingredients chosen by 山岸隆博 and craftsmen's technique in an open kitchen; the group lists 富小路やま岸, 呑小路やま岸, 二条やま岸, 祇園やま岸, 焼肉やまちゃん (kyoto_yakiniku_yamachan) and 饗宴 in Kyoto, and 銀座 呑小路やま岸 and 富小路やま岸 麻布台ヒルズ in Tokyo. Tabelog: opened 28 July 2022; Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024–2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Eat what you like, as much as you like, without ceremony (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase starters; anago; oden in season.

anecdotes.text: "they adjusted the amount of oden for me and even grilled just one piece of meat" — October 2026.
"Wow, there were so many foreign customers!" — October 2026.
"This restaurant doesn’t list prices on the menu for food or drinks!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tominokoji-yamagishi.com): 呑小路やま岸、富小路やま岸が手掛ける美食の居酒屋、アラカルトで好きなものを好きなだけ、山岸隆博の目利きの素材と職人の技法、オープンキッチン、予算15,000〜19,999円、店舗一覧: 富小路やま岸、呑小路やま岸、二条やま岸、祇園やま岸、焼肉やまちゃん、饗宴、銀座 呑小路やま岸、富小路やま岸 麻布台ヒルズ。食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区下白山町293-3、京都市役所前駅から徒歩約5分、月・火・木〜土・祝 16:00〜23:30、日曜は L.O.23:00、水曜と不定休、予約可、1時間以上の遅れはキャンセル扱い、12席 (カウンター10、テーブル2)、カード可、2022年7月28日オープン、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2024〜2026。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): おまかせ4品8,800円、穴子、松茸のフライ、おでん、値段のない品書き、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Four set dishes then à la carte; no prices on the menu, so ask.

places.name: ルーデンス (LUDENS)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Italian courses with ravioli and risotto alongside medicinal soups and vegetable plates; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-rich medicinal courses, but prosciutto and meat appear (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch from 12:00 and dinner from 18:00 or 19:00, everyone starting together (official site; Tabelog); Tabelog gives Tue–Sat 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:30, closed Monday. The official site gives Sunday and Monday as closing days. A medicinal breakfast (Sat 7:00–9:00, Sun 8:00–11:00 per Tabelog; ¥2,800 in September 2026) is temporarily unavailable from 11 October 2026 (September 2026 review). Reservation only; online bookings are confirmed by phone; lunch takes about 2 hours, dinner about 2.5 (Tabelog). Chef's counter "田淵薬膳研究所": a seasonal course matched to your condition, lunch from 13:00 and dinner from 20:00 when counter seats are free (official site). Cards (Tabelog). 6 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 19 September 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 間之町通 north of Nijo, near a street once lined with herbal-medicine wholesalers — 6 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Italian-based "innovative fusion" with medicinal herbs and nourishing ingredients (official site) · a seasonal wellness course: medicinal soup, herbal soup, spiced appetisers, root vegetables, ravioli, chestnut risotto (October 2026); herbs and spices ground at the table to suit your condition (October 2026) · chef's counter 田淵薬膳研究所: a "seasonal yojo course" opening with a medicinal tea, four amuse-bouches, a vegetable plate and medicinal soup plus à la carte (official site) · wine, medicinal liqueurs and herbal drinks (official site) · spices to take home (August 2026)
places.notes: [Italian · Marutamachi, medicinal-herb Italian] On a street near Nijo once lined with herbal-medicine wholesalers, a renovated townhouse serves Italian food built around nourishing, yakuzen-style ingredients: a medicinal soup to start, a plate of vegetables, ravioli, a chestnut risotto, with herbs and spices you grind at the table to suit how you feel. At the chef's counter, 田淵薬膳研究所, chef 田淵 — a qualified practitioner of Japanese-Chinese medicinal cooking — tailors a seasonal course to the day's condition. Diners praise the detailed explanations and warm send-off. Booking only; closed Mondays (and Sundays per the official site); the popular breakfast is paused from 11 October 2026.

chef_bio.chef_name: 田淵 (surname only; official site: "和漢薬膳食医の田淵シェフ"; no romaji in a source)
roles: Chef at the 田淵薬膳研究所 counter; a 和漢薬膳食医 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the name echoes "Ristorante", from ristorare, "to restore with food and rest"; Nijo-dori to the south once thrived with herbal-medicine wholesalers, a history the restaurant carries on with medicinal cooking; Italian-based courses rich in nourishing ingredients; a mail-order medicinal hot-pot set with a soup kept going for eight years, Kyoto Ohara vegetables and Miyagi "kampo" beef. Tabelog: opened 19 September 2017; Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: A place to relieve daily fatigue and restore energy (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal medicinal course; medicinal soups.

anecdotes.text: "According to the seasonal changes and my health, I was able to grind various medicinal herbs and spices (Chinese medicinal ingredients) that were blended into the dish." — October 2026.
"I also appreciated being able to take home the spices used in the dishes to enjoy at home." — August 2026.
"*Please note that breakfast will be temporarily unavailable from October 11, 2026." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ludens-kyoto.net): 薬膳イタリアン LUDENS、心と身体が喜ぶ素材を活かしたイノベーティブ・フュージョン、Ristorante の語源 Ristorare は「食事や休養で元気を回復させる」、南の二条通はかつて薬種問屋で栄えた街、イタリア料理をベースに滋養のある食材のコース、シェフズカウンター「田淵薬膳研究所」では和漢薬膳食医の田淵シェフが体調に合わせた「季節の養生コース」、ランチ13時〜・ディナー20時〜 (カウンターに空きがある場合)、薬膳茶から、アミューズ4種と野菜プレートと薬膳スープ、薬酒やハーブのドリンク、お取り寄せの養生鍋セット、昼12:00一斉スタート、夜18:00・19:00一斉スタート、日曜・月曜定休。食べログ: イタリアン・イノベーティブ、中京区間之町通二条上ル夷町560-8、丸太町駅から徒歩6分、予約のみ、昼は約2時間・夜は約2.5時間、2017年9月19日オープン、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 薬膳イタリアン、その場で挽くスパイス、薬膳の朝食は2026年10月11日から休止、丁寧な説明と見送り。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses explained dish by dish; book ahead.

places.name: フランソア喫茶室 (Salon de thé FRANCOIS)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Cakes and tarts (rare cheesecake, pear and lemon tarts) and pudding; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and tea suit; the cakes and pudding use dairy and eggs, and coffee comes with fresh cream unless you say otherwise (October 2026).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:30), every day except 31 December to 2 January (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); weekend afternoons often have a queue, weekdays and late morning are easier (October 2026). 80 seats at tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children not allowed (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). In a lane south of Shijo-Kobashi on Nishi-Kiyamachi, 1 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi, a lane just south of Shijo-Kobashi — 1 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: A 1934 salon-style kissaten for coffee, tea and cakes (official site) · cake set ¥1,450: house rare cheesecake with blueberry sauce, pear tart, lemon tart (October 2026; Tabelog shop text) · special pudding with dried orange, pudding set ¥1,600 · coffee served with fresh cream; tea, including a "whiskey tea" and tea with a splash of brandy for aroma (October 2026) · diners spend about ¥1,000–1,999
places.notes: [Kissaten · Kawaramachi, the 1934 salon of free speech] Opened in 1934 down a lane off Shijo-Kobashi and designed by young artist friends of founder 立野正一, this European salon of stained glass, a white domed ceiling and red velvet chairs was meant as a place to talk about peace and art as wartime speech closed in; reviewers note it is a registered cultural property. Order the cake set — the house rare cheesecake with blueberry sauce, with coffee and fresh cream — or the special pudding. Open late, to 22:00, which suits a night after Minamiza. Cash only; no children; weekend queues.

roles: Historic café founded by 立野正一 (official site); present staff not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (quoting エキゾチック京都, 淡交社, 左方郁子): opened in Showa 9 (1934) in a lane just south of Shijo-Kobashi; designed by 立野正一, 高木四郎 and the Italian ベンチベニ, young artist friends; stained-glass windows, an elegant white ceiling, red velvet chairs and a copy of the Mona Lisa; the owner meant it as a place to discuss anti-war and avant-garde art as free speech became hard, and the anti-fascist tabloid 「土曜日」 (1936–1937) could always be found there. An October 2026 review calls it a nationally registered tangible cultural property. Tabelog Kissaten "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: A cultural, free oasis where anyone could talk about peace and art (official site; October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Rare cheesecake; special pudding.

anecdotes.text: "This place was once an oasis where people could freely discuss art, literature, and peace during a time when freedom of speech was restricted." — October 2026.
"Most nearby cafes were closed, but this place is open until 10 PM!" — October 2026, after kabuki at Minami-za.
"When ordering coffee, I was asked if I needed milk, and upon confirming, I received coffee that already had milk added." — October 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask when booking: courses only, and the restaurant asks for dislikes in advance (Tabelog). The signature white-miso zoni is made without dashi (official site); other dishes use soy and miso.

places.cuisine: Classic Kyoto ryori, kaiseki courses with house dishes handed down from father to son (official site) · signatures: guji salted overnight, sprinkled with sake and grilled, then finished with hot water poured over the bones as a soup; white-miso zoni made with water and no dashi, with a grilled round mochi and thin mustard (official site) · 2026 courses: hishi crab with ikura and yam; sashimi of shrimp, sea bream and octopus; scooped tofu with hamo-bone crackers; summer courses with hamo, ayu, sea urchin and hairy crab · the house sake 「Aoko」 (as written in reviews) brewed for Nakamura · diners report ¥20,000–29,999 at lunch and ¥40,000–49,999 at dinner
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Oike, two hundred years of Kyoto ryori] Behind a white noren on Tomikoji-dori, a house that began in 1827 when the first master carried Wakasa fish along the 鯖街道 (the mackerel road) to the palace and court nobles. Sixth-generation 中村元計 (Motokazu Nakamura) — once a Zen trainee at 天龍寺 and now a doctor of food science — keeps the two dishes passed from father to son: sake-grilled guji, finished as a soup with hot water over the bones, and a white-miso zoni made without dashi. Courses are served in quiet private rooms over a courtyard; reviewers note three Michelin stars. Lunch around ¥20,000–30,000, dinner ¥40,000–50,000; book ahead; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.chef_name: Motokazu Nakamura (中村元計; official site, sixth-generation master, with the romaji Motokazu Nakamura)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in Bunsei 10 (1827) when the first master, 若狭屋清兵衛, carried Wakasa fish such as guji and mackerel to Kyoto for the palace and court nobles; the second generation began catering; the third, a tea devotee, made tea kaiseki catering the core; the fourth supplied the inns 柊家, 俵屋 and 炭家 during the war; after the war the restaurant opened on its present site, and the fifth generation built today's base. The sixth, 中村元計, studied at Tokyo University of Fisheries, trained as a Zen monk at 天龍寺 in 嵯峨嵐山, and in 2021 earned a doctorate in food and agricultural science at 龍谷大学, approaching cooking as science. Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2023; Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021. 2026 reviews call it Michelin three-starred.
chef_bio.philosophy: 「即味心也」 — taste is the heart: only a person's heart moves another's (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sake-grilled guji; white-miso zoni.

anecdotes.text: "This restaurant has been awarded three Michelin stars for six consecutive years." — October 2026.
"The white miso zoni (soup) was surprising; I learned that it didn’t use any dashi, yet it was incredibly tasty." — January 2026.
"Due to its adherence to tradition, I felt that this course, at this price point, lacked the surprises" — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoryori-nakamura.com): 一子相伝 なかむら、「即味心也」、中京区富小路御池下ル136、6代目主人 中村元計、創業は文政十年 (1827年)、初代若狭屋清兵衛が若狭物を鯖街道で運び御所や公卿衆に供した、二代目から仕出しと出張料理、三代目中村庄三郎の茶懐石、四代目中村正蔵は戦中に柊家・俵屋・炭家に仕出し、戦後に京料理「なかむら」を設立、当代は東京水産大学卒業、天龍寺僧堂で修行、2021年に龍谷大学で博士 (食農科学)、名物は一晩寝かせて酒をふって焼くぐじの酒焼きと、出汁を使わず白味噌を水だけで練る雑煮。食べログ: 日本料理、昼12:00〜14:00、夜17:00〜19:30最終入店、日曜休み (10名以上は予約で営業)、67席、個室あり、カード可、The Tabelog Award Bronze 2017〜2023、日本料理 WEST 百名店 2021。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): ミシュラン三つ星、ぐじの酒焼き、白味噌の雑煮、店の日本酒、伝統に忠実で驚きは少ないという声も。

Here they taste of the fruit or tea they are named for: La France pear, mandarin, melon, rich matcha, black sesame and buckwheat, with seasonal flavours that sell out by afternoon. Small bags from ¥750 make light, long-keeping gifts. Takeaway only; come early; closed Wednesdays.

places.notes: [French · Gion, a Ducasse alumnus on Kyoto's south side] Chef Yosuke Yamaji — Hotel Okura, the Institut Paul Bocuse in Lyon, then Alain Ducasse au Plaza Athénée in Paris — cooks creative French with Kyoto seasons and produce from the family farm, in an eighteen-seat room with a counter, four tables and a small courtyard. Sommelier-manager Maeda leads warm service, and the team sees guests off at the door. Lunch from ¥6,800 is a good-value entry; dinner from ¥12,000. 2026 opinions vary: most praise the sauces and presentation, a few found it salty or slow. Closed Wednesdays.

places.cuisine: Italian technique with Japanese seasonal ingredients — "fudo" means climate — with Japanese wines (2026 reviews) · signatures: foie gras marinated in Saikyo miso with fresh yatsuhashi; pasta in sea-bream broth with plenty of karasumi; sweetfish risotto with three whole confit ayu; chicken white-liver with spiced baguette; steak with a condiment-rich broth; figs fried with lots of pepper; eel and chili pasta; spencer roll (September–October 2026) · aromatic non-alcohol drinks; Japanese wine pairings · diners spend about ¥8,000–14,999
places.notes: [Italian · City Hall, Kyoto ingredients in a late-night basement] Down a narrow stair off Oike-dori, a lively counter-and-table room where Italian technique meets Kyoto produce and Japanese wines: foie gras with Saikyo miso folded into fresh yatsuhashi, pasta in sea-bream broth under shaved karasumi, a risotto into which you break three confit ayu. Diners call it fun, creative and good value at around ¥10,000, and it serves until late — midnight on Fridays and Saturdays. Book about a month ahead for weekdays; closed Tuesdays.

places.notes: [Pizza · Karasuma-Oike, the neighbourhood Neapolitan] A plain, office-like front on Anekoji-dori hides a lively pizzeria where pizzaioli work a wood-fired oven behind a high counter. The crust is the star — crisp at the edge, chewy within, good to the last bite even cold — under classics like Margherita and funghi with Parmigiano grated at the table, or a fiery house salami. Spoon on the spicy basil oil. Antipasti like ham with tuna sauce are worth extra bread. Pizzas ¥1,900–2,500; lunch is easier than dinner. Closed Thursdays.

places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a quiet room over a rain-washed garden] A Gion kaiseki house since 1988, where private tatami rooms shut out the city and the only sound may be rain in the garden. An April 2026 diner notes two Michelin stars. Courses run about ¥50,000–76,000 plus 15% service; book ahead; closed Wednesdays.

places.notes: [Kaiseki · Nijo Castle, a six-seat charcoal counter] Behind a modest sign near Nijo Castle, a counter of six where the owner-chef — trained at Yukimura, Wakuden and Gion Okada, per a November 2025 review — cooks alone over charcoal, letting the fish take its time. Dishes lean on dashi and the grill, and the meal ends with a takikomi rice diners remember. It can feel like being invited into someone's home. Omakase from ¥20,000 plus 10% service; one June 2026 diner found the drinks pricey. Book by phone or via Instagram.

places.notes: [Kissaten · Teramachi, Kyoto's pancake kissaten since 1932] A wood-panelled, high-ceilinged coffee house in the Teramachi arcade, said to date from 1932, where the queue forms for the pancakes — crisp outside, soft inside, with butter and maple syrup — and the French toast. The mixed sandwich and the firm, caramel-topped pudding are just as loved, and the coffee is rich and balanced; beans are sold to take home. Upstairs, a western-style lunch room keeps shorter hours. Pancake set ¥1,400; weekday afternoons have the shortest waits. Open daily 8:00–19:00; AMEX only.

chef_bio.specialty: Pancakes; French toast; mixed sandwich.

anecdotes.text: "The pancakes, slathered with butter and drenched in maple syrup, brought me to tears." — October 2026.
"I arrived before 10 AM and there were already about seven groups in line." — October 2026.
"It’s rare to be moved by a sandwich, but this one truly impressed me." — October 2026.

places.name: ワルダー (Warder)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery of hard breads, danishes, croissants and filled breads (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Many breads use butter, cheese, cream or meat; the Kyoto dashi bread uses fish stock; plain hard breads may suit (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 9:00–19:00, Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun; closed Wednesday and Thursday (Tabelog). Takeaway only, no seats (Tabelog). Fresh bread keeps coming out through the morning; busy at weekends (October 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards, iD and QUICPay (Tabelog). On Fuyacho-dori south of Rokkaku, by a small park; 8 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 5 February 2007 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho-dori south of Rokkaku, opposite a small park — 8 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small bakery packed with hard breads, danishes and filled breads under handwritten signs (2026 reviews) · examples: Kyoto dashi bread with iriko and katsuobushi (two per person); baked curry bread with curry from the Osaka shop Navin; Shiba-zuke French bread; garlic French; squid-ink bread; pistachio an-butter sandwich; cheese pretzel ¥270; banana-caramel bread ¥370; chestnut pie and chestnut danish; tea croissant with almond and apple; sausage focaccia; canelé; sliced loaf (September–November 2026)
places.notes: [Bakery · Fuyacho, the busy little bread shop] A small bakery by a little park on Fuyacho-dori, its wooden shelves crowded with handwritten labels and more bread arriving from the oven all morning: a Kyoto dashi bread that tastes of iriko and bonito (two per customer), a baked curry bread with curry from Osaka's Navin, Shiba-zuke French, squid-ink bread, and autumn chestnut pies and danishes. Prices are modest, from about ¥270. Takeaway only; cards and IC accepted; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Bakery staff; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Tabelog: bread and sandwiches, opened 5 February 2007; takeaway only; Bread "Tabelog 100" 2017, 2018 and Bread WEST 2020, 2022, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto dashi bread; danishes; hard breads.

anecdotes.text: "I tried the Dashi Bread after getting home, and from the very first bite, I could taste the flavors of iriko (dried sardines) and katsuobushi (dried bonito flakes)." — October 2026.
"As soon as I entered just before noon, fresh bread started coming out one after another" — October 2026.
"It uses a medium-spicy curry from the famous Osaka curry shop, Navin" — September 2026.

places.name: 喫茶 マドラグ (Kissa Madrague)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the menu is toast, sandwiches, spaghetti and curry; the famous egg sandwich comes on thick bread with demi-glace and mustard (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Food centres on eggs, ham, meat sauce and cheese, and the omelette is made with dashi; juices, tea and black coffee suit (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 8:00–18:00 every day; last food order 17:00, drinks 17:30; closes early when food runs out; closed irregularly, with notices on Facebook (official site). Seats can be booked at the shop or by phone for 8:00 or 9:30 (morning) or 12:00 (lunch) (official site); lunch seats rotate hourly and walk-ins are possible, but booking is safer (Tabelog). Breakfast until 11:00 (October 2026). Only the Corona sandwich is sold to take away, ordered by phone two days ahead (official site). 18 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 9 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: West of Karasuma, north of Oike — 9 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Retro kissaten that carries on two closed Kyoto shops: the coffee house Kissa Seven (the building) and the western-style restaurant Corona (its egg sandwich) (official site) · Corona egg sandwich: a thick, hot dashi omelette on bread spread with demi-glace and mustard, ¥1,180 · Set A breakfast with two pieces of it, salad, prosciutto, soup, yogurt and a drink ¥1,800 (November 2026) · thick toast, pizza toast, iron-plate Napolitan ¥1,100, pork curry rice ¥990, carbonara · blend coffee ¥600, Monte Carlo (Vienna-style coffee) ¥600, banana juice, cream soda; beer, highball, whisky, Calvados (official menu)
places.notes: [Kissaten · Karasuma Oike, the Corona egg sandwich] A retro coffee house in a building that was Kissa Seven for about 50 years from 1963; after its master died in 2011, the son looked for someone to keep the shop going, and Madrague opened that September. About a year later the free paper 音読 asked the shop to carry on the famous egg sandwich of Corona, a western-style restaurant that had just closed, and Corona's master came to teach it in person. The result is a fist-sized, hot, dashi-soft omelette on bread with demi-glace and mustard (¥1,180) — cut it in half to eat. Breakfast sets until 11:00; book a seat for 8:00, 9:30 or 12:00. Open daily 8:00–18:00 (irregular closures); cash only.

roles: Owner (unnamed on the official site), who opened the shop with the owner’s wife
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: before opening, the owner managed a café tied to the revival of Kyoto townhouses and old shopping streets and wanted to get back to hands-on work; while looking for a property with the owner’s wife, the couple met the son of the master of Kissa Seven (in business from 1963 for about 50 years; the master died in 2011) and opened Kissa Madrague there in September 2011. The name is that of Brigitte Bardot’s villa in Saint-Tropez; the owner’s wife loved the actress. The owner once worked part-time at Francois, near Corona, and often ate Corona’s egg sandwich on breaks. The site also describes a team, 京都喫茶文化遺産, formed to take over and keep old neighbourhood kissaten. Tabelog Kissaten "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to keep "the long-running neighbourhood kissaten with tradition", not a retro-styled café, and hand it on to the next generation.
chef_bio.specialty: Corona egg sandwich; Set A breakfast.

anecdotes.text: Per the official site: after customers said the old Corona sandwich had been softer or bigger, the owner reworked the bread, eggs, seasoning, cooking time and heat, the hand pressure when sandwiching and the cut, keeping the basics.
"The egg sandwich is so big that I couldn’t fit it in my mouth in one bite, so I had to cut it in half with a knife." — October 2026.
"It seems there used to be long lines, but now you can easily make a reservation by phone." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (madrague.info): 喫茶 la madrague、8:00〜18:00 (ラストオーダー 食事17:00・ドリンク17:30)、食材がなくなり次第終了、予約は店頭または電話で 8:00・9:30 (モーニング)・12:00 (ランチ)、不定休、コロナサンドのみテイクアウト可 (2日前までに電話予約)、メニュー: コロナの玉子サンドイッチ1,180円、鉄板ナポリタン1,100円、トロトロポークカレーライス990円、ブレンドコーヒー600円、モンテカルロ600円など。開店のいきさつ: 店名はブリジットバルドーの南フランスのサン-トロペの別荘の名、以前は昭和38年から約50年続いた喫茶セブン、2011年にマスターが他界、息子さんとの縁で同年9月に開店、約1年後にフリーペーパー「音読」から閉店した洋食店コロナの玉子サンドイッチを継いでほしいとの話、喫茶フランソアでのアルバイト時代、コロナのマスターから直接レクチャー、京都喫茶文化遺産チーム。食べログ: 喫茶店・サンドイッチ・洋食、中京区上松屋町706-5、毎日8:00〜18:00、予約可、18席、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、2011年9月1日オープン、喫茶店百名店 2021・2022・2026。口コミ (2026年10〜11月、英語): Aセット1,800円、コロナの玉子サンド、モンテカルロ、予約で入店。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a slot by phone or at the door; cash only.
