places.name: マリベル 京都本店 (MarieBelle Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The shop sells chocolates (art ganache, Carré de Chocolat) alongside cookies and sablés; the café adds crepes, cheesecake, quiche and gelato; no ingredient list is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Many chocolates and the gelato, crepes and cakes use milk, cream or eggs; a 70% dark chocolate is sold but its ingredients are not published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Shop 11:00–19:00; Cacao Bar (café) 11:00–19:00, last order 18:00; takeaway 11:00–19:00; closed Tuesday; holiday calendar on the official site (official site). Tabelog instead lists Tuesday 11:00–18:00, but the official site and an October 2026 review both give Tuesday as closed. Café seats cannot be booked: sign in at the entrance and wait in turn; one order per person (official site; October 2026). The upstairs room can be hired for meetings (official site). 20 seats; non-smoking; cards and QR payments (Tabelog). In an alley entrance on Yanagibaba-dori south of Sanjo; 6 min from Karasuma Oike Stn, 5 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yanagibaba-dori south of Sanjo — 6 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto main shop of the New York chocolatier MarieBelle, in a townhouse with an antique-furnished café, the Cacao Bar (official site; 2026 reviews) · art ganache printed with artists’ designs, sold in the blue box (two pieces ¥1,900); Carré de Chocolat squares (8 pieces ¥2,500); sablés and cookies · café: hot chocolate, chocolate crepe ¥1,430, gelato two flavours ¥1,430, autumn chestnut-and-kadaif chocolate crepe ¥2,500, New York cheesecake, quiche, seasonal tasting set (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Chocolate & café · Sanjo, New York chocolates in a Kyoto townhouse] The Kyoto main shop of MarieBelle, the chocolatier born in New York's SoHo, reached through a narrow alley off Yanagibaba-dori: an antique-furnished townhouse where the art ganache — each piece printed with an artist's design — comes in the brand's blue boxes, and the Cacao Bar serves hot chocolate, crepes, gelato and cheesecake on sofas. Two ganache pieces ¥1,900; café sweets from about ¥1,430. No café bookings; sign in at the door. 11:00–19:00, closed Tuesday.

roles: Brand of chocolatier Maribel Lieberman (New York); no Kyoto staff are named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: MarieBelle was born in New York’s SoHo (484 Broome St.); the Japanese company MarieBelle Japan runs the Kyoto honten, MarieBelle the Lounge in Daimaru Shinsaibashi (Osaka) and, from 28 October 2026, マリベル渋谷 in Shibuya Scramble Square; cacao is chosen from producing countries, mainly beans grown with support for farms in Honduras, the homeland of Maribel Lieberman; the designs are all paintings made by artists. The Kyoto honten opened on 24 April 2012 (Tabelog) and marked its 14th anniversary in April 2026 (official site). Tabelog Sweets "Tabelog 100" 2018 and Sweets WEST 2018–2020, 2022.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site (in English): "Life is all about the pleasure and happiness we find in food, art and beauty" — Maribel Lieberman, Chocolatier.
chef_bio.specialty: Art ganache; Carré de Chocolat; hot chocolate.

anecdotes.text: "The service was top-notch, and even though I only bought a small amount, I was treated with great care" — September 2026.
"The entrance is tucked away in a narrow alley, typical of Kyoto." — November 2026.
"In the fall, you can savor the Chestnut Kadaif Chocolate Crepe." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (mariebelle.jp): ニューヨーク・SoHo 生まれのチョコレートブランド、京都本店 (中京区槌屋町83番地)、SHOP 11:00〜19:00、Cacao Bar 11:00〜19:00 (L.O 18:00)、火曜定休、カフェの席は予約不可で入り口で受付、2階は貸し切り可、大阪・大丸心斎橋の MarieBelle the Lounge、2026年10月28日マリベル渋谷オープン、祖国ホンデュラスの農園を支援したカカオ豆、デザインはすべてアーティストの絵画、京都本店14周年 (2026年4月)、運営は MarieBelle Japan。食べログ: チョコレート・ジェラート・カフェ、20席、予約不可、カード・QR 可、2012年4月24日オープン、スイーツ百名店 2018、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018〜2020・2022。口コミ (2026年9〜11月、英語): アートガナッシュ、Carré de Chocolat、ホットチョコレート、チョコレートクレープ、ジェラート、栗のクレープ、細い路地の入口。

cultural_comfort.note: Shop counter downstairs; sign in at the entrance for the café; cards accepted.

places.name: 赤垣屋 (Akagakiya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A traditional izakaya: duck with a soy-based sauce, oden in broth (with fish cakes), tempura and sashimi with soy sauce; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in broth, duck, fish and yakitori make up most of the menu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30), Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday and on Mondays that are public holidays (Tabelog). A queue forms from about 16:30; the owner hangs the noren at 17:00 and the first round is seated in arrival order (October–November 2026). Table seats can be booked, for 17:00 or 19:00 starts; the 11 counter seats are walk-in only (Tabelog; November 2026); same-day booking is hard (September 2026). Two-hour limit (October 2026). Menu without prices; bills around ¥4,000–6,000 a head (2026 reviews). 41 seats (11 counter, 30 on tatami); smoking allowed; cash only (Tabelog). 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawabata Nijo by the Kamo River — 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: One of Kyoto’s oldest izakaya, founded in 1934 and on this site since 1949 (an October 2026 review) · duck loin roast with a sweet soy-based sauce and mustard (ordered by almost every table) · shime saba with onion and herbs · kumiage yuba with plum-wasabi · Kyoto-style oden: octopus (order early), rolled cabbage, daikon, egg, atsuage · simmered small taro with yuzu · grilled eel with wasabi soy or ponzu · sesame tofu, tempura, yakitori · hot sake, shochu, beer (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kawabata Nijo, a 1930s tavern by the Kamo River] An old izakaya beside the Kamo River, with lantern light, a counter worn smooth and darkened beams; a reviewer gives its founding as 1934 and the move here as 1949. The line forms from 16:30 and the owner hangs the noren at 17:00. Almost every table orders the duck roast; the shime saba, kumiage yuba and Kyoto-style oden (the octopus takes time — order it early) are the other classics. The menu shows no prices, yet bills run around ¥4,000–6,000. Book a table for 17:00 or 19:00; the 11 counter seats are first come. Cash only; smoking allowed; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: founded in 1934 (Showa 9) and moved to the present site in 1949 (Showa 24), once a tavern for students and day labourers; reviews disagree on whether the present owner is the third or fourth generation (October 2026). Tabelog Izakaya "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022 and Izakaya WEST 2024, 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Duck roast; shime saba; oden.

anecdotes.text: "Soon, the quiet owner appears and hangs the noren (curtain)." — October 2026.
An October 2026 reviewer noted a tension created by the owner and the staff that some first-time visitors might find intimidating, while calling it part of the shop’s long-held traditions.
"When I went to the restroom, they quickly offered me slippers. Such thoughtful service!" — November 2026.
"The oden was served with an old wooden ladle that looked like it had been used for ages" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、左京区孫橋町9、三条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、日曜と祝日の月曜休み、予約可 (カウンターは予約不可)、41席 (カウンター11、小上がり30)、個室2、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、居酒屋百名店 2021・2022、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2024・2025。口コミ (2026年9〜11月、英語): 1934年創業、1949年に現在地へ、鴨ロース、しめ鯖、汲み上げ湯葉、おでん (たこ、ロールキャベツ)、里芋の煮物、うなぎ、値段のないお品書き、開店前の行列、主人が暖簾を掛ける、テーブルは17時と19時の予約。

places.name: ZEN CAFE (Kagizen Yoshifusa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kuzumochi and kuzukiri are made from kudzu starch, and the seasonal wagashi vary; the fruit sandwiches use bread; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Kudzu sweets, zenzai and seasonal wagashi are based on starch, beans, sugar and chestnut, but no ingredient list is published; the fruit sandwiches use cream (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00, Tuesday to Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog): take a number at the ticket machine; a queue can form before 11:00 and at busy times (September–October 2026). The fruit sandwiches can sell out by about 11:45 (September 2026). Payment is asked for 30 minutes before closing (October 2026). 16 seats (10 at tables, 6 at the counter); non-smoking; cards and QR payments (Tabelog). In a Gion back street opposite the ZENBI museum; 158 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 8 November 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion back street south of Shijo, opposite the ZENBI museum — 158 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Café of the old wagashi house Kagizen Yoshifusa (Tabelog; 2026 reviews): Kagizen’s wagashi with tea, coffee, fresh juices and sparkling water · kuzumochi ¥1,200 (also as a set with a drink) · kuzukiri with black syrup ¥1,200 · zenzai ¥1,200 · seasonal jo-namagashi ¥1,000, e.g. chestnut kinton in autumn, with sencha or green tea · seasonal fruit sandwiches (chestnut, fig) · persimmon juice in autumn (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Wagashi café · Gion, Kagizen's quiet café] The café that the old Gion wagashi house Kagizen Yoshifusa opened in 2012 down a back street opposite its ZENBI museum: dim, modern and calm, with a counter and a sofa. Order kuzumochi (¥1,200), the shop's kuzukiri with black syrup, or the seasonal jo-namagashi — chestnut kinton in autumn — with sencha, or come early for the fruit sandwiches, which can be gone before noon. Take a number at the machine; no bookings. One October 2026 visitor found the prices high for Gion and was asked to pay 30 minutes before closing. 11:00–18:00, closed Monday.

roles: Café of Kagizen Yoshifusa; no person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per the Kagizen official site (read for batch 15): the company also runs ZEN CAFE and the ZENBI art museum. Per a 2026 review, a café opened in 2012 by Kagizen Yoshifusa, in business since the Kyōhō era, with modern ceramics by contemporary artists; opened 8 November 2012 (Tabelog). Tabelog Cafe "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022, Cafe WEST 2025 and Sweets WEST 2019, 2020.
chef_bio.specialty: Kuzumochi; seasonal jo-namagashi; fruit sandwiches.

anecdotes.text: "The kuzumochi was so delicious that I could eat it on its own" — February 2026.
"Be careful, as the fruit sandwiches seemed to sell out by 11:45." — September 2026.
An October 2026 visitor called the prices "Gion pricing" and objected to being asked to pay 30 minutes before closing, which felt rushed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・甘味処・和菓子、東山区祇園町南側570-210、祇園四条駅から158m、火〜日 11:00〜18:00、月曜休み、予約不可、16席 (テーブル10、カウンター6)、禁煙、カード・QR 可、2012年11月8日オープン、お茶、コーヒー、フレッシュジュース、炭酸水と和菓子、カフェ百名店 2021・2022、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2019・2020。鍵善良房公式サイト (第15バッチで確認): ZEN CAFE と ZENBI も運営。口コミ (2026年2〜10月、英語): くずもち1,200円、くずきり1,200円、ぜんざい1,200円、上生菓子1,000円、栗きんとん、フルーツサンド (11時45分ごろ売り切れ)、柿のジュース、発券機、閉店30分前の会計、ZENBI の向かい。

places.name: イグレック (Ygrec)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Three curries (vegetable, beef, small shrimp) in a smooth European-style sauce; some of the vegetables come deep-fried; no ingredient or gluten information is published (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The vegetable curry carries about ten kinds of vegetables, but what goes into the curry sauce is not published (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday to Sunday 11:30–14:00 and 16:30–23:00; closed Monday, but open on Mondays that are public holidays (Tabelog; a July 2026 review gives the same hours). No reservations (Tabelog; July 2026). 12 seats at the counter and tables; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Second floor, up an outside staircase (October 2024). 2 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu) (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi just north of Shijo, by the river — 2 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: European-style curry with three choices — vegetable, beef and small shrimp — plus a few soups and appetisers (July 2026) · vegetable curry ¥1,400 (August 2026): about ten kinds of seasonal vegetables, raw, pickled, grilled, steamed and deep-fried, over the sauce (2024–2026 reviews) · small shrimp curry ¥1,400 and homemade seasonal soup (corn) ¥600 (July 2026) · pickled cabbage and diced raw yam on the side (April 2025) · wine, with a sommelier on hand (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Curry · Shijo Kiyamachi, a couple's upstairs curry room] A retro curry shop up an outside staircase on the second floor of an old building by the river, run by a couple, with big windows. There are three curries — vegetable, beef and small shrimp — in a smooth, mild European-style sauce whose spice comes through late; the vegetable curry (¥1,400) is the one to order, heaped with about ten kinds of seasonal vegetables cooked several ways. Not fast, but the water is refilled and you are seen off warmly. No reservations; 11:30–14:00 and 16:30–23:00, closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviews from 2024 to 2026 describe the shop as run by a couple; an October 2024 review calls the owners an elderly couple. A December 2024 review says the curry is "prepared by a French chef". A February 2025 review notes a signed photo of the composer Katsuo Ohno, received by the owner, on display. An April 2025 review describes the building as one with tree roots growing out of it.
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable curry.

anecdotes.text: "The owners are an elderly couple, so you shouldn’t expect a fast service; however, they kindly refill your water and offer warm farewells as you leave" — October 2024.
"It had been about two years since my last visit. I was glad to see the owner couple looking well." — August 2026.
"As I passed by the mysterious building with tree roots protruding from it, I was drawn in by the enticing aroma of curry." — April 2025.
"I also enjoyed chatting with the owner, making it a great recommendation for solo lunches too!" — July 2026.

places.name: 高瀬川 槇 (Takasegawa Maki)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the sea bream is eaten with the house-made dashi soy sauce (soy sauce is normally brewed with wheat), and the miso soup is made with Ehime barley miso (official site; Tabelog shop text; July 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the menu is built on raw sea bream, dashi and egg yolk; the courses add fish, abalone and shellfish (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00, until the sea bream runs out; dinner 18:00–21:00; closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Courses, lunch or dinner, must be booked by 18:00 two days before (official site); the lunch course allows 1 hour 30 minutes (official site). Tabelog says reservations are taken for groups of 10 or more, yet also sets rules for lunch bookings, and 2026 reviewers booked lunch for one or two; a May 2026 weekday walk-in was seated at once. Over 10 minutes late and the table may go to those waiting (Tabelog). 14 seats (4 counter, 10 table); non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted, no e-money or QR; children welcome (Tabelog). The restroom is outside (July 2026). 3 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn, 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Back street on the Takase River south of Shijo — 3 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Uwajima-style tai-meshi from Ehime, made by a couple from Uwajima (official site): raw sea bream sashimi over rice with the house dashi soy sauce and an egg yolk, rather than rice cooked with the fish · lunch gozen: tai-meshi gozen ¥2,200, double sea bream ¥2,860, triple ¥3,520, with salmon roe ¥2,860, with sea urchin ¥3,000, sea urchin and salmon roe ¥3,660, with grated yam ¥2,530; the same as a jubako box from ¥2,200 (official site) · the gozen comes with simmered greens and white miso soup (August 2026) · lunch tai-meshi course in a clay pot ¥6,600 (6 dishes); abalone clay-pot rice and abalone ramen course ¥8,800 (Tabelog); dinner course ¥16,500 (official site) · rice from Kumakogen, Ehime, grown with reduced pesticides at 800 m; Shimanto River water for all cooking; barley miso (official site) · the okami’s brother’s mikan juice from Uwajima, ¥715 (July 2026), also as a chuhai; draft beer and sake (official site; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Tai-meshi · Kawaramachi, Uwajima's sea bream rice by the Takase River] A townhouse restaurant down a back street on the Takase River, past a small inner garden, where a couple from Uwajima in Ehime serve their home town's tai-meshi: thin slices of raw sea bream in the house dashi soy sauce, eaten first as sashimi, then over rice, then with an egg yolk on top. Lunch gozen from ¥2,200 (double sea bream ¥2,860), served until the fish runs out; the mikan juice is pressed from the okami's brother's Uwajima orchard. Courses (¥6,600 lunch, ¥16,500 dinner) need booking two days ahead. One August 2026 reviewer found the taste simple, like a basic egg over rice.

roles: Chef (the shop’s Tabelog text: "Enjoy the culinary world crafted by Chef Makino")
chef_bio.origin: Uwajima, Ehime (Tabelog shop text: "Tai Meshi from Uwajima, made by a chef from Uwajima"; official site: a couple from Uwajima runs the shop)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "宇和島出身の夫婦が手掛ける" (run by a couple from Uwajima); the mikan juice is made only for Maki by the okami’s brother in Uwajima; the group has three shops in Kyoto (高瀬川 槇, 鯛めし槇 金閣寺店, 京都寺町 鯛めし槇) and one in Ehime (鯛めし槇 松山店); TV appearances include Kansai TV "よーいドン！" (June 2023) for this shop. The shop’s Tabelog text: a building with the feel of the Edo period and an inner garden, low-pesticide ingredients and few additives, Uwajima’s local cooking combined with past experience. Opened 23 June 2019 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the shop’s Tabelog text: "food" is made of "people" and "goodness", so the kitchen aims for dishes that are kind to the body.
chef_bio.specialty: Uwajima tai-meshi; tai-meshi courses with clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "Upon entering and taking my seat, the owner greeted me by name, which was a lovely touch." The reviewer’s wife does not eat squid, and the course dish was changed to taro at the last minute. — November 2026.

"The sea bream is served until it runs out, so if you definitely want to try it, I recommend arriving early." The same reviewer found the flavour "quite simple, resembling a basic egg over rice". — August 2026.
"This rich mikan juice is freshly squeezed from the mikan orchard of the owner's brother in Uwajima City, Ehime Prefecture, and is not available for sale anywhere else." — July 2026.
"You can also add more for an extra JPY 660, so you can place an additional order during your meal." — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (taimeshi-maki.com): 宇和島出身の夫婦が手掛ける「本場の宇和島鯛めし」、生の鯛のお刺身に自家製だし醤油と卵黄で食べる「真鯛の入った贅沢な玉子かけご飯」、来島海峡の真鯛 (2キロ前後、神経締め、産地は変わる場合あり)、カウンター4席・テーブル10席、昼の鯛めしコース6,600円 (全6品、1時間30分まで)、鯛めし御膳2,200円・倍盛2,860円・3倍盛3,520円・いくら2,860円・雲丹3,000円・雲丹いくら3,660円・とろろ2,530円、鯛めし重2,200円〜、夜の16,500円コース、愛媛県久万高原町産の減農薬米、土鍋、四万十川天然水、麦みそ、女将の兄 (愛媛県宇和島市) が槇の為だけに作る「兄貴のこだわりみかんジュース」(酎ハイも)、昼11:30〜14:00 (鯛が無くなり次第終了)・夜18:00〜、コースは2日前の18時までの予約制、不定休、系列店: 鯛めし槇 金閣寺店、鯛めし槇 松山店、京都寺町 鯛めし槇。食べログ: 日本料理・海鮮・海鮮丼、下京区市之町240-2、毎日11:30〜14:00・18:00〜21:00、不定休、予約は10名以上 (ランチ予約の注意書きあり)、14席、カード可、禁煙、子供可、サービス料なし、2019年6月23日オープン、Chef Makino。口コミ (2026年3〜11月、英語): 鯛めし御膳、刺身・だし茶漬け・卵黄の3通りの食べ方、みかんジュース715円、外のトイレ、名前で迎えてくれた、イカを里芋に替えてくれた。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain how to eat the tai-meshi; book courses two days ahead; cards accepted.

places.name: 日本料理 とくを (Japanese cuisine Tokuo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase courses of sashimi, dashi soups, soft-shelled turtle chawanmushi, Saikyo-miso grilled fish, tempura and breadcrumbed fries, with soy- and miso-based seasonings throughout; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses are built on fish, dashi, soft-shelled turtle and wagyu (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (last entry 12:30), Wednesday to Saturday; dinner 18:00–22:00 (last entry 20:00), Tuesday to Saturday; no lunch on Tuesday; closed Sunday and Monday (official site; Tabelog). Lunch must be booked by the day before; for dinner, same-day calls are welcome as seats are sometimes free, and solo diners are welcome (official site). Booking through Tabelog is possible (February 2026). A 10% service charge from 1 February 2026 (official site). 16 seats: a 10-seat counter and a private table room for up to 6; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). An April 2026 reviewer wrote that the shop "generally does not accept reservations from inbound tourists". 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu) and from Shijo Stn (Keihan) (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi-dori north of Bukkoji, by the Takase River — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kappo-style Japanese cooking from ingredients the owner-chef buys every morning, as courses or, at the counter, à la carte (official site; Tabelog) · lunch omakase ¥10,800 with tax and service (11 dishes), lunch short course ¥8,400 (8 dishes); dinner omakase ¥24,000 (13 dishes), dinner short course ¥16,200 (9 dishes) (official site, prices from 1 February 2026) · signature dishes: marunabe (soft-shelled turtle hot pot) and wagyu grilled slowly over charcoal (Tabelog shop text) · a lunch course in August 2026: fish-stock jelly, seasonal ohitashi, hamo, bluefin tuna, chawanmushi, breadcrumbed fries, karasumi daikon, Saikyo-yaki, grilled nama-fu, uzaku, simmered kinmedai, rice with chirimen sansho · homemade karasumi and warabi mochi (2026 reviews) · sake from Kyoto, Fukui, Niigata and beyond; Swiss and Bulgarian wines, Kenzo Estate wines, shochu, fruit liqueurs (official site)
places.notes: [Kappo · Kiyamachi, Shinji Tokuo's counter] A Kiyamachi kappo by the Takase River, open since 2005, where Shinji Tokuo buys at the market each morning and cooks without show: "food you never tire of", in the shop's words. Sit at the polished zelkova counter for omakase courses — lunch ¥10,800, dinner ¥24,000, tax and service included — of sashimi, soft-shelled turtle chawanmushi, wasabi wagyu steak, homemade karasumi with daikon and Saikyo-miso fish; marunabe turtle hot pot is the house dish. Reviewers praise the warm welcome from the chef, the proprietress and the young staff. Tabelog Bronze 2017–2021. Lunch Wed–Sat, dinner Tue–Sat; book lunch a day ahead. One April 2026 reviewer wrote that the shop generally does not take bookings from inbound tourists.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 日本料理とくを marked its 21st anniversary on 11 February 2026; the staff page lists 徳尾 真次 (born 19 January, from Kyoto Prefecture, hobbies travel and playing in a band) and four more staff, from Fukuoka and Amami Ōshima (Kagoshima); "私も含め、スタッフも若い者ばかりです" (the owner and the staff are all young). Tabelog’s shop text names the chef as Shinji Tokuo and says the owner goes to the market every morning. An April 2026 regular describes the head chef as "sometimes a band member, sometimes a horse owner, and sometimes a loving traveler", says the shop has been run with the proprietress for over 20 years, and that it serves black soybeans and young Tsukahara bamboo shoots year after year. Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2021; Tabelog Japanese cuisine WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: dishes that make the most of the ingredients bought every day, handled lightly — no showy effects, but food you never tire of; Japanese cuisine to be enjoyed more casually.
chef_bio.specialty: Marunabe (soft-shelled turtle hot pot); charcoal-grilled wagyu; karasumi daikon.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular wrote that "Tokuo generally does not accept reservations from inbound tourists", and that the lunch course at ¥10,800 including tax and service has no match nearby.
"I made a reservation around 9 PM the day before, and they were very kind in their response." — May 2026.
"Despite the refined Japanese ambiance, the warm welcome from the owner, Shinji Tokuo, and the staff made it feel very comfortable." — August 2026.
"The warm welcome from the head chef, the proprietress, and the staff creates a cozy, home-like atmosphere" — September 2026 (a 14th visit).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tokuwo.com): 下京区木屋町通り仏光寺上る天王町151、2026年2月11日で21周年、2026年2月1日からサービス料10%、定休日は日曜・月曜、火曜のランチは休み、12:00〜14:00 (最終入店12:30)・18:00〜22:00 (最終入店20:00)、お昼は前日までに予約、当日の電話も可、お一人様歓迎、カウンター10席とテーブル個室 (最大6名)、私が毎日仕入れる食材、派手な演出はないが食べ飽きない料理、お昼のおまかせコース9,000円 (税サ込10,800円、11品)、お昼のショートコース7,000円 (税サ込8,400円、8品)、とくをのおまかせコース20,000円 (税サ込24,000円、13品)、ショートコース13,500円 (税サ込16,200円、9品)、カウンターではアラカルト (約20%値上げ)、スタッフ: 徳尾 真次 (1月19日生まれ、京都府出身、趣味は旅行とバンド) ほか4名、日本酒、焼酎、果実酒、スイスワイン、ブルガリアワイン、ケンゾーエステイト。食べログ: 日本料理、天王町151、Tabelog Award Bronze 2017〜2021、日本料理 WEST 百名店 2021、16席、個室あり、カード可、禁煙、Chef Shinji Tokuo、名物の丸鍋 (すっぽん)、和牛の炭火焼き。口コミ (2026年2〜10月、英語): おまかせコース、すっぽんの茶碗蒸し、カラスミ大根、うざく、西京焼き、わらび餅、欅のカウンター、女将、インバウンドの予約は基本的に受けない (2026年4月の口コミ)。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter kappo with conversation; book by phone or Tabelog (lunch by the day before). An April 2026 review says inbound tourists are generally not booked.

places.name: 鳥かご (Tori Kago)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Skewers come with salt or sauce; the course ends with a rice dish (oyakodon, tsukune rice bowl or takikomi gohan, varying by day); no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an all-chicken skewer course with chicken soup; the few vegetable skewers (shiitake, corn, eggplant) come within it (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 every day; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog), in two seatings, 17:00 and 20:30 (March 2026); hard to book (2026 reviews). Tabelog notes that bookings are open until the end of December and that free seats and extra bookings from cancellations are posted on Instagram (@torikago.kyoto). Course only: 11 skewers ¥15,000 with soft drinks, ¥17,000 with alcohol, tax included, for 1–8 people (Tabelog); drinks are ordered from a QR menu, and all drinks are included except bottles and expensive wines (March 2026). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted, no e-money or QR; can be hired for up to 20 (Tabelog). The room can get quite warm (September 2026). Opened 20 August 2023 (Tabelog). 2 min walk from Shijo-Omiya Stn (Hankyu) (Tabelog); in a residential street (July 2026).
places.neighborhood: Mibu, a residential street near Shijo-Omiya — 2 min walk from Shijo-Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori omakase grilled over strong, direct charcoal heat in the Torishiki style (2026 reviews) · 11 skewers with pickles, chicken soup, a rice dish and dessert, ¥15,000 (soft drinks) or ¥17,000 (all drinks) (Tabelog; July 2026) · Date chicken (two July 2026 reviews) · skewers vary by day: thigh, gizzard, neck, shiitake, maruhatsu (whole heart), outside skirt, wings, tsukune, chōchin, liver, corn, eggplant, atsuage · to finish: oyakodon, tsukune rice bowl with a raw egg (July 2024), kamameshi or takikomi gohan (2024–2026 reviews) · beer and about ten sakes (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Shijo Omiya, a one-cook charcoal counter] An eight-seat yakitori counter in a quiet street near Shijo-Omiya, opened in 2023 by Kato, who cooked at Kyoto's Torisaki before: skewers of Date chicken grilled over strong, direct charcoal heat in the Torishiki manner, eleven to a course with pickles, chicken soup, a rice bowl and dessert. ¥17,000 covers the food and all the drinks (¥15,000 with soft drinks). Kato grills and serves alone, and reviewers single out the warmth of the welcome; one July 2026 regular calls the gizzard "undoubtedly the best I've ever had". Two seatings, 17:00 and 20:30; reservations only, hard to get — watch Instagram for cancellations. Tabelog Yakitori WEST 100 2024, 2025.

roles: Owner-chef, who grills and serves alone (2026 reviews: "The owner, Mr. Kato")
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: Kato previously worked at Torisaki in Kyoto (February, May and September 2026), and the shop grills in the Torishiki style (February and May 2026). A July 2026 reviewer writes that only two places in Kyoto handle Date chicken — the master’s restaurant and Tori Kago, run by one of the master’s apprentices — and that the meat is soaked in baking-soda water to loosen it from the bone and the shiitake sun-dried for half a day. Another July 2026 reviewer has known the chef since the training days. Opened 20 August 2023 (Tabelog). Tabelog Yakitori WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024, 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled skewers of Date chicken; gizzard.

anecdotes.text: "The chef runs the place solo." The reviewer took the 17:00 of two seatings (17:00 and 20:30). — March 2026.
"On the other hand, since Mr. Kato handles all the cooking himself, the variety of skewers and choices for finishing dishes are somewhat limited." — February 2026.
"The standout item for me is the sunagimo (gizzard). The balance of cooking, texture, and aroma is exquisite" — July 2026.
"Although the seating is limited to the counter, the interior can get quite warm, which is a minor downside." — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (Tabelog); fixed course with drinks included; drinks ordered by QR code; cards accepted.

places.gf_detail: Ask. A drinks-first bar: canned craft beer (one made with rice), sake, wine, gin and cocktails, with small plates such as fried spring rolls and baguette with dip; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Most snacks use fish, chicken or cheese (mackerel spring rolls, steamed chicken, a cheese platter); no vegan information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 15:00–24:00; Fri–Sun 13:00–24:00 (Tabelog; the same hours in an August 2025 review). No reservations (Tabelog). 15 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR payments listed (Tabelog), though an April 2026 reviewer noted that PayPay is not accepted. A standing counter is outside and seats are inside (September 2026). Opened 19 December 2023 (Tabelog). 88 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kayukoji alley off Shinkyogoku, north of Shijo — 88 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Standing bar laid out like a liquor shop: pick a bottle or can from the fridges and drink it there (2025–2026 reviews) · canned craft beer, e.g. a collaboration beer of the shop, KITSUNE (a light lager made with Omi Koshihikari rice), Habakari-san from Kyoto ¥1,200, HINO from Shiga ¥1,260 · Japanese sake, wine, local dry gin (Nozawa Onsen Dry Gin), cocktails · small plates: fried spring rolls with mackerel and tomato ¥660, steamed chicken, an assorted three-snack platter, baguette and dip; an August 2025 review describes creative obanzai with seasonal fish from Nishiki Market and vegetables from Ohara (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Standing bar · Kawaramachi, a fridge of craft beer and gin] A modern take on the liquor shop that lets you drink on the premises, in the Kayukoji alley a few steps from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn: choose a can or bottle from the refrigerated cases — craft beer, sake, wine, a strong line of Japanese craft gin — and drink at the standing counter outside or the seats inside; the owner brings the glass, printed with the shop emblem. Staff will suggest easy-drinking picks. Snacks are small and inventive (mackerel-and-tomato spring rolls ¥660). Reviewers call it stylish but pricey for a standing bar (¥1,200–1,260 a can in September 2026); one 2025 visitor was disappointed by the service. Open to midnight daily, from 13:00 at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists the shop as a corporate member, opened on 19 December 2023. An August 2025 review describes it as a modern sake shop that blends liquor sales with standing-bar culture, with music playing.
chef_bio.specialty: Craft gin and canned craft beer from the fridge; mackerel-and-tomato spring rolls.

anecdotes.text: "Once you select your drink and take a seat, the owner brings you a glass, complete with the Kobayashi Saketen emblem." — September 2026.
"I was a bit overwhelmed by the variety, but the staff kindly came over to recommend some options that were easy to drink" — August 2025.

A September 2026 visitor arrived at about 14:00 on a public holiday as the first customer; several groups followed, one staff member was running the whole room, and the reviewer judged the drinks the reason to come rather than the snacks.
An April 2025 visitor, drawn by the local dry gin, found the service and the food aimed at inbound tourists and below expectations; the staff could not describe the cheese platter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (公式情報): 小林酒店、立ち飲み、中京区新京極通四条上る中之町565-1、京都河原町駅から88m、月〜木 15:00〜24:00、金〜日 13:00〜24:00、予約不可、15席、個室なし、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2023年12月19日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 冷蔵ケースから選ぶ缶のクラフトビール、日本酒、ワイン、クラフトジン、カクテル、外に立ち飲みのカウンター、店内に席、サバとトマトの揚げ春巻き660円、蒸し鶏、3種の盛り合わせ、京都の「はばかりさん」1,200円、滋賀の「HINO」1,260円、PayPay 不可 (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick your drink from the fridge and order at the counter; staff explain the drinks when asked; cards accepted (PayPay not, April 2026).

places.name: さらさ花遊小路 (Sarasa Kayu Koji)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Lunch plates lean on fried food — kara-age, tonkatsu, chicken katsu with demi-glace — next to curry, dry curry, taco rice and cakes; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and a focus on vegetables, but the reviewed plates are meat-based and the desserts use cream and cheese; no vegan menu is published (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–22:00, closed Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). Lunch 12:00–15:00, coffee only 15:00–18:00, dinner 18:00–22:00; last order food 21:00, drinks 21:30 (Tabelog). Bookings by phone only (Tabelog note of 29 May 2026); a queue can form at opening, so booking is advised (August, October 2026). 90-minute seating limit (August 2026 on a public holiday; October 2026). Orders by QR code (August 2026); water is self-service (August 2026). 60 seats over two floors (10 counter, 18 sofa, 32 table); non-smoking, with a smoking area in the ground-floor courtyard; cash only — no cards, e-money or QR payments (Tabelog). 1 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 6 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kayukoji alley off Shinkyogoku, north of Shijo — 1 min from Kawaramachi Stn exit 6
places.cuisine: Café by day, a place for a drink and food at night (official site), with international dishes, house-made cakes and freshly roasted coffee (Tabelog) · lunch plate about ¥1,350 (October 2026) · daily lunch sets ¥1,280, e.g. pork chinjao rosu, chili-style chicken kara-age (October 2026) · chicken curry ¥1,100, drink set +¥300 (August 2026) · kara-age plate, tonkatsu, chicken katsu set, taco rice, dry curry with cheese and egg, chicken steak with onion sauce (rice extra), carrot croquette (2026 reviews) · spiced chai parfait ¥750, caramel cheesecake, pumpkin cheesecake, double chocolate cake · coffee, iced coffee; beer, wine, shochu, cocktails (official site; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Café · Kawaramachi, a two-floor townhouse café down an alley] Through a narrow entrance in the Kayukoji alley, a few steps from Kawaramachi Stn, the room opens into a surprisingly large old wooden house with heavy beams, retro counter seats downstairs, roomy table seating upstairs, and rows of manga on display. Lunch is generous plates at about ¥1,280–1,350 (kara-age, curry, taco rice), afternoons are coffee and house cakes, and at night it turns to drinks and small plates until 22:00. A line forms at noon, so phone ahead; seating is 90 minutes. Part of SARASA, a Kyoto café company dating from 1984; this shop opened in 2007. Cash only; closed Wednesday.

roles: Run by 株式会社サラサ (SARASA inc), representative director 尾崎 友哉 (official site); no kitchen staff are named
chef_bio.background: Per the official company page: SARASA opened in December 1984 on the first floor up of "wood inn", a converted kimono shop at Tominokoji Sanjo; a second shop followed at Nishijin in 2000 and サラサ3 in 2005; in October 2007 the main shop moved from Tominokoji Sanjo to Shinkyogoku Shijo-agaru and opened as this Kayukoji shop (Tabelog gives the opening as 6 November 2007). 尾崎 joined in 2008; a new company, 株式会社サラサ, took over the running in April 2026. The company now runs さらさ西陣 (in a former public bath), さらさ花遊小路, さらさ3, サラサケーキ工房 and CLAMP COFFEE. Tabelog's introduction says the name comes from sarasa, a fabric that spread from the Middle East along the Silk Road.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official company page: the thing the company values most is kindness (親切心) toward everyone it deals with, from staff and suppliers to local customers and visitors to Kyoto.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch plates; house-made cakes; coffee.

anecdotes.text: "The meal included kara-age and tonkatsu with a sweet sauce. Since it gets busy, I recommend making a reservation." — August 2026.
An August 2026 reviewer came for the carrot croquette, found it sold out, and had the chai parfait instead: chai panna cotta under vanilla ice cream and whipped cream.
An August 2026 visitor who liked the company's other shops found the chicken katsu set over-fried and drenched in demi-glace and left most of it.
"I arrived a few minutes before opening, and there was already a line, but I managed to get in during the first round." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (cafe-sarasa.com): さらさ花遊小路「昼はコーヒー、夜は誰かと一杯。」、12:00〜22:00、水曜定休、中京区新京極通四条上る中之町565-13、株式会社サラサ (代表取締役 尾崎 友哉)、運営店舗はさらさ西陣、さらさ花遊小路、さらさ3、サラサケーキ工房、CLAMP COFFEE。沿革: 1984年12月 富小路三条の「wood inn」2階にサラサ開店、2000年 西陣店、2005年 サラサ3、2007年10月 本店を新京極四条上ルへ移転しサラサ花遊小路店開店、2008年 尾崎入社、2026年4月 新会社「株式会社サラサ」。食べログ: カフェ・洋食・創作料理、ランチ12:00〜15:00、喫茶のみ15:00〜18:00、ディナー18:00〜22:00、水曜休み、電話予約のみ、60席、中庭に喫煙所、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、2007年11月6日オープン。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 日替わりランチ1,280円、チキンカレー1,100円、チャイパフェ750円、唐揚げ、タコライス、90分制、QR 注文。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code; menu with photos; phone to book; cash only.

places.name: メゾン ド フルージュ (maison de frouge)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the range is shortcake, mille-feuille, tarts, roll cake, financiers and madeleines; no gluten-free item is listed (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the cakes are built on whipped cream, eggs, butter and cheese (shortcake, pudding, cheesecake, mousse) (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–17:00 every day, open all year (Tabelog). No reservations for the café or for holding cakes; pay first when buying in the shop; phone orders need a bank transfer in advance (Tabelog). 9 seats; the eat-in seats can be full (October 2026). Non-smoking; credit cards accepted, no e-money or QR payments (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin-dori south of Sanjo — 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Patisserie and small café that makes only strawberry sweets, from fully ripe strawberries sent from farms across Japan, a different variety each day (official site) · premium strawberry shortcake ¥1,430 on the official list; ¥1,450 plus tax (October 2026) and ¥1,595 eaten in (September 2026) · strawberry mille-feuille ¥1,078, two per person, tied with a ribbon cut with small scissors · strawberry tart ¥1,430 · strawberry and rhubarb cheese tart ¥902 · strawberry cheesecake ¥880 · roll cake ¥702 · tea and berry mousse ¥858 · strawberry pudding ¥418 (official site, undated prices) · strawberry trifle ¥380 plus tax (October 2026) · strawberry financier, raspberry marshmallow, raspberry and pistachio madeleine · wild berry tea ¥880, iced café latte ¥990 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Strawberry sweets · Karasuma Oike, a strawberry-only patisserie] A small white-and-brown shop off Sanjo where every cake is a strawberry cake. Founder Mika Watabe was working in fashion design when a friend brought round some remarkably good strawberries; the visit to the grower behind them led to the first shop in 2003. Fully ripe berries now come straight from farms around Japan, a different variety each day. The premium shortcake (about ¥1,450–1,595) layers strawberries inside and on top; the mille-feuille comes tied with a ribbon you snip with tiny scissors. Nine café seats, no bookings; 11:00–17:00 every day. Prices are high, as reviewers note.

roles: Representative director of 株式会社ミュウ, the operating company (official company page: 代表取締役 渡部美佳)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: while working in fashion planning and design, Watabe was so moved by strawberries a friend introduced that the shop for strawberry sweets opened in 2003; the farm that grew those berries became a contract grower, sending only berries ripened in the field. The site credits Watabe with more than 100 recipes across Japanese, Western and Chinese sweets, appearances on TV, in magazines and at events, and work as an adviser on strawberry breeding for agricultural research bodies. Company history: opened in April 2003 on Senbon-dori in Kamigyo-ku; moved to Sanjo, Nakagyo-ku, in March 2014 (Tabelog: 9 March 2014); the company was set up in March 2013, has a strawberry laboratory and production atelier in Okayama Prefecture, and lists 株式会社三越伊勢丹, 株式会社大丸松坂屋百貨店, 株式会社高島屋 and 株式会社阪急阪神百貨店 as trading partners. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to change how strawberries are distributed in Japan — avoiding the early picking used for market looks, buying fully ripe berries from farms each time, and simplifying packing so growers spend less — so that customers can taste truly good strawberries.
chef_bio.specialty: Premium strawberry shortcake; strawberry mille-feuille.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor noted that, ten days earlier, the shortcake had been ranked first in its category in a poll of 10,000 Kansai residents on the TV show "Chachai-re Monday"; even the restroom had strawberry decorations.
"You cut the ribbon with the adorable little scissors provided." — the strawberry mille-feuille, made with strawberries from Shiga, October 2026.

An October 2026 reviewer described the shortcake as four layers of strawberries between the sponge, and the strawberry trifle as made from the cake trimmings left from other cakes, at a much lower price.
A September 2026 visitor passed over the shortcake at over ¥1,500 and had the limited strawberry-caramel and lemon-cream pudding (¥780) with wild berry tea instead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ichigonoomise.com): メゾン・ド・フルージュ 苺のお店、渡部美佳 (Mika Watabe)、服飾の企画デザインの仕事をしていた頃に友人から紹介されたいちごのおいしさに感動し2003年に開業、契約農家から畑で完熟したいちごを直送、100種類以上のレシピ、京都市在住、農業研究機関へのいちご開発のアドバイザー、苺の流通を変えたい。生菓子: 苺のプレミアムショートケーキ1,430円、苺のミルフィーユ1,078円 (お一人様2個まで)、苺のタルト1,430円、苺とルバーブのフロマージュタルト902円、苺のチーズケーキ880円、苺のロールケーキ702円、紅茶とベリーのムース858円、苺のプリン418円。会社概要: 株式会社ミュウ、代表取締役 渡部美佳、2013年3月設立、中京区東洞院通三条下ル三文字町201 1F、苺研究所・製造アトリエは岡山県英田郡西粟倉村、2003年4月 上京区千本通りで開業、2014年3月 中京区三条へ移転、取引先は三越伊勢丹、大丸松坂屋、高島屋、阪急阪神百貨店。食べログ: ケーキ・カフェ、11:00〜17:00 年中無休、予約不可、9席、カード可、2014年3月9日オープン、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2023・2026。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose at the showcase and pay first; café seats are first come; cards accepted.

places.name: ザ・コモン・ワン・バー・キョウト (The Common One Bar Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail and whisky bar; beer-based drinks such as the Red Eye contain gluten, and no gluten information is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Cocktails are made with fresh seasonal fruit; there is a snack selection with no vegan information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–02:00 every day, last order 01:30 (official site; Tabelog). Cover charge ¥1,100 per person; the private rooms are by reservation at ¥1,700 per person (official site). Reservations taken (Tabelog). 25 seats: a counter, sofas and tatami private rooms for 4 and 6; smoking allowed; JCB, AMEX and Diners cards, no e-money or QR payments (Tabelog). Opened 23 August 2010 (Tabelog). About 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo or Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion Shinbashi by the Shirakawa, off Yamatooji — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Cocktail and whisky bar in a renovated Gion machiya with a garden behind the counter (official site; 2026 reviews) · cocktails with seasonal fresh fruit, e.g. plum, kiwi (July 2026) · classics: Martini with Tanqueray and Noilly Prat, Rob Roy with The Balvenie 12, gin and tonic, Jack Rose, mojito, piña colada, Red Eye with Heartland beer, Bull-Dog · single malts as highballs or shots (Glen Moray, GlenDronach, Ardbeg, Glenmorangie), Calvados soda, vermouth · flavoured vodkas · non-alcoholic cocktails and lower-strength drinks on request (2026 reviews) · two drinks and the cover came to ¥4,700 (May 2026)
places.notes: [Bar · Gion Shinbashi, a hidden machiya cocktail bar] Off a stone-paved Gion lane by the Shirakawa, a dark gate you might not take for an entrance leads down a lit stone path to a century-old townhouse: tatami private rooms along the corridor, then a high-ceilinged room with a one-slab counter facing a glowing back bar and an illuminated garden. Seasonal fresh-fruit cocktails and well-made classics (Martini, Rob Roy), plenty of single malt, and non-alcoholic or lighter drinks on request. Cover ¥1,100; two drinks with cover ¥4,700 in May 2026. Open nightly 18:00–02:00. A sister bar of Gion's FINLANDIA BAR.

roles: Run by 株式会社ケイ・ステージ (K-stage), representative 世古昌弘 (official company page); a July 2026 review calls it one of five establishments run by bartender Seko
chef_bio.background: Per the official company page: K-stage took over ぎをん FINLANDIA BAR (opened 1982 as the sister of a Finnish restaurant, FINLANDIA, from 1976) in 2002; in August 2010 it opened 何生館, a base for Japanese culture in a Gion Shinbashi townhouse more than 100 years old that belonged to a relative of one of the managers, and The Common One Bar Kyoto inside it. Sister venues: The Northern Lights Corner on Kayukoji (2013), Turquoise Bar at Kiyamachi Shijo (2016 as TurQuois Bar 2), and CLASSIC TEA & COCKTAILS ぎをん新橋 何生庵 in the same building (2021). A related company, アルコ・ノルディック株式会社 (2023), imports a Finnish vodka (コスケンコルヴァ). Tabelog Bar "Tabelog 100" 2022.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fresh-fruit cocktails; classic cocktails; single malt.

anecdotes.text: "You enter through a dark gate that you might not even realize is the entrance, and as you follow the lights on the stone path, you arrive at a bar that feels like a grand residence." — May 2026.
A February 2026 group booked a private tatami room; the bar prepared non-alcoholic cocktails for the members who do not drink.
A July 2026 reviewer, celebrating an 80th birthday in a tatami room, watched the 80-year-old and a 79-year-old enjoy shots.
A June 2026 regular notes there was a period when the customers were mostly visitors from abroad, and that the crowd has recently become more mixed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (k-stage.jp): ザ・コモン・ワン・バー・キョウト、白川の石畳から路地を入った別世界、一枚板のカウンター、季節のフルーツのカクテル、ウイスキー、ワイン、チャージ1,100円、個室は予約制で1,700円、18:00〜02:00 (L.o. 01:30)、東山区新橋通大和大路東入元吉町46番地 何生館内。会社概要: 株式会社ケイ・ステージ、代表者 世古昌弘、2002年 ぎをん FINLANDIA BAR の経営権を引き継ぐ、2010年8月 祇園白川に築百年以上の町屋を改装した何生館を開館し同時にバーを開業、2013年 The Northern Lights Corner、2016年 TurQuois Bar 2 (のち Turquoise Bar)、2021年 何生庵、2023年 アルコ・ノルディック設立 (コスケンコルヴァ・ウォッカの輸入)。食べログ: バー、25席、個室 (4人・6人)、喫煙可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、2010年8月23日オープン、ぎをん FINLANDIA BAR の姉妹店、バー百名店 2022。口コミ (2026年、英語): 季節のフルーツのカクテル、マティーニ、ロブロイ、シングルモルト、ノンアルコールのカクテル、2杯とチャージで4,700円 (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in through the gate and down the path; a staff member may come out to greet you (June 2026); cover charge; smoking allowed; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners).

places.name: Hyssop (ヒソップ)
places.gf_detail: Ask, and tell the restaurant in advance: it asks guests with allergies to say so beforehand and warns that, depending on the allergy, it may not be able to adapt on the day (Tabelog). Lunch sets include bread or rice, fritters, miso sauces and wontons; dinner has pasta (official menu; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the cooking is built on vegetables, with a shojin (vegetarian) dashi in some soups, but most sets carry chicken, pork, fish or egg; one spring 2025 lunch let the diner pick the wonton filling (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order), closing 16:00; dinner 17:30–21:00 (last order), closing 22:00; closed days follow the building (official site). Tabelog gives the same two sittings (lunch last orders food 15:00, drinks 15:30; dinner food 21:00, drinks 21:30) and in its notes a continuous 11:30–22:00 day with lunch last order 14:30, brunch and desserts until 16:30 and no café service during lunch; closed irregularly. Bookings online (TableCheck link on the official site; Tabelog); party plans for 10 or more by phone (Tabelog). 54 seats at 2- and 4-person tables, sofa seats and an open terrace; a table charge applies on the terrace (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards and PayPay; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). The bill could not be split per person for a group of five (October 2026). 4th floor of GOOD NATURE STATION, 2 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo Kawaramachi, next to Takashimaya — 4F of GOOD NATURE STATION, 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Casual restaurant of healthy, vegetable-centred dishes in a plant-filled room with an open-atrium terrace (official site); vegetables mostly from producers in Kyoto, cooked simply (Tabelog) · seasonal lunch sets with a medicinal-food theme: Summer Balanced Meal ¥2,500 (soup, five small deli dishes, charcoal-grilled Tanba chicken, multigrain rice, tofu pudding; September 2026), Autumn Hyssop Lunch Set ¥3,400 (vegetable mousse and shojin jelly, saury and cauliflower bagna salad, minestrone, roast Kyoto pork with mustard sauce, mini douhua, coffee or tea; Tabelog, September 2026) · dinner à la carte: hors d’oeuvre ¥2,200, farm tomato and burrata caprese ¥2,400, long pasta with Kyoto duck ragù ¥2,400, charcoal-grilled venison with mushroom koji-miso sauce 100 g ¥4,000, roast Kameoka beef loin 120 g ¥5,400 (official site) · party plans with free-flow drinks ¥6,500 and ¥9,500 (Kameoka beef) (Tabelog); summer "Nature Beer Terrace 2026" free-flow course ¥5,500 (July 2026) · cocktails, wine, sake, elderflower soda ¥500
places.notes: [Vegetable-led restaurant · Shijo Kawaramachi, a greenhouse room four floors up] The restaurant of GOOD NATURE STATION, next to Takashimaya: a room full of plants with an open-atrium terrace, cooking mostly Kyoto-grown vegetables simply. Lunch is a seasonal set with a medicinal-food theme — five small deli dishes, soup, a main of Tanba chicken or Kyoto pork, multigrain rice and a small dessert (¥2,500–3,400 in 2026); dinner turns to wine with caprese, duck-ragù pasta, venison and Kameoka beef. Terrace seats carry a table charge, and a September 2026 diner on the open terrace worried about the many birds overhead. Book online; 11:30–16:00 and 17:30–22:00.

roles: Hotel restaurant; no chef or manager is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Opened 9 December 2019 (Tabelog) on the 4th floor of GOOD NATURE STATION, the building of GOOD NATURE HOTEL KYOTO (official site; 2026 reviews). A July 2026 reviewer describes it as part of the Keihan group. Lunch sets change with the seasons; a repeat diner who visited from 2022 to October 2026 described the winter set as a way to experience "Winter Nourishment" through food and the lunch sets as medicinal-herb sets, and a July 2022 visit found an afternoon-tea wellness set themed on "Yaku Shoku Dougen" (the synergy of medicine and food).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the restaurant’s own text): ingredients, mainly vegetables, are sourced from local producers in Kyoto and cooked simply to bring out their character; the lunch course pairs "sauces that embody the essence of French cuisine" with Kyoto and Japanese flavours.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal vegetable lunch sets; Kameoka beef and venison at dinner.

anecdotes.text: "The interior is filled with greenery, making it feel like a botanical garden, and the open terrace seating is delightful." — September 2026.

A September 2026 diner on the open terrace felt anxious about bird droppings, as many birds are around, and suggested a garden-view seat inside or a later booking; the same diner found the portions a little smaller than in July.
"The drink ordering system via smartphone meant we didn’t have to call a waiter" — July 2026.
A group of five in October 2026 could not split the bill per person and had to settle up among themselves.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (goodnaturestation.com): GOOD NATURE STATION 4F、野菜を中心としたヘルシーなお料理をお楽しみいただけるカジュアルレストラン、吹き抜けのテラス席、ランチ 11時30分〜15時00分 (L.O.) 16時00分close、ディナー 17時30分〜21時00分 (L.O) 22時00分close、定休日は施設に準ずる、ディナー: 前菜オードブル2,200円、農園トマトとブーラッタチーズカプレーゼ2,400円、ロングパスタ 京鴨ラグーソース2,400円、鹿肉 炭火焼 きのこ麹味噌ソース 100g 4,000円、亀岡牛ロース肉のロースト 120g 5,400円、予約は TableCheck。食べログ: カフェ・ダイニングバー、下京区稲荷町318-6 グッドネイチャーホテル 4F、54席、テラス席はテーブルチャージ、アレルギーは事前に連絡 (当日は対応できない場合あり)、ベジタリアンメニューあり、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、車椅子可、2019年12月9日オープン、ランチセット3,400円、パーティープラン6,500円・9,500円。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 季節のランチセット (夏2,500円、秋3,400円)、薬膳、Tanba の鶏、京都ポーク、精進出汁、Nature Beer Terrace 2026 (5,500円)、テラスの鳥、スマートフォンでのドリンク注文、個別会計不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; drinks can be ordered by smartphone; cards accepted.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The restaurant asks guests with allergies to tell it in advance and warns that, depending on the allergy, it may not be able to accommodate on the day of the visit.

places.name: 京都 鉄板焼 grow (Kyoto Teppanyaki grow)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The courses mix plain teppan-grilled wagyu and lobster with a wagyu katsu sandwich, baguette with the stew, a soy-sauce foam and teriyaki-sauced beef sushi; no gluten information is published (Tabelog course menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every course is built on wagyu beef and lobster, with beef broth in the chawanmushi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 17:00–22:00; Saturday, Sunday and public holidays 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Two-hour seating limit; same-day cancellations are charged 100%; a 5% service charge is added (Tabelog). 14 seats: 10 at the counter and a private room for 4 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). B1F of the ユーイットゥ池善ビル, 1 min from Exit 2 of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu), 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn Exit 3 — reachable without an umbrella in the rain (Tabelog). Instagram @kyoto.grow (October 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori east of Kawaramachi, basement — 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn Exit 2
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki counter for black wagyu and lobster; an undated macaro-ni article calls the beef A5 grade at reasonable prices (macaro-ni) · most popular dinner (Tabelog): 10 dishes with Ise lobster teppanyaki, lean black wagyu steak and 2-hour free-flow drinks ¥14,000 — foie gras roast beef, seared wagyu sushi, dish of the day (wagyu tomato stew with baguette), wagyu and taro chawanmushi, Ise lobster with Kujo-negi sauce and lobster-broth sauce, salad with anchovy-garlic sauce, wagyu katsu sandwich with shibazuke tartar, steak (upgrade strip loin +¥1,600, tenderloin +¥2,700, Chateaubriand +¥3,800) with whipped soy-sauce foam, garlic rice ball finished with broth, panna cotta (October–November 2026) · lunch wagyu lean steak course, 9 dishes ¥6,600, abalone or lobster extra (Tabelog) · Christmas course 24–25 December ¥15,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Shijo Kawaramachi, wagyu and lobster in a basement] A 10-seat counter (plus one private room) a minute from Kawaramachi Station, where black wagyu and Ise lobster are grilled on the teppan in front of you. The popular dinner is ten dishes with two hours of free-flow drinks for ¥14,000 — foie gras roast beef, seared wagyu sushi, lobster with Kujo-negi sauce, a wagyu katsu sandwich, a lean steak you can upgrade to Chateaubriand, and a garlic rice ball finished with broth. Popular for birthdays, with decorated dessert plates; one October 2026 diner found the room loud and the 5% service charge unwelcome. Two-hour limit; book ahead. Dinner daily, lunch at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 June 2017 (Tabelog); run by a company (a corporate invoice registrant, Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer credits the owner with sourcing high-quality wagyu at reasonable prices and noted many foreign guests that evening. A macaro-ni article (undated) describes the shop as serving top-grade A5 beef at reasonable prices.
chef_bio.specialty: Black wagyu steak; Ise lobster teppanyaki; wagyu katsu sandwich.

anecdotes.text: "There were many foreign guests, and the thoughtful gesture of a dessert plate decorated with anime characters made for a memorable experience." — October 2026.
"According to the staff, they whip the soy sauce to create a foamy texture" — October 2026.

An October 2026 birthday diner found the room lively rather than subdued, the staff’s energy like an izakaya’s, the 5% service charge unexpected and the birthday plate the same as everyone else’s, while calling the food delicious.
A September 2026 diner preferred the lean cut to the filet and found the house red wine served too warm.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鉄板焼・ステーキ、下京区真町88-3 ユーイットゥ池善ビル B1F、阪急京都河原町駅2番出口から徒歩1分、京阪祇園四条駅3番出口から徒歩3分、月〜金 17:00〜22:00、土日祝 12:00〜14:00・17:00〜22:00、不定休、2時間制、当日キャンセル100%、サービス料5%、14席 (カウンター10、個室4名)、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、子供可、2017年6月1日オープン、ディナー (飲み放題2時間 + 伊勢海老 + 黒毛和牛赤身ステーキ、全10品) 14,000円、ランチ (和牛赤身ステーキコース 9品) 6,600円、クリスマスコース15,000円。macaro-ni: 京都鉄板焼 グロウ（grow）河原町店、最高級であるA5ランクのお肉をリーズナブルに。口コミ (2026年9〜11月、英語): フォアグラのローストビーフ、黒毛和牛の炙り寿司、和牛のトマト煮込み、茶碗蒸し、伊勢海老の鉄板焼 (九条ねぎのソース、海老の出汁のソース)、柴漬けタルタルの和牛カツサンド、泡の醤油、ガーリックライスのおにぎり、パンナコッタ、誕生日のプレート、サービス料への不満。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course online; many foreign guests (October 2026); cards accepted; 5% service charge.

places.name: LA VOITURE
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the tarte tatin is baked on tart pastry, and the shop’s own allergen label lists wheat, milk, egg and apple, with walnuts handled on the same line (official online shop).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the apples are caramelised with butter and sugar (Fashion Headline, 2016), the allergen label lists milk and egg (official online shop), and the tart comes with yogurt (2026 reviews). Drinks only.
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–18:00 (last order 17:00); closed Monday; other closures irregular — check the official website (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Can be busy: a 10-minute wait (October 2026) and a 5-minute wait on a holiday afternoon (September 2026); quiet right after opening on a weekday (October 2026). Slices to take away at the shop (2026 reviews); frozen tarts by mail through the official online shop. 18 seats, tables only; non-smoking; cards and IC/e-money, no QR payments; one parking space (No. 2) (Tabelog; September 2026). A step at the door and a narrow doorway make wheelchair access difficult (October 2026). 15 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn, 5 min from the Kumano-jinja-mae city bus stop: head east on Marutamachi-dori and turn right just before the city martial arts centre (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shogoin, south of Marutamachi near Heian Shrine — 15 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Tarte tatin shop and café in Okazaki (official site): each tart uses about 20 apples caramelised with butter and sugar for over four hours (Fashion Headline, 2016; Leaf Kyoto, 2021) · choose among two to four apple varieties by season — Fuji all year, plus e.g. サンつがる, Shinano Gold, Iwai, Olin (2026 reviews) — served warm with unsweetened yogurt · tarte tatin (Fuji) ¥950, takeaway slice ¥1,000 · walnut caramel tart ¥730 · Darjeeling with a cake ¥730, iced café au lait ¥800, apple-caramel flavoured tea (September–October 2026) · by mail, frozen: 2 slices ¥2,250, 15 cm whole tart ¥7,150 (official online shop, sold out at the time of reading)
places.notes: [Tarte tatin café · Okazaki, half a century of tarte tatin] A small, old-fashioned café near Heian Shrine devoted to tarte tatin. Its story starts with the café 紅屋 that Yuri Matsunaga and husband 辰夫 opened in Gion in 1959; it became an art gallery, moved here in 1971 as a French restaurant beside the gallery, and turned into this café in 1987. Yuri kept baking the tarte tatin — honoured in France by the Confrérie des Lichonneux de tarte tatin in 2006 — until dying in 2014, and a grandchild bakes it now. About 20 apples go into each tart; pick from the day's varieties (Fuji ¥950 in 2026) and eat it warm with yogurt. No bookings; Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–18:00.

roles: Granddaughter of the founder, named in a January 2016 article as carrying on the recipe; the official site says the recipe is now baked by the founder’s grandchild
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the first owners, 松永ユリ (Yuri Matsunaga in Leaf Kyoto and Fashion Headline) and 辰夫, opened the café 紅屋, forerunner of LA VOITURE, in Gion in 1959; out of a love of art it became the gallery 紅 in 1964; in 1971 the business moved to Okazaki, where the French restaurant LA VOITURE opened alongside the gallery. Yuri, captivated by the tarte tatin served as a French dessert, kept baking it and was admitted in France to the Confrérie des Lichonneux de tarte tatin in 2006. The official site gives Yuri’s death in 2014 at 96; a January 2016 Fashion Headline article says Yuri died "two years ago at the age of 92", was born in the Taisho era, always sat in a corner of the shop, and created the recipe after eating tarte tatin on a trip to France. Leaf Kyoto (March 2021) adds that the daughter, Tomomi, helped open the 1971 restaurant and that the shop became a tarte tatin café in 1987. The maker on the online shop is the company 株式会社 紅 at the shop address. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2020, 2022, 2023, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: Yuri baked the tarte tatin "with an artist’s feeling", and that feeling and the recipe are being carried on by the grandchild.
chef_bio.specialty: Tarte tatin by apple variety; walnut caramel tart.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor learned that the classic Fuji tarte tatin is offered all year, alongside several seasonal varieties made with other apples.
"The cake was served slightly warm with yogurt on the side." — September 2026.
A November 2026 reviewer remembers the shop having been in Gion before and says it was much less crowded in the reviewer’s student days.
An October 2026 reviewer found one young staff member a little aloof; another that month said the staff were very kind and explained a lot.
An October 2026 first-timer found ordering a little complicated, with three apple varieties and five teas to choose from.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (voiture.buyshop.jp): 京都・岡崎のタルトタタンの店、初代店主 松永ユリと辰夫が1959年に祇園で喫茶「紅屋」を始め、1964年に画廊「紅」へ転業、1971年に岡崎へ移り画廊「紅」と共にフランス料理店「LA VOITURE」が始まる、ユリは「タルトタタン」に魅了され芸術への思いを込めて焼き続け、2006年フランスで Confrerie des Lichonneux de tarte tatin の一員として認められる、2014年96歳で亡くなる、現在はレシピと思いが孫へと焼き継がれている。オンラインショップ: タルトタタンカット2個入 (サンつがる・早生ふじ) 2,250円、15cmホール7,150円、冷凍で発送、アレルギー物質: 乳、小麦、卵、りんご、製造ラインでくるみを含む製品を製造、製造者 株式会社 紅 (左京区聖護院円頓美町47-5)。食べログ: ケーキ・カフェ、火〜日 11:30〜18:00 (L.O. 17:00)、月曜休み、予約不可、18席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、駐車場1台、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2020・2022・2023・2026。英語の記事: Leaf Kyoto (2021年3月) 1971年に娘の Tomomi と開店、1987年に今のカフェに、Fashion Headline (2016年1月) 92歳で亡くなった、孫の Maya Wakabayashi が継ぐ。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): ふじ950円、テイクアウト1,000円、クルミのタルト730円、ダージリン730円、アイスカフェオレ800円、りんごは3〜4種から選ぶ、ヨーグルト添え。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the table; staff explain the apple varieties; cards accepted; no bookings.

places.name: 酒処 てらやま (Sake Dokoro Terayama)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal fish, oden, kabura-mushi with a thickened sauce, curry, fried rice, tempura and a beef katsu sandwich; soy-based seasonings throughout and no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the menu is fish, oden in broth, chicken wings and beef; ginkgo nuts and pickles are the few plant dishes (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday 13:00–21:00; closed Tuesday and Saturday (Tabelog). The 13:00 opening began in September 2026; last call 21:00 (September 2026). Reservations by phone: no bookings by proxy; during business hours call only about availability and same-day bookings (Tabelog); the shop sometimes limits bookings even when seats are free and the line can be hard to get through (October 2026). Menu without prices (market prices); bills from about ¥6,000 a head for two to about ¥11,600 for one (2026 reviews). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and two tables for 4–5 upstairs; children are seated upstairs only, with no children’s menu (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards accepted, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley entered from the north; 6–8 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Ayanokoji, west of Kawaramachi, down an alley — 6–8 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Counter izakaya-kappo of seasonal fish and sake (2025–26 reviews) · sashimi (seared hamo, sea urchin, squid, tuna), shime saba, first-of-season saury, seared sawara, hamo nanban with okra, hamo with matsutake, sea urchin with eggplant, rock oysters with sea grapes · maguro namero, kabura-mushi with wasabi, dashimaki, oden (from October 2026), chicken wings (single wings can be ordered), toro-taku, kizushi, fried matsutake, ginkgo nuts · to finish: beef curry rice with garlic rice, fried rice, the "famous" beef katsu sandwich, crusts cut off · sake chosen for you, hot sake, Hakushu and Yamazaki highballs, homemade lemon sour (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo Kawaramachi, seasonal fish down an alley] A 16-seat counter izakaya hidden down a narrow alley off Ayanokoji, behind a sign one diner found hard to read. The board has no prices: seasonal fish — hamo, sea urchin, sawara, shime saba — dashimaki, oden in the cold months and juicy chicken wings, with sake picked for you, then the shop's beef curry, fried rice or katsu sandwich to finish. Since September 2026 it opens at 13:00 for daytime drinking. A September 2026 diner was surprised by the prices; others call it fair for the quality. Book by phone; closed Tuesday and Saturday.

roles: Chef at the counter (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: A September 2025 Tabelog reviewer calls it a counter kappo "run by the owner of Shokudo Ogawa", and a September 2026 reviewer was told it is easier to book than the popular Ogawa; Retty reviews (one posted March 2026) say instead that the shop’s cook came from 食堂おがわ. An October 2026 regular heard the shop will mark its 10th anniversary in December 2026. A March 2025 reviewer found the interior renovated. Tabelog Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024, 2025, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fish; beef curry; katsu sandwich; chicken wings.

anecdotes.text: "The option to order just one is a thoughtful touch for solo diners" (of the chicken wings) — October 2026.
"Starting this month, they open at 1 PM, which is great news for daytime drinking." — September 2026.
A September 2026 diner was surprised by the high prices on the unpriced menu, especially as several planned dishes were unavailable, while praising the sashimi.
A repeat diner ranks the curry among the top three in Kyoto: rice fragrant with garlic, tender beef and a blend of spices (September 2025).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、下京区綾小路通足袋屋町317-11、月水木金日 13:00〜21:00、火曜・土曜休み、予約可 (代理予約不可、営業中は空席と当日予約の問い合わせのみ)、16席 (カウンター8、2階に4〜5名のテーブル2)、子供は2階のみ、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2024・2025・2026。Retty: 口コミによれば食堂おがわ出身の方の店。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 値段のないお品書き、鱧、雲丹と茄子、しめ鯖、秋刀魚、まぐろのなめろう、かぶら蒸し、手羽先 (1本から)、だし巻き、おでん、カレー、炒飯、カツサンド、日本酒のおまかせ、2026年9月から13時開店、2026年12月に10周年、路地の奥。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone in Japanese (no proxy bookings); the menu has no prices; ask what is in season.

places.name: NIKOLABO (ニコラボ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Stews, carpaccio and salads sit beside pasta, risotto, pizza and rice croquettes; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Most stews are meat or fish, and the vegetable dishes reviewers name come with cheese (water eggplant with parmesan, caprese); no vegan dishes are listed (Tabelog menu; 2023–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Dinner 18:00–23:00 Tuesday to Friday and 17:00–23:00 Saturday and Sunday; lunch 12:00–14:00 on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday; closed Monday; last order 22:30 (Tabelog; the official site gives last order 22:00). Lunch opens only for bookings made by phone by the day before, with a one-drink minimum, and serves the evening menu (official site; Tabelog). Booking is recommended even on weekdays (November 2025). All-you-can-drink courses ¥7,000 and ¥8,000 for groups (Tabelog). 16 seats (6 at the counter, 10 at tables), the whole room can be hired for up to 25 standing, from ¥60,000 Tuesday–Friday and ¥80,000 at weekends; BYO wine ¥2,000 a bottle (Tabelog). Non-smoking, with a smoking space; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor of the エリッツ四条河原町ビル on the west side of Kawaramachi-dori, south of Takashimaya (October 2025); 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 December 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-dori south of Shijo — 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Italian wine bistro built on stews — the official site calls it ワインのための煮込み料理研究所, a research lab for stews to go with wine; produce and fish come from Kyotango, the chef’s home area (official site) · Kyotango fish carpaccio ¥1,200 (fish of the day) · caprese of Kumihama Toma Kobo fruit tomato and buffalo mozzarella ¥1,200 · more than 30 stews, e.g. tripe in tomato ¥1,680, coq au vin ¥2,300, carbonade (beef in beer) ¥2,400, saffron-stewed Kyotango fish ¥2,600 · risotto with scallops ¥1,880, black-tea chiffon cake with vanilla ice cream ¥800 (Tabelog menu, December 2024) · braised pork belly with a choice of sauces (lotus root, apple, sansho), lamb stewed in tomato, oven-baked chicken wings, water eggplant with parmesan, persimmon and gorgonzola canapés, taro fritters, rice croquettes, pasta with gorgonzola or oyster cream (2023–26 reviews) · over 40 wines chosen by the chef, who is a sommelier; glass from ¥780, bottle from ¥3,900; draft beer ¥600, highball ¥700 (official site; Tabelog menu, December 2024)
places.notes: [Italian · Shijo Kawaramachi, stews made for wine] A second-floor wine bistro on Kawaramachi-dori that calls itself a research lab for stews to go with wine. The chef — a sommelier from Kyotango — brings in fish and vegetables from that coast, and the menu lists more than 30 stews: braised pork belly tender enough for chopsticks with a lotus-root or apple sauce, lamb in tomato, coq au vin, tripe. Start with the carpaccio of the day or the water eggplant with parmesan. Reviewers in 2026 found the owner running the room alone, cooking, taking orders and the bill, so order starters and mains together. Dinner daily except Monday (from 17:00 at weekends); lunch on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday by booking only.

roles: Owner-chef and sommelier (official site: "ソムリエでもあるシェフ"; reviews describe one owner who cooks, serves and takes payment); not named in the sources
chef_bio.origin: Kyotango, Kyoto Prefecture (official site: "シェフの地元でもある京丹後市").
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the shop researches dishes made for wine every day, with seasonal ingredients ordered in from Kyotango, the chef’s home area, and wines chosen by the chef, who is also a sommelier. Opened 1 December 2017 (Tabelog). Reviews from October 2025 to August 2026 describe a single person on duty: drinks for a group course were self-served from the bottles (October 2025), "The owner was managing everything alone" (April 2026), and the owner "handles everything from cooking to taking orders and processing payments" (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to serve the season’s ingredients from Kyotango at their best, as dishes made to go with wine.
chef_bio.specialty: Braised pork belly with lotus-root sauce; stewed lamb; carpaccio of the day.

anecdotes.text: "Since the owner handles everything from cooking to taking orders and processing payments, it’s a good idea to order your appetizers and main dishes in advance." — August 2026.
An April 2026 diner arrived early and found that the lift in the building did not stop at the restaurant’s floor.
An October 2025 regular booked ahead to have a message written on a dessert for a daughter’s 18th birthday.
"Almost everything with chicken here is delicious." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (nikolabo1201.com): ワインのための煮込み料理研究所 NIKOLABO、ワインのための料理を日々研究、シェフの地元でもある京丹後市から取り寄せた四季折々の旬の食材、ソムリエでもあるシェフ自らが厳選したワイン、下京区稲荷町329 エリッツ四条河原町ビル2F、12:00〜14:00 (前日までの事前予約・1ドリンク制)、18:00〜23:00 (土・日は17:00から、ラストオーダー22:00)、定休日 月曜日。食べログ: イタリアン・肉料理・ワインバー、河原町駅から徒歩1分、火・木・土 12:00〜14:00、火〜金 18:00〜23:00、土・日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、月曜休み、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、貸切は立食25名まで、ワイン持ち込み1本2,000円、カード・PayPay 可、2017年12月1日オープン、メニュー (2024年12月更新): 京丹後の鮮魚のカルパッチョ1,200円、煮込み30種以上、ワイン40種以上、飲み放題コース7,000円・8,000円。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 豚バラの煮込み (れんこん・りんごのソース)、ラムのトマト煮込み、水茄子とパルメザン、柿とゴルゴンゾーラ、オーナーが一人で調理と接客。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone or online; lunch only by booking by the day before; one person runs the room, so order early.

places.name: 乙羽 (Otowa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-style sushi: the inari skins are soaked in broth, the anago is grilled and the shiitake simmered sweet and savoury; no gluten information is published (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: mackerel, conger eel, egg and shrimp run through the menu, and the inari skins are soaked in broth (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–20:00 (last order 19:45), Tuesday to Sunday; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Takeaway: sit on the chair by the entrance; an order took about ten minutes (June 2024). Mushi-zushi (steamed sushi) is a winter dish: roughly October to March by a February 2026 blog, served into early April in the cold spring of 2025, and not served in summer (August 2026); in summer the speciality is hamo box sushi (February 2026). 20 seats; non-smoking; cards (VISA, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). At the Shijo end of the Shinkyogoku arcade, a short walk from exit 9 of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (February 2026 blog; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinkyogoku arcade just north of Shijo — 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Long-running Kyoto-sushi house of the Meiji era (2025–26 reviews) · winter mushi-zushi (むしすし): vinegared rice steamed in a lidded Imari bowl under fluffy shredded egg, with grilled anago, simmered shiitake, bamboo shoot and kanpyo, ¥1,600 before tax (February 2026 blog), ¥1,760 (November 2025) · inari-zushi in thick, broth-soaked fried tofu, ¥840 (April 2025); single pieces of inari, saba-zushi and mushi-zushi can be ordered (February–March 2026) · saba-zushi (five pieces) (January 2026) · Kyoto sushi set of box sushi, roll and mackerel ¥1,650 (December 2025) · "Kyo no Shiki" chirashi with shrimp, anago, snap peas and shiitake ¥2,100 (December 2025) · Kurama (くらま): steamed shrimp, snap peas, pickled ginger and shredded egg over anago and shiitake (October 2026) · mini maki ¥550 (October 2026); kappa and shinko rolls (August 2026); anago-cucumber roll ¥1,600 (April 2025) · hamo box sushi in summer (February 2026) · sake, shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Sushi · Shinkyogoku, Kyoto's winter steamed sushi] An old Kyoto-sushi shop at the Shijo end of the Shinkyogoku arcade, dated to the Meiji era and said to be more than 120 years old. In winter a steamer at the door sends up clouds for the mushi-zushi: warm vinegared rice in a lidded Imari bowl, under shredded egg, with grilled anago and sweet-simmered shiitake (¥1,760, November 2025). Year round, reviewers praise the inari, with thick tofu skins soaked in broth, the saba-zushi and the small rolls; in summer, hamo box sushi. Single pieces can be ordered, and everything can be taken away. 11:00–20:00, closed Monday; no bookings.

chef_bio.background: A Kyoto-sushi shop dated to the Meiji era: a March 2025 review says "established in the Meiji era", a January 2026 review "founded in the mid-Meiji period", and reviews from December 2025 and October 2026 give its age as 120 years and over 120 years. A February 2026 blog found no official site and notes that the shop is often introduced as founded in 1902 (Meiji 35); some articles present it as the birthplace of mushi-zushi. A January 2026 reviewer writes that the sushi rice is rested overnight to soften the vinegar before steaming.
chef_bio.specialty: Mushi-zushi (winter); inari-zushi; saba-zushi.

anecdotes.text: "In winter, there’s a large steamer in front of the restaurant, and passing by always makes me crave their steamed sushi." — February 2026.
"I was warned that it would be hot, and when I opened the lid, steam rose up" — March 2026.
An October 2026 diner who came in just before closing was given a ¥30 discount on a ¥550 mini maki, and called the owner "such a wonderful person".

A long-time regular wrote in June 2024 that a foreign visitor left after being shown a paper in English and that the shop might not be very welcoming to inbound customers; on the same regular’s April 2025 visit, a group of Western tourists was dining and the staff spoke English fluently.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、中京区新京極通四条上ル中之町565、阪急「河原町」駅から徒歩約5分、火〜日 11:00〜20:00 (L.O. 19:45)、月曜休み、予約不可、20席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、テイクアウト可、日本酒・焼酎。ブログ「日本全国食べ歩き」(2026年2月13日訪問): 京都の冬の名物の蒸し寿司を代表する老舗、公式サイトは見当たらない、明治35年 (1902年) 創業と紹介されることが多い、冬は蒸し寿司、夏は鱧の箱寿司、蒸し寿司はおおむね10〜3月、店頭にせいろ、京都河原町駅の9番出口のすぐ近く、むしすし1,600円 (税別)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 明治創業、120年以上、蒸し寿司 (錦糸玉子、穴子、椎茸、筍、かんぴょう)、いなり寿司840円、鯖寿司、京寿司 (箱・巻・鯖) 1,650円、Kyo no Shiki 2,100円、くらま、ミニ巻き寿司550円、かっぱ巻き・しんこ巻き、穴子きゅうり巻き1,600円、1個から注文可。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the table or at the door for takeaway; check the display of samples by the entrance to see what each set holds; cards accepted.
