places.name: La Biographie... (ラ ビオグラフィ)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Allergies are handled if told in advance, but not on the day (Tabelog); the omakase has included bread, a kumquat tart, a baba, and nama-fu (wheat gluten) in an amuse and a taiyaki (2024–25 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: A vegetarian or vegan menu can be arranged — ask when booking; changes on the day are not possible (official site; Tabelog). The standard omakase uses beef, crab, fish, egg and cream.
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00 (last entry) to 15:00, Friday to Sunday only; dinner 18:00 (last entry) to 22:00, Wednesday to Sunday; closed Monday and Tuesday and irregularly, with summer and New Year breaks posted on the official site (official site). Tabelog still lists lunch Wednesday to Sunday; the official site gives Friday to Sunday. Reservation only: by phone or online (TableCheck, OMAKASE, Ikkyu, linked from the official site); a booking with no word 10 minutes after the time is treated as cancelled (Tabelog). Omakase only: lunch ¥16,500 (8 dishes, about 2 hours), dinner ¥28,000 or ¥38,500 (11 dishes, about 2.5–3 hours), plus 10% service (official site). 8 counter seats facing the open kitchen; private hire up to 20; barrier-free, with gentle slopes throughout; non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog; official site). 13 min walk from JR Nijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shimodachiuri-dori east of Senbon — 13 min walk from JR Nijo Stn
places.cuisine: Counter French by chef Masahiro Takimoto, who keeps a Michelin star in the 2026 Kyoto/Osaka guide (official site); omakase only — lunch ¥16,500, dinner ¥28,000 or ¥38,500, plus 10% service (official site) · opens with an aperitif of five tastes (bitter, sweet, umami, sour, salty) in finger-sized bites · signature egg, the "microcosm": warm yolk, cold cream, maple sap and chives in the shell · Kasumi crab with homemade senmaizuke and caviar · Kyoto mushroom soup served like a cappuccino · Kyoto Hime beef cooked about 100 minutes at low temperature with a hinoki scent · Uji matcha dessert, tarte Tatin, baba, mignardises (2024–26 reviews) · in October 2026: tuna tartare with caviar and shibazuke, Lake Biwa sweetfish, Awaji hamo with matsutake in consommé, herbal tea made at the counter (October 2026)
places.notes: [French · Senbon, a Michelin-starred counter] Masahiro Takimoto was head chef at a Kyoto hotel from 1999, won a Michelin star in the guide's 2010 edition — the only French restaurant among Kyoto's starred Japanese kitchens, by the official profile — and opened La Biographie in 2011. Since 2021 it has been an eight-seat counter with an open kitchen on Shimodachiuri-dori, where the chef cooks and talks across the counter. The omakase begins with a five-taste aperitif and the signature egg, then Kasumi crab with senmaizuke and caviar, Kyoto mushrooms, and Kyoto Hime beef cooked slowly for about 100 minutes. Vegetarian or vegan menus can be arranged in advance. Lunch Friday–Sunday ¥16,500; dinner Wednesday–Sunday from ¥28,000, plus 10% service; booking only.

roles: Owner-chef (official site: chef profile and company founder; signs the shop notices); reviews from January 2025 and October 2026 describe the chef cooking behind the counter
chef_bio.background: Per the official profile: entered cooking as a pâtissier in 1982; trained at a hotel in Kyoto from 1983, then went to Europe; from 1987 trained at hotels and Michelin-starred restaurants in Switzerland and France; returned in 1992 and joined a Kyoto hotel, becoming head chef in 1999; won a star in the Michelin Guide 2010 edition (2009), the only French restaurant to do so in a Kyoto otherwise starred for Japanese cuisine; in 2011 founded 株式会社 T&T カンパニー and opened La Biographie...; selected for La Liste 1000 two years running from 2017; closed the 御池衣棚 shop in 2020 to move, and reopened at Shimodachiuri-dori Senbon in 2021 (Tabelog: 18 March 2021). A February 2024 review gives different years and names: part-time restaurant work from 17 as a pastry cook, the main dining room of the Kyoto Royal Hotel in 1984, Switzerland from 1987 ("International" and "Montre" in Zurich), an auberge in Albertville and "Alcazar" in Paris, back in Japan in 1990 at the Kyoto Brighton Hotel, head chef of its "Vi Za Vi" from 1996, own restaurant in 2011. A January 2025 review says the chef led the Brighton Hotel restaurant for 20 years. The official site reports that the restaurant kept its Michelin star in the 2026 Kyoto/Osaka guide. Tabelog French WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: face each ingredient, judge it, and heat it without stress at the temperature that suits it, to draw out its nature; and a promise to the chef’s teacher, a great French chef, to pass the techniques, spirit and philosophy on to the next generation of Japanese cooks.
chef_bio.specialty: Aperitif of five tastes; the egg "microcosm"; low-temperature Kyoto Hime beef.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 reviewer describes the signature egg as an homage to the "Oeuf à la Coque" of a three-star restaurant in Paris, and a July 2025 reviewer links the chef’s techniques to Alain Passard.
"Handcrafted right in front of us by the chef, who hand-cut the herbs into a bowl." — on the fresh herbal tea, October 2026.
A March 2026 lunch guest found the dishes delicate but the portions small, and the bill with wine, water and service steep for the value.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (la-biographie.info): 歴史ある平安宮中和院跡、下立売通千本に佇む本格フレンチレストラン、上京区田中町422-1 セントガーデン1F、シェフ 滝本 将博 (TAKIMOTO Masahiro)、1982年パティシエとして料理の世界に入る、1983年京都市内のホテルで修業後渡欧、1987年スイス・フランスのホテル、ミシュラン星付きレストランで修業、1992年帰国し京都市内ホテル入社、1999年料理長、2009年ミシュランガイド2010年版で星獲得 (日本料理ばかりの京都で唯一のフランス料理での星)、2011年株式会社 T&T カンパニー設立・La Biographie... 開業、2017年 La Liste 1000 に2年連続選出、2020年御池衣棚での営業を移転準備のため終了、2021年下立売通千本東入るに移転オープン、Michelin Guide 京都/大阪2026で星を維持。Lunch 16,500円 (金・土・日のみ、デザートを含む8皿、約2時間)、Dinner 28,000円・38,500円 (11皿、約2時間半〜3時間)、サービス料10%別、おまかせコースのみ、ベジタリアン・ヴィーガンのメニューも対応、バリアフリー、月曜・火曜定休・不定休、昼12:00 (最終入店) 15時クローズ、夜18:00 (最終入店) 22時クローズ。加熱の哲学: 素材にストレスを与えず心地よい温度帯で加熱。食べログ: フレンチ、完全予約制、8席、アレルギー・ベジタリアン・ヴィーガンは事前に相談 (当日の変更は不可)、2021年3月18日オープン、フレンチ WEST 百名店 2023・2025。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 五味のアペリティフ、卵の小宇宙、Kasumi の蟹、京都の茸のスープ、Kyoto Hime beef の低温焼き、ハーブティー。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online (TableCheck, OMAKASE or Ikkyu) or by phone; state allergies or a vegan menu when booking.

positives.text: Vegetarian and vegan menus can be arranged on request (official site); vegetarian, vegan and allergy requests must be made in advance — no changes on the day (Tabelog).

places.name: 京うどん 生蕎麦 岡北 (Kyo Udon Nama Soba Okakita)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon, soba of unstated buckwheat ratio, tempura, curry sauce and nama-fu (wheat gluten), all in a dashi-based broth (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every bowl sits in dashi — the official site names natural Rishiri kombu, and a May 2026 reviewer tasted kombu and bonito; toppings include chicken, beef, egg, shrimp and herring (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–19:00 (last order 19:00), Monday and Thursday to Sunday; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Expect a queue: 15 people and a 20-minute wait at 13:00 on a holiday Saturday, about 40 minutes on a weekday, five groups ahead 30 minutes before opening (October 2026); a line before 15:00 on a Sunday was gone by 16:30 (November 2026). Staff take orders while you wait, food comes quickly, and diners are expected to finish promptly for the next in line (October 2026). 36 seats; non-smoking; cash only (Tabelog). Children welcome, with child-sized bowls and forks (Tabelog). City bus 5 to the Zoo stop, 2 min north; or 10 min walk from Higashiyama Stn; park in the municipal lot in front for a discount coupon (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, by the zoo and Heian Shrine — 10 min walk from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto udon and fresh soba in Okazaki since 1940 (official site); every noodle dish comes as udon or soba (official menu) · kitsune ¥970 · shippoku ¥1,400 · tori-nanba ¥1,280 · nishin soba ¥1,500 · tempura ¥1,680 · nabeyaki udon ¥1,850 · oyako-nanba ¥1,430 · ten-toji ¥1,780 · tanuki ¥1,100 · noppei ¥1,450 · fresh yuba keiran ¥1,680 · sweet-kitsune curry ¥1,180, tori-nanba curry ¥1,400, beef curry ¥1,950 · seiro (cold) ¥980, ten-seiro ¥2,200 · donburi from tamago-don ¥1,000 and kinugasa-don ¥1,280 to ten-don ¥2,000, each with red-miso soup with fresh yuba (official menu, undated) · tempura udon ¥1,680 and chopped curry udon ¥1,100 (October 2026); beef udon ¥1,850 (May 2026); a one-shrimp tempura udon ¥1,430 and a mini oyako-don (October 2026); curry comes spicy or mild (October 2026)
places.notes: [Udon & soba · Okazaki, Kyoto udon by the zoo] A Kyoto udon house in Okazaki, open since 1940, a few minutes from Heian Shrine and the zoo. The kitchen builds its dashi on natural Rishiri kombu, and the thin, soft Kyoto udon is boiled 10–15 minutes; toppings include fried tofu fried by hand every morning at a local tofu shop and nama-fu from 京麩 半兵衛. The tempura udon — big shrimp, a fluffy egg-thickened broth — and the dashi curry udon are what most reviewers order; any bowl can be had with soba instead. Lines are the rule (20–40 minutes in October 2026); staff take orders in the queue and seat you fast. Cash only. 11:00–19:00, closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: The second generation (official site: 二代目) carries on the founder’s dashi; no one is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in Showa 15 (1940); the founder learned the dashi technique in seventeen years of training, and the second generation has refined it over more than fifty years. Ingredients named on the site: buckwheat flour from the foot of 白山 in Ishikawa, organic rice, nama-fu from 京麩 半兵衛, fresh yuba, domestic wagyu and young chicken, wild shrimp, fried tofu fried by hand each morning at a local tofu shop, and Kyoto vegetables. The interior has wooden chairs made by craftsmen and karakami paper with an autumn-grass pattern printed from woodblocks in use since the Edo period. Renewal opened on 20 August 2008 (Tabelog). Tabelog Udon "Tabelog 100" 2017–2019 and Udon WEST 2020, 2024.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "dashi is the life of Kyoto udon"; to serve a gentle, warm bowl, boiling thin noodles 10–15 minutes while "checking their mood" so they come out glossy with some bite.
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura udon; curry udon; kitsune.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 regular noted many foreign visitors, who tended to linger after eating, lengthening the wait outside.
An October 2026 diner gave an order while still in the queue and had the food almost as soon as being seated.
"The staff was attentive, frequently checking on us and taking orders while we waited" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-okakita.com): 京うどん 生蕎麦 岡北、創業昭和15年、石川県白山山麓産のそば粉、有機米、京麩 半兵衛さんの生麩、生湯葉、国産和牛、若鶏、天然海老、毎朝手揚げの地元豆腐店のおあげさん、京野菜、出汁は天然利尻昆布のみを使用、初代が十七年の修行で修得した技法を二代目が五十年余りで培った技で仕上げる、細めの麺を10分から15分ゆがく、職人手製の木製椅子、江戸時代からの版木で刷った秋草模様の唐紙、左京区岡崎南御所町34、市バス「動物園前」から北へ徒歩2分、11:00〜19:00 (L.O.)、毎週火曜日・水曜日定休。おしながき: きつね970円、しっぽく1,400円、鳥なんば1,280円、にしんそば1,500円、天ぷらそば1,680円、鍋焼きうどん1,850円、親子なんば1,430円、天とじ1,780円、たぬき1,100円、のっぺい1,450円、生湯葉けいらん1,680円、甘ぎつねカレー1,180円、鳥なんばカレー1,400円、肉カレー1,950円、せいろ980円、天せいろ2,200円 (うどんか蕎麦を選べる)、丼もの: 玉子丼1,000円〜天丼2,000円 (生湯葉入赤だし付き)。食べログ: うどん・そば・丼、予約不可、36席、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、子供用の器とフォーク、2008年8月20日リニューアルオープン、うどん百名店 2017〜2019、うどん WEST 百名店 2020・2024。口コミ (2026年5〜11月、英語): 行列 (20〜40分)、並んでいる間に注文、天ぷらうどん1,680円、カレーうどん、肉うどん1,850円、カレーは辛口と甘口。

cultural_comfort.note: Join the queue; staff take your order in line. Udon or soba for any bowl; cash only.

places.name: 京料理 御旅町田ごと (Tagoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. The operator lists gluten-free, vegan and vegetarian options on Tabelog, and the English page says dietary restrictions and food allergies can be accommodated; but this is Kyoto cuisine built on broth and seasonings, and no gluten-free dish is named (Tabelog; official site).
places.vegan_detail: Ask in advance. The English page says vegetarian or vegan meals can be provided if the shop is told ahead, and notes that the broth for most dishes is made with bonito; the standard bento, yuba and kaiseki menus include fish (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00; dinner 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Wednesday and the second Thursday (open on public holidays) (official site; Tabelog). Bookings by phone (toll-free 0120-307-361) or online; a 2-hour stay for lunch and dinner; seat requests (window, quiet room) cannot be taken; changes on the day by phone only (Tabelog). Dishes are decided at booking to cut food waste (Tabelog). The third-floor rooms take only kaiseki of ¥11,000 or more, with a room charge; a service charge applies at lunch and dinner (official site). 108 seats over three floors: tables, sunken kotatsu seats and tatami rooms, up to 32 in the hall; elevator; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR payments; English menu (Tabelog). 1 min from Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn exit 6; partner parking at フヤ町パーキング, 2 hours free for groups spending ¥6,000 or more (official site).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori at Kawaramachi, opposite Takashimaya — 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn exit 6
places.cuisine: Kyoto cuisine with Kyoto vegetables and seasonal ingredients (official site) · Kōetsu mizusashi bento, served in a copy of a water jar by the early-Edo artist 本阿弥光悦, from ¥4,950; November version with a sea bream and turnip hot pot and sashimi ¥7,700 · yuba course from ¥4,950 · lunch kaiseki ¥7,700 · kaiseki 「うさぎ」 ¥11,000, 「杵」 ¥13,200, 「臼」 ¥16,500, 「鶴」 ¥22,000, drinks and service extra (official site, prices with tax) · tempura soba and kabura-mushi at lunch (February 2026) · house sake (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Shijo Kawaramachi, a house from 1871] A Kyoto-cuisine restaurant founded in 1871, now in its fifth generation (堀部素久, per the company site) and on Shijo Otabi-cho since moving here from Shinkyogoku after the war. Behind the noren: tables and kotatsu seats downstairs, private rooms and a hall above, a small courtyard garden. The house dish is the Kōetsu mizusashi bento (from ¥4,950), with a yuba course and kaiseki from ¥11,000; English menu, and vegan meals if asked ahead. Lunch 11:30–15:00, dinner to 21:00; closed Wednesday and the second Thursday.

roles: Fifth-generation head of the house and representative director of 株式会社田ごと (company site); the kitchen staff are not named
chef_bio.background: Per the company history page: founded in 1871 (Meiji 4) by 堀部徳兵衛; the second generation renamed the shop from 田毎 to 田ごと in 1938; in 1945, after the war, the shop moved from Shinkyogoku to Shijo Otabi-cho, where it still runs as the Shijo honten; 株式会社田ごと was set up in 1950; the Keio department store shop in Shinjuku opened in 1964; the honten was rebuilt and reopened in 2008; Kyoto Prefecture "Kyoto shinise" award 2013; listed as a provider of seasonal Kyoto vegetables 2014. Today the company runs the Shijo honten, the Shinjuku Keio shop, the Kyoto Takashimaya shop and the Kyoto Porta shop (soba), and sells Kyoto bento at Kyoto Isetan and in Kyoto Station.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to bring out the best of Kyoto vegetables and nature’s ingredients, express the turning seasons, and give the menu life through a Kyoto sense of beauty. Per Tabelog (operator text): "Cherishing a Simple and Pure Heart."
chef_bio.specialty: Kōetsu mizusashi bento; yuba course; Kyoto kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: "Nearly 40 years ago, I had my first taste of yuba at this restaurant during a family trip to Kyoto." The reviewer came back for a yuba course and chilled sake — August 2026.
A solo diner, put off by the "somewhat intimidating entrance", found staff who said dining alone was fine and seated the reviewer away from larger groups; yuba course ¥5,170 — July 2026.
Lunch kaiseki ¥6,600 with hamo sashimi and Kamo eggplant dengaku, finishing with matcha shaved ice; the reviewer usually eats at the Takashimaya branch across the street — July 2026.
An April 2026 visitor noted many elderly diners and international visitors, Wi-Fi, a courtyard and staff in traditional dress; Kōetsu mizusashi bento ¥4,840.
A September 2026 lunch guest praised the garden-view room but found the wait after the hassun long and the service "somewhat clumsy".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-tagoto.co.jp): 京料理 御旅町田ごと、下京区四条通寺町東入御旅町34番地、阪急河原町駅6番出口から東へ約10メートル、ご昼食11:30〜15:00、ご夕食17:00〜21:00 (L.O20:00)、定休日 水曜日・第2木曜日 (祝日を除く)、霜月の光悦水指弁当 (鯛かぶら鍋とお造り付) 税込7,700円、光悦水指弁当 税込4,950円〜、ゆば料理 税込4,950円〜、お昼の会席 税込7,700円、会席「うさぎ」11,000円・「杵」13,200円・「臼」16,500円・「鶴」22,000円 (税込、飲み物・サービス料別)、3階のお座敷は11,000円以上の会席で別途お部屋代。歴史: 明治4年 (1871年) 初代 堀部徳兵衛、昭和13年「田毎」から田ごとに改名、昭和20年 新京極から四条御旅町に移転、昭和25年 株式会社田ごと設立、昭和39年 新宿京王百貨店に「田ごと光悦舗」、平成20年 本店新装開店、平成25年 京都老舗表彰、五代目 堀部素久 (代表取締役)、現在は四条本店・新宿京王店・京都高島屋店・京都ポルタ店。英語ページ: ベジタリアン・ヴィーガン料理は事前連絡で対応、ほとんどの料理の出汁は鰹。食べログ: 京料理、108席、個室あり、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語メニュー、英語・中国語のスタッフ、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーのオプション (店舗情報)。口コミ (2026年1〜9月、英語): ゆば料理、光悦水指弁当、昼の会席、天ぷらそば、かぶら蒸し。

cultural_comfort.note: English page and English menu; Tabelog lists English- and Chinese-speaking staff. Book by phone or online.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The English page says: "We can accommodate special requests, food preferences and dietary restrictions, including children's menus and food allergies. Please note that the broth used for most of our dishes is made with bonito (fish)." It also says vegetarian or vegan meals can be provided with advance notice.

places.name: サラダの店 サンチョ 河原町本店 (Salad no Mise Sancho Kawaramachi Honten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the grills are fried shrimp, chicken and beef cutlets, minced cutlets, crab-cream croquettes and teriyaki steak, served with rice or a roll; no gluten information (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Every grill is meat, seafood or egg; the green salad (six vegetables, house dressing ¥750) and the fresh fruit juices are the plant-based items, but the dressing ingredients are not published, and reviewers mention a homemade mayonnaise (official menu; April 2026).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–22:00 (last order 21:00), basically closed 15:30–17:00; lunch menu 11:30–15:30 (official site). Closed Wednesday, plus two extra closing days a month, mostly Tuesdays; the 2026 calendar lists 10 and 24 November, 8 and 22 December, and 30 December–6 January (official site). No bookings; queues of 30 minutes to over an hour are usual, and a reviewer advises joining by about 14:45 for lunch (2026 reviews). Takeaway grills, salads and dressings; dressings ship nationwide (official site). 20 seats (8 counter, 12 table); non-smoking; cash only (Tabelog). 50 m north of Shijo-Kawaramachi, beside Mizuho Bank (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Just north of Shijo-Kawaramachi, beside Mizuho Bank — 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Salad shop and western-style grill since 1972; every grill comes with a six-vegetable green salad in the house dressing (official site) · weekday lunch with salad and rice or a roll: omelette and crab-cream croquette ¥1,200, teriyaki steak and croquette ¥1,480 (+¥150 for a fresh juice) · weekend lunch with fresh juice: A ¥1,400, B (hamburg steak, croquette, fried shrimp) ¥1,600, C (teriyaki steak, croquette, fried shrimp) ¥1,880 · teriyaki steak and salad ¥1,880, handmade hamburg steak ¥1,330, demi-glace hamburg ¥1,560, shiso chicken cutlet with cheese ¥1,390 · Select set ¥2,880 · about 18 salads from ¥750 · fresh banana, lemon, pineapple and seasonal fruit juices · house dressings ¥650 a bottle (official menu, prices with tax)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Shijo-Kawaramachi, salads and teriyaki steak since 1972] A small white-walled western-style diner off Shijo that opened in 1972 as a salad specialist: every grill — teriyaki steak, hamburg steak, crab-cream croquettes, fried shrimp — comes with a big, crisp six-vegetable salad in the house dressing, and the lunch sets add rice or a roll and a fresh fruit juice. Weekday lunch from ¥1,200; teriyaki steak with salad ¥1,880. Twenty seats and no bookings, so expect a queue. Cash only; closed Wednesday and two other days a month.

roles: Owner (unnamed; the site carries an "owner diary"); run by サンチョ株式会社
chef_bio.background: Per the shop history page: opened in 1972 (Showa 47) as a salad specialist at the present Kawaramachi honten, as an individual business; became サンチョ株式会社 in 1975; opened a Fushimi branch in 1980 and later other branches; featured in non-no (1979) and other magazines; from 1991 grew its own organic rice and from 1994 bought direct from organic farmers. Today the site lists two shops, the Kawaramachi honten and Fushimi. The company marked its 54th year in September 2026 (owner diary).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: carefully chosen fresh vegetables and additive-free ingredients, to serve food that is as kind to the body and as tasty as possible; the crispness of the salad unchanged since 1972.
chef_bio.specialty: Green salad with house dressing; teriyaki steak; lunch sets with fresh juice.

anecdotes.text: "I've been a fan of this gem since a friend took me here over 30 years ago." — August 2026.
An August 2026 visitor advised lining up by about 14:45 for lunch, as a first-round miss can mean an hour in the sun, and wished the shop handed out tickets; the staff were friendly and cheerful.
B lunch ¥1,600 after a wait of about 1 hour 10 minutes from before noon — September 2026.
On the weekday lunch, skipping the salad takes ¥200 off; the reviewer kept it — September 2026.
Juice was being made from freshly cut fruit, a diner saw — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sancho.co.jp): 1972年にサラダの専門店としてオープン、厳選した新鮮な野菜と添加物を使用していない素材、6種類の野菜のグリーンサラダと自家製ドレッシングを全てのグリルに、約18種のサラダ、河原町店 11:30〜22:00 (21:00ラストオーダー、15:30〜17:00は基本的にクローズ)、水曜定休・月2回は連休、中京区裏寺町通四条上ル中之町572。平日ランチ: オムコロランチ1,200円、照り玉バーグランチ1,250円、フライランチ1,300円、テリコロランチ1,480円、ミックスランチ1,230円、ミニジュースセット+150円。土日ランチ (本日の生ジュース付き): Aランチ1,400円、Bランチ1,600円、Cランチ1,880円。照焼ステーキとサラダ1,880円、手作りハンバーグとサラダ1,330円、デミグラスハンバーグとサラダ1,560円、セレクトセット2,880円、グリーンサラダ750円、自家製ドレッシング各650円 (税込)。2026年5月1日から照焼用牛肉とワインの価格改定。2026年の臨時休業日 (11月10日・24日、12月8日・22日、12月30日〜1月6日)。サンチョの歩み: 昭和47年 個人の店として開店、昭和50年 サンチョ株式会社、昭和55年 伏見支店。食べログ: 洋食・ハンバーグ・ステーキ、20席 (カウンター8、テーブル12)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙。口コミ (2026年4〜10月、英語): 行列30分〜1時間超、照焼ステーキ、生ジュース、サラダ。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue outside (no bookings); a counter suits solo diners; cash only.

places.name: まっしゅ京都 (MASH Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery — baguettes, pain de mie, croissants, filled buns and sandwiches (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Many breads carry cream, cheese, bacon or egg; plain loaves such as the long-fermented baguette may suit, but no ingredient list is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 8:00–19:30, Monday and Thursday to Sunday; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog; official site). Closes when sold out (2023 article); reviewers in September–October 2026 found most shelves empty by 9:30–11:00, so go early. Takeaway only, with no café corner or eat-in (Tabelog); the shop’s own site, last updated in 2017, still lists a second-floor café, Cafe 8 huit. Cards accepted (Tabelog). East of Karasuma on Takatsuji-dori, just south of the corner by the Nikko Princess hotel; 4 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2023 article). Narrow street: no stopping by car (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takatsuji, a short walk east of Karasuma — 4 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Bakery in a renovated old house, opened 2004, with Kyoto-sweet-style buns (Tabelog; 2023 article) · 藤壷 Fujitsubo, a matcha anpan (¥410 in October 2026) · 花のいろは。, a purple-sweet-potato anpan with a violet on top · 六条御息所, black-cocoa dough with strawberry and raspberry jam and custard · 粽あんぱん shaped like a chimaki · にぬき sandwich of hard-boiled egg, cheese and ham (official site; 2023 article) · long-fermented baguette and épi; shio-koji dough breads (official site) · croissant ¥280, pain de mie ¥290, tandoori chicken bread ¥370, shio-koji bacon ¥290, Kujo-negi and bacon bake, croque monsieur, curry bread, lemon cream sweet wrapped in bamboo leaf (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bakery · Karasuma-Takatsuji, breads like Kyoto sweets] A bakery in a renovated old house near Karasuma-Takatsuji, opened in 2004 by the owner-baker 増野, who trained in Paris before coming home to Kyoto. It is known for buns made to look like wagashi: the green matcha anpan 藤壷 (Fujitsubo), the purple-potato 花のいろは。 with a violet on top, and the jam-and-custard 六条御息所 — plus a long-fermented baguette and generous croissants (¥280). Most shelves are empty by mid-morning. Takeaway only; cards accepted; closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Bread WEST Tabelog 100, 2020, 2022 and 2026.

chef_bio.origin: Kyoto (the article says the shop opened in the owner's home town).
chef_bio.background: Per a ルルブ article (updated 29 July 2023): the owner-baker found the fun of bread at a Japanese bakery, decided to become a baker, went to Paris to train because "if I aim for it, I have to know the real thing", and after training opened the shop in home-town Kyoto; the building is a renovated old house. Opened 25 March 2004 (Tabelog). Tabelog Bread WEST "Tabelog 100" 2020, 2022, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "パンを探究する毎日" — every day spent exploring bread; per the 2023 article, the owner wanted to make "interesting breads that feel like Kyoto".
chef_bio.specialty: 藤壷 (Fujitsubo) matcha anpan; 花のいろは。; long-fermented baguette.

anecdotes.text: Arriving around 11:00, a September 2026 reviewer found about 80% sold out; the Fujitsubo had no noticeable matcha flavour, though the red bean filling was tasty, and the bread itself was "just average in both texture and flavor".
"I was surprised by the size of the croissant." At ¥280 it was "a great price" — September 2026.
A lemon cream sweet came wrapped in bamboo leaves, "making a striking presentation" — October 2026.
At 9:30 most items were sold out; the Kujo-negi and bacon bake and a croque monsieur were being finished in the back — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (mashkyoto.com、2017年まで更新): ブランジュリーまっしゅ京都、京都四条烏丸近く東洞院高辻、8:00am〜7:30pm、火・水曜定休、2F「Cafe 8 huit」(12:00〜18:30頃)、長時間低温熟成発酵のフランスパン (バゲット、エピ、ブール)、塩糀種の小物フランス、京菓子パン: 紫芋のあんぱん「花のいろは。」、抹茶のあんぱん「藤壷-fujitsubo」、桜型のメロンパン。ルルブ (2023年7月29日更新): オーナー兼ブーランジェの増野さん、日本のベーカリーでパンのおもしろさに触れ、フランス・パリで修行、地元の京都で開店、古民家を改築した建物、「京都らしい、おもしろいパンを作りたい」、花のいろは299円、粽あんぱん275円、藤壺297円、六条御息所297円 (ブラックココアの生地にいちごジャム・ラズベリージャム・カスタードクリーム)、にぬき318円、売り切れ次第終了。食べログ: パン・サンドイッチ・スイーツ、下京区東洞院通高辻下る燈籠町568、月・木〜日 8:00〜19:30、火・水休み、テイクアウトのみ (イートインなし)、カード可、2004年3月25日オープン、パン WEST 百名店 2020・2022・2026。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): 早い時間に売り切れ、藤壷410円、クロワッサン280円、食パン290円、タンドリーチキン370円、塩糀ベーコン290円。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-serve bakery; point and pay at the counter; cards accepted.

places.name: レーヌ デ プレ (Reine des prés)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. A single omakase course with bread (ciabatta, baguette), pastry desserts and butter or wine sauces; the shop asks guests to state allergies and disliked ingredients in advance and cannot change the menu on the day (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the omakase course is built on fish, shellfish, meat, foie gras, consommé and egg, and the menu is not changed on the day (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30 (last entry 12:00); dinner 18:00 (last entry 19:00); Tabelog gives 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–23:00. Closed Wednesday and the second and third Thursday (may vary); summer break 16–22 August 2026 (official site; Tabelog). Reservation only, by phone, at least two days ahead (same day sometimes possible); 100% cancellation charge from three days before; overseas guests book through Pocket Concierge (official site). Allergies and dislikes must be told in advance (Tabelog). Lunch course ¥11,000, dinner ¥22,000, plus 10% service; wine pairing ¥10,000 (tasting) or ¥16,000 (standard) (official site). Dress code: smart casual, no shorts, short trousers or beach sandals; children from middle-school age, younger only for private bookings (official site; Tabelog). 6 seats; private hire for about 8; non-smoking; cards accepted (official site; Tabelog). 3 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: A quiet street south of Marutamachi, west of the Kamo River — 3 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Six-seat French omakase: "ingredients × heat × simplicity", at most three ingredients on a plate, served on Kiyomizu-ware made with the artists (official site; Michelin Guide) · lunch course ¥11,000, dinner ¥22,000 (official site) · signatures in 2026 reviews: tomato consommé in a matcha bowl, 師へのオマージュ (Homage to the Master: egg yolk in its shell with maple syrup and sherry vinegar), 遊びゴコロ (Playful Spirit) small plates, "Premium Pumpkin" ice cream with pumpkin soup, ciabatta kept warm on a hot stone, Mimasaka venison with Manganji pepper stuffed with foie gras, low-temperature Kagoshima black wagyu · tea chosen by scent from about six · over 200 wines chosen by the sommelier-qualified chef (Tabelog)
places.notes: [French · Marutamachi, six seats and three ingredients a plate] A six-seat French restaurant on a quiet street near Jingu-Marutamachi, opened in 2012, with wood and stone like a chef's home and dishes on Kiyomizu-ware made with the artists. Only an omakase course: ingredients picked from producers, gently cooked at low temperature, no more than three on a plate — the egg 'Homage to the Master' with maple syrup, a tomato consommé drunk from a matcha bowl, venison with foie-gras-stuffed Manganji pepper. Lunch ¥11,000, dinner ¥22,000 (+10%). Book by phone two days ahead (overseas guests via Pocket Concierge); smart casual. Closed Wednesday and the second and third Thursday.

roles: Chef ("Chef Akai" in a February 2026 review); sommelier-qualified (official site)
chef_bio.background: Opened 26 November 2012 (Tabelog). Per the operator’s Tabelog text: 13 consecutive years in the Michelin Guide and 7 in Gault & Millau; Tabelog French WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023, 2025. Per the official site: the chef visits producers, buys directly, and works with ceramic artists on one-of-a-kind dishes; suppliers named in 2026 news include 桃里庵 peaches from Okayama, asparagus from ジェットファーム長谷川 and あいち鴨 duck from Toyohashi; in October 2026 the restaurant held its first curry event at じんぐうみち, an event space by Heian Shrine.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "素材 × 火入れ × シンプル" — share the vegetables and ingredients producers have raised with care, cook them with the heat the chef has in mind, and finish them as simply as possible with a sense of the season. Per the Michelin Guide: no more than three ingredients on a plate, so a diner can tell what is on the plate.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase course; 師へのオマージュ egg; tomato consommé.

anecdotes.text: The chef came to the table to explain an approach of blending the essence of Japanese cuisine with French technique, for "depth" beyond immediate deliciousness — January 2026.
For tea, six test tubes were set out to smell before choosing — January 2026.
"Served in a matcha bowl, you drink it just like enjoying a cup of matcha." (the tomato consommé) — September 2026; the same reviewer found the drink menu "a bit too small to read".
A solo lunch guest talked with the serving staff about the tableware and Kyoto — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (reine-des-pres.com): 素材はすべて自ら選びとった上質なもの、仕上げは極上のシンプル、おまかせコースのみ、ランチ11,000円・ディナー22,000円 (税込、サービス料10%別)、ワインペアリング デギュスタシオン10,000円・スタンダード16,000円、ソムリエの資格を持つシェフ、コンセプト「素材×火入れ×シンプル」、作家さんと唯一無二の器、予約は電話 (075-223-2337)、2日前完全予約制、キャンセルは3日前から100%、ドレスコード (短パン、ふくらはぎより短いパンツ、ビーチサンダル等は不可)、上京区中町通丸太町下ル駒之町537-1、京阪神宮丸太町から徒歩3分、ランチ11:30〜12:00 (L.O)、ディナー18:00〜19:00 (L.O)、水曜・第2第3木曜休み (変動あり)、6席、貸切8人、海外の方は Pocket Concierge から予約、お知らせ: 8月16〜22日夏季休暇、岡山 桃里庵の桃、ジェットファーム長谷川の夏アスパラ、あいち鴨、じんぐうみちでのカレーイベント。ミシュランガイド: シェフのテーマは素材、火入れ、シンプル、一皿の食材は三つまで、清水焼の器。食べログ: フレンチ・創作料理・イノベーティブ、予約のみ、6席、カード可、サービス料10%、2012年11月26日オープン、フレンチ WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2025、アレルギーと苦手な食材は事前に、中学生以上。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年9月、英語): トマトのコンソメ、師へのオマージュ、遊びゴコロ、プレミアムかぼちゃ、ジビエ、試験管のお茶、Akai シェフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone two days ahead, or via Pocket Concierge from overseas; tell allergies when booking; smart casual.

places.name: ekaki
places.gf_detail: Ask. The menu mixes fritters, fries, spring-roll sausages, quiche, gratin, toast and pasta with salads, cheeses, charcuterie and grilled meat; no gluten information (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A few vegetable plates (salted boiled peanuts, black edamame pickles, salads, fritters, fries with black shichimi) sit among meat, cheese and egg dishes; dishes are cooked to the size of the group, so ask (official menu; March 2026).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–22:00 daily (Tabelog), but hours vary: the official site posts the day’s hours (4 November: 15:00–22:00, for drinkers only), and a reviewer advises checking Instagram (April 2026). Tabelog says reservations are taken and the site gives a phone number for same-day bookings and changes, yet an April 2026 reviewer called it "a popular restaurant that doesn’t take reservations". House rules (official site): order at least 2 drinks a person (the menu says 2 to 10); dishes are cooked to the size of the group; seats are limited to 2 hours when busy; one cook makes almost everything, so food takes time; when very busy, guests wanting only drinks may be turned away. The menu has no prices (November 2025; April 2026). Japanese menu only, and staff mostly speak Japanese (official site, in English); wines explained via mobile ordering (January 2026). Cards (JCB per Tabelog; contactless per the site), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats on two floors with a counter, and benches outside (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Red door, a short alley off the main street; 2 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu) (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 20 May 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Alley off Kawaramachi south of Shijo — 2 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small-plates izakaya with natural wine, from a chef who studied natural wine and French cuisine (official site): glass and bottle wines (ask the staff), draft Sapporo, grape beer, sake from Nara, Shimane, Tottori and more, shochu, cardamom shochu, fresh-squeezed sours, 季の美 gin (official menu) · plates: anchovy oeufs mayo, sweet potato and cardamom potage, fig with burrata, salad lyonnaise with liver paste and bacon, Tanba chestnuts fried, fries (black shichimi, ketchup or shiso salsa verde), mussels in white wine, quiche, busiate pasta with squid in oil, tripe and chickpeas in tomato, spare ribs in balsamic, duck breast, beef kainomi (flap) steak, croque monsieur (until 16:00), raisin butter, dashi omelette (official menu) · desserts: pudding, walnut and fig tart, fruit gratin (official menu) · a March 2026 bill: beet, Treviso and soft egg salad, fries, grape beer and cardamom soda, ¥2,550
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kawaramachi, natural wine behind a red door] A small two-floor bistro-izakaya with a red front and benches outside, a short alley off Kawaramachi, open from midday: natural wines chosen to your taste, and plates cooked by one chef who studied natural wine and French cuisine — flap steak, dashi omelette, raisin butter, beet salads, mussels, a chestnut soup in autumn. Portions are big and scaled to the group; order at least two drinks each; the menu has no prices, and reviewers paid about ¥2,000–10,000 a head. Japanese menu only — the shop asks you to try ordering in Japanese. Hours change day to day; check the site or Instagram.

roles: Chef (unnamed), who cooks almost everything alone (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (in English): "We’re an izakaya, not a bar"; the chef studied natural wine and French cuisine; one chef makes almost everything. The site lists a sister shop 200 m away, chichi (croissant soft-serve, wine and a gallery space), and sells ekaki goods (stickers, plates, glasses, a logo long-tee). Opened 20 May 2015 (Tabelog). An April 2026 reviewer heard that the owner is sometimes in and sometimes not, which can change the menu; on the second visit the beef steak was not available.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "let’s enjoy good food, good drinks, and a good time together!"
chef_bio.specialty: Beef flap steak; dashi omelette; raisin butter.

anecdotes.text: "I had some concerns, such as the lack of prices on the menu and the two-drink minimum per person, but in the end, it was an amazing experience!" — November 2025.
"The selection of natural wines was truly impressive, and they made perfect suggestions based on my specific requests." — December 2025.
"I was particularly impressed by the chestnut soup I had at the end! The soup was topped with cocoa" — October 2025.
"The service wasn’t cold, but rather dry with a comfortable distance." The same reviewer noted "Allergy accommodations: Yes". — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ekaki-kyoto.crayonsite.info): その日の営業時間を掲載 (11/4 15:00〜22:00 お酒飲まれる方のみ)、御注文は口頭、人数に合わせて料理、お酒一人2杯〜10杯、お会計はお席で、クレジットカードタッチ決済可、混雑時お席2時間制、1人で料理を作っております、メニュー: グラスワイン・ボトルワイン、生ビール サッポロ、ぶどうビール、日本酒 (奈良・島根・鳥取ほか)、カルダモン焼酎、生搾り酎ハイ、季の美、大人プリン、塩ゆで落花生、アンチョビウフマヨ、焼き芋とカルダモンのポタージュ、いちぢくとブッラータチーズ、サラダリヨネーズ、丹波栗の素揚げ、フライドポテト (黒七味)、ムール貝の白ワイン蒸し、海老とほうれん草のキッシュ、イカのオイルパスタ ブジアーテ、ハチノスとひよこ豆のトマト煮、豚スペアリブのバルサミコ煮、鴨胸ロースト、牛カイノミステーキ、クロックムッシュ (16:00迄)、レーズンバター、出汁オムレツ、当日予約や変更は電話で、系列店 chichi (200mの所、クロワッサンコーン ソフトクリーム、ワイン)。英語の案内: 日本語のメニューのみ、スタッフは主に日本語、シェフは自然派ワインとフランス料理を学んだ。食べログ: ビストロ・バー、下京区貞安前之町611-3、阪急河原町駅から徒歩2分、毎日12:00〜22:00、予約可、20席、カード可 (JCB)、2015年5月20日オープン。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年4月、英語): 値段のないメニュー、2杯以上の注文、自然派ワイン、ハラミステーキ、出汁オムレツ、レーズンバター、栗のスープ、赤い扉、2階席、外のベンチ。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese menu only, staff mostly speak Japanese, and the shop asks guests to try ordering in Japanese (official site). At least 2 drinks each.

places.name: 京極スタンド (Kyogoku Stand)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: much of the menu is breaded and fried (croquettes, tonkatsu, mixed fry, aji fry, eel tempura), with ramen, fried noodles, curries and shumai (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden and simmered dishes in dashi, fried meat and fish, and set meals with miso soup; Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but nothing is marked vegan (official menu; Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–21:00; closed Tuesday (official site; Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); tables are shared, and a seat at the counter is usually found for one (2026 reviews). Except with set meals, each person orders at least one drink and one dish (September and October 2026). A red slip is left on the table and taken to the register, where the bill is added up on an abacus (2026 reviews). Cash only; smoking allowed, and tobacco is sold inside (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). English menu available (Tabelog). 42 seats: a 20-seat counter, three tables for six and one for four (Tabelog). On Shinkyogoku just north of Shijo, near Nishiki Tenmangu; a short walk from Kawaramachi Stn exit 9 (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Shinkyogoku arcade just north of Shijo — a short walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Taishu sakaba and shokudo from 1927 serving set meals, Western-style, Japanese and Chinese dishes and drinks (official site) · 2026 prices: homemade croquette ¥800, agedashi eggplant ¥650 (October 2026); kizushi ¥800, hiyayakko ¥400, simmered atsuage and eggplant ¥450 (August 2026); appetiser plate ¥900, potato salad ¥500 (October 2026) · also oden, aji fry, eel tempura, hamo tempura, shumai, uzaku, grilled horumon, smoked duck (2026 reviews) · daily set meal, omelette curry, om-demiglace don, fried noodles, ramen, karaage (official menu, older prices) · Kirin draft ¥650, large ¥950, lemon chuhai ¥550 (October 2026); Gekkeikan sakes including Kyo no Izumi ¥800 (August 2026) and the Gekkeikan "伝匠", sold only at selected shops (official site)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shinkyogoku, a 1927 tavern with an abacus at the till] A real Showa-era taishu sakaba on the Shinkyogoku arcade, opened in 1927 by a founder who had come from Asakusa after the Great Kanto Earthquake, as a 'ten-sen shokudo' where everything cost ten sen. The marble counter and tables are the originals. Drink from noon at the counter or share a long table: Kirin draft, Gekkeikan sake, homemade croquettes (¥800), kizushi, oden, aji fry. A red slip goes to the register, where the bill is added on an abacus. Cash only; smoking allowed; at least one drink and one dish each. Closed Tuesday. One long-time customer found the food rushed and a server loud in October 2026, but keeps coming for the building and the atmosphere.

roles: Owner at the register (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the first owner moved from Asakusa in Tokyo after the Great Kanto Earthquake and opened the shop in 1927 (Showa 2) in a Taisho-era building, as a "ten-sen shokudo" where everything cost ten sen; at first there was also a Stand north shop, and stalls in Yasaka Shrine and Maruyama Park in cherry-blossom season; the marble counter and tables are as they were at the founding, along with an early electric register and early-Showa posters. The site calls it "real Showa retro", not made up. Reviews in 2026 describe the owner at the register adding bills on a five-bead abacus.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: the menu keeps the taste, recipes and work of the founder’s day.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade croquette; oden; set meals.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor chatted with the owner about the five-bead abacus at the register; the owner said, "It’s never too late to start."
"The owner was quickly calculating with an abacus, and it came to exactly JPY 3000!" — March 2026.

An October 2026 visitor, a customer since living in Kyoto years ago, found the food rushed, the potato salad supermarket-like and a server loud about the shop’s operations, and comes "for the location, the building, and the atmosphere".
"Outside, there were many foreign tourists, but inside felt purely Japanese, with a nostalgic atmosphere as if time had stopped." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (shinkyogoku-stand.jp、新京極スタンド): 昭和２年創業の大衆酒場、営業時間12:00〜21:00、火曜日休み、中京区新京極通り四条上ル、関東大震災で東京浅草から移ってきた一代目が大正時代の建物で創めた大衆食堂、十銭食堂としてスタート、スタンド北店、八坂神社・円山公園内にも出店、大理石のカウンターとテーブルは創業当時そのまま、電動式のレジ、昭和初期のポスター、メニュー: 日替定食、オムデミグラスソース丼、揚げそば、ラーメン、おでん、自家製コロッケ、鶏のから揚げ、月桂冠「伝匠」、キリン満点生の店 (価格は当時のもの)。食べログ: 居酒屋・コロッケ・食堂、中京区新京極通四条上ル中之町546、12:00〜21:00、火曜休み、予約不可、42席、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、喫煙可、店内でたばこ販売、英語メニューあり、ベジタリアンメニューあり。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 昼飲み、相席、赤い伝票、そろばんで会計、コロッケ800円、揚げ出し茄子650円、きずし800円、生ビール650円、一人一品一ドリンク、喫煙可。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; say how many and take the seat offered; take the red slip to the register; cash only; smoky.

places.name: 藤むら (Fujimura)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku with a different sauce for each cut, ponzu with grated daikon for the yaki-shabu, and garlic with the steak; no gluten information (2026 reviews; a Kyoto guide site, undated).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef yakiniku house; the sides are kimchi, namul, bibimbap and rice (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–21:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog; June 2026). Book ahead: reviewers booked a month out (August 2026) or found it full (2026 reviews), and some got in when a seat opened (June and July 2026); one booked without being able to choose the time (September 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). 16 seats: 4 at the counter, a table and two tatami tables; non-smoking, with ashtrays outside (Tabelog). No parking; coin parking nearby (Tabelog). On Bukkoji-dori west of Aburanokoji; 5 min by taxi from Kyoto Stn; 462 m from Omiya Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Bukkoji-dori west of Aburanokoji, southwest of Shijo Karasuma — 462 m from Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood yakiniku of mostly lean beef; the house recommends four cuts in order — ichibo (sirloin cap) steak, yaki-shabu, premium tongue and filet — each with its own sauce (2026 reviews) · September 2026 prices: filet ¥2,900, yaki-shabu ¥2,000, special loin ¥2,000, premium tongue ¥1,800, special kalbi ¥1,500, ichibo steak ¥1,500, tetchan ¥800, rice ¥500, chuhai ¥600 · kimchi ¥600, highball ¥600 (June 2026) · also mino (premium tripe) with sauce, liver, outside skirt, namul, bibimbap without gochujang (2025–2026 reviews) · an undated Kyoto guide site describes Omi beef, 8–9 lean cuts, an ichibo tataki when fresh stock comes in, and yaki-shabu eaten with grated daikon and ponzu
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Bukkoji-Aburanokoji, a family's lean-beef counter] A small, retro neighbourhood yakiniku house run by a family, where the owner steers you through four cuts in a set order — ichibo steak, yaki-shabu, premium tongue, then filet — each with its own sauce; one regular's group added the premium tripe and tetchan and found them a pleasant surprise. A September 2026 bill for a group of plates came to ¥13,600; most reviewers paid ¥6,000–10,000 a head. In Tabelog's Yakiniku or Grill 100 lists in 2018 and every year from 2020 to 2026. Cash only; book well ahead; 17:00–21:30, closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: "run by a family" in blue work aprons (August 2025); a regular wrote in September 2026 that "the usual mother wasn’t there, and it was just the father and son running the place"; the owner recommends the cuts and the order (2026 reviews), and a hostess explains which sauce goes with which cut (July 2026). Tabelog Yakiniku "Tabelog 100" 2018, Yakiniku WEST 2020–2023, 2025, Grill WEST 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Ichibo steak; yaki-shabu; premium tongue; filet.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular: the shop serves the ichibo steak first, then yaki-shabu, premium tongue and filet; reordering the ichibo afterwards felt milder, but it came back to life with the grated garlic on the plate.
"It was a popular spot and fully booked, but they kindly called me when a table became available" — June 2026.
The owner asked a solo diner whether the portions would be manageable, then guided the order: ichibo steak, yaki-shabu, filet, tongue and kimchi — September 2026.
"I was a bit disappointed when I received a less desirable cut of meat compared to other customers." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉、下京区仏光寺通油小路西入ル、京都駅からタクシー5分、大宮駅から462m、17:00〜21:30、水曜休み、予約可、16席 (カウンター4、テーブル1、座敷2)、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙 (店外に灰皿)、焼肉百名店 2018、焼肉 WEST 百名店 2020〜2023・2025、グリル WEST 百名店 2024・2026。京都観光サイト (アクアディーナ、日付なし): 下京区喜吉町161、上質な近江牛、赤身中心の8〜9種類、イチボのたたき、大根おろしとポン酢の焼きしゃぶしゃぶ。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 家族で営む、イチボステーキ、焼きしゃぶ、タン (premium)、ヒレの順のおすすめ、部位ごとのたれ、ヒレ2,900円、焼きしゃぶ2,000円、タン (premium)1,800円、イチボステーキ1,500円、テッチャン800円、キムチ600円、予約は1か月前に。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; let the owner guide the order of cuts; cash only.

places.name: 沐 (moku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Genre-free izakaya plates include spring rolls, rare fish katsu, croquette potato salad, gratin and hayashi rice alongside sashimi-style and grilled dishes; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dishes are built on fish, wagyu, chicken, pork and cheese, and the appetiser is a yuzu-scented dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 15:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed 2–3 days a week on an irregular schedule posted on Instagram (Tabelog). Bookings through TableCheck (July and October 2026) or by phone; prime evening slots fill three weeks to a month ahead, and same-day cancellations come up (May and August 2026). places.vegan_detail: Ask. The reviewed curries all carry meat or seafood (chicken, pork, hamburg steak, shrimp, scallops); no vegan information (2024–2026 reviews).

places.notes: [Curry · Shinkyogoku, European-style curry in a stone-paved alley] A small curry shop on the quiet, stone-paved Yanagikoji, a few steps from the Shinkyogoku arcade, where the smell of curry carries into the alley. The curry is European-style — gently spiced, a little sweet — with the sauce served apart from saffron rice dressed with vegetables, on pretty tableware. Lunch Set A (¥1,500 with salad, pickles and coffee, September 2026) and the fuller Course A with soup and caramel banana pudding are the usual orders; seasonal curries change through the year. One diner first visited about 35 years ago. Curry only (no tea-and-cake orders), no photos, cash only; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A May 2025 reviewer had first visited about 35 years earlier and noted that the interior had since been updated.
chef_bio.specialty: European-style curry with saffron rice; caramel banana pudding.

anecdotes.text: "Amidst the rapid changes in the Shijo Kawaramachi area, this restaurant has been around since I visited 35 years ago." — May 2025.
A June 2025 visitor who wanted only tea and cake was told that this is a curry shop, ordered Curry Course A instead, and found the service a bit lacking in warmth but every dish delightful.
A September 2025 diner felt watched at first by the woman running the room, then found the service polite once the two spoke.
"My saffron rice arrived on a Peter Rabbit plate" — March 2025.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Soup curry on a Japanese dashi base with fried vegetables, rice and toppings such as cheese and fried onion; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan as served: every soup is built on a Japanese-style dashi base, even the colourful vegetable soup curry (¥1,280); ask whether the broth can be made without fish or meat (official site).
places.hours_raw: Weekdays 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; weekends and holidays 11:30–15:30 and 17:30–21:00; last food order 20:30; may close early when the soup runs out; irregular holidays (Tabelog; the official site gives 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00). Reservations via Instagram DM (official site) or the booking link on the site, for 11:30–12:00 and 17:30–18:00 only, two groups per slot; phone bookings may not be accepted; one-hour seating limit (Tabelog). Queues at lunch, often of overseas visitors (June, September 2026); orders through an app (September 2026). places.cuisine: Kyoto-style soup curry: more than 15 spices with a Japanese dashi taste, served in an orange clay pot with fried vegetables from contract farms; spice in 7 levels (official site) · Kyoto Akajidori chicken drumstick soup curry ¥1,580 (¥1,550 in March 2026) · domestic pork hamburg steak ¥1,880 · Kyoto-brand beef (京の肉) braised in red wine ¥2,200, limited · braised pork belly ¥1,650 · colourful vegetable soup curry ¥1,280; extra vegetables +¥200; extra soup ¥300 · toppings: seared cheese ¥180, soft-boiled egg ¥150, fried garlic or onion ¥130 · potato salad with pickled daikon ¥350 · caramel ice cream ¥330 (official site) · rice in sizes, e.g. 200 g or 300 g (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Curry · Kawaramachi, Kyoto-style soup curry in clay pots] A small second-floor soup curry shop behind Kawaramachi OPA that gives the Hokkaido dish a Kyoto turn: a dashi-tasting broth with more than 15 spices, Kyoto Akajidori chicken and the Kyoto beef brand 京の肉, and a pile of fried vegetables, served piping hot in an orange clay pot. The chicken drumstick soup curry (¥1,580) is the house pick; there is a vegetable soup curry too (¥1,280, dashi base). Spice runs in 7 levels, but reviewers found even level 5 mild (June 2026). Lunch queues are common — book a 11:30 or 17:30 slot through Instagram. One-hour seating; cards accepted.

roles: Owner (unnamed on the official site, which calls the chicken drumstick curry 店主オススメ)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: formerly named 土鍋スープカレー近江屋清右衛門; a sister shop of the European-style curry shop CLAY POT CURRY OHMIYA; the shop studied which chicken suits its soup curry and settled on Kyoto Akajidori; vegetables come direct from contract farms around Japan; the clay pots are handmade Mashiko ware. Tabelog gives the opening as 21 August 2018.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto Akajidori chicken drumstick soup curry; beef braised in red wine.

anecdotes.text: "The soup, based on a Japanese dashi broth and blended with over 15 spices, is robustly spicy yet has a gentle flavor." — June 2026.
A June 2026 reviewer found the soup milder than expected even at level 5 and the dish more vegetable-led than spice-led, noting many tourists from Chinese-speaking regions among the customers.
A June 2026 diner booked noon on a holiday through Instagram and arrived to a line of about ten people, mostly foreign tourists.
An October 2026 visitor found level 2 not spicy at all and suggested level 3 for anyone who can handle "Karumucho".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (soupcurryohmiya.com): 阪急河原町駅徒歩2分、裏寺町、京都の食材と15種類以上のスパイスと和風出汁のテイストの特製スープカレーをオレンジの土鍋で、京赤地鶏、京の肉、全国の契約農家の野菜、辛さ7段階、益子焼の器、欧風カレー店 CLAY POT CURRY OHMIYA の姉妹店、予約はインスタグラムの DM、旧店名 土鍋スープカレー近江屋清右衛門。メニュー: 京赤地鶏の手羽元スープカレー1,580円、国産豚のハンバーグのスープカレー1,880円、京の肉の赤ワイン煮込みスープカレー2,200円、豚の角煮スープカレー1,650円、彩り野菜のスープカレー1,280円、たっぷり野菜トッピング+200円、追加スープ300円、ポテトサラダ350円、キャラメルアイス330円。食べログ: スープカレー、中京区裏寺町607-3 2F、16席、予約は2組まで、1時間制、英語・中国語・韓国語メニュー、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2018年8月21日オープン。

places.name: 麩嘉 錦店 (Fuka Nishiki ten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: nama-fu is wheat gluten mixed with glutinous rice flour and steamed, and the fu manju and fu taiyaki are made from it (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: The fu manju is described as house-made smooth bean paste wrapped in nama-fu (wheat gluten and glutinous rice flour) flavoured with aonori and rolled in a bamboo leaf, with no animal ingredient named; a full ingredient list was not seen, so check (official site).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–17:30; closed Monday, and on the last Sunday of each month from February to August (Tabelog; the official site gives 10:00–17:30, closed Monday). Mainly takeaway, with a tiny eat-in corner: one table for two and a counter (September 2026); eat-in buyers can add Ippodo roasted bancha for ¥100 (August–September 2026) and one was served chilled tea (August 2026). Reservations taken by phone (Tabelog). Cards accepted (Tabelog). The main shop at Nishinotoin does no retail: phone ahead or buy online (official site). 326 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishiki Market at Sakaimachi — 5 min walk from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: The Nishiki shop of an old Kyoto nama-fu (fresh wheat gluten) maker that supplies ryotei (official site) · fu manju: house-made smooth bean paste in aonori-flavoured nama-fu, wrapped in a bamboo leaf, ¥330 (August 2026) or ¥350 (September 2026) · fu taiyaki, small and baked to order, ¥352 (October 2026) · summer shaved ice Sasa no Tsu with bean paste ¥400 (August 2026) · nama-fu to cook at home · Ippodo roasted bancha +¥100 with eat-in (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Nishiki Market, fu manju from an old nama-fu maker] The Nishiki Market counter of Fuka, a nama-fu maker that has supplied fresh wheat gluten to the Imperial Palace and to Kyoto ryotei since at least the 1860s. The thing to get is the fu manju its own history says Fuka created: smooth bean paste wrapped in chewy, aonori-green fu and a bamboo leaf (¥330–350), eaten chilled. Small fu taiyaki are baked to order (¥352). Two seats and a counter for eating on the spot, with Ippodo bancha for ¥100. 10:00–17:30, closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Fuka has long supplied fu to the Kyoto Imperial Palace; its founding year is unknown because its records burned in the upheavals of the late Edo period, but a pass for entering the palace is dated in the Keio era (1865–68), and the present owner is the 7th generation counted from then. Fuka helped bring nama-fu from plain temple cooking into Kyoto cuisine by delivering it fresh to ryotei every morning, and still works mainly to order for ryotei, making 30–40 kinds a day by hand from pumped groundwater with about 20 craftsmen, all of whom study the tea ceremony. The site says Fuka made the first nama-fu manju, an idea attributed to Emperor Meiji, who liked nama-fu. Tabelog Wagashi WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: the family business is "craft, not commerce" — use natural ingredients as far as possible and make by hand everything it can.
chef_bio.specialty: Fu manju; fu taiyaki.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 reviewer noted that the fu is mixed with aonori and the filling is smooth bean paste of Tanba Dainagon azuki; fu manju and bancha came to ¥490.
"I was pleasantly surprised to be served chilled tea when I chose to dine in." — August 2026.
A September 2026 visitor found the fu manju wobbly and slippery to hold, with a chewy skin and light, smooth filling, and the staff very kind.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (fuka-kyoto.com): 京生麩の専門店、古くから京都御所に麩を献上、創業年は江戸時代後期の動乱で資料が焼失し不明、御所の手形に慶応年間の記載、現在の店主は7代目、料亭からの受注生産が主、毎朝生麩をつくる、一日30〜40種類、地下水を汲み上げて手づくり、職人は20人ほどで全員が茶道を習う、生麩饅頭をはじめてつくったのも麩嘉 (明治天皇のアイデアとされる)、自家製こしあんを青のりの生麩で包み笹で巻く、「商売ではなくものづくり」。店舗: 麩嘉 本店 (上京区西洞院通椹木町上る、小売りなし、電話予約かオンラインショップ)、麩嘉 錦店 (中京区錦小路堺町角菊屋町534-1、10:00〜17:30、月曜定休)。食べログ: 和菓子、2席、予約可、カード可、2月〜8月の最終日曜休み、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。

cultural_comfort.note: Buy at the shop counter; ask to eat in if the table is free; cards accepted.

places.gf_detail: Ask. A September 2026 buyer read the mizu yokan label as only adzuki beans, sugar and agar, but the steamed yokan (mushi yokan) ingredients were not reported and the shop publishes none; ask before buying (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: The mizu yokan label lists only adzuki beans, sugar and agar (a September 2026 review); the steamed yokan in chestnut, hojicha, kinako and matcha flavours have no ingredient list in the sources (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 10:30–19:00, closed Sunday; may close early (Tabelog; the same in a September 2026 review). The Gion shopping street association lists 10:00–20:00, closed Sunday. Takeaway only, no seats (Tabelog): ring the bell at the counter and the owner comes out (September 2026). Popular yokan sell out by late afternoon (September 2026); orders can be reserved by phone (Tabelog; October 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). In an alley just north of Shijo-dori in Gion, about 8 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: A Gion alley just north of Shijo-dori — 8 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Takeaway-only yokan shop, founded in 1884 per reviews (2026 reviews) · kuri mushi yokan (chestnut steamed yokan) wrapped in bamboo leaves, ¥2,000, seasonal · mizu yokan ¥2,000 (adzuki, sugar and agar, with bamboo leaves inside) · small drum-shaped steamed yokan ¥350: hojicha, kinako, matcha, and bite-sized ones with tomato or nuts (September 2026)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Gion, an old yokan shop down an alley] A small, Showa-feeling yokan shop hidden in an alley just off Shijo-dori in Gion, founded in 1884 according to reviewers. There is no one at the counter: ring the bell and the owner comes out (one reviewer describes a man in a white chef’s coat and black cap). The famous chestnut steamed yokan, packed with chunks of chestnut and wrapped in bamboo leaf (¥2,000), is seasonal — in September 2026 some visitors bought it and others were told it was not yet being made; there is also a silky mizu yokan, and small chilled steamed yokan (¥350) to eat on a walk. Flavours sell out by late afternoon — phone ahead for the big ones. Several reviewers call the service brusque. Cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: September 2026 reviews give the founding as 1884 (Meiji 17), and one calls it the first shop in Kyoto to make mizu yokan. Tabelog Sweets "Tabelog 100" 2017 and Sweets WEST 2018–2020, 2022; Wagashi WEST 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Chestnut steamed yokan; mizu yokan.

anecdotes.text: "When I pressed the call button, a gentleman in a white chef's coat with a black cap came out from the back to assist me." — September 2026.

An October 2026 buyer reserved a chestnut yokan by phone three days ahead and found the shop more aloof than most — and was glad of the lack of fuss; other September 2026 reviewers found the service indifferent or brusque.
A September 2026 buyer read the mizu yokan label — adzuki beans, sugar and agar only — and was told to wait about five minutes.
A September 2026 visitor, before the chestnut season, found that the chestnut steamed yokan was not yet being made and bought mizu yokan, which came with two bamboo leaves inside to ease it out.

On the back street (Ura-Teramachi) opposite the back of Kawaramachi OPA, 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Ura-Teramachi behind Kawaramachi OPA — 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small café of French pastries, parfaits and lunch plates, begun as a baked-goods shop (rurubu, 2024) · 京カヌレ canelés, of which 300 sold in a single day, per a 2025 reviewer (tall canelé ¥400, September 2025) and financiers to take away · seasonal parfaits with a drink ¥2,500, e.g. Mio Shizuku strawberry (March 2026) and three kinds of fig with tea jelly (September 2026), with the making shown to the diner (2025–26) · seasonal cake with a drink ¥1,500, topped with a butterfly tuile (2025) · French-style açaí bowl in a plant-pot bowl ¥1,600, +¥300 for a drink (2024) · lunch plates with vegetables and a drink, under ¥1,500 (June 2026): pie with porcini cream, quiche, shrimp gratin pie, chicken nanban with cold tomato soup · café latte ¥600
places.notes: [Pâtisserie café · Kawaramachi, canelés and parfaits on a back street] A 10-seat café on the quiet street behind Kawaramachi OPA, run by the owner of the French restaurant Le cadeau. It began with baked goods — the canelé is the thing to take away — and now makes tall seasonal parfaits (strawberry in spring, figs in autumn, ¥2,500 with a drink), cakes crowned with a butterfly tuile, and lunch plates of pie or quiche with plenty of vegetables (under ¥1,500 with a drink in 2026). You may get to watch your parfait being made. 12:00–19:00, closed Thursday; check Instagram for extra closures.

roles: Owner, who runs the French restaurant Le cadeau (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Per rurubu (September 2024): the owner runs the French restaurant Le cadeau, which serves a late-night dessert course to one booked party at a time; Au point de rendez-vous started by selling baked goods and now serves parfaits and lunch; the 2024 açaí bowl was overseen by the Le cadeau chef. A December 2022 reviewer says the shop opened in May 2022 and that its Christmas dessert course was supervised by "Chef Imoto", with pastry chef Kaede and staff member Kokoro each devising a plate; a July 2024 reviewer quotes the shop calling itself the "sister store of a Michelin-listed establishment". A 2025 reviewer mentions a "Canelé Day" on the 21st of each month and occasional cooking classes.
chef_bio.specialty: Canelés; seasonal parfaits; butterfly-tuile cakes.

anecdotes.text: "I even got to see how it was made, which was so exciting!" (of the fig parfait) — September 2026.
"The female staff member was very warm and welcoming" — June 2026.
"The bowl was actually a plant pot, so when I lifted it, acai spilled out everywhere!" — July 2024.
A 2025 reviewer was told the canelé is so popular that 300 sold in a single day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: るるぶ&more (2024年9月更新): Au point de rendez-vous (おー ぽわん どぅ らんでゔー)、オーナーが営むフランス料理店「Le cadeau」は営業後の深夜24時から1組限定の予約制のデザートコース、焼き菓子の販売から始まり今はパフェやランチも、看板は京カヌレ、2024年のアサイーボウル、モーニング (2024年8月から)。食べログ: スイーツ・カフェ、中京区中之町575 丸仲ビル 1F、京都河原町駅から約1分、12:00〜19:00、木曜と不定休 (Instagram で告知)、予約可、10席、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 2022年5月開店、カヌレ、パフェ (いちご、いちじく) ドリンク付き2,500円、季節のケーキ1,500円、アサイーボウル1,600円、ランチプレート (パイ、キッシュ、チキン南蛮) 1,500円以下、蝶のチュイール。

cultural_comfort.note: Small seated café; cards and PayPay; check Instagram for closures.

places.name: イタリア食堂イスコ (Trattoria ISUQO)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pizza and spaghetti (Barilla No. 3) are the core; steak, salads, carpaccio and ajillo are also on the menu, but no gluten information is published (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the shop says it cares about vegetables, but no vegan dish is described; most dishes carry ham, seafood, chicken or cheese (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–24:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; all-you-can-drink courses from ¥5,000; private hire for 20–50 people (Tabelog). One drink per person required (May 2024). Friday is "Wine Day" with wine at ¥700 (Tabelog). 40 seats, counter and sofa seating, a large central table; smoking allowed (Tabelog; a June 2025 diner welcomed it, an April 2024 diner saw no smokers); cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR payments; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). 2nd floor of the 招徳ビル, 2 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of Shijo, west of Kawaramachi — 2 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Casual trattoria aiming to be "neither too cheap nor too expensive" (Tabelog) · thin-crust pizza from a 500 °C oven (meat sauce, prosciutto, anchovy) · spaghetti with Barilla No. 3, the house chili-and-sansho spaghetti, shirasu and Kujo-negi garlic spaghetti, seafood pasta · antipasto platter (smoked salmon, potato salad, prosciutto, olives), Spanish tortilla, carpaccio, ajillo, mussels in spicy tomato, fried squid · grilled steak with mustard, chicken neck, gizzards, fried chicken with yuzu pepper · Friday wine ¥700; free-flow courses from ¥5,000 (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Trattoria · Kawaramachi, pizza and pasta until midnight] A 40-seat second-floor trattoria a couple of minutes from Kawaramachi Station, done in bright blue walls and sofas, open 18:00 to midnight. Thin, crisp pizza from a 500 °C oven, the house spaghetti with chili and sansho, a mixed antipasto plate and a steak with mustard are what reviewers order; Friday is wine day at ¥700 a glass. Built for groups: free-flow courses from ¥5,000 and private hire for up to 50. One drink per person; smoking allowed. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Run by a company (a corporate invoice registrant, Tabelog). Per the shop’s own Tabelog text: seasonal Kyoto ingredients, authentic crisp pizza and a signature chili-and-sansho spaghetti at reasonable prices; banquets, after-parties and weddings for up to 40 guests.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): an adult hideaway offering "the perfect satisfaction that’s neither too cheap nor too expensive."
chef_bio.specialty: Pizza; chili-and-sansho spaghetti.

anecdotes.text: "As soon as I opened the door, I was greeted by cute blue wallpaper and blue sofas." — March 2026.
"The garlic in the pasta was intense, and the thin pasta with extra garlic was fantastic!" — March 2026.
"The server was calm and helpful, providing good advice when we were unsure between the two flavors of mussels." — September 2024.
A May 2024 diner notes a one-drink-per-person rule.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・ピザ・ステーキ、下京区市之町239-1 招徳ビル 2F、京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、18:00〜24:00、木曜休み、予約可、40席、貸切20〜50名、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、500℃のピザ窯で焼くピッツァ、バリラ No.3 の細いスパゲッティ、唐辛子と山椒のスパゲッティ、毎週金曜はワイン700円、飲み放題コース5,000円から。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 青い壁とソファ、前菜盛り合わせ、トルティージャ、ムール貝、ステーキ、しらすと九条ねぎのパスタ、1ドリンク制。

cultural_comfort.note: Order from the menu; one drink per person; cards accepted.

places.name: ひいらぎ亭 (Hiiragi Tei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori comes with salt, wasabi or tare; the thigh tataki is served with a slightly sweet soy sauce, and the menu also has nyumen, shiso rolls and bacon-cheese skewers; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken shop; even the grilled shiitake and green chili come with bonito flakes or dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00) Monday, Thursday–Sunday and holidays; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; lunch 12:00–14:00 once a month (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; the owner cooks alone, so orders can take time at busy moments (Tabelog). Tables may be booked in two-hour slots (18:00–20:00, September 2026). Cover charge ¥1,000 for the starters (otoshi), which have included potato salad, shijimi clam soup and chicken with jelly (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). 20 seats: 10 at the counter downstairs and 10 at tables upstairs (private for up to 10) (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Easy to miss from the street (August 2026). By the Chion-in-mae bus stop on Higashioji-dori; about 15 min walk from Sanjo, Gion-Shijo or Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashioji-dori in front of Chion-in — by the Chion-in-mae bus stop
places.cuisine: Yakitori and chicken dishes from Omi (Shiga) jidori chicken (2026 reviews) · thigh and breast tataki: charcoal-seared skin, a pink centre, onion, green onion and ginger with a slightly sweet soy sauce · large skewers: white liver ("premium"), back liver, chōchin, seseri, bonjiri, wings, hinedori (old hen), cartilage · shiso rolls, bacon-cheese, pork shin with grated wasabi · grilled shiitake, maitake with sudachi, green chili with bonito flakes · obanzai on the counter, steamed chicken with sansho sauce, aged-potato fries · to finish: karasumi egg rice, nyumen · sake by omakase, shochu, highballs, wine (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Chion-in, Omi jidori on the counter] A 20-seat yakitori shop on Higashioji-dori in front of Chion-in, where the owner grills Shiga's Omi jidori alone at the counter downstairs (tables upstairs). Start with the thigh tataki — seared over charcoal, pink inside, with a slightly sweet soy — then move to big skewers: the creamy white liver is the one people talk about, along with back liver, bonjiri and the old-hen hinedori. A ¥1,000 starter charge brings small dishes such as shijimi soup. Most 2026 reviewers spent ¥8,000–15,000 a head. Book ahead; tables may be limited to two hours. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef, who cooks alone (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own note): the owner cooks alone, so orders can take longer when busy. Reviewers in August–September 2026 describe the chicken as Omi jidori from Shiga. Tabelog Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024, 2025, 2026; En Primeur Club lists a 2024 Michelin Bib Gourmand (page last reviewed September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Thigh tataki; white liver skewers.

anecdotes.text: "After finishing our meal, the owner always bows and sees us off with a smile." — March 2026.
A September 2026 diner was booked for 18:00–20:00 and could not order more at the end because the table had another reservation.
"The yakitori portions were generally large, especially the white liver, which was the biggest I’ve ever seen!" — October 2026.
An August 2026 diner found each cartilage skewer quite pricey and the overall price range a bit high.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・焼鳥・鳥料理、東山区知恩院前石橋町306-6、知恩院前バス停すぐ、月・木〜日・祝 17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、火・水休み、月1回 12:00〜14:00 のランチ、予約可、一人で調理しているため混雑時は提供に時間がかかる、付き出し代1,000円、20席 (カウンター10、2階テーブル10)、個室10名まで、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2024・2025・2026。En Primeur Club: 2024年ミシュラン ビブグルマン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): Omi の地鶏、もものたたき、白肝の串焼き、背肝、ちょうちん、ぼんじり、手羽、ひね鶏、しじみの味噌汁、おばんざい、からすみ卵ご飯、にゅうめん、日本酒のおまかせ、1人8,000〜15,000円、2時間制。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; a ¥1,000 starter charge applies; cards accepted.

places.name: スパイスチャンバー (SPICE CHAMBER)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The keema is made from onions, tomatoes, minced meat and a 17-spice mix tempered in the pan (Serai, 2021) and served on rice with grilled vegetables, achaar and pickles; no gluten information is published.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the only food is keema curry of beef and pork or of chicken (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 Tuesday–Saturday; dinner 18:00–21:00 Tuesday only; closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog): a queue forms before opening (7th in line 10 min before opening on a September 2026 holiday; 5 ahead at 11:35 on an October 2026 weekday), with a 4-person bench outside. Each plate is stir-fried to order, so it takes 15–25 minutes (September–October 2026). Beef and pork can sell out (September 2026). 14 seats (6 at the counter, up to 8 at tables); non-smoking; cash only (Tabelog). In the Muromachi wholesale streets, 2 min from Exit 26 of Shijo / Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Muromachi south of Ayanokoji — 2 min from Shijo Stn Exit 26
places.cuisine: Spice-curry counter with one dish: keema curry (Serai, 2021), now in two kinds, beef and pork or chicken (2026 reviews) · stir-fried to order with a 17-spice mix (Serai, 2021); quite spicy, topped with fried and grilled eggplant, shishito, pumpkin and king oyster mushroom, a crunchy umeboshi in the middle, with homemade pickles · beef and pork keema with pickles: small (170 g rice) ¥1,350, medium (250 g) ¥1,500, large (320 g) ¥1,700 (September 2026); another September 2026 reviewer and an October 2026 reviewer paid ¥1,400 for a small · extras: onion achaar, yogurt, extra pickles, cheese +¥200 · mango juice ¥450, guava juice, Heartland and Kirin Classic Lager beer (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Curry · Shijo Karasuma, one keema, very spicy] A 14-seat curry counter in the Muromachi back streets that serves a single dish: keema curry, beef and pork or chicken, stir-fried to order with a 17-spice mix, topped with grilled vegetables and an umeboshi, with homemade pickles and optional onion achaar. Expect real heat — staff warn that everything is spicy — and a 15–25 minute wait for your plate. Plates from about ¥1,350–1,700 in 2026, cash only. Queue from before 11:30; lunch Tuesday to Saturday, plus Tuesday dinner.

chef_bio.background: Per Serai (October 2021): the owner, 阿蘓慎太郎, is from Yamagata Prefecture and lived in Tokyo, Osaka and Kyoto; before the shop, worked in promotion at a record company in Osaka, then took an early-retirement offer to become a curry cook and opened SPICE CHAMBER in 2010. The owner’s CDs, used for the shop’s music, line up beside the spice jars. The name translates as "spice room". The shop was in the 2021 Michelin Guide’s curry Bib Gourmand (Serai, 2021). Tabelog Curry WEST "Tabelog 100" 2019, 2020, 2023, 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Keema curry (beef and pork, or chicken).

anecdotes.text: "The owner has great communication skills" — September 2026.
"Since they sauté the ingredients after the order is placed, it took about 25 minutes for my dish to be served." — September 2026.
"At the center of the dish was a pickled plum, specifically a crunchy type, evoking nostalgic memories of old bento lunches." — September 2026.
An October 2026 diner found the curry sauce a little scant, while calling it tasty.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: サライ.jp (2021年10月): 店主は阿蘓慎太郎さん、山形県出身、東京、大阪、京都と移り住み2010年に SPICE CHAMBER をオープン、大阪でレコード会社の宣伝担当、早期退職の募集を機にカレー職人に転身、フードメニューはキーマカレー1種類、17種類のミックススパイス、店内の BGM の CD がスパイスの瓶の横に並ぶ、「スパイスの部屋」、2021年版ミシュラン カレー部門ビブグルマン。食べログ: カレー・インドカレー、下京区室町綾小路下る白楽天町502番地 福井ビル1F、四条駅26番出口から徒歩2分、火 11:30〜15:00・18:00〜21:00、水〜土 11:30〜15:00、日・月休み、予約不可、14席 (カウンター6、テーブル最大8)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カレー WEST 百名店 2019・2020・2023・2024・2026。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 牛豚キーマとチキンキーマ、小1,350円・中1,500円・大1,700円 (別の口コミでは小1,400円)、チーズ +200円、アチャール、ヨーグルト、ピクルス、梅干し、開店前の行列、注文後に炒めるので15〜25分。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue outside, order at the seat; staff explain the spice level; cash only.

places.name: 鯛壽司 (Tai Sushi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Nigiri omakase and sashimi plates; no gluten or soy-sauce information. Dislikes have been swapped out of the omakase when asked (November 2021).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every guest must order one dish, a fish sushi set or a sashimi plate (February 2026), and the house negima soup is tuna and leek.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 17:00–22:00, closed Thursday; hours may change, check before visiting. Reservations taken by phone (075-221-6598); a January 2023 diner booked the same day and the counter filled at opening. One dish per person is required (a sashimi plate or a sushi set), drinks are optional (February 2026). Cash only (no cards, e-money or QR). 17 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). 2 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: First lane east, north of Shijo-Kawaramachi — 2 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood Edomae sushi at a U-shaped 17-seat counter, more than 50 years in business (Retty) · omakase nigiri: 8 pieces ¥2,000 (2021–22), ¥2,640 (January 2023); a sushi set for one ¥3,300 before tax (January 2025) · thick-sliced chu-toro sashimi, 8 slices ¥3,300 (February 2026) · extra pieces to order: chu-toro, squid, scallop, negi-toro, kanpachi, anago, toro-taku · the house negima soup (tuna and leek) to finish · sake (one kind, 2017) and shochu
places.notes: [Sushi · Shijo-Kawaramachi, old-style counter] A family sushi counter up the first lane off Kawaramachi north of Shijo, in business for over 50 years: a U-shaped counter of 17 seats, large cuts on traditional rice, and the house negima soup of tuna and leek. A long-time regular found in January 2023 that the previous owner had handed over to a son. Omakase of 8 pieces was ¥2,640 in 2023; a set was ¥3,300 before tax in January 2025, and 8 thick slices of chu-toro sashimi ¥3,300 in February 2026. One dish per person; cash only. 17:00–22:00, closed Thursday; book by phone.

roles: Chef at the counter (unnamed); a son of the previous owner, per a January 2023 review
chef_bio.background: Retty describes a long-established sushi shop at Shijo-Kawaramachi with more than 50 years in business; a 2017 Retty review calls it a popular Edomae sushi shop of "50 years and more", and a 2015 Retty review says it was run by a friendly couple, another the warmth of a family business. A Tabelog review of a March 2021 visit describes a kind chef and the chef’s wife working quickly; a January 2023 diner, a regular under the previous owner, found the previous owner had passed the shop on to a son who looks just like the father.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase nigiri; negima soup; toro-taku.

anecdotes.text: "I once asked the owner if it was okay to order just chu-toro. … [The answer was] yes but … it would put [the shop] in the red." — remembered by a former regular, January 2023.
"I had so many pieces of toro-taku … that I even lost count, and the chef laughed at me." — December 2021.

A diner who had come long before felt a little let down in January 2025 by a menu now "tailored for foreign customers", while finding the sushi delicious; in November 2024 another found every other guest was from overseas.
"I was honestly surprised to receive 8 generous slices of fatty tuna sashimi for just JPY 3,300." — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Retty: 四条河原町で創業50年を超える老舗の寿司屋、カウンターのみ17席、全席禁煙、毎週木曜日休み、カード不可。口コミ: 「京都最高の大衆江戸前寿司」「50年有余」(2017年)、お任せ8貫2000円・瓶ビール500円 (2015年)、気さくなご夫婦でやっておられて (2015年)、御家族経営の暖かさ、名物のねぎま(汁)、メニューや値段表はない、酒は一種類 (2017年)。食べログ: 寿司・海鮮・日本料理、中京区四条河原町上ル一筋目東入ル、17:00〜22:00、木曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター17席、禁煙。口コミ (2021年3月〜2026年2月、英語): お任せ8貫2,000円 (2021〜22年)・2,640円 (2023年1月)、セット3,300円税別 (2025年1月)、中トロの刺身8切れ3,300円 (2026年2月)、ねぎま汁、とろたく、ひとり一品の注文制、2023年1月に先代から息子さんへ代替わり。

cultural_comfort.note: Set omakase at the counter, so little ordering is needed; book by phone and bring cash. Many overseas guests (November 2024).
