places.name: ザ ノーザンライツコーナー (The Northern Lights Corner)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A drinks bar: beer, gin and tonics, whisky and cocktails; the only food reviewers mention is potato bread and cream cheese with rum raisins on crackers (March 2025).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Spirits and fruit cocktails may suit; some cocktails use cream (a Grasshopper, June 2025) and the snacks seen include cream cheese.
places.hours_raw: Official site: 15:00–23:00 (last order 22:30), opened as a bar for a light drink from the afternoon; Tabelog also gives 15:00–23:00 every day; an October 2025 review gave 15:00–24:00 with irregular closures. No cover charge (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Mostly standing at the counter, with high tables and a terrace by the entrance; 16 places (Tabelog). Smoking is allowed inside (Tabelog; October 2025 and October 2026 reviews). Cards and QR payments (Tabelog). On the ground floor of the Hare no Hi Hanayu Koji building, the first alley east off Shinkyogoku north of Shijo; 1 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Hanayu Koji alley off Shinkyogoku, north of Shijo — 1 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Afternoon-to-late standing bar with a terrace, from the company behind Gion’s Finlandia Bar (official site; Tabelog) · no cover charge; recommended drinks in the low ¥1,000s (2025 reviews) · Earl Grey gin and tonic ¥1,300, yuzu gin and tonic ¥1,300 (October 2025); seasonal fruit Bellinis (Shine Muscat, Asian pear) and a strawberry rum cocktail; Moscow mule, China Blue, Grasshopper, Naked and Famous; a wide whisky list with some pours around ¥3,000 (December 2025) · snacks: potato bread, cream cheese with rum raisins (March 2025)
places.notes: [Bar · Shinkyogoku, a drink from 3 pm] A standing bar with a small terrace at the mouth of the Hanayu Koji alley off Shinkyogoku, opened in 2013 by K-stage, the company that runs Gion's Finlandia Bar; it was named for the aurora, as a curtain of light over the alley. No cover charge and most drinks in the low ¥1,000s: gin and tonics with Earl Grey or yuzu (¥1,300), seasonal fruit Bellinis, a long whisky list. A year-end regular praises the young manager's knowledge; smoking is allowed inside, so non-smokers take the terrace. 15:00–23:00.

roles: Bar of K-stage (株式会社ケイ・ステージ), which also runs ぎをん FINLANDIA BAR, The Common One Bar Kyoto, Turquoise Bar and ぎをん新橋 何生庵
chef_bio.background: Per the K-stage company history: in August 2013 the company opened The Northern Lights Corner on the ground floor and the more formal Bar The Northern Lights on the first floor of the new Hare no Hi Hanayu Koji building in Shinkyogoku (the upstairs bar closed in December 2021; the space is now an office of アルコ・ノルディック株式会社, the company’s vodka importer). The name wishes for a curtain of light like the aurora over Hanayu Koji. The corner bar first opened at 14:00 and now opens at 15:00. K-stage took over Gion’s Finlandia Bar (founded February 1982 as a sister to the Finnish restaurant FINLANDIA, opened at Gojo-Yanaginobaba in 1976) in November 2002. Tabelog’s note calls it Finlandia’s first try at a standing bar. A June 2025 review says staff sometimes rotate between the sister bars.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: opened as a bar for a light drink from midday, with everything from beer to proper cocktails to enjoy casually.
chef_bio.specialty: Gin and tonics; seasonal fruit cocktails; whisky.

anecdotes.text: "I received a business card later and found out [the bartender] was the manager, which made sense." — December 2024; the same diner returns every year-end (December 2025).
"I was tempted by bartender Nakagawa's conversation to try the trendy Naked and Famous cocktail." — June 2025.
A June 2025 diner found guests "of all ages and nationalities" and the owner serving at the counter that day.
"I can't stand the smell of cigarettes, so I chose to drink outside." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (k-stage.jp): ザ ノーザンライツコーナー、Northern Lights はオーロラのような光のカーテン、お昼から軽く飲めるバーとして開店、新京極花遊小路、エントランス前にテラス席、ビールから本格的カクテルまで、Open 15:00 - 23:00 (L.o. 22:30)、京都市中京区新京極四条上ル中之町565番23。会社沿革: 1976年フィンランド料理店「FINLANDIA」、1982年「ぎをんFINLANDIA BAR」、2002年株式会社ケイ・ステージ設立、2013年8月「The Northern Lights Corner」と「Bar The Northern Lights」を開業 (2階の Bar The Northern Lights は2021年12月で営業終了)、午後2時開店 (現在は3時オープン)。食べログ: バー、15:00〜23:00、予約可、ノーチャージ、スタンディング (テラス席あり)、16席、喫煙可、カード・QR 可、祇園のフィンランディアが初めて手がけたスタンディングバー。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年10月、英語): アールグレイのジントニック1,300円、柚子のジントニック1,300円、季節のフルーツのベリーニ、ポテトのパン、ラムレーズンのクリームチーズ、若い店長、バーテンダーの Nakagawa さん、店内は喫煙可。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk-in standing bar; tell the bartender the spirits or flavours you like and a drink is suggested. Smoking is allowed inside.

places.name: イル ギオットーネ 京都本店 (IL GHIOTTONE Kyoto honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Every course has two pasta courses (chitarra, orecchiette, tagliatelle, linguine) plus house focaccia and bread (2026 reviews; official course list); a September 2026 diner who pre-ordered had disliked ingredients left out, so some changes are made.
places.vegan_detail: Ask when booking. No vegetarian course is listed; courses run on fish, shellfish, duck, lamb, veal and beef, with burrata and Parmigiano (2026 reviews). A September 2026 diner noted many vegetable dishes.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 12:00–14:00 and dinner 18:00–20:00 (both times are the last seating), closed Tuesday and Wednesday; changes to closing days on the official website. Booking online (Toreta, via the official site) or by phone; a September 2026 diner booked a weekday lunch about a month ahead, and the same month a diner saw walk-ins turned away. Courses only: lunch Pranzo A ¥6,000, B ¥8,000, C ¥12,000, D ¥16,000; dinner Cena A ¥12,000, B ¥16,000, C ¥20,000; tax and service (5% lunch, 10% dinner) added (official site). Children 6 and under: ask the restaurant; à la carte and a kids’ plate can be made (official site). 45 seats with counter, sofa seats and private rooms for 2–12; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). On the lane just below the Yasaka Pagoda; 8 min walk from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn, or tell a taxi "Yasaka Pagoda" (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Below the Yasaka Pagoda, Higashiyama — 8 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: "What if Italy had a region called Kyoto?" — Italian courses built on Kyoto ingredients (official site) · lunch Pranzo A ¥6,000 (3 antipasti, 1 pasta, main, dessert and coffee), B ¥8,000 (2 pasta), C ¥12,000 and D ¥16,000; dinner Cena A ¥12,000, B ¥16,000, C ¥20,000; tax and service extra (official site) · 2026 dishes: charcoal-grilled sea snail and tairagi, burrata with autumn fruit, caviar and osmanthus wine; Spanish mackerel with Kyoto dashi, sea urchin and snow crab; chitarra with barracuda and matsutake; orecchiette with sausage and porcini; tagliatelle with Parmigiano and black truffle (+¥2,420); New Zealand duck, Australian lamb or Kyoto heifer (+¥3,630); house focaccia kept warm in a wooden box
places.notes: [Italian · Yasaka Pagoda, Kyoto as an Italian region] Chef-owner Yasuhiro Sasajima's restaurant in a converted townhouse right beside the Yasaka Pagoda, open since 2002 and built on one idea: what if Italy had a region called Kyoto? Courses only, lunch from ¥6,000 and dinner from ¥12,000 (plus tax and service): Kyoto vegetables and seasonal fish, two pastas with cheese or truffle grated at the table, charcoal-grilled meat. Italian WEST Tabelog 100 (2021, 2023, 2025). One September 2026 diner found the floor short-staffed. Lunch and dinner, closed Tuesday and Wednesday; book online.

roles: Owner-chef (オーナーシェフ, official site)
chef_bio.background: Born in Osaka Prefecture in 1964 (Serai, from its spring 2013 issue). Bunshun Online (2017) recalls the chef at イル・パッパラルド in Kyoto, with generous, energetic, reasonably priced plates, and dates the chef’s independence to 2002, launching IL GHIOTTONE as "Italian sent out from Kyoto": courses based on kombu dashi, scented with kinome and yuzu, with Kyoto vegetables such as Kujo leek and Shogoin turnip. Serai gives the Kyoto opening as 2002 and a Marunouchi (Tokyo) branch as 2005; the official site now lists the Kyoto honten, the wine shop Officina IL GHIOTTONE KYOTO (which also sells the group’s frozen pasta sauces) and IL GHIOTTONE DI PIÙ in Grand Front Osaka. Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023 and 2025. A September 2026 diner praised the service of the chef’s wife.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: the cooking grew from the thought "what if Italy had a region called Kyoto?" — the chef’s answer, as a Japanese cook, to the meaning of going on making the Italian food the chef loves in Japan: Italian cooking found only in Japan.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-ingredient Italian courses; chitarra and tagliatelle; charcoal-grilled meat.

anecdotes.text: A diner who came after a YouTube video by Junya Chihara found personal message cards at each reserved seat, and lotus leaves and a shaved-ice machine used as props during the course (August 2025); in August 2026 the machine shaved cucumber into a sauce.

"The hall staff was working alone … I was left waiting at the entrance without any acknowledgment." The same September 2026 diner found the flavours average and saw walk-ins turned away though seats were empty.
"Before I knew it, two and a half hours had flown by." — a weekday lunch booked a month ahead, September 2026.
"The bread is served in a wooden box to keep it warm." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ilghiottone.com): 京都 笹島シェフのイタリアンレストラン、オーナーシェフ 笹島保弘、「もしイタリアに京都という州があったら」、日本でしか出会えない唯一無二のイタリア料理、京都本店 (東山区下河原通塔ノ前下ル八坂上町388-1)、Pranzo A 6,000円・B 8,000円・C 12,000円・D 16,000円、Cena A 12,000円・B 16,000円・C 20,000円、税別・サービス料 (昼5%・夜10%) 別、6歳以下は要問い合わせ、アラカルトやキッズプレートも用意、Officina IL GHIOTTONE KYOTO (ワインショップ、冷凍パスタソース)、グランフロント大阪の IL GHIOTTONE DI PIÙ。サライ (2013年春号): 昭和39年大阪府生まれ、平成14年京都に「イル ギオットーネ」、17年に丸の内店。文春オンライン (2017年): イル・パッパラルドのシェフ、2002年に独立、「京都発信のイタリアン」、昆布だし、木の芽や柚子、九条ネギや聖護院蕪。食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ・イノベーティブ、12:00〜14:00・18:00〜20:00 (最終入店)、火・水曜定休、45席、個室 (2〜12名)、禁煙、カード可、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2025。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): Pranzo B 8,000円、Cena A 12,000円、キタッラ、オレキエッテ、タリアテッレと黒トリュフ、八坂の塔の隣の町家、シェフの奥さまのサービス、ホールがひとりで手が回らない日も。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses booked online through the official site (Toreta); dishes are explained at the table. Many kimono-clad overseas visitors around the pagoda (September 2026).

places.name: たかつじ 佳粋 (Takatsuji Kasui)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking: the shop asks guests to state allergies when reserving and will do its best, but may not always be able to accommodate (Tabelog). No gluten information; dishes include nuta with miso, dashi soups and seasoned rice.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every first visit is served a soup and two small dishes (Tabelog), and the soup is a dashi broth, in 2026 with shrimp dumpling; the rest of the menu is fish, shellfish and sashimi.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Monday–Friday 17:00–23:00, Saturday, Sunday and holidays 16:00–23:00, last order 22:00; closed irregularly. Bookings taken; the shop does not accept bookings from overseas guests because of no-shows — visitors should book through their hotel front desk or come in person beforehand, and bookings made through a Japanese individual are not accepted; a booking more than 10 minutes late may be cancelled. Minors are not admitted (ask). First visits are served a soup and two small dishes even on a seats-only booking (the set was ¥3,000 in September and October 2026); à la carte prices are not printed, so ask; a seat charge may apply if nothing à la carte is ordered (Tabelog; October 2026). 14 seats (10 counter, one table of 4); non-smoking; cards accepted, no e-money or QR (Tabelog; Retty lists PayPay). Behind a heavy iron door at the back of the ground floor of アネックス2番館; 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Takatsuji-dori, Shimogyo-ku — 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Counter izakaya with Japanese and some Western dishes and a deep sake list (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · first-visit set of appetiser, soup and sashimi ¥3,000 (September and October 2026): in autumn simmered grilled eggplant, a jelly and sesame tofu, a shrimp-dumpling soup with winter melon and sudachi, bonito and kombu-cured sea bream · à la carte without printed prices: vinegared sardine, whelk and Kujo leek nuta with red miso, grilled Spanish mackerel with sudachi soy, soft-shell turtle soup, a grilled fish with yuzu ¥1,200, an assortment of sea bream, grilled Spanish mackerel and mackerel ¥1,500 (October 2026), octopus with myoga · donabe rice (from 2 servings; about 30 minutes; anago rice in October 2026) with leftovers wrapped as onigiri to take home · sake kept at −5 °C (March 2023), shochu, beer, white wine from ¥800
places.notes: [Izakaya · Takatsuji-dori, a hidden counter] A 14-seat counter izakaya behind a heavy iron door at the back of a building on Takatsuji-dori, opened in March 2023 by the former owner of Kasui in Pontocho. A first visit starts with appetisers, a dashi soup and sashimi (¥3,000 in 2026), then à la carte — vinegared fish, nuta, grilled Spanish mackerel — and donabe rice, the leftovers sent home as onigiri in a paper bag with a drawing of the owner. Prices are not printed; ask. Izakaya WEST Tabelog 100 2025 and 2026. Overseas guests book through their hotel front desk or in person. Evenings, from 16:00 at weekends.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), the former owner of Kasui in Pontocho
chef_bio.background: A Tabelog review of a March 2023 visit says the owner of the former Pontocho shop Kasui reopened in Takatsuji after three years; a March 2023 Retty review likewise says the owner ran 佳粋 in Pontocho before opening Takatsuji Kasui. Tabelog gives the opening day as 28 March 2023. A September 2026 diner found two staff running the counter with jazz playing; another remembered the master in a bow tie. Tabelog izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025 and 2026; Tabelog Hot Restaurant 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Dashi soups; donabe rice; sake.

anecdotes.text: Leftover donabe rice goes home as onigiri "in a paper bag with a drawing of the owner on it" — October 2026.
"I nervously asked for the prices, but [the staff] didn’t provide an immediate answer." The same October 2026 diner wished prices were shown, though every dish was delicious.
"Smartphone reception is weak … Limited to Softbank." — September 2026.
A diner in October 2026 loved the food and drink but found the water tasted of chlorine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、下京区高辻通り御幸町西入ル茶磨屋町233 アネックス2番館 1F、月〜金 17:00〜23:00・土日祝 16:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、不定休、インバウンドの方は近隣ホテルのフロント経由で予約、海外の方の予約は受け付けない (日本人を通した予約も不可)、未成年不可、初回は席のみの予約でも汁物と2品を提供、アラカルトに価格表示なし、アレルギーは予約時に、14席 (カウンター10、4名テーブル1)、禁煙、カード可、2023年3月28日オープン、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2025・2026、ホットレストラン 2026。Retty: たかつじ 佳粋 (たかつじ かすい)、以前は先斗町で「佳粋」、一汁二菜、土鍋ご飯、ウニ乗せ玉子豆腐、鰻のお寿司、出汁巻き、PayPay 可、Instagram takatsuji_kasui。口コミ (2023年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 一汁二菜3,000円、えびしんじょうのお椀、土鍋ご飯の残りはおにぎりに、日本酒は−5℃で管理、蝶ネクタイのマスター、値段が書かれていない、水がカルキ臭い。

cultural_comfort.note: The shop takes no bookings from overseas guests directly: book through your hotel front desk, or visit in person beforehand. À la carte prices are not printed — ask.

places.name: 御二九と八さい はちべー (Oniku to Yasai Hachibe)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the evening course runs through soy-marinated and ponzu-dressed offal, fried cartilage and a Chinese-noodle finish in the hot-pot broth; lunch comes with red miso soup and a soy-marinated heart dish (official menu; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef-offal restaurant — every course dish and lunch plate is built on beef (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:00–23:00; closed Tuesday (official site). Tabelog gives last entry at 14:00 for lunch (until sold out) and 21:30 for dinner. Lunch cannot be booked — come to the shop; the evening is a single omakase course, best booked (official site; Tabelog). Corkage ¥3,000 a bottle, by arrangement (official site). 20 seats: 8 at the first-floor counter, three tables upstairs (about 12) that can be hired; non-smoking; cards accepted, no e-money or QR (official site; Tabelog). Children welcome. On Yanagi-koji, 3 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Yanagi-koji alley off Shinkyogoku, north of Shijo — 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: "Niku kappo" of beef offal (uchiniku), with Kyoto vegetables and seasonal ingredients, using Japanese, Western and Chinese techniques (official site; Tabelog) · evening omakase, about 12–13 dishes, ¥8,800: liver-pâté salad, beef-tongue dumpling stew, tail, blanched mino and senmai tripe, fried trachea cartilage (urute), aorta in Chinese dressing, Achilles tendon with ponzu, grilled cuts cooked by the staff, then the house beef-tongue harihari hot pot finished with Chinese noodles in its broth (official site) · lunch 11:30–14:30 with small dish, rice, red miso soup, dessert and coffee: seasonal-vegetable and harami rice bowl ¥2,500, beef-tongue hamburg steak with vegetables ¥1,800, beef-neck stew ¥1,800 (official site) · drink pairing ¥4,000; house sake 佳風 ¥1,000; natural wines (official site) · takeaway bento from ¥2,200 (official site)
places.notes: [Beef-offal kappo · Yanagi-koji off Shijo] A small two-storey house on the stone-paved Yanagi-koji alley, named after the nearby Hachibei Myojin shrine, serving beef offal as Kyoto-style kappo. Evenings are one omakase of about a dozen dishes (¥8,800) — Achilles tendon with ponzu, aorta, liver with garlic chives, tripe — with the grilling done for you at the counter and a beef-tongue harihari hot pot finished with Chinese noodles. Lunch is a harami rice bowl with vegetables (¥2,500), no booking. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed in the sources); run by the yagenbori group
chef_bio.background: Per the yagenbori group site: one of the group’s six Kyoto restaurants (with 花見小路やげんぼり, 出逢ひ茶屋おせん, しぐれ茶屋侘助, 祇をん う桶や う and 花遊小路 江戸川); each cut is prepared one by one so that the texture, flavour and nourishment of beef offal come through. Per Tabelog (operator text): the name comes from the Hachibei Myojin shrine nearby. A March 2026 reviewer had eaten the harami bowl at lunch several times before the pandemic.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to overturn the idea of horumon by drawing out its flavour to the limit with careful handwork.
chef_bio.specialty: Beef-tongue harihari hot pot with Chinese noodles; harami rice bowl.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 repeat guest described the owner pacing the dishes to the guest’s drinking and talking passionately about beef horumon.
The yakiniku part of the course was "grilled by the master" — April 2026.
At lunch the staff "confirmed the amount of rice before serving" — December 2025.
A June 2026 diner who eats a lot found the slices a bit thin and would have liked one thicker cut, while praising the cheek sashimi and the liver with garlic chives.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yagenbori.co.jp): 御二九と八さい はちべー、京都の路地文化を残す小道の一角、新鮮な牛のうちにく (ホルモン)、京野菜や旬の素材の京料理仕立ての「肉割烹」、夜のおまかせ料理8,800円 (おおよそ12〜13品、名物「牛タンはりはり鍋」と〆の「中華そば」、レバーペーストのサラダ、牛タンだんご煮、テール丸仕立、ミノ湯引、センマイ、ウルテ唐揚げ、ハツモト中華和え、アキレスポン酢和え)、焼き調理はすべてスタッフ、お昼 11:30〜14:30 (小鉢、ごはん、赤出汁、デザート、コーヒー付き、予約不可): 季節の野菜のハラミ丼2,500円、牛タンのハンバーグと温野菜1,800円、牛ネックのシチュー1,800円、ドリンクペアリング4,000円、オリジナル日本酒 佳風、ワイン持込3,000円、お持ち帰り 牛サガリ炙り弁当2,200円・鰻牛弁当3,700円、1階カウンター8名、2階3テーブル (最大約12名)、中京区新京極四条上る中之町577番地17、昼 11:30〜14:30・夜 17:00〜23:00、火曜定休、やげんぼりグループ6店。食べログ: 牛料理・ホルモン・日本料理、20席、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、店名は近くの八兵衛明神から。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): おまかせコース、アキレス、大動脈、レバーとニラ、牛タンのはりはり鍋と〆のラーメン、昼のハラミ丼2,500円。

cultural_comfort.note: Book the evening course; lunch is walk-in; the staff grill the meat; an English page is on the group site.

places.name: 酒呑にし川 柳小路店 (Shuten Nishikawa Yanagikoji)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, grilled fish, tofu and obanzai, but many dishes use soy sauce, dashi or miso (firefly squid in soy sauce, cucumber with meat miso, grilled vegetables in dashi); no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the food is sashimi, fish, shellfish, meat miso and dashi-based obanzai (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 15:00–23:00 every day, closing days not fixed (generally open year-round); hours may change, so booking is advised (Tabelog). Reviewers also drank here at lunch: a March 2026 review gives opening at 13:00, and an April 2026 visitor was the only lunch guest. 10 counter seats; parties of up to 4; private hire for up to 20; non-smoking; cards, iD/QUICPay and QR payments; no cover charge (Tabelog). In the Yanagi-koji Hachibei Nagaya, 2 min from Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn exit 6 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yanagi-koji alley north of Shijo — 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Sake izakaya with about 30–40 local sakes from all over Japan and daily obanzai of Kyoto vegetables (Tabelog) · three-sake tasting ¥1,000, also a limited-edition tasting and free-flow (2026 reviews) · sashimi platter (small size is generous), firefly squid in soy sauce, cucumber with meat miso, salted squid with cream cheese ¥890, sea bream with Kujo green onion ¥1,090, sesame mackerel ¥1,080, clams steamed in sake with Kujo green onion, thick fried tofu, grilled hamo, grilled summer vegetables in dashi, smoked burdock with cream cheese (2026 reviews) · dishes ¥790–1,390, draft beer ¥770 (August 2026)
places.notes: [Sake izakaya · Yanagi-koji off Shijo] A ten-seat sake bar in a row house on Yanagi-koji, where guests share one big slab table split by a low partition. The draw is the sake: around 30–40 local brews, poured as three-glass tastings (¥1,000) or free-flow, with generous plates of sashimi, obanzai and snacks (¥790–1,390). Open from 15:00 daily (earlier on some days, per reviewers) to 23:00; book ahead. Its sister shop is at Kawaramachi Gojo.

chef_bio.background: Opened 29 November 2020 (Tabelog). The same name has a shop at Kawaramachi Gojo (Tabelog 26036839, opened 14 January 2022); an April 2026 reviewer had been to a Kyoto Station branch that has since closed. A July 2026 review says the local sakes come from Koyama Shoten.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (operator text): a casual place for seasonal obanzai and carefully chosen sake, welcoming solo diners.
chef_bio.specialty: Three-sake tastings; obanzai; sashimi platter.

anecdotes.text: "The staff and the owner are all lovely people." — August 2026.
A large single-slab table fills the room and guests share it, with a partition down the middle — August 2026.
A returning guest found the sashimi pieces smaller than three years earlier, put down to rising prices, but still good — August 2026.
A guest from abroad seated next to an August 2026 reviewer laughed "OMG!" on tasting the grilled vegetables in dashi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒呑にし川 柳小路店、居酒屋・日本料理・日本酒バー、中京区中之町577 柳小路はちべえ長屋、阪急京都河原町駅6番出口から徒歩2分、毎日 15:00〜23:00、不定休 (基本無休)、営業時間が変わることがあるため予約推奨、10席 (カウンター10)、貸切20人まで、禁煙、カード・iD・QUICPay・PayPay・d払い可、チャージなし、2020年11月29日オープン、京野菜の旬のおばんざいと全国の地酒30〜40種。河原町五条店 (2022年1月14日オープン)。口コミ (2026年1〜8月、英語): 日本酒3種飲み比べ1,000円、限定酒の飲み比べ、飲み放題、刺身盛り合わせ、ホタルイカの醤油漬け、いかの塩辛クリームチーズ890円、鯛の九条ねぎ1,090円、ごまさば1,080円、生ビール770円、昼は13時から、京都駅店は閉店。

places.name: HUNTER
places.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled meats and fish are the core, but there are fritters, spring rolls, quiche, semolina-coated sweetfish, curry and bread; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: a meat-and-game bistro (ham, rillettes, venison, duck, lamb), with fish dishes and cream; a few vegetable plates such as the zucchini steak come with a shellfish paste (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00; closed Thursday and the third Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). A November 2025 reviewer reported a weekend-only lunch course (appetizers, bread, choice of main) restarting, and a February 2026 reviewer had it; Tabelog lists dinner only. Booking is essential (July 2026). The menu shows no prices; bills were ¥8,000–15,000 a head at dinner and ¥4,000–5,000 at lunch (2025–26 reviews). 20 seats: a counter and a few small tables; non-smoking; cards accepted, no e-money (Tabelog; June 2026). 4 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of the Imperial Palace, near Karasuma-Marutamachi — 4 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Bistro of meat, game and charcoal grilling with spices and sauces, plus Japanese ingredients (2025–26 reviews) · homemade Yonezawa-pork ham and rillettes, pâté, spiced lamb stew, charcoal-roasted Ezo venison, magret and Moulard duck, raw-beef hamburg steak, lamb steak · fish: Donchicchi horse mackerel with passion fruit, fried young sweetfish (one in semolina), Moroccan-style charcoal-grilled octopus with couscous, grilled eel with spiced soy sauce · zucchini steak with shellfish-and-basil paste, cold corn potage with salted sea urchin, quiche · mango curry to finish; Miyazaki-mango sorbet; grilled cream · orange wine and wines by the glass (2025–26 reviews) · weekend lunch course of appetizers, bread and a main (November 2025)
places.notes: [Meat bistro · south of the Imperial Palace, game over charcoal] A stylish 20-seat bistro near Marutamachi with a counter facing the kitchen, known for meat: house ham, rillettes and pâté, spiced lamb, charcoal-roasted Ezo venison and duck — but the kitchen also turns Japanese fish into spiced, sauced plates, like octopus with couscous or sweetfish fritters, and ends with a mango curry. The menu carries no prices; expect about ¥10,000–15,000 a head with wine. Book ahead. Dinner from 18:00 (weekend lunch reported); closed Thursday and the third Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 27 March 2017 (Tabelog). Tabelog Steak/Teppanyaki WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024. A November 2025 reviewer says the shop used to serve a regular lunch of curry and burgers before bringing back a weekend lunch course.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled game and duck; homemade ham; mango curry.

anecdotes.text: The chef talked with guests and explained the dishes over the counter — July 2026.
"At first, I was a bit nervous since there were no prices listed on the menu, but every dish was carefully prepared" — December 2025.
A special shrimp tempura with house tartar sauce was made on request — February 2026.

places.name: 生きている珈琲 (Ikiteiru Coffee)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee is the focus; the food is cheesecake, fondant au chocolat, coffee jelly and soft serve, with no ingredient list published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and cold brew suit; the desserts, Vienna coffee, floats and soft serve use cream, milk or eggs (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday and public holidays 10:00–19:00, Monday 11:00–19:00 (last order 18:20); closed 31 December and 1 January; occasional changes (official site; Tabelog). Bookings on weekdays only (Tabelog). Ordering is by mobile order at the table (October 2026). Smoking is allowed only in a walled-off smoking room (official site); one October 2026 reviewer called the shop smoke-free, others chose the smoking area. 50 seats, including sofa seats and solo counter seats with power outlets; free Wi-Fi; English menu; cards, IC cards and QR payments (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Beans sold in the shop and online. Basement of the Minoya Shijo building on Shijo-dori west of Fuyacho; 5 min from Kawaramachi or Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori between Karasuma and Kawaramachi, basement — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Coffee specialist in a dim, retro basement, with the coffees likened to actors on the menu (2026 reviews) · Red blend, the shop’s most popular (100 g beans ¥850 online), White blend, Geisha, Yemen Golden Mocha, Kopi Luwak, 8-hour cold brew (official shop; 2026 reviews) · hot Vienna coffee, coffee float ¥980, coffee soft serve ¥700, fresh coffee jelly ¥800, rich cheesecake, fondant au chocolat (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kissaten · Shijo-dori, a coffee house underground] Down a staircase off Shijo-dori, a dim, retro basement café with sofas, solo counter seats with outlets and a walled-off smoking room. The house Red blend is the easy choice; there are also single origins up to Geisha and Kopi Luwak, an 8-hour cold brew, and a coffee float (¥980), fresh coffee jelly (¥800) and a molten fondant au chocolat. Orders by smartphone at the table. 10:00–19:00 (Monday from 11:00); weekday seats can be booked.

roles: Run by 株式会社生きている珈琲; the online shop names 小林弘樹 as the person responsible for sales
chef_bio.background: Opened 15 January 2011 (Tabelog). Tabelog Kissaten "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022, 2026. Per a November 2026 review: each cup is brewed from 25 g of coarsely ground beans in a cone-shaped flower dripper, and the beans are roasted in a hot-air, low-temperature roaster said to bring out sweetness without damaging the beans. The official site sells beans by mail order.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: care over the space where the coffee is served, with areas for families, couples and business meetings, and full separation of smoking seats.
chef_bio.specialty: Red blend; 8-hour cold brew; fresh coffee jelly.

anecdotes.text: The organic stick sugar and syrup, and the coffee-bean pattern on the staff’s neckties, caught one visitor’s eye — October 2026.
"I found myself zoning out for a bit, only to realize it was a mobile order system" — October 2026.
A November 2026 visitor went back and forth along Shijo before finding the entrance to the basement.

places.name: 炭焼 やないの (Sumiyaki Yanaino)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Skewers are mostly salted, but the menu also has ponzu, soy-marinated and fried dishes (chikuwa tempura, kara-age) and oyster soy sauce; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, May 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Fish and pork skewers make up most of the menu; vegetable skewers (lotus root, ginkgo, broad beans, zucchini) appear in 2025–26 reviews, but their seasoning is not stated.
places.hours_raw: 16:00–22:30 Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday; 15:00–22:00 Sunday; closed Thursday and on some other days (Tabelog). Bookings taken; parties over two hours by arrangement; the 2nd-floor tatami room seats 5–8 and can be booked (Tabelog). 16 seats (8 at the counter, 8 on tatami); smoking allowed at the seats (Tabelog; January and August 2026); cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Hard to find: a December 2025 diner phoned and staff came out to guide the way. 3 min walk from Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 12 November 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ura-Teramachi just north of Shijo — 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal-grill izakaya of fish and pork skewers rather than chicken (a January 2026 diner notes that no yakitori is served) · skewers from one piece: kombu-cured mackerel ¥420, seasonal pork rolls ¥350, shishamo ¥280, salmon belly ¥300, kuruma prawn ¥420, oyster with sudachi ponzu ¥420, spicy cod roe ¥330, Kyotanba highland pork steak ¥350 · sashimi such as flounder ¥1,400, amberjack ¥1,300, yokowa ¥1,200 · smoked-mackerel macaroni salad ¥580, house-stuffed chikuwa tempura ¥600, chicken-breast chashu ¥750, salted kara-age ¥750, Stuffed Squid from Kesennuma ¥800, namero of the day’s fish ¥880 · tatami-iwashi ¥400, dried red sea bream ¥1,200 · egg-yolk rice ¥500, Yanaino Two-Color Rice Bowl ¥1,580, shijimi soup ¥380 (Tabelog menu, May 2026) · pork rolled with Kujo green onion, shiso or lettuce (2025–26 reviews) · homemade pickled sours (mandarin, ginger, myoga) ¥650, draft beer ¥600, many sakes by the glass (Tabelog drink menu, May 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Ura-Teramachi, charcoal skewers of fish and pork] A small charcoal-grill izakaya down Ura-Teramachi, with eight counter seats in front of the grill and a tatami room upstairs. The skewers are fish and pork, not chicken: kombu-cured mackerel, oysters with sudachi ponzu, kuruma prawn, and pork rolled round seasonal vegetables — Kujo green onion, shiso, lettuce. The smoked-mackerel macaroni salad is the house's must-order, and the sashimi comes with generous wasabi and ginger. Skewers from ¥280; a May 2026 table found the value excellent, a June 2026 pair paid ¥13,000 for a light meal. Smoking is allowed. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: The invoice register lists an individual, 木村 高行, as the holder of the shop’s invoice number (registered 1 October 2023). Opened 12 November 2020 (Tabelog). Staff explain the dishes in detail (December 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Pork-roll skewers; kombu-cured mackerel skewer; smoked-mackerel macaroni salad.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner could not find the door, phoned, and was met outside by the staff.
A January 2026 diner liked the food but left early because of smokers, and was seated by the cold entrance with only one other group in.
A May 2026 diner noted generous wasabi and ginger with the sashimi, and tonteki served with mustard.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 串焼き・居酒屋・魚介料理、中京区裏寺町607-18、阪急「河原町」駅から約3分、月・火・水・金・土 16:00〜22:30、日 15:00〜22:00、木曜休み・不定休、予約可、2階の座敷 (5〜8名) 予約可、16席 (カウンター8、座敷8)、喫煙可、カード可・電子マネー・QR 不可、英語メニューあり、2020年11月12日オープン、メニュー (英語版、2026年5月更新): 鯖 (昆布〆) 420円、季節の豚巻き350円、子持ちししゃも280円、鮭ハラス300円、車海老420円、牡蠣 (すだちポン酢) 420円、明太子330円、Kyotanba highland pork のトンテキ350円、刺身、鯖のスモークのマカロニサラダ580円、ちくわの天ぷら600円、鶏むね肉のチャーシュー750円、塩唐揚げ750円、海鮮なめろう880円、たたみいわし400円、卵黄ご飯500円、しじみ汁380円、自家製漬け込みサワー650円。インボイス登録: 木村 高行 (個人)。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): Kujo ねぎ・大葉・レタスの豚巻き、キンミヤ自家製漬け込みサワー、みょうがサワー、焼き鳥はない、席で喫煙可。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu available; phone if you cannot find the door; smoking is allowed inside.

places.name: だいあん 河原町木屋町店 (Diane Kawaramachi Kiyamachi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The draw is a shrimp shabu-shabu hot pot finished with ramen noodles; the menu also has tempura, fried nama-fu, soy-sauce dishes and Sushi Dogs; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, February 2025; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, and the Kyoto dishes include yudofu, sesame tofu, yuba sashimi, grilled eggplant with miso and Kyoto-vegetable tempura, but no dish is marked vegan and the hot-pot broth is made from shrimp heads (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 every day, last order 22:30 (Tabelog; a Gurunavi page dated October 2023 gave 17:00–24:00). People wait at the door for the 17:00 opening (May 2026). Two-hour seating limit, cut to 1 h 30 when busy; the all-you-can-eat shrimp shabu-shabu takes orders for 60 minutes, and reviewers say staff do not announce the end (May 2026). Seat-only bookings need an order of ¥6,000 or more; table charge ¥330 (¥550 from 26 December to 5 January) (Tabelog). 56 seats over two floors, with private rooms for 4 to 30+; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, UnionPay), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Seats look over the Takase River (Gurunavi). 3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi by the Takase River — 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Large Kiyamachi izakaya of sushi, tempura and Kyoto dishes, known on social media for all-you-can-eat shrimp shabu-shabu (2026 reviews) · shrimp shabu-shabu: 8–10 head-on shrimp each to start, eaten raw or swished in a broth that deepens with the shrimp heads, finished with ramen; ¥5,980 (May 2026), ¥4,980 (September 2025) · dashimaki topped with ikura ¥968 · Sushi Dogs (sea urchin and green onion ¥858, negitoro and caviar ¥638, salmon and ikura ¥693) · Kyoto dishes: two-colour nama-fu dengaku ¥638, sesame tofu ¥638, yuba sashimi ¥748, Kyoto yudofu ¥858, Kyoto-vegetable tempura ¥1,078; tempura from ¥300 (Tabelog menu, February 2025) · five-kind sashimi ¥1,518, scallops in butter soy ¥968 (September 2025) · free highball until 18:00 and ¥199 lemon sour until 19:00 (May 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi, all-you-can-eat shrimp shabu-shabu] A two-floor izakaya on Kiyamachi with windows over the Takase River, popular for its all-you-can-eat shrimp shabu-shabu (¥5,980 in May 2026): big head-on shrimp to eat raw or swish in a broth that grows richer with every head, then ramen in the broth to finish. Ordering stops after 60 minutes, and reviewers say no one warns you, so order early. Reviewers praise the shrimp; some found the side dishes average and, in May–June 2026, the floor sticky. The menu also runs to Kyoto dishes — yudofu, yuba, nama-fu dengaku — and Sushi Dogs. Daily 17:00–23:00.

roles: Run by 株式会社ＣＲＯＷＮ (Sakai, Osaka; invoice T9120001167719); no person is named
chef_bio.background: The invoice number on Tabelog (T9120001167719) belongs to 株式会社ＣＲＯＷＮ, head office in Sakai, Osaka (NTA corporate-number site). Gurunavi describes the shop as a 個室居酒屋 centred on Kyoto cuisine, with seats overlooking the Takase River and semi-private rooms. No other だいあん shop was found on Gurunavi or Hot Pepper.
chef_bio.specialty: All-you-can-eat shrimp shabu-shabu; dashimaki with ikura.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner warns that all-you-can-eat orders stop after 60 minutes with no announcement, so order plenty early.
A May 2026 diner found the floor consistently sticky and the end of the all-you-can-eat unannounced; a June 2026 diner also noticed a sticky floor but found the staff "very friendly and welcoming".
A September 2026 diner wished for disposable gloves or napkins for pulling off the shrimp heads.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・寿司、中京区紙屋町674-5、河原町駅から徒歩3分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、年中無休、予約可 (席のみの予約は6,000円以上の注文)、お通し330円、12月26日〜1月5日はチャージ550円、通常2時間制 (混雑時は1時間半)、56席 (1階16、2階40)、個室あり、禁煙、カード可・電子マネー・QR 不可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、インボイス T9120001167719、メニュー (英語版、2025年2月更新): いくらのせだし巻き968円、Sushi Dog、二色の生麩田楽638円、胡麻豆腐638円、湯葉刺し748円、京湯豆腐858円、京野菜の天ぷら盛り合わせ1,078円、天ぷら300円から。国税庁法人番号公表サイト: 株式会社ＣＲＯＷＮ (大阪府堺市)。ぐるなび: 個室居酒屋 だいあん 河原町木屋町、京料理中心、高瀬川を眺められる席、半個室。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年11月、英語): 海老しゃぶ食べ放題5,980円 (2025年9月は4,980円)、生でも食べられる海老、海老の頭の出汁、締めのラーメン、注文は60分まで。

cultural_comfort.note: Book the shrimp shabu-shabu ahead; order freely early, as the all-you-can-eat closes after 60 minutes without warning.

places.name: RESTAURANT hidamarino (レストランヒダマリーノ)
places.gf_detail: Ask by phone when booking: the shop asks guests to tell the chef about allergies by phone, and menu changes may cost extra (Tabelog). Courses include the house baguette, foie gras with pain d’épices and wine sauces (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask when booking; no vegetarian or vegan course is published. Courses are built on fish, duck, foie gras, egg and dairy (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 19:30); closed Wednesday (official site). Tabelog gives lunch 12:00–14:30 with last order 12:30, and irregular closures. Booking only: lunch by the day before, dinner by reservation; one drink per guest at both; lunch is cash only (Tabelog). Schoolchildren order one course; a dish can be made smaller (Tabelog). 16 seats (6 at the counter, 10 at tables), table area can be hired for about 10; wheelchair users asked to tell the shop ahead; non-smoking; cards at dinner (Tabelog). 1 min from exit 15 of Hankyu Karasuma Stn (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Just south of Shijo, east of Karasuma — 1 min from exit 15 of Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Chef ますむら’s French cooking with wine or Kyoto-tea pairings; the house aims for a "round taste" with the five tastes in balance (official site) · lunch "W main" course of 7 dishes with fish and meat ¥7,700 (July and October 2026) · dinner omakase of 10 dishes ¥13,200 (Tabelog) · a short dinner course on the official site: oeuf à la coque, yokowa mi-cuit, hidamarino baguette, sautéed foie gras with pain d’épices, steamed sawara with white-wine sauce, roast duckling with Madeira sauce, dessert, coffee or tea · July 2026 lunch: egg yolk at 115 °C with eggplant and duck ragù in the shell, pepper mousse with Nemuro sea urchin, Kenken bonito with beets, gazpacho with fried young sweetfish, a baguette rubbed with garlic and tomato at the table, Gotō sea bream, Kyoto duck breast · pairings (before tax and the 10% service charge): Kyoto tea, 4 teas including gyokuro, ¥4,000; wine 4 glasses ¥4,000, 6 glasses ¥6,000, 8 glasses ¥7,800 (official site)
places.notes: [French · Shijo Karasuma, French with a Kyoto-tea pairing] A narrow, wood-lined French restaurant a minute from Karasuma Station, where chef ますむら cooks in front of a six-seat counter with two assistants. The house's aim is a 'round taste', the five tastes in balance, matched with wine or with a pairing of four Kyoto teas including gyokuro. Dishes mix French technique and Japanese ingredients: a warm egg yolk served in the shell, sea urchin over pepper mousse, Kyoto duck — and a baguette rubbed with raw garlic and tomato by hand at the table. Lunch 'W main' course ¥7,700; dinner omakase ¥13,200. Booking only, lunch by the day before (cash only at lunch). Closed Wednesday.

roles: Chef (official site signature: "シェフ ますむら"); reviews mention a chef and two assistants (August 2026) and a "friendly owner" (October 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: RESTAURANT hidamarino was born in Kyoto in October 2014 (Tabelog gives the opening day as 10 October 2015). Sister shop: komorebino natural wine bar near Gion-Shijo (Tabelog). Tabelog French WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a "round" taste, like a sphere, with the five tastes (sweet, salty, sour, bitter, umami) in balance and flavour and texture in harmony; pairings with wine or fine Kyoto tea built mainly on "harmony" (同調), since a marriage most often happens when taste and aroma suit each other.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-tea pairing; the hidamarino baguette; egg in the shell.

anecdotes.text: "The dish where you spread raw garlic on the baguette with your hands was innovative and surprising. Just be prepared for your hands to smell!" — October 2026.
A September 2026 diner tried a tea pairing for the first time and found it suited the cooking well.
An August 2026 couple sat next to guests from overseas who were having the pairings, and ordered pairings too.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hidamarino.com): RESTAURANT hidamarino は2014年10月に京都で誕生、五味 (甘味・塩味・酸味・苦味・うま味) のバランスが整い、風味と食感が調和した球体のような「まるい味」、ワインや京銘茶とのペアリング、「同調」が基本、シェフ ますむら、下京区高倉通四条下る高材木町218、阪急烏丸駅15番出口を出てすぐ、Lunch 12:00〜15:00 (L.O 13:00)、Dinner 18:00〜22:00 (L.O 19:30)、水曜定休日、京銘茶のペアリング4,000円 (玉露など4種)、ワインペアリング4杯4,000円・6杯6,000円・SP 8杯7,800円 (税抜、サービス料10%別)、ショートコース: ウッフ・ア・ラ・コック、ヨコワのミキュイ、hidamarinoバゲット、フォアグラのソテーパンデピス、鰆の蒸し焼き 白ワインソース、仔鴨ロースト マデラソース。食べログ: フレンチ・創作、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、ランチは前日までの予約・現金のみ、ディナーは予約のみ、1人1ドリンク、アレルギーは電話でシェフに、2015年10月10日オープン、姉妹店 komorebino natural wine bar、ディナーのおまかせ10品13,200円、フレンチ WEST 百名店 2023・2025。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): W メインのランチ7,700円、ティーペアリング、手でにんにくをこするバゲット。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (lunch by the day before); tell the chef about allergies by phone; lunch is cash only.

places.name: カフェ 火裏蓮花 (Cafe Karirenge)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Lunch is chicken curry; the sweets are cakes (chiffon, cheesecake with a cookie base, matcha milk cake, a Mont Blanc on chocolate cake) and a parfait with cornflakes and arare; no gluten information is published (rurubu, October 2025; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The curries are chicken (butter chicken and spicy chicken) and most sweets use cream, ice cream or cheese; summer shaved ice comes with citrus syrup (August 2026); no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–18:00 (last order 17:00), Monday, Thursday to Sunday and holidays; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; other closures are posted on Instagram (Tabelog; rurubu, October 2025). Shaved ice from 13:30 (Tabelog). No reservations; queue without blocking the doors of the neighbouring houses (Tabelog). Full at lunch on weekends; weekday afternoons can be quiet (August–October 2026); popular items such as the coffee-jelly ice cream can sell out (August 2026). 19 seats; non-smoking; no cards, PayPay accepted; free Wi-Fi; children welcome (Tabelog). At the end of a narrow alley off Yanagibaba-dori, about 5–6 min from Karasuma Oike or Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; rurubu).
places.neighborhood: Alley off Yanagibaba-dori between Oike and Sanjo — 6 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Curry and cake café in a machiya of nearly 150 years, once the home of the first owner (rurubu, October 2025) · chicken curry ¥1,380; a two-curry plate of butter chicken and spicy chicken (October 2026) · まったりお抹茶ミルクケーキ (Uji matcha milk cake) ¥820, 大人のブルーチーズケーキ ¥950 · 珈琲党のための炭焼珈琲ゼリーアイスパフェ, charcoal-roast coffee jelly over vanilla ice cream with arare and nuts, with a mini coffee, ¥1,400 (rurubu, October 2025; September 2026) · seasonal cakes, e.g. fig rare cheesecake, Earl Grey chiffon with figs, Mont Blanc (October 2026) · summer けづり氷 (shaved ice), e.g. citrus (rurubu; August 2026) · 黒蜜ジンジャーラテ ¥720, six house-made drinks, coffee, wine (rurubu; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Café · Karasuma Oike, curry and cake in an alley machiya] A café at the end of a narrow alley near Karasuma Oike, in a townhouse of nearly 150 years that was once the first owner's home: wooden lattice, a small garden, and the sound of a 水琴窟 (water-harp) from the speakers. Lunch is chicken curry, served on the owner's favourite 小鹿田焼 (Onta ware) or antique Western plates; afterwards, cakes like the matcha milk cake or the blue-cheese cake, or the coffee-jelly parfait made for coffee lovers (¥1,400). Shaved ice in summer from 13:30. No bookings; queue quietly in the alley. 12:00–18:00, closed Tuesday and Wednesday; PayPay, no cards.

chef_bio.background: Per rurubu (updated 18 October 2025): a Kyoto machiya of nearly 150 years, originally the home of the first owner; the owner, who loves small things, chose the objects on the shelves, and uses favourite Onta ware (小鹿田焼, from Oita) and antique Western plates for the curry; the speakers play the sound of a 水琴窟. An October 2026 reviewer writes that the name refers to a Chinese saying about a flower that blooms beautifully and strongly even in fire, in adversity. Tabelog Cafe "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022 and Cafe WEST 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken curry; charcoal-roast coffee-jelly parfait; cakes.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner waiting for the opening was kindly invited in with "We are already open."
A September 2026 diner who roasts coffee at home found the coffee-jelly parfait less striking than its "for coffee lovers" name, the handle-less cup too hot to hold and the music a little loud.
An October 2026 diner was disappointed that the Mont Blanc was a Mont Blanc top on a chocolate cake, but praised the staff and the coffee.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: るるぶ&more. (2025年10月18日更新): 静かな住宅街の路地裏の京町家カフェ、築150年近くの町家はもとは初代オーナーの自宅、小物好きのオーナーが選んだ雑貨、スピーカーから流れる水琴窟の音色、カレー皿は大分の小鹿田焼 (おんたやき) やアンティークの洋皿、地下鉄烏丸御池駅と京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分ほど、チキンカレー1,380円、まったりお抹茶ミルクケーキ820円、珈琲党のための炭焼珈琲ゼリーアイスパフェ1,400円、大人のブルーチーズケーキ950円、黒蜜ジンジャーラテ720円、夏季限定のけづり氷、手作りドリンク6種、12〜18時 (17時LO)、火・水曜休み。食べログ: カフェ・カレー・ケーキ、中京区柳馬場通姉小路上ル柳八幡町74-4、月・木〜日・祝 12:00〜18:00、火・水休み、かき氷は13:30から、休みは Instagram で、予約不可、近隣の玄関をふさがずに並ぶ、19席、カード不可・PayPay 可、カフェ百名店 2021・2022、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): バターチキンとスパイシーチキンのあいがけカレー、珈琲ゼリーのパフェ、いちじくのレアチーズケーキ、アールグレイのシフォン、モンブラン。

cultural_comfort.note: No bookings; queue quietly in the alley; pay by cash or PayPay.

places.name: 活魚居酒屋 マルフク (Katsugyo Izakaya Marufuku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Fish courses use soy sauce, ponzu and gochujang-soy tare, fried fugu and tempura, and finish with udon, soba or ramen; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a live-fish izakaya; even the shabu-shabu broth is made from conger eel bones with bonito and kombu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (last food order 22:30, drinks 23:00); Sun 13:00–22:30 (last order 21:30); public holidays 13:00–22:30; closing days vary (Tabelog). Reservations taken; a table booking may be seated at the counter when busy (Tabelog). Charge ¥400 per person (Tabelog). 19 seats: counter, tables, tatami and a private room for 4; non-smoking, ashtray outside; cards accepted, no e-money or QR payments (Tabelog). On the Takase River, 1 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn, 2 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi by the Takase River, north of Shijo — 1 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Live-fish izakaya: fish prepared to order, with seasonal courses (2024–2026 reviews) · summer: live hamo shabu-shabu course ¥11,000 — sashimi platter, the day's tataki, an "unrolled" eel omelette, salt-grilled ayu, hamo shabu-shabu in a broth of hamo bones with bonito and kombu (leftover hamo made into tempura on request), sudachi udon, matcha monaka (July–September 2026) · fugu: torafugu charcoal-grill course ¥9,800 — fugu skin, fugu "kejang" in spicy sauce, tessa, fried fugu, fugu grilled at the table on a shichirin with salt or soy-gochujang tare, fugu nigiri, chawanmushi (September–October 2026) · à la carte: sashimi platters, hamo and Kujo negi champuru, yuba and nagaimo salad, crab cream croquettes, grilled fugu, hirezake · shio or shoyu ramen to finish (November 2024) · sake from around Japan, e.g. Houou Bida ¥1,280, Asahi draft ¥580 (October 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi, live fish, hamo and fugu] A fish izakaya set back from the Takase River, a minute from Kawaramachi Stn, with a counter, tables and tatami. In summer the draw is the live hamo shabu-shabu course (¥11,000): sashimi, the day's tataki, an "unrolled" eel omelette and ayu, then hamo swished through a cloudy broth simmered from hamo bones with bonito and kombu, finished with sudachi udon. The other draw is torafugu, grilled at the table over charcoal (course ¥9,800, September–October 2026). There is plenty à la carte too, with a regional sake list. ¥400 charge; cards accepted; open to 23:00, from 13:00 on Sundays.

roles: Owner and head chef (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists the shop as run by a corporate member. Reviews describe the head chef preparing live fugu to order (March 2024) and the owner helping diners with the first round of the hamo hot pot (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Live hamo shabu-shabu (summer); charcoal-grilled torafugu.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner learned that the cloudy shabu-shabu broth is hamo bones and heads simmered with bonito and kombu broth and the innards.
"While the charcoal is heating up, please enjoy this" — the crispy fried fugu that arrives with the grill, October 2026.
A September 2026 reviewer had passed the alley countless times without noticing the set-back entrance, and judged the ¥9,800 fugu course exceptionally reasonable.
A September 2026 diner noted cat-shaped chopstick rests on the table.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 活魚居酒屋 マルフク、居酒屋・海鮮・ふぐ、中京区鍋屋町225 萩原ビル 1F、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩1分、祇園四条駅から徒歩2分、月〜土 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:30)、日 13:00〜22:30、祝日 13:00〜22:30、定休日不定、予約可、チャージ料400円、19席、個室 (4人)、掘りごたつ・座敷、禁煙 (店前に灰皿)、カード可、日本酒・焼酎にこだわり、魚にこだわり。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 活鱧しゃぶしゃぶコース11,000円、刺身盛り合わせ、本日のたたき、う巻きの巻かないもの、鮎の塩焼き、すだちうどん、抹茶モナカ、とらふぐ炭火焼コース9,800円、ふぐのケジャン、てっさ、ふぐ唐揚げ、七輪、ひれ酒、締めのラーメン (塩・醤油)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course ahead; ¥400 seat charge; cards accepted.

places.name: A kyoto
places.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase courses use house soy marinades, white miso, sukiyaki sauce, spring-roll wrappers and panko; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fixed omakase courses built on fish and black wagyu, with dashi in the soups and side dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:30–22:00; closed Tuesday and occasionally on other days, announced on Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations taken; the whole room can be booked by phone (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese original 「なし」; the English page wrongly says one is added). 12 counter seats, with a terrace view of the Kamo River (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Menu in English and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); about 70% of guests were from abroad on a September 2026 visit. Non-smoking; cards and QUICPay, no QR payments (Tabelog). Through a gate, on the right; 2 min from Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 9 January 2026 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: By the Kamo River near Shijo — 2 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Counter that joins Japanese cuisine and teppanyaki, centred on black wagyu and Kyoto vegetables; the course changes on the first day of odd-numbered months (opening article, January 2026) · lunch "light" omakase, 8 dishes, ¥8,000 (September 2026) · omakase, 10 dishes (about 1 hour 30 minutes), ¥12,000 (August 2026) · autumn 2026 dishes: tuna marinated in house soy sauce, Fushimi fig with white miso and mascarpone, horse mackerel and taro spring rolls, black wagyu sukiyaki on the teppan with a northern-Kyoto egg yolk, pomegranate sorbet, amadai and eggplant dengaku, pumpkin dashi soup, black wagyu tenderloin 60–80 g with salt, wasabi and salted kombu, Kyoto rice with pickles, miso-and-yogurt gelato (September–November 2026) · wine by the glass ¥1,300, Premium Malt's draft ¥1,000, Ichiro's Malt highball (August–September 2026)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki & Japanese · Kiyamachi, a Kamo River counter] A new (January 2026) twelve-seat counter in a renovated machiya more than a century old, with a terrace view over the Kamo River. Two chefs — one for Japanese dishes, one for the teppan — cook an omakase that runs from marinated tuna and a fig with white miso through wagyu sukiyaki on the griddle to a black wagyu tenderloin, then Kyoto rice and a miso-and-yogurt gelato. Omakase ¥8,000 (lunch, 8 dishes) or ¥12,000 (10 dishes). English menu and English-speaking staff; on one September 2026 visit about 70% of the guests were from abroad. Closed Tuesday; book ahead.

roles: Run by ORI Corporation, Taito-ku, Tokyo (opening article)
A team of four: manager, Japanese-cuisine chef, teppanyaki chef and a server (September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per an opening article of 6 January 2026: ORI Corporation opened A kyoto (teppanyaki, ground floor) and B kyoto (a tea-and-gin café-bar upstairs) on 9 January 2026 in a renovated Kyoto machiya more than 100 years old, finished by experienced plasterers. A September 2026 reviewer adds that the Japanese-cuisine chef has a background in French cooking.
chef_bio.specialty: Black wagyu tenderloin teppanyaki; omakase of Japanese dishes and teppanyaki.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 reviewer worried that the name sounded aimed at inbound tourists, found that about 70% of the guests were from abroad, and concluded that Japanese guests enjoy it just as much.
Before the sukiyaki, the day’s meat is shown to the guest with the green onions and onions (September 2026).
The northern-Kyoto egg yolk served with the sukiyaki comes from hens fed paprika and fish powder, which a September 2026 reviewer credits for its deep colour.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: A kyoto、鉄板焼き・日本料理、下京区斎藤町140-6 1F、阪急京都河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩2分、11:30〜14:30・17:30〜22:00、火曜休み (ほか不定休、インスタグラムで告知)、予約可、サービス料あり、カウンター12席、テラス、英語メニュー・英語の話せるスタッフ、カード・QUICPay 可、2026年1月9日オープン。開業記事 (2026年1月6日、英語): ORI Corporation (東京都台東区)、築100年以上の京町家、1階が A kyoto、2階が茶とジンのカフェバー B kyoto、黒毛和牛と京野菜、コースは奇数月の1日に替わる。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): ランチのおまかせ8品8,000円、おまかせ10品12,000円、鴨川の眺め、黒毛和牛ヒレ80g、味噌とヨーグルトのジェラート。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); most guests are from abroad (September 2026).

places.name: いとう (Ito)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking: the chef builds each course around what the guest asks for on the phone, no bread is served, and the courses lean on fish, vegetables and rice; sauces are not described for gluten (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask when booking. Every course has a large plate of a dozen or more Kyoto vegetables, but the rest is fish and meat; requests are discussed by phone (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 12:00–13:30 and 17:00–22:00; Sat–Sun 11:30–13:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only, by phone; dinner is the main service and lunch is not often served (2023 reviews). A January 2026 reviewer advises phoning rather than booking online, because the chef asks about preferences, portion size and the main dish. 10 counter seats; non-smoking; cards accepted (Tabelog). On Furumonzen-dori; 344 m from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Furumonzen-dori, Higashiyama — 5 min walk from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Classic French as an omakase, cooked by one chef at a U-shaped counter and tailored to each booking (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews) · amuse of raw fish, e.g. sawara, aori squid, persimmon and prosciutto · a plate of a dozen or more Kyoto vegetables named for the month, with an "essence of beets" · ancient rice with sea urchin and truffle, or with fugu or salmon roe · fish such as live mackerel · Southdown milk lamb from Ishida Farm, or Omi beef rump · Uji hojicha; dessert only on request, e.g. blancmange · a deep, mainly Burgundy wine list (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews) · a tailored course cost ¥12,000 (January 2026)
places.notes: [French · Higashiyama, a one-chef counter in its third decade] A ten-seat U-shaped counter on Furumonzen-dori in Higashiyama where owner-chef Tsutomu Ito has cooked alone for more than twenty years. The course is set on the phone: the chef asks what you like, how much you eat and which main you want, then builds an omakase around Kyoto vegetables (a dozen-plus on one plate), the season's fish, ancient rice with sea urchin and truffle, and lamb or Omi beef. The wine list is the other draw, mostly Burgundy, with old vintages. Some reviewers found the chef's firm views on wine and photos uncomfortable; others found the chef humble and pleasant. A tailored course cost ¥12,000 in January 2026; Tabelog’s dinner average is ¥15,000–19,999. Phone to book; closed Monday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Tsutomu Ito (romaji from a February 2024 review; the kanji is not in a source)
roles: Owner-chef (February 2024 review: "The owner-chef, Tsutomu Ito, manages everything"; Tabelog: "Owner-chef Ito")
chef_bio.background: Reviews describe a one-person counter run for 22 years (September 2025) or 23 years (January 2026). Tabelog's introduction calls the shop "Seiyo Chubo Ito" and describes classic French courses, a Kyoto seasonal vegetable platter, domestic Southdown lamb and wines mainly from Burgundy. Tabelog French WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023 and 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per a January 2026 review: guests may customise everything from the ingredients to the shape of the menu.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto seasonal vegetable plate; ancient rice with sea urchin and truffle; Southdown lamb.

anecdotes.text: A July 2023 lunch guest who ordered sparkling water was told that wine is standard and that the sauces would be made lighter without it, and found the meal uncomfortable.
A February 2024 reviewer notes that the seasoning is adjusted for wine drinkers and non-drinkers, and that older guests who do not drink are welcome.
A June 2025 diner praised the dishes, the house wine and the handwritten menu but felt the master's manner suggested only those who understand the cooking can appreciate it.
"It's rare to find a restaurant that serves a 1960 vintage Palmer" — October 2026.
"The chef mentioned that the restaurant mainly caters to regulars, with many doctors as patrons." — July 2023.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: いとう、フレンチ、東山区古門前通石橋町307、東山駅から344m、火〜金 12:00〜13:30・17:00〜22:00、土日 11:30〜13:00・17:00〜22:00、月曜休み、完全予約制、10席、禁煙、カード可、ワインにこだわり、魚にこだわり、フレンチ WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2025。店の紹介 (英訳): オーナーシェフの Ito によるクラシックなフレンチのコース、京の旬野菜の盛り合わせ、国産サウスダウン種の羊、ブルゴーニュ中心のワイン。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): オーナーシェフ Tsutomu Ito がひとりで営む、22〜23年、電話で好みを聞いて作るおまかせ、古代米とウニとトリュフ、京野菜の皿、パンなし、デザートは別注文、ワインを飲まない客にはソースを軽く。

places.name: カフェ ビブリオティック ハロー! (Cafe Bibliotic Hello!)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Most food is wheat-based — tarts, cakes, sandwiches, pasta and bread from the bakery — alongside hayashi rice; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Cakes and tarts use cream, cheese and eggs; drinks such as juices, black coffee and tea suit, but no vegan information is given (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–23:00 every day (Tabelog). The official site, last updated in 2017, gives 11:30–24:00 with last order 23:00, and a ground-floor bakery (Hello Bakery) closed on Monday. No reservations; a queue can form at lunch (October 2026). Fruit sandwiches from 14:00 (October 2026). 45 seats on two floors; the upstairs is quieter (September 2026). No smoking inside, allowed in the small back garden; cash only — no cards, e-money or QR payments (Tabelog). 6 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn exit 9 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo-dori at Yanagibaba — 6 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Café and bakery behind banana trees, with a library wall of bookshelves (2026 reviews; official site) · breakfast and lunch plates, hayashi rice, sandwiches, seafood and tomato pasta · fruit tarts in seven kinds, e.g. mango tart ¥900; Basque cheesecake ¥750; gâteau chocolat; fruit sandwiches from 14:00 · banana lassi ¥900, mixed fruit lassi, shakes, juices, Mandheling coffee ¥750, Yakushima grape tea, wine (September–October 2026)
places.notes: [Café · Nijo, a book-lined café behind banana trees] A café on Nijo-dori that you spot by the banana trees and potted plants at the door: inside, warm wood, a wall of bookshelves like a library, sofas and music, with a quieter upstairs. Lunch plates, hayashi rice and pasta, then seven kinds of fruit tart (mango ¥900), Basque cheesecake and lassis through the afternoon and evening, with wine. Open 11:30–23:00 every day; no bookings and a line at lunchtime; many guests are visitors from abroad. One reviewer rated the room above the drinks and found some staff curt. Cash only.

roles: Operator not named in the sources
chef_bio.background: The official site (copyright 2012, last news 2017) lists the café, a ground-floor bakery (Hello Bakery) and a rental gallery upstairs (Halo Galo). Tabelog Cafe "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022 and Cafe WEST 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Fruit tarts; lassis.

anecdotes.text: "Inside, the warm wooden decor, along with a wall full of bookshelves reminiscent of a library, creates a spacious and inviting atmosphere" — September 2026.
A September 2026 visitor loved the room, the hours and the music but found the hot drink poorly made and some staff surprisingly curt.
"The signal is weak, and while there seems to be Wi-Fi, it's not really available." — October 2026.
An October 2026 visitor waited about ten minutes at 13:00 on a Sunday and noted that more than half the customers were from abroad.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (cafe-hello.jp、最終更新2017年): Cafe Bibliotic Hello!、中京区二条柳馬場東入ル晴明町650、11:30〜24:00 (ラストオーダー23時)、1階ハローベーカリー (11:30〜23:00、月曜休み)、2階ハロー画廊 (レンタルギャラリー)。食べログ: カフェ・パン、毎日11:30〜23:00、予約不可、45席、店内禁煙 (奥の小さな庭で喫煙可)、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カフェ百名店 2021・2022、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): バナナの木の入口、図書館のような本棚、2階は静か、7種のフルーツタルト、マンゴータルト900円、バスクチーズケーキ750円、バナナラッシー900円、マンデリン750円、ハヤシライス、フルーツサンドは14時から、海外からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Wait at the door at busy times; many guests from abroad; cash only.

places.name: mixologybar smooth
places.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail bar: fresh-fruit cocktails on liqueurs, whisky and brandy, some with mascarpone or milk fat, and dried-apple or apple-chip snacks; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Many cocktails are fresh fruit with spirits, but some use mascarpone or milk fat; no ingredient list is published (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–03:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; the whole bar can be hired for up to 20 (Tabelog). A ¥500 a person charge (Tabelog). Cocktails about ¥1,000–2,000 each (February 2026); strong, but can be made lighter on request (April 2026). 19 seats: 11 at the counter and 8 at tables, with a sofa at the back (Tabelog; July 2026). Heated tobacco only inside, ashtray outside (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi-dori, ground floor of ヨシキビル; 3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu) (Tabelog). Opened 7 July 2006 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi-dori near Shijo — 3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Mixology bar: fresh-fruit cocktails made with liquid nitrogen, espuma and smoke machines (Tabelog shop text) · melon mojito, kiwi and pear cocktails, a mascarpone cocktail, a liquid-nitrogen mojito, a chocolate-mint cocktail with frozen milk fat (about 10% alcohol), smoked cocktails, a smoky coffee cocktail with a salt-and-chocolate rim (2023–2026 reviews) · cocktails made to your stated taste (March 2025) · apple chips and dried apple with the drinks (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Cocktail bar · Kiyamachi, fresh fruit and liquid nitrogen] A late-night mixology bar on Kiyamachi, open since 2006 until 03:00: tell the bartenders what you like and they build a fresh-fruit cocktail in front of you with liquid nitrogen, espuma, smoke, a triangular flask of brandy and test tubes of water — a melon mojito, a kiwi or pear cocktail, a chocolate-mint drink of frozen milk fat. Cocktails run about ¥1,000–2,000, plus ¥500 a head; they pour strong but will make it lighter. Counter, a few tables and a sofa at the back; English menu. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: "Fresh Fruits + Cutting-Edge Technology → Mixology", using fresh fruits, liquid nitrogen, espuma and smoke machines. Opened 7 July 2006 (Tabelog). Reviews from 2023 to 2026 describe friendly, talkative bartenders (two on a May 2026 night), regulars who liven the room when busy (July 2026), and drinks made to order from a guest’s stated taste.
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh-fruit cocktails; liquid-nitrogen and smoked cocktails.

anecdotes.text: "I simply said I wanted something coffee-based, and they served me a smoky, sweet coffee cocktail... I was amazed to find the rim of the glass coated with salt and chocolate!" — March 2025.
"The brandy stored in a triangular flask, distilled water poured from a test tube, and the smoke machine with liquid nitrogen created an exciting atmosphere!" — July 2026.
"The alcohol was quite strong in a good way, so if you're not used to drinking, be careful not to overindulge. ⚠️ They can make it lighter upon request." — April 2026.
"I thought bars in Kyoto would be intimidating and hard to enter." Then: "once I started talking to them, I realized how fun they were." — May 2026.

places.name: ja!rêve DESSERT&WINE
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog’s staff-maintained listing ticks "gluten-free options", but no gluten-free dish is named; the desserts are tarts, cakes, Mont Blanc and croissants (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The plated desserts use cream, custard, butter pastry and ice cream; fruit and gelato vary; no ingredient list is published (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog lists 18:30–23:30 (last order), closed Wednesday and irregularly; the shop text says it is open from the morning as a café, with croissant sandwiches and espresso, and reviewers came at 10:00 (September 2025) and for brunch (March 2026), but no morning hours are published (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Bookings accepted; each guest orders at least one food item and one drink; ¥1,000 a person for cancellations the day before (Tabelog). 10% service charge and a one-drink rule (Tabelog). Bring-your-own bottled wine with a ¥3,000 corkage (Tabelog). Birthday plates on advance request (Tabelog). 9–11 counter seats plus tables at the back; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog; January 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR; one reviewer could not use PayPay (Tabelog; September 2025). Ground floor of the hotel Rakuten STAY URBAN四条河原 (as Tabelog writes it); 5 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 22 January 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Hotel ground floor south of Shijo, west of the Kamo River — 5 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Dessert café-bar with wine: plated desserts finished at the counter by a pastry chef who is also a certified sommelier, with wines to match (Tabelog shop text; June 2026) · melon tart assembled in front of you with cream, custard, crown melon and white wine jelly, ¥2,500 (April 2025) · classic chocolate cake with strawberry ice cream; pudding plate with matcha meringue cookies and berry gelato; strawberry shortcake; Mont Blanc on a log-shaped plate; coffee jelly; affogato with homemade vanilla ice cream (2025–2026 reviews) · mornings: croissants and croissant sandwiches with salad, summer mango-and-cheese croissant, espresso from beans ground to order (Tabelog shop text; 2025–2026 reviews) · wines by the glass, sparkling wine, royal milk tea, a blue latte (2025–2026 reviews) · baked goods to take away (January 2026)
places.notes: [Desserts & wine · Shijo Kawaramachi, a pastry chef-sommelier's counter] A blue-themed counter on the ground floor of a hotel south of Shijo, where a pastry chef who is also a sommelier finishes plated desserts in front of you — a melon tart broken open at the counter (¥2,500), Mont Blanc, pudding with matcha meringue — and pours a wine to go with each, until 23:30. It opens as a café in the morning too, for croissants and espresso. One food and one drink each, plus 10% service; reviewers call the prices bar-level. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Pastry chef, also a certified sommelier (Tabelog shop text); a barista for the coffee; no one is named
chef_bio.background: Per the shop’s Tabelog text: a café-bar for any time of day — croissant sandwiches, homemade pastries and barista espresso from the morning; in the evening, plated desserts by a pastry chef who is also a certified sommelier, with wines; a blue-themed interior. Opened 22 January 2023 (Tabelog). One reviewer chatted with the owner (January 2026); another received Kyoto travel tips at the end of a visit (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Plated desserts with wine pairings; croissants.

anecdotes.text: "The tart is assembled right in front of you, and then served after being beautifully broken apart." — April 2025.
"It was fun to watch the pastry chef finish them right at the counter. … I was thrilled to receive tips for my trip to Kyoto at the end." — June 2026.
"It was a holiday evening, but since it was late, I was able to get in without a reservation." Some desserts were sold out by 22:30. — January 2026.
"If I had to mention one downside, being a bar, the prices are generally on the higher side." — July 2026.

places.name: eze bleu (エズ ブルー)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery — croissants, hard breads, baguettes, Danish and donuts (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Croissants and many pastries are made with butter, cream or cheese; the hard breads and baguettes are simpler, but no ingredient list is published (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 7:00–19:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog; an October 2026 review gives the same hours). Takeaway only (Tabelog). Popular items sell out by lunchtime, and by mid-afternoon much of the shelf is empty — go in the morning (September and October 2026). Cash only (Tabelog; September 2026). No parking; coin parking nearby (October 2026). On Imadegawa-dori west of Teramachi, under a red awning; 5 min walk from Imadegawa Stn, 8 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Imadegawa-dori west of Teramachi, by the Imperial Palace — 5 min walk from Imadegawa Stn
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood bakery of everyday breads and authentic hard breads, most items around ¥200 (2026 reviews) · Bacon Spice, a hard bread with bacon, cheese and black pepper, ¥324 (the best-seller in June 2025) · all-butter croissant ¥248, pain au chocolat ¥259, apple-cinnamon Danish ¥259, Furano melon-cream bun ¥216, cream bun ¥205, butter roll ¥118, cinnamon donut ¥172 (September 2026) · potato-butter French bread ¥248 (October 2026); pain aux fruits with raisins and walnuts ¥669, mini sausage croissant ¥97 (September 2026) · sesame baguette, cheese-and-bean bread, curry donut with egg, pear pie, rusks (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bakery · Imadegawa, the neighbourhood's bread] A takeaway bakery under a red awning on Imadegawa-dori near the Imperial Palace and Doshisha, open from 7:00, with shelves of everyday breads at around ¥200 and serious hard breads — the cheese-and-pepper Bacon Spice (¥324) is the favourite, and the all-butter croissant (¥248) is crisp outside and moist within. Go in the morning; by mid-afternoon much is sold out. Cash only; closed Tuesday. Tabelog Bread WEST 100 2026.

roles: Bakery (no baker is named in the sources)
chef_bio.background: A September 2026 reviewer calls it a bakery "around for a long time and … loved by the locals"; another returned after five and a half years and found it an everyday bakery with basic breads at fair prices. Tabelog Bread WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Bacon Spice; croissant; hard breads.

anecdotes.text: "The croissant had a crispy outer layer and a moist interior, making it absolutely delightful." — October 2026.
"When I visited on a Saturday at 3 PM, most of the items were sold out" — September 2026.
A June 2025 visitor bought "the popular No. 1 item, Bacon Spice": "a hard bread with a great blend of spices, and the combination of bacon and cheese was absolutely delicious."

places.name: ビリヤニ専門店 INDIA GATE (Biryani Senmon Ten INDIA GATE)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Biryani is basmati rice, but it comes with a little mapo tofu and achaar on the side, and the sea bream biryani uses a dashi; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the biryanis are chicken, mutton or sea bream (in a fish dashi), with mapo tofu on the side; lassi and chai are dairy (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Friday and Saturday 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–20:00; Sunday 11:30–15:30; closed Wednesday and Thursday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog): a queue forms at opening — about ten people at 11:30 on a Sunday, under an hour’s wait (October 2026); a weekday 13:30 visitor waited about 10 minutes (September 2026). One drink per person on weekends (October 2026). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay; takeaway; English menu (Tabelog). Do not leave bicycles at neighbouring shops; use the nearby bicycle park (Tabelog). On a narrow one-way street (November 2026); 5 min walk from Karasuma Stn (Hankyu), near Shijo Stn (subway) (Tabelog). Opened 31 July 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Side street west of Shijo Karasuma — 5 min walk from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Biryani specialist with a gentle, Japanese-leaning style (2026 reviews) · chicken biryani; mutton biryani (spicier); sea bream dashi chicken biryani, mild so the broth comes through; limited biryanis such as shirasu and fresh seaweed; two-kind platters; each comes with achaar and a little mapo tofu (2026 reviews) · mutton keema; extra toppings such as spiced egg and nagaimo achaar (October–November 2026) · spice highball (Suntory Kaku with cinnamon, clove and cardamom), Sapporo Lager, lassi, weekend chai (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Biryani · Shijo Karasuma, an 8-seat biryani counter] An eight-seat counter on a narrow side street west of Shijo Karasuma that is only about biryani: fluffy basmati rice in chicken, mutton or a mild sea bream-dashi chicken version, served with achaar and a spoon of mapo tofu, often as a two-kind platter. The style is gentle and Japanese-leaning, with the mutton the spicy one; weekends bring chai and a one-drink rule. Expect a queue at opening (up to an hour on a Sunday). Lunch and early dinner; closed Wednesday and Thursday. Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST 100 2026.

roles: Manager and staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Opened 31 July 2020 (Tabelog); a November 2026 reviewer notes six years in business. Reviewers in 2026 call it one of Japan’s top three biryani shops; it has taken pop-ups to Tokyo (Seibu Ikebukuro in January 2022; Toranomon Yokocho "SPICE UP!" in September 2026) and served a lamb noodle bowl, "Hitsujiro", at a 2026 ramen event. A November 2026 reviewer praised "the youthful energy of the manager and staff". Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Sea bream dashi chicken biryani; mutton biryani.

anecdotes.text: "On Sunday afternoon, I arrived at the restaurant shortly after it opened at 11:30 AM, and there were about 10 people in line." — October 2026.
"The Sea Bream Dashi Chicken Biryani was mild in spice, allowing the rich flavor of the broth to shine through" — October 2026.
"The restaurant is small, and the street in front is a narrow one-way, making it feel a bit risky with cars passing by. The youthful energy of the manager and staff is fantastic!" — November 2026.
A September 2026 diner found it "wasn't spicy and wasn't served piping hot", mild and refreshing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: インド料理・カレー、中京区天神山町271、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩5分、月・火・金・土 11:30〜14:30・17:00〜20:00、日 11:30〜15:30、水・木休み、予約不可、8席 (カウンター)、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、テイクアウト、英語メニューあり、近くの店や会社の駐輪場に自転車を停めない、2020年7月31日オープン、アジア・エスニック WEST 百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年9〜11月、英語): チキンビリヤニ、マトンビリヤニ、鯛出汁チキンビリヤニ、しらすと生のりの限定ビリヤニ、2種盛り、アチャールと麻婆豆腐、マトンキーマ、スパイスハイボール、週末のチャイと1ドリンク制、開店時の行列、狭い一方通行の道、東京でのポップアップ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; queue at the door, no reservations; cards and PayPay accepted.
