places.name: B STORE 1st
places.gf_detail: Ask. The menu centres on pasta, pizza, bread and baked sweets, alongside charcoal-grilled meat and vegetables; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the lunch starts with seasonal vegetables and hummus, but the pastas and grills are mostly meat, cheese or cream (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:30 and dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); Friday dinner only; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). The Kamo River terrace (kawadoko) runs 1 May–15 October, with terrace lunch only in May, June, September and October (Tabelog remarks; the seat note says to the end of September). Lunch is a pasta set (¥1,950, booked online, seat assigned by the shop); dinner is à la carte in a "neo izakaya" style (Tabelog). 26 seats; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; English menu; cards and QR payments (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi-dori south of Shijo, by the Takase River; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn across the Shijo bridge (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Shijo, between the Takase and Kamo rivers — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal grilling, craft pasta and wine in a renovated 100-year-old townhouse on the Kamo River, by an Italy-trained chef (Tabelog) · lunch set ¥1,950: seasonal-vegetable appetizers, bread, a choice of pasta and a drink — charcoal-grilled chicken confit with lemon carbonara (+¥500), chilled basil genovese with prosciutto and eggplant (2025–26 reviews) · dessert plate of baked sweets from the sister bakery B STORE 2nd, +¥500 (September 2025, July 2026) · dinner: Caesar salad, carrot râpé, fries, Gorgonzola pizza, lamb-and-cabbage spring rolls, porcini-and-duck cream pasta, charcoal-grilled A5 wagyu, mini lobster gratin (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Kiyamachi on the Kamo River, a kawadoko townhouse] A renovated century-old townhouse on the Kamo River side of Kiyamachi, run by an Italy-trained chef: charcoal-grilled meats and vegetables, craft pasta and wine. Lunch is a ¥1,950 pasta set with vegetable starters, bread and a drink (add ¥500 for baked sweets from the sister bakery, B STORE 2nd); dinner is shared plates. From May to mid-October there are terrace seats over the river. Closed Wednesday; no lunch on Friday.

roles: Chef (unnamed; trained in Italy, per the operator’s Tabelog text)
chef_bio.background: Opened 19 September 2022 (Tabelog). Per the operator’s Tabelog text: an innovative restaurant in a 100-year-old machiya along the Kamo River; the chef, who trained in Italy, brings a fresh perspective to Japanese food culture. Sister shop: B STORE 2nd (Tabelog), whose baked sweets are served here.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled chicken with lemon carbonara; kawadoko terrace.

anecdotes.text: A guest who has come 22 times called the chef’s porcini-and-duck cream pasta with truffle "among the best I’ve ever had" — August 2026.
A July 2026 diner found the steamed vegetables reduced and the mains small, with no explanation of the grilling and too little staff knowledge of wine and food (¥7,500 for two).
"I visit every year during the kawadoko season!" — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: B STORE 1st 炭火焼きパスタとワイン、イタリアン・イノベーティブ、下京区斎藤町140-25、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分 (四条大橋を渡って木屋町通を左へ)、月火木土日・祝 12:00〜15:30・17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、金曜は夜のみ、水曜休み、26席、川床 (5月1日〜10月15日、昼の川床は5・6・9・10月のみ)、禁煙、無料 Wi-Fi、英語メニュー、カード・QR 可、2022年9月19日オープン、パスタ選択ランチセット1,950円、姉妹店 B STORE 2nd、築100年の町家、イタリアで修業したシェフ、夜はネオ居酒屋スタイル、ベジタリアンメニューあり。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 炭火焼きチキンコンフィのレモンカルボナーラ、冷製ジェノベーゼ、デザート+500円、ゴルゴンゾーラのピザ、A5和牛の炭火焼き。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book lunch online; terrace seats in season.

places.name: レスカモトゥール バー (L'ESCAMOTEUR BAR)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail bar; the drinks use spirits, liqueurs and syrups whose ingredients are not published, and a reviewer mentions food without naming it (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Cocktails only are described; ingredients such as egg white, cream or honey are not listed (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 19:00–1:00, Tuesday to Sunday; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2024 found it opening at 20:00 and nearly full at once, with a queue before opening. No reservations (Tabelog; November 2025): late arrivals stand at the side counter. 12 seats plus standing; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Stage-magic cocktails about ¥2,000–2,500, service charge included (December 2025). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payments (Tabelog). Second floor, on 西石垣通 south of Shijo; 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of Shijo between Kiyamachi and the Kamo River, 2F — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Magic-themed mixology bar: "Stage Magic" cocktails grouped by the show that comes with them — ALCHEMY, FIRE, SMOKE, BANG — e.g. Fudo Myo-o, Death in Provence, Strawberry Ichie and Get Your Spirit Back (¥2,500 each in December 2025), smoky old fashioned; also standard cocktails and omakase cocktails (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Cocktail bar · Shijo-Kiyamachi, magic in a glass] A small second-floor bar like a wizard's den — swing chairs, a restroom behind a bookshelf, loud music on the stairs — where each "Stage Magic" cocktail comes with its own trick, chosen by style: alchemy, fire, smoke or bang. Most staff and guests are from overseas and English is the working language. Cocktails about ¥2,000–2,500 with service included. No bookings and it fills fast, so come at opening. Smoking allowed. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner, a professional magician (per a January 2024 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 14 February 2015 (Tabelog). Per 2024–26 reviews: a magic bar where the bartenders perform with the drinks, with guest participation; in March 2024 about 90% of guests were from overseas and most staff did not speak much Japanese, while a November 2025 reviewer found the Japanese staff fluent in English.
chef_bio.specialty: Stage Magic cocktails.

anecdotes.text: "This magic bar not only offers magic tricks but also a playful atmosphere, and the flirtatious staff are amazing!" — January 2024.
"The owner is Christoph, a professional magician!" — January 2024.
"The restroom is hidden behind a bookshelf, which adds an element of excitement." — August 2025.
Arriving at 20:10, a March 2024 reviewer found it already full and was sent to the standing area; a server from South Africa appears in the photos.
"I was pleasantly surprised that the prices included service charges." — December 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: レスカモトゥール バー (L'ESCAMOTEUR BAR)、バー、下京区西石垣通四条下ル斎藤町138番地9 2階、京都河原町駅から徒歩5分、火〜日 19:00〜1:00、月曜休み、予約不可、12席、喫煙可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)・QR 可、2015年2月14日オープン。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年2月、英語): マジックバー、オーナーはプロのマジシャンの Christoph、STAGE MAGIC のカクテル (ALCHEMY、FIRE、SMOKE、BANG)、1杯2,000〜2,500円でサービス料込み、客とスタッフの多くは海外から、開店前から行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff work in English (November 2025); no bookings; come at opening.

places.name: Bar K6
places.gf_detail: Ask. A bar with a food menu of pâté, carpaccio, oil sardines, house-smoked quail eggs and cheese, pizza, pasta and fries; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Spirits and many cocktails suit; the food is mostly meat, fish and cheese (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–2:00; closed Monday and Tuesday (official site; Tabelog); last food order 1:00 (July 2026). Bookings by phone (Tabelog; June 2026). A ¥550 charge applies at the bar counter, not on the casual floor (July 2026). 40 seats: a large semicircular counter and group seating; smoking allowed, and cigars are served (Tabelog; June 2026). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). Second floor of the Vals building, up an outdoor staircase on Nijo-dori just east of Kiyamachi; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (official site; Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Nijo-dori just east of Kiyamachi, near The Ritz-Carlton — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Cocktail and whisky bar: a long shelf of whisky, cocktails made to the guest’s taste, the house gin and tonic (2026 reviews) · cocktails such as a Quarter Deck with wasanbon sugar and a Stinger; Calvados, rum, sherry brandy; bourbon with soda; cigars (2026 reviews) · gin and tonic ¥1,100, vanilla ice cream ¥900 (July 2026) · food: chicken liver pâté, kinmedai carpaccio, oil sardines, house-smoked quail eggs and cheese, pizza, pasta, fries (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bar · Kiyamachi-Nijo, a Kyoto bar institution since 1994] A big, bright second-floor bar on Nijo-dori near the Kamo River, often named first when Kyoto drinkers are asked for a bar: a semicircular counter where several bartenders work, a casual floor for groups, a deep whisky shelf and cigars. The gin and tonic is the house signature — reviewers say new bartenders must master it — and the cocktails are built around the sweetness of the spirit. Counter charge ¥550; gin and tonic ¥1,100. 18:00–2:00, closed Monday and Tuesday.

roles: Bar team; a June 2026 review names the chief bartender as Sawada
chef_bio.background: Opened 24 March 1994 (Tabelog). Tabelog Bar "Tabelog 100" 2022. The official site also runs 角打酒場KASK (open every day 14:00–2:00) and Cave de K (15:00–0:00, closed Tuesday). Per a July 2026 review: many well-known Kyoto bartenders trained here, and making a gin and tonic to K6’s standard is a required test for bartenders joining.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per a June 2026 review: K6’s cocktails are designed to bring out the hidden sweetness of the spirits.
chef_bio.specialty: Gin and tonic; whisky; cigars.

anecdotes.text: A young bartender said of the chief’s Stinger: "This is the cocktail I aspire to create." — June 2026.
The bar uses tableware by the artist Shiro Tsujimura — August 2026.
A first-time visitor in July 2026 was told it is a whisky bar that does not serve cocktails, apart from gin and tonic; other 2026 reviewers ordered cocktails.
A June 2026 regular found the service "a bit inconsistent depending on the staff", and in April 2026 felt it kept "a distance from newcomers".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ksix.jp): Bar K6、京都市中京区木屋町二条東入ル ヴァルズビル2F、18:00〜2:00、月曜・火曜休み、スタッフのブログ (2026年11月まで)、角打酒場KASK (年中無休 14:00〜2:00)、Cave de K (15:00〜0:00、火曜休み)。食べログ: バー・ダイニングバー、中京区二条通木屋町東入ル東生洲町481 ヴァルズビル2F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分、水〜日 18:00〜2:00、40席、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー可、1994年3月24日オープン、バー百名店 2022。口コミ (2026年4〜9月、英語): ジントニック、カクテル、ウイスキー、葉巻、カウンターはチャージ550円、フードのラストオーダー1時、レバーパテ、金目鯛のカルパッチョ。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose the counter (charge) or the casual floor; tell the bartender what you like; cards accepted.

places.name: セクションドール (Section D'or)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The only dish is tandoori chicken with grilled vegetables, served with bread; the marinade ingredients are not published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the single menu item is a tandoori-chicken plate (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00, dinner 17:30–21:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken, even on the day (October 2026); the owner said few come on rainy days without a booking (June 2026). 8 seats at 4 tables (Tabelog; an October 2026 reviewer counted four seats); non-smoking; cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). In an apartment building in Okazaki; 4 min from the Higashiyama-Nijo or Kumano-jinja-mae bus stops, 9 min from Higashiyama or Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, west of Heian Shrine — 4 min from the Higashiyama-Nijo bus stop
places.cuisine: One dish only: a tandoori-chicken plate, ¥2,700, with a generous spread of seasonal grilled vegetables (pumpkin, butternut squash, eggplant, okra, lotus root, yam, turnip, tsurumurasaki and more) and bread for the juices; mild rather than hot, closer to a light Italian plate than a typical Indian one (2026 reviews) · drinks: oolong teas, cold-brewed and frozen, Taiwanese Dong Ding; wine (2026 reviews; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Tandoori chicken · Okazaki, one plate done well] A quiet eight-seat room in an Okazaki apartment building that serves a single dish: tandoori chicken, crisp-skinned and juicy, mildly spiced, on a plate crowded with seasonal grilled vegetables that regulars come back for each season (¥2,700). Order an oolong tea with it. Book ahead, even same day. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 April 2011 (Tabelog). Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Tandoori-chicken plate with seasonal vegetables.

anecdotes.text: The butternut squash and tsurumurasaki surprised a regular enough to ask the chef about them — August 2026.
A June 2026 diner first found the owner quiet, but asking brought out a lot of information; the same reviewer rated several vegetables (okra, burdock, broccoli) below average.
「典型的に日本のインド料理屋で提供されるタンドリーチキンをイメージすると全く異なるため、軽いイタリアンを食べに来ているような気持ちで行くのがおすすめです。」 — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: セクションドール、インド料理・鶏料理、左京区岡崎西天王町84-1 M&M's APARTMENT 1F、市バス東山二条・熊野神社前から徒歩4分、月・水〜日 11:30〜14:00・17:30〜21:00、火曜休み、予約可、8席 (4テーブル)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、2011年4月1日オープン、アジア・エスニック WEST 百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年5〜10月): メニューはタンドリーチキン一択、2,700円、彩り豊かな焼き野菜のワンプレート、注文から10分ほどで提供、鶏肉が非常に柔らかく上品、軽いイタリアンのような気持ちで、烏龍茶、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: One dish, so ordering is easy; book ahead; cash only.

places.name: カジュアル割烹 とのみず (Casual Kappo Tonomizu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-based kappo cooking with soy-based seasonings, tempura, kara-age, oden with fish cakes and a pasta to finish; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the cooking rests on dashi, fish, eel, duck and wagyu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30) every day; closing days may vary (Tabelog). Reservations online or by phone; dinner starts with a booked "one soup" opener of soup and small dishes, ¥1,650, then à la carte (Tabelog; August 2026); an extra appetizer is +¥550 (August 2026). Full by 18:00 on a September 2026 weekday; same-day bookings possible (October 2026). Groups of up to 4; private hire for 8–20 (Tabelog). 12 seats: 6 at the counter and two tatami tables for 3 (Tabelog). Charcoal-grilling smoke stung the eyes of two September 2026 diners. Non-smoking; cards and PayPay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Basement of the 河原町アペックスビルⅡ, 4 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of Shijo, west of Kawaramachi, basement — 4 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: À la carte kappo, "Japanese cuisine and kappo in a new way" (Tabelog), with over 20 sakes chosen by season (Tabelog) · opener of soup and three small dishes ¥1,650 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · assorted sashimi, botan shrimp marinated in junmai sake, foie gras miso-cured and wrapped in kombu-cured sea bream (the dish "everyone posts about"), wagyu cheek simmered Koshu-style with crumbled sesame tofu, abalone with winter melon and sea-urchin sauce, eel chawanmushi, umaki with cheese, grilled eel, black wagyu zabuton, duck with Kamo eggplant, chicken-wing kara-age with wasabi-nori soy, potato salad, lotus-root tempura, oden (from autumn 2026) · clay-pot rice with matsutake and eel or saury · the "staff meal" pasta to finish (2026 reviews); the menu changes monthly (October 2026)
places.notes: [Kappo · Kawaramachi, kappo cooking by the dish] A 12-seat basement counter near Kawaramachi where one cook turns out kappo food à la carte, so you order what you like instead of a set course. Dinner opens with a booked soup-and-small-dishes starter (¥1,650); then come sashimi, the much-photographed foie gras wrapped in kombu-cured sea bream, wagyu cheek with sesame-tofu sauce, oden in the cold months and a clay-pot rice of matsutake with eel or saury, with the 'staff meal' pasta that reviewers rave about to finish. Over 20 seasonal sakes. Bills ran ¥6,000–15,000 a head in 2026. Charcoal smoke can drift over the counter. Open daily 17:00–23:00.

roles: Owner-chef, who cooks alone (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per an August 2026 review: the owner is 40, trained at a ryokan in Fukui and a kaiseki restaurant in Pontocho, and cooks everything alone, with a female staff member serving; an October 2026 diner was surprised at the speed with one person cooking. A September 2026 regular asks "the manager" to choose the sake.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "Dishes to Enjoy Japanese Cuisine and Kappo in a New Way"; young customers and sake lovers welcome; suited to solo diners, dates and groups of 2–4.
chef_bio.specialty: Foie gras with kombu-cured sea bream; clay-pot rice; staff-meal pasta.

anecdotes.text: "The gentle owner quickly prepares dishes right in front of you." — August 2026.
"I was surprised at how quickly the food was served, especially since it was just one person cooking!" — October 2026.
A September 2026 diner found the charcoal smoke from grilling vegetables stung the eyes, and asked the shop to look into it.
"Watching the staff prepare the staff meal pasta from across the counter looked incredibly appetizing!" — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 創作料理・肉料理・居酒屋、下京区市之町240-1 河原町アペックスビルⅡ B1F、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩4分、毎日17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、予約可、12席 (カウンター6、座敷テーブル3名×2)、1組4名まで、貸切8〜20名、禁煙、カード・PayPay・WeChat Pay 可、日本酒20種以上、季節の一汁のコース1,650円。口コミ (2026年7〜11月、英語): 40歳の店主が Fukui の旅館と先斗町の懐石で修業、一人で調理、刺身盛り合わせ、ぼたん海老、フォアグラと昆布締めの鯛、和牛ほほ肉、鮑と冬瓜、うなぎ、おでん、松茸の土鍋ご飯、まかないパスタ、炭火の煙、毎月変わる献立。

cultural_comfort.note: Book the opener online; order the rest à la carte from a menu whose dish names can be hard to picture (October 2026); cards accepted.

places.name: 京鴨とsake 鴨蔵 (Kyogamo to Sake Kamokura)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Duck seiro with soba, tempura, duck katsu, pizza and sukiyaki with a soy-based sauce are on the menu; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, and Kyoto-vegetable tempura and grilled vegetables are served, but nearly everything centres on duck, the hot pots use duck broth and the soba dip is duck-based (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:30) daily; dinner Monday–Friday 17:00–22:00, Saturday, Sunday and holidays 16:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:30, drinks 21:45) (Tabelog). Evening cover charge (otoshi) ¥800; a service charge is added on 1–3 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; walk-ins possible at quiet times, but popular dishes sell out early in the evening (June and October 2026). 41 seats: 9 at the counter, 20 at tables, 12 at sunken kotatsu tables; semi-private rooms for 2–20; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; cards, IC cards and e-money, PayPay; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi-dori between the Kamo and Takase rivers, ground floor of ラクアス木屋町; 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Exit 1B) and Gion-Shijo Stn (Exit 3) (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi-dori south of Shijo, between the Kamo and Takase rivers — 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Izakaya built on 京鴨 (Kyoto duck), Kyoto vegetables and rice, with Fushimi sake and Tanba wine (Tabelog) · low-temperature duck breast sushi with sea urchin, Kyoto-duck sukiyaki, duck shabu-shabu finished with soba (Tabelog; October 2026) · five-skewer duck platter (negima, roast, liver, heart, bonjiri), grilled duck neck, dashimaki of Kyoto-duck eggs, simmered duck roast and confit, Kyoto-vegetable tempura (August 2026) · lunch: duck seiro soba with tempura or Kujo-negi tempura (May–August 2026), sukiyaki lunch · courses with free-flow drinks: Ujigawa ¥6,500 (duck katsu, pizza, duck sukiyaki; 3 groups a day), Takasegawa ¥8,500 (duck skewers, pork loin cutlet, shabu-shabu), Kamogawa ¥10,500 (duck and fresh fish) (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Duck izakaya · Kiyamachi, Kyoto duck from sushi to sukiyaki] A duck-only izakaya on Kiyamachi, between the Kamo and Takase rivers, with a counter, tables and sunken kotatsu rooms in reclaimed wood. Kyoto duck turns up as skewers (liver, heart, bonjiri), a slow-cooked roast, sushi with sea urchin, dashimaki from duck eggs, and in two hot pots — sukiyaki or shabu-shabu finished with soba. Lunch is duck seiro soba with tempura. Courses with free-flow drinks run ¥6,500–10,500; evenings carry an ¥800 starter charge. Popular dishes sell out early, so book or come early. Lunch and dinner daily.

roles: Company-run restaurant (a corporate invoice registrant, Tabelog); no staff named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): creative dishes from fresh Kyoto ingredients, especially the brand duck 京鴨, Kyoto rice and vegetables; local drinks such as Fushimi sake and Tanba wine, including rare once-a-year brands; a calm room in reclaimed wood with sunken-kotatsu private rooms.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-duck sukiyaki; duck skewers; duck seiro soba.

anecdotes.text: "Despite visiting at 7:00 PM, many items were already sold out, and I could only order the assorted skewers" — June 2026.
A June 2026 lunch diner found the sukiyaki lunch a little small and waited a long time for more water.
A family in October 2026 finished the duck shabu-shabu broth with the soba; the sukiyaki eater wished for white rice alongside.
An August 2026 birthday dinner ended with a surprise birthday plate.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ、下京区斎藤町123 ラクアス木屋町 1F、京都河原町駅1B出口から徒歩1分以内、祇園四条駅3番出口から徒歩2分、鴨川と高瀬川の間の木屋町通、ランチ 11:30〜14:30、ディナー 月〜金 17:00〜22:00・土日祝 16:00〜22:00、夜のみお通し代800円、1月1〜3日はサービス料、予約可、41席 (カウンター9、テーブル20、掘りごたつ12)、半個室、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、車椅子可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、京鴨と京野菜、伏見の日本酒と Tanba のワイン、コース (飲み放題付き) 6,500円・8,500円・10,500円。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): 鴨せいろ、九条ねぎの天ぷら、京鴨の串5種、京鴨の卵のだし巻き、鴨すき焼き、鴨しゃぶ、低温調理の鴨、夜の早い時間の品切れ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course online or order à la carte; ¥800 evening starter charge; cards and IC cards.

places.name: 松之助 京都本店 (Matsunosuke Kyoto honten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the menu is pies, cakes, scones, biscuits and pancakes, all wheat-based; no gluten-free item or allergen information is published (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the pies, cheesecakes and pancakes use butter, cream, sour cream, eggs and cheese (official menu; 2026 reviews). Drinks only.
places.hours_raw: 9:00–17:30 (last order 17:00); closed Tuesday (open when a holiday), at Obon and New Year (Tabelog; official site). Pancakes 9:00–14:00 from October to March and 9:00–16:00 from April to September, until sold out (official site; Tabelog). No reservations for seats (Tabelog); order and pay at the counter, then wait at your table; up to three items per person (October 2026). Whole pies and cakes need ordering a week ahead; takeaway by phone (official site). 17 seats, mostly tables for two; non-smoking; cards not accepted (Tabelog). On Takakura-dori south of Oike, 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takakura-dori south of Oike — 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Café and pantry of New England–style American baking (official site; 2026 review) · apple pies, takeaway (eat-in) prices: sour cream apple pie all year ¥770 (¥784), Big Apple Pie October–March ¥890 (¥1,111), custard ¥770 (¥958), maple ¥820 (¥988) and caramel ¥810 (¥968) apple pies in autumn–winter, 14 Lincoln Street apple pie in spring ¥770 (¥784) · cherry pie ¥780, banana cream pie ¥760, chocolate pie ¥790 · New York cheesecake ¥750 and other cheesecakes, carrot cake ¥630, New England cranberry cake ¥660 · scones ¥370–450, biscuits ¥330 · pancakes ¥1,001–1,800: banana caramel, sour cream black, ricotta, Fruit Gardens (¥1,700, October 2026), sausage and egg (official menu) · hot coffee ¥500 (October 2026)
places.notes: [American bake shop · Takakura Oike, apple pie since 2000] The café and pantry that the Kyoto cookery researcher 平野顕子 opened in 2000 after studying New England baking in Connecticut. The glass-fronted white room serves American pies and cakes from a showcase — the sour cream apple pie all year, the Big Apple Pie from October, custard, maple and caramel apple pies through winter — plus cheesecakes, scones, biscuits and morning pancakes (until 14:00 in winter, 16:00 in summer). Order and pay at the counter, up to three items each. Slices of apple pie ¥784–1,111 to eat in. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

roles: Founder and owner (Akiko Hirano in an October 2026 review), a cookery researcher
chef_bio.background: Per the official profile: born in Kyoto into a family of Noh-costume weavers; graduated from ノートルダム女学院 and, per the profile, an American university (named both 東コネチカット州立大学 and コネチカット大学 on the page); in 1995, while studying in New England, studied 17th-century New England baking under シャロル・ジーン; took a cake diploma, returned to Japan and opened cake classes, cafés and pantries in Kyoto and Tokyo; took a special lesson at the CIA in Hyde Park, New York, in April 2003; opened Cafe & Pantry 松之助 at Takakura, Kyoto, in October 2000. The name, unusual for a cake shop, is that of a grandfather who was a master Noh-costume craftsman. The official site lists a second shop, MATSUNOSUKE N.Y. in Daikanyama, Tokyo, and the book blurb there calls the owner the "Apple Pie Godmother". Tabelog Cafe "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022 and Cafe WEST 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Sour cream apple pie; Big Apple Pie; pancakes.

anecdotes.text: "There’s a limit of three items per person, so I ordered some popular cakes for takeout in advance" — October 2026.
An October 2026 visitor paid ¥750 for the sour cream apple pie to take away, where the official menu lists ¥770.
"I was excited to see the large size of the items in the showcase, but they disappeared in seconds" — October 2026.
A November 2026 buyer was told to warm the Big Apple Pie in the oven for 7–8 minutes before eating.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (matsunosukepie.com): 松之助 本店 (京都市中京区高倉御池下ル亀甲屋町605、9:00〜17:30、L.O. 17:00、火曜休み) と MATSUNOSUKE N.Y. (東京・代官山 ヒルサイドテラス)、パンケーキは京都本店で4〜9月 9:00〜16:00、10〜3月 9:00〜14:00 (なくなり次第終了)、アップルパイ: サワークリーム770円 (イートイン784円)、ビッグ890円 (1,111円)、カスタード770円、メープル820円、キャラメル810円、14リンカンストリート770円、チェリーパイ780円、バナナクリームパイ760円、ニューヨーク・チーズケーキ750円、スコーン370円〜、ビスケット330円、ホールは1週間前までに予約、2026年10月1日ビッグアップルパイ販売開始。平野先生プロフィール: 京都の能装束織元の家に生まれる、ノートルダム女学院卒業、1995年コネチカット大学に留学中シャロル・ジーンに師事、2000年10月京都・高倉にてカフェ＆パントリー松之助オープン、2003年4月ハイドパーク CIA でスペシャルレッスン、店名は能装束の匠であった祖父の名前に由来。食べログ: カフェ・ケーキ・パンケーキ、17席、予約不可、カード不可、禁煙、火曜休み、カフェ百名店 2021・2022、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年10〜11月、英語): 注文と会計はカウンターで、1人3品まで、ショーケースのケーキ、ビスケット、スコーン。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose from the showcase, order and pay at the counter, then sit; cash only.

places.name: ナカガワ小麦店 (Nakagawa Komugiten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery — organic Canadian wheat, in-house stone-milled organic whole wheat and Hokkaido wheat (Waraku, 2022).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No ingredient lists are published; reviewers note the rich butter of the croissant and pain au chocolat, and the An bread is filled with Tanba red beans (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Thursday–Sunday 10:00–16:00, until sold out; closed Monday–Wednesday (Tabelog; October 2026 reviews). Takeaway only (counter sales, 2026 reviews). The Toast Montagne loaf can be reserved by phone from 8:30 on the day (Waraku, 2022); a reviewer reserved loaves in person, paying in advance or on pickup (October 2026). A line of about ten formed at the 10:00 opening on an October 2026 Saturday; some breads are gone by early afternoon. Cash only (Tabelog). On Shimogamo-hondori next to Shimogamo Shrine, opposite a mitarashi dango shop; by the Shimogamo-jinja-mae bus stop (lines 1, 4, 205), 12 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn; no parking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Shimogamo-hondori by Shimogamo Shrine — 12 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Bakery of about 18 breads made from organic wheat (Waraku, 2022) · Toast Montagne, a loaf of 100% organic Canadian wheat (¥680 in 2022) · pain complet from organic whole wheat stone-milled in-house, naturally grown Hokkaido wheat blended in for about five years (Waraku, 2022) · baguette rouge, petit rouge ¥100, Fruity Levain with walnuts and organic figs ¥340, An with Tanba red beans ¥310, cinnamon walnut roll ¥230, Compresse roll ¥190, walnut and plain bagels, raisin bread, croissant and pain au chocolat (2026 reviews; ¥220 and ¥230 in 2022)
places.notes: [Bakery · Shimogamo, organic-wheat loaves by the shrine] A small wood-fitted bakery on Shimogamo-hondori next to Shimogamo Shrine, where one baker, 中川恵介, has made every loaf since opening. About 18 breads, from organic Canadian wheat and whole wheat stone-milled in the shop: the Toast Montagne loaf, a crusty baguette rouge, a fig-and-walnut levain (¥340), An with Tanba beans (¥310) and cinnamon walnut rolls (¥230). Takeaway only; come near the 10:00 opening, as breads sell out. Thursday–Sunday 10:00–16:00, cash only.

roles: Owner-baker, the only baker since opening (Waraku, 2022)
chef_bio.background: Per Waraku (magazine issue April/May 2022, republished online May 2024): since opening 13 years earlier, 中川恵介 alone has baked the bread in the workshop at the back; the shop makes 18 kinds; 100% organic Canadian wheat for the loaves, organic whole wheat stone-milled in-house for the pain complet, and about five years earlier began blending in naturally grown Hokkaido wheat; the baker says the slightly chewy texture suits Japanese tastes raised on rice. Tabelog Bread "Tabelog 100" 2017–2019 and Bread WEST 2020, 2022, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Waraku (2022): a chewy (もちっと) texture, which the baker thinks suits Japanese tastes raised on rice.
chef_bio.specialty: Toast Montagne; pain complet; baguette rouge.

anecdotes.text: On an October 2026 Saturday the reviewer queued from 9:50; by the time the reviewer left, about ten people were in line.
"I thought they would be closed since I arrived around 3:30 PM, but they had one last type of bread available" — October 2026.
"The staff provided wonderful and attentive service." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 和樂web (雑誌『和樂』2022年4・5月号の転載、2024年5月): ナカガワ小麦店 (なかがわこむぎてん)、開店以来、店の奥の工房でパンを焼くのは中川恵介さんひとり、パンは18種類、カナダ産有機小麦100％の山型食パン「トースト・モンターニュ」1本680円、クロワッサン220円、パン・オ・ショコラ230円、有機玄麦を石臼で自家製粉する「パン・コンプレ」、約5年前から自然栽培の北海道産小麦をブレンド、10時〜16時 (売り切れ次第終了)、トースト・モンターニュは来店当日8時30分から電話予約可。食べログ: パン・ベーグル、左京区下鴨松ノ木町52-1、木〜日 10:00〜16:00、月〜水休み、売り切れ次第終了、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、駐車場なし、パン百名店 2017〜2019、パン WEST 百名店 2020・2022・2026。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): フルュイルヴァン340円、あん310円、Petit Rouge 100円、Cinnamon Walnut 230円、Compresse Roll 190円、Baguette Rouge、ベーグル、開店時の行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Point to the breads at the counter; cash only; takeaway.

places.name: テルヌーラ (Ternura)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu leans on paella and ajillo, but ajillo comes with bread, the house bread is made with Manitoba wheat flour, and there are baked pastas and coca (Spanish flatbread pizza) (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetable tapas and leaf salad is on the menu, but the signature paella is cooked in a rich seafood stock based on prosciutto fat, and most dishes use pork, fish or cheese (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 12:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 23:30), closed Wednesday; tapas and paella can be ordered all day, 12:00–23:00. A March 2026 diner wrote that the bar opens at 15:00. Bookings online, by phone (075-213-0220) or through Tabelog; parties of 5 or more by phone; private hire for 10–20 (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog). About 40 seats: ground floor counter and tables (20), first floor tables (20), terrace (3) (Tabelog; Tabelog’s seat field shows 8). Non-smoking; cards and IC cards, no QR (Tabelog). Children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Moved here from Takoyakushi-dori Fuyacho; opened 1 April 2005 (Tabelog). 3 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Off Shinkyogoku, north of Shijo — 3 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Spanish bar with paella, ajillo and wine, open from noon (official site; Tabelog) · tapas from ¥500 (tortilla of the day), Iga mochi-pork roast ham, cheese, terrine, adult tuna salad, smoked mackerel with Brie, bonito marinated in balsamic · ajillo from ¥1,000 (shrimp and baby corn ¥1,100 in March 2026; Tanba shiitake and prosciutto) · paella: mussel and scampi ¥2,600, squid-ink arroz negro ¥2,800, duck and porcini ¥3,400 · grilled Iga mochi-pork shoulder ¥1,200, fish and sea-urchin cabbage roll, Spanish meatballs ¥1,100, baked pasta, coca · Basque-style cheesecake ¥600 · glass wine ¥800 (three red and three white by the glass, August 2025), house sangria ¥700, draft beer ¥700 · courses ¥3,500–6,500, some with 90-minute free flow (official site)
places.notes: [Spanish bar · Shinkyogoku, paella from noon] A small Spanish bar marked by a sign and a little window off Shinkyogoku, open since 2005: counter and tables downstairs, more tables upstairs, a three-seat terrace. Paella in small pans (scampi and mussel ¥2,600, squid ink ¥2,800), ajillos, Iga pork and a long by-the-glass wine list; lunch plates come with plenty of vegetables. A March 2026 diner found the squid-ink paella undercooked; others call it the highlight. 12:00–24:00, closed Wednesday; book for busy evenings.

roles: Owner (unnamed); a manager (店長) is mentioned on the official site
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening day as 1 April 2005 and notes the bar moved from Aburaya-cho on Takoyakushi-dori west of Fuyacho. The official site describes a hideaway Spanish bar marked by its sign and small window, with a red ceiling and wood inside, pairing wines from around the world with the food. The house bread uses Manitoba flour, Guérande salt, hard water and malt syrup at 100% hydration (official site). A July 2026 diner described two young staff as polite and quietly professional, matching the soft, gentle manner of the owner.
chef_bio.specialty: Paella; ajillo; balsamic-marinated bonito.

anecdotes.text: "The paella was served in a cute, individual-sized pot!" — lunch, March 2026.

A March 2026 diner found the squid-ink paella "a bit too watery and mushy, with the rice slightly undercooked" and the small table cramped; a December 2025 diner called the same paella "particularly outstanding".
"There are no staff members on the second floor and no call buttons at the tables, so I had to get up." — December 2025.
"They even served us some homemade bread as a complimentary treat." — January 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ternura.owst.jp): スペインバル Ternura (テルヌーラ)、看板と小さな窓が目印の隠れ家的バル、12:00〜24:00 (料理L.O. 23:00、ドリンクL.O. 23:30)、水曜定休、タパス・パエリアは12:00〜23:00注文可、本日のトルティージャ500円、伊賀産もち豚のロースハム850円、本日のテリーヌ950円、スペイン風ミートボール1,100円、伊賀産もち豚肩ロースのグリル1,200円、特製 魚と雲丹のロールキャベツ、ムール貝とスカンピのパエリア2,600円 (生ハムの油をベースとした濃厚魚介ダシ)、アロス・ネグロ (イカスミ) パエリア2,800円、鴨ロースとポルチーニ茸のパエリア3,400円、アヒージョ1,000円から (丹波椎茸と生ハムなど)、コカ1,500円、バスク風黒いチーズケーキ600円、自家製パン (マニトバ粉、ゲラント塩、硬水、モルトシロップ、加水率100%)、グラスワイン800円、コース3,500〜6,500円 (飲み放題付きあり)、10〜20名で貸切可。食べログ: スペイン料理・バル・居酒屋、中京区新京極通四条上ル中之町565、12:00〜24:00、水曜定休、予約可、総席数40 (1階20、2階20、テラス3)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、子連れ可、2005年4月1日オープン、蛸薬師通麩屋町西入ル油屋町146から移転。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年8月、英語): イカスミのパエリア、アヒージョ、鰹のバルサミコマリネ、伊賀の豚肩ロース、魚のロールキャベツ、女子会コース3,500円、自家製サングリア700円。

cultural_comfort.note: The official booking site has English, Korean and Chinese pages; order à la carte from a menu of tapas, ajillo and paella.

places.name: おばんざいと純洋食 アイサニ (Obanzai to Jun Youshoku Aisani)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu mixes Kyoto obanzai with yoshoku such as menchi-katsu, bifkatsu, a crab gratin and a demi-glace hamburger steak, plus fried dishes (tempura, kara-age) (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The obanzai include vegetable dishes (Kyoto-style okara, eggplant, yuba with greens, lotus root and celery kinpira), but several are simmered dishes (炊いたん) with no stock stated, and one has jako; the rest of the menu is meat and fish (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), closed Tuesday; hours may change; a July 2026 review gives the same and a June 2026 diner was told the shop stays open late at weekends. The official site still lists dinner 17:00–last order 20:30, closing 21:00, and opening 30 December–3 January. An October 2026 diner ate a set lunch (one option). Bookings by phone (075-744-1610); diners in October 2026 found it full or were turned away (Tabelog; October 2026). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and two tables of 4 in sunken-kotatsu seats by the Takase River window; non-smoking (official site; Tabelog). JCB and AMEX cards and QR payments (Tabelog). Opened 14 October 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi on the Takase River, north of Ayanokoji — near Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto obanzai and old-style yoshoku by the Takase River (official site) · obanzai ¥550 each (Kyoto-style okara, eggplant, yuba with greens, lotus root and celery kinpira, manganji pepper with jako), three for ¥920, five for ¥1,380 · Kyoto-style dashimaki ¥640, silken yuba ¥700, cream cheese cured in Saikyo miso ¥650, chicken liver with sansho ¥880, assorted Kyoto pickles ¥800 · yoshoku: demi-glace hamburger steak ¥1,280, menchi-katsu ¥1,280, crab and mushroom white-miso gratin ¥1,280, beef skirt steak ¥1,520, bifkatsu ¥1,520, beef cheek stewed in red miso and wine ¥1,520, unseasoned grilled eel ¥1,800 · seasonal clay-pot pilaf ¥950 and sea-bream rice ¥980 (from two servings) (official menu) · five-kind sashimi ¥980, strawberries with mozzarella and balsamic ¥900 (July 2026) · Kyoto sake, warm or cold; Akaboshi bottled beer ¥700; wine by the glass from ¥700 (official drink menu)
places.notes: [Obanzai & yoshoku · Takase River, a casual counter] A 16-seat counter and two sunken-kotatsu tables looking onto the Takase River in Nishi-Kiyamachi, open since October 2016; the name means "now and then" in Kyoto dialect, for a place people drop into now and then. Obanzai at ¥550 a dish (five for ¥1,380) laid out on the counter, plus yoshoku such as demi-glace hamburger steak and bifkatsu, and Kyoto sake. A five-kind sashimi plate was ¥980 in July 2026. One March 2026 visitor found it a little pricey for the food but loved the view. 17:00–23:00, closed Tuesday; book by phone.

roles: Master (マスター, unnamed on the official site)
chef_bio.background: The official site says the master aims for a casual shop that is easy to enter even alone, centred on Kyoto obanzai and nostalgic yoshoku, and explains the name as Kyoto dialect for "now and then", wishing guests would drop by now and then. It sits on the Takase River in Nishi-Kiyamachi, where the cherry trees bloom in spring. Tabelog gives the opening day as 14 October 2016; a September 2026 diner saw the 10th anniversary being celebrated and three friendly staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a casual shop, easy to enter even for one, centred on Kyoto obanzai and old-fashioned yoshoku.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai assortment; demi-glace hamburger steak; Kyoto sake.

anecdotes.text: "The staff is friendly, even with foreign customers." — February 2026.
A March 2026 visitor liked the fried eggplant, okara and spinach ohitashi but found it "a bit overpriced considering the touristy location"; the view is the draw.
"Although the seating is limited, the location is great, so they had to turn away many customers." — October 2026.
A September 2026 diner chose from obanzai laid out on the counter — silken yuba, a five-dish assortment, avocado with house chili oil — with warm Kyoto sake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (aisani.net): おばんざいと純洋食 アイサニ、マスターのこだわり「京都のおばんざいと昔懐かしの洋食を中心に、お一人様でも入りやすいカジュアルなお店」、アイサニは京都弁で時々という意味、西木屋町の高瀬川沿い、春には満開の桜、ディナー 17:00〜L.O.20:30 閉店21:00、年末年始は12月30日〜1月3日まで営業、カウンター8席と高瀬川を臨むテーブル席 (4名×2)、メニュー: おばんざい各550円 (京風おから、茄子オランダ煮、湯葉と菜っ葉の炊いたん、蓮根とセロリのきんぴら、万願寺唐辛子とじゃこの炊いたん)、三種盛り合わせ920円、五種盛り合わせ1,380円、京風だし巻き640円、とろとろ湯葉700円、クリームチーズの西京味噌漬け650円、鳥肝の山椒煮880円、デミグラスハンバーグ1,280円、メンチカツ1,280円、ビフカツ1,520円、牛ホホ肉赤味噌ワイン煮こみ1,520円、鰻の白焼き1,800円、季節の土鍋ピラフ950円・鯛めし980円 (二人前より)、瓶ビール (赤星ラガー) 700円。食べログ: 洋食・居酒屋・日本料理、下京区西木屋町通綾小路上ル市之町260-2、17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、火曜定休、予約可、16席、禁煙、カード (JCB、AMEX)・QR 可、2016年10月14日オープン。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): 刺身5種盛り980円、苺とモッツァレラのバルサミコ900円、掘りごたつのテーブル、高瀬川の眺め、10周年、満席で断られる客も。

cultural_comfort.note: The official menu gives English names for many dishes, and obanzai sit on the counter to point at; book by phone.

places.name: みつばち (Mitsubachi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The core sweets are agar jelly from tengusa seaweed, Hokkaido red peas and azuki, black syrup from Hateruma brown sugar, shiratama and house-stewed apricots (Kansai Walker 2020; 2026 reviews), but nothing is said about wheat or shared equipment; ice cream and kinako toppings are also served.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Anmitsu, mamekan and zenzai are built on agar, beans, brown-sugar syrup and rice dumplings, but cream versions, vanilla or matcha ice cream and a milk shaved ice are also on the menu (2026 reviews); no vegan information.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tuesday–Saturday 11:00–18:00 (last order 17:45), closed Sunday and Monday; open until sold out; hours may change (Tabelog; Kansai Walker 2020). No reservations; queues are common — one to eight groups on summer and autumn 2026 afternoons, a line before 10:45 on an August Saturday — and orders are taken while you wait (2025–2026 reviews). Mamekan and apricot ice can sell out (August–September 2026). Cash only (no cards, e-money or QR). 14 table seats; non-smoking (Tabelog; Kansai Walker 2020 gave 12). Children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). 5 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn exit 1, or the Kawaramachi-Imadegawa bus stop (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-dori south of Imadegawa — 5 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Kanmidokoro of homemade anmitsu and mamekan, with shaved ice in summer (Tabelog; Kansai Walker) · agar from Chiba tengusa seaweed, black syrup from Hateruma Island brown sugar, Hokkaido red peas and azuki, red-bean paste cooked each morning with a little salt, house-stewed apricots (Kansai Walker 2018, 2020; 2026 reviews) · shiratama anmitsu ¥800 (August 2026), matcha cream anmitsu, mamekan, tokoroten, zenzai (warm or chilled) · mini sets pairing anmitsu with zenzai or a small shaved ice · shaved ice in about five flavours: milk, hojicha made with Ippodo tea, Uji, black syrup and kinako, Uji kintoki, and the summer apricot ice (¥1,050, Retty review posted October 2025) · green tea
places.notes: [Kanmi · Demachiyanagi, anmitsu and summer kakigori] A small table-only sweets shop on Kawaramachi-dori, marked by a noren reading "anmitsu": agar from Chiba tengusa, black syrup of Hateruma brown sugar, Hokkaido red peas and lightly salted red-bean paste, all made in the shop. Shiratama anmitsu ¥800; summer brings a thick house apricot ice and an Ippodo-hojicha shaved ice, winter zenzai. Expect a queue; cash only. Wagashi WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2026. 11:00–18:00 until sold out, closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Kansai Walker (February 2020) quotes the owner, 松尾恵子: the black syrup of Okinawa Hateruma brown sugar is made with a stronger aroma and flavour so that it is not overpowered by the sea taste of the agar, and the plump Hokkaido red peas are popular. Kansai Walker (February 2018) adds agar slowly simmered from tengusa from the Chiba sea and red-bean paste cooked every morning with salt to hold down the sweetness. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2019, 2020, 2022 and Wagashi WEST 2023, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Anmitsu; mamekan; apricot shaved ice.

anecdotes.text: A diner who comes back every summer for the shaved ice: "The red bean paste had a hint of saltiness, which made it even more delicious" — August 2025.
"This hojicha is made from tea leaves sourced from Ippodo … the flavor was rich and deep." — August 2026.
"By the time I left, there was a line of about eight groups." — September 2026; the apricot ice had sold out.
"The texture is possibly the best I've ever had." — of the agar jelly, October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 関西ウォーカー (2020年2月): みつばち、店主の松尾恵子さん「沖縄県波照間島産の黒糖で作る黒みつは、寒天の海藻の味に負けないよう、香りや風味を強めに出しています。北海道産赤エンドウ豆のふっくらとした食感も人気です」、豆かん650円、ミニところ天セット900円、「あんみつ」と書かれたのれん、上京区河原町通今出川下ル梶井町448-60、11:00〜18:00 (LO17:45)、休み日月、12席、禁煙。関西ウォーカー (2018年2月): 千葉県の海から届くテングサをじっくり煮込んだ寒天、毎朝炊き上げるあんこは塩を効かせて甘さを控え、白玉あんみつ650円、白玉ぜんざいとあんみつのセット950円、抹茶クリームあんみつ700円、売切れ次第終了。Retty: 白玉あんみつ800円、特製あんず氷1,050円、火〜土 11:00〜18:00、日月休み。食べログ: 甘味処・かき氷、11:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:45)、日月休み、売り切れ次第終了、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、テーブル14席、禁煙、子供可、テイクアウト可、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2019・2020・2022、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 白玉あんみつ800円、あんず氷、一保堂の茶葉のほうじ茶氷、ミルク、宇治金時、黒みつきなこ氷、豆かん、ぜんざい、行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Order verbally from a short sweets menu; wait in line outside and bring cash. Many overseas visitors in summer (August 2025).

places.name: 祇園きなな 本店 (Gion Kinana Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The kinako ice cream itself lists milk, cream, sugar, glucose, kinako (soy), skim milk powder, starch, agar and konjac flour (official site), but the parfaits add yatsuhashi, warabi mochi, rice-flour cookies and tiramisu (2026 reviews), and nothing is said about wheat in the starch or shared equipment.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The signature kinana ice cream is made with milk, cream and skim milk powder (official site), so the parfaits and sets are not vegan; it contains no egg. Ask about the shaved ice — the black-syrup kinako ice hides kinako ice cream inside (September 2026).
places.hours_raw: Official site: 12:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); irregular closing days, posted on Instagram around the 20th of the month before. Tabelog instead gives 12:00–17:30, closed Thursday. Reservations take priority; bookings by phone (075-525-8300); a notice in the Instagram feed on the official site (read November 2026) said bookings for October were paused while days, hours, menu and the booking system were reviewed — reviews show the café open in October and November 2026. One order per person and a one-hour limit when busy (September 2026). Cashless only, no cash (official site; Tabelog). Children under 12 are not admitted (official site; Tabelog and an August 2026 review say under 6). Upstairs by a steep staircase: 18 seats, 6 at the counter; non-smoking; wheelchair users can ask two weeks ahead about the ground-floor shop (official site; August 2026). English menu (Tabelog). In a lane one street west of Hanamikoji; 7 min walk from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Gion, a lane west of Hanamikoji — 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kinako ice cream café: "kinana" is ice cream of Tanba black-soybean kinako blended with domestic kinako, made without eggs, colourings or preservatives (official site) · freshly made kinana, served soft before it fully freezes, drink set ¥1,400; three-scoop set ¥1,600; parfaits with a drink — berry-berry kinana, kinana hapon (Japanese style: warabi mochi, shiratama, Tanba dainagon azuki, mugwort and black-sesame ice), kinana italian ¥1,600, kinana tiramisu ¥1,700 (official menu); a September 2026 diner paid ¥600 for freshly made kinana and ¥1,100 for the hapon · lunch plates with a day’s vegetables, roast pork or mouthwatering chicken with sixteen-grain rice and soup ¥2,600 (until 14:00); croque-monsieur and hummus with bagel until 17:00 · seasonal shaved ice: black syrup and kinako ¥1,800, Uji kintoki ¥2,100 with a drink (official menu)
places.notes: [Kinako ice cream · Gion, upstairs off Hanamikoji] An upstairs café in a Gion townhouse lane serving kinana — ice cream of Tanba black-soybean kinako made without eggs or additives, served freshly made, soft and smooth, with hojicha or matcha (drink sets from ¥1,400). Parfaits pile it with warabi mochi, shiratama, yatsuhashi and mugwort or black-sesame ice. The owner first served it as the dessert at the restaurant 一碗, which has reopened downstairs as a six-seat counter. Cashless only; no children under 12. 12:00–18:00, irregular closures; booking recommended.

chef_bio.background: Per the owner’s greeting on the official site: more than 20 years ago the owner ran 一碗, a Kyoto restaurant shaped by the Slow Food idea, and the kinako ice cream served there after meals proved so popular that a sweets-only shop followed. The ice is made around the theme "gentle and delicious" with Tanba black-soybean kinako, no chemical colourings or preservatives, little fat and no eggs, so guests with egg allergy can eat it. The honten has 一碗 on the ground floor and the café upstairs. The 一碗 page (undated) says the shop had been in Gion 21 years when kinana was remade the previous autumn, with far fewer seats and bookings so guests no longer wait, and 味司一碗 reopened downstairs after 21 years: six counter seats, reservation only (Instagram DM), one omakase course ¥10,000. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018–2020, 2022 and Wagashi WEST 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to keep serving ice cream that is truly gentle on the body and delicious, not something that looks good only because it is "Kyoto" or "Gion".
chef_bio.specialty: Freshly made kinana; kinana parfaits.

anecdotes.text: "Kinana is said to be ice cream just before it completely freezes." — September 2026.
"The mugwort ice cream contained finely chopped mugwort, allowing me to truly appreciate its flavor." — September 2026.
An August 2026 diner liked the shaved ice but found the green tea serving "quite minimal", and advised budgeting about ¥1,200 even for a drink.
A September 2026 diner found the shop "located on a narrow alley just off Hanamikoji Street", among places that "seem exclusive to first-time visitors".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyo-kinana.com): 店主 大本勝司のあいさつ「きななとはきなこのアイス」、20年以上前にスローフードの理念に感化された料理店「一碗」を経営、食後のデザートのきなこアイスがルーツ、丹波黒大豆きなこ、化学的な着色料・保存料不使用、脂肪分控えめ、卵不使用で卵アレルギーの方も、一階は料理店「一碗」、二階が甘味処、「京都だから」「祇園だから」という外見ばかりのものではなく本当に体にやさしく美味しいアイスを。店舗: 祇園町南側570-119、花見小路から一本西の路地、工房併設、12:00〜L.O.17:30 (18:00閉店)、不定休 (翌月の店休日を毎月20日頃 Instagram に投稿)、2階カウンター・テーブル全18席、予約優先、キャッシュレス決済のみ (現金不可)、全席禁煙、12歳未満はご遠慮、車椅子は2週間以上前の相談で一階の別店舗で対応。原材料: 牛乳、生クリーム、砂糖、ぶどう糖、きなこ (大豆)、脱脂粉乳、でんぷん、寒天、こんにゃく粉。メニュー: できたてきなな ドリンクセット1,400円、アイス3種盛り1,600円、きななハポン1,600円、きななイタリアン1,600円、きななティラミス1,700円、1日分の野菜プレート2,600円 (14:00 L.O.)、黒みつきなこ氷1,800円、宇治金時2,100円。一碗のページ: 祇園に21年、昨秋きななを一新、席数を減らし予約制に、一階に味司一碗が21年ぶりにオープン、カウンター6席、完全予約制、おまかせコース10,000円。Instagram の告知: 10月の予約受付を見合わせ、営業日・時間・メニュー・予約制の有無を調整中。食べログ: 甘味処・ジェラート・カフェ、12:00〜17:30、木曜定休、予約優先、キャッシュレスのみ、18席、6歳未満不可、英語メニュー、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018〜2020・2022、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年8月〜11月、英語): できたてきなな600円、きななハポン1,100円、ほうじ茶付き1,400円、よもぎと黒ごまのアイス、ひとり一品、混雑時は1時間制。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book by phone if you can; bring a card or IC card — no cash.

places.name: 炭焼工房 まほろば (Sumibi Kobo Mahoroba)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Skewers come with salt or a light tare; the menu has many fried dishes (kara-age, chicken nanban, chicken-skin gyoza) and kamameshi; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, August 2025; 2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A chicken and horse-meat house; grilled vegetables (manganji peppers, shiitake, lotus root, yam, thick fried tofu) and salads are on the menu, but seasonings are not stated (Tabelog menu, August 2025).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30) Sunday to Thursday; 17:00–03:00 (last order 2:30) Friday and Saturday; closes when the chicken runs out; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Two-hour limit at weekends, before holidays and on holidays, and from 28 December to 3 January (Tabelog). Chicken sashimi is not served at present (Tabelog; August 2026). Table charge ¥380 (Tabelog). 13 seats — about 8–9 at the counter and one table for four (2025 reviews); book ahead, it fills by 18:00 (August 2026). Smoking allowed at all seats; cards and iD/QUICPay (Tabelog). Up steep stairs on the 2nd floor of the 詩の小路プラスビル (November 2024; Tabelog). 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Just south of Nishiki Market — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small charcoal yakitori counter that also serves basashi (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews) · skewers from ¥250 (negima, seseri, liver, heart, bonjiri, skin, gizzard, homemade tsukune), thigh and wings ¥300, Kyoto red chicken ¥450 (limited), chef’s five-skewer platter ¥1,200 · basashi by the cut — fatty brisket, tenderloin, outside skirt, mane, liver, heart and more — ¥1,480 each · grilled vegetables ¥530–630 · chicken kara-age, yurinchi and tartare chicken nanban ¥750 each, chicken-skin gyoza ¥580, fried camembert ¥580 · potato salad ¥580, grilled-eggplant ohitashi ¥550 (Tabelog menu, August 2025) · kamameshi cooked to order in an iron pot, e.g. 1.5 go (October 2025) · lychee-orange sour (August 2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Nishiki, a late-night charcoal counter] A 13-seat yakitori counter up a steep stair just south of Nishiki, open to midnight and to 3:00 on Friday and Saturday. Skewers from ¥250 come off the charcoal in front of you — the chef's five-skewer platter is ¥1,200 — and the basashi is served by the cut, from tenderloin to mane, at ¥1,480. Finish with kamameshi cooked to order. Reviewers praise the bright, attentive staff; one April 2025 diner found the kamameshi undercooked and the fried dishes tired, and a June 2025 diner found the jazz loud. Smoking allowed throughout; book ahead.

chef_bio.background: The invoice register lists an individual, 山本 明生, as the holder of the shop’s invoice number (registered 1 October 2023). Reviewers describe bright, attentive staff who are kind to international guests (December 2024) and grill in view of the counter (January 2025). A December 2024 diner noticed many foreign customers and a full house; an August 2026 diner noticed few foreigners and suggested the shop may be hard to find.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal skewers; basashi by the cut; kamameshi.

anecdotes.text: "Be careful on the stairs; they are quite steep, especially if you're tipsy on your way out!" — November 2024.
An April 2025 diner found the kamameshi undercooked, the fried cartilage and kara-age tired and the yakitori tough, and did not plan to return.
A June 2025 diner enjoyed the slow-grilled skewers but found the seating close and the jazz loud.
"At 5:30 PM, I was the first customer at the counter. By 6 PM, the cozy interior was completely full." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・焼き鳥・鶏料理、中京区御幸町通錦小路下ル大日町403-2 詩の小路プラスビル 2F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分、月〜木・日 17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、金・土 17:00〜翌3:00 (L.O. 2:30)、鶏がなくなり次第終了、不定休、週末・祝前日・祝日と12月28日〜1月3日は2時間制、鶏刺しは現在提供なし、お通し税込380円、13席、喫煙可、カード・iD・QUICPay 可、インボイス登録: 山本 明生 (個人)、メニュー (英語版、2025年8月更新): 串250円から、おまかせ5本1,200円、馬刺し各部位1,480円、唐揚げ・油淋鶏・チキン南蛮750円。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年8月、英語): 急な階段、カウンター8〜9席とテーブル1卓、釜飯、明るい接客、全席喫煙可。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; call out your order over the music; smoking allowed throughout.

places.name: 割烹 やました (Kappou Yamashita)
places.gf_detail: Ask the chef at the counter. Dishes are cooked to order from the fish on show — sashimi with soy or ponzu, simmered dishes in dashi, tempura, miso-marinated grills — and no gluten information is published (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led kappo, with dishes built on dashi (2025–26 reviews; the 2016 Sarai feature names kombu and bonito dashi).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner from 17:00, last order 22:00 (23:00 in summer), Tuesday to Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). The Tabelog notes also say "no lunch service", but reviewers had lunch courses in October 2025 and March 2026. À la carte at lunch and dinner (Tabelog); a lunch course, Sakura, was ¥7,700 plus 10% service (March 2026). Bookings taken; a same-day booking worked in August 2026. 30 seats: 14 at the counter, 16 at tables upstairs, private room for 8; designated smoking area; cards (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi south of Nijo by the Takase River; 3 min walk north along Kiyamachi from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Nijo, by the Takase River — 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Kiyamachi kappo of seasonal fish and Kyoto cooking, ordered à la carte from what is on show or as a course (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews) · spring: sansho hot pot finished with somen (April 2026); summer: hamo as boiled otoshi or charcoal shimo-yaki with myoga and vinegar soy (August 2026), junsai, steamed kuze (July 2026); autumn: sanma with its innards, matsutake fried or as ohitashi, sweetfish, kue sashimi with ponzu (August–October 2026); winter: fugu sashimi and fried fugu, grilled bear, oysters (November 2025); whole suppon hot pot (August 2026) · Sakura lunch course ¥7,700 plus 10% service: hassun, five-kind sashimi, simmered vegetables, grilled sea bream, roast duck, tempura, Matsuba crab in vinegar, rice, miso soup, pickles, cherry-blossom ice cream (March 2026)
places.notes: [Kappo · Kiyamachi Nijo, à la carte by the Takase River] A long-running kappo on Kiyamachi by the Takase River, founded in 1983 by a reviewer's account and run by owner 山下 茂, a cook of more than fifty years by a 2016 magazine profile. Sit at the 14-seat counter and choose from the fish on show — the chef suggests how to cook it: hamo grilled over charcoal in summer, matsutake and sanma in autumn, fugu and kue in winter. One regular has logged 119 visits. Lunch courses from ¥7,700 plus service; dinner à la carte runs ¥15,000–30,000 a head. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner and itamae (Sarai, October 2016 issue: "店主の山下茂さん"); a March 2026 reviewer names "the owner, Mr. Yamashita"
chef_bio.background: Per Sarai (October 2016 issue, reposted online in 2017): 山下 茂, then 68, a cook of more than 50 years, known in Kyoto for skill and big-hearted hospitality (男気ある接客); remembers regulars’ tastes and suggests dishes to first-time guests by age and way of ordering, e.g. two or three seasonal kinds of sashimi for an older couple, many small kinds for two women; prices then were from ¥4,000 at lunch and ¥8,000 at dinner. A March 2026 review gives the founding year as 1983. The Tabelog Award 2019 Bronze.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Sarai (2016), quoting 山下 茂: "遠慮なく食べたいものを言っていただくのが一番" — the best thing is for guests to say freely what to eat that day.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamo (shimo-yaki and otoshi); seasonal fish à la carte; hassun.

anecdotes.text: A regular logging a 117th visit in July 2026 was steered by the chef from akou to kuze for its better fat, steamed.
"I always choose a seat at the counter, where I can discuss with the chef how to prepare the seasonal ingredients displayed." — November 2025.
A March 2026 lunch guest found the kitchen busy with evening preparations and the explanations of the dishes brief, but the course a fair price for a Kyoto kappo.
A June 2026 first-timer liked the friendly staff but wished for more Japanese sake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 魚介料理・日本料理、中京区木屋町通二条下ル上樵木町491-3、京都市役所前駅から木屋町を北へ徒歩3分、火〜土 11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:00〜23:00、日 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:00、月曜休み、夜 17:00〜22:00 (L.O.)、夏は23:00 (L.O.) まで、昼夜ともアラカルト可、30席 (カウンター14、2階テーブル16)、個室 (8名)、分煙、カード可、The Tabelog Award 2019 Bronze。サライ (2016年10月号、2017年10月にウェブ掲載): 割烹やました、店主の山下茂さん (68歳)、料理歴50年以上、男気ある接客、常連の好みを把握、初めての客には年齢や注文の仕方を見て薦める、「遠慮なく食べたいものを言っていただくのが一番」、昼4000円〜、夜8000円〜 (当時)。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 1983年創業、カウンターで旬の素材から調理法を相談、鱧の焼き霜、松茸、ふぐ、クエ、すっぽん鍋、さくらコース7,700円 (サービス料10%別)。

cultural_comfort.note: Sit at the counter and ask the chef what is good today; à la carte prices are not posted, so ask.

places.name: りきちゃん 祇園店 (Riki Chan Gion)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking: Tabelog marks allergy information as available. The meat is served with a house dipping sauce (the same as Kimiyah’s, a July 2026 reviewer says), ponzu, lemon or salts; kimchi and soup come with every course (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses only, each built on beef fillet or Chateaubriand and tongue; no meat-free course (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: 13:00–23:00 (last order 22:00) every day (Tabelog). Reservation only; the 13:00–15:00 slot serves the evening menu and must be booked at least two days ahead; same-day bookings, private rooms, non-smoking requests and parties of 6+ by phone (Tabelog). Charcoal is lit for your booked time, so arriving early may mean no seat; a same-day cancellation may be charged 100% (Tabelog). Courses only, one per person aged 12 and over; children up to elementary age may share an adult’s meal (Tabelog). 30 seats; private rooms for 2, 4 or 6 (10% room charge); designated smoking area, smoke-free except private rooms when children or pregnant guests are present (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). Just off Hanamikoji, 8 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 3 August 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Just off Hanamikoji, Gion — 8 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Yakiniku of Kuroge wagyu fillet from unbred female cattle only, grilled over charcoal and pulled apart with a fork; the Kyoto shop of the first disciple of Kimiyah in Ikoma, Nara (2026 reviews) · courses only, before tax: fillet or Chateaubriand 200 g ¥21,000, 300 g ¥23,000; fillet-and-Chateaubriand tasting 200 g ¥21,000, 300 g ¥23,000 (Tabelog) · every course: three kimchi (napa cabbage, cucumber, nagaimo), seasonal grilled vegetables, thick-cut special tongue, the main meat, soup simmered from fillet and vegetables, rice, seasonal fruit (2026 reviews) · condiments: grated daikon with ponzu, the house sauce, lemon, Himalayan salt, truffle salt (July 2026)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Gion, fork-tender wagyu fillet] A machiya yakiniku off Hanamikoji serving only Kuroge wagyu fillet from unbred female cattle, by the first disciple of Nara's Kimiyah. The owner grills it on a teppan over charcoal and tears it with a fork; reviewers say the owner still checks the grilling at Kimiyah once a week. Courses only, ¥21,000–23,000 before tax: three kimchi, grilled vegetables, thick tongue, 200 or 300 g of fillet or Chateaubriand, a soup simmered from fillet, rice and fruit. The portions are big — some reviewers took meat home. Booking only; 13:00–23:00 daily.

roles: Owner, the first disciple of Kimiyah (Ikoma, Nara) by 2026 reviews; not named. Operator: 株式会社瀧 (Osaka; invoice T9120901044728)
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: the shop is run by the first disciple of the yakiniku house Kimiyah in Ikoma, Nara; it uses the same marinade, seasonings, sourcing, teppan and charcoal approach, and the owner checks the grilling at Kimiyah once a week (June and October 2026). A May 2026 reviewer had been to the Kimiya main shop and to Riki Chan in Toyonaka before this Gion shop. The invoice number on Tabelog (T9120901044728) belongs to 株式会社瀧, Chuo-ku, Osaka (NTA corporate-number site). Opened 3 August 2021 (Tabelog). Tabelog Yakiniku WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023–2026 (Tabelog’s Japanese award list; the English page labels 2024 and 2026 as Grill).
chef_bio.specialty: Chateaubriand and fillet torn with a fork; special tongue; fillet soup.

anecdotes.text: "For women, I think 200g will be quite satisfying. If it's not enough, we can accommodate additional servings." — the owner’s advice to a May 2026 diner who had booked 300 g.
An October 2026 regular on a third visit found the portions so large that the table took leftovers home.
A thirty-something couple in August 2026 found the fat a bit much by the end of a 300 g course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉、東山区祇園町南側572-10、祇園四条駅から徒歩8分、花見小路すぐ、毎日 13:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、完全予約制、13:00〜15:00 は夜と同じメニューで2日前までの予約、当日予約・個室・禁煙・6名以上は電話で、炭は予約時間に合わせて用意、当日キャンセルは100%の場合あり、ヘレかシャトーブリアンのコースのみ、12歳以上は1人1コース、30席、個室 (2・4・6名、料理代の10%)、分煙、カード可、2021年8月3日オープン、インボイス T9120901044728、コース (税抜): ヘレ・シャトーブリアン各200g 21,000円、300g 23,000円、焼肉 WEST 百名店 2023〜2026。国税庁法人番号公表サイト: 株式会社瀧 (大阪市中央区)。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): Kimiyah (奈良・生駒) の一番弟子の店、未経産の雌牛のみ、フォークで裂いて焼く、キムチ3種、焼き野菜、特選タン、ヘレのスープ、季節の果物。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (by phone for same-day or special requests); do not arrive early; the owner grills for you.

places.name: 丼と手巻き 玄海 錦市場店 (Don to Temaki Genkai Nishiki)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Bowls are dressed with a choice of three soy sauces or a sesame sauce, and the hand rolls include a kombu-zuke; Tabelog marks allergy information as available (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every bowl and hand roll is seafood, served with fish-head soup or red-miso soup, and a bonito broth is poured over the last of the bowl (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30), every day (Tabelog). Bookings taken; walk-ins were seated without a wait (May 2025; March 2026). Order by QR code (May 2025). The menu changed when the shop reopened on 9 December 2025: hand rolls were added and the cheaper bowls dropped (December 2025; February 2026). 20 seats (8 at the counter, 12 at tables); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR payments; English menu and English-speaking staff; children welcome (Tabelog). On the street just north of Nishiki Market; 4 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 27 April 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Just north of Nishiki Market — 4 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Seafood-bowl and hand-roll shop by Nishiki Market (Tabelog) · kaisen-don in grades such as Take (bamboo: chu-toro, lean tuna, ikura, salmon, white fish, yellowtail) ¥1,800 (August 2025), Matsu and Ume; Shiga rice; a choice of three soy sauces; bonito broth to finish the bowl as chazuke (August 2025; September 2026) · open-style hand rolls with rice and toppings stacked rather than rolled: Hokkai Assortment ¥800, Hon Maguro Trio ¥1,000, Kombu Zuke ¥600, Salmon Cream Cheese ¥600; mini bowl and two hand rolls with fish-head soup ¥2,300 (December 2025); Special set of hand rolls and a mini bowl ¥3,000 (February 2026) · seared-salmon bowl ¥2,000 (May 2025) · mango sorbet (July 2025)
places.notes: [Seafood bowls · Nishiki Market, kaisen-don and open hand rolls] A 20-seat counter-and-table shop on the street just north of Nishiki Market, open since 2024, serving seafood bowls on Shiga rice with a choice of soy sauces — finish the last of the bowl as chazuke with the bonito broth the staff bring — and, since a December 2025 reopening, open-style hand rolls. English menu and staff. Reviews are split: some found the bowls fresh and good value, others small, chopped rather than sliced, and pricey for what came (2025–26). Daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00.

roles: No person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Opened 27 April 2024 (Tabelog). A December 2025 reviewer visited on the reopening day, 9 December 2025, and found hand rolls added and the budget seafood bowls gone; a February 2026 reviewer also noted a changed menu and higher prices. Several reviewers noted that most customers were tourists or international guests (February, March and July 2026); one couple was brought by a taxi driver (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Kaisen-don; open-style hand rolls.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner found the bowl small, the tuna not the chu-toro described, and flies in the room; a February 2026 diner found the Special set too expensive for its small portions.
A September 2026 diner ate half the bamboo bowl, then had the rest as chazuke with the bonito broth brought to the table.
A March 2026 solo diner found the counter welcoming and quiet, and received a slice of bluefin tuna sashimi for filling in a survey.
A July 2026 diner found the staff low on energy and the bonsai in the window a replica.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 海鮮丼・寿司、中京区御幸町通錦小路上る船屋町389 1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩4分、毎日 11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、予約可、20席 (カウンター8、テーブル12)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、子供可、2024年4月27日オープン。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年9月、英語): 2025年12月9日にリニューアル、手巻きを追加、海鮮丼の Take 1,800円、醤油3種、締めに鰹の出汁で茶漬け、ミニ丼と手巻き2種のセット2,300円、Special セット3,000円、量や値段への不満の声もある。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); order by QR code.

places.name: 桃園亭 本店 (Touen Tei Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A Chinese menu of noodles, fried rice, sweet and sour pork, spring rolls and soy- and miso-based sauces; no gluten information (official lunch menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but no vegetarian dishes are named on the lunch menu or in reviews (Tabelog; official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–14:30 and dinner 17:00–21:00 (both last order, official site); closed Monday, open when Monday is a holiday (official site). Tabelog adds that lunch courses (12:00–13:30) are by reservation. Reservations taken by phone or online (official site). Cards accepted, but not for lunch set meals; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 120 seats, a banquet room for up to 100 and a private room for 4; non-smoking; parking for 4 cars, booked by the day before (official site; Tabelog). On the 13th floor of the 宝源ビル: take the lift at the back of the ground-floor lobby (October 2026). 2 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-dori just south of Shijo — 2 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Long-established Peking-style Chinese restaurant, 13 floors up with a view of Higashiyama (official site; 2026 reviews) · lunch: noodle-and-mini-bowl set ¥1,200 (ramen, Tianjin noodles, tantanmen or gomoku noodles with Tianjin rice, mapo don or chuka don); crab omelette, mapo tofu or chicken in sweet miso set ¥1,200; happosai, tantanmen or sweet and sour pork set ¥1,300; summer cold noodles ¥1,000, set ¥1,400; three ¥2,000 sets, e.g. shrimp chili with green pepper and beef (official lunch menu) · dinner: courses from about ¥3,000 (May 2026), fried rice, shrimp chili, Shaoxing wine, Tsingtao beer (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Chinese · Shijo Kawaramachi, a century-old restaurant with a Higashiyama view] A Chinese restaurant whose history goes back to about 1914, now on the 13th floor of a building just south of the Shijo Kawaramachi crossing — look for the antiques and stone lion-dogs in the ground-floor lobby and take the lift at the back. The reward is a wide window over Higashiyama, from Chion-in and Yasaka Shrine to Kiyomizu-dera. Lunch sets are good value (¥1,200–1,300, e.g. mapo tofu or sweet and sour pork); dinner courses start around ¥3,000. Big tables suit groups; two diners found them awkward for a pair. Closed Monday.

roles: Restaurant founded by 王澤文 (official site); present owners not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 王澤文, from Shandong, opened a shop selling noodles, steamed buns and fried rice on Teramachi around 1914 (Taisho 3); with three friends it was named 桃園亭 after the Peach Garden Oath of the Three Kingdoms story. In the mid-Showa period it moved to a three-storey building on Kawaramachi and by then called itself pure Peking cuisine, a line the present restaurant keeps. The site lists one sister shop, 中国料理 龍門.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to carry on the pure Peking cuisine the restaurant has stood for over more than a century.
chef_bio.specialty: Sweet and sour pork; shrimp chili; lunch set meals.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner arrived right at opening to get a window seat, and from it named Chion-in, Yasaka Shrine, the Gion Kaku, Ryozen Kannon and Kiyomizu-dera.
"The cold noodles were topped with delicious vinegared jellyfish" — the summer cold-noodle lunch set, September 2026.
A May 2026 visitor found the food delicious and lightly seasoned, the service a bit distant, and the big tables awkward for two.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (touentei.com): 創業100有余年、山東出身の王澤文が大正三年 (1914年) 頃に寺町で麺・饅頭・炒飯の店を開き、三人の友人とともに『桃園の誓い』の故事から「桃園亭」と命名、昭和中期に河原町の三階建ての建物に移転し「純北京料理」を標榜、姉妹店 中国料理 龍門、下京区河原町通四条下る稲荷町335 宝源ビル13階、昼11:00〜14:30 (L.O)・夜17:00〜21:00 (L.O)、月曜定休 (祝日は営業)、全面禁煙、駐車場4台 (前日までに予約)、宴会場最大100名、個室4名。ランチ: ラーメンとミニ丼1,200円、かに玉・麻婆豆腐・鶏の甘みそ定食1,200円、八宝菜・担々麺・酢豚定食1,300円、夏の冷麺1,000円 (セット1,400円)、「福」「禄」「寿」定食2,000円。食べログ: 中華料理・飲茶、120席、ランチのコースは予約制、カード可 (ランチの定食は不可)、PayPay 可、ベジタリアンメニューあり。

cultural_comfort.note: Take the lift from the back of the lobby to the 13th floor; no cards for lunch set meals (PayPay accepted).

places.name: ゆったり 炙ジビエとワイン 炭然 (Yuttari Aburi Gibier to Wine Tanzen)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled game and vegetables with wine sauces, plus pasta and appetizers; no gluten information (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, and the charcoal-grilled vegetables (e.g. Awaji onion, manganji pepper) are praised, but the menu centres on game meat (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–1:00, last food order 24:00, drinks 24:30 (Tabelog); the official site gives 18:00–1:00 (last order 0:30). Irregular closures, posted monthly (November 2026: Tabelog lists the 11th and 25th, the official site the 6th and 23rd). Same-day reservations online or by phone; 16:00 bookings by noon; tables released 30 minutes after the booking time (Tabelog). Cashless only: cards and QR payments including PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog; May 2025). No charge. 18 seats: a 7-seat counter and sofa seats; non-smoking; English menu; BYO wine or sake ¥3,630, spirits ¥6,050 (Tabelog). Second floor of a building at the Shijo end of Pontocho (official site; November 2024).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho at the Shijo end — 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal-grilled game (gibier) and wine bar: meat grilled slowly to order for 20–30 minutes, then rested; deer, boar and bear by season, plus wagyu and sausages (official site) · grilled brown bear (Hokkaido higuma) ¥3,630, reserve ahead (May 2025) · also rabbit, duck, raccoon dog, nutria, capybara, kangaroo, seal and lamb on various days (2024–2026 reviews) · Tsudoi course (book the day before): skewers of deer, boar, pheasant, rabbit and quail (official site) · rabbit and rapeseed Spanish omelette ¥847, octopus carpaccio ¥1,210, shrimp tomato pasta ¥1,815, wild boar bolognese ¥1,815 (May 2025) · charcoal-grilled vegetables, appetizer platters · wide wine list, sake, shochu, cocktails
places.notes: [Game & wine · Pontocho, charcoal-grilled bear, boar and deer until 1 a.m.] Up a flight of stairs at the Shijo end of Pontocho, a snug wine bar with a counter and hidden sofa nooks that grills game over charcoal — deer, boar and Hokkaido brown bear, with rarer meats such as nutria, capybara or kangaroo on some nights. The meat takes 20–30 minutes, so order early and start with the appetizer platter, the much-praised grilled vegetables (the sweet onion especially) or a pasta. Brown bear was ¥3,630 a portion in May 2025 (book it ahead). Open nightly to 1:00, last orders around midnight. Cashless only.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 1 December 2011. Per the official site, the shop grills to order over charcoal for 20–30 minutes — grilling, wrapping and resting the meat — so that guests feel "gibier is delicious".
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to make guests feel that gibier is delicious, the cooking method is the point.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled brown bear and other game; grilled vegetables.

anecdotes.text: "We have bear meat available year-round, but we can't guarantee whether it will be Higuma or Tsukinowaguma that we receive." — the staff, May 2025.
A November 2024 newcomer to game, unsure what to order, had raccoon dog, duck, wild rabbit and venison on the manager's advice and found none of it gamey.
A May 2025 diner found the table seating cramped and noisy and the dishes slow to arrive.
"I'm really happy that the last order is at midnight, making it perfect for after work!" — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tanzen-pontocho.com): ゆったり 炙ジビエとワイン 炭然 (たんぜん)、先斗町の“大人の隠れ家”、2階、炭火焼のジビエは鹿・猪・熊など季節により変更、和牛・ソーセージ・前菜も、深夜1時まで、注文を受けてから炭火で20〜30分、焼いて包んで寝かせる、炭然コース 獣達の集 (前日予約限定6品、鹿・猪・きじ・うさぎ・うずらの串焼き)、18:00〜1:00 (0:30 L.O.)、不定休 (11月は6日・23日)、18席、全席禁煙。食べログ: ジビエ料理・パスタ・ダイニングバー、中京区先斗町通四条上ル鍋屋町220-6 弥栄ビル先斗町2F、毎日17:00〜1:00、完全キャッシュレス、チャージなし、英語メニュー、持ち込み料あり、2011年12月1日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): ヒグマの炭火焼3,630円、うさぎ、鴨、アライグマ、ヌートリア、カピバラ、カンガルー、焼き野菜。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); staff advise newcomers to game; cashless only.

places.name: むろまち 加地 (Muromachi Kaji)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese counter cooking with sashimi in soy sauce, simmered dishes, tempura, dashimaki and clay-pot rice; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-sake counter; vegetables come as simmered dishes or tempura alongside fish (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00, last food order 22:00, drinks 22:30; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Two seatings, at 18:00 and 20:15 (October 2024; October 2026). Booking essential (October 2024); online bookings through the shop's Instagram (Tabelog). 9 counter seats (Tabelog), though a September 2026 diner had eaten in a private room on an earlier visit. Non-smoking, smoking area outside; cards accepted (Tabelog). 5–10 min walk from Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 18 August 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Matsubara-dori near Shinmachi — 5–10 min walk from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Counter of seasonal Japanese dishes and sake: an 8-dish course or à la carte (October 2026) · the hassun appetizer under leaves (reserve it) · sashimi platters with soy sauce, nikiri-zake and fish-liver miso, often with saba sushi · simmered octopus, roast beef, "adult" potato salad with karasumi or crab miso · seasonal grills, e.g. ayu, Spanish mackerel, yellowtail collar · hamo tempura, vegetable tempura · dashimaki · clay-pot rice, e.g. sea bream, anago or karasumi; leftovers made into onigiri to take away · rare sake such as Katsukoma, Hanamura, Akabu, Sharaku (2024–2026 reviews) · about ¥10,000–15,000 a head (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese · Gojo, a nine-seat counter for fish and sake] A small counter on Matsubara-dori, a short walk from Gojo Stn, where the day's fish is laid out and explained before you order. The hassun under leaves and the sashimi platter (with saba sushi, and soy, nikiri-zake and fish-liver miso to dip) are the musts; then simmered octopus, the karasumi "adult" potato salad, seasonal tempura and a clay-pot rice — what you can't finish comes back as onigiri. Rare sake (Katsukoma, Akabu, Sharaku). Two seatings, 18:00 and 20:15; book ahead. About ¥10,000–15,000 a head. Closed Thursday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed in the sources; a September 2026 review mentions "the owner-chef")
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 18 August 2011. The Tabelog Award Bronze 2019 and 2020 (Tabelog). A regular of more than ten years returns every autumn (October 2024 – September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter with saba sushi; "adult" potato salad; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "I was captivated by the sound of the conger eel being filleted right in front of me" — October 2026.
An August 2026 diner, full from lunch, had a little of the clay-pot rice and took the rest back to the hotel as onigiri.
A September 2026 diner on a second visit found a new counter staff member slow to notice orders, while the food was as good as ever.
An October 2024 regular notes it is close to Kyoto Station and popular with international guests.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: むろまち 加地、日本料理・居酒屋、下京区松原通新町東入中野之町185 1F、五条駅から徒歩5〜10分、18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00・ドリンク22:30)、木曜休み、予約可 (インスタグラムからネット予約)、カウンター9席、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、カード可、2011年8月18日オープン、The Tabelog Award 2019・2020 Bronze。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 18時と20時15分の二部制、八寸、刺身の盛り合わせと鯖寿司、たこの煮物、ローストビーフ、からすみの大人のポテトサラダ、鱧の天ぷら、だし巻き、土鍋ご飯 (残りはおにぎりに)、8品のコースかアラカルト、日本酒 (Katsukoma、Hanamura、Akabu、Sharaku など)、一人1万〜1万5千円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (Instagram or phone) for the 18:00 or 20:15 seating; staff explain the day's fish at the counter.
