places.name: KANEGURA
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sukiyaki-style wagyu nikunabe with a sweet soy broth, sauced beef tongue, hamburg steak and yukhoe; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu izakaya built around a meat hot pot, beef tongue, yukhoe and hamburg steak (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 16:00–23:00, last food order 22:00, drinks 22:30; last entry 21:30; courses from 18:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Two-hour limit; reservations taken, special requests by phone (Tabelog). One-drink minimum, otherwise a ¥500 seat charge (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink courses ¥6,500 and ¥7,500 (October 2026). Many dishes can be served as single portions for solo diners (October 2026). 22 seats (6 counter, 4 tables of 4); no high chairs; non-smoking; cards and PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 6 min walk from Shijo Stn exit 5 (Tabelog). Opened 19 November 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yanagibaba-dori south of Bukkoji — 6 min walk from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Wagyu izakaya whose signature is the nikunabe, a sukiyaki-like hot pot piled with beef, eaten with egg (2024–2026 reviews) · grades of meat for the nabe, from lean to marbled; eggs and rice extra (October–November 2026) · 100% black wagyu hamburg steak, black wagyu yukhoe, raw marinated beef tongue, grilled beef tongue in sauce, wagyu tataki, thin-sliced sirloin, hash-brown beef · house salad, potato salad, pickles · courses with all-you-can-drink ¥6,500 or ¥7,500 (October 2026) · sake and wine
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo, a wagyu nikunabe hideaway] A lively meat izakaya on Yanagibaba-dori south of Bukkoji whose star is the nikunabe: a mountain of wagyu simmered sukiyaki-style at the table and dipped in Kyoto egg, which staff help cook through to the end. Around it come a 100% wagyu hamburg steak, yukhoe, beef tongue and tataki. Courses with all-you-can-drink were ¥6,500–7,500 in October 2026; à la carte works too, and solo diners can order many dishes as single portions. Two-hour limit, last entry 21:30; closed Tuesday. Many guests are visitors from abroad.

roles: Operator not named; a 2024 post names its instigators as 伊藤氏 and 抜木氏
chef_bio.background: Per a post on foodle.pro (22 August 2024): the name is read カネグラ and is said to mean a storehouse for gold, silver and treasure; it was formed from radicals of the surnames of the two instigators, 伊藤氏 and 抜木氏, the former being the 大将 of the Kyoto meat kappo にくの匠 三芳. Tabelog gives the opening as 19 November 2021. Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025 and 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu nikunabe; 100% wagyu hamburg steak; yukhoe.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 solo diner, whose friend had caught the flu, was told at the counter that many dishes can be served as a single portion.
An October 2026 group had warned ahead that one member does not eat raw dishes, and an alternative meat was prepared.
A November 2026 diner praised the meat and the cheerful part-time staff but found the meat cook unsmiling and sharp with junior staff in front of guests.
An October 2026 visitor found the course tasty but light on volume, and would have liked rice from the start rather than at the end.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: KANEGURA、居酒屋・鍋、下京区柳馬場通仏光寺下ル万里小路町187、四条駅5番出口から徒歩約6分、16:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00・ドリンク22:30)、最終入店21:30、コースは18時から、火曜休み、2時間制、ワンドリンク制 (注文がない場合席料500円)、22席 (カウンター6、4人テーブル4)、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、2021年11月19日オープン、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2025・2026。foodle.pro の投稿 (2024年8月22日): 伖 (カネグラ)、金銀や財宝を入れておく蔵の意味、仕掛け人の伊藤氏と抜木氏の偏と旁から命名、伊藤氏はにくの匠 三芳の大将、名物は肉を重ねた肉鍋、サーロインの薄切り、牛肉100パーセントのハンバーグ。口コミ (2026年10〜11月、英語): 肉鍋、ユッケ、牛タン、飲み放題付きコース6,500円・7,500円、一人前から注文可、海外からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff help cook the hot pot; one drink per person; many guests from abroad (October 2026).

places.name: BISTRO NAMI
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses include bread (refilled freely at lunch), pâté, gratin, a small curry before dessert, cake and pasta; allergies should be told when booking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the shop stresses Kyoto vegetables (vegetable terrine, salads, potages), but courses centre on meat and fish and no vegan dish is named (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 12:00–15:30 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–23:00; dinner last entry 22:00; closed Wednesday and one irregular day a month (Tabelog). 23–25 December 2026: Christmas course only (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; tell the shop about allergies in advance; cancellation fees of 50% the day before and 100% on the day (Tabelog). At dinner, a cover charge for guests not taking a course (Tabelog). 21 seats: a counter on the ground floor and well-spaced tables upstairs (Tabelog; June 2026). Tabelog lists cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay, but an April 2026 reviewer was told cash only. Children welcome, with a kids’ menu (Tabelog). Look for the large noren; 1 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu) (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Just south of Nishiki Market street — 1 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Casual French home cooking with Kyoto vegetables, meat and fresh fish (Tabelog shop text) · lunch: a light course ¥2,200 with salad, corn potage, baguette, fish of the day and coffee (July 2026); a seven-dish course with a warm amuse-bouche, potage, appetiser platter, sea bass or pork shoulder, a choice of two curries (beef tendon, or cardamom with clams) and dessert (May 2026); a ¥3,500 lunch with gratin and steak (June 2026) · dinner course ¥5,200 (Tabelog shop text); à la carte vegetable terrine, roast duck, pâté, miso-marinated cheese bruschetta (2026 reviews) · winter and Christmas courses ¥11,000 with lobster thermidor and a pie-wrapped main (Tabelog) · wines by the glass, seasonal fruit cocktails, all-you-can-drink plans (Tabelog shop text)
places.notes: [Bistro · Kawaramachi, Kyoto vegetables at the counter] A small two-floor bistro a minute from Kawaramachi Station, behind a large noren, where one chef cooks French home food with Kyoto vegetables: a warm amuse-bouche, potage, a vegetable terrine, fish or meat, then — unusually — a little curry before dessert. Lunch courses from ¥2,200 with bread refills; dinner course ¥5,200. Sit at the counter to talk with the chef, or upstairs at roomier tables. Most 2026 reviewers liked it; one April 2026 diner found the kitchen visible from the counter dirty. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: casual French cooking with Kyoto vegetables and fresh meat and fish, wines by the glass, seasonal fruit cocktails, and dessert plates with messages for celebrations. Reviewers in 2026 describe one chef running the kitchen, chatting with counter guests and seeing them off at the door, with a young staff member at the counter (April 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch courses ending with curry; vegetable terrine.

anecdotes.text: "Since there is only one chef in the kitchen, it seemed a bit challenging when multiple orders came in at once." The same diner found the chef friendly and talkative — June 2026.
"I forgot to take a photo, but I was surprised by the curry served before dessert. It was incredibly delicious." — May 2026.
An April 2026 reviewer found the taste and value reasonable, but "the kitchen visible from the counter was in terrible condition", the coffee weak, and was told the shop took cash only.
"The chef kindly saw us off to the door, which was a nice touch." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ビストロ・フレンチ・肉料理、中京区御幸町通錦小路下る大日町403、阪急河原町駅から徒歩1分、月・火・木・金 12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)・17:00〜23:00、土日祝 12:00〜15:30 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜23:00、水曜と月1回不定休、2026年12月23〜25日はクリスマスコースのみ、予約可 (アレルギーは事前に連絡、キャンセル料あり)、夜はコース以外はチャージ料、21席、カード・PayPay 可、禁煙、子供可・キッズメニュー、ベジタリアンメニューあり、京野菜と肉と鮮魚のカジュアルなフレンチ、ディナーコース5,200円、クリスマスコース11,000円 (オマール海老のテルミドール)。口コミ (2026年4〜7月、英語): シェフ1人の厨房、デザート前のカレー、パンのおかわり、ランチ2,200円・3,500円、1階はカウンター、2階はテーブル、厨房が汚いとの声、現金のみと言われた。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead and mention allergies; counter seats face the chef; payment method unclear (cards on Tabelog, cash only per one review).

places.name: 先斗町 藤わら (Pontocho Fujiwara)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase sushi and small dishes: nigiri with a lightly sweet soy sauce or salt, simmered clam and anago with sauce, sake-lees and miso grilled fish; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase of fish and shellfish sushi with dashi soups (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order food 14:00, drinks 14:30); dinner 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); open every day, closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations; same-day cancellation is charged 100% (Tabelog). Courses: limited lunch special sushi course ¥16,500 (15 items, 2–7 people) and special omakase ¥24,200 (Tabelog, tax included); a September 2025 diner booked a ¥22,000 course. 10% service charge (Tabelog). No cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No perfume, please; children only with the adult course (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at a white-wood counter and 8 at tables, plus a private room for 5–8; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog; March 2026). In the alley joining Pontocho and Kiyamachi; 5 min walk from Kawaramachi, 8 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 11 April 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Alley between Pontocho and Kiyamachi north of Shijo — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Omakase sushi with small dishes: rice of Ryuu no Hitomi cooked in a clay pot and seasoned with a blend of three red vinegars; wild bluefin tuna (Tabelog shop text) · a February 2026 dinner: cod milt with urui, sashimi, Shogoin turnip soup, sawara grilled with sake lees and karasumi, monkfish liver with narazuke, then otoro with salt, chutoro, akami, hirame, aji, sayori with yuzu, simmered clam and nodoguro in nori · a September 2025 course: mozuku, sashimi, hamo and matsutake, homemade karasumi, rock oyster, then nigiri to simmered anago · sake such as Jizaemon, white wine (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Pontocho, red-vinegar sushi in a back alley] A quiet sushi counter of white wood down the alley joining Pontocho and Kiyamachi, open since 2019, where the rice — Ryuu no Hitomi cooked in a clay pot — is seasoned with three red vinegars blended to sit back behind the fish. Omakase courses run through small seasonal dishes, sashimi and soup to nigiri: lunch ¥16,500, the special omakase ¥24,200, plus 10% service; cash only. Reviewers praise the friendly, humorous chef and the sake list; one March 2026 diner found the sushi too sweet. No perfume.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop’s Tabelog text: a blend of three red vinegars and Ryuu no Hitomi rice cooked in a clay pot; attention to tempo, portion and aftertaste as well as flavour; a calm atmosphere and a gentle distance for those new to counter sushi. Opened 11 April 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a friendly, humorous chef who asks about appetite through the meal.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Tabelog shop text: red-vinegar rice that harmonises with the toppings without overpowering them, and a meal enjoyed comfortably to the end.
chef_bio.specialty: Red-vinegar nigiri; bluefin tuna.

anecdotes.text: "The chef was attentive and asked about my appetite throughout the meal" — June 2025.
A February 2026 diner remembered otoro served with salt, sayori with salt and yuzu, and grilled nodoguro wrapped in nori, and a chef who was "friendly and humorous".

"The chef was friendly and attentive, but perhaps due to visiting on a Sunday, the quality of the ingredients wasn't great. The sushi felt a bit too sweet, and the red vinegar rice itself was disappointing." — March 2026.
"When I come to Kyoto, I usually choose from three sushi places, and lately, I find myself at Fujiwara more often." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 寿司、中京区木屋町通四条上る二丁目下樵木町204-7、河原町から徒歩5分、祇園四条から8分、12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 料理14:00・ドリンク14:30)・18:00〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00)、不定休、予約可 (当日キャンセルは100%)、限定ランチ特選寿司コース16,500円 (15品)、特選おまかせ24,200円、サービス料10%、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、15席 (カウンター7、テーブル8)、個室あり、車椅子可、香水は控える、子供は大人と同じコースのみ、2019年4月11日オープン、店舗紹介: 3種の赤酢を合わせ、Ryuu no Hitomi を土鍋で炊くシャリ、天然本まぐろ、日本酒。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年10月、英語): 先斗町と木屋町を結ぶ路地、白木のカウンター、おまかせのつまみと握り、気さくなご主人、赤酢のシャリが甘すぎたとの声 (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; omakase only; cash only; no perfume.

places.name: ステーキハウス新吾 (Steak House Shingo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan steak with a soy-butter sauce, mustard and garlic chips; garlic rice fried with soy sauce; soups, salad with French dressing and fried onions; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef steakhouse; courses start with prosciutto and wagyu tataki and end with ice cream (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–13:00 and 17:00–22:00, every day (Tabelog). Reservations recommended; a seat may be found if one is free (October 2026). 10% service charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats at the counter, plus private rooms; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). Takeaway available (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley off Shinmonzen-dori in Gion; check the map first (2026 reviews); 3 min walk from Sanjo Keihan Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmonzen-dori in north Gion — 3 min walk from Sanjo Keihan Stn
places.cuisine: Long-running teppan steakhouse: aged kuroge wagyu grilled at the counter (Tabelog shop text) · Omi beef, A4 (July 2026) or A4–A5 depending on supply (October 2026) · lunch steak gozen ¥8,000: salad, onion soup, black-wagyu steak, rice, fruit (October 2026) · omakase course ¥18,000: three appetisers (prosciutto, shrimp, wagyu tataki), potage, steamed vegetables, wagyu tenderloin or sirloin, pickles, garlic rice, vanilla ice cream with kinako and kuromitsu (August 2026) · chateaubriand with soy-butter sauce (September 2026) · steaks by weight, 120–300 g (2026 reviews) · wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Steak · Gion Shinmonzen, a teppan counter down an alley] A retro teppan steakhouse with brick walls and glassware, down a narrow alley off Shinmonzen-dori, where aged wagyu — Omi beef, A4 or A5 as supply allows — is grilled rare at the counter and served with soy-butter sauce, mustard and garlic chips, then garlic rice. Lunch steak gozen ¥8,000; dinner omakase ¥18,000, plus 10% service. A July 2026 reviewer gives the method as 48 years old; regulars in March and April 2026 noted a change of owner and younger staff. Book ahead.

roles: Owner and grill cooks (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: a long-established Gion restaurant that keeps its traditions, with skills honed over many years at a quiet counter and carefully aged kuroge wagyu. A July 2026 reviewer writes of a cooking method passed down for 48 years. A March 2026 regular thought the management was changing, and an April 2026 regular found the owner had changed and the staff younger. places.name: ジュメルニジュウク (Jumelles 29)
places.gf_detail: Ask. About 60 dishes, including pasta, gnocchi, quiche, fritters, gratin, bread and cakes alongside grilled meats and carpaccios; portions and dishes can be adjusted on request, but no gluten information is given (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: a meat-focused bistro (the "29" in the name means meat); the few vegetable plates are pickles, marinated olives and a bagna cauda (official menu).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:30, drinks 23:00) (Tabelog; official site). The official site says closed Tuesday; Tabelog lists every day with irregular closures. Reservations through the shop’s app or Tabelog (official site; September 2026); booking advised (October 2026). Warm dishes can take about 30 minutes; order early (official menu). ¥500 a person for the appetiser and service (official menu; Tabelog). 24 seats with a counter and sofas, in a townhouse; non-smoking; private hire from 17 people (Tabelog; official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). Coin parking opposite (Tabelog). 4 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn, 5 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Opened 12 July 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ayanokoji at Fuyacho, between Karasuma and Kawaramachi — 4 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Neo-bistro of French cooking with a focus on meat — "29" reads as niku, meat — and about 60 dishes, all available in half portions (official site) · 尾崎牛 beef from Miyazaki, raised long with little stress; the shop met it at a nearby restaurant, then visited the farm: grilled with Bordeaux sauce ¥2,500 per 100 g, tartare ¥1,750, bresaola ¥1,580 (official site and menu) · duck breast smoked over vine cuttings ¥2,550, veal tongue in red wine, Ezo venison fillet, bear shoulder, lamb rump with couscous, wagyu heart, veal kidney, tripe, black-pork belly in beer (official menu) · smoked mackerel with potato salad ¥980, sea urchin pudding with garlic toast ¥1,350, chickpea-and-cheese fritters ¥770, foie gras terrine, homemade karasumi pastas, cacio e pepe ¥1,650, wagyu Bolognese with gnocchi ¥2,100, truffle risotto (official menu) · hazelnut crème brûlée, baba au rhum, gâteau chocolat ¥750–800 (official menu) · glass wines from ¥550, mostly French, new bottles about monthly; Tabelog cites about 200 wines (official site; Tabelog) · banquet course with 1.5-hour free drinks ¥7,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Bistro · Ayanokoji, meat and wine in a townhouse] A neo-bistro in a townhouse just off the main streets between Karasuma and Kawaramachi — the "29" is niku, meat — with a counter, sofas and some 60 dishes that can all be ordered as halves: smoked mackerel on potato salad, sea urchin pudding with garlic toast, vine-smoked duck, 尾崎牛 beef from Miyazaki, game such as Ezo venison, then a hazelnut crème brûlée. Glass wines from ¥550, mostly French. ¥500 a head cover; most reviewers paid ¥3,000–10,000. Open 17:00–23:00; the site gives Tuesday as closed. Tabelog Bistro 100 2021.

roles: Chef (unnamed), trained at hotels in Japan and restaurants in France (Tabelog shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: authentic French cooking at fair prices by a chef who trained at renowned hotels in Japan and top restaurants in France, with a focus on meat. Per the official site: the shop first tasted 尾崎牛 at a nearby restaurant, wanted to know more, visited the farm and fell for the beef and its farmer; a counter was built to watch guests react; the wine list, chosen with a sommelier, describes each wine’s region, grape and character; the aim is hospitality that makes guests want to return. Opened 12 July 2011 (Tabelog). Tabelog Bistro "Tabelog 100" 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: for a cook, "delicious" is a given; the aim is for guests to want to come back.
chef_bio.specialty: Smoked mackerel and potato salad; vine-smoked duck breast; 尾崎牛 grill.

anecdotes.text: "I was particularly surprised by the spare ribs, which were unlike any I had tasted at other restaurants" — September 2026.
"The rabbit meat dishes have a unique flavor that may not appeal to everyone, so I recommend trying other dishes first if you're a first-time visitor." — September 2026.
"This place is incredibly delicious! However, it is on the pricier side. … It was disappointing when someone tried to take my plate away even though I still had rice left on it." — October 2026.
"I made a reservation through Tabelog and received a complimentary dish!" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (jumelles29.jp): 京都・河原町のフレンチ・ネオビストロ、下京区綾小路通麩屋町下ル塩屋町81-1、17:00〜23:00、火曜日定休、メニューは約60種、ハーフポーション可、店名の「29」は肉への思いから、尾崎牛 (近所の店で出会い、牧場を訪ねた)、カウンター席、ソムリエと選んだワインリスト、ひと月ごとに新しいワイン、貸し切りは17名から、アプリで予約、メニュー: ひよこ豆ペーストとチーズのフリット770円、葡萄の木で燻した鴨胸肉のロティ2,550円、尾崎牛のグリエ100g 2,500円、真さばマリネのスモークとポテトサラダ980円、濃厚なウニのプリンとガーリックトースト1,350円、カチョエペペ1,650円、黒毛和牛ボロネーゼとじゃがいものニョッキ2,100円、ヘーゼルナッツのクレームブリュレ750円、温かい料理は30分ほどかかることも、お突出し代・サービス料1人500円、グラスワイン550円から。食べログ: ビストロ・イタリアン・肉料理、毎日17:00〜23:00、不定休、24席、カード・QUICPay・PayPay 可、禁煙、2011年7月12日オープン、ビストロ百名店 2021、ワイン約200種、飲み放題付き宴会コース7,000円。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 生ハム、さばのポテトサラダ、スペアリブ、ウニのプリン、キッシュ、うさぎ、値段は高め、皿を早く下げられそうになった。

places.name: メゾン ド ヴァン 鶉亭 (Maison de Vin Uzura Tei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. French courses with bread, sauces such as beurre blanc, a flan and a cutlet, and mizutaki in winter; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses centre on wagyu, pork, fish and chicken, and the soups are fish- or chicken-based (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00), Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and the 2nd and 4th Monday (Tabelog). Reservations online; Tabelog notes that reservations for individuals are not accepted on Fridays and Saturdays (Tabelog). Table charge ¥1,100 per person and 10% service (Tabelog). Seating at the counter or tables, assigned by the shop; private room for 3–8 (Tabelog). In summer a riverside platform (kawadoko) over the Kamo River; rain can move diners indoors (2026 reviews). Shoes come off at the entrance (May 2026). Heated tobacco only, in the private room and on the platform (Tabelog). 19 seats (6 counter, 13 table); cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money, no QR (Tabelog). At the Y-junction on the Takase River, Kiyamachi south of Shijo; 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn, 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; May 2026).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Shijo, on the Kamo River — 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: French restaurant and wine bar with mizutaki (Tabelog) · November 2026 courses: A course with a choice of main ¥9,350; Petit Gourmandises with three glasses of wine ¥16,500; Harmonie Gourmande, six dishes with six 100 ml glasses ¥23,000 (Tabelog, tax and service included) · a September 2026 riverside A course of 9 dishes: purple sweet potato flan with hamo and mushroom clear soup, salad, black wagyu sirloin-cap carpaccio, pan-fried amadai with beurre blanc, Kyoto pork tenderloin Rossini with foie gras and truffle, bread, dessert, coffee · four appetizers, soup, ayu and lamb (October 2026) · winter mizutaki of Miyama chicken after French starters such as crab jelly and shark-fin flan (December 2025) · bottles and glasses chosen by the owner-sommelier, including second wines of known châteaux (September 2026)
places.notes: [French & wine · Kiyamachi, a riverside platform and a sommelier] A 19-seat French restaurant at the Y-bend of the Takase River where you take off your shoes, sit at the counter or a table, and in summer move out to a platform over the Kamo River facing the Minami-za. The owner is a sommelier, and diners praise the glasses as much as the food: courses run from ¥9,350 (choose your main) to ¥23,000 with six paired glasses. In winter the house turns to mizutaki of Miyama chicken after French starters. Add ¥1,100 table charge and 10% service. Closed Sunday and the 2nd and 4th Monday.

chef_bio.background: A June 2026 diner spent the evening talking with the owner-sommelier; an October 2026 diner says the owner explains each dish. A September 2026 diner was told the wine list favours second labels of renowned châteaux so that glasses are good without being overly expensive. A diner who has come in the riverside season for about 25 years found the cooking consistently excellent but the prices higher than before (September 2026). Tabelog French WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal French courses with paired wine; winter mizutaki.

anecdotes.text: "I’ve been visiting this place during the riverside dining season for about 25 years now" — September 2026.
"You take off your shoes at the entrance, and from there, it feels like stepping into another world." — May 2026.
A March 2026 party was moved to a window seat with a view of the Kamo River when one came free.
"However, it is on the pricier side, so if you’re making a reservation for a date, be prepared to splurge!" — May 2026.

places.name: BABBI GELATERIA KYOTO
places.gf_detail: Ask. Gelato comes in a cup or a wafer or cocoa cone topped with BABBI wafer, and the gelato itself uses BABBI’s wafer pastes; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Most flavours are milk-based (milk, ricotta fig, salted caramel vanilla); fruit flavours such as yuzu and lemon exist, but their ingredients are not published (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 13:00–22:00 daily; eat-in and drink last orders 21:30 (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). 12 seats inside, plus a 36-seat riverside platform (kawadoko) over the Kamo River from May to October (Tabelog); a single scoop of milk was ¥990 on the platform in August 2026, which the reviewer took to include a platform fee. Non-smoking; cards, IC cards and e-money, PayPay and other QR payments including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Wet towels at the counter (September 2026). At the west end of Dango Bridge on Kiyamachi-dori south of Shijo; 4 min from Gion-Shijo and Kyoto Kawaramachi Stns (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi-dori at Dango Bridge, south of Shijo, on the Kamo River — 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gelato shop of BABBI, the Italian wafer maker with a 70-year history; the gelato uses its wafer pastes, alongside Japanese flavours such as matcha and black sesame (Tabelog) · pistachio, hazelnut, chocolate, ricotta fig, rich milk, salted caramel vanilla, Amaou strawberry, yuzu and lemon, cookies and cream, black sesame, cherry (2024–26 reviews) · cup, wafer or cocoa cone topped with a BABBI wafer · triple ¥1,620 (September 2026); double just under ¥900 in 2024; in 2020 single ¥550 and double ¥660 (Walkerplus) · chocolate shaved ice, a Dubai chocolate dessert, coffee float, matcha drink, yuzu cello soda (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Gelato · Kiyamachi, Italian gelato over the Kamo River] The only gelato shop of BABBI, the Italian wafer brand, at the Dango Bridge end of Kiyamachi: flavours from pistachio and hazelnut to ricotta fig and Kyoto-leaning matcha and black sesame, in a cup or a cone crowned with a BABBI wafer. Eat inside looking at the river, or from May to October on the riverside platform, where prices run higher (a single was ¥990 there in August 2026). Open daily 13:00–22:00, a handy stop after dinner in Kiyamachi.

roles: Shop of the Italian brand BABBI, run in Japan by a company (corporate invoice registrant, Tabelog); no staff named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a gelato shop from the Italian wafer brand BABBI, which has a 70-year history, using its wafer pastes in the gelato and offering Japanese flavours such as matcha and black sesame; it faces the Kamo River. Walkerplus (February 2020) reported it as the brand’s first gelato shop in Japan; an October 2026 reviewer says it is still the only BABBI location in Japan serving gelato, with ingredients imported from Italy and made in-house, and a September 2026 reviewer notes BABBI also has a Tokyo shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Pistachio and hazelnut gelato; wafer-topped cones.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor paid ¥990 for a single scoop on the riverside platform and called it the last visit for that reason, while praising the taste.
An October 2026 regular noticed that prices had risen in recent years and balked at ¥1,600 for three flavours.
"I appreciated the wet towels available at the counter, as gelato can sometimes drip" — September 2026.
An August 2026 visitor saw a display of discounted outlet products but found them sold out, with no sign saying so.

places.name: 祇園ねぎ焼 かな 東店 (Gion Negiyaki Kana Higashi ten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: negiyaki, betayaki, okonomiyaki and yakisoba are wheat-batter or wheat-noodle dishes cooked on one shared teppan with sauce or soy sauce (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fillings are beef tendon, pork, squid and chikuwa, the dashimaki is egg and dashi, and the batter dishes carry egg or meat (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday 12:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); Friday and Saturday 12:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); closed Monday and the 1st and 3rd Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations recommended; two-hour limit (Tabelog); some walk-ins get seats, others find it full (2026 reviews). places.neighborhood: Higashioji-dori southwest of Yasaka Shrine — 8 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Teppan counter of Kyoto-style flour dishes (2025–26 reviews) · negiyaki with plenty of green onion, eaten with soy sauce: pork ¥800, mix of beef, pork, squid and chikuwa, extra egg ¥100 · betayaki (thin Kyoto-style okonomiyaki) mix ¥1,000 or beef tendon ¥1,000, with a spicy sauce · okonomiyaki, tonpeiyaki, beef yakisoba, lotus root stuffed with meat, mushrooms, a pizza · special dashimaki rolled on the teppan with green onion and pickled ginger ¥650 · the owner’s potato salad ¥500 and simmered whelk · draft beer ¥600, oolong tea ¥400 (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Negiyaki · Gion, a teppan counter by Yasaka Shrine] A 12-seat counter on Higashioji-dori near Yasaka Shrine, founded in 1984 per a reviewer, where the owner cooks on the teppan in front of you and chats with the regulars along the counter. Order the negiyaki — thin batter under a heap of green onion, with soy sauce (¥800 with pork) — or the Kyoto betayaki with its spicy sauce, and start with the special dashimaki rolled on the griddle with pickled ginger (¥650) while you wait. Book ahead; two-hour limit; cash only. Open until 3:00 on Friday and Saturday; closed Monday.

roles: Owner-cook at the teppan (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: An October 2026 reviewer gives the founding year as 1984, and another that month calls it a teppan-yaki restaurant with over 40 years of history. Reviewers describe the owner cooking at the teppan and chatting with customers, the owner’s homemade potato salad and simmered whelk, and a counter of regulars. Tabelog Okonomiyaki "Tabelog 100" 2018, 2019, 2022–2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Negiyaki; betayaki; dashimaki.

anecdotes.text: "The owner was friendly and struck up a conversation, which made me feel welcome." — September 2026.

"I also learned the proper way to enjoy it, which was quite educational!" — September 2026.

places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 11:00–19:00; closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Takeaway only; the shop is small and feels full with two or three customers (2026 reviews). Some breads sell out by the afternoon (September 2026). No reservations; cash only (Tabelog). On Higashinotoin-dori south of Sanjo, near Rokkakudo; 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin-dori south of Sanjo — 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Small French-style bakery of mostly savoury breads at low prices — many items ¥180–240 (2026 reviews) · 5種の豆のフランスパン (five-bean French bread, sweet beans) ¥220 (August 2026; ¥216 in a September 2026 review) · ベーコンとチーズのフランスパン ¥240 · croque monsieur ¥280, camembert cream ¥220, cheese "Fromage" baguette of about 20 cm · beef cutlet sandwich ¥370, French anpan ¥140, an épi-style bread ¥260 (October 2026, before tax) · egg and pumpkin-salad sandwiches, chestnut anpan and chestnut coupé, cranberry custard bread, Fruity dried-fruit bread (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bakery · Karasuma Oike, savoury breads at old prices] A tiny Paris-looking bakery on Higashinotoin-dori, a few minutes from Karasuma Oike, whose shelves are packed with savoury breads that reviewers cannot believe are so cheap: three items with change from ¥1,000. Try the croque monsieur (¥280), the cheese-filled Fromage, a beef cutlet sandwich (¥370) or the sweet five-bean French bread (¥220). Takeaway only, cash only; two or three customers fill it. Tuesday–Saturday 11:00–19:00.

roles: Bakery; no owner or baker is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a very small shop with a Parisian look, shelves packed with mostly savoury breads, and prices low for the times. A September 2026 visitor found the name FLEUR DE FARINE hard to read on the front. Tabelog Bread WEST "Tabelog 100" 2022, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Savoury breads; croque monsieur; five-bean French bread.

anecdotes.text: "You can buy three items and still get change from JPY 1000, which is quite a blessing in these times." — October 2026.
"I wish they had the name "FLEUR DE FARINE" written prominently, as I struggled to read it" — September 2026.
An October 2026 buyer named the ¥370 beef cutlet sandwich the star of the bag.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン・サンドイッチ、中京区東洞院通三条下ル三文字町200 ミックナカムラビル1F、烏丸御池駅から305m、火〜土 11:00〜19:00、日・月休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、パン WEST 百名店 2022・2026。口コミ (2026年8〜10月): 六角堂近くのこじんまりした店、5種の豆のフランスパン220円 (9月の口コミでは216円)、ベーコンとチーズのフランスパン240円、英語の口コミ: クロックムッシュ280円、カマンベールクリーム220円、牛カツサンド370円、フランスあんパン140円、総菜パン中心、2〜3人でいっぱいの小さな店、安い。

cultural_comfort.note: Small takeaway shop; cash only.

places.name: 柚子元 京都先斗町店 (Yuzu Gen Pontocho)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The yuzu hot pots finish with noodles or rice porridge, and the menu adds gyoza, noodle bowls and fried chicken; the broth ingredients are not published (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but every hot pot on the menu is wagyu, sea bream, shrimp, pork or chicken, and the gyoza filling is not described as meat-free (Tabelog; official menu).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Tuesday; hours may change with weather or season (Tabelog). The operator’s own page also lists lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order) — not on Tabelog, so check. Bookings by phone or Tabelog only (not via Auto Reserve); two-hour seating; ¥3,000 a head for same-day cancellation or no-show; a service charge is added (Tabelog). One-drink policy and QR ordering (December 2025). 48 seats: a counter downstairs, tatami rooms up a steep staircase; restroom on the first floor only (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards, IC cards and QR payments; non-smoking (Tabelog). Takeaway and Uber Eats (official site). On Pontocho, north of Shijo; 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho alley, just north of Shijo — 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Yuzu-themed Chinese-style hot-pot house in a renovated Pontocho townhouse (official site) · yuzu nabe per person (from two servings): black-wagyu yuzu shabu ¥4,800, shrimp and sea bream ¥3,300, sea bream ¥3,000, pork ¥2,800, chicken ¥2,800, finished with noodles or rice porridge · yuzu-shaped gyoza, green yuzu (with yuzu kosho, spicy) and yellow yuzu (yuzu miso), 4, 6 or 8 pieces from ¥500 · yuzu noodle bowls ¥1,380–1,800; spicy beef-tendon noodles · whole fried sea bream or chicken with yurin sauce, yuzu cabbage, smashed cucumber · yuzu sakes and yuzu highball (official menu, March 2025, prices with tax; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yuzu hot pot · Pontocho, a townhouse full of citrus] A small renovated townhouse on Pontocho, open since 2005, where almost everything carries yuzu: hot pots of sea bream, shrimp, pork, chicken or wagyu in a tart yuzu broth (from ¥2,800 a head, finished with noodles or porridge), yuzu-shaped gyoza in green and yellow versions, and yuzu sakes. Counter downstairs, tatami rooms up a steep stair. Dinner 17:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; book through Tabelog or by phone.

roles: Run by KIWA Corporation (際コーポレーション); kitchen staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Opened 16 July 2005 (Tabelog). One of the many restaurant brands of KIWA Corporation (際コーポレーション), whose brand list links 柚子元 to this Pontocho shop only (official site). A December 2025 reviewer who has eaten here since it opened said the taste is unchanged.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: a small, cute townhouse in historic Pontocho where yuzu dishes and drinks soothe with their scent — "a drink at a fair price, and a full stomach" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Yuzu nabe; yuzu gyoza.

anecdotes.text: "The taste has remained unchanged since the opening!" — December 2025; the same regular noted mostly foreign customers in June 2026.
With one burner per table of four, a March 2026 diner advised ordering a pot each and not overcooking the sea bream.
An April 2026 visitor found the meal "just okay", the yuzu broth reminiscent of a Taiwanese sour-cabbage hot pot, while the yuzu dumplings were the highlight.
Steep stairs to the second floor worried a couple with knee trouble, though the staff were very pleasant — January 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kiwa-group.co.jp): 柚子元 先斗町、柚子を使った料理やお酒、歴史ある花街先斗町の京町家を改装した小さくてかわいらしい店、1階はカウンター、2階はお座敷、11:30〜14:00 L.O.・17:00〜22:00 (21:00 L.O.)、火曜定休、48席、個室あり、カード・QR・電子マネー可、禁煙、テイクアウト・UberEats、中京区先斗町四条上る鍋屋町212。メニュー (2025年3月、税込): 柚子鍋 (一人前、二人前より) 黒毛和牛柚子しゃぶ4,800円・海老と鯛柚子鍋3,300円・鯛柚子鍋3,000円・豚柚子鍋2,800円・鶏柚子鍋2,800円、柚子麺1,380〜1,800円、青柚子餃子・黄柚子餃子 (8ケ1,000円・6ケ750円・4ケ500円)、鯛油淋、鶏唐揚、柚子キャベツ、たたき胡瓜、柚子酒。食べログ: 中華料理・鍋・居酒屋、17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、火曜休み、席は2時間制、当日キャンセル・無断キャンセルは1人3,000円、サービス料あり、ベジタリアンメニューあり、2005年7月16日オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 豚柚子鍋、鯛の鍋、柚子餃子2種、締めの麺と雑炊、急な階段、外国からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering; book via Tabelog or phone; two-hour seating; tatami upstairs.

places.name: 先斗町 あさり (Pontocho Asari)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The house hot pot is soy-sauce based, and the menu includes tempura, sushi and fried eel rolls; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and there are yuba, nama-fu and vegetable obanzai, but obanzai such as eggplant in dashi are made with broth, and the hot pot holds pork, offal and clams (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 15:00–2:00, Saturday and Sunday 12:00–2:00, open every day (Tabelog). Bookings via Tabelog, even on the day; parties of two sit at the counter; large groups may be sent to an annex nearby (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). Courses with all-you-can-drink from about ¥5,000–6,000 (2025–26 reviews; Tabelog). A March 2026 reviewer was charged 10% service at night. 78 seats, private rooms for 6 to 30+, private hire for 20–50; heated-tobacco area only; cards, IC cards and QR payments (Tabelog). Second floor on Pontocho, about 1 min north of Shijo; 3 min from Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho alley, just north of Shijo (2F) — 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Casual izakaya for Kyoto vegetables, obanzai with yuba and nama-fu, Kyoto and Shiga sake, and hot pot (Tabelog) · house hot pot of pork, horumon, asari clams and vegetables in a soy-garlic broth, finished with zosui; also an asari-and-yuba hot pot (2025 reviews) · obanzai: fresh yuba sashimi, fried eggplant in dashi, Manganji peppers, simmered chicken, Kujo green onion, dashimaki tamago; sashimi, tempura, nigiri sushi, unagi-katsu roll (2025–26 reviews) · all-you-can-drink courses: obanzai and sushi, ¥6,000; Kyoto obanzai 10 dishes, ¥5,000 (Tabelog; March 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Pontocho, obanzai and hot pot until 2 am] A large, bright second-floor izakaya on Pontocho with Japanese umbrellas hanging from the ceiling, open from mid-afternoon (noon at weekends) to 2:00 every day: Kyoto obanzai like yuba sashimi and eggplant in dashi, a pork-offal-and-clam hot pot, and Kyoto and Shiga sake, mostly as all-you-can-drink courses (¥5,000–6,000). Easy to book even on the day. Reviews are mixed; many guests are tourists.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2022 (Tabelog). Per the operator’s Tabelog text: a casual izakaya for first-timers, with seasonal Kyoto vegetables, obanzai such as yuba and nama-fu, and local sake from Kyoto and Shiga.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai courses; asari and horumon hot pot.

anecdotes.text: A party of 11 got a last-minute Friday booking; the yuba was the highlight, the only downside bottled beer — June 2025.
A March 2025 diner found the dishes over-seasoned and the drinks hastily made.
A March 2026 reviewer reported a 10% night service charge, a clogged soy-sauce dispenser and staff who did not name the dishes.
A group of 15 that booked a "fully private room" was sent to another location and seated in a space other guests could enter — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 先斗町 あさり、居酒屋・もつ鍋・日本料理、中京区鍋屋町213 2F、四条先斗町から北へ徒歩約1分、月〜金 15:00〜2:00、土日 12:00〜2:00、年中無休、2名の予約はカウンター席、78席、個室あり、貸切20〜50人、加熱式たばこのみ喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2022年5月1日オープン、京野菜、湯葉や生麩のおばんざい、京都と滋賀の地酒、飲み放題付きおばんざいと握り寿司のコース6,000円、ベジタリアンメニューあり。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 生湯葉、もつ鍋 (豚、ホルモン、あさり、醤油ベース)、雑炊、飲み放題付き京のおばんざい10品コース5,000円、夜はサービス料10%、別館の個室、観光客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book on Tabelog; courses with all-you-can-drink are the easy order.

places.name: プチレストランないとう (Petit Restaurant Naitou)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the menu is built on breaded cutlets (tonkatsu, beef cutlet, ham cutlet, fried shrimp, croquettes), demi-glace stews and curry; no gluten information (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every main is pork, beef, seafood or chicken, and the salads carry house ham, bacon, meatloaf or pork (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Since September 2026: 13:00–21:00 straight through (last order 20:30); closed Monday (official site; November 2026 calendar). 13:00–16:00: one drink per person (coffee or tea after the meal counts), à la carte, plus the Naitou special plate until 15:00, ten a day; from 16:00: one drink and a seasonal otsukidashi ¥800 (table charge) (official site). The lunch set menu ended in August 2026; Tabelog still shows the old lunch/dinner split. Bookings preferred, by phone (official site). 25 seats with a 5-seat bar counter; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On Fuyacho-dori north of Oshikoji, 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho north of Oshikoji, south of the Imperial Palace — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal dishes and tonkatsu, à la carte (official site) · Naitou special plate (13:00–15:00, ten a day): fillet cutlet, hamburg steak, fried shrimp, pork-shabu salad, green salad, ¥2,900, or ¥3,500 with rice and tonjiru (official site, September 2026) · pork: loin tonkatsu, Gorgonzola fillet cutlet, ginger-and-shiso mille-feuille cutlet, quattro formaggi "pizza katsu" with honey, house ham cutlet and ham steak, tonteki · beef: wagyu hamburg steak, beef cutlet (¥3,300, August 2026), black-wagyu beef stew, tongue stew (winter) · seafood: shrimp-and-crab cream croquettes, kuruma-ebi fry, oyster fry (season), sea bream poêlée · wild sea bream curry, roast pork curry, tonkatsu jū (official menu) · a considered sake list, including a dry Shiga junmai ginjo (Tabelog; August 2026)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · south of the Imperial Palace, tonkatsu and seasonal plates] A small, red-carpeted western-style restaurant on Fuyacho run by its owner since 2001 (first an eight-seat counter in Kawaramachi-Sanjo): crisp tonkatsu and creative cutlets, a dense wagyu hamburg steak, beef cutlet and demi-glace stews. Since September 2026 it runs straight through 13:00–21:00 with a one-drink rule; before 15:00 try the Naitou plate (¥2,900, ten a day). Book by phone. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in 2001 as an eight-seat, four-tsubo counter at Kawaramachi-Sanjo, when the owner was 33; moved to Yanagibaba-dori south of the palace in 2004 and to Fuyacho-dori in 2019 (December 2019, per Tabelog). From September 2026 the lunch sets ended and the shop switched to straight-through hours. Tabelog Yoshoku WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Tonkatsu; wagyu hamburg steak; Naitou special plate.

anecdotes.text: Beef cutlet ¥3,300, Australian top sirloin cooked medium-rare, with a generous tonjiru — August 2026.
A July 2026 family party found the host adjusted the à la carte portions for sharing so it felt like a course.
A November 2026 diner paid over ¥4,000 for the plate set and a juice and found the hamburg steak firmer than hoped.
The room has a deep red carpet and curtains, wooden tables and European decorations: three tables for four, one for five and about four counter seats — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (petitrestaurant-naito.com): 季節の料理&とんかつのお店、2001年 河原町三条にカウンター8席4坪で開業 (33歳)、2004年 御所南・柳馬場通りに移転、2019年 御所南・麩屋町通りに移転、店主 内藤毅彦、2026年9月から通し営業 13時〜21時 (20時30分 L.O)、13時〜16時はワンドリンク制 (食後のコーヒー紅茶可)、16時からはワンドリンク制と季節のおつきだし800円 (テーブルチャージ)、ランチセットメニューは2026年8月末で終了、ご予約優先、定休日 月曜日、ないとうスペシャルプレート (1日10食、13時〜15時): ヒレトンカツ、ハンバーグ、エビフライ、豚しゃぶサラダ、グリーンサラダ、プレートのみ2,900円・ご飯と豚汁セット3,500円、メニュー: ロースとんかつ、ゴルゴンゾーラポークカツ、生姜と大葉のミルフィーユサンドカツ、ピザカツ、自家製ハムカツ、トンテキ、天然鯛のカレーライス、海老と蟹のクリームコロッケ、牡蠣フライ (季節)、和牛ハンバーグステーキ、黒毛和牛三角バラのビーフシチュー、中京区尾張町217 サンロータス池治1F。食べログ: 洋食・とんかつ・ハンバーグ、25席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、洋食 WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年11月、英語): ビーフカツ3,300円、ないとうプレート、豚汁、ハンバーグ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; one drink per person; ¥800 starter charge after 16:00.

places.name: 京菓子司 松寿軒 (Kyogashi Tsukasa Shojuken)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Mochi and bean-paste sweets such as botamochi and warabi mochi may suit, but the Mikasa is a small dorayaki (a baked batter cake) and the monaka has a wafer shell; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Bean-paste and mochi sweets such as botamochi, warabi mochi and monaka may suit, but the Mikasa batter and the other sweets have no published ingredient list (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: No fixed hours published. Tabelog (operator text): reservation-only, and "currently closed all day" for renovation while taking phone orders; seasonal fresh wagashi must be ordered by the day before; walk-in sales happen but booked orders come first and items sell out. Reviewers bought over the counter through November 2026, mostly between 11:00 and 15:00; a November 2026 reviewer says it opens at 11:00, not 10:00 as some sites say. Book by phone (075-561-4030) a day or more ahead. Cash only; non-smoking (Tabelog; June 2026). Room for about five inside (October 2026). On a narrow lane west of Yamato-oji on Matsubara-dori, near Kenninji; 6 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yumiya-cho, between Kenninji and Matsubara-dori — 6 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto wagashi maker supplying Kenninji and Kodaiji temples and Gion teahouses (Tabelog) · Mikasa, a small dorayaki with chunky bean paste, ¥180 · monaka filled to order, ¥180 · seasonal jō-namagashi ¥300–360, e.g. Ubatama, Ubazukuri, Tsubaki mochi, Wakaayu, Yamatsuto · botamochi (bean paste or kinako) ¥200, warabi mochi ¥350, doyō-mochi in high summer (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Kenninji, a temple supplier in a back lane] A tiny wagashi shop on a quiet lane by Kenninji, supplier to Kenninji and Kodaiji: the small dorayaki called Mikasa (¥180), a monaka filled after you order so the shell stays crisp (¥180), and seasonal fresh sweets from ¥300. Phone ahead — booked orders come first, and fresh sweets need a day's notice; walk-ins often find things sold out. Tabelog says it is under renovation and taking phone orders. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per the operator’s Tabelog text: founded in 1932; a favourite of Kenninji since its founding and, by reputation, also a supplier to Kodaiji; trusted by Gion teahouses. A March 2026 reviewer gives 2026 as its 94th year; a November 2026 reviewer gives the founding as 1927. Tabelog Japanese-sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026, Sweets WEST 2018–2020 and 2022, Sweets 2017.
chef_bio.specialty: Mikasa; monaka; seasonal jō-namagashi.

anecdotes.text: Without a booking at 11:30, a March 2026 visitor was told the Mikasa was not ready and came back at 14:30; dried sweets were given free.
Customers who came after a May 2026 reviewer without a booking found the products sold out.
"The monaka is filled with sweet red bean paste right after you order it" — February 2026.
A March 2026 reviewer heard the shop is a favourite of Kenninji and was patronised by Nene, wife of Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京菓子司 松寿軒、和菓子・どら焼き、東山区松原通大和大路西入弓矢町19-12、清水五条駅から徒歩6分、予約優先 (来店時は売り切れの場合あり)、現在は終日休業で改装中だが電話予約は可能、上生菓子は前日までに要連絡、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、1932年創業、建仁寺御用達、高台寺にも納める、祇園のお茶屋さん、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018〜2020・2022、スイーツ百名店 2017。口コミ (2026年2〜11月、英語): Mikasa (小さなどら焼き) 180円、注文後にあんを詰める最中180円、季節の上生菓子300〜360円、ぼたもち200円、わらび餅350円、土用餅、開店は11時、1927年創業とする口コミも。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone ahead to reserve sweets; small counter shop; cash only.

places.name: イタリアンビアパブ ICHI-YA (Italian Beer Pub Ichi-ya)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: a craft-beer pub (beer is barley or wheat) whose food includes zeppole (fried bread), croquettes, pizza and ravioli; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, October 2026; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, and olives, smoked nuts, sauerkraut, green salad, grilled black-soybean edamame and fries are on the menu, but nothing is marked vegan (Tabelog menu, October 2026).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday; 12:00–22:00 Saturday, Sunday and holidays (and on Tuesdays that are holidays); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Renovated and renamed from BEER PUB ICHI-YA, with a new, more food-led Italian menu (March 2026). Bookings taken; over 9 people by phone (Tabelog). An appetizer is served: one May 2026 reviewer calls it complimentary, another paid ¥300 each. 43 seats (counter, round tables, a large table, wall counter); non-smoking, with a smoking area outside; cards, e-money and QR; English menu and English-speaking staff; children welcome (Tabelog). 3 min walk north from exit 9 of Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 8 August 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Just north of Nishiki Market — 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Craft-beer pub of Ichijoji Brewery (Kyoto), now with an Italian menu (2025–26 reviews) · beers such as Ichijoji Belgian Wheat, Destroy Angel IPA, Terroir Kyoto Yuzu Weiss, golden ale and stout; 420 ml ¥990 (May 2026); tasting set of three beers and three small dishes ¥2,500 (¥2,200 in happy hour) (June 2026); a ¥4,000 course with all-you-can-drink, craft beer +¥500 (October 2026) · herb-marinated olives ¥440, smoked nuts ¥440, sauerkraut ¥550, Kyoto yuba potato salad ¥660, cured-meat platter ¥1,200, caprese with Sugiyama Milk Farm mozzarella ¥1,210 · baccalà croquettes ¥500, zeppole ¥500, black-soybean edamame ¥550, fries ¥660 · Choshu chicken in white wine ¥1,320, spare ribs stewed in Ichijoji beer ¥1,320, octopus in red wine ¥1,430, wagyu tagliata ¥1,800, salsiccia ¥1,320 (Tabelog menu, October 2026) · ravioli, panna cotta with bitter chocolate (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Craft beer & Italian · Nishiki, Ichijoji Brewery's pub] Ichijoji Brewery's taproom just north of Nishiki Market, renovated in 2026 with an Italian menu: beers from Belgian wheat to a yuzu weiss and an English-style IPA, then Kyoto yuba potato salad, spare ribs stewed in the brewery's own beer, octopus in red wine, wagyu tagliata. A three-beer, three-dish tasting set (¥2,500) is the easy way in. Reviewers like the beer and the panna cotta; two found the high chairs uncomfortable, and some found the prices on the high side. English menu. Open from noon at weekends; closed Tuesday.

roles: Pub of Ichijoji Brewery (Kyoto); no person is named
chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists the former name BEER PUB ICHI-YA; a March 2026 regular found it renovated, the menu much more food-led and the Red Ale gone. Reviewers describe it as the pub of Kyoto’s Ichijoji Brewery (December 2025; May 2026), and a November 2025 reviewer refers to a second location. Opened 8 August 2016 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Ichijoji Brewery craft beer; beer-stewed spare ribs; tasting set.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner liked the beers and a light Kyoto-style oden on the old menu but found the chairs uncomfortable.
A March 2026 regular found many international customers and a lively rather than quiet room after the renovation.
An October 2026 solo diner on the all-you-can-drink course wished the busy kitchen had paced the dishes more slowly.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビアバー・パブ・バル、旧店名 BEER PUB ICHI-YA、中京区御幸町通蛸薬師下る船屋町384 Casa INO’s 1F、阪急河原町駅9番出口から北へ徒歩3分、月・水・木・金 17:00〜22:00、土・日・祝 12:00〜22:00、火曜休み (祝日の火曜は営業)、予約可 (10名以上は電話)、43席、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、ベジタリアンメニューあり、2016年8月8日オープン、メニュー (英語版、2026年10月更新): オリーブ440円、燻製ナッツ440円、ザワークラウト550円、京湯葉のポテトサラダ660円、カプレーゼ1,210円、バッカラのコロッケ500円、ゼッポレ500円、黒枝豆550円、スペアリブの一乗寺ビール煮込み1,320円、タコの赤ワイン煮1,430円、和牛のタリアータ1,800円。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 一乗寺ブリュワリーのクラフトビール、2026年に改装しイタリアンのメニューに、飲み比べセット2,500円、パンナコッタ、ハイチェアが座りにくいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog).

places.name: うずら屋 京都・四条 (Uzura Ya Kyoto Shijo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Chicken sashimi comes with sesame oil, ponzu or yuzu pepper, and the grills and oyakodon use sauces and dashi; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken and quail house; grilled vegetables are on the menu, but the soup is chicken and the oyakodon uses dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00; Thursday 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Usually fully booked: book online through Pocket Concierge (Tabelog) or phone; walk-ins are sometimes offered a one-hour slot or a later time (August–September 2026). Serves chicken sashimi (raw and rare chicken: sasami, gizzard, white liver, heart, kombu-cured breast) (July–October 2026). 10 counter seats; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). On the east side of Kawabata-dori just north of Shijo, by the Kamo River; 122 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Kawabata-dori just north of Shijo, by the Kamo River — 2 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Chicken and quail at a 10-seat counter, grilled over charcoal and served off the skewer, cut into bite-size pieces on a plate (2026 reviews) · chicken sashimi platter: breast, gizzard, white liver, heart, kombu-cured breast; white liver sashimi with sesame oil; chicken-thigh tataki with yuzu pepper and ponzu (July–October 2026) · grills: grilled quail thigh, neck, thigh, tsukune with ginger, gizzard, back liver, Datchan (glandular stomach), ソレリス, red liver, white liver (sells out), sausage, wings, grilled green onion, Kamo eggplant two ways, grilled-vegetable salad, corn; grilled foie gras rice ball (2026 reviews) · caciocavallo wrapped in nori; jidori soup (can sell out); oyakodon in rich dashi to finish (2025–26 reviews) · sake including Aramasa and other Akita brewers, 花垣, 秋鹿 and 春鹿; lemon shochu highball (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Chicken · Shijo Kawabata, a 10-seat chicken counter by the Kamo River] A narrow ten-seat counter on Kawabata-dori just north of Shijo, where the master grills chicken and quail over charcoal and serves it off the skewer in bite-size pieces. Start with the chicken sashimi — white liver with sesame oil, heart, kombu-cured breast — or the rare thigh tataki; then quail thigh, gizzard, red liver and grilled vegetables such as Kamo eggplant; finish with an oyakodon soaked in dashi. Good sake, including Aramasa. Almost always full: book, or ask for an hour's slot. Bills ran about ¥6,000–15,000 a head in 2026. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Master (主) at the grill, with young staff (August 2026); not named
chef_bio.background: Per an August 2026 Japanese review: the master holds the grill at the far end of the long counter and young staff work briskly under the master’s direction; the cooking is not on skewers, and the heat is well managed; the staff came to call the reviewer, who had arrived early and was waiting by the Kamo River. A regular of ten years (January 2024) and others describe it as always booked. Tabelog Chicken "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken sashimi (white liver); thigh tataki; oyakodon.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular phoned at 17:56, was offered seats for one hour, and noticed many overseas visitors asking to come in without a booking.
An October 2026 diner ordered the grilled white liver, and the next guest was told it had sold out.
A May 2025 regular brought a cheesecake and asked the kitchen to recreate it; it might be added to the dessert menu.
A May 2026 diner found the counter a bit cramped for larger people, but the atmosphere inviting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鳥料理・焼き鳥、東山区川端通四条上ル東詰、祇園四条駅から122m、17:30〜22:00、木曜18:00〜22:00、水曜休み、予約可 (ポケットコンシェルジュで24時間)、10席 (カウンター)、禁煙、カード可、鳥料理百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年8月、日本語): 予約の数分前に着いて鴨川のそばで休んでいたらスタッフが呼びに来てくれた、長いカウンターの奥の主が陣取る焼き場、お通しはざく切りキャベツ、お造り盛り合わせ、みどりなす、ムネたたき、ささみわさび、うずらモモ焼、せせり、ずり、ソレリス、赤肝、つくね、地鶏のスープ、冷酒 秋鹿、燗酒 春鹿、串を打っていない、若いスタッフが主の指示のもとてきぱき働く。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 白レバーの刺身、もものたたき、親子丼、Aramasa、ほぼ満席。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (Pocket Concierge online, or by phone); chicken is served raw or rare in several dishes.

places.name: KYOTO STAR BAR
places.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail bar: drinks, kakigori with matcha, yuzu or fermented-milk syrups, smoked nuts and dried fruit; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, April 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The kakigori comes with matcha, yuzu and fermented-milk syrups (the last is dairy); smoked nuts and dried fruit are the only food (Tabelog menu, April 2026).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 (last drink order 23:00) every day, with irregular closures — check by phone or Google Maps on the day (Tabelog). In summer it is a kakigori shop by day (official site); a reviewer found it opening at 14:00 (August 2026). Table charge ¥2,200, waived before 19:00 (Tabelog; August 2026). Groups of three or more must book (Tabelog). Card and cashless payment only, no cash (Tabelog; September 2026). 12 seats (8 at the counter, one table for 4); fully non-smoking, no heated tobacco, ashtray outside; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). In an alley off Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, between Pontocho and Kiyamachi; 4 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 11 July 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Alley off Kiyamachi south of Sanjo — 4 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto shop of Ginza’s Star Bar, a bar built around ice: hand-cut clear ice and its own craft ice 洛氷 made from Kyoto spring waters under an ice-making licence (official site) · cocktails with Japanese flavours, e.g. Japanese Martini Matcha ¥2,300, Sakura Fubuki ¥2,300, Matcha Hopper, Yuzu Mule; cocktails about ¥2,000–3,000 (2026 reviews) · kakigori of 洛氷 shaved with a SWAN cygne machine, with matcha, yuzu and fermented-milk syrups served alongside, ¥2,500 (Tabelog menu, April 2026); matcha whisked at the counter and poured on (August 2026) · smoked mixed nuts ¥1,000, dried fruit ¥1,000 (Tabelog menu, April 2026) · non-alcoholic yuzu-ginger, tonic water (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bar & kakigori · Kiyamachi, Ginza's Star Bar in a Kyoto alley] The Kyoto branch of Ginza's Star Bar, down an alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho: a dim, Japanese-styled room with a tea set at its centre, where the kimono-clad master works alone. Everything turns on ice — hand-cut clear ice for highballs, and the bar's own 洛氷 from Kyoto spring water, shaved into kakigori (¥2,500) with matcha whisked at the counter or yuzu syrup. Come before 19:00 to skip the ¥2,200 table charge. Cocktails run ¥2,000–3,000. Cards only. One May 2026 visitor found the charge poor value and the staff absorbed in a computer.

roles: Owner (the invoice holder); a May 2026 review describes the master, in a kimono, managing everything solo
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a directly managed shop of STAR BAR GINZA in Ginza 1-chome, Tokyo. Per the official site: four STAR BAR shops (Ginza, Namiki, Kyoto, Hibiya Midtown); Star Bar made ice the star of the bar, uses three kinds of ice frozen in different ways, and the Kyoto shop makes craft ice (洛氷) from Kyoto spring waters under the only ice-making licence in Kyoto city; by day in summer the Kyoto shop is a kakigori shop. The invoice register lists an individual, 松田 高雅, for the Kyoto shop’s invoice number. Tabelog Bar "Tabelog 100" 2022. Opened 11 July 2016.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: hand-cut ice is pursued for function as well as beauty, down to water quality and the theory of freezing.
chef_bio.specialty: Kakigori of 洛氷; matcha cocktails; hand-cut ice.

anecdotes.text: "I had a delightful time with the master, who was dressed in a kimono." — May 2026.
An August 2026 visitor watched the owner grind matcha at the counter and pour it over the kakigori, and was told to add it gradually with a spoon.
A May 2026 visitor took part in a tea-ceremony experience at the counter.
A May 2026 visitor felt the ¥2,200 charge brought no service and found the staff engrossed in computer work.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (starbar.jp): ４店舗ある STAR BAR (銀座、並木、京都、日比谷ミッドタウン)、京都: 先斗町は京都の代表的な花街、氷雪製造許可を得て京都各所の銘水でクラフト氷【洛氷】を造る、夏の昼間はかき氷屋、夜のお酒のかき氷も名物、中京区木屋町通三条下る材木町185-5、氷を BAR の主役にした、凍り方の違う3種類の氷、京都市内で唯一の氷雪製造免許。食べログ: バー、STAR BAR GINZA の直営店、毎日 17:00〜24:00 (ドリンク L.O. 23:00)、不定休、カードのみ (キャッシュレス)、3名以上は要予約、チャージ2,200円、12席 (カウンター8、テーブル4)、全席禁煙、2016年7月11日オープン、バー百名店 2022、インボイス登録: 松田 高雅 (個人)、メニュー (英語版、2026年4月更新): 洛氷のかき氷2,500円 (抹茶、柚子、発酵乳のシロップ)、燻製ミックスナッツ1,000円、ドライフルーツ1,000円。口コミ (2026年5〜9月、英語): 着物のマスター、抹茶のかき氷、19時まではチャージなし、14時開店の日も、カクテル2,000〜3,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards only; ¥2,200 charge from 19:00; book for three or more.

places.name: koe donuts 京都店 (koe donuts Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat donut shop — the crullers use organic whole-wheat flour (September 2026) — fried in rice oil (September 2026); the morning plate is French toast (Tabelog menu, September 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The official site lists a plant-based dough among its donut types, but no ingredient list is published; the cruller uses Miyama milk and free-range eggs, and the dango donuts buttercream and chocolate (official site; Tabelog menu; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 8:00–20:00 every day; closed irregularly (Tabelog; official site). Morning plate 8:00–11:00, brunch plate 11:00–15:00, both limited each day (Tabelog menu). No reservations: find a seat first, then pay at the counter (November 2026). Popular items can sell out by evening (September 2026). 65 seats plus standing; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; free Wi-Fi and power outlets; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). On Shinkyogoku just north of Shijo, 1 min from exit 9 of Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (official site). Opened 21 March 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinkyogoku just north of Shijo — 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Donut factory-café of the koe brand, built on three keywords — organic, natural origin, local production (official site) · about 30 regular donuts across chewy koe, cruller, raw, yeast, old-fashioned, baked and plant-based doughs (official site): koe plain ¥260 (October 2026), a wasanbon cruller with organic whole-wheat flour and Miyama milk, almond-caramel yeast donut (September 2026) · eat-in "donut melt" with knife and fork: strawberry ¥1,100, crème brûlée ¥1,280 (November 2026) · seasonal dango donuts ¥380 (persimmon caramel, roast-sweet-potato cheesecake, hojicha chestnut Mont Blanc) and six-ball donut set ¥590 (Tabelog menu, September 2026); Halloween Chocolate Ghost ¥480 (October 2026) · French-toast morning plate with Miyama free-range eggs and Kyoto pork bacon ¥1,800 (8:00–11:00); breakfast set of coffee and a plain donut ¥500 (October 2026) · coffee ¥600, café latte ¥680 (October 2026)
places.notes: [Donuts & café · Shinkyogoku, organic donuts under bamboo baskets] A large donut factory-café a minute from Kawaramachi Station, under a dome of 572 traditional hexagon-weave bamboo baskets designed by Kengo Kuma's office. The koe brand fries its donuts in rice oil from organic and natural ingredients: try the plain koe donut (¥260) or the wasanbon cruller to take away, or sit down for a 'donut melt' eaten with knife and fork (from ¥1,100). Seasonal dango donuts change with the season. From 8:00 there's a French-toast morning plate, or a ¥500 coffee-and-donut set. Spacious, with Wi-Fi and outlets. Daily 8:00–20:00.

roles: koe brand café; Tabelog gives Stripe International’s PR department as the press contact; no person is named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: an experiential donut factory serving freshly made donuts with knife and fork; ingredients chosen by three keywords, organic, natural origin and local production, made by hand in the shop as far as possible. The interior by Kengo Kuma & Associates covers a dome with 572 traditional hexagon-weave (六ツ目編み) bamboo baskets using Arashiyama bamboo; artist Yu Nagaba designed the goods, with Shun Kawakami as brand and art director. Opened 21 March 2019 (Tabelog). Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "life happens, donut helps" — new donuts for a healthy and sustainable future, with care for the environment, ingredients and production.
chef_bio.specialty: koe plain donut; wasanbon cruller; donut melt.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor came back for a second try after finding everything sold out the night before.
An October 2026 visitor waited a while for the lunch set’s soup and salad, but found the donuts crisp, chewy and not greasy.
At 9:00 on an October 2026 weekday the café was quiet, with four other groups, all apparently from the West.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (donuts.koe.com): koe donuts は出来立てのドーナツをナイフ＆フォークスタイルで楽しむ体験型のドーナツファクトリー、「オーガニック」「天然由来」「地産地消」、約30種のドーナツ (もちもちコエドーナツ、クルーラー、生ドーナツ、イースト、オールドファッション、ベイクドーナツ、プラントベース)、イートイン限定のドーナツメルト、京都嵐山の竹を用いた六ツ目編みの竹かご572個のドーム、隈研吾建築都市設計事務所、アーティスト長場雄、シュンカワカミ、中京区新京極通四条上ル中之町557、8:00〜20:00、阪急京都河原町駅9番出口より徒歩約1分。食べログ: カフェ・ドーナツ・スイーツ、毎日 8:00〜20:00、不定休、予約不可、65席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、Wi-Fi・電源、2019年3月21日オープン、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025、メニュー (英語版、2026年9月更新): 団子ドーナツ380円、ドーナツボール6個590円、フレンチトーストのモーニングプレート1,800円。口コミ (2026年9〜11月、英語): コエドーナツ プレーン260円、和三盆のクルーラー、米油で揚げる、ドーナツメルト1,100円から、モーニングセット500円。

cultural_comfort.note: Take a seat first, then order and pay at the counter.

places.name: BOCCA del VINO (ボッカ・デル・ヴィーノ)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the dinner guide asks guests to mention allergies and foods they cannot eat for the omakase. Pasta is central (from ¥1,800 at lunch) and the dinner table charge includes bread; fried dishes include oysters and moroko (2025–2026 reviews; official dinner guide).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the official English dinner guide (March 2026) says the restaurant does not cater for vegans.
places.hours_raw: Official blog: lunch 12:00–16:00 (last order 15:00), à la carte, at least one dish per person, no café use for dessert or drinks only; dinner last order 21:00, closing 22:00; closing days on the blog calendar, sometimes changed at short notice. A May 2026 review lists lunch on Monday, Tuesday and Sunday and dinner Wednesday–Saturday; Tabelog lists dinner every day and lunch on Monday, Tuesday and Sunday, and says lunch was limited to Monday and Tuesday from late March 2025. Closed 30 December–1 January (Tabelog). Book by phone (075-585-8267, up to two months ahead) or by email; not through Auto Reserve. Dinner table charge ¥550 per person, bread included; omakase ¥8,800 (tax and table charge included), for groups only, booked by the day before, ¥4,400 per person for same-day cancellation (official dinner guide, March 2026). 12 seats; one table for two by the counter is exposed to the weather; no river view or terrace; no smoking; no large luggage; strollers folded; children by prior arrangement; smart casual, no strong fragrance (Tabelog; official blog). Cash, cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 5 min walk south along Kiyamachi from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 1 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Dango-bashi — 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Southern-Italian trattoria built around Italian wine (Tabelog; November 2025 review) · lunch à la carte: pasta from ¥1,800 (bluefin tuna and tomato, cacio e pepe, August 2025), an 11-item antipasto plate ¥800, artichoke aglio e olio ¥2,500 (May 2026); many dishes in half sizes (August 2026) · dinner from the blackboard: vegetable dishes from ¥2,000, meat from ¥2,500, pasta and risotto from ¥2,500 (May 2026); fried moroko, fried oysters with house tartar sauce, marinated mackerel, nanohana and anchovy pasta, sautéed venison, rum baba (February 2025); roast venison with persimmon sauce (October 2026) · omakase ¥8,800 for groups (official) · glass and bottle wines
places.notes: [Italian · Kiyamachi, a one-cook trattoria] A 12-seat Italian on Kiyamachi south of Dango-bashi, open here since May 2015, where the chef cooks alone and dishes come to share: tomatoes and olive oil in the southern way, blackboard antipasti, pasta, venison in winter, Italian wines by the glass and bottle. Lunch is à la carte (pasta from ¥1,800); dinner adds a ¥550 table charge with bread, or an ¥8,800 omakase for groups. The restaurant asks for no hurry, says it speaks no English and does not cater for vegans. Book ahead.

roles: Chef (unnamed) who cooks alone, per the official dinner guide
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction says the ristorante opened in May 2015 for enjoying Italian wines; the blog speaks of six years of irregular closing days "after the move" (March 2021). The official English dinner guide (March 2026) says the chef cooks alone, so dishes take time and are best shared, and the restaurant cannot serve guests in a hurry. A November 2025 review explains the name as "mouth of wine" and describes a Southern-Italian trattoria of tomatoes and olive oil that does not adapt to Kyoto styles, and calls it a Bib Gourmand selection, as does a May 2026 review. A February 2025 diner praised the service of a gentle madam; an October 2026 diner, the chef’s charming manner.
chef_bio.specialty: Blackboard antipasti; southern-Italian pasta; venison.

anecdotes.text: After a kabuki show at Minami-za, a diner booked for a course was steered to à la carte so as to catch the last train — December 2024.
Of the cacio e pepe: "it was indeed quite thick, just as the customer at the next table remarked, 'It’s like udon!'" — August 2025.
A February 2025 diner heard the maritozzo, popular during the pandemic, can be made if reserved in advance; the blog (March 2021) had limited it to breakfast.
"Personally, I especially loved the roasted venison! It was topped with a persimmon sauce." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式ブログ (bocca-del-vino.com): ランチ OPEN 12:00、ラストオーダー 15:00、CLOSE 16:00、お昼用のアラカルト、お一人様1品以上、ドルチェのみ・ドリンクのみのカフェ利用不可、ディナーはコース (要予約) とアラカルト、テラス席・川床なし、店内から鴨川・高瀬川は見えない、大きな荷物はご遠慮、ベビーカーは折り畳み、店舗前の駐輪禁止、下京区木屋町団栗橋下る斎藤町138-9 赤煉瓦造りの建物1階、電話予約がおすすめ (2カ月先まで)、オートリザーヴ不可、2021年3月: 移転後6年間不定休、マリトッツォは朝食限定。英語のディナー案内 (2026年3月更新): 英語不可・日本語メニューのみ、ヴィーガン不可、ピザなし、シェフひとりで調理、急ぎの客は不可、ディナーL.O. 21時・22時閉店、席料550円 (パン込み)、ひとり1品以上、おまかせ8,800円 (前日までに予約、グループのみ、当日キャンセル4,400円)、アレルギーは事前に。食べログ: イタリアン、12席、ディナー席料550円、禁煙、スマートカジュアル、2015年5月オープン、2025年3月下旬から月・火曜に限定してランチ。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年10月、英語): パスタランチ1,800円、前菜盛り合わせ800円、カルチョーフィのアーリオ・オーリオ2,500円、鹿のロースト、ラムババ、ビブグルマン。

cultural_comfort.note: The official English dinner guide says no English is spoken and the menu is Japanese only; change or cancel bookings by email. Mostly a blackboard menu.

places.name: 京都スタンド きよきよ 木屋町 (Kyoto Stand Kiyokiyo Kiyamachi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The food is daily obanzai and beef tongue simmered in Kyoto-style dashi (official site); seasonings are not described.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the obanzai change daily and reviewers describe them as dashi-flavoured; some include jako or herring (August 2026).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 14:00–22:30 (last order 22:00), closing days irregular; the official site says it opens at 14:00 for daytime drinking. Bookings taken (Tabelog). No service or cover charge (Tabelog; August 2026). 31 places: 15 at the counter and 4 tables; a standing bar, but reviewers found chairs at the counter (2026 reviews). Heated tobacco only (Tabelog; official site). Cards, IC and QR payments including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). At the end of a narrow passage on the ground floor of the FORUM木屋町先斗町ビル; 1 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Shijo — 1 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Standing bar for Kyoto sake and obanzai from 14:00, sister to the 京家きよみず izakaya (official site) · obanzai ¥300 each from a blackboard and large platters on the counter (October 2026): sansho potato salad with fried baby sardines, edamame and corn okara, eggplant with herring, jako and manganji peppers; three obanzai omakase ¥900 · the house beef tongue simmered long in Kyoto-style dashi ¥1,000 · pickled ginger between dishes, "the Kiyokiyo way" (official site) · about 20 Kyoto sakes from ¥400, three-sake tasting sets, a dice game (chinchiro) that can discount or double the price of a sake (August 2026) · draft beer ¥550, lemon sour ¥600, fruit chuhai with plenty of fruit pulp, house sansho gin soda (2026 reviews; official site)
places.notes: [Standing bar · Kiyamachi, sake from 2 pm] A bright standing bar at the end of a narrow passage off Kiyamachi, open from 14:00 every day: about 20 Kyoto sakes from ¥400 (roll the dice and a glass can be ¥100 off, double, or free), obanzai at ¥300 a dish chosen from platters on the counter, and beef tongue simmered in Kyoto dashi (¥1,000). No cover charge, and there are chairs at the counter. Opened in July 2018 by the company behind the 京家きよみず izakaya; two more Kiyokiyo stands are in Sanjo and Nijo. 14:00–22:30.

roles: Standing bar of the 京家きよみず group (company not named on the site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in July 2018 as a sister shop of the izakaya 京家きよみず, which has four shops in Kyoto, with a wide range of carefully chosen Kyoto sake and Kyoto food centred on obanzai; the house dishes are beef tongue simmered for a long time in Kyoto-style dashi and the daily obanzai, and pickled ginger is served between dishes. A second stand opened on the Sanjo shopping street and a third, BiVi二条, later (official site; Tabelog). Tabelog gives the opening day as 5 July 2018.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to let people enjoy Kyoto food culture more casually and more stylishly — for a daytime drink, a quick drink or a woman drinking alone.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai at ¥300; dashi-simmered beef tongue; Kyoto sake.

anecdotes.text: "When I tried it, I got a discount of JPY 100 on both drinks!" — of the sake dice game, August 2026.
An August 2026 diner got eggplant, a disliked vegetable, in the omakase obanzai, but praised the dashi-simmered beef tongue and noted signage "geared towards foreigners and tourists".
"As a Kyotoite, I found all the dishes to have a nostalgic sweetness." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoya-kiyomizu.com/kiyokiyo): 京都の立ち飲み・昼飲みにおすすめの「京都スタンド きよきよ」、祇園四条・河原町・木屋町・先斗町、京都に4店舗展開する人気居酒屋「京家きよみず」の姉妹店として木屋町は2018年7月にオープン、厳選された京の地酒、3種飲み比べ、おばんざいを中心とした京料理、果肉たっぷりのフルーツチューハイ、14時から営業、名物は京風のお出汁でじっくり炊く牛タン煮と日替わりの京おばんざい、箸休めにガリ、加熱式タバコのみ喫煙可、三条商店街と BiVi二条にも店舗。食べログ: 立ち飲み・居酒屋・日本料理、中京区木屋町通四条上ル鍋屋町220-1 FORUM木屋町先斗町ビル 1F、毎日14:00〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、不定休、予約可、サービス料・チャージ料なし、31席 (カウンター15、テーブル4)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、英語メニュー、2018年7月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): おばんざい各300円、おまかせ3品900円、牛タン煮1,000円、生ビール550円、レモンサワー600円、地酒400円から、チンチロ、山椒のポテトサラダ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); point at the obanzai on the counter; no cover charge.
