places.name: フルーツパーラーヤオイソ (Fruit Parlour Yaoiso)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The famous fruit sandwiches are on bread; parfaits, cut fruit, fruit kanten, kuzu-arare and juices are also on the menu (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Cut-fruit plates, fruit kanten and fresh juices are on the menu, but the sandwiches and parfaits use cream and vanilla ice cream (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: parlour 9:30–17:00 (last order 16:45); Tabelog gives every day 9:30–17:00 with last order 16:30. The fruit shop next door is open 9:00–18:00 all year except the New Year (official site). Seats cannot be booked; bookings are for takeaway only (Tabelog), and the listed phone number is the fruit shop’s (July 2025 review). A Saturday diner waited about 15 minutes at 13:00 (September 2026); morning visits found it nearly empty. 32 seats at tables and sofas; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog; September 2026). JCB and AMEX cards and IC cards, no QR (Tabelog). Next to Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Omiya — next to Hankyu Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Fruit parlour of a fruit shop founded in 1869, known for its fruit sandwiches (official site) · fruit sandwich with mixed juice ¥900, special sandwich set ¥1,100, ladies’ set (sandwich, mixed-juice float, house jelly) ¥1,000, royal fruit sandwich ¥1,100, seasonal fruit parfait ¥1,100, musk-melon parfait ¥1,100, cut fruit ¥1,100, fruit kanten ¥750, cream kuzu-arare ¥900 (official menu from April 2022, before tax; about ¥50 added from February 2025) · seasonal: peach sets ¥2,700 (August 2026), mango set ¥2,600 (September 2026), fig and strawberry sandwiches, Yamagata cherry parfait, hot cakes and crêpes with fruit · classic fruit parfait ¥1,045 (September 2026) · lemon squash with house lemon syrup ¥550 · sandwiches to take away (official site; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Fruit parlour · Shijo-Omiya, the fruit sandwich] The parlour of Yaoiso, a Shijo-Omiya fruit shop founded in 1869, which added a fruit parlour in 1972 and moved it into this room next door in 2013: soft cream (lightly sweet to some reviewers, quite sweet to one) and generous seasonal fruit in soft bread (a set with mixed juice about ¥900–1,000), parfaits, and set plates of peaches or mangoes in season. Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2026. One September 2026 diner found the fruit cut too small and the staff unfriendly. Daily 9:30–17:00; sandwiches also to take away.

roles: Parlour of the fruit shop Yaoiso (no owner named)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a fruit specialist founded in Meiji 2 (1869), selling gift fruit and household fruit, known for Okayama white peaches in the summer gift season and Saga Sagahonoka strawberries in winter; a fruit parlour was added in Showa 47 (1972), and its signature fruit sandwich is widely loved; a certified fruit-adviser shop, with a governor’s award as an old Kyoto business. A second shop with a parlour stands on Karasuma-dori north of Imadegawa, next to Doshisha University (official site). Tabelog gives the opening day of this parlour as 23 May 2013; a September 2026 review says it began on the second floor of the main shop in 1972 and moved here in 2013. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2022, 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Fruit sandwich; seasonal fruit parfaits.

anecdotes.text: A sign advises eating the sandwich quickly because the air conditioning dries the bread — August 2026.
A September 2026 diner found even strawberries and muscat grapes cut small in the ¥1,045 parfait and the staff "not particularly friendly".
"How do they do this?" — of the soft yet firm cream in the fruit sandwich, October 2026.
A November 2026 takeaway buyer got ice packs but no guidance on how long the sandwich keeps.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yaoiso.com): 創業明治2年の果物専門店、進物用の高級果物から家庭の果物まで、お中元時期の岡山直送の水蜜桃、お歳暮時期の佐賀のさがほのか苺、昭和47年にフルーツパーラーを併設、代表作「フルーツサンド」、フルーツアドバイザー認定店、京の老舗 知事賞受賞。本店 9:00〜18:00 年中無休 (年末年始を除く)、下京区四条大宮東入ル立中町488。パーラー 9:30〜17:00 (ラストオーダー 16:45)、立中町496。烏丸通今出川上ル東側 (同志社大学北隣) の店にもパーラー、10:00〜17:00、不定休。メニュー (2022年4月以降、税抜): フルーツサンドとミックスジュースのセット900円、スペシャルサンドのセット1,100円、ミニパフェセット1,250円、ロイヤルフルーツサンド1,100円、季節のフルーツパフェ1,100円、クリーム葛あられ900円、カットフルーツ1,100円、レディースセット1,000円、フルーツ寒天750円、マスクメロンパフェ1,100円、持ち帰りのフルーツサンド750円など。2025年2月から税抜50円程度の値上げ。レモンスカッシュ550円 (税込)、山形さくらんぼパフェ (四条大宮店のみ)。食べログ: フルーツパーラー・カフェ、立中町496、毎日9:30〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、予約はテイクアウトのみ、32席、禁煙、子供可、カード (JCB、AMEX)・電子マネー可、2013年5月23日オープン、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2022・2023・2026。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年11月、英語): 桃づくし2,700円、マンゴーづくし2,600円、定番のフルーツパフェ1,045円、ミックスジュース、スペシャルフルーツサンド。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the table from a set menu of sandwiches, parfaits and juices; seats cannot be booked.

places.name: 酒場 井倉木材 (Sakaba Ikura Mokuzai)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information and no printed sake menu; dishes include chicken-skin gyoza, mentaiko mochi, karinto with cream-cheese dip and conger-eel tempura alongside sashimi and charcoal-grilled fish (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The food is mostly fish and seafood; cucumber dishes and potato salad are on the menu, but nothing is said about their dressings (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Monday–Saturday 17:00–22:00 (last seating and last order 21:00), closed Sundays and public holidays; hours may change. No reservations: queues form before 17:00 (about ten people at 16:30 in June 2026); in December 2025 a regular came an hour before opening for the winter crab; later in the evening there may be no wait, but dishes sell out (2025–2026 reviews). Up to three people at the counter; groups of four or more go to the outdoor tables in the lumber yard (June 2026). Counter seats non-smoking; smoking allowed in the yard seats (Tabelog). Cash only (no cards, e-money or QR) (Tabelog). No telephone (Serai 2017). About 15 min walk from Imadegawa or Marutamachi stations (June 2026).
places.neighborhood: Kamigyo, near the Horikawa shopping street — about 15 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Standing bar in a working lumber yard: seasonal fish and drinking snacks that regulars rank with kappo cooking (Serai 2017; Tabelog) · salt-seared bonito tataki, flamed outside, with mustard ¥1,500; bluefin tuna and myoga roll ¥1,200; tuna sashimi ¥1,200; grilled hamo ¥1,800; very large rock oyster ¥2,500 (June 2026) · potato salad ¥90 (October 2026), chicken-skin gyoza, mentaiko mochi ¥450, cucumber dishes ¥500, karinto with cream-cheese dip ¥600, shuto with cream cheese, natto omelette, dried fish, charcoal-grilled pork belly and bacon, frozen crab-miso ruibe, conger eel in hot pot and tempura (2026 reviews) · a giant crab from mid-November to the end of December · Kyoto and rare sake told out loud, Heartland draft, original highball, jabara sake soda
places.notes: [Standing bar · Kamigyo, a lumber yard at night] By day a family lumber yard, by night a standing bar: the fourth-generation 井倉康博 turned a three-tatami office into a counter and the car park into tables (Serai 2017). Salt-seared bonito flamed outside (¥1,500), tuna and myoga rolls, grilled hamo, a ¥90 potato salad, and sake recommended out loud. A queue forms before 17:00, and the giant crab of November–December draws longer ones; popular dishes sell out. Tachinomi Tabelog 100 2025. Cash only, no bookings; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00.

roles: Owner (fourth generation of the family lumber business), per Serai 2017
chef_bio.background: Serai (5 October 2017): as the name says, the family has long made its living in the lumber trade; the fourth generation, 井倉康博 (then 40), could not give up a dream of running a restaurant, and five years earlier had opened a night-only standing bar while carrying on the family business, turning a three-tatami office into the counter and the car park into the shop; seven or eight people fit inside, and drinking outside in the autumn wind is part of the fun. Serai then listed house oil sardines (made only when large sardines come in), crab-miso ruibe ¥800, sake from ¥600 a gō, and closing on Sundays and holidays. A September 2026 diner heard that the lumber business, once run by the owner’s father, is no longer very active and the bar is now the main focus. Tabelog tachinomi "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Salt-seared bonito tataki; grilled hamo; winter crab.

anecdotes.text: "Don’t underestimate it because it’s a standing bar" — what regulars say, per Serai (2017).
The bonito "was cooked with flames roaring!" — October 2026.
"As for the Japanese sake, there wasn't a menu; they just explained the brands verbally." — August 2026.
An October 2026 diner ended up chatting and sharing dishes with the people at the same table.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: サライ (2017年10月5日): 酒場 井倉木材、京都市上京区、旨いものを知り尽くした客が集う立ち飲み店、かにみそのルイべ800円、自家製オイルサーディン700円 (大羽の鰯が入ったときだけ)、日本酒は1合600円〜、「立ち飲みと侮るな」と常連、ポテトサラダやするめ天、割烹にも引けをとらない旬の味、新鮮な鰹やウニは造り、肉厚しいたけは炭焼き、本来は材木業を生業としてきた家、4代目の井倉康博さん (40歳) が家業を継ぎながら5年前に夜だけの立ち飲み屋を開店、3畳の事務所を改装してカウンターに、駐車場を店舗に、店内は7〜8名、薮之内町77-1、電話なし、17時〜22時30分 (最終注文)、日曜・祝日休み。食べログ: 立ち飲み、月〜土 17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00、最終入店21:00)、日・祝休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンターは禁煙、倉庫の席は喫煙可、立ち飲み 百名店 2025。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 鰹の塩たたき1,500円、本マグロとみょうがの巻き1,200円、鱧の焼き霜1,800円、ポテトサラダ90円、鶏皮餃子、冬の大きな蟹、開店前の行列。

cultural_comfort.note: No sake menu — the staff name the brands out loud; queue before opening, cash only, no bookings.

places.name: Bar 凛ト (Bar Rinto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail and whisky bar with some snacks; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks-first bar; no information on the snacks (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–2:00 every day; closed only on 1 January (Tabelog). Reservations taken; busy lately, so booking is advised, though walk-ins happen (Tabelog; March 2025). 20 seats: a 9-seat counter facing the river window, tables and a private room for 6; smoking allowed (Tabelog), and a non-smoker found the basement smoky (April 2025). Cards and QR payments (Tabelog). Cocktails about ¥1,600 (June 2026). Basement of a Pontocho building: look for the white noren and lantern, then take the stairs down (March 2025). 1 min from Gion-Shijo or Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, just north of Shijo — 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Authentic bar with a long counter and a window onto the Kamo River (2025–2026 reviews) · "Nise Denki Bran", a brandy drink from the novels of Tomihiko Morimi (March, June, July 2026) · original cocktails, some with the bar's own tea liqueur, e.g. the "Gion" (2025–2026 reviews) · classics: rye whiskey and soda, gin and tonic with a choice of gin, Orange Blossom, XYZ, fresh strawberry cocktail, cocktails made to your taste · a Kyoto gin ("Kino Mi" in a March 2025 review), Laphroaig and other whisky, cigars · snacks · cocktails about ¥1,600 (June 2026)
places.notes: [Bar · Pontocho, a basement counter with a Kamo River view] Under a white noren on Pontocho, stairs lead down to a long counter whose back bar faces a window onto the Kamo River — snow, cherry blossoms and, in the distance, the lights of Minami-za, depending on the night. The bar is known for "Nise Denki Bran", the fake brandy drink from Tomihiko Morimi's Kyoto novels; there are original cocktails with a house tea liqueur, the classics, whisky and cigars. Cocktails about ¥1,600. Open nightly 17:00–2:00, which makes it a late stop when Pontocho closes. Smoking allowed. A March 2025 visitor found the bartender fluent in English.

roles: Master and bartenders (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: A July 2026 reviewer learned that it is a sister bar of a bar called Nostalgia.
chef_bio.specialty: Nise Denki Bran; original cocktails with tea liqueur.

anecdotes.text: On a night of heavy snow in February 2026, a regular watched couples building snowmen on the Kamo riverbank from the counter, over a rye and soda and a gin and tonic.
"While there seemed to be many inbound customers, the bartender was fluent in English and very pleasant" — March 2025.
An April 2026 group came after dinner during cherry-blossom season and saw the blossoms along the Kamo River and, in the distance, the lights of Minami-za.
An April 2025 non-smoker found the basement smoke overwhelming, while noting the authentic atmosphere suits smokers.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Bar 凛ト、バー、中京区先斗町四条上ル柏屋町173-2 B1F、祇園四条駅4番出口・河原町駅1A出口から徒歩1分、毎日17:00〜2:00、1月1日のみ休み、予約可、20席 (カウンター9)、個室 (6人)、喫煙可、カード・QR 可、無料 Wi-Fi、景色・夜景。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 先斗町の白い暖簾と提灯、階段を下りる、鴨川の見える窓とカウンター、Tomihiko Morimi の小説に出てくる「Nise Denki Bran」、自家製のお茶のリキュールのカクテル、カクテル約1,600円、英語が流暢なバーテンダー、Nostalgia の姉妹店。

cultural_comfort.note: A bartender fluent in English (March 2025); cards and QR payments; smoking allowed.

places.name: 和彩たか (Wasai Taka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Fish izakaya cooking with sashimi and soy sauce, kara-age, tempura, croquettes and udon; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish izakaya; the buri shabu, sashimi and most small dishes are fish or meat, and yuba tofu comes in a dashi sauce (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 16:00–1:00 (last order 0:30); closed Tuesday, but open on a Tuesday before a public holiday (Tabelog). Reservations taken, including Tabelog course bookings (January 2026). An appetizer (otoshi) is served and charged; it changes each time (Tabelog). 18 seats, counter and tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards, iD, QUICPay and PayPay accepted (Tabelog). On the Takase River side of Kiyamachi, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2024).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi by the Takase River, north of Shijo — 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Fish izakaya with a wide sake and shochu list (Tabelog; 2025 reviews) · white-shrimp kara-age, the regulars' must-order · sashimi of the day, e.g. bluefin tuna, sea bream, swordfish, red and white shrimp, kawahagi · buri shabu-shabu, finished with Himi udon · course with buri shabu ¥5,000, all-you-can-drink +¥2,000 (January 2026) · Quick Drink Set of house appetizers (August 2024, January 2025) · hamo carpaccio in summer, yuba tofu with sauce, nama-fu dengaku, kombu-cured fish, sanma namerou, crab cream croquette with crab-miso sauce, fried oysters, sukiyaki, rice with raw egg and grilled mentaiko · a regular from Kanazawa comes for Hokuriku fish such as yellowtail and sweet shrimp (October 2025)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi, buri shabu and white shrimp until 1 a.m.] A fish izakaya on the Takase River side of Kiyamachi with a handsome frontage, a counter for solo drinkers and a good sake and shochu list. Regulars never skip the white-shrimp kara-age; the other star is buri shabu-shabu, finished with Himi udon, and the ¥5,000 buri shabu course (all-you-can-drink +¥2,000, January 2026) is good value. The day's sashimi, hamo carpaccio in summer and yuba tofu round it out. One February 2025 diner found the menu narrow and portions small. Open 16:00–1:00, closed Tuesday; an otoshi is charged; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists an invoice number for the operator but no name. A regular has eaten here six times between March and August 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: White-shrimp kara-age; buri shabu-shabu.

anecdotes.text: "The fried white shrimp was consistently good, so I ordered a second helping." — May 2025.
A November 2024 first-timer on the buri shabu course with all-you-can-drink asked whether a bone cracker could be made, and was given one on the house.
A February 2025 diner liked the crab cream croquette but found the menu limited, the portions small, and the reserved counter seat changed to a table.
"As I am from Kanazawa, this is a place I often visit when I want to enjoy sashimi." — October 2025.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seats suit solo diners; an otoshi is charged; smoking allowed.

places.name: SPICE GATE
places.gf_detail: Ask. Spice curries on basmati or long-grain rice, but the monthly specials often add katsu (pork or salmon) and the menu includes hayashi rice; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The reviewed curries are meat or fish (mutton, katsu, salmon) and one special uses dashi; no vegan curry is named (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:30–11:00 (last order); lunch to dinner 11:30–21:00 (last order); Thursday 11:30–15:00 only after breakfast; no regular closing day; spices can be bought at any time (official site). Tabelog adds that curry is served through the café hours and that hours may change, announced on Instagram. No reservations (Tabelog). 22 seats (8 counter, 14 table); non-smoking; cards, IC cards and QR payments (Tabelog). Second floor, up a white spiral staircase (October 2026), on Teramachi south of Bukkoji; 5 min from Kawaramachi Stn; no bicycle parking (Tabelog). Opened 12 May 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi-dori south of Bukkoji — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Spice shop and curry café: spice curries on basmati rice, chai, spice sweets and drinks; make your own garam masala in the shop (official site) · breakfast of a choice of three curries with side dishes, from 7:30 (official site; October 2026) · regular curries ¥1,300–1,500, large katsu curry about ¥1,800 (September 2026) · monthly specials: dashi curry katsu don ¥1,680 (September 2026), salmon rare-katsu curry large ¥1,980, with tomato curry, white curry, dill butter and salmon roe (October–November 2026) · bone-in mutton curry ¥1,580 (November 2026) · hayashi rice, small ¥1,430 (October 2026) · craft cola ¥500, lemongrass sour (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Curry · Teramachi, a spice shop that serves curry from breakfast] Up a white spiral staircase on Teramachi, a "curry & spice select shop": shelves of spices to smell and buy (you can blend your own garam masala) and a counter serving spice curry on basmati rice from 7:30 in the morning. Regular curries run ¥1,300–1,500, with a monthly special such as a salmon rare-katsu curry (¥1,980 large) or a dashi curry katsu don; finish with a craft cola or a lemongrass sour. Most reviewers find the spicing aromatic rather than hot (the bone-in mutton curry has more kick). Listed on the same website as the biryani shop INDIA GATE. Open every day; Thursday until 15:00.

roles: Run alongside INDIA GATE (official site); no staff named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: SPICE GATE grew from the wish to make spices feel closer to everyday life — a little spice added to Japanese food, home cooking or tea — with organic and unusual spices; it aims to be "the Village Vanguard of spices". The site lists it with INDIA GATE (biryani and curry, Tenjinyama-cho). Tabelog Curry WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to suggest easy, everyday ways to use and buy spices.
chef_bio.specialty: Spice curry on basmati rice; monthly special curries.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor found the September dashi curry katsu don, topped with a mildly spicy sweet-vinegar sauce, a combination never met before and delicious to the last bite.
An October 2026 diner noted that the large size comes with 230 g of rice mixing basmati and Japonica, and judged the value modest.
An October 2026 breakfast visitor chose from three curries served with Thai rice and several side dishes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (spicegate.jp): SPICE GATE (スパイスゲート)、「スパイスをもっと身近に感じてほしい」、朝7:30からバスマティライスのスパイスカレー、チャイ、スパイスのスイーツやお酒、自分だけのガラムマサラ作り、スパイス界のビレッジバンガード、朝定食7:30〜11:00 (L.O)、ランチ〜ディナー11:30〜21:00 (L.O)、木曜のみ11:30〜15:00、定休日なし、下京区寺町通仏光寺下る恵美須之町546番地1 しきさい寺町ビル2F、INDIA GATE (ビリヤニ・カレー、中京区天神山町271)。食べログ: カレー・カフェ・アジア・エスニック、予約不可、22席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2022年5月12日オープン、カレー WEST 百名店 2024・2026。口コミ (2026年9〜11月、英語): カレー1,300〜1,500円、出汁カレーかつ丼1,680円、サーモンのレアかつカレー大盛り1,980円、骨付きマトンカレー1,580円、ハヤシライス1,430円、クラフトコーラ500円、レモングラスサワー、白いらせん階段。

cultural_comfort.note: No reservations; cards and QR payments.

places.name: 京都 ネーゼ (Kyoto Neze)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta is the heart of the menu (carbonara, capellini, bolognese), with baguette, gratin and croquette-style dishes; grilled pork, prosciutto and smoked chicken are also served; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Most dishes use egg, cheese, ham, seafood or meat (the signature carbonara uses five egg yolks); seasonal vegetable pasta appears, but no vegan dish is named (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00, Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday and irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations taken, same day possible (Tabelog; March 2026). Mostly à la carte; an omakase course with a reservation by the day before — ¥6,000 in one Tabelog note, "from ¥8,800" in another (Tabelog; July 2026). 16 seats (8 counter, 8 table); non-smoking; cards accepted (Tabelog). Third floor, the third building north of Sanjo on Kiyamachi; 3 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 20 August 2007 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi just north of Sanjo — 3 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Couple-run Italian with a daily-changing menu, mostly à la carte (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · carbonara with Yamada Farm eggs, five yolks and no cream, the signature · cold capellini with sea urchin sauce and soil-grown green onions · prosciutto you slice yourself on the shop's machine · lightly smoked Omi chicken offal, served on a perforated dish over cherry chips · ayu spring rolls from the teppan, mushroom gratin, oysters in season · Fuji "phantom" pork, grilled · pastas such as Neapolitan, bolognese, shirasu, white asparagus, dashi peperoncino · baguette from Akane BAKERY in Nishijin · tiramisu, crème brûlée, gelato · Italian wine (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Sanjo Kiyamachi, a couple's third-floor trattoria] A sixteen-seat Italian on the third floor, three buildings up Kiyamachi from Sanjo, run since 2007 by chef Hiroshi Mori and the chef’s wife. The menu changes almost daily and is mostly à la carte: the must-order is the carbonara made with five Yamada Farm egg yolks and no cream; the cold sea-urchin capellini and the prosciutto you slice yourself on an Italian machine come close behind. Sit at the counter to talk with the chef. Around ¥8,000–15,000 a head with wine. Open 18:00–23:00, closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Hiroshi Mori (romaji from Tabelog's introduction; the kanji is not in a source)
roles: Chef (Tabelog: "Chef Hiroshi Mori ... runs this restaurant")
Runs the shop with the chef's wife (September 2026 review: "the owner's wife"; February and March 2026 reviews: run by a couple)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog's introduction: chef Hiroshi Mori previously worked at Santa Maria Novella Tisaneria; the menu changes almost daily, so tell the shop what you would like when booking. Tabelog gives the opening as 20 August 2007. Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023 and 2025. The chef keeps a blog on Ameba (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Yamada Farm egg carbonara; sea-urchin capellini; self-sliced prosciutto.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor who came for the carbonara was invited to slice prosciutto on the machine before the meal — a first, and "thin and fluffy".
A July 2026 diner at the counter learned from the chef that the green onions on the sea-urchin capellini come from one of the few Aichi farms still growing them in soil.
Two older first-timers in September 2026 found the owner curious about how the pair had found the place, and the owner’s wife recommended the wine.
"It's a go-to spot when I want to drink a little more or enjoy a delicious pasta dish to wrap up the night." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都 ネーゼ、イタリアン、中京区三条木屋町上ル三軒目 三条木屋町ビルⅡ 3F、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、月〜土 18:00〜23:00、日曜・不定休、予約可、16席 (カウンター8、テーブル8)、禁煙、カード可、2007年8月20日オープン、メインはアラカルト、前日までの予約でコース (6,000円、別の欄では8,800円から)、シェフのブログ (アメブロ)、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2025。店の紹介 (英訳): Santa Maria Novella Tisaneria にいたシェフ Hiroshi Mori、メニューはほぼ毎日替わる、鶏の内臓の燻製、生ハムを自分で切れる。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営む、Yamada Farm の卵黄5個のカルボナーラ、ウニの冷製カッペリーニ、Akane BAKERY のバゲット。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seats face the chef; book ahead, same day often possible.

places.name: 京のむすびめ (Kyo no Musubime)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai and izakaya plates seasoned with dashi, soy sauce and miso, plus spring rolls and fried chicken wings; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the menu centres on fish, sea urchin, chicken and seasonal obanzai, and no vegan dish is named (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30), every day; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, confirmed by a call from the shop; booking recommended (July 2026), though walk-ins at opening and later have found seats (July and November 2026). Fresh sea urchin "at cost" needs a reservation (Tabelog). Courses for groups: 7 dishes ¥4,400 (3–16 people) or 9 dishes ¥5,500 (2–16) (Tabelog). A ¥330 charge per person (Tabelog, original text "330"). 20 seats at a counter and a few tables (25 standing); smoking allowed (Tabelog; February 2026). Cards, QUICPay, PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Ground floor of ランブラス館, just off Kiyamachi; 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo (Keihan) and Kawaramachi (Hankyu) stations (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 15 June 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Just off Kiyamachi south of Shijo — 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Home-style Kyoto izakaya of obanzai and seasonal dishes with Kyoto vegetables and fish, cooked in an open kitchen (Tabelog shop text) · obanzai of the day such as eggplant ohitashi and potato salad (November 2026) · scallop potato salad, assorted sashimi, mentaiko chicken wings (May 2026); hamo sashimi (July 2026); meat spring rolls with Saikyo-miso sauce (September 2026); an egg rice to finish (June 2026); warabi mochi (September 2026) · fresh sea urchin at cost, by reservation (Tabelog) · Kyoto sake, with a wide range of Tamagawa from Kinoshita Sake Brewery (Tabelog shop text); umeshu, beer
places.notes: [Obanzai izakaya · Kiyamachi, Kyoto home cooking late] A small counter izakaya just off Kiyamachi, open until midnight, where an open kitchen turns out Kyoto obanzai — eggplant ohitashi, potato salad — and seasonal plates: hamo sashimi in summer, scallop potato salad, mentaiko chicken wings, Saikyo-miso spring rolls, and an egg rice to finish. Local sake, with a deep list of Tamagawa. Reviewers single out friendly, attentive staff who explain the dishes and suggest sake off the list. Courses ¥4,400–5,500 for groups; book ahead. Smoking allowed.

roles: Owner and kitchen staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: a home-style Kyoto izakaya of seasonal ingredients and local produce, Kyoto vegetables and fish, with an open kitchen visible from every seat; courses use ingredients chosen by the owner. Opened 15 June 2015 (Tabelog). A July 2026 reviewer found two women working in the kitchen; reviewers in 2026 describe staff who explain the ingredients and recommend sake not on the menu.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Tabelog shop text: a place built on connections between people and food.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai; seasonal sashimi; egg rice.

anecdotes.text: "The two women in the kitchen were busy but provided excellent service, and I left the restaurant feeling very satisfied." — July 2026.
"While I was contemplating the menu, the staff casually approached me and offered assistance." — February 2026.
"They even prepared a special dish with eggplant that wasn’t on the menu." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 居酒屋・日本料理・ダイニングバー、下京区和泉屋町160 ランブラス館1F、京阪四条駅・阪急河原町駅から徒歩7分、17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、不定休、予約可 (店からの電話で確定)、京のむすびめコース7品4,400円、特選コース9品5,500円、生ウニを原価で (要予約)、サービス料330円、20席 (立ち25)、喫煙可、カード・QUICPay・PayPay・Alipay 可、英語メニューあり、2015年6月15日オープン、店舗紹介: 京野菜と魚の旬のおばんざい、オープンキッチン、京都の Kinoshita Sake Brewery の Tamagawa。口コミ (2026年2〜11月、英語): ホタテのポテトサラダ、刺身の盛り合わせ、明太子の手羽先、鱧の刺身、肉の春巻き 西京味噌のソース、締めの卵ご飯、わらび餅、気さくな店員、厨房に女性2人。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; staff explain dishes and suggest sake; smoking allowed; cards accepted.

places.name: 京冰菓 あてなるもの (Kyo Hyoka Atenaru Mono)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Shaved ice of pure ice with homemade syrups and toppings such as dried fruit, sweet-potato dumplings and chips, and condensed-milk ice; no ingredient or gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Some kakigori use condensed milk or cheese; fruit syrups and the four "refreshing drinks" may suit, but ingredients are not published (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Seasonal: the 2026 season ran 29 April to 30 September, Wednesday to Sunday 13:00–20:30 (last order 20:00), closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). A reviewer had yudofu and sake here in February 2026, so there may be winter service, but no off-season hours are published. Reservations accepted (Tabelog; August 2026). One order per person; tables are shared (Tabelog). 14 places: two tables for four and a standing counter for six (Tabelog). All seats face the Kamo River (October 2025). Cards, e-money and most QR payments (Tabelog). English menu with photos; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). At the back of a leather goods shop (ノーノーイエス京都店); 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 1 and Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn exit 1B (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 15 May 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Behind a leather shop on the Kamo River south of Shijo — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kakigori of pure ice made from natural ice, shaved fluffy, with homemade syrups (Tabelog shop text) · about ¥2,000 each, large enough to share (2025 reviews): peach and pink grapefruit over condensed-milk ice with dried fruit (August 2025); Kyoto sweet potato with Beni Haruka syrup, sweet-potato dumplings and chips (October 2025); tomato, cheese and basil (September 2026); a fruit kakigori brought back from 2025 (August 2026) · four "refreshing drinks" and seasonal drinks with homemade syrups (Tabelog shop text) · yudofu ¥1,000 and sake ¥1,500 (February 2026) · a leather coaster as a gift with kakigori or a drink (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kakigori · Shijo Kamo River, a summer counter behind a leather shop] Walk through a leather goods shop south of Shijo to find a bar-like room where every seat looks over the Kamo River: summer kakigori of pure natural ice, shaved fluffy and dressed with homemade syrups in unusual pairings — Kyoto sweet potato with dumplings, peach with pink grapefruit, even tomato, cheese and basil — about ¥2,000 each and big enough to share. You get a leather coaster with your order. Seasonal: 2026 ran from late April to the end of September, Wednesday to Sunday from 13:00.

roles: Staff of the leather shop’s café (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: a stylish hideaway with an open view of the Kamo River, fluffy shaved ice of pure ice made from natural ice, four refreshing drinks and seasonal drinks with homemade syrups. Opened 15 May 2024; the 2026 season ran 29 April to 30 September (Tabelog). An August 2025 reviewer understood the shop to sell leather goods and serve kakigori only in summer; a February 2026 reviewer was served yudofu and sake there.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kakigori with homemade syrups.

anecdotes.text: "It's a café located behind a store that sells leather jackets. There are posters at the entrance, but you wouldn't expect to find a café tucked away in the back." — September 2025.
"The tomato, cheese, and basil shaved ice was innovative yet delicious. Rather than tasting like pizza, it had a subtle sweetness from the syrup." — September 2026.
"I was very curious about the business model behind charging JPY 1,000 for this yudofu." — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): かき氷・スイーツ・甘味処、下京区和泉屋町162 ノーノーイエス京都店、京阪祇園四条駅1番出口・阪急京都河原町駅1B出口から徒歩5分、水〜日 13:00〜20:30 (L.O. 20:00)、月・火休み、2026年4月29日〜9月30日の季節営業、予約可、1人1品以上、相席、14席 (4人掛けテーブル2、立ち席6)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語メニュー・写真メニューあり、子供・ベビーカー可、2024年5月15日オープン、店舗紹介: 天然氷から作る純氷のふわふわのかき氷、鴨川の眺め、4種のドリンクと自家製シロップの季節のドリンク。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): かき氷2,000円ほど、桃とピンクグレープフルーツ、京都のさつまいも (Beni Haruka)、トマト・チーズ・バジル、革のコースターのプレゼント、革製品の店の奥、湯豆腐1,000円 (2026年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with photos; order at the counter; one item each; shared tables.

places.name: ベルアメール 京都別邸 三条本店 (Bel Amer Kyoto Bettei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Bonbons and stick chocolates are sold alongside cakes, choux, quiche, sandwiches and pasta in the café; no gluten information is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Many chocolates and desserts use milk, white chocolate, cream or custard; ingredients for individual chocolates are not listed on the shop pages read (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–20:00 (last order 19:30), closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Ground floor: chocolate shop; first floor up: Chocolat Bar café (official site). Only the afternoon tea set can be booked, by form (official site); Tabelog lists no reservations, and an October 2026 visitor found the café full and took chocolates away instead. 24 seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). No parking or bicycle parking (official site). In a townhouse over 100 years old on Sanjo-dori east of Sakaimachi; 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). A second Kyoto Bettei shop is a counter in JR京都伊勢丹 B1F (official site). Opened 11 September 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-dori east of Sakaimachi — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Chocolate brand from Kyoto using Japanese ingredients, techniques and seasons, born from Chocolat Bel Amer (official site; October 2026) · shop: Mizuho no Shizuku, masu-shaped chocolates filled with sake, tea or fruit-and-honey jelly (15 flavours; 10 for ¥3,564); stick chocolates ¥540; Kyoto chocolates, bonbons shaped like flowers and temari; Pare Chocolat squares ¥378 each (official site; October 2026) · Chocolat Bar café: Kyoto matcha Saint-Honoré ¥2,200 (autumn), smoked fondant chocolat ¥1,540, chocolate berry or matcha parfait ¥1,430, chocolat noir cake ¥1,210, matcha white-chocolate cake ¥1,540, chocolate-and-sansho Kyoto vegetable curry ¥1,650, cacao Bolognese ¥1,430, autumn afternoon tea ¥7,150 with a drink, chocolate-and-drink sets ¥1,320–2,090, sencha and matcha ¥1,100 (official site, tax included)
places.notes: [Chocolate & café · Sanjo, chocolate in a hundred-year-old townhouse] The Sanjo main shop of Bel Amer Kyoto Bettei, a Kyoto chocolate brand born from Chocolat Bel Amer, in a townhouse over a century old with a small garden: downstairs, jewel-like bonbons, stick chocolates and Mizuho no Shizuku — masu-shaped chocolates filled with sake or tea jelly; upstairs, the Chocolat Bar overlooking Sanjo-dori serves plated desserts like a smoked fondant chocolat (¥1,540), parfaits, a chocolate curry and afternoon tea (¥7,150, the only thing you can book). 10:00–20:00. Tabelog Sweets WEST 100 2026.

roles: Chocolatiers of Bel Amer Kyoto Bettei (no one is named)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a chocolate brand created to send chocolate from Kyoto, a town of tradition and internationality, to the world, using Japanese ingredients, techniques and seasons; the shop is a traditional townhouse with a Chocolat Bar upstairs; chocolates in the café sets come on small plates from the Gion antique dealer 奥田連峯堂; the site is run by J･WORKS INC. and links to the Chocolat BEL AMER website. An October 2026 review quotes the brand as "born from Chocolat Bel Amer", which makes chocolates for Japan’s climate. Two Kyoto Bettei shops: 三条本店 and JR京都伊勢丹 (official site). Opened 11 September 2015 (Tabelog). Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: chocolate that represents Japan and connects it to the world, made one piece at a time.
chef_bio.specialty: Mizuho no Shizuku; stick chocolates; plated desserts.

anecdotes.text: "The chocolates are as beautiful as jewels. It was the first time I felt it was such a shame to eat something so exquisite." — October 2026.
"I intended to enjoy some sweets in the shop, but it was fully booked, so I opted for takeout chocolate instead." — October 2026.
An October 2026 afternoon-tea guest liked the quiche and opera cake but found the canelé chewy rather than crisp, and the pot of tea cooling fast.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (belamer-kyoto.jp): 伝統と国際性のある京都から世界へ発信するショコラブランド、日本の素材・技術・季節、町家の店内、二階にショコラバー、瑞穂のしずく (枡に見立てたショコラに日本酒・お茶・国産果実と蜂蜜のジュレ、15種)、スティックショコラ、京都ショコラ、彩ショコラ、ショコラバーのメニュー: 京抹茶のサントノレ2,200円、フォンダンショコラ 燻製1,540円、パフェ1,430円、ショコラノワール1,210円、テヴェール1,540円、ショコラと山椒、京野菜の和風カレー1,650円、カカオ風味のボロネーゼ1,430円、秋のアフタヌーンティーセット7,150円 (予約はアフタヌーンティーのみ)、ショコラセット1,320〜2,090円、奥田連峯堂の小皿、三条本店 10:00〜20:00 (L.O. 19:30、不定休)、ジェイアール京都伊勢丹店、運営 J･WORKS INC.。食べログ: チョコレート・カフェ・ケーキ、中京区三条通堺町東入ル北側桝屋町66、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、予約不可、24席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2015年9月11日オープン、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年10月、英語): 宝石のようなショコラ、パレショコラ378円、2階のカフェ、満席でテイクアウト、アフタヌーンティー、Chocolat Bel Amer から生まれたブランド。

cultural_comfort.note: Shop downstairs, café upstairs; only afternoon tea can be booked; cards and QR accepted.

places.name: 創作中華 一之船入 (Sosaku Chuka Ichino Funairi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Chinese courses with soy- and Shaoxing-seasoned braises, fermented black bean sauce, spring rolls, fried dishes and fried rice; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses are built on shark fin, seafood, chicken and duck in stocks (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:00) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 20:30); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Courses only, by reservation; parties of 9 or more by phone, best called 15:00–17:00 (Tabelog). 10% service charge, no cover charge (Tabelog). 32 seats and seven private rooms for 2 to 20, some tatami or sunken; non-smoking (Tabelog). Children from elementary school age (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). In a townhouse facing the Ichinofunairi canal off Kawaramachi Nijo; 2 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ichinofunairi canal off Kawaramachi Nijo — 2 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Creative Kyoto-style Chinese on the idea that food and medicine are one, blending the eight Chinese cuisines with Japanese and Western techniques and Kyoto seasonal produce (Tabelog shop text) · dinner courses: Funairi course, 7 dishes, ¥11,000; Kongming course, 7 dishes with braised shark fin and a drink, ¥14,850; Wei course, 8 dishes with a large braised shark fin (Tabelog) · a lunch Wei course: five-kind appetiser (jellyfish, tomato compote, spring rolls, steamed chicken, octopus), steamed Cantonese shrimp spring roll, shark fin braised in white soy sauce, chicken with makomo, flounder in black bean sauce, spinach fried rice, mango shaved ice (September 2026) · shark fin soup, Peking duck with homemade prawn crackers, Shanghai crab with shark fin, Ise lobster in chilli sauce, Buddha Jumps Over the Wall, matsutake clay-pot rice (2026 reviews) · aged and original Shaoxing wine; sommelier (2026 reviews; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Chinese · Kawaramachi Nijo, Chef Wei's townhouse by the canal] Creative Chinese cooking in a century-old townhouse facing the old Ichinofunairi boat landing on the Takase River, with private rooms: Chef Wei blends the eight Chinese cuisines with Japanese and Western techniques and Kyoto produce, on the principle that food is medicine. The braised shark fin is the signature; light, ungreasy courses run from appetiser platters to fried rice and a huge mango shaved ice. Lunch around ¥6,000–8,000; dinner courses ¥11,000–14,850, plus 10%. Book a course; closed Sunday. Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 2021, 2024.

roles: Owner-chef (reviews: "Chef Wei"; "The owner-chef trained at Banchinro")
chef_bio.background: Per an August 2026 review: founded in 1996 in a renovated 100-year-old townhouse that was once a tea shop facing the historic Ichinofunairi; the owner-chef trained at Banchinro in Yokohama Chinatown and holds a special chef qualification from China; organic vegetables, especially Kyoto vegetables, from contracted farms. The Tabelog shop text calls the chef Michelin-starred and the restaurant featured in the Michelin Guide; a September 2026 review says it "previously earned a Michelin star". A September 2026 regular mentions Chef Wei’s television appearances; another saw the chef greet every room at the start and end of the meal. Sister shops listed on Tabelog: Gohan Iido Sanjo (a Chinese diner known for soup dumplings) and Gohan Gyoza (gyoza and Taiwanese food near Karasuma Oike). Tabelog Chinese WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2024.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Tabelog shop text: "Ishoku-Dogen" — food and medicine are one; delicious, health-conscious dishes.
chef_bio.specialty: Braised shark fin; shark fin soup.

anecdotes.text: "Chef Wei made a point to visit each room to greet guests both at the beginning and end of the meal" — September 2026.
"For dessert, I had mango shaved ice, which was a pleasant surprise." — September 2026.
"Overall, the flavors felt a bit on the lighter side. Surprisingly, I ended up quite full" — October 2026.
"The private room allowed us to relax, and the view of the Takase River from the window was charming." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 中華料理・飲茶、中京区河原町二条下ル一之船入町537-50、京都市役所前駅から徒歩2分、月〜土 11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 13:00)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 20:30)、日曜休み、予約はコースのみ (9名以上は電話、15〜17時)、サービス料10%・チャージなし、32席、個室7 (2〜20名)、座敷・掘りごたつ、禁煙、小学生以上、カード可、ソムリエ、中華 WEST 百名店 2021・2024、店舗紹介: 築百年の町家、医食同源、中国八大料理と和・洋の技法、京都の旬の食材、ミシュランガイド掲載、Funairi コース7品11,000円、Kongming コース14,850円、系列店: Gohan Iido Sanjo、Gohan Gyoza。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語・日本語): Chef Wei、1996年創業、元はお茶屋の町家、Banchinro で修業、契約農家の有機野菜、フカヒレの姿煮、フカヒレスープ、北京ダック、マンゴーのかき氷、紹興酒、個室から高瀬川。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course ahead; private rooms only; 10% service; cards accepted.

places.name: お料理 MIYAMA (Oryori MIYAMA)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Game dishes come with soy-based sauces and dashi; pheasant kara-age, a pheasant katsu sandwich, spring rolls and ramen are wheat-based; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a game-meat bar (venison, wild boar, pheasant, bear), with dashi-based small dishes and egg-and-mayonnaise starters (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 15:00–23:00 daily; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Ground floor: a standing bar for up to about 20 (Tabelog); standing spots can be booked only on the day (June 2026). Upstairs: rooms for 2–8 by reservation only, for the bear hot-pot and pheasant sukiyaki courses (Tabelog). Table charge ¥330 (Tabelog); a small starter such as a pickled egg with spiced mayonnaise is served (2026 reviews). Non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay (Tabelog). On Nishikiyamachi along the Takase River, within 5 min of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Nishikiyamachi by the Takase River, south of Shijo — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Second shop of the Gion game restaurant Gibier MIYAMA, serving game from the town of Miyama (Tabelog) · standing bar with plates of rare meats such as bear and pheasant for under ¥1,000 (Tabelog): venison roast, summer venison tartare with bread, bear pâté, wild boar and shungiku spring rolls with cheese, pheasant tsukune tofu with chili soy ¥800, pheasant kara-age, pheasant katsu sandwich, grilled rice ball with fuki-no-tō miso, a late-night "yakan" ramen, aubergine agebitashi ¥700, cilantro salad with cod roe, sun-dried cucumber in sweet vinegar (2026 reviews) · homemade umeshu and shiso liqueur, wine, Iyoshi Cola (2026 reviews) · upstairs courses: black-bear tsuki-nabe ¥22,000, pheasant sukiyaki ¥16,500 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Game standing bar · Kawaramachi, bear and pheasant by the plate] The casual second shop of Gion's Gibier MIYAMA, on the Takase River: a calm, stylish standing bar downstairs where small plates of game from Miyama — venison tartare and roast, bear pâté, wild-boar spring rolls, pheasant tsukune tofu (¥800) — go with homemade umeshu or shiso liqueur, and booked rooms upstairs for bear hot pot (¥22,000) or pheasant sukiyaki (¥16,500). Reviewers note the meat has little gamey taste. ¥330 table charge. Open daily 15:00–23:00.

roles: Chef of Gibier MIYAMA and this shop (Tabelog, shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): the second location of Gibier MIYAMA in Gion, offering its game in a more casual setting; game comes from the nature-rich town of Miyama; the owner-chef won the Bronze Egg award at RED U-35, and the shop text names "Chef Futa Kanda". An August 2026 reviewer notes that Gibier MIYAMA itself does not take reservations. An October 2026 reviewer took the concept to be introducing game meat to people not used to it.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "The charm of a surprisingly mild flavor."
chef_bio.specialty: Venison tartare; pheasant tsukune tofu; bear hot pot.

anecdotes.text: "I ordered the roasted venison and bear pâté, both of which had no unpleasant odors and were easy to eat." — June 2026.
"The cheerful hospitality from the owner made for a wonderfully comfortable atmosphere." — October 2026.
A July 2026 reviewer spent ¥7,810 on venison and three drinks, against a Tabelog budget of about ¥3,000, and found the prices slightly high for the area but the food excellent.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 立ち飲み、下京区市之町260-2、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩5分以内、毎日15:00〜23:00、不定休、予約可 (2階の個室は予約制、2〜8名)、1階は立ち飲みで最大20名ほど、テーブルチャージ330円、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、祇園の「Gibier MIYAMA」の2号店、Miyama の自然の中のジビエ、RED U-35 Bronze Egg の Futa Kanda シェフ、熊や雉の珍しい肉を1皿1,000円以下、熊の Tsuki Nabe コース22,000円、雉のすき焼きコース16,500円。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): 鹿のロースト、夏鹿のタルタル、熊のパテ、猪と春菊の春巻き、雉のつくね豆腐800円、雉の唐揚げ、雉のカツサンド、自家製の梅酒としそのリキュール、落ち着いた立ち飲み。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the standing counter; book the upstairs rooms ahead; cards accepted.

places.name: 酒厨～ Shuz ～ (Shu Shuz)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi with soy sauce and marinated fish, simmered dishes, meat dishes and burger-like snacks; ingredients change daily and no gluten information is published (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and fish izakaya; the starters have included sushi egg (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday 17:30–23:00; Friday 17:15–24:00; Saturday 17:15–1:00; Sunday 17:15–23:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations recommended, as early as possible: ingredients and the menu change daily, orders stop when ingredients run out, and specific requests can be prepared if asked in advance (Tabelog); a February 2026 diner booked a week ahead and found it nearly full. Groups of 1–4 only (Tabelog). Charge of ¥500 per person (おひとり様¥500, Tabelog). Smoking allowed at the tables (Tabelog; June 2026). Cash only (Tabelog; November 2025). 20 seats (6 at the counter, 14 at tables) (Tabelog). In a narrow alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho north of Shijo — hard to find; enter from the main street (March 2025); 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn Exits 1 and 2 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, north of Shijo — 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Sushi izakaya with daily-changing fish, meat dishes and regional sake (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews) · nigiri on rice blended with white and red vinegar, ordered by the piece or as sets: 6 pieces with sea bream, shrimp, salmon roe, shiso and pickled daikon; 6-piece omakase; a 10-piece set at the counter; creative sushi; eel, seaperch, marinated fish (2025–26 reviews) · small dishes: kimchi lotus root, oyster namero, black-cooked firefly squid, tuna wrapped in nori, burger-like snacks, meat dishes (2024–26 reviews) · sake such as Keigetsu and a junmai ginjo from Itaru (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi izakaya · Kiyamachi, a hidden alley counter] A 20-seat sushi izakaya tucked into a narrow alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, run by a couple, with nostalgic anime stickers on one wall. Sushi on red-and-white-vinegar rice comes by the piece or as six- and ten-piece sets, alongside small dishes such as oyster namero and kimchi lotus root, meat dishes, and sake from around Japan; ingredients change daily, so book early and ask for favourites in advance. Service can be slow when busy. Smoking allowed; ¥500 charge each; cash only. Late on Friday and Saturday; closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner and the owner’s wife, per a February 2026 review (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: A February 2026 reviewer says the shop is run by the owner and the owner’s wife, who warned in advance that service would take time when busy; another February 2026 reviewer describes some nigiri handed straight from the chef’s hand and a wall of nostalgic anime stickers. An October 2024 reviewer mentions travelers toasting with the owner over sake.
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi by the piece; oyster namero.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner found the couple running the shop very busy and the service a little slow, as the shop had warned beforehand.
"The entrance is a bit hard to find! It’s easier to enter from the main street!" — March 2025.
An October 2024 diner liked the sushi but would rather the smoke stayed away from it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・寿司・日本酒バー、中京区東木屋町通四条上る鍋屋町122、阪急京都河原町駅1・2番出口から徒歩3分、月火木 17:30〜23:00、金 17:15〜24:00、土 17:15〜1:00、日 17:15〜23:00、水曜休み、予約可 (仕入れの都合で早めに連絡、食材がなくなり次第終了、食材とメニューは日替わり、希望があれば事前に)、1〜4名まで、おひとり様500円、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、20席 (カウンター6、テーブル14)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営む、白と赤の酢を合わせたシャリ、寿司1貫から、6貫・10貫のセット、牡蠣のなめろう、蓮根のキムチ、ホタルイカの黒煮、アニメのステッカーの壁、路地の奥で見つけにくい、現金のみ、喫煙可。

cultural_comfort.note: Book early by phone; ask what is in today; cash only; smoking allowed.

places.name: 松屋常盤 (Matsuya Tokiwa)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: miso matsukaze is made from wheat flour, sugar, white miso and sesame (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Reviewers list only wheat flour, sugar, white (Saikyo) miso and sesame, and one notes it is egg-free; the shop publishes no ingredient list (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 9:30–15:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). Takeaway only (Tabelog). The miso matsukaze is best reserved: the large (¥1,200) needs booking by the day before; the small (¥1,000) is sold on the day in limited numbers (Tabelog). Walk-ins often find one to three left, or none (2026 reviews); cut ends for home use (¥300) are sometimes available and can be prepared if you call ahead (June, September, October 2026). Keeps about three days; the miso top sticks, so do not wrap it in plastic (July 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). Parking for one or two cars at the shop (Tabelog). On Sakaimachi-dori south of Marutamachi, below the Imperial Palace’s Sakaimachi gate; 5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi-dori south of Marutamachi, by the Imperial Palace — 5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Old wagashi shop with essentially one sweet, 味噌松風 (miso matsukaze): a castella-like sheet of wheat flour, sugar and white Saikyo miso, sprinkled with sesame, moist and chewy, with a sweet-savoury miso top (2026 reviews) · small ¥1,000, large ¥1,200 (Tabelog); cut ends for home use ¥300 (June and September 2026)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Imperial Palace, one sweet for centuries] A noren-hung shop south of the Imperial Palace's Sakaimachi gate that sells one thing: miso matsukaze, a moist, castella-like cake of flour, sugar, white Saikyo miso and sesame — one of Kyoto's three famous matsukaze, per a reviewer. Reviewers in 2026 were greeted by an elderly lady in the small tatami-floored shop. Book a day ahead (large ¥1,200; small ¥1,000, a few sold on the day), or ask for the ¥300 bag of cut ends. Eat within about three days. Daily 9:30–15:00, cash only.

roles: Family shop; no one is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: An April 2026 reviewer calls it a historic wagashi shop established in the Shoo era and favoured by the Imperial Palace and Daitoku-ji; a July 2026 reviewer says it has been in business for 360 years. Reviewers describe an elderly woman, apparently the head of the shop, with a young male staff member in the small tatami-floored shop. A July 2026 reviewer calls it one of Kyoto’s three famous matsukaze shops. Tabelog Japanese sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Miso matsukaze.

anecdotes.text: "The lovely elderly lady at the shop welcomed me with a smile" — July 2026.
An October 2026 holiday walk-in asked for miso matsukaze and was told three were left; the staff added that a sliced version could be prepared for home use if called ahead.
A September 2026 visitor without a reservation was asked whether it was for home use and sold a bag of cut ends for ¥300.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和菓子、中京区堺町通丸太町下ル橘町83、丸太町駅から徒歩5分、毎日9:30〜15:00、予約可 (大1,200円は前日までに予約、小1,000円は当日限定販売)、テイクアウトのみ、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、駐車場1〜2台、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2026年4〜10月、英語): 味噌松風のみ、小麦粉・砂糖・白味噌 (西京味噌)・ごまで卵なし、日持ち約3日、家庭用の切り落とし300円、Shoo 年間の創業、約360年、京都の三大松風の一つ、店の奥の座敷の年配の女性。

cultural_comfort.note: Reserve by phone in Japanese a day ahead; say if it is for home use; cash only.

places.name: 亀屋良永 (Kameya Yoshinaga)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Oike senbei tastes of egg and wheat (August 2026); bean-paste sweets, yokan and kudzu sweets may be wheat-free, but no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Yokan and bean-paste sweets are plant-based in principle, but the Oike senbei contains egg and Honohono is a baked sweet; no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 8:00–18:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday (Tabelog). A reviewer found it open on Sunday 1 November 2026 at about 8:00, against Tabelog’s Sunday closure — check before going. Takeaway only. Reservations taken (Tabelog). Cards not accepted; e-money accepted (Tabelog). At the south-west corner of Teramachi and Oike, diagonally opposite Honnoji; 151 m from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; MAPPLE; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi-Oike, south-west corner, opposite Honnoji — by Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Old wagashi house known for 御池煎餅 (Oike senbei): light, sugar-glazed wafers that melt like snow (MAPPLE; 2026 reviews) · Oike senbei ¥1,350 for a tin of 22, 月 (Tsuki, shaped like the door pulls of Katsura Imperial Villa) ¥2,000 for 10, 小倉山 yokan ¥1,520 (MAPPLE, undated) · seasonal sweets: Seseragi summer yokan ¥2,350, Honohono (lemony white-bean baked sweet), a summer Toba tama manju branded with Daimonji, okuribi-themed kudzu sweets in August, Meigetsu ¥500 in September, shirataki kudzu yokan (2026 reviews) · a miso version of the senbei (September 2026)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Teramachi Oike, Oike senbei] A long-established wagashi house on the corner of Teramachi and Oike, opposite Honnoji, best known for Oike senbei — pale, sugar-glazed wafers that dissolve like snow (¥1,350 for a tin of 22, per MAPPLE). The shelves also hold Tsuki, modelled on the door pulls of Katsura Imperial Villa, 小倉山 yokan and seasonal sweets, such as Daimonji-themed ones in August. One reviewer found the senbei has grown pricey. Takeaway only. 8:00–18:00; Tabelog says closed Wednesday and Sunday, but a reviewer found it open on a Sunday in November 2026.

roles: Long-established wagashi house; no one is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: MAPPLE gives the founding as 1832 (天保3); an August 2026 reviewer says it has been around since 1803. MAPPLE lists Oike senbei, Tsuki (after the door pulls of Katsura Imperial Villa) and 小倉山 yokan. A July 2026 reviewer who has loved the senbei since childhood found it has become quite pricey and that a favourite seasonal sweet, Toki no Nagare, is no longer made. Tabelog Japanese sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Oike senbei; Tsuki.

anecdotes.text: "Instead of being hard and crunchy, they dissolve almost instantly in your mouth, reminiscent of cotton candy." — August 2026.
A September 2026 visitor was given a taste of a miso version of the senbei.
"Tabelog says they are closed on Sundays, but I visited on November 1, which was a Sunday." — November 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: まっぷる: 天保3 (1832) 年創業の和菓子の老舗、淡雪のような口溶けの「御池煎餅」、桂離宮の襖の引手の形をした「月」、甘さ控えめのようかん「小倉山」、御池煎餅1,350円 (1缶・22枚入) 〜、月2,000円 (10個)、小倉山1,520円、8:00〜18:00、寺町通御池西南角。食べログ: 和菓子、中京区寺町通御池下ル本能寺前町504、京都市役所前駅から151m、月火木金土 8:00〜18:00、水・日休み、予約可、カード不可、電子マネー可、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2026年7〜11月、英語): 1803年創業との記述、御池煎餅、夏のようかん Seseragi 2,350円、Honohono、Meigetsu 500円、Toki no Nagare は製造終了、日曜 (11月1日) に営業していた。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose from the counter; staff introduce the sweets; e-money but no cards.

places.name: 烹祥庵 (Hosho An)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses run through yuba, yudofu, sashimi with dashi soy sauce, hamo shabu with plum sauce, lava-stone grilled meat with house soy sauce, and sukiyaki in winter; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the courses centre on black wagyu, hamo, lobster, abalone and sashimi, with sukiyaki in winter (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), Tuesday to Sunday; closed Monday, and Tuesday may close after a Monday holiday (Tabelog). Kawadoko terrace over the Kamo River from May to the end of September (Tabelog). Book by phone or Tabelog; tell changes by the day before; 100% charge for cancellations on the day before or the day (Tabelog). Each guest orders at least one dish and one drink (Tabelog). 20 table seats; private hire for 20; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; cards accepted (Tabelog). Back of the first floor of 紫光会館 on Pontocho, north of Shijo; 3 min from Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, north of Shijo, facing the Kamo River — 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Black-wagyu yakiniku, meat sushi, yuba and yudofu with a night view of the Kamo River and Higashiyama; black-wagyu sukiyaki in winter (Tabelog) · black-wagyu sukiyaki set ¥7,000 (Tabelog) · lava-stone (Fuji) yakiniku course ¥9,500: three appetizers, yudofu, hamo shabu, lobster, abalone, grilled meat, meat sushi, dessert (July 2025) · fresh yuba with caviar, sea bream and tuna sashimi, abalone steak with burnt butter, grilled A5 wagyu strip loin with rock salt and house soy sauce (August 2026) · all-you-can-drink courses (Tabelog; June 2025)
places.notes: [Wagyu & Kyoto courses · Pontocho, on the Kamo River] A restaurant at the back of a Pontocho building that looks over the Kamo River toward Higashiyama and the Minamiza theatre, with a riverside kawadoko terrace from May to September. Courses pair Kyoto starters — yuba, yudofu, hamo shabu — with lobster, abalone and black wagyu grilled on Fuji lava stones (about ¥9,500); in winter, wagyu sukiyaki (¥7,000 set). Reviews range from delighted to disappointed. 17:00–23:00, closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 28 March 2016 (Tabelog). A June 2025 reviewer had dessert at a sister restaurant downstairs. Tabelog lists kyo-shikian.com as the website; it did not answer on 2026-11-05.
chef_bio.specialty: Lava-stone wagyu course; kawadoko terrace.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner was lent a blanket when the terrace turned chilly, and warned that crows are many along the river.
An April 2026 diner found the food average, the shrimp and meat served cold, the furniture cheap for the price and the card payment slow.
For a birthday the staff brought a "Happy Birthday" plate — October 2026.
Grilling the meat at the table was a bit challenging for one September 2026 diner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 烹祥庵、日本料理・焼肉・居酒屋、中京区先斗町通四条上ル鍋屋町227 紫光会館 1F奥、阪急河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、火〜日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、月曜休み (祝日の月曜の翌火曜は休みの場合あり)、20席 (テーブル)、貸切20人、禁煙、無料 Wi-Fi、カード可、2016年3月28日オープン、5月〜9月末は川床、黒毛和牛すき焼き鍋セット7,000円、黒毛和牛の焼肉と肉寿司、湯葉、湯豆腐、鴨川と東山の夜景、キャンセルは前日・当日100%、1人1品1ドリンク。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 富士の溶岩石の焼肉コース9,500円、鱧しゃぶ、ロブスター、あわび、湯豆腐、川床、南座の眺め、評価は分かれる。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead, especially for the terrace; one dish and one drink each.

places.name: G麺 (G Men)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the house dish is homemade wheat udon, and the menu adds ramen, katsudon, tempura and fried food (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the udon is served in the house dashi, and most dishes carry meat, egg or tempura (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 19:00–7:00 every day (Tabelog). Bookings possible (Tabelog). Order by QR code on your phone (September 2026). 14 seats at the counter and tables; smoking allowed; cash only (Tabelog). In the passage between Pontocho and Kiyamachi, north of Shijo (Tabelog; July 2024).
places.neighborhood: Between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, north of Shijo — 276 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Late-night udon and teppan izakaya: homemade udon in a house dashi and 28 teppanyaki dishes (Tabelog) · curry udon, the house favourite, with shrimp tempura (tempura curry ¥900 in July 2024), keiran (egg-drop) udon with ginger · soba, ramen, curry ramen, katsudon, rice bowls, onigiri, fried food · izakaya plates: yam and onion slices, tofu (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Udon izakaya · Kiyamachi, open until 7 am] A small, worn, friendly late-night spot in the lane between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, open from 19:00 to 7:00 every night — the last stop after drinks. The curry udon (thin, firm noodles in a mild, dashi-rich curry) is what most people order; there are also egg-drop udon, katsudon, ramen and teppan snacks. Orders by QR code. Cash only; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per an April 2023 review: a long-running shop famous for its curry udon, which had recently opened another place on Marutamachi in front of the prefectural office. Per the operator’s Tabelog text: homemade noodles, a special dashi and 28 kinds of teppanyaki.
chef_bio.specialty: Curry udon.

anecdotes.text: "Late at night on Kiyamachi, it's pretty much filled with Westerners. It's like a different country. It’s quite troublesome." — April 2023.
"The owner, with a charming smile, adds to the experience." — July 2024.
Regulars include staff from nearby bars, and guests shift seats as space frees up — July 2024.
"I thought the noodles might be soft, but they were actually quite firm" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: G麺、居酒屋・うどん、中京区木屋町通四条上ル下樵町202-1 1F、毎日 19:00〜7:00、予約可、14席 (カウンターとテーブル)、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、自家製麺と特製だしのうどん、28種の鉄板焼き。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年10月、英語): カレーうどん、天ぷらカレー900円 (2024年7月)、卵とじうどん、カツ丼、カレーラーメン、深夜から早朝まで、QR コードで注文。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code; late-night crowd; cash only.

places.name: 和食晴ル (Washoku Haru)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Japanese à la carte built on dashi — sashimi, dashimaki, fried chicken, yakisoba, saba sushi, tempura rice bowl; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the menu is fish, duck and chicken dishes and dashi-based cooking (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00 (Friday last orders: food 21:10, drinks 21:25); closed Monday; no lunch (Tabelog). Two seatings, 18:00 and 20:00; bookings through TableCheck only, with phone bookings on the day; the 18:00 seating fills even on weekdays (Tabelog; October 2026). Solo diners get in only when there is room on the day (October 2026). 11 counter seats; high-school age and up; non-smoking; cash only (Tabelog). 3 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: A back lane near Bukkoji, Shijo-Karasuma area — 3 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Creative Japanese à la carte with seasonal ingredients, from a blackboard menu (2026 reviews) · the unmashed potato salad (cubed potatoes in mayonnaise sauce) that reviewers single out · sashimi platter, conger-eel sashimi · tai sansho mochi (sweet-spicy sea bream flakes with brown-rice mochi, ¥2,200), duck menchi katsu (¥2,000), duck wrapped in fu, roast duck · fried amadai scales, fried jidori chicken, dashimaki · salt yakisoba with crab, saba sushi (reserve it), shrimp tempura rice bowl · seasonal appetizers, e.g. fig with sesame cream · a strong sake list (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Washoku · near Shijo-Karasuma, an eleven-seat counter] A small counter on a back lane by Bukkoji, opened in 2015 by an owner who trained at Wakuden, serving refined Japanese cooking as à la carte plates to go with sake: the famous unmashed potato salad, conger-eel sashimi, duck menchi katsu, sea-bream sansho mochi, crab salt yakisoba and saba sushi to finish. Two seatings (18:00 and 20:00), booked on TableCheck; expect about ¥10,000–15,000 with drinks. Cash only; closed Monday.

roles: Owner (unnamed; trained at Wakuden, per a July 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 16 June 2015 (Tabelog). Per a July 2026 review: the owner trained at the renowned Wakuden and opened the shop so guests could enjoy authentic kaiseki flavours in a relaxed à la carte setting. Tabelog Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025 and 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Potato salad; conger-eel sashimi; saba sushi.

anecdotes.text: "The potato salad will change your perception of it" — October 2026.
With an 8 pm booking on a holiday, a guest waited outside until just before the turnover — October 2026.
The sea-bream sansho mochi (¥2,200) and duck menchi katsu (¥2,000 each) were worth it but "on the expensive side"; about ¥15,000 for two with sake — October 2026.
"It's a cash-only system where you are presented with the total amount at the end, so be sure to bring cash." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和食晴ル、居酒屋、下京区神明町230-2、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩3分、火〜日 18:00〜22:00 (金曜 L.O. 料理21:10・ドリンク21:25)、月曜休み、昼営業なし、11席 (カウンターのみ)、高校生以上、禁煙、現金のみ、20時入れ替えの2部制、予約は TableCheck のみ (電話は当日のみ)、2015年6月16日オープン、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2025・2026。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): ポテトサラダ、刺身盛り合わせ、穴子の刺身、鯛山椒餅2,200円、鴨メンチカツ2,000円、蟹の塩焼きそば、鯖寿司、和久傳で修業した店主、黒板のメニュー。

cultural_comfort.note: Book on TableCheck; pick the 18:00 or 20:00 seating; cash only.

places.name: 京都くりや (Kyoto Kuriya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Many sweets are chestnut, sugar, mochi rice and bean paste (Kin no Mi, kuri ohagi, chestnut yokan), but the range also has chestnut dorayaki, monaka and senbei; no ingredient list is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Candied chestnuts, kuri ohagi and yokan are described as chestnut, sugar and rice, but no ingredient list is published and the dorayaki batter is not described (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 9:00–18:00, Sundays and public holidays 10:00–15:00; closed Monday (next day if Monday is a holiday) and New Year’s Day; hours may change (official site). Takeaway only, no seats (Tabelog). Orders can be reserved up to the day before (Tabelog); kuri ohagi is seasonal (autumn) and sells out, and a reviewer was told it is not made on some weekdays — reserve by phone (2026 reviews). Parking ticket for purchases of ¥2,500 or more at くるっとパーク大文字町 (official site). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 2 min from the Horikawa-Marutamachi bus stop, 8 min from Marutamachi Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Near Horikawa-Marutamachi and the prefectural office — 2 min from the Horikawa-Marutamachi bus stop
places.cuisine: Chestnut wagashi shop: simple, rustic sweets that "bring back home" rather than showy Kyoto confections (official site) · Kin no Mi, the signature: whole chestnuts candied in a crisp sugar coat, wrapped in gold (¥259 in September 2026) · kuri ohagi, mochi rice wrapped in chestnut paste of Tanba chestnuts, autumn only (¥324 each in September 2026) · chestnut dorayaki, chestnut yokan, Sato no Tsuki (monaka with mochi and chestnut, ¥313) · seasonal: mizu-yokan, wakaayu, brown-rice manju (official site; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Horikawa-Marutamachi, all about chestnuts] A small chestnut-sweets shop near the prefectural office whose wooden sign announces its signature, Kin no Mi — whole chestnuts glazed in a crisp sugar shell and wrapped in gold (about ¥260 each). In autumn the queue forms for kuri ohagi, sticky rice wrapped in Tanba-chestnut paste (about ¥320), which sells out: phone a day ahead. Also chestnut dorayaki and yokan. Takeaway only; cards accepted; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: a chestnut-sweets specialist established in the Taisho era, using carefully selected domestic chestnuts. Tabelog Japanese-sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "当店の菓子は京菓子のような華やかさは無いかもしれませんが、故郷を思い出して頂ける素朴な菓子です" — not the showiness of Kyoto confections, but simple sweets that remind people of home, made with care for natural flavour.
chef_bio.specialty: Kin no Mi; kuri ohagi.

anecdotes.text: At 11:30 on a weekday, about five groups were waiting outside, and the reviewer got the last kuri ohagi — October 2026.
The staff serve each customer individually, so it can take a little while to be served — October 2026.
An October 2026 buyer found the mochi a bit soft for ohagi and the chestnut overly sweet, and was told the kuri ohagi is not made on Thursdays.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-kuriya.jp): 栗の和菓子製造・販売、銘菓「金の実」、名物「栗おはぎ」、中京区大文字町42-4、平日 (火〜土) 9:00〜18:00、日曜・祝日 10:00〜15:00、定休日 元旦・月曜日 (祝日の場合翌日休み)、堀川丸太町バス停から徒歩2分、丸太町駅から徒歩8分、2,500円以上で駐車サービス券 (くるっとパーク大文字町)、定番商品: 金の実 栗納豆、栗どら、山の端、栗羊羹、山里、るりの里、おちょぼ、さいからせんべい、季節商品: 水羊羹、梅香水・紫香水、若鮎、栗おはぎ、栗の園、玄米饅頭、一口羊羹、京菓子のような華やかさは無いかもしれないが故郷を思い出して頂ける素朴な菓子。食べログ: 和菓子、予約は前日まで、席なし、カード・電子マネー・QR (PayPay) 可、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): 金の実259円、栗おはぎ324円、丹波栗100%、大正創業、行列、売り切れ。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter shop; staff serve one customer at a time; reserve kuri ohagi by phone.

places.name: 麺や 轍 木屋町店 (Menya Wadachi Kiyamachi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in soy-sauce and salt broths, mazesoba, kara-age and fried rice (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: back-fat soy and chicken-based broths with chashu (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog lists no hours. Reviewers describe a late-night shop: busy at about 4:00 (February 2025), "open until 9 AM" (May 2025), "open until the morning" (October 2025); one reviewer came at about 15:00 (August 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; November 2025, October 2026). 11 seats (7 counter, 2 table) (Tabelog). A November 2025 reviewer found the owner working alone on a busy Friday night; e-cigarettes allowed inside (November 2025). Opened 1 May 2023 (Tabelog). 226 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Shijo — 226 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Late-night ramen counter for the end of a night out (2025–2026 reviews) · original back-fat soy sauce ramen ¥950–960 (November 2025 – October 2026), light despite the fat, thin straight noodles · lemon salt ramen ¥900 (February 2025) · curry mazesoba with chicken broth and egg yolk · spicy ramen, "Yokozuna" ramen, carbonara noodles · hanasaki chashu +¥350, fried rice ¥500, mini kara-age rice bowl (2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Ramen · Kiyamachi, a late-night counter] A small ramen counter in the middle of Kiyamachi that reviewers find open deep into the night and morning, for a last bowl after drinking. The staple is the back-fat soy sauce ramen (¥960 in October 2026) — lighter than it looks, with thin straight noodles — alongside a lemon salt ramen and curry mazesoba. Reviews are mixed: some praise the kara-age bowl and the value, while a November 2025 visitor, who knew the Kokura shop, found the fried rice cold and the ramen bland on a busy night. Cash only. Hours are not published.

roles: Owner (unnamed; a November 2025 reviewer saw the owner working alone)
chef_bio.background: A November 2025 reviewer had earlier eaten at the shop's Kokura branch and found it better. Tabelog gives the opening as 1 May 2023.
chef_bio.specialty: Back-fat soy sauce ramen; lemon salt ramen.

anecdotes.text: "When I arrived around 4 AM, it was quite busy." — February 2025.

A November 2025 visitor ordered back-fat soy sauce ramen (¥950), hanasaki chashu (¥350) and fried rice (¥500), found the rice cold and the ramen under-seasoned, and allowed that the owner was alone on a busy Friday.
An October 2025 reviewer called the mini kara-age rice bowl well made, and noted that the small room fills with people who have just finished drinking, which explains some low ratings.

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; small counter; hours not published.

places.name: 京都焼鳥製作所 (Kyoto Yakitori Seisakujo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori comes with salt by default (Guérande salt), but tare, kara-age with soy marinade, chicken nanban and spring rolls are also on the menu; no gluten information (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan options, but the official menu is built on chicken; grilled vegetables appear in the courses (Tabelog; official site).
places.hours_raw: Sunday–Thursday 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); Friday, Saturday and the day before a holiday 17:00–1:00 (last order 24:00); irregular closures, posted on the site (official site; Tabelog). Reservations online or by phone; same-day courses possible (official site; March 2026). ¥330 service charge (Tabelog). Seats: 53 on the official site (6 counter, 14 table, 20 in a sunken-kotatsu room, two semi-private rooms), 60 on Tabelog; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). Menus in English, Chinese and Korean, with staff who speak them (Tabelog). 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn exit 10 (official site). Opened 25 February 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of Shijo — 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori izakaya using only female Kyo Akajidori chickens, grilled over binchotan with Guérande salt (official site) · aburi-yaki of thigh ¥1,320, neck ¥880, breast ¥968, harami ¥748, with yuzu kosho · skewers: thigh ¥352, negima, neck, breast with skin, bonjiri ¥275, white liver ¥330, sasami ¥253, tsukune ¥330 in four styles (with Ranno egg yolk, cheese, salt or grated daikon) · beef-tendon doteyaki ¥825, kara-age with grated daikon and ponzu ¥715, chicken-stock dashimaki ¥715, iburi-gakko potato salad ¥528, oyakodon ¥880 · chicken nanban · courses with all-you-can-drink ¥4,000–7,000, chicken hot-pot course ¥6,000 (book by the day before) · sake, e.g. Juyondai (January 2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Shijo Kawaramachi, Kyo Akajidori over binchotan] A retro-modern yakitori izakaya down a narrow "eel's bed" building a couple of minutes from Kawaramachi Stn, using only female Kyo Akajidori chickens grilled over binchotan and salted with Guérande salt. Start with the aburi-yaki (thigh ¥1,320), then skewers from ¥253 — the tsukune with Ranno egg yolk and the white liver (when it hasn't sold out) are favourites — and finish with the oyakodon, which one regular calls the best anywhere. Courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥4,000. Open to midnight, to 1:00 on Friday and Saturday; ¥330 service charge.

roles: Kitchen unnamed; the official menu says the beef-tendon doteyaki has been made since training days in Osaka
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the restaurant uses only female Kyo Akajidori, grills over binchotan for a crisp outside and juicy inside, and settled on French Guérande salt after a long search; yakitori is served with salt by default; the chicken is grilled before it goes into the oyakodon, made with Ranno eggs. Tabelog gives the opening as 25 February 2015.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyo Akajidori aburi-yaki and yakitori; oyakodon.

anecdotes.text: "The oyakodon (chicken and egg rice bowl) here is on another level—absolutely delicious!" — January 2026.
A February 2026 regular from the early days came back for the white liver at 21:30 on a Friday and found it sold out.
A May 2026 diner sat at the back counter facing the grill, which is closed in by clear walls so no smoke reaches the room.
A June 2026 diner found the yakitori varied and good but some orders were slow or missed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yakitoriseisakusyo.com): 京都焼鳥製作所 (きょうとやきとりせいさくしょ)、下京区足袋屋町324、京赤地どりの雌のみ、備長炭、ゲランドの塩、焼き鳥は基本的に塩、炙り焼き (もも1,320円、せせり880円、胸とろ968円、鶏ハラミ748円)、串 (もも352円、ねぎま・せせり・皮つき胸・ぼんじり275円、白肝330円、ささみ253円、つくね330円)、牛すじどて焼き825円 (大阪での修業時代から)、唐揚げおろしポン酢715円、鶏スープだし巻き715円、いぶりがっこポテトサラダ528円、親子丼880円 (蘭王)、飲み放題付きコース4,000〜7,000円、鍋コース6,000円 (前日までに予約)、日〜木17:00〜24:00、金土17:00〜25:00、不定休、53席。食べログ: 焼き鳥・鶏料理・居酒屋、サービス料330円、60席、禁煙、カード・PayPay・Alipay 可、英語・中国語・韓国語メニュー、ヴィーガンメニューあり、2015年2月25日オープン。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus and staff (Tabelog); many guests from abroad (May 2026).
