places.name: ゆたか (Yutaka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses pair the steak with carpaccio, soup, salad with house dressing, garlic rice and bread; the steak itself is steamed on garlic on the griddle; no gluten information (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a steakhouse whose courses centre on wagyu fillet, with seafood starters (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–13:30 (last order); dinner from 17:30 (Tabelog lists 17:30–22:30, last order 22:00); closed Sunday and public holidays, and irregularly (Tabelog; official site). Reservation only (Tabelog), by phone or TableCheck (official site). Lunch steak course ¥8,800; dinner courses from ¥32,000; prices include service and tax (official site). 24 seats: a 10-seat counter facing the kitchen and a small garden, a private room for 6, and an upstairs zashiki with a stage for parties with geiko and maiko (official site; Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards accepted (Tabelog). Gion Machi Minamigawa, south of Shijo off Hanamikoji; about 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Moved here from 末吉町 on 7 May 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion Machi Minamigawa, south of Shijo off Hanamikoji — 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion steakhouse founded in 1962, serving only the centre of domestic black wagyu fillet, cut thick and steamed slowly over garlic on the griddle (official site) · lunch steak course ¥8,800: hors d'oeuvre, salad, 80 g steak, bread, dessert; lunch hamburg steak of black wagyu (July 2025) · dinner: special steak course ¥32,000 and Yutaka standard course ¥38,000, each with 100 g Chateaubriand and garlic rice; Yutaka special course ¥66,000 with tartare, abalone and Beluga caviar, sirloin, hamburg steak and a fillet katsu sandwich (official site) · à la carte starters from ¥6,600 (seafood carpaccio) to Beluga caviar ¥66,000; consommé ¥1,800 (official site) · pudding to finish · mostly French wine, with a sommelier (official site)
places.notes: [Steak · Gion, a 1962 steakhouse in a former teahouse] A Gion steakhouse in a remodelled ochaya south of Shijo, entered under a noren and red lantern, with a vermilion counter that faces the griddle and a small garden. The house steak is the heart of the black wagyu fillet, cut thick and steamed slowly over garlic so it is soft enough to barely need chewing; it comes with garlic rice and a triangle of pudding. The lunch course (¥8,800, 80 g fillet) is the way in; dinner courses start at ¥32,000. Upstairs there is a zashiki with a stage for parties with geiko and maiko. Reservation only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Mamoru Takada (official site; the kanji is not given)
roles: Second-generation owner-chef (official site: 二代目オーナーシェフ)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Steak House Yutaka was founded in 1962 (Showa 37); following the founder, the father, Takada entered cooking after high school, was put in charge of the Gion shop at 24 and became owner young; the father's teaching "cooking is conversation" is kept; the company also runs Yutaka Ginza in Tokyo. A June 2025 review gives the owner-chef's name as "Ei Takada"; a September 2026 review (in Japanese) gives 創業62年 and saw the owner and one young cook running the room. A June 2026 reviewer says Kazuo Inamori and family were regulars in the founder's time. Tabelog Steak WEST "Tabelog 100" 2022, 2024 and 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: the joy of food that comes out of conversation — reading each guest and recommending what suits that day, from the composition of the meal to the doneness of the meat.
chef_bio.specialty: Steamed black wagyu fillet (Chateaubriand); garlic rice.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 lunch guest (writing in Japanese) found the room to be a business-entertaining restaurant of an older era, run that day by the owner and one young cook, and had the ¥8,800 lunch course.
A June 2026 diner had 150 g of Chateaubriand while a companion over 70 ordered 300 g and finished it.
A March 2026 regular of about ten years booked the second-floor private room for a group of eight.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yutaka-steak.com): 祇園ゆたか、東山区祇園町南側 四条花見小路下ル四筋目東入ル、かつてのお茶屋の京町家を改築、1階カウンター10席と個室6席、2階に舞台のあるお座敷 (芸妓・舞妓をまじえた宴席)、昼8,800円〜 (11:30〜L.O.13:30)、夜32,000円〜 (17:30〜)、サービス料・消費税込み、カード可、特選ステーキコース32,000円、ゆたかスタンダードコース38,000円、ゆたかスペシャルコース66,000円、ステーキランチコース8,800円、国産黒毛和牛のフィレの芯の部分のみ、鉄板に敷いたニンニクの上で蒸し焼き、フランス産中心のワイン。オーナーシェフ Mamoru Takada: 昭和37年創業のステーキハウスゆたかの二代目、先代である父にならい高校卒業後から料理の世界へ、24歳で祇園店を任される、「料理は対話」。ゆたか銀座 (東京)。食べログ: ステーキ、完全予約制、24席、個室 (4人・6人)、日祝休み、2012年5月7日に末吉町西入から移転、ステーキ・鉄板焼き WEST 百名店 2022・2024・2025。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone or TableCheck; the counter faces the chef; an English page exists on the official site.

places.name: リストランテ野呂 (Ristorante Noro)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The signature is a breaded menchi-katsu with demi-glace, and handmade pasta features in most courses, but fish dishes, risotto and salads are also served and the kitchen takes requests (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Courses centre on fish, meat and egg pasta; the seasonal vegetable plate is the most plant-based dish reviewed, but its jelly is set with a dashi broth (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–20:30; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations taken; lunch fills up, so book (Tabelog; July 2026). Lunch: menchi-katsu set ¥3,300 (August 2026); lunch course with soup, fish tasting, pasta, main, dessert and drink. Dinner course ¥10,000 (¥11,000 with tax) (October 2026); à la carte at night has no printed prices (July 2026). 12 counter seats on the ground floor (10 per an August 2026 review), with tables upstairs and in a separate building; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners only (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 8 min from JR Nijo Stn; no parking (Tabelog). Opened 13 June 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishinokyo, east of JR Nijo Stn — 8 min walk
places.cuisine: Italian-based yoshoku with Japanese touches, in a renovated machiya (2026 reviews) · signature menchi-katsu of Ozaki beef and Kofuku pork with demi-glace and balsamic (2026 reviews) · lunch: menchi-katsu set with soup, seasonal vegetable plate and drink ¥3,300 (August 2026); lunch course with chilled soup, a tasting of seasonal fish, handmade tagliolini, a choice of main and dessert · dinner course ¥10,000 plus tax: vegetable purée, seasonal fish tasting, Daisendori chicken involtini, sautéed sea bream, menchi-katsu and Tanba pork tonteki, Sicilian-style sardine spaghetti, dessert (October 2026) · à la carte: seafood platters, homemade prosciutto, risotto, pasta with your choice of sauce, Kamo eggplant dengaku with duck and tomato miso, wagyu steak · wine with a sommelier (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian yoshoku · Nijo, a menchi-katsu worth the trip] A renovated machiya a short walk from JR Nijo Stn where chef Noro — trained in Italy, then at Hotel Granvia Kyoto's La Risata and at Yoshoku Ogata — cooks Italian-based yoshoku with Japanese touches. The signature is a juicy menchi-katsu of Ozaki beef and Kofuku pork under demi-glace and balsamic; the menchi-katsu lunch set (¥3,300) comes with a soup and a vegetable plate that reviewers rave about. Dinner is a ¥10,000 course or à la carte with handmade pasta, risotto and the day's fish. Lunch fills up — book. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Noro (surname only; owner-chef per July and August 2026 reviews)
roles: Owner-chef (July 2026 review: "Chef Noro, the owner"; August 2026: "The owner, Mr. Noro")
chef_bio.background: Per a July 2026 review: chef Noro trained in Italy, then worked at Hotel Granvia Kyoto's La Risata and at Yoshoku Ogata before opening Ristorante Noro in 2017 (Tabelog: 13 June 2017). Yoshoku Ogata is in data as mp_yoshoku_ogata. Another July 2026 reviewer calls Noro a sister restaurant of a place where no table was free, without naming it. The official site describes the shop as a kappo-like restaurant that serves "100 dishes for 100 guests", for ordinary days and special ones. Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021 and 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: 「100人の方に、100様の料理でもてなす、割烹のようなレストラン」 — a restaurant like a kappo, serving each guest a dish made for that guest.
chef_bio.specialty: Menchi-katsu with demi-glace and balsamic; handmade pasta.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner was seen off at the door by the owner, Mr. Noro, and found the welcome very friendly and warm.
An August 2026 regular, on a second visit, wrote at length about the chilled corn soup of Dake Kimi corn and a vegetable plate of beets, apple and blood-orange jelly set with dashi.
An August 2026 diner asked for both a seafood and a summer-vegetable risotto, and the kitchen made one with cream and one with tomato.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ristorante-noro.com): リストランテ野呂、「ふだんの日にも､特別な日にも。100人の方に、100様の料理でもてなす、割烹のようなレストラン。」、コースメニューと毎日の日替わりメニュー。食べログ: イタリアン・洋食、中京区西ノ京職司町67-14、JR二条駅から徒歩8分、火〜日 11:30〜13:30・17:30〜20:30、月曜休み、予約可、カウンター12席 (2階にテーブル)、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、ソムリエあり、2017年6月13日オープン、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2021・2025。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): シェフの Noro はイタリアで修業し、Hotel Granvia Kyoto の La Risata と Yoshoku Ogata を経て開業、メンチカツのデミグラスとバルサミコ、メンチカツのセット3,300円、夜のコース10,000円 (税込11,000円)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead, especially for lunch; cards are JCB, AMEX and Diners only.

places.name: はっすんば (Hassunba)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice for overseas guests: the shop offers them only a fixed course that includes fish tempura and miso-grilled fish (Tabelog). The à la carte menu adds fried nama-fu (wheat gluten) and dishes in white miso (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the course for overseas guests is an appetiser platter, chicken and root-vegetable soup, fish tempura and miso-grilled fish (Tabelog), and the cooking is built on dashi (October 2026).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 17:30–22:30 (last order 22:00), closed irregularly. Bookings taken; a booking more than 15 minutes late without notice is cancelled (Tabelog). For overseas guests the shop offers only a course of four dishes chosen by the owner — appetiser platter, chicken and root-vegetable soup, an original fish tempura and miso-grilled fish, changing with the season — at ¥7,500 including tax; there is no English menu and the owner cannot explain the dishes in English (Tabelog). Table charge ¥1,000 with an appetiser (Tabelog). 18 seats: 6 at the counter, 12 at tables; non-smoking; children and folded strollers welcome (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Down 21番路地 off Pontocho north of Shijo; 5 min walk from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, an alley north of Shijo — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto cooking and sake in a Pontocho alley (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · for overseas guests a fixed course of four dishes, ¥7,500 (Tabelog) · à la carte: hassun and obanzai assortments (three or five kinds), fluffy dashimaki, yuba sashimi, fried nama-fu salad, beef and Kujo leek simmered in white miso, chicken with Kujo leek, conger eel and lotus root in clear soup (2026 reviews) · a long sake list from classic to rare brands, and shochu (Tabelog; June 2026) · table charge ¥1,000 with an appetiser
places.notes: [Kyoto cooking · Pontocho, a hidden alley] A calm 18-seat counter-and-table restaurant at the end of an alley off Pontocho, which a June 2026 diner heard would mark its 25th year that autumn: obanzai and hassun assortments, fluffy dashimaki, fried nama-fu salad, beef and Kujo leek in white miso, and a deep sake list. Overseas guests are offered only a four-dish course (¥7,500), because the owner cannot explain dishes in English. One March 2026 diner found the food bland, greasy and over-seasoned; most others loved it. Daily 17:30–22:30.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who chooses the course for overseas guests
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s notes for overseas customers say there is no English menu, the owner cannot explain the dishes in English, and foreign guests are offered only a ¥7,500 course of four dishes recommended by the owner. A June 2026 diner, on a fourth visit, heard the restaurant would celebrate its 25th anniversary that autumn.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai and hassun; dashimaki; beef and Kujo leek in white miso.

anecdotes.text: "The dashimaki tamago (Japanese rolled omelette) with a 3-minute shelf life was incredibly fluffy and delicious." — July 2026.

A March 2026 diner who walked in found the beef with burdock and lotus root "bland and mushy", the fried dishes greasy and the omelette over-seasoned; four dishes with a beer and a highball came to ¥8,500.
"I hear they will celebrate their 25th anniversary this autumn!" — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、中京区四条通先斗上ル鍋屋町209-6 21番路地 1F、毎日17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、不定休、予約可、連絡なく15分以上遅れると自動キャンセル、チャージ料1,000円 (付き出しあり)、18席 (カウンター6、テーブル12)、禁煙、子連れ・ベビーカー可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可。海外のお客様へ: 英語メニューなし、外国のお客様はコースのみ、7,500円 (税込)、店主おすすめの4品 (前菜盛り合わせ、鶏と根菜の汁物、オリジナルの魚の天ぷら、魚の味噌焼き、季節で変更あり)、店主は英語で料理を説明できない。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): 八寸、おばんざい3種・5種、だし巻き、湯葉刺し、揚げ生麩のサラダ、牛と九条ネギの白味噌煮、鱧と蓮根のお吸い物、日本酒が豊富、25周年 (2026年秋)。

cultural_comfort.note: No English menu and the owner cannot explain dishes in English; overseas guests are offered only a ¥7,500 four-dish course, booked ahead.

places.name: ビストロ プティラパン (Bistro Petit Lapin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses come with house rye bread and the dinner menu includes crêpes, pâtés and tarte Tatin; dishes are chosen from a long list, so ask before ordering (official menu; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Salads (mushroom, Niçoise, carrot râpé) are on the menu, but the bistro cooking leans on charcuterie, pâtés, game and foie gras (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:30); café and dessert 14:30–17:30 (last order 16:30); dinner 18:00–23:00 (last entry 21:30); closed Wednesday plus one run of days off a month, posted on the site. Tabelog gives lunch 12:00–15:00 (food last order 13:30) and dinner 18:00–22:30 (food last order 21:30; courses 21:00), closed Wednesday. Bread and amuse-bouche ¥700 per person (Tabelog). Corkage ¥2,000 for one bottle per two guests; please do not use mobile phones in the room (Tabelog). From January 2026 children are welcome by booking by the day before, with a lunch course or a dinner main (official site); Tabelog still says no children. 15 seats: 5 at the counter, 10 at tables; non-smoking; private hire up to 20; English menu (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). On Gokomachi-dori north of Ayanokoji — one minute south on the street west of Fuji Daimaru; red fence and black sign; 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gokomachi-dori north of Ayanokoji — 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: French regional home cooking and French wine in a small bistro (official site; Tabelog) · lunch menu A ¥3,000 (salad or soup, main of the day, house rye bread, dessert); menu B ¥4,000 (amuse, a starter from about ten such as horse-mackerel and potato mosaic, rillettes-style venison, ratatouille with poached egg, country pâté, plus a main and dessert) (official menu) · dinner Bistro menu ¥5,500 and some 70 à la carte dishes: escargots, mussels, Nagahama Anegawa ayu confit, Satsuma pork tongue, tête de cochon, boudin noir; mains such as Hino-town venison crépinette with foie gras, roast beef, lamb rump, French duck, lobster tail (official menu; 2026 reviews) · tarte Tatin, crème brûlée, crème caramel · vegetables, meat and fish from Miyama (Tabelog)
places.notes: [French bistro · Gokomachi-Ayanokoji, a little rabbit] A 15-seat bistro behind a red fence south of Fuji Daimaru, open since July 2009, whose site likens its guests to a hungry little rabbit: French regional home cooking with French wines — lunch courses at ¥3,000 and ¥4,000, a ¥5,500 dinner menu and about 70 à la carte dishes from escargots and boudin noir to Hino venison crépinette with foie gras, and tarte Tatin. Reviewers in 2026 praise the owner-chef's warm service. Closed Wednesday; café hours 14:30–17:30.

chef_bio.background: The official site describes a shop where people who love to eat gather, always smiling like a rabbit that never stops munching, and serves house "a little rye" bread. Tabelog gives the opening day as 5 July 2009 and describes traditional French cooking in bistro style, with vegetables, meat and fish from Miyama. The official information page names the current venison supplier, ジビエ堂 in Hino, Shiga, and sells party hors d’oeuvres and rice from Keihoku farmers. A May 2026 diner found the owner-chef attentive and was photographed by the owner on leaving; another the same month found the owner kind.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a shop where food-lovers gather, never without a smile, like a hungry little rabbit.
chef_bio.specialty: Venison crépinette with foie gras; tarte Tatin; regional French dishes.

anecdotes.text: "At first glance, it looks like a hamburger, but it’s something entirely different!" — of the venison crépinette with foie gras, May 2026.
"There were cute chairs made from cork stoppers lined up." — May 2026.
"You absolutely must try the Tarte Tatin!" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (petitlapin-fr.com): フランス地方家庭料理とフランスワイン、いつももぐもぐ口を動かす食いしん坊のウサギのように笑顔が絶えない食いしん坊が集まるお店、自家製ちょっとライ麦パン、ランチ12時〜15時 (最終入店13時30分)、Cafe Dessert 14時30分〜17時30分 (ラストオーダー16時30分)、ディナー18時〜23時 (最終入店21時30分)、2026年1月よりお子様同伴可 (ランチはコース、ディナーはドゥプラ、前日までの予約のみ)、定休日は水曜日、月1連休、下京区御幸町通り綾小路上る大寿町396。Dejeuner menu A 3,000円、menu B 4,000円 (アントレ2皿で+1,200)、Bistro menu 5,500円 (18:00〜21:00 ラストオーダー)、アラカルト: エスカルゴ、ムール貝、長浜姉川アユのコンフィ、薩摩茶美豚舌ソテー、テートドコション、ブーダンノワール、メイン: フォアグラ入り鹿肉のクレピネット包み、ローストビーフ、仔羊ランプ肉、フランス産鴨肉のロティ、オマール海老。鹿肉は滋賀県日野町のジビエ堂。食べログ: ビストロ・フレンチ・ワインバー、ランチ12:00〜15:00、ディナー18:00〜22:30、水曜定休、パン・アミューズ代700円、持ち込み料2,000円、店内での携帯電話はご遠慮、子供不可、15席 (カウンター5、テーブル10)、禁煙、英語メニュー、2009年7月5日オープン、美山町の野菜・肉・魚、約70品のアラカルト。口コミ (2023年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 鹿のクレピネット、タルトタタン、クレームブリュレ、オーナーシェフの温かいサービス。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); set lunch courses with a choice of starter and main; book ahead.

places.name: Cucina Italiana 東洞 (Cucina Italiana Todo)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the lunch courses are built around pasta (three kinds in one course, dried and handmade) with house ciabatta and focaccia and a cream croquette amuse (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask when booking. No vegan information; courses use fish, pork, beef, chicken-liver mousse and cheese, with plenty of Kyoto vegetables in the antipasto (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 12:00–15:00 (food last order 14:00, drinks 14:30), dinner 17:30–22:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Thursday and the second and third Wednesdays. Bookings taken; a diner booked the same day in September 2026. Dinner service charge 10% from 3 March 2024 (Tabelog). 18 seats: counter on the ground floor facing a small garden, tables upstairs, private rooms for 4 and 6, private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 4 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin south of Takeyamachi, south of the Imperial Palace — 4 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Northern-Italian regional cooking in a renovated 100-year-old townhouse — an "adult trattoria" (Tabelog; Mitsubishi Estate town guide) · lunch three-pasta course ¥3,700 (amuse, Kyoto-vegetable antipasto, three pastas, dessert; September 2026); a full lunch course with fish and meat · dinner prix fixe: choose antipasto, pasta, main and dessert, with half portions to try two of each (October 2026) · 2026 dishes: spaghettini with mackerel and apple, basil trofie with white fish, tagliolini with lobster sauce, braised beef cheek, braised pork shank with apple, Awa black-wagyu sirloin tagliata (supplement), jasmine gelato, apple polenta cake · Italian wines
places.notes: [Italian · south of the Imperial Palace, three pastas] A northern-Italian "adult trattoria" in a renovated 100-year-old townhouse on Higashinotoin, with a counter facing a small garden and quiet rooms upstairs. Lunch is a set course — the ¥3,700 three-pasta course is the draw, dried and handmade side by side; dinner is a prix fixe where half portions let two people try more. Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2021, 2023, 2025. One October 2026 diner found it salty and the welcome cool. Closed Thursday and the 2nd and 3rd Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction: a relaxed "adult trattoria" in a traditional townhouse over 100 years old, blending Japanese and Western styles; the ground-floor counter lets guests watch the cooks, the upstairs tables are calm, and the food is Northern Italian regional cooking with fresh ingredients and simple methods, paired with Italian wines. The Mitsubishi Estate town guide adds that the chef reached this style after years of training. A September 2026 diner believed it belongs to the same group as Misato and Gyoza no Ryosho. Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023 and 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Mitsubishi Estate town guide: an unpretentious "slightly grown-up trattoria" for relaxing over the season’s flavours.
chef_bio.specialty: Three-pasta lunch course; prix fixe dinner.

anecdotes.text: "They kindly divided everything in half for us, allowing us to enjoy two varieties of both pasta and the main course." — October 2026.
On a birthday lunch, "HAPPY Birthday" and flowers were drawn in chocolate on the dessert plate and a young staff member took a photo — September 2026.
An October 2026 diner found the seasoning a little salty and "didn’t feel much hospitality overall".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 三菱地所の住まいリレー (町のガイド): Cucina Italiana 東洞 (クッチーナ イタリアーナ トウドウ)、京都御所南の閑静な街並みの一軒家レストラン、長年かけて修業しイタリアンとは何かを見つめてきたシェフ、「ちょっぴり大人なトラットリア」、11:30〜15:00・17:30〜23:00、木曜日・第2・3水曜日休み、中京区東洞院通竹屋町下ル三本木町5-496-3。食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ、ランチ12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 料理14:00・ドリンク14:30)、ディナー17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 料理21:00・ドリンク21:30)、木曜定休、第2・3水曜休み、2024年3月3日からディナーはサービス料10%、18席、個室 (4名・6名)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可、築100年以上の町家、北イタリアの郷土料理、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2025。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): パスタ3種のコース3,700円、ランチのフルコース、プリフィックスのディナー (ハーフ可)、鯖とりんごのスパゲッティーニ、トロフィエ、阿波牛のタリアータ、ジャスミンのジェラート。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses at lunch and a prix fixe at dinner; book ahead.

places.name: FORNI (フォルニ)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking: the hotel asks diners with allergies to tell it beforehand (official site). No gluten information; courses include pasta (Awaji-made casarecce and cavatelli), focaccia, a croissant with cheese and tiramisu, and the oven turns out Roman-style pizza (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask when booking. No vegan menu is listed; consultant chef Fumio Yonezawa is the author of a vegan cookbook and works on vegan cuisine (official site), but 2026 courses used beef, chicken, veal, fish, burrata and cheese.
places.hours_raw: Official site: breakfast 7:00–10:00, lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:30–21:30 (last orders); Tabelog: open all year. Prix fixe courses: lunch Moderare ¥5,900, Contento ¥8,900, Divertito ¥12,900; dinner Moderare ¥12,000, Contento ¥15,000, Divertito ¥19,000; prices include the 15% service charge and tax (official site). Christmas courses 24–25 December 2026: lunch ¥13,000, dinner ¥22,000 (official site). Booking online (TableCheck) or by phone (+81 75 468 3166); cancellation 50% two days before, 70% the day before, 100% on the day (Tabelog). 105 seats: 99 at tables including 18 on the terrace, a private room for 6 (lunch from ¥12,700, dinner from ¥19,000); non-smoking, with a smoking area in the hotel; children welcome with a kids’ menu; dress casual; parking for 23 cars, two hours free with ¥8,000 spent (official site; Tabelog). Breakfast is a semi-buffet with a Japanese or American main (September 2026, a hotel guest). On the ground floor of HOTEL THE MITSUI KYOTO; 3 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn exit 2 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: HOTEL THE MITSUI KYOTO, south of Nijo Castle — 3 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Hotel Italian of handmade dishes from Italian and Kyoto ingredients, following the 24 solar terms, with a garden view from every seat and an okudosan (kamado-style range) reworked as a pizza and roasting oven (official site) · lunch courses ¥5,900–12,900, dinner ¥12,000–19,000, service and tax included (official site) · September 2026 lunch: croissant with cheese, edamame potage with yuzu, burrata and tomato with Genovese, Awaji casarecce with salt-and-spice beef ragù, grilled chicken breast with Tasmanian mustard and cold caponata, round tiramisu; wine pairing of four glasses ¥4,000 · October 2026 Divertito dinner (¥19,000): veal tonnato, crab and sansho Genovese tagliatelle, abalone risotto with liver butter, charcoal-grilled beef fillet, Tanba chestnut Mont Blanc; Quattro Formaggi Roman pizza ¥4,800 · aosa-seaweed focaccia · afternoon tea (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Hotel Italian · Nijo Castle, a garden and a kamado oven] The Italian restaurant of HOTEL THE MITSUI KYOTO, opened November 2020: prix fixe courses of Italian and Kyoto ingredients following the 24 solar terms, Roman-style pizza from a kamado-style oven, and a garden in view from every seat, with consultant chef Fumio Yonezawa since 2022. Lunch from ¥5,900, dinner from ¥12,000, service and tax included. Italian WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Polished five-star service; breakfast 7:00–10:00, lunch and dinner daily.

roles: Consultant chef (from July 2022), per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: born in Tokyo in 1980, Fumio Yonezawa trained at Trattoria Il Boccalone in Ebisu, moved to New York at 22 and became the first Japanese sous chef at the three-Michelin-star Jean-Georges; back in Japan, after serving as executive chef at a Tokyo restaurant, the chef became chef de cuisine at Jean-Georges Tokyo on its opening in 2014; won the US Embassy’s Taste of America competition in 2013 and, in 2015, was the first Japanese chef to receive the Golden Egg at RED U-35; opened the sustainable grill restaurant The Burn in Minami Aoyama in 2018; wrote Vegan Recipes (Shibata Shoten); runs the company NO CODE; and was appointed consultant chef at FORNI in July 2022. Tabelog gives the restaurant’s opening day as 3 November 2020. Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: respect for the tradition of handmade dishes, with the 24 solar terms expressed through Italian and Kyoto ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: Roman-style pizza from the okudosan oven; prix fixe courses.

anecdotes.text: When everyone greeted guests with "Hello!" instead of "Irasshaimase", a September 2026 diner thought it a lovely touch.
"Although I arrived 30 minutes late, they welcomed me without any sign of annoyance" — and wrote a message on a friend’s plate on request, August 2026.
A diner who has come back each autumn for the chestnut afternoon tea found the chestnut flavour weaker than a few years before but the Mont Blanc exceptional — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・ピザ・パスタ、中京区油小路通二条下る二条油小路町284 1F、毎日 11:30〜14:30・17:30〜21:30、年中無休、予約可、キャンセル料 (2日前50%、前日70%、当日100%)、サービス料15% (表示料金は税・サービス料込み)、105席 (テラス18席を含むテーブル99席、個室1室6名、個室料 昼12,700円・夜19,000円)、禁煙 (ホテル内に喫煙所)、駐車場23台 (8,000円以上で2時間無料)、子供可・キッズメニュー、ドレスコードはカジュアル、2020年11月3日オープン、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年10月、英語): ランチのコース約6,000円と4杯のペアリング4,000円、淡路の製麺所のカサレッチェと牛肉のラグー、丸いティラミス、Divertito 19,000円、クアトロフォルマッジのピザ4,800円、丹波栗のモンブラン、アフタヌーンティー、朝食のセミビュッフェ。

cultural_comfort.note: A five-star hotel restaurant with an English website and online booking (TableCheck); many international guests (September 2026).

places.name: 蛸八 (Tako Hachi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo dishes: sashimi, kizushi, grilled and blanched anago or hamo, uzaku, fried small taro, kara-age and fried eggplant, with soy-based seasonings; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, eel, duck and chicken make up most of the menu; the egg tofu starter is egg (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); often full, so book — though same-day calls and walk-ins have found a seat (July 2025; July 2026). 11 counter seats, packed close (Tabelog; March 2025). The menu on the wall has no prices; bills ran about ¥6,000–7,000 a head (2025–2026 reviews). Cash only; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Takoyakushi-dori just west of Shinkyogoku; 4 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu) (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takoyakushi-dori just west of Shinkyogoku — 4 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small family-run Kyoto kappo counter of seasonal dishes for sake (2025–2026 reviews) · egg tofu with grated yuzu to start (July 2025; July 2026) · kizushi, sashimi (squid, bonito, octopus, sea bream), anago grilled or blanched to order, anago don, grilled hamo, uzaku, fish somen, zuiki with sesame, grilled guji, grilled shirako in winter, seared bonito, roast duck with Worcestershire sauce, fried small taro (a regular’s must-order), fried eggplant, kara-age (2025–2026 reviews) · sake from Kyoto and beyond, highballs, bottled beer (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · Takoyakushi, a family counter for Kyoto food and sake] An 11-seat counter behind a noren in the Shinkyogoku arcade area, run by a family — a couple behind the counter — where plain-sounding Kyoto dishes come out exceptionally well: egg tofu with yuzu, kizushi, anago grilled or blanched to order, hamo and uzaku in summer, fried small taro, and roast duck with Worcestershire sauce. Praised by food writers and on local TV, so it is often full; book. No prices on the wall menu; most pay ¥6,000–7,000. Cash only; closed Wednesday and Sunday.

roles: Family-run; a couple at the counter (2026 reviews), unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: "family-run" (March 2025, July 2026); "the couple running the counter exudes a wonderful vibe" (March 2026); "the head chef and the owner were friendly" (April 2025). Reviewers came after an article by a former editor-in-chief of DANCHU (July 2025), a piece on Waraku web (July 2026) and a KBS television feature with Takuzo Kadoya and Yoshimasa Kondo (March 2026). A March 2025 regular noted the counter had grown from 6 to 11 seats and bills had risen.
chef_bio.specialty: Anago; kizushi; fried small taro; egg tofu.

anecdotes.text: "After taking my order, they skillfully removed the bones and quickly blanched it in hot water before serving." — of the anago, May 2025.
"The restaurant is family-run, creating a wonderful atmosphere. The fried small potatoes are exceptional, and I always make sure to order them!" — July 2026.
"I particularly enjoyed the area at the counter where you can grill your own food; the seared bonito was especially delightful." — March 2026.
A March 2025 regular found the counter much more crowded than before, with dishes arriving in a rush and a bill 1.5 times higher, but still good value for the quality.

places.name: 祇園 河道 (Gion Kawamichi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Small seasonal plates — sashimi, sake-steamed clams, tempura, beef and Kujo-negi udon — with dashi and soy seasonings; no gluten information (2023–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the appetiser is a clam broth, and the menu is built on fish, hamo, beef and sea urchin (2024–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog publishes no hours; reviewers came in the evening (2023–2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); walk-ins have been seated at the counter (October 2023). 14 seats: 8 at the counter and 6 at tables; smoking only at the counter (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; March 2023). Second floor of 幕間ビル on Yamatooji-dori north of Shijo, opposite the Minami-za; 2 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2023–2025 reviews). Opened 28 October 2010 (Tabelog); a November 2025 regular wrote that it marked its 14th anniversary that October.
places.neighborhood: Yamatooji-dori facing the Minami-za, north of Shijo — 2 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion izakaya of à la carte seasonal plates at fair prices, from a handwritten menu (2023–2026 reviews) · three standing starters and a daily list; omakase sashimi in one-bite pieces; hamo and matsutake dobin-mushi (October 2023) · hamo sashimi, hamo with scrambled egg, prosciutto and peach, fried small taro and yuba, beef and Kujo-negi udon (July 2024) · clam broth with sesame tofu, kombu-cured fish with Tosa-vinegar jelly, nameko with mekabu, roast beef with sea urchin, tempura (November 2025) · sake such as Toyo Bijin and Tatenokawa, shochu, white wine, highballs (2023–2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Gion, a woman's counter facing the Minami-za] A small second-floor izakaya on Yamatooji opposite the Minami-za, whose lights fill the window at night, run by its woman owner-chef with one helper. A handwritten menu of seasonal plates — omakase sashimi in small bites, hamo in summer, kombu-cured fish, roast beef with sea urchin — at prices reviewers call reasonable; a November 2025 regular paid just over ¥10,000. Regulars chat at the counter; solo diners are welcome. Seen on Kazuhiko Ota's TV show. Cash only; smoking at the counter only. Hours are not published; call ahead.

roles: Owner-chef, a woman (2023–2025 reviews), unnamed; one helper
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: "a small establishment operated by just the owner and a male server", with local regulars chatting with the owner at the counter (March 2023); "run by a woman with experience as an office lady", offering à la carte dishes at reasonable prices, and featured on a show by Kazuhiko Ota about Gion (October 2023); "a friendly little restaurant run by a warm female chef" that marked its 14th anniversary in October 2025 (November 2025). Tabelog gives the opening date as 28 October 2010.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal small plates; hamo; omakase sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "From the window, you can enjoy a stunning view of the illuminated Minami-za Theatre" — November 2025.
An October 2023 visitor watched maiko pass below the second-floor window, and was served an off-menu vinegared dish and miso soup with the rice and pickles.
"A woman was efficiently serving dishes and drinks. I didn’t get a chance to chat, but everything was reasonably priced and delicious." — April 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-style Chinese: fried noodles, spring rolls, shumai, fried chicken, ankake sauces and fried rice; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dishes use seafood, chicken, beef, egg white and stock-based sauces (2026 reviews).

Reservations for dinner only (Tabelog). Lunch sets ¥1,300 (July and September 2026). No cards or e-money; PayPay and au PAY accepted; no service or table charge (Tabelog). 32 seats: a 12-seat counter on the ground floor and tables upstairs (Tabelog). places.notes: [Kyoto Chinese · Mototanaka, egg-white fried rice] A neighbourhood Kyoto-Chinese restaurant by Mototanaka Station, famous for its egg-white ankake fried rice (¥1,100) — moist fried rice under a fluffy, creamy egg-white sauce — and a crisp ankake yakisoba that one regular has ordered for 25 years. Founder 田口 茂雄 was honoured as a Contemporary Master Craftsman (2017) and received the Medal with Yellow Ribbon (2020); after the founder's death in 2021, 田口 弥生 has run the shop with a son. Lunch sets ¥1,300; cash or PayPay. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Carries on the shop with a son since the founder’s death in 2021 (official site)
Kitchen led by a younger chef reviewers call "Waka" (August 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founder and manager 田口 茂雄 died on 16 May 2021; the founder was named a Contemporary Master Craftsman (現代の名工) by the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare in fiscal 2017 and received the Medal with Yellow Ribbon (黄綬褒章) in spring 2020. In a notice signed 田口 弥生, the writer says "主人が他界いたしました" (my husband has passed away) and "これからは息子と共に華祥をがんばっていきたい" (from now on I will carry on Kasho with my son). The operating company is 株式会社 華祥企画. An August 2026 reviewer calls the current owner "Waka", a master of the wok; a September 2026 regular of about 25 years, who first came to the earlier site near Hyakumanben, wondered whether ownership had changed as the staff seemed young. Tabelog Chinese WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2024.
chef_bio.specialty: Egg-white ankake fried rice; ankake yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: "I’ve loved their an-kake yakisoba (stir-fried noodles with sauce) since then, and it’s been about 25 years now." The same regular felt the portion was slightly smaller than before. — September 2026.
"The current owner, whom I affectionately call 'Waka,' has truly mastered the art of cooking with the Chinese wok" — August 2026.
"I think this is the first time I’ve felt 'comfortable' while enjoying Chinese food in my life." — September 2026.
"The cost-effective lunch has now increased to JPY 1,300! I really felt the impact of rising prices." — July 2026.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, and the meze include hummus, eggplant salad, imam bayildi (cold eggplant and vegetables), stuffed peppers and vine leaves with pilaf and a spicy vegetable paste; several other meze use yogurt or cheese, and the soups are not described (official menu; Tabelog).

Reservations by phone, recommended for weekend lunch (official site; August and October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay, d Barai and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-dori north of Sanjo, 3rd floor — 2 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Turkish cooking in the line of Ottoman court cuisine; kebabs and stretchy Turkish ice cream; courses (Tabelog shop text; official site) · meze: five-kind meze platter ¥1,950, vine leaves stuffed with pilaf ¥1,100, hummus ¥800, imam bayildi ¥980, cacik ¥750, Antep ezme ¥750, Circassian chicken with walnuts ¥750, Albanian-style fried liver ¥900, soups of the day ¥650 (official menu, undated) · weekend lunch about ¥1,800–2,650 with lentil soup, meze, Turkish bread, a kebab or stew, rice pudding and tea (August 2026) · lamb shish and chicken kebabs over charcoal, pide with minced meat and egg, grilled cheese, oven-baked lamb with vegetables (2026 reviews) · Turkish beer, wine, ayran, Turkish tea and coffee (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Turkish · Kawaramachi Sanjo, kebabs and meze upstairs] A Turkish restaurant on the third floor of a building on Kawaramachi north of Sanjo, open since 2002, decorated with Turkish tiles: meze platters with fresh bread — hummus, eggplant, ezme — then charcoal-grilled lamb and chicken kebabs or pide, and a cold rice pudding that reviewers rave about. Weekend lunch sets run about ¥1,800–2,650; dinner courses are big. The shop says its meat is all certified halal, though wine and beer are served. Weekday dinner; lunch at weekends. Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST 100 2022–24, 2026.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: authentic Turkish cooking that carries on Ottoman court cuisine, "one of the world’s three great cuisines", and the only Turkish specialist in Kyoto; groups up to 40 by reservation. Per the Tabelog shop text: kebabs, Turkish ice cream and courses, with all meat certified halal. Opened 9 December 2002 (Tabelog). Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST "Tabelog 100" 2022, 2023, 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Meze platter; kebabs; rice pudding (sütlaç).

anecdotes.text: "However, the rice pudding at the end was incredibly delicious and left me amazed! I would want to repeat just that." — August 2026.
"The flavors remind me of my trip to Turkey. It was easier to eat than what I had there, so it might have been adjusted to suit Japanese tastes." — September 2026.
"I chose the course with the most dishes, but that turned out to be a mistake... The portions were quite large" — September 2026.

places.name: 京料理 本家たん熊 本店 (Honke Tankuma Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Courses include tempura (油物), red-miso soup and dashi-simmered dishes; the shop prepares halal, kosher and vegan courses on request, but publishes no gluten information (official site).
places.vegan_detail: A shojin kaiseki of vegetables only, with vegetable dashi and no alcohol or the five pungent roots, ¥22,000 plus 15% service — book two days ahead (official site). The standard kaiseki is built on suppon, fish and dashi.
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (last order 19:30); closed Sunday, the 2nd and 4th Monday and 25 December–6 January, with a calendar of closures on the official site (official site). Tabelog lists Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–19:30. Bookings from one person, up to three months ahead, by phone or TableCheck; vegan menus two days ahead, kosher seven days ahead, some halal menus the same day (official site). 15% service charge (official site; Tabelog). Seven or eight private rooms for 1 to 35 people; kawadoko riverside seating 1 May–30 September, 17:00–22:00, seat fee ¥1,650 (official site). Children’s platter ¥3,000 by booking (Tabelog). English menu; the okami speaks English (Tabelog; official site). Cards (Tabelog). 5 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn, 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Bukkoji, between the Takase and Kamo rivers — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto ryotei of "monmo" cooking — ingredients served as they are — founded in 1928; famous for suppon (official site) · Kyoto kaiseki: Suma ¥22,000 (11 dishes, with the signature 丸吸 suppon soup), Kocho ¥33,000 (11 dishes, with 丸鍋, a one-person suppon hot pot), Hana-utage ¥19,800 for 10 or more; seasonal matsutake kaiseki to ¥55,000; all plus 15% service (official site) · halal kaiseki ¥33,000 and special ¥44,000, halal wagyu and chicken course ¥33,000, certified by the Kyoto Halal Council; kosher menu (Kosher Japan); shojin kaiseki of vegetables only ¥22,000 (official site) · over 150 wines and 30 sakes, chosen by the fourth-generation owner, a certified sommelier (official site) · 2019–25 reviews: suppon liver and shoulder sashimi, zosui, dobin-mushi, matsutake, ayu with roe
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Kiyamachi, a 1928 ryotei famous for suppon] A sukiya-style ryotei between the Takase River and the Kamo, founded in 1928 by 栗栖 熊三郎 at a five-seat counter and now run by the family's fourth generation, Junichi Kurisu (from September 2026), a sommelier who travelled some 80 countries. The kaiseki is 'monmo' — ingredients served as they are — and its signature is suppon, in the 丸吸 soup or the 丸鍋 hot pot. It was among the first Kyoto ryotei with halal certification (2014) and serves kosher and vegan kaiseki on request. Courses from ¥22,000 plus 15% service; riverside kawadoko in summer. Booking required; closed Sunday.

roles: 4th-generation executive chef and owner from September 2026 (official site)
Sommelier: A.S.I. Sommelier Diploma, WSET Level 3 Wines and Sake, J.S.A. Sake Diploma (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded on 13 December 1928 by 栗栖 熊三郎 and 栗栖 フミ子 as a five-seat counter by the Takase River; the name joins 丹 of Tanba, the founder’s home, with 熊 of 熊三郎; moved to the present site in 1954 as たん熊南店 and opened the Kyoto Takashimaya shop the same year; renamed 本家 たん熊 in 1989 (the separate たん熊北店 was founded in 1957); the third generation, Kumasaburo Kurisu (born 栗栖 富滋), took the name in 1991 and is now senior advisor; Junichi Kurisu trained at the tea-kaiseki house 東京 柿傳, joined in 2009 and became the fourth-generation owner in September 2026, having travelled about 80 countries; the okami, Haruko Kurisu, speaks English. Two Michelin stars in the Kyoto/Osaka 2010 guide; one star in the 2024 guide. Halal certification from the Kyoto Halal Council (2014); kosher certification from Kosher Japan (2023).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "monmo" cooking — 「もんも」 is Kyoto dialect for "as it is" — drawing out the flavour of carefully chosen natural ingredients without ornament; and food diversity, so that visitors of any faith or diet can enjoy Kyoto cuisine.
chef_bio.specialty: 丸吸 (suppon soup); 丸鍋 (suppon hot pot); うずら饅頭, 玉子宝楽.

anecdotes.text: A 2015 review of the course lists the signature one-person suppon hot pot, yudofu and Kyoto-style dashimaki (November 2015).
"The soft-shelled turtle was exquisite, with its tender, collagen-rich meat complemented by a gentle ginger broth" — October 2025.
An April 2024 business dinner began with suppon liver and shoulder sashimi and ended with zosui.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tankuma.jp): 京料理 本家たん熊、創業より100年の「もんも」な京料理 (「もんも」は京都の言葉で「そのままな」)、1928年 (昭和3年) 12月13日に初代 栗栖 熊三郎と妻 栗栖 フミ子が高瀬川のほとりで5名がけのカウンターから創業、名は出身地の丹波の「丹」と熊三郎の「熊」、名物は丸鍋 (すっぽん鍋)・うずら饅頭・玉子宝楽、1954年に現在地へ移転し京都高島屋店を出店、1989年に「本家 たん熊」に改称、1991年に三代目 栗栖 富滋が栗栖 熊三郎を襲名、2009年に栗栖 純一が東京 柿傳での修行を経て入店、2010年ミシュラン2つ星、2014年京都ハラール評議会の認証、2023年 Kosher Japan の認証、2026年9月に栗栖 純一が四代目主人に就任、女将 栗栖晴子は英語可、ワイン150種以上・日本酒30種、本店: 下京区木屋町通仏光寺下る和泉屋町168、17時〜22時 (L.O. 19時30分)、日曜・第2第4月曜・12月25日〜1月6日休み、須磨22,000円、胡蝶33,000円 (サービス料15%別)、精進会席22,000円 (2日前まで)、ハラール会席33,000円、ハラール特別会席44,000円、納涼床5月1日〜9月30日 (席料1,650円)、ミシュランガイド京都・大阪2024で一つ星、店舗は本店と京都高島屋店。食べログ: 日本料理・すっぽん、サービス料15%、50席・個室7、英語メニュー、お子様の盛り合わせ3,000円 (要予約)、1928年12月13日創業。口コミ (2015〜2025年、英語): すっぽんの肝と肩の刺身、雑炊、土瓶蒸し、子持ち鮎。

Halal menus certified by the Kyoto Halal Council; all ingredients halal-certified, no pork or alcohol (official site).

places.name: てらまち福田 (Teramachi Fukuda)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Many dishes use dashi, soy or miso, and the menu has tempura, fried dishes, ramen and somen; no gluten information is published (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, chicken, duck and suppon dishes built on dashi; even the vegetable dishes use dashi or fish (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed Tuesday and Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). Lunch takes no bookings and is cash only (official site; July 2026); queues can form before 12:00 and the saba-zushi can sell out (March 2026). Dinner bookings taken; courses from ¥5,000 by booking, full charge for same-day cancellations (official site). 20 seats (6 at the counter, three tables for 4); non-smoking; no children under junior-high age; no strong perfume; English menu (Tabelog). Cards and cashless at dinner only (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor of えびすテラス on Teramachi south of Bukkoji, opposite the Watts 100-yen shop — walk to the back of the 1st floor and up the stairs (official site). Opened 5 July 2012 as 美碧 and renamed Teramachi Fukuda on 5 June 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi south of Bukkoji, quiet side of Shijo — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kappo-standard Japanese cooking served the casual izakaya way, by owner-chef 福田 竹志 (official site) · lunch (tax included): daily set ¥1,000, saba simmered in sansho miso ¥1,100, tendon ¥1,300, kaisen-don ¥1,500, saba-zushi with seasonal nyumen or somen ¥1,500 (official site); clam ramen ¥1,500 (March 2026) · evening: suppon dobin-mushi, zosui or ramen ¥2,600 each; seasonal fish salt-grilled, fried or sake-steamed ¥2,400; Kyoto duck roast ¥1,800; kombu-cured sasami ¥1,200; tempura platter (about 7 pieces) ¥1,650; sashimi platter (about 8 kinds) ¥2,000 (official site) · small dishes: potato salad with prosciutto ¥550, burdock with sesame ¥600, homemade raisin butter ¥700, steamed onion with sea-urchin soy ¥850, house squid satsuma-age ¥850, daikon and millet-fu dengaku ¥900, fried Kyoto mochi-pork kakuni ¥900, tempura spring roll of toro yuba and salted uni ¥900, beef tendon and atsuage ¥1,100 (official site) · hamo cutlet, saba-zushi, roast beef (2026 reviews) · courses ¥5,000, ¥7,700 and up (official site) · a long sake list; wine by the bottle only (June 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Teramachi, kappo cooking at izakaya prices] A second-floor room on Teramachi south of Bukkoji, hard to find — through the building and up the back stairs — where owner-chef 福田 竹志, in Japanese cooking since 18, serves kappo-standard dishes the casual izakaya way. Order the sea-urchin-soy onion, the toro-yuba and uni spring roll, a hamo cutlet in summer, and finish with the house saba-zushi; or come at lunch for the saba-zushi and somen set (¥1,500) or the clam ramen. A strong sake list. Lunch is walk-in and cash only; dinner by booking. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday; no children under junior-high age.

roles: Owner and cook (official site: "店主・料理人 福田竹志")
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: in Japanese cooking since the age of 18, aiming to serve kaiseki-style dishes casually, for locals and visitors alike; the menu follows the four phases of a season (走り、旬、名残り) with orthodox technique, "過ぎず、程よく" (not too much, just right). Per Tabelog: opened 5 July 2012 as 美碧 (みどり) and reopened under the present name on 5 June 2020. Tabelog Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "過ぎず、程よく" — the handwork of a kappo with the ease of an izakaya.
chef_bio.specialty: Saba-zushi; steamed onion with sea-urchin soy; suppon dishes.

anecdotes.text: A regular on a ninth visit (May 2026) had hamo with jelly and fried young ayu, and finished as always with the saba-zushi.
A March 2026 diner who arrived ten minutes before opening found the saba-zushi sold out early and the noodle soup weak.
A July 2026 diner asked about a dish listed only with niboshi as a condiment, and the kitchen kindly made it with somen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (teramachi-fukuda.jp): てらまち福田、店主・料理人 福田竹志、18歳から和食の世界、懐石で提供するようなお料理を気軽に、「過ぎず、程よく」、走り・旬・名残り、割烹のような手技と居酒屋のような気軽さ、下京区寺町通仏光寺下る恵美須之町528 えびすテラス2F (Watts の向かいのビル、1F 奥の階段)、昼 12:00〜13:30 (L.O) 14:00 close、夜 17:00〜22:00 (L.O) 22:30 close、昼は予約不可、火・水曜定休 (2024年11月から)、ランチ: 日替わり1,000円、鯖の山椒味噌煮定食1,100円、天丼定食1,300円、海鮮丼定食1,500円、鯖寿司と季節の煮麺 (素麺) セット1,500円、夜: すっぽんの土瓶蒸し・雑炊・ラーメン各2,600円、京都産鴨ロース1,800円、天ぷら盛り合わせ1,650円、造り盛り合わせ2,000円、生ハムのポテトサラダ550円、玉葱の蒸し焼き雲丹醤油850円、トロ湯波と塩雲丹の春巻天900円、コース5,000円から (要予約、当日キャンセルは全額)。食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、旧店名 美碧、20席、禁煙、中学生未満不可、英語メニュー、夜のみカード・QR 可、2012年7月5日オープン、2020年6月5日に改称、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2024。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年7月、英語): 鯖寿司、鱧カツ、clam のラーメン、昼は現金のみ、ワインはボトルのみ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; lunch is walk-in and cash only; book for dinner; no children under junior-high age.

places.name: kashiya
places.gf_detail: Ask. Plated desserts mix mochi, uirou and bean paste with crepe, sablé, cookie and roll-cake elements; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Many plates use cream, cream cheese, ice cream or butter; no vegan items are marked (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–19:00 (last order 18:00); closed Tuesday; temporary closures on Instagram (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Photos of the food only — no other photos or video, to avoid disturbing guests (Tabelog; October 2026). 16 seats at tables, front and back rooms, with garden green at the back (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards (AMEX) and QR payments (Tabelog). Takeaway sweets in a showcase at the door (June 2026). On Nijo-dori east of the Kamo River (June and August 2026); 6 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn exit 11, 7 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 12 September 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo-dori east of the Kamo River — 6 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Plated desserts that blend wagashi and Western pastry, served with tea or coffee in a long, narrow machiya (2026 reviews) · plates named for their pairings: Amazon cacao and banana ¥1,600 (June 2026), grapes and cream cheese ¥1,400 (October 2026), amanatsu and yomogi, banana and chocolate, passion fruit and coconut, nashi and osmanthus (May–September 2026); anmitsu with shiratama and kuromitsu (June 2026) · takeaway: passion-fruit uirou and miso-walnut cookies (¥900 together, May 2026), Amazon cocoa sand ¥500 (May 2026), coconut-mango roll cake ¥1,200 (August 2026), salted-caramel kinako sablé (October 2026), smoked pickled nuts (June 2026) · blend coffee ¥550, café latte, tea ¥600 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Café & sweets · Nijo, wagashi-meets-pastry plates in a machiya] A quiet dessert café in a long, narrow townhouse on Nijo-dori just east of the Kamo River, with garden green at the back. The plates pair a fruit with something unexpected — Amazon cacao and banana, grapes and cream cheese, amanatsu and yomogi, nashi and osmanthus — mixing mochi, uirou and bean paste with crepe and sablé; the anmitsu is the simpler classic. Takeaway sweets in the front case. Photos of the food only. Reviewers praise the drinks; a few found the welcome cool and the house rules strict. 12:00–19:00, closed Tuesday.

roles: No person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Opened 12 September 2014 (Tabelog). Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2018–2020, Cafe "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022 and Cafe WEST 2025. A September 2026 reviewer notes it was serving plated desserts before the recent wave of dessert-course shops.
chef_bio.specialty: Plated seasonal desserts; Amazon cacao and banana; anmitsu.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor, wary after mixed reviews of the service, was met with a silent stare at the door but found the sweets and the drinks exceptional.
A May 2026 visitor asking for a plate to share was told there were none, and found the photography rules unusual.
A September 2026 colleague’s dessert was hefty; the coffee alone had "a perfect balance of acidity".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・スイーツ、左京区吉永町270-3、京阪三条駅11番出口から徒歩約6分、神宮丸太町駅2番出口から約7分、12:00〜19:00 (L.O. 18:00)、火曜休み、臨時休業は Instagram で、予約不可、16席 (テーブル)、禁煙、カード (AMEX)・QR 可、テイクアウト可、料理以外の撮影不可、2014年9月12日オープン、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018〜2020、カフェ百名店 2021・2022、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): アマゾンカカオとバナナ1,600円、ぶどうとクリームチーズ1,400円、甘夏とよもぎ、梨と金木犀、あんみつ、パッションフルーツのういろう、ロールケーキ1,200円、ブレンドコーヒー550円。

places.name: 楽庵 (Raku An)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A fish-and-dashi izakaya: sashimi with soy, Saikyo-miso grills, tempura, kara-age and simmered dishes; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, eel, duck and dashi-based dishes make up the menu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30), Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Usually fully booked: reservations a must (May 2026). 30 seats with a counter; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On the west side of Takakura-dori by Ayakoji, a short walk from Shijo Karasuma (November 2025; May and August 2026); 193 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takakura-dori by Ayakoji, south of Shijo Karasuma — 3 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Busy Japanese izakaya of fish, dashi and a long sake list, much loved by regulars at the counter (2026 reviews) · sashimi platter of about eight kinds (sea bream, yokowa, bonito tataki, shima-aji, octopus, swordfish, sweet shrimp) · grilled guji (amadai), sawara in Saikyo miso, grilled natural eel, squid legs in Saikyo miso ¥780 · hamo tempura, oyster tempura, white shrimp and new-onion tempura ¥980, kara-age · lotus-root manju ¥1,000, duck manju, flounder liver with ponzu ¥780, stewed meat, simmered taro, beef tendon and daikon, nama-fu dengaku, matsutake and hamo dobin-mushi, unagi sushi · pickled mizu-nasu ¥780 · a fruit dessert to finish (April–October 2026) · sake such as Juyondai and 黒龍; Ebisu and Sapporo beer (May–October 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo Karasuma, fish, dashi and sake by Ayakoji] A busy, always-booked izakaya on Takakura-dori near Ayakoji, a few minutes from Shijo Karasuma, where regulars fill the counter. The broth is the star: duck or lotus-root manju in dashi, matsutake and hamo dobin-mushi in autumn; then an eight-kind sashimi platter, sawara or squid in Saikyo miso, hamo tempura, grilled natural eel. Dishes are made to order and fairly priced — around ¥6,000–8,000 a head in 2026 — with a deep sake list. Book ahead. Closed Sunday and holidays.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a counter full of regulars and a friendly, chatty owner (September 2026); a September 2026 reviewer heard that the usual chef is now running a new establishment. Tabelog Izakaya "Tabelog 100" 2022 and Izakaya WEST 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Lotus-root manju; sashimi platter; Saikyo-miso grills.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 regular came back for the duck manju, a favourite, and found it as good as remembered.
An April 2026 diner found the dashi the star — "not the kind that hits you hard at first" — and called it a steal for Kyoto.
A September 2026 couple from Kanto ate and drank well for about ¥7,000 a head.

places.name: 麩房老舗 (Fufu Roho)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the shop sells nama-fu, which is wheat gluten, and its dengaku is fried nama-fu with miso (2023–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Nama-fu (wheat gluten with millet, mugwort or sesame) and the house dengaku miso may suit, but no ingredient list is published (2023–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 9:00–18:00 every day; hours may change (Tabelog). Takeaway shop with two seats inside for eating the dengaku (Tabelog; October 2024). In April 2023 the dengaku was limited to 100 servings on Saturdays and Sundays (review). Cash only; no bookings (Tabelog; December 2024). In Nishiki Market, east of Fuyacho; 287 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishiki Market, east of Fuyacho — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto nama-fu (fresh wheat gluten) maker in Nishiki Market (2023–26 reviews) · Kyoto nama-fu dengaku: bite-size fried nama-fu with house dengaku miso (cooked 8 hours, per a 2023 review) and sesame, ¥756 (December 2024) · mini set of five fried nama-fu (awa, goma, yomogi, white) ¥648 (July 2023) · nama-fu to take home: white, awa, yomogi (yomogi-fu ¥432, December 2024), half sizes available, about a month’s shelf life (February 2025) · kuruma-fu (March 2026)
places.notes: [Nama-fu · Nishiki Market, a gluten maker from the 1800s] A nama-fu specialist in Nishiki Market, said by reviewers to date from the Tenpō era (1830s–40s), selling fresh wheat-gluten cakes — plain, millet, sesame, mugwort — to take home, plus hot fried nama-fu dengaku with a long-cooked sweet miso to eat on the two stools inside (about ¥750). Cash only; open daily 9:00–18:00.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a Kyoto nama-fu specialist with nearly 200 years of history (April 2023), in business since the Tenpō era, 1831–1845 (December 2025). The shop website listed on Tabelog (fufusa.com) did not answer on 2026-11-05.
chef_bio.specialty: Nama-fu dengaku.

anecdotes.text: "The nama-fu was cut into bite-sized pieces, topped with rich miso and sesame" — December 2025.
A March 2026 visitor bought dengaku to eat under the cherry blossoms in Arashiyama, and kuruma-fu as a gift.
A June 2024 buyer found the texture chewy but could not tell the flavours apart, and wished the staff had explained them.

places.name: 宮川町 水簾 (Miyagawa Cho Suilen)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Monthly kaiseki with dashi, soy-based sauces, miso and fried courses; no gluten information (official site; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the kaiseki courses are built on fish, shellfish, dashi and a meat course (official site; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 20:00); closed Monday (Tabelog; official site). Courses only, changing monthly: lunch 9 dishes ¥10,000, dinner 12 dishes ¥20,000, with tax, 10% service extra (official site). 20 seats: a 10-seat counter facing the kitchen and its okudo (kamado) on the first floor, three private rooms upstairs (Tabelog; official site). Children welcome in private rooms (Tabelog). Cards accepted; non-smoking (Tabelog). 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 1 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Miyagawa-cho, behind the Minamiza — 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki in a Miyagawa-cho townhouse, changing with the month and with no fixed signature dishes (official site) · lunch 9 dishes ¥10,000, dinner 12 dishes ¥20,000 (official site) · rice cooked in a Nanbu iron pot on the okudo stove, with dashimaki and chirimen sansho, seconds offered (official site; December 2025) · dishes in 2025–26 reviews: soft-shelled turtle chawanmushi, flounder with liver ponzu, hassun with saba sushi, a small hot pot of clams and turnip, a summer consommé served like draft beer, hamo katsu sandwich, herring and eggplant gazpacho-style, Hinamatsuri chirashi bento, New Year white-miso ozoni and mini osechi · sake from around Japan chosen by the head chef (official site)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Miyagawa-cho, behind the Minamiza] A kaiseki restaurant in a townhouse in the Miyagawa-cho geisha district, with a ten-seat counter around the kitchen and its okudo (kamado) downstairs and private rooms above. The courses change monthly — playful seasonal touches like a summer consommé served as "draft beer" — and end with pot-cooked rice and dashimaki, seconds offered. Lunch ¥10,000, dinner ¥20,000 (+10%). There is a sister shop in Tokyo Midtown. Closed Monday.

roles: Executive chef (総料理長, official site; "Munehero Shimatani" on its English page)
chef_bio.background: Opened 22 May 2012 (Tabelog). The group runs this Kyoto honten and a shop in Tokyo Midtown, Akasaka (official site). A December 2025 reviewer saw young chefs working the counter while the head chef was at the Tokyo shop.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: like water that turns from raindrops into a stream, cooking should flow flexibly with the seasons and the people; so as not to forget the season or the guest, the shop deliberately keeps no signature or famous dishes.
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly kaiseki; okudo-cooked rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 guest put the service "among the top-tier hospitality experiences in Kyoto".
A May 2026 diner found the cooking intricate but lacking surprise, and did not think the ¥20,000 course was worth it — "It's more about the location."
A New Year guest found the atmosphere hushed — "not one for a casual, lively gathering" — January 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (suiren-group.com): 宮川町 水簾 京都本店、四季を映す本格和食・京料理、京町家を活かした空間、ランチ全9品10,000円・ディナー全12品20,000円 (税込、サービス料10%別)、ご飯は精米したての米を南部鉄羽釜でおくどさんで炊く、1階カウンター10席、2階個室3室、総料理長 島谷宗宏、看板料理や名物料理はあえて用意しない、料理長が選んだ全国の地酒、東山区宮川筋2-253、定休日 月曜日、京阪祇園四条駅1番出口から徒歩3分、東京ミッドタウン店。食べログ: 日本料理、昼 12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 13:30)、夜 18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 20:00)、月曜休み、コースのみ、20席、個室、カード可、禁煙、2012年5月22日オープン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): すっぽんの茶碗蒸し、鯖寿司、生ビールのようなコンソメ、鱧カツサンド、だし巻きとご飯のおかわり、もてなし、値段に見合わないという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; ask for the counter or a private room; English page on the official site.

places.name: グリル小宝 (Grill Kodakara)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: omurice and hayashi rice come under a demi-glace sauce, and the menu runs to fried shrimp, chicken katsu and crab-cream croquettes (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the omurice rice holds beef, every main is meat, egg or seafood, and the sauce is demi-glace (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–20:30; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). No reservations: queues of 10–50 people form before the 11:30 opening, with waits of 30–60 minutes; orders are taken in the line, so food arrives as soon as you sit; evenings are often easier (2026 reviews). 33 seats at tables, no shared tables (Tabelog; October 2026). Takeaway. Cards, IC cards and QR payments; non-smoking (Tabelog). 3 min from the Dobutsuen-mae or Okazakimichi bus stops; 15 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, north of the zoo and Heian Shrine — 3 min from the Dobutsuen-mae bus stop
places.cuisine: Old-school yoshoku, famous for omurice (2026 reviews) · omurice: rice with beef, onion and green peas in a thin omelette under the house demi-glace (called "Dobi sauce"), ¥1,540 in October 2026, the small size already large · hayashi rice, hamburg steak, fried shrimp, chicken katsu, crab-cream croquettes, fried rice with table pickles · tomato juice (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Okazaki, the omurice queue] A retro yoshoku in Okazaki that has drawn queues for decades for one dish: omurice — beefy ketchup rice in a soft omelette drowned in a rich house demi-glace (¥1,540; the small is plenty). Hayashi rice, fried shrimp and crab-cream croquettes are the other favourites. Expect 30–60 minutes in line from before the 11:30 opening; your order is taken while you wait. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the name takes one character from Takarabune, the famous Gion yoshoku restaurant where the previous owner trained. An October 2026 review gives the founding year as 1961. Tabelog Yoshoku "Tabelog 100" 2020, 2022 and Yoshoku WEST 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Omurice with house demi-glace.

anecdotes.text: "When you ask for water, the staff has a wonderful trick, so be sure to request it!" — October 2026.
An October 2026 diner noted the Tabelog menu’s old omurice price of ¥970 against the ¥1,540 paid.
About 20 people were ahead and 30–40 behind at opening; many left on seeing the line — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (grillkodakara.com): グリル小宝、左京区岡崎北御所町46、毎週火曜水曜定休、11:30-20:30。食べログ: 洋食・オムライス、市バス動物園前・岡崎道から徒歩3分、月・木〜日 11:30〜20:30、火・水休み、予約不可、33席 (テーブルのみ)、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、店名は先代が修業した祇園の洋食店 Takarabune の一字から、洋食百名店 2020・2022、洋食 WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年9〜11月、英語): オムライス1,540円、デミグラスソース、ハヤシライス、エビフライ、カニクリームコロッケ、開店前から行列、並んでいる間に注文、1961年創業。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue outside; staff take orders in the line; cards accepted.

places.name: しろはとベーカリー (Shirohato Bakery)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery — whole-wheat loaves, French bread, cream buns, bagels (some with brown rice) (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain loaves such as the 100% whole-wheat bread and brown-rice bagels may suit, but the cream buns use custard and other breads carry butter, cheese or meat; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–18:00, Tuesday to Saturday; closed Sunday and Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Takeaway only, no eat-in (Tabelog). Reservations possible (Tabelog). Popular items sell out by afternoon: in September 2026 a door notice at 17:00 said little stock was left (2026 reviews). Cash or PayPay; no cards (Tabelog). Ground floor of ヴィラート押小路, 3 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Oshikoji, north of Karasuma Oike — 3 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Small neighbourhood bakery of simple, low-priced breads, most around ¥200 (2026 reviews) · cream bun with homemade custard ¥170, the best seller; chocolate cream bun ¥190; anpan ¥190; rye anpan ¥190 · 100% whole-wheat bread, plain and with figs; brown-rice bread; bagels with 20% brown rice, brown-rice cheese bagel, shiso-and-pastrami bagel ¥210 · umashio butter French bread ¥190 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bakery · Karasuma Oike, ¥200 breads] A tiny bakery with a white-dove sign near Karasuma Oike, opened in 2013, known for nostalgic, cheap breads: a soft cream bun with homemade custard (¥170) that reviewers call the best around, anpan, and healthier loaves — 100% whole-wheat bread, brown-rice bagels. Takeaway only; things sell out by late afternoon. Pay cash or PayPay. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 22 January 2013 (Tabelog). Tabelog Bread WEST "Tabelog 100" 2020, 2022, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Cream bun; whole-wheat and brown-rice breads.

anecdotes.text: At 17:00 a note on the door read, in effect, "Limited stock available. Please come in if that's okay with you"; the reviewer remembered "the kind smile of the elderly lady who served me" — September 2026.
The shiso-and-pastrami bagel and rye anpan had just come out of the oven at 11:40 — October 2026.
An October 2026 reviewer scored the service "nothing special, neither good nor bad" and found most items sold out by 14:00.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: しろはとベーカリー、パン・ベーグル・サンドイッチ、中京区西押小路町102-2 ヴィラート押小路 1F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩3分、火〜土 10:00〜18:00、日・月休み、予約可、イートインなし、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、禁煙、2013年1月22日オープン、パン WEST 百名店 2020・2022・2026。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): クリームパン170円 (自家製カスタード)、チョコクリームパン190円、あんぱん190円、全粒粉100%の食パン、いちじくパン、玄米入りベーグル、しそとパストラミのベーグル210円、Umashio butter French bread 190円、夕方には売り切れ。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter bakery; PayPay or cash; go before afternoon.

places.name: いそやま (Isoyama)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi and soy-based Japanese cooking with fried dishes (kara-age, fried fugu, beef cutlet), udon, crab shumai and a curry; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, eel, fugu, wagyu and chicken dishes built on dashi (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Course from 18:00 (all guests start together when the noren goes up); à la carte from 21:00, closing time not fixed; closed days not published (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Book ahead, online (July 2026); a reviewer found it while looking for somewhere open at 22:00 (July 2026). 8 seats at an L-shaped counter; children welcome, strollers allowed (June 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). In Pontocho alley No. 25 (先斗町25番路地), hard to find on a map — look for the alley number; 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn, 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; June 2026).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, alley No. 25 — 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese counter cooking by a young owner-chef: a course at 18:00 (¥12,000 in August and October 2026), à la carte after 21:00 (2026 reviews) · course: about 10 seasonal dishes, sashimi eaten without soy sauce, swordfish with sesame, udon in broth, abalone rice porridge (the specialty), clay-pot rice with refills, peanut rice (June–October 2026) · à la carte: umaki of charcoal-grilled dashimaki and eel, eggplant with sesame vinegar, karasumi mochi, squid sashimi with plum jelly, salt-seared yellowtail, mackerel dried with soy, hamo, chicken-wing kara-age, fried aji, jako fried rice (2025) · fried ginkgo, wagyu tataki, crab shumai, fugu sashimi and fried fugu, charcoal-grilled sawara, beef cutlet, white-miso soup, "Iso Curry" on butter rice (October 2026) · rare sakes, wine, Mars whisky highball (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese counter · Pontocho, course early, à la carte late] An 8-seat L-shaped counter down Pontocho's alley No. 25, where a young owner cooks alone in front of you. At 18:00 everyone sits down to a course of about ten dishes (¥12,000 in 2026) — abalone rice porridge is the house specialty, and the clay-pot rice comes back for seconds; from 21:00 it turns à la carte, with umaki grilled over charcoal, karasumi mochi, fugu in season and an 'Iso Curry' to finish. Rare sakes and wine. Look for the alley number, not the map pin. Book ahead; cash only.

roles: Young owner-chef who runs the shop alone (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a young owner runs the 8-seat counter alone (October 2026), trained at a famous restaurant in Osaka before opening (July 2026), and plays Showa-era pop songs (October 2026); an October 2026 reviewer says the shop was featured in the Michelin Guide a year after opening. A September 2025 reviewer calls the owner young and a wine lover with a wide wine list, and says karasumi is made in a large batch at the end of the year.
chef_bio.specialty: Abalone rice porridge; umaki; karasumi mochi.

anecdotes.text: "They allowed us to bring in the stroller, and they were very accommodating even when my child was crying." — June 2026.
"It’s a bit tricky to find on Google Maps, so it’s easier to look for it by the alley number." — June 2026.
"The young owner runs the place by himself, allowing guests to enjoy watching the meticulous cooking right in front of them!" — October 2026.
An October 2026 diner found the 2.5-hour course passed quickly, with Showa-era pop songs playing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区鍋屋町212-3 先斗町25番路地、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、祇園四条駅から4分、コースは18:00から、21:00からアラカルト (終了時間は未定)、予約可、8席、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 若い店主が一人で営む、大阪の名店で修業、開店1年でミシュランに掲載との記述、コース12,000円、鮑の粥、土鍋ご飯のおかわり、ピーナッツご飯、う巻き、胡麻酢、からすみ餅、ふぐ、牛カツ、Iso Curry、珍しい日本酒、子連れ歓迎、路地の番号を目印に。

cultural_comfort.note: Book the 18:00 course online or come after 21:00 for à la carte; cash only.

places.name: 先斗町 鮨いし屋 (Pontocho Sushi Ishi Ya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase courses of sushi with soy sauce, tempura, simmered and grilled dishes and red miso soup; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2023–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi, sashimi, fish and Kyoto beef courses with dashi-based soups (Tabelog; 2023–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 by reservation only, dinner 17:00–23:00; closed Wednesday, though Wednesday bookings can be discussed (Tabelog); a March 2025 reviewer says lunch needs booking by the day before. 12 seats at the counter, private rooms for 2–8, private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). At the end of Pontocho alley No. 24 (先斗町24番路地奥), entered from the Pontocho side, not from the Takase River; easy to miss (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews); 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn Exit 1A (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, end of alley No. 24 — 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Sushi counter whose owner picks the fish from around Japan, with dishes of the Kyoto brand beef "Kyo no Niku" (Tabelog; TableCheck) · Omakase 12 nigiri: seasonal hassun, 12 pieces, red miso soup and dessert, 15 dishes ¥16,500; Special 16 pieces, 19 dishes ¥22,000 (Tabelog) · a ¥9,900 omakase (lunch, March 2025; also March 2026): hassun of firefly squid, broad beans and bamboo shoot, clam soup, sea bream and tuna sashimi, simmered and grilled dishes, spring-cabbage tempura, 6 nigiri, red miso soup, hojicha ice cream · red-vinegar rice; seasonal sake (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Pontocho, at the end of alley 24] A sushi counter hidden at the end of Pontocho's alley No. 24, with fans bearing geisha names on the walls and private rooms behind. The owner chooses fish from around Japan and adds dishes of Kyoto brand beef; the omakase runs to 15 dishes with 12 nigiri (¥16,500) or 19 with 16 (¥22,000), and lunch (booked by the day before) has offered a ¥9,900 course heavy on seasonal starters. Reviewers found the head chef friendly and good company at the counter. Closed Wednesday; enter from the Pontocho side.

roles: Owner and head chef (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and TableCheck (the shop’s own text): the owner selects the seafood personally from across Japan, and the meat dishes use the Kyoto brand beef "Kyo no Niku". Reviewers in 2024 describe a friendly, attentive head chef and a counter decorated with fans bearing geiko names; a June 2023 reviewer recognised the premises as a former restaurant run by an elderly couple.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase nigiri; Kyoto beef dishes.

anecdotes.text: "The interior is decorated with geisha fans, and thinking about how to read their names adds to the enjoyment." — March 2024.
"The entrance is from the street in Pontocho, so you can’t access it from the Takase River." — July 2024.
A July 2024 lunch diner waited a while for the sushi after the many starters, and found the sea urchin a little off.
"While it may not be overwhelmingly impressive, it was the perfect place to enjoy slightly better sushi in a relaxed setting." — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、中京区鍋屋町210 先斗町24番路地奥、京都河原町駅1A出口から徒歩2分、祇園四条駅4番出口から4分、11:00〜15:00 (ランチは予約制)・17:00〜23:00、水曜休み (予約は相談可)、12席、個室2〜8名、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可、おまかせ12貫 (全15品) 16,500円、特選16貫 (全19品) 22,000円、店主が全国から選ぶ魚介と「Kyo no Niku」の京都のブランド牛。TableCheck: 先斗町の路地奥の寿司割烹。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 9,900円のおまかせ、八寸、蛤の吸い物、赤酢のシャリ、芸妓の名前の飾り、先斗町側から入る、気さくな大将。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course online; sit at the counter to talk with the head chef; cards accepted.
