places.name: ぎをん森幸 (Gion Morikou)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Cantonese dishes with soy and oyster-type sauces, spring rolls, shrimp tempura, dumplings, yakisoba and kara-age; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, chicken, shrimp, crab and beef dishes, with a Japanese-dashi accent in some (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 17:00–21:30 (last order 20:30); closed Wednesday and on some other days (Tabelog). Book ahead, especially for lunch: a May 2026 walk-in could not get in, and tables fill within minutes of the 11:30 opening (October 2026); a November 2026 walk-in was given a 45-minute slot. The weekday daily special is weekdays only (October 2026). A 10% charge applies only in the tatami rooms (Tabelog). 37 seats: 20 at tables and rooms with sunken kotatsu; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master) (Tabelog). Bento to take away (Tabelog). On the west bank of the Shirakawa north of Chion-in Bridge; by the Chion-in-mae bus stop, near Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shirakawa north of Chion-in Bridge, Gion — near Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style Cantonese cooking, light and without strong spices, since 1955; Shaoxing wine from China and Taiwan (Tabelog, shop text) · signature handmade spring rolls (Tabelog) · lunch: Morikou special bento in a two-tier box ¥1,400 — sweet-and-sour pork, crab omelette, roast pork, spring rolls, shrimp tempura — with mapo tofu as an add-on (May and November 2026); lunch mini course (November 2026) · sweet-and-sour pork of lean tenderloin with black vinegar ¥1,300 (September 2026) · dinner: appetizers of roast pork, ginger steamed chicken and fried gizzards, crab and shark-fin soup, Peking duck, beef with green peppers, chive dumplings, cream-stewed scallops, spicy shrimp, yakisoba, almond tofu, coconut milk with tapioca (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kyoto Chinese · Gion Shirakawa, light Cantonese since 1955] A Cantonese restaurant in a house on the Shirakawa, open since 1955, cooking the light, dashi-tinged Chinese food Kyoto calls its own; inside hangs a large peacock painting by a Kyoto artist. Lunch is the two-tier Morikou bento (¥1,400 in 2026) of spring rolls, shrimp tempura, crab omelette and sweet-and-sour pork; dinner brings shark-fin soup, Peking duck and the handmade spring rolls. Book ahead — lunch fills at opening. One October 2026 diner found the mapo tofu too oily. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Long-established restaurant; no one is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): opened in 1955 and cherished by local food lovers for over half a century; Kyoto-style Chinese cooking that is light and avoids strong spices; handmade spring rolls with every ingredient made from scratch; bento to take away. A September 2026 reviewer says its customers range from geiko to tourists; an October 2026 reviewer describes a large peacock painting by a Kyoto artist; a diner of nearly 20 years brought a business guest in October 2026. Tabelog Chinese WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): light, flavourful dishes that avoid the strong spices typical of Chinese cooking, for everyone from children to the elderly.
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade spring rolls; Morikou bento.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor found the cooking elegant but the mapo tofu too oily, and would not return for that reason.
"I was a bit disappointed that the amount of rice was too much compared to the side dishes." — October 2026.
"I’ve been visiting this restaurant for nearly 20 years, and it offers surprisingly light Cantonese cuisine." — October 2026.
A November 2026 walk-in couple were told a 45-minute stay would be fine and had the lunch mini course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華料理・飲茶、東山区白川筋知恩院橋上ル西側556、知恩院前バス停・東山駅、月火木金土日 11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:00〜21:30 (L.O. 20:30)、水曜休み、不定休あり、予約可、チャージお座敷のみ10％、37席、掘りごたつの個室、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、カード (VISA・Master)、中国料理 WEST 百名店 2021・2024・2026、1955年開店、強い香辛料を控えた京風の広東料理、中国と台湾の紹興酒、手作りの春巻き、お弁当の持ち帰り。口コミ (2026年、英語): 森幸弁当1,400円 (酢豚、かに玉、焼豚、春巻き、海老の天ぷら)、酢豚1,300円、麻婆豆腐、フカヒレスープ、北京ダック、孔雀の絵、昼は開店すぐ満席、油が多いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead by phone; lunch bento is the easy order; cards accepted.

places.name: GOSPEL
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: scones, tarts and cakes, with lunches of shrimp gratin or hamburg steak with demi-glace (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: scones come with clotted or whipped cream, the cakes use butter and cream, and the lunches are meat or shrimp with dairy (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog): a 30-minute wait with three groups ahead on a June 2026 Saturday; walk-ins turned away when full (September 2026). Video recording inside is prohibited (September 2026). 35 seats at tables and sofas; cash only (Tabelog). No parking; the city car park about 50 m north is free after 17:00 (Tabelog). Up the wooden stairs to the 2nd floor of an ivy-covered Western-style house, a different business on the ground floor; 3 min from the Jodoji or Ginkakuji-mae bus stops, near the Philosopher’s Path (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Jodoji near Ginkakuji and the Philosopher’s Path — 3 min from the Ginkakuji-mae bus stop
places.cuisine: Café in an ivy-covered Western-style house (2026 reviews) · scone set ¥1,650: large, soft scones with clotted cream and jam and a pot of tea (September 2026) · cake set ¥1,350: pear tart with almond cream, cherry chocolate cake (September–November 2026) · lunch: shrimp gratin or hamburg steak with demi-glace and rice (August 2026) · tea in generous pots, blend coffee, iced tea; Wedgwood and Royal Copenhagen tableware (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Café · Ginkakuji, scones in an ivy-covered house] A tea room up a broad wooden staircase on the 2nd floor of an old ivy-covered Western-style house near the Philosopher's Path: dark wood, antique furniture, shelves of worn records, and jazz from a JBL Paragon speaker. The scone set (¥1,650) brings big, soft scones with clotted cream, jam and a pot of tea; the cake set (¥1,350) a pear tart or cherry chocolate cake; lunch is shrimp gratin or hamburg steak. No bookings — expect a wait at weekends. No video inside. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

roles: Café; no owner or staff named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a classic Western-style house covered in ivy; a November 2026 reviewer says it was designed by Vories, while a September 2026 reviewer calls it reminiscent of Vories’ architecture. Inside: antique furniture, shelves of old literature and records, a JBL Paragon playing jazz, and Wedgwood and Royal Copenhagen china (2026 reviews). Instagram @gospel_kyoto (September 2026 review). Tabelog Cafe "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2022 and Cafe WEST 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Scone set; cake set.

anecdotes.text: "⚠️ Video recording is prohibited." — September 2026.
"Typically, cakes are perceived as more expensive than scones, but here the cake set is JPY 1350, while the scone set is JPY 1650." — September 2026.
"It seems like the shelves are bending under the weight of the records." — September 2026.
A June 2026 Saturday visitor waited about 30 minutes behind three groups.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・パブ・ケーキ、左京区浄土寺上南田町36 2F、浄土寺・銀閣寺前バス停から徒歩3分、月水木金土日 12:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:30)、火曜休み、予約不可、35席、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、駐車場なし (北50mの市営駐車場は17時以降無料)、カフェ百名店 2021・2022、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年6〜11月、英語): ツタの洋館の2階、1階は別の店、Vories の設計との記述、スコーンセット1,650円、ケーキセット1,350円 (洋梨のタルト、チェリーのチョコレートケーキ)、ランチはハンバーグか海老グラタン、ポットの紅茶、JBL Paragon のジャズ、レコード棚、Wedgwood と Royal Copenhagen の器、店内の動画撮影は禁止、週末は待ち。

cultural_comfort.note: Wait to be seated; order verbally; cash only; no video.

places.name: おでん割烹 叶哉 (Oden Kappou Kanoya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Oden in dashi with fish cakes, sashimi with soy sauce, simmered and grilled dishes; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden and every simmered dish sit in a fish-based dashi, alongside sashimi and duck (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday and holidays 16:00–23:00; closed Sunday and irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations taken, also through TableCheck; bookings are cancelled after 30 minutes without word (Tabelog). An otoshi of ¥700 per seat (Tabelog). 19 seats: a 13-seat counter, tables and private rooms for 4 and 6; heated tobacco only in a smoking area; cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 5 min from Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened at this address on 25 April 2024 (Tabelog), after a move from Gion (February 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Bukkoji — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Oden kappo: oden in a rich dashi plus the chef's own seasonal dishes (2025–2026 reviews) · course ¥9,000, with seasonal sashimi, white fish simmered with vegetables and tender simmered octopus (November 2025) · oden, including egg topped with salmon roe · winter yellowtail, dashimaki, saikyo-yaki, duck simmered with celeriac · matsutake somen and matsutake rice in season (August 2026 visit) · dashi-wari: sake or shochu mixed with dashi · sake, shochu and wine (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Oden · Kiyamachi, oden kappo with dashi-wari] A bright, modern oden kappo on the Kiyamachi side near Bukkoji, which moved here from Gion in 2024. Besides oden simmered in a deep dashi — the egg topped with salmon roe is a regular's favourite — the chef turns out kappo dishes: sashimi, simmered octopus, winter yellowtail, duck with celeriac. Try the dashi-wari, sake or shochu let down with the broth. A ¥9,000 course or à la carte; ¥700 otoshi. A young, quick staff, Showa-era hits on the speakers, a long counter and two private rooms. Open 16:00–23:00, closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A February 2026 reviewer had loved the shop since it was in Gion and visited after its move; Tabelog gives the opening at this address as 25 April 2024.
chef_bio.specialty: Oden; dashi-wari; seasonal kappo dishes.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 group of sixty-somethings from Kanto was told by the taxi driver that the area used to be a geisha district, and was given a private room away from the lively young crowd; the reviewer warned that it can be cold at your feet.
Showa-era hit songs played as background music (March 2026).
A March 2026 diner, who usually dislikes sake, enjoyed the dashi-wari and noted that every dish came portioned for the party of three.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おでん割烹 叶哉、おでん・居酒屋、下京区木屋町通仏光寺上ル天王町157-727、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩5分、月〜土・祝 16:00〜23:00、日曜休み (ほか不定休)、予約可 (TableCheck)、無断で30分遅れると自動キャンセル、お付きだし料700円、19席 (カウンター13)、個室 (4人・6人)、加熱式たばこのみの喫煙所、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2024年4月25日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 祇園から移転、コース9,000円、刺身、白身魚と野菜の炊き合わせ、たこの柔らか煮、いくらをのせた玉子、冬のぶり、だし巻き、西京焼き、鴨と根セロリ、だし割り、松茸のそうめんと松茸ご飯、昭和の歌謡曲。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (TableCheck); ¥700 otoshi; cards and QR payments.

places.name: お酒と食事 うり (Osake to Shokuji Uri)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Small Japanese dishes with soy sauce, tempura, saba sushi and oden; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, duck and beef-tendon oden lead the menu, and the vegetable dishes use dashi (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 17:00–22:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations taken; booking a day ahead or the same day is usually enough (Tabelog; December 2024). No service charge and no otoshi charge (Tabelog). Omakase of five dishes ¥6,600 (July, August 2025). Seats: Tabelog lists 11 (4 counter); a 2023 Tabelog Magazine article quoted in an August 2025 review gives 5 counter seats and a table for 4; a December 2025 review adds a near-private table for 6 upstairs, where the toilet is. The chef cooks alone with one hall staff, so service can be slow (August 2026). Non-smoking; cards accepted (Tabelog). At the end of a narrow alley, 282 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews). Opened 20 November 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: An alley south of Shijo near Ayanokoji — 282 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small hideaway for sake and carefully made Japanese dishes, à la carte or a five-dish omakase ¥6,600 (2025 reviews) · obanzai platter, e.g. saba sushi, duck roast, ebi-mame, okra with sesame, tokobushi · sashimi such as Awaji hamo, Akashi sea bream and octopus, shime aji · Kamo eggplant agedashi ¥980, tsurumurasaki ohitashi ¥480, summer vegetable tempura ¥1,280 (July 2025) · miso-grilled tokishirazu salmon, sanbaizu salad with jako · oysters in winter: oyster tempura, oyster rice (December 2025) · oden with tofu and beef tendon, eel, duck (February 2025) · plum wine ¥650; beer ¥700, sake from ¥900, shochu ¥700, highball ¥650 (2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese · Shijo Kawaramachi, a hideaway at the end of an alley] A small, homely restaurant at the end of a narrow alley just off Shijo Kawaramachi, opened in 2018 by a chef who had been head chef at Nikomi Suzuya. Order à la carte or the ¥6,600 five-dish omakase, which covers most of the menu: a plate of obanzai with saba sushi, Awaji hamo or Akashi sea bream, Kamo eggplant agedashi, tempura, oysters in winter. Quiet enough to come alone; good with sake. The chef cooks single-handed, so service can be slow, and some find it pricey for what it is. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Kunihiko Kamimon (romaji from a 2023 Tabelog Magazine article quoted in an August 2025 review; a December 2025 review writes "Mr. Uegato"; the kanji is not in a source)
roles: Head chef and owner (Tabelog: former head of Nikomi Suzuya; August 2026 review: "The owner runs the kitchen alone")
chef_bio.background: Per a 2023 Tabelog Magazine article quoted in an August 2025 review: after training at renowned kaiseki and Japanese restaurants, the chef served as head chef at Nikomi Suzuya before opening this small eatery. Tabelog's remarks name the shop's former post as "Nikomi … Suzuya". Tabelog gives the opening as 20 November 2018.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai platter with saba sushi; seasonal tempura.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 reviewer, a classmate of the chef from middle and high school, finally came with an old friend over New Year, let the chef choose about six dishes, and ranked the sea-bream tempura among the best ever eaten.
A June 2024 visitor singled out a tempura of corn silk.
A December 2024 diner found everything good but without a wow factor and not cheap — about ¥18,000 for two.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お酒と食事 うり、日本料理・おでん、下京区足袋屋町317-15、京都河原町駅から282m、火〜日 17:00〜22:00、月曜休み、予約可、サービス料・お通し代なし、11席 (カウンター4)、禁煙、カード可、2018年11月20日オープン、Nikomi Suzuya の元料理長。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 細い路地の奥の隠れ家、おまかせ5品6,600円、鯖寿司、鴨ロース、えび豆、とこぶし、Awaji の鱧、Akashi の鯛、賀茂なすの揚げだし980円、夏野菜の天ぷら1,280円、牡蠣の天ぷらと牡蠣ご飯、料理長は一人で厨房、2階に席とお手洗い。

cultural_comfort.note: Small and quiet; book a day ahead; no otoshi or service charge.

places.name: マダム紅蘭 (Madam Koran)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Chinese dishes with oyster and soy-based sauces, dumplings, ramen and fried dishes; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Seasonal Kyoto-vegetable dishes and vegetable oil are used, but the happosai rests on a Chinese stock and most dishes carry meat or seafood (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Wednesday–Sunday 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–21:00, closed Monday and Tuesday. The official site gives lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and dinner 17:00–21:30 (last order 21:00), and closed Monday (open on a holiday, then closed the next day); its front page says closed Monday and the fourth Tuesday. Reservations taken by phone; often full at lunch (2026 reviews). Lunch: Chinese bento with soup ¥1,600; mini kaiseki ¥3,000, from two people, ordered by 13:30 (October 2026). Takeaway by phone (official site). 30 seats: chairs on the ground floor, tatami rooms up a steep stair; children from primary-school age (official site; 2026 reviews). Non-smoking; cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 2 min from the Kawaramachi Marutamachi bus stop; 5 min west of Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi at Marutamachi, south-east of the Imperial Palace — 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Sichuan-based Chinese made light for Japanese palates, with vegetable oil and few spices, in a 90-year-old sukiya house (official site) · seasonal Kyoto-vegetable dishes four times a year, e.g. Kamo eggplant mapo, manganji peppers with squid and cashews; spring sakura dongpo pork (official site; August 2026) · "refined happosai" on a carefully made Chinese stock (official site) · Dongpo burger: braised pork belly in a mantou, a takeaway favourite; ¥400 as an add-on to the mini kaiseki (official site; September 2026) · lunch: Chinese bento with soup ¥1,600 (shrimp tempura, shumai, sweet and sour pork); mini kaiseki ¥3,000 (appetizers, squid with oyster sauce, fried mackerel, shrimp mayo, xiaolongbao, chashu ramen, dessert) (2026 reviews) · tantanmen, xiaolongbao, steamed chicken with scallion and ginger, burdock with beef and peppers (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Chinese · Marutamachi, Kyoto-style Sichuan in a sukiya house] A Chinese restaurant south-east of the Imperial Palace in a 90-year-old all-cypress sukiya house that was the main home of a confectioner: chairs downstairs, tatami rooms up a steep stair. The cooking is Sichuan at heart but gentle, with seasonal Kyoto vegetables four times a year — the Kamo eggplant mapo in summer is a favourite. Lunch is the mini kaiseki (¥3,000, two or more) or a ¥1,600 Chinese bento; reviewers rate the kaiseki and the xiaolongbao well and are cooler on the bento. The Dongpo burger (pork belly in a mantou) also sells as a gift. Book ahead; closed Monday.

roles: Kitchen and owners not named on the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the restaurant occupies a renovated 90-year-old sukiya-style house of solid hinoki that was once the main house of a confectioner; the motto is to serve first the flavours the cook finds delicious, with original recipes. A September 2026 reviewer notes Michelin recognition. Tabelog Chinese WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: 「まず自分が美味しいと思った味覚をお客様に提供する」 — serve the guest, first of all, what one has found delicious oneself.
chef_bio.specialty: Kamo eggplant mapo; Dongpo burger; mini kaiseki lunch.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner who ordered the mini kaiseki added a Dongpo burger (¥400) and wished for one each: "light and elegant, melting in the mouth".
An October 2026 walk-in found the bento small and asked, "Is this really Chinese cuisine?", while noting the steep stairs.
An August 2026 regular called it the best Chinese food in Kyoto for the price, and found the restaurant fully booked that day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (madam-ko-ran.com): マダム紅蘭〜京町家でいただく本格的チャイニーズ〜、京都御所の東南、築90年の菓子匠の本家跡を改築した総檜造りの数寄屋建築、「まず自分が美味しいと思った味覚をお客様に提供する」、基本は中国四川料理だが植物油脂を使い香辛料もほとんど使わず、日本人の口に合うようにあっさり、京野菜の季節限定メニューが年に四回 (朝掘り竹の子、賀茂なす、万願寺唐辛子、ゆり根など)、上品な八宝菜、春限定のさくらの東坡肉、東坡バーガー (お土産に人気)、テイクアウトは電話で、定休日は月曜日 (祝日は営業で翌日代休)、トップページでは月曜と第四火曜、ランチ11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)、ディナー17:00〜21:30 (L.O. 21:00)、1階はイス席、お子様は小学生以上。食べログ: 中華料理・四川料理・担々麺、中京区寺町丸太町下御霊前町631-2、水〜日、月火休み、30席、個室、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、中国料理 WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2024・2026。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone to book; shoes off for the upstairs tatami rooms; ask for chairs if sitting on the floor is hard (official site).

places.name: 梅園 河原町店 (Umezono Kawaramachi ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Mitarashi dango, shiratama, warabi mochi and kanten are starch- and rice-based, but the mitarashi sauce is soy-based and baked matcha sweets also appear; no ingredient list is published (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Dango, warabi mochi, zenzai and kakigori with bean paste are mostly plant-based, but cream, ice cream, milk kakigori and parfaits use dairy; no ingredient list is published (official menu).
places.hours_raw: 10:30–19:30 every day (Tabelog). The group closed 7–9 January in its New Year notice (official site). No reservations; a short wait at busy times (Tabelog; September, October 2026). At least one item per person; three dango can be ordered with a drink (September, October 2026); hojicha is served free (November 2026). Prices across 梅園 were revised from 1 October 2026 (official site). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). Non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi south of Sanjo, 6 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-dori south of Sanjo — 6 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Amami tea house known for its small, square, grilled mitarashi dango (2026 reviews) · mitarashi dango, five sticks ¥600; with matcha or brown-sugar warabi mochi ¥1,070; with kinako shiratama ¥900; with anmitsu ¥1,170; with a small parfait ¥1,350; amami tenshin assortment ¥1,110 · warabi mochi ¥950; anmitsu with kuromitsu ¥950–1,250; Uji chilled zenzai ¥1,150; matcha cream with azuki ¥1,200 · kakigori, e.g. Uji kintoki shiratama with matcha warabi mochi ¥1,680, brown-sugar shiratama with warabi mochi ¥1,550 (official menu) · green tea ¥750 (September–October 2026)
places.notes: [Wagashi café · Kawaramachi Sanjo, mitarashi dango since the 1920s] A long, narrow tea house on Kawaramachi south of Sanjo, founded in 1927 according to a reviewer, where a pot of mitarashi dango greets you at the door. The dango are small, square and grilled until charred at the edges, under a glossy sweet-soy sauce (¥600 for five); pair them with warabi mochi, anmitsu or, in summer, an Uji kintoki kakigori. Hojicha comes free. Most reviewers love the dango; one from Kanto found the sauce far sweeter than expected. Open daily 10:30–19:30; no bookings.

roles: Run by 甘党茶屋 京 梅園 (official site); no staff named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, 梅園 runs three 甘党茶屋 tea houses in Kyoto (河原町店, 清水店, 三条寺町店), the café うめぞの CAFE&GALLERY, 梅園 oyatsu at ジェイアール京都伊勢丹, みたらし 京 梅園 at 西武池袋, and an online shop; its うめぞの茶房 closed on 20 October 2025. A September 2026 review dates the shop to 1927. Tabelog Wagashi WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Mitarashi dango; warabi mochi; kakigori.

anecdotes.text: "I never really liked Mitarashi Dango, but the ones here were different!" — September 2026.
An October 2026 visitor from Kanto found the dango overwhelmingly sweet compared with the sweet-and-salty style back home.
"As soon as I entered the shop, I was captivated by the pot filled with Mitarashi Dango." — November 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (umezono-kyoto.com): 甘党茶屋 京 梅園 河原町店、メニュー: 甘味点心1,110円、みたらし団子と抹茶わらび餅・黒糖わらび餅1,070円、みたらし団子ときなこ白玉900円、みたらし団子600円、みたらし団子と小さいパフェ1,350円、みたらし団子とあんみつ黒みつ添え1,170円、宇治冷やしぜんざい1,150円、わらび餅950円、白玉あんみつ黒みつ添え950円、かき氷 (宇治金時白玉＋抹茶わらび餅1,680円など)。店舗: 河原町店、清水店、三条寺町店、うめぞの CAFE&GALLERY、梅園 oyatsu ジェイアール京都伊勢丹店、みたらし 京 梅園 西武池袋店、2026年10月1日から全店で価格改定、うめぞの茶房は2025年10月20日に閉店。食べログ: 甘味処、中京区河原町三条下る山崎町234-4、毎日10:30〜19:30、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、禁煙、テイクアウト可、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2026年9〜11月、英語): 1927年創業、四角い小さなみたらし団子、焦げ目、ほうじ茶付き、一人一品。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at least one item each; no bookings; cards and PayPay.

places.name: しゅん逢 紗々木 (Shun Ai Sasaki)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the courses use dashi, white miso, ponzu, sesame dressing and nama-fu (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses built on dashi with beef (roast beef, oxtail, beef cheek), eel and fish in most dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day lunch 12:00–14:30 and dinner 18:00–21:30; on days before and after public holidays dinner is listed as 18:00–18:30; closed irregularly. Bookings taken. Courses: lunch ¥6,600 (August 2026) and ¥8,800 (March 2026), a special lunch kaiseki (September 2026); dinner ¥13,500, with a ¥1,500 charge for a private room (October 2026). 20 seats: 8 at the counter and two tatami rooms with sunken seating for up to 12; non-smoking (Tabelog). Children only from middle-school age, ordering the same course as adults (Tabelog). Dress: not overly casual (Tabelog). Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Teramachi north of Bukkoji; 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi north of Bukkoji — 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto set courses that pair dashi cooking with beef (2026 reviews) · lunch courses ¥6,600 and ¥8,800, a special lunch kaiseki; dinner ¥13,500 (2026 reviews) · September 2026 lunch: kombu-cured yam noodles with lightly cooked beef and aosa; conger eel and winter melon in a ginger-scented bowl; steamed abalone; sea bream, amberjack and Awaji bonito sashimi with ponzu; oxtail with yuba dumpling and nama-fu; hassun with roast beef and sea-bream sushi; beef cheek braised in white miso; sea-bream kamameshi; coconut, fig and white-wine jelly · spring: firefly squid, bamboo shoots, canola flowers; clay-pot rice with sakura shrimp (2026 reviews) · sake, shochu and wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Teramachi-Bukkoji, dashi and beef] A 20-seat Kyoto restaurant on Teramachi with a counter and two sunken tatami rooms, unusual for setting meat — roast beef, oxtail, beef cheek in white miso — among dashi-led seasonal courses that end with clay-pot rice. Lunch from ¥6,600, dinner about ¥13,500 (2026). Reviewers praise an attentive proprietress and call the room new and spotless. Children from middle-school age only. Lunch and dinner daily; book ahead.

roles: Kitchen (unnamed); a proprietress (女将) looks after the room, per a March 2026 review
chef_bio.background: No owner or chef is named in the sources read. Reviewers describe Kyoto courses that include meat — rare for Kyoto cuisine, as a May 2026 diner put it — with a seasoning "that appeals to Japanese tastes" (March 2026), and the room as still new and well kept (August 2026). A March 2026 family of six praised the attentive proprietress.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch kaiseki with beef dishes; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "The reviews were decent, but I went in with low expectations, and to my surprise, it was much better than I anticipated." — the ¥6,600 lunch, August 2026.
"Despite being Japanese cuisine, the inclusion of meat dishes like oxtail, roast beef, and beef cheek was impressive." — September 2026.
A family of five in May 2026 found the course centred on meat with portions modest enough for a smaller appetite.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、下京区寺町仏光寺上ル中之町582、毎日12:00〜14:30・18:00〜21:30 (祝前日・祝後日のディナーは18:00〜18:30)、不定休、予約可、20席 (カウンター8席、掘りごたつの座敷2室で最大12名)、禁煙、子供は中学生以上で大人と同じコースを注文する場合のみ、服装はあまりにカジュアルでなければ可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): ランチのコース6,600円・8,800円、特別ランチ懐石、ディナー13,500円 (個室料1,500円)、肉料理の多い京料理、ローストビーフ、テールの焼き物、牛ほほ肉の白味噌煮、鯛の釜飯、女将の気配り。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses only, booked ahead; private tatami rooms for groups.

places.name: 先斗町 たばこや (Pontocho Tabakoya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the menu has tempura, fried dishes, a crab gratin, nama-fu dengaku and many dishes in thick sauces (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable obanzai (eggplant dengaku, simmered eggplant) are on the menu, but the cooking leans on dashi and fish — even the fried taro was cooked in shrimp broth (July 2026).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 17:00–22:30 (food last order 21:15, drinks 22:00); hours may change. Bookings by phone 12:00–22:00 (075-221-1756), and only for arrivals 17:00–18:00 — 17:00–17:30 at any time, 17:30–18:00 if seats allow; no bookings for after 18:00; a 2.5-hour limit at busy times (Tabelog). Table charge ¥500 including the appetiser (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 at the counter and three tables (Tabelog). Tabelog lists it as non-smoking, but in May 2025 staff asked a diner whether smoking inside was all right. Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Pontocho, about 250 m from the Shijo end; parking near Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, about midway between Shijo and Sanjo — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Obanzai izakaya on Pontocho with fish and Kyoto sake (Tabelog; reviews) · obanzai served even as single portions (April 2025): agedashi tofu, minced-meat stew, simmered squid and taro, jako with salt kombu and peppers, simmered eggplant, fried shrimp-taro · round-eggplant dengaku, nama-fu dengaku, black cod in Saikyo miso, yuba sashimi, Awaji octopus sashimi with plum, cod-milt tempura, crab gratin, shrimp dumplings, heshiko, mackerel pressed sushi (2024–2026 reviews) · hot sake, shochu chuhai, highballs; sake served in a teacup (February 2025) · ¥500 charge with appetiser
places.notes: [Obanzai izakaya · Pontocho, old-fashioned and lively] A 20-seat obanzai izakaya on Pontocho, behind a wooden sign reading obanzai: home-style Kyoto dishes such as simmered squid and taro, round-eggplant dengaku, Saikyo-miso black cod and fried shrimp-taro, with hot sake. Reviewers describe an apron-clad owner serving (2024–2025) and a room bustling with regulars (September 2024); a July 2026 diner found the heshiko too salty and the young staff distracted. Bookings only for 17:00–18:00 arrivals; ¥500 charge. Daily 17:00–22:30.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who serves in an apron, per 2024–2025 reviews
chef_bio.background: A December 2024 review describes the mother in the chef’s apron serving Kyoto dishes such as yuba sashimi and saikyo-yaki at reasonable prices; a May 2025 diner was served by the charming, gentle owner in a traditional apron. A January 2025 diner read in blogs that the owner had once run a high-end restaurant in Gion. A June 2026 diner found the staff kind and the place not especially aimed at tourists.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai; Saikyo-miso black cod; round-eggplant dengaku.

anecdotes.text: "Since I was alone, I was worried that I couldn't order many obanzai dishes, but they kindly prepared a single serving for me." — April 2025.
A May 2025 walk-in was asked first whether smoking inside was all right, and guessed that this kept seats free.
A July 2026 diner loved the fried shrimp-taro and simmered eggplant but found the heshiko "just overly salty" and the part-time staff "in their own little world".

cultural_comfort.note: An old-style local izakaya; book by phone for a 17:00–18:00 start, or try your luck later.

places.name: 亀廣永 (Kame Hironaga)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No ingredient list is published. The signature shitatari is described as agar jelly sweetened with Okinawan brown sugar, zarame and wasanbon (July 2026 review); the shop also sells soy-sauce okaki and rakugan with bean paste, which are not described.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The shitatari is described as agar and three sugars (July 2026 review), but no full ingredient list is published.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog and Waraku (2023): 9:00–18:00, closed Sundays and public holidays; hours may change. A takeaway shop with no seating (September 2026). Orders can be reserved by phone (075-221-5965), and the shop is especially busy around the Gion Festival, from late June until after Obon (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; September 2026). On Takakura-dori north of Takoyakushi, south of Takakura Elementary School; 8 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 5 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takakura-dori north of Takoyakushi — 8 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Old Kyoto wagashi shop for takeaway (Tabelog; Waraku) · shitatari, an amber brown-sugar agar sweet first made for the Gion Festival tea at the Kikusui float and now sold all year, ¥1,500 a block; keeps about 10 days and can stay at room temperature, best chilled (2024–2026 reviews; Waraku 2023 lists it as a summer sweet) · koto ouchi, rakugan dough around chunky bean paste, box ¥3,450, from October (Waraku 2023) · seasonal wagashi and soy-sauce okaki in three hardnesses (July and September 2026)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Takakura-Takoyakushi, the shitatari] A small takeaway wagashi shop on Takakura-dori known for shitatari (¥1,500): a translucent amber block of agar and brown sugar, first made for the Gion Festival tea at the Kikusui float and now sold year round — softer than yokan, best chilled, keeps about ten days. In autumn, koto ouchi rakugan with bean paste. Waraku (2023) describes a family shop run by the second-generation couple and the third generation. Wagashi WEST Tabelog 100 2023 and 2026. Cash only; 9:00–18:00, closed Sundays and holidays.

chef_bio.background: Per Waraku (September 2023, from its October–November 2021 issue): the shop’s founder went independent from 亀末廣 in the early Showa era; the second generation is 西井新太郎, and the shop is run by a couple in their eighties together with the next, third-generation head, 孝明. Reviewers give older dates — "since its establishment in 1804" (July 2026) and "since around 1800" (September 2026) — which this record does not resolve. The shitatari was first made for the tea ceremony at the Kikusui float of the Gion Festival and, being popular, is now sold all year (July 2026 review; Tabelog). Tabelog Wagashi WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Shitatari; koto ouchi.

anecdotes.text: "On the evening of the 16th, it was already sold out at the Kikusui Hoko float, but there was still plenty available at the main store." — July 2026.
"The elderly staff member kindly explained the details about Shitatari." — September 2026.
A September 2026 buyer also took soy-sauce okaki, sold in three levels of hardness, and found the medium one quite firm.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 和樂web (2023年9月、2021年10・11月号より): 亀廣永、昭和のはじめに「亀末廣」から独立した初代の作、2代目 西井新太郎、80代夫婦と次期3代目・孝明さんの3人4脚で店を支える、古都大内 (落雁の生地の中につぶあん) 1箱3,450円、日もち1週間、30個入り紙箱1,950円、夏季は琥珀羹「したたり」、営業時間9時〜18時、日曜・祝日休み、古都大内は10月から。食べログ: 和菓子、中京区高倉通蛸薬師上ル和久屋町359、月〜土 9:00〜18:00、日・祝休み、予約可、祇園祭の頃 (6月末〜お盆過ぎ) は特に混む、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、「したたり」は通年販売 (Available year-round)、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年10月、英語): したたり1,500円、日もち10日、菊水鉾、黒糖・ざらめ・和三盆、おかき。

cultural_comfort.note: A small takeaway counter; point at the shitatari and pay in cash. Staff explain the sweets (2026).

places.name: 竹ざき (Takezaki)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the omakase includes tempura, vinegared-miso dishes and dashi-based dishes (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase built on dashi and seafood — shellfish, sashimi, flounder, yellowtail — with duck and game; even the breakfast miso soup is made with fish (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Monday–Saturday lunch 12:00–14:30 (last order 12:00) and dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 20:00); Sunday also breakfast 9:00–10:30; closed irregularly and on 29–30 December (osechi pickup only on the 31st). Reservation only, by phone or Instagram DM; online up to the end of the month after next; walk-ins may not be possible. Cancellation: 30% from 7 days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day or with no contact (Tabelog). Courses: omakase ¥9,900 (January 2026); Sunday breakfast ¥4,950 with refills of clay-pot rice and miso soup (July–August 2026); sake pairings (six glasses ¥3,520, January 2026). Only one red and one white wine by the glass — bring your own wine (fee charged). Allow 2.5–3 hours for dinner, 2 for lunch, 1 for breakfast (Tabelog). 7 seats (6 at the L-shaped counter, per reviews) in a townhouse, shoes off; private hire for 5 or more; smoking only in the garden (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). School-age children; younger children only if the room is booked for four or more adults (Tabelog). Cards, IC and QR (Tabelog). 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 1 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Oshikoji-dori east of Takakura, south of the Imperial Palace — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: One-cook kappo counter of seasonal Kyoto cooking and sake (2026 reviews) · omakase ¥9,900 (January 2026): two shellfish in vinegared miso, steamed rice with a large clam and sansho, sashimi of tuna, yellowtail, horse mackerel and flounder, a fish and maitake soup with yuzu, salt-grilled winter yellowtail, Shogoin daikon with crab, rice with shiitake and duck fat, a hot pot of bear meat, hojicha ice made at the counter · spring 2026: Omi beef shabu-shabu with bamboo shoot and sansho, sakura-shrimp rice · summer 2026: Kamo eggplant dengaku, ayu tempura, hamo · Sunday breakfast ¥4,950: clay-pot rice, fish miso soup, sashimi, simmered dishes, grilled fish · sake pairings of regional brews; coffee hand-dripped per guest
places.notes: [Kappo · Oshikoji-Takakura, one cook at the counter] A seven-seat L-shaped counter in a small townhouse south of the Imperial Palace, where the chef cooks, pours and serves almost single-handed: plain-spoken seasonal omakase (about ¥9,900 at lunch in January 2026) with unusual fish, game in winter, and sake pairings. On Sundays a ¥4,950 breakfast course with clay-pot rice and refills. Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2020. Reservation only; shoes off; bring your own wine. Expect some waits — the cook works alone.

roles: Owner-chef who runs the counter alone (name given only in a machine-translated review)
chef_bio.origin: Kyoto (born and raised, per an April 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a chef who handles everything from food to drinks alone (January, April and May 2026), and on one Sunday in August 2026 a team of five at breakfast. An April 2026 diner wrote that the chef was born and raised in Kyoto, trained at a prestigious establishment and was in the 11th year here; Tabelog gives the opening day as 6 June 2015. An August 2026 review, read in English translation, names the chef as Sho Takezaki and the training place as a renowned Kyoto ryotei; this record does not use the name or reading because the Japanese original was not seen. Tabelog Award Bronze 2017, 2018, 2019 and 2020; a March 2026 diner called it Michelin-selected.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal omakase with sake pairings; Sunday breakfast.

anecdotes.text: "I was truly impressed when they even showed me a reference book to explain the ingredients (fish)." — June 2026.
In January 2026 the owner was alone and the sake sommelier absent, so a diner on a six-sake pairing could not ask about the sake.
An April 2026 diner wished for more sake by the glass: the main style is to order by the bottle.
"The hojicha ice cream … was surprisingly made right in front of me with an ice cream machine." — January 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区押小路通高倉東入竹屋町150、月〜土 12:00〜14:30 (L.O. 12:00)・18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 20:00)、日曜は朝9:00〜10:30も、所要時間 夜2.5〜3時間・昼2時間〜・朝1時間〜、不定休、12月29・30日休み (31日はおせちの受け渡しのみ)、完全予約制、電話または DM で予約、キャンセル料 (7日前から30%、前日50%、当日・連絡なし100%)、基本サービス料なし (食事を頼まない方がいる場合10%)、7席 (カウンターのみ)、貸切は5名から、喫煙は庭のみ、靴を脱いで上がる、ワインは赤白1種ずつなので持ち込み (有料)、子供は小学生以上 (4名以上の貸切なら未就学児も可)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2015年6月6日オープン、食べログアワード ブロンズ 2017〜2020。口コミ (2026年1月〜8月、英語): おまかせ9,900円、日本酒ペアリング6種3,520円、日曜の朝食4,950円 (土鍋ご飯と味噌汁はおかわり可)、L字のカウンター6席、店主ひとりで調理から飲み物まで、京都生まれ京都育ち、11年目、熊肉の鍋、ほうじ茶アイス。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only by phone or Instagram DM; a one-cook counter with a set omakase; shoes off.

places.name: 茶寮京都よしつぐ (Saryo Kyoto Yoshitsugu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The warabi-mochi is made with 100% bracken starch (official site), but the menu also has the flower-anko cake on sponge, inaniwa udon, Mont Blanc and dango with soy glazes; no gluten information is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; matcha, tea, warabi-mochi and zenzai are plant-based in principle, but the flower-anko cake has cream and the udon sauce and steamer sets are not described (official site; Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–18:00; closed Wednesday (Thursday when Wednesday is a holiday) and the day after a holiday (official site; Tabelog). No takeaway (official Instagram text on the site). Bookings by phone (seats only) or TableCheck; the flower-anko cake must be pre-ordered on TableCheck with card details; Tabelog bookings paused from 13 October 2026 during a system change (official site). A booking is cancelled if you are 15 minutes late without word (Tabelog). The cake can sell out by afternoon without a booking (August 2026). Order by touch panel; tatami seating and some counter seats (September 2026). 42 seats, a room for 8 upstairs; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; cards, e-money and QR; menu in English, Traditional Chinese and Korean; children welcome (Tabelog). 30 seconds from Nishiki Market, 7 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (official site). Opened 18 December 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Just off Nishiki Market — 7 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Matcha café and sweets house in an 1877 machiya with a garden and storehouse; matcha whisked by an Urasenke teacher, sweets made by hand in the shop every day (official site) · koicha from ¥2,420, usucha from ¥880, gyokuro (pot) ¥1,320 · 100% bracken warabi-mochi ¥1,815, ten-flavour dango set ¥1,320, Yoshitsugu zenzai (shiratama, chestnut or toasted mochi) from ¥1,320, roast-sweet-potato Mont Blanc ¥1,210 · iced Uji teas: matcha ¥880, hojicha ¥660, gyokuro ¥1,320, sencha ¥1,100 · chilled inaniwa udon with roasted-brown-rice-tea dipping broth from ¥1,650 (single ¥1,100 on another line), steamer-basket rice sets Nagomi ¥1,650, Irodori ¥1,870, Kanade ¥2,090 (official site; the page lists some items at two prices) · 花餡ケーキ, a cake topped with flowers piped in white bean paste over sponge, cream and strawberries, its flowers changing with the season (hydrangea, sunflower, cosmos, chrysanthemum, autumn leaves), by pre-order (official site; 2026 reviews) · matcha, hojicha and genmaicha puddings; soy-sauce brûlée dango (September–October 2026)
places.notes: [Wagashi café · Nishiki, matcha and flower-anko cakes in an 1877 machiya] A tea house in a townhouse built in 1877, thirty seconds from Nishiki Market, with a garden and storehouse at the back and a tatami room upstairs for tea lessons. An Urasenke teacher whisks the matcha; the sweets are made in house every day — 100% bracken warabi-mochi, a ten-flavour dango set, zenzai. The star is the 花餡ケーキ: a shortcake under a garden of seasonal flowers piped in white bean paste, which sells out — pre-order it on TableCheck. Staff in kimono; order by touch panel. 10:00–18:00, closed Wednesday.

roles: Matcha served by an Urasenke teacher (師範), sweets by in-house artisans (official site); no one is named. Operator 株式会社インテ (invoice T3140001048195)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the townhouse was built about 150 years ago, in 1877 (Meiji 10), with a garden between the main house and the storehouse; the ground floor is the café and the upper floor is used for matcha classes and private groups; matcha is chosen and whisked by an Urasenke teacher who also talks about tea and Japanese culture, and a matcha experience is offered. Opened 18 December 2023 (Tabelog). The invoice number belongs to 株式会社インテ (NTA corporate-number site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: sweets particular about ingredients, method and taste, all made by hand in the shop every day.
chef_bio.specialty: 花餡ケーキ; 100% bracken warabi-mochi; ten-flavour dango.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor found the street lined with people in kimono, many visitors from abroad and staff in kimono too.
An August 2026 visitor arriving at 16:00 on a Sunday found the cake sold out and advised booking early.
A September 2026 visitor found the dango smaller than expected.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-yoshitsugu.com): 京都よしつぐ、裏千家師範が自ら点てるお抹茶、甘味はすべて店内で職人が毎日手作り、約150年前 (1877年/明治10年) に建てられた京町家、1階は店舗、2階はお抹茶教室や接待・グループ用、奥に蔵とお庭、濃茶2,420円〜、薄茶880円〜、玉露 (ポット) 1,320円、太夫の本わらび餅 (本わらび粉100%) 1,815円、十種の味わい団子膳1,320円、よしつぐ善哉 (白玉/栗/焼餅) 1,320円〜、焼き芋モンブラン1,210円、冷し稲庭うどん (香ばし玄米茶つゆ) 1,650円など、せいろごはん 和1,650円・彩1,870円・奏2,090円、涼茶四撰、花餡ケーキ、10:00〜18:00、水曜定休 (祝日の場合は木曜)、テイクアウトなし、錦市場から徒歩30秒、2026年10月13日のお知らせ: 予約は TableCheck へ移行、花餡ケーキは TableCheck で事前予約 (カード情報が必要)、食べログからの予約は一時停止、お席のみは電話でも。食べログ: 甘味処・和菓子・カフェ、42席、個室 (8名)、禁煙、Wi-Fi、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語・繁体字・韓国語メニュー、ベジタリアンメニューあり、2023年12月18日オープン、インボイス T3140001048195 (株式会社インテ)。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 花餡ケーキ (アジサイ、ひまわり、コスモス、菊)、十種の団子、わらび餅、タッチパネルで注文、着物のスタッフ。

places.name: Ristorante dei CACCIATORI (リストランテ デイ カッチャトーリ)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: courses only, built around handmade pasta (tajarin, agnolotti dal plin, fettuccine), bread and pastry desserts; no gluten information is published (2019–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Piedmontese courses of meat, game, fish, egg pasta, cheese fonduta and anchovy bagna cauda (2019–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog lists lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–24:00 (last order 21:00) under "Tue – Thu", and Monday as the closing day (open on holidays); the other days are not stated, and the shop’s own site could not be read (it returned an error), so check before going. Courses only (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). 16 seats at four tables for four; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). On Yamato-oji just north of Shijo; 3 min walk from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yamato-oji just north of Shijo — 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Northern Italian — Piedmontese — courses only (Tabelog), by chef Nagata, trained under Cesare Giaccone in Piedmont (October 2026) · dishes reviewers name: roasted paprika with Jerusalem-artichoke bagna cauda, tripe salad with Parmigiano, pomegranate and apple, oven-baked sea bass with hazelnut sauce, quail and bean soup (December 2024); agnolotti dal plin of beef, pork and rabbit, with black truffle (January 2024); tajarin with meat sauce, ravioli with fonduta, Ezo deer salad, pheasant with porcini and Tanba chestnuts, apple pie (November 2019); handmade fettuccine with fresh tomato, frittata (April 2023); rabbit salad, fried lamb (April 2023) · Piedmontese wines such as Arneis and Barbaresco (2024–26 reviews) · a ¥6,000 dinner course in 2019; reviewers spent ¥8,000–19,999 a head (2023–25)
places.notes: [Italian · Gion-Shijo, Piedmont in a three-table room] A small white room with four tables on Yamato-oji just north of Shijo, where chef Nagata — trained in Piedmont under Cesare Giaccone — cooks Piedmontese courses almost single-handed and the chef's wife runs the room. Expect tajarin and agnolotti dal plin made by hand, bagna cauda, game in season (pheasant, Ezo deer), hazelnut sauces and a Barbaresco to match. Courses only; book ahead. Reviewers describe a calm, unhurried place with opera in the background. Check hours by phone.

roles: Front of house: the chef’s wife, who worked for many years at the inn Tawaraya (October 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: Chef Nagata trained under Cesare Giaccone in Piedmont and worked at Michelin-starred restaurants in Italy before returning to Japan to open the restaurant; the chef’s wife, formerly of the Tawaraya inn for many years, serves. An October 2025 regular says the chef "operates almost solo". A January 2024 review mentions umai-nasu from the chef’s family garden; a December 2024 visitor met an Italian chef, Filico, visiting and explaining the dishes in Italian. A January 2020 review says the new-onion soup follows a recipe passed down from a 400-year-old inn.
chef_bio.specialty: Tajarin; agnolotti dal plin; Piedmontese game.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 regular noted groups of foreign tourists sometimes arriving unexpectedly and the staff handling these situations expertly.
A July 2024 lunch guest enjoyed two and a half hours with operatic music in the background.
An April 2023 first-timer expected Gion glamour and found instead a calm, cafeteria-like room that put the guest at ease.

places.name: 祇園 鹿六 (Gion Karoku)
places.gf_detail: Ask (allergies can be noted when booking — Tabelog). Meat comes with salt or the house soy-based tare, and the menu has chijimi, cold noodles and soy-dressed yukhoe; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, August 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house; namul, kimchi and salad are on the menu, but courses are built on beef and the soup is beef-bone komtang (Tabelog menu; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 and dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30), Tuesday to Sunday; closed Monday, open some holiday Mondays with a weekday off instead (Tabelog; official site calendar). Lunch needs no booking but may close on some days (Tabelog; official site). A booking is cancelled 15 minutes after the time without word; children under 10 only in private rooms (Tabelog). 5% service charge; private rooms ¥3,000 or ¥5,000 (Tabelog). 58 seats: four private rooms, sunken-kotatsu seating and a counter; dessert is served in a separate room upstairs (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards (Tabelog). Just off Yasaka-dori; 3 min from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop, 12 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; June 2026). Opened 11 May 1999 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yasaka-dori west of Higashioji — 3 min from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop
places.cuisine: Charcoal yakiniku of A4-grade-and-up Kuroge wagyu in a 1927 mansion with a tsubo-niwa garden (official site; 2026 reviews) · specialties: Yamagata beef yukhoe ¥3,500, chuck-rib "hana aburi" with fresh wasabi ¥3,300, strip-loin yaki-suki with egg ¥3,800, special negi-tan shio (wagyu tongue round hand-chopped Kujo negi) ¥4,200 · cuts: special tongue ¥4,000, kalbi ¥2,800, Omi beef ribeye ¥3,800, fillet 90 g ¥6,500, Chateaubriand 100 g ¥9,000, flap and sirloin cap ¥3,000 · Karoku salad ¥1,300, namul ¥1,300, kimchi ¥1,500, Kujo-negi and nira chijimi ¥1,800 (Tabelog menu, August 2026) · courses ¥11,000–25,000 (Premium Gion Karoku course ¥18,000); lunch charcoal courses ¥2,500 and ¥3,500 by booking (Tabelog course page) · komtang soup, cold noodles, kakigori (Uji kintoki, strawberry), Karoku mochi upstairs (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Yasaka, wagyu over charcoal in a 1927 mansion] A charcoal yakiniku house in a 1927 mansion just off Yasaka-dori, where you take off your shoes, sit at a sunken table or in a private room looking onto a tsubo-niwa with stone lanterns and pine, and finish with kakigori in a separate room upstairs. The house specialty is negi-tan shio — wagyu tongue wrapped round hand-chopped Kujo negi — with Yamagata beef yukhoe and strip loin dipped in egg. Courses ¥11,000–25,000, cuts from ¥2,800; lunch from ¥2,500. Reviewers praise the setting and mostly the service; one June 2026 host found it short of expectations, and a May 2026 diner found it slow. Closed Monday.

roles: Operator 有限会社鹿永アソシエイツ (Tokyo; invoice T6010402017668); a June 2026 review says the shop is produced by the owner of a long-established Tsukiji restaurant; no one is named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a mansion built in 1927 (Showa 2), with A4-grade-and-up Kuroge wagyu eaten with salt, tare or the house negi mince. Opened 11 May 1999 (Tabelog). The invoice number belongs to 有限会社鹿永アソシエイツ (NTA corporate-number site). Tabelog Yakiniku WEST "Tabelog 100" 2020, 2021 and Grill WEST 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: 美味しさの"おもてなし" — hospitality through flavour.
chef_bio.specialty: Special negi-tan shio; Yamagata beef yukhoe; chuck-rib hana aburi.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner noted shoes off at the entrance, coats taken, and polite service to a mostly inbound clientele.
A May 2026 diner loved the food and the upstairs kakigori but found the service slow — about three hours in all.

A June 2026 host of overseas guests found the ¥18,000 course delicious but the service short of the "Japanese hospitality" seen online: greeted at once by foreign staff, drinks taken by what seemed to be student part-timers, no explanation of the cuts.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gionkarokuonline.com): 炭火焼肉 祇園 鹿六、昭和2年建造のお屋敷、厳選された A4 ランク以上の黒毛和牛、塩とタレ、特製ネギミンチ、月曜定休 (祝日営業の振替あり)、ランチは予約なしで可、毎月28〜30日は「お肉の日」(コースに1杯サービス)、2025年9月30日で駐車場サービス券の配布終了。食べログ: 焼肉・ホルモン・韓国料理、東山区八坂通東大路西入ル小松町566-25、清水道バス停から徒歩3分、火〜日 11:30〜14:30・17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、サービス料5%、個室料3,000円・5,000円、58席 (個室4、掘りごたつ8)、10歳未満は個室のみ、カード可、1999年5月11日オープン、インボイス T6010402017668 (有限会社鹿永アソシエイツ)、メニュー (英語版、2026年8月更新): Yamagata beef のユッケ3,500円、Chuck Rib Hana Aburi Yaki 3,300円、特選ネギタン塩4,200円、シャトーブリアン100g 9,000円、コース11,000〜25,000円、ランチの炭火焼きコース2,500円・3,500円。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年8月、英語): 1927年の建物、坪庭、2階でかき氷、コムタン、冷麺、接客への評価は分かれる。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off at the entrance; staff grill the first round; book private rooms by phone.

places.name: ぎをん 藤 (Gion Fuji)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura course, and the shop states it cannot accommodate gluten-free requests (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the shop states it cannot accommodate vegan, vegetarian or halal requests (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–22:00 (last food order 20:00); closed Sunday and holidays, irregularly (official site). Tabelog adds lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:00) on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday, dinner Tuesday to Saturday and holidays, closed Sunday and Monday, with occasional Monday openings on the booking calendar; a lunch visit is recorded in January and August 2026. Booking via TableCheck or phone; cancellation 50% the day before, 100% on the day; allergies and dislikes in advance; children 6 and over who order a course (Tabelog; official site). 10% service charge (official site; Tabelog). 8 counter seats and a table room for 4 behind lattice doors; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; cards (Tabelog). 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened April 2020 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Gion south of Shijo, among the old houses — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Tempura counter of seasonal seafood, vegetables and meat, fried in first-press safflower oil and served piece by piece with salts, sauces and condiments (official site) · omakase tempura courses ¥17,600, ¥19,800, ¥23,100 and ¥25,300, tax included, plus 10% service (official site); lunch course Benikikyo ¥23,100 (August 2026) · seasonal pieces (official site): spring — shirauo, clam, aburame, wild greens, Kyoto bamboo shoot; summer — hamo, young ayu, aori-ika, kisu, white corn, Kamo eggplant, manganji pepper; autumn — hamo and matsutake roll, tachiuo, ginkgo, chestnut, wild maitake; winter — fugu, seko crab, kumoko, Horikawa burdock, Shogoin turnip · sesame tofu with sea urchin; finish with tendon, ochazuke or egg yolk with caviar (2025–26 reviews) · champagne from ¥12,000; wine, sake, shochu and whisky chosen by a sommelier (official site)
places.notes: [Tempura · Gion, a Ritz-Carlton tempura chef's own counter] An eight-seat tempura counter on a street of old Gion houses, opened in 2020 by Kenji Fujimoto, former head chef of Tempura Mizuki at The Ritz-Carlton Kyoto (one Michelin star three years running). Each piece is fried in first-press safflower oil and served as it comes out: hamo and young ayu in summer, a hamo-and-matsutake roll in autumn, fugu and seko crab in winter, and a sesame tofu with sea urchin. Finish with tendon, ochazuke or egg yolk with caviar. Courses ¥17,600–25,300 plus 10% service; a sommelier pairs wine or sake. No vegan, vegetarian, halal or gluten-free requests. Booking only.

roles: Chef-owner (official site: 店主 / "Chef-owner Kenji Fujimoto")
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: The Ritz-Carlton Osaka, Japanese restaurant Hanagatami (1996–2007); 鉄板・てんぷら 義 北新地 (2007–2013); head chef of Tempura Mizuki at The Ritz-Carlton Kyoto (2013–2019), which held one Michelin star for three consecutive years from the 2018 guide; opened ぎをん藤 in April 2020. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社京都フードサービス (NTA corporate-number site). Tabelog Tempura "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: tempura fried a piece at a time, timed in front of the guest, in light first-press safflower oil so that the meal never feels heavy.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal omakase tempura; sesame tofu with sea urchin; tendon to finish.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner at the table found the tempura not piping hot, perhaps because of the table seat or the air conditioning, and planned to sit at the counter next time.
A December 2025 dinner began with grilled fugu and ankimo, then prawn heads with three salts — Awaji, Sea of Japan and a black pepper salt.
A July 2026 diner who booked the same day wished for more Kyoto ingredients and found the value modest for the price.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-fuji.com): 2020年4月に開店した京都祇園の天ぷら「ぎをん藤」、旬の魚介や野菜、お肉の天ぷらを御影石のカウンターで、目の前で揚げたてを一品ずつ、べに花油の一番搾りのみ、春: 白魚、蛤、油目桜巻き、山菜、京筍、白アスパラ、夏: 鱧、小鮎、アオリ烏賊、鱚、白とうもろこし、賀茂茄子、万願寺とうがらし、秋: 鱧松茸巻き、太刀魚、銀杏、栗、天然舞茸、冬: 河豚、セコ蟹、雲子、堀川牛蒡、聖護院蕪、京かんざし、おまかせ天ぷらコース 17,600円・19,800円・23,100円・25,300円 (税込・サービス料別)、シャンパーニュ12,000円〜、8席のカウンターと4名の個室、店主 藤元 健司 (ザ・リッツ・カールトン大阪 日本料理 花筐、鉄板・てんぷら 義 北新地、ザ・リッツ・カールトン京都 天麩羅 水暉 料理長、ミシュランガイド2018年版から3年連続一つ星)、17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 20:00)、日・祝休 (不定休)、予約は TableCheck。食べログ: 天ぷら・日本料理、東山区祇園町南側570-121、火・木・土 12:00〜15:00、火〜土・祝 17:00〜22:00、日・月休み、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・ハラール・グルテンフリーは対応不可、キャンセル料は前日50%・当日100%、6歳以上でコースを注文できる子供のみ、サービス料10%、12席、天ぷら百名店 2023・2025、インボイス T9130001081365 (株式会社京都フードサービス)。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年11月、英語): 雲丹をのせた胡麻豆腐、天丼、ランチのコース Benikikyo 23,100円。

About 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu) (Tabelog). Opened 1 September 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Shijo Kawaramachi, in a townhouse — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Italian cooking with Kyoto seasonal ingredients, from breakfast to dinner (official site): a chef with executive-chef experience at well-known hotels, herbs from the shop’s own garden, no additives (Tabelog shop text) · breakfast course ¥3,850: granola yogurt, tomato salad or juice, fluffy pancakes, coffee; avocado toast (September–October 2026) · lunch: an August–September set of stuzzichini, gazpacho, handmade ravioli of Kyoto chicken and Taggiasca olives in chestnut-flour pasta, tiramisu and coffee; a ¥6,500 holiday lunch course with a choice of three pastas and fish or beef (August–September 2026) · dinner: spinach tagliatelle with cream, tomato and sea urchin pasta, cheese risotto, duck breast; white truffle dishes promised for October (September 2026) · aperitivi, signature cocktails, a chosen wine list (official site)
places.notes: [Italian · Kawaramachi, la dolce vita from breakfast] A warm, wood-and-greenery Italian restaurant in a townhouse near Kawaramachi that feels, reviewers say, like being abroad: breakfast of pancakes and granola from 9:00 (¥3,850), lunch courses and handmade ravioli, then dinner of pasta, cheese risotto and duck, with cocktails and Italian wines. Much of the staff is from abroad and speaks English, the owner's dog wanders the room, and dogs are welcome on the terrace. A 10% service charge; no children under 10 at dinner. One September 2026 diner with a table booking was first shown to the terrace.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: authentic Italian cooking by a chef who was executive chef at renowned hotels, using fresh ingredients from selected regions and herbs from the shop’s own garden, without additives. Per the official site: Italian food with Japan’s finest seasonal ingredients, aperitivos, cocktails and wine, for Kyoto residents and visitors from Japan and abroad, "in the spirit of la dolce vita". Opened 1 September 2020 (Tabelog). A September 2026 regular heard from the owner-chef about white truffle dishes coming the next month; another reviewer saw the owner’s dog roaming the restaurant.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a destination where excellent food, culture, music, art and fashion converge, "our own definition of luxury".
chef_bio.specialty: Breakfast pancakes; handmade pasta and ravioli.

anecdotes.text: "Many of the staff members are foreigners, but they are also fluent in Japanese. The owner's dog roams around the restaurant, adding to the comforting ambiance." — September 2026.
"The pancakes were crispy and fragrant on the outside, while being soft and fluffy on the inside." — September 2026.

A September 2026 diner with a table booking was led to a dim terrace and told only the terrace was available; a table was opened on request. The holiday lunch came to nearly ¥10,000 with the surcharge.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・ステーキ・パスタ、中京区伊勢屋町362、阪急河原町駅から徒歩約5分、毎日 9:00〜11:00 (L.O. 10:30)・11:30〜17:00 (14〜17時は一部のアラカルトのみ)・17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 料理21:00・ドリンク22:30)、予約可、10歳未満はランチのみ、犬はテラス席のみ、サービス料10%、56席 (テラス20、カウンター8、テーブル28)、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、2020年9月1日オープン、店舗紹介: ホテルの総料理長を務めたシェフ、自家菜園のハーブ、無添加。公式サイト (英語): 京都の旬の食材とイタリア料理、アペリティーヴォ、カクテル、ワイン、朝食、la dolce vita。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 朝食コース3,850円、パンケーキ、グラノーラ、手打ちのラビオリ、ほうれん草のパスタ、ウニのトマトパスタ、チーズのリゾット、鴨胸肉、英語で接客する海外のスタッフ、オーナーの犬、テラス席。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff and an English website; 10% service; dogs on the terrace.

places.name: 祇園みかく (Gion Mikaku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan steak, grilled shabu-shabu and teppan sukiyaki, finished with garlic rice or Mikaku beef curry; sukiyaki and curry usually involve soy sauce or roux, and no gluten information is given (official menu; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef house; even the lunch comes with beef shigure on the rice and a beef-bone soup (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Monday; booking required for both (official site). Tabelog adds that dinner should be booked a day or two ahead. Formal dress: no sandals or patterned shirts in summer; school-age children only, no infants (Tabelog). 16 counter seats upstairs around the teppan, plus a private room for up to 7 (official site; Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Nawate by the Shirakawa, north of Shijo; reached by lift; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site; Tabelog; December 2025).
places.neighborhood: Nawate by the Shirakawa, north of Shijo — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki beef house of female cattle only, bought whole as calves raised in Sanda, Hyogo, aged and boned in-house (official site); Tabelog’s shop text says young female Tajima cattle · Mikaku three-way course ¥30,000: 8 plates with 150 g of beef as grilled shabu-shabu (round), steak (fillet) and teppan sukiyaki (loin), garlic rice or Mikaku beef curry, ice cream (official menu) · Mikaku beef steak course: round 150 g ¥26,500, fillet 150 g ¥38,500, loin 200 g ¥40,000 (official menu) · lunch steak with soup, grilled vegetables, rice with beef shigure and beef-bone soup: 100 g ¥5,000 to 250 g ¥9,500 (official menu) · beer, whisky, sake, chosen wines (official menu)
places.notes: [Teppan steak · Gion Shirakawa, a beef house since 1929] A third-generation beef house on the Shirakawa, where the cooks grill only female wagyu — bought whole, aged and boned in-house — on the teppan in front of a 16-seat counter, with big windows onto weeping cherries in spring and greenery in summer. Steak, grilled shabu-shabu and teppan sukiyaki come together in the ¥30,000 three-way course; the lunch steak starts at ¥5,000 for 100 g. The house began teppan steak after the war at the request of occupation officers. Formal dress; book ahead; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1929 (Showa 4) — Tabelog’s shop text gives 1927 — as a gyūnabe house that grew on the founder 三田進太郎’s "太牢油焼"; teppan steak began after the war at the request of occupation officers; the founder, the second generation 三田昌治 and the third generation 三田兼司 have served only the best cuts of female cattle; calves registered by nose print and raised in Sanda, Hyogo, are bought whole and aged and boned in the shop; the centenary falls in 2029. A sister shop, 北新地みかく, is in Osaka (official site; a June 2026 reviewer also mentions it).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: choose the finest beef, cut it with the best technique and cook it to the best doneness, unchanged since the founder.
chef_bio.specialty: Three-way course of steak, grilled shabu-shabu and teppan sukiyaki.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 group at the counter called it an honour to have a steak grilled by the chef, and admired the greenery through the large windows.
"At the counter seats, the view through the window resembles a beautiful painting." Two lunches of 200 g and 150 g with dessert and coffee came to about ¥16,000. — December 2025.
An October 2024 visitor took the nine-dish tasting course (¥28,000) of sukiyaki, shabu-shabu and teppan steak, finishing with garlic rice and beef curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (mikaku.co.jp): 1929年 (昭和4年) 創業、雌牛の太牢のみ、創業者・三田進太郎、二代目・三田昌治、三代目・三田兼司、牛鍋から始まり「太牢油焼」、戦後に占領軍将校の求めで鉄板焼ステーキ、兵庫県三田市で育った子牛を一頭買いし店内で熟成・脱骨、2029年に百周年、東山区常盤町165番地 (祇園縄手四条上ル車道)、カウンター16席、12:00〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、予約必須、月曜定休、みかく三種焼コース30,000円、みかく牛ステーキコース (もも150g 26,500円、フィレ150g 38,500円、ロース200g 40,000円)、ランチのみかく牛鉄板ステーキ100g 5,000円〜250g 9,500円、北新地みかく。食べログ: ステーキ・すき焼き、1927年からの老舗、Tajima の若い雌牛 (店舗紹介)、夜は1〜2日前までに予約、ドレスコード、小学生以上、乳幼児不可、カード可。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年6月、英語): 窓からの白川の眺め、シェフが目の前で焼く、ランチ2人で約16,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (Tabelog or TableCheck); English page on the official site; formal dress; cards accepted.

places.name: トラットリア レオーネ (Trattoria Leone)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tuscan trattoria: pasta (dried and homemade), lasagna, crostini, arancini and breaded vegetables in the appetiser platter, bread with meals; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetable aglio e olio and basil pasta appear as daily pastas, but the appetiser platters mix in tuna, liver, omelette and cheese; no vegan dish is named (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 (last order 14:00), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday and the third Tuesday of the month (Tabelog). Book by phone: Tabelog takes one online booking (up to two people) a day and none for Friday to Sunday; lunch booking advised (Tabelog; July 2026). No children below elementary school age (Tabelog). 16 table seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), iD, QUICPay, PayPay and au PAY (Tabelog). English menu; sommelier; takeaway (Tabelog). Ground floor of 京都1号館ビル on Takatsuji west of Muromachi; 5–10 min walk from Shijo or Karasuma stations (Tabelog). Opened 11 November 2007 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takatsuji-dori west of Muromachi, south of Shijo Karasuma — 5–10 min walk from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Authentic Tuscan cooking in a small trattoria (Tabelog shop text) · lunch, four set options from salad and pasta to appetisers, pasta, main and dessert: salad and the day’s spaghetti ¥1,300 (September 2026); a generous appetiser platter of frittata, bean stew, fritters, crostini with chicken-liver pâté and a small lasagna (July–October 2026) · pastas: spicy spaghetti carrettiera, homemade pappardelle or tagliatelle with Tuscan wagyu ragù ¥2,000, basil pasta, mushroom-cream ravioli with sage butter (2026 reviews) · arista (herbed roast pork loin), beef braciole rifatte ¥3,400, tagliata (2026 reviews) · chicken-liver crostini ¥1,000, pecorino arancini ¥800, mushroom and Parmigiano salad ¥1,500, tiramisu (July 2026) · Tuscan wines, bottles from about ¥3,000 (July 2026)
places.notes: [Italian · Shijo Karasuma, a small Tuscan trattoria] A 16-seat trattoria south of Shijo Karasuma, open since 2007, with maps and drawings on the walls and cooking straight from Tuscany: an appetiser platter so large it is nearly a meal, spicy carrettiera, homemade pappardelle with wagyu ragù, herb-roasted arista and chicken-liver crostini, with Tuscan wines from about ¥3,000 a bottle. Lunch from ¥1,300 is a bargain and fills up — book by phone. Service is quiet and minimal: reviewers in June and October 2026 found it brusque and unexplained. Closed Wednesday and the third Tuesday. Tabelog Italian WEST 100 2021.

roles: Chef and a server (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: a cozy little Italian restaurant of authentic Tuscan cuisine. Opened 11 November 2007 (Tabelog). Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021. Regulars in 2026 praise the value and the portions; two 2026 reviewers describe a quiet server who explains little.
chef_bio.specialty: Tuscan appetiser platter; carrettiera; wagyu ragù pappardelle; arista.

anecdotes.text: "The appetizer portion is incredible... I mean, is this really just an appetizer? It's so much food." — July 2026.
A June 2026 diner found the service brusque, the beef tagliata tough and the card payment handled out of sight with no breakdown, though the pastas had a Tuscan flavour.
"At TRATTORIA LEONE, everything I’ve tried has been delicious and there are no misses, all at reasonable prices." — July 2026.
"The quiet server... quite innovative." There was no explanation of the daily pasta or dessert. — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): イタリアン・パスタ・ダイニングバー、下京区高辻通室町西入ル繁昌町295-1 京都1号館ビル1F、四条駅・烏丸駅から徒歩5〜10分、12:00〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、水曜と第3火曜休み、ネット予約は1日1組2名まで (金〜日は不可)、電話予約がおすすめ、未就学児不可、16席、禁煙、カード・iD・QUICPay・PayPay・au PAY 可、英語メニュー、ソムリエ、テイクアウト、2007年11月11日オープン、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2021、店舗紹介: 本格トスカーナ料理の小さなイタリアン。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): ボリュームのある前菜の盛り合わせ、カレッティエラ、和牛ラグーのパッパルデッレ2,000円、アリスタ、鶏レバーのクロスティーニ1,000円、ランチ1,300円から、無口な接客、説明がない、カードの会計への不満 (2026年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; book by phone; little explanation from the server; cards and QR accepted.

places.name: The Churrasco 京都河原町 (The Churrasco Kyoto Kawaramachi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled meats carved at the table with sauces, alongside a buffet of bread, curry, pizza, pasta and fried dishes; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an all-you-can-eat meat restaurant; grilled vegetables, pineapple and the salad bar are sides (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday to Friday 16:00–23:30; Saturday 12:00–23:00; Sunday and holidays 12:00–23:30; last food order 22:30, drinks 23:00 (Tabelog). Two-hour sittings (food last order at 70 or 90 minutes, depending on the course); one drink per person unless you take free drinks (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, same-day welcome (Tabelog). From 12 to 31 December courses cost ¥500 more; a reviewer paid ¥500 extra on a Sunday (Tabelog; October 2026). 100 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome, with child prices (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay; no service or table charge (Tabelog). Menus in English, traditional Chinese and Korean (Tabelog). 6th floor of Don Quijote Shijo Kawaramachi; 2 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Tabelog gives the opening as 1 May 2025; the shop text says May 2023.
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-dori south of Takoyakushi, 6th floor — 2 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: All-you-can-eat Brazilian churrasco: skewers of beef, pork, chicken and sausage roasted with rock salt and carved at the table, plus grilled vegetables, grilled pineapple, pão de queijo, a salad bar, curry and rice (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews) · courses (2 hours): premium, 18 churrasco types and Italian dishes ¥4,990; standard, 16 types ¥3,990 (Tabelog); a reviewer paid ¥4,490 for the standard course at a holiday lunch, plus ¥660 for soft drinks (October 2026) · Italian all-you-can-eat with free drinks ¥3,500: 8 pizzas, 6 pastas, fritti, mussels, zeppole (Tabelog; November 2026) · children: elementary ¥2,500, preschool ¥500 (October 2026) · birthday dessert plate ¥500 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Churrasco · Kawaramachi, all-you-can-eat Brazilian grill] A big, 100-seat churrasco room on the 6th floor of the Don Quijote at Shijo Kawaramachi, with night views over the city: staff — one reviewer mentions a Brazilian chef — carve skewers of beef, garlic chicken and sausage at the table, with grilled pineapple, cheese bread, a salad bar and a well-liked curry. Two-hour courses run ¥3,990–4,990 (more on Sundays and in late December); there is also an Italian buffet with free drinks for ¥3,500. Good for groups and families. One October 2026 regular found the beef tough and the carving clumsy. Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST 100 2026.

roles: Staff who carve at the table; a Brazilian chef per one review (October 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: one of the few churrasco restaurants in Kyoto, with all-you-can-eat and all-you-can-drink courses, wagyu skewers grilled and carved in front of you, and a night view; projector and microphone hire for groups. The operator’s website is will-food.com (株式会社WILL). Tabelog gives the opening date as 1 May 2025, while its shop text says "Opened in May 2023". Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Churrasco skewers carved at the table; grilled pineapple.

anecdotes.text: "This restaurant offers authentic churrasco prepared by a Brazilian chef" — October 2026.

An October 2026 repeat visitor liked the pineapple, mushrooms and chicken but found the beef tough and thick or thin by turns as staff struggled to carve it, and was struck on the neck by a skewer while meat was being sliced.

"In the last 10 minutes of the all-you-can-eat period, I could also order additional servings of my favorite churrasco" — October 2026; the same reviewer noted sauces left in open containers on the table.
"And when you come here, you absolutely must try the... self-service homemade curry!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): シュラスコ・イタリアン・ビュッフェ、中京区河原町通蛸薬師下る塩屋町321 ドン・キホーテ四条河原町店6F、京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、月〜金 16:00〜23:30、土 12:00〜23:00、日祝 12:00〜23:30 (L.O. 料理22:30・ドリンク23:00)、予約可 (当日も可)、1人1ドリンクか飲み放題、2時間制、プレミアム食べ放題4,990円、スタンダード3,990円、イタリアン食べ飲み放題3,500円、12月12〜31日は500円増し、100席、禁煙、車椅子可、子供可、カード・PayPay・Alipay・WeChat Pay 可、サービス料・チャージなし、英語・繁体字・韓国語メニュー、2025年5月1日オープン (店舗紹介は2023年5月)、アジア・エスニック WEST 百名店 2026、運営サイト will-food.com。口コミ (2026年10〜11月、英語): ブラジル人のシェフ、パイナップル、ポン・デ・ケージョ、カレー、サラダバー、日曜は500円増し、子供料金、肉が硬く切り方が下手との声、串が首に当たった、タレの容器が開いたまま。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; meat brought to the table; cards and QR accepted.

places.name: 魚々鶏夜 (WOW WOW TONIGHT)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Straw-grilled fish, teppanyaki and oden with soy-based seasonings, plus fried dishes (fried oysters, shrimp mayo, fried corn) and hamburg steak; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and grilled vegetables are on the menu, but the oden is in broth and most dishes are fish, chicken or beef (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–24:00 daily; last booking for dining 21:00; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Book ahead, especially at weekends; on-the-day bookings and cancellations sometimes free a seat (October 2026). Ground floor: 11 counter seats, 2 tables and one private room for 4–5; upstairs: 20 table seats where you ring a bell for staff, which can be slow (Tabelog; August and October 2026). Non-smoking with a smoking area; cards, e-money and PayPay; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). In a renovated Kyoto townhouse down a back alley behind Fujii Daimaru, 2 min from Exit 11 of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Back alley behind Fujii Daimaru, Shijo Teramachi — 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Izakaya in a renovated townhouse: fish grilled over straw, teppanyaki, seasonal dishes and seasonal sake, including Kyoto sakes such as Shōtendōji and Hōryō (Tabelog, shop text) · Manzoku course of 7 dishes with straw-grilled seasonal seafood ¥5,000 (Tabelog) · straw-grilled platter, sashimi with seared bonito, sea urchin, grilled squid, grilled hokke, katsuobushi shuto (2026 reviews) · warm potato salad, shrimp mayo with corn, fried corn, fried oysters with homemade tartar, beef carpaccio, hamburg steak, liver with garlic chives, Kujo-negi and chicken neck stir-fry, meat tofu, grilled rice balls · oden from autumn: thick fried tofu, rolled cabbage (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo Teramachi, straw-grilled fish in a townhouse] A renovated Kyoto townhouse at the end of an alley behind Fujii Daimaru, with a busy counter downstairs and tables upstairs. The house specialty is fish seared over burning straw — try the straw-grilled platter or the ¥5,000 seven-dish course — alongside a much-praised warm potato salad, shrimp mayo with corn, fried corn and, in the cold months, oden. Kyoto sakes by the season. Some 2026 diners found service slow, especially upstairs where you ring a bell. Book ahead; open daily 18:00–24:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): an adult hideaway renovated from a Kyoto townhouse, with fish grilled over straw and sizzling teppanyaki made from seasonal ingredients, and seasonal sake; the owner wants every guest to try the signature straw-grilled dish in the Manzoku course. An October 2026 reviewer found the counter busy with many international customers; another that month noted a wide age range among the patrons.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): dishes that highlight the natural flavours of the ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: Straw-grilled seafood; warm potato salad; oden.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner liked the food but found each dish and drink slow to arrive and did not plan to return.
"Calling the staff is done with a bell, so they don’t come quickly. The first floor is more convenient." — October 2026.
"The potato salad was prepared in a unique way that I had never experienced before, and it was delicious!" — September 2026.
An August 2026 diner found the goya too bitter, while liking the potato salad and shrimp mayo.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・鉄板焼き、下京区大寿町400、阪急京都河原町駅11番出口から徒歩2分、Fujii Daimaru の裏の路地、毎日18:00〜24:00、食事の予約は21:00まで、不定休、予約可、38席 (1階カウンター11、テーブル2、完全個室4〜5名、2階テーブル20)、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、車椅子可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、町家を改装した大人の隠れ家、藁焼きの鮮魚と鉄板焼き、季節の日本酒 (Shōtendōji、Hōryō など京都の地酒)、Manzoku コース7品5,000円。TableCheck: 藁焼きの魚介と鉄板焼き。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): 藁焼きの盛り合わせ、温かいポテトサラダ、海老マヨとコーン、とうもろこしの揚げ物、牡蠣フライ、おでん、牛のカルパッチョ、2階は呼び鈴、提供が遅いという声、海外の客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; sit downstairs if you can; cards accepted.
