places.name: 窯焼和牛ステーキと京のおばんざい 市場小路 寺町本店 (Ichiba Koji Teramachi honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Steaks are grilled on the teppan and in a stone oven, but sauces, obanzai, chicken nanban and tofu toppings use soy and other seasonings; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, and the homemade tofu, multigrain rice and some obanzai may suit, but dashi and miso soup are likely and the mains are meat (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–16:00 (last order 15:00), dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:15); closed on New Year’s Day (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, seat requests not guaranteed (Tabelog); walk-ins usually fine at lunch, with a short queue at opening (September 2026). Evening starter charge ¥330 for all-you-can-eat homemade tofu (not with lunch or courses) (Tabelog). Order by scanning a code (September 2026). 136 seats at sunken kotatsu, tables and an 8-seat counter facing the open kitchen; private rooms for 20 or more (Tabelog). All seats non-smoking, with a smoking room; wheelchair accessible; cards, IC cards, e-money, PayPay and au PAY (Tabelog). Basement of the WITH YOU building on the west side of Teramachi north of Nishiki — look for the meat-print noren; 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi-dori north of Nishiki, basement — 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Large teppan izakaya of black-wagyu steak grilled on the teppan and in a stone oven, served on warming trays, with Kyoto obanzai (Tabelog, shop text) · lunch: a plate of eight obanzai with a main — wagyu steak, ginger pork, beef short rib, chicken nanban — and free refills of homemade steamed tofu, multigrain rice and miso soup; from about ¥1,000, over ¥2,000 with beef short rib (September 2026) · dinner: unlimited homemade tofu as a starter (¥330), lean and top black wagyu steaks, dashimaki, a tall "frozen lemon tower" sour; courses with free-flow drinks (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Steak & obanzai · Teramachi, wagyu and all-you-can-eat tofu] A big, lively basement restaurant on Teramachi near Nishiki Market, the main shop of a small Kyoto group, where black wagyu is seared on the teppan and finished in a stone oven. Lunch is the draw: eight small obanzai, a main of steak or ginger pork, and unlimited refills of warm homemade tofu, multigrain rice and miso soup, from about ¥1,000. Evenings bring steak, dashimaki and a tower of frozen-lemon sour, with the tofu as a ¥330 starter. Some 2026 diners found dishes salty or a fried dish served cold. Open daily.

roles: Company-run restaurant (a corporate invoice registrant, Tabelog); no staff named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): steaks grilled on a teppan and in a stone oven, served with warming trays; homemade steamed tofu refilled at lunch and as the dinner starter; Kyoto obanzai lunches; room for banquets of 30 or more. Other 市場小路 shops: AEON Mall Kitaoji (Gurunavi) and Katsuragawa (an August 2026 reviewer who visits all three).
chef_bio.specialty: Stone-oven wagyu steak; obanzai lunch with unlimited tofu.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular who uses the shop for office parties wishes the course tofu came plain with salt and could be refilled, as it can à la carte.
An October 2026 holiday lunch diner found the chicken nanban served cold.
An October 2026 diner found the miso soup and obanzai a little too salty, while praising the free refills.
"I really enjoy being able to watch the cooking in the open kitchen right in front of me." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・ステーキ・日本料理、中京区寺町通錦小路上ル円福寺前町283 WITH YOUビル B1F、京都河原町駅から徒歩3分、寺町通錦上ル西側、肉ののれんが目印、11:30〜16:00 (L.O. 15:00)・17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:15)、元日休み、予約可 (席の希望には沿えない場合あり)、お通し食べ放題330円 (ランチ・コースは除く)、136席、個室、喫煙室あり、車椅子可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay・au PAY 可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、鉄板と石窯で焼くステーキ、自家製の蒸し豆腐。ぐるなび: 市場小路 イオンモール北大路店。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): おばんざい8種と和牛ステーキのランチ、豆腐・雑穀ご飯・味噌汁のおかわり自由、桂川にも店、バーコードで注文、オープンキッチン、冷めたチキン南蛮、塩辛いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by scanning the table code; refills of tofu, rice and miso soup are free at lunch; cards accepted.

places.name: ボン・ボランテ (bonne volonte)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery — loaves, croissants, filled buns and rusks (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain loaves and walnut or raisin breads may be simple doughs, but croissants, cream buns and sausage bread are not, and no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 11:00–20:00; closed Sunday, Monday and all of August; times may change with the baking (Tabelog; September 2026). Popular breads, especially the walnut bread, can sell out soon after opening or before it, and the shelves can be nearly empty by 16:00 (June–July 2026). Phone reservations are taken, but with one person baking and serving the line can be hard to get through (Tabelog; June 2026). Takeaway only; the shop fits three or four customers; loaves are sliced to order (September 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi-dori south of Kojinguchi, about 8–10 min walk from Exit 1 of Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-dori south of Kojinguchi — 8–10 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Bakery with a wood-fired clay oven (2026 reviews) · walnut bread ¥90 (June 2026), raisin and orange bread ¥90, whole-wheat sesame chocolate bread ¥160, つぶあんぱん ¥220, hazelnut "Sunrise" ¥250, チョコクロワッサン ¥250 (September 2026), orange croissant ¥250 (April 2026) · yama-shokupan loaves sliced to order, cream buns, bread with Lindenbaum sausage, dried-fruit rusk (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bakery · Kojinguchi, one baker and a wood-fired oven] A tiny bakery on Kawaramachi-dori where the owner bakes alone in a large clay oven fired with wood, and prices stay low — a walnut bread is ¥90. Come near the 11:00 opening: the walnut bread and the hazelnut 'Sunrise' go fast, and by late afternoon little may be left. Loaves are sliced as you like. Takeaway only, cash only. Tuesday–Saturday; closed all of August.

roles: Owner-baker who runs the shop alone (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per a July 2026 reviewer: the owner and a friend designed the interior and built a large clay oven fired with thinned wood from the mountains of Kyoto (the same review mentions firewood from Miyama); the name means "goodwill" in French; as the sole baker, the owner’s baking times and quantities vary from day to day. A June 2026 reviewer also notes the single staff member. A November 2026 visitor came on the recommendation of several geiko but found it closed on Sunday. Tabelog Bread WEST "Tabelog 100" 2020, 2022, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Walnut bread; hazelnut Sunrise; yama-shokupan.

anecdotes.text: "I was amazed by how delicious the walnut bread was. At just JPY 90, it was incredibly simple yet deeply flavorful." — June 2026.
A July 2026 visitor arrived at 16:00 to find only a yama-shokupan left and bought a dried-fruit rusk instead.
"The bread can be cut into your preferred number of slices inside the shop." — September 2026.
A November 2026 visitor came on several geiko’s recommendation, only to find the shop closed on Sunday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン・スイーツ・ベーグル、上京区河原町通荒神口下ル上生洲町229-1、神宮丸太町駅1番出口から徒歩約10分、火〜土 11:00〜20:00、日・月と8月は休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、パン WEST 百名店 2020・2022・2026。口コミ (2026年4〜11月、英語): 店主が一人で薪の土窯で焼く、くるみパン90円、レーズンとオレンジのパン90円、全粒粉とごまのチョコパン160円、つぶあんぱん220円、Sunrise 250円、チョコクロワッサン250円、オレンジのクロワッサン250円、山型食パンは好みの枚数に切ってくれる、早い時間に売り切れ、8月は長い休み。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the breads in the case; say how many slices for a loaf; cash only.

places.name: 菓子・茶房 チェカ (cheka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kakigori and pudding are flour-free in principle, but the cakes (cheesecake on a cookie base, tiramisu, Mont Blanc) use wheat, and no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Fruit and matcha kakigori syrups may be plant-based, but the pudding kakigori, custard and the cakes use milk, cream and eggs; no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Wednesday–Sunday 10:00–18:00, until sold out; closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). No reservations; cash only (Tabelog). Order on the ground floor, then sit in the upstairs tea room and pay on leaving (2026 reviews). Kakigori is served upstairs from about May to September, when cakes are takeaway only; outside that season cakes can be eaten upstairs (September 2026). Groups are let in one at a time — wait outside when asked (October 2026); a 15–20 minute wait is common (July and November 2026). Photography inside is not allowed (September 2026). 16 seats: tatami for 6–8 and tables for 8–10 (Tabelog). Near the Kyoto City Zoo and Kyocera Museum of Art; Hosshoji-cho bus stop, 7 min walk from Keage Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki near the Kyoto City Zoo — 7 min walk from Keage Stn
places.cuisine: Cake shop with a retro upstairs tea room (2026 reviews) · summer kakigori, served with warm hojicha: pudding kakigori with custard, caramel and a whole pudding inside ¥1,400; matcha and Uji matcha, mango, peach, strawberry (June–September 2026) · cakes: cube-shaped cheesecake on a lemon white-chocolate cookie base, donut-shaped tiramisu with coffee jelly and Japanese chestnut Mont Blanc, about ¥600 each (September–November 2026) · coffee and freshly whisked matcha (November 2026)
places.notes: [Cake shop & tea room · Okazaki, pudding kakigori] A small cake shop near the Kyoto City Zoo with a Showa-retro tea room upstairs. In summer it is all kakigori — the pudding kakigori (¥1,400), with custard, caramel and a whole pudding hidden inside, is the one people queue for; the rest of the year you pick a cake downstairs (donut-shaped tiramisu, chestnut Mont Blanc, cube cheesecake, about ¥600) and eat it upstairs with coffee. Expect to wait outside, one group at a time. No photos inside; cash only. Wednesday–Sunday 10:00–18:00.

roles: Cake shop; no one is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a small cake shop near the zoo with a retro, Showa-era feel, a tea room upstairs that serves kakigori from about May to September, careful choice of furniture and decor, and a no-photography rule. Tabelog Cafe "Tabelog 100" 2022 and Cafe WEST 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Pudding kakigori; tiramisu; Mont Blanc.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor found the staff a bit intimidating after being firmly told to wait outside until the previous group had gone in.
A September 2026 visitor found the no-photo rule and being told not to move from an assigned seat a little much, while praising the furniture and decor.
"The fluffy shaved ice contained a whole custard pudding, which was incredibly satisfying!" — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・ケーキ・かき氷、左京区岡崎法勝寺町25番地、法勝寺町バス停、蹴上駅から徒歩7分、水〜日 10:00〜18:00 (売り切れ次第終了)、月・火休み、予約不可、16席 (座敷6〜8、テーブル8〜10)、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、カフェ百名店 2022、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年6〜11月、英語): 1階で注文し2階の茶房へ、会計は帰り、5〜9月ごろはかき氷のみ店内でケーキは持ち帰り、プリンかき氷1,400円、抹茶、マンゴー、桃、いちご、温かいほうじ茶、ドーナツ形のティラミス、和栗のモンブラン、約600円、店内撮影禁止、1組ずつ入店、外で待つ。

cultural_comfort.note: Wait outside until called; order downstairs; no photos; cash only.

places.name: 棲家 富小路店 (Sumika Tomikoji)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, simmered dishes and vegetables built on dashi, plus tempura, fried yuba and curry udon; the shop asks guests to tell it about allergies, but no gluten information is given (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the menu is rich in Kyoto vegetables and tofu, but the obanzai and simmered dishes use dashi, and the courses include fish and pork (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 18:00–1:00, Saturday, Sunday and holidays 17:00–1:00 (last order 0:30); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Bookings for seats only; stays may be limited to two hours when busy; tell the shop about allergies (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink course ¥6,000 (September 2026). 34 seats: 6 at the counter, tables, a loft for up to 8 and a tatami room for up to 14; smoking allowed; cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Up a steep staircase on the second floor, 50 m north of Shijo on Tominokoji (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Tominokoji just north of Shijo, toward Nishiki Market (2F) — 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Izakaya for Kyoto vegetables, obanzai, fish and sake (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · stone-grilled and steamed Kyoto vegetables, Manganji peppers, Kujo green onion stir-fried with chicken neck · assorted obanzai, simmered pork belly and taro, fried Kyoto yuba, the house tofu (one reviewer’s "best ever") · thick-cut sashimi, hamo with sauce, tempura with three salts · curry udon to finish · all-you-can-drink course ¥6,000: appetizers, salad, sashimi, three obanzai, Saikyo-miso pork on a hot stone, fried dish, takikomi gohan and miso soup, dessert (September 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Tominokoji, Kyoto vegetables until 1 am] A second-floor izakaya up a steep stair just north of Shijo, open until 1:00 every night: stone-grilled and steamed Kyoto vegetables, obanzai, a house tofu that reviewers rave about, thick-cut sashimi and local sake, with curry udon to finish. Bills about ¥5,000–8,000 a head; an all-you-can-drink course is ¥6,000. One of three Sumika shops in Kyoto. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Opened 22 August 2009 (Tabelog). Our crawl lists two other 棲家 shops in Kyoto, the 本店 (Tabelog 26004942) and the 三条店 (26030888).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto vegetables; obanzai; house tofu.

anecdotes.text: A third-time guest called the Kyoto tofu "the best tofu I’ve ever had" and got in without a booking — August 2026.
An August 2026 group found the sake good but the food not particularly noteworthy, and the four-seat tables cramped.
"It was great that this place was open until 1 AM." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 棲家 富小路店、居酒屋・野菜料理・日本料理、中京区四条富小路上ル西大文字町615 メディナ四条富小路 2F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分、月〜金 18:00〜1:00、土日祝 17:00〜1:00 (L.O. 0:30)、不定休、席のみ予約可、混雑時は2時間制、アレルギーは要連絡、34席 (カウンター6、テーブル24)、ロフト8名、座敷14名、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、2009年8月22日オープン、ベジタリアンメニューあり。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 京野菜の石焼きと蒸し野菜、おばんざい、豆腐、刺身、天ぷら、豚バラと里芋の煮物、京湯葉の揚げ物、九条ねぎ、締めのカレーうどん、飲み放題付きコース6,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a seat; tell the shop about allergies; steep stairs.

places.name: 祇園 そのう (Gion Sonou)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Japanese à la carte with an emphasis on dashi — sashimi, grilled and fried dishes, battera, clay-pot rice; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the menu centres on market fish and dashi-based cooking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–23:30 (last order 23:00), Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Bookings online or by phone; five or more by phone (Tabelog). 18 seats: a long counter and private rooms for 4–8; smoking area until 21:00; BYO allowed; cards accepted (Tabelog; January 2026). Second floor of 鴨東ビル; 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn, a short walk from the Minamiza (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: East of the Kamo River near the Minamiza, north of Shijo — 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Casual Japanese kaiseki and à la carte: market-fresh fish, obanzai, seasonal flavours and dashi (Tabelog) · omakase course with seasonal clay-pot rice (Tabelog) · à la carte: sashimi platters, battera, firefly-squid shabu-shabu in spring, oysters and ayu in early summer, matsutake in autumn · "today’s kamadaki rice" from three choices, e.g. with eel; leftovers made into onigiri to take home · seasonal and rare sake, matched to your dishes (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese · Gion-Shijo, à la carte by the counter] A second-floor Japanese restaurant near the Minamiza, opened in 2023, with a long counter staffed by several cooks and a few private rooms. Order a little of everything — market fish, seasonal shabu-shabu, battera — with sake matched by the staff, and finish with kamadaki rice (leftovers come back as onigiri). About ¥10,000–15,000 a head; portions are small. Open late; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 January 2023 (Tabelog). Per the operator’s Tabelog text: freshness first in the sashimi, easy obanzai, seasonal flavours and dashi; fish bought directly from the market.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fish; kamadaki rice.

anecdotes.text: Rice left over from the kamadaki pot is made into onigiri to take home — May 2026.
A July 2026 diner found the portions on the small side and the cost-performance "not the best", but would return.
Told in advance of an anniversary, the shop prepared a surprise "beyond our expectations" — July 2026.
"The charm of the chef's personality is also one of the highlights." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 そのう、日本料理、東山区廿一軒町236 鴨東ビル 2F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、月〜土 17:30〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00)、日曜・祝日休み、5名以上は電話予約、18席、個室 (4・6・8名)、21時まで分煙、持ち込み可、カード可、2023年1月15日オープン、市場直送の鮮魚、おばんざい、出汁、旬の土鍋ご飯付きのおまかせコース。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): アラカルト、刺身の盛り合わせ、バッテラ、ホタルイカのしゃぶしゃぶ、鮎、牡蠣、松茸、釜炊きご飯 (残りはおにぎりに)、珍しい日本酒、量は少なめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; ask the staff to pick sake for your dishes.

places.name: ドミニク・ブシェ・キョート・ル・テッパンヤキ (Dominique Bouchet Kyoto Le Teppanyaki)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Teppanyaki courses of wagyu, seafood and grilled vegetables with French sauces and appetizers, garlic rice or ramen to finish; no gluten information (official site; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses are built on wagyu, lobster and abalone, with sauces such as beef rillettes and butter (official site; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:00–22:00 (last entry 20:00); closed Wednesday except holidays; lunch must be booked by 20:00 the day before (official site). Lunch from ¥10,000, dinner from ¥20,000, tax and service included (official site); Tabelog lists a 15% service charge. Changes and cancellations by phone by the day before; a no-show on the day is charged (official site). 26 seats in several teppan counter rooms of 6–8 with views over Higashiyama; jacket recommended for men; non-smoking; children welcome; wheelchair accessible (official site; Tabelog; May 2026). Cards, IC cards and QR payments (Tabelog). In The Westin Miyako Kyoto, 2 min from Keage Stn; hotel shuttle from Kyoto Station Hachijo exit (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Keage, in The Westin Miyako Kyoto — 2 min from Keage Stn
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki with French touches, the first teppanyaki restaurant produced by the French chef Dominique Bouchet (official site) · French-style appetizers and desserts; Kyoto-raised beef and brand wagyu — Kobe, Omi and Kyoto beef, A4 grade or higher, offered as a three-way comparison (official site) · lunch from ¥10,000, dinner from ¥20,000 (official site) · seasonal grilled vegetables, abalone, blue or Ise lobster (each about ¥5,000 extra), Omi Chateaubriand, garlic rice, Ise-lobster ramen to finish (2025–26 reviews) · walk-in cellar of about 300 wines (2,500 bottles) with a sommelier (official site)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Keage, a French chef’s grill in The Westin Miyako] The Westin Miyako’s teppanyaki room, produced by the French chef Dominique Bouchet: counter rooms for six to eight with views over Higashiyama, French-style starters and desserts, then Kobe, Omi and Kyoto wagyu, abalone and lobster on the plate, and garlic rice or lobster ramen to finish. Lunch from ¥10,000, dinner from ¥20,000. Book lunch the day before; jacket suggested. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Producing chef (監修, per the hotel’s page); the teppan chefs are not named
chef_bio.background: Per the hotel page: born in Poitou-Charentes; head chef at La Tour d’Argent and Hôtel de Crillon in Paris before opening Restaurant Dominique Bouchet in Paris’s 8th arrondissement in 2004; besides Kyoto, now runs Dominique Bouchet Tokyo in Ginza and the bistro Les Copains de Dominique Bouchet. This is the first teppanyaki restaurant Bouchet has produced. Opened 27 November 2019 (Tabelog). Tabelog Steak/Teppanyaki WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025. The same hotel also houses Dominique Bouchet Kyoto Le Restaurant (hotel page).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the hotel page: a new kind of teppanyaki with French playfulness.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu teppanyaki; garlic rice; lobster ramen.

anecdotes.text: A guest timed an August 2025 dinner to watch the Gozan no Okuribi from the room.
At the start, the fresh Ise lobster and abalone to be cooked are shown to the table — August 2026.
A May 2026 diner found the two French appetizers "somewhat pre-prepared", while praising the lobster and abalone.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ホテル公式ページ (miyakohotels.ne.jp、ウェスティン都ホテル京都): ドミニク・ブシェ キョート ル・テッパンヤキ、ドミニク・ブシェ氏の監修による初の鉄板焼レストラン、フレンチらしい前菜、京都産のお肉・神戸牛などのブランド牛、ランチ 11:30〜14:30、ディナー 17:00〜22:00 (最終入店20:00)、定休日 水曜日 (祝日除く)、ランチは前日20:00までの予約制、ランチ10,000円〜・ディナー20,000円〜 (消費税・サービス料込み)、26席、全席禁煙、個室なし、男性はジャケット推奨、ウォークインワインセラー約300種類2,500本、A4ランク以上の神戸牛・近江牛・京の肉の3種食べ比べ、東山の眺望、シェフの経歴: ポワトゥ＝シャラント生まれ、トゥール・ダルジャン、ホテル・ド・クリヨンの総料理長、2004年にパリ8区で独立、京都のほか銀座のドミニク・ブシェ トーキョー、ビストロ レ・コパン ドミニク・ブシェ。食べログ: 鉄板焼き・ステーキ、東山区粟田口華頂町1、蹴上駅から徒歩2分、サービス料15%、2019年11月27日オープン、ステーキ・鉄板焼き WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年8月、英語): あわび、伊勢海老、近江牛のシャトーブリアン、ガーリックライス、伊勢海老ラーメン、五山の送り火。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; book lunch by 20:00 the day before; jacket suggested for men.

places.name: パティスリー タツヒト サトイ (Patisserie TATSUHITO SATOI)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: cakes, tarts, roll cakes and a bakery line (baguette, curry bread); the kakigori comes with espuma, jellies and sauces whose ingredients are not published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Cakes, mousses and kakigori espuma use dairy or eggs; plain breads and fruit-sauce kakigori may suit, but no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 8:00–17:00 every day, with occasional temporary closures; kakigori and parfaits 11:00–16:00 (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). 9 seats at a counter and a few tables at the back (Tabelog; August 2026). PayPay and au PAY only; no cards (Tabelog). On Imadegawa-dori between Hyakumanben and Ginkakuji, 2 min east of the Kyoto University Faculty of Agriculture bus stop; 15 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Imadegawa-dori by Kyoto University, east of Hyakumanben — 2 min from the Kyoto University Faculty of Agriculture bus stop
places.cuisine: Patisserie and bakery with a small café (Tabelog) · cakes: Earl Grey mousse, peach tart ¥640, cheese tart, "master roll" cake · breads: baguette, curry bread · kakigori in season, e.g. pistachio-muscat, raspberry, mango, and the Caramel Mocha "Satopetino" with espuma and coffee jelly ¥1,300 · iced latte ¥440, homemade lemonade (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Patisserie · Kitashirakawa by Kyoto University] A small patisserie-bakery on Imadegawa near Kyoto University, opened in 2016 by Kyoto-born pâtissier Tatsuhito Satoi, formerly sous-chef at Sweets Garden Yuji Ajiki in Yokohama: refined cakes and tarts (peach tart ¥640), bread, and in the warm months mountainous kakigori with espuma (about ¥1,300). Nine seats inside. Open daily 8:00–17:00; pay by PayPay or au PAY.

chef_bio.origin: Kyoto (home town, per an October 2026 review).
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a patisserie opened by Satoi, a staff member who supported Yuji Ajiki from the start. Per an October 2026 review: previously sous-chef at Sweets Garden Yuji Ajiki in Yokohama, returned to home-town Kyoto and opened the shop in 2016. Opened 15 April 2016 (Tabelog). Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Cakes; seasonal kakigori.

anecdotes.text: The Caramel Mocha Satopetino (¥1,300) was piled so high the ice almost overflowed the plate — August 2026.
A September 2026 visitor found no other customers inside and guessed takeout is the main trade; the peach tart tasted of fresh rather than cooked peach.
In the afternoon the café seats were fully booked — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パティスリー タツヒト サトイ、ケーキ・パン・カフェ、左京区北白川追分町2 Eフラット北白川 1F、京阪出町柳駅から徒歩15分、市バスの Kyoto University Faculty of Agriculture 停留所から東へ徒歩約2分、毎日 8:00〜17:00 (かき氷とパフェは11:00〜16:00)、臨時休業あり、予約不可、9席、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay・au PAY 可、禁煙、2016年4月15日オープン、Ajiki Yuji を初期から支えたスタッフの Satoi さんの店、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2023・2026。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): アールグレイのムース、桃のタルト640円、チーズタルト、ロールケーキ、カレーパン、バゲット、かき氷 (ピスタチオマスカット、キャラメルモカ1,300円)、アイスラテ440円、自家製レモネード、横浜の Sweets Garden Yuji Ajiki の元スーシェフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; kakigori from 11:00; PayPay or au PAY.

places.name: 焼き鳥 参 木屋町店 (umaimonyaki sun Kiyamachi Ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori with tare or salt, fried chicken, lotus-root chijimi and an omelette with tartar sauce; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the shop is known for vegetable dishes (raw vegetables with spicy miso, eggplant dengaku), but no vegan dish is confirmed (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–24:00 every day, last order 23:00; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations taken; birthday-cake requests by phone the day before (Tabelog); Friday evenings book up (September 2024). 30 seats over two floors: counter and tables downstairs, tatami, sunken-kotatsu and couple seats up a steep stair; the upstairs can be booked for 14–20 people (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Heated tobacco in a designated area (Tabelog). Cards accepted (Tabelog). Orders by QR code (August 2026). Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; English- and Korean-speaking staff (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley off Kiyamachi, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2025).
places.neighborhood: An alley off Kiyamachi north of Shijo — 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori over binchotan with locally sourced chicken, plus vegetables bought daily (October 2025) · 10-skewer assortment; skewers such as neck, gizzard, heart, tsukune, negima, shiso-wrapped neck and breast, quail eggs, shiitake (2024–2026 reviews) · "lard rice", the house signature (October 2025) · fried bonjiri, young-chicken kara-age, fried cartilage · avocado with house chili oil, eggplant dengaku, lotus-root chijimi, raw vegetables with spicy miso, broad beans, potato salad, kimchi, omelette with tartar sauce (2024–2026 reviews) · courses with all-you-can-drink (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Kiyamachi, binchotan skewers and lard rice down an alley] A two-storey yakitori house down a narrow alley off Kiyamachi: counter and tables below, tatami and sofa seats up a steep stair. The skewers are grilled over binchotan, the vegetables come in daily — raw ones with a spicy miso dip, eggplant dengaku, lotus-root chijimi — and the thing to finish with is the "lard rice". Order by QR code; English menus. Most reviews praise the skewers and the staff; an April 2024 visitor found the service cold and rushed. Open nightly 18:00–24:00.

roles: Operator not named (Tabelog lists an invoice number)
chef_bio.background: An October 2025 reviewer describes the yakitori as grilled over binchotan from fresh, locally sourced chicken, with vegetables sourced daily, and the "lard rice" as featured in a famous restaurant guide.
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan yakitori; lard rice; vegetable dishes.

anecdotes.text: An August 2022 solo diner found that skewers could only be ordered two of a kind.
An April 2024 visitor praised the food but found the service arrogant — told off over a bag, a towel thrust at the diner, a plate cleared the moment it was empty — and would not return.
A March 2026 diner liked dipping the side-dish vegetables in the spicy miso.
"Be careful on the stairs to the second floor; they are quite steep." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼き鳥 参 木屋町店 (umaimonyaki sun)、焼き鳥・もつ鍋・野菜料理、中京区木屋町通四条上る下樵木町204-3、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、毎日18:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、不定休、予約可、30席 (カウンター・テーブル・掘りごたつ・座敷)、2階は14〜20名で貸切可、加熱式たばこ専用の喫煙所、カード可、英語・中国語・韓国語メニュー、英語・韓国語のスタッフ、野菜にこだわり、ベジタリアンメニューあり、飲み放題コース。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 備長炭、地元の鶏、毎日仕入れる野菜、名物のラードご飯、10本盛り、つくね、ぼんじり唐揚げ、アボカドの自家製ラー油、茄子田楽、蓮根チヂミ、QR 注文、急な階段。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); QR-code ordering.

places.name: 先斗町薬膳カレー (Pontocho Yakuzen Curry)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A September 2022 review says the curry is thickened with rice flour, and a January 2023 review says the vegetable curry has no flour or oil, but there is no recent confirmation and the bar snacks are not described (2022–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A January 2023 review describes the vegetable curry as made without oil, flour or animal products, and Tabelog lists vegetarian options; the other curries are beef, chicken or keema (Tabelog; 2022–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–24:00; closed Tuesday and irregularly (Tabelog). Curry by day, a bar at night (April 2024). Reservations taken; takeaway; BYO allowed (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; smoking allowed except at lunch (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). No charge (Tabelog). The owner works alone, so food can take a while (February, April 2024). Poor mobile reception inside (April, September 2024). Tucked away between Pontocho and Kiyamachi (April 2023; September 2022). Opened 1 June 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Between Pontocho and Kiyamachi, north of Shijo — 264 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Yakuzen (medicinal) curry with 38 spices, mild rather than hot (2022–2026 reviews) · yakuzen beef curry ¥800 (October 2026); beef, keema and vegetable curries from ¥700 (July 2025) · vegetable curry and chicken curry; chicken tikka with vegetables ¥1,000 (July 2025) · bar snacks: shrimp and avocado stir-fry, chicken tikka, apple bacon ¥500 (February 2024) · Nepalese iced tea, Kahlua milk, beer · the house spice salt, sold by the jar (July 2025)
places.notes: [Curry · Pontocho, a one-man yakuzen curry bar] A seven-seat counter hidden in the lanes between Pontocho and Kiyamachi, where the owner, working alone, serves yakuzen curry by day and drinks by night until midnight. The curries — beef, keema, vegetable, chicken — are built on 38 spices, gently hot and cheap (¥700–800); the vegetable curry has been described as made without oil or flour. Bar snacks such as shrimp-and-avocado or chicken tikka round it out. Food can take a while when the owner is busy, and phone signal is weak. PayPay or cash; smoking allowed after lunch; closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed; reviews describe the owner running the shop alone)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog describes the shop as specialising in medicinal-food (yakuzen) curry and gives the opening as 1 June 2015. Reviews from 2022 and 2023 mention 38 spices, no additives and rice flour. The website listed on Tabelog (shaftjapan.com) did not load on 5 November 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Yakuzen beef and vegetable curry.

anecdotes.text: "I doubted it could be this tasty without animal products." — the vegetable curry, January 2023.
A July 2025 diner, chatting with the owner about spices, was offered the shop's special spice salt and took a jar home.
An April 2024 visitor waited for the food because the owner was alone, and found the beef curry closer to a Japanese curry than a spice curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 先斗町薬膳カレー、カレー・薬膳・バル、中京区下樵木町203-5 sakizo立誠校前ビル 1F、祇園四条駅から264m、11:30〜24:00、火曜休み (ほか不定休)、予約可、7席、喫煙可 (ランチのみ禁煙)、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、チャージなし、持ち込み可、テイクアウト可、野菜にこだわり、ベジタリアンメニューあり、2015年6月1日オープン、薬膳カレーの専門店。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 38種のスパイス、無添加、米粉、油と小麦粉を使わない野菜カレー、薬膳ビーフカレー800円、700円からのカレー、チキンティッカ、海老とアボカドの炒め物、アップルベーコン500円、店主一人、電波が弱い、スパイス塩。

cultural_comfort.note: Seven counter seats; PayPay or cash; smoking allowed after lunch.

places.name: スイーツ カフェ キョウト ケイゾー (Sweets Cafe KYOTO KEIZO)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The Mont Blanc is built on a low-temperature-baked meringue with cream and chestnut or matcha paste, but parfaits with sablé, cakes and lunch plates are also served; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the Mont Blanc and cakes use meringue (egg white) and Hokkaido cream; parfaits use ice cream (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 8:30–17:30 every day; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); queues at weekends and in season — over 30 minutes in November 2026, two groups waiting on a September 2026 Sunday. Cards: AMEX only; QR payments accepted (Tabelog). Counter, sofa and garden seats; non-smoking, smoking area outside (Tabelog; October 2026). Children welcome, with picture books (Tabelog; October 2026). In the 三条会 shopping arcade, 6 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 24 March 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo shopping arcade (三条会) near Nijo Castle — 6 min from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Patisserie café in a renovated machiya, known for its "10-minute" Mont Blanc, made to order on a meringue baked three hours at low temperature that softens after ten minutes (2026 reviews) · matcha Mont Blanc ¥1,680 (August 2026) · Japanese-chestnut Mont Blanc; seasonal chocolate Mont Blanc; drink sets ¥100 off (2026 reviews) · shortcake (seasonal), tower cake, fig parfait (September 2026) · lunch: gapao rice and chicken spice curry with multigrain rice, Napolitan of the day, spicy potatoes with crab (2026 reviews) · caramel or hazelnut latte ¥800, matcha latte, Aomori apple juice
places.notes: [Sweets café · Sanjo arcade, the 10-minute Mont Blanc] A machiya café in the 三条会 shopping arcade, a short walk from Nijo Castle, with counter, sofa and garden seats. Everyone comes for the Mont Blanc: piped to order over a meringue baked for three hours, with a "best within 10 minutes" promise because the crisp meringue softens as it sits (matcha version ¥1,680 in August 2026; Japanese chestnut and seasonal versions too). Lunch plates, parfaits and lattes too. Expect a queue at weekends — over 30 minutes in November 2026. Open daily 8:30–17:30; AMEX or QR payments.

roles: Patissier-owner (not named in the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 24 March 2016. A March 2020 Walkerplus article reports that "KEIZO", known for its Mont Blanc with a 10-minute shelf life, opened a bakery, KYOTO KEIZO BAKERY パンとパティシエ (中京区聚楽廻南町1). A September 2026 reviewer mentions tarts from another KEIZO location. Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Ten-minute Mont Blanc.

anecdotes.text: A regular on a seventh visit (October 2026) noted that prices have gone up but still rates the Mont Blanc above any other, and is surprised by the steady flow of tourists to a shop far from the station.
"The freshly made matcha mont blanc is prepared one by one after the order is placed." — August 2026.
A September 2026 diner who came for the Napolitan of the day found it sold out and had gapao rice, chicken curry and a fig parfait instead.
A September 2026 Sunday visitor got the last seat and found the taste average.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スイーツ カフェ キョウト ケイゾー (Sweets Cafe KYOTO KEIZO)、カフェ・ケーキ、中京区御供町293、二条城前駅から徒歩6分、毎日8:30〜17:30、予約不可、カード (AMEX)、QR 可、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、テラス、子ども歓迎、2016年3月24日オープン、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。Walkerplus (2020年3月14日): 賞味期限10分のモンブランで知られる「KEIZO」がベーカリー KYOTO KEIZO BAKERY パンとパティシエ (中京区聚楽廻南町1) をオープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 三条会商店街の町家、10分モンブラン (低温で3時間焼いたメレンゲ)、抹茶モンブラン1,680円、和栗のモンブラン、いちじくのパフェ、ガパオライス、30分以上の行列 (2026年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: No reservations; watch the Mont Blanc being made at the counter; AMEX or QR payments.

places.name: 美齢 (Meirin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Cantonese-based dishes with soy, oyster and black-bean sauces, daikon cake and fried nama-fu, shumai and noodles; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The daily lunch includes vegetable dishes such as braised eggplant, but the soups use dried shrimp and most mains carry meat or seafood (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Monday (open on public holidays) and irregularly (Tabelog). Lunch by reservation only, in two seatings at 11:30 and 13:00 (Tabelog); walk-ins were turned away when full (September, October 2026). Phone to book; same-day calls can work (September 2026). 20 seats: counter and tables downstairs, a tatami room for about 10–12 upstairs (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards accepted (Tabelog). Non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog). Deep in a narrow residential alley in Nishijin, near Seimei Shrine; 2–3 min from the Imadegawa-Omiya or Horikawa-Imadegawa bus stops (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Nishijin back alley, south-west of Horikawa-Imadegawa — near Seimei Shrine
places.cuisine: Cantonese-based Chinese, gentle and not greasy (2026 reviews) · today's lunch ¥1,705: three appetizers, dried-shrimp and daikon soup, daikon cake and fried black-sesame nama-fu, a main such as young chicken with black-bean sauce, rice, dessert like soy-milk almond jelly (September 2026) · cold noodles with shrimp ¥1,320 (August 2026) · stone-grilled mapo tofu · today's shark-fin soup, e.g. crab and shark fin ¥1,485 (September 2026) · shrimp mayo, scallop cream stew, mentaiko and takana fried rice, shumai, bang bang chicken, cream-braised bok choy, beef with green peppers (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Chinese · Nishijin, a back-alley Cantonese kitchen] A small two-storey Chinese restaurant deep in a residential alley in Nishijin, near Seimei Shrine, run by a chef and the chef's wife. The draw is the daily lunch (¥1,705): three appetizers, a dried-shrimp soup, daikon cake, a main and dessert, in two booked seatings at 11:30 and 13:00. In the evening, order the stone-grilled mapo tofu (stir it, or the bottom chars bitter), shumai and the scallop cream stew. Cooking is light and not greasy. Book by phone — walk-ins are often turned away. Closed Monday.

roles: Chef and the chef’s wife (August 2026 review: the chef’s "gentle demeanor and warm smile" and the wife’s "attentive and heartfelt hospitality")
chef_bio.background: Tabelog Chinese WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026. Reviewers describe the cooking as Cantonese-based (August, September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Daily lunch set; stone-grilled mapo tofu; shumai.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner was given cold tea in the restaurant's own stainless-steel cup and received a much bigger plate of cold noodles than expected.
A September 2026 diner found the stone-grilled mapo tofu went bitter where it burned onto the bowl unless stirred.
A November 2026 first-timer got only voicemail in the morning and a counter seat by calling again in the evening.

cultural_comfort.note: Phone booking only; lunch in two fixed seatings; no English evidence.

places.name: 斗米庵 (Tobei An)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. The cooking is Kyoto cuisine on a bonito-and-kombu dashi with soy sauces made from soybeans and wheat (official site); a September 2026 diner who declared a seafood and shellfish allergy found the broth and menu adjusted.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every course starts from a bonito-and-kombu dashi, and the courses carry fish and, at dinner, wagyu (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–16:00 (food last order 15:00), Tuesday–Sunday; dinner 18:00–22:00 (food last order 20:00, or 21:00 per the Tabelog remarks), Tuesday–Saturday; closed Monday, the first and third Tuesday and other irregular days (Tabelog). Bookings online or by phone (call before 11:00); seats are assigned by the shop; 15 minutes late without notice cancels the booking with a 100% charge; Tabelog states that foreign nationals must book with advance payment (Tabelog). 18 table seats; no service charge; non-smoking; English menu; cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley entered from Nishiki Market; 5 min from Kawaramachi or Shijo Stn (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Down an alley off Nishiki Market — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto cuisine built on Nishiki Market’s seasonal produce (official site) · lunch: KIRIBAKO 錦, a masu-shaped paulownia box of seasonal dishes — persimmon cup, terrine, sashimi, rolled egg, grilled and simmered dishes, rice and a sweet, with kabuse tea — after a soup, ¥4,600 plus one drink (official site) · dinner: 宵の京錦 八寸, seven courses ¥8,500; 宵の京錦 会席 with wagyu steak, eight courses ¥10,000, plus one drink (official site) · dashi from Nishiki well water with Rishiri and Rausu kombu and bonito; Kotohiki salt from Tango; Suehiro soy sauce; Kokonoe mirin (official site) · take-home yuba chirimen ¥1,600 for 100 g (official site)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Nishiki Market, a quiet room down an alley] A Kyoto-cuisine restaurant hidden down a narrow alley from Nishiki Market, named after one of the art names of the painter Itō Jakuchū, who is closely tied to the market. Lunch is the KIRIBAKO — a paulownia box of a dozen small seasonal dishes from the market, opened at the table (¥4,600 + a drink); dinner is a seven- or eight-course Kyoto meal (¥8,500–10,000). Book ahead; closed Monday and the first and third Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 April 2018 (Tabelog). Per the official site: the name comes from an art name (別号) of the painter 伊藤若冲, who is closely tied to Nishiki Market; the shop prepares each plate carefully in the spirit of Jakuchū’s detailed brushwork; the dinner courses keep the flow of Kyoto cuisine with a quiet Western aftertaste.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: dashi drawn from Nishiki’s spring water and freshly shaved bonito; seasonings chosen with care (Kotohiki salt, Suehiro soy sauce, Kokonoe mirin).
chef_bio.specialty: KIRIBAKO 錦 lunch box; evening Kyoto courses.

anecdotes.text: The paulownia box arrived wreathed in dry-ice mist, and the chef opened the lid — September 2025.
A diner who had told the shop of a seafood and shellfish allergy found the broth and menu adjusted — September 2026.
An April 2025 reviewer noted the calm inside, off a shopping street "filled with foreign tourists".
At the end the staff served tea and chatted — November 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tobeian.jp): 京都錦市場 斗米庵、錦市場の細い路地の奥の京料理の店、店名は錦市場に縁の深い絵師・伊藤若冲の別号から、昼は名物「KIRIBAKO 錦」(柿釜、テリーヌ、造里、玉〆、焼物、温物、ご飯、菓子、やまだしやのかぶせ茶) 4,600円+1ドリンク、夜は「宵の京錦 八寸」全7品8,500円、「宵の京錦 会席」和牛ステーキ付き全8品10,000円 (税込)、錦の名水と削りたてのかつお節の出汁、利尻昆布と羅臼昆布、琴引浜の塩、末廣醤油 (国産大豆・小麦)、九重味淋、お土産の湯葉ちりめん1,600円。食べログ: 日本料理・海鮮、中京区東魚屋町196-1、入口は錦市場の中、火〜土 11:00〜16:00・18:00〜22:00、日・祝 11:00〜16:00、月曜・第1第3火曜休み、18席、サービス料なし、英語メニュー、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、2018年4月7日オープン、外国籍のお客様は事前決済での予約。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年11月、英語): KIRIBAKO、ドライアイスの演出、魚介アレルギーへの対応、もてなし。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book online; foreign visitors book with advance payment.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The official site names its soy sauces (Suehiro usukuchi, koikuchi and tamari) as made from domestic soybeans and wheat.

staff_allergy_handling.text: A September 2026 diner who declared a seafood and shellfish allergy in advance says the shop "kindly adjusted the broth and menu just for me".

places.name: 京鴨ひつまぶし かもしぎん (Kyogamo Hitsumabushi Kamoshigin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The house dish is duck hitsumabushi with a sweet-savory sauce and dashi to pour, and the menu adds soba and obanzai; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the menu is built on duck, with dashi and seafood from Tango in the obanzai (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (Monday to 14:30), limited to 30 servings, no bookings; dinner 18:00–21:30 (Sunday to 21:00; food last order 20:15); holidays lunch only; closing days irregular — the calendar is on the shop’s Instagram (Tabelog). Night: starter charge and one-drink minimum; under-15s not admitted in the evening (Tabelog). Each guest orders a rice bowl or soba (May 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). 20 seats; private rooms for 8 and 10–20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Up from Shijo on Tominokoji, 2 min from Hankyu Karasuma or Kawaramachi exit 12 (Tabelog; October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Tominokoji just north of Shijo — 2 min from Hankyu exit 12
places.cuisine: Kyoto duck hitsumabushi and obanzai, using domestic ingredients and Kyoto products where possible (Tabelog) · Kyogamo hitsumabushi from Uji brand duck, eaten plain, with condiments, then with dashi poured over; "Oni Niku Mori" with extra meat (a Mezamashi TV Kyoto-area winning menu); with rich egg ¥2,560 (June 2026) · seasonal soba, cold soba · obanzai of Kyoto vegetables and Tango seafood · duck courses with all-you-can-drink, incl. Peking duck (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Duck hitsumabushi · Shijo-Tominokoji] A small modern shop just up from Shijo serving hitsumabushi made with Kyoto duck from Uji: tender, ungamey slices on rice, eaten three ways — plain, with condiments, and with dashi poured over (about ¥2,500 at lunch). Evenings add obanzai and duck courses. Lunch is 30 servings, first come; cash only. Reviews are mostly warm, with some complaints about service.

chef_bio.background: Opened 30 April 2023 (Tabelog). Per the operator’s Tabelog text: all ingredients domestic, Kyoto products where possible; the signature Kyoto duck hitsumabushi uses a brand duck from Uji; obanzai change daily with Kyoto vegetables and Tango seafood.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyogamo hitsumabushi.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 pair ordering one rice bowl and one soba was cut off mid-order and told each person must order one or the other; the food was delicious.
A July 2026 diner found the chopsticks set carelessly and would not return for the service and price, though the hitsumabushi was good.
A September 2026 diner saw a foreign customer turned away while a Japanese customer who came later was let in, and felt uneasy.
The yuba udon seen online had been discontinued — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京鴨ひつまぶし かもしぎん、居酒屋・おでん・しゃぶしゃぶ、中京区富小路西大文字町610、阪急烏丸駅・京都河原町駅12番出口から徒歩約2分、昼 12:00〜14:00 (月曜は14:30まで、30食限定、予約不可)、夜 18:00〜21:30 (日曜21:00まで、L.O. 料理20:15)、祝日は昼のみ、不定休 (Instagram)、夜はお通しと1ドリンク制、15歳未満は夜の入店不可、現金のみ、20席、個室、禁煙、2023年4月30日オープン、国産食材と京都産、宇治の銘柄鴨「京鴨」のひつまぶし、Tango の魚介と京野菜のおばんざい、Oni Niku Mori のひつまぶし (Mezamashi TV の京都エリアの優勝メニュー)、北京ダックを含む飲み放題付きコース。口コミ (2026年5〜11月、英語): ひつまぶしを3通りで、濃厚卵2,560円、冷たいそば、接客への不満の声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch is first come, 30 servings; one rice bowl or soba per person; cash only.

places.name: 祗園245 (Gion 245)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. A Japanese-Italian course with fresh pasta, risotto, bread and Danish pastry, seasoned with dashi and white miso; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses centre on black-wagyu fillet, fish and cheese (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservation only — by phone, or online where the calendar may differ from real availability (Tabelog). Course with black-wagyu Chateaubriand ¥15,000 with tax (Tabelog); a December 2025 reviewer paid ¥8,000 for a seven-course dinner incl. tax, service and a glass of sparkling wine. 10% service charge; corkage ¥5,000 a bottle (Tabelog). 14 seats: 7–8 at the counter facing the open kitchen, a table area and semi-private rooms; children from elementary-school age; smart casual; English menu and English-speaking staff; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; December 2025). On Shinmonzen-dori, the fifth house east of Hanamikoji, north side; 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmonzen-dori, just east of Hanamikoji — 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese-Italian courses in a Kyoto townhouse, with seasonal ingredients, Kyoto vegetables and colourful tableware (Tabelog) · dinner course with black-wagyu Chateaubriand main, 8 dishes, ¥15,000 (Tabelog) · dishes in 2025–26 reviews: Amela-tomato and mozzarella caprese with anchovy sauce and white miso, Italian-style chawanmushi, Komoro white-potato soup, risotto, grilled kinmedai, fresh pasta of the day, micro-herb garnishes · champagne, wines and sake; the wine cellar is in a converted air-raid shelter below a glass floor (Tabelog; September–December 2025)
places.notes: [Japanese-Italian · Shinmonzen, a townhouse with a cellar below] A small Japanese-Italian restaurant in a renovated townhouse on Shinmonzen-dori in Gion: a counter around the open kitchen, a few semi-private rooms, and a wine cellar in an old air-raid shelter seen through the floor. Courses of Kyoto vegetables, fresh pasta and a black-wagyu fillet main (about ¥15,000; cheaper courses reported), cooked by a single chef who explains each dish. Reservation only; smart casual.

chef_bio.background: Per a December 2025 review: owner-chef Masakazu Yoshioka trained at "Kanobiano" after hotel work and then in Europe before going independent. Another December 2025 review says the present chef took over about a year earlier from the previous chef, a long-time restaurant consultant in Hong Kong, keeping the name. In April 2026 a single chef was cooking, so bookings were limited (review). Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023, 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator’s Tabelog text: a place to eat with peace of mind, with seasonal ingredients and Kyoto vegetables in a Japanese-Italian style.
chef_bio.specialty: Black-wagyu Chateaubriand course; fresh pasta.

anecdotes.text: "The wine cellar in the basement is a renovated air raid shelter" — September 2025.
A December 2025 diner paid ¥8,000 for seven courses with tax, service and a sparkling toast, and wondered if it was a promotional price.
With only one chef, reservations were limited and the dishes explained in detail — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-245.com): 祗園で味わう、京都ならではのイタリアン。祇園 245。食べログ: イタリアン・フレンチ・ステーキ、東山区智恩院新門前大和大路東入二丁目中之町245-1、新門前通花見小路から東へ5軒目の北側、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩7分、17:00〜23:00、不定休、完全予約制、14席 (カウンター8、テーブル6)、個室、サービス料10%、持ち込み料1本5,000円、小学生以上、スマートカジュアル、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、黒毛和牛シャトーブリアンがメインのディナーコース全8品15,000円 (税込)、京町家、京野菜、和のイタリアン、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2025。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年4月、英語): オーナーシェフ Masakazu Yoshioka、Kanobiano、防空壕を改装したワインセラー、Amela トマトのカプレーゼ、生パスタ、7品8,000円のコース、シェフ一人。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); reservation only.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Sukiyaki with a house warishita and shabu-shabu with house ponzu and sesame sauce, finished with Inaniwa udon; no gluten information (official brand page; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses are wagyu shabu-shabu or sukiyaki on a kombu broth or with egg (official brand page; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Weekdays and holidays 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); Saturday and Sunday also 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) (Tabelog). Bookings online or by phone (Tabelog). Shoes off; private and semi-private rooms on the second floor; the staff cook the first meat for you (2026 reviews). No service charge; designated smoking area; cards, IC cards and QR payments; English menu (Tabelog; official brand page). On Pontocho near the Shijo entrance; 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, near the Shijo end — 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Black-wagyu shabu-shabu and Kansai-style sukiyaki (grilled first), with house-made sauces and warishita, produced by Chef Hasegawa of Gourmandise (official brand page; Tabelog) · Toki course ¥18,500: appetizer, three obanzai, a thick-cut wagyu tenderloin (e.g. Tottori Tamura beef), vegetables, Kobe-beef ribeye and chuck eye, rice and pickles, sesame soy-milk Inaniwa udon, dessert (October–November 2026) · Kawasemi sukiyaki course with A5 wagyu and Kobe beef ¥12,800 (Tabelog) · Suzaku course; weekend lunch (2026 reviews) · sake and shochu (official brand page)
places.notes: [Shabu-shabu & sukiyaki · Pontocho, wagyu in tatami rooms] A shoes-off wagyu house at the Shijo end of Pontocho, opened in 2024, with tatami private rooms upstairs: shabu-shabu with house ponzu and sesame sauce, or Kansai-style sukiyaki grilled first and dipped in whipped egg, using thick-cut tenderloin and Kobe beef. Courses ¥12,800–18,500; English menu. Open to midnight; weekend lunch. Tabelog Hot Pot 100 2026.

roles: Produced by Chef Hasegawa of Gourmandise (operator text); run by RIC2 Inc.
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2024 (Tabelog). Per the operator (RIC2 Inc.) brand page: the brand also has 北新地しゃぶしゃぶすき焼き きらく in Osaka; the Pontocho shop is produced by Chef Hasegawa of Gourmandise, with homemade sauces and warishita, and an English menu for visitors. Tabelog Hot Pot "Tabelog 100" 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Toki course; Kansai-style sukiyaki.

anecdotes.text: "The sukiyaki served with whipped eggs was a refreshing new experience." — October 2026.
The first shabu-shabu cut was a thick tenderloin, "typically used for yakiniku" — October 2026.
Even on a weekday night there were customers from Japan and abroad — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 運営会社のブランドページ (ric2.co.jp): しゃぶしゃぶすき焼ききらく、北新地しゃぶしゃぶすき焼き きらく (大阪市北区堂島1-2-7)、先斗町しゃぶしゃぶすき焼き きらく (中京区先斗町通四条上る柏屋町169-2)、グルマンディーズ長谷川シェフ監修、上質な黒毛和牛、タレや割り下は自家製、英語併記のメニュー、人気No.1の朱鷺コース。食べログ: しゃぶしゃぶ・すき焼き・日本料理、平日・祝日 17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、土日 12:00〜15:00・17:00〜24:00、30席 (カウンター4、テーブル26)、個室、サービス料なし、分煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2024年5月1日オープン、鍋百名店 2026、Kawasemi のすき焼きコース12,800円 (A5和牛と神戸牛)。口コミ (2026年10〜11月、英語): 朱鷺コース18,500円、自家製ポン酢、厚切りのヒレ、神戸牛、稲庭うどん、泡立てた卵のすき焼き、靴を脱いで2階の個室。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (operator); staff cook the first meat; shoes off.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish omakase of small dishes and about 14 pieces of nigiri (2026 reviews).

On Gokomachi-dori south of Bukkoji, two doors from the bar Rocking Chair, behind a hard-to-spot entrance; 4 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 10 (Tabelog; April 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gokomachi-dori south of Bukkoji — 4 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Edomae sushi omakase at a counter in a restored townhouse (2026 reviews) · about four small dishes, then around 14 nigiri on red-vinegar rice from lean tuna through chu-toro to o-toro, finishing with soup and tamago (April 2026) · dishes seen in 2026: salted ginkgo, sashimi with new onion, ponzu and a house sauce, sake-steamed sea bream, chawanmushi with scallop and surf clam, grilled swordfish, grilled surf-clam nigiri, sumi-ika, aji · omakase ¥22,000, then ¥28,000 (April 2026) · sake such as Aramasa around ¥1,000 a glass (April 2026), shochu, wine
places.notes: [Sushi · Gokomachi-Bukkoji, a young Edomae counter] A 10-seat sushi counter opened in January 2025 in a carefully restored old townhouse with a garden and a bar counter. A twenty-something chef serves an Edomae omakase on red-vinegar rice — small dishes, then around 14 nigiri climbing from lean tuna to o-toro — and speaks fluent English with overseas guests. The omakase rose from ¥22,000 to about ¥28,000 in 2026. One April 2026 diner found the quality uneven and the part-time service weak; most praise it. Evenings daily; book ahead.

roles: Head chef (unnamed), twenty-something per an April 2026 review
chef_bio.background: An April 2026 review describes a beautifully restored townhouse over 200 years old (a January 2026 diner wrote 100 years), brought back by sukiya craftsmen, with a garden, a bar counter and a large private room; a twenty-something head chef who had travelled as a backpacker, speaks fluent English with overseas guests, and named the Shimbashi sushi shop "Tomidokoro" as a favourite, so the sushi follows the Edomae style. A January 2025 diner heard the shop works closely with renowned Toyosu suppliers. A January 2026 diner took the name Imajin to mean making the most of the moment. Tabelog gives the opening day as 11 January 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Edomae nigiri on red-vinegar rice.

anecdotes.text: "The young chef's service is still a bit awkward, but it's genuinely pleasant. Unfortunately, the level of service from the part-time staff is disappointing." — April 2026; the same diner found the quality uneven.
A June 2026 regular found the rice softer than before and, as on the first visit, every other guest from overseas.
An April 2026 diner found the drinks slow to arrive because the chef handles everything alone, but thought the sushi worth the wait.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、下京区御幸町通仏光寺下ル橘町442、毎日17:30〜23:00、不定休、予約可 (7名以上は電話で確認)、10席、貸切可、禁煙、子供は事前に相談、カード可 (銀聯も)、電子マネー・QR 不可、2025年1月11日オープン。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 築100年 (別の口コミでは200年以上) の町家を数寄屋の職人が改装、庭、バーカウンター、大きな個室、20代の大将、英語が堪能、新橋の「Tomidokoro」が好き、江戸前、赤酢のシャリ、つまみ4品ほどと握り14貫、22,000円から28,000円に、Aramasa などの日本酒が1,000円ほど、豊洲の仲卸とのつながり、海外からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: The head chef and some staff speak fluent English with overseas guests (2026 reviews); omakase only, booked ahead.

places.name: 貝と白ワインのバル KAKIMARU 綾小路店 (Kai to Shiro Wine no Bar KAKIMARU Ayanokoji)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; much of the menu is fried (fried oysters, oyster tempura, salmon katsu) or pasta (oyster carbonara, crab tomato-cream pasta), and ajillo comes with baguette (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the menu is built on oysters, shellfish and seafood (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 17:00–2:00 (food last order 1:00, drinks 1:30); closed irregularly. Bookings taken; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). 35 seats at tables and a counter; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX, UnionPay) and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). On Ayanokoji west of Tominokoji; 2 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma or Kawaramachi stations (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ayanokoji west of Tominokoji — 2 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Oyster and white-wine bar serving oysters all year, open to 2 am (2026 reviews; Tabelog) · raw oysters from several regions with toppings (salmon roe and sea urchin, meat and sea urchin), grilled, fried with shibazuke tartar, tempura; an oyster assortment of all of them · oyster carbonara, oyster risotto, cold oyster vapore, shrimp ajillo, rare salmon katsu with ikura, baby tuna sashimi, soft-shell crab tomato-cream pasta, bonito tataki; an all-oyster course and all-you-can-drink (2026 reviews) · white wines, sparkling, sake; a tequila bell on the counter · about ¥4,500 for several dishes and a drink (May 2026)
places.notes: [Oyster bar · Ayanokoji, oysters till 2 am] A 35-seat bar off Ayanokoji built around oysters and white wine, open from 17:00 to 2:00 every day: raw oysters from several regions, some crowned with uni and ikura or meat, plus grilled, fried and tempura oysters, oyster carbonara and risotto, and seafood such as rare salmon katsu. About ¥4,500 for a few dishes and a drink (2026). One August 2026 diner left early because of loud music and a noisy group at the counter, though the staff were polite. Reservations taken.

roles: Ayanokoji branch of KAKIMARU (operator not named on the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists the shop as the Ayanokoji branch of 貝と白ワインのバル KAKIMARU, a bar, izakaya and Italian with vegetarian options and a particular interest in wine and cocktails. Reviewers in 2026 describe oysters served year round in many forms and a lively but calm room; one August 2026 diner heard loud background music and a group of four young regulars at the counter who seemed to know the staff.
chef_bio.specialty: Oyster assortment; oyster carbonara.

anecdotes.text: "The bell here isn’t for calling the staff; it’s actually a tequila bell!" — May 2026.
An August 2026 diner left soon after ordering because of loud music and a noisy group at the counter, while praising the polite staff and the variety of oysters.
Two diners in October 2026 found themselves counting the oysters in the ajillo and risotto: "this one is mine."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バル・居酒屋・イタリアン、下京区綾小路通富小路西入ル塩屋町66、毎日17:00〜翌2:00 (L.O. 料理1:00・ドリンク1:30)、不定休、予約可、35席 (テーブル・カウンター)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、子供可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、カード (VISA、Master、AMEX、銀聯)・PayPay 可。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): 生牡蠣 (産地いろいろ、いくら雲丹や肉雲丹のせ)、焼き牡蠣、カキフライ (柴漬けタルタル)、牡蠣の天ぷら、牡蠣のカルボナーラ、海老のアヒージョ、レアサーモンカツ、ソフトシェルクラブのトマトクリームパスタ、テキーラベル、4,500円ほど、BGM が大きい夜も。

cultural_comfort.note: A casual bar ordering à la carte; open late, bookings taken.

places.name: 天婦羅処 京林泉 (Tempura Tokoro Kyorynsen)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura restaurant whose courses are battered and fried, served with tempura sauce and red miso soup (official site; 2026 reviews). Guests with allergies are asked to say so in advance, and some items may then be left out (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses mix shrimp and fish with vegetables, and the tempura sauce, simmered dishes and miso soup are dashi-based (2026 reviews; official site).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 11:30–15:00 (food last order 14:00), dinner 17:00–22:00 (food last order 21:00; courses 20:30); closed Monday (except public holidays) and the Tuesday after a holiday; weekend and holiday lunch in two sittings, from 11:30 and 13:30; lunch limited to 90 minutes and dinner to 120. A booking more than 20 minutes late without notice is cancelled; allergies to be notified in advance (Tabelog). Prices include a 15% service charge; à la carte only incurs a ¥1,500 table charge (Tabelog). Courses: lunch Yasaka ¥7,000, Higashiyama ¥5,000, weekday Kyo-gozen ¥3,500; dinner Tsuki ¥15,000, Yuki ¥12,000, Hana ¥9,000 (official site); Higashiyama ¥5,500 and a ¥1,000 discount on the Yuki course before 18:00 (October–November 2026 reviews). 27 seats: 6 (plus 1) at the counter and 21 at tables; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome with a kids’ menu (Tabelog). Cards, IC, QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Parking at the JR Kyoto Station building with validation (Tabelog). Floor M3 of Hotel Granvia Kyoto, 1 min from the JR Kyoto central gate (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, Hotel Granvia Kyoto — 1 min from the JR central gate
places.cuisine: Tempura from a sister of the ryotei 京大和 (founded Meiji 10), fried in a house blend of white cottonseed oil and pure sesame oil and served with Mongolian lake salt (official site) · lunch: weekday Kyo-gozen ¥3,500 (yuba tofu, simmered vegetables, shrimp and seasonal vegetable tempura, rice, red miso soup, pickles, dessert), Higashiyama ¥5,000, Yasaka ¥7,000; dinner: Hana ¥9,000, Yuki ¥12,000, Tsuki ¥15,000 (official site) · 2026 courses: sweet shrimp, kuruma prawn, shrimp in shiso, ginkgo, Manganji pepper, Kyoto long eggplant, lotus root with curry salt, shiitake, mukago, maitake, hamo, tachiuo, Biwa trout in shiso, amadai, roasted sweet potato; a choice of kakiage rice bowl or chirimen-jako rice to finish · salt, curry salt, lemon or tempura sauce suggested piece by piece (November 2026)
places.notes: [Tempura · Kyoto Station, the Granvia's tempura counter] A tempura restaurant inside Hotel Granvia Kyoto, a minute from the JR gates and a sister of the old ryotei 京大和: a seven-seat counter and tables, a house blend of cottonseed and sesame oil, and pieces matched to salt, curry salt, lemon or tempura sauce. Weekday lunch Kyo-gozen ¥3,500, lunch courses ¥5,000–7,000, dinner ¥9,000–15,000. Tempura Tabelog 100 2022, 2023, 2025. Closed Monday; book the counter to watch the frying.

roles: Tempura restaurant of 京大和 (Kyo Yamato group)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Kyorinsen is a sister restaurant of 京大和, a ryotei in Higashiyama founded in Meiji 10 (1877); it buys ingredients from trusted suppliers, fries in its own blend of white cottonseed oil and premium pure sesame oil, light and not heavy on the stomach, and serves a mineral-rich natural salt from a Mongolian salt lake. Tabelog gives the opening day as 11 September 1997 and lists it as Tempura "Tabelog 100" 2022, 2023 and 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: tempura is the simplest way to concentrate an ingredient’s flavour — frying at the right temperature for the right time, a judgement only a professional can make.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal tempura courses; kakiage rice bowl.

anecdotes.text: "As a left-handed person, I appreciated that they served the dishes in reverse order halfway through." — November 2026.
A September 2026 diner liked the light batter but would have liked a juicier pear in the seasonal dessert.
In the busy November 2026 season the room stayed calm, with no line outside, because most guests had booked.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoyamato.com/kyorinsen): 京林泉は明治10年創業、京都東山の料亭「京大和」の姉妹店、軽やかで繊細な天ぷら、最適な温度・最適な時間でカラッと揚げる、信頼のおける仕入先、白絞油と最高級の太白胡麻油を独自に配合した揚げ油、モンゴルの塩湖の天然塩。昼のコース「八坂」7,000円・「東山」5,000円、平日限定「京御膳」3,500円、夕食コース「月」15,000円・「雪」12,000円・「花」9,000円 (税込)。食べログ: 天ぷら、ホテルグランヴィア京都 M3F、11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00、コース20:30)、月曜 (祝日を除く) と祝日翌日の火曜休み、土日祝の昼は11:30と13:30の2部制、昼90分・夜120分、アレルギーは事前に、20分以上の遅刻はキャンセル扱い、サービス料15%込み、単品のみはテーブルチャージ1,500円、27席 (カウンター6+1、テーブル21)、禁煙、車椅子可、子供可・キッズメニュー、1997年9月11日オープン、天ぷら百名店 2022・2023・2025。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): 京御膳3,500円、東山5,500円、雪のコースは18時前に1,000円引き、かき揚げ丼かちりめんじゃこご飯、塩・カレー塩・レモン・天つゆ。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant with set courses and a photo menu (Tabelog); book ahead, especially for the counter.

places.name: 三嶋亭 本店 (Mishima Tei Honten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the sukiyaki is cooked in a secret warishita sauce, and the pot includes wheat gluten (fu) (official site; July 2026 review); appetisers have included tempura and soba (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef restaurant — sukiyaki, water-boiled and oil-grilled wagyu courses, with raw egg (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 11:00–21:00. Bookings online up to a month ahead, by phone (075-221-0003) for the same day or within a month (official site); a September 2026 family booking a month ahead could not get the time it wanted. Courses (May 2025, tax and service included): lunch course ¥8,591 (sukiyaki, oil-grilled or water-boiled); Tsuki course ¥17,545; Premium Tsuki ¥21,780; snowy pot November–February (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). A Meiji-era building, not barrier-free: shoes off on the ground floor and up the stairs; socks please on the tatami (Tabelog). 250 seats with private rooms; all rooms now have tables (October 2026); non-smoking (Tabelog). No children’s menu; a ¥1,210 seat fee from age 3 (Tabelog). Cards, IC and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). On Teramachi south of Sanjo; 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi south of Sanjo — 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Sukiyaki since 1873, in the founding building, with black wagyu chosen and aged by the house and a secret warishita (official site) · staff cook at the table: sugar in the pan, the meat seared, the sauce poured, then dipped in raw egg; vegetables such as grilled tofu, Kujo leek, shungiku, shiitake, fu, shirataki and onion (2026 reviews) · lunch course ¥8,591; Tsuki ¥17,545; Premium Tsuki ¥21,780 (May 2025, tax and service included) — sukiyaki, oil-grilled (oil-yaki) or water-boiled (mizutaki) wagyu; Hana course with appetisers, sweets and usucha devised by the fifth generation (official site) · shigure-ni, rice, red miso soup, pickles; melon to finish all year (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sukiyaki · Teramachi-Sanjo, since 1873] Kyoto's founding sukiyaki house, opened in 1873 after the founder learned gyunabe in Nagasaki, still in its Meiji sukiya building with a courtyard garden: up steep stairs to tatami rooms (now with tables), where staff cook black wagyu with sugar and the secret warishita at the table and you dip it in raw egg. Lunch course about ¥8,600; dinner courses ¥17,500–21,800 (2025). Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2019. One October 2026 diner found the premium course not worth its price. Daily 11:00–21:00; book ahead.

roles: Fifth-generation head (五代目主人), per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the founder 三嶌兼吉, who served a court-noble’s samurai, learned gyunabe in Nagasaki together with the founder’s wife てい and opened Mishima Tei here on Teramachi-Sanjo in Meiji 6 (1873); the sukiya interior — garden, railings, ceilings, lattices — is mostly as it was at the founding; the house selects black wagyu from across Japan regardless of origin and ages it in its own way, cooking the sukiyaki on electric heaters that act like charcoal. The fifth generation, 三嶋太郎, refined the secret warishita, began training in Japanese cuisine, tea and ikebana eight years before the page was written, and devised the kaiseki-style Hana course with appetisers, sweets and usucha. A sister restaurant, 翁樹庵, is introduced on the site. Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2019; Hot Pot "Tabelog 100" 2024 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: keeping the good things of old Kyoto, which is now harder than making new ones; the fifth generation aims to keep evolving while carrying on the tradition.
chef_bio.specialty: Sukiyaki of black wagyu with the house warishita.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner on the ¥21,780 Premium Tsuki course found the appetisers unremarkable and the Hokkaido beef good but not extraordinary, and suspected tourist pricing.
A diner returning after decades found all the rooms converted to tables instead of seiza — October 2026.
A September 2026 family found staff waiting at the entrance at the booked time, "very well-dressed and attentive"; rice and egg refills were offered.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (mishima-tei.co.jp): 創業明治6年 三嶋亭、霜降り牛すき焼き、京懐石・オイル焼き・水炊き、明治の文明開化以来150余年の伝統、数寄屋造りの店内の坪庭・欄干・天井・格子はほとんどが創業当時のまま、初代三嶌兼吉が妻“てい”と長崎で牛鍋を学び、明治六年に寺町三条で創業、現在五代目、産地にこだわらず全国から厳選した黒毛和牛を独自の方法で熟成、炭火に近い効果の電熱器、割下は五代目が進化させた秘伝のレシピ、五代目 三嶋太郎が八年前から日本料理・茶の湯・生け花を学び懐石仕立ての「花コース」を考案、姉妹店 翁樹庵、ネットで1ヶ月先まで予約、当日や1ヶ月以内は電話。食べログ: すき焼き・日本料理・牛肉料理、中京区寺町通三条下ル桜之町405、毎日11:00〜21:00、予約可、明治の建物でバリアフリーではない、1階で靴を脱ぎ階段で上へ、畳なので靴下を、サービス料10%、250席、個室あり、禁煙、お子様メニューなし (3歳以上は席料1,210円)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2025年5月の料金: プレミアム月コース21,780円、月コース17,545円、昼のコース8,591円 (税・サービス料込み)、食べログアワード ブロンズ 2017〜2019、すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ百名店 2024・2026。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 砂糖と割下で焼き溶き卵で、九条ネギ・焼き豆腐・春菊・麩、メロン、全室テーブル席に。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has English, Chinese and Korean pages and online booking; staff cook the sukiyaki at the table and explain it (August 2026).

places.name: 黒兵衛 (Kurobee)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki, okonomiyaki and yakisoba are wheat-batter or wheat-noodle dishes with sauce (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: takoyaki with octopus and dashi batter, okonomiyaki with bonito flakes, squid butter and beef tendon (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 daily per Tabelog; a January 2025 reviewer was told it opens every day of the year from 15:00 until after 23:00, New Year’s Day included — check before going. Reservations taken (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; January 2025). 18 seats: 6 at the counter and three low tatami tables, not sunken (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). Down an alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho north of Shijo, hard to find; 259 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, north of Shijo — 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Old-style takoyaki and teppan shop (2025–26 reviews) · make-your-own takoyaki on a tabletop plate, 18 pieces, with staff showing first-timers how; soft, dashi-rich takoyaki in the street-stall style · okonomiyaki, yakisoba, a "modern" mixed platter that adds yakisoba noodles · squid butter, beef tendon with ponzu, homemade dashimaki · bottled beer, strong highballs and chuhai, shochu with hot water, nigori umeshu (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Takoyaki · Kiyamachi, a family shop down an alley] A small Showa-feeling takoyaki and okonomiyaki shop down an alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, with a counter and three low tatami tables. You can grill your own takoyaki at the table — staff show first-timers when to turn the heat on — or let the kitchen make soft, dashi-rich ones, then add okonomiyaki, yakisoba and squid butter with a strong highball. Cheap for the area. Smoking allowed. Open daily into the night.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe the shop as run by an elderly couple (February and September 2026); a January 2025 reviewer described it as run by a mother and son, with old photos on the counter, and estimated that about 80% of customers were from overseas, with large groups arriving around 21:00.
chef_bio.specialty: Takoyaki; okonomiyaki; squid butter.

anecdotes.text: "Since it was my first time, they kindly taught me when to switch on the heat and the order of preparation." — November 2025.
"It’s run by a lovely elderly couple, and despite that, the speed of service for food and drinks is quite good." — September 2026.
A February 2026 visitor found the low tatami seating, not a sunken kotatsu, hard on the legs.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: たこ焼き、中京区木屋町四条上ル下樵木町205、祇園四条駅から259m、毎日17:00〜24:00、予約可、サービス料なし、18席 (カウンター6、座敷4名×3卓)、喫煙可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 木屋町と先斗町の間の路地、年配の夫婦が営む (2026年)、母と息子が営むという2025年1月の口コミ、毎日15時から23時過ぎまで営業との記述、自分で焼くたこ焼き18個、お好み焼き、焼きそば、いかバター、牛すじポン酢、だし巻き、濃いハイボール、安い。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff show you how to grill takoyaki; shoes off for the tatami; smoking allowed.

places.name: 京都サムゲタン とっとり (Kyoto Samgyetang Tottori)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Soy-marinated crab and shrimp, chijimi pancakes, spring rolls, japchae and samgyetang with seasonings added at the table; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken samgyetang, marinated crab and shrimp, pork and beef dishes (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00) daily; closing days may vary (Tabelog). Book ahead — a 9-seat counter that fills up; one reviewer booked a month ahead by Instagram (December 2025). Soy-marinated crab (ganjang gejang) must be reserved in advance (April and July 2026). Parties of 7 or more: an omakase course from ¥12,000 with free-flow drinks after 18:00; cancel by phone or a fee is charged (Tabelog). A February 2026 reviewer found dinner was a set omakase starting at 19:00; the shop says it switched from courses to à la carte in April (Tabelog). The menu board shows no prices (August 2026). Free-flow drinks ¥2,000 (July 2026). Heated tobacco only; cash only (Tabelog). 2nd floor of the Donguri Kaikan (どんぐり会館) in Gion, shared toilet; 1 min from Exit 1 of Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; July 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gion, south of Shijo near the Kamo River — 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Samgyetang and creative Korean cooking by a former fishmonger (Tabelog, shop text) · samgyetang to finish, white (classic) or black, with garlic, seaweed, spice and vinegar to change the flavour (2025–26 reviews) · ganjang gejang (soy-marinated crab, reserve ahead) with rice in the shell, ganjang saeu (soy-marinated shrimp), kegani in season with uni and ikura (2025–26 reviews) · an appetizer plate of several small dishes, yukhoe bruschetta, steamed pork, cheese chijimi, spring rolls of crab cream or cod milt, firefly-squid japchae, grilled liver (2025–26 reviews) · makgeolli (white and pink), free-flow drinks ¥2,000 (July 2026)
places.notes: [Korean · Gion, samgyetang at a 9-seat counter] A retro-modern 9-seat counter upstairs in Gion's Donguri Kaikan, where a former fishmonger cooks samgyetang and seafood-led Korean dishes. Reserve the soy-marinated crab ahead and eat it with rice in the shell; then try the steamed pork or a cod-milt spring roll, and finish with samgyetang, white or black, seasoned your way. Free-flow drinks are ¥2,000 and makgeolli is the house pour. The board has no prices, but reviewers call the bill fair. Book early; cash only.

roles: Owner-chef, a former fishmonger (Tabelog, shop text; unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): claims to be the best in Kyoto for samgyetang and creative Korean cooking; the owner-chef was formerly a fishmonger; the shop used to serve set courses only and switched to à la carte in April. Reviewers describe the owner as kind, explaining how to eat each dish and offering to reduce portions when diners are full (April 2026); a February 2026 reviewer found the room full of regulars.
chef_bio.specialty: Samgyetang; ganjang gejang.

anecdotes.text: "The owner even suggested that I could reduce the portions if I was feeling full" — April 2026.
"The menu varies each time, and there are no posted prices on the board, so keep that in mind if you’re curious." — August 2026.
A December 2025 diner booked a month ahead by Instagram and requested the soy-marinated crab when booking.

places.name: 京都宇治金時や (Kyoto Uji Kintoki Ya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kakigori, matcha soft serve and red beans may be wheat-free, but the udon, tempura and fried tofu are not; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Matcha kakigori without milk and red beans may suit, but the soft serve and milk ice are dairy, and the udon broth is likely dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–21:30 daily; hours may change irregularly (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Takeaway soft serve from the front; seats inside and on the 2nd floor, with a courtyard view; a May 2026 reviewer notes ¥200 extra to sit inside in the air conditioning. 12 seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master), IC cards and iD (Tabelog); PayPay used in June 2026. On Gojo-zaka toward Kiyomizu-dera, near the Higashiyama-Gojo crossing; 12 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn, 6 min from Kiyomizu-dera (Tabelog; June 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gojo-zaka toward Kiyomizu-dera — 12 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Matcha kakigori, soft serve and udon (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · Uji Kintoki kakigori with red beans ¥1,200 (September 2026); Uji matcha kakigori with shiratama; "special milk" Uji matcha; milk-free matcha with little sweetness (2026 reviews) · hojicha soft serve ¥700 (March 2026), matcha soft serve ¥800 (September 2026), matcha ice cream ¥700 (June 2026) · jumbo kitsune udon with homemade fried tofu ¥1,200–1,300 (September 2026, two reviews), wagyu udon with beef from Ginza Yoshizawa and udon from Kochi (May 2026), tempura udon, cold broth on hot days · warm hojicha with kakigori
places.notes: [Kakigori & udon · Gojo-zaka, matcha on the way to Kiyomizu] A small shop on Gojo-zaka on the walk up to Kiyomizu-dera: grab a matcha or hojicha soft serve at the front (¥700–800), or sit upstairs over the courtyard for a fluffy Uji Kintoki kakigori (¥1,200) with warm hojicha. The owner talks matcha with real passion. It also serves udon — a jumbo kitsune with homemade fried tofu, or wagyu udon — which surprises dessert hunters. One reviewer noted a ¥200 charge to sit in the air-conditioned room. Open daily 10:00–21:30.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe an owner who talks passionately about matcha and fluffy kakigori (September and October 2026), sources udon from Kochi and beef from Ginza Yoshizawa (May 2026), and served a hot-day customer cold broth, fresh water and ice to take away (July 2026). Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2022, 2023, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Uji Kintoki kakigori; matcha soft serve; kitsune udon.

anecdotes.text: "For an additional JPY 200, you can enjoy air conditioning inside." — May 2026.
"They also provided me with freshly prepared cold water, and as I was leaving, they even gave me some ice to take with me." — July 2026.
A September 2026 visitor found the ice softer but less fluffy than hoped after the owner’s build-up, and the milk-free matcha barely sweet.
A September 2026 diner found the ¥1,300 jumbo kitsune udon pricey and the thick noodles a little undercooked.
