places.name: 五山望 (Gozan Nozomi)
places.gf_detail: Ask, and tell the restaurant in advance: it asks guests allergic to any of eight allergens, wheat included, to say so beforehand and will do its best for others (Tabelog). The courses include a monaka-shell starter, soy-based and miso sauces and garlic rice (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: teppanyaki courses of wagyu, lobster, abalone and scallops (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); open every day (Tabelog). Book online; for three or more guests a phone confirmation is needed (August 2026). 15% service charge (Tabelog). 26 seats, mostly at teppan counters facing Kyoto Tower; dessert may be served at a window table (2026 reviews). Non-smoking; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR payments including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 15th floor of Hotel Granvia Kyoto, directly connected to the central exit of JR Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, 15th floor of Hotel Granvia Kyoto
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki at counters facing Kyoto Tower, using Kyoto vegetables in the starters and sauces (2026 reviews) · lunch "Torii" course (most popular): appetizer such as wagyu rillettes in a rice-flour monaka or a beef "macaron", soup, lobster and scallops, domestic beef fillet 70 g with salt, wasabi, ponzu, garlic chips and red miso, grilled vegetables, sautéed thick tofu, garlic rice or rice with red miso soup and pickles, dessert, coffee (July–October 2026) · dinner: chef’s course with special black wagyu fillet and live lobster; a September 2026 course comparing Omi beef fillet and ribeye with matsutake and chicken kamameshi; abalone with Uji matcha sauce · lunch from over ¥10,000 (August 2026)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Kyoto Station, wagyu with a view of Kyoto Tower] The teppanyaki restaurant on the 15th floor of Hotel Granvia Kyoto, straight off the JR Kyoto Station concourse, where chefs grill lobster, scallops and wagyu fillet in front of you with Kyoto Tower filling the windows. The popular Torii lunch course runs from starters to garlic rice; dinner courses bring black wagyu, live lobster and, in autumn, Omi beef and matsutake. Lunch starts above ¥10,000, plus 15% service. Tell them about allergies in advance. Open daily.

roles: Hotel restaurant; no chef named in the sources
chef_bio.background: The teppanyaki restaurant of Hotel Granvia Kyoto (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 note starters that change monthly, a choice of soup, grilled vegetables and doneness, chefs who chat across the teppan, the day’s meat shown at the start (Ibaraki beef in September 2026), and a view of Kyoto Tower and the distant Mt Hiei. Tabelog Steak/Teppanyaki WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024, 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu fillet and lobster teppanyaki; garlic rice.

anecdotes.text: "The appetizers change monthly, and you can choose the soup, grilled vegetables, and the doneness of the meat" — June 2026.
"First, I was shown the ingredients of the day. The meat is sourced from Ibaraki Prefecture, and the origin changes daily." — September 2026.
An October 2026 weekend dinner guest had to wait in front of the restaurant until the booked time.

places.name: 京都餃子enen 祇園本店 (Kyoto Gyoza enen Gion)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: wheat-wrapped gyoza are the core of the menu, with noodles, fried rice and Chinese sauces; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, December 2025).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat gyoza, mapo tofu, chicken and fish dishes; only pickled cucumber, kimchi and a coriander tofu salad are meat-free on the menu (Tabelog menu, December 2025).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30), every day; closing days may vary (Tabelog). The mala soup set is lunch only (February 2026). Bookings taken, online or by phone; held 10 minutes (Tabelog). Waits of 10–30 minutes at dinner without a booking (October 2025; February 2026). Order by QR code (October 2025). 18 seats, no counter (Tabelog; February 2026); non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; cards (Tabelog). Dress smart casual (Tabelog). 6 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn, 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 April 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yamato-oji just south of Shijo — 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Small bite-size gyoza with a Sichuan-style sauce already on, plus Chinese and Japanese-Chinese dishes (2025–26 reviews) · gyoza, 6 pieces: garlic ¥600, ginger ¥600, la-zu ¥800, ume-shiso ¥800; dipping vinegar-pepper, soy or miso · Sichuan mapo tofu ¥1,200, saliva chicken ¥900, shrimp mayo with house orange sauce ¥1,200, chashu egg ¥1,200 · yodare katsuo ¥1,200, Chinese-style fish namero ¥750 · fresh spring roll ¥800, coriander tofu salad ¥450, whole pickled cucumber ¥500, kimchi ¥500 · Sichuan mapo noodles ¥1,300, salted fried rice ¥1,100, rice ¥400 · Tanba chestnut ice cream ¥400 (Tabelog menu, December 2025) · lunch sets: spicy mala soup with gyoza (noodles or glass noodles, spice to taste), mapo noodle set, gyoza set with fish carpaccio (2025–26 reviews) · yuzu and ponkan beers, highball ¥600 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Gyoza · Gion-Shijo, small gyoza with a Sichuan kick] An 18-seat gyoza bar on Yamato-oji opened in April 2025, now full most evenings with travellers who found it on social media. The gyoza are small and come six to a plate — garlic, ginger, la-zu or ume-shiso — already dressed in a numbing Chinese-style sauce; add mapo tofu, saliva chicken or yodare katsuo, and finish with the Sichuan mapo noodles. Lunch brings mala soup and gyoza sets. Gyoza from ¥600. Book or expect a short wait; order by QR code. Daily.

roles: Operator 株式会社ｅｎｅｎ (invoice T1120901030677), which also runs 京都焼肉 enen 先斗町本店; no person is named
chef_bio.background: Opened 25 April 2025 (Tabelog). The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ｅｎｅｎ (NTA corporate-number site). Reviewers from October 2025 to September 2026 describe a room filled mostly with overseas visitors; an April 2026 diner was told by the manager that the visitors come via social media.
chef_bio.specialty: Garlic and ume-shiso gyoza; Sichuan mapo noodles; mala soup set (lunch).

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 couple waited about 30 minutes on a Tuesday night, ordered by QR code and found it good value; the carpaccio was sold out.
A February 2026 diner came for the mala soup seen on Instagram and learned it is served only at lunch.
A September 2026 diner advised ordering gyoza in bulk, as service can take a while.

places.name: SUGiTORA (スギトラ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Gelato is served in cups or cones with a cookie on top; parfaits layer meringue, savarin, tart or cake; apple pie and baked goods; no gluten information is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Most gelato is milk-based (the "milk" uses high-fat Nemuro milk), and parfaits use cream and meringue; a soy-milk tofu-pudding dessert (douhua) is on the café menu, but no item is marked vegan (official site).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–12:00 baked goods to take away only; café from 13:00; mini parfaits and gelato to take away from 13:30; last order 18:00; closes when the gelato sells out (official site). Closed Tuesday and Wednesday (official site top) or Tuesday and every other Wednesday (official site shop panel; Tabelog). Café seats by booking on TableCheck, with the order chosen and paid by card in advance (August–September 2026). 8 seats on the 2nd floor up a spiral stair; benches outside for gelato; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). In an alley between the Teramachi and Shinkyogoku arcades; 6 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (official site; Tabelog). Opened 13 March 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Alley between the Teramachi and Shinkyogoku arcades — 6 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Gelato and plated parfaits by a patissier who won silver for Japan at the Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie 2015 (official site) · gelato in cup or cone, one to three flavours: milk (Nemuro high-fat milk), 60-days chocolate, red fruits and tea, rich pistachio (+¥50), Uji matcha, plus seasonal flavours; single ¥864 (August 2026) · "Tora-chan’s paw": a paw-shaped ice cream (milk, hojicha, peach or seasonal) over a gelato, with a tiger cookie, ¥1,350 (July–September 2026) · seasonal parfaits in the 2nd-floor café, e.g. peach and savarin soaked in red wine, summer citrus, lemon tart, caramel apple with fromage, Mont Blanc on a meringue bowl (official site; August–September 2026) · morning plate (brioche or croissant), douhua, matcha kakigori, apple pie with coffee ¥1,700 (official site; August–October 2026) · original cookie tins: vanilla, chocolate, matcha, speculoos (official site)
places.notes: [Gelato & parfaits · Teramachi, a fruit shop reborn as a gelateria] Hidden in an alley between the Teramachi and Shinkyogoku arcades, SUGiTORA revives the name of スギトラ果実店, a fruit shop that stood near Kawaramachi-Sanjo for over a century until 2008. Owner-chef Shinichi Sugita, a Kyoto native who won silver for Japan at the 2015 Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie, makes gelato built to melt slowly for walking — try the 'Tora-chan's paw' (¥1,350) — and, upstairs in an eight-seat café, plated seasonal parfaits worth booking on TableCheck. 10:00–19:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesdays.

roles: Owner-chef (official site: "オーナーシェフ 杉田 晋一（スギタ シンイチ）")
chef_bio.origin: Born and raised in Kyoto (official site).
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: represented Japan at the Coupe du Monde de la Pâtisserie 2015 and won silver; worked at a well-known Tokyo hotel before opening in Kyoto, the chef’s home town. The shop takes its name from スギトラ果実店, a small fruit shop at Kawaramachi-Sanjo for over 100 years, which closed in 2008; it returned in 2017 as the gelato shop SUGiTORA. The site lists two more shops, Patisserie labo and 京都タワーサンド店. Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: gelato with seasonal flavours to make Kyoto’s seasons felt, made with gratitude in every piece, "to make as many people smile as possible".
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal gelato; Tora-chan’s paw; plated parfaits.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor found the TableCheck system of choosing and paying in advance a little formal, but understood from the shop’s Instagram that it followed past no-shows.
A July 2026 visitor found the gelato lighter than expected, not lingeringly sweet or milky.
An October 2026 weekday visitor was the only guest in the upstairs café, reached by a spiral staircase.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sugitora.com): 寺町商店街と新京極商店街の間の路地の隠れ家、2階のカフェでオリジナルのパフェ、ジェラートは食べ歩きに、河原町三条に100年以上あった果物屋スギトラ果実店が2008年に閉店し、2017年にジェラート屋 SUGiTORA として戻った、オーナーシェフ 杉田 晋一 (スギタ シンイチ)、Coupe du Monde de la Patisserie 2015 に日本代表で出場し銀メダル、東京の有名ホテルを経て生まれ育った京都で開店、10:00〜12:00 焼き菓子テイクアウトのみ、13:00〜カフェ、13:30〜ミニパフェ・ジェラートテイクアウト、18:00 ラストオーダー、ジェラートが売り切れ次第終了、定休日は毎週火曜日・水曜日 (別の欄には毎週火曜日・隔週水曜日)、店舗: SUGiTORA、Patisserie labo、京都タワーサンド店、テイクアウト: とらちゃんのおてて、ミルク (根室地区の高乳脂肪の牛乳)、60デイズショコラ、赤い果実と紅茶、リッチピスタチオ (+50円)、特選宇治抹茶、カフェ: SUGiTORA の豆花、モーニングプレート、桃とサバランのパフェ、サマーシトラスパフェ、檸檬タルトと夏のパフェ、キャラメル林檎と軽いフロマージュのパフェ。食べログ: カフェ・スイーツ、中京区中筋町488-15、河原町駅から徒歩6分、8席、禁煙、カード可、2017年3月13日オープン、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): とらちゃんのおてて1,350円、シングル864円、TableCheck での事前決済、モンブランのパフェ、アップルパイとコーヒー1,700円。

cultural_comfort.note: Book café seats on TableCheck (order and pay ahead); gelato to take away from 13:30.

places.name: シェモア (Chez Moi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the shop cannot accommodate allergies or food dislikes (Tabelog), and courses include bread, pastry and sauces (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fixed French courses of seafood, foie gras and meat, with no changes for dietary needs (Tabelog; official menu).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00 (last order 19:30); closed irregularly (official site). Tabelog lists Tuesday to Sunday and holidays, closed Monday. Reservation only, by phone or the web; no allergies or dislikes catered for (Tabelog). Takeaway set ¥10,800, by the day before, collected 16:00–17:30 (official site, September 2026). Closed 29 October–1 November 2026 (official site). 12 seats and a terrace; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards; no shorts, T-shirts, sandals or sweatpants (Tabelog). At the end of a narrow alley, the third building north of Oike on the west side of Gokomachi-dori; 2 min from exit 10 of Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (official site; Tabelog). Moved here from Karasuma-Nishiki in July 2005 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Gokomachi-dori north of Oike, down an alley — 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Classic French courses from a husband-and-wife restaurant: the chef cooks, the madame, a sommelier, serves (official site) · Chef course ¥9,900 (amuse, cold and hot starters, soup, fish of the day, a meat dish, bread, dessert, coffee); lobster course ¥13,000; abalone course ¥13,200; foie gras course ¥15,000; mains to choose: truffled beef hamburg, domestic beef fillet, French duck, lamb, beef braised in red wine (official site) · signature seafood terrine in jelly, sea-urchin flan, escargots in cream, bouillabaisse of fish sent from Wajima on Noto, sea bream with Café de Paris sauce, foie gras with truffle Madeira sauce; seasonal soups such as peach in summer and matsutake under pastry in autumn (official site; 2025–26 reviews) · French wines from about ¥3,000 a bottle and about 30 Madeiras (official site; January 2026)
places.notes: [French · Oike, a couple's hideaway with piano and magic] A classic French restaurant at the end of a narrow alley off Gokomachi-Oike, run by a husband-and-wife team: the chef, from Wajima on Noto, cooks alone, and the madame, a sommelier, runs the room. Courses start at ¥9,900 — the jellied seafood terrine, sea-urchin flan, escargots and a bouillabaisse of fish sent from Wajima — and for birthdays the chef plays the piano and shows card tricks. A reviewer notes that a stone lantern in the garden is one of eight built under Hideyoshi. No allergies or dislikes catered for. Booking only; 18:00–22:00.

roles: Chef (born in Wajima, Ishikawa) and madame (born in Kyoto, a sommelier), a married couple who run the restaurant together (official site); not named on the site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the chef trained at Kyoto’s cookery school, worked at Ginza’s 三笠会館, then trained in French cooking under chef 大渕康文 at アタント in Roppongi and was shaped by chef 小澤貴彦 of OZAWA; the couple ran Chez Moi at Karasuma-Nishiki for nearly 20 years before moving to the present alley in July 2005; the madame has worked in restaurants for 30 years and passed the sommelier exam while helping a daughter study for high-school entrance exams; both practise the tea ceremony. Since the 2024 Noto earthquake the chef, a Noto native, ran soup kitchens for about a year and a half and now supports Noto by buying its fish; the couple also did volunteer soup-kitchen work in Yatsushiro, Kumamoto, in October 2026. Tabelog French WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: the couple’s own restaurant, with a beautiful, comfortable space and an unhurried flow of time — learned from chef 小澤貴彦.
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood terrine in jelly; sea-urchin flan; Noto fish bouillabaisse.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 couple celebrating an anniversary were treated to the chef’s piano performance and card tricks.
A January 2026 visitor notes that one of the eight lanterns built when Toyotomi Hideyoshi unified Japan stands in the garden.
An August 2026 visitor found the summer peach soup saltier than hoped and the ¥880 fillet supplement small.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (chez-moi.co.jp): 京都市役所の近く、御幸町御池を北へ、細い路地の奥の隠れ家、シェフとマダム二人でおもてなしのフレンチ、能登半島地震から約1年半続けた炊き出し、シェフの故郷能登を応援、輪島のお魚屋さんの魚でブイヤベース、2005年7月に烏丸錦から移転、シェフ: 石川県輪島市生まれ、京都調理師学校卒業、銀座の三笠会館、六本木「アタント」大渕康文シェフ、白金台「OZAWA」小澤貴彦シェフ、趣味は茶道と三味線、マダム: 京都生まれ京都育ち、この仕事に30年、ソムリエ、営業時間 18:00〜22:00 (L.O 19:30)、不定休、シェフコース9,900円 (税込)、オマール海老のコース13,000円、フォアグラのコース15,000円、アワビのコース13,200円、お持ち帰りセット10,800円 (前日までに予約、受け取り16時〜17時半)、2026年10月29日〜11月1日休み、2026年10月に熊本県八代で炊き出しボランティア、マディラワイン30種類。食べログ: フレンチ、完全予約制、アレルギー・苦手な食材には対応できない、12席、テラス、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可、短パン・T シャツ・サンダル・スウェット不可、フレンチ WEST 百名店 2023・2025。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 夫婦で営む、海の幸のテリーヌ、ウニのフラン、シェフのピアノと手品、庭の灯籠。

cultural_comfort.note: Booking only; smart dress (no shorts, T-shirts or sandals); no dietary changes.

places.name: はふう 本店 (Hafuu Honten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the signatures are breaded beef cutlet and katsu sandwiches, with croquettes, curry, hayashi rice and demi-glace stews; plain steak is the only simple option and its sauces are not described (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a butcher-run meat house — steak, beef cutlet, hamburg, stew (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30; last entry 21:00); closed Wednesday and irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Dinner seat charge ¥500 a head (official site; Tabelog). Bookings by phone or TableCheck; cancelled after 20 minutes late (Tabelog). A queue of about 10 can form before lunch on holidays (August 2026). 36 seats: 16 at the counter, 20 at tables including large shared round tables (Tabelog; August 2026); non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). In a quiet street south of the Imperial Palace; 10 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae or Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 18 April 1999 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho-dori south of the Imperial Palace — 10 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Yoshoku and steak from a family long in Kyoto’s butcher trade (official site) · lunch (tax included): premium sirloin steak ¥5,200, fillet ¥5,400, Hafuu special beef cutlet ¥3,100, beef stew ¥3,000, Hafuu steak don ¥3,350, fried prawns ¥2,200, hamburg steak ¥1,800, weekday daily lunch ¥1,100 (with small dish, salad, rice, miso soup, pickles, coffee), curry or hayashi rice ¥1,400, katsu sando ¥2,500, premium katsu sando ¥5,800 · dinner courses: Original ¥11,300 (sirloin 190 g or fillet 170 g), Niku-senka and Hafuu courses ¥9,200; dinner sets with starter, soup, salad, bread or rice, dessert and coffee: fillet ¥8,800, sirloin ¥8,300, fillet teriyaki ¥8,800, beef stew ¥5,700, fillet beef cutlet ¥6,200, hamburg ¥4,500; à la carte fillet 120 g ¥5,400, sirloin 140 g ¥5,200 (official menu) · beef sukiyaki don, Japanese-style beef cutlet, beef cream croquettes (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · south of the Imperial Palace, a butcher's beef cutlet] A long-running yoshoku and steak house in a quiet street south of the Imperial Palace, run by a family with a long history as Kyoto butchers — the site credits that for good beef at a fair price. The beef cutlet — fillet, rare inside — and the katsu sando are the names to know; the hamburg steak and the weekday daily lunch (¥1,100) are the bargains, and the steak don comes with green-onion salt and horseradish. Dinner courses from ¥9,200, plus a ¥500 seat charge. Expect a short queue at lunch on holidays. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Operated by a family butcher business (official site: 「はふう」の母体は京の町にて古くからお肉屋); no person is named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Hafuu’s parent business has long run a butcher’s shop in Kyoto, and its experience shows in the beef; the name joins は (wave) and ふう (wind), for a relaxed feeling like swaying on gentle waves in the breeze; the main shop is Japanese in feel and the Shogoin shop oriental, with private rooms. Opened 18 April 1999 (Tabelog). Tabelog Yoshoku "Tabelog 100" 2020, 2022, 2023 and Yoshoku WEST 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to let people enjoy delicious beef at a good price — "something only Hafuu can do".
chef_bio.specialty: Beef cutlet; katsu sando; steak don.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner arriving 15 minutes before a holiday lunch found about 10 people in line, and was seated at a large shared table.
An August 2026 diner found the premium katsu sando’s rare beef cutlet superb on its own but thought the sandwich did not do it justice.
"The rice, miso soup, and salad were all tasty, and the sauce paired perfectly with both the Hamburg Steak and the rice" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hafuu.com): 肉専科はふう、京都御所の南、「は」は波、「ふう」は風、母体は京の町で古くからお肉屋を営む、本店 (和風) と聖護院店 (オリエンタル、完全個室)、本店: 中京区麩屋町通夷川上る笹屋町471-1、11:30〜13:30 (L.O.)・17:30〜21:30 (L.O.)、水曜日・他不定休、ランチ: 極上サーロインステーキ5,200円、極上フィレステーキ5,400円、はふう特選ビフカツ3,100円、ビーフシチュー3,000円、はふうステーキ丼3,350円、エビフライ2,200円、ハンバーグステーキ1,800円、日替りランチ (平日のみ) 1,100円、カレーライス・ハヤシライス各1,400円、カツサンド2,500円、極上カツサンド5,800円、ディナー: お席料ひとり500円、オリジナル Dinner 11,300円、肉専科コース・はふうコース各9,200円、極上牛フィレステーキ Dinner 8,800円、ビフカツ (牛フィレ) Dinner 6,200円、ハンバーグ Dinner 4,500円。食べログ: 洋食・ステーキ・牛料理、36席 (カウンター16、テーブル20)、20分以上の遅刻はキャンセル扱い、禁煙、カード可、1999年4月18日オープン、洋食百名店 2020・2022・2023、洋食 WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 肉屋が営む洋食店、ビフカツ、極上カツサンド、ステーキ丼、ハンバーグ、牛すき丼。

cultural_comfort.note: Book dinner on TableCheck or by phone; lunch is first come; ¥500 dinner seat charge.

places.name: MENYA EDITION 木屋町店 (MENYA EDITION Kiyamachi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in a soy-sauce broth; fried rice, gyoza and kara-age on the side (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: back-fat soy-sauce ramen with chashu; the broth has animal flavours (Tabelog shop text; March 2026).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–7:00, every day (Tabelog); the shop recommends 18:00–24:00 (Tabelog shop text). No reservations; groups of eight have been seated without a wait (Tabelog; March 2026). 24 table seats, more than the entrance suggests, down a narrow passage (Tabelog; March and June 2026). Non-smoking; children welcome; photo menu (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC and other e-money, PayPay (Tabelog). On Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Rokkaku, ground floor of 第二観光ビル; 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 30 September 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Rokkaku — 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto back-fat shoyu ramen, served until morning (Tabelog shop text) · back-fat shoyu ramen ¥980, with Kujo negi, chashu, menma and nori; chopped garlic +¥30 (September 2026) · "Dark Side", a black burnt-soy shoyu ramen with a smoky garlic note, about ¥850 (June 2026) · reviewers liken the "white" bowl to Daiichi Asahi and the "black" to Shin-Fukusaikan (March 2026) · Edilou ramen (May 2026) · Kiyamachi-only black fried rice; gyoza, chashu appetiser, kara-age (ramen and kara-age combo ¥1,710) (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews) · highballs and beer
places.notes: [Ramen · Kiyamachi, Kyoto shoyu until 7 a.m.] A café-like ramen shop on Nishi-Kiyamachi open from 18:00 until 7:00, for the end of a night out: classic Kyoto back-fat shoyu ramen (¥980) with a pile of Kujo negi, and the pitch-black "Dark Side" of burnt soy and garlic. Reviewers find the broth lighter and gentler than it looks; one disliked the coarsely cut onions. Kiyamachi-only black fried rice and kara-age on the side. More seats lie beyond a narrow passage; groups fit. Cards and PayPay. A second shop is near Shichijo Station.

roles: Young staff, some from abroad (March 2026); no one is named
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: traditional back-fat shoyu ramen, open until 7 a.m.; "The Dark Side" has the highest repeat rate; Kiyamachi-exclusive black fried rice. Opened 30 September 2024 (Tabelog). A June 2026 reviewer had eaten at the Edition near Shichijo Station and noted the Kiyamachi shop’s name in romaji; a March 2026 reviewer read it as an independent brand designed with inbound visitors in mind and found prices a little high for the style.
chef_bio.specialty: Back-fat shoyu ramen; Dark Side black shoyu ramen.

anecdotes.text: "The broth was surprisingly light and refreshing, with a good balance of sweetness, rather than being overly rich." The same diner found the green onions thick and harsh. — March 2026.
"The menu features two styles of ramen: the 'white' reminiscent of Daiichi Asahi and the 'black' that evokes Shin Fukusaikan." — March 2026.
"I also tried the black broth, which had a burnt garlic flavor and a smoky taste. I preferred this broth." — March 2026.
"There was a narrow passage with a disorganized arrangement of a refrigerator and alcohol. There were a few tables in the back" — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ラーメン、中京区西木屋町通六角下る北車屋町272-1 第二観光ビル1F、三条駅から徒歩5分、毎日18:00〜翌7:00、予約不可、24席 (テーブル)、禁煙、子供可、写真メニュー、カード・交通系IC・PayPay 可、2024年9月30日オープン、店舗紹介: 伝統の背脂醤油ラーメン、朝7時まで、リピート率の高い「ダークサイド」、木屋町限定の黒チャーハン。口コミ (2026年1〜9月、英語): 背脂醤油ラーメン980円、刻みにんにく30円、ダークサイド850円ほど、九条ねぎ、チャーシュー、メンマ、のり、白は Daiichi Asahi、黒は Shin Fukusaikan のよう、唐揚げセット1,710円、餃子、狭い通路の奥のテーブル、七条駅近くの店。

cultural_comfort.note: Photo menu; walk in late at night; cards and PayPay accepted.

places.name: 寿し小松 (Sushi Komatsu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi and sashimi with soy sauce, plus tempura, fried taro and grilled dishes; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a tuna and seafood sushi counter; red miso soup with lunch (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–21:00 (last order 20:30), without a break; closed Thursday (Tabelog). The lunch menu runs until 14:00 (April 2026); quiet mid-afternoon, so good for a daytime drink (July 2026; Tabelog shop text). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; August 2026). 14 counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome, with a kids’ menu (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC, iD and PayPay (Tabelog). On Tominokoji just north of Nishiki Market, easy to miss; 3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu) (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 20 April 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Tominokoji just north of Nishiki Market — 3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Sushi and seafood izakaya run by a wholesaler that supplies Kyoto restaurants, known for wild fresh bluefin tuna (Tabelog shop text) · lunch: 10-piece sushi set with a negitoro roll and red miso soup, about ¥2,200 (April 2026) · rare tuna cuts as sashimi — eye, brain, others — and grilled tuna collar; tuna-belly sashimi; toro-taku (2026 reviews) · assorted sashimi, fresh oysters, saba sushi, sea urchin and squid salad, tempura (white fish, corn, clam), fried taro, chawanmushi, uzaku (2026 reviews) · Kyoto and other Japanese sakes, shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Sushi · Nishiki Market, a tuna wholesaler's counter] A 14-seat sushi counter tucked just north of Nishiki Market, run by a seafood wholesaler and open straight through from 11:30 to 21:00 — handy for a late lunch or an afternoon drink. Tuna is the thing: rare cuts such as the eye and brain as sashimi, grilled collar, toro-taku. The lunch set of 10 nigiri with a negitoro roll is about ¥2,200; dinners with sake run ¥8,000–15,000. Friendly chefs chat at the counter; one who once worked in America talks with foreign customers. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: next to Nishiki Market, using domestic ingredients and fresh tuna, operated by a wholesaler connected to many well-known Kyoto restaurants. Opened 20 April 2020 (Tabelog). A July 2026 diner heard a chef mention working in America, chatting with foreign customers; a September 2026 diner says it is run by the same tuna wholesaler as Sushi Noboru in the central market, with several experienced chefs at the counter; a June 2026 diner learned it is the same as the Sushi Komatsu at Kyoto Station.
chef_bio.specialty: Rare tuna cuts; grilled tuna collar.

anecdotes.text: "I caused a bit of trouble by accidentally spilling the red miso soup, creating a sea of red miso on the counter... They kindly brought me another cup of red miso soup." — April 2026.

"There were four types available, and while all were delicious due to their rarity, one piece from the back of the eye had a slight odor, so be cautious." The same diner found the rice a little loose that day. — July 2026.
"While I can't recommend many places in Nishiki Market due to their high prices, I can at least suggest this one." — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 海鮮・寿司・居酒屋、中京区富小路通錦上ル高宮町594、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、11:30〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、木曜休み、予約可、14席 (カウンター)、禁煙、子供可・キッズメニュー、カード・交通系IC・iD・PayPay 可、2020年4月20日オープン、店舗紹介: 錦市場のすぐそば、国産の食材、天然本生マグロ、京都の名店に卸す問屋が営む、昼飲み、京都の地酒と全国の銘酒。口コミ (2026年4〜10月、英語): 昼の寿司10貫とねぎとろ巻き2,200円ほど、マグロの珍しい部位 (目、頭)、カマ焼き、とろたく、刺身の盛り合わせ、生牡蠣、鯖寿司、天ぷら、茶碗蒸し、うざく、京都駅にも寿し小松、アメリカで働いた職人。

cultural_comfort.note: Friendly counter chefs; open all day; cards and PayPay accepted.

places.name: 室町 唯 (Muromachi Yui)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A single omakase kaiseki course with dashi-based soups, sushi, tempura and grilled dishes; no gluten information (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kaiseki of fish, shellfish, crab and dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–20:30 (last entry); closed Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). Reservation only, by the day before; by phone or web (official site; Tabelog). One omakase course (Tabelog shop text), ¥30,000 at a first visit (July 2025; August 2026). 10 seats at a curved counter looking onto a garden; the room can be hired for up to 20; designated smoking area (Tabelog; February 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). In a townhouse on Oshikoji-dori west of Karasuma; 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 2 (Tabelog). Opened 15 December 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Oshikoji-dori west of Karasuma — 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: One omakase kaiseki course of the day from ingredients bought at the market each morning and fish from Tango ports (official site; Tabelog shop text) · ¥30,000 (July 2025; August 2026) · e.g. red sea urchin with abalone, hairy-crab shinjo, ayu with its bones fried crisp, hamo carved at the counter (July 2025); hoba sushi and hairy crab — the chef is from Gifu — and clay-pot Omi rice (June 2026); corn wrapped round prawns as tempura (August 2026) · the rice comes with about nine to ten side dishes to eat as you like — chirimen, nameko, nori, karasumi, iwana roe (2026 reviews) · sake chosen for the food, including vintages; seasonal Kyoto sencha (official site); wine, by the owner’s choice (June 2026)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Karasuma Oike, 前田一光's counter by a garden] A 10-seat curved counter in a townhouse on quiet Oshikoji, facing a garden, where 前田一光 — born in Gifu to a restaurant family — serves one omakase kaiseki a night (about ¥30,000) built from that morning's market and Tango fish: playful dishes like corn-wrapped prawn tempura, then clay-pot rice with nine or ten side dishes to graze. Reviewers describe it as holding two Michelin stars. Book by the day before; last entry 20:30; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 前田一光 (MAEDA KAZUTERU) was born in Nakatsugawa, Gifu, and grew up in the kitchen of the restaurant run by a parent ("料理屋を営む父親のもと"); after high school, trained in Kyoto aiming to equal that father; became owner of 室町 唯 in December 2019. The site describes visits to the market every morning, daily contact with Tango fishing ports, a counter built so guests watch the cooking, and a garden view. Reviewers in June–August 2026 say the restaurant holds two Michelin stars; a June 2026 reviewer describes a head chef and a wine-loving owner who joined guests for a drink, and says regulars sometimes bring their own wine.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "唯一無二の食事を目指して" — food that can only be had here; nothing used that the kitchen is not satisfied with; menus not bound by convention.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase kaiseki; clay-pot rice with many side dishes.

anecdotes.text: "What stood out the most was the variety of about 9 different accompaniments for the rice, all available for unlimited servings." — February 2026.
"I was lucky that there was a large supply of tuna caught by a customer, so we could have unlimited servings of tuna rice bowl." — June 2026.
"They wrapped the shrimp in the corn after steaming and cooling it, then tempura-fried it, which created an interesting texture." — August 2026.
"The chef is from Gifu, so we enjoyed Hoba Sushi and plenty of hairy crab." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (muromachi-yui.jp): 京都烏丸御池の会席料理店、17:00〜20:30 (最終入店)、水曜定休、完全予約制、唯一無二の食事を目指して、市場に毎朝通い最高の食材だけを仕入れ、丹後の漁港と毎朝連絡、既成概念に捉われない献立、カウンター中心の内装と庭、季節に合わせた煎茶、ビンテージも含む日本酒、店主 前田一光 (MAEDA KAZUTERU): 岐阜県中津川市生まれ、料理屋を営む父親のもと幼少期から調理場に入る、高校卒業後に京都で修行、2019年12月に室町 唯の店主に就任。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理、中京区押小路通烏丸西入金吹町459、烏丸御池駅2番出口から徒歩3分、完全予約制 (前日まで)、おまかせコースのみ、10席 (カウンター)、貸切20名まで、カード可、2019年12月15日オープン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年9月、英語): コース30,000円、ミシュラン二つ星、ご飯のお供9〜10種、朴葉寿司、毛蟹、とうもろこしで巻いた海老の天ぷら、庭の見える曲線のカウンター。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by the day before; one omakase course at a counter; cards accepted.

places.name: 研覃 ほりべ (Kentan Horibe)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki of dashi-based soups, mackerel sushi, sashimi with soy-based dips, grilled and fried fish, simmered beef and rice with tsukudani; no gluten information (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses are built on fish, soft-shelled turtle, Omi beef and dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–12:30 last entry, closes 14:00; dinner 18:00–19:30 last entry, closes 22:00; closed Tuesday; reservation required (official site; Tabelog gives slightly different last entries). Phone bookings 14:00–17:00, or TableCheck; changes or cancellations by phone at least three days ahead; cancellation fees 25% two days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day (official site). Even when Tabelog shows full, seats may be free by phone or the website (Tabelog). Dress code: no sweatpants, jeans, shorts or sandals; cover tattoos; no strong perfume (Tabelog). Children below elementary school age only in private rooms (Tabelog). 14 seats at a counter and tables, plus private rooms for 4–6 with a room charge of 10–20% of the food (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). In a townhouse on Nishikikoji west of Muromachi; 4 min walk from Shijo Stn / Karasuma Stn exits 22 and 24 (official site). Opened here 10 December 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishikikoji-dori west of Muromachi, in a townhouse — 4 min walk from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto cuisine built on the five flavours, five colours and five methods, in a townhouse with a small garden (Tabelog shop text) · lunch ¥12,000 and dinner ¥25,000 including tax and service (official site); Tabelog also lists "limited courses for foreign guests" at ¥15,000 for lunch (cash only) and ¥28,000 for dinner, seats not selectable, no children · a September 2026 lunch: grated-yam tofu with shrimp, soft-shelled turtle soup with egg tofu, Akashi sea bream, grilled bonito with sesame, fried hamo with Joyo figs, Omi beef with wasabi vinegar, Tango rice with hamo tsukudani, sudachi-champagne sorbet · seasonal hassun in a basket, cedar-plank grilled sawara, mackerel sushi, kue soup (2025 reviews) · sake such as Tsuru no Tomo, Kirin and Sapporo beer, champagne (2026 reviews) · New Year osechi to order (official site)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Shijo Karasuma, 堀部努's Kyoto cuisine] A townhouse kaiseki restaurant on Nishikikoji with a small garden, a counter and private rooms, where 堀部努 — who cooked in Gion, at Gion Horibe, before moving here — serves monthly Kyoto courses: soft-shelled turtle soup, sea bream from Akashi, fried hamo with figs, a hassun in a basket. Lunch ¥12,000, dinner ¥25,000, tax and service included; Tabelog also sells pricier "courses for foreign guests". Michelin one star nine years running, per its site. Dress smartly; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 研覃 (けんたん) means to pursue and explore deeply and to cultivate oneself; the owner signs as 店主 堀部 努; site news marks a Michelin one star for nine years running (July 2026) and the restaurant’s twentieth anniversary (August 2026). A September 2026 reviewer names the chef as Tsutomu Horibe, who honed skills in Gion and at "Gion Horibe" before moving to Karasuma; Tabelog dates this site from 10 December 2016. A November 2025 regular notes foreign guests at lunch; a July 2026 reviewer says the owner-chef and staff always seem to enjoy their work.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to serve the world through cooking for the guest’s "delicious!", and to grow as people.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki; hassun; soft-shelled turtle soup.

anecdotes.text: "Upon entering, the owner personally greeted us, and there was a natural warmth in the way the dishes were presented." — November 2025.
"I asked about it, and they told me they grind the conger twice—a truly labor-intensive dish." — of the hamo surinagashi, August 2026.
"The owner-chef and the staff always seemed to be enjoying their work, which left a lasting impression." — July 2026.
A November 2025 group of five paid ¥12,000 each for lunch plus a 5% private-room fee and found the hospitality worth it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-horibe.com): 研覃 (けんたん) とは「深ク深ク追求スル、探求スル。又自分自身ヲ耕シ研鑽スル」という意、店主 堀部 努、昼餉12,000円・夕餉25,000円 (税・サ込)、昼11時30分〜12時30分 (最終入店) 14時閉店、夜18時00分〜19時30分 (最終入店) 22時閉店、火曜定休、電話予約は14時〜17時、TableCheck、キャンセル料 (2日前25%、前日50%、当日100%)、一つ星9年連続 (2026年7月)、二十周年 (2026年8月)、おせち、四条駅・烏丸駅22番・24番出口から徒歩4分。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理・海鮮・創作、中京区錦小路通室町西入ル天神山町273、外国人のお客様限定コース 昼15,000円 (現金のみ)・夜28,000円、ドレスコード、タトゥーは隠す、未就学児は個室のみ、14席、個室あり (個室料10〜20%)、カード可、2016年12月10日オープン、店舗紹介: 京都の五味・五色・五法、町家と坪庭。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 祇園時代からの名店、すっぽんと玉子豆腐の椀、Akashi の鯛、鱧の揚げ物と Joyo のいちじく、Omi beef、Tango のお米、八寸、杉板焼き。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (phone 14:00–17:00 or TableCheck); smart dress; Tabelog sells separate, pricier courses for foreign guests.

places.name: イタメシOliva (Itameshi Oliva)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, risotto, gratin with bread and fried olives stuffed with meat dominate; carpaccio, prosciutto and roasts are also served; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Most dishes use seafood, meat or cheese; seasonal vegetable and fruit appetizers appear, but no vegan dish is named (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Friday–Sunday 17:00–24:00; Thursday 19:00–24:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations by phone (Tabelog) or Instagram DM (June 2026); a ¥1,000 per-person fee for same-day no-shows; at least one food item and one drink each; a 120-minute limit when busy (Tabelog). 12 seats: a 5-seat counter and small tables (Tabelog). Prices shown before tax; no charge (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Third floor of the 先斗町たばこやビル: from Pontocho, take alley no. 15 on the north side and the lift to 3F (Tabelog). 3 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 2 August 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho alley no. 15, north of Shijo — 3 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small Italian using fish and seasonal produce from Wakasa in Obama, Fukui, the owner's home town; risotto of Wakasa rice (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews) · antipasto platter, prosciutto and mozzarella, seasonal prosciutto with cheese and strawberry, pork pâté, fried olives stuffed with meat · pasta: peperoncino, seaweed aglio e olio, mussel pasta, firefly squid and fuki-no-tou linguine · squid-ink risotto, gorgonzola risotto · oyster gratin, eggplant and porcini cheese bake · roast duck, roast beef, lamb steak · panna cotta · Italian beers and wine (2024–2026 reviews) · about ¥14,000 for two with a bottle of wine (July 2025)
places.notes: [Italian · Pontocho, a third-floor hideaway with Wakasa produce] A twelve-seat Italian up a lift in the Tabakoya building, reached from Pontocho's alley no. 15. The owner-chef is from Obama in Fukui and builds the menu around Wakasa fish, seasonal produce and Wakasa rice: start with the antipasto platter or prosciutto and mozzarella, then the squid-ink risotto, a seasonal pasta, oyster gratin or the lamb steak, and panna cotta. Portions are generous and good for sharing; the owner will cook off-menu on request. About ¥14,000 for two with wine (July 2025). Book by phone; closed Wednesday, open to midnight.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed; November 2024 reviews: "The owner is from Obama in Fukui", "The owner-chef is friendly")
chef_bio.origin: Obama, Fukui Prefecture (November 2024 and February 2025 reviews).
chef_bio.background: Tabelog's introduction describes fresh seafood and seasonal ingredients from Wakasa in Obama City, Fukui Prefecture, and risotto of Wakasa rice. Tabelog gives the opening as 2 August 2017.
chef_bio.specialty: Squid-ink risotto; seasonal pasta; fried stuffed olives.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 diner found the owner running the room alone because the staff member was off sick, with four groups in.
A November 2024 regular named the squid-ink risotto "a flavor bomb" and the meat-stuffed fried olives a perfect match for Italian beer.
A May 2025 reviewer notes the place is popular with foreign tourists, so phone booking is essential, and that the owner will make dishes not on the menu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタメシOliva、イタリアン・バル・居酒屋、中京区下樵木町202-4-1 先斗町たばこやビル 3F、河原町駅から徒歩約3分、月火金土日 17:00〜24:00、木 19:00〜24:00、水曜休み、電話予約、当日の無断キャンセルは1人1,000円、1人1品1ドリンク以上、混雑時120分制、12席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、英語メニュー、税別表記、2017年8月2日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): Fukui の Obama の Wakasa の鮮魚と旬の食材、Wakasa の米のリゾット、先斗町の15番路地。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 店主は Obama 出身、ペペロンチーノ、イカスミのリゾット、オリーブの肉詰めフライ、牡蠣のグラタン、ラムステーキ、パンナコッタ、2人でワイン1本と約14,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); popular with visitors from abroad; book by phone or Instagram DM.

places.name: 麺喰金家 (Men Kui Kin Ya)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: handmade wheat udon and battered tempura and kushikatsu (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A February 2025 reviewer says the shop offers vegan options and English menus, but the standard broth is bonito and kombu dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Monday–Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday 11:30–15:40 and 18:00–19:40; closed Thursday and Friday. An October 2025 review instead gives 11:30–20:00 (last order 19:30), closed Monday (or the next day after a holiday). No reservations; queues at times (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). 15 seats (7 counter, two tables for 4); non-smoking (Tabelog). No cards; e-money and QR payments accepted (Tabelog). On a corner of the Miyagawacho tea-house streets, marked by a large lantern; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; April 2026).
places.neighborhood: Miyagawacho, south of Shijo east of the Kamo River — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Handmade udon: thin, flat, glossy "hirauchi" noodles of Kyoto wheat, made by the owner, in a clear bonito-and-kombu broth (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · kake udon ¥650 (June 2026) · tanuki udon ¥1,150 (August 2026) · Kujo negi tempura with cold udon set ¥1,300, raw egg +¥250 (October 2025) · kamo negi tempura udon, kama-tama udon · tempura à la carte, e.g. burdock or onion ¥180, chicken (kashiwa) tempura, eggplant tempura · tempura rice bowl with a large shrimp, chicken tempura bowl · tamago kake gohan · kushikatsu (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Udon · Miyagawacho, handmade flat udon by the tea houses] A small handmade-udon counter on a corner of Miyagawacho's tea-house streets, under a big lantern, five minutes from Gion-Shijo Stn. The owner makes the noodles: thin, flat and glossy, from Kyoto wheat, boiled to order and served in a clear bonito-and-kombu broth. Kake udon from ¥650; the Kujo negi tempura with cold udon (¥1,300) and the tempura bowls are the popular orders. Reviews split on the tempura — some find it light and crisp, an August 2026 diner found it greasy — but agree on the noodles. Many guests are visitors from abroad; English menu. Hours vary between sources; check before going.

roles: Owner, who researches and makes the noodles by hand (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog's introduction: the owner researches and makes the noodles by hand; tempura and kushikatsu are specialities; the shop sits in Miyagawacho among tea houses. An April 2025 reviewer saw the udon being made, to the delight of tourists.
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade flat udon; Kujo negi tempura.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 reviewer noted that 70–80% of the customers were from abroad and that the shop offers English menus and vegan options.
An August 2026 diner praised the flat Kyoto-wheat udon but found the tempura greasy and the chicken tough: "Just come for the udon."
An August 2026 visitor liked the burdock and onion tempura (¥180 each) so much with a little salt that it never went into the udon.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 麺喰金家、うどん、東山区博多町112-2、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月火水土日 11:30〜15:40・18:00〜19:40、木金休み、予約不可、15席 (カウンター7、4人テーブル2)、禁煙、カード不可、電子マネー・QR 可。店の紹介 (英訳): 店主が研究を重ねた手打ちの麺、天ぷらと串カツ、宮川町のお茶屋の並ぶ通り。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 京都の小麦の平打ち麺、かつおと昆布の澄んだ出汁、かけうどん650円、たぬきうどん1,150円、九条ねぎの天ぷらと冷やしうどんのセット1,300円、天丼、卵かけご飯、英語メニュー、ヴィーガン対応、海外からの客が多い、2025年10月の口コミでは11:30〜20:00 (L.O. 19:30)・月曜休み。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (February 2025); most guests are from abroad; no cards, but e-money and QR payments.

places.name: カフェ デ コラソン (cafe de corazon)
places.gf_detail: Ask. House-made tarts, cheesecake, cookies, parfaits, French toast and toast; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee suits, but the sweets use cream, cheese and eggs (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and the third Monday (Tabelog). No seat reservations, but cakes can be held (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog: payment changed to cash only; September 2026). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; one parking space (Tabelog; October 2026). Takeaway: coffee beans, baked goods, coffee jelly (Tabelog; September 2026). 8–9 min walk from Imadegawa Stn (2026 reviews). Opened 12 June 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishijin residential streets — 8 min walk from Imadegawa Stn
places.cuisine: Roastery café: about 20 house-roasted beans from light to dark, hand-picked to remove defects, brewed with care (September 2026) · single origins such as Guatemala SHB ¥880 (August 2026), Peru and Uganda; Italian blend; coffee from ¥930 and iced coffee ¥930 (October 2026); coffee soda, iced milk ¥750 · sweets by the owner's wife, a pastry chef: cheesecake ¥450, seasonal tarts, seasonal parfaits (white peach in summer), nougat glacé with plum ¥680, vanilla crescent cookies, coffee jelly (2026 reviews) · lunch such as toast and weekday French toast (September 2026)
places.notes: [Café · Nishijin, an eight-seat roastery counter] A counter café in a residential lane of Nishijin, opened in 2012 by Katsushi Kawaguchi, who trained and served as manager at the famed Cafe Bach in Tokyo's Minami-Senju, with the owner's wife, a pastry chef. About 20 house-roasted, hand-sorted beans are brewed to order; cakes, tarts and seasonal parfaits come from the wife's oven; seasonal paintings change on the walls. Coffee from about ¥930 (October 2026), cheesecake ¥450. Eight seats, no seat bookings, cash only. Closed Sunday and the third Monday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Katsushi Kawaguchi (romaji from a September 2026 review; the kanji is not in a source)
roles: Owner and roaster (September 2026 review: "The owner, Katsushi Kawaguchi, trained at ... Cafe Bach")
The owner's wife, a pastry chef, makes the sweets (September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per September 2026 reviews: the owner trained at Cafe Bach in Minami-Senju, Tokyo, and served as its manager; the owner's wife, originally from Kyoto and a pastry chef, makes the sweets; the café roasts on the same type of roaster as Cafe Bach. One September 2026 reviewer gives the founding of this shop as 2002; Tabelog gives the opening as 12 June 2012. An August 2026 reviewer mentions a second shop, cafe de corazon Nino, in Nijo. Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Hand-sorted house-roasted coffee; seasonal tarts and parfaits.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular (22 visits) noted the seasonal paintings on the walls — a Gion Matsuri float earlier, chrysanthemums for the Chōyō festival in September.
A September 2026 visitor bought the coffee jelly to take away; it separated before reaching the hotel but still tasted delicious.
An October 2026 diner found coffee from ¥930 a bit pricey but enjoyed it from a Wedgwood mug and a long chat with the owner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ デ コラソン (cafe de corazon)、カフェ、上京区革堂町593-15、今出川駅から604m、月〜土 10:00〜17:00、日曜と第3月曜休み、席の予約不可 (ケーキの取り置きは可)、現金のみに変更、カウンター8席、禁煙、駐車場1台、テイクアウト可、2012年6月12日オープン、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。公式サイト (cafe-de-corazon.com): 自家焙煎珈琲と手作りお菓子のお店、コーヒー豆とお菓子のオンラインショップ。口コミ (2026年、英語): 店主 Katsushi Kawaguchi は Minami-Senju の Cafe Bach で修業し店長も務めた、パティシエの奥さん、約20種の豆、ハンドピック、チーズケーキ450円、季節のタルトとパフェ、コーヒー930円から、二条に2号店 Nino。

places.name: SONGBIRD COFFEE
places.gf_detail: Ask. The signature curry comes with rice, fried onions and a soft-boiled egg, while the egg sandwiches use buttered bread; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature dishes are built on egg (the thick omelette sandwich, the curry's soft-boiled egg), with butter, cheese and chicken (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–18:30, last order 18:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; a wait at lunch (October 2026). 25 seats: a counter of single boxes, tables for 2, 4 and 6; non-smoking; children and prams welcome (Tabelog; October, November 2026). Cards, IC cards and QR payments (Tabelog). Egg sandwiches to take away (October 2026). Second floor of SONGBIRD DESIGN STORE, near Nijo Castle; 7–8 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 16 May 2009 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takeyamachi-dori east of Horikawa, near Nijo Castle — 8 min from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Café above a furniture and design shop, known for its curry and egg sandwich (2026 reviews) · SONGBIRD curry: rice moulded into a cylinder like a nest, topped with a soft-boiled egg and fried onions; fried-egg curry; cheese topping · egg sandwich with a hot, thick, fluffy omelette on buttered bread, with marinated carrots and yogurt ¥1,350; egg and tuna, egg and roast chicken sandwiches · half-and-half lunch (half curry, half egg sandwich) ¥1,650 · butter yokan, cheesecake · coffee from roasters around Japan, e.g. "Café Vivant Dimanche" of Kamakura: iced coffee ¥750–850; hojicha banana shake ¥900 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Café · Nijo Castle, curry and egg sandwiches above a design store] A café on the second floor of SONGBIRD DESIGN STORE near Nijo Castle, furnished with the studio's own furniture and goods (some for sale). The two dishes everyone orders are the SONGBIRD curry — a cylinder of rice crowned with a soft-boiled egg and crisp onions — and the hot, thick egg sandwich on buttered bread; the half-and-half lunch (¥1,650) gets both. Coffee comes from roasters around Japan; the hojicha banana shake is a big glass. Expect a short queue at lunch. Open 10:00–18:30, closed Thursday.

roles: Run with SONGBIRD DESIGN STORE, a Kyoto interior and furniture studio (Tabelog address; October 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: An October 2026 reviewer describes the café as designed by an interior designer and furnished with original furniture and décor; another notes that the company also runs a furniture store and sells some of the café's items. Tabelog gives the opening as 16 May 2009. Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: SONGBIRD curry; egg sandwich.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner rated the egg sandwich as good as the one at Yamamoto Kissa and bought a coaster and a sticker in the shop.
A November 2026 visitor sat in a single-person box at the counter and had an iced coffee from "Café Vivant Dimanche" of Kamakura (¥850), too big to finish, so half went into a takeaway cup.
An October 2026 regular compares the egg sandwich with those of "Maduragu" and "Tirol".

places.name: 錦 活鮨 (Nishiki Katsuzushi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Temari sushi with sauces and condiments, inari, tempura and red miso soup; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the sets are fish temari sushi with tempura and miso soup; a few pieces (lotus root, yuba, inari) are plant-based but come in mixed sets (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 (last order 15:00) and 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:00), every day (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). 20 seats: 16 at the counter facing the kitchen, one table for four; non-smoking; English menu; cards only, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Just off the Nishiki Market arcade; near Kyoto Kawaramachi and Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; April 2026).
places.neighborhood: Just off Nishiki Market — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Temari sushi — bite-size round sushi said to have been made for maiko — with seafood from Nishiki Market, and about 30 local sakes incl. a house sake from a Joyo brewery (Tabelog) · 12-piece temari sets, e.g. lotus root, yuba, mixed rice, sea bream, sea bass, flounder, cuttlefish, salmon, tuna, shrimp, inari and ikura, with 12 condiments to try; with three obanzai, three tempura or three sashimi, red miso soup, matcha parfait and tea; sushi lunch ¥3,600 (March–April 2026)
places.notes: [Temari sushi · Nishiki Market] A bright counter just off the Nishiki Market arcade, opened in 2025, serving temari sushi — small round pieces said to have been made for maiko — in sets of twelve with tempura or obanzai and miso soup (lunch about ¥3,600). Pretty and photogenic; reviewers split between delighted and underwhelmed by the taste and service. Open daily; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 January 2025 (Tabelog). Per the operator’s Tabelog text: a pioneer of the temari-sushi trend, with seafood from Nishiki Market and an original sake.
chef_bio.specialty: 12-piece temari sushi set.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner was surprised to find mostly Japanese customers rather than tourists, and noted the format may have changed recently.
A March 2026 evening diner found more than half the guests from overseas, the portions small, the taste unremarkable at over ¥3,000, and the staff unfriendly.
A May 2026 reviewer could not hear the softly spoken staff and noted dust on the counter bottles.
A family of four generations was completely satisfied — August 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask. French à la carte plus galettes and crêpes, canelés and spring rolls; no gluten information, and the galette flour is not described (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: charcuterie, duck, venison and lobster dishes, and crêpes with butter and cream (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 14:00–23:00 every day; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Bookings via TableCheck (September 2026); also used as a café for crêpes and galettes (May 2026). 8 counter seats facing a crêpe station, plus table seats upstairs by reservation; designated smoking area; cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). In an alley south of Shijo near Dango-bashi, toward Miyagawa-cho; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: An alley south of Shijo near Dango-bashi, toward Miyagawa-cho — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: French à la carte and courses with crêpes and galettes from a counter crêpe station; the chef has a pastry background (2025–26 reviews) · charcuterie platter, duck ham, crisp spring rolls, venison with crisp potatoes, a course with lobster · galette with blue cheese · crêpes: Calpis fermented butter and sugar; citron with lemon, butter and white pepper; seasonal strawberry or white peach; with fresh cream and house caramel · canelés (to take home with the course), bear-shaped monaka, house caramel ice cream · champagne by the glass and wines chosen to the dishes (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [French & crêpes · south of Shijo near Dango-bashi] A small French counter in a Gion back alley, opened in 2021, where a pastry-trained chef cooks bistro plates — charcuterie, duck ham, venison — and then makes crêpes and galettes at a station in front of you: lemon-butter-white-pepper citron, Calpis-butter sugar, seasonal fruit. Champagne by the glass; also good just for crêpes. Open 14:00–23:00; book on TableCheck.

roles: Chef ("Chef Sakane" in an August 2026 review); pastry background (August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 19 May 2021 (Tabelog). Per 2026 reviews: the chef comes from pastry, so the desserts are a strength, and a crêpe station sits at the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Crêpes and galettes; charcuterie.

anecdotes.text: A five-time visitor’s favourite is the crêpe with Calpis fermented butter and sugar — August 2026.
A December 2025 family birthday ended with canelés, a bear-shaped monaka and a strawberry crêpe, then a second, citron crêpe.
At the end of a March 2026 course the canelé was boxed to take home.

places.name: 亀屋清永 (Kameya Kiyonaga)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The signature seijō kankidan is a rice- and wheat-flour dough fried in sesame oil (an October 2026 review), and the shop lists wheat flour among its main ingredients (official notice); other sweets are bean paste and chestnut, with no ingredient list published.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Bean-paste and fried sweets such as the seijō kankidan may suit, but no ingredient list is published, and the dorayaki and kintsuba are not described (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 8:30–17:00; closed Wednesday and some other days — in November 2026 also the 12th and 19th (Thursdays) (official site). Tabelog gives 8:30–17:30. Takeaway shop; orders by phone or the online shop for delivery (official site). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On the south side of the stone steps below Yasaka Shrine — face the west gate and turn right without crossing Higashioji-dori (official site); 460 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Below the steps of Yasaka Shrine, Gion — 8 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto confectioner since 1617, supplier to many temples and shrines (official site) · seijō kankidan, a Tang-style "karakudamono" sweet from the Nara period: a drawstring-pouch shape of rice- and wheat-flour dough around bean paste scented with seven spices, fried in sesame oil (¥750 for one, ¥1,620 for two in October 2026) · buto (餢飳, a fried sweet) · Kyoto kintsuba 吟角 (¥518), 栗くり (¥205), dorayaki, seasonal jō-namagashi such as 山苞 (official site; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Gion, a confectioner since 1617] A Kyoto sweets house founded in 1617, now facing Yasaka Shrine's west gate, that has supplied temples and shrines for centuries. Its signature, the seijō kankidan, is a Nara-period Tang sweet — a hard, pouch-shaped dough of rice and wheat flour around spiced bean paste, fried in sesame oil (¥750 each). Also kintsuba, chestnut sweets and seasonal fresh sweets. Closed Wednesday and some Thursdays.

roles: Operator: 亀屋清永 (company); no person named
chef_bio.background: Per the official history page: founded, by tradition, in 1617 (Genna 3), living at Teramachi-Sanjo with the trade name 亀屋冶兵衛 before taking the name 亀屋清永; listed in 1842 among the confectioners supplying the Imperial Palace; the seijō kankidan descends from the Tang confections brought by envoys in the Nara period and is called the root of Kyoto sweets. Tabelog Japanese-sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026. In October–November 2026 the shop sold its seijō kankidan and buto at the 78th Shōsōin exhibition in Nara (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seijō kankidan; buto.

anecdotes.text: Plaques inside show supply to Chion-in, Yasaka Shrine, Enryaku-ji and Nanzen-ji — October 2026.
The staff suggested a freshly made dorayaki alongside the kankidan — October 2026.
At 16:00 on a Saturday the choice of fresh sweets was limited — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kameyakiyonaga.co.jp): 京御菓子司 亀屋清永、創業は元和3年 (1617年) と伝わる、寺町三条北入に住み当時の屋号は亀屋冶兵衛、のちに亀屋清永、天保13年 (1842年) の御所巻物、清浄歓喜団は奈良時代に遣唐使が伝えた唐菓子で京菓子のルーツ、多くの寺社仏閣の御用達、本店は八坂神社西楼門の前 (東山区祇園石段下南)、8:30〜17:00、毎週水曜定休 (その他不定休、2026年11月は4・11・12・18・19・25日)、清浄歓喜団と餢飳、京きんつば「吟角」、栗くり、季節の和菓子、オンラインショップ、主原料は砂糖・小豆・小麦粉・ごま油 (2024年の価格改定のお知らせ)、第78回正倉院展での特別販売。食べログ: 和菓子、祇園石段下南側534、月火木〜日 8:30〜17:30、水曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): 清浄歓喜団1個750円・2個1,620円、吟角518円、栗くり205円、どら焼き、寺社の御用達の札。

cultural_comfort.note: Small shop counter; staff suggest sweets; cards accepted.

places.name: 恒屋伝助 (Tsune Ya Densuke)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Over a hundred à la carte dishes — sashimi, grilled fish, saba sushi, tempura, fried conger and whale, miso dengaku, bear hot pot; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the menu centres on seasonal fish, wagyu and bear, with dashi-based cooking (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 17:30–22:30; closed Sunday and twice more a month — in November 2026 the Thursdays and Sundays plus the 23rd (official site). Tabelog gives 17:00–22:30, closed Thursday and Sunday. Bookings by phone; popular, so book early (official site; September 2026). The menu shows no prices; bills about ¥10,000–20,000 a head (2026 reviews). No children under junior-high age (Tabelog). 14 seats: 5 at the counter, tables and one private room with a sunken kotatsu; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners only (Tabelog; April 2026). On the corner of Sakaimachi and Nijo; 7 min from Marutamachi or Karasuma Oike Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi-Nijo corner, south of the Imperial Palace — 7 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Kappo izakaya with no courses: over a hundred à la carte dishes of seasonal fish and vegetables, traditional kappo and creative plates (official site) · the signature sashimi platter (bone crackers and fish-bone red miso soup sometimes follow) · grilled shirokuji (white amadai), charcoal-grilled wagyu, thick saba sushi (to take away with a day’s notice), bear hot pot, bear stewed with sansho in spring (official site; 2026 reviews) · hamo shabu with matsutake and porridge, fried conger, fried whale, Kamo eggplant dengaku, white shrimp, gratin, noodles to finish · seasonal sake (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo izakaya · south of the Imperial Palace, a hundred dishes and bear hot pot] A small izakaya on a quiet corner near the palace, open about 25 years, with no set courses: pick from over a hundred seasonal dishes — a famous sashimi platter, shirokuji, thick saba sushi, hamo shabu, and its rare bear hot pot. No prices on the menu; expect ¥10,000–20,000 with sake. Book ahead. No children under junior-high age. Closed Sunday and some Thursdays.

roles: Owner (unnamed; the official site says the owner chooses the ingredients)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: in its 25th year, with the owner choosing seasonal fish and vegetables; all dishes à la carte, from traditional kappo to creative cooking; the website opened in June 2025. Tabelog Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "自分の好きなものを好きなだけ食べていただきたい" — eat what you like, as much as you like.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; bear hot pot; saba sushi.

anecdotes.text: Wanting sake, a July 2026 guest had the sashimi platter cut from ten kinds to five by the owner; the bill came to about ¥15,000 as expected.
After the sashimi, a fish-bone cracker and red miso soup from the bones arrived unasked — September 2026.
A September 2026 diner was nervous at the counter because the menu shows no prices.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tsuneyadensuke.com): 京都の本格割烹居酒屋 恒屋伝助、創業25年、店主が四季の魚介や野菜を厳選、コースではなく全て一品料理、百を超す逸品、白ぐじ焼、和牛炭火焼き、鯖寿司 (持ち帰りは前日までに予約)、熊鍋、造り盛り合わせ、中京区観音町84 堺町二条の角、丸太町駅・烏丸御池駅から徒歩約7分、月〜土 17:30〜22:30、日曜定休、月二回不定休、2026年11月の休み (1・5・8・12・15・19・23・26・29日)。食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・日本料理、月火水金土 17:00〜22:30、木・日休み、中学生未満入店不可、14席 (カウンター5、テーブル10)、個室、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2024。口コミ (2026年4〜9月、英語): 値段の書かれていないメニュー、刺身盛り合わせ、熊肉と花山椒、鱧しゃぶと松茸、鯨の唐揚げ、賀茂なすの田楽、鯖寿司。

cultural_comfort.note: No prices on the menu, so ask; book by phone; JCB, AMEX or Diners only.

places.name: 鮨 おび乃 (Sushi Obino)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae sushi with soy-brushed nigiri, small dishes with miso and egg-yolk vinegar, and a soup; no gluten information is published (official site; 2022–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses only (official site).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–21:00, last entry 19:30; closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog lists every day 17:00–21:00). Bookings via the web or by email; the courses no longer start all at once — come at any time (official site). Lunch teyui-zushi is described on the official site; no lunch hours are given. 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards; children welcome, with a children’s menu; tell the shop ahead about a stroller (Tabelog; official site). At the back of the 若葉ビル on the east side of Tomikoji north of Nishiki (south of Takoyakushi); 7 min from Shijo Stn, 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (official site). Opened 1 October 2020 (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Tomikoji-dori north of Nishiki — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Edomae sushi counter with sake and wine chosen by the owner, a sommelier (official site; reviews) · young-artisan course ¥6,000 (3 small dishes, 12 nigiri, soup), made for first-timers, younger guests and visitors from abroad; head chef’s course ¥12,000 (15 items) or ¥17,000 (20 items) (official site) · lunch 手結寿司 (teyui-zushi) ¥4,800: 10 toppings and 10–15 balls of rice to wrap in Ariake nori toasted yourself over a charcoal shichirin, 3 small dishes and miso soup (official site) · fish chosen with a partner wholesaler at the central market, by season rather than brand (official site) · over 10 sakes served at chosen temperatures and in chosen vessels; red wine recommended with sushi; sake pairings (official site; 2022–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Tomikoji-Nishiki, counter sushi made approachable] An eight-seat Edomae counter at the back of a building on Tomikoji just north of Nishiki, opened in 2020 and reworked in 2023 to make counter sushi easier for younger and overseas guests: a ¥6,000 course by its young artisans, the head chef's course from ¥12,000, and no fixed start time. The owner is a sommelier and pairs sake — served at chosen temperatures — or, unusually, red wine with the sushi. The official site also describes a teyui-zushi lunch of hand-rolls you assemble, toasting the nori over charcoal (¥4,800). Booking advised.

roles: Owner-sommelier (2022 reviews; official site: ソムリエ) and a head chef (大将), with young artisans for the ¥6,000 course (official site); no names on the site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in October 2020 during the pandemic; from September 2023 the single omakase with a simultaneous start was replaced by more affordable courses at any time, including a ¥6,000 course made by a different artisan from the head chef, to pass on counter-sushi culture to younger and overseas guests; young or less experienced staff are hired as sushi artisans; fish is bought through a partner wholesaler. An October 2022 review names the chef then as Mr. Kosakai, of the Sushi Masuda line; a March 2023 review links the shop to the Sukiyabashi Jiro and Sushi Masuda lineage.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "もっとカウンター鮨を多くの方に知っていただきたい" — to make counter sushi known to more people, with some tension but no stiffness.
chef_bio.specialty: Edomae nigiri with sake or red-wine pairing; teyui-zushi lunch.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor who added the wine pairing found the chef explaining the origins of each sake and sushi in detail.
A November 2023 visitor booked the young-artisan course on TableCheck and noticed many foreign customers.
A March 2023 visitor was surprised to be served red wine with the stronger-flavoured pieces.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sushi-ovino.com): 鮨 おび乃、2020年10月オープン、2023年9月から「お任せコース1本」「一斉スタート」をやめ、好きな時間に来店可能に、若い世代や海外の方にカウンター鮨を、若手コース6,000円 (小鉢3品、鮨12貫、椀物)、大将コース 15品12,000円・20品17,000円、昼 手結寿司 TEYUI-SUSHI 4,800円 (小鉢3品、鮨ネタ10品、シャリ10〜15貫、有明海苔15枚を七輪で自分で炙る、お味噌汁)、中央市場の魚卸問屋と提携、日本酒は常時10種類以上、鮨には赤ワインを推奨、京都市中京区高宮町585 若葉ビル1階奥、富小路通り錦上ル (蛸薬師下ル) 東側、営業時間17〜21時 (最終入店19時30分)、不定休、カウンター8席、カード可。食べログ: 寿司・日本料理、8席、禁煙、子供可・お子様メニューあり、2020年10月1日オープン。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): ソムリエのオーナー、日本酒と赤ワインのペアリング、2022年は Kosakai 大将 (Sushi Masuda 系)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; the ¥6,000 course is pitched at first-timers and overseas guests; English site available.

places.name: CLAY POT CURRY OHMIYA
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: a European-style curry roux with demi-glace, breaded pork cutlet and fried toppings (official site); no gluten information is published.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the curry sauce starts from a bouillon made over a day, and every curry on the menu carries meat or seafood (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (to 15:30 at weekends and holidays) and dinner 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:30); closed irregularly; may close early when ingredients run out (official site; Tabelog). Bookings taken; late arrivals may lose the table (Tabelog); booking advised at weekends (April 2026). Order by QR code: curry, spice level, rice size and toppings (September 2026). 16–17 seats: counter and small tables (Tabelog; official site); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; takeaway and delivery; menu in English, Chinese and Korean; children welcome, with a children’s curry (Tabelog; official site). On the 2nd floor of the 辨天堂ビル on the Shinkyogoku arcade south of Rokkaku, with a lift; 5 min from exit 9 of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (official site; Tabelog). Opened here 11 August 2023 after 14 years at Marutamachi (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinkyogoku arcade south of Rokkaku — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: European-style curry served bubbling in a clay pot: a bouillon simmered a day, house-blended and roasted curry powder, and a sauce cooked two days with fruit and red wine (official site) · beef rib simmered in demi-glace curry ¥1,650 (the most popular) · Kyoto-beef (京の肉, Kameoka Kuroge wagyu) curry braised in red wine ¥2,200 · Tanba Kogen pork loin cutlet curry ¥1,550 · six-hour simmered pork and onsen egg curry ¥1,550 · head-on prawn and scallop fry curry ¥1,450 · Kyoto pork keema ¥1,450 · 100% domestic pork hamburg curry ¥1,800 · house curry ¥1,000 (official site) · toppings such as fried onions, crab cream croquette, soft-boiled egg; spice from medium up (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Curry · Shinkyogoku, European curry bubbling in clay pots] A second-floor curry shop on the Shinkyogoku arcade that moved here in 2023 after 14 years at Marutamachi (once known as 近江屋清右衛門), sister to SOUP CURRY OHMIYA. The curry — a day-long bouillon, house-roasted curry powder and two days of simmering with fruit and red wine — arrives still bubbling in a clay pot. The beef rib in demi-glace (¥1,650) is the one everyone orders; Kyoto-beef, Tanba Kogen pork cutlet and keema are the local-ingredient options. Order by QR code; a September 2026 visitor saw one chef and one staff member at work, so book at weekends.

roles: Owner (unnamed; the official site says the owner chose the Kyoto beef personally); one chef and one staff member on a September 2026 visit
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a European-style curry specialist that ran for 14 years at Marutamachi before moving to Shinkyogoku; former name 欧風土鍋カレー近江屋清右衛門 (Tabelog); the sister shop is SOUP CURRY OHMIYA (in data as kyoto_soup_curry_ohmiya); for the beef curry the owner ate around Kyoto’s beef and chose certified 京の肉 from Kyoto Tanba-Kameoka. The invoice number on Tabelog is T3130001077204.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a handmade curry that takes a day for the bouillon and two days for the sauce.
chef_bio.specialty: Beef rib demi-glace curry; Kyoto-beef curry.

anecdotes.text: "The curry was bubbling in a hot pot, so much so that the ingredients were hidden from view." — April 2026.
An April 2026 diner found the place more popular with foreign tourists than locals and advised booking at weekends.
A September 2026 visitor found the toppings made the meal quite pricey.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (claypotcurryohmiya.com): 14年間丸太町で営業した後、新京極に移転した欧風カレー専門店、1日かけて作るブイヨン、ブレンド・焙煎したカレー粉、2日間フルーツや赤ワインを加えながら炊き上げる、牛バラ肉のデミグラス煮込みカレー1,650円、丹波高原豚のロースカツカレー1,550円、京の肉のビーフカレー2,200円 (京都丹波・亀岡産の黒毛和牛、オーナー自ら食べ歩いて選んだ)、自家製カレー1,000円、6時間煮込んだ煮豚と温玉のカレー1,550円、有頭エビと貝柱フライのカレー1,450円、京都ぽーくのキーマカレー1,450円、国産豚100%のハンバーグカレー1,800円、お子様向けカレー、テイクアウト・デリバリー可、姉妹店 SOUP CURRY OHMIYA、中京区桜之町438-1 辨天堂ビル2F、昼11:30〜15:00 (土日祝は15:30)、夜17:30〜21:00 (LO 20:30)、不定休、17席。食べログ: カレー・洋食、旧店名 欧風土鍋カレー近江屋清右衛門、16席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、2023年8月11日オープン、インボイス T3130001077204。口コミ (2026年3〜11月、英語): 土鍋でぐつぐつ、牛バラ肉、QR コードで注文、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code (English, Chinese and Korean menus); book at weekends.

places.gf_detail: Ask. The shop’s allergen list says its dishes may contain wheat, milk, soy, cashew, beef, pork and chicken — ask staff which (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A bean-and-vegetable curry (¥1,000) is on the regular menu, but the allergen list includes milk and the curry bases are not described (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 and dinner 17:00–20:30 (last order 20:00) on weekdays; lunch only on Saturday and holidays; closed Sunday and irregularly (official site; Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). A queue forms at lunch, with orders taken in line (October 2026); evenings are quieter (October 2026). Children under junior-high age not admitted, as the curry is fairly spicy (official site). Takeaway curry +¥100 for the container, ordered by phone 11:00–19:30 (official site). 21 seats; non-smoking; cards, QR and transit IC (Tabelog; official site). On Shinmachi-dori north of Marutamachi, south of the prefectural office; 4 min from exit 2 of Marutamachi Stn (official site). Opened 3 March 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi-dori north of Marutamachi — 4 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Spice curry built on layered original spice blends — "香る旨味", fragrant umami (official site) · regular curries: chicken ¥1,100, pork ¥1,100, butter chicken ¥1,250, beef ¥1,500, keema ¥1,100, beans and vegetables ¥1,000; toppings: spice egg ¥150, raw egg ¥70, coriander ¥150; salads ¥300; lassi ¥350, mango lassi ¥400 (official menu) · a monthly curry: oyster curry ¥1,800 in October–November 2026, mushroom curry in September 2026 (official site; 2026 reviews) · lunch set with a mini salad and mini mango lassi for +¥50; spice levels from +1 upward, chilli powder on the table (2026 reviews) · beer and highballs (official menu)
places.notes: [Curry · Marutamachi, layered spice curry with a monthly special] A small spice-curry shop on Shinmachi-dori just north of Marutamachi, opened in 2015 and on Tabelog's Curry WEST 100 list in 2023, 2024 and 2026. The curries are thin and fragrant from layered house spice blends: chicken, butter chicken, keema, beans and vegetables — plus a monthly special (oysters in a coconut-scented sauce, ¥1,800, in October–November 2026). Add a spice egg, and the ¥50 lunch upgrade of salad and mango lassi. Expect a line at lunch, quieter evenings. No children under junior-high age. Closed Sunday; Saturday lunch only.

roles: No person is named on the site (its recruitment page is hosted by atcompany)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 March 2015 (Tabelog). A November 2026 regular has come for nearly ten years. Tabelog Curry WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023, 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "オリジナルスパイスを重ねて作り出す『香る旨味』" — fragrant umami from layered original spices, with care in every ingredient and step.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken curry; butter chicken; the monthly curry.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a 15th visit found ten people in line just after noon; staff took orders in the queue and the wait was about ten minutes.
An October 2026 diner in a white top was offered a paper apron.
An October 2026 diner thought the dishes could be served warmer, "but that’s a minor detail".

places.neighborhood: Higashioji-dori north of Marutamachi, opposite Kyoto University Hospital — 2 min from the Kumano-jinja-mae bus stop
places.cuisine: A Kyoto curry counter since 1975: smooth European-style curry over turmeric rice, choose the sauce — beef (sweet, medium or spicy), chicken or vegetable — and have it plain or with a cutlet (2024–26 reviews) · curry ¥950 and katsu curry ¥1,200 (September 2026); another October 2026 diner paid ¥880 for beef curry plus ¥170 for a large; chicken katsu curry; the pork cutlet thin and fried in front of you (2026 reviews) · "medium" is already fairly hot (October 2026)
places.notes: [Curry · Kumano-jinja, a 1975 katsu-curry counter] An eight-seat curry counter on Higashioji-dori opposite Kyoto University Hospital, serving since 1975. Pick the sauce — beef from sweet to spicy, chicken or vegetable — over turmeric rice, plain or with a thin cutlet fried to order (katsu curry ¥1,200 in September 2026). Even 'medium' has a kick. A line forms at opening and at lunch, but it moves fast. Cash only; no photos inside. Closed Friday and Saturday.

roles: No person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per October 2026 reviews: founded in 1975, over 50 years in business; one reviewer heard that a famous actress once worked there. Tabelog Curry WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023, 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Katsu curry; beef curry three ways; vegetable curry.

A September 2026 diner praised the staff’s attitude and service.

places.gf_detail: Ask. The soba is juwari (100% buckwheat) per 2026 reviews, but the dipping sauce is soy-based, the tempura uses batter, and no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba sauce and broth are dashi-based, and the snacks include duck, firefly squid, shrimp and dashimaki (2026 reviews).

places.neighborhood: Alley off Yamato-oji, east of Shijo Ohashi — 2 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Soba and sake for adults (2026 reviews) · very thin juwari soba: seiro, soba with wasabi miso, seasonal cold soba with fresh yuba and grilled eggplant or with sudachi, sesame dipping soba, kitsune soba, new-crop soba in season · snacks with drinks: dashimaki, sobagaki, oboro tofu, grilled duck, "duck kitsune" (minced duck in fried tofu), duck and green onion, simmered eggplant · tempura: firefly squid from Toyama, sakura shrimp, young ayu, natural sweet shrimp, tara-no-me, fuki-no-tō · omakase appetizers ¥5,500 · sake and soba shochu (2026 reviews; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Soba · Gion, juwari soba for drinkers] A 10-seat soba bar at the end of a dead-end alley just over Shijo Ohashi, where very thin juwari soba comes after sake and snacks: sobagaki, grilled duck, dashimaki, and seasonal tempura such as firefly squid. Mind the rules: adults only, a drink per person after 14:00, snacks only with drinks, and no photos. Reviewers love the soba and find the mood a little strict. Cash only; closed Thursday, Wednesday until 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a dignified, slightly tense atmosphere set by the owner (March 2026), service that is polite but a little distant (March and July 2026), and the chef thanking guests from the back (July 2026). The house rules — adults only, drinks with snacks, no photography — are recorded on Tabelog and in reviews.
chef_bio.specialty: Juwari soba; duck dishes; seasonal tempura.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner who ordered oolong tea was told the dashimaki is a side dish for alcohol, served only to those who order drinks.
A May 2026 diner found the photo rule unclear and the service unfriendly, while praising the soba and sakura shrimp tempura.

Reservations accepted; seat-only bookings may be asked to settle within 90 minutes when busy (Tabelog); often fully booked at night (2026 reviews).
