Weekend lunch sets about ¥1,200 (September 2026). 50 seats including a counter, tables, sofas and a terrace; non-smoking inside with a smoking area; cards, IC cards, iD and QUICPay; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Loud and lively (October 2026). On a corner of 御幸町通 south of Takoyakushi, 6 min from Exit 9 of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; April 2026).
places.neighborhood: 御幸町通 south of Takoyakushi — 6 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Chinese izakaya styled on a Taiwanese night market, cooked by a chef of 30 years (Tabelog, shop text) · saliva chicken, bang bang chicken, mapo tofu, Sichuan shrimp chili with mushrooms, shrimp mayo fried in the shell, twice-cooked pork, black-vinegar pork, drunken shrimp, beef with green peppers (2026 reviews) · dim sum: xiaolongbao, shumai, pan-fried dumplings · dan dan noodles, lu rou fan, char siu fried rice, tenshin rice · Tsingtao and Taiwanese fruit beers, Taiwanese spirits (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · weekend lunch sets with dim sum and soup, e.g. sweet-and-sour pork, about ¥1,200 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Chinese izakaya · Kawaramachi, a Taiwanese night market indoors] A loud, cheerful corner izakaya done up like a Taiwanese night market, popular with students and tourists. The kitchen, led by a chef of 30 years, turns out saliva chicken, mapo tofu, a Sichuan shrimp chili, xiaolongbao that burst with soup and twice-cooked pork, with Taiwanese beers and free-flow drinks. Weekend lunch sets run about ¥1,200. One April 2026 diner reported rude, pushy service; most others found staff friendly. Book for evenings; ¥250 starter.

roles: Head chef with 30 years in Chinese cooking (Tabelog, shop text; unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): authentic Chinese cooking by a veteran chef of 30 years, with a menu supervised, per the shop, by a grand-student of Chen Jianmin, in the lively mood of a night market; signature yodare chicken, mapo tofu and Sichuan shrimp chili. Run by a company (a corporate invoice registrant, Tabelog). A 2019 Walkerplus article describes a shop of the same name in a SAKURA building on Kiyamachi-dori.
chef_bio.specialty: Saliva chicken; mapo tofu; xiaolongbao.

anecdotes.text: "Despite the restaurant being nearly empty with plenty of available seats, I was seated at a cold table right by the entrance (with the door wide open). In contrast, other customers who seemed to be part-time staff were shown to the cozy sofa seats in the back, which made me feel quite uneasy about the obvious disparity in treatment." — April 2026.

An April 2026 diner had a bad experience: pressured by a staff member for not ordering signature dishes, seated at a cold table by the open door while others were free, and plates cleared too quickly.
An October 2026 diner with a 19:30 booking was told the Tabelog coupon applied only to guests arriving by 18:30.
"The complimentary shrimp chips are also available for refills and are absolutely delicious." — April 2026.

places.name: デザートカフェ長楽館 (Dessert Cafe Chourakukan)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: afternoon tea with scones and pastries, tarts, millefeuille, galette des rois, sandwiches and a beef katsu sandwich (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream-and-butter pastries, parfaits and meat sandwiches (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–18:30 (last order 18:00) daily; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Café seats first come, first served, with some days reserved; weekday walk-ins usually fine (January and November 2026). Afternoon tea 12:00–18:00 by reservation only, for two or more (Tabelog); booked via TableCheck (September 2026). 10% service charge (Tabelog). 100 seats in several period rooms; private rooms for a fee; non-smoking with an outdoor smoking area; cards; parking for 10 cars (Tabelog). Popular parfaits can sell out (October 2026). Up the slope east of Yasaka Shrine, by Maruyama Park; 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Maruyama Park, east of Yasaka Shrine — 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Café in the Chourakukan, a Western-style mansion built in 1909 (2026 reviews) · seasonal afternoon tea ¥6,500 (September 2026), e.g. fig and tea in autumn, with savouries, sweets and scones on Herend china and a choice of teas (October 2026) · seasonal fig parfait, shine muscat tart, millefeuille and the modern-tile tart in cake sets; galette des rois in January · mixed sandwich and beef fillet katsu sandwich · Chourakukan blend tea, royal milk tea, coffee (2026 reviews) · souvenirs such as a cigarette-shaped pie (October 2026)
places.notes: [Café · Maruyama Park, tea in a Meiji mansion] The café of the Chourakukan, a stone Western-style mansion of 1909 beside Maruyama Park, built as a guest house by a tobacco magnate. Each room has its own style — stained glass, heavy furniture, Art Nouveau touches — and the seasonal afternoon tea (¥6,500, booked ahead) comes on Herend china; without a booking, a café seat gets you a fig parfait, a shine muscat tart or a beef katsu sandwich. Add 10% service. Open daily 11:00–18:30.

roles: Café in a historic building; no staff named
chef_bio.background: Per reviewers in 2026: the Chourakukan was built in 1909 (late Meiji) as a guest house by a businessman who made a fortune in tobacco, and the design includes light and smoke motifs. Reviewers disagree on its status — one (August 2026) calls it a tangible cultural property of Kyoto, another (September 2026) an important cultural property of the country. Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal afternoon tea; fig parfait.

anecdotes.text: "If I had to be picky, I would have preferred the scones to be a bit warmer, as they were only slightly warm." — October 2026.
An October 2026 visitor found the seasonal fig parfait and the modern-tile tart sold out and settled for the house blend tea.
An October 2026 visitor heard from a taxi driver that the house belonged to someone who succeeded in tobacco, and noticed light and smoke in the design.

places.name: かさぎ屋 (Kasagiya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Ohagi, Kameyama, zenzai and kakigori are made from mochi rice, beans and sugar and may be wheat-free, but no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Bean-and-rice sweets are plant-based in principle, but the shiruko shake and milk kakigori use dairy and no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00 daily; hours and closed days may change (Tabelog). No reservations; cash only (Tabelog; September 2026). One order per person (September 2026). Free sencha in a pot, refilled on request (2026 reviews). A short queue is common; turnover is quick (September 2026). Tabelog gives 20 seats; 2026 reviewers describe a small room of about five seats. Non-smoking (Tabelog). Halfway up Ninenzaka on the way from Kiyomizu-dera to Yasaka Shrine (2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Ninenzaka, below Kiyomizu-dera — on the walk to Yasaka Shrine
places.cuisine: Old sweet shop, founded in 1914 per an October 2026 review (2026 reviews) · three-colour ohagi (red bean, smooth bean paste, white bean or kinako in summer, or matcha) ¥900 (October 2026) · Kameyama: steamed whole red beans with grilled mochi and no soup, with pickles · Kyoto-style zenzai with two small mochi, iso-maki · kakigori: Uji Kintoki with shiratama, ice Uji shiratama · shiruko shake · usucha with a small ohagi (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sweet shop · Ninenzaka, ohagi and Kameyama since 1914] A small, old sweet shop halfway up Ninenzaka, Taisho and Showa in feel, said to have been a favourite of the artist Yumeji Takehisa. Order the three-colour ohagi (¥900) — big, soft mochi rice under whole red beans, smooth bean paste and kinako or white bean — or Kameyama, a soupless bowl of fluffy steamed beans over grilled mochi; summer brings Uji Kintoki kakigori. Free sencha by the pot. One order each; cash only. Daily 10:00–17:00.

roles: Long-established sweet shop; no one is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: An October 2026 reviewer gives the founding year as 1914; a September 2026 reviewer calls it over 100 years old on Ninenzaka; a November 2026 reviewer says it was a favourite of the artist Yumeji Takehisa. A September 2026 reviewer found the service a little cool but proper. Tabelog Japanese sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Three-colour ohagi; Kameyama.

anecdotes.text: "In Kansai, there are three types of "zenzai." … the third is "Kameyama," which is made with chunky red beans but without soup!" — November 2026.
"The service may seem a bit cold, but it was actually quite proper, so that’s a plus." — September 2026.
A September 2026 visitor was third in line and seated within about 10 minutes, with free sencha refills.

places.name: 河道屋銀華 (Kawamichiya Ginka)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: soba served in a soy-and-bonito broth (a strong bonito dashi, September 2026), with tempura and thick-sauce bowls on the menu; no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is a strong bonito dashi (September 2026), and the menu centres on herring, duck, chicken and tempura soba.
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 11:30–24:00 (last order 23:30), closed Wednesday; the official Pontocho page also says the shop opens from 17:00 to suit the evening street, and an October 2026 diner noted it now closes around midnight rather than later. No reservations (Tabelog). Prices revised from November 2025 (official site). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) with a 5% charge, and QR payments (Tabelog). 20 seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog). A little west of Pontocho Park, midway along Pontocho (official site).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, just west of Pontocho Park — 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Old Kyoto soba house open to midnight, a favourite last stop after drinks (official site; reviews) · nishin (herring) soba and a herring set meal ¥1,980 (January 2026), kake soba ¥880 (September 2026), tempura soba with two shrimp ¥2,000 (October 2026), duck nanban with Kujo leek, tori-nanba, tanuki, oroshi soba with grated daikon in a thick sauce, spicy-daikon soba, tororo zaru, itawasa · soba-yu after the noodles · sake by the 180 ml (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Soba · Pontocho, since 1902, open till midnight] An old-fashioned soba shop just off Pontocho Park, one of three houses that branched from 総本家河道屋 in 1902: herring soba, duck nanban with Kujo leek, tempura soba and grated-daikon soba in a rich bonito broth, with green onions served on the side. Kake soba ¥880, tempura soba ¥2,000 (2026). Run by father and son, per a September 2026 diner. 11:30–24:00, closed Wednesday; no bookings; smoking allowed.

roles: Family owners (unnamed): the current head and a son, per a September 2026 review
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (2017 page): Kawamichiya Ginka branched from 総本家河道屋 in 1902 (Meiji 35); the head house had three daughters, who married craftsmen trained at Kawamichiya and were given the house names 金華, 銀華 and 銅華 to branch out. Ginka first ran a soba shop at Kiyamachi-Sanjo; in the second generation it closed during the Pacific War, and the third generation reopened it at the present site on Pontocho. A September 2026 diner understood the current owner to be the fourth generation, with a son working alongside, and noted green onions served on a separate plate, appreciated by overseas guests; a February 2026 diner described a quite elderly owner.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: aiming for a taste found only in this shop, unchanged since the founding.
chef_bio.specialty: Nishin soba; duck nanban; tempura soba.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner on a ninth dinner of the day overheard the son chatting with the father over a staff meal, and found the bonito dashi "incredibly rich".
A January 2026 diner liked the broth but found the portion of noodles "way too small", at a tourist price.
A March 2026 diner from the Kanto region found the dashi lacking and the famous herring less impressive than hoped.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ginka.biz): 京都、先斗町のそば処 河道屋銀華、創業明治35年、今も変わらぬ味、この店でしか味わえない味を目指す、2025年11月から価格改定、中京区下樵木町192-3、11:30〜24:00 (23:30 ラストオーダー)、水曜定休、先斗町公園から少し西に入った場所、午後五時からの営業 (先斗町本店のページ)、北大路ビブレ店にランチの定食 (サイトの説明文)。河道屋銀華とは (2017年): 1902年 (明治35年) に「総本家河道屋」より分家、本家の3人の娘さんが河道屋で修行した職人を婿養子にし、長女は「金華」、次女は「銀華」、三女は「銅華」の屋号で分家、創業当時は木屋町三条、二代目の時代に太平洋戦争の影響で休業、三代目が先斗町で再開。食べログ: そば、予約不可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)・QR 可、カードは5%の手数料、20席、喫煙可。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): にしん定食1,980円、かけそば880円、天ぷらそば2,000円、鴨なんば、鳥なんば、とろろざる、からみ大根そば、そば湯、四代目と息子さん、ネギは別皿。

cultural_comfort.note: A simple soba menu; green onions come on a separate plate, appreciated by overseas guests (September 2026); no bookings.

places.name: 壹錢洋食 本店 (Issen Yoshoku Honten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the one dish is a wheat-flour batter mixed with dashi, cooked with tenkasu (tempura bits) and finished with sauce (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the batter is made with dashi and topped with bonito flakes, eggs, chikuwa and domestic wagyu (official site). Tabelog’s "vegetarian options" tag is not borne out by the official recipe.
places.hours_raw: Official site: Gion honten open every day — weekdays 11:00–1:00, Saturdays and days before holidays 11:00–3:00, Sundays and holidays 10:30–22:00; Tabelog gives Friday and Saturday to 3:00. No reservations (Tabelog). One main dish only, the Issen Yoshoku, ¥950 with a choice of sweet, normal (sweet-and-spicy) or spicy sauce (official menu). 100 seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Takeaway, a counter in Takashimaya Kyoto B1F, and mail order (official site). At the corner of Shijo and Nawate, beside the police box; 1 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Nawate, the gateway to Gion — 1 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion’s one-dish shop for issen yoshoku, the folded flour-pancake ancestor of okonomiyaki (official site) · Issen Yoshoku ¥950: dashi batter spread thin, bonito flakes, Kujo leek, two eggs, tenkasu, pickled ginger, seasoned konnyaku, sliced chikuwa and domestic wagyu, folded and sauced — normal (spicy inside, sweet outside), sweet or spicy; shredded nori instead of aonori (official site) · draft Premium Malt’s ¥800, highballs from ¥600, Denki Bran ¥600, sake ¥800–1,000, hiyashi-ame and ramune at the honten only (official menu) · matcha anmitsu jelly to take away ¥800
places.notes: [Issen yoshoku · Shijo-Nawate, Gion's late-night snack] The 100-seat Gion shop that revived issen yoshoku, the pre-war flour snack seen as okonomiyaki's ancestor: a thin dashi batter folded over Kujo leek, egg, konnyaku, chikuwa and wagyu, sauced sweet, normal or spicy — the only dish, ¥950. Inside, tongue-in-cheek risqué ema, figures and kimono-clad mannequins at the tables play on the old pleasure quarter. Open daily from 11:00 to 1:00 (3:00 on Saturdays and days before holidays); a counter in Takashimaya and mail order too.

roles: 株式会社壹錢洋食 (founding president 木下辰雄, per the official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: issen yoshoku faded in the late Showa era as modern okonomiyaki took over; the company’s first president, 木下辰雄, set out to revive it and make it better, choosing Kujo leek, egg and domestic wagyu, working on the seasoned konnyaku, dashi and sauce, and using shredded nori so that it would not cling to the teeth. It was first sold in a small shop by the Shirakawa in Gion, popular with maiko, geiko and entertainers, then moved to the larger shop at Shijo-Nawate, where the playful decor — saucy ema and figures satirising love in the pleasure quarter — became a sight in itself; mail order on Rakuten from April 2011. The site lists two shops today, the Gion honten and Takashimaya Kyoto, and sales at Mitsui Outlet Park Shiga Ryuo. Okonomiyaki "Tabelog 100" 2018.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "that nostalgic taste once more — and even better."
chef_bio.specialty: Issen Yoshoku (one dish only).

anecdotes.text: "Interestingly, I was seated at the same table as a mannequin." — October 2026; the price is now ¥950.
An August 2026 diner remembered it at ¥600–700 and found ¥950 steep for a dish that was once a cheap snack.
"We will prepare the Issen for you," without any hesitation — there is only one dish (October 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (issen-yosyoku.co.jp): 京都祗園名物「壹錢洋食」、お好み焼きのルーツとなった粉もの焼きの元祖、初代社長の木下辰雄が九条ネギ・卵・国産和牛を吟味し、こんにゃくの味付け、出汁、ソース、焼き方を試行錯誤、京風の上品さ、青海苔ではなく刻み海苔、祇園の白川沿いの小さな店から四条通縄手の大きな店へ、舞妓さん芸妓さん芸能人も、色街の洒落をきかせた店内 (お色気あふれる絵馬や招ね金さん)、2011年4月から楽天で通販、作り方: お出汁で溶いた小麦粉、かつおぶし、九条ネギ、玉子Sサイズ2個、天カス、紅ショウガ、味付けこんにゃく、ちくわ、国産和牛、ふつう味は中に辛いソース・外に甘いソース、あま味・から味も、壹錢洋食 950円、生ビール800円、角ハイボール600円、電気ブラン600円、冷やしあめ・ラムネ水は本店のみ、祗園本店 (祇園町北側238、年中無休、平日11:00〜深夜1:00、土曜・祝前日11:00〜深夜3:00、日曜・祝日10:30〜22:00)、京都髙島屋店 (地下1階、10時〜20時)。食べログ: お好み焼き、予約不可、100席、禁煙、子供可、カード・PayPay 可、お好み焼き百名店 2018。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 950円、マネキン、昭和レトロ、外国人のスタッフ、深夜まで営業。

cultural_comfort.note: One dish only — just choose the sauce (sweet, normal or spicy); no bookings, open late.

places.name: 吉田山せせり (Yoshida Yama Seseri)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers come with salt, the house tare (sauce) or the chef’s choice (2026 reviews); the tare’s ingredients are not described, so ask.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori counter; the few vegetable dishes (water eggplant, Manganji peppers, chilled tomato) sit beside chicken, pork, tuna and octopus (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Monday–Friday 17:00–23:00, closed Saturday and Sunday; hours may change. Bookings by phone (090-6979-1444) up to a month ahead, in two-hour slots: 17:00–19:00, 19:00–21:00, 21:00–23:00 (Tabelog); diners booked from the same day to two weeks ahead, and one August 2026 walk-in found a seat. Cash only (no cards, e-money or QR). 8 counter seats; non-smoking, with an ashtray outside (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original text なし). Deep in an alley in a residential area behind Kyoto Station — look for the lantern of the neighbouring Kouyouken; 5 min walk from the Hachijo exit (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Higashikujo, behind Kyoto Station — 5 min walk from the Hachijo exit
places.cuisine: Charcoal yakitori skewered to order at an 8-seat counter (2026 reviews) · the namesake seseri (neck) — three pieces wound round the skewer, best with the tare — negima, tsukune, cheese tsukune, curry negima, liver, heart, gizzard, yagen, momo, local chicken with plum, Kyoto pork; salt, tare or omakase · water eggplant sashimi, Manganji peppers, chilled tomato, chilled tofu, octopus, tuna · Sapporo Lager Akaboshi, highballs (Yamazaki, Hakushu, Ichiro’s Malt), fresh watermelon sour, honey-ginger and sansho sours, Akadama, sake · about ¥4,000–4,500 a head with drinks (August 2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · behind Kyoto Station, a couple's 8-seat counter] A tiny yakitori counter down an alley south of Kyoto Station, where each skewer is threaded to order and grilled over charcoal — the house seseri wound three times round the skewer, juicy liver, curry negima — while the owner's wife grates fresh watermelon for the sours. Around ¥4,000–4,500 with drinks (2026). Yakitori WEST Tabelog 100 2024 and 2025. Weeknights only, two-hour slots from 17:00, 19:00 and 21:00; book by phone; cash only. It can be hot inside in summer.

roles: Owner-griller (unnamed), working with the owner’s wife, per August 2026 reviews
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe the owner grilling every skewer to order in front of the counter and the owner’s wife making the sours, including grating fresh watermelon (August 2026); one diner called both very kind. Tabelog Yakitori WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024 and 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Seseri; skewers threaded to order.

anecdotes.text: "They boldly wrap three pieces of seseri around a skewer and grill them in a unique style." — August 2026.
A July 2026 diner found the yakitori tender but the small room stifling in the summer heat.
"Thanks to the solo diner next to me, I was able to enjoy my drinks and had a wonderful time." — a solo walk-in, August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼き鳥・居酒屋・肉料理、南区東九条室町31、月〜金 17:00〜23:00、土日休み、予約は1か月前から、17〜19時・19〜21時・21〜23時の2時間制、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター8席、禁煙 (外に灰皿)、サービス料なし、路地の奥、隣の Kouyouken の提灯が目印、京都駅八条口から徒歩5分、焼き鳥 WEST 百名店 2024・2025。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年9月、英語): せせり (3つ巻きつけた串)、ねぎま、つくね、チーズつくね、カレーねぎま、レバー、ハツ、砂ずり、やげん、地鶏の梅、京都の豚、水茄子、万願寺唐辛子、冷やしトマト、スイカのサワー (奥さんが生のスイカをすりおろす)、塩・タレ・おまかせ、4,000〜4,500円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a two-hour slot by phone; order skewers with salt or tare at the counter; cash only.

places.name: 西京焼き 京都やま六 (Saikyo Yaki Kyoto Yamaroku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog notes that allergy information is available. The set meals are fish marinated in Saikyo miso with rice, red miso soup and small side dishes such as mentaiko and fried tofu (2026 reviews); the miso and side dishes are not described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every set is built on miso-marinated fish (silver cod, Spanish mackerel, salmon, kinmedai), with mentaiko and marinated horse mackerel among the sides (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 16:00–20:00 (last order 19:30); closed on JR Kyoto Isetan’s closing days. No reservations: register at the ticket machine in front of the shop for a numbered ticket; when seats run out for the day, ticketing may stop early (Tabelog; October 2026). Waits in October 2026 ran from none to about 45 minutes; a sitting takes 30–40 minutes. 21 seats: a counter and two booths; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards and QR payments, no e-money (Tabelog). JR Kyoto Isetan B1F, directly connected to JR Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: JR Kyoto Station, JR Kyoto Isetan B1F
places.cuisine: Set meals of freshly grilled Saikyo-yaki — fish marinated in sweet white Saikyo miso — from a long-established Kyoto fish and miso-marinade house (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · silver cod set ¥2,650 (October 2026), Spanish mackerel set ¥2,280 (October 2026); à la carte salmon ¥1,100 and kinmedai · each set with glossy rice (free refills), red miso soup and four small sides such as mentaiko, marinated horse mackerel, beef-tendon potato salad and fried tofu (2026 reviews) · sake
places.notes: [Saikyo-yaki set meals · Kyoto Station, a fish house's first restaurant] A 21-seat set-meal counter in the basement of JR Kyoto Isetan from 京都やま六, a Kyoto fish house founded in 1927: miso-marinated fish grilled to order — the silver cod set (¥2,650 in 2026) is the classic — with glossy rice you can refill, red miso soup and small sides like mentaiko. Diner Tabelog 100 2026. No bookings: take a number from the machine out front, and expect a wait at peak times. 11:00–15:00 and 16:00–20:00.

roles: Restaurant of 京都やま六 (company; no person named)
chef_bio.background: Per October 2026 reviews: 京都やま六 began in 1927 as a fish wholesaler with the opening of the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market and refined Saikyo-zuke (fish marinated in Saikyo miso) as a way to bring out flavour; the fish is marinated a full day in a first miso and then re-marinated in fresh miso; this restaurant, opened in August 2023 (Tabelog gives 1 August 2023), is the house’s first. Tabelog Diner "Tabelog 100" 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Silver cod Saikyo-yaki set meal.

anecdotes.text: "Honestly, I still don’t quite understand this restaurant’s system!" — arriving 30 minutes before opening, a diner found tickets handed out only 5 minutes before (October 2026).
An October 2026 diner tried an à la carte kinmedai beside the silver cod set and still found the silver cod richer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂、下京区烏丸通塩小路下ル東塩小路町 ジェイアール京都伊勢丹 B1F、毎日11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・16:00〜20:00 (L.O. 19:30)、ジェイアール京都伊勢丹に準じる休み、整理券制で満席になり次第当日の受付を終了することあり、予約不可、21席、禁煙、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、アレルギー表示あり、2023年8月1日オープン、食堂百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年10月〜11月、英語): 1927年に京都中央卸売市場の開場とともに魚の仲卸として創業、西京漬けの技、一日本漬けしたあと新しい味噌で漬け直す、初めての飲食店、銀だらの西京焼き定食2,650円、さわらの西京焼き定食2,280円、鮭の西京焼き単品1,100円、金目鯛、ご飯のおかわり自由、赤だし、明太子などの小鉢、整理券。

cultural_comfort.note: Take a number from the machine out front, then order a set meal; rice refills are free.

places.name: てしま (Teshima)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The omakase runs through obanzai, oden, sashimi with soy sauce, saba sushi and udon; tempura and kushikatsu also appear; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden and simmered dishes in dashi, sashimi and sushi make up the omakase (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–24:00 every day; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations by phone (Tabelog); counter fills soon after opening (2023–2024 reviews); one July 2024 booking seemed to have been forgotten. Seating limited to about 90 minutes (July 2024). 8 counter seats; smoking allowed; cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No drinks price list; large bottles of beer only (July 2024). At the far end of the corridor of 四富会館, an old building of small counter bars on Tominokoji just north of Shijo; 4 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; June 2023).
places.neighborhood: Tominokoji just north of Shijo — 4 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: One-man counter of homely Japanese food and sake (2023–2026 reviews) · omakase of five or six dishes: a plate of five seasonal obanzai, oden or simmered cabbage, sashimi, saba sushi, then hot kitsune udon — ¥1,500 in Tabelog's introduction, ¥1,800 (2023–2024), ¥2,000 and ¥5,000 (March 2026) · tempura with grated daikon, kushikatsu · sake such as Kikumasa and Tomi no Hozan; Nikaido shochu (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo, a one-man counter at the back of 四富会館] At the very end of the narrow, red-painted corridor of 四富会館 — an old building of tiny counter bars just north of Shijo — an eight-seat counter where the owner, Takada, a sushi-trained cook from Awaji Island, cooks and serves alone. Order the omakase (¥2,000 in March 2026): five seasonal obanzai, oden, sashimi, saba sushi and a bowl of hot udon, enough for two to share. Strangers end up talking across the counter. Some love the owner's banter; a March 2026 visitor found the manner tiring. Cash only, smoking allowed; open to midnight.

roles: Owner-chef who cooks and serves alone (Tabelog: Takada, the owner, trained at sushi restaurants; July 2024 review: the chef managed the cooking and service for seven diners alone)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog's introduction: the owner trained at sushi restaurants, is respected in the trade, and chose a small counter on purpose; food-trade people from Nishiki Market come here. A May 2023 reviewer says the shop has been here more than 20 years and that the owner worked in sushi kappo.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase of obanzai, sashimi, saba sushi and udon.

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 visitor who had come on the first day of the trip returned because the chef, with a regular, had given life advice that almost brought tears.
"The walls were adorned with handwritten menus and various foreign banknotes." — June 2023.
A March 2026 visitor found the owner's difficult manner tiring and did not see why the place is so popular, though the food and prices were fair.
A March 2026 diner on the ¥2,000 omakase was surprised by the quality and quantity, and found strangers chatting by the end of the night.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: てしま、居酒屋・日本料理・海鮮、中京区富小路四条上ル 四富会館 1F、河原町駅から徒歩4分、毎日17:30〜24:00、不定休、予約可 (電話)、カウンター8席、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、魚にこだわり。店の紹介 (英訳): 寿司屋で修業した店主の Takada、錦市場の料理人も通う、季節の先付け5品、寿司・串カツ・煮物・刺身などのおまかせ6品1,500円。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): Awaji Island 出身の店主が一人で料理と接客、おばんざい、おでん、刺身、鯖寿司、きつねうどん、おまかせ1,800円 (2023〜2024年)、2,000円と5,000円 (2026年3月)、90分ほど、20年以上。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny counter; phone booking; cash only; smoking allowed; no drinks price list.

places.name: 千登利亭 (Chidori Tei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-style sushi with soy-based sauces on conger eel and simmered ingredients, plus chawanmushi and clear soup; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: mackerel, conger eel, sea bream and other fish sushi, with dashi soups (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–17:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations taken (Tabelog). 14 seats (4 counter, tables for 2 and 4); non-smoking; cash only (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Takeaway, with a small container charge (May 2026). On Donguri-dori west of Yamatooji, 2 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 1 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Donguri-dori between Gion and the Kamo River — 2 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style sushi house: saba sushi, hako-zushi and bo-zushi rather than Edo nigiri (2026 reviews) · "Wakasa" Kyoto sushi set — saba sushi, live conger-eel box sushi, Kyoto chirashi (steamed sushi instead in winter, ¥3,200), rolls in oboro kombu, clear soup — ¥2,730 · saba sushi to take away, 6 pieces ¥2,520 · young sea bream (kasugo) sushi 6 pieces ¥1,900; isobe maki 8 pieces ¥1,360 (May 2026) · summer hamo sushi 6 pieces ¥6,000, ayu sushi in bamboo leaf (June 2026) · nigiri, 8 pieces ¥3,600 (January 2026) · lunch gozen around ¥2,000 (September 2026) · chawanmushi · Kirin beer ¥950, Kamotsuru Gold junmai ¥1,650 (May 2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Gion, Kyoto saba sushi and box sushi] A small, old-fashioned sushi house on Donguri-dori near Gion-Shijo Stn, serving the Kyoto styles: thick, soft saba sushi, conger-eel box sushi, kombu-wrapped rolls and, in winter, piping-hot steamed sushi. The "Wakasa" set (¥2,730) samples most of them with a clear soup; in summer there are hamo and ayu sushi. Saba sushi travels well as a takeaway. The owner is friendly and the chawanmushi has fans of its own. Lunch to 17:00 only; cash only; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 reviewer first came about ten years earlier while touring shops of the Kyoto Sushi Noren Association for saba sushi. An October 2026 reviewer calls it a long-established sushi restaurant.
chef_bio.specialty: Saba sushi; "Wakasa" Kyoto sushi set; steamed sushi in winter.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor from Kanto swapped the chirashi for steamed sushi (¥3,200) and found the bowl too hot to hold.
"I was left speechless by the best chawanmushi (savory egg custard) I've ever had." — June 2026.
A May 2026 diner found the tables full of families from abroad, three generations at one table.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 千登利亭、寿司・日本料理、東山区団栗通大和大路西入ル六軒町203、京阪祇園四条駅1番出口から徒歩2分、11:00〜17:00、木曜休み、予約可、14席 (カウンター4、2人テーブル3、4人テーブル1)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、英語メニュー、テイクアウト可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 京寿司セット「Wakasa」2,730円 (鯖寿司、活穴子の箱寿司、京ちらし、巻き寿司、吸い物)、冬は蒸し寿司に変更3,200円、鯖寿司6切れ2,520円、小鯛寿司6切れ1,900円、磯辺巻き1,360円、夏の鱧寿司6切れ6,000円、鮎寿司、にぎり8貫3,600円、茶碗蒸し、Kyoto Sushi Noren Association。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); many families from abroad (May 2026); cash only.

places.name: ル・プチメック 今出川店 (Le Petit Mec Imadegawa ten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a French bakery of croissants, Danish, hard breads and pies (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Most pastries are butter-based; a July 2026 reviewer describes the ciabatta as made with olive oil and without butter or milk (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 8:00–18:00 every day (Tabelog). No reservations; takeaway (Tabelog). Eat-in at 18 table seats: breads are warmed and sliced, juice served over ice (May 2026). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On the north side of Imadegawa-dori between Horikawa and Senbon, behind a red awning; 2 min from the Imadegawa-Omiya bus stop (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 30 October 1998 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Imadegawa-dori at Omiya, Nishijin — 2 min from the Imadegawa-Omiya bus stop
places.cuisine: French-style bakery with a café corner, the first shop of Le Petit Mec, known as "Aka Mec" for its red front (2026 reviews) · croissants: au beurre ¥270, aux amandes ¥430, Earl Grey almond ¥440, à la crème · pain au chocolat ¥330 · Olivier ¥250, ciabatta, lemon-macadamia ¥280 and other hard breads · chestnut pie ¥300, lemon custard pie ¥340, apple Danish, milk France with rum raisins ¥320, edamame and corn bread ¥360 · cakes with fruit (May–October 2026)
places.notes: [Bakery · Imadegawa, the red-fronted French bakery] Le Petit Mec's first shop, opened in 1998 on Imadegawa-dori in Nishijin and nicknamed "Aka Mec" for its red door and awning. Inside it smells of butter and plays French radio-style music; pick your breads, pay, and eat them at the tables, where they are warmed and sliced for you. The croissants are the stars (au beurre ¥270, almond ¥430, Earl Grey), with hard breads, fruit pies and seasonal specials. Busy from the morning; open daily 8:00–18:00.

roles: Le Petit Mec co., Ltd. (official site); no bakers named
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 30 October 1998; the official site marks the brand's 28th anniversary this autumn and lists 今出川店, 御池店, 大丸京都店 and 日比谷店 (Tokyo). Tabelog Bread "Tabelog 100" 2017–2020 and Bread WEST 2022.
chef_bio.specialty: Croissants; hard breads.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner eating in was impressed that the breads were warmed and cut into easy pieces, and that a bottled orange juice came with a glass of ice.
"There are many international customers, and the music playing in the background feels like a French radio broadcast" — May 2026.
A July 2026 regular, who usually buys hard breads at the other shops, ordered items here that are best eaten fresh: the croissant à la crème and an apple Danish.

places.name: 夢屋 (Yume Ya)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki batter, negiyaki and yakisoba are wheat-based, with sweet sauces (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: okonomiyaki with pork, beef, squid and egg, topped with fish flakes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–21:00, last order 20:30; closed Wednesday; closes when sold out (Tabelog). Reservations taken and advised (Tabelog; May 2026). 45 seats, with sofa and tatami seats; the whole room can be hired for 20–50 people; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Paid parking next door (Tabelog). On Kawabata-dori at Nijo, by the Kamo River, under red lanterns; 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn, 5 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; June 2026).
places.neighborhood: Kawabata-dori at Nijo, by the Kamo River — 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Okonomiyaki and teppan izakaya (2026 reviews) · Yume-yaki, the signature: a thin batter rich in yam with egg, cabbage and pork layered rather than mixed, ¥1,480 · Super Yume-yaki with potato and cheese · Fukafuka, a fluffy yam-and-egg okonomiyaki with beef, pork and squid, ¥1,480 · Yume negi (soy or sauce) ¥1,300; jaga cheese ¥950; garlic yaki ¥750 · yakisoba with thin noodles, e.g. mixed or salt ¥1,300, kimchi yakisoba · teppan: tonpei, gizzard, chicken neck, squid tentacles, chicken wings, beef intestines, pork kimchi · white "muroaji-bushi" flakes from Iyo, Ehime (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Kawabata Nijo, fluffy yam okonomiyaki by the Kamo River] A long-running okonomiyaki and teppan house under red lanterns on Kawabata-dori, its walls signed by many celebrities. The house style is soft and fluffy, thanks to plenty of yam in the batter: the Yume-yaki (¥1,480), layered rather than mixed, and the Fukafuka, piled with beef, pork and squid, both finished with white flakes from Ehime. Add a thin-noodle salt yakisoba and teppan sides such as tonpei or gizzard. Dishes arrive cooked. Cash only; 17:00–21:00, closed Wednesday; it closes when sold out, so book.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a long-established okonomiyaki shop with many regulars (September 2026) and walls covered with celebrity signatures (July 2026); one February 2026 reviewer has been coming since student days. Tabelog Okonomiyaki "Tabelog 100" 2018, 2019, 2022, 2023 and 2024.
chef_bio.specialty: Yume-yaki; Fukafuka; salt yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: On 5 January 2026, when few restaurants were open for New Year, a diner found it nearly full and was won over by the sauce's distinctive sweetness.
A July 2026 diner was amazed by the "muroaji-bushi", white fish flakes from Iyo City in Ehime used in place of ordinary bonito flakes.
A July 2026 visitor noted that, although there is a griddle at the table, the yakisoba and yume-yaki came out already cooked.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 夢屋、お好み焼き・焼きそば・居酒屋、左京区川端通二条通上ル孫橋町1、市役所前駅から徒歩3分、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、17:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、水曜休み、売り切れ次第終了、予約可、45席、ソファ席・座敷、20〜50名で貸切可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、お好み焼き百名店 2018・2019・2022・2023・2024。口コミ (2026年、英語): 赤提灯、山芋たっぷりの生地の Yume-yaki 1,480円、Super Yume-yaki (じゃがいもとチーズ)、Fukafuka 1,480円、Yume negi 1,300円、じゃがチーズ950円、ガーリック焼き750円、細麺の塩焼きそば、とんぺい、Iyo の「muroaji-bushi」、有名人のサイン、学生時代からの常連。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; dishes arrive cooked; cash only.

places.name: 焼肉つむぎ (Yakiniku Tsumugi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu yakiniku with salt or sauce, strip loin grilled sukiyaki-style and dipped in egg yolk, kimchi and namul; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house; the only sides in the course are kimchi and bean-sprout namul (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 15:00–23:00, every day (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closing days may vary (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, though walk-ins are welcomed; full by 17:00 on a September 2026 evening, so booking is wise (Tabelog; September 2026). 10% service charge (Tabelog). 18 table seats on high chairs around drum-can grills; can be hired for up to 50 (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay (Tabelog). By the Takase River on Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Sanjo; 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi by the Takase River, south of Sanjo — 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Wagyu yakiniku in small portions, "like sushi", grilled around drum cans (Tabelog shop text; September 2026) · Wagyu course, 120 g, ¥4,400: assorted kimchi, bean-sprout namul, three kinds of kuroge wagyu tongue, special outside skirt, chateaubriand, premium kalbi (or the day’s cut) with salt and with sauce, sliced strip loin grilled sukiyaki-style with egg yolk (Tabelog; September–October 2026) · Premium wagyu course, 180 g, ¥5,500 (Tabelog) · rice ¥330; Kyoto Beer Matcha ¥990; umeshu soda ¥770 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Kiyamachi, wagyu courses round a drum can] A casual yakiniku room by the Takase River where you sit on high chairs round drum-can grills and work through small portions of wagyu: three kinds of tongue, outside skirt, chateaubriand, kalbi with salt and with sauce, and a strip-loin slice grilled sukiyaki-style and dipped in egg yolk — 120 g for ¥4,400, or 180 g for ¥5,500, plus 10% service. Cheerful staff explain the cuts. Open from 15:00; book for evenings.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: high-quality meat at prices as accessible as possible, small portions of wagyu like sushi, "satisfaction beyond the price" in Kiyamachi. October 2026 reviewers describe cheerful staff who explain each cut and a mix of tourists and locals.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Tabelog shop text: "satisfaction beyond the price".
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu course with chateaubriand; strip loin with egg yolk.

anecdotes.text: "The style of grilling around the drum can was refreshing, creating a different atmosphere from the usual yakiniku." — September 2026.
"The meat portion is 120g per person, which might be just right for women! For men, it might feel a bit insufficient." — October 2026.
"The cheerful and energetic staff provided explanations about the meat, making the dining experience enjoyable." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉・ホルモン、中京区北車屋町272-1、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、毎日15:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00・ドリンク22:30)、不定休、予約可、サービス料10%、18席 (テーブル)、貸切50名まで、カード・PayPay・d払い・楽天ペイ・au PAY・Alipay 可、和牛コース120g 4,400円 (牛タン3種、シャトーブリアン、ハラミ、ロースの焼きすき)、特選和牛コース180g 5,500円、店舗紹介: 寿司のように少量ずつ味わう和牛、値段以上の満足。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): ドラム缶を囲む焼肉、ハイチェア、キムチ盛り合わせ、もやしナムル、上カルビ (塩・たれ)、卵黄のロース、ライス330円、Kyoto Beer Matcha 990円、梅酒ソーダ770円、明るいスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Fixed courses; staff explain the cuts; 10% service; cards and QR accepted.

places.name: カワカフェ (kawa cafe)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Quiche, galettes, pasta, pizza, sandwiches, crêpes and tarts by day, bistro dishes at night; no gluten information (official site; October 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. French bistro and café menu with cakes and tarts; no vegan dish is named (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 10:00–23:30 every day, closed irregularly. The official site gives 10:00 to midnight in Japanese and 10:00–23:00 in English and French, "non-stop". No reservations (Tabelog); private hire for groups (official site). The riverside terrace (kawayuka) runs only in season, until September, with a ¥300 seat charge (July–October 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). 20 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Many guests and staff are from abroad (2026 reviews). On Kiyamachi north of Matsubara, backing onto the Kamo River; 8 min walk from Kawaramachi, Gion-Shijo and Kiyomizu-Gojo stations (Tabelog). Open since 2012 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Matsubara, on the Kamo River — 8 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: All-day café, bistro and bar in a Kyoto townhouse on the Kamo River — breakfast, brunch, lunch, tea, aperitif, dinner and bar, with French bistro dishes, sweets and Japanese food (official site) · lunch in October 2026: quiche, galettes, pasta, pizza, baguette sandwiches, crêpes, tarts, and even shoyu and tonkotsu ramen; bistro menu with wine and cocktails at night · pear tart ¥950, orange juice ¥650 (October 2026); iced chai ¥700 (July 2026); shandy gaff ¥900 (September 2026) · an August 2026 reviewer found the food menu gone late in the evening, with only drinks, cakes and snacks
places.notes: [Café · Kiyamachi, a machiya on the Kamo River] An all-day café-bistro in an old townhouse whose big back windows — and, until September, a riverside terrace — look straight onto the Kamo River and the herons on its banks. French-leaning food from galettes and quiche at lunch to bistro plates and wine at night, with cakes, chai and cocktails between; the house cat Kawa-chan naps in a basket. Many staff and guests are from abroad. Service draws mixed reviews in 2026 — slow, orders misunderstood, a ¥300 terrace charge. Cash only.

roles: Owner and staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (in Japanese, English and French): Kawa Café, since 2012, in a machiya facing the Kamogawa, offers non-stop service from breakfast to bar, French bistro food, sweets and Japanese dishes "at very friendly prices", and aims to preserve Kyoto’s architectural heritage and save water and energy. Reviewers in 2026 describe staff mostly from abroad and a resident cat, Kawa-chan, the cat on the shop sign.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: Kyoto heritage preserved, water and energy saved, "an eco-friendly perspective".
chef_bio.specialty: Tarts; galettes; drinks on the river.

anecdotes.text: "Kawa-chan was wandering around the cafe and napping in a basket, looking incredibly cute!" — June 2026.
"There was a white heron on the opposite bank, and I leisurely enjoyed a relaxing afternoon." — June 2026.
A July 2026 visitor paid a ¥300 terrace charge, found the chairs worn, had to repeat an order for iced chai several times, received no water, and felt ¥700 for a weak chai was too much.
A May 2026 visitor found both staff members on duty unfriendly.
An October 2026 visitor was served an iced drink instead of a hot one and found the wanted cake sold out.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kawa-cafe.com、日本語・英語・フランス語): Since 2012、鴨川に面した京町家、床シーズンにはテラス席、朝食、ブランチ、ランチ、スイーツとお茶、夕食前の一杯、ディナー、バータイムまでノンストップ営業、フランスのビストロ料理、スイーツ、和食、営業時間は毎日朝10時から夜24時まで (英語・仏語では23時まで)、個室貸し切り、京都の建築遺産と資源の保全。食べログ: カフェ・ビストロ・バー、下京区木屋町通松原上ル美濃屋町176-1、毎日10:00〜23:30、不定休、予約不可、20席、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): 看板猫の Kawa-chan、鴨川の眺め、テラス席は9月まで・席料300円、洋梨のタルト950円、アイスチャイ700円、シャンディガフ900円、キッシュ、ガレット、パスタ、ピザ、ラーメン、海外のスタッフ、接客への不満。

cultural_comfort.note: Trilingual website; many staff from abroad; cash only; terrace seat charge in season.

places.name: 日本料理 櫻川 (Japanese cuisine Sakuragawa)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the restaurant states on Tabelog, "We do not accept reservations for vegetarians or those with gluten allergies," and may decline other dietary restrictions (Tabelog, staff-maintained).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the restaurant does not accept reservations for vegetarians (Tabelog); the kaiseki is built on fish, freshly shaved katsuobushi dashi and seasonal seafood (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00, dinner 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday and over New Year (official site; Tabelog). Lunch course at ¥16,500 must be booked by the day before (official site). Cancellations: 50% the day before, 100% on the day; tell the shop if more than 15 minutes late — after 30 minutes the booking may be cancelled (Tabelog). 10% service charge at lunch and dinner (official site). No vegetarians or gluten-allergic guests; other dietary restrictions may be declined (Tabelog). Counter seats from middle-school age, ordering the adult course (Tabelog). 14 seats: a 10-seat white-wood counter and a semi-private table for 2–4; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (official site; Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi south of Nijo by the Takase River; 3 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Nijo, by the Takase River — 3 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal kaiseki at a white-wood counter, with katsuobushi shaved fresh for the dashi (official site) · lunch courses ¥8,800 and ¥16,500 (book the day before); dinner courses ¥22,000 and ¥27,500; à la carte at night on request; all plus 10% service (official site) · seasonal examples: hamo shabu-shabu in an onion dashi (July–August), ayu and hamo otoshi (May–June), autumn eggplant and ochiayu steak (September–October) (official site) · autumn 2026: hassun with figs in sesame soy and grilled sanma liver, matsutake and hamo soup, kombu-cured sea bream, grilled kamasu, turnip mousse, clay-pot rice with eel and simmered beef (September 2026); hamo and matsutake in many ways (September 2026) · 15–20 sakes and wines at any time, served in artists’ sake vessels (official site) · tsukudani, nabe sets and ponzu by mail; New Year osechi (official site)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Kiyamachi Nijo, a white-wood counter by the Takase River] A quiet kaiseki restaurant by the Takase River with a 10-seat white-wood counter, where the cooks use freshly shaved katsuobushi and build seasonal courses — hamo shabu-shabu in summer, matsutake and hamo in autumn, clay-pot rice with eel to finish. Lunch from ¥8,800, dinner ¥22,000–27,500, plus 10% service. Note: the house does not take bookings from vegetarians or guests with gluten allergies. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner and cooks (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Japanese cooking that respects tradition while offering Sakuragawa’s own taste, katsuobushi shaved fresh, fifteen to twenty sakes and wines on hand, sake vessels made by artists, and dishes suited to each guest’s tastes; a branch, おばんざい櫻川, closed in February 2026. A September 2026 reviewer says the restaurant has earned a Michelin star; an eighteen-time regular describes the counter full of locals (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: no corner cut, from buying to cooking to serving.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamo and matsutake; clay-pot rice; pudding.

anecdotes.text: An 18th-visit regular in September 2026 had hamo from Awaji and Korea and matsutake from Iwate in a dobin-mushi, a fried dish, a grilled wrap, sashimi and clay-pot rice, and took the leftover rice home.
"This was the best kombu-kelp marinated dish I’ve ever had." — September 2026.
"If I had to wish for something more, I would have liked to have one additional dish... It might be a bit insufficient in quantity for men." — November 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-sakuragawa.jp): 京都・木屋町の日本料理、白木のカウンター十席と半個室のテーブル一卓、昼12:00〜14:00・夜18:00〜22:00、昼夜ともサービス料10%、日曜定休、年末年始休み、削りたての鰹節、常時15〜20種の日本酒とワイン、作家の酒器、夜の会席22,000円・27,500円 (税込)、夜は一品料理も、昼の会席8,800円・16,500円 (前日までの要予約)、季節の例 (鱧しゃぶ玉葱風味だし、秋茄子と落鮎のステーキ ほか)、佃煮・鍋セット・ポン酢の通販、おせち、支店おばんざい櫻川は2026年2月に閉店。食べログ (店舗会員): ベジタリアンとグルテンアレルギーの方の予約は不可、その他の食事制限もお断りする場合あり、カウンターは中学生以上、キャンセル料 (前日50%、当日100%)、14席、禁煙、車椅子可、カード可。口コミ (2026年5〜11月、英語): 昼の会席16,500円+サービス料、鱧しゃぶ、松茸、昆布締めの鯛、土鍋ご飯、プリン、ミシュランの星。

cultural_comfort.note: English page on the official site; book ahead (TableCheck); no vegetarian or gluten-allergy bookings.

staff_allergy_handling: Declines reservations from vegetarians and guests with gluten allergies; may decline other dietary restrictions (Tabelog, staff-maintained).

places.name: COPPIE
places.gf_detail: Ask. Genre-free plates include spring rolls, shumai, noodles, risotto and curry alongside sashimi and grilled fish and game; the shop asks to be told of allergies and dietary restrictions in advance (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu is built on fish, game and meat, but the shop invites guests to state dietary restrictions in advance (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: From 17:00 to 24:30, last food order 21:30; closed irregularly — see Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; tell the shop in advance about allergies, restrictions or a stay under two hours; no strong perfume (Tabelog). Children under 9 only at one table, arranged in advance; children’s meals on request (Tabelog). 20 seats: 12 at the counter and 8 at tables; non-smoking, with a smoking spot outside (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Sommelier; bring-your-own possible (Tabelog). In a townhouse with a courtyard on Takatsuji; 10 min walk from Shijo-Omiya, about 10 min by taxi from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; June 2026). Opened 12 August 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takatsuji-dori near Inokuma, south-west of Shijo Omiya — 10 min walk from Shijo-Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Genre-free creative cooking from ingredients all over Japan, mostly à la carte in small portions, with courses at times (2026 reviews) · June 2026 plates: Shimane horse mackerel sashimi with green plum, Kamo eggplant with mole poblano and passion fruit, Aichi conger and young corn spring roll with gorgonzola, charcoal-grilled sweet sea bream with gyokuro and Manganji pepper, Ezo venison loin, clams with soy milk and chilled kudzu noodles · April 2026 course: funazushi-flavoured potato salad, lamb and turnip, firefly squid shumai, bonito with wild garlic, sea bream, spiced curry, a terrine for dessert · fifth-anniversary course ¥15,000 with sea bream risotto and noodles under karasumi made when the shop opened (August 2026) · wine, sake and drink pairings; alcohol-free "craft winy" mocktails, Belgian alcohol-free beer, homemade ginger ale, sansho soda (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Creative · Shijo Omiya, a genre-free townhouse counter] A stylish machiya counter with a courtyard, a short walk off the beaten track south-west of Shijo Omiya, cooking genre-free small plates from ingredients all over Japan — Kamo eggplant with mole and passion fruit, conger and gorgonzola spring rolls, Ezo venison — mostly à la carte, with clever wine, sake and alcohol-free pairings. Staff are friendly and full of stories. Bills run about ¥10,000–30,000. A March 2026 regular felt the mood changed with many overseas guests. Open from 17:00; closed irregularly (Instagram).

roles: Chef and staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Opened 12 August 2021 (Tabelog); reviewers celebrated its fifth anniversary in August 2026 with a special course. 2026 reviewers describe friendly, knowledgeable staff, drink pairings full of surprises, and an alcohol-free list of "craft winy" mocktails. A March 2026 regular found the visit disappointing, suggesting that about half the guests being foreigners had changed the atmosphere.
chef_bio.specialty: Genre-free small plates; drink pairings.

anecdotes.text: "For the noodle dish, I had it topped with karasumi (dried mullet roe) made when the restaurant first opened" — August 2026.
"What stood out this time was the impressive selection of non-alcoholic drinks." — August 2026.
"This time was a bit disappointing. Perhaps it’s because about half of the customers were foreigners, which changed the atmosphere?" — March 2026.
"The à la carte dishes were excellent, but what truly stood out was the wine and drink pairings, which were filled with surprises and excitement." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 創作料理・イノベーティブ、下京区高辻猪熊町367、阪急四条大宮駅から徒歩10分、17:00〜24:30 (料理 L.O. 21:30)、不定休 (Instagram)、予約可 (アレルギーや苦手なもの、2時間未満の滞在は事前に連絡、香水は控える)、9歳未満は1卓のみ・事前連絡、子供の料理は予約時に相談、20席 (カウンター12、テーブル8)、禁煙 (屋外に喫煙所)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、ソムリエ、持ち込み可、2021年8月12日オープン。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): ジャンルレスのアラカルト、Shimane の鯵、賀茂茄子のモーレ、穴子とゴルゴンゾーラの春巻き、甘鯛の炭火焼き、Ezo 鹿、5周年の特別コース15,000円、開店時のカラスミ、ノンアルコールのペアリング、自家製ジンジャーエール、中庭、海外の客が多いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead and mention allergies; à la carte at the counter; cards accepted.

places.name: 無双心 祇園店 (Musou Shin Gion)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade wheat noodles in a chicken-and-pork-bone soup; tsukemen and mazesoba also wheat (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is chicken and pork bone with vegetables, topped with chashu (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–24:00 (last order 23:30), every day (Tabelog). Order by ticket machine (September 2026). 15 seats: 11 at the counter and a table for four; non-smoking; no cards (Tabelog). On Yamato-oji south of Shijo, near Kenninji; 238 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; March 2025).
places.neighborhood: Yamato-oji south of Shijo, near Kenninji — 238 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kameoka "veggie potage" ramen: a rich chicken-and-pork-bone soup made with eight aromatic vegetables, on homemade flat noodles, with braised chashu (Tabelog) · Musou Shin ramen ¥1,200 (September 2026), tonkotsu ramen, black sesame ramen with black vinegar and seaweed, ajitama tsukemen · Maeda Kaisen mentaiko mazesoba; a spicy Thai-style bowl · chashu rice, karaage rice bowl (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Ramen · Gion, near Kenninji] A late-opening Gion branch of a Kameoka ramen shop, with a creamy chicken-and-pork-bone soup thickened with eight vegetables, homemade flat noodles and tender chashu (Musou Shin ramen ¥1,200); also black-sesame ramen, tsukemen and a mentaiko mazesoba. Busy with overseas visitors; reviewers born in Kyoto are mixed. Ticket machine; open 11:30 to midnight daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 2 July 2014 (Tabelog). Per the operator’s Tabelog text: Kameoka’s veggie-potage ramen brought to Gion. Reviews mention a Kameoka shop (September 2024) and a Toronto shop listed in the Michelin Guide, which the Gion shop advertises on a sign (August 2025, September 2026). The shop website listed on Tabelog returned 403 on 2026-11-05.
chef_bio.specialty: Musou Shin ramen; black sesame ramen.

anecdotes.text: A Kyoto-born August 2025 diner noticed long lines of foreign customers at night and found the ramen "somewhat difficult to understand".
An April 2026 regular-of-old found prices up, the ¥10 extra-noodle option gone and the portion seemingly smaller.
A September 2024 reviewer found the broth lacking umami and the service poor.

Cash only (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 50 seats incl. counter and tatami, with a busy second floor up the stairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). 6 min from the Hachijo exit of JR Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishikujo, south of Kyoto Station Hachijo exit — 6 min walk
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style okonomiyaki and horumon teppanyaki (Tabelog) · Arata-yaki, the namesake: thin batter layered with soba, cabbage and bean sprouts, topped with agi (beef-jaw tendon) and Kujo green onion; agi-filled Arata okonomiyaki ¥900 (operator text, undated) · yakisoba with agi ¥1,510 and a homemade spicy sauce · horumon mix, gizzard, chicken neck, salt-grilled hoso and mino, "mambo-yaki", "danjiri-yaki" udon, garlic rice · "Bakudan" (Akadama port wine and soda) ¥420 (operator text; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki & horumon · south of Kyoto Station] A lively, Showa-feeling okonomiyaki house near the Hachijo exit, packed from its 17:00 opening: the famous Arata-yaki loaded with agi beef tendon and Kujo onion, salt-grilled offal, yakisoba with a fiery house sauce, and the sweet 'Bakudan' (port wine and soda) to drink. Book ahead; 90-minute tables; cash only. Okonomiyaki Tabelog 100 2018–2025. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (unnamed; quoted in the operator’s Tabelog text)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator’s Tabelog text: a charming okonomiyaki shop with a wide range of horumon dishes; "agi" is the sinewy meat from the jaw, a different cut from the one in the yakisoba, per the owner. Tabelog Okonomiyaki "Tabelog 100" 2018, 2019, 2022–2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Arata-yaki; agi yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: With a 17:00 booking, a party of five found the place already full at opening — October 2026.
Three adults without alcohol paid ¥17,100; the gizzard and chicken neck were over-peppered and the seats tight — September 2026.
An October 2026 reviewer counted American families among the guests.

places.name: かね正 (Kane Sho)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled eel with a soy-based tare over rice, liver in sauce, rolled omelette and clear soup; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant; the rice bowls also carry egg (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Thursday and Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations for dinner only (Tabelog); a wait at weekend lunches (July 2026). Lunch serves the rice dishes only; omakase and side dishes such as liver and the eel omelette in the evening (January, October 2026). Eel is grilled to order, about 20 minutes (September 2026). 14 seats (6 counter, 8 table); non-smoking; cash only; no service charge (Tabelog). At the end of a back alley off Yamatooji north of Shijo — the entrance is hard to find; 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: A back alley off Yamatooji, north of Shijo, Gion — 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Old Gion eel house, grilling in the Kansai style without steaming: crisp skin, soft flesh (2026 reviews) · kinshi-don, eel under a heap of shredded omelette on sesame rice, said to have started here, ¥2,700 (September 2026) · unaju · mamushi-don · eel ochazuke with real green tea · evening omakase: simmered liver, shirayaki, dashimaki, eel omelette (January 2026) · liver soup · Yebisu beer; sake such as Gekkeikan and Matsuno Midori (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Unagi · Gion, the kinshi-don's home in a back alley] A small eel house at the end of an alley off Yamatooji, said by reviewers to date from 1866 and to have created the kinshi-don: eel tucked under a mound of fine shredded omelette on rice mixed with sesame and sauce (¥2,700, September 2026). The eel is grilled Kansai-style without steaming, to order, so allow about 20 minutes. Unaju and an eel ochazuke with green tea are the other classics; liver and the eel omelette are evening-only. Run by two cooks; cash only; closed Thursday and Sunday; book for dinner.

roles: Two cooks run the shop (September 2026 reviews); unnamed
chef_bio.background: Reviews from January–August 2026 give the founding as 1866 (Keio era) and call it the birthplace of the eel kinshi-don; two 2026 reviewers mention a Michelin Bib Gourmand. A January 2026 reviewer says the eel is mainly domestic, from Mikawa.
chef_bio.specialty: Kinshi-don; Kansai-style unaju.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner, back after 12 years, could not have grilled liver because there was not enough eel that night, and was talked out of ordering both an omelette and a kinshi-don ("too much egg").
"The teapot contained actual tea, not dashi broth." — the eel ochazuke, July 2026.
An October 2026 lunch diner, frustrated by reheated eel elsewhere, found the freshly grilled skin still crisp at the last bite.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: かね正、うなぎ、東山区大和大路通四条上ル2丁目常盤町155-2、祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、11:30〜14:00・17:30〜21:00、木曜・日曜休み、予約は夜のみ、14席 (カウンター6、テーブル8)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、サービス料・チャージなし。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 1866年 (Keio) 創業、きんし丼発祥の店、ミシュランのビブグルマン、蒸さずに焼く関西風、きんし丼2,700円、うな重、まむし丼、お茶漬け (本物のお茶)、夜のおまかせ (肝煮、白焼き、だし巻き、う巻き)、肝吸い、二人で営む、入口がわかりにくい。

places.name: ムムリク (mumurik)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta and bread alongside carpaccio, grilled meats, ajillo and vegetable plates; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable dishes appear (sweet-potato fries, mushroom salad, white asparagus), but sauces use egg, butter and cheese and no vegan dish is named (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 daily except Tuesday, and no lunch on the 1st, 3rd and 5th Wednesdays; dinner 17:00–22:00 (Friday and Saturday to 22:30), last food order 21:30; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). At dinner at least one drink and one food item each, and no pasta-only orders — come at lunch for pasta alone (Tabelog). Reservations online or by phone; weekends book out (Tabelog; September 2026). Lunch sets A and B, with appetizers, dessert and a drink in B (May, September 2026). 14 seats (8 table, 6 counter); non-smoking; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Off Nishiki Market on Fuyacho south of Takoyakushi, 5 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 5 December 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho south of Takoyakushi, by Nishiki Market — 5 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small Italian bar with a long, tempting menu and a strong wine list (2026 reviews) · appetizer platter, liver pâté, prosciutto, figs with butter, mascarpone and honey, La France pear with blue cheese · Naruto-kintoki sweet-potato fries, yuri-ne (lily bulb), white asparagus with egg-lemon sauce, baked vegetables with blue cheese, mushroom salad, duck and eggplant salad · sea bream carpaccio, oyster and mushroom carpaccio, firefly squid, ajillo · balsamic-braised pork spare ribs, beef skirt steak with mashed potato · pastas such as tomato with mascarpone and bacon on flat noodles · crêpes · lunch set B with appetizers, dessert and a drink (+¥650 on set A, May 2026)
places.notes: [Italian · Nishiki, a small wine bar with a big menu] A fourteen-seat Italian on Fuyacho, steps from Nishiki Market, calm and stylish, with a menu so long it is hard to choose: figs with mascarpone and honey, Naruto-kintoki fries, lily bulb, white asparagus with egg-lemon sauce, balsamic spare ribs, carpaccio, then pasta to finish. Staff suggest wines to your taste. At night order at least a drink and a dish — pasta-only diners are asked to come at lunch, when sets with appetizers and dessert are good value. Weekends book out. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed; Tabelog lists a corporate invoice number)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 5 December 2011. A July 2026 reviewer has been coming on every Kyoto trip for nearly eight years.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog: the shop welcomes guests who come to enjoy both food and drink, and asks pasta-only diners to come at lunch because seats are few.
chef_bio.specialty: Antipasti; balsamic spare ribs; lily bulb.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 group found the tables booked and the counter full of visitors from abroad, saw several walk-in groups turned away, and was briefly served a neighbour's salad.
A January 2026 diner described the wines wanted and was recommended excellent ones.
A July 2026 regular of nearly eight years recommends the lily bulb above all and likes eating alone early in the evening.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Minestrone and white beans appear, but the menu centres on beef, boar and duck, and no vegan dish is named (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations needed (July 2025); some nights are reservations only (December 2025). Bread and water are charged; still or sparkling (May 2026). 14 seats at four tables; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners only (Tabelog). Few non-alcoholic choices (May 2026). On Sakaimachi south of Takoyakushi, 7 min from Karasuma or Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 27 April 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi south of Takoyakushi — 7 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Tuscan osteria cooking simply in the home style (2024–2026 reviews) · bistecca alla fiorentina, from 1 kg on the bone or 500 g off it, cooked rare from lean beef — one diner was offered 800 g (July 2025) · beef fillet from 150 g (June 2026) · crostini, salsiccia bruschetta, tuna and white bean salad, minestrone · pasta: ragù spaghetti, wild boar pappardelle, peach and porcini pasta, bamboo shoot pasta · peposo (braised beef shin), hand-cut beef hamburg · apple tart and other desserts · Tuscan wines, e.g. Brunello di Montalcino, Chianti Classico (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Sakaimachi, a Tuscan osteria for bistecca] A small four-table osteria south of Takoyakushi that cooks Tuscany without fuss: crostini, minestrone, wild-boar pappardelle, peposo and, above all, the bistecca alla fiorentina, lean and rare, sold from 500 g off the bone or 1 kg on it — bring friends, though the kitchen has cut smaller. Classic LPs line the room and the chef will put one on. Bread and water are charged; wine-led, with few soft drinks. Book ahead; dinner only, closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 27 April 2011; a June 2026 reviewer calls it about 15 years old. Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021.
chef_bio.specialty: Bistecca alla fiorentina; wild boar pappardelle.

anecdotes.text: An October 2024 diner talked music with the chef among shelves of classic LPs, and the chef played the record requested.
A July 2025 diner who could not manage the listed 1 kg was offered a smaller bistecca and finished 800 g with a Brunello.
A May 2026 diner noted that bread and water are charged and that the only alcohol-free choice was non-alcoholic beer.

places.name: 萬亀樓 (Mankame Rou)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki with soy- and miso-based seasonings, fu, udon or somen and sweets; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses run on dashi and fish, with eel, crab and beef (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 12:00–22:00 daily, irregular closures. The official site gives closing days as every Wednesday and the 1st and 4th Tuesdays (may change with bookings), and closes 26 December–5 January. Reservations taken, also online through Pocket Concierge; the phone can be hard to reach during service (Tabelog). About 20% is added for service and taxes (Tabelog). 60 seats in private tatami rooms for 2–6 and larger rooms, with a garden (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). Parking for 5 cars behind the building (Tabelog; official site). Inokuma-dori north of Demizu in Nishijin: 3 min from the Horikawa-Shimochojamachi bus stop, about 20 min on foot from Nijojo-mae or Marutamachi Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Inokuma-dori north of Demizu, Nishijin — 3 min from the Horikawa-Shimochojamachi bus stop
places.cuisine: Yusoku-ryori (court cuisine) and Kyoto kaiseki in private tatami rooms (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · seasonal courses: e.g. sesame tofu, hamo and green-plum soup, sashimi, hassun, ayu grilled live in the room, shiso udon, Kamo eggplant and scallops with miso, sea-bream chazuke, fruit, wagashi and matcha (June 2026) · winter: crab chawanmushi, sun-and-moon hassun on gold and silver plates, grilled black cod in saikyo miso, house karasumi, buri daikon (January 2026) · spring: sweet shrimp and scallops dressed with egg yolk and white miso, clear soup with sesame tofu, steamed sushi, bamboo shoots with Ise lobster (March 2026) · kago bento (October 2026) · Ikama-ryu shikibocho, a ceremonial knife performance, for some events (July 2026)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Nishijin, a 300-year-old ryotei of court cuisine] A ryotei on Inokuma-dori in Nishijin that began in 1722 as a sake brewery, 萬屋, and later became the restaurant 萬亀楼; it formally carries on the Imperial Court's Ikama-ryu ceremonial knife school and yusoku-ryori, and the present head is the tenth generation. Meals are served in private tatami rooms over a garden: seasonal courses with hamo and live-grilled ayu in summer, crab and karasumi in winter, and a kago bento at lunch. Courses run about ¥30,000–40,000 a head with about 20% added; at events there may be shikibocho and maiko. Book ahead.

roles: The tenth-generation head of the house (official site; not named)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in Kyoho 7 (1722) as the sake brewery 萬屋 in a corner of Kyoto's Nishijin, later renamed 萬亀楼 as a restaurant; it formally carries on the Ikama-ryu shikibocho and yusoku-ryori connected with the Imperial Palace; the present head is the tenth generation; the house values sincerity, wisdom and humility (「堅実・賢明・謙虚」). Reviewers give its age as 300 years (January, March 2026) or 400 years (December 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: hospitality first — 「おもてなしの心を第一に」.
chef_bio.specialty: Yusoku-ryori; seasonal kaiseki; Ikama-ryu shikibocho.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 party, after a small-drum recital, watched a ceremonial knife performance before dinner and was joined later by maiko and geiko.
A June 2026 diner timed the visit for the Gion Festival season and saw live ayu grilled in the room, with hamo in soup and as sashimi.
An October 2025 reviewer found the cooking prized purity, beauty and the seasons over bold flavour, served in a quiet tatami room with flowers.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (mankamerou.com): 享保七年 (1722年) 創業、京都西陣の一角で造り酒屋「萬屋」として営みを始め、のちに料理屋として「萬亀楼」と改める、御所ゆかりの生間流式庖丁・有職料理を正式に継承、当代は十代目、「堅実・賢明・謙虚」、上京区猪熊通り出水上ル蛭子町387、定休日は毎週水曜日と第1・第4火曜日、12月26日〜1月5日休み、駐車場5台、市バス堀川下長者町から徒歩3分。食べログ: 日本料理・弁当、上京区猪熊通出水上ル、12:00〜22:00、不定休、予約可 (ポケットコンシェルジュ)、サービス料と税で約20%、60席、個室、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 有職料理、個室の座敷と庭、鱧の吸い物、鮎の焼き物、鯛茶漬け、八寸、かご弁当、女将のもてなし、式包丁と舞妓。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (Pocket Concierge online); private tatami rooms; about 20% service and tax added.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog’s feature list ticks gluten-free options, but no gluten-free dish is described; the menu is wheat pizza, pasta, gnocchi and fritto (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog’s feature list ticks vegan and vegetarian options, but no vegan dish is described; most pizzas carry mozzarella, ricotta or pork (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:30–22:30 (last orders food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Seat-only reservations, 120 minutes (last order at 90), no seat requests (Tabelog); walk-ins welcomed when space allows (December 2025), a queue at night (October 2026). 10% service charge at dinner (from 2 June 2025, Tabelog). Tabelog also ticks halal options; not verified. 40 seats with counter and sofas; non-smoking; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR payments; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). On Kawabata-dori north of Shijo, by the Kamo River; 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawabata-dori north of Shijo, by the Kamo River — 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Neapolitan pizzeria and trattoria with a Stefano Ferrara wood-fired oven from Naples, the fourth shop after Minami Aoyama, Tokyo Midtown and Yokohama (Tabelog, shop text) · pizzas: Margherita, Quattro Formaggi with honey, Chicory (bacon or pork-belly confit, cheese, spinach, onion; the reviewers’ favourite) (2025–26 reviews) · seasonal vegetable fritto, carpaccio, prosciutto and white-asparagus risotto, gnocchi with organic lemon cream, tagliatelle Bolognese, panna cotta · Italian wines; chef’s omakase course (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Pizzeria · Gion, Neapolitan pizza by the Kamo River] The Kyoto branch of Tokyo's Napule, a bright, busy room on Kawabata-dori where pizzas come out of a wood-fired oven built in Naples. Reviewers single out the Chicory — cheese, spinach, onion and bacon — along with a classic Margherita and a honey-drizzled Quattro Formaggi, plus seasonal vegetable fritto and a good panna cotta. Lively and full of visitors from abroad; one May 2026 diner found it too busy to relax. Dinner adds 10% service. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Restaurant of the TERRAMIA group (no chef named)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): the fourth Napule after Minami Aoyama, Tokyo Midtown and Yokohama, baking Neapolitan pizza in a Stefano Ferrara wood-fired oven imported from Naples and using ingredients from Italian producers; Italians living in Japan are said to praise it. Run by a company (a corporate invoice registrant, Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 note many visitors from Europe, America and elsewhere, and some foreign staff whose Japanese was limited (May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Neapolitan pizza; seasonal fritto.

anecdotes.text: "You, who are reading this review! Think only about eating the pizza called "Chicory" right now!" — December 2025.
A January 2026 diner who came for the decorated surprise plate seen on the official account received a plain plate instead and was disappointed.
A May 2026 diner found the room too crowded with foreign visitors to relax and was told some dishes would take a long time.
An October 2026 lunch for one came to just under ¥9,000 with four desserts and coffee to share; the diner wished lunch desserts and coffee were cheaper.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン、東山区川端通四条上る弁財天町4-4 1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)・17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 料理21:30、ドリンク22:00)、水曜休み、席のみの予約 (120分制、L.O. は90分、席の指定不可)、ディナーのみサービス料10% (2025年6月2日〜)、40席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリー・ハラールの対応ありと掲載、南青山・東京ミッドタウン・横浜に続く4店目、ナポリから輸入した Stefano Ferrara の薪窯。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): Chicory、マルゲリータ、クアトロ・フォルマッジと蜂蜜、季節の野菜のフリット、カルパッチョ、リゾット、レモンクリームのニョッキ、ボロネーゼ、パンナコッタ、海外の客が多い、サプライズプレートへの不満。

cultural_comfort.note: Many international guests and some non-Japanese staff (2026 reviews); cards and QR accepted.

places.name: 鮨 泰蔵 (Sushi Taizo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae sushi courses with soy sauce, simmered octopus and chawanmushi; no gluten information (2016–25 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi and seafood courses (2016–25 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Dinner 18:00–21:00 (last order 20:30) Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday; Saturday, Sunday and holidays also lunch 12:00–14:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; a 2023 diner was allowed to bring a baby after asking ahead. 8 counter seats, with a counter in a private room for 4 (Tabelog; January 2022). Non-smoking, with a smoking spot outside; cards (Tabelog). On the Takase River near Kiyamachi and Matsubara, 2 min from the Kawaramachi-Matsubara bus stop, about 10 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; 2022–25 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi near Matsubara, by the Takase River — 10 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small Edomae sushi counter with seasonal fish, appetizers and unusual sakes (2016–25 reviews) · omakase ¥15,000 (June 2025); lunch courses about ¥6,000–7,000 (2022–23) · dishes have included hairy crab, firefly squid, simmered octopus, moroko and homemade karasumi, aji, squid, kohada, sea urchin, brown-sugar ice cream (March 2022) · New Year lunch with small osechi dishes (January 2022)
places.notes: [Sushi · Kiyamachi-Matsubara, a quiet counter on the Takase] An 8-seat sushi counter on the Takase River near Matsubara, plus a little private room with its own counter. Earlier reviews describe a couple running it, a friendly, talkative chef, seasonal Edomae nigiri, homemade karasumi and a good list of unusual sakes; the omakase was ¥15,000 in 2025, with lunch courses on weekends. Book ahead. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: run by a couple (April 2016), with a friendly head chef and lady of the house (November 2018); in business for over eight years by March 2022; a solo diner in June 2025 enjoyed talking with the friendly chef.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase Edomae sushi.

anecdotes.text: A July 2023 diner booked lunch with a 5-month-old baby after checking with the shop, and thanked staff and other guests for their understanding.
"Since I was traveling alone, I enjoyed engaging conversations with the friendly chef" — June 2025.

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; omakase at the counter; the chef chats with guests; cards accepted.
