places.name: 居酒屋 ニエフ (Izakaya Niefu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Fried fish with homemade tartar, tempura, salt-fried chicken, simmered dishes and somen; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-led izakaya with dashi-based dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 Tuesday–Saturday; closed Sunday, Monday and on some days in summer and winter (Tabelog). Reservations recommended, also via TableCheck (September 2026); walk-ins sometimes find counter seats late (September 2026). The chef cooks alone, so dishes can take time (July 2026). Portions sized for two, adjusted for three on request (May 2026). 14 seats at an L-shaped counter and two small tables, up a steep wooden staircase; another restaurant is on the ground floor (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). The air conditioning felt weak in July 2026. Non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). A few minutes north of Shijo-Omiya Stn; the sign is easy to miss (2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: North of Shijo-Omiya, 2nd floor — a few minutes from Shijo-Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Seafood-led creative izakaya with Kyoto-style obanzai (2026 reviews) · salt-seared bonito, assorted sashimi (bonito, aji), mehikari, simmered whelk and other clams, mozuku in vinegar · fried aji or sawara with homemade tartar, young-ayu tempura, white-shrimp tempura · salt-fried chicken thighs, jidori neck and lotus root stir-fry · potato salad with nagaimo and smoked daikon, white sesame tofu with figs and grapes, komatsuna and mushroom ohitashi · sudachi somen, jako fried rice · sake; dishes around ¥1,500 each (September 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Omiya, a 2nd-floor seafood counter] A 14-seat izakaya up a steep wooden staircase north of Shijo-Omiya — the name, reviewers work out, is '2F'. One chef cooks fresh seafood with care: salt-seared bonito, fried aji or sawara with homemade tartar, young-ayu tempura, simmered whelk, plus salt-fried chicken thighs and a smoked-daikon potato salad, with sake. Most dishes are about ¥1,500 and sized for two. Book ahead; dishes can be slow, and one October 2026 diner found the staff unfriendly. Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–23:00.

roles: Chef who runs the kitchen alone (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: A July 2026 reviewer notes that the chef runs the kitchen alone, so service takes time; reviewers in May and October 2026 take the name to mean "2F", as the shop is on the second floor above another restaurant. Tabelog Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Salt-seared bonito; fried fish with homemade tartar; salt-fried chicken.

anecdotes.text: "Since the chef is the only one running the kitchen, it takes quite a while for the dishes to be served, but the quality is definitely worth the wait." — July 2026.
An October 2026 repeat visitor found most dishes ordinary, the value poor and the staff unfriendly, apart from the mehikari.
"Since we visited with three, they kindly adjusted our order from two servings to three." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区壬生坊城町47 2F、四条大宮駅から343m、火〜土 17:00〜23:00、日・月休み (夏と冬に不定休)、予約可、14席 (カウンターとテーブル)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 2階の店で名前は「2F」から、料理人が一人で調理、かつおの塩たたき、刺身盛り合わせ、めひかり、つぶ貝の煮付け、自家製タルタルのあじフライと鰆フライ、稚鮎の天ぷら、鶏ももの塩唐揚げ、燻製大根と長芋のポテサラ、すだちそうめん、じゃこ炒飯、1品約1,500円、提供は遅め、無愛想だったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (TableCheck); dishes come for two; cards and QR accepted.

places.name: 和栗専門 紗織 (Waguri Senmon Saori)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The Mont Blanc sits on a baked meringue base, but some versions include sponge cake, and tarts and pies are wheat-based; no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chestnut cream with fresh cream and meringue (egg white); fruit parfaits with cream and sorbet (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:00) daily; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Numbered tickets are handed out from 9:00 (earlier if a queue forms); they set the order, not a time, and you are messaged when your turn comes; takeaway from 11:00 (Tabelog). Reservations online; by phone for one person or for 10 or more; tables are held for one hour and a booking lapses 15 minutes after the time (Tabelog). Some items sell out depending on the time (Tabelog). 34 seats (6 counter, 28 table) including a 2nd floor overlooking the river; non-smoking; cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On Kiyamachi-dori north of Matsubara by the Takase River; 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi-dori north of Matsubara, by the Takase River — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese-chestnut specialist whose Mont Blanc is piped in 1 mm strands in front of you (Tabelog, shop text; 2026 reviews) · Kinshi Mont Blanc "Sa" with Kyotanba chestnuts only, limited to 40 a day, ¥3,080 (September–October 2026) · smaller Mont Blanc "Tsumugi" with a drink ¥1,800 (September 2026) · chestnut mochi ¥1,980 (September 2026) · seasonal fruit parfaits with Mont Blanc (shine muscat and Nagano Purple grapes, Arakawa peach), a chestnut tart and a whole chestnut pie (2026 reviews) · drinks such as cold-brewed sencha; a small cup of dashi as a palate cleanser (September 2026)
places.notes: [Mont Blanc · Kiyamachi, chestnut threads 1 mm thin] A calm Japanese-chestnut café on Kiyamachi by the Takase River, opened in 2019, where a machine pipes chestnut paste into 1 mm threads at your table. The top Mont Blanc, 'Sa', uses only Kyotanba chestnuts (¥3,080, 40 a day); 'Tsumugi' is a smaller one with a drink (¥1,800), and seasonal parfaits pair the Mont Blanc with grapes or peaches. A sip of dashi resets the palate. Get a numbered ticket from 9:00 or book online. Open daily 10:00–18:00.

roles: Company-run shop (a corporate invoice registrant, Tabelog); no staff named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): Mont Blanc with chestnut strands as thin as 1 mm, freshly made with carefully selected ingredients, plus seasonal fruit options. A September 2026 reviewer says it opened in October 2019. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "Delivering exquisite products filled with the producers’ passion to many people."
chef_bio.specialty: Kinshi Mont Blanc "Sa".

anecdotes.text: "They squeeze chestnut cream right in front of you!" — September 2026.
An October 2026 diner felt that at over ¥3,000 the Mont Blanc ought to taste exceptional, while finding it quite delicious.
"I felt there might be a bit too much meringue inside. I think it could use a bit more cream." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スイーツ・カフェ・洋菓子、下京区木屋町通松原上る二丁目和泉屋町170-1、京都河原町駅から徒歩5分、毎日10:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:00)、不定休、整理券は毎朝9:00から配布 (時間指定ではなく順番)、テイクアウトは11:00から、予約可 (1名・10名以上は電話、席は1時間、15分遅れでキャンセル扱い)、34席 (カウンター6、テーブル28)、禁煙、カード・交通系IC・PayPay 可、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2026、1mm の和栗のモンブラン。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): 2019年10月開店、Kyotanba の栗だけの錦糸モンブラン「Sa」3,080円 (1日40食)、「Tsumugi」ドリンク付き1,800円、栗餅1,980円、季節の果物のパフェ、目の前で絞る、口直しの出汁、2階から川の眺め。

cultural_comfort.note: Take a numbered ticket or book online; cards, IC and PayPay accepted.

places.name: Café DOnG by Sfera (カフェ・ドン バイ スフェラ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tarts, pudding and wagashi from Shogetsu are the sweets; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. An August 2026 reviewer praised the café’s "commitment to quality vegan food" and the menu offers soy lattes, but the lavender pudding and cheese tart are not vegan; nothing is marked on Tabelog (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); closed Wednesday; hours may change for events — check Instagram (Tabelog). No seat reservations; wagashi from Shogetsu can be reserved by phone for Friday–Sunday (Tabelog; May 2026). No service charge (Tabelog). 30 seats — tables, sunken kotatsu, sofas and a terrace; smoking only on the terrace or outside (Tabelog). Pets allowed inside in a cart or bag (July and October 2026). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). On the semi-basement floor of the Sfera building by the Shirakawa, with galleries and the Sfera shop upstairs; 5 min from Gion-Shijo or Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Formerly named せせらぎ すへら (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: By the Shirakawa between Sanjo and Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Design café of the Kyoto homeware brand Sfera, with a weekend wagashi set from Shogetsu (2026 reviews) · Shogetsu set: a seasonal wagashi (chestnut kinton, warabi-mochi) with a drink, Friday–Sunday, ¥1,500 (July 2026); seasonal wagashi set Kōgetsu ¥1,800 (October 2026) · organic lavender pudding with iced coffee ¥1,500 (August 2026); tart of the day with tea; matcha "Fujiyama", matcha soy latte, Awaban tea · Kyoto Brewing’s Ichigo Ichie saison ¥1,200 (August 2026)
places.notes: [Café · Shirakawa, a design café with weekend Shogetsu wagashi] A calm, spacious café on the semi-basement floor of the Sfera building, home of the Kyoto homeware brand, near the Shirakawa between Sanjo and Shijo. Seats range from sofas to sunken kotatsu and a terrace, and everything — chairs, cups, plates — is designed. On Friday to Sunday it serves seasonal wagashi from Shogetsu with a drink (¥1,500–1,800; reserve the sweets by phone); otherwise try the organic lavender pudding or the tart of the day. Pets in a carrier welcome. 12:00–19:00, closed Wednesday.

roles: Café of Sfera (homeware brand; official site); no person is named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Sfera designs furniture, tableware and home accessories in natural materials made with traditional hand techniques. Tabelog: formerly せせらぎ すへら; invoice T9130001053604. Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025 (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Shogetsu wagashi set (weekends); lavender pudding.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor phoned the same day and was kindly let reserve Shogetsu wagashi, though a day’s notice is usual.
A June 2026 visitor loved the interior and tableware but found the air conditioning weak on a 33 °C day.
An October 2026 visitor arriving on a gloomy Sunday at 13:00 had the room to choose from.

places.name: La Mer giki (ラ・メール・ギキ)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the shop asks for allergies and dislikes at booking (official site). Courses include bread, tarts, sauces and desserts.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood-led French courses with duck, oysters, beef, lobster and fish (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–21:30 (last order 19:30); closed Tuesday and irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Phone bookings 9:00–12:00 (Tabelog); the La Mer course can be booked the same day, the bouillabaisse, lobster and special courses two days ahead (official site). 50% charge for same-day cancellations (Tabelog). 12 seats (10 at tables, 2 at the counter), exclusive hire from 9 guests (Tabelog). Cards and QR (Tabelog). An attic room on the 2nd floor west of Kawaramachi-Takatsuji; 5 min from Hankyu Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; February 2025).
places.neighborhood: West of Kawaramachi-Takatsuji — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Seafood-minded French in an attic room, by owner Shingo Giki (official site) · lunch A ¥4,500 and B ¥5,300 courses (official site) · dinner La Mer course ¥6,500: amuse, starter, three-layer soup, fish, a main from duck with honey-mustard, oysters Burgundy-style, beef cheek in red wine (+¥800), beef steak (+¥1,400) or roast lobster (+¥1,800), dessert and coffee; bouillabaisse course ¥6,700 (risotto to finish); lobster course ¥9,000; special course with lobster and Kagoshima beef fillet ¥11,000 (official site) · signatures reviewers name: Kintoki-carrot mousse, the hot-and-cold three-layer soup, oysters Burgundy-style, Mont Blanc (2023–26 reviews) · osechi boxes for New Year (official site)
places.notes: [French · Kawaramachi-Takatsuji, a seafood French in the attic] A twelve-seat attic restaurant west of Kawaramachi-Takatsuji, decorated after the sea of the south of France and of the owner-chef's home, where Shingo Giki cooks French food built on Japanese seafood. The La Mer dinner course (¥6,500) runs from a Kintoki-carrot mousse and a hot-and-cold three-layer soup to a main such as oysters Burgundy-style or duck with honey and mustard; bouillabaisse and lobster courses need two days' notice. Lunch from ¥4,500. Reviewers find it charming and unpretentious; on weekdays the chef's wife may serve. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (official site: 代表 冝喜 慎吾（ギキ シンゴ）) and chef; the chef’s wife sometimes serves (March 2024)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: La Mer is French for "the sea"; the interior evokes the sea of southern France and the sea of the owner’s home town; the aim is inventive cooking beyond the bounds of French, drawing on Japan’s fresh seafood, for guests including those who come from across the sea. A March 2024 regular notes that the chef usually handles everything and was helped that weekday by the chef’s wife.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to bring out the best in fresh ingredients, especially Japan’s seafood, in cooking full of originality.
chef_bio.specialty: Three-layer soup; oysters Burgundy-style; Kintoki-carrot mousse.

A September 2026 diner enjoyed everything but found a few too many sweet dishes.
A February 2026 couple singled out the mushroom sauce on daikon and beef.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (la-mergiki.com): 屋根裏レストラン ラメールギキ、La Mer はフランス語で「海」、店内は南仏の海と故郷の海のイメージ、代表 冝喜 慎吾 (ギキ シンゴ)、下京区茶磨屋町228-2、ランチ12:00〜15:00 (LO 13:00)、ディナー18:00〜21:30 (LO 19:30)、火曜定休 (不定休あり)、ランチ A コース4,500円・B コース5,300円 (税込)、ラメールコース6,500円 (メインは鴨のロースト、カキのブルゴーニュ風、国産牛ホホ肉の赤ワイン煮込み+800円、牛肉のステーキ+1,400円、オマール海老のロースト+1,800円)、ブイヤベースコース6,700円、オマール海老コース9,000円、特別コース11,000円 (2日前までの予約)、苦手な食材・アレルギーは予約時に、2027年のお節料理。食べログ: フレンチ・ビストロ、予約は9時〜12時、当日キャンセルは50%、12席 (テーブル10、カウンター2)、貸切は9名以上、カード・QR 可。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 金時人参のムース、3層のスープ、カキのブルゴーニュ風、モンブラン、平日はシェフの奥さんがサービス。

places.name: 休憩処 さるや (Saruya, Shimogamo Shrine)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The 申餅 is a rice-cake sweet with bean paste and the summer ice uses syrups and shiratama; the monaka has a wafer shell; no ingredient list is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The 申餅, bean tea, zenzai and matcha-azuki ice are plant-based in principle, but the strawberry and black-sugar ices come with milk and no ingredient list is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–16:30 every day (official site; Tabelog); hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Pay at a ticket machine (November 2026). Summer kakigori is served until about mid-September (August 2026) and can take over 20 minutes in the busy season (August 2026). 60 seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; paid parking at the shrine; children welcome (Tabelog). Inside the grounds of Shimogamo Shrine; 2 min from the Tadasu-no-mori-mae bus stop, 10 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 15 May 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shimogamo Shrine grounds, Tadasu-no-mori — 10 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Rest house of Shimogamo Shrine serving the shrine’s own sweets (official site) · 申餅 (saru-mochi), the Aoi Matsuri rice cake pounded with azuki cooking water to a pale "hanezu" pink, revived after about 140 years; with まめ豆茶, a roasted black-soybean tea from Tanba, ¥500 (October 2026); the set with cold bean tea ¥550 (Tabelog menu, 2012) · 良縁ぜんざい made with Tanba dainagon azuki offered at the Aioi shrine (official site) · summer 鴨の氷室の氷 kakigori (matcha-azuki with Hosendo’s Tanba dainagon bean paste, black sugar with shiratama, strawberry milk) ¥1,300, with hojicha (August 2026) · Aoi monaka, iced green tea (August 2026)
places.notes: [Wagashi tea house · Shimogamo Shrine, the revived Aoi Matsuri rice cake] A tea house inside the grounds of Shimogamo Shrine, by the Tadasu-no-mori woods. Its signature is the 申餅, the Aoi Matsuri rice cake coloured a dawn pink with azuki water and revived after some 140 years, served with まめ豆茶, a black-soybean tea that was once the drink of the shrine's priests (¥500). In summer it shaves 'ice of the Kamo ice house' with Hosendo bean paste (¥1,300); in winter, zenzai of Tanba azuki. Pay at the machine; free refills of hojicha. Daily 10:00–16:30.

roles: Shimogamo Shrine rest house (official shrine site); sweets made with Hosendo bean paste per an August 2026 review; no person is named
chef_bio.background: Per the official shrine site: the 申餅, offered to the deities on the Aoi Matsuri day until early Meiji, was revived after 140 years; the black-soybean tea was the drink of shrine priests during purification and is made only from Tanba black soybeans, once from the shrine’s estates; the summer ice is named after the shrine’s old ice house. A November 2026 review says local wagashi artisans revived the 申餅 in 2010 from the shrine’s oral tradition. The background of kyoto_hosen_kyoto_station lists 下鴨神社 さるや among 宝泉’s outlets. Opened 15 May 2011 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official shrine site: eating the 申餅 purifies the body and brings good health, after the old custom.
chef_bio.specialty: 申餅 with まめ豆茶; summer ice; 良縁ぜんざい.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family waited over 20 minutes for the kakigori in the summer heat.
A September 2026 visitor found the 申餅’s filling "not overly sweet, perfectly seasoned".
An October 2026 visitor noted the free refills of warm hojicha.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 下鴨神社の公式サイト (shimogamo-jinja.or.jp): 休憩処 さるや、下鴨神社境内、10:00〜16:30、「鴨の氷室の氷」(下鴨神社の氷室神事にならった夏のかき氷)、「良縁ぜんざい」(相生社に供えるあずき、最高級の丹波大納言小豆、紅白餅)、冬季メニュー「下鴨神社 まめ豆茶」(神社社領のあった丹波地方の黒豆、潔斎期間中の神官の飲み物)、「申餅」(葵祭りの日に小豆の茹で汁で搗いた御餅、はねず色、140年ぶりに復元)。食べログ: 甘味処・カフェ・和菓子、左京区下鴨泉川町59、糺の森前バス停から徒歩約2分、出町柳駅から徒歩約10分、毎日10:00〜16:30、予約不可、60席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、駐車場あり (有料)、2011年5月15日オープン。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): 申餅とまめ豆茶500円、かき氷1,300円 (Hosendo の丹波大納言のあん)、Aoi Monaka、券売機、ほうじ茶のおかわり。

cultural_comfort.note: Buy a ticket at the machine; free hojicha refills.

places.name: 亀屋良長 本店 (Kameya Yoshinaga Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Mostly bean-paste wagashi; a September 2026 reviewer saw new gluten-free products such as a bean-paste spread for bread, while monaka, castella-style An no Hako and baked sweets contain wheat; no full ingredient list was read (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Ubatama (black-sugar bean-paste balls coated in agar) and many bean-paste sweets are plant-based in principle, but no ingredient list was read; An no Hako combines Western-pastry technique (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Shop 9:30–18:00 and tea room 11:00–17:00, every day; closed 1–2 January (Tabelog). The online shop’s phone line runs 9:00–17:30, closed 1–3 January (official site). Takeaway mainly; the tea room has 4 seats at 2 tables and serves fresh wagashi and kakigori (Tabelog; September 2026); the 吉村和菓子店 corner is at the back (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR; paper bags for a fee (Tabelog; September 2026). On Shijo-dori west of Aburanokoji; 5–6 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori between Omiya and Horikawa — 5 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto confectioner founded in 1803 (official site), branched from Kameya Yoshian and settled at Shijo Sakai for its water (2026 reviews); brands 亀屋良長, Satomi Fujita and 吉村和菓子店 (official site) · 烏羽玉 (ubatama): jet-black balls of smooth bean paste made with Hateruma black sugar, coated in agar, 6 for ¥540 (Tabelog menu, January 2026; 2026 reviews); seasonal assortments such as apricot-lemon ¥648 (September 2026) · Kyo Monaka about ¥300, An no Hako (castella-like bean-paste cake), Ichiyo Raifuku bean crackers, instant shiruko Hane Usagi ¥540 with a fortune slip (2026 reviews) · slice yokan, monaka, rice-cake sweets, baked sweets, senbei, higashi (official site) · fresh wagashi and kakigori in the 4-seat tea room (September 2026)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Shijo-Horikawa, a confectioner since 1803] An old Kyoto confectioner on Shijo-dori, founded in 1803 and still making its signature 烏羽玉: small jet-black balls of smooth bean paste and Hateruma black sugar, glossy with agar (six for ¥540). The bright, renovated shop also sells modern lines — An no Hako, bean-paste spreads, seasonal assortments — under the 亀屋良長, Satomi Fujita and 吉村和菓子店 names, and a four-seat tea room serves fresh wagashi and summer kakigori. Mostly takeaway. Daily 9:30–18:00.

roles: Family confectioner; the site links to the 八代目 (eighth generation) and the okami on X; no names read
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1803; brands 亀屋良長, Satomi Fujita and 吉村和菓子店; wagashi-making classes and a collaboration with SOU・SOU. Per 2026 reviews: an independent offshoot of Kameya Yoshian from the Edo period, which settled at Shijo-Sakai for good water; the ubatama, made with Hateruma black sugar, has been made since the founding (September 2026); a September 2026 visitor found the store newly opened and beautiful, staffed by polite young women, with new gluten-free products.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per 2026 reviews: cherishing traditional Kyoto sweets while bringing in techniques and ingredients from Western confectionery.
chef_bio.specialty: 烏羽玉; Kyo Monaka; An no Hako.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor called the ubatama "small, jet-black balls beautifully arranged" that shimmered in the light.
An October 2026 buyer found the shiruko easy to make, with a fortune slip read from the shape of its amber jelly.
An October 2026 visitor thought the Ichiyo Raifuku bean crackers deserve to be better known.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kameya-yoshinaga.com): 創業1803年の京菓子司 亀屋良長、ブランド: 亀屋良長、Satomi Fujita、吉村和菓子店、烏羽玉、スライスようかん、もなか、おしるこ、涼菓、餅菓子、焼き菓子、せんべい、干菓子、羊羹、和菓子手づくり教室、SOU・SOU×亀屋良長、電話 9:00〜17:30 (1月1日〜3日休み)。食べログ: 和菓子、下京区四条通油小路西入柏屋町17-19、大宮駅から351m、販売9:30〜18:00、茶房11:00〜17:00、1月1日・2日休み、4席 (2卓)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、テイクアウト、奥に吉村和菓子店のコーナー、メニュー (2026年1月更新): 烏羽玉 (6個) 540円。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 烏羽玉 (Hateruma の黒糖)、An no Hako、Kyo Monaka、Ichiyo Raifuku、Hane Usagi のおしるこ540円、1803年創業、Kameya Yoshian からの暖簾分け、グルテンフリーの品も。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly takeaway; a four-seat tea room for fresh wagashi.

places.name: BASSANOVA 京都店 (BASSANOVA Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles in every bowl (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the green-curry, tom yum and laksa broths come with chicken chashu, and one diner tasted a seafood base (June 2025).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 11:00–15:00 and 16:00–21:00; hours may change. A diner in July 2024 found it open on a Wednesday although a website listed Wednesday as closed; it once stayed open late at night (December 2023). Ticket machine; no reservations; cards and QR, though one diner found PayPay missing (Tabelog; 2023 review). Counter and some tables; non-smoking (Tabelog; January 2024). Opened 1 July 2023 (Tabelog). At the back of the 舟木ビル off the Teramachi Kyogoku arcade, an entrance that is easy to miss (2024 reviews); 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn.
places.neighborhood: Off the Teramachi arcade north of Shijo — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Thai-style ramen from the Shindaita (Tokyo) shop known for green-curry ramen (reviews) · green curry ramen — creamy coconut broth, mild heat, medium-thick curly noodles, grilled chicken chashu, menma, wood ear, red onion and greens — ¥1,200 (2024–January 2026), ¥1,700 (July 2026); tom yum kung ramen ¥1,200 (January 2026); laksa ramen ¥1,300 (November 2024); cold versions in summer · toppings: coriander ¥200, egg ¥200, chicken chashu ¥250; chashu rice bowl ¥600; a cheese risotto to finish the soup (2024–2025 reviews) · beer
places.notes: [Ramen · Teramachi, Thai curry ramen] The Kyoto branch, opened July 2023, of BASSANOVA, the Shindaita ramen shop that made green-curry ramen its name: a creamy, gently spiced coconut broth with curly noodles and grilled chicken chashu, plus tom yum and laksa versions and cold bowls in summer. Hidden at the back of a building off the Teramachi arcade. Prices rose in 2026 (green curry ¥1,700 in July); some diners now find it pricey for the portion. 11:00–15:00, 16:00–21:00.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: BASSANOVA began in Shindaita, Tokyo, nearly 20 years before a December 2023 visit, first known for Hakata noodles in a rich pork-bone broth with Japanese dashi and then for Thai curry ramen; a January 2024 diner names locations in Shindaita and Shinjuku and calls Kyoto the first in Kansai, opened in July 2023 (Tabelog: 1 July 2023). A December 2023 diner noticed the noodles are now medium-thin and chewy rather than Hakata-style.
chef_bio.specialty: Green curry ramen.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner said it tasted almost the same as Nissin’s instant green curry ramen — "In a way, it made me appreciate the greatness of Nissin!"
A July 2026 regular found the green curry ramen lukewarm, with cold toppings, and wondered whether ¥1,700 was worth it.
"I have visited BASSANOVA several times since it opened in Shindaita nearly 20 years ago." — December 2023.

places.name: 秀秀生煎 京都本店 (Shushu Shenjian Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pan-fried soup dumplings in a wheat wrapper, scallion-oil noodles and wontons (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dumplings are pork (or shrimp and pork) in chicken stock (Tabelog), though side dishes such as dried tofu salad and wood ear with mustard greens appear in the sets (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:00–20:30, closed Tuesday. Bookings by phone only (Tabelog; diners also booked through Tabelog in 2025–2026). 10 seats at five tables for two; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). PayPay only, no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Order by smartphone; self-service water (June 2026). Takeaway and delivery (Tabelog; April 2025). English menu (Tabelog). Opened 18 January 2022 (Tabelog). In the 舟木ビル off the Teramachi arcade, behind a large xiaolongbao model at the door (August 2026); 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn.
places.neighborhood: Off the Teramachi arcade north of Shijo — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Shanghai-style pan-fried soup dumplings (shengjian), handmade and wrapped just before cooking with fresh pork and a chicken stock (Tabelog) · original pork and green-skinned shrimp-and-pork shengjian, with black vinegar · sets: Manpuku set ¥1,780 (April 2026); four dumplings with two small sides (dried tofu salad, wood ear with pickled mustard greens, spicy kombu) and Chinese tea such as white-peach oolong (2026) · Shanghai scallion-oil noodles ¥580, Sichuan red-oil wontons · Tsingtao beer, highballs
places.notes: [Soup dumplings · Teramachi, Shanghai shengjian] A 10-seat Shanghai-style shop for pan-fried soup dumplings — crisp-bottomed, wrapped to order and full of hot broth (bite carefully, add black vinegar) — in the original pork or a green-skinned shrimp version, sold in sets with small sides and Chinese tea. Manpuku set ¥1,780 (2026). Reviews split: many love the juicy dumplings; a November 2025 diner found the noodles and wontons poor and the service cold. 11:00–20:30, closed Tuesday; PayPay only.

roles: Shop (operator not named on the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction: opened in January 2022 (opening day 18 January 2022), proud of handmade xiaolongbao wrapped just before cooking with flavourful chicken stock and fresh pork, three good-value sets for drinking, and a retro Shanghai interior. An April 2025 diner heard from staff that Uber Eats couriers collect often; another found the room full of overseas guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Pan-fried soup dumplings (shengjian).

anecdotes.text: "I still wonder why the skin is green, but the burst of shrimp flavor is irresistible." — April 2025.
A November 2025 diner found the dumplings full of soup but the scallion-oil noodles and wontons disappointing, and the male staff member expressionless and cold.
"The staff kindly explained how to eat the hot xiaolongbao, and there were instructions on the menu as well." — September 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The tea room serves matcha and other teas with wagashi, ice cream, a matcha roll cake and summer shaved ice (official menu); the sweets are not described.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The teas themselves (matcha, sencha, gyokuro, hojicha, genmaicha) suit, but the ice creams, roll cake and cream teas use dairy, and the wagashi are not described (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Official site: shop 9:30–18:00; tea room 10:30–17:00 last order (closing 17:30); closed every Wednesday, the third Tuesday and the New Year. Tabelog gives Wednesday closed (open on holidays). No reservations for seats; the take-home matcha roll cake (¥3,780 a 15 cm roll) is by phone order only, not on the day, collected at the shop (official site). The tea room seats about 10–13 and includes a two-mat tea room (no tea ceremony performed) facing a garden; non-smoking; children welcome (official site; Tabelog). Cards, IC and QR payments (Tabelog). On Nishinotoin-dori south of Oike; 6 min walk from Karasuma Oike or Nijojo-mae stations (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishinotoin-dori south of Oike — 6 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Shop and tea room of the Uji tea house Marukyu Koyamaen, founded in the Genroku era (official site; October 2026 review) · usucha 「雅の院」 (this shop only) with wagashi ¥1,595; 「長安」 usucha ¥2,035 or koicha ¥2,860 with wagashi; gyokuro 「滴の院」 with wagashi ¥2,255; hojicha with wagashi ¥1,430 · Uji matcha ice cream ¥990, Kyoto hojicha ice cream ¥880; matcha roll cake set ¥1,925 (a slice ¥1,100, sold out daily) · summer: matcha shaved ice ¥1,210, matcha-azuki shaved ice ¥1,320; winter: matcha zenzai · koicha rice until 14:00 (official menu, tax included) · matcha, gyokuro and sencha to buy, soft-serve to take away in summer (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Tea room · Nishinotoin-Oike, an Uji tea house's own shop] The Kyoto shop of Marukyu Koyamaen, a tea house from the Genroku era: buy matcha and gyokuro in front, then sit in the small tea room Motoan at the back, looking onto a garden, for usucha and wagashi (from ¥1,595), Uji matcha ice cream (¥990) or the matcha roll cake set (¥1,925), with shaved ice in summer. Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. No bookings for seats; the tea room is small. 9:30–18:00 (tea room to 17:00 last order), closed Wednesdays and the third Tuesday.

roles: Directly run shop of the tea company 丸久小山園 (Uji)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Marukyu Koyamaen’s directly run shops are all in Kyoto — the headquarters shop, this Nishinotoin shop with the tea room 元庵, and counters in JR Kyoto Isetan and Kyoto Takashimaya; the Nishinotoin shop sells matcha, gyokuro, sencha and genmaicha and matcha sweets, and its tea room includes a proper two-mat tea room where the menu can be enjoyed without a tea ceremony. An October 2026 review gives the founding as the Genroku era and the tea room as a renovated 100-year-old townhouse. Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Usucha with wagashi; matcha roll cake.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 buyer of the summer Uji matcha kanten jelly was disappointed to find the matcha in a separate packet to sprinkle on.
A September 2026 visitor’s friend quoted the Southern Song poet Lu You on the rainy Kyoto afternoon over a cup of matcha.
"Although it's a bit away from the bustling area, there are many foreign visitors." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (marukyu-koyamaen.co.jp): 西洞院店・茶房「元庵」、ショップは抹茶・玉露・煎茶・玄米茶と抹茶のお菓子、茶房は抹茶・煎茶・ほうじ茶と和菓子のセット、アイスクリーム、ロールケーキ (席数13)、本格的な二畳の茶室 (茶道の点前はなし)、中京区西洞院通御池下ル西側、茶房10:30〜17:00ラストオーダー (17:30閉店)、売店9:30〜18:00、毎週水曜日・第3火曜日・年末年始休み、メニュー (税込): 抹茶「雅の院」(西洞院店限定) 薄茶と和菓子1,595円、宇治抹茶アイスクリーム990円、京ほうじ茶アイスクリーム880円、抹茶「長安」薄茶と和菓子2,035円・濃茶と和菓子2,860円、玉露「滴の院」と和菓子2,255円、ほうじ茶と和菓子1,430円、抹茶のロールケーキセット1,925円 (1カット1,100円、予約不可・売り切れ次第終了)、抹茶かき氷「京氷室」1,210円・抹茶あずき氷1,320円 (夏季のみ)、抹茶ぜんざい (冬季のみ)、濃茶の薄葉ごはん1,600円 (午後2時まで)、持ち帰りのロールケーキ1本3,780円 (完全事前電話予約制)。会社概要: 直営店は京都のみ (本社直売店、西洞院店・茶房元庵、ジェイアール京都伊勢丹店、京都高島屋店)。食べログ: カフェ・甘味処・かき氷、水曜休み (祝日は営業)、10席、禁煙、子供可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。

cultural_comfort.note: Order tea sets from a short menu in the small tea room; the official site has Chinese pages; no bookings.

places.name: 京・富小路 天ぷら吉川 (Kyo Tominokoji Tempura Yoshikawa)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the official site says the restaurant cannot cater for gluten-free diets; the cooking is battered tempura.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the official site says vegan diets cannot be catered for; a vegetarian menu is offered for an extra charge.
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: tempura counter lunch 11:00–13:30 last order (closes 15:00), dinner 17:30–20:00 last order (closes 22:00); private rooms lunch 12:00–13:30 and dinner 17:30–19:30 last order; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (may open by season; counter closed 31 Dec and 1 Jan). Reservation only; same-day changes to numbers or diet requests cannot be accommodated; cancellation fees apply; 30 minutes late without contact counts as a cancellation (Tabelog). Service charge: private rooms 15%, counter 5% at dinner only (Tabelog; official site). Counter: no children aged 5 or under; private rooms take children with a kids’ course from ¥3,000 (official site; Tabelog). About 100 seats: 8 private rooms with garden views, a hall for up to 25, and the counter (8 seats per Tabelog; 11 per an August 2026 review); designated smoking area, e-cigarettes only in private rooms; paid parking for 3 cars by reservation (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Tominokoji south of Oike; 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Tominokoji south of Oike — 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto itamae tempura at a counter made from the ryokan’s tea room in 1964, and tempura kaiseki in garden rooms (official site) · counter lunch ¥6,600: 12 pieces — starting and ending with shrimp, with seasonal vegetables (okra, lily bulb, pumpkin, Kamo eggplant), conger eel, squid, scallop, manakatsuo — with rice, red miso soup and pickles; add-ons such as kakiage, tendon or tencha (+¥1,100) (2026 reviews) · dinner and private-room courses with sashimi and 14 pieces, finishing with kakiage rice bowl or tempura chazuke; special hamo, crab, fugu and kue courses (official site; August 2026) · matcha salt and tempura dashi (October 2026) · vegetarian menu for an extra charge (official site)
places.notes: [Tempura · Tominokoji-Oike, a ryokan's tea-room counter] A cooking ryokan founded in 1952 in an early-Taisho sukiya house with part of a garden attributed to Kobori Enshu; in 1964 it turned the tea room into a tempura counter, rare in Kyoto then. Counter lunch of 12 pieces, shrimp first and last, ¥6,600 (2026); dinners and garden-room kaiseki cost more. Tempura Tabelog 100 2022, 2023, 2025. The house cannot cater for vegan or gluten-free diets. One June 2026 diner found the batter thick and the service hurried. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday; reservation only.

roles: Cooking ryokan (料理旅館) and tempura counter; no chef named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Yoshikawa opened in 1952 on its present site as an inn; the sukiya building dates from the early Taisho era, and the main garden, about a third of the property, is older and is said to be by Kobori Enshu; the house was once the home of the poet 江馬天江, who was involved in founding what is now Ritsumeikan University, and works by 太田垣蓮月 and 富岡鉄斎 remain; the eight rooms are each furnished differently; itamae tempura, then rare in Kyoto, began in 1964, the year of the Tokyo Olympics, in a converted tea room. Tabelog gives the opening day as 1 February 1952. Diners in October 2026 had come for over 20 and 30 years; one notes more tourists, including overseas guests, than before.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to be a cooking ryokan where guests feel as relaxed as on coming home ("okaeriyasu").
chef_bio.specialty: Counter tempura lunch; kakiage.

anecdotes.text: "I've been coming here for 30 years… I always place an additional order at the end, and that’s for the kakiage." — October 2026.
A June 2026 diner found the lily bulb and pumpkin slightly hard, the batter thick, and the serving and handling of utensils hurried.
A July 2026 family celebrated a daughter’s wedding with a tempura course in a garden-view private room during the Gion Festival.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-yoshikawa.co.jp): 料理旅館・天ぷら 吉川、京都御苑近く、戦後に料理旅館として創業、「退享園」(退去園) と呼ばれた小堀遠州作と伝わる庭園、豪商の住まいの数奇屋造りの館。吉川について: 1952年に片泊まりの宿として創業、建物は大正初期、庭は小堀遠州作と聞き及ぶ、漢詩人の江馬天江の住まい、太田垣蓮月尼や富岡鉄斎の作品、八室のしつらえはすべて異なる、1964年の東京オリンピックに合わせて茶室を改装して板前天ぷらを始めた。お食事: お昼12:00〜13:30 L.O. (15時閉館)、夜17:30〜19:30 L.O. (22時閉館)、天ぷら会席、ハモ・蟹・フグ・クエの特別コース、消費税・奉仕料15%別、ベジタリアン対応 (追加料金)、ヴィーガン・グルテンフリーは対応致しかねます、天ぷらカウンター 11:00〜13:30 L.O.・17:30〜20:00 L.O.、奉仕料5% (昼のカウンターは消費税のみ)、5歳以下は不可、カウンター貸切 (最大10名)、法事やお子様メニュー。食べログ: 天ぷら・日本料理・料理旅館、中京区富小路通御池下ル松下町135、火・水曜休み、完全予約制、100席 (個室8、広間最大25名、カウンター8席)、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、カード可、駐車場3台 (要予約)、1952年2月1日オープン、天ぷら百名店 2022・2023・2025。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): カウンターのランチ6,600円で12品、海老で始まり海老で終わる、天茶+1,100円、抹茶塩と天つゆ、30年通う客。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); reservation only; vegetarian menu on request (extra charge).

places.name: 日本酒とお料理 お湯 (Nihonshu to Oryori Oyu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, sashimi, simmered pork cartilage with ponzu, spring rolls, tempura and keema curry; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: obanzai and snacks with fish (shirasu, herring, sardines), pork and tuna; the appetiser is shirasu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 14:00–22:00, last food order 21:00, every day; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Afternoon drinking from 14:00 is a draw (Tabelog shop text). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; March 2026). An appetiser (otoshi) charge (Tabelog). 15 seats: 6 at the counter and 3 tables; non-smoking, with a smoking spot outside; children welcome (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi-dori north of Matsubara; 10 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo or Kyoto-Kawaramachi stations (Tabelog). Opened 12 September 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-dori north of Matsubara — 10 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Warm-sake izakaya — the name means "hot water", for sake that warms like a bath — with over 30 sakes that change often, and seasonal obanzai and sashimi from the central market (Tabelog shop text; September 2026) · signature pork cartilage simmered soft, with grated daikon and ponzu (Tabelog shop text; March 2026) · assorted snacks of about eight kinds ¥1,500; ayu and cucumber spring rolls with yogurt sauce ¥1,200 (July 2026) · shira-ae with strawberry and black beans, saba kizushi, sardine and ginger rolls, firefly squid and udo tempura, potato salad with nuts and gorgonzola (March 2026) · herring with eggplant, tomatoes simmered with dried sardines, marinated bluefin, seared bonito; keema curry to finish (2026 reviews) · sakes such as Kikuhime, Yuho, Gikyō; most sake chosen by the owner (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sake izakaya · Kawaramachi-Matsubara, warm sake from 14:00] A small, bright modern counter on Kawaramachi south of Shijo, run by a woman owner who trained at Manzara-tei, opening at 14:00 for afternoon drinking: over 30 sakes, many served warm — the name, "hot water", is for sake that warms you like a bath — with careful obanzai, sashimi and the signature soft-simmered pork cartilage with ponzu. Reviewers praise the home-style cooking and let the owner choose their sake. An otoshi charge applies. Open daily from 14:00 to 22:00.

roles: Owner (a woman, unnamed), who cooks and chooses the sake
chef_bio.background: Per a May 2026 review: run by a female owner and staff, both from Manzara-tei. A September 2026 review explains that the owner named the shop hoping guests would feel warmed from the inside by kanzake, as if soaking in hot water; an October 2026 visitor saw the owner managing everything alone; a July 2026 regular now chats with the owner and staff. The shop was listed in "Japanese Sake dancyu 2026" (March 2026 review). Opened 12 September 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Tabelog shop text: warm sake that comforts you like a hot bath.
chef_bio.specialty: Kanzake; simmered pork cartilage; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: "In my 65 years of life, I've been to many restaurants, but for some reason, this one feels particularly comfortable." — July 2026.
"I appreciated the thoughtful gesture of splitting one serving into portions depending on the dish's volume" — March 2026.
"Even while managing everything alone, the quality of the menu was remarkable." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 居酒屋、下京区河原町通松原上る清水町282、清水五条駅・京都河原町駅から徒歩10分、毎日14:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 21:00)、不定休、予約可、お通し代あり、15席 (カウンター6、テーブル3)、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、子供可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、2024年9月12日オープン、店舗紹介: 湯につかるように温まる燗酒、中央市場の旬の刺身とおばんざい、豚なんこつの煮込み、30種以上の日本酒、14時からの昼飲み。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 女性の店主とスタッフ (ともに Manzara-tei 出身)、肴の盛り合わせ8種1,500円、鮎ときゅうりの春巻き1,200円、いちごと黒豆の白和え、鯖のきずし、ほたるいかとうどの天ぷら、にしんなす、キーマカレー、燗酒、Japanese Sake dancyu 2026 に掲載、店主一人で切り盛り。

cultural_comfort.note: Let the owner pick the sake; small counter; cards accepted.

places.name: とり新 (Tori Shin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Oyakodon in a dashi-and-tare sauce at lunch; yakitori with tare or salt at night; no gluten information (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken house — oyakodon of chicken and egg at lunch, chicken skewers and chicken soup at night (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (oyakodon only: large, regular, small or takeaway), dinner 18:00–22:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). No reservations at lunch; dinner can be booked (Tabelog). Lunch queues are common, though some reviewers walked straight in (2025 reviews). Cash only; smoking allowed (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter and two tables (Tabelog). On Nawate (Yamato-oji) north of Shijo, at the north end of Yamato-bashi over the Shirakawa; 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nawate by the Shirakawa, north of Shijo in Gion — 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Lunch: oyakodon only — local chicken in an egg-and-dashi topping finished firm round a raw yolk in the centre, Kujo or Kamo green onion, small-grain Tsuruga Koshihikari, home-made pickles and a soup of the season; the miso is made in-house (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · Night: assorted skewers omakase ¥2,200 — chicken, gizzard, wings, lotus root, shiitake, shishito, asparagus — with chicken liver to start and chicken soup to finish (March 2026; September 2025) · Asahi Super Dry, medium bottle ¥770; Asahi "Yawaragi" wine; sansho from Shichimiya (official site; March 2026) · the family’s main house, 鳥新, serves kashiwa mizutaki and chicken sukiyaki in private rooms with sunken kotatsu (official site; November 2025)
places.notes: [Yakitori & oyakodon · Gion Shirakawa, a Meiji chicken family's casual shop] The casual counter of 鳥新, a Gion chicken house whose family traces itself to the mid-Meiji era and whose earlier shops appear in Ryōma ga Yuku and Tanizaki. At lunch it serves only oyakodon — the old geisha-delivery recipe, egg set round a raw yolk with Kujo onion on Tsuruga rice, with house pickles and miso soup; at night, a ¥2,200 skewer omakase with chicken soup. Cash only; smoking allowed; closed Thursday.

roles: Owner, fourth generation by the family’s count (official site); unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per the official site of 鳥新: founded about 120 years ago in the mid-Meiji era, with the present owner "said to be the fourth generation" though without firm proof; related 鳥新 shops once stood by Shijo Kobashi, on Kawaramachi, Teramachi and Shinkyogoku, and the family traces bird dealing back to Oda Nobunaga’s time; the Shijo Kobashi shop is thought to be the one in the last scene of Shiba Ryōtarō’s "Ryōma ga Yuku"; Tanizaki Jun’ichirō wrote of the Teramachi shop (Bungei Shunjū, 1924) and ate at Nawate; mizutaki came to dominate over sukiyaki from about Showa 40. The oyakodon was made for delivery to geiko, maiko and Gion households from the late Meiji, delivery ended around 1955, and the dish was revived for lunch at とり新 after some fifty years (official site). An August 2025 reviewer found the owner a person of few words who wore very tall geta; an April 2026 reviewer calls the house Meiji-era.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "町の普通の店" — an ordinary neighbourhood shop, a secret little space in Kyoto.
chef_bio.specialty: Oyakodon; yakitori omakase.

anecdotes.text: "The owner, wearing incredibly high geta (traditional wooden sandals), brought it to me...!" The owner seemed a person of few words, but warned of the weather on the way out. — August 2025.
A March 2026 diner took the ¥2,200 skewer omakase with a medium Super Dry (¥770) and found it surprisingly affordable for Gion, with a friendly, chatty owner.
"The donburi (rice bowl) was a classic oyakodon, with the eggs cooked to perfection" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (torishin.my.coocan.jp、鳥新): 創業は約120年前の明治中頃、四代目と一応言われている、四条小橋・河原町・寺町・新京極にも鳥新があった、織田信長入洛の頃から鳥屋、司馬遼太郎『竜馬がゆく』の最後の場面の小橋の店、谷崎潤一郎『上方の食ひもの』(文藝春秋1924年) の寺町の店、縄手通り大和橋北詰東側、昭和40年過ぎから水だきが主流、水だき・すき焼きの2コース、とり新は昼に親子丼: 九条か賀茂の青葱、福井・敦賀産のコシヒカリ、真ん中に黄身、卵約2.5個、自家製の漬物と味噌、明治末〜大正初めから出前、昭和30年ごろ出前を廃止、約50年ぶりに営業、焼き鳥の山椒は七味家、アサヒスーパードライ、Instagram ktorishin。食べログ: 焼き鳥・鶏料理・親子丼、東山区祇園縄手四条上ル、祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、昼12:00〜14:00 (親子丼のみ、予約不可)・夜18:00〜22:00、木曜休み、14席、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、喫煙可。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年10月、英語): 親子丼、行列、高い下駄の店主、串のおまかせ2,200円、中瓶770円、鶏スープ、掘りごたつの個室で水炊き (2025年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch is oyakodon only — sit and it comes; cash only; smoky.

places.name: 柊家旅館 (Hiiragiya Ryokan)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki; the inn handles food allergies and vegetarian requests "as far as possible" with three days’ notice (official site FAQ); no gluten-specific information.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetarian requests are handled as far as possible with three days’ notice; halal and kosher cannot be done (official site FAQ). The standard kaiseki uses fish, crab and dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: A ryokan: dinner starts at 18:00 or 19:00 and breakfast at 8:00 or 9:00 for guests (official site FAQ). Dining without staying is possible by reservation — dinner from two people, lunch for groups of ten or more outside busy periods (official site FAQ; Tabelog says lunch from 15); 10% service charge for meals only (Tabelog). Allergies and vegetarian requests three days ahead; special orders five days ahead (official site FAQ). Meals in the guest room, a shared dining room or a hall; tables and chairs on request (official site; 2024 review). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (official site). Corkage charged on brought drinks (official site). Phone 8:00–21:00 (official site). On Fuyacho north of Aneyakoji, just off Oike-dori; about 4 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (official site; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho north of Aneyakoji, off Oike-dori — 4 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki of local seasonal ingredients with chosen tableware, "tradition with a new breeze" (official site) · a November 2025 dinner: Daidokutofu with welsh onion and vinegar miso, ginkgo, Matsuba crab soup …; an August 2025 dinner: sea urchin, abalone, hamo, scaled ayu, ayu tsukemen-style udon, hairy crab · the head chef’s recent soba (August 2024) · breakfast of Kyoto yudofu, grilled fish, clay-pot rice and house pickles, or Western on request (official site) · seasonal extra dishes such as wild hamo otoshi and wild ayu (official site, summer 2026) · New Year sea bream and zōni (January 2025) · dining-only bills ¥20,000–50,000 (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Ryokan kaiseki · Fuyacho, one of Kyoto's grand old inns] A historic inn near Oike, in the inn trade since 1861 (the house since 1818), whose holly crest is on everything and whose guests have included Kawabata Yasunari: seasonal Kyoto kaiseki in your room or a dining room, with fine old tableware. You can come just to eat — dinner for two or more, lunch for groups of ten — by booking ahead; allergies and vegetarian requests need three days' notice. Expect ¥20,000–50,000 a head. A 2026 Michelin Key hotel and Relais & Châteaux member.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: in 1818 the first 庄五郎 came from Fukui and set up in transport and seafood here; the name comes from the holly-shrine 比良木神社 at Shimogamo; the second generation, a sword-fitting craftsman, made the inn the main business in 1861; guests have included Bakumatsu activists, nobility and men of letters, and the site carries Kawabata Yasunari’s essay on the inn; registered tangible cultural property; selected as a 2026 Michelin Key hotel (September 2026) and joined Relais & Châteaux (July 2026). Reviewers give the founding as 1850 (August 2026) and call it one of Kyoto’s three great ryokan; a July 2026 reviewer mentions guests such as Charlie Chaplin and Mishima Yukio.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: 来者如帰 — "may you feel as if you had come home".
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki; Kyoto breakfast with yudofu.

anecdotes.text: "Dining Only: First Meal Celebration … As expected from a ryokan, the treatment for children was exceptional." — December 2024.
"The hotel accommodated my allergies and provided excellent alternatives using fish." — January 2024.
"A maiko also came to visit, making our dining experience even more enjoyable." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hiiragiya.co.jp): 来者如帰、文政元年 (1818) 福井から上った初代庄五郎が運送業・海産物商、屋号は下鴨神社境内の比良木神社から、文久元年 (1861) に宿を本業に、国登録有形文化財、川端康成の寄稿文、夕食は京懐石、朝食は湯豆腐・焼き魚・土鍋ご飯・自家製漬物 (洋食も可)、夕食18:00か19:00開始、食物アレルギー・ベジタリアンは3日前までに可能な範囲で、ハラル・コーシャは不可、特別注文は5日前まで、食事のみの利用は夕食2名から・昼食は繁忙期以外10名以上、持ち込みは抜栓料、カード可、2026年ミシュランキーホテル、ルレ・エ・シャトー加盟 (2026年7月)、別注の天然鱧・天然鮎 (2026年夏)。食べログ: 旅館・日本料理、中京区麩屋町姉小路上ル中白山町277、完全予約制、料理のみはサービス料10%、昼食15名以上、48席 (広間)、個室あり。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年10月、英語): Kyoto Gosan-ke、創業1850年、夕食は部屋か食事処、蕎麦、鱧、鮎、毛蟹、Matsuba crab、食事のみのお食い初め、舞妓、川端康成の部屋。

cultural_comfort.note: English website; book ahead (dinner from two diners); allergies and vegetarian requests three days ahead.

staff_allergy_handling: Handles food allergies and vegetarian requests as far as possible with three days’ notice; no halal or kosher (official site FAQ).

places.name: MOKO
places.gf_detail: Ask. Course French with homemade sourdough campagne at every meal, sauces built on bread, koji and miso, and aged fish and meat; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses centre on aged fish, game and meat, with butter and caviar (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday dinner 18:00–22:00 (last food order 19:30); Wednesday to Saturday lunch 12:00–14:30 (last order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 19:30); closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). 38 seats: a 14-seat counter, tables and private rooms for 2–8; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). A kids’ menu for small children (June and October 2026). In a renovated townhouse with a courtyard and a storehouse at the back, near Marutamachi Stn (2026 reviews; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Townhouse near Marutamachi, west of Karasuma — near Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Modern French of Japanese ingredients, built on fermentation and ageing in the restaurant’s own room, from a chef raised in Versailles (2026 reviews) · lunch ¥9,000, dinner ¥22,000 (March and July 2026) · e.g. week-aged Goto kanburi with sourdough-miso sauce; smoked aged sawara with koji-carrot sauce (March 2026); Hokkaido clams, cucumber and caviar (June 2026); Wakayama bonito with tomato and Oscietra caviar (August 2026); Kumamoto kuruma prawns, Hokkaido lamb, Goto pork (July 2026); whole-animal game (December 2025) · homemade sourdough with Maldon salt and Hokkaido butter · wine pairings: six glasses ¥15,000, "Prestige" three glasses ¥15,000; mostly clean natural wines; caviar and truffle supplements (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [French · Marutamachi, Chef Alexey Moko's townhouse] A modern French restaurant in a renovated Kyoto townhouse with a central counter, a courtyard and a storehouse, where Chef Alexey Moko — trained at Taillevent and in London hotels — cooks Japanese ingredients aged and fermented in-house: week-aged fish with koji or sourdough-miso sauces, game, and a sourdough loaf with butter people ask for again and again. Lunch ¥9,000, dinner ¥22,000, with natural-wine pairings. Families welcome, with a kids' menu. Michelin one star, per reviewers. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: Alexey Moko worked at renowned places such as Taillevent in France and hotels in London (March 2026); an owner-chef from Versailles focusing on fermentation and ageing (October 2026); the restaurant gained a Michelin star soon after opening, about three years ago (August and March 2026); the long-time service manager, who spoke fluent English and looked after international guests, left in August 2026; an October 2026 family was looked after by Chef Alexey and the chef’s wife. An April 2026 reviewer found most guests were from overseas.
chef_bio.specialty: Aged and fermented fish and game; sourdough with butter.

anecdotes.text: "The butter and salt served with the bread were so delicious that I ended up asking for three extra servings." — December 2025.
An October 2026 family with a two-and-a-half-year-old found Chef Alexey and the chef’s wife "incredibly kind and attentive".
A July 2026 diner loved the townhouse space but found the flavours a little strong and the ¥5,000-a-glass "Prestige" pairing pricey for what it was.
"Most of the guests were from overseas." — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ、中京区玉植町235-2、火 18:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 19:30)、水〜土 12:00〜14:30 (L.O. 13:00)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 19:30)、日・月休み、完全予約制、38席 (カウンター14、テーブル8、個室)、個室は2〜8名、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): Alexey Moko シェフ (Versailles 出身、Taillevent やLondon のホテルで経験)、開業まもなくミシュランの星、昼9,000円・夜22,000円、自家熟成の魚と肉、発酵、ジビエ、自家製のサワードウ、ワインペアリング6杯15,000円、プレステージ3杯15,000円、キャビアやトリュフの追加、町家と中庭と蔵、キッズメニュー、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: A French chef; many international guests; reservation only; kids’ menu.

places.name: さか本 (Sakamoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kappo courses on dashi — yuba, sesame tofu with fuki-miso, clear soup, seasonal bamboo shoots; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: omakase kappo courses with fish and dashi (2025–26 reviews).

Ground floor of the EF building on Sueyoshi-cho facing the Shirakawa; the entrance is set back and easy to miss (Tabelog; 2021–2024 reviews). 251 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion Shirakawa, on Sueyoshi-cho by the stream — 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kappo omakase beside the Shirakawa (2025–26 reviews) · white sesame tofu with fuki-no-tō miso, clear soup, yuba (a reviewer’s highlight), seasonal Kyoto bamboo shoots in Kyoto dashi; sansho flowers in spring · Fushimi sake; sake pairing chosen by the chef (2025–26 reviews) · courses around ¥20,000 a head per a 2024 reviewer; bills of ¥15,000–50,000 a head reported (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion Shirakawa, dinner over the stream] A small kappo counter on the Shirakawa in Gion, open since 1977 per a reviewer, where window seats look over the stream and, in spring, illuminated cherry blossoms. Omakase courses of seasonal Kyoto cooking — yuba, bamboo shoots, sesame tofu — with Fushimi sake. Reservation only; expect ¥20,000 a head and up. The entrance is tucked away.

roles: Owner and chef (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per a June 2025 review: in business since October 1977, reservation only. A June 2021 reviewer was welcomed by a woman who seemed to be the owner; a November 2022 reviewer heard the manager had studied cooking in America.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kappo omakase; yuba.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 window table had the illuminated cherry blossoms across the Shirakawa, with Kyoto bamboo shoots and Fushimi sake.
An April 2024 diner thought ¥85,000 for two hard to square with courses of about ¥20,000 a head.
The owner and staff were "very friendly", and the chef’s sake pairing suited the reviewer — January 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: さか本、日本料理、東山区祇園末吉町大和大路東入ル EFビル 1F、祇園四条駅から251m、毎日 12:00〜14:00・17:00〜22:00、不定休、完全予約制、12席 (カウンター6、テーブル6)、貸切可、禁煙、カード可、白川の眺め。公式サイト: 京都・祇園 割烹さか本。口コミ (2021年6月〜2026年6月、英語): 1977年10月創業、白川沿い、湯葉、白胡麻豆腐とふきのとう味噌、筍、花山椒、伏見の地酒、日本酒のペアリング、高いという声、入口がわかりにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; ask for a window seat over the Shirakawa; cards accepted.

places.name: れんこんや (Renkonya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai and izakaya dishes with soy-based simmering — nikujaga with a strong soy taste, beef shigureni, tonjiru, karashi renkon with a miso-mustard filling; no gluten information (guide article; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Pickles, chilled tofu, grilled eggplant, Manganji peppers and okara are on the menu, but obanzai are usually simmered in dashi and much of the menu is meat or fish (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:30, Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog); a travel guide gives 17:00–23:00 (last order) and says the shop opens on a holiday Monday and closes the Tuesday instead. Bookings taken; walk-ins sometimes fit (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). 20 seats: a counter of about four, two tables for four and three small tables for two on a raised tatami floor (Tabelog; April 2025). Non-smoking; JCB, AMEX, Diners and e-money (Tabelog). On Nishikiyamachi-dori south of Sanjo, by the Takase River; 5 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; guide).
places.neighborhood: Nishikiyamachi south of Sanjo, by the Takase River — 5 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Old Kyoto izakaya of obanzai home cooking with sake (guide article) · house karashi renkon with a white-miso mustard filling (¥700 in the guide) · wakasa karei, dried flounder as sashimi, grilled and in soup (¥1,600 in the guide) · obanzai: nikujaga ¥800, beef shigureni, okara, Manganji peppers, grilled eggplant, chilled tofu, atsuage with grated daikon, homemade pickles ¥300, teppai, chicken liver · onigiri with chirimen sansho, tonjiru, yudofu (guide article; 2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Obanzai izakaya · Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, an old townhouse] A tiny, wood-built izakaya by the Takase River, running since 1950 per a travel guide, in an Edo-era townhouse with an okudo hearth and low tables: Kyoto home-style obanzai and sake, with the house karashi renkon (lotus root stuffed with miso mustard), simmered dishes and onigiri to finish. Cosy and often busy with visitors; book or call ahead. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who cooks every dish (April 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per a travel-guide article (aquadina.com, undated): a long-established izakaya since 1950, centred on obanzai lined up on the counter; the interior is an Edo-period townhouse where the okudo, a black telephone and low chabudai tables are still in use.
chef_bio.specialty: Karashi renkon; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: Ordering pickled eggplant, a guest was offered it old, regular or lightly pickled — May 2025.
"It seems the owner is cooking all the dishes" — April 2025; the same reviewers found the small raised tables cramped.
An August 2025 diner, after the Gozan no Okuribi, noted many foreign guests and a casual dress code with lots of tank tops.
A kitchen mix-up left an order of okara unclaimed, and a late guest got it at half price — September 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 観光ガイド記事 (aquadina.com、日付なし): れんこん屋、1950年から続く老舗の居酒屋、カウンターに並ぶおばんざい中心、自家製からしれんこん (白味噌をブレンドした辛子味噌) 700円、わかさかれい1,600円、たたきとろろ800円、にしきぎ600円、江戸時代の町家、おくどさん・黒電話・ちゃぶ台、17:00〜23:00 (L.O)、日曜休み (月曜が祝日の場合は営業し月曜休み)。食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理・郷土料理、中京区西木屋町通り三条下ル山崎町236、三条駅から247m、月〜土 17:00〜22:30、日曜休み、予約可、20席、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・電子マネー可。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): からしれんこん、肉じゃが800円、漬物300円、牛しぐれ煮、おから、万願寺とうがらし、てっぱい、鶏レバー、おにぎり、豚汁、湯豆腐、店主が一人で料理、海外からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Small and busy; call ahead; obanzai are ordered from the counter display.

places.name: とくら 京都三条店 (Tokura Kyoto Sanjo)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: hamburg steak, demi-glace and red-wine sauces, fried shrimp, roll bread (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a hamburg-steak specialist (official site).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–20:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No reservations: weekend queues from about 11:30 with waits of 20–40 minutes; orders are taken in the line and parasols lent in the sun (Tabelog; October 2026). Takeaway (official site). Counter seating; non-smoking; JCB and AMEX, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Ground floor of 京都三条ビル; 4 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-dori east of Karasuma — 4 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Handmade hamburg steaks that burst with juice, with 12 sauces from a red-wine house sauce to grated-daikon ponzu (official site) · original hamburg steak ¥1,030 (rice ¥275), 300 g ¥1,250 with a Japanese set +¥345; cheese, negi-miso and mentaiko hamburg; hamburg with fried shrimp; lunch sets (October 2026 reviews) · rice from Hachidaime Gihei (October 2026)
places.notes: [Hamburg steak · Sanjo near Karasuma] The Sanjo branch of a Kyoto hamburg-steak specialist: plump handmade patties that flood with juice when cut, a choice of 12 sauces, and rice from Hachidaime Gihei. Original hamburg about ¥1,030; 300 g ¥1,250. Expect a short queue at lunch — orders are taken while you wait. Yoshoku WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the main shop is in Kuze, Minami-ku, with another branch in Takeda, Fushimi-ku. The shop site announced a Lucua Osaka shop opening on 5 April 2022. Per the shop site: the onion moisture and fat ratio are adjusted day by day to keep the taste constant. Tabelog Yoshoku WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the shop site: "肉汁溢れるハンバーグといえば「とくら」" — the hamburg that overflows with juices.
chef_bio.specialty: Original hamburg steak.

anecdotes.text: While queuing, guests were lent sun umbrellas and orders were taken — October 2026.
Many Korean customers were there and the staff spoke fluent Korean; the corn potage was slightly powdery — October 2026.
A diner who finds the Osaka Tokura lines too long got in here with little wait — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tokura-hamburg.com): 手づくりハンバーグの店 とくら、肉汁溢れるハンバーグ、玉ネギの水分や肉の脂肪分を見ながら日によって配合を微調整、赤ワイン仕立てのオリジナルソースやおろしポン酢など12種類のソース、テイクアウト、ルクア大阪店 2022年4月5日オープン。食べログ: ハンバーグ、中京区桝屋町57 京都三条ビル 1F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩4分、月火木〜日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜20:30、水曜休み、予約不可、カウンター席、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、本店は南区久世上久世町516-6、伏見区竹田中畑町24に支店、洋食 WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年10月、英語): オリジナルハンバーグ1,030円、ライス275円、300g 1,250円、和風セット+345円、チーズ、ねぎ味噌、明太子、エビフライ、Hachidaime Gihei の米、行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue and order in line; counter seats; cards (JCB, AMEX) accepted.

places.name: hikari-yurari
places.gf_detail: Ask. Italian small plates — prosciutto, pâté, potato salad, cheese, soups, pasta; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: cured hams, pâté and cheese lead the menu (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00 (last seating 22:00; food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Tuesday and every other Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only, by phone; same-day bookings possible; reviewers say the shop checks that you drink alcohol — not a place for non-drinkers (2025 reviews). Changes in numbers must be given by the day before, or ¥7,000 a head is charged; same-day cancellations are billed through a law firm (Tabelog). Cover charge ¥600 + tax (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; parties up to 4; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). Basement of ヴァインオークトゥエルブ on Oshikoji-dori east of Fuyacho; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Oshikoji-dori east of Fuyacho, basement — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Italian wine bar and counter kitchen: dishes from ingredients the chef sources, wines chosen to match (2025–26 reviews) · assorted prosciutto (hams hang before the glass wine cellar), pâté, "adult" potato salad, cheese platter, mixed appetizers incl. figs · soups such as mushroom consommé (¥660 in February 2025) and Shogoin-turnip soup · Italian wines by the glass and bottle (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian wine bar · Oshikoji, a hidden basement counter] A ten-seat basement counter near City Hall, with jazz, a glass wine cellar and hams hanging behind the bar: Italian small plates — prosciutto, pâté, an 'adult' potato salad, cheese — cooked by a single chef and matched with Italian wine. Reservation only, for drinkers (non-drinkers are steered away); ¥600 cover. About ¥10,000–15,000 a head. Closed Tuesday and alternate Mondays.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who runs the kitchen alone (July 2024 review)
chef_bio.background: Per a July 2024 review: in business for 22 years, 12 of them at the present site. Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021 and 2023.
chef_bio.specialty: Prosciutto; wine pairing.

anecdotes.text: "Please do not visit if you do not drink alcohol." — June 2025; another June 2025 reviewer says the shop asks about this when you call.
The chef works the kitchen alone and comes across as shy but answers if spoken to — July 2024.
A February 2025 pair found the service somewhat lacking and the portions small for the price, calling it more a wine bar than an Italian restaurant.
The owner explained each dish in detail, with a real passion for pairing — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: hikari-yurari、イタリアン・ワインバー、中京区押小路通麩屋町東入橘町611-1 ヴァインオークトゥエルブ B1F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分、月水〜日・祝 18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00・ドリンク22:30、最終入店22:00)、火曜と隔週月曜休み、完全予約制、前日までに人数変更の連絡がない場合1人7,000円、当日キャンセルは提携の法律事務所を通じて請求、チャージ600円 (税別)、10席 (カウンターのみ)、禁煙、カード可、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2021・2023。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 創業22年・現在地12年 (2024年)、シェフ一人、ジャズ、生ハムの盛り合わせ、パテ、大人のポテトサラダ、チーズ、きのこのコンソメ660円、聖護院かぶのスープ、お酒を飲まない人には向かない。

places.name: 百景 (Hyakkei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee, tea, beer and two cakes, cheesecake and chocolate cake; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and tea suit; the cakes use dairy and egg (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 14:00–1:00; closed Friday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); often full in the evening, with a short wait or turned away (March–August 2026). 17 seats, counter and tables (Tabelog; March 2026). Smoking allowed at the tables — ashtrays on them — and often smoky (2026 reviews); Tabelog lists a heated-tobacco area. No cards; e-money and PayPay (Tabelog); one August 2026 diner paid cash. Second floor of 山下ビル on Tominokoji just south of Nishiki, behind a bar-like door; 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2026). Opened 10 August 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Tominokoji just south of Nishiki Market — 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Night-time kissa: coffee, tea, cakes and beer in a dim room (2026 reviews) · Hyakkei blend ¥750 in three roasts — mild, medium, strong (the strong mixes three beans) · hot au lait ¥850, iced café latte, iced rooibos · cheesecake ¥600 (soft and rich, the favourite) and chocolate cake ¥600 · beer · beans named in reviews: the blend from Kissa Ashijima's roast, the au lait from Jikasei Coffee Garo (March 2026)
places.notes: [Kissa · Nishiki, a coffee room open until 1 a.m.] Up a flight of stairs off Tominokoji by Nishiki Market and through a door that looks like a bar's, a dim room of concrete walls and yellow light that stays open until one in the morning — rare in Kyoto. Order the Hyakkei blend in mild, medium or strong (¥750) and the soft, rich cheesecake (¥600). It fills up from about nine at night, and smoking is allowed at the tables, so it can be hazy. Closed Friday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 10 August 2019. A March 2026 reviewer thought the room might once have been a bar.
chef_bio.specialty: Hyakkei blend in three roasts; cheesecake.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor at 22:00 on a holiday found it full but got in as others left.
An April 2026 reviewer asked what made the cheesecake so soft; the staff did not know.
A March 2026 visitor found the counter seats uncomfortable for a long stay and the medium roast sold out.

places.name: りょうりや 御旅屋 (Ryoriya Otaya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal kappo dishes with dashi, soy and miso seasonings and heshiko sauce; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses built on fish and dashi, with crab, hamo, sanma and sea bream (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–22:00, Tuesday–Sunday; lunch 12:00–14:00 on Saturday and Sunday only, booked by the day before; closed Monday and irregularly about twice a month (Tabelog). Reservations advised — easiest between 17:00 and 19:00 (Tabelog). An otoshi of ¥700; no service charge (Tabelog). 16 seats: counter, tables and private rooms for 2–6, some looking onto the Takase River (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Non-smoking, ashtray outside; cards accepted (Tabelog). By the Takase River south of Shijo, 8 min from Kawaramachi Stn, 7 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 August 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: By the Takase River south of Shijo — 8 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kappo with Hokuriku threads — the owner's roots are in Toyama — beside the Takase River (Tabelog; November 2025) · omakase of eight dishes ¥8,800 (November 2025) or à la carte · a salad of 20 ingredients with jelly dressing; vegetables with heshiko sauce (November 2025) · autumn: a rare water plant and hairy crab in vinegar, hamo and matsutake pot, sanma grilled in a rich marinade with chestnut, taro and ginkgo, cod milt with ponzu, shrimp and anago steamed in domyoji, yuba and egg rice bowl (October 2025) · matsutake rice, crème brûlée, pear sorbet · sake from Kyoto and Toyama, e.g. Haneya, Kuzuryu (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · Takase River, Kyoto cooking with a Toyama accent] A quiet kappo south of Shijo whose counter and private rooms look out on the Takase River, opened in 2011 by an owner with roots in Toyama — the name recalls a rest-house of the Kaga lords. The eight-dish omakase (¥8,800 in November 2025) moves through the seasons: a 20-ingredient salad, vegetables with a heshiko sauce, hamo and matsutake in autumn, cod milt in winter, with sake from Kyoto and Toyama. Tabelog records eight straight years of a Bib Gourmand. Book ahead; dinner Tuesday–Sunday, lunch at weekends.

roles: Owner (unnamed; roots in Toyama per a November 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per a November 2025 review: opened on 25 August 2011; the name Otaya comes from a rest-house used by the Kaga lord for falconry and inspections, chosen for the owner's Toyama roots; the kitchen uses a traditional stove. Tabelog's introduction cites eight consecutive years of a Bib Gourmand and names a sister shop, Ryoriya Toki, opened on the Takase River at Takatsuji by Harada, who worked in Otaya's kitchen. The shop cleans the Takase River and releases fireflies each May (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal omakase; heshiko-sauced vegetables.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner noticed the owner explaining every dish carefully to guests from abroad, and found the bill surprisingly modest without alcohol.
An October 2025 regular on a fifth visit called a rare water plant with hairy crab — only four or five pieces from a stalk — the taste of the season.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: りょうりや 御旅屋、日本料理、下京区天満町456-2、阪急河原町駅から徒歩8分、京阪清水五条駅から徒歩7分、火〜日 17:00〜22:00、土日のみ昼12:00〜14:00 (前日までに予約)、月曜休み・月2回不定休、予約可 (17〜19時が比較的取りやすい)、突き出し700円、16席、個室 (2〜6人)、禁煙、カード可、2011年8月25日オープン、ビブグルマン8年連続、姉妹店 Ryoriya Toki (Takatsuji の高瀬川沿い、店主 Harada)、高瀬川の清掃と5月の蛍の放流。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 店主は富山にゆかり、加賀藩の御旅屋に由来する店名、おまかせ8品8,800円、20種の野菜のサラダ、へしこのソース、鱧と松茸の鍋、さんま、白子ポン酢、湯葉と卵の丼、京都と富山の日本酒。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (easiest 17:00–19:00); the owner explains dishes to visitors; ¥700 otoshi.

places.name: 京都 いとおかし (Kyoto Itookashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled salted salmon with a choice of three seasonings, pot-cooked rice, clam soup and side dishes; the seasonings are not described for gluten (October 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set meals of grilled salmon, eel or sashimi with clam soup (October 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 7:00–14:30, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations only, through TableCheck; queues form before opening even with bookings; a 50-minute limit (Tabelog; October 2026). Breakfast at the counter; tables and an upstairs room for other slots (Tabelog; October 2026). A student set at the 7:00 slot ¥1,000 (October 2026). No service charge (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Smoking allowed per Tabelog. In a machiya on Takatsuji-dori east of Aburanokoji, about 10 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 2 August 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takatsuji-dori east of Aburanokoji — 10 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Breakfast-and-lunch set-meal house built around a huge, thick fillet of grilled salted salmon, with three seasonings to choose (October 2026 reviews) · Kyoto grilled salmon set ¥2,500, with pot-cooked Kagoshima Natsuhonoka rice (free refills), clam soup, two side dishes and a dashi to pour over the last of the rice · student set at the 7:00 slot ¥1,000 (half a fillet and the collar) · sesame mackerel, amberjack sashimi, grilled eel, raw oysters, tamago kake gohan (October 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Set meals · Takatsuji, the giant grilled salmon breakfast] A machiya with an old tiled kitchen where a fillet of salted salmon so thick it could feed three is grilled on display, then served with glossy pot-cooked rice (refills offered again and again), clam soup and sides — ¥2,500 in October 2026, finished with a pour of dashi. Students eat for ¥1,000 at the 7:00 slot. Bookings only, via TableCheck, and they go fast; even so there is a queue at opening and a 50-minute limit. Lively, kind staff; many visitors from abroad. Monday–Saturday 7:00–14:30.

roles: Operator not named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 2 August 2025. October 2026 reviewers mention it being featured on TV and video sites.
chef_bio.specialty: Thick grilled salted salmon with pot-cooked rice.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, a little hungover, chose the Kyoto grilled salmon (¥2,500) and found the fillet a battle to finish — enough, it seemed, for three.
An October 2026 student took the ¥1,000 student set at 7:00 — half a fillet plus the collar — and was impressed by the tea served first.
An October 2026 diner wished for more time than the 50-minute limit allowed.

places.name: KIZAHASHI
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Kyoto courses with dashi, soy and miso (e.g. hoba-yaki with mushroom sauce); no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses use dashi and include fish or meat (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–10:00, lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:30–20:00; closed Tuesday except holidays; hours may change — check the official site (Tabelog). Reservations taken; cancellations from two days before are charged 100% (Tabelog). 15% service charge on the pre-tax bill (Tabelog). 60 seats including a counter, sunken seats and private rooms for 2–12; parties up to 6 at a table; non-smoking, smoking room outside; wheelchair access (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments; hotel parking for 50 cars (¥800 per 30 min) (Tabelog). No dress code, though sandals may not be allowed (September 2026). Second floor of THE THOUSAND KYOTO, 2 min east of the JR Kyoto Stn central exit (underground exit 5) (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: In front of Kyoto Station (THE THOUSAND KYOTO, 2F) — 2 min from the central exit
places.cuisine: Kyoto cuisine in a hotel: seasonal courses with Kyoto vegetables, at lunch and dinner, and breakfast (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · dinner courses from ¥10,000, e.g. the autumn course "Kaze": appetizer, matsutake and autumn-salmon soup, two kinds of sashimi, hoba-yaki of kinmedai, swordfish, sweet potato and lotus root, mushroom sauce, mushroom rice with refills, dessert (September 2026) · drink pairing with a sommelier, ¥10,000 course with small pours of rare sake and wine (September 2026) · seasoned rice, refillable (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Kyoto Station, a hotel restaurant for seasonal courses] The Japanese restaurant on the second floor of THE THOUSAND KYOTO, a two-minute walk from the station, with a calm, spacious room, a counter and private rooms. Seasonal courses start at about ¥10,000 — in autumn 2026 a matsutake soup, hoba-yaki with kinmedai and a mushroom rice you can have refilled — with a sommelier pairing of rare sake and wine. Breakfast and lunch too. Reviewers call it refined and reliable for business meals and family occasions; one found it very much "hotel Japanese". 15% service; closed Tuesday.

roles: Restaurant of THE THOUSAND KYOTO hotel (Tabelog address); chefs not named
chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists it as a hotel restaurant on the second floor of THE THOUSAND KYOTO, with a 15% service charge from 1 April 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto courses; refillable seasoned rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner chose it for a meeting between a partner and parents and found the service warm and elegant.
A September 2026 diner, worried about portions, took the smallest course (¥10,000) and was too full for a second helping of the mushroom rice.
A September 2026 reviewer described the food as authentic but very much the Japanese cuisine of a hotel.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: KIZAHASHI、日本料理、下京区東塩小路町570 THE THOUSAND KYOTO 2F、JR京都駅中央口から東へ徒歩約2分 (地下通路5番出口)、朝7:00〜10:00、昼11:30〜14:30、夜17:30〜20:00、火曜休み (祝日を除く)、予約可、2日前から100%のキャンセル料、サービス料15% (2025年4月1日から)、60席、個室 (2〜8人、最大12人)、禁煙 (店外に喫煙室)、車いす可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、駐車場50台。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 季節のコース (秋のコース「Kaze」、松茸と秋鮭の椀、朴葉焼き、きのこご飯)、1万円のコース、ソムリエのペアリング、おかわりできる炊き込みご飯、サンダル不可のことも、ホテルの和食。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant by Kyoto Station; 15% service; sandals may not be allowed.
