places.name: Luca
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the restaurant states it cannot accommodate wheat allergies (nor dairy, seafood or almond allergies, or vegetarians) (Tabelog). The courses include unlimited bread (April 2025).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the restaurant states it cannot accommodate vegetarians or dairy allergies (Tabelog); courses centre on seafood, foie gras and wagyu (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last arrival 12:30), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last arrival 19:00); arrivals after the last order time count as cancellations; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservation only; tell the restaurant about allergies in advance — same-day requests cannot be met, and it cannot accommodate seafood, dairy, wheat or almond allergies, vegetarians, or long lists of exclusions; raw meat or fish can be adjusted only for the main (Tabelog). One drink per person; 8% service on course prices (Tabelog). All guests start together, so do not arrive early (February 2026). A quiet room: diners have been asked to lower their voices (March and July 2025). 8 seats at three small tables, up a staircase with no lift; blankets on request (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Non-smoking; cards, IC cards, iD and QUICPay (Tabelog). On Tominokoji just north of Nishiki Market; 6 min from Shijo / Karasuma and Kyoto Kawaramachi Stns (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Tominokoji by Nishiki Market, 2nd floor — 6 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Chef’s omakase French with seasonal produce and black wagyu (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews) · dinner course ¥14,700 with a 6-glass wine pairing ¥10,800 (November 2025); lunch courses ¥7,200 (January 2025) and ¥12,000 (April 2025) · courses run from an amuse-bouche through three appetizers, two mains and three desserts, with unlimited bread (April 2025) · dishes have included crab with kombu jelly over a soft egg, salmon with oyster cream and kiwi in spinach, sea bass, Satsuma Nishiki beef, a red-wine main, autumn saury, abalone, lobster, eel, foie gras, venison, and desserts such as persimmon with sake lees, hojicha and lentils (2025–26 reviews) · wine pairings of 3–6 glasses
places.notes: [French · Nishiki Market, an 8-seat room for long lunches] A high-ceilinged, grey-toned room up a flight of stairs off Tominokoji, with three tables and eight seats, where owner-chef Takuya Sawahara cooks a set course single-handed. Expect a parade of small appetizers, two mains and three desserts — crab with kombu jelly, salmon with oyster cream, Satsuma Nishiki beef — with wine pairings from three to six glasses; dinner was ¥14,700 in late 2025. House rules are firm: book ahead, arrive on time, one drink each, keep your voice down, and no wheat, dairy or vegetarian adjustments. 8% service.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): owner-chef Takuya Sawahara; the name Luca stands for something that brings and gives light. A February 2026 reviewer says the chef trained at renowned Kyoto restaurants and a two-star French restaurant; a July 2026 reviewer says the chef cooks everything from amuse-bouche to dessert alone; an August 2025 regular praises "the chef, and the madam".
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): meals that bring a smile — "the light that spills out when you take a bite."
chef_bio.specialty: Chef’s omakase course; wine pairing.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 birthday diner and another table were reminded several times to lower their voices; the diner took it as the shop protecting its atmosphere.
A March 2025 diner found it a bit intimidating when staff asked another table to keep their voices down mid-explanation.
A November 2025 regular on a fourth yearly visit was recognised a year later with "You got a haircut!"
A July 2026 diner was impressed that the chef handles everything from amuse-bouche to dessert alone, and found the course incredibly satisfying.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ、中京区富小路通蛸薬師下ル高宮町585 若葉ビル 2F、四条駅・烏丸駅・京都河原町駅から徒歩6分、エレベーターなし、12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 12:30)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 19:00)、遅れた場合はキャンセル扱い、不定休、完全予約制、アレルギーは事前に (当日不可、魚介・乳・小麦・アーモンドのアレルギーやベジタリアンには対応不可)、1人1ドリンク、コースにサービス料8％、8席 (テーブルのみ)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、オーナーシェフ Takuya Sawahara、店名は光をもたらすという意味。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年9月、英語): ディナーコース14,700円、ワインペアリング6種10,800円、ランチ7,200円・12,000円、パン食べ放題、京都の名店と二つ星のフレンチで修業、シェフが一人で調理、マダム、声を落とすよう注意されることも、一斉スタート。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; arrive on time; quiet room; one drink each; cards accepted.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The restaurant asks for allergies in advance (no same-day requests) and states it cannot accommodate seafood, dairy, wheat or almond allergies, vegetarians, or many exclusions.

places.name: 佛沙羅館 (Bussarakan)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Thai dishes such as green curry and tom yum may be wheat-free, but soy and oyster sauces, fried dishes, pad Thai and yakisoba are common; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but most dishes use shrimp, chicken, fish sauce or shrimp-based broth (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00, dinner 17:00–22:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Riverside platform (kawadoko) seats in summer with an ¥800 charge, no charge indoors (Tabelog; October 2025). 56 seats: an 8-seat counter and 12 sunken seats around an irori downstairs, 36 seats in three private rooms upstairs, 30 on the summer platform (Tabelog). Spice is mild by default; ask for Thai-style heat (November 2025; March 2026). Smoking allowed; cards (Tabelog). In a townhouse on a side alley of Kiyamachi north of Matsubara, by the Kamo River; 6 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Matsubara, on the Kamo River — 6 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Thai cooking in a Kyoto townhouse (2025–26 reviews) · lunch sets such as gapao rice with a rice-noodle salad and dessert; lunch course of appetizers, fried dishes, tom yum kung, a choice of green curry, fried rice or yakisoba, and dessert · dinner courses with a three-tier appetizer stand, tom yum kung with rich shrimp broth, pad Thai or green curry to finish · à la carte: yum woon sen, som tum, tom kha gai in a hot pot, pad prik pao shrimp, fish with pad pong curry, khao soi, Thai-style kara-age · Thai beer (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Thai · Kiyamachi-Matsubara, Thai food in a Kyoto townhouse by the river] A Thai restaurant in an old townhouse down a side alley off Kiyamachi, with an irori counter, tatami rooms upstairs looking at the Kamo River, and a riverside platform in summer (¥800 charge). Lunch sets of gapao or green curry are good value; dinner courses bring tom yum kung, pad Thai and green curry, or order à la carte — tom kha gai, khao soi, som tum. Spice is gentle unless you ask for Thai heat. A Japanese owner fronts the house with a Thai chef, per one reviewer. No bookings; closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed) with a Thai chef, per an August 2026 review
chef_bio.background: An August 2026 reviewer describes a combination of traditional Japanese service by the owner and a Thai chef; a January 2026 reviewer was welcomed by a friendly master. Reviewers note the seasoning is adjusted for Japanese tastes, with authentic heat on request.

An April 2026 diner found the portions a little small for sharing but the tom yum kung excellent.
A March 2026 diner was pleased the kitchen swapped a ginger chicken stir-fry for Thai-style kara-age.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Cheesecakes and toast are wheat-based; karaki mochi and red-bean sweets may not be, but no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Teas and black coffee suit; the cheesecakes use cheese, and other sweets are not described ingredient by ingredient (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 8:00–16:00; Saturday and Sunday 8:00–17:00 (Tabelog); a September 2026 visitor found it closes early. Reservations accepted (Tabelog); a reviewer’s friend booked the upstairs room (September 2026). 31 seats: 14 at tables, 7 at the counter, 10 on the terrace (no smoking there either) (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). Tea caddies and crafts on display and for sale (2026 reviews). On Kawaramachi-dori north of Shichijo, a bus stop to Kyoto Station in front; 320 m from Shichijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-dori north of Shichijo — 5 min from Shichijo Stn
places.cuisine: Café of Kaikado, the old Kyoto tea-caddy maker, in a registered tangible cultural property (2026 reviews) · Kaikado cheesecake, shaped after its tea caddies and made with cheese from Nasu Highland, with a drink ¥2,050 (August–October 2026); Basque cheesecake set · seasonal tea set with karaki mochi ¥1,700, with a second infusion on request (August 2026) · monaka set, a set served in a tea caddy, ogura and an toast (2026 reviews) · hand-dripped coffee, cold brew ¥1,150, iced coffee ¥950, café au lait, matcha latte, cold-brewed green tea, seasonal "Iware" tea (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Café · Shichijo, tea-caddy maker's café in an old tram building] The café of Kaikado, the venerable Kyoto maker of hand-made tea caddies, in a registered cultural property that reviewers describe as a former streetcar building near Shichijo: high ceilings, big windows, wooden shelves of caddies for sale. Try the Kaikado cheesecake shaped like a caddy (set ¥2,050), the seasonal tea with karaki mochi (¥1,700, second steep included) or an early-morning an toast — it opens at 8:00. Drinks are priced high; the room is calm.

roles: Café of the tea-caddy maker Kaikado; no staff named
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a café run by Kaikado, a long-established Kyoto tea-caddy maker, in a nearly 100-year-old Western-style building registered as a tangible cultural property and renovated from an old streetcar depot (August–October 2026). Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Kaikado cheesecake; seasonal tea with karaki mochi.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor found the ¥1,150 cold brew pricey for a standard glass and its taste close to a well-known chain’s.
A September 2026 visitor waited a long time between a companion’s order and the reviewer’s, so the coffee went cool.
"The excitement of opening the tea canister was irresistible!" — October 2026.

places.name: あごつゆしゃぶしゃぶ 山福 本店 (Agotsuyu Shabushabu Yamafuku Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The broth is grilled flying-fish dashi with soy milk, the dipping sauce is dashi-based, and the courses finish with Chinese-style noodles or soba; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork and beef shabu-shabu in flying-fish broth (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 daily; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, online or by phone; a two-hour limit on all seats; bookings lapse 15 minutes after the time without notice (Tabelog); walk-ins can find it full (August 2026). Shoes off at the entrance; many steps inside, so guests with mobility issues should take note (Tabelog). 36 seats at a counter, sofas, tatami and sunken tables; private rooms; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). Staff spoke English to overseas guests (October 2026). Down an alley on Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, toward Pontocho; 5 min from Sanjo and Kyoto Kawaramachi Stns (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, toward Pontocho — 5 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Pork shabu-shabu in a broth of whole grilled flying fish (ago) with soy milk (2026 reviews) · Mochi pork belly, "Baumkuchen" pork loin from pigs fed Club Harie baumkuchen, and A5 Omi beef chuck flap, with mushrooms, Yoshino kuzukiri and as much sliced white leek as you like (August–September 2026) · noodles to finish, custom-made by an old Kyoto soba maker; matcha ice cream from Gion Tsujiri (August 2026) · courses: Pontocho ¥5,250, a ¥6,000 course with free-flow drinks, Yamafuku ¥6,500, Kamogawa (most popular), a ¥9,000 course with free-flow drinks; appetizers such as Aomori grilled mackerel and tuna carpaccio (August–October 2026)
places.notes: [Shabu-shabu · Kiyamachi, pork in flying-fish broth] A shoes-off shabu-shabu house down an alley off Kiyamachi near Sanjo, where a whole grilled flying fish flavours the broth before soy milk goes in. Swish three meats — mochi pork belly, 'Baumkuchen' pork loin and A5 Omi beef — with plenty of free white leek, then finish with custom noodles and Gion Tsujiri matcha ice cream. Courses run ¥5,250–9,000, some with free-flow drinks. Young, chatty staff, English spoken. Two-hour limit; open daily 17:00–24:00.

roles: Restaurant; no staff named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe young, friendly, humorous staff, English spoken with overseas guests (October 2026), and noodles made to order by a long-established Kyoto soba shop (August 2026). Tabelog Hot Pot "Tabelog 100" 2024.
chef_bio.specialty: Agotsuyu pork shabu-shabu.

anecdotes.text: "The staff had a great sense of humor. I won’t say too much to avoid spoilers." — August 2026.
An October 2026 diner arriving at 21:30 found every other guest was from overseas and the staff speaking English.
An October 2026 diner found the portions a little small but everything delicious.

places.name: OICHO (おいちょ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Chicken cuts are grilled at the table with salt, sauce or yuzu pepper; the menu also has kushiage, spring rolls, takana fried rice and ponzu dishes; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, March 2026; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the menu centres on chicken, and the hot pot uses chicken-bone and kombu dashi (Tabelog; Tabelog menu, March 2026).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–24:00; closed Wednesday, but open on Wednesdays before and on holidays (Tabelog). Bookings taken; mention children’s ages; the hot pot needs a booking (Tabelog; April 2026). Table charge ¥330 a head, none for children of elementary age and under (Tabelog). Raw chicken (tataki yukke) to be eaten within 30 minutes of serving (February 2025). 30 seats (9 at the counter, 21 at tables); non-smoking, ashtray outside the door; cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). On Teramachi south of Takatsuji; 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi south of Takatsuji — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Chicken you grill yourself over a charcoal shichirin, yakiniku-style, plus chicken sashimi and izakaya dishes (2025–26 reviews) · Kyotanba chicken cuts: thigh ¥630, breast ¥470, harami ¥550, neck ¥550, tender ¥550, skin ¥470, liver ¥520, gizzard ¥630, heart ¥520, tail ¥430, yagen cartilage ¥520 · Kyotanba chicken salt hot pot for one (mizutaki, chicken-bone and kombu dashi, yuzu ponzu) ¥1,880 · 10 assorted kushiage ¥1,320 (Tabelog menu, March 2026) · five-cut grilled and five-kind sashimi platters, chicken tataki yukke, chicken-and-cream-cheese fresh spring rolls, shiso tsukune, takana fried rice (2025–26 reviews) · courses from ¥5,500 with all-you-can-drink (August 2025)
places.notes: [Chicken · Teramachi-Takatsuji, grill-your-own chicken on charcoal] A busy chicken house on Teramachi south of Takatsuji where you order Kyotanba chicken by the cut — thigh, harami, neck, liver, heart — and grill it yourself on a charcoal shichirin, yakiniku-style. Start with the five-kind sashimi platter or the rare tataki yukke, and don't skip the chicken-and-cream-cheese spring rolls. Cuts from ¥430; a one-person salt hot pot (¥1,880) needs booking. Reviewers praise the friendly staff; on busy nights service can be slow. Open to midnight; closed Wednesday.

roles: No person is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: A sister shop, 鶏焼肉はやし おいちょ, appears in the Tabelog crawl. Reviewers describe a friendly, engaging chef (January 2025) and attentive staff (2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Grill-your-own Kyotanba chicken; chicken sashimi; cream-cheese spring rolls.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 diner was told to eat the chicken tataki yukke within 30 minutes of serving.
A March 2026 diner was asked about dislikes before the five-cut grilled platter came.
An April 2026 diner was warned dishes would take time on a crowded night and could not order the hot pot without a booking.

places.name: Bistro × Bar HAKONIWA (ハコニワ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A meat-and-drinks bistro bar: roast-beef bowls with dashi soy sauce, sausages, kara-age, fries, French toast and pancakes; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, September 2026; 2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat bowls, BBQ, meat hot pot, kara-age and egg dishes make up the menu (Tabelog menu; 2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–16:00, then 16:00–24:00 (last order 23:00) Monday to Saturday, and to 22:00 (last order 21:30) Sundays and holidays; Tabelog also notes 16:00–24:00 in summer and 16:00–22:00 in winter; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Bookings via TableCheck or phone; same-day by phone only, even when online shows full (Tabelog). Rooftop terrace: ¥500 a head unless on a course (Tabelog); summer beer garden and BBQ courses from April; kotatsu seats with hot pot from November to March (Tabelog menu; 2024–26 reviews). Two-hour seating on the all-you-can-drink courses (October 2025). 13 seats inside (5 at the counter, two tables) plus the terrace, up to 20 guests; designated smoking area; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On the 4th floor (B) of the 大西ビル; 3 min from Sanjo Stn, 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 26 February 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Between Sanjo and Gion-Shijo, east of the Kamo River — 3 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Bistro bar with a rooftop terrace over the Kyoto streets: lunch bowls and sweets by day, BBQ and drinks by night (2024–26 reviews) · lunch: NIKU bowl of thick roast beef with egg yolk and house dashi soy, finished as meat chazuke, ¥1,950 with extra meat (February 2025); Kyoto-egg hamburg ¥1,200 (February 2025); thick French toast and pancakes made with Uji-tea-fed Kyoto eggs, French toast ¥1,480 (March 2025; November 2025) · food: Happy Roast Beef ¥1,400, chicken-wing gyoza ¥550, fries ¥660, stuffed wing kara-age ¥750, BIG grilled sausages ¥900, kara-age ¥800, atsuage with Kujo green onion ¥550, potato salad ¥550, cheese omelette ¥880 (Tabelog menu, September 2026) · rooftop BBQ courses with all-you-can-drink, e.g. Halloween BBQ ¥5,500 (to 31 October 2026); Afternoon Tea BBQ ¥5,500 (October 2025); winter kotatsu meat hot pot of pork and beef over bean sprouts in a soy broth (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Bistro bar · Sanjo-Gion, a rooftop terrace for every season] A small fourth-floor bistro bar between Sanjo and Gion-Shijo whose real draw is its rooftop terrace over the city: a beer garden and BBQ courses in the warm months, and kotatsu tables with a meat hot pot from November to March. By day there are roast-beef NIKU bowls you finish as chazuke and French toast made with Uji-tea-fed eggs. Reviewers like the view, the friendly owner and the value; some found the hot pot mild and, in May 2026, the sodas flat. ¥500 terrace charge unless on a course. Open from noon.

roles: Owner (unnamed); an August 2026 reviewer found the owner very friendly
chef_bio.background: Opened 26 February 2018 (Tabelog). The rooftop terrace turns into kotatsu seating with blankets and hand warmers for winter (December 2024; November 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: NIKU bowl; rooftop BBQ; winter kotatsu hot pot.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 group was given a large blanket and disposable hand warmers at the group’s rooftop kotatsu.
A May 2026 diner found the rooftop view excellent and the meat decent, but the sodas almost flat.
A May 2026 diner who left something behind called the next day and was kindly helped.

places.name: Ristorante t.v.b (リストランテ ティー ブイ ビー)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking: allergies and dislikes must be told in advance, as day-of changes may not be possible (Tabelog). Courses include pasta, kadaif-wrapped lobster, risotto and desserts (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: prix-fixe courses of seafood, Kameoka beef, pork and dairy desserts (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00 (last order 13:00) and dinner 18:00 (last order 20:00); closed Sunday and some weekdays (official site; Tabelog lists 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00, Monday to Saturday). Booking advised for all meals; phone is easiest 11:00–12:00 and 14:00–16:00 (Tabelog; official site); also via Ikkyu and Pocket Concierge (official site; October 2026). 10% service charge (official site; Tabelog). 14 seats, private rooms for 2, 4 or 6 (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). In a machiya with a modern interior and a wine cellar, in a narrow Gion alley; 7 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 30 January 2007 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion south of Shijo, in an alley — 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Prix-fixe Italian: choose starters, pasta and main from the day’s list, with sommelier-chosen wine (official site) · lunch ¥6,800 and dinner ¥15,000, plus 10% service; supplements for Canadian lobster in kadaif (+¥1,500), Wakayama abalone and ito-nori risotto (+¥2,500), Kameoka beef misuji (+¥2,500 at lunch) and Australian black truffle (+¥2,000) (official site) · dishes on the current menus: edamame purée with cuttlefish and sea urchin, a salad of 13 vegetables with whelk and truffle-scented egg, chilled pasta with fruit-tomato sauce and ripe white peach with caviar, Nagasaki kasago with okahijiki, Kameoka beef Bolognese with zucchini, roast Wakayama kinmedai, "shirokuma" ice, tiramisu with espresso cookie (official site) · reviewers paid ¥7,480 for lunch (July 2026) and ¥16,500 for a seven-dish dinner (August 2026), with service; three-glass wine pairings (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Gion, prix-fixe in a machiya] A fourteen-seat Italian restaurant in a Gion machiya with a modern interior and a wine cellar, opened in 2007. Both lunch (¥6,800) and dinner (¥15,000, plus 10% service) are prix-fixe: pick a starter, a pasta and a main from the day's list — kadaif-wrapped Canadian lobster, chilled tomato capellini with white peach and caviar, Kameoka beef Bolognese, roast kinmedai — and finish with the tiramisu reviewers rave about. A sommelier pairs wine by the glass. Book ahead and mention allergies in advance. Closed Sunday.

roles: Restaurant of 株式会社ｔｖｂ (invoice T9130001058710); a sommelier chooses the wine; no chef is named in the sources read
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Ristorante t.v.b (リストランテ ティ ヴォリオ ベーネ) serves seasonal course food in Gion, with starter, pasta and main chosen from the day’s best ingredients, and wines chosen by a sommelier. Opened 30 January 2007 (Tabelog). Other records in data name 祇園t.v.b and Vineria t.v.b as past workplaces of chefs in those records. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ｔｖｂ (NTA corporate-number site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to bring out the appeal of carefully chosen fish, meat and seasonal vegetables, dish by dish.
chef_bio.specialty: Kadaif-wrapped lobster; chilled tomato capellini; tiramisu.

anecdotes.text: "I was truly amazed by the best tiramisu I've ever had!" — August 2026.

places.name: 亀屋陸奥 (Kameya Mutsu)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the signature matsukaze is made of wheat flour, sugar, malt syrup and white miso (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The matsukaze’s listed ingredients are wheat flour, sugar, malt syrup and white miso, with poppy seeds; the rakugan 憶昔 is sugar, white bean paste, rice flour, wasanbon, hama-natto and cinnamon (official site) — none lists animal products, but ask.
places.hours_raw: 8:30–17:00; closed Wednesday and 1–3 January (official site; Tabelog). Takeaway only (Tabelog). Seasonal sweets (fresh wagashi, warabi-mochi, mizu-yokan, manju) are sold only at this main shop (official site). Matsukaze is also sold at Nishi Hongan-ji’s shops, Kyoto Takashimaya, JR Kyoto Isetan and station shops (official site). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Opposite Nishi Hongan-ji, north of Shichijo on Nishinakasuji-dori, by the Shichijo-Horikawa bus stop; about 12 min walk from Kyoto Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Opposite Nishi Hongan-ji, north of Shichijo — 12 min walk from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: Confectioner to Hongan-ji, founded by tradition in 1421 (official site) · 松風 (matsukaze): a fermented dough of wheat flour, sugar, malt syrup and white miso baked in a 45.5 cm pan, scattered with poppy seeds and cut into strips — said to have begun as rations during the 石山合戦 siege; 8 pieces ¥700 (August–October 2026), cut-end value bags; 西六條寺内松風 made with hama-natto instead of white miso (official site; 2026 reviews) · 憶昔 (soft rakugan with hama-natto and cinnamon), 滴翠 (sugar-glazed fu-yaki senbei), おいまつ yokan, ogura and Uji-matcha yokan, 一会 wasanbon, 季の詞 higashi (official site) · seasonal fresh wagashi, warabi-mochi, mizu-yokan, shonin manju, kurakake manju at the main shop only (official site); monaka ¥220 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Nishi Hongan-ji, the matsukaze of a 600-year-old confectioner] An old confectioner opposite Nishi Hongan-ji that by its own history has supplied the temple's offerings since 1421. Its famous 松風 is a chewy, bread-like slab of fermented wheat dough, white miso and malt syrup, baked in a huge pan and scattered with poppy seeds — said to have started as siege rations in the 石山合戦, and named from a poem by 顕如. Eight pieces ¥700; cut-end bags are a bargain. Seasonal wagashi are sold only here. Takeaway only; 8:30–17:00, closed Wednesday.

roles: 株式会社亀屋陸奥 (founded as a company in 1964; official site); no person is named in the sources read
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded, by tradition, in 1421; supplier of offerings to Hongan-ji from about the time 蓮如 (Rennyo) led it; during the 石山合戦 (from 1570) a sweet first made as rations became matsukaze, named after 顕如’s poem once Hongan-ji settled at 六条堀川 (1591); around 1660 the house received a cypress turtle said to have floated in Hideyoshi’s Jurakudai pond, the 亀 of its name, and in 1715 the title 陸奥大掾 from the court; matsukaze specimens won silver at the 1900 Paris Exposition; incorporated in 1964. 司馬遼太郎 wrote matsukaze into 『燃えよ剣』 and 『関ヶ原』. Tabelog Wagashi WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026 (official site news, 29 September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to keep the taste handed down since the Warring States period and pass it on to the next era, one sheet at a time.
chef_bio.specialty: 松風; 憶昔; seasonal wagashi.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor found the shop closed on its Wednesday holiday and bought matsukaze inside Nishi Hongan-ji instead.
An October 2026 buyer of the value bag found about 20 pieces, including broken ones — "quite a bargain".
A September 2026 visitor noticed a steady stream of local customers buying gifts.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kameyamutsu.jp): 1421年創業、京都・西本願寺前の老舗和菓子店 亀屋陸奥、本願寺御用達の御供物司、応永28年 (1421年) 創業と伝わる、蓮如上人のころから御供物の調達、石山合戦の籠城の中で松風の原型、1591年に本願寺が六条堀川へ移り「松風」と名づけられる (顕如上人の歌)、1660年頃に豊臣秀吉ゆかりの檜造りの亀を拝領、1715年に「陸奥大掾」の御宣旨、1900年パリ万国博覧会で銀賞、1964年に株式会社亀屋陸奥、松風は小麦粉、砂糖、麦芽飴、白味噌を自然発酵させ、直径約45.5cm の一文字鍋で焼きケシの実を振る、西六條寺内松風 (浜納豆)、徳用袋、憶昔 (落雁)、滴翠 (麩焼煎餅)、季節のお菓子は本店のみ、下京区西中筋通七条上る菱屋町153、8:30〜17:00 (水曜日定休)、七条堀川バス停前、京都駅から徒歩約12分、取扱店舗: 西本願寺売店、京都高島屋、JR京都伊勢丹ほか、2026年9月29日 食べログ 和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2026 選出。食べログ: 和菓子、テイクアウトのみ、1月1日〜3日休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): 松風8枚700円、もなか220円、徳用袋。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway counter; matsukaze also sold inside Nishi Hongan-ji.

places.name: KOTOWARI
places.gf_detail: Ask. Lunch plates of mini rice bowls, sashimi, tempura and miso soup with a bonito dashi; seared cheesecake and other sweets at café time; the shop asks guests to tell it about allergies (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the plates centre on fish, roast beef, chicken tempura and dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30; may end early when sold out), café 15:00–17:00, dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Bookings taken; dinner courses and the birthday plate (¥1,100) need two days’ notice; Monday–Thursday the dinner plate is limited to three groups a day (Tabelog). 20 seats incl. counter, tables and a small semi-private tatami room; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). Leather goods are sold in the shop and bag repairs taken (Tabelog). On a street just west of Kawaramachi behind Mina Kyoto; 5 min from Sanjo or Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Just west of Kawaramachi behind Mina Kyoto — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Japanese cooking in a shop that pairs food with leather goods (Tabelog) · lunch: KOTOWARI three-kind mini rice-bowl plate ¥2,200 (e.g. shirasu, seafood and roast beef, with salad, tempura, potato salad, dashimaki, miso soup), a daily plate with sashimi or chicken tempura, uni-ikura-roast-beef bowl; white or multigrain rice (2026 reviews) · café: seared cheesecake finished in front of you, Dubai chocolate mochi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · dinner: Japanese à la carte or courses with sake and wine (Tabelog) · kids’ lunch (August 2026)
places.notes: [Japanese plates & café · Kawaramachi-Sanjo] A bright, stylish shop behind Mina Kyoto that sells leather goods alongside food: at lunch a colourful plate of three mini rice bowls with tempura and sides (¥2,200), in the afternoon a cheesecake seared in front of you, and at night Japanese dishes with sake. Family-friendly, with a small tatami room and a kids' lunch. Lunch can sell out; book ahead.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who was cooking alone at an October 2026 lunch
chef_bio.background: Opened 12 March 2021 (Tabelog). A June 2026 reviewer learned the restaurant is run by Akashiya, a bag-repair shop near Kyoto Station; Tabelog notes leather goods for sale and bag-repair consultations in the shop.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator’s Tabelog text: the essence of everyday life with Japan’s seasonal delights, in a space both special and comforting.
chef_bio.specialty: Three-kind rice-bowl plate; seared cheesecake.

anecdotes.text: "It seemed that the owner was the only one cooking, so there was a bit of a wait" — October 2026.
A September 2026 diner found the mini rice bowls much smaller than expected, though the food was good.
The cheesecake was seared right in front of an August 2026 guest.

Mina Kyoto 7F, Kawaramachi south of Sanjo; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae or Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Mina Kyoto 7F, Kawaramachi south of Sanjo — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn

places.notes: [Indian curry café · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, Mina Kyoto 7F] A roomy, all-day Indian café on the 7th floor of the Mina Kyoto building: curry sets with fluffy naan or cheese naan, a proper mutton biryani (allow 20 minutes), thick lassi, and dessert naan and parfaits. Open 11:00–23:00 daily; English menu; party plans with all-you-can-drink.

roles: Operator unnamed; a reviewer thanks "Manager Tamangu" (August 2025)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator’s Tabelog text: authentic Indian food at reasonable prices with plenty of spices imported directly from India. No other Diwali shops were found in our crawl or a web search.
chef_bio.specialty: Biryani; naan sets.

anecdotes.text: A four-time visitor had chicken biryani before the Gozan no Okuribi and thanked "Manager Tamangu" — August 2025.
The mango pudding was sold out; soft serve instead — December 2025.
A January 2025 diner found the curries and tandoori chicken not quite the expected flavour, but good, and took half the cheese naan home.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled-fish and simmered set meals, Saikyo-miso fish, chirashi sushi and Kyoto bento, all built on dashi, miso and soy; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: grilled and simmered fish and beef set meals with dashi-based side dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–20:00; closed Wednesday and the 2nd and 4th Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; the second-floor tatami room (30 seats) can be reserved for groups (Tabelog). The daily set sells out — staff announce how many are left (June 2026). 59 seats: 5 at the counter and 24 at tables downstairs, tatami upstairs; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; no cards — e-money and PayPay accepted (Tabelog). Takeaway bento (Tabelog). On Shinmachi-dori north of Ayanokoji, in the Ofune-hoko neighbourhood; 5 min from Karasuma or Shijo Stn (Tabelog; July 2026).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi-dori north of Ayanokoji, by the Ofune-hoko — 5 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Set meals from a Kyoto caterer founded in 1909, in a Kyoto townhouse on Shinmachi (Tabelog) · daily set meal with several side dishes; grilled-fish sets: hokke, salt-grilled mackerel, guji (amadai), sanma in autumn; simmered mackerel; beef simmered in soy (2026 reviews) · "Oofune" Gion Matsuri special ¥2,600: Saikyo-miso grilled fish, simmered vegetables, chirashi sushi (July 2026) · Kyoto-cuisine bento at dinner; sake incl. one named after the Ofune-hoko float (July 2026)
places.notes: [Set meals · Shinmachi near Shijo-Karasuma, a 1909 caterer's dining room] The dining room of a Kyoto caterer founded in 1909, in a townhouse on Shinmachi-dori: honest set meals of grilled fish — hokke, mackerel, guji, autumn sanma — or the daily special with a spread of small sides, at about ¥1,000–2,000. Popular with locals at lunch; the daily set sells out. No cards (PayPay OK). Closed Wednesday and the 2nd and 4th Tuesday.

roles: Operator: 矢尾定 (caterer); no person named
chef_bio.background: Per the operator’s Tabelog text: founded in 1909, handmade dishes made with care, keeping the flavours and techniques of more than 100 years; Kyoto cuisine and bento. Tabelog Teishoku "Tabelog 100" 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator’s Tabelog text: safe, trustworthy Kyoto food, cooked with a sincere attitude.
chef_bio.specialty: Grilled-fish set meals; daily set.

anecdotes.text: After seeing the Ofune-hoko float at Yoiyama, a regular had the limited "Oofune" lunch (¥2,600) — July 2026.
A yearly sanma pilgrim came for the "Sanma Set Meal" again in a year of short supply — October 2026.
The staff who answered the phone greeted the guest at the noren — May 2026.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki courses of fish, shellfish and dashi (2026 reviews).

Seasonal Kyoto courses at the counter — lunch about ¥15,000–17,000, dinner about ¥30,000 with drinks. Shoes off; smart casual. Closed Monday.

roles: 店主 (owner) per the official site, which romanises the name "Yokoi Yushi"; Tabelog’s operator text calls the chef "Hiroshi Yokoi"
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: from 18 trained for 12 years in shops of the 高台寺和久傳 group; head chef of 二条やま岸 at 32; independent at 36 near Karasuma-Gojo; listed in the Michelin Guide from 2023 and awarded one star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto–Osaka 2026. Opened 1 December 2023 (Tabelog). Reviews differ on who the owner is: several 2026 reviewers describe a woman owner who welcomes guests alongside the head chef, and a July 2026 reviewer writes that the owner and the head chef are business partners, not a couple.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator’s Tabelog text: "Koufuku" — food happiness — from the first bite to the swallow; to leave guests with warm memories.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; saba-zushi.

anecdotes.text: A late-June 2026 lunch guest at the counter enjoyed the sound of the chef filleting hamo.
A July 2026 lunch guest (¥17,000 with a highball) found several later dishes — turtle, sashimi, hand-rolled sushi — lacking distinct flavour.
A guest who missed a Shinkansen and arrived very late was still warmly welcomed — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyo-yokoi.com): よこい、店主 横井裕史 (Yokoi Yushi)、18歳から高台寺和久傳グループの店舗にて12年間研鑽、32歳で二条やま岸料理長、36歳で京都烏丸五条にて独立、ミシュランガイド2023から掲載継続、ミシュランガイド京都・大阪2026で1つ星、昼 12:00〜15:00 (水・木・土・日)、夜 18:00〜22:00 (入店は18時か19時)、月曜定休、おもたせ (鯖寿司、きんぴら鮭弁当、湯葉ちりめん山椒)、下京区万寿寺中之町88、タクシーでは「高倉万寿寺」。食べログ: 日本料理、五条駅1番出口から徒歩5分、14席 (カウンター10、個室4)、個室料1人2,200円、2026年12月1日からサービス料10%、スマートカジュアル、靴を脱いで入店、大人と同じコースを食べられる子どものみ、カード可、禁煙、2023年12月1日オープン、築180年の京町家、横井裕史シェフ。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): 蓮の葉のトマトのジュレ、帆立と甘海老と桃のジュレとキャビア、鮑の天ぷら、鱧、鮎、ランチ1万5千〜1万7千円、女性の店主と料理長。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; shoes off; smart casual; tell the taxi 高倉万寿寺.

places.name: 温 (onn)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Creative wagashi built on daifuku (rice-flour mochi) with fillings such as rum raisin, Earl Grey, chestnut and osmanthus, and kakigori with kinako, shiratama and job’s tears; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Wagashi are bean-, rice- and chestnut-based, but some kakigori come with fresh cream or milk and the latte uses milk; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). No reservations: write your name and number at the door and they call when a seat is free, asking you to come within about 10 minutes; waits of up to two hours in summer 2026, while solo guests and weekday visitors were sometimes seated at once (Tabelog; August–October 2026). Order at the counter by the entrance first (August 2026). 13 seats; non-smoking; no table charge (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC, iD and QUICPay (Tabelog). Takeaway sweets sold at the front (2026 reviews). 6 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn exit 9 (Tabelog). Opened 16 November 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Townhouse north of Shijo — 6 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Creative seasonal wagashi on a daifuku base, with matcha whisked in front of you in a bowl you choose (2026 reviews) · sets of two or three sweets with matcha or tea; sweets such as "Ajisai" (hydrangea, with rum raisin), "Razu", "Yamato Kuri" (chestnut paste with whole chestnuts), an Earl Grey sweet, an osmanthus sweet with cinnamon, and autumn names "Hanaberry", "Koke Musubi", "Shizuka", "Onka", "Hisui" (August–October 2026) · kakigori: hojicha with kinako espuma; rich matcha with Wazuka matcha, chestnut, Dainagon azuki, Tanba black beans, shiratama, job’s tears and fresh cream ¥1,870 (August–October 2026) · iced matcha latte, cold Yabukita tea (August 2026) · takeaway sweets about ¥400 each (October 2026)
places.notes: [Wagashi café · Kawaramachi, matcha in a townhouse] A calm, much-queued tea room in a renovated townhouse with a small garden seen through a round window, serving seasonal creative wagashi on a daifuku base — rum-raisin "Ajisai", chestnut "Yamato Kuri", osmanthus with cinnamon — with matcha whisked before you in a bowl you pick from a shelf of handmade pottery. Summer brings kakigori such as hojicha with kinako espuma or rich Wazuka matcha (¥1,870). No bookings: leave your number and they call. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who chose the pottery (October 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 16 November 2023 (Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer calls it "onn Kyoto Gion-cho", a renovated Kyoto townhouse with a small garden through a round window and handcrafted pottery chosen by the owner; reviewers in August–October 2026 describe long summer waits, staff who are pleasant, and a shop seen on Instagram.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal creative wagashi; hojicha kakigori.

anecdotes.text: "I saw a sign saying there was a 2-hour wait. I hesitated but decided to go in and made a reservation by writing my name and phone number." The call came about an hour later. — August 2026.
"The Ajisai had a striking flavor of rum raisin, which is a unique combination not often found in wagashi." — September 2026.
"You can also choose your matcha bowl, so be sure to pick your favorite; mine is the camellia bowl." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 甘味処・和菓子、中京区伊勢屋町341-1、阪急京都河原町駅9番出口から徒歩6分、11:00〜18:00、火・水曜休み、予約不可、13席、禁煙、チャージなし、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay 可、2023年11月16日オープン。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 入口で名前と電話番号を書いて呼び出し、夏は2時間待ち、入口のカウンターで先に注文、大福が基本の創作和菓子 (Ajisai のラムレーズン、Yamato Kuri、アールグレイ、金木犀とシナモン)、選べる抹茶碗、目の前で点てる抹茶、ほうじ茶のかき氷ときな粉のエスプーマ、Wazuka の抹茶のかき氷1,870円、町家と丸窓の坪庭、持ち帰りの和菓子は1個400円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter by the door; leave a name and number when there is a wait; cards and IC accepted.

places.name: 大神 (Oogami)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase kaiseki with dashi soups, sashimi, vinegared miso dishes, simmered and grilled courses and kamameshi; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the kaiseki is built on fish, shellfish, hamo, eel and dashi (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch from 11:30, dinner from 17:00, all guests starting together; allow about two hours for lunch and three for dinner; closed Thursday (Tabelog; February 2025). Reservation only, for two or more (Tabelog); lunch is hard to book (August 2025). Lunch ¥6,500 per Tabelog, ¥7,000 in February 2026; service included; cash only (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Dress smartly (Tabelog). 9 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). In a back alley of Gion north of Shijo, ground floor of サカタビル; 8 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2025).
places.neighborhood: Back alley of Gion north of Shijo — 8 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Gion kaiseki omakase changing monthly, many small dishes in fine tableware (2024–2026 reviews) · lunch course ¥6,500–7,000 (Tabelog; February 2026), with tea included and the kamameshi wrapped as onigiri to take home (September 2025) · dinner omakase, about ¥13,800 in May 2024; bills ¥20,000–29,999 in 2025–2026 reviews · a September 2025 dinner: corn purée with squid, grilled-fish soup, sea urchin and abalone in jelly, sea bream and hamo sashimi, grilled ayu, prawns, hassun, hairy crab, dobin-mushi, chawanmushi, crispy rice and soup, kuzukiri with ice cream · bottled Asahi and Kirin, a half bottle of Chablis, sake and shochu (July 2026)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a nine-seat counter of many small dishes] A nine-seat counter in a Gion back alley where Mr. Oogami, cooking here for about 30 years with an apprentice, sends out a stream of small seasonal dishes in beautiful tableware — two hours at lunch, three at dinner, everyone starting together. Lunch at ¥6,500–7,000 is the famous bargain and hard to book; the leftover kamameshi comes wrapped as rice balls to take home. The chef looks stern but is chatty and funny. Cash only; book for two or more; dress smartly; closed Thursday.

roles: Owner-chef (May 2024 review: "The owner, Mr. Oogami"), with an apprentice (July 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per a May 2024 review: kaiseki in Gion for about 30 years; the owner, Mr. Oogami, is meticulous and serves an astonishing variety of dishes, with the menu changing monthly; the restaurant was shown on the TV programme "Hayashi’s Nippon Drill" on 23 January 2019 as a favourite of Hayashi Osamu (also March 2025). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a chef who looks intimidating but is friendly and entertaining, and who shared a beer with guests and the apprentice (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase kaiseki of many small dishes; kamameshi.

anecdotes.text: "At the end, they offered to wrap the kamameshi in bamboo leaves as an onigiri to take home" — September 2025.
"What surprised me was how entertaining the head chef was." The lunch course lasted about two hours. — August 2025.
A July 2026 diner, alone with the chef and the apprentice at 17:00, shared a bottle of Asahi — the chef’s favourite — and toasted with both.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、東山区末吉町88 サカタビル1階、河原町駅から8分、昼11:30〜・夜17:00〜 (昼は約2時間、夜は約3時間)、木曜休み、完全予約制 (2名から)、昼6,500円、サービス料込み、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、ドレスコード、9席 (カウンター)、禁煙。口コミ (2024年5月〜2026年7月、英語): 祇園で約30年の会席、店主の Oogami さん、毎月変わる献立、美しい器、Hayashi Osamu の番組 (2019年1月)、昼のコース6,500〜7,000円、全員一斉スタート、釜飯を葉で包んだおにぎりの持ち帰り、見た目は怖いが気さくで面白い大将、弟子、アサヒの瓶ビール、シャブリのハーフボトル。

cultural_comfort.note: Book for two or more; fixed start time; cash only; smart dress.

places.name: いはら田 (Iharada)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki courses with sushi, a fried dish, miso-marinated items and red miso soup; no gluten information (official menu; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses include hamo, soft-shelled turtle, crab, aged Tajima beef and dashi throughout (official menu; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00, last entry 20:00; closed Sunday (official site); Tabelog adds irregular closures and opening on holidays that fall on Sunday. Reservations by phone or TableCheck; same-day cancellations are charged 100% (official site; Tabelog). Courses ¥12,000, ¥15,000, ¥20,000 before tax and 10% service (¥14,520, ¥18,150, ¥24,200 all-in) (official site). Children from elementary-school age, eating the adult course (official site). A 6 m single-plank hinoki counter of 9–10 seats and a second-floor room for 2–20; non-smoking at the table, with a smoking corner (official site; Tabelog). Cards accepted (official site). On Nishioji-dori 150 m north of Shichijo, west side; 1 min from the Nishioji-Shichijo bus stop, about 10 min by taxi from Kyoto Stn (official site). Opened 5 October 2002 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishioji-dori north of Shichijo, west Kyoto — 10 min by taxi from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: "New washoku", traditional and innovative: about 10–11 courses from fish bought at the market each morning, vegetables from the house’s own farm in Ohara, aged Tajima beef from 中勢似 (carcass-aged on the bone), hamo, soft-shelled turtle, matsutake and crab (official site) · courses ¥14,520, ¥18,150 and ¥24,200 all-in (official site) · a sample ¥15,000 menu: hamo, sea urchin and kumiage yuba starter; soft-shelled-turtle egg tofu soup with matsutake; whelk and botan shrimp, straw-smoked bonito; mackerel sushi; a hassun mid-course; aged Tajima beef fillet; crab vinegared dish; oysters with Kujo negi purée; rice with salmon roe and red miso; sudachi sherbet and a mascarpone monaka (official menu) · reviewers single out the tuna and mackerel sushi, the soft-shelled turtle pot and the ice-cream monaka (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Nishioji-Shichijo, aged beef and the house farm] A white, modern kaiseki house on Nishioji, a short taxi ride from Kyoto Station, with a 6 m single-plank hinoki counter and calligraphy on the walls: 10–11 courses of morning-market fish, vegetables from its own Ohara farm and carcass-aged Tajima beef, with the hassun served mid-course, mackerel sushi, soft-shelled turtle and an ice-cream monaka to finish. Courses ¥14,520–24,200 all-in. Regulars return for years; one March 2026 diner felt rushed by the schedule. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef and okami (unnamed on the pages read)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: fish bought at the market every morning; vegetables grown at いはら田農園 in Ohara; aged Tajima beef specially bought from 中勢似, carcass-aged on the bone; calligraphy by 山田秋邨 throughout the white interior; a greeting from the okami on its fifteenth year; press from 2003 (All About Japan, Gainer) to 2008 (あまから手帖). Opened 5 October 2002 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe the head chef seeing guests off (March 2026), an eight-time regular (February 2026), and an earlier complaint about the pace that a December 2025 diner found fixed.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: traditional yet innovative "new washoku", with the cook free to combine whatever the season allows.
chef_bio.specialty: Aged Tajima beef; mackerel sushi; hassun.

anecdotes.text: "This time, both the atmosphere and the pace have changed dramatically … and I was very satisfied." — December 2025.
"I also love the ice cream monaka that they serve for dessert here." — April 2026.
A March 2026 diner who arrived late had to rush the meal to fit the restaurant’s schedule.
"The top sirloin, aged for two months, allowed me to fully enjoy the rich taste of the red meat." — November 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (iharada.jp): 御料理 いはら田、下京区西七条比輪田町26 (西大路七条上る150m西側)、17:30〜22:00 (最終入店20:00)、日曜定休、カウンター9席と2Fの個室 (2〜20名)、喫煙コーナーあり、カード可、毎朝市場で仕入れる魚、大原のいはら田農園の野菜、熟成但馬牛のヒレ (中勢似から仕入れる枝肉熟成)、鱧、すっぽん、松茸、カニ、長さ6mの一枚板の檜のカウンター、書道家 山田秋邨の書、女将のごあいさつ、コース12,000円 (税サ込14,520円)・15,000円 (18,150円)・20,000円 (24,200円)、約10〜11品、当日キャンセルは100%、小学生以上、メディア掲載 (2003〜2008年)、TableCheck。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理、月〜土 17:30〜22:00、日曜 (祝日除く)・不定休、30席 (1階カウンター10、2階テーブル20)、サービス料10%、禁煙、2002年10月5日オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年11月、英語): 鯖寿司と鮪の握り、すっぽん鍋、八寸、熟成肉、アイス最中、急かされたとの声 (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese pages on the official site; book via TableCheck; tell the taxi "Nishioji Shichijo, 150 m north".

places.name: 燕 (En)
places.gf_detail: Ask. À la carte kappo: sashimi, tempura and fried dishes, nama-fu dengaku, miso-marinated scallops, mackerel sushi, duck and truffle noodles; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, fish, meat and dashi dishes; even the appetiser has yuba with dashi jelly (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00, Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and needed — reviewers took three to five tries to get in; many regulars (Tabelog; June–September 2026). An appetiser charge of about ¥900, varying with the season (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 12 seats: a counter and one table; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). A small, easy-to-miss sign; two doors from a Daily Yamazaki, 5 min walk from Kyoto Stn’s Hachijo exit — Tabelog warns that Google Maps puts it in the wrong place (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 18 April 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Kujo, south of Kyoto Stn — 5 min walk from the Hachijo exit
places.cuisine: Kappo counter with a long à la carte menu for drinkers — rare among Kyoto counters (August 2026) · assorted sashimi (shima-aji, isaki, sea urchin with salt and nori, Biwa trout, toro hidden under shiso) (June–July 2026) · seasonal plates: hamo, grilled ayu done before you, grilled water eggplant, white asparagus and corn fritters, beef cutlet, simmered kinmedai, tuna cheek, grilled tuna collar, white shrimp and lily-bulb tempura, figs with walnut miso, nama-fu dengaku, miso-marinated scallops, duck and truffle noodles, mackerel sushi (June–October 2026) · dishes marked on the menu as suited to solo diners (June 2026) · sake chosen to match, highballs, plum water (2026 reviews) · bills about ¥9,000–15,000 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · Kyoto Station Hachijo, an à la carte counter] A 12-seat counter a few minutes south of Kyoto Station, behind a sign so small that Tabelog warns Google Maps has it wrong: one of the few Kyoto counters where you order à la carte, from a long seasonal list — sashimi with sea urchin and toro, ayu grilled before you, white shrimp and lily-bulb tempura, simmered kinmedai, duck and truffle noodles. The owner's warm, careful service is praised as much as the food. Bills about ¥9,000–15,000; cash only; book well ahead. Closed Sunday.

roles: Chef and owner (a woman, front of house), unnamed in the sources
chef_bio.background: Opened 18 April 2013 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a chef working in view across the counter, an owner whose attentive service and choice of words they single out, and women staff who are kind from the moment of booking; many regulars, and bookings that take several tries.
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte seasonal plates; sashimi; tempura.

anecdotes.text: "After trying three times, I finally managed to make a reservation." The menu marks dishes suited to solo diners. — June 2026.
A July 2026 diner most wanted to stress the owner’s service — exceptionally attentive, with impressive choice of words — and paid ¥9,200 for one.
"Finally got to the restaurant I've always wanted to visit! … it was my fifth attempt!" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、南区東九条西山王町15-2、京都駅八条口から5分、Daily Yamazaki の2軒隣 (Google マップの位置は違う)、月〜土 17:30〜23:00、日曜休み、予約可、お通し約900円 (季節変動)、12席、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、2013年4月18日オープン。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): アラカルトのカウンター、お造りの盛り合わせ (しまあじ、いさき、ウニ、Biwa trout、トロ)、鱧、目の前で焼く鮎、白海老と百合根の天ぷら、金目鯛の煮付け、鴨とトリュフの麺、鯖寿司、生麩田楽、一人客向けの印、常連が多い、予約に3〜5回、女将の気配り、1人9,000〜15,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte Japanese menu at a small counter; book by phone well ahead; cash only.

places.name: 我家我家 (Gaya Gaya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the menu mixes quiche, baguettes, pasta and ajillo with Japanese small plates (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information; dishes seen include yuba and sesame tofu but mostly meat and fish — horse sashimi, Ezo venison, duck confit, swordfish (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 17:30–4:30 (food last order 3:30, drinks 4:15); open through New Year’s Eve and Day, though 1–3 January it closes at 1:00 (last order 24:00). Reservations by phone 10:00–3:00; private hire for 11 or more (Tabelog). Courses with all-you-can-drink (2024–2025 reviews). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, 10 at tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards and QR payments, no e-money (Tabelog). 3F of the 佐野ビル, east off Kawaramachi south of Sanjo along the BAL north street; 4 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi south of Sanjo — 4 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: A one-man dining bar with a long menu of small plates and cocktails, open until 4:30 am (Tabelog; reviews) · duck confit ¥1,100, quiche lorraine (prosciutto and camembert), swordfish in vermouth sauce (September 2026) · chicken-tender carpaccio with mentaiko sauce, warm yuba and sesame tofu, raw horse ruibe, roasted Ezo venison with stem wasabi, conger-eel ajillo, clam-chowder-style soup with bread, crab pasta (2024–2025 reviews) · courses with all-you-can-drink, including a 3-hour plan under ¥5,000 for a group (January 2024) · cocktails, sake, shochu, wine, Heartland draft
places.notes: [Dining bar · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, one man till dawn] A 16-seat dining bar up on a third floor off Kawaramachi, run single-handed by its owner and open until 4:30 every night: a long menu of small plates — duck confit (¥1,100), quiche, venison, horse sashimi, conger-eel ajillo — and well-made cocktails, with all-you-can-drink courses for groups. Reviewers praise the speed and value. Smoking allowed. 17:30–4:30 daily.

roles: Owner (unnamed) who runs the bar alone, per 2024–2025 reviews
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2024 to 2025 describe a one-man operation — the owner cooks, mixes drinks and serves — with dishes arriving quickly despite a wide menu; an April 2025 diner found the owner a big anime fan who loves to chat, and an August 2025 diner discovered the master was a senior from the same university.
chef_bio.specialty: Duck confit; quiche; cocktails.

anecdotes.text: A diner who comes back once a year for the ¥1,100 duck confit compares it to a ¥4,000 dish at a fine-dining restaurant — September 2026.
"Still a one-man operation, with a wide menu and absolutely delicious!" — September 2024.
An August 2025 group found the master was a senior from their university and spent the course reminiscing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・バー・ダイニングバー、中京区河原町通三条下ルBAL北通り東入ル北側北車屋町267 佐野ビル 3F、毎日17:30〜翌4:30 (L.O. 料理3:30・ドリンク4:15)、年末年始も営業 (1月1〜3日は24:00 L.O.、25:00閉店)、電話予約は10:00〜3:00、11名以上で貸切、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、喫煙可、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、飲み放題・コースあり。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 鴨のコンフィ1,100円、キッシュ、カジキのベルモットソース、ささみのカルパッチョ明太子ソース、湯葉と胡麻豆腐、馬刺しのルイベ、蝦夷鹿のロースト、穴子のアヒージョ、蟹のパスタ、店主ひとりで営業。

cultural_comfort.note: A small late-night bar run by one person; book a course for groups; smoking allowed.

places.name: 吉左エ門、 (Kichizaemon)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; each fish can be cooked four or five ways, so ask for grilled or raw preparations; dishes have included tempura, Hatcho miso and soba (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and game kappo, with dashi in the soups — a January 2026 diner praised the rich bonito dashi of the kasujiru.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Monday–Saturday 18:00–22:30, closed Sunday; lunch by reservation at least a day ahead. Bookings online or by phone; same-day cancellations may incur a fee; seats-only bookings are cancelled 15 minutes after the time without notice (Tabelog). A 10% room charge for a private room used by four or fewer (Tabelog). 18 seats: 10 at the counter, 8 at tables; a tatami private room with a table for 4–8 looking onto the Kamo River (Tabelog; March 2024). Smoking allowed at dinner, not at lunch (Tabelog). Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 2F of スペース新橋, by the Shirakawa bridge in front of a Seven-Eleven; 4 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; March 2024).
places.neighborhood: Gion, by the Shirakawa near Yamato-oji — 4 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Casual kappo of seafood from Wakasa Bay — Wakasa guji, fugu, Echizen crab — plus wagyu, wild boar and duck, mostly à la carte, each fish cooked the way you choose (Tabelog; reviews) · September 2025: Echizen red crab with crab-miso sauce, Obama botan shrimp, shime saba and white whale sashimi · fugu milt and grilled fugu, bear meat, abalone, junsai and hamo hot pot, soba finished with karasumi (2023–2024) · kasujiru with rich bonito dashi, kabura with Hatcho miso, clam soup (January 2026) · a blackboard of daily specials · sake (including off-menu bottles), wine (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion Shirakawa, Wakasa fish your way] An 18-seat second-floor kappo by the Shirakawa, where the owner, from Wakasa, buys fish from Wakasa Bay and cooks each the way you choose from four or five methods: guji, fugu, Echizen crab, botan shrimp, with game such as boar and bear in season. Mostly à la carte from the menu and a blackboard, with a tatami room looking onto the Kamo River. About ¥10,000–15,000 a head at dinner (reviews). Smoking allowed at night. Mon–Sat from 18:00; lunch by booking.

roles: Owner-chef from Wakasa (named only in a machine-translated review)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction: a casual kappo where the owner personally selects fresh seafood from Wakasa Bay, the owner’s hometown — Wakasa guji, fugu and Echizen crab — alongside wagyu, wild boar and duck, in a modern Japanese space with tables looking onto the Kamo River. A September 2025 regular of over ten years adds that the owner comes from a family that runs a restaurant in Wakasa and served for many years as second-in-command at a Kansai kaiseki restaurant in Osaka; that review names the owner, but only in English translation, so the name is not used here. A September 2026 diner found three people at work: the owner, a young assistant and a part-timer.
chef_bio.specialty: Wakasa seafood à la carte; fugu.

anecdotes.text: Asked "What would you like for your meal?", a regular of ten years answers "a little bit of everything that’s delicious" and has dishes brought at a comfortable pace — September 2025.
"They offer 4 to 5 cooking methods for each ingredient, allowing you to choose how you’d like it prepared." — July 2023.
A March 2024 diner liked being able to order à la carte and smoke at the table.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・ふぐ・海鮮、東山区弁財天町15 スペース新橋 2F、月〜土 18:00〜22:30、日曜休み、ランチは前日までの予約制、予約可 (当日キャンセルは料金あり、席のみの予約は15分の遅刻でキャンセル)、4名以下で個室利用の場合は個室料10%、18席 (カウンター10、テーブル8)、個室 (畳にテーブル、4〜8名)、喫煙可 (ランチのみ禁煙)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、若狭湾の魚介 (若狭ぐじ、ふぐ、越前がに)、和牛・猪・鴨、鴨川の見えるテーブル席。口コミ (2023年7月〜2026年9月、英語): ほぼアラカルト、食材ごとに4〜5通りの調理法、越前の紅ずわい蟹、小浜のぼたん海老、しめ鯖、鯨、白子、熊肉、粕汁、八丁味噌のかぶら、黒板の日替わり、店主と若い助手とアルバイトの3人。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly à la carte from a Japanese menu and blackboard, with the chef’s suggestions; book ahead.

places.name: Walden Woods Kyoto (ウォールデン ウッズ キョウト)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; coffee and tea drinks with croissants, cream puffs, pudding and ice cream on a cookie base (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and Americano suit; lattes, ice cream, pudding and croissants use dairy, and plant milk is not mentioned (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 8:00–18:00; hours may change; an August 2026 review gives 8:30–18:00. No reservations. Order at the first-floor counter; the second floor is an all-white room with tiered benches and no tables or chairs, round a white tree (2026 reviews; Tabelog). Takeaway; children welcome; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards including UnionPay, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). No sign outside — a white building in a residential street (August 2026); 15 min walk from Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Residential Shimogyo south-east of Gojo-Karasuma — 15 min walk from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Coffee and chai stand in an all-white building themed on a "white forest" (2026 reviews; official site) · light-roast coffee, Americano ¥550, cappuccino, latte, chai latte ¥700, matcha latte ¥700 · morning combo of mini croissant, mandarin juice and cappuccino ¥1,000 (August 2026) · Walden pudding ¥400, cream puff ¥300, ice cream ¥500 (matcha, strawberry) (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Coffee stand · Gojo, a white forest] A coffee and chai stand in an all-white, unsigned building on a residential street: order on the ground floor, then sit on the tiered white benches upstairs, round a single bare white tree, with no tables at all. Light-roast coffee and lattes (¥550–700), a ¥1,000 morning combo, pudding and cream puffs. Cafe WEST Tabelog 100 2025. Reviews are mixed on the cappuccino and matcha ice cream, warm about the space. Daily 8:00–18:00.

roles: Coffee stand (operator not named on the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a white building with a first-floor counter round the kitchen and a second-floor room of tiered benches round a white tree, on the concept of living simply in harmony with nature after Walden (October 2026); the official site is titled "Coffee & Chai / Walden Woods Kyoto". Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per an October 2026 review: "living simply in harmony with nature."
chef_bio.specialty: Light-roast coffee; chai latte.

anecdotes.text: "I stood in front of the entrance for quite a while, comparing it to the map and wondering, 'Is this really the right place?'" — August 2026.
An August 2026 morning visitor found the croissant good but the cappuccino disappointing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (walden-woods.com): Coffee & Chai / Walden Woods Kyoto。食べログ: カフェ、下京区栄町508-1、毎日8:00〜18:00、予約不可、2階は立ち飲みかベンチ、テイクアウト、子供可、禁煙、カード可 (銀聯も)、電子マネー・QR 不可、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 白い森がテーマ、2階は白い木のまわりの段々のベンチ、看板がない、浅煎りのコーヒー、アメリカーノ550円、チャイラテ・抹茶ラテ700円、モーニングコンボ1,000円、プリン400円、シュークリーム300円、アイス500円。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter downstairs and take it up to the benches; no bookings.

places.name: ＡＪＡＮＴＡ 寺町店 (Ajanta Teramachi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; lunch sets come with naan (refills free) or rice, so rice is the choice to ask about, but how the curries are thickened is not described (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and there are chickpea, lentil, okra, eggplant and spinach-potato curries, but butter, cream and paneer appear in others, and the use of ghee is not stated (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00. Bookings taken; private hire for 20 to over 50 (Tabelog). Lunch sets with salad, a spiced carrot-and-tomato soup, a drink and free naan or rice refills — ¥1,100 (August 2025), special lunch ¥1,450 (March 2026), C lunch about ¥1,000 including a glass of wine (February 2026); about 25 curries to choose from at lunch (July 2026). 63 seats over two floors (28 and 35); non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). On Teramachi south of Takatsuji, 1F of the 山本ビル; 5 min walk south from Hankyu Kawaramachi’s Fujii Daimaru exit (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi south of Takatsuji — 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Indian curry house with a chef who spent over 15 years at a five-star hotel in India, spices imported from India (Tabelog) · lunch sets from about ¥1,000–1,450 with salad, a spiced carrot-and-tomato soup, a drink (mango lassi, even red wine) and free naan or rice refills; cheese naan +¥250, mutton curry +¥200 (2025–2026 reviews) · about 25 curries: butter chicken, spinach and mutton, keema, chickpea, lentil, egg masala, prawn, okra, eggplant and vegetable, spinach-potato with prawns · tandoori chicken, seekh kebab, chicken biryani (large; half size suggested) · sake, shochu, wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Indian curry · Teramachi-Takatsuji, a long-time naan house] A two-floor, 63-seat Indian curry house on Teramachi that one regular has visited for about 20 years: lunch sets around ¥1,000–1,450 with spiced carrot soup, salad, a drink and free naan refills, a choice of some 25 curries (butter chicken is the favourite), tandoori chicken and big biryani. Curry WEST Tabelog 100 2020. Vegetarian curries available. Open daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00.

roles: Chef (unnamed) with over 15 years at a five-star hotel in India, per Tabelog
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction: authentic Indian food by a chef with more than 15 years at a five-star hotel in India, with herbs, spices and other ingredients imported directly from India, and over 60 seats on two floors. A March 2026 regular has come for about 20 years, when this and Ashoka were among the few places for authentic naan and curry in Kyoto. A February 2026 diner found the staff answered in broken Japanese, attentively. Tabelog Curry WEST "Tabelog 100" 2020.
chef_bio.specialty: Butter chicken curry; free naan refills.

anecdotes.text: "If you tend to sweat while eating, a towel is a must!" — June 2026.
A September 2025 diner found the okra curry bitter and the chicken biryani far too big to finish, and suggests a half size.
"I was thrilled to see that there were 25 different types of curry to choose from for lunch." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: インド料理・インドカレー、下京区寺町通高辻下ル京極町515-4 山本ビル 1F、毎日11:00〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、予約可、63席 (1階28、2階35)、貸切20〜50名以上、禁煙、子供可、テイクアウト、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、インドの五つ星ホテルで15年以上の経験のシェフ、ハーブやスパイスをインドから直輸入、カレー WEST 百名店 2020。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年7月、英語): ランチ1,100円・スペシャルランチ1,450円・C ランチ約1,000円 (グラスワイン付き)、ナンのおかわり無料、にんじんとトマトのスパイススープ、カレー25種、バターチキン、ほうれん草とマトン、キーマ、ひよこ豆、レンズ豆、タンドリーチキン、ビリヤニ、20年来の客。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick a curry and naan or rice from the lunch sets; staff speak some Japanese (February 2026).

places.name: 京辛麺 KYO-KARA 木屋町店 (Kyokara Men KYO-KARA Kiyamachi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the noodles are Chinese wheat noodles by default; konjac noodles can be chosen, but the soup, gyoza and fried rice are not described as wheat-free (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the spicy noodle soup is egg-thickened, and the sides are gyoza, cartilage and fried rice (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday 18:00–24:00; Tuesday–Friday 0:00–6:00 and 18:00–24:00; Saturday and Sunday 0:00–6:00, 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–24:00 — in effect evenings through to 6:00 the next morning, with weekend lunch (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); a queue can form before opening (July 2026); full at 3:00 on a September 2026 night. 19 counter seats, dim; non-smoking with ashtrays outside; cards, IC cards, iD, QUICPay, PayPay and other QR (Tabelog). Also on Uber Eats (August 2026). On Rokkaku east of Kawaramachi; 4 min from Sanjo Stn Exit 6 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Rokkaku east of Kawaramachi — 4 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Late-night spicy-noodle bar with drinks (2026 reviews) · Kyokara Men: an egg-thickened spicy soup with a spice level you choose — level 5 is said to be about Shin Ramyun’s heat, regulars go to 20–35 — Chinese or konjac noodles, garlic to taste, toppings such as cilantro and a soft-boiled egg; mega size; a tomato version (2026 reviews) · gyoza and shiso gyoza, tender cartilage, fried rice ¥715 (June 2026), kara-age (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Spicy noodles · Kawaramachi, a bowl until dawn] A dim 19-seat counter off Kawaramachi that serves its 'Kyokara Men' until 6:00 most mornings — the place for a late-night finish. Pick your spice level (5 is about Shin Ramyun, the brave go to 20 and up), your noodles (the konjac noodles are a favourite), garlic and toppings like cilantro; the egg-thickened soup is rich under the heat. Gyoza, shiso gyoza and a ¥715 fried rice round it out. One June 2026 diner got the wrong order. Open from 18:00, through the night.

chef_bio.background: A June 2026 reviewer, an acquaintance of the owner, ordered on the recommendation of staff from a sister restaurant; reviewers note it is open until early morning and also on Uber Eats (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyokara Men with konjac noodles.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner received a different dish from the one ordered and found the food average.
"The staff mentioned it was about as spicy as Shin Ramyeon, so I tried it at level 5" — July 2026.
A September 2026 diner arriving just after 3:00 found it full.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラーメン・ダイニングバー、中京区河原町六角東入山崎町258-24、京阪三条駅6番出口から徒歩4分、月 18:00〜24:00、火〜金 0:00〜6:00・18:00〜24:00、土日 0:00〜6:00・12:00〜15:00・17:00〜24:00、予約可、19席、禁煙 (店外に灰皿)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年3〜9月、英語): 京辛麺の辛さを選べる (5で辛ラーメンくらい)、中華麺かこんにゃく麺、にんにく、パクチー、卵、トマト、餃子、しそ餃子、軟骨、炒飯715円、明け方まで営業、注文の間違いの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose spice level, noodles and toppings when ordering; cards and QR accepted.

places.name: 貴久政 (Kikuma)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo cooking with dashi and soy-based seasonings: sashimi, simmered dishes, grilled fish, dashimaki, sake-lees soup; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, crab and dashi-based dishes (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–13:30, dinner 17:00–22:00, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Book ahead — 10 seats, and walk-ins have been turned away at lunch (February 2025); a short-notice July 2026 booking was hard to get. White miso soup can be requested when booking (January 2025). 10 seats at the counter plus a sunken-table room for 4 behind sliding doors; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). On the north side of Gion near Yasaka Shinchi; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2025 reviews).
places.neighborhood: North Gion, Yasaka Shinchi — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion kappo: a fixed lunch and an à la carte dinner (2025–26 reviews) · lunch set ¥2,500 (January 2025, February 2026; ¥1,600 in 2016): starters, sashimi, simmered dishes, dashimaki grilled in front of you, skewer-grilled fish, kasujiru or miso soup from the fish trimmings, pickles and chirimen-sansho with rice refills, dessert · extras from the dinner menu at lunch, e.g. squid and homemade karasumi, bonito tataki (April 2025) · dinner à la carte or a set budget: kabura-mushi, crab in winter, sashimi, clear soup (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion, a ¥2,500 lunch at a ten-seat counter] A small Gion counter where the chef grills dashimaki in front of you and paces each course to your eating. Lunch is one of Kyoto's kappo bargains — a ¥2,500 set of sashimi, simmered dishes, grilled fish, soup and chirimen-sansho rice — with extras like homemade karasumi; at night the menu goes à la carte, with crab and kabura-mushi in winter. Reviewers call the chef friendly and entertaining. Book ahead; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a friendly, entertaining head chef (January 2025, February 2026) who watches each guest’s pace (January 2025); a September 2026 reviewer says the restaurant comes from the Tankuma lineage.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch set; dashimaki; karasumi.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 diner asked about white miso soup and was told it depends on the chef’s mood, not the season, and can be requested when booking.
A November 2025 diner found the dashimaki gentle but felt the dashi did not quite blend with the egg.
"The chef was also an entertainer, which made for a relaxing atmosphere." — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、東山区八坂新地末吉町78、祇園四条から徒歩約5分、月〜土 11:30〜13:30・17:00〜22:00、日曜休み、予約可、10席、個室 (掘りごたつ4名、襖で仕切る)、禁煙、カード可。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 昼の定食2,500円 (2016年は1,600円)、目の前で焼くだし巻き、串焼きの魚、粕汁、ちりめん山椒、ご飯のおかわり、夜の品書きから追加も可、からすみ、かぶら蒸し、蟹、気さくな大将、Tankuma の流れという記述、要予約。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; lunch is a set; the chef chats at the counter; cards accepted.

places.name: グリル デミ (GRILL DEMI)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: demi-glace sauce, fried shrimp, omurice and beef stew; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, beef tongue, fried shrimp and egg (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00, dinner 17:00–20:30 (Tabelog gives 17:30 in its table); closed Monday and the third Tuesday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog), though a September 2026 diner advises booking; queues of 10–16 people at noon, with waits of 20–50 minutes; you order by QR code while queuing, so food comes quickly once seated (August–October 2026). 20 seats (2 counter, 18 table); non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB), QUICPay, PayPay (Tabelog). In a back street off Ryogaemachi at Ebisugawa, 3 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ryogaemachi at Ebisugawa — 3 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Hamburg steak and demi-glace yoshoku (2026 reviews) · signature tongue-stew hamburg steak on a sizzling plate over a burner ¥2,200 (October 2026) · teppan hamburg steak M 200 g with demi-glace and a fried egg ¥1,500 (October 2026) · "ultimate" set of tongue-stew hamburg, thick-cut tongue steak and boiled tongue (August 2026) · hamburg with fried shrimp and tartar, beef tongue stew, demi-glace omurice, ketchup spaghetti on the side; choose hamburg size, egg style and large rice · red wine ¥500 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Marutamachi, tongue stew on a sizzling hamburg] A small, storybook-looking yoshoku shop near Marutamachi with a queue most lunchtimes. The order is the tongue-stew hamburg steak (¥2,200) — tender beef tongue in thick demi-glace over a hamburg and fried egg, kept bubbling on a burner — or a plain teppan hamburg (¥1,500 for 200 g); fried shrimp and omurice too. You order by QR code in the queue, so food comes fast. One long-time fan found the demi-glace changed in 2026. Closed Monday and the third Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a hamburg-steak specialist with queues of locals and tourists, featured on TV programmes such as "Matsuko no Shiranai Sekai" and "Mahō no Restaurant" (October 2026), and in the manga "Karasu no Ito: Kyoto Meshi" (September 2026). Tabelog Yoshoku WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Tongue-stew hamburg steak.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner who used to come from Osaka for the demi-glace found its flavour had changed significantly and was taken aback.
"While waiting, we placed our order via a QR code, which made the process very systematic and smooth." — September 2026.
An October 2026 diner who prefers spiced hamburgers with nutmeg found the patty standard but the sauce good.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ハンバーグ・洋食・弁当、中京区両替町夷川通室町東入ル巴町80 パルマビル 1F、丸太町駅から徒歩3分、ランチ 11:30〜14:00、ディナー 17:00〜20:30、月曜と第3火曜休み、予約不可、20席 (カウンター2、テーブル18)、禁煙、カード・QUICPay・PayPay 可、洋食 WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): タンシチューハンバーグ2,200円、鉄板ハンバーグ M 200g 1,500円、Ultimate Set Meal (牛タン3種)、海老フライ、オムライス、ナポリタン、昼は10〜16人の行列、並びながら QR コードで注文、デミグラスの味が変わったという声、テレビや漫画で紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue, then order by QR code on your phone; cards and PayPay accepted.

places.name: epice
places.gf_detail: Ask. French courses with bread (refills on request), sauces, ravioli and yoshoku such as shrimp fry on some days; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables lead every course (the vegetable terrine is the signature), but each course also has fish and meat; no vegan course is described (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 20:00); closed Wednesday and two weekends a month (Tabelog). From October 2026 yoshoku is served at lunch, with à la carte at dinner, on Sundays, Mondays and Tuesdays, alongside the courses (Tabelog; October 2026). Online bookings cannot choose seats — phone for requests; when paying partly with Tabelog points, the remainder must be cash (Tabelog; May 2026). Service charge 7% at lunch, 10% at dinner (Tabelog). Small dogs allowed in carriers (Tabelog; March 2026). 34 seats: 8 at the counter, 10 at tables and the 16-seat private "Hanare" for groups of 10 or more (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master), PayPay (Tabelog). In a townhouse on Teramachi south of Imadegawa, 7 min west of Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi south of Imadegawa — 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Vegetable-led French in a Kyoto townhouse (Tabelog, shop text) · signature vegetable terrine · lunch courses ¥3,520 (May 2026) and about ¥5,500 (March 2026): new-onion soup, pan-seared sea bass, pork steak, desserts such as strawberry (2026 reviews) · dinner full course with an extensive wine list including rare vintages and pairings (September 2026) · Sunday–Tuesday yoshoku from October 2026: beef tongue stew, shrimp fry, fresh-fish carpaccio (Tabelog; October 2026)
places.notes: [French · Demachiyanagi, vegetables first in a townhouse] A French restaurant in a Kyoto townhouse on Teramachi near Imadegawa, where vegetables star — start with the much-praised vegetable terrine — before fish and meat. Lunch courses from about ¥3,500 are good value; dinner adds a deep wine list. Since October 2026, Sunday to Tuesday also bring yoshoku such as beef-tongue stew and shrimp fry. Small dogs in carriers are welcome. Reviews are mixed on service: some praise the brisk pace, others found the room noisy or the chef cold to first-timers. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a French full course featuring vegetables in a Kyoto townhouse, with yoshoku added on Sundays–Tuesdays; dogs welcome. An April 2026 visitor found the owner running everything alone that day. Tabelog French WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021.
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable terrine.

anecdotes.text: "The staff seemed rushed, and the kitchen noise was constant, with dishes being handled roughly. ... The chef also lacked a sense of cleanliness; hair should be tied back." — May 2026.
A June 2026 first-time diner felt ignored by the head chef throughout and was put out by having to pay part of the bill in cash after using Tabelog points.
A May 2026 diner found the room noisy with large groups, the staff rushed, dishes handled roughly in the kitchen, and the kitchen’s hygiene lacking.
An April 2026 diner with a train to catch asked for quick service and got it, with the owner running the room alone.
"I was absolutely thrilled with the terrine on the first plate." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・洋食、上京区寺町通今出川下ル真如堂前町105、出町柳駅から今出川通を西へ徒歩7分、11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 20:00)、水曜と月2回の週末休み、予約可 (ネット予約は席の指定不可、ポイント利用時の残額は現金)、サービス料 ランチ7％・ディナー10％、34席 (カウンター8、テーブル10、離れの個室16)、禁煙、カード (VISA・Master)・PayPay 可、フレンチ WEST 百名店 2021、野菜が主役のフレンチのフルコース、京町家、日・月・火は洋食も、犬連れ可。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 野菜のテリーヌ、ランチ3,520円・約5,500円、鱸のポワレ、豚のステーキ、ワイン、10月からの洋食 (タンシチュー、海老フライ)、うるさかった・初めての客に冷たかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online or by phone for seat requests; cards and PayPay; small dogs in carriers allowed.
