places.name: ラム＆ウイスキー (Rum and Whisky)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A spirits bar — rum, whisky and fruit cocktails; no food or gluten information in the sources (2018–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Rum, whisky and seasonal fruit cocktails; no information on ingredients (2018–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 19:00–2:00, Monday and Thursday–Sunday; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). ¥500 charge (Tabelog). 10 seats: 8 at the counter and one table for two (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards: JCB, AMEX, Diners; no e-money (Tabelog). Fourth floor of 光ビル on Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, up by elevator; 283 m from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; 2018 review). Opened 30 May 2009 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Sanjo — 283 m from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Rum-led spirits bar with whisky too: a back bar packed with rum bottles, likened by two reviewers to the rows of Sanjusangendo (2022, 2025 reviews) · the owner guides choices by taste — a cask-strength English rum, a French rum, a JM aged in Calvados barrels (October 2022) · Rhum J.M Single Barrel and Ardbeg Uigeadail (February 2025) · a rare Captain Morgan (December 2024) · seasonal fruit daiquiris and other fruit cocktails (2018 review)
places.notes: [Bar · Kiyamachi, a library of rum] Up an elevator from the noise of Kiyamachi, a quiet room of soft lamps and a back bar lined with rum — and some whisky — bottles, open until two in the morning. Tell the owner what you like and the pours follow: cask-strength rums, Martinique rhum, smoky Islay malts, or a seasonal fruit daiquiri. Quiet enough that one regular reads here. Ten seats; ¥500 charge; four drinks came to about ¥8,000 in 2022. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who guides the rum choices
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 30 May 2009. Reviewers call it a rum specialist and the owner a "master of rum" (2022–2024 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: A 2018 reviewer felt in the owner a deep respect for alcohol, for people and for Kyoto culture.
chef_bio.specialty: Aged rum; seasonal fruit daiquiri.

anecdotes.text: An October 2022 visitor, meaning to have one quick drink, followed the owner’s recommendations through four rums, ending with a JM aged in Calvados barrels — about ¥8,000.
A January 2022 visitor had the bar almost alone for the whole evening, thanks to Omicron and heavy snow.
An August 2024 first-timer had never tasted a rum so strong that just touching it to the lips brought out the alcohol and the sweetness.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラム＆ウイスキー、バー、中京区木屋町三条下ル材木町188-3 光ビル4F、三条駅から283m、月・木〜日 19:00〜翌2:00、火・水休み、予約可、チャージ500円、10席 (カウンター8、2人掛けテーブル1)、喫煙可、カード可 (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、公式サイト rumlovers.net、2009年5月30日オープン。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): ラムの専門バー、棚いっぱいのラム、店主のおすすめ、Rhum J.M Single Barrel、Ardbeg Uigeadail、Captain Morgan、季節のフルーツのダイキリ、静かで本が読める。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥500 charge; smoking allowed; the owner helps choose by taste.

places.name: ラーメン 大志 (Ramen Taishi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in a soy-sauce broth; gyoza (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone broth with back fat, chashu; a raw egg on the mazesoba (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–22:30 daily, holidays included; closing days may vary (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Meal tickets from a machine at the door that takes cash, cards and QR codes (Tabelog; August 2026). 12 seats: 8 at the counter and a table for four at the back (Tabelog; August 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). English and Chinese menus, English-speaking staff, children welcome (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi-dori just north of Matsubara, 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi and Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo (Tabelog). Opened 1 November 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-dori just north of Matsubara — 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style back-fat shoyu ramen: a rich pork-bone soy broth with back fat, thin straight noodles, chashu, green onion and bean sprouts (July–August 2026 reviews) · shoyu ramen ¥930, seasoned egg ¥150 · a shio ramen and a black-shoyu bowl are also named (August–September 2026) · mazesoba ¥950 with thick wavy noodles, two kinds of chashu, minced meat, garlic chips and a raw egg (December 2025) · grilled gyoza ¥400, rice ¥250, pork rice bowl · Kirin small bottle ¥550 (August 2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Kawaramachi-Matsubara, back-fat shoyu until 22:30] A small ramen counter opened in November 2025 on Kawaramachi between Shijo and Gojo, serving the Kyoto classic: a pork-bone shoyu with floating back fat over thin straight noodles (¥930 in August 2026). Diners split on it — some found the broth rich with a smoky charcoal-grilled chashu, others light, sweet-leaning or quite salty. There is also a mazesoba with thick noodles and a raw egg, plus gyoza and rice. Tickets from the machine; English menu; open daily to 22:30.

roles: Operator not named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 1 November 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Back-fat pork-bone shoyu ramen; mazesoba.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 parent, with nothing planned in the middle of Obon, came on a Kyoto ramen stamp rally because the daughter wanted ramen — and, taken with the shoyu, wanted to try the shio next.
An August 2026 visitor stopped in after a night of drinking and found the bowl lighter than it looked.

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese menus and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); ticket machine.

places.name: 壺味 (Tsubomi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-batter negiyaki, okonomiyaki and takoyaki are the core of the menu (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus, wagyu, pork kimchi, and egg in the negiyaki (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 22:30), Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); a June 2026 visitor booked by phone. Usually crowded; long queues in cherry-blossom and autumn-leaf seasons, easier in summer (July 2026). The negiyaki is grilled to order and takes about 40 minutes to an hour (July–August 2026). Hot inside in summer (2026 reviews). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No charge (Tabelog). 8 counter seats plus standing room for about 5; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Under an old fishing-tackle-shop sign with takoyaki lanterns (June 2026), 115 m from Omiya Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishiki-Omiya — 115 m from Hankyu Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Showa-era konamon counter: negiyaki, okonomiyaki and takoyaki on the teppan (2026 reviews) · the signature negiyaki ¥1,500, piled with Kujo green onions — three stalks a serving, cut to order by the owner’s mother — and grilled slowly until sweet (June–August 2026) · mixed okonomiyaki ¥1,200 · takoyaki, eight for ¥500 (August 2026; a June 2026 diner recalled eight large for ¥700), also with garlic · garlic-grilled octopus with cabbage, wagyu steak on the teppan, white corn, pork kimchi · highballs, beer, sake and shochu (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Omiya, the hour-long negiyaki] A worn, Showa-era counter of eight seats near Omiya Station, under an old fishing-tackle sign, run by the owner and the owner’s mother. Come for the negiyaki (¥1,500): a mountain of Kujo green onions, cut to order and grilled slowly on the teppan for 40 minutes to an hour until sweet and creamy. Order takoyaki, garlic octopus or a mixed okonomiyaki while you wait among chatty regulars and travellers — the owner speaks English. Cash only; hot in summer; queues in the cherry-blossom and autumn seasons. Closed Wednesday.

roles: The owner’s mother, who cuts the green onions
chef_bio.background: An August 2026 review calls it a long-established konamon shop; another says the owner and the owner’s mother run it. An April 2026 reviewer heard the owner speaking English with tourists and wondered whether it came from earlier work abroad.
chef_bio.specialty: Negiyaki of Kujo green onions.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner asked the owner about the negiyaki and learned that each one takes three stalks of Kujo green onion, thicker than the usual kind.
A June 2026 regular was greeted with "Thank you for coming on such a hot day," on a day that was actually cool, and noted that the owner’s mother cuts the green onions after each order.

A July 2026 visitor during the Gion Festival was waved inside by regulars drinking outside, and heard from the owner that summer is the easy season — cherry-blossom and autumn-leaf seasons bring long lines.
An April 2026 neighbour had walked past for years, too shy to go in; the owner’s "Sorry for the wait, I’ll cook the next batch for you!" settled that.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 壺味、たこ焼き・お好み焼き、中京区錦大宮町152、大宮駅から115m、月・火・木〜日 17:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00、ドリンクL.O.22:30)、水曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、サービス料・チャージなし、8席 (立ち飲み約5人)、貸切20人まで、喫煙可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 名物のねぎ焼き1,500円 (Kujo ねぎ3本、注文後に母が切る、焼き上がりまで40分〜1時間)、ミックスお好み焼き1,200円、たこ焼き8個500円、にんにくのたこ焼き、たこのガーリック焼き、和牛ステーキ、豚キムチ、店主と母で営む昭和の雰囲気の店、店主は英語で外国人客と話す、夏は店内が暑い。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; smoking allowed; the owner speaks English with travellers (April 2026); allow up to an hour for the negiyaki.

places.name: 京料理 藤本 (Kyo Ryori Fujimoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase courses of sashimi, dashi soups and simmered dishes, with tempura and desserts such as mille-feuille; the kitchen took likes, dislikes and menu requests at booking (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood-led courses and soups on bonito and kombu dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: dinner 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30) Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday; lunch 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 12:30) Tuesday, Friday and Sunday; closed Wednesday and public holidays. Tabelog differs: closed Tuesday as well as Wednesday. Reservations through the official site (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (official site; Michelin). 13 seats at a white-wood counter (Tabelog; official site). Non-smoking; no parking (official site). Off Shinmachi south of Oike, 266 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog). At this address since July 2018 (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi south of Oike — 266 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Kyoto cuisine as omakase at a white-wood counter, with a Michelin star after the 2018 move (official site) · evening omakase ¥14,300 (official site); lunch courses of ¥5,000, ¥7,000, ¥7,700 and ¥10,000 named (2025 reviews) · abalone cooked in sake to open, sesame tofu in soups on bonito and Rishiri kombu dashi, sashimi with sea urchin and tuna, hamo with Kamo eggplant, Manganji peppers in tempura, figs in sesame with black shichimi, Kagoshima roast beef, grilled fish under homemade karasumi, seasonal rice (2025–2026 reviews) · desserts from a cart — guests ask for "one of everything" (2025–2026 reviews) · sake chosen to taste (2025 review)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Shinmachi-Oike, a Michelin-starred counter run by a couple] A thirteen-seat white-wood counter just off Shinmachi south of Oike, run by the chef, Fujimoto, and the chef’s wife. The omakase follows the market: abalone simmered in sake, hamo and matsutake soup, sashimi with sea urchin, Manganji pepper tempura, grilled fish under homemade karasumi, and a dessert cart where guests ask for everything. Lunch (¥5,000–10,000 in 2025) is the bargain; dinner is ¥14,300. Give likes and dislikes when you book. Cash only; closed Wednesday.

roles: The chef’s wife, front of house
chef_bio.background: Per a September 2026 review: a Kyoto native who trained at restaurants including Shuhaku, went independent in 2008, and moved to the present address in 2018. The Michelin Guide says the family were vegetable wholesalers, so markets were familiar from childhood, and that trips to the market with a mentor taught the eye for ingredients. The official site dates the move to July 2018 and says a Michelin star followed.
chef_bio.philosophy: The Michelin Guide writes that the chef wants a menu rich in ingredients to convey the seasons and the people behind the ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal omakase; homemade karasumi; the dessert cart.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 diner who had disliked conger eel in Tokyo, where it came boiled with plum paste, came round here over grilled conger eel and tempura — and ordered a Nagasaki sake, Hiran, for home after the shop introduced it.
At a holiday lunch in July 2026, with the chef cooking solo, the dishes came out together, and two guests drank seven cups of sake for ¥20,680 in all.
A November 2025 guest on a third visit took the dessert option of “everything” — a Shine Muscat mille-feuille and a monaka made on the spot.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京料理 藤本、日本料理、中京区新町通御池下ル神明町72 エリタージュ新町1F、烏丸御池駅から266m、予約は公式サイトから、カード不可、13席、禁煙、2018年7月2日オープン。公式サイト: 夜18:00〜22:00 (月・火・木〜日)、昼12:00〜14:00 (火・金・日)、水曜・祝日休み、夜のおまかせ14,300円、白木のカウンター、2018年7月に移転、移転後もミシュランの星。ミシュランガイド: 実家が野菜の卸業で幼い頃から市場に親しみ、師匠と市場へ行き目利きを学んだ、現金のみ。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営む、店主の Fujimoto さんは京都出身で Shuhaku などで修業、2008年に独立、鮑の酒煮、胡麻豆腐、鱧と松茸、自家製からすみ、デザートワゴン、昼のコース5,000〜10,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Book through the official site and give likes and dislikes; cash only; omakase only.

places.name: mitoho kyoto bettei
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Courses are built on dashi, soy-based sukiyaki and special sauces; no gluten information is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat courses (Japan’s three great wagyu, Omi beef) with dashi, bonito-topped egg rice and fish (official site; Tabelog courses).
places.hours_raw: Lunch seatings at 10:00, 12:00 and 14:00 (one hour each); dinner 17:00–22:30, last seating 20:30 (about two hours); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservation only; arrive 5 minutes early, as all guests start together; for seat-only bookings, choose the course by 17:00 the day before (Tabelog). One drink order required at lunch (March 2026). 10 counter seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley off Miyagawa-suji south of Shijo, with only a small lit sign at your feet (April 2026); 5 min from Gion-Shijo or Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Grand opening 28 January 2025 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Miyagawacho, down an alley south of Shijo — 5 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese courses centred on wagyu at a 10-seat counter (Tabelog; official site) · lunch "immersive course to enjoy Kyoto with all five senses" ¥5,000 (6 items): four starters of Kyoto cuisine with Kyoto vegetables, fish or meat grilled with Kyoto vegetables and house sauce, rice in a three-tier jewel box eaten with bonito flakes then as tamago-kake-gohan, and a dessert (official site; Tabelog) · lunch sukiyaki course of Japan’s three great wagyu ¥8,000 · dinner: Meat Lover’s Feast "Extreme" ¥13,800, three-wagyu sukiyaki course ¥14,800, PREMIUM course with Omi beef ¥16,000 (Tabelog course page) · winter lunch dishes on the site: Jerusalem-artichoke soup, duck loin simmered with yuzu (official site) · reviewers mention braised tongue, grilled shabu-shabu and sukiyaki (July 2026)
places.notes: [Japanese & wagyu · Miyagawacho, a hidden 10-seat meat counter] A ten-seat counter hidden down an alley in Miyagawacho, opened in January 2025, where a young owner-chef cooks wagyu-centred Japanese courses for a few groups at a time. Lunch (from ¥5,000) runs from four small Kyoto-style starters to a grilled main and a three-tier box of rice eaten first with bonito flakes and then as tamago-kake-gohan; dinner courses (¥13,800–16,000) bring sukiyaki of Japan's three great wagyu and an Omi-beef yakiniku course. All guests start together — book and arrive early. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Young owner-chef who runs the room alone (May 2026); not named. Operator 株式会社リーフィ (Osaka; invoice T2120001154574)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the mitoho story began with a woman who grew up in the village of 南山城村 in Kyoto, among rice fields, and believed people grow healthy through nature’s power. Grand opening 28 January 2025 after a pre-opening in mid-January (official site). A December 2025 reviewer says the restaurant is supervised by the owner of a Michelin two-star restaurant, "Yugen". A May 2026 reviewer found the young owner managing alone as the chef. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社リーフィ (NTA corporate-number site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: Kyoto through all five senses — seasonal food with Kyoto vegetables, old Japanese tradition renewed with new ingredients and methods.
chef_bio.specialty: Three-tier rice box with bonito and egg; wagyu sukiyaki; immersive lunch course.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner booked 10:00 for a leisurely breakfast and was the only guest, served by the young owner-chef who runs it alone.
A March 2026 diner was surprised by the tamago-kake-gohan, with so much katsuobushi that plenty was left after adding a lot.
A December 2025 reviewer writes that the restaurant is supervised by the owner of a Michelin two-star restaurant, "Yugen".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (mitoho.jp): 京都 宮川町の日本料理 mitoho kyoto bettei、京都を五感で楽しむ没入型ランチコース、前菜4種 (京料理や日本料理、京野菜)、焼き物 (予約時にお魚かお肉を選ぶ、京野菜と特製ソース)、ご飯もの (珠型三段重、京漬物、鰹節、濃厚な卵で卵かけご飯)、水物、冬季の菊芋のスープ、黄柚子香る鴨ロース煮、2025年1月28日グランドオープン、物語: 京都・南山城村で育ったある一人の女性。食べログ: 日本料理・すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ、完全予約制、東山区宮川筋四条下る宮川筋5-324-2、祇園四条駅・清水五条駅から徒歩5分、ランチは10時・12時・14時 (各1時間)、ディナー17:00〜20:30 最終入店 (約2時間)、水曜休み、一斉スタート、10席 (カウンター)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、インボイス T2120001154574 (株式会社リーフィ)、コース: ランチ5,000円・8,000円、ディナー13,800円・14,800円・16,000円。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年8月、英語): 若いオーナーが一人で料理、卵かけご飯、近江牛、すき焼き。

cultural_comfort.note: Booking only; arrive 5 minutes early (all start together); one drink order at lunch.

places.name: ステーキ・鉄板焼 みくら (Steak Teppanyaki Mikura)
places.gf_detail: Ask — the shop asks about allergies (official site). Courses include steamed bread, a yuba-and-seafood parcel and sauces; the lunch set adds pancakes (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu steak and seafood teppanyaki courses (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), every day; closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog lists open year-round). 10% service charge on courses (official site; Tabelog). Bookings taken; check whether a lunch booking includes the welcome drink (August 2026). 15 counter seats in front of the teppan, some by the window over the Kamo River; designated smoking area; cards and QR (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On the 3rd floor of the 先斗町ビル, three buildings south of Sanjo on Pontocho near the Kaburenjo; no sign in the lift (September 2026); 3–4 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn (official site; Tabelog). Formerly named 味くら (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho just south of Sanjo, over the Kamo River — 3 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki of A4-and-up Kuroge wagyu, lobster and Kyoto vegetables at a counter with a view of Mt Hiei across the Kamo (official site) · chef’s course ¥8,800 (7 dishes) with 80 g of wagyu loin, or 100 g ¥11,000, 120 g ¥13,200; fillet 80 g ¥12,100, 100 g ¥14,850, 120 g ¥17,600 · special Mikura course from ¥11,000 (10 dishes: yuba-and-seafood parcel, shrimp with shiso-cashew sauce, Kyoto vegetables, choice of steak) (official site) · lunch "Kyoto’s best pancake & mini steak plate": appetizers, onion soup, an 80 g steak, rice and pancakes, ¥2,640 (August–October 2026; ¥2,400 in two July–August 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Pontocho, wagyu over the Kamo River] A fifteen-seat teppan counter on the third floor of a Pontocho building, with windows over the Kamo River towards Mt Hiei. Dinner courses start at ¥8,800 with A4-grade wagyu loin, grilled in front of you, plus Kyoto vegetables and lobster on the special course; lunch is the bargain — a steak-and-pancake set for about ¥2,640 with appetizers and onion soup. Reviewers like the view, the chef's show and the value; one August 2026 regular found the meat tougher than before. 10% service on courses. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: The invoice register lists an individual, 西藤 啓太, for the shop’s invoice number. Per the official site: counter seats only, so guests can watch the cooking; a friendly, at-home atmosphere despite teppanyaki’s high-end image; A4-and-up Kuroge wagyu and Kyoto vegetables. Formerly named 味くら (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to let people enjoy teppanyaki more casually, with consistent quality under the tension of cooking in front of guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu loin and fillet teppanyaki; steak-and-pancake lunch set.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular on a fourth visit found the meat tough, lean and slightly off, and cooked rarer than the medium-rare asked for.
A July 2026 pair was surprised to be served one steak cut in half for two, though the pancakes were generous.
A September 2026 diner praised the friendly, skilled chef grilling right in front of the counter and the view.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-mikura.com): 京都・先斗町で鴨川越しに比叡山を望む鉄板焼き、野菜は京都のもの、カウンター席のみ、A4ランク以上の国産黒毛和牛、オマール海老、旬の京野菜、本日のシェフのお任せコース8,800円 (全7品、ロース80g 8,800円・100g 11,000円・120g 13,200円、フィレ80g 12,100円・100g 14,850円・120g 17,600円)、特選みくらコース11,000円〜 (全10品、京湯葉と海鮮の包み焼き、特選海老の鉄板焼き 大葉とカシューナッツソース、京野菜の鉄板焼き)、サービス料10%、中京区先斗町三条下る橋下町135 先斗町ビル3F、三条駅6番出口より徒歩約4分、ランチ11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)、ディナー17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、不定休。食べログ: ステーキ・鉄板焼き・魚介料理、旧店名 味くら、15席 (カウンター)、分煙、カード・QR 可、インボイス登録: 西藤 啓太 (個人)。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): パンケーキとミニステーキのプレート2,640円 (7〜8月は2,400円の口コミも)、鴨川の眺め、肉が硬くなったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; ask for a window seat; 10% service on courses.

places.name: 純心庵 (Junshin An)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses mix seafood dishes, a soup and charcoal-grilled wagyu; no gluten information is published (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu steak, lobster, abalone and seafood courses (official menu).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00; open Friday to Sunday, other days by reservation only; closed irregularly (Tabelog; official site gives 18:00–23:00 and irregular closures). A limited number of guests a day (official site). Lobster and THE Junshin An courses must be booked two days ahead (official site). A December 2021 solo diner was offered only a designated Sunday. 10% service charge (Tabelog). 32 seats: a counter of 7, tables, private rooms and a 2nd floor; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). Through a narrow entrance on Matsubara-dori west of Yamato-oji, in a spacious Kyoto-style interior; about 240 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (official site; March 2026). Founded 1979 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Matsubara-dori west of Yamato-oji — 4 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Steak house since 1979: "創味割鮮" seafood and charcoal (binchotan) grilled wagyu with a Japanese touch (official site) · Kuroge wagyu charcoal steak course with starters, soup and a vegetable dish, about 100 g ¥10,000, 150 g ¥13,000 (DX +¥3,200) · BOSS omakase course of seafood dishes and a small wagyu main, A ¥10,000, B ¥12,000, C ¥15,000, Premium · live lobster (550–600 g) or abalone steak with wagyu, for two ¥38,000–42,000 · THE Junshin An course (seafood salad, abalone steak, lobster, wagyu) for two ¥50,000–54,000 (official menu) · fresh oysters, crab, very spicy curry, abalone liver (2023–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Steak & seafood · Matsubara, a 1979 charcoal steak house] A long-running steak house behind a narrow entrance on Matsubara-dori, opening into a spacious, dim, Kyoto-style room of counter, tables and private rooms. The 'BOSS' cooks a seafood-and-steak style called 創味割鮮: Kuroge wagyu grilled over binchotan with Japanese touches, alongside crab, oysters, abalone and live lobster. Courses from ¥10,000 (plus 10% service); lobster and abalone courses for two from ¥38,000. Some guests hold every celebration here. Open Friday–Sunday evenings, other days by reservation.

roles: The owner signs as "BOSS" on the official site; not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: ステーキハウス純心庵 since 1979; a limited number of guests a day in roomy seats; seafood and rich steak with a Japanese taste, grilled over binchotan; private rooms. Reviewers note many regulars (May 2024) and celebration gifts (June 2026). Tabelog Steak "Tabelog 100" (2021 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site (BOSS): "贅沢に、優雅に、そして安心して、存分にお楽しみください" — enjoy it luxuriously, gracefully and without worry.
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan wagyu steak; BOSS omakase seafood course; lobster and abalone.

anecdotes.text: A June 2023 couple asked a week ahead for lobster for a wedding anniversary and found it prepared as asked.
"All our celebrations are held here," another guest told a March 2026 diner.
A June 2026 diner on a crab course received a celebration gift on leaving.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (junshinan.com): 京都・祇園花街の創味割鮮 ステーキハウス純心庵、since 1979 kyoto、1日限定人数・ゆったり席、備長炭で焼き上げる、BOSS、東山区松原通大和大路西入ル弓矢町24-1、18:00〜23:00、不定休、清水五条駅より約240m、メニュー: 特選黒毛和牛 炭火焼きステーキコース 約100g 10,000円・約150g 13,000円 (DX +3,200円)、BOSS におまかせコース A 10,000円・B 12,000円・C 15,000円・Premium、活オマール海老&特選黒毛和牛 (2日前までに要予約) 二人で38,000〜42,000円、アワビステーキ&特選黒毛和牛 二人で38,000〜42,000円、THE 純心庵コース 二人で50,000〜54,000円。食べログ: ステーキ・ヨーロッパ料理・洋食、18:00〜23:00、金・土・日 (ほかの日は予約のみ)、不定休、サービス料10%、32席 (カウンター7、テーブル、個室、2階)、禁煙、カード可。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 常連が多い、記念日、蟹、オマール海老、生牡蠣。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (weekdays by reservation only); lobster and abalone courses two days ahead.

places.name: ベッカライ・ペルケオ・アルト・ハイデルベルク (Bäckerei Perkeo Alt Heidelberg)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: German breads of rye, wheat and house-milled organic spelt (dinkel), plus cakes (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Many German rye and wheat breads are made from flour, water, salt and the house sourdough cultures, but no ingredient list is published; pretzels, sandwiches and cakes use butter, sausage or cream (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 9:00–18:00 Monday and Friday; 7:30–18:00 Saturday, Sunday and holidays; closed Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday; summer and New Year breaks posted on the site (official site; Tabelog). About 20 of 30 German breads each day; some sell out by late afternoon (September 2026). Phone reservations for bread (Tabelog). 6 eat-in seats inside and on the terrace (Tabelog; official site). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). Staff greet in English or German (October 2026). On the ground floor of クリヨン岡崎, 1 min from the Okazaki-jinja-mae bus stop; about 20 min walk from Keage or Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (official site). Opened December 2009 (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki by Okazaki Shrine — 1 min from the Okazaki-jinja-mae bus stop
places.cuisine: German bakery of two Bäckermeister: about 20 of 30 German breads a day from domestic rye and wheat and house-milled organic German spelt, raised with 8 natural sourdough cultures built from 3 brought from Germany (official site) · Laugen pretzel ¥350, Brötchen ¥240, 100% Roggen ¥590 (September 2026); Jägerbrötchen and other rye breads · sandwiches (wurst, prosciutto), German cakes such as Linzer Torte and Flocken Sahne (2026 reviews; official site) · café drinks of Dallmayr coffee and tea: coffee ¥550, cappuccino ¥750, iced coffee ¥620; juices ¥500; German beer (official site)
places.notes: [Bakery · Okazaki, German bread from two master bakers] A German bakery near Okazaki Shrine run by Mariko, from Kyoto, and Johnny, from Germany, who met at the state bakery school in Weinheim, both earned the Bäckermeister title in 2009, and later married. About twenty German breads a day — sour, chewy rye loaves, Laugen pretzels (¥350), Brötchen — raised on natural sourdoughs from German starters, plus German cakes and sandwiches, with Dallmayr coffee at six seats inside and on the terrace. Open Friday to Monday; arrive early for the full range.

chef_bio.chef_name: Mariko and Johnny (マリコ and ジョニー)
roles: Bäckermeister and owners (official site): Mariko, from Kyoto, and Johnny, from Germany, a married couple; Johnny is the main chef since September 2018
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (written by Mariko): taken with German bread and Heidelberg on a trip, Mariko went to Germany alone in August 2004 and talked a Heidelberg bakery into an apprenticeship, earning the Geselle qualification in February 2007; at the state bakery school in Weinheim, Johnny sat next to Mariko; both earned the Meister title in July 2009; Mariko returned and opened the bakery in Kyoto in December 2009, the name Perkeo coming from a figure in Heidelberg legend; after a long-distance relationship Johnny and Mariko married and Johnny came to Japan; from 2013 to 2016 Johnny worked as a Meister in German bakeries, taught at the Weinheim school from 2017 and qualified as a bread judge, then returned in September 2018 as Perkeo’s main chef and expanded the cakes. Tabelog Bakery WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026 (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "日本人にドイツパンの本当の美味しさを届けたい" — to bring the real taste of German bread to Japan, aiming for the best German bread in Japan.
chef_bio.specialty: Laugen pretzel; rye breads; German cakes.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor was greeted in English or German by staff who switched to fluent Japanese at the counter.
A June 2026 visitor came for pretzels, found only one, and was won over by the rye bread instead.
A September 2026 holiday visitor at 16:00 found some items sold out.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (perkeo-kyoto.com): 京都市岡崎のドイツパン専門店 ベッカライ・ペルケオ、ドイツパン職人の最高資格マイスターを持つジョニーとマリコ、天然酵母から100%手作り、国産のライ麦・小麦、自家製粉のドイツ産オーガニックのディンケル小麦、約30種のレシピから約20種を日替わり、ドイツから持ってきた3種の酵母種をもとに8タイプの天然酵母、ペルケオ誕生物語: ドイツ人のジョニーと京都出身のマリコ、2004年8月に単身渡独、ハイデルベルクのパン屋に弟子入り、2007年2月にゲゼレ、ヴァインハイムの国立製パン学校でジョニーと出会う、2009年7月にマイスター、2009年12月に京都で開店、ペルケオはハイデルベルクの伝説の人物の名、その後ジョニーと結婚、2018年9月からジョニーがメインシェフ、カフェ: ダルマイヤーのコーヒー・紅茶、ドイツビール、レギュラーコーヒー550円、カプチーノ750円、アイスコーヒー620円、店舗: 左京区岡崎天王町54-1 クリヨン岡崎1階、平日9:00〜18:00、土・日・祝7:30〜18:00、火・水・木定休。食べログ: パン・チョコレート・カフェ、6席、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、2009年12月6日オープン。口コミ (2026年5〜11月、英語): Laugen pretzel 350円、Brötchen 240円、Roggen 590円、Linzer Torte、英語やドイツ語のあいさつ。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff greet in English or German (October 2026); the site has an English page.

places.name: 寺町 大丈夫 (Teramachi Daijoubu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; curries are served with Japanese rice, and how they are thickened is not described (2024–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetable keema with lemon cream appears beside chicken, beef-tendon and keema curries (February 2025); dairy (cream, yogurt) is used in some.

places.neighborhood: Teramachi arcade north of Shijo — 7 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn

places.notes: [Spice curry · Teramachi arcade, a one-person curry bar] A 16-seat café-bar at the back of a second floor off the Teramachi arcade, with a DJ booth, where the owner alone cooks Indian-based spice curries mixed with a Japanese touch: the house Daijoubu chicken curry (¥1,080 in 2025), beef-tendon korma, a lemon-cream vegetable keema and a changing plate with achaar and sides. Most reviewers find it warm and good value; one October 2025 diner felt the service cold. Cash only; smoking allowed. Lunch and dinner, closed irregularly.

roles: Owner (unnamed) who runs the shop alone, per 2025 reviews
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction: original spice curries based on Indian food, aiming to blend Indian cooking with Japanese curry, made fresh every day, and a bar as well; opened 12 September 2015 under the earlier name カフェ&バー 大丈夫. Reviewers in 2025 describe a quiet, kind and stylish owner who runs the place solo (April and September 2025) and a DJ booth in the room (April 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog: balancing ease of eating with bold flavours, hoping guests fall in love with Indian food.
chef_bio.specialty: Daijoubu spice curry; keema plates.

anecdotes.text: "Daijoubu" is such a kind phrase — a November 2025 diner was glad to see the sign, and was asked whether cilantro was all right.
An October 2025 diner was told to call out when ready, then had to shout the order to the kitchen, and found the service cold and the food unremarkable.
An April 2025 diner climbed past renovation boards in the building, unsure it was open, and found the shop at the very back of the second floor.

places.name: 浜作 新本店 (Hamasaku Shin-honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; one set kappo course built on kombu dashi, with dishes such as fried Wakasa sole and somen (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a set course of fish and seafood (sea bream, hamo, abalone, eel, sea urchin) built on dashi (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: 17:00–22:00, closed irregularly; Tabelog lists 18:00–21:00 Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Saturday, closed Wednesday and Sunday; courses start at 18:00 (July 2026). Reservation only: telephone first (075-223-8118 for bookings; 075-561-0330 the shop); the site says seats are heavily booked and dates are arranged after a call. Regular service ends at the end of March 2027, after a final "farewell" year from April 2026, marking the 100th year since the 1927 founding (official site). Dress: semi-formal, jackets for men (official site; Tabelog). An L-shaped counter; non-smoking; cards accepted (Tabelog; July 2026). About ¥100,000 a head per recent reviews. On Shinmachi-dori south of Rokkaku; about 10 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma, or tell a taxi “蛸薬師新町上る 浜作” (official site).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi-dori south of Rokkaku — about 10 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Japan’s first itamae kappo (counter cooking in front of the guest), founded in Gion in 1927 (official site) · one course a night, priced by the season (July 2026): yuba with kuzukiri, sea urchin and lily bulb, a clear soup of hamo, Awaji flatfish sashimi, hamo tataki, abalone, fried Wakasa sole (a house classic), simmered shrimp-potato, sea-bream sashimi, dashimaki, white-miso soup, grilled eel with somen; dashi of top-grade kombu (2023–2026 reviews) · about ¥100,000 a head (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Itamae kappo · Shinmachi-Rokkaku, the first of its kind] Hamasaku opened in Gion in 1927 as Japan's first itamae kappo — the chef cooking at the counter in front of guests — and served Kawabata Yasunari, Shiga Naoya and Princess Grace of Monaco among others (official site); the third-generation master Hiroyuki Morikawa now cooks at an L-shaped counter in the new main shop on Shinmachi. One seasonal course built on outstanding dashi, around ¥100,000 a head. Regular service ends in March 2027 after a farewell year. Reservation by phone; jackets for men. Mon, Tue, Thu–Sat evenings.

roles: Third-generation owner (浜作三代目店主) and president of 株式会社浜作, per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 森川裕之 was born in Gion-machi, Kyoto, in 1962, spent student days in Tokyo at kabuki, classical concerts and opera, and took over as third generation in 1991 on the death of the father, the second-generation 武; the founder, the grandfather 森川榮 (森川栄), opened Hamasaku on 1 September 1927 (Showa 2) in Gion Tominaga-cho as Japan’s first itamae kappo. The cookery school 浜作料理教室, started around the same time, has run some 2,300 sessions for 30,000 people; in 2017 the master was honoured as a Contemporary Master Craftsman, the youngest in Kyoto cuisine; books include 和食の教科書 ぎをん献立帖 and 京料理の品格. Guests listed on the site include the Showa Emperor, Kawabata Yasunari, Shiga Naoya, Mukoda Kuniko, Robert De Niro and Princess Grace of Monaco. The site announces that regular service ends at the end of March 2027, the 100th year, fulfilling a promise to the late father, after the master returned to the counter from a nine-hour heart operation over the New Year. Facebook account: hiroyuki.morikawa.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: since the founder, choosing first-class ingredients and cooking "to create something delicious" — not by form, not for show.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal itamae kappo course; hamo; dashi.

anecdotes.text: "Recently, it seems that Charles Chaplin visited, and his son came 90 years later and was so moved that he cried." — a regular of 20 visits, August 2026.
A September 2025 diner found the conger-eel and matsutake soup lacking in taste and the dishes below average, though stylish.
Jackets required, a July 2026 diner in the Gion Festival heat found folding screens on show in the building for the festival.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hamasaku.kyoto): 日本最初の板前割烹 京ぎをん浜作、昭和二年九月一日に祖父森川榮が京都祇園富永町で創業、今年で百周年、来年の三月末で通常営業を終える、三十六年前に父が亡くなり後を継いだ、二代目の父との約束、年末年始の九時間の心臓大手術を乗り越えカウンターに復帰、今年四月からの一年が本当の浜作さよなら営業、予約は二月二十三日から。三代目主人 森川裕之: 浜作三代目店主・株式会社浜作代表取締役、1962年京都・祇園町生まれ、東京での学生時代に歌舞伎・クラシック・オペラ、1991年に二代目の父・武の逝去で三代目を継承、初代森川栄以来「美味しいものを創る」、浜作料理教室 通算2300回・延べ3万人、平成29年「現代の名工」(京料理界最年少)、著書『和食の教科書 ぎをん献立帖』『京料理の品格』『名食決定盤』ほか、御贔屓: 昭和天皇、川端康成、志賀直哉、向田邦子、ロバート・デ・ニーロ、グレース モナコ大公妃ほか。ご予約: まずは電話で (新本店代表 075-561-0330、ご予約専用 075-223-8118)、ドレスコードはセミフォーマル、男性はジャケット着用。アクセス: 中京区新町通六角下ル六角町360、営業時間17:00〜22:00 (不定休)、タクシーで「蛸薬師新町上る 浜作まで」。食べログ: 日本料理、月・火・木〜土 18:00〜21:00、水・日休み、完全予約制、禁煙、カード可。口コミ (2023年1月〜2026年8月、英語): 1人10万円以上、L字のカウンター、鱧、湯葉の葛切り、若狭の魚の唐揚げ、鰻と素麺、昆布だし。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation by phone only, often booked far ahead — a hotel concierge or Japanese speaker helps; jackets for men; one set course.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the signatures are egg-and-cheese soufflé, egg pudding cake and crêpes with caramel, cream and ice cream (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Shop 10:00–17:00; café 11:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Café seats can be booked (Tabelog; May 2026). Six counter seats in the back, facing the crêpe griddle; English menu; non-smoking; cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). In an alley just west of Hanamikoji, south of Shijo; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: An alley just west of Hanamikoji, south of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion sweets shop and six-seat crêpe counter from the Hanamikoji restaurant 侘家古暦堂 (official site; Tabelog) · "Gohobi" (reward) crêpes made to order with caramel finished on the spot: red-egg caramel, hojicha and Tanba chestnut; savoury "gochiso" crêpes such as hojicha with prosciutto and persimmon, or fig, cheese and basil (official site; 2026 reviews) · cheese soufflé "chef’s hat" ¥303, Tanba-chestnut version ¥454 (autumn); red-egg pudding cake; tuiles, nut cookies, amber nougat bar (official site) · kakigori in summer; coffee charcoal-roasted by Ogawa Coffee (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sweets & crêpes · Gion, off Hanamikoji] A small sweets shop in a quiet Gion alley from the 20-year-old Hanamikoji restaurant 侘家古暦堂, with six counter seats at the back where crêpes are cooked to order and finished with caramel made in front of you — chestnut and hojicha in autumn, or savoury prosciutto and persimmon. To take away: the 'chef's hat' cheese soufflé (¥303). Opened 2025. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Operator: 侘家古暦堂 (restaurant group); no person named
chef_bio.background: Opened 29 October 2025 (Tabelog). Per the official site: the sweets arm of 侘家古暦堂, a restaurant on Hanamikoji for 20 years, made by its head chef and a pâtissier together; shops at Osaka Takashimaya, Kyoto Takashimaya and this Nishi-Hanamikoji shop. The parent’s site also lists the restaurant 侘家古暦堂 祇園花見小路本店, wabiya and 薬味wabiya.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "自然に、丹念に、素を活かす" — naturally and carefully, making the most of the ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: Gohobi crêpes; chef’s-hat cheese soufflé.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 return visitor came back just for the hojicha and chestnut crêpe — and finished it "in seconds".
Soon after opening the staff seemed unsteady and service slow until another person took over the crêpes — September 2026.
After the Miyako Odori, an April 2026 buyer found the staff helpful with a larger takeaway order.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kashi.wabiya.com): 菓子wabiya、京都花見小路で料理店を営む侘家古暦堂から、料理長とパティシエが対話を重ねたお菓子、自然に丹念に素を活かす、チーズスフレ 料理長の帽子 303円、丹波栗 454円 (秋限定)、赤たまごの匠プリンケーキ、薄玻璃チュイル、ナッツクッキー 祇園このみ、琥珀ヌガーバー、ご褒美クレープ (ほうじ茶 丹波栗、赤たまごキャラメル)、ご馳走クレープ ほうじ茶 生ハム&柿 (西花見小路店限定)、大阪髙島屋店・京都髙島屋店・西花見小路店。食べログ: スイーツ・クレープ・ガレット、東山区祇園町南側570-123、物販 10:00〜17:00、カフェ 11:00〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、水曜休み、予約可、6席 (カウンターのみ)、英語メニュー、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、2025年10月29日オープン、小川珈琲の炭火焙煎コーヒー。口コミ (2026年4〜10月、英語): 米粉のクレープ、目の前で作るキャラメル、かき氷、無花果とチーズとバジルのクレープ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); counter seats facing the griddle; book the café.

places.name: ぎをん今 (Gion Kon)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Unadon with its sauce, soft-shelled-turtle ramen, hot pots and kappo dishes on dashi; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: eel, soft-shelled turtle, fish and beef dishes (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch in two sittings, 12:00 and 13:00, by booking (phone, Instagram DM or online); hot-pot dinner from 17:30 by booking; the evening kappo is referral-only (完全紹介制) and takes no bookings from new guests; closing days irregular — calendar on the official site (official site; 2026 reviews). 50% cancellation charge from three days before, 100% on the day (official site; Tabelog). Lunch about ¥5,000–10,000; hot-pot course from ¥10,000 (official site). 26 seats incl. counter, tatami and private rooms; private hire for 10 or more; separate smoking area; JCB, AMEX and Diners (official site; Tabelog). Takeaway eel sushi and inari, ordered ahead and collected at lunch (official site). Gion south of Shijo; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion south of Shijo (Gion-machi Minamigawa) — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion kappo that is "ichigen-san okotowari" at night, opening its doors at lunch and for hot-pot dinners (official site) · lunch: unadon with charcoal-grilled eel, soft-shelled-turtle (suppon) ramen, a mini eel course (2026 reviews) · hot-pot course from ¥10,000 (official site) · evening kappo à la carte for introduced guests: karasumi, matsutake dobin-mushi with hamo, fried abalone, Kagoshima or Kumamoto beef fillet, bamboo-shoot or eel rice (2026 reviews) · takeaway: eel sushi with a whole Hamanako eel ¥8,100 (half ¥4,320), two-bite inari ¥2,376 (official site)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion, a referral-only house that opens at lunch] A long-established Gion kappo that only takes introduced guests at night — but anyone can book its two lunch sittings for a charcoal-grilled unadon or a soft-shelled-turtle ramen (about ¥5,000–10,000), or a hot-pot dinner from ¥10,000. Book by phone, Instagram or online; irregular closing days. Takeaway eel sushi made with a whole Hamanako eel.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: seasonal ingredients made by hand by its craftsmen; a long-established kappo where newcomers are declined ("一見さんお断り") and evening kappo is by introduction only. Per 2026 reviews: lunch was opened to everyone, and hot-pot dinners on the second floor can now be booked online.
chef_bio.specialty: Unadon; suppon ramen; seasonal kappo.

anecdotes.text: A regular was taught again how to squeeze kabosu over the matsutake dobin-mushi — October 2026.
A first-timer invited in July 2026 found orders slow on a busy night but the owner’s warm personality charming.
A June 2026 couple split the lunch menu: unadon for the eel lover, suppon ramen for the other.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-kon.com): ぎをん今、四季折々の食材を職人が手作り、一見さんお断りの老舗割烹、東山区祇園町南側570-6、不定休、お昼ごはん 12:00〜・13:00〜 (2部制)、鍋の夜ごはん 17:30〜 (要予約)、夜の割烹料理は完全紹介制で予約不可、予算 ランチ5,000〜10,000円・鍋コース10,000円〜、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、予約は Instagram DM も可、貸切10名以上、個室あり、分煙、キャンセルは3日前から50%・当日100%、お持ち帰り: 浜名湖産鰻の鰻寿し1本8,100円・半分4,320円、二口お稲荷2,376円。食べログ: 日本料理・うなぎ、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、夜は予約のみ、26席、個室。口コミ (2026年4〜10月、英語): 鰻丼、すっぽんラーメン、鰻のミニコース、からすみ、松茸の土瓶蒸し、鮑の唐揚げ、牛フィレ、ランチは誰でも予約可、夜は紹介制。

cultural_comfort.note: Book lunch or the hot-pot dinner; evening kappo is by introduction only.

places.name: 中満 (Nakamitsu)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. An omakase Kyoto course built on dashi, white miso and soy, with tempura; no gluten information (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase course of crab, fish, fugu and dashi (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Dinner from 18:00, all guests starting together; Wednesday closed (irregular) (Tabelog; official site, which gives 17:00). Reservation only; online for the 18:00 start, by phone for other times, for one person or more than six (Tabelog). Omakase course ¥25,000 with tax (November–December 2024); 10% service (Tabelog). Junior-high age and up; shoes off — wear socks (Tabelog). 6 counter seats (a March 2026 reviewer heard of plans to grow to 8); private hire for up to 20; non-smoking; cards accepted (Tabelog). 5 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanbonki, south of the Imperial Palace — 5 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto omakase at a six-seat counter, mostly local seasonal ingredients chosen by the owner (official site; Tabelog) · one course, about ¥25,000 (2024 reviews) · dishes in 2024–26 reviews: steamed crab and egg custard, Awaji saba sushi, honmoroko, kōbako crab, white-miso soup with ebi-imo, grilled fugu milt, karasumi mochi, Akashi sea bream, steamed amadai with turnip, fig tempura, sakura-shrimp rice
places.notes: [Kyoto kappo · south of the Imperial Palace, six seats and a Michelin star] A six-seat counter in a quiet street near the palace, opened in 2024 by a husband-and-wife team — the chef trained at Tomikoji Yamakishi and Anku; an August 2025 reviewer calls it Michelin-starred. One omakase of seasonal Kyoto cooking — crab, fugu milt, saba sushi — for about ¥25,000 + 10%. Shoes off; all guests start at 18:00. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef (September 2026 review; the official site says the owner chooses the ingredients)
chef_bio.origin: Shiga Prefecture (an August 2026 review says the couple is from Shiga).
chef_bio.background: Opened 24 September 2024 (Tabelog), in the former premises of Hijiwata (November 2024 review). Per 2026 reviews: the owner-chef trained at Tomikoji Yamakishi and Anku; the shop is run by a husband-and-wife team, with a third staff member by August 2026; an August 2025 reviewer calls it Michelin-starred.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: seasonal ingredients, mostly local, selected by the owner; tradition given new life; heartfelt hospitality in a calm Japanese room.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal omakase; saba sushi.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 diner found the dishes a bit salty, better with wine, and singled out the sakura-shrimp rice.
"The couple who runs the restaurant were also wonderful, and I enjoyed our conversation." — January 2026.
Reservations can sometimes be had at short notice — January 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (nakamitsu-kyoto.com): 中満、御所南の日本料理、地元産を中心に店主自ら厳選した旬の素材、伝統に新たな息吹、前室からカウンターの部屋へ、中京区三本木五丁目496-2、17:00より (水曜不定休)、オンライン予約または電話。食べログ: 日本料理、丸太町駅から徒歩5分、18:00〜22:00、水曜休み、完全予約制、一斉スタート (オンラインは18時のみ)、6席 (カウンター)、貸切20人、サービス料10%、中学生以上で大人と同じ料理を食べられる方のみ、靴を脱いで入店、禁煙、カード可、2024年9月24日オープン。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年9月、英語): おまかせ25,000円 (税込)、店主 Keijiro Nakamitsu と奥様、Tomikoji Yamakishi と Anku で修業、ミシュランの星付き (2025年8月の口コミ)、蒸し蟹と茶碗蒸し、淡路の鯖寿司、香箱蟹、白味噌の椀、ふぐの白子、桜海老ご飯、滋賀県出身の夫婦。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; everyone starts at 18:00; shoes off.

places.name: オードビー (eau de vie)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Western set lunches with quiche, bread, cream croquettes, hamburg steak with demi-glace and spring rolls; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Ratatouille and salads appear among the appetisers, but courses centre on meat, fish, egg quiche and cream sauces (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday 17:30–24:00; Wednesday to Saturday and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–24:00; Sunday 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–1:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Lunch is a set course only (April 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). A 3.25% fee for e-money payments (Tabelog). 24 seats: 8 at the counter, 12 at tables (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Third floor of 先斗町92ビル on the west side of Pontocho, south of Sanjo and the Kaburenjo; easy to walk past; 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Keihan) (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho south of Sanjo, 3rd floor — 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Dining bar of home-style Western cooking, run by a couple for about 35 years (2025–2026 reviews) · lunch course about ¥1,890–3,000: three appetisers (Thai carpaccio, ratatouille, quiche), soup, salad, a main — hamburg steak with demi-glace, steak, chicken sauté, wagyu steak — rice or bread, dessert and coffee (2025–2026 reviews) · dinner of about ten dishes — appetisers, soup, quiche, spring rolls, bread, dessert — with beef tongue stew +¥500 (October 2026); herb-butter chicken, yuba-wrapped shrimp cream croquettes, herb-stuffed salmon (August 2026) · craft beer, wine, flavoured coffee (hazelnut, vanilla) (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Pontocho, a couple's Western kitchen upstairs] A bright third-floor dining bar on Pontocho, run by a husband and wife for some 35 years, that turns out careful Western home cooking: a lunch course under ¥2,000–3,000 with quiche, ratatouille, soup and a hamburg steak or wagyu, and a dinner of about ten small dishes with wine for well under ¥8,000. Open late as a bar. One October 2025 diner found the husband curt and unfriendly while the wife was charming. Closed Monday.

roles: A married couple (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: "run by a husband and wife team" (May 2026), "a couple" (October 2025, October 2026); an October 2026 reviewer says it has been around for 35 years.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch course; quiche; hamburg steak.

anecdotes.text: "At the end, we even had coffee included, all for around JPY 2000, which felt like a great deal." — February 2026.

An October 2025 lunch guest found the husband unfriendly — speaking sharply to the wife during the rush and not answering a thank-you — while the wife left a very good impression; the food was delicious.
"It's easy to see why this restaurant has been around for 35 years, and I highly recommend it!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・洋食・バー、中京区材木町183-1 先斗町三条下ル2番西側 先斗町92ビル3F、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、火 17:30〜24:00、水〜土・祝 12:00〜15:00・17:30〜24:00、日 12:00〜15:00・17:30〜翌1:00、月曜休み、予約可、電子マネーは手数料3.25%、24席 (カウンター8、テーブル12)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 夫婦で営む、約35年、昼のコース1,890〜3,000円 (前菜3種、キッシュ、ラタトゥイユ、スープ、サラダ、ハンバーグ、ステーキ、チキンソテー)、夜は約10品で牛タンシチュー+500円、湯葉巻き海老クリームコロッケ、クラフトビール、フレーバーコーヒー、夫の接客が無愛想との声 (2025年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Third floor — look for the building on Pontocho; set lunch; cards accepted (e-money surcharge).

places.name: あおい (Aoi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai simmered in dashi and soy, fried dishes such as ebi-imo kara-age, croquette-style dishes, pasta and shrimp cream rice; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: obanzai and dishes with dashi, fish (sea bream, herring, sardines), pork, duck and shrimp (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00; closed Monday and some Sundays (Tabelog). Book ahead — a week ahead for a Saturday, with sittings at 17:30 or 20:30 (January 2026); last bookings around 21:00 even on weekdays (June 2026). 11 seats: 6 at the counter, 1 table; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). Ground floor of ニュー京都ビル by Kiyamachi, north of Shijo (Tabelog; September 2025). Opened 24 January 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Shijo — near Kawaramachi and Sanjo stations
places.cuisine: Kyoto obanzai counter with the day’s dishes laid out in bowls and a longer menu (2025–2026 reviews) · shima-aji and yuba sashimi; ebi-imo kara-age; sea bream with turnip ¥980; herring with eggplant ¥880; shinoda roll ¥880; kamo eggplant simmered with grated daikon ¥1,080; shrimp tsukune with plum sauce ¥580; bacon and summer vegetable peperoncino ¥880 (September 2025–January 2026) · Manganji peppers with dried fish, duck meatballs in tomato sauce, butter potatoes, potato salad, shrimp cream rice to finish (March 2026) · Mibu greens, nama-fu, pork and nama-fu with green-onion salt, sawara and potato in miso butter, pumpkin and sweet potato (October 2026) · Kyoto sake (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Obanzai · Kiyamachi, a cheerful owner's counter] A tiny obanzai counter by Kiyamachi — six seats and one table — where a lively owner with a strong Kyoto accent and the staff serve the day's home cooking from bowls on the counter: shinoda rolls, fried ebi-imo, sea bream with turnip, yuba and shima-aji sashimi, and shrimp cream rice to finish. Dishes run ¥580–1,080 and come generous. Popular with solo diners and visitors from abroad, and featured in guidebooks and on TV — book ahead. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 24 January 2013 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a cheerful owner with a strong Kyoto dialect who recommends dishes and manages a busy room, many regulars and solo diners, international tourists, a guidebook feature and a TV crew filming in October 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Shinoda-maki; ebi-imo kara-age; yuba sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "This time, there was a TV crew filming, and I nervously participated in an interview (laughs)." — October 2026.
A first-timer in August 2026 let the owner recommend dishes, ordered every suggestion, and found each one a hit — the yuba sashimi twice.
"It's a popular spot frequented by many international tourists, making reservations a must." — September 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、中京区材木町181-2 ニュー京都ビル1F、17:00〜23:00、月曜と一部の日曜休み、予約可、11席 (カウンター6、テーブル1)、禁煙、カード可 (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、2013年1月24日オープン。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 京都弁の明るい女将、カウンターに並ぶおばんざい、しまあじと湯葉のお造り、信田巻き、海老芋の唐揚げ、鯛かぶら980円、にしんなす880円、賀茂茄子のおろし煮1,080円、海老つくねの梅だれ580円、壬生菜、生麩、締めの海老クリームご飯、予約は17時半か20時半、海外の客も多い、テレビの取材 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Ask the owner to recommend; tiny counter; book ahead; cards accepted.

places.name: 余志屋 (Yoshiya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo à la carte with ankake, dengaku, fried guji, kara-age, fried shrimp and kamameshi; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based ankake and kamameshi with chicken, oysters or anago; fish, eel and duck dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations essential — "you cannot enter without a reservation" (Tabelog, October 2025); 20:00 is easier at weekends; reserve popular dishes such as fried guji with the table (December 2025; March 2026). Dress smart-casual — no flip-flops or gym clothes (Tabelog). Tabelog’s service-charge field reads なし (none) in the original. 28 seats: a 10-seat counter, a raised area for 4 and a tatami room upstairs for up to about 12 (Tabelog; September 2025). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). An old townhouse on Pontocho south of Sanjo; a second shop has opened across the street (Tabelog); 8 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho south of Sanjo — 8 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Pontocho kappo of à la carte Kyoto home dishes, famous for its iron-pot kamameshi (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · kamameshi of the season — oyster and peas, oyster and ginkgo, chicken, maitake and edamame, anago (2025–2026 reviews) · fried guji with crisp scales, Yawata-maki of eel and burdock, dashimaki and eel omelette, duck manjū, vegetable ankake, dengaku tofu, matsukasa-yaki, grilled shirako, sea urchin with fresh yuba, fried small taro, fried shrimp, firefly squid nuta, hamo tempura, a matsutake and hamo pot (2025–2026 reviews) · homemade dessert, brown-sugar sorbet (2025–2026 reviews) · bills ¥10,000–19,999 (Tabelog review bands)
places.notes: [Kappo · Pontocho, kamameshi in an old townhouse] A long-loved Pontocho kappo in an old townhouse — counter downstairs, tatami room up — where you order Kyoto dishes à la carte: crisp-scaled fried guji, eel Yawata-maki, dashimaki, duck manjū, vegetable ankake, and the house's famous iron-pot kamameshi to finish (oyster in winter, anago in summer). Popular dishes sell out, so reserve them with the table, and book well ahead; 20:00 is easier at weekends. Smart casual. Closed Monday. A second shop has opened across the street.

roles: Chef and staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: very popular, no entry without a reservation (October 2025); a second shop has opened across the street; known for the kamameshi. Long-time regulars in 2025–2026 describe a historic building, a counter on the ground floor and a tatami room upstairs, and staff flexible with orders.
chef_bio.specialty: Kamameshi; fried guji; Yawata-maki.

anecdotes.text: "I made sure to reserve the fried guji fish and Yawata roll, which I absolutely wanted to try." — December 2025.
"I recommend going at 8 PM on weekends, as it’s relatively easier to secure a reservation." — March 2026.
"There was a little mix-up with the fried items not being ordered, but it was all in good fun. I appreciated how flexible they were" — May 2026.

Courses (omakase) or à la carte from a long menu (2025–2026 reviews). 5% service charge (Tabelog). 25 seats with a counter, tatami and a private room for 8 upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; June 2026). places.notes: [Kappo · Gion Hanamikoji, Kyoto cuisine à la carte] A Gion Kyoto-cuisine house on Hanamikoji that lets you order from a menu longer than most izakaya's — hairy crab, fugu shirako, whale with mizuna, mackerel sushi, corn tempura — or take the omakase, finishing with rice porridge. Quality is high and so are prices (about ¥20,000–30,000), with 5% service. Book up to two months ahead. Some 2025–2026 diners found service slow on busy nights. Open until midnight; closed Sunday and holidays.

roles: Chef and staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 call it a famous Gion kaiseki house, mention a Michelin Guide listing (June 2026), praise the à la carte menu and the presentation, and note that service was slow at year-end (December 2025) and only average (February 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte Kyoto cuisine; mackerel sushi.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular, told the house was full three weeks ahead, was squeezed in until 18:30 after a Kabuki matinee, and took mackerel sushi home for a son minding the family dog.
"It seems to have more choices than your average inexpensive izakaya, yet the quality of everything is high." — July 2025.
"While I understand that delays are inevitable, the service was really slow... Waiting 20 minutes for the bill was tough." — December 2025.
"The saba sushi was outstanding—I ended up ordering it three times!" — April 2026.

places.name: 祇をん 萬屋 (Gion Yorozuya)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon in a soy-seasoned dashi (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is kombu and bonito dashi, and toppings include duck, chicken and egg (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 12:30–15:00 and 17:30–19:00 (last order 18:40); Sunday and holidays 12:30–15:30; closed irregularly (Tabelog). No reservations; queues are common — waits of an hour to 1 h 20 min in October and November 2026, none at quiet times (June–August 2026). No shared tables: 14 seats at three tables for four and one for two; single diners get a table for four (Tabelog; October 2026). Some rice bowls are not served every day (November 2026). Cash only; non-smoking; a "no mobile phones" sign on the tables, photos allowed (Tabelog). Wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). On a narrow back street that cars use as a shortcut — take care while queuing — between Hanamikoji and Kennin-ji; 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Gion back street off Hanamikoji, by Kennin-ji — 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto udon shop (2026 reviews) · signature negi udon heaped with Kujo negi, with grated ginger, ¥1,500 (July 2026) · kitsune udon, cold natto udon, duck and negi udon in winter · rice bowls: oyako-don, kinugasa-don (2026 reviews) · thin, soft Kyoto-style udon in a kombu and bonito dashi
places.notes: [Udon · Gion, a mountain of Kujo negi] A small udon shop on a Gion back street near Kennin-ji, its walls hung with fans bearing maiko names, known for one bowl: negi udon (¥1,500), soft Kyoto noodles under a heap of Kujo negi in a bonito dashi, sharpened with grated ginger. Kitsune udon and rice bowls such as oyako-don are the alternatives. No bookings and no shared tables, so expect a queue — up to an hour or more in autumn 2026. Cash only; lunch daily, short evenings except Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 mention Michelin recognition (Bib Gourmand or Plate, per different reviewers), appearances on the TBS programme "Jinsei Saikō Restaurant", maiko fans on the walls, and a kind owner (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Negi udon.

anecdotes.text: "I arrived at 12:30 PM and found 8 people ahead of me, which meant I waited about 1 hour and 20 minutes to be seated." — October 2026.
"The owner was very kind and provided excellent service." — August 2026.
A July 2026 diner found the oyako-don a little strongly seasoned.

places.gf_detail: Ask, and tell the restaurant about allergies in advance (Tabelog). The courses include a breaded "Oka katsu", croquettes, pasta and curry alongside charcoal-grilled meat (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef kaiseki of aged and charcoal-grilled meat (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday 12:00–15:00, 16:00–18:30 and 19:00–22:30; Wednesday and Friday 16:00–18:30 and 19:00–22:30; closed Tuesday and irregularly (Tabelog). Reservation only; bookings with an unreachable phone number may be cancelled; allergies in advance (Tabelog). 10% service charge (Tabelog). 8 counter seats facing the grill, with a small garden at the back (Tabelog; September 2024). Staff speak English (September 2026). Non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). In Yayoi alley, Gion south of Shijo; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; September 2024).
places.neighborhood: Gion south of Shijo, Yayoi alley — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Meat kaiseki of aged beef grilled slowly over charcoal and firewood (Tabelog, shop text) · the shop text names pure Tajima beef; reviewers list Omi beef from Fukunaga in Shiga, Kobe beef, Tokachi beef aged 70 days and Iwate Kanzaki beef (2025) · "Oka katsu" of Chateaubriand, Omi beef tartare styled as a Kyoto garden, chilled Omi beef shabu-shabu with yuba, congee of snow-aged potatoes and Omi beef, aged-meat steaks, beef consommé, pâté, spicy pasta, curry, seasonal desserts (2024–26 reviews) · dinner bills about ¥30,000–50,000 a head; lunch course ¥13,200 in 2024; occasional Sunday fan lunches "Oka Shokudo" with chicken katsu and croquettes (August 2026)
places.notes: [Meat kaiseki · Gion, aged beef over charcoal] An 8-seat counter in a Gion alley where chef Yoshitaka Oka, a meat griller of over 20 years, cooks aged beef slowly over charcoal and firewood as a kaiseki course: Omi beef tartare laid out like a Kyoto garden, the Chateaubriand 'Oka katsu', and aged steaks from several farms, between soups and seasonal small dishes. Dinner runs about ¥30,000–50,000 a head plus 10% service. Reservation only; closed Tuesday. Aged meat has a distinct aroma — one regular warns it isn't for everyone.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): chef Yoshitaka Oka has over 20 years of grilling beef in Gion, butchering bone-in meat and cooking it slowly over charcoal and firewood; guests call the chef the "Meat Griller". A July 2025 reviewer says the restaurant was originally based in Shiga before moving to Kyoto; a March 2025 regular had visited before the relocation. An April 2025 reviewer learned the beef comes from Fukunaga in Shiga.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): meat cooked slowly over a distant fire, which some guests say "doesn’t tire you out."
chef_bio.specialty: Oka katsu; aged-meat steaks.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular, dining with one other guest, found the chef growing more enthusiastic through the evening and grilling extra cuts.
A March 2025 regular notes that aged meat has a distinctive aroma that may be challenging for those not fond of it.
"The service and customer care were good, but I felt it didn’t quite match the price." — September 2026.

places.name: Gibier MIYAMA
places.gf_detail: Ask. Game dishes include spring rolls, fried tripe with Parmigiano, quiche, hamburg steak and house bread alongside grilled meats and hot pots; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a game-meat restaurant (venison, wild boar, bear, pheasant, duck) (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:30, last seating 21:00, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday; closed days vary by season; lunch for two or more by reservation (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog); a no-show 15 minutes after the time counts as a cancellation; please avoid strong fragrances (Tabelog). 5% service charge (Tabelog). The meal takes about 3 hours or more (April 2026). 15 seats at a U-shaped counter; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog; March 2026). Gion north of Shijo; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). (お料理 MIYAMA, the casual second shop, is kyoto_oryori_miyama; its record cites an August 2026 reviewer saying Gibier MIYAMA takes no reservations, which conflicts with Tabelog’s "reservation only".)
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Game-meat course: four set dishes chosen by the chef, then as much as you like from about 30 à la carte dishes for one price (2025–26 reviews) · course ¥28,000 or ¥32,340 with tax (April 2026); bills about ¥30,000–50,000 with drinks (2026 reviews) · venison (roast, tripe, summer venison hamburg), wild boar (loin, spring rolls, botan-nabe), black-bear pâté and hamburg, charcoal-grilled pheasant, mallard, fried tripe with Parmigiano · seasonal produce and wild vegetables from Miyama: sansho-pepper hot pot in spring, summer mushrooms, ayu with somen, eel and soft-shell turtle soup · house-baked bread, cheese and quiche · a wine cellar (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Game · Gion, all the venison and bear you can order] A U-shaped counter in Gion where chef Futa Kanda, from the mountain town of Miyama, serves game: four set dishes, then as many of about 30 à la carte plates as you can manage, for one price (about ¥28,000–32,000 in 2026). Venison tripe, bear pâté, pheasant over charcoal, wild-boar spring rolls and botan-nabe come with Miyama's wild vegetables and house bread; reviewers say the meat has little gamey taste. Allow three hours — one December 2025 diner found service slow and the room cold. Reservation only; closed Sunday.

roles: Chef (April 2026 review; named in お料理 MIYAMA’s Tabelog text)
chef_bio.background: Per an April 2026 reviewer: run by chef Futa Kanda, born in 1989 in Miyama town, Kyoto, cooking seasonal game and wild vegetables from Miyama. Another April 2026 reviewer says the shop works with hunters to secure game and also wholesales it. The Tabelog text of the sister shop お料理 MIYAMA (kyoto_oryori_miyama) names the owner-chef as a RED U-35 Bronze Egg winner and Gibier MIYAMA as nominated for the Tabelog Award 2027.
chef_bio.specialty: Game course with free à la carte.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner found the system slow — à la carte plates were paced with the whole room — and the room too cold, and did not plan to return.
"This restaurant offers all-you-can-eat a la carte, so whether you order one dish or try everything, the price remains the same." — March 2026.
An April 2026 diner was given some of the house bread to take home.

places.name: 京都 いと (Kyoto Ito)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki with dashi and organic soy sauce, French sauces and dairy, tempura and somen; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the restaurant states it cannot accommodate vegetarian menus because of the nature of its courses (Tabelog, shop text).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 and dinner 18:00–21:00, each course starting at a set time; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). 5% service charge, no table charge (Tabelog). Lunch prices rose from October 2026 (September 2026). 16 seats: an 8-seat counter of a single 9 m board, and private rooms for 2–8, including upstairs (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). In a 100-year-old townhouse behind Shichijo-dori facing the moat of Higashi Hongan-ji; 5 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Facing the moat of Higashi Hongan-ji, behind Shichijo — 5 min from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: Kaiseki joining Kyoto cooking and French technique in a renovated townhouse; organic vegetables, rice and seasonings (Tabelog, shop text; September 2026) · signature seasonal salad (Tabelog) · dishes have included corn blancmange with dashi, fig jelly and purple sea urchin; Miwa somen with Manganji pepper, ashiaka shrimp, tomato, basil and anchovy; grilled eggplant with beer-braised wagyu; seared hamo and kinmedai sashimi; warm sushi of fried sawara with sea urchin; ashiaka shrimp and truffle chawanmushi; Kumamoto conger uzaku; Kumamoto beef roast; ayu kamameshi (2025–26 reviews) · dinner bills about ¥20,000–45,000 a head; lunch about ¥15,000–20,000 (2025–26 reviews) · sake, house-made liqueurs and French wines (Tabelog; December 2025)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Kyoto Station, Kyoto–French in an old townhouse] A reservation-only kaiseki in a 100-year-old townhouse across the moat from Higashi Hongan-ji, five minutes from Kyoto Station. Chef Shohei Noguchi, from Fukushima and trained in France and at a sushi shop, mixes dashi, charcoal and rice with French sauces and organic vegetables: corn blancmange with sea urchin, Miwa somen dressed like pasta, ayu kamameshi to finish. Courses start together at 12:00 and 18:00; sit at the 9 m counter or in a private room. Dinner runs about ¥20,000–45,000; one October 2026 diner found it poor value.

chef_bio.background: Per a September 2026 reviewer: head chef Shohei Noguchi is from Fukushima; after culinary school the chef went to France in 2010 to train at a Michelin-starred restaurant, then worked at a Michelin-starred French restaurant in Osaka and trained in sushi at "Fuku Sushi Mori". A June 2026 reviewer says the shop received a Michelin star in 2019 under a different chef and that the current chef was born in 1990, with a young team aged 20s to 30s. Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): organic seasonings such as soy sauce, salt and mirin, and gratitude to producers, fishermen and farmers.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "To Producers, Fishermen, and Farmers: Elevating Gratitude for the Life of Food into Culinary Art."
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal salad; Kyoto–French kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 family booked lunch quickly before a price rise from October, for a father who wanted to return after leaving hospital.
An October 2026 diner praised the staff’s warmth and humour but found the value for money poor for the ingredients.
"In particular, the "Warm Sushi with Fried Sawara Tachi Fish Topped with Sea Urchin" was the most impressive sushi I have ever had in my life." — October 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、下京区中居町112-1、京都駅より徒歩5分、東本願寺のお堀の向かい、七条通りの裏、昼 12:00〜14:00・夜 18:00〜21:00、不定休、完全予約制、サービス料5％、チャージなし、16席 (カウンター8席、個室2〜8名)、禁煙、カード可、築100年の町家を改装した懐石、京料理とフランス料理、有機の醤油・塩・みりん、名物の季節のサラダ、コースの性質上ベジタリアンメニューは対応不可、Shohei Noguchi 料理長。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): Fukushima 出身、2010年に渡仏、大阪のミシュラン星付きフレンチ、Fuku Sushi Mori で寿司の修業、2019年の星は前の料理長の時、1990年生まれの料理長、若いスタッフ、とうもろこしのブランマンジェ、Miwa の素麺、鱧、Kumamoto のうざく、鮎の釜飯、10月から昼の値上げ、コスパへの不満の声。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; staff explain each dish; many overseas guests (December 2025); cards accepted.

places.name: 京フレンチきしもと (Kyo French Kishimoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Set courses of hors d’oeuvres, soup, amadai meunière or beef fillet, and dessert; soy sauce is used as a hidden seasoning (official site); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every course centres on fish meunière or beef fillet, with cream soups and gratins (official site).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Tuesday; tables limited to two hours. Tabelog gives dinner L.O. 21:30. Reservations by phone only (official site). Kamo River yuka (riverside terrace) 1 May–30 September, dinner only except lunch in May and September; outside the yuka season a terrace for two a day, with 10% added (official site). Cards (official site: VISA only; Tabelog: VISA, Master, AMEX, Diners) at dinner only — cash at lunch. 16 seats: 10 at the counter, 6 at tables; 16 more on the summer terrace (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Pontocho south of Sanjo, 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho south of Sanjo, on the Kamo River — 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: “Kyoto-style” French: French technique with Kyoto ingredients and seasonings — soy sauce as a hidden seasoning, beef steak with fresh wasabi, duck with black shichimi — eaten with chopsticks (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · dinner courses A ¥6,600, B ¥8,800, C ¥13,200, chef’s selection ¥16,500; lunch A ¥4,400, B ¥6,600, C ¥11,000; yuka courses ¥7,260–18,150 (official site) · each built from hors d’oeuvres, soup, amadai meunière and/or beef fillet, dessert and coffee or herb tea · example dishes: salmon with grape and pear jelly, persimmon and barracuda with sesame sauce, kuruma prawn and pumpkin gratin, crab and autumn vegetable salad, mushroom cream soup, amadai with sweet potato and chestnut sauce (official site) · summer yuka menus with hamo and Kamo eggplant (official site) · wine
places.notes: [French · Pontocho, French with chopsticks above the Kamo River] A long-running Pontocho French restaurant where a chef of more than twenty years in French cooking hides soy sauce in the sauces, serves the beef fillet with fresh wasabi and lays chopsticks on the table. From May to September you can eat on the yuka over the Kamo River at dusk. Courses only: a sea bream meunière or beef fillet at the centre, from ¥4,400 at lunch and ¥6,600 at dinner (more on the yuka). Book by phone; two-hour seating; cash only at lunch; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: The official site describes cooking from more than twenty years devoted to French cuisine, built on French technique with Kyoto ingredients and seasonings. The yuka stands on a former teahouse’s terrace (official site). A September 2025 regular found the restaurant unchanged as Pontocho changed after the pandemic.
chef_bio.philosophy: A light, easy-to-eat French for all ages, adapted to Kyoto (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Beef fillet steak with fresh wasabi; amadai meunière.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 regular recalled the chef explaining that soy sauce and other Japanese flavours go into the cooking as a hidden seasoning.
In July 2025, after rain, the chef and staff still let a pair dine on the riverside terrace; the reviewer had chosen French because the companion does not like raw food.
A May 2026 pair on the terrace at 6 p.m. on a Sunday were the only guests on the yuka all evening, while the Pontocho alley outside was full of visitors from abroad.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京フレンチ 先斗町きしもと、中京区先斗町三条下ル若松町141番地、昼11:30〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)、夜17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、火曜休み、予約は電話のみ、カードは VISA のみ、昼はカード不可、席は2時間まで、鴨川納涼床は5月1日〜9月30日 (5月と9月は昼も)、床の時期以外は1日2名のテラス席 (別途10%)。フレンチ一筋20年余、隠し味に醤油、ステーキにワサビ、鴨に黒七味、箸を添える。夜のコース6,600円〜16,500円、昼4,400円〜11,000円、床のコース7,260円〜18,150円、甘鯛のムニエルか牛フィレ肉。食べログ: 16席 (カウンター10、テーブル6、夏は床16席)、禁煙。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 床で食べるフレンチ、箸で食べる、柔らかいフィレ、デザート3種。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; two-hour seating; cash only at lunch; chopsticks provided.

places.name: ぎをん縄手 とり安 (Gion Nawate Tori Yasu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The mizutaki is a white chicken-bone broth (seasoned with salt and ginger, per an October 2026 review) eaten with house ponzu; the course also has simmered liver, salt-grilled thigh, and udon or zosui to finish; ponzu and the liver seasoning are not described (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken house — chicken-bone broth, Tanba chicken, liver (official site).
places.hours_raw: Official site: 17:00–22:00, last entry 21:00; closed Monday and Thursday. Tabelog asks for entry by 20:30. Reopened on 1 March 2026 after a long closure, with fewer seats and mainly by reservation (official notice, 21 February 2026). Reservations online or by phone; changes by the day before (Tabelog). Prices include tax and service (official site). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats with a counter, tatami rooms for 2 and 4; the upstairs tatami room has tables and chairs (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). On Nawate in Gion, 3 min from Gion-Shijo and Sanjo Stns (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nawate in Gion, near Shinbashi — 3 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Mizutaki specialist since 1955: a white chicken-bone broth simmered for a full day with well water from the premises, morning-killed Kyoto Tanba chicken, house ponzu (official site) · mizutaki course ¥11,000 — simmered liver, salt-grilled thigh with three seasonal vegetables, mizutaki, zosui, fruit (official site) · chicken sukiyaki course ¥9,500 (official site) · à la carte: simmered liver ¥1,300, salt-grilled or teriyaki thigh ¥2,000, karaage ¥2,200, duck loin ¥2,500, zosui ¥1,200 (official site) · Kyoto sake, shochu, Suntory whiskies, wine (official site)
places.notes: [Mizutaki · Gion Nawate, seventy years of white chicken broth] A Gion house that has served one thing since 1955: mizutaki, Tanba chicken in a milky chicken-bone broth simmered for a day with well water from under the shop, dipped in house ponzu and finished as zosui. The ¥11,000 course starts with simmered liver and salt-grilled thigh. It reopened on 1 March 2026 after a long closure, with fewer seats — book ahead. Tatami rooms upstairs have tables and chairs. Closed Monday and Thursday.

roles: Head chef and owner (named only in Japanese on the official site; no reading given)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1955 by the previous owner, 岸澤邦夫, in Kawaramachi-Takoyakushi, and moved in 1962 to the present spot on Nawate at Shinbashi in Gion; a white-broth mizutaki specialist ever since. The February 2026 reopening notice is signed 岸澤邦和. An October 2026 diner mentions a head chef and an owner.
chef_bio.philosophy: To keep the taste inherited from the previous owner while staying aware of the times (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Mizutaki in white chicken-bone broth.

anecdotes.text: A regular of about twenty years was saddened to hear early in 2026 that the shop would close for a long time, and came back as soon as it reopened.
Asked in July 2025 how much zosui to serve, a diner said half a bowl; the staff answered, "Just enough to float away!"
A June 2025 diner who does not eat liver asked for the liver starter to be swapped, and the kitchen obliged.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ぎをん縄手とり安、東山区弁財天町18、創業七十年の水だき専門店、昭和30年に先代の岸澤邦夫が河原町蛸薬師で開業、昭和37年に祇園縄手新橋へ移転、白い鶏がらスープ、朝びきの京都丹波地鶏、敷地内の井戸の東山の名水で丸一日かけて取るスープ、自家製ポン酢、17:00〜22:00 (入店21:00まで)、月・木休み、特選水だきコース11,000円、特選すき焼きコース9,500円 (税・サ込)、一品料理 (肝だき、もも肉塩焼き、唐揚げ、鴨ロース、雑炊)。2026年2月21日のお知らせ: 3月1日から営業再開、席数を絞り予約中心、署名は岸澤邦和。食べログ: 15席、個室 (2人・4人)、禁煙、カード可、子ども可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 肝だき、もも肉の塩焼き、水だき、雑炊、果物、70年のスープ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; tax and service included; chairs in the upstairs tatami room.
