places.name: 肉料理 澁谷 (Niku Ryori Shibuya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Raw and grilled beef with sauces and mustard, salted grills, stews, a hot pot and tail soup; the sauces are not described (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef restaurant — raw tongue, heart, yukhoe, tripe, grilled cuts, tail soup (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–21:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations only (Tabelog); hard to get through by phone, but callbacks come and same-day bookings sometimes work (March–September 2026). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners; IC cards, iD, QUICPay; no QR (Tabelog). Counter and tatami room; private rooms for 10–20 (Tabelog); about ten guests in all (July 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a renovated machiya in a lane off Kawaramachi north of Ebisugawa, 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn exit 16 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 9 June 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: A lane off Kawaramachi north of Ebisugawa — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Beef kappo in small plates: no fixed brand of beef, the best available each time (Tabelog) · a set ordering rule — dishes come in order from the right of the menu until an off-menu Yanagawa-style dish marks the break, skipping any you decline, then free ordering (September 2026) · raw tongue, raw heart and yukhoe ¥1,200 each, blanched mino ¥1,200, salad ¥400 (September 2026) · grilled mino ¥2,500, tail soup ¥1,000; salt-grilled tongue, tripe and loin; stews and a hot pot (2026 reviews) · courses on request (Tabelog) · sake, shochu, wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Beef · Kyoto City Hall, raw tongue and heart in a machiya] A renovated machiya in a lane near City Hall, opened in 2019 by a chef who for many years led the kitchen at Anzan, the old Gion meat restaurant, and runs it with the chef’s daughter. Beef arrives in small plates in menu order — raw tongue, raw heart and yukhoe (¥1,200 each), blanched mino — until a Yanagawa-style dish signals the break; then order freely from the grill: tongue, tripe, loin, tail soup. About ten seats; reservations only, and the phone is busy. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Chef-owner (unnamed), formerly head chef at Anzan in Gion
The chef’s daughter, front of house
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s shop note: the chef was head chef for many years at the well-known Anzan in Gion before going independent and opened Niku Ryori Shibuya with the chef’s daughter on 9 June 2019. A March 2026 reviewer describes a skilled chef and a friendly daughter.
chef_bio.philosophy: Not tied to any beef brand; the best quality available each time (Tabelog shop note).
chef_bio.specialty: Raw tongue, raw heart and yukhoe; Yanagawa-style beef.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner who could not book Anzan alone came here instead, struggled to get through on the phone, got a callback, and saw why — the phone in front of the counter rang constantly.
An April 2026 solo traveller had the counter alone just after opening on a weekday and found the young proprietress friendly.
A May 2026 solo diner at Golden Week found it tasty but not extraordinary for the price and did not plan to return.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 肉料理 澁谷、牛料理・日本料理、中京区河原町夷川西入一筋目上ル西革堂193-1、京都市役所前駅16番出口から北へ徒歩5分、17:00〜21:00、水曜休み、完全予約制、カード可、電子マネー可、個室 (10〜20人)、禁煙、2019年6月9日オープン。店の紹介: 祇園の名店 Anzan で長く料理長を務めて独立、娘と開業、銘柄にこだわらずその時の最良の牛肉、アラカルト中心でコースも相談可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 生のタン、ハツ、ユッケ各1,200円、湯引きのミノ、サラダ400円、柳川風、焼きミノ2,500円、テールスープ1,000円、町家を改装した店、メニューの右から順に出てくる独特の注文の仕方。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservations only, by phone (keep trying); a set ordering rule; raw beef dishes.

places.name: 炭棲堂 (Sumizumi Do)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled vegetables and meat with soy-based sauces such as fermented-butter soy and dashi soy; yuba tempura and fries on the menu; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Many vegetable dishes — grilled vegetables, yudofu in a broth of nine vegetables, nine small dishes at breakfast — but sauces include dashi and butter and the meat dishes are many; the kitchen adjusted dishes for a pregnant guest and an onion-averse guest (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 8:00–12:00 Monday and Thursday–Sunday, in three reserved seatings at 8:00, 9:15 and 10:30 (Tabelog; September 2026); dinner 17:00–23:00 daily; charcoal-grill orders by 22:00 (October 2026); hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Counter around an irori on the first floor, tables on the second (Tabelog; October 2026). Half portions for solo diners on many items (October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a back lane 4 min from the JR Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station (October 2026). Opened 26 March 2025 (Tabelog; Leaf KYOTO).
places.neighborhood: Behind the Kyoto Station Hachijo exit — 4 min on foot
places.cuisine: Irori izakaya of binchotan grilling and vegetables from its own ISO FARM and partner farmers (Leaf KYOTO, a PR article) · charcoal-grilled vegetables ¥800 — lotus root with wild boar mince, shiitake with fermented-butter soy; onion with sakura shrimp and dashi soy; sweet potato with black tea, lemon and honey (2026 reviews) · domestic beef hanging tender 150 g ¥2,800, black wagyu inside round 200 g ¥3,800 (October 2026) · seared bonito and vegetable carpaccio ¥1,300, spicy chicken ¥1,300, yudofu ¥800, yuba and okra tempura with Nara pickles ¥950, venison and apple salad, fries with black-shichimi butter soy (2026 reviews) · breakfast ¥2,400: rice, white-miso soup, nine small dishes and a huge yudofu in vegetable broth (September–October 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kyoto Station Hachijo, charcoal and farm vegetables] A few minutes from the Hachijo exit, an irori counter where vegetables from the group’s own farm and partner growers go over binchotan: shiitake with fermented-butter soy, onion with sakura shrimp, a sweet potato with tea, lemon and honey that eats like dessert, then wagyu by weight. Many dishes come in half portions for solo diners. In the morning it turns into a reserved breakfast (¥2,400) of nine small dishes, rice and a vast block of tofu in vegetable broth. Opened 2025.

roles: Operated by the Kyoto izakaya group 五十家 (Isoya), per Leaf KYOTO
chef_bio.background: Leaf KYOTO (a PR article) introduces it as a new concept from the izakaya group 五十家, with irori and charcoal grilling, using vegetables from the group’s own ISO FARM and partner farmers; opened 26 March 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled vegetables; vegetable breakfast with yudofu.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 breakfast guest was startled by the size of the tofu, and loved the broth made from nine vegetables most of all — finishing it with a spoon.
An October 2026 solo traveller wrote it was worth taking the Shinkansen for, praised the half portions, and was walked to the door on leaving.
An October 2026 breakfast guest who noted a dislike of onions at booking found a different dish prepared instead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 炭棲堂、居酒屋、南区東九条西山王町12-7、京都駅から305m、月・木〜日 8:00〜12:00 と 17:00〜23:00、火・水 17:00〜23:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙、2025年3月26日オープン。Leaf KYOTO (PR記事): 五十家グループの新業態、自社農園 ISO FARM と提携農家の野菜。口コミ (2026年、英語): 炭火焼き野菜800円、蓮根の猪ミンチのせ、椎茸の発酵バター醤油、国産牛ハラミ150g 2,800円、黒毛和牛内もも200g 3,800円、鰹と野菜のカルパッチョ1,300円、湯豆腐800円、湯葉とオクラの天ぷら950円、朝ごはん2,400円 (小鉢9品、大きな湯豆腐、9種の野菜の出汁)、一人客にハーフサイズ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book breakfast seatings ahead; half portions for solo diners; cards and QR accepted.

places.name: キチ・キチ (Kichi Kichi)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the omurice comes with a house demi-glace and there are cream croquettes (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature is an omurice of egg over chicken rice, with cream croquettes and chicken poêlé on the menu (2024–2026 reviews), though Tabelog lists vegetarian options.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tuesday–Friday 17:00–21:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed Monday. Reservation only, through the official website; seating is limited to one hour and late arrivals are cancelled (Tabelog). Online booking opens at 9:00 for lunch and 13:00 for dinner and filled within three minutes for a January 2025 diner. 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 in booths; non-smoking; children welcome; English menu (Tabelog). Cards, IC and QR payments (Tabelog). Opened 2 December 1978 (Tabelog). Down an alley south of Sanjo between Kiyamachi and Pontocho; 5 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; reviews).
places.neighborhood: Off Kiyamachi south of Sanjo — 5 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto yoshoku since 1978, world-famous for the master’s "Happy Omurice" performance (official site; Tabelog) · omurice — a soft omelette slit open over ketchup chicken rice and finished with house demi-glace at the counter — ¥2,700 (March 2021), ¥3,000 (January–February 2026) · soup of the day (corn), cream croquette, chicken poêlé · sake, shochu, wine, cocktails (2024–2026 reviews; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Kiyamachi-Sanjo, the omurice show] A 16-seat counter yoshoku down an alley near Pontocho, open since 1978, made world-famous by its master's 'Happy Omurice' — the omelette flipped, slit and spread over ketchup rice with a flourish, demi-glace on top, and the room singing along. Omurice ¥3,000 (2026); soup and cream croquettes too. Booking online only, and slots go within minutes; one-hour sittings, mostly overseas guests. One February 2026 diner found ¥3,000 a lot unless you count the show. Closed Monday.

roles: Master (マスター), per the official site
chef_bio.background: The official site names the master as 幸村 元吉 (Motokichi Yukimura) and is titled "オムライスで世界をHappyに!" ("making the world Happy with omurice"), with a fan club, music and overseas omurice events listed in its news. Tabelog: born in Kyoto in 1978 (opening day 2 December 1978), a western-style restaurant pursuing its own style, built on the idea that being able to order what you want, when you want, in the amount you want is the gateway to deliciousness. Reviewers describe videos viewed more than 100 million times, a visit by the King of Malaysia (January 2025) and fame in Taiwan (October 2024).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog: "May the feelings of both the cooks and the diners be in perfect harmony."
chef_bio.specialty: Happy Omurice.

anecdotes.text: "In the end, everyone, including the customers, sang the omurice song together with great enthusiasm!" — June 2024.
A diner who learned omurice from Kichi Kichi’s YouTube saved up and travelled from Nagaoka to eat it — August 2024.
A February 2026 diner, the only Japanese guest, found the ¥3,000 omurice delicious but pricey without the show.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kichikichi.com): ザ・洋食屋・キチキチ、オムライスで世界をHappyに!、マスター (幸村 元吉)、ファンクラブ、音楽のリリース、海外のオムライスイベント、予約ページ。食べログ: 洋食、中京区三条先斗町下ル材木町185-4、火〜金 17:00〜21:00、土日祝 12:00〜14:00・17:00〜21:00、月曜休み、完全予約制 (公式サイトから)、1時間制、遅刻は自動キャンセル、16席 (カウンター8、ボックス8)、禁煙、子供可、英語メニュー、ベジタリアンメニューあり、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、1978年12月2日オープン、食べたいときに食べたいものを食べたい量だけ注文できることが美味しさの入口。口コミ (2021年3月〜2026年2月、英語): オムライス2,700円 (2021年)・3,000円 (2026年)、マスターのパフォーマンス、デミグラスソース、クリームコロッケ、チキンのポワレ、オムライスの歌、ネット予約は昼9時・夜13時開始で数分で満席、海外からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog) and an English booking site; book online the moment slots open; one-hour seating.

places.name: cantina arco (カンティーナ アルコ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; pasta, bruschetta, croquettes and fried cutlets are central, beside carpaccio, caprese and fish dishes (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but most dishes use cheese (braided mozzarella), cured meat, anchovy colatura or fish (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 14:00–16:30 (last order 16:30) and 18:00–0:30 (last order 0:30); closed Wednesday and one longer break a month. Bookings taken, by phone for parties of 13 or more and for the sharing course; often full, so book (2026 reviews). Sharing course ¥6,000 for groups (3 antipasti, 2 pastas, main, mini dessert; May 2026). 40 seats with counter and tables, one private room for 4, private hire 20–50; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; sommelier (Tabelog). Cards, no e-money (Tabelog). Opened 20 October 2014 (Tabelog). On the ground floor of the 洋燈館 west of Takoyakushi-Fuyacho; 5 min walk from Kawaramachi or Karasuma stations (Tabelog; 2017 review).
places.neighborhood: Takoyakushi west of Fuyacho — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Southern-Italian (Sicilian) trattoria cooking and Italian wine (2026 reviews) · antipasti: treccia caprese (braided buffalo mozzarella, a house specialty), carpaccio with house anchovy colatura, house bottarga, octopus and potato salad, prosciutto and salami, four-plate antipasto set · pasta: spaghetti with sardines and pine nuts, lemon spaghetti "Arco style", large fusilli with pistachio, orecchiette with meatball tomato sauce, spicy tomato pasta · mains: lamb or beef cutlet, 150 g red-beef steak, aqua pazza, zuppa di pesce · group sharing course ¥6,000 · wine by the decanter, bottles (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Takoyakushi-Fuyacho, a Sicilian-minded trattoria] A 40-seat trattoria in an old building west of Takoyakushi-Fuyacho, open from afternoon until after midnight: braided buffalo-mozzarella caprese, carpaccio with house colatura, Sicilian sardine-and-pine-nut spaghetti, lemon pasta, crisp cutlets and decanted Italian wine. Courses for groups at ¥6,000; most come à la carte. Busy in the evenings — book. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed) with training in Italy, per a May 2026 review
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe an Italian inspired by southern-Italian taverns, run by an owner-chef with training experience in Italy (May 2026); a June 2026 diner heard the owner-chef had worked at Antico in Ichijoji, and another praised the female owner. Tabelog gives the opening day as 20 October 2014. A 2017 diner already singled out the braided buffalo mozzarella as rare in Japan.
chef_bio.specialty: Treccia caprese; sardine and pine-nut spaghetti.

anecdotes.text: "They don’t use any strange seasonings, and you can really taste the natural flavors of the organic ingredients." — June 2026.
An August 2026 diner who came without the phone-only course was steered by the staff through the menu and given a drink at the end anyway.
"I’m glad I could come here just before my training in Italy starts tomorrow." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ・バル、中京区油屋町145 洋燈館 1F、14:00〜16:30・18:00〜24:30 (L.O.)、水曜休み、月1回の連休、予約可 (13名以上は電話)、40席、個室 (4名)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、子連れ・ベビーカー可、ソムリエ、ベジタリアンメニューあり、カード可、電子マネー不可、2014年10月20日オープン。口コミ (2017年4月、2026年5月〜10月、英語): 南イタリアの居酒屋のような店、イタリアで修業したオーナーシェフ、一乗寺のアンティーコ出身、女性のオーナー、トレッチャのカプレーゼ、自家製コラトゥーラのカルパッチョ、自家製からすみ、鰯と松の実のスパゲッティ、レモンのパスタ、ピスタチオのフジッリ、ミートボールのオレキエッテ、カツレツ、アクアパッツァ、6,000円のシェアコース、デキャンタのワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte trattoria with staff who recommend dishes; book for evenings.

places.name: 京都 鮨ノ蔵 (Kyoto Sushi no Kura)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking: one chef’s-choice course whose ingredients and cooking cannot be changed; allergies and religious restrictions must be raised in advance, not on the day, and the full fee is charged if a guest cannot eat (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish omakase of small dishes, nigiri, hand rolls and fish-bone miso soup, with no changes to ingredients (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tuesday–Sunday 18:00–23:00, closed Monday. Reservation only; two-hour seating; 15 minutes late counts as a cancellation; a smaller party on the day is still charged for the booked number (Tabelog). Omakase only, no changes; allergies or religious restrictions must be raised in advance (Tabelog). Courses ¥22,000–24,000; an eel and crab course ¥33,000 (April and September 2026). No service charge except 10% over 31 December–3 January (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; BYO; children only if they can eat the adult course (Tabelog). Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Opened 26 March 2024 (Tabelog). EXIT祇園 1F; about 10 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama, east of Gion — 10 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Hokkaido-sourced sushi omakase from the Kyoto sister of Sapporo’s Sushi no Kura, with red-vinegar rice in Kyoto (rice vinegar in Sapporo) (2026 reviews) · about seven small dishes — pea-clam dashi, grilled flatfish, firefly squid, hairy-crab cream, marinated oysters, herring roe with cream cheese, house karasumi — then about ten nigiri (kinmedai, spear squid, kohada, botan shrimp, smoked nodoguro, akami and chu-toro, Hokkaido uni), hand rolls, fish-bone miso soup and dessert · omakase ¥22,000–24,000; eel and crab course ¥33,000 · rare sake by the glass, unpriced on the list (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Gion-Higashiyama, Hokkaido fish on red-vinegar rice] An eight-seat counter, opened March 2024 as the Kyoto sister of Sapporo's hard-to-book Sushi no Kura: a single omakase of about seven Hokkaido-led small dishes — herring roe with cream cheese, hairy-crab cream — then ten or so nigiri on mild red-vinegar rice, hand rolls and fish-bone miso soup, for ¥22,000–24,000. The chef speaks English to overseas guests. No changes to the course; reservation only. Tue–Sun evenings.

roles: Head chef (named only in a machine-translated review)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe the shop as a sister of the Sapporo restaurant Sushi no Kura, produced by its chef, with Hokkaido ingredients, red-vinegar rice in Kyoto against rice vinegar in Sapporo (May 2026), and a friendly head chef who speaks English with overseas guests (August 2025; September 2026). A September 2026 review names the producer and the chef at the counter, but only in English translation, so the names are not used here. Tabelog gives the opening day as 26 March 2024.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase of Hokkaido fish; smoked nodoguro nigiri.

anecdotes.text: "I feel like the chef's English skills are improving more and more, haha." — August 2025.
A March 2026 diner wished the staff were a bit more cheerful.
A diner who visits almost monthly loves the delicately scored squid and the smoked nodoguro, and hopes the "quick drink set" of five small plates returns — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、東山区林下町434 EXIT祇園 1F、火〜日 18:00〜23:00、月曜休み、完全予約制、2時間制、15分以上の遅刻はキャンセル扱い、当日の人数減でも予約人数分を請求、おまかせのみで食材・調理法の変更不可、アレルギーや宗教上の制限は事前に相談、当日の申告は不可、サービス料・チャージなし (年末年始は10%)、カウンター8席、禁煙、持ち込み可、大人と同じコースを食べられない子供は不可、カード可、2024年3月26日オープン。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 札幌の鮨ノ蔵の姉妹店、北海道の食材、京都は赤酢・札幌は米酢、おまかせ22,000〜24,000円、鰻と蟹のコース33,000円、つまみ7品ほど、数の子とクリームチーズ、毛蟹のクリーム、炙りののどぐろ、北海道の雲丹、手巻き、あら汁の味噌汁、大将は英語で会話。

cultural_comfort.note: The chef speaks English with overseas guests (2025–2026 reviews); omakase only, booked ahead.

places.name: 御所 岩さき (Gosho Iwasaki)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the restaurant says it cannot accommodate gluten-free diets and asks such guests not to come (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dashi-based kaiseki of fish, crab, shellfish, duck or beef hot pot; the restaurant cannot accommodate fish, shellfish or mollusc allergies (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch from 12:00 and dinner from 18:00 (all guests start together), closed Wednesday. Bookings online or by phone; mention allergies when booking; gluten-free diets and fish, shellfish or mollusc allergies cannot be accommodated; cancellation or change on the day is charged in full (Tabelog). Omakase course ¥23,100 (official site); lunch courses ¥11,000–11,500 (2023–2024 reviews). Service charge 5% (Tabelog). 8 seats: 6 at the counter, 2 at a table; non-smoking; school-age children (Tabelog). Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). The chef works alone (2024–2026 reviews). Just south of Marutamachi-dori; 3 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of the Imperial Palace, just south of Marutamachi — 3 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki served at a small counter, never repeating a menu for a returning guest (official site) · omakase ¥23,100 (official site); lunch ¥11,000–11,500 (2023–2024) · dishes seen: crab with Tosa-vinegar jelly, homemade karasumi mochi, abalone with egg-yolk vinegar, sesame tofu in white miso, sashimi of guji and sea bream, hamo and matsutake, grilled managatsuo, duck or beef-loin hot pot, kamadaki rice with pickles and mentaiko (2022–2026 reviews) · Japanese sake under ¥1,000 a gō (April 2025)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · south of the Imperial Palace, one chef, eight seats] An eight-seat kaiseki counter near the Imperial Palace where the chef, trained at Wakuden and Gion Maruyama and once head chef at the inn Hiiragiya, cooks and serves alone, never giving a returning guest the same menu: crab in Tosa-vinegar jelly, karasumi mochi, a seasonal soup, hot pot, kamadaki rice. Omakase ¥23,100; Michelin one star (Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2025). No gluten-free; no fish or shellfish allergies. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef (店主), per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: drawn to cooking by an elder brother who was a cook, the owner trained at the Kyoto ryotei 和久傳 and 祇園丸山 and served as head chef at the inn 京の宿 柊家, then opened 御所 岩さき near the Imperial Palace in 2007 (Heisei 19); following the inn custom of changing the menu for guests staying several nights, the chef never serves the same menu twice; one Michelin star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2025. A 2025 review says the restaurant moved from near Karasuma Oike and reopened here in 2021; reviewers in 2024–2026 note the chef runs everything alone.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "旬に寄り添い、心を満たす" — staying close to the season to satisfy the heart; a once-in-a-lifetime menu each visit.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki omakase; kamadaki rice.

anecdotes.text: An October 2024 guest asked about New Year osechi; the chef said that, working alone, osechi could not be made that year.
"Within four seconds of arriving, crab was served." — April 2025.
A December 2023 guest who booked through another site paid almost ¥5,000 more for the same course than on Tabelog.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gosho-iwasaki.com): 京都市・丸太町、御所南エリアの日本料理店「御所 岩さき (ごしょ いわさき)」、旬の食材の繊細な会席料理をコースで、京都御所や二条城から徒歩圏内、一期一会の献立 (一度来た客に同じものは出さない)、「旬に寄り添い、心を満たす」、店主 岩崎義則: 料理人の兄の影響で料理人を志す、和久傳・祇園丸山で修業、京の宿 柊家で料理長、平成19年に京都御所近くで独立、旅館のもてなしに倣い同じ献立は出さない、ミシュランガイド京都・大阪2025で一つ星、おまかせコース23,100円 (税込)。食べログ: 日本料理、中京区間之町通丸太町下ル東側大津町660、昼12:00・夜18:00一斉スタート、水曜休み、アレルギーは予約時に、グルテンフリーと魚・甲殻類・軟体類のアレルギーは対応不可、当日のキャンセル・変更は100%、サービス料5%、8席 (カウンター6、テーブル2)、禁煙、小学生以上、カード可。口コミ (2022年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 昼のコース11,000〜11,500円、蟹の土佐酢ジュレ、からすみ餅、鮑、胡麻豆腐の白味噌仕立て、ぐじ、鱧と松茸、鴨や牛ロースの鍋、釜炊きご飯、店主ひとりで営業、2021年に烏丸御池近くから移転。

cultural_comfort.note: Set kaiseki with a single start time; dishes explained clearly for overseas guests (October 2025); book ahead.

places.name: 四川料理と酒Yuan (Sichuan to Sake Yuan)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sichuan dishes built on chili oil, bean pastes and sauces, with gyoza, buns, noodles and fried rice; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly meat and seafood (mapo tofu, twice-cooked pork, chili shrimp); a few vegetable plates such as steamed eggplant with leek and Sichuan pepper sauce and two Sichuan potato salads, but no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00 Tuesday to Saturday (last food order 22:00, drinks 22:30); 17:30–21:30 Sunday (last food order 20:30, drinks 21:00); closed Monday (Tabelog; Gurunavi gives Tuesday–Sunday, closed Monday). 10% service charge after 22:00 (Tabelog). Bookings taken; recommended at weekends (August 2026). 19 seats: a counter of 6 facing the kitchen, tables and a 5-seat private room; non-smoking; cards accepted, no e-money or QR (Tabelog); cash and cards (January 2026). Tabelog lists BYO drinks. At the back of the 1st floor of the 鍵屋小路会館, a multi-tenant building on the west side of Fuyacho-dori just south of Takatsuji; look for the door with an upside-down 福 beside a big fridge (Tabelog; September 2026). 10 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 21 January 2026 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho-dori south of Takatsuji, in a multi-tenant building — 10 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: À la carte Sichuan cooking with drinks (Tabelog) · assorted appetizers ¥1,980 (January–February 2026) or ¥3,200 for two (September 2026): saliva chicken of Kyoto red jidori, spicy jellyfish, Sichuan potato salad, octopus with salt, lemon and Sichuan pepper, zha cai with green onion in chili oil, century egg with white sesame tofu · mapo tofu ¥1,650 (January and August 2026; ¥1,600 in September 2026) · Yuan-style Sichuan chili shrimp ¥1,900 · special black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork on the bone ¥3,200 · Yuan-style twice-cooked pork ¥1,760 · crab-sauce fried rice ¥1,760–1,800 · chewy grilled gyoza ¥660 · shrimp shumai ¥660 · master’s dan dan noodles ¥1,320 · bang bang chicken cold noodles (limited) ¥1,800 · lu rou fan ¥1,210 · "dangerous" custard buns 2 for ¥800 · almond tofu ¥660; half portions offered to solo diners (2026 reviews) · Shaoxing wine soda ¥880–900, chenpi mojito ¥900–980, Sichuan-pepper beer ¥1,300
places.notes: [Sichuan · Fuyacho, a new hidden Sichuan kitchen] A 19-seat Sichuan restaurant at the far end of the ground floor of a multi-tenant building on Fuyacho-dori, opened in January 2026 by chef Keiichi Hara, who trained at well-known restaurants and in China per an opening-day reviewer. Order à la carte: a six-item appetizer plate, mapo tofu, a celery-and-bitter-melon chili shrimp, black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork on the bone and crab fried rice, with Shaoxing-wine sodas — numbing and hot but refined, say reviewers; solo diners are offered half portions. Most spend ¥6,000–8,000. Closed Monday.

roles: Chef (named in a January 2026 review); a September 2026 reviewer calls the chef the owner
chef_bio.background: Per a January 2026 opening-day reviewer: chef Keiichi Hara trained at renowned restaurants and in China before opening this Sichuan restaurant, which mixes traditional flavours with a modern sensibility. Another January 2026 reviewer came because a favourite chef had opened a shop and enjoyed this chef’s Sichuan cooking again after a long time. A September 2026 diner found three people running the room and an open kitchen. Opened 21 January 2026 (Tabelog). Name written only in Latin letters in the source.
chef_bio.specialty: Mapo tofu; Yuan-style chili shrimp; black-vinegar pork on the bone.

anecdotes.text: An opening-day reviewer in January 2026 found many congratulatory flowers from well-known food lovers at the door and only one seat left.
An August 2026 regular watched the staff help a family of tourists from abroad who were in trouble, speaking fluently and kindly.
A September 2026 diner who disliked century egg was assured the century-egg white tofu would suit even people who dislike it, and was won over.
A September 2026 solo diner found the owner tough-looking at first but gentle when talking, explaining Chinese cooking and serving half portions.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 四川料理と酒Yuan (ゆえん)、四川料理・中華料理・居酒屋、下京区麩屋町通高辻下る鍵屋町219 鍵屋小路会館 E号、麩屋町高辻の交差点から南へ10m 西側、鍵屋小路会館1階の奥、京都河原町駅から徒歩10分、火〜土 17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00・ドリンク22:30)、日 17:30〜21:30、月曜休み、22時以降サービス料10%、予約可、19席 (カウンター6、テーブル2×4、個室5)、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、持ち込み可、2026年1月21日オープン。ぐるなび: 鍵屋小路会館内、京都河原町駅から徒歩6分、火〜日、月曜定休、19席。口コミ (2026年9月、日本語): 前菜盛り合わせ (2人前) 3,200円 (クラゲの麻辣和え、京赤地鶏のよだれ鶏、四川風ポテサラ、タコの塩レモン山椒風、搾菜と葱の辣油和え、ピータンの白和え)、ゆえん式・四川のエビチリ 1,900円、麻婆豆腐 1,600円、別格・黒酢豚 3,200円、蟹あんかけチャーハン 1,800円、爽 (紹興酒ソーダ) 900円、山椒ビール 1,300円、調理場の前のカウンター、「逆さ福」の扉。英語の口コミ (2026年1〜10月): Keiichi Hara シェフ、名店と中国で修業。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead at weekends; the shop is at the back of a building and hard to find on the map; 10% service after 22:00.

places.name: BISTRO MAUMU
places.gf_detail: Ask. A bistro menu of croquettes, fritters, gratin soup, pasta, gnocchi and bread; a few plates such as carpaccio, burrata with fruit and steak may suit, but no gluten information is published (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; the menu is mostly meat, fish, cheese and egg, with a tofu-and-tomato caprese and truffle-mayo fries among the few meat-free plates (Tabelog; official menu).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–1:30 (official site); Tabelog gives 17:00–1:00 Monday, Tuesday and Thursday to Sunday and holidays, 17:00–23:00 Wednesday; a September 2026 review gives 17:00–25:00 (Wednesday to 23:00) and irregular closures. Bookings taken; include the date and message when booking a celebration cake (Tabelog). 25 seats: a wooden counter round the kitchen on the 1st floor and about seven tables for two on the 2nd (Tabelog; September 2026); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). English, Chinese and Korean menus; staff and chef speak English (Tabelog; October 2026). Green door down a small alley on Ayakoji west of Yanaginobamba; 2 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn exit 15 (Tabelog). Opened 31 May 2024 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Paris-style wine bistro with French classics plus Italian and Spanish plates (official site; Tabelog) · burrata with seasonal fruit ¥1,800 · seasonal fish carpaccio ¥1,800 · Kyoto tofu and fruit-tomato caprese ¥1,480 · jamón serrano ¥1,380 · pâté de campagne ¥1,280 · chilled Kyoto duck loin ¥1,280 · œuf mayo ¥680 · crab cream croquette with crab miso and white miso ¥1,180 · French onion gratin soup ¥1,300 · fried chicken with gazpacho sauce ¥980 · steak frites ¥3,200 · wagyu steak Rossini with foie gras ¥5,800 · porchetta ¥1,580 · spicy roast chicken ¥1,500 · seasonal pasta ¥1,950 · seared-cheese Bolognese ¥1,880 · Parmesan-cream gnocchi ¥1,650 · crème brûlée ¥600 (official menu) · courses ¥6,000 and ¥9,000 (official site); celebration French course ¥6,600 (September 2026) · wines chosen by the sommelier, sangria, gin and tonic
places.notes: [French bistro · Karasuma, a late-night wine bistro] A two-floor bistro behind a green door in an alley off Ayakoji, styled on Paris back streets, with a wooden counter round the kitchen downstairs and small tables upstairs. The menu sticks to bistro classics — steak frites, French onion gratin soup, pâté, crab croquettes — plus burrata with whatever fruit is in season, a torched-cheese Bolognese and Parmesan gnocchi, with wines picked by the sommelier. Reviewers like the late hours and the English-speaking staff; one solo diner was given a smaller pasta portion. Open until 1:30 (to 23:00 on Wednesday).

roles: Operator 株式会社ＧＭＩ (Gion; invoice T6130001067887), which also runs 焼肉マウム and 居酒屋 マウム; chef not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Bistro Maumu does not chase trends and loves the unchanging scene of Paris bistros — steak frites, a daily pasta, honest food at the end of the day — with a resident sommelier choosing classic French and Italian bottles and New World wines. Opened 31 May 2024 (Tabelog). The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ＧＭＩ, whose head office is at the 焼肉マウム address in Gion (NTA corporate-number site; Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "We make food that makes people happy" — a place to reset after work, not a special place you visit stiffly.
chef_bio.specialty: Steak frites; burrata with seasonal fruit; Parmesan-cream gnocchi.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 solo diner was given a smaller pasta portion by the chef, with an offer to add more if it was not enough.
Staff told an October 2026 diner that the team has visited the Hokkaido oyster area three times.
A September 2026 diner watched the staff torch the cheese on the Bolognese at the table.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Hand-dripped coffee, juices and a few sweets (custard pudding, nougat glacé); no ingredient or gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee, shiso soda and the ginger drink look plant-based, but the pudding is egg custard and there is a milk coffee; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–17:00 Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday; 12:00–17:00 Thursday (last order 16:30); opens at 12:00 the day after a holiday; closed Wednesday and the third Sunday of each month (Tabelog). No bookings; no groups of more than 5 (Tabelog). The pudding cannot be ordered on its own (May 2026). 11 seats: 8 at tables and 3 at the counter (Tabelog; a May 2026 reviewer counted 12); non-smoking; no cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog); PayPay was not working for an August 2026 diner, who paid cash. On the ground floor of モア御所南 on Ebisugawa-dori east of Higashinotoin; 6 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 26 April 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ebisugawa-dori south of the Imperial Palace — 6 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small coffee house of hand-dripped coffee and homemade sweets (2026 reviews) · blend ¥550 (Kenyan base with Guatemala and Mandheling) · coffee of the day ¥600 (El Salvador in May 2026) · custard pudding with bitter caramel ¥450, also with vanilla ice cream · nougat glacé about ¥500 · shiso soda (summer) ¥650 · homemade ginger drink · "adult" mixed juice · a milk coffee (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Café · Ebisugawa, pudding and hand-drip coffee] An eleven-seat coffee house on Ebisugawa-dori south of the Imperial Palace, all warm wood, antique-style lamps, a bookshelf and mismatched cups. The owner explains the coffee of the day; the blend (¥550) is Kenya-based and the soft, silky pudding (¥450) with bitter caramel is the reason most come — it must be ordered with a drink. Tabelog Cafe 'Tabelog 100' 2021 and WEST 2025. Small and quiet: no groups over five. Closed Wednesday and the third Sunday.

roles: Owner (not named) who serves and explains the coffee (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 26 April 2014 (Tabelog). Selected for Tabelog Cafe "Tabelog 100" 2021 and Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025 (Tabelog). The listed website, coffeeplease.jimdo.com, no longer answers.
chef_bio.specialty: Custard pudding; Kenya-based blend coffee.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner heard another customer ask the owner what goes into the "adult" mixed juice, and noted that every question was answered with care.
A May 2026 diner was told the characteristics of the El Salvador coffee of the day by the owner and noted that every cup has a different design.
A June 2026 visitor came back after finding the café temporarily closed on a first try.

places.name: 韓国料理 先斗町 李南河 (Rinanha)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Korean dishes with marinades, gochujang and soy-based sauces, pancakes, dumplings and noodles; no gluten information is published (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly wagyu, pork, chicken and seafood; a vegetable bibimbap, namul and seasonal vegetable plates are on the menu, but no ingredient list is published (official menu).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 Monday to Friday; 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 Saturday, Sunday and holidays (last orders 14:00 and 22:00); closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Courses need booking ahead (official site). 10% service charge; private rooms for 4–6 cost an extra ¥6,000 (¥6,000–8,000 on the course page) (official site; Tabelog). 50 seats: a counter round the kitchen, tables on the 2nd floor facing the Kamo River and private rooms facing Pontocho (official site; August–September 2026); non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Pontocho north of Shijo; 2 min from Gion-Shijo or Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Kyoto shop opened July 2009 in a renovated old house in a Pontocho back alley, later moved to the riverside within Pontocho (operator site; official site).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho north of Shijo, on the Kamo River — 2 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Korean cooking with Japanese seasonal produce and Kyoto-market wagyu (official site) · house (李家) kimchi platter ¥2,000 · seasonal bossam kimchi ¥2,500 · namul ¥1,500 · japchae ¥1,800 · tteokbokki ¥1,500 · Kujo-negi chijimi ¥1,800, seafood or beef-tendon chijimi ¥2,500 · raw tripe with green chili ¥1,650 · wagyu yukhoe ¥2,000 · wagyu by weight from ¥5,000 (120 g) · Shinshu wagyu bulgogi for two ¥7,500 · Omi-beef skirt shabu-shabu hot pot for two ¥7,500 · jidori dakhanmari ¥5,000 · samgyetang ¥5,000 (book ahead) · kimchi or soft-tofu jjigae ¥1,800 · vegetable bibimbap ¥1,800 · gimbap ¥1,500 · house (李家) naengmyeon ¥1,600 (official menu) · set courses: jidori dakhanmari or Kagoshima black-pork samgyeopsal ¥7,000, ¥10,000 with 2 hours of drinks (5+ people); seasonal Korean set with a choice of main ¥9,500; November omakase ¥12,000 (official course page) · Korean liquors, makgeolli, house fruit liqueurs, Korean teas, wine
places.notes: [Korean · Pontocho, wagyu and kimchi over the Kamo River] The Kyoto branch of an Osaka-born chef's Korean restaurant that began in Daikanyama in 2000, here since 2009 and now in a stone-and-wood building on Pontocho with a counter round the kitchen and second-floor tables over the Kamo River. Courses open with a seasonal porridge and the house kimchi, then chijimi of Kyoto Kujo-negi, japchae and a main such as dakhanmari, bulgogi hot pot or black-pork samgyeopsal (¥7,000–12,000); à la carte runs to wagyu by the gram and bossam kimchi with seasonal fruit. 10% service. Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST 'Tabelog 100' 2026.

roles: Owner-chef of the operator group (grate-ful.co.jp); the shop carries the chef’s own name
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: in 2000 the Osaka-born cook 李 南河 opened 代官山 李南河 in Tokyo, naming it after the chef in the hope that guests feel as if eating at home; the Kyoto sister shop opened in a renovated old house in a Pontocho back alley and later moved to the riverside within Pontocho; the owner-chef visits producers and markets and buys wagyu at the Kyoto meat market; selected by ZAGAT and as a best Korean restaurant by the Korean Food Foundation; the bulgogi shop SURAGAN (Ebisu) followed in 2005. The operator グレイトフル株式会社 lists 9 restaurants and delis in Tokyo, Kanagawa and Kyoto, two named 李南河, and dates the Kyoto opening to July 2009 (grate-ful.co.jp). The invoice holder is the group company グレイトフルオペレーション株式会社 (Tabelog; NTA).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to keep trying new things with carefully chosen seasonal ingredients so people learn how good Korean food is.
chef_bio.specialty: Bossam kimchi with seasonal fruit; Kujo-negi chijimi; dakhanmari and bulgogi hot pots.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 host whose guest disliked green onion was given seafood chijimi in place of the Kujo-negi one at no extra charge; the private room faced Pontocho, not the river.
A September 2026 diner who arrived far too early was still welcomed and given a 2nd-floor seat over the Kamo River.
A September 2026 regular plans to come back every two months, finishing with fig compote and vanilla ice cream.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (linamha-pontocho.com): 京都 李南河 (りなんは)、鴨川を一望できる上質な和牛の韓国料理店、2000年に大阪出身の料理人・李南河が代官山 李南河を開店、自らの名前を店名に、京都では先斗町の路地裏の古民家を改装して姉妹店、現在は先斗町内の鴨川沿いに移転、京都食肉市場の和牛、自家製果実酒、ZAGAT SURVEY・韓食財団のベスト韓国レストラン、2005年にプルコギ専門店 SURAGAN (恵比寿)、中京区先斗町通四条上る鍋屋町232、月〜金17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、土日祝12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)・17:00〜23:00、不定休、個室料6,000円、コース: 地鶏タッカンマリ定食・黒豚サムギョプサル定食 各7,000円 (2時間飲み放題付き10,000円、5名から)、旬で自由な韓定食9,500円、11月のお任せコース12,000円、アラカルト: 李家キムチ盛り合わせ2,000円、季節のポッサムキムチ2,500円、京都九条ネギのチヂミ1,800円、信州プレミアム和牛特選プルコギ (2人前) 7,500円、近江牛特選ハラミしゃぶしゃぶ辛味鍋 (2人前) 7,500円、地鶏タッカンマリ5,000円、野菜のビビンバ1,800円、李家冷麺1,600円、サービス料10%。グレイトフル株式会社: オーナーシェフ 李 南河、2009年7月 京都 李南河 オープン、9店舗。食べログ: 韓国料理・ステーキ、50席、禁煙、カード可、インボイス T5011001151289 (グレイトフルオペレーション株式会社)、アジア・エスニック WEST 百名店 2026。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book courses ahead; ask for a 2nd-floor river seat; 10% service and a private-room fee.

Bookings online; by phone for more than 9 people or after 21:00; at a full lunch, tables are limited to 90 minutes (Tabelog). 20 seats (4 at the counter); non-smoking; children welcome, strollers stored rather than brought in; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of Kyoto City Hall — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn, 10 min from Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: Wine bar and izakaya with French, Italian and Japanese plates that change daily: about eight small plates such as marinated mushrooms and pork rillettes, salads and fried dishes, mains like beef sirloin steak and meat-sauce spaghetti; lunch sets of a main with bread, soup and a drink; a cellar of about 200 bottles, mainly French, and about 10 wines by the glass (Tabelog) · vegetable and meat appetizer platters (mixed on request), squid-ink "black Neapolitan" pasta, gratin of salmon and Kamo eggplant, itoyori and mussels simmered in Kyoto dashi, rare-fried sawara, braised pork belly with lentils, hashed beef, pudding (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Wine izakaya · south of Kyoto City Hall] A stylish 20-seat bar for wine and food, with plates that change daily — French, Italian and Japanese — and staff who pour by the glass after asking what you like. Lunch sets around ¥2,000; dinner around ¥6,000–8,000. Booking advised: it fills up even on weekdays. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 2 February 2022 (Tabelog). Per the operator: dishes change daily with the fresh ingredients — fish such as flounder and sea bream, chicken and beef; about 200 bottles in the cellar, mainly French.
chef_bio.specialty: Small plates with wine; black Neapolitan pasta.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner found the owner's passion for wine plain in the detailed explanations, and moved from glasses to two bottles.
A reviewer who mixed up the booking date by a day was still served with care — October 2026.
A lunch with an extra glass of wine (¥500) and the pudding (¥500) came to ¥2,900 — October 2026.

Eat-in seats cannot be booked; takeaway saba-zushi can be reserved by phone from 8:00, other orders online (Tabelog). 16 seats at four tables of four; non-smoking; the only soft drink is oolong tea; cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo (Yasaka-shinchi) — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto pressed sushi, above all saba sugata-zushi: fatty chub mackerel from Japanese waters on a house rice blend, wrapped in Hokkaido kombu (official site) · eat-in menu, 4 pieces unless noted: saba sugata-zushi ¥2,200, kodai suzume-zushi ¥1,980, amadai sugata-zushi ¥4,400, tai-zushi ¥1,980, hamo sugata-zushi (summer) ¥5,060, grilled-anago sushi ¥1,760, futomaki ¥1,760, Kyo-chirashi ¥3,300, mushi-zushi (winter) ¥3,300, Kyo-zushi assortment ¥3,960 (official site) · reviewers also had a limited set comparing yesterday's and today's saba (¥2,500), sea bream with yuzu in bamboo leaf (¥495), and a "Gion Flavor" set with a clear soup (¥3,190) (2026 reviews) · takeaway and nationwide delivery (official site)
places.notes: [Saba-zushi · Gion, since 1781] The old Gion house for Kyoto's mackerel pressed sushi, in a machiya with a white noren: four pieces of saba sugata-zushi wrapped in kombu (¥2,200) at one of four tables, or boxed to take away. Try the set comparing yesterday's and today's saba. No bookings for the tables; some reviewers find it pricey for the portion. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Family business (no person named for today)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1781 (Tenmei 1) by the first-generation いづみや卯兵衛 ("Izumiya Uhe" on the English site). Besides this main shop there are counters at Daimaru Kyoto and JR Kyoto Isetan, and the sushi is sold at several department stores and Kyoto Station.
chef_bio.specialty: Saba sugata-zushi.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor learned that the large straw sandals on display are where the ajari monk changes footwear.
An October 2026 visitor came because a late grandparent had loved the saba-zushi, and the chef shared stories of the shop's history.
A September 2026 reviewer found both assortments "quite small" for the price; a November 2026 regular "couldn't help but laugh at the prices".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (izuu.jp): いづう、天明元年 (1781年) に初代いづみや卯兵衛が創業、京名物 鯖姿寿司、鯖は日本近海の脂がのった真鯖、いづう特選米、寿司全体を包む昆布は北海道産、本店 東山区八坂新地清本町367、11:00〜22:00 (日祝〜21:00)、火曜休み (祝日・行事の日は営業)、お召し上がり処 (税込): 鯖姿寿司2,200円、小鯛の雀寿司1,980円、甘鯛姿寿司4,400円、鯛寿司1,980円、鱧姿寿司 (夏季) 5,060円、焼穴子寿司1,760円、太巻き寿司1,760円、京ちらし寿司3,300円、蒸し寿司 (冬季) 3,300円、京寿司盛合せ3,960円、大丸京都店とジェイアール京都伊勢丹店。食べログ: 予約不可 (持ち帰りの鯖姿寿司のみ8時から電話予約)、16席 (4人席4卓)、ソフトドリンクは烏龍茶のみ、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): 昨日と今日の鯖の食べ比べ、柚子の香る鯛の笹巻き寿司、吸い物付きの盛り合わせ、阿闍梨のわらじ。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in for a table (no bookings); takeaway by phone or online. A September 2026 reviewer heard staff serving in fluent English.

places.name: RESTAURANT KOGA
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. The restaurant asks for allergies and restrictions at booking and may decline bookings that rule out much of what it cooks with, naming wheat, egg, dairy, butter, olive oil and nuts (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: "ベジタリアン、ビーガンの対応は出来かねます" — vegetarian and vegan requests cannot be met (official site; Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00 (last order 13:00); dinner 18:00 (last order 19:30 — the site gives 19:00 in one place); closed Tuesday and Wednesday, with some special openings (official site; Tabelog). Bookings online (TableCheck) or by phone; 100% charge for same-day cancellation (Tabelog). Lunch course ¥12,000, dinner course ¥22,000, tax included, plus 10% service (official site). 32 seats: tables for 16 and a private room for up to 16; wheelchair accessible; English menu and English-speaking staff; sommelier; BYO allowed; no very casual clothes such as men's shorts and sandals; children welcome if able to eat the adult menu; cards incl. UnionPay (Tabelog). 8 min west of Imadegawa Stn along Imadegawa-dori (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ogawa-dori north of Imadegawa, west of the Imperial Palace — 8 min from Imadegawa Stn
places.cuisine: French omakase in a renovated 120-year-old machiya: lunch 8–10 dishes ¥12,000, dinner 10–12 dishes ¥22,000 (official site) · signature warm salad of 30-plus vegetables picked that morning; seafood sent direct; a cellar for up to 3,000 bottles, mainly French (Tabelog) · 2026 reviews: corn dog with crab cream or fond de veau and duck, squid and sardine tarts, scallops with zucchini and saffron, spicy fish beignet, Kyoto Mochi pork with Kita Akari gnocchi, chicken with cep sauce, pigeon, a soufflé baked to order, freshly baked financier · wine pairing 60 ml ¥8,000 or 30 ml ¥6,000 (October 2026 review)
places.notes: [French · Ogawa-dori near the Imperial Palace, Michelin one star per reviewers] Chef 古賀 隆稚 (Koga Ryuji) — once deputy head chef at Le Cinq in Paris and later head chef at the Four Seasons Hotel Kyoto — opened this French restaurant in a renovated machiya in 2025. Omakase only: lunch ¥12,000, dinner ¥22,000, plus 10%. English menu and staff; no vegan or vegetarian meals. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: after École Tsuji's school in France and training in regional France, worked from 2006 at Joël Robuchon (Ebisu), then in France at Le Chabichou (Courchevel), Villa Archange (Cannes), Ledoyen (Paris) and as sous-chef at a one-star restaurant; from 2016 the first Japanese deputy head chef, also developing menus, at Le Cinq (Hôtel George V, Paris) under Christian Le Squer; back in Japan in 2019 as head chef at the Four Seasons Hotel Kyoto. RED U-35 bronze egg 2013 and silver egg 2014 and 2015. Opened KOGA on 9 January 2025 (Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer writes that it holds one Michelin star in the 2026 Kyoto-Osaka guide.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a restaurant as a "総合芸術" (total art) of space, service and cuisine; respect for every ingredient and its producer; combining ingredients like a perfumer combines scents.
chef_bio.specialty: Warm salad of 30-plus vegetables; soufflé baked to order.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 return guest asked about each dish and the chef "openly shared everything I was curious about".
An August 2026 diner's one complaint: the cheese in the little pizza was hot enough to burn two tongues.
A fifth-time guest in October 2026 praised the "cuisson" and that past dishes are tracked so each visit brings something new.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (koga-kyoto.jp): RESTAURANT KOGA、シェフ 古賀 隆稚 (KOGA RYUJI)、福岡県生まれ、エコール辻フランス校卒業後フランスの地方にて研修、2006年よりジョエル・ロブション (恵比寿)、Le Chabichou、Villa Archange、Ledoyen、2016年 Le Cinq でクリスチャン ルスケール氏のもと日本人で初めての副料理長兼メニュー開発、2019年帰国後フォーシーズンズホテル京都料理長、空間・サービス・料理がひとつになって完成する総合芸術、ランチ12,000円・ディナー22,000円 (税込、サービス料10%)、Lunch 12:00〜13:00 L.O.、Dinner 18:00〜19:30 L.O.、毎週火・水曜休み、ベジタリアン・ビーガンの対応は出来かねます。食べログ: フレンチ、上京区小川通今出川上ル中小川町230、築120年の町家を改装、32席・個室16名、ソムリエ、英語メニュー、持ち込み可、2025年1月9日オープン、当日キャンセル100%。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 温野菜のサラダ、焼き立てのスフレ、ミシュラン一つ星 (2026年版)、ペアリング60ml 8,000円・30ml 6,000円。

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seasonal fish, dashi-based dishes, chicken, beef and duck (official site).

An otoshi charge of ¥1,000 per person (Tabelog). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 13 seats: 8 at the counter and one table for 4; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; official site). Non-smoking (Tabelog). places.neighborhood: Shirakawa in Gion, near Tatsumi Shrine — 4 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Small Kyoto-cuisine counter of seasonal fish and Kyoto vegetables (official site) · omakase of nine courses ¥11,000 — sakizuke, soup, sashimi, lidded dish, grill, plate, a small dish, fried dish, rice (official site) · à la carte: autumn salmon saikyo-yaki, Kyoto turnip steamed ¥1,500, saba heshiko ¥1,200, funazushi ¥2,200, whale bacon ¥2,000, karasumi ¥1,800, duck loin ¥1,800 (official site) · seasonal list: dashimaki, homemade karasumi, wakatake-ni, sea bream roe with butterbur, Kyoto jidori grilled with salt, tempura, saba-zushi, jako rice (official site; March 2026) · takeaway saba-zushi and braised pork (official site) · Kyoto sake (official site)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Gion Shirakawa, a counter by the stone lane] A tiny counter hidden on the Shirakawa stone lane in Gion, with eight seats in front of the cooks and one table. The nine-course omakase is ¥11,000, or order à la carte from the seasonal list: rolled omelette, karasumi with daikon, salt-grilled Kyoto chicken, saba-zushi to finish, and old-Kyoto drinking snacks such as funazushi and whale bacon. The head chef, named 筒井 on the official site, trained within the yagenbori group. ¥1,000 otoshi; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 筒井 (head chef; reading not given)
roles: Head chef 筒井, promoted after training at yagenbori (official site)
chef_bio.background: The official site says the head chef, 筒井, was chosen to lead Wabisuke after training at yagenbori, and that the kitchen blends Kyoto tradition with new arrangements. A March 2026 reviewer first came about 35 years ago, when an elderly woman ran it alone; it later joined the yagenbori group, and the chef has changed on each visit since. A February 2026 reviewer says the present head chef has led the kitchen for a few years.
chef_bio.philosophy: To bring out the character of fish from around Kyoto and Kyoto vegetables in Kyoto cuisine that shows the four seasons (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal omakase; karasumi with daikon; saba-zushi.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular of some 35 years noticed the large platters of obanzai once laid along the counter were gone, and was told the change came with COVID-19.
A February 2026 family bonded with the young head chef over baseball at a packed counter.
A 2019 regular who loves teppai mentioned it ahead of time, and the kitchen made it.

places.notes: [Wine stand · Kiyamachi-Matsubara, natural wine by the coin] A small open-fronted stand on Kiyamachi where you feed ¥1,000 into a machine, get two coins, and pour your own natural wine from the servers — orange, Japanese, Spanish, French — about ¥500 a pour, from 10 a.m. to 11 p.m. Coffee, chai, beer, cheese, salami and canelé come from the counter, and bottles are sold upstairs. A sister of the soba shop next door, suba, so it works well before or after. Mostly standing; one November 2025 visitor found the system unexplained.

roles: Staff (unnamed); same group as the soba shop suba and a yakitori shop (July 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 6 July 2023. A July 2026 reviewer learned from the staff that it belongs to the same group as suba next door and a yakitori shop; a May 2026 reviewer calls suba the sister restaurant.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor who had read about ¥500 wine expected to order from staff, then found the machine: a ¥1,000 note, two coins, and the wine pours itself into the glass.
A November 2025 traveller started a Kyoto trip at 10:30 a.m. here and worked through twelve wines.
A November 2025 visitor found nobody explained the system and the staff chatting with someone inside; a neighbouring customer showed how it worked.

places.cuisine: Couple-run izakaya with Japanese cooking and inventive kushiage (2026 reviews) · nanakushi, seven assorted kushiage ¥2,100, including angel shrimp (April 2026) · duck and Kujo green-onion hot pot, finished as zosui (March–October 2026) · bonito shio-tataki ¥1,650, nama-fu with walnut miso ¥990, sashimi of local fish, tender simmered octopus, sake-steamed guchi, herb-grilled pork loin, fried sesame tofu, young-sweetfish nanban (2026 reviews) · chirimen-sansho fried rice to finish (May–October 2026) · sake on the blackboard, Sapporo draft ¥730, ume soda ¥890 (April–July 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Ebisugawa, kushiage and duck hot pot by a couple] A warm, counter-led izakaya run by a couple, which moved in 2024 from Kiyamachi to a quiet stretch of Ebisugawa. A good blackboard of sake. Cash only; book by phone; closed Wednesday.

roles: Chef (unnamed) and the chef’s wife, who run it as a couple
chef_bio.background: Reviewers knew it first on Kiyamachi; it moved to Ebisugawa, and Tabelog gives the opening here as 7 September 2024. Several 2026 reviews describe it as run by a couple.
chef_bio.specialty: Nanakushi kushiage; duck and Kujo green-onion hot pot.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 pair, not knowing when a concert would end, called at the last minute and were offered a table for two at 7:30 — and skipped the merchandise stand to make it.
A May 2026 diner arrived just before opening and watched the chef hang out the noren, glad to see the chef’s wife as lively as ever.
An August 2026 visitor returning after five years found the cooking unchanged while so many places were raising prices or cutting corners.

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; book by phone; 2 h 30 min seating.

places.name: 鮨 森学 (Sushi Mori Gaku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase of sushi and small dishes with soy-based seasonings, anago and eel with sauce, and wagyu shabu-shabu; allergies can be raised when booking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi omakase of fish and seafood, with wagyu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Reservations only. Lunch 12:00–14:00; dinner in two seatings that start together, 18:00–20:00 and 20:30–22:30; closed Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). Tell the shop about dislikes, allergies or celebrations when booking (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese listing). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 8 counter seats (Tabelog). BYO drinks allowed (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children and babies welcome, no baby chairs (Tabelog). Set back inside a building on Kiyamachi south of Nijo, 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 2 June 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Nijo — 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Omakase sushi counter with straw and charcoal theatre: fish from Maizuru in Kyoto and elsewhere in Japan (official site) · dinner is the chef’s course only, about 17 dishes (May 2026) · bonito grilled over flaming straw with the lights dimmed, served with shiso, ginger and salt; mackerel skin seared with hot charcoal for a roll (July 2026) · squid with charcoal salt or black salt and citrus, flounder, toro with mustard, anago sushi in a bamboo steamer, abalone with sea urchin, chawanmushi with gold leaf, yuba with salmon roe (July–October 2026) · wagyu shabu-shabu and other meat dishes between the sushi (June–July 2026) · white miso soup and sorbet to close (June 2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Kiyamachi-Nijo, straw-flamed bonito at an eight-seat counter] Down a passage off Kiyamachi, a dark, bar-like counter of eight seats where the owner, with more than thirty years in Japanese cooking, serves omakase from Maizuru fish and beyond. The show is the straw grill: lights down, flames up, bonito seared in front of you; mackerel skin is pressed with live charcoal. About seventeen dishes at dinner, in two seatings that start together; lunch at noon. Reservations only; closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed on the official site; an August 2026 review thanks “Master Inoue”)
chef_bio.background: The official site says the owner has more than thirty years of experience across Japanese cuisine, and describes the room as a calm, bar-like hideaway. Tabelog gives the opening as 2 June 2024.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal fish chosen from Maizuru and across Japan, served as omakase at the counter (official site); a May 2026 reviewer noted the focus on origin and season.
chef_bio.specialty: Straw-grilled bonito; charcoal-seared mackerel roll.

anecdotes.text: At a July 2026 lunch the room went dark as the straw caught fire and the bonito was seared inches away — a first for the diner, who already loved katsuo tataki.
A September 2026 diner said it engaged smell and hearing as well as taste, with the scent of straw and the sizzle of charcoal, and a friend from Singapore planned to recommend it.
A June 2026 lunch guest found nothing memorable and was distracted by a server’s constant chatter with other guests.

places.name: とんちんかん (Okonomiyaki Tonchinkan)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki, monjayaki, yakisoba and betayaki are wheat-batter or wheat-noodle dishes cooked on shared teppan with sauce (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the monjayaki is made with a bonito and kombu dashi and most dishes carry pork, squid or beef tendon (Tabelog; June 2026).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–22:30 (last order 22:00) daily; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); walk-ins found seats on a Saturday afternoon (October 2026). The kitchen cooks the dishes and brings them nearly ready (May–October 2026). Third floor up stairs, no lift (June and August 2026). 44 seats including a tatami room; private hire for 20–50; smoking allowed; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). On Rokkaku-dori west of Kawaramachi; 5 min from Sanjo, Kawaramachi and Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stns (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Rokkaku-dori west of Kawaramachi, 3rd floor — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Okonomiyaki and monjayaki — rare in Kyoto — on Kawaramachi for about 20 years (Tabelog, shop text) · monjayaki ¥850 plus toppings, e.g. squid, mentaiko and Baby Star, beef tendon and green onion, mentaiko-mochi-cheese; "Tonchi" monja, rice monja (September 2026; 2026 reviews) · okonomiyaki mix ¥1,199, Hiroshima-style, modern-yaki, betayaki, sujitama, ikatama ¥891 · yakisoba mix ¥1,199, pork yakisoba ¥902, curry yakisoba, omusoba, negiyaki with beef tendon ¥902 · grilled squid tentacles ¥693, baked cheese potatoes ¥671 (August–September 2026) · large portions +¥200–300 (October 2026)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki & monja · Kawaramachi, Tokyo-style monja up three flights] A retro, third-floor teppan shop on Rokkaku, cheap for central Kyoto, that has served monjayaki — rare in the city — for two decades or more. Start with a monja of squid, mentaiko and Baby Star (¥850 base), then a mixed okonomiyaki, betayaki or yakisoba (about ¥900–1,200); the kitchen brings them almost ready to finish on your griddle. Portions are modest; one October 2026 diner thought the mixes tasted pre-made. Smoking allowed; no lift. Open daily 11:30–22:30.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): open on Kawaramachi for 20 years, serving authentic monjayaki, rare in Kyoto, with a fluffy batter of its own blend, and gives the opening day as 4 March 2000; a September 2026 reviewer gives the founding as 27 years ago. A June 2026 reviewer says the name comes from a nickname given to the mischievous previous owner.
chef_bio.specialty: Monjayaki; okonomiyaki.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner felt dishes arrived pre-prepared rather than off the teppan and suspected frozen mixes, likening the taste to a festival stall.
"The interior may not be the cleanest, but the service is quick, and the dishes come out promptly!" — August 2026.
"By the way, the name "Tonchinkan" comes from a nickname given to the previous owner, who was quite a mischievous character." — June 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Order from the menu; dishes come ready to finish on the griddle; cards and PayPay; smoking allowed.

places.gf_detail: Ask. The lunch buffet is bread, pasta, quiche-style dishes and desserts alongside salads and vegetables; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the buffet is vegetable-led, but it also carries prosciutto, pâté, mussels and cheesecake (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:30–10:30 (last order 10:00), lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00; buffet until 14:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 22:00), daily (Tabelog). Lunch is a buffet with one main dish chosen from 6–8, for 90 minutes; book ahead — online slots fill and the restaurant asks diners not to phone on fully booked days (Tabelog; September–October 2026). No birthday plates at lunch (Tabelog). Dinner charge ¥500; dinner courses need one drink each (Tabelog). 50 seats with an open kitchen; private hire up to 50; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Ground floor of the hotel YUGEN Kyoto Shijo on Takatsuji; 6 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).

places.cuisine: French regional cooking and wine in a hotel restaurant, by a chef with over 20 years’ experience (Tabelog, shop text) · lunch: one main from 6–8 — Bolognese with penne, carbonara, crab tomato cream pasta (+¥300), saury peperoncino, strip-loin steak, onion gratin soup, pâté de campagne — with a buffet of salads, vegetable dishes with Kyoto white miso and nama-fu dengaku, mussels steamed in white wine, chicken pâté, prosciutto, chilled pumpkin soup, breads and croissants, Basque cheesecake (August–October 2026) · breakfast and dinner à la carte and courses with world wines and sake (Tabelog)
places.notes: [French bistro · Kawaramachi, a vegetable-led lunch buffet] The glass-walled restaurant of the hotel YUGEN Kyoto Shijo, with an open kitchen and a lunch formula that fills up: pick one main — Bolognese, carbonara, a steak or onion gratin soup — and help yourself to a buffet of vegetable dishes, prosciutto, pâté, mussels, breads and Basque cheesecake, for 90 minutes. Lunch bills run about ¥2,000–4,000. Breakfast from 7:30 and French dinners with wine too. Book online; one September 2026 diner found the room tight, with staff carrying dishes taking the aisles.

roles: Hotel restaurant; chef unnamed (over 20 years’ experience per Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a casual French regional restaurant on the first floor of the hotel, with an open kitchen run by a chef of over 20 years, seasonal Kyoto ingredients, and wines from around the world and domestic sake; private hire for up to 50.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch buffet with a main.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner wanted more dessert choice and felt rushed when plates were cleared straight away.
An October 2026 diner found 90 minutes too short to try everything wanted.
An October 2026 diner, crowded at the buffet by a large group, was kindly offered extra time by the staff.

places.name: 料 かわしま (Ryo Kawashima)
places.gf_detail: Ask, and tell the restaurant in advance about allergies and dislikes for every guest (Tabelog). The course uses dashi and soy, with a fried shrimp-and-yam dish, udon in one dish and sushi (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led kaiseki with dashi (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: One sitting: all guests start together at 18:00; closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only; the next free dates have been one and a half to two years away, with cancellation slots appearing on TableCheck (May 2026); a January 2026 diner heard it was not taking new reservations. Phone or message only Tuesday–Saturday 12:00–17:00 (Tabelog). Tell the restaurant in advance of allergies and dislikes for every guest (Tabelog). 8 counter seats (6 bookable online; 7–8 for private hire) (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards and e-money (Tabelog). A renovated townhouse just north of Oike-dori, 3 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; March 2026).
places.neighborhood: North of Oike-dori — 3 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: One-chef kappo course of seasonal fish (2025–26 reviews) · evening course ¥20,000 plus drinks (May 2026) · opens with a rice porridge (eel tsukudani, clam and Brussels sprouts, koppe crab); Densuke conger eel, firefly squid from Hyogo then Toyama, tuna sashimi with shungiku and sesame, grouper soup, lily bulb with karasumi, swordfish with sesame tofu, saba sushi, anago sushi, sekogani rice (2025–26 reviews) · two clay-pot rices to finish — plain white rice with six accompaniments such as karasumi, ikura and egg-yolk soy, and a flavoured one (2025–26 reviews) · sake; Heartland beer (December 2025)
places.notes: [Kappo · Karasuma Oike, one chef and eight seats] A townhouse counter near Karasuma Oike where chef Kawashima cooks a single fish-led course for eight, all starting at 18:00: a gentle opening porridge, Densuke conger eel, firefly squid, lily bulb with karasumi, and a finish of clay-pot rice with half a dozen accompaniments. It is ¥20,000 before drinks, a price one three-time diner calls reasonable, and the waiting list runs a year or two. Watch TableCheck for cancellations, and phone only Tuesday–Saturday 12:00–17:00. Closed Sunday and Monday.

roles: Owner-chef who runs the 8 seats alone (2026 reviews; surname only)
chef_bio.background: A March 2026 reviewer says the restaurant opened in September 2022 in a renovated Kyoto townhouse; reviewers describe chef Kawashima as gentle and kind (May 2026), running all eight seats single-handed (January and August 2026), and showing guests how the dashi is made (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fish course; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "I made a reservation targeting cancellation slots through table check, as the next available booking is a year and a half away." — May 2026.
A January 2026 diner, brought by a regular, heard the restaurant was not accepting new reservations and found the seasoning a little mild for those who like stronger flavours.
"I look forward to my next visit in 2028." — April 2026.

places.name: 祇園 まんま (GION MANMA)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo cooking with dashi and soy, saba sushi, shrimp shinjo and Saikyo-miso marinated fish; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, shrimp, conger eel and beef dishes with dashi (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–13:00 by reservation only, courses booked by the day before; dinner 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday; may close early (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Omakase course or à la carte — three recommended dishes first, then order (May 2026). 8 counter seats facing the charcoal grill and a small courtyard (Tabelog; October 2025). Non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). In the Rakuen Koji alley, Gion north of Shijo; 3 min from the Gion bus stop, 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Rakuen Koji, Gion north of Shijo — 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion kappo with a charcoal grill and straw-searing, as a course or à la carte (2025–26 reviews) · straw-seared bonito, Akashi sawara, Awaji mackerel and conger eel, kuruma-shrimp shinjo in soup, sashimi of squid and shrimp with fried shrimp heads, salt-grilled onaga sea bream, Saikyo-miso mutsu, saba sushi, simmered octopus with lotus root, Omi beef tenderloin grilled in front of you (2025–26 reviews) · course ¥20,680 (December 2025); bills about ¥15,000–30,000 a head (2025–26 reviews) · sake
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion, straw-seared fish in Rakuen Koji] An 8-seat counter down Gion's Rakuen Koji, where the chef sears bonito over burning straw and grills on charcoal in full view, with a little courtyard behind. Have the omakase or go à la carte after three starters: Akashi sawara, Awaji conger eel, shrimp shinjo, salt-grilled sea bream and Omi beef. Opened in 2018 by a chef trained at Takada Hassho in Gifu; reviewers mention a Michelin listing. About ¥15,000–30,000 a head. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per an August 2026 reviewer: the owner, from Kagawa, trained at the renowned "Takada Hassho" in Gifu before opening GION MANMA in 2018; the name expresses the wish that guests enjoy seasonal ingredients as they are. A November 2025 reviewer counted three chefs for seven counter seats; a November 2025 reviewer calls it Michelin-listed and an October 2026 reviewer Michelin-starred.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per an August 2026 reviewer: seasonal delicacies enjoyed "just as they are, in their purest form."
chef_bio.specialty: Straw-seared bonito; charcoal-grilled fish.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner was troubled by visible food waste — anything slightly imperfect was discarded.
"Conversations over the counter are enjoyable, and the chef’s personality is delightful." — September 2026.
A May 2026 diner watched Omi beef tenderloin grilled in front of the counter after ordering straw-seared bonito.

Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). places.notes: [Italian · just off Nishiki Market, Wakayama produce] A cave-like trattoria tucked at the back of a building on Sakaimachi, a step north of Nishiki Market, cooking Kyoto vegetables with fish and produce from the owner's home of Wakayama. The draw is the sea-urchin cream pasta; lunch sets of about ¥2,000 bring a generous appetiser plate, pasta or a whole pizza and a drink (wine included). Some diners found the sauces on the salty side. Book lunch ahead. Closed Monday.

roles: A couple, per an August 2026 review
chef_bio.origin: Wakayama (Tabelog: the owner was born and raised there).
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, the fish and vegetables come from Wakayama, where the owner was born and raised, alongside Kyoto vegetables. chef_bio.philosophy: Ingredients from the owner’s home of Wakayama and from Kyoto (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sea-urchin cream pasta.

Three friends sharing pasta and pizza in May 2026 were given six plates without asking.
"The Uni Cream Sauce pasta had a strong uni flavor right from the first bite, but it was a bit too salty for my taste." — July 2026.
"I was quite surprised that I could choose wine as my set drink for the lunch course without any additional charge!" — October 2026.

places.name: 祇園新橋 中谷 (Gion Shinbashi Nakatani)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki courses with dashi, ponzu, nama-fu, fried dishes and mackerel sushi; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-centred kaiseki courses built on kombu dashi, sashimi, grilled fish and hot pots (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday and holidays 11:30–13:30 (last entry) and 18:00–21:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Courses of about ¥9,000 and ¥13,000 (the latter at lunch), omakase ¥14,300 and ¥17,600 (2025–2026 reviews). 16 seats with a counter and a raised area of two 4-seat tables behind blinds; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley off Gion Shinbashi near Tatsumi Bridge; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Gion Shinbashi near Tatsumi Bridge — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kaiseki courses of fish sent direct from Awaji and Wakasa and Kyoto vegetables bought from farmers (Tabelog) · e.g. appetiser, soup, seasonal sashimi, assorted dishes, grilled dish, small hot pot, rice and dessert (September 2025); ikura, fig with sesame, nama-fu, mackerel sushi (October 2025); bluefin tuna and yellowtail sashimi, Spanish mackerel soup, grouper with ponzu, fried gurnard, roast beef, clay-pot rice (December 2025); grilled scallops with Usui-bean tofu (April 2026); stuffed sweetfish from Takashima grilled on skewers, matsutake soup (September 2026) · leftover rice wrapped as onigiri to take home; mackerel sushi to take away (2025–2026 reviews) · a wide sake list (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion Shinbashi, a chef of 30 years in an alley] A quiet kaiseki restaurant at the end of a narrow alley off Gion Shinbashi, run by Ichirou Nakatani, a chef of over 30 years trained at a renowned Kyoto restaurant. Fish comes straight from Awaji and Wakasa, vegetables from Kyoto farmers, and the tableware draws on the family's pottery shop. Courses run from about ¥9,000 to ¥17,600; leftover clay-pot rice goes home as onigiri. Staff explain dishes in English. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the owner is a chef with over 30 years in Japanese cuisine, trained at a renowned Kyoto restaurant (not named); fish is sourced from Awaji Island and Wakasa Bay and vegetables directly from local farmers. An October 2025 reviewer: "The chef's family runs a pottery shop, so the beautiful tableware was filled with thoughtful details." A January 2026 reviewer noted the staff's English.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Choosing Ingredients Without Compromise, from Fish and Vegetables to Kombu Used for Broth" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal hassun; mackerel sushi; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner watched stuffed sweetfish from Takashima, Shiga, chilled in a glass bowl of ice, then skewered and grilled — "tender enough to bite into from the head."
A March 2026 diner's leftover rice came back as onigiri wrapped in foil "like a cute mini bag" to take home.
"I can't forget the mackerel sushi—it was unforgettable! I loved it so much that I even bought some as a souvenir!" — October 2025.
"The explanations of the dishes are clear, and the staff's proficiency in English is reassuring." — January 2026.

places.name: メッシタ パーネ エ ヴィーノ (Mescita Pane e Vino)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled dry-aged beef seasoned with salt, alongside homemade wheat bread, spring rolls, cake salé and pasta; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef steak restaurant that takes reservations only from guests who order a meat main (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 18:00–22:00, last entry 20:30; closed Sunday, with some irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservation only, and only for guests who order a meat main; parties of three or more take a course; no children under 15; foreign nationals must book online; the owner works alone and may not answer the phone (Tabelog). Expect waits when the room is full (May 2026). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, tables for 10 (Tabelog). Cards and Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). On Nishikikoji west of Muromachi; 3 min walk from exit 24 of Shijo / Karasuma stations (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishikikoji west of Muromachi — 3 min walk from Shijo / Karasuma stations
places.cuisine: One-man steak and wine bar: dry-aged black wagyu from the Shiga butcher Sakaeya grilled slowly over binchotan, natural wine, organic vegetables from the owner’s family home in Shiga, and homemade natural-yeast bread of Hokkaido wheat (Tabelog) · a ¥6,800 course (May 2026), 250 g and three-cut tastings (June–July 2026) · appetisers such as Hikone pickles, cake salé, firefly squid, roasted onions, caprese, grilled new onions with Manganji-pepper cashew sauce, meat and cheese spring rolls, onion bread (2026 reviews) · pastas: fermented butter and sheep cheese, cheese, Cagliostro-style meatball (2026 reviews) · affogato (2026 reviews) · bills about ¥10,000–14,999 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Steak and natural wine · Nishikikoji, a one-man counter] A 16-seat room near Shijo Karasuma where the owner, working alone, grills dry-aged black wagyu from Shiga's Sakaeya over binchotan and pours natural wine. Appetisers, onion bread and a rich cheese pasta round out the meal; a course was ¥6,800 in May 2026 and most bills run ¥10,000–15,000. Reservation only — a meat main is required, no under-15s, and foreign nationals book online. With one person cooking, be ready to wait. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who runs the shop alone
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: "Operated by a single owner, please note that there may be times when the phone is not answered"; dry-aged black wagyu from the Shiga butcher Sakaeya is grilled slowly over binchotan, with organic vegetables from the owner’s family home in Shiga and natural wines. Reviewers in 2026: "the owner runs the place alone" (May 2026), "the owner seems to be managing everything alone" (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Dry-aged beef over binchotan; cheese pasta.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner asked about the steak knife and learned it was developed with a renowned product designer.
"Since the owner runs the place alone, I think it’s best to go with a relaxed mindset and be prepared to wait a bit." — May 2026.
"The onion bread that came afterward was especially amazing! (I ended up asking for a second helping.)" — June 2026.
