places.name: 割烹 梅津 (Kappou Umetsu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo à la carte and omakase with dashi, sesame dressings, soba, fried conger eel, kakiage, beef cutlet and nama-fu; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-centred kappo of sashimi, grilled river fish, shellfish, horse sashimi and dashi dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday and holidays 12:00–14:00 (lunch by reservation only) and 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Omakase of about 10 dishes, and à la carte from January 2026; for à la carte parties of four or more, appetisers and sashimi are prepared ahead (Tabelog). 21 seats: an 11-seat counter and private rooms upstairs, including a tatami room (room fee ¥1,000); private hire possible; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley in Gion north of Shijo; 4 min walk from exit 9 of Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo, in an alley — 4 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion kappo cooking seasonal fish and vegetables over charcoal and in a brick oven, with a long sake list (Tabelog) · omakase of about 10 dishes, ¥11,500 in May 2025 — e.g. Kamigamo vegetables, firefly squid nuta, chawanmushi, toro and surf-clam sashimi, young Lake Biwa ayu (May 2025) · matsutake soup, sea urchin and octopus sashimi, salt-grilled ayu, soba with yuzu, fried conger eel, Kamo eggplant and charcoal-grilled wagyu fillet, chirimenjako rice with clam miso soup (August 2026) · à la carte: three-shellfish platter, horse sashimi, karasumi mochi, corn kakiage (July 2026), grilled shirako, beef cutlet (February 2026), honmoroko (April 2026), saba sushi, white-shrimp tempura (October 2026) · bills about ¥15,000–19,999 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion alley, à la carte by the counter] A hidden kappo down a Gion alley, opened by chef Naoto Umetsu after heading the kitchen at Kappou Nakagawa in Gion. Seasonal fish and vegetables go over charcoal and into a brick oven, and horse sashimi nods to the owner's Kumamoto roots. Take the omakase of about ten dishes or, since January 2026, order à la carte at the 11-seat counter; rooms are upstairs. Regulars love it; one October 2025 visitor found it cool to outsiders and the food average. Lunch by reservation. Closed Sunday.

roles: A second chef in the kitchen (October 2026)
chef_bio.origin: Kumamoto (July 2026 review: "the owner is from Kumamoto").
chef_bio.background: An August 2026 reviewer: Naoto Umetsu, head chef at Kappou Nakagawa in Gion, opened this restaurant some years ago, and some tableware comes from a renowned kaiseki house. Per Tabelog, a special brick oven and charcoal are used for seasonal fish and vegetables; à la carte orders began in January 2026. An October 2026 diner saw two chefs in the kitchen, including the head chef.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal fresh ingredients, cooked to bring out the natural flavour (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled fish; horse sashimi; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular, on a 23rd visit, was touched that white rice was cooked in a clay pot just for a husband who loves rice to finish.
"Choosing dishes through conversation rather than a menu is truly the best way to enjoy traditional Japanese cuisine. The chef secretly prepared the last of the season's Honmoroko" — April 2026.
"Overall, I think it’s a decent izakaya, but it feels a bit unwelcoming to outsiders. The food is honestly just average." — October 2025.
An October 2026 diner found the head chef not very talkative but the service attentive, down to being seen out at the door.

A March 2026 diner took leftover chicken home and paid a small fee for the container.

UnionPay; PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). At Rokkaku and Tominokoji; 8 min from Karasuma, Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae or Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; December 2024).
places.neighborhood: Rokkaku and Tominokoji — 8 min from Karasuma or Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Izakaya for aged sashimi and sake: the "tsukuri-mori" platter of usually five fish mixes fresh fish from Maizuru, Iki and Kochi with aged sashimi; obanzai and small dishes on a dashi of kombu soaked a day, simmered four hours and finished with bonito, such as dashi-simmered then fried daikon; nama-fu and nama-yuba dishes; about 30 sake chosen by the owner, including Jikon and Juyondai, and about five off the menu (Tabelog) · set menus with tempura and sushi: Kyoto set ¥7,700, eel kabayaki set ¥8,800, wagyu set ¥9,900 (Tabelog) · reviewers single out Camembert grilled with saikyo miso, fried fish scales, cod milt, and a seasonal 8-dish kaiseki with 90 min of drinks at ¥10,000 (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Aged sashimi & sake · Rokkaku-Tominokoji] A stylish izakaya with counter seats around a small courtyard, built on two things: sashimi platters mixing fresh and aged fish, and about 30 sake chosen by the owner — half price on Thursdays, per regulars. Don't miss the saikyo-miso grilled Camembert. Around ¥6,000–8,000; ¥500 starter. Open to 23:00; closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed in the sources; chooses the sake)
chef_bio.background: Opened 22 May 2018 (Tabelog). Per the operator: fish sent direct from places such as Maizuru, Iki and Kochi, served fresh and aged; dashi from kombu soaked for a day and simmered four hours, finished with bonito flakes.
chef_bio.specialty: Tsukuri-mori of fresh and aged fish; saikyo-miso grilled Camembert.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 third-timer found the aged sashimi "a matter of personal preference" — creamy, unusual and sweet — and the Thursday half-price sake kept the bill low.
In August 2025 the place was "lively with many international guests", though some dishes a traveller wanted had run out.
A November 2025 diner's one request: fix the wobbly chair legs.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 熟成刺身と旨い酒 ひとしお、居酒屋・海鮮・日本酒バー、中京区大黒町88 シルブープレビル 1F、17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:15)、火曜休み、お付き出し500円 (コースは不要、元旦から3日は1,500円)、18席、中庭を望むカウンター個室、テーブルは3名から、未成年は原則不可、2018年5月22日オープン、名物つくり盛り (舞鶴、壱岐、高知などからの鮮魚と熟成刺身)、昆布を一日水に浸けて4時間炊き鰹節を合わせる出汁、大根の揚げ出汁、生麩や生湯葉、店主が選ぶ日本酒約30種、京都セット7,700円、鰻蒲焼セット8,800円、黒毛和牛セット9,900円。口コミ (2023年6月〜2026年8月、英語): カマンベールの西京味噌焼き、木曜日は日本酒半額、鱗の唐揚げ、白子、熟成刺身。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online ahead; one drink and one dish each; ¥500 starter; adults only by default.

places.name: 俵屋旅館 (Tawaraya Ryokan)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kaiseki dinners and Japanese or Western breakfasts; no gluten information (2023–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: kaiseki of fish such as sea bream and ayu, duck hot pot and dashi; no vegan or vegetarian information in the sources (2023–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: A ryokan: check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00; open all year (Tabelog). Dinner from 18:30 and breakfast from 8:00, Japanese or Western, served in the guest room (June 2026 review). The sources found describe meals only as part of a stay; no source shows meals for non-guests. Bento can be ordered ahead or on the day of a stay, but not collected on Tuesdays; no corkage on brought wine or drinks (Tabelog). Book by phone 075-211-5566 or through travel agents (Tabelog; September 2023). Rooms with tatami and sunken seating; Tabelog lists smoking as allowed; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Fuyacho north of Aneyakoji, across the street from Hiiragiya; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; June 2026).
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho north of Aneyakoji, opposite Hiiragiya — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki for staying guests, served in the room: e.g. ayu grilled on bamboo leaves over hot stones (June 2026), duck hot pot (March 2026) · breakfast: yudofu warmed over charcoal, a choice of grilled or dried fish such as guji, salmon or aji, kinpira of lotus root, chirimen-jako, pickles and miso soup; or a Western breakfast of croissants, eggs and bacon (2023–24 reviews) · warabi mochi with tea on arrival (2023 and 2025 reviews) · New Year osechi with white-miso zōni, for which a regular waited on a waitlist (January 2024) · bills ¥60,000–100,000-plus per person including the stay (2023–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Ryokan kaiseki · Fuyacho, a grand old Kyoto inn] One of Kyoto's most famous inns, across the street from Hiiragiya, with garden views and art in every room. Its kaiseki dinners and celebrated breakfasts (charcoal-warmed yudofu) come with a stay, roughly ¥60,000–100,000+ a head; we found no source for dining without staying. Reviews are split: some call the food exceptional, others average.

roles: Cook named by a March 2026 reviewer
chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a long-established inn dating to the Edo period (May 2025), often called one of Kyoto's three great ryokan (2023–24 reviews); scrolls and ornaments in the rooms, with a list explaining them (April 2023).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto kaiseki; breakfast yudofu.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular wrote it is "worth coming here just to enjoy Mr. Kurokawa's cooking", but that the atmosphere had changed since skilled staff left.
A December 2023 guest found the food below expectations — the rice and dashi raised questions, and the breakfast fish was too dry to finish.
A January 2024 guest, waitlisted since early the previous year, got a 3 January slot for the New Year osechi, with the guest's own name on the chopstick wrappers.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 俵屋旅館、旅館・日本料理、中京区麩屋町通姉小路上ル中白山町278、京都市役所前駅から徒歩約5分、チェックイン15:00・チェックアウト11:00、年中無休、カード可、個室、持ち込み可 (持ち込み料なし)、弁当は事前または宿泊日に手配可 (火曜は受け取り不可)。口コミ (2023年4月〜2026年8月、英語): 京都三大旅館のひとつ、わらび餅とお茶の出迎え、朝食の湯豆腐、夕食は18時30分から、朝食は8時から和洋選択、鮎、鴨鍋、正月のおせちと白味噌の雑煮、料理が期待に届かないという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Meals come with a stay; book the room by phone or through an agent.

places.name: 御所東 うなしげ (Gosho Higashi Unashige)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Eel under a soy-based sauce on rice, eel chawanmushi, uzaku; no gluten information (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Booking preferably through Instagram (Tabelog). The eel is steamed after you order, so expect about 30 minutes; a November 2025 reviewer suggests phoning the order ahead. Cards and QR payments, no e-money; non-smoking (Tabelog). 7 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: East of the Imperial Palace (Gosho-higashi) — 7 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kanto-style eel — steamed, then grilled, soft and fluffy, with a lighter soy-leaning sauce — grilled at a central counter in a machiya-style room (2025–26 reviews) · unaju ¥5,200 for one eel (July and November 2025), large with 1.5 eels; kabayaki ¥4,000 (December 2024); a June 2025 reviewer says from ¥4,800 for a whole eel · uzaku ¥1,400, grilled liver ¥800, eel chawanmushi, nikogori (2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Unagi · east of the Imperial Palace] A calm machiya-style room where eel is cooked Kanto-style — steamed then grilled at the counter, soft and fluffy, with a restrained sauce. Unaju from about ¥5,200; the eel chawanmushi has fans. Each eel is steamed to order, so allow 30 minutes or phone ahead. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 March 2022 (Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer writes that the chef trained for many years at "Unakiku" before opening here.
chef_bio.specialty: Kanto-style unaju; eel chawanmushi.

anecdotes.text: A sixth-time visitor in April 2025 singled out the eel chawanmushi — pricey on its own, but "that good".
An October 2026 regular found upbeat rock playing, lighter than usual, and trusted the 30-minute wait for eel steamed to order.
A July 2025 visitor who usually eats unaju in Nihonbashi called this a new favourite.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 御所東 うなしげ、うなぎ、上京区新烏丸頭町180 グラスド御所、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩7分、火〜土 11:30〜15:00・17:30〜21:00、日月休み、予約はできれば Instagram で、カード・QR 可、禁煙、2022年3月1日オープン。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 関東風で蒸してから焼く、注文後に蒸すので約30分、鰻重5,200円、大 (1.5尾)、蒲焼4,000円、うざく1,400円、肝焼き800円、鰻入りの茶碗蒸し、煮こごり、町家風の店内の中央のカウンター、Unakiku で修業。

cultural_comfort.note: Book via Instagram; allow 30 minutes for the eel.

places.name: ORALE!
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tacos come on handmade corn tortillas, but the menu also has burritos and quesadillas, and sauces and soups are not described for gluten (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and a vegetable focus; reviewed fillings are pork, chicken, beef, shrimp, and bean with cheese (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30), dinner 17:00–20:30 (L.O. 19:50); closed Monday; lunch may end early when the tortillas run out; temporary closures posted on Google and Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; busy at weekend lunch (Tabelog; March 2026). No service charge (Tabelog, original text). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, 10 at tables, plus a terrace (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children welcome; takeaway and delivery via Demae-can, Uber Eats and Foodpanda (Tabelog). Near Nishiki, north from Shijo Stn exit 14 up Sakaimachi (Tabelog; April 2026). Opened 5 November 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi north of Shijo, near Nishiki — 291 m from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Mexican kitchen of handmade corn tortillas grilled one by one, house salsas and seasonal dishes; rare tequilas, Mexican wine and beer (Tabelog shop text) · Tres Tacos lunch ¥2,700 — three tacos with soup and a small salad (July 2025) · lunch sets around ¥2,000 with soup (November 2025) · suadero and carnitas tacos (August 2025), pork, chicken, and shrimp-avocado tacos (March–April 2026), taco set with mini taco rice (March 2026) · enchiladas, mole, quesadillas (bean and cheese), burritos, homemade tortilla chips with salsa and guacamole (2025–2026 reviews) · cilantro goes on the tacos (March 2026)
places.notes: [Mexican · Shijo-Sakaimachi, handmade corn tortillas] A small, cheerfully decorated Mexican restaurant up Sakaimachi from Shijo, around since 2014, where the corn tortillas are made and grilled by hand. Lunch sets come with a soup — the Tres Tacos with three heavily filled tacos was ¥2,700 in 2025 — and there are burritos, quesadillas, enchiladas and mole, plus tequila and Mexican beer. Portions are large; leftovers can be packed. Lunch can end early when the tortillas run out. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 5 November 2014. An April 2026 reviewer admired the female owner’s creative ideas and presentation.
chef_bio.specialty: Tacos on handmade corn tortillas.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner, there only because another restaurant was closed, had a first burrito, could not finish it, and had the rest packed to take away.
A July 2025 diner found each taco so heavily filled that it would make three elsewhere.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ORALE!、メキシコ料理、中京区八百屋町555 澤栄1F、四条駅14番出口から堺町通を北へ、烏丸駅から291m、火〜日 昼12:00〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)、夜17:00〜20:30 (L.O.19:50)、月曜休み、昼はトルティーヤがなくなり次第終了、予約可、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR可、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10、テラス)、禁煙、子ども可、テイクアウト・デリバリー、2014年11月5日オープン。店の紹介: 一枚ずつ焼く手作りトルティーヤ、オリジナルのサルサ、季節のメキシコ料理、テキーラ、メキシコのワインとビール。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): タコス3種のランチ2,700円、スープ付き、スアデロ、カルニタス、ブリトー、ケサディーヤ、エンチラーダ、モレ、パクチー入り。

cultural_comfort.note: Book for weekend lunch; large portions, takeaway of leftovers; cilantro on the tacos.

places.name: ワインと串揚げ こぱん 先斗町店 (Wine to Kushikatsu Kopan, Pontocho)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a kushiage restaurant — every skewer is breaded and deep-fried (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: skewers include beef fillet, braised pork, salmon and duck, fried in batter (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00, last entry 21:00, Monday and Thursday–Sunday; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted for the omakase course; same-day cancellations by phone (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥550 including a vegetable platter and dessert (Tabelog). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX; e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: 10 at the counter and tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, 3 min from Keihan Sanjo exit 6 (Tabelog). Opened 30 July 2004 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Sanjo — 3 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Creative kushiage fried one skewer at a time with wine chosen by a sommelier, using Kyoto ingredients (Safari group site; Tabelog) · omakase course of 12 skewers ¥4,620 or 16 skewers ¥6,160, served until you say stop; the special beef fillet skewer +¥638 (Tabelog) · skewers from about ¥500 à la carte (August 2026) · the menu changes monthly: yuba, braised pork, truffle-topped, salmon, duck skewers (2026 reviews) · vegetable platter and dessert with the ¥550 seat charge (Tabelog) · wine by the bottle at fair prices, beer (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kushiage · Kiyamachi-Sanjo, omakase skewers with wine] A stylish counter just south of Sanjo where kushiage are fried one at a time and brought hot until you say stop — 12 skewers for ¥4,620 or 16 for ¥6,160, with a beef fillet skewer as an extra. The skewers change monthly (yuba, braised pork, truffle) and pair with a fair-priced wine list, to jazz in the background. ¥550 seat charge brings a vegetable platter and dessert. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Run by the Safari group (Osaka); a woman reviewers took to be the owner runs the floor
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 30 July 2004. The Safari group site lists ワインと串揚げ こぱん with shops in Naha and Pontocho, among the group’s 13 concepts in Kansai and Seattle.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase kushiage; beef fillet skewer.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular asked to skip a few skewers so as to reach the end of the course, and was given braised pork and others not tried before.
A March 2026 diner named a cucumber allergy, yet was served vegetable sticks with cucumber.
A May 2026 diner found the skewers arrived faster than a drinker could keep up with, and the plate overflowed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ワインと串揚げ こぱん 先斗町店、串揚げ・居酒屋・ワインバー、中京区木屋町三条下ル材木町180-1 1F、京阪三条駅6番出口から徒歩3分、月・木〜日 17:00〜22:00 (最終入店21:00)、火・水休み、予約可、おまかせ12本4,620円、16本6,160円、特選牛フィレ串は1本638円追加、席料550円 (野菜盛り合わせ・デザート付き)、カード・電子マネー可、20席、禁煙、子ども可、2004年7月30日オープン。サファリグループのサイト: 創作串あげ専門店、京の食材、ソムリエが選ぶワイン、那覇店と先斗町店。口コミ (2026年、英語): 毎月替わる串、湯葉、豚の角煮、トリュフ、ジャズ、ワインが手ごろ。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥550 seat charge; say when to stop the skewers; state allergies clearly (one slip reported in March 2026).

places.name: 魚河岸 宮武 (Uogashi Miyatake)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Fish courses of sashimi, grills, simmered dishes and sushi, including tempura and fried cod, which are not gluten-free (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses with dashi soups (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 22:30), Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and holidays; no lunch at present (Tabelog; official site). Reservations by phone 14:00–22:00 (official site); Tabelog: phone bookings for 1–2 guests (seats only), courses booked online for 3 or more. Evenings are course-based (December 2025; September 2026). Cards, IC cards and QR accepted (Tabelog). 34 seats: 10 at the counter, 24 in a sunken-hearth tatami room for 2–24 (Tabelog; official site). Non-smoking; wheelchair access (Tabelog). Junior-high age and up only (Tabelog). In Shimabara next to the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market, 3 min from JR Tambaguchi Stn; no sign outside (official site). Opened 1 October 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shimabara, by the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market — 3 min from JR Tambaguchi Stn
places.cuisine: Open-kitchen fish izakaya aiming at “ryotei-class seasonal fish as an izakaya,” with the counter level with the chopping board (official site) · courses ¥6,000 and ¥9,900 (October 2025; July–September 2026) · sashimi of akou, amadai, ojisan and others; buri grilled with shio-koji; scallops with garlic and basil; simmered kinmedai head; cod fry; mozuku soup; omakase sushi and a small dessert (July–August 2026) · autumn: shrimp and persimmon with tofu dressing, grilled fugu, seiko crab, steamed kinmedai with turnip, cod-milt tempura, clam soup (November 2025) · marinated mackerel (September 2026) · mini seafood bowl to finish (December 2025) · a broad sake list
places.notes: [Fish izakaya · Shimabara, the market’s back door] An unsigned izakaya in old Shimabara beside Kyoto’s Central Wholesale Market, where the cooks work at a counter level with your plate and the fish comes from a trusted market wholesaler. Evenings are courses — ¥6,000 or ¥9,900 — that change completely between visits: rare sashimi such as akou and ojisan, shio-koji yellowtail, simmered kinmedai head, cod fry, omakase sushi. Lunch has stopped for now. Closed Sunday and holidays; junior-high age and up.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in Shimabara next to the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market as a sign-less open-kitchen izakaya, buying through the market wholesaler 河市水産. Tabelog gives the opening as 1 October 2012. December 2025 and September 2026 reviewers note the popular lunch has stopped and evenings run on courses.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal fish close to ryotei standard at izakaya prices, served in the spirit of ichigo ichie (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fish courses; omakase sushi.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor booked a hotel five or six minutes away purely to eat here, and phoned to book the ¥6,000 course.
An August 2026 regular had the same ¥6,000 course twice and found the dishes completely different, opening with sashimi of akou and ojisan.
A February 2026 visitor stopped in after training at the Kyoto Railway Museum.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 魚河岸 宮武、京都中央卸売市場に隣接する島原の看板のない大人の隠れ家、オープンキッチンの居酒屋、「料亭クラスに限りなく近い旬の魚料理を居酒屋として」、カウンターとまな板を同じ高さに、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、日曜・祝日休み、予約は電話 (14:00〜22:00)、カウンター10席、座敷24席、主要仕入先 河市水産、JR丹波口駅から徒歩3分。食べログ: 下京区西新屋敷下之町6-5 アンクル島原1F、昼の営業は休止中、カード・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙、車椅子可、中学生以上、2012年10月1日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 6,000円と9,900円のコース、あこう、おじさん、ぶりの塩麹焼き、金目鯛のかぶと煮、鱈フライ、おまかせ握り、締め鯖。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone (courses online for 3 or more); no sign outside; junior-high age and up.

places.name: 丸太町十二段家 (Marutamachi Junidan Ya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Ochazuke sets of rice, pickles, dashimaki and red-miso soup; the pickles and miso are not described for gluten (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashimaki of egg and bonito-kombu dashi in every set; some sets add fish (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30), dinner 17:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:30); closed Wednesday and over New Year; open until sold out; other irregular closures, posted on the site — closed on 6 November 2026 (official site; Tabelog). No reservations (official site), except the second-floor shabu-shabu rooms, whose bookings resumed in September 2026 (official site notice). Queues in autumn — nearly an hour for the second seating in November 2026. Cards and e-money accepted; Apple Pay; no QR (Tabelog). 22 seats on the first floor at tables and low round tables; Tabelog notes only the first floor open with a limited menu (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). On Marutamachi west of Karasuma, at the southwest corner of the Imperial Palace grounds, 2 min from Marutamachi Stn exit 4 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Marutamachi west of Karasuma, by the Imperial Palace — 2 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: “Everyday Kyoto cuisine”: the original ochazuke house, a light meal of rice, pickles and sides (official site) · Suzushiro set ¥1,500 — dashimaki, red-miso soup, rice in a wooden tub for about two bowls, assorted seasonal pickles, hojicha (official site; July–September 2026) · Mizuna set with a seasonal simmered dish; a set with sea bream nanban (2026 reviews) · dashimaki of two eggs and a strong first dashi of Makurazaki katsuobushi and Rishiri kombu, made from 4 a.m. (official site) · pickles from contract and local farms, some homemade nukazuke; Ippodo hojicha (official site; July 2026) · shuanyangrou (beef shabu-shabu), wagyu steak, tuna sashimi (official site)
places.notes: [Ochazuke · Marutamachi, Kyoto’s everyday meal since the Taisho era] An old machiya by the Imperial Palace serving “ochazuke” in the Kyoto sense — a modest meal. The Suzushiro set (¥1,500, lunch or dinner) brings a feather-light rolled omelette made with a dashi started at 4 a.m., red-miso soup, a tub of rice and seasonal pickles, with Ippodo hojicha for the ochazuke. No reservations and queues in autumn; dinner ends early, at 19:00. Staff greet in soft Kyoto dialect and speak English. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: an ochazuke house in business since the Taisho era. It began as a sweets shop in Gion named Junidanya after the twelve acts of Chushingura; ochazuke served to settle the palates of tipsy customers proved so popular that it has continued ever since. The site lists TV and press coverage and a 2025 article recalling 長嶋茂雄 as a patron.
chef_bio.philosophy: Ochazuke as Kyoto cuisine in everyday dress — plain food that cannot hide anything; local and contract-farm vegetables, Ippodo tea (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Dashimaki; the Suzushiro ochazuke set.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 sightseer sent by a taxi driver got a table straight away, and on leaving was waved off by the kitchen staff with "Enjoy your trip in Kyoto!"
A November 2026 visitor arrived five minutes before opening, still landed in the second seating, and waited nearly an hour — good food, not worth that wait.
A September 2026 regular noticed many visitors from abroad and staff who spoke fluent English.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 丸太町十二段家、中京区常真横町184-3 (丸太町通両替町西入)、大正から続くお茶漬けの老舗、もとは祇園町の甘党屋で歌舞伎の忠臣蔵十二段にちなむ屋号、酔客の口直しのお茶漬けが始まり、元祖お茶漬け、すずしろ (だし巻き、赤だし、ご飯、季節のお漬物盛り合わせ)、枕崎の鰹本節と利尻昆布の一番だしのだし巻き、毎朝4時から出汁、契約農家と地元の野菜、一保堂のほうじ茶、涮牛肉と和牛ステーキ、昼11:30〜14:00、夜17:00〜19:00、水曜休み、予約不可、2026年11月6日は臨時休業、しゃぶしゃぶ2階個室の予約再開 (2026年9月)。食べログ: 22席、カード・電子マネー可、禁煙、子ども可、現在は1階のみで品数を限定。口コミ (2026年、英語): すずしろ1,500円、ふわふわのだし巻き、京言葉の接客、英語を話すスタッフ、秋は行列。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff (September 2026); no reservations, queue in busy seasons.

places.name: Taku Sando Sanjo
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every sandwich is on house shokupan milk bread, and the katsu and croquettes are coated in panko (Sanjo menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the two vegetarian sandwiches (potato croquette, egg salad) still use milk bread and karashi-mustard mayo; the fries carry a fish-and-vegetable dashi furikake (Sanjo menu). Shiso edamame is marked vegetarian — ask.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 12:00–17:00 (food L.O. 16:30); schedule changes are posted on Google Maps. Tabelog says reservations are not taken, but a December 2025 diner booked ahead and a January 2026 diner booked through Tabelog; a February 2026 diner found the counter filling up at 1 pm on a Saturday and suggests booking at weekends. 12 counter seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR accepted; take-out; English menu and English-speaking staff; children welcome with a kids menu (Tabelog). Opened 15 October 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Downtown, just south of Sanjo-dori — 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn and Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese katsu and egg sandwiches on house shokupan milk bread, from a Brooklyn sandwich shop, with a sake bar counter · pork katsu or chicken katsu (breast and thigh) sando ¥1,500, potato-croquette or egg-salad sando ¥1,300, Japanese beef fillet katsu sando ¥4,000, matcha-strawberry sando ¥850, dashi fries ¥600 (Sanjo menu) · sake by the glass chosen by the owner-sommelier (Sanjo menu)
places.notes: [Sandwiches · downtown, Brooklyn katsu sando with sake] A twelve-seat counter south of Sanjo, the Kyoto outpost of a Brooklyn sando shop ("HELLO, Kyoto! WE ARE FROM BROOKLYN"), with a second Kyoto shop at Kiyomizu. Freshly fried pork or chicken katsu with cabbage and house sauce on milk bread, ¥1,500; egg-salad sando ¥1,300; beef fillet katsu ¥4,000. Portions are big — several diners took half home — and one found the sauce about to spill out. Sake picked by the owner-sommelier. English menu and staff; many overseas customers. Daily 12:00–17:00.

chef_bio.chef_name: Sakaki Nakamura (owner and sommelier, per the Sanjo menu; name known only in Latin letters)
roles: Owner and sake sommelier (Sanjo menu: "Sakaki Nakamura, the owner/sommelier, curates fine sake from all over Japan")
chef_bio.background: Taku Sando began in Greenpoint, Brooklyn (29 Greenpoint Ave), "brought to you by the creative team of Takumen in LIC", around a shokupan milk bread baked in-house daily (takusando.com About page). The Kyoto site lists two Kyoto shops, Sanjo and Kiyomizu, beside Brooklyn; the Sanjo menu is headed "HELLO, Kyoto! WE ARE FROM BROOKLYN." The Sanjo shop opened on 15 October 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: From the Brooklyn About page: the shokupan "represents a wholesome luxury, and is the heart of the meal".
chef_bio.specialty: Pork katsu sando; chicken katsu sando; tamago sando.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner who does not like thigh meat asked for chicken katsu of breast only, and a friend switched to all thigh; the staff obliged.
"The sandwich was packed with tonkatsu and cabbage, and the sauce was about to spill out." — April 2026; the diner ate half and took the rest away.
An August 2025 diner found all the other customers were from overseas.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (takusandokyoto.com): Taku Sando Kyoto、京都の店舗は Sanjo (海老屋町327) と Kiyomizu (英語表記 4 Chome-148-3 Kiyomizu)、ほかにブルックリン店。三条のメニュー (英語 PDF): Ton-Katsu Sando 1,500円、Chicken-Katsu Sando 1,500円 (むねともも)、Classic Korokke Sando 1,300円 (ベジタリアン)、Tamago Sando 1,300円 (ベジタリアン)、Japanese Beef Fillet Katsu Sando 4,000円、Matcha Strawberry Sando 850円、Kids Sando 900円、Dashi Fries 600円 (魚と野菜のだしのふりかけ)、Shiso Edamame 700円 (ベジタリアン)、日本酒グラス100ml 900円、オーナー兼ソムリエ Sakaki Nakamura が全国の日本酒を選ぶ、"HELLO, Kyoto ! WE ARE FROM BROOKLYN"。ブルックリン店のサイト: Takumen (LIC) のチームによる店、毎日店で焼く食パンが主役。食べログ: サンドイッチ・日本酒バー、中京区御幸町通三条下ル海老屋町327、毎日12:00〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、予約不可、カウンター12席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、テイクアウト、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、子供メニュー、2024年10月15日オープン。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年4月、英語): 卵サンド、揚げたてのカツ、量が多く半分持ち帰り、客は海外からの人が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); take-out available.

places.name: 秀蛸 (Hide Tako)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki are wheat-batter balls; sauces include Worcester-style sauce, soy and demi-glace (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every takoyaki holds octopus, with mayonnaise and cheese toppings (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–04:00 (L.O. 03:30); Sun and holidays 18:00–03:00 (L.O. 02:30); irregular closing days. No reservations. 13 counter seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog). No cards or QR; e-money accepted (Tabelog). Take-out (Tabelog). Toppings such as green onion and mayonnaise cost extra (November 2025).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo, ground floor of a building on Hanamikoji — 310 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Late-night takoyaki bar · 17 kinds of takoyaki, 8 for ¥800 (June 2025); half-and-half of two flavours +¥50 (June and November 2025) · sauce, salt, soy, pizza sauce with cheese, demi-glace, seaweed kimchi, green onion with wasabi (2025–2026 reviews) · beef tendon stew, gizzard with pepper; sake, shochu, beer, champagne (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Takoyaki · Gion, until 4 am] A thirteen-seat L-shaped counter under red lanterns on the ground floor of a club building on Hanamikoji, frying takoyaki till 4 am; diners say it has been there 20 years, with a second-generation owner greeting passers-by. Eight crisp-shelled, gooey balls for ¥800 in seventeen flavours — sauce, salt, pizza, seaweed kimchi — plus half-and-half; champagne and sake beside the beer. One diner found the beer glass small; another felt chilly in the half-open room in autumn and a little intimidated by the street at night. Smoking allowed. Cash or e-money.

roles: Second-generation owner (January 2026 review); not named in a source
chef_bio.background: The shop blog (ameblo, last updated 2012) calls 秀蛸 a takoyaki shop born in Kyoto, with a Gion main shop and a Kiyamachi shop; a February 2012 post mentions staff from all three shops of the time. Tabelog lists the Gion shop and a Kiyamachi shop today. A June 2025 diner and a January 2026 diner say it has been running for 20 years; the January 2026 diner calls the energetic young owner the second generation.
chef_bio.specialty: Takoyaki in many sauces, with half-and-half plates.

anecdotes.text: "The energetic young owner, the second generation, has been running this place for 20 years, and it shows in the warm greetings exchanged with passersby." — January 2026.
A couple staying nearby came past 10 pm when hunger struck and were squeezed in at the busy counter (April 2026).
"The beer was served in a small glass and I finished it quickly." — April 2026; the beef tendon stew was the highlight.
A November 2025 diner found the half-open room chilly on an autumn night, and the street, lined with clubs, a little intimidating.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 店のブログ (ameblo、2012年まで更新): 祗園「秀蛸」、京都生まれのたこ焼き屋、祇園本店と木屋町店、2012年2月の記事に「秀蛸３店舗の全メンバー」。食べログ: たこ焼き、東山区清本町353-1 花見小路ビル1F、祇園四条駅から310m、月〜土 18:00〜翌4:00 (L.O. 3:30)、日・祝 18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O. 2:30)、不定休、予約不可、13席、喫煙可、カード・QR不可、電子マネー可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年6月、英語): 8個800円で17種類、ハーフ&ハーフ+50円、ソース・塩・ピザ・デミグラス・海苔キムチ・ねぎとわさび、牛すじ煮込み、砂肝、日本酒とシャンパン、20年続く店、2代目の若い店主、外のような席で秋の夜は寒い、ビールのグラスが小さい。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk-in counter; point at the flavour list; friendly staff (2025–2026 reviews).

places.name: また吉 (Matakichi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information: dinner is pasta, bruschetta and a veal cutlet beside carpaccio and charcoal-grilled meat; lunch sets are simmered fish or teriyaki wagyu with miso soup (official menu). Course changes for allergies must be phoned in ahead, not on the day (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Lunch sets and dinner dishes use fish, beef, pork or cheese (official menu); the shaved-ice syrups are fruit, matcha or brown sugar, with condensed milk as an extra topping.
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 12:00–16:00 (drinks and shaved ice only after 14:00; lunch 12:00–14:00, shaved ice 12:00–16:00), dinner 17:00–21:00, irregular closing days; reservations by phone. Tabelog lists 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00. Official site: counter of 7 and tables for 5 and 2; cards and QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, d Barai, Merpay, Alipay, WeChat Pay), cash not accepted. Tabelog: 19 seats (8 counter, 11 table), a private room for 4; children 13 and up; non-smoking; course allergy changes by phone in advance only. Dinner prices exclude 10% tax (official menu).
places.neighborhood: Gion south side, just off Hanamikoji — 6 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Casual sister of the two-Michelin-star Gion Matayoshi · lunch sets: simmered fish with herring, kombu, a small hot pot of fried tofu and Kyoto vegetables and beef soup in white miso ¥2,980, or teriyaki Ishigaki wagyu ¥5,000 (official menu) · shaved ice of Nikko natural ice: matcha ¥2,300, strawberry, pineapple or brown sugar with kinako ¥1,500, fig or mango ¥2,000 (official menu) · Italian à la carte on Japanese tableware at night: sea-urchin aglio e olio ¥3,500, Ishigaki wagyu Bolognese ¥2,500, veal cutlet ¥3,300, charcoal-grilled wagyu rump ¥4,200 (official menu, tax extra) · earlier reviews: sea-bream chazuke set (2025–2026), lunch mini-course and ¥6,000 course (July 2026)
places.notes: [Italian & shaved ice · Gion south, Matayoshi's casual sister] The casual sister of Gion Matayoshi, also on the south side of Gion, behind a patterned block lattice: by day a fish or wagyu lunch tray and natural-ice kakigori with house syrups, by night Italian à la carte on kaiseki plates — sea-urchin aglio e olio, wagyu Bolognese, veal cutlet. Diners in 2025–2026 praised sea-bream chazuke, rich matcha ice and warm send-offs; others found a ¥1,800 matcha ice average (July 2026), slow drinks with two staff (July 2026), and food average with uneven pacing and few drinks (October 2026). No cash.

roles: Sister shop of 祇園又吉 (official site); the chef is not named
chef_bio.background: The 祇園又吉 site announced the new shop また吉 on 1 August 2021; Tabelog reviews go back to January 2025. The また吉 site itself says it was born in October 2026, serving Italian with the same chosen ingredients and preparation as the main restaurant plus natural-ice shaved ice at casual prices; an August 2026 diner mentions a recent renovation, and an October 2026 diner calls it still new. A July 2026 diner writes that the owner hails from Okinawa. Natural ice from 四代目徳次郎 in Nikko (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「もっと軽い気持ちで、本物の味を楽しんで欲しい」 — "We want people to enjoy the real thing, with a lighter heart."
chef_bio.specialty: Natural-ice kakigori; Italian à la carte on Japanese tableware; lunch trays.

anecdotes.text: A diner brought an elderly mother for the chazuke lunch in June 2026 and found the staff kind and the meal comfortable for older guests.
"At JPY 1,800, it was on the expensive side, but both the quantity and flavor were just average." — matcha shaved ice, July 2026.
A September 2026 diner came only for a pineapple shaved ice, served with warm tea, and was seen off by several staff.
"Sometimes the dishes come out quickly, while at other times, they take an unusually long time." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: また吉の公式サイト (gion-matayoshi.com/matakichi): 祇園又吉がひらく気軽なもう一軒、「もっと軽い気持ちで、本物の味を楽しんで欲しい」、2026年10月に祇園町南側に生まれた、本店と同じ厳選食材や仕込みのイタリアンと天然氷のかき氷、花ブロックの格子が目印、祇園町南側570-120 万治ビル1階、昼12:00〜16:00 (14時からはドリンクとかき氷のみ)、夜17:00〜21:00、不定休、電話予約、カウンター7席・テーブル5名と2名、カードとバーコード決済のみで現金不可。メニュー: 魚御膳2,980円 (魚の炊いた物、鰊とおぼろ昆布、京のお揚げさんと京野菜の小鍋、牛汁 京白味噌仕立て、新潟村上産コシヒカリ、自家製浅漬け)、肉御膳5,000円 (石垣牛の照り焼き)、かき氷は日光・四代目徳次郎の天然氷 (究極の抹茶2,300円、濃厚いちご・石垣島のパイナップル・波照間黒糖蜜きな粉につぶあん1,500円、いちじく・木の芽・マンゴー2,000円、トッピング400円)、夜のアラカルト (塩水ウニのアーリオオーリオ3,500円、石垣牛のボロネーゼ2,500円、仔牛のカツレツ3,300円、石垣牛イチボの炭焼きタリアータ4,200円、抹茶ティラミス800円ほか、税別)。祇園又吉の公式サイト: 新店舗「また吉」開店のご案内 [2021.8.1]。食べログ: イタリアン・日本料理・かき氷、12:00〜15:00、17:30〜21:00、不定休、予約可、コースのアレルギー変更は事前に電話で、当日は不可、19席 (カウンター8、テーブル11)、個室4名、禁煙、13歳以上。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 鯛茶漬けの御膳、女将のもてなし、店主は沖縄出身、昼のミニコース、6,000円のコース、抹茶かき氷1,800円は普通、抹茶が濃い、改装、パイナップルのかき氷1,500円、スタッフ2人でドリンクが遅れる、料理は普通で出るのにむらがあり、飲み物が少ない。

cultural_comfort.note: Bilingual Japanese/English website and menu; bookings by phone; diners walked in for shaved ice (2026 reviews).

places.name: 祇園もりわき (Gion Moriwaki)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; courses end with the owner’s handmade 100% buckwheat soba (official site), served in a dashi-based kaiseki.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish kaiseki opening with freshly shaved bonito flakes, with sashimi, sweetfish, eel and dashi soups (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch, entry at 12:00 (booking required); dinner, entry 18:00–19:00 (booking required); closed Thursday and Friday lunch, other days irregular. Tabelog gives the same: Mon–Wed, Sat, Sun 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–19:00; Fri 18:00–19:00; Thu closed — the times are entry times, not closing times. Cash only (official site; April 2026). Lunch courses ¥7,000–18,000, dinner ¥12,000/15,000/18,000, plus tax and 10% service (official site). Cancellation: 100% the day before or on the day, 80% two days before, 50% three days before (official site). 10 seats: 6 counter, one table for 4; babies welcome; non-smoking with a smoking spot outside (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion south side, east of Hanamikoji — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki finished with the owner’s handmade 100% buckwheat soba (official site) · lunch ¥7,000–18,000, dinner ¥12,000–18,000 plus tax and service (official site) · dishes seen: brown-rice soup to start, freshly shaved bonito flakes, sea urchin and crab with egg-yolk vinegar, simmered abalone, hamo and matsutake soup, guji, sweetfish, grilled eel, sashimi of sea bream, tuna and squid (2025–2026 reviews) · Kyoto sake (March 2025)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion south, ten seats and handmade soba] A ten-seat kaiseki counter east of Hanamikoji, opened in 2014 and starred in the 2016 Michelin Guide (Tabelog). Courses start with a brown-rice soup and freshly shaved bonito, run through hamo, sweetfish and eel, and end with the owner’s own 100% buckwheat soba. An April 2026 couple found it rare for Gion: lightly seasoned, traditional Kyoto cooking from ¥12,000 at night, with the owners seeing them off. The site says no English is spoken — book through your hotel. Cash only. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Moriwaki (surname from the shop name; Tabelog gives a full name only in machine translation, so it is not used)
roles: Owner-chef (店主), per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a small ten-seat shop born in Gion in 2014, serving seasonal kaiseki that ends with the owner’s handmade 100% buckwheat soba. Tabelog (in its English translation): the chef trained at ryokans, sushi restaurants and other places, then at "Irifune" and "Gion Okada" before going independent; opened 28 August 2014; a Michelin star in the 2016 Michelin Guide, about a year after opening. A January 2025 diner was served by the head chef, the proprietress and another chef.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: to be a shop that always stays close by, for time alone or time with someone dear.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; handmade 100% buckwheat soba to finish.

anecdotes.text: "I had the handmade 100% buckwheat soba prepared by the owner himself." — March 2025, a second visit.
An April 2026 couple, after finding most well-known Gion dinners near ¥30,000, chose the ¥18,000 course here and were seen off by the owners after the meal.
An eighth-time regular notes that payment is cash only; a card is taken at booking only for cancellations (April 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-moriwaki.jp): 2014年に祇園町に10席だけの小さな店、四季折々の料理と店主の手打ち十割蕎麦を〆に会席料理、おひとりでの時間にも大切な方との時間にも寄り添える店、昼12時入店・夜18時〜19時入店 (要予約)、定休日は木曜日と金曜日の昼ほか不定休、祇園町南側570-177、昼7,000・9,000・12,000・15,000・18,000円、夜12,000・15,000・18,000円 (税別、サービス料10%)、支払いは現金、キャンセルは当日・前日100%・2日前80%・3日前50%、英語は話せないのでホテルのコンシェルジュから電話を、贈りもの (お土産)。食べログ: 日本料理、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル4名1卓)、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、夜のみサービス料10%、赤ちゃん可、2014年8月28日オープン、ミシュランガイド2016で一つ星 (食べログの紹介文)。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年10月): 玄米のスープから始まる、削りたての鰹節、雲丹と蟹の黄身酢、鮑、鱧と松茸、ぐじ、鮎、鰻、十割蕎麦で〆、大将と女将ともう一人の料理人、薄味の京料理、見送り。2026年6月の口コミ (日本語、9,000円の昼): 水無月豆腐とシマエビとウニ、鱧落としのお椀、焼いたびわ湖の鮎、鯛・本マグロ・ミルガイ・ケンサキのお造り。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site says no English is spoken and asks overseas guests to book by phone through their hotel concierge; online booking also offered.

places.name: 祇園 天ぷら晩餐 (Gion Tempura Bansan)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura counter — every course centres on battered, fried tempura and a tempura rice ball (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses open with wagyu tail soup and run through prawn, fish, sea urchin and wagyu tempura (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Dinner from 17:00 to 25:00 (last order 24:30) and lunch from 12:00, lunch by reservation made by the day before (official site). Tabelog gives lunch last entry 13:30 (reservation only, by the day before) and dinner last entry 21:00, courses only, booked by the day before; per the official site, à la carte is available after 21:00. Closed irregularly, sometimes without notice (Tabelog). Book ahead: 6 counter seats (Tabelog; official site; some reviewers counted about 8); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Staff spoke fluent English with foreign guests (September 2025). On the 1st floor of キャッスルギオンビル on a corner in Tominagacho, off the main street; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; December 2025). Opened 21 March 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Tominagacho in Gion, off Yamato-oji north of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal tempura courses at a six-seat counter (official site) · "Gion no Bansan" course ¥12,100 (lunch ¥11,000): wagyu tail soup, sashimi of the day, seared Kuroge wagyu, about ten tempura such as kuruma prawn, eggplant, sea urchin, shiitake, yuzu-marinated sawara, eel, clam, wagyu and tilefish, then a tempura rice ball, red miso soup and dessert · lighter course ¥7,700 (lunch ¥6,600) · lunch "tempura kaiseki" ¥3,300 (official site) · lunch tempura and kakiage bowl ¥3,300 (April 2026); kama-tama udon at lunch (October 2026) · fried in 100% cottonseed oil, per the chef (July 2026) · sake such as Tazaka, Yuki no Bijin, Suigei; Hakushu highballs; white wine
places.notes: [Tempura · Gion, a six-seat counter] A tiny tempura counter on a Gion corner, where one chef fries course after course in front of six guests. Dinner (¥7,700 or ¥12,100) starts with wagyu tail soup, sashimi and seared wagyu, then about ten seasonal pieces — kuruma prawn, aosa seaweed piled with sea urchin, Kamo eggplant, eel, young ayu in summer, a rare-fried wagyu — and ends with a tempura rice ball. Lunch from ¥3,300 is the value pick. Book by the day before. Run by the small Kyoto group 京色; reviewers like the quiet chef and the price for Gion.

roles: Head chef (not named) who runs the counter alone (June 2026); operator 株式会社京色
chef_bio.background: Per the operator site: 株式会社京色 was founded by its president 眞鍋 and the cooks 藤原 and 山内, who studied together at a cooking school and gained experience in Japanese, Western and creative cooking before reuniting; the company runs 5 Kyoto shops — うらやま京色, BANSAN 京色, 祇園 晩餐 京色, 祇園天ぷら晩餐 and 角打ちと麺 ばんさん. Per the official page: a counter of six seats, "the distance at which freshly fried tempura can be served without losing its taste." Opened 21 March 2021 (Tabelog). The chef told a July 2026 diner the oil is 100% cottonseed.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official page: tempura needs both fresh ingredients and the cook’s skill — no letting up from buying to the moment it is served.
chef_bio.specialty: Aosa tempura topped with sea urchin; wagyu tail soup; tempura rice ball.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner noted the head chef runs everything alone, keeping a comfortable distance without too much talk.
A March 2026 diner liked the yuzu-daikon palate cleanser so much as to ask for a second helping.
An April 2026 lunch guest found the tail soup tasty but small, and understandable for a ¥3,300 lunch.
A March 2026 diner found the space a bit cramped for groups of more than three.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyosyoku.com): 祇園天ぷら晩餐、京都祇園のカウンターのみの天ぷら専門店、カウンター6席は「揚げたての美味しさを逃さずお届けできる距離」、21:00以降はアラカルトも、旬の味覚をおひとり様ずつコースで、祇園の晩餐に12,100円コース (ランチ11,000円)、より気軽に7,700円コース (ランチ6,600円)、ランチ限定の天ぷら会席3,300円、ある日の例: 先付 テールスープ、本日の鮮魚の造り、国産黒毛和牛あぶり、天ぷら (車海老、茄子、雲丹、肉厚しいたけ、サワラゆず幽庵、コッペガニ、ウナギ、蛤、国産黒毛和牛、甘鯛)、天むす、赤出汁、デザート、東山区富永町112 キャッスルギオン、ディナー17時〜25時 (L.O. 24時30分)、ランチ12時〜 (前日迄の完全予約のみ)。株式会社京色: 社長 眞鍋、料理人 藤原・山内、食の専門学校で共に学ぶ、うらやま京色・BANSAN 京色・祇園 晩餐 京色・祇園天ぷら晩餐・角打ちと麺 ばんさん。食べログ: 天ぷら・居酒屋・日本料理、大和大路通四条上る富永町112 キャッスルギオンビル 1F、ランチ最終入店13:30、ディナー最終入店21:00 (コースのみ、前日までに予約)、不定休、6席 (カウンター)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可、2021年3月21日オープン。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 綿実油100%、英語が話せるスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff spoke fluent English with foreign guests (September 2025); book by the day before.

places.name: ぎおんの豚汁屋さん あだち家 (Gion no Tonjiru-yasan Adachiya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. An izakaya menu of miso pork soup, fried dishes, oden, Saikyo-miso fish and soy-seasoned plates; no gluten information is published (official menu; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature is pork miso soup, alongside horse sashimi, fish, fried chicken and oden; a few plates such as grilled shiitake or Tochio fried tofu with negi miso have no published ingredients (official menu; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–3:00 Monday to Saturday (last order 2:30); 17:00–24:00 on the day before a holiday (last order 23:30); closed Sunday, but open Sunday and closed Monday when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog; official site gives 18:00–3:00, closed Sunday). Cover charge ¥500 per person; bookings taken, with a 2-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). 18 seats: 8 at the counter and 2 tables, pairs usually at the counter; smoking allowed (Tabelog; official site; October 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Faces Kiritoshi in Gion, near Tatsumi Bridge; 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (official site; Tabelog; April 2026). Opened 26 November 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiritoshi in Gion, near Tatsumi Bridge — 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Late-night izakaya with the owner’s home-prefecture Niigata sake and dishes (official site) · Adachiya’s tonjiru (pork miso soup), with rice balls · Kumamoto horse sashimi, four kinds · Hokkaido shishamo · wagyu tendon stew · house roast beef · thick grilled Tokushima shiitake · Niigata Tochio jumbo fried tofu with natto, negi miso or mentaiko mayo · Niigata squid sashimi with mentaiko · Kyoto silver cod Saikyo-yaki · prawn fry with house tartare · chicken kara-age (curry, lemon soy or ponzu) (official menu) · tuna macaroni salad, nikujaga, oden in winter, sake-lees soup, half-size ikura bowl, bacon-wrapped quail eggs (2025–26 reviews) · Niigata sake such as Sasashiki, some off the list
places.notes: [Izakaya · Gion, Niigata sake till 3 a.m.] A small, smoky, late-night izakaya on Gion's Kiritoshi, run by an owner from Niigata. It pours Niigata sake — ask for the off-menu bottles — with a long list of homey plates: tuna macaroni salad, nikujaga, horse sashimi, giant Tochio fried tofu with negi miso, oden in winter, and the namesake pork miso soup to finish. Mostly locals, Showa pop on the speakers, ¥500 cover. Open until 3:00; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner, 大将 (the invoice holder; from Niigata)
chef_bio.background: The invoice register lists an individual, 安達 秀行, for the shop’s invoice number; the official site links the Instagram account adachihideyuki. Per the official site: a slightly hidden shop facing Kiritoshi in Gion, with sake and local dishes from the 大将’s home prefecture of Niigata alongside popular modern dishes. Reviewers describe an owner from Niigata (June and October 2025) and a master who sometimes drinks along with guests (April 2025). Opened 26 November 2013 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "空間、人、美味しさ" — the space, the people and good food; at-home and hidden at once.
chef_bio.specialty: Pork miso soup; Tochio fried tofu with negi miso; Niigata sake.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 guest ended up drinking with the tipsy master, with Showa pop on the speakers turning into a DJ session.
A June 2025 pair found the atmosphere between the chef and the owner a bit off, which made it hard to relax.
A January 2026 guest found the service from staff other than the owner lacking.
An April 2026 diner asked the owner for off-menu Niigata sake and liked the Sasashiki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-adachiya.com): ぎをんの豚汁屋さん あだち家、和風居酒屋、京都祇園の切通しに面する隠れ家、大将の故郷新潟県の地酒、郷土料理、東山区清本町368-4 セラヴィビル1F、18:00〜3:00、日曜定休、18席 (カウンター8席・テーブル2卓)、カード可、喫煙可、メニュー: 熊本直送 馬刺し4種盛り、北海道産 本ししゃも、和牛すじ煮込み、自家製ローストビーフ、徳島産 肉厚椎茸焼き、新潟特産 栃尾のジャンボ油揚げ (納豆・ネギ味噌・明太子マヨネーズ)、新潟産 イカ刺し明太子和え、男のポテトサラダ、京都産 銀鱈の西京焼き、海老フライ、国産鶏もも唐揚げ (カレー味・レモン醤油・おろし胡麻ポン酢)。食べログ: 郷土料理・日本酒バー・居酒屋、月〜土18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O. 2:30)、祝前日17:00〜24:00、日曜休み (月曜祝日なら日曜営業・月曜休み)、お通し代1人500円、混雑時2時間制、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2013年11月26日オープン、インボイス: 安達 秀行 (個人)。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年11月、英語): 新潟出身のオーナー、豚汁、マカロニサラダ、肉じゃが、おでん。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking allowed; ¥500 cover; mostly local regulars.

places.name: 京都三条 箔 (Kyoto Sanjo Haku)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Sukiyaki is cooked in the house warishita and kaiseki starters use dashi; the current menu publishes no gluten information. The operator once announced a gluten-free wagyu sukiyaki kaiseki for inbound guests (press release, now offline; per a search summary) — confirm it is still offered (official menu, November 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu sukiyaki and shabu-shabu kaiseki with dashi-based starters (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–22:00 (last entry 19:00); lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:00) Saturday, Sunday and holidays only; closed Tuesday (official site; Tabelog also lists Monday dinner). Reservation required; changes and cancellations at least 3 days ahead, 100% fee for cancelling the day before (Tabelog). Course prices on the site include tax and service; Tabelog lists a 10% service charge. Private-room fee ¥1,650 per person at dinner, ¥1,100 at lunch (official site); 2nd-floor hall ¥11,000 (Tabelog). 34 seats in private rooms (tables and sunken kotatsu), some over the Kamo River, with a terrace; designated smoking area; cards, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). English menu and staff; children welcome, with a ¥5,500 sukiyaki bento for children (Tabelog). Down a narrow stone path off Kiyamachi-dori north of Sanjo; 3 min from Sanjo Stn exit 7 (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi-dori north of Sanjo, on the Kamo River — 3 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Wagyu sukiyaki kaiseki cooked at the table by staff in the house warishita (official site) · dinner: wagyu sukiyaki kaiseki ¥24,500, Omi-beef sukiyaki ¥30,500, Omi-beef shabu-shabu with kombu dashi, house ponzu and sesame sauce ¥30,500 (book ahead), Kobe-beef sukiyaki ¥36,500, Omi-beef chateaubriand sukiyaki (limited) ¥42,500 — each with a starter, soup, the main, rice and dessert · weekend lunch: wagyu sukiyaki ¥12,100, wagyu and Omi-beef tasting ¥18,150, Omi-beef sukiyaki ¥24,200 (official menu, prices including tax and service) · Kobe and Omi beef tasting sukiyaki ¥38,500 over New Year 2025–26 (press release) · hamo and kakigori in summer (June 2026)
places.notes: [Sukiyaki · Kiyamachi, private rooms over the Kamo River] A sukiyaki house in private rooms down a stone alley off Kiyamachi, in the building where the Bakumatsu samurai Takechi Hanpeita lodged when it was the ryotei 四国屋丹虎; some rooms look over the Kamo River, one onto a tsukubai garden by Kazuyuki Ishihara. Staff cook wagyu, Omi or Kobe beef sukiyaki at the table in the house warishita, after seasonal kaiseki starters; dinner from ¥24,500, weekend lunch from ¥12,100, service included. Reviewers praise the rooms and the river terrace; one found the sukiyaki too light. Run by the Kobe-based G LION GROUP. Closed Tuesday.

roles: 料理長 (head chef, not named); operator G LION GROUP (Kobe; representative 菊地 秀武)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: wagyu sukiyaki kaiseki in a new style by a cook long experienced in traditional Japanese cuisine, made in front of guests with the house warishita; the building was the ryotei 四国屋丹虎 in the Bakumatsu era, where 武市半平太 lived when in Kyoto, and the tokonoma board and pillar of the 半平の間 are kept unchanged; a box-staircase trace from that era was found during renovation; tsubo-niwa garden supervised by the garden designer 石原和幸. Press releases name the operator as the G LION GROUP of Kobe (representative 菊地 秀武), whose recruitment site describes about 150 group companies, mostly car dealerships. Tabelog Hot Pot "Tabelog 100" 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: an out-of-the-ordinary sukiyaki experience — the seasons of Kyoto with all five senses.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu, Omi and Kobe beef sukiyaki kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 guest left something behind without noticing, and staff came outside to find the guest.
An April 2026 diner asked for a sake recommendation, was left waiting by a newer staff member and gave up, and found the meat cut thicker than liked.
A September 2026 diner, used to Kyushu-style sukiyaki, found the taste too light and refreshing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (haku.kyoto): 京都三条 箔、鴨川を望む個室で味わう和牛すき焼き会席、伝統的な日本料理を経験した料理人による新しいスタイルの和牛すき焼き会席、箔特製の割り下、スタッフが目の前で作る、世界的な庭園デザイナー石原和幸氏監修の坪庭、木屋町通に面する、武市半平太寓居之跡、幕末は四国屋丹虎という料亭、半平の間の床板と床柱、中京区木屋町通三条上る上大阪町528-3、三条駅より徒歩3分、12時〜15時 (最終入店13時) 土日祝のみ、17時〜22時 (最終入店19時)、火曜定休、お品書き: 和牛すき焼き会席24,500円、近江牛すき焼き会席30,500円、近江牛しゃぶしゃぶ会席30,500円 (要予約)、神戸牛すき焼き会席36,500円、近江牛シャトーブリアンすき焼き会席42,500円 (税サ込)、ランチ 和牛すき焼き12,100円・和牛と近江牛食べ比べ18,150円・近江牛すき焼き24,200円、個室料金 昼1,100円・夜1,650円。プレスリリース (さんたつ): GLION GROUP (兵庫県神戸市、代表取締役 菊地秀武) が運営、年末年始の神戸・近江牛食べ比べすき焼き会席38,500円。食べログ: すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ・日本料理、サービス料10%、34席 (テーブル24、掘りごたつ10)、個室、分煙、カード・Alipay・WeChat Pay、英語メニュー、持ち込み可、鍋 百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and staff (Tabelog); book ahead, cancellation fees apply.

places.name: 然花抄院 京都室町本店 (Zen Kashoin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The house sweets are paper-baked castella, dorayaki, cookies and Mont Blanc on castella; warabi mochi, ice cream and teas are also served, but no gluten information is published (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Castella and the egg sweets use eggs, and parfaits use cream and ice cream; Japanese teas and coffee are plant-based, but no ingredient list is published for the warabi mochi or other sweets (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00 daily, café last order 17:30; closed days posted on the store calendar (official site; Tabelog). No café bookings (official site). A Sunday 15:00 visitor in November 2026 found 5–6 groups waiting. 20 seats looking onto the inner garden; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Shop, café, gallery (Gallery SUGATA) and workshop in a wide-fronted townhouse dated 元禄十三年 (1700) on Muromachi-dori south of Nijo; 5–6 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn exit 2 (official site). Opened August 2009 (official site; Tabelog gives 8 August 2009). Fresh castella keeps about two days (October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Muromachi-dori south of Nijo — 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Paper-baked castella of Kyoto eggs and the house café in an old townhouse (official site) · 茶庭ノ膳: three castellas — matcha, egg-yolk "ranmitsu" and plain — with a drink ¥1,760 · 宝卵ノ膳: castella with custard, "Muromachi bolo" and hojicha ice cream, with a drink ¥1,650 · autumn 実ノ膳: Kumamoto chestnut Mont Blanc, chestnut castella, chestnut dorayaki and hojicha ice cream, with a drink ¥1,870 (to 30 November) · purple sweet-potato parfait with a drink ¥1,870 · autumn cream anmitsu with persimmon and Shine Muscat ¥1,870 (November) · grill-your-own mitarashi dango with a drink ¥1,870 (November–May) · "Zen" ice, two of hojicha, matcha or vanilla, with a drink ¥1,320 (official menu) · warabi mochi with a drink about ¥1,650 (October 2026) · drinks ¥880 alone: sencha, genmaicha, ume bancha, hojicha, kombu tea, matcha ¥990, bamboo-charcoal roast coffee, Okinawa Kanakawa black tea (official drinks) · take-away castella, zarame castella ¥702 (November 2026), dorayaki, rusks
places.notes: [Sweets & café · Muromachi, castella in a 1700 townhouse] The flagship of a castella maker in a broad-fronted Muromachi townhouse built in 1700, with an earthen entry, an old kamado and well, a gallery and a tearoom over an inner garden. Its paper-baked castella of Kyoto eggs comes as a three-piece tasting set with tea (¥1,760), and seasonal plates — chestnut Mont Blanc and dorayaki in autumn, grill-your-own dango in winter — come with a drink for about ¥1,870. No bookings; expect a queue at weekends. Run by 長崎堂 of Osaka, which also has a café in Shibuya Hikarie. Open daily 11:00–18:00.

roles: Operator 株式会社長崎堂 (Osaka; founded 1960; chairman 荒木 貴史); not a chef-led shop
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 然花抄院 opened its Kyoto Muromachi main store in August 2009 among old kimono merchants, with shop, café, gallery and workshop; the townhouse has a pillar inscribed with its building year, 元禄十三年, paving stones from the Kitano tram line, a well in the courtyard and kamado, and walls partly papered in karakami by 唐長; the name expresses hospitality with "a heart of flowers" and sweets in the true taste of each. The company page lists 株式会社長崎堂 (founded August 1960, capital ¥30 m) and two cafés, Kyoto Muromachi and Shibuya Hikarie ShinQs (opened April 2012), plus ZENKASHOIN gift shops in mass retailers and station and airport shops (official site). Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "花も、菓も、然るべき姿へ" — flowers and sweets, each in its proper form; serving things plainly, without affectation.
chef_bio.specialty: Paper-baked "Zen" castella; seasonal sweet plates with tea.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor was intimidated by the size of the entrance but relieved by the warm welcome, and found the chestnut plate fair value with a drink included.
An October 2026 visitor ordered warabi mochi but was most moved by the salty-sour ume bancha.
An October 2026 visitor wanted to take home lots of fresh castella but bought one, as it keeps only until the next day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (zen-kashoin.com): 京都室町御菓子司 然花抄院、2009年8月に京都室町通りに京都室町本店、物販・カフェ・ギャラリー・工房、建立元禄十三年の町家、北野行ちんちん電車の敷石、中庭や竃の井戸、唐長の唐紙、花ある心でおもてなし、「花も、菓も、然るべき姿へ」、茶寮「然カフェ」、中京区室町通二条下ル蛸薬師町271-1、11:00〜18:00 (喫茶17:30 L.O.)、喫茶の席の予約不可、烏丸御池駅2番出口より徒歩6分、渋谷ヒカリエ ShinQs店 (2012年4月)、ZENKASHOIN (ギフト商品、量販店・駅空港土産店)、お品書き: やきたてみたらし団子1,870円 (11月1日〜5月31日)、実ノ膳1,870円、お芋パフェ紫月夜1,870円、くりーむあんみつ秋1,870円、茶庭ノ膳1,760円、宝卵ノ膳1,650円、「然」アイス1,320円 (いずれもドリンク付)、煎茶・玄米茶・梅番茶・焙じ茶・昆布茶・京番茶880円、抹茶990円、竹炭焙煎コーヒー880円。会社概要: 株式会社長崎堂、1960年8月創業、資本金3,000万円、代表取締役会長 荒木貴史、和洋菓子の製造及び販売。食べログ: カフェ・和菓子・甘味処、20席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2009年8月8日オープン、運営: 長崎堂 (心斎橋)、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年11月、英語): ざらめカステラ702円。

cultural_comfort.note: No café bookings; weekend queues; sweets come as sets with a drink.

places.name: ベルギービール＆欧風料理 刻シラズ (Tokishirazu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Beer bar food — fries, pizza, pasta, risotto, carbonnade and course menus — alongside a long beer list; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Caprese, marinated vegetables and fries appear, but most dishes are mussels, meat, cheese and seafood (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 23:30); irregular closures, and private hire for parties (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Courses with all-you-can-drink, e.g. 9 dishes + 120 min for ¥4,400 (Tabelog); a ¥4,200 course with two drinks (November 2025). No service or table charge (Tabelog). 44 seats: 8 at the counter, 36 at tables; private hire 20–50+; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Third floor of プラネシア六角柳馬場, up a steep straight stair (November 2025); 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yanagibaba south of Rokkaku, 3rd floor — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Belgian beer bar with about 120 Belgian beers and European dishes mixing Belgian, Italian and Spanish cooking (Tabelog) · mussels steamed in white wine (in a Staub pot, with fries, or turned into pasta or risotto), beef-cheek carbonnade, waterzooi (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · sardine and tomato or shrimp and Brussels sprout ajillo, Bismarck pizza, carbonara, caprese, a three-deli platter, thick-cut fries, grilled beef (2025–2026 reviews) · Czech and German beers too — Pilsner Urquell, Weizen, Schöfferhofer, Hoegaarden White (2025–2026 reviews) · bills about ¥4,000–8,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Belgian beer · Yanagibaba Rokkaku, 120 Belgian beers] A big third-floor beer hall south of Rokkaku with about 120 Belgian beers plus Czech and German drafts, and generous European plates alongside: white-wine mussels with fries, beef-cheek carbonnade, ajillo, pizza and pasta. Courses with all-you-can-drink make it a party favourite, but there is a counter for two. The stairs are steep after a few beers; one guest found the tables cramped. Open nightly to midnight.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: one of the largest Belgian beer selections in Kyoto, with about 120 varieties, and European cooking that combines Belgian regional dishes with Italian and Spanish flavours; 53 seats in all, used for parties. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe banquets with all-you-can-drink, attentive staff and generous portions.
chef_bio.philosophy: Pairing Belgian beer with European dishes (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Mussels steamed in white wine; Belgian beer.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 couple who missed the Belgian pavilion at the Osaka Expo came here instead, drank Belgian, Czech and German beers, and had the white-wine mussels made into pasta.
A November 2025 guest held onto the handrail going down: the stairs run straight up to the third floor and "can be dangerous for those who have had a few drinks."
"The portion sizes of the food were quite generous, so by the time I had sampled all the beers, I was completely full" — February 2026.
"However, the tables were a bit cramped, which was unfortunate." — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Third floor up a steep stair; à la carte or all-you-can-drink courses; cards accepted.

places.name: 蕎麦や 竹花 (Sobaya Takehana)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, yuba tempura and dashi-and-soy broths; the soba is stone-milled and handmade, but no source says it is 100% buckwheat (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba served in dashi broth, with shrimp tempura, herring and chicken teriyaki among the toppings (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–21:30 (last order 21:00); closed Monday and the second Tuesday of the month (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); short waits around lunchtime (January 2025). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and four tables for two (Tabelog). About 20 m east of Kennin-ji, 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Keihan) (Tabelog). Sake and shochu for daytime drinking (Tabelog; May 2025).
places.neighborhood: Just east of Kennin-ji, south Gion — 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Small soba shop of handmade, stone-milled soba (Tabelog) · thin noodles, hot or cold (2024–2026 reviews) · tempura soba or tempura zaru soba ¥1,790; nishin soba ¥1,390; tororo soba ¥1,190 (2024–2026 reviews) · ume tororo soba with tororo kombu, lemon soba, chicken teriyaki soba, mori soba with shrimp tempura, nishin oroshi soba (2024–2026 reviews) · yuba tempura and small dishes with sake (2024–2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Soba · beside Kennin-ji, thin handmade noodles] A 16-seat soba shop a few steps from Kennin-ji, serving thin, stone-milled handmade soba from late morning to evening: ume tororo, lemon soba, nishin soba and tempura zaru, mostly ¥1,190–1,790, with sake and small dishes for daytime drinking. Reviews split on the noodles — praised for the cut and lightness, faulted by some for lacking firmness in hot broth. Cash only, no bookings. Closed Monday and the second Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: authentic handmade soba from stone-milled flour; children welcome. A May 2026 reviewer says the shop has been near Kennin-ji for a long time; a September 2024 reviewer describes an old building with a newer interior.
chef_bio.specialty: Ume tororo soba; lemon soba; tempura zaru soba.

anecdotes.text: The soba came with a little plover-shaped flag stuck in pickled daikon — "The cute Chidori flag" (September 2024).
A November 2024 diner found the noodles in hot chicken teriyaki soba too soft, "falling apart" on the chopsticks.
"The fact that this soba shop allows for daytime drinking makes it a must-visit." — May 2025.
"The broth tasted somewhat commercial … On the positive side, the soba was expertly cut" — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: そば、東山区小松町560-2、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩約7分、Kennin-ji の東約20m、火〜日 11:00〜21:30 (L.O.21:00)、月曜と第2火曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、16席 (カウンター8、2人席4)、日本酒・焼酎、子ども可、石臼挽きの手打ちそば。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年5月、英語): 細いそば、天ぷらそば・天ざる1,790円、にしんそば1,390円、とろろそば1,190円、梅とろろ、レモンそば、照り焼きチキンそば、湯葉の天ぷら、昼飲み、千鳥の旗、温かいそばはコシが弱いとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; no reservations; small counter shop.

places.name: 割烹 しなとみ (Kappou Shinatomi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo courses and à la carte with dashi, white and red miso, tempura, karasumi mochi, fried fugu and saba sushi; no gluten information (2022–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kappo of fish, shellfish, sea urchin, Tanba black wagyu and dashi-based dishes (Tabelog; 2022–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00, last entry 19:00, no second sitting; for same-day bookings call by 18:00; closed Wednesday and about twice a month (Tabelog). Reservation only; Tabelog bookings are seated by the house — call for the counter or a private room; reservations cannot be taken from anyone without a Japanese phone number (Tabelog). Tabelog's machine-translated note says bookings are for course meals, while reviewers 2022–2025 ordered à la carte. 10% service charge (Tabelog). 7 counter seats and private rooms for 2–3; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). East of the Imperial Palace near Teramachi and Marutamachi; 10 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi (Keihan) or Shiyakusho-mae (subway) (Tabelog; 2023, 2025 reviews).
places.neighborhood: East of the Imperial Palace, near Teramachi and Marutamachi — 10 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kappo of seasonal fish, Kyoto vegetables and Tanba black wagyu, as a course tailored to the day or à la carte (Tabelog) · e.g. smoked Lake Biwa bream and wild-vegetable tempura (March 2022); grilled hon-moroko, small turnip with crab sauce (January 2023); sweetfish with roe simmered with sansho, matsutake tempura, anago shirayaki, uni tofu (November 2023); white-miso soup, winter sawara, anago, karasumi mochi, ebi-imo with crab sauce, charcoal-grilled Kyoto black wagyu with uni, shirasu rice (November 2024); clams with aonori sauce, grilled fugu, shirako, fuki-no-tō chawanmushi (March 2025); Akashi sea bream and octopus, Awaji hamo, hamo with matsutake, saba sushi (September 2025) · white-miso hot pot (August 2024) · sake, shochu, wine; beer and sake by the glass around ¥1,000 (Tabelog; March 2025) · bills about ¥20,000–29,999 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kappo · east of the Imperial Palace, à la carte by a couple] A seven-seat kappo counter east of the Imperial Palace, opened in 2021 by chef Shuichi Takahashi after kappo work in Gion, with the hostess in the room. Take a course built around the day, or order à la carte — grilled hon-moroko, sweetfish with roe, white-miso hot pot, wagyu with sea urchin — at an unhurried pace. Bills run ¥20,000–30,000 with 10% service; one 2024 guest found it a little dear. Reservations need a Japanese phone number. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A March 2025 reviewer: "Chef Shuichi Takahashi, who gained experience at kappou in Gion, opened this establishment in 2021"; the shop's name reflects its location (the address is 信富町). An August 2024 reviewer: "Apparently, the chef used to work at Umezu in Gion." Reviewers describe a couple — "Authentic Kappou Cuisine by a Warm Couple" (November 2023), "both the owner and the hostess were very pleasant" (October 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: "We do not rush our guests, so please take your time and enjoy your meal" (the shop's statement, quoted March 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte kappo; white-miso hot pot; grilled river fish.

anecdotes.text: "Moreover, the fact that the maru-nabe (round hot pot) is served in smaller pots is simply outstanding." — March 2022.
A November 2023 diner singled out sweetfish with roe simmered with sansho — a sauce worth pouring over rice at home.
"However, I felt that the price was a bit high for what I received." — February 2024.
"The grilled fugu was surprisingly flavorful, reminiscent of fried chicken" — March 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・魚介料理、上京区信富町315-4、神宮丸太町駅・市役所前駅から徒歩10分、月火木〜日 17:30〜22:00 (最終入店19:00、二回転制なし、当日予約は18時まで)、水曜と月2回の不定休、完全予約制、食べログ予約は席の指定不可、日本の電話番号がない方の予約不可、サービス料10%、7席 (カウンター)、2〜3名の個室、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、旬の魚介、京野菜、Tanba の黒毛和牛、コースとアラカルト。口コミ (2022年3月〜2025年10月、英語): 店主 Shuichi Takahashi は祇園の割烹で経験を積み2021年に開店、梅津にいたとの話 (2024年8月)、夫婦の店、本もろこ、子持ち鮎、白味噌の鍋、ふぐの焼き物、白子、蛤、鯖寿司、値段がやや高いとの声 (2024年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservations only, and not from anyone without a Japanese phone number; ask a hotel to book. 10% service; cards accepted.

places.name: 祇園楽味 (Gion Rakumi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. You choose ingredients and cooking methods, so dishes vary — tempura, gratin, hamburg steak and curry appear alongside sashimi and grilled fish; no gluten information (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a counter built around fish, crab, sea urchin and wagyu from the day's ingredient box (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 17:30–23:00; closed Sunday and the second and fourth Monday (Tabelog). The official site (page last updated 2022) lists two dinner sittings, 17:30–20:20 (last entry 18:30) and 20:30–23:00 (last entry 21:30), a lunch from 12:00 or 12:30, and irregular closures. Reservations up to the end of the second month ahead (official site). Average about ¥20,000 at dinner and ¥7,000 at lunch (official site); reviewers spent ¥15,000–49,999 (2025–2026). 14 seats at a counter; private hire possible; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). Facing Minamiza-koji in Gion south of Shijo, near Yasaka Shrine; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gion south of Shijo, near Yasaka Shrine — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: "Adult kappo izakaya" of Gion Sasaki: the day's ingredients from around Japan and abroad are laid out in a box, and you choose the ingredient and the cooking method, over the charcoal at the centre of the counter (official site) · grilling, frying, simmering, steaming — even a Chinese wok (March 2026) · e.g. small turnip with crab sauce, sashimi of tuna, sea bream, sea urchin and beef tataki, crab in white miso, crab gratin, tenderloin steak (December 2025); simmered nodoguro, wagyu steak, karasumi (February 2026); shrimp topped with sea urchin (March 2026); hamburg steak, corn tempura, curry (July 2026) · bills about ¥20,000–30,000 (official site; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kappo izakaya · Gion, choose your ingredient and cooking] Gion Sasaki's "adult kappo izakaya" on Minamiza-koji: a high-ceilinged 14-seat counter where a young, cheerful team shows you the day's ingredient box and cooks whatever you pick, however you like — grilled over the central charcoal, simmered, fried, even wok-tossed — in portions you set. Nodoguro, crab gratin, wagyu, corn tempura and curry are favourites. Expect ¥20,000–30,000 or more. Listed in OAD 2026 (per a reviewer). Closed Sunday and the second and fourth Monday.

roles: A young team of chefs (unnamed), of the Gion Sasaki group
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, one of the Gion Sasaki group's shops (with Gion Sasaki, Sushi Rakumi and Shoku Bar Rakumi), themed "大人の割烹居酒屋" (an adult kappo izakaya). An August 2026 reviewer: opened in November 2013, "known as a restaurant run by the chef of 'Gion Sasaki'", and listed in OAD Top Restaurants 2026; a March 2026 reviewer thought it is run by the owner's son. Reviewers in 2026 describe a young, energetic team of chefs.
chef_bio.philosophy: Guests choose the ingredients and decide with the chefs how each is cooked (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Ingredients cooked to order over charcoal; nodoguro; crab gratin.

anecdotes.text: "I think this is the first time I've seen a Chinese wok in a Japanese restaurant!" — March 2026.
A March 2026 guest took the suggestion of sea urchin on top of shrimp for sashimi — "that luxurious combination!"
"Be careful not to overindulge, as it can impact your budget!" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (祇園さゝ木): 祇園楽味、テーマは「大人の割烹居酒屋」、全国各地や時には世界から仕入れた旬の食材をネタ箱に並べ、客が選んだ食材の食べ方を相談して決める、カウンター中央の炭火、昼12:00・12:30〜、夜は17:30〜20:20 (最終入店18:30) と20:30〜23:00 (最終入店21:30)、平均予算は昼7,000円・夜20,000円、日曜・第2第4月曜・不定休、予約は2か月先の末日まで、東山区祇園町南側570-206、グループに祇園さゝ木、鮨楽味、食ばぁー楽味。食べログ: 日本料理、月〜土 17:30〜23:00、14席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 若い料理人たち、のどぐろの煮付け、和牛ステーキ、蟹グラタン、とうもろこしの天ぷら、ハンバーグ、カレー、中華鍋も、2013年11月開店、OAD 2026。

Come for natural wine — more than 120 bottles — or cocktails, plus bar food: the dashimaki brioche sandwich, sukiyaki spring rolls, tacos and shake-bag fries. Courses from ¥4,500; 10% service in the lounge. Some find the music too loud. Adults only; until 3:00 on Friday and Saturday.

roles: Bar and restaurant; kitchen staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per Metropolis and 2026 reviews: the "Sound Forest" concept is by producer Tomoyuki Tanaka, known as Fantastic Plastic Machine, music director for the opening and closing ceremonies of the Tokyo 2020 Olympics and Paralympics (February 2026 review); natural wines chosen by sommelier Kei Tashiro and cocktails by bartender Keita Saito (Metropolis). Opened 12 July 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Natural wine; dashimaki brioche sandwich.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner liked the food and service but found the music "as loud as in a movie theater".
A November 2025 diner found it noisy and too brightly lit, and was given a table after booking the counter.
A March 2026 diner described ten speakers in the ceiling and a huge old tree in the middle of the room.
