places.gf_detail: Ask. A fixed course of five sweets with teas; the sweets change monthly and use mochi (gyuhi), miso, herbs and fruit; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan as served: the July 2026 sweets included fermented milk and caramel (July 2026). Ask when booking.
places.hours_raw: 12:00–18:00 daily, open year-round, by reservation only (Tabelog); three sittings a day (July 2026). One course: the tea-and-sweets kaiseki, ¥7,700 with tax, with the same price whether the paired drinks are alcoholic or not (July and September 2026). 8 counter seats; private hire; non-smoking; cards only, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Second floor of a building on the 570 block south of Shijo in Gion, 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). A second shop, 然美 御所南, is listed on the official site.
places.neighborhood: Gion south of Shijo — 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Tea-and-sweets pairing in a standing-style tea room (ryurei), as a monthly course (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · tea and sweets kaiseki ¥7,700: five sweets with five or six teas, two of them tea cocktails in the alcohol pairing (July and September 2026) · July 2026: passion fruit, coconut and caramel; mango with matcha gin; corn with mitarashi; peach, fermented milk and gyuhi; cold-brewed gyokuro, hojicha with cardamom and timur pepper (July 2026) · February 2026: gyokuro, blended hojicha and matcha with five sweets (February 2026) · pickles to finish, for sale (March and June 2026)
places.notes: [Tea & sweets course · Gion, a monthly pairing at an 8-seat counter] A hushed second-floor counter south of Shijo where each guest gets one course: five seasonal sweets, each paired with a tea brewed in front of you — gyokuro, hojicha with spice, matcha — with tea cocktails if you choose the alcohol pairing, at the same ¥7,700. Expect fruit, herbs and miso in the sweets, and pickles to finish. Book a sitting; one March 2026 guest found the service lacking.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded by the contemporary artist Taiga Takahashi (1995–2022). Opened 4 December 2021 (Tabelog). The shop text speaks of "rust" — the beauty of change over time and imperfection — and of sukiya-style architecture (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): the beauty of imperfection and imbalance, "the essence hidden deep within gradually seeps out with the passage of time."
chef_bio.specialty: Tea and sweets kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner found the course dragging, had a drink taken away unfinished, and saw a fallen sweet taken to the back and fixed by hand; the diner did not plan to return.
A September 2026 diner felt the teas and sweets each leave room for the other, more a flow than a series of peaks.
"The first cup of tea was truly exquisite, with a flavor reminiscent of dashi that I had never encountered before" — April 2026.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led kaiseki built on dashi (2023–26 reviews).

places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, sesame tofu and saba sushi down a lane] A traditional kaiseki house tucked into a Gion back lane, with a counter and tatami rooms, some upstairs over a courtyard. Chef Akihiko Nishimura's nine or ten dishes run from a silky sesame tofu and a clear dashi soup through sashimi and a famous saba sushi to sea-bream chazuke; the saba sushi is also sold to take home. One June 2026 diner found the seasoning on the strong side. Reviewers spent about ¥20,000–30,000 a head; a 17% service charge applies. Mon–Sat evenings, reservation only.

chef_bio.background: Per an October 2025 reviewer: a renowned Kyoto-cuisine restaurant in Gion where chef Akihiko Nishimura cooks a delicate seasonal kaiseki around the counter. A December 2023 diner found the head chef and the hostess warm and cheerful; an April 2025 diner enjoyed the chef’s stories.
chef_bio.specialty: Sesame tofu; saba sushi.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner liked everything but found the flavours strong — the saba sushi salty, the sesame tofu rich — and was left thirsty.
A June 2024 diner, there with a friend from abroad, was put at ease by the friendly chef at the six-seat counter.
A January 2024 party was shown to a tatami room with a sunken table, its own restroom and a view of the courtyard.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Northern Italian cooking centred on meat, cheese and cream; no seafood is served (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).

places.cuisine: Emilia-Romagna and northern Italian trattoria of handmade pasta by a chef who trained at Ristorante Antica Moka (Tabelog, shop text) · no seafood (Tabelog) · tagliatelle, bigoli from an extruder, tortellini in brodo, lasagne, gargati; Bolognese ragù, cream pesto, cacio e pepe, Genovese with cream (2026 reviews) · prosciutto with gnocco fritto, tigelle, homemade prosciutto cotto, Modena pickles, ricotta with jam and balsamic (2026 reviews) · Bolognese-style cotoletta, Piedmont beef tartare, ossobuco, wine-braised beef cheek, grilled beef (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews) · tiramisu, panna cotta (2026 reviews) · lunch set ¥2,750 (soup, antipasti, a pasta; Bolognese or tagliatelle +¥550 each), lunch course with two pastas ¥5,500 (September 2026) · Peroni ¥990–1,100, limoncello ¥880 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Italian · Umamachi, Emilia-Romagna pasta up the hill] A 14-seat trattoria up the slope east of Gojo, where a chef trained at Antica Moka in Emilia-Romagna rolls tagliatelle by hand, presses bigoli and floats tortellini in brodo. Lunch on weekends is a bargain — soup, a plate of antipasti with gnocco fritto and prosciutto, and a pasta for ¥2,750 — booked by the day before. Dinners add Modena tigelle, cotoletta and slow-braised meats, and tiramisu. No seafood, no service charge. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): the chef trained at Ristorante Antica Moka, known for handmade pasta, in Emilia-Romagna; a September 2026 reviewer places the training in Modena. Opened 12 October 2023 (Tabelog) in a space that had been a classic French restaurant (October 2026 regular).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): traditional northern Italian dishes as they are actually eaten locally.
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade pasta.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner asked to try more dishes and was given half portions of the prosciutto and gnocco fritto and slightly smaller pastas.
A September 2026 diner swapped the bigoli for gargati, a short Veneto pasta, with the cream pesto.
A regular since before the opening marked the third anniversary in October 2026, noting the evening second course takes 45 minutes to prepare.

places.name: 祇園 静水香 (Gion Shizuka)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kaiseki with sushi, sukiyaki, a kadaif-coated croquette, udon and ponzu; the official site has a notice on ingredient restrictions (April 2026) that we could not read (Tabelog; 2026 reviews; official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of fish, foie gras, sea urchin, wagyu and dashi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 12:30); dinner from 18:00, all guests starting together, booking required; no regular closing day (official site; Tabelog). Tabelog gives dinner to 22:00, the official site to 21:00. Pairing courses by advance booking only; bookings may be cancelled after 15 minutes' unannounced lateness (Tabelog). No children under 12; everyone 12 and over orders a course; no very casual clothes or strong perfume; please do not leave your seat to smoke during the meal (Tabelog). Service 10%, included in some prices (Tabelog). 18 seats: a 10-seat counter and a 2nd-floor tatami room for 2–8 (room charge); English menu; English- and Chinese-speaking staff; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). Near the Tatsumi bridge on the Shirakawa; 5 min from Gion-Shijo or Sanjo-Keihan Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gion Shirakawa near the Tatsumi bridge — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki at a counter in a renovated Gion machiya, built around sake pairings: sake sent direct from breweries and kept at –5 °C, pairings of nine sake including Juyondai with ten dishes, and non-alcoholic or light pairings (Tabelog) · courses: seasonal omakase dinner ¥19,800 (one drink required), anniversary kaiseki "Yui" ¥19,800, sake pairing course ¥26,400 (Tabelog); "Shiki" ¥16,500 (September 2026) · monthly menus in 2026 reviews: foie gras croquette in kadaif, round tofu with sea urchin, hassun, sashimi with ponzu, guji with Inaniwa udon, kamasu or aji sushi, hamo, abalone with fig and miso dengaku, black wagyu sukiyaki, sanma or mackerel rice, hojicha kakigori, chestnut Mont Blanc · lunch options with Kyoto vegetables and Kyoto-style sushi (September 2026)
places.notes: [Kaiseki & sake pairing · Gion Shirakawa] A ten-seat counter in a renovated machiya near the Tatsumi bridge, where seasonal Kyoto kaiseki comes with pairings of rare sake (Juyondai among them) kept at –5 °C. The cooking is credited to a Michelin-starred chef. Dinner courses about ¥16,500–26,400 + service; lunch too. No under-12s; English menu. Open daily.

roles: Supervising chef: "Kazumi Sawada" per Tabelog (romaji only; a Michelin star in 2008 and 2009)
Head chef unnamed on the official site; a September 2026 reviewer names "Chef Kimura"
chef_bio.background: Opened 29 July 2024 (Tabelog). Per Tabelog: a 10-course Kyoto kaiseki by chef Kazumi Sawada, "who has earned a Michelin star" (2008 and 2009), with Kyoto vegetables, wagyu and Setouchi seafood. The official site credits a Michelin-starred chef with supervising the food and names no one; it is run by EDGE (ed-ge.co.jp), whose other venues listed on the site are in Tokyo.
chef_bio.specialty: Kaiseki with sake pairings.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner was touched by "the warm hospitality of Chef Kimura and the staff".
In September and October the room keeps crickets, so the meal comes with their song — September 2026.
An October 2026 family calls it the family favourite, above all for the sake pairings, and hopes it stays easy to book.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-shizuka.jp): 祇園 静水香、ミシュラン星付きシェフ監修、料理長、ランチ 12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 12:30)、ディナー 18:00〜21:00 (18:00 一斉スタート)、無休、運営 EDGE (Fish Bank TOKYO、Bar&Lounge MAJESTIC、TOKYO Whisky Library、Cheese Tavern CASCINA、スナックロマンチック)、食材制限についてのお知らせ (2026年4月16日)。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理、東山区清本町371-2、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、12:00〜15:00・18:00〜22:00、サービス料10%、18席 (カウンター10、2階座敷)、12歳未満入店不可、英語メニュー、2024年7月29日オープン、蔵元直送で−5℃保管の日本酒、Juyondai を含む9種と10品のペアリング、Kazumi Sawada (ミシュラン一つ星 2008・2009年)、季節のおまかせ19,800円、Yui 19,800円、日本酒ペアリングコース26,400円。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): フォアグラのコロッケ、雲丹の丸豆腐、八寸、ぐじと稲庭うどん、黒毛和牛のすき焼き、Shiki 16,500円、Chef Kimura、虫の音。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English/Chinese-speaking staff (Tabelog); book ahead; no under-12s.

places.name: 祇園 川上 (Gion Kawakami)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kappo kaiseki with dashi and soy-grilled fish; no gluten information (official site; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led kaiseki on dashi — sea bream, eel, konowata (official site; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:00 daily; holidays posted on the official site (a November–December 2026 notice) (Tabelog; official site). Bookings by phone or online (TableCheck) (official site; Tabelog). A lunch kaiseki was ¥6,600 with tax, service extra (September 2026). 24 seats: a 10-seat counter and seven private rooms across the main house and annex (Tabelog; February 2026). Non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners (Tabelog). Takeaway seasonal bento in November only, ¥5,250, two days' notice, no shipping (official site). On a lane one street west of Hanamikoji, south of Shijo; 248 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Gion, a lane west of Hanamikoji south of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion "itamae kappo" with no fixed monthly menu — dishes built daily from the day's produce and each guest's wishes; Awaji sea bream and suppliers kept since the founding; kabura-mushi from mid-November (official site) · lunch: kaiseki ¥6,600 (September 2026) and bento such as the "Chochin" bento, in the ¥5,000s (2025–26 reviews) · dinner kaiseki ¥20,000–39,999 per reviewers: konowata chawanmushi, hamo, steamed sea-bream head, dashi-steamed eel (2026 reviews) · takeaway November bento ¥5,250 (official site)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion, since 1960] A Gion kappo in a 100-year-old machiya on a quiet lane off Hanamikoji, with a bright counter where you watch the cooks and private rooms behind. No fixed menu: the day's market sets the dishes. Lunch kaiseki around ¥6,600 or a bento is the easy way in; dinners run ¥20,000+. A reviewer notes a Michelin star.

roles: Owner (店主, signs the official site, unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1960 (Showa 35) in the middle of Gion; motto "親切・センス・鮮度" (kindness, sense, freshness) kept since the founding; teamwork among the cooks at the counter. Per a February 2026 reviewer: a renovated machiya over 100 years old, a 10-seat counter and seven private rooms, and one Michelin star.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: no set monthly menu — the day's ingredients and each guest's wishes make the menu; bring out each ingredient's own aroma and taste.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kappo; kabura-mushi in winter.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner warned the chef's sharp style "might not appeal to those who lack a refined palate" — and praised the dashi-maki.
A June 2026 visitor with business at Minami-za dropped in for the Chochin bento and found lunch very reasonable.
Sake runs just under ¥2,000 for 180 ml, and the staff gladly suggest pairings — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-kawakami.co.jp): 京都の割烹 祇園川上、創業昭和35年、花見小路、「親切・センス・鮮度」、月ごとの決まった献立はなくその日の食材とお客様のご要望で献立、淡路島の鯛、創業以来の仕入先、板前割烹、11月中旬からかぶら蒸し、11月限定の季節のお弁当一段5,250円 (持ち帰りのみ、2日前までに予約)、東山区祇園町南側570-122、11〜12月のお休みのご案内。食べログ: 日本料理・弁当、12:00〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、24席、個室、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 築100年超の町家、カウンター10席と個室7室、ミシュラン一つ星、このわたの茶碗蒸し、昼の懐石6,600円、Chochin Bento、鯛のかぶと蒸し、鱧。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online or by phone; English page on the official site.

places.name: mane
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the restaurant says it cannot accommodate wheat allergies; courses include pasta and house bread (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: "We cannot accommodate vegetarian requests. We do not have a vegan menu." A seafood-only course can be arranged (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Monday, open on some Mondays (Tabelog). Reservation only; solo diners and families with children of elementary-school age or younger book by phone (Tabelog). Water (free-flow) ¥880 per person on top of the course (Tabelog). Allergies handled where possible, but not fish or wheat (Tabelog). 16 seats: 12 at the counter and one table, facing a garden; private hire up to 20; children of all ages welcome; English menu and staff; smart casual; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: West of Kawaramachi near Kyoto City Hall — 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Creative Italian courses of seasonal local ingredients, seafood-centred with a meat main; the owner buys at the market and from local farmers (Tabelog) · lunch omakase of 3 appetizers, pasta and a main ¥8,360, with black wagyu ¥10,560; chef's special lunch of 8 dishes ¥14,960 (Tabelog) · dinner: chef's special of 7 dishes and dessert ¥17,160 (July 2026); drink pairing ¥7,700 (October 2026) · dishes in 2026 reviews: clam chowder, burrata with peas, kinmedai with mountain vegetables, shirasu and spring cabbage pasta, hairy crab and scallop carpaccio, cold pasta with ayu, Mangalica pork, Agu pork with burdock and Kyoho grapes, Tottori wagyu, eel spring rolls with kabosu, tiramisu with milk gelato; house herbal tea
places.notes: [Creative Italian · near Kyoto City Hall] Moved from Kyotanabe in 2024 after eight years there: a bright 12-seat counter facing a small garden, serving inventive, seafood-led Italian courses with Japanese and other Asian touches. Lunch from ¥8,360, dinner about ¥17,000; plus ¥880 for water. Cannot cater for wheat allergies, vegetarians or vegans. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened here 23 April 2024 (Tabelog). Per 2026 reviews: previously in Matsuiyamate, Kyotanabe City, for about eight years before moving (May and August 2026); the name is the Scandinavian word for moon, written "måne" (May 2026); a July 2026 reviewer writes the chef trained at Yonemura and Il Ghiottone, and that the restaurant was selected by Michelin. Per the operator: the tables came from the old premises.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal seafood Italian courses.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner who dislikes coffee still wanted more of the tiramisu.
An October 2026 reviewer read the cooking as fusion, with Japanese, Chinese and Korean touches.
A passer-by of more than two years had never noticed it, then came for the duck — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): mane、イタリアン・イノベーティブ、中京区山本町440-1、京都市役所前駅から徒歩7分、火〜日 12:00〜15:00・18:00〜22:00、月曜休み (営業する月曜もあり)、完全予約制、ベジタリアン・ヴィーガン不可、魚介のみのコースは可、魚と小麦のアレルギーは不可、水 (フリーフロー) 1人880円、16席 (カウンター12、テーブル1)、子供可、英語メニュー、スマートカジュアル、2024年4月23日オープン、昼のおまかせ8,360円・黒毛和牛10,560円・シェフスペシャル14,960円。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): Kyotanabe (Matsuiyamate) から移転 (約8年)、måne は月の意味、Yonemura と Il Ghiottone で修業、ミシュラン選出、夜17,160円、ペアリング7,700円、ティラミス。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and staff (Tabelog); reservation only; ¥880 water charge.

staff_allergy_handling: Allergies handled within its means, but not fish or wheat allergies (Tabelog).

places.name: 日本酒と肴 いち陽 (Nihonshu to Sakana Ichiyo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, simmered and grilled fish, with fried dishes (mehikari kara-age, Tochio fried tofu, spring rolls) that are not gluten-free (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-sake izakaya (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 daily; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reviewers also describe a ¥1,000 lunch that sells out (November 2025; October 2026); lunch hours are not listed. Reservations accepted; often full (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats, counter-centred (Tabelog; March 2026). Near Karasuma, 297 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 August 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ayanokoji east of Karasuma — 297 m from Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Izakaya of fish and a long sake list — two A4 pages, with tastings to find your style (2025–2026 reviews) · sake named by reviewers: Aramasa, Hanayuki, Jikon, Ibi muroka nama genshu (April 2026) · assorted sashimi, fish namero, simmered sawara, teppai, dashimaki, mehikari kara-age, Tochio fried tofu, shrimp spring rolls, grilled squid with chili or shichimi soy (January–August 2026) · charcoal-grilled shark fin, dried firefly squid, mirin-dried fish (August 2026) · matsutake dobin-mushi (October 2026) · most dishes under ¥1,000 (January 2026) · ¥1,000 lunch: two sashimi, a main such as chicken nanban, three sides, miso soup and rice (October 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma, sake tastings and fish] A calm, counter-centred izakaya near Karasuma with two pages of sake — Aramasa, Jikon and rarer bottles — where the owner pours you tastings until you find the one you like. The food is fish-led and mostly under ¥1,000 a dish: thick sashimi, namero, simmered sawara, fried mehikari, grilled squid, with matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn. A ¥1,000 lunch set sells out. Book ahead; open nightly to midnight.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who guides the sake choices
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 1 August 2023. An October 2026 reviewer found the owner friendly and full of knowledge about sake.
chef_bio.specialty: Sake tastings matched to taste; sashimi.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner, brought by a sake-loving son, was pleased that the shop’s tastings led a wife who rarely drinks sake to say, "I want to go again!"
A lunch regular on an eighth visit, in October 2026, finally got in after weeks of finding it closed or full, and had a ¥1,000 set with two sashimi and chicken nanban.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本酒と肴 いち陽、居酒屋・魚介料理、下京区綾材木町199 1F、烏丸駅から297m、毎日 17:00〜24:00、不定休、予約可、カード可、20席、2023年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 日本酒の品揃えが豊富 (A4で2枚)、好みを伝えると試飲させてくれる、Aramasa、Hanayuki、Jikon、Ibi の無濾過生原酒、刺身の盛り合わせ、なめろう、鰆の煮付け、てっぱい、だし巻き、めひかりの唐揚げ、Tochio の油揚げ、松茸の土瓶蒸し、ほとんどの料理が1,000円以下、昼の定食1,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; ask for sake tastings by preference.

places.name: SOUP CURRY KING 京都新京極店 (Soup Curry King, Kyoto Shinkyogoku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Soup curry of chicken-bone, vegetable and Japanese dashi broth with deep-fried vegetables; the zangi topping is soy-marinated fried chicken; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every soup is built on chicken bones plus dashi of kombu, niboshi and katsuobushi (Tabelog shop text).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00) daily, holidays included (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); long queues after opening, quieter mid-afternoon on weekdays (September 2026). Cards and QR accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). A Wednesday discount was signposted in October 2026. 15 counter seats (Tabelog; September 2026). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Second floor of the カレッジタウン詩の小路ビル on Shinkyogoku south of Sanjo, near MOVIX (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 30 January 2026 (Tabelog; press release).
places.neighborhood: Shinkyogoku south of Sanjo, near MOVIX — 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Sapporo soup curry, the brand’s first Kansai shop: a broth of chicken bones and aromatic vegetables with a Japanese dashi of kombu, niboshi and katsuobushi, plus house spices; choose the heat level and rice size (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews) · chicken curry ¥1,430 — a whole leg with potato, carrot, pepper, cabbage and quail egg (October 2026) · chicken and vegetable curry; seafood curry (2026 reviews) · Hokkaido zangi vegetable curry ¥1,760; pork kakuni vegetable curry ¥1,980 (August–October 2026) · toppings such as eggplant, cheese, soft-boiled egg; extra soup (September–October 2026) · plain lassi ¥500 (August 2026)
places.notes: [Soup curry · Shinkyogoku, Sapporo’s soup curry comes to Kyoto] The first Kansai branch of a Sapporo soup-curry name, up a flight on the Shinkyogoku arcade south of Sanjo, opened in January 2026. A light but deep broth of chicken bones and Japanese dashi, piled with crisp fried vegetables and a fall-apart chicken leg (¥1,430), or soy-marinated zangi or pork kakuni; pick your spice level. Fifteen counter seats under lamps and coloured tiles; queues at peak times. Open daily 11:00–22:00.

roles: Operated by 株式会社B級グルメ研究所 (Tokyo), per the opening press release
chef_bio.background: A press release from 株式会社B級グルメ研究所 announced the grand opening on 30 January 2026 as the brand’s first shop in Kansai. Reviewers describe SOUP CURRY KING as a popular, often-queued Sapporo soup-curry shop, and an August 2026 reviewer notes it among Sapporo’s top 100 restaurants.
chef_bio.philosophy: An everyday soup curry: light yet deep, keeping Sapporo’s taste while working with local producers (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken soup curry.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 first-timer dreaded tackling a whole chicken leg, then found it shredded easily with a spoon.
An October 2026 diner, lured in by a Wednesday-discount sign, ran out of soup halfway and ordered more.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: SOUP CURRY KING 京都新京極店、カレー・スープカレー、中京区新京極通三条下ル桜之町407-1 カレッジタウン詩の小路ビル2F、京都市役所前駅から354m、毎日 11:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、予約不可、カード・QR可、15席、禁煙、子ども可、2026年1月30日オープン。店の紹介: 鶏ガラと香味野菜のスープに昆布、煮干し、鰹節の和風出汁、オリジナルスパイス、札幌の味を大切に地元の生産者と連携。プレスリリース (株式会社B級グルメ研究所): 2026年1月30日グランドオープン、関西初出店。口コミ (2026年、英語): チキンカレー1,430円、ザンギ野菜カレー1,760円、豚角煮野菜カレー1,980円、プレーンラッシー500円、辛さを選べる、カウンター15席。

cultural_comfort.note: No reservations; counter seats only; many visitors from abroad (October 2026).

places.name: 個室居酒屋 和ノ音 京都駅前店 (Wanone, Kyoto Ekimae)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, yakitori, hot pot and many fried dishes (kara-age, Tochio fried tofu, agedashi), with hegi soba to finish; no gluten information (October 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, chicken, beef and shrimp-broth dishes (October 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 16:00–24:00 Monday–Friday; 12:00–24:00 Saturday, Sunday and holidays (food L.O. 23:00, drinks 23:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; no-show after 15 minutes without notice; same-day changes charged for food; in December two dishes and a drink per person and a 2-hour limit (Tabelog). Cards: VISA, Master; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 100 seats in private rooms for 2 to 30+, parties up to 130 seated; a terrace (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog); paper cigarettes permitted (October 2026). QR-code ordering; English menu (Tabelog; October 2026). 3 min from Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: In front of Kyoto Station, north side — 3 min on foot
places.cuisine: Private-room izakaya of fish, yakitori and Japanese small plates, with all-you-can-drink courses (Tabelog; October 2026 reviews) · Shiki no Kaze course, 8 dishes with 2 hours’ all-you-can-drink, ¥6,500 (¥5,500 on offer in October 2026) · sashimi platters, three-delicacy platter, Saikyo-miso cream cheese, soy-marinated quail eggs, grilled skate wing, offal stew, beef-tendon stew, Tochio fried tofu with natto, red-shrimp shabu-shabu, wagyu gunkan, hand-rolled salmon-and-roe sushi, kara-age, hegi soba, warabi mochi, tiramisu (October 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kyoto Station, private rooms near the trains] A big private-room izakaya three minutes from Kyoto Station, open from 4 p.m. on weekdays and noon at weekends until midnight — handy for an early drink before a train or a group dinner. Order by QR code from sashimi platters, Saikyo-miso cream cheese, offal stew and red-shrimp shabu-shabu, and finish with hegi soba; all-you-can-drink courses from about ¥5,500. Smoking is allowed, and reviewers split between praise and complaints of slow service.

roles: Operator not named in the sources; other 和ノ音 shops are listed in Hiroshima, Akihabara and Kaihin-Makuhari
chef_bio.background: Not stated in the sources read. Other shops under the 和ノ音 name appear on Gurunavi and Hot Pepper in Hiroshima (Hiroshima-ekimae), Tokyo (Akihabara-ekimae) and Chiba (Kaihin-Makuhari).
chef_bio.specialty: Private rooms; hegi soba to finish.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 group, unsure where to go after a meeting, landed here and found everything at least good — just over ¥8,000 a head for a hearty meal.
An October 2026 diner found the portions tiny, the food arriving all at once near the end of a timed drinks plan, and a problem with the bill.

places.name: いづ重 (Izuju)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto pressed sushi with sweet-simmered fillings, kombu and tare-grilled hamo; the awafu roll uses wheat-gluten fu; no gluten information (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Limited: most sushi is fish, but the site offers shojin (Buddhist vegetarian) sushi boxes to order, the awafu roll is cooked shojin-style, and there is an eight-seaweed roll; the inari is simmered fried tofu — ask about the simmering (official site).
places.hours_raw: 10:30–17:00, Monday, Tuesday and Friday–Sunday and holidays; closed Wednesday and Thursday (a holiday closure moves to the next day); may close early when sold out (Tabelog; official site for the closed days). The official English page gives older hours to 19:00. No reservations for tables; takeaway with or without ordering ahead (official site). Saba-zushi orders suspended for lack of good mackerel (official site; Tabelog, end of April 2026; July–September 2026 reviews). Reopened 5 September after a long renovation closure, its longest since 1945 (official site). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: tables and two semi-private tatami booths for three (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome; English menu (Tabelog). At the northwest corner of the crossing below the Yasaka Shrine steps (official site).
places.neighborhood: Gion, below the Yasaka Shrine steps — 8 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style pressed, rolled and saba sushi made almost unchanged since the late Meiji founding (official site) · saba sugata-zushi of Tsushima mackerel — suspended until good fish returns (official site) · jo-hako-zushi, the layered box of tai, egg, shrimp and seasonal fish ¥2,160 · Kyoto maki ¥1,200 · inari ¥950 with hemp seeds, yuzu and burdock in the rice; a winter version with grilled Kujo green onion · guji (amadai) sugata-zushi ¥5,160 · kodai sasamaki ¥1,620 · aji (shima-aji) sushi ¥1,500 · Kyoto chirashi ¥1,560; hamo chirashi ¥1,800 in season; awafu roll ¥600; seaweed roll ¥900 (official site, prices before tax) · reviewers paid ¥2,200 for aji sushi, ¥990 for inari and ¥440–550 for sasamaki of ayu, eel or matsutake (September 2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Gion, Kyoto pressed sushi below Yasaka Shrine] An old sushi house at the foot of the Yasaka Shrine steps, making Kyoto sushi — pressed boxes, saba-zushi, rolls — much as it has since the late Meiji era. The famous saba-zushi is on hold until good mackerel returns (the owner would rather not sell than sell poor fish), but the layered jo-hako box, shima-aji sushi, inari with crunchy hemp seeds and seasonal sasamaki carry on. No bookings; arrive at 10:30 to beat the queue. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who signs the site’s notices and explains each sushi
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Kyoto sushi made by methods kept almost unchanged since the founding in the late Meiji era, more than a hundred years from the first-generation owner, 重吉. The shop reopened on a 5 September after its longest closure since the forced evacuations at the end of the war in 1945. Takeaway is also sold at counters in Kyoto Station, the Takashimaya stores in Kyoto and Osaka, and Abeno Harukas. A July 2026 reviewer calls the owner a living encyclopedia of Gion and Kyoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Better to give up and not sell than to sell poor mackerel” — the owner’s note on suspending saba-zushi (official site); keep old methods alive so that Kyoto sushi has a future (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Saba sugata-zushi; jo-hako-zushi.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 lunch guest was told the small batch of rice had run out and to come back in an hour; on return the empty room filled up fast.
An August 2026 diner nearly left on hearing there was no mackerel sushi, but was offered hamo and ayu sushi instead.
A September 2026 diner arrived on the very day the inari came back, and liked the crunch of hemp seeds in the rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京寿司の老舗 祇園石段下 いづ重、東山区祇園町北側292-1、八坂神社の石段下の交差点北西角、明治の創業からほとんど変わらない製法、初代重吉より百年以上、鯖寿司受付中止 (良いサバが獲れないため)、9月5日に営業再開 (昭和20年の強制疎開以来の長期休業)、水・木曜定休、上箱寿司2,160円、巻寿司1,200円、いなり寿司950円 (苧の実、柚子、ごぼう)、焼九条葱入り大人のいなり寿司 (10〜3月)、ぐぢ姿寿司5,160円、小鯛笹巻1,620円、あじ寿司1,500円、京ちらし1,560円、鱧ちらし1,800円、粟麩巻600円 (精進料理の手法、精進の寿司折りにも対応)、海藻巻900円 (いずれも税抜)、お持ち帰りは京都駅構内、高島屋京都店・大阪店、あべのハルカスでも。食べログ: 10:30〜17:00、水・木休み、売り切れ次第終了、予約不可、カード可、20席、禁煙、英語メニュー、鯖不漁のため鯖の料理は休止 (2026年4月末時点)。口コミ (2026年、英語): あじ寿司2,200円、いなり3個990円、笹巻、鱧ちらし、上箱寿司。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog) and an English page on the site; no reservations; tatami booths and tables.

places.name: ELOVE (エラブ)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the lunch sets come with house focaccia (or multigrain rice with the hamburg steak), and pasta is a course; the rest of the courses are vegetables, fish and meat (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables lead every dish and Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the set courses include fish, venison, boar or wagyu, and desserts include a white-miso tiramisu (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 13:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), irregular closing days. Tabelog: dinner food L.O. 21:00, drinks 21:30; lunch in two seatings, 90 minutes when busy; dinner 2.5 hours when busy; bookings after 21:00 by phone; Christmas Eve and Day course only, in two seatings. Same-day cancellation may be charged 100% (official site). 30 table seats on two floors; private hire 12–30 (official site). Non-smoking; children welcome; take-out; cards and PayPay. No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 18 September 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Karasuma — 1 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn, exit 16
places.cuisine: Vegetable-led Italian built on about 20 morning-picked vegetables from contract farms (official site) · lunch course of four dishes with a drink ¥2,500; pasta or risotto set ¥1,500; hamburg steak with vegetables ¥2,000 (official site) · dinner course with one drink ¥6,800, upgraded course ¥8,000, three-glass wine pairing ¥3,000 (official site) · natural wine, vegetable highballs and house sodas (official site) · deli and vegetable stand: salad bowl ¥1,000 (official site) · seen: choose-your-own grilled or fried vegetables, Spanish mackerel, clam risotto, white-miso sweet-potato tiramisu (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Shijo-Karasuma, vegetables first] A two-floor wooden dining room by Karasuma Station where every course is built on the day’s vegetables from Kyoto contract farms — diners pick vegetables to be grilled or fried, and the white-miso tiramisu is a favourite. Lunch course ¥2,500; dinner course with a drink ¥6,800; a deli and a vegetable stand too. Several diners warn the portions are generous. One of six shops of the local Ushinohone group.

roles: One of six shops of the うしのほねグループ (株式会社セカンダイズ); the chef is not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Italian with vegetables as the star, using around 20 kinds of morning-picked vegetables sent daily by contract farmers, with a vegetable stand and a deli; the site lists named farms behind each dish. The group site (株式会社セカンダイズ) says the うしのほねグループ runs six shops of different styles in central Kyoto plus an online shop; ELOVE’s site lists the other five as sister shops. Opened 18 September 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: to pass on, in the restaurant’s own way, the vegetables producers want people to eat now — not the textbook season but "delicious at this moment".
chef_bio.specialty: Daily vegetable courses; white-miso and sweet-potato tiramisu.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner found a thank-you card at the table addressed to the diner by name, and a menu dated for the day.
"Even though there were just two of us, we ended up ordering too much." — September 2026, after choosing vegetables to be grilled or fried.
A clam risotto came with a vegetable the October 2026 diner had never heard of — "slimy" but crunchy.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (elove-kyoto.com): 京都・四条烏丸の野菜が主役のイタリアン ELOVE (エラブ)、契約農家から毎朝届く朝採れ野菜を20種ほど、一般的な旬ではなく「今この瞬間、美味しい」こと、野菜の直売とデリカテッセン、ランチコース (全4品、ドリンク付き) 2,500円、季節の野菜と煮込みハンバーグ2,000円、本日のパスタ・リゾット各1,500円、ディナーコース (ワンドリンク付き) 6,800円、8,000円のコース、マリアージュセット3,000円、ナチュールワイン、野菜のハイボール、サラダボウル1,000円、グリルセット1,200円、価格は税込み、当日キャンセルは100%の場合あり、ランチ11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 13:30)、ディナー17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、不定休、テーブル30席 (2階建て)、貸切12〜30名、系列店5軒。グループ (株式会社セカンダイズ): うしのほねグループは京都の中心部に業態の異なる6店舗とオンラインショップ。食べログ: イタリアン・カフェ・惣菜、中京区帯屋町585、ランチは2部制で混雑時90分、ディナーは混雑時2.5時間、21時以降の予約は電話、ベジタリアン対応、禁煙、子供可、テイクアウト、2021年9月18日オープン。口コミ (2026年1月〜10月、英語): 量が多い、野菜を選んで焼くか揚げる、鰆、あさりのリゾット、白味噌とさつまいものティラミス、名前入りのメッセージカード。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses with online booking; vegetables are chosen at the table.

places.name: 旬の料理とおばんざい つぼみ (Shun no Ryouri to Obanzai Tsubomi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; a dashi-seasoned obanzai platter is served to everyone on sitting down, and the menu runs to tempura, fried oysters and udon (2023–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the obanzai platter served to every guest is seasoned with dashi, and the menu is fish, chicken, duck and horse (2023–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun 17:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed Monday, and may close two Sundays a month for a two-day break; lunch (booking only) is suspended. Seating charge ¥2,200 per guest for the obanzai platter (Tabelog; Japanese original 「着席セット料金（おばんざい盛合せ）2,200円」). Bookings taken; guests wearing strong perfume may be refused. 20 seats around two sunken counters; smoking allowed; cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Second floor by lift.
places.neighborhood: Gion south of Shijo, on Hanamikoji three buildings north of the Gion Kobu Kaburenjo — 324 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion obanzai and seasonal dishes until midnight · obanzai platter on sitting down, ¥2,200 (Tabelog) · dashimaki omelette, umaki, tempura of okra with shrimp paste, conger eel or octopus, fried sakura shrimp and small flatfish, octopus stew, fried namafu, horse sashimi, salt-grilled Kyoto red chicken, smoked duck breast, chorizo, meat udon to finish (2023–2025 reviews) · sake and shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Obanzai · Gion, open till midnight] Up a lift behind a lattice on Hanamikoji: two sunken U-shaped counters around a friendly owner, where an obanzai platter (¥2,200 seating charge) arrives as you sit. Fluffy dashimaki is the dish everyone mentions; then tempura, horse sashimi, smoked duck, meat udon. Regulars chat with the staff; diners like the late hours and fair prices for Gion. Smoking allowed; no strong perfume. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner at the counter (2023–2025 reviews); not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Tabelog describes a hidden Gion spot for seasonal dishes, obanzai and drinks, on the second floor of 第3万治ビル, three buildings north of the Kobu Kaburenjo theatre on Hanamikoji. Reviewers from 2023 to 2025 describe guests seated around the owner at sunken U-shaped counters, with regulars chatting with the staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tabelog introduction: a place to forget the rush of daily life over seasonal dishes and obanzai.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai platter; fluffy dashimaki tamago.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 diner arriving late in Kyoto was greeted by regulars, who said cherry-blossom season makes a seat hard to get.
A December 2024 diner, turned away everywhere on a Saturday night, found a booking here and was seated at the warm sunken counter while a year-end party filled the other.
"The friendly and warm service from the owner was outstanding." — October 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 旬の料理とおばんざい つぼみ、日本料理、東山区祇園町南側 第3万治ビル2F、四条花見小路を下がって歌舞練場の3軒北、路地の格子を開けてエレベーターで2階、火〜日 17:30〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、月曜休み (月2回日曜も連休の場合あり)、ランチ (予約制、20食限定) は休止中、着席セット料金 (おばんざい盛合せ) 2,200円、予約可、香水など強い香りの方は入店を断る場合あり、20席 (カウンター12と8)、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、Facebook と ヒトサラのページあり。口コミ (2023年2月〜2026年7月、英語): 気さくな店主、掘りごたつのU字のカウンター2つ、おばんざいの盛り合わせ、ふわふわのだし巻き、う巻き、オクラと海老しんじょの天ぷら、鱧や蛸の天ぷら、桜海老と笹がれいの唐揚げ、蛸のやわらか煮、生麩の揚げ出し、馬刺し、京赤地鶏の塩焼き、鴨ロースの燻製、チョリソー、肉うどん、常連が多い、遅くまで開いている。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seating around the owner; a set obanzai platter arrives first; book at busy times.

places.name: 祇園 なん波 (Gion Nanba)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a dashi-based kaiseki with soy-seasoned dishes, somen and the occasional fried course (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish kaiseki on dashi — conger eel, sweetfish, bonito, duck (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 12:00–13:30, dinner 17:30–20:00; closed Thursday; 2–4 January lunch from the ¥13,310 course. SavorJapan gives lunch from 12:30 (L.O. 13:00) and dinner from 17:30 (L.O. 20:00). Service charge 10% (Tabelog; Japanese original 「サービス料１０％」). Bookings taken; children welcome, with children’s dishes from ¥4,000 by reservation (Tabelog). 24 seats: 6 at the counter, 10 at tables upstairs, a tatami room and private rooms for 2–8; sunken kotatsu seating; non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo, down a narrow alley east of Hanamikoji — 1 min walk from the Gion bus stop
places.cuisine: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki, the same course at lunch and dinner (July 2026) · lunch course ¥9,680 (September 2026); diners spent ¥8,000–39,999 a head (2026 reviews) · dishes seen: conger eel sashimi and hamo with plum rice soup, dobin-mushi of hamo and matsutake, grilled young sweetfish, somen with egg yolk, duck and eggplant, bonito, lotus-root tofu, fig, corn and ginger rice, matcha to finish (2026 reviews) · osechi for New Year (September 2026) · sake (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a Michelin-starred alley house] A kaiseki house down a narrow alley off Shijo near Yasaka Shrine, with a six-seat counter, tables upstairs and kotatsu private rooms. Diners in 2026 praise the dashi, summer hamo and early matsutake, and lunch from ¥9,680 for a Michelin-starred house; the owner, proprietress and staff chat through the meal. Others found it not exceptional for the stars (July 2026) and dishes slow, with repeated apologies (August 2026). 10% service. Closed Thursday.

roles: Chef and owner (2026 reviews); not named in a primary source
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 call it long-established and Michelin-starred; Retty’s introduction also says it holds a Michelin star. A regular orders osechi every year and comes for a wedding anniversary (September 2026). A July 2026 diner describes conversation with the owner, the proprietress and the staff through the course.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; dashi; summer hamo.

anecdotes.text: In an August 2026 kotatsu room, the staff said they were heating the kotatsu for a guest who felt chilly in the air conditioning, and brought a blanket.
"I was disappointed that the staff repeatedly apologized for the wait each time they brought out a dish." — August 2026.
"Personally, while it is Michelin-rated, I didn't find it exceptionally delicious." — July 2026, who still called the lunch a wonderful travel memory.
A regular who orders osechi every year comes back each September for the overlap of summer hamo and autumn matsutake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (法人会員): 祇園 なん波、日本料理、東山区四条花見小路東入る祇園町北側279-7、祇園のバス停から徒歩1分、昼12:00〜13:30、夜17:30〜20:00、木曜休み、1月2〜4日の昼は13,310円のコースから、サービス料10%、予約可、子供料理4,000円から (要予約)、24席 (カウンター6、2階テーブル10、座敷、個室2〜8名)、掘りごたつ、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可。SavorJapan: 昼12:30〜 (L.O. 13:00)、夜17:30〜 (L.O. 20:00)、木曜休み、昼の平均6,000円、先付・煮物椀・八寸・箸休・水物・菓子と抹茶。Retty: ミシュランで星を獲得している懐石料理店。口コミ (2024年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 八坂神社近くの路地、ミシュランの星、昼のコース9,680円、鱧と梅の雑炊、土瓶蒸し、鮎、鰹、卵黄のそうめん、毎年おせち、店主と女将とスタッフ、こたつを温めてくれた、料理の出が遅く何度も謝られた、星の割に特別おいしいとは思わなかった。

cultural_comfort.note: Set kaiseki with dishes explained (July 2026); private rooms and a counter; book ahead.

places.name: 割烹 市川 (Kappou Ichikawa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the à la carte menu mixes sashimi and grilled fish with tempura, fried sardines or horse mackerel, mackerel sushi and soba (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led kappou — sashimi, guji, sweetfish, soft-shell turtle, oysters, beef (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00), closed Thursday. Bookings by phone or online (Tabelog; an April 2026 review lists Gurunavi, Tabelog and Ikkyu). No service charge listed on Tabelog. 16 seats with a private room for 8 (Tabelog); a counter of 8 and two tables for 4 (April 2026 review; a February 2023 diner counted six counter seats). Non-smoking; no children; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners per Tabelog). Opened 3 February 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Between Karasuma Oike and Marutamachi — 7 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn, 8 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kappou with a long à la carte list as well as courses (2026 reviews) · course ¥11,000 (February 2023); à la carte prices not shown, about ¥25,000–31,000 for two with drinks (2026 reviews) · dishes seen: sashimi platters (bafun uni on squid, toro, shime saba, amadai, seared hamo), grilled guji, grilled sweetfish, corn tempura, firefly squid tempura, fried sardines or horse mackerel with house tartar, agedashi Kamo eggplant, whelk with asparagus, soft-shell turtle egg soup and hot pot, kinmedai in sake lees, mackerel sushi, rock oyster, potato salad with pickled shallots in nori, beef with flower pepper, soba and warabi mochi to finish (2023–2026 reviews) · sake, shochu, wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kappou · Karasuma Oike–Marutamachi, à la carte kaiseki] A counter kappou north of Oike where, unusually, almost everything can be ordered à la carte: sashimi of bafun uni on squid, grilled guji whose scales one diner called life-changing, corn tempura, soft-shell turtle, potato salad wrapped in nori. Prices are not shown — two diners paid ¥25,000–31,000 for two with drinks. The owner trained at a Tankuma kaiseki house; a 2026 diner says it entered the Michelin Guide this year. Mostly regulars; private rooms can be noisy. No children. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Ichikawa (surname from the shop name; reviews give a full name only in machine translation, so it is not used)
chef_bio.background: Opened on 3 February 2018 (Tabelog). Per an April 2026 review, the owner trained at renowned kaiseki houses including a Tankuma house (the review’s English gives "Tan Kuma Kitaten"; a June 2026 review calls the owner "from Tankuma G"). A June 2026 regular on a 29th visit saw the Michelin award ceremony on Instagram Stories and writes that the restaurant was featured in the guide that year.
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte kappou; grilled guji; soft-shell turtle.

anecdotes.text: "Just like in the past at Tanakatan, there were no prices listed, which added a thrill to the bill at the end." — August 2026; two paid ¥31,000.
"The grilled 'guji' … was one of the most shocking fish experiences of my life. I never knew fish scales could be so delicious." — May 2026.
An April 2026 diner booked a course but was allowed to switch to à la carte for everything after the opening dishes.
"I recommend the counter seats over the table ones, as private rooms can be noisy if neighboring guests are loud." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 割烹 市川、日本料理、中京区夷町572、烏丸御池駅から徒歩約7分・丸太町駅から約8分、17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、木曜休み、予約可、16席、個室8名、禁煙、子供不可、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、電子マネー不可、サービス料の記載なし、Facebook ページ、2018年2月3日オープン。口コミ (2023年2月〜2026年9月、英語): アラカルトが充実、値段の書かれていない品書き、2人で25,000〜31,000円ほど、11,000円のコース (2023年)、馬糞雲丹をのせた烏賊、とろ、しめ鯖、甘鯛、炙り鱧、ぐじの焼き物、鮎、とうもろこしの天ぷら、ほたるいかの天ぷら、鰯や鯵のフライと自家製タルタル、賀茂茄子の揚げ出し、つぶ貝とアスパラ、すっぽんの卵のスープと鍋、金目鯛の粕煮、鯖寿司、岩牡蠣、ポテトサラダ、牛肉の花山椒、〆の蕎麦とわらび餅、常連が多い、店主は「Tan Kuma Kitaten」(英訳) などで修業、2026年にミシュランガイドに掲載、個室は隣がうるさいことも。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte with no prices shown; staff suggest drink pairings (May 2026); mostly regulars.

places.name: 祇をん 麺や 凛々 (Gion Menya Rinrin)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles in every bowl, and wheat gluten (fu) as a topping (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito, shellfish and chicken broths with chicken or pork chashu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00 Monday and Sunday; 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–2:00 Tuesday to Saturday; open year-round (Tabelog). Tabelog lists reservations. About 10 people were queuing at 19:00 in January 2026. 8 counter seats in a room like a sushi or kaiseki counter; no condiments on the counter; paper bibs; non-smoking (Tabelog; September–October 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; June and August 2026). At the back of the 1st floor of 切通しビル on Kiritoshi in Gion, behind a noren; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August–September 2026). Opened 17 October 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiritoshi in Gion, between Shijo and Yasaka Shrine — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Clear-broth ramen of bonito, shellfish or chicken (2026 reviews) · "Kiwami Katsuo" bonito ramen ¥1,680 (September 2026; ¥1,690 in August), its katsuo broth said to take over 8 hours · "Tori Tanrin" chicken ramen ¥1,390 · "Kai Tanrin" shellfish ramen ¥1,490 · toppings kept minimal: chicken chashu, fine white negi, fu or yuba · limited bowls such as a sea-bream shio ramen (October 2026) and cold seafood-kombu noodles (July 2026) · rice: "Yasaka don" of pork ¥780, "Shirakawa don" of chicken ¥580, seared-pork don ¥580, tamago-kake-gohan ¥420, rice ¥300 · chashu ¥350; seared-pork sushi, chicken skin with ponzu
places.notes: [Ramen · Gion, golden bonito broth at an 8-seat counter] A tiny ramen counter at the back of a building on Gion's Kiritoshi, dressed like a sushi bar, with no condiments on the counter. Three bowls: 'Kiwami Katsuo' (¥1,680), a golden, clear bonito broth said to take over eight hours, with thin straight noodles neatly folded; chicken; and shellfish — topped only with chicken chashu, fine negi and a piece of fu. Most praise the clean umami; a few found it thin or salty for the price. Queues at dinner; cash only; open to 2:00 most nights.

roles: Owner not named; an August 2026 reviewer says it is run by the independent owner of the noodle shop "Men Tori Hyakutori"
chef_bio.background: Opened 17 October 2025 (Tabelog). An August 2026 reviewer says the shop is run by the owner who went independent from "Men Tori Hyakutori" and that the noodles come from "Menya Teigaku"; a June 2026 reviewer describes it as the new shop that replaced "Hyakkyo" in the same space. A September 2026 reviewer heard the bonito broth takes over 8 hours. Names known only from English reviews.
chef_bio.specialty: Kiwami Katsuo bonito ramen; Yasaka pork rice bowl.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner called it ramen as "the ultimate form of subtraction": a golden broth, folded thin noodles and just chicken chashu, negi and fu.
A May 2026 diner found the chicken broth thin and lacking depth, like high-end instant noodles for over ¥1,000, and thought it aimed at tourists.
An August 2026 reviewer noted many foreign customers and that prices had risen a lot compared with the owner’s earlier shop.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇をん 麺や 凛々、ラーメン、東山区清本町364-5 切通しビル 1F、月・日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、火〜土 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜翌2:00、無休、予約可、8席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、2025年10月17日オープン。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): Kiwami Katsuo 1,680円、Tori Tanrin 1,390円、Kai Tanrin 1,490円、Yasaka don 780円、Shirakawa don 580円、卵かけご飯420円、現金のみ、カウンター8席、卓上調味料なし、鰹だしは8時間以上、細いストレート麺、鶏チャーシュー、白ねぎ、麩。

noodles.notes: Thin straight noodles, folded in the bowl, firm with a good bite; from "Menya Teigaku" per an August 2026 reviewer; flat, chewy noodles in the cold summer bowl (2026).

ramen.signature_bowl: Kiwami Katsuo bonito ramen ¥1,680 (September 2026).
ramen.chashu: Chicken chashu, two small pieces (September 2026); pork chuck in the cold noodles (July 2026).

gf.note: Wheat noodles; fu topping.

vegan.note: Bonito, shellfish and chicken broths.

ramen.pantheon: Gion’s sushi-bar ramen counter: a golden, eight-hour bonito broth served with almost nothing on top.

richness: "The clear soup was light yet packed with umami" (August 2026); another found it "light and refreshing" (B536144901), one found it "too thin" (B532994439), one "rich and aromatic" (B535370655).
oiliness: "It seemed to be coated in oil, allowing me to enjoy the hot broth until the very end" (September 2026).
clarity: "The broth sparkles in a golden hue" (September 2026); "the clear soup" (B533971499).
tare_strength: "The seafood flavor centered around the bonito came forward, beautifully balanced by the soy sauce" (January 2026); "a bit salty for my taste" (B530487265).
noodle_firmness: "The noodles were straight and firm, with a nice bite" (January 2026); "slightly firm, medium-thin, and straight" (October 2026).
aroma_punch: "The rich aroma of bonito that spread in my mouth the moment I tasted the broth" (August 2026); "the aroma of bonito filled the air" (B516250036).

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; queue at dinner; 8 seats.

places.name: ひつじ食堂 (Hitsuji Shokudo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Lamb is grilled with vegetables and eaten with a slightly sweet, garlicky sauce; sausages, keema curry and salads are on the menu, and no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a lamb jingisukan restaurant; the few vegetable sides (pickles, daikon kimchi, cucumber, grilled vegetables and mushrooms) have no published ingredients (Tabelog menu).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30) Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday and holidays; 17:00–22:30 Friday (last entry 21:00, last order 22:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; same-day online booking may not be possible — a March 2026 diner phoned, was told it was full and got a cancellation call five minutes later. 18 seats with a counter where staff grill the meat; non-smoking; children welcome; cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). In Nakagyo, about 425 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Opened 18 December 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nakagyo near Shijo-Karasuma — 6 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Jingisukan (Genghis Khan) lamb grilled at the counter by staff (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews) · lamb shoulder ¥1,080 · top lamb (chuck eye roll) ¥1,280 · tenderloin ¥1,480 · chuck eye roll steak ¥1,280 · spiced bone-in lamb chop ¥1,100 per 100 g · grilled vegetable set ¥550 · mushrooms ¥500 · three sausages (house lamb, pork, chorizo) ¥720 · potato salad with lamb bacon and cheese ¥550 · coleslaw ¥550 · smoked daikon with cream cheese ¥700 · pickles ¥480 · daikon kimchi ¥380 · "addictive" cucumber ¥380 (Tabelog menu, October 2025) · lamb tongue, nakaochi kalbi, lamb prosciutto, lamb keema curry to finish, peach sorbet in half a peach (2025–26 reviews) · a one-drink course (October 2026) · wines chosen to go with lamb
places.notes: [Lamb jingisukan · Shijo-Karasuma, lamb grilled at the counter] One of few jingisukan (grilled lamb) places in central Kyoto: staff grill shoulder, chuck eye roll, tenderloin and lamb chops with bean sprouts and onion on the counter griddle, cuts from about ¥1,080. Reviewers stress the lamb has almost no gamey smell; the sauce is slightly sweet and garlicky. Finish with lamb keema curry. Sides of pickles, kimchi and lamb-bacon potato salad; wine to match. Some found service slow or portions small for the price. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Not named in any source found
chef_bio.background: Opened 18 December 2016 (Tabelog). The Tabelog menu (updated October 2025) lists lamb cuts cut and grilled by staff and house-made lamb sausage. Reviewers call it one of the few jingisukan restaurants in central Kyoto (2025–26).
chef_bio.specialty: Lamb jingisukan; lamb keema curry.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner wanted to eat the crispy fat left on the griddle, but it was taken away first.
A March 2026 diner was told by phone the shop was full, then got a call five minutes later offering a cancelled seat.
An August 2026 diner waited after being told staff would come to cut the meat, and the ordered sorbet was forgotten.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ひつじ食堂、ジンギスカン、中京区十文字町432-7-2、烏丸駅から425m、月水木土日祝 17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、金 17:00〜22:30 (最終入店21:00、L.O. 22:00)、火曜休み、予約可、18席、カウンター、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、子ども可、2016年12月18日オープン、メニュー (2025年10月14日更新、税込、英語表示): ラム1,080円、上ラム1,280円、ヒレ1,480円、ステーキ1,280円、骨付きラム100g 1,100円、焼き野菜550円、きのこ500円、ソーセージ3種720円、ポテトサラダ550円、コールスロー550円、スモーク大根とクリームチーズ700円、ピクルス480円、大根キムチ380円、きゅうり380円。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 臭みのないラム、甘めのたれ、にんにく、キーマカレー、桃のシャーベット。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; staff grill the meat at the counter.

places.name: 祇をん う桶や う (Gion Uokeya U)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kabayaki, the tub rice and rice bowls use the house tare, and the menu has rolled omelettes and liver soup; plain shirayaki (white-grilled eel) is also offered, but no gluten information is published (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant — every main is eel, with eel-liver soup or red miso soup (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 and dinner 17:00–20:00, Tuesday to Sunday; closed Monday, other closures posted on the website (Tabelog). The official site gives lunch from 11:30 (last order 14:00) and dinner from 17:00 (last order 20:00). Bookings by phone up to the end of the following month, in Japanese only (official site); the "u-oke" tub serves 3 people or more. No service charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: なし). 24 seats: tatami rooms (16) and tables (4) on the 2nd floor and more on the 1st; non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Take-away available (official site). Live eels swim in a tank by the door (April and July 2026). Down a lane west of Hanamikoji, south of Shijo; 5–7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site; Tabelog). Opened 1991 (operator history: 平成3).
places.neighborhood: West of Hanamikoji, south of Shijo in Gion — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Edo-style eel — split from the back, white-grilled over high heat, steamed, then grilled with the secret tare (official site) · 名代「う桶」, eel laid like a raft over rice in a cedar tub, with liver soup or red miso: small (3 people) ¥12,600, medium (4) ¥16,800, large (5) ¥21,000 · eel bowl matsu ¥5,250, take ¥4,200 (with liver soup) · kabayaki matsu ¥4,700, take ¥3,700 · shirayaki ¥3,700 · eel tataki ¥1,900 · uzaku ¥1,800 · yawata-maki ¥2,100 · liver yakitori ¥850 · eel skewers (salt or tare) ¥1,050 · umaki ¥1,800 · dashimaki ¥1,300 (official menu) · original cold sake 佳風-カーフ- 300 ml ¥1,850
places.notes: [Eel · Gion, eel in a cedar tub] A Gion eel house down a lane west of Hanamikoji, with live eels by the door and tatami rooms upstairs. The house dish is the u-oke: Edo-style eel — steamed, then grilled with tare, soft and lightly sweet — laid like a raft across rice in a cedar tub for three to five people (¥12,600–21,000), so groups serve as much as each likes. Smaller parties take an eel bowl (from ¥4,200), umaki or the yawata-maki. The shop dug its own well for the water. Tabelog Unagi 'Tabelog 100' 2018, 2019 and 2022. Closed Monday; phone bookings in Japanese.

roles: Operator 株式会社やげん堀グループ (representative 岡本 美科); chef not named
chef_bio.background: Per the operator site: the やげんぼり group began with the eel shop 花遊小路 江戸川 (founded 明治37 / 1904) and opened う桶や う as an eel specialist in 1991 (平成3); it now runs 6 Kyoto shops — 花見小路やげんぼり, 出逢ひ茶屋おせん, しぐれ茶屋侘助, 祇をん う桶や う, 花遊小路 江戸川 and 御二九と八さい はちべー; company sales ¥390 m. Per the shop page: when opening, the first job was digging a well by hand among the teahouses of Nishi-Hanamikoji, near Kenninji, to secure well water for river fish; Edo-style eel follows the saying "開き五年、串打ち八年、焼き一生"; slimmer eels are used for the tub, soft and light. Tabelog Unagi "Tabelog 100" 2018, 2019 and 2022 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the shop page: "ぎをんう桶や「う」の味、ここに極まります" — water first, then the long craft of Edo-style grilling.
chef_bio.specialty: U-oke (eel over rice in a cedar tub); yawata-maki; umaki.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor took the thing in the water outside for decoration until it turned out to be a live eel.
An August 2026 diner booked a month ahead for the tub of kabayaki and shirayaki, about ¥4,000 a head, in a 2nd-floor tatami room.
A February 2026 diner found the eel fluffy and the sauce light, preferring a stronger grill, and noted many foreign visitors.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yagenbori.co.jp): 祇をん う桶や う、祇園名物 江戸焼 う桶、「開き五年、串打ち八年、焼き一生」、活鰻を背から開き、背びれ・尾びれ・向骨を取り除き竹串で刺し強火で白焼、天然水で打ち清め蒸し、秘伝のタレで焼き上げる、井戸掘り (西花見小路、建仁寺のそば)、杉桶に筏に並ぶ江戸焼きうなぎ、細目の鰻、名代「う桶」大 (5人前) 21,000円・中 (4人前) 16,800円・小 (3人前) 12,600円 (肝吸いまたは赤だし付き、持ち帰り可)、鰻丼 松5,250円・竹4,200円、鰻蒲焼 松4,700円・竹3,700円、鰻白焼き3,700円、鰻のタタキ1,900円、うざく1,800円、八幡巻き2,100円、きも焼き850円、鰻串焼き1,050円、う巻1,800円、だし巻1,300円、冷酒 佳風-カーフ- 300ml 1,850円、東山区祇園西花見小路四条下ル、昼11:30〜 (L.O. 14:00)・夜17:00〜 (L.O. 20:00)、月曜定休、予約は翌月末分まで (日本語対応のみ)、祇園四条駅徒歩7分。会社概要: 株式会社やげん堀グループ、代表 岡本 美科、年商3億9千万円、平成3年 う桶や う 開業、明治37年 花遊小路 江戸川 創業。食べログ: うなぎ・日本料理、火〜日 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜20:00、月曜休み、サービス料なし、24席 (2階 座敷16・テーブル4、1階にも席)、禁煙、カード可、テイクアウト、うなぎ百名店 2018・2019・2022。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone bookings in Japanese only (official site); the tub needs 3 or more.

places.name: 三本木商店 (Sanbongi Shoten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled meat and fish with a changing handwritten menu of small plates, some fried or with bread, soy or miso; no gluten information is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: charcoal-grilled game, pork, chicken, duck and fish at the centre; a few vegetable plates (grilled zucchini, mushroom salad) have no published ingredients (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 Wednesday to Saturday (last order 22:00); 16:00–21:00 Sunday and holidays (last order 20:00); closed Monday and Tuesday; charcoal dishes stop an hour before last order; closed irregularly (Tabelog). The official site gives Monday as the regular closing day plus irregular closures, and asks guests to phone for hours. Bookings by phone only; the opening calendar is posted on Instagram and lines are busy (April 2026). A Saturday party of four was served the first two dishes, including a starter platter, before ordering (April 2026). An August 2026 reviewer says non-drinkers are not admitted. 19 seats: a 9-seat counter and one large shared table of 10; non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (official site; Tabelog). In a renovated Kyoto townhouse over 100 years old, in the former Sanbongi pleasure quarter between the Imperial Palace and the Kamo River; 3 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn exit 3 (official site). Opened 28 March 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanbongi by the Kamo River, Kamigyo — 3 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Izakaya of binchotan charcoal grilling, natural wine and warm sake (official site) · game such as boar and venison, Shinshu pasture pork, Kawamata shamo and Kyoto duck grilled over binchotan (official site) · from the handwritten menu (2026 reviews): starter platters, tuna carpaccio or toro-taku tartare, sawara sashimi with garlic-chive soy, clams steamed with lemongrass, young ayu and basil spring rolls, sakura-shrimp and seaweed chijimi with Parmigiano, white asparagus with ham and onsen egg, charcoal-grilled duck, Miyama venison (about 220 g), Kuroge wagyu tongue (120 g), steak, pork-wrapped manganji peppers, grilled butter-soy rice balls · natural wines from the cellar, sake such as Aramasa
places.notes: [Izakaya · Sanbongi, charcoal and natural wine in an old townhouse] A hard-to-book izakaya in a century-old townhouse near the Kamo River, with a nine-seat counter and one big shared table. The idea is charcoal and drink: binchotan-grilled boar, venison, duck and pasture pork, plus a long handwritten list of inventive small plates — lemongrass clams, ayu-and-basil spring rolls, tuna tartare — with natural wine from the cellar and warm sake. Book by phone once the calendar is out on Instagram; an August 2026 reviewer says non-drinkers are not admitted. About ¥8,000–15,000 a head. Tabelog izakaya WEST 'Tabelog 100' 2026.

roles: Not named in any source found; an October 2026 reviewer says the staff moved here from Tokyo
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: an izakaya built on charcoal grilling with wine and sake — vin nature that reflects the land without chemical help, sake mainly served warm — and ingredients raised with passion by the producers, grilled over binchotan; in a renovated Kyoto townhouse more than 100 years old in Sanbongi, once a lively pleasure quarter. Opened 28 March 2019 (Tabelog). Tabelog izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026 (Tabelog). An August 2026 reviewer says the place was started as a sophisticated bar for wine and sake with good food.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: wines that reflect the land of origin, sake served warm, and producers’ ingredients grilled over binchotan.
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan-grilled game and duck; natural wine.

anecdotes.text: A friend of an April 2026 diner phoned about 50 times before getting through to book.
An April 2026 couple with small appetites were served two dishes before ordering on a Saturday, one of which the couple would not have chosen.
An October 2026 visitor finally got in after three years of hitting closing days.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sanbongi-shoten.com): 京都市、丸太町の居酒屋 三本木商店、炭火焼とワイン・日本酒がメインの居酒屋、化学の力に頼らず土地の個性を反映したヴァンナチュール、日本酒は燗酒を中心、猪や鹿などのジビエ、信州の放牧豚、川俣シャモ、京鴨を備長炭で焼く、京都御所と鴨川の間、かつて花街として賑わった三本木、築100年以上の京町家をリノベーション、カウンター9席と大テーブル1卓 (10席、相席)、上京区真町478、営業時間は店舗に問い合わせ、月曜定休 (その他不定休)、神宮丸太町駅3番出口より徒歩3分。食べログ: 居酒屋、水〜土 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、日・祝 16:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:00)、月・火休み、炭火焼は L.O. の1時間前まで、19席、禁煙、カード可、2019年3月28日オープン、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年4〜11月、英語): 電話予約のみ、Instagram で営業カレンダー、お酒を飲まない客は不可という声、手書きのメニュー。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone bookings only; shared big table; drinkers only, per an August 2026 reviewer.

places.name: 藤石 (Fuji Ishi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo izakaya dishes with ankake, tempura, grilled eel, duck and miso; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-focused kappo izakaya of sashimi, hamo, eel, sweetfish, duck, chicken and beef, with dashi dishes (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00); closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; call ahead to change or cancel; tables are released 30 minutes after the booked time (Tabelog); full on holidays, with walk-ins turned away (July 2025). An otoshi (お付き出し) of ¥770 per person (Tabelog original). The menu shows no prices (June, July and September 2025 reviews). 18 seats: 6 at the counter, 12 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 5th floor of the Showa-era Gion Plaza building, up a narrow alley north of Shijo off Hanamikoji; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; April 2025).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo, off Hanamikoji, 5th floor — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion kappo izakaya of seasonal fish and obanzai, with over 50 dishes on a daily menu and about 8 local sakes (Tabelog) · Kyoto duck aburi, grilled eel skewers, grilled sweetfish, hamo (Tabelog) · hamo and yuba (June 2025); beef tataki, sashimi, fish tempura (July 2025); grilled sanma, matsutake dobin-mushi (September 2025, September 2026); tempura, sashimi, steak, firefly-squid tempura with sweet miso (March 2026); ankake dishes (April 2026); grilled local chicken, salad (June 2026) · barley and sesame shochu (2026 reviews) · bills about ¥5,000–10,000 (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo izakaya · Gion off Hanamikoji, 50 years upstairs] A long-running Gion izakaya on the fifth floor of an old Showa building, reached by a narrow alley off Hanamikoji, serving seasonal fish and Kyoto home cooking from a daily list of fifty-plus dishes: hamo, duck aburi, grilled eel and sweetfish, dobin-mushi in autumn, with local sake. Prices are fair for Gion, but the menu shows none, which unsettled some visitors; one June 2025 guest was put off by the chef correcting staff in front of diners. A ¥770 otoshi. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: loved by locals in Gion for 50 years, with a menu written daily from the best ingredients of the day; the Instagram tag given is "#Fujiishi Honten". Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a gentle owner (April 2025), a serious, sincere chef (September 2025) and well-trained, attentive staff (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Delicious seasonal dishes at reasonable prices (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Hamo; Kyoto duck aburi; grilled eel skewers.

anecdotes.text: "Head north through a narrow alley that makes you wonder, 'Can I really go this way?'" — April 2025.
A June 2025 visitor liked the hamo and yuba but felt pressure from the chef's corrections of staff in front of diners, and left soon after eating.
"I found it a bit awkward that the menu didn't list prices, so I ended up asking each time." — September 2025.
A March 2026 guest who brought a pre-school child was warmly welcomed, and loved the firefly-squid tempura with sweet miso.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、東山区四条花見小路上1筋目東入 ギオンプラザビル5F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土 17:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00)、日・祝休み、予約可 (変更・取消は電話で、30分の遅れで取消扱い)、お付き出し770円、18席 (カウンター6、テーブル12)、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、祇園で50年地元に愛される、旬の魚とおばんざい、50品以上の日替わり、地酒約8種、京鴨のあぶり、鰻の串焼き、鮎、鱧。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年9月、英語): 細い路地の奥の昭和のビル、鱧と湯葉、牛のたたき、さんま、松茸の土瓶蒸し、ほたるいかの天ぷら、品書きに値段がない、料理人がスタッフを客前で注意するのが気になったとの声 (2025年6月)、子連れも歓迎。

cultural_comfort.note: Fifth floor of an older building; no prices on the menu — ask; ¥770 otoshi; cards and PayPay.

places.name: 観山 (Kanzan)
places.gf_detail: Ask — and tell the shop in advance: allergies must be notified when booking and cannot be handled on the day (Tabelog). Kaiseki courses with dashi, soy-based sauces, fried dishes and mackerel sushi; no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki courses of fish, eel, wagyu and dashi, though vegetables from a farm inside the Shugakuin Imperial Villa grounds are a focus (official site; 2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch Wednesday, Friday and Sunday 12:00–14:00 (last entry 12:00); dinner Tuesday to Sunday 18:00–22:00 (last entry 20:30); closed Monday (open on holidays), some irregular days and 26–31 December (official site; Tabelog). Reservation only, at least two days ahead — no same-day bookings; cancellation fees 100% on the day, 50% the day before, 30% two days before; allergies must be notified in advance (official site; Tabelog). Courses: lunch ¥11,000 and ¥15,000, dinner ¥22,000 and ¥26,000, tax included, plus a 10% service charge (official site; Tabelog original サービス料10%). 10 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog; official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (official site; Tabelog). South side of Bukko-ji, Takatsuji-dori east of Takakura; 8 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (official site; Tabelog). Opened 10 November 2016 (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Takatsuji Takakura, south of Bukko-ji — 8 min walk from Karasuma / Shijo stations
places.cuisine: Counter kaiseki by a chef with 16 years at Kyoto Arashiyama Kitcho and 8 at Hiiragiya ryokan, built on vegetables grown for the shop by a farm of 300 years' standing inside the Shugakuin Imperial Villa (official site) · a monthly menu and hassun with a monthly theme, finishing with donabe rice — e.g. Shugakuin peas (official site; Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · the house plum sauce mixed with wasabi, served with sashimi and conger eel, a signature (2023–2026 reviews) · e.g. mackerel kizushi, fried crab shinjo, flounder, squid and tuna sashimi, namako oroshi-ae (February 2024); unagi simmered with sansho, fig, bonito with ponzu, Inca-no-mezame potatoes (October 2024); fried conger-eel bones, mackerel sushi in bamboo leaf, hojicha blancmange, kashiwa mochi (May 2026) · desserts homemade by the chef; mackerel sushi and the house seasonings to take away or ship (official site; May 2026) · antique Imari tableware (October 2024)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Takatsuji Takakura, Kitcho-trained, Shugakuin vegetables] A ten-seat counter south of Bukko-ji where owner-chef 八木一真, after 16 years at Arashiyama Kitcho and 8 at Hiiragiya, cooks monthly kaiseki around vegetables grown for the shop at a 300-year-old farm inside the Shugakuin Imperial Villa. Sashimi with the house plum sauce and wasabi, a themed hassun, donabe rice and homemade sweets are the talk of reviews. Lunch ¥11,000–15,000 (Wed, Fri, Sun), dinner ¥22,000–26,000, plus 10% service. Book at least two days ahead; give notice of allergies then. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 八木一真 (romaji not given in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the owner, 八木一真, decided to become a cook as a student on discovering the joy of being told the food was delicious, trained for 16 years at Kyoto Arashiyama Kitcho and 8 years at Hiiragiya ryokan, and opened Kanzan; the shop marked its 10th anniversary on 10 November 2026. A July 2023 reviewer says the head chef comes from a family of pottery craftsmen. Reviewers describe the chef with a service staff member (January 2026) and the chef and the owner running the place together (May 2026). The official site carries a notice titled "ミシュランガイド京都・大阪2026" (April 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Particular about Kyoto vegetables — using vegetables raised in the land of the Shugakuin Imperial Villa, rich in water and soil" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Plum sauce with wasabi; monthly hassun; mackerel sushi.

anecdotes.text: "I was told to mix wasabi into the plum sauce before tasting it. Skeptical, I tried it, and on the first bite... Wow!" — October 2025.
An August 2023 couple ended the evening chatting with the other guests and the chef, who shared tips on other Kyoto spots — and bought three bottles of the plum-wine soy sauce to take home.
The June 2026 hassun took the summer purification ring of reeds as its theme, which set the table talking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 店主 八木一真、学生時代に料理の喜びを知り、京都嵐山吉兆で16年、柊家旅館で8年修行して観山を開業、修学院離宮の地で育った野菜 (300年の歴史ある農家)、2日前までの完全予約制、キャンセル料 当日100%・前日50%・2日前30%、昼は水・金・日 12:00〜14:00 (最終入店12:00) 11,000円・15,000円、夜 18:00〜22:00 (最終入店20:30) 22,000円・26,000円、税込・サービス料10%別、月曜定休 (祝日は営業)・不定休・12月26〜31日休業、カウンター10席、カード可、鯖寿司や合わせ調味料の持ち帰り・地方発送、2026年11月10日に10周年、お知らせ「ミシュランガイド京都・大阪2026」。食べログ: 日本料理・釜飯、下京区高辻通高倉泉正寺町465-2 たかくらビル1F、サービス料10%、アレルギーは事前に。口コミ (2023年3月〜2026年6月、英語): 梅だれにわさび、月替わりの八寸、土鍋ご飯、修学院の豆、自家製の甘味、伊万里の器、陶芸の家の出身。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online at least two days ahead; notify allergies when booking; 10% service; cards accepted.

staff_allergy_handling: Allergies must be notified in advance; requests on the day cannot be accommodated (Tabelog).

places.name: 志る幸 (Shiruko)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Miso soups (white, red and clear) with a choice of fillings, and the Rikyu bento of grilled fish, chicken, miso-dressed vegetables, tofu and kayaku rice; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soups on dashi, and a bento with grilled salmon and chicken; a reviewer expecting a vegetarian meal found it was not (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–15:00 (last entry 14:00) and 17:00–21:00 (last entry 20:00); closed Wednesday (open on holidays) and occasionally (Tabelog). The official site gives dinner last entry 19:00 and also closes Tuesday evening. Tabelog lists no reservations, but a reviewer booked by phone two days ahead (October 2026); kaiseki needs a reservation (official site). Queues form before holiday openings (September 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 29 seats: about 10 at the counter and a tatami room with 3 tables for 10–20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Low counter seats (August 2026). Takeaway (Tabelog). In a lane east of Kawaramachi just north of Shijo; 2 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Hankyu) (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Lane east of Kawaramachi just north of Shijo — 2 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Soup house founded in 1932: a cup of soup — white miso, red miso or clear — with over ten fillings to choose from, after the old custom of 汁講 where guests brought rice and the host served only soup (official site) · the Rikyu bento, a tea-style tenshin of five small dishes (e.g. grilled salmon, chicken, kogomi, cucumber with miso, yuzu-scented tofu), kayaku rice, white-miso soup and pickles, ¥3,300 in 2026 (official site; 2026 reviews) · soup fillings such as tofu, otoshi-imo (grated yam), sweet potato or sea bream for a supplement (2026 reviews) · à la carte from ¥550 and kaiseki by reservation (official site, older prices) · tai chirimen to take home (official site)
places.notes: [Soup house · Kawaramachi, since 1932] A soup house down a lane off Kawaramachi, open since 1932, with a counter built like a Noh stage and seats styled on the railings of the Sanjo and Gojo bridges. The draw is the Rikyu bento (¥3,300): five small dishes, kayaku rice and a bowl of sweet white-miso soup — swap the tofu for grated yam or sweet potato. Light, gentle flavours; small portions. Cash only; queues before opening on holidays. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in Showa 7 (1932); the name comes from 汁講, a frugal custom in which guests brought rice and the host provided only soup, said to descend from a Heian-period practice; the interior keeps the founder's touches — a counter modelled on a Noh stage and seats styled after the railings of the Sanjo and Gojo bridges. A September 2026 reviewer saw artisans and the head chef bustling about.
chef_bio.philosophy: "The spirit of hospitality put into a single cup of soup" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Rikyu bento; white-miso soup.

anecdotes.text: "The miso soup made with white miso was truly delicious; I even went searching for where to buy that miso afterward." — August 2026.
A September 2026 visitor arrived 20 minutes before a holiday opening to no queue — and found three groups waiting 15 minutes later.
"When I looked up the Rikyu Bento on Tabelog, I imagined it would be more like a simple vegetarian meal, but it was completely different." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 志る幸 (しるこう)、昭和七年創業、「汁講」に由来、汁は白味噌・赤味噌・すましの三種、具は常時十種類以上、能舞台を模したカウンター、三条・五条大橋の欄干に見立てた席、名物の利久辨當 (茶事風の点心)、一品・汁物550円〜、懐石は要予約 (税・サービス料5%別)、お土産に鯛ちりめん、11:30〜15:00 (最終入店14:00)・17:00〜21:00 (最終入店19:00)、火曜の夜・水曜・不定休。食べログ: 日本料理・弁当、下京区西木屋町四条上ル真町100、河原町駅から徒歩2分、水曜休み、予約不可、現金のみ、29席、座敷 (10〜20名)、禁煙、テイクアウト。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 利久弁当3,300円、白味噌汁、落とし芋やさつまいもに替えられる、かやくご飯、低いカウンター席、祝日は開店前から行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Order the Rikyu bento and choose the soup filling; cash only; low counter seats.
