places.name: 京都肉割烹 みや田 (Kyoto Niku Kappou Miyata)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu courses with ponzu, a tenderloin sandwich, beef tempura and spring rolls; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses built entirely around Kyoto black wagyu (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:00, irregular closures (Tabelog). Courses only, no à la carte; bookings reserve a seat and the course is chosen on arrival; two-hour seating (Tabelog); premium anniversary courses are online-only (2026 reviews). 10% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料10%). 12 counter seats; private hire possible; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) (Tabelog). A machiya of 1890 at the end of a stone-paved alley off Kitakoji, 8–10 min walk from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 15 July 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kitakoji off Shinmachi — 8 min walk from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: "Niku kappo": Kyoto black wagyu served in kappo style at a counter (Tabelog) · courses ¥20,000 and ¥22,000 premium (2026 reviews) · e.g. seared wagyu with lotus-root sauce or ponzu jelly and figs, wagyu tataki, beef sashimi with swordtip squid, strip-loin rice bowl with pickled daikon, beef shabu-shabu soup, tenderloin sandwich, beef tempura or spring rolls, roast beef salad, Chateaubriand, sudachi sorbet (September–November 2026) · sake, shochu, wine (Tabelog) · birthday dessert plate on request (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Wagyu kappo · near Kyoto Station, an 1890 townhouse] A twelve-seat counter in an 1890 Kyoto townhouse at the end of a quiet stone alley, eight minutes from Kyoto Station, that serves Kyoto black wagyu as a kappo course: seared with ponzu jelly, as tataki and sashimi, in a strip-loin rice bowl, a tenderloin sandwich, shabu-shabu soup and tempura. Courses about ¥20,000–22,000 plus 10% service; two-hour seatings. Open daily, lunch and dinner.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 15 July 2023 in a Kyoto townhouse built in 1890 and remodelled, serving selected Kyoto beef in a style that highlights each cut ("meat kappo"); the invoice registration is a corporate number. Reviewers in 2026 describe watered garden stones at the entrance, high ceilings and cooking in front of the counter.
chef_bio.philosophy: Selected Kyoto beef served in a style that highlights the qualities of each cut (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Strip-loin and pickled-daikon rice bowl; tenderloin sandwich.

anecdotes.text: A mother and daughter in September 2026 were welcomed through a narrow alley where the garden had just been watered.
A September 2026 pair noted that the house took care not to seat guests too close together.
"The sirloin course along with 2 to 3 drinks each came to just under JPY 40,000." — two guests, September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 牛料理・ステーキ、下京区北小路通新町西入井筒町656、京都駅から徒歩8分、毎日 12:00〜14:00・17:00〜22:00、不定休、コースのみ (アラカルトなし)、予約は席のみで来店後にコースを選ぶ、2時間制、サービス料10%、12席 (カウンターのみ)、貸切可、禁煙、カード可、1890年築の京町家を改装、京都牛を肉割烹で、誕生日のデザートプレート、2023年7月15日オープン。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): コース20,000円・22,000円 (記念日のプレミアムはネット予約のみ)、和牛のあぶりとポン酢ジュレ、たたき、牛刺しとけんさきいか、ロースとたくあんのご飯、牛しゃぶのお椀、ヒレカツサンド、牛の天ぷらや春巻き、シャトーブリアン、すだちのシャーベット。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a seat, choose the course on arrival; two-hour seating; 10% service; cards accepted.

places.name: 串市 (Kushi Ichi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kushikatsu in a wheat batter and breadcrumbs, fried in shared oil (2021–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shared fryer with meat and seafood skewers; the starter includes oden (2022 review).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–4:00 (last order 3:30); closed Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; a Saturday table was secured by phone (Tabelog; February 2022). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 12 seats: a counter of about 10 and two small tables (Tabelog; December 2021, December 2024). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). In a narrow lane between Kiyamachi and the north end of Pontocho, by the Pontocho Kaburenjo theatre; 3 min from Sanjo Stn (2021–26 reviews).
places.neighborhood: North end of Pontocho, off Kiyamachi — 3 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kushikatsu with a light, thin batter, until 4 a.m. (2021–26 reviews) · a starter of pickles and oden (February 2022) · whole shrimp eaten head to tail with tartar sauce, asparagus, beef fillet cutlet, ham and potato, white fish paste with pickled ginger, kombu with roe, burdock, mizu-nasu eggplant, manganji pepper stuffed with shrimp, mushrooms, seasonal skewers (2021–24 reviews) · octopus karaage, salt-cured beef cheek sashimi, raw oysters (2021–22 reviews) · beer, highballs, sake, shochu, wine (Tabelog; 2024) · bills about ¥2,000–6,000 a head (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Kushikatsu · Kiyamachi, a former boxer's counter open till 4 a.m.] A twelve-seat counter in a lane at the top of Pontocho where the owner, a former boxer, fries skewers in a batter so thin that diners keep ordering: whole shrimp with tartar sauce, asparagus, beef fillet, kombu with roe, ham and potato. Pickles and oden to start; beer and sake to go with it. Full of regulars and friendly to newcomers. Cash only; smoking allowed. 18:00–4:00, closed Thursday.

roles: Owner-cook (unnamed; a former boxer per 2023–24 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the kushikatsu as made by a former boxer (September 2023, December 2024) and the owner as friendly and welcoming to first-timers among the many regulars (September 2023, March 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Kushikatsu; shrimp with tartar sauce.

anecdotes.text: "The paper doesn’t get oily... it’s amazing!" — July 2022.
A September 2023 visitor, nervous among the regulars, ended up drinking with the friendly owner.
A December 2021 diner liked the kombu with roe so much it was ordered twice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 串揚げ・居酒屋、中京区木屋町三条下ル材木町140番地 河きたビル1F、三条駅から175m、18:00〜翌4:00 (L.O. 3:30)、木曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、12席、カウンター、喫煙可、魚介と肉の串、日本酒・焼酎・ワイン・カクテル。口コミ (2021年12月〜2026年3月、英語): 先斗町の北の端の細い路地、Kaburenjo の前、元ボクサーの店主、薄く軽い衣、海老とタルタル、アスパラ、ヘレカツ、ハムポテト、昆布、お通しは漬物とおでん、常連が多い、気さくな店主。

cultural_comfort.note: Order skewers by name at the counter; bring cash; smoking allowed.

places.name: アーマー (Armor)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A coffee shop of toast, sandwiches and fried cutlets; the daily lunch is a rice set (2024–26 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Coffee is fine; food is egg sandwiches, meat set lunches with miso soup and cream desserts (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 7:30–20:00 daily (Tabelog). Morning sets, a daily lunch and an evening menu (May 2026, Japanese review). No reservations listed (Tabelog). 14 seats, counter and tables; it fills up and is a little cramped (Tabelog; June 2024, May 2026). Cash or QR payment; no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Tabelog lists smoking as heated tobacco only; an August 2024 diner found it non-smoking inside. On Sakaimachi-dori just north of Nishiki, 333 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; 2024 reviews). Takeout orders (June 2024).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi-dori by Nishiki Market — a few minutes from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Old Showa-style kissa near Nishiki Market (2024 reviews) · morning sets: A set of egg sandwich, salad, fruit and drink ¥650; B set with anko toast (August 2024, July 2025; June 2024) · mixed sandwich (half) ¥580, shrimp-fry sandwich with coffee ¥1,650 (2024) · daily lunch with miso soup and coffee — ginger pork, teriyaki chicken with vegetables, tonkatsu, beef cutlet with side dishes (2024–26 reviews) · pudding with cream and orange (May 2024) · iced coffee ¥420 (June 2024), iced café au lait ¥540 (May 2026)
places.notes: [Kissa · Nishiki Market, the vendors' coffee shop] A small, brown-walled Showa coffee shop a few steps from Nishiki Market, run single-handed, where locals and market traders come for a ¥650 morning set of egg sandwich, salad, fruit and coffee, or a hearty daily lunch — ginger pork, tonkatsu, teriyaki chicken — with miso soup and coffee. The shrimp-fry sandwich is huge. Cash or QR only. Open 7:30–20:00 daily.

chef_bio.background: An August 2024 diner found the owner running the shop alone; reviewers describe a homely, old-fashioned coffee shop with a Showa atmosphere, a resting spot for Nishiki Market traders (April–June 2024).
chef_bio.specialty: Morning sets; daily lunch.

anecdotes.text: "Are you sure you don’t want a half portion?" — the question with the shrimp-fry sandwich, April 2024.
A June 2024 diner found the shop early-opening and good value but cramped and quick to fill, not a place to linger.
An August 2024 diner noted the old ashtrays and brown wallpaper, a clean interior, and the owner working alone.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 喫茶店、中京区堺町通錦小路上る菊屋町531、烏丸駅から333m、毎日7:30〜20:00、14席、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、加熱式たばこのみ喫煙可。口コミ (2024年4月〜2026年6月): 錦市場の近く、昭和の喫茶店、モーニング A セット650円、エビフライサンド、ミックスサンド、日替わりランチ (豚のしょうが焼き、照り焼きチキン、とんかつ)、みそ汁、プリン、店主一人で営業 (2024年8月)、モーニングやイブニングもあるという声 (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Order the morning set or daily lunch at the counter; cash or QR.

places.name: ぎおん 元勢 (Gion Motose)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo cooking with dashi and soy; à la carte includes a katsu sandwich and tantanmen (2024–26 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, game and dashi throughout (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed some Sundays and public holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day cancellation is charged 100% of the course (Tabelog). Guests are asked not to wear perfume or strong scents (Tabelog). Omakase courses ¥20,000, ¥25,000 and ¥30,000 before tax and a 10% service charge (¥24,200 and ¥30,250 with both), or à la carte from a handwritten menu (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews). 20 seats: 10 at the counter, a table for 6 and a tatami room for 4 upstairs; a bar salon on the second floor (Tabelog). Smoking allowed in the private room; ashtrays outside (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Reopened after renovation in March 2026 (March and May 2026). In a lane off Hanamikoji, south of Shijo; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; November 2024).
places.neighborhood: Gion, off Hanamikoji south of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion kappo of seasonal fish and game, as an omakase course or à la carte, with sake chosen by a certified sake sommelier and wines by a wine sommelier (Tabelog, shop text) · game: wild boar, badger, bear hot pot, deer, green sea turtle and suppon (May 2024, November 2025, January 2026) · Akashi sea bream sashimi, Matsuba crab in yuzu, sweet shrimp with tosa-vinegar jelly, sea-bream sushi, grilled conger eel, grilled fugu, Kyoto Akajidori chicken (2024–26 reviews) · to finish: takikomi gohan, oyster rice, a mini beef bowl, small tantanmen, game keema curry; ricotta pudding (2024–26 reviews) · katsu sandwich to take home (November 2024, March 2026) · omakase ¥20,000–30,000 plus tax and 10% service (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion, fish and wild game] A Gion kappo, renovated in 2026, where the chef cooks seasonal fish alongside rare game — wild boar, badger, bear hot pot, even sea turtle in a special course — as an omakase or from a handwritten à la carte list. Sake is chosen by a sake sommelier; finish with takikomi gohan or a mini tantanmen and take home a katsu sandwich. The counter gets loud with a lively chef and regulars, and the upstairs bar louder later. Omakase from ¥20,000 plus tax and 10% service. Evenings only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): seasonal Kyoto cooking and game in a Kansai kaiseki format, with drinks chosen by a sake sommelier and a wine sommelier, and a bar salon upstairs. Reviewers describe the head chef as friendly, chatty and loud (October 2024, March 2025, January 2026); the restaurant reopened after renovation in March 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Game; omakase or à la carte.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner found the full counter, matching the chef’s energy, too loud to hear the explanations of the dishes.
A November 2025 diner found the staff kind to children, but warned that the second-floor bar gets loud later in the evening.
An August 2024 diner joked that the chef’s handwritten à la carte menu is hard to read.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・海鮮、東山区祇園町南側570番地6、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、日曜・祝日不定休、予約可、当日キャンセルはコース料金の100%、香水など強い香りは控えて、サービス料10%、おまかせコース20,000円・25,000円・30,000円 (税・サービス料別)、20席 (1階カウンター10席、テーブル6名、2階個室4名)、個室は喫煙可、カード可、日本酒のソムリエとワインソムリエ、2階にバーサロン。口コミ (2024年5月〜2026年5月、英語): ジビエ (猪、アナグマ、熊鍋、鹿、アオウミガメ、すっぽん)、Akashi の鯛、松葉蟹、手書きのアラカルト、カツサンドの持ち帰り、2026年3月に改装して再開、店主が賑やかで店内がうるさいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; omakase or à la carte; no strong perfume; same-day cancellation charged in full.

places.name: Da YUGE
places.gf_detail: Ask. A single course built around three or four handmade wheat pastas, with homemade bread (2026 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the course opens with pasta in shark broth with caviar and includes fish, shellfish and beef (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–22:00, last entry 19:00; closed Sunday and some Mondays (Tabelog). Reservation only; starts are staggered by about 15 minutes (Tabelog; August 2026). One monthly course, Menu Degustazione ¥22,000 with tax, for 1–4 per booking, plus a 5% service charge (Tabelog; September 2026). Extra "Tonnarelli in salsa" ¥1,620 for 40 g (August–September 2026). 13 counter seats round an open kitchen, facing a small garden; private hire up to 20; non-smoking, smoking area outside; cards (Tabelog). A renovated townhouse on Sakaimachi-dori north of Oike, 5 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 3 April 2026 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi-dori north of Oike — 5 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-Italian monthly course by Keita Yuge, 2019 Pasta World Championship winner, with about ten dishes and handmade pasta (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · Menu Degustazione ¥22,000 (September 2026) · July–September 2026: cold capellini in Kesennuma shark broth with kombu-cured caviar; Akashi akou with passion fruit and cucumber; abalone with corn; squid-ink tagliolini with black truffle; corzetti with pesto and ragù; tagliolini with lobster and tomato; red-wine risotto with beef cheek; Nakayama Farm beef from Hiroshima with Kamo eggplant (2026 reviews) · "Tonnarelli in salsa", the championship pasta, as an extra ¥1,620 (August–September 2026) · Italian and Japanese wines, pairing available (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Gosho-minami, the pasta world champion's counter] A 13-seat counter in a renovated townhouse off Oike, opened in April 2026 by Keita Yuge, winner of the 2019 Pasta World Championship. One monthly course of about ten dishes for ¥22,000 — a cold capellini in shark broth with caviar, squid-ink tagliolini, a risotto, Hiroshima beef — with the championship tonnarelli as an extra. Most diners are delighted; one August 2026 diner found it rushed and overpriced. Plus 5% service. Book well ahead; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviewers: sous-chef at Il Teatrino da Salone in Minami-Aoyama, head chef at Quintocanto in Osaka and then at Salone 2007 in Yokohama; winner of the Pasta World Championship 2019 (July and September 2026). Opened Da YUGE in a renovated townhouse said to be about 100 years old on 3 April 2026 (Tabelog; September 2026). Reviewers mention a YouTube channel (July and August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a new "Kyoto Italian" spun in Kyoto.
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade pasta; Tonnarelli in salsa.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner found the dishes arriving every five minutes, plate temperatures uneven, and the course overpriced for its quality.
A July 2026 diner asked for glasses of red instead of a pairing, which made the chef laugh.
An August 2026 diner celebrating a 60th birthday was given a special plate of mango sorbet and orange madeleine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (dayuge.jp): 料理人弓削啓太が提案する京都の地で紡ぐ新たな【京イタリアン】。食べログ: イタリアン、中京区堺町通押小路上ル竹屋町158-2、烏丸御池駅から徒歩約5分、月〜土 18:00〜22:00 (最終入店19:00)、日曜・一部月曜休み、完全予約制、Menu Degustazione 22,000円 (税込)、サービス料5%、カウンター13席、貸切20名まで、禁煙 (屋外に喫煙所)、カード可、2026年4月3日オープン、2019年パスタ世界大会優勝のシェフ、日本とイタリアのワイン。口コミ (2026年7〜9月、英語): Kesennuma のサメの出汁と昆布締めキャビアの冷製パスタ、イカスミの tagliolini、Tonnarelli in salsa (40g 1,620円)、町家を改装、オープンキッチン、坪庭、急ぎすぎで割高だという声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; one fixed course; dishes are explained; cards accepted.

places.name: ももてる (Momoteru)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Home-style izakaya dishes from a handwritten menu; fried dishes (breaded swordfish, shrimp tempura, fried chicken, spring rolls) and egg sandwiches are not gluten-free (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, meat, egg and cheese throughout; some vegetable dishes such as komatsuna with walnut dressing or lotus root in vinegar — ask (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:30–23:00, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; groups of more than four are often not possible (Tabelog); busy with regulars, so check before going (September 2025). No cards or e-money; QR payments accepted (Tabelog). 11 counter seats; a low door you stoop to enter (Tabelog; September 2025). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Two burners only, so dishes can take time when full (March 2026). Down a back lane off Ayanokoji west of Sakaimachi, 293 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: A lane off Ayanokoji near Shijo-Karasuma — 293 m from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Counter izakaya of home-style, creative small dishes from a handwritten menu (2024–2026 reviews) · potato salads that change flavour — with salmon roe and shiso, or blue cheese — and can be refilled in another (2024–2026) · kitsune cheese, young-corn spring rolls with cheese, komatsuna with walnut dressing, anchovy cabbage, tonteki (June 2026) · breaded swordfish, roast beef loin, asparagus with salted kombu (September 2024) · scallops simmered with Inaniwa udon in season, chive omelette (May 2024; September 2025) · lotus root and chrysanthemum in vinegar, sanma Arima-yaki, beef tendon with shishito, a mushroom-and-meat rice to finish (October 2024) · egg sandwich, keema curry with egg, fried chicken, shrimp tempura (2025–2026) · beer, Fushimi sake, shochu, wine (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma, Momoko’s counter in a back lane] Stoop through a low door in a lane off Ayanokoji into an eleven-seat counter run by Momoko, where regulars chat across to newcomers and sometimes share plates. The handwritten menu is home cooking with a twist: potato salads in changing flavours, kitsune cheese, breaded swordfish, anchovy cabbage, an egg sandwich, keema curry. Two burners only, so be patient when it is full. No cards (QR is fine); smoking allowed; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (named Momoko in a September 2024 review), who cooks
chef_bio.background: A September 2024 reviewer names the owner as Momoko and enjoyed the lively talk between Momoko and the regulars; an August 2026 reviewer credits the food to Momo. Reviewers describe a long-standing local haunt where regulars talk with newcomers.
chef_bio.specialty: Changing potato salads; egg sandwich.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 regular on an eleventh visit tried young-corn spring rolls — the corn looked more grown-up than young — and was handed a taste of a neighbouring regular’s food.
An October 2024 first-timer, sent by a colleague who had moved to Kyoto, was surprised by an otoshi of a whole sea-bream head and found the drinks list scribbled on a fan.
A September 2024 visitor came after seeing a lawyer’s post on Twitter, and found the breaded swordfish as fluffy as high-end French cooking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ももてる、居酒屋・焼酎バー・創作料理、下京区綾小路堺町西入ル綾材木町197、烏丸駅から293m、月〜土 18:30〜23:00、日曜休み、予約可 (4人以上は難しいことが多い)、カード・電子マネー不可、QR可、カウンター11席、喫煙可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 店主の Momoko さん、手書きのメニュー、味の変わるポテトサラダ (いくらと大葉、ブルーチーズ)、きつねチーズ、ヤングコーンの春巻き、小松菜のくるみ和え、アンチョビキャベツ、トンテキ、かじきのパン粉焼き、帆立と Inaniwa のうどん、ニラ玉、さんまの Arima 焼き、牛すじとししとう、玉子サンド、キーマカレー、常連が多くあたたかい雰囲気、コンロは2口。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter of regulars; book ahead, groups over four hard; no cards (QR accepted); smoking allowed.

places.name: Restaurant muni
places.gf_detail: Ask. French and Western-style dishes including fried tuna-katsu and fish burgers, puff pastry, omurice with demi-glace, hamburg steak and curry, which are not or may not be gluten-free (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Limited: the shop says on Tabelog that it offers a vegan menu and vegetarian options; the regular courses are fish and meat — ask ahead (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) Wednesday–Sunday; dinner 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00) Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday, all day on the 1st and 3rd Tuesday, and at lunch on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday; updates on Google and Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; 15 minutes late may count as a cancellation; cancellation fees the day before and on the day (Tabelog). Seat and service charge ¥200 per person; corkage ¥2,000 per person (Tabelog, original text). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 at the counter, 12 at tables, and a box seat for four by the wine cellar (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff; sommelier (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). Next to the Pontocho Kaburenjo, 3 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 14 July 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi by the Pontocho Kaburenjo — 3 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: French and Western-style bistro built on fish from Sasue Maeda Fish Shop of Yaizu, Shizuoka, and vegetables from the chef’s family farm (2026 reviews) · lunch courses of about five dishes, meat or fish (September–October 2026) · omurice set ¥2,900 + ¥200 charge — fish soup, a fish starter and demi-glace omurice (October 2026) · ¥10,000 dinner course (September 2026) · dishes reviewed: shrimp and soybean potage, horse-mackerel terrine, steamed sea bream with yuzu-kosho miso, red snapper in puff pastry, fish burger and tuna-katsu burger, Shiga venison, wagyu roasted over whisky-barrel wood, cream risotto, curry to finish (July–October 2026) · Kobe beef at events only, by phone (Tabelog) · Kyoto craft beer, wine, sake (September 2026)
places.notes: [French bistro · Pontocho Kaburenjo, Sasue fish in Kyoto] A relaxed French-and-yoshoku restaurant next to the Pontocho Kaburenjo whose draw is fish from Sasue Maeda, the celebrated fishmonger of Yaizu, alongside vegetables from the chef’s family farm. Lunch runs from a ¥2,900 omurice set to five-course menus; dinner courses go to about ¥10,000, with fish burgers, puff-pastry snapper, wagyu over whisky-barrel wood and a curry to close. A vegan menu is offered. ¥200 charge; English spoken; closed Monday.

roles: Chef (named inconsistently in reviews; not used)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 14 July 2021. A September 2026 review says the chef trained in French cooking, placed second in the Toque d’Or contest for young chefs, and grows vegetables on the family farm. The shop says on Tabelog that kitchen trimmings go into demi-glace, consommé and staff meals, and that retired whisky-barrel wood fires the wagyu.
chef_bio.philosophy: The name muni means unique and unparalleled (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Sasue fish dishes; demi-glace omurice.

anecdotes.text: Two 2026 reviewers note that the omurice was eaten by the President of Ecuador on a visit.
A September 2026 family made a same-day booking with two children during Silver Week; the children had fried rice à la carte while the parents took the lunch course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Restaurant muni、フレンチ・ビストロ・ハンバーグ、中京区材木町176-3、Pontocho Kaburenjo の隣、三条駅から徒歩3分、昼11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:00) 水〜日、夜17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:00) 火〜日、月曜休み、第1・3火曜は終日、第1・3水曜は昼休み、予約可、当日・前日のキャンセル料あり、席料・サービス料1人200円、持ち込み料1人2,000円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、20席 (カウンター8、テーブル12)、禁煙、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、ソムリエ、子ども可、2021年7月14日オープン、Kobe 牛はイベント時のみ。店の取り組み: 端材でデミグラスやコンソメ、ウイスキー樽の薪で和牛を焼く、ヴィーガンメニュー。口コミ (2026年、英語): Yaizu の Sasue Maeda 魚店の魚、シェフの実家の畑の野菜、オムライスのセット2,900円、10,000円のコース、フィッシュバーガー、まぐろカツバーガー、締めのカレー。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); ¥200 charge; children welcome.

places.name: SAVORY (セイボリー)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Vegetable-led French courses with steak or fish, soups, potato bread and focaccia, and fruit parfaits; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the courses centre on vegetables from the rooftop farm, but mains are beef, fish or venison and desserts use dairy (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order), tea 14:00–16:30 (L.O. 16:00), dinner 17:30–21:00 (food L.O. 20:00, drinks 20:30); closed Wednesday (open on a holiday Wednesday, closed the next Thursday). Reservations by phone or in person only (Tabelog); 12:00 lunch slots fill up (October 2026). BYO bottle wine accepted, per a site notice. Cards: JCB, AMEX, Diners; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 60 seats; private room for 10–20 by reservation (Tabelog). Non-smoking; English menu (Tabelog). Third floor of 京都八百一本館 on Higashinotoin south of Sanjo, beside the building’s Rokkaku Farm; 375 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn (official site; Tabelog). Opened 24 April 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin south of Sanjo — 375 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Vegetable-led French in the restaurant of the greengrocer 京都八百一, with vegetables from the store and its rooftop Rokkaku Farm (official site; 2026 reviews) · lunch courses: vegetable-parfait starter, soup (corn, carrot, butternut, chestnut), potato bread and focaccia, a main of steak, Omi beef, sea bass in zucchini, fish in a magnolia leaf from the roof, or ayu confit cooked seven hours (May–October 2026) · venison steak recommended for autumn and winter (official site) · seasonal fruit parfaits — peach in summer; Shine Muscat pavlova for a limited time (2026 reviews; official site) · tea time 14:00–16:30 · wine and cocktails
places.notes: [French · Sanjo-Higashinotoin, lunch beside a rooftop farm] The third-floor restaurant of Kyoto Yaoichi Honkan, a greengrocer’s flagship, where you eat looking out on the building’s own rooftop farm. Lunch courses open with a vegetable parfait and run to steak, Omi beef or fish — once wrapped in a magnolia leaf from the roof — with seasonal fruit parfaits after; afternoons are for tea and parfait. Spacious and calm, popular for birthdays with family. Book by phone; closed Wednesday.

roles: Restaurant of 京都八百一本館 (operator 株式会社セントラルフルーツ)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the building houses the greengrocer 京都八百一, a deli, bakery, butcher, fishmonger and other shops, with SAVORY on the third floor and the Rokkaku Farm on the roof. Tabelog gives the opening as 24 April 2013.
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable-parfait starter; ayu confit; fruit parfaits.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular comes every year for the peach parfait.
A September 2026 father chose it for lunch to meet a daughter’s boyfriend, a gym-goer, for the health-conscious menu.
A September 2026 diner found the vegetable parfait a little disjointed and preferred the steamed vegetables a family member ordered.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都八百一本館、中京区三文字町220、3階のレストラン セイボリー、昼11:30〜15:00 (L.O)、ティータイム14:00〜16:30 (L.O.16:00)、夜17:30〜21:00 (フードL.O.20:00、ドリンクL.O.20:30)、水曜休み (祝日は営業、翌木曜休み)、屋上の六角農場、秋冬は鹿肉のステーキがおすすめ、期間限定のシャインマスカットのパブロバ、ボトルワインの持ち込み (BYO) の案内、運営は株式会社セントラルフルーツ (京都八百一)。食べログ: 東洞院通三条下る三文字町220 八百一本館3F、烏丸御池駅から375m、予約は電話か店頭のみ、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、60席、個室 (10〜20人)、禁煙、英語メニュー、ベジタリアン対応、2013年4月24日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 屋上の畑の野菜、野菜のパフェ、Omi 牛、鮎のコンフィ、朴葉包みの魚、桃のパフェ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book by phone; spacious seating.

places.name: 神宮道 じん (Jingu Michi Jin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo courses and à la carte of sashimi, dashi-based dishes and grills, with fried dishes (fried squid, shrimp-and-yam fritters) and eel rice; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, dashi, Tanba beef, eel (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–21:00; closed Wednesday; open on holidays and the days before and after (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Courses ¥15,000 and ¥20,000, or à la carte (Tabelog). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 12 seats: a counter and tables over sunken kotatsu, a private room for four; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; January 2026). BYO allowed; takeaway (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome, with care around the sunken seating (Tabelog). Upstairs, through an entrance at the edge of an eel restaurant, on Jingu-michi in sight of the Heian Shrine torii; 5 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; January 2026). Opened 2 June 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Jingu-michi, by the Heian Shrine torii — 5 min from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Kappo counter of seasonal Kyoto cooking, courses or à la carte from the board (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · courses ¥15,000 and ¥20,000 (Tabelog) · spring course: firefly squid in soy, white-sesame salad with strawberry, sashimi of sea bream, tuna, squid and sea urchin (March 2026) · summer: pumpkin and hamo cold dishes, hamo, octopus, Biwa trout, Yanagawa hot pot, ayu, potato salad with sansho, Tanba beef fillet (July 2025) · winter seko-gani (December 2025) · à la carte: whale bacon, grilled mehikari, fried squid, cream cheese with nara-zuke, soft-shelled-turtle porridge, unadon (2025–2026 reviews) · a strong sake list; wine
places.notes: [Kappo · Okazaki, a counter in sight of the Heian Shrine torii] Upstairs on Jingu-michi, a twelve-seat counter run by a chef who trained at Tankuma, then spent more than a decade at Inaba and Gion Ima, and opened here in 2024 with the chef’s wife at front of house. Order a course (¥15,000 or ¥20,000) or graze à la carte from the board in small portions: hamo and ayu in summer, seko-gani in winter, whale bacon, a soft-shelled-turtle porridge to finish. Warm, chatty hosts. Closed Wednesday.

roles: The chef’s wife, front of house (September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop’s Tabelog introduction: trained for several years at Tankuma, then honed skills at Inaba and Gion Ima for more than ten years, and opened this restaurant in June 2024 where the Heian Shrine torii can be seen. A March 2026 reviewer gives thirteen years at Gion Ima, a kaiseki house that turns away first-time guests.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal dishes enjoyed while chatting at the counter (shop’s Tabelog introduction).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kappo; soft-shelled-turtle porridge.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor was briefly lost at an entrance tucked beside an eel restaurant; on leaving, the owner came to the door to say goodbye with "Please come again!"
A September 2026 diner fell into conversation with two local regulars at the counter and booked again for New Year’s Eve, when the shop will open.
A May 2026 regular on a ninth visit went à la carte from the board for the first time and finished with soft-shelled-turtle porridge.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 神宮道 じん、日本料理、東山区堀池町374-5、東山駅から徒歩5分、17:00〜21:00、水曜休み、予約可、コース15,000円と20,000円、アラカルトも、カード可、12席、掘りごたつ、4人の個室、持ち込み可、禁煙、子ども可、2024年6月2日オープン。店の紹介: Tankuma で数年修業、その後 Inaba と Gion Ima で十年以上、2024年6月に平安神宮の鳥居が見える場所に開店、カウンターで会話を楽しみながら季節の料理を。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 店主と妻の明るい人柄、ほたるいかの醤油漬け、鱧、鮎、Tanba 牛のヒレ、せこがに、くじらベーコン、めひかり、すっぽん雑炊、うな丼、小さめのポーション、うなぎ屋の端の入口から2階へ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; courses or à la carte in small portions; sunken kotatsu seating.

places.name: 近江牛 すき焼き しゃぶしゃぶ 都 (Omi-gyu Sukiyaki Shabushabu Miyako)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The sukiyaki pot includes yaki-fu and nama-fu (wheat gluten) with a sweet soy sauce; meat sushi and appetizers also served; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef restaurant; pork can replace beef on request, except in the steak course (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:30 (last order 21:00); open all year (Tabelog). Bookings taken; one course per person; seating limited to 90 minutes when busy, except the special course; pork instead of beef if requested ahead (Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし" (its English translation says a charge is added). 20 seats at 5 tables, up a flight of stairs on the 2nd floor; private hire up to 50; non-smoking; children welcome, kids' menu; English and Traditional Chinese menus; English-, Chinese- and Korean-speaking staff; cards, PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog; October 2026). 3 min from Sanjo or Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi near Sanjo — 3 min from Sanjo or Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Sukiyaki, shabu-shabu and steak of A5 certified Omi beef (female cattle) and A5 Kobe beef; the staff cook the Kanto-style sukiyaki, melting a ball of cotton candy over the meat in place of sugar (Tabelog) · lunch sukiyaki sets with special Omi loin: 150 g ¥6,600, 200 g ¥8,140 (September 2026) · courses: sukiyaki with two pieces of meat sushi ¥8,800; Kobe-beef version ¥11,770; Kobe beef "Miyako" special course of sukiyaki, shabu-shabu and steak ¥17,600 (Tabelog); eight-appetizer Omi beef course ¥9,350 (October 2026) · the pot has vegetables, shirataki, tofu, yaki-fu and nama-fu; eggs from Oita, rice from Hachidaime Gihei, miso soup, pickles and matcha pudding (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sukiyaki · Kawaramachi near Sanjo] A calm 2nd-floor room where staff cook A5 Omi or Kobe beef sukiyaki for you, melting a ball of cotton candy over the meat instead of sugar. Lunch sets from about ¥6,600; courses with meat sushi from ¥8,800. English menu and multilingual staff; no service charge per Tabelog's Japanese text. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 August 2024 (Tabelog). Per the operator: only certified A5 Omi beef from female cattle and A5 Kobe beef; a sister shop, 都和 祇園四条店, with semi-private rooms, for when this one is full.
chef_bio.specialty: Cotton-candy sukiyaki.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner exclaimed "Wow!" as the staff melted the cotton candy over the beef.
An October 2026 visitor warned to mind the stairs up to the 2nd-floor room.
A weekday lunch booked a week ahead was calm enough to relax — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 近江牛 すき焼き しゃぶしゃぶ 都、すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ・ステーキ、中京区大黒町42-3 山新ビル 2F、三条駅・京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分、11:30〜15:30 (L.O. 14:00)・17:00〜22:30 (L.O. 21:00)、年中無休、1人1コース、混雑時は90分制、牛肉が食べられない方は豚肉に変更可、サービス料: なし、20席 (テーブル5卓)、子供可、英語・繁体字のメニュー、2024年8月10日オープン、綿あめで作るすき焼き、A5 の認定近江牛 (雌牛) と神戸牛、姉妹店 都和 祇園四条店、肉寿司付きすき焼きコース8,800円、神戸牛11,770円、都スペシャルコース17,600円。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): ランチのすき焼きセット150g 6,600円・200g 8,140円、前菜8品のコース9,350円、大分の卵、Hachidaime Gihei の米、焼き麩と生麩。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; English-, Chinese- and Korean-speaking staff (Tabelog); staff cook the pot for you.

places.name: 肉の大橋亭 (Niku no Ohashi Tei)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the hot food is breaded and fried — croquettes, menchi-katsu and cutlets (2021–25 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a butcher; the croquettes are beef, fried with a lard aroma per a November 2021 reviewer.
places.hours_raw: 10:00–17:30; closed Sunday (official site). Tabelog lists 10:00–17:30 every day. Croquettes and cutlets are fried to order, about 6–8 minutes (2022–23 reviews). A meat sale on the 29th of the month ("meat day"), e.g. 29 October 2026 (official site; September 2022). Three seats on pipe chairs inside to eat hot (Tabelog; April 2024). Cards from ¥3,000 per a March 2023 reviewer; QR payments (Tabelog). On Matsubara-dori just west of Yamato-oji; 373 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Matsubara-dori west of Yamato-oji, near Rokuharamitsu-ji — 373 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: A butcher selling Omi beef and other meats, miso-marinated meat, retort curry and hamburgers (Tabelog; official site; August 2022) · fried to order to eat on the spot or take away: Omi beef croquette ¥180 (2022–24; ¥100 on sale days), Omi beef menchi-katsu ¥300, Omi beef mince burger ¥380, wagyu fillet cutlet ¥600, black wagyu thigh cutlet ¥450, croquette burger ¥380; a limited mince sandwich that sells out (2022–24 reviews)
places.notes: [Butcher's croquettes · Matsubara-dori, since 1894] An old Omi-beef butcher near Rokuharamitsu-ji that fries croquettes and cutlets to order — an Omi beef croquette was ¥180 in 2022–24 — to eat hot on one of three stools or carry away. Neighbourhood regulars come in for the meat. Closed Sunday per the official site.

roles: Family firm (大橋商事); no person named for today
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: founded in Kyoto in 1894 by the first-generation Zen'emon Ohashi (romaji only), dealing in quality meat ever since; the official site's title reads "総本家 肉の大橋亭 | 近江牛匠技・創業明治二十七年". Reviewers say it once supplied the shogunate (2021–22 reviews). The official site lists this main shop and a processing centre in Minami-ku; recent site news (September and October 2026) announces sales and a stall at the Kyoto meat festival in Okazaki.
chef_bio.specialty: Omi beef croquette.

anecdotes.text: On sale day in November 2021 the Omi beef croquette dropped from ¥180 to ¥100.
An April 2024 diner ate a croquette burger and a wagyu cutlet on a pipe chair while neighbourhood regulars kept coming in.
A March 2023 reviewer found it delicious but "a bit on the pricier side".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ohashitei.co.jp): 総本家 肉の大橋亭、近江牛匠技・創業明治二十七年、本店 東山区松原通大和大路西入ル弓矢町11、10:00〜17:30、定休日 日曜日、南加工センター (南区吉祥院)、2026年9月の秋の大売出し、2026年10月29日の肉の日セール、第11回京都肉祭に出店。食べログ: コロッケ、10:00〜17:30 (毎日)、3席、カード・QR 可、明治27年に初代 (英語訳では Zen'emon Ohashi) が創業。口コミ (2017〜2025年、英語): 近江牛コロッケ180円、ミンチカツ300円、ヒレカツ600円、揚げたてを店内で、カードは3,000円から。

cultural_comfort.note: Point and order at the counter; wait a few minutes for frying.

places.name: 祇園ゆやま (Gion Yuyama)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kappo kaiseki with dashi soups, yuba and fish; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seasonal fish, tuna, duck and dashi-based soups (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only; online booking takes one person (Tabelog; April 2026). Cancellation: 100% on the day, 80% the day before (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; January 2026). 8 counter seats with a sunken (horigotatsu) footwell — shoes off at the entrance — plus tea-room-style private rooms for 4 or 6 (Tabelog; July 2026). Tatami rooms may not suit limited mobility (October 2026). English- and Chinese-speaking staff (July 2026). On Shinbashi-dori east of Hanamikoji; near Yasaka Shrine and Chion-in (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinbashi-dori east of Hanamikoji, Gion — near Yasaka Shrine and Chion-in
places.cuisine: Kappo-style Kyoto cooking from seasonal ingredients the owner buys daily, with organic Kyoto vegetables from local farmers and the wanmono (soup) course as a signature (Tabelog) · lunch "Yasaka" course of over eighteen small dishes ¥5,500, "Shimizu" plan ¥7,500, dinner "Hana" course ¥15,000 (Tabelog); a February 2026 reviewer paid ¥4,800 for the Yasaka course · dishes in reviews: Oma tuna, duck wrapped in yuba grilled on hot stones in the private room, figs with white-sesame sauce, hamo with plum sauce in summer (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion Shinbashi] A small Gion kappo where you take off your shoes and sit at a sunken counter to watch the chef, or book a tea-room-style private room. The lunch course of eighteen-plus little dishes (¥5,500) is the draw; dinner from ¥15,000. Cash only; staff speak English and Chinese. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the operator: the chef trained at a renowned Kyoto restaurant (unnamed) and buys seasonal ingredients every day.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch course of many small dishes; wanmono.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor found the owner "very kind to us as tourists" with plenty of helpful advice.
The staff ask what time you must leave and pace the meal to it — October 2026.
A January 2026 lunch was kept warm by the heated floor, but the cash-only rule made one diner anxious at the end.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 祇園ゆやま、日本料理、東山区新橋通り花見小路東入 ルアートハイツ1F、火〜日 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:00、月曜休み、完全予約制、キャンセル料は当日100%・前日80%、カード不可、8席、掘りごたつのカウンター、茶室風の個室 (4名・6名)、昼のコース5,500円から・夜15,000円から、Yasaka コース5,500円、Shimizu プラン7,500円、Hana コース15,000円、店主が毎日仕入れる旬の食材、京都の有機野菜、椀物。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): Oma の鮪、湯葉で巻いた鴨を石で焼く、無花果の白胡麻ソース、夏は鱧の梅肉、英語と中国語を話すスタッフ、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: English- and Chinese-speaking staff (July 2026); book ahead; cash only; shoes off.

places.name: Pizzeria Napoletana Da Yuki
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: wood-fired wheat pizza is the core of the menu; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Most pizzas and plates carry cheese, fish or meat; the official site says disliked ingredients can be swapped, but says nothing about vegan meals (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 12:00–14:30 (last order 14:30) and 18:00–21:30 (last order 21:30); closed Monday, plus some irregular closures (official site; Tabelog). Bookings taken; ¥3,300 per person for a no-show or unannounced cancellation (official site). Takeaway pizza (October 2026). Terrace seats (October 2026). Cards and QR payments (Tabelog). In a glass-fronted building near the great torii of Heian Shrine, Okazaki; 375 m from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; July 2026).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki near the Heian Shrine torii — 375 m from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Neapolitan pizza from a wood-fired oven, with many ingredients from Italy: Margherita D.O.C., buffalo-mozzarella Margherita, Bismarck, mortadella and pistachio, fig and gorgonzola, shirasu and sakura shrimp; no pasta (2026 reviews) · a daily-changing list of antipasti and mains: raw mushroom salad with Parmesan, abalone carpaccio with liver sauce, saba and mozzarella caprese, Ozaki beef braciola, fried porcini, fried conger eel, tuna cutlet (2026 reviews) · wine
places.notes: [Neapolitan pizza · Okazaki by Heian Shrine] A long-loved Kyoto pizzeria, now in a bright glass-fronted space by the Heian Shrine torii: wood-fired Margherita D.O.C. and seasonal pizzas, plus an unusually good daily list of antipasti. About ¥3,000–9,000 a head. Book ahead (¥3,300 no-show charge); terrace and takeaway. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Moved within Okazaki to this address (official site; 2026 reviews). Per our record kyo_senza_x, Senza X opened in Da Yuki's former premises on 9 February 2024 after Da Yuki "relocated ~200m east to a larger space", and Da Yuki is a Michelin Bib Gourmand pizzeria listed among Tabelog's Pizza 百名店.
chef_bio.specialty: Margherita D.O.C.; antipasti.

anecdotes.text: An eight-time regular in September 2026 calls the Margherita D.O.C. "a must-have every time".
A September 2026 return visitor felt the pizzas were better before the move, though every appetizer was delicious.
An overseas family without a booking ate on the terrace — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (da-yuki.jp): Pizzeria Napoletana Da Yuki、左京区岡崎円勝寺町62 ボーパサージュ京都岡崎1F、12:00〜14:30 (L.O. 14:30)・18:00〜21:30 (L.O. 21:30)、月曜休み、無断キャンセルは1人3,300円、苦手な食材の変更などのアレンジ可。食べログ: ピザ、東山駅から375m、カード・QR 可。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 薪窯、マルゲリータ D.O.C.、マッシュルームのサラダ、鮑のカルパッチョ、移転後初めて、平安神宮の鳥居の近く、テラス席、持ち帰り、パスタはない。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; no-show charge ¥3,300; terrace for walk-ins when free.

places.name: ぎをん鮨尚充 (Gion Sushi Takamitsu)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. An omakase of nigiri and small dishes seasoned with soy, sweet soy, ponzu or salt; the course includes somen, and no gluten information is published (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and seafood omakase (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–15:00, 18:00–20:30 and 21:00–23:30 Monday to Saturday and holidays; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservation only, through OMAKASE, where the course fee is paid in advance; extras ordered on the day are paid by cash or card (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Next to 祇園 徳山 on Hanamikoji (Tabelog); about 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn. Most diners spend ¥30,000–50,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 10 February 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Hanamikoji in Gion, south of Shijo — 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Edo-style sushi omakase, nigiri and small dishes served in a mixed order (2025–26 reviews) · shijimi clam soup to start · prize-winning Nagasaki oysters · tuna from the Yamako wholesaler (191–238 kg fish from Nachikatsuura), chutoro, otoro, a tuna steak, toro-taku with caviar · sea urchin tastings, sea urchin rice · white squid, kohada, white shrimp, Hokkaido kinki with yamawasabi, kinmedai from Choshi, ankimo and kanpyo roll, anago with salt · iburi-gakko with mascarpone · warm somen and tamagoyaki to finish (2025–26 reviews) · wine and sake; a tequila toast for the whole counter at the end (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Gion, a Tokyo sushi-ya's party counter] The Kyoto branch of Nakameguro's Sushi Takamitsu, opened in February 2025 on Hanamikoji: a ten-seat counter where the young chef, Jun Kamekawa, serves an Edo-style omakase with small rice portions, tuna from the Yamako wholesaler, plenty of sea urchin and toro-taku with caviar, mixed in with dishes such as a tuna steak and iburi-gakko with mascarpone. It ends loud — music changes and the whole counter toasts with tequila; Louis Vuitton cases serve as sushi stands. Prepaid booking through OMAKASE; about ¥30,000–50,000. Closed Sunday.

roles: Chef (named in a September 2026 review, Instagram @sushi.jjj); an April 2026 reviewer says the chef runs the shop with a spouse
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviewers: the shop is a Kyoto branch (noren-wake) of the famous Nakameguro restaurant Sushi Takamitsu; chef Jun Kamekawa comes from Sushi Takamitsu (September 2026). Opened 10 February 2025 (Tabelog). Names written only in Latin letters in the sources, except a Japanese review that calls the parent shop 中目黒の名店.
chef_bio.specialty: Sea urchin; Yamako tuna; toro-taku with caviar.

anecdotes.text: At the end of a March 2026 meal the music changed and everyone at the counter raised a glass of tequila.
A May 2026 diner noted two Louis Vuitton suitcases used as stands for the sushi.
A June 2026 diner found the closing tequila "festival" not really necessary, though the food was good.
A June 2026 diner liked the cat bonsai in the entrance garden and the light used to serve the closing tea.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ぎをん鮨尚充、寿司、東山区祇園町南側570-239、花見小路通「祇園 徳山」の隣、祇園四条駅から徒歩10分、月〜土・祝 12:00〜15:00・18:00〜20:30・21:00〜23:30、日曜休み、完全予約制 (OMAKASE で予約、コース代は事前決済、当日の追加注文は現金・カード)、10席、禁煙、2025年2月10日オープン。口コミ (2026年4月、日本語): 中目黒の名店の暖簾分けで京都進出、しじみ汁、長崎県の牡蠣、白イカ、コハダ、白えび、バフン雲丹、金目鯛の塩焼きとやま山葵、マグロのステーキ、いぶりがっことマスカルポーネ、那智勝浦のマグロ、中トロ・大トロ、トロタクキャビア、白子、あん肝、温かい素麺、玉子焼き、最後は VIP 待遇の演出。英語の口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月): Jun Kamekawa シェフ、テキーラで乾杯、Louis Vuitton のケース。

cultural_comfort.note: Prepaid booking through OMAKASE; a loud tequila toast ends the meal.

places.name: 割烹 竹きし (Kappo Takekishi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kappo cooking with dashi and soy, tempura, fried dishes and nama-fu, and about ten kinds of kamameshi; no gluten information is published (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, shellfish and meat kappo with dashi; vegetable dishes such as nasu dengaku or yuba with vegetables have no published ingredients (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (booking required) and dinner 17:00–22:00, Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday and holidays (official site; Tabelog gives Sunday closed and notes closing days can change over long holidays). Cover of a starter and appetiser ¥1,600 at dinner (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「付き出し＋前菜 １６００円」). 17 seats: a counter of 9 and two horigotatsu tatami rooms for 4 (official site); smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards accepted (official site; Tabelog). Average spend: lunch ¥2,600–5,000, dinner ¥10,000–15,000 (official site). Leftover kamameshi can be wrapped as rice balls (May 2023). On the 1st floor of 高見ビル on Sueyoshicho west of Hanamikoji, near Shirakawa-minami-dori and Shinbashi-dori; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site). Opened 9 September 1996 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sueyoshicho west of Hanamikoji, Gion — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Unpretentious Kyoto kappo with Kyoto vegetables, nama-fu, yuba, Wakasa guji and fish sent from the Sea of Japan (official site) · kamameshi, about ten kinds: wild vegetables ¥1,600, taro and chirimen ¥1,600, chicken and mushroom ¥1,700, gomoku ¥1,800, seafood butter ¥1,800, paella-style ¥2,100, turban shell ¥2,000, ayu ¥2,000, sea bream ¥2,200 · kamameshi gozen ¥4,180, sashimi gozen ¥5,390 (before tax) · Takekishi kaiseki ¥7,480 (official menu) · à la carte: salt-grilled ayu, Kamo eggplant with prawn sauce, nodoguro, hamo, Wakasa guji, nasu and nama-fu dengaku, maru-nabe (soft-shelled turtle), yuba with vegetables, beef cutlet, tempura, shijimi soup ¥300 (official menu)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion, kamameshi in the old geisha quarter] A long-running kappo counter by Shirakawa-minami-dori in Gion, open since 1996 and loved by locals for being easy to drop into. The draw is kamameshi cooked to order in about ten kinds — chicken and mushroom, seafood butter, a paella-style pot, ayu or sea bream in season — after Kyoto dishes of guji, hamo, nama-fu and yuba. Lunch gozen from ¥4,180 (booking needed); dinner course ¥7,480 or à la carte, with a ¥1,600 starter cover. Smoking allowed. Closed Sunday and holidays.

roles: Head chef and owner, neither named (August 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: near the teahouses of Shirakawa-minami-dori and Shinbashi-dori in the heart of Gion, but with an unpretentious feel, loved by locals; kaiseki and many à la carte dishes with Kyoto vegetables, nama-fu, yuba, Wakasa guji and fish sent direct from the Sea of Japan, using the ingredients’ own flavour, good dashi and touches such as kinome; about ten kamameshi always available, many regulars coming for the kamameshi. Opened 9 September 1996 (Tabelog); a May 2023 reviewer notes more than 30 years in business.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: make the most of each ingredient with good dashi — "これぞ京都の味".
chef_bio.specialty: Kamameshi; Kyoto kappo dishes.

anecdotes.text: A January 2022 pair booked a ¥9,000 course and were served two different kamameshi chosen from about ten kinds.
A May 2023 diner was offered the unfinished kamameshi as rice balls to take home.
An October 2026 family came after a Shichi-Go-San visit, and the one-year-old granddaughter happily dug into the kamameshi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (takekishi.com): 割烹 竹きし、祇園で出会う正統派京料理の割烹、白川南通や新橋通のすぐ近く、気取りのない雰囲気で地元の人に愛される店、会席料理と一品料理、京野菜、生麩、湯葉、若狭ぐじ、日本海から直送の魚貝、名物の釜めし (鶏ときのこ、小芋とおじゃこ、海鮮バター、パエリヤ風、季節限定のカニ、カキ、アユなど常時10種類程)、釜めし御膳4,180円・お造り御膳5,390円 (税別)、竹きし会席7,480円、釜めし: 山菜1,600円、小芋とおじゃこ1,600円、鶏きのこ1,700円、五目1,800円、海鮮バター1,800円、パエリヤ風2,100円、さざえ2,000円、あゆ2,000円、たい2,200円、しじみ汁300円、東山区祇園花見小路末吉町西入ル 高見ビル1F、昼12:00〜14:00 (要予約)・夜17:00〜22:00、日・祝定休、17席 (カウンター9席、お座敷4名×2)、カード可、平均予算 昼2,600〜5,000円・夜10,000〜15,000円。食べログ: 日本料理、付き出し＋前菜1,600円、喫煙可、1996年9月9日オープン。口コミ (2017〜2026年、英語)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book lunch ahead; ¥1,600 starter cover at dinner; smoking allowed.

places.name: 呑喜屋むね (Nonkiya Mune)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A long menu of sashimi, grilled fish, tempura, beef cutlet, croquettes, stir-fries and dobin-mushi; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led counter; vegetable plates such as stir-fried lettuce or grilled shiitake have no published ingredients (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00 Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Book ahead — a March 2026 caller was turned away at 18:00, and an October 2026 pair booked by phone two weeks ahead. 12 seats: a long counter facing a small courtyard and one table for four (Tabelog; June and October 2026); designated smoking area; JCB and AMEX cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). A dobin-mushi or chawanmushi comes first as a starter (May–September 2026). Down an alley off Sakaimachi-dori north of Ebisugawa, near the Imperial Palace; about 5 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Tabelog Diner "Tabelog 100" 2026; a May 2026 diner saw a Michelin sticker inside.
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi-dori south of the Imperial Palace — 5 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Fish-led small dishes at a counter (2026 reviews) · assorted sashimi ¥2,750 (March 2026): bluefin tuna, katsuo, fugu, seared kinmedai, squid, octopus, sea urchin; in August 2026 hamo, shima-aji, toro, amaebi, torigai · grilled kinki, natural hirame, first sanma · matsutake dobin-mushi as a starter · maitake and greens stew ¥660 · tempura, beef cutlet of rare strip loin, crab cream croquette, chicken-wing kara-age, butter-fried octopus and asparagus, stir-fried lettuce with oyster sauce, potato salad, kabuto-ni, tai-shabu with rice porridge, sea urchin rice ball · sake from Kyoto, Shiga, Osaka and Akita (Ugo no Tsuki ¥990)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Goshominami, a fish-led counter run by owner and mother] A twelve-seat counter in a townhouse down an alley off Sakaimachi-dori, where the owner cooks and the owner's mother serves. Built on fish: a big sashimi platter (about ¥2,750 in March 2026), grilled kinki or the first sanma, a matsutake dobin-mushi as a starter, then a long list from tempura and rare beef cutlet to stir-fried lettuce. More a refined small restaurant than its name suggests; about ¥6,000–10,000. Book well ahead. Tabelog Diner 'Tabelog 100' 2026. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef, not named, working with the owner’s mother (August and October 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per an August 2026 reviewer: the owner entered cooking through a part-time restaurant job as a student and trained at a Japanese restaurant specialising in seafood before going independent, so the cooking is rooted in fish; the owner selects seasonal seafood personally. Reviewers in June, August and October 2026 describe a parent-and-child team — the owner and the owner’s mother, with a part-timer. A May 2026 diner saw a Michelin sticker inside. Tabelog Diner "Tabelog 100" 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; seasonal grilled fish; beef cutlet.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner was guided by the owner through the menu and called the tai-shabu with its closing porridge the highlight.
A September 2026 visitor from Tokyo, served a dobin-mushi as the first dish, joked about being tested — "the baptism of Kyoto".
An October 2026 diner noted that all the guests that evening were Japanese or fluent in Japanese.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 呑喜屋むね、食堂・居酒屋、中京区堺町通夷川上る絹屋町127-5、丸太町駅から386m、月〜土 17:30〜22:00、日曜休み、予約可、12席、分煙、カード (JCB・AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、食堂 百名店 2026。口コミ (2026年2〜10月、英語): 刺身の盛り合わせ2,750円、キンキ、天然ヒラメ、土瓶蒸し、天ぷら、牛カツ、カニクリームコロッケ、手羽先の唐揚げ、レタス炒め、鯛しゃぶ、雲丹のおにぎり、店主とお母さん、ミシュランのステッカー。

cultural_comfort.note: Book well ahead; designated smoking area.

places.name: よこちょう (Yokocho)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, simmered and grilled fish, fried squid and horse mackerel, saba sushi and simmered chicken liver; no gluten information is published (2023–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; vegetable plates such as grilled shiitake, manganji peppers or mozuku have no published ingredients (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). 2-hour limit (Tabelog). Book by phone, and order the sashimi platter when booking — a July 2026 diner was told one platter per person is a booking condition; fully booked on Saturday nights (2026 reviews). 60 seats over two floors with a counter; the 1st-floor menu differs from upstairs (July 2026); first orders are written on paper from the whiteboard (August 2026); non-smoking; cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Nijo-dori east of Kawabata, near Heian Shrine; about 10 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo-dori east of Kawabata, near Heian Shrine — 10 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Seafood izakaya with a whiteboard menu that changes with the catch (2026 reviews) · the assorted sashimi platter, about ¥2,500–3,000 a head (August 2026): flounder, boiled anago, abalone, squid, tuna, amaebi, karasumi, torigai, kombu-cured white fish; hamo in summer; katsuo on a separate plate · simmered whelk, grilled sanma, ayu and hatahata, fried squid legs, fried horse mackerel, braised fish · simmered chicken liver, potato salad, deep-fried tofu, mozuku, fried Kamo eggplant · tekka-maki, saba sushi by the piece · hairy crab ¥8,500 (November 2026), soft-shelled turtle zosui, dobin-mushi · a wide range of sake and shochu
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kawabata-Nijo, the sashimi platter everyone books] A busy two-floor seafood izakaya on Nijo east of the Kamo, loved by locals and by students who come back years later. The thing to order — ask for it when booking — is the sashimi platter, nine kinds such as flounder, abalone, karasumi and kombu-cured white fish for about ¥2,500–3,000 a head; then simmered and grilled fish from the whiteboard, chicken liver, potato salad and saba sushi by the piece, with plenty of sake. Cash only, two-hour limit, book by phone. Tabelog izakaya WEST 'Tabelog 100' 2026. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner, not named, who chats with regulars and sees guests out (August 2026)
chef_bio.background: A long-loved local seafood izakaya; reviewers describe coming first as students, brought by a seminar professor, and returning for years (June 2026), and visitors from near and far (September 2026). Tabelog izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Assorted sashimi platter; simmered and grilled fish.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 regular first came as a university student, brought by a seminar professor, and stops by on every Kyoto visit since.
An August 2026 solo diner was handed paper and a pencil to write the first order from the whiteboard, and the owner saw the diner out with a chat.
Four friends in November 2026 shared a ¥8,500 hairy crab, carefully prepared for the table.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: よこちょう、居酒屋・魚介料理、左京区二条通川端東入ル難波町210、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩約10分、月〜土 17:00〜22:00、日曜休み、60席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、2時間制、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2026。口コミ (2023年9月〜2026年11月、英語): 刺身の盛り合わせ (予約時に注文、1人1皿が予約の条件という声)、ホワイトボードのメニュー、紙と鉛筆で注文、1階と2階でメニューが違う、鶏レバーの煮付け、ポテトサラダ、鯖寿司1貫から、毛蟹8,500円、すっぽん雑炊。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone bookings; order the sashimi platter when booking; cash only.

places.name: 團'sキッチン (Dan's Kitchen)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the plates are built round breaded fries — cream croquettes, mille-feuille pork cutlet, chicken cutlet, fried shrimp — with demi-glace hamburg steak and stew (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, beef-tongue stew, pork, chicken and fish fries, cheese and gratin (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:30–14:00 (food L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (food L.O. 21:00); closed Wednesday and Thursday; other irregular closures. Bookings online; same-day cancellation ¥3,000 per person (official site). 15 seats, counter and tables, in a basement off Kawaramachi-dori; non-smoking; children welcome; private hire up to 20 (official site; Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and QR accepted. No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 15 May 2023 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-Matsubara, basement of a building on Kawaramachi-dori — 5 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Handmade yoshoku with a light, Japanese touch (official site) · lunch plates pairing a main with fries of your choice; beef-tongue stew set with two fries ¥1,800 (March 2026), with fried shrimp, croquette, three desserts and coffee ¥2,500 (September 2026) · booked courses ¥2,500–5,000: hamburg steak course, mixed fry (3 of 7: seasonal cream croquette, chicken cutlet with tomato sauce, pork and cheese mille-feuille, fried shrimp or fish with shibazuke tartar, karaage, fried seasonal vegetables), beef steak or cutlet, sharing course (official site) · soy-milk soup, onion potage with salt kombu, house pickles (2026 reviews) · beer, wine, cocktails (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Kawaramachi-Matsubara, fifteen seats downstairs] Down the stairs from Kawaramachi-dori, a monochrome fifteen-seat room for handmade yoshoku seasoned lightly so it won't sit heavy: fluffy demi-glace hamburg steak, melting beef-tongue stew, and plates where you pick your fries — cream croquette, mille-feuille cutlet, fried shrimp with shibazuke tartar. Lunch sets ¥1,800–2,500 fill up, so book. One diner found the hamburg plate a little small. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: The master cooks (September 2026 review); not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened on 15 May 2023 on Kawaramachi-dori south of Matsubara, near the Takase River and Gojo Bridge; a handmade yoshoku shop using seasonal ingredients and Japanese touches so the food is easy to eat and does not sit heavy; 15 seats down a flight of stairs, counter and tables; private hire for under 20.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: a yoshoku shop close to the everyday life of the street, from lunch for people working nearby to dinner after sightseeing.
chef_bio.specialty: Demi-glace hamburg steak; beef-tongue stew; choose-your-own fries.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner was told to stir the cold onion potage, because salt kombu sat at the bottom.
A regular who stops by on every Kyoto visit ordered the drinking set, then a side plate to repeat the fries and hamburg steak (June 2026).
"I could have eaten a bit more—maybe I was only about 70% full." — March 2026, on the hamburg steak lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (danskitchen-kyoto.com、多言語): 京都・河原町五条の手作り洋食の店「團's Kitchen」、旬の食材と和の素材で食べやすく胃もたれしない洋食、ハンバーグ、エビフライ、タン元シチュー、ランチはメインと好みのフライを組み合わせるプレート (クリームコロッケ、ミルフィーユカツ、チキンカツ)、デミグラスソース、豆乳スープ、コース2,500〜5,000円 (ハンバーグステーキコース、ミックスフライ、ビーフステーキ、シェアコースなど)、当日キャンセルは1人3,000円、階段を降りた隠れ家のような15席、20名以下の貸切、全席禁煙、2023年5月15日に河原町通松原下ルで開店、カード・電子マネー・QR可。食べログ: 洋食・ハンバーグ、下京区河原町通松原下ル難波町410-2 河原町エイトビル、月火金土日 11:30〜14:00・17:30〜22:00、水木休み、15席、子供可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2026年3月〜9月、英語): タンシチューと2種のフライのランチ1,800円、2,500円のランチ、ふわふわのハンバーグ、貝のだしのクリームコロッケ、塩昆布入りの冷製ポタージュ、お酒とつまみのセット (英語の口コミでは Horo-Yoi Set)、ランチは満席で予約必須、ハンバーグは少し物足りないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Official site in English and other languages with online booking; lunch fills up, so book.

places.name: 祇をん ひつじカフェ (Gion Hitsuji Cafe)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the signature is wheat choux pastry, and meals are pasta, gratin, curry or hamburg steak with rice or bread; ice creams are listed separately (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: custard-filled choux, ice cream, milkshakes, beef-tendon curry and cream pastas; no item is marked vegan (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: Mon–Thu 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); Fri–Sat 14:00–01:00 (L.O. 00:30); closed Sundays and holidays, though it opens on some in busy seasons. Bookings taken; take-out and delivery of cream puffs (official site). 18 seats with sofas; non-smoking, with a smoking spot outside; PayPay only, no cards or e-money (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 21 November 2011 (Tabelog). Upstairs, 祇をんひつじ serves obanzai 18:00–23:00 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo, in the Gion Raku-en Koji courtyard off Hanamikoji — 10 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Night-time café in a machiya on a hidden courtyard · wasanbon petit choux filled to order, plate of 4 from ¥600, box of 10 from ¥1,300, custard plus a seasonal cream (chestnut, Anno sweet potato in autumn 2026) (official site) · French-press coffee, matcha, parfaits, milkshakes (official site; 2026 reviews) · light meals: beef-tendon curry ¥1,050, stewed hamburg steak ¥1,300, white-miso soy-milk gratin ¥1,200, yuba and namafu ankake bowl ¥1,300, Napolitan ¥1,100 (official menu, February 2024; prices revised since)
places.notes: [Café · Gion, petit choux till midnight] Through a narrow alley off Hanamikoji into a courtyard with a fire-watch tower and goldfish pond: a retro machiya café that opens at 5 pm (2 pm on Fridays and Saturdays) and stays open until midnight or 1 am. The draw is the bite-sized wasanbon cream puff, crisp on top and filled only when ordered, with French-press coffee; beef-tendon curry and hamburg steak for supper. Boxes of ten to take away. PayPay only.

chef_bio.chef_name: 曽我 良子 (representative, per the official site; no reading in a source)
roles: Representative (代表者), per the official site; an in-house patissier makes the sweets (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a hideaway café with its own courtyard in the middle of Gion-machi, retro inside with jazz, French-press coffee, and petit choux by a dedicated patissier; the wasanbon choux has a cookie crust of wasanbon sugar and is filled with custard only after ordering. The obanzai restaurant 祇をんひつじ is upstairs on the second floor. Opened 21 November 2011 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe the courtyard of the 楽宴小路 with a watchtower and a goldfish pond.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: Gion can feel intimidating, so the café aims to be a relaxed place anyone can drop into, and to share the charms of Gion with travellers.
chef_bio.specialty: Wasanbon petit choux; French-press coffee.

anecdotes.text: After a business meeting, an April 2026 diner had cream puffs delivered from here to a nearby bar — half custard, half strawberry.
"As I twisted and turned into a very narrow alley (Rakuenshoji), a courtyard that looks like it came straight out of a period drama suddenly opened up before me." — April 2026.
A reviewer who first came in 2016 returned in May 2026 for the beef-tendon curry and the petit choux.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gionhitsujicafe.com): 1F 祇をん ひつじカフェ、京都祇園町のど真ん中に中庭を持つ隠れ家カフェ、専属のパティシエの名物プチシュー、レトロな店内でジャズ、フレンチプレス式のコーヒー、祇園は敷居が高いと言われるので気軽に立ち寄れる空間を、月〜木 17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、金・土 14:00〜25:00 (L.O. 24:30)、日・祝休み (季節により営業)、2F 祇をんひつじ (おばんざいと焼酎・日本酒、18:00〜23:00)、代表者 曽我 良子、祇園町北側347 祇園楽宴小路内、和三盆シュー (注文を受けてからカスタードを詰める) シュー皿4粒600円〜、シュー箱10粒1,300円〜、季節のクリーム (2026年10月マロン、11月安納芋)、すじカレー1,050円、煮込みハンバーグ1,300円、白味噌豆乳グラタン1,200円、湯葉と生麩の京風あんかけ丼1,300円、ナポリタン1,100円 (2024年2月のお品書き、その後価格改定のお知らせあり)、お祝いケーキと配達。食べログ: カフェ、18席、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、PayPay のみ、2011年11月21日オープン。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 路地の奥の中庭、火の見櫓と金魚の池、和三盆シュー、抹茶、パフェ、牛すじカレー、夜遅くまで開いている、10個入りのお持ち帰り。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the table; the courtyard is easy to miss — enter from Hanamikoji through the narrow alley.

places.name: 料理屋 自在 (Ryoriya Jizai)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. A diner with a wheat allergy who said so when booking was given a wheat-free version of the course, with the Handa somen swapped for a corn and edamame risotto (September 2026). The regular course includes somen and a rice-flour galette (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a set course of fish, duck, wagyu ribeye and hamo consommé, changed monthly (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–22:00, irregular closing days. Tabelog: daily 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:30–23:30 (L.O. 23:00). Set courses only at lunch and dinner, booked for two or more by the day before; same-day cancellation may be charged in full (official site). No service charge (Tabelog; Japanese original 「なし」). 24 seats: a teppan counter downstairs (eight seats per a November 2026 review, six per a September 2026 one) and tables upstairs, private hire of the second floor for 10–16; non-smoking; school-age children, no preschoolers; wheelchair accessible; cards (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-dori, in a narrow machiya alley — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Creative teppan cooking in a monthly set course (official site) · lunch course ¥5,500 (2026 reviews); dinner course ¥10,000 (official site); wine pairing of three glasses ¥3,300 (official site) · autumn 2026 course: pumpkin "declinaison", chestnut flan with porcini, truffle and house bacon, autumn salmon with Anno sweet potato and Shine Muscat, salad of house duck prosciutto and fig, sous-vide mackerel on squid-ink mash, black wagyu ribeye with grilled vegetables, Handa somen in hamo consommé with matsutake, sorbet and desserts (official site; October–November 2026 reviews) · house non-alcoholic cocktails (official site)
places.notes: [Creative teppan · Sanjo, a monthly course] Down a narrow alley off Sanjo-dori, a machiya with a teppan counter downstairs and tables upstairs. One monthly course: chestnut flan with porcini, sous-vide mackerel on squid-ink mash, black wagyu ribeye off the teppan, and Handa somen in hamo consommé to finish. Lunch ¥5,500, dinner ¥10,000. Diners praise the value and the surprises; one found the squid-ink mash hard going. A wheat-allergic guest got a wheat-free course by asking ahead. One of six shops of the local Ushinohone group.

roles: The owner chooses the month’s ingredients and designs the course (official site); not named. One of six shops of the うしのほねグループ (株式会社セカンダイズ)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 料理屋 自在 (りょうりや じざい), a teppan creative-cuisine restaurant tucked into a lane of old machiya off Sanjo-dori; dishes freely combine ingredients, seasonings and techniques, including the latest cooking methods; courses only, changed every month; message plates for anniversaries; house non-alcoholic cocktails. The site lists ELOVE, DUE and the three 牛の骨 restaurants as sister shops, all run by 株式会社セカンダイズ.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: dishes that combine everything "freely, at will" (自在) for something new each time.
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly creative course; black wagyu ribeye on the teppan; Handa somen in consommé.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner with a wheat allergy flagged it when booking and was served a wheat-free course, with the somen replaced by a corn and edamame risotto.
"I was initially worried about the low price of the omakase course, but it turned out to be an incredible value." — October 2026.
A November 2026 diner at the counter found the squid-ink mashed potatoes "a bit challenging" but the rest a wonderful combination.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-zizai.com): 料理屋 自在 (りょうりや じざい)、三条通の京町家の路地の鉄板創作料理、最新の調理法も取り入れた柔軟な発想、ランチ・ディナーともにおまかせコースのみ、毎月内容が変わる、店主が旬の食材を選んで考案、ディナーコース10,000円 (税込み)、予約は2名から前日まで、マリアージュセット (シャンパン・赤・白の3杯) 3,300円、記念日のメッセージプレート無料、自家製ノンアルコールカクテル、1階はカウンターで鉄板を見ながら、2階はテーブル (10〜16名で貸切可)、24席、11:30〜14:30・17:30〜22:00、不定休、当日キャンセルは100%の場合あり、系列店は牛の骨、牛の骨あなざ、草風土 牛の骨、DUE、ELOVE (株式会社セカンダイズ)、今月のコース (11月3日まで): 南瓜のデクリネゾン、和栗のフラン、秋鮭と安納芋とシャインマスカット、無花果と自家製鴨の生ハム、ガストロバックした秋鯖とイカスミのマッシュポテト、黒毛和牛リブロースステーキ、半田素麺と鱧のコンソメ、ソルベとデザート。食べログ: 創作料理・鉄板焼き・ステーキ、中京区三条通富小路西入ル中之町12-3、11:30〜15:00・17:30〜23:30、不定休、サービス料なし、24席、禁煙、未就学児不可、車椅子可。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年11月、英語ほか): ランチコース5,500円、小麦アレルギーに対応 (素麺をコーンと枝豆のリゾットに変更)、誕生日のデザートにメッセージ、カウンターは8席 (2026年11月) とも6席 (2026年9月) とも、イカスミのマッシュポテトは少し苦手という声。

cultural_comfort.note: One set course, booked a day ahead for two or more; staff explain each dish (September 2026); raise allergies when booking.

places.name: こりょうり たか屋 (Koryouri Takaya)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a dashi-based course with soy-seasoned dishes, spring rolls and the occasional tempura (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish course on dashi — herring, hamo, mackerel sushi, tuna, sweetfish, wagyu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Thu 12:00–14:00 (food L.O. 13:00) and 17:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:00); Fri–Sat 17:00–22:00; Saturday in two seatings, 17:00–19:30 and 20:00–22:30; closed Sunday. Lunch: small-dish meal ¥2,970; dinner course ¥11,550 (tax included, Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog; Japanese original 「なし」). 9 counter seats; non-smoking; take-out; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Opened 18 March 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shichijo-dori west of Karasuma — 5 min walk from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: Small-plate Kyoto cooking at a nine-seat counter · lunch of about ten small dishes with clay-pot rice ¥2,970; dinner course ¥11,550 (Tabelog) · dishes seen: simmered herring and autumn eggplant, chawanmushi with snow crab or hairy crab, straw-grilled toro, hamo with plum, hamo and matsutake spring rolls or hot pot, mackerel sushi wrapped in nori, firefly-squid namerou, braised wagyu with flower pepper, sweetfish rice, sukiyaki, cheesecake (2026 reviews) · sake chosen to match (July 2026)
places.notes: [Kyoto small plates · near Kyoto Station, nine counter seats] A nine-seat U-shaped counter on Shichijo, a few minutes from Kyoto Station, listed in the 2025 Michelin Guide according to 2026 diners. Dinner is one ¥11,550 course — simmered herring and eggplant, hamo with plum, mackerel sushi in nori, clay-pot rice — and lunch is a ¥2,970 spread of ten small dishes. Regulars praise the value and generous portions; one July 2026 diner found the food and sake only average. English-speaking staff member (May 2026). Closed Sunday.

roles: Chef at the counter (2026 reviews); not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Opened 18 March 2016 (Tabelog). Diners in May and June 2026 say it is listed in the 2025 Michelin Guide. A June 2026 lunch guest saw the chef and one other man working the small kitchen; a May 2026 diner found the chef friendly and an English-speaking staff member on hand.
chef_bio.specialty: Small-plate Kyoto course; clay-pot rice; mackerel sushi wrapped in nori.

anecdotes.text: "Although the heat made me a bit weak, I always find the portions to be generous. I felt like I had to push myself to finish the dashi chazuke this time." — August 2026, a third visit.
"Both the food and the sake were just average. Perhaps the flavors of Kyoto cuisine just don't suit my palate." — July 2026.
A June 2026 lunch guest left nothing of the fish but the pit of the umeboshi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: こりょうり たか屋、日本料理、下京区七条通烏丸西入西境町165 GEM7 1F、京都駅から徒歩約5分、月〜木 12:00〜14:00 (L.O. 13:00)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、金・土 17:00〜22:00、土曜は17:00〜19:30と20:00〜22:30の2部制、日曜休み、昼は小皿の御膳2,970円、夜はコース11,550円 (税込)、サービス料なし、カウンター9席、禁煙、テイクアウト、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、2016年3月18日オープン。口コミ (2026年4月〜9月、英語ほか): ミシュランガイド2025に掲載、U字のカウンター9席、BGMなし、週末は一斉スタート、秋茄子とニシンの煮浸し、蟹の茶碗蒸し、藁焼きの中トロ、鱧の梅肉、鱧と松茸の春巻きや小鍋、鯖寿司の海苔巻き、ホタルイカのなめろう、黒毛和牛の花山椒煮、鮎ご飯、すき焼き、チーズケーキ、量が多い、英語を話すスタッフ、料理も酒も普通だったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter course with dishes explained; an English-speaking staff member (May 2026); book ahead.

places.name: RUNG ARUN タイ料理 (Rung Arun Thai)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Thai rice and rice-noodle dishes, but also fried spring rolls, egg noodles, fish-sauce and soy-based sauces; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but most dishes use fish sauce, shrimp, pork or chicken (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday to Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; bookings lapse 30 minutes after the time without contact; two-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). 23 seats: 5 at the counter, 18 at tables; private hire 20–50; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). English menu with photos; takeaway (Tabelog). Third floor of 遊里香ビル on Kiyamachi above Sanjo, above a ramen shop; 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Keihan) (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 2 June 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Sanjo, 3rd floor — 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Thai restaurant (Tabelog) · tom yum kung hot pot, gapao rice, seafood curry, Thai beers and Thai milk tea (Tabelog) · lunch sets with salad, soup, shrimp chips and a mini dessert — khao man gai set ¥1,100; pad thai with pork-ball soup ¥1,500; green curry with Thai omelette; tom yum seafood noodles with egg fried rice (2026 reviews) · po pia tod, rad na mee krob moo ¥1,210, sup nor mai bamboo-shoot salad ¥1,100 (2026 reviews) · Singha (July 2026) · dinner about ¥3,000–5,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Thai · Kiyamachi above Sanjo, lunch sets upstairs] A third-floor Thai room on Kiyamachi, opened in 2025, easy to miss above a ramen shop. Lunch sets of about ¥1,100–1,500 bring salad, soup, shrimp chips and a mini dessert with khao man gai, pad thai, green curry or tom yum noodles; staff will steer you to milder dishes. Dinner adds tom yum hot pot and seafood curry with Thai beer. English menu. Busy at lunch — book. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 2 June 2025, serving authentic Thai dishes in a wood-toned room for up to 23. Reviewers in 2026 describe friendly staff, kitchen staff who laughed along with a guest practising Thai, and a busy lunch trade.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets; pad thai; tom yum.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular asked the kitchen to teach the Thai phrase for a dish, mispronounced it into an unintended joke, and the whole room laughed — "something Thai people cherish."
"I asked the staff for recommendations on milder dishes, and I ended up having a delicious meal." — May 2026.
"It seems to be a popular spot; I was able to get in early in the evening, but it looked like later customers would have a hard time without a reservation." — May 2026.
