places.gf_detail: Ask. Izakaya dishes including edamame tempura, a rare salmon cutlet, sushi rolls, hot pots and cheesecake; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-focused izakaya of sashimi, seafood rolls, katsuo tataki, salmon and fish hot pots (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday to Friday 17:00–23:00; Saturday 15:00–23:00; Sunday 15:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted by phone; DMs are not answered during opening hours (Tabelog); 19:00 slots fill, with 90-minute seatings at busy times (March 2026). No table charge (Tabelog original チャージ料無し). Orders by smartphone (July 2026). 16 seats: 6 at a ground-floor counter, 10 at tables upstairs; private hire up to 20; non-smoking, smoking area outside (Tabelog; July 2026). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay (Tabelog). In the 三条食彩ろぉじ alley of small shops — look for the red noren (Tabelog; April 2026).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo shokusai roji, off Sanjo near Karasuma Oike
places.cuisine: Young, lively izakaya with a sister shop, SAUNA (2026 reviews) · seafood overflowing from the negitoro roll, mentaiko roll, katsuo tataki, squid sashimi several ways (2026 reviews) · edamame tempura, a popular dish; salmon rare cutlet; cream cheese dip; hamo and matsutake tempura (2026 reviews) · shirako dishes in winter, a "gout hot pot", yellowtail hot pot (2026 reviews) · cheesecake of the day (2026 reviews) · OFURO sour with Amaou strawberry, yuzu honey; Japanese sake (2026 reviews) · bills about ¥3,000–6,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Sanjo food alley, seafood rolls and edamame tempura] A small, young izakaya behind a red noren in a lane of tiny shops off Sanjo: sushi rolls heaped with seafood, edamame tempura, rare salmon cutlet, katsuo tataki and fish hot pots in winter, with fruit sours and sake. Staff are friendly and chatty, and both regulars and travellers fill it — book, as evening slots go fast. One August 2026 guest found the counter noisy. Orders go through your smartphone. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a young team cooking dish by dish in a small kitchen, friendly service and drink suggestions, many regulars, and a sister restaurant, SAUNA (April and August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood-overflow rolls; edamame tempura.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor stayed longer than planned, and on the way out one of the staff flashed a peace sign.
"The Edamame Tempura, a popular menu item, was especially tasty and disappeared quickly!" — March 2026.
"I had my meal at the counter, but it was quite noisy, possibly because there were many regular customers." — August 2026.

places.name: 中善 (Nakazen)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase kappo courses with dashi, soy-based sauces, saba sushi, ganmodoki and fried ginkgo; no gluten information (2022–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of Setouchi fish, hamo, anago, sweetfish and duck liver, on dashi (official site; 2022–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday to Sunday 18:30–23:30, last order 20:30; closed Wednesday (official site). Tabelog gives 18:00–24:00 with last seating 22:00, and lunch by reservation only; lunch serves the same courses as dinner (2025 review). Reservations through the official site (AutoReserve) or by phone (official site; Tabelog); book well ahead — locals fill it (June 2025). A fixed course of about ¥14,000–15,000 (2022–2024 reviews); reviewers spent ¥15,000–29,999 (2025–2026). 10 seats: 6 at the counter and one table of 4; non-smoking (Tabelog; February 2024). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (official site; Tabelog). Near the corner of the Daikokuya supermarket, Kitashirakawa, by Kyoto University; 3 min walk from the Ginkakuji-michi bus stop (Tabelog; May 2022).
places.neighborhood: Kitashirakawa, near Ginkakuji-michi — 3 min walk from the bus stop
places.cuisine: A couple's kappo of Setouchi fish and vegetables from Ohara, with local sake and Italian and French wines for pairing (official site) · omakase course, about ¥14,000–15,000 (2022–2024 reviews); in February and September the course is more lavish (February 2024) · e.g. yam kan with mountain vegetables, Awaji sea bream, densuke anago with torigai, guji soup made with gyokuro, an eight-item hassun, saba sushi in bamboo leaf with sansho, suzuki grilled crisp in sesame oil (May 2022); Akashi sea bream and shima-aji, hamo, anago and ganmodoki (June 2025); grilled eggplant with dashi jelly, wild grouper and yellowtail, duck liver, hamo dumplings (2025) · grilled sweetfish (July 2024) · leftover rice made into onigiri to take home (2024 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · Kitashirakawa, a couple since 2009] A ten-seat kappo near Ginkakuji-michi, opened in 2009 by a husband and wife: the chef (trained at Kikunoi, reviewers say) cooks Setouchi fish and Ohara vegetables into a fixed omakase of around ¥15,000, and the okami, a sake sommelier per one reviewer, pairs local sake or wine. Generous, unfussy and warm, with leftover rice wrapped as onigiri. Popular with locals — book well ahead. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Okami (the wife of the owner, unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in Kitashirakawa in 2009 and run by a married couple; the owner honed skills at famous Kyoto restaurants and wanted a kappo that is easier and freer to enjoy; fish from the Seto Inland Sea and vegetables from Ohara. Reviewers say the owner seems to have trained at Kikunoi (October 2022) and that the chef trained at Kikunoi and the okami is a sake sommelier (February 2026). A September 2025 reviewer calls it a Michelin one-star restaurant.
chef_bio.philosophy: "A kappo to enjoy more closely and more freely" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase course; hamo; saba sushi.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 guest on a fourth visit, coming only every year or two, was still remembered.
February and September, the low seasons in Kyoto, are a "special service month with more extravagant dishes" (February 2024).
A June 2025 guest who could not get a booking on an earlier trip — locals had taken every seat — called the hamo, cut with a large steel knife, the best of a lifetime.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都・北白川の夫婦で営む隠れ家的な割烹、2009年開店、京都の名店で腕を磨いた店主、女将の気配り、瀬戸内の魚介と大原の野菜、地酒とイタリア・フランスのワイン、ペアリング、月・火・木〜日 18:30〜23:30 (L.O.20:30)、水曜休み、最寄りは元田中駅、駐車場なし、カード可 (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、予約は公式サイトから。食べログ: 日本料理、左京区北白川久保田町26、銀閣寺道バス停から徒歩3分、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル4)、昼は予約のみ。口コミ (2022年5月〜2026年2月、英語): Kikunoi で修業したという店主、女将は sake sommelier、おまかせ14,000円ほど、2月と9月は特別に豪華、鱧、伝助穴子、ぐじのお椀、八寸、鯖寿司、ご飯の残りはおにぎりに、ミシュラン一つ星との記述 (2025年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online through the official site (multilingual) well ahead; fixed omakase; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners).

places.name: Synager
places.gf_detail: Ask. A French tasting course with sauces, terrines, fried amuse-bouches, bread, butter and baked sweets; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a set French course of fish, shellfish, foie gras and meat, with butter and cheese (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last food order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (last food order 19:00); closed Monday, open on holidays (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). 10% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料10%). Courses with wine or non-alcoholic aroma pairings: lunch with four pairings a little over ¥12,000 (September 2026); bills ¥10,000–29,999 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 12 seats; private hire for 6 or more, children welcome when booked whole (Tabelog). Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). A renovated machiya down a cobbled alley through a small wooden gate, Higashinotoin north of Nijo; 4 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (subway) (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin north of Nijo — 4 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: French tasting course by a chef who is also an herb coordinator, with sommelier wine pairings or non-alcoholic aroma pairings from herb distillation (Tabelog) · a welcome of water scented with distilled Damask rose (2026 reviews) · e.g. fried shirako on coral, Shinshu salmon with caviar and flowers (February 2026); Yamato tachibana citrus (April 2026); corn and shrimp potage, fried hamo, sardine and potato-salad tart, tuna tartare, squid and hamo terrine, smoked vegetables (August 2026); oyster flan, sanma, eggplant and foie gras terrine (September 2026); higuma bear, fugu jelly (October 2026) · cheese platter for a supplement; baked sweets to finish (April, July 2026) · non-alcoholic pairing with kombucha and other drinks mimicking wines (September 2026)
places.notes: [French · Higashinotoin Nijo, aromas and non-alcoholic pairings] A twelve-seat French restaurant in a renovated machiya down a cobbled alley near the Imperial Palace, where a chef who is also an herb coordinator builds the course around scent — it opens with rose-distilled water — and pairs it with wine or with non-alcoholic aroma drinks made by herb distillation. Fish, foie gras, game and flower-strewn plates; one diner found the meat sauces rich. Lunch with four pairings is a little over ¥12,000; 10% service. English spoken. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a "unique style: chef × herb coordinator × sommelier"; a chef's course viewed over the kitchen and courtyard, paired with wines by the sommelier or with aroma pairings created by herb distillation. Reviewers in 2026 describe a warm owner greeting guests (February 2026), a team of male staff (September 2026) and a dining room opened up by removing part of the first-floor ceiling of a two-storey house (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "The chef's wish is for you to enjoy your meal time to the fullest" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Aroma pairings; rose-water welcome.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner took the full non-alcoholic pairing — kombucha and other drinks standing in for the acidity of white wine, the tannins of red and the sweetness of port — and called it the right decision.
"The sauce for the meat dishes was a bit too rich for my taste, as I'm not fond of spices" — July 2026.
A September 2026 guest found a vegetable mentioned as disliked still appeared in one dish — a small piece, eaten anyway.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・創作料理、中京区東洞院二条上ル壺屋町512-2、地下鉄丸太町駅から徒歩4分、昼 12:00〜15:00 (料理L.O.13:00)、夜 18:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.19:00)、月曜休み (祝日は営業)、完全予約制、サービス料10%、12席、6名以上で貸切可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、シェフ兼ハーブコーディネーター、ソムリエのワインペアリング、ハーブ蒸留のアロマペアリング (ノンアルコール)。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): 町家を改装、ダマスクローズの香りの水、Shinshu salmon とキャビア、Yamato tachibana、鱧、まぐろのタルタル、牡蠣のフラン、フォアグラのテリーヌ、ヒグマ、ふぐのジュレ、チーズの盛り合わせ、焼き菓子、昼は4種のペアリングで12,000円あまり。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); reservation only; 10% service.

places.name: Freestyle Italian Restaurant DA CIRO
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the restaurant cannot handle dietary needs or allergies raised on the day (Tabelog). Courses include fresh pasta, focaccia, pizza fritta and baked sweets (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan as served: vegetable-led courses but with fish, meat, cheese and cured meats in most dishes (2025–26 reviews). Ask when booking.
places.hours_raw: Lunch Tue–Sun and holidays from 12:00 (12:00–15:00); dinner Tue–Sat and holidays, starting at 18:00 or 19:00 (to 22:00); no dinner on Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only; tell the restaurant of any dietary needs or allergies, including companions’, when booking — none can be handled on the day (Tabelog). Courses: lunch ¥7,500 (7 dishes), lunch with five-drink pairing ¥12,700 (non-alcoholic ¥9,900), dinner ¥15,730 (9 dishes) (Tabelog). Service charge 5% at lunch, 10% at dinner (Tabelog, Japanese text). À la carte on two days every two months (July 2026). 9 counter seats on the fifth floor; private hire; non-smoking, smoking space available; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 April 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Freestyle Italian courses built on seasonal vegetables, with wine pairings chosen by the owner-chef, a sommelier (Tabelog; May 2026) · lunch ¥7,500 (7 dishes), dinner ¥15,730 (9 dishes), pairings from ¥9,900 non-alcoholic to ¥12,700 at lunch (Tabelog) · 2025–26 dishes: corn soup with corn mini-pizza and corn gelato; horse mackerel carpaccio; fig soup and fig zeppole with prosciutto; Hida beef with zucchini and gorgonzola; Densuke conger eel with corn, beef tongue and black truffle; chicken with a burdock tiramisu; cold pasta with peach, tomato and burrata; Shinshu salmon with pumpkin gnocchi; foie gras terrine monaka (2025–26 reviews) · a final pasta ordered by weight in 10 g steps (May and October 2026) · focaccia, also to take away by pre-order (October 2026) · homemade cola, cream melon soda (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Creative Italian · Gion, a sommelier-chef's nine-seat counter] A quiet fifth-floor counter north of Shijo where the owner-chef, also a sommelier, builds playful seasonal courses around vegetables — a corn soup served with corn pizza and corn gelato, figs four ways, cold pasta with peach and burrata — then lets you choose the size of the final pasta by the 10 g. Lunch ¥7,500, dinner ¥15,730, with wine or non-alcoholic pairings; 5–10% service. Give allergies when booking. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef and sommelier (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a freestyle Italian restaurant where the owner-chef combines techniques and ingredients freely, with wines from a specialist shop and pairing as part of the concept. A May 2026 reviewer notes the chef is also a sommelier; reviewers describe the chef as approachable and often at the counter explaining dishes (May and October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal vegetable courses; pasta by weight; focaccia.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner who could not choose between four white wines was offered two 50 ml pours.
A July 2026 diner found the pairing pours only 50 cc and ordered a glass of white instead.
A July 2026 regular said à la carte is offered on just two days every two months.

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead and give allergies at booking; set course; cards, e-money and QR accepted.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Dietary restrictions and allergies, including companions’, must be given at booking or before arrival; none can be accommodated on the day.

places.name: 京野菜 桜肉 鴨肉 子鴨 (kogamo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses include tempura and a soy- or ponzu-seasoned hot pot; grilled duck and horse sashimi are served with condiments and ponzu (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a duck and horse-meat restaurant; the hot pot is cooked with duck (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00 (last food order 21:00); closed Monday (Tabelog). Ingredients are limited, so an early booking or a course is recommended; ask for horse meat when booking, as supply is limited (Tabelog; September 2025). Courses: Kyoto duck salt-grill course ¥7,900, duck hot pot course ¥9,700, horse and duck hot pot course ¥12,900 — the hot pots in autumn and winter (Tabelog). 12 seats at a hinoki counter facing the open kitchen; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards and QR, no e-money (Tabelog). Bookings for one are accepted (September 2026). In a small alley off Kawaramachi south of Sanjo; 3 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; January 2026). Opened 13 July 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi south of Sanjo — 3 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto duck, horse meat (sakura-niku) and Kyoto vegetables at a counter, with sake from Kyoto and Omi and French and Italian wines (Tabelog, shop text) · duck yukhoe, duck breast and tenderloin sashimi, salt-grilled and roast duck, duck soboro rice (2025–26 reviews) · horse sashimi, horse liver sashimi, steak, sakura-don of horse yukhoe on rice ¥1,900 (2024–26 reviews; March 2025) · duck hot pot in a copper pot with Kyoto vegetables, finished as rice porridge with egg (autumn–winter) (February–March 2025) · seasonal salads, vegetable and nama-fu tempura (2025–26 reviews) · lemon beer and dekopon highball ¥980 each (March 2025) · courses ¥7,900–12,900 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Duck & horse meat · Kawaramachi Sanjo, a hinoki counter in an alley] A 12-seat counter tucked off Kawaramachi where the cooks serve Kyoto duck — as yukhoe, sashimi so fresh it barely needs the hot pot, salt-grilled or roasted — alongside tender horse sashimi and liver, with Kyoto vegetables as salad and tempura. In autumn and winter the duck hot pot in a copper pot is the draw. Courses ¥7,900–12,900; ask for horse meat when booking. Solo diners welcome. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): Kyoto vegetables, Kyoto duck and horse meat prepared by chefs specialising in Kyoto cuisine, at a hinoki counter with an open kitchen; opened 13 July 2013. Reviewers note the chef’s care over seasoning and the order of dishes (March 2025) and passion for the ingredients (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto duck; horse sashimi; duck hot pot.

anecdotes.text: A November 2024 diner loved the horse liver but found the menu a little limited.
A September 2026 solo diner felt unwell mid-course; the staff were kind as the diner left early.
A September 2026 diner wished for more dishes unique to the restaurant, as many are simply grilled or in hot pot.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 馬肉料理・日本料理・居酒屋、中京区河原町三条下ル大黒町46-1、三条駅から徒歩約3分、火〜日 18:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 21:00)、月曜休み、食材に限りがあるため早めの予約かコースを、京鴨の塩焼きコース7,900円、鴨鍋コース9,700円、桜肉と鴨の鍋コース12,900円 (鍋は秋冬)、12席、檜のカウンターとオープンキッチン、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード・QR 可、2013年7月13日オープン。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 鴨のユッケ、鴨の刺身、桜肉の刺身、レバー刺し、銅鍋の鴨鍋と雑炊、京野菜の天ぷら、生麩の天ぷら、馬肉は予約時に伝えると確実、メニューが少ないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course online; ask for horse meat when booking; solo diners accepted.

places.name: 鮨 楽味 (Sushi Rakumi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae sushi with soy, marinated fish and sauces, plus cooked dishes such as fried sea bream (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi omakase of fish and shellfish (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Two sittings, starting 17:00 and 19:30, about two hours each; closed Sunday and the second and fourth Mondays — ask about holidays (Tabelog). Reservation only; bookings for the month after next open at the start of each month; cancellation charges 50% three days before, 80% two days before, 100% the day before or on the day (Tabelog). Card payment only, no cash; service charge included in the course price (Tabelog, Japanese text). 8 counter seats of a single slab of cypress, with a waiting room and bar upstairs overlooking the river; private hire (Tabelog; October 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On the Shirakawa north of Shijo; 5 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 11 January 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shirakawa, north Gion — 5 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Edomae sushi with Kyoto dashi techniques from Gion Sasaki, as an omakase of small dishes then nigiri (Tabelog, shop text; 2025–26 reviews) · rice seasoned with both red and white vinegar; fish from Kyoto, Toyosu and Yaizu (Tabelog) · marinated tuna, grilled eel with simmered daikon, abalone jelly in a persimmon, nodoguro and horse-mackerel sashimi, chawanmushi with ikura or shirako, abalone with an abalone-liver risotto, grilled squid tentacles, snow crab with ikura, monkfish liver; lotus root with the gari (2025–26 reviews) · sake and wine with pairing advice (October 2025) · bills about ¥20,000–49,999 a head (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Gion Shirakawa, Gion Sasaki's sushi counter] An eight-seat cypress counter on the Shirakawa, produced by Gion Sasaki and led by chef Kazuya Nomura, from Toyama. The omakase moves from Kyoto-style small dishes — abalone with its liver risotto, chawanmushi, seasonal sashimi — to Edomae nigiri on red- and white-vinegar rice. A cheerful, chatty counter; on some nights most guests are from abroad (2025). Card only, service included; about ¥20,000–50,000. Two sittings, 17:00 and 19:30.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): sushi chefs trained at Gion Sasaki and Sushi Yoshitake; the sushi concept of Gion Sasaki, blending Kyoto dashi with Edomae technique. An October 2025 reviewer says the chef is from Toyama; reviewers describe a cheerful, friendly chef and a lively counter (October 2025 to October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "learning from the past to create the new."
chef_bio.specialty: Edomae sushi with red- and white-vinegar rice.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 diner liked the cooking but found the seasoning slightly salty and the sushi, about seven pieces, a little few for a big appetite.
An October 2025 diner found the Akashi sea bream sashimi exquisite but missed explanations of the dishes.
A six-time regular looks forward to the lotus root served with the gari on every visit (November 2025).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司・海鮮・日本料理、東山区三吉町332-6、三条駅から徒歩5分、2部制 (17:00〜、19:30〜、約2時間)、日曜・第2・第4月曜休み、完全予約制、翌々月の予約は月初から、キャンセル料3日前50%・2日前80%・前日と当日100%、カードのみ (現金不可)、サービス料はコース料金に含む、カウンター8席 (一枚板)、2階に待合、貸切可、禁煙、2019年1月11日オープン、祇園さゝ木の寿司、料理人 Kazuya Nomura、京の出汁と江戸前、赤酢と白酢のシャリ。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 白川沿い、Toyama 出身の大将、漬けのまぐろ、鮑と肝のリゾット、茶碗蒸し、明るく気さくな店、塩味がやや強いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book two months ahead at the start of the month; card only; strict cancellation fees.

places.name: 近又 (Kinmata)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a whole: tempura is central — the lunch tendon, the sesame-tofu tempura and the counter’s fried "uni bread" — alongside a dashi-and-soy kaiseki (2026 reviews). Ask about a kaiseki without fried dishes.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kaiseki built on dashi, with fish and wagyu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–13:30 and dinner 17:30–19:00 are the last seatings (counter lunch to 13:00, counter dinner from 18:00); closed mainly on Wednesday, irregularly — see the calendar on the official site (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; a booking may be cancelled if the guest cannot be reached 30 minutes after the time (Tabelog). Service charge 15% (Tabelog, Japanese text). Tatami-room lunch kaiseki ¥10,000, ¥15,000 and ¥20,000 for 2–8 (Tabelog); tempura-bowl lunches ¥2,200–5,750 (March 2026); dinners about ¥20,000–60,000 (March 2026). 50 seats: a 9-seat counter and six tatami rooms for 2 to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Near Nishiki Market; 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2026).
places.neighborhood: Near Nishiki Market — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki since 1801 in a townhouse that is a registered tangible cultural property, with ingredients from Nishiki Market (official site; Tabelog) · tatami-room lunch kaiseki ¥10,000–20,000 with matcha (Tabelog) · counter lunch of tempura bowls ¥2,200–5,750 with red miso soup, the special with conger eel, shrimp, abalone, scallop, sea bream and hamo (March 2026) · sesame-tofu tempura, a house speciality (2026 reviews) · counter-only "uni bread" — fried fish paste topped with sea urchin at the counter (April 2026) · spring 2026: wild vegetables with isaza, white asparagus soup with fresh-shaved bonito, kue sashimi, grilled anago with sansho, black wagyu or strip loin, hojicha dashi chazuke (April 2026) · summer: hamo, Saikyo-grilled sawara, dashimaki (June 2026) · autumn: conger eel shabu-shabu, saury kamameshi (September 2026) · rice from Shiga (March 2026)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Nishiki, an 1801 inn-turned-kaiseki house] A registered-heritage Kyoto townhouse by Nishiki Market that began in 1801 as an inn for medicine merchants from Omi and still serves kaiseki in tatami rooms around a small courtyard garden. Book a private room for a seasonal kaiseki (lunch from ¥10,000), or sit at the 9-seat counter for the theatrical uni bread and hojicha chazuke — or a tempura-bowl lunch from ¥2,200. Eighth-generation family run; 15% service. Mainly closed Wednesday.

roles: Family-run house; seventh- and eighth-generation owners (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1801 (Kyowa 1) as an inn for medicine merchants from Omi under the name 近江屋; the fourth-generation 又八 renamed it 近又, from 近 of 近江 and 又 of 又八. Reviewers met the seventh- and eighth-generation owners (March 2026) and heard stories from the eighth generation (August 2026); a June 2026 diner had breakfast there before.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto kaiseki; sesame-tofu tempura; uni bread.

anecdotes.text: A February 2023 diner who had said at booking that raw fish was a problem was served sea bream sashimi; the owner ran after the diner to apologise.
A March 2026 diner waited about 50 minutes for a tempura bowl while a course guest was served first.
A September 2026 couple, too full to finish, were given the rest of the saury kamameshi as rice balls to take home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kinmata.com): 創業1801年 (享和元年) の京懐石料理店、登録有形文化財の京町家、近江の国からの薬商人の定宿として始まり、初代又八が「近江屋」として宿を始め、四代目又八の代に「近又」と改名、錦市場の材料、少人数向けのカウンター席「近また」は昼はミニ懐石や天ぷら、夜は天ぷらコースや鉄板焼きを含む料理長の特別コース。食べログ: 日本料理、中京区大日町407、京都河原町駅から徒歩5分、昼 12:00〜13:30・夜 17:30〜19:00 (最終入店、カウンターは昼13:00まで・夜18:00から)、主に水曜不定休、サービス料15％、座敷の昼懐石10,000円・15,000円・20,000円、50席 (カウンター9席と座敷6室)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2023年2月〜2026年9月、英語): 七代目と八代目、天丼のランチ2,200〜5,750円、胡麻豆腐の天ぷら、カウンターの Uni Bread、ほうじ茶の出汁茶漬け、天丼を50分ほど待ったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a tatami room or the counter; staff explain each dish; 15% service charge.

places.name: ぢんとら (Jintora)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Soft serve with shichimi or sansho mixed in; whether it comes in a cone or a cup, and the cone’s ingredients, are not stated (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: milk soft serve (2026 reviews). The spice blends are sold separately to take home.
places.hours_raw: Official site: 10:00–18:00, open every day except at New Year. Tabelog gives 9:30–18:00. No reservations (Tabelog). Cards and e-money accepted; no QR (Tabelog). 4 seats for eating in (Tabelog; March 2025). Inside Nishiki Market, 3 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn (official site). Sansho products limited to two bags a person because of scarce supply (official site).
places.neighborhood: Nishiki Market, west of Sakaimachi — 3 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Shichimi specialist founded in 1878, selling Kyoto shichimi, ichimi, sansho, yuzu-kosho and yuzu shichimi; a few seats for its soft serve (official site; Tabelog) · shichimi soft serve, pale pink, sweet first then a tingle of heat in the throat — ¥430 (2024–2025), ¥480 (July 2026) · sansho soft serve ¥480 (October 2026) · a mixed swirl (March 2025) · yuzu shichimi around ¥450 a jar to take home (January 2025)
places.notes: [Sweets · Nishiki Market, shichimi soft serve] A Nishiki Market spice shop that has blended shichimi since 1878 and, on the side, swirls it into soft serve: pale pink, sweet at first, then a gentle heat that tickles the throat. There is a sansho version too (¥480 in 2026). Four seats to eat in; buy a jar of yuzu shichimi on the way out. Open daily 10:00–18:00.

roles: Family spice house (operator ぢんとら Co., Ltd.)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in Meiji 11 (1878), blending fragrant shichimi passed down from one heir to the next, in Nishiki Market.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto shichimi; shichimi soft serve.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 visitor asked how hot it was; the staff said not very, but that the throat would tingle later — so the visitor cautiously ordered a mixed swirl.
A January 2025 visitor bought three jars of yuzu shichimi as light souvenirs and ended up keeping the jars at home after the family raved about the yuzu shichimi in a hot pot.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ぢんとら、創業明治11年、一子相伝の七味、中京区中魚屋町494 (錦市場内)、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩3分、10:00〜18:00、無休 (年始は休み)、京七味、一味、柚こしょう、山椒、七味・山椒ソフトクリーム、山椒は入手困難のため1人2袋まで。食べログ: 9:30〜18:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー可、4席。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 七味ソフトクリーム430円 (2026年7月は480円)、山椒ソフトクリーム480円、ピンク色、甘さのあとに喉にピリッと、柚子七味は約450円。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk-up counter in Nishiki Market; four seats.

places.name: ブイヤベースのお店 プチポワソン (Petit Poisson)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Bouillabaisse of fish and shellfish served with focaccia; starters include quiche and pâté; a cutlet in one course; canelé to take away; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a bouillabaisse house built on fish stock, with duck and pâté among the starters (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (food L.O. 12:30, drinks 14:00) Thursday–Sunday; dinner 17:00–22:30 (food L.O. 20:00, drinks 21:30) Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday and some Tuesdays and Wednesdays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (card details for Tabelog online booking); à la carte bookings on the day only; 100% cancellation fee the day before for the private-room bouillabaisse course (Tabelog). No service charge; one drink per person at dinner (Tabelog, original text). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 13 seats: 7 at the counter, 6 in a sunken-kotatsu private room (Tabelog). Non-smoking; ashtray outside (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Off Takakura north of Bukkoji, 5 min from Shijo and Karasuma Stns (Tabelog). Opened 25 October 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takakura north of Bukkoji, near Shijo-Karasuma — 5 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Bouillabaisse specialist: a rich broth made with fish trimmings that would otherwise be discarded (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews) · lunch bouillabaisse set ¥3,600 — a generous starter plate (duck breast, tofu, quiche, carrot râpée, pâté, salad), the day’s bouillabaisse (sea bream, mussels, eggplant) and focaccia from HANAKAGO (August–October 2026) · dinner courses: two fish starters, bouillabaisse, a meat main such as a cutlet, dessert; a sweetfish bouillabaisse course in November 2026 · private-room bouillabaisse course (Tabelog) · large canelé to take away (October 2026) · wine, sake, shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [French bistro · Shijo-Karasuma, Kyoto’s bouillabaisse house] A small counter bistro off Takakura that makes one thing its business: bouillabaisse, rich with seafood and built from fish trimmings. The ¥3,600 lunch brings a crowded starter plate and the day’s bouillabaisse — sea bream, mussels, vegetables — with focaccia; dinner courses add fish starters and a meat main. Take a canelé home. Book ahead (counter seats are few); one drink each at dinner; closed Monday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), trained at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Nice (September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per a September 2026 review: the chef trained at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Nice, and the restaurant is listed in Gault&Millau POP. Tabelog gives the opening as 25 October 2020. An October 2026 reviewer took the calm host to be a female owner.
chef_bio.philosophy: The signature bouillabaisse uses fish trimmings that would otherwise be discarded (shop’s Tabelog text).
chef_bio.specialty: Bouillabaisse.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 lunch guest, nervous about French table manners, found there was nothing to worry about.
A November 2026 diner had the chef’s course built around a sweetfish bouillabaisse.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ブイヤベースのお店 プチポワソン、ビストロ・フレンチ、下京区高倉通仏光寺上ル西前町374-1、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩5分、昼11:30〜15:00 (木〜日)、夜17:00〜22:30 (火〜日、料理L.O.20:00)、月曜と一部の火・水休み、予約可、アラカルトは当日予約のみ、サービス料なし、ディナーは1ドリンク制、カード・電子マネー・QR可、13席 (カウンター7、掘りごたつ6)、禁煙、英語メニュー、2020年10月25日オープン。店の取り組み: 捨てられる魚のアラでブイヤベース。口コミ (2026年、英語): 昼のブイヤベースセット3,600円、前菜の盛り合わせ (鴨、豆腐、キッシュ、キャロットラペ、パテ)、鯛のブイヤベース、HANAKAGO のフォカッチャ、持ち帰りのカヌレ、シェフはニースの星付きで修業、Gault&Millau POP。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book ahead; one drink per person at dinner.

places.name: バル agiyao (Bar agiyao)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Fish small plates with white wine; bread with the ajillo and pan con tomate, a monaka-wafer otoshi, fried monkfish, squid-ink rice croquettes and fries are not gluten-free (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-seafood bar (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: 17:00–24:00 on weekdays, 14:00–24:00 on weekends and holidays; lunch with white wine is served upstairs at 魚料理あぎやお from 12:00. Tabelog: 17:00–23:00 Monday–Thursday, 12:00–23:00 Friday–Sunday and holidays; irregular closures. Reservations accepted; take care not to book the 2nd-floor restaurant by mistake; ¥7,700 cancellation fee from two days before (Tabelog). Otoshi ¥550 per person (Tabelog, original text). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 24 seats: 8 at the counter, two tables for four, a counter private room for five (room fee ¥2,500) (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children only in the private room (Tabelog). About 10 m east of the Gojo–Higashinotoin crossing, 2 min from Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 3 February 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gojo-Higashinotoin — 2 min from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: “Fish × white wine” bar: seasonal fish and a deep white-wine list, with Kyoto ingredients (official site) · otoshi of a taiyaki-shaped monaka (March–October 2026) · kohada with cucumber and aonori, purple sea urchin with pan con tomate, smoked anago with green papaya, squid and mushroom ajillo (September 2026) · mussels in white wine, boiled black clams, herring bagna cauda, uni bruschetta, grilled kinmedai, flounder marinated with dill, squid-ink rice croquettes, tuna with tomato, eel, soup paella (October 2026) · fried monkfish, Basque ham, French fries (September 2026) · white wine chosen to your taste, sparkling, champagne (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Wine bar · Gojo, fish and white wine] A grown-up bar at Gojo–Higashinotoin built on a simple pairing: seasonal fish and a long list of white wine, poured to your taste. Start with the taiyaki-shaped monaka otoshi, then small plates — sea urchin on pan con tomate, kohada, ajillo with bread, grilled kinmedai, a soup paella. The fish restaurant agiyao is upstairs; book the right floor. ¥550 otoshi; open until midnight.

roles: Owner (named Aoyagi in a September 2026 review), who also runs fish restaurants; kitchen chef (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per a September 2026 review: the owner, Aoyagi, also runs Uo Ryori Aoyagi near Gion and is involved in a wine shop; the sister restaurant 魚料理あぎやお is upstairs in the same building, which an October 2026 reviewer says holds a Michelin star. Tabelog gives the opening as 3 February 2014.
chef_bio.philosophy: Supporting Kyoto’s food culture and local producers with Kyoto ingredients (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Fish small plates with white wine.

anecdotes.text: On a September 2026 day when the chef had just left, the owner was cooking and serving alone, and the lunchtime guest got to eat the owner’s own cooking.
Four friends in October 2026 got through about fifteen glasses of white wine, poured in a considered order.
An October 2026 visitor found the master intimidating at first, then friendly and full of wine recommendations.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: お魚と白ワインのバル agiyao、下京区深草町592-3 1階、旬の魚と豊富な白ワインの大人のバル、京都産の食材で京都の食文化と地元産業を応援、平日17時〜24時、土日祝14時〜24時、白ワインのランチは2階の魚料理あぎやおで12時から。食べログ: 月〜木 17:00〜23:00、金〜日祝 12:00〜23:00、不定休、予約可、2日前からキャンセル料7,700円、お通し550円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、24席 (カウンター8、テーブル4人×2、個室5人、個室料2,500円)、禁煙、2014年2月3日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 店主の Aoyagi さんは Gion 近くの魚料理店も営む、2階の姉妹店はミシュランの星、たい焼き型の最中のお通し、雲丹のパンコントマテ、アヒージョ、金目鯛の焼き物、スープパエリア、白ワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥550 otoshi; book the right floor (bar on 1F, restaurant on 2F); cancellation fee from two days before.

places.name: kurs
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery of sourdough, croissants, pain de mie and baguette sandwiches (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Croissants, condensed-milk butter bread and sandwiches use dairy, egg and meat; the levain and other lean breads are not described (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Opens from about 7:00 (sometimes 6:00); the day’s opening time is posted on Instagram; closed Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog; July–October 2026). Closing time not given; long breaks are announced (one until 26 August in 2026). Queues at opening — 40 minutes in July 2026 — easier around 10:00 (2026 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog; July 2026). Takeaway bakery; seats not listed (Tabelog). In a back lane near Nijo Castle, a brick building with a spiral stair, 5–6 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Began as an event stall; shop opened at the end of 2019 (October 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Near Nijo Castle, by Ogawa-dori — 5–6 min from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Bakery of hard breads and generous sandwiches: house sourdough levain, croissants, pain de mie seen on TV (2026 reviews) · sandwiches: chicken and gorgonzola ¥500, BLT ¥650, blue cheese and ham, croque madame ¥550, fig fruit sandwich ¥1,000 (September–October 2026) · sausage bread with Kawakita-ya sausage ¥600 (September 2026) · epi ¥300, salted butter ¥300, diamante ½ ¥340, chestnut and brown sugar ½ ¥380, céréales ½ ¥480, pain de mie ¥430 (September–October 2026) · cinnamon and cardamom rolls, flan, carrot cake, chewy doughnuts, condensed-milk butter bread (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bakery · Nijo Castle, hard bread at first light] A hidden bakery in a back lane near Nijo Castle — brick front, spiral stair — that opens around 7 a.m. (check Instagram that morning) and draws a queue for its sourdough, deeply buttery croissants and pain de mie. The sandwiches are the other reason to come: chicken and gorgonzola, a stacked BLT, a ¥1,000 fig fruit sandwich. Cash only; Thursday to Sunday; arrive at opening or around ten.

roles: Baker-owner (unnamed in Tabelog; one review thanks “Masamichi” and the baker’s wife)
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: it began as an event vendor and opened its shop at the end of 2019. Another October 2026 regular thanked "Masamichi and your wife".
chef_bio.specialty: Croissants; sourdough; sandwiches.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor waited 40 minutes after a 7 a.m. opening and left with twelve items for ¥5,620.
An October 2026 regular calls these the best croissants of a lifetime, rich with butter yet never heavy, and still fairly priced.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: kurs、パン、中京区西大黒町334 コーポラス二条1F、二条城前駅から430m、朝7時から (その日の開店時間は Instagram で)、月・火・水休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 自家製の天然酵母のルヴァン、クロワッサン、テレビで紹介されたパンドミ、鶏とゴルゴンゾーラ500円、BLT650円、クロックマダム550円、いちじくのフルーツサンド1,000円、ソーセージパン600円、行列、現金のみ、イベント出店から始まり2019年末に店舗。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; check Instagram for the opening time; queues at opening.

places.name: 先斗町寿司よし乃 (Pontocho Sushi Yoshino)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi with soy and sauces, saikyo-miso grilled fish, fried dishes and vinegared dishes; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi, sashimi, grilled fish and clam soup (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 17:00–22:30; Sat–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–22:30 (last orders 14:00 and 22:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; the omakase "sushi kaiseki" by the day before; on 30–31 December, course bookings only; families with children under school age contact ahead (Tabelog). 17 seats: 9 at the counter and 8 at tables; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Pontocho near the Kaburenjo theatre, now on the ground floor after moving down from the 2nd floor of the same building; 5 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho near the Kaburenjo — 5 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Sushi and à la carte Kyoto dishes: omakase "sushi kaiseki" ¥11,000 (Tabelog) · in 2025–26 reviews: grilled sawara and saikyo-miso black cod, three kinds of vinegared dishes, shima-aji sushi with a sauce, surf clam, sea urchin, ikura and scallop, clam soup made to order, fried dishes including conger eel, yuzu sorbet
places.notes: [Sushi · Pontocho] A small sushi counter on Pontocho by the Kaburenjo, now at street level, known as much for its side dishes — vinegared plates, saikyo-miso black cod, a clam soup made to order — as for the sushi. Omakase sushi kaiseki ¥11,000 (book a day ahead) or à la carte; bills around ¥8,000–15,000. Busy with overseas visitors; book. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Listed as opening 9 December 2021 (Tabelog); per the operator, the shop moved from the 2nd floor of its building to the ground floor facing Pontocho. A September 2025 reviewer first visited "7 to 8 years ago".
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi kaiseki; side dishes.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 returnee, back after seven or eight years, was remembered by the owner.
A twelve-time regular in October 2026 noted two hours of "consistently meticulous service".
A May 2026 diner found the staff stretched: one server friendly and full of explanations, another "quite unfriendly"; the ikura was "just okay".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 先斗町寿司よし乃、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、中京区石屋町122-5、三条駅から徒歩5分、月火木金 17:00〜22:30、土日 11:30〜14:30・17:00〜22:30、水曜休み、17席 (カウンター9、テーブル8)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可、2021年12月9日オープン、ビルの2階から先斗町に面した1階へ移転、おまかせの寿司懐石11,000円 (前日までに予約)。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 鰆の焼き物、銀鱈の西京焼き、三種の酢の物、北寄貝、雲丹、注文ごとの貝の吸い物、穴子の揚げ物、柚子のシャーベット、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; many overseas guests (2025–26 reviews).

places.name: グランマーブル 祇園本店 (GRAND MARBLE Gion honten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Danish bread and pies (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: butter-laminated Danish bread and butter pies (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:30–18:30 daily; a summer break 6–10 July (Tabelog). Mainly a takeaway shop; 4 seats (Tabelog); the café upstairs, カフェ・グランマーブル祇園ちから, serves French toast and croque-monsieur (2026 reviews). Some items sell out by late afternoon (June 2026). Cards, IC cards and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). In a Gion machiya; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gion south of Shijo, near Yasaka Shrine — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Marble Danish bread by the loaf or slice in boxed gift sets, about 11 days' shelf life: plain "Prestige" ¥1,188 (August 2026), matcha with azuki or kuromitsu, matcha chocolate, Kyoto three-colour, brown-sugar milk kinako, azuki butter, chocolate banana; burnt-sugar butter pie ¥783 (September 2026); leaf pie, sandwich cookies, chocolate (2026 reviews; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Danish bread · Gion] The Gion flagship of a Kyoto marble-Danish bakery (founded 1996, per a reviewer), in a machiya near Yasaka Shrine: boxed loaves in flavours like matcha-azuki or Kyoto three-colour, which keep about 11 days — a favourite Kyoto gift. Loaves from about ¥1,188; a café upstairs. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a Kyoto marble-Danish specialist founded in 1996, the Danish ranked first in Kyoto City's furusato-tax bread category five years running (August 2026). The official site lists this Gion main shop and a factory shop, with pop-up shops at department stores elsewhere in Japan (November 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Marble Danish bread.

anecdotes.text: By 4 pm on a June 2026 afternoon, some items were already sold out.
A June 2026 regular found the Danish less buttery than remembered, and a little sweet and greasy toasted.
A gift recipient in August 2026 sliced and toasted the plain loaf the next morning as instructed — "crispy and delicious".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (grandmarble.com): GRAND MARBLE、グランマーブル祇園本店、グランマーブル ファクトリー店、大丸福岡天神店と水戸京成百貨店の期間限定ショップ (2026年11月)。食べログ (店舗会員): パン・チョコレート、東山区祇園街南側570-238、祇園四条駅から徒歩約5分、10:30〜18:30 (無休、7月6〜10日は夏季休業)、4席、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年6〜9月、英語): マーブルデニッシュ、Prestige 1,188円、抹茶あん、抹茶黒蜜、Kyoto Sanshoku、黒糖ミルクきなこ、焦がし砂糖のバターパイ783円、賞味期限11日、2階はカフェ・グランマーブル祇園ちから、1996年創業、ふるさと納税のパン部門で5年連続1位。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick boxed loaves at the counter; go early for the full range.

places.name: 上古屋 (Joko Ya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, fried shrimp and squid tempura, oden broth and sushi; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led izakaya; even the cold tomato oden sits in broth (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–23:30 (last order 23:00); 2nd-floor seats to 22:30 (last order 22:00); closed over New Year and in summer, and on some days (e.g. 8 October) (official site; Tabelog). Starter charge ¥330 per person — Tabelog's Japanese original: "付き出し330円". Bookings taken; walk-ins sometimes possible (September 2026). Counter on the ground floor, tables with sunken footwells upstairs: 21 seats per Tabelog, 22 per the official site; children basically not admitted; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog; official site). In a machiya on Nishinotoin south of Takoyakushi; 6 min from Karasuma or Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishinotoin south of Takoyakushi, near Shijo-Karasuma — 6 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese izakaya built on ingredients and sake from the owner's home, Kyotango: fish from Kyotango and Maizuru, Kyoto vegetables and over ten sake (official site; 2026 reviews) · salt-seared Kyoto sawara, sashimi platters, deep-fried gasa shrimp, squid-leg tempura, raw octopus with wasabi, seafood yukhoe, cold shinjo, basil potato salad, cold oden with Kyoto tomatoes, grilled chicken neck, mozuku in vinegar, grilled saba sushi to finish (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Nishinotoin near Shijo-Karasuma] A machiya izakaya where the owner, from Kyotango on the Japan Sea, serves fish and sake from home: salt-seared sawara, crisp gasa shrimp, saba sushi to finish. Counter downstairs, sunken tables upstairs; ¥330 starter; about ¥5,000–8,000. Popular — book. Open to 23:30.

chef_bio.background: Opened 31 August 2016 (Tabelog). Per the official site: a Japanese izakaya near Shijo-Karasuma serving ingredients and local sake from the owner's hometown, Kyotango. An August 2026 reviewer says the shop is named after the chef's surname and calls it "Kamigoya"; Tabelog romanises it "Joko Ya" and the site is johkoya.com.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyotango fish; grilled saba sushi.

anecdotes.text: A party of three in June 2026 had the sashimi platter sized for three.

An October 2026 diner found the fish not very fatty that season, and the fried gasa shrimp heavily seasoned — "more like a snack" — which "might actually be a good thing"; locals and tourists were about half and half.
A September 2026 regular overate again: the saba sushi at the end was "a bit too much".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (johkoya.com): 上古屋、京都 四条/烏丸駅にほど近い西洞院蛸薬師の和食居酒屋、店主の地元である京丹後の食材や地酒、17:30〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00)、2階席は22:30まで (L.O. 22:00)、年末年始と夏季休業、10月8日休み、22席 (カウンター8、テーブル14)。食べログ (店舗会員): 居酒屋・海鮮・鍋、中京区西洞院蛸薬師下ル古西町427、付き出し330円、21席、子供は基本的に不可、2016年8月31日オープン。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): 京丹後と舞鶴の魚、京都の鰆の塩たたき、刺身の盛り合わせ、ガサエビの唐揚げ、げそ天、焼き鯖寿司、冷やし真薯、京都のトマトの冷やしおでん、店名は料理人の名字、店主は丹後出身。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; ¥330 starter; adults only, basically.

places.name: Sudo
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: "We do not offer vegan, vegetarian, or gluten-free menus", and the course centres on pizza and fresh pasta (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: no vegan or vegetarian menu (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat and holidays 18:00–22:30; Sun 12:00–14:30 and 18:30–22:30; closed Monday and on some other days (Tabelog). Reservation only; the course can take 2–3 hours (Tabelog; August 2026). Service charge 5% — Tabelog's Japanese original: "サーヴィス料 5%". BYO with a corkage fee (Tabelog). 9 counter seats; private hire up to 20; children of school age eating an adult course; no strong perfume or very casual clothes; sommelier; non-smoking; cards incl. UnionPay (Tabelog). Takeaway of leftover pizza (October 2026). On Nijo-dori east of Fuyacho; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo-dori east of Fuyacho — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: A monthly-changing omakase that blends Italian cooking with the chef's Japanese-cuisine background, with Neapolitan pizza from an Italian oven at the counter; seasonal ingredients from the market, Kyoto pickles among the surprises; about 100 wines and sommelier pairings (Tabelog) · seasonal omakase ¥6,600, lunch course ¥6,600, Christmas course ¥11,000 (Tabelog) · in 2026 reviews: bonito pizza, edamame genovese pizza, house chitarra with Miyagi mackerel confit and daikon, mussels arrabbiata, karasumi peperoncino, pork or duck mains, eel, financier
places.notes: [Italian omakase & pizza · Nijo-Fuyacho] A nine-seat counter opened in 2025 where a chef with a Japanese-cuisine background cooks a long seasonal omakase, with Neapolitan pizza from the oven in front of you. Courses ¥6,600 (+5% service), lunch on Sundays; wine pairings. Allow 2–3 hours. No vegan, vegetarian or gluten-free menus. Closed Monday.

roles: Chef (unnamed; background in Japanese cuisine per the operator and 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 10 November 2025 (Tabelog). Per the operator: Italian cooking shaped by the chef's experience in Japanese cuisine. A July 2026 reviewer calls it a restaurant produced by "etto"; an October 2026 reviewer says the chef prepares everything alone, so dishes come at a leisurely pace.
chef_bio.specialty: Pizza within an omakase.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner booked for 7:30 pm and left at 10:30.
An October 2026 visitor took home the leftover pizza, after a bonito pizza that "was incredibly delicious".
An October 2026 diner found the course a bit oily and salty overall, with two similar slices of pizza, though the dessert was delicious.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Sudo、ピザ・イタリアン、中京区二条通麩屋町東入尾張町202-1 オーク二条、京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分、火〜土・祝 18:00〜22:30、日 12:00〜14:30・18:30〜22:30、月曜休み (ほかに休みあり)、完全予約制、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーのメニューなし、サーヴィス料5%、9席 (カウンター)、持ち込み可 (持ち込み料あり)、小学生以上、2025年11月10日オープン、和食の経験を生かしたイタリアン、イタリア製のピザ窯、ワイン約100種、季節のおまかせ6,600円、ランチ6,600円、クリスマス11,000円。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 鰹のピザ、枝豆のジェノベーゼ、キタッラ、からすみのペペロンチーノ、etto のプロデュース、料理人一人で調理、2〜3時間のコース。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; allow 2–3 hours; 5% service.

places.name: 宮川町ほった (Miyagawacho Hotta)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. An omakase of Kyoto cooking with dashi, soy and miso, plus a beef cutlet sandwich, somen, a mini ramen and nama-fu in some seasons; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led omakase with dashi, beef cutlet, eel and crab (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 Monday to Saturday, last entry 20:30; closed Sunday and irregularly (Tabelog); the Michelin Guide gives Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–23:00, closed Monday and Sunday. Reservation only; the phone may go unanswered during service (Tabelog); one omakase with everyone starting together (March 2026). Omakase ¥26,400 or ¥28,600, service and tax included (TableCheck). Tabelog’s English page says a service charge is added, but its Japanese original reads なし. 8 counter seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; junior-high age and up; cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay and others), no e-money (Tabelog). English menu; sommelier; BYO; take-away beef cutlet sandwich (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On the stone-paved Miyagawa-suji among teahouses; 4 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; Michelin Guide). Opened 14 June 2023 (Tabelog; a July 2026 reviewer says 2022).
places.neighborhood: Miyagawa-suji in the Miyagawacho geisha quarter — 4 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto omakase mixing tradition and play at an eight-seat counter (Michelin Guide; 2026 reviews) · omakase ¥26,400 or ¥28,600 (TableCheck) · winter: Yamaguchi tiger-fugu broth with grilled fins, house karasumi over rice, fugu milt with balsamic and black truffle, crab rice cooked like fried rice (January–February 2026) · spring: soy-milk soup with white asparagus and karasumi, firefly squid, clams and bamboo shoot, flounder with sesame (March 2026) · summer: corn soup with coffee jelly, sea urchin and squid with Handa somen, charcoal-grilled ayu soup, hamo, abalone with liver sauce, eel donabe rice (July 2026) · the signature fillet beef cutlet sandwich, also to take away · a mini seafood ramen, mochi pizza, tamago-kake-gohan (2026 reviews) · sake and wine chosen by the sommelier chef
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Miyagawacho, a playful Kyoto counter] An eight-seat counter on Miyagawacho's stone-paved lane of teahouses, run by a chef-sommelier who trained at Gion Sasaki. The omakase (about ¥26,400–28,600) moves from classic Kyoto dishes — fugu broth over grilled fins, house karasumi on rice, hamo and ayu in summer — to playful turns such as fugu milt with truffle, a mini seafood ramen and the signature fillet beef cutlet sandwich, before donabe rice. Diners in May 2026 found the entrance full of flowers for a new Michelin star. Everyone starts together; book ahead. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: The invoice register lists an individual, 堀田 功雄, for the shop’s invoice number. Per 2026 reviewers: the chef trained at Gion Sasaki (January and March 2026); a July 2026 reviewer adds that the chef is a sommelier and ran Sasaki’s sister restaurant BAR Kappo before going independent. Reviewers in May and July 2026 report a first Michelin star in the 2026 guide; the Michelin Guide page praises the unconventional flow with a beef cutlet and the owner’s handiwork. Opened 14 June 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Michelin Guide: cooking not bound by formality, with ideas that look unconventional at first — "格式に縛られない料理".
chef_bio.specialty: Fillet beef cutlet sandwich; house karasumi; seasonal donabe rice.

anecdotes.text: Two diners in May 2026 found the entrance full of flowers celebrating a new Michelin star.
A January 2026 guest watched the chef grill tiger-fugu fins over charcoal and pour fugu dashi over grilled nama-fu.
A March 2026 diner found the cold first soup’s aftertaste lacking and the dishes tasty but unsurprising, liking the mochi pizza best.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ミシュランガイド: 宮川町 ほった、日本料理、¥¥¥、東山区宮川筋6-359-4、火〜土 17:00–23:00、月・日休み、歌舞練場のある宮川町、石畳の筋にお茶屋や置屋、型破りと思える発想、ありきたりではない流れにビフカツを組み込む、格式に縛られない料理、頼もしい店主の手仕事。TableCheck: おまかせコース26,400円・28,600円 (サービス料・税込)、カウンター席。食べログ: 日本料理、完全予約制、月〜土 17:00〜23:00 (最終入店20:30)、日曜・不定休、サービス料なし、8席 (カウンター)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、車椅子可、中学生以上、カード・QR 可、英語メニュー、ソムリエ、持ち込み可、テイクアウト、2023年6月14日オープン、インボイス: 堀田 功雄 (個人)。口コミ (2026年1〜9月、英語): Gion Sasaki で修業、BAR Kappo、ミシュラン一つ星 (2026年)、ビフカツサンド。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); booking only; everyone starts together.

places.name: オステリア・コチネッラ (Osteria Coccinella)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta is the core of the menu (four or five a night); starters such as carpaccio, terrines and cheese may suit, but no gluten information is published (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, meat and cheese starters, meat ragù pasta and mains; a garlic peperoncino or tomato pomodoro pasta is on the sample menu, but no ingredient list is published (official menu).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:00) Tuesday to Sunday; holidays 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Monday, plus a run of days off once a month (Tabelog; official site; the official shop page lists Tuesday–Thursday). Table charge ¥300 (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 300円). Bookings taken; also welcome as a second-stop wine bar (official site). Seats: 21 per the official site (12 at tables, 9 at the counter), 19 per Tabelog; non-smoking. Cards: the official site says not accepted, Tabelog lists cards and PayPay. In a renovated townhouse on Takakura-dori east of Bukkoji; 5 min from Shijo or Hankyu Karasuma Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Takakura-dori by Bukkoji, south of Shijo-Karasuma — 5 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: À la carte osteria with about 500 wines (official site) · starters, about ten a night, e.g. wild yellowtail carpaccio ¥1,400, oysters in lemon butter ¥1,400, figs with sheep’s feta ¥1,400, lamb or shamo terrine ¥900, country pâté of Daisen pork ¥700, chicken terrines ¥600–700, pig’s trotter jelly ¥600, cheese from Via Zabbio ¥1,400 · pasta, four or five a night, e.g. Oe-farm tomato pomodoro ¥1,300, Spanish garlic peperoncino ¥1,200, carbonara ¥1,300, squid-ink bavettine ¥1,500, red snow crab arrabbiata fettuccine ¥1,800, lamb cacio e pepe ¥1,800, Kuroge wagyu brisket bolognese ¥1,800, Challans duck ragù ¥1,800 (official menu) · house ham of Yonezawa pork, buri tataki with fermented vegetables, trout carpaccio ¥1,500, Iberico pork red-wine pasta ¥1,800, bear bolognese (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Shijo-Karasuma, pasta and 500 wines in a townhouse] A wood-warm osteria in a renovated townhouse off Bukkoji-dori, where the owner-chef cooks simple Italian dishes with a twist — about ten starters of terrines, carpaccio and cheese, then four or five pastas from a ¥1,200 garlic peperoncino to lamb cacio e pepe or duck ragù — with some 500 wines to choose from. Regulars call it a pasta place worth returning to; one found it a bit salty. Fine as a second-stop wine bar. ¥300 table charge. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef (店主, official site; the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: The official site signs its greeting 店主 森山 雅彦, and the invoice register lists the same individual. Per the official site: a renovated townhouse full of warm wood, carefully chosen ingredients served simply with small accents, and about 500 wines in stock, chosen to the guest’s wishes. A July 2025 reviewer praises the chef’s skill as a solo operator.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: simple dishes with new pairings and small arrangements, and dishes where the ingredients’ own dashi comes through.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal pasta; terrines; wine.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 regular, on a fifth-plus visit, found the octopus with black hummus left the diner wondering how its umami was made.
A March 2024 diner found the food a bit salty and hoped it could be toned down.
A January 2026 diner liked the duck pâté, which a child also enjoyed, but felt hesitant to bring the family, accepting the shop has its own policy.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (coccinella77.com): 京都市下京区のイタリアン Osteria Coccinella、町屋を改装した木のぬくもり溢れる店内、厳選した食材をシンプルにちょっとしたアクセント、ワインは500本以上、二軒目のワインバーとしても、店主 森山 雅彦、メニュー (一例): 前菜約10品 (天然ブリのカルパッチョ1,400円、牡蠣のソテー レモンバターソース1,400円、イチジクと羊のフェタチーズ1,400円、仔羊のテリーヌ・軍鶏のテリーヌ900円、大山豚うで肉の田舎風パテ700円)、パスタ4〜5品 (大江農園のトマト ポモドーロ1,300円、スペイン産にんにくペペロンチーノ1,200円、カルボナーラ1,300円、紅ズワイガニのアラビアータ1,800円、仔羊のカチョエペペ1,800円、黒毛和牛ブリスケのボロネーゼ1,800円、シャラン鴨のラグー1,800円)、下京区高倉通仏光寺東入ル新開町397-2、18:00〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00)、月曜定休 (月1回連休)、21席 (テーブル12、カウンター9)、クレジットカード利用不可。食べログ: イタリアン・ワインバー・バル、火〜日 18:00〜23:30、祝日 18:00〜23:00、チャージ300円、19席、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、インボイス: 森山 雅彦 (個人)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語)。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥300 table charge; card acceptance differs between sources — bring cash.

places.name: monk
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the course opens and ends with wood-fired pizza of Japanese wheat and natural yeast (2023–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The cooking is centred on vegetables from Ohara farms, but the course also has fish, meat, cheese and dairy desserts; no vegan course is published (yousakana.jp; 2023–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Dinner from 17:30, last order 20:30; closed Monday (yousakana.jp, the restaurant’s own text); Tabelog gives 17:00–20:30 Tuesday to Saturday, closed Monday and Sunday. One omakase course built from the day’s ingredients, ¥15,400 (March and July 2026). Book well ahead — a March 2026 diner booked two months out; mostly overseas guests (2024–26 reviews). 14 seats: 6 at the counter facing the wood-fired oven and two tables for four; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners cards (Tabelog; March 2026). A detached house on the Philosopher’s Path near Ginkakuji; about 1.7 km from Keage Stn, narrow streets for cars (Tabelog; June 2024). Opened December 2015 (October 2023 review).
places.neighborhood: Philosopher’s Path near Ginkakuji — about 25 min walk from Keage Stn
places.cuisine: Omakase of the day’s ingredients cooked in a wood-fired oven, with pizza as the main (yousakana.jp) · ¥15,400 (2026) · begins with a soup and a plain "suyaki" pizza of Japanese wheat and natural yeast with Parmigiano and olive oil · wood-roasted Ohara vegetables, sashimi or fish with seasonal greens, Noto fruit tomatoes · ends with half-and-half pizzas chosen from about six, e.g. shirasu, wild venison ragù with sansho, bamboo shoot, mushroom, shungiku, Yoshida-farm cheese, margherita · desserts such as honey and dill, dill granita, sake-lees mousse (2023–26 reviews) · natural wines, house syrup drinks
places.notes: [Italian · Philosopher's Path, wood-fired vegetables and pizza] A fourteen-seat restaurant in a house on the Philosopher's Path, where chef 今井 義浩 (Imai) cooks nearly everything in a wood-fired oven: a plain dough 'suyaki' pizza to start, then vegetables picked up each morning from Ohara farms, fish and seasonal plates, and a closing half-and-half pizza such as shirasu or venison ragù with sansho. One course, about ¥15,400; counter seats face the fire. Featured on Netflix's Chef's Table, it is booked months ahead, mostly by overseas guests. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the restaurant’s own text (on yousakana.jp): a small restaurant on the Philosopher’s Path cooking simple food over live fire, with pizza from the wood-fired oven as the main dish; every morning the chef visits farms in the mountains of Ohara and markets around Kyoto. Tabelog notes the owner-chef paused in January 2020 to focus on writing and reopened in March 2020. Reviewers note the opening in December 2015, training at renowned restaurants abroad including one in Denmark and in California (October 2023), and a Netflix Chef’s Table episode (2024). Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the restaurant: "Is it possible to express the beauty and the life of the vegetable; to invoke such feelings as the sunlight, the moisture of the soil, the blowing of the wind?"
chef_bio.specialty: Wood-fired pizza; Ohara vegetables from the oven.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 regular on a twelfth visit comes with the diner’s mother every season, loving a honey-and-dill dessert.
An April 2024 diner joined an American colleague who had booked after watching Chef’s Table; everyone else in the room was from overseas.
A June 2024 diner drove up and nearly got stuck in the narrow streets, advising a nearby coin park instead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: yousakana.jp (店の紹介と店自身の文章): 京都・哲学の道、薪窯のレストラン monk、料理人 (ピザ職人) の今井義浩さん、毎日畑や市場から仕入れた食材を薪窯で、住所 左京区浄土寺下南田町147、17:30〜20:30 (L.O)、その日の食材によるお任せ、定休 月曜、電話 075-748-1154、メインにはピザ、毎日畑や市場から仕入れた食材 (英語の文では毎朝 Ohara の畑と京都の市場へ)。食べログ: イタリアン・ピザ、火〜土 17:00〜20:30、月・日休み、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、禁煙、店主は2020年1月から執筆のため休業し3月に再開、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): コース15,400円、2015年12月開店、Chef’s Table、カウンター6席とテーブル2卓、素焼きのピザ、Ohara の野菜、ハーフ&ハーフのピザ。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly overseas guests and some foreign staff (2024 reviews); book months ahead.

places.name: SCALAE (スカーラエ, THE THOUSAND KYOTO)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the hotel asks guests with food allergies to tell staff in advance (press release). Courses include pasta, bread, gnocchi and breaded mains (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask in advance. Courses use meat, fish, ham and dairy; no vegan course is published (2026 reviews; press releases).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–10:00 (last order), lunch 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:30–21:30 (last orders: course 20:00, à la carte 20:30, drinks 21:00); closed Wednesday (except holidays) (hotel press releases, September 2026; Tabelog). Service charge 15% of the pre-tax total from 1 April 2025 (Tabelog’s Japanese original: サービス料15％; also in the hotel’s release). Cancellation 100% from two days before (Tabelog). 110 seats with 3 private rooms (room fee ¥11,000); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; hotel parking (Tabelog; press release). Non-alcoholic tea pairing available (May 2026). On the 2nd floor of THE THOUSAND KYOTO, up the hotel’s grand staircase; 2 min east of JR Kyoto Stn, via underground exit 5 (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: THE THOUSAND KYOTO, east of Kyoto Station — 2 min from JR Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: Hotel Italian of seasonal courses with sommelier-team pairings (press releases; 2026 reviews) · lunch course "Stelo" (August 2026): prosciutto and peach amuse, corn carbonara, spaghettini with Kamo eggplant, myoga and fried white fish in white miso, the day’s fried fish with garden tomato sauce, Japanese-beef hamburg, zuppa inglese · gnocchi fritto, pork cotoletta with roasted pear (October 2026); summer truffle pasta in a ¥10,000 seven-course lunch (July 2026) · wine pairings by a team led by the hotel’s beverage director, a World’s Best Sommelier semi-finalist; non-alcoholic tea pairing · Christmas 2026 sommelier dinner ¥120,000 with seven drinks; LE TRABE × SCALAE collaboration 29–31 January 2027, ¥28,000 (press releases)
places.notes: [Italian · Kyoto Station, hotel Italian up the grand staircase] The Italian restaurant of THE THOUSAND KYOTO, two minutes from Kyoto Station, reached up the hotel's grand staircase. Chef Kenta Shibahara, born in Kyoto and trained at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Naples, cooks seasonal courses that play with texture — corn 'carbonara', Kamo eggplant spaghettini with white miso — paired by a sommelier team known for competition results. Lunch courses are the easy way in; 15% service on top. 110 seats and private rooms; closed Wednesday.

roles: 料理長 (head chef) of SCALAE; operator 京阪ホテルズ＆リゾーツ株式会社
chef_bio.background: Per the hotel’s September 2026 press release: 芝原 健太, born in Kyoto, went to Italy in 2009 and learned European technique at a Michelin-starred ristorante in Naples, then became SCALAE’s chef at THE THOUSAND KYOTO in 2021, building the cooking on “素材自然回帰” — conveying each producer’s thoughts and philosophy to the diner. The hotel is the Keihan group’s flagship; the invoice number belongs to 京阪ホテルズ＆リゾーツ株式会社 (NTA corporate-number site). Its sommelier team is led by the beverage director 岩田 渉 (A.S.I. World’s Best Sommelier semi-finalist, fifth in 2023) and chef-sommelier 沖中 亮真 (press release). Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the press release: "素材自然回帰" — a return to the ingredient and its producer, seeking flavour rooted in harmony.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Italian courses with wine or tea pairings.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 lunch guest chose a non-alcoholic tea pairing, each tea matched to a dish.
A July 2026 diner was frustrated that the drink menu was slow and nobody explained the bread, olive oil or refills.
A May 2026 diner found the drinks pricey and wished for more reasonable options.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 京阪ホテルズ＆リゾーツのプレスリリース (2026年9月): THE THOUSAND KYOTO 2階 イタリア料理「SCALAE (スカーラエ)」、京阪グループのフラッグシップホテル、料理長 芝原 健太 (京都生まれ、2009年に渡伊、ナポリのミシュラン星付きリストランテで修業、2021年にシェフ就任、素材自然回帰)、LE TRABE × SCALAE 2027 (2027年1月29〜31日、28,000円、サービス料15%と消費税込み)、Christmas Dinner (2026年12月19日、120,000円、ペアリング7銘柄)、シェフソムリエ 沖中 亮真、ビバレッジディレクター 岩田 渉、営業時間 朝食7:00〜10:00 (L.O.)・ランチ11:30〜15:30 (14:30 L.O.)・ディナー17:30〜21:30 (コース20:00、アラカルト20:30、ドリンク21:00 L.O.)、水曜定休、110席 (個室3室)、食物アレルギーは事前にスタッフへ。食べログ: イタリアン・ワインバー、下京区東塩小路町570 THE THOUSAND KYOTO 2F、JR京都駅中央口から東へ徒歩約2分、サービス料15% (2025年4月1日から税抜の15%)、キャンセル料 2日前から100%、個室料11,000円、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、インボイス T8130001019457 (京阪ホテルズ＆リゾーツ株式会社)、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2023。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語)。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; 15% service; cancellation fees from two days before.

places.name: 百 (Hyaku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; much of the menu is battered kushikatsu, isobe-age, fried chicken and churros, beside oden and dashimaki (2021–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden and dashimaki on dashi, fried chicken, sausages and sushi (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 15:00–21:30; Sat–Sun 14:00–21:30; hours may change. No reservations. Standing only, about 20 places; designated smoking area — a March 2026 reviewer says smoking is allowed (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog); pay up front with tickets, and ¥1,000 books of tickets give ¥1,100 of value (December 2021 review). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Weekend and holiday happy hour until 19:00 with a medium bottle of beer at ¥440 (March 2026). Tabelog’s website link goes to 遊食邸 (有限会社京フーズ), a Kyoto bento maker with three shops; that site does not mention 百.
places.neighborhood: Nishiki-koji behind Daimaru Kyoto — 7 min walk from Shijo Stn and Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Pay-first standing bar with snacks and drinks mostly ¥110–330 (March 2026) · oden ¥110–220, Kyoto-style dashimaki ¥330, salted cabbage ¥220, kushikatsu from ¥110, fried chicken, sasami-shiso-cheese fry, octopus sausages, isobe-age, kimchi fried rice, sushi, churros and corn dogs (2025–2026 reviews) · draft beer ¥440 in a small glass (July 2025), small highball ¥110, shochu sodas ¥330 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Standing bar · Nishiki behind Daimaru, from ¥110] A cash-only standing bar on Nishiki-koji opposite Daimaru that opens mid-afternoon: buy tickets, then order oden, fluffy dashimaki, kushikatsu and fried chicken at ¥110–330 a plate. Weekend happy hour brings a medium bottle of beer for ¥440. Regulars note the draft beer doubled to ¥440 in a smaller glass and the counter of ready-made side dishes is gone (2025–2026); one found the sushi rice too big. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: A pre-pay standing bar on Nishiki-koji in front of Daimaru Kyoto, open from mid-afternoon (Tabelog; 2021–2026 reviews). A February 2026 diner heard that, depending on timing, the kitchen may make omurice. Regulars in July 2025 and July 2026 noticed the ready-made side dishes once lined up at the back were gone, while the ticket books were still sold.
chef_bio.specialty: Oden; dashimaki; ¥110 snacks.

anecdotes.text: "When I came back, I found that the draft beer had doubled in price to JPY 440!" — July 2025, after three and a half years away; the glass is also smaller than usual.
A June 2026 drinker on a sixth stop of the afternoon paid ¥550 for a medium bottle of beer and pickled plum with mustard greens.
"The rice was quite large, making it a bit difficult for women to eat comfortably." — April 2026, on the sushi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 百、立ち飲み・居酒屋、中京区西魚屋町610、四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩7分、月〜金 15:00〜21:30、土日 14:00〜21:30、予約不可、立ち飲み (椅子なし) 20席、分煙、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、ホームページ欄は遊食邸 (有限会社京フーズ、京都の弁当店3店舗) のサイトで、そこには百の記載なし。口コミ (2021年12月〜2026年7月、英語): 先払いのチケット制、1,000円の回数券で1,100円分、生ビールは220円から440円に値上がりしグラスも小さめ、おでん110〜220円、京風だし巻き330円、塩キャベツ220円、串カツ110円から、唐揚げ、ささみしそチーズフライ、タコさんウインナー、磯辺揚げ、キムチチャーハン、寿司、チュロス、アメリカンドッグ、土日祝の19時までハッピーアワーで瓶ビール中瓶440円、ハイボール小110円、作り置きの惣菜はなくなった、寿司のシャリが大きい、喫煙可。

cultural_comfort.note: Buy tickets first, then order at the counter; standing only; cash only.

places.name: 祇園 壹凛華 (Gion Ichirinka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; a Chinese menu of soy- and black-vinegar-sauced dishes, dumplings, noodles and a sweet-and-sour dish of wheat-gluten namafu (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the signatures are shrimp chili, mapo tofu, sweet-and-sour pork, beef tendon and shark-fin soup (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–02:30 (L.O. 02:00); closed Sunday. Lunch by reservation only, booked at least three days ahead, one ¥5,000 course. Bookings taken; private hire up to 20. 22 seats: 6 at the counter, four tables of 4. Smoking allowed. Cards; no e-money or QR. Tabelog’s English page says a 10% service charge is added, but the Japanese original says 「なし」 (none), so no service charge is recorded. Opened 7 January 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo, a little off Hanamikoji — 6 min walk from Yasaka Shrine
places.cuisine: Creative Chinese and wine until 2 am · courses with wine pairing; dishes seen: assorted appetizers with yodare chicken, jellyfish and pickles, aosa seaweed and shark-fin soup, braised beef tendon, shrimp chili, mapo tofu, black-vinegar pork, sweet-and-sour namafu, dumplings, Chinese rice dumplings, egg-gravy fried rice, noodles, almond tofu (2024–2026 reviews) · dishes plated per person (March 2026) · lunch course ¥5,000 by reservation (Tabelog) · wine with a sommelier (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Chinese · Gion, open till 2:30 am] A calm wood-and-Chinese room in a Gion alley that serves creative Chinese food and wine until 2:30 in the morning. Diners praise the shrimp chili, mapo tofu, black-vinegar pork and a sweet-and-sour dish of namafu, plated per person, and a sommelier who pairs wine. Most guests are locals from Gion, so book early; reviewers call the value outstanding for the area. Lunch only by booking three days ahead. Smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 January 2016 (Tabelog). A January 2025 regular writes that the food is created by a renowned chef from a famous hotel. A November 2024 diner notes most customers are from the Gion area; a June 2025 diner describes a calm Japanese-modern room of warm wood with Chinese touches on the ground floor of the 吉村ビル.
chef_bio.specialty: Shrimp chili; mapo tofu; black-vinegar pork; sweet-and-sour namafu.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 first-timer arrived after 1 am, having heard it stays open late, and was welcomed and guided through the menu.
"Even I, who usually can't eat Mapo Tofu, found it delicious." — May 2025.
A July 2025 regular orders the sweet-and-sour namafu every time.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 壹凛華 (いちりんか)、中華料理・ワインバー・飲茶、東山区祇園町北側347-125 吉村ビル1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩10分・八坂神社から徒歩6分、月〜土 18:00〜翌2:30 (L.O. 2:00)、日曜休み、昼は3日前までの予約制で5,000円のコースのみ、貸切20名まで、22席 (カウンター6、4名テーブル4卓)、喫煙可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、サービス料は日本語原文で「なし」(英語版の10%は誤訳)、ベジタリアン対応、ソムリエ、2016年1月7日オープン。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年4月、英語): 有名ホテル出身の料理人、エビチリ、麻婆豆腐、黒酢酢豚、生麩の甘酢、よだれ鶏、くらげ、あおさとフカヒレのスープ、牛すじの煮込み、中華ちまき、卵あんかけチャーハン、餃子、杏仁豆腐、ワインのペアリング、客は祇園の人が多く予約は早めに、一人ずつの盛り付け、深夜1時過ぎでも歓迎。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain the menu (January 2026); book ahead, as locals fill it.

places.name: 炭焼 芹生 (Sumiyaki Seriu)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a set kappou course of sashimi, charcoal-grilled fish and meat, soup and rice, with soy-based seasonings and a sauced eel (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a charcoal-grill course of fish, eel, sweetfish and beef, with dashi soups (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon 17:00–22:00; Tue–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday. Official site: 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00, other times by arrangement, closed Sunday. Courses only (May 2026): lunch and dinner ¥16,500 tax included (official site); a June 2026 diner paid ¥14,300 for the omakase. Overseas visitors must book through their hotel concierge; direct online bookings by overseas visitors are cancelled (Tabelog). Tabelog’s English page says a service fee is added, but the Japanese original says 「なし」 (none), so no service charge is recorded. 10 seats at an L-shaped counter; non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Opened 16 March 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near the Nishiki–Muromachi crossing — 3 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn and Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal-grill kappou: one seasonal course of 7–10 dishes with charcoal grilling at its centre (official site) · lunch and dinner ¥16,500 tax included (official site); omakase ¥14,300 (June 2026) · dishes seen: sashimi with chosen condiments, yellowtail, soft roe, firefly squid, junsai, grilled sweetfish, crisp grilled eel with a light sauce, Hokkaido beef, sirloin cap, soup, rice (2025–2026 reviews) · sake and wine chosen with the staff (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Charcoal kappou · Shijo-Karasuma, ten counter seats] A ten-seat L-shaped counter round a big charcoal grill, a few minutes from Shijo-Karasuma. One seasonal course — sashimi with carefully chosen condiments, crisp-skinned grilled eel, sweetfish, Hokkaido beef — for ¥16,500. Diners love the friendly owner and the regulars’ chatter; a June 2026 regular missed the sake sommelier, who had left. Overseas visitors must book through a hotel concierge. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef (2025–2026 reviews); not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a charcoal-grill kappou serving seasonal seafood and meat with charcoal grilling as the centre of the course; 10 seats; closed Sunday. Opened 16 March 2017 (Tabelog). A November 2025 diner writes that the chef previously worked at a restaurant the review’s English calls "Yamashita". Reviewers in 2025 mention a friendly sake sommelier on staff; a June 2026 regular found the sommelier was no longer there.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled seasonal fish, eel and beef.

anecdotes.text: "Next time, I want to bring someone who appreciates good flavors (please refrain from bringing those who prefer flashy presentations or wear perfume to a restaurant)." — September 2025.
A June 2026 couple paid ¥19,500 for the ¥14,300 omakase with five glasses of sake and wine.
A May 2026 diner tried junsai and a kind of horse mackerel for the first time.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (3349seriu.wordpress.com): 炭焼芹生、炭火焼をコースのメインに旬の海鮮や肉を楽しむ炭火割烹、10席、日曜休み、11:30〜14:00・17:00〜22:00 (他の時間帯は相談)、昼・夜のコース16,500円 (税込)、予算に応じて相談可、コースは7〜10品、ビール・日本酒・ワイン。食べログ: 肉料理・日本料理・海鮮、中京区占出山町299 ヒラタビル1F、月 17:00〜22:00、火〜土 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜22:00、日曜休み、訪日客の予約は宿泊先のコンシェルジュ経由のみで直接のネット予約はキャンセル、サービス料は日本語原文で「なし」(英語版の記載は誤訳)、カウンター10席、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、2017年3月16日オープン。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): L字のカウンターと大きな炭火、気さくな店主、利き酒師のスタッフ (2026年6月にはいなかった)、お造りの薬味、鰻の炭火焼、鮎、北海道の牛、ホタルイカ、じゅんさい、白子、コースのみでアラカルトなし、おまかせ14,300円 (2026年6月)、2人で2万円弱、常連が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Overseas visitors must book through their hotel concierge; direct online bookings from overseas visitors are cancelled (Tabelog).
