places.name: Lino (リノ)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; pasta is at the heart of every course, beside risotto, fish and meat (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The courses run through cured ham, sardines, sea urchin, conger eel, duck and horse meat (2026 reviews); no vegetarian options are listed.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat and holidays 12:00–15:00 (food L.O. 13:30, drinks 14:30) and 18:00–22:00 (food L.O. 20:30, drinks 21:30); closed Sunday and the first and fourth Mondays. Seating charge ¥500 per person for à la carte orders only (Tabelog; Japanese original 「アラカルトオーダーに限り席料としてお一人様500円」). Prices exclude tax. Courses cancelled or changed on the day are charged in full; a booking may be cancelled if you are 30 minutes late without word; parties of 5 or more by phone, courses only. 22 seats: 6 counter, 16 table; non-smoking (ashtray outside); school-age children only; BYO allowed; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Opened 12 May 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Residential streets west of Karasuma Oike — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn, exit 2
places.cuisine: Italian with seasonal ingredients, by course or à la carte · weekday pasta-and-risotto lunch course ¥4,200 (July and October 2026); seasonal lunch course ¥7,800 (August 2026); drink pairing of three ¥3,300 (October 2026) · signature sea-urchin oil pasta (2026 reviews) · dishes seen: marinated sardines with orange, homemade ham with caponata, shima-aji (striped jack) tartare with grilled eggplant and myoga, horse-meat tagliata with balsamic, duck tagliata with fig, conger eel with bottarga, squid aglio e olio with Kujo leeks, Iwami pork ragù, sawara in kadaif, chestnut risotto, tiramisu (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · west of Karasuma Oike, sea-urchin pasta] A 22-seat Italian dining room tucked into a residential street near Karasuma Oike, known for its sea-urchin oil pasta. Weekday lunch brings a pasta-and-risotto course for ¥4,200; seasonal courses run to ¥7,800, and à la carte portions are split for two. Diners praise light, surprising combinations — sardines with orange, horse-meat tagliata, sawara in kadaif — and careful explanations. ¥500 seat charge à la carte; no preschoolers. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 12 May 2017 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe it appearing suddenly in a residential area, with a counter and tables, a signature sea-urchin pasta always on the menu, and staff who explain each dish. A July 2026 diner who booked the wrong date was still given the omakase course.
chef_bio.specialty: Sea-urchin oil pasta; pasta-and-risotto lunch.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner who had mistakenly booked the wrong date was still served the omakase course.
A third-time visitor who prefers oil-based sea-urchin pasta to cream calls this one of the few places that always has it (July 2026).
An October 2026 regular ordered both hot starters, duck and horse meat, rather than choose.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Lino (リノ)、イタリアン・パスタ・ワインバー、中京区上妙覚寺町230-2 秋山法衣ビル1F、烏丸御池駅2番出口から徒歩5分、月〜土・祝 12:00〜15:00 (料理 L.O. 13:30)・18:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 20:30)、日曜と第1・第4月曜休み、アラカルトに限り席料1人500円、税別、コースの当日キャンセル・変更は100%、連絡なく30分遅れるとキャンセル扱い、5名以上は電話でコースのみ、22席 (カウンター6、テーブル16)、禁煙 (店外に灰皿)、未就学児不可、持ち込み可、カード・PayPay 可、2017年5月12日オープン。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語ほか): 住宅街に突然現れる店、名物の雲丹のオイルパスタ、平日限定のパスタとリゾットのコース4,200円、季節のランチコース7,800円、ドリンク3杯のペアリング3,300円、鰯のマリネとオレンジ、自家製ハムとカポナータ、シマアジのタルタル、馬肉のタリアータ、鴨のタリアータといちじく、鱧とからすみ、舞鶴の烏賊と九条ねぎのアーリオオーリオ、石見ポークのラグー、鰆のカダイフ揚げ、栗のリゾット、ティラミス、ワカサギの南蛮漬けのお通し、丁寧な説明。

cultural_comfort.note: Courses or à la carte; staff explain each dish (August 2026); book ahead.

places.name: 焼鳥 ひさどり (Yakitori Hisadori)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori with salt or tare, chicken sashimi and tataki, liver stew and a rice bowl; tare and some dishes are soy-based; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant — skewers, sashimi, tataki and offal (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–24:00, irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservation only; 17:00 and 22:00 entries by phone only; call ahead for special requests such as a birthday cake (Tabelog). An omakase course or à la carte (2024–2026 reviews). No table charge (Tabelog original 無し). Prices are not shown and there is no drink list (June 2026). 15 seats with a counter and a private room; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed at table seats only (Tabelog; December 2024). BYO drinks possible (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) (Tabelog). Third floor of グランドランド; step out of the lift into the shop; 1 min walk south of Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; May 2025). Opened 27 July 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Just south of Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae, 3rd floor — 1 min walk from the station
places.cuisine: Upscale yakitori counter of several chicken brands, best known for antibiotic-free Takasaka chicken (2025 reviews) · omakase course of appetisers then skewers grilled one by one, or à la carte (2024–2026 reviews) · white-liver sashimi, chicken breast and thigh tataki, "tori no toro taku", heart, rare cuts, liver stew, a rice bowl to finish (2025–2026 reviews) · sake, shochu, wine and cocktails (Tabelog) · bills about ¥8,000–20,000 (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakitori · by City Hall, one cook, Takasaka chicken] A dim, stylish third-floor counter south of City Hall where the owner, cooking alone, grills premium chicken — Takasaka above all — and serves it as sashimi and tataki too: white-liver sashimi and thigh tataki are the talk. Omakase or à la carte, popular with visitors from abroad. No prices are shown; one June 2026 diner found the skewers uneven and the tare and rice bowl too spicy. Smoking at tables. Reservation only.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who runs the shop alone
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 27 July 2022. A May 2025 reviewer: "The owner runs the place alone, and it was lively with many foreign customers." Reviewers describe a friendly, quiet owner (December 2024 to March 2026), à la carte added to the course (December 2024), and a phone booking where the guest was asked on arrival about a referral (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken sashimi and tataki; Takasaka chicken.

anecdotes.text: "The white liver sashimi was so delicious that I ended up ordering a second serving." — November 2025.
A February 2026 diner said the "tori no toro taku", eaten with eyes closed, tasted like fatty tuna belly.
"The salt-grilled skewers had inconsistent quality, and the sauce on the grilled skewers was too spicy." — June 2026.
"However, the dim lighting makes the yakitori look less appealing visually when served... but it tastes great!" — August 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼鳥・鶏料理・創作料理、中京区下丸屋町406 グランドランド3F、京阪三条駅から西へ徒歩5分、市役所前駅から南へ徒歩1分、毎日 18:00〜24:00、不定休、完全予約制 (17時と22時の入店は電話のみ)、チャージ無し、15席、貸切20名まで、テーブル席のみ喫煙可、持ち込み可、カード可、2022年7月27日オープン。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年6月、英語): 店主が一人で営む、Takasaka chicken など数種の銘柄鶏、おまかせとアラカルト、白レバーの刺身、ももとむねのたたき、鶏のトロたく、ハツ、レバーの煮込み、締めの丼、値段や酒の品書きがない、串にむらがありタレや丼が辛すぎたとの声 (2026年6月)、海外の客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only (17:00 and 22:00 by phone); no prices shown — ask; smoking at tables; cards accepted.

places.name: 生そば大黒屋 (Namasoba Daikokuya)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soba and udon in soy-based dashi, tempura, curry nanban and nabeyaki (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every bowl is built on the house dashi, with herring, chicken, egg, kamaboko and shrimp tempura among the toppings (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–19:00 (last order 18:30), open straight through; closed Monday — if Monday is a holiday, open and closed Tuesday instead — and occasionally (official site; Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). 20 seats: 10 at the counter and 10 at tables; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR, including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). English menu with photos (Tabelog). Higashinotoin south of Ayanokoji; 3 min walk from Shijo Stn exit 3 (Tabelog). Founded 1916; closed at the end of 2024 and reopened here on 12 December 2025 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin south of Ayanokoji — 3 min walk from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Old Kyoto soba and udon house revived in 2025 (official site) · ten-zaru, zaru, nameko, imokake, tori-nanban, kitsune, nishin, curry-nanban, nabeyaki (official site) · seasonal specials such as sudachi soba, hamo ten-zaru, chilled kitsune soba, sansai soba, chicken soba, wakatake soba (official site, 2026) · tempura zaru soba ¥1,900, ō-zaru ¥1,400, okame (shippoku) soba ¥1,400, half tempura bowl ¥1,450 (August–October 2026 reviews) · konoha-don, egg rice bowl, egg over rice with the zaru dipping sauce (2026 reviews) · sake and shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Soba · Higashinotoin, a 1916 soba house reborn] A soba and udon house founded in 1916, long in Pontocho and later in Daimaru, that closed at the end of 2024 and reopened in December 2025 in a new wooden shop near Shijo — with the old head chef, cookware and signboard, after a crowdfunding drive. Tempura zaru, nishin, kitsune, okame and seasonal bowls run about ¥1,400–1,900; some find it a little dear. English menu; cards and QR. Open 11:00–19:00. Closed Monday.

roles: Head chef of the former Daikokuya (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in Taisho 5 (1916), Daikokuya quietly closed at the end of 2024 after 109 years; inheriting the former head chef, the cooking tools and the signboard, it reopened on 12 December 2025 as the new Daikokuya, with the shop's Daikokuten statue at the door. Reviewers in 2026 recall the old shop near the Pontocho Kaburenjo and in Daimaru, and a revival through crowdfunding with former members returning (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "A shop local people can drop into casually while out shopping" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura zaru soba; seasonal soba.

anecdotes.text: "In the final days before Daimaru closed, the flavor of the broth was lacking, but it seems to be returning to its former glory." — August 2026.
A July 2026 diner found the noodles so long that a single chopstick-lift could not take the whole portion.
"While it's delicious, the prices are a bit high, making it less suitable for regular visits." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 生そば 大黒屋、大正5年創業、109年の歴史を経て2024年末にいったん閉店、旧大黒屋の料理長・調理器具・看板を受け継ぎ2025年12月12日に新生大黒屋として再開、店名は大黒天にちなみ大黒天像も引き継ぐ、下京区東洞院通綾小路下る扇酒屋町287、11:00〜19:00 (L.O.18:30)、月曜定休、天ざる・ざる・なめこ・いもかけ・鶏なんば・きつね・にしん・カレーなんば・なべ焼き、季節のすだちそば・鱧天ざる・冷やしきつね・山菜そば・鶏そば。食べログ: そば・うどん、四条駅3番出口から徒歩3分、予約不可、20席、禁煙、車椅子可、子ども可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語メニュー。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): 天ざる1,900円、大ざる1,400円、おかめ (しっぽく) 1,400円、天丼ハーフ1,450円、木の葉丼、玉子丼、以前は先斗町や大丸に、クラウドファンディングで復活、やや高いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with photos (Tabelog); no reservations; cards, e-money and QR.

places.name: うらやま京色 (Urayama Kyoshoku)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a kushiage restaurant — the courses centre on battered, deep-fried skewers and finish with curry (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kushiage courses with fish, meat and seafood, crab-miso dip and seared tuna (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday, with closures and openings posted month by month — for November 2026, closed 1, 8, 15, 23 (Monday holiday) and 29, and open Sunday 22 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; call for 5 or more, or when online booking is full (Tabelog); counters fill by 19:00 (October 2026). One drink per guest required (Tabelog original 当店全てのお客様にワンドリンク制をお願いしております). Courses, e.g. ¥6,800 (August 2026), or à la carte (Tabelog). 26 seats: 12 at the counter, a private room for up to 6 and a semi-private room for 4–8 upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). A renovated townhouse down a narrow alley off Shijo Karasuma; 2 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Alley off Shijo Karasuma — 2 min walk from Karasuma / Shijo stations
places.cuisine: Creative seasonal kushiage with Japanese and Western dishes, reopened under this name after 14 years at Shijo Teramachi (Tabelog) · courses such as ¥6,800 (August 2026) or a course of 8 skewers with seasonal dishes — e.g. yam and hamo, crab-miso dip, seared tuna, a vegetable platter with crab miso and bagna cauda, skewers, a bite of curry to finish, dessert (September–October 2026) · à la carte too (Tabelog) · sake, wine, sours; all-you-can-drink plans (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · bills about ¥4,000–8,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kushiage · Shijo Karasuma alley, creative skewers] A renovated townhouse down a back alley near Shijo Karasuma serving creative, seasonal kushiage in courses — light-battered skewers between small Kyoto dishes, a vegetable platter with crab-miso bagna cauda, and a bite of curry to finish — for about ¥6,000–8,000 with drinks. Counter downstairs, private rooms up. Book: the counter fills by seven. One drink per guest. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: after 14 years in Shijo Teramachi, the restaurant reopened under the new name Urayama Kyoshoku with a new menu; the Tabelog opening date is 15 December 2020. Reviewers in 2026 describe chefs working in view of the counter, staff explaining each skewer "as if we were at a sushi restaurant", and a nearly full house run efficiently.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients highlighted in creative skewers (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kushiage; crab-miso bagna cauda.

anecdotes.text: "The staff explained the different ingredients as if we were at a sushi restaurant." — October 2026.
"I expected the bill for two people to exceed JPY 10,000, but when I asked for the check, it was around JPY 8,000" — October 2026.
"The final curry was a bit heavy; perhaps a chazuke would have been better." — August 2026.
"However, the counter seats on the right side felt a bit hectic and not very relaxing." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・串揚げ・洋食、中京区占出山町310-20、烏丸駅・四条駅から徒歩2分、月〜土 17:00〜23:00、日曜休み (11月は1・8・15・23・29日休み、22日 (日) は営業)、予約可 (5名以上や満席時は電話で)、ワンドリンク制、26席 (カウンター12、個室 (6名まで)、半個室)、禁煙、カード可、四条寺町で14年営業したのち店名を変えて再開、季節の創作串揚げと和洋の料理、コースとアラカルト。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): コース6,800円、串8本と季節の料理のコース、山芋と鱧、蟹味噌のディップ、まぐろのたたき、野菜の盛り合わせとバーニャカウダ、締めのひと口カレー、町家を改装、路地の奥、19時には満席。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; courses or à la carte; one drink per guest; cards accepted.

places.name: this is ormary store
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bakery standing bar — every plate comes with the house wheat breads (focaccia, epi, pizza) (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Breads are sold to take away, but the plates are pâté, rillettes, ham, duck, fish and cheese, and some breads contain bacon and cheese (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday to Sunday 12:00–20:00, open straight through; closed Tuesday and occasionally without notice — check Instagram; breakfast from 08:00 on some days (Tabelog; July 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); queues can form at opening (October 2026). Standing room plus bench and L-shaped table seating (July 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards for purchases of ¥3,000 or more (Tabelog). Bread to take away (2026 reviews). A renovated machiya with glass walls in a lane north of Shosei-en, near Tominokoji Rokujo; 5–8 min walk from Gojo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 5 October 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Tominokoji north of Rokujo, by Shosei-en — 5–8 min walk from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Standing bar of house-baked bread with dishes and wine (2026 reviews) · platter of 5 small dishes ¥2,000 — e.g. pâté de campagne, duck with Kyoto eggplant and colatura, buri with baba ghanoush, house ham with tonnato, fritto, with focaccia and a tuna and semi-dried tomato pizza (July 2026); platter of 3 — bonito tataki, meat pâté, mushroom stew, carrot râpée (September 2026) · fried octopus, seared bonito, chicken curry stew; a fig and cheese-sauce fritter (2026 reviews) · bacon, onion and cheese bread, epi, focaccia, to eat in or take away (2026 reviews) · a Hyuganatsu non-alcoholic drink (August 2026) · bills about ¥2,000–5,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bread and wine bar · north of Shosei-en, a bakery to drink in] A glass-fronted machiya near Gojo that is half bakery, half standing bar: hot house breads — focaccia, epi, bacon-and-cheese — alongside platters of pâté, duck with colatura, ham tonnato and fritters, with wine from noon to 8 pm. A five-dish platter is ¥2,000; drinks are not standing-bar cheap. Breads to take away. Smoking allowed; cards only from ¥3,000. Closed Tuesday and sometimes without notice.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a standing bar and bakery opened 5 October 2023, with occasional breakfast service from 8:00. Reviewers in 2026 describe freshly baked bread served hot, a renovated machiya with glass walls, quick crowds at opening, and unannounced closures posted on Instagram.
chef_bio.specialty: House bread with small plates; 5-dish platter.

anecdotes.text: "I once tried to visit on a snowy day, but it was unexpectedly closed." — July 2026; the reviewer now checks Instagram first.
A July 2026 visitor rated the duck with Kyoto eggplant and colatura the standout, and noticed many guests buying bread to take home.
"The drinks are not cheap for a standing bar, so even for one person, the total can add up." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 立ち飲み・パン、下京区富小路六条上る本塩竈町533-3、月・水〜日 12:00〜20:00、火曜と不定休、朝8時からの営業も不定期、予約可、喫煙可、カードは3,000円以上、2023年10月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 五条駅から徒歩5〜8分、Shosei-en の北の路地、ガラス張りの町家、パンを主役にした立ち飲み、5品盛り合わせ2,000円 (パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、鴨と京都の茄子のコラトゥーラ、ぶりとババガヌーシュ、自家製ハムのツナソース、フリット)、3品盛り、フォカッチャ、エピ、ベーコンとチーズのパン、持ち帰りも、酒は安くない、臨時休業はインスタで。

cultural_comfort.note: Order the platter and bread at the counter; smoking allowed; cards only from ¥3,000.

places.name: まつおか (Matsuoka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Traditional Japanese courses and à la carte built on dashi, with fried dishes (whole fried goby, fried rockfish bones) included; no gluten information (2023–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood courses on dashi (2023–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards: JCB, AMEX, Diners; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; a private room with a garden view, by request (Tabelog; June 2023). Designated smoking area (Tabelog). Takeaway available (April 2024). On Matsubara-dori west of Yamato-oji, just east of Miyagawa-cho, 387 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; August 2024). Opened 26 April 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Matsubara-dori by Miyagawa-cho — 387 m from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Traditional Japanese cooking, omakase or à la carte, built on good dashi and seafood (2023–2025 reviews) · hairy crab, summer hamo, salt-grilled sea bream, Kyoto matsutake (2017–2023 reviews) · live rockfish as sashimi with its liver, the bones fried; a spring Hanakansho hot pot (April 2024) · dengaku, hamo and matsutake soup, grilled nodoguro, rice porridge with seaweed (August 2024) · namerou, uzaku, dashimaki and ochazuke to finish (February 2024) · salted sea bream and fried goby to take away (April 2024) · sake, shochu, wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Japanese · Miyagawa-cho, an eight-seat counter for seafood] A quiet counter on Matsubara just east of the Miyagawa-cho geisha quarter, with a garden-view private room on request. Order omakase or à la carte: rockfish carved live into sashimi, grilled nodoguro, hamo and matsutake soup in late summer, the spring Hanakansho hot pot, and dashimaki or ochazuke to finish. Not cheap — ¥15,000–30,000 a head in reviews — and one 2025 diner felt pushed toward pricey items. Open to midnight; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 26 April 2012. Reviewers describe faithful traditional Japanese cooking; a 2017 diner came for a meal with geisha.
chef_bio.specialty: Hanasansho hot pot; grilled nodoguro.

anecdotes.text: An April 2024 regular comes every year for the Hanakansho hot pot, and this time watched a live rockfish turned into sashimi, its liver served and its bones fried.
A November 2025 couple spent ¥56,000 for two and felt the chef kept recommending expensive items and talked so much that there was little time to savour the food.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: まつおか、日本料理、東山区松原通大和大路西入ル弓矢町25、清水五条駅から387m、17:00〜24:00、水曜休み、予約可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、8席、個室あり (要相談)、分煙、2012年4月26日オープン。口コミ (2017〜2025年、英語): 宮川町の東、伝統的な日本料理、毛蟹、鱧、鯛の塩焼き、松茸、生きたロックフィッシュの造り、Hanakansho の鍋、のどぐろの焼き物、なめろう、うざく、だし巻き、お茶漬け、持ち帰り (塩をした鯛、ハゼの唐揚げ)、1人15,000〜30,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; à la carte prices add up; book ahead.

places.name: 浜町 (Hamacho)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-style dishes of fish, sesame tofu, yuba, nama-fu (wheat gluten) and obanzai, with fried items such as shrimp-gyoza spring rolls, croquettes and fried yuba; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; the menu is mostly fish and meat on dashi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: 17:00–23:00, irregular closures (8 November 2026 announced); lunch 12:00–15:00 by reservation only, courses only. Tabelog lists 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 daily. Reservations from 12:30 (official site). Private rooms ¥300 a head (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 100 seats over three floors: counter and semi-private rooms on the first, a bar counter and sunken kotatsu on the second, private rooms on the third; groups up to 55 (Tabelog; April 2026). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). English site. By the Takase River, first lane north of Sanjo on Kiyamachi, west side; 3 min from Keihan Sanjo, 2 min from Shiyakusho-mae (official site).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Sanjo, by the Takase River — 3 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style izakaya and kaiseki courses with a daily-changing à la carte menu of about 100 dishes (official site; April 2026) · monthly omakase course ¥5,000; autumn courses ¥7,000 and ¥9,000; banquet course ¥3,500; all-you-can-drink plans (official site; 2026 reviews) · fresh sashimi — hamachi, saba, shima-aji, hirame, tai, needle squid (October 2026) · sesame tofu, yuba, nama-fu, Kyoto vegetables, obanzai, shibazuke salad (official site; June 2026) · specialty tsukune, shrimp-gyoza spring rolls, grilled hamachi collar, pork kakuni, scallop gratin croquettes (2026 reviews) · sea bream rice with yuba sauce ¥700, spinach and shirasu ohitashi ¥650 (September 2026) · over 15 local sakes (official site)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi-Sanjo, Kyoto dishes by the Takase River] A long-running, three-storey izakaya beside the Takase River just north of Sanjo, with counter seats, sunken-kotatsu rooms and private rooms for groups. The daily menu runs to about a hundred dishes — sashimi of the day, sesame tofu, yuba and nama-fu, specialty tsukune, shrimp-gyoza spring rolls — or take a monthly omakase course from ¥5,000. Over fifteen local sakes. Reviews of the banquet courses are mixed. Open 17:00–23:00; lunch by reservation.

roles: Operated by 株式会社 四季企画 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: run by 株式会社 四季企画, with a sister restaurant, 先斗町 よし菜; a February 2025 blog post marks new noren for the entrance, the first in 25 years since opening.
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto flavour and the tastes of the four seasons (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi of the day; tsukune; shrimp-gyoza spring rolls.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 couple who stop in on every Kyoto trip were pleased to be remembered by the staff, and never tire of watching the cooks cut sashimi at the counter.
A May 2026 banquet guest found drinks slow, the sashimi pieces small and the tsukune and spring rolls only average.
A September 2026 diner on a fifth dinner of the day came in at 20:41 just for the ¥700 sea bream rice with yuba sauce.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 四季の味 京都 浜町、中京区河原町通三条上ル恵比須町448-2 (木屋町通三条上ル1筋目西入ル南側、高瀬川畔)、17:00〜23:00、不定休 (2026年11月8日休み)、昼は予約・コースのみ、霜月の月替りおまかせコース5,000円、秋の味覚満喫コース7,000円、秋の京風会席コース9,000円、お得宴会コース3,500円、日替わりの単品、胡麻豆腐、湯葉、生麩、京野菜、おばんざい、地酒15種類以上、姉妹店「先斗町 よし菜」、運営は株式会社 四季企画、開店以来25年ぶりに暖簾を新調 (2025年2月)。食べログ: 100席、個室料1人300円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙、ベジタリアン対応、子ども可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 刺身、つくね、海老餃子春巻、はまちのかま焼き、湯葉あんかけの鯛ご飯700円、飲み放題付きのコース。

cultural_comfort.note: English site; private rooms ¥300 a head; good for groups.

places.name: 食 京都小川生薬 RESTAURANT (Shoku Kyoto Ogawa Shoyaku Restaurant)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Breakfast courses with yudofu, nama-fu (wheat gluten), Handa somen (wheat), granola and small plates; the herbal soup curry is not described for gluten (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses include Agu pork or duck shabu-shabu, dashi broth, yogurt, anago and egg (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 8:00–13:30 on weekdays; 7:30–15:00 on weekends and holidays. Reservations only, all guests start together, 90-minute sessions; a no-show after 15 minutes may be cancelled (Tabelog). A medicinal herbal soup curry was sold by meal ticket at lunch in June–July 2026. Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats along a 12 m counter, with semi-private rooms for 4–6 (official site; Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome, kids’ menu (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Second floor; a café on the first floor and a one-group villa above (official site). 5 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (official site). Opened 6 April 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Aburanokoji near Nijo Castle — 5 min from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Breakfast courses built around herbal teas from the 小川生薬 herbal-medicine house (official site; 2026 reviews) · seasonal course ¥5,500 (July–August 2026): mulberry-leaf tea, yogurt with barley granola and kuromoji, rich yudofu, a hot pot of Agu pork or domestic duck, vintage 1996 pu-erh, a long plate of Kyoto small dishes (sesame tofu with nama-fu, eggplant with anago, marinated tuna, yuba with sansho), white or mixed-grain rice with refills, Handa somen with karasumi or sudachi, kuromoji gelato · add-ons: dashimaki with yellow chives, grilled rice balls for chazuke, a burdock cocktail (October 2026) · medicinal herbal soup curry of 100 herbs with three chutneys (June–July 2026) · several refillable health teas (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Breakfast · Nijo Castle, an herbal-tea morning course] A bright second-floor counter, 12 m long, near Nijo Castle, run by an herbal-medicine house, that turns breakfast into a gentle course: mulberry-leaf tea, granola yogurt with kuromoji, creamy yudofu, a small hot pot of duck or Agu pork, a long plate of Kyoto small dishes and Handa somen with karasumi (¥5,500 in 2026). Refillable herbal teas throughout. Reservations only, from 7:30 at weekends; 90-minute sittings.

roles: Run by the herbal-medicine maker 小川生薬 (official site; August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the 京都小川生薬 building has a first-floor café pairing health teas with sweets, this second-floor restaurant, and a one-group villa on the third floor. Tabelog gives the opening as 6 April 2024. An August 2026 reviewer notes the teas as the hospitality of an herbal-medicine manufacturer.
chef_bio.philosophy: To be the place in central Kyoto closest to nature and health, through drink, food and lodging (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Herbal-tea breakfast course; karasumi Handa somen.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 passer-by was drawn in by a sign for herbal soup curry, got the last serving before 2 p.m., and only at home found the place already saved on Tabelog for its breakfast course.
An October 2026 guest at the 7:30 sitting thought the karasumi somen the best dish but wished for a full portion, and finished with grilled rice balls in broth from the hot pot.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都小川生薬、中京区油小路通押小路上る二条油小路町272、2F レストラン、カウンター中心の20席 (12mのカウンター)、半個室、完全予約制、自然の恵みを取り入れたコース仕立ての朝食、平日8:00〜13:30、土日祝7:30〜15:00、1F カフェ (健康茶とお茶菓子)、3F は一日一組の宿泊。食べログ: 90分制、一斉スタート、カード可、禁煙、車椅子可、子ども可、英語メニュー、2024年4月6日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 季節のコース5,500円、桑の葉茶、大麦グラノーラのヨーグルト、湯豆腐、アグー豚や国産鴨のしゃぶしゃぶ、1996年のプーアル茶、京のおばんざい、からすみの半田そうめん、黒文字のジェラート、100種の生薬のスープカレー。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); reservations only, fixed start times; wheelchair accessible.

places.name: 漬け野菜 イソイズム (Tsukeyasai Isoism)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pickled-vegetable plates, dashimaki, clay-pot rice and grills; fried yuba rolls and a meat-wrapped cutlet with demi-glace are not gluten-free; soy koji used as a topping (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Twelve kinds of pickled vegetables lead the menu, but the plate comes topped with duck, chicken or cheese, the soup and rice use fish and dashi, and the vegetable dishes are not described as plant-only (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch from 11:30 in four seatings (11:30, 12:00, 13:00, 13:30); dinner 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; often fully booked, including weekday lunch and weekends (October 2026). Cards: JCB, AMEX, Diners; QR accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). Counter seating (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Shichijo west of Karasuma, south of Higashi Hongan-ji, 5 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 18 July 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shichijo west of Karasuma, south of Higashi Hongan-ji — 5 min from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: “Tsukeyasai”: pickled and marinated vegetables from the group’s own farm and Kyoto growers, in creative izakaya dishes (2026 reviews) · lunch, one set only: a plate of 12 kinds of pickled vegetables topped with duck, steamed chicken or cheese, onion-broth soup and seasonal clay-pot rice — mackerel with Kujo green onion, or mackerel and mushroom — with a rice ball made from leftovers on request (October–November 2026) · dinner: assorted pickled vegetables, fluffy tofu dashimaki with house soy koji, fried yuba rolls, pork belly wrapped in mizuna, a rare meat-wrapped cutlet of white celery with demi-glace, salmon and maitake clay-pot rice (October 2026) · coffee shochu and other drinks (October 2026)
places.notes: [Creative izakaya · Kyoto Station, twelve kinds of pickled vegetables] A cheerful spot near Higashi Hongan-ji from the Kyoto izakaya group 五十家, built on “tsukeyasai” — vegetables, many from the group’s own farm, pickled and marinated a dozen ways. Lunch is one set: twelve vegetables with duck, chicken or cheese, a light onion soup and seasonal clay-pot rice. At night add tofu dashimaki, fried yuba and a celery-filled meat cutlet. Lively staff; book ahead, even for weekday lunch.

roles: Operated by the Kyoto izakaya group 五十家 (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers place it in the Gojyuya (五十家) group and call it a sister of “Sumisoudo”; the vegetables come from the group’s own farm (October 2026). Tabelog gives the opening as 18 July 2016.
chef_bio.specialty: Twelve-vegetable pickled plate; seasonal clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 lunch party could not finish the clay-pot mackerel rice, and the staff shaped the last bowlful into a rice ball to take away.
A September 2026 diner had been to about four of the group’s restaurants and still ranked this the favourite, mostly for the staff.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 漬け野菜 イソイズム、創作料理、下京区七条通烏丸西入中居町114、京都駅から徒歩5分、昼は11:30から4部制 (11:30、12:00、13:00、13:30)、夜17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、予約可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、QR可、カウンター席、禁煙、2016年7月18日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 五十家グループ、Sumisoudo の姉妹店、自社農園の京野菜、12種の漬け野菜に鴨や蒸し鶏やチーズ、玉ねぎのスープ、季節の土鍋ご飯 (鯖と Kujo ねぎ)、豆腐のだし巻きと自家製の醤油麹、湯葉の揚げ巻き、水菜の豚バラ巻き、白セロリのレアカツ、コーヒー焼酎。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (lunch in four seatings); family-friendly per reviewers.

places.name: 魚棚ふみ文 (Uotana Fumibun)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A long menu of sashimi, simmered and grilled dishes alongside tempura, kushikatsu and croquettes; soy and dashi throughout (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood kappo-izakaya; even the vegetable dishes come in dashi or white-miso dressings (2025–26 reviews). Tabelog’s vegetarian tick is not evidence.
places.hours_raw: 16:00–22:00 (last order 21:30), open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); it fills up by early evening (May 2026). À la carte from a long menu, or courses (2025 reviews). 34 seats: 8 at the counter, 6 on a raised tatami area, 20 at tables; private hire up to 23 (Tabelog). Smoking area for heated tobacco outside (Tabelog). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). In the basement of a building between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, behind a heavy door; 3 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; May 2025).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo Kiyamachi, by Pontocho — 3 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kappo-izakaya of seafood brought daily from Akashi port, with about 40 sakes from around Japan, 30 shochu and Tanba wine (Tabelog, shop text) · signature grilled Akashi anago (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews) · Akashi octopus as sashimi or tempura, sea bream simmered in soy, saury sashimi, steamed shirako with kombu, kabura-mushi, bamboo shoots with mitsuba and white miso, shishamo, shrimp with grated yam (2025–26 reviews) · dashi-rolled omelette served in broth "like Akashi-yaki", homemade croquettes with black beans, beef kushikatsu, sakura motsu-ni, eel roll, tenderloin steak (2025–26 reviews) · sake served with a tag naming the brand (March 2025) · bills about ¥5,000–15,000 a head (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo-izakaya · Sanjo Kiyamachi, Akashi seafood down the stairs] A basement kappo-izakaya behind a heavy door between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, open more than 30 years. Seafood comes daily from Akashi: the grilled anago is the signature, with octopus as sashimi or tempura, simmered sea bream and a dashi omelette in broth. The long menu runs from seasonal small plates to croquettes and kushikatsu, with about 40 sakes. Opens at 16:00 daily; book for the evening.

roles: Owner and chef (unnamed); a younger owner also serves (May 2026)
chef_bio.background: An August 2026 reviewer says the restaurant has over 30 years of history; an October 2025 reviewer says the dishes are now cooked by a chef who took over from the previous owner. A July 2025 regular praises the chef and the owner; a May 2026 diner was served by "the owner and the young owner".
chef_bio.specialty: Grilled Akashi anago; seasonal small plates.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner had several dishes arrive at once, so the grilled anago went cold.
An August 2025 diner returned to a restaurant a late father used to visit, for the sea bream simmered in soy.
A December 2025 diner found the course a bit pricey but the staff lively and welcoming.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、中京区三条木屋町石屋町121 先斗町松嶋屋ビル B1F、三条駅から徒歩3分、16:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、年中無休、予約可、34席 (カウンター8、小上がり6、テーブル20)、貸切可 (23名まで)、屋外に加熱式たばこの喫煙所、カード・QR 可、Akashi の港から毎日届く魚、全国の地酒40種・焼酎30種、Tanba のワイン、名物は Akashi の焼き穴子。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年8月、英語): 地下の隠れ家、30年以上、先代から継いだ料理人、Akashi の蛸、鯛のあら炊き、だし巻き、黒豆のコロッケ、かぶら蒸し、料理が一度に来て冷めたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Long Japanese menu, order à la carte or a course; book for evenings; cards and QR.

places.name: 酒蔵 (SHUKURA)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sake is generally gluten-free, but the snacks include oden, soba and grilled heshiko with soy-based seasonings (2023–25 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A sake bar; the snacks include fish (heshiko), clams, oden and soba in broth (2023–25 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:00–1:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–1:00 (last order 0:30); closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, advised for the 14 seats — 6 at the counter, 2 tables (Tabelog; August 2025). Seat charge ¥1,000 a person (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「1000円（お一人様あたり）」). Non-smoking, ashtray at the entrance (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and e-money (Tabelog). By the Pontocho Kaburenjo theatre at the Sanjo end; 3 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho by the Kaburenjo, Sanjo end — 3 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Sake bar with 60–70 sakes at any time — chilled, warmed, nigori, sparkling and aged — centred on Kyoto, Shiga and local sake from around Japan (Tabelog, shop text) · tasting sets, e.g. three Kyoto and Shiga sakes of 80 ml for ¥2,000 (August 2023) · the master or staff choose to your taste (2024–26 reviews) · snacks: grilled heshiko ¥800 (August 2023), oden, clams steamed in sake, thick fried tofu, soba to finish (2024–25 reviews) · seat charge ¥1,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Sake bar · Pontocho, sixty sakes by the Kaburenjo] A small wooden sake bar at the Sanjo end of Pontocho with 60–70 sakes on hand, from Kyoto and Shiga breweries to summer and aged bottles. Tell the master or staff what you like and get a pour to match, or take a three-glass tasting set; snacks run from grilled heshiko and oden to a bowl of soba to finish. ¥1,000 seat charge. Open to 1:00, from 16:00 at weekends; a good second or last stop.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a master who explains and chooses sake (September 2024, February 2025, August 2026) and knowledgeable staff (February 2024); an August 2023 visitor heard the place had been open 11 years and that the owner also runs a nearby bar.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto and Shiga sake; tasting sets.

anecdotes.text: An August 2023 visitor had the Kyoto & Shiga set of three 80 ml pours for ¥2,000 and grilled heshiko for ¥800; the bill came to ¥6,900.
A seven-time regular finishes with the bar’s soba, a lighter end than ramen (August 2025).
An April 2025 diner felt the area has changed over the years and the bar now seems mostly frequented by visitors from abroad.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー・日本酒バー・ダイニングバー、中京区木屋町三条下ル石屋町122-4、三条駅から徒歩約3分、月〜金 18:00〜翌1:00、土日祝 16:00〜翌1:00 (L.O. 0:30)、不定休、予約可、14席 (カウンター6、テーブル8)、チャージ1人1,000円、禁煙 (入口に灰皿)、カード・電子マネー可、先斗町の Kaburenjo の近く、日本酒は常時60〜70種 (冷酒、燗酒、にごり、スパークリング、古酒)、京都・滋賀と全国の地酒。口コミ (2023年8月〜2026年8月、英語): 京都・滋賀の3種飲み比べ2,000円、へしこ焼き800円、おでん、酒蒸し、締めの蕎麦、マスターが好みに合わせて選ぶ、11年続く店という声 (2023年)。

cultural_comfort.note: Say what sake you like and let the staff choose; ¥1,000 seat charge; cards and IC cards.

places.name: 二条有恒 (Nijo Aritsune)
places.gf_detail: Ask. À la carte Japanese dishes with soy and dashi, including crab cream croquettes, a beef cutlet sandwich and fried horse mackerel (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, shellfish, chicken and beef dishes with dashi (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 17:00–23:00 (last entry 21:00, last order 22:00); Sun 17:00–21:30 (last entry 20:00); closed Monday and two consecutive days a month (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; phone 12:00–16:00, as calls may go unanswered during service; ask even on days marked unavailable (Tabelog). No service charge or cover (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料・チャージ共に無し」). The menu shows no prices; reviewers spent about ¥15,000–20,000 a head (2026 reviews). 22 seats: a 10-seat counter, a table and private rooms for 4 and 6 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Near Nijo-Teramachi; 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; April 2026). Opened 18 August 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo-Teramachi — 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: "Adult izakaya" of à la carte Kyoto dishes close to kaiseki, with charcoal grilling, sake and wine (Tabelog, shop text; 2026 reviews) · signatures: karasumi mochi and crab cream croquettes (August 2026) · charcoal-grilled seasonal fish — sweetfish, guji, hamo, eel — half-cooked fried horse mackerel, hairy crab, Kyoto Akadori chicken, tsukune with egg yolk, grilled scallops (2026 reviews) · beef cutlet sandwich, also to take away (July and November 2026) · eel rice bowl, yaki-onigiri, rice with chirimen sansho and karasumi (2026 reviews) · no prices on the menu; about ¥15,000–20,000 a head (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo-izakaya · Nijo Teramachi, build your own kaiseki] A grown-up izakaya near Nijo-Teramachi where you assemble your own course from a long, seasonal à la carte list — karasumi mochi and crab cream croquettes are the signatures, with charcoal-grilled fish, hairy crab and a beef cutlet sandwich you can take home. The menu has no prices; expect about ¥15,000–20,000, with no service charge. One March 2026 diner found the service slow. Closed Monday; book by phone 12:00–16:00.

roles: Head chef (unnamed); a new chef since the previous owner left (August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): the name means "to keep changing in order to remain the same"; an adult izakaya of carefully chosen ingredients and charcoal grilling, opened 18 August 2015. An August 2026 reviewer heard that the previous owner had left the year before to open a Kyoto restaurant in Milan, and wished the current chef well; reviewers describe the head chef as approachable (November 2025, September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "to keep changing in order to remain the same."
chef_bio.specialty: Karasumi mochi; crab cream croquette.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner found drinks and dishes so slow it was hard to order more.
A May 2026 diner liked the food but not the glass of white wine, and found the prices on the high side.
A July 2026 diner, already full, had the beef cutlet sandwich packed to eat on the Shinkansen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、中京区二条寺町西入丁子屋町694-3、京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分、火〜土 17:00〜23:00 (最終入店21:00、L.O. 22:00)、日 17:00〜21:30 (最終入店20:00)、月曜と月に2連休、電話は12:00〜16:00に、サービス料・チャージ共に無し、22席 (カウンター10席、個室)、禁煙、カード可、2015年8月18日オープン、店名には変わらないために変わり続けるという意味。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年11月、英語): 品書きに値段がない、1人約15,000〜20,000円、からすみ餅と蟹クリームコロッケが名物、炭火の焼き魚、毛蟹、ビーフカツサンドの持ち帰り、先代は前年にミラノで京料理の店を開いたという声、提供が遅いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order à la carte from a Japanese menu without prices; staff help; book by phone 12:00–16:00.

places.name: 南禅寺参道 菊水 (Nanzenji Sando Kikusui)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Italian courses with handmade pasta and house bread (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-rich Italian courses, but with seafood, meat and dairy, e.g. sea urchin pasta and chestnut tiramisu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–16:00 (last food order 13:30), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last food order 20:00), open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; cancellation 20% three or two days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day (Tabelog). Private rooms for up to 6 and 16 at ¥11,000 a room (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「個室利用料：11,000円/室」). 26 seats in the dining room and two private rooms, overlooking the garden (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Five parking spaces (Tabelog). On the approach to Nanzen-ji; 260 m from Keage Stn (Tabelog). Opened 11 June 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nanzen-ji approach — 260 m from Keage Stn
places.cuisine: Italian with local terroir at a "cooking ryokan" with a rare garden by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei (official site; Tabelog) · handmade pasta by a chef with experience in Italian three-star restaurants; over 100 wines chosen by a sommelier (Tabelog, shop text) · lunch Italian course of 8 dishes ¥11,000 plus drinks (November 2025) · sea urchin pasta, chestnut tiramisu, house bread (October 2026) · Japanese dishes too — a yudofu kaiseki (Tabelog review) — afternoon tea (April 2026) and a children’s plate (September 2026) · champagne and sake (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Nanzen-ji, a ryokan garden by Ogawa Jihei] A traditional inn on the approach to Nanzen-ji that serves Italian cooking to visitors as well as guests, in a dining room and private rooms looking onto a garden by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei. Courses of seasonal Kyoto produce with handmade pasta — an eight-dish lunch was ¥11,000 in 2025 — and a sommelier's list of 100-plus wines. Staff have taken guests’ photos in the garden. Private rooms ¥11,000 extra. Open daily.

roles: Hotel restaurant; chef unnamed (Tabelog: experience in Italian three-star restaurants)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a "cooking ryokan" — neither restaurant nor inn — serving Italian made with seasonal ingredients from around Kyoto, around a rare garden by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei. Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a ryokan by Nanzen-ji with authentic Italian by chefs with experience in Italian three-star restaurants, and wines chosen by a sommelier; opened 11 June 2018.
chef_bio.specialty: Italian courses; handmade pasta.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner celebrating Mother’s Day was photographed in the lit garden by the staff after dinner.
An October 2026 diner liked the recommended sea urchin pasta but might skip the pasta next time; the chestnut tiramisu was the best dish.
An April 2026 family, joined by an unexpected extra guest, were accommodated with à la carte dishes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-kikusui.com): 京都東山の和食・洋食を愉しむ料理旅館、七代目小川治兵衛の希少な庭、レストランでもない旅館でもない「料理旅館」、京都近郊のテロワールの旬の食材のイタリアン。食べログ: 旅館・イタリアン、左京区南禅寺福地町31、蹴上駅から260m、昼 12:00〜16:00 (料理 L.O. 13:30)、夜 18:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 20:00)、年中無休、予約可、キャンセル料 3日前・2日前20%、前日50%、当日100%、個室利用料11,000円/室、26席 (個室6名・16名)、カード・PayPay 可、駐車場5台、2018年6月11日オープン、手打ちパスタ、イタリアの三つ星で経験を積んだシェフ、ソムリエが選ぶ100種以上のワイン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 昼のイタリアン8品11,000円 (2025年11月)、庭を望む個室、雲丹のパスタ、栗のティラミス、アフタヌーンティー、子ども用プレート。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course online; private garden-view rooms extra; cards and PayPay.

places.name: 割烹たいら (Kappou Taira)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kappo omakase with dashi soups, fu, sashimi with soy and ponzu; no gluten information (2023–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led kappo on a fish broth (2023–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Lunch omakase ¥6,600 (April 2023); a lunch course at ¥8,000 among several price levels (August 2026). 8 counter seats; private hire possible; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners (Tabelog). In a renovated machiya with a white noren and no sign, on Bukkoji-dori; about 6 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog; June 2025).
places.neighborhood: Bukkoji-dori between Karasuma and Kawaramachi — 6 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kappo omakase at an eight-seat white-wood counter: sakizuke, soup, sashimi, small dishes, grilled, simmered and vinegared dishes, rice and dessert (June 2025) · in reviews: minced tuna with fu, cod and tofu with new onion, sashimi of amadai, bluefin tuna and yellowtail with salt, soy or ponzu, grilled amadai, young ayu, Biwa trout and wakasagi from Lake Biwa (2023–25 reviews) · a wide range of sake and wine; wine-pairing events (February 2024)
places.notes: [Kappo · Bukkoji-dori near Shijo] An unsigned machiya with a white noren hides an eight-seat white-wood counter, where the chatty chef — once head chef at Gion's Senka, per a reviewer — cooks seasonal omakase and pours from a deep sake list. Lunch courses about ¥6,600–8,000; dinner around ¥10,000–15,000. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2023–26 reviews: an owner-chef who keeps up a lively conversation with each guest at the counter; an August 2026 reviewer writes the owner was formerly head chef at the Gion restaurant "Senka". A September 2025 reviewer notes staff serving the dishes.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kappo omakase; sake.

anecdotes.text: With "the lively chatter of Chef Taira", a November 2023 lunch guest felt completely at ease.
A February 2024 wine-pairing event surprised a guest who had doubted wine with Japanese food.
A September 2025 diner's son, training as a chef, quietly watched the cooking from the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 割烹たいら、日本料理、下京区仏光寺通柳馬場西入ル東前町401、四条駅から徒歩約6分、火〜日 12:00〜14:00・18:00〜23:00、月曜休み、8席 (カウンター)、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2023年4月〜2026年8月、英語): 町家の白木のカウンター、看板のない白いのれん、昼のおまかせ6,600円、昼のコース8,000円、Chef Taira、祇園 Senka の元料理長、マグロのたたきと麩、甘鯛、ビワマス、ワカサギ、日本酒とワインのペアリングの会、魚の出汁。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; a talkative counter chef.

places.name: 祇園 大季 (Gion Daiki)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kappo course with sushi, dashi, akadashi and fried dishes; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, crab, foie gras and wagyu courses (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday, but Sunday bookings for 6 or more by phone (Tabelog). Bookings by phone preferred; guests who cannot read Japanese must order the omakase course, not à la carte; cancellations two days ahead, the day before or on the day are charged 100%, and prepayments are not refunded (Tabelog). Service charge 10% — Tabelog's Japanese original: "サービス料１０パーセント". 12 seats (counter with shoes off) plus private rooms for 2–18; smoking allowed at the counter seats; wheelchair accessible; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). At the end of a narrow alley by the Mame Roku Building, off Hanamikoji-Sueyoshi; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo, off Hanamikoji-Sueyoshi — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kappo with sushi: fish direct from Maizuru, mainly Kyoto vegetables, beef from a long-established Shichijo-Gozen butcher; an appetizer platter that changes daily and weekly (Tabelog) · "sushi × kappo" omakase ¥22,000 + service: appetizers, steamed dish, sashimi, simmered, grilled, sushi, dessert; all-you-can-drink +¥4,000 for 6 or more (Tabelog) · in reviews: foie gras chawanmushi, hairy-crab sashimi, nodoguro with fried lotus root and shrimp, grouper and matsutake, grilled conger eel, wagyu, saba sushi, akadashi; snow crab and kue hot pot in winter (2019–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo & sushi · Gion off Hanamikoji] A hidden house at the end of a Gion alley, where an owner-chef who ran a Japanese restaurant in Bangkok for 15 years cooks Kyoto kappo alongside a father who is a sushi chef: Maizuru fish, foie gras chawanmushi, crab and kue hot pot in winter. Omakase ¥22,000 + 10%. Counter seats allow smoking. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Masayuki Tomimura (romaji, per an October 2024 review)
roles: Father: sushi chef with 50 years' experience (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator on Tabelog: born in 1975 in Kyoto Prefecture and drawn to cooking by watching a father who was a sushi chef; trained at Yoshitora in Kyoto, Kappo Kamitome in Kitashinchi and Kōmei ARIAKE in Tokyo, then ran the Japanese restaurant "Dai no Ki" in Bangkok as owner for 15 years; opened Gion Daiki in May 2018 (Tabelog: 28 May 2018) and runs it with the father, a sushi chef of 50 years. An October 2024 reviewer names the owner as Masayuki Tomimura, "Tomi". 2025–26 reviews mention a head chef, a hostess and staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: new ideas while keeping the flavours of Kyoto.
chef_bio.specialty: Foie gras chawanmushi; sushi within the kappo course.

anecdotes.text: A family has made Gion Daiki its year-end tradition — snow crab and kue hot pot in December 2019.
A November 2024 guest noted a private room where smoking is allowed, with good ventilation.
A June 2026 diner celebrated a 60th birthday here and thanked "the owner and the hostess".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 祇園 大季、日本料理・寿司・鍋、東山区清本町374-4、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、Mame Roku Building から細い路地の奥、月〜土 17:00〜22:00、日曜休み (6名以上は電話で予約可)、日本語が読めない海外の客はおまかせコースのみ、2日前からのキャンセルは100%、サービス料１０パーセント、12席、個室2〜18名、カウンターは喫煙可、2018年5月28日オープン、1975年京都府生まれ、寿司職人の父、Yoshitora、Kappo Kamitome、Kōmei ARIAKE で修業、バンコクで Dai no Ki を15年経営、父と営む、Maizuru 港直送の魚、Shichijo Gozen の老舗の肉、寿司×割烹おまかせ22,000円 (+サービス料)。口コミ (2019年12月〜2026年10月、英語): フォアグラの茶碗蒸し、毛蟹、のどぐろ、クエ鍋、Masayuki Tomimura。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; guests who cannot read Japanese order the omakase (Tabelog); 100% cancellation charge from two days ahead.

places.name: K36
places.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail bar with bar food such as truffle fries and onion rings; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Mainly drinks; the food menu is not described in the sources beyond fried snacks (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: The Bar (indoor) 15:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); Rooftop 15:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 23:30) for 16 September–30 November 2026; open all year; the rooftop closes in bad weather (official site; Tabelog). Seat-only bookings are not taken — booking is by plan, with a ¥25,000-per-person minimum for reserved seats; walk-ins may wait (Tabelog; November 2026: about an hour). Service charge 10% plus a ¥1,100 charge per person — Tabelog's Japanese original: "サービス料10％に加え1,100円(税込)のチャージ料". Adults only in The Bar; the rooftop admits under-20s with an adult until 17:00, and from 17:00 no one of elementary-school age or younger, 13–19 only with an adult (official site). Smart casual in The Bar — no shorts, T-shirts or sandals (official site). 108 seats (rooftop 72, bar 36); wheelchair accessible; smoking space at the rooftop entrance; cards and IC cards (Tabelog). On the 4th floor of The Hotel Seiryu Kyoto Kiyomizu, the former Kiyomizu Elementary School; 5 min from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Kiyomizu, by Yasaka Pagoda — 5 min from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop
places.cuisine: Rooftop bar and main bar open to hotel guests and visitors, with a 360-degree view over Kyoto and Hokan-ji's Yasaka Pagoda (official site) · cocktails, whisky, wine and champagne; signature "K36 Gin and Tonic" with the tonic bottle upturned in the glass ¥1,650, "Sex on the Rooftop" (August 2026); caipirinha, mojito, old fashioned (Tabelog) · bar food: truffle fries, onion rings (November 2026)
places.notes: [Rooftop bar · Kiyomizu, facing Yasaka Pagoda] The rooftop and bar of The Hotel Seiryu, a former elementary school, open to non-guests: cocktails with the Yasaka Pagoda lit up right in front of you and the city beyond. Come at sunset; expect to queue without a plan booking. ¥1,100 charge + 10% service; cocktails from about ¥1,650. Smart casual. Open daily to midnight.

roles: Butler (head of the bar), per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: run by Stillfoods inc.; the bar invited 西田 稔, who runs the Kyoto bars Bar K6, Cave de K and Bar Keller, as its butler — a Champagne Officier, Krug ambassador, "knight of grappa" and whisky-contest judge. Opened 22 March 2020 (Tabelog). The main bar was converted from a classroom of the former Kiyomizu Elementary School (Tabelog; August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: K36 gin and tonic; sunset view.

anecdotes.text: A K6 regular in October 2026 followed Nishida-san here and calls K36 a pioneer among Kansai rooftop bars.
Without a booking, a November 2026 visitor waited about an hour to get in.
By 11 pm on a 15 °C October 2026 night, the rooftop was almost empty and the best tables free.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (stillfoods.com/k36): K36 | The Bar & Rooftop、ザ・ホテル青龍 京都清水の宿泊者もビジターも利用できるルーフトップバー＆レストラン・メインバー、360度のパノラマビュー、法観寺・八坂の塔の眺望、The Bar 15:00〜24:00 (23:00 L.O.)、Rooftop 15:00〜24:00 (Food 23:00 L.O.、Drink 23:30 L.O.、2026年9月16日〜11月30日)、荒天時は Rooftop 閉鎖、The Bar は終日未成年不可、スマートカジュアル、バトラー 西田稔 (Bar K6、Cave de K、Bar Keller)、Stillfoods inc.。食べログ (店舗会員): ダイニングバー・バー、東山区清水2-204-2 4F、席のみの予約不可、席の予約は1人25,000円以上、サービス料10％に加え1,100円のチャージ料、108席 (ルーフトップ72、バー36)、2020年3月22日オープン。口コミ (2026年7〜11月、英語): K36 ジントニック1,650円、八坂の塔の夜景、旧清水小学校、予約なしで約1時間待ち。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel bar used to visitors; smart casual; ¥1,100 charge + 10% service.

places.name: To
places.gf_detail: Ask. Brioche crostini at breakfast; yatsuhashi, monaka, gyoza and fried dishes at night; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: duck liver pâté, prosciutto, eggs, cheese, pork and fish dishes (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 8:00–12:30 daily; dinner Mon, Wed, Thu, Sun 17:00–23:00 and Fri–Sat 17:00–24:00; no dinner on Tuesday, except Tuesday holidays (Tabelog). Bookings online, also for one person; breakfast starts together at the booked time with an explanation of the ingredients first, so dishes take about 30 minutes; walk-ins turned away when full (2026 reviews). 12 seats: an 8-seat single-plank counter around an island kitchen and two tables; Tabelog lists halal options; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). 3 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn exit 1 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Oike-dori near Karasuma — 3 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Creative izakaya with Italian touches at night: "Hachi To. Bashi" — Kyoto duck liver pâté between grilled yatsuhashi, pork kakuni in Marsala, duck gyoza, fruit shira-ae, salsiccia mapo tofu, natto-mousse rice; red, white, rosé and natural wines and small-brewery sake (Tabelog) · 2026 reviews: fried hamo with manganji-pepper salsa, mozzarella dumplings, fried potatoes, monaka; small plates around ¥4,000–5,000 a head · morning: brioche crostini sets with soup, drink and dessert — caramelised fig, prosciutto and sesame mascarpone, or ham and soft-boiled egg; bomboloni (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Creative izakaya & breakfast · Oike near Karasuma] The second shop of the popular Italian fudo: a 12-seat counter around an open kitchen serving playful small plates — duck pâté in yatsuhashi, Marsala pork belly — with natural wine at night, and booked-ahead crostini breakfasts from 8 am. Dinner about ¥4,000–6,000. Always busy: book.

chef_bio.background: Opened 14 January 2020 (Tabelog) as "the second store of Karasuma Oike's popular Italian Cuisine restaurant 'fudo'" (Tabelog); fudo is in our data as kyoto_fudo. Per the operator: a relaxed space like a friend's house, built around an island kitchen and a single-plank counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Hachi To. Bashi; crostini breakfast.

anecdotes.text: An 8 am September 2026 breakfast was full of overseas guests, many from Korea, and began with an explanation of the ingredients to everyone at once.
An October 2026 visitor found the slow, careful explanation lovely but noticed a later arrival being seated first.
A September 2026 fan of fudo came here for the same yatsuhashi starter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): To、居酒屋・創作料理、中京区御池高田町500 ポポラーレ御池 1F、烏丸御池駅1番出口から徒歩3分、月水木日 8:00〜12:30・17:00〜23:00、火 8:00〜12:30、金土 8:00〜12:30・17:00〜24:00 (祝日の火曜は営業)、12席 (一枚板のカウンター8、テーブル)、ハラール対応あり、2020年1月14日オープン、烏丸御池の人気イタリアン fudo の2号店、京都の鴨レバーのパテを焼き八ッ橋で挟んだ前菜、マルサラ酒の豚の角煮、鴨肉の餃子、果物の白和え、サルシッチャの麻婆豆腐、納豆ムースのご飯、自然派ワイン、小さな蔵の日本酒。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): ブリオッシュのクロスティーニの朝食、無花果と生ハム、半熟卵とハム、鱧のフライ、最中、要予約。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online (also for one); breakfast starts together at the booked time.

places.name: み MITARASHI DANGO by kolme kyoto
places.gf_detail: Ask. The dango are glutinous rice (Leaf KYOTO), but the mitarashi glaze is a sweet soy sauce; Tabelog says allergy information is available.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain dango with bean paste, kinako or mitarashi glaze may suit, but there are ice-cream and latte options (2026 reviews); allergy information is available (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Wed–Mon 11:00–18:00; closed Tuesday. Bookings taken for the café. A dango counter at the entrance of the kolme kyoto glasses shop; order downstairs, then eat in a shoes-off room upstairs with two tables for four and two for two (May 2026), 10 seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; wheelchair accessible; take-out; cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 3 March 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yanagibamba-dori just south of Sanjo — 10 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal-grilled mitarashi dango of glutinous rice, served inside a glasses shop (Leaf KYOTO) · Hachifuku set of eight dango flavours with a drink, or matcha you whisk yourself (2026 reviews) · nine mitarashi dango to take away ¥1,000, with kinako, good until the next day (May 2026) · mitarashi matcha ice cream; hojicha and matcha lattes (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Dango · Yanagibamba-Sanjo, inside a glasses shop] A dango stand at the door of the kolme kyoto eyewear shop: order below, then slip off your shoes for a small room upstairs. Charcoal-grilled glutinous-rice dango in bright colours — the Hachifuku set brings eight flavours with matcha you whisk yourself — or a box of nine mitarashi to take away. One July 2026 diner found the flavours ordinary but the presentation charming. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Leaf KYOTO (2022): the glasses select shop kolme kyoto, reopened that spring, began selling dango with a Japanese confectioner as partner, hoping people would drop into a glasses shop more casually; the dango are charcoal-grilled glutinous rice. Opened 3 March 2022 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Leaf KYOTO: a reason for people to step into a glasses shop casually.
chef_bio.specialty: Mitarashi dango; eight-flavour dango set.

anecdotes.text: "I initially thought this was just a gimmicky shop for tourists, as it was located in front of a glasses store. However, my impression changed after trying the dango." — May 2026.
"The flavors were not particularly special, but they were generally tasty." — July 2026, on the eight-dango set.
A May 2026 diner was told to carry the take-away box flat because of all the sauce.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Leaf KYOTO (2022年5月): この春リニューアルした眼鏡のセレクトショップ kolme kyoto で団子の販売を始めた、和菓子店と組み、眼鏡店に気軽に入るきっかけに、炭火で焼くもち米の団子、みたらし9個のおもたせ団子700円、こしあん・つぶあん各800円、好きな団子2本と自分で点てる抹茶のセット1,000円、12:00〜17:00 (売り切れ次第終了)、不定休 (当時)。食べログ: カフェ・和菓子、中京区柳馬場三条下ル槌屋町89-1、水〜月 11:00〜18:00、火曜休み、予約可、10席、禁煙、アレルギー表示あり、子供・ベビーカー可、車椅子可、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2022年3月3日オープン。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): 入口で注文して2階の靴を脱ぐカフェへ、4人席2つと2人席2つ、八福セット (団子8種とドリンク)、自分で点てる抹茶、みたらし9個の持ち帰り1,000円ときな粉、翌日まで、みたらし抹茶アイス、ほうじ茶、味は普通という声、海外からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter by the door, then take shoes off upstairs; many overseas visitors (October 2026).

places.name: El Rincon (エルリンコン)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; paella, ajillo, charcoal-grilled meats and tapas, beside a pasta paella (2021–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: jamón, octopus, anchovy, lamb, pork, beef and chicken paella (2021–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Wed–Sun 17:00–23:00; closed Monday and Tuesday. In 2021 lunch was served Friday to Sunday (June 2021 review, citing Instagram); Tabelog now lists dinner only. Bookings taken; even if online booking shows full, call — same-day and large groups by phone (Tabelog). 20 seats: two tables of 4, a counter of 4, private rooms for 2 and 4 and a semi-private room for up to 6, some in a half-basement (2025–2026 reviews); non-smoking; children welcome; English menu; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 1 May 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Between Shijo and Ayakoji, just east of Karasuma — 4 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn, exit 19
places.cuisine: Spanish: paella and pasta paella, ajillo (octopus a favourite), charcoal-grilled lamb, pork and beef, jamón and cheese platters, carpaccio (2021–2026 reviews) · cava and Spanish wine (2024–2026 reviews) · in 2021 a ¥1,800 lunch course and a ¥1,300 paella lunch (2021 reviews)
places.notes: [Spanish · Shijo-Karasuma, cave-like private rooms] A quiet Spanish restaurant a few minutes from Karasuma, with snug half-basement rooms. Fans praise the paella, octopus ajillo, charcoal-grilled meats and cava, and the warm, calm room. Recent visits were mixed: a September 2026 diner found the chef aloof and the staff chatting among themselves and left early; an October 2026 diner found the paella too salty. English menu. Dinner only, Wednesday to Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2018 (Tabelog). A June 2022 diner found it run by a single staff member that night; later reviews describe a chef and front-of-house staff, a counter, tables and half-basement private rooms.
chef_bio.specialty: Paella; octopus ajillo; charcoal-grilled meats.

anecdotes.text: "I was seated in a cozy pocket-like cave underground." — February 2025.
A July 2026 regular was put in a semi-basement private room and was grateful the restaurant let a booking move earlier at the last minute.
"The staff were chatting among themselves, and I wish they had done it somewhere out of earshot..." — September 2026.
"As for the paella, it was a bit too salty for my taste." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: El Rincon (エルリンコン)、スペイン料理、下京区神明町724、阪急烏丸駅19番出口から徒歩4分、水〜日 17:00〜23:00、月火休み、予約可 (ネットで満席でも電話で空きの場合あり)、20席 (4名テーブル2、カウンター4)、個室2名・4名、半個室6名まで、禁煙、子供可、英語メニュー、カード・PayPay 可、2018年5月1日オープン。口コミ (2021年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 2021年はランチあり (バルセロナランチコース1,800円、丹波鶏のパエリアランチ1,300円、金土日のみ)、パエリア、パスタのパエリア、蛸のアヒージョ、生ハム、ラム、豚、牛の炭火焼き、チーズ盛り合わせ、カルパッチョ、カヴァ、半地下の洞窟のような個室、2022年は一人で営業、2026年9月は料理人が無関心でスタッフの私語が気になった、2026年10月はパエリアが塩辛い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); call if online booking shows full.

places.name: 山本料理店 (Yamamoto Ryori Ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Skewers come with salt (Guérande sea salt) or a sweet tare (official site); the signature fried chicken has a dipping sauce of Hatcho miso, sesame paste and black vinegar, and the course ends with soba, ramen or oyakodon (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant — skewers, liver, fried chicken and chicken soup (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday and two Mondays a month (Tabelog the same). Courses last 2 hours 30 minutes, with last drink orders 2 hours in (Tabelog). Same-day cancellation may be charged ¥7,000 per person (official site). Tabelog’s charge field reads 「500円」 (¥500), with no further detail. 8 counter seats (9 with an extra chair); non-smoking, with a smoking spot inside; school-age children; English menu; BYO allowed; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; official site). Opened 3 March 2026 (Tabelog); one October 2026 diner says April.
places.neighborhood: Gojo-dori near Takakura, upstairs in the Yuasa Kaikan — 4 min walk from Gojo Stn, exit 1
places.cuisine: Yakitori over binchotan from Omi Kurodori and Kyoto Akadori, with thigh skewers of about 60 g, salt or a light sweet tare (official site) · signature 炸鶏 (zaji): whole Kyoto Akadori boiled, glazed, hung to dry half a day and twice-fried, with a black-vinegar dip (official site) · omakase course with drinks ¥12,000 (official site); à la carte too · seen: necktie, white liver, outside skirt, neck, cartilage, tsukune, chicken tataki, Peking-duck style chicken, shark-fin rice, chicken soba, ramen or oyakodon to finish (2026 reviews) · 25–30 bottles of wine chosen by the sommelier-owner (official site)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Gojo, an eight-seat sommelier’s counter] Up the stairs of the Taisho-era Yuasa Kaikan, an eight-seat counter round a binchotan grill, opened in 2026 by an owner who spent over twenty years at a famous yakitori house and is a qualified sommelier. Big, crisp-skinned Omi Kurodori and Kyoto Akadori skewers, the signature twice-fried zaji chicken, and a chicken-broth soba to finish, with wines matched to salt or tare. Omakase with drinks ¥12,000. Booked up within months. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yamamoto (surname from the shop name and 2026 reviews; no given name in a source)
roles: Owner-chef and sommelier (official site: ソムリエ資格を持つ店主)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a chicken restaurant run by an owner who honed the craft for over 20 years at a famous yakitori restaurant, on the belief that yakitori is proper cuisine; eight counter seats on the second floor of the Yuasa Kaikan; birds chosen cut by cut from Omi Kurodori, Kyoto Akadori and others; the owner tastes and selects every wine. Opened 3 March 2026 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a renovated Taisho-era building and say it became hard to book within six months.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「焼き鳥も立派な料理」 — yakitori is proper cooking too.
chef_bio.specialty: Large thigh skewers; 炸鶏 (zaji) fried chicken; chicken soba.

anecdotes.text: When some planned starters and skewers had sold out, the chef gave a September 2026 guest a discount.
An October 2026 diner who could only find a 9 pm slot on an all-you-can-drink course noticed walk-ins being seated later in the evening.
"I can't wait to come back to Kyoto just to see the owner again!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yamamotorestaurant.com): 山本料理店 (やまもとりょうりてん)、五条駅1番出口から徒歩4分、湯浅会館2階、有名焼き鳥店で20年以上腕を磨いた店主の鶏料理店、「焼き鳥も立派な料理」、近江黒鶏や京赤地どりを部位ごとに、もも串は約60g、皮を巻き込む串打ち、備長炭、ゲランドの塩と甘めのたれ、名物「炸鶏 (ザージー)」は京赤地どりの丸鶏をボイルして水飴を塗り半日干し、140度と170度で揚げ、八丁味噌・芝麻醤・黒酢のつけだれ、ソムリエ資格の店主が選ぶワイン25〜30種、おまかせコース (お飲み物付き) 12,000円 (税込)、カウンター8席、17:00〜23:00、日曜と月2回の月曜休み、当日キャンセルは1人7,000円の場合あり、カード・電子マネー可。食べログ: 焼き鳥・鶏料理・居酒屋、下京区五条通高倉上ル亀屋町172 湯浅会館2F、コースは2時間30分、料金欄に「500円」、8席 (補助席で9)、禁煙 (店内に喫煙所)、小学生以上、英語メニュー、持ち込み可、2026年3月3日オープン。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 大正時代の建物、近江黒鶏、ネクタイ (英語の口コミでは necktie)、白レバー、ハラミ、せせり、軟骨、つくね、むね肉のたたき、北京ダック風、フカヒレご飯、鶏そば、ラーメン、親子丼、半年で予約困難、売り切れの分を値引き。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book well ahead — later-evening walk-ins sometimes seated (October 2026).

places.name: 末廣 (Suehiro)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; Kyoto pressed sushi with a sweet tare on the anago, simmered kanpyo and shiitake, and soy-seasoned fillings (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Inari with carrot, burdock and sesame rice, and small kanpyo, cucumber, pickle and ume-shiso rolls are listed, but the fried tofu and kanpyo may be simmered in dashi; most sushi is mackerel, anago, sea bream or egg (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Wed–Sun 11:00–18:00, closing when sold out; dine-in until 15:00; closed Monday and Tuesday. No reservations to eat in; take-away can be ordered ahead by phone (2019 and March 2026 reviews). 6 seats at three small tables; queues of 30 minutes or more on winter weekends (March 2026). Non-smoking; cards, IC cards and QR accepted (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Prices rose on 2 April 2025 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi-dori north of Nijo — 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style sushi since the Tenpo era: mackerel sushi ¥5,800 a roll of 12, half ¥2,900 (official menu; 2026 reviews); anago box sushi ¥1,840; Kyoto box sushi ¥1,920; inari ¥1,190; Kyoto chirashi ¥2,200; sukeroku ¥1,380; futomaki ¥1,750; mackerel-and-shibazuke iso-maki ¥1,440; small sea-bream sushi ¥2,800 (official menu) · steamed mushi-zushi from November to March, ¥2,750 for the premium version (April 2026) · clear soup or red miso ¥600 (official menu)
places.notes: [Kyoto sushi · Teramachi-Nijo, since the 1830s] A six-seat Kyoto sushi shop founded in the Tenpo era south of the Imperial Palace, still making mackerel sushi, box sushi, rolls and inari the old way — and, from November to March, warm steamed mushi-zushi topped with egg ribbons and grilled anago, which draws winter queues. Regulars rank its mackerel sushi above the famous names. One March 2026 diner waited 30 minutes and found it nothing special. Take-away by phone. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in the Tenpo era (1830–1844) as a cooked-food shop at Teramachi-Nijo, south of the Imperial Palace, keeping the taste of Kyoto sushi for about 200 years with unchanged methods — mackerel, box, rolled, inari and chirashi sushi, and steamed sushi in winter. Prices were raised from 2 April 2025 because of the rising price of rice (official site). An October 2026 diner found the owner and staff friendly.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: keeping to genuine Kyoto sushi.
chef_bio.specialty: Mackerel sushi; winter mushi-zushi; anago box sushi.

anecdotes.text: "Currently the Number One Saba Sushi in Kyoto" — October 2026, from a diner who had long bought elsewhere; the half roll of six came with a cooling pack.
A March 2026 diner queued from 10:40 and sat down around 12:30, in the fourth round of six seats; take-away orders were quoted at an hour.
"The steamed sushi was... just good, nothing extraordinary." — March 2026, after a 30-minute wait.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sushi-suehiro.jp): 京のすし処 末廣、天保年間に京都御所の南、寺町二条で煮売屋として創業、京寿司の味を約200年、さばずし・箱ずし・巻ずし・おいなりさん・ちらしずし、冬はむしずし、2025年4月2日から米価高騰などで価格改定。おしながき: 名代さばずし一本 (12切) 5,800円、ハーフ (6切) あり、あなご箱ずし1,840円、いなりずし1,190円、盛合せ2,310円、京風ちらしずし2,200円、助六1,380円、京風箱ずし1,920円、箱と巻1,660円、巻ずし1,750円、江戸前盛合せ2,700円、いそ巻1,440円、うざく巻2,000円、小鯛ずし2,800円、小巻480円〜、お吸い物・赤だし各600円。食べログ: 寿司・日本料理、中京区寺町二条上ル要法寺前町711、水〜日 11:00〜18:00 (売り切れ次第終了、店内は15:00まで)、月火休み、予約不可、6席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、テイクアウト、蒸し寿司は11月〜3月末。口コミ (2019年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 蒸し寿司 上2,750円、さばずしハーフ2,900円、冬は30分以上の行列、持ち帰りは電話予約がよい、店主とスタッフが気さく、蒸し寿司は普通という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order from the menu at the table; queue in winter; phone ahead for take-away.

places.name: 祇園 岩元 (Gion Iwamoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kaiseki with dashi and soy, anago rice boxes with tare and seasonal dishes; Tabelog lists vegetarian options but no gluten information is published (official menu; Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Ask when booking. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; courses otherwise centre on fish, dashi and Omi Hime wagyu (meat can be swapped for fish), and no vegan course is published (official menu; Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:00) and dinner 17:30–22:30 (last order 21:00; Tabelog gives 17:30–22:00, last order 20:00); closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Service charge 10%; 2nd-floor private rooms 15%, or 20% for two guests (official site; Tabelog’s Japanese original agrees). Cancellation 80% the day before and 100% on the day; lunch 100% the day before or on the day (official site). Seats: a one-plank counter of 8 and a window counter of 3 facing the moss garden on the 1st floor; private rooms of 8 and 16 upstairs; up to 26 (official site; Tabelog lists 30); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children from elementary-school age (Tabelog). Cards accepted (Tabelog). Geiko and maiko can be booked for banquets in the private rooms (official site). Off Hanamikoji near Ichiriki, south of Shijo; 5–7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site; March 2025). Opened 7 July 2009 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Off Hanamikoji in Gion, south of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki of seasonal ingredients, with charcoal-grilled Omi Hime wagyu (official site) · lunch: half Kyoto anago rice box ¥2,530, Kyoto anago rice box ¥3,850, ogi bento ¥5,280 (4 or more), seasonal courses ¥8,800 and ¥12,100 · dinner: seasonal courses ¥12,100, ¥16,500 and ¥22,000 — sakizuke, hassun, owan, sashimi, grilled Omi Hime wagyu (or fish), a warm dish, rice and dessert · à la carte at night, e.g. sashimi from ¥1,320 · New Year courses ¥14,300 (lunch) and ¥19,800 (dinner) (official menu; service extra) · all-you-can-drink with courses for groups (May 2025) · wines chosen by a well-known sommelier (official site) · osechi supervised by the restaurant (2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a townhouse kappo off Hanamikoji] A Gion townhouse just off Hanamikoji, with a one-plank counter, a window counter facing a moss garden and private tatami rooms upstairs, where you can book geiko or maiko for a banquet. Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki from ¥8,800 at lunch and ¥12,100 at dinner, its grilled course centred on charcoal-grilled Omi Hime wagyu (or fish if you prefer), plus an anago rice box lunch from ¥2,530. Reviewers find it classic rather than surprising, and good for entertaining. 10% service (more in private rooms).

roles: Representative (代表責任者) on the shop’s commercial-law notice; reviewers describe an owner who explains each dish, with a head chef (料理長) not named
chef_bio.background: The official site’s commercial-law notice names 岩元 勝己 as the responsible representative of 祇園 岩元. Per the official site: authentic, artistic Kyoto cuisine with seasonal ingredients, Kyoto vegetables and fresh seafood, made easy to enjoy; the delicate cooking of the head chef; Omi Hime wagyu, raised longest in Shiga, grilled over charcoal; osechi supervised by the restaurant offered through Kyoto’s furusato-nozei programme (2021 notice). Opened 7 July 2009 (Tabelog). A July 2024 honeymoon couple describe the owner adjusting dishes for a pregnant guest and explaining each in English with a picture booklet.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: make the most of each season’s ingredients, beautiful to the eye as well as the palate, in relaxed Gion style.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; charcoal-grilled Omi Hime wagyu; Kyoto anago rice box.

anecdotes.text: A July 2024 honeymoon couple had forgotten to say the wife was pregnant and could not eat raw food; the owner adjusted the dishes on the spot and explained each one in English with a picture booklet.
A January 2025 diner in a private room could hear the neighbouring room clearly and found the drinks list limited.
A May 2025 group of nine had a ¥12,000 course with all-you-can-drink in the tatami room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-iwamoto.jp): 祇園 岩元、花街祇園の京町家、一枚板のカウンター、坪庭を眺める窓際のカウンター、個室、季節素材の味を最大限に活かした芸術的な本格京料理を気軽に、近江姫和牛の炭火焼、料理長の繊細な料理、舞妓さん・芸妓さんとのお座敷、席: 1階カウンター8席・庭の見えるカウンター3席・2階個室8席と16席・最大26席、サービス料10%・2階個室15%・2名20%、キャンセル料 前日80%・当日100% (ランチは前日・当日100%)、11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 13:00)・17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 21:00)、不定休、東山区祇園町南側570-127、祇園四条駅より徒歩7分、メニュー: 京半あなご重2,530円、京あなご重3,850円、扇弁当5,280円、季節料理コース 昼8,800円・12,100円、夜12,100円・16,500円・22,000円 (サービス料別)、お肉が苦手な方は魚に変更可、特定商取引法の表記: 代表責任者 岩元 勝己。食べログ: 日本料理、30席、禁煙、車椅子可、ベジタリアンメニュー、小学生以上、2009年7月7日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語)。

cultural_comfort.note: The owner explained dishes in English with a picture booklet (July 2024); service 10–20%.
