places.name: お茶と晴ル (ocha to haru)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Warabi mochi with kinako and kuromitsu, Uji matcha kakigori with azuki and shiratama, and zenzai; no ingredient or gluten information is published (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The kakigori comes with condensed milk on the side and the matcha latte has milk; warabi mochi, zenzai and plain teas may suit, but no ingredient list is published (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:30–17:00 daily except Wednesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog); kakigori can sell out (May 2026). About 7–12 seats: a counter of 5 and a table, with a small garden at the entrance where guests wait (Tabelog lists 12; October 2025 and October 2026 reviews describe a counter and one table). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Down a side street south of Hanamikoji past the Gion Kobu theatre (October 2025); 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 May 2024 (Tabelog); an August 2025 reviewer calls the building 90 years old.
places.neighborhood: Side street south of Hanamikoji in Gion — 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Small Gion tea café (2025–26 reviews) · Uji matcha kakigori with spring-water ice, azuki and three shiratama, extra matcha syrup and condensed milk on the side ¥1,600 · warabi mochi with kinako and kuromitsu, as a set with a drink ¥1,700 (matcha or matcha latte ¥1,750) · zenzai · hojicha in a pot ¥800, sencha, matcha latte hot or iced
places.notes: [Sweets · Gion, matcha kakigori and warabi mochi] A quiet little tea café down a side street south of Hanamikoji, entered past a tiny waiting garden into a dim room with a counter and one table, birdsong and running water in the background. Order the huge Uji matcha kakigori (¥1,600) with azuki, shiratama and extra matcha syrup, or the soft warabi mochi set with a matcha latte (about ¥1,750). Some find the sets pricey and service slow. Cash only; 12:30–17:00, closed Wednesday.

roles: Not named in any source found
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2024 (Tabelog). An August 2025 reviewer describes the shop as a 90-year-old Japanese café building in Gion. Reviewers note the spring-water ice and rich matcha syrup (2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Uji matcha kakigori; warabi mochi.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 kakigori fan made this the 74th bowl of the summer and finished with hot hojicha in a ceramic pot.
A May 2026 visitor found the famous kakigori sold out and had warabi mochi instead.
A September 2026 visitor found the service slow and the ¥1,750 set a bit high.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お茶と晴ル、甘味処・かき氷、東山区祇園町南側570-125、祇園四条駅から徒歩4分、12:30〜17:00、水曜休み、予約可、12席、個室あり、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、2024年5月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): Uji 抹茶のかき氷1,600円 (湧き水の氷、小豆、白玉3つ、抹茶蜜と練乳を別添え)、わらび餅とドリンクのセット1,700円 (抹茶・抹茶ラテは1,750円)、ぜんざい、ほうじ茶800円、カウンター5席とテーブル、入口の待合の小さな庭、築90年という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; tiny room; kakigori may sell out.

places.name: カ・デル ヴィアーレ (Ca’ del Viale)
places.gf_detail: Some GF options: the official menu says gluten-free pasta made from rice flour or corn flour is available, and the group runs a gluten-free deli (AL CAMINO). Cross-contact in a kitchen making fresh wheat pasta is not addressed — ask (official site). Reviewers also had a rice-flour chocolate cake for dessert (2025).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The restaurant is known for Kyoto and organic vegetables, with vegetable marinades and seasonal vegetable plates, but most dishes use ham, cheese, egg pasta or meat, and no vegan menu is published (official site; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); Tabelog lists Wednesday to Sunday and holidays, closed Monday and Tuesday (open when a holiday falls on either); the official site gives closed every Monday (open on holidays). Dinner table charge ¥300 per person (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「ディナータイムのみテーブルチャージお一人300円」). 48 seats: a wide counter by the open kitchen and tables on the 1st floor (about 16 seated, 40 standing), and the 2nd floor for private parties of 10–24 (official site; Tabelog). Cards, iD and PayPay (Tabelog). Coin parking next door (September 2026). A white detached house on the north side of Sanjo-dori west of Senbon, with the group’s Paninoteca take-out counter at the front; 3–5 min from Nijo Stn (official site; Tabelog). Opened 1999 (official site; December 2025 review).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-dori west of Senbon, near Nijo Castle — 3 min from Nijo Stn
places.cuisine: Northern Italian, mainly Piedmontese, with Kyoto and organic vegetables, house hams and handmade pasta (official site) · antipasto Il Viale of seasonal vegetables and Italian hams ¥4,950, five antipasti ¥4,400, Kyoto mortadella (house original) ¥1,980, speck ¥2,200, cold fedelini with sea urchin ¥6,050 or caviar ¥13,200, burrata with sweet tomatoes ¥2,750, vegetable marinades ¥2,750, scallops with bottarga ¥4,730, tripe and chickpeas ¥2,200, ginger consommé ¥990 · handmade pasta such as egg-yolk tajarin; gluten-free rice- or corn-flour pasta on request (official menu, tax included) · lunch courses from ¥5,500–6,000 (2026 reviews) · seasonal European produce such as white asparagus, fresh porcini and white truffle · a large Piedmont wine list, magnum Barolo
places.notes: [Italian · Nijo, a Piedmontese ristorante with Kyoto vegetables] A white house near Nijo Station where chef Watanabe — a Piedmont wine lover who goes to the harvest there each year — has cooked northern Italian food with Kyoto and organic vegetables since 1999. Start with the showpiece platter of seasonal vegetables and house hams, then handmade pasta such as egg-yolk tajarin or cold fedelini with sea urchin, with Piedmontese wine; white truffle, porcini and white asparagus arrive in season. Gluten-free rice- or corn-flour pasta is offered. Lunch courses from about ¥5,500; ¥300 table charge at dinner.

roles: Owner-chef of the Il Viale group (株式会社イルヴィアーレ); given name not published
chef_bio.background: Per the group site: chef Watanabe first went to Italy at 21 to see Ferraris and Ducatis, was won over by the food, trained at well-known Italian restaurants in Kyoto and Tokyo, worked for a time on a farm in Kamigamo, and opened Cucina Il Viale at Horikawa-Oike in 1999; Kyoto-vegetable pasta met resistance at first ("put some bacon in it"), but ten years of keeping to it led to running five shops — Ca’ del Viale, TAVERNA il Viale, the gluten-free deli AL CAMINO, PANINOTECA and LA RISOTTERIA in the Daimaru Kyoto store; the chef goes to Piedmont every year to help with the grape harvest. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社イルヴィアーレ (NTA). Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 (Tabelog). A March 2025 reviewer found the chef cooking at the counter with an assistant.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the group site: "本当に美味しいものはいつか認められる" — truly good food is recognised in time.
chef_bio.specialty: Antipasto of Kyoto vegetables and house hams; handmade tajarin; Piedmont wine.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner was surprised to see chef Watanabe cooking at the counter despite running several shops.
An April 2026 regular was shown how to cut the extra-thick imported asparagus lengthwise with a knife.
A May 2026 diner found the vegetable assortment salty and the bread a bit dry, but loved the zucchini and pecorino pappardelle.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: il Viale の公式サイト (watanabechef.com): 本店カ・デル ヴィアーレ (本格リストランテ)、11:30〜14:00 (L.O.)・18:00〜21:30 (L.O.)、定休日 毎月曜日 (祝日は営業)、JR二条駅近くの一軒家、店先にパニーノテカ、自家製ハムと地元京都の旬の野菜の前菜、自家製手打ちパスタ、白アスパラガス・ポルチーニ茸・白トリュフ、北イタリアピエモンテ州の料理とワイン、渡辺シェフ、2階は10〜24名で貸切、メニュー (税込): イル ヴィアーレスペシャル4,950円、前菜5種盛り4,400円、京都モルタデッラ1,980円、生うにの冷たいフェッデリーニ6,050円、キャビアの冷たいフェッデリーニ13,200円、ブッラータチーズ2,750円、いろいろなお野菜のマリネ2,750円、ホタテ貝のソテー カラスミ風味4,730円、トリッパとひよこ豆のトマト煮込み2,200円、生姜風味のコンソメスープ990円、グルテンフリー 米粉・トウモロコシ粉パスタご用意、渡辺シェフの経歴 (21歳で初めてイタリアへ、京都と東京の有名イタリア料理店で修業、上賀茂の農家で畑仕事、1999年堀川御池に Cucina Il Viale を開店、現在5店舗)。食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ、中京区西ノ京千本三条西入ル北側、水〜日・祝 11:30〜14:30・18:00〜22:00、月・火休み (祝日は営業)、ディナーのみテーブルチャージ300円、48席、カード・iD・PayPay 可、インボイス T9130001040404 (株式会社イルヴィアーレ)、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2023。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語)。

cultural_comfort.note: QR-code menu (October 2026); ¥300 table charge at dinner.

gf_cross_contamination.text: No source says how the gluten-free pasta is cooked — the kitchen makes fresh wheat pasta daily, so shared water, pans and surfaces are possible; confirm with the restaurant.

positives.text: The official menu states that gluten-free pasta made from rice flour or corn flour is available (グルテンフリー 米粉、トウモロコシ粉パスタご用意ございます).

places.name: 老香港酒家京都 (Old Hong Kong Restaurant Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Cantonese dim sum, noodles, fried dishes and sauces such as black vinegar and oyster; no gluten information is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dim sum, seafood from the live tank, roast and braised meats, shark fin and abalone; a July 2026 buffet diner found few vegetable dishes (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:30 (last order 15:00), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); open every day except two building closure days a year (official site; Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: サービス料10％; official site). No same-day cancellations (Tabelog); for the dim sum buffet, call if late — after 5 minutes without notice the booking is cancelled (official site). 92 seats with 5 private rooms for 2–60 (extra fee); non-smoking (smoking room in the building); wheelchair accessible; cards, UnionPay and PayPay (Tabelog). Take-away of nearly every dish by reservation (official site). In the basement of COCON KARASUMA, directly linked to Shijo Stn exit 2 and Hankyu Karasuma Stn exit 23 (Tabelog). The group began in Kobe’s Ijinkan district; this shop opened with COCON KARASUMA in December 2004 (official site).
places.neighborhood: COCON KARASUMA basement at Shijo-Karasuma — 1 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Hong Kong-style Cantonese with dim sum carts and a live seafood tank (official site) · Hong Kong dim sum course, 90-minute order buffet from eight carts: about 15 starters, soup, 20 steamed, 10 grilled and 10 fried dim sum, Chinese vegetables, congee, noodle soup, baked sweets and desserts, ¥5,000 (children ¥2,500) · lunch courses ¥6,600 and ¥8,800; weekly chef’s lunch ¥2,280 including tax and service (official lunch page) · shark fin, dried abalone, Buddha-jumps-over-the-wall soup, kiln-roasted Peking duck, live-tank seafood (official site) · Shanghai crab in season, drunken crab, steamed soft-shelled turtle and shark fin soup, frog (2026 reviews) · weekday-evening dim sum buffet (from February 2026) · Shaoxing wine from the jar
places.notes: [Chinese · Shijo-Karasuma, Hong Kong dim sum from the carts] A big Hong Kong-style Cantonese restaurant in the basement of COCON KARASUMA, run since 2004 by a Kobe-born group whose cooks are from Hong Kong and Guangdong. The draw is the dim sum course: for ¥5,000 eight carts roll round with about sixty kinds of dim sum, congee, noodles and desserts for 90 minutes. Evenings bring shark fin, abalone, live-tank seafood, Peking duck and Shanghai crab in season. A longtime regular complains prices have doubled in two years. 10% service; open daily.

roles: 総料理長 (head chef) since 2026; with 料理相談役 劉 錦超 and general manager 陳 暁冬; operator KDA株式会社
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the restaurant began in Kobe’s Ijinkan district and opened in Kyoto with COCON KARASUMA in December 2004, operated by KDA株式会社. Head chef 陳 李富 (born 1964 in Guangdong) cooked Hong Kong food for ten years from 1982, joined 老香港酒家 after coming to Japan in 1992, became sous-chef in 2018 and head chef in 2026; culinary adviser 劉 錦超 (born 1965 in Taishan, Guangdong) joined in 2004, was head chef from 2018 and specialises in dried shark fin, abalone and shiitake, and Buddha-jumps-over-the-wall soup; general manager 陳 暁冬 (born 1972 in Beijing) says eight dim sum carts run 365 days a year and nine cooks visit Hong Kong regularly to research. Tabelog Chinese WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023 and 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the general manager on the official site: "没有最好 只有更好" — there is no best, only better.
chef_bio.specialty: Dim sum from the carts; shark fin and abalone; live-tank seafood.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on an eighth visit was shocked by a ¥45,000 bill, finding prices up 1.5 times on a year and double on two years, especially the drunken crab.
A June 2026 family arrived early on a hot day and were let in before opening time.
A May 2026 diner, still hungry after an unsatisfying meal next door, was kindly seated just for fried rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (oldhongkong-kyoto.net): 老香港酒家京都 (オールドホンコンレストランキョウト)、広東料理の伝統と最新のトレンドを融合した香港料理、活魚水槽の海鮮料理、ワゴンサービスの飲茶、香港出身の調理人、テーブルサイドで個別に盛付け、神戸異人館街が発祥、2004年12月 COCON烏丸のオープンと同時に開業、KDA株式会社、総支配人 陳暁冬 (ちん・ぎょうとう、1972年北京生まれ)、料理相談役 劉錦超 (りゅう・きんちょう、1965年広東省台山市生まれ)、総料理長 陳李富 (ちん・りふう、1964年広東省生まれ、1992年来日、2026年総料理長)、8台のワゴン、香港式飲茶コース (90分の時間制オーダーバイキング) 5,000円・小学生2,500円・幼児1,500円、昼のコース6,600円・8,800円、シェフのおまかせランチ2,280円 (税サ込)、別途サービス料10%、下京区烏丸通四条下ル水銀屋町620 COCON烏丸地下1階、ランチ11:30〜15:30 (L.O. 15:00)、ディナー17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、年中無休 (年2日の全館休館日を除く)。食べログ: 中華料理・飲茶、92席、個室5室、禁煙、車椅子可、カード・銀聯・PayPay 可、当日キャンセル不可、中国料理 WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2024。口コミ (2020〜2026年、英語)。

cultural_comfort.note: English site; large room with carts — point at what you want; 10% service.

places.name: ノスタルジア (Nostalgia)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Bar food such as omurice, canapés and smoked duck; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the dishes reviewers name — omurice, anchovy-butter canapés, smoked duck — are not vegan (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–2:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 1:59); closed only on 1 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day by phone (Tabelog). A charge of ¥330 per person (Tabelog original: 330円 under service charge and fees). 32 seats: 8 at the counter, 10 at tables, 14 on sofas, some semi-private; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi, but phone signal is weak underground (Tabelog; March–April 2026). Cards (Tabelog). Basement (B1F) of グリントランドビル on Kawaramachi north of Sanjo, down the stairs by the sign; 1 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; March 2026).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi north of Sanjo, basement — 1 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Dining bar of old bottles, vintage glasses and seasonal fresh-fruit cocktails, with food — the house recommends the omurice (Tabelog) · drinks tied to Tomihiko Morimi's novel "The Eccentric Family" (Uchoten Kazoku): "fake Denki Bran", Akadama port wine, "Benten" sparkling cocktail with gold flakes (2025–2026 reviews) · martinis, soft drinks too (2026 reviews) · omurice, smoked duck, anchovy-butter canapés (2025–2026 reviews) · all-you-can-drink plans (Tabelog) · bills about ¥4,000–6,000 (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bar · Kawaramachi Sanjo, a basement for Morimi fans] A dim, old-fashioned basement bar on Kawaramachi near City Hall, open nightly until 2 am, that has become a pilgrimage stop for fans of Tomihiko Morimi's "The Eccentric Family": order the "fake Denki Bran" and you may be shown the fans' message book, a signed card and given a postcard. Beyond that, good martinis, fresh-fruit cocktails, and an omurice and smoked duck that surprise. ¥330 charge per person; smoking allowed; weak phone signal.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: named for the wish to capture the charm of the good old days in space, service and drinks; a bar that also serves food, open from 17:00 until late, featuring old bottles, vintage glassware and "Uchoten Kazoku" (The Eccentric Family). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a guestbook for fans of the novelist Tomihiko Morimi, a signed card from the author, anime postcards for guests, artful ice and attentive service.
chef_bio.philosophy: The charm of the good old days, in the space, service and drinks (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: "Fake Denki Bran"; omurice; fresh-fruit cocktails.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 guest who ordered the Akadama drinks was asked "Are you a fan?" and given a postcard on the way out.

A September 2026 visitor came on a "pilgrimage to the sacred site of Uchoten Kazoku", was allowed to photograph the author's signed card and a bottle of fake Denki Bran, and found the omurice and smoked duck "surprisingly authentic".
"It's located in the basement, so the signal is poor and it's hard to connect to the internet." — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・イタリアン・バル、中京区河原町三条上ル下丸屋町406 グリントランドビルB1F、市役所前駅から徒歩1分、毎日 17:00〜翌2:00 (料理L.O.23:00、ドリンクL.O.1:59)、1月1日のみ休み、予約可、330円 (サービス料・チャージ欄)、32席 (カウンター8、テーブル10、ソファ14)、喫煙可、Wi-Fi、カード可、昔の良さを空間・サービス・品で表した店、おすすめはオムライス、季節のフルーツカクテル、オールドボトル、ヴィンテージグラス、「Uchoten Kazoku」、ベジタリアン対応あり。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): Tomihiko Morimi ファンの聖地、Gisei Denki Bran、Akadama、Benten、メッセージ帳、サイン色紙、ポストカード、マティーニ、スモークダック、アンチョビバターのカナッペ、地下で電波が弱い。

cultural_comfort.note: Basement bar; ¥330 charge per person; smoking allowed; weak phone signal; cards accepted.

places.name: オステリア イタリアーナ セブン・エンバーズ (Osteria Italiana Seven Embers)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Southern Italian menu of wood-fired pizza, handmade pasta, bread and tiramisu; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but courses centre on cheese, seafood, pork ragù, beef and steak (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Prices include tax and service (Tabelog original 表示料金には税金・サービス料が含まれております). Lunch course about ¥4,500 (November 2025); dinner course ¥7,500 (December 2025). 64 seats; non-smoking (hotel smoking area); wheelchair accessible; children welcome, kids' menu (Tabelog). Cards incl. UnionPay (Tabelog). English menu with photos and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Hotel parking ¥350 per 30 min, 2 hours for ¥500 when spending ¥3,000 (Tabelog). Ground floor of Hilton Kyoto, Kawaramachi north of Sanjo; 2 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Hilton Kyoto, Kawaramachi north of Sanjo — 2 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Southern Italian osteria of Hilton Kyoto, by chef Mariangela Ruggero: family recipes, naturally leavened pizza from a wood-fired oven, handmade pasta and seasonal local ingredients (Tabelog) · lunch course of antipasti, pasta and dessert, about ¥4,500 (November 2025); dinner course ¥7,500 (December 2025) · e.g. Southern Italian antipasti with Awaji cheese, cavatelli with Kyotanba pork ragù (December 2025); Omi beef Bolognese, tiramisu (2026 reviews) · bistecca of about 1 kg, T-bone steak, Margherita (December 2025; September 2026) · bread with olive oil served freely (2026 reviews) · Italian craft beer and wine (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Hilton Kyoto, Southern Italian family cooking] The Hilton Kyoto's ground-floor osteria, where chef Mariangela Ruggero cooks the food of Southern Italy from family recipes: wood-fired pizza, handmade cavatelli with Kyotanba pork ragù, Omi beef Bolognese, a big tiramisu and kilo-scale bistecca or T-bone. Lunch courses about ¥4,500, dinner ¥7,500, tax and service included. Open kitchen, relaxed for a hotel, family-friendly; English spoken. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the Italian restaurant of Hilton Kyoto, with cooking by chef Mariangela Ruggero, honoured by the Italian government as an "Ambassador of UNESCO World Heritage Italian Cuisine"; recipes handed down from the nonna, naturally leavened wood-fired pizza and handmade pasta. A December 2025 reviewer described the dinner course as the warm flavours of Puglia, with the chef's grandmother's ragù.
chef_bio.philosophy: Warmth and passion of Italy; recipes passed down from the nonna (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wood-fired pizza; cavatelli with pork ragù.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner, unable to forget a bistecca eaten in Italy, ordered the 1-kilo steak here — Australian beef, delicious for the price but a little sinewy.
"The bread was served continuously, and we enjoyed it with delicious olive oil and salt." — February 2026.
A July 2026 couple celebrating a silver anniversary filled up on pasta and pizza before the main course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン、中京区下丸屋町416 ヒルトン京都1F、市役所前駅から徒歩2分、毎日 11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、予約可、表示料金は税・サービス料込み、64席、禁煙、車椅子可、子ども可・キッズメニュー、カード可 (銀聯も)、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、駐車場あり、シェフ Mariangela Ruggero (イタリア政府から "Ambassador of UNESCO World Heritage Italian Cuisine" に)、祖母から受け継ぐレシピ、薪窯の天然酵母ピッツァ、手打ちパスタ、旬の地元食材。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): ランチコース4,500円ほど、ディナーコース7,500円、南イタリアの前菜盛り合わせ、Kyotanba の豚のラグーのカヴァテッリ、Omi beef のボロネーゼ、ティラミス、1kg のビステッカ、Tボーンステーキ、マルゲリータ、パンとオリーブオイルはおかわり自由。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); prices include tax and service; cards accepted.

places.name: ル・キャトーズィエム (le 14e)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Steaks pan-cooked and served with salt and fries or potatoes, alongside bread, salads, pâté and charcuterie; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a steak bistro — wagyu by the 100 g, duck confit, pâté, charcuterie and cheese-topped salads (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 18:00–23:00; Saturday and holidays 17:00–23:00; last order 21:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog) — book well ahead, two Saturday sittings (April 2025). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats: 6 at tables, 4 at the counter, up a steep staircase (Tabelog; February 2026). Takeaway by reservation since March 2020 (Tabelog). Second floor of ポガンビル on Kawaramachi near Marutamachi; 1 min walk from the Kawaramachi Marutamachi bus stop, 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 20 February 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi Marutamachi, 2nd floor — 5 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: French steak bistro: the day's cuts of wagyu and other rare beef, shown at the table and chosen by origin, cut and weight (110 g to 300 g+), at about ¥3,000 per 100 g, pan-cooked in the French manner and served with salt and fries or potatoes (2025–2026 reviews) · e.g. Yamagata Keisan black wagyu ribeye, Kaku wagyu, strip loin, inner thigh, outside skirt (2025–2026 reviews) · burrata with fresh tomato ¥2,700, Hokkaido duck leg confit ¥2,800, pasture-raised pork pâté ¥1,800 (July 2025) · "foodie salad" loaded with charcuterie, marinated ishidai, salami, a strawberry nougat-glacé-style dessert (2025–2026 reviews) · wine by the glass (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Steak bistro · Kawaramachi Marutamachi, beef by the 100 g] A ten-seat French bistro up a steep stair at Kawaramachi Marutamachi, opened in 2013 by chef Shigeno Makoto, once of a Roppongi wine bar: the day's wagyu cuts are brought to the table, you choose origin, cut and weight at about ¥3,000 per 100 g, and the steak comes pan-cooked, salted, with fries. Burrata, duck confit, a charcuterie-heavy salad and glass wines round it out. French spoken. Cash only. Book well ahead. Closed Wednesday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: "This small restaurant was opened by Chef Shigeno Makoto, who also worked as the chef at Wine Bar Shozui in Roppongi"; opened 20 February 2013. Reviewers describe a chef fluent in French (June 2025), a taste for Black music (November 2025), staff explaining the cuts and origins before cooking (July 2026), and a steak technique "that resembles frying", served with salt (November 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu by the 100 g, pan-cooked; burrata.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner's French friend, long unable to get a booking, was delighted to finally eat here — and impressed by the chef's French.
A September 2026 visitor had wanted to come since seeing it in a Kansai meat magazine ten years earlier, as a student without the money.
"I totally relate to the chef's taste in black music." — November 2025.
A February 2026 guest felt it was "still too early" — the sirloin came within ten minutes, faster than the bistecca the guest had expected.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビストロ・ステーキ、上京区伊勢屋町393-3 ポガンビル2F、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩5分、河原町丸太町バス停から徒歩1分、月・火・木・金 18:00〜23:00、土・祝 17:00〜23:00、L.O.21:00、水・日休み、予約可、現金のみ、10席 (テーブル6、カウンター4)、2020年3月からテイクアウト (予約制)、2013年2月20日オープン、六本木のワインバー Shozui のシェフだった Shigeno Makoto が開いた店。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年9月、英語): 肉を見せて産地・部位・量を選ぶ、100g 3,000円ほど、フランス式に焼いて塩で、フライドポテト、Yamagata Keisan の黒毛和牛のリブロース、ブッラータ2,700円、鴨のコンフィ2,800円、パテ1,800円、シャルキュトリーのサラダ、シェフはフランス語が堪能、急な階段。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; book well ahead; choose your cut and weight at the table; steep stairs.

places.name: 仁王門 無為 (Niomon Mui)
places.gf_detail: Ask. À la carte kappo with tempura, crab spring rolls, ponzu, simmered and grilled dishes and red miso soup; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-focused kappo of sashimi, grilled fish, eel, duck, Murazawa beef and dashi dishes (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 17:00–23:00, last seating 21:30; closed Sunday, open on holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, same-day too — call if online shows full (Tabelog; November 2025). Seat-only bookings choose dishes on the day; seat-only bookings are not accepted for guests coming from overseas (Tabelog). No children under elementary-school age (Tabelog). The menu shows no prices (March and May 2026); reviewers spent ¥15,000–49,999. 8 counter seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; BYO possible (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). On Niomon-dori near Chomyo-ji; 4 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Keihan), 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog). Opened 21 July 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Niomon-dori near Chomyo-ji — 4 min walk from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Counter kappo serving dishes one at a time, à la carte or as a course, cooked to each guest's taste from the season's ingredients — charcoal grilling and tempura, Murazawa beef from southern Nagano, sake flights (Tabelog) · a start of three small dishes, then à la carte (November 2025; March 2026) · e.g. grilled yellowtail, grouper and squid, ankimo with ponzu (October 2025); shirako, tuna, squid and sea urchin, crab and yellow-leek spring rolls, grilled sea bream with scales (November 2025); grilled duck, buri daikon, straw-grilled yellowtail (January 2026); uzaku (March 2026); red miso soup with a soft egg, grilled ayu, hamo (May–August 2026) · sake and wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kappo · Niomon-dori, à la carte at the counter] An eight-seat counter near Chomyo-ji and the Kamo river where two cooks serve Kyoto dishes one by one, à la carte: three small starters, then whatever you fancy — straw-grilled yellowtail, crab spring rolls, scaled sea bream, uzaku, charcoal-grilled ayu — with Murazawa beef and sake flights. Open late, last seating 21:30. The menu shows no prices; one May 2026 guest found the bill about ¥10,000 over expectations. No under-6s. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a traditional kappo near Chomyo-ji, known for its Niomon gate statues by Unkei; dishes are not pre-set but prepared from seasonal ingredients to the guest's preference and served individually; opened 21 July 2021. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a relaxed, kind owner who takes requests, a second cook at the grill, and a shop "run by just two people" (May 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients cooked the way each guest prefers, served individually (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte kappo; charcoal grilling; Murazawa beef.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 regular opened four bottles of wine over the evening, pairing an Alsace Riesling with ankimo in ponzu.
"The absence of prices on the menu allowed me to enjoy my meal freely, driven by curiosity." — March 2026.
A May 2026 guest titled the review "Not worth the price": the food was good, but with no prices listed, the bill came to about ¥10,000 more than expected.

The menu is on the wall without prices (March 2025). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). In a narrow lane by Tatsumi Shrine, Gion Shirakawa; 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Gion Shirakawa, by Tatsumi Shrine — 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Small one-person hot pots, about 15 kinds, in a light Kyoto dashi (2024–26 reviews) · yuba hot pot with soy milk, finished by adding nigari to set fresh tofu in the pot; Kujo green onion with chicken, pork or yuba; hamo; pork and molokhia; yellowtail shabu-shabu (2024–26 reviews) · obanzai: moist okara with yuzu, "elevator" of fried tofu with grated daikon, dashimaki with daikon sauce, Isakichi salad with plum dressing, stewed umanohana (2024–26 reviews) · fried chicken skin with sansho, fried flatfish, fried small potatoes with sansho salt (2025 reviews) · about ¥5,000–10,000 a head; two people paid ¥14,800 (November 2025)
places.notes: [Hot pot · Gion Shirakawa, small pots till 3 a.m.] A tiny counter in a lane by Tatsumi Shrine, over 30 years old, serving one-person hot pots in a gentle Kyoto dashi — yuba in soy milk that ends as fresh tofu, Kujo green onion with chicken, hamo in season — with obanzai like the much-praised okara. Open until 3:00, a favourite late stop. The owner cooks largely alone, so service can be slow when full. Cash only; smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-cook (unnamed), running the shop largely alone (November 2025, October 2026)
chef_bio.background: A November 2024 reviewer says the restaurant has been open over 30 years; a February 2025 diner had known it for 20 years. Reviewers describe the owner cooking almost single-handed (November 2025, October 2026) and chatting with regulars; a November 2025 diner came after hearing it recommended on the TV show "Futtou Word 10".
chef_bio.specialty: Small hot pots; okara.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 diner on a full holiday weekend found the gaps between dishes far too long, and two items ordered never came.
An October 2026 regular says the owner may seem unfriendly but is a good person, and suggests helping by refilling drinks when the owner is busy.
A September 2024 diner liked the okara so much that there were second helpings and some to take home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鍋・日本料理・創作料理、東山区祇園花見小路新橋西入巽小路上ル、祇園四条駅から約400m、月〜土 18:00〜翌3:00、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、16席、カウンターと座敷、喫煙可。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年10月、英語): Tatsumi 神社の前の細い路地、30年以上、約15種の小鍋、湯葉と豆乳の鍋はにがりで豆腐に、九条ねぎ、鱧、おから、elevator (揚げと大根おろし)、品書きに値段なし、ほぼ一人で営む店主、テレビで紹介、提供が遅く注文が抜けたという声 (2025年11月)、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; read the menu on the wall; bring cash; be patient when it is full.

places.name: 乍旨司 (Sashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi is dressed piece by piece with sauces such as garlic soy and natto, and there are fried dishes and sushi rolls (2026 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; obanzai and dishes use dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 17:00–22:30; Sat–Sun 15:00–22:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; usually full, so book ahead by phone (Tabelog; September 2026). 20 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Near Nijo Castle, 454 m from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 7 July 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Nijo Castle — 454 m from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Seafood izakaya with a seasonal menu (2026 reviews) · sashimi platter served without soy and wasabi — each piece seasoned, e.g. tuna with natto sauce, marinated tuna, salt-seared swordfish, bonito with salt (2026 reviews) · signature "namida uni" roll heaped with sea urchin, tekka, negitoro and grilled-eel rolls, sea-urchin gunkan, toro-taku (2026 reviews) · assorted obanzai that change between visits, fried horse mackerel with parsley sauce, abalone-liver soy, chicken chashu with egg, charcoal-grilled chicken, grilled hamo, egg tofu with hamo roe, simmered octopus (2025–26 reviews) · soy beans and niboshi with cumin as snacks; seasonal sake chosen to taste (2026 reviews) · about ¥5,000–10,000 a head (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Nijo Castle, sashimi seasoned piece by piece] A busy neighbourhood izakaya near Nijo Castle where the sashimi comes without soy and wasabi — each slice has its own seasoning, like tuna with natto sauce or salt-seared swordfish — and the signature roll is buried in sea urchin. Add the changing obanzai, fried horse mackerel and seasonal sake picked to your taste. About ¥5,000–10,000. Book ahead; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 July 2019 (Tabelog). An April 2026 visitor came on the recommendation of a Pontocho chef; reviewers praise the care in each dish and the seasonal sake (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasoned sashimi platter; namida uni roll.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, there for the uni sushi, wished the floor service were more attentive given the chefs’ effort, and was unsure about returning.
An August 2026 diner went back within a week and found the obanzai and sashimi platter already changed.
A May 2026 diner was asked about preferences before each sake was poured.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、中京区西大黒町336-10、二条城前駅から454m、月火木金 17:00〜22:30、土日 15:00〜22:00、水曜休み、予約可、20席、禁煙、カード・交通系IC・PayPay 可、2019年7月7日オープン。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 二条城の近く、醤油とわさびではなく一切れずつ味付けした刺身の盛り合わせ、名物の Namida Uni の巻き、鉄火巻き、おばんざいの盛り合わせ、鯵フライのパセリソース、季節の日本酒、いつも満席、ホールの接客に不満という声 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; order à la carte; sake chosen to your taste; cards, IC and PayPay.

places.name: フィオリスカ (Fiorisca)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses centre on handmade pasta — tagliolini, tagliatelle, ravioli, gnocchi — plus fried dough and baked sweets (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-led courses, but with seafood, meat and cheese, e.g. a gorgonzola mousse and pork terrine (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 and dinner 18:00–21:30; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day bookings sometimes possible (Tabelog; October 2025). Lunch courses about ¥3,000–5,000; dinner courses under ¥9,000 to about ¥10,000; a 10-dish course with two drinks ¥9,800 via Ikkyu (2024–26 reviews). 15 seats, mainly a counter; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards, no e-money (Tabelog). Quiet residential street a few minutes north of Oike, 7 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; January 2026). Opened 20 March 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: North of Oike — 7 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Italian courses of seasonal Kyoto vegetables and seafood with handmade pasta (2025–26 reviews) · lunch: soup, assorted antipasti, two handmade pastas, fish or meat, dessert — e.g. white-fish tagliatelle, gnocchi, pork or pan-seared sawara, passion-fruit gelato (October 2026) · dinner of about 10 dishes: daikon soup, gorgonzola mousse with anpo persimmon, cauliflower blancmange with white sesame, Goto Islands yellowtail tartare, two pastas, fish, meat, dessert and baked sweets (January and April 2026) · a "rare pasta" three-pasta course (October 2026) · Italian wines (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Karasuma Oike, a couple's counter of Kyoto vegetables] A small counter on a quiet street north of Oike, opened in 2012 and now run by a couple, cooking gentle, vegetable-led Italian with seafood and handmade pasta — a pure daikon soup, cauliflower blancmange, two pastas, then fish or meat. Lunch courses about ¥3,000–5,000, dinner around ¥9,000–10,000. One diner found the pasta portions small in the three-pasta course. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Run by a couple (October 2025 review); names not given
chef_bio.background: Opened 20 March 2012 (Tabelog). An October 2025 diner found the couple running the restaurant serving quickly and efficiently; a September 2026 regular came on the recommendation of a chef at a well-known Kyoto restaurant.
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable and seafood courses; handmade pasta.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner found the pasta portions small in the three-pasta course, with gnocchi-like dishes counted as pasta.
A December 2024 host was grateful the restaurant took a small group late at night.
A September 2026 regular hopes it stays easy to book.

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course; counter seating; cards accepted.

places.name: 祇をん 段ばた (Gion Danbata)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-based courses with handmade pasta, bread, mapo sauce and fried dishes; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dashi is katsuobushi and Rishiri kombu, and courses include fish and wagyu (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Wed–Sun 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:00) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 19:00); closed every Monday and every other Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservation only. Tabelog states: "We do not accept reservations from foreign customers due to our limited English skills. In the unlikely event that a reservation is made, we will take the liberty of canceling it." Courses: lunch ¥10,000, dinner ¥15,000–18,000, tax included (Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし" (its English says a fee may be added). 10 seats: 6 at the counter, 1 table for 4; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking; BYO allowed; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). In a machiya down a narrow alley off Hanamikoji south of Shijo; 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Gion, off Hanamikoji south of Shijo — 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Genre-free courses that change completely every two weeks with the 24 solar terms, on a dashi of top katsuobushi and Rishiri kombu, mixing French, Italian and Chinese techniques (Tabelog) · lunch ¥10,000, dinner ¥15,000–18,000 (Tabelog) · in reviews: consommé soups, amadai with crisp scales and mapo or cabbage sauce, kadaif-wrapped mushroom duxelles, handmade pasta (crab, octopus and kohlrabi), Ehime sirloin, a choice of rice dishes with refills — chirimen-jako, soy-simmered wagyu, lemon-egg fried rice, mapo tofu — and homemade pudding, matcha and nerikiri (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Genre-free courses · Gion off Hanamikoji] A ten-seat machiya counter where a husband-and-wife team cooks Japanese-rooted courses with French, Italian and Chinese touches, changing every two weeks with the solar terms. Lunch ¥10,000, dinner from ¥15,000. Note: the shop states on Tabelog that it does not accept bookings from foreign customers, because of limited English, and will cancel any that are made. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed in the sources), with a spouse who makes the desserts (2025–26 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 September 2018 (Tabelog). Per 2025–26 reviews: a couple runs the restaurant together — the chef cooks and the spouse makes the desserts (May 2025; May 2026); a September 2026 reviewer speaks of "the chefs" at the counter, so other staff are not ruled out.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: playful dishes that invite new flavours, reflecting the 24 solar terms.
chef_bio.specialty: Crisp-scaled amadai; rice dishes with refills.

anecdotes.text: On a solo birthday lunch in August 2025, the couple timed each dish to the diner's own pace.
A September 2026 regular came across town from Kitano Tenmangu just for lunch, and had seconds of the homemade bread.
A first-time June 2026 guest found everyone started at noon, but the pace was adjusted to each table.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 祇をん 段ばた、イノベーティブ・フレンチ・イタリアン、東山区祇園町南側570-128、祇園四条駅から徒歩約6分、水〜日 12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 13:00)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 19:00)、毎週月曜と隔週火曜休み、完全予約制、英語が話せないため海外の客の予約は受けず、予約があった場合はキャンセルする、ランチ10,000円・ディナー15,000〜18,000円 (税込)、サービス料: なし、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル1)、2018年9月1日オープン、二十四節気で2週間ごとに替わるコース、上質な鰹節と Rishiri 昆布の出汁、フレンチ・イタリアン・中華の技法。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営む、奥様のデザート、甘鯛の鱗焼き、手打ちパスタ、レモン卵炒飯、麻婆豆腐、ちりめんじゃこ、プリン、抹茶と練り切り。

cultural_comfort.note: Tabelog says the shop does not accept bookings from foreign customers (limited English) and cancels any made; reservation only.

places.name: 京都さしみ丸 (Kyoto Sashimi Maru)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, tempura, fried fish, gratin and spring rolls; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood, wagyu and game (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 15:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); 15:00–17:00 by advance booking only; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Service charge 3% — Tabelog's Japanese original: "サービス料3%". The food menu shows no prices; the drinks list does (December 2025; July 2026). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards, IC cards, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). In "Momiji no Koji", a 100-year-old machiya alley of small restaurants; 8 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn, 10 min from Kawaramachi (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Between Shijo and Gojo, west of the Kamo River — 8 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal kaiseki-level dishes à la carte or as a small omakase: fish from the ports, black wagyu and game, donabe rice; six champagnes (Tabelog) · in reviews: sashimi platters (shima-aji, ishigaki-dai, octopus, straw-smoked first bonito), tempura of large red shrimp, cold chawanmushi, sirloin-cap sukiyaki, thick-cut fried tuna with tartare, fried horse mackerel, rock-oyster gratin, Sichuan-pepper wagyu, cod-milt spring rolls, green curry, crab in vinegar, junsai (2025–26 reviews) · one diner's 15 items with four drinks came to ¥14,000 (July 2026)
places.notes: [Seafood kappo · Momiji no Koji between Shijo and Gojo] Despite the casual name, an eight-seat counter in a century-old machiya alley serving kaiseki-level dishes à la carte — straw-smoked bonito, red-shrimp tempura, rock-oyster gratin, even green curry. The food menu has no prices; expect ¥8,000–15,000 plus 3% service. Closed Sunday.

roles: Chef (unnamed; one cook per a September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 16 October 2019 (Tabelog). Per the operator: in "Momiji no Koji", a renovated machiya over 100 years old, serving seasonal kaiseki of port-fresh seafood, black wagyu and game with donabe rice.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi; red-shrimp tempura.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 New Year's Eve diner found it "a bit nerve-wracking" that the food menu listed no prices.
Kept waiting in May 2026, a diner was given simmered bamboo shoots as an apology.
A September 2026 regular felt rushed with only one person cooking, and wished the dishes used fewer repeat ingredients.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 京都さしみ丸、居酒屋・海鮮・天ぷら、下京区石不動之町682-7 もみじの小路S-3、清水五条駅から徒歩8分、月〜土 15:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00、ドリンク L.O. 22:30)、15:00〜17:00は事前予約のみ、日曜休み、サービス料3%、8席 (カウンター)、2019年10月16日オープン、築100年超の町家を改装した「もみじの小路」、漁港直送の魚介、黒毛和牛、ジビエ、土鍋ご飯、シャンパン6種。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 料理の品書きに値段がない、刺身の盛り合わせ、大海老の天ぷら、冷やし茶碗蒸し、マグロのフライ、岩牡蠣のグラタン、白子の春巻き、グリーンカレー、一人で調理。

cultural_comfort.note: No prices on the food menu; 3% service; book for 15:00–17:00.

places.name: 焼野菜 五十家 (Yaki Yasai Isoya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled vegetables with miso, ponzu and soy-based sauces, quesadillas and fried rice; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables are the focus, but most plates pair them with squid, pork, chicken, tuna, fish, cheese or a soy-milk dashimaki; ask what can be made without (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00 daily (last order 22:30), closing days not fixed (Tabelog); the official site gives 17:00–23:00 every day. Bookings online through the official site or by phone; seat-only bookings (official site; Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original: "サービス料・チャージなし。". About 20 seats at a curved counter (November 2026); Tabelog lists smoking as allowed; JCB, AMEX and Diners; QR payments (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi south of Oike; 1 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Oike — 1 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Teppan-grilled seasonal vegetables from the 五十棲農園 farm and partner farms, listed on a blackboard and paired with sauces and a little meat or fish (official site; Tabelog) · menu examples: "infinite tomato" with tuna, shiso and citrus ponzu ¥500, yodare-dori with farm herbs and dukkah ¥850, soy-milk dashimaki ¥750 (official site) · in reviews: arugula with miso-marinated squid, Kamo eggplant with sweet miso, Kujo negi with pork belly and spices, lotus root with saba-miso cream cheese, kiwi and nama-yuba in white miso, daikon miso dengaku, lotus-root quesadilla, fried rice to finish; vegetable sours, red-shiso soda and vegetable juice (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Grilled-vegetable izakaya · Kiyamachi by Kyoto City Hall] A stylish curved counter where seasonal vegetables from the owner's family farm are grilled on the teppan and paired with clever sauces — arugula with miso squid, Kamo eggplant with sweet miso, lotus root with saba-miso cream cheese — plus vegetable sours. About ¥3,000–6,000; no service charge. Open nightly.

roles: Operator: the 五十家 group (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: vegetables from 五十棲農園, described as the owner's family source, and partner farms. Reviewers call it a shop of "the Isoya group" with other sister restaurants (2026 reviews); a Tabelog review says the group runs seven shops in Kyoto, and our record kyoto_sumizumido_hachijo describes 炭棲堂 as "a new concept from the izakaya group 五十家". An October 2026 reviewer first came about ten years ago.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: "Let us grill seasonal vegetables for you."
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan-grilled vegetables with sauces.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner liked the small portions, which made it easy to try many dishes, and the avocado sour.
An October 2026 visitor returned after about ten years, remembering the first visit.
A non-drinker in October 2026 ordered a soda of red shiso from Ohara.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yakiyasai-isoya.com): 焼野菜 五十家、中京区木屋町通御池下ル下丸屋町421-5 ラディーチェ・マツヤビル 1F、17:00〜23:00 (毎日)、五十棲農園の野菜、無限トマト (ツナ・大葉と柑橘ポン酢) 500円、よだれ鶏 (農園ハーブと自家製デュカ) 850円、豆乳だしまき750円、オンラインか電話で予約、席のみの予約。食べログ: 野菜料理・鉄板焼き、京都市役所前駅から徒歩1分、17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、不定休、サービス料・チャージなし、喫煙可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): ルッコラとイカの味噌漬け、賀茂なすの甘味噌、九条ねぎと豚バラ、蓮根と鯖味噌クリームチーズ、大根の味噌田楽、締めの炒飯、野菜のサワー、約20席の曲線のカウンター、五十家グループ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; blackboard menu changes with the season.

places.name: ルラション (RELATION)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Bistro plates with sauces, gratin and baguette; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: terrine, steak, lamb, escargot and butter (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 20:30); Thu dinner only; closed Wednesday; lunch bookings until 13:00 (Tabelog). Popular — book; fish can sell out at lunch (2026 reviews). BYO wine at dinner, ¥1,000 per bottle (Tabelog). 16 seats: counter and tables; children welcome; non-smoking; cards, nanaco, iD, Rakuten Pay and au PAY (Tabelog). On Sakaimachi-dori south of Aneyakoji; 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi-dori south of Aneyakoji — 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood French bistro with big portions: lunch sets of steak (about 140 g, ¥1,600–1,650), fish or the C course with appetizers and dessert; a ¥3,300 dinner prix-fixe with a starter and main (2026 reviews) · Daisen chicken and liver terrine ¥990, escargot simmered in white wine, beef tendon or beef stew in red wine, Bolognese with potato gratin, grilled lamb, chilled corn soup, warm baguette with plenty of butter, gâteau chocolat, blancmange; wine by the glass from ¥600 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [French bistro · Sakaimachi near Karasuma-Oike] A neighbourhood bistro marking 25 years in 2026, loved for generous, cheap French cooking: steak lunch about ¥1,650, a huge chicken-liver terrine, escargot, and a ¥3,300 dinner prix-fixe. BYO wine ¥1,000 at dinner. Often full — book. Closed Wednesday; no lunch Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a bistro celebrating its 25th anniversary in 2026 and long loved by locals (August–September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken-liver terrine; steak lunch.

anecdotes.text: A twelve-time regular got a booking only two days ahead for the 25th-anniversary year — August 2026.
A September 2026 couple sharing the dinner set had each dish split onto two plates.
The water kept coming, and an October 2026 lunch guest chatted on until closing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ルラション (RELATION)、フレンチ・ステーキ、中京区堺町通姉小路下ル大阪材木町687、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、月火金土日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 20:30)、木曜は夜のみ、水曜休み、ランチ予約は13時まで、16席、子供可、禁煙、ワイン持ち込み可 (夜のみ、1本1,000円)。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 25周年、ステーキランチ1,600〜1,650円、鶏のテリーヌ (Daisen chicken) 990円、エスカルゴ、ボロネーゼとポテトグラタン、仔羊、ディナーセット3,300円、グラスワイン600円、ガトーショコラ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; casual and family-friendly.

places.name: Affinage (アフィナージュ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A wine bar whose food runs to quiche, naturally leavened bread, cheese, prosciutto, potage and braised beef cheek (2025–2026 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cheese, prosciutto, quiche and beef dishes (2025–2026 reviews); the fruit cocktails are plain fruit and spirits — ask.
places.hours_raw: Official site: Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–01:00 (L.O. 0:00); closed Monday; bookings by phone (official site), also online on Tabelog — if online shows full, call (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners per Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Glass wine at a flat ¥3,500 (November 2025, May 2026), up from ¥1,500 (July 2026 regular); dishes from ¥500 (July 2026). Opened 11 March 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion Shirakawa, on Hanamikoji north of Shinmonzen — 10 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Wine bar on the Shirakawa: Champagne and wine by the glass, a flat ¥3,500 a glass (2025–2026 reviews), and seasonal whole-fruit cocktails — strawberry, melon, apple (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · food from ¥500: cheese platter, quiche (oyster and cheese Lorraine), naturally leavened bread, prosciutto sliced to order, potage, homemade cheesecake (2025–2026 reviews) · the "Kojikoji" set of five: amuse, quiche, potage, beef cheek bourguignon or fish, dessert or cheese (May 2025)
places.notes: [Wine bar · Gion Shirakawa, one-man counter till 1 am] A seven-seat counter cut from a single slab of rock, on the Shirakawa, where the owner, working alone, pours French wine at a flat ¥3,500 a glass and makes whole-fruit cocktails — melon, strawberry, apple — and surprisingly good food: quiche, cheese, beef cheek bourguignon. Regulars praise the gentle, attentive master and the music; a July 2026 regular regrets that the glass price rose from ¥1,500. Gion mamas drink here (October 2026). Closed Monday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yukinori Kojima (from the Instagram account yukinori_kojima_kyoto linked on the official site; reviews call the master Mr. Kojima; no kanji in a source)
roles: Owner and only staff (July 2026: "despite being run by a single person")
chef_bio.origin: From Aomori, per an April 2026 review ("A wine bar run by a proprietor from Aomori").
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a wine bar on the bank of the Gion Shirakawa serving Champagne and wine by the glass and cocktails of seasonal fruit; the name Affinage means "maturing" — the owner hopes the bar, the owner and the guests will mature over 10, 20, 30 years like a fine wine. Opened 11 March 2011 (Tabelog). A July 2026 regular says the set name "Coji Coji" comes from the master’s name.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: a bar to ease the day’s tiredness and restore energy for tomorrow; 「マリアージュ（出会い）から アフィナージュ（熟成）へ」.
chef_bio.specialty: Whole-fruit cocktails; wine by the glass; quiche.

anecdotes.text: "I think one downside is that the price for glass wine has increased from JPY 1500 to JPY 3500 across the board." — July 2026, a regular on a fourth visit.
"It’s one of the bars frequented by the mamas of Gion." — October 2026.
An April 2026 guest booked the same day and came in at 10 pm after work for a strawberry cocktail, carrot soup and red wine.
A May 2025 guest came back after eight years for the five-course Kojikoji set and a melon-and-Champagne cocktail.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (affinage-kyoto.com): Affinage、祇園白川のほとりのワインバー、シャンパーニュとワインをグラスで、季節のフルーツのカクテル、店名は熟成の意味で、店も店主もお客様も10年、20年、30年と熟成していきたい、1日の疲れを癒し明日の元気を取り戻すバーを目指す、グラスワインは時々で変わる、カード可、店内全面禁煙、予約は電話、東山区花見小路通新門前上ル東側 花見会館汀館1F、火〜日・祝 17:00〜1:00 (0:00 L.O.)、月曜休み、店主の Instagram (yukinori_kojima_kyoto)。食べログ: ワインバー、東山区中之町244-1、7席、ネットで空きがなければ電話を、2011年3月11日オープン。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 一人で営業、青森出身の店主、一枚岩のカウンター、フルーツカクテル (苺、メロン、林檎)、グラスワインは一律3,500円 (以前は1,500円)、料理は500円から、チーズ盛り合わせ、キッシュ、天然酵母のパン、目の前で切る生ハム、自家製チーズケーキ、コジコジのセット5品、牛頬肉の赤ワイン煮、音楽、祇園のママたちが通う。

cultural_comfort.note: A seven-seat counter run by one person; book by phone, or call if online shows full.

places.name: IL TESORO (イル テゾーロ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; courses centre on pasta (squid ink, cold crab, anago with Kujo leeks), three homemade breads and a pork cutlet (2024–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of duck, fish, pork spare ribs, cutlet, burrata and crab pasta (2024–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 11:45–14:30 (L.O. 13:30) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Wednesday and the first and third Thursdays. Bookings taken. 12 seats, counter and tables, up steep stairs (September 2025); non-smoking; cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. A December 2025 regular says it moved here from Shijo-Karasuma.
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-dori east of Yanagibamba, upstairs under an Italian flag — 10 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Italian set lunches and dinners with a long pasta list · lunch course ¥3,850 (September 2025): appetizer plate, soup, three homemade breads, a choice of pasta and main, dessert · pastas: cold crab pasta with orange (a regulars’ favourite), squid ink (+¥440), anago and Kujo leeks · mains: Kyoto-raised "Moti Pork" spare-rib confit, Yonezawa pork cutlet, roast sea bass, venison · caprese of fruit tomato and burrata (2024–2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Sanjo-dori, up the stairs] Look for the Italian flag on Sanjo-dori and climb steep stairs to a twelve-seat room with an old coffee-house feel. Set lunches start with a lavish appetizer plate and three homemade breads, then a choice from a long pasta list — the cold crab pasta is the regulars’ pick — and mains like spare-rib confit or a crisp pork cutlet. Portions are big. A September 2025 diner found it generous but ordinary. Cash only. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog introduces a hidden Italian restaurant on the second floor of a building on Sanjo-dori, marked by an Italian flag. A December 2025 regular has followed it since it was at Shijo-Karasuma; a March 2025 diner likens the room to an old coffee house.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tabelog introduction: Italian food for grown-ups, made with good ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: Cold pasta; homemade breads; set lunch.

anecdotes.text: Asked what to order, the staff told a May 2025 diner that many regulars choose the cold pasta.
"Everything had a homemade touch and was made with care, but overall it felt quite ordinary." — September 2025.
A September 2024 diner’s friend was given a birthday plate on the house.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: IL TESORO (イル テゾーロ)、イタリアン・パスタ・ダイニングバー、中京区三条通柳馬場東入中之町6 三条有本ビル2F、月火木〜日 11:45〜14:30 (L.O. 13:30)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、水曜と第1・第3木曜休み、予約可、12席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、ビルの2階の隠れ家、三条通のイタリア国旗が目印、良い食材の大人のイタリアン。口コミ (2024年6月〜2025年12月、英語): ランチ3,850円、前菜の盛り合わせ、自家製パン3種、冷製パスタ (蟹とオレンジ)、イカスミ (+440円)、穴子と九条ねぎ、京都産の Moti Pork のスペアリブのコンフィ、Yonezawa のポークのカツレツ、スズキのロースト、鹿肉、フルーツトマトとブッラータのカプレーゼ、量が多い、昔の喫茶店のような店内、急な階段、四条烏丸から移転、誕生日プレート、普通だったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses with choices; staff suggest dishes (May 2025); cash only.

places.name: 京都祇園 おかる (Kyoto Gion Okaru)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon in a curry or ankake broth (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every broth is a dashi of mackerel, urume and bonito flakes with kombu (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Thu 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–02:00; Fri until 02:30; Sat until 03:00; Sun 11:00–15:00 only; hours may change. No reservations; shared tables at busy times (October 2026). 37 seats: tables and two tatami tables for six. Smoking allowed except at lunch (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; September 2026). No service charge listed on Tabelog. A large udon portion is +¥220, though not on the menu (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo — 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn, exit 7
places.cuisine: Gion udon house open until the small hours · famous cheese-and-meat curry udon, ¥1,470 large (September 2026); cheese curry kitsune udon; kitsune udon; chicken-and-egg udon; konoha-don made with mushrooms instead of chicken (2026 reviews) · winter ankake udon on a dashi of four kinds of katsuobushi and kombu, thickened with kudzu and topped with ginger, ¥680 (Tabelog) · large portion +¥220 (Tabelog) · sake, shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Udon · Gion, open till 2–3 am] A long-standing Gion udon house that fills up after midnight with people ending a night out. The draw is cheese-and-meat curry udon — spicy at first, then rich with dashi — beside soft Kyoto-style kitsune udon and a winter ankake udon thickened with kudzu. Quick turnover; shared tables when busy. Cash only; smoking allowed after lunch. Sunday lunch only.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog describes the ankake udon: a dashi from four kinds of katsuobushi — mackerel, urume and bonito among them — with fine kombu, thickened with kudzu without water and topped with grated ginger. An October 2026 diner first ate the cheese curry udon here over ten years ago; reviewers in 2026 call it a traditional place and describe it packed after midnight.
chef_bio.specialty: Cheese-and-meat curry udon; ankake udon.

anecdotes.text: "Even after midnight, the place was packed." — October 2026.
An October 2026 visitor ended a 30-person office outing here for the cheese curry udon first eaten ten years before ("Sorry for the commotion!").
A September 2026 diner tried the konoha-don, made with mushrooms instead of chicken, and noted it is cash only.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都祇園 おかる、うどん・そば・食堂、東山区八坂新地富永町132、祇園四条駅7番出口から徒歩3分、月〜木 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜翌2:00、金は翌2:30まで、土は翌3:00まで、日 11:00〜15:00、予約不可、37席 (テーブルと6名の座敷2卓)、喫煙可 (ランチは禁煙)、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、うどんの大盛りは220円増し (メニューになし)、あんかけうどんは鯖・うるめ・鰹など4種の削り節と昆布のだしを葛でとじ、おろし生姜をのせて680円。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): チーズ肉カレーうどん大盛り1,470円、チーズカレーきつねうどん、きつねうどん、鶏卵うどん、このは丼、深夜も満席、相席、回転が早い、現金のみ、10年以上前から通う。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in, share a table at busy times; cash only.

places.name: すっぽん鍋 鱧料理 三栄 (Sanei)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; hamo courses include tempura and soy- or ponzu-seasoned dishes, and the winter guji course a fried dish in rice-flour crumbs (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamo, guji and soft-shell turtle courses, with a hamo-bone and kombu broth for the hot pot (official site).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:00), dinner 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 19:00); closed Monday; summer holiday 28 September–1 October 2026. Tabelog gives dinner L.O. 20:00. Bookings by phone or online. Official site: up to 15 seats downstairs, the tatami room currently closed; Tabelog lists 30 seats (8 counter, 8 table, tatami for 2–14). Non-smoking since November 2019 (official site); children welcome; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; official site). No service charge (Tabelog; Japanese original 「なし」). Hamo shabu for mail order or take-away May–November (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Off Kawaramachi-dori just south of Shijo — 2 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kappou of hamo, guji and soft-shell turtle, founded in 1934 (official site) · hamo cut to order after you arrive: hamo shabu course ¥12,100; seasonal hamo set of nine dishes ¥9,900 (official site; August 2026) · winter Wakasa guji course of eight dishes ¥15,400; spring bamboo-shoot courses ¥9,900 and ¥12,100 (official site) · lunch sets such as a lotus-root manju set ¥3,960, and seared-hamo dashi chazuke in October–November ¥4,180 (official site) · seen: hamo otoshi with plum, grilled hamo with cucumber and myoga, hamo tempura, anago or hamo pressed sushi, egg tofu, yuba (2025–2026 reviews) · Kyoto sake (August 2026)
places.notes: [Hamo kappou · Kawaramachi-Shijo, since 1934] A third-generation kappou down an alley off Kawaramachi, where the hamo is bone-cut only after you arrive and the hamo-shabu broth is a family recipe. Summer and autumn bring hamo courses — otoshi with plum, tempura, hot pot, pressed sushi — winter brings Wakasa guji and soft-shell turtle. Hamo shabu course ¥12,100. Busy since a July 2026 TV feature. One August 2026 guest wanted service to match the room and found the hand towels too strongly scented. Closed Monday.

roles: A family restaurant now in its third generation (official site: 三代続く); the owner is not named. A June 2026 diner writes of "the owner and his wife".
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1934 (Showa 9), with three generations of hamo technique and a hamo-shabu broth passed down in the family; the hamo is bone-cut and blanched only after guests arrive; the shabu broth is made daily from grilled hamo heads and bones with kombu and Kujo leeks; bamboo shoots fetched each morning from a farm under contract. The site says the shop was featured on Kansai TV on 30 July 2026, after which bookings flooded in for two months, and that hamo is at its fattest in October and November, not summer.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「あーこれが本当の鱧料理なんだ」 — to let guests experience real hamo cooking.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamo shabu; hamo otoshi; Wakasa guji course.

anecdotes.text: A former chef dining in June 2026 enjoyed the sound of the hamo bones being cut.
"The scent of the wet towels was surprisingly strong, almost overpowering the aroma of the food." — August 2026.
An October 2026 diner was told by the staff that autumn is the best time for hamo.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kappou-sanei.com): 京料理・鱧料理 三栄、昭和九年創業、三代続く本物の技と味、鱧しゃぶのスープは代々相伝、来店後に骨切りして湯引き、カウンターで割烹スタイル、テーブル席、鱧しゃぶコース12,100円、季節限定鱧旬菜御膳9品9,900円、グジづくしコース8品15,400円 (若狭ぐじ)、竹の子づくしコース9,900円、竹の子会席コース12,100円、ランチの蓮根饅頭御膳3,960円、10月・11月限定の炙り鱧の出汁茶漬け4,180円、鱧しゃぶの出汁は焼いた鱧の頭と背骨、昆布、九条ねぎ、2026年7月30日に関西テレビで紹介され予約が殺到、鱧は10月・11月が旬、9月28日〜10月1日は夏季休暇、昼11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 13:00)、夜17:00〜21:00 (L.O. 19:00)、月曜休み、一階席最大15名、お座敷は現在クローズ、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2019年11月から全席禁煙。食べログ: 日本料理・すっぽん、下京区河原町通四条下ル稲荷町319、夜 L.O. 20:00、30席、サービス料なし、子供可、5月〜11月は鱧しゃぶの通販・持ち帰り。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 鱧の落とし、鱧の造り、照り焼き、天ぷら、鱧鍋、押し寿司、卵豆腐、湯葉、焼き鱧の胡瓜と茗荷、9,900円のコース、店主夫婦、昭和の雰囲気、サービスがもう少しという声、おしぼりの香りが強い。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses by season; book ahead, especially since the July 2026 TV feature.

places.name: 祇園鮨 琢 (Gion Sushi Taku)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the course pairs sushi with freshly fried tempura, and sushi is seasoned with soy (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi, tempura and Kobe-beef course (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Two dinner seatings daily: 17:30–19:30 (last order 19:00) and 20:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed 31 December 2026–4 January 2027 (Tabelog). Staff explain dishes in several languages, including Chinese (October 2026). On the 1st floor of SAKIZO花見小路ビル on Hanamikoji; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Edomae sushi and freshly fried tempura in one course (2026 reviews) · sushi-and-tempura course ¥12,000 including tax (October 2026), about 25 items: yuba and matsumae-zuke to start, sashimi, otoro on black squid-ink red-vinegar rice, squid with karasumi, kinmedai, striped jack, botan shrimp dusted with "snow" salt at the counter, a small crab and ikura bowl, seared Kobe beef with caviar, tempura of shrimp, sweet potato and Tanba shimeji, half-size last roll on request · sake such as Hibi and Gakki Masamune, Pinot Noir
places.notes: [Sushi · Gion, sushi and tempura on Hanamikoji] A six-seat white-wood counter on Hanamikoji serving one generous course (about ¥12,000) that mixes Edomae sushi with freshly fried tempura: otoro on black squid-ink rice, shrimp dusted with salt like falling snow, a crab-and-ikura bowl, seared Kobe beef with caviar. Two seatings a night; the chefs explain dishes in several languages, and reviewers praise the friendly head chef and the counter chat. 10% service.

roles: Head chef, not named; operator 株式会社ファイブディアライフ (the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ファイブディアライフ (NTA corporate-number site). October 2026 reviewers praise a friendly head chef who explains each dish, and multilingual service for overseas guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Otoro on squid-ink rice; "snow" salt shrimp; sushi with tempura.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner was mesmerised as the chef sprinkled salt over the shrimp like falling snow.
An October 2026 pair of light eaters were glad the last roll could be served as a half portion, and noticed staff explaining the sushi in Chinese to guests from China.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses use fish, beef, pâté and consommé alongside Kyoto vegetables (2023–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last entry 12:30) and dinner 17:30–22:00 (last entry 20:00); closed Wednesday and the second Tuesday of each month (Tabelog). Reservation only; the door opens 15 minutes before the booking (October 2025). Service charge 10% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: サービス料10％). 18 seats: a counter of 8 decorated with bonsai and three tatami private rooms (shoes off; up to 8); non-smoking; cards (Tabelog; January 2026). On the 2nd floor of 祇園神聖ビル on Hanamikoji north of Shijo; about 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 16 November 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Hanamikoji north of Shijo, Gion — 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: French kaiseki built on Kyoto vegetables and Japanese ingredients, eaten with chopsticks (Tabelog; 2023–26 reviews) · lunch courses about ¥4,840 (January 2023) · dinner course ¥12,100 (January 2026) · dishes reviewers had: yokowa with yuba and caviar, salmon and pork pâté, turnip and ginger soup, Goto Islands kampachi with Tanba black soybeans, katsuo and yuba, white-fish consommé, poached otome-dai or roast domestic beef, homemade pudding, Spanish ham with shredded gourd · about five red and five white wines, sake such as Tamano Hikari
places.notes: [French · Gion, French kaiseki with Kyoto vegetables] A second-floor restaurant on Hanamikoji serving French cooking as a kaiseki eaten with chopsticks — Kyoto vegetables, yuba and Japanese fish in consommés and sauces, then poached sea bream or roast beef and a homemade pudding. Counter seats with bonsai, or one of three tatami rooms, good for business lunches. Chef Shigenaga also runs the Kyoto-vegetable French restaurant Lulache. Lunch from about ¥4,800, dinner about ¥12,100, plus 10% service. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Chef and owner (Tabelog’s official introduction); a December 2023 diner met the chef and the chef’s wife
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: chef Shigenaga, owner of the Kyoto-vegetable French restaurant Lulache in Ogura, Uji, cooks French kaiseki focused on Kyoto vegetables and traditional ingredients, at a counter decorated with bonsai and in private rooms. Opened 16 November 2019 (Tabelog). A December 2023 diner found the chef and the chef’s wife very friendly. Name known only in Latin letters from the English page.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: French kaiseki that catches each seasonal ingredient at its most delicious.
chef_bio.specialty: French kaiseki with Kyoto vegetables.

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 diner who came just after a typhoon was met by an owner who had worried whether the party could make it.
A September 2026 diner found the cooking leaned so Japanese that it was hard to call French, and lacking novelty, but enjoyed talking with the chef and the owner.
A September 2025 diner found the air conditioning too strong.

places.name: ハシヤとナカセ (Hashiya to Nakase)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, risotto, bruschetta, spring rolls, cutlets and fried dishes fill much of the menu; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly fish, meat and cheese; dishes such as a yam and broccoli aglio e olio or tomato salads may suit, but no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 16:00–22:00 Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday and irregularly (Tabelog). Starter cover ¥300 — a generous salad (Tabelog’s Japanese original: お通し300円; May 2026). Bookings by TableCheck or phone; may be treated as cancelled if 30 minutes late (Tabelog); popular, often full on Fridays (June 2026). 28 seats: a counter of 10 and tables; non-smoking; children welcome, with a high chair and a nappy-changing station; aisles narrow for strollers (Tabelog; July 2026). Cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). In a renovated townhouse in a quiet residential lane south of Karasuma-Matsubara; about 5 min from Gojo Stn (TableCheck; 2026 reviews). Opened 26 May 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Residential lane near Gojo-Karasuma — 5 min from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Genre-free creative dishes on an Italian base with Japanese and Asian touches, for drinking (TableCheck; Tabelog) · daily whiteboard menu (2026 reviews): Caesar salad starter, margherita spring rolls, shirasu and shiso-genovese bruschetta, yodare katsuo, beef tartare with cheese and truffle-oil bruschetta, venison cutlet, chicken wings marinated in dashi, fried lotus-root cake with crab sauce, crab and shiitake puttanesca, scallop and aonori cream risotto, gorgonzola risotto, fruit-tomato or Shine Muscat caprese, grilled duck, pâté de campagne · wines and a wide range of sake
places.notes: [Izakaya · Gojo, creative Italian-leaning plates] A cosy townhouse izakaya hidden in a residential lane near Gojo, opening at 4 p.m., where a whiteboard of genre-free plates on an Italian base meets plenty of wine and sake: margherita spring rolls, shirasu bruschetta, yodare katsuo, venison cutlet, creamy risottos. Solo diners get smaller portions; families with small children are welcome. ¥300 salad cover. Tabelog Izakaya WEST 'Tabelog 100' 2024. Closed Sunday.

roles: Not named in any source found; a June 2026 diner watched two staff working together
chef_bio.background: Opened 26 May 2022 (Tabelog). Per Tabelog’s official introduction: an izakaya on the theme of "drinks and food", with genre-free creative dishes of seasonal ingredients. Tabelog Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Margherita spring rolls; shirasu bruschetta; risotto.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner’s two-year-old tasted the margherita spring roll and exclaimed that it was pizza.
A May 2026 solo diner, ordering before 17:00, was given smaller portions.

places.name: 辻布紗 (Tsujifusa)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kaiseki built on dashi with citrus, vinegar and soy; no gluten information is published (Michelin Guide; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kaiseki of dashi, fish and seafood such as hamo, ayu, crab and soft-shell crab (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–13:30 Tuesday to Saturday; dinner 18:00–21:30 (last food order 19:30) Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog; Michelin Guide). Reservation only; ask ahead for the private room (Tabelog). 12 seats: a counter of 7 and a private counter room of 5 with sunken seating; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; OMAKASE). Lunch ¥10,000–10,500, dinner about ¥24,000 (OMAKASE; 2026 reviews). The entrance window and counter lights use kumiko woodwork from Okawa, Fukuoka (Michelin Guide). About 6 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 9 May 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of the Imperial Palace, near Marutamachi — 6 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki of gentle dashi lifted by citrus, vinegar, ume and ginger (Michelin Guide; 2026 reviews) · lunch omakase ¥10,000–10,500, dinner about ¥24,000 (OMAKASE; September 2026) · summer: cold-brewed gyokuro to start, soft-shell crab and ito-uri, hamo, ayu, winter melon (July–August 2026) · autumn: fig with sesame dressing, egg tofu with hairy crab, grilled sawara with chilli vinegar, simmered turnip, chestnut rice, matsutake (September–October 2026) · sake and wine chosen by the okami, a sommelier and kikisake-shi (OMAKASE)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Marutamachi, a couple's quiet Kyoto counter] A twelve-seat kaiseki counter near the Imperial Palace, opened in May 2024 by chef 辻 義勝 — long trained at Oryori Hayashi and head chef at Aji Fukushima for eleven years — with the okami, a sommelier, pairing sake and wine. The cooking is gentle dashi sharpened with citrus and vinegar: soft-shell crab, hamo and ayu in summer, figs with sesame and matsutake in autumn. Lunch about ¥10,000, dinner about ¥24,000. Listed with a Michelin star soon after opening. Cash only; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef, with the okami (a sommelier and kikisake-shi) — a couple (OMAKASE; July 2025 review)
chef_bio.origin: A hometown known for woodworking, per the Michelin Guide (the kumiko is from Okawa, Fukuoka).
chef_bio.background: Per OMAKASE: 店主 辻義勝 trained for many years at the long-established 御料理はやし, helped launch 味ふくしま and was its head chef for eleven years, then went independent and opened 辻布紗 in May 2024; the okami is a qualified sommelier and kikisake-shi who pairs wine and sake. An August 2026 reviewer adds training at "Yoshiyasu". Per the Michelin Guide: an owner devoted to Kyoto cuisine, attentive to the harmony of ingredients and dashi, using citrus and vinegar for rhythm; the name 布紗 refers to a hemp cloth used in Shinto rites, and plain hemp hangs as the noren. July 2026 reviewers note a Michelin star soon after opening.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Michelin Guide: deep, nourishing flavour from the harmony of ingredients and dashi, with acidity giving the menu its rise and fall.
chef_bio.specialty: Dashi-led kaiseki; seasonal rice.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 guest enjoyed the chef’s cooking again for the first time in more than a decade.
An October 2026 diner had a second helping of the matsutake rice and noted overseas guests nearby were also impressed.
A September 2026 group of chatty friends booked the private tatami counter room for five within a ¥15,000 budget with drinks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: OMAKASE (omakaseje.com): 辻布紗、丸太町駅から徒歩6分の日本料理店、店主の辻義勝氏は老舗の名店「御料理はやし」で長年修行、「味ふくしま」の立ち上げに参加し11年間料理長、2024年5月に独立、ソムリエで利き酒師の資格を持つ女将がワインやお酒を選ぶ、ランチ10,500円、ディナー24,000円。ミシュランガイド: 辻布紗、¥¥¥、中京区百足屋町155、京料理にひたむきに打ち込んできた主人、食材の風味とだしの調和、柑橘や酢の酸味、組子細工は福岡県大川市の伝統工芸、月 18:00–21:30、火〜土 12:00–13:30・18:00–21:30、日曜休み。食べログ: 日本料理、完全予約制、12席 (カウンター7、個室カウンター5)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、2024年5月9日オープン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 夫婦で営む、ミシュラン一つ星、無花果の胡麻和え、松茸。

cultural_comfort.note: Booking only; cash only.

places.name: 京都ぎをんおむすび屋 さんかく (Omusubi-ya Sankaku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Rice balls with fillings such as salt, ume, salmon, marinated tuna, chicken soboro, negi miso and salmon mayo, with miso soup; seasonings may contain wheat; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Salt, ume and negi-miso rice balls appear, but the miso soup has been a meat-based broth (February 2024) and many fillings are fish or chicken (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday to Friday 8:00–14:00; Saturday and Sunday 8:00–16:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, including through Instagram (Tabelog; December 2023); 30-minute seating; book ahead, as the four seats fill and fillings sell out (January–February 2024). Takeaway — ready-made rice balls on a shelf by the door; the shop calls if a takeaway order has a wait (Tabelog; December 2023). No cards or e-money; QR payments accepted (Tabelog). 4 counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). English menu signs (May 2025). In Gion south of Shijo near Yasaka Shrine; 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; January 2024). Opened 17 December 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion south of Shijo, near Yasaka Shrine — 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Four-seat breakfast counter of large omusubi from rice cooked in a clay pot, made to order in front of you (2023–2026 reviews) · eat-in sets of two rice balls with the day's miso soup, ¥1,100, some fillings +¥50 or +¥100 (January–February 2024) · fillings such as salt, ume, marinated tuna, salmon, chicken soboro, negi miso, salmon mayo — about ¥350 each (2023–2026 reviews) · a meat-broth miso soup (February 2024; May 2025)
places.notes: [Onigiri · Gion near Yasaka Shrine, breakfast at four seats] A tiny morning counter in Gion where two cooks shape big, loose rice balls from clay-pot rice to order: salt, ume, marinated tuna, salmon, negi miso. Sit-down sets of two with miso soup are about ¥1,100; rice balls to take away are about ¥350. Four seats and 30-minute sittings, so book (Instagram works) or take away. One 2023 guest found the room too quiet and close for conversation. QR pay, no cards. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 17 December 2022 as a rice-ball shop with breakfast and takeaway. Reviewers describe two male staff shaping rice balls at the counter (December 2023, February 2024), warm and welcoming service (August 2026), and English signage (May 2025); a February 2026 visitor thought it "seems to be run by a couple".
chef_bio.specialty: Clay-pot rice omusubi; salt and ume.

anecdotes.text: An October 2023 customer took four to go and was surprised, on unwrapping, at how big each one was.
"As soon as you take a bite, it crumbles beautifully, releasing the wonderful aroma of the rice." — February 2026.
"It's too quiet to have a conversation, and the staff are quite close by." — September 2023.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おにぎり、東山区祇園町南側533、祇園四条駅から徒歩約7分、火〜金 8:00〜14:00、土・日 8:00〜16:00、月曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、4席 (カウンター)、禁煙、子ども可、テイクアウト (待ち時間があれば電話)、朝食、2022年12月17日オープン。口コミ (2023年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 八坂神社の近く、土鍋で炊いたご飯の大きなおむすび、目の前で握る、イートインは2個と日替わりの味噌汁で1,100円、具によって+50円・+100円、1個350円ほど、塩、梅、漬けまぐろ、鮭、鶏そぼろ、ねぎ味噌、鮭マヨ、肉の出汁の味噌汁、30分制、インスタで予約、男性スタッフ二人、店内が静かで会話しづらいとの声 (2023年9月)、英語の表示。
