places.name: 合法ユッケかたまり (Goho Yukke Katamari)
places.gf_detail: GF options on request: the shop's page lists gluten-free among its food-diversity options, and the group's policy says its GF menu excludes wheat, barley, rye and non-GF oats, with seasonings checked against manufacturers' labels. You must tell staff when ordering — the same dish is otherwise served with gluten. Shared kitchen; separate frying oil and pans (official site, 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a raw-beef specialist — wagyu yukke and steak bowls with egg yolk, ikura and sea urchin (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:30) (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; bookings over 15 minutes late may be cancelled (Tabelog). An otoshi of ¥330 at dinner (Tabelog original ディナー営業、お通し料(330円)). 20 seats at eight two-person tables; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; children welcome, kids' menu (Tabelog). Cards, iD/QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). Menus in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean, with photos (Tabelog). Muslim-friendly menu with halal-certified wagyu (official site). Second floor of 祇園ヒロビル near Yasaka Shrine; coin parking next door; 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 28 March 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion south of Shijo, near Yasaka Shrine, 2nd floor — 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Yukke specialist with a licence to serve raw beef (Tabelog; October 2026) · temari yukke don of finely cut black wagyu blending lean and marbled meat, single ¥2,200 or double, e.g. with ikura ¥4,070; finish with Kyoto dashi poured over (official site; October 2026) · kinu-toro yukke of sirloin; black wagyu steak box (kuroge wagyu o-jū), also topped with yukke; sea urchin yukke bowl (official site; Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · sake and cocktails (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yukke bowls · Gion by Yasaka Shrine, raw wagyu] A small second-floor room by Yasaka Shrine from the Oagari group, licensed to serve raw beef: the draw is the temari yukke don — a dome of finely cut black wagyu with egg yolk, ikura optional, finished as dashi chazuke — about ¥2,200–4,100, plus steak boxes and a sea urchin yukke bowl. GF on request (say so when ordering) and a Muslim-friendly menu with halal-certified wagyu. Photogenic; one diner preferred izakaya yukke. ¥330 otoshi at dinner. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a yukke specialist of the Oagari group (おあがりグループ), which also runs 和牛火山おあがり in Arashiyama and Gion and うしとさかな in Sapporo; the group publishes a gluten-free policy and a Muslim-friendly policy (halal-certified wagyu, dedicated utensils, separate storage, staff training) that both name this shop. Per Tabelog: opened 28 March 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Food diversity" — options for allergies, religion and lifestyle so everyone can share a table (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Temari yukke don; kinu-toro yukke.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a third visit ate the double yukke bowl with ikura three ways: with the yolk, with condiments, then with the dashi poured over.
"It was tasty, but I think the Yukke at local izakayas might be better." — October 2026.
"Since it was still warm when I visited, it might be better to choose a different season to go." — October 2026, on a faint off-flavour.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (おあがりグループ): 日本初のユッケ専門店 合法ユッケかたまり、黒毛和牛お重、黒毛和牛手毬ユッケ丼 (超極細のカット、赤身とサシの肉をブレンド)、絹トロユッケ (サーロイン)、Food Diversity (グルテンフリー、ハラール対応)、東山区祇園町南側537-2 祇園ヒロビル2F、11:30〜15:00・17:30〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)。グルテンフリーの取り組み: 小麦・大麦・ライ麦・グルテンフリーでないオート麦を使わない、調味料は成分表示を確認、同じ厨房だが揚げ油やフライパンは分ける、注文時に申告が必要。ムスリムフレンドリーの取り組み: ハラール認証の和牛、専用の調理器具、保管を分ける、スタッフ研修。食べログ: 肉バル・丼、毎日営業、予約可 (15分遅れで取消の場合あり)、ディナーはお通し料330円、20席、貸切20名まで、禁煙、子ども可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、2025年3月28日オープン。口コミ (2026年10月、英語): 手毬ユッケ丼シングル2,200円、ダブルいくらのせ4,070円、締めは出汁をかけて、生食用食肉の取扱い、写真映え、居酒屋のユッケの方がという声、季節を選んだ方がという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese and Korean with photos (Tabelog); tell staff about GF or Muslim-friendly needs when ordering.

gf_cross_contamination.text: The group states gluten-free items are prepared in the same kitchen as dishes containing gluten, with separate frying oil and pans; other equipment is shared but washed before use. Trace cross-contact remains possible.
GF must be requested when ordering: without notice, the same menu item is served with gluten, and the shop takes no responsibility.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The GF policy excludes wheat, barley and rye and says seasoning labels are checked, but does not name the soy sauce used on yukke; standard soy sauce contains wheat, so confirm with staff.

positives.text: The shop page lists gluten-free and halal-friendly options under its "Food Diversity" commitment, and both group policies name Wagyu Steak KATAMARI.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog's listing ticks gluten-free options, and basmati rice and many curries are served alongside naan, roti and papad, but no source says which dishes are gluten-free or how gluten-free food is kept apart (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).

places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and dinner 18:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:45); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; with children, give the number and ages of the children when booking, or entry may be refused (Tabelog); sometimes closed for private parties (March 2026). 40 seats: 36 at tables, 4 at the counter; private room for 10–20; non-smoking, smoking area by the entrance (Tabelog). Cards incl. UnionPay; QR incl. Alipay (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff; takeaway and delivery; halal and Hindu options listed (Tabelog). Second floor of アイル竹島ビル on Kiyamachi north of Oike, up an apartment-style stair; 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; January 2026). Founded 1987 (January 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Oike, 2nd floor — 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Long-running Indian restaurant and wine bar (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · lunch sets: two curries ¥1,100 (October 2025); "The Full Thali" ¥2,530 with rasam, four curries of your choice, chicken and fish tikka, vegetarian or non-vegetarian (March–September 2026); weekend biryani set ¥1,760 (September 2026) · curries such as spinach and potato (daily special), mutton, chicken masala, dal fry, sambar, vindaloo, yogurt curry; tandoori chicken, seekh kebab (2025–2026 reviews) · naan, roti, basmati rice, papad, achar, mango chutney ¥350 (2026 reviews) · Kingfisher ¥900, wine and cocktails, lassi, masala chai (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · dinner about ¥3,000–4,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Indian · Kiyamachi above Oike, since 1987] A spacious second-floor Indian restaurant on Kiyamachi, open since 1987 and trusted by locals — one reviewer's Indian colleague called it the best curry ever. The lunch "Full Thali" (¥2,530, vegetarian or not) brings rasam, four curries, tikka and naan; two-curry sets start at ¥1,100, and biryani appears at weekends. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and Hindu options are listed; English spoken. Fast service. Open late. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A January 2026 regular says the restaurant was founded in 1987 and is among the most trusted in the area. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a spacious room with rich decor, well-mannered staff and very fast service; Tabelog lists English-speaking staff.
chef_bio.specialty: The Full Thali; biryani; daily vegetable curry.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor came on the repeated recommendation of an Indian colleague who called it the best curry ever eaten, India included.
A March 2026 guest, turned away once by a private party, returned on a weekday and was surprised by a lightly cooked spinach-and-potato curry.
"The sweet potato soup was almost entirely garlic-flavored. It was a valuable spice experience." — June 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); mention children when booking; cards and QR.

places.name: 祇園迦陵 (Gion Karyo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Monthly kaiseki courses with dashi, white and red miso, soy-based sauces and clay-pot rice; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki courses of fish, crab, oysters, duck and dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00, last order 19:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted — and needed (Tabelog; July 2026). A 10% service charge from 1 November to 8 December 2026 (Tabelog original 2026/11/1〜12/8までの期間中サービス料10%頂戴いたします). A seasonal course changing monthly, about ¥15,000–20,000 in reviews (Tabelog). 38 seats: a 14-seat counter and a private room on the ground floor, table seating for 2–10 upstairs, one private and two semi-private rooms; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; children welcome, kids' menu (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). Dishes explained in English (December 2025; July 2026). On Hanamikoji directly opposite the Gion Kobu Kaburenjo; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Hanamikoji, opposite the Gion Kobu Kaburenjo — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kaiseki course changing monthly, with tradition and new techniques; rice cooked in a kamado and sashimi prepared at the counter (Tabelog) · e.g. yuzu-pot dish, white-miso soup, hassun, clay-pot rice with shirasu and mentaiko (January 2026); a rice bowl of chirimen sansho and egg yolk (January 2026); a choice of three takikomi rice (June 2026); Hokkaido hairy crab with shirouri, Awaji hamo, yuzu somen, Awaji flounder and Tsushima squid, Tokushima rock oysters, ayu sushi, duck, red miso soup (August 2026) · a changing aperitif (July 2026) · sake, shochu and wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Hanamikoji, opposite the Kaburenjo] A long-established kaiseki house on Hanamikoji facing the Gion Kobu Kaburenjo, with a 14-seat counter where you watch the sashimi cut and the kamado rice cooked, and private rooms upstairs. Monthly courses of about ¥15,000–20,000 end with a choice of clay-pot rice — chirimen sansho or shirasu and mentaiko. Warm, unhurried service, with dishes explained in English; reviewers call it good value for Gion. 10% service from 1 Nov to 8 Dec 2026. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a seasonal course changing monthly, cherishing the traditions of Japanese cuisine while exploring new techniques and ingredients, with rice and sashimi prepared at the counter. A July 2026 regular since 2019 has watched the chefs grow and heard that one early chef has opened a Kyoto-kaiseki restaurant in Milan; a June 2026 family returned after several decades to find it unchanged.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tradition and innovation in Japanese cuisine (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kamado rice; monthly hassun.

anecdotes.text: "I often see the staff patiently explaining the dishes in English to foreign customers, and watching that is one of my personal joys of coming here." — July 2026.
A June 2026 family, back after several decades, found the interior and exterior unchanged — and chose the chirimen and mentaiko rice from three.
A December 2025 guest celebrated finishing a project with friends from Germany at the long counter, with each dish explained in English.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、東山区祇園町南側 祇園甲部歌舞練場前、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、花見小路を入って歌舞練場の正面、月・火・木〜日 18:00〜22:00 (L.O.19:30)、水曜休み、予約可、2026年11月1日〜12月8日はサービス料10%、38席 (1階カウンター14、個室1、2階テーブル)、個室1・半個室2、禁煙、Wi-Fi、子ども可・キッズメニュー、カード可、月替わりの季節のコース、伝統と新しい技法、かまどのご飯とお造りを目の前で。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年8月、英語): 柚子釜、白味噌のお椀、八寸、しらすと明太子の土鍋ご飯、ちりめん山椒と卵黄の丼、3種から選ぶ炊き込みご飯、毛蟹、鱧、ひらめ、牡蠣、鮎寿司、鴨、英語で料理の説明、ミラノで京懐石を開いた元料理人の話、数十年ぶりでも変わらない。

cultural_comfort.note: Dishes explained in English (2025–2026 reviews); book ahead; 10% service 1 Nov–8 Dec 2026; cards accepted.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Teas are plain leaf or flavoured; the pasta (carbonara, basil with steamed chicken) and cakes use egg, dairy or meat (2024–2026 reviews).

Reservations accepted; private hire by phone (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 10 seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Tea leaves, sweets and tea cosies to take away; some sweets are made by people with disabilities (Tabelog shop text). On Kaki-machi-dori by Rokuharamitsu-ji, 3 min from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo exit 5 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kaki-machi-dori by Rokuharamitsu-ji — 3 min from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Tea specialist café: leaf teas from many countries and flavoured blends, brewed with care; choose your own cup from the shelf and a cosy for the pot (2024–2026 reviews) · Nuwara Eliya with a scone about ¥1,200–1,300 (July 2024) · Afternoon Tea Blend 1 (Darjeeling and Assam); Ichigo Ichie, a strawberry-and-peach blend, sold by the 100 g (2026) · crisp scones, four petit cakes, mille-feuille, Mont Blanc (2024–2026) · pasta, tea and dessert set: fresh tagliatelle with basil and steamed chicken, or carbonara (March and October 2026) · iced tea in round cups (October 2026)
places.notes: [Kissa · Kiyomizu-Gojo, a one-man tea room] A ten-seat tea specialist near Rokuharamitsu-ji, run single-handed by a kind, elderly owner who explains every tea. Pick your own cup and pot cosy from the shelves, then a Darjeeling-Assam blend or a fruit tea with crisp scones, cake, or the fresh-pasta lunch set. Blankets on the chairs in winter; tea leaves and sweets to take home, some made by people with disabilities. Closed Tuesday and the second Monday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who runs the shop alone
chef_bio.background: A March 2026 reviewer describes the shop as run single-handed by a kind elderly gentleman; a January 2026 regular has come for about fifteen years. A July 2024 reviewer describes the owner as supporting children with disabilities, and the shop’s Tabelog text says some sweets on sale are made by people with disabilities. A November 2024 reviewer heard it is loved by Kyoto’s geiko and maiko.
chef_bio.specialty: Leaf teas; scones; fresh pasta.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor came in from the snow to find blankets on the seats, and had the owner explain the teas before choosing a cup from the shelf.
An October 2026 visitor found it full with three groups at 1:30 on a weekday, bought 100 g of the strawberry-and-peach Ichigo Ichie blend in a pouch of choice, and resolved to book next time.
A September 2025 visitor noticed the floor by the entrance table sloped slightly.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 紅茶倶楽部、喫茶店、東山区柿町通大黒町西入東川原町508、清水五条駅5番出口から徒歩3分、11:00〜17:00、火曜と第2月曜休み (予約があれば営業)、予約可、カード・PayPay可、10席、禁煙、茶葉、お菓子 (障がいのある方が作った商品も)、ティーコジーの販売、ブログ。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 年配の店主がひとりで営む、棚からカップを選べる、ヌワラエリヤとスコーン約1,200〜1,300円、Afternoon Tea Blend 1、Ichigo Ichie (いちごと桃)、スコーン、ミルフィーユ、モンブラン、パスタと紅茶とデザートのセット (タリアテッレ)、芸妓さん舞妓さんにも愛される。

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; the reviewed dishes use chicken, shrimp and fish sauce (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 daily; dinner 17:00–22:00 Monday–Thursday, 17:00–23:00 Friday–Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 28 seats; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; free Wi-Fi and power outlets; children welcome (Tabelog). Two staff at lunch (July 2025). Second floor of the MIYUKI building on Kiyamachi south of Oike, the lift opening straight into the restaurant; 1 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 7 June 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Oike — 1 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Vietnamese cooking, named for the S-shape of Vietnam (Tabelog shop text) · lunch sets about ¥1,000–1,300 with dessert and a drink (2025–2026 reviews) · Special S set ¥1,200: half pho, fresh and fried spring rolls, mini rice bowl, salad, coconut-milk che, shrimp chips (2025–2026) · banh mi and half pho set ¥1,200–1,300; grilled-chicken pho (2025–2026) · shrimp fresh spring rolls ¥420, Hanoi fried spring rolls (two) ¥490 (July 2026) · Saigon beer; Asahi Super Dry ¥650 (February 2026) · takeaway (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Vietnamese · Kiyamachi-Oike, pho and banh mi upstairs] A small, cheerfully decorated Vietnamese restaurant one floor up on Kiyamachi near Oike — the lift opens straight into the room. Lunch is the draw: the ¥1,200 Special S set brings half a pho, both kinds of spring rolls, a mini rice bowl, salad and che; or pair homemade banh mi with half a pho. Evenings run to beer and small plates. Seasoning is mild — add fish sauce at the table. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 7 June 2023; the shop’s text says the name comes from Vietnam’s S-shaped map. A July 2025 reviewer found two staff running lunch.
chef_bio.specialty: Special S set; banh mi.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner, drawn by high Google reviews despite a low Tabelog score, found the seasoning toned down for Japanese tastes and added plenty of fish sauce.
A February 2026 regular of a nearby Thai restaurant tried Vietnamese for a change and nearly walked past the street-level menu board.

places.cuisine: Bakery and cake shop that, per an August 2026 reviewer, changed from a cake shop to a bakery: hard and soft breads, savoury breads, baked goods and a cake showcase (2026 reviews) · mentaiko French bread, the 48-hour baguette, sausage breads, hot dogs, takuan-and-bonito bread (July–October 2026) · croissant ¥270, fig and cream cheese ¥230, fig and blue cheese ¥280, blueberry muffin ¥280, all before tax (July 2026) · fig croissant with vanilla cream, pear tart, onion tarte flambée, chocolate doughnut, canelé, mugwort and red-bean bread (June–August 2026) · thinly sliced apple pie, the house favourite (September–October 2026)
places.notes: [Bakery · Prefectural Office, mentaiko bread and apple pie] A busy bakery-pâtisserie near the Kyoto Prefectural Office and the Imperial Palace, which an August 2026 regular says turned from a cake shop into a bakery. Regulars name the mentaiko French bread and the thin-sliced apple pie first; there are also croissants (¥270 before tax), fig breads, a 48-hour baguette, savoury twists such as takuan with bonito, and cakes in the case. PayPay but no cards; closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Not stated in the sources read. The shop name 府庁前店 implies another shop, but none was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Mentaiko French bread; apple pie.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor came for the mentaiko French bread, found it not yet out of the oven, waited, and went straight home with it.
A July 2026 regular, who ranks it in a personal Kyoto top five, always buys the sausage breads.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ポワンプールポワン 府庁前店、パン・ケーキ、上京区春帯町345、丸太町駅から365m、水〜日 10:00〜18:30、月・火休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、テイクアウト、禁煙。口コミ (2026年、英語): ケーキ店からパン屋に、明太フランス、48時間のバゲット、ソーセージのパン、たくあんと鰹節のパン、クロワッサン270円、いちじくとクリームチーズ230円、いちじくとブルーチーズ280円、ブルーベリーマフィン280円 (税抜)、いちじくのクロワッサン、洋梨のタルト、タルトフランベ、チョコのドーナツ、カヌレ、よもぎと小豆のパン、薄切りのりんごのアップルパイ。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway bakery; PayPay but no cards.

places.name: ACTUAL KYOTO
places.gf_detail: Ask. Specialty coffee with cheesecakes (classic Basque, matcha, chocolate, seasonal lemon); whether the cheesecakes contain flour is not stated (2023 article; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee suits; the cheesecakes, lattes and gelato use dairy (2023 article; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 10:00–18:00, closed Tuesday; hours may change. A July 2023 rurubu article gave Wednesday–Thursday 10:00–18:00, Friday–Sunday 11:00–18:00, evenings on Friday and Saturday, closed Monday and Tuesday. No reservations; queues — about an hour at 15:00 in October 2026; a July 2026 reviewer met unexpected closures (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cash, cards (VISA, Master), IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 20 seats over two floors; a terrace where pets are allowed (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Beside the Randen Arashiyama line, 4 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 14 April 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Mibu, by the Randen line at Shijo-Omiya — 4 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Specialty coffee and cheesecake in a machiya over 100 years old (rurubu, July 2023; 2026 reviews) · drip coffee ¥650, cold-brew iced coffee ¥650, café latte ¥650, iced matcha latte ¥750 (rurubu, July 2023) · classic Basque cheesecake ¥800 (the favourite), matcha and craft-chocolate cheesecakes ¥800, cheesecake with a drink ¥1,300 (rurubu, July 2023); a June 2026 reviewer says cheesecake comes only as a drink set · Ethiopian medium roast; seasonal lemon Basque; cheesecake with gelato and whipped cream (2026 reviews) · staff suggest beans to your taste (October 2026)
places.notes: [Café · Shijo-Omiya, cheesecake by the Randen tracks] A machiya over a century old, opened up with concrete and old beams, right beside the Randen tram line near Shijo-Omiya — ask for a window seat upstairs and watch the trains pass. The order is specialty coffee (an Ethiopian medium roast is popular) with a cheesecake: classic Basque, matcha or a seasonal flavour, about ¥1,300 as a set. Expect a queue, sometimes an hour; pets welcome on the terrace. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owners 北浦夫妻 (a married couple), per rurubu
chef_bio.background: Per a July 2023 rurubu article: opened in April 2023 by the owners, the 北浦 couple, in a renovated machiya over 100 years old. Tabelog gives the opening as 14 April 2023.
chef_bio.philosophy: The name ACTUAL reflects a wish to value the place and time — that people actually come here on purpose, or meet someone here (rurubu, July 2023).
chef_bio.specialty: Classic Basque cheesecake; specialty coffee.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 pair joined a queue of about ten at 3 p.m., got in after 4, and landed the upstairs window table right above the Randen tracks.
A July 2026 visitor had been turned away twice by unexpected closures before finally getting in, and found the lemon in the seasonal cheesecake a little faint.
A September 2026 visitor warns that service can be slow when busy, so allow extra time.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: るるぶ&more (2023年7月): ACTUAL KYOTO、2023年4月に四条大宮にオープンしたスペシャルティコーヒーとチーズケーキの店、オーナーは北浦夫妻、店名は「実際に、ここを目指して来ていただいたり、人と待ち合わせしたり」という場所や時間を大切にしたい思いから、築100年を超える町家をリノベーション、ドリップコーヒー650円、カフェラテ650円、抹茶ラテ750円、クラシックバスクチーズケーキ800円、抹茶チーズケーキ800円、セット1,300円、当時は月・火休み。食べログ: 中京区壬生賀陽御所町20-2、阪急大宮駅から徒歩4分、10:00〜18:00、火曜休み、予約不可、現金・カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、20席、テラスはペット可、2023年4月14日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 嵐電の線路沿い、2階の窓から電車、エチオピア、レモンのバスクチーズケーキ、ジェラート、行列、臨時休業。

cultural_comfort.note: Queues, no reservations; staff help choose beans; many visitors from abroad (October 2026).

places.name: 米々庵 (Maimai An)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The onigiri themselves are rice, but fillings, oden, miso soups and many side dishes use soy and dashi, and there are fried dishes (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan as a whole: most fillings are fish or meat, and the soups and oden use dashi (2024–26 reviews). A plain "shiro" onigiri exists — ask.
places.hours_raw: 19:00–4:00; closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; fills up after midnight (Tabelog; September 2025). 13 seats at an L-shaped counter (Tabelog; January 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners only); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). East of Hanamikoji, Gion; 322 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, east of Hanamikoji — 322 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Late-night onigiri counter with izakaya dishes; onigiri of Uonuma Koshihikari rice and Echigo water (official site; 2024–26 reviews) · small onigiri, about 20 fillings — plain "shiro", salmon, mentaiko, simmered beef, ikura, horse mackerel with sansho, anago, chicken curry, ume — ¥150 each (March and May 2024) · dashimaki ¥500, grilled gyoza ¥500, red miso soup ¥400 (March 2024); pork miso soup, clam miso soup, sake-lees soup (2024–25 reviews) · winter oden, five pieces ¥1,000; chicken breast and cheese katsu ¥600 (November 2025) · sashimi platter, steamed clams in sake, fried small potatoes with minced-meat sauce, agedashi tofu, miso-stir-fried offal, beef tendon (2024–25 reviews)
places.notes: [Onigiri & izakaya · Gion, rice balls till 4 a.m.] A small L-shaped counter east of Hanamikoji where Gion's night ends: bite-size onigiri of Uonuma Koshihikari — about 20 fillings at around ¥150 each — with red miso or pork miso soup, dashimaki and, in winter, oden. Come early for drinks and sashimi, or after midnight when it fills up. Smoking allowed. 19:00–4:00, closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: onigiri made with Uonuma Koshihikari rice and water from Echigo. Reviewers describe a quiet master shaping the rice balls at the counter (November 2025), many regulars and a welcome for travellers (May 2024), and a shop open for several years (April 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Small onigiri; late-night side dishes.

anecdotes.text: A December 2023 diner loved the onigiri but found the fried taro too salty.
"Isn’t JPY 150 for an onigiri incredibly cheap? I wonder if prices have gone up due to inflation now..." — March 2024.
A September 2025 diner arrived about 1 a.m. and was seated at once; within 30 minutes the counter was full.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (maimaian.com): 京都 祇園 米々庵 (まいまいあん)、魚沼産こしひかりと越後の名水を使ったおにぎり。食べログ: 日本料理・おにぎり、東山区花見小路富永町東入ル ゴールドビル1F、祇園四条駅から322m、月〜土 19:00〜翌4:00、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、13席、喫煙可、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2023年12月〜2026年1月、英語): 小さなおにぎり約20種、1個150円 (2024年)、だし巻き500円、赤だし400円、冬のおでん5品1,000円、鶏むねのチーズカツ600円、L字のカウンター、深夜に満席、里芋の唐揚げが塩辛かったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order onigiri by filling at the counter; JCB, AMEX or Diners only; smoking allowed.

places.name: Common Well
places.gf_detail: Ask. Breakfast plates come with toast and baguette, and the cakes and tarts are baked; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: A September 2026 diner found a solid vegan menu, with vegan butter for the bread; soy and oat milk are offered for coffee (December 2024; September 2026).
places.hours_raw: 7:00–22:00 daily, open year-round: breakfast 7:00–11:30, lunch 11:30–15:00, café 15:00–18:00, dinner 18:00–22:00 (last orders food 20:30, drinks 21:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service charge or cover (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料、チャージ料なし」). 33 seats — counter, a big shared table, tables and a low table — and a terrace; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; June 2026). Cards and IC cards (Tabelog); a September 2026 diner also paid by QR. The café of HOTEL RINGS KYOTO, next door; on Sakaimachi-dori south of Rokkaku, near Nishiki Market; 7 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 28 September 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi Rokkaku, near Nishiki Market — 7 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Melbourne-style specialty coffee — beans, extraction, milk and foam made to order — produced by a barista who twice won the world latte-art championship and opened ten cafés in Melbourne (official site) · flat white, long black, white flat, cold brew, decaf, soy and oat milk, charcoal latte ¥650, fig cream latte (2024–26 reviews) · breakfast: regular plate of salad, poached egg, bacon and sausage, minestrone, toast, baguette and yogurt with a drink ¥2,300 (August–September 2026) · carrot cake ¥550, nut tart, chocolate gâteau; apple-mango smoothie (2026 reviews; Tabelog) · lunch, afternoon tea and dinner menus (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Café · Nishiki area, Melbourne coffee from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.] The café of HOTEL RINGS KYOTO, a bright space round a big wooden table near Nishiki Market, serving Melbourne-style coffee made to your spec — flat white, long black, decaf, soy or oat milk — under a world latte-art champion's direction. A hearty breakfast plate (¥2,300) from 7:00, cakes all day, and a calm late café until 22:00. A vegan menu too. No service charge.

roles: Hotel café; coffee produced by a champion barista (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the café of HOTEL RINGS KYOTO, with Melbourne-style specialty coffee produced by a barista who twice won the world latte-art championship, placed at world championships five years running, and produced ten cafés in Melbourne over seven years. Opened 28 September 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Melbourne-style coffee; breakfast plates.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner liked the breakfast plate but found the moromi-miso salad dressing a little salty.
A September 2026 diner found the fig cream latte low on fig flavour but enjoyable for the mascarpone and espresso.
A latte and chocolate gâteau came to about ¥1,200 — good value for Kyoto, an October 2026 diner felt.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hotel-rings.com/cafe): メルボルンスタイルのスペシャリティコーヒー、豆の種類や抽出方法、ミルクの量や温度、泡の質感までカスタマイズ、ラテアート世界大会で2度優勝し、メルボルンで7年間に10店舗のカフェをプロデュースしたバリスタ。食べログ: カフェ、中京区堺町通六角下る甲屋町393、烏丸駅から徒歩7分、毎日7:00〜22:00 (朝食7:00〜11:30、ランチ11:30〜15:00、カフェ15:00〜18:00、ディナー18:00〜22:00)、年中無休、予約可、サービス料・チャージ料なし、33席、貸切20名まで、カード・交通系IC可、2021年9月28日オープン。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年10月、英語): フラットホワイト、デカフェ、豆乳とオーツミルク、レギュラープレート2,300円、キャロットケーキ、ヴィーガンメニュー、海外の客が多い、ドレッシングがやや塩辛いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order coffee to your spec at the counter; cards and IC cards; many international guests.

positives.text: A September 2026 diner found a solid vegan menu, with vegan butter served for the bread.

places.name: 鳥彌三 (Tori Yasa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Mizutaki in a chicken-bone broth with house-made ponzu and grilled mochi, finished as zosui or chicken soba; courses add sushi and fried fish (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken mizutaki house; the broth is boiled from chicken bones (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–16:00 (last food order 14:30) and dinner 17:00–22:00 (last food order 20:00); closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog; official site). Reservation only (Tabelog); a same-day set menu may be offered on arrival (October 2026). Not suitable for guests under 18 (Tabelog). Lunch ¥4,800 with one drink — chicken soba or chicken zosui after broth and appetizers (May and September 2026); dinner mizutaki courses about ¥15,000–30,000 a head (2026 reviews). 30 seats with a counter facing a small garden, private rooms for 2–8, and riverside seating by the Kamo in summer (Tabelog; May–July 2026). Non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). English-speaking staff (October 2026). By the Kamo River south of Shijo; 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi and Gion-Shijo Stns (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: By the Kamo River, south of Shijo — 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Mizutaki house founded in 1788 in a building that is a registered tangible cultural property (official site; Tabelog) · white chicken broth boiled at high heat from bones, with bone-in chicken, handmade grilled mochi and ponzu, finished with zosui (Tabelog, shop text) · dinner courses: chicken-skin crackers of Daisen chicken, simmered eel, chicken liver, chawanmushi, grilled barracuda sushi, fried amadai with karasumi, mizutaki and zosui, pudding (October 2026); crisp grilled chicken skin, broth with quail egg (August 2026) · lunch ¥4,800: broth, appetizers and chicken soba with chicken, breast and duck chashu, or chicken zosui, with a drink (May–September 2026)
places.notes: [Mizutaki · Kamo riverside, since 1788] A mizutaki house founded in 1788 by the Kamo River south of Shijo, in a heritage building with a garden-view counter, private rooms and summer riverside seats. The rich white chicken broth, boiled from bones, is the point — sip it first, cook the chicken in it, and finish with zosui. Lunch, newly added after a recent renovation, is ¥4,800 with a drink; dinner courses run about ¥15,000–30,000. Reservation only; adults only. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Long-running family house (unnamed); an October 2026 diner heard it has passed to the ninth generation
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1788, it began as a poultry shop opened by the first-generation 彌助; the second generation, 彌三郎, began serving chicken dishes upstairs, and the building has kept its appearance since the founding. Tabelog’s shop text says the mizutaki was loved by Sakamoto Ryoma. Reviewers note a recent renovation and the start of lunch (May and July 2026), and an October 2026 diner heard the business had passed to the ninth generation.
chef_bio.specialty: Mizutaki in a white chicken broth; zosui.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner in a yukata, kept off the riverside by the weather, ate the mizutaki in a cool tatami room; the broth is simmered for three days.
A September 2026 diner contrasted it with Hakata mizutaki: this one uses chicken breast.
A July 2026 lunch guest was served iced hojicha in a wine glass and a taste of the broth before choosing soba or zosui (Japanese review).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (toriyasa.jp): 創業天明八年 (1788年)、木屋町の水炊き料亭、初代彌助の「かしわ屋」が起源、二代目彌三郎が店でさばいた鶏で二階で鶏料理を出し始めた、創業以来変わらない建物、昼 11:00〜16:00・夜 17:00〜22:00。食べログ: 水炊き・鶏料理・日本料理、下京区西石垣通四条下ル斉藤町136、京都河原町駅・祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、火・水曜休み、完全予約制、18歳未満は不向き、30席、個室 2〜8名、夏は納涼の席、禁煙、カード可、登録有形文化財、Sakamoto Ryoma が愛した水炊き、白濁スープ、焼き餅とポン酢は自家製、締めの雑炊。口コミ (2026年5〜10月): 昼4,800円 (鶏そばか雑炊、1ドリンク)、改装してランチを開始、川沿いの席、Daisen 鶏の皮せんべい、夜のコース、九代目に代替わりしたという声、英語が通じる。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; staff speak good English and explain the course; adults only.

places.name: BRON RONNERY
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the restaurant asks for allergies and dietary needs at reservation (Tabelog). Courses include bread with refills, soups and desserts (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask when booking (Tabelog). Courses feature Kyoto vegetables but are built around fish and meat (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 20:00), daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; give allergies and dietary needs when booking (Tabelog). Dinner "Menu Ronronne" of 11 dishes ¥15,730 (Tabelog); lunch courses about ¥3,000–5,000, a 5-dish short course, and a fish-and-meat lunch (2026 reviews). Private room with a sunken kotatsu and garden view for 4, ¥1,100 (Tabelog; August 2026). 40 seats (36 at tables) on the basement floor of the hotel THE SCREEN (Tabelog; June 2026). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Near the Imperial Palace; 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi and Marutamachi Stns (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi near the Imperial Palace — 5 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style French served on distinctive tableware, eaten with chopsticks, in a room painted by the artist Tetsuei Nakamura (Tabelog, shop text) · dinner "Menu Ronronne" of 11 dishes ¥15,730 by chef Yasumasa Nakahira (Tabelog) · lunch courses: terrine with salad, seasonal soups such as chilled corn or pumpkin potage, fish from the Kyoto Central Market such as pan-seared sea bream, Miyazaki beef or outside skirt, dessert trio with coffee (June–September 2026) · squid tartare, fried conger eel (June 2026) · birthday message plates drawn by the pastry chef (June and August 2026)
places.notes: [French · near the Imperial Palace, Kyoto-style French in a design hotel] The basement restaurant of the design hotel THE SCREEN, where chef Yasumasa Nakahira serves Kyoto-vegetable French to eat with chopsticks, in a room painted by Tetsuei Nakamura. Lunch courses (about ¥3,000–5,000) are good value; the 11-dish dinner is ¥15,730. Book the garden-view kotatsu room (¥1,100) and ask for a message plate — the pastry work is the talk of reviews. Service can be patchy. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): Kyoto-style French in a Japanese space painted by the artist Tetsuei Nakamura, with seasonal ingredients on distinctive tableware, eaten with chopsticks; the 11-dish Menu Ronronne is by chef Yasumasa Nakahira. The hotel THE SCREEN is run by 株式会社トレーダー愛 (official site). Reviewers single out a pastry chef for the dessert plates (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-vegetable French courses; dessert plates.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner had to point out that the bread never reached one of three guests.
A June 2026 diner liked the seasoning and the tender steak but found the portions small for men.
A June 2026 diner, there for a birthday, called the message plate the best artwork ever seen on one.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (screen-hotel.jp): ホテル THE SCREEN、運営会社は株式会社トレーダー愛。食べログ: フレンチ・ステーキ、中京区下御霊前町640-1 THE SCREEN 内、神宮丸太町駅・丸太町駅から徒歩5分、昼 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 13:30)・夜 17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 20:00)、予約可、アレルギーは予約時に、夜の Menu Ronronne 11品15,730円 (シェフ Yasumasa Nakahira)、40席、掘りごたつの個室 (4名、1,100円)、カード・PayPay 可、画家 Tetsuei Nakamura の空間で箸で食べる京風フレンチ。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): ホテルの地下、昼のコース約3,000〜5,000円、京都中央市場の魚、Miyazaki の牛肉、メッセージプレートが見事、パンが一人に来なかったという声、量が少ないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course online; give allergies when booking; cards and PayPay.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The restaurant asks guests to give food allergies and dietary needs when booking.

places.name: 百歳牛肉麺 三条河原町店 (Hyakusai Gyuniku Men Sanjo Kawaramachi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: hand-pulled wheat noodles and gyoza (Tabelog; official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-bone broth, beef, lamb and dumplings (Tabelog; official site).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–21:00 daily, open all year (official site; Tabelog). No bookings (Tabelog). The shop serves no pork dishes, per its Tabelog text. Mobile ordering (June 2026). 39 seats over two floors; English, Chinese and Korean menus with photos; English- and Chinese-speaking staff; children welcome; takeaway and delivery; BYO allowed; non-smoking; cards, IC cards and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). On the south side of the Sanjo shopping street just off Kawaramachi; 8 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn exit 7 (Tabelog; January 2026).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo shopping street just off Kawaramachi — 8 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Beef noodles with noodles hand-pulled to order in eight shapes, from thin to flat, thick and triangular (Tabelog) · Lanzhou beef noodles in clear beef-bone broth ¥1,000, beef dan dan noodles ¥1,000, spicy beef mixed noodles ¥1,050, Taiwanese beef noodles ¥1,100, pickled-mustard beef noodles ¥1,100 (official site) · grilled gyoza (lamb, chive and egg), lamb dishes, honeycomb tripe with sesame, Taiwanese sweets such as douhua; Taiwan beer (Tabelog; official site; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Beef noodles · Sanjo off Kawaramachi] Lanzhou and Taiwanese beef noodles with noodles hand-pulled to order in your choice of eight shapes — about ¥1,000–1,100 a bowl — plus lamb dumplings, sesame tripe and douhua for dessert. No pork dishes. Multilingual menus, mobile ordering, open daily 11:00–21:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the operator: a beef-noodle specialist where skilled cooks hand-pull the noodles after you order. The official site lists this single shop. A June 2026 regular has eaten its beef noodles since a former location in Fukakusa before the pandemic.
chef_bio.specialty: Hand-pulled beef noodles.

anecdotes.text: A diner who lived in Taiwan for six months forty years ago came for the Taiwanese beef noodles — June 2026.
An April 2026 lunch guest chose the wide flat noodles and found them broader than expected, almost knife-cut.
On a staff recommendation, a June 2026 business traveller paired beer with the sesame honeycomb tripe — "incredibly delicious".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hyakusai-beefnoodles.com): 百歳牛肉麺 三条河原町店、中京区石橋町14-14、毎日11:00〜21:00、蘭州牛肉麺1,000円、牛肉担々麺1,000円、旨辛牛肉混ぜ麺1,050円、台湾牛肉麺1,100円、酸菜牛肉麺1,100円、焼き餃子・揚げ物、羊料理、台湾甘味。食べログ (店舗会員): ラーメン・中華・居酒屋、京阪三条駅7番出口から徒歩8分、年中無休、予約不可、39席、注文後に手打ちする8種の麺、豚肉料理はなし、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、テイクアウト・デリバリー、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年1〜9月、英語): 蘭州牛肉麺980円、台湾牛肉麺、羊の餃子、ハチノスの胡麻和え、豆花、モバイルオーダー、以前は Fukakusa にあった。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus; English- and Chinese-speaking staff; mobile ordering (Tabelog; 2026).

places.name: 洋食屋 なかご (Nakago)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Demi-glace hamburg, breaded cutlets, gratin and pasta; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, pork, prosciutto, pâté and shrimp (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:30–21:00, last seating 20:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer says lunch has stopped and only dinner is served; earlier lunch sets (hamburg set ¥2,200 in January and April 2026) are no longer offered. Bookings taken — one diner booked by phone a month ahead (May 2026); no photos of the menu (April 2026). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards and e-money (Tabelog). At the back of "Momiji no Koji", a machiya alley off Matsubara-dori; 7 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2026).
places.neighborhood: Matsubara-dori near Kawaramachi, in the Momiji no Koji alley — 7 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Yoshoku at an eight-seat counter: hamburg steak with long-simmered demi-glace, cabbage rolls, pork cutlet on potato purée, pork ginger, Neapolitan pasta (2025–26 reviews) · evenings now centre on drinks and small plates: chicken ham, prosciutto salad, pâté de campagne, seared bonito, chicken liver, shrimp with nama-fu, shrimp gratin, finished with a hamburg steak (September–October 2026)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Momiji no Koji off Matsubara] An eight-seat counter at the back of a renovated machiya alley, cooking classic Western-style dishes — a hamburg steak in long-simmered demi-glace, cabbage rolls — alongside wine-friendly small plates. Dinner only since 2026; about ¥8,000–10,000 with drinks. Regulars fill it: book. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed; a May 2026 reviewer describes a husband-and-wife team)
chef_bio.background: Opened 27 July 2023 (Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer heard stories about the owner's work in New York; a May 2026 reviewer says it appears to be run by a husband-and-wife team, the husband cooking quietly and the wife serving.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak with demi-glace.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 lunch guest found the service "quite unfriendly", while regulars were greeted with conversation — "a nostalgic feel reminiscent of Kyoto from decades ago".
A May 2026 diner booked by phone a month ahead and found the counter full of chatting regulars.
Returning in September 2026, a guest found lunch discontinued and the evening menu richer in drinks and appetizers.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食屋 なかご、洋食、下京区松原通御幸町西入ル石不動之町682-2 もみじの小路 H-8、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩7分、火〜日 17:30〜21:00 (最終入店20:00)、月曜休み、8席 (カウンター)、禁煙、2023年7月27日オープン。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): デミグラスのハンバーグ、ロールキャベツ、トンカツ、ポークジンジャー、ナポリタン、ランチのハンバーグ定食2,200円 (のちにランチ終了)、生ハムのサラダ、パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、鰹のたたき、海老グラタン、メニューの撮影不可、夫婦で営む様子、ニューヨークでの仕事の話。

cultural_comfort.note: A small counter of regulars; book by phone; no menu photos.

places.name: 京野菜と炭火料理 庵都 (Kyoyasai to Sumibi Ryori Ihoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Gozen sets with tempura, charcoal-grilled skewers, miso soup and many small dishes; a July 2026 reviewer says allergies were catered for well; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: sashimi, chicken and fish skewers, and an Ihoto soup with pork (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:30) daily (Tabelog). Bookings advised; the tempura gozen can be ordered on the day (September 2026). Enter by the restaurant's own entrance, left of the ryokan Fufu Kyoto's north front along the stone path (Tabelog) — a January 2026 guest was sent round to the hotel entrance instead. No lunch parking (Tabelog). 46 seats incl. a counter facing the garden and private rooms; English menu; children welcome with kids' menu; wheelchair accessible; smoking area; cards and QR (Tabelog). By Nanzen-ji; 7 min from Keage Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nanzen-ji, by the Lake Biwa Canal — 7 min from Keage Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto vegetables and charcoal cooking at the lunch restaurant of the ryokan Fufu Kyoto, over a Japanese garden (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · gozen sets: "Fukushige" of nine small dishes with tempura, rice, Ihoto soup and dessert; tempura gozen ¥3,800 (September 2026); charcoal-grilled gozen ¥5,800 (March 2026); lunch about ¥4,800 (July 2026) · tempura of shrimp, white fish and eight vegetables with salt and lemon; sea bream and tuna sashimi; white-miso soup; seasonal smoothies (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Ryokan lunch · Nanzen-ji] The garden restaurant of the luxury ryokan Fufu Kyoto, open to non-guests at lunch: gozen trays of Kyoto vegetables, tempura and charcoal-grilled skewers (about ¥3,800–5,800) in quiet, screened seats over the garden. Use the restaurant's own side entrance; book ahead. Open daily for lunch.

roles: Restaurant of the ryokan Fufu Kyoto (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 20 April 2023 (Tabelog), as the restaurant of Fufu Kyoto, a small luxury ryokan by Nanzen-ji with a garden fed by the Lake Biwa Canal (2026 reviews). A January 2026 guest describes Ihoto as the ryokan's main dining room, also serving its breakfast. Lunch is open to non-guests (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Fukushige gozen; tempura.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 lunch guest found the service on the gozen "rather careless" for a hotel of this calibre.
The waiting area is laid out so that guests do not cross paths — July 2026, when allergies were also handled well.
After Nanzen-ji, a March 2026 visitor had the charcoal gozen of chicken and fish skewers while gazing at the garden.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 京野菜と炭火料理 庵都、日本料理、左京区南禅寺草川町41、蹴上駅から徒歩約7分、毎日11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 13:30)、ふふ 京都の北側の正面に向かって左の石畳から専用の入口、ランチ用の駐車場なし、46席、個室、英語メニュー、子供可、ホテルのレストラン、2023年4月20日オープン。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): Fukushige 膳 (小鉢9品、天ぷら、ご飯、庵都の汁、甘味)、天ぷら御膳3,800円、炭火焼き御膳5,800円、日本庭園を望むカウンター、白味噌の味噌汁、アレルギー対応、朝食も庵都で。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book ahead; use the restaurant's own entrance.

staff_allergy_handling: A July 2026 reviewer says allergy concerns were catered for perfectly.

places.name: コムシコムサ (comme ci comme ca)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. A French omakase with bread, a venison pie and a curry or cheese finale; no gluten information (2023–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: foie gras, fish, eel, venison and black wagyu (2023–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch Thu–Sun from 12:00 (last entry), closing 15:00; dinner Wed–Sun 17:30–21:30, last entry 18:30; closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservation only, from about two months ahead (Tabelog). 6 seats, up to 4 per group; children 12 and over; no very casual clothes (beach sandals, geta, shorts); no flash photography; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). A house in an alley in Okazaki; by the Okazaki Park and Zoo bus stop (buses 5, 32, 100) (Tabelog; April 2024).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki near the zoo — Okazaki Park and Zoo bus stop
places.cuisine: A ten-course French omakase with Japanese touches and a garden view: dashi jellies, sea urchin, eel, a paella-like rice, scale-crisped fish with Thai seasoning, a small foie gras burger, venison pie, black wagyu roast; a finale of curry, pho or a cheese platter; petits fours, bread and coffee (2023–26 reviews) · wine pairings, including lighter pairings on request (2024–25 reviews)
places.notes: [French · a house in Okazaki] A six-seat French restaurant in a hidden house near the Okazaki zoo, where the hostess's warm welcome is as famous as the cooking — ten courses with Japanese touches, ending in a choice of curry or cheese. About ¥15,000–20,000; wine pairings. Reservation only, two months ahead; 12 and over. Closed Monday–Tuesday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), with a hostess ("Madam") who runs the room (2024–26 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 27 May 2015 (Tabelog). Reviews from 2023 to 2026 describe a madam who greets and serves, and an owner remembered as "warm and wonderful" (June 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: French omakase with a curry or cheese finale.

anecdotes.text: A six-time regular in June 2023 sensed a return to Japanese influences — dashi jellies and Dentaku anago — as foie gras grew expensive.
For a February 2025 birthday, the madam took many photos with the birthday plate.
A July 2025 couple had stayed away two years after price rises but found it worth it for a birthday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): コムシコムサ、フレンチ、左京区岡崎法勝寺町124-4、市バス「岡崎公園 動物園前」すぐ、昼 木〜日 12:00 (最終入店)〜15:00、夜 水〜日 17:30〜18:30 (最終入店)〜21:30、月火休み、完全予約制 (約2か月前から)、6席 (1組4名まで)、12歳以上、ラフすぎる服装は不可、フラッシュ撮影不可、2015年5月27日オープン。口コミ (2023年6月〜2026年5月、英語・日本語): マダムの温かいもてなし、10品のコース、雲丹、鰻、黒毛和牛、鹿のパイ、締めはカレーかチーズ、ワインのペアリング、一皿の量が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book about two months ahead; small groups of up to four.

places.name: お立ち処 鮨㐂。 (Otachidokoro Sushi Ki.)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; Edomae nigiri on red-vinegar rice, with simmered anago, marinated fish and red miso soup in the course (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish nigiri course with red miso soup and tamagoyaki (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily including holidays 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–22:00; open year-round. Bookings taken. 14 places at a standing counter (no chairs; a March 2026 diner wished for one); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; children welcome if they eat the adult course; menus in English and Chinese, Chinese-speaking staff (Tabelog); chefs who speak English (August 2026). Cards and QUICPay; no QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog.
places.neighborhood: Just north of Shijo — 2 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Standing Edomae sushi bar on red-vinegar rice · a 12-piece course ¥7,700 at lunch and dinner, with red miso soup and tamagoyaki, extra pieces to order (2026 reviews) · seen: chutoro, kombu-cured sea bream, kinmedai, toro sawara, week-aged shima-aji, yuzu-pepper yellowtail, kombu-cured salmon, scallop, barracuda, kohada, herring box sushi, simmered anago, crab with crab miso, toro-taku hand roll (2026 reviews) · sake and shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Sushi · Shijo-Karasuma, standing Edomae counter] A clean standing sushi bar a couple of minutes from Karasuma, with a small garden beyond the counter: a 12-piece Edomae course on red-vinegar rice for ¥7,700, from chutoro and aged shima-aji to herring box sushi and a toro-taku roll, then extras to order. Chefs explain the fish in Japanese, English and Chinese, and many guests are from overseas. Diners call it great value; one wished for a chair over a full course, another wanted more rice under the large toppings.

roles: Several sushi chefs (2026 reviews); not named in a source
chef_bio.background: A standing Edomae sushi counter just north of Shijo, 2 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a team of chefs who speak Japanese, English and Chinese, red-vinegar rice, aged toppings and a small garden beyond the counter; an August 2026 diner heard the chef changes from time to time.
chef_bio.specialty: Twelve-piece Edomae course; aged toppings.

anecdotes.text: "Still, I wish there were chairs." — March 2026; a proper course does not finish in 20–30 minutes.
"When the fish is large and the rice is minimal, it feels more like eating sashimi than sushi." — August 2026.

A September 2026 diner watched the team serve a family with a small child, a couple and a guest from China in Japanese, English and Chinese; two extra pieces and two hot shochu brought the bill to ¥10,340.
"However, since most of the customers were from overseas, it felt a bit lacking in calmness." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お立ち処 鮨㐂。、立ち食い寿司、中京区東洞院通錦小路下る阪東屋町664番地7、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩2分、毎日 12:00〜14:30・18:00〜22:00、年中無休、予約可、14席 (カウンター、立ち飲みも)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、大人と同じコースを食べられる子供は可、英語・中国語のメニュー、中国語のスタッフ、カード・QUICPay 可、QR不可。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年11月、英語): 江戸前12貫のコース7,700円 (昼夜)、赤酢のシャリ、熟成のネタ、中トロ、鯛の昆布締め、金目鯛、トロさわら、一週間熟成のシマアジ、柚子胡椒のぶり、昆布締めのサーモン、帆立、かます、こはだ、鰊の箱寿司、煮穴子、蟹味噌和え、トロたく手巻き、赤だし、玉子、追加注文可、英語と中国語で対応、海外からの客が多い、椅子が欲しい、シャリが少なめという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Chefs speak English and Chinese (2026 reviews); English and Chinese menus (Tabelog); standing only.

places.name: 風の家 三条店 (Kaze no Ie Sanjo)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki, okonomiyaki, yakisoba and yaki udon are all wheat (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the takoyaki is seasoned with bonito dashi (2026 reviews); okonomiyaki and noodles come with pork, squid or egg (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 10:00–19:00. Bookings taken. 10 counter seats; take-out; designated smoking area (Tabelog). No cards; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. On the second basement floor of the 京阪三条北ビル, by the Keihan Sanjo ticket gates; a reviewer says it has been there at least 20 years (April 2026).
places.neighborhood: Inside Keihan Sanjo Station, by the ticket gates (B2F of the 京阪三条北ビル)
places.cuisine: Takoyaki, okonomiyaki and yakisoba counter in the station · official menu: takoyaki 7 for ¥400 or 11 for ¥580, with yuzu ponzu or mentaiko mayo options; okonomiyaki pork or squid ¥580, mixed ¥680; yakisoba from ¥520; yaki udon, omusoba, modan-yaki; tonpei-yaki ¥400; gyoza; teppan dashimaki ¥400; draft beer from ¥420 · a 2026 review gives 8 original takoyaki for ¥550 · plate lunch until 15:00 of pork okonomiyaki with half yakisoba and salad, ¥1,000 (April 2026; the official menu shows ¥850) · ¥1,000 quick-drink set of draft beer, edamame and one dish (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Takoyaki & okonomiyaki · Keihan Sanjo Station] A ten-seat counter by the Keihan Sanjo ticket gates, there for at least 20 years, frying takoyaki, okonomiyaki and yakisoba for commuters and take-away families. The ¥1,000 quick-drink set — beer, edamame and takoyaki — is the draw. Reviews are mixed: some found the takoyaki crisp and dashi-rich, others lukewarm or undercooked, and the yakisoba ordinary. No cards.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog introduces a counter-only shop just outside the Keihan Sanjo ticket gates for okonomiyaki, takoyaki and yakisoba, with take-out. An April 2026 reviewer says it has been in business for at least 20 years. The shop’s menu site (© 2019) is headed 風の家 三条店; no other branch is listed there or found on the web.
chef_bio.specialty: Takoyaki; quick-drink set.

anecdotes.text: "The takoyaki was more warm than freshly made, and the outer skin was overcooked and thick." — December 2025.
A February 2026 diner found every takoyaki burst with runny batter — "not so much gooey as it was undercooked" — while families bought several packs to take home.
"The large takoyaki was exquisite, with a rich bonito dashi flavor." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式のメニューサイト (techtas.wixsite.com/kazenoya、© 2019): 風の家 三条店、たこ焼き (味付き) 7個400円・11個580円、ゆずポン酢、明太マヨ、お好み焼ブタ・イカ580円、ミックス680円、焼きそば520円〜、焼きうどん、オムそば、モダン焼き、豚平焼400円、焼き餃子、鉄板だし巻き400円、プレートランチ (〜15時) 850円〜、生ビール420円〜、ちょい飲みセット。食べログ: たこ焼き・お好み焼き、東山区三条通大橋東入ル大橋町124 京阪三条北ビルB2F、京阪三条駅の改札のすぐ外、毎日 10:00〜19:00、予約可、カウンター10席、テイクアウト、分煙、カード不可、電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): ちょい飲みセット1,000円 (生ビール、枝豆、一品)、たこ焼き8個550円 (2026年10月)、プレートランチ1,000円 (2026年4月)、焼きそばいか700円、少なくとも20年の店、たこ焼きがぬるい・生焼けという声とカリッとしてだしが効いているという声、焼きそばは普通。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; quick and casual; no cards.

places.name: 町家四川 星月夜 (Machiya Shisen Hoshitsukiyo)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking: the official site invites guests to discuss allergies. Courses include soy- and bean-paste sauces, mapo tofu rice or noodles to finish (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses of shark fin, shrimp, fish, Kyoto pork, chicken and beef (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Tuesday and some irregular days. Courses only, for two or more (official site); bookings taken. Service charge 10% at dinner only (official site; Tabelog, Japanese original 「夜のみサービス料10%」). Smart-casual dress; no sandals, T-shirts acceptable (July 2025); children only in private rooms, no children’s chairs (Tabelog). 30 seats: 24 at tables, a private room for 6; non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Opened 25 November 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Shijo-Horikawa — 10 min walk from Hankyu Omiya Stn and Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Sichuan cooking with Kyoto ingredients in a century-old machiya (Tabelog) · lunch courses ¥4,000, ¥6,000, ¥9,000; dinner courses ¥9,900 and ¥14,300 plus 10% service (official site, from July 2024) · dishes seen: six-flavour appetizers (bang bang chicken, spicy beef, jellyfish), braised shark fin with Shanghai crab roe, shrimp in chili sauce, black sea bream in white chili oil, Kyoto Ajiwai chicken, Kyoto beef in Sichuan sauce, mapo tofu rice or dan dan noodles, almond tofu, Chinese teas (2024–2026 reviews; official site) · glass drinks ¥500 (November 2024)
places.notes: [Sichuan · near Shijo-Horikawa, a hundred-year-old machiya] Sichuan cooking with Kyoto vegetables in a renovated machiya with a courtyard, run by an owner-chef from Tokyo’s Sichuan houses and an owner-manager from hotel service. Courses only: six small appetizers, shark fin, shrimp in chili sauce, then mapo tofu rice or noodles — lighter and less oily than diners expected, with mild options for those who avoid heat. Lunch from ¥4,000; dinner from ¥9,900 plus 10%. Smart casual. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 遠藤 浄 (owner-chef, per the official site; no reading in a source)
roles: Owner and chef (official site: オーナー／シェフ 遠藤 浄)
Co-owner and manager 佐藤 幹夫 (official site: オーナー／支配人)
chef_bio.origin: Born 1962 in 長野県安曇野市 (official site).
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the chef joined 株式会社揚子江 in 1982 and trained at well-known Chinese restaurants including 獅子琳, 翠園 and 翠凰, joined 株式会社グリーンハウス 謝朋殿 in 1998 and was head chef at its restaurants, then head chef of 四川豆花飯荘 東京店 from its opening in 2007. The co-owner and manager 佐藤 幹夫, born 1963 in 秋田県横手市, joined 東京丸の内パレスホテル in 1982, worked at 浦安ブライトンホテル, joined 謝朋殿 in 1998 and managed 四川豆花飯荘 東京店 from 2007. Opened in Kyoto on 25 November 2015 (Tabelog), in a machiya about a hundred years old.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: Kyoto ingredients and freshly picked seasonal produce reborn as Sichuan cooking, in a machiya whose old pillars and fittings give a timeless ease.
chef_bio.specialty: Sichuan courses with Kyoto vegetables; shark fin; mapo tofu rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 diner was told sandals are not allowed under the smart-casual dress code, but T-shirts are fine.
"All glass drinks, both soft drinks and alcohol, are just JPY 500." — November 2024.
A family celebrating a son’s birthday in February 2026 found the food light, close to medicinal cooking, with mild dishes for those who avoid spice.
"The spicy stir-fried squid and vegetables were a bit too spicy for me, but I still found them delicious." — March 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hoshitsukiyo.kyoto): 町家四川 星月夜、こだわりの京食材と採れたての旬の素材の四川料理、町家造りの古い柱や建具の温もり、オーナー／支配人 佐藤 幹夫、オーナー／シェフ 遠藤 浄、昼11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)、夜17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、火曜と不定休、ディナーはサービス料10%、2024年7月からランチコース4,000円・6,000円・9,000円、ディナーコース9,900円・14,300円 (税込、サービス料別)、各コース2名から、アレルギーは相談を、遠藤 浄は1962年長野県安曇野市生まれ、1982年株式会社揚子江、獅子琳・翠園・翠凰で修業、1998年株式会社グリーンハウス謝朋殿、各店の料理長、2007年四川豆花飯荘東京店の料理長、佐藤 幹夫は1963年秋田県横手市生まれ、1982年東京丸の内パレスホテル、浦安ブライトンホテル、1998年謝朋殿、2007年四川豆花飯荘東京店の支配人。食べログ: 四川料理・中華料理、下京区油小路通仏光寺上ル風早町582、30席 (テーブル24、個室6)、禁煙、スマートカジュアル、子供は原則個室のみ、カード可、2015年11月25日オープン、築100年の町家。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年2月、英語): 六味前菜、フカヒレと上海蟹みそ、海老のチリソース、黒鯛の白い辣油煮、京あじわい鶏、麻婆豆腐ご飯か担々麺、杏仁豆腐、中国茶、グラスドリンク500円、サンダル不可、中庭、油が少なく薬膳のよう、辛すぎるという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses for two or more, booked ahead; smart casual, no sandals; allergies by arrangement.

places.name: 鶏菜 ヨコドリ (Torisai Yokodori)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; courses include fried dishes, chazuke and ramen to finish, and soy-based seasonings (2026 reviews; official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Tamba black chicken skewers and a chicken-broth hot pot (official site).
places.hours_raw: Official site: 17:00–23:00 (last entry 21:00); Tabelog: closed Thursday. Courses only (2026 reviews). Counter courses start together every hour with two-hour seating; the hot-pot courses upstairs need booking the day before and allow three hours (official site). 32 seats: 16 at the counter, 16 at tables upstairs; private rooms; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). The toilet is outside the restaurant (July 2026). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 21 December 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: An alley off Shijo-Fuyacho — 257 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori of Tamba black chicken over Kishu binchotan with Kyoto vegetables from the group’s own farm (official site) · counter omakase course ¥8,000 with drinks (¥7,000 with soft drinks only); upstairs Tamba black chicken hot pot ¥6,500, hot pot and yakitori ¥8,000, drinks included (official site, 2026) · earlier: counter courses ¥2,200, ¥3,800 and ¥5,800, hot pot ¥6,000 and ¥8,000 (February 2026) · seen: chicken tataki, chawanmushi in chicken broth, wings basted in chicken fat, watercress tsukune, black-bean mascarpone, chicken-broth chazuke and ramen (2026 reviews) · whisky made with Nagahama Distillery (June 2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Shijo-Fuyacho, chicken and farm vegetables] Down an alley off Shijo, a renovated house with a sixteen-seat U-shaped counter round the binchotan grill and hot-pot tables upstairs, from the local 五十家 group. Tamba black chicken skewers alternate with vegetables from the group’s own farm; wings are basted in chicken fat for a burst of flame. Now one omakase with drinks for ¥8,000. Diners praise the cheerful staff; one found the portions small for the price, another the endings repetitive. Closed Thursday.

roles: Owner with a yakitori background (official site); not named. One of the 五十家グループ restaurants
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a hidden yakitori shop in an alley off Shijo-Fuyacho, part of the 五十家グループ, grilling Tamba black chicken chosen by an owner who came from yakitori, with Kyoto vegetables from the group’s own farm, ISO FARM, and nearby growers, cooked over Kishu binchotan; vegetables are also simmered, pickled and steamed. Opened 21 December 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「鶏と野菜をもっと美味しく」 — making chicken and vegetables even more delicious.
chef_bio.specialty: Tamba black chicken yakitori; chicken hot pot.

anecdotes.text: "The prices are a bit high for the portion sizes, but the atmosphere is nice and the food is delicious." — March 2026.
A March 2026 diner wished the chazuke and ramen at the end had used different broths, and missed pepper for the ramen.
When grilling wings, the cooks brush on chicken fat for a burst of flame (July 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (isozumi.jp、五十家グループ): 鶏菜 ヨコドリ、「鶏と野菜をもっと美味しく」、四条麩屋町下ル東入ル、路地裏の隠れ家、自社農園 ISO FARM と近隣の農家の京野菜、焼鳥出身の店主が惚れ込んだ丹波黒どり、紀州備長炭、1階カウンター16席のおまかせコース8,000円 (料理・飲み物込み、ソフトドリンクのみ7,000円)、1時間ごとの一斉スタート、2時間制、2階テーブル16席の丹波黒どり鍋コース6,500円、鍋＋焼鳥コース8,000円 (前日までの予約、3時間)、17:00〜23:00 (最終入店21:00)。食べログ: 焼き鳥、下京区八文字町354-3、木曜休み、32席、個室、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2024年12月21日オープン。口コミ (2026年2月〜9月、英語): 以前はおまかせ2,200円・3,800円・5,800円と鍋6,000円・8,000円、五十家グループ、U字のカウンター、鶏のたたき、鶏だしの茶碗蒸し、手羽の鶏脂の炎、クレソンのつくね、黒豆マスカルポーネ、鶏だしの茶漬けとラーメン、長浜蒸溜所とのウイスキー、明るいスタッフ、量の割に高いという声、〆が似ているという声、トイレは店の外。

cultural_comfort.note: Courses only, starting on the hour; English page on the group site; book ahead.

places.name: おやじ (Oyaji)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a yakisoba shop — wheat noodles with sauce, plus chikuwa (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: noodles are cooked in chicken broth with squid and chikuwa, and toppings include pork, beef tendon and egg (April 2026).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–13:00 Monday, Tuesday and Thursday; 11:00–13:00 and 18:00–20:00 Friday to Sunday; closed Wednesday and the first Sunday of each month (Tabelog). No bookings; queues and early sell-outs at the short lunch hours (2025–26 reviews). 10 counter seats round the teppan (about 8 in practice); non-smoking; cash only; take-away (Tabelog; April 2026). No phone use inside, no video, and photos only of the finished dish (Tabelog remarks; October 2025, June 2026). Order by writing noodles and toppings on a slip of paper (2026 reviews). In an old candy-shop-like house near Kenninji and the Daikoku-yu bathhouse; 5 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; January and April 2026). Founded 1957 (April 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Near Kenninji, south of Gion — 5 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Yakisoba only, cooked on the teppan in front of you and eaten off it (2025–26 reviews) · chewy fresh noodles boiled for about ten seconds in chicken broth with cabbage, squid and chikuwa, then fried in a light-coloured but punchy sweet house sauce; sauce or salt; order by the number of servings — two servings for ¥1,000 to take away (June 2026) · toppings such as pork, beef tendon and egg; rice · curry powder, a spicy sauce and pickled ginger on the side · crispy bits from the griddle saved for you (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakisoba · Kenninji, a 1957 griddle counter] A tiny yakisoba-only counter near Kenninji, open since 1957 and now run by a mother and daughter who took it over from the founder. Write your order on a slip — servings, plus pork, beef tendon or egg — and the two fry fresh noodles, cabbage, squid and chikuwa in a sweet, punchy house sauce on the teppan in front of you; add curry powder or spicy sauce. Lunch is only 11:00–13:00 (evenings Friday–Sunday), queues are common, and phones and video are not allowed. Cash only.

roles: Run by a mother and daughter, not named (October 2025; April and May 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per April 2026 reviewers: founded in 1957, first serving okonomiyaki and later only yakisoba; run by a mother and daughter who inherited it from the grandfather. Reviewers describe a brusque but warm style, with the staff gathering the noodles together as the plate runs low and saving the crispy bits.
chef_bio.specialty: Yakisoba with house sauce.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 visitor saw a "no video" sign and was told only photos of the finished dish were allowed.
A June 2026 take-away customer was given the crispy bits from the teppan wrapped in foil.
A May 2025 couple came back after nine years and arrived right at opening.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おやじ、焼きそば、東山区北御門町259、清水五条駅から徒歩5分、月・火・木 11:00〜13:00、金・土・日 11:00〜13:00・18:00〜20:00、水曜と第1日曜休み、予約不可、10席 (カウンターのみ)、禁煙、カード不可、テイクアウト、携帯電話の使用禁止。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 1957年創業、お好み焼きから焼きそば専門に、母と娘が祖父から受け継ぐ、紙に書いて注文、鶏ガラスープで麺をさっと茹でる、キャベツ・イカ・ちくわ、甘めの独特のソース、豚・すじ・卵のトッピング、カレー粉と辛いソース、2人前1,000円 (持ち帰り)、動画禁止・写真は出来上がりのみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Written order slips; no phones or video inside; cash only; short hours.

places.name: 祇園 いわさ起 (Gion Iwasaki)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kaiseki with dashi and soy, including fried sesame tofu with sauce; no gluten information is published (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dashi-based kaiseki of fish, hamo and sea bream (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and dinner 18:00–21:00 (last order 20:00), every day; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Bookings taken; lunch fills with bookings at opening (July 2026). Service charge 10% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: サービス料10％); a lunch of ¥9,600 included tax and service (October 2026). 11 seats: a counter of 7 and one table; non-smoking with a smoking area inside; children by prior arrangement, ideally older primary-school age (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). On Higashi-Matsuchikoji, two or three lanes east of Hanamikoji; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (January and August 2026). Opened 21 April 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Matsuchikoji, east of Hanamikoji in Gion — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki with deep dashi and seasonal produce (2025–26 reviews) · lunch courses ¥8,000, ¥10,000 and ¥14,000 (October 2026); lunch ¥9,600 including tax and service, the lightest course (October 2026) · dishes reviewers had: seasonal hassun, scallop shinjo soup, sashimi of sea bream, horse mackerel and squid, new-potato soup with shrimp, hamo, grilled Lake Biwa trout, grilled barracuda with sauce, sea bream collar soup, fried sesame tofu with sauce, rice with young ginger and chirimen or as onigiri, warm pudding to finish
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a counter on a back lane] An eleven-seat Kyoto-cuisine counter on a dim lane east of Hanamikoji, opened in 2016 and, per reviewers, holding a Michelin star and listed in OAD 2026. Courses lean on rich dashi — scallop shinjo soup, hamo, sea bream collar soup, a fried sesame tofu — with seasonal rice, sometimes as onigiri, and a warm pudding that diners rave about. Lunch from about ¥8,000–9,600, dinner around ¥15,000. Cash only; 10% service.

roles: Owner and head chef, not named (December 2025 – October 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 21 April 2016 (Tabelog). Reviewers note a Michelin star (December 2025, August 2026) and a listing in OAD Top Restaurants 2026 (August 2026), and praise the hospitality of the head chef and the owner, who decorates dishes with seasonal leaves such as persimmon (October 2026). One regular finds the flavours closer to Kanto than typical light Kyoto seasoning (April 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Dashi-led kaiseki; warm pudding.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a fourth visit noted the owner had sourced persimmon leaves to decorate the dishes.
A December 2025 diner had the closing rice customised for each person.
An October 2026 diner and a regular at the next table both found the sea bream sashimi cut a bit thick.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 いわさ起、日本料理、東山区祗園町南側570-183、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)・18:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:00)、不定休、予約可、カード不可、サービス料10%、11席 (カウンター7、テーブル4)、禁煙 (店内に喫煙所)、子どもは事前確認、2016年4月21日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ミシュランの星、OAD 2026、東松竹小路、昼のコース8,000円・10,000円・14,000円、昼9,600円 (税サ込)、帆立しんじょうのお椀、鱧、鯛のあら炊きのお吸い物、胡麻豆腐の揚げ出し、温かいプリン、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; cash only; 10% service.

places.name: 即今藤本 (Sokkon Fujimoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kaiseki with well-water dashi and soy; the closing noodles (nyumen, lemon soba) are wheat or buckwheat; no gluten information is published (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kaiseki of dashi, fish, eel, turtle, shark fin and beef (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 and dinner 18:00–21:30; closed Wednesday, Obon and the New Year holidays; lunch booked by phone (Tabelog). Reservation only. Several reviewers say photos of the dishes may not be posted on social media — the chef explains guests should meet the food first by sight, smell and taste (2024–26 reviews). 9 counter seats and a private room for 4–5 by arrangement; non-smoking; cards and UnionPay; BYO; children of middle-school age and up order the adult menu (Tabelog). In a renovated house of about 80 years with a garden, down a narrow lane off Gokomachi-dori north of Ebisugawa; a well was dug for the dashi (May 2024; July 2026). About 5 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae or Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 7 May 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gokomachi-dori north of Ebisugawa, south of the Imperial Palace — 5 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki of 11–14 dishes, with well-water dashi and Kinu Hikari rice (2024–26 reviews) · lunch about ¥15,000–20,000, dinner about ¥30,000–40,000 (Tabelog budgets; a ¥15,000 course in February 2026) · summer: abalone with mozuku and okra, sweet sea bream chimaki sushi in a handwritten wrapper, Kamo eggplant and shark fin in white miso, hamo shabu-shabu with nori soy, charcoal-grilled ayu, corn tempura (July 2026) · autumn: soft-shell crab and ikura in vinegar jelly, turtle soup with a full-moon egg tofu, matsutake from two regions side by side, homemade karasumi, chestnuts, white rice, nyumen, fruit and kuzu-yaki (September 2026) · lemon soba in place of red miso, beef (September 2025) · sake such as Juyondai and Kokuryu
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Goshominami, a chef's renovated townhouse] A nine-seat kaiseki counter in an 80-year-old house with a garden, down a lane off Gokomachi-dori, opened in May 2024 by chef 藤本 宏和 — trained at the late, legendary Sakurada and head chef of Awata Sanso before going independent, per reviewers — who even dug a well for the dashi. Expect 11–14 seasonal dishes such as sea bream chimaki sushi, hamo shabu-shabu or matsutake compared side by side, and a warm, joking chef. Note: the shop asks guests not to post photos of the dishes on social media. Dinner about ¥30,000–40,000; Michelin star per reviewers. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: The invoice register lists an individual, 藤本 宏和, for the shop’s invoice number. Per a September 2026 reviewer: the chef trained at the renowned Sakurada, still talked about after its closing, then served as head chef at Awata Sanso of the Kyoto Hotel Okura before going independent, and works with apprentices. A July 2026 reviewer says the chef is from Hiroshima, and reviewers in July 2026 note a newly won Michelin star. A May 2024 regular found the cooking evolved beyond the chef’s earlier shop, with a well dug for the dashi and Kinu Hikari rice. Opened 7 May 2024 (Tabelog). Names of earlier restaurants known only in Latin letters from English reviews.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per a May 2026 reviewer: the chef asks that dish photos not be shared, so later guests meet each dish through sight, smell and taste rather than a picture.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; sweet sea bream chimaki sushi; well-water dashi.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner took home the sweet sea bream chimaki wrapper, handwritten by the owner, as a keepsake.
A party of three in September 2025 ate rice and meat with second helpings over three and a half hours, paying a little over ¥114,000 in total.
A February 2026 diner paired a ¥15,000 course with about ¥24,000 of sake, including Juyondai, and recommends it for younger guests.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 即今藤本、日本料理、中京区御幸町通夷川上ル松本町580-1、京都市役所前駅・丸太町駅から徒歩約5分、12:00〜14:00・18:00〜21:30、水曜・お盆・年末年始休み、昼の予約は電話、完全予約制、9席 (カウンター)、個室 (4〜5名、要相談)、禁煙、カード・銀聯 可、持ち込み可、中学生以上は大人と同じコース、2024年5月7日オープン、インボイス: 藤本 宏和 (個人)。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 料理の写真の SNS 投稿は不可、井戸を掘っただし、Kinu Hikari の米、築80年の町家と庭、Hiroshima 出身、Sakurada と Awata Sanso、ミシュランの星、甘鯛のちまき寿司、鱧しゃぶ、松茸、すっぽん、にゅうめん。

cultural_comfort.note: Booking only; do not post photos of the dishes on social media (house request).

places.name: ワインと和食 みくり (Wine to Washoku Mikuri)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the site asks guests to state allergies and dislikes for the whole party in advance. The kaiseki includes a fried course (tempura) and soy-based dishes (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led kaiseki with dashi (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch from 12:00 and dinner from 18:30, everyone starting together; closed Monday, plus irregular days twice a month, Obon and New Year (Tabelog; the official site posts closed days each month). Omakase course only, by phone or web booking; no email bookings; no children under 13; cancellation 50% the day before and 100% on the day (official site). Service charge 10% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: サービス料10％); the official site says its prices include tax and service. 19 seats: a 7-seat counter on the 1st floor (recommended for first visits) and three sofa tables for four upstairs, bookable as a private floor for about 10 (official site). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Three buildings east of the Kiyamachi-Nijo crossing, opposite The Ritz-Carlton, Kyoto; 5–7 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn exit 2 (Tabelog; official site). Opened 4 June 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo-dori by Kiyamachi, opposite The Ritz-Carlton — 5 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Kaiseki-style omakase built to pair with wine, by an owner-sommelier and a kaiseki chef (official site) · dinner omakase ¥22,000 including tax and service: sakizuke, fried dish, owan, hassun, sashimi, a palate break, grilled dish, a hearty dish, donabe rice and dessert (official course page) · lunch course ¥8,800 (January 2026), about ¥10,000 (July 2026) · wine pairing ¥11,000 (8 glasses, about 500 ml), half pairing ¥8,000 (4 glasses); also sake and Uji gyokuro (official site) · dishes reviewers had: live ayu shown before cooking, grilled katsuo with yellow chives, hamo soup with myoga and ume, kinmedai, maitake tempura with Champagne, kamado rice with five accompaniments and refills (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kaiseki & wine · Kiyamachi-Nijo, Japanese food paired by a master sommelier] A two-floor restaurant opposite The Ritz-Carlton where 西別當 選 — a sommelier of over forty years and once chef sommelier of Ginza L'Ecrin — pairs a glass of wine with each course of chef 西 正希's seasonal kaiseki: hamo, grilled katsuo, maitake tempura with Champagne, and kamado rice with side dishes and refills. Dinner omakase ¥22,000 plus pairing (¥8,000–11,000); lunch from about ¥8,800 is the easy way in. Everyone starts together; no under-13s. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 西別當 選 (Nishibetto Erabu) and 西 正希 (Nishi Masaki)
roles: Owner-sommelier 西別當 選 (the invoice holder; master sommelier); chef 西 正希
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: owner-sommelier 西別當 選, born 1956 in Kagoshima, joined Kobe’s Kitano Club in 1976, trained ten years in service and wine at Kyoto’s French restaurant Lyon, became chef sommelier of the grand maison Ginza L’Ecrin in 1989, later worked in hotels, was chef sommelier and manager at 粟田山荘 in 2014 and opened this restaurant in 2015; in February 2016 the owner became the first sommelier honoured as one of Kyoto Prefecture’s outstanding craftsmen (現代の名工). Chef 西 正希, born 1975 in Mie, trained 14 years at a kaiseki restaurant in Kobe and then at a two-Michelin-star ryotei in Mie. The invoice register lists 西別當 選. A July 2026 reviewer calls the owner a former president of the Kyoto Sommelier Association. Sister shop: みくり 桑 (Tabelog crawl).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "どんな料理にも相性の良いワインは、世界のどこかに必ずある" — somewhere in the world there is always a wine that suits any dish.
chef_bio.specialty: Kaiseki with wine pairing; kamado rice.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 diner who phoned to book a solo lunch was told bookings are for two or three, so gathered friends and booked for three online.
A June 2026 diner was shown a live ayu at the start of the meal before it was cooked.
A June 2026 lunch guest found service slow, stretching the meal to about two and a half hours.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (mikuri-kyoto.com): ワインと和食 みくり、京都市役所前駅出口2より徒歩5分、京都三条・木屋町エリア、ソムリエ歴40年以上のオーナー、おまかせコースのみの予約制、1F カウンター7席、2F 4名掛けテーブル3卓 (10名前後で貸切)、予約は電話又は WEB (メール不可)、アレルギーは事前に、一斉スタート、13歳未満不可、キャンセル料 前日50%・当日100%、とある日のおまかせコース22,000円 (税・サービス料込み: 先付・揚物・椀物・八寸・お造り・凌ぎ・焼物・強肴・土鍋ご飯・水物)、ワインペアリング11,000円 (8種類・約500ml)、ハーフ8,000円 (4種類)、地酒や宇治玉露、シェフ 西 正希 (1975年三重県生まれ、神戸の会席料理店で14年、三重のミシュラン2つ星の料亭)、オーナーソムリエ 西別當 選 (1956年鹿児島県生まれ、神戸北野クラブ、京都のフランス料理リヨンで10年、1989年銀座レカンのシェフソムリエ、2014年粟田山荘のシェフソムリエ兼支配人、2015年に開業、2016年京都府の現代の名工)、マスターソムリエ。食べログ: 日本料理・ワインバー、中京区東生洲町38-1、木屋町二条の交差点から東へ3軒目、ザ・リッツ・カールトン京都の向かい、ランチ12:00〜・ディナー18:30〜、月曜と月2回不定休、サービス料10%、19席、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、インボイス: 西別當 選、2015年6月4日オープン。

cultural_comfort.note: English site; everyone starts together; no children under 13; cancellation fees.

places.notes: [Curry · Gojo-Takakura, a one-person spice kitchen] An easily missed café in a residential lane near Takakura-Matsubara where the owner cooks and serves alone: a curry of the day piled with vegetables (about ¥1,100–1,300 with salad), a daily lunch plate, and chai in several spices. roles: Owner (unnamed), who runs the café alone

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner booked by phone the day before and was asked to come at opening time rather than queue, and to leave bicycles elsewhere.
An August 2025 diner loved the soup curry but found the staff unfriendly and only one dish on offer, and was surprised at the quick, serious Japanese used with foreign guests.
