Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). A TV in the shop (August 2025). places.notes: [Ramen · Higashiyama-Yasui, an old-school Kyoto bowl] A traditional-looking ramen shop with noren and lanterns at the Higashiyama-Yasui crossing, a few minutes south of Yasaka Shrine. The bowl is the Kyoto classic — rich soy-sauce tonkotsu with back fat, chashu and a heap of Kujo green onion — at ¥750 (¥850 with extra chashu), with juicy gyoza on the side. Dim, homely room; many visitors from abroad. PayPay but no cards; closed Monday.

roles: Owner (unnamed); reviewers describe a couple at work, and in April 2026 a foreign staff member
chef_bio.background: A November 2024 reviewer calls it an old shop; a December 2024 reviewer describes it as run by a Japanese couple, likely the owner and the owner’s wife, and an August 2025 reviewer says it seems to be run by a couple. An April 2026 regular was greeted by a friendly foreign staff member while the owner hung the noren.
chef_bio.specialty: Back-fat soy-sauce ramen; gyoza.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular arrived at 11:27 and was let in as the owner hung the noren; the bowl came in about five minutes.
A December 2024 visitor noted it keeps its traditional look while chains spread across Kyoto, and that many tourists from abroad come.

places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00), dinner 17:30–21:00 (L.O. 20:00), Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday (holiday Mondays vary) (Tabelog; official site). Reservations online or by phone (Tabelog; official site). places.neighborhood: Okazaki, near Okazaki Park and Miyako Messe — 5 min from the Okazaki-dori bus stop
places.cuisine: Charcoal-grilled eel from clear-water farms in Hiroshima, Shizuoka and elsewhere, and Omi beef, with pot-cooked rice (official site) · lunch unaju: small (half an eel) ¥3,850, regular (one eel) ¥5,390, jō (one and a half) ¥7,590, toku-jō (two) ¥9,790; any can become hitsumabushi (official site) · shirayaki ¥4,950, kabayaki ¥4,950, umaki ¥2,750, liver grilled ¥1,650 (official site) · dinner omakase of eel and Omi beef ¥16,500: hairy crab shiraae, clam and bamboo shoot, Omi beef roast beef or yukhoe, seafood snacks, eel shirayaki, meat course, pot rice as kabayaki, donburi or chazuke, dessert (official site) · takeaway eel bō-zushi ¥5,390 (official site) · salad and small dishes while the eel grills (2026 reviews) · sake, shochu, Kyoto whisky, wine (official site)
places.notes: [Eel · Okazaki, charcoal-grilled unaju near Heian Shrine] A renovated townhouse by Okazaki Park, opened in October 2025, where eel is grilled to order over charcoal at the counter and glazed with a brown-sugar and tamari tare. Lunch unaju runs from ¥3,850 (half an eel) to ¥9,790; dinner is an eel and Omi-beef omakase at ¥16,500. Expect to wait for the grill — small dishes come meanwhile — and service upstairs can lag. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened beside Okazaki Park on 1 October 2025, grilling eel and selected Omi beef over charcoal, with a tare of brown sugar and tamari soy. The site links to 路地 との本 (Japanese cuisine and sushi).
chef_bio.philosophy: “The refined aroma of charcoal, an exquisite taste in every bite” (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Unaju; eel and Omi-beef omakase.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner waited about 30 minutes for one of the ten limited ¥3,850 unaju, and was given roast beef on the house as an apology for the delay.
An October 2026 diner seated upstairs felt forgotten, with no menu, and went downstairs to ask — but praised the food and will return, asking for the first floor.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Japanese course built on dashi, with Saikyo-miso grills, ponzu and fried fish; no gluten information (2019–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses on dashi (2019–2026 reviews).

Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter; private hire possible (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). No sign outside; photography of dishes generally not allowed (2022–2026 reviews). places.neighborhood: Nijo-dori west of Takakura, south of the Imperial Palace — 366 m from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Quiet, seasonal Japanese courses by a chef who trained in French cooking, in France, before turning to Japanese cuisine (2023, 2026 reviews) · course ¥30,000 (February 2026); reviewers spend ¥20,000–39,999 · dishes reviewed: sesame tofu with fuki-no-tō and white miso; hassun of roast duck, plum, sweetfish and simmered sardine; fugu milt with grated daikon; amadai grilled with Saikyo miso; crab shinjo with seko-crab sauce; oysters, narezushi and sea cucumber with ankimo miso (February 2024; February 2026) · amadai and nodoguro grilled crisp and folded into a white-sesame purée; seasonal fish cakes, such as eel (July 2023) · matsutake rice (October 2022) · sake such as Juyondai and Houou Bida (July 2022)
places.notes: [Japanese · Nijo-Takakura, a referral-only counter] A sign-less counter in a lane south of the Imperial Palace, booked only through existing guests, where a chef trained in French cooking cooks quiet, exacting Japanese courses (¥30,000 in February 2026): sesame tofu with white miso, crisp-grilled amadai folded into sesame purée, fugu milt, crab shinjo. Photos of dishes are generally not allowed; the room is calm and mostly regulars. Evenings only.

chef_bio.background: Per 2021–2026 reviews: the chef trained for many years in renowned French and Kyoto restaurants, studying French cuisine in France before moving to Japanese cooking; an October 2021 reviewer calls the chef the last apprentice of Kyo-mi. A July 2023 reviewer says most guests have a connection to Kyoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: To bring out the natural flavour of seasonal ingredients (July 2023 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Crisp-grilled fish in white-sesame purée; seasonal fish cakes.

anecdotes.text: A July 2023 guest at a private dinner was so taken by an eel fish cake as to want ten more.
A February 2026 reviewer describes a quiet chef, no loud voices, a room of regulars, and a modest Tabelog score that undersells it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 游美、日本料理、中京区二条通高倉西入松屋町51、丸太町駅から366m、17:00〜22:00、完全予約制・紹介制、カード可、カウンター、貸切可、禁煙。口コミ (2019〜2026年、英語): 看板のない隠れ家、料理の撮影は原則不可、フランスで仏料理を学び和食へ転じた料理人、Kyo-mi の最後の弟子という声、コース30,000円 (2026年2月)、胡麻豆腐の白味噌、八寸、ふぐの白子、甘鯛の西京焼き、蟹真薯、甘鯛とのどぐろの白胡麻和え、鰻のしんじょ、松茸ご飯、Juyondai、Houou Bida、常連が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Referral only — book through an existing guest; dish photos generally not allowed.

places.name: GION COFFEE NANAFUKU
places.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee and soft serve alongside hot sandwiches, a cat-shaped French toast and sweets; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee, cold brew and lemonade squash are plant-based, but lattes, soft serve and the food use dairy or egg; no plant-milk information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 7:30–18:30; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Takeaway (Tabelog). 15 seats over two floors — remove shoes for the tatami-style upper floor; blankets and a clean restroom (Tabelog; April–May 2026). Small dogs allowed on the ground floor, held on your lap (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Suica, iD, QUICPay); no QR (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (April 2026). Glass-fronted shop just before Yasaka Shrine near the Gion intersection; about 8 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (April 2026). Opened 8 February 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion at Yasaka Shrine, by the Gion intersection — 8 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Specialty coffee café: single origins such as a Guatemala and Ethiopia light roast (May 2026), cold brew in a large glass (June–July 2026), café latte and café au lait (April–May 2026) · espresso soft serve (July 2026) · hot sandwiches, a cat-shaped French toast and sweets (June, October 2026) · lemonade squash (August 2026) · wine (Tabelog) · mostly under ¥1,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Coffee · Gion at Yasaka Shrine, open from 7:30] A small two-floor coffee shop just before Yasaka Shrine, open from 7:30 every day: light-roast single origins, a smooth cold brew, café latte and an espresso soft serve that one reviewer called a must, with hot sandwiches and a cat-shaped French toast. Take your shoes off for the upstairs seats by the window over the Gion crossing. Cheerful, English-speaking staff and lots of visitors from abroad; small dogs welcome on your lap downstairs.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café opened 8 February 2022. Reviewers in 2026 describe cheerful staff greeting guests in English and Japanese, many foreign tourists, freshly roasted coffee, and a calm Japanese-modern interior with a tatami-style upper floor.
chef_bio.specialty: Cold brew; espresso soft serve; light-roast single origins.

anecdotes.text: "I ordered the Espresso Soft Serve, and it was incredibly delicious—a hit menu after a long time." — July 2026, on the night of the Gion Festival.
An April 2026 visitor noted English menus and English-speaking staff, and was greeted with a smiling "Good morning".
"Being in the heart of a tourist area, I thought the taste might be secondary, but I was pleasantly surprised by the deep flavor and mild acidity" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、東山区祇園町南側540-2、毎日 7:30〜18:30、予約不可、テイクアウト、15席、座敷あり、小型犬は1階で抱っこなら可、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、子ども可、2022年2月8日オープン。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 八坂神社の手前、祇園の交差点、グアテマラとエチオピアの浅煎り、水出しコーヒー、カフェラテ、カフェオレ、エスプレッソのソフトクリーム、ホットサンド、猫の形のフレンチトースト、レモンスカッシュは甘め、英語のメニューと英語のスタッフ、海外の客が多い、2階は靴を脱ぐ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (April 2026); shoes off upstairs; small dogs on your lap downstairs.

places.name: カフェ コチ (CAFE KOCSI)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bread café — lunch sets come with all-you-can-eat bread, plus quiche, croutons and baked goods (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A daily soup (e.g. pumpkin, mushroom) and salad come with the bread, but the quiche, pâté and many breads use egg, dairy or meat; no vegan information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday 12:00–18:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; lunch 12:00–15:00 on weekdays only; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); a short queue on the stairs at opening at weekends (September 2025; October 2026). Order at the table, pay at the counter (September 2025). 20 seats with counter and sofa seating; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). Takeaway (Tabelog). Second floor of 黄瀬ビル, near Kyoto City Hall; 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike or Shiyakusho-mae stations (Tabelog; October 2025). Opened 11 November 2000 (Tabelog); reopened by September 2026 after a pause (September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Near Kyoto City Hall, 2nd floor — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Bread café, sister of the bakery Année, serving its dense breads (2025–2026 reviews) · lunch sets with salad and all-you-can-eat bread: soup of the day ¥900 (September 2025), quiche of the day, pâté (2025–2026 reviews) · soups such as pumpkin with a hint of curry, mushroom with croutons (2025–2026 reviews) · spinach quiche (November 2025) · small breads at the register, desserts (November 2025) · wine, shochu and cocktails (Tabelog) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Bread café · near City Hall, all the bread you want] A cosy second-floor café near City Hall, open since 2000 and sister to the popular bakery Année, where lunch means soup of the day, quiche or pâté with salad and refills of dense house bread — about ¥900–2,000. Books, sofas and an old-house feel; one guest found the back counter seats warm on a hot day. Short queues at weekend opening. Lunch on weekdays only. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 11 November 2000. Reviewers describe it as the sister café of the bakery Année, which opened in 2014 west of Karasuma Oike (October 2025), guests being sent here from Année on a short day (September 2025; September 2026), small breads delivered from a nearby bakery (November 2025), and a reopening reported in September 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Soup of the day with unlimited bread; quiche.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 guest who found the sister store Année short of bread that day was directed here, ten minutes' walk away, and would gladly have eaten more of the unlimited bread.
A September 2026 regular came as soon as the reopening was announced and found "the interior and atmosphere are just as I remembered."
"I would have appreciated a few more varieties of bread in the all-you-can-eat selection." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン・カフェ、中京区福長町123 黄瀬ビル2F、烏丸御池駅・市役所前駅から徒歩5分、月・火・金・土・日 12:00〜18:00、水・木休み、平日のみランチ12:00〜15:00、予約不可、20席、禁煙、子ども可、カード可、テイクアウト、2000年11月11日オープン。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): パン屋 Annéeの姉妹店、サラダとパン食べ放題のランチ、日替わりスープのセット900円、キッシュ、パテ、かぼちゃやきのこのスープ、ほうれん草のキッシュ、週末は開店時に階段に行列、2026年9月に再開、奥のカウンター席は暑かったとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Second floor; order at the table, pay at the counter; cards accepted.

places.name: カーヴ ド ケイ (Cave de K)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A wine bar with a custard pancake, sandwiches, fritto and roast beef; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Wine and champagne by the glass; the food named in reviews — cheese, fritto with shrimp and shirako, roast beef, custard pancake — is not vegan (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 15:00–24:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted — call ahead, as late hours fill (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). A ¥1,100 charge from 17:00 (Tabelog original 17時からはチャージ1100円; official site: 5:00pm〜 チャージ 1,100 yen); the official site also lists 税・サービス料 10%. 12 counter seats and a private room for up to 6, for guests who bring a bottle only; non-smoking; no children (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Ground floor of ヴァルズビル on Nijo east of Kiyamachi, below Bar K6; 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 24 March 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo east of Kiyamachi, ground floor — 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Wine bar themed on wine and desserts, pouring champagne and sparkling wine by the glass from magnums — a Krug ambassador shop, per an October 2026 reviewer (2026 reviews) · the signature pancake: a brûléed, custard-soft cake rich with spirits (2026 reviews) · potato and chestnut potage ¥990, mixed fritto of mushrooms, white shrimp and shirako ¥2,430, roast beef ¥2,200, smaller portions on request (October 2026); club sandwich, cheese (June 2026) · dessert wines such as a Kerner from Omori (September 2026) · drinks shared with Bar K6 upstairs (August 2026) · bills about ¥6,000–20,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Wine bar · Nijo Kiyamachi, champagne by the glass and a famous pancake] A bright counter wine bar below Bar K6 on Nijo-dori, opening from 3 pm, where champagne and sparkling wine — Krug included — are poured by the glass from magnums, and the signature brûléed custard pancake is the sweet to order. Real dishes too: fritto, roast beef, soup, halved for solo guests. A ¥1,100 charge from 5 pm. Call ahead late at night. No children. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 24 March 2014. Per the official site, part of K6 (ksix.jp), whose Bar K6 is upstairs. Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm, friendly owner who explains the wines, a ground floor for wine and an upstairs bar for whisky and spirits, and a theme of wine and desserts.
chef_bio.philosophy: Wine and desserts (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Champagne by the glass from magnums; custard pancake.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 guest was steered to a rare dessert wine to go with the pancake, and learned that sweet desserts can make lighter whites taste bitter.
A solo October 2026 diner, hesitating over dishes sized for two, was offered smaller portions of the fritto and roast beef.
Reviewers in August 2026 came down to Cave de K after finding Bar K6 upstairs fully booked — for one reviewer, the third time.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (K6): Cave de K、15:00〜0:00、火曜定休、税・サービス料10%、17時からチャージ1,100円。食べログ: ワインバー・パンケーキ、中京区木屋町二条東入ル ヴァルズビル1F、市役所前駅から5分、月・水〜日 15:00〜24:00、火曜休み、予約可、17時からはチャージ1100円、12席 (カウンター)、個室6名まで (ボトル持ち込みの客のみ)、禁煙、子ども不可、カード可、英語メニュー、2014年3月24日オープン。口コミ (2026年6月〜11月、英語): マグナムのシャンパーニュやスパークリングをグラスで、Krug のアンバサダーの店、名物のパンケーキ (ブリュレのようなカスタード)、じゃがいもと栗のポタージュ990円、フリット2,430円、ローストビーフ2,200円、少なめにもできる、2階は Bar K6、夜遅くは満席が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); ¥1,100 charge from 17:00; call ahead late; no children.

places.name: ビュー＆ダイニング コトシエール (View & Dining Kotoshie-ru)
places.gf_detail: Ask. French and Italian courses with pasta, bread (focaccia, baguette), butter sauces and desserts; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses of fish, abalone, duck and beef, with butter sauces and dairy desserts (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday to Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Monday except holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire by phone (Tabelog); queues at opening for lunch (September 2026). 15% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料15％). Dress code smart casual — men are asked not to wear sleeveless shirts or sandals; discounts and promotions not applicable (Tabelog). Lunch course ¥5,500 (October 2026); a ¥10,000 Tabelog course with champagne and wines (October 2026). A dessert-plate message for ¥500 (October 2026). 42 seats plus a 16-seat salon; private room "Grace Salon" for 6–16 from ¥16,800 courses; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 15th floor of Hotel Granvia Kyoto in the Kyoto Station building, directly connected to JR Kyoto Station (Tabelog; October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Hotel Granvia Kyoto 15F, Kyoto Station building — directly connected to JR Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: French and Italian dining with a city view, menus changing monthly (Tabelog; September 2026) · lunch course ¥5,500: appetiser, soup or pasta (+¥1,000), a main from three or beef (+¥3,000), dessert, bread, drink (October 2026) · e.g. sea bream with butter sauce, salmon, Kujo negi and aori-ika Genovese (September 2026); pumpkin soup (October 2026); pesto pasta, duck, yogurt mousse with ice cream and meringue (October 2026); abalone pasta, beef fillet steak (October 2026) · focaccia and baguette with refills (October 2026) · wine, sake, cocktails (Tabelog)
places.notes: [French-Italian · Kyoto Station, Hotel Granvia 15F with a view] The Hotel Granvia Kyoto's top-floor restaurant above Kyoto Station, with wide windows over the city and monthly French-Italian courses: a ¥5,500 lunch of appetiser, soup or pasta, a main and dessert, or dinners with abalone pasta, duck and beef fillet. Attentive service that will time courses to your Shinkansen; one October 2026 diner found the food somewhat average for the price. 15% service; smart casual. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: The restaurant of Hotel Granvia Kyoto, on the 15th floor of the Kyoto Station building (2026 reviews; Tabelog address). Reviewers in 2026 describe attentive, well-timed service, monthly-changing menus and the view of Kyoto from the large windows.
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly course with a view; Genovese pasta.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner on the ¥10,000 Tabelog course found the food "somewhat average" against high expectations, but the service outstanding — timed around a Shinkansen departure.
"I got a bit lost trying to find this place since the address on Tabelog doesn't mention that it's above Granvia." — October 2026.
A September 2026 couple were moved to a window seat, which delighted the companion.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・イタリアン、下京区烏丸通塩小路下ル東塩小路町901 京都駅ビル、JR京都駅直結、火〜日・祝 11:30〜15:30 (L.O.14:30)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、月曜休み (祝日は営業)、予約可、サービス料15%、ドレスコードはスマートカジュアル (男性のノースリーブ・サンダル不可)、割引不可、42席とサロン16席、個室「グレースサロン」(6〜16名、16,800円〜)、車椅子可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月、英語): ホテルグランヴィア京都の15階、京都の眺め、月替わり、ランチコース5,500円、食べログのコース10,000円、鯛のバターソース、九条ねぎとあおりいかのジェノベーゼ、鴨、鮑のパスタ、牛フィレ、フォカッチャとバゲット、メッセージプレート500円、新幹線の時間に合わせてくれた、料理はやや普通との声。

cultural_comfort.note: Smart casual; 15% service; book ahead; cards, e-money and QR.

places.name: お好み焼き 鉄板焼 OAGARI
places.gf_detail: Ask. The signature "French Maiko" okonomiyaki is made with rice flour and dashi — a June 2026 diner called it gluten-free — but wheat yakisoba is cooked on the same teppan and sauces are used throughout (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the rice-flour batter uses dashi, and most dishes have meat, seafood, egg or cheese (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Thursday and 26 December–4 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Table charge with an appetizer ¥495 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料（お通し）あり 495円税込」). 18 seats: 6 at the counter facing the teppan, 3 tables; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On the ground floor at the back of a building in a back street near Sanjo Kiyamachi; 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn, 4 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; June 2026). Opened 3 December 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo Kiyamachi — 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Creative teppanyaki built on rice-flour okonomiyaki, with wine chosen by a sommelier (Tabelog, shop text) · signature "French Maiko" rice-flour okonomiyaki with a cheese sauce and egg yolk ¥1,980 (June 2026) · squid-ink and Parmigiano black yakisoba ¥1,800–1,880, shiso-basil Genovese yakisoba, tonpei kimchi cheese tartare-yaki ¥1,180, seafood bakudan-yaki ¥2,480 (May–October 2026) · beef heart carpaccio, beef carpaccio ¥1,580, octopus carpaccio ¥1,080, yellowfin tartare ¥980, French-style daikon oden ¥480, sea urchin dashimaki, duck steak with sage red-wine sauce, wagyu steak (2026 reviews) · Japanese and imported wines from ¥800 a glass, a three-sake tasting ¥1,980 (May–June 2026)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki & teppan · Sanjo Kiyamachi, French twists with wine] A bar-like teppan counter tucked behind a building near Sanjo Kiyamachi, opened in December 2025 and sharing its name with the Wagyu Kazan Oagari shops. The rice-flour "French Maiko" okonomiyaki comes under a cheese sauce and egg yolk, and the rest of the menu runs to squid-ink yakisoba, beef-heart carpaccio, French-style daikon oden and duck steak — all paired with wine. ¥495 table charge. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a hidden dining spot built on rice-flour okonomiyaki and teppanyaki, with wine chosen by a sommelier; opened 3 December 2025. It shares the OAGARI name with the Wagyu Kazan Oagari shops in Gion and Arashiyama (Tabelog). A May 2026 diner praised the owner’s wine selection; a June 2026 diner noted Aesop soap and mouthwash in the restroom.
chef_bio.specialty: French Maiko rice-flour okonomiyaki; black yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner was satisfied with taste and portions but would not call it the best value for money.
A June 2026 diner described the French Maiko as gluten-free, made with rice flour and dashi, creamy rather than fluffy.
An October 2026 traveller ranked it among the top five restaurants of recent years.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お好み焼き、中京区恵比須町442-1 ル･シゼームビル 1F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分、三条駅から4分、17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、木曜休み、12月26日〜1月4日休み、予約可、サービス料 (お通し) 495円税込、18席 (カウンター6、テーブル3)、貸切20名まで、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2025年12月3日オープン、米粉のお好み焼きと鉄板焼、ソムリエが選ぶワイン。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): French Maiko1,980円、イカスミとパルミジャーノの黒焼きそば、Tonpei kimchi cheese tartare-yaki、牛ハツのカルパッチョ、フレンチ風の大根おでん、鴨のステーキ、日本酒3種飲み比べ1,980円、コスパは最高ではないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; order à la carte; ¥495 table charge; cards, IC and QR accepted.

places.name: 炭火やきとり隠れ家 呑んべゑ (Sumibi Yakitori Kakurega Nonbee)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori comes with salt or a soy-based tare; ask for salt (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori bar; vegetables and tofu are grilled on the same grill (July 2025).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, advised — often fully booked (Tabelog; August 2025, April 2026). Charge ¥330 (Tabelog, Japanese text gives only 「330」). A Tabelog course of 10 skewers ¥3,300 for 2–8 (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and a private room for up to 6; a tight counter (Tabelog; December 2025). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). At the end of a narrow lane off Hanamikoji east of Shinbashi, with a tobacco shop on the corner; 3 min from the Gion bus stop, 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; December 2025). Opened 25 November 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, a lane off Hanamikoji — 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Binchotan-grilled yakitori of chicken bought fresh each morning, at Gion prices that reviewers find low (Tabelog, shop text; 2025–26 reviews) · course of 10 skewers ¥3,300 (Tabelog) · liver (kimo) — the house recommendation, mild even for those who dislike liver — tsukune, the jumbo "Otsukimi" tsukune with egg yolk, beef skewers (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews) · chicken liver sashimi (September 2025) · grilled eggplant, grilled atsuage, yaki-onigiri, a cucumber starter (2025 reviews) · beer, sake, shochu, strong highballs; no desserts (2025 reviews) · about ¥3,000–7,000 a head (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Gion, binchotan skewers till 3 a.m.] A small counter at the end of a Gion back lane where morning-fresh chicken goes over binchotan: start with the 10-skewer course (¥3,300) and don't skip the liver, the house pride. Prices are low for Gion, so it books up — reserve. Smoking allowed; ¥330 charge. Open 18:00–3:00, closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): yakitori grilled over binchotan by a chef trained at a well-known restaurant in Shijo Mibu, with chicken prepared and skewered in-house by the owner; opened 25 November 2019.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken liver (kimo); 10-skewer course.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular waited over ten minutes for the first beer when the tap failed, with only two staff on, and wished bottled beer had been offered at once.
A December 2025 diner found the counter so tight that elbows kept bumping.
A September 2025 diner’s husband, who usually avoids liver, happily ate it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼き鳥・居酒屋・鶏料理、東山区四条通大和大路東入北側347-118、祇園四条駅から徒歩7分、祇園バス停から3分、月〜土 18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O. 2:00)、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、チャージ330円、焼き鳥10本のコース3,300円、16席 (カウンター8、個室6名まで)、喫煙可、カード可、2019年11月25日オープン、朝引きの鶏を備長炭で、Shijo Mibu の名店で修業した料理人、おすすめはきも。口コミ (2023年12月〜2026年7月、英語): 祇園にしては安い、レバー刺し、月見つくね、焼きおにぎり、予約で埋まる、カウンターが狭い、ビールが出るまで10分以上待ったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; the course is the easiest order; smoking allowed; cards accepted.

places.name: 出町ろろろ (Demachi Rororo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A bento of small obanzai seasoned with soy, dashi and miso, plus tempura (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan as served: mostly vegetables, but dressed with niboshi and dashi, with egg and fish in some dishes (July and October 2026). Ask when booking.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Thu 11:30–16:00; Fri–Sun lunch 11:30–13:30 and dinner 18:00–20:30; closed Monday and the second and fourth Sundays (Tabelog). Reservations essential — walk-ins are turned away; book by phone, best around 8:00–11:00, as calls during service go to voicemail; the mini kaiseki must be booked by the day before (Tabelog; July–September 2026). No cards or e-money (Tabelog). 15 seats at lunch (a U-shaped counter and two small tables), 9 counter seats at night; shoes off (Tabelog; July 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Imadegawa-dori, Demachi; 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn, 2 min from the Aoi Bridge West End bus stop (Tabelog). Opened 25 July 2007 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Imadegawa, Demachi — 7 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Obanzai lunches built on organic vegetables from Ohara (July 2026) · Rororo bento ¥1,500: a two-tier box of 8–12 small seasonal dishes — water spinach with niboshi, green beans with sesame, eggplant with ginger, zucchini with shiso sauce, dashimaki with tororo-kombu sauce, tempura — with clay-pot rice with a crisp crust and miso soup (June–October 2026) · rice refills ¥50 half, ¥100 full (July 2026) · mini kaiseki ¥2,650 adds fish and dessert, booked by the day before (September 2026) · evening service Friday to Sunday (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Obanzai · Demachi, the two-tier vegetable bento] A shoes-off counter on Imadegawa near Demachiyanagi whose ¥1,500 lunch bento — a dozen small dishes of Ohara organic vegetables, each seasoned differently, with clay-pot rice and its crisp crust — is booked solid weeks ahead. Phone in the morning (8–11), since calls go to voicemail during service; the mini kaiseki (¥2,650) adds fish and dessert. Cash only. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner (unnamed); a man runs the floor with a woman in the kitchen (July 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 25 July 2007 (Tabelog). A July 2026 diner saw a man, probably the owner, handling the room single-handed with a woman in the kitchen; an August 2026 diner felt the owner’s passion matched the careful cooking.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai bento; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 group found the room poorly ventilated; eyes hurt and a strong smell clung to clothes for the rest of the day.
An August 2026 diner saw walk-ins turned away even when tables had freed up.
A June 2026 diner loved the variety but thought the portions might be small for some.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、上京区今出川通寺町東入一真町67-1、出町柳駅から徒歩約7分、Aoi Bridge West End バス停から2分、火〜木 11:30〜16:00、金〜日 11:30〜13:30・18:00〜20:30、月曜と第2・第4日曜休み、予約可、営業中は電話に出られないことがあり朝8時〜11時がつながりやすい、カード・電子マネー不可、15席 (夜はカウンター9席)、禁煙、2007年7月25日オープン。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): ろろろ弁当1,500円 (Ohara の有機野菜のおばんざい8〜12品、土鍋ご飯とおこげ、味噌汁)、ご飯のおかわり半分50円・1杯100円、ミニ懐石2,650円は前日までに予約、靴を脱いで上がる、予約なしは断られる、換気が悪く匂いが服に残ったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone in the morning (Japanese helps); shoes off; bring cash.

places.name: 鮨おおが東山 (Sushi Ooga Higashiyama)
places.gf_detail: Ask. An omakase of small dishes and nigiri with soy, marinated fish and sauces (2024–26 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and shellfish sushi omakase (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 and dinner 18:00–20:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservation only; omakase course only; cancellation within 48 hours charged 100%; booking released if no contact 30 minutes after the time; children from middle school get the adult menu (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On the second basement of Six Senses Kyoto, through a door behind the lobby; 3 min from the Higashiyama-Shichijo bus stop, 10 min from Shichijo Stn (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews). Opened 1 May 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama Shichijo, in Six Senses Kyoto — 3 min from Higashiyama-Shichijo bus stop
places.cuisine: Edomae omakase from the Kyoto branch of Sakai’s Sushi Ooga, with tuna from the same wholesaler, Yamako (Tabelog, shop text) · small dishes such as sakura-shrimp or seiko-crab chawanmushi, Akashi sea bream, kinmedai with salt and soy, hairy crab with manganji pepper and Kamo eggplant, sake-steamed fish, ikura (2024–25 reviews) · nigiri: marinated fish, se-toro, chutoro, otoro, kohada, kuruma ebi, squid, uni, Densuke anago (2024–25 reviews) · bills about ¥30,000–59,999 a head (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Higashiyama Shichijo, Sushi Ooga inside Six Senses] The Kyoto counter of Sakai's famously hard-to-book Sushi Ooga, hidden behind a door at the back of the Six Senses Kyoto lobby, two floors down. Ten seats, omakase only: small dishes, then nigiri centred on tuna from the same wholesaler as the original — se-toro, chutoro, otoro — by a young head chef trained at the main shop. Expect ¥30,000–50,000+. Strict 48-hour cancellation. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Head chef (a young apprentice of the Sakai shop; reviewers give the name Sakai, 2024)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): the second shop of Osaka’s Sushi Ooga, serving only the chef’s omakase with tuna from Yamako, the original’s wholesaler, inside Six Senses Kyoto; opened 1 May 2024. Reviewers in 2024 describe the head chef as the Sakai shop’s top apprentice, trained there for seven years and 26 years old (June 2024), and name the chef as Sakai (April and August 2024); a December 2025 diner found the head chef friendly and kind.
chef_bio.specialty: Tuna nigiri.

anecdotes.text: A June 2024 diner found it underwhelming for the price and the nori not crisp despite being toasted, while liking the young owner’s manner.
An April 2024 diner came on opening day for lunch; Mr. Ooga came from Sakai to greet guests.
A September 2024 diner found the cost performance poor, on the expensive side even by Tokyo standards.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、東山区馬町通妙法院北門前妙法院側町431 シックスセンシズ京都 B2F、七条駅から徒歩約10分、東山七条バス停から3分、昼 12:00〜14:30・夜 18:00〜20:30、水曜休み、完全予約制、おまかせのみ、48時間前以降のキャンセルは100%、予約時間から30分連絡がなければキャンセル、中学生以上は大人と同じ料理、カウンター10席、貸切20名まで、カード可、2024年5月1日オープン、大阪の鮨おおがの2号店、本店と同じ仲卸 Yamakoのまぐろ。口コミ (2024年4月〜2026年1月、英語): 本店で修業した若い大将、せとろ・中とろ・大とろ、1人約30,000〜59,999円、値段に比べ物足りないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; omakase only; ask hotel staff for the hidden door; cards accepted.

places.name: めし処ぽち 四条烏丸 (Meshi Dokoro Pochi Shijo Karasuma)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tempura, oden on a bonito-and-flying-fish dashi, saikyo-miso grilled pork and kamameshi; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and vegetable tempura is served, but the oden broth is bonito, flying-fish and kombu dashi and most dishes are fish or meat (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings online or by phone — call even if online shows full (Tabelog). Ordering by smartphone (June 2026). 30 seats: an 11-seat counter around the kitchen and tables upstairs; private rooms for 6–8, or 12–16 by arrangement; children 3 and over; non-smoking with a smoking space; cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 5 min from Shijo-Karasuma (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takakura south of Shijo, near Shijo-Karasuma — 5 min walk
places.cuisine: Izakaya of fish, oden, tempura and kamameshi: sashimi platters around chutoro with fish from Kyoto Central Market every morning; year-round oden on a dashi of Matsushimaya Honten bonito, flying fish, dried shiitake and Hidaka kombu; tempura in flour chilled to –26 °C, fried at 165 °C (Tabelog) · in reviews: octopus or shirasu-ume kamameshi, firefly squid, kombu-cured sea bream, straw-grilled yellowtail, whale, water-eggplant tempura, saikyo-miso Kyoto pork, grilled eel, yuba, poke, tokoroten (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · near Shijo-Karasuma] A calm, grown-up izakaya with a counter around the kitchen, where the stars are the kamameshi rice pots, oden with playful twists and light tempura — plus market-fresh sashimi. About ¥4,000–6,000. Popular: book, or call even if online looks full. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 17 April 2023 (Tabelog). Per the operator: fish from Kyoto Central Market every morning; oden dashi from Matsushimaya Honten bonito flakes with flying fish, dried shiitake and Hidaka kombu.
chef_bio.specialty: Kamameshi; creative oden.

anecdotes.text: The first guest of the evening in March 2026 was surprised by a light clear soup as the starter.
Fully booked by 7:30 pm on a March 2026 night; the octopus kamameshi was the highlight.
An August 2026 pair appreciated the serving chopsticks set out for sharing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): めし処ぽち 四条烏丸、居酒屋・おでん・海鮮、下京区高材木町221-3、四条烏丸から徒歩5分、17:00〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、火曜休み、30席 (カウンター11、テーブル)、個室あり、3歳以上の子供可、2023年4月17日オープン、中トロを中心とした刺身の盛り合わせ、京都中央市場から毎朝届く魚、Matsushimaya Honten の鰹節とあご出汁、干し椎茸、Hidaka 昆布の出汁の創作おでん、マイナス26度の粉で揚げる天ぷら。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 蛸の釜飯、しらす梅の釜飯、ホタルイカ、鯛の昆布締め、鰤の藁焼き、鯨、水なすの天ぷら、スマホで注文。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by smartphone; book ahead.

places.name: ジビエの隠家 (Gibier no Nabariya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Breaded venison cutlets, menchi-katsu, curry, pasta and baguette; allergies can be noted when booking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a game-meat restaurant — deer, boar, duck, rabbit, bear, carp (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri and days after holidays 15:00–21:00; Wed, Sat, Sun, holidays and days before holidays 12:00–21:00 (lunch menu 12:00–15:00); food last order 20:00, drinks 20:15; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Charge ¥350 per person — Tabelog's Japanese original: "チャージ料 お一人様350円（税込）". No children after 16:00; note allergies when booking (Tabelog). 18 seats: 6 at the counter, 3 tables for 4; 90-minute all-you-can-drink plans; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners) and QR (Tabelog). In a former coffee shop at the back of a building ground floor, 3 min north of Hankyu Karasuma Stn exit 16 (Tabelog; June and October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Takakura south of Takoyakushi, behind Daimaru — 3 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Game and wine for beginners and fans: slow-roasted Ezo deer and its liver, roast bear and badger; lunch set of four game meats — venison cutlet, grilled boar, duck menchi-katsu, fried rabbit or quail — game spice curry and European-style deer curry; about ten wines by the glass (Tabelog) · in reviews: house salad with smoked boar, "usamayo" rabbit mayonnaise on baguette ¥800, carp carpaccio, boar and duck prosciutto, marinated pheasant, grilled boar ¥1,000, venison cutlet with demi-glace ¥1,500, venison-cutlet curry ¥1,800, courses ¥4,500 and ¥5,500 with drinks (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Game meat & wine · behind Daimaru near Karasuma] A cosy retro bistro in a former coffee shop serving game that converts sceptics: slow-roasted Ezo deer, boar, duck, rabbit, even bear, plus a four-game lunch plate and venison-cutlet curry. Dinner about ¥4,000–8,000, ¥350 charge; lunch at weekends and Wednesdays. No children after 4 pm.

roles: Chef (unnamed; a September 2026 reviewer saw one chef working)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator: game slow-roasted for about 30 minutes to tame its smell; a lunch menu meant for game beginners. Per a June 2026 reviewer, the room was a coffee shop before it became a game restaurant; a September 2026 regular praises how the hunters process the meat.
chef_bio.specialty: Roast Ezo deer; four-game lunch plate.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 first-timer who had doubts about venison wrote that it was so good it prompted a first-ever Tabelog review.
An April 2026 diner tried koi carpaccio for the first time and found no muddy taste.
After a concert at Kamigamo Shrine, an October 2026 couple ended with rabbit "usamayo" that tasted like tuna.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ジビエの隠家、ジビエ料理・バル、中京区高倉通蛸薬師下ル貝屋町558-1、阪急烏丸駅16番出口から北へ徒歩3分、月火木金・祝翌日 15:00〜21:00、水土日・祝・祝前日 12:00〜21:00 (L.O. 料理20:00、ドリンク20:15)、不定休、16時以降は子供不可、チャージ料 お一人様350円 (税込)、18席 (カウンター6、テーブル3)、エゾ鹿のロースト、熊や穴熊のロースト、ジビエ4種のランチ定食、鹿カツ、猪の網焼き、鴨のメンチカツ、兎や鶉の唐揚げ、ジビエのスパイスカレー、グラスワイン約10種、90分飲み放題。口コミ (2026年4〜11月、英語): Usamayo800円、鯉のカルパッチョ、猪と鴨の生ハム、雉のマリネ、鹿カツカレー1,800円、元喫茶店、コース4,500円・5,500円。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥350 charge; adults only after 16:00; note allergies when booking.

places.name: 下鴨茶寮 本店 (Shimogamo Saryo Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kaiseki on dashi, with fu, sushi and tempura-style dishes; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki of fish, hamo, ayu and dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings by phone or online (TableCheck) (Tabelog; September 2026). Service charge 15% in private rooms, 10% in shared rooms — Tabelog's Japanese original: "別途サービス料15％（個室）、10%（相室）を頂戴いたします". 50 seats in rooms with garden views, private rooms up to 36; children welcome in private rooms only, with a kids' menu; English menu and English-speaking staff; sommelier; smart casual; parking for about 8 cars; cards, PayPay and d Barai (Tabelog). By the Takano River near Shimogamo Shrine; 9 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shimogamo, by the Takano River near Shimogamo Shrine — 9 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki and tea kaiseki from a ryotei founded in Ansei 3 (1856), "local ingredients, local methods" with Kyoto vegetables (Tabelog) · courses: ten-dish "Fukuzen" ¥14,300, private-room course ¥22,000, a celebration course ¥27,500 (Tabelog); a lunch course at ¥8,800 and a Japanese-style afternoon tea of saba sushi, nama-fu dengaku and sweets (September 2026) · June–August 2026 menus: minazuki tofu, flounder and shima-aji sashimi, hamo soup with winter melon, bamboo-leaf sushi, river shrimp, anago yawata-maki, grilled ayu and sawara with sansho, matcha (2026 reviews) · takeaway and New Year osechi (official site; August 2026)
places.notes: [Ryotei · Shimogamo, since 1856] A 170-year-old Kyoto ryotei by the Takano River, near Shimogamo Shrine: seasonal kaiseki served in garden-view rooms, with a century-old garden to stroll after. Lunch courses from about ¥8,800, dinner ¥14,300–27,500, plus 10–15% service. English menu and staff. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Ryotei (no person named in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator: founded about 170 years ago, in Ansei 3 (1856), in Shimogamo; a ryotei carrying on Kyoto cuisine and tea kaiseki, with tea rooms such as Sansen-an, garden views from every room, and a history of guests among writers and dignitaries. Besides this main house, our crawl lists 下鴨茶寮 counters at 京都駅ポルタ and ジェイアール京都伊勢丹, and a 2024 press release announced a Matsuya Ginza shop with an eat-in corner.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: "local ingredients, local methods"; traditional technique with modern creativity.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 fan came because two idols had visited on a TV show, and was photographed in the garden by the staff.
A June 2026 lunch guest loved the minazuki tofu enough to want it sold at department stores.
A September 2026 regular brought extended family here to thank those who had travelled far — "a bit pricey".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 下鴨茶寮 本店、日本料理、左京区下鴨宮河町62、出町柳駅から徒歩9分、11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:00)、火曜休み、別途サービス料15％ (個室)・10% (相室)、50席、個室は36名まで、子供は個室のみ、英語メニュー、ソムリエ、スマートカジュアル、駐車場約8台、創業約170年 (安政三年)、京料理と茶懐石、Sansen-an などの茶室、地元の食材を地元の方法で、Fukuzen 14,300円、22,000円、27,500円のコース。公式サイト (shimogamosaryo.co.jp): 本店の料理の持ち帰り、百貨店の売り場・催事。口コミ (2026年6〜9月、英語): Minazuki 豆腐、鱧の椀、笹寿司、鮎、昼のコース8,800円、和のアフタヌーンティー、庭の散策。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); book ahead; smart casual.

places.name: 都季 (TOKI)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. French courses on a dashi of Fushimi water, with gnocchi, canapés and sauces; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of ayu, eel, fish and black wagyu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–13:30 (last order) and dinner 17:30–20:30 (last order), daily (Tabelog). Bookings taken; tables are held for 2 h 30 min (Tabelog). Service charge 15%, included in the listed prices — Tabelog's Japanese original: "サービス料15％（表記料金は税金・サービス料が含まれております。）". Open to non-staying guests (September 2026). 44 seats: a 12-seat counter, dining room, a private room for 6 (room charge ¥19,000) and a 16-seat room (dinner ¥60,000); children under 13 in the private room; smart casual; wheelchair accessible; sommelier; hotel parking free for 2 h with ¥8,000 spent; cards (Tabelog). On the ground floor of HOTEL THE MITSUI KYOTO by Nijo Castle; 3 min from Nijojo-mae Stn exit 2 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo Castle area, in HOTEL THE MITSUI KYOTO — 3 min from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Innovative Kyoto French: a French "dashi" made with Fushimizu, the Fushimi sake-brewing water, and Kyoto ingredients; carrot gnocchi in the 7- and 8-course menus (Tabelog) · a ¥12,000 lunch course with a ¥7,000 wine set (September 2026); a weekday private-room lunch ¥15,000 (July 2026); Christmas lunch ¥12,000 (Tabelog) · in reviews: Shiga ayu "water" soup, Kamo eggplant with ayu, eel in a red-wine style, edamame gazpacho, hon-shimeji canapé (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kyoto French · HOTEL THE MITSUI KYOTO by Nijo Castle] The hotel's French dining room, open to non-guests, where chef Tetsuya Asano — formerly executive sous-chef of the Ritz Paris main dining room and Japan's 2027 Bocuse d'Or candidate — builds sauces on a dashi of Fushimi brewing water. Lunch from about ¥12,000, dinner ¥20,000+ (service included). Smart casual; garden views.

chef_bio.chef_name: Tetsuya Asano (romaji, per the operator on Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator on Tabelog: trained at several renowned restaurants in the Netherlands and France before the Ritz Paris; in 2017 the first Japanese executive sous-chef of the main dining room, overseeing the hotel's restaurants including the two-Michelin-star Espadon with the executive chef; selected as Japan's representative for the Bocuse d'Or 2027. TOKI opened 3 November 2020 (Tabelog). A June 2026 reviewer says it holds a Michelin star; a September 2026 reviewer says it is listed in the Michelin Guide.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: Kyoto ingredients and Kyoto water, with a French "dashi" of Fushimizu.
chef_bio.specialty: Fushimizu dashi; carrot gnocchi.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 solo traveller chose it for something lighter after heavy French meals, and could have sipped the ayu "water" soup forever.
A birthday guest in October 2026 was looked after by a staff member, Nakaba-san, who also explained the local ingredients.
An August 2026 lunch guest found the menu gave nothing away beforehand — "an experience far beyond your imagination".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 都季 (TOKI)、イノベーティブ・フレンチ、中京区油小路通二条下ル二条油小路町284 HOTEL THE MITSUI KYOTO 1F、二条城前駅2番出口から徒歩3分、12:00〜13:30 (L.O.)・17:30〜20:30 (L.O.)、利用は予約時刻から2時間30分、サービス料15％ (表記料金は税金・サービス料込み)、44席 (カウンター12、ダイニング、個室6名・部屋代19,000円、16名の部屋・夜60,000円)、13歳未満は個室、スマートカジュアル、ソムリエ、2020年11月3日オープン、Fushimizu で作るフレンチの出汁、人参のニョッキ、料理長 Tetsuya Asano (オランダとフランスで修業、2017年 Ritz Paris のメインダイニングのエグゼクティブ・スーシェフ、ボキューズ・ドール2027日本代表)。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): 鮎の椀、賀茂なすと鮎、鰻の赤ワイン煮風、枝豆のガスパチョ、昼のコース12,000円、ワインセット7,000円、宿泊しなくても利用可。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; smart casual; service included in prices.

places.name: 天ぷら 東山 (Tempura TOHZAN)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura counter — wheat-batter tempura with dipping sauce, kakiage and tendon (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shrimp and cuttlefish tempura, a dashi dipping sauce and red miso soup (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); irregular closures; lunch courses by reservation only; dinner courses must be booked by 21:00 the day before. Service charge 10% at dinner (Tabelog; Japanese original 「１０％（ディナー）」). 12 counter seats; non-smoking; English menu; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Opened 19 September 2018 (Tabelog). A January 2025 diner notes the name is read "Tohzan", not "Higashiyama".
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-Oike, second floor — 3 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Tempura counter, fried and explained piece by piece · lunch tempura set meals (regular and premium) with rice, red miso soup and pickles; lunch courses such as the "Hiei" with kakiage tencha or tendon to finish (2023–2024 reviews) · dinner courses including the "Tohzan" course: four appetizers, about ten tempura with matcha salt, salt with rice flour or dipping sauce, then kakiage, rice, miso soup, pickles and dessert (2024–2025 reviews) · shrimp, cuttlefish, corn, okra, sweet potato, eggplant, taro (2023–2024 reviews)
places.notes: [Tempura · Kawaramachi-Oike, twelve-seat counter] A twelve-seat tempura counter upstairs by Kyoto City Hall, run by a couple with a little help: the chef fries shrimp, corn and seasonal vegetables to order and explains how to eat each. Lunch sets are good value; dinner is a course ending in kakiage on rice or tencha. Diners like the chatty chef; others found the decor and background music in need of work (2024–2025) and, in April 2026, service so-so — no one offered more tea. 10% service at dinner.

roles: Chef (not named); a June 2024 diner writes the restaurant "is run by a couple and their staff"
chef_bio.background: Opened 19 September 2018 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2023 to 2026 describe a counter where the chef fries each piece in front of guests and explains how to eat it; a July 2025 diner saw the chef handling everything alone at a busy dinner, and an April 2026 diner saw two people working the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura courses; kakiage tencha or tendon to finish.

anecdotes.text: "The chef seems to fry tempura as naturally as breathing." — October 2024.
"If the background music were selected by a professional, I believe this would become the best restaurant." — July 2024.
"They didn’t even ask if we wanted a refill for our tea, so I don’t think I’ll be coming back." — April 2026.
A July 2025 family brought a child to try real tempura and enjoyed the chef’s funny stories; the tempura bowl was the best they had ever eaten.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 天ぷら 東山 (Tempura TOHZAN)、天ぷら・天丼・日本料理、中京区河原町御池下ル下丸屋町401 福三ビル2F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩約3分、毎日 11:30〜14:00・17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、不定休、昼のコースは予約制、コースは前日21時までに予約、サービス料10% (ディナー)、12席、禁煙、英語メニュー、カード可、2018年9月19日オープン。口コミ (2023年8月〜2026年4月、英語): 夫婦とスタッフで営む店、ランチの天ぷら定食 (並・上)、「比叡」のコース、〆はかき揚げの天茶か天丼、「東山」のコース、前菜4品と天ぷら10種ほど、抹茶塩・米粉の塩・天つゆ、海老、紋甲いか、とうもろこし、オクラ、さつまいも、茄子、里芋、読みは「とうざん」、店主が気さく、内装やBGMはもう少しという声、お茶のおかわりを聞かれなかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); the chef explains each piece; book dinner courses by 21:00 the day before.

places.name: ぎをん 津崎 (Gion Tsuzaki)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; a sushi and à la carte menu with simmered dishes, tempura in the winter fugu course and red miso soup (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi, sashimi, fugu, shrimp and dashi-simmered dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 12:00–13:30 (lunch by reservation only) and 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday. A daily otoshi from ¥500 is charged (Tabelog; Japanese original 「つきだし 500円～ ※日替わり」). BYO allowed at ¥2,000 per bottle (Tabelog). 13 seats: 7 at the counter, 6 at sunken tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog), e-cigarettes too (August 2026); cards and e-money, no QR (Tabelog). Opened 24 June 2010 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, Shinbashi-dori east of Hanamikoji — 3 min walk from the north gate of Yasaka Shrine
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood sushi in Gion, by course or à la carte · omakase nigiri courses, then favourites to order; sashimi, simmered dishes, the day’s grilled dish, red miso soup with egg (2024–2026 reviews) · seen: engawa of sea bream and flounder, dancing shrimp with fried heads, grilled fin, uni, ikura, funazushi (2024–2026 reviews) · winter fugu course with sashimi, tempura, hot pot and zosui (December 2024) · lunch seafood chirashi ¥2,000 (August 2023) · a sake list regulars praise (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Gion Shinbashi, relaxed and smoking-friendly] A thirteen-seat sushi shop near Yasaka Shrine that regulars call welcoming rather than formal: omakase nigiri, then whatever you like à la carte — dancing shrimp, engawa, funazushi — with a strong sake list and fugu in winter. Families return every Obon; one regular has been 27 times. Smoking and e-cigarettes allowed. ¥500+ otoshi. Lunch by reservation; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner, chef and hostess at the counter (2024–2026 reviews); not named
chef_bio.background: Opened 24 June 2010 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe a friendly chef, owner and hostess, a counter and sunken tables, à la carte ordering beside courses, and a sake list chosen with care; a June 2025 regular on a 27th visit was glad to see the couple again.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase nigiri; à la carte sushi with sake; winter fugu.

anecdotes.text: A family returns every Obon; in August 2026 they tried the rare funazushi with sake.
"They also allow electronic cigarettes, so if you're looking for a sushi restaurant where you can smoke, I highly recommend this place." — August 2026.
A December 2024 guest’s friend quietly ordered dancing shrimp, still moving, followed by their fried heads; the bill came to about ¥10,000 each with drinks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ぎをん 津崎、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、東山区新橋通り花見小路東入ル、八坂神社北門から徒歩3分、月〜土 12:00〜13:30 (昼は予約のみ)・18:00〜22:00、日曜休み、つきだし500円〜 (日替わり)、持ち込み1本2,000円、13席 (カウンター7、掘りごたつ6)、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、2010年6月24日オープン。口コミ (2023年8月〜2026年8月、英語): おまかせ握りのコースとアラカルト、鯛と平目のえんがわ、踊り海老と頭の唐揚げ、ひれ焼き、雲丹、いくら、鮒寿司、冬のふぐのコース (造り、天ぷら、鍋、雑炊)、昼の海鮮ちらし2,000円 (2023年)、日本酒の品揃え、大将と女将と店主が気さく、毎年お盆に来る家族、27回目の常連、電子たばこも可。

cultural_comfort.note: Order from the menu at the counter or take the omakase; book ahead on busy days.

places.name: ホーフベッカライ エーデッガー・タックス 京都店 (Hofbäckerei Edegger-Tax Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an Austrian bakery of wheat and rye breads, pretzels, croissants and cakes (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter croissants and Danishes, cream-filled cornets, Sachertorte with cream (2026 reviews); ask about plain breads such as pretzels or rye.
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 10:00–18:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday. Products can be reserved; café seats cannot (Tabelog). Take-out is paid first, drinks ordered at the table (October 2026); breads often sell out by lunchtime on holidays (October 2026). Café with a terrace; non-smoking; parking for four cars; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 19 September 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki — 411 m from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Austrian court bakery and café: the Kyoto shop of Graz’s Hofbäckerei Edegger-Tax, founded 1569 (official site) · Handkaiser rolls, pretzel ¥250, Hand-Kaiser with sesame ¥240, rye wholegrain ¥600, croissant ¥360 (September 2026), Kipferl, Salzstangerl, Vollkornbrot · Sachertorte, Kaiserkugelhupf, Sissi Busserl, chestnut tart, Mont Blanc, cornet with whipped cream, Danishes · café drinks on the terrace (official site; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Austrian bakery-café · Okazaki] The Japanese shop of a Graz court bakery founded in 1569, whose eighth-generation owner entrusted its recipes to a Vienna-trained Japanese baker. Handkaiser rolls, pretzels, rye bread and a giant cream cornet to take away, or Sachertorte and chestnut tart on the terrace. Breads sell out early on holidays. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 野澤 孝彦 (のざわ・たかひこ, per the official site)
roles: Chef of the Japanese shop, entrusted with the recipes by Robert Edegger (official site)
chef_bio.origin: Born 1972 in 埼玉県上尾市 (official site).
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Hofbäckerei Edegger-Tax in Graz, founded in 1569, held the Habsburg court warrant; the eighth-generation owner Robert Edegger, in charge since 1992, entrusted the recipes to 野澤 孝彦 and opened the Japanese shop, "from Graz to Kyoto". 野澤 was drawn to Austrian culture through piano lessons, went to Vienna at 22 and trained at the café houses Oberlaa and L. Heiner, learned bread-making at Wandinger in southern Germany, opened Neues in Japan in 1999 and received the recipes from Robert Edegger in 2012. A September 2026 diner remembers the shop near Mansei-bashi in Tokyo and writes that it has moved twice. Opened in Kyoto on 19 September 2020 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「いまを生きる伝統」 — a living tradition, not mere repetition.
chef_bio.specialty: Handkaiser; Sachertorte; Kipferl and pretzels.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor recognised the shop from Mansei-bashi in Tokyo years ago, and found it had moved twice before settling in Kyoto.
"The Lauren... it's about 14 cm long! This is the biggest and longest cornet I've ever seen!" — September 2026.
On a three-day weekend in October 2026 most of the bread was gone by lunchtime; the diner had cake on the terrace instead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (edegger-tax.jp): ホーフベッカライ エーデッガー・タックス、皇帝も愛したパン、王家御用達、1569年創業のグラーツ最古のベーカリー、ハプスブルク帝国の皇帝も認めた、8代目店主ロベルト・エーデッガー氏がウィーンで修行した菓子職人の野澤孝彦シェフに秘伝の技とレシピを託し日本店を開く、グラーツから京都へ、「いまを生きる伝統」、野澤 孝彦 (のざわ・たかひこ) は1972年埼玉県上尾市生まれ、ピアノをきっかけにオーストリア文化に興味、22歳でウィーンへ、Oberlaa・L. Heiner で修行、南ドイツの Wandinger で製パン、1999年に Neues を開業、2012年にレシピを伝授される、ハンドカイザー、キプフェル、ザルツシュタンゲル、クグロフ、カイザークグロフ、ザッハトルテ、シシーブッセル、左京区岡崎成勝寺町3-2、10:00〜18:00、水木定休。食べログ: パン・ケーキ、2020年9月19日オープン、商品の予約は可、席の予約は不可、テラス、駐車場4台、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年11月、英語): プレッツェル250円、ハンドカイザー胡麻240円、ライ麦全粒粉600円、クロワッサン360円、14cmのコルネ、デニッシュ、ザッハトルテ、栗のタルト、モンブラン、休日は昼までにパンが売り切れ、東京の万世橋近くから2度移転、客の半分ほどは海外から。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick breads at the counter and pay first; drinks ordered at the table; about half the customers were from overseas (October 2026).

places.name: ATELIER PAGES KYOTO (アトリエ パージュ 京都)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Financiers, croissants, canelés and cakes are wheat; the gelato and chocolates may suit, but no gluten information is given (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Butter financiers, croissants and cheesecake are not vegan; some gelato flavours (cacao, coconut) may be dairy-free — no information given (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Thu–Tue 10:00–18:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change. Cashless payment only — cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). Take-out by mobile order (official site). A booking-only café upstairs opened in February 2024 and a May 2024 notice paused it; the site still links café booking, and a September 2026 diner found the café crowded at weekends. No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 20 July 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-Oike, above Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn — 94 m from the station
places.cuisine: Pâtisserie, gelato and chocolate from the chef of Paris’s Restaurant Pages (official site) · financiers (classic and chocolate), chocolates of Nicolas Berger couverture, gelato (chocolate 82%, Colombia 100%, seasonal fruit with fromage blanc, coffee) (official site) · canelé, Basque cheesecake, croissants and croffins ¥450, mango-coconut croissant ¥1,500, hojicha pudding (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Pâtisserie & gelato · Kawaramachi-Oike] The Kyoto atelier of Ryuji Teshima, whose Restaurant Pages in Paris holds a Michelin star: AOP-butter financiers best warmed at home, chocolates, and gelato that diners say tastes of the fruit and cacao itself, to take away or eat in. Reviewers rave about the gelato and Basque cheesecake; one found the canelé and financier milder than hoped. Cashless only. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 手島 竜司 (Ryuji Teshima, per the official site)
roles: Owner-chef of RESTAURANT PAGES in Paris, whose products this atelier sells (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: began training at 19 in a French restaurant in Kumamoto, qualified as a sommelier at 23, moved to France at 26 and trained at starred restaurants including the then three-star Lucas Carton in Paris; studied meat at Boucherie Hugo Desnoyer and produce at Terroir d’Avenir; opened RESTAURANT PAGES near the Arc de Triomphe in the 16th arrondissement in 2014 at 37; named "Grand Chef de Demain" by Gault&Millau in 2015 and opened the wine bar 116 next door; one Michelin star in 2016, held eight years running; appointed a goodwill ambassador of Kumamoto in 2016; opened ATELIER PAGES KYOTO in July 2023.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: an atelier for Paris and Kyoto, two cities of layered history, bringing "new esprit" from a Japanese chef shaped in France.
chef_bio.specialty: Financiers; gelato; chocolates.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 "lunch refugee" turned away from two closed restaurants ended up with a ¥1,500 mango-coconut croissant filled with mango, coconut cream and mango pudding — "a delightful calorie bomb".
"It wasn't just a rich chocolate flavor; it truly highlighted the fruity acidity of the cacao itself." — August 2026, on the cacao gelato.
An October 2026 diner found the croffins sugary and less generously filled than in the video.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (atelier-pages.com): ATELIER PAGES、パリと京都に共通する歴史を重ねた街のアトリエ、手島 竜司 (Ryuji Teshima) は熊本県出身、19歳から熊本のフランス料理店で修行、23歳でソムリエ、26歳で渡仏、当時三ツ星の LUCAS CARTON などで修行、BOUCHERIE HUGO DESNOYER と TERROIR D’AVENIR で学ぶ、2014年37歳でパリ16区に RESTAURANT PAGES、2015年ゴーミヨ「未来の巨匠」、隣に BAR A VIN「116」、2016年にミシュラン一つ星 (8年連続)、熊本親善大使、2023年7月 ATELIER PAGES KYOTO オープン、ニコラ・ベルジェのクーベルチュールのショコラ、ジェラート (ショコラ フェルテ82%、ショコラ コロンビア100%、季節のフルーツ＋フロマージュブラン、コーヒー)、AOP バターのフィナンシェ (クラシック、ショコラ)、モバイルオーダー、2階カフェは予約制 (2024年2月に開店、5月に一時休止の告知)。食べログ: 洋菓子・ジェラート・チョコレート、中京区下丸屋町412-3、木〜火 10:00〜18:00、水曜休み、キャッシュレスのみ、2023年7月20日オープン。口コミ (2026年8月〜11月、英語): ジェラート、フィナンシェ、カヌレ、バスクチーズケーキ、クロワッサン、クロッフル450円、マンゴーとココナッツのクロワッサン1,500円、ほうじ茶プリン、週末のカフェは混む、カヌレやフィナンシェは好みが分かれる。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter or by mobile order; cashless only.

places.name: ぎおん石 京そば処 (Gion Ishi Kyo Soba Dokoro)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Soba and udon in soy-based dashi with tempura and kakiage; buckwheat noodles usually contain some wheat and no gluten information is published (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the broth is dashi-based and most bowls add chicken, duck, beef, herring, shrimp or egg; no ingredient list is published (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–19:00 (last order 18:30); closed Wednesday and every other Thursday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; can be a wait at busy times (Tabelog; August 2026). 20 seats: 12 at tables and 8 at the counter; non-smoking; cards; English menu; children welcome (Tabelog). On the 3rd floor of the Gion Ishi building, a stone and gem shop at the foot of the Yasaka Shrine steps, east of the Kyoto Gion Hotel — take the lift at the back of the 1st-floor shop; the 2nd floor is the café Kissa Ishi (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews). Jazz plays in the room (January 2026). 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Foot of the Yasaka Shrine steps, Gion — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto soba and udon (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews) · zaru soba ¥800 (January 2026) · tempura soba hot or cold, tempura zaru soba, tempura bukkake soba · big kakiage soba of shrimp, onion, burdock and maitake with a tempura egg · oyako tofu soba with chicken and egg · duck soba · herring soba · soba with small shrimp and yuba · Kyoto-style beef sukiyaki with soba or udon (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Soba · Gion, a quiet room above a stone shop] A calm soba room on the third floor of the Gion Ishi building, a gem and stone shop right below the Yasaka Shrine steps — ride the lift at the back of the shop, past the 2nd-floor café. Firm, cold zaru soba (¥800), a huge kakiage soba, duck or herring soba, and a beef sukiyaki with soba or udon, to jazz in the background. Few tourists find it, though a queue can form. Closed Wednesday and every other Thursday.

roles: Not named in any source found
chef_bio.background: Part of the Gion Ishi building at the foot of the Yasaka Shrine steps: a stone and gem shop on the 1st floor, the café Kissa Ishi on the 2nd and this soba room on the 3rd (2025–26 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Kakiage soba; zaru soba.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor was greeted at the 1st-floor shop with a cheerful welcome before taking the lift up to the soba room.
A January 2026 diner was warned the large kakiage soba would take a while and found the bowl covered in freshly fried kakiage.
An August 2026 longtime customer of the shop dislikes queuing with tourists.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ぎおん石 京そば処、そば・うどん・うどんすき、東山区四条祇園石段下、京都祇園ホテルの東側、祇園四条駅から徒歩約5分、11:30〜19:00 (L.O. 18:30)、水曜と隔週木曜休み、予約可、20席 (テーブル12、カウンター8)、禁煙、カード可、英語メニュー、ベジタリアンメニュー、子ども可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 天然石の店の3階、2階は喫茶、奥のエレベーター、ざるそば800円、天ぷらそば、かき揚げそば、親子豆腐そば、鴨そば、にしんそば、牛すき焼き、ジャズ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); take the lift at the back of the stone shop.

places.name: 葡萄酒堂 (Wine Do)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Lunch is hamburg steak with demi-glace and rice or bread; dinner brings ravioli, pâté and meat; no gluten information is published — the shop asks guests to mention allergies when booking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steaks of beef and duck, prosciutto, foie gras pâté and meat dishes; the obanzai sides have no published ingredients (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–13:30, café 13:30–16:00, dinner 17:00–24:00 (Tabelog lists last orders 23:00 food and 23:30 drinks, but also notes dinner last order 21:30); closed Sunday (Tabelog). No bookings for drinks-only or dessert-only café visits; tell allergies when booking (Tabelog). Dinner charge ¥330 per person (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「お一人様につきチャージ料330円（税込・ディナータイムのみ）」). 20 seats: 6 at the counter and 14 at tables; cards, transit IC, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). Menu by QR code (July 2026). The owner runs it alone, so large groups may be hard (April and September 2026). Fourth shop down a narrow alley south of the Shijo-Higashinotoin crossing; 2 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn exit 19 (Tabelog). Opened 14 February 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Alley off Higashinotoin south of Shijo — 2 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Wine bar with Italian and Japanese plates at night and a hamburg-steak lunch (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · lunch: classic hamburg steak (200 g) with demi-glace or a daily sauce, three obanzai, rice or bread and miso soup ¥1,300; comparison of the classic and a duck-and-negi hamburg (100 g each) with demi-glace and Kujo-negi sauce ¥1,700; extra rice ¥150 (April–October 2026) · dinner: three kinds of prosciutto, foie gras pâté with berry sauce, salad with ume vinaigrette, meat and ravioli; an all-you-can-drink course with three wines (2026 reviews) · a wide, temperature-kept wine list
places.notes: [Wine bar · Shijo-Karasuma, a one-man alley wine bar] A small wine bar down a narrow alley near Shijo-Higashinotoin, run single-handed by a quiet owner. At lunch it is a hamburg-steak shop — ¥1,300 for a 200 g steak with three homemade obanzai, rice and miso soup, or a classic-and-duck tasting for ¥1,700. At night it turns to wine, with prosciutto, foie gras pâté and ravioli, and an all-you-can-drink course. ¥330 charge at dinner. Sister bar: 葡萄酒堂 musica. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (the invoice holder), who runs the shop alone (April and September 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: The invoice register lists an individual, 川口 真哉, for the shop’s invoice number. Reviewers describe an owner who runs the place alone, reserved but considerate (April 2026), with a well-kept range of wines (March 2026). Opened 14 February 2020 (Tabelog). A sister bar, 葡萄酒堂 musica, appears in the Tabelog crawl.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak lunch with obanzai; wine.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 group of four colleagues found the owner running the place alone — a bit reserved but very considerate.
An August 2026 visitor saw a "closed" sign on a Saturday but heard activity inside, asked, and was served lunch.
A March 2026 diner from Osaka found the 100 g hamburgers light, and the duck one a match for red wine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 葡萄酒堂、ワインバー・イタリアン・日本料理、下京区元悪王子町47-12、烏丸駅・四条駅19番出口から四条東洞院の交差点、東洞院を南へ、パンケーキ店と弁当店の間の路地の4軒目、月〜土・祝 11:30〜13:30・13:30〜16:00・17:00〜24:00、日曜休み、カフェのドリンクのみ・デザートのみの予約不可、アレルギーは予約時に、チャージ330円 (税込・ディナーのみ)、20席 (カウンター6、テーブル14)、カード・交通系IC・QUICPay・PayPay 可、2020年2月14日オープン、インボイス: 川口 真哉 (個人)。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): ハンバーグ定食1,300円 (200g、おばんざい3種、ご飯かパン、味噌汁)、Ishikura-tei のクラシックハンバーグと鴨ネギバーグの食べ比べ1,700円、生ハム3種、フォアグラのパテ、飲み放題のコース、店主が一人で営む。

cultural_comfort.note: One-person shop; QR-code menu; ¥330 dinner charge.

places.name: 割烹 はらだ (Kappou Harada)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Seasonal Kyoto kappo with dashi and soy; no gluten information is published (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led kappo — ayu, hamo, turtle, shellfish — with dashi (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Hours are not published; a July 2025 regular says the shop is closed on Monday, when the owner goes ayu fishing. Reservation only; Tabelog notes it is not strictly introduction-only but bookings may be hard without one. AMEX accepted; non-smoking (Tabelog). Run by the owner and the owner’s wife with a part-time student (September 2026). Formerly on Kawaramachi-dori (July 2025); now off Nakamachi-dori north of Ebisugawa, about 400 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Most diners spend ¥15,000–30,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Nakamachi-dori north of Ebisugawa, near the Imperial Palace — 6 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Kyoto kappo, famous for ayu the owner catches himself (2025–26 reviews) · summer: live ayu as sashimi and grilled twice over charcoal so even the bones can be eaten, wild ayu from Wakayama compared with Lake Biwa ayu, ayu rice cooked with salt and sake only, botan-hamo soup, wild Amakusa turtle soup (July 2025 – September 2026) · spring: hassun of kogomi with sesame, junsai and koi with sansho, torigai, young ayu, Kamo eggplant in dashi, pea rice (May 2026) · autumn: matsutake and maitake dobin-mushi (September 2026) · a turnip "lid" over a dish in winter (February 2026)
places.notes: [Kappo · Marutamachi, the angler chef's ayu] A small kappo near the Imperial Palace, formerly on Kawaramachi, where the owner — a keen angler who fishes for ayu on the weekly day off — cooks seasonal Kyoto dishes with the chef’s wife serving. Summer is the time: live ayu as sashimi and double-grilled until you can eat it bones and all, a side-by-side of wild and Lake Biwa ayu, and ayu rice to finish; spring brings young ayu and pea rice, autumn matsutake. Hard to book without an introduction; about ¥15,000–30,000. Closed Monday per regulars.

roles: Owner-chef (not named) and the owner’s wife, the okami, with a part-time student (September 2026)
chef_bio.background: A July 2025 regular has known the restaurant since it was on Kawaramachi-dori and says the owner, an expert angler, goes ayu fishing on Mondays, the regular day off, lately at Amano in Nara; a September 2026 diner says the couple caught the day’s live ayu in a river in Wakayama. A May 2026 diner praises the chef’s craft and the okami’s attentive service. Many guests are regulars (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Ayu, live and grilled twice; ayu rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 regular trusts the owner’s word that the best ayu comes in the second week of July and visits every year then.
An August 2026 regular compared wild Tomita River ayu with farmed Lake Biwa ayu and found the wild one cleaner and more intense.
A September 2026 first-timer from Kanto, among mostly regulars, was warmly welcomed and finally understood hamo.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 割烹 はらだ、日本料理、中京区中町通夷川上ル鉾田町290、神宮丸太町駅から396m、完全予約制 (完全紹介制ではないが紹介がないと予約が難しいことも)、カード (AMEX) 可、禁煙。口コミ (2026年8月、日本語): お盆明け、八寸、天草産の天然スッポンの椀物、富田川の天然鮎と琵琶湖の養殖鮎の食べ比べ、出汁を入れず塩と酒だけの天然鮎の炊き込みご飯。英語の口コミ (2025〜2026年): 以前は河原町通、店主は釣りの名人で休みの月曜に鮎釣り、2度焼きの鮎、ぼたん鱧、豆ご飯、松茸の土瓶蒸し、店主と奥さんと学生アルバイト。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly regulars; booking may need an introduction; hours not published.

places.name: hakubi
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the shop asks for allergies in advance and may not adapt on the day. The 25-dish course includes dumplings, spring rolls, noodles, XO and black-vinegar sauces (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Chinese course of shark fin, char siu, saliva chicken, seafood, lamb and beef (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch from 12:00; dinner in two seatings at 18:00 and 19:30 (official site: dinner courses 18:00–22:00, about 2.5 hours); open daily except 31 December and 1 January (Tabelog). Reservation only; everyone starts together — be seated 10 minutes early; allergies and dislikes in advance; a ¥3,000 water charge if no drinks are ordered; cancellation 50% the day before and 100% on the day (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: サービス料10％). 26 seats: a counter of 14, a table for 4 and a private room for 8 (Tabelog); a 2nd-floor space, Suo (official site). Cards, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). A wine cellar of over 500 bottles in the basement of an old townhouse (official site; a September 2026 reviewer dates it to the Taisho era). South of Yasaka Shrine; about 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 10 November 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of Yasaka Shrine, Higashiyama — 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Chinese course of about 25 small dishes on the theme of the imperial Manhan banquet, with Kyoto produce (official site) · standard course, 25 dishes, ¥13,000 (dinner, 18:00–22:00), e.g. caviar rice noodles, seasonal vegetables with ham sauce, jellyfish, charcoal char siu, shark-fin pie, matsutake steamed soup, saliva chicken, water dumplings, Hong Kong noodles, hairy-crab spring rolls, Chinese greens, spicy sea bream, jade eggplant with ume sauce, Cantonese shumai with XO, lamb dumplings, black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork, steamed kinmedai, shrimp in chili and in mango mayonnaise, beef in Sichuan chillies, donabe rice of Kyotango rice, pickles, almond tofu, sesame balls (official site) · lunch: 16-dish shark-fin short course ¥13,000 (October 2026) · Buddha-jumps-over-the-wall, Peking duck, truffle shumai (2026 reviews) · wine pairing ¥8,000; Chinese tea and Shaoxing pairings; 500+ wines (official site; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Chinese · Higashiyama, 25 small dishes in an old townhouse] A modern Chinese restaurant in an old Kyoto townhouse south of Yasaka Shrine, opened in November 2024. Chef 佐藤 廉歩, trained in Ginza and Nishi-Azabu, sends out about 25 small plates in one course (¥13,000 at dinner) — caviar rice noodles, charcoal char siu, shark-fin pie, hairy-crab spring rolls, mango-mayo shrimp, Peking duck — with a sommelier's wine pairing from a 500-bottle cellar below. Michelin-listed. 10% service; a ¥3,000 water charge if you order no drinks. Two dinner seatings.

roles: Chef (official site); operator 株式会社ｐａｎｇａｅａ (the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: chef 佐藤 廉歩 honed skills in Ginza and Nishi-Azabu, and cooks traditional Chinese methods with a modern sense; the restaurant offers a course themed on the Manhan banquet, Kyoto ingredients, wine and Chinese-tea pairings chosen by a sommelier, and a cellar of over 500 wines beneath the old townhouse. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ｐａｎｇａｅａ (NTA corporate-number site). Listed in the Michelin Guide (official site news, April 2025; July 2026 review). Opened 10 November 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: each plate brings the chef’s own sense to traditional methods and carefully chosen Kyoto produce.
chef_bio.specialty: Manhan-themed 25-dish course; shark fin; Peking duck.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 group booked a course without shark fin, were shown the shark fin and offered an upgrade, and took it for a birthday.
An August 2026 regular felt unwell from heatstroke and had to leave early, and was touched by how concerned the staff were.
An October 2026 solo diner was glad to be able to book lunch for one.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hakubi-kyoto.com): hakubi、京都 少量多皿中華、「満漢全席」をテーマに約25種の中華料理、京都産の食材、伝統的な調理法にシェフ独自のセンス、ソムリエ厳選のワインや中国茶とのペアリング、古民家の地下に500本以上のワインのセラー、シェフ 佐藤 廉歩 (銀座・西麻布で研鑽)、スタンダードコース25品13,000円 (税込、18:00〜22:00、滞在2時間30分)、一例: キャビア米粉、旬野菜 ハムタンソース、クラゲ、炭火焼き叉焼、フカヒレパイ、松茸蒸しスープ、よだれ鶏、水餃子、香港麺、毛蟹の春巻き、真鯛スパイシー炒め、翡翠茄子 梅ソース、広東焼売 XO醬、ラム肉餃子、黒酢酢豚、金目鯛の蒸し物、海老チリソース、海老マンゴーマヨネーズ、牛肉四川唐辛子煮込み、土鍋ご飯 京丹後米、杏仁豆腐、胡麻団子、2F の Suo。食べログ: 中華料理、東山区清井町481-1、祇園四条駅から徒歩約10分、12:00〜14:00・18:00〜22:00 (夜は18:00と19:30の2部制)、12月31日・1月1日休み、完全予約制、一斉スタート、ドリンクの注文がない場合はお水代3,000円、キャンセル料 前日50%・当日100%、サービス料10%、26席 (カウンター14、テーブル4、個室8)、カード・QUICPay・PayPay 可、インボイス T3040001120567 (株式会社ｐａｎｇａｅａ)、2024年11月10日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): ミシュランセレクテッド、佛跳牆、北京ダック、ワインペアリング8,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Fixed start times; order a drink (or pay a ¥3,000 water charge); 10% service.
