places.name: 豆水楼 祇園店 (Tousuiro, Gion)
places.gf_detail: Some GF options: two gluten-free kaiseki courses, 清水G.F. and 六波羅G.F. (¥13,000), made without wheat flour and with wheat-free seasonings, tofu dengaku replacing nama-fu; book at least three days ahead. The regular courses use nama-fu (wheat gluten) and fried dishes. Cross-contact in the shared kitchen is not addressed — ask (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: the 六波羅 course (¥12,000) uses no meat, fish, egg or dairy, and its dashi uses no niboshi or katsuobushi; a gluten-free version exists. Other courses include fish and Kyoto chicken (official site).
places.hours_raw: Official site (Gion shop page): lunch 11:30–15:00 and dinner 17:00–22:00 Monday–Saturday, dinner to 21:30 on Sundays and holidays (elsewhere on the page 21:00); last entry 20:00; no fixed closing day, closed over New Year. Tabelog gives 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–21:30 Monday–Saturday, 12:00–20:30 Sundays and holidays. Reservations accepted, advised (Tabelog; December 2025). Prices include tax and service (official site). Cards: VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners (Tabelog). 50 seats, including a counter over a sunken hearth and the 古蔵庵, a converted storehouse for up to 8 (Tabelog; official site; December 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Higashioji north of Matsubara, near Yasaka Shrine, Kodai-ji and Kiyomizu-dera; 15 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Higashioji north of Matsubara, near Yasaka Shrine and Kiyomizu-dera — 15 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Tofu kaiseki in a machiya of 130–150 years (both figures appear on the site), with oboro yudofu refills in every course (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · lunch 尾花 ¥5,000 (lunch only); 白河 ¥8,000; 清水 ¥12,000; 六波羅 vegetarian ¥12,000 — all plant-based; 清水G.F. and 六波羅G.F. gluten-free ¥13,000, by reservation three days ahead (official site, tax and service included) · autumn specials 6 November–6 December 2026: 白河 (lunch) ¥10,000, 六波羅 ¥15,000, 音羽 ¥15,000, GF +¥1,000 (official site) · dishes: kumiage yuba and sashimi konnyaku, tofu and nama-fu dengaku, yuba manjū with amber sauce, chestnut tofu, walnut tofu, soy-milk steamed dishes, grilled yuba with miso (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · tofu to take away (official site) · sake, shochu
places.notes: [Tofu kaiseki · Higashioji, vegan and gluten-free courses] The Gion branch of a Kyoto tofu restaurant (the other is on Kiyamachi), in an old machiya with a converted storehouse room, between Yasaka Shrine and Kiyomizu-dera. Every course centres on refillable oboro yudofu, with dengaku, yuba and soy-milk dishes around it, from a ¥5,000 lunch. Unusually, there is a fully plant-based course, 六波羅 (no meat, fish, egg, dairy or fish dashi), and gluten-free versions of two courses — book these three days ahead. Open daily.

roles: Head chef (unnamed), per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 豆水楼 has two shops, on Kiyamachi (a Taisho-era townhouse on the Kamo River, with a summer yuka) and in Gion (a machiya with a storehouse room, 古蔵庵). The site says gluten-free courses were started in response to many requests, mostly from visitors from abroad. A February 2025 regular has come for 22 years.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tofu kaiseki in a traditional machiya; the vegetarian 六波羅 is presented as a new Kyoto tofu kaiseki (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Oboro yudofu; vegetarian and gluten-free tofu kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular of the Kiyamachi shop noticed that Gion serves the tofu as hot yudofu rather than cold, and enjoyed it in the air-conditioning.
A February 2026 diner on the most expensive course loved the grilled yuba with miso but found the yudofu mild and the price hard to justify except as a trip memory.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 豆水楼 祇園店、東山区東大路通松原上ル4丁目毘沙門町38-1、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩約15分、月〜土 昼11:30〜15:00・夜17:00〜22:00、日祝 夜は21:30まで (21:00の表記も)、入店は20時まで、無休 (年末年始は休業)、築150年 (130年の表記も) の町家、蔵を改装した古蔵庵 (2卓、最大8名)、尾花5,000円 (昼のみ)、白河8,000円、清水12,000円、六波羅 (ベジタリアン向け) 12,000円 (肉類、魚介類、卵、乳製品を一切使わず、出汁も煮干しや鰹節を使わない)、清水G.F.・六波羅G.F. 13,000円 (小麦粉を使わず、調味料も小麦粉の入っていないもの、要予約3日前まで)、税サ込、秋の特別懐石 (11/6〜12/6)、名物おぼろ湯豆腐はお代わり可、木屋町店もある。食べログ: 50席、禁煙、カード可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 昼の懐石5,000円、湯豆腐のお代わり、田楽、湯葉、豆乳蒸し、22年通う客。

cultural_comfort.note: English site; vegan and gluten-free courses by reservation; tax and service included.

gf_cross_contamination.text: The official menu describes the G.F. courses as made without wheat flour and with wheat-free seasonings, but does not say whether these courses are prepared apart from the regular ones, which use nama-fu and fried dishes; confirm with the restaurant.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The G.F. courses use seasonings without wheat flour, per the official menu; the regular courses’ soy sauce is not described.

vegan_cross_contact.text: The 六波羅 course uses no meat, fish, egg or dairy and no niboshi or katsuobushi dashi; whether it is cooked apart from the other courses is not stated.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The menu page asks guests to contact the shop about dietary restrictions and allergies (食材の制限、アレルギーなどについては店舗にお問い合わせください).

positives.text: Official gluten-free courses (清水G.F., 六波羅G.F.) made without wheat flour and with wheat-free seasonings, tofu dengaku replacing nama-fu; reservation three days ahead.

places.notes: [Café · Gojo, the Kamo River from every window] A café in the old efish space on the Kamo River’s west bank at Gojo, where window counters and sofas look straight over the water — in summer, at people wading in the river. Come for a Basque cheesecake (¥700, ¥1,000 with a drink) or a kara-age lunch plate and a hand-drip coffee. Busy at weekends; ordering can be a little confusing. PayPay only; pets on the terrace.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor spent the coffee break watching people swimming in the Kamo River.
A September 2026 lunch guest had the kara-age plate but found the hoped-for pudding sold out.

places.notes: [Rice · Yasaka Shrine, breakfast built on the rice] The restaurant of a Kyoto rice merchant, right in front of Yasaka Shrine, where the star is the white rice — cooked in pots, refilled as often as you like, then served as crunchy okoge and finally as chazuke. A grilled-fish set (¥1,980–2,480) carries it. Book a breakfast slot: you order outside ten minutes early and have 50 minutes at the table. Dinner Friday–Sunday only.

roles: Operated by 株式会社八代目儀兵衛 (rice merchant)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator’s job listing (en-japan): a Kyoto rice merchant founded in 1787 (incorporated 2006) that runs three rice restaurants — Kyoto Gion, Tokyo Ginza and OMOYA. An October 2026 reviewer notes Kyoto restaurants and hotels that serve 八代目儀兵衛 rice.
chef_bio.specialty: Pot-cooked white rice; Saikyo-miso sablefish.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner on a second lunch of the day ordered the three-fish set and envied neighbours asking for rice refills.
An October 2026 family waited outside ten minutes early to choose from the menu and wondered how that works on rainy or hot days.
An October 2026 regular found three bowls in one breakfast differed in texture and stickiness, and wondered why.

Cards and e-money accepted; no QR (Tabelog). 21 seats: 7 at the counter, 14 at tables and sofas upstairs (Tabelog; August 2024). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; February 2024). places.cuisine: Soba izakaya open late: drinking snacks and sake, then handmade 100% buckwheat soba to finish (2023–2026 reviews) · otoshi of a rich sake-kasu soup; itawasa; a large potato salad; seared sawara tataki; five-item sake snack plate; wakasagi tempura; duck simmered with shungiku; unagi-maki with grated yam; tempura soba to close (December 2025, Japanese review) · crab-miso cream croquettes, smoky potato salad, shrimp and broad-bean tempura (April 2023) · chicken liver with sansho, simmered bamboo shoot (April 2024) · smoked daikon, mizu-nasu, onion with shuto oil, duck soba, simmered whelk, moringa ohitashi (2025–2026) · zaru soba, hot soba, several soba choices · a wide sake list, e.g. Tsurugoe (May 2026)
places.notes: [Soba izakaya · Nijo-Tominokoji, open until 2 a.m.] A rare late-night spot south of the Imperial Palace: a counter downstairs and sofas upstairs, a long sake list and careful drinking snacks — sawara tataki, duck with shungiku, crab-miso croquettes — then handmade 100% buckwheat soba to finish, cold as zaru or in hot broth (until it sells out). Fair prices. Smoking is allowed inside. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 29 April 2014. A December 2025 Japanese reviewer calls it a valuable late-opening izakaya in the Goshominami area.
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade 100% buckwheat soba; sake.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner had walked past many times taking it for an ordinary izakaya, then found it serves good soba.
A February 2024 diner thought the smoking allowed inside a drawback for non-smokers, but found the food and prices more than made up for it.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Crab courses with sashimi, grilled and shabu-shabu crab, crab-miso in the shell, crab bowls with dashi, zosui and ramen; no gluten information (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a crab-only restaurant — every course is built on live crab (official site).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00 (food last order 20:00); closed the day after a holiday, with variable closures (Tabelog). The official site gives lunch 12:00–17:00 and dinner 17:00–22:00, closed irregularly. Reservation only; courses only for guests of junior-high age and up (Tabelog). Lunch courses ¥12,000 and ¥14,000 (March–May 2026); a lunch-only Kasumi crab bowl set (official site, January 2026); seasonal full courses (official site). places.cuisine: Live-crab specialist run by a Kasumi crab wholesaler founded in 1941, which trucks crabs from the Shibayama and Kasumi ports of Hyogo and keeps the crabs alive until cooking; no seafood but crab (official site) · live Shibayama crab (Matsuba crab) courses from November to March; live Kasumi crab (Benizuwai) from autumn to early summer; Hokkaido hairy crab full course in summer (official site; 2026 reviews) · sashimi, grilled, shabu-shabu, zosui (official site) · lunch: Kasumi crab bowl with crab-miso grilled in the shell and dashi poured over (official site; March 2026); kuppe (young Matsuba crab) lunch in season (January 2026); lunch courses ¥12,000–14,000 (2026 reviews) · matcha pudding to finish (August 2026) · sake, shochu, wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Crab · Gion by Chion-in, live crab from Hyogo] A crab-only restaurant near Yasaka Shrine run by a Kasumi crab wholesaler (in business since 1941) that trucks live crabs from Shibayama and Kasumi ports and cooks each to order: Matsuba (Shibayama) crab in winter, Benizuwai in spring, hairy crab in summer — as sashimi, grilled, shabu-shabu and zosui. Lunch courses are about ¥12,000–14,000, or try the crab bowl finished with dashi. Reviews range from "worth the price" to a March 2026 diner who felt overcharged and was served Kasumi crab instead of the Shibayama on the menu. Reservation only.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site and Tabelog: a crab wholesaler at the Shibayama and Kasumi fishing ports since 1941 (Tabelog EN gives "Kani Nakaori Kaneni", supplying ryokans and restaurants in Kasumi), focusing on the "Shibayama crab" brand of top-graded Matsuba crab, opened this Gion restaurant in February 2024; crabs are kept alive in tanks at the port and delivered by the company's own trucks. An August 2026 reviewer found the owner kind.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Live, ultimate crab" — crabs alive until just before cooking (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Live Matsuba crab; crab bowl with crab-miso shell.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 guest on the ¥14,000 lunch course was surprised at the price, was served Kasumi crab although the menu said Shibayama, found the meat too soft, and wrote: "I really don't want to go back to this restaurant again. However, the staff were nice."
A December 2025 father, whose family crab trip had been cancelled, brought the daughters here instead and ate two servings of Kasumi Matsuba crab.
"Towards the end, I started to feel a bit overwhelmed by the crab (laughs)" — August 2026, on the full course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 祇園 かにを喰らう、兵庫の香住・柴山漁港から自社便で届く「活極蟹」、食事の直前まで生きている蟹を調理する活蟹料理の専門店、八坂神社・知恩院の近く、柴山・香住漁港で1941年創業の蟹仲買人、ブランド「柴山がに」、蟹以外の魚介は出さない、刺身・焼き・しゃぶ・雑炊、活柴山がに (松葉がに) コース、活香住ガニコース、香住ガニ丼と蟹味噌甲羅焼の「香住御膳」(ランチ限定)、Hokkaido の毛蟹フルコース、東山区林下町434 EXIT祇園ビル1F、昼の部12:00〜17:00、夜の部17:00〜22:00、不定休。食べログ: かに・海鮮・日本料理、11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.20:00)、祝日の翌日休み、完全予約制、中学生以上でコースを注文する客のみ、サービス料無し、17席、個室6名、禁煙、カード可、2024年2月オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年8月、英語): ランチコース12,000円・14,000円、クッペのランチ、蟹丼に出汁、抹茶プリン、値段の割にという声 (2026年3月)、店主は親切。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; courses; crab shelled for you; cards accepted.

Opened 1 June 2021 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: "Meat kappo": a single omakase course of many cuts grilled for you at the counter, from the owner of a long-established Kitano Hakubaicho yakiniku house known for hormone (Tabelog; 2024 review) · e.g. salad and kimchi, fresh tongue, grilled cuts, roast-beef salad, Chateaubriand, abomasum with green onion, curry and soup to finish, ice cream (2023–2026 reviews) · wine by the glass, sake, shochu, highballs (Tabelog; 2023 review) · about ¥10,000–20,000 (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Gion opposite Chion-in, grilled for you at the counter] The Gion counter of a long-loved Kitano Hakubaicho hormone house: one omakase course of beef and offal grilled in front of you and served at just the right moment — fresh tongue, Chateaubriand, abomasum with green onion — ending with a curry many ask seconds of. About ¥10,000–15,000; drinks are Gion-priced. Chatty owner and staff, but one 2024 newcomer felt out of place among regulars. Hidden at the back of the building. No children. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the owner of a popular, long-established yakiniku restaurant in Kitano Hakubaicho opened this Gion shop, serving one omakase course of cuts grilled at the counter; opened 1 June 2021. A November 2024 reviewer recalls the parent Ebata near Senbon Imadegawa, famous for gyū-ranegi. Reviewers describe an entertaining manager (July 2025), owner and staff who talk with regulars and first-timers (March 2023), and "the couple running the restaurant" (March 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: A traditional hormone house's flavours served as a counter course (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase meat course; curry to finish.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor found the couple running the restaurant friendly and chatty with tourists, and asked for a second helping of the closing curry.
"Last time, I ended up eating three bowls of rice early on, which made the later part of the meal quite difficult, so this time I practiced some moderation (laughs)." — July 2025.
"Perhaps it was just coincidence, but it felt a bit awkward as we were the only newcomers among regulars. Also, being in Gion, the drinks were understandably pricey." — May 2024.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉、東山区林下町434 EXIT祇園1F、祇園四条駅・東山駅から徒歩7分、火〜日 18:00〜23:00 (最終入店21:00)、月曜休み、完全予約制、14席 (カウンター)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、子ども不可、カード可、2021年6月1日オープン、北野白梅町の老舗焼肉店の店主が祇園に開いた店、おまかせコースのみ、目の前で焼く、肉割烹。口コミ (2023年3月〜2026年3月、英語): 姉妹店の千本今出川のえばた、サラダとキムチ、タン、ローストビーフのサラダ、シャトーブリアン、ギアラのねぎ、締めのカレーとスープ、知恩院の入口の向かい、建物の奥で見つけにくい、店主とスタッフの会話、夫婦で営む (2026年3月)、常連ばかりで気まずかったとの声 (2024年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; one course grilled for you; at the back of the building; no children; cards accepted.

places.name: here
places.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee and tea alongside canelé, croissants, sandwiches and a house pudding; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Lattes can be made with oat milk (official Instagram feed), and black coffee and tea are plant-based, but the pudding, canelé and pastries use egg and dairy (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–18:00, irregular closures; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; order at the counter and you are called to collect (Tabelog; October 2026). Busy with visitors from abroad at times (August–September 2026). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Ground floor of the hotel 椛 京都三条, between Karasuma and Karasuma Oike stations; 10 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 27 July 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo west of Karasuma, hotel ground floor — between Karasuma and Karasuma Oike stations
places.cuisine: Specialty coffee café, one of a small group with a Kyoto kiosk and shops in Tainan and Shanghai (official site) · single-origin espresso, e.g. Ethiopia Bench Maji Geisha G1 Natural ¥400 (October 2026); café latte and iced latte (September 2026); coffee and tea about ¥500 (September 2026); organic green rooibos ¥450 (September 2026) · house pudding ¥650 with vanilla ice cream; canelé; croissants; sandwiches (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Coffee · Sanjo near Karasuma Oike, opens at 9] A spacious, concrete-walled café on the ground floor of a hotel near Karasuma Oike, built around a big shared table: single-origin espresso and fruity iced lattes, a firm house pudding with vanilla ice cream (¥650), and a chewy canelé. Coffee and tea run about ¥400–500. Popular with visitors from abroad, so busy at times. Open daily 9:00–18:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 27 July 2019. Per the official site: the brand also runs here Kyoto kiosk and shops in Tainan and Shanghai, marked its seventh anniversary, and is recruiting staff. Reviewers in 2026 describe staff who explain the coffees attentively and a large open table under exposed concrete.
chef_bio.specialty: Single-origin espresso and latte; pudding; canelé.

anecdotes.text: "The iced latte here is truly delicious! If you love single-origin café lattes, you must visit this place." — September 2026.

An October 2026 guest, back for a second visit after loving the canelé, ordered the pudding and found the price justified by the vanilla-bean ice cream and portion; only the coffee could have been hotter.
"During certain times, it can get quite crowded with inbound tourists, which might not be ideal for those looking to relax alone." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: here、here Kyoto kiosk、Tainan と Shanghai の店舗、7周年、スタッフ募集、オーツミルクのラテ。食べログ: カフェ、中京区姉西洞院町524 椛 京都三条1F、二条城前駅から徒歩10分、毎日 9:00〜18:00、不定休、予約不可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、2019年7月27日オープン。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 烏丸駅と烏丸御池駅の間、ホテルの1階、コンクリート打ち放しで大きなテーブル、エチオピアのエスプレッソ400円、カフェラテ、アイスラテ、コーヒーと紅茶は500円ほど、オーガニックのグリーンルイボス450円、プリン650円 (バニラアイス付き)、カヌレ、クロワッサン、サンドイッチ、海外の客が多く混む時間がある。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter and collect when called; cards and e-money.

places.name: サケホール 益や (SAKE-HALL MASUYA)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Creative izakaya dishes — kara-age, fried octopus and chicken nanban with tartar, corn tempura, spring rolls, yuba pizza, gratin, chilled soba — beside sashimi and tofu; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tofu, ginkgo nuts and some vegetable dishes appear, but most dishes are fish, chicken, beef or cheese; no vegan information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday 17:00–22:30; Friday and the day before a holiday 17:00–23:30; Saturday 15:00–23:30; Sunday 15:00–22:30; holidays 15:00–23:00; closed Wednesday, with other closures posted on Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; seating type (counter or table) may change on the day; same-day bookings possible (Tabelog; September 2026). An otoshi of ¥450 — a small dish with a glass of sake (Tabelog original 付き出し料金450円; August and October 2026). 40 seats at the counter, tables and private rooms (private rooms for courses from ¥6,500); a standing area; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). A renovated townhouse with a courtyard on Takoyakushi east of Karasuma; 3 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takoyakushi east of Karasuma — 3 min walk from Karasuma / Shijo stations
places.cuisine: Sake hall in a renovated townhouse with a courtyard: over 40 sakes from across Japan, changing daily, by the half-gō or in tasting sets, with creative Japanese dishes; weekend daytime drinking; party courses (Tabelog) · e.g. fried octopus with shibazuke tartar, corn tempura, cheese with shuto (August 2026); kara-age with shibazuke tartar, yuba pizza with gorgonzola (September 2026); chicken nanban with curry tartar, eggplant gratin (September 2026); assorted sashimi, spring rolls of fig, avocado and blue cheese (October 2026); ginkgo nuts, tofu, chawanmushi, chilled soba with marbled beef (October 2026) · sake highball; Akabu, Hanayuki (2026 reviews) · bills about ¥3,000–6,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sake hall · Takoyakushi Karasuma, 40 sakes in a townhouse] A renovated townhouse near Shijo Karasuma turned into a sake hall: forty-odd sakes from across Japan, poured by the half-gō or in tasting flights, with knowledgeable staff to guide you, and inventive snacks — octopus or kara-age with shibazuke tartar, yuba pizza, fig and blue-cheese spring rolls. The ¥450 otoshi includes a glass of sake. Counter, tables, a standing area and a courtyard; open from 3 pm at weekends. Drinks can add up. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a renovated Kyoto townhouse with a courtyard, more than 40 sakes chosen from across Japan and changing daily, creative Japanese dishes, and weekend daytime drinking. Reviewers in 2026 describe knowledgeable, younger staff, a sake list organised by type, and staff who phoned a guest about a forgotten umbrella.
chef_bio.philosophy: Casual yet authentic sake, easy for beginners (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sake flights; shibazuke tartar dishes.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 guest who left a folding umbrella behind was promptly phoned by the staff on the number given when booking.
"I started with a Japanese sake highball, and to my surprise, the appetizer came with a small cup of sake as well." — August 2026.
"The drinks were a bit on the pricey side, but the food was so good that I plan to visit again." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本酒バー・居酒屋・日本料理、中京区蛸薬師通烏丸東入ル一蓮社町298-2 1F、烏丸駅・四条駅から徒歩3分、月・火・木 17:00〜22:30、金・祝前日 17:00〜23:30、土 15:00〜23:30、日 15:00〜22:30、祝日 15:00〜23:00、水曜休み (ほかの休みはインスタで)、予約可、付き出し料金450円、40席 (カウンター、テーブル、個室)、立ち飲みあり、禁煙、車椅子可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、京町家を改装、中庭、全国から選んだ日本酒40種以上、半合から、飲み比べ、週末は昼飲み、宴会コース。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 付き出しに日本酒が一杯、たこの唐揚げと柴漬けタルタル、とうもろこしの天ぷら、湯葉のピザ、カレータルタルのチキン南蛮、茄子のグラタン、刺身の盛り合わせ、無花果とアボカドとブルーチーズの春巻き、銀杏、豆腐、茶碗蒸し、霜降り牛の冷やしそば、Akabu、Hanayuki、スタッフが詳しい、忘れた傘を電話で知らせてくれた、酒はやや高め。

cultural_comfort.note: Ask staff to guide a sake flight; ¥450 otoshi with sake; cards, e-money and QR.

places.name: est pizzeria e trattoria GION
places.gf_detail: Ask. A pizzeria of wheat-dough Neapolitan pizza and fresh pasta, with fried starters; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. About 30 pizzas, mostly with cheese, plus meat and seafood starters (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 and dinner 17:30–22:30 (last order); closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; courses must be booked ahead, arriving by 18:00 (Tabelog). No service charge or cover (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料・チャージ料なし」). 19 seats: 6 at a solid-wood counter facing the open kitchen, 8 at tables and a private room for 4–5 (Tabelog; July 2026). Non-smoking; cards and IC cards, no QR (Tabelog). Behind a hidden entrance in a Gion lane, 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (Tabelog). Opened 27 October 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, north of Shijo — 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Neapolitan pizza from a custom wood-fired oven by pizzaioli who won Japan’s national qualifier, and handmade fresh pasta (Tabelog, shop text) · about 30 pizzas — margherita, quattro formaggi, bufalina (2025–26 reviews) · three kinds of fresh pasta, risotto, appetizer platters, braised wagyu tripe, fried porcini and matsutake, fried squid, seasonal corn soup with caviar ¥1,400 (July 2026) (2025–26 reviews) · a walk-in wine cellar about 3 m high, leaning to Burgundy (Tabelog; July 2026) · lunch about ¥3,000–4,000, dinner about ¥10,000–20,000 a head (2025–26 reviews); pizza to take away (October 2025)
places.notes: [Pizza & Italian · Gion, wood-fired pizza behind a hidden door] A Gion pizzeria with a solid-wood counter facing a custom wood-fired oven, where prize-winning pizzaioli bake around 30 Neapolitan pizzas — the bufalina is a favourite — alongside fresh pasta, starters and a deep, Burgundy-heavy cellar. Lunch is a casual ¥3,000–4,000; dinners à la carte run higher, and a couple of reviewers found value only fair. No service charge. Closed Sunday.

roles: Chef and pizzaioli (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): Neapolitan pizza from a custom wood-fired oven by craftsmen who took first place in the Japan representative qualifiers, and fresh pasta by an award-winning chef; opened 27 October 2020. An August 2025 diner noted a pizzaiolo with experience in Italy.
chef_bio.specialty: Neapolitan pizza; fresh pasta.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner loved the porcini and fried squid but found the value not as good as expected.
A June 2025 lunch guest found the margherita delicious but felt something was missing.
A July 2026 diner found aged Burgundies in the walk-in cellar at prices now hard to match.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・ピザ・パスタ、東山区祇園町北側347-147 1F、祇園四条駅7番出口から徒歩6分、昼 11:30〜14:00・夜 17:30〜22:30 (L.O.)、日曜・祝日休み、予約可 (コースは要予約、18時までに来店)、サービス料・チャージ料なし、19席 (カウンター6、テーブル8、個室)、禁煙、カード・交通系IC可、2020年10月27日オープン、特注の薪窯のナポリピッツァ、日本代表選考会で1位の職人、約30種のピッツァ、手打ちの生パスタ、高さ3m のワインセラー。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年10月、英語): bufalina、マルゲリータ、クアトロ・フォルマッジ、ポルチーニのフライ、とうもろこしのスープとキャビア1,400円、ブルゴーニュ中心のワイン、昼は3,000〜4,000円、コスパはいまひとつという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order pizza à la carte; book courses ahead; cards and IC cards.

places.name: 京家 きよみず 祇をん新橋 (Kyoya Kiyomizu Gion Shinbashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Oden in kombu-and-dashi broth, obanzai, sashimi and tempura, seasoned with soy (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the Kyoto oden and obanzai are made with dashi (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: 16:00–22:30 (last order 22:00) daily; closed 31 December–3 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; two guests are usually seated at the counter; cancellation 50% the day before, 100% on the day; seating may be limited to 2 hours when busy (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「チャージ料無し」). Courses from about ¥5,000, ¥7,500 with 90 minutes of all-you-can-drink, and an obanzai, oden and sashimi set for two ¥8,800 (2025–26 reviews). 48 seats: a counter on the ground floor, tatami and private rooms with alcoves upstairs for 3–8, whole-floor use for 18–24 (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR, including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). On Shinbashi-dori east of Hanamikoji, Gion; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 14 March 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion Shinbashi, east of Hanamikoji — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Obanzai and year-round Kyoto oden in a fully renovated machiya over 150 years old, with yuba, nama-fu, Kyoto vegetables and local sake (Tabelog, shop text) · assorted obanzai platter, Kyoto oden in kombu dashi, sashimi of sea bream, squid and bonito, dashimaki, nama-fu dengaku, fresh yuba sashimi, grilled hamo, eggplant tempura, steak, grilled stingray fin, chirimen sansho, Mont Blanc potato salad (2025–26 reviews) · sake from Sasaki Shuzo in Kyoto and from Ine (November 2025) · courses about ¥5,000–7,500; winter premium course with Kyoto beef and oden (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Obanzai & oden izakaya · Gion Shinbashi, a 150-year-old machiya] One of four Kyoya Kiyomizu izakaya, this one in a renovated Gion Shinbashi townhouse with a counter downstairs and tatami rooms above. Order the obanzai platter, Kyoto oden in a gentle kombu dashi, yuba sashimi and nama-fu dengaku, with Kyoto sake. Courses from about ¥5,000, good value for Gion. Open 16:00–22:30 daily; 2-hour limit when busy.

roles: Restaurant of the Kyoya Kiyomizu group; staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): an izakaya in a fully renovated Kyoto machiya over 150 years old, serving obanzai, Kyoto oden all year, yuba, nama-fu and Kyoto vegetables with local sake; opened 14 March 2016. Tabelog lists three other Kyoya Kiyomizu shops — Kiyamachi, Yanagibaba honke and Nishi-Nishikikoji.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto oden; obanzai platter.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular found value had changed a little since earlier visits but still a safe choice under ¥10,000 in Gion.
A September 2026 diner on the ¥7,500 all-you-can-drink course found each type of drink limited to one brand.
A December 2025 year-end party sat on chairs at tables in the upstairs tatami room, easy on the knees.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・おでん・豚しゃぶ、東山区新橋通花見小路東入ル2丁目橋本町416、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日16:00〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、12月31日〜1月3日休み、予約可 (2名はカウンター)、キャンセル料 前日50%・当日100%、混雑時は2時間制、チャージ料無し、48席 (座敷、床の間付きの個室、カウンター)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2016年3月14日オープン、築150年以上の京町家を改装、おばんざい、通年の京おでん、湯葉、生麩、京野菜、地酒。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): おばんざいの盛り合わせ、刺身、だし巻き、生麩田楽、生湯葉の刺身、鱧、コース約5,000円、飲み放題付き7,500円、2人用セット8,800円、飲み放題は銘柄が少ないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; courses or à la carte; cards, IC and QR accepted.

places.name: 食堂ほかげ (Shokudo Hokage)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese dishes with dashi and soy, including agedashi sesame tofu and fried horse mackerel (2024–26 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the vegetable kuzu-hiki and takikomi rice are made with dashi, and fish and meat dishes dominate (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 17:00–21:30; Sun 13:00–20:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day bookings sometimes possible (Tabelog; October 2024). Clay-pot rice takes about 30 minutes, so order it early (July 2022). 10 counter seats, some with a sunken footwell at the back (Tabelog; September 2024). Non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi-dori north of Marutamachi, opposite the prefectural medical university; 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; June 2023).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi Marutamachi — 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: À la carte seasonal Japanese dishes and freshly cooked clay-pot rice from a one-man counter (2024–26 reviews) · takikomi gohan cooked to order, about 30 minutes — shirasu and shiso, sakura shrimp and corn, chicken and burdock, octopus, bamboo shoot with chirimen (2022–26 reviews) · sashimi such as sea bream, kinmedai, ishidai and bonito; seasonal vegetables with kuzu sauce; agedashi sesame tofu; smoked or fried horse mackerel; pork kakuni with poached egg; simmered chicken liver; steamed white fish with domyoji; beef tendon with daikon (2024–26 reviews) · sake tasting sets, a lemon sour of domestic lemons, organic ginger ale (2022–26 reviews) · about ¥4,000–10,000 a head (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese bistro · Kawaramachi Marutamachi, one cook and a clay pot] A ten-seat counter north of Marutamachi run by a single cook, with a long seasonal à la carte list — sashimi, vegetables in kuzu sauce, agedashi sesame tofu — and rice cooked to order in a clay pot (order it first; it takes half an hour), perhaps shirasu and shiso or sakura shrimp and corn. Gentle, careful cooking for about ¥5,000–10,000. Closed Monday; Sunday from 13:00.

roles: Owner-cook (unnamed), running the counter alone (2024–26 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the restaurant as run single-handed by the owner (February 2024, July and September 2026), with a pace that keeps up despite that (July 2026); a February 2024 visitor was sent by the chef of a popular restaurant.
chef_bio.specialty: Clay-pot takikomi gohan; seasonal vegetable kuzu-hiki.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 diner thought 1.5 go of bamboo-shoot rice too much for one, then finished it.
A September 2026 diner asked about the dry lemon sour and learned it uses domestic green lemons.
A July 2022 visitor saw the notice that the rice takes about 30 minutes and ordered sake tastings while waiting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、上京区河原町通丸太町上る出水町273-1、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩5分、火〜土 17:00〜21:30、日 13:00〜20:00、月曜休み、予約可、10席、禁煙、カード可。口コミ (2022年7月〜2026年9月、英語): 店主一人で営むカウンター、季節のアラカルト、土鍋の炊き込みご飯 (約30分、しらすと大葉、桜海老ととうもろこし、鶏ごぼう、蛸、筍)、季節の野菜の葛引き、揚げ出し胡麻豆腐、鯵、豚の角煮、日本酒の飲み比べ、国産レモンのレモンサワー。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; order the clay-pot rice early; Japanese menu; cards accepted.

places.name: うどん しき 京都うどん (Udon Shiki Kyoto Udon)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: handmade wheat udon from four domestic flours, with wheat-batter tempura (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is a bonito dashi (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30), daily (Tabelog). Not taking reservations for now — come in person and join the waiting list by QR code or app; waits of 30 minutes to over an hour (Tabelog; September–October 2026). May close early when the noodles sell out (September 2026). 37 seats: 9 at the counter, 28 at tables; noodle-making room and waiting area upstairs (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). In a quiet residential lane, so you cannot queue outside; 8 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 3 December 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of Shijo near Kawaramachi — 8 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Freshly made chewy udon in a rich bonito dashi, with seasonal vegetable tempura (Tabelog, shop text) · cold tempura bukkake or zaru udon with large shrimp and vegetables ¥1,500–1,650; chicken and egg tempura bukkake; Japanese-style curry udon ¥1,650; nabe-yaki curry udon ¥2,280; "Roppongi udon" ¥2,400; carbonara udon (August–October 2026) · noodles from four kinds of domestic wheat flour (August 2026)
places.notes: [Udon · near Kawaramachi, chewy handmade udon and crisp tempura] A modern machiya-style udon shop opened in December 2025, with a noodle-making room upstairs. The firm, chewy udon comes cold with big shrimp and vegetable tempura, in curry, or as a cheese-and-yolk carbonara; about ¥1,500–2,400. No bookings — sign up on the waiting list (often an hour in the evening) and wander off. Some found the broth and service uneven. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): freshly made, chewy udon with a rich bonito dashi and seasonal vegetable tempura, made in a noodle room on the second floor; opened 3 December 2025. An August 2026 reviewer says the restaurant has roots in Roppongi and uses four domestic wheat flours.
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura bukkake udon; carbonara udon.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, first in at 17:00, waited until 17:20 for orders to be taken and for water, though the tempura was outstanding.
An August 2026 diner liked the chewy noodles but found the broth a poor match and the egg tempura overcooked.
An October 2026 diner waited 65 minutes on a Tuesday night and advised checking in well ahead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・うどん・鍋、下京区丸屋町415-23、京都河原町駅から徒歩8分、毎日 11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、新規予約は受けていない (直接来店)、37席 (カウンター9、テーブル28)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2025年12月3日オープン、2階に製麺室、もちもちの手打ちうどんと濃い鰹出汁、季節の野菜の天ぷら。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 天ぷらぶっかけ1,650円、和風カレーうどん1,650円、鍋焼きカレーうどん2,280円、六本木うどん2,400円、カルボナーラうどん、国産小麦4種、アプリで順番待ち (1時間以上)、麺がなくなり次第終了、出汁が合わないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Join the waiting list by QR code or app; many international guests; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: 日常茶飯 (Nichijo Sahan)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; one set meal of the day with simmered dishes in soy-based sauces, miso soup, rice and pickles (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the day’s main has been chicken meatballs, minced-meat sauce or marinated horse mackerel, with miso soup (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Thu–Tue 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change. No reservations; queues of up to 30–45 minutes at busy times (June and October 2026). 18 seats: tables, a sofa for 4–5, a small counter; third floor of a building, hard to find (2026 reviews). Smoking area; no smoking at lunch (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog.
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-Takakura, third floor — about 7–10 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: One-man set-meal café: a single "one soup, three dishes" set of the day, ¥1,000, with five-grain brown rice or seasoned rice, miso soup and pickles; a bigger portion for a little more at lunch (2026 reviews) · mains seen: thick fried tofu with minced-meat sauce and simmered daikon, chicken meatballs with fried tofu, marinated small horse mackerel; sides of lotus-root and konnyaku kinpira, onion salad, vinegared pumpkin (2026 reviews) · sake, shochu, wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Set meals · Sanjo-Takakura, one man and one soup, three dishes] Up three floors among antiques, a quiet owner cooks and serves alone: one ¥1,000 set a day — a simmered main, two small sides, brown rice, miso soup, pickles — gentle, vegetable-rich Kyoto home cooking that diners call nourishing. Expect a wait at noon and in the evening. A hot May 2026 day with only a fan was uncomfortable. Cash only. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner, cooking and serving alone (August 2026: "run by a quiet gentleman, operating solo")
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a café on the third floor of a building near Sanjo-Takakura, furnished with antiques and vintage pieces, where one person runs everything and serves a single daily set of one soup and three dishes for ¥1,000.
chef_bio.specialty: Ichiju-sansai set of the day.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner who could not find the place at night was walked to the door by a staff member from a nearby okonomiyaki shop.
Turned away at 6:30 pm in June 2026, a diner came back 45 minutes later; on leaving, the diner received an apology for the earlier brusque welcome.
"It was a bit warm that day, and despite having air conditioning, only a fan was on, making it somewhat uncomfortable." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日常茶飯、カフェ・食堂、中京区枡屋町55 三条高倉白鳥ビル3F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩約10分、木〜火 12:00〜15:00・18:00〜21:00、水曜休み、予約不可、18席 (テーブル8、ソファ4〜5、カウンター6)、分煙 (昼は禁煙)、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 一汁三菜の日替わり定食1,000円、五穀米や炊き込みご飯、味噌汁、漬物、昼は大盛り可、厚揚げのそぼろあんと大根、鶏つくねと厚揚げ、小鯵の南蛮漬け、蓮根とこんにゃくのきんぴら、オニオンサラダ、骨董に囲まれた店内、物静かな店主が一人で営業、昼も夜も待つことがある、暑い日に扇風機だけだったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: One set meal, so no menu to read; queue at busy times; cash only.

places.name: ひゃくてんまんてん (Hyakuten Manten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles in a thick curry broth; curry rice made with a roux (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the curry broth is built on dashi and the ramen comes with chashu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 11:00–22:30; Sun and holidays 11:00–19:00. Bookings taken; banquets for two or more from ¥4,000; private hire for 25–36. 36 seats: 12 at the counter, 24 at tables. Smoking allowed (Tabelog). No cards (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Weekday sets until 14:00 come with rice or a mini curry (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-Takakura, on the south side of the Museum of Kyoto, upstairs — 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Curry-ramen diner and izakaya · signature curry ramen in a thick, spiced broth with thin noodles, chashu, green onion and bean sprouts — ¥780 on Tabelog, ¥1,100 in October 2026 · homemade curry rice simmered two days with 38 spices, ¥680 (Tabelog) · daily sets of shoyu or miso ramen with a mini curry; curry udon; rice set ¥200 with kimchi (2026 reviews) · banquets from ¥4,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Curry ramen · Sanjo-Takakura, an old-style diner] Up the stairs beside the Museum of Kyoto, a nostalgic diner known for curry ramen: a thick, dashi-rich curry broth clinging to thin noodles, with fukujinzuke to stir in and rice for the last of the soup. Daily sets pair shoyu or miso ramen with a mini curry. Regulars love it; one found the noodles unremarkable. Open late on weekdays. Smoking allowed; no cards.

roles: Owner who makes the curry daily (Tabelog); not named
chef_bio.background: Tabelog says the owner makes the curry every day, simmering it for two days with 38 spices, and describes a bright, nostalgic diner for everyone from solo diners to families, with banquets for regulars. A September 2026 reviewer calls it a long-established ramen shop; an October 2026 diner was greeted by two friendly women and noticed a noodle-making machine by the second-floor entrance.
chef_bio.specialty: Curry ramen; curry rice.

anecdotes.text: "I had known for years that this place served curry ramen, but I was always hesitant to step inside due to the unassuming entrance." — October 2026.
"The noodles were unremarkable, but the curry broth was classic and well-prepared." — September 2026.
A curry-ramen regular tried the daily miso ramen and mini curry set in November 2026 and found a new favourite.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ひゃくてんまんてん、ラーメン・カレー・居酒屋、中京区三条高倉西入ル京都文化博物館南側 くらしハウス2F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩3分、月〜土 11:00〜22:30、日・祝 11:00〜19:00、予約可、宴会は2名から4,000円〜、貸切25〜36名、36席 (カウンター12、テーブル24)、喫煙可、カード不可、店主が毎日作る38種のスパイスで2日煮込んだカレーライス680円、一番人気のカレーラーメン780円、平日14時までのセットはライスかミニカレー付き。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年11月、英語): カレーラーメン1,100円 (2026年10月)、ライスセット200円とキムチ、細麺、チャーシュー、ねぎ、もやし、福神漬け、日替わりの醤油や味噌ラーメンとミニカレーのセット、カレーうどん、老舗、昭和の食堂のような雰囲気、二人の女性スタッフ、2階入口に製麺機、麺は普通という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter or table; cash only; smoking allowed.

places.name: バイタルサイン (Vital Sign)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; vegetable plates sit beside pasta, couscous salad and pâté (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables lead — Kamo eggplant steak, hummus, grilled zucchini, herb salads — but many plates add fish, oysters, prosciutto, duck or pork (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:30; closed Sunday; hours may change. Bookings taken; Instagram bookings at least two days ahead; urgent matters by phone (Tabelog). A 3% fee is added when paying by card (Tabelog; Japanese original 「クレジット使用時、手数料3%上乗せ」); no e-money or QR. 23 seats including a counter; non-smoking inside, ashtray under the eaves outside (Tabelog). Opened 1 April 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: A quiet alley near Shijo-Kawaramachi, close to the Kamo River — 199 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Creative vegetable dishes and natural wine, mostly Italian in style, with organic vegetables from Shizuhara and Tango (2026 reviews) · seen: Kamo eggplant steak, hummus, grilled zucchini, herb salad of okra and moringa on couscous, sansho pâté, bonito carpaccio, oysters with turnip and turnip-green sauce on yuzu spaghetti, chestnut cream pasta with mushrooms and chicken, duck with red-wine sauce, roast pork with red wine and miso, red-shrimp américaine, white miso with prosciutto and Shine Muscat (2025–2026 reviews) · desserts such as jasmine-tea tiramisu, chamomile-jelly panna cotta, affogato (2026 reviews) · natural wine, Belgian beer, non-alcoholic cocktails (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Vegetables & natural wine · Shijo-Kawaramachi back alley] A dim, minimal room in a quiet alley off Kawaramachi where one chef cooks generous, inventive plates from organic Shizuhara and Tango vegetables — Kamo eggplant steak, oysters with turnip-green sauce on yuzu spaghetti, sansho pâté — to go with natural wine. With one cook, plates come slowly but well timed. 3% extra on cards. Closed Sunday.

roles: Chef who cooks alone (February 2026: "the chef prepares everything by himself"); not named
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 April 2015 (Tabelog). A February 2026 regular on a fourth visit describes organic vegetables from Kyoto’s Shizuhara and Tango, natural wines and non-alcoholic cocktails, all cooked by one chef; an April 2026 diner describes a concrete-toned, dimly lit, minimalist room.
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable plates; natural wine.

anecdotes.text: "The serving speed was slow, but they timed it perfectly with the meal." — May 2026.
A February 2026 regular still remembers the oysters with turnip and turnip-green sauce on yuzu spaghetti.
"The assorted appetizers were packed with vegetables, so if you're craving fish, you might want to choose the carpaccio instead." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バイタルサイン、野菜料理・創作料理・ワインバー、下京区船頭町235、京都河原町駅から199m、月〜土 18:00〜23:30、日曜休み、予約可 (Instagram からは2日前まで)、急ぎは電話、カード利用は手数料3%上乗せ、電子マネー・QR不可、23席、店内禁煙 (店外の軒下に灰皿)、2015年4月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): Shizuhara と Tango の有機野菜、ナチュールワイン、ノンアルコールカクテル、料理人が一人で作る、賀茂茄子のステーキ、フムス、ズッキーニのグリル、オクラとモリンガとクスクスのハーブサラダ、山椒のパテ、鰹のカルパッチョ、牡蠣と蕪と蕪の葉のソースの柚子のスパゲッティ、栗のクリームパスタ、鴨の赤ワインソース、豚のロースト、赤海老のアメリケーヌ、白味噌と生ハムとシャインマスカット、ジャスミン茶のティラミス、カモミールのパンナコッタ、アフォガート、提供はゆっくり、静かな路地の薄暗くミニマルな店内。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte at the counter or tables; book ahead, by Instagram two days in advance.

places.name: くずし理 (Kuzushi Kotowari)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the course uses house-made soy sauces, tempura (hamo, soft roe) and a foie-gras sushi with a ginger-pork style sauce (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and meat course on dashi from bonito, vegetables and fish (official site).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Thu–Tue and holidays 18:00–22:30; closed Wednesday and the last day of each month, plus irregular days. One course a night, ¥8,800 tax included, starting together at 18:00 (official site; December 2024); foie-gras sushi ¥800 extra (Tabelog). A ¥300 charge applies if no drink is ordered (Tabelog; Japanese original 「ドリンクのご注文がない場合は、チャージ料として300円(税込)頂戴いたします。」). Bookings by phone or TableCheck (official site). 16 seats: 10 at the counter, a tatami room upstairs for up to 6; non-smoking; children welcome if counted for the adult course; please avoid strong perfume (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay. Opened 1 October 2021 (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Between Shijo and Gojo — 10 min walk from Gojo Stn and Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: "Kuzushi kappo": creative Japanese with Western touches, one monthly course of about eight dishes for ¥8,800 (official site) · sakizuke, five small appetizers, a soup, sashimi with house-made vegetable soy sauces (grilled-corn soy with flounder), a main "kuzushi" dish, a vinegared course, rice and dessert (official site) · seen: hamo tempura with green-plum purée, asparagus and isaki in clam broth with truffle oil, Kamo eggplant dengaku with grilled-ayu sauce, buri and turnip, soft-roe tempura, guji rice, sakura-shrimp mochi in white miso, cold dashi chazuke with jelly (official site; 2024–2026 reviews) · foie-gras sushi ¥800 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Creative kappo · Shijo-Gojo, one course at six] A ten-seat counter that sets out to "break down" stiff kappo: one ¥8,800 monthly course at 18:00, mixing Japanese technique with Western touches — sashimi with house vegetable soy sauces, hamo tempura with green-plum purée, guji rice — plus the much-ordered foie-gras sushi. Diners call it remarkable value and the service relaxed. ¥300 charge without a drink; no strong perfume. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef from Mie (official site: 生まれ故郷である三重); not named. A July 2025 diner found it run by three men.
chef_bio.origin: Mie Prefecture, per the official site (「生まれ故郷である三重産をはじめ」).
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in October 2021 near Gojo Station aiming to be an everyday kappo, breaking down the formal image of kappo in both mood and food for younger diners; one reasonably priced ¥8,800 course; traditional Japanese technique with Western elements; the name’s 理 recalls 北大路魯山人’s saying that cooking is measuring the principle of things; ingredients from the owner’s home of Mie and from Kyoto (vegetables, hamo, ayu); dashi from bonito, vegetables and fish used by dish; house-made soy sauces blended with seasonal vegetable sauces; antique and contemporary tableware chosen by season.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 崩しつつも細部まで妥協しない本格和食 — breaking down the stiffness of kappo while never compromising on detail.
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly ¥8,800 course; foie-gras sushi; house vegetable soy sauces.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 guest who arrived early found the owner hanging the noren and was invited in; by 18:00 nine guests had arrived for the single seating.
"Given the quality, it felt a bit too affordable, which made me a little worried." — January 2025.
A November 2026 regular on a third visit wondered whether the sudachi and crab on the sesame tofu were really needed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kuzushi-kotowari.com): くずし理 (くずしことわり)、日常使いのできる割烹を目指し2021年10月に五条駅近くに開店、割烹の格式高く堅苦しいイメージを雰囲気と料理の両面から崩したい、若い人にも気軽に、お品書きは8,800円のディナーコース一つ、伝統的な日本料理の技法に洋食の要素、店名の「理」は北大路魯山人の「料理とは、理を料ること」から、毎月変わるコース、生まれ故郷である三重産をはじめ京野菜、ハモ、鮎、出汁は鰹や野菜や魚から、造りや前菜の手作り醤油に野菜のソース、骨董と現代作家の器、先付 (ハモの天ぷらと青梅のすり流し)、前菜5種、椀 (あさり出汁のアスパラとイサキ、トリュフオイル)、造り (ヒラメに焼きとうもろこし醤油)、くずし (賀茂茄子の田楽に焼き鮎の餡)、酢の物 (アコウの昆布締め)、2025年12月30日〜2026年1月7日は年末年始休み、TableCheck で予約。食べログ: 日本料理・海鮮、下京区万寿寺通堺町東入俵屋町239-2、木〜火・祝 18:00〜22:30、水曜と毎月末日休み、不定休、ドリンクの注文がない場合はチャージ料300円 (税込)、16席 (カウンター10、座敷6)、禁煙、子供は大人と同じコースなら可、香水など強い香りは控えて、カード・PayPay 可、追加のフォアグラ寿司800円、2021年10月1日オープン。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年11月、英語): 18時一斉スタート、8,800円のコース、フォアグラの握り、酢のジュレ、鯛と春菊と柚子のたれ、白子の天ぷら、ぐじのご飯、桜海老の餅と白味噌、冷たい出汁茶漬け、男性3人で営む、値段の割に安すぎて心配になるほど。

cultural_comfort.note: One course at a single 18:00 start, each dish explained (September 2026); book ahead; avoid strong perfume.

places.name: LA RISOTTERIA
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists gluten-free options and risotto is rice-based, but pasta, pizza and bread are also served; no detail on how (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the signature risotto alla milanese comes with ossobuco and most risotti use stock and cheese (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00, café 15:00–17:00, dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closing days follow Daimaru Kyoto (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Happy hour with ¥500 drinks (July 2026). 32 seats incl. sofa seats and a counter; English and Simplified Chinese menus with photos; children welcome with kids' menu; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking, smoking area on the floor; cards and QR (Tabelog). On the 8th floor of the Daimaru Kyoto store, linked underground to Karasuma and Shijo Stns (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Daimaru Kyoto 8F, Shijo-Karasuma — linked to Karasuma and Shijo Stns
places.cuisine: Milanese risotto bar using aged Italian rice, with ossobuco on saffron risotto as the specialty (Tabelog) · lunch A (pasta or risotto, dessert, drink) ¥2,200, porcini risotto +¥1,100; lunch B with appetizer plate and soup (2026 reviews) · dinner pair set of appetizers, a risotto and a pasta for two with a drink each ¥8,800; ossobuco alla milanese ¥6,600; Bolognese, Margherita pizza (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Risotto · Daimaru Kyoto 8F] A department-store-top Italian specialising in Milanese risotto of aged Italian rice — the ossobuco on saffron risotto is the dish — with good-value lunch sets from ¥2,200 and a ¥500 happy hour. Part of the local Il Viale group. Open daily with Daimaru's hours.

roles: Run by the eldest son of a sister restaurant's owner, Milan-trained, per a July 2026 review
chef_bio.background: Opened 29 October 2023 (Tabelog). One of the five shops of the Il Viale group named in our record kyoto_ca_del_viale ("Ca’ del Viale, TAVERNA il Viale, the gluten-free deli AL CAMINO, PANINOTECA and LA RISOTTERIA in the Daimaru Kyoto store"). A July 2026 reviewer writes it is run by the eldest son of a sister restaurant's owner, who trained in Milan.
chef_bio.specialty: Ossobuco with saffron risotto.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 lunch guest found the porcini risotto (+¥1,100) short on porcini aroma and "just average" for ¥3,300.
A September 2026 diner savoured the bone marrow of the ¥6,600 ossobuco and the firmly cooked Italian rice.
A May 2026 regular noticed the pasta lunch had gone, leaving risotto lunches only.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): LA RISOTTERIA、イタリアン、下京区四条通高倉西入立売西町79 大丸京都店 8F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から直結、ランチ11:00〜15:00、カフェ15:00〜17:00、ディナー17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、大丸京都店に準ずる、32席、英語・簡体字のメニュー、ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーの対応あり、子供可、2023年10月29日オープン、イタリアの熟成米のリゾット、仔牛すね肉の煮込みとミラノ風サフランのリゾット。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): ランチ A 2,200円、ポルチーニ +1,100円、ディナーのペアセット8,800円、オッソブーコ6,600円、ハッピーアワーのドリンク500円、ミラノで修業した姉妹店のオーナーの長男。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese menus with photos (Tabelog); department-store setting.

places.name: おそば宝来 (Osoba Horai)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A September 2026 reviewer says the soba is 100% buckwheat, but the broths, tempura and small dishes are not described for gluten; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba in dashi broths, duck, beef tendon, sashimi and tempura (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–2:00 (last order 1:00); closed Sunday and on about two other days a month (Tabelog). Bookings taken, also same-day and after midnight by phone (2026 reviews). À la carte only per a September 2026 regular; an omakase course is also possible (February 2026). 15 seats: an L-shaped 9-seat counter and a room upstairs with a sunken table for 6; half portions of soba on request; designated smoking area; children welcome; cards (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). In a narrow alley in Gion north of Shijo (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo, in a narrow alley — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Late-night soba and small plates from the 和食 宝来 group: juwari (100% buckwheat) soba — mori soba, duck soba with kabosu, cold duck soba, beef tendon and Kujo negi soba, green curry soba, white sweet potato and ginger-sauce soba, kake soba (2026 reviews) · sashimi (bonito, hamo, squid), tender simmered octopus, saba sushi, karasumi mochi, fried white shrimp, kisu tempura, duck roast, sansho-grilled chicken, fugu and oysters in season; sake such as Hidakami (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Soba · Gion, open to 2 am] A late-night counter in a Gion alley for 100% buckwheat soba and sake snacks — simmered octopus, karasumi mochi, sashimi — and surprises like green-curry soba. Sister of the popular 和食 宝来. About ¥5,000–15,000 depending on how far you go. Open until 2 am; closed Sunday.

roles: Operator: the 和食 宝来 group (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 16 January 2024 (Tabelog) as a sister restaurant of 和食 宝来 (Tabelog remarks: "Washoku Horai Group of Restaurants"; September 2026 review). A January 2026 reviewer finds the main Horai better for soba but often fully booked.
chef_bio.specialty: Juwari soba late at night.

anecdotes.text: A nine-time regular phoned after midnight in September 2026 and was eating by 12:30 am.
An April 2026 late-night diner found the green curry soba "surprisingly" well matched to the broth.
A February 2026 party of three spent ¥57,000 on the omakase course with a bottle of champagne in the upstairs room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): おそば宝来、そば、東山区祇園町北側338-4、月〜土 18:00〜翌2:00 (L.O. 1:00)、日曜休み、月2回ほど不定休、15席 (カウンター9、個室6)、分煙、子供可、2024年1月16日オープン、和食宝来グループ。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): 和食宝来の姉妹店、深夜0時過ぎの電話予約、十割そば、鴨とかぼすのそば、牛すじと九条ねぎのそば、グリーンカレーそば、蛸の柔らか煮、からすみ餅、白海老の唐揚げ、鯖寿司、ふぐや牡蠣、2階の掘りごたつ、半量のそば。

cultural_comfort.note: Late-night counter; book by phone, even same day.

places.name: 京氷菓 つらら (Kyo Hyoka Tsurara)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Shaved ice is naturally wheat-free, but toppings include pie, granola and tiramisu-style creams; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: most kakigori carry cream, mascarpone, milk or cheese (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Fri 11:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 10:30–19:30 (last order 19:00); closed Tuesday, open on holiday Tuesdays (Tabelog). Bookings online only, opening at midnight two weeks ahead (Tabelog); walk-ins can wait in an air-conditioned waiting room nearby (September 2026), and in October booking was not needed (October 2026). Warm tea served with the ice (September 2026). 40 seats; children welcome; non-smoking; no cards — e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 10 min from JR Nijo Stn; 3 min from the Senbon Kyu-Nijo bus stop (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishinokyo west of Nijo Castle — 10 min from JR Nijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kakigori with seasonal fruit syrups and creams, changing through the year: chestnut caramel pie and Japanese chestnut hojicha milk, persimmon or grape with gorgonzola, fig and sansho cream cheese, strawberry mascarpone, tiramisu, peach and muscat in season, a pumpkin Halloween special (2025–26 reviews) · about ¥1,700 a bowl (September 2026)
places.notes: [Kakigori · near Nijo Castle] Kyoto's cult shaved-ice shop: fluffy ice built up with seasonal fruit, creams and surprising savoury notes — gorgonzola with grapes, fig with sansho cream cheese, chestnut caramel pie. About ¥1,700 a bowl, with warm tea. Book online two weeks ahead in summer. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 25 July 2019 (Tabelog). The menu changes with the seasons (2025–26 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fruit kakigori with cheese creams.

anecdotes.text: A 27-time visitor in October 2026 found the pumpkin flavour of the Halloween special weak and wanted more cassis sauce.
One visitor waited 30 minutes the previous August; booking online for September 2026 meant walking straight in at opening.
"This is the place that got me hooked on shaved ice" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 京氷菓 つらら、かき氷、中京区西ノ京内畑町22、JR二条駅から徒歩10分、月水木金 11:00〜19:00 (L.O. 18:30)、土日祝 10:30〜19:30 (L.O. 19:00)、火曜休み (祝日は営業)、予約はネットのみで2週間前の0時から、40席、カード不可・電子マネーと PayPay 可、2019年7月25日オープン。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 和栗のほうじ茶ミルク、栗のキャラメルパイ、柿や葡萄とゴルゴンゾーラ、無花果と山椒のクリームチーズ、苺のマスカルポーネ、ティラミス、かぼちゃ、温かいお茶、1,700円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online two weeks ahead in season; no cards.

places.name: 野菜と魚 en (Yasai to Sakana en)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tempura, fried dishes, spring rolls and ponzu; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables are half the concept, but dishes often pair them with fish, salmon miso or bonito; only one or two meat dishes (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.hours_raw: 16:30–22:30 daily, closing days may vary (Tabelog). Cash only; two-hour limit; cancellations and party-size changes by the day before (Tabelog). Courses ¥5,000 and ¥6,000 with optional all-you-can-drink (Tabelog). 35 seats: a U-shaped counter of about 15 on the ground floor, tables for 20 upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). In a renovated machiya south of Ayanokoji; 5 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ayanokoji near Shijo-Karasuma, in a machiya alley — 5 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: A "slightly more adult" izakaya of seasonal vegetables and fish: charcoal-grilled salmon potato salad, straw-smoked bonito with onions from an Awaji farm, tempura with house lemon pepper, namero, spring rolls of Aomori apple and sweet potato with Kumamoto ricotta, served on Shigaraki and antique ware (Tabelog) · in reviews: Awaji pepper with salmon miso, bonito tataki in ponzu jelly, nameko tempura, a whole warm eggplant, eel claypot rice (leftovers made into onigiri to take home), lemongrass sour (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Vegetable-and-fish izakaya · near Shijo-Karasuma] The grown-up sister of 野菜酒場あしおと: a stylish machiya with a U-shaped counter, cooking seasonal vegetables and fish with care — straw-smoked bonito, lemon-pepper tempura — and claypot rice to finish (leftovers come back as onigiri). About ¥4,000–6,000. Cash only; book.

chef_bio.background: Opened 17 April 2025 (Tabelog). Per the operator: born as a sister of あしおと (野菜酒場あしおと, a few doors away per reviewers), aimed at diners aged 30 to 50.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal vegetables with fish; claypot rice.

anecdotes.text: Two August 2026 diners who could not finish the claypot rice were given the rest as onigiri to take home.
One August 2026 diner missed a wanted dish after an order mix-up, but was satisfied overall.
A September 2026 fan of the sister shop next door found the menu a little limited.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 野菜と魚 en、居酒屋、下京区綾小路柳馬場下ル永原町153-10、四条駅から徒歩5分、16:30〜22:30、休みは変動あり、現金のみ、2時間制、キャンセルと人数変更は前日まで、35席 (1階カウンター約15、2階テーブル20)、2025年4月17日オープン、あしおとの姉妹店、30〜50代向けの少し大人の酒場、鮭の炭火焼きポテサラ、藁焼きの戻り鰹とAwajiの玉ねぎ、自家製レモンペッパーの天ぷら、なめろう、Aomoriの林檎と薩摩芋とKumamotoのリコッタの春巻き、信楽焼と骨董の器、5,000円と6,000円のコース。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 鮭味噌、鰹のたたきのポン酢ジュレ、なめこの天ぷら、焼き茄子、鰻の土鍋ご飯、残りはおにぎりに、レモングラスサワー。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; two-hour limit; book ahead.

places.name: Planetarium Cafe&Bar Misora
places.gf_detail: Ask. Cocktails, drinkable parfaits, churros and bar snacks; no gluten information is published (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Many drinks and mocktails may suit, but parfaits, desserts and snacks (prosciutto and mozzarella) use dairy or meat; no ingredient list is published (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 Monday to Friday; 12:00–23:00 Saturday, Sunday and holidays (last order 22:30, last entry 22:00); open year-round (Tabelog). Seat charge: ¥520 until 17:00, ¥1,020 after 17:00, tax included (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「オープンから17時まで520円(税込)17時以降1020円(税込)」); small snacks come with drinks (2025–26 reviews). Bookings taken; advised on Friday and Saturday nights (July 2024). 20 seats: 14 at tables (deep sofas) and 6 at the counter; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Very dim inside, with stars and a moon projected round the walls (2024–26 reviews). On the 4th floor of 祇園ファーストビル on the north side of Gion, in an ordinary mixed-use building that can be hard to spot; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). Opened 7 July 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: North side of Gion near Yasaka Shrine — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Planetarium café and bar under a projected starry sky (2024–26 reviews) · original cocktails such as Shooting Star (apple), Eclat (mango), Apollo (chocolate liqueur and cranberry sorbet), Soleil, with star-shaped ice or pineapple; drinks from ¥780 (July 2024) · five or more non-alcoholic cocktails, Shirley Temple · limited drinkable parfaits (mango, berry), chocolate churros, prosciutto and mozzarella (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Café & bar · Gion, cocktails under a planetarium sky] A dim café-bar on the fourth floor of an ordinary Gion building, where a planetarium projector fills the walls with stars and a moon over deep sofas — billed as Kyoto's first planetarium café and bar. Space-themed cocktails with star-shaped ice (from about ¥780), plenty of mocktails, drinkable parfaits and churros. Seat charge ¥520 by day, ¥1,020 after 17:00. Book on weekend nights. Open daily, to 23:00.

roles: Not named in any source found
chef_bio.background: Opened 7 July 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers call it the first planetarium café and bar in Kyoto (May 2025, May 2026), with a projector made by a planetarium designer (May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Space-themed cocktails; drinkable parfaits.

anecdotes.text: A July 2024 visitor found the moon-shaped table lamps and star-shaped pineapple garnishes a sign of the care for detail.
A February 2025 visitor found it too dark for table photos, but liked the complimentary salty snacks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Planetarium Cafe&Bar Misora、バー・カフェ・バル、東山区祇園町北側281-1 祇園ファーストビル 4F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜金 17:00〜23:00、土日祝 12:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30、最終入店22:00)、無休、チャージ オープンから17時まで520円・17時以降1,020円 (税込)、予約可、20席 (テーブル14、カウンター6)、カード・PayPay 可、2022年7月7日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 京都初のプラネタリウムカフェ&バー、星と月の投影、オリジナルカクテル、星形の氷、ノンアルコールカクテル、飲むパフェ、チュロス、お通しの小皿。

cultural_comfort.note: Seat charge ¥520–1,020; very dark room; book on weekend nights.

places.name: カフェビストロ オーボンモルソー (Cafe Bistro Au Bon Morceau)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Lyonnaise bistro food with bread, gratinéed onion soup, sausages and sauces; Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but no gluten information is published (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the menu centres on meat, offal and fish, with butter and cream; no vegan dish is named (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–24:00 (last orders food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Tuesday and the third Wednesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; busy on Friday nights (August 2026). Tabelog’s Japanese original lists no service charge (「なし」), while a September 2026 reviewer mentions a 5% service charge. 26 seats: a counter of 4 and tables; non-smoking; cards; English menu; school-age children welcome (Tabelog). Walls covered with French paintings, posters and plates collected by the chef (2025–26 reviews). Off Kawaramachi-dori north of Sanjo, by Aneyakoji; moved here about 2018 from near Nishiki Market / Teramachi; 5 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae or Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). Opened 2001 (2025–26 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Off Kawaramachi north of Sanjo — 5 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Traditional Lyonnaise bistro cooking with organic wines (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews) · AAAAA-certified andouillette, the house speciality · boudin noir, branded sausages · escargots bourguignonne, French onion soup, soupe de poisson, foie gras terrine, smoked mackerel and potato salad, salmon salad · steak, onglet, beef braised in red wine with macaroni, horse tartare with chips · crêpes Suzette, baba · a starter-and-main set ¥2,000 (May 2025); glass of Côtes du Rhône ¥900 (September 2026) · bread served in a paper bag
places.notes: [French bistro · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, Lyon in a cluttered room] A crowded, cheerful Lyonnaise bistro off Kawaramachi, its walls covered with French paintings and posters, run since 2001 by chef Masaki Kubo, who trained in Osaka, Tokyo, Lyon and Paris. The speciality is andouillette — the shop holds the AAAAA certification, the first outside France — alongside boudin noir, escargots, onion soup, steak and red-wine beef, with crêpes Suzette to finish and organic wines. Good value; book on Fridays. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per a November 2025 reviewer: owner-chef Masaki Kubo, born in Kyoto, studied French cooking in Osaka and Tokyo after high school, honed it in Lyon and Paris, and opened the restaurant in 2001; the paintings, posters and coasters on the walls are the chef’s collection. Per a September 2026 reviewer: the chef has pursued the perfect andouillette since meeting it in Paris, and the restaurant holds the first certification outside France from the Association Amicale des Amateurs d’Andouillette Authentique (AAAAA); the shop has been at the present address about eight years. Tabelog’s introduction says it moved from Teramachi. Name known only in Latin letters.
chef_bio.specialty: AAAAA andouillette; Lyonnaise bistro dishes.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 solo diner, sent here by a chef from another restaurant, was let in ten minutes before opening.
An April 2026 regular found prices and portions less satisfying than before, perhaps due to recent costs.
An April 2026 diner noticed French customers too and took it as a sign of quality.

places.name: 鰻・割烹 戸石 (Unagi Kappo Toishi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Eel grilled with a sweet tare, tempura and dashi dishes; plain shirayaki is also served, but no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant with seasonal fish and crab courses (2026 reviews; Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 21:00), daily (Tabelog). Reservation only, with the donabe rice timed to your arrival (September 2026). Tabelog’s English page says a service charge is added, but its Japanese original reads 「無し」 (none). 16 seats: a counter of about 10 and tables; non-smoking; no children under 10; cards (Tabelog). Parking very close by (July 2026). About 5 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn exit 11 (Tabelog). Opened 3 April 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Between Kyoto City Hall and Karasuma-Oike — 5 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Kansai-style jiyaki eel — grilled without steaming for a crisp skin — with seasonal kappo dishes (2026 reviews) · unaju of 1.5 eels (September 2026) · course ¥7,800 (July 2026); seasonal eel course ¥10,000 (September 2026): starters, sashimi, soup, chilled eel with myoga and cucumber in dashi jelly, tempura, kabayaki and shirayaki · donabe rice cooked to order with rice from the rice shop "Hachidaime Gihei" · male eels from Isshiki, per a July 2026 reviewer · crab and game in season (Tabelog categories)
places.notes: [Eel · City Hall, crisp jiyaki eel with kappo courses] A sixteen-seat counter-and-table eel kappo near Kyoto City Hall, opened in 2024 by a young chef who previously grilled eel at the Gion restaurant 時菜今日萬, per reviewers. The eel is grilled Kansai-style without steaming, for a crackling skin — some love it, one reviewer found it dry — served as unaju or in seasonal courses (about ¥7,800–10,000) with tempura and rice cooked in a donabe to your arrival. Booking only; no children under 10.

roles: Young owner-chef (not named) with the okami (September 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 April 2024 (Tabelog). Reviewers who followed the chef say the eel was cooked earlier at 時菜今日萬 (Tokina Kyo-man) in Gion (September 2026). Reviewers describe a young, friendly chef at the counter and the owner and okami chatting with guests (September 2026). The rice comes from "Hachidaime Gihei" (July and September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Crisp jiyaki eel; donabe rice.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular who followed the chef from 時菜今日萬 chooses restaurants by who is cooking, not where.
A September 2026 diner found the eel more crunchy than crispy, firm and in parts like eel jerky, with a thick, sweet sauce.
Another September 2026 diner, who had eaten the chef’s eel three times, preferred the richer, fattier style of the 今日萬 days.

places.name: 喫茶 ソワレ (Kissa Soiree)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The menu is mostly drinks, jelly drinks, ice cream and floats, with cakes and thick toast; no gluten information is published (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The official menu says the five-colour jelly is not agar (so likely gelatin), and many drinks use milk, yogurt or ice cream; plain coffee, tea and sodas may suit (official menu).
places.hours_raw: 13:00–19:00 Tuesday to Friday (last order 18:00); 13:00–19:30 Saturday, Sunday and holidays (last order 18:30); closed Monday, even on holidays; a monthly opening calendar is posted on the official site (official site; Tabelog). No bookings; queues of several groups at weekends (Tabelog; September–October 2026). 52 seats on two floors, small and narrow to fit the Japanese builds of the 1940s; fully non-smoking since October 2016; cards (official site; Tabelog). No background music, and blue lighting throughout (official site). About 30 m from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn exit 1A, on Nishi-Kiyamachi north of Shijo (official site). Opened 11 April 1948 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi north of Shijo, by the Takase River — 1 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Blue-lit kissaten famous for five-colour jelly drinks (official site) · jelly punch with Kobe local cider ¥850, jelly punch float ¥950, yogurt punch ¥1,000, jelly milk ¥800, jelly yogurt ¥850, jelly coffee ¥850, jelly wine ¥900, jelly coffee float ¥950 · ice cream ¥800, seasonal ice cream ¥850, orange sherbet ¥800, kiwi float (May–December) ¥950 · cream soda in six colours ¥800, cream coffee ¥800, cream cocoa ¥850, cream cola ¥800 · cake ¥550, thick toast to share (butter and cinnamon sugar, jam and marmalade, or chocolate and cream) ¥650 · blend coffee in Koransha cups with line drawings made for the shop by 東郷青児 (official menu) · iced lemon tea ¥650 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Kissaten · Kawaramachi, jelly punch under blue light since 1948] A two-floor coffee house by the Takase River, opened in 1948 and designed with artist friends of the founder: carved wood by the sculptor 池野禎春, blue lights chosen by a dye scholar, paintings by 東郷青児 and other Nika-kai artists, and no background music. Order the jelly punch (¥850) — five colours of jelly sparkling in soda, created by the second owner's wife in the 1970s — or a cream soda, with thick toast to share. Chairs are small; expect a queue at weekends. Closed Monday.

roles: Family-run since 1948 (founder 元木和夫; jelly menu by 元木成子, wife of the second owner); current owner not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened on 11 April 1948, just after the war; the building and furnishings were created by the founder 元木和夫’s cultural friends — painter 佐々木良三, sculptor 池野禎春 (whose French training shaped the carved interior), dye scholar 上村六郎 (who suggested the blue light that makes women look beautiful and men young) and count-poet 𠮷井勇 (whose poem stands by the door); the line drawings on the cups were drawn for the shop by 東郷青児; 元木成子 (1937–1991), wife of the second owner, created the jelly drinks — first jelly milk for a daughter who disliked milk, then jelly punch from 1975 to bring in young women. The shop sells original Koransha cups and holds the jelly punch trademark (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "Soirée" means an evening party — a dreamlike room that feels like night even by day.
chef_bio.specialty: Jelly punch; cream soda.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor found the jelly almost tasteless and the soda faint, but loved how it looked.
A September 2026 Sunday visitor waited 20 minutes behind four groups.
A September 2026 visitor noted the cramped seats are sized for the bodies of an earlier era.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (soiree-kyoto.com): 喫茶ソワレ、京都河原町、昭和23年創業の老舗喫茶、1948年4月11日開店、建物や調度品は洋画家 佐々木良三、彫刻家 池野禎春、大学教授 上村六郎、伯爵歌人 𠮷井勇らの文化人が創った、BGM なし、青い照明、座席は当時の日本人の体格に合わせて小さい、ソワレはフランス語で「夜会」、東郷青児の線画、有田 香蘭社のカップ12,000円、ゼリーの誘惑: 2代目オーナーの妻 元木成子が考案、ゼリーポンチは1975年から、ゼリーポンチ850円、ゼリーポンチフロート950円、ヨーグルトポンチ1,000円、ゼリーミルク800円、ゼリーヨーグルト850円、ゼリーコーヒー850円、ゼリーワイン900円、5色のゼリーは寒天ではない、神戸産の地サイダー、アイスクリーム800円、クリームソーダ6種800円、ケーキ550円、トースト650円、営業: 平日13:00〜19:00 (L.O. 18:00)、土日祝13:00〜19:30 (L.O. 18:30)、月曜定休 (祝日も休業)、下京区西木屋町通四条上る真町95、京都河原町駅1A番出口から約30m。食べログ: 喫茶店、予約不可、52席、2016年10月から全面禁煙、カード可。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語)。

cultural_comfort.note: No bookings; weekend queues; small seats; no music.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists gluten-free options, but the reviewed dishes include tempura, fried lotus root and camembert, shumai, chicken-dashi soba and white-miso motsunabe; which dishes are gluten-free is not stated (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options and the menu leans on vegetables (steamed seasonal vegetables with dips, whole tomato), but which dishes are plant-only and dashi-free is not stated (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30, reservation-only courses; dinner 17:00–22:30, daily; irregular closures (Tabelog). When full, the shop directs guests to its Karasuma Sanjo branch (075-256-5177) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, with foreign-language booking support (Tabelog). Otoshi charge ¥440 a head (Tabelog, original 先付け料). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 48 seats in machiya semi-private rooms, sunken-kotatsu tables and a room for 20; private hire 30–50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; Wi-Fi; children and pets welcome (Tabelog). English and Chinese menus; QR ordering (Tabelog; May 2025). Kiyamachi north of Oike, 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 27 April 2009 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Oike — 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Vegetable-led izakaya “of the vegetable sommelier”, in machiya rooms (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · seasonal vegetables steamed in a bamboo basket, about twelve kinds, with miso, salt and sesame dips ¥900; artisan mapo tofu ¥700; “My House’s Whole Tomato” with sorbet ¥640 (July 2026) · white-miso motsunabe; hot-pot courses with appetizers such as white sesame tofu (2025–2026) · grilled eggplant, bamboo-shoot tempura, shumai, fried lotus root, fried camembert or mozzarella, tongue stir-fried with vegetables, pork kakuni, chicken-dashi soba (2025–2026) · Heartland draft, black-sesame shochu, craft beer, fruit liqueurs (May 2025)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi-Oike, vegetables in machiya rooms] A quiet, vegetable-minded izakaya in machiya semi-private rooms just north of Oike on Kiyamachi, open since 2009. Start with a bamboo steamer of a dozen seasonal vegetables and three dips (¥900), a whole chilled tomato, and the house mapo tofu; groups come for white-miso motsunabe courses. Order by QR code; English and Chinese menus. ¥440 otoshi. A June 2026 diner met a rude staff member; an October 2026 regular praises the warm owner-chef.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 27 April 2009; a July 2026 reviewer marks its 17th year. The Tabelog listing names a sister shop, 十祇家 烏丸三条店. An October 2026 regular was remembered after four months and calls the owner and chef warm.
chef_bio.specialty: Steamed seasonal vegetables; mapo tofu; motsunabe.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 diner, coupon in hand after training, ordered a three-person motsunabe alone and finished it — mostly vegetables, so it cooked down.
A June 2026 diner enjoyed the pork kakuni but was let down by a rude male staff member near the end.
