places.name: 亀甲屋 (Kikkouya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pulled yuba with a dipping sauce and soy, shabu-shabu, obanzai, nama-fu (wheat gluten), tempura and fried dishes; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The yuba pot is soy milk set with nigari into tofu, and there are vegetable obanzai, but the sauces and shabu broth are not described for dashi (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:00); closed Wednesday and irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day booking sometimes possible (Tabelog; December 2025). Seat charge ¥390 with an otoshi (Tabelog, original お席料 (付だしつき)); one drink per person (May 2025). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats: 8 at the counter, 10 at tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; English menu and English-speaking staff; children welcome (Tabelog). In a machiya — 70 years old per one review, over 100 per another — on Takakura south of Oike, 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn exit 3-1 (Tabelog; August 2025; June 2026). Opened 29 May 1989 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takakura south of Oike — 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto dishes and obanzai with local sake in a machiya (Tabelog shop text; 2025–2026 reviews) · hikiage yuba: soy milk warmed over a candle, pull the skins with a skewer, then set the rest with nigari into oboro tofu (2025–2026) · shabu-shabu of Kyoto Tanba beef and mochi pork in Kyo-bancha dashi, as a course or from one serving (Tabelog shop text; August 2025) · yuba ankake rice; chirimen-sansho rice; three-colour rice (2025–2026) · colourful nama-fu grilled with olive oil; fried taro; sawara Saikyo-yaki; potato salad; mizu-nasu with olive oil and prosciutto; octopus with Tosa vinegar; beef tendon in demi-glace; fried mochi pork; sayori sashimi (2025–2026) · Kyoto sake (including Eikun), seasonal sake, domestic wine, kokuto shochu, fruit liqueurs; Kyo-bancha (Tabelog; 2025)
places.notes: [Kyoto dishes · Karasuma-Oike, pull your own yuba] A long-running (since 1989) counter-and-tables restaurant in an old machiya on Takakura, where the signature is hikiage yuba: you lift skins from soy milk warming over a candle, then the staff set the rest into tofu. Around it, Kyoto obanzai, grilled nama-fu, Tanba-beef or mochi-pork shabu-shabu and yuba-ankake rice, with plenty of Kyoto sake. Not cheap for the portions, some say. ¥390 seat charge; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 29 May 1989; a June 2025 visitor arrived on the 36th anniversary, with flowers at the entrance. Several reviewers return every year.
chef_bio.philosophy: Traditional dishes from carefully chosen Kyoto ingredients in a modern machiya (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Hikiage yuba; Kyo-bancha shabu-shabu.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 parent brought a high-school daughter who wanted to make yuba; the daughter asked for seconds of the potato salad.
A June 2025 business traveller enjoyed pulling yuba but felt the course small and the value short of the price.
An August 2025 couple who come every year found the usual Eikun sold out and shared about six go of sake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 亀甲屋、日本料理・豆腐料理・しゃぶしゃぶ、中京区高倉通御池下ル亀甲屋町601、烏丸御池駅3-1番出口から徒歩5分、17:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.21:00)、水曜・不定休、予約可、お席料 (付だしつき) 390円、カード (VISA、Master、JCB)、18席 (カウンター8、テーブル10)、禁煙、Wi-Fi、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、子ども可、1989年5月29日オープン。店の紹介: 京町家で京の食材の料理、引き上げ湯葉、Kyo-Tanba の牛ともち豚のしゃぶしゃぶ (Kyo-bancha の出汁)、京都の地酒、季節の酒、国産ワイン、黒糖焼酎、果実酒。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 1ドリンク制、湯葉のあんかけご飯、ちりめん山椒ご飯、彩り生麩のオリーブオイル焼き、鰆の西京焼き、ポテトサラダ、水なすと生ハム、牛すじのデミグラス煮、Eikun、36周年。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff; ¥390 seat charge; one drink each.

places.name: 野菜酒場あしおと (Yasai Sakaba Ashioto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Creative vegetable and fish dishes with house sauces; fried items (lotus root with mentaiko in seaweed tempura, rare-fried tuna) and a tempura-anago clay-pot rice are not gluten-free (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables lead the menu, but most dishes pair the vegetables with fish, prosciutto or dashi, and the clay-pot rice is finished with broth (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 16:30–22:30 daily; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations recommended — often fully booked; two-hour limit (enter at 21:00, leave by 22:30); changes by the day before (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥500 including tax, waived with two drinks (Tabelog, original text). 30 seats: 6 at the counter, 24 at tables, with tables for two up a steep stair on the second floor (Tabelog; July–September 2026). Non-smoking; English menu (Tabelog). On Sakaimachi south of Ayanokoji, 5 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 13 June 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi south of Ayanokoji — 5 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Creative vegetable izakaya pairing seasonal vegetables with fish and unusual sauces (2026 reviews) · onion Caesar salad with prosciutto; wild kanpachi from Ehime simmered with long eggplant in sesame soy; rare-fried yokowa tuna from Tokushima with chive sauce; fried Tokushima lotus root with mentaiko and nori tempura (June–September 2026) · marinated sweet shrimp, tuna with vinegar miso (September 2026) · clay-pot rice to finish — burdock with tempura anago, or eel — served last with broth poured over (July–September 2026) · sake and shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Sakaimachi, vegetables and clay-pot rice] A busy, cheerful izakaya off Ayanokoji where vegetables meet fish in unexpected pairings — kanpachi with eggplant in sesame soy, lotus root fried with mentaiko, a sweet-onion Caesar with prosciutto — and everyone saves room for the clay-pot rice (burdock and tempura anago, finished with broth). Seats are close; book ahead; two-hour limit. Cash only; ¥500 seat charge unless you have two drinks.

places.notes: [Udon · Sanjo Ohashi, curry udon the old way] A retro little udon and donburi shop just east of the Sanjo bridge, known for curry udon over Kyoto dashi: meat curry udon ¥900, shrimp-tempura curry udon ¥1,050, and sets with a mini egg bowl or a fried-curry bowl. chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 call it a long-established, retro udon shop famous for curry udon, popular with locals, students and visitors from abroad; Tabelog lists English and Chinese menus.
chef_bio.specialty: Curry udon; egg rice bowl.

anecdotes.text: "It's important that the noodles don't break when lifted with chopsticks, and the firmness of the noodles holds up well against the thickness of the curry." — January 2026.
"Please note that it takes quite a while for the food to be served, so those in a hurry should be cautious!" — March 2026.
"The egg rice bowl had a rather bland flavor—maybe it's a Kyoto-style?! I prefer a stronger seasoning." — June 2026.

places.name: 酒と魚 DNA (Sake to Sakana DNA)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki-style izakaya dishes on dashi — wan soups, hassun, sashimi, grilled fish, tempura, fried taro, spring rolls, Inaniwa udon; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-sake izakaya — soups on dashi, soft-shelled turtle, sashimi, grilled fish and duck (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 17:30–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Sunday and irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; tables cannot be joined — groups of five or more sit separately; ask before bringing children (Tabelog). No service or table charge (Tabelog original サービス料・チャージ料 共になし). 20 seats: a 10-seat counter and tables for two by the entrance; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). Directly south of the main entrance of Hotel Nikko Princess Kyoto on Higashinotoin; 3 min walk from exit 5 of Shijo Stn, 8 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin south of Takatsuji, opposite Hotel Nikko Princess — 3 min walk from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Izakaya of fish and sake that brings kaiseki technique to an izakaya format, with fish delivered each morning from Obama (Tabelog) · start with a wan (soup) — e.g. soft-shelled turtle, scallop, pumpkin dumpling with mushroom sauce — then hassun, sashimi (kombu-cured sea bream), grilled fish skewers and a closing dish of your choice (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · regulars' staples: salted-squid potato, mentaiko potato, fried small taro, bonito potato salad, umaki, atsuage, duck breast (2026 reviews) · seasonal dishes such as soft-shelled-turtle or sanma-and-matsutake spring rolls, chestnut and maitake tempura, young-ayu tempura, mushroom and abalone sautéed in butter soy, Inaniwa udon (2026 reviews) · sake by the glass, e.g. Akabu, Senkin, Atago no Matsu; craft cola (October 2026) · about ¥5,000–10,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Higashinotoin opposite the Nikko Princess, kaiseki skills at izakaya prices] A bright counter izakaya near Shijo Karasuma that builds your own small kaiseki: start with a soup — soft-shelled turtle is the one to have — then hassun, kombu-cured sashimi from Obama fish, grilled skewers and a closing bowl, with sake by the glass. Regulars swear by the salted-squid potato, fried small taro and the umaki; reviewers mention a Michelin Bib Gourmand. About ¥5,000–8,000 a head, no charge. Groups of five or more are split. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a quality izakaya focused on fish and sake that expresses techniques and ideas honed in kaiseki through the izakaya format, with local fish delivered every morning from Obama. Reviewers in 2026 describe warm, professional staff, a menu that changes with the seasons, and a Michelin Bib Gourmand — "in 2026" (June 2026) and "for three consecutive years" (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Rediscovering the beauty of "wa" cuisine, casually and affordably (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wan (soups), esp. soft-shelled turtle; hassun; umaki.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a seventeenth visit comes for every seasonal menu change; the pumpkin dumpling in mushroom sauce was "one of the best bowls I've ever had."
"It felt like creating a personalized kaiseki course" — August 2026, though a few dishes could have come hotter.
"It was by far the best I've ever had!" — August 2026, on the umaki.

places.hours_raw: Tuesday to Saturday 10:00–17:00; closed Sunday and Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). places.neighborhood: Marutamachi east of Kawaramachi — 3 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Tiny takeaway bakery of hard and soft breads (2026 reviews) · croissant ¥360, noir raisin ¥360, potato-dough bread ¥510, cinnamon doughnut ¥240, lemon doughnut (May–August 2026) · loaf bread, said to be the best seller; French bread and walnut bread (March–July 2026) · pain au chocolat, cranberry chocolate, nut chocolate, sugar-cane bread, anpan, melon bread, curry bread, croque monsieur, cream bread, honey nuts (2026 reviews) · mostly under ¥1,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Bakery · Marutamachi near Kawaramachi, one customer at a time] A shop so narrow it takes one group at a time, lined with breads from croissants and walnut loaves to cream bread and a light, barely greasy cinnamon doughnut (¥240); the loaf is the best seller. Prices are fair — croissants ¥360. Takeaway only; queues at weekends, quieter just after opening on weekdays. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 29 January 2020. Reviewers in 2026 describe a takeaway-only shop barely wide enough for one person, shelves of hard breads, croissants and savoury breads, and weekend queues.
chef_bio.specialty: Loaf bread; croissant; cinnamon doughnut.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor found the cinnamon doughnut far less oily than most — "almost non-greasy to the touch" — with a dense, chewy crumb.
"Although it's a popular spot that draws a line on weekends, it's relatively easy to get in right after opening on weekdays or in the early afternoon." — July 2026.
"The most shocking item was definitely the 'Cream Bread.'" — August 2026.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Kansai-style sukiyaki cooked in soy sauce and sugar, with yuba and grilled tofu (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Omi-beef sukiyaki cooked in beef fat and eaten with raw egg (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–22:00, irregular closures; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); a reviewer found the phone manner curt and heard it followed a past no-show (December 2025). 60 seats in tatami rooms with sunken seating; private rooms; terrace dining in summer; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2025). Cards (Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). A machiya down a narrow lane off Kiyamachi north of Sanjo, by the Kamo river; 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn exit 7 (Keihan) (Tabelog; October 2025).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Sanjo, by the Kamo — 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Sukiyaki and shabu-shabu house (Tabelog) · Omi-beef sukiyaki in the Kansai style — beef seared in its fat with zarame sugar and soy sauce, cooked at the table by staff (and sometimes the owner) and dipped in egg (2025–2026 reviews) · with Kujo negi, yuba, grilled tofu and large shiitake; rice included; yuzu sorbet to finish (2025–2026 reviews) · bills about ¥5,000–15,000 (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sukiyaki · Kiyamachi by the Kamo, Omi beef the Kansai way] An old townhouse down a narrow lane off Kiyamachi, with tatami rooms and terrace seats in summer, where staff — sometimes the owner — cook Omi-beef sukiyaki at your table the Kansai way, searing the beef in its fat with sugar and soy, then serving it with egg, Kujo negi and yuba. About ¥10,000–15,000; some find it a little dear for the amount of meat. Popular with visitors. Open nightly.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a long-established sukiyaki house in a traditional machiya by the Kamo river, where staff cook the first slices for you; an August 2025 regular on a fifth visit saw the owner come out to cook too, and a December 2025 diner heard the curt phone manner dates from a past no-show.
chef_bio.specialty: Omi-beef sukiyaki, Kansai style.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 regular, visiting during the Gozan Okuribi, had the Omi-beef sukiyaki prepared by the staff — and by the owner, who came out to cook it in person.

"The phone service felt a bit curt, but I heard it's because of a past incident with a no-show cancellation." — December 2025, adding that there seemed to be fewer Chinese customers and more Japanese diners lately.
"Considering the quantity and quality of the meat, the price felt a bit on the higher side." — October 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ、中京区木屋町三条上ル大阪町532、京阪三条駅7番出口から徒歩約3分、毎日 17:00〜22:00、不定休、予約可、60席、座敷・掘りごたつ、個室、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年6月、英語): Omi beef のすき焼き、関西風でざらめと醤油、スタッフ (時に店主) が焼いてくれる、卵、九条ねぎ、湯葉、焼き豆腐、大きな椎茸、ご飯付き、柚子のシャーベット、木屋町の細い路地の町家、鴨川沿い、夏はテラス席、電話の対応がそっけないとの声 (無断キャンセルがあったため、2025年12月)、肉の量の割にやや高いとの声。

Non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). A renovated townhouse on a quiet street south of the Imperial Palace; 9 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; August–September 2026). Opened 24 November 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of the Imperial Palace — 9 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Omakase course of about 11 dishes built on charcoal, from a young chef trained at the charcoal kaiseki restaurant Sumibi Kappo Ifuki (2026 reviews) · sashimi such as kinmedai, goma-saba, hata, hokkigai and bonito; Asahi shrimp salt-aged for two days with almond oil; tuna head simmered about three days; charcoal-grilled sawara, menuke, shiitake, duck with fig, sirloin cap with garlic purée (February–August 2026) · Furano asparagus with house karasumi; mozuku with nagaimo; a fried fish sandwich with wasabi tartar (April 2026) · donabe rice to finish — firefly squid and uni on seri rice, eel and uni (March–June 2026) · Japanese sake in small glasses, beer, wine (August 2026) · course about ¥15,000–16,000; bills about ¥15,000–40,000 a head with drinks (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Charcoal kaiseki · south of the Imperial Palace, a new eleven-seat counter] Opened in November 2025 in a renovated townhouse, this counter's young chef — trained at Sumibi Kappo Ifuki — builds an omakase around the charcoal: salt-aged Asahi shrimp, tuna head simmered for three days, sawara and sirloin cap seared over binchotan, then clay-pot rice crowned with firefly squid and uni. About ¥15,000–16,000 for the course, plus a seat fee. Open daily from 17:00.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed); young and newly independent (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers say the chef trained at a renowned charcoal-grill restaurant in Gion (March 2026), named as Sumibi Kappo Ifuki (August 2026), before opening independently in November 2025; both the restaurant and the owner are young (May and August 2026). The chef told a March 2026 diner the restaurant is still evolving.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-cooked fish and meat; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner thought the ¥15,000 course well worth it but found the meat’s presentation, including the drippings, a little lacking.
A June 2026 diner found the charcoal aroma subtle — a gentle spice rather than smoke — and noted some may find it too faint.
An April 2026 diner preferred the house tartar made with wasabi instead of pickles.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂・海鮮、中京区毘沙門町542-2、丸太町駅から徒歩9分、神宮丸太町駅から10分、毎日17:00〜22:00、予約可、お席料あり (金額の記載なし)、カウンター11席、貸切可、禁煙、カード可、2025年11月24日オープン。口コミ (2026年2〜9月、英語と日本語): 御所南の改装した町家、炭火割烹の名店で修業した若い店主、炭を軸にした約11品のおまかせ、コース約15,000〜16,000円、塩で熟成した海老、三日炊いたまぐろの頭、土鍋の締め (ホタルイカと雲丹のせりご飯)、肉の盛り付けが物足りないという声、炭の香りが控えめという声、当面は一斉スタート (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; one omakase course; seat fee; cards accepted.

places.name: 萍萍 (Ping Ping)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Taiwanese dishes with wheat dumpling wrappers, noodles, spring rolls and soy-based sauces (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dumplings of pork and chives, squid balls, clams, oysters and pork-filled zongzi (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday and public holidays, following the restaurant’s calendar (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; walk-ins are often seated on weekdays, but it can be full at year-end (Tabelog; October 2025, January 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 11 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). A retro shop in a back lane of Gion, 1 min from the Gion bus stop (Tabelog; February 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gion back lane, by the Gion bus stop
places.cuisine: Taiwanese home cooking from a fixed menu, run by a cheerful owner reviewers call "Mama" (2025–26 reviews) · homemade boiled dumplings of pork, chives and ginger, twelve to a plate — the dish everyone orders (2025–26 reviews) · squid balls, Taiwanese salami, shijimi clams in garlic soy, stir-fried oysters, oyster omelette, soy-braised beef tongue, spring rolls, pork and shiitake zongzi, danzai noodles, century egg, a spicy dried-radish omelette and spicy rice vermicelli (2025–26 reviews) · Shaoxing wine, bottled beer, sake (2025–26 reviews) · about ¥2,000–5,000 a head (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Taiwanese · Gion, dumplings in a back lane] A tiny, retro Taiwanese kitchen in a Gion back lane, a favourite second stop. Order the homemade boiled dumplings — twelve to a plate, heavy on chives — then squid balls, garlic-soy clams or danzai noodles, with warm Shaoxing wine. Some dishes are very spicy and salty. About ¥2,000–5,000. Cash only. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe an energetic owner, called "Mama", who jokes with guests and whose regulars come back for the same dishes year after year (2025–26 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Boiled dumplings; squid balls.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner found the dried-radish omelette and the rice vermicelli extremely spicy and salty — not for those who like mild food — but the dumplings good and the prices fair.
The owner told a November 2025 first-timer, half joking: "If you didn’t like it, please come again anyway!"
A January 2026 regular, turned away at year-end when it was full, came back for the clams and dumplings.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 台湾料理、東山区祇園富永町北側397 ピッケルビル1F、祇園バス停から徒歩1分、月〜土 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、日曜・祝日休み (カレンダーに準じる)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、11席、禁煙。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年9月、英語): 祇園の路地の台湾の家庭料理、自家製の水餃子 (12個)、イカ団子、台湾ソーセージ、しじみのにんにく醤油、牡蠣、牛タンの醤油煮、春巻き、ちまき、担仔麺、紹興酒、ママと呼ばれる明るい店主、辛くて塩辛い料理もあるという声、1人約2,000〜5,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Order from a short fixed menu; bring cash; walk-ins often fine on weekdays.

places.name: お菓子工房 ファヴリット (favorite)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pies and tarts on wheat pastry (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the pie crust is made with fermented butter, and there are cheese tarts and puddings (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–20:00; closed Wednesday (open on public holidays) (Tabelog). Take-away only (Tabelog). Whole pies can be ordered ahead; pre-ordered pies may leave few slices by opening or mid-afternoon (Tabelog; June and August 2026). Tabelog lists PayPay, but a reviewer could not find the code and another says cash only — bring cash (Tabelog; August–September 2026). 2 min from the Shijo Nishinotoin bus stop, 6 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo Nishinotoin — 6 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Take-away pastry shop known for its apple pie (2024–26 reviews) · apple pie packed with large chunks of cooked apple, cinnamon, on a crisp fermented-butter crust — ¥630 a slice (May–August 2026), ¥680 (August 2026); whole 18 cm pies to order (June 2026) · seasonal tarts — kumquat, fig, apricot, pear — and a baked cheese tart, half-baked cheese ¥250, maple pudding (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Pastry · Shijo Nishinotoin, Kyoto's chunky apple pie] A small take-away pâtisserie west of Karasuma whose apple pie is more apple than pastry — thick, cinnamon-scented slices under a crisp fermented-butter crust, about ¥650 a slice — with seasonal fruit tarts and a baked cheese tart alongside. Slices go by mid-afternoon on busy days; order a whole pie ahead. Bring cash. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A long-standing neighbourhood pastry shop: reviewers have bought its apple pie for years (December 2020 to August 2026) and describe a master who runs it (May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Apple pie; seasonal fruit tarts.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular arrived at the 11:00 opening to find the pre-ordered pies taken, but managed one still warm from the oven.
A June 2026 diner with a sweet tooth found the pie slightly lacking in sweetness and the crust firm.
An August 2026 diner noted prices have risen a few times in recent years but still found them reasonable.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ケーキ、下京区妙伝寺町705 CASA VERDE 西洞院 1F、四条駅2番出口から徒歩約6分、四条西洞院バス停から2分、11:00〜20:00、水曜休み (祝日は営業)、テイクアウトのみ、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可との表示。口コミ (2020年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 大きなりんごがぎっしりのアップルパイ1切れ630円 (2026年5〜8月)、680円 (2026年8月)、発酵バターの生地、18cm のホール、金柑・無花果・杏・洋梨のタルト、ベイクドチーズタルト、半熟チーズ250円、メープルプリン、予約分で売り切れることも、現金のみだったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Take-away counter; point and pay; bring cash.

places.name: はり清 (Hari Se)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the restaurant discusses allergies and preferences in detail (Tabelog). Kaiseki with dashi and soy, tempura in an almond batter and a beef cutlet (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan as served: a kaiseki of fish, beef and dashi (2025–26 reviews). Ask when booking (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 and dinner 17:00–21:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; menus, allergies, preferences and the purpose of the meal can be discussed in detail when booking (Tabelog). Full kaiseki in private rooms for 2 to 30; the mini kaiseki is served in the large upstairs hall, with tatami rooms with chairs (Tabelog; July 2026). 100 seats; non-smoking; cards and QR (Tabelog). Parking across the street (November 2025). South of Gojo; 5 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of Gojo, Higashiyama — 5 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki in a house founded over 350 years ago (official site), with a courtyard and tatami rooms (2025–26 reviews) · full kaiseki: hassun, clear soup, sashimi, simmered, grilled and fried courses, rice, red miso soup, fruit — about ¥8,000–30,000 a head (2025–26 reviews) · mini kaiseki lunch about ¥4,000–5,000: sea-bream chimaki, tokobushi, eggplant with shinjo, bonito tataki, firefly squid with vinegar miso, potato dumplings with beef, grilled sweetfish, bamboo-shoot rice, dessert (May 2026) · tempura in almond batter, sweet-potato rice, clam and tomato soup, Miyazaki beef cutlet (November 2025, April 2026) · homemade anko; roll cakes from the sister patisserie Famille de Chie Hari Se (October–November 2025)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gojo, a ryotei of 350 years] A long-established Kyoto ryotei south of Gojo, more than 350 years old, with a courtyard and rooms for two to thirty — a favourite for family celebrations and memorial meals. Full kaiseki runs about ¥8,000–30,000; the mini kaiseki lunch (about ¥4,000–5,000) is served in the big upstairs hall. Seasonal, gently seasoned cooking with a few modern touches like an almond-batter tempura. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a Kyoto-cuisine ryotei founded more than 350 years ago in Higashiyama Gojo. Reviewers speak of a history of about 360 years and a well-kept building (November–December 2025), and of a sister patisserie, Famille de Chie Hari Se, whose roll cakes appear at dessert (November 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; mini kaiseki lunch.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 solo diner, booking the day before during Obon, was given a private room.
An October 2026 memorial lunch saw guests aged 91, 91 and 85 finish all ten dishes.
A November 2025 diner warned that the road in front and the parking are narrow.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (harise.com): 京都 東山 五条、創業三百五十余年の京料理 はり清。食べログ: 日本料理、東山区大黒町通五条下ル袋町、清水五条駅から徒歩5分、昼 11:30〜14:30・夜 17:00〜21:00、火曜休み、予約可 (料理、アレルギー、好み、会の目的まで相談できる)、100席、個室 2〜30名 (ミニ懐石は2階の大広間)、禁煙、カード・QR 可。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 創業約360年、中庭、懐石1人約8,000〜30,000円、ミニ懐石約4,000〜5,000円、アーモンド衣の天ぷら、Miyazaki の牛カツ、自家製のあんこ、姉妹店 Famille de Chie Hari Se のロールケーキ、法事や祝いの席に。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead and discuss allergies and the occasion; private rooms; cards and QR.

staff_allergy_handling.text: At booking the restaurant discusses the meal, individual allergies and preferences, and the purpose of the gathering in detail.

places.name: 蛸薬師 ふるかわ (Takoyakushi Furukawa)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a set Japanese course on bonito or tuna dashi with soy-seasoned dishes (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish course opening with a bonito or tuna broth, with crab, sea urchin, octopus and sea bream (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–21:00, all guests starting together at 12:00 and 18:00; irregular closures; reservation only; arrive at least 5 minutes early; cancellation 100% from two days before. Lunch began in earnest in November 2025 (press release). No service charge: Tabelog’s English page says a service charge is added, but the Japanese original says 「なし」. BYO ¥5,000 a bottle (Tabelog). 8 counter seats (7 per the press release); no shorts or revealing clothes; no strong perfume; English menu; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Entered through the back of the izakaya 鯛之鯛 烏丸店 (press release; 2026 reviews). Opened 11 June 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takoyakushi east of Karasuma, through the back of an izakaya — 7 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese omakase at a hinoki counter hidden behind an izakaya · lunch course ¥11,000; dinner course ¥20,000–22,000 (2026 reviews) · opens with a clear broth of well water drawn from 52 m underground and bonito flakes, or a tuna dashi made with soft water from the Shirakami mountains (2026 reviews) · seen: lotus-root cake with okra, cashew, purple sea urchin and sweet shrimp in a lotus leaf, hairy crab with crab miso, grilled eggplant with sudachi jelly and corn sauce, octopus with buckwheat groats, salt-baked sea bream for a birthday, black-syrup and ginger dessert (2026 reviews) · house furikake to take home (July 2026)
places.notes: [Japanese omakase · Shijo-Karasuma, behind an izakaya] Walk through the busy fish izakaya 鯛之鯛 and open the door at the back: an eight-seat hinoki counter where the owner, twelve years at 山玄茶, starts every course with a broth made in front of you from deep well water and bonito. Seasonal, beautifully plated dishes; lunch ¥11,000, dinner about ¥20,000. A Michelin Guide Selected restaurant. Reservation only; no strong perfume.

chef_bio.chef_name: 古川 毅 (owner, per a press release; no reading in a source)
roles: Owner-chef (press release: 店主 古川毅)
chef_bio.background: Per a press release on san-tatsu.jp: owner 古川毅 trained for twelve years at the Kyoto restaurant 山玄茶 before opening 蛸薬師ふるかわ; the restaurant was listed as a Michelin Guide Selected Restaurant and began full lunch service in November 2025; it sits behind the lively izakaya 鯛之鯛 near Hankyu Karasuma and Shijo stations, with a single-plank hinoki counter. Opened 11 June 2024 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 praise the owner’s warmth and the sake recommendations.
chef_bio.specialty: Broth made to order from well water and bonito; seasonal omakase.

anecdotes.text: The course opens with a broth made from soft water drawn from 52 metres underground and bonito flakes, skimmed in front of the guest (August 2026).
A birthday guest in August 2026 was served a salt-baked sea bream.
"I think it would be hard to find the entrance if it’s your first time." — July 2026; the guest took home the house furikake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: プレスリリース (san-tatsu.jp、株式会社リバリュース): 蛸薬師ふるかわがミシュランガイドのセレクテッドレストランに掲載、2025年11月からランチ営業を本格的に開始、店主 古川毅は京都の名店「山玄茶」で12年間修行して開業、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅近くの居酒屋「鯛之鯛」の店内を抜けた奥の扉の先、檜の一枚板のカウンター7席。食べログ: 日本料理、中京区一蓮社町蛸薬師通烏丸東入ル300 パームビル1F、毎日 12:00〜14:00・18:00〜21:00 (12時・18時一斉スタート)、不定休、完全予約制、5分前までに来店、2日前から100%のキャンセル料、サービス料は日本語原文で「なし」(英語版の記載は誤訳)、持ち込み1本5,000円、カウンター8席、短パンや露出の多い服は不可、強い香水不可、英語メニュー、カード可、2024年6月11日オープン。口コミ (2026年5月〜9月、英語): 昼11,000円、夜20,000〜22,000円のおまかせ、深さ52mの井戸水と鰹節の一番だし、白神山地の軟水の鮪だし、蓮の葉の蓮根餅と紫雲丹と甘海老、毛蟹の蟹味噌、焼き茄子とすだちジュレ、蛸と蕎麦の実、鯛の塩釜焼き、黒蜜と生姜のデザート、自家製ふりかけ、店主の人柄、日本酒のすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only with a single start time; English menu (Tabelog); enter through the izakaya at the front.

places.name: コム シェ ミッシェル (Comme Chez Michel)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; bistro courses with terrines, rillettes and baguette, pastry desserts (Paris-Brest, Mont Blanc, tarte Tatin) (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork rillettes, terrines, meat and fish mains finished with bouillon (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 12:00–14:00 (L.O.), dinner 18:00–21:00 (L.O.); closed Wednesday (Thursday if Wednesday is a holiday) and one irregular day a month. Bookings by phone (official site); birthday messages on dessert with notice (April 2026). 18 seats: 10 at tables downstairs, 8 upstairs; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 29 April 2009 in the former obanzai restaurant 三月 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yanagibamba south of Oike, near Kyoto City Hall — 8 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Parisian everyday bistro cooking with little butter or cream, finished with bouillon (official site) · lunch and dinner courses A, B and C with choices, or à la carte (official site); lunch reviewers spent ¥3,000–3,999 · seen: pork rillettes, seafood terrine, wild-boar terrine, mushroom potage of four or five mushrooms (¥900, 2024), green-pea soup, Shogoin turnip purée, Kyotango chicken ballotine, roast Kyoto pork, beef cheek braised with tarragon, steak with lentils and mash, pan-seared sea bream (2024–2026 reviews) · desserts learned at Blé Sucré in Paris: Paris-Brest, Mont Blanc, tarte Tatin with caramel gelato (official site; 2026 reviews) · Michelin Bib Gourmand, Kansai 2014 (official site)
places.notes: [French bistro · Oike, a Paris bistro’s Kyoto namesake] A small two-floor bistro in a former obanzai house, named after Chez Michel in Paris, where the chef trained three years under Thierry Breton. Everyday Parisian cooking with little butter or cream — rillettes, terrines, mushroom potage, roast Kyoto pork — and desserts from Blé Sucré training, by A/B/C course or à la carte. Lunch from about ¥3,000. One diner found the small rooms full of cooking smells by dessert (December 2024). Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 大川 (surname only, from the official site: シェフ大川; no given name or reading)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the chef trained at hotels in Japan, then spent five years in Paris, three of them under chef Thierry Breton at the bistro Chez Michel, and learned desserts at the pâtisserie Blé Sucré in the 12th arrondissement; on opening in Kyoto, the mentor urged the chef to become "the Chez Michel of Japan". Michelin Guide Kansai 2014 Bib Gourmand. Opened 29 April 2009 in the building that was the obanzai restaurant 三月 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: bistro cooking that knows its ingredients — meat on the bone, butter and cream kept down, finished with good bouillon — eaten happily, even with the fingers.
chef_bio.specialty: Bistro courses; Paris-Brest; rillettes and terrines.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 family enjoyed the Christmas course, though the smell of other tables’ mains lingered through dessert in the small room; the chef saw them off at the door.
An April 2026 birthday group chose from about five starters, mains and desserts on the day instead of fixing the menu when booking.
An October 2026 regular added a steak and was surprised by lentils and mash instead of fries.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (commechezmichel.com): コム シェ ミッシェル、フランス人が食べる本場のビストロフレンチを気軽に、ミシュランガイド関西2014 ビブグルマン、パリで日常的に食べられているビストロ料理、ランチとディナーにA・B・Cのコース、アラカルトも一人から、パリ12区 Blé Sucré でシェフが学んだデセール、店名はパリの名店 Chez Michel に近づきたいという思い、シェフ大川は国内のホテルで修行の後に渡仏、パリで5年、うち3年はシェフ ティエリー・ブルトンのもとで修行、師匠から「日本のシェミッシェルとなれ」、バターと生クリームを控えブイヨンで仕上げる、骨付き肉、パリ・ブレスト、中京区柳馬場通御池下る柳八幡町80番1、ランチ12:00〜14:00 (L.O.)、ディナー18:00〜21:00 (L.O.)、水曜休み (祝日の場合木曜)、月1回不定休、予約は電話。食べログ: フレンチ、18席 (1階テーブル10、2階テーブル8)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、2009年4月29日オープン (おばんざいの店「三月」だった建物)。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 豚のリエット、魚介のテリーヌ、猪のテリーヌ、きのこのポタージュ900円、グリーンピースのスープ、聖護院かぶらのピュレ、京丹後の鶏のバロティーヌ、京都ポークのロースト、牛頬肉のエストラゴン風、ステーキとレンズ豆とマッシュポテト、鯛のポワレ、モンブラン、タルト・タタン、ランチ3,000円台、誕生日のメッセージ、店が狭く料理の匂いがこもるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Bilingual website; choose dishes for the A/B/C courses on the day; book by phone.

places.name: 押小路 岡田 (Oshikoji Okada)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a dashi-based Kyoto kaiseki with soy-seasoned dishes and pressed sushi (official site; 2022–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish kaiseki on bonito dashi — sweetfish, sea bream, hamo, crab, tuna — though reviewers note little or no meat (2022–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 13:00); dinner 17:30–20:30 (last entry); closed Sunday and Monday holidays (open on ordinary Mondays and other holidays). Reservation only; hard to book (2023 and 2025 reviews). Courses tax and service included: lunch ¥8,500; dinner ¥13,500, ¥16,500, ¥19,800 (official site). 13 seats: a counter of 7 (6 per a 2023 review) and a private room for 6; non-smoking; children by arrangement; AMEX only (official site; Tabelog). No service charge listed separately on Tabelog. Take-away boxes and mackerel sushi by order (official site). Opened June 2018; moved to this machiya in 2021 (official site; Tabelog gives 16 September 2021).
places.neighborhood: Oshikoji-Takakura, south of the Imperial Palace — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn, exit 1
places.cuisine: Quiet, traditional Kyoto kaiseki in a machiya, built on dashi from well water the chef draws each morning (official site) · lunch course ¥8,500; dinner ¥13,500, ¥16,500 or ¥19,800, tax and service included (official site) · seen: nagaimo tofu with blue crab and ikura, matsuba crab with yuba, sweetfish and daikon soup, sashimi of Setouchi sea bream, tuna and bonito, grilled barracuda pressed sushi, hamo roe, steamed rice with new ginger, two desserts (2022–2026 reviews) · to take away: bento boxes ¥4,320–6,480, chirimen sansho and shio kombu ¥1,620, mackerel sushi ¥4,860 a roll (official site)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Oshikoji-Takakura, a quiet chef and well water] A machiya south of the Imperial Palace where a quiet chef, once an opening cook at 祇園 なん波, serves textbook Kyoto kaiseki with little meat, its dashi made from well water fetched each morning. Seven counter seats and one private room; lunch ¥8,500, dinner from ¥13,500 all-in. Regulars return every season; reservations are hard to get. A 2022 diner found some seasoning salty. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 岡田 晃 (Okada Akira, per the official site)
chef_bio.origin: Born 13 September 1979 in 長野県千曲市 (official site).
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: began in 1999 at the local kaiseki restaurant 竹葉亭, trained at 祇園はやかわ from 2002, joined 祇園 なん波 as opening staff in 2006 and served as its simmering cook, and opened 押小路岡田 with about six counter seats in June 2018; in 2021 moved across Oshikoji to a larger machiya with a gallery upstairs; draws dashi water from springs around the shop every morning; also caters boxed meals for guests of the hotel 東山 四季花木. A January 2022 reviewer saw the owner working almost alone at the old shop, with more help after the move.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「ただ直向きに 丹念に、京都の 想い出の料理 こしらえます」 — true flavour lies in well water, ingredients that meet in season and a faint scent of dashi, not costly ingredients or showmanship.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki; pressed sushi; dashi.

anecdotes.text: A guest who once gave a business card at the old shop received New Year cards every year after (January 2022).
"It felt like being in a textbook on Japanese cooking." — December 2023; the party of six brought a magnum of brut and was welcomed.
"I did find the seasoning a bit on the salty side." — May 2022.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (oshikoji-okada.com): 押小路 岡田、京料理、「ただ直向きに 丹念に、京都の 想い出の料理 こしらえます」、走り・旬・名残、高価な食材や華やかな演出より毎朝近所に汲みに行く地下水と出会い物とほのかなだし、押小路通高倉西北角の京町家、寡黙な店主、カウンター7席と6人掛けの個室、昼7,700円・夜12,100円と16,500円 (旧表記)、お品書きは昼8,500円、夜13,500円・16,500円・19,800円 (税サ込)、岡田 晃 (Okada Akira) は1979年9月13日長野県千曲市生まれ、1999年地元の竹葉亭、2002年祇園はやかわ、2006年祇園なん波のオープンスタッフで煮方、2018年6月にカウンター6席ほどで独立、2021年に北西向かいの一回り大きな店へ移転し2階にギャラリー、東山 四季花木のお重のケータリング、持ち帰りの折詰4,320円・6,480円、ちりめん山椒・塩昆布1,620円、鯖寿司1本4,860円、昼12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 13:00)、夜17:30〜20:30 (最終入店)、日曜と祝日の月曜休み、全面禁煙。食べログ: 日本料理、中京区押小路高倉東入瓦町565-2、完全予約制、13席、カードは AMEX、2021年9月16日オープン。口コミ (2022年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 移転で内装と料理がさらによくなった、肉をほとんど使わない伝統的な京料理、教科書のような和食、長芋豆腐と渡り蟹といくら、松葉蟹と湯葉、鮎と大根のお椀、瀬戸内の鯛、鮪、鰹、かますの焼き霜の棒寿司、鱧の子、新生姜の炊き込みご飯、デザート2品、予約が取りにくい、やや塩辛いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only through the official booking link; set courses; a quiet counter.

places.name: 五建 ういろ 本店 (Goken Uiro Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No ingredient information; uiro, mitarashi dango in soy glaze, kuzumochi and fu-manju downstairs, and katsu curry and omurice in the upstairs café (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Uiro, minazuki and bean-paste sweets may suit, but no ingredient information is given; the café serves katsu curry and omurice (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog lists no hours and the official site was under maintenance on 5 November 2026; reviewers came at lunchtime on weekdays and weekends (2026). No reservations (Tabelog). Wagashi shop downstairs; a Showa-retro café upstairs serving lunch (katsu curry ¥1,000, omurice, set meals) and an uiro parfait (2026 reviews). Smoking allowed; cards accepted, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. A second shop sells at JR 京都伊勢丹 B1F (Tabelog), with pop-ups at department stores (2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Gojozaka, east of the Kamo River on Gojo-dori — 2 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Long-established uiro maker with a café upstairs · fresh uiro (brown-sugar, chestnut, yomogi), keeping only two days, or vacuum-packed (2026 reviews) · minazuki, kuzumochi, warabi mochi, giant "Odama Mitarashi" dango, fu-manju, sekihan manju (2026 reviews) · upstairs: katsu curry ¥1,000, omurice, set lunches, uiro parfait (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Uiro & wagashi · Gojozaka, with a retro café upstairs] The main shop of a long-established uiro maker near Kiyomizu-Gojo: fresh uiro that keeps only two days, giant mitarashi dango and seasonal minazuki downstairs, and upstairs a bright Showa-era café where locals eat katsu curry and omurice at lunch. Staff are kind and explain what keeps. Hours not published — check before going. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 call it a long-established uiro shop at Gojozaka, with wagashi sold downstairs and a café on the second floor that feels like a Showa-era local lunch spot. A second shop is in the basement of JR 京都伊勢丹 (Tabelog), and the shop has run pop-ups at department stores in Kyoto and at Daimaru Tokyo (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh uiro; Odama Mitarashi dango.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 café guest found no uiro or dango on the upstairs menu; the staff offered to bring dango up from downstairs.
The staff explained that fresh uiro is better but keeps only two days, so an August 2026 visitor took a vacuum pack instead.
"Personally, it was the best uiro I've ever tasted." — August 2026, on the brown-sugar uiro.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 五建 ういろ 本店 (五建外良屋)、和菓子・喫茶店、東山区五条橋東2丁目18番地1、清水五条駅から徒歩約2分、予約不可、営業時間の記載なし、喫煙可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、ほかにジェイアール京都伊勢丹B1Fの店。公式サイト (gokenuiro.jp) は2026年11月5日時点でメンテナンス中。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 生ういろ (黒糖、栗、よもぎ)、生は日持ち2日で真空パックもある、水無月、葛餅、わらび餅、大玉みたらし、麩まんじゅう、赤飯まんじゅう、2階は昭和レトロのカフェで地元の人の昼ごはん、カツカレー1,000円、オムライス、定食、ういろパフェ、親切なスタッフ、高島屋や大丸東京店の催事。

cultural_comfort.note: Buy sweets at the counter downstairs; the café upstairs is a casual local lunch spot.

places.name: 肉まぶし専門店 稀 (MARE)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu over rice with a "secret sauce" and dashi to pour over; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu restaurant; the broth and egg-yolk sauce come with every bowl (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:00) and 17:00–21:00 (Tabelog). Bookings taken; one order per person except small children, no sharing; Tabelog says both that a seat cannot be held past 10 minutes late and that tables are held for one hour from the booked time (Tabelog). 13 counter seats; children welcome, strollers allowed; non-smoking; cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). On the south side of a lane 70 m east of Hanamikoji, north of Shijo; 1 min from the Gion bus stop (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo, east of Hanamikoji — 1 min from the Gion bus stop
places.cuisine: Wagyu "hitsumabushi" eaten three ways like the eel original — plain, with condiments, then with broth (Tabelog) · black wagyu uchihira mabushi à la carte ¥2,800 with condiments, broth and egg-yolk sauce (April 2025); a limited rare-cut mabushi ¥3,800 (October 2025); a black wagyu ichibo steak box (Tabelog); the MARE set adds a small shabu-shabu, side dishes and matcha ice cream (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Wagyu hitsumabushi · Gion north of Shijo] A 13-seat counter serving black wagyu, grilled rare, over rice to eat in three stages like eel hitsumabushi — finishing with broth. Bowls about ¥2,800–3,800; sets add shabu-shabu and matcha ice cream. Popular with overseas visitors; book. Open daily, lunch and dinner.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 November 2018 (Tabelog). Per the operator: a specialist in wagyu hitsumabushi with a secret sauce; a black wagyu ichibo steak box added as a new menu.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu hitsumabushi.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 returnee found part-time staff arguing over the seating, and the meat looking different from before.
In October 2026 one diner noticed being the only Japanese customer — everyone else was from overseas.
A February 2026 solo traveller added Kyoto black shichimi to change the flavour and finished every grain.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 肉まぶし専門店 稀、丼・牛肉料理、東山区祇園町北側338-1 祇園川長ビル 1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩7分、四条花見小路を北へ、東へ70mの南側、月〜金 11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、土日祝 11:00〜16:00 (L.O. 15:00)・17:00〜21:00、1人1オーダー制、10分以上の遅刻は席の用意ができない、予約時刻から1時間で席を解除、13席、子供可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2018年11月15日オープン、秘伝のたれの和牛ひつまぶし、黒毛和牛のイチボのステーキ重。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 黒毛和牛のうちひらの肉まぶし2,800円、希少部位3,800円、薬味と出汁、卵黄のソース、MARE セット (しゃぶしゃぶ、抹茶アイス)、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests (October 2026); one order per person; book ahead.

places.name: 割烹 いいもり (Kappou Iimori)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Fish courses with dashi, sashimi and claypot rice; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2023–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of Toyama seafood and dashi (Tabelog; 2023–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat lunch 12:00–14:00 (last entry 12:30) and dinner 17:00–21:00 (last entry 19:00); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Courses by reservation; lunch only when booked — a ¥4,500 lunch course (Tabelog). Service charge: none noted — Tabelog's Japanese original: "特にございません". 10 seats: a 5-seat counter and a tatami room upstairs for up to 6; smoking only on the 2nd floor; children welcome; cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley in Gion north of Shijo — reviewers warn it is hard to find (2024–26 reviews); 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo, in an alley — 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kappo courses of seasonal seafood sent daily from Toyama, with Kyoto vegetables, and sake to match (Tabelog) · lunch course ¥4,500 (Tabelog); a ¥7,000 lunch (November 2023) and a ¥9,000 course (July 2024) · in reviews: crab and ikura chawanmushi, seko crab, marinated mackerel, Toyama tuna, squid, turban shell, kombu-cured amadai, water octopus, hamo soup, white shrimp and firefly squid in spring, claypot rice to finish (2023–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion, Toyama seafood] A hidden Gion kappo down a narrow alley, where a couple from Toyama serve fish sent daily from home — kombu-cured amadai, white shrimp, seko crab — with Kyoto vegetables and claypot rice. Five counter seats and a tatami room. Lunch from ¥4,500 by booking; dinner about ¥10,000–15,000. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef from Toyama (unnamed), with a spouse — per 2024–26 reviews
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 April 2002 (Tabelog). Per the operator: fresh seasonal seafood sent daily from Toyama. Per 2024–26 reviews: the owner couple are from Toyama and welcome first-timers warmly; a July 2024 reviewer says the Toyama tuna has come in for about seven years.
chef_bio.specialty: Toyama seafood courses.

anecdotes.text: Unlike many traditional ryotei, the chef couple made first-time visitors very welcome — July 2026.
On a hot July 2024 day, water had been sprinkled outside the alley entrance, and the guest was shown to an elegant room upstairs.
An August 2026 business traveller ended with claypot rice and wondered whether crab comes in winter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 割烹 いいもり、日本料理・海鮮、東山区祇園町北側347-100、祇園四条から徒歩10分、月〜土 12:00〜14:00 (最終入店12:30)・17:00〜21:00 (最終入店19:00)、日曜休み、サービス料: 特にございません、10席 (カウンター5、2階の座敷6)、2階のみ喫煙可、子供可、2002年4月1日オープン、富山から毎日届く旬の魚介と京野菜、昼の4,500円のコース (要予約)。口コミ (2023年11月〜2026年8月、英語): 富山出身の店主夫婦、蟹といくらの茶碗蒸し、せこ蟹、鯖、富山の鮪、甘鯛の昆布締め、水蛸、鱧の椀、白海老、ホタルイカ、土鍋ご飯、7,000円の昼、9,000円のコース。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; lunch only by reservation; the alley entrance is hard to find.

places.name: ヌフ クレープリー (neuf creperie)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Galettes are buckwheat-based but the sweet crêpes are wheat (September 2026 review); the buckwheat share and kitchen practice are not stated; no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: galettes of ham, egg and cheese, and crêpes with butter, custard and cream (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 10:00–16:30 (last order 16:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 10:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog); a set of galette, crêpe and drink at lunch, 11:00–15:00 (August 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 30 seats (4 at the counter); takeaway; children welcome, strollers allowed; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Ebisugawa-dori west of Takakura; 5 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ebisugawa-dori south of the Imperial Palace — 5 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Breton galettes and crêpes (October 2026): six galettes and six crêpes to choose from in the lunch set with a drink (August 2026) · galettes such as the complète of ham, cheese and vegetables, mozzarella with tomato, meat sauce and basil, peach with prosciutto; crêpes such as Échiré butter and sugar, honey and whipped cream, the custard "neuf crêpe" (2026 reviews) · breakfast available (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Galettes & crêpes · south of the Imperial Palace] A bright, relaxed Breton crêperie on Ebisugawa-dori: crisp buckwheat galettes (ham, cheese, egg; peach and prosciutto in summer) and chewy sweet crêpes like Échiré butter and sugar. Lunch sets about ¥2,000. Cash only; book at weekends. Open daily from 10:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 9 September 2015 (Tabelog). A five-time regular orders the galette, crêpe and drink set at lunch (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Buckwheat galettes; neuf crêpe.

anecdotes.text: A first-time visitor in September 2026 learned that galettes are buckwheat and crêpes wheat — and that galettes are not always savoury.
A galette lover who dislikes avocado swapped the classic complète for the mozzarella, tomato and meat-sauce galette — October 2026.
Walking in without a booking on a weekday afternoon, an October 2026 diner was told to sit anywhere; three more groups followed.

Friendly, quick staff; open every evening to 23:30.

The invoice number belongs to 株式会社セカンダイズ (NTA corporate-number site). An October 2026 regular praises the head chef’s training of the energetic staff.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 family of four found a handwritten note on the table saying "please relax and enjoy your time".
An October 2026 diner says a friend makes a point of coming back for the beef stew on every visit to Japan.

places.name: 京都祇園鉄板焼プランチャー健 (Plancha Ken)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking — Tabelog’s booking note asks guests with a gluten allergy to say so when reserving, and the restaurant will try to accommodate. Courses include sauces, baked cheese curry or curry as a finish, and dessert (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu, Matsusaka beef, lobster, abalone and foie gras teppanyaki courses (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–22:30 (last order 21:00) Tuesday to Friday, holidays and the day before; also lunch 12:00–14:30 on Saturday and Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; gluten-allergic guests should say so when booking (Tabelog). No service charge; a seat charge of ¥600 per person, ¥1,100 from 31 December to 3 January (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料なし、チャージ料お一人600円（税込）12月31日から1月3日まではチャージ料1100円（税込）」). 22 seats with a counter and a semi-private room; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). On the corner of the lane into Hanamikoji-Tominagacho, past a tobacco shop; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (Tabelog). Opened 14 February 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Lane into Tominagacho off Hanamikoji, Gion — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki of A5 Kuroge wagyu, Matsusaka beef and live lobster (2026 reviews) · Maruyama course with A5 wagyu fillet ¥8,800 (October 2026) · Gion course with A5 wagyu steak and Canadian lobster ¥10,500 (October 2026): seasonal appetizers (wagyu tataki, broccoli mousse, purple sweet potato purée), Matsusaka beef grilled shabu-shabu, seasonal soup, lobster, steak flambéed at the counter, grilled vegetables, a choice of finish such as cheese curry, dessert and coffee · courses with foie gras and abalone; birthday plates; a tenugui to take home (October 2026)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Gion, wagyu and lobster on a back lane] A teppanyaki counter on a quiet lane off Hanamikoji, run by a chef from a hotel teppanyaki background, per reviewers. Courses (about ¥8,800–10,500) bring wagyu tataki, Matsusaka beef grilled shabu-shabu, a live Canadian lobster shown before cooking, and an A5 steak flambéed in front of you, finishing with cheese curry. Gluten-allergic guests can ask when booking. No service charge, but a ¥600 seat charge. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner (the invoice holder); reviewers describe a master chef with hotel teppanyaki experience
chef_bio.background: The invoice register lists an individual, 浅沼 健史, for the shop’s invoice number. October 2026 reviewers say the restaurant is run by a chef who was head chef at a prestigious hotel, with a gentle, playful manner. Opened 14 February 2014 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: A5 wagyu and lobster teppanyaki.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 birthday couple lifted the live lobster for a photo before it was cooked, and got a birthday plate for dessert.
An October 2026 diner was surprised by the beef-rich baked curry as the closing dish and was given a tenugui to take home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都祇園鉄板焼プランチャー健、ステーキ・鉄板焼き・洋食、東山区祇園町北側282-3 太田ビル 1F、祇園四条駅7番出口から徒歩5分、花見小路富永町へ入る路地の角、火〜金・祝・祝前日 17:00〜22:30 (L.O. 21:00)、土日 12:00〜14:30・17:00〜22:30、月曜休み、予約可、グルテンアレルギーの方は予約時に連絡を (できる限り対応)、サービス料なし、チャージ料1人600円 (税込、12月31日〜1月3日は1,100円)、22席、半個室、カード・PayPay 可、2014年2月14日オープン、インボイス: 浅沼 健史 (個人)。口コミ (2026年9〜11月、英語): 円山コース8,800円、祇園コース10,500円、A5黒毛和牛、松阪牛の焼きしゃぶ、カナダ産オマール海老、フランベ、チーズカレー、ホテルの料理長だった料理人。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; ¥600 seat charge; say if you have a gluten allergy when booking.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Tabelog’s booking note (auto-translated) asks guests with a gluten allergy to contact the restaurant when booking; it will do its best to accommodate.

places.name: LE CHENE (長楽館)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the restaurant asks in advance for allergies and any ingredient restrictions for everyone in the party (Tabelog). French courses with bread, sauces and pastry (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask in advance — the restaurant takes restrictions for the whole party ahead of time; courses centre on fish, duck, meat and butter sauces with Kyoto vegetables (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:30 (last entry 14:00) and dinner 17:30–22:00 (last entry 19:30); closed Tuesday and one irregular day a month (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (15% from 31 December to 5 January), per Tabelog. Allergies and restrictions (including pregnancy, caffeine and alcohol in cooking) must be told in advance for the whole party (Tabelog). About 10 parking spaces at the east front entrance; 7 min from the Gion bus stop, 11 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Inside 長楽館, a Meiji-era Western-style mansion in Maruyama Park that also houses a dessert café and a hotel; meals are served in the historic rooms or a newer annex (2025–26 reviews). Cards (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Maruyama Park, east of Yasaka Shrine — 11 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: French cooking with Kyoto ingredients and vegetables the chef sources personally (2025–26 reviews) · lunch course "Paon" ¥12,100, nine dishes (April 2026) · dishes reviewers had: Japan Sea mackerel with heshiko, omohata poêlé with beurre blanc, Nanatani duck, sea urchin consommé royale, whelk, red snapper, kinmedai, a signature beurre-noisette dish, cold consommé · wine pairing of six glasses ¥12,000 (June 2026)
places.notes: [French · Maruyama Park, dining in a Meiji mansion] The main dining room of 長楽館, a Western-style mansion built in the Meiji era by a tobacco magnate as a guesthouse and now an Important Cultural Property, per reviewers. Chef Kazuki Hashimoto cooks French courses around Kyoto produce the chef sources in person — Wakasa mackerel with heshiko, rare omohata with beurre blanc, local Nanatani duck — served under high ceilings (dress warmly in winter) or in the annex. Lunch from ¥12,100; 10% service. The chef often greets diners after the meal. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Chef (January 2026 review); operator 株式会社長楽館 (the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per 2025–26 reviewers: 長楽館 was built in the Meiji era as a guesthouse by a prominent businessman and was used to welcome foreign guests; it is an Important Cultural Property; the restaurant is named after the founder’s family crest of three oak leaves; chef Kazuki Hashimoto personally sources Kyoto vegetables and has long used local Nanatani duck (January 2026). The invoice number belongs to 株式会社長楽館 (NTA corporate-number site). The same building’s dessert café is a separate record. Chef’s name known only in Latin letters.
chef_bio.specialty: French courses with Kyoto vegetables; Nanatani duck.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner warns the high-ceilinged historic rooms feel chilly in winter.
A June 2026 hotel guest who stayed on points paid for dinner and called six glasses of pairing wine for ¥12,000, including Dom Pérignon, a good deal.
A February 2026 diner was greeted by the chef after the meal.

cultural_comfort.note: Historic mansion with a hotel; tell all dietary restrictions in advance; 10% service.

places.name: 鴨川たかし (Kamogawa Takashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled Omi beef with sauces, grilled sukiyaki dipped in egg, beef bowls, croquettes and cutlets, and noodles to finish; no gluten information is published (official site; 2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an Omi beef restaurant — even the vegetables are grilled in Omi beef fat (official site; February 2026).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–14:00 (last order 13:00) Monday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday; dinner 18:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30) Monday and Wednesday to Sunday; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Phone bookings only at 10:00–11:00 and 17:00–18:00 (Tabelog). Private and semi-private rooms in an old house (June and August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR including UnionPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). On Nakamachi-dori north of Takeyamachi; about 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nakamachi-dori near Kawaramachi-Marutamachi — 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal yakiniku and meat kaiseki of Omi Hino beef from the Okazaki farm only (official site) · lunch: Omi beef bowl ¥500, large ¥700, with namul and soup; Omi beef croquette ¥200; beef cutlet and minced cutlet; Kamogawa Takashi gozen (2026 reviews) · dinner: meat kaiseki course ¥7,800 (February 2026) up to the "Ultimate" course, with rare cuts grilled on a shichirin, grilled sukiyaki dipped in raw egg, vegetables grilled in Omi beef fat, ochazuke or simmered noodles to finish, and a creative dessert (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Marutamachi, Omi Hino beef from one farm] A beef restaurant in an old house near the Imperial Palace that serves only Omi Hino beef from the Okazaki farm, whose cows are raised long and unhurried. Lunch is a bargain — an Omi beef bowl with namul and soup for ¥500 — while dinner is a meat kaiseki (from about ¥7,800) of rare cuts grilled over charcoal on a shichirin, grilled sukiyaki in egg and noodles to finish. Private rooms; phone bookings at set hours only. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Chef not named; operator 株式会社Ｍｕｎｄｏ Ｒｉｃｏ (the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: after tasting Omi Hino beef at the Okazaki farm in Shiga, the owners set out to serve only that farm’s beef — heifers fattened slowly to 36–40 months in a calm environment on the farm’s own feed — grilled simply over charcoal. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社Ｍｕｎｄｏ Ｒｉｃｏ (NTA corporate-number site). Reviewers describe a friendly chef and grill master (February 2026) and a young manager (August 2026); one guest from Tokyo has come back five or six times (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "ただ純粋に本物をお届けしたい" — simply to serve the real thing.
chef_bio.specialty: Okazaki-farm Omi Hino beef; grilled sukiyaki; ¥500 beef bowl lunch.

anecdotes.text: A regular of about 20 visits always looks forward to the charcoal-grilled sukiyaki, rolled and dipped in raw egg, and the creative dessert.
A June 2026 group of four in a private room found the meat portions a bit small and ordered extras.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kamogawa-takashi.jp): 完熟近江牛 鴨川たかし、滋賀県近江の岡崎牧場の近江日野牛、日本最古のブランド牛、雌牛のみを生後36〜40ヶ月を目標に長期肥育、炭火焼き、オンラインショップ。食べログ: 焼肉・日本料理・すき焼き、中京区中町通竹屋町上ル末丸町265-1、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩約8分、月・金・土・日 11:00〜14:00 (L.O. 13:00)・18:00〜22:00、水・木 18:00〜22:00、火曜休み、予約電話は10:00〜11:00と17:00〜18:00、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、インボイス T1130001064030 (株式会社Ｍｕｎｄｏ Ｒｉｃｏ)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 近江牛丼500円 (大盛り700円)、コロッケ200円、肉懐石7,800円、七輪の炭火、焼きすき、近江牛の脂で焼く野菜、個室。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone bookings only at 10:00–11:00 and 17:00–18:00; you grill at the table.

places.name: ふくや京都 (Fukuya Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thick Yamagata soba and torichūka ramen in soy-based chicken-and-bonito broths, with saba sushi and dashi rice (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat soba with chicken in chicken-and-bonito broth; other dishes include saba sushi and shirasu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Wednesday to Sunday 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Monday and Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); evenings can be fully booked (September 2026). Lunch queues of 2–5 groups are common, and the kitchen boils four servings at a time, so waits can run long (June–July 2026). 16 seats: 10 at the counter, 6 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX) and QR (Tabelog). A rebuilt old townhouse at the end of a narrow alley behind a coin parking lot, on Sanjo east of Higashinotoin — maps can lead to the car park instead (Tabelog; official site; 2026 reviews). First anniversary in July 2020 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo east of Higashinotoin, down an alley — near Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Yamagata soba izakaya: the owner's home-region "niku soba", Yamagata sake and Yamagata local dishes (official site) · cold meat soba ("tsuttai niku soba") ¥1,200 or hot meat soba — thick, firm soba with free-range chicken chashu in a chicken-and-bonito broth (June–October 2026) · cold or hot torichūka (chicken ramen) (July 2026) · saba sushi, dashi rice ¥500 set, shirasu potato salad, dashi tofu, Manganji peppers, tama-konnyaku, Yamagata nameko (2026 reviews) · Yamagata sake such as Dewazakura and Toko (October 2026) · lunch about ¥1,000–2,000; dinner about ¥3,000–5,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yamagata soba · Sanjo Higashinotoin, hidden behind a car park] A hand-built old townhouse at the end of an alley behind a coin car park, serving the food of the owner's home, Yamagata: thick, chewy "niku soba" with chicken, cold or hot (¥1,200), chilled torichūka, saba sushi, and Yamagata sake and snacks at night. Expect a queue at lunch — the kitchen cooks four bowls at a time, and one July 2026 visitor waited 90 minutes all told. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.origin: Yamagata (official site: "the culture of the owner's home, Yamagata").
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a hideaway at the back of an alley at Sanjo Higashinotoin, built around Yamagata meat soba, Yamagata sake and Yamagata dishes, in an old house rebuilt almost entirely by the owner and staff from old timber and tools; the owner's other shops are ふくや大町 (the main shop) and ふくや六地蔵 in Kamakura; the Kyoto shop marked its first anniversary in July 2020.
chef_bio.philosophy: A place where the cultures of Yamagata, Kamakura and Kyoto meet (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Cold meat soba; torichūka.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner, once hooked on Yamagata meat soba while living in Tohoku, felt shy ordering "tsuttai niku soba" by its menu name — and found the noodles a little too hard.
A July 2026 guest queued 30 minutes while seats sat empty inside, waited over an hour and a half in all, and found a loud regular distracting: "It's a shame because the food was delicious."
An October 2026 visitor, sent to a parking lot by Google, found the shop at the end of the alley on a later try and paired Dewazakura and Toko with Yamagata nameko.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ふくや京都、京都三条東洞院の路地奥の隠れ家、山形特有の肉そば、山形の日本酒、山形の郷土料理、古民家をオーナーとスタッフでほぼ手作りで改築、オーナーの地元山形、本店ふくや大町と2号店ふくや六地蔵は鎌倉、2020年7月に一周年。食べログ: 居酒屋・そば・おでん、中京区菱屋町39、水〜日 11:00〜15:00・18:00〜22:00、月・火休み、予約可、16席 (カウンター10、テーブル6)、禁煙、カード・QR 可。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 駐車場の奥の路地、つったい肉そば1,200円、温かい肉そば、太く硬めのそば、放し飼いの鶏、鶏と鰹のつゆ、鶏中華、鯖寿司、だしご飯500円、しらすのポテサラ、だし豆腐、万願寺とうがらし、玉こんにゃく、なめこ、出羽桜、東光、昼は行列、一度に4人前しか茹でられず待つ、長く待ったとの声 (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Hidden behind a car park; queue at lunch; book for evenings; cards (JCB, AMEX) and QR.

places.name: curd
places.gf_detail: Ask. Fresh pasta, bread (served freely at lunch), fritters and desserts alongside the house cheeses; Tabelog says allergy information is available and asks guests with allergies to phone ahead (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Some vegan options per Tabelog, which lists vegan and vegetarian options and allergy information; the menu is built on house-made cheese, so ask (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 7:00–23:00 (last order 21:30), including breakfast; closed in line with Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Sanjo Premier (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; dishes chosen on the day; 90-minute lunch and 120-minute dinner limits at busy times; phone ahead about allergies and when bringing a pet (Tabelog). 10% service charge at dinner only (Tabelog original ディナーのみ、サービス料10%). 160 seats incl. counter, sofas and an open terrace where dogs are welcome; semi-private room for 10–30; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Ground floor of Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Sanjo Premier, overlooking a courtyard; 4 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; July 2026).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo east of Higashinotoin, hotel ground floor — 4 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Italian of cheese made fresh each morning in the shop's own workshop from milk from a Tanba farm, with homemade fresh pasta and seasonal ingredients (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · lunch: deli plate with two fresh cheeses, antipasti, soup and bread ¥2,420 (July–September 2026); pastas such as burrata tagliatelle with Tanba shimeji and tomato bisque ¥3,080, ricotta, anchovy and lemon spaghettini ¥1,980, pomodoro with fresh mozzarella, squid and chestnut with basil (2026 reviews) · fresh ricotta, burrata, a fig and Kameoka-beef prosciutto platter with tea sauce (August–September 2026) · half-buffet breakfast of cheeses with a main such as an omelette, about ¥3,800 (September 2026) · night café: mascarpone tea-lime tiramisu, plum wine (July 2026) · cheese to take away (August 2026)
places.notes: [Italian · Sanjo, hotel courtyard, cheese made every morning] The Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Sanjo Premier's all-day restaurant, built around an in-house cheese workshop: ricotta, burrata and mozzarella made each morning from Tanba milk, on a ¥2,420 deli-plate lunch, on fresh pastas (about ¥2,000–3,100), or at a cheese-laden breakfast buffet (about ¥3,800). Bright room over a green courtyard, a dog-friendly terrace, mostly overseas hotel guests at breakfast. 10% service at dinner. Open 7:00–23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the Italian dining of Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Sanjo Premier, with fresh cheese made every morning from milk delivered by a farm in Tanba, homemade fresh pasta and seasonal ingredients; a terrace where dogs are welcome. Reviewers in 2026 describe an in-house cheese workshop with a shop, attentive staff, and many international guests at breakfast.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh cheese made every morning (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh ricotta and burrata; cheese breakfast.

A September 2026 diner could not catch all of the soft-spoken explanation of the sparkling wine over the chatter of other tables.
An October 2026 mother came with two daughters and the dog for the terrace, and the staff accommodated a last-minute time change.

places.name: 宗 (Sou)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-based creative Japanese dishes including cream croquettes, tempura, fried taro, kara-age and kamameshi; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-centred cooking with fish, crab, hamo and chicken (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–24:00 (last order 23:30); closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; BYO possible; courses and hot pots; half portions for solo diners (Tabelog; August 2026). An otoshi of ¥600 (Tabelog original お通し代600円) — a three-item starter (October 2026). 32 seats with tables for two and sofas for six; private hire 20–50; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Takeaway (Tabelog). Ground floor of サンハイツ入江 at Nishihorin, west of Shijo Karasuma; 5 min walk from Shijo or Karasuma stations (Tabelog; October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Nishihorin, west of Shijo Karasuma — 5 min walk from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Creative Japanese izakaya built on dashi, with seasonal ingredients from Kyoto and across Japan, cooked by ryotei-trained chefs using vacuum and steam-convection equipment; regional sake (Tabelog) · signature cream croquettes, e.g. crab and crab-miso (Tabelog; September 2026) · courses and hot pots; kamameshi, a house favourite (Tabelog; October 2026) · e.g. fried taro and Kumamoto ginkgo (August 2026); hamo dishes, Saikyo-grilled fish (August 2026); yuba tofu, cucumber with chicken, toro-taku, yuba tempura (September 2026); a three-item starter, sashimi of octopus, sea urchin and white fish, shirako ponzu, salted firefly squid, kara-age with grated daikon (October 2026) · about ¥4,000–8,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Nishihorin west of Shijo Karasuma, dashi and cream croquettes] A lively izakaya a short walk west of Shijo Karasuma where ryotei-trained cooks build creative dishes on careful dashi: a three-bite starter, sashimi, shirako ponzu, fried taro, the house crab cream croquette and kamameshi, with regional sake. Half portions for solo diners; courses for groups. Busy with visitors from abroad early in the evening, calmer after 8. One August 2026 guest was charged for a wrong item — check the bill. ¥600 otoshi. Open until midnight.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: skilled chefs who worked in traditional ryotei, combined with modern equipment such as vacuum machines and steam-convection ovens, cook dashi-centred creative Japanese food from seasonal ingredients; loved by locals and tourists. Reviewers in 2026 describe a thoughtful chef, a friendly manager, efficient staff and many international guests around 19:00.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic, dashi-focused cooking in a casual, welcoming room (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Cream croquettes; kamameshi; dashi dishes.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 solo diner chose a course and found the chef had worked hamo — not on the course — into several dishes.
"However, I was disappointed to find that there was an order mistake, and I was charged for the incorrect menu item." — August 2026, titled "I should have checked the receipt".
An October 2026 Monday visitor found more than half the room foreign tourists at 7 pm and a much calmer room by 8.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、中京区蟷螂山町460 サンハイツ入江1F、四条駅・烏丸駅から徒歩5分、17:30〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、不定休、予約可、お通し代600円、32席 (2人用テーブルから6人のソファ席)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、子ども可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、持ち込み可、テイクアウト、京都や全国の旬の食材とだし、料亭出身の料理人と真空機やスチコン、自慢のクリームコロッケ、全国の地酒、コースと鍋。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 小芋の唐揚げ、熊本の銀杏、鱧、西京焼き、湯葉豆腐、とろたく、湯葉の天ぷら、蟹と蟹味噌のクリームコロッケ、突き出し3品、お造り、白子ポン酢、ほたるいかの塩辛、唐揚げのおろし、釜飯、一人なら半量も、注文を間違えて会計されたとの声 (2026年8月)、19時は海外の客が多く20時以降は落ち着く。

cultural_comfort.note: Half portions for solo diners; ¥600 otoshi; check the bill; cards, e-money and QR.

places.name: 家傳京飴 祇園小石 祇園本店 (Gion Koishi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto candies, kakigori with syrups, anmitsu, warabi mochi with kinako and parfaits; some sweets include wheat gluten (fu); no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Kuromitsu and kinako kakigori, warabi mochi and many candies may be plant-based, but milk, condensed milk, cream and ice cream run through much of the menu; no ingredient information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–17:30; hours may change (Tabelog); one November 2026 visitor arrived for a 10:30 opening. No reservations (Tabelog). Candy shop on the ground floor; the tea room (茶房こいし, a separate Tabelog listing at the same address) at the back of the ground floor and upstairs (Tabelog; August 2026). Waits of about 10 minutes at busy times (September 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Wheelchair access; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). On Shijo-dori in Gion, a short walk from Yasaka Shrine; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori, Gion near Yasaka Shrine — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto candy maker (kyō-ame) with a tea room for kakigori and wagashi (Tabelog; official site) · candies such as the namesake Gion Koishi mix, Uji matcha, hojicha, fruit and monthly seasonal flavours, about ¥432–540 a bag (official site) · kakigori: Uji matcha, Uji kintoki, kuromitsu-kinako, melon, peach with homemade jam, "Wagamama Ice" with anmitsu inside — Amaou strawberry milk ¥1,630, brown-sugar milk ¥1,270 (July–October 2026) · matcha parfait ¥1,350 with free hojicha (June 2026); "Maiko's After-Practice" assortment of nine sweets (August 2026); kuromitsu-kinako warabi mochi (November 2026) · mostly ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Sweets · Gion near Yasaka Shrine, Kyoto candy and kakigori] A Kyoto candy maker on Shijo-dori where, a reviewer says, maiko buy candy here: the ground floor sells jars of kyō-ame — the namesake Gion Koishi mix, Uji matcha, seasonal flavours — and the tea room behind and upstairs serves fluffy kakigori (Uji kintoki, melon, Amaou strawberry milk with anmitsu hidden inside, ¥1,270–1,630), a matcha parfait with free hojicha and warabi mochi. Short waits in the afternoon. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a Kyoto candy (kyō-ame) house, whose namesake Gion Koishi mix has been its signature since the founding; its Gion main shop also has a tea room, and its hojicha candy uses the Kyoto hojicha served there. Per Tabelog: the ground floor is a candy shop and the upper floor a tea room (also listed as 茶房こいし). A reviewer says maiko from Gion come here to buy candy and that the shop avoids additives (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Bringing out natural flavour and sweetness without additives (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyō-ame candy; kakigori.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor called it the best kakigori of a lifetime — Uji kintoki — on a scorching day after visiting family graves at Gojozaka.
An October 2026 theatre-goer, before Kabuki at Minami-za, was glad to find kakigori still served after its supposed end in September.
"This is a shop where maiko from Gion come to buy candy." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (オンラインストア): 家傳京飴 祇園小石、屋号を冠した看板商品「祇園小石」(色とりどり6種の京飴)、宇治抹茶飴、ほうじ茶飴 (祇園本店の甘味処で出す京ほうじ茶を使う)、果物、月替わりの祇園飴歳時記 (10月は栗あめ、11月は葡萄酒飴)、432〜540円、茶房こいし。食べログ: 和菓子・かき氷・カフェ、東山区祇園町北側286-2、祇園四条駅7番出口から徒歩5分、毎日 10:00〜17:30、予約不可、1階は飴の専門店、2階は甘味処 (茶房こいしとして別掲載)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、車椅子可、子ども可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2026年6月〜11月、英語): 抹茶パフェ1,350円、無料のほうじ茶、宇治抹茶のかき氷、宇治金時、黒蜜きなこ、メロン、自家製ジャムの桃、わがまま氷 (あんみつ入り) のあまおうミルク1,630円・黒糖ミルク1,270円、舞妓さんのお稽古帰り (9種の甘味)、黒蜜きなこのわらび餅、舞妓さんが飴を買いに来る店、無添加。

cultural_comfort.note: Say whether you are shopping or eating in; short waits in the afternoon; cards, e-money and QR.

places.name: 逸品さかい (Ippin Sakai)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase courses with dashi and soy, tempura and somen (2026 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses built on dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch from 12:00 (enter by 13:00) and dinner from 18:00 (enter by 20:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Lunch is cash only — no cards at lunch (Tabelog). Service in Japanese only (Tabelog). Lunch omakase ¥3,300 (7 dishes), with dearer lunch courses around ¥4,600; dinner omakase about ¥6,500 (Tabelog; June–October 2026). 19 seats: 8 at the counter and a semi-private sunken-kotatsu room for up to 12 (Tabelog). Free Wi-Fi (February 2026). On Takoyakushi west of Takakura; 4 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 August 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takoyakushi Takakura — 4 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Kyoto cooking as good-value omakase courses from a one-man kitchen (Tabelog, shop text; 2026 reviews) · lunch omakase ¥3,300 for 7 dishes, also ¥3,000 and ¥4,600 courses; dinner omakase ¥6,500 (Tabelog; June–October 2026) · sashimi including fatty tuna, matsutake dobin-mushi, bonito Saikyo-yaki, conger eel in sashimi and soup, sea-bream somen, tempura of sweetfish, eggplant and sweet potato, nama-fu, eel, clay-pot new rice with chirimen sansho, black-sesame dessert, seasonal fruit (July–October 2026) · sake from ¥800, Dassai about ¥1,500 (July 2026)
places.notes: [Kappo · Karasuma, a one-man kitchen at lunch prices] A hidden kappo near Karasuma where the owner cooks every dish alone, yet serves a seven-dish seasonal lunch for ¥3,300 — sashimi, hot tempura, conger eel, clay-pot rice — and a ¥6,500 dinner omakase. Counter or a sunken-kotatsu room; Japanese-only service; cash at lunch. One July 2026 diner flagged housekeeping (a sticky floor, clutter in view). Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), cooking every dish alone (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 August 2020 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe the owner preparing every dish single-handed, still stopping to explain dishes in the private room (July and November 2026), and a gentle, attentive manner (June and August 2026). The shop text pitches seasonal Kyoto flavours at reasonable prices, suited to memorial gatherings and longevity celebrations (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "Enjoying the moment through interaction, not just flavor."
chef_bio.specialty: Value omakase courses; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner liked the food but listed housekeeping lapses: cardboard by the entrance, a sticky floor, and papers and notebooks piled in view of guests.
A July 2026 diner celebrating a husband’s birthday had been brought here by a mother for a birthday years before.
An October 2026 regular used Tabelog points for the ¥4,600 course with the year’s first matsutake dobin-mushi.
