places.name: 京串カツ轟 (Kyokushi Katsu Todoroki)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kushikatsu in a wheat batter, fried in shared oil (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: vegetable skewers share the fryer with meat and seafood, and seasonings include dashi soy (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); Sun 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥200 a person plus tax (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「お席チャージ料、お一人様200円+税頂いております。」). 11 seats: 7–8 at the counter and a sunken-kotatsu table for 4; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; July 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and some QR (Tabelog). Up the stairs on the second floor of a Gion building, easy to miss; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2025). Opened 11 December 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kushikatsu in a delicate batter, each seasoned to its ingredient so no sauce is needed (dashi soy and salt on the side), about 20 seasonal kinds (Tabelog, shop text; 2025–26 reviews) · omakase course of appetizers and 8 skewers ¥2,700 (Tabelog; July 2026) · pork, ume-shiso cheese, beef tongue, duck, sukiyaki, beef sirloin cap with yam, swordfish, nama-fu, asparagus, zucchini, eggplant, mizu-nasu, yam with nori tsukudani (2025–26 reviews) · daily seafood from Ishikawa, horse sashimi (Tabelog; 2025 reviews) · sake from around Japan, highballs (Tabelog; July 2026) · usually under ¥5,000–8,000 a head (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Kushikatsu · Gion, sauce-free skewers till 3 a.m.] A small second-floor counter in Gion frying kushikatsu in a thin, light batter and seasoning each skewer so it needs no sauce — duck, beef tongue, swordfish, nama-fu, mizu-nasu. The ¥2,700 course of eight skewers and starters is a bargain for Gion; add horse sashimi or Ishikawa fish. ¥200 seat charge; smoking allowed. Open to 3:00 (midnight on Sunday).

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): kushikatsu in a delicate batter with house-made sauces, daily seafood from Ishikawa and sake from around Japan; opened 11 December 2022. Reviewers mention a youthful team, sometimes one staff member on alone (August 2025, July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Sauce-free kushikatsu.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner found it still finding its direction, was put off seeing staff accept drinks from acquaintances while cooking, and might go elsewhere next time.
A July 2026 solo diner found one person serving six guests until a second arrived, and still ate eight skewers plus five more for under ¥5,000.
An August 2025 diner with a picky companion found the staff accommodating with the omakase.

cultural_comfort.note: Take the omakase course or order skewers à la carte; ¥200 seat charge; smoking allowed.

places.name: 一華 (Ichihana)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses with dashi and soy, tempura and a beef cutlet, finished with kamameshi (2024–26 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses built on dashi with fish and meat (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 and dinner 17:00–21:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday (Tabelog). Because of a staff shortage, lunch is by phone reservation only (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥880 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「先付け 880円」). Lunch: two kamameshi courses, with or without sashimi (September 2026); dinner courses from ¥7,700 (the basic Koka course, November 2024) or à la carte (December 2025, February 2026). 7 counter seats only (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Near Nijo Castle; 3 min from Nijojo-mae Stn exit 2 (Tabelog). Opened 3 February 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: By Nijo Castle — 3 min from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Japanese cooking finished with kamameshi — about seven kinds, cooked to order in an iron pot (2024–26 reviews) · kamameshi of octopus and young ginger, oyster, crab, chicken and mushroom, clam (2024–26 reviews) · yuba with uni, sashimi of sea bream, kanpachi, yellowtail, bonito and sweet shrimp, chawanmushi, anago sashimi, braised sea-bream head, fried sweetfish, tempura of sakura shrimp and new onion, beef cutlet (2024–26 reviews) · lunch kamameshi courses about ¥3,000–5,000; dinner course from ¥7,700, about ¥8,000–15,000 a head (2024–26 reviews) · sake such as Eiko Fuji and Garyubai (February 2026)
places.notes: [Kamameshi kappo · Nijo Castle, seven seats and an iron pot] A seven-seat counter near Nijo Castle where the chef cooks alone and ends every meal with kamameshi — oyster, crab, octopus and young ginger — cooked to order with a crisp crust. Lunch is a kamameshi course (about ¥3,000–5,000, phone booking only); dinner is a course from ¥7,700 or à la carte with sake. ¥880 appetizer charge. Closed Wednesday and Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), cooking alone at the counter (November 2025)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 February 2015 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a friendly owner-chef who runs the counter alone and talks with guests while cooking (2024–26 reviews); a December 2025 reviewer calls it a Bib Gourmand restaurant.
chef_bio.specialty: Kamameshi; seasonal small dishes.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner found the dishes slow to arrive but the care worth the wait.
A January 2025 same-day booker heard about the etiquette of doing business in Kyoto from the chef.
A November 2024 diner noted prices had been raised because of rising costs.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・釜飯、中京区押小路油小路西入る二条油小路町264-1、二条城前駅2番出口から徒歩3分、昼 12:00〜14:00・夜 17:00〜21:00、水曜・日曜休み、人手不足のため昼は電話予約のみ、先付け880円、カウンター7席のみ、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2015年2月3日オープン。口コミ (2024年5月〜2026年9月、英語): 約7種の釜めし (蛸と新生姜、牡蠣、蟹、鶏ときのこ)、湯葉と雲丹、お造り、茶碗蒸し、鯛のあら炊き、天ぷら、牛カツ、夜のコース7,700円から、昼の釜めしコース、店主一人で切り盛り、ビブグルマンという声、料理が出るまで時間がかかるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone (lunch phone only); counter of seven; ¥880 appetizer charge.

places.name: 茶寮哲心 (Saryo Tesshin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The soba is 100% buckwheat (October 2026), but the dipping sauces and broths use soy, and there is fried tofu and a financier (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: broths are bonito or duck, and the signature Daigo soba has cheese and egg yolk (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Japanese breakfast 8:00–11:00 (reservation by 21:00 the day before); lunch 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:15); dinner 17:00–21:00 (last entry 20:00; evening course by reservation the day before); Wednesday 10:00–16:00 only (Tabelog). Seating limited to 45 minutes; one drink per person; preschool children only in the 15:00 slot; same-day bookings by phone (Tabelog). No cash — cards, IC cards, e-money and QR only (Tabelog; September 2026). 13 counter seats, some beside a small garden; English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog; October 2026). Just south of Karasuma Marutamachi, 3 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 27 April 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma Marutamachi, south of the Imperial Palace — 3 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Soba of 100% buckwheat in an elegant, ryotei-like room, from breakfast to dinner — the Kyoto shop of a Miyazaki soba restaurant (2026 reviews) · Daigo soba with Parmigiano and egg yolk, hot or cold (September–October 2026) · duck nanban set with grilled leek, maitake, fried tofu and grilled eggplant; duck seiro and duck tsuke-soba (2026 reviews) · soba-yu to finish; a financier with sets; yuzu cider (2026 reviews) · Japanese breakfast and an evening course by reservation (Tabelog) · about ¥4,000–6,000 a head; a large duck soba came to ¥5,200 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Soba · Karasuma Marutamachi, luxury soba from 8 a.m.] A plush thirteen-seat soba counter south of the Imperial Palace, the Kyoto shop of a Miyazaki soba house, open from breakfast. Try the Daigo soba — 100% buckwheat under Parmigiano and egg yolk — or the duck nanban in a rich broth. Pricey at about ¥4,000–6,000, and two diners found the soba's aroma faint for the price. 45-minute seatings; one drink each; no cash.

chef_bio.background: Opened 27 April 2024 (Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer calls it the Kyoto shop of a long-popular soba restaurant from Miyazaki City (Tabelog lists Soba ya Tesshin in Miyazaki), notes a painting of a tiger and cub by Shinsuke Kawahara, and a Tabelog review title cites a Michelin Bib Gourmand. The soba flour came from Azumino, a September 2026 diner was told.
chef_bio.specialty: Daigo soba; duck nanban soba.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner found the soba’s aroma and sweetness barely there for ¥5,200 and the bowl too hot to hold, though the décor and service were striking.
An October 2026 diner liked the cheese aroma of the Daigo soba but felt it lacked buckwheat fragrance for the price.
An October 2026 visitor found the English menu and fluent English service thorough, and urged finishing with soba-yu.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff; book online; cashless only; 45-minute seatings.

places.name: 都野菜 賀茂 烏丸店 (Miyakoyasai Kamo Karasuma)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists gluten-free options and allergy information, but the shop says allergy details are not available for every item; the buffet also has udon, gratin, curry and fried chicken (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options, and an October 2026 reviewer found no meat or fish at breakfast; but miso soup and obanzai are dashi-based, and lunch and dinner add meat dishes (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–10:00 (last order 9:15), lunch 10:30–16:00, dinner 16:30–22:00 (buffet to 21:30); open all year (Tabelog). Bookings on the website; no phone bookings — calls 15:00–18:00 for questions only (Tabelog). Buy a ticket at the machine on entry; when full, 60 minutes at lunch and 80 at dinner — Tabelog's Japanese original: "満席の場合はランチ60分／ディナー80分の時間制限あり". Breakfast buffet ¥650 (October 2026). Children's prices at lunch and dinner; 67 seats; English and Simplified Chinese menus with photos; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking; cards incl. UnionPay (Tabelog). 2 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin south of Ayanokoji, near Shijo-Karasuma — 2 min walk
places.cuisine: All-you-can-eat buffet of Kyoto vegetables grown by local farmers using organic, pesticide-free or reduced-pesticide methods, with salads and obanzai; shabu-shabu and courses as well (Tabelog) · breakfast buffet of vegetables, obanzai and rice porridge ¥650 (October 2026) · lunch and dinner mains with the buffet: beef sukiyaki udon ¥2,300 + ¥700 buffet (September 2026); beef-topped seafood bowl or sukiyaki mazesoba ¥3,500 with buffet (September 2026); weekday mala tang fair (September 2026) · buffet extras: curry, gratin, udon, kara-age, house dressings such as Shogoin turnip (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kyoto-vegetable buffet · near Shijo-Karasuma] A long-running, good-value buffet of Kyoto farm vegetables, obanzai and salads — from a ¥650 breakfast at 7 am to lunch and dinner sets with sukiyaki, shabu-shabu or rice bowls. Buy a ticket on entry; time limits when busy. Tabelog lists vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options — ask which dishes. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 26 December 2012 (Tabelog). Per the operator: Kyoto vegetables grown by local farmers using organic, pesticide-free and reduced-pesticide methods. A sister shop, 都野菜 賀茂 京都駅前店, appears in our crawl.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: to share the true blessings of Kyoto through its vegetables.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-vegetable buffet; ¥650 breakfast.

anecdotes.text: Arriving at 7:00 on an October 2026 morning, a diner found people already queuing for breakfast.
A September 2026 return visitor found the weekday vegetable corner a little thinner than at weekends, but the mala tang fair delicious.
A November 2026 diner who meant to eat only vegetables was undone by the curry, gratin, udon and kara-age.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 都野菜 賀茂 烏丸店、ビュッフェ・鍋・しゃぶしゃぶ、下京区東洞院通綾小路下る扇酒屋町276、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩2分、朝食7:00〜10:00 (L.O. 9:15)、ランチ10:30〜16:00、ディナー16:30〜22:00 (バイキングは21:30まで)、年中無休、予約はウェブで (電話予約は不可)、入口の券売機で食券、満席の場合はランチ60分／ディナー80分の時間制限あり、67席、英語・簡体字のメニュー、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーの対応あり、アレルギー表示は全品ではない、子供料金あり、2012年12月26日オープン、地元の農家が有機・無農薬・減農薬で育てた京野菜、サラダとおばんざいの食べ放題。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): 朝食650円、牛すき焼きうどん2,300円+ビュッフェ700円、海鮮丼とすき焼き混ぜそば3,500円、麻辣湯、Shogoin かぶのドレッシング、カレー、グラタン、唐揚げ。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese menus with photos; ticket machine on entry (Tabelog).

staff_allergy_handling: Allergy information is not available for every item; ask the staff (Tabelog).

places.name: 祇園ごずこん (Gion Gozukon)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Gyoza, pasta, ramen, fried dishes and Japanese plates; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2022–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, local chicken, wagyu and meat gyoza (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 18:00–23:00; Sun and holidays 18:00–22:00; closed Monday and the 1st and 3rd Sundays (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし". 8 counter seats, renovated (Tabelog says on 17 June); private hire; non-smoking with a smoking space; cards (Tabelog). The wine list is not handed out — staff suggest bottles in conversation (Tabelog). On Shinbashi-dori east of Hanamikoji, south side; 7 min from Gion-Shijo or Sanjo-Keihan Stn (Tabelog; February 2025).
places.neighborhood: Shinbashi-dori east of Hanamikoji, Gion — 7 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: "Wa-yo kappo" without genre: three chef's-choice starters, then à la carte — Japanese, Western, gyoza, ramen, pasta — from contract-farm vegetables, local chicken, wagyu and fish from around Japan; wines chosen in conversation (Tabelog) · in reviews: the signature Gozukon gyoza, hairy crab, sirloin cap, takikomi rice, dashimaki, grilled hamo, Kyoto Akadori chicken thigh, sea urchin with tuna and egg yolk, bamboo shoot with seaweed, chilled corn soup, onigiri (2022–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Wa-yo kappo & wine · Gion Shinbashi] An eight-seat counter off Hanamikoji where genre-free cooking — Japanese plates, pasta, ramen and a famously meaty gyoza — meets wine chosen by talking with the staff rather than from a list. Three starters, then order as you like; about ¥15,000–25,000. Loved by regulars for some 20 years. Closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Per the operator: renovated on 17 June (year not given), now counter-only; loved by local regulars and welcoming tourists. An August 2026 reviewer has come for about 20 years. A February 2025 reviewer (Japanese) relates that the gyoza became the signature after the late singer やしきたかじん asked for a dish to go with wine.
chef_bio.specialty: Gozukon gyoza with wine.

anecdotes.text: "故やしきたかじんさんがワインに合う名物料理を作れと言う事で大将が苦心して名物になった餃子が出来上がった" — a February 2025 reviewer on how the gyoza began.
An October 2024 regular noted that many Kyoto restaurants now charge over ¥50,000, while here kaiseki-style dishes come à la carte at reasonable prices.
A diner of about twenty years praised the owner's personality — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 祇園ごずこん、海鮮・日本料理・居酒屋、東山区新橋通花見小路東入ル2丁目橋本町417、三条京阪駅・祇園四条駅から徒歩7分、火〜土 18:00〜23:00、日祝 18:00〜22:00、月曜と第1・3日曜休み、サービス料: なし、8席 (カウンター)、6月17日にリニューアル、ジャンルにとらわれない創作料理 (和食、洋食、餃子、ラーメン、パスタ)、契約農家の野菜、地鶏、和牛、全国の鮮魚、お任せの前菜3品のあとアラカルト、ワインリストは出さず会話で選ぶ、名物ごずこん餃子、和洋割烹。口コミ (2022年6月〜2026年8月): 毛蟹、サーロインのかぶり、炊き込みご飯、だし巻き、鱧の焼き物、Kyoto Akadori の鶏、雲丹と鮪と卵黄、故やしきたかじんさんの注文で生まれた餃子 (2025年2月、日本語)、約20年通う客。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; wine by conversation, no list; book ahead.

places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Sushi with soy, alternating with kaiseki dishes on dashi; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi and fish kaiseki (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 15:00–22:00, last seating 19:00; closed Tuesday and over Obon and New Year (Tabelog). Reservation only, through OMAKASE (Tabelog). No children (Tabelog). 10 seats over two rooms of five, at counters; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog; October 2026). Bills about ¥30,000–59,999 a head (2025–26 reviews). In a quiet alley off the stone-paved Shimogawara-dori near Kodai-ji (2025–26 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Shimogawara near Kodai-ji, Higashiyama — 15 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Sushi kaiseki from Kikunoi, alternating sushi and Kyoto dishes, served on Kitaoji Rosanjin and other fine ware that guests may choose from the shelves (2025–26 reviews) · in reviews: tai-roe tofu with konowata, karasumi wrapped in squid, kinome tofu, sea-urchin tofu, kisu, torigai, sea bream, akami and toro, Densuke anago soup, charcoal-grilled sweet shrimp, filefish, a dish of crab and caviar (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi kaiseki · near Kodai-ji, from Kikunoi] The famous Kyoto ryotei Kikunoi's sushi counter: ten seats in two rooms down a quiet Higashiyama alley, where sushi alternates with kaiseki dishes and you can pick your plate from shelves of Rosanjin ware. Once for regulars only, now bookable online. Around ¥30,000–50,000. No children; closed Tuesday.

roles: Kikunoi group (no person named in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per 2025–26 reviews: a sushi kaiseki restaurant of the long-established Kyoto ryotei Kikunoi (our record kyoto_kikunoi_honten), first an exclusive room for regulars (August 2025) and opened to the public in 2025 (October 2026); reached by booking through OMAKASE (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi alternating with kaiseki; Rosanjin tableware.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 regular of the main Kikunoi could ask for a particular Rosanjin piece and have a dish served on it.
A July 2026 guest at first thought grilling sweet shrimp over charcoal was excessive — until tasting it.
A diner without contacts got in in August 2025 only through a friend's connection.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 菊乃井 鮨 青、寿司、東山区下河原通463-30、15:00〜22:00 (最終入店19:00)、火曜休み、お盆と年末年始休み、完全予約制 (OMAKASE から)、10席 (カウンター)、子供不可、カード可。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年10月、英語): 菊乃井の鮨懐石、常連向けから2025年に一般公開、2室各5席、Rosanjin の器、器を選べる、鯛の子豆腐とこのわた、イカで巻いたからすみ、雲丹豆腐、鱚、鳥貝、鮪、Densuke 穴子の椀、炭火の甘海老、皮剥、蟹とキャビア、高台寺近くの路地。

cultural_comfort.note: Book through OMAKASE; no children.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Cakes, pies, cookies and chocolate; Tabelog says allergy information is available (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. An August 2026 reviewer had a plant-based "botanical vanilla" gelato; most cakes and sweets use butter, cream and cheese (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–19:00, closing days not fixed (Tabelog). No bookings; a waiting number by tablet at busy times (October 2026). Takeaway sweets on the 1st floor; eat-in café on the 3rd floor of the building, a separate listing (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay; allergy and calorie information available; children welcome (Tabelog). Parking free for 2 hours with ¥5,000 spent at GOOD NATURE STATION or Takashimaya Kyoto (Tabelog). 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn exit 4 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi south of Shijo, in GOOD NATURE STATION — 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Patisserie and bean-to-bar chocolate known for sculptural cakes (2026 reviews) · gelato: smoked cheese, aroma-chocolate strawberry single ¥660 + ¥200, cassis cabbage, double ¥990; plant-based botanical vanilla (2026 reviews) · seasonal plated desserts such as fig with several cheeses; cocoa kakigori ¥2,200 in summer; cinnamon pie with figs; caramel sandwich cookie with salted praline; "Nami-Nami" six-piece biscuits as gifts (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Patisserie & chocolate · Kawaramachi] A stylish patisserie in the GOOD NATURE STATION building, famous for artful cakes and bean-to-bar chocolate, with unusual gelato (smoked cheese, cassis-cabbage) and a plant-based vanilla. Take away downstairs or eat in at the leafy 3rd-floor café. About ¥1,000–3,000. Open daily 11:00–19:00.

roles: Shop of GOOD NATURE STATION (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 9 December 2019 (Tabelog), in GOOD NATURE STATION, whose 3rd-floor café serves RAU sweets with regional coffee, Japanese black tea and chocolate drinks (Tabelog remarks).
chef_bio.specialty: Artistic cakes; bean-to-bar chocolate.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 third-timer found the summer cocoa kakigori smaller than expected for ¥2,200.
A September 2026 guest made several takeaway requests and all were met with a smile.
On a Sunday evening in October 2026 a gelato fan took a tablet number and waited about 15 minutes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: RAU、ケーキ・チョコレート・パン、下京区河原町四条下ル2稲荷町318-6 GOOD NATURE STATION 1F、阪急京都河原町駅4番出口から徒歩2分、11:00〜19:00、不定休、予約不可、カード・PayPay 可、アレルギー表示・カロリー表示あり、テイクアウト、2019年12月9日オープン、3階のカフェスペースは別掲載。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): 芸術的なケーキ、ビーン・トゥ・バーのチョコレート、スモークチーズのジェラート、プラントベースのバニラ、カシスとキャベツ、無花果とチーズのデザート、ココアのかき氷2,200円、シナモンパイ、塩プラリネのキャラメルサンド、Nami-Nami 6個入り。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in; tablet queue numbers when busy.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options, and there is a vegetable paella (2026 reviews), but how the stock is made is not stated. Most paellas use seafood, chicken or bacon.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–21:30 — lunch 11:30–16:00, dinner 16:00–21:30 (food L.O. 20:30, drinks 21:00); take-away paella orders until 20:30, pick-up by 21:00; irregular closures. Bookings online through the official site; parties of 7 or more by phone. Opened 12 June 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yanagibamba-dori near Oike — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Paella restaurant of the local Bajarbol group, named after the farmhouses of the Albufera near Valencia (official site) · about eleven paellas, including a small one-gō size; iron-pan paella lunch with salad and soup — vegetable ¥2,350 (May 2026) or ¥2,480 (August 2026), mixed chicken and seafood ¥2,780, sardine and tomato ¥2,150, bacon and cheese (2026 reviews; Tabelog) · tapas: oven-baked lamb with lemon ¥1,540, gizzard ajillo ¥1,100, prosciutto and mushroom ajillo ¥1,100, smoked salmon salad ¥1,050, sea bass with garlic-lemon sauce ¥1,800, homemade bread ¥400 (2026 reviews) · Spanish courses; wine, cocktails and mocktails ¥660 (2026 reviews) · take-away paella by the day before (official site)
places.notes: [Paella · Oike, a Valencian farmhouse in Kyoto] A two-floor Spanish dining room by Oike that cooks about eleven paellas in iron pans, from vegetable to seafood and chicken, in one-gō sizes for one or two. Lunch sets with salad and soup run ¥2,150–2,780; tapas like gizzard ajillo and lemon lamb fill out dinner. Paella takes time — reviewers say it is worth the wait. A regular noted prices rising and bread dropped from the lunch set (August 2026). Vegan options are listed — ask. Sister café nearby.

roles: Not named in a source; run by Bajarbol Co. (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official sites: run by Bajarbol (バハルボール), a company that began with a small restaurant at Teramachi-Nijo and also runs a paella food truck (Paella Bus) and the sister Café Barraca nearby (亀屋町380); the name Barraca is the thatched, whitewashed farmhouse around Lake Albufera near Valencia, where paella began with rabbit and chicken. Opened 12 June 2016 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: everyday Spanish food, without formality, that turns an ordinary meal into a good memory.
chef_bio.specialty: Iron-pan paella; tapas.

anecdotes.text: A seventh-time regular noted in August 2026 that paella prices had risen since May and that homemade bread was no longer part of the lunch set.
A wall display of pan sizes helps choose how big a paella to order (August 2026).
"I heard that this is the only paella specialty restaurant in Kyoto." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (barraca.jp、bajarbol.jp): パエリアレストラン バラッカ、店名はバレンシアのアルブフェラ湖のまわりの漆喰塗りで藁ぶき屋根の家「BARRACA」から、パエリアは猟師がウサギや鶏で作ったのが始まり、伝統的なパエリアからオリジナルまで、パエリアの持ち帰りは前日までの予約、中京区柳八幡町78 (柳馬場通姉小路上ル)、姉妹店カフェバラッカ (亀屋町380、御幸町通御池上ル)、運営はバハルボール (寺町二条のビルの奥の小さなレストランから始まった会社、パエリアバス)。食べログ: スペイン料理・バル・居酒屋、毎日11:30〜21:30 (ランチ〜16:00、ディナー16:00〜、料理 L.O. 20:30)、テイクアウトは20:30まで注文・21:00受け取り、不定休、7名以上は電話予約、サービス料・チャージ無し、40席 (1階24、2階16)、2階は貸切可、禁煙、子供可、持ち込み可、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン対応、カード・交通系IC可、QR不可、2016年6月12日オープン、パエリア11種ほど、1合の小サイズ。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): 鉄鍋パエリアランチ (サラダとスープ付き)、野菜2,350円 (5月)・2,480円 (8月)、鶏と魚介のミックス2,780円、鰯とトマト2,150円、ベーコンとチーズ、仔羊のオーブン焼きレモン1,540円、砂肝のアヒージョ1,100円、生ハムときのこのアヒージョ1,100円、スモークサーモンのサラダ1,050円、スズキのガーリックレモンソース1,800円、自家製パン400円、モクテル660円、パエリアは時間がかかる、値上げとランチのパンがなくなった、京都で唯一のパエリア専門店と聞いたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English page on the official site; photo and digital menus (Tabelog); book online.

places.name: ヒレ焼肉 京都園 (Hire Yakiniku Kyoto En)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; yakiniku with house sauces and ponzu, a sukiyaki in sweet soy, and cold noodles to finish (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu tenderloin course with beef sashimi and sukiyaki (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 21:30, drinks 22:00); large groups outside these hours by arrangement; irregular closures. Same-day bookings accepted if seats are free. 20 seats at four tables; smoking allowed — ask before bringing children; English menu; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 6 July 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion near Yasaka Shrine and Chion-in, second floor — 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Yakiniku specialising in wagyu tenderloin · the "Hire Yakiniku" course ¥22,000: kimchi, namul, Korean seaweed, beef sashimi (salt yukhoe with caviar), about 200 g each of wagyu Chateaubriand and tenderloin grilled at the table and pulled apart with a fork, sirloin sukiyaki under shaved summer truffle with egg, seaweed soup, rice, mini cold noodles (2026 reviews) · Omi beef cuts (July 2026) · sauces, salt, grated-daikon ponzu, wasabi, yuzu pepper, meat miso (July 2026) · lemon chuhai, makgeolli (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Gion, tenderloin only] A small upstairs yakiniku near Yasaka Shrine that serves only tenderloin: one ¥22,000 course where the staff grill thick wagyu Chateaubriand and fillet at the table until it pulls apart with a fork, then a sirloin sukiyaki buried in shaved truffle. Diners call it pricey but worth it. Smoking allowed. Open daily till 23:00.

roles: Owner who grills at the table (October 2026); not named
chef_bio.background: Opened 6 July 2023 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a tenderloin-only yakiniku on the second floor near Yasaka Shrine and Chion-in, where the owner or staff grill each cut at the table and guests compare Chateaubriand, head tenderloin and fillet of Omi beef.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu Chateaubriand and tenderloin; truffle sukiyaki.

anecdotes.text: For the first bite, a July 2026 guest was told to dip the meat in a cocotte of beef fat and whole garlic warming on the grill.
"What surprised me the most was the enormous Chateaubriand and Tenderloin, which looked like Ayers Rock!" — September 2026.
An October 2026 guest used the egg left from the sukiyaki to make egg over rice at the end.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ヒレ焼肉 京都園、焼肉、東山区松原町272-5 コミュニティ祇園ビル2F、八坂神社から200m、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 21:30、ドリンク L.O. 22:00)、営業時間外の団体は相談、不定休、空きがあれば当日予約可、20席 (4名2卓・6名2卓)、喫煙可 (子供連れは相談)、英語メニュー、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2023年7月6日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): ヒレ焼肉コース22,000円、キムチ、ナムル、韓国のり、肉刺し (塩ユッケとキャビア)、和牛シャトーブリアンとヒレ各200gほどをフォークで裂ける焼き加減に、サーロインの夏トリュフすき焼き、わかめスープ、ご飯、冷麺、近江牛、タレ・塩・おろしポン酢・わさび・柚子胡椒・肉味噌、店主が焼いてくれる、高いが価値があるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); one course, grilled for you at the table.

places.name: Rauk 本店 (Boulangerie Rauk)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery of breads, sandwiches, Danishes and pies (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream buns, bacon epi, burgers and egg sandwiches; no item is marked vegan (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 7:00–18:30; closed Thursday. Take-away only; products can be reserved (Tabelog). No cards; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 2 October 2001 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishinotoin north of Shichijo, between the two Hongan-ji temples — 7 min walk from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood bakery with some 30 kinds of bread from 7 am · signature "California Uji" (red-bean paste and walnuts, soft or hard) about ¥250; custard cream bun ¥240; chocolate gâteau ¥280; Western-style curry bread ¥260; pain aux raisins ¥460; Kyoto melon bread with matcha ¥305; "Wasa Mayo" bacon bread with wasabi mayo and shiso; Tsukimi cheese burger ¥519; bacon epi; mizuna sandwich (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bakery · Nishinotoin-Shichijo, from 7 am] A small retro bakery blending into a residential street north of Shichijo, open from 7 am with about thirty breads: the walnut-and-red-bean "California Uji", a lemony custard cream bun, wasabi-mayo bacon bread, burgers. A friendly owner and classical music; a May 2026 regular found prices higher and a sandwich’s tomato thin. Take-away only. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 2 October 2001 (Tabelog). The shop’s own page shows the main shop blending into the houses around it, so that drivers often pass it. Reviewers in 2026 describe a small retro bakery between Higashi and Nishi Hongan-ji, about 30 breads, classical music and a friendly owner.
chef_bio.specialty: California Uji; cream bun.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 hotel guest next door bought breakfast here and found the wasabi mayo on the bacon bread a combination never tasted before.
"Overall, the prices seem a bit high. I wonder if they have increased in line with the recent rise in living costs?" — May 2026, after five years away.
A September 2026 customer arriving at the 7 am opening wondered what time baking must start.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 店のページ (rauk.okoshi-yasu.com): Boulangerie Rauk (ルーク)、本店の外観は周りの民家にとけこんでいて車では通り過ぎる人も多い、下京区西洞院七条上る福本町422-2、7:00〜18:30、木曜定休。食べログ: パン・サンドイッチ・ベーグル、京都駅から徒歩約7分、持ち帰りのみ、予約可、カード不可、電子マネー・QR可、2001年10月2日オープン。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): パン30種ほど、California Uji (あんこと胡桃、ソフトとハード) 250円ほど、クリームパン240円、ショコラガトー280円、洋風カレーパン260円、パン・オ・レザン460円、Kyoto Melon Bread 305円、Wasa Mayo、Tsukimi Cheese Burger 519円、ベーコンエピ、水菜のサンド、気さくな店主、クラシック音楽、値上がりした、トマトが薄いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick breads from the shelves and pay at the till; no cards.

places.name: 肉料理 川もり (Niku Ryori Kawamori)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; yakiniku with house sauces, japchae and garlic rice (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef and offal yakiniku (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun 17:00–22:00 (last entry 21:30); closed Monday and one other day a month. Bookings taken; a reservation-only restaurant per an October 2026 diner. A charge of ¥500 including tax per guest (Tabelog; Japanese original 「500円（税込）」). 30 seats with a counter, sunken and partitioned private rooms; English menu; children welcome; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Tabelog lists it as non-smoking, but July 2026 diners and a September 2026 diner say smoking is allowed, including in the semi-private room. A July 2026 regular knew it from its earlier site in Higashiyama.
places.neighborhood: South of Marutamachi, in a machiya down an alley — 7–10 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Yakiniku of very fresh beef and offal in a Kyoto machiya, à la carte or by course (2026 reviews) · seen: beef sashimi, premium beef-tongue yukhoe, fresh tongue, special outside skirt, seared heart, tetchan, thin-sliced tripe, front-leg cuts, beef tendon, japchae, yukgaejang, garlic rice (2026 reviews) · the house chilli is a must (July 2026) · makgeolli, wine, sake, shochu (2026 reviews; Tabelog) · about ¥10,000–20,000 a head with drinks (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · near the Imperial Palace, beef fresh enough to eat raw] A tidy yakiniku in a machiya down an alley south of Marutamachi, moved here from Higashiyama, where diners sear very fresh beef and offal only lightly — tongue, skirt, heart, tripe — and the house chilli is a must. Staff show first-timers how to grill and are relaxed with children. ¥500 charge. Smoking allowed in parts despite Tabelog’s listing. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A July 2026 regular followed it from its earlier site in Higashiyama. Reviewers in 2026 describe a small, tidy yakiniku in a Kyoto machiya down an alley, popular with locals, with staff who teach guests how to grill and welcome families.
chef_bio.specialty: Very fresh beef and offal; house chilli.

anecdotes.text: "Everything except for the Tetchan can be eaten raw!" — October 2026.
A September 2026 diner who phoned on the off-chance got a table, and the staff showed how to grill each cut.
"Considering the abundance of similar quality restaurants in Tokyo, I would rate it a solid 3.5." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 肉料理 川もり、焼肉・牛料理、中京区堺町通竹屋町上る橘町97、丸太町駅5番出口から徒歩7〜10分、火〜日 17:00〜22:00 (最終入店21:30)、月曜と月1回の不定休、予約可、チャージ料500円 (税込)、30席 (カウンター、掘りごたつ、仕切りのある個室)、禁煙と記載、英語メニュー、子供可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 以前は東山にあった、路地の京町家、生でも食べられそうな新鮮な肉、肉刺し、上タンのユッケ、生タン、ハラミ、ハツの炙り、テッチャン、センマイ、トウガラシ、牛すじ、チャプチェ、ユッケジャン、ガーリックライス、名物の唐辛子、マッコリ、2人で2万円ほど、焼き方を教えてくれる、子供連れにやさしい、喫煙可 (半個室も)、東京なら同等の店が多いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); staff show how to grill (September 2026); book ahead.

places.name: ラクイイッカイ (Rakui Ikkai)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-based dishes, carpaccio, game meats, terrines, pâté and a tonkatsu; agedashi tofu is the signature; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi throughout, fish, venison, horse, pork and chicken (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–24:00, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; phone ahead about dessert plates; one drink per person (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥330 a head including tax (Tabelog, original お席代). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 12 seats, including shared seating at a large iron teppan table for about eight; a private room, kanna., for course meals by reservation (Tabelog; November 2025). Non-smoking; Wi-Fi; BYO allowed; sommelier (Tabelog). No sign before opening (November 2025). Off Muromachi south of Ayanokoji, 2 min from Shijo / Karasuma Stns (Tabelog). Opened 5 June 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Muromachi south of Ayanokoji — 2 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Dashi and wine bistro: Kyoto dashi dishes, local vegetables and game with over 150 wines chosen by the sommelier owner (Tabelog shop text; October 2026) · signature agedashi tofu (Tabelog shop text) · dashi and vegetable terrine ¥1,300 (November 2025) · carpaccio with edible flowers, salads (2025) · horse tartare, fromage de tête, herb-crusted venison, chicken-neck ajillo, liver pâté (January 2026) · venison steak; a light tonkatsu (2026) · wine by the glass to taste, pairings (2025–2026)
places.notes: [Wine bistro · Shijo-Muromachi, dashi meets wine] A small, sign-less bistro in the Muromachi back streets — formerly the restaurant sketch. — where a sommelier owner matches more than 150 wines to dashi dishes, local vegetables and game: agedashi tofu, a dashi-and-vegetable terrine, venison steak, fromage de tête. Shared seating around a big teppan table. Service can be slow when busy, and some find it pricey. ¥330 seat charge; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: the restaurant sketch. became Rakui Ikkai, specialising in dashi and wine, with a private room, kanna., for course meals. Tabelog gives the opening as 5 June 2020. An October 2026 reviewer notes the owner is a sommelier.
chef_bio.specialty: Agedashi tofu; game with wine pairings.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 birthday diner, booking during Obon at half an hour’s notice, ordered only quick starters and ended up with a table of cold dishes.
A November 2025 visitor wished the soft drink came with dashi too, and was briefly unsure the sign-less door was the right place.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラクイイッカイ、居酒屋・創作料理・ワインバー、下京区白楽天町502 福井ビル1F、四条駅・烏丸駅から徒歩2分、月〜土 18:00〜24:00、日曜休み、予約可、デザートプレートは電話で確認、1ドリンク制、お席代1人330円、カード可、12席、禁煙、Wi-Fi、持ち込み可、ソムリエ、2020年6月5日オープン。店の紹介: sketch. が出汁とワインの店ラクイイッカイに、名物の揚げ出し豆腐、150種以上のワイン、個室 kanna. はコースのみ予約制。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 出汁と野菜のテリーヌ1,300円、花をのせたカルパッチョ、馬肉のタルタル、フロマージュ・ド・テット、鹿のハーブ焼き、鶏ネックのアヒージョ、レバーパテ、鹿のステーキ、とんかつ、大きな鉄板のテーブルの相席、店主はソムリエ、提供が遅いことも。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥330 seat charge; one drink each; shared table; no sign before opening.

places.name: 天ぷら 天寅 新風館店 (Tempura Tentora, Shinpukan)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura bar — wheat batter on nearly everything (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and there is vegetable tempura (sweet potato, fig), but batter, dipping broth and miso soup are not described (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Weekdays: lunch 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); weekends and holidays 11:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); open every day (Tabelog). Lunch reservations until 11:00, then first come, first served (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 18 high counter seats (Tabelog; April 2026). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; Wi-Fi; children welcome (Tabelog). Ground floor of Shinpukan, 1 min from the Karasuma-Oike south ticket gate (Tabelog). Opened 22 June 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinpukan, Karasuma-Oike — 1 min from the station
places.cuisine: Casual tempura bar: freshly fried tempura sets and à la carte with drinks (2026 reviews) · tempura set meal ¥1,540 — shrimp, white fish, vegetables, a large sweet potato and kakiage, with rice, miso soup and pickles (April–July 2026) · Tentora set meal (May 2026) · tempura rice bowl, weekday lunch only (July 2026) · chilled sudachi soba with tempura; seasonal fig tempura (August 2026) · anago tempura, oden daikon, creative tempura of seafood, vegetables and meat (October 2026) · sake, wine, cocktails (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Tempura · Shinpukan, a quick tempura counter by Karasuma-Oike] A bright, glass-fronted counter on the ground floor of Shinpukan, steps from Karasuma-Oike station, frying tempura to order all day. The ¥1,540 set brings shrimp, white fish, vegetables, a big slab of sweet potato and kakiage — more than most can finish — with rice and miso soup; weekday lunches add a tempura bowl, summer a chilled sudachi soba. In the evening it works as a tempura bar. Open daily; lunch walk-ins after 11:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 22 June 2020. Reviewers note many visitors from abroad in Shinpukan (2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura set meal; tempura bowl.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner, during the run-up to the Yamaboko procession, waited a little and then could not finish the generous tempura set.
An October 2026 group found the main tempura decent and the oden daikon good, but the anago tempura disappointing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 天ぷら 天寅 新風館店、天ぷら・バル・居酒屋、中京区烏丸通姉小路下ル場之町586-2 新風館、烏丸御池駅南改札から徒歩1分、平日 昼11:00〜15:00・夜17:00〜22:00、土日祝 11:00〜17:00・17:00〜22:00、無休、昼の予約は11時まで、カード・電子マネー・QR可、18席、禁煙、車椅子可、Wi-Fi、子ども可、ベジタリアン対応、2020年6月22日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 天ぷら定食1,540円 (海老、白身魚、野菜、大きなさつまいも、かき揚げ)、天寅定食、平日の昼だけの天丼、すだちの冷やしそば、いちじくの天ぷら、穴子の天ぷら、おでんの大根、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter only; walk-ins for lunch after 11:00; many visitors from abroad.

places.name: マリーフランス 今出川店 (Marie France, Imadegawa)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery of anpan, croissants, sweet rolls and filled breads (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The anko is made in house, but the breads use butter, cream, custard and fillings with ham or sausage; nothing is described as plant-only (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: 7:00–18:30, Sundays and holidays to 18:00; closed Monday and Tuesday. Takeaway only (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; QR payments accepted (Tabelog). Small shop, crowded at weekends; you move along a set route and cannot go back (September 2026). Photography not allowed inside (Tabelog). On Imadegawa-dori west of Shinmachi, 7 min from Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog). Opened on Imadegawa-dori in 1984 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Imadegawa-dori west of Shinmachi — 7 min from Imadegawa Stn
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood bakery making its own dough, coarse anko, curry filling, custard and butter cream; the anko is cooked daily (official site) · thin-skinned anpan packed with anko — ogura anpan ¥290, yomogi anpan ¥313, a yakimochi-style anpan, an butter (2026 reviews; official site) · croissant au beurre ¥330, Parmesan bacon ¥340, cream bread ¥290, homemade curry bread ¥340, pain au chocolat ¥300, cinnamon roll ¥302 (August–October 2026) · choco cornet, melon bread, frankfurter, corn-egg, almond twist, ham sandwich, cream puffs (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bakery · Imadegawa, anpan that is mostly anko] A small, unpretentious bakery on Imadegawa-dori, in business since 1984, famous for thin-skinned anpan so full of house-cooked anko that it feels almost all filling (¥290). Regulars also come for the curry bread, croissants and choco cornets. It fills up at weekends and the route through the shop is one-way. Takeaway only; no photos inside; closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened on Imadegawa-dori in 1984, making dough, anko, curry filling, custard and butter cream in house; anko is cooked every day, about 450 pieces a day across shop and online sales. Reviewers mention another shop in Kitayama (July and October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: To be a shop that keeps the neighbourhood company for years (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Ogura anpan; yomogi anpan.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor found the ogura anpan surprisingly heavy, “95% red bean paste” yet not too sweet.
A June 2026 visitor loved the anko but wished for more bread to balance it.
A July 2026 visitor preferred the Kitayama shop’s bread.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: マリーフランス、1984年 (昭和59年) に京都今出川通で営業開始、生地も粒あん、カレーフィーリング、カスタード、バタークリームもすべて自家製、小倉あんパン、よもぎあんパン、やきもち風あんパンの粒あんは毎日炊く、店舗とネットで1日約450個、7:00〜18:30 (日祝は18:00)、月・火休み。食べログ: 上京区今出川通新町西入ル元本満寺町307、今出川駅から徒歩7分、テイクアウトのみ、カード・電子マネー不可、QR可、店内撮影不可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 小倉あんパン290円、よもぎあんパン313円、クロワッサン330円、パルメザンベーコン340円、カレーパン340円、パンオショコラ300円、シナモンロール302円、チョコクロネ、メロンパン、週末は混み一方通行、北山の店も。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway only; no photos inside; QR payments but no cards.

places.name: 洋食の店 ITADAKI 円町店 (Yoshoku no Mise ITADAKI, Enmachi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: set meals built around fried shrimp, cream croquettes and katsu, with demi-glace; the hamburg steak is served alongside (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, steak, fried shrimp and croquettes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:30–21:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original 特にございません). 20 seats on two floors — tables for two and four (Tabelog; August–October 2026). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome, kids’ menu (Tabelog). On Marutamachi-dori near Nishioji, 3 min from JR Enmachi Stn (Tabelog; June 2026).
places.neighborhood: Marutamachi-dori near Nishioji — 3 min from JR Enmachi Stn
places.cuisine: Classic Kyoto yoshoku served sizzling on teppan: hamburg steak, steak, katsu and curry (Tabelog shop text) · hamburg steak set ¥1,850–1,940 — hamburg with demi-glace, shrimp fry with tartar, shrimp cream croquette with tomato sauce, with rice, salad, miso soup, a side and pickles (August 2026) · Kujo-negi teriyaki hamburg ¥1,700 (June 2026) · meat lunch of the day, e.g. sansho grilled chicken thigh with shrimp tempura and croquette (June 2026) · 200 g steak (July 2026) · kids’ menu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Enmachi, a century-old Kyoto Western kitchen] The Enmachi branch of ITADAKI, a Western-style restaurant serving Kitano Hakubaicho since 1921. The sets are what one reviewer called an “adult lunch”: a juicy demi-glace hamburg with fried shrimp and a cream croquette, each with its own sauce, plus rice, salad and miso soup (about ¥1,850–1,940). Busy at lunch; no reservations. PayPay but no cards; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: ITADAKI has served Kitano Hakubaicho since 1921 and opened this Enmachi shop. A May 2026 reviewer who grew up with the original learned the name means a mountain peak, not “itadakimasu”.
chef_bio.philosophy: A long-standing commitment to handmade flavours (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak set with fried shrimp and cream croquette.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner watched a parent and child, apparently regulars, eating there and thought food like this every day would make for a healthy mind.
A July 2026 diner liked the hamburg, croquette and fried shrimp but found the lean 200 g steak not to taste.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食の店 ITADAKI 円町店、洋食・ハンバーグ・ステーキ、中京区西ノ京円町31-4、JR円町駅から徒歩3分、昼11:30〜14:30、夜17:30〜21:00、水・木休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、20席、禁煙、車椅子可、子ども可・キッズメニュー、北野白梅町店もある。店の紹介: 1921年から北野白梅町で ITADAKI の味を、鉄板で出すハンバーグ、ステーキ、カツ、カレー。口コミ (2026年、英語): ハンバーグ定食1,850〜1,940円 (デミグラスのハンバーグ、海老フライとタルタル、海老クリームコロッケとトマトソース、ご飯、サラダ、味噌汁、小鉢、漬物)、Kujo ねぎの照り焼きハンバーグ1,700円、日替わりの肉ランチ、200gのステーキ、名前は山の頂の意味。

cultural_comfort.note: No reservations; PayPay but no cards; kids’ menu.

places.name: 鮨割烹 味幸 (Sushi Kappou Miyuki)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; Edomae nigiri on red-vinegar rice, already seasoned, with simmered conger eel and small dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi course of fish, monkfish liver, sea urchin and toro (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 12:00–14:00 (lunch starts at 12:00) and 18:00–22:00 (dinner bookings 18:00–20:00). Reservation only; phone bookings 12:00–17:00; 7 or more by phone; tell the shop if you are late. Tabelog’s note for overseas guests, in its own words: "After making a reservation, please call the restaurant from your accommodation to ensure a smooth visit." No service charge: Tabelog’s English page says a service fee is added, but the Japanese original says 「なし」. 6 counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Formerly called 鮨 えび奈 (Tabelog). Opened 23 October 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gojo, just east of the Gojo bridge — 1 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn, exit 4
places.cuisine: Edomae sushi with small dishes at a six-seat counter · lunch course ¥6,500 (July 2025; June and October 2026); dinner course of about 17 dishes, 6 appetizers and 8 nigiri (July 2026) · nigiri on red-vinegar rice, already seasoned (2025–2026 reviews) · regulars’ standbys: toro-taku roll, ankimo wrapped in nori, sea-urchin rice; also smoked tuna, sawara sashimi with house onion sauce, simmered conger eel and isaki (2024–2026 reviews) · a wide sake list (July 2025)
places.notes: [Sushi · Kiyomizu-Gojo, one chef and six seats] A six-seat Edomae counter a minute from Kiyomizu-Gojo Station, where the chef — once a long-time izakaya master in Tokyo — works alone, chatting easily and seeing guests out to the door. Lunch is a ¥6,500 course of nigiri on red-vinegar rice with the much-loved toro-taku and nori-wrapped ankimo; dinner runs to about 17 dishes. Reviewers found the pieces large and the course a little samey. Overseas guests are asked to phone from their hotel after booking.

roles: Chef who runs the restaurant alone (May 2025: "The chef, who runs the restaurant alone"); not named
chef_bio.background: Opened 23 October 2021 (Tabelog), formerly under the name 鮨 えび奈 (Tabelog). A June 2025 reviewer writes that the chef spent many years as an izakaya master in Tokyo; reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a chef working alone, friendly and easy to talk to, who sees guests off at the entrance.
chef_bio.specialty: Toro-taku; nori-wrapped ankimo; sea-urchin rice.

anecdotes.text: For a late Mother’s Day lunch in May 2025, the chef suggested less rice for an elderly mother and set the platter within easy reach.
"The sushi pieces are relatively large, which is a matter of preference, but personally, I felt they could have been a bit smaller." — November 2024.
A June 2026 lunch guest was seen out to the entrance by the chef.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鮨割烹 味幸 (旧店名 鮨 えび奈)、寿司・日本料理、東山区五条通大橋東入東橋詰町13 アーバイン京都清水五条1F、清水五条駅4番出口から徒歩1分、毎日 12:00〜14:00 (昼は12時スタート)・18:00〜22:00 (夜の予約は18〜20時)、完全予約制、電話予約は12:00〜17:00、7名以上は電話で相談、海外のお客様へ: 予約後に宿泊先から店に電話を、サービス料は日本語原文で「なし」(英語版の記載は誤訳)、カウンター6席、禁煙、子供可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、2021年10月23日オープン。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 昼のコース6,500円、夜は17品ほど (前菜6品と握り8貫)、赤酢のシャリ、味付き握り、トロたく、海苔巻きのあん肝、雲丹ご飯、燻製の鮪、鰆のお造りと自家製玉ねぎソース、煮穴子とイサキ、日本酒の品揃え、大将が一人で営む、東京で長く居酒屋の主人だった、気さくで見送ってくれる、握りが大きめ、コースが単調という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Tabelog asks overseas guests: "After making a reservation, please call the restaurant from your accommodation to ensure a smooth visit." Phone bookings 12:00–17:00.

places.name: チェネッタ バルバ (Cenetta Barba)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; pasta, risotto and homemade focaccia are central (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables come from the Ohara morning market (official site), but the menu leans on meat, cheese and whitebait (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Wed–Mon 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Tuesday and about two irregular days a month. Lunch is a set course of seasonal dishes; dinner is Roman cooking à la carte (Tabelog; official site). No service charge and no cover (Tabelog; Japanese original 「サービス料なし、お通し代なし」). 19 seats with a counter; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX) and e-money (Tabelog). Opened 10 July 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Karasuma, south of Shijo — 5 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn and Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Two faces: a seasonal lunch course, Roman trattoria cooking à la carte at night (official site) · lunch course ¥4,500 (August 2026) · seen: truffle omelette, assorted antipasti for two, shirasu and shiso Genovese, porcini or gorgonzola risotto, sakura-shrimp and ginger risotto, Roman carbonara and amatriciana, bucatini, bottarga orecchiette, veal scaloppine with Marsala, herb-roast lamb, Ezo venison with black-garlic sauce, beef cheek in red wine, homemade focaccia and ginger ale, tiramisu, caramel sorbet (2025–2026 reviews) · Michelin Bib Gourmand, Kyoto 2016–2021 (official site)
places.notes: [Italian · south of Shijo, Roman trattoria at night] A nineteen-seat restaurant south of Shijo: a delicate seasonal lunch course by day, robust Roman trattoria cooking à la carte by night — truffle omelette, carbonara, amatriciana, porcini risotto, lamb and venison. Vegetables come from the Ohara morning market. Bib Gourmand 2016–2021. A diner found the ¥4,500 lunch a bit pricey and was unsure if bread refills were free. No service charge or cover. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 藤田 紘一 (FUJITA Kohichi, per the official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: found the joy of cooking in a part-time restaurant job as a student, joined an Italian restaurant, became its head chef at 27 and held the post for ten years; before going independent travelled through Italy, renting a monthly apartment in Rome; opened Cenetta Barba in 2015 with Roman cooking at its core, a ristorante at lunch and à la carte at night, at 烏丸高辻; buys fresh vegetables and fruit at the Ohara morning market; Michelin Guide Kyoto Bib Gourmand five years running, 2016–2021. The name: cena (supper) and barba (beard, from the roots of field vegetables) (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: local produce for local tables, the spirit of Italian cooking; an easy, happy meal with friends and family.
chef_bio.specialty: Roman pasta; porcini risotto; truffle omelette.

anecdotes.text: A group has held its Christmas and year-end lunch here every December (December 2025).
An August 2026 solo diner noticed the next table was offered more bread but not the diner — "I wasn't sure if refills were complimentary" — and found the ¥4,500 lunch a bit expensive.
"Both the neighbors and the people behind us were speaking foreign languages ... It feels like being overseas right in front of the station." — October 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (cenettabarba.com): Cenetta Barba、イタリア語で cena は夕食、barba はひげ (畑のイメージのひげ根)、友達や家族との気楽なご飯、昼は季節感を大切にした繊細なコース、夜は肉料理中心の骨太なローマの下町料理をアラカルトで、シェフ 藤田 紘一 (FUJITA Kohichi) は1978年京都生まれ、学生時代のアルバイトで料理の楽しさに目覚めイタリア料理店に就職、27歳で料理長、10年務める、独立前にローマなどイタリア各地を旅しマンスリーアパートで暮らす、2015年にローマ料理を主軸にした Cenetta Barba を烏丸高辻に開店、地産地消、京都大原の朝市で野菜や果物を仕入れる、ミシュランガイド京都ビブグルマン2016〜2021年に5年連続。食べログ: イタリアン・バル、下京区高辻通東入ル匂天神町642、水〜月 12:00〜14:30・18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 21:00)、火曜と月2回ほど不定休、サービス料なし・お通し代なし、19席、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX)・電子マネー可、2015年7月10日オープン。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年8月、英語): 昼のコース4,500円、トリュフのオムレツ、前菜の盛り合わせ、しらすと大葉のジェノヴェーゼ、ポルチーニやゴルゴンゾーラのリゾット、桜海老と生姜のリゾット、ローマ風カルボナーラとアマトリチャーナ、ブカティーニ、からすみのオレキエッテ、仔牛のマルサラ、仔羊のハーブロースト、蝦夷鹿の黒にんにくソース、牛頬肉の赤ワイン煮、自家製フォカッチャとジンジャーエール、ティラミス、毎年12月の忘年会、隣の席は外国語ばかり、昼はやや高い、パンのおかわりを聞かれなかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte at dinner, one course at lunch; staff attentive without fuss (August 2026); book ahead.

places.name: 京洛焼肉やぶ (Kyoraku Yakiniku Yabu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; yakiniku with sauces, a sukiyaki-style sauce, cold noodles and garlic rice (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu and offal yakiniku (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–02:00. Bookings taken; seating limited to 120 minutes; walk-ins may wait (November 2026). No service charge: Tabelog’s English page says a service fee is added, but the Japanese original says 「無し」. 29 seats: a counter of 11 and five tables; designated smoking area; children welcome; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Orders by QR code (October 2026). Opened 15 August 2024; a second shop, 京洛焼肉やぶ 西院店, opened on 18 October 2026 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Kawaramachi — 1 min walk from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Late-night yakiniku of black wagyu and fresh offal at fair prices · signature wagyu aburi tataki: grill a thick block, the staff dip it in sauce and slice it (2026 reviews) · fresh outside skirt ("legendary fresh outside skirt" ¥1,639), salted tongue under green onion, premium loin and kalbi, special fresh liver, sirloin-cap shabu with sukiyaki sauce, grilled shabu with grated daikon, yukhoe, horumon (2026 reviews) · assorted kimchi ¥858, namul ¥660, choregi salad, beef-tendon stew to start, cold noodles, garlic rice (2026 reviews) · about ¥5,000–6,000 a head with drinks (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Shijo-Kawaramachi, open till 2 am] A busy, clean yakiniku a minute from Kawaramachi Station, open until 2 am, known for value: the signature wagyu aburi tataki — grill a thick block, the staff slice it — fresh outside skirt, tongue under a heap of green onion, and cold noodles to finish, for about ¥5,000–6,000 a head. Book ahead; two-hour seating. A second shop opened in Saiin in October 2026.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 August 2024 (Tabelog). Tabelog announces a second shop, 京洛焼肉やぶ 西院店, opened on 18 October 2026, serving high-quality black wagyu and fresh offal at reasonable prices. Reviewers in 2026 describe a long room with a counter at the front and tables behind, lively on weekdays, with QR-code ordering.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tabelog: high-quality black wagyu and fresh offal at reasonable prices, for after-work meals or gatherings with family and friends.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu aburi tataki; fresh outside skirt.

anecdotes.text: A solo diner at 9 pm on a weekday in October 2026 found a quiet street outside but a lively room within.
"Enjoying such a wide selection of meats along with drinks for under JPY 6,000 per person was quite astonishing." — October 2026.
A rainy weekday in November 2026 let one diner walk in without a booking — "What a stroke of luck!"

places.cuisine: Cream-puff specialist with a café, run by the Kyoto confectioner 石田老舗 (official site) · Crème de la Crème ¥430, Chanotsuki-egg custard choux ¥380, Jersey cream and Chanotsuki custard ¥460, chocolat ¥400, swan choux ¥440, Kyoto white-miso choux with fu, egg tart, seasonal choux (2026 reviews; official site) · café: peach cream-puff parfait ¥2,970, original teas (2026 reviews) · ice cream, baked sweets, chocolate, gifts (official site)
places.notes: [Cream puffs & café · Karasuma-Oike] A yellow-and-blue cream-puff shop and café near Sanjo from the Meiji-era Kyoto confectioner 石田老舗: custard choux made with Kyoto 茶乃月 eggs, a swan choux, a white-miso choux seen on TV, and towering peach parfaits in the café. Now its only shop since Roppongi closed. Good choux sell out by mid-afternoon; a September 2026 visitor found them pricey. Hours have been shortened — check before going.

roles: Made by specialist pâtissiers (official site); run by 株式会社石田老舗
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 株式会社石田老舗, founded 1871 (Meiji 4), president 石田宏次 (sixth generation), about 105 staff, makes and wholesales baked sweets and runs this cream-puff shop; the Kyoto main shop has a café; the Roppongi Hills shop has closed. Opened 11 November 2019 (Tabelog). A June 2026 regular says this is now the only place to buy these cream puffs.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: carefully chosen ingredients and the craft of hand-finished work by specialist pâtissiers.
chef_bio.specialty: Chanotsuki-egg custard choux; swan choux; white-miso choux.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor arriving at 3 pm found only a few choux left; lunchtime would have been better.
"They were incredibly delicious! But a bit pricey!" — September 2026.
A parent who wanted a parfait settled for a cream puff when the child wanted to go home — and was amazed (September 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (cremedelacreme.co.jp): クレーム デ ラ クレーム、京都のシュークリーム専門店、京都本店は当面営業時間短縮 (SHOP 11:00〜18:30、CAFE 11:00〜18:15 L.O. 17:45、平日 CAFE 11:00〜17:30 L.O. 17:00 の表記も)、定休日なし (臨時休業は Instagram)、六本木ヒルズ店閉店、京たまご「茶乃月」のカスタードシュークリーム、季節限定シュークリーム、和スイーツ、焼菓子、チョコレート、ギフト、専門のパティシエの手作り、中京区東洞院通三条上ル曇華院前町449 CASA LOTUS 1F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩4分。会社概要: 株式会社 石田老舗、1871年 (明治4年) 創業、代表取締役社長 石田宏次 (六代目)、社員105名、焼き菓子製造卸とシュークリーム専門店運営。食べログ: シュークリーム・カフェ・ケーキ、11:00〜19:30 (L.O. 19:00)、火曜休み、予約不可、18席、禁煙、カード (VISA・Master)、2019年11月11日オープン。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): クレーム デ ラ クレーム430円、茶乃月たまごのカスタード380円、ジャージークリームと茶乃月カスタード460円、ショコラ400円、白鳥のシュー440円、京の白味噌シュー (生麩入り)、エッグタルト、桃のシュークリームパフェ2,970円、オリジナルティー、午後には売り切れが多い、高いという声、六本木の店が閉まりここだけに。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose from the showcase; café seats at the back; no bookings.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal kappo — sashimi, dashi soups, grills, simmered dishes, tempura and an anago tempura rice bowl; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based kappo of fish, crab and shellfish (2024–2026 reviews).

Reservations accepted; groups of four or more are phoned about sashimi (Tabelog). Otoshi ¥800 when not on a course (Tabelog, original お付き出し800円(コースはなし)). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats at an L-shaped counter; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; September 2024). Non-smoking; BYO allowed; English menu (Tabelog). On Fuyacho near Nijo, west of Kyoto City Hall, 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; September 2024).
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho near Nijo, west of Kyoto City Hall — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Couple-run kappo counter of seasonal Kyoto cooking, by omakase course or à la carte (2024–2026 reviews) · omakase full course with a large clam soup, sashimi and light tempura (February 2024) · hamo and matsutake pot, fig tempura, simmered red snapper (September 2024) · obanzai of nanohana and Kujo green onion, steamed clams with wakame and urui, oysters and small taro with aonori sauce, anago tempura rice bowl (February 2025) · yuba, suzuki, grilled anago, katsuo tataki (June 2025) · a small crab the reviewer calls Kuppe (Shako) crab, matsutake chawanmushi, shiro-amadai grilled with sansho (November 2025) · Okinawan touches — sea grapes, brown sugar, goya ohitashi, brown-sugar sorbet (June 2025; August 2026) · Kyoto sake by the glass (2025–2026)
places.notes: [Kappo · Fuyacho-Nijo, a couple’s counter with an Okinawan accent] A calm, dimly lit ten-seat L-shaped counter west of Kyoto City Hall, run by a couple, where you can take the omakase or order à la carte from the day’s list — sashimi, clam soup, hamo and matsutake, fig tempura — and the husband cooks in front of you. Reviewers spot Okinawan touches such as sea grapes, goya and brown-sugar sorbet. Easy for solo diners; ¥800 otoshi if you skip the course.

roles: Chef (unnamed) and the chef’s wife, who run it as a couple
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from May 2025 to August 2026 describe a counter run by a couple — “a young couple” (June 2025), “a quiet husband and wife team” (May 2025). Two reviewers think the husband may be from Okinawa (June 2025: “Perhaps due to the owner’s Okinawan background”; August 2026: “The husband appears to be from Okinawa”), and the August 2026 reviewer adds that neither seems to be originally from Kyoto. A November 2025 diner wondered where “the charming lady of the restaurant” came from.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal à la carte kappo; Okinawan-accented touches.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 guest was delighted that the restaurant remembered an earlier visit and prepared a favourite crab dish.
A July 2026 regular prefers ordering à la carte from obanzai to fried dishes and finds booking easy.

places.notes: [Sushi · Karasuma back lane, ¥315 a piece] A compact, lively sushi counter tucked in an alley off Muromachi near Karasuma station, where nigiri and hand rolls are a flat ¥315 each and the bluefin tuna is the pride. Start with a few appetizers — grilled salmon belly, simmered collar, whale bacon — then an omakase of ten or order piece by piece; finish with clam-heavy red miso soup. Book ahead; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Not stated in the sources read. Reviewers describe a friendly, chatty chef, and a December 2025 reviewer felt the chef truly values local customers and visitors from within Japan.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Casual sushi” at a flat price per piece (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Bluefin tuna; ¥315 nigiri.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular says the chef always finds a seat even when contacted on the day, and the conversation is half the fun.
A December 2025 diner who is wary of sea urchin found it with no hint of fishiness and was delighted.

Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service charge or table charge (Tabelog, original サービス料・チャージは頂戴しておりません). places.neighborhood: Near Nijo Castle — 7 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Classic Kyoto kaiseki in a machiya (2025–2026 reviews) · signature abalone in white-miso soup (2025–2026) · mini-kaiseki lunch ¥6,000–6,600 — seasonal hassun (shrimp, datemaki and small dried fish the reviewer calls tamazukuri, at New Year), tuna and white-fish sashimi, grilled ayu, white-miso soup (January–April 2026) · bamboo shoots, simmered hamo, small mackerel sushi, warm sesame tofu, grilled salmon, very good white rice (2026) · Kyoto sake such as Kumiyama (May 2026)
places.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Nijo Castle, a former Hiiragiya head chef’s machiya] A machiya near Nijo Castle opened by a former head chef of the inn Hiiragiya, serving quiet, classic kaiseki at gentle prices: the mini-kaiseki lunch is about ¥6,000, and the signature is abalone in sweet white-miso soup. Counter, tables and private rooms (shoes-off rooms suit families). No service charge. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner (named Horii on Tabelog) — reviewers describe a former head chef of Hiiragiya
chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists the owner as Horii. March and May 2026 reviewers say it was started by a former head chef of Hiiragiya, the historic Kyoto inn. July 2026 and December 2025 reviewers found the chef and owner friendly and easy to talk to.
chef_bio.specialty: Abalone in white-miso soup.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 reviewer wrote that the white-miso abalone seemed raised with so much love it “would not hurt to have it in your eye”.
A May 2026 diner found it serene and classic but wished for more creativity, especially in the sashimi and mackerel sushi.

places.neighborhood: Nishikiyamachi north of Shijo — 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Established Kyoto kaiseki house, courses only, in private rooms and at the counter (July 2026) · lunch course of eight dishes: sashimi, soup, grill, simmered vegetables, sea bream and pea rice, red miso soup, dessert, coffee or herbal tea (March 2025) · seasonal dishes: soft-shelled turtle (April 2026), boiled hamo with plum and grilled ayu (July 2026), sashimi of sea bream, shrimp and tuna, sesame tofu, young sweetfish, Kamo eggplant (May 2026) · spring bento of chirashi sushi and simmered dishes; meals delivered to Gion teahouses for Setsubun and after the Miyako Odori (2025–2026 reviews) · generous portions (November 2025)
places.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Nishikiyamachi, an established house] A long-established kaiseki house on Nishikiyamachi near Shijo serving courses in private rooms and at a seven-seat counter — sea bream rice in spring, hamo and ayu in summer, soft-shelled turtle — and cooking for Gion teahouse banquets with maiko and geiko. Note the booking rule: per its Tabelog English listing, foreign visitors are asked to book via the hotel where the guest is staying. 15% service on kaiseki; cancellation fees from three days out.

chef_bio.background: Not stated in the sources read. A May 2025 business guest describes a reception with maiko and geiko, one assigned to each guest, and felt it might be hard for first-time visitors to get in; February 2026 and April 2025 reviewers had its food delivered to Gion teahouses.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Ichigo ichie” — cherishing each encounter (April 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; soft-shelled turtle.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular looks forward every year to the spring bento of chirashi sushi and simmered dishes.
A November 2025 family, after the autumn leaves, found the course generous enough to satisfy guests from abroad in both quantity and quality.

places.name: 魚師匠 (BURISHO)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yellowtail sashimi with soy or ponzu, tempura, Western and Chinese-style buri dishes, rolled cabbage and a Chaliapin steak; no gluten information is published (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yellowtail specialist with A5 wagyu on the courses (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30 per the official site; Tabelog gives food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Tuesday (official site; Tabelog). Bookings taken; stays may be limited to 2.5 hours when busy (Tabelog); the premium lunch sets need booking (August 2026). Tabelog’s English page says a service charge is added, but its Japanese original reads 「なし」. 20 seats: a 14-seat counter and one private room (official site; Tabelog). Cards, transit IC and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (official site). On the 2nd floor of 松原クラタビル on Matsubara-dori east of Sakaimachi; about 10 min from Shijo, Gojo, Kyoto-Kawaramachi or Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (official site). Opened 1 March 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Matsubara-dori east of Sakaimachi — 10 min from Shijo or Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Yellowtail specialist using the Kagoshima brand buri 鰤王, ice-aged (氷熟ぶり), cooked whole in many ways (official site) · dinner courses: 比叡 with Kyoto vegetables ¥6,500; 大原 with A5 Kuroge wagyu ¥9,000; 嵯峨 full course ¥12,000 — e.g. buri small plates, a tasting of ice-aged buri sashimi, buri collar soup, Western and Chinese-style buri plates, buri chikuzen-ni, seared buri tasting, A5 wagyu Chaliapin steak, wagyu nigiri and buri otoro sushi, a "mysterious tomato" (official menu) · lunch: daily set ¥1,000 (e.g. buri hamburg, June 2026), buri lunch ¥2,000, buri steak set, BURISHO gozen with five cuts, a premium gozen with grilled belly, collar and tail (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Seafood · Matsubara, a whole menu of ice-aged yellowtail] A second-floor counter off Matsubara-dori devoted to one fish: Kagoshima's branded 鰤王 yellowtail, ice-aged to deepen its flavour and used nose to tail — sashimi tastings of different cuts, seared buri, buri in Western and Chinese styles, buri otoro sushi. Lunch sets run from ¥1,000 to multi-cut gozen; dinner courses from ¥6,500, the top ones adding A5 wagyu. Some diners find the cuts small for the price; most love the freshness. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Not named; operator 株式会社匠カンパニー (the invoice holder and site copyright)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: yellowtail that overturns expectations — Kagoshima’s brand buri 鰤王, ice-aged (氷熟) like meat to increase umami, used whole in many dishes; a 14-seat counter and one private room. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社匠カンパニー, which also holds the site copyright (2022). Opened 1 March 2022 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "鰤の常識を覆す" — to overturn what people expect of yellowtail.
chef_bio.specialty: Ice-aged yellowtail sashimi tasting; buri otoro sushi.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 lunch guest found many side dishes pre-made and still partly frozen, with the buri soboro overpowered by sesame.
A June 2026 diner was walked through each cut of yellowtail, including one topped with shaved karasumi.
An August 2026 diner liked the cuts but wished the slices were thicker, even at extra cost.

places.gf_detail: Ask. A buffet of Japanese, Western and Chinese dishes, curries, breads and desserts; no gluten labelling is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The buffet has many dishes, but meat, seafood and dairy dominate; no vegan labelling is published (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–10:00 (to 10:30 at weekends and holidays); lunch buffet 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00); dinner 17:30–21:30 (last order 21:00); à la carte 11:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); sweets buffets in the afternoon (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Prices include tax and service (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「表示料金には税金・サービス料が含まれております」). 120 seats, two private rooms free of charge; non-smoking, with a smoking area in the hotel; cards (Tabelog). Hilton members get 10% off (August 2026). On the 1st floor of Hilton Kyoto, with a bonfire visible outside; about 2 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 12 September 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Hilton Kyoto, Kawaramachi-Sanjo — 2 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: All-day buffet restaurant of Hilton Kyoto with Japanese, Western and Chinese dishes (2026 reviews) · lunch buffet weekdays ¥5,800, weekends ¥6,200 (July 2026): herb-roasted beef carved to order, pinchos and tapas on homemade baguette, seafood fried rice, mango chicken curry, yellow curry · seasonal sweets buffets, e.g. summer fruit (mango, melon, peach) and autumn chocolate, ¥5,800 (September 2026) · dinner buffet; breakfast; à la carte (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Buffet · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, Hilton Kyoto's all-day restaurant] The big, bright buffet restaurant on the ground floor of Hilton Kyoto, opened in 2024, with a fire burning outside. Lunch (about ¥5,800–6,200) brings carved herb-roast beef, tapas on house baguette, fried rice and well-liked curries; seasonal sweets buffets of mango, melon or chocolate pack the afternoons. Prices include service; Hilton members get 10% off. Busy with overseas visitors; private rooms free for groups.

roles: Hotel restaurant of Hilton Kyoto; chef not named
chef_bio.background: The all-day dining restaurant of Hilton Kyoto, opened 12 September 2024 (Tabelog). The hotel’s Osteria Italiana Seven Embers is a separate record.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch and sweets buffets.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 sweets-buffet guest who arrived 20 minutes early was invited to wait in the hotel lobby.
An August 2026 diner found the cakes are not pre-sliced, so guests slice the cakes, and rated the yellow curry the best dish.

places.name: つくもうどん 塩小路本店 (Tsukumo Udon)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat-udon shop with free tenkasu and tempura (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is iriko (dried sardine) dashi, and the free topping is fried iriko (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 7:00–22:00 daily (last order 21:30); open year-round (Tabelog). No bookings; buy a ticket from the machine, order, then find a seat; queues of 7–10 minutes at peak lunch (2026 reviews). No charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: なし). 35 seats: 21 at counters (some standing) and 14 at tables; non-smoking; English menu; children and strollers welcome; cards, transit IC and QR (Tabelog; October–November 2026). Inside JR Kyoto Station on basement level 2, by the east exit, in front of the JR gates (Tabelog; November 2026). Opened 27 July 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Inside JR Kyoto Station, B2 east exit
places.cuisine: Station udon of homemade noodles in iriko dashi from anchovies caught around Kujukushima, Nagasaki (Tabelog) · kake udon ¥400 (October 2026; ¥380 in November 2025) · chicken-and-egg curry udon ¥900, the most popular · chicken and egg (kashiwa-tama) udon, kitsune, kamaage, keiran, toriten bukkake ¥720 · chicken tempura, chikuwa tempura, small rice, chicken rice set · free tenkasu and fried iriko at the counter (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Udon · Kyoto Station, iriko udon from 7 a.m.] A busy udon counter on the second basement level of JR Kyoto Station, by the east exit, open from 7:00 — handy before a Shinkansen. Homemade noodles come in a clear iriko broth made from Kujukushima anchovies; the hit is the creamy chicken-and-egg curry udon (about ¥900), and kake udon is about ¥400. Help yourself to free tenkasu and crunchy fried iriko. Buy a ticket, order, then grab a seat. Open daily.

roles: Operator 株式会社神戸ゴマルゴ (the invoice holder); a sister shop is in Tenjinbashi, Osaka
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: homemade noodles with an iriko dashi of anchovies caught around Kujukushima, Nagasaki. Opened 27 July 2018 (Tabelog). The invoice number belongs to 株式会社神戸ゴマルゴ (NTA corporate-number site); つくもうどん 天神橋店 in Osaka is the only other branch in the Tabelog crawl.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken-and-egg curry udon; kake udon with free fried iriko.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on an 11th visit always orders the kake udon and noted it rose from ¥360 to ¥400.
An October 2026 diner warns the spicy sauce of the curry udon sits at the bottom, so mix well.
A late-evening October 2026 diner found the chicken tempura smaller than expected and the total over ¥1,000 high for a standing udon shop.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Kyoto and farm vegetables feature, but most dishes use cheese, cured meat, fish or meat; no vegan dish is named (2026 reviews).

Bookings taken, also through Tabelog; times may be adjusted when busy (Tabelog; August 2026). 21 seats: a counter of 5 and 16 at tables; fully non-smoking; cards; private hire by phone (Tabelog). Portions are large — staff warn solo diners (May 2026). A Japanese-style building on Sanjo-dori west of Muromachi; 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; July 2026). Over 20 years in business (October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-dori west of Muromachi — 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Italian à la carte from a handwritten menu, with Kyoto and farm vegetables and a strong wine list (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · salmon and nagaimo tartare, sea bream, horse-meat carpaccio, prosciutto sliced in house, burrata with figs, fruit-tomato and fish pairings · Parmigiano cheese risotto mixed in a wheel at the table, shirasu pasta, fresh gorgonzola pasta, cabbage and seafood aglio e olio · duck, pork and other meat mains · panna cotta (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Sanjo-Muromachi, generous plates and good wine] A long-running Italian behind a Japanese-style front on Sanjo-dori, with a handwritten menu built on Kyoto and farm vegetables and an excellent wine list. Regulars return for the salmon and nagaimo tartare, the cheese risotto finished in a Parmigiano wheel and house-sliced prosciutto; portions are large, so share. About ¥8,000–15,000 a head. Dinner only; closed Thursday.

roles: Not named in any source found
chef_bio.background: An October 2026 reviewer notes over 20 years of history. Tabelog’s introduction highlights meat with Kyoto vegetables, fish with fruit tomatoes, generous starters and an excellent wine selection.
chef_bio.specialty: Salmon and nagaimo tartare; Parmigiano-wheel risotto.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 solo diner was warned that portions are large, ordered too much anyway, and still found it good value.
An April 2026 regular wished the menu changed a little more between visits.

places.name: 節道 (BUSHIDO)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A rice bowl of shaved bonito eaten with dashi soy, with miso soup and pickles; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dish is bonito flakes, with egg and a dashi for ochazuke (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 7:00–15:00 daily (Tabelog); an August 2026 diner was told it is open until 14:30. Reservations accepted, advised at weekends; the B set needs a reservation, and early arrivals may be asked to come back at the booked time (Tabelog; October 2025, May 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; May 2026). 15 seats: a 6-seat counter downstairs and tables upstairs (Tabelog; September and December 2025). At the end of a narrow alley in the 三条食彩ろぉじ lane off Sanjo; 6 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; November 2025).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo, west of Karasuma — 6 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: One dish: a rice bowl heaped with bonito flakes shaved to order in front of you (2025–26 reviews) · A set ¥1,000 — bonito rice bowl, miso soup with bonito, Kyoto pickles, condiments and a special egg; B set ¥1,200 adds small obanzai such as yuba and wakame salad (October 2025–May 2026) · eat the flakes plain, then with egg and dashi soy, and finish as dashi chazuke from the pot of broth (2025–26 reviews) · extra bonito on request (November 2025)
places.notes: [Bonito rice bowl · Sanjo, breakfast from 7 a.m.] At the end of a narrow alley off Sanjo, a cook shaves katsuobushi to order and piles it in a fluffy mound over rice: eat it plain, then with egg and dashi soy, then as chazuke. ¥1,000–1,200 with miso soup and pickles. Reviews are mixed — some found the rice too soft and the broth thin, and a September 2026 diner reported a dirty restroom and dusty upstairs room. Cash only; 7:00–15:00 daily.

roles: Shop of the BUSHIDO brand (Tokyo and Utsunomiya shops on Tabelog); staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists BUSHIDO TOKYO (Awajicho) and BUSHIDO UTSUNOMIYA under the same name; a March 2026 diner compared it with an often fully booked Shibuya shop. A November 2025 diner found one staff member running the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Freshly shaved bonito rice bowl.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner waited about 25 minutes upstairs, noticed dust and a smell from an uncleaned restroom, and found the previous day’s rubbish and no toilet paper there.
A May 2026 diner found lukewarm self-serve water, blood spots in the bonito flakes, and a chazuke broth almost like hot water, though the miso soup and pickles were good.
A September 2025 diner found the rice mushy and the poured broth diluted, and saw no value for money.
A March 2026 returning diner missed the lively bonito-shaving show of five years earlier but found the flavours as good as ever.
