places.cuisine: Galettes and crepes, sweet and savoury, in a renovated Meiji townhouse (2026 reviews) · galettes: yuba and vegetables, yuba and prosciutto (+¥200 in the set), asparagus and bacon with avocado, anchovy, tomato and egg (2026 reviews) · lunch set of galette, mini crepe and drink; galette and drink ¥1,300 (June–September 2026) · crepes with plain or matcha batter and three fillings, butter and sugar, lemon sorbet, "Teberu" with matcha ice cream; cream +¥100 (2026 reviews) · cream sodas such as apricot-mango and honey lemon (June–July 2026)
places.notes: [Galettes & crepes · Karasuma Shijo, a Meiji townhouse café] A café of galettes and crepes in a renovated Meiji-era townhouse a minute from Karasuma Station, with sofas among the plants upstairs. The lunch set — a vegetable-packed galette, a mini crepe and a drink — is good value; the crepes come in plain or matcha batter. One diner found the simplest crepe forgettable. Cash or PayPay. Open 11:00–18:30.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 January 2021 in a renovated Meiji-era townhouse (Tabelog; September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Galettes; crepes.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner found the plain crepe chewy and good but not memorable.
A September 2026 diner found the galette on the small side for big appetites, but the set with a mini crepe filling.
An August 2026 visitor found the upstairs room full of women and a male friend felt out of place.

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the table; book at lunchtime; cash or PayPay.

places.name: 鮨こまつ (Sushi Komatsu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi and sashimi with soy and sauces, plus tempura and fried dishes (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and seafood counter (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–21:00 straight through (last orders food 20:00, drinks 20:30); closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; phone even when online slots are full; a booking more than 30 minutes late is cancelled (Tabelog). Walk-ins sometimes seated (October 2026). À la carte; the menu shows no prices, a diner noted (October 2026). 15 seats round a U-shaped white-wood counter; groups up to 5 (Tabelog; May and October 2026). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley; 6 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; February 2025). Opened 1 October 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: North of Kyoto Station — 6 min walk
places.cuisine: Sushi counter run by a tuna wholesaler, ordered à la carte all day (Tabelog, shop text; 2025–26 reviews) · lean, fatty and rare cuts of tuna — otoro, chutoro, nōten — sardine, sea bream, uni, kuro-mutsu, torigai, sayori, botan-ebi, guji, tsubugai (2025–26 reviews) · sashimi platters, tempura of shrimp, anago, firefly squid and wild vegetables, whale bacon, octopus, mozuku, Amakusa oysters (2026 reviews) · lunch set of 8 sushi, a negitoro roll and tempura (March 2026) · two people about ¥24,000 for 9 pieces each, tempura and drinks (July 2026); about ¥30,000 for two with omakase sushi and tempura (October 2026) · sake such as Bakuren from Yamagata (October 2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Kyoto Station, a tuna wholesaler's counter, open all day] A white-wood U-shaped counter down an alley north of Kyoto Station, run by a tuna wholesaler and open straight through from 11:30 — handy for a late lunch. Order à la carte: rare tuna cuts, uni, guji, then tempura of anago or seasonal vegetables. Friendly chefs; prices aren't on the menu, but two people paid about ¥24,000–30,000 for a full meal. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Chefs (unnamed); formerly at Sushi Masahiro at Kyoto Station (April 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): sushi from a tuna wholesaler that knows tuna inside out, with lean, fatty and rare cuts served à la carte; opened 1 October 2024. A March 2026 diner heard it previously operated as Komatsu Shokudo; an April 2026 diner learned the chefs had worked at Sushi Masahiro at Kyoto Station. An October 2026 diner described the chef as friendly "with a wonderful smile".
chef_bio.specialty: Rare tuna cuts; à la carte sushi and tempura.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner found the restaurant mostly full of guests from abroad, from countries such as India and Korea; an October 2026 couple found the clientele mostly local.
An October 2026 diner’s wife worried because the menu showed no prices; sushi and tempura for two came to about ¥30,000 before drinks.
A March 2026 diner came at 15:30 after missing lunch elsewhere and was glad it stays open.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、下京区北不動堂町573-3、京都駅から徒歩6分、木〜月 11:30〜21:00 (L.O. 料理20:00、ドリンク20:30)、火・水曜休み、予約可 (ネットで空きがなくても電話で相談)、30分以上の遅刻はキャンセル扱い、カウンター15席、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2024年10月1日オープン、まぐろの仲卸直営、赤身・トロ・希少部位、アラカルト。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年10月、英語): 通し営業、のうてん、雲丹、ぐじ、天ぷら、鯨のベーコン、もと Komatsu Shokudo、Sushi Masahiro 出身の職人、品書きに値段なし、2人で約24,000〜30,000円、海外の客が多いという声と地元客が多いという声。

places.name: 茂庵 (Moan)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Drinks, cakes, kakigori and a hot sandwich of anko and mochi on bread; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Teas, coffee and kakigori with fruit syrups are likely options, but the sandwich has butter and the cakes are baked (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Wed–Sun 12:00–17:00; closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations: the official site says the café does not take reservations (「茂庵カフェはご予約をお受けしておりません。」) and can be full on fine spring and autumn days — phone or check the website for seats; Tabelog says weekend and holiday bookings are taken for up to an hour, and several 2026 diners booked. No food menu, light meals included (official site): drinks, cakes, cookies, kakigori in summer (2026 reviews). Card: AMEX only (Tabelog). 35 seats on the upper floor with windows over the city; shoes off (Tabelog; April 2026). Cars only to the foot of Yoshida-yama; a 15-minute walk up from the Jodo-ji or Ginkaku-ji bus stops, about 30 minutes from Demachiyanagi (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Top of Yoshida-yama — 15 min walk from the Ginkaku-ji bus stop
places.cuisine: Hilltop café in a Taisho-era building registered as a Kyoto City tangible cultural property, with views over the city (April 2026) · anko and mochi butter hot sandwich set with Japanese black tea and ice cream; matcha ice cream; chiffon cake; seasonal kakigori with yuzu, grape or fresh fruit syrup in summer; yuzu soda; coffee with a small sweet (2026 reviews) · an An Mochi butter toast, black tea and matcha ice cream came to ¥1,500 (May 2026) · no meals (official site)
places.notes: [Café · Yoshida-yama, tea in the treetops] A Taisho-era building at the top of Yoshida-yama, reached only on foot — a 15-minute climb from the Ginkaku-ji side — where the upstairs room opens on all sides to the forest and the city below. Drinks, cakes and an anko-mochi butter sandwich, kakigori in summer; no meals. The official site says no reservations and it fills on fine days; Tabelog says weekend bookings for an hour. Wear sneakers. Wed–Sun 12:00–17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a café reached only on foot at the top of Yoshida-yama, serving no meals. An April 2026 diner says the building dates from the Taisho era and is a Kyoto City registered tangible cultural property; it opened a tea room and an underground pantry for the Kyoto Modern Architecture Festival (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Anko-mochi butter sandwich; kakigori.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor came on a pilgrimage to a location from an NHK BS drama and found a lively group of older women a bit overwhelming before the birdsong returned.
An April 2026 hiker found the path steep enough to leave a gym-goer out of breath.
During the October 2026 Kyoto Modern Architecture Festival, pork miso soup and rice balls were served outside.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (mo-an.com): 車は吉田山のふもとまで、どのルートでも最後は徒歩、茂庵カフェは予約を受けていない、春・秋・晴れの日は満席になることもある、空席状況は電話かサイトで、軽食を含む食事メニューの提供はない。食べログ: カフェ、左京区吉田神楽岡町8 吉田山山頂、浄土寺・銀閣寺バス停から徒歩15分、水〜日 12:00〜17:00、月・火曜休み、土日祝は最大1時間の予約可、35席、禁煙、カードは AMEX のみ。口コミ (2026年4〜10月、英語): 大正時代の建物で京都市の登録有形文化財、2階から市街の眺め、あんこと餅のバターホットサンド、抹茶アイス、かき氷、柚子ソーダ、Kyoto Modern Architecture Festival。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk up in good shoes; check seats by phone or website; AMEX is the only card.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tendon bowls with shrimp, scallop, eel and cheese tempura; tencha finished with dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday to Sunday and holidays 12:00–15:30 and 17:30–21:00 (food last order 20:30); closed Monday and irregularly — the shop says to check Google Maps, as it sometimes opens on Mondays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); queues at opening (September 2026). 9 seats: 4 at a counter and 5 side by side facing the wall; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards, Suica and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Allergy information available (Tabelog). Ground floor on Higashioji-dori near the Chion-in-mae bus stop, a couple of minutes north of Yasaka Shrine; 7 min walk from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Higashioji north of Yasaka Shrine — 7 min walk from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Tendon specialist, each bowl fried to order by a chef with a Japanese-cuisine background (September 2026) · "Hannari Ten-don" of 15 bite-sized tempura — a large shrimp plus vegetables, nama-fu, cheese, scallop — eaten with chopsticks and a spoon, ¥1,600; bowls from ¥1,200 (2026 reviews) · Hannari Ten-don with grilled eel (August–September 2026) · chilled tencha finish with myoga, mitsuba and wasabi, +¥300; oolong tea ¥300 as a set drink (August 2026) · sake (Tabelog) · about ¥1,200–2,500 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Tendon · Higashioji by Yasaka Shrine, fifteen bites in a bowl] A nine-seat café-like counter north of Yasaka Shrine frying tendon to order: the "Hannari" bowl of fifteen bite-sized tempura — a big shrimp, nama-fu, cheese, scallop, vegetables — is ¥1,600, with eel as an upgrade and a chilled tencha finish for ¥300 more. Bright, friendly staff; popular with visitors from abroad; queues at opening. Closed Monday (sometimes open — check Google Maps).

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a tendon shop "crafted with care by a chef from a Japanese cuisine background" (September 2026), a bright manager and staff (August 2026), a Western-style name and interior, and a room where an August 2026 family were the only Japanese guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Hannari Ten-don; chilled tencha.

anecdotes.text: A party of five — mother, daughter, sister, niece and the reviewer — found it at 2 pm in August 2026 when other places were closing, and asked for the air-conditioning to be turned up.
"It was my first time trying eel tempura, and it was shockingly delicious." — September 2026.
"The manager and staff were bright and provided wonderful service." — August 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; queue at opening; cards, Suica and QR (Alipay, WeChat Pay).

places.name: MALDA (Café MALDA)
places.gf_detail: GF options: the official menu labels two rice-flour muffins gluten-free (maple; matcha with adzuki), and the almond gelato is made with rice flour; the lunch curry comes with organic brown and black rice. Wheat muffins (maple, banana-cocoa-coconut) are baked in the same kitchen every day, so ask about cross-contact (official site, 2026; October 2026 review).
places.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: all desserts are made with no sugar, egg or dairy (official menu), and the gelatos are dairy-free. The lunch curry is vegetarian but served with raita (yogurt), and the chai contains milk — the menu says "not vegan" (official site, 2026).
places.hours_raw: Wednesday to Sunday 11:30–19:00, lunch 11:30–14:00; closed Monday and Tuesday (official site). Tabelog gives 11:30–17:00. No reservations (Tabelog). 8 seats around a large communal table, counter and tables (Tabelog; December 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) only for bills of ¥5,000 or more (Tabelog). English menu; takeaway muffins and cookies (Tabelog; September 2026). Ground floor of Hotel MALDA, a three-room inn, on Sakaimachi just south of Oike; 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 3 (official site; Tabelog). Opened July 2018 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi just south of Oike — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Café of the Babaghuri brand below its three-room inn: muffins and cookies baked daily with no sugar, egg or dairy, hand-drip organic coffee, herb teas and gelato (official site) · lunch: MALDA curry of seasonal vegetables and lentil dal with organic brown and black rice, four sides and raita — vegetarian, the Jurgen Lehl company-canteen favourite (official site; September 2026); Taiwanese-style congee with a scallion pancake (October 2025; October 2026) · muffins: maple (with rum), rice-flour maple and rice-flour matcha (gluten-free), banana-cocoa-coconut, muffin of the day; e.g. lemon and Earl Grey rice-flour muffin ¥410–450 (official site; December 2025; June 2026) · roasted-almond or cardamom-coconut gelato with a cookie, caramel nuts (official site) · Babaghuri bean tea, lemongrass tea from the Ishigaki farm, chai ¥700 (milk), green-lemon and honey soda, natural wine (official site; June 2026)
places.notes: [Café · Sakaimachi Oike, egg-, dairy- and sugar-free baking] The Babaghuri brand's café under its three-room inn: a calm, wooden room where everything sweet — muffins, cookies, gelato — is made without sugar, egg or dairy, with gluten-free rice-flour muffins. Lunch is a vegetarian lentil-and-vegetable curry on brown and black rice (raita on the side) or a Taiwanese congee; herb teas from Lehl's Ishigaki farm. Cards only from ¥5,000. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: MALDA opened in July 2018 on Anekoji as a café and inn embodying the life philosophy of Babaghuri; desserts are baked in-house every morning without sugar, egg or dairy, and the lunch curry is a favourite from Jurgen Lehl's company canteen; seasonal fruit and herbs come from Jurgen Lehl's farm on Ishigaki Island. The inn upstairs takes three groups a day.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Simple, yet born over time from facing people, things and the environment honestly" — Babaghuri's philosophy of living (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Egg- and dairy-free muffins; vegetarian curry; congee.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 hotel guest received a vegan cookie as a welcome gift, went down to buy a tin, and found the tins sold out.

"After exercising, I pay special attention to what I eat" — an October 2026 visitor chose the congee with ginger and mozuku while recovering from a cold, noting the vegan options and rice-flour gluten-free sweets.
A September 2026 diner liked best the beet and chickpea hummus on the vegetarian curry plate.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: MALDA、2018年7月に姉小路通に開いたカフェと宿、ババグーリの生活哲学、カフェ・マルダは宿の1階、砂糖・卵・乳製品を使わないお菓子 (マフィン、クッキー) を毎朝手作り、ランチ (11:30〜14:00) は季節の野菜とレンズ豆のダールのマルダのカレー (オーガニック玄米と黒米、4種の付け合わせ、ライタ)、米粉のメープルマフィンと米粉の抹茶マフィン (グルテンフリー)、ローストアーモンドのジェラート (乳製品不使用)、ババグーリの豆茶、石垣島ヨーガンレール農園のレモングラス茶、チャイ (牛乳使用、ヴィーガンではない)、自然派ワイン、11:30〜19:00、月・火定休、京都市中京区堺町通御池下る丸木材木町684、宿は1日3組。食べログ: カフェ・洋菓子、烏丸御池駅3番出口から徒歩5分、水〜日、予約不可、8席、禁煙、カードは5,000円から、英語メニュー、テイクアウト、ベジタリアン対応、2018年7月23日オープン。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年11月、英語): 台湾風のお粥とねぎ餅、レモンとアールグレイの米粉マフィン410〜450円、チャイ700円、ベジカレー、ビーツとひよこ豆のフムス、金継ぎの器、ヴィーガンのクッキー。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog; official site is bilingual); cards only from ¥5,000.

gf_cross_contamination.text: Gluten-free rice-flour muffins are baked in the same kitchen as wheat muffins (maple, banana-cocoa-coconut) every day; no separation is described — ask before ordering if you are coeliac.

vegan_cross_contact.text: All desserts are free of egg and dairy, but the kitchen also prepares raita (yogurt) and milk chai.

positives.text: The official menu labels the rice-flour maple and matcha muffins gluten-free and states that all desserts contain no sugar, egg or dairy.

places.name: CHERIE MAISON DU BISCUIT
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: biscuits, biscuit sandwiches, financiers and cakes made with wheat flour and fermented butter (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: baked goods built on fermented butter, with cream-filled biscuit sandwiches and cheese cookies (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Thursday and Friday 12:30–16:00; Saturday 12:30–16:30; closed Sunday to Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog; official site). Takeaway only for now — the salon is closed; no reservation needed to buy, but biscuit sandwiches are limited per person (Tabelog). Queues at opening (June 2026). Biscuit sandwiches must be refrigerated and keep about a week; online sales sell out fast (July 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). A white building on Takakura-dori north of Ebisugawa, south of the Imperial Palace; 4–5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; official site; 2026 reviews). Opened 1 March 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takakura-dori north of Ebisugawa — 5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Biscuit shop of the confectionery researcher Kanae Kobayashi, one of three CHÉRIE shops with CHÉRIE CAFE and CHÉRIE MAISON DU PARFAIT (official site) · the signature biscuit sandwich (refrigerated) and biscuits of fermented butter and premium flour — e.g. Biscuit Nature set of three, chocolate, Parmigiano cookies (2026 reviews) · financiers, lemon cake (2026 reviews) · tins illustrated by the artist Yuko Higuchi (May 2026) · about ¥1,000–4,000 a purchase (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Biscuits · Takakura south of the Imperial Palace, a cult biscuit sandwich] A white-walled shop on Takakura-dori where confectionery researcher Kanae Kobayashi sells the famous biscuit sandwiches — crisp biscuits around cream, refrigerated, rationed per person and hard to buy online — plus fermented-butter biscuits, Parmigiano cookies and financiers, some in tins illustrated by Yuko Higuchi. Takeaway only for now; open Thursday to Saturday afternoons; queue at opening. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the shops of 小林かなえ, with books, media appearances and NHK sweets recipes listed; CHÉRIE MAISON DU BISCUIT sells sweets to take away, CHÉRIE CAFE serves soft serve, and CHÉRIE MAISON DU PARFAIT is a reservation-only parfait shop in a townhouse; the company recruits staff. A May 2026 reviewer calls the shop well known among dessert lovers in Kyoto. Per Tabelog: opened 1 March 2019.
chef_bio.specialty: Biscuit sandwich; Parmigiano cookies.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor who had once left with only biscuits — not realising the famous sandwich was refrigerated — came back, queued before 12:30, and bought both.
An October 2026 buyer of Parmigiano cookies found the balance of cheese and sweetness "simply exquisite" and could not stop eating.
"As a lemon cake lover, I found it a bit lacking in lemon flavor, but as a baked sweet, it was truly delicious." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: CHÉRIE MAISON DU BISCUIT、小林かなえ、シェリーメゾンドビスキュイ (お菓子テイクアウト) 12:30〜16:00 (土16:30)、日・月・火・水定休、京都市中京区高倉通夷川上る福屋町733-2 (高倉通りの白いビル)、シェリーカフェ (ソフトクリーム、東洞院竹屋町)、シェリーメゾンドパフェ (完全予約制のパフェ店、竹屋町通の町家)、オンラインショップ、書籍、NHK のお菓子レシピ、スタッフ募集。食べログ: カフェ・洋菓子、木・金 12:30〜16:00、土 12:30〜16:30、予約不要で購入可、ビスキュイサンドは個数制限、現在サロンは休業しお菓子の販売のみ、7席、現金のみ、2019年3月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年5月〜11月、英語): 丸太町駅から徒歩4〜5分、御所の南、ビスキュイサンド (要冷蔵、日持ち約1週間、オンラインはすぐ完売)、発酵バター、パルミジャーノのクッキー、フィナンシェ、レモンケーキ、Yuko Higuchi のイラストの缶、開店前から行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway only; biscuit sandwiches rationed and refrigerated; cash only; open Thu–Sat afternoons.

places.name: かもがわカフェ (Kamogawa Cafe)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee with scones, toast, cakes such as apple crumble, lasagna and a cheesy hamburg-steak gratin; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and a soy-milk chai appear, but the scones come with cream and the food uses cheese, butter and meat; no vegan information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Friday 10:30–20:00; Wednesday 10:30–17:00; Saturday and Sunday 10:30–21:30; closed Thursday and the fourth Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Tabelog notes that lunch stopped in March 2024, with drinks and light meals continuing, though reviewers had a noon lunch and a hamburg gratin in 2025–2026. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 30 seats on the second floor with counter and sofas; non-smoking (Tabelog; August 2025). Takeaway coffee beans (August 2025). On a residential street a block off the main road near Kojinguchi; 3 min from the Kojinguchi bus stop, 10 min north of Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kojinguchi, a block west of the Kamo — 3 min walk from the Kojinguchi bus stop
places.cuisine: Second-floor café roasting and selling its own coffee (August 2025) · Kamogawa blend, a deep roast with a hint of sweetness; lightly roasted coffees brewed cup by cup (2025–2026 reviews) · scone set with fresh cream, toast, smoothie set with yogurt, fruit and toast (2025–2026 reviews) · cakes such as apple crumble (May 2026) · onion gratin with cheesy hamburg steak; lasagna after 15:00 (June 2026) · soy-milk chai, apple juice, wine with sets (2025–2026 reviews) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Café · Kojinguchi, house-roast coffee upstairs] A high-ceilinged second-floor café on a quiet street near Kojinguchi and the Kamo, with colored-glass windows you open yourself, rakugo posters, books and magazines — a student-quarter coffee house roasting its own beans. The Kamogawa blend, scones with cream, an apple crumble, a smoothie-and-toast set; lunch is limited. Open late at weekends. Cash only. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a long-running café that roasts and sells its own beans, with high ceilings, colored-glass windows and posters for solo rakugo shows; a May 2026 regular says it was once known as "Sarasa Kamogawa" and thinks its operation may have changed (not confirmed elsewhere).
chef_bio.specialty: Kamogawa blend coffee; scone set.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 visitor came on the night of the Gozan Okuribi and was impressed by the low-acid, aromatic Kamogawa blend.
A November 2025 guest, back after eleven years, arrived before the noon lunch and had the scone set with fresh cream.
"I would be happy if there were more choices on the lunch menu." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、上京区西三本木通荒神口下ル上生洲町229-1、京阪丸太町駅から北へ徒歩10分、荒神口バス停から徒歩3分、大通りから一本入った住宅街、月・火・金 10:30〜20:00、水 10:30〜17:00、土・日 10:30〜21:30、木曜と第4水曜休み、予約不可、2024年3月からランチの提供をやめた (ドリンクと軽食は継続)、現金のみ、30席、禁煙、テイクアウト。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年9月、英語): 2階、自家焙煎の豆も販売、かもがわブレンド、スコーンのセット、トースト、スムージーのセット、りんごのクランブルケーキ、オニオングラタンとチーズのハンバーグ、15時以降のラザニア、豆乳のチャイ、落語のポスター、色ガラスの窓、以前は「Sarasa Kamogawa」と呼ばれていたとの声 (未確認)。

cultural_comfort.note: Second floor; cash only; limited food; open late at weekends.

places.name: 祇園なか原 (Gion Nakahara)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the shop asks about likes, dislikes and foods guests cannot eat (August 2025); dashi-based kappo with tempura; no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kappo of fish on dashi (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday and on Mondays that are holidays (Tabelog). Bookings taken; a nine-course dinner runs about two hours (Tabelog; May 2025). 13 seats: six counter seats, a small raised area and a table; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews). Down a very narrow back alley in front of Yasaka Shrine, three streets west of Minami-za (2024–25 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo, in a narrow alley by Yasaka Shrine — 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Small Gion kappo: a mini kaiseki lunch (about ¥5,000–6,000) and dinner courses of around nine dishes (2024–26 reviews) · in reviews: hassun for Hinamatsuri, clam soup, live flounder and guji sashimi, kombu-cured sea bream, grilled moroko, grilled fugu, bamboo shoots grilled, as tempura and simmered, young ayu and koshiabura tempura, sea-bream shuto, round daikon in sea-bream broth with Kujo negi, kamadaki rice to finish (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion, down a narrow alley] A tiny kappo hidden in one of Gion's narrowest alleys near Yasaka Shrine: seasonal kaiseki with a rich Kansai dashi, finished with kamadaki rice. Mini kaiseki lunch about ¥5,000–6,000; dinner about ¥10,000–19,999. Six counter seats; book. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a couple ran the room with no other servers (March 2024); in August 2024 the owner worked with two apprentices. A November 2024 reviewer heard it had held a Michelin star four years in a row but no longer does.
chef_bio.specialty: Mini kaiseki lunch; kamadaki rice.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 diner, there on a furusato-tax voucher, found it more like a calm izakaya than a kaiseki house, the couple working seamlessly but a little rushed.
An August 2025 guest was asked about likes, dislikes and any foods to avoid.
"I heard this place earned Michelin stars 4 years in a row, but it's no longer recognized." — November 2024.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園なか原、日本料理、東山区祇園町北側286-5、祇園四条駅から446m、月〜土 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜22:00、日曜と祝日の月曜休み、13席 (カウンター)、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年7月、英語): 八坂神社前の細い路地、夫婦で営む (2024年3月)、店主と弟子2人 (2024年8月)、ミシュランの星を4年連続で得たが今はない (2024年11月)、ミニ懐石の昼5,000〜6,000円、9品のコース、ひな祭りの八寸、蛤の吸い物、平目やぐじの造り、鯛の昆布締め、もろこ、ふぐ、筍、稚鮎とこしあぶらの天ぷら、鯛の酒盗、丸大根、九条ねぎ、釜炊きのご飯。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; the alley entrance is hard to find.

places.name: ブランカ (Blanca)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kara-age, fried noodles, shumai and spiced fried dishes; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: pork, chicken, lamb, shellfish and oysters run through the menu (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat from 18:00 (last order 21:00 per Tabelog); closed Sunday and some other days (Tabelog). A March 2025 reviewer says there is no time limit and the rice is ready around 21:00. Bookings for the next month open at the start of each month and are hard to get; Saturday walk-ins are possible if you arrive before opening, when the head chef may be away and the menu shorter (Tabelog; April 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 11 seats: 7 at the counter, 4 at a table; a private room for 6 for regulars, with a special course (Tabelog). North of Sanjo; 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: North of Sanjo, near Kyoto City Hall — 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: An izakaya of small plates with flavours from around the world (2025–26 reviews): pork and cilantro salad with white-sesame dressing, cilantro white tofu, potato namul, kara-age, boiled pork with cucumber and dipping sauce, fig and steamed chicken with sesame, eggplant nanban with tokoroten, sesame tofu, simmered shellfish platter, steamed clams, Miyazu rock oysters, lamb shumai, "Islamic" spiced fried shrimp, salt-fried chicken with corn, Thai-style fried noodles, rice ready around 9 pm; rum-raisin ice cream and coffee awamori · Friday special course ¥6,000 (May 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · near Sanjo and Kyoto City Hall] One of Kyoto's hardest-to-book izakaya, loved by restaurant people after hours: eleven seats and a stream of small, deeply flavoured plates — cilantro and white-sesame salad, lamb shumai, spiced fried shrimp, Thai-style noodles. About ¥4,000–10,000. Cash only; bookings open monthly; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Tetsu-san (as a November 2025 reviewer calls the chef)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a popular izakaya that restaurant workers visit after hours (May 2026); a November 2025 reviewer had eaten the chef's cooking at an inn the chef runs with a friend in Yura before coming here. When the head chef is away on Saturdays the staff run a shorter menu (April 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Cilantro and white-sesame dishes; small plates for drinking.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular walked in on a Saturday before opening, knowing walk-ins are possible then — though the head chef was off and the menu limited.
A June 2026 diner in Kyoto on a typhoon night phoned for a cancellation and got a table.
A party of five in November 2025 found a separate room next door and missed only chatting with Tetsu-san at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ブランカ、居酒屋、中京区御幸町三条上ル丸屋町334、京都市役所前駅から248m、月〜土 18:00〜21:00 (L.O. 21:00)、日曜休み・不定休、翌月の予約は毎月はじめに受付、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、11席 (カウンター7、テーブル4)、常連向けの個室6名 (特別コース)、禁煙。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年7月、英語): パクチーと豚の白胡麻サラダ、パクチー白和え、ポテトナムル、唐揚げ、茹で豚、無花果と蒸し鶏、茄子の南蛮とところてん、貝の盛り合わせ、Miyazu の岩牡蠣、羊の焼売、イスラム風の海老フライ、タイ風焼きそば、金曜の特別コース6,000円、土曜は開店前なら予約なしでも、料理長 Tetsu-san、Yura の宿。

cultural_comfort.note: Hard to book (next month opens at the start of each month); cash only; mostly regulars (July 2026).

places.name: 京都 柳馬場 ほん田亭 (Kyoto Yanaginobamba Honda Tei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dashimaki bowls with dashi, soy-based sauces and soboro; fish courses; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg and dashi bowls with chicken, meat or eel; fish courses (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) daily except Tuesday; dinner Mon 17:30–21:00, Wed–Sun and days before/after holidays 17:30–22:30 (food last order 21:30), holidays 17:30–21:30; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Lunch takes no bookings and is cash only (May 2026); dinner courses can be booked (Tabelog). Seat charge 10% — Tabelog's Japanese original: "別途、席料として10%頂いております。". 26 seats: about 10 at the counter and sunken-floor tables; non-smoking, smoking outside; cards incl. UnionPay (Tabelog; July 2026). On Yanaginobamba-dori; 3 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn exit 3-1 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yanaginobamba-dori near Oike — 3 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Two faces: at lunch, Kyoto-style dashimaki rice bowls — a thick, dashi-heavy rolled omelette made in the "Kyomaki" way — with chicken soboro and golden ginger sauce ¥1,430, meat soboro ¥1,430, mentaiko, or eel (half sizes) (2026 reviews); at night, fish from a live tank prepared with ikejime, line-caught wild kue from Nagasaki's Goto Islands as nabe, Awaji fugu, yellowtail shabu-shabu and fish courses from ¥5,000 (Tabelog; January 2026)
places.notes: [Dashimaki bowls & seafood · near Karasuma-Oike] By day, a queue for rice bowls crowned with a huge, wobbly Kyoto dashimaki omelette (about ¥1,430, cash, no bookings); by night, a fish restaurant with live-tank seafood, Goto-island kue hot pot and fugu, courses from ¥5,000 plus a 10% seat charge. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed; chats with guests at the counter per the operator and reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator: fish kept alive in tanks and dispatched with ikejime by optical fibre; wild kue line-caught off Nagasaki's Goto Islands shipped alive; fugu from Awaji. A July 2026 reviewer watched the dashimaki made in the "Kyomaki" way, with more dashi and no air.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto dashimaki rice bowl; kue nabe.

anecdotes.text: The staff also recommended good matcha-parfait shops — February 2026.
An October 2026 diner found the bowl lovely at first but a little monotonous, and the staff's coordination slightly uneven.
Another October 2026 guest was offered the chance to film the sauce being poured.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 京都 柳馬場 ほん田亭、海鮮・日本料理、中京区柳八幡町75-6 LS京都ビル 1F、烏丸御池駅3-1出口から徒歩3分、昼11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)、夜 月17:30〜21:00、水〜日・祝前後17:30〜22:30、祝日17:30〜21:30、火曜休み、別途席料として10%、26席 (掘りごたつとカウンター)、カード可、生け簀の魚を光ファイバーで神経締め、Nagasaki の Goto Islands の一本釣りの天然クエの鍋、Awaji のふぐ、5,000円からの魚のコース、冬は鰤しゃぶと天然とらふぐ。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): 京だし巻き丼 鶏そぼろ金あんかけ1,430円、肉そぼろ1,430円、明太子、鰻、京巻き、昼は現金のみ・予約不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch: queue, cash only; dinner: book; 10% seat charge.

places.name: ビストロヤナギハラ (Bistro Yanagihara)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Bistro dishes with sauces, pâtés, bread and croutons; the omakase can be adjusted on request (December 2024); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: charcuterie, foie gras, venison, salmon and trout (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 17:30–21:30 (last order 19:30); closed Wednesday and Thursday (Tabelog). Bookings needed, often a month or two ahead, also online (2025 reviews). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし". 10 seats: tables and 2 at the counter; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). Portions are large — staff suggest two starters and one main for two (2025–26 reviews). At Kawaramachi-Nijo; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-Nijo, north of Kyoto City Hall — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Classic French bistro from an Alsace-trained chef (April 2025): charcuterie platter of liver pâté, rillettes, smoked chicken, pâté de campagne, house roast ham and sauerkraut ¥1,540 per person; thick-cut smoked Shinshu salmon ¥3,080; white or German asparagus with egg sauce; mushroom salad; gazpacho with foie gras and venison; saffron trout; chicken-liver mousse (2024–26 reviews) · omakase course ¥8,800 (October 2024; February 2026) or à la carte; wine to match
places.notes: [French bistro · Kawaramachi-Nijo] A ten-seat bistro run by an Alsace-trained chef since 2010: generous charcuterie, thick-cut smoked salmon, foie gras and game, with good wine. Omakase ¥8,800 or à la carte (portions are large). Book well ahead; dinner only, closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Chef (unnamed; trained in Alsace per an April 2025 reviewer)
chef_bio.background: Opened 12 December 2010 (Tabelog). An April 2025 reviewer calls it a Bib Gourmand bistro run by a chef trained in Alsace; a December 2024 guest returned after about eight years.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcuterie; thick-cut smoked salmon.

anecdotes.text: An October 2024 birthday party praised the service of "the beautiful staff member (the owner's wife?)", though the crab tartare could have had more crab.
A December 2024 guest who could not eat much had the omakase adjusted so every dish could be enjoyed.
An April 2025 diner was advised that two starters and one main would be plenty.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビストロヤナギハラ、フレンチ・ビストロ、中京区河原町二条上る清水町358、京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分、月火金土日 17:30〜21:30 (L.O. 19:30)、水木休み、サービス料: なし、10席 (テーブル、カウンター2)、禁煙、カード可、2010年12月12日オープン。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年9月、英語): アルザスで修業したシェフ、ビブグルマン、シャルキュトリーの盛り合わせ1人1,540円、Shinshu サーモンの燻製3,080円、ホワイトアスパラ、マッシュルームのサラダ、フォアグラと鹿のガスパチョ、鱒のサフラン、鶏レバーのムース、おまかせコース8,800円、量が多い、予約は1〜2か月前。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a month or two ahead; generous portions.

places.name: COCOLO KYOTO (ココロ キョウト)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Granola usually contains oats and no gluten information is given; the black-shichimi nuts use an organic gluten-free tamari (official site), but other flavours are not labelled.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Organic nuts and granola, and soy-milk ice cream (January 2026), may suit; acai bowls come with fruit and granola, but no vegan labelling is given (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: 11:00–19:00, closed Tuesday. Tabelog: daily 11:00–18:00; hours may change. The café stops serving at 17:00 (January 2026). Bookings taken (Tabelog). 16 seats; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Second floor; samples offered (2025–2026 reviews). Two more shops in Tokyo (Yurakucho Marui, Ginza Melsa) (official site).
places.neighborhood: Just south of Sanjo, upstairs — 297 m from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto’s first granola specialist (official site): organic granola and roasted nuts, acai bowls and ice cream upstairs · nut flavours made with famous Kyoto makers: Gion 原了郭 black shichimi (30 g ¥700, 65 g ¥1,290, August 2025), 九重味噌 white miso, 北尾 black-bean kinako, Uji organic matcha, yatsuhashi cinnamon, Ogawa Coffee, Nile Restaurant curry (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · acai bowl with fruit and granola, nut topping; soy-sauce-and-shichimi ice cream, soy-milk and hazelnut ice cream (2025–2026 reviews) · cheaper broken nuts without a box (September 2025)
places.notes: [Granola & nuts café · Karasuma-Oike, upstairs] Kyoto’s first granola specialist, up a flight of stairs: organic nuts roasted in Kyoto with black shichimi from 原了郭, white miso, matcha or yatsuhashi cinnamon — boxed for souvenirs, with tastings — and acai bowls or soy-sauce ice cream to eat in. The café closes before the shop. One August 2026 buyer found them good, practical gifts rather than incredible; a black-pepper lover wanted more heat. Closed Tuesday (official site).

roles: Nut roasters in its own Kyoto factory (official site); not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the first granola specialist to open in Kyoto, treating granola as a health and beauty food with almost all-organic ingredients; nuts are roasted one by one by nut craftsmen in its factory in central Kyoto, adjusting for Kyoto’s seasons; flavours made with old Kyoto makers (原了郭 black shichimi, 九重味噌 white miso, 北尾 kinako, Uji matcha); shops in Kyoto and in Tokyo at Yurakucho Marui and Ginza Melsa.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「毎日食べてココロもカラダもHAPPYに」 — granola eaten daily to make heart and body happy.
chef_bio.specialty: Black-shichimi nuts; organic granola; acai bowls.

anecdotes.text: Arriving at 5:30 pm after the café had closed, a January 2026 visitor bought nuts instead and was given ice cream on the house.
"To be honest, I wouldn't say they were 'incredibly delicious' (sorry!), but they weren't excessively expensive either." — August 2026; long-keeping and light for souvenirs.
Someone who dislikes nuts kept buying the black-shichimi nuts as gifts, then tried them and became a fan (December 2025).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (cocolo-kyoto.jp): COCOLO KYOTO、京都に初めて誕生したグラノーラ専門店、毎日食べてココロもカラダもHAPPYに、グラノーラは健康食品・美容食品、ほぼすべての素材がオーガニック、京都市中心部の工場でナッツ職人が一粒ずつ焼く、祇園原了郭の黒七味と丸又商店のオーガニックグルテンフリーたまり醤油、九重味噌の極上白味噌、北尾の京・丹波ぶどう黒豆きな粉、宇治の有機抹茶、八ツ橋のニッキ、店舗は京都本店 (東洞院通三条下ル三文字町201、11:00〜19:00、火曜休み)、有楽町マルイ店、銀座メルサ店。食べログ: カフェ・スイーツ、中京区東洞院通三条下ル三文字町201 2F、毎日11:00〜18:00、予約可、16席、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年8月、英語): アサイーボウル、ナッツのトッピング、祇園黒七味ナッツ30g 700円・65g 1,290円、白味噌、八ツ橋、Nile Restaurant のカレー、Ogawa Coffee のコーヒー味、きな粉、のり、箱なしの割れナッツ、醤油と七味のアイス、豆乳とヘーゼルナッツのアイス、試食、カフェは17時まで、親切なスタッフ、お土産向き、驚くほどではないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick boxes from the shelves and taste first; café orders at the counter upstairs.

places.name: お好み焼き 鉄板焼き まんまるの月 (Manmaru no Tsuki)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-batter okonomiyaki, negiyaki and yakisoba with sauce (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the Kyoto-style okonomiyaki is rich with dashi and topped with bonito flakes (2026 reviews); Tabelog lists vegetarian options — ask.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); irregular closures. Bookings taken; a counter booking may be moved to the tatami room. 43 seats with a counter, sunken seating and semi-private rooms; private hire for 30–40; non-smoking with a smoking spot in front; children welcome; menus in English, Chinese and Korean; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 1 December 2010 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishiki-koji just west of Karasuma — 3 min walk from Shijo Stn and Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style okonomiyaki and creative teppanyaki, plated on ceramics · okonomiyaki: mochi-cheese, wagyu, green-onion and seaweed, negiyaki, "Manbo-yaki" with mayonnaise and green onion (2026 reviews) · teppan dishes: assorted grilled vegetables, sautéed maitake and shimeji, avocado with blue cheese, shrimp and broccoli with spicy mayo, pork in Saikyo miso, omelette, seafood salad, salt yakisoba, potato salad (2026 reviews) · birthday dessert plates (June 2026) · draft Sapporo, shikuwasa chuhai, sake, wine (2026 reviews; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki & teppan · Shijo-Karasuma, Kyoto-style with a French twist] A stylish counter and sunken-seat room on Nishiki-koji where dashi-rich, fluffy Kyoto-style okonomiyaki shares the teppan with creative plates — avocado with blue cheese, grilled vegetables, Saikyo-miso pork — served on ceramics. Multilingual menus; staff warm and quick. Some found the yakisoba bland and the prices a little high for the taste (2026); you will leave smelling of sauce.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 December 2010 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a large teppan behind the counter, a sunken-seat area at the back for parties, regulars at the counter, Kyoto-style okonomiyaki and teppan dishes with French and Italian touches; an August 2026 diner found it via the Kansai TV programme "Yoi Don" featuring the mochi-cheese okonomiyaki.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-style okonomiyaki; creative teppan plates.

anecdotes.text: "The only downside is that by the time you leave, you'll smell like okonomiyaki from the sauce." — May 2026.
「味は全体的にまずまず。」 — November 2026, who still recommends it for a date, for the big teppan in front of you.
A June 2026 group celebrating a friend’s occasion had a message written on the dessert plate.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お好み焼き 鉄板焼き まんまるの月、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・ステーキ、中京区錦小路通烏丸西入占出山町312 KEY’Sビル1F、四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩3分、毎日17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、不定休、予約可 (カウンター予約でも座敷になる場合あり)、43席、半個室、貸切30〜40名、禁煙 (店前に喫煙スペース)、子供可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、ベジタリアン対応、カード・PayPay 可、2010年12月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年4月〜11月、英語・日本語): 京風お好み焼き、だしが効いてふわふわ、もちチーズ (関西テレビ「よーいドン」で紹介)、和牛、ねぎと海苔、ねぎ焼き、まんぼ焼き、焼き野菜の盛り合わせ、きのこ炒め、アボカドのブルーチーズ焼き、海老とブロッコリーのピリ辛マヨ、豚の西京焼き、オムレツ、海鮮サラダ、塩焼きそば、ポテトサラダ、誕生日のデザートプレート、焼きそばは薄味という声、少し高め・味はまずまずという声、ソースの匂いが残る。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese and Korean with photos (Tabelog); counter seats watch the teppan.

places.name: 寺町よしくら (Teramachi Yoshikura)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; lunch sets with tempura and dashi-simmered obanzai, Saikyo-miso grilled fish (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: obanzai simmered in dashi and fish or beef mains (2026 reviews; official site).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 11:00–14:00 (L.O.), dinner 17:00–21:00 (L.O.); closed Tuesday. Tabelog: 11:00–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00). Lunch is cash or PayPay only; cards at dinner (Tabelog). Bookings taken; lunch fills up, so book (October 2026). No service charge (Tabelog; Japanese original 「なし」). 20 seats: a counter of 10 and tatami rooms; non-smoking; children welcome but no nursing or changing facilities (Tabelog). Opened 13 November 2006 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi-dori just south of Imadegawa, east of the Imperial Palace — 5 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese cooking by a hotel-trained chef, famous for all-you-can-eat obanzai at lunch · every lunch set comes with 6–8 obanzai refilled on request (okara, hijiki, pumpkin, satoimo, ganmo, atsuage, red konnyaku, dried daikon) and rice refills: daily set ¥2,300, saba miso-grilled ¥2,400, sashimi gozen ¥4,200, Saikyo-grilled black cod or mackerel, sukiyaki rice bowl (2026 reviews); Shinshu-beef steak gozen, Kyoto-style sukiyaki box, eel box, Saikyo-yaki set limited to 20 (official site) · dinner: kaiseki, soy-milk hot pot, wild kue simmered in its own broth (official site) · rice from Miyama (official site)
places.notes: [Japanese & obanzai · Teramachi-Imadegawa, refills on the house] A counter-and-tatami restaurant east of the Imperial Palace run by a chef trained in Okura and Royal hotel kitchens, beloved at lunch for set meals with unlimited obanzai and rice — okara, hijiki, pumpkin, simmered satoimo — beside sashimi, tempura or Saikyo-grilled fish, ¥2,300–4,200. Dinner is kaiseki and soy-milk hot pot. One diner found the seasoning on the sweet side; obanzai are now served by staff rather than self-serve. Lunch cash or PayPay. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 谷口 寿幸 (owner-chef, per the official site; no reading in a source)
roles: Owner and chef (official site: 店主 / 料理人 谷口 寿幸)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: trained in Japanese cooking at the Kobe Oriental Hotel from 1991 (Heisei 3) and in Kyoto cuisine at 京大和, then worked at the Rihga Royal Hotel Tokyo, Hotel Okura Tokyo and Hotel Okura Kyoto, often cooking at the state guesthouse and the Prime Minister’s residence; opened 寺町よしくら independently in 2006 (Heisei 18). The site also lists a sister shop, よしくら 北店, in Kita-ku, and sells Saikyo-marinated black cod and pickles online.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: to keep improving ingredients and menu and never forget the beginner’s mind, thanks to guests and staff.
chef_bio.specialty: All-you-can-eat obanzai lunch; Saikyo-miso grilled fish.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular noticed the obanzai, once self-served from bowls on the counter, are now refilled by the staff on request.
"Please feel free to ask for more anytime," a staff member told an October 2026 diner asking for refills.
A September 2026 visitor near the Futaba mochi shop found the obanzai and sukiyaki bowl on the sweet side — recommended for those who like sweet flavours.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (teramachiyoshikura.com): 寺町よしくら、御所東の本格和食、旬の魚介と京野菜、数々の有名ホテルで経験を積んだ匠、ランチはお惣菜6〜7品が食べ放題 (信州牛のステーキ御膳、京風すき焼き重、鰻重、限定20食の西京焼定食など)、夜は限定会席、豆乳鍋、和歌山産天然クエのあら煮、日本酒・焼酎、京都美山のキヌヒカリ、店主・料理人 谷口 寿幸: 平成3年神戸オリエンタルホテルで日本料理の修業、京大和で京料理、リーガロイヤルホテル東京、ホテル・オークラ東京、ホテル・オークラ京都、迎賓館や総理公邸での調理、平成18年に独立、昼11:00〜14:00 (L.O.)、夜17:00〜21:00 (L.O.)、火曜休み、よしくら 北店、楽天の通販 (銀だら西京漬け、漬物)。食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋・海鮮、上京区寺町通今出川下ル真如堂前町102、出町柳駅から徒歩5分、11:00〜14:30・17:00〜22:00、火曜休み、ランチは現金か PayPay のみ、サービス料なし、20席 (カウンター10、座敷10)、禁煙、子供可 (授乳室やおむつ替えの設備なし)、2006年11月13日オープン。口コミ (2026年8月〜11月、英語): おばんざい食べ放題 (おから、ひじき、南瓜、里芋、がんも、厚揚げ、赤こんにゃく、切り干し大根)、ご飯おかわり自由、日替わり2,300円、鯖の味噌焼き2,400円、お造り御膳4,200円、銀だらや鯖の西京焼き、すき焼き丼、以前はセルフで今はスタッフがよそう、甘めの味付けという声、ランチは予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose a lunch set; staff refill obanzai on request; lunch cash or PayPay only.

places.name: 洛空 (Raku, The Westin Miyako Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask the staff: Tabelog says allergy information is available. The buffet mixes tempura, bread, pasta and noodles with sushi, roast beef and rice dishes (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: allergy information is available (Tabelog); salads, vegetables and rice are on the buffet, but most stations serve fish, meat or eggs (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 6:30–21:00; Sat–Sun 6:30–22:00 — breakfast, lunch (a 90-minute course, September 2026), afternoon tea and dinner buffets. Service charge 15% (Tabelog; Japanese original 「15％」); an August 2026 breakfast guest paid ¥5,000 per adult and ¥2,500 per child (4–12) including tax and service. One child under school age eats free with each paying adult (August and October 2026). Bookings taken; dinner guests may enter about 10 minutes early (August 2026). 186 seats; a private room for 24 or more; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; parking 2 hours free with ¥3,000 spent; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Opened 27 November 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Keage, in The Westin Miyako Kyoto — 2 min walk from Keage Stn
places.cuisine: All-day hotel buffet with live kitchens and a view · breakfast ¥5,000 adults, ¥2,500 children 4–12, tax and service included: onigiri and dashimaki made in front of you, omelettes, red miso soup, nyumen, obanzai, fresh orange juice, smoothies, breads, Kyoto pickles (August–October 2026) · lunch 90-minute buffet ¥6,200 (September 2026) · dinner: sushi made to order, freshly fried tempura, roast beef, noodles, pasta, unagi rice, curry, cheese, rice from 八代目儀兵衛, Cremia soft serve, mini cakes, Ogawa Coffee (2026 reviews) · afternoon tea set with free-flow drinks (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Hotel buffet · Keage, The Westin Miyako Kyoto] The Westin Miyako’s all-day buffet room, with a window view of the Daimonji on the hill: breakfast of onigiri and dashimaki made in front of you, and at dinner sushi to order, fresh tempura and roast beef from live kitchens. Families love that a preschooler eats free with each adult; others found the menu barely changes with the seasons and lines at the sushi station long. 15% service. Open daily from 6:30.

roles: Hotel restaurant of The Westin Miyako Kyoto (official hotel site); chefs not named
chef_bio.background: The all-day buffet restaurant of The Westin Miyako Kyoto in Keage (hotel site; Tabelog). Opened 27 November 2019 (Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer had stayed at the hotel almost every year since it was the Miyako Hotel.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tabelog: a buffet put together with care, in a spacious room with plenty of distance between tables.
chef_bio.specialty: Live-kitchen onigiri and dashimaki at breakfast; sushi and tempura at dinner.

anecdotes.text: "The cost performance is great, and the food is delicious, but it’s a bit disappointing that the menu doesn’t change significantly with each season." — August 2026, a regular.
An August 2026 family ate dinner looking out at the Daimonji on the hill through the window.
On an October 2026 weekend about 80% of the guests were families with small children.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洛空、ビュッフェ・寿司・洋食、東山区粟田口華頂町1 (ウェスティン都ホテル京都)、蹴上駅から徒歩2分、京都駅八条口から無料シャトルバス、月〜金 6:30〜21:00、土日 6:30〜22:00、サービス料15%、予約可、186席、24名以上で個室、禁煙、車椅子可、3,000円以上で駐車2時間無料、アレルギー表示あり、デザートビュッフェ、アフタヌーンティー、2019年11月27日オープン。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 朝食大人5,000円・子供 (4〜12歳) 2,500円 (税サ込)、目の前で握るおにぎりとだし巻き、オムレツ、赤だし、にゅうめん、おばんざい、搾りたてオレンジジュース、スムージー、パン、京漬物、昼は90分で6,200円、夜は握り寿司、揚げたて天ぷら、ローストビーフ、麺、パスタ、鰻ご飯、カレー、八代目儀兵衛の米、クレミア、小川珈琲、未就学児は大人1人につき1人無料、窓から右大文字、季節で内容があまり変わらない、寿司は行列という声。

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel buffet; point and serve yourself; live-kitchen staff cook to order.

places.name: Japanese Noodle 一寸法師 (Japanese Noodle Issunboushi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every bowl is wheat noodles, the vegan ramen included; the shoyu broths use soy sauce (Savor Japan menu; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: a KYOTO VEGAN NOODLE (¥1,500) and a morning vegan ramen (¥800), described on the Savor Japan menu as made without animal or seafood stock, with white miso, rice malt and soy milk; a September 2026 diner had the soy-milk vegan ramen with tomato and olive oil. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options. All other bowls use chicken, seafood or shellfish broths and meat toppings. In June 2025 a reviewer saw a vegan ramen remade after ground meat had been added to it by mistake — say clearly that you need the vegan bowl.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Thu–Sun and the day before a holiday 8:00–20:30 (food L.O. 20:00); Tue, holidays and the day after a holiday 8:00–18:30 (L.O. 18:00); Wed 8:00–18:00 (L.O. 18:00). Breakfast menu until 10:30, then the full menu until the day’s 100 bowls sell out — the shop closes when the noodles run out. Open year-round (Tabelog; the shop’s own note on the same page gives breakfast from 7:00 to 11:00, which disagrees). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR codes accepted (Tabelog); orders by tablet at the seat in January 2026, by ticket machine in July 2025. 10 counter seats, L-shaped; office and restroom upstairs (Tabelog; August 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese and Korean menus with photos; children welcome, kids’ menu, strollers OK (Tabelog). Waits of about 40 min on a Sunday afternoon (March 2026). A tips box sits by the ticket machine (June 2025). 2 min from Kiyomizu-michi bus stop, 5 min from Kiyomizu-dera’s Niomon Gate (Tabelog). Opened 26 February 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Below Kiyomizu-dera, off Kiyomizu-zaka near the Hokanji five-story pagoda — 2 min from Kiyomizu-michi bus stop
places.cuisine: Ramen, with a breakfast menu from 8:00 (Tabelog) · shoyu “Issunboushi ramen” ¥900 with seasoned egg ¥300 and rice ¥300, a light shellfish shoyu (March 2026) · ¥500 plain morning ramen on a shellfish broth (August 2026) · “Mochi Mochi Enmusubi” morning ramen with mochi and egg, with a takikomi-gohan set; the shoyu broth moved from clam to chicken and seafood (January 2026) · salt, shoyu and white-miso bowls, shrimp and seared scallop bowls ¥2,000, a snow-crab white-miso bowl ¥3,400, a tomato and grilled-cheese ramen ¥1,500, a Wagyu sirloin ramen ¥7,000 limited to ten a day, chashu rice bowls, a children’s ramen set ¥600 (Savor Japan menu, undated) · KYOTO VEGAN NOODLE ¥1,500 and a morning vegan ramen ¥800 (Savor Japan menu) · special meat ramen ¥1,300 with sweet beef, shirataki and tomato (June 2025)
places.notes: [Ramen · below Kiyomizu-dera, breakfast bowls from 8:00] A ten-seat counter on the walk down from Kiyomizu-dera, open from 8:00 with a morning menu (a ¥500 bowl, a vegan bowl, porridge) and then ramen until the day’s 100 bowls are gone. Light shellfish and chicken-seafood shoyu and salt broths, a vegan soy-milk ramen, and showpiece bowls up to a ¥7,000 Wagyu sirloin. Most diners are overseas visitors; multilingual menus. Reviews split: fans of the clean broth, critics of the prices (one 2025 reviewer called the ¥7,000 bowl an overcharge aimed at foreigners), slow turnover and a drop in quality noted in October 2026.

chef_bio.background: A June 2025 reviewer saw “the male owner” training a new staff member at the counter. A March 2025 reviewer described the team as two Brazilian staff who “seem to be working hard but are not adequately trained” and “one unfriendly Japanese chef”; a January 2026 reviewer wrote that “most of the staff are also from abroad”. An August 2025 family wished more staff besides the manager spoke English.
chef_bio.specialty: Light shellfish and chicken-seafood shoyu ramen; morning ramen; a vegan soy-milk ramen.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 regular, on a twelfth visit, came for the morning ramen and noted the broth had changed from clam to chicken and seafood.
A June 2025 visitor found a tips box by the ticket machine and glasses of foreign banknotes on the tables, and arrived to find only the morning menu served until 10:30.
An October 2026 repeat visitor found the quality much lower than six months earlier and the prices sharply higher.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Japanese Noodle 一寸法師、ラーメン・中華料理・餃子、東山区清水4-148-6、清水道バス停から徒歩2分、清水寺仁王門から徒歩5分。月・木〜日・祝前日 8:00〜20:30、火・祝日・祝後日 8:00〜18:30、水 8:00〜18:00、朝食は10:30まで、その後は100食で売り切れ次第終了、年中無休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、カウンター10席、禁煙、英語・繁体字・簡体字・韓国語メニュー、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン対応、子ども可、2022年2月26日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): あっさりした貝の醤油ラーメン、朝の500円ラーメン、豆乳のヴィーガンラーメン、チップ箱、値段が高いとの声、2026年10月には味が落ちたとの声、2025年6月にはヴィーガンラーメンにひき肉を入れて作り直す場面。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus with photos and tablet ordering (Tabelog; January 2026); the manager speaks English, other staff less so (August 2025). Mostly overseas visitors.

vegan_cross_contact.text: A June 2025 reviewer watched a vegan ramen being remade after ground meat had been added to it; the vegan bowls are cooked at the same counter as the meat and seafood bowls.

positives.text: Dedicated vegan ramen (KYOTO VEGAN NOODLE, morning vegan ramen) made without animal or seafood stock, per the Savor Japan menu.

places.name: さかな 波波 (Sakana Naminami)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Natural-fish courses and à la carte — sashimi with soy sauce, grilled and fried fish, tempura, agedashi tofu, seasoned rice; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish restaurant; dobin-mushi and dashi dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:30, Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats (Tabelog); a February 2025 reviewer saw only counter seating. Non-smoking (Tabelog). A reviewer (April 2024) calls it an adult space and asks families with children to stay away. On Fuyacho south of Nijo, 350 m from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 11 April 2003 (Tabelog); two reviewers (June 2024, February 2025) think it was recently renovated.
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho south of Nijo, west of Kyoto City Hall — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Natural (wild-caught) fish, prepared in front of the counter (2017–2026 reviews) · a ¥15,000 course of ten dishes (November 2025) · the house’s top course: a hassun of ten small dishes, rock oysters, a five-kind sashimi platter, hamo sashimi with plum sauce, grilled and fried dishes, agedashi tofu (July 2026) · dobin-mushi, oysters, swordtip squid sashimi with ginger soy, tempura, seasoned rice (September 2026) · à la carte: assorted sashimi ¥8,800, dashimaki ¥1,500, with dishes over ¥5,000 and ¥10,000 (June 2024) · an okara appetizer (February 2025) · sake ¥1,500, beer ¥880, white wine (2024–2026)
places.notes: [Fish · Fuyacho-Nijo, wild fish since 2003] A natural-fish restaurant on a quiet stretch of Fuyacho, open since 2003, where the fish is cut and cooked in front of the counter. Go for a course — ten dishes for ¥15,000, or the top course with a ten-item hassun, rock oysters, five kinds of sashimi and hamo sashimi in summer — or order à la carte, though a 2024 diner found that very expensive (¥8,800 for the sashimi platter). Reviewers like the friendly chef; one asks families with children to stay away.

chef_bio.background: A July 2017 reviewer described “the friendly surf-loving chef” who “specializes in natural seafood dishes”; an August 2024 reviewer called the head chef “friendly and approachable”, and a November 2025 guest enjoyed the conversation at the counter.
chef_bio.philosophy: All-natural fish (April 2024 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Natural-fish courses; hamo sashimi in summer.

anecdotes.text: Three July 2026 reviewers on business dinners each rated the hamo sashimi the best ever eaten; the staff told one that it runs until about October, best in September.
A June 2024 diner found the prices well above those in older photos: sashimi platter ¥8,800, dashimaki ¥1,500.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: さかな 波波、魚介料理、中京区麩屋町二条下ル尾張町231、京都市役所前駅から347m、火〜日 17:00〜22:30、月曜定休、予約可、カード可 (VISA、Master、JCB、AMEX、Diners)、電子マネー・QR決済不可、18席、禁煙、2003年4月11日オープン。口コミ (2017〜2026年、英語): 天然の魚、サーフィン好きの気さくな料理人、10品15,000円のコース、10品の八寸、岩牡蠣、刺身5種、鱧の造りと梅のたれ、土瓶蒸し、天ぷら、炊き込みご飯、2024年6月には刺身盛合せ8,800円、だし巻き1,500円で高いとの声、子連れは遠慮してほしいとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: No English menu listed; counter dining with a chef reviewers find friendly.

places.name: 二條 葵月 (Nijo Kizuki)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi courses with small dishes; nigiri often seasoned with salt, sauces such as seaweed soy and vinegar miso, Saikyo-miso grilled fish, miso soup; no gluten information (Tabelog shop text; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses only, of fish and sushi, with fish-bone miso soup (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 (last seating 13:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last seating 21:00), Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservation only; same-day bookings have worked (May and June 2026). The shop’s rules (Tabelog): “We do not allow visitors wearing perfume or other items with strong smells. In this case, a cancellation fee will also be charged.” Arriving more than 15 minutes late counts as a cancellation. “In order for you to enjoy your meal in a relaxed manner, we do not allow children under the age of 13 to enter our restaurant.” Cards: VISA, Master, AMEX; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats: 6 at the counter, 4 at a table (Tabelog); a January 2026 regular counted eight at the counter. Private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking, ashtray outside; wheelchair users can sit at a table (Tabelog). On Nijo-dori east of Yanagibaba, 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae and Karasuma Oike Stns (Tabelog). Opened 26 July 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo-dori east of Yanagibaba — 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Sushi with Japanese small dishes, courses only (Tabelog; June 2026) · the owner buys at the market and seasons much of it with salt; signature uni ice with sesame tofu, scented with Saikyo miso (Tabelog shop text) · sushi lunch course ¥3,300: inari sushi, fruit with tofu dressing, vinegar-miso dish, sashimi with seaweed soy and mustard, grilled wild hamachi, ten nigiri, miso soup and soba tea (October 2026) · ¥8,800 course: appetizers, corn soup, flounder with lemon and charcoal salt, Saikyo-miso mackerel, ten nigiri, miso soup, dessert (May 2026) · ¥19,800 and longer courses ending in twelve nigiri, abalone with sea urchin, braised shark fin (March and December 2025) · New Year osechi dishes and white-miso zoni (January 2026) · shari of rice vinegar and red vinegar, small and lightly sweet (December 2025; August 2026) · sake tasting sets, many from Omachi rice and the owner’s home prefecture, Yamaguchi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Nijo-dori, a one-man counter, no perfume] A glass-fronted, café-like room on Nijo-dori, easy to walk past but for the lantern, where the owner works the counter alone: seasonal small dishes, then ten or twelve slim nigiri on small red-vinegar shari, with sake tasting sets. Lunch from ¥3,300, dinner courses from ¥8,800. Reservation only; no perfume or strong scents (a cancellation fee applies) and no children under 13. Some find the service reserved.

chef_bio.origin: Yamaguchi (Tabelog shop text: “sake from the owner’s hometown, Yamaguchi”)
chef_bio.background: A January 2026 regular names the master as Mr. Morimoto and writes that the family runs a ryotei. Reviewers describe a one-man counter: “Although it was a one-person operation, the speed of food and drink service was good” (June 2026); the owner was alone on an early May 2026 evening and talked at length with the only guest. A February 2026 reviewer, echoing others, found the service “a bit cold … more welcoming to regular customers”; an August 2026 lunch guest noted little conversation but smooth service.
chef_bio.philosophy: Ingredients chosen by the owner at the market, carefully prepared and often seasoned with salt (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi courses with creative small dishes; uni ice with sesame tofu; sake tastings.

anecdotes.text: On an early May 2026 evening with no other guests, the owner shared stories with the one diner, and the sake cups had each sake’s name written underneath; the owner seemed especially fond of Omachi-rice sake.
A January 2026 regular booked the same day and time as the year before for the New Year dishes and white-miso zoni.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 二條 葵月、寿司・創作料理・日本料理、中京区二条通柳馬場東入ル晴明町659 ヴァインオークFINE 1F、京都市役所前駅・烏丸御池駅から徒歩7分、月〜土 昼12:00〜14:30 (最終入店13:30)、夜17:00〜22:00 (最終入店21:00)、日曜定休、完全予約制、香水など強い香りの方は入店不可 (キャンセル料あり)、15分以上の遅れはキャンセル扱い、13歳未満は入店不可、カード可 (VISA、Master、AMEX)、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル4)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、2014年7月26日オープン。店の紹介: 店主が市場で選ぶ魚を塩で仕上げることが多い、ウニのアイスと胡麻豆腐、店主の故郷 Yamaguchi の日本酒。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 店主 Morimoto、実家は料亭、ひとりで営む、昼のコース3,300円、夜8,800円、米酢と赤酢のシャリ、日本酒の飲み比べ、接客はやや冷たいとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: No foreign-booking restriction stated; reviewers note many international guests (October 2026). Strict house rules: no perfume or strong scents (cancellation fee), no children under 13, 15 minutes late counts as a cancellation (Tabelog).

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based seasonal cooking of fish and shellfish (2022–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00, Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; booked out on a November 2022 evening, when à la carte guests were still fitted in (Tabelog; November 2022). No credit cards; e-money accepted; no QR (Tabelog). 19 seats: 11 at the counter and two tatami tables for 8 (Tabelog). Half portions available, useful for solo diners (April 2025). 5 min from Imadegawa-Omiya and Imadegawa-Jofukuji bus stops (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishijin, near Imadegawa-Omiya — 5 min from Imadegawa-Omiya bus stop
places.cuisine: Seasonal Japanese cooking, omakase course or à la carte (2022–2026 reviews) · a ¥6,000 omakase of nine dishes on seasonal vegetables and fish; sea-bream dashi, young sweetfish, firefly squid, asari and aosa nyumen (April 2025) · obanzai small dishes at ¥500 (December 2023) · persimmon shira-ae with sour cream, atsuage with yuba ankake, charcoal-grilled mullet gizzard and Lake Biwa honmoroko, milt tempura, five-piece omakase nigiri with clam dashi (December 2023) · sakura-masu tartare, sashimi, sea urchin and botan-shrimp nigiri, firefly squid and tara-no-me tempura, braised veal tongue, Handa noodles with asari (May 2025) · water eggplant, sesame salad (May 2025) · about ten sakes, mostly from Kansai, including Saku (2023–2025)
places.notes: [Seasonal Japanese · Nishijin, a couple’s counter] A cosy counter-and-tatami room near Imadegawa-Omiya, between izakaya and formal kappo, run by the chef and the chef’s wife. Take the ¥6,000 nine-dish omakase or order à la carte — generous ¥500 obanzai, charcoal-grilled river fish, seasonal tempura, nigiri — with about ten Kansai sakes. Half portions make it easy alone. No credit cards (e-money OK).

roles: Chef (unnamed) and the chef’s wife, who run it as a couple
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the chef cooking with the chef’s wife serving: the chef and the chef’s wife “were attentive and thoughtful” (December 2023); “the owner’s wife kindly took our coats and served us warm tea” (March 2024); “it seems that now the husband and wife are running the place together” (February 2026). In November 2022 a reviewer saw the chef alone in the kitchen with one service staff member.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal omakase and à la carte; obanzai; charcoal-grilled fish.

anecdotes.text: On a fully booked November 2022 night, two à la carte guests felt the chef balanced the à la carte orders with the course guests’ without pushing the pair to the back of the line.
A December 2023 diner ordered one serving of nigiri and the companion was given an extra bowl of the clam dashi free.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 旬菜 咲や、日本料理、上京区元北小路町176、今出川大宮・今出川浄福寺バス停から徒歩5分、火〜日 18:00〜22:00、月曜定休、予約可、カード不可、電子マネー可、19席 (カウンター11、座敷テーブル2卓8席)。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営む、6,000円9品のおまかせ、500円のおばんざい、柿の白和えにサワークリーム、ぼらの砂肝やホンモロコの炭火焼き、白子の天ぷら、蛤の出汁と握り、あさりとあおさのにゅうめん、関西の日本酒10種ほど、半量の注文も可。

cultural_comfort.note: No English menu listed; à la carte from the day’s list; a warm couple-run counter.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sea-bream broth, grilled sea bream and chashu (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00; Sun 11:00–16:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). No bookings (Tabelog). Counter seats; non-smoking; cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). Often busy with overseas visitors (2025 reviews). On Shinbashi-dori east of Yamato-oji, just west of the crossing near Chion-in (Tabelog; July 2026).
places.neighborhood: Shinbashi-dori, Gion — 6 min from Sanjo-Keihan Stn
places.cuisine: Ramen on a clear or white sea-bream broth, with a slice of sea bream grilled to order, thin negi and rare chashu; noodles made in-house; shio ramen ¥1,400 (July 2026); yuzu ramen; sea-bream rice to finish, or as ochazuke with the leftover broth; the "Nishiki gozen" set (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Ramen · Gion Shinbashi] A stylish counter that looks more like a Japanese restaurant, serving light, clear sea-bream-broth ramen topped with sea bream grilled to order — about ¥1,400 — and sea-bream rice you can finish as ochazuke. Open to 23:00 Tue–Sat; closed Monday.

roles: Operator unnamed in the sources; one person managing everything per a May 2026 reviewer
chef_bio.background: Opened 21 August 2018 (Tabelog). A November 2026 regular of nineteen visits calls it "the best in Kyoto"; a June 2026 reviewer notes the noodles are all handmade in the shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Sea-bream broth ramen; sea-bream rice.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 regular found the small shop crowded with foreign tourists who "tend to linger and chat" after eating, slowing turnover — "It's not a café, after all."
A July 2025 diner found the sea-bream flavour present but the broth relying on seasoning rather than "the delicate essence of natural ingredients".
A May 2026 regular docked a star because the restroom soap was not refilled — understandable "with just one person managing everything".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: らーめん錦、ラーメン・日本料理、東山区新橋通大和大路通東入2橋本町416、三条京阪駅から439m、火〜土 11:00〜15:00・18:00〜23:00、日 11:00〜16:00、月曜休み、予約不可、カウンター、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2018年8月21日オープン。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年11月、英語): 鯛出汁の清湯と白湯のラーメン、注文ごとに焼く鯛、レアチャーシュー、自家製麺、塩ラーメン1,400円、柚子ラーメン、鯛めし、残ったスープでお茶漬け、錦御膳、海外の客が多い、一人で切り盛り。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in; busy with overseas visitors (2025 reviews).

places.name: 魚屋に毛の生えたようなお店 京都つりや (Kyoto Tsuriya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi with two house soy sauces, simmered fish, tempura and fried dishes; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish izakaya with chicken and game too (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Wed–Sun 17:30–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Monday, and Tuesday "for fishing trips" (Tabelog). Bookings taken, also on Tabelog; seating type not guaranteed; two-hour limit (Tabelog; May 2026). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original: "サービス料、チャージなしで突き出しあり" (no service or cover charge, a starter is served). Smoking allowed; no children; 16 seats (6 counter, 10 table) plus the 2nd floor for up to 13; cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). Down an alley in 三条食彩ろぉじ off Sanjo, near Sakaimachi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo near Sakaimachi, in an alley — 6 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Fish izakaya of the owner's own catches and market fish, à la carte only: thick-cut sashimi served with two chosen soy sauces (or sesame oil and salt), simmered fish, braised yellowtail with daikon as the free starter, octopus, kanpachi, grilled sawara, squid with the tentacles as tempura, oysters, cold noodles and rice dishes; chicken and game too; a blackboard says anything can be prepared (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · sake such as Isojiman, wine and cocktails
places.notes: [Fish izakaya · Sanjo, in an alley] A self-styled "fishmonger with a little extra" run by a keen angler, closed Tuesdays for fishing trips: thick-cut sashimi in huge portions, simmered fish and a generous free starter, with no service or cover charge. About ¥4,000–6,000; cramped but fun. Smoking allowed; no children. Closed Mon–Tue.

roles: Owner (unnamed; a fishing enthusiast per an August 2026 reviewer)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator: fresh-caught fish served as sashimi with two selected soy sauces; closed on Tuesdays for fishing trips. An August 2026 reviewer found the shop full of fishing information.
chef_bio.specialty: Thick-cut sashimi.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner found the sashimi generous but "not particularly exceptional; it was just average".
A September 2026 couple were surprised there was no service or cover charge — and that the free starter was a large simmered fish.
An October 2026 guest ordered octopus sashimi and asked, "How many servings is this?"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 魚屋に毛の生えたようなお店 京都つりや、海鮮・牡蠣・居酒屋、中京区道祐町135-1 三条食彩ろぉじ ほとけのざの舗、烏丸御池駅・烏丸駅から徒歩6分、水〜日 17:30〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00)、月・火休み (火曜は釣りのため)、2時間制、サービス料、チャージなしで突き出しあり、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、2階は13名まで、喫煙可、子供不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、釣りたての刺身を2種の醤油で。口コミ (2026年4〜10月、英語): 厚切りの刺身、ぶり大根の突き出し、ごま油と塩、蛸、カンパチ、鰆の焼き物、ゲソの天ぷら、アラカルトのみ、黒板に何でも作れます、店主は釣り好き、席は狭め。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; two-hour limit; smoking allowed; adults only.

places.cuisine: Classical French pâtisserie: strawberry shortcake, iced lemon cake (the specialty), gâteau melon, a Japanese-citrus tart, caramel éclair, cream puffs, salted sablés, "piglet" lemon cookies in a gift tin (2026 reviews) · seasonal glass desserts — cherry blossom and Kyoto strawberry ¥2,750 (April 2026), melon with mint meringue (May 2026) (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Patisserie · Shimogamo Shrine] A classical pâtisserie by Shimogamo Shrine whose glazed lemon cake sells out at weekends; seasonal glass parfaits (cherry blossom, melon) draw queues on release. Cakes from under ¥1,000; parfaits about ¥2,750. Gift tins of cookies. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Masaya Kato (romaji, per a May 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 30 August 2018 (Tabelog). A May 2026 reviewer writes that it is run by Masaya Kato, formerly of the noted pâtisserie "Au Grenier d'Or".
chef_bio.specialty: Lemon cake; seasonal glass desserts.

anecdotes.text: A repeat buyer in April 2026 always ends up getting a shortcake for themself when buying a gift.
On a weekday in April 2026 only about four cakes were left in the case — baked goods are the main focus.
A May 2026 visitor came on the release day of the melon glass dessert after seeing it on Instagram.

cultural_comfort.note: Go early at weekends for the lemon cake.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork cutlets and katsudon (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–20:30 (last order 20:00); closed Tuesday, holidays, and the 2nd and 4th Wednesdays (open when a holiday) (Tabelog). No bookings; queues at busy times, menus handed out while waiting (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). No cards or e-money; PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). 35 seats: 4 at the counter, three tables, a tatami room upstairs; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). In a quiet street of machiya about 15 min west of Kyoto Station, 5 min from the Omiya-Shichijo bus stop, near To-ji (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: West of Kyoto Station near To-ji — Omiya-Shichijo bus stop
places.cuisine: Old-style tonkatsu and yoshoku with a house demi-glace: loin tonkatsu 180 g, fillet 100 g set, katsudon of Yonezawa pork (large ¥1,510), the signature tonkatsu rice set; Kyoto-style miso soup with sansho, potato salad (2026 reviews) · Michelin Bib Gourmand, Kyoto-Osaka 2021 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Tonkatsu · west of Kyoto Station] A long-established neighbourhood tonkatsu house in a quiet machiya street, Bib Gourmand in 2021: crisp-yet-soft cutlets drowned in a house demi-glace, katsudon, and a Kyoto miso soup with sansho. About ¥1,500–2,500; queues common, often many overseas visitors. No cards (QR pay ok). Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening date as 18 November 1949; a November 2026 reviewer writes it was founded in 1960. Tabelog's remark names a sister, "Tonkatsu Ichiban 2deux" in Awaza, Osaka. Bib Gourmand in the Michelin Guide Kyoto-Osaka + Okayama 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Tonkatsu with demi-glace.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner waiting outside found that everyone in the queue but one person was from overseas.
A September 2026 visitor found the food decent but the price and service speed off-putting, and wished water were left on the table.
An August 2026 diner likened it to a home-cooked meal from a skilled mother, "no offense to the professionals".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): とんかつ一番、とんかつ・洋食・居酒屋、下京区黒門通木津屋橋上る徹宝町403、京都駅から徒歩約15分、市バス大宮七条から徒歩約5分、11:30〜14:00・17:00〜20:30 (L.O. 20:00)、火曜・祝日休み、第2・4水曜休み (祝日は営業)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可・QR 可、35席 (カウンター4、テーブル3、2階座敷)、子供可、テイクアウト、開業1949年11月18日、大阪・阿波座のとんかつ一番 2deux、ミシュランガイド京都・大阪+岡山2021 ビブグルマン。口コミ (2026年4〜11月、英語): ロースかつ180g、ヒレ100gの定食、米沢豚のかつ丼大1,510円、デミグラスソース、山椒の京風味噌汁、ポテトサラダ、1960年創業との記述、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue; no cards (QR pay ok); many overseas visitors (2026 reviews).

places.name: Cafe & Dining Amber Court (Hotel Nikko Princess Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The restaurant checks allergies and dislikes and swapped an ingredient for one guest (January 2026); menus lean on bread, pasta, curry and cakes (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A salad bar at breakfast, but most dishes have meat, fish, dairy or egg (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily: breakfast 7:00–11:00 (buffet), lunch 11:00–14:30, café in the afternoon, dinner 17:00–21:30 (last order 21:00; courses 20:30) (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Prices include a 15% service charge and tax (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「料金はサービス料15％・税金が含まれた価格となります。」). Free hotel membership gives 10% off (October 2026). 88 seats; non-smoking, smoking area in the building; parking; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Ground floor of Hotel Nikko Princess Kyoto, east of Karasuma on Takatsuji; 3 min from Shijo Stn exit 5 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma Takatsuji, in Hotel Nikko Princess — 3 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: The hotel’s café-restaurant: French dishes of seasonal ingredients at dinner, casual lunches and afternoon tea (Tabelog, shop text) · breakfast buffet with a live omelette station, the signature Princess beef curry, doughnuts, breads, cheese and ham, a salad bar (May–August 2026) · lunch of appetizer, pasta (three choices), breads including a small melon bread, mini dessert and coffee ¥2,500 (July 2026); casual lunch course with a drink ¥3,200 via Ikkyu, grilled sirloin +¥500 (January 2026); bistro lunch with a toast (September 2026) · afternoon tea, priced below most hotel teas (July 2026) · Princess Dinner with choices from appetizer to main (October 2026) · cakes from the entrance showcase (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Hotel café · Karasuma Takatsuji, breakfast to dinner] The bright ground-floor café-restaurant of Hotel Nikko Princess Kyoto, open from a 7 a.m. buffet (try the Princess beef curry) through good-value lunches — a pasta set with a basket of breads for ¥2,500 — to afternoon tea and French dinners. Prices include the 15% service charge. One September 2026 diner found the café drinks weak. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): the café-restaurant of Hotel Nikko Princess Kyoto, where the chef prepares seasonal French dishes, with breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea and dinner. Reviewers single out the breakfast curry (May and August 2026) and the attentive hotel service (July and September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Breakfast buffet and Princess beef curry; afternoon tea.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner liked the cake but found the café au lait and iced tea weak and the glasses thick, "resembling those used in izakayas".
An April 2026 regular arrived at 16:00 to find the seasonal cakes sold out; a group of six tourists from abroad was the only other party.
A January 2026 anniversary lunch guest who dislikes fish had the appetizer changed after the staff asked about allergies and dislikes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (princess-kyoto.co.jp): ホテル日航プリンセス京都のカフェ&ダイニング アンバーコート。食べログ: ヨーロッパ料理・カフェ、下京区烏丸高辻東入高橋町630 ホテル日航プリンセス京都 1F、四条駅5番出口から徒歩約3分、毎日 朝 7:00〜11:00・昼 11:00〜14:30・夜 17:00〜21:30 (L.O. 21:00、コース20:30)、年中無休、予約可、料金はサービス料15%と税込み、88席、禁煙 (館内に喫煙所)、駐車場あり、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、季節の食材のフレンチ、アフタヌーンティー。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年10月、英語): 朝食ビュッフェ (オムレツ、Princess beef curry)、パスタのランチ2,500円、一休のランチ3,200円、メロンパン、会員10%引き、カフェオレが薄いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; book lunch or tea ahead; prices include 15% service; all cards and QR.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Staff checked a guest’s allergies and dislikes before a lunch course and substituted the appetizer for a guest who dislikes fish (January 2026 review).
