places.neighborhood: Kitashirakawa, Shirakawa-dori — by the Kyoto University of the Arts bus stop
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood pâtisserie of over 20 years (April 2025) · signature "Equivalence" chocolate mousse with hazelnuts ¥700 (April 2025), ¥780 (May 2026) · shortcake and Shine Muscat tart ¥750 each (November 2025); seasonal peach shortcake, fig, pear-and-pistachio and kumquat tarts; mille-feuille, marjolaine, cream puffs (2025–26 reviews) · coconut-pineapple cream pudding ¥680, mango pudding ¥600 (April 2025, August 2026) · canelé ¥350, lemon cake and baked goods; coffee ¥450 (May–July 2026) · Christmas noël cakes (December 2025)
places.notes: [Pâtisserie · Kitashirakawa, the chocolate mousse named after the shop] A small, smart cake shop on Shirakawa-dori opposite the art university, baking for the neighbourhood for over 20 years. Try the namesake chocolate-hazelnut mousse (¥780) or a seasonal fruit tart, and eat at the counter or on the terrace with coffee. Gently sweet, classic cakes; one diner found the cream-puff shell hard. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: An April 2025 reviewer says the shop has been in business for over 20 years; reviewers describe classic, gently sweet cakes and attentive service (2025–26 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Equivalence chocolate mousse; fruit tarts.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner loved the namesake mousse and fig tart but found the cream-puff shell a bit hard.
A May 2026 diner expected tiramisu from the shop’s name cake and found a chocolate mousse, not too sweet.
A June 2026 diner came because another cake shop was sold out and was glad to be able to eat in.

places.name: 京都 かつ田 かつざんまい (Kyoto Katsuda Katsuzanmai)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breaded cutlets of pork, chicken, beef, seafood, vegetables and egg, fried in shared oil, with curry (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: vegetable cutlets share the fryer with meat and seafood (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:45) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:45); Sat–Sun 11:30–22:00 (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); queues at peak times (July 2026). 17 counter seats; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; cards and IC cards, no QR (Tabelog). 2 min from Shijo and Karasuma Stns (Tabelog). Opened 3 June 2022 (Tabelog); recently renovated (February 2026).
places.neighborhood: Shijo Karasuma — 2 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Katsu sets fried in front of you and served one piece at a time on a rack, tempura-style (2024–26 reviews) · set B ¥1,970 — 60 g pork and 60 g chicken-cheese katsu, fried eggplant and baby corn, a boiled-egg cutlet, curry soup (August 2026) · set C with tonkatsu, seafood cutlet, vegetables and a premium egg, with curry (July 2025, October 2026) · Wagyu Katsuzanmai with beef cutlet, shiitake, eggplant, chicken and pork cutlets ¥3,500 (November 2026) · branded pork from Kagoshima; lunch sets from ¥1,900 (January 2025) · eat with salt, wasabi or sauce; katsu curry (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Tonkatsu · Shijo Karasuma, katsu one piece at a time] A 17-seat counter by Shijo Station that fries pork, chicken, beef, vegetable and egg cutlets to order and serves them one by one, tempura-style, with curry on the side. Sets run about ¥1,900–3,500. Busy with visitors; no bookings, so expect a queue at dinner. Reviews are mixed on value and service. Open daily, all day at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Opened 3 June 2022 (Tabelog), one of three かつ田 tonkatsu shops on Tabelog in central Kyoto. An August 2026 reviewer heard it began as a tonkatsu and curry restaurant; a February 2026 diner saw celebration flowers after a renovation.
chef_bio.specialty: Katsuzanmai sets served piece by piece.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 diner felt the staff were polite to foreign customers but treated Japanese customers with disdain, acting only when prompted.
A December 2024 diner found the format interesting but the katsu clearly below high-end shops and somewhat geared to tourists.
A November 2026 diner loved the Wagyu Katsuzanmai with salt and wasabi but found ¥3,500 a bit steep.
A February 2026 diner was the only local customer among many visitors from abroad.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led izakaya; even the starter tofu and the omelette use dashi (2026 reviews).

Reservations accepted; seat requests may not be met; bookings more than 20 minutes late are cancelled; no-shows for courses charged 100%; 2-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). Table charge ¥418 with a seasonal small plate (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「380円（税抜）※418円（税込）季節の小皿付き」). 20 seats: 10 at the counter, 10 at tables (Tabelog). Cards and QR, no e-money (Tabelog). In the Ayanokoji Square building in an alley off Shijo Karasuma; 2 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 June 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo Karasuma — 2 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Retro-modern izakaya of market-fresh seasonal fish by a chef from a hotel background, with sake chosen by a sake sommelier, whisky and gin from 15:00 (Tabelog, shop text; October 2026) · sashimi platter ¥1,980 — e.g. Tsushima Densuke anago, Ise hata, meichi-dai, Akashi sawara, Biwa masu (September 2026) · rare-fried seasonal fish cutlets, fried shrimp with sansho ¥913, dashi-poured tamagoyaki ¥858, Miyazaki A4 beef steak ¥3,168 (Tabelog; September 2026) · fig, prosciutto and mascarpone; duck and white-leek spring rolls; grilled chicken neck with black shichimi; firefly squid, shirako, seasonal vegetable tempura (2026 reviews) · Sapporo Black Label draft ¥682, Houou Biden sake ¥990 a glass, the Kinohachi highball (September–October 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya & sake bar · Shijo Karasuma, fresh fish from 3 p.m.] A retro-modern counter in an alley off Shijo Karasuma, opened in 2025 by a former hotel chef: a five-fish sashimi platter (¥1,980), rare-fried fish cutlets, figs with prosciutto and mascarpone, and a deep list of sake, whisky and gin picked by the manager. Friendly to solo drinkers. ¥418 table charge; small plates and prices on the high side. Daily from 15:00.

roles: Chef from a hotel background; manager and sake sommelier (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a hideaway near Shijo Karasuma with a retro-modern room by a chef from a hotel background, and sake chosen by a sake sommelier and bartender; opened 25 June 2025. A sister shop, KINOHACHI 京都駅前, is on Tabelog. Reviewers praise the friendly manager and staff (April–May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal sashimi; rare-fried fish cutlets.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner found the dishes creative and good but the portions small for the price — meant for one, not for sharing.
An April 2026 diner liked the day’s fish but found the vegetable tempura a little oily and the prices high.
An April 2026 diner said the chef "might be a genius".

places.notes: [Spanish bar · Kawabata by the Kamo, open from noon] A Spanish bar on Kawabata-dori by the Kamo, with a counter upstairs and a big basement of sofas, serving terrines, tapas, ajillo, paella and steak with sherry, cider and Spanish wine — plus a coin-operated self-pour wine machine. Lunch sets around ¥1,600, a ¥3,800 lunch course with rice-flour Basque cheesecake, open straight through to 11 pm. Some find dishes salty and prices a bit high. Orders by smartphone. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Spanish bar for afternoon drinking with colourful dishes, Spanish wines, a ground-floor counter and a basement for dates and groups. Reviewers in 2022–2026 describe accommodating staff, a wide sherry list, and smartphone ordering.
chef_bio.specialty: Terrines; rice-flour Basque cheesecake; sherry.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 conference-goer, caught in pouring rain before the last Shinkansen, was grateful to find it open at 4 pm and settled in with cider, cava and paella.
"Be aware that if your smartphone signal is weak, you might have trouble placing orders." — August 2026.
"The lamb was cut into bite-sized pieces, and while some were delicious, others were overly salty and tough due to the fat." — February 2026.

No cards or QR; e-money accepted (Tabelog). 18 seats: a 10-seat counter and two raised tables for four; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Spend ¥1,000 for a ¥100 coin-parking ticket (Tabelog). Just east of the Gojo Ohashi bridge; 4 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Keihan) (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Local udon and oden shop, founded in 1975 as a food stall where drinkers from Gion finished the night, at this site since 1994, named after the warrior-monk Benkei of Gojo bridge legend (October 2026 review) · Benkei udon ¥1,200 with spicy burdock kinpira on the side (June, October 2026) · curry udon, meat curry udon, beef curry udon; sweet kitsune udon; tempura udon; chicken soba; kayaku udon ¥780 (2026 reviews) · sets with white rice, kayaku rice or inari; onigiri (2026 reviews) · Kyoto-style oden, e.g. daikon and egg ¥180 each; large bottled beer ¥650 (October 2026) · about ¥800–2,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Udon · Gojo Ohashi, late-night bowls since 1975] An old-fashioned counter udon shop at the east end of Gojo bridge, open until 11 pm, where Kyoto has finished its drinking nights since the 1970s: the house Benkei udon (¥1,200) comes with fiercely spicy burdock kinpira on the side, plus a good curry udon, sweet kitsune and Kyoto-style oden for ¥180 a piece. Locals and many visitors from abroad fill it late. Smoking allowed. No cards. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: An October 2026 reviewer: founded in 1975 as a food stall where people ended a night of drinking in Gion, moved to this site in 1994, named after Musashibō Benkei of the Gojo bridge legend, with two shops — this Higashiyama branch and the main shop in Nishikyogoku. A September 2026 reviewer praised the efficient owner.
chef_bio.specialty: Benkei udon with spicy kinpira; curry udon.

anecdotes.text: "Loved by Kyoto locals for over 50 years!" — an October 2026 visitor who had the namesake Benkei udon with oden on a business-trip night.
"It's spicy—really spicy! But apparently, it becomes addictive!" — June 2026, on the burdock kinpira.
An August 2026 local, in at 10:30 pm after an Obon drinking party, found about ten foreign tourists inside and felt a little out of place.
"The owner is wonderful and works efficiently, a great place!" — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter udon shop; smoking allowed; no cards (e-money OK); open late.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a cheesecake café — cheesecakes, quiche, pizza and dairy-rich lunch dishes (2026 reviews).

places.notes: [Cheesecake café · Imadegawa by Doshisha, a campus classic] A long-running American-style café beside Doshisha University and Shokoku-ji, famous for its New York cheesecake — plus pistachio and honey-lemon versions, pies and a summer cheesecake kakigori — with quiche, pizza and curry at lunch. chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a long-established café next to Doshisha University, famous for cheesecake, with polite, friendly staff and steady takeaway trade; our crawls hold a second shop, パパジョンズ 六角店.
chef_bio.specialty: New York cheesecake.

anecdotes.text: "This place has been next to the university for a long time, so if you come at the wrong time, you'll find a lot of students." — July 2026, noting prices creeping up.
A July 2026 regular, usually loyal to the cheesecakes, tried the summer-only cheesecake kakigori with a yogurt-like sauce.
"It had a moist texture and was made with sour cream, giving it a mild and not overly rich taste." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ケーキ・カフェ・ピザ、上京区烏丸上立売東入ル相国寺門前町642-4 コーポマルス1F、今出川駅から徒歩3分、10:00〜19:00 (料理L.O.18:00)、火曜休み (備考)、予約可、20席、分煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、テイクアウト、子ども可。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): Doshisha University の隣、Shokoku-ji の東門の前、昔からのアメリカンカフェ、ニューヨークチーズケーキが一番人気、ピスタチオ、ハニーレモン、季節のチーズケーキ、チーズケーキのかき氷、パンプキンパイ730円、キッシュのプレート (サラダ・スープ付き)、ピザ、カレー、スコーン、学生が多い時間も、値段が少しずつ上がった。

cultural_comfort.note: Order cakes to eat in or take away; cards, e-money and QR.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki courses with dashi, soy-based sauces and hamo dishes; no gluten information (2026 reviews).

places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday to Sunday 12:00–15:00 (last entry 13:30) and 17:30–22:30 (last entry 20:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; guests coming from overseas are asked to book (online or by phone) after arriving in Japan; seating type cannot always be chosen (Tabelog). A private-room charge of 15% for two guests and 10% for three or more (Tabelog original 個室料＜2名様15%＞、＜3名様以上10％＞頂戴いたします). Courses: lunch from ¥5,000; dinner of 10 dishes from ¥6,000, monthly course ¥8,000 (July–September 2026). Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). On Marutamachi-dori east of Ogawa, near the Imperial Palace; 5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn exit 4 (Tabelog). Opened July 2001 (July 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Marutamachi east of Ogawa, near the Imperial Palace — 5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki of seasonal courses, on the site of Fujiwara no Yorimichi's former Koyo-in, for over 20 years (Tabelog) · lunch-only course ¥5,000 — umeshu aperitif, hamo and shinjo soup, sea bream, tuna and hamo sashimi (July 2026) · evening course of 10 dishes from ¥6,000; "Yuki" and "Roku" courses; monthly course ¥8,000 (July–September 2026) · hamo in many forms in summer, hamo shabu-shabu; suppon hot pot at year's end (2026 reviews) · mugwort ice cream and sorbets (August–September 2026) · a wide list of rare sake (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Marutamachi by the Imperial Palace, Kyoto cuisine at fair prices] A Kyoto-cuisine house on Marutamachi-dori since 2001, where chef Kenji Kaji — trained at an old Kyoto ryotei and head chef for 15 years at a Takagamine ryotei — serves seasonal courses from ¥5,000 at lunch and ¥6,000–8,000 at dinner, rich in hamo in summer, with rare sake. Counter or courtyard private rooms (10–15% room charge). The chef even waves children goodbye. Guests from overseas are asked to book after arriving in Japan. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: chef Kenji Kaji trained at a long-established Kyoto ryotei and was head chef for 15 years at a ryotei in Takagamine; the restaurant stands on the site of the Koyo-in, the residence of Fujiwara no Yorimichi, founder of Byodo-in, and has served Kyoto cuisine for over 20 years; Tabelog presents the cooking as by craftsmen selected as "Modern Master Craftsmen". A July 2026 reviewer gives the opening as July 2001 and mentions an OAD 2026 listing.
chef_bio.philosophy: Sharing the beauty of Japanese cuisine through seasonal courses (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki; hamo.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family found the master chef especially kind to the children — serving the children a kaiseki too and coming outside to wave goodbye.
An August 2026 diner on the Roku course found the online menu's appetiser missing and a slightly off sea urchin, but called it great value overall.
A July 2026 diner noted the evening course of 10 dishes starts at ¥6,000, tax included.

cultural_comfort.note: The shop asks guests coming from overseas to book (online or by phone) only after arriving in Japan; private rooms carry a 10–15% charge; cards and QR.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the draws are fruit sandwiches and egg sandwiches on bread, toast and cream puffs (2026 reviews).

A July 2026 diner found the door sign saying 1 pm, but the staff said it opens at noon and the sign was out of date. No reservations; waiting outside in the residential alley is discouraged (September 2026). 7 seats: 3 at the counter and two tables for two, with more seats upstairs in an attic room (2026 reviews). places.neighborhood: A residential alley just north of Keihan Sanjo Stn — 180 m from the station
places.cuisine: A tiny, dim coffee house of fruit sandwiches and hand-brewed coffee · seasonal fruit sandwich ¥1,450–1,650 — Yamagata peach with Earl Grey cream, fig with caramel cream, Nagano Purple grapes and pear, chestnut in October (2026 reviews) · egg sandwich, butter toast, fig toast, rum cream puff (2026 reviews) · house blend, iced coffee ¥850, café au lait, decaf; cold brew to take home (2026 reviews) · bread from the bakery "Kurs" (September 2026)
places.notes: [Coffee house · Sanjo-Keihan back alley, fruit sandos] A seven-seat coffee house hidden in a residential alley behind Keihan Sanjo, lit by candles and jazz records, with an attic room upstairs. People come for the seasonal fruit sandwich — Yamagata peach with Earl Grey cream, figs with caramel, grapes and pear — and a chocolatey medium-roast blend; decaf too. A September 2026 diner praised the chic female staff. No queuing outside — neighbours live opposite. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 22 February 2025 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a small, dimly lit wooden room in a residential alley north of Keihan Sanjo Station, jazz records, candles on the tables, an attic room upstairs, gentle staff, and seasonal fruit sandwiches on bread from a bakery called Kurs.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fruit sandwich; house blend.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular thought the bread was dry once, then learned it came from a different bakery for that period: "When it’s from Kurs, the bread makes all the difference!"
The staff warned a July 2026 diner that the peaches were big and might be hard to eat — "honestly, having something that’s both delicious and generous in size is just wonderful."
"The stylish lighting and the soothing jazz created a wonderful atmosphere, complemented by the chic female staff." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: LOB COFFEE HOUSE、喫茶店、左京区大菊町134-8、三条京阪駅から180m、月火 9:00〜20:30、金土日 12:00〜20:30、水木休み、予約不可、7席 (カウンター3、2名テーブル2)、禁煙、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2025年2月22日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 季節のフルーツサンド1,450〜1,650円 (山形の桃とアールグレイのクリーム、無花果とキャラメルのクリーム、ナガノパープルと梨、10月は栗)、たまごサンド、バタートースト、無花果のトースト、ラム酒のシュークリーム、ブレンド、アイスコーヒー850円、カフェオレ、デカフェ、持ち帰りの水出しコーヒー、パンは Kurs のもの、薄暗くジャズのレコードとキャンドル、屋根裏のような2階席、外で待つのは控えて、扉の表示は13時だが実際は12時開店、おしゃれな女性スタッフ。

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura kaiseki of wheat-batter tempura and a tendon to finish (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of shrimp, fish, crab, wagyu and soft-shell turtle tempura, with dashi soups (official site).

Children only if they eat the full adult course — no children’s menu, half portions, baby food or high chairs; others are refused on the day (Tabelog). 10 counter seats of zelkova; hinoki lockers for each guest (official site; July 2026); non-smoking; English menu; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Opened 12 January 2024 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Tempura kaiseki of ingredients named by origin, fried piece by piece at the counter (official site) · dinner courses ¥19,800 (Higashiyama) and ¥24,200 (Yasaka); pre-booked ¥36,300 (Gion) and ¥44,000 (Tantora); weekend lunches ¥12,100 (Nene), ¥15,400 (Gion), ¥22,000 — plus 10% service (official site) · earlier: lunch Yasaka ¥9,680 (January 2026), July Gion Matsuri course ¥16,830 (July 2026) · seen: Kumamoto shrimp, aged Awaji sawara, karasumi daikon, Higo red eggplant, Fujikuro ginkgo, wagyu fillet in shiso, soft-shell turtle fry, Beni Haruka sweet potato with Yamazaki whisky, sea-urchin tempura at market price, mackerel sushi, anago tendon, basil sorbet (official site; 2026 reviews) · crab kaiseki in season (official site)
places.notes: [Tempura kaiseki · Kodaiji, a ten-seat zelkova counter] Two minutes from Kodaiji Temple, a ten-seat counter where each ingredient is introduced by its origin and fried in front of you: Kumamoto shrimp, aged sawara, Fujikuro ginkgo, and a sweet potato finished with Yamazaki whisky, ending with an anago tendon. Dinner from ¥19,800, weekend lunch from ¥12,100, plus 10%. One diner warned the sea-urchin tempura is market-priced. No young children. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: A chef with long training (official site); not named. Run by G LION (official site links to glion.co.jp)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a tempura kaiseki house two minutes from Kodaiji, the temple of Nene, closing a visit with food; cooked by a chef after long training, looking again at the essence of Kyoto without being bound by form; hinoki lockers for each guest; private hire plans. The site’s recruitment and footer links go to G LION. Opened 12 January 2024 (Tabelog). A January 2026 regular on a fifth visit heard the chef had changed but found the taste unchanged.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「形式にとらわれすぎることなく、京都の本質を見つめ直した、至極の天ぷら会席」 — tempura kaiseki that looks again at Kyoto’s essence without being bound by form.
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura kaiseki; whisky-finished sweet potato.

anecdotes.text: A fifth-time regular heard in January 2026 that the chef had changed, but found the food as good as ever.
"Since the sea urchin tempura is priced at market value, it might be wise to prepare for the cost before ordering." — March 2026.
A July 2026 diner says only four reservations are taken a day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kodaiji-tantora.com): 高台寺 丹虎 (Kodaiji Tantora)、ねねの寺の高台寺から徒歩二分、参拝後の余韻を料理で結ぶ天ぷら会席、長年の修業を経た料理人、形式にとらわれすぎることなく京都の本質を見つめ直した至極の天ぷら会席、夕食: 天ぷら会席 東山19,800円、おまかせ天ぷら会席 八坂24,200円、事前予約限定 祇園36,300円、特別天ぷら会席 丹虎44,000円、土日祝の昼: ねね12,100円、祇園15,400円、丹虎の特別天ぷらランチ22,000円、別途サービス料10%、熊本の才巻海老、京都の唐墨大根、すっぽんフライ、黒毛和牛ヒレ大葉巻、藤九郎銀杏、丹波篠山の無農薬こしひかり、天丼、蟹会席、一人ずつの檜のロッカー、貸切プラン、昼12:00〜15:00 (13時最終入店) 土日祝のみ、夜17:00〜22:30 (19時最終入店)、火曜・水曜休み、年末年始の特別営業、7月の祇園祭コース、採用は G LION。食べログ: 天ぷら・日本料理、東山区高台寺北門前通鷲尾町503-6、サービス料10%、子供は大人と同じコースを食べられる場合のみ (子供メニュー・ハーフ・離乳食・ハイチェアなし、条件に合わない場合は当日入店不可)、カウンター10席、禁煙、英語メニュー、カード可、2024年1月12日オープン。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年7月、英語): 料理人が替わったが味は変わらない、昼の八坂9,680円 (2026年1月)、祇園祭コース16,830円、熟成の淡路の鰆、肥後の赤茄子、紅はるかと山崎ウイスキー、雲丹の天ぷらは時価、鯖寿司、穴子の天丼、バジルのソルベ、欅のカウンター、1日4組。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); each ingredient explained at the counter; online booking.

places.name: 佳辰 (Kashin)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a dashi-based kaiseki of soups, simmered dishes, grills and sashimi (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki with clear dashi soups, sashimi, hamo and grilled pork (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: Mon–Sat 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sundays and holidays. Tabelog lists Wed–Sat only; hours may change. Courses booked ahead by phone or through the official booking page; 13 or more by phone (official site; 2026 reviews). 35 seats: a counter of 6, four private rooms and tables; shoes off (official site). Smoking: the official site says there are smoking and non-smoking seats; Tabelog says non-smoking with a smoking area in the garden. Cards, e-money and QR (official site). No service charge listed on Tabelog.
places.neighborhood: South of Kyoto Station, behind Avanti — 296 m from the station
places.cuisine: Family-run Kyoto kaiseki a few minutes from Kyoto Station · courses from ¥6,000–6,600 rising in ¥1,000 steps; ¥8,800 a popular level (2026 reviews) · clear dashi soups, simmered dishes, grills and sashimi with seasonal specials (official site) · seen: hamo appetizer, house Kyoto tofu with fried tofu in white-miso soup, grilled domestic pork (2026 reviews) · a long sake list, including Juyondai one night (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · south of Kyoto Station, a family house] A renovated house behind Avanti, south of Kyoto Station, where a family — the elderly owner couple, their daughter and her husband — cook and serve seasonal kaiseki in private rooms or at a small counter. Courses start around ¥6,000 in ¥1,000 steps, with a long sake list; the daughter, also a chef, speaks fluent English. Good for business dinners; one diner found three hours long. Closed Sunday.

roles: Family-run: the owner couple, their daughter (also a chef) and her husband (December 2025 review); not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a hidden kaiseki house near Kyoto Station where guests take their shoes off, keeping Kyoto food culture with a modern touch, loved by local gourmets for many years. A December 2025 regular describes it as run by a husband and wife, both elderly yet still cooking and serving, with their daughter, a chef who speaks fluent English, and her husband; an October 2026 diner saw the father source ingredients and the daughter cook. A July 2026 diner notes a recent renovation.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: listening to the voice of each ingredient, minding heat, seasoning and the space on the plate; kaiseki built to sit well with sake.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; sake pairing.

anecdotes.text: "Both the husband and wife are quite elderly, yet they are still actively involved in cooking and serving guests. They are truly inspiring." — December 2025.
A July 2025 solo diner found the food excellent but the meal long — about three hours — and grew sleepy.
Booking by phone in April 2026, a diner was asked whether the meal was for a business meeting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyouchisou-kashin.com、多言語): 佳辰、繊細と優雅が香る京都駅至近の隠れ家懐石、靴を脱いで上がる、店主の真心、美味しい日本酒、旬を映す京料理、澄んだ出汁の椀物、煮物、焼き物、刺身、季節の特別メニュー、京都の伝統と現代の感性、長年地元の食通に愛される、素材の声に耳を澄まし火加減や塩梅や盛りの余白に心を配る、日本酒との調和、南区東九条西山王町12、月〜土 18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、日曜・祝日休み、分煙 (喫煙席・禁煙席)、カード・電子マネー・QR可、13名以上は電話予約。食べログ: 日本料理、水〜土 18:00〜22:00、35席 (カウンター6、個室4、テーブル)、禁煙 (庭に喫煙所)、公式サイトから予約。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 家族経営 (年配の夫婦と娘夫婦)、娘も料理人で英語が流暢、コースは6,000〜6,600円から1,000円刻み、8,800円の懐石、鱧の前菜、自家製の京豆腐とお揚げの白味噌汁、国産豚の焼き物、日本酒が豊富 (十四代も)、接待向き、3時間ほどかかる、改装、アバンティの南の路地。

cultural_comfort.note: The daughter, a chef, speaks fluent English (December 2025); multilingual website; courses booked ahead.

places.name: らく山 (Raku Zan)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; a dashi-based seasonal course with fish somen and assorted platters (2022–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish course — sweetfish, conger eel, octopus, fugu milt, funazushi — on dashi (2022–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 20:00); irregular closures. Reservation only; sweetfish may not be available on a given day (August 2026); a summer meal can take about four hours (August 2026). 17 seats: a counter of 9, and an upstairs private room for 8 that is not in use at present. Non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog.
places.neighborhood: Gion, Tominagacho north of Shijo — 215 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Kyoto cooking served as five assorted-platter courses (March 2026) · famous for wild sweetfish the owner catches each morning by tomozuri, and mountain vegetables the owner forages (2025–2026 reviews) · seasons: bamboo shoots in spring, sweetfish in summer, taro in autumn (April 2022) · seen: vinegared hamo, octopus and scallop; fish somen with okra, tororo and sakura shrimp; junsai salad; grilled sweetfish eaten head to tail; New Year beans, taro, pickled sea cucumber, grilled fugu milt, funazushi, roast beef (2022–2026 reviews) · about ¥15,000–20,000 a head (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kyoto cooking · Gion, the owner’s own sweetfish] A nine-seat counter in Gion where the owner goes out at dawn to catch wild sweetfish by tomozuri and forage mountain greens, then cooks them that evening in generous assorted platters — fish somen, junsai, sweetfish grilled to eat whole. A quiet chef who warms up with jokes, and his wife at the front, keep regulars coming 20 years. Reservation only; a summer meal can run four hours. Sweetfish depends on the catch.

roles: Owner-chef, with his wife front of house (2026 reviews); not named
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a Gion restaurant visited for over twenty years (April 2022), whose owner catches wild sweetfish each morning in the upper reaches of Kyoto rivers by tomozuri and forages mountain vegetables, preparing them the same day; a seemingly stern, taciturn chef who opens up with jokes, and a friendly wife who chats with regulars (2023–2026). A March 2026 diner saw the chef cook alone while two women served about eight guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Wild sweetfish caught by the owner; seasonal assorted platters.

anecdotes.text: A regular of over twenty years times visits to bamboo shoots, sweetfish and taro — and learned here that the base of a bamboo shoot holds the real flavour (April 2022).
"At first, the chef is quiet and focused on the food, but as the meal progresses, he starts to share jokes." — April 2023.
An August 2026 guest was told at booking that sweetfish might not be available, and that the meal could take about four hours.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: らく山、日本料理、東山区富永町109-2、祇園四条駅から215m、毎日 18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 20:00)、不定休、完全予約制、17席 (1階カウンター9、2階個室8名は現在使用していない)、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、電子マネー・QR不可、グルメサイトのページ (gorp.jp)。口コミ (2021年7月〜2026年8月、英語): 20年以上通う常連、春は掘りたての筍、夏は鮎、秋は里芋、店主が朝に友釣りで釣る天然鮎と自ら採る山菜、鱧と蛸と帆立の酢の物、魚そうめん (オクラ、とろろ、桜海老)、じゅんさいのサラダ、頭から食べられる焼き鮎、正月の黒豆・里芋・このわた・ふぐの白子焼き・鮒寿司・ローストビーフ、5品の盛り合わせのコース、寡黙だが冗談も言う大将と気さくな女将、2人の女性が給仕、1人1万5千〜2万円ほど、夏は4時間ほどかかる、鮎がない日もある。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; a set seasonal course at the counter; allow plenty of time.

places.name: SHAVA LIVA (シャバ リバ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, bread, toast sets, risotto croquettes and demi-glace sauces; no gluten information is published (official menus).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and a salad bar comes with lunch, but nothing vegan is marked (Tabelog; official menus).
places.hours_raw: Wednesday–Friday: breakfast 9:00–11:00, lunch 11:30–14:00, café 14:00–18:00, dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00). Saturday, Sunday and holidays: lunch 11:30–16:00, café 16:00–18:00, dinner 18:00–22:30 (last order 21:30). Closed Monday and Tuesday; New Year 2026–27 closed 31 December–4 January (Tabelog). No service or cover charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料無し、チャージ料無し」). 72 seats with sofa seating and an outdoor terrace; pets only on the terrace; non-smoking, with a smoking space outside; children welcome; cards, transit IC, iD and QUICPay; bookings via Tabelog (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Ground floor of the FIS Building at the south-west corner of Kawaramachi-Oike, reached by escalator from the Kawaramachi south exit of Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 21 October 2008 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-Oike — 1 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Modern Italian café-lounge from breakfast to bar (official site) · morning sets ¥600–800: hot sandwiches, honey toast, toast with sausage and fried egg (official menu) · lunch ¥1,200 with bread or rice and a salad buffet: weekly lunch, homemade hamburg steak with demi-glace (10 a day), beef Bolognese with balsamic reduction, autumn salmon and mizuna spaghetti in Saikyo-miso cream, shio-koji roast chicken, roast pork loin chasseur; half pasta +¥400, set drink +¥100 (official menu, autumn 2026) · Wednesday 150 g beef ribeye with red-wine sauce ¥1,300 (2026 reviews) · dinner à la carte: cheese, jamón serrano, bagna cauda ¥1,000, caprese with buffalo bocconcini, risotto croquettes (official menu) · party plans with all-you-can-drink from ¥4,500 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Italian · Kawaramachi-Oike, all-day café-lounge] A big, sofa-filled lounge on the corner of Kawaramachi and Oike, straight off the subway escalator, serving from 9:00 breakfast sets to late wine. Lunch is the draw: about ¥1,200 for pasta, hamburg steak or a roast, with bread or rice and a help-yourself salad bar, and a drink for ¥100 more; Wednesdays bring a 150 g ribeye. Dinner is Italian small plates and pasta. Popular — book lunch. Dogs welcome on the terrace. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official concept page: modern Italian from seasonal ingredients, with the head chef’s own methods and homemade sauces, served from morning to bar in a lounge of designer furniture also used for wedding after-parties. Opened 21 October 2008 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to be used "hotel-like" for every scene of the day, as if relaxing in the living room of a friend’s house.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets with the salad buffet; Wednesday ribeye.

anecdotes.text: A family at a May 2026 dinner found the prices so low that the Tokyo-based daughter wondered aloud how the place survives.
A May 2026 guest lunched on the shaded terrace with a dog.
An October 2026 diner arrived at 11:30 opening for the Wednesday ribeye and found it already fully booked.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (shavaliva.com): Cafe & Lounge SHAVA LIVA、京都市役所前、河原町御池交差点南西角下がる FISビル1F、旬の食材のモダンイタリアン、料理長のアイデアの調理法と自家製ソース、ソファ席中心、ウェディング二次会。モーニング600〜800円、ランチ1,200円 (パンorライス・サラダブッフェ付、自家製ハンバーグ1日10食、ボロネーゼ、秋鮭と水菜の西京味噌クリーム、塩麴の鶏ロースト、豚ロースのシャスールソース)、パスタハーフ+400円、セットドリンク+100円、ディナーのアンティパスト (バーニャカウダ1,000円など)。食べログ: イタリアン・居酒屋・カフェ、サービス料・チャージ料なし、72席、テラス席 (ペットはテラスのみ)、子供可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、水〜金 朝9:00〜、土日祝11:30〜22:30、月火定休、2008年10月21日オープン。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 水曜の牛リブロース150g 1,300円、ワイン+100円、満席が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: The official menus give English names for every dish.

places.name: 水田食堂 (Mizuta Shokudo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, kara-age, fried hamo and baguette; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu changes with the day’s ingredients and leans on pork, chicken and seafood; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (last order food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Wednesday and irregularly (Tabelog). Two-hour limit; bookings strongly advised — weekends fill weeks ahead (Tabelog; August–October 2026). No charge listed (Tabelog). 10 counter seats (11 per an October 2026 review); no one under 20 admitted; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB), no QR (Tabelog). 2nd floor of the Tanaka Building, 5 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 30 November 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn — 5 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Western-style izakaya of Italian-based dishes that change with the day’s ingredients (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · signature low-temperature roast pork (chashu) · tandoori chicken kara-age · fig and prosciutto salad · salmon and lemon cream pasta · uni and scallop carbonara · fried hamo with fried maitake · garlic mussels in white wine · tuna and avocado with aioli · homemade sausage when available (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae, one-person Italian-leaning counter] A ten-seat L-shaped wooden counter on a second floor near City Hall, run single-handed by a cook with over 20 years in Italian kitchens — cooking, pouring and billing alone without the pace flagging. The melting roast pork is the must-order; tandoori kara-age, fig and prosciutto salad and creamy pastas follow. Dinner only, adults only (20+), and book ahead: weekends fill up. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-cook, not named; runs the shop alone
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: a chef with over 20 years’ experience cooking fusion dishes that blend Italian and Western food, at a 10-seat counter. Reviewers in August and November 2026 describe the master cooking, serving drinks and billing alone; an October 2026 reviewer gives over 20 years in Italian cooking. Opened 30 November 2022 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: warm hospitality and "ichigo ichie" at a counter where every seat sees the cooking.
chef_bio.specialty: Signature low-temperature roast pork; tandoori chicken kara-age.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 guest with a fig allergy had the fig salad made with white peach instead.
An October 2026 diner learned that the owner, a hard-rock fan, plays Southern All Stars live footage every night because some guests were disappointed when it was switched to other artists.
A September 2026 guest booked a month ahead for a holiday evening and found the counter almost fully reserved.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋風居酒屋 水田食堂、バル・イタリアン・居酒屋、中京区下丸屋町401-10 田中ビル2F、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、京都市役所前駅から95m、17:00〜22:00 (料理L.O. 21:00、ドリンクL.O. 21:30)、水曜・不定休、2時間制、L字カウンター10席、20歳未満入店不可、禁煙、カード可 (VISA・Master・JCB)、2022年11月30日オープン。公式紹介: イタリアンと洋食を融合させた料理、20年以上の経験のシェフ、名物のやわらかいローストポーク。口コミ (2026年5〜11月、英語): マスターが一人で切り盛り、イチジクと生ハムのサラダ、タンドリーチキンの唐揚げ、雲丹と帆立のカルボナーラ、鱧のフライ、イチジクのアレルギーで白桃に替えてくれた。

cultural_comfort.note: One person runs the counter; book ahead.

staff_allergy_handling.text: A guest with a fig allergy had the fig and prosciutto salad made with white peach instead (August 2026).

places.name: 御料理 味舌 (Mashita)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki seasoned with soy and miso, with nama-fu (wheat gluten), a cold udon or soba course and wheat-based sweets; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dashi is made daily from freshly shaved katsuobushi and kombu, and the courses are built on fish (Tabelog official introduction; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:30); dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 19:30); closed Sunday, but open on long weekends (official site; Tabelog). New Year special courses only, 26 December–3 January, with no lunch 26–31 December (official site). Course prices include tax and service (official menu: 税サ込; Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「1Fカウンター席テーブル席、二階個室一律サービス料10%」). Private rooms upstairs ¥3,300 (2–4 guests) or ¥5,500 (5–12) per room. Cancellation 50% from a week before, 100% from 3 days before (official site). About 30 seats: a 9-seat counter and 6 table seats downstairs, two private rooms upstairs; children under 6 are seated in the private rooms (Tabelog). Cards accepted, but the ¥7,500 tenshin lunch is cash only; non-smoking with a smoking area (official site; Tabelog). On the north side of Shijo-dori, the tenth door east of the police box at Shijo-Nawate, about 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site). Opened 9 December 1979 (Tabelog); one Michelin star in the Kyoto–Osaka 2020 guide (official English page).
places.neighborhood: Gion, Shijo-dori — 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Classic Kyoto kaiseki around a dashi made daily from shaved katsuobushi and kombu, with house-made seasonal wagashi (official site; Tabelog) · courses, tax and service included: 寿 about 8 dishes ¥11,000 (lunch only), 雪 about 10 ¥16,000, 月 about 11 ¥22,000, 花 about 12 ¥28,000, omakase at market price; weekday-lunch tenshin of about 7 dishes ¥7,500; children’s courses ¥6,000 and ¥7,500 (official menu) · e.g. conger eel and edamame kuzu dumpling soup, a hassun with grilled nama-fu and Camembert or Tokishirazu salmon, a cold udon or tororo soba mid-course, steamed conger-eel rice, matsutake and hamo chirashi (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion, a Shijo-dori classic since 1979] A kaiseki house tucked a step off the bustle of Shijo-dori in Gion, with a nine-seat counter downstairs and private rooms above. A long-time regular calls it the standard of Kyoto cooking: delicate, umami-deep dashi, seasonal fish, a noodle course midway and house-made sweets. Courses run ¥11,000–28,000 with tax and service included; the weekday ¥7,500 lunch (cash only) is the gentle way in. Michelin one star (2020). Families with small children get a private room. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner and head chef not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: seasonal ingredients carefully chosen, hot dishes served hot and cold ones well chilled, each dish made with heart; seasonal wagashi made in-house. Per Tabelog’s official introduction: the dashi is made every day from freshly shaved katsuobushi and kombu. Opened 9 December 1979 (Tabelog). Listed with one Michelin star in the Kyoto–Osaka 2020 guide (official English page).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: 「温かいものは温かいうちに、冷たいものはうんと冷やして」 — hot things while hot, cold things well chilled.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto kaiseki built on the house dashi; seasonal hassun.

anecdotes.text: A guest returning in August 2026 found that a long-time assistant of the former head chef now leads the kitchen, and judged the essence of the cooking unchanged.
For an early Mother’s Day lunch in May 2026, told in advance, the kitchen tied the soup bowl with red and white mizuhiki.
A January 2026 guest who asked ahead for hon-moroko, though it was early in the season, was told at the counter that the fish had been found.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-mashita.com): 京都 祇園の懐石料理 御料理 味舌、四条通のにぎわいから一歩入った別世界、季節の食材を吟味し温かいものは温かいうちに冷たいものはうんと冷やして、食後の和菓子も手作り。コース (税サ込): 寿 8品あまり11,000円 (昼のみ)、雪16,000円、月22,000円、花28,000円、おまかせ時価、点心 (平日昼のみ) 7,500円は現金のみ、お子様メニュー6,000円・7,500円、2F個室料3,300円・5,500円、キャンセル料1週間前から50%・3日前から100%。席数30席あまり (カウンター9席、テーブル6席、2階個室2室)、12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 13:30)、17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 19:30)、京阪祇園四条駅から東へ約1分、四条縄手北東角交番より東へ10軒目、東山区祇園町北側246。英語ページ: ミシュランガイド京都・大阪2020で一つ星。年末年始は特別コースのみ (12月26日〜1月3日)。食べログ: 日曜定休 (連休は営業)、サービス料10%、6歳未満は個室、カード・交通系IC可、1979年12月9日オープン。

cultural_comfort.note: English pages and an English reservation form on the official site.

places.name: ryu no hige by MITATE (龍のひげ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Fixed courses fusing Kyoto cuisine, French cooking, sushi and fermentation, ending in kamameshi and a dessert buffet; no gluten information is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fixed courses with sushi, fish and optional meat; no vegan course is published (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:30 (last entry 13:30); dinner 18:00–21:30 (last entry 19:30); closed Tuesday and Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). Dinner resumed with the renewal in 2026 (official site). No-shows are charged 100% (Tabelog). 24 seats with a counter, sofa seating and a semi-private room; wheelchair accessible; children welcome at lunch, but under-10s are asked not to come at dinner; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On the 1st floor of Daiwa Roynet Hotel Kyoto Shijo-Karasuma, 213 m from Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Here since 2022; first opened 2004 in Nakagyo (group site).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Karasuma, in Daiwa Roynet Hotel — 213 m from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Story-led courses fusing Kyoto cuisine and French, with sushi and fermentation at dinner (official site) · lunch Story Teller: 6 dishes, kamameshi and a seasonal dessert buffet ¥5,500, ¥7,700 with a meat course · dinner Luxury Story Teller: 6 dishes, sushi and seasonal dessert ¥11,000, ¥14,300 with meat (official site, tax included) · dishes themed on Kyoto landmarks such as Heian Shrine’s torii and To-ji, served from a "travel bag" set on the table (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [French · Shijo-Karasuma, Kyoto-landmark story courses] A playful Kyoto–French course restaurant in a Shijo-Karasuma hotel: lunch opens with a little suitcase on the table holding the cutlery and an itinerary, and bite-sized dishes take you round Kyoto's sights before a clay-pot rice and an all-you-can-eat dessert table. Dinner, back since the 2026 renewal, pairs French dishes with sushi. Lunch ¥5,500–7,700, dinner ¥11,000–14,300. Some find the portions small; most love the show. No under-10s at dinner. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the group site: drawn to cooking by a father who was a cook, worked in another job after school, then trained in Kyoto restaurants in Kyoto cuisine, kaiseki and kappo, and studied French cooking independently. Opened 龍のひげ in Nakagyo in 2004, fusing Kyoto cuisine and French; opened 嵐山MITATE in 2015; held a special dinner show in Italy; started the white-chocolate brand amana by MITATE, since renamed siro (Daimaru Umeda shop April 2025). 龍のひげ moved to Daiwa Roynet Hotel Kyoto Shijo-Karasuma in 2022. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ＭＩＴＡＴＥ.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the group site: "素材の声に耳を澄ませ" — listen to the voice of the ingredients and express the delicacy of Kyoto cuisine and the depth of French in one plate.
chef_bio.specialty: Story Teller courses themed on Kyoto; French × sushi dinner course.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 lunch began with a travel bag on the table holding the glasses, cutlery and a blanket, and a menu laid out like a travel itinerary.
A June 2026 guest asked for quick service because a friend was short of time, and the kitchen kept pace.
A fan since the Arashiyama days liked how a single wine was paired with different dishes by changing its aroma (May 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: グループサイト (mitate.co.jp): 京の雅とフレンチの洗練、見舘孝司シェフ、1973年京都府生まれ、料理人だった父の影響、別の職業を経て京都の料理店で修業、京料理・会席・割烹料理、フレンチは独学、2004年 京都中京区に龍のひげ開業、2015年 嵐山MITATE開業、2022年 ダイワロイネットホテル京都四条烏丸1Fへ移転、ホワイトショコラブランド amana by MITATE を siro に改称、2025年4月 siro 大丸梅田店。店舗サイト: フレンチ×寿司×発酵、リニューアルでディナー営業再開、ランチ ストーリーテラー5,500円・肉料理付き7,700円 (6品+釜飯+季節のデザート)、ディナー ラグジュアリーストーリーテラー11,000円・肉料理付き14,300円 (6品+寿司+季節のデザート)、昼12:00〜15:30 (最終入店13:30)、夜18:00〜21:30 (最終入店19:30)、火水定休。食べログ: フレンチ・日本料理、24席、車椅子可、夜は10歳未満不可、無断キャンセル100%、インボイス T9130001053455 (株式会社ＭＩＴＡＴＥ)。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese-language site; staff explain each themed dish.

places.name: ルシュルシュル (Işıl ışıl)
places.gf_detail: Ask. À la carte Italian with pasta and risotto, carpaccio and tartare, meat mains, gelato and tiramisu; no gluten information (2021–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an ingredient-led Italian menu of fish, meat, game, cheese and cream (2021–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: From 18:00, last entry 20:00; closed Tuesdays and the third Wednesday; irregular extra closures are posted (official site, read 2026-11-05: open 3 November, closed 9 and 11 November). Tabelog: 18:00–22:00, closed Tuesday. Reservations by phone (075-252-2587) or TableCheck (official site). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats: 5 at the counter, tables for 4 and 2 (Tabelog); TableCheck says 9. Private hire possible; non-smoking; sommelier (Tabelog). No printed drink menu — the wines change often and the staff recommend (June 2024). On Fuyacho between Oshikoji and Nijo, 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn exit 11 (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho between Oshikoji and Nijo, Goshominami — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Italian, “an Italian restaurant in Goshominami where you think about the outline of each flavour and how it finishes” (TableCheck, translated) · à la carte by default, with a chef’s-choice menu at ¥9,900 (TableCheck) · kombu-cured sea bream carpaccio, porcini pasta, moules pasta, sautéed seafood with hollandaise, pistachio gelato, tiramisu (December 2021) · sweet shrimp and prosciutto on cheese, Aizu horse sashimi, tenderloin steak, crab risotto (November 2022) · tuna tartare ¥3,500, rabbit and chestnut risotto ¥2,600, Ezo deer ¥5,800 (December 2022) · sea urchin pasta (October 2023) · plates sized for about two, split for the table (June 2024) · wines by the glass chosen by the sommelier, including bottles usually sold only whole (January 2026)
places.notes: [Italian · Fuyacho, a chef and a sommelier] A glass-fronted room on Fuyacho with a short counter, a sofa corner and a gleaming kitchen, where a female chef cooks alone and a male sommelier pours. Order à la carte — tartare, porcini pasta, risotto, game such as Ezo deer — or take the ¥9,900 chef’s choice, and let the sommelier pick wines by the glass; there is no drink menu. Expect ¥10,000–20,000 a head with wine. Last entry 20:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the restaurant as “run by a lovely couple” (December 2022) and as “the space created by a female chef and a male sommelier” (November 2022). In January 2026: “The dishes prepared by the female chef, who works solo, are all crafted with great care”, with wine service by the male sommelier “on par with famous restaurants in Tokyo”. A July 2025 regular credits “the personalities of the two owners”.
chef_bio.philosophy: Thinking about the outline of each flavour and how it finishes (TableCheck, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte Italian; risotto; game; wine by the glass.

anecdotes.text: At the end of a December 2021 dinner, the chef and the sommelier came to the door to see the guests off.
A November 2022 guest, already full, wanted the porcini pasta and the crab risotto too, and the kitchen cut the portions down to fit.
A June 2024 party of three found no drink menu and no explanation of how the shared plates would be priced, and felt it poor value.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: Işıl ışıl (ルシュルシュル)、中京区麩屋町押小路上がる225 第二ふや町ビル1F、18時から (最終入店20時)、火曜と第3水曜定休、予約は電話とテーブルチェック。テーブルチェック: 「味の輪郭や食後の抜け方に思考を巡らせる、京都 御所南のイタリア料理店」、9席、おまかせ9,900円。食べログ: イタリアン・ワインバー、18:00〜22:00、火曜定休、予約可、カード可、10席 (カウンター5、テーブル4と2)、貸切可、禁煙、ソムリエ。口コミ (2016〜2026年、英語): 女性の料理人がひとりで作り、男性のソムリエがワインを選ぶ、夫婦の店との声、鯛の昆布締めのカルパッチョ、ポルチーニのパスタ、馬刺し、鮪のタルタル、兎と栗のリゾット、エゾ鹿、ウニのパスタ、ドリンクメニューはない。

cultural_comfort.note: No drink menu — the sommelier recommends; TableCheck booking has an English interface.

places.gf_detail: Ask. The hayashi sauce is made from additive-free tomato juice and plenty of onion (Tabelog shop text), but nothing is said about flour or roux; most toppings are breaded and fried (katsu, croquettes, shrimp fry, chicken nanban).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the sauce reminds a reviewer of beef stew, with a buttery richness (November 2026); toppings of hamburg steak, sausage, egg, cheese and fried meat or seafood.
places.hours_raw: 10:00–20:30 daily (L.O. 20:00); irregular closures; closed 31 December–3 January (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Meal tickets from a machine (May and November 2026). No cards; e-money and QR codes accepted (Tabelog; PayPay, November 2026). 12 seats: a counter and about two tables (Tabelog; November 2026). Non-smoking; take-out and delivery; children welcome, one stroller at a time (Tabelog). Self-service water (May 2026). On Shijo-dori just west of Karasuma, 2–3 min from Hankyu Karasuma and Shijo Stns exit 26 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori just west of Karasuma — 2 min from Shijo / Karasuma Stn exit 26
places.cuisine: Hayashi rice only, with a long list of toppings (Tabelog shop text; November 2026) · a light, tangy sauce of additive-free tomato juice and plenty of onion (Tabelog shop text) · plain hayashi rice ¥800, large ¥940; standard rice 250 g (May and November 2026) · toppings: cheese, soft-boiled egg, homemade tartar with shrimp tempura (Tabelog shop text); chicken katsu, hamburg steak, shrimp fry, spinach with scrambled egg and sausage, chicken nanban (2026 reviews) · taro and crab-cream croquette, called a hidden specialty, ¥1,080 (November 2026) · hamburg omurice, side salad (May 2026)
places.notes: [Hayashi rice · Shijo Karasuma, from 10:00] A small ticket-machine counter on Shijo-dori west of Karasuma that serves only hayashi rice: a light, tomato-sharp sauce over 250 g of rice from ¥800, built up with toppings from cheese and egg to katsu, hamburg steak and a taro-and-crab croquette. Quick, cheap and solo-friendly, open 10:00–20:30. Some reviewers want a richer, demi-glace-style sauce. A March 2026 reviewer says it replaced a Hino-ya Curry franchise in the same space.

roles: Operated by 株式会社かもめ (Ukyo-ku, per the NTA invoice registry)
chef_bio.background: A March 2026 reviewer writes that the space used to be a Hino-ya Curry and, since the Instagram account stayed the same, guesses the franchisee simply changed its business. The Tabelog invoice number T1130001057447 is registered to 株式会社かもめ, a company in Ukyo-ku, Kyoto.
chef_bio.specialty: Hayashi rice with toppings.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 diner spotted a sign calling the taro croquette a hidden specialty and switched from the hamburg steak.
A May 2026 parent and child arrived at opening and watched customers come in one after another.

places.name: 京御菓子司 亀屋博永 (Kameya Hironaga)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The warabi mochi is described as made from authentic bracken starch with brown sugar, dusted with kinako of Tanba black soybeans and wasanbon (2023–2026 reviews), but no ingredient list is published; the shop also sells monaka, ohagi, sakura mochi and daifuku, not described.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The warabi mochi as described is bracken starch, brown sugar, kinako and wasanbon (2023–2026 reviews), but no full ingredient list is published.
places.hours_raw: 9:00–18:00, Wednesday to 17:00, every day (Tabelog); hours may change. A takeaway shop: “a cozy sales area without dining space” (February 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; phone 075-431-4438). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No parking; the street in front is narrow (Tabelog; March 2025). A sample of warabi mochi is offered on entry (February 2025). On Aburanokoji south of Shimochojamachi, near the Kyoto Prefectural Office, about 15 min on foot from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; February 2025).
places.neighborhood: Aburanokoji south of Shimochojamachi, near the Kyoto Prefectural Office — 15 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Takeaway Kyoto wagashi (Tabelog) · warabi mochi of authentic bracken starch with brown sugar, kinako of Tanba black soybeans and wasanbon, featured on Matsuko no Shiranai Sekai; small (serves two) ¥1,000, large (serves four) ¥2,000; keeps a week at room temperature (2025–2026 reviews) · monaka, tea monaka ¥200 (January 2026) · ohagi, sakura mochi (April 2025) · minazuki in season; mango and other unusual flavours (December 2023) · strawberry daifuku (March 2025)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Aburanokoji, the warabi mochi] A small machiya sweet shop near the Kyoto Prefectural Office, with no seats — you buy and take away. The draw is a soft, melting warabi mochi of real bracken starch and brown sugar under homemade kinako of Tanba black soybeans, ¥1,000 for a small pack that keeps a week; it was featured on Matsuko no Shiranai Sekai. Also monaka, ohagi and seasonal sweets. The owner trained at Kameya Kiyonaga in Gion. Cash only.

roles: Owner (unnamed), trained at Kameya Kiyonaga in Gion
chef_bio.background: A February 2025 review, quoting the shop’s own introduction, says “The owner trained at the famous ‘Kameya Kiyonaga’ shop in Gion before establishing this place.” In December 2023 a reviewer described a shop “operated by an elderly couple” with the couple’s son; in January 2026 another described an elderly gentleman running the shop alone, hands covered in warabi mochi and kinako while packing. A July 2026 regular of four years noted the sweets now come pre-packed, where four years earlier each order was taken from the fridge, cut, weighed and packed on the spot, and that prices had gone up.
chef_bio.specialty: Warabi mochi with homemade kinako.

anecdotes.text: A December 2023 regular recalled long queues after a television appearance, now calmer.
A February 2025 visitor was offered a sample of warabi mochi on entering.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京御菓子司 亀屋博永、和菓子、上京区油小路下長者町下る大黒屋町38、丸太町駅から809m、9:00〜18:00 (水曜は17:00まで)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR決済不可、駐車場なし、テイクアウト、子ども可。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 本わらび粉と黒糖のわらび餅、Tanba 黒豆のきな粉と和三盆、Matsuko no Shiranai Sekai で紹介、小1,000円 (2人前)、大2,000円 (4人前)、常温で1週間、最中、おはぎ、桜餅、水無月、いちご大福、店主は祇園の Kameya Kiyonaga で修業、イートインはない、年配の夫婦と息子の店との声 (2023年)、年配の男性がひとりで営むとの声 (2026年)。

places.cuisine: Takeaway French-style patisserie (Tabelog) · Écarlate (chocolate sponge, dark chocolate mousse, milk chocolate cream, raspberry) and Marron (rum-soaked sponge, chestnut mousse and cream) (October 2025) · a mosque-shaped Mont Blanc, Caramel Vanille, Chocolat (November 2025) · Éclair Latte, Passion, Macaron Pistachio with cherry (August 2025) · Amaou strawberry roll, Chestnut, Bergamot, cream puff (March 2026) · peach tart (August 2026) · Pistachio (September 2026) · Tart Bomb of apple and mousse ¥896 (October 2026) · pound cake and financiers (July 2026)
places.notes: [Patisserie · Shogoin, opposite the university hospital] A small, chic cake shop so understated that people walk past it, across from Kyoto University Hospital. Glossy French-style cakes — the Chestnut, a mosque-shaped Mont Blanc, Écarlate, cream puffs, seasonal tarts — from about ¥900, carefully packed to take away. Open four days a week from noon until sold out; check Instagram. Reviewers call it refined; a few find it heavy or sweet.

chef_bio.background: An October 2025 reviewer writes that the cakes are “crafted by a chef who previously served as the pastry chef at Robuchon”, and that the careful packing reflects the chef’s commitment. Another October 2025 visitor thought “it seems that the owner runs it alone.”
chef_bio.specialty: Entremets and petits gâteaux; chestnut cakes.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular asked to photograph the display, which is normally not allowed, and was kindly let.
A May 2026 first-timer was nervous after reading the shop’s notices but was welcomed warmly.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: アングレディアン 京都、ケーキ、左京区聖護院西町19、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩約10分、バス停 Kyoto University Hospital から徒歩4分、水・木・金・日 12:00〜18:00、月・火・土定休 (営業日と閉店時間はインスタグラムで案内、売り切れ次第終了)、予約は店頭のみ (電話不可)、カード・電子マネー可、テイクアウト、2020年4月25日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 京大病院の向かい、小さくおしゃれな店、Robuchon でパティシエを務めた人のケーキとの声、ひとりで営んでいるようだとの声、モンブラン、栗、ピスタチオ、シュークリーム、タルト、ショーケースの撮影は要確認、甘く重いとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the display case; ask before photographing it. Reservations in person only.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the oden simmers in a domestic beef-bone broth and comes with cheese sauces (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat, holidays and days before/after holidays 15:00–22:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; tell the shop about allergies in advance; groups of 14 or more get the whole shop (Tabelog). Service charge 10% on à la carte, and a ¥500 charge for drinks only — Tabelog's Japanese original: "アラカルトはサービス料10%、ドリンクのみはチャージ＋５００円". 14 seats: a counter with Kyoto kumiko woodwork and tables upstairs; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay (Tabelog). In 三条食彩ろぉじ, the alley off Sakaimachi south of Sanjo; 6 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: "French oden": oden simmered in a domestic beef-bone broth, served with four French sauces — the gorgonzola is recommended — with daikon, egg and konnyaku as house picks; daily obanzai and bistro dishes; about three glass wines a day, sake (Tabelog) · in reviews: white-mushroom skewers, stick fu from Hanbeifu, mochi pouches, chilled oden in summer, the "Yahoyorozu Salad"; a casual course ¥4,400 with beef-bone soup, seasonal dishes, salad and bread (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [French oden & wine · Sanjo Shokusai Roji] A bright little bistro in a Sanjo alley that simmers oden in beef-bone broth and serves it with French sauces — try daikon or egg with gorgonzola — alongside wine. Courses from ¥4,400; à la carte +10%. Some find the flavours mild. Closed Sunday and Monday.

roles: Chef (unnamed; trained in Italian cooking per a November 2024 reviewer)
chef_bio.background: Per a November 2024 reviewer: a new place that opened the year before, whose chef trained in Italian cuisine and pairs oden with Italian-style sauces. Per the operator: a counter with Kyo-kumiko woodwork.
chef_bio.specialty: Oden with gorgonzola sauce.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 first-timer found the food beautiful but the flavours "a bit too mild", with little difference between the gorgonzola and mozzarella sauces.
A March 2026 diner who grew up dipping oden in red miso found the Burgundy-style sauce a natural fit.
Arriving late in January 2025, a guest found many dishes sold out and was shown upstairs, where the doorbell was a little bell.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): French Oden & Wine やほよろづ、ビストロ・創作料理・ワインバー、中京区堺町通三条下ル道祐町135 三条食彩ろぉじ堺町の道 せりの舗、烏丸御池駅から徒歩6分、火〜土・祝・祝前後 15:00〜22:00 (L.O. 料理21:00、ドリンク21:30)、日・月休み、アレルギーは事前に、14名以上は貸切、アラカルトはサービス料10%、ドリンクのみはチャージ+500円、14席、Kyo-kumiko のカウンター、2階のテーブル、国産牛骨のスープで煮込むフレンチおでんと4種のフレンチソース、ゴルゴンゾーラ、大根・卵・こんにゃく、日替わりのおばんざいとビストロ料理、グラスワイン3種。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年10月、英語): マッシュルームの串、Hanbeifu の棒麩、餅巾着、夏は冷やしおでん、カジュアルコース4,400円、イタリアンで修業した料理人、味が控えめという声。

cultural_comfort.note: 10% service on à la carte; ¥500 charge for drinks only.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku with sauces, a sukiyaki-style cut and rice; no gluten information (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku course of wagyu (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily incl. Sundays and holidays, later by arrangement; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Bookings needed — usually full with regulars (2024 reviews); harder since a January 2026 TV appearance (February 2026). Omakase course only (October 2024); ¥10,200 in May 2024. Cash only — no cards (Tabelog). 14 seats incl. a counter and a private tatami room for 4; Tabelog lists smoking as allowed (Tabelog). Near Yasaka Shrine, south of Shijo; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; November 2025).

places.cuisine: Small yakiniku counter of a meat-obsessed owner who tastes and picks each cut for fat quality and grain; the chef's special omakase is what 60% of regulars order (Tabelog) · courses of about six cuts — chateaubriand, a Spencer-roll cut, a sukiyaki-style slice — with grilled vegetables, pickled tomatoes, rice and seasonal fruit (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Gion near Yasaka Shrine] A tiny, regular-filled yakiniku counter where the meat-obsessed owner picks every cut and shows you how to grill it: one omakase course (about ¥10,000–15,000) from chateaubriand to rice. Cash only; book early. Open nightly to 23:00.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who runs the shop alone per the operator; 2024 reviewers met the owner and a spouse
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 September 2013 (Tabelog). Per the operator: "the owner manages everything alone" across 14 seats, pacing dishes to each table. A March 2024 reviewer was told the chef and a spouse had run it for about ten years; a January 2026 reviewer relates that the shop usually refuses media, but agreed to filming of Kotaro Koizumi for Nippon TV's "Oh! My God" (aired in Kanto only).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: "The higher the quality of fat, the quicker it melts just from being touched or cut… delivering only what I personally find delicious."
chef_bio.specialty: Chef's special yakiniku course.

anecdotes.text: A May 2024 reviewer: only a ¥10,200 course is offered at first, and diners who appreciate it may later order higher-grade meat.
During the July 2026 Gion Matsuri, a diner saw the portable shrine pass right in front of the shop.
After seeing the owner on TV, a February 2026 viewer phoned and was surprised to get a booking from the owner himself.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): まる廣、焼肉・居酒屋・鍋、東山区祇園町南側529-1 祇園Kentビル 1F、祇園四条から徒歩5分、17:00〜23:00 (23時以降は相談)、不定休 (日祝も営業)、カード不可、14席、4名の個室、喫煙可、2013年9月1日オープン、肉好きで知られる店主、脂の質や肉のきめを見極め自ら食べて美味しいものだけ、店主一人で切り盛り、常連の6割が頼むおまかせコース。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年7月、英語): 夫婦で約10年、10,200円のコース、6種の肉、シャトーブリアン、すき焼き風、焼き野菜、トマトのマリネ、ご飯、季節の果物、Nippon TV の「Oh! My God」で Kotaro Koizumi が来店 (2026年1月)、予約が取りにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Book early; cash only; the owner explains how to grill each cut.

places.notes: [Udon · Gojo near Kiyomizu-dera] A popular little udon shop on Gojo-dori where a Kagawa-born owner makes chewy Sanuki-style noodles: chicken-tempura bukkake from ¥900, curry udon, and a fragrant bonito broth. Some find the noodles softer than true Sanuki. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), from Kagawa Prefecture per an October 2026 reviewer
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 reviewer: homemade noodles by an owner from Kagawa Prefecture; reviewers call it a popular spot for curry udon (January 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Kashiwa tempura bukkake; curry udon.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner expected more chewiness and wondered whether the noodles are adjusted for tourists.
A March 2026 guest found too much udon for the broth, so the tempura batter soaked it up.
At the peak of Obon in August 2026 the shop was full, but a table opened within ten minutes and the bowl came in five.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 讃式 (SANSHIKI)、うどん・天ぷら、東山区五条橋東2-9-4、京阪清水五条駅から徒歩3分、月 11:00〜15:00、水〜日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜20:00、火曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、18席 (テーブルのみ)、禁煙。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): かしわ天ぶっかけ900円、肉入り1,000円、海老天うどん1,000円 (素うどん700円)、肉わかめうどん中1,100円、カレー肉うどん、鶏天カレーうどん、かやくご飯、卵天丼、鰹出汁、Kagawa 出身の店主の自家製麺、Sanuki ほどのこしはないという声。

places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, simmered and fried dishes, Yanagawa nabe and kamameshi; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led Japanese izakaya on dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–23:00 (food last order 22:00); closed Sunday and once a month irregularly (Tabelog). Bookings advised — usually full (2026 reviews). Order the kamameshi early, as it takes time (February 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR (Tabelog). A counter, three tables for four and one for two, and a tatami room; non-smoking (Tabelog; February 2026). On Oike-dori east of Muromachi; 1 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog).

places.notes: [Izakaya · Karasuma-Oike] A busy, always-booked izakaya by Karasuma-Oike station loved for its showpiece sashimi platter and seasonal Kyoto dishes — Fushimi peppers with jako, grilled ayu, eel Yanagawa nabe — finished with kamameshi. About ¥5,000–10,000. Book ahead; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a popular, usually fully booked izakaya with friendly regulars, the hall run by one staff member; an October 2026 reviewer says it has been selected as a Bib Gourmand.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; kamameshi.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner enjoyed the friendly regulars and said "the owner looked just like Keanu Reeves".
A February 2026 walk-in met "some slightly rude comments" and left soon, while granting it suits those who like a chatty izakaya.
A July 2026 party paid ¥4,500 a head for a sashimi platter of salmon and cheaper fish while other tables got tuna for the same price — "very frustrating".

places.name: 角打ちと麺 ばんさん (Kakuuchi to Men Bansan)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Izakaya plates, tempura, shumai and wheat ramen to finish (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the ramen broth is simmered six hours with seafood dashi, and oden and most plates use dashi or meat (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 15:00–24:00 (last order 23:00), daily, with irregular closures announced on Tabelog (e.g. 3, 10, 11 and 18 November) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and often needed; a booking is cancelled if you cannot be reached 10 minutes after the time (Tabelog; October 2026). No children (Tabelog). Charge ¥300 with tax (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「300円（税込）」). Drinks are self-serve from the fridge — pour your own sake and leave a numbered tag (2026 reviews). 23 seats: standing bar and counter, private rooms for 4–20 (Tabelog). Cards and IC cards, no QR (Tabelog). In the Yuasa Kaikan, a renovated townhouse north of Gojo; 4 min from Gojo Stn (Tabelog; May 2026).
places.neighborhood: North of Gojo, west of Karasuma — 4 min from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Kakuuchi-style sake bar and izakaya of the Kyoiro restaurant group: help yourself to sake and wine from the fridge, order Kyoto small plates, finish with noodles (Tabelog, shop text; 2026 reviews) · "Yamamen" ramen in a clear broth simmered six hours with seafood dashi — the same ramen as a Gion late-night shop of the group (Tabelog; June 2026) · simmered manganji peppers ¥700, oden platter ¥950, large grilled mushrooms (May 2026) · Kameoka Nanatani duck tataki, Nanatani egg dashimaki, jellyfish sashimi, water kimchi, mizu-nasu with myoga, nishin-nasu, chikuwa tempura, shumai, garlic tomatoes, horse sashimi, potato salad (2026 reviews) · Kyoto red-chicken hot pot course for private rooms (Tabelog) · about ¥3,000–6,500 a head (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sake bar & izakaya · Gojo, pour your own and finish with ramen] A Kyoiro-group bar in a renovated townhouse north of Gojo where you take sake from the fridge, pour it yourself, and order Kyoto snacks — Nanatani duck, dashimaki, garlic tomatoes — before the house "Yamamen" ramen in a six-hour broth. Lively and affordable; book ahead. No children; ¥300 charge. 15:00–24:00.

roles: Shop of the Kyoiro group; staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a shop created by the representative of the Kyoiro group, a Kyoto restaurant group, serving sake from around Japan and Kyoto seasonal dishes in a townhouse, with noodles in a broth simmered six hours. A June 2026 diner noted the same ramen is served at a Gion shop open only from 23:00 to 2:00.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per a May 2026 reviewer quoting the shop: "Noodles after drinking that lead to tomorrow."
chef_bio.specialty: Yamamen ramen; self-serve sake.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner found the regular ramen too much for one after shumai, but drank all the broth.
A May 2026 diner who came for the noodles found it an izakaya and settled for a light drink.
An August 2026 diner found prices a little above typical standing bars but the flavours exceptional.

cultural_comfort.note: Pour your own drinks from the fridge; book ahead; no children; ¥300 charge.

At the south end of the Furukawa-cho arcade, near Ipponbashi on the Shirakawa; 5 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). Opened 1 May 2021 (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Furukawa-cho arcade, Higashiyama — 5 min from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Ramen of stir-fried ("aori") miso (official site) · miso ramen with a bonito accent, ginger, watercress and sautéed onions, caramelised chashu; spicy miso ramen (2025–26 reviews) · shoyu chuka soba ¥950; extra chashu (3 slices) +¥300; set C of rice and karaage +¥400; lunch set with rice and two croquettes ¥1,200 (June 2025, April–May 2026) · chashu and karaage rice bowls; a lemon-peel sorbet after the meal (April 2025, October 2026) · featured in 究極のラーメン 2020 and 2022 関西版 (official site)
places.notes: [Ramen · Higashiyama, stir-fried miso in an old arcade] A thirteen-seat ramen shop at the far end of the Furukawa-cho arcade near the Shirakawa, known for miso ramen made with stir-fried miso — rich, ginger-bright, with watercress and caramelised chashu — and a lighter shoyu chuka soba from ¥950. Buy a ticket at the machine. No cards. Closed Monday; check hours, which have changed.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a ramen shop of "authentic aori (stir-fried) miso" that opened on 1 May (2021, Tabelog) on the south side of the Furukawa-cho arcade, and has appeared in 究極のラーメン 2020 and 2022 (関西版) and a LEAF guide to Kyoto and Shiga ramen. A January 2026 diner was greeted by the owner during a wait.
chef_bio.specialty: Miso ramen.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner found the extra chashu a bit dry and tough but the karaage good, and most guests were tourists from abroad.
A May 2026 diner found the shoyu ramen smooth but would have liked more dashi or soy punch.
An April 2025 diner touring with friends from abroad was struck by the warm welcome while waiting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-shirakawa.com): 東山区古川町商店街南側の「本格煽り味噌」のラーメン店、5月1日開店、雑誌「究極のラーメン2020 関西版」「究極のラーメン2022 関西版」、LEAF 別冊「京都 滋賀旨いラーメン」に掲載、営業時間変更のお知らせあり。食べログ: ラーメン、東山区稲荷町北組567-26、東山駅から徒歩5分、火〜日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜21:30、月曜休み、予約不可、カード不可、電子マネー・楽天ペイ可、13席、禁煙、2021年5月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年11月、英語): 味噌ラーメン、辛味噌、中華そば950円、チャーシュー追加300円、C セット (ご飯と唐揚げ) +400円、昼のセット1,200円、食券制、海外の客が多い、チャーシューが硬いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Buy a ticket at the machine; no cards (e-money and Rakuten Pay); check hours.

places.name: ortensia (オルテンシア)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses centre on pasta, gratins and fried seafood (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood-led Italian with cheese and house-cured pork (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 and dinner 18:00–21:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; lunch is cash only (Tabelog). Lunch course about ¥5,300 with a drink (December 2025); chef’s dinner course of 5–6 dishes with a drink ¥8,300 (May 2026); à la carte also offered (January 2026). 14 seats; private hire; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX) at dinner (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi-dori north of Marutamachi; 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened October 2019 per Tabelog (a review says November 2019).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi Marutamachi — 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Seafood-led, seasonal Italian of chef Takayuki Nasu (Tabelog review) · lunch course ¥5,300: two appetizers, pasta, fish, dessert, coffee and a drink (December 2025) · dinner course ¥8,300: stracciatella with sweet shrimp, white asparagus with prosciutto and gorgonzola, clams, scallops, wakasagi and firefly squid in parsley sauce, pasta with tuna and wild asparagus (May 2026) · cold spaghettini with sea urchin, hamo wrapped in prosciutto, acqua pazza of isaki or itoyori, Bolognese, Amatriciana, hamo and caper tomato spaghetti, porcini and scallop butter spaghetti (2025–26 reviews) · house-cured pork ham and sausages, buffalo mozzarella, beef cheek braised in red wine (December 2024) · panna cotta with peach sorbet, blancmange (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Kawaramachi Marutamachi, seafood and pasta in a small room] A stylish fourteen-seat Italian north of Marutamachi where chef Takayuki Nasu cooks generous seasonal plates — sea urchin cold pasta, hamo in prosciutto, acqua pazza, house-cured ham. Lunch courses about ¥5,300 (cash only), dinner ¥8,300 with a drink. Reviews mention a Michelin Bib Gourmand (2021–23). Service can be slow when one person runs lunch. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Chef (named in a May 2025 Tabelog review)
chef_bio.background: A May 2025 Tabelog review names the chef as Takayuki Nasu; a March 2023 review notes a Michelin Bib Gourmand for 2021–2023 and an opening in November 2019 (Tabelog gives 1 October 2019). Reviewers saw one person running lunch alone (December 2025, September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood pasta; acqua pazza.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 birthday-lunch diner found two rich appetizers in a row and the flavours strong throughout — better suited to an evening with wine.
A January 2026 diner’s only gripe was that espresso was the only post-meal drink.
A July 2026 regular found the sweet shrimp and buffalo mozzarella sold out but loved the sea-urchin cold pasta.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ・海鮮、上京区河原町丸太町上ル出水町274、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩約5分、昼 12:00〜15:00・夜 18:00〜21:00、水曜休み、予約可、昼は現金のみ、14席、貸切可、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX)、2019年10月1日オープン。口コミ (2023年3月〜2026年9月、英語): シェフ Takayuki Nasu、ミシュランのビブグルマン 2021〜2023、昼のコース5,300円、夜のおまかせ8,300円 (1ドリンク付き)、雲丹の冷製パスタ、鱧の生ハム巻き、アクアパッツァ、自家製のハムとソーセージ、昼は一人で回していて時間がかかるという声、味が全体に濃いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course; cash only at lunch; JCB or AMEX at dinner.

places.name: KOSA (Kōsa, Ace Hotel Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask — the restaurant asks guests with allergies or dietary restrictions to tell it in advance (Tabelog). Breakfast toasts, focaccia, burgers and set meals with rice (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask in advance (Tabelog). A vegetable set meal, a vegetable clay-pot steam and a salad lunch of over ten vegetables are on the menu, but most dishes have meat, fish or dairy (Tabelog; April–October 2026).
places.hours_raw: Daily: breakfast 7:00–11:00 (last order 10:30), lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; seat requests may not be met; tell the restaurant of allergies or dietary restrictions in advance (Tabelog). Menu prices include a 10% service charge and tax (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料10％（メニューはサービス料・税込での金額を表示しております。）」). Water: filtered or bottled; one diner found the water charged and expensive (March–April 2026). 118 seats with a bar counter, private room ¥22,000 for 2–12, and a garden terrace (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Third floor of Ace Hotel Kyoto in the Shinpukan; 1 min from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 5 (Tabelog; official site). Opened 10 August 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma Oike, in Ace Hotel Kyoto — 1 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal farm-to-table dining overlooking a rooftop garden (official site) · breakfast of about six choices — eggs Benedict, avocado toast, Japanese and American breakfasts (April–October 2026) · lunch "teishoku" one-plate sets of fish (grilled sea bream), vegetables or meat with soup and kamameshi (March–April 2026); KOSA salad lunch of over ten vegetables ¥3,000, ¥3,800 with a drink, ¥3,500 with a topping such as roast beef (Tabelog; October 2026); wagyu burger ¥3,800 (June 2026) · dinner steak course with Japanese strip loin and hojicha cheesecake ¥8,000 (June 2026) · cocktails and mocktails (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Hotel restaurant · Karasuma Oike, farm-to-table in the Ace Hotel] The third-floor restaurant of Ace Hotel Kyoto, a big, sunlit room opening onto a garden terrace. Breakfast from 7:00 (eggs Benedict, avocado toast), one-plate fish or vegetable teishoku and a ten-vegetable salad lunch at about ¥3,000–3,800, and steak courses at night. Prices include service but run high, and water isn't free. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "Kōsa: Seasonal Farm-to-Table Dining in the heart of Kyoto", overlooking a rooftop garden, on the third floor of Ace Hotel Kyoto. Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): valuing farm-to-table and fresh ingredients; opened 10 August 2023. An April 2026 diner had expected an American chef’s steak-and-burger menu.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): serving dishes of fresh ingredients, valuing farm-to-table.
chef_bio.specialty: Farm-to-table set meals; salad lunch.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner enjoyed the teishoku and kamameshi but found the water charged and quite expensive.
A May 2026 business diner found the steak course’s five sauces too many and the rice portion small.
An October 2026 breakfast guest who could not eat smoked salmon was given bacon instead.
A June 2026 breakfast guest found the eggs Benedict perfect but the side vegetables a little wilted.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kosakyoto.com): Kōsa、京都の中心の季節のファーム・トゥ・テーブル、屋上庭園を望む、エースホテル京都3F、車屋町245-2。食べログ: 創作料理・オーガニック・カフェ、中京区車屋町245-2 新風館 エースホテル京都 3F、烏丸御池駅5番出口から徒歩1分、毎日 朝 7:00〜11:00 (L.O. 10:30)・昼 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・夜 17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、予約可、アレルギーや食事制限は事前に、サービス料10% (メニューはサービス料・税込で表示)、118席、個室料22,000円、カード可、2023年8月10日オープン、KOSA サラダランチ3,000円 (1ドリンク付き3,800円)。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 朝食6種、エッグベネディクト、魚や野菜の定食と釜飯、和牛バーガー3,800円、ステーキのコース8,000円、庭のテラス、水が有料で高いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; prices include 10% service; give allergies in advance.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Guests with food allergies or dietary restrictions are asked to tell the restaurant in advance; a breakfast guest’s smoked salmon was swapped for bacon on request (October 2026).
