places.name: 春夏秋冬ざこや (Shunkashuto Zakoya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Fish-focused courses with dashi, soy-based dishes, fried anglerfish and takikomi rice; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses — sashimi, grilled fish, eel, sweetfish — with dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–23:00, last dinner seating 21:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservation only, by the day before; fixed start times (Tabelog; September 2026). Two fish-focused courses, ¥6,500 and ¥8,800, at lunch and dinner (March–June 2026). 10 seats at a U-shaped counter; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; March 2026). Cards (Tabelog). Second floor of ミックナカムラ on Higashinotoin south of Sanjo; 4 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (exit 5 is easiest) (Tabelog; June 2026).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin south of Sanjo, 2nd floor — 4 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Fish-focused omakase counter of about ten dishes, two courses ¥6,500 and ¥8,800 (2026 reviews) · e.g. tofu mousse, sweetfish simmered with sansho, escargot in butter, yellowtail sashimi, blue-cheese chawanmushi, sweetfish with edamame sauce, grilled eel, matsutake soup, autumn salmon rice, yatsuhashi sorbet (October 2026); gurnard grilled with crisp scales, sanma rice with Fushimi peppers (September 2026); fried anglerfish, yatsuhashi ice cream (September 2026) · leftover takikomi rice made into onigiri (June, September 2026) · a sake list with tastings before ordering (March, June 2026) · about ¥8,000–15,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Fish counter · Higashinotoin Sanjo, a couple's omakase] A ten-seat U-shaped counter near Karasuma Oike where a couple serve fish-focused omakase courses of about ten dishes for ¥6,500 or ¥8,800, lunch or dinner: crisp-scaled grilled gurnard, eel, sweetfish, blue-cheese chawanmushi, a seasonal rice whose leftovers come back as onigiri, and a yatsuhashi sorbet. Taste the sake before you order. Book by the day before. Closed Sunday.

roles: A couple (unnamed), per a March 2026 review
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe "the lovely couple who runs the place" (March 2026), the owner's meticulous craftsmanship and sincere service (March 2026), a manager who explains each dish (March 2026), and staff who explain the sake breweries and styles (June 2026). An August 2025 review of 鮨ざこや places it in the Zakoya group with 鮨ざこや and Petit Poisson.
chef_bio.specialty: Fish omakase; grilled fish with crisp scales.

anecdotes.text: "I appreciated the service of being able to taste the Japanese sake before ordering it, which was a nice touch." — March 2026.
A June 2026 birthday diner, too full for the last rice, had it made into onigiri to take home.
"It would be nice to have a few more options for white wine." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・魚介料理、中京区東洞院三条下ル三文字町200 ミックナカムラ2F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩4分、月〜土 11:30〜14:00・17:30〜23:00 (夜は21時が最終入店)、日曜休み、完全予約制 (前日まで)、10席 (カウンター)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 魚中心の2つのコース6,500円・8,800円、昼も夜も、コの字のカウンター、夫婦で営む (2026年3月)、日本酒は試飲してから選べる、豆腐のムース、鮎の山椒煮、エスカルゴのバター、ぶりのお造り、ブルーチーズの茶碗蒸し、鰻の焼き物、松茸のお吸い物、秋鮭のご飯、八ツ橋のシャーベット、ほうぼうの鱗焼き、さんまと伏見とうがらしのご飯、あんこうの唐揚げ、残ったご飯はおにぎりに、白ワインの種類がもう少しあればとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by the day before; set courses; sake tastings offered; cards accepted.

places.name: 鮨ざこや (Sushi Zakoya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae nigiri and small dishes with soy sauce, nikiri and kombu curing; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi counter of fish, shellfish and sea urchin (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Reservation only; irregular closures; no hours published (Tabelog); dinner usually from 18:00 (August 2026). Referral- or membership-based: Tabelog lists no phone number, and reviewers describe "a referral-only basis" (August 2025), "By Invitation Only" (February 2026) and "reservation-only and membership-based" (April 2025). A 15-piece nigiri course (April 2026); bills about ¥8,000–15,000 (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). 5 counter seats and a private room for about five; private hire for up to six; non-smoking (Tabelog; April 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) (Tabelog). Dress code: very light clothing is not appropriate (Tabelog). An unmarked room in ミックナカムラ (2F) on Higashinotoin south of Sanjo; 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; February 2026).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin south of Sanjo, 2nd floor — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Five-seat Edomae sushi counter of the Zakoya group, by a chef who trained in Tokyo (March 2026; August 2025) · a nigiri course of about 15 pieces with small dishes, aged fish (2025–2026 reviews) · e.g. seared hamo, Akashi sea bream, baigai, isaki, kohada with yuzu, nori-wrapped ebi, yari-ika with sea urchin (August 2025); seared sawara, kombu-cured sea bream, akagai (March 2026); sanma and shima-aji (August 2026); sea urchin heaped on at the counter, eaten with salt (October 2026) · sake such as Saku "Kami no Ho" and Dassai; a peach liqueur (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Higashinotoin Sanjo, five seats by referral] A hidden five-seat Edomae counter (and a small private room) of the Zakoya group, behind an unmarked door: a Tokyo-trained chef serves about fifteen pieces of aged-fish nigiri — kombu-cured sea bream, kohada, sea urchin on squid — with good-value sake, for roughly ¥8,000–15,000. It works by referral: no phone number is published, and reviewers came by introduction or membership. Smart dress.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a chef who honed the craft in Tokyo (March 2026), a counter of five with a private room, and a shop of the Zakoya group, which also runs 春夏秋冬ざこや and Petit Poisson (August 2025; February 2026); access is by referral or membership, with no public phone number (2025–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Aged-fish Edomae nigiri.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner placed it amid Kyoto's "sushi bubble" of ¥30,000–50,000 omakase as a referral-only counter known for reasonable prices and high satisfaction.
An August 2026 regular's group booked the whole counter on a Sunday, when it usually closes; everyone talked in Chinese and the chef joined in easily.
"A sushi restaurant that feels like a 'secret club,' yet serves absolutely wonderful sushi without any hint of mystery!" — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、中京区東洞院三条下ル三文字町200 ミックナカムラ2F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、不定休、完全予約制、電話番号の掲載なし、5席、個室あり、貸切可、禁煙、カード可、ドレスコード (極端な軽装は不可)。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): ざこやグループ (春夏秋冬ざこや、プチポワソン)、紹介制・会員制、東京で修業した料理人、握り15貫ほどのコース、熟成した魚、鱧の焼霜、Akashi の鯛、ばい貝、いさき、柚子のこはだ、海老の海苔巻き、やりいかとうに、さわら、昆布締めの鯛、赤貝、さんま、しまあじ、うにを塩で、Saku「Kami no Ho」、Dassai、桃のリキュール。

cultural_comfort.note: By referral or membership — no public phone number; ask someone who knows the shop or a concierge.

places.name: 一品料理 高倉 (Ippin Ryori Takakura)
places.gf_detail: Ask. À la carte Japanese dishes including tempura, fried dishes with wheat gluten, agedashi, nanban-zuke and tonkatsu chazuke; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable dishes such as agedashi eggplant, fried bamboo shoots, sesame tofu and nanban-zuke appear, but dashi and fish run through most of the menu (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday to Friday 17:30–22:00; closed Saturday, Sunday and Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations open on the same date one month ahead (the next day if that is a closing day); no bookings for three or more (Tabelog). Fully booked most nights — call at 16:30 a month ahead (February 2025). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 9 counter seats and 2 tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Ebisugawa-dori west of Kawaramachi; 5 min walk from the Kawaramachi Marutamachi bus stop or Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; April 2026).
places.neighborhood: Ebisugawa west of Kawaramachi — 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Family-run counter of à la carte dishes written on paper strips above the counter and taken down once sold out — Japanese, with some Italian touches (2025–2026 reviews) · e.g. sea bream shirako with ponzu ¥1,000, yuba sashimi with canola flowers and wakame ¥850 (April 2026); sweet-shrimp and sea-bream sashimi, deep-fried ayu, fried maitake with fu (September 2025); beef shabu-shabu, fried bamboo shoots, agedashi eggplant, fresh yuba rice (April 2026); vegetable nanban-zuke, avocado and nagaimo with fuki miso (June 2026); eel tempura, sesame tofu, tonkatsu chazuke (July 2026) · sake and shochu, no wine (Tabelog; July 2026) · about ¥4,000–8,000 (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [À la carte counter · Ebisugawa Kawaramachi, kaiseki taste at izakaya prices] A small family-run counter near City Hall where the day's dishes hang on paper strips and come down once sold out: shirako ponzu, yuba sashimi, fried bamboo shoots, agedashi eggplant, eel tempura, a celebrated sesame tofu and tonkatsu chazuke, mostly around ¥1,000. Regulars call it kaiseki-level at izakaya prices, so it is booked out: reservations open a month ahead, two people max. Cash only. Open Tuesday to Friday.

chef_bio.background: A February 2025 reviewer: "The counter is run by a family, and it seems to be popular among the locals." Reviewers describe a menu that changes with the seasons and the chef's choices, dishes on paper strips removed once sold out, and long-standing regulars (2025–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal à la carte; sesame tofu; tonkatsu chazuke.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor came with a son to the restaurant the parents had visited every year.
"The taste is at the level of a kaiseki restaurant, but the prices are those of an izakaya." — February 2026.
An April 2026 regular of eight years was thrilled the fresh-yuba rice was back — though missed the old version served with wasabi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区夷川通河原町西入西革堂町205 1F、河原町丸太町バス停から徒歩5分、火〜金 17:30〜22:00、土・日・月休み、予約は前月の同日から (定休日なら翌日)、3名以上の予約不可、現金のみ、カウンター9席とテーブル2卓、禁煙。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年7月、英語): 家族で営むカウンター、品書きは短冊でカウンターの上に、売り切れると外す、和食に少しイタリアンも、ワインはなし、鯛の白子ポン酢1,000円、湯葉のお造りと菜の花とわかめの柚子胡椒850円、甘海老と鯛のお造り、鮎の唐揚げ、舞茸と麩の揚げ物、牛しゃぶ、筍の唐揚げ、揚げ出し茄子、生湯葉ご飯、野菜の南蛮漬け、アボカドと長芋のふき味噌、鰻の天ぷら、胡麻豆腐、とんかつ茶漬け、懐石の味で居酒屋の値段、予約が取りにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu on hand-written paper strips; book by phone a month ahead, two people max; cash only.

places.name: 燻 (Kemuri)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Smoked dishes including fried gyoza, pizza, nama-fu, hanpen with crab-miso sauce and ochazuke; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Smoked yuba, nama-fu, takuan and salad appear, but bacon, cheese, sashimi, chicken and fish cake run through the menu (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day calls often work (July and September 2026). Orders by QR code (July, September 2026). 34 seats incl. counter, semi-private L-shaped seats on two floors and sunken-kotatsu private rooms for 2–4; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX) and PayPay (Tabelog). A renovated machiya on Ayanokoji west of Muromachi; 3 min walk from Karasuma Stn (Hankyu) (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ayanokoji west of Muromachi — 3 min walk from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Izakaya of house-smoked dishes over mild hickory chips in a renovated machiya, finishing with kamado rice of Kyohoku aigamo rice (Tabelog) · smoked appetiser platter; smoked bacon, cheese, nama-fu, yuba, fried gyoza (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · smoked hanpen with crab-miso sauce, smoked sashimi, smoked takuan, smoked ochazuke, smoked hojicha (October 2026) · grilled stingray fin, pizza, grilled chicken, salad (June 2026) · kamado rice such as salmon and mushroom with butter-soy (Tabelog) · sake, wine, whisky — e.g. Laphroaig and Yamazaki 12 at ¥1,200 (Tabelog; October 2026) · about ¥3,000–6,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Smoked izakaya · Ayanokoji Muromachi, everything over hickory] A renovated machiya near Shijo Karasuma devoted to house-smoked food: a smoked appetiser platter, smoked nama-fu and yuba, hanpen with crab-miso sauce, smoked sashimi and takuan, even smoked hojicha and ochazuke — with a closing kamado rice and good-value malts (Laphroaig, Yamazaki 12 at ¥1,200). Counter, semi-private seats and kotatsu rooms. QR ordering. Open nightly.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a modern space in a renovated machiya specialising in homemade smoked dishes over mild hickory chips, from bacon and cheese to nama-fu, yuba and fried gyoza, with kamado rice of Kyohoku aigamo rice and a list of sake, wine and whisky. Reviewers in 2026 praise attentive staff and note QR-code ordering.
chef_bio.philosophy: Smoking for the aroma, not just preservation (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Smoked appetiser platter; smoked nama-fu; kamado rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor, escaping the Gion Matsuri crowds with a last-minute booking, found the machiya a calm place to rest.
"The takuan has a flavor reminiscent of iburigakko, and smoking the sashimi changes its profile" — October 2026, from a whisky lover pleased by the ¥1,200 malts.
"Ordering is done via QR code, which can be a bit cumbersome, but the food is served promptly." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理・ダイニングバー、下京区綾小路通室町西入善長寺町128、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩3分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、予約可、34席、掘りごたつの個室 (2〜4名)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード (JCB、AMEX)・PayPay 可、町家を改装したモダンな空間、マイルドなヒッコリーチップの自家製燻製 (ベーコン、チーズ、生麩、湯葉、揚げ餃子)、Kyohoku の合鴨米の釜炊きご飯 (鮭ときのこのバター醤油など)、日本酒・ワイン・ウイスキー。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 燻製の前菜盛り合わせ、燻製はんぺんの蟹味噌ソース焼き、燻製の刺身、燻製たくあん、燻製茶漬け、燻製ほうじ茶、えいひれ、ピザ、焼き鳥、Laphroaig や Yamazaki 12年が1,200円、注文は QR コード、スタッフの対応が良い、祇園祭の日に当日予約。

cultural_comfort.note: QR-code ordering; same-day calls often work; cards (JCB, AMEX) and PayPay.

places.name: 石焼地鶏とりくら (Torikura)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Chicken grilled on stone with three seasonings, plus kara-age, spring rolls, carbonara and tsukune; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken specialist, with chicken sashimi and seafood (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 daily (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30) (Tabelog). Bookings taken; it fills early in the evening (2026 reviews). Tabelog’s Japanese original for service charge reads 「記載なし」 (none stated). 11 seats per Tabelog, at a counter and tatami or sunken-floor tables, with private rooms for 2 and 4 and private hire for up to 20; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On the 1st floor of the WISTERIA Building on Nishikikoji east of Karasuma, one block north of Shijo-Karasuma, 155 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Karasuma, Nishikikoji — 155 m from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Jidori chicken from Nishiki Market grilled slowly on a far-infrared stone at the table; over 200 drinks including more than 30 sakes such as Aramasa; limited Kagoshima chicken sashimi and Nagoya Cochin liver and heart sashimi (Tabelog official introduction) · seven-cut stone-grill platter (bonjiri, shoulder, wings, heart, thigh, breast, tenderloin) · Yusui chicken tataki · chicken yukhoe · tulip kara-age · tsukune · corn tempura · grilled rice balls · oyakodon · carbonara to finish · courses about ¥5,000, also with all-you-can-drink (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Shijo-Karasuma, grill-it-yourself jidori on hot stone] A chicken izakaya just north of Shijo-Karasuma where cuts of fresh jidori from Nishiki Market arrive raw with a hot stone for grilling at the table: the seven-cut platter is the way to compare. Chicken sashimi and tataki, tulip kara-age and a rich carbonara to finish round it out, with a deep sake list. Courses about ¥5,000. Open to midnight every day; book for early evening.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: chicken delivered directly from Nishiki Market, grilled slowly on a special stone with a strong far-infrared effect; over 200 drinks and more than 30 sakes; limited Kagoshima chicken sashimi and Nagoya Cochin liver and heart sashimi. The operator is not stated.
chef_bio.specialty: Seven-cut stone-grill platter of jidori.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner hoping for the liver sashimi found it unavailable that night and had thigh sashimi instead.
A September 2026 guest sent back a beer that was not cold enough, and it was exchanged.
An October 2026 visitor enjoyed grilling yakitori at the table and found the owner and staff friendly, with thorough explanations.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 石焼地鶏とりくら、焼き鳥・居酒屋、中京区錦小路烏丸東入ル元法然寺町685 WISTERIAビル1F、烏丸駅から155m、17:00〜24:00 (料理L.O. 23:00、ドリンクL.O. 23:30)、サービス料は記載なし、11席、2名・4名の個室、20名まで貸切可、座敷・掘りごたつ、禁煙、子供可、カード可。公式紹介: 錦市場から直送の新鮮な鶏を、遠赤外線効果の高い特製の石でじっくり焼く、200種以上のドリンク、30種以上の日本酒 (新政など)、数量限定の鹿児島の鶏刺し、名古屋コーチンのレバー・ハツ刺し。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 7種の石焼盛り合わせ、自分で焼く、チューリップの唐揚げ、締めのカルボナーラ、5,000円のコース、飲み放題付きのコース。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain the cuts and the stone grill.

places.name: Severance (セヴェランス)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yoshoku with demi-glace, cream croquettes, kataifi-wrapped fried shrimp, katsu sandwiches and bread; no gluten information is published (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A meat- and seafood-led yoshoku menu with a few salads; nothing vegan is marked (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order food 14:00, drinks 14:30); dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Monday and every other Tuesday — see the official Instagram for the calendar (official site; Tabelog). Lunch bookings by phone or Instagram DM (official site). Service charge 5% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料5%」). 14 seats: a 5-seat counter facing the teppan and 9 table seats; private hire for up to 20; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and d Barai (official site; Tabelog). A small house on Sanjo-dori east of the Sanjo bridge, 1 min (110 m) from Sanjo Keihan Stn (official site). Opened 6 January 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-dori east of the Sanjo bridge — 1 min from Sanjo Keihan Stn
places.cuisine: Classic-meets-modern yoshoku with a teppan in front of the counter (official site) · lunch: the "adult’s kids’ lunch" Severance plate, four choices of signature dishes ¥5,000, or the Casual plate, three choices ¥3,800 — e.g. beef hamburg with demi-glace, "angel" fried shrimp wrapped in kataifi with bisque sauce, lobster and crab cream croquette, wagyu sirloin-cap roast beef, fried hamo, with soup, salad and rice or bread (official site; 2026 reviews) · dinner à la carte: wagyu roast-beef temari sushi ¥3,000, rare-fried salmon ¥2,420, chef’s salad ¥2,200, angel fried shrimp ¥3,800, cheese omelette with week-long demi-glace ¥1,430, wagyu lean steak from 100 g ¥5,000 · Standard course, 9 dishes ¥10,000; Special course with foie-gras hamburg and wagyu katsu sandwich ¥17,250 (official site, tax included)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Sanjo bridge, grown-up kids' lunch plates] A small blue-toned house just over the Sanjo bridge where a chef from old-school yoshoku and hotel French kitchens cooks in front of a teppan. Lunch is the famous "adult's kids' lunch": pick three or four of hamburg, kataifi-wrapped giant fried shrimp, crab cream croquette, roast wagyu or fried hamo on one plate (¥3,800–5,000). Dinner is à la carte or courses, with wines chosen by the owner-sommelier; half portions on request. 5% service. Closed Monday and alternate Tuesdays.

roles: Chef; the owner is a sommelier (not named)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: trained at long-established yoshoku restaurants and in hotel French kitchens; after going independent ran ROKUMEI, a pop-up curry shop known for European-style curry and grown-up kids’-plate lunches; cooked at Dining Bar MO-JI in Gion for a year, then became chef at its sister restaurant Severance. Severance ran a five-day pop-up at 404Kitchen in Shibuya Sakura Stage on 8–12 May 2025 (official news). Opened 6 January 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: the name means a dividing line — "beyond the door, a blissful space and food apart from everyday life"; old-style yoshoku such as hamburg and steak, updated for today.
chef_bio.specialty: "Angel" fried shrimp wrapped in kataifi; the adult’s kids’ lunch plate.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular reported that the chef brought back the adult’s kids’ lunch after a break because people kept asking for it, now with Manyo beef in the hamburg.
At an August 2026 à la carte dinner the staff offered half portions, since servings are large.
An August 2026 diner liked the homely mood but found the banter among staff too loud.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (severance-kyoto.com): 京都三条鴨川近くの隠れ家洋食レストラン、三条通に面した小さな一軒家、青を基調とした店内、カウンター前に鉄板、最大14名、クラシックとモダンが重なった洋食、ドリンクはオーナーソムリエが厳選、系列店 Dining Bar MO-JI (祇園)。シェフ 小石修平: 老舗洋食店やホテルのフレンチで修業、独立後に間借りカレー店 ROKUMEI、欧風カレーや大人のお子様プレート、MO-JI で1年料理を担当したのち Severance のシェフ。ランチ: 大人のお子様ランチ、Severance プレート5,000円 (4種)、Casual プレート3,800円 (3種)、予約は電話か Instagram の DM。ディナーのアラカルト: 和牛ローストビーフの手毬寿司3,000円、サーモンレアフライ2,420円、Chef’s サラダ2,200円、天使のエビフライ3,800円、とろっとチーズのオムレツ1,430円、和牛の赤身ステーキ5,000円。コース: Standard 10,000円、Special 17,250円。東山区三条大橋東2丁目82、京阪三条から徒歩1分、ランチ火〜日11:30〜15:00、ディナー18:00〜22:00、月曜・隔週火曜定休、14席、カード可。2025年5月8〜12日に渋谷サクラステージ「404Kitchen」に出店。食べログ: 洋食・ビストロ、サービス料5%、d払い可、2023年1月6日オープン。

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch bookings by phone or Instagram DM.

places.name: 魚料理 あぎやお (Sakana Ryori Agiyao)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal fish served as sashimi with soy, grilled, simmered, fried and in miso dishes; no gluten information is published (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish specialist (official site).
places.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–24:00 per Tabelog; the official site gives lunch from 12:00 and dinner 17:00–23:00. Closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Bookings by phone or online (official site); late bookings such as 21:00 are taken (October 2026). À la carte carries a seat charge of ¥5,500 including two or three of the day’s recommended dishes (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「【アラカルトの場合】席料として5500円（税込）（その日のオススメ2〜3皿含み）」); courses also offered; the à la carte menu shows no prices (November 2025). 10 counter seats (official site; a February 2026 reviewer counted 8); private hire for up to 20; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor above バル agiyao on Higashinotoin north of Gojo; the entrance is a separate door beside the bar, and bar staff point the way (official site; February and October 2026). Opened 10 December 2007 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gojo-Higashinotoin — near Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Fish specialist: the owner’s seasonal seafood and Kyoto vegetables, à la carte or chef’s omakase, with over 20 sakes chosen by a kikizakeshi and white wines by the glass from the bar downstairs (official site) · e.g. sashimi of striped jack, yellowtail, beardfish or trout, Hokkaido uni, koppe-gani crab, charcoal-grilled guchi, fried Spanish mackerel served rare, fried oysters and cod milt with sansho sauce, buri teppai with Kujo negi, monkfish liver, rock oysters in summer, red-miso clam soup (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Seafood · Gojo, a ten-seat fish counter] A wood-scented counter upstairs from the white-wine bar バル agiyao, devoted to seasonal fish: choose sashimi, grilled, simmered and fried dishes one by one, or leave it to the chef, with a deep sake list and wine from downstairs. À la carte has a ¥5,500 seat charge that covers two or three dishes of the day; dinners run ¥15,000–20,000. Use the separate door beside the bar. Open late; closed irregularly.

roles: Head chef not named (changed in late 2025, per reviews); operator 株式会社ＦＯＩＳ (invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a fish specialist with only ten counter seats, a calm grown-up izakaya away from the bustle, cooking the owner’s seasonal seafood and Kyoto vegetables and supporting Kyoto food culture with Kyoto-grown ingredients; sake chosen by a kikizakeshi, white wine from バル agiyao on the 1st floor (a separate record). Reviewers in December 2025 and July 2026 note a new head chef. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ＦＯＩＳ. Opened 10 December 2007 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a time that changes what you think "good fish" is.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal sashimi and charcoal-grilled fish, à la carte.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 guest arriving late from a delayed Shinkansen was met outside by staff and shown through the right door.
A February 2026 diner unsure which door to use was guided upstairs by the bar staff.
A November 2025 diner found the ¥1,000 appetizers arrived only after three dishes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sakana-agiyao.jp): 魚料理 あぎやお、京都 五条、大人のための居酒屋、カウンター10席のみの魚料理専門店、店主が仕入れる旬の魚介と季節の京野菜、一皿ずつアラカルトでも料理長のおまかせでも、唎酒師が厳選した日本酒を常時20種類以上、1階バル agiyao の白ワインもグラスで、京都産の食材で京都の食文化と地元産業を応援、下京区東洞院五条上る深草町592-3 2階、ランチ12:00〜、ディナー17:00〜23:00、不定休。食べログ: 魚介料理・日本料理・居酒屋、17:00〜24:00、アラカルトは席料5,500円 (その日のオススメ2〜3皿含む)、カウンター10席、20名まで貸切可、禁煙、カード可、2007年12月10日オープン、インボイス T1130001073080 (株式会社ＦＯＩＳ)。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 料理長が交代、値段のないメニュー、こっぺ蟹、ぐじの炭火焼き、岩牡蠣、入口は1階のバルの隣。

cultural_comfort.note: The menu shows no prices; ask as you order.

places.name: 祇園 鮨よし田 (Sushi Yoshida)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo dishes and Edomae sushi with soy, plus tempura and fried dishes; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kappo and Edomae sushi built on seafood (official site).
places.hours_raw: Dinner 17:30–21:00, bookings only (official site); Tabelog also lists lunch 11:30–13:30; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Bookings by phone or LINE (official site). Access: reviewers in June 2025, January 2026 and June 2026 describe it as introduction-only (一見さんお断り) and hard to book; the official site invites enquiries. No service charge listed (Tabelog). 10 seats: an 8-seat counter, a raised area for 2 and an upstairs private room for 4; non-smoking; cards, no e-money (Tabelog; official site). In a lane off Hanamikoji in south Gion, 394 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 11 November 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, off Hanamikoji — 394 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kappo and Edomae sushi on red-vinegar rice, à la carte or as a course, with close care over temperature and ageing (official site; Tabelog) · courses: 8 dishes, 10 nigiri and red-miso soup from ¥25,000; kappo of your choice with nigiri from ¥30,000 (official site) · e.g. hamo sashimi, matsutake dobin-mushi, kawahagi with liver sauce, seared mackerel, fugu, monkfish liver, Lake Biwa moroko, grilled eel, turtle hot pot, corn tempura, fried abalone, an uni tasting with Amakusa uni, nigiri of akagai, white shrimp, kuruma ebi, abalone, anago and tuna, futomaki cut to size (reviews 2023–2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Gion, kappo and Edomae sushi as you like it] A ten-seat Gion counter off Hanamikoji where the motto is "what you like, how you like, as much as you like": kappo dishes such as hamo, fugu or turtle hot pot first, then Edomae nigiri on red-vinegar rice, ordered piece by piece or as a course (from ¥25,000; most spend ¥30,000–50,000). Several reviewers describe it as introduction-only and hard to book; the official site takes enquiries by phone or LINE. Dinner, bookings only.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site, signed by the owner 吉田紀彦: kappo and Edomae sushi served in peak condition, with care over the number of dishes, temperature and ageing, matched to each guest’s taste; à la carte, omakase courses or dishes to a budget; a raised area and an upstairs private room for business use. Opened November 2014 in Hanamikoji (Tabelog official introduction).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: 「お好きなものを お好きな様に お好きなだけ」 — what you like, how you like, as much as you like; a food utopia where truly good things can be enjoyed freely.
chef_bio.specialty: Edomae nigiri on red-vinegar rice after à la carte kappo dishes.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner, there by a friend’s introduction, found the chef gentle-mannered and happy to adjust portions to taste.
A June 2025 guest watched the futomaki being cut to a chosen size.
A September 2026 diner returning after seven years ate eight dishes and then 15 pieces of sushi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-yoshida.com): 祇園 鮨よし田、「お好きなものを お好きな様に お好きなだけ」、品数・温度管理・熟成にこだわり割烹と江戸前鮨を最高の状態で、アラカルト・おまかせコース・ご予算に合わせた料理、小上がりと二階個室、店主 吉田紀彦。ディナー17:30〜21:00 (予約のみ)、料理8品・にぎり10貫・赤だし25,000円〜、お好み割烹とにぎり30,000円〜、東山区祇園町南側570-179、予約は電話か LINE。食べログ: 寿司・日本料理、2014年11月花見小路に開店、赤酢のシャリの江戸前鮨、昼11:30〜13:30・夜17:30〜21:00、不定休、10席 (カウンター8、小上がり2、個室4)、カード可。口コミ: 一見さんお断り (2025年6月、2026年1月・6月)、大将は物腰が柔らかく量も調整、基本はアラカルト。

cultural_comfort.note: Reported as introduction-only; bookings by phone or LINE in Japanese.

places.name: 串かつ専門 串文 (Kushikatsu Kushibun)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every skewer is battered and fried; nama-fu (wheat gluten) is on the menu; dipping sauces include a sauce and ponzu (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: vegetable skewers (Manganji pepper, lotus root, yuba, konnyaku, pumpkin) share the fryer and batter with meat and seafood; batter ingredients not stated (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00; irregular closures (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; GoToEat online bookings must order at least ¥2,000 a head (Tabelog). ¥300 cover per person including free cabbage; ¥2,000 a head for a same-day no-show (official site). Cards (VISA, Master) per Tabelog; the official site adds PayPay and Alipay. 17 seats: 6 at the counter, 11 on tatami (official site; Tabelog says 18). Private hire for 15–18. Non-smoking, smoking area (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). Second floor of the Takenaka Building on Shijo-dori, up a staircase; 2–3 min from Hankyu Karasuma exit 26 and subway Shijo exit 2 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori just west of Karasuma — 2 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn exit 26
places.cuisine: Kushikatsu with Kyoto vegetables, in a fine, light batter fried in a blend of six vegetable oils including sesame and rice-bran oil (official site; August 2025 and October 2026) · omakase: skewers keep coming until you say stop (official site) · Kyoto set “Arashiyama” ¥3,280: dashimaki, 15 skewers (beef, shrimp, Manganji pepper, shiso-wrapped sweetfish, conger eel, quail egg, lotus root, konnyaku, shumai, yuba, octopus, eggplant, chikuwa, cherry tomato, yuzu-miso dengaku), nori chazuke, yuzu sorbet (October 2026) · single skewers ¥120–250: beef ¥250, pork ¥200, shrimp ¥250, scallop ¥150, bacon-cheese ¥220, mochi ¥150; dashimaki ¥400 (December 2025) · dipping sauce, ponzu, mayonnaise and sansho; free cabbage refills (October 2026)
places.notes: [Kushikatsu · Shijo Karasuma, since 1972] A small second-floor counter and tatami room on Shijo-dori, founded in Arashiyama in 1972 and here since 2009. Light, finely battered skewers with Kyoto touches — Manganji pepper, yuba, nama-fu, shiso-wrapped sweetfish — fried to order and handed straight to your plate, with free cabbage. Take the ¥3,280 Arashiyama set or the omakase until you say stop; single skewers from ¥120. ¥300 cover.

chef_bio.background: The official site dates the shop to 1972 in Arashiyama; it closed in 2006 and reopened near Karasuma Station in 2009. An August 2025 reviewer, back after more than ten years, read that actors Shun Oguri and Osamu Mukai had visited. A July 2025 diner was thanked by the owner for eating so many skewers.
chef_bio.specialty: Light-battered kushikatsu with Kyoto vegetables.

anecdotes.text: An October 2024 visitor ordered the Manganji pepper skewer about three times.
An August 2025 family on the omakase said the children were thrilled to eat skewers straight out of the fryer.
A February 2025 diner found the oil not well drained and the ochazuke flavourless.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 串かつ専門 串文、下京区四条通新町東入ル月鉾町46 竹中ビル2階 (階段)、阪急烏丸駅26番出口・地下鉄四条駅2番出口から徒歩約3分、17:30〜23:00、不定休、カウンター6席・座敷11席、貸切15〜18名、お通し300円 (キャベツ付き)、当日無断キャンセル2,000円、カード・PayPay・Alipay可、1972年に嵐山で創業、2006年に一度閉店、2009年に烏丸駅近くで再開、おまかせはストップと言うまで。食べログ: 串揚げ・居酒屋、毎日17:30〜23:00、不定休、予約可、18席、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、子ども可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 6種の植物油、細かい衣、京野菜、万願寺とうがらし、湯葉、生麩、京の彩りセット「嵐山」3,280円、1本120〜250円。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter dining with skewers served one by one; ¥300 cover; omakase until you say stop.

places.name: ブション (Le Bouchon)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Lyonnais bistro — grilled hanging tender with fries, braised beef, fish of the day, terrines, cassoulet, gratinée lyonnaise (onion soup with bread and cheese), baguette with every lunch; no gluten information (official menus; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the menus are built on meat, charcuterie and fish; no vegan dish is listed (official menus; Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last entry), dinner 17:30–21:30; closed Thursdays and the second and fourth Mondays (official site; Tabelog gives Thursday only). Monthly opening calendars on the official site. Reservations by phone only, up to a month ahead, on 075-211-5220 between 9:00–11:00, 15:30–17:00 or 21:00–22:00 (official site; Tabelog). Fills by noon on weekdays and holidays; booking advised (2026 reviews). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; November 2026). 32 seats, open terrace, non-smoking, English menu, children welcome (Tabelog). On Teramachi just south of Nijo, 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi just south of Nijo — 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Traditional Lyonnais bistro (Bellecour group page) · lunch: Formule ¥2,100 (main, green salad, bread) or ¥2,600 with dessert; mains of grilled hanging tender with maître d’hôtel butter and fries, beef braised with carrots, meat or fish of the day (official lunch menu); reviewers paid ¥2,500 with drink and dessert (October 2026) · carte: soupe de poisson, gratinée lyonnaise, salads (mushroom and raw ham, endive with Roquefort), sea-bream carpaccio, scallop-and-vegetable terrine with tomato jelly, crab terrine, pâté de campagne, gras-double à la lyonnaise, assiette de cochonnaille, hot saucisson with lentils (official carte, prices not legible) · tripe, cassoulet of duck and pork, lamb, lamb couscous, praline dessert, chocolate cake (2025–2026 reviews) · baguette refills free at lunch (August 2026); wine list praised (August 2026)
places.notes: [Lyonnais bistro · Teramachi-Nijo, cash only] A Parisian-looking bistro with a terrace on Teramachi below Nijo, from the Bellecour group (since 1985). Lunch is the draw: ¥2,100 for salad, free baguette and a main — the grilled hanging tender with fries is the favourite — or ¥2,600 with dessert. At night, Lyonnais classics: gratinée, tripe, cochonnaille, cassoulet. Phone bookings only, at set hours; cash only; fills by noon.

roles: Kitchen (unnamed); operated by the Bellecour group
chef_bio.background: The Bellecour group page (“ベルクールグループ depuis 1985”) lists the salon de thé restaurant オ・タン・ペルデュ and ブション, “伝統的地方料理、リヨン料理” (traditional regional, Lyonnais cooking). No chef is named on the pages opened.
chef_bio.specialty: Lyonnais bistro cooking; grilled hanging tender (onglet).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor came back for the hanging tender before seeing Super Kabuki at Minami-za.
A family celebrated a mother’s 80th birthday over the meat dishes and the praline dessert (September 2026).
An August 2026 diner heard many languages in the room and called it like being abroad.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ベルクールグループ): ブション、伝統的地方料理・リヨン料理、中京区寺町二条榎木町71-1、昼11:30〜14:30 (最終入店)、夜17:30〜21:30閉店、木曜および第2・第4月曜定休、予約は1か月前以内、電話のみ (9〜11時、15時半〜17時、21〜22時)。ランチ: Formule 2,100円 (主菜、サラダ、パン)、2,600円 (デザート付き)、主菜はハラミステーキのメートルドテルバターとポテトフライ、牛肉の人参煮込み、本日の肉料理、本日の魚料理。食べログ: フレンチ・ダイニングバー、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、32席、テラス、禁煙、英語メニュー、ベジタリアン対応、子ども可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ハラミ、トリップ、カスレ、仔羊のクスクス、昼は満席、現金のみ、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); bilingual French–English lunch menu (official site); many international guests (August 2026). Phone-only reservations; cash only.

places.name: 饗応 元 (Kyoou Hajime)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A long menu of small dishes, many with soy sauce, dashi or frying — tempura, karaage, fries, nanban-zuke, croquettes, katsu, gyoza, ramen, pasta, chazuke, cha-soba; no gluten information (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A few vegetable and tofu dishes (hiyayakko, yuba, nama-fu dengaku, baby-leaf salad, fries, grilled nagaimo with soy) and mixed nuts are listed, but seasonings and dashi are not described (official menu).
places.hours_raw: Opens 18:00; last walk-in entry 23:00; with a phone booking made before 23:00, à la carte until as late as 2:00; closes if no guests at 23:00. Irregular closures, some Sundays closed — see the site’s news page (official site; Tabelog). Courses must be booked two days ahead; à la carte seat bookings taken; parties of 5 or more (6 or more per another note) by phone (official site; Tabelog). On the 29th of each month, reservation only: a Kuroge Wagyu “meat day” course ¥10,500 (Tabelog). Service charge 5% (refunded for cash) and one-drink rule (¥500 if no drink) — Tabelog original: サービス料5%（現金の場合キャッシュバック有り）、ワンドリンク制（飲まれない場合はチャージ500円頂きます）. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, two tables for 4; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; official site). Listed as non-smoking, with an ashtray on the table (Tabelog). School-age children only, for the first booking of the day only; children’s meals not prioritised (Tabelog). BYO allowed; sommelier (Tabelog). In a back lane on Ryogaemachi north of Ebisugawa, 3 min from Marutamachi Stn exits 4 and 5 (official site). Opened 6 January 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Back lane on Ryogaemachi north of Ebisugawa — 3 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese cooking “with free ideas” built on washoku, with ideas from an Italian background (official site) · seasonal fish as sashimi, grills, soups and sake snacks; horse sashimi; Kuroge Wagyu (official site) · à la carte (official menu, prices a guide): Japanese mapo tofu ¥1,050, tuna and avocado ¥1,000, Earl Grey-scented duck loin ¥950, gyoza ¥900, Kyoto nama-fu dengaku ¥900, karasumi daikon ¥1,250, Kyoto pickles of suguki, shibazuke and senmaizuke ¥700, A5 Kuroge Wagyu gyudon ¥2,700, homemade ramen ¥1,050, curry of the day from ¥1,100, dashi chazuke ¥950, A5 Wagyu steak from ¥3,000 per 100 g, Ezo deer ¥2,300 per 100 g, hamburg steak with white-mould cheese ¥1,150 · seasonal courses booked two days ahead (official site) · spring rolls including duck-and-sansho keema curry, sakura yukhoe, red snow-crab tomato-cream pasta, karasumi mochi (2026 reviews) · sake chosen by the owner to match each dish, plus whisky, shochu and wine (official site)
places.notes: [Japanese small plates and sake · Marutamachi, open late] A 14-seat house in a back lane near Marutamachi run by an owner qualified as a sake master (酒匠) and sake taster, who picks a sake for each dish and talks you through it. A long à la carte list on a washoku base with Italian-influenced freedom — horse sashimi, Earl Grey duck, karasumi daikon, keema-curry spring rolls, A5 Wagyu gyudon — or a seasonal course booked two days ahead. Last walk-in 23:00; with a call, food until 2:00. 5% service charge (refunded if you pay cash); one drink required.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), 酒匠 (sake master) and 唎酒師 (sake taster)
chef_bio.background: The official site describes the owner as a 酒匠 and 唎酒師 who checks every ingredient personally — seasonal fish, horse meat, Kuroge Wagyu — and builds the dishes on washoku technique with “free ideas cultivated in Italian cooking” (イタリアンで培った自由な発想). Tabelog’s shop text calls 酒匠 an advanced qualification held by few, and notes a KBS Kyoto TV appearance (Angya de Gozaru!!). Reviewers call the owner “a manager like a professor” with “an incredible knowledge of alcohol” who visits breweries (August and October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: “Low threshold, high expertise” (敷居は低く、専門性は高く); a shop where the sake master chooses sake to suit the dish, not a shop with many sakes (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sake pairing; horse sashimi; Kuroge Wagyu.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 group, waiting for change after paying, was surprised with a birthday celebration the group had forgotten to request.
A January 2026 regular on an eleventh visit described sakes matched by temperature and age to duck tataki, horse sashimi, veal yukhoe and grilled eel.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 饗応 元 (キョウオウハジメ)、中京区両替町通夷川上る松竹町135-1、丸太町駅4・5番出口から徒歩約3分、18:00開店、予約なしの最終入店23:00、23:00までの電話予約で最長翌2:00まで、23:00に客がいなければ閉店、不定休 (日曜休業あり)、コースは2日前までに予約、14席。「和食をベースに、自由な発想を加えた料理」、酒匠・唎酒師の店主、「料理に合わせて酒匠が日本酒を選ぶ店」、イタリアンで培った発想、旬魚、馬刺し、黒毛和牛、毎月29日の肉会。メニュー例: 和製麻婆豆腐1,050円、アールグレイ香る鴨ロース950円、カラスミ大根1,250円、大人の牛丼2,700円、自家製ラーメン1,050円など。水曜の担々麺ランチは休止中。食べログ: サービス料5% (現金の場合キャッシュバック有り)、ワンドリンク制 (飲まれない場合はチャージ500円)、カード・電子マネー可、子どもは小学生以上で当日最初の予約のみ、2020年1月6日オープン、KBS京都の番組で紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: The owner explains each dish and sake; tell the owner what you like. 5% service charge (refunded for cash) and a one-drink rule. Children: school-age only, first booking of the day.

places.name: 福栄堂 (Fukueido)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dango and ohagi are rice-based, but no ingredient list is published; the matcha dango is described with a kuzumochi-like texture in bamboo leaf (January 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Dango with bean paste and ohagi are often plant-based, but no ingredient list is published; the 祇園ぷるこちゃん jelly contains collagen and is not vegan (official site).
places.hours_raw: Sunday–Thursday 10:00–22:00, Friday–Saturday 10:00–23:00; no closing days (official site). Tabelog gives Monday–Saturday 10:00–24:00, Sundays and holidays to 22:00, open year-round. Takeaway. Reservations accepted (Tabelog; phone 075-561-3078). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). Online shop (official site). On Yamatooji just north of Shijo, near 壹錢洋食 (same company), 110 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yamatooji just north of Shijo, Gion — 2 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Takeaway Kyoto sweets from a shop with 80 years of history (official site) · Gion no Tsuki (祇園の月) dango, the long-seller since the founding, in smooth bean paste: matchbox-style box of 6, ¥820 (February 2026) to ¥880 (August 2026), with a choice of box designs · Kabuki dango, three colours of bean paste on a skewer, ¥300 (April 2026) · ohagi of chestnut, tsubuan and koshian (February 2026) · matcha dango with chestnut in bamboo leaf (January 2026) · small minazuki, plain and matcha, ¥400 (June 2026) · chilled dango in summer (August 2026) · 祇園ぷるこちゃん matcha anmitsu jelly with collagen (official site)
places.notes: [Dango · Gion, open until 22:00] A small sweets counter on Yamatooji just above Shijo, open late every day, run by the same company as nearby 壹錢洋食. Buy the house dango, Gion no Tsuki — soft rice dumplings in smooth bean paste, six in a matchbox-style box for about ¥880, a pretty souvenir — or a ¥300 three-colour Kabuki dango to eat on the walk, plus ohagi and seasonal minazuki. Mildly sweet.

roles: Shop artisans (unnamed); operated with 壹錢洋食
chef_bio.background: The official site, on the 壹錢洋食 company domain, calls it a Kyoto sweets shop with 80 years of tradition whose dango 祇園の月 has been sold since the founding and are made by the shop’s artisans; the company’s top page thanks maiko and geiko for supporting both 福栄堂 and 壹錢洋食.
chef_bio.specialty: Gion no Tsuki dango.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 buyer was allowed to choose among three box designs and bought one of each.
An April 2026 buyer ordered the plain pack and was charged the boxed price, putting it down to inexperienced staff.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 福栄堂、創業から80年の伝統を持つ京菓子店、自慢のお団子「祇園の月」は創業当時からのロングセラー、コラーゲン入りの「祇園ぷるこちゃん 抹茶あんみつゼリー」、職人の手づくり、日〜木10:00〜22:00、金・土10:00〜23:00、定休日なし、東山区大和大路通四条上る廿一軒町226、オンラインショップあり。壹錢洋食の会社サイトに掲載。食べログ: 和菓子、予約可、カード・PayPay可、テイクアウト、祇園四条駅から110m。口コミ (2026年、英語): 祇園の月のマッチ箱 (6個) 820〜880円、歌舞伎団子300円、栗・つぶあん・こしあんのおはぎ、笹の抹茶団子、水無月400円、甘さ控えめ、夜遅くまで開いている。

cultural_comfort.note: A takeaway counter; point at the dango boxes. Cards and PayPay accepted.

places.name: 075食堂 (075 Shokudo)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, kara-age, bruschetta and dan dan noodles are on the menu (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-first counter — sashimi, yellowtail collar, Omi beef, shuto (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 11:30–13:00 and 16:00–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–22:00 (the shop’s own Tabelog blurb says it opens from 3 pm for daytime drinking). 12 counter seats plus 4 standing places by the door; private hire up to 20 by arrangement; non-smoking; cards (Visa, Master, JCB, Amex, Diners) and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「無し」 (the English auto-translation wrongly says one is added). Opened 13 April 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma Oike — 2 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: A small counter izakaya of fish and sake (Tabelog) · sashimi from fish sent from Maizuru port and market, grilled Omi beef, tempura, obanzai (Tabelog) · one kind of sashimi a day — sanma in September 2025, buri (yellowtail) in October 2025 and January 2026 (reviews) · a "buri festival" day in August 2026: buri sashimi, a big grilled buri collar, buri tempura in shiso (reviews) · bruschetta, spring-greens namul, kara-age, potato salad, shuto, dan dan noodles to finish, homemade ginger ale (2025–2026 reviews) · seasonal sake, e.g. Gangi by the 180 ml (August 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Karasuma Oike counter, fish and sake] A bright, twelve-seat counter two minutes from Karasuma Oike, opened in April 2024: one fish of the day as sashimi — sanma, buri — plus grilled Omi beef, tempura, obanzai and a good run of seasonal sake. A picture menu, and in 2025–2026 the counter often filled with visitors from abroad. One August 2026 diner found the high counter stools awkward. Lunch on weekdays only. No service charge.

roles: Not named in a source; an October 2025 diner chatted with "the master"
chef_bio.background: Opened 13 April 2024 (Tabelog). The shop’s Tabelog blurb describes a stylish counter bar with sashimi from fish delivered from Maizuru port and market, grilled Omi beef, tempura and obanzai, seasonal sake, and daytime drinking welcomed. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a calm, clean, bright counter visible from the street, a menu with photos, and many casual visitors from abroad.
chef_bio.specialty: Fish of the day as sashimi; buri in winter.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 traveller hunting for a second stop was waved in by a friendly regular smoking outside, who recommended the sanma sashimi — "incredibly delicious, with a rich layer of fat."
On a Friday in October 2025 every other seat was taken by tourists from abroad, "leaving me as the only Japanese customer" — and a good chat with the master.
"The counter seats are quite high, which might be uncomfortable for women." — August 2026.
A January 2026 regular came back for the buri collar, found it sold out, and promised "a revenge visit during the delicious winter season."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 075食堂 (ゼロ・ナナ・ゴウ食堂)、居酒屋、中京区笹屋町446-4 ツインイワキ 1F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩2分、月〜金 11:30〜13:00・16:00〜22:00、土日祝 16:00〜22:00、カウンター12席と入口の立ち飲み4、貸切20名まで相談、禁煙、カード・PayPay可、サービス料は原文で「無し」、2024年4月13日オープン、舞鶴の港と市場から届く魚の刺身、近江牛の焼き物、天ぷら、おばんざい、季節の日本酒、昼飲み歓迎。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年8月、英語): 刺身は日替わりで1種 (秋刀魚、鰤)、鰤かまは売り切れのことも、ブルスケッタ、春菜のナムル、唐揚げ、ポテトサラダ、酒盗、締めの担々麺、自家製ジンジャーエール、8月の「鰤祭り」で鰤の刺身・鰤かま・鰤の大葉天ぷら、雁木180ml、写真付きのメニュー、海外からの客が多い、カウンターの椅子が高い、マスターとの会話。

cultural_comfort.note: Picture menu; a counter that often fills with visitors from abroad (2025–2026 reviews).

places.name: 和久 (Waku)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the set course includes tempura (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dashi course with sashimi, tempura and red miso soup (official site); sea bream and Iberico pork in reviews.
places.hours_raw: Official site: reservations only; open about 12:00–21:30 on days and times that are booked, closed otherwise; the site notes Google Maps shows it as temporarily closed but it is open by reservation. Tabelog: lunch 11:30–13:00 and dinner 18:00–20:30 starts, closed irregularly; lunch and dinner are the same course. Bookings by phone (answering machine, call back the next day) or e-mail; the site asks for date, dislikes, wishes, phone number and how you heard of the shop. Hard to book: Tabelog (2022) advises 4–6 months ahead; a 2022 diner said full a year ahead; a January 2025 diner booked the next autumn on leaving. Course about 3½ hours. 9 counter seats (official site; Tabelog says 10); private hire for 6 or more; non-smoking; no cards, e-money or QR — cash only (official site; Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「なし」. No parking. Opened 14 September 2007 (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama, about 2 min walk from the Yasaka Pagoda — 2 min from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop
places.cuisine: One omakase kappo course of Kyoto cooking with the owner’s own ideas (official site) · ¥5,940 tax included: a dashi dish, sashimi, a main, tempura, rice with accompaniments, red miso soup and dashimaki, fruit; changes with the season and the guest (official site) · seen: a whole sea bream filleted at the counter for white-miso and sashimi dishes, Iberico pork hot pot with grated lotus root (February 2024); roasted eggplant mixed with shrimp, tempura, grilled fish, sashimi (November 2024) · spend with drinks ¥6,000–9,999 (2022–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · below the Yasaka Pagoda, the "Waku Theater"] A nine-seat counter on a rickshaw lane two minutes from the Yasaka Pagoda, run since 2007 by 和久 秀郎 (Waku Hiderō). One course, ¥5,940 tax in, about three and a half hours — and regulars call it "Waku Theater" for the owner’s non-stop comic patter. Booking is the hard part: months ahead, by phone or e-mail. Cash only. No service charge.

chef_bio.background: Per his own profile page: born 12 February 1982 in Itami, Hyogo; 174 cm, blood type O. Studied at 育成調理師専門学校 in Hyogo, a three-year cooking school combined with high school, 1997–2000, working part-time in an izakaya, an udon chain and a family restaurant; cook’s licence 2000. From April 2000 worked at ryotei in Kyoto — one with a Kamo River summer platform, one at Nanzenji, one in Nishikyo — then filled in at dozens of kitchens: a sushi kappo in Shinsaibashi, Kibune riverside restaurants, Gion kappo, Kodaiji and Nanzenji inns, hotels in Kusatsu, Nagoya and Kyoto, an Asian restaurant in Otsu. Japanese-cuisine cooking-skills certificate 2007; opened Waku in Higashiyama on 14 September 2007, and kept taking stints elsewhere afterwards; fugu licence 2013. Also lists a heavy-motorcycle licence.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「京料理を主体としながら、私らしい料理も日々考えております」 — Kyoto cooking at the core, with dishes of his own worked out day by day; 「おもてなしの料理を作りたい」.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase kappo course with counter-side talk.

anecdotes.text: "A counter restaurant run by an entertainer owner, simply the best. Three hours of non-stop laughter." — April 2022.
An eight-time regular in July 2024: "Once the dishes start coming out, it truly becomes a Waku Theater, with the chef’s entertaining talks continuously easing the atmosphere."
A January 2025 diner booked the following autumn before leaving: "I wonder if I’ll still be around by then, haha."
A group of former colleagues has met here once a year for ten years; seven came from Tokyo and Kyushu in November 2024.
February 2024: "While they don’t use particularly expensive ingredients, I was impressed by the creativity in each dish."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ryourininn.com): 京都市東山区で割烹を営んでいる和久 (わく)、店主 和久 秀郎 (わく ひでろう)、1982年2月12日生まれ、兵庫県伊丹市出身、身長174センチ、O型、育成調理師専門学校 (三年制高校併用) 1997〜2000年、居酒屋・うどんチェーン・ファミレスでアルバイト、2000年に調理師免許、鴨川納涼床の料亭・南禅寺の料亭・西京区の料亭に就職、その後心斎橋のすし割烹、貴船の川床料理、祇園の割烹、高台寺や南禅寺の料理旅館、草津や名古屋のホテルなどで助勤務、2007年に調理技能士 (日本料理)、2007年9月14日に「和久」経営開始、2013年ふぐ処理師免許、大型二輪免許。人力車の通り道、カウンター9席、京料理を主体に私らしい料理、要予約、留守番電話かメールで予約、12時から21時半ごろ、予約のない日時は営業しない、おまかせ税込5940円 (だし系、御造り、主菜、天ぷら、御飯・赤だし・だし巻き、水物)、約3時間半、6名以上貸切、カード不可、駐車場なし、八坂の塔から徒歩2分、清水道バス停から徒歩2分。食べログ: 日本料理、東山区月輪町96-1、予約のみ、10席、サービス料は原文で「なし」、現金のみ、2007年9月14日オープン。口コミ (2017〜2025年、英語): 「和久劇場」、芸人のような店主の話で3時間笑いっぱなし、予約は数か月〜1年先、鯛を目の前でおろして白味噌と刺身に、イベリコ豚とすりおろし蓮根の鍋、焼き茄子と海老、高い食材ではないが工夫がある。

cultural_comfort.note: The evening is built around the owner’s talk at the counter; booking by phone or e-mail.

places.name: 御所南 かまた (Gosho Minami Kamata)
places.gf_detail: Ask: a kaiseki course with fried dishes (fried koi, fried rock oysters, fried bracken in reviews) and soy-based seasoning; a February 2026 diner thanked the shop for handling a dietary restriction. Raise it when booking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the course is built on dashi — a dashi hot pot is one of its three pillars (official site) — with fish and charcoal-grilled meat.
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 12:00–15:00, dinner 18:00–22:00; closed irregularly; courses only, by reservation only. Prices include tax and there is no service charge (official site). 14 seats: a counter (8 per the Tabelog blurb; a January 2026 diner counted six) and a fully private room for up to 6 (Tabelog); non-smoking; cards and e-money (Tabelog). Online booking offers a course with one drink (August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gosho-minami, a quiet residential street south of the Imperial Palace — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 1
places.cuisine: Kappo kaiseki built on three pillars: a small dashi hot pot, charcoal grilling and a kamameshi rice pot with ingredients of your choice (official site) · lunch courses ¥10,000 / ¥13,000 / ¥18,000; dinner ¥22,000 / ¥28,000; chef’s omakase from ¥40,000; tax included, no service charge (official site) · earlier: lunch ¥9,000 (May and September 2025) · seen: fried koi, sesame tofu with yomogi, aosa hot pot (May 2025); fried rock oysters, koi soup, sanma rice, sakura-shrimp and young-ginger rice (June 2023); koppe crab on request (November 2023); a New Year course with bear meat, Nagano wild boar over binchotan, white-miso zoni, Hiroshima oyster rice (January 2026)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Gosho-minami, dashi pot and kamameshi] A kappo on a quiet street south of the Imperial Palace, run by 鎌田 通: a counter and one private room, courses only. The fixtures are a small hot pot of carefully drawn dashi, a charcoal-grilled course where you pick the grill, and a kamameshi with the ingredient you choose. Lunch from ¥10,000, dinner from ¥22,000, tax in, no service charge. One diner found the rice pot light on ingredients — the leftovers came back as onigiri to take home.

chef_bio.background: Named as owner (店主) on the official site, signed 鎌田 通; reviewers call him Chef Kamata. The Tabelog blurb, written at opening, says the chef brings 20 years of experience, aims to bring out each ingredient’s own flavour and keep fish free of fishy smells so even people who dislike seafood can enjoy it, and pays attention to seasonal plating; the opening was on 12 May (year not given). An August 2026 diner was back after seven years. A February 2025 diner enjoyed chatting with the chef and his wife.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「私どもが何より大切にしているのは、お客様との一期一会です」 — and above all the dashi, drawn to suit each day’s ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: 旨出汁小鍋 (a small dashi hot pot); kamameshi.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner thought the rice pot had fewer ingredients than expected, "but they kindly made the leftovers into onigiri (rice balls) for me to take home" — and thanked the shop for handling a dietary restriction.
On 2 January 2026 the New Year course opened with "Kaiun" sake in place of toso, then bear meat on steamed turnip — "despite the tumultuous year of bear sightings, I felt grateful."
A snowy February 2025: other guests had cancelled for the weather; "as always, I enjoyed chatting with the chef and his wife."
"The fried rock oysters and koi soup have changed my perception entirely." — June 2023.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-kamata.com): 御所南 かまた、京都・御所南の日本料理・割烹、店主 鎌田 通、お客様との一期一会、特に大切にしているのは出汁、旨出汁小鍋・炭火焼き・釜飯 (具材を選んで一釜ずつ) が三つの柱、先附・凌ぎ・旨出汁小鍋・八寸・焼き物・釜飯・水物、個室で顔合わせやお食い初めも、完全予約制のコースのみ、昼10,000円・13,000円・18,000円、夜22,000円・28,000円、大将おまかせ40,000円〜、すべて税込でサービス料なし、中京区堺町通二条下る杉屋町634 Do.Dream杉屋町1階、昼12:00〜15:00・夜18:00〜22:00、不定休、Instagram kamata_gosyominami。食べログ: 日本料理、14席 (カウンター8、個室は6名まで)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、5月12日オープン、料理人歴20年、魚の臭みを抑える、烏丸御池駅1番出口から徒歩5分。口コミ (2023年6月〜2026年8月、英語): 7年ぶりの再訪、鯉の唐揚げ、蓬の胡麻豆腐、岩牡蠣のフライ、鯉こく、秋刀魚ご飯、こっぺ蟹、正月のコースで熊肉・長野の猪の炭火焼き・白味噌の雑煮・広島の牡蠣ご飯、大将と奥さんとの会話、京都の軟水の出汁、食事制限に対応、釜飯の具が少なめだったが残りをおにぎりにして持ち帰り。

cultural_comfort.note: Courses with choices to make (grill, rice-pot ingredient); a quiet counter.

places.name: 洋食 ヒグチ亭 (Higuchi Tei)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: mains include a cod gratin, sole meunière and a hamburg steak; quiche on the starter platter (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every main is meat or fish (official site); courses end in dessert or cheese.
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:30–21:30 (last order 20:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog lists lunch to 16:00). One order per person; no children under 6; hard to reach by phone in service — call 9:30–11:00, 16:00–17:00 or after 21:00; more than 15 minutes late may be cancelled; same-day cancellation ¥2,000 a person; parties of two or fewer may be moved to a different seat type (official site). Tabelog notice: "As I am currently operating alone, I kindly ask for your patience as service may take a little longer." 8 seats — three tables and a counter (Tabelog; August 2026); non-smoking; cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog or the official site. Opened 10 April 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma Oike — 4–5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: A one-cook yoshoku bistro of set courses (official site) · Course A ¥4,000: starter platter, one main, dessert or cheese, coffee or tea; Course B ¥4,500: two smaller mains; Course C ¥5,000: two mains (official site) · mains: Kyoto kuroge wagyu hamburg steak, cod gratin with curry, scallops à la nage, sole meunière, pork grill with sauce condiment, Kyoto kuroge wagyu braised in red wine (+¥500) (official site) · starters seen: daily assorted platter with quiche and pepper jelly, marinated fresh fish, smoked salmon; desserts: peach melba (2026 reviews) · wine, a three-glass wine set ¥1,500 (August 2026) · ordering by QR code (August 2026)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Karasuma Oike, one-cook bistro courses] An eight-seat yoshoku bistro near Karasuma Oike, cooked and served by one person: pick a ¥4,000–5,000 course from a starter platter, mains like sole meunière, cod gratin with curry or Kyoto wagyu in red wine, then dessert or cheese. Reviewers in 2026 call it outstanding value; some warn the solo service is unhurried. No children under 6; ¥2,000 same-day cancellation. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner-chef, not named; runs the shop alone (Tabelog notice)
chef_bio.background: Opened 10 April 2015 (Tabelog). The Tabelog notice says the shop is currently run by one person, so service may take longer. Reviewers in 2026 describe a compact room of three tables and a counter, the chef cooking and serving alone even when full, set courses ordered by QR code, Kyoto vegetables and local meat, and a daily-changing starter platter.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tabelog blurb: carefully chosen ingredients such as Kyoto vegetables and local meat, all at reasonable prices.
chef_bio.specialty: Course A with sole meunière or wagyu braised in red wine.

anecdotes.text: "It was impressive to see the chef managing everything on his own, especially since the place was fully booked on the day of my visit." — August 2026.
A September 2026 diner had hesitated over reviews of slow solo service, but "found that the timing was just right while enjoying my drinks."
A May 2026 diner planned a whole trip around it: "After confirming that I could make a reservation, I arranged my hotel and transportation."
A first-timer in August 2026 took Course B and "vowed to stick with the A course with one main dish on my next visit."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 洋食 ヒグチ亭 (Restaurant HIGUCHITEI)、ランチ11:30〜15:30 (LO 14:00)、ディナー17:30〜21:30 (LO 20:30)、火曜休み、中京区瓦之町373 メイゾン東洞院、1人ワンオーダー制、6歳未満は入店不可、電話は9:30〜11:00・16:00〜17:00・21:00以降、15分以上の遅れはキャンセルの場合あり、当日キャンセルは1人2000円、2名以下は席のタイプが変わる場合あり、Aコース4000円 (前菜の盛り合わせ、メイン1品、デザートかチーズの盛り合わせ、コーヒーか紅茶)、Bコース4500円 (メイン2品、小さめ)、Cコース5000円、メイン: 京都産黒毛和牛ハンバーグ、たらのカレー風味グラタン、帆立貝のア・ラ・ナージュ、舌平目のムニエル、ポークグリル コンデュマンソース、京都産黒毛和牛 赤ワイン煮込み (+500円)、ワイン多数。食べログ: 洋食・カフェ・ビストロ、8席、禁煙、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・PayPay可、2015年4月10日オープン、現在一人で営業しているため提供に時間がかかる場合あり、京都の野菜と地元の肉、日替わりの前菜の盛り合わせ。口コミ (2026年4月〜9月、英語): 一人で切り盛り、満席でも一人、テーブル3つとカウンター、QRコードで注文、ピーチメルバ、鯛の白ワインソース、ペッパーゼリー、キッシュ、スモークサーモン、グラスワイン3杯セット1,500円、5月に少し値上げ、コスパが非常に高い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code from a short course menu; no children under 6.

places.name: ぶゞ家 (Bubuya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Rice, pickles, miso soup and ochazuke with hojicha; pickles and toppings are not described for gluten (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The core is rice, pickles and tea, but miso soup and toppings such as chirimen-jako and eel are not plant-based (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No bookings; the pickle shop ぎおん川勝 in front opens at 10:00 (Tabelog; April 2026). 12 seats at tables; English menu; children welcome, kids' menu; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking; cards (VISA, JCB), IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Inside ぎおん川勝, a stone's throw from Yasaka Shrine; 2 min from the Gion bus stop (Tabelog; April 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gion north of Shijo by Yasaka Shrine — Gion bus stop
places.cuisine: Bubu-zuke (Kyoto ochazuke) set meals at a pickle maker: about seven kinds of house pickles with rice served from a wooden ohitsu, miso soup and hot hojicha to pour over — bubu-zuke ¥1,815 (June 2026); chirimen-sansho or grilled-eel chazuke; rice refills ¥200, but not with the chirimen-jako rice (2025–26 reviews) · pickles to take away from ぎおん川勝: celery, mibuna, burdock, umeboshi (2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Ochazuke & pickles · Gion by Yasaka Shrine] The little dining room of the Gion pickle shop ぎおん川勝: a colourful spread of house pickles, glossy rice from a wooden tub and hojicha to make bubu-zuke (Kyoto ochazuke) — about ¥1,815, or with chirimen-sansho or eel. A gentle breakfast-lunch near Yasaka Shrine; buy pickles on the way out. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Restaurant of the pickle shop ぎおん川勝 (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the eat-in room of ぎおん川勝, relocated from 祇園町北側292-2; the pickle shop opens an hour before the dining room (April 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Bubu-zuke with house pickles.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner found the pickles average but the umeboshi exceptional.
Arriving fifteen minutes before opening in June 2026, a couple were invited to wait at a table in the shop and read the menu.
A February 2026 regular wished the strong tea were milder for ochazuke.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ぶゞ家、お茶漬け・日本料理、東山区祇園町北側297 ぎおん川勝、市バス祇園から徒歩2分、11:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:30)、水曜休み、予約不可、12席 (テーブル)、英語メニュー、子供可・キッズメニュー、車椅子可、禁煙、カード (VISA・JCB)・電子マネー・PayPay 可、祇園町北側292-2から移転。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年10月、英語): 7種ほどの漬物、おひつのご飯、味噌汁、ほうじ茶、ぶぶ漬け1,815円、ちりめん山椒、鰻のお茶漬け、ご飯のおかわり200円 (ちりめんご飯は不可)、川勝は10時開店、梅干し、セロリや壬生菜や牛蒡の漬物の持ち帰り。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); walk in.

places.name: ボクのスタンド 四条烏丸店 (Boku no Stand Shijo Karasuma)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori with sauce, chicken-katsu curry, ponzu dishes; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori bar (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–23:00; Sat and holidays 12:00–23:00; Sun 12:00–22:00 (last orders an hour before close) (Tabelog). Bookings taken; all-you-can-drink courses from ¥4,000 (Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし" (its English says 10% is added). QR ordering and Wi-Fi (2026 reviews). Standing bar on the ground floor, four tables for four upstairs; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners) (Tabelog; September 2026). In a back alley on the west side of Daimaru Kyoto; 3 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Behind Daimaru near Shijo-Karasuma — 3 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Popular izakaya and standing bar of "dodeka" (giant) yakitori: the signature giant liver skewer, ¥99 for the first one (2026 reviews), negima, chicken skin and neck with ponzu, garlic chives with liver, steak; chicken-katsu "Boku Suta" curry set at lunch; drinks from a liquor-store-style range, mega mugs of beer (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakitori standing bar · behind Daimaru near Shijo-Karasuma] The third shop of a popular Kyoto–Osaka standing-bar brand, opened June 2026: giant yakitori skewers — the first giant liver is ¥99 — chicken skin with ponzu and curry to finish, from lunch to 23:00. About ¥2,000–4,000. QR ordering; no service charge per Tabelog's Japanese text.

chef_bio.background: Opened 11 June 2026 (Tabelog). Per the operator's press release (PR TIMES, 2026): a third shop after 四条大宮店 and 梅田店, standing on the ground floor and tables upstairs, the signature being a giant liver skewer.
chef_bio.specialty: Giant liver yakitori.

anecdotes.text: An old friend's "quick standing drink" turned into a two-hour stay — August 2026.
A September 2026 diner found drinks a bit pricey and the skewers slow to arrive.
A September 2026 guest praised the thoughtful staff, "especially the manager".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ボクのスタンド 四条烏丸店、居酒屋・焼き鳥、中京区阪東屋町664-29、烏丸駅から徒歩3分、月〜金 11:30〜14:30・17:00〜23:00、土祝 12:00〜23:00、日 12:00〜22:00、サービス料: なし、20席 (4人掛けテーブル4卓と立ち飲み)、禁煙、カード可、2026年6月11日オープン、名物デカ焼鳥、ドデカレバー、酒屋ならではの飲み物、4,000円からの飲み放題コース。PR TIMES (2026年): 四条大宮店、梅田店に続く3店舗目。口コミ (2026年8〜9月、英語): レバー1本目99円、ねぎま、鶏皮とせせりのポン酢、ニラレバ、ステーキ、ランチのチキンカツカレー、QR 注文、大丸の西の路地。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering; standing downstairs, tables upstairs.

places.name: 鰻屋 瀬がわ (Unagiya Segawa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Eel grilled with a soy-based tare, dashi for hitsumabushi, dashimaki; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–21:30 (last order 21:00), daily (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). 38 seats incl. sunken-floor seats and a semi-private room for two; English menu with photos; children welcome; non-smoking, smoking area outside; cards incl. UnionPay, PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). In a machiya down a stone-paved alley on Shinmachi-dori north of Nishiki; 10 min from Karasuma or Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi-dori north of Nishiki — 10 min from Karasuma or Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kansai-style eel, prepared and skewered at the shop and grilled crisp over binchotan with a light tare (2026 reviews) · premium unaju (one eel); premium eel rice in a clay pot kept hot on lava stones, finished as ochazuke; hitsumabushi with Kujo negi and dashi; grilled eel with ikura; dashimaki; refillable pickles; freshly ground sansho and a house sansho-shichimi blend (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Unagi · machiya off Shinmachi-Nishiki] A calm eel house down a stone-paved alley, opened in 2025, grilling Kansai-style — crisp skin, soft flesh — over binchotan: unaju, hitsumabushi, or eel rice in a clay pot on hot stones. About ¥5,000–8,000. English menu; open daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 27 August 2025 (Tabelog). An August 2026 reviewer watched each eel prepared and skewered at the front of the shop and grilled Kansai-style over binchotan; a September 2026 reviewer calls it one of Japan's selected restaurants of 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Kansai-style unaju; clay-pot eel rice.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner found it upscale yet "quite reasonable" in price, and liked that Kujo negi replaced ordinary leeks in the hitsumabushi.
An October 2026 guest, no fan of sweet sauces, ate the eel with sansho instead and asked for the pickles again and again.
An October 2026 return visitor came back from the eel with ikura to the premium unaju.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 鰻屋 瀬がわ、日本料理・うなぎ・海鮮、中京区新町通錦小路上る百足屋町380、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩10分、11:00〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:00〜21:30 (L.O. 21:00)、無休、38席、2名の半個室、掘りごたつ、英語メニュー、子供可、禁煙 (喫煙所は外)、カード・PayPay・Alipay 可、2025年8月27日オープン。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 店の前で捌いて串打ち、備長炭の関西焼き、上鰻重、土鍋の鰻ご飯を溶岩石で、お茶漬けに、ひつまぶしと九条ねぎ、いくらのせ、だし巻き、漬物のおかわり、挽きたての山椒、2026年の名店に選出との記述。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with photos (Tabelog); book for dinner.

places.name: 聖護院 嵐まる (Shogoin Ranmaru)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Simmered and grilled fish, tempura, sushi, crab pasta and nyumen; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish izakaya with wagyu and chicken too (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). Bookings taken, by phone (Tabelog; August 2026); matsutake can be set aside on request when booking (November 2025). The menu shows almost no prices (September 2026). 20 seats: a counter and a small raised tatami area; non-smoking; JCB and AMEX (Tabelog; August 2026). Near Kumano Shrine and Heian Shrine — 2 min from the Kumano-jinja-mae bus stop, 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shogoin near Kumano Shrine — 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Fish izakaya where much of the fish is caught by the owner: big simmered fish with burdock, grilled flounder head, firefly squid, fish tempura, mozuku with octopus and crab, baby octopus, saba sushi and sushi, crab pasta, a Ranmaru salad, black wagyu steak, grilled Kyoto chicken with Kujo negi, a mini uni and ikura bowl, nyumen; fried matsutake and dobin-mushi in autumn; Sado sake (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Fish izakaya · Shogoin near Heian Shrine] A neighbourhood fish izakaya of some 30 years where the friendly owner catches much of the fish — simmered fish double the usual size, grilled flounder head, saba sushi — with Sado sake. Few prices on the menu; about ¥6,000–8,000. Open late; handy after a show at the nearby theatre. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner (unnamed; an angler who catches much of the fish, per 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a fish izakaya loved by locals for about 30 years (September 2026); many of the fish are caught by the chef (July 2026); the house sake comes from Sado (June–July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Simmered and grilled fish; saba sushi.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 returnee asked when booking for matsutake to be set aside, and had them fried.
A June 2026 diner recognised a rare Sado sake last tasted on Sado ten years before.
After a show at a nearby theatre in August 2026, a guest phoned around 9 pm and found the shop full even on a weekday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 聖護院 嵐まる、海鮮・居酒屋、左京区聖護院山王町28-58、京阪神宮丸太町駅2番出口から徒歩8分、熊野神社前バス停から徒歩2分、火〜日 17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、月曜休み、20席、カウンターと座敷、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX)。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年9月、英語): 平目の頭の焼き物、ホタルイカ、魚の天ぷら、蛸と蟹のもずく酢、煮付け、飯蛸、鯖寿司、寿司、蟹のパスタ、嵐まるサラダ、黒毛和牛のステーキ、九条ねぎと京都の鶏、雲丹といくらの小丼、にゅうめん、松茸の唐揚げと土瓶蒸し、Sado の酒、店主が釣った魚、約30年、値段のない品書き。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; few prices on the menu.

places.name: All Day Dining & Lounge Bar OPEN (DoubleTree by Hilton Kyoto Higashiyama)
places.gf_detail: Ask. An international hotel menu — breakfast, lunch sets, afternoon tea with sandwiches and scones, Western courses with breadcrumb-crusted fish and bread — alongside Japanese set meals; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Fruit, congee, a yuba set meal and warabi mochi appear, but most dishes include meat, fish, egg or dairy; no vegan information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily: breakfast 7:00–10:00 on weekdays and 6:30–10:00 at weekends and holidays (last order 9:45); lunch 11:30–14:30; café 14:30–16:00 (last order 15:30); dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); bar 11:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); open to non-guests; hours may vary over New Year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). 13% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料13%); a grilled-salmon set was ¥2,400 including tax and service (April 2025). 84 seats: 50 in the restaurant, 8 at the bar counter, 26 in the lounge; non-smoking, smoking area on B1 (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). In the lobby of DoubleTree by Hilton Kyoto Higashiyama; 1 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn exit 2 (Keihan) (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Hotel lobby by Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn — 1 min walk
places.cuisine: All-day hotel dining of genre-free, internationally inspired dishes with Kyoto touches, by a chef with 28 years' experience (Tabelog) · e.g. Tanba chicken with seasonal vegetables and romesco on shio-koji, a lunch with one drink (Tabelog); Mediterranean octopus salad, ocean trout crusted with Kujo-negi breadcrumbs with lime cream and polenta (June 2026); a spring Western course with cherry-blossom touches (May 2026) · Japanese set meals: yuba gozen (January 2025), grilled salmon set ¥2,400 incl. tax and service (April 2025) · afternoon tea in a stand of glass boxes — yuba-wrapped teriyaki chicken sandwich, egg sandwich, matcha and black-bean scone (April 2025) · coffee ¥800 (January 2026); shaved ice in summer (July 2024); congee, fruit, Japanese tea and warabi mochi (June 2026) · seasonal fairs, e.g. Korean royal cuisine supervised by chef Sung Hoon Ahn (October–December 2024) · about ¥2,000–5,000 (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Hotel all-day dining · Kiyomizu-Gojo, open to all from breakfast] The DoubleTree by Hilton Kyoto Higashiyama's lobby restaurant, a calm Japanese-styled room open to non-guests from breakfast to a late bar: international plates with Kyoto touches (Kujo-negi crusted trout, Tanba chicken with romesco), Japanese sets such as yuba gozen, and an afternoon tea in glass boxes. A minute from Kiyomizu-Gojo station, popular with visitors from abroad. 13% service. Open daily.

chef_bio.chef_name: Agatha Phoebic Tobias (as given on Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the all-day dining restaurant of DoubleTree by Hilton Kyoto Higashiyama, serving genre-free dishes inspired by world cuisines and by Kyoto, open to all guests whether staying or not; Tabelog names the chef as "Agatha Phoebic Tobias with 28 Years of Chef Experience". Reviewers mention seasonal fairs (a Korean royal-cuisine fair supervised by chef Sung Hoon Ahn, October–December 2024) and many guests from Western countries (June 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Providing cuisine unbound by genre" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Afternoon tea; Kyoto-inflected Western plates.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor, a little early for tea time, was welcomed in and took a corner seat with a view of cranes — ¥800 coffee "worth it".
"I arrived at my reservation time, but I had to wait over 15 minutes because the previous guests hadn't finished, which was disappointing." — September 2025.
"Since this is Kyoto, there were quite a few tourists from Western countries." — June 2026, noting fruit and congee on the menu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食・肉料理・カフェ、東山区本町1-45 ダブルツリーbyヒルトン京都東山 ロビー、京阪清水五条駅2番出口から徒歩1分、毎日、朝食 平日7:00〜10:00・土日祝6:30〜10:00、ランチ11:30〜14:30、カフェ14:30〜16:00、ディナー17:00〜22:00、バー11:30〜23:00、宿泊客以外も利用可、予約可、サービス料13%、84席 (店内50、バーカウンター8、ラウンジ26)、禁煙 (B1に喫煙所)、カード可、ジャンルにとらわれない料理、料理人歴28年のシェフ、Tanba の鶏と季節野菜のロメスコソースと塩麹のランチ。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年6月、英語): 地中海風のたこのサラダ、九条ねぎのパン粉焼きのオーシャントラウト、湯葉御膳、焼き鮭の定食2,400円 (税・サ込み)、ガラスの箱のアフタヌーンティー (湯葉巻きの照り焼きチキンサンド、卵サンド、抹茶と黒豆のスコーン)、コーヒー800円、かき氷、お粥、わらび餅、韓国宮廷料理フェア (2024年)、欧米の客が多い、予約時間に15分以上待ったとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel restaurant, open to non-guests; 13% service; cards accepted.
