places.name: 割烹 吉膳 (Kappou Yoshizen)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal kappo courses with dashi, white miso, soy-based sauces and grated-daikon dishes; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-focused courses of sea urchin, nodoguro, yellowtail, fugu and calf's liver, on dashi (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–14:30 (food last order 13:00; lunch by reservation at least two days ahead) and 17:00–22:00 (food last order 20:00); open year-round (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). Overseas guests can book the private room only if someone proficient in Japanese comes, and the shop then replies by phone (Tabelog). Courses, e.g. ¥17,000 (May 2024); bills about ¥15,000–30,000 (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews). 18 seats: a 10-seat hinoki counter and a retro-modern private room upstairs for up to 8; designated smoking area (Tabelog). Cards and QR (Tabelog). A machiya on the lane east of Shimogawara, by the north gate of Kodaiji; 3 min walk from Yasaka Shrine and Kodaiji, 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: By Kodaiji's north gate, south of Yasaka Shrine — 10 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Counter kappo of seasonal creative dishes for 27 years, with the owner sourcing fish and vegetables from across Japan (Tabelog) · courses, e.g. ¥17,000 starting with sea urchin and cabbage and junsai (May 2024) · e.g. canola flowers with sea urchin, squid with sea cucumber, calf's liver, Kaga lotus root with shrimp konjac in grated daikon, a fugu-brain sauce, nodoguro, steamed sticky rice with goby, Horikawa burdock, buri daikon (January 2024); swordfish, sea-urchin sashimi, white-miso soup (August 2026) · chilled sake such as Somai (November 2024) · about ¥15,000–30,000 (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · by Kodaiji's north gate, an engineer turned cook] A machiya counter on a quiet lane between Yasaka Shrine and Kodaiji, where a former engineer who says "cooking is logical" has served seasonal creative kappo for 27 years, sourcing fish and vegetables from across Japan: sea urchin with canola flowers, nodoguro, fugu-brain sauce, buri daikon, white-miso soup. Courses about ¥15,000–20,000. Explanations in English at the counter; the upstairs private room needs a Japanese speaker for overseas guests. Lunch by booking two days ahead.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: serving creative dishes that reflect the seasons for 27 years; the owner, a former engineer who found a calling in cooking ("Cooking is logical"), sources seasonal seafood and vegetables from across Japan. Reviewers mention the owner and the head chef (November 2024), a single chef preparing each dish with care (August 2026), and explanations of ingredients in English (January 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Cooking is logical" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fish course; white-miso soup.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 visitor from abroad found the chef explained the ingredients thoroughly in English — and received a discount at the end of the meal.
An August 2026 diner, on a humid night eased by a passing shower, watched a single chef prepare and plate each dish with care.
"Although the selection of drinks is limited, the chilled sake is exceptionally delicious" — November 2024, recommending Somai.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、東山区祇園下河原高台寺北門前通東入ル鷲尾町503-14、祇園四条駅から徒歩10分、八坂神社・高台寺から徒歩3分、毎日 12:00〜14:30 (料理L.O.13:00、昼は2日前までに予約)・17:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.20:00)、無休、完全予約制、海外の客が個室を希望する場合は日本語の堪能な人がいれば可能で電話で対応、18席 (檜のカウンター10、2階のレトロモダンな個室8名まで)、分煙、カード・QR 可、季節を映す創作料理を27年、「料理は理論」元エンジニアの店主、店主が全国から旬の魚介と野菜を仕入れる。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年8月、英語): 17,000円のコース (うにとキャベツ、じゅんさい)、菜の花とうに、いかとなまこ、仔牛のレバー、加賀れんこんと海老しんじょうのおろし、ふぐを使ったソース、のどぐろ、ハゼの蒸しおこわ、堀川ごぼう、ぶり大根、かじきの焼き物、うにのお造り、白味噌のお椀、日本酒「Somai」、英語で食材の説明、店主と料理長。

cultural_comfort.note: English explanations at the counter (January 2025); overseas guests need a Japanese speaker to book the private room (Tabelog); reservation only.

places.name: 夷川 燕楽 (Ebisugawa Enraku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto oden in soy-based dashi with fish cakes, plus tempura, agedashi tofu and chilled udon; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden simmered in dashi with beef tendon and egg; sashimi and grilled fish (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday to Thursday and Sunday 17:00–22:30 (food last order 21:30); Friday and Saturday 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00); closed Monday and two Tuesdays a month (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No table charge (Tabelog original チャージ料なし). 65 seats: an 8-seat counter by the open kitchen, private rooms on the ground floor (one with a sunken kotatsu), and a tatami hall for up to 40 upstairs; non-smoking, smoking area outside; projector, free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). A former furniture shop on Ebisugawa-dori west of Fuyacho, south of the Imperial Palace; 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Ebisugawa-dori west of Fuyacho — 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Oden izakaya between izakaya and kaiseki, with a wide Kyoto menu (2026 reviews) · Kyoto-style oden: daikon, beef tendon, egg (July 2026) · kombu-cured sea bream, sashimi, agedashi tofu, yuba (June–August 2026) · tempura of fig with sesame sauce and of corn (July 2026) · grilled sweetfish, a corn grilled rice ball to finish (August 2026); Kamo eggplant with sauce and chilled udon in a nine-dish course (July 2026); yellowtail ajillo (August 2026) · local sake and white wine (2026 reviews) · about ¥3,000–6,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Oden · Ebisugawa south of the Palace, a furniture shop turned izakaya] A big townhouse that was once a furniture shop, now an oden izakaya with a red-toned counter by the open kitchen, private rooms and a tatami hall upstairs. Kyoto oden is the draw — daikon soaked through, beef tendon, egg — with fig and corn tempura, kombu-cured sea bream, grilled sweetfish and a yellowtail ajillo; about ¥4,000 a head. Taxi drivers know it. No table charge. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a well-known local spot (a taxi driver recognised it, July 2026), a renovated former furniture shop with a red-themed interior, an open-kitchen counter, private rooms and a second-floor tatami hall, and a menu centred on oden with seasonal dishes. One July 2026 diner wished the course dishes had come with explanations.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto oden; fig tempura.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 traveller told a taxi driver the destination and found the driver knew it at once.
A July 2026 diner had never tried fig tempura before and was surprised how good it was with the oden.
"If I had to nitpick, I would say it was a bit disappointing that all the dishes were served without any explanation." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・おでん・日本料理、中京区夷川通麩屋町西入ル北側、市役所前駅から徒歩5分、火・水・木・日 17:00〜22:30 (料理L.O.21:30)、金・土 17:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00)、月曜と月2回の火曜休み、予約可、チャージ料なし、65席 (カウンター8、1階に個室、2階に最大40名の座敷)、掘りごたつの個室、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、プロジェクター、Wi-Fi、カード可。口コミ (2026年6月〜8月、英語): 家具屋を改装、赤い内装、京風おでん (大根、牛すじ、卵)、鯛の昆布締め、お造り、揚げ出し豆腐、湯葉、無花果の天ぷらの胡麻だれ、とうもろこしの天ぷら、鮎の塩焼き、とうもろこしの焼きおにぎり、賀茂茄子のあんかけ、冷やしうどん、ぶりのアヒージョ、地酒、1人4,000円ほど、タクシーの運転手も知っている、料理の説明がなかったとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter by the open kitchen, private rooms upstairs; no table charge; cards accepted.

places.name: キャトルセゾン (quatre saison)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery of croissants, bagels, French-bread sandwiches, paninis and curry bread (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain hard breads may be plant-based, but croissants, cream buns, bagels with white chocolate and the meat sandwiches use butter, dairy, egg or meat; no ingredient information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday to Saturday 7:00–19:00; closed Sunday and Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Takeaway; a small shop that sells out by mid-afternoon (April–May 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; May 2026). On Marutamachi-dori east of Kawabata, near Kumano Shrine; 5–8 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; April 2026).
places.neighborhood: Marutamachi east of Kawabata, near Kumano Shrine — 8 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small bakery of seasonal breads, sweet and savoury, hard and soft (2025–2026 reviews) · Setoka croissant ¥350, fromage currants ¥310, strawberry croissant ¥410, cream-filled croissant, bacon and egg croissant (April–May 2026) · matcha and white-chocolate bagel, mentaiko French bread, anpan, chocolate melon bread (September–December 2025) · French-bread sandwiches, a large mixed sandwich, paninis, sausage chili dog with béchamel, vegetable curry with French bread, curry bread with meat (2025–2026 reviews) · cream buns with homemade custard, canelé, raisin oatmeal cookies (2026 reviews) · mostly under ¥1,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Bakery · Marutamachi by Kumano Shrine, open from 7] A small, calm bakery on Marutamachi near Kumano Shrine, open from 7 am, with seasonal breads both savoury and sweet: Setoka and strawberry croissants, a matcha and white-chocolate bagel, mentaiko French bread, paninis, a béchamel chili dog and custard cream buns, mostly ¥300–400 apiece. Go early — it sells out by mid-afternoon. Cash only. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a small, quiet shop named for the four seasons (November 2025), friendly staff (May 2026), local customers and visitors from abroad (December 2025; May 2026), and an older man baking while a woman runs the register (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal croissants; panini; bagels.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 customer found the matcha and white-chocolate bagel "amazing when reheated, as the chocolate melted just right."
"An older gentleman cooks while a woman manages the register" — October 2026, a regular who loves the paninis and the 7 am Saturday opening.
An April 2026 visitor arriving at 2 pm on a weekday found little left on the shelves.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン・ベーグル・サンドイッチ、左京区丸太町通川端東入ル東丸太町39-5、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩8分、熊野神社前のバス停、火〜土 7:00〜19:00、日・月休み、予約可、現金のみ、禁煙、テイクアウト、子ども可。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 店名はフランス語で「四季」、小さく落ち着いた店、せとかのクロワッサン350円、フロマージュカランツ310円、苺のクロワッサン410円、クリームのクロワッサン、ベーコンエッグのクロワッサン、抹茶とホワイトチョコのベーグル、明太フランス、あんぱん、チョコのメロンパン、バゲットのサンドイッチ、ミックスサンド、パニーニ、ソーセージのチリドッグ (ベシャメル)、野菜カレーとバゲット、肉入りのカレーパン、自家製カスタードのクリームパン、カヌレ、レーズンとオートミールのクッキー、午後は品薄、年配の男性が作り女性がレジ。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the breads; go early; cash only.

places.name: 串鉄板ぞろんぱ 室町仏光寺店 (Kushi Teppan Zoronpa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan-grilled skewers with sauces, okonomiyaki, pasta, croquettes and fried dishes (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat and seafood skewers on a shared teppan; the starters include dashi dishes (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Thursday, with some extra closures listed on Tabelog (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥600 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「お通し代600円」). 28 seats at a counter facing the skewer display, plus private and semi-private rooms; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog; February 2025). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). On Muromachi south of Bukkoji; 3 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 20 March 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Muromachi Bukkoji — 3 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Over 40 original skewers grilled on a teppan — Japanese, Italian and teppan styles fused, from shrimp chili and ebi-mayo to tandoori chicken — plus market fish and about 100 wines picked by a sommelier (Tabelog, shop text; 2025–26 reviews) · omakase of 3 or 5 skewers, or à la carte, each skewer split in two for sharing (January and October 2025) · sashimi, horse yukhoe, braised beef tendon, non-fried crab cream croquette, cream-cheese-stuffed mushrooms, duck with blueberry sauce, fried shrimp with yam (2024–26 reviews) · okonomiyaki with tartar sauce, yakisoba, garlic rice, pasta made to request (2025–26 reviews) · two people paid ¥17,580 à la carte (January 2025)
places.notes: [Teppan skewers · Shijo Muromachi, Japanese-Italian on the griddle] A calm counter south of Shijo where a former Italian cook grills over 40 kinds of skewers on a teppan — ebi-mayo, shrimp chili, tandoori chicken — alongside market sashimi, a tartar-topped okonomiyaki and pasta made to order, with a hundred wines. Skewers come halved for sharing. ¥600 appetizer charge. Open to midnight; closed Thursday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), a former Italian cook (January 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): Zoronpa’s "new challenge" of skewers grilled on the teppan, fusing Japanese, Italian and teppan cooking, with a sommelier’s wines; opened 20 March 2018. Tabelog lists two other Zoronpa shops in Kyoto; an October 2022 diner noted several branches and rusks sold as souvenirs. A January 2025 diner was told the chef is a former Italian cook.
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan-grilled skewers; okonomiyaki.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular brought friends from Tokyo and Hyogo, who praised the staff’s hospitality.
A February 2025 diner found the crab cream croquette unlike any other — not fried at all.
A March 2026 diner asked for a pasta by sauce and ingredients and had it made to order.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 串焼き・鉄板焼・海鮮、下京区室町通仏光寺下ル山王町542、四条駅から徒歩3分、17:30〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、木曜休み (ほか臨時休業あり)、予約可、お通し代600円、28席 (カウンター、個室、半個室)、貸切20〜50名、カード・PayPay 可、2018年3月20日オープン、40種以上のオリジナルの鉄板串、和とイタリアンと鉄板、ソムリエの約100種のワイン。口コミ (2022年10月〜2026年9月、英語): 海老マヨ、海老チリ、串は半分に切って出す、刺身、馬肉のユッケ、牛すじ、揚げない蟹クリームコロッケ、タルタルのお好み焼き、ガーリックライス、注文に応じたパスタ、イタリアン出身の料理人、京都に数店舗。

cultural_comfort.note: Order skewers à la carte or as an omakase set; ¥600 appetizer charge; cards and PayPay.

places.name: PIOPIKO (Ace Hotel Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tacos on tortillas, burritos, burgers and fries; no gluten information (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Guacamole with tortilla chips is on the menu, but most tacos and mains are meat, seafood or cheese (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and days before holidays 15:00–24:00 (last orders food 23:00, drinks 23:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–24:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, advised at weekends (Tabelog; September 2026). Prices include a 10% service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料10%（表示価格に含む）」). Taco Tuesday every Tuesday (Tabelog). 82 seats with a DJ booth and a private room for 8; non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On the mezzanine and lobby level of Ace Hotel Kyoto in the Shinpukan; 1 min from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 6 (Tabelog; November 2026). Opened 11 June 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma Oike, in Ace Hotel Kyoto — 1 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Bar and taco lounge with a menu by Los Angeles chef Wes Avila: LA-style Mexican with ingredients from Kyoto and nearby, and tequila and mezcal cocktails (Tabelog, shop text; November 2026) · Taste of Tacos, three kinds, ¥2,600 — e.g. calamari with roasted habanero and tomatillo salsa (November 2026) · prix-fixe lunch taco plate with salad and soup (September–October 2026); burger lunch set with salad, fries and a drink ¥3,000 (Tabelog) · pork burrito in a hot skillet, guacamole with chips, beef tacos (2026 reviews) · course with all-you-can-drink ¥6,000 (October 2026)
places.notes: [Mexican · Karasuma Oike, LA tacos in the Ace Hotel] The taco bar of Ace Hotel Kyoto, its menu by Los Angeles chef Wes Avila: Kyoto-sourced tacos (a three-taco plate is ¥2,600), skillet burritos, guacamole and tequila or mezcal cocktails in a plant-filled, DJ-booth lounge. Taco Tuesdays; lunch at weekends. Prices include service. Open to midnight.

roles: Menu supervisor (Los Angeles chef; Tabelog shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a bar and taco lounge curated by Wes Avila, who grew up in the diverse food culture of Los Angeles, rooted in traditional American-style Mexican cooking with ingredients from Kyoto and nearby; cocktails by the bar team; opened 11 June 2020. A November 2026 reviewer describes Wes Avila as a Mexican-American chef from LA overseeing the menu.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "tacos you can only taste here."
chef_bio.specialty: Tacos; burritos; tequila and mezcal cocktails.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner checked the menu showed no coriander, but the burrito came topped with it.
A September 2026 group found the room dim and the tables small and cramped, though the food was good.
An October 2026 diner felt two older men might feel out of place in a room suited to dates and girls’ nights.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: メキシコ料理・バー・カフェ、中京区車屋町245-2 エースホテル京都 2F、烏丸御池駅6番出口から徒歩1分、月〜金と祝前日 15:00〜24:00 (L.O. 料理23:00、ドリンク23:30)、土日祝 11:30〜24:00、予約可、サービス料10% (表示価格に含む)、毎週火曜はTaco Tuesday、82席、個室8名、禁煙、カード可、2020年6月11日オープン、Los Angeles 育ちの Wes Avila が監修するバーとタコスのラウンジ、京都近郊の食材、バーガーランチセット3,000円。口コミ (2024年5月〜2026年11月、英語): タコス3種2,600円、タコスプレートのランチ、ブリトー、ワカモレ、テキーラとメスカルのカクテル、飲み放題付きコース6,000円、パクチーが入っていたという声、席が狭いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel bar used by many international travellers; book at weekends; prices include service.

places.name: 四方食店 (Shikata Shokuten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal plates including a rare-fried horse mackerel and clay-pot rice, with soy and dashi (2026 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Known for its vegetable dishes, but most plates have fish, duck or pork, and dashi is likely (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; October 2026). A small standing area by the entrance and seats further in and upstairs (2026 reviews). Some dishes come in half sizes, at more than half the price (September 2026). Non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). In a renovated townhouse near Shijo Karasuma, 411 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Shijo Karasuma — 411 m from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Standing bar and izakaya of creative Japanese dishes, vegetables and Japanese sake in a townhouse, with a seasonal menu (2026 reviews) · rare-fried horse mackerel with lemon, salt and tomato soy, the signature (July–October 2026) · grilled mackerel with mashed potatoes, roasted duck with green onion, hamo, seared bonito, summer-vegetable dishes, potato salad, mackerel roll with mizuna (2026 reviews) · clay-pot rice cooked over charcoal — firefly squid and asparagus, yellowtail (May–October 2026) · Ippodo roasted-bancha highball; half-size portions for solo diners (August–September 2026)
places.notes: [Standing bar & izakaya · Shijo Karasuma, the rare-fried horse mackerel] A stylish townhouse bar near Shijo Karasuma, standing room at the front and seats behind and upstairs, popular with a young crowd. Order the rare-fried horse mackerel, the roasted duck and a charcoal clay-pot rice, with Kyoto sake or an Ippodo-tea highball; half portions suit solo diners. Some found the young staff unclear on the menu and prices. Daily from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a popular, stylish izakaya with a seasonally changing menu and young staff at the counter (July–October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Rare-fried horse mackerel; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner listed communication lapses — a drinks list said to be complete that wasn’t, a half-size dish said to be half price that was marked up, and staff who could not explain the bill until a senior stepped in.
An October 2026 diner found the value poor, some flavours off and the mackerel roll tough.
A September 2026 solo traveller appreciated the half-size portions at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・立ち飲み・バル、中京区姥柳町190-2、烏丸駅から411m、毎日17:00〜23:00、予約可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): 町家の居酒屋、入口に立ち飲み、奥と2階に席、季節で変わる品書き、名物のアジのレアフライ、鯖の焼き物とマッシュポテト、鴨のロースト、鱧、炭火の土鍋ご飯、Ippodo のほうじ番茶ハイボール、ハーフサイズあり、若いスタッフの説明が不十分という声、コスパが悪いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book or stand at the front; half sizes for solo diners; cards, e-money and QR.

places.name: Bar MICHIya
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seafood, pasta, pizza, fried potatoes and satsuma-age alongside oysters and sashimi (2026 reviews). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable dishes such as bagna cauda (with a crab-miso sauce) are offered, but the menu is seafood-led (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, advised for groups (Tabelog; October 2026). Course ¥3,300 with optional 120-minute all-you-can-drink, and birthday cakes on request (April 2026). 21 seats: 9 at the counter, 12 at tables; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Cards, no e-money (Tabelog). On the 4th floor of the Sanjo Kiyamachi Building II at the Sanjo–Kiyamachi corner; 3 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; May 2026). A May 2026 diner heard an interior renovation was planned.
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi Sanjo — 3 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: A bar that cooks: market seafood and Italian-leaning dishes with seasonal-fruit cocktails, until 3 a.m. (Tabelog, shop text; 2026 reviews) · fresh oysters all year, e.g. Iwate rock oysters (Tabelog; May 2026) · sashimi such as sakura masu and kombu-cured sea bream, tuna salt tataki, crab miso, bagna cauda with crab-miso sauce, white-wine steamed shellfish, acqua pazza finished as zosui or risotto (2026 reviews) · clam pasta, karasumi pasta, porcini omelette, pizza, homemade satsuma-age, fried potatoes, macaroni salad, duck breast (2026 reviews) · Heartland draft, highballs, Japanese sake on request (2025–26 reviews) · about ¥3,000–8,000 a head (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bar with kitchen · Kiyamachi Sanjo, oysters till 3 a.m.] A fourth-floor bar at the Sanjo–Kiyamachi corner that eats like a restaurant: oysters all year, kombu-cured sea bream, bagna cauda with crab miso, acqua pazza finished as risotto, karasumi pasta — with fresh-fruit cocktails or a highball. Good for a second stop or a late dinner. Open 18:00–3:00.

roles: Bartenders and two kitchen staff (unnamed; April 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): fresh seafood from the market, Italian dishes with seasonal vegetables, and desserts and cocktails of seasonal fruit. An April 2026 diner saw several bartenders at the counter and two cooks in the kitchen; the chef came out to chat with a May 2026 group.
chef_bio.specialty: Oysters; acqua pazza finished as risotto.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 birthday party had a cake at the end and the whole bar celebrated with them.
An April 2026 pair walked in at opening without a booking and were given a table until 20:30.
A July 2026 group, on a second stop, ordered the sashimi and macaroni salad several times over.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー・バル・居酒屋、中京区木屋町三条上ル東側 三条木屋町ビルⅡ 4F、三条駅から徒歩3分、18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O. 2:00)、不定休、予約可、21席 (カウンター9、テーブル12)、貸切20名まで、カード可、市場の魚介と季節の野菜のイタリアン、季節の果物のカクテルとデザート、アクアパッツァの雑炊、岩牡蠣。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 一年中の生牡蠣、桜鱒の刺身、鯛の昆布締め、蟹味噌のバーニャカウダ、あさりのパスタ、からすみのパスタ、自家製のさつま揚げ、ピザ、3,300円のコースと120分の飲み放題、改装の予定という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order food and cocktails at the counter or tables; book for groups; cards accepted.

places.name: LOCANDA SENESE (ロカンダ セネーゼ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Homemade pasta, focaccia, quiche and desserts; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Plenty of Kyoto vegetables, but the menu centres on meat, fish and cheese; nothing vegan is marked (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sunday lunch 12:00–15:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Bookings advised — lunch fills by noon (2024–2026 reviews). Dinner only: ¥500 per person including bread (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「夜のみ500円(パン付き)」). 18 seats: 14 at tables and 4 at the counter; private hire for up to 20; non-smoking; English menu; children welcome, kids’ menu, stroller storage; BYO allowed; sommelier; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay, though mobile signal is weak in the basement (Tabelog; August 2024). Down a steep staircase with no elevator, in the basement of the Shijo Karasuma Star Building on Karasuma-dori south of Takoyakushi, 242 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; March 2025). Opened 1 June 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma-Takoyakushi — 242 m from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Tuscan cooking with Kyoto vegetables: hearty meat, homemade pasta (Tabelog official introduction) · pasta lunch with soup and focaccia ¥1,500 (April 2026; ¥1,400 before) · one-plate lunch of pasta, quiche or omelette and salad, with drink and dessert, ¥2,000 · pair or share sets of pasta and meat · e.g. Shogoin-turnip or squash potage, homemade tagliatelle with beef ragù, clam and zucchini celery genovese, Hiroshima wild-boar pappardelle, grilled beef with basil sauce, antipasti platter, tiramisu, gelato, apple tart (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Karasuma-Takoyakushi, a couple's Tuscan basement] Down a steep stair off Karasuma-dori, a small, homely trattoria run by a couple, the chef having trained four years in Tuscany. Lunch is the bargain: potage, warm focaccia and a homemade pasta for about ¥1,500, or ¥2,000 with drink and dessert; share sets add a grilled meat. Dinner brings antipasti, wild-boar pappardelle and steaks. Book — it fills at noon. No elevator. Closed Monday; Sunday lunch only.

roles: Chef not named; run by a couple
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: run by a friendly couple; the chef trained for four years in Tuscany and pairs traditional Tuscan cooking with fresh, seasonal Kyoto vegetables. Opened 1 June 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: to recreate authentic Tuscan flavours faithfully with an abundance of seasonal Kyoto produce.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade tagliatelle and pappardelle; grilled meat.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular on a sixth visit noted the pasta lunch had gone up ¥100, to ¥1,500.
An August 2024 couple at a two-top were offered a larger four-seat table when one came free.
A March 2025 diner warned that the steep basement stairs may be hard for anyone with limited mobility.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: LOCANDA SENESE (ロカンダ セネーゼ)、イタリアン・ステーキ・パスタ、中京区烏丸通蛸薬師下ル手洗水町650 四条烏丸スタービル B1F、烏丸駅から242m、火〜土 12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、日 12:00〜15:00、月曜定休、夜のみ500円 (パン付き)、18席 (テーブル14、カウンター4)、20名まで貸切可、禁煙、英語メニュー、子供可・キッズメニュー、持ち込み可、ソムリエ、カード・PayPay 可、エレベーターなし、2021年6月1日オープン。公式紹介: 仲の良い夫婦によるおもてなし、トスカーナで4年修業したシェフ、伝統のトスカーナ料理と新鮮な京野菜。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): パスタランチ1,500円、ドリンクとデザート付きのワンプレートランチ2,000円、シェアセット、自家製タリアテッレ、猪のパッパルデッレ、急な階段。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu available (Tabelog).

places.name: 松涛カフェ KYOTO (Shoto Cafe KYOTO)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a chiffon-cake and roll-cake café; the chiffon is made with Hokkaido wheat flour (December 2025 review).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the chiffon uses eggs, the roll cake egg whites, and both come with whipped cream (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Friday 12:00–18:00; Saturday 11:30–18:00; Sunday 11:30–17:30; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「無し」 — the English page wrongly says one is added). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Eat-in upstairs at a few tables (about 18 places); take-out and the counter downstairs; showcase sweets can be eaten in for ¥100 extra; the L roll cake sells out, so reserve it (Tabelog; December 2025–November 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). A renovated machiya in a quiet lane 148 m from Sanjo Keihan Stn; narrow, steep stairs (Tabelog; November 2025). Opened 1 March 2024 (Tabelog); the Kyoto branch of 松涛カフェ in Shibuya, Tokyo (2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo Keihan, north side — 148 m from Sanjo Keihan Stn
places.cuisine: Chiffon cake and roll cake, from the Kyoto branch of a Shibuya, Tokyo café (2026 reviews) · chiffon of Hokkaido wheat and red-yolk eggs, plain, as "cake butter toast" or half and half, e.g. Shoto Cake Half & Half with cream and maple ¥1,070 (August 2026), half & half chiffon ¥750, with ice cream and maple · egg-white roll cake in four heights, SS 3.5 cm to L 14 cm, S ¥550 (February 2026) · freshly roasted coffee, iced chai, sandwiches; the lunch menu has given way to sweets and bread (September 2026)
places.notes: [Café · Sanjo Keihan, chiffon cake in a machiya] The Kyoto outpost of Shibuya's Shoto Cafe, in a renovated townhouse on a quiet lane just north of Sanjo Keihan. The star is the chiffon cake — fluffy, lightly salty, best as crisp-edged "cake butter toast" heaped with cream — and a tall egg-white roll cake sold in four heights. Climb the steep stairs to a small upstairs room; the owner is warm and chatty. Cash only. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 1 March 2024. Reviewers in 2026 describe it as the second shop of 松涛カフェ of Shoto, Shibuya, Tokyo, known for chiffon and roll cakes; the chiffon is made with Hokkaido wheat flour and red-yolk eggs, the roll cake with egg whites only (December 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Chiffon "cake butter toast"; roll cake in four heights.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 guest asked about toppings for the toast chiffon and the owner laughed, "No need, no need!" — it came heaped with whipped cream anyway.
A January 2026 regular was offered a larger sandwich than the regular size.
A September 2026 regular noted that lunch has given way to sweets and bread, with online sales too.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 松涛カフェ KYOTO、カフェ、左京区新丸太町75-9、三条京阪駅から148m、火〜金12:00〜18:00、土11:30〜18:00、日11:30〜17:30、月曜定休、サービス料無し、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、テーブル (最大18名)、禁煙、2024年3月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年11月、英語): 東京・渋谷の松涛カフェの2号店、町家を改装、1階は厨房とレジと持ち帰り、2階がイートイン、急な階段、北海道産小麦と赤玉子のシフォン、ケーキバタートースト、卵白だけのロールケーキ (SS 3.5cm〜L 14cm)、ハーフ&ハーフ1,070円、ロールケーキS 550円、ショーケースの菓子はイートイン+100円、気さくな店主。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; the owner is friendly and happy to recommend.

places.name: 京の鴨料理 北斎 (Kyo no Kamo Ryori Hokusai)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Duck courses include katsu, fried dishes, nanban-zuke, yuba rolls, soups and ponzu; no gluten information is published (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Kyoto-duck specialist (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00); dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Sunday by reservation only; book ahead when bringing children; the kuwa-yaki course needs booking 2–3 days ahead (Tabelog; official site). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 28 seats: a 5-seat counter and 10 table seats downstairs, a 13-seat upstairs room that can be divided into semi-private rooms; private hire up to 13–20; non-smoking, with a smoking area outside; children welcome, kids’ menu; cards (VISA, Master, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay (Tabelog; official site). Ordering is by tablet (July 2026). On Yamato-oji south of Sanjo by the Shirakawa, 1 min from exit 9 of Gion-Shijo Stn (official site). Opened at this address 4 July 2022 (Tabelog); the official site gives the business as founded 75 years ago and calls it the birthplace of kuwa-yaki.
places.neighborhood: Gion, Yamato-oji by the Shirakawa — 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-duck specialist using 京鴨 raised by 山城農産 (official site) · lunch: salad and appetizers, a main of choice and a glass parfait — chicken kara-age ¥2,300, duck tenderloin katsu ¥2,800, duck thigh ¥3,600, duck loin ¥4,100, both ¥4,800, wagyu roast beef ¥4,500; yukhoe-style mini duck bowl +¥770; Kyo-duck lunch course ¥6,300 · dinner courses: duck and roast beef ¥7,400, Kyo-duck course ¥9,500 (duck and tuna yukhoe, duck ham, seared duck-loin nigiri, duck-liver cheesecake), 10-plus-dish duck courses ¥13,200–13,800 · charcoal kuwa-yaki iron-plate course from ¥6,000 (jidori) to ¥18,000 (chateaubriand), book ahead · duck yakitori course ¥4,800 (March 2026) · maiko dance plan with candlelight, from ¥80,000 plus food (official site, tax included)
places.notes: [Duck · Gion by the Shirakawa, Kyoto duck every way] A duck house a minute from Gion-Shijo Station, cooking Kyoto's brand duck as salad, yakitori, katsu, ham, yukhoe and seared nigiri. Lunch is a choose-your-main set from ¥2,300 ending in a showy glass parfait; dinner courses run ¥7,400–13,800, and the old house speciality, charcoal kuwa-yaki, needs booking. Most reviews are warm, though a few 2026 diners found the duck gamey. Private rooms upstairs; maiko dinners can be arranged.

roles: Representative (代表) of 株式会社北斎; head chef not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: run by 株式会社北斎 under representative 岡本 賢志; the duck is 京鴨, raised entirely in Kyoto by 山城農産; the business was founded 75 years ago and serves its traditional skills; it calls itself the birthplace of kuwa-yaki, cooked over charcoal. Tabelog gives the opening at this address as 4 July 2022. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社北斎, at the same address.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a serene space and a luxurious meal; the true flavour of carefully chosen ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyo-duck courses; charcoal kuwa-yaki.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 lunch guest chose among six duck mains and played with salt, shichimi and Kaneyama miso.
A May 2026 family found the staff very kind to the child in the party.
A June 2026 diner who had travelled for the duck course found the meat gamey and the meal a disappointment.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-hokusai.com): 京の鴨料理 北斎、株式会社北斎、代表 岡本賢志、東山区弁財天町11、京阪祇園四条駅9番出口より徒歩1分、ランチ12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)、ディナー18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、不定休、創業75年、山城農産の京鴨、くわ焼き発祥の店。ランチ: メインを選ぶコース2,300円〜 (鳥もも唐揚げ2,300円、京鴨ささ身カツ2,800円、京鴨もも焼3,600円、ロース焼4,100円、もも・ロース4,800円、和牛ローストビーフ4,500円、ユッケ仕立てミニ丼+770円、グラスパフェ)、京鴨ランチコース6,300円、炭火くわ焼き一人鉄板コース6,000〜18,000円 (要予約)。会席: 京鴨とローストビーフ7,400円、京鴨満喫コース9,500円、京鴨づくし13,800円・13,200円。舞妓さんプラン80,000円・120,000円 (飲食別)、貸切最大13名。食べログ: 日曜は予約のみ、28席、禁煙、子供可、カード・PayPay 可、2022年7月4日オープン、インボイス T7130001009657 (株式会社北斎)。口コミ (2026年3〜9月、英語): 京鴨焼き鳥コース4,800円、パフェ、臭みがあるという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Tablet ordering with photos; book ahead on Sundays and for kuwa-yaki.

places.name: 鉄板焼 葵 (Teppanyaki Aoi, RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan-grilled wagyu, seafood and vegetables with soy- and butter-based sauces, garlic rice and dessert; the hotel asks guests with food allergies to tell the staff (hotel site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: teppanyaki courses of wagyu and seafood (hotel site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch weekdays 12:00–15:30 (last order 14:00 per the hotel; 14:30 per Tabelog); weekends and holidays in two sittings, 11:30–13:00 and 13:30–15:00; dinner 17:00–21:30 (last order 20:00); hours differ in holiday periods; closed irregularly — see the hotel site (hotel site; Tabelog). Service charge 15% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料15%」); the hotel’s listed prices include tax and service. 35 seats, all at counters, including one private room for 4–8 (room charge extra) and two semi-private rooms; non-smoking; children welcome, kids’ menu; sommelier; cards, e-money and QR; hotel parking (hotel site; Tabelog). On basement level 1 of RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto, about 5 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; June 2025).
places.neighborhood: RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto, B1 — 5 min from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki of wagyu, seafood and vegetables grilled at the counter; a certified Omi-beef restaurant (hotel site) · lunch from ¥7,084, dinner from ¥17,457, tax and service included; à la carte too (hotel site) · e.g. lobster and scallop with lemon or butter soy, abalone with parsley butter or bouillabaisse sauce, catch of the day such as kinmedai in lemon butter, domestic beef or Kuroge wagyu fillet, garlic rice, chawanmushi, sweetfish escabeche, consommé, yuzu sorbet (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Kyoto Station, the RIHGA Royal's grill counter] The RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto's teppanyaki room, a short walk from Kyoto Station: every seat faces the hot plate, where the chef sears lobster, abalone, scallops and Omi or Kuroge wagyu fillet, finishing with garlic rice. Lunch courses from about ¥7,100 are the gentler entry; dinner starts near ¥17,500. Prices include tax and 15% service. Good for birthdays — expect a message plate.

roles: Chef of 鉄板焼 葵 (hotel staff)
chef_bio.background: Per the hotel site: worked at the hotel’s French Dining Top of Kyoto and at 鉄板焼 葵, then as banquet hot-kitchen chef, before becoming chef of 鉄板焼 葵; in 2018 trained in France at the two-star Jean Sulpice in Savoie and the three-star Maison Pic. The restaurant is one of the hotel’s own; it is a certified Omi-beef restaurant.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the hotel site: to bring out seasonal, carefully chosen ingredients with skills from training in France, for a teppanyaki meal to remember.
chef_bio.specialty: Lobster and scallop teppanyaki; wagyu fillet with garlic rice.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 lunch guest watched the cooking for about two hours while the chef chatted, and was given a generous helping of garlic rice.
A February 2025 guest celebrating a birthday received a birthday drink and a "Happy Birthday" dessert plate.
A June 2026 dinner opened with a chawanmushi styled as a cactus, served with a shovel-shaped spoon.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: リーガロイヤルホテル京都 公式サイト: 鉄板焼 葵、全席カウンター、三大和牛の一つ「近江牛」の認定指定店、和牛・魚介・野菜を目の前の鉄板で。シェフ 鵜飼大輔: フレンチダイニングトップオブキョウトと鉄板焼 葵で勤務、宴会ホットのシェフを経て葵のシェフ、2018年フランス・サヴォワの2つ星「ジャンシュルピス」と3つ星「メゾンピック」で研鑽。ランチ平日12:00〜15:30 (L.O. 14:00)、土日祝は2部制 (11:30〜13:00、13:30〜15:00)、ディナー17:00〜21:30 (L.O. 20:00)、地下1階、ランチ7,084円〜、ディナー17,457円〜、アラカルトあり、料金は税金・サービス料込み、35席 (個室含む)、個室1室 (4〜8名、個室料別)、全席禁煙、アレルギーは係員へ。食べログ: 鉄板焼・日本料理・ステーキ、下京区松明町1 リーガロイヤルホテル京都 B1F、サービス料15%、子供可、ソムリエ、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、駐車場117台、インボイス T1130003004166。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 伊勢海老と帆立、鮑、金目鯛、和牛ヒレ、ガーリックライス、誕生日のサービス。

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel with a multilingual website.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The hotel asks guests worried about allergens to tell the staff and links a food-allergy notice.

places.name: ピッツェリア ダ ナギーノ (PIZZERIA DA NAGHINO)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a Neapolitan pizzeria — wheat-dough pizzas from a wood-fired oven, plus fritto and tiramisu (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A marinara-style pizza without cheese may be possible, but the menu is built on mozzarella, buffalo mozzarella, sausage and prosciutto; no vegan information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–21:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; busy at lunch (February 2026). 20 seats incl. a counter close to the oven; narrow aisles — strollers must be folded, no high chairs (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). Takeaway (Tabelog). Near the Higashiyama Sanjo crossing; 2 min walk from Higashiyama Stn exit 2 (Tabelog). Opened 7 August 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama Sanjo — 2 min walk from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Neapolitan pizzeria with a wood-fired oven imported from Italy and about 80% of ingredients from Italy, following traditional Neapolitan methods (Tabelog) · pizzas such as Margherita, Bufala, Quattro Formaggi with honey, Bismarck and Bismarck Bianco with mushrooms and egg, salsiccia with greens, 'nduja, prosciutto and arugula, half-and-half on request (2026 reviews) · caprese with buffalo mozzarella, sweet-shrimp fritto, marinated octopus, salad, tiramisu (2026 reviews) · lunch sets with salad and a drink (September 2026) · wine and beer in maiko-silhouette glasses (Tabelog; March 2026) · lunch about ¥1,000–2,000, dinner ¥2,000–4,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Pizza · Higashiyama Sanjo, Naples by wood fire] A lively little pizzeria near Higashiyama Sanjo built around an Italian wood-fired oven: chewy-crusted Neapolitan pizzas — Bufala, Quattro Formaggi with honey, an egg-topped Bismarck Bianco, 'nduja, salsiccia — with half-and-half on request, plus caprese and fritto. Lunch sets are good value; pizzas arrive fast. Young, friendly staff; one diner found plates cleared too briskly. Strollers must fold. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a pizzeria dedicated to Naples in ingredients, methods and its Italian wood-fired oven, with seats close to the kitchen and about 80% of ingredients imported from Italy; opened 7 August 2017. Reviewers in 2026 describe young, kind and attentive staff ("The staff were incredibly cute as well", March 2026), quick service and many guests from abroad.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Neapolitan methods and ingredients (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Bismarck Bianco; Quattro Formaggi with honey.

anecdotes.text: "The Bismarck Bianco is absolutely amazing!!!!!!! It was so delicious that I felt tears of joy in my mouth." — September 2026.
"The beer glasses featured a silhouette of a maiko, adding a charming Kyoto touch. ... The staff were incredibly cute as well." — March 2026.
"However, the staff clearing the plates was a bit too quick, which felt somewhat rude." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ピザ・イタリアン、東山区七軒町20-2 サングリーン1F、地下鉄東山駅2番出口から徒歩2分、東山三条の近く、毎日 11:30〜14:30・17:30〜21:00、予約可、20席、禁煙、カード可、テイクアウト、2017年8月7日オープン、ナポリにこだわり、イタリアから輸入した薪窯、食材の8割はイタリア産、伝統のナポリの製法。口コミ (2026年2月〜9月、英語): マルゲリータ、ブッファラ、クアトロフォルマッジに蜂蜜、ビスマルクとビスマルク・ビアンコ (きのこと卵)、サルシッチャ、ンドゥイヤ、生ハムとルッコラ、ハーフ&ハーフ可、ブッファラのカプレーゼ、甘海老のフリット、たこのマリネ、ティラミス、ランチセット、舞妓のシルエットのビアグラス、若いスタッフ、提供が速い、皿を下げるのが速すぎたとの声、通路が狭くベビーカーは畳む、子ども用の椅子はない。

cultural_comfort.note: Book for lunch; half-and-half pizzas on request; strollers must fold; cards accepted.

places.name: バルケッタ (barchetta)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Italian wine-bar dishes such as risotto, pasta, ajillo, bagna cauda and confit; no gluten information (2022–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Bagna cauda vegetables, fruit and some vegetable dishes appear, but anchovy, pancetta, cheese, fish and meat run through the menu (2022–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 18:00–24:00; Saturday and Sunday 15:00–24:00, with a daytime-drinking menu 15:00–18:00; closed Wednesday; last entry and last food order 22:30 — the shop may close if no one is in by then (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; call for 5 or more (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 at the counter and tables for 2–4, plus a red sofa at the back; non-smoking; live music (Tabelog; 2024 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On Matsubara-dori west of Karasuma; 5–6 min walk from Gojo, Shijo or Karasuma stations (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Matsubara-dori west of Karasuma — 5 min walk from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Casual wine bar run by a sommelier, with Italian dishes made to go with wine (Tabelog) · "Solo Set" of five half-portion dishes, ¥2,500 (March 2023) — e.g. potato salad, smoked salt mackerel, chicken confit with rosemary, eggplant with pancetta in balsamic, cheese risotto (May 2022) · Yokowa tuna carpaccio, daikon risotto (December 2024); karasumi pasta (November 2024); bagna cauda of unusual vegetables (March 2024); ajillo (February 2026); boiled egg with a rich sauce (October 2025) · wines from many countries, poured blind — origin and grape not given (October 2025); dessert and botrytised wines (2024–2026 reviews); beer ¥800 (March 2023) · about ¥3,000–6,000 (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Wine bar · Matsubara Karasuma, a sommelier and a piano] A calm, late-opening wine bar west of Karasuma where the sommelier-master pours wines from many countries — sometimes without naming the wine, so you taste first — and cooks small Italian plates to match; solo guests can take a five-dish half-portion set (about ¥2,500). Bagna cauda, karasumi pasta, risotto and ajillo; on some nights the master plays the piano. Many regulars; one newcomer felt a little left out. Last entry 22:30. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a casual wine bar run by a sommelier, whose dishes are made to pair with wine, with a five-dish "Solo Set" and occasional live piano. Reviewers describe a gentle master who plays piano at times (2022–2024), wines served without disclosing origin to encourage tasting without preconceptions (October 2025), and nights when the master works alone (February 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Wines tasted without preconceptions (October 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Solo Set; wine pairing.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 guest noted the wines are poured without naming origin or grape, "this approach encourages guests to set aside preconceptions."
A December 2024 newcomer loved the Yokowa tuna carpaccio and daikon risotto but, among the regulars, felt a little distant when no one gave a goodbye at the door.
A September 2023 guest, back for only a second time, was remembered — and was quickly made a snack platter and a small risotto.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・ワインバー・パスタ、下京区松原通烏丸西入る玉津島町307、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩6分、五条駅から5分、月・火・木・金 18:00〜24:00、土・日 15:00〜24:00 (15〜18時は昼飲みメニュー)、水曜休み、最終入店・料理L.O.22:30 (客がいなければ閉店も)、予約可 (5名以上は電話で)、20席 (カウンター8、2〜4名のテーブル)、禁煙、ライブ演奏、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、ソムリエのいるカジュアルなワインバー、ワインに合う料理、半量5品を選べる「おひとりさまセット」、ピアノの演奏も。口コミ (2022年5月〜2026年2月、英語): おひとりさまセット2,500円 (ポテトサラダ、塩鯖の燻製、手羽元のコンフィ、茄子とパンチェッタ、チーズのリゾット)、横輪まぐろのカルパッチョ、大根のリゾット、からすみのパスタ、バーニャカウダ、アヒージョ、ゆで卵、産地や品種を伏せて出すワイン、貴腐ワイン、ビール800円、常連が多く少し疎外感があったとの声、マスター一人の日も。

cultural_comfort.note: Ask the sommelier to choose; Solo Set for one; last entry 22:30; cards, e-money and QR.

places.name: のんき亭 (Nonki Tei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Japanese dishes including tempura, kakiage, fried nameko, beef cutlet, katsu sandwiches, sushi and hot pots; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-led menu — sashimi from a seafood box, whale bacon, crab, fugu, soft-shelled turtle — with dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted — call even if online slots are full (Tabelog). 50 seats: a wooden counter, a banquet room for up to 50 and a private room for 6; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). Takeaway, e.g. katsu sandwiches (Tabelog; September 2026). On Shinbashi-dori east of Yamatooji in Gion; about 400 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Moved here in 2012; a sister, Bistro Nonki, opened in 2023 at the APA Hotel in front of Kyoto Station (Tabelog remarks).
places.neighborhood: Shinbashi-dori east of Yamatooji, Gion — 6 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion kappo-izakaya of seasonal dishes from ingredients sourced from Kyoto, Kyushu, Hokuriku and Hokkaido (Tabelog) · choose from boxes of seafood at the counter — e.g. whale bacon, scallops, tuna, Matsuba crab, octopus, Spanish mackerel (February 2026) · lightly grilled torigai, liver with wasabi, mantis shrimp, wild-vegetable tempura, sweet-potato salad (May 2026); sea urchin from Maizuru, fresh shirasu, sushi, grilled ayu, soft-shelled-turtle hot pot, hojicha ice cream (May 2026); moga, corn tempura, beef cutlet ¥4,200 (June 2026); fried nameko, clam hot pot, kakiage (April 2026); matsutake dobin-mushi, bonito tataki (August 2026); katsu sandwich to take away (September 2026) · fugu-fin sake; Niigata Shimeharitsuru (2026 reviews) · bills about ¥10,000–20,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo izakaya · Gion Shinbashi, pick from the seafood box] A long-running Gion counter where you choose from boxes of the day's seafood — Matsuba crab, torigai, mantis shrimp, whale bacon — or let the owner recommend: sashimi, tempura, soft-shelled-turtle hot pot, matsutake dobin-mushi, a famous beef cutlet. Portions are generous and courses come fast. Prices are higher than the homely look suggests; reviewers warn that following every recommendation adds up. Smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: seasonal dishes from fresh ingredients from across Japan; 50 seats with a wooden counter, a banquet room and private rooms; relocated from Gion-machi in 2012; a sister restaurant, Bistro Nonki, opened in 2023 in front of Kyoto Station. Reviewers in 2026 describe a pleasant owner who recommends dishes, many regulars, and a chef who once warned that the course was coming too fast (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood box; beef cutlet; seasonal tempura.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 guest, treated by a daughter for Mother's Day, was asked about dislikes and was served sea urchin from Maizuru, sushi, ayu and a turtle hot pot — and overcame a dislike of sake.
"According to the customer who brought me here, if you order exactly what the owner suggests, it could lead to quite a surprise! Haha." — September 2026.
An August 2026 diner on the chef's course found portions large and dishes arriving so fast that the table filled up — the chef even warned that the dishes were coming too quickly.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・創作料理・寿司、東山区新橋通大和大路東入ル二丁目橋本町405-1、祇園四条駅から415m、月〜土 17:00〜22:00、日・祝休み、予約可 (予約枠が埋まっていても電話で確認を)、50席、座敷 (宴会50名まで)、6名の個室、喫煙可、カード可、テイクアウト、京都・九州・北陸・本州・北海道の旬の食材、2012年に祇園町から移転、2023年に京都駅前のアパホテルに姉妹店「Bistro Nonki」。口コミ (2026年2月〜9月、英語): 魚介の箱から選ぶ (鯨のベーコン、帆立、まぐろ、松葉がに、たこ、さわら)、とり貝のあぶり、肝のわさび和え、しゃこ、山菜の天ぷら、さつまいものポテサラ、Maizuru のうに、生しらす、寿司、鮎、すっぽん鍋、ほうじ茶のアイス、とうもろこしの天ぷら、牛カツ4,200円、なめこの唐揚げ、はまぐりの鍋、かき揚げ、松茸の土瓶蒸し、鰹のたたき、カツサンドの持ち帰り、ひれ酒、Shimeharitsuru、店主のおすすめ、値段は高めとの声、料理の出るのが速すぎたとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose from the seafood boxes or ask the owner — and ask prices; smoking allowed; cards accepted.

places.name: 炭火焼肉KINOE (Sumibi Yakiniku KINOE)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal yakiniku with tare and seasoned yukhoe, plus rice and mochi desserts; salted cuts are offered, but there is no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house — Kobe beef, yukhoe and beef sashimi (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00; closed 31 December and 1 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; two-hour limit when busy; bookings lapse 15 minutes after the time without contact (Tabelog). A 10% service charge in busy seasons — 24 December–4 January, 29 April–6 May, 11–16 August (Tabelog original 繁忙期（12月24日～1月4日・4月29日～5月6日・8月11日～8月16日）は、お食事代金の10％をサービス料として別途頂戴いたします). Touch-panel ordering (March 2025). 26 seats incl. private rooms for 4 and sofas; private hire 15–26; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards incl. UnionPay; PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). A renovated machiya near Jingu-Marutamachi; 3 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Formerly called 嘉 (2025 reviews; web).
places.neighborhood: Near Jingu-Marutamachi, between the Imperial Palace and the Kamo — 3 min walk from the station
places.cuisine: Charcoal yakiniku of premium wagyu, mainly Kobe beef, in a modern machiya, from a meat shop with long experience selling Kobe beef (Tabelog; web) · KINOE meat course ¥7,700 (Tabelog); a ¥7,000 course with about 280 g of meat (April 2025) · yukhoe in several styles, the signature; beef sashimi; thick salted tongue; assorted cuts and rare cuts of the day (2024–2025 reviews) · hojicha mochi (March 2026) · sake, shochu, wine and cocktails (Tabelog) · about ¥6,000–14,000 (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Jingu-Marutamachi, Kobe beef in a machiya] A stylish renovated townhouse near the Kamo serving charcoal yakiniku of Kobe and other wagyu from a long-established Kobe-beef dealer: several kinds of yukhoe (the signature), beef sashimi, thick salted tongue and the day's rare cuts, with a ¥7,700 meat course. Private rooms and sofas; touch-panel ordering. 10% service in the New Year, Golden Week and Obon weeks. One March 2026 regular felt the taste had slipped. Open nightly.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakiniku house fusing charcoal grilling with Japanese tradition, sourcing premium wagyu, mainly Kobe beef, in a renovated Kyoto townhouse. A web article describes it as run by a meat shop with sixty years of selling Kobe beef, previously named 嘉; 2025 reviewers noticed the name change.
chef_bio.philosophy: A fusion of charcoal-grilled yakiniku and Japanese tradition (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Yukhoe; thick salted tongue.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 regular, back after a year, noticed the sign had changed and started with the classic-sauce yukhoe in a first-floor private room.
A June 2024 guest from The Ritz-Carlton nearby warns the large rice is huge — "stick to a medium rice if you want to eat like a normal person."
"Unfortunately, the taste seemed to have declined compared to my first experience, but the yukhoe was still delicious!" — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・ステーキ・居酒屋、上京区駒之町535-3、京阪神宮丸太町駅から徒歩3分、毎日 17:00〜23:00、12月31日と1月1日休み、予約可 (混雑時2時間制、15分連絡がなければ取消)、繁忙期 (12月24日〜1月4日、4月29日〜5月6日、8月11日〜8月16日) はサービス料10%、26席、4名の個室、ソファ席、貸切15〜26名、禁煙、Wi-Fi、カード (銀聯も)・PayPay・Alipay 可、京町家の雰囲気、神戸牛を中心とした和牛、KINOE 肉コース7,700円。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年3月、英語): 以前は別の店名、ユッケ数種、牛刺し、厚切りの塩タン、盛り合わせ、希少部位、280gの7,000円コース、タッチパネルで注文、ほうじ茶のお餅、味が落ちたとの声 (2026年3月)。ウェブ記事: 神戸牛の販売60年の精肉店が営む、旧店名「嘉」。

cultural_comfort.note: Touch-panel ordering; 10% service in holiday weeks; cards, PayPay and Alipay.

places.name: ガーネッシュ (Ganesh)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a European-style curry sauce (roux not described) served with breaded katsu, menchi katsu, fried shrimp, croquettes and fried oysters (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the single house curry sauce is not described, and the 2026 menu adds a pork curry; the shop takes “wagamama” special requests where it can (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 14:00), dinner 18:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30), Monday–Saturday, until sold out; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, with a table charge of ¥200 a head and a ¥1,000 minimum per person (Tabelog, original ご予約に際しまして、テーブルチャージ料お一人様200円を頂戴しております。). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 12 counter seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; take-out and delivery; children welcome, kids’ menu (Tabelog). Spices sold in 15 g packs, with an online shop (August 2025). On Sanjo-dori west of Muromachi, 2 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog). Opened 22 December 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-dori west of Muromachi — 2 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: European-style curry: one house sauce that tastes fruity and sweet at first, with the heat following after (official site) · Takayama curry, styled on a Gion Festival float, with a meringue of whipped egg white, the yolk, and fresh-fried tenderloin katsu or menchi katsu, ¥1,100 (2024–2026 reviews) · Select curry ¥850 with toppings such as tenderloin cutlet and shrimp fry (March 2026) · pork curry ¥850 (official site, May 2026) · mixed fry curry with white fish and crab-cream croquette (December 2024) · katsu curry, fried-oyster topping (January 2026) · extra spice ¥200 per 15 g; large rice free; rice from a contracted farm (March 2026) · pickled shallots and fukujinzuke (December 2024)
places.notes: [Curry · Sanjo-Muromachi, the meringue curry] A 12-seat counter for European-style curry near Karasuma Oike: one house sauce, sweet and fruity first with the heat arriving later, under fresh-fried katsu, shrimp or croquettes. The signature Takayama curry, styled on a Gion Festival float, is crowned with whipped egg-white meringue and a yolk (¥1,100). Curries from ¥850, large rice free, spices for sale. Lunch and dinner, closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: An August 2025 reviewer writes that the owner “apparently retired early from the police force to open this curry shop” and has a vibrant personality. The official site says the owner personally selects every ingredient. In January 2026 the shop’s connection with the Aomori team was told on NHK’s broadcast of the 44th National Women’s Ekiden in Kyoto (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: A two-stage sauce, fruity and sweet first, then spicy; high hospitality and “wagamama” special orders where possible (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Takayama curry; European-style curry.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner added 15 g of extra spice for ¥200 and ended up sweating happily.
An August 2025 visitor came to buy spices when the usual shop was shut and stayed for lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 欧風カレーハウス ガーネッシュ、三条通室町西入る、一口目はフルーティーで甘口、後から辛さが追いかける二段カレーソース、オーナー自ら食材を吟味、わがまま注文も可能な範囲で、2026年5月にポークカレー850円を発売、2026年1月の全国女子駅伝のNHK中継で青森チームとの話が放送。食べログ: カレー、中京区三条通室町西入衣棚町59-2、烏丸御池駅から徒歩2分、月〜土 11:30〜14:00、18:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、売り切れ次第終了、日曜・祝日定休、予約時はテーブルチャージ1人200円・1人1,000円以上、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、12席、禁煙、車椅子可、テイクアウト・デリバリー、子ども可、ベジタリアン対応、2014年12月22日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): メレンゲの「Takayama カレー」1,100円、セレクトカレー850円、辛さ追加200円、大盛無料、店主は警察を早期退職して開店したらしい、スパイスも販売。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter curry shop; pick a curry and toppings. ¥200 table charge only when booking ahead.

places.name: ごはんとお酒 Jinsuke (Gohan to Osake Jinsuke)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase courses with sashimi, a fried dish, obanzai, clam cream croquette, kakiage, clam ajillo with focaccia, clam shabu-shabu finished with soba or zosui; tell the shop about foods you avoid when booking, as the official site asks (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses built on fish, clams and beef, with bonito and clam dashi (official site; April 2026).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Tuesday–Saturday and the day before a holiday; closed Sunday and Monday, with bookings on closed days by request (Tabelog). November 2026 closures: 3, 8, 9, 10, 16, 23, 29, 30 (official site). Reservations are for courses only; à la carte after 21:00 (official site; December 2025); a March 2026 walk-in was told only courses were available. Tell the shop about foods you avoid when booking; children’s meals arranged where possible (Tabelog; official site). One drink per person (Tabelog, original お一人様1ドリンクのオーダーをお願いします。). Courses allow 3 hours (official site). Cards, iD, QUICPay, PayPay (Tabelog). 16 seats: an L-shaped counter of about eight and two tables; a separate private room for 4–6, one group a day, booked by phone (Tabelog; official site; February–March 2026). Non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). On Sanjo-dori west of Muromachi, 4 min from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 6 (Tabelog; official site). Opened 14 February 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-dori west of Muromachi — 4 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Daily omakase of seasonal vegetables and fresh fish, gentle on the stomach, with about ten sakes always on (official site) · omakase seven dishes ¥5,000: otoshi, sashimi, a fried dish, obanzai platter, a seasonal dish, clam shabu-shabu, the day’s finish (zosui or noodles); five dishes ¥3,850 (official site) · clam course with two hours’ free drinks ¥8,000: clam cream croquette, clam ajillo, clam shabu-shabu (official site) · seven dishes with free drinks ¥7,500; sake-pairing course ¥8,500 with about 20 sakes to choose from, homemade roast beef and beef sukiyaki (official site) · bar menu after 21:00: mixed nuts ¥600, fresh popcorn ¥800 (official site) · clams from Kuwana; chawanmushi with milt and karasumi; dashimaki with clam tsukudani; curry risotto (February 2026) · fish from Maizuru (May 2026) · Kyoto and national sakes, including a bottle made with a long-established brewery that shares the shop’s name (February 2026)
places.notes: [Clams and sake · Sanjo-Muromachi, a couple’s counter] A homely L-shaped counter on Sanjo-dori run by a husband and wife, where the day’s omakase ends in the house clam shabu-shabu finished with soba. Seven dishes ¥5,000, or the clam course with croquette, ajillo and shabu-shabu with two hours of drinks for ¥8,000; about ten sakes, and a pairing course. Bookings are for courses; à la carte after 21:00. Solo-friendly. One drink each.

roles: Owner (unnamed) and the owner’s wife; invoice holder 株式会社べっぴんや
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a couple behind the counter: “the cheerful demeanor of the owners (a couple)” (May 2026); the owner and the owner’s wife “very friendly” (February 2026); “the charm of the owner’s wife is truly captivating” (February 2026). An April 2026 diner also mentions staff. A February 2026 visitor booked after seeing the clam course on a TV show visited by Tohru Kazama. Tabelog’s invoice number T2130001044213 is registered to 株式会社べっぴんや (NTA invoice registry).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal vegetables and fresh fish, cooking that is kind to the body and stomach; a new dish each visit (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Clam shabu-shabu; sake.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular on a seventh visit liked that the obanzai platter arrives just before the clam hot pot.
A February 2026 guest saw the counter of about eight fall into conversation, foreign guests included.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ごはんとお酒 Jinsuke、烏丸御池駅6番出口から徒歩4分、家庭的な雰囲気で日替わりのおまかせ料理とこだわりの日本酒、旬の野菜や鮮魚で身体や胃に優しい料理、日本酒は常時10種類、カウンターメインでひとりでも。コース: はまぐりづくし8,000円 (2時間飲み放題)、おまかせ7品7,500円 (飲み放題)、日本酒ペアリング8,500円、お食事のみおまかせ7品5,000円、お手軽5品3,850円、はなれの完全個室コース7,500円 (1日1組、電話のみ)、予約はコースのみ、苦手な食材は予約時に相談、21時以降のバータイムメニュー (ミックスナッツ600円、ポップコーン800円)、11月の休業日。食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区三条通室町西入る衣棚町45-2、火〜土・祝前日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日・月定休、お一人様1ドリンク、16席、個室あり、2024年2月14日オープン、適格請求書 T2130001044213 (株式会社べっぴんや)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営む、桑名の蛤、舞鶴の魚、はまぐりのしゃぶしゃぶと〆のそば。

cultural_comfort.note: Course bookings; à la carte only after 21:00. A chatty counter where foreign guests have been drawn into the conversation (February 2026). One drink each.

places.name: Three HORSES KYOTO
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: toast, French toast, sandwiches, scones, quiche, cakes and cookies (Kyotopi 2023; 2026 reviews). The pudding and granola with Greek yogurt are not described — ask.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A café of eggs, bacon, dairy and baked goods; no vegan item or plant milk is mentioned in the sources read.
places.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday 9:00–17:00, Friday–Saturday 9:00–21:00, Sundays and holidays 9:00–18:00 (Tabelog; hours may change). In 2023 Kyotopi gave 8:00–18:00, closed Thursdays. Morning menu in the early hours (October 2026). Order and pay at the counter; food is brought to your seat (Kyotopi 2023; October 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). Glass-walled concrete room with a terrace on the Shirakawa; pets on the terrace only (Tabelog; Kyotopi). Children and strollers welcome; take-out (Tabelog). Waits of about 30 min for food at busy breakfast times (October 2026). 5 min from Higashiyama Stn, near Heian Shrine and the Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 31 March 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, on the Shirakawa near Heian Shrine — 5 min from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: All-day café with breakfast, lunch and café time (Kyotopi 2023) · morning plate of salad, half boiled egg, toast, herb sausage, granola with Greek yogurt, ¥1,200 in 2023; ¥100 off a drink with a morning item (Kyotopi 2023; October 2026) · honey cheese toast with grainy mustard; bacon-and-egg French toast with honey (September–October 2026) · lunch: sandwiches, quiche sets, dry curry, tartare salmon sandwich (Kyotopi 2023; October 2026) · Italian pudding, Mont Blanc ¥900, anko-and-butter scone sandwich ¥750, P-chan cookie ¥300, carrot cake, cheesecake, very large scones (2026 reviews) · hand-drip coffee, café latte ¥700, matcha latte, espresso, smoothies (Kyotopi 2023; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Café · Okazaki, by the Shirakawa] A glass-walled concrete café with a terrace on the Shirakawa, steps from Heian Shrine and the KYOCERA Museum — useful before a museum, Noh at the Kanze Kaikan, or a shrine visit. Breakfast from 9:00 (French toast, honey cheese toast, morning plate), sandwiches and dry curry at lunch, and a showcase of puddings, Mont Blanc and huge scones. Order at the counter. Open to 21:00 on Fridays and Saturdays. Busy; expect waits at breakfast.

chef_bio.background: Kyotopi (October 2023) reports the café opened in March 2023 on the site of a bistro that closed during the pandemic, as a sister shop of cafe KaimanaLio in Kusatsu, Shiga, known for specialty coffee. A November 2026 reviewer found the man who served the table “a bit brusque”, if busy.
chef_bio.specialty: Breakfast toasts; pudding; scones; coffee.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor watched the river through the glass with a hand-drip coffee and carrot cake after the KYOCERA Museum.
An October 2026 hotel guest arrived at 9:10 to find five groups already seated and waited about 30 minutes for the French toast.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Kyotopi (2023年10月): Three HORSES (スリー ホースィズ)、2023年3月オープン、コロナ禍で閉じたビストロの跡、滋賀・草津の cafe KaimanaLio の姉妹店、白川沿いのガラス張りとテラス、8時〜18時の通し営業 (当時)、木曜休み (当時)、モーニングプレート1,200円、モーニングとドリンクで100円引き、サンドイッチやキッシュのランチ、ケーキ、スコーン、カウンターで注文し席へ運ぶ。食べログ: カフェ、左京区岡崎円勝寺町65-1 パークハウス京都岡崎有楽荘1F、東山駅から徒歩5分、月〜木 9:00〜17:00、金・土 9:00〜21:00、日・祝 9:00〜18:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー可、テラス、ペットはテラスのみ、子ども可、2023年3月31日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): フレンチトースト、ハニーチーズトースト、プリン、モンブラン900円、あんバタースコーンサンド750円、大きなスコーン、カフェラテ700円、朝は混む。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter, food is brought over; many foreign visitors at breakfast (October 2026).

places.name: 酒ノみつぼし (Sake no Mitsuboshi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Izakaya small plates — fried chicken, dote-yaki, meat tofu, sea bream in sesame-miso with sweet soy, fried pig’s feet, fried yam and corn, spring rolls, stuffed peppers with broth; no gluten information (company site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an izakaya menu of meat, fish and broth-based dishes; the otoshi was shirasu (September 2026).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily; irregular closures (Tabelog; company site). Reservations accepted, including TableCheck; a call 10–20 minutes after a missed booking time, then a no-show cancellation (Tabelog; August 2026). Usually full — book (2026 reviews); a reviewer wondered whether there is a two-hour limit (July 2026). Otoshi ¥330 (Tabelog, original お通し代：330円). Cards, e-money and QR codes (Tabelog). 50 seats: 18 at the counter, 26 at tables, 6 standing, with a second floor (Tabelog; September–October 2026). Private hire 20–50. Non-smoking. English menu. BYO with a corkage fee (Tabelog). 3–5 min from Hankyu Karasuma and subway Shijo Stns (Tabelog). Opened 23 May 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of Shijo between Karasuma and Takakura — 4 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Washoku brought to the izakaya in a Showa-retro room: crisp fried chicken, slow-simmered dote-yaki (company site) · signature meat tofu, sea bream with sesame miso and sweet soy, fried pig’s feet, fried corn, stuffed peppers that burst with broth (2026 reviews) · fried yam, spring rolls, grilled potato salad, braised pork with eggs (July–September 2026) · small portions for sharing; about ¥4,000–6,000 a head with drinks (2026 reviews) · beer poured two ways; sakes including Abu no Tsurugi from Yamaguchi; no wine in September 2026
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo Karasuma, Showa-retro and loud] A packed two-floor taishu sakaba south of Shijo from the team behind 酒呑気びんご, serving small, cheap, well-made plates — the meat tofu, dote-yaki, sesame-miso sea bream, burst-of-broth stuffed peppers, fried yam — with sake and beer poured two ways. Staff push recommendations with gusto. Book ahead; ¥330 otoshi.

chef_bio.background: The company site of 株式会社Atari, which proposes “new sakaba rooted in Kyoto”, lists four shops: 酒呑気びんご, 六角ace, 酒ﾉみつぼし and ageru. Reviewers call it the sister of “Bingo” and “Rokkaku Ace” (August and September 2026). An October 2026 reviewer wrote that “all the staff were handsome, with one beautiful girl”, and called the service outstanding; a September 2026 diner admired the staff’s energetic recommendations.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Bringing washoku to the sakaba” (和食を酒場へ) (company site).
chef_bio.specialty: Meat tofu; dote-yaki; fried chicken.

anecdotes.text: When a September 2026 diner ordered the braised pork, staff asked whether to add boiled eggs to match the number of people.
A July 2026 office drinking club recommended the beer-opening performance.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 株式会社Atari の店舗ページ: 酒ﾉみつぼし、「和食を酒場へ。」、外はカリッと中はジューシーな「鶏揚げ」、とろとろに煮込んだ「どて焼き」、昭和レトロな空間の大衆酒場、17:00〜23:00、不定休、50席、現金・カード・電子マネー、ほかの店は酒呑気びんご、六角ace、ageru.。住所は中京区槌屋町102-2 と書かれているが、これは同社の別の店のページと同じ住所。食べログ: 居酒屋、下京区高材木町227-2、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩3〜5分、毎日17:00〜23:00、予約可、お通し代330円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、50席 (カウンター18、テーブル26、立ち飲み6)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、英語メニュー、持ち込み可 (持ち込み料あり)、2025年5月23日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): びんごの系列、肉豆腐、ごま味噌の鯛、豚足の唐揚げ、旨みの詰まったピーマン、長芋の揚げ物、いつも満席。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); lively, crowded room with proactive staff; ¥330 otoshi.

places.name: JUNGLE CAVE (ジャングルケイブ)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: lunch is kara-age, chicken nanban, fried oysters and tonteki in sauce (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat bar — steaks, homemade sausages, fried chicken and pork set meals with miso soup (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sat dinner only 18:00–23:00; closed Sunday, but open on a Sunday before a Monday holiday. Lunch ends when it sells out (Tabelog; September 2026). Phone bookings only in business hours. 20 seats with sofa seating; smoking allowed (Tabelog); no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted. Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「無し」 (the English auto-translation wrongly says one is added). Opened 22 March 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: West of Kyoto City Hall — about 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae and Karasuma Oike Stns
places.cuisine: A meat bar: homemade sausages, steaks, about ten meat and vegetable snacks, beer, highballs, lemon sours, wine, cocktails (Tabelog) · a one-pound steak with butter and potatoes (November 2025; January 2025) · weekday lunch: two or three set meals a day, listed on a board outside and on Instagram — kara-age set ¥1,100 (October 2025, May 2026), kara-age with homemade tartar ¥1,250 (August 2026), tonteki (pork steak) set ¥1,650–1,680 (August, October 2026), chicken nanban, fried oysters in season (March 2025); big salad, rice and miso soup; rice refills charged (October 2025)
places.notes: [Meat bar · west of City Hall, steak and sausages, big lunch plates] A twenty-seat meat bar open since 2013: homemade sausages and steak by the pound at night, and on weekdays two or three hefty set lunches — kara-age, chicken nanban, a tonteki in a rich sauce — that sell out early. Regulars split on the rice: "declining a bit" (September 2025), "a bit too soft" (May 2026). Smoking allowed. PayPay but no cards. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 22 March 2013 (Tabelog). The Tabelog blurb calls it a pioneering meat bar — a meat tavern with homemade sausages and steaks, about ten snacks always on, and popular meat set lunches that end when they sell out. An older shop blog (2016) announced dinner from 18:00 daily, Friday-only lunches then, and a "chicken mountain" as its speciality. Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe a lunch board at the entrance, two or three set meals a day, and a menu posted on Instagram.
chef_bio.specialty: Steak by the pound; homemade sausages; tonteki set lunch.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner came for the "famous Tonteki Set Meal" before noon: the chicken nanban was already gone, and the tonteki sold out just after, "marking the end of lunch service."
"I personally feel that the quality of the rice (white rice) has been declining a bit" — a ten-time lunch regular, September 2025.
October 2026: "The Tonteki feels 1.5 times bigger than it looks in the pictures."
The fried-oyster set comes once a year in limited numbers — six large oysters with an original tartar sauce (March 2025).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: JUNGLE CAVE (ジャングルケイブ)、バル・ステーキ・居酒屋、中京区橘町641 京都建設会館別館 1F、京都市役所前駅・烏丸御池駅から徒歩約5分、月〜金 11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、土 18:00〜23:00、日曜休み (月曜が祝日なら日曜営業)、20席、ソファ席、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、サービス料は原文で「無し」、2013年3月22日オープン、肉バルの先駆け、自家製ソーセージとステーキ、肉と野菜のおつまみ約10種、ランチの肉定食は売り切れ次第終了。店のブログ (2016年): 夕方18時から営業、名物チキンマウンテン。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年10月、英語): 唐揚げ定食1,100円、自家製タルタル付き1,250円、トンテキ定食1,650〜1,680円、チキン南蛮、季節の牡蠣フライ定食、1ポンドステーキとバターのポテト、ランチは入口の黒板とInstagram、ご飯のおかわりは有料、ご飯の質が落ちた・柔らかすぎるという声、ソースが濃いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch choices are on a board at the entrance; smoking allowed.

places.name: 修伯 (Shuhaku)
places.gf_detail: Ask: a French-influenced kaiseki with deep-fried fugu, fig dengaku and a dessert spread of millefeuille, tarts and Mont Blanc (2020–2024 reviews); soy and wheat are likely through the course. Raise it when booking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of fish, sweetfish sushi, mackerel sushi, Kyoto beef and foie gras with dashi (guide; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun and holidays, lunch 12:00–14:00 (last order 12:30), dinner 17:30–20:30 (last order 18:30); closed Monday and irregularly; reservations only; children welcome. 10 seats — counter and tatami; private hire possible; non-smoking; cards (Visa, Master, JCB, Amex, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). An older, undated guide (aquadina) gave lunch from ¥5,250, dinner from ¥10,500 with 10% service at dinner, closing on Mondays and third Sundays, and no cards. Tabelog lists no service charge.
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama, near the Yasaka Pagoda — 15 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7; 5 min from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki with French ideas, cooked by an owner trained in French cuisine, served kappo-style at a counter (aquadina guide) · lunch course ¥7,000 (November 2020, January 2024); ¥10,000 lunch (May 2018); dinner spend ¥10,000–14,999, up to ¥30,000–39,999 in October 2026 (Tabelog; reviews) · a platter of about 18 vegetables to open (May 2018) · grilled sweetfish sushi, dobin-mushi, sashimi, fig dengaku with white miso, grilled mackerel sushi, Nagano matsutake rice, rice from a kamado (2018–2026 reviews) · a dessert spread of eight or more — Tamba chestnut Mont Blanc, walnut millefeuille, monaka — take as many as you like (2020–2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · near the Yasaka Pagoda, French-trained, the dessert spread] A ten-seat counter-and-tatami kaiseki near the Yasaka Pagoda, run by an owner trained in French cooking: a platter of a dozen-plus vegetables, grilled sweetfish sushi, rice from a kamado, then a spread of eight-plus French-leaning desserts to take as many as you like. Lunch around ¥7,000. Two older gripes: a sukiyaki finish (2018), a hard-centred mochi in the New Year ozoni (2024). Reservations only; closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef, not named; trained in French cuisine (aquadina guide)
chef_bio.background: Per the aquadina guide (undated): an original Kyoto kaiseki restaurant by an owner who trained in French cooking, serving kappo-style at the counter — Kyoto vegetables arranged as a starter, seasonal fish such as eel and fugu, foie gras and truffle, rice cooked over wood, and about ten desserts to choose from freely. A May 2018 reviewer first came about ten years earlier after reading Hisashi Kashiwai’s book on Kyoto restaurants, which named it a rising star, and said it had received a Michelin star the year before.
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable platter; grilled sweetfish sushi; the dessert spread.

anecdotes.text: May 2018: "The most prominent change was the owner, who had previously kept a low profile while raising her children, was now present in the restaurant."
A November 2020 diner meant to take two desserts of eight, "and then they suggested I try a smaller portion of the walnut millefeuille, so I ended up choosing three."
January 2024: deep-fried fugu and karasumi at this price felt generous, "however, I was a bit disappointed that the mochi in the ozoni still had a hard center."
"In Kyoto, there are many places known for delicious grilled mackerel sushi, but this one is my favorite." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 修伯 (しゅうはく)、日本料理、東山区金園町392、京阪祇園四条駅7番出口から徒歩15分、火〜日・祝 12:00〜14:00 (L.O. 12:30)・17:30〜20:30 (L.O. 18:30)、月曜休み・不定休、完全予約制、子供可、10席 (カウンター・座敷)、貸切可、禁煙、カード可。アクアディーナ京都版 (日付なし): フレンチで修業した店主の新感覚のフレンチ風京懐石、カウンター中心で割烹風、昼5,250円〜・夜10,500円〜、京野菜の前菜、鰻・フグ、フォアグラ・トリュフ、〆は薪窯炊きごはん、約10種から好きなだけ選べるデザート、月曜・第3日曜休み、夜のみサービス料10%、カード不可、清水道バス停から徒歩5分。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): Hisashi Kashiwai の本で知った、前年にミシュランの星、18種の野菜の盛り合わせ、子育て中は表に出なかった店主が店に、締めのすき焼きは好みでない、昼7,000円、稚鮎の焼き寿司、無花果の田楽、丹波栗のモンブラン、胡桃のミルフィーユ、デザートは好きなだけ、雑煮の餅に芯、焼き鯖寿司、土瓶蒸し、かまどのご飯、長野の松茸ご飯。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservations only; a small counter and tatami room.
