places.name: とんかつ豚料理 寿樹 三条神宮道本店 (Tonkatsu Juju)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tonkatsu in bread panko, served with tonkatsu sauce and soy sauce (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a pork tonkatsu shop; sets come with pork miso soup and meat miso (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:00. Low-temperature frying takes 20–30 minutes, stated on the menu (October 2026); waits of about 30 minutes at peak (October 2026). Booking advised; phone is more reliable (Tabelog). 26 table seats; non-smoking, smoking in front of the shop; English menu; children and strollers welcome; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「なし」. Opened 14 July 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama-Sanjo — 1 min walk east of Higashiyama Stn; near the Kyocera Museum
places.cuisine: Tonkatsu fried slowly at low temperature from named pork brands (2026 reviews) · Kyoto pork loin ¥2,500; special Kyoto loin 200 g ¥3,000; Hayashi SPF pork from Chiba, loin 150 g ¥2,700; also Iwachu SPF (Iwate), TOKYO X (Ibaraki), Hakkinton (Iwate) when in stock; loin, tenderloin and Spencer roll (September–October 2026 reviews) · every order a set: rice with one free refill, white-miso tonjiru, meat miso, pickles, cabbage with sesame dressing (October 2026) · seven condiments — tonkatsu sauce, two salts, sesame oil, wasabi, yuzu pepper, mustard (October 2026) · warabi mochi (October 2026)
places.notes: [Tonkatsu · Higashiyama-Sanjo, low-temperature fried, by pork brand] A tonkatsu shop a minute from Higashiyama Station where you pick the pig — Kyoto brand pork, Hayashi SPF, TOKYO X — and wait 20–30 minutes while it fries slowly at low temperature. Sets of ¥2,500–3,000 with white-miso tonjiru and seven condiments. Gripes: a strong frying-oil smell that stays on clothes (September 2026), and a lukewarm crust for one diner (October 2026). English menu. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 14 July 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a shop of two tables for two and five for four, a menu that names each pork brand and farm, a note that low-temperature frying takes 20–30 minutes, and a menu sheet crediting its suppliers: an organic Kyoto sauce, panko made from in-house bread, a Kyoto soy sauce, cold-pressed sesame oil from Nantan, salt from Kyotango, rice from Koka in Shiga, and white miso from an old Miyagawacho shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Low-temperature tonkatsu; Kyoto brand pork loin.

anecdotes.text: "I was bothered by the strong smell of frying oil that lingered while I was in the restaurant. Even after leaving, my clothes smelled like oil." — September 2026.
A September 2026 diner came back two weeks later for dinner and found less meat miso, less pepper and the pork rarer than at lunch — "a bit disappointed this time."
An October 2026 diner praised a staff member as "very charming, attentive," with a voice so gentle "I found myself thinking, 'Maybe I should order another serving' (laughs)."
A first-timer in October 2026 found the light-coloured crust not piping hot — "for a hungry girl like me, it felt a bit too upscale."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: とんかつ豚料理 寿樹 三条神宮道本店 (Juju)、とんかつ・しゃぶしゃぶ、東山区五軒町117、地下鉄東西線東山駅から東へ徒歩1分、毎日 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜21:00、予約は早めに・電話が確実、テーブル26席、禁煙 (店の前で喫煙可)、英語メニュー、子供・ベビーカー可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、サービス料は原文で「なし」、2022年7月14日オープン。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 低温でじっくり揚げるので20〜30分、京都のブランド豚、林SPFポーク (千葉)、岩手の SPF 豚、TOKYO X、Hakkinton、京都ポークロース2,500円、京都特選ロース200g 3,000円、林SPFポーク ロース150g 2,700円、ご飯はおかわり1回無料、白味噌の豚汁、肉味噌、漬物、キャベツに胡麻ドレッシング、7種の薬味、わらび餅、揚げ油の匂いが服に残る、夜は肉味噌が少なめ、女性スタッフの丁寧な接客。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; expect a 20–30 minute wait for the frying.

places.name: エール新町 (Ailes Shinmachi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pâté en croûte, a millefeuille-style starter, onion gratin soup, baguette refills and cakes (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: French courses of terrines, fish, duck, lamb, pork and wagyu (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 11:30–14:15 (last order 13:15), dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 20:00); closed Wednesday (irregular in December). Tabelog adds 2–4 other closed days a month. Courses only, one per person; no children of primary-school age or younger, and no guests who do not order a course (official site; Tabelog says under 10). Same-day cancellations or changes are charged 100% (official site). 30 table seats, private room for 6 (guarantee ¥20,000 lunch / ¥30,000 dinner), parties up to 50; non-smoking with a smoking spot in front; wheelchair accessible; cards (Visa, Master, JCB, Amex, Diners) and PayPay (official site; Tabelog) — though a July 2026 diner noted "they only accept cash." Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「頂いておりません」. Opened 2 July 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: A brick building near Shijo-Karasuma — 3–4 min walk from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Classic French courses with Kyoto vegetables and seasonal seafood (official site) · courses, tax included: a weekday prix-fixe lunch ¥3,000 (green salad, soup, main, dessert, bread, coffee); prix-fixe courses ¥4,000 and ¥5,000; chef’s omakase ¥6,500 (amuse, hors d’oeuvre, soup, grilled abalone, kuroge wagyu, dessert); a ¥12,000 omakase at Shinmachi only; course-plus-drink plans (official site) · Fleur lunch with a drink ¥3,600 (August 2026) · seen: pâté en croûte, vichyssoise, burdock potage, seafood gâteau on grilled eggplant, mussels, sea bass, herb-crusted pork, duck, lamb stew, a hamburg steak, 100 g kuroge wagyu upgrade, matcha mousse (2026 reviews) · birthday and anniversary courses (official site)
places.notes: [French · Shijo-Karasuma, a brick building with a French flag] A thirty-seat French dining room in a retro brick building with a French flag, sister to the original Ailes in Muromachi (2005). Prix-fixe courses from ¥3,000 at weekday lunch to a ¥6,500 chef’s omakase — terrines, sea bass, duck, lamb stew, with baguette refills. 2026 diners keep calling it rare value for Kyoto. Courses only; no young children; 100% same-day cancellation. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Not named in a source; run by 株式会社エール (president 太田 篤), which also runs Ailes Muromachi
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Ailes — imagined as "La table des anges", the angels’ table — opened in Muromachi-Oike in September 2005; today it runs two restaurants, the second being Ailes Shinmachi near Shijo-Karasuma, an at-home but serious French restaurant with diners from the neighbourhood and far away. The company, 株式会社エール (20 staff), also does catering, take-out, delicatessen and an online shop started for regulars who moved away. The Shinmachi shop opened 2 July 2012 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: to obey the law in handling food, waste no food, and judge by what is good and kind to people and the planet.
chef_bio.specialty: Prix-fixe French lunch; pâté en croûte.

anecdotes.text: "The cost performance is also quite rare in Kyoto" — though the private room for six "was a bit small." — June 2026.
A September 2026 first-timer was tempted to go all out, "but my companion suggested, 'This is more than enough,'" and took the recommended lunch.
August 2026: the baguette came with refills; "the fluffy white bread was even tastier, but it seems that one wasn’t available for refills."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-restaurant.jp): Ailes (エール)、「天使たちの食卓」をイメージして2005年9月に室町御池で開業、現在は四条烏丸の Ailes 新町と2店舗、アットホームな本格フレンチ、株式会社エール (中京区橋本町、代表取締役社長 太田 篤、従業員20名、飲食・ケータリング・物販)、新町店は下京区船鉾町400、ランチ11:30〜14:15 (L.O. 13:15)、ディナー17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 20:00)、水曜休み (12月は不定休)、カード可、四条駅から徒歩4分、レンガ作りのレトロな建物にフランス国旗、京野菜と旬の魚介、平日のプリフィクスのランチ3,000円、プリフィックス4,000円・5,000円、シェフお任せ6,500円 (鮑のグリル、黒毛和牛のポワレ)、新町店のみのスペシャリテ12,000円、税込、人数分のコースを注文、小学生以下とコースを頼まない客は不可、当日のキャンセル・変更は100%。食べログ: フレンチ・イタリアン、30席、個室6名 (保証金 昼2万円・夜3万円)、宴会50名、禁煙 (店頭に喫煙所)、車椅子可、PayPay可、サービス料は原文で「頂いておりません」、10歳未満不可、2012年7月2日オープン、水曜と月2〜4日休み。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月): パテ・アン・クルート、ヴィシソワーズ、ごぼうのポタージュ、焼き茄子の上の魚介のガトー、ムール貝、スズキのポワレ、香草パン粉の豚、鴨、仔羊の煮込み、ハンバーグ、黒毛和牛100gへの変更、オニオングラタンスープ、フルールコース ドリンク付き3,600円、バゲットはおかわり可、個室は少し狭い、京都では珍しいコスパ、現金のみという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Prix-fixe courses explained at the table; courses only, no young children.

places.name: オステリア・バスティーユ (Osteria Bastille)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, bread and breaded dishes sit beside steak, game, carpaccio and salads; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the official site stresses organic vegetables from Kyoto and Shiga growers, but most dishes are meat or fish (Tabelog; official site; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Thu and Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00); Fri, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Mon–Wed for dining, with catering and large take-away orders (Tabelog; official site, January 2025). Bookings advised — "Reservations are necessary" (October 2025 review); lunch courses can be booked, other lunches by phone from 10:00 (February 2026 review). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし"; a ¥440 seat-and-bread charge applies to table-only bookings (Tabelog). Lunch is cash only; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay at dinner (Tabelog). 22 seats, about five tables (March 2022 review); children welcome; non-smoking (Tabelog). 5 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: East of Karasuma near Shijo-Karasuma — 5 min from Shijo / Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Italian × French bistro cooking: assorted appetizers, carpaccio of amberjack or sea bass, sakura-shrimp or anchovy pasta, warm gizzard-and-bacon salad, beef steak, venison braised in red wine, braised pork; lunch daily special ¥1,800 and pasta set ¥2,900 (August 2026); lunch course with soup, pasta, venison and three desserts (November 2025) (2025–26 reviews) · organic vegetables, catering and bento (official site)
places.notes: [Italian-French bistro · near Shijo-Karasuma] A cosy, antique-filled osteria of about 22 years, mixing Italian and French: carpaccio, sakura-shrimp pasta, game such as venison braised in red wine, and generous lunch sets around ¥1,800–2,900. Lunch Thu–Sun, dinner Fri–Sat only; book ahead, and bring cash for lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the chef draws on training abroad to take "the best of French and Italian"; the name comes from the Bastille quarter of Paris; the 22nd anniversary was marked in December 2025; in recent years the shop has added catering, markets and outdoor events. A long-time regular describes it as "run by a lovely couple" (August 2025 review), while the official site advertises for part-time staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: A "上質な日常" (a fine everyday) in a European room of antique furniture; safe food with clear origins, buying organic vegetables directly from Kyoto and Shiga growers (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Italian-French bistro dishes; game in season.

anecdotes.text: A diner of nearly 20 years called it a warm restaurant whose gentle flavours reflect the owners' kind personalities — August 2025.
In October 2025 a couple had the season's first venison, from Shiga, and found it remarkably tender.
Calling on a snowy February 2026 morning, two friends got a same-day table and said the meal "blew our taste buds away".
A September 2026 pair noted the pasta came split onto two plates unasked.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: オステリア バスティーユ、中京区烏丸蛸薬師東入ル一蓮社町310 メゾン高見1F、シェフ 山本 知 (SATORU YAMAMOTO)、海外での修行を生かしたフレンチとイタリアンのいいとこ取り、京都・滋賀の生産者から仕入れる有機野菜、アンティーク家具の空間、ケータリング・ランチボックス・ネットショップ、月火水休み (ケータリング対応)・木日ランチのみ・金土ランチとディナー (2025年1月)、2025年12月に22周年、アルバイト募集中。食べログ (店舗会員): イタリアン・フレンチ・ダイニングバー、22席、サービス料なし、席のみ予約は席料・パン代440円、ランチは現金のみ。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年9月、英語): 夫婦で営む温かい店、前菜盛り合わせ、カルパッチョ、桜海老のパスタ、砂肝とベーコンのサラダ、鹿肉、日替わり1,800円、パスタセット2,900円、予約推奨。

cultural_comfort.note: Small bistro; book ahead; cash only at lunch.

places.name: GRIDDLE FORCE 逸楽 (GRIDDLE FORCE Itsuraku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan steak with sauces, a curry to finish, croquettes and fried sets at lunch; no gluten information (Tabelog; official site; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a teppanyaki steak restaurant (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30; lunch ends when sold out) and 18:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). The official site gives dinner as 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「席のみ予約のお客様には、お通し代として、500円頂いております。」 — a ¥500 appetizer charge for seat-only bookings. Lunch is cash only (August 2025 and October 2026 reviews); cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY per Tabelog. 16 seats: 10 at the counter and a hidden private room for six reached by a side passage and an intercom at the back door (Tabelog; official site gives 12 + 6). Children at lunch; at dinner only in the private room (Tabelog). Free Wi-Fi; non-smoking. 5 min from Karasuma or Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: East of Karasuma near Shijo-Karasuma — 5 min from Karasuma / Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki steak counter: Kyoto beef fillet and sirloin, golden-eye snapper carpaccio, lamb tenderloin, seasonal Kyoto vegetables from the central market, the manager's mini curry instead of garlic rice to finish; 30–40 wines (Tabelog; official site) · lunch steak set in three sizes, medium (225 g) ¥1,400 (September 2026); Friday hamburg steak; dinner courses with lobster and wagyu (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki steak · near Shijo-Karasuma] A ten-seat teppan counter with a secret private room behind, where the chef grills Kyoto beef in front of you and finishes with a small curry instead of garlic rice. The lunch steak set (about ¥1,400, cash only) is the draw; dinner courses with lobster and wagyu run ¥8,000–10,000. Closed Monday.

roles: Manager (店長), maker of the finishing curry
chef_bio.background: Opened 19 November 2015 (Tabelog). The official site also links a sister izakaya, 居酒屋いつらく (kushiyaki).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto beef fillet and sirloin, the day's best from a trusted Kyoto supplier, paired with wine (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan steak; 吉田's mini curry to finish.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 lunch guest watched the chef grill lean beef on the teppan and cut it into bite-size pieces, at about ¥1,200.
A May 2026 diner loved the course and the private room but wished the staff were friendlier and the coffee deeper.
An October 2026 lunch guest was told to move to the end seat after choosing a seat, and that cards were not taken at lunch.
In October 2026 a guest left food and drinks to the chef and staff for a reunion dinner ending in the house curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: GRIDDLE FORCE.逸楽、中京区一連社町298-2 染匠会館1F、京都牛のフィレとサーロイン、店長の吉田が作る〆のミニカレー、グラスワイン赤白各3種・ボトル20種以上、店内奥の完全個室 (6名、裏口のインターフォンから)、ランチ 11:30〜14:00、ディナー 17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、月曜休み、18席、姉妹店の居酒屋いつらく。食べログ (店舗会員): 鉄板焼き・ステーキ、2015年11月19日オープン、火〜日 11:30〜14:00・18:00〜22:00、16席、席のみ予約はお通し代500円、金目鯛のカルパッチョ、仔羊フィレ。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): ステーキランチ大中小、中225g 1,400円、ランチは現金のみ、ロブスターと和牛のコース。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seating; cash only at lunch.

places.name: 御幸町ささき (Goko Machi Sasaki)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura izakaya; the batter is wheat. Sashimi and simmered dishes exist, but fryer and broth are shared (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and meat dishes; vegetable tempura is served with dashi-based broth (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 15:00–22:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken online; parties of five or more by phone. "If you are unable to order from the Japanese menu, we will accommodate you with a course menu" (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 at tables; children and strollers welcome; non-smoking, smoking area outside; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Goko Machi Street, in the former home of Umaimonya Issho (February 2026 review); 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Goko Machi Street near Kyoto City Hall — 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Edo-style tempura fried in sesame oil, rare in Kansai, with izakaya dishes: sashimi platters, obanzai, salads, fried chicken (Tabelog) · oyster tamayose ¥770, duck roast ¥1,100, rare-fried yellowtail cutlet ¥1,540 (February 2026); clam tempura in the shell with broth, Kamo eggplant and manganji pepper tempura, shrimp-and-celery spring rolls, shumai made to order; 15–20 sakes (2026 reviews; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Tempura izakaya · Goko Machi Street near Kyoto City Hall] A calm counter-and-table izakaya, opened 2024, frying Edo-style tempura in sesame oil to order — clams in the shell with broth, Kamo eggplant, lotus root — alongside sashimi, duck roast and good sake. Opens at 15:00 for an early drink; about ¥6,000–8,000. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 27 June 2024 (Tabelog), in the former home of Umaimonya Issho (February 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Edo-style tempura in sesame oil that brings out the ingredients, with seasonal dishes from the morning market (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sesame-oil Edo-style tempura.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner found some drinks and dishes unavailable and the busy owner a bit unfriendly.
An August 2026 guest arriving at 16:30 was first in, followed by two older local couples; the ayu simmered with sansho sold out as the couples ordered it.
In October 2026 the master cooked alone; a pair ordered the clam tempura twice, and a staff member who came in later served a foreign family in fluent English.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 御幸町ささき、居酒屋・天ぷら、中京区御幸町通押小路上る山本町427、京都市役所前駅から徒歩7分、15:00〜22:00、水曜休み、2024年6月27日オープン、16席 (カウンター8・テーブル8)、子供可、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、カード可、関西では珍しい胡麻油の江戸前天ぷら、市場の旬の一品、刺身、おばんざい、日本酒15〜20種、日本語の品書きで注文できない方にはコースで対応。口コミ (2026年2〜10月、英語): 牡蠣の Tamayose 770円、鴨ロース1,100円、ぶりのレアカツ1,540円、蛤の天ぷら、なす、唐辛子、海老とセロリの春巻き、焼売、店主が一人で揚げる、英語の堪能なスタッフ、店主が忙しく無愛想という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese menu; a course is offered to guests who cannot order from it (Tabelog); an English-speaking staff member was seen in October 2026.

places.name: 酒処 四方 (Sake Dokoro Shikata)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dote-ni and oden in soy-based broth, sashimi, clay-pot rice; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-tendon dote-ni, fish and dashi dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily; hours may change, check before visiting (Tabelog). Hitosara gives 17:00–24:00 with irregular holidays. Bookings taken (Tabelog). Counter on the ground floor, tables upstairs with a dumbwaiter by the stairs (August and November 2026 reviews); children welcome; non-smoking; cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). In a traditional Kyoto machiya (October 2026 review); about 300 m from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; October 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: South-west of Karasuma Oike — 5 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Creative izakaya in a machiya: the signature dote-ni (beef-tendon stew, also as a rice bowl), oden, motsu-ni, negitoro, potato salad with shime-saba, chicken-thigh tataki, white tofu with prosciutto, figs with white-sesame dressing and Shine Muscat, mascarpone and figs; clay-pot rice — leftovers wrapped as onigiri to take home; a seasonal menu, half portions for solo diners (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Machiya izakaya · near Karasuma Oike] A stylish townhouse izakaya, counter downstairs and tables up: the signature dote-ni, oden, seasonal small plates and a clay-pot rice whose leftovers come back as onigiri to take away. About ¥3,000–5,000 with drinks; portions suit two, and staff offer solo-size helpings. Daily from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff in a traditional Kyoto machiya, popular with a younger crowd (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Dote-ni; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 first-timer was told up front that portions serve about two, which helped with ordering.
An October 2026 diner was disappointed by the lack of Japanese sake on the menu, while an October 2026 traveller praised the drinks list.
A November 2026 party found the ikura dishes sold out and the dumbwaiter beside the upstairs table noisy, but loved the dote and oden.
A salt-averse October 2026 diner found the oden and doteyaki strong in soy but delicious.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒処 四方、居酒屋、中京区烏帽子屋町477、烏丸御池駅から302m、毎日17:00〜23:00 (変更あり)、予約可、禁煙、子供可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可。ヒトサラ: 17:00〜24:00、不定休。口コミ (2026年6〜11月、英語): 町家の居酒屋、1階カウンターと2階テーブル、名物の土手煮 (土手煮丼)、おでん、もつ煮、ねぎとろ、ポテサラとしめ鯖、鶏ももたたき、無花果の白ごまの和え物、土鍋ご飯の残りはおにぎりにして持ち帰り可、2人前ほどの量でおひとり様向けの量にも、日本酒がないという声と飲み物の品揃えを褒める声、2階の運搬機の音。四方食店 (姥柳町) との関係を示す資料は見つからなかった。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff offer solo-size portions; book ahead at weekends.

places.name: 圓徳院アメックスラウンジ (Entokuin Amex Lounge)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese sweets served with the tea (2025–26 reviews); no ingredient information. The teas named in reviews are kombu tea, Uji tea and barley tea.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tea (kombu tea, Uji tea, barley tea, ume kombucha, hiyashi ame) and a Japanese sweet (2023–26 reviews); no ingredient information for the sweets.
places.hours_raw: AMEX CARDHOLDERS ONLY: entry is for holders of an AMEX Gold or Business Gold card or higher (Tabelog remarks; reviews from August 2024, December 2025 and May 2026), and the cardholder’s companions may come in too (April 2026). A cardholder with a US-issued AMEX was turned away and entered on a friend’s card (April 2026), so the card may need to be issued in Japan. 10:00–17:00 daily, closed irregularly (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Tea, sweets and entry to Entoku-in (normally ¥500) are free for cardholders (December 2025); nothing to pay. 20 tatami seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Kodai-ji parking free for 1 hour (Tabelog). Enter by a back gate off Nene no Michi with an AMEX sign, not the temple’s main entrance (February and August 2024); ring the bell if no one is there; shoes off (April 2026).
places.neighborhood: Entoku-in at Kodai-ji, off Nene no Michi — 761 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: AMEX Gold-or-higher cardholders only (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews) · complimentary seasonal tea — kombu tea, ume kombucha, Uji tea, barley tea, hiyashi ame (chilled ginger sweet drink) — with a Japanese sweet, served on tatami facing the garden (2023–26 reviews) · free entry to Entoku-in, normally ¥500 (December 2025) · free sutra copying and miniature dry-garden making (February 2024, April 2026)
places.notes: [AMEX lounge · Kodai-ji, tea in a temple — AMEX Gold cardholders or higher only] A tea room inside Entoku-in, the Kodai-ji sub-temple, open only to holders of an AMEX Gold card or higher and anyone accompanying a cardholder (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews); one April 2026 visitor with a US-issued card was refused. Through a back gate off Nene no Michi, ring the bell, leave shoes, and sit on tatami over the garden with free seasonal tea — kombu tea, Uji tea, chilled hiyashi ame — and a sweet. Entry to the temple, sutra copying and a miniature dry-garden are included. 10:00–17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: the AMEX cardholder lounge in Entoku-in, a sub-temple of Kodai-ji, described in May 2023 as the only AMEX lounge outside an airport and in December 2025 as the Entoku-in Guest Hall, formerly the Kyoto Special Tourist Lounge. Tabelog links the AMEX Japan benefits page and states that only Amex Gold or Amex Business Gold cardholders or higher may enter.
chef_bio.specialty: Complimentary seasonal tea and a sweet.

anecdotes.text: A May 2023 visitor was welcomed after ringing the bell in the courtyard and served ume kombucha at a high tea table; Uji tea, ume water, kombu tea and roasted tea rotate.
A February 2024 visitor likened the place to a relative’s grandmother’s house crossed with a ninja mansion, with a hanging scroll within reach.
A June 2026 regular singled out the hiyashi ame, a chilled ginger drink, for humid days.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 東山区高台寺下河原町530、祇園四条から761m、10:00〜17:00、不定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、20席、座敷、禁煙、高台寺駐車場1時間無料、備考 (英訳): Amex Gold と Amex Business Gold 以上のカード会員のみ入場可。口コミ (2022年7月〜2026年6月、英語): AMEX Gold 以上で無料、同伴者も可、米国発行のカードでは入れなかった (2026年4月)、昆布茶・梅昆布茶・Uji のお茶・麦茶・冷やし飴と和菓子、圓徳院の拝観 (通常500円) も無料、写経、小さな枯山水づくり、Nene no Michi 側の裏口、呼び鈴、靴を脱ぐ。

cultural_comfort.note: Entry only with an AMEX Gold card or higher (companions welcome); a US-issued card was refused in April 2026, so check the card qualifies. Find the back gate off Nene no Michi, ring the bell, shoes off; staff serve the tea.

places.name: 逸品 はし長 (Ippin Hashinaga)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Set courses that include tempura and fried dishes (March 2025, June 2026) and soy-seasoned dishes; no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led courses built on dashi — clear soups, dobin-mushi, chawanmushi (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (last entry 12:30), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last entry 19:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; the shop asks for a call before visiting as it is small (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR, but lunch and all-you-can-drink cannot be paid by card (Tabelog). 20 seats: 6 at the counter and 12 on tatami; semi-private rooms separated by blinds, private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Muromachi north of Takoyakushi; 5 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 21 April 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Muromachi north of Takoyakushi — 5 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kappo set courses that change monthly (April 2025) · lunch course ¥3,500 in 2025, about seven dishes — chirashi sushi, clear soup, sashimi, tempura, chawanmushi, rice with homemade chirimen sansho and red miso soup, hojicha ice cream (March and May 2025); ¥4,400 lunch with hamo sashimi and simmered octopus and taro (June 2026) · dinner courses ¥5,800 (April 2025), ¥7,700 (October 2025), and ¥6,000 or ¥8,000 with more hamo in summer (August 2026) · matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn (October 2026) · homemade desserts (December 2025) · Kyoto sake (March 2026)
places.notes: [Kappo · Shijo Muromachi, monthly courses at a fair price] A small counter-and-tatami kappo on Muromachi that has served monthly-changing courses since 2011: a ¥3,500–4,400 lunch of chirashi sushi, sashimi, tempura and homemade chirimen sansho rice, and dinner courses from about ¥6,000, with hamo in summer and matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn. Desserts are homemade; Kyoto sake. Lunch is cash or e-money only. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), described as kind and explaining each dish (October 2025)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant particular about fish and sake, opened 21 April 2011, with 6 counter seats and 12 on tatami. An April 2025 diner learned the menu changes monthly.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kappo courses; hamo in summer, matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 diner found the dashi in the soup course so good it could be sipped forever, and was so taken with the meal that work talk never came up.
An August 2026 diner chose between hamo courses: about one piece a dish at ¥6,000, about five at ¥8,000.
An August 2026 diner called the sea urchin the best of half a century of eating.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区室町通蛸薬師上ル鯉山町535 室蛸ビル 1F、四条駅から徒歩5分、昼12:00〜14:00 (最終入店12:30)、夜18:00〜22:00 (最終入店19:30)、火曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可 (昼と飲み放題はカード不可)、20席 (カウンター6、座敷12)、半個室、2011年4月21日オープン。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年11月、英語): 昼のコース3,500円・4,400円、夜5,800円・7,700円、夏は鱧のコース6,000円と8,000円、松茸の土瓶蒸し、ちりめん山椒のご飯、自家製のデザート、月替わりの献立、京都の地酒。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a set course; dishes are explained (October 2025); tatami seating suits families (June 2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: 十二段家 花見小路店 (Junidanya Hanamikoji)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: sukiyaki with udon in the pot (December 2025), a tempura rice bowl (Tabelog category; January 2026) and soy-based sauces. For shabu-shabu, ask about the sesame and ponzu sauces.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef house; even the yuba soy-milk hot pot set came with simmered beef and a dashi omelette (January 2026).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–20:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); waits of 15–30 min at 18:00 (October 2025, February 2026). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). 55 seats with tatami; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Hanamikoji; 5 min east of Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). The separate main shop, four doors east, took groups of two or more only (December 2025).
places.neighborhood: Gion, on Hanamikoji south of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Shabu-shabu from the house that calls itself its birthplace (official site; Tabelog) · shabu-shabu set ¥3,800 — three large slices of marbled beef with vegetables, tofu and kombu in an individual pot, sesame sauce or ponzu, both for +¥200, rice and pickles (October 2025, April 2026, August 2026); extra meat from ¥900 (October 2025) · beef sukiyaki set ¥4,200 with a little udon (December 2025) · yuba soy-milk hot pot (January 2026) · Black Wagyu strip loin grilled on a tile (November 2025) · simmered beef, dashimaki omelette, tempura rice bowl (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Shabu-shabu · Gion Hanamikoji, where beef shabu-shabu began] The Hanamikoji branch of Junidanya, whose second-generation owner devised beef mizutaki — now known as shabu-shabu — in 1949, and opened this shop as a more casual one (official site). A ¥3,800 set brings three slices of marbled beef for your own pot with sesame sauce or ponzu; the sukiyaki set (¥4,200) is the other favourite. No reservations — expect a short wait at dinner. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (junidanya-kyoto.com): 「牛肉の水炊き(しゃぶしゃぶ)発祥の店」. In 1949 (昭和24年) the second-generation owner, advised by a doctor friend from Tottori (吉田璋也) and others, devised beef mizutaki, which became the shabu-shabu known across Japan. The same owner opened the Hanamikoji shop to make it easier to drop in; the main shop is four doors east, and the site marks the two as separate shops.
chef_bio.specialty: Shabu-shabu with house sesame sauce; beef sukiyaki.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner dipped the beef mostly in the sesame sauce and kept the milder ponzu for the vegetables.
An August 2026 diner noted that every other customer was from overseas, and several staff too.
A December 2025 diner, turned away from the main shop as a party of one, came here instead for shabu-shabu with simmered beef and Kyoto yuba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 牛肉の水炊き(しゃぶしゃぶ)発祥の店、昭和24年に二代目が鳥取の医師 吉田璋也らの助言で考案、二代目がより気軽にと花見小路店を出店、本店はその四軒東で別店舗。食べログ: しゃぶしゃぶ・鍋・天丼、東山区祇園町南側570-240、祇園四条から徒歩5分、11:30〜14:00・17:00〜20:00、水木休み、予約不可、カード・PayPay 可、55席、座敷、貸切20〜50名。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年8月、英語): しゃぶしゃぶ定食3,800円 (肉3枚、ごまだれ・ぽん酢、両方で200円増し)、追加の肉900円から、すき焼き御膳4,200円、湯葉の豆乳鍋、黒毛和牛ロースの瓦焼き、だし巻き、牛の煮物、外国人の客と店員が多い、夕方は15〜30分待ち。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in and wait; set meals with your own pot, and staff explain how long to simmer (December 2025). Many overseas guests and several overseas staff (August 2026).

places.name: 先斗町ふじ田 (Pontocho Fujita)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki courses include tempura, nama-fu (wheat gluten) and grilled fu (August 2025, July 2026); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the cooking rests on a kombu and katsuobushi dashi (Tabelog, shop text); fish and meat courses.
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last food order 12:00), dinner 17:30–21:30 (last food order 19:00); closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). Tabelog still notes a closure until mid-April 2026 after a fire next door; reviews from June to October 2026 show it open again. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 50 seats at a counter and in private and tatami rooms (Tabelog); shoes off at the entrance (July 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Pontocho south of Sanjo, facing the Pontocho Kaburenjo (September 2025); 4 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, facing the Kaburenjo — 4 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto cuisine built on a dashi of three kombu, steeped at 60°C for two hours, with katsuobushi; fish chosen each morning at the central market by the head chef and from a fishmonger of over 20 years (Tabelog, shop text) · lunch and dinner kaiseki and à la carte (Tabelog) · eight-dish course ¥12,000 (Tabelog), the same price as the Hana dinner (July 2026) · Miyabi lunch course ¥8,000: sashimi, Kyoto wagyu steak, hamo tempura, squid rice (August 2025) · Tsuki dinner course (April 2025) · a ¥25,400 course with seared kinmedai (June 2025) · fried hamo (June and October 2026) · hojicha gelato (July 2025) · roast beef coated in tea leaves sold online (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Pontocho, facing the Kaburenjo] A kaiseki house on Pontocho opposite the Kaburenjo theatre, where the head chef shops the central market every morning and builds everything on a two-hour kombu-and-bonito dashi. Lunch courses from about ¥8,000, dinner around ¥12,000; seats at the counter, where the chef talks with guests, or in window rooms upstairs. One May 2025 diner found the meat and grilled fish weaker than the rest. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

roles: Head chef (unnamed), who goes to the central market each morning (Tabelog, shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): Kyoto cuisine centred on dashi from ma-kombu and two kinds of Rishiri kombu, steeped at 60°C for two hours with katsuobushi added quickly; seafood from Setouchi and Kyushu through a fishmonger of more than 20 years; private rooms for business and celebrations; an online shop sells roast beef of Kyoto beef round coated in tencha tea leaves from Wazuka, Uji.
chef_bio.philosophy: Dashi as the essence of every dish, drawing out the ingredients’ own flavour (Tabelog, shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto kaiseki courses; hamo in season.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner found the head chef friendly and easy to talk to; most guests were from overseas and were served well in English.
A September 2025 diner ate in a second-floor private room looking out on the Pontocho Kaburenjo, a filming location of the film “National Treasure”.
An October 2026 diner was served hamo described as “the best at this time of year” and found it remarkably fluffy.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区先斗町通三条下る材木町179-2、三条駅から徒歩4分、昼11:30〜14:00・夜17:30〜21:30、月火休み、隣の店の火事で2026年4月中旬まで休業との記載、予約可、カード可 (電子マネー・QR 不可)、50席、個室、禁煙。店の紹介 (英訳): 3種の昆布を60℃で2時間、鰹節で引く出汁、料理長が毎朝中央市場へ、20年以上の付き合いの魚屋から Setouchi と Kyushu の魚介、昼と夜の懐石とアラカルト、8品のコース12,000円、てん茶をまぶしたローストビーフの通販。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年10月、英語): 歌舞練場の向かい、2階の個室、料理長と話せる、英語での対応 (2025年5月)、肉と焼き魚は今ひとつ (2025年5月)、常連が多く落ち着かない日も (2025年7月)、鱧の天ぷらと揚げ物、ほうじ茶のジェラート。

cultural_comfort.note: A May 2025 diner reported most guests were from overseas and were served well in English; the head chef chats at the counter. Shoes off; book ahead.

places.name: 京都祇園茶寮 (Kyoto Gion Saryo)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bakery café built around thick toast of its house-baked bread, with cakes and hot sandwiches (official menu; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Teas and lattes can be made with soy milk (August 2026), but the bread sets come with butter and egg salad; nothing vegan is marked (official menu; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Weekdays 9:00–15:30; Saturday and Sunday 8:00–16:30 (Tabelog); the official site gives 9:00–17:00 (last order 16:30). Closing days are posted monthly on the official site. No service or cover charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料・チャージ なし」). The bread sets are limited to about 20–30 a day, so come early (November 2025; March 2026). Seating on two floors, including sofas; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX), transit IC, iD and QR (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Whole-building hire with food for groups (official site). A renovated storehouse about 100 years old in front of the south gate of Yasaka Shrine; about 5 min from the Higashiyama-Yasui bus stop (official site). Opened 1 August 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, Yasaka Shrine south gate — 5 min from Higashiyama-Yasui bus stop
places.cuisine: Breakfast and tea café whose signature is 蔵出し食パン, a chewy loaf baked in the shop (official site) · freshly baked plain loaf with salad and soup ¥1,380 (November 2025); matcha and plain loaf set ¥2,650 with salad, corn soup, salted butter, egg salad and yuzu jam (June 2026); sansho corned-beef hot sandwich; seasonal salad; morning soup; three patissier’s cakes with a drink about ¥2,000 · drinks: matcha latte from 八十八良葉舎, hōjicha latte from 一保堂, matcha espresso ¥1,080, burnt-caramel latte, Mlesna teas, sake-lees lemonade, plum juice; monaka with milk ice cream (official menu; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Café · Yasaka Shrine, thick toast in an old storehouse] A two-floor café in a century-old storehouse facing the south gate of Yasaka Shrine, open from 8:00 at weekends — handy before the crowds. The draw is a chewy house-baked loaf served thick with butter, egg salad, yuzu jam or sweet bean paste, plus soup and salad; only 20–30 sets a day. Matcha espresso and Ippodo hōjicha lattes for later. Upstairs looks out toward the shrine. Closing days vary; check the site.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a select tea house that aims to hand Kyoto’s history and culture down to the next generation (its theme is "紡ぐ", to spin a thread); a renovated storehouse about 100 years old near the main gate of Yasaka Shrine, with 13 staff in 2023 (recruiting page). The loaf 蔵出し食パン is baked in the shop’s own workshop. Opened 1 August 2020 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to spin Kyoto’s history and culture into the future.
chef_bio.specialty: Thick toast of the house-baked 蔵出し食パン.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor who came at 8:00 near Yasaka Shrine got one of the roughly 30 bread sets.
An August 2026 guest had the matcha espresso made with soy milk.
An April 2026 pair wished the only dessert option, a three-cake set, could be varied.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-saryou.kyoto): 京都祇園茶寮、京都の文化を世界に伝えるセレクト茶寮、テーマは京都の想いを後世に紡ぐこと、八坂神社南楼門前、東山区祇園町南側506、9:00〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、市バス東山安井から徒歩約5分、定休日は毎月お知らせ、一棟まるごとプラン。メニュー: 焼きたて蔵出し食パン、季節のサラダ、お目覚めスープ、山椒コンビーフのホットサンド、パティシエのおすすめケーキ3種とドリンク、八十八良葉舎の抹茶ラテ、一保堂のほうじ茶ラテ、抹茶エスプレッソ、ムレスナティー。求人 (2023年): 築100年の蔵を改装、スタッフ13名。食べログ: カフェ・パン、平日9:00〜15:30、土日8:00〜16:30、サービス料・チャージなし、カード・交通系IC・iD・QR 可、禁煙、2020年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年9月、英語): 食パン1,380円、抹茶とプレーンの食パン2,650円、1日20〜30食、抹茶エスプレッソ1,080円、豆乳に変更可。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas visitors in the morning; order at the counter.

places.name: やよいComodo (やよい 本店, Yayoi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The ojako is chirimen-jako simmered in soy sauce, and the udon is wheat; warabi-mochi and green tea are also served; no gluten information is published (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the meals are built on chirimen-jako (baby sardines), and the udon broth is made from the simmered ojako (official site).
places.hours_raw: Café 9:30–15:00 (last order 14:00); closed Tuesday, Wednesday and irregularly (official café page). Tabelog instead lists eat-in at weekends and holidays 9:30–14:00 — check before going. The shop itself is open 9:30–17:00 daily except 1–2 January (official site; Tabelog). Ojako-zen is limited to 12 a day; matcha warabi-mochi from 11:00 while it lasts (official site). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 12 places on floor cushions in the back, past the shop counter (Tabelog; July 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and QR (Tabelog). In the はなれ behind the main shop, about 100 m south of the south gate of Yasaka Shrine on Shimogawara-dori (official site). The café opened in 2004 and was renamed やよいComodo on 1 October 2026 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Gion, Shimogawara-dori — 100 m south of Yasaka Shrine’s south gate
places.cuisine: Café of a chirimen-sansho maker, serving its ojako — baby sardines simmered with sansho — with rice cooked in a hagama (official site) · おじゃこ膳 ¥1,100: ojako with fresh rice, soup, dashimaki, pickles, grated-sansho miso, condiments and dessert, 12 a day · sweet kitsune udon in an ojako broth with an ojako rice ball ¥1,210 · summer sansho shaved ice ¥880 · matcha warabi-mochi made by monna of Kiyomizu ¥1,100 · sansho tonic ¥660 · green tea of 一保堂 Uji-shimizu ¥550 (official café page, tax included) · the shop sells ojako, Kurama sansho and seasonal tsukudani (official site)
places.notes: [Café · Yasaka Shrine, Kyoto's chirimen-sansho in a back-room café] Behind the sales counter of Yayoi, a Gion maker of chirimen-sansho (baby sardines simmered with Japanese pepper), a small floor-cushion room serves the house ojako as a set meal with rice from an iron hagama, soup and dashimaki (¥1,100, 12 a day), or in a sweet fox udon. In summer there is sansho shaved ice. Buy a bag of ojako on the way out — a classic Kyoto souvenir. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Founder, per Tabelog’s official introduction; company head 代表取締役 中西 良仁 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the founder was a former cook who began making ojako at the family home in 1982; it spread as a gift among the tea houses of Gion; 有限会社やよい was set up in 1988, the main shop opened on Shimogawara-dori by Yasaka Shrine in 1994, a factory followed, and the café opened in the はなれ behind the shop in 2004; shops in Isetan Kyoto (2002) and Shinjuku, and department-store fairs nationwide; 65 staff. Tabelog’s official introduction names the founder Katsuji Nakanishi, who wondered what could be made with one pot, and says the founder’s son now selects the chirimen-jako from Kyushu and Shikoku, paired with Tanba sansho.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "美味しい物は素材が全て" — good food is all in the ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: Ojako-zen; ojako chirimen-sansho.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular of 30 years bought eight bags of ojako, then ate it in the back with fresh rice and miso soup.
A July 2026 visitor tried the sansho shaved ice, topped with fruit and a sansho-yuzu syrup, with matcha on the side.
A February 2025 customer who first tried the ojako about 20 years ago found that the shop now serves meals as well.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yayoi-ojako.co.jp): ちりめん山椒 京佃煮舗 やよい、初代は元調理人、1982年創業、1988年有限会社やよい設立、1994年八坂神社下河原通りに本店、2001年本社工場、2002年 JR京都伊勢丹、2004年本店奥 (はなれ) にカフェ併設、2007年伊勢丹新宿店、代表取締役 中西良仁、従業員65名、「美味しい物は素材が全て」。カフェ「やよいのはなれ Comodo」: 祇園下河原清井町481 (八坂神社南楼門を南へ100m)、9:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)、火・水・不定休、おじゃこ膳1,100円 (1日12食)、やよいの甘きつねうどん1,210円 (おじゃこのおにぎり付)、山椒氷880円 (夏季)、抹茶わらび餅1,100円 (清水 monna)、山椒トニック660円、一保堂のグリーンティ550円。2026年10月1日にやよいカフェから「やよいComodo」に改称。食べログ: やよい 本店、その他、9:30〜17:00、イートインは土日祝9:30〜14:00、1月1・2日休み、12席 (座布団)、カード・QR 可、公式紹介: 創業者 Katsuji Nakanishi、息子がちりめんじゃこを九州・四国から選び丹波の山椒と合わせる。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 奥のイートイン、炊きたてご飯とおじゃこ、山椒氷。

cultural_comfort.note: English pages on the official site; staff are warm with regulars and tourists alike.

places.name: 寿斗 ふかがわ (Sushi Fukagawa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Each piece comes pre-seasoned with salt or soy sauce, and the rice is cooked in katsuobushi dashi; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: omakase sushi, with rice cooked in katsuobushi dashi (Tabelog official course descriptions).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last entry 14:00); dinner 16:00–21:00 (last entry 19:00); open daily (Tabelog). Omakase courses only on weekends (October 2026); bookings advised. No service charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料なし」). 12 counter seats; private hire for up to 12; non-smoking; children welcome, kids’ menu, strollers OK; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transit IC, iD, QUICPay and QR including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Many overseas guests (December 2025; October 2026). A machiya with a noren near Teramachi-Ebisugawa, 488 m from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; August 2025). Opened 1 March 2013 as 寿司 深川龍丈 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi-Ebisugawa — 488 m from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Omakase sushi on rice cooked in katsuobushi dashi, each piece seasoned so no dipping is needed (Tabelog; reviews) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): lunch omakase ¥15,500; dinner omakase ¥23,000 and ¥28,500 · reviewers also report a lunch omakase at ¥9,500 (January and July 2026) and a 13-piece lunch at ¥8,800 · e.g. Niigata tuna, Akashi sea bream, kama-toro, sayori, Hokkaido uni, monkfish liver, scallops, a California-style yuba roll with uni, steamed uni roll, marinated sea bream, eel, grilled anago (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Teramachi-Ebisugawa, dashi-cooked rice in a machiya] A twelve-seat counter in a quiet machiya north of City Hall, where the rice is cooked in katsuobushi dashi and every piece arrives already seasoned with salt or soy. Omakase runs from about ¥9,500 at lunch to ¥28,500 at night: Niigata tuna, Akashi sea bream, kama-toro, Hokkaido uni and a melting grilled anago to finish. Popular with overseas visitors. Open daily; book ahead.

roles: Owner-chef not named; works with an apprentice (October 2026); operator 株式会社ふかがわ (invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 1 March 2013 under the former name 寿司 深川龍丈; a sushi-only course using rice cooked in katsuobushi dashi and carefully chosen fish. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ふかがわ (head office in 東山区泉涌寺門前町). An October 2026 reviewer was served by the chef and an apprentice.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: traditional sushi made with care in a calm setting, a short step from the city’s bustle.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase nigiri on dashi-cooked rice; grilled anago.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner heard from the chef that grilled anago is the hardest piece to make and the chef’s own favourite.
A December 2025 guest found the owner curt with newcomers but chatty with regulars, and still recommended a visit.
A May 2026 birthday guest, a sushi novice, noticed the hidden knife work on the white and silver-skinned fish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿斗 ふかがわ (旧店名 寿司 深川龍丈)、寿司・日本料理・かに、中京区松本町576-2 ルレーブ寺町夷川、京都市役所前駅から488m、12:00〜15:00 (最終入店14:00)、16:00〜21:00 (最終入店19:00)、サービス料なし、カウンター12席、12名まで貸切可、禁煙、子供可・キッズメニュー、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay・WeChat Pay 含む) 可、2013年3月1日オープン、インボイス T7130001045628 (株式会社ふかがわ)。コース: 昼のおまかせ15,500円、夜のおまかせ23,000円・28,500円、鰹節の出汁で炊いたシャリ。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 昼のおまかせ9,500円、13貫8,800円、一貫ごとに塩や醤油で味付け、新潟の鮪、明石の鯛、カマトロ、北海道の雲丹、穴子、海外からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests; pieces come pre-seasoned.

places.name: だいしめ (Daishime)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seafood marinated in soy, fried horse mackerel, shumai, eel wrapped in bread and somen; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fishmonger’s seafood omakase (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Thursday, Friday and Saturday 16:30–20:00; closed Sunday–Wednesday (Tabelog). Extremely hard to book: reviewers in 2026 report waits of about a year, and many evenings are booked whole by groups (April–August 2026). Omakase of about ¥10,000; bring-your-own alcohol with a ¥500 corkage per bottle, and self-service drinks (April–July 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). By the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market, 365 m from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn (Tabelog; reviews).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Central Wholesale Market — 365 m from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn
places.cuisine: Seafood omakase from a fishmonger at the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market, about ¥10,000, in generous portions (2025–2026 reviews) · e.g. crab to start, ikura tofu, a tasting of five rare cuts of tuna, two kinds of uni with tuna wrapped in nori, firefly squid marinated in soy, namerou, simmered baby octopus, fried horse mackerel, eel shumai, sanma rolls, okra somen, eel wrapped in bread, a rice of shirasu and sakura shrimp (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Seafood · Central Wholesale Market, the hardest-to-book fish izakaya] A fishmonger's izakaya beside Kyoto's wholesale fish market, open only Thursday to Saturday evenings and booked about a year out. For around ¥10,000 the chef piles on the market's best: crab, a tasting of five rare tuna cuts, uni with tuna in nori, firefly squid, eel shumai and sakura-shrimp rice. Bring your own bottle (¥500 corkage) and pour your own drinks. Cash only.

roles: Chef-owner not named; a fishmonger at the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market (reviews)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe it as run by a fishmonger from the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market who buys the fish there each day, with a cheerful, talkative chef and very generous portions (2025–2026 reviews). Tabelog gives no opening date.
chef_bio.specialty: Five-cut rare tuna tasting; uni and tuna wrapped in nori.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 first-timer, in on a friend’s private booking, heard the next open date was a year away.
A July 2026 regular on a sixth visit noted the corkage was still ¥500 a bottle.
A regular who travels about two hours to come says shy guests are soon won over by the chef’s charm (October 2025).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: だいしめ、魚介料理・居酒屋、下京区朱雀宝蔵町44、梅小路京都西駅から365m、木・金・土16:30〜20:00、日〜水定休、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、サービス料の記載なし。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年8月、英語): 京都中央卸売市場の魚屋が営む居酒屋、予約は1年待ち、貸切の会が多い、おまかせ1万円ほど、持ち込みは1本500円、ドリンクはセルフ、蟹、いくら豆腐、鮪の希少部位5種、2種の雲丹と鮪の海苔巻き、ホタルイカの醤油漬け、なめろう、鯵フライ、鰻の焼売、さんま巻き、オクラそうめん、しらすと桜海老のご飯。

cultural_comfort.note: Booked about a year ahead; cash only.

places.name: ラ ファミーユ モリナガ (La famille Morinaga)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses only; homemade bread of Hokkaido and French flour served with every course; dishes include gratins, quenelles and fried items (2023–2026 reviews). The shop asks guests to mention disliked foods and allergies when booking (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set French courses of fish, foie gras, game and beef, with butter and cream; some dishes use dashi (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:00), dinner 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 19:30), Tuesday–Saturday; closed Sunday and Monday, when private hire for 8–12 is possible from ¥8,500 a head (official site; Tabelog). Courses only; tell the shop about disliked foods or allergies when booking (official site). Reservations by phone or online; parties of 5 or more and the private room by phone (official site). No service charge (Tabelog, original サービス料なし). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners per Tabelog; the site says cards accepted). No children under 12 except with private hire — consult the shop (Tabelog; official site). Smart casual recommended (Tabelog). No flash or noisy photography; non-smoking (official site). 12 table seats on the ground floor, a private room for 4–6 upstairs (Tabelog). In a renovated machiya off Shinmachi on Takoyakushi, 10 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takoyakushi west of Shinmachi — 10 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: French, a single daily-changing seasonal course at lunch and dinner (Tabelog shop text) · dinner course ¥12,000 with no service charge: Ohara leek mousse with botan shrimp, kanpachi with green-olive sauce, a terrine of Kurobuta, Ezo deer and duck, butternut soup with autumn truffle, homemade bread (September 2023) · winter: crab quenelle, oyster confit, foie gras with fava beans, game pâté, cod milt with truffle cream and Shogoin turnip broth, Australian beef tenderloin, baked apple sabayon (January 2025) · summer: hamachi and fennel gazpacho, foie gras risotto, pan-seared amadai, roast lamb, coconut blancmange; course with pairing about ¥24,000 (July 2025) · lunch omakase: yellowtail carpaccio, hamo with risotto and kombu sauce, wild sea bream with brown butter and sherry vinegar, Fairford beef sirloin, chestnut Mont Blanc (October 2025) · touches of dashi and sansho (July 2024); bread from dough rested two days (October 2025)
places.notes: [French · Shinmachi, a family restaurant in a machiya] A warm little French restaurant in a renovated old machiya with a white-gravel garden, run by chef Masahiro Morinaga — trained at Chez Ino in Tokyo and in France, later executive chef at Mikuni Nagoya and Grand Maison Graciani in Kobe — as a family restaurant. One daily course of Kyoto-seasonal French with homemade bread; dinner about ¥12,000, no service charge. No children under 12; smart casual.

chef_bio.background: Per an October 2025 review: drawn to cooking by a love of food and a family restaurant background; graduated from a Kyoto culinary school; trained six years at “Chez Ino” in Tokyo under Akira Inoue; in France from 1993 at Guy Savoy (Paris), a Bordeaux restaurant, Troisgros (Roanne) and a Swiss restaurant; back in Japan in 1997; executive chef of “Mikuni Nagoya” at the Nagoya Marriott Associa from 2003, then of “Grand Maison Graciani” in Kobe; opened La famille Morinaga in Kyoto in 2013. Tabelog’s shop text confirms Chez Ino, a three-Michelin-star restaurant in France and Grand Maison Graciani. The name, “the Morinaga family”, was inspired by the Troisgros family (October 2025). A June 2026 diner found “the couple running the place exude warmth”.
chef_bio.philosophy: A warm family restaurant passed down like Troisgros (October 2025); fresh seasonal ingredients in a single daily course (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal French course; homemade bread.

anecdotes.text: A September 2023 diner noted the bread: Hokkaido wheat blended with French flour and Guérande salt.
A June 2026 lunch guest was served corn soup with corn sorbet and truffle-scented popcorn hidden under the bowl.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: La famille Morinaga、ランチ11:30〜14:30 (L.O.13:00)、ディナー18:00〜22:00 (L.O.19:30)、日・月定休 (貸切は8〜12名、1人8,500円から)、料理はコースのみで苦手な食材やアレルギーは事前に、全席禁煙、フラッシュや音の出る撮影はお断り、子どもは相談、カード可。食べログ: フレンチ、中京区蛸薬師通新町西入不動町175-5、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩10分、サービス料なし、1階テーブル12席・2階個室4〜6名、12歳未満は入店不可 (貸切なら可)、スマートカジュアル、店の紹介: 東京の Chez Ino とフランスの三つ星で修業し、神戸の Grand Maison Graciani の総料理長を務めたシェフ、日替わりのコースのみ。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): シェフ Masahiro Morinaga、1993年に渡仏、2013年に開店、夫婦で営む、ディナー12,000円、自家製パン。

cultural_comfort.note: Course only; tell the shop about allergies when booking. No children under 12 (private hire excepted); smart casual; no flash photography.

places.name: ネオパスタヤマウチ (Neo Pasta Yamauchi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade fresh pasta of domestic whole-wheat flour, the noodle shape matched to each sauce (October 2025; January 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Sauces include bonito dashi, mentaiko, white-miso carbonara with bacon and hamburg steak; a Kyoto-pickle pasta and seasonal vegetable pastas exist, but the makeup of those sauces is not described (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–20:00 (Tabelog lists every day; a July 2026 reviewer mentions regular closing days — check). Reservations accepted; weekend tables can be full (July 2026). Cards, e-money and QR codes (Tabelog). 15 seats, counter and tables (Tabelog; November 2025). Non-smoking; English menu (Tabelog). On a side street near Karasuma Oike, between Karasuma Oike and Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stns (Tabelog). Opened 26 November 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: North of Oike near Karasuma — walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Homemade fresh pasta of domestic whole-wheat flour, with Kyoto and Japanese flavours; noodle type and shape changed to suit each sauce (2025–2026 reviews) · mentaiko pasta with the roe served like a scoop of ice cream; set with leaf salad and black-vinegar or Japanese Caesar dressing (October 2025) · mentaiko carbonara made with white miso, with bacon paste, on wide flat noodles (January 2026) · bonito-dashi pasta with cheese and extra shiso (July 2026) · Kyoto pickle pasta; cold pasta with creamy Kamo eggplant (July 2026) · tomato-sauce pasta with hamburg steak, linguine (June–August 2026) · homemade spicy ginger ale (January 2026)
places.notes: [Fresh pasta · near Karasuma Oike, Kyoto-style sauces] A small counter-and-table room making chewy fresh pasta from domestic whole-wheat flour, with the noodle shape matched to the sauce and a Kyoto accent: white-miso mentaiko carbonara, bonito-dashi pasta with shiso, Kyoto pickle pasta, Kamo eggplant in summer. Sets around ¥1,000–2,000 with salad. Portions on the small side. Solo-friendly; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers note the shop has appeared on television (May and July 2026); a July 2026 reviewer writes that it opened “about five years ago”, while Tabelog gives November 2022.
chef_bio.philosophy: Changing the noodle type and shape to suit the sauce (January 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh pasta with Kyoto flavours.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 visitor, walking back from the Jidai Matsuri, found the room nearly full of festival-goers from Europe and America.
A July 2026 diner had kept arriving on closing days before finally getting in.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ネオパスタヤマウチ、パスタ、中京区観音町85-1、烏丸御池駅・京都市役所前駅から徒歩、11:30〜14:00、17:30〜20:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、15席、禁煙、英語メニュー、2022年11月26日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 国産全粒粉の自家製生パスタ、ソースに合わせて麺を変える、白味噌の明太子カルボナーラ、鰹出汁のパスタ、京漬物のパスタ、Kamo なすの冷製パスタ、ハンバーグのトマトソース、量は少なめ、テレビで紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); many overseas diners at festival time (October 2025).

places.name: 満寿形屋 (Masugataya)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon and soba in soy-based dashi; saba sushi is the one non-noodle dish, seasoning not described (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based udon and soba with kamaboko, mackerel sushi, herring soba. Tabelog’s shop note says vegetarian dishes can be prepared on request — ask.
places.hours_raw: 12:00–15:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog); ends when sold out — staff close the line with a last group (October 2026). No reservations except for saba sushi (Tabelog). Queues from before opening; waits of 20 minutes to an hour (2026 reviews); six tables for four, no sharing — even solo diners get a table (August 2026). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog; August 2026). Tabelog lists smoking as allowed (pre-2020 note). Parking at the municipal Demachi lot. In the shopping street on Masugata-dori at Demachi, 5 min from Keihan Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: the Masugata shopping street at Demachi — 5 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Thick saba (mackerel) sushi with udon and soba in an old-style diner (2026 reviews) · kake udon and saba sushi set ¥1,300 — thin, soft udon in a gentle, sweetish dashi with kamaboko and tororo kombu (August 2026) · kitsune udon set ¥1,500; two extra pieces of saba sushi ¥1,300 (August 2026) · matsutake and saba sushi set ¥2,500 in autumn (August 2026) · chilled bukkake udon (July 2026) · nishin (herring) soba; saba sushi ordered separately is thicker than the set’s (September 2026) · seasonal ingredients and daily specials not on the menu; local sake and shochu (Tabelog shop note)
places.notes: [Saba sushi and udon · Demachi shopping street, lunch only] A long-running diner in the shopping street on Masugata-dori at Demachi, open only 12:00–15:00, where the line forms before noon for thick, vinegared saba sushi with a bowl of thin, soft udon in gentle Kyoto dashi (set from ¥1,300). Six tables, no sharing, slow turnover — expect to wait up to an hour; it closes the line when stock runs out. PayPay or cash. A July 2026 reviewer suggests pairing it with Futaba.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a long-established diner with a well-worn gas stove (August 2026) that prides itself on fresh saba sushi (August 2026). No owner is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.specialty: Saba sushi; udon.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, in line at 12:30, was in the last group: staff came out, announced it, and took down the noren.
A July 2026 visitor recommended pairing the meal with Futaba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 満寿形屋、食堂・寿司・うどん、上京区桝形通出町西入ル二神町179、京阪出町柳駅から徒歩約5分、河原町今出川バス停から徒歩約3分、12:00〜15:00、水曜定休、予約不可 (鯖寿司のみ可)、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、24席 (4人掛け6卓)、テイクアウト、店の案内: 季節の食材やメニューにない日替わり、ベジタリアン対応も相談可、地酒と焼酎。口コミ (2026年、英語): 厚い鯖寿司、細くやわらかいうどん、きつねうどんセット1,500円、かけうどんと鯖寿司1,300円、松茸と鯖寿司2,500円、にしんそば、開店前から行列、相席なし、売り切れで暖簾を下ろす。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue outside from before noon; order a set; no sharing tables. PayPay or cash only.

places.name: ミスター モーリスズ イタリアン (MR.MAURICE'S ITALIAN)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wood-fired pizza, homemade pasta, focaccia with cheese fondue and tiramisu; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A Kyoto-vegetable pizza and salads appear, but most dishes use cheese, sausage, salami, beef or seafood; no vegan information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Weekdays and the day before a holiday 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; weekends and holidays 11:30–22:00 with tea 15:00–17:30; last order 21:30; open year-round; two dinner sittings on 24–25 December and 30 December–2 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, phone 11:30–21:30 (Tabelog). A 10% service charge, included in displayed prices (Tabelog original サービス料10％（表示価格に含む）). 170 seats: 96 indoors incl. a 12-seat bar counter, and a rooftop of 74 with an 18-seat bar; partitions but no private rooms; non-smoking indoors (Tabelog). Dogs welcome on the rooftop terrace (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards (Tabelog). 3F of Ace Hotel Kyoto in Shinpuhkan, directly connected to Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinpuhkan, Ace Hotel Kyoto 3F — direct from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: American-style Italian osteria of Ace Hotel Kyoto with a rooftop bar, menu supervised by the chef Marc Vetri: wood-fired pizza, homemade pasta, courses and all-you-can-drink plans (Tabelog) · lunch sets: pasta (e.g. rigatoni with Fiorella sausage ragù) or pizza with Kyoto vegetables and Hokkaido mozzarella, salad, tiramisu (August 2026); a ¥4,050 lunch with focaccia and cheese fondue, cacio e pepe, beef tagliata (September 2026) · fried eggplant salad, cream pasta, salami and Kyoto-vegetable half-and-half pizza, grilled salmon and lobster (September 2026); five-course dinners with drinks (September 2026) · beer-terrace menu on the rooftop (September 2026) · about ¥3,000–8,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Ace Hotel Kyoto, rooftop terrace by Karasuma Oike] The Ace Hotel Kyoto's big, casual Italian-American osteria, with a Marc Vetri menu: wood-fired pizzas with Kyoto vegetables, homemade pastas such as cacio e pepe and rigatoni with sausage ragù, tagliata and tiramisu — plus a breezy rooftop bar and terrace where dogs are welcome. Lunch sets and courses; prices include 10% service. One September 2026 guest found the staff cold; most praise the service. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: Mr. Maurice's Italian at Ace Hotel Kyoto, supervised by the Italian chef Mark Vetri (as Tabelog writes it), offers wood-fired pizza, homemade pasta and courses in a refined room and an open rooftop. An October 2026 reviewer notes the building, over 100 years old, was redesigned by Kengo Kuma for Ace Hotel, and that course prices have risen over 40% since opening.
chef_bio.philosophy: A modern twist on classic flavours (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wood-fired pizza; cacio e pepe.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 guest brought the dog Flora to the rooftop terrace and found many other dogs there too.
A September 2026 visitor came for a Harlow ice-cream pop-up, found the staff "rather cold", and questioned ¥1,500 for a small double scoop.
"Although the course prices have increased by over 40% since the opening, the beautiful space designed and rebranded by Kengo Kuma ... offers a wonderful harmony" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・バー・パスタ、中京区車屋町245-2 Ace Hotel Kyoto 3F、烏丸御池駅直結、平日・祝前日 11:30〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、土日祝 11:30〜22:00 (ティー15:00〜17:30)、L.O.21:30、無休、予約可、サービス料10% (表示価格に含む)、170席 (屋内96、ルーフトップ74)、禁煙、カード可、Mark Vetri 監修のアメリカンスタイルのイタリアン、薪窯のピッツァ、自家製パスタ、コース、飲み放題、ルーフトップで犬連れも可。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): ランチのパスタセット (ソーセージのラグーのリガトーニ)、京野菜と Hokkaido のモッツァレラのピッツァ、ティラミス、4,050円のランチ (フォカッチャのチーズフォンデュ、カチョエペペ、牛のタリアータ)、茄子のサラダ、クリームパスタ、サラミと京野菜のハーフ&ハーフ、鮭とオマールのグリル、5品のコース、ルーフトップのビアテラス、犬連れのテラス、スタッフの対応が冷たかったとの声、開業時からコースが4割以上値上がり、建物は Kengo Kuma がリデザイン (口コミ)。

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel restaurant; prices include 10% service; dogs welcome on the rooftop; cards accepted.

places.name: 亀山学 (Kameyama Manabu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, tempura and rice dishes such as unadon, with soy and dashi; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-sake counter — sashimi, crab, eel and tempura (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog lists daily 6:00–22:00, but reviewers describe evenings of 18:30–22:00 (April 2026) and a weekday lunch for regulars (2023–2024); hours may change (Tabelog). No first-time customers at lunch or dinner (Tabelog remarks) — reviewers came with someone who knows the shop (2024–2026). Evening courses with all-you-can-drink sake, e.g. the 2-hour "Go Go" course ¥5,500 (June 2025) or ¥9,500 cash (April 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). 14 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). No sign, just a nameplate (October 2023). On Takoyakushi west of Muromachi; 5 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog). Opened 22 April 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takoyakushi west of Muromachi — 5 min walk from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: One-man counter of fish and sake: evening courses with self-serve all-you-can-drink from over 40 sakes, many from Yamagata (2023–2026 reviews) · appetisers, thick-cut sashimi, a whole crab, crisp tempura (2024–2026 reviews) · lunch for regulars, once famous for an oversized unadon and a Thursday "Tonio rice" (2023–2024) · eel tempura served at the street stall on a festival evening (July 2026) · about ¥5,500–9,500 a head in the evening (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sake counter · Takoyakushi Muromachi, regulars and friends of regulars] An unmarked fourteen-seat counter near Shijo Karasuma where owner Mr. Kameyama cooks and serves alone: thick sashimi, a whole crab, crisp tempura, with self-pour all-you-can-drink from over forty sakes, about ¥5,500–9,500 in cash. First-time guests are not accepted — you need to come with someone who knows the shop. A Tigers-fan, regulars' kind of place.

roles: Owner, called Mr. Kameyama or Mr. Manabu by reviewers, who runs the shop alone
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 22 April 2016; first-time customers are not accepted at lunch or dinner. A January 2024 reviewer explains that lunch turns away first-timers because the owner runs everything alone; reviewers address the owner as "Mr. Manabu" (March 2024) and "Mr. Kameyama" (June 2025), and describe a sake list of over 40 brands, many from Yamagata (April 2026), and a Tigers-supporting crowd (August 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: All-you-can-drink sake courses; thick sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "Finally! Finally! Finally! I was able to visit in the evening!! Thank you, my husband." — March 2024, on a shop that turns away first-timers.
A June 2025 guest watched the owner, Mr. Kameyama, line up an impressive row of sake bottles from the fridge at the start of the "Go Go" course.
"I personally prefer to savor my drinks with care, paying attention to the glassware and sake vessels." — September 2023, on the self-pour sake that warms as it waits.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理・寿司、中京区蛸薬師室町西入る姥柳町192、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩5分、営業時間の表記は毎日 6:00〜22:00、現金のみ、14席 (カウンター)、禁煙、2016年4月22日オープン、昼も夜も一見客は不可。口コミ (2023年9月〜2026年7月、英語): 看板はなく表札だけ、店主一人で営む、ランチは常連向け (特大の鰻丼、木曜の「Tonio Rice」)、夜は18:30〜22:00、日本酒40種以上 (山形の酒が多い) の飲み放題のコース、「Go Go」コース5,500円 (2025年6月)、現金9,500円 (2026年4月)、厚切りのお造り、蟹一杯、さくさくの天ぷら、祭りの夜の屋台で鰻の天ぷら、タイガースのファン。

cultural_comfort.note: No first-time guests — come with someone who knows the shop; cash only.

places.name: チドリアシ (Chidoriashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto oden in a sweet-savoury dashi with fish cakes, plus kara-age, eel spring rolls and potato salad; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi with duck and fish cakes, sashimi and meat dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–24:00; closed Wednesday and some other days each month (Tabelog). Reservations accepted — courses by the day before; seat-only bookings on the day if free (Tabelog). 18 seats: 8 at the counter and 10 on tatami in a back room; private hire up to 20; non-smoking, smoking outside; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On Oike-dori just south of Nijo Castle, west of Horikawa; 3 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn exit 3 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Oike-dori south of Nijo Castle — 3 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Oden and sake izakaya under a red lantern (2025–2026 reviews) · Kyoto-style oden in a clear, slightly sweet broth — daikon, konnyaku, hirousu, duck with Kujo negi, tomato oden — with yuzu pepper (2025–2026 reviews) · a much-praised potato salad; seasonal sashimi, grilled dishes, Manganji peppers, eel spring rolls, red snapper, chilled kara-age as a summer starter (2025–2026 reviews) · a broad sake list served hot, warm or cool, with a choice of small cups — e.g. Wakaebisu Plus 006 (2026 reviews) · about ¥4,000–5,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Oden · south of Nijo Castle, red lantern and warm sake] A small red-lantern izakaya on Oike-dori in front of Nijo Castle: Kyoto oden in a clear, gently sweet broth (daikon, hirousu, duck with Kujo negi, even tomato), a famous potato salad, seasonal sashimi and eel spring rolls, with a broad sake list warmed to order and poured into a cup of your choice. Friendly owner and staff who chat and pour; open to midnight. About ¥4,000–5,000. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a popular izakaya south of Nijo Castle with warm hospitality from the owner and staff, friendly conversation at the counter, staff who pour for solo guests, and a pot of kanzake warming at the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto oden; potato salad; warmed sake.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 couple, whose first-choice oden shop was closed, found the staff so friendly; on praising the food, the couple heard it was the second such compliment that day.
"I was enjoying a bottle of beer by myself, and the staff noticed and kindly poured it for me" — February 2026.
"When you order Japanese sake, you can choose from a variety of small cups, which is a delightful surprise!" — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・肉料理・おでん、中京区堀川御池西入ル大文字町233-6、二条城前駅3番出口から徒歩3分、18:00〜24:00、水曜と月に数日の不定休、予約可 (コースは前日まで、席のみは当日空きがあれば)、18席 (カウンター8、座敷10)、貸切20名まで、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、Wi-Fi、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 二条城の南の御池通、赤提灯と「Chi」の字ののれん、京風のおでん (大根、こんにゃく、ひろうす、鴨と九条ねぎ、トマト)、柚子胡椒、評判のポテトサラダ、お造り、焼き物、万願寺とうがらし、鰻の春巻き、真鯛、冷やし唐揚げ、燗酒、選べるお猪口、日本酒が豊富 (Wakaebisu Plus 006 など)、店主とスタッフの温かいもてなし。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter or tatami; staff recommend dishes; book courses by the day before; cards, e-money and QR.

places.name: オールデイダイニング 弥栄 (All Day Dining Yasaka, Imperial Hotel Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A hotel menu of Western classics — hamburg steak, Chaliapin steak, curry, onion gratin soup, pies and bread — plus Japanese breakfast and afternoon tea; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Fruit desserts appear, but the menu centres on beef, cheese, eggs, dairy and dashi-based breakfast; no vegan information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily: breakfast 6:30–10:30 (last order 10:00; Japanese breakfast from 7:00); lunch 11:30–14:30; tea 14:30–17:30; dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Open to non-guests, though the hotel lobby itself is for staying guests (July 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Private rooms (Tabelog). 2F of the main building of the Imperial Hotel Kyoto, next to the Gion Kobu Kaburenjo off Hanamikoji (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 5 March 2026 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Imperial Hotel Kyoto by the Gion Kobu Kaburenjo, Hanamikoji
places.cuisine: All-day dining of the Imperial Hotel Kyoto, which carries on the legacy of the old Yasaka Kaikan, with dishes inspired by Gion and maiko (2026 reviews) · breakfast featuring dishes from the Gion restaurant Kawakami — a three-tier platter, saikyo-miso-grilled karasugarei, dashimaki, rice and miso soup with refills (July 2026) · lunch course of four appetisers, cold soup, hamburg steak and mango shortcake (July 2026) · Chaliapin steak and Yasaka curry, soup of the day (August 2026); classic pie (July 2026); seasonal fruit skillet with ice cream, Yasaka parfait (August–September 2026); assorted cheese and ham, onion gratin soup, steak, bread refills (October 2026) · afternoon tea with 90-minute free-flow tea, incl. beef stew (October 2026); Ronnefeldt teas (September 2026) · about ¥3,000–10,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Hotel all-day dining · Gion by the Kaburenjo, the new Imperial Hotel] The all-day restaurant of the Imperial Hotel Kyoto, opened in March 2026 in the restored Yasaka Kaikan beside the Gion Kobu Kaburenjo: a breakfast built with dishes from the Gion restaurant Kawakami, lunch courses with hamburg steak, the Imperial's Chaliapin steak and a Yasaka curry, parfaits and fruit skillets at tea, and afternoon tea. Polished, warm service; one September 2026 tea party waited through a muddle over sold-out desserts before the kitchen head stepped in. Open to non-guests. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 5 March 2026 on the second floor of the main building of the Imperial Hotel Kyoto. Reviewers in 2026 describe a hotel that inherits the former Yasaka Kaikan, a breakfast featuring dishes from the Gion restaurant Kawakami (July 2026), Gion- and maiko-inspired dishes (July 2026), and attentive service, with the head of the kitchen and the manager stepping in when an order went wrong (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Chaliapin steak; Yasaka curry; Kawakami breakfast.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 family, hoping for coffee in the lobby, learned it was for hotel guests only and were seated instead at Yasaka on the second floor.
A July 2026 hotel guest had three bowls of rice at breakfast and found the second bowl of miso soup came with different ingredients from the first.

A September 2026 party, told twice that ordered desserts had run out, grew anxious before a Minami-za show — until the head of the kitchen came out, both were served, and the manager added a Ronnefeldt herbal tea.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食、東山区祇園町南側570-289 帝国ホテル 京都 本棟2F、朝食6:30〜10:30 (L.O.10:00、和朝食は7:00から)、ランチ11:30〜14:30、ティータイム14:30〜17:30、ディナー17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、個室あり、2026年3月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 歌舞練場の隣、旧弥栄会館を受け継ぐホテル、ロビーは宿泊客のみ、祇園の料理店「Kawakami」の料理の朝食 (三段の盛り合わせ、からすがれいの西京焼き、だし巻き、ご飯と味噌汁のおかわり)、前菜4種・冷製スープ・ハンバーグ・マンゴーのショートケーキのランチ、シャリアピンステーキ、弥栄カレー、クラシックパイ、季節のフルーツのスキレット、弥栄パフェ、チーズとハムの盛り合わせ、オニオングラタンスープ、ステーキ、アフタヌーンティー (90分の紅茶飲み放題、ビーフシチュー)、ロンネフェルトのハーブティー、デザートの品切れで待たされたが厨房の責任者が対応 (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel restaurant, open to non-guests (the lobby is guests-only); book for tea; cards, e-money and QR.

places.name: トラットリア ラ・ヴォーチェ (Trattoria La Voce)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pasta, lasagna, gnocchi, cannelloni and pizza are the core of the menu (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the lunches seen are cheese-heavy pasta and lasagna and the courses lean on meat and fish (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: Tue–Sun lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Monday, plus about two irregular Sundays or Tuesdays a month; closed 31 December–1 January and for summer and winter breaks; open days on Instagram. Weekday lunch is the daily special only; weekends and holidays have the regular pasta lunch, and a dinner course at lunch for 2+ booked by the day before (official site; Tabelog). Dinner seat charge ¥500 a person, covering the starter (Tabelog, Japanese original 「席料(つきだしなど)…￥500」). Pairs usually sit at the counter; some plans are limited to two hours (Tabelog). 21 seats — 9 counter, 12 at tables that become private rooms for 4 and 5–8; non-smoking, ashtray outside; wheelchair accessible; English menu and English-speaking staff; small children in private rooms only (Tabelog). Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, Diners); the site also lists PayPay and Rakuten Pay, Tabelog says no QR. Founded in Kuzuha, Osaka on 26 May 2004; moved here 18 March 2009 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Karasuma — 2 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn; 4 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Italian trattoria that puts the ingredient first: produce shipped from Italy, Hokkaido akaushi beef, vegetables from contract farms in Kyoto; a walk-in wine cellar and a shop of Italian groceries and take-out (official site) · lunch: nine choices ¥1,800–3,500 (July 2026); weekend pasta lunch ¥2,800 (September 2026); panna cotta +¥600 (May 2026) · seen: an antipasto platter with quiche, couscous and pickles, peach or corn soup, sweet-potato and gorgonzola lasagna, gnocchi, Roman cannelloni of duck and pork, prawn bisque pasta, scallop and canola pesto, venison, tiramisu (2026 reviews) · omakase dinner with wine ¥10,000–14,999 (September 2026) · lasagna, pizza and rice croquettes by delivery (official site)
places.notes: [Italian · Shijo-Karasuma trattoria, since 2009] A 21-seat trattoria two minutes from Karasuma Station — counter, two private rooms and a wine cellar you can walk into. Weekend lunches have antipasto platters and pastas like a Roman duck-and-pork cannelloni; dinner runs to venison and omakase. Some find the portions small (March 2026) or the flavours light (April 2026). ¥500 seat charge at dinner. English menu. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner (signs the shop notices "オーナー 山本", official site); chef not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Trattoria La Voce opened in Kuzuha, Osaka on 26 May 2004 and moved to Shijo-Karasuma on 18 March 2009, marking 20 years in 2024 with a fair signed by the owner, 山本. The name is Italian for "voice" or "opinion": a restaurant full of happy voices that listens to its guests. Since opening it has held to the Italian basic of enjoying the ingredient’s own taste; in 2022 it added a shop for Italian wine and food, alongside department-store events and catalogue sales.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「素材が持つ本来の味を楽しむ」 — enjoy the taste the ingredient already has.
chef_bio.specialty: Lasagna; antipasto platter; pasta lunch.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner, choosing among nine lunches, passed up lasagna and venison ragù: "I might not have another chance to try cannelloni" — duck and pork rolled in sheet pasta.
"While the portions might be a bit small for men, everything was tasty." — March 2026.
An October 2026 diner was won over by the venison — "the subsequent sirloin cap completely faded in comparison."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (lavoce-kyoto.com): Trattoria La Voce (トラットリア ラ・ヴォーチェ)、四条烏丸のイタリアン、2004年5月26日に大阪府樟葉で開業、2009年3月18日に現在地へ移転、創業20周年 (オーナー 山本)、店名はイタリア語で声・意見、「素材が持つ本来の味を楽しむ」、イタリア直送の食材、北海道の“あか牛”、京都の契約農家の野菜、自由に見られるワインセラー、2022年から物販スペース、デリバリーはラザニア・ピッツァ・ライスコロッケ、火〜日 昼12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)・夜17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、月曜休み (不定期で日曜か火曜、月2回程度)、平日はピッツァランチのみ、土日祝はパスタランチ、21席 (テーブル12、カウンター9)、カード可、PayPay・楽天ペイ可。食べログ: イタリアン・ビストロ、中京区観音堂町456 シティキャスル四条 1F、ディナーのみ席料 (つきだしなど) 1人500円、2名は原則カウンター、プランにより2時間制、個室2つ、英語メニュー・英語対応、ベジタリアン対応、小さな子供は個室のみ、2009年3月18日オープン。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): ランチは9種1,800〜3,500円、週末のパスタランチ2,800円、さつまいもとゴルゴンゾーラのラザニア、ニョッキ、鴨と豚のカネロニ、海老のビスク、鹿肉、ティラミス、パンナコッタ+600円、男性には量が少なめ、味は軽め、おまかせコース。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog).
