places.name: 焼貝とお酒 貝貝貝〜ごひいき〜 (Kai Kai Kai)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried oysters, an oyster and shirako gratin and crab fried rice are on the menu; grilled shellfish may be seasoned with soy (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an oyster and shellfish bar (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri and the days before and after holidays 16:00–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 13:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30); 11–15 August 12:00–22:00. 10 counter seats only, standing up to 20; book ahead at weekends (October 2025; February 2026). Inside the yakitori shop Kyoto Suehiro-gari in Shinpukan, sharing its entrance — easy to miss (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Non-smoking; English and Simplified Chinese menus with photos; small children by phone consultation (Tabelog). Charge: ¥550 a person (Tabelog, Japanese original 「550円」). Cards, transit IC and most e-money and QR. Opened 3 September 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinpukan, Karasuma Oike — 1 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: A ten-seat counter for grilled and raw shellfish and sake (Tabelog) · oysters raw or grilled ¥330 each, ¥220 with a coupon (June 2026); raw ¥300–600 (August 2026); Miyajima oysters (February 2026) · signature steamed shellfish for two — scallops, shrimp, clams, mussels — then risotto +¥770 (January–June 2026) · grilled scallops and turban shells, dashimaki with ikura, fried oysters, foie gras on daikon, shirako and oyster gratin, stingray sashimi, crab fried rice, potato fries with cod roe and anchovy butter (2026 reviews) · a solo drinking course, a chef’s course and all-you-can-eat (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · sake, shochu, wine, a fruity local highball (February 2026)
places.notes: [Oyster bar · Shinpukan, ten seats behind a yakitori shop] A ten-seat counter for oysters and grilled shellfish hidden at the back of a yakitori shop in Shinpukan, a minute from Karasuma Oike. Oysters from ¥330 (¥220 with a coupon), a steamed shellfish pot finished as risotto, and a solo drinking course. One February 2026 regular found new staff less practised and the oysters overcooked. ¥550 charge a person. English menu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 3 September 2025 (Tabelog), inside Kyoto Suehiro-gari, a yakitori shop in the Shinpukan complex, with a grill right in front of the counter and a high ceiling (2026 reviews). A June 2026 diner noted a male chef and young female staff, and regulars and newcomers treated alike.
chef_bio.specialty: Signature steamed shellfish with a risotto finish; oysters.

anecdotes.text: February 2026: "Has there been a change in staff?" — the female staff from the year before were gone, and "some of the new staff seemed a bit inexperienced… which may have led to the oysters being overcooked."
"The male chef and the beautiful female staff (students, perhaps?) showed great care" — June 2026.
A January 2026 solo diner got "kind service without any hint of disdain."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼貝とお酒 貝貝貝〜ごひいき〜、居酒屋・海鮮・オイスターバー、中京区場之町586-2 新風館 1F、京都スエヒロガリの中、烏丸御池駅から徒歩1分、平日 16:00〜22:00、土日祝 13:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 21:00、ドリンク L.O. 21:30)、8月11〜15日は12:00〜22:00、カウンター10席のみ (立ち20名)、禁煙、英語・簡体中国語のメニュー、子連れは電話で相談、チャージ550円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2025年9月3日オープン。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年11月、英語): 焼鳥店の奥、入口がわかりにくい、生牡蠣・焼牡蠣は1個330円 (クーポンで220円)、Miyajima の牡蠣、名物の貝の蒸し物とリゾット+770円、帆立やサザエの焼き物、いくらのだし巻き、牡蠣フライ、大根とフォアグラ、白子と牡蠣のグラタン、エイの刺身、蟹炒飯、ひとり飲みコース、食べ放題、スタッフが変わり牡蠣が焼きすぎという声、親切な接客。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese menus with photos; counter only; the entrance is through a yakitori shop.

places.name: MIZO
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every lunch set is built around pasta and bread; tarts and cheesecake for dessert (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: vegetables from pesticide-free and low-pesticide farms (official site), but the dishes reviewed all carry fish, meat, cheese or egg; dietary requests were met for a low-salt diner (October 2026).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Thursday, plus irregular days (in November 2026 also Wednesday the 11th and 25th); may close early when ingredients run out. Lunch seats about two hours. No café-only use; coffee to take away. Dinner has no service charge but one drink per person (official site; Tabelog 「ディナータイムはサービス料は頂きませんがワンドリンクはオーダー頂きます」). Cancellation: lunch ¥2,500 a person after 10:00 on the day; dinner ¥5,500 a person on the day; omakase full price (official site). 12 table seats, no private room; non-smoking; children welcome but call first — narrow aisles, small restroom with no changing space; cards and PayPay. Opened 21 November 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo, on Senbon-dori — 2–3 min walk north of JR/subway Nijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gentle Italian cooking with natural wine and specialty coffee (official site) · lunch A ¥1,800 (salad, pasta; +¥300 coffee, +¥400 dolce), B ¥2,700 (antipasto, pasta, dolce, coffee), C ¥3,900 (adds a main) (official site) · dinner prix-fixe from ¥3,850 (antipasto platter, pasta or main, dolce, coffee); omakase from ¥6,600, book by the day before; à la carte antipasti from ¥1,100, pasta ¥1,650, mains ¥2,750, dolci ¥1,100 (official site) · all natural wine, bottles from ¥5,500, glasses from ¥990; light-roast espresso drinks (official site) · seen: Bolognese with an onsen egg, shirasu and Kujo leek aglio e olio, Yamagata pork ragù, sawara carpaccio, scallops in sea-urchin cream, a "broken" pear tart (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Nijo, natural wine and a Bolognese with onsen egg] A twelve-seat Italian bistro on Senbon-dori, two minutes from Nijo Station: lunch sets from ¥1,800, a ¥3,850 dinner prix-fixe or omakase from ¥6,600, all with natural wine and light-roast coffee. The Bolognese with an onsen egg is the one people mention. Quibbles: small portions, subtle sauces, and tight seats against the wall (2026). One drink a person at dinner; strict cancellation fees. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 21 November 2019 (Tabelog). The official site describes gentle Italian food, natural wines from organic grapes, and specialty coffee from a Synesso espresso machine; pesticide-free open-field vegetables, fish sent direct from the source including kinds rare in Kyoto, and carefully raised meat; a bright front room on Senbon-dori and a calmer room behind. It also sells P Mustard from Pullst Factory and links to Pullst Cafe and べんてん洞.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「優しいイタリア料理と自然派ワインとスペシャルティコーヒーのお店」 — gentle Italian food, natural wine and specialty coffee.
chef_bio.specialty: Bolognese with onsen egg; prix-fixe dinner.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "the gentlest Bolognese I’ve ever had" — though "I would have been even happier if decaf coffee was available."
An October 2026 diner asked for a low-salt option, "and they kindly accommodated my request."
"For some reason, I felt there was a bias towards eggplant dishes on the menu. Overall, the portion sizes were a bit on the smaller side." — September 2026.
A June 2026 lunch guest stayed over an hour and "felt a bit awkward as they kept refilling our water."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (eatarymizo.com): MIZO、優しいイタリア料理と自然派ワインとスペシャルティコーヒーのお店、JR・地下鉄二条駅から北へ徒歩約2分、千本通りに面する、無農薬露地栽培や低農薬の野菜、産地直送の魚、自然派ワインのみ (ボトル5,500円〜、グラス990円〜)、シネッソのエスプレッソマシンで浅煎り、店内でカフェのみは不可、テイクアウト可、テーブル12席、ランチA 1,800円・B 2,700円・C 3,900円、ディナーのプリフィックス3,850円〜、お任せ6,600円〜 (前日までに予約)、アラカルト 前菜1,100円〜・パスタ1,650円〜・メイン2,750円〜・ドルチェ1,100円〜、ディナーはサービス料なしでワンドリンク制、ランチ11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)、ディナー17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、木曜休み・不定休、11月は11日と25日の水曜も休み、キャンセル料 (ランチ当日10時以降2,500円、ディナー当日5,500円、お任せは全額)、カード・PayPay可、プルストファクトリーPマスタード販売、プルストカフェとべんてん洞へのリンク。食べログ: イタリアン・カフェ・ワインバー、中京区西ノ京小堀町1-7、12席、禁煙、子供可 (通路狭く、おむつ替えスペースなし)、2019年11月21日オープン。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 温玉のボロネーゼ、しらすと九条ねぎのアーリオ・オーリオ、Yamagata の豚のラグー、鰆のカルパッチョ、帆立と雲丹のクリーム、洋梨のタルト、減塩に対応、デカフェなし、量は少なめ、茄子が多い、ソースは控えめ、壁側の席が狭い、水を何度も注がれて気まずい。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead — often full, and walk-ins were turned away in October 2026; strict cancellation fees.

places.name: 味野里香 (Minoriko)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: courses include wild-vegetable tempura and dishes in soy-based dashi (2018–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dashi-based course of fish, fugu, hamo, karasumi and uni (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday and irregularly. 22 seats — a counter downstairs and tables upstairs (Tabelog; July 2026); non-smoking; children welcome; cards, no e-money or QR. Tabelog lists no service charge. Courses: ¥10,000 (2018); ¥8,800 (2023; given on request in March 2025, when online booking started at ¥11,000); ¥13,200 (July 2025). Sake is poured to match each dish at no premium — a July 2025 diner paid ¥18,480 for the ¥13,200 course, a beer and six cups (reviews). Serai (published October 2017): counter 6, tables 8; small cups of sake from ¥400, 100 ml from ¥600; reservations needed.
places.neighborhood: Oshikoji, near Karasuma Oike — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: A sake-led Kyoto course between kaiseki and izakaya, the chef pairing a cup to every dish from over 100 sakes (reviews; Serai 2017) · fresh yuba strained into a mousse; homemade karasumi wrapped in mochi; fugu-skin jelly; fugu shirako tofu; wild-vegetable tempura; hassun; hamo three ways; Akashi sea bream and octopus; Uji sweetfish; Kamo eggplant dengaku; uni tekka-don or marinated tuna rice to finish (2018–2025 reviews) · sakes poured: Aramasa, Jikon, Juyondai, Mimuro Sugi, Hanamura, Isojiman, Kuheiji, Toyo Bijin (reviews)
places.notes: [Kaiseki & sake · Oshikoji, a chef who pours to every dish] A Kyoto course-and-sake house near Karasuma Oike, at Shinmachi-Oike for 32 years before moving to Oshikoji: the chef, cooking for over fifty years, pairs a cup from 100-plus sakes — Aramasa, Jikon, Juyondai — to each dish, and charges for sake at everyday prices. Fresh yuba mousse and karasumi on mochi are the signatures. Courses ¥8,800–13,200. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Serai (published October 2017): after 32 years at Shinmachi-Oike, it moved to Oshikoji-dori and added a refrigerator for over 100 sakes, keeping its style of recommending a sake for each dish. A July 2025 reviewer names the owner as Mr. Minoru Kaneko, with 51 years of cooking, and says he stores and ages a large stock of sake in a warehouse in Shiga; a February 2025 regular puts it at over 50 years and says the head chef cooks and pairs the sake personally. A 2024 diner wondered whether a couple runs it; another mentioned a kind hostess.
chef_bio.philosophy: Reviewers (2018–2025): sake is charged without a premium, so rare bottles cost about the same as ordinary ones.
chef_bio.specialty: Sake pairing; fresh yuba; homemade karasumi.

anecdotes.text: A February 2018 first-timer had a beer and seven cups including junmai daiginjo and was charged about ¥14,000 all in — "I was so shocked that I asked the chef to repeat it (laughs)."

February 2025: the first dish came in a vessel by a craftsman newly named a Living National Treasure — "the way the chef casually explained it after I finished eating shows his depth of knowledge from over 50 years in the field."
On a quiet Wednesday in March 2025 the chef sent out a grilled sea-bream head on the house; the couple also found the salted cherry leaves "saltier than expected."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 味野里香 (Minori Ka)、日本料理・日本酒バー、中京区押小路通衣棚西入上妙覚寺町208-6、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、月〜土 18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、日曜休み・不定休、22席、禁煙、子供可、カード可。サライ (2017年10月公開): 味野里香 (みのりこ)、新町御池で32年営んだのち押小路通へ移転、100種類以上の日本酒の専用冷蔵庫、料理に合う日本酒を薦める、日本酒 小400円〜・中 (100ml) 600円〜、鱧の造り・焼き霜・落とし、鰻の白焼きと松茸、鯛茶漬け、要予約、カウンター6席・テーブル8席。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): 店主 Minoru Kaneko 氏、料理歴51年、懐石と居酒屋の間の料理、料理ごとに日本酒を合わせる、日本酒は割高にしない、滋賀の倉庫で日本酒を熟成、生湯葉、自家製からすみの餅巻き、ふぐ皮の煮こごり、ふぐ白子豆腐、山菜の天ぷら、鱧、Akashi の鯛と蛸、Uji の鮎、雲丹の鉄火丼、コース8,800円・10,000円・13,200円、Jikon・Aramasa・Juyondai・Mimuro Sugi・Hanamura・Isojiman・Kuheiji、1階カウンター・2階テーブル、約10年前に移転、女将の心遣い。

cultural_comfort.note: Sake is chosen in conversation with the chef; there is no sake list.

An October 2024 diner found the tripe and the Jinhua-ham mushrooms mild, but the five-item appetizer plate and crisp spring rolls excellent.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly Wagyu, duck, octopus and oyster dishes (2024–25 reviews); a king oyster mushroom cappuccino and a seasonal vegetable soup appear, but no vegan information.

places.cuisine: A Japanese-wine bar with fusion dishes under the concept "DISCOVER NEW JAPAN" — Kyoto vegetables and Wagyu with Italian and global influences, about 120 Japanese wines with free tastings (Tabelog, shop text; May 2025) · Wagyu cigarette, minced Wagyu rolled in thin pastry (2024–25 reviews) · aosa seaweed risotto, Kyoto duck (May 2024) · spicy octopus ¥2,400, Seoul-style spicy stew ¥3,600 (May 2024) · king oyster mushroom cappuccino, oysters (January 2025) · MATT KYOTO lunch set: grilled romaine Caesar, Wagyu cigarette, Kyoto vegetable soup, Kyoto-style rigatoni, Earl Grey apple pie (April 2025) · charcoal tiramisu and apple pie in a café set; a dessert course (July 2024, May 2025)
places.notes: [Japanese wine bar · Karasuma Gojo, fusion plates in an all-white basement] An all-white basement with a U-shaped counter and Showa pop on the speakers, pouring about 120 Japanese wines — taste before you choose — with fusion plates such as the Wagyu cigarette, aosa risotto and Kyoto-style rigatoni. Lunch on weekends and holidays. Reviewers praise the wine guidance but call it pricey, with a 15% service charge. Open to midnight.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (mattjapan.com): MATT JAPAN Inc., founded in Kyoto in 2023, runs Restaurant 1.0 (reworked everyday street food), Restaurant 2.0 (modern Japanese dining, this shop; the site says it was established in Kyoto in April 2023, while Tabelog gives an opening day of 20 April 2024), Restaurant 3.0 (a "gastronomic show" opening in Minato, Tokyo, in August 2026) and W/PIZZA°, and also lists SAMURAI SAUVIGNON, a wine served here (May 2024).
chef_bio.philosophy: "DISCOVER NEW JAPAN": Japanese ingredients such as Kyoto vegetables and Wagyu, combined with world cuisines (Tabelog, shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu cigarette; Japanese wine.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner noted the clash of a stark white room with retro Showa pop, and the chance to sample wines before choosing.
A December 2024 diner found it expensive and was not left full, and was told the knowledgeable wine server held no sommelier qualification.
A May 2025 group booked the night before for a birthday and still got a birthday plate.

places.notes: [Cocktail-paired Italian · Kiyomizu-Gojo, six courses in a machiya] An unsigned machiya with a dim counter, where six seasonal Italian-French dishes each come with a low-alcohol "savory cocktail" — ¥14,800, ¥13,600 with alcohol-free pairings, or ¥9,800 for food alone. Churros with pâté de campagne stood out for one May 2026 diner. Reservation only, two sittings; 10% service charge; no young children. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (ondorio.jp): the name, read オンドリオ, is coined from the story of a boy in one theory of the word “cocktail” — the Mexican rooster’s tail. The food is “genreless”, based on Italian and French cooking, and the drinks are savory cocktails designed to mirror or contrast each dish’s aroma, in what the site calls “Aroma Pairing”. Opened 7 December 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Free thinking and mixing: cooking and making cocktails with the spirit of that boy (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Six-course aroma pairing with cocktails.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner was steered toward soft-drink pairings at first, since the cocktails run about 4–5%, then switched to the alcoholic ones from the second glass.
A May 2026 diner found the churros with pâté de campagne and strawberries a memorable cross of savory and sweet.
A June 2026 diner found the portions too generous and wished for a smaller, cheaper course.

places.notes: [Wagashi · Sakaimachi Sanjo, the clam-shell sweet] An old wagashi house selling in the traditional seated style, from samples rather than a showcase. Known for hamazuto — a real clam shell of yellow jelly over miso-flavoured beans, a tea-ceremony sweet (July 2026) — and, October to about April, a very thin warabi mochi (¥480). Seasonal fresh sweets change through the year. Take-away only; closed Tuesday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 御菓子司 亀屋則克, maker of seasonal fresh sweets and dry sweets, whose signature is 浜土産 (はまづと). Reviews give the history differently: moved from Fukui to Kyoto in 1916 (May 2026), founded in 1916 (October 2026), founded in 1926 (July 2026); the founding year is not confirmed here.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamazuto; warabi mochi; seasonal fresh wagashi.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 buyer was told the sweets keep 4–5 days refrigerated and the hamazuto over a week, and heard the shop is favoured by a Kyoto tea teacher.
A June 2026 visitor came for two rainy-season sweets — one of rain and rainbows, one of three green layers — and got both.
An October 2026 buyer carried a box of warabi mochi flat all the way home to Saitama.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter, cream, milk and eggs in the cakes and baked goods (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). The official site says to check its calendar for hours and closures. No bookings; 6 eat-in seats; one drink per person when eating in (April 2026 review). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking. 3–4 min from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 5 (official site; Tabelog). A second counter sells in the JR Kyoto Isetan B1F sweets floor (official site).
places.neighborhood: South of Karasuma Oike — 4 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Patisserie of Japanese ingredients in Western sweets — matcha, wasanbon sugar, kudzu starch (official site): strawberry shortcake, sakura mousse ¥660 with tea ¥484 (April 2026), banana-chestnut pie, peach parfait, Rakkan matcha pudding ¥594 to take away (July 2026), monaka-shell financiers ¥200 each or six for ¥1,200 (October 2026), butter sand with white-bean-paste cookies, cookies and pound cake (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Patisserie & tea · near Karasuma Oike] A bright glass-fronted cake shop with six seats, joining Japanese ingredients and French technique: matcha pudding with wasanbon, butter sand made with white bean paste, financiers in a monaka shell (¥200), and seasonal cakes with tea. Cash only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 August 2015 (Tabelog). The official site lists the main shop and a counter in JR Kyoto Isetan; its sweets were chosen as Kyoto City hometown-tax gifts.
chef_bio.philosophy: 和魂洋才 (Japanese spirit, Western skill): carefully chosen Japanese ingredients such as matcha, wasanbon and kudzu starch, raised by Western pastry technique (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha pudding; monaka financier; butter sand.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor having sakura mousse was given a free bite of matcha terrine.
An August 2026 customer noticed quite a few international customers in the small eat-in space.
Having bought cookies at the Kyoto Station counter, a visitor found the shop in April 2026 and praised the kind staff.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: パティスリー洛甘舎 (らっかんしゃ)、和魂洋才、抹茶・和三盆・吉野本葛などの和素材を洋菓子の技で、本店は中京区三文字町227-1 藤六ビル1F (東洞院六角西北角)、烏丸御池駅5番出口から徒歩3分、営業日はカレンダーで確認、ジェイアール京都伊勢丹 B1F 洋菓子売場にも店、京都市ふるさと納税の返礼品。食べログ (店舗会員): ケーキ・カフェ・スイーツ、11:00〜18:00、水曜休み、予約不可、6席、カード・電子マネー不可、2015年8月19日オープン。口コミ (2026年4〜10月、英語): いちごのショートケーキ、桜のムース660円、紅茶484円、ワンドリンク制、バナナと栗のパイ、桃のパフェ、抹茶プリン594円 (持ち帰り)、最中フィナンシェ1個200円・6個1,200円、白餡入りのバターサンド、海外の客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the showcase; cash only.

places.name: フレンチダイニング トップ オブ キョウト (French Dining Top of Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. French courses with bread and sauces; the hotel asks guests with food allergies to tell staff, and a June 2026 diner said dietary preferences were handled perfectly (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Courses are fish and meat; dietary requests were accommodated for a June 2026 diner (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:30–10:00 (last order 9:30), lunch 12:00–15:30 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:00–21:30 (last order 20:00); weekend and holiday lunch in two sittings, 11:30–13:00 and 13:30–15:00; irregular closures, see the official calendar (official site; Tabelog). Breakfast ¥4,301, lunch from ¥7,000, dinner from ¥14,000, tax and service included (official site). Service charge: 15% — Tabelog's Japanese original says 「サービス料15%」. Dress code at dinner: no T-shirts, shorts or sandals. 88 seats, all by the window on a floor that turns 360° in about 90 minutes; two private rooms (2–8 people, extra charge) do not rotate (official site; 2026 reviews). Children welcome; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). 14F of the RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto — change to the restaurant lift on 11F; 7 min walk west of JR Kyoto Stn, or the hotel shuttle bus (official site; August 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto, west of Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: French courses with a 360° view: lunch from ¥7,000, dinner from ¥14,000 (official site); a seasonal dinner course, the "Manege" lunch course, bouquet-style plates, salmon with edible flowers, chocolate mousse and a whole cake for celebrations (2026 reviews) · set breakfast ¥4,301 with Kyoto vegetables, pork, eggs and pastries, or the hotel curry (official site; June–October 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Revolving French · RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto, by Kyoto Station] Billed as Japan's only revolving observation French restaurant: every table is at the window as the floor turns once in about 90 minutes past Kyoto Tower, Toji and Higashi Honganji. Lunch from ¥7,000, dinner from ¥14,000 (tax and service included); breakfast too. Popular for anniversaries.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: winner of several cooking competitions, including the 食の都大阪グランプリ; worked at the RIHGA Royal Hotel's 「シャンボール」 and was sous-chef at 「ザ レイ」 before becoming chef here; trained in France at 「ジャンフランソワ ピエージュ」 (Paris, two stars) and 「クリストフ バッキエ」 (now La Table du Castellet, three stars).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal produce and the traditions of French cooking, each plate made with care (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal French courses.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 lunch guest said staff accommodated dietary preferences perfectly.
An August 2026 couple took a private lift up for an anniversary dinner and were each given a single rose.
A September 2026 private-room lunch dragged to three hours; the diner called staff about three times and felt the room was short-staffed.
A July 2026 breakfast guest found the hotel curry, over ¥4,000, just average, and heard the hum of the turning mechanism.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (リーガロイヤルホテル京都): ホテル最上階、日本唯一の回転展望フレンチレストラン、14階 (11階で専用エレベータ)、朝食 7:30〜10:00、ランチ 12:00〜15:30、ディナー 17:00〜21:30、不定休、朝食4,301円・ランチ7,000円〜・ディナー14,000円〜 (税・サービス料込)、88席、個室2室 (回転しない、別料金)、ディナーのドレスコード、シェフ 石橋 敬太 (コンクール受賞、シャンボール、ザ レイのスーシェフ、ジャンフランソワ ピエージュ、クリストフ バッキエで研鑽)。食べログ (店舗会員): フレンチ、下京区松明町1 リーガロイヤルホテル京都 14F、サービス料15%、土日祝ランチは2部制、車椅子可、子供可。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): 約90分で一周、Kyoto Tower や Toji、記念日に一輪のバラ、Manege のランチコース、遅いサービスへの不満、朝食のカレーは平凡という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Large hotel restaurant; the hotel site is in English and other languages; dinner dress code.

places.name: 本マグロと島ごはん ぱなり 京都河原町三条 (Honmaguro to Shimagohan Panari)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tuna bowls with sweet soy sauce, Okinawa soba (wheat), spring rolls; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a tuna and Okinawan izakaya (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon and Fri 17:00–24:00; Tue–Thu, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–24:00; irregular holidays (Tabelog). Bookings online — the phone line was out of order, questions by Instagram DM (Tabelog); seating not guaranteed at busy times. Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「ディナーのみお通し代あり(380円)」 — a ¥380 appetizer fee at dinner only. Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Shoes off; counter, sofa seats, sunken kotatsu tables and a loft (Tabelog; September 2026 review). QR ordering and payment (September 2026 review). Cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Up a narrow entrance to the 2nd floor on Kawaramachi north of Sanjo; 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; September 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi north of Sanjo — 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Bluefin tuna from the central market and Okinawan home cooking (Tabelog): lunch mini-bowl sets of two or three kinds — lean tuna, negitoro, seared cheek, poke, sea grapes — with aasa seaweed soup; the Panari bowl and Honmaguro bowl; tuna platters for two or large; shrimp-and-cream-cheese spring rolls, taco salad, goya, mozuku, grilled dried squid, house Okinawa soba and rafute; Orion beer, kiwi sour; lunchtime all-you-can-drink (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Tuna & Okinawan izakaya · Kawaramachi-Sanjo] A shoes-off upstairs hideaway with sofa seats and kotatsu tables: bluefin tuna bowls with sea grapes at lunch, tuna platters, goya and Okinawa soba with Orion beer at night, open to midnight. Lunch about ¥1,500; dinner ¥4,000–5,000 with a ¥380 appetizer. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: bluefin tuna bought at the central market, house-made Okinawa soba and rafute, and celebration dessert plates with message cards.
chef_bio.specialty: Bluefin tuna bowls; Okinawan dishes.

anecdotes.text: Arriving at 21:00 after a concert in September 2026, a couple sat with legs stretched at a round kotatsu table; spicy grilled edamame came as the ¥380 appetizer, and the bill for two was ¥8,320.
An October 2026 diner found the Honmaguro bowl's lean tuna dry and the fatty tuna off-colour and smelly — too poor to eat — while the Panari bowl was fine.
In October 2026, when the appetizer turned out to be edamame, staff asked whether a guest wanted to cancel an edamame order.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 本マグロと島ごはん ぱなり 京都河原町三条、居酒屋・沖縄料理・海鮮、中京区河原町通三条上ル恵比寿町534-6 エリゼビル2F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩2分、月金 17:00〜24:00、火水木土日祝 12:00〜24:00、不定休、ディナーのみお通し代380円、40席、喫煙可、中央市場の本マグロ、自家製の沖縄そばとラフテー、昼飲みの飲み放題、ロフト席・ソファ席・掘りごたつ、電話不通のためネット予約・Instagram の DM で問い合わせ。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): ミニ丼2種・3種セット (赤身、ねぎとろ、ほほ肉の炙り、ポキ、海ぶどう)、アーサ汁、マグロの盛り合わせ、ゴーヤー、もずく、QR 注文、靴を脱いで上がる、本マグロ丼の質がひどかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering; shoes off; smoking allowed.

places.name: つるや (Tsuruya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A ju-wari (100% buckwheat) ishikurumi soba is on the menu alongside Sarashina soba, but the dipping sauce is soy-and-dashi, and tempura, tendon and fried dishes share the kitchen (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based soba sauce and broth; fish tempura, sashimi and dashimaki (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30, dinner 18:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations for dinner only (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 seats: a counter and a tatami area (Tabelog; January 2026). Private dinners for a group of 11 have been held (March 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a quiet residential street on Dotemachi north of Ebisugawa, behind the Ritz-Carlton, about 415 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 7 July 2005 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Dotemachi north of Ebisugawa, behind the Ritz-Carlton — 6 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Handmade thin soba — Sarashina and ju-wari ishikurumi — with a light, dashi-forward dipping sauce (2025–2026 reviews) · lunch sets: a fish tempura bowl (the day’s fish, e.g. yellowtail, rockfish, eel or wrasse) with a small hot or cold soba and pickles; ten-nan set; oyakodon set (2025–2026) · tempura zaru soba, corn tempura, soba-tea pudding (August 2025) · evenings: obanzai, sashimi often from the owner’s own catch (the owner is described as a fishing master), myoga tempura, dashimaki, crab, grilled dishes, with rare sakes, finishing with soba (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Soba · behind the Ritz-Carlton, a fisherman’s soba house] An eight-seat counter-and-tatami soba shop on a quiet residential street, loved by locals and recommended by hotels. Lunch is a fish tempura bowl with a small bowl of fine handmade soba; at night it turns into a sake-and-small-plates spot with sashimi of fish the owner often catches, ending with Sarashina or ju-wari soba. Cash only; dinner by reservation; closed Thursdays.

chef_bio.background: An October 2026 regular on a twelfth visit calls the chef a “fishing Meijin” whose own catch often makes it onto the menu. A September 2026 diner learned of the shop from a book by the author Akira Nagai; a May 2026 visitor came on a hotel’s recommendation. A July 2026 diner found the staff unfriendly — a parting thanks went unanswered.
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade Sarashina and ju-wari soba; fish tempura bowls.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 solo diner, offered the tatami, asked for the counter instead and the staff cleared a seat.
A May 2025 regular came in after a morning run and a public bath for the ten-nan set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: つるや、そば、中京区土手町通夷川上ル鉾田町299-3、神宮丸太町駅から415m、昼12:00〜14:30、夜18:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、木曜定休、予約は夜のみ、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、8席 (カウンター、座敷)、禁煙、2005年7月7日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): Ritz-Carlton の裏、手打ちの細いそば (更科と十割の Ishikurumi)、日替わりの魚の天丼と小そばのセット、天ざる、とうもろこしの天ぷら、そば茶のプリン、夜は造り、だし巻き、蟹など、珍しい日本酒、店主は釣りの名人で自分で釣った魚も出る、店員が無愛想との声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny local soba shop; cash only; dinner by reservation. Recommended by hotels to guests (May 2026).

places.name: 白川 京とみ (Shirakawa Kyotomi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-battered tempura over rice; nyumen of wheat noodles (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shrimp, conger eel and hamo tempura, dashimaki, dashi broths (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday and the second Tuesday of the month (Tabelog). Reservations accepted per Tabelog, but not at lunch (April 2026); waits of 30–40 minutes at peak, slow turnover (April 2026). Cards (AMEX) and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter and 14 at tables; a private room (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). By the Shirakawa, 142 m from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 February 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: By the Shirakawa near Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Tempura rice bowls, served on the rice or with the tempura on a separate plate (2025–2026 reviews) · shrimp and anago tempura bowl with dashimaki ¥1,980 (February and July 2026) · shrimp and hamo tempura bowl with dashimaki ¥2,580 (July 2025); hamo tempura bowl (October 2026) · seasonal tempura set with conger eel and shrimp (May 2026) · nyumen with yuba and tempura (December 2025) · light, crisp batter; vegetable tempura · a small dessert — sorbet, strawberry ice cream or yellow watermelon (2025–2026) · dashimaki sells out early (April and July 2026)
places.notes: [Tempura bowls · Shirakawa by Higashiyama Stn] A calm lunch-only room steps from Higashiyama Station, handy before Heian Shrine or the KYOCERA Museum: light, crisp tempura bowls of shrimp, anago or hamo, with the tempura on the rice or on its own plate, a fluffy dashimaki (it sells out) and a little sorbet to finish, about ¥2,000–2,600. No lunch bookings; expect a wait at noon. Closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: No owner or chef is named in the sources read. Reviewers describe an older local clientele and a calm, slightly formal room (July 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura bowls; dashimaki.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner meant to go to the soba shop next door, saw its line, and came here instead — and got the last dashimaki.
A July 2025 guest was served a rare yellow watermelon after the meal.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 白川 京とみ、天丼、東山区石泉院町393-3、東山駅から142m、火〜日 11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、月曜と第2火曜定休、予約可、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー可、20席 (カウンター、テーブル14)、個室あり、禁煙、2017年2月1日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 海老と穴子の天丼とだし巻き1,980円、海老と鱧の天丼とだし巻き2,580円、天ぷらとご飯を別盛りにもできる、ゆばのにゅうめん、軽い衣、デザートにシャーベット、昼は予約不可で行列、だし巻きは早く売り切れる。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the tempura sets; ask for the tempura served separately if you prefer. Queue at lunch.

places.name: Dough
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery — sourdough, ciabatta, pizza bianca and rossa, brioche maritozzi, doughnuts, scones (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain hard breads such as sourdough and pizza bianca may be plant-based, but no ingredient list is published; many items use cheese, cream, eggs or butter (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Friday and Saturday 11:00–16:00; closed Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday; extra closures announced on social media (Tabelog). Reviewers describe three opening days a week — check Instagram before going (August 2025; June and July 2026). Takeaway only; the shop fits one or two customers at a time (July 2026). Items can be reserved for pickup, and some made to order; on Thursdays and Sundays the team is at the workshop and answers the phone; nationwide shipping on request (Tabelog). No cards; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Often sells out early (May 2026). South of the Imperial Palace off Marutamachi on Fuyacho, about 7 min from Marutamachi Stn (2026 reviews; Tabelog). Opened 23 January 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho just south of Marutamachi, below the Imperial Palace — 7 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Takeaway European-style hard breads and American bakes (May and July 2026 reviews) · sourdough; blue cheese and walnut ciabatta ¥350–380; pizza bianca alla romana ¥280; pizza rossa; Welsh cheese toast ¥390; frittata sandwich (2025–2026) · tiramisu maritozzo ¥330–350; cinnamon-sugar and glazed doughnuts ¥260–290; cinnamon rolls; apple-cranberry crumble; muffins, carrot cake, scones (2025–2026)
places.notes: [Bakery · Fuyacho below the Imperial Palace, three days a week] A tiny takeaway bakery — room for one or two customers — selling serious hard breads (sourdough, blue-cheese ciabatta, Roman pizza bianca) alongside American sweets: cinnamon doughnuts, a tiramisu maritozzo, crumbles. Open only Monday, Tuesday, Friday and Saturday from 11:00, often sold out early; reserve by phone. No cards.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 reviewer writes that the bakery began in 2003 as “BREAD ROOM” and moved and renamed itself Dough at this address in 2015 (Tabelog gives an opening date of January 2015).
chef_bio.specialty: Hard breads; cinnamon doughnuts; tiramisu maritozzo.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 shopper arrived after 16:00 and found the shop still open because customers with reservations had not yet collected.
A December 2025 regular wants every resident of Kyoto to try the cinnamon doughnut.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Dough、パン、中京区舟屋町424、丸太町駅から589m、月・火・金・土 11:00〜16:00、水・木・日定休 (臨時休業はSNSで案内)、取り置き予約可、木・日は工房で仕込み中のため電話対応、全国発送も相談可、カード不可、電子マネー・QR可、テイクアウト、2015年1月23日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 1〜2人しか入れない小さな店、サワードウ、ブルーチーズとくるみのチャバタ、ピッツァ・ビアンカ、ティラミスのマリトッツォ、シナモンドーナツ、2003年に「BREAD ROOM」として開業し2015年に移転・改名との声、売り切れが早い。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny takeaway counter; point at the breads. Check opening days on Instagram; reserve by phone.

places.name: 京菜味のむら 烏丸本店 (Kyosaimi Nomura, Karasuma)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pick-your-own obanzai from a showcase — simmered, grilled and dressed dishes, many in soy and dashi (teriyaki mackerel, ganmo, hijiki) — with rice, miso soup and a yuba rice bowl; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Many of the obanzai are vegetables, beans, tofu and yuba, but dashi and fish or meat dishes (mackerel, duck, pork belly) are mixed in, and the broths are not described (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 7:00–14:00 daily; may close early when food runs out; open year-round, New Year by inquiry (Tabelog). No reservations — first come, first served (Tabelog). Order at a touch-panel ticket machine, then choose obanzai at the showcase (October 2026). No cover or charge (Tabelog, original 「なし。」). Cards (VISA), IC and e-money, QR (Tabelog). 36 seats: 10 at the counter, 26 at tables; wheelchair access; free Wi-Fi; children welcome (Tabelog). Rice refills not offered (October 2026). The Miyabi Gozen is limited and can sell out (Tabelog). On Takoyakushi just west of Karasuma, 3 min from Shijo / Karasuma Stns exit 22 (Tabelog). Opened 12 June 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takoyakushi just west of Karasuma — 3 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Obanzai breakfast and lunch from 7:00 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · six obanzai of your choice with white or multigrain rice and miso soup, about ¥850 (September–October 2026) · six obanzai with a yuba rice bowl, about ¥1,000; an 18-dish set with yuba bowl (October–November 2026) · Miyabi Gozen of twelve obanzai, with a small Heartland beer as an “alcohol set” ¥1,800 (October 2026) · obanzai seen: teriyaki mackerel, creamy cauliflower stew, simmered beans, ganmo, simmered shredded vegetables, spinach with tuna, hijiki and burdock, namasu, kombu rolls, braised pork belly, duck (October 2026)
places.notes: [Obanzai · Shijo Karasuma, breakfast from 7:00] A bright counter-and-table room just off Karasuma where you buy a ticket and pick six (or twelve, or eighteen) small dishes of Kyoto home cooking from a showcase, with rice and miso soup — about ¥850, or ¥1,000 with a yuba rice bowl. A good early Japanese breakfast before sightseeing. No bookings; busy with tourists at times. A second shop is in Nishiki.

chef_bio.background: An October 2026 reviewer notes that the company supplies its dishes to department stores. A September 2026 diner thought the dishes looked aimed at international guests and suspected the miso soup and sides were pre-made; other 2026 reviewers praise the gentle, home-style flavours.
chef_bio.specialty: Pick-your-own obanzai sets; yuba rice bowl.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor arrived at 7:10 to find two groups already eating, with more coming in.
An October 2026 diner wished the rice could be refilled, the obanzai being so good with it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京菜味のむら 烏丸本店、日本料理・カフェ・豆腐料理、中京区蛸薬師通烏丸西入橋弁慶町224、四条駅・烏丸駅22番出口から徒歩3分、毎日7:00〜14:00、材料がなくなり次第終了、年中無休、予約不可 (先着順)、チャージなし、カード (VISA)・電子マネー・QR可、36席 (カウンター10、テーブル26)、車椅子可、子ども可、2015年6月12日オープン、「Miyabi Gozen」は数量限定。食べログ京都の店名検索では錦店もある。口コミ (2026年、英語): 券売機で選び、ショーケースからおばんざいを6品、白米か雑穀米と味噌汁で約850円、湯葉丼付き約1,000円、12品の Miyabi Gozen とビールのセット1,800円、朝食向き、百貨店にも卸しているとのこと。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine and point-to-choose showcase; easy without Japanese. Popular with inbound tourists (October 2026).

places.name: 百春 (momoharu)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: the menu centres on an egg sandwich on soft bread, French toast and cakes (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg sandwich, French toast and cakes; coffee is the only plant-based item reviewers mention (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–17:00; closed Tuesday and Thursday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); expect a short wait at lunch and on weekends (November 2025; September 2026). 9 seats: 4 at tables and 5 at the counter; non-smoking; signs ask guests to speak quietly (Tabelog; September 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 2F of the Taneike building on Teramachi-dori near Marutamachi, overlooking the street; 4 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 1 September 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi-dori near Marutamachi, upstairs — 4 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Quiet upstairs coffee shop (2025–2026 reviews) · a thick, hot egg sandwich of a salt-seasoned omelette of 3–4 eggs with a demi-glace and ketchup sauce, ¥880 (July 2026) · French toast with maple syrup ¥880, the cake of the day, brandy cake (May–September 2026) · hand-dripped coffee from beans roasted in-house each morning (July 2026): Momoharu Blend ¥660, plus Ethiopia, Brazil, Guatemala and Mandheling; café latte (2025–2026 reviews) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Café · Teramachi Marutamachi, upstairs and quiet] A nine-seat café on the second floor above Teramachi-dori, known for its egg sandwich: a thick omelette of three or four eggs, made to order and served steaming, with a sweet-tangy sauce, ¥880. French toast, cakes and hand-dripped coffee roasted in-house, from a house blend to single origins. Calm and bookish, with a quiet-please sign; often a short wait. Cash only; closed Tuesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 1 September 2015, nine seats, registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers describe beans roasted in-house each morning and hand-dripped (July 2026), books to read (December 2025) and a feature in the magazine Kuuneru (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Egg sandwich.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor, having read about the café in the magazine Kuuneru, ordered the egg sandwich and blend to recreate the cover photo at the counter.
A December 2025 pilgrim on the Rakuyo 33 Kannon temple circuit stopped in, hungry, for an egg sandwich and a Mandheling.
The omelette is made from three to four eggs seasoned only with salt, with a demi-glace and ketchup sauce between egg and bread — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、中京区常盤木町55 種池ビル 2F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩4分、11:00〜17:00、火曜・木曜定休、予約不可、9席 (テーブル4、カウンター5)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、2015年9月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 寺町通の2階、厚くて熱々の玉子サンド880円 (卵3〜4個、塩だけで焼き、デミグラスとケチャップのソース)、フレンチトースト880円、本日のケーキ、ブランデーケーキ、毎朝自家焙煎のハンドドリップのコーヒー、ブレンド660円、エチオピア、ブラジル、グアテマラ、マンデリン、カフェラテ、本が置いてある、「お静かに」の貼り紙、雑誌「Kuuneru」に掲載。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at your seat; keep voices low; cash only; small, so you may wait.

places.name: 沁みる (SHIMIRU)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Miso soups from around Japan — one option is Kagoshima barley miso, which contains barley — with rice bowls dressed in a sesame sauce; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The soups are full of vegetables and tofu, but one reviewer remarks on the dashi and the rice bowls use bonito flakes, tuna flakes, chicken or egg; some soups are pork-based (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 8:30–14:00 (Tabelog); mixed rice can sell out by about 12:30 (May 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Order and pay at the counter on entry (June 2026). 20 seats: 6 at the counter and 2 tables of 4, with tatami seating; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). In a narrow alley of townhouses between Karasuma and Omiya, a block from Shijo-dori; 5 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Shijo Karasuma, a townhouse alley west of Karasuma — 5 min walk from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Miso-soup specialist for breakfast and lunch: a set of one rice dish, a miso soup and small daily sides (Tabelog) · miso from around Japan — Hokkaido, Aichi Hatcho, Kyoto white, Kagoshima barley, Niigata floating koji (Tabelog) · about nine soups, e.g. Hokkaido corn and potato, Kyoto white miso with a whole tomato and Kyoto vegetables, an Okinawa-style pork miso soup (2026 reviews) · rice choices such as bonito-flake rice, tuna-flake rice with egg yolk and sesame sauce, chicken and burdock rice, kamameshi (2026 reviews) · sides of tamagoyaki, takuan and bean sprouts (March and September 2026) · sets ¥1,100 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Miso soup · Shijo Karasuma back alley, breakfast and lunch] A miso-soup specialist tucked in a townhouse lane west of Shijo Karasuma: pick a rice (bonito flakes, tuna flakes with egg yolk, chicken and burdock) and one of about nine hearty soups made with miso from around Japan — Hokkaido corn and potato, or Kyoto white miso with a whole tomato — with small sides, for about ¥1,100. Counter and tatami. Some find the soups mild, some salty; one summer visit had a broken air conditioner. Open daily from 8:30.

roles: Owner (unnamed; called young by a July 2026 reviewer) and staff
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a miso-soup specialist offering five kinds of miso — Hokkaido, Aichi Hatcho, Kyoto white, Kagoshima barley and Niigata floating koji — in sets of rice, miso soup and a daily side, in a Japanese-style room with counter and tatami seats; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 describe a hidden shop in an alley of townhouses, found via Instagram (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Miso soups from all over Japan in a relaxing Japanese room (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Regional miso soups with vegetables.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 traveller, a ramen man whose wife picked the place, ordered bonito-flake rice with an Okinawa-style miso soup and called it a great start to the trip.
In July 2026 the air conditioning broke; a single fan cooled a few seats while other guests sweated over the soup.
A September 2026 visitor from Kanto chose the Kyoto white miso soup with a whole tomato and found a surprisingly large sweet potato inside.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂、下京区新釜座町735-2、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩約5分、地下鉄四条駅から徒歩約6分、毎日 8:30〜14:00、予約可、20席 (カウンター6、4人がけテーブル2)、座敷あり、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。店の紹介: 味噌汁専門店、北海道の味噌、愛知の八丁味噌、京都の白味噌、鹿児島の麦味噌、新潟の浮き麹味噌の5種、ご飯と味噌汁と日替わりの小鉢のセット、カウンターと座敷。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 町家の並ぶ細い路地、入口で注文と支払い、ご飯 (おかか、ツナ、鶏ごぼう、釜飯など) と約9種の味噌汁から選ぶ、北海道のとうもろこしとじゃがいも、京野菜と丸ごとトマトの白味噌汁、沖縄風の豚汁のような味噌汁、ごまだれ、卵黄、小鉢 (卵焼き、たくあん、もやし)、セット1,100円、味が薄い・塩辛いとの声、エアコンの故障 (2026年7月)、男性アイドルグループの映像が流れていた (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the counter; pick a rice and a soup; cards, e-money and QR.

places.name: アグレアーブル (Agreable)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: a French patisserie of tarts, roll cakes, mille-feuille, choux, sablés and financiers (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: all dairy comes from Takahashi Dairy, with cream, custard, butter and eggs throughout (June 2026).
places.hours_raw: Opens 10:00 and closes when sold out — usually by early afternoon (Tabelog; September 2026); closed on irregular days, posted on Instagram (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Come early for choice; queues at opening on busy days (January 2025). No reservations (Tabelog). 4 seats at one table; mostly takeaway; packs cakes with ice for long trips (Tabelog; April 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Under a yellow awning on Ebisugawa-dori east of Takakura; 5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 12 April 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ebisugawa-dori east of Takakura — 5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: French patisserie by chef Kato, trained at Gérard Mulot; all dairy from Takahashi Dairy (June 2026) · cakes mostly about ¥600–700: raspberry, lemon, apricot and Améche tarts; Fraisier; mille-feuille; Mont Blanc on meringue; Black Forest; opera; tarte Tatin; cream puffs with Tahitian vanilla custard; a Camembert soufflé cheesecake (2025–2026 reviews) · Agre roll cake ¥2,000 whole, ¥1,100 half; limited rolls such as a chocolate roll ¥2,500 (2025–2026 reviews) · baked goods: lemon sablé ¥700, diamants, financiers, orange cake and cheese batons ¥350, canelés, Rocher fraise (2026 reviews) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Patisserie · Ebisugawa near Marutamachi, takeaway] A small French patisserie under a yellow awning, opened in 2013 by chef Kato, trained at Gérard Mulot in Paris. Classic cakes at fair prices — tarts with Nagano apricots or raspberries, Fraisier, a firm-layered mille-feuille, opera, Black Forest — plus roll cakes, cream puffs and a much-loved lemon sablé, all with Takahashi Dairy cream and butter. Opens at 10 and sells out by early afternoon; irregular closing days. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: A June 2026 reviewer writes that the shop was opened in April 2013 by Chef Kato, who trained at Gérard Mulot, and that all dairy comes from the Hokkaido series of Takahashi Dairy; Tabelog gives the opening date as 12 April 2013. An April 2026 regular thanks "the chef and madam" for such treats at these prices.
chef_bio.specialty: Lemon sablé; Agre roll cake; Fraisier.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor from Tokyo had cakes packed with ice packs in a cooler bag for the trip home, all arriving undamaged.
On 2 January 2025 the shop opened for the new year, and a guest five minutes late found a line already inside — fifth in the queue.
A December 2025 visitor finally got in after struggling to find a day the shop was open.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ケーキ・カフェ、中京区夷川通高倉東入天守町757 ZEST-24 1F、地下鉄丸太町駅から徒歩5分、10:00〜売り切れまで、不定休、予約不可、4席、禁煙、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、2013年4月12日オープン。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 黄色いテント、Gérard Mulot で修業したシェフ Kato が開いた、乳製品はすべて Takahashi Dairy の北海道シリーズ、ケーキは600〜700円ほど、フランボワーズ・レモン・杏・Améche のタルト、フレジエ、ミルフィーユ、モンブラン、フォレノワール、オペラ、タルトタタン、シュークリーム (タヒチ産バニラ)、カマンベールのスフレ、Agre Roll (ホール2,000円、ハーフ1,100円)、限定のチョコのロール2,500円、レモンサブレ700円、Diamant、フィナンシェ、オレンジケーキ、チーズバトン、カヌレ、ロッシェフレーズ、昼過ぎには売り切れ、保冷剤で持ち帰り、シェフとマダムへの感謝。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the showcase; mostly takeaway; cash only; check Instagram for open days.

places.name: ザ・ブレッド (THE BREAD, Kyoto Yaoichi Honkan)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: a wheat bakery of croissants, hard bread, sweet and savoury breads and sandwiches (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Some hard breads and vegetable breads (Kujo negi, spinach, corn, potato) appear, but no ingredient information; many items use butter, sausage, bacon, cheese or fish (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–21:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Self-service; takeaway, with a small eat-in counter and tables; laptops not allowed in the eat-in (Tabelog remarks; 2026 reviews). Cards accepted, but no e-money or QR — PayPay not taken (Tabelog; July and October 2026). 1F of Kyoto Yaoichi Honkan, a produce store on Higashinotoin one block south of Sanjo; 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 5 (Tabelog). Opened 20 April 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Yaoichi Honkan 1F, Higashinotoin south of Sanjo — 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Bakery of the Kyoto Yaoichi Honkan produce store, sister to its SAVORY restaurant (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · croissant ¥280, fromage ¥320, mackerel and lotus-root bread ¥380, sausage French ¥320 (November 2025–January 2026) · crescent butter rolls, horns, an-butter, kinako doughnuts, chocolate tart, banana bread (2026 reviews) · vegetable breads: Kujo negi and bacon épi, maitake rolls, burdock and tuna sesame bread, croquette bread (2026 reviews) · sandwiches ¥420, salmon sandwich (July–October 2026) · under ¥1,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Bakery · Karasuma Oike, inside Yaoichi Honkan] The in-house bakery on the ground floor of Kyoto Yaoichi Honkan, a big produce store near Karasuma Oike: self-service trays of croissants, hard breads and plenty of vegetable breads — Kujo negi and bacon épi, maitake rolls, burdock and tuna — plus sandwiches, mostly ¥300–400. Small eat-in corner, no laptops. Cards but no QR. Open daily to 21:00.

roles: Bakery staff of Kyoto Yaoichi Honkan (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bakery inside Kyoto Yaoichi Honkan, opened 20 April 2013, with eat-in seating; the Yaoichi website introduces its seasonal breads (Tabelog remarks). Reviewers in 2025–2026 call it a bakery inside a famous vegetable shop, with frequent new products (February 2026). SAVORY, on the third floor of the same building, is in data as kyoto_savory_yaoichi_honkan.
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable breads; crescent butter roll.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 shopper who had just bought bread at a nearby boulangerie could not resist an an-butter sandwich and a kinako doughnut here too.
"This area is a fierce battleground for bakeries" — October 2026, on a Kujo negi and bacon épi generous with negi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン・サンドイッチ、中京区東洞院通三条下る三文字町220 京都八百一本館 1F、烏丸御池駅5番出口から徒歩3分、毎日 10:00〜21:00、予約不可、テイクアウト、イートインあり、パソコンの使用は禁止、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、2013年4月20日オープン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 八百一の中のパン屋、セルフサービス、クロワッサン280円、Fromage 320円、鯖と蓮根380円、Sausage French 320円、Crescent Butter、Horn、あんバター、きなこドーナツ、チョコタルト、バナナブレッド、九条ねぎとベーコンのエピ、舞茸のロール、ごぼうとツナのごまパン、コロッケパン、サンドイッチ420円、サーモンサンド、PayPay 不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-service trays; pay at the till; cards but no QR; no laptops in the eat-in.

places.name: Cafe ふふふあん (Cafe Fufufuan, 半兵衛麸)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the café is built around nama-fu, which is wheat gluten, along with yuba, muffins and pizza (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The café says its dishes contain no meat, but some use dairy and some use fish in the broth (Tabelog, restaurant’s own note).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); closed Wednesday (open on some Wednesday holidays) and 29 December–4 January (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). Lunch and tea times can mean a short wait (July–August 2026). 63 seats, including window counters and sofas; groups up to 12; non-smoking; children welcome; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transit IC, iD, QUICPay and QR including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On the 3rd floor of the 半兵衛麸 Gojo Building above the shop, with a glass wall over the Kamo River, 83 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Moved here from across the street from the 半兵衛麸 main store; opened 28 April 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gojo, by the Kamo River — 83 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Café of the fu maker 半兵衛麸, cooking with its fresh nama-fu and nama-yuba (Tabelog) · lunch: Benkei, nama-fu and nama-yuba in a savoury ankake over rice or noodles, with okara salad and a fu manju; Ichihime; pizza; nama-yuba dengaku +¥500 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · nama-fu dengaku of five kinds with seasonal toppings · sweets: fu-mochi zenzai in winter, cold zenzai with three-colour nama-fu, chimaki-fu with matcha for the Gion Festival, the seasonal Seseragi, matcha kakigori, nama-fu matcha parfait with Tsujiri matcha ice cream, kinako muffin (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Café · Gojo by the Kamo River, sweets and lunch of fresh fu] The bright upstairs café of 半兵衛麸, Kyoto's old maker of fu (wheat gluten), with a glass wall looking over the Kamo River at Gojo. Come for nama-fu dengaku with sweet miso, Benkei (fu and yuba in a savoury sauce over rice) at lunch, or chewy fu in zenzai and a matcha parfait. Meat-free, though some dishes use dairy or fish broth. Shop for fu downstairs. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Run by 株式会社半兵衛麸 (invoice holder); no chef named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café produced by the fu maker 半兵衛麸, serving dishes and sweets of freshly made nama-fu and nama-yuba; moved from across the street from the 半兵衛麸 main store and opened on 28 April 2022 (pre-opening 15 April). anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family found the nama-yuba rice bowl such a hit with the child in the party that it was nearly finished.
A September 2026 visitor heading to Ichihime Shrine stopped for lunch and nama-fu dengaku.
A June 2026 guest came for coffee and a kinako muffin straight after a fu lunch at the main store.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Cafe ふふふあん、カフェ・日本料理・甘味、東山区問屋町通五条下る上人町433 半兵衛麸五条ビル3F、清水五条駅から83m、10:00〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、水曜定休・年末年始 (12月29日〜1月4日)、63席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2022年4月28日オープン (半兵衛麸本店の向かいから移転、半兵衛麸プロデュース)、インボイス T6130001009591 (株式会社半兵衛麸)。お店の情報: 肉を使わない料理、一部に乳製品や魚 (出汁) を含む。公式紹介: 生麩と生湯葉の甘味、冬の麩もちぜんざい、夏の祇園祭の粽麩と抹茶、昼の「弁慶」(生麩と生湯葉のあんかけご飯)。口コミ (2026年6〜9月、英語): 鴨川の眺め、生麩田楽5種、生湯葉田楽+500円、一姫、ピザ、おからサラダ、麩まんじゅう、冷やしぜんざい、抹茶かき氷、都路里の抹茶アイスの生麩パフェ、きなこマフィン。

places.name: 本家 重兵衛 (Honke Jubei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-style sushi seasoned with soy-simmered toppings, rice cooked in kombu dashi, and kappo dishes; no gluten information is published; allergies can be raised when booking omakase (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi house; the rice is cooked in kombu dashi, but the menu is built on fish (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:15–13:30); dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Tuesday and irregularly (official site); Tabelog shows dinner to 21:00 daily. Takeout of most sushi at slightly lower prices (official menu). Bookings welcome for both; omakase needs booking, with likes, dislikes, allergies and budget given in advance (official site). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; non-smoking; cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no QR; paid parking nearby (Tabelog). English, Chinese and Korean menus online (official site). In the 占出山 float district on Nishikikoji east of Muromachi, 2 min from exit 22 of Shijo or Karasuma Stn (official site). Founded 1936 in Gion (Nawate-Shinbashi); moved here in March 2011 (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Karasuma, Nishikikoji-Muromachi — 2 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto (Kansai) sushi and kappo: rice of aged Kyoto or Omi rice cooked in kombu dashi; mostly wild fish from the Kyoto market, Tsuruga and Ise; 40-plus toppings, from one piece (official site) · lunch sets: nigiri ¥2,420–6,600, chirashi ¥2,090–4,950, Kyo-chirashi with no raw fish ¥1,980, maki from ¥1,650 · house specialities: 名物 磯巻 ¥1,430, 京好み おぼろ巻 ¥1,210, mackerel sushi ¥2,750 (whole roll for two ¥5,500), box sushi ¥2,420, small sea-bream suzume-zushi ¥2,530, anago bo-zushi ¥1,760 · omakase: sushi only or dishes only from ¥9,900, sushi and dishes from ¥14,300 (official menu)
places.notes: [Sushi · Nishiki-Muromachi, Kyoto-style sushi since 1936] A ten-seat counter keeping old Kyoto sushi alive: rice cooked in kombu dashi and seasoned to stand up to the fish, and house classics like the 磯巻 roll, sweet おぼろ巻 and mackerel bo-zushi, all available to take away. Lunch sets start around ¥2,000; evenings bring omakase of nigiri and kappo dishes from ¥9,900. Founded in Gion in 1936 by a master of decorative sushi, now run by the third generation. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1936 in Gion (Nawate, above Shinbashi) by 荒木 信次, a leading craftsman of decorative sushi who spread the technique nationwide and wrote a sushi textbook; the second generation, 照雄, held senior posts in the sushi trade association; the third, 荒木 一雄, built today’s "sushi and kappo" style. The shop moved to the 占出山 float district in March 2011. A May 2025 reviewer recalls seven or eight 重兵衛 in Gion some 30 years ago, including one at the now-closed Fujita Hotel.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: gratitude to guests, to ingredients and to the trade; as a Kyoto-sushi house the rice comes first — aged Kyoto or Omi rice cooked in kombu dashi so it tastes deeper the more you chew.
chef_bio.specialty: 名物 磯巻; 名代 鯖寿し; omakase of sushi and kappo dishes.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 omakase guest was asked at the start about favourite and least favourite ingredients.
A May 2025 customer remembered eating at the 重兵衛 in the Fujita Hotel decades ago and found the Kyoto box sushi unchanged.
A September 2024 visitor found the owner quiet and the fish excellent, and noted a rare Muraza beef on the menu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sushijubei.jp): 京の寿し処 割烹 本家 重兵衛、初代 荒木信次が昭和11年に祇園 (縄手新橋上ル) で開業、細工寿司の第一人者、二代目 照雄は寿司同業組合の要職、三代目 一雄が「寿しと料理」の形に、平成23年3月に山鉾町 (占出山) へ移転、店主 荒木一雄。すし飯は京都米や江州米の古米を昆布出汁で炊く、天然ものが中心、京都卸売市場と敦賀・伊勢などから直送、京野菜提供店・京都米提供店、40種以上のネタを1個から。昼11:30〜14:00、夜17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、火曜定休・不定休、四条駅・烏丸駅22番出口から徒歩2分。昼: 梅にぎり2,420円〜特上6,600円、ちらし2,090円〜、京ちらし1,980円、名物 磯巻1,430円、京好み おぼろ巻1,210円、名代 鯖寿し2,750円、箱寿し2,420円、小鯛雀寿し2,530円、穴子棒寿し1,760円、持ち帰り可。夜のおまかせ: 寿司のみ・一品料理のみ9,900円より、寿司と一品料理14,300円より。食べログ: カウンター10席、禁煙、カード可。

places.name: 中国饗膳 粋廉 (China Kyosen Suiren)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Shark-fin sauce over ramen or rice, spring rolls and dim sum; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a shark-fin specialist (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–13:30 and dinner 18:00–19:00 (times as listed by Tabelog, likely the last entries); closed Monday and Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations essential: since a celebrity YouTube feature, lunch is booked a month or more ahead, though same-day lunch slots sometimes open (January–September 2026). A notice in the restroom asks first-time guests to wait about six months before booking again (July 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). A calm dining room 238 m from Nijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Nijo — 238 m from Nijo Stn
places.cuisine: Chinese with shark fin at the centre (2026 reviews) · lunch: four courses, e.g. the second at ¥4,500 with three appetizers, spring rolls, rice, pickles and shark-fin ramen; the Ichinozen set with a clear soup, fresh spring rolls and shark-fin sauce, sizzling on a hot plate, over ramen (with a mini rice) or over rice, with rice refills; almond jelly; black vinegar on the table (January–September 2026) · dinner courses, about ¥10,000–15,000 per Tabelog’s budget
places.notes: [Chinese · Nijo, sizzling shark-fin ramen] A quiet restaurant near Nijo Station known for one thing: a rich, slightly sweet shark-fin sauce poured sizzling over ramen or rice. The lunch sets (about ¥3,500–4,500) add a clear soup, crisp spring rolls and dim sum; dinners are full courses. A celebrity YouTube visit made it hard to book — plan a month ahead, and expect to wait about six months before a second booking. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a shark-fin specialist near Nijo; a long-time local regular says it has become very hard to book after celebrity coverage on YouTube and in a magazine, and that a restroom notice now asks first-time guests to wait about six months before rebooking (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Shark-fin sauce ramen; shark-fin sauce rice on a hot plate.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular since the opening missed the warmer, homelier service of earlier years but still praised the food.
A February 2026 guest booked a month ahead for a Saturday and still missed the preferred date.
A July 2026 diner added black vinegar halfway through the shark-fin ramen to sharpen it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中国饗膳 粋廉、中華料理、中京区西ノ京職司町76、二条駅から238m、水〜日 12:00〜13:30・18:00〜19:00、月・火定休、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、電子マネー・QR 不可、予算は夜1万〜1万5千円、昼3千〜4千円。口コミ (2026年1〜9月、英語): フカヒレラーメン、鉄板で出すフカヒレあんかけご飯、春巻、スープ、ランチコース4種 (2番目4,500円)、ご飯のおかわり、黒酢、有名人の YouTube で予約困難に、1か月以上前の予約が必要、初回のあとは半年後の予約を、というトイレの貼り紙 (2026年7月)。

places.name: ristorante DONO (リストランテ ドーノ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses include fresh pasta (tagliolini), wood-fired bread, tarts and lasagna; no gluten information is published (official menu; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-led courses that also include fish, venison, wagyu and dairy; nothing vegan is offered on the published menus (official site).
places.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–20:00, Tuesday–Saturday; lunch 12:00–14:00, Wednesday–Saturday; closed Sunday and Monday (official site). Fully booked by reservation only; tables are turned after two hours; a confirmation call two days ahead, without which the booking may be cancelled; cancellation 50% the day before, 100% on the day; private room for 6 at an extra charge (official site). Course prices include tax and service (税サ込). 24 seats; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor of the ボーパサージュ京都岡崎 building, looking out on the great torii of Heian Shrine, 365 m from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened April 2024 (official site; Tabelog 18 April).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, facing the Heian Shrine torii — 365 m from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Italian built on vegetables and wild plants the chef gathers and grows each morning, with wood-fired cooking (Tabelog; official site) · Alta course ¥14,500; Bassa course, lunch only, ¥12,000; autumn matsutake course ¥35,000 (official site, tax and service included) · October 2026 menu, e.g. pinzimonio of mountain gifts, carrot with a river sauce, butternut squash, leaf minestra, matsutake tagliolini, Biwa trout with makomotake, venison with wild grape, budino and a chestnut Mont Blanc · also mentioned: a salad of 11 freshly picked vegetables, heshiko cream with wood-fired bread, bamboo-shoot lasagna, red bean with olive oil, house herbal tea (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Okazaki, a forager's vegetable Italian by Heian Shrine] Big windows onto the Heian Shrine torii and the scent of a wood fire: chef Toshifumi Nakahigashi, son of the family behind 草喰 なかひがし, picks wild plants and vegetables every morning as the heart of Italian courses — leaf minestra, matsutake tagliolini, venison with wild grape, herbal tea to close. Lunch ¥12,000, dinner from ¥14,500, tax and service included. Michelin Green Star. Reservations only; closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: born and raised in Kyoto in 1982; the father runs 草喰 なかひがし at Ginkakuji and a cousin runs 美山荘 in Hanase. Went to Italy alone at 18 and cooked mains at the two-star Ristorante Arnolfo in Tuscany, then trained at Villa Fiordaliso on Lake Garda (one star) and Alain Ducasse au Plaza Athénée in Paris (three stars). Back in Japan, head chef of Prinz in Ichijoji, then opening chef for The St. Regis Osaka from 2010; opened erba da nakahigashi in Nishi-Azabu, Tokyo, in 2016, renamed it 草片 cusavilla on 22 February 2021 with a stronger vegetable focus, and opened ristorante DONO in Okazaki, Kyoto, in April 2024. Listed with a Michelin Green Star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto–Osaka 2025 (official site). A May 2026 reviewer names the chef Toshifumi Nakahigashi, second son of the Nakahigashi family; the invoice registration is in the chef’s own name.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: "Dono" means sharing in Italian — to share nature’s gifts, gathered from the mountains and fields every morning, with guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable and wild-plant courses; matsutake tagliolini in autumn.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner heard that the ingredients are gathered from the mountains every day and found the owner friendly and full of stories.
An August 2026 lunch party was seen off at the door by the chef.
An October 2026 guest who had often eaten at the father’s restaurant found the same love of vegetables here in Italian form.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (dono-kyoto.com): ristorante DONO、シェフ 中東俊文、1982年京都生まれ、父は銀閣寺「草喰 なかひがし」、従兄は花背「美山荘」、18歳で単身イタリアへ、トスカーナの Arnolfo (二ツ星) でメイン担当、ガルダ湖畔の Villa Fiordaliso (一ツ星)、パリの Alain Ducasse au Plaza Athénée (三ツ星)、帰国後 一乗寺 Prinz 料理長、2010年 St. Regis Osaka 立ち上げシェフ、2016年 西麻布 erba da nakahigashi、2021年2月22日 草片 cusavilla に改称、2024年4月 京都岡崎に ristorante DONO。ミシュランガイド京都・大阪2025 グリーンスター。Alta コース14,500円、Bassa コース (ランチのみ) 12,000円、秋の松茸尽くし35,000円 (税サ込)、2時間制、2日前に確認の電話、キャンセル料 前日50%・当日100%、個室は使用料、全席禁煙・完全予約制、ディナー火〜土17:00〜20:00、ランチ水〜土12:00〜14:00、日月定休、左京区岡崎円勝寺町62 ボーパサージュ京都岡崎2階。2026年10月31日でショートコース (6,500円) 終了。食べログ: イタリアン・オーガニック・イノベーティブ、24席、2024年4月18日オープン、インボイス T3810181797047 (中東俊文)。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): 平安神宮の大鳥居が見える、毎朝畑と山から、薪の香り、ハーブティー。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservations only; a confirmation call comes two days before.

places.name: ルバカサブル (Le bac a sable)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery — croissants, salt bread, quiche, tarts, baguettes (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter croissants, cheese and egg quiches, bacon epi, cream-filled pastries (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 8:00–19:00, closed Wednesday; hours may change. A June 2026 diner found it had been closed for a long stretch earlier. 11 seats — 5 at the counter, 6 at tables — for eating in; you can warm bread yourself (June 2026); take-out; no reservations; non-smoking; children welcome. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Opened 11 October 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama-Sanjo — 1 min walk from Higashiyama Stn exit 2
places.cuisine: A small neighbourhood bakery-café with a French owner, per reviewers (June and September 2026) · quiches are the speciality — mushroom and garlic ¥400, four-cheese ¥400, salmon and shiso, tomato and mustard, a dessert quiche (2026 reviews) · croissants, cinnamon rolls, salt bread ¥150–180, a loaf ¥250, bacon epi about ¥300, pastrami and smoked-chicken sandwiches, baguettes (2026 reviews) · pear, apricot and apple tarts ¥400; rocher (coconut) ¥70 (2026 reviews) · blend coffee, red-berry smoothie ¥500, wine (Tabelog; June 2026)
places.notes: [Bakery café · by Higashiyama Station, quiches and croissants] A brick-counter bakery a minute from Higashiyama Station, open from 8 am, with a French owner per reviewers: buttery croissants, a row of ¥400 quiches, fruit tarts and very low prices. Opinions split — some praise the croissants and wheat flavour, others found the quiche bland and the bread dense (June, October 2026). Cash only. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-baker, not named; French per reviewers (June and September 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 11 October 2014 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a European-style room with a brick counter and tiled floor near Higashiyama Station, round "storybook" breads, many quiches, low prices, a French owner baking, and many foreign customers.
chef_bio.specialty: Quiche; croissant.

anecdotes.text: "While the prices are very affordable, my overall impression was that the flavors were lacking" — salt bread with no butter taste, a tasteless quiche, but a delicious pear tart (June 2026).
A September 2026 diner had read that a French owner bakes here, "however, from the items I purchased this time, I couldn’t really detect a French taste."
November 2026: salt bread eaten on a stroll — "The aroma of wheat is incredible."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ルバカサブル (Le bac a sable)、パン・カフェ、東山区西海子町51 メゾンドアリス 1F、地下鉄東西線東山駅2番出口から徒歩1分、8:00〜19:00、水曜休み、予約不可、11席 (カウンター5、テーブル6)、テイクアウト、禁煙、子供可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、2014年10月11日オープン。口コミ (2026年4月〜11月、英語): フランス人の店主が焼く、レンガのカウンターとタイルの床、キッシュが名物 (きのことにんにく400円、4種のチーズ400円、サーモンと大葉、トマトとマスタード)、クロワッサン、シナモンロール、塩パン150〜180円、食パン250円、ベーコンエピ、パストラミのサンド、洋梨・杏・りんごのタルト、Rocher 70円、赤いベリーのスムージー500円、パンは自分で温められる、外国人客が多い、味が物足りない・パンが詰まっているという声も、長く休業していた時期がある。

places.name: 風枝 (KazeEda)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: dim sum wrappers, wonton and ramen noodles, spring rolls and kara-age (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-filled dim sum, chicken-bone and shrimp broths, collagen soup (official site; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch Tue–Fri 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00), on about three of those days a week; dinner Tue–Sun and holidays 17:30–22:30 (last orders food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Monday. The official site posts the lunch days each month and takes take-out set orders by the day before, for pickup 17:30–20:30. Cards at dinner only; PayPay and Alipay at both (Tabelog). 20 seats — 6 at the counter, three tables for 4, a tatami room; non-smoking; children welcome (say when booking how many children will not eat an adult portion). Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「なし」 (the English auto-translation wrongly says one is added). Opened 9 September 2006 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Shijo-Karasuma — 5 min walk from Karasuma / Shijo Stn exit 22
places.cuisine: Gentle Chinese food, dim sum and obanzai (official site) · handmade xiao long bao, shumai, gyoza, spring rolls with Sichuan pepper, a giant dumpling equal to three xiao long bao, sesame balls, almond tofu (2025–2026 reviews) · "Ebi-nyan" ramen in a sweet-shrimp and lobster broth with fried shrimp wontons ¥1,450 (official site); shrimp wonton noodles in salt broth ¥900 with free large rice or noodles (March 2026); chilled collagen ramen in summer (July 2026) · lunch kara-age set with salad and fried vegetables — ¥1,550 with xiao long bao added (June 2026) · aged Shaoxing wines and Belgian beers; homemade chilli oil (December 2025 – October 2026) · take-out sets ¥2,000–3,500 (official site)
places.notes: [Chinese dim sum & obanzai · near Shijo-Karasuma, gentle flavours] A twenty-seat Chinese dining room in the old kimono-wholesale streets near Shijo-Karasuma, since 2006: handmade xiao long bao, a lobster-and-shrimp "Ebi-nyan" ramen, kara-age lunch sets and a shelf of aged Shaoxing wines. Lunch only on about three weekdays, packed by noon. No service charge. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 9 September 2006 (Tabelog). The official site calls it a place for Chinese and yum-cha food and obanzai, gentle on the body, in Kyoto’s kimono district. Reviewers in 2025–2026 praise kind staff, an owner whose care shows in the food, a calm room, help choosing Shaoxing wine, and a willingness to adjust the heat.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「体に優しい中華料理」 — Chinese food that is kind to the body.
chef_bio.specialty: Xiao long bao; Ebi-nyan ramen.

anecdotes.text: After the Gion Matsuri in a yukata, a July 2026 regular came for the chilled collagen ramen — "the wobbly collagen jelly paired perfectly with the ramen."
"At first glance, the portions may seem small, but each item is crafted with care in terms of flavor and aroma." — December 2025.
An October 2026 first-timer "knew nothing about Shaoxing wine, but they took the time to explain it."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kaze-eda.com): 風枝、中華・飲茶料理とおばんざいの店、体に優しい中華料理、京都の呉服街の蛸薬師室町、えびにゃんらーめん (甘海老とオマール海老のダブル海老だし) 1,450円、持ち帰りのおかずセットA 3,500円・B 3,000円、コラーゲン鍋セット2,000円・2,300円 (前日までに注文、17時30分〜20時30分にお渡し)、ランチは火〜金の週2〜3日 11:30〜14:30、ディナー火〜日 17:30〜22:30、月曜休み、中京区蛸薬師通室町西入姥柳町189 エチカビル1階、烏丸駅・四条駅22・24番出口から徒歩5分。食べログ: 飲茶・点心、居酒屋、中華料理、20席 (カウンター6、4人テーブル3)、座敷、禁煙、子供可、カードはディナーのみ、PayPay・Alipay可、サービス料は原文で「なし」、2006年9月9日オープン。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 小籠包、焼売、餃子、春巻、小籠包3個分の大きな包子、胡麻団子、杏仁豆腐、海老ワンタン麺 (塩) 900円、冷やしコラーゲンラーメン、唐揚げ定食、小籠包付きで1,550円、熟成紹興酒とベルギービール、自家製ラー油、親切なスタッフ、昼は混む。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff help with Shaoxing wine and spice levels (2026 reviews); lunch fills by noon.

places.name: 鮨 のぼる (Sushi Noboru)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, fried horse mackerel, a whale cutlet and homemade satsuma-age sit beside sushi seasoned with soy (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi counter; dobin-mushi, chawanmushi and clam miso soup on dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:30–21:00 without a break; closed Wednesday and Thursday; hours may change. About 10 counter seats; non-smoking; private hire; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Same-day phone bookings taken (October 2026); weekend afternoons nearly full (April 2026). Prices are not on the menu; about ¥10,000–15,000 a head (October 2026; reviews). About 15 chilled sakes (July 2025). Opened 8 March 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: A back alley near Higashiyama-Sanjo — 1 min from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: An all-day sushi counter with a long list of sake snacks: sashimi, simmered, grilled, fried and tempura dishes, then nigiri à la carte (2025–2026 reviews) · seen: wild buri, wild Akashi sea bream, sanma, harii squid, bonito, firefly squid in soy, kinmedai simmered sweet, fugu and king crab in winter, shinko in August, hamo and matsutake dobin-mushi, conger eel and matsutake hot pot, homemade satsuma-age, uzaku, chawanmushi, clam miso soup (2025–2026 reviews) · nigiri: lean and medium-fatty tuna, kohada, nodoguro, white shrimp, surf clam, negitoro (2025–2026 reviews) · fish aged overnight for texture (April 2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Higashiyama-Sanjo back alley, all-day counter] A ten-seat sushi counter in an alley by Higashiyama Station, open 11:30–21:00 without a break: a long board of sake snacks — wild buri, simmered kinmedai, homemade satsuma-age, seasonal dobin-mushi — then nigiri piece by piece. One regular has been ten times since mid-2025. No prices on the menu; about ¥10,000–15,000. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Not named in a source; "friendly young chefs" (August 2025)
chef_bio.background: Opened 8 March 2024 (Tabelog). A July 2026 diner says it belongs to the Komatsu sushi group and is backed by a tuna wholesaler (not confirmed elsewhere). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a clean, bright counter of about ten seats in a back alley near Higashiyama-Sanjo, young chefs, many regulars, warm service to newcomers, and a menu that changes with each season’s catch.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal sake snacks and nigiri; wild buri; homemade satsuma-age.

anecdotes.text: A regular logged ten visits from July 2025 to November 2026, from the first sanma and matsutake to fugu and seiko crab "soon" — "I feel like winter has arrived all at once."
April 2026: the chef explained that the fish is aged overnight, because it can be too firm when freshly prepared.
"The prices were not listed on the menu at all. It was JPY 10,000 per person." — October 2026.
"The attention to detail in the preparation is evident, although the prices might be a bit on the higher side." — October 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鮨 のぼる (Sushi Noboru)、寿司、東山区八軒町450-2、東山駅から62m、月・火・金・土・日 11:30〜21:00、水・木休み、禁煙、貸切可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2024年3月8日オープン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年11月、英語): カウンター約10席、通し営業、裏路地、若い職人、常連が多い、つまみが豊富、天然の鰤、Akashi の天然鯛、秋刀魚、ハリイカ、鰹、ホタルイカの醤油漬け、金目鯛の煮付け、冬はふぐとタラバガニ、8月の新子、鱧と松茸の土瓶蒸し、穴子と松茸の鍋、自家製さつま揚げ、う巻き、茶碗蒸し、しじみの味噌汁、鮪の赤身と中トロ、小肌、のどぐろ、白海老、ほっき貝、ねぎとろ、魚は一晩寝かせる、冷酒約15種、メニューに値段がない、1人1万〜1万5千円ほど、こまつグループで鮪の仲卸が母体という声 (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: No prices on the menu; ordering à la carte at the counter.
