places.name: 京・菓る茶cafe (Kyo Karucha cafe)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: cheesecakes, gâteau chocolat, sablés and pasta lunches (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a cheese-sweets shop — every cake is cheesecake (official site).
places.hours_raw: Official site: take-out 10:00–19:00; café 10:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog gives the café as 10:00–18:00, last order 17:00). Eat-in upstairs in a renovated machiya, ordering by QR code on your phone (2026 reviews). Reservations and holds possible (Tabelog; official site). Non-smoking; children welcome; no parking or bicycle parking. Cards (Amex listed), e-money and QR (Tabelog). The shop warns that look-alike cheesecakes are sold online; its own are sold only at the shop, its online shop and department-store events. Opened 20 February 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: A residential street between Karasuma Oike and Marutamachi — about 6 min walk from either station
places.cuisine: Cheese-sweets shop and café in a machiya: "storybook" cheesecakes shaped like holey cheese with a chocolate mouse (official site; 2026 reviews) · 口福のチーズケーキ ¥650 eat-in / ¥560 take-out; chocolate ¥670, strawberry ¥650, matcha ¥680, autumn ¥590; baked cheesecake ¥510; gâteau chocolat fromage ¥550 (official site) · lunch pastas ¥1,250–1,350 — cheese carbonara, squid and mentaiko cream cheese, shrimp and tomato cream, shrimp genovese; demi-glace cheese omurice ¥1,350; cake and drink set +¥750 (official site) · Uji teas ¥550–680, coffee from ¥500, matcha and hojicha lattes ¥680 (official site) · sablé ¥600 (August 2026)
places.notes: [Cheesecake café · between Karasuma Oike and Marutamachi, the cheese-and-mouse cakes] A cheese-sweets café in a renovated machiya: cheesecakes shaped like storybook cheese with a chocolate mouse peeking out, ¥560–680, plus carbonara and omurice at lunch and Uji teas. Order by QR upstairs, overlooking a small garden. One diner missed syrup for the drinks. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 20 February 2023 (Tabelog). The official site describes a cheese-sweets speciality shop with cheesecakes "as if jumped out of a picture book", fluffy yet light, in a café with Showa-era nostalgia and the feel of an old Kyoto house. It sells online and at department-store events (a September 2026 diner found it at Shinjuku Takashimaya). Reviewers in 2026 note cheese-themed decor, shovel-shaped spoons, a garden view upstairs, and polite staff.
chef_bio.specialty: 口福のチーズケーキ (the mouse cheesecake).

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "as soon as I poured the cream cheese sauce over it, the face melted away."
"There were no syrups or sugars available, and as someone with a sweet tooth, I wished I could add some syrup to my drink..." — June 2026.
A local worker waited until the opening queues died down: "I thought it was just a cake shop, but they also serve as a cafe!" (July 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (karucha.jp): 菓る茶 (KARUCHA)、チーズスイーツ専門店、絵本から飛び出したような可愛いチーズケーキ、ふんわりと濃厚ながらさっぱり、京民家の風情と昭和の懐かしさのカフェ、口福のチーズケーキ 650円 (持ち帰り560円)、ショコラ670円、いちご650円、抹茶680円、オトンヌ (秋季限定) 590円、ベイクドチーズケーキ510円、ガトーショコラフロマージュ550円、濃厚チーズカルボナーラなどパスタ1,250〜1,350円、とろとろデミチーズのオムライス1,350円、ケーキ+ドリンクセット+750円、京都宇治の和紅茶・玄米茶・ほうじ茶・抹茶ラテ・ほうじ茶ラテ550〜680円、コーヒー500円〜、模倣品に注意 (公式オンラインショップ・店舗・百貨店催事のみで販売)、中京区松屋町51、水曜休み、テイクアウト10:00〜19:00、カフェ10:00〜19:00 (18:30 L.O.)、烏丸御池駅から徒歩約6分、駐車場・駐輪場なし。食べログ: カフェ、予約可、禁煙、子供可、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー・QR可、2023年2月20日オープン。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 2階の町家のイートイン、スマホでQR注文、ネズミのチョコ、スコップ型のスプーン、庭が見える、シロップがない、サブレ600円、新宿高島屋の催事。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code on your phone upstairs.

places.name: 祇園 おくおか (Gion Okuoka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Udon and somen are wheat; yudofu, simmered sea bream, sukiyaki and hot pots come with soy-based broths and sauces (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and there is yudofu, but broths are likely dashi-based (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; dinner courses about ¥10,000, and portions were lightened on request (July 2026 review). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし" (its English says a service fee is added). 34 seats at sunken-kotatsu and tatami tables; the 2nd floor takes parties of up to 25; one reviewer describes a basement room with a counter (October 2025). Designated smoking area. Children welcome. Cards, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). In a machiya on the main road in front of the Higashiyama Yasui bus stop, between Gion and Kiyomizu-dera (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama Yasui bus stop, between Gion and Kiyomizu-dera
places.cuisine: Kyoto set meals (gozen) with three small side dishes, pickles and clear soup: yudofu with obanzai, simmered sea bream with vegetables, Kyoto-style beef sukiyaki with white miso, eel hot pot, oyster-and-egg hot pot in winter; summer sudachi udon or soba, cold and thin; the house "Matoi Nabe" of rare beef cuts; sashimi, fresh yuba, takikomi gohan; a three-sake tasting set and Kyoto sake (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Kyoto set meals & yudofu · Higashiyama Yasui] A calm machiya on the road between Gion and Kiyomizu-dera, with sunken-kotatsu seats: yudofu or simmered sea bream sets with obanzai, white-miso sukiyaki, and in summer a cold sudachi udon floating with citrus slices. Lunch about ¥1,500–3,500; dinner courses about ¥10,000. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: Kyoto cuisine in a traditional townhouse with a garden view; Kyoto and regional sake.
chef_bio.specialty: Yudofu set meals; sudachi udon.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 lunch guest asking the way was kindly helped by staff.
An October 2025 group found service slow that day, which left time to talk over the trip.
Two women on a ¥10,000 course in July 2026 asked for lighter portions; the unfinished pot rice was packed to take away.
An April 2026 repeat diner found the simmered sea bream a little salty.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 祇園 おくおか、日本料理・豆腐料理・うどん、東山区東大路毘沙門町44-66、東山安井バス停前、12:00〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、火曜休み、予約可、サービス料: なし、34席 (掘りごたつと座敷)、2階は25名まで、分煙、子供可、カード・PayPay・Alipay・WeChat Pay 可、町家、京白味噌のすき焼き、湯豆腐、Matoi Nabe、京都の地酒。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年8月、英語): 小鉢3品・漬物・お吸い物付きの御膳、おばんざいと湯豆腐、鯛のあら炊き、鰻の鍋、冬の牡蠣と卵の鍋、夏のすだちうどん・すだちそば、生湯葉、利き酒3種、1万円のコース、鯛が少し塩辛いという声、提供が遅かったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off for tatami and kotatsu seats; set meals easy to order.

places.name: 韓屋 具っさんとこ (Kanya Gussan Toko)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Chijimi and noodles are wheat; gukbap is rice in pork-bone broth seasoned at the table with gochujang and miso, which can contain wheat (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone soup, bossam, chicken and seafood dishes (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Wed 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); Fri–Sun 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Thursday, with occasional irregular days (Tabelog). Lunch is gukbap only and ends when it sells out (April 2026 review). Book for dinner — walk-ins were turned away on a full night (December 2025 review). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats, shared tables at lunch; non-smoking (Tabelog; April 2026 review). One cook in the kitchen, so dishes take time — one July 2026 diner waited about an hour (2025–26 reviews). North of Gojo; 350 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: North of Gojo — 6 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Korean home cooking: lunch is daeji gukbap — unsalted pork-bone soup with pork belly and shank, seasoned at the table with chive kimchi, gochujang, dried shrimp and miso, with rice or somen and seaweed namul, corn tea free; at night bossam, chijimi (tendon or oyster) from an iron pan, japchae, tteokbokki, bibim noodles, dakhanmari, dak-galbi, kimchi platter, makgeolli (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Korean home cooking · north of Gojo] A small, warm family-run Korean kitchen: at lunch only daeji gukbap, a pork-bone soup you season yourself; at night bossam, crisp chijimi from the iron pan, japchae and makgeolli. About ¥1,500 at lunch, ¥4,000–5,000 at night. One cook, so expect a wait; book dinner; cash only. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the owner explaining how to season the gukbap (September 2025), a single cook in the kitchen (December 2025), and "the kind mother, sister, and the chef" at work (July 2026). Featured on TV in 2025 (September 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Dwaeji gukbap; bossam; chijimi.

anecdotes.text: When the lunch dish came, the owner apologised for the wait — September 2025.
A diner who lives near Shin-Okubo apologised for doubting Korean food in Kyoto; five ate for just over ¥20,000 — December 2025.
Warned in advance that the one-person kitchen was slow, a December 2025 table waited comfortably and got crispy rice candy at the end.
An October 2025 regular on a third visit said the trip to Kyoto was for this restaurant alone.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 韓屋 具っさんとこ、韓国料理、下京区富小路五条上ル本神明町406 コーポ大耋 1F、清水五条駅から353m、月火水 17:30〜23:00、金土日 11:30〜14:30・18:00〜23:00、木曜休み (不定休あり)、予約可、20席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年7月、英語): 昼はテジクッパのみ (豚骨の無塩スープにニラキムチ、コチュジャン、干しエビ、味噌で味付け、ご飯かそうめん)、とうもろこし茶、ポッサム、すじやカキのチヂミ、チャプチェ、トッポッキ、ビビン麺、タッカンマリ、タッカルビ、キムチ盛り合わせ、マッコリ、厨房は一人で提供に時間がかかる、満席で飛び込み客を断る日も、テレビで紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain how to season the gukbap; cash only.

places.name: SALAO
places.gf_detail: Ask. The chicken rice is pilaf stuffed in a whole chicken, but sauces (demi-glace, cream, curry) and fried shrimp likely contain wheat (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken, hamburg steak, fish and liver pâté (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–16:00 (last order 15:00) and 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Monday (holidays too) and the 1st and 3rd Sunday (Tabelog). Tabelog also says last orders are 10 minutes before closing — 14:50 and 19:50. Online bookings for dinner only, none after 19:30; at lunch, write your name on the waiting list — about 40 minutes in July 2026 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog; June 2026 review). Prices include tax, no service charge (October 2026 review). 24 seats, tables only, on two floors; ring the bell at the top of the stairs to order (Tabelog; August 2026 review). Children welcome with notice; no car or bicycle parking (Tabelog). On Nijo-dori; 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo-dori — 7 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood yoshoku bistro: the signature "adult chicken rice" — a whole chicken, crisp-skinned, stuffed with pilaf or garlic rice — with a choice of six sauces (mild or bitter demi-glace, tomato-basil, onion-truffle, curry, a monthly sauce such as mushroom cream), lunch with salad ¥1,650; cheese or foie gras toppings; hamburg steak and fried shrimp plate; petite course ¥2,750 with liver pâté, soup, main, ice cream and coffee; dinner courses with sawara; Heartland beer ¥880; anniversary whole cakes by the pastry chef (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Yoshoku bistro · Nijo-dori near City Hall] A small two-floor bistro with a cat on its sign, famous for its "adult chicken rice": a whole crisp chicken stuffed with pilaf, with your pick of six sauces (¥1,650 at lunch, with salad). Lunch queues are common — leave your name and wander. Cash only; closed Monday and the 1st and 3rd Sunday.

roles: Operator unnamed; a pastry chef makes the celebration cakes (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog's shop text says it relocated in 2023; its listed opening day is 25 March 2024. Reviewers knew it near the City Hall before the move (August and October 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Adult chicken rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 diner found the tables close together and conversation hard with loud customers nearby.
Ordering the bitter demi-glace in October 2026, a guest was warned it is "a unique sauce that divides opinions"; the chicken took thirty minutes.
An August 2026 diner noted the cat silhouette on the sign and cat figurines inside, and a bell at the top of the stairs to call for orders.
A July 2026 walk-in wrote a name on the list, strolled the neighbourhood and waited about forty minutes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): SALAO、ビストロ・カフェ・洋食、中京区二条通柳馬場東入晴明町667-2、京都市役所前駅から徒歩7分、11:30〜16:00・17:30〜21:00、月曜 (祝日含む) と第1・第3日曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、24席 (テーブルのみ)、子供可 (要連絡)、2023年移転、オープン日2024年3月25日、看板の「大人のチキンライス」、パティシエのホールケーキ付き記念日プラン、ネット予約はディナーのみ。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 鶏一羽にピラフを詰めたチキンライス、ソース6種、ランチ1,650円、プチコース2,750円、ハートランド880円、税込みでサービス料なし、2階の階段上のベル、猫の看板、昼は記名して約40分待ち、席が近く隣がうるさいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff suggest a sauce for first-timers; cash only.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter croissants, cream buns, cheese and meat fillings; plain baguettes may be the exception — ask (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Fri–Sun 8:00–17:00; closed Mon–Thu; hours may change (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Take-away; the shop fits two or three customers at a time, with a bench out front (August 2026 reviews). No cards; d Barai per Tabelog, and a May 2026 reviewer paid with PayPay. Weekend queues are common; a Friday before 9:00 was empty (July 2026 review). In a residential lane behind Rokuharamitsu-ji, 8–10 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Behind Rokuharamitsu-ji — 8–10 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Small neighbourhood bakery of classic breads: croissant ¥300 and salt-butter roll ¥180 (May 2026), chocolate-coated Danish bars ¥315 for three, garlic toast and egg sandwich ¥630 (May 2026), passion-fruit milk bun ¥300, cream bun, melon bread (August 2026), croque monsieur with béchamel and meat sauce, curry bread, cheese bread with bacon and dried tomato, half baguettes and sticks (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bakery · behind Rokuharamitsu-ji] A tiny weekend-only bakery in the lanes between Kiyomizu and Gojo: flaky croissants, salt-butter rolls, chocolate Danish bars, passion-fruit cream buns, croque monsieur and baguettes, mostly ¥200–600. Fri–Sun from 8:00; expect a short queue; take away.

chef_bio.background: Opened 13 September 2018 after a three-day pre-opening (Tabelog). Featured on the TV show "Seven Rules" (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Croissants and classic breads.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor walking down from the Gojozaka bus stop found no queue before 9:00 on a Friday; staff said that happens when you are lucky.
A croissant enthusiast in May 2026 called it a fine classic croissant but not one to return for.
An August 2026 visitor ate a croissant and salt bread on the bench outside straight away.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ニッタベーカリー (Nitta_Bakery)、パン、東山区六波羅南東入多門町158-4、清水五条駅から516m、金土日 8:00〜17:00、月〜木休み、予約不可、カード不可、d払い可、2018年9月13日オープン (9月9〜11日プレオープン)。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): クロワッサン300円、塩バターパン180円、チョコのデニッシュバー3本315円、ガーリックトーストと玉子サンド630円、パッションフルーツミルク300円、クリームパン、メロンパン、クロックムッシュ、カレーパン、チーズのパン、ハーフのバゲット、Rokuharamitsu-ji の裏の住宅街、店は2〜3人で一杯、店先のベンチ、週末は行列、PayPay 可という声、テレビ「Seven Rules」で紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the breads; take-away.

places.name: スマイルバーガー 清水寺店 (Smile Burger Kiyomizudera)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every burger comes in a soft white bun (2023–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef and chicken burgers with cheese and bacon options (2022–26 reviews). No vegan information.
places.hours_raw: 11:00–20:00; closed Tuesday, with irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). One-drink minimum for eating in, from ¥300 (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money (Tabelog). 9 seats: 6 at tables and a sofa for 2–3 (Tabelog). Smoking outside the shop (May 2022). On Higashioji near the foot of Kiyomizu-zaka (March 2024); 2–3 min from the Gojozaka or Kiyomizu-michi bus stops (Tabelog). Lunch queues on busy days (August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Higashioji below Kiyomizu-zaka — 2–3 min from Gojozaka bus stop
places.cuisine: Big American-style burgers in a soft, chewy white bun, patties grilled after you order, served with potato chips and pickles rather than fries (2020–26 reviews) · teriyaki burger with chips ¥1,300, Coke ¥300 (March 2024) · Smile cheeseburger ¥1,450 (November 2024) · salsa burger (August and October 2023), teriyaki chicken burger (November 2024), bacon cheeseburger (January 2025), the Quattro burger (March 2024) · canned soft drinks, drip coffee (2023–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Burgers · Higashioji by Kiyomizu-zaka, a break from Japanese food] A nine-seat burger shop on the bus route to Kiyomizu-dera, open since 2008, its shelves lined with miniature cars. Thick patties grilled to order in a soft white bun, with potato chips and pickles; most burgers run ¥1,300–1,450, plus one drink each. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per a March 2024 review: opened in 2008 and run by the local design company Kyoto Shokunin Katagi. A January 2025 diner thought it was run by a couple; an August 2026 diner found one man working alone.
chef_bio.specialty: Burgers in a white bun; salsa and teriyaki burgers.

anecdotes.text: A June 2020 diner called it the best-tasting of all the gourmet burgers tried, and a relief for anyone tired of Japanese food in Kyoto.
An October 2023 passer-by was drawn in by the smell of grilling meat, though missed having fries instead of chips.
An August 2026 diner shared the room with a foreign couple and then a group of six from overseas at the bench table in the middle.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ハンバーガー・カフェ・アメリカ料理、東山区清水4-188-1、五条坂・清水道バス停から徒歩2〜3分、11:00〜20:00、火曜休み (不定休あり)、予約可、店内はワンドリンク制 (300円から)、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、9席。口コミ (2020年6月〜2026年8月、英語): 白いバンズ、注文後に焼くパティ、ポテトチップスとピクルス付き、照り焼きバーガー1,300円、スマイルチーズバーガー1,450円、サルサバーガー、ミニカーの棚、2008年開店、地元のデザイン会社の経営 (2024年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Order a burger and a drink at the table; many overseas visitors (August 2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: そのば (Sonoba)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The soba is juwari, 100% buckwheat milled in-house (Michelin Guide; July 2026 review), but the dipping sauce and broths are soy-based and the menu has sushi and dashimaki. No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba served in dashi broths and dipping sauce (July 2026), with herring, duck, hamo and fish sushi on the menu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–15:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday (Tabelog). The Michelin Guide lists Saturday and Sunday to 17:00. No reservations (Tabelog); order and pay at the entrance before sitting at two large shared tables (October 2026). Queues are usual: five waiting before opening on a weekday, 30 min to an hour on summer weekends (July 2026), 15–20 min in September 2026. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 14 seats (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). On Tominokoji north of Rokujo; 407 m from Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 7 July 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Tominokoji north of Rokujo — 407 m from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Handmade juwari soba of buckwheat milled in-house, served on tableware the owner makes; the cold mori soba is the signature, and a seasonal soba changes monthly (Michelin Guide) · July’s chilled soba with hamo in a Manganji pepper broth with umeboshi (July 2026) · sudachi soba ¥2,100 (August 2026), duck dipping soba, walnut mazesoba (September and October 2026), nishin soba (June 2026) · bonito sushi, saba sushi, aji bo-zushi — saba can sell out (June–October 2026) · dashimaki omelette; drinks at lunchtime (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Soba · Gojo Tominokoji, juwari soba on the owner’s own pottery] A bright, renovated room where the owner — soba maker and potter — serves 100% buckwheat soba milled in-house on plates from the studio, with a monthly seasonal bowl and sides of bonito or saba sushi. In the Michelin Guide, and reviewers call it a Bib Gourmand. Expect a queue; order and pay at the door. One July 2026 diner found the noodles clumpy and the soba-yu lukewarm. Lunch only; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), a soba maker who also makes pottery (Michelin Guide)
chef_bio.background: Per the Michelin Guide: the proprietor is a soba craftsman who makes pottery, mills buckwheat in-house for handmade juwari soba, serves it on tableware of the owner’s own making, and designed the industrial-style interior with recycled materials. Reviewers (June–August 2026) call it a Michelin Bib Gourmand, and mention a pottery space where visitors can try making pottery (August 2026). Opened 7 July 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Juwari mori soba; monthly seasonal soba; bonito sushi.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner came for the soba and left raving about the bonito sushi, wanting a whole roll to take home.
A July 2026 diner noticed reggae playing and a staff vibe unlike a usual soba shop.
A July 2026 diner found the soba weak in aroma and clumpy, the wasabi ordinary and the soba-yu lukewarm, though the dipping sauce was well balanced.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: そば、下京区富小路六条上る本塩竈町533-3、五条駅から407m、11:30〜15:00、水木休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、14席、子供可、2023年7月7日オープン。Michelin Guide (英語): 店主は蕎麦職人で陶芸家、自家製粉の手打ち十割蕎麦を自作の器で、もり蕎麦が看板、月替わりの季節の蕎麦、店主が設計した再生素材の内装。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): ビブグルマン、鱧と Manganji の唐辛子の冷たい蕎麦、すだち蕎麦2,100円、鴨のつけ蕎麦、くるみのまぜそば、にしん蕎麦、鰹の寿司、鯖寿司、鯵の棒寿司、だし巻き、入口で注文と会計、大きな相席のテーブル2つ、行列、陶芸体験。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue, then order and pay at the entrance; shared tables. More than half the guests were from overseas (July 2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: ドミニク・ブシェ・キョート・ル・レストラン (Dominique Bouchet Kyoto Le Restaurant)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Classic French courses with sauces, bread and pastry desserts (2025–26 reviews); the hotel publishes a food-allergy guide on the restaurant page. No gluten information found.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Butter sauces and seafood and meat courses (2025–26 reviews); a vegetable course dish appears ("Vegetable Symphony", February and March 2025), but no vegan information.
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:00–22:00 (last entry 20:00); closed Wednesday except holidays (hotel page; Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Lunch from ¥10,000, dinner from ¥20,000, tax and service included (hotel page); service charge 15% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「15%」). Cards (incl. UnionPay), Suica-type e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 54 seats and private rooms; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). No children below elementary-school age except in private rooms; jackets recommended for men (Tabelog). On the 3rd floor of The Westin Miyako Kyoto, 2 min from Keage Stn; free hotel bus from Kyoto Stn Hachijo exit (Tabelog). Opened 27 November 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Keage, in The Westin Miyako Kyoto — 2 min from Keage Stn
places.cuisine: French cuisine supervised by Dominique Bouchet, who holds a Michelin star in Tokyo, cooked by chef 左古 昂 as an "evolved classic" of Japanese ingredients and French technique, with light, deep sauces and a cellar of about 300 wines (hotel page) · lunch courses from ¥10,000 such as HARMONIE — corn from Murata Farm, lobster Parmentier with caviar butter, Kyoto sea bass with Basque sauce, braised oxtail with truffle mash (June 2026); weekday course SOLEIL (hotel page) · dinner from ¥20,000; the Heritage course with blue lobster jelly, sea urchin and caviar (April 2026) · abalone Rossini, Kamiseya venison, a winter vegetable "symphony" (February 2025) · à la carte at lunch; a dessert wagon (November 2025)
places.notes: [French · Keage, Dominique Bouchet’s dining room in The Westin Miyako] The Westin Miyako’s main French restaurant, supervised by the Paris chef Dominique Bouchet and run by chef 左古 昂: blue lobster jelly with sea urchin and caviar, lobster Parmentier in caviar butter, sauces that are rich but light, a dessert wagon and city views. Lunch from ¥10,000, dinner from ¥20,000 including service. Reviewers find drinks and water pricey. No young children; jacket suggested. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the hotel page: Dominique Bouchet was chef at La Tour d’Argent and Hôtel de Crillon in Paris, opened Restaurant Dominique Bouchet in Paris’s 8th arrondissement in 2004, and besides Kyoto runs Dominique Bouchet Tokyo in Ginza and the bistro Les Copains de Dominique Bouchet. Chef 左古 昂 trained at Dominique Bouchet Tokyo in Ginza before coming to Kyoto, and has led this kitchen since April 2022. An April 2026 reviewer calls the chef Sako. The same hotel houses Dominique Bouchet Kyoto Le Teppanyaki.
chef_bio.philosophy: An "evolved classic": carefully chosen Japanese ingredients with traditional French technique, and sauces that are "deep yet light" (hotel page).
chef_bio.specialty: Blue lobster jelly with sea urchin and caviar; lobster Parmentier.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner found the wine fairly priced for a luxury hotel and the 15% service charge stiff, and noted guests in T-shirts admitted despite the jacket advice.
A January 2026 regular felt the signature blue lobster had become smaller than before.
A June 2025 diner on a third visit asked ahead for Beluga caviar and finished with a choice from a wide range of teas.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ホテルのページ: 東京でミシュラン一つ星のドミニク・ブシェ監修のフレンチ、左古シェフ (左古 昂、2022年4月から、銀座の Dominique Bouchet Tokyo で研修)、"進化形クラシック"、「味わい深いのに軽やか」なソース、約300種のカーヴ、ランチ11:30〜14:30、ディナー17:00〜22:00 (最終入店20:00)、水曜休み (祝日を除く)、ランチ10,000円〜、ディナー20,000円〜 (税・サービス料込み)、平日限定コース「SOLEIL」、食物アレルギー対応のご案内。食べログ: フレンチ、東山区粟田口華頂町1、蹴上駅から徒歩2分、ウェスティン都ホテル京都3階、サービス料15%、54席、個室、未就学児不可 (個室は可)、男性はジャケット推奨、2019年11月27日オープン。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年7月、英語): ブルーオマールのジュレとウニとキャビア、オマールのパルマンティエ、デザートワゴン、飲み物と水が高い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course; staff explain each dish (January 2025). Jacket suggested for men; no children under elementary age except in private rooms. No English evidence found.

places.name: 遊亀 祇園店 (Yuki Gion)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: vegetable tempura, corn kakiage, fried nama-fu (wheat gluten), nanban-zuke (2026 reviews); soy sauce throughout.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and sake izakaya — sashimi, hamo, dashimaki, oden in dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 16:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, and advised at dinner (June 2026); reservations taken until 19:00 (March 2026). Table charge ¥440 per person (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「440円（税込）」; an appetizer, ¥430 in September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay, no e-money (Tabelog). 58 seats at a counter downstairs and tatami upstairs; non-smoking, smoking area outside (Tabelog). Children and strollers welcome, second floor only (Tabelog). 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 16 December 2009 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, north of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Sake straight from the Shiga brewery Okamura Honke — its 金亀 range poured by rice-polishing ratio from 20% to 90% — with fresh fish at everyday prices (Tabelog, shop text; June and September 2026) · seasonal sake ¥660, hamo bone crackers ¥418, bluefin chutoro ¥1,309, oden ¥209, whelk ¥594 (September 2026) · hamo sashimi, flatfish sashimi, grilled bamboo shoots (April and July 2026) · fried nama-fu, dashimaki, grilled chicken neck, vegetable tempura (April 2026) · saba sushi with ginger and shiso, nanban-zuke (June 2026) · simmered chicken liver, corn tempura, grilled ayu (August 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Gion, a sake brewer’s own bar] A busy two-floor izakaya in Gion run by the Shiga brewer Okamura Honke, pouring its 金亀 sake by polishing ratio — taste the 60% against the 70% — alongside hamo, sashimi, dashimaki and fried nama-fu at prices reviewers call fair for Gion. Many overseas guests; book for dinner. ¥440 table charge. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), trained at a well-known Kyoto restaurant (Tabelog, shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): an izakaya run directly by Okamura Honke, the Shiga sake brewery, serving its sake and fresh fish; the owner trained at a famous Kyoto restaurant. The brewery’s site (kin-kame.co.jp) describes 株式会社 岡村本家 of Toyosato, Shiga, founded in 安政元年 and maker of 金亀 and 大星, and lists the restaurants that pour its sake. A June 2026 review calls the shop a former direct operation of the brewery. Opened 16 December 2009 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: The brewery’s sake by polishing ratio; hamo; fresh fish.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 sake novice compared the 60% (dry) and 70% (rich) and could clearly taste the difference.
A regular on a 13th visit in July 2026 ordered flatfish sashimi and was surprised by the generous portion.
An August 2026 diner found the downstairs counter narrow and not very clean, and staff slow to grasp questions, but every dish beat expectations.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮、東山区富永町111-1、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、16:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、火曜休み、予約可、440円（税込）、カード・QR 可、58席 (カウンター、座敷)、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、子供は2階のみ、2009年12月16日オープン、店の紹介 (英訳): 滋賀の酒蔵 岡村本家の直営、蔵直送の酒と新鮮な魚、京都の名店で修業した店主。岡村本家のサイト: 滋賀県豊郷町、創業安政元年、金亀・大星。口コミ (2026年3月〜11月、英語): 精米歩合20〜90%の飲み比べ、季節の酒660円、鱧の骨せんべい418円、本鮪中トロ1,309円、おでん、バイ貝、鱧の刺身、生麩の揚げ物、だし巻き、鯖寿司、外国人の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter downstairs, tatami upstairs; sake listed by polishing ratio, so check prices (September 2026). Many overseas guests, but one August 2026 diner found staff slow to grasp questions. No English evidence found.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tarako (cod roe) spaghetti with butter or cream, chicken curry, Spanish omelette and desserts (2026 reviews).

places.cuisine: Café and trattoria with vegetable-filled set meals and à la carte (Tabelog) · tarako spaghetti set ¥1,600: cod roe spaghetti with green and red shiso and a hint of lemon, with salad, soup (e.g. butternut squash), a Spanish omelette and focaccia; large size +¥300 (July–September 2026) · spice chicken curry set (August 2026) · dinner à la carte: caprese, prosciutto with peaches, scallop Genovese, tomato-mozzarella pasta, acqua pazza, tagliata (July 2026) · tiramisu and other desserts, soft-serve, baked goods to take away; bottled tarako sauce for sale (2026 reviews) · lunch ¥1,000–2,000, dinner about ¥6,000–8,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Café-trattoria · Teramachi Nijo, tarako spaghetti] A bright, family-friendly café-trattoria on Teramachi known for its tarako spaghetti set: creamy cod roe pasta under green and red shiso, with salad, soup, Spanish omelette and focaccia, ¥1,600. The owner pours out the stories of a November 2025 visit by the TV show "Sekkaku Gourmet". Desserts and takeaway sweets by day, a short Italian à la carte by night. Book for weekend lunch. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who also handles the dinner service alone on some nights (July 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 25 September 2019, offering set meals full of vegetables and à la carte; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 say the restaurant was featured in Banana Man's "Sekkaku Gourmet" (broadcast 9 November 2025), where Himura of Banana Man ate the tarako spaghetti set; a signed photo hangs inside (July–September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Tarako spaghetti.

anecdotes.text: Himura of the comedy duo Banana Man ate the tarako spaghetti set on "Sekkaku Gourmet" (aired 9 November 2025); a July 2026 fan who came for the same set was offered a photo with Himura's signed picture by the owner.
A July 2026 dinner guest noted that the dishes came at a good pace "even with just one person handling it".
A November 2026 regular, hooked since a first visit a year before after seeing the show, was tempted by the daily special but chose the tarako spaghetti again.

places.name: node (node hotel)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog notes allergy information is available; the menu has pasta, bread and cakes alongside carpaccio, roast beef and steak (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and a focus on vegetables, but the dishes reviewers name use Omi beef, fish, anchovy or dairy (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 7:30–23:00 (food last order 22:00); breakfast 7:30–10:00 by reservation, lunch 11:30–15:00, café 15:00–17:00, dinner and bar 17:00–23:00; closed on irregular days (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog original チャージ料なし). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). 37 seats with counter and sofas; non-smoking, with a smoking room; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; private hire for over 50 (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). On the ground floor of the node hotel, entered past the lobby; Nishinotoin north of Shijo; 6 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog; March and July 2026).
places.neighborhood: Nishinotoin north of Shijo, node hotel 1F — 6 min walk from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Café, dining and bar of the node hotel, themed "Art Close to You", with farm-to-table dishes from Kyoto ingredients (January 2026) · lunch from ¥2,000 with salad and soup: roast beef bowl, seasonal pasta, fish of the day, hamburg steak; set drink +¥300 (February–October 2026) · dinner: fish carpaccio with anchovy vinaigrette ¥1,960, Omi beef roast beef salad ¥2,200, Omi beef Bolognese ¥2,200, Omi beef sirloin cap steak ¥4,180 (January 2026) · cakes, tarts and fondant chocolate at café time; sake, shochu, wine and cocktails (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · about ¥1,000–4,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Hotel café-bar · Nishinotoin Shijo, art all around] The all-day lounge of the node hotel, hung with large modern paintings and set to jazz: weekday-friendly lunches from ¥2,000 (hamburg steak, pasta, fish of the day, roast-beef bowl, with salad and soup), cakes in the afternoon, and Omi beef, carpaccio and cocktails at night. Most praise the food; one June 2026 guest found the fish tired, and one regular finds the staff a little cool. Open daily to 23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the café, bar and Italian dining of the node hotel, offering art and food in an extraordinary space, with breakfast, lunch, café and dinner; registered as an official listing by the operator. A January 2026 reviewer describes the hotel concept "Art Close to You" and a farm-to-table menu of seasonal Kyoto ingredients, with fish chosen daily by the chef.
chef_bio.philosophy: Farm to table with seasonal Kyoto ingredients (January 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Omi beef dishes; pasta lunch.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular was unsure at first because the hotel lobby is right at the entrance, but went in on the strength of the sign outside and has been coming back often since.
An October 2026 couple, chatting under the art over hamburg steak and pasta, found the chef and staff so friendly that the visit ran longer than planned.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・バー・イタリアン、中京区西洞院四条上ル蟷螂山町461、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩6分、毎日 7:30〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00)、朝食7:30〜10:00 (要予約)、ランチ11:30〜15:00、カフェ15:00〜17:00、ディナー&バー17:00〜23:00、不定休、チャージ料なし、予約可、37席、禁煙 (喫煙室あり)、車椅子可、Wi-Fi、カード・PayPay 可、ホテルのレストラン、野菜にこだわる、アレルギー表示あり、ベジタリアン対応のメニューあり、アートと料理の非日常の空間。口コミ (2026年1月〜10月、英語): ホテルの1階、「Art Close to You」のコンセプト、京都の旬の食材のファーム・トゥ・テーブル、鮮魚のカルパッチョ1,960円、近江牛のローストビーフサラダ2,200円、近江牛のボロネーゼ2,200円、近江牛のステーキ4,180円、ランチ2,000円から (ローストビーフ丼、季節のパスタ、魚料理、ハンバーグ)、ドリンク+300円、ケーキ、タルト、フォンダンショコラ、ジャズ、大きな現代アート、魚がいまひとつとの声 (2026年6月)、スタッフはややクール。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel lounge; walk in past the lobby; book breakfast; cards and PayPay.

positives: Tabelog lists allergy information available and vegetarian options (Tabelog).

places.name: Etto
places.gf_detail: Not GF: the restaurant states it offers no gluten-free menu (Tabelog); the course includes two pastas, bread and grissini (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the restaurant states it offers no vegan or vegetarian menu (Tabelog); a set course of fish, foie gras and wagyu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Saturday and holidays 18:00–22:30 (one 18:00 or 18:30 simultaneous start); Sunday lunch 11:30–14:30 and dinner from 18:30; closed Wednesday and twice a month on irregular days (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Reservation only; no vegan, vegetarian or gluten-free menus (Tabelog). A 10% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料10％), on top of the ¥13,200 omakase course, tax included (October 2026). 8 counter seats with an open kitchen; private use possible; non-smoking; bicycle parking on request (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Down a long stone path in a quiet residential lane west of the Kyoto Prefectural Office; 10–15 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 22 August 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: West of the Kyoto Prefectural Office, a townhouse down a stone path — 10–15 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Innovative Italian omakase at an eight-seat counter, Japanese ingredients through Italian technique (2026 reviews) · one course, ¥13,200 at lunch or dinner, changing every two months; wine pairing to ¥24,800 in total (August–October 2026) · e.g. fried ginkgo-and-pistachio gnocchi with house karasumi; sweet shrimp with Genovese and finger lime; foie-gras ice cream with plum and hozuki in a tart; peanut sformato with anago; beef-cheek squid-ink grissini with autumn truffle; bagna cauda poured as a soup over autumn vegetables (September–October 2026) · two pastas, e.g. cold whole-wheat bavettini with Rishiri uni and Senshu eggplant, egg tagliatelle with chestnuts or a ragù; charcoal-grilled akou with new-ginger risotto; Nagano sirloin cap (September–October 2026) · about 350 wines, mostly Italian (October 2026) · ¥15,000–20,000 with drinks (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Italian omakase · west of the Prefectural Office, hidden townhouse counter] Down a long stone path to a renovated townhouse with a small garden: eight seats at a flat counter where two cooks handle all the cooking and service for one Italian omakase of Kyoto and Japanese produce — ginkgo gnocchi with karasumi, bagna cauda poured as soup, two pastas, charcoal-grilled fish and wagyu — for ¥13,200 plus 10% service. Reviewers in 2026 say it is listed in the Michelin Guide. No vegan, vegetarian or gluten-free menus. Reservation only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 22 August 2024, a reservation-only eight-seat counter. A September 2026 reviewer names the chef as Seiya Tatsumi, who trained for many years at the Italian restaurant RADICE; reviewers in 2026 say the restaurant is listed in the Michelin Guide Kyoto-Osaka for a second year, and that the name means "small" in Italian (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Japanese ingredients transformed with Italian technique (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase with two pastas; bagna cauda soup.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 guest wrote that two good-looking men handle all the cooking and service, and that the pairing of a Shiraz appassimento with the smoked sirloin cap was the high point.
A September 2026 diner was shown the bread both before and after baking, then served it fresh from the oven mid-course.
Toward the end of the course the staff checked how full each guest was so portions could be adjusted, and tea sweets could be taken home — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・イノベーティブ、上京区大黒屋町47、地下鉄丸太町駅から徒歩10分、月・火・木〜土・祝 18:00〜22:30、日 11:30〜14:30・18:30〜21:30、水曜と月2回の不定休、完全予約制、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーのメニューはない、サービス料10%、8席、個室あり、貸切可、禁煙、自転車置き場、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、2024年8月22日オープン。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 京都府庁の西の住宅街、長い石畳の先の町家、庭、8席のカウンター、おまかせのコース13,200円 (昼も夜も)、2か月ごとに替わる、ワインペアリング込み24,800円、銀杏とピスタチオのニョッキに自家製のからすみ、甘海老、ほおずきとフォアグラのアイス、穴子と落花生のスフォルマート、トリュフ、バーニャカウダのスープ、2種のパスタ (利尻の雲丹と泉州の茄子の冷製、栗のタリアテッレ)、あこうの炭火焼き、長野の牛、ワイン約350本、シェフは Seiya Tatsumi (RADICE で長く修業)、ミシュランガイドに掲載との声。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; one simultaneous-start course; dishes explained; 10% service; cards.

places.name: ラニオン (Lannion)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses of terrine, soup, fish and meat with homemade bread, choux and pastry desserts; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: French courses of fish, pork, beef and chicken with butter and cream desserts (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday, Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday: lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 18:00–21:30 (last order 19:30); closed Monday, Thursday and Friday; hours may change (Tabelog). Dinner by reservation; no children below elementary school age (Tabelog remarks). 20 seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards: AMEX listed; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 1F of Capital Villa Marutamachi, east of Kawabata Marutamachi on the south side; 2 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2025). Opened 4 November 2005 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawabata Marutamachi, east side — 2 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Classic French courses at good value in a cosy, picture-hung room with white tablecloths (2023–2026 reviews) · lunch courses such as Déjeuner B ¥4,500 with fish, meat, dessert, homemade bread and coffee (June 2023) · Gruyère choux amuse-bouche, Kyoto chicken terrine, Kagoshima yokowa mi-cuit with a seasonal salad, vegetable soups, pan-fried rockfish or sea bass, herb-crusted Aichi pork tenderloin with braised cheek, steak (2025–2026 reviews) · desserts: apple mille-feuille, crème caramel with caramel ice cream, strawberry and lime, meringues with coffee (2025–2026 reviews) · lunch ¥3,000–4,000, dinner ¥8,000–10,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [French · Kawabata Marutamachi, couple-run since 2005] A cosy French restaurant near the Kamo River, run by a warm owner couple since 2005: white tablecloths, paintings, and generous, light classic courses — a Gruyère choux to start, terrine, vegetable soup, fish from Awaji or Aomori, Aichi pork two ways, crème caramel — with homemade bread and fairly priced wine. Lunch is the bargain and fills with regulars. Dinner by reservation; no young children. Open Tuesday, Wednesday and weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 4 November 2005; dinner by reservation, no children below elementary age. Reviewers say the name comes from a town in Brittany (June 2023), that the owner couple greet guests warmly (July 2026), and that the restaurant is often visited by Kyoto University professors, including Nobel laureates (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch course; Aichi pork two ways.

anecdotes.text: Asked in June 2023 about speaking fluent French, the owner laughed and said no.
A June 2026 reviewer calls it a place often visited by Kyoto University professors, including Nobel Prize winners.
A March 2026 party of four had the dishes chosen in advance by a guest who once worked with the owner's wife.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ、左京区川端丸太町東入 キャピタルヴィラ丸太町 1F、京阪神宮丸太町駅から徒歩2分、火・水・土・日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.13:30)・18:00〜21:30 (L.O.19:30)、月・木・金定休、予約可 (ディナーは要予約)、未就学児不可、20席、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可 (AMEX)、電子マネー・QR 不可、2005年11月4日オープン。口コミ (2023年6月〜2026年10月、英語): 店名はブルターニュの町の名、白いクロス、絵の飾られた温かい店内、ランチのコース (Déjeuner B 4,500円)、グリュイエールのシュー、京都の若鶏のテリーヌ、鹿児島の Yokowa のミキュイ、野菜のスープ、淡路や青森の魚のポワレ、愛知の豚のロースと頬肉、ステーキ、りんごのミルフィーユ、クレームキャラメルとキャラメルのアイス、メレンゲ、自家製パン、手頃なワイン、オーナー夫妻の温かい迎え、京大の教授やノーベル賞受賞者も訪れるとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book dinner ahead; no young children; set courses; AMEX listed.

places.name: ICHiMARU5
places.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-flour dango, but the mitarashi glaze and the soy-sauce dango use soy sauce, and the dorayaki is a wheat pancake; no ingredient list published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Dango with mitarashi glaze or bean paste may be plant-based, but no ingredient list is published; the dorayaki has matcha butter cream (March 2026).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00 daily (Tabelog; hours may change); a March 2026 reviewer visited in the evening on the way to a night opening of Kiyomizu-dera. No reservations (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog; June 2026). 10 seats: 6 at the counter, 4 at a table; an eat-in space and a photo spot (Tabelog; June 2026). Mostly eaten walking — dango served in cups (April 2026). On Gojozaka, the slope up to Kiyomizu-dera, about 1 km from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Gojozaka, on the slope up to Kiyomizu-dera
places.cuisine: Homemade dango to eat on the walk (April 2026) · large mitarashi dango ¥330, served warm or chilled (March and August 2026) · soy-sauce dango; bean-paste dango about ¥300; colourful dango (June 2026) · dorayaki with matcha butter cream ¥360 (March 2026) · Uji matcha drinks and matcha dango (March and May 2026)
places.notes: [Dango · Gojozaka, on the way to Kiyomizu-dera] A small, photogenic dango stand on the slope to Kiyomizu-dera: an oversized mitarashi dango (¥330, warm or chilled), soy-sauce and bean-paste dango in takeaway cups, matcha dorayaki and Uji matcha, with a few seats inside. Busy with school trips and tourists. PayPay or cash.

roles: Operated by OKAMOTO Co., Ltd. (per an April 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: An April 2026 reviewer writes that the business began in 1831 as an Okamoto textile shop and has run the kimono rental “Rental Kimono Okamoto” since 2004 under OKAMOTO Co., Ltd., and that ICHiMARU5 is its homemade-dango shop; another April 2026 reviewer says there is a main shop and a Kiyomizu-zaka branch. A March 2026 visitor found the room not very clean and wondered whether it was aimed at overseas guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Large mitarashi dango.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 couple chose the large mitarashi dango chilled on a hot day and shared it.
A May 2026 visitor with a sensitive tongue ate the piping-hot dango inside rather than on the street.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ICHiMARU5、和菓子、東山区五条橋東6-540-6、清水五条駅から966m、毎日10:00〜17:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル4)。口コミ (2026年): 清水寺への坂の手作り団子、大きなみたらし団子330円 (温かいか冷たいか選べる)、醤油団子、あんの団子約300円、抹茶バタークリームのどら焼き360円、宇治抹茶、カップ入りで食べ歩きしやすい、本店と Kiyomizu-zaka の店があるとの声、1831年に Okamoto Textile Shop として始まり、2004年から Rental Kimono Okamoto を営む株式会社OKAMOTO の店とのこと、夜は店内の清潔感がいまひとつとの声 (日本語の口コミ、2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Point-and-pay dango stand; eat-in seats; PayPay or cash. Popular with overseas visitors.

places.name: みくり 桑 (Mikuri Kuwa)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a fried-food kappo — panko-fried fish, menchi katsu, tonkatsu, Wagyu cutlet, crab-cream croquettes, fried bread with shrimp paste; homemade Worcester-style sauce (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, crab, pork and beef courses with dashi soups (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday dinner only 18:00–22:00 (food L.O. 20:30); Wednesday–Saturday lunch 11:30–14:00 (food L.O. 12:30) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:00, Saturday 20:30); Sunday and holidays lunch only; closed Monday, Sunday dinner and the third Sunday (Tabelog). Lunch by reservation only, courses only for seat bookings (official site; Tabelog). “Ryokan-style” breakfast mini-course Saturdays and Sundays in two sittings (8:30 and 10:00), by reservation, ¥3,980; a hotel-stay plan with Agora Hotel (official site). Cards, Rakuten Pay (Tabelog), but set lunches are cash only (July and September 2026). 16 seats: 8 at the ground-floor counter, 8 at tables upstairs, which also serve as a private room for 4–8 (Tabelog). Heated-tobacco area on the ground floor; upstairs non-smoking (Tabelog). Shoes off at the entrance (Tabelog). Children welcome, small children upstairs (Tabelog). Take-away: seko crab, saba sushi, gyu-katsu and tonkatsu sandwiches at New Year (official site). Down an alley off Nishinotoin south of Rokkaku, 9–11 min from Shijo / Karasuma Oike Stns (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 11 July 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Alley off Nishinotoin south of Rokkaku — 9 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: “Kyoto fry kappo”: seasonal dishes and signature fried dishes by course, from a chef with Japanese, French and crab-ryokan experience; Kinki produce such as Kyotamba-kogen pork, Yoka pork and fish from Maizuru port (official site) · signature rare-fried horse mackerel, fillet katsu, crab-cream croquette, menchi katsu, Wagyu cutlet (official site; 2026 reviews) · lunch: Yoka-pork menchi katsu set ¥1,650 with rice, miso soup and salad (June 2026); a ¥5,500 lunch with fried horse mackerel and tonkatsu (June 2026) · dinner: “MICURI Ultimate Course” ¥22,000 with sashimi, conger eel and matsutake soup, fried bread with shrimp paste, Omi beef, abalone (July 2026); hassun, nodoguro, white squid (September 2026) · breakfast: clay-pot rice, Kamo eggplant, sashimi, dashimaki, obanzai, miso soup, menchi katsu (July 2026) · house sauce with sansho; tartare with pickled daikon (July 2026) · natural wines, mainly white; sakes including Aramasa and Ōroku; whisky; premium free-drink plans (official site; September 2026) · Matsuba crab course in season (official site)
places.notes: [Fried-food kappo · Nishinotoin-Rokkaku, alley counter] A small alley house — shoes off — where fried food becomes kappo: rare-fried horse mackerel, fillet katsu, crab-cream croquettes and menchi katsu from Kinki pork, fried slowly to order, alongside sashimi and seasonal dishes. Lunch sets from ¥1,650 (cash only), dinner courses up to ¥22,000 with natural wine and rare sake, and a ryokan-style breakfast on weekends. Book ahead. Sister of ワインと和食 みくり.

chef_bio.background: The official site describes a chef who has built experience not only in Japanese cooking but also in French cuisine and at a crab ryokan; a June 2026 reviewer calls it “run by a chef with experience in French and Japanese cooking”. A September 2026 diner mentions both “the head chef and the owner” recommending drinks. The invoice number here, T9130001059304, is registered to 株式会社Ｇｒｅｅｎ Ｓｍｉｌｅ (NTA register). The site also advertises a monthly cooking event, “みくり 桑 お料理会”.
chef_bio.philosophy: Local produce for local tables (地産地消), mainly Kinki ingredients; attention to oil and breadcrumbs (official site; July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Rare-fried horse mackerel; crab-cream croquette; menchi katsu.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 lunch guest noted that the fries are cooked slowly at low temperature after ordering, so each takes about 15 minutes.
A July 2026 breakfast guest was shown the clay-pot rice before it steamed, then had a run of dishes during the 10-minute wait.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都フライ割烹 みくり 桑 (みくり くわ)、四条烏丸の路地奥、和食だけでなくフレンチやカニ旅館など様々な経験を積んだシェフ、旬の料理と名物フライをコースで、地産地消、京丹波高原豚、八鹿豚、舞鶴漁港の鮮魚、白中心のナチュールワイン、新政や王祿などの日本酒、2階に個室、朝ごはんは土日のみ2部制 (8時30分〜、10時〜)、要予約3,980円、アゴーラホテルと提携、ランチは事前予約のみ、名物のレアアジフライやヘレカツ、松葉ガニのコース、毎月の「みくり 桑 お料理会」、年末年始のテイクアウト (せこ蟹3,300円、鯖寿司3,800円など)。食べログ: 揚げ物・とんかつ・かに、中京区西洞院通り六角下がる池須町419-6、火は夜のみ、水〜土は昼夜、日・祝は昼のみ、月曜・日曜夜・第3日曜休み、カード・楽天ペイ可、16席 (1階カウンター8、2階テーブル8)、1階は加熱式たばこのみ可、靴を脱いで上がる、子ども可、2024年7月11日オープン、適格請求書 T9130001059304 (株式会社Ｇｒｅｅｎ Ｓｍｉｌｅ)。口コミ (2026年、英語): フライ割烹、八鹿豚のメンチカツ定食1,650円、レアアジフライ、カニクリームコロッケ、22,000円のコース、昼の定食は現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off; lunch by reservation and set lunches cash only. Families welcome upstairs; walk-in foreign families have been seated upstairs (July 2026).

places.name: こけこっこ (Kokekokko)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal yakitori with salt or tare, chicken rice bowls, tororo rice, yuba with sweet soy sauce; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori restaurant; lunch sets with chicken and egg (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00), lunch to 16:00; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; advised at lunch (October 2026). Dinner table charge ¥330, free for children up to 6 and not added to free-drink courses (Tabelog, original ディナーのみテーブルチャージ料として330円(税込)頂戴いたします。(6歳まで無料/飲み放題付きコースは除く)). Cards and many QR codes; no e-money (Tabelog). 70 seats at tables and a counter (Tabelog). Non-smoking; sommelier; children welcome (Tabelog). Views of Kyoto Tower and the city at night (October 2026). JR Kyoto Isetan 10F, directly connected to Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, JR Kyoto Isetan 10F
places.cuisine: Binchotan-grilled yakitori (2026 reviews) · lunch: charcoal-grilled chicken and tororo gozen with pickles, aosa miso soup and matcha warabi mochi, rice refills (November 2026); charcoal chicken and egg rice bowl with yuba and matcha warabi mochi (September 2026); a ¥3,700 lunch course with salad, small dishes, six skewers and a drink (October 2026) · dinner: Oyadori course of eight grilled items — breast, thigh, liver, gizzard, pork, wings, cherry tomato, tsukune (September 2026) · à la carte: tsukune ¥400, liver ¥450, negima ¥450, skin ¥450, yuba with sweet soy ¥800, bonjiri, outside skirt, chilled tomato (October 2026) · draft beer ¥700, Kuro Kirishima shochu ¥660, sake of the day (2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Kyoto Station, Isetan 10F with a tower view] A 70-seat charcoal yakitori room on the restaurant floor of JR Kyoto Isetan, with windows on Kyoto Tower and the night city — handy before a Shinkansen. Lunch sets of charcoal chicken with tororo or an oyakodon-style bowl; at night skewers at about ¥400–450 each or the Oyadori course. ¥330 table charge at dinner. Prices run a little high; busy with tourists.

chef_bio.background: No operator or chef is named in the sources opened. Reviewers praise attentive staff (September 2026). An October 2026 diner on a business trip found service slow, the course skewers brought two at a time, and the neighbouring tourist group loud.
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan yakitori; charcoal chicken lunch sets.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner waited 20 minutes over edamame before the eight Oyadori skewers arrived, anxious about the Shinkansen.
An October 2026 lunch guest mistook the white dessert for tofu with yuzu before finding it was a milk pudding.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: こけこっこ、居酒屋・ステーキ・焼き鳥、下京区烏丸通塩小路下ル東塩小路町901 ジェイアール京都伊勢丹10F、京都駅直結、11:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、予約可、ディナーのみテーブルチャージ330円 (6歳まで無料、飲み放題付きコースは除く)、カード・QR決済可、70席、禁煙、ソムリエ、子ども可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 備長炭の焼き鳥、炭火焼き鶏ととろろの御膳、親子丼風の丼、昼のコース3,700円、Oyadori コース、串1本400〜450円、湯葉800円、京都タワーと夜景、やや高め、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Department-store restaurant by the station; many foreign visitors (October 2026). ¥330 table charge at dinner.

places.name: Roji-oku (ロジオク)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Roast beef with red-wine or garlic-soy sauce, hamburg steak with demi-glace, beef cutlet, shrimp tempura, curry, pasta; bread with lunch; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a roast-beef bistro; consommé soup with the set lunches (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), dinner 17:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closed Wednesday, with Wednesday banquets for about 20 or more on request (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; dinner often fully booked (October 2026). Corkage for brought-in cakes and drinks (Tabelog). Cards, IC, iD, QUICPay and QR codes (Tabelog). 50 seats; private rooms from 4 to over 30 (up to 64 seated), secured for 16 or more at ¥7,000 a head; projector; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking with a smoking spot outside (Tabelog). Children welcome, kids’ menu (Tabelog). Down an alley behind an apartment building on Bukkoji, 5 min from Shijo / Karasuma Stns exit 26 (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 10 August 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Alley off Bukkoji west of Karasuma — 5 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Casual creative yoshoku with roast beef as the main dish (company site; 2026 reviews) · roast beef set with salad, soup and bread, slices about 7 mm thick with wasabi (October 2026) · roast beef and hamburg steak set ¥2,700 with hot consommé (October 2026) · roast beef from Hirai beef, with original red-wine sauce or Japanese garlic soy sauce (October 2026) · beef cutlet; curry; shrimp tempura and sweet-potato salad on the lunch set (October 2026) · weekday lunch specials, e.g. pork loin omelette with chicken soboro and yuzu-pepper cream, hamo and summer vegetable escabeche (June 2026) · ¥6,000 free-drink banquet course with appetizers, pasta and roast beef (October 2026)
places.notes: [Roast beef bistro · down an alley near Shijo Karasuma] True to its name (“the back of the alley”), a stylish bistro bar hidden behind an apartment block on Bukkoji, built around thick-cut roast beef with red-wine or garlic-soy sauce. Lunch sets around ¥2,000–2,700 (roast beef, hamburg, beef cutlet); evenings run to midnight with courses and big private rooms for parties. Dinner books out. Closed Wednesdays.

roles: Representative of 合同会社Rミート, the operating company
chef_bio.background: The company site of 合同会社Rミート (Rmeet) names 井上 剛 as representative and calls Roji-oku the company’s founding shop, opened during the pandemic, with roast beef as its main dish; the “R” stands for Roji-oku, roast beef and royal. Tabelog gives an Inoue mobile number for Wednesday banquet enquiries. Whether the representative cooks is not stated.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Keep doing the obvious things properly”; creating new menus throughout the pandemic (company site).
chef_bio.specialty: Roast beef.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner came back within the month with the diner’s wife, this time for the beef cutlet.
A 21-person workplace alumni party booked a semi-private room for the ¥6,000 free-drink course (October 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 合同会社Rミートのサイト: 代表 井上 剛、創業の地ロジオク、メインディッシュのローストビーフ、R はロジオク、ローストビーフ、ロイヤルの頭文字、コロナ禍に誕生、「気軽に愉しめるカジュアル創作洋食」。食べログ: Roji-oku、ビストロ・バル・洋食、下京区糸屋町215-1 ブローディア仏光寺1F、四条駅・烏丸駅26番出口から徒歩5分、昼11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、夜17:30〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、水曜定休 (20名ほどからの宴会は相談可)、ケーキや飲み物の持ち込みは持ち込み料、カード・電子マネー・QR可、50席、個室あり (最大64名)、車椅子可、子ども可、2020年8月10日オープン、適格請求書 T2130003007903。口コミ (2026年、英語): 厚切りのローストビーフ、ハンバーグとのセット2,700円、牛カツ、海老天、6,000円の飲み放題コース、夜は満席が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual bistro; set lunches; large private rooms for groups.

places.name: 鉄板焼・お好み焼 仁 (Teppanyaki Okonomiyaki Jin)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat-batter okonomiyaki, negiyaki and chijimi, and yakisoba in a house sauce (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: teppan dishes of pork, beef, squid and egg, with bonito flakes on top (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–16:30 (last order 16:00) and 18:00–2:00 (food last order 1:00, drinks 1:30); the 2nd and 4th Wednesday closed in the evening, lunch still served (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — full soon after opening (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). No service charge (Tabelog original 無し). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). 14 seats at tables with teppan griddles, plus a raised tatami area; non-smoking; children welcome, no strollers inside (Tabelog). Menu on the wall (February and October 2026). Nijo-dori west of Takakura; 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 May 2008 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo-dori west of Takakura — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Old-style okonomiyaki and teppanyaki izakaya (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · Kyoto beta-yaki okonomiyaki, negiyaki of green onion and beef tendon ¥950, jaga-cheese chijimi (2025–2026 reviews) · yakisoba with very thin noodles in a house sauce, with beef tendon or fried pork fat (2025–2026 reviews) · teppan dishes: tonpei-yaki, its seafood version umihira-yaki, cheese omelette, squid tentacles, spinach with bacon, wagyu outside skirt, gizzard, corn butter (2025–2026 reviews) · Jin yakko: cold tofu with spicy garlic chives (June 2025) · "Otsukaresama" set of two drinks and two small dishes ¥1,650–1,800; strong highballs and "Aka" (2025–2026 reviews) · about ¥3,000–5,000 at night (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Nijo Takakura, open till 2 a.m.] A Showa-feeling okonomiyaki and teppan bar where each dish is finished on the griddle at your table: Kyoto-style beta-yaki and negiyaki, very thin-noodle yakisoba many call the best in town, tonpei-yaki, cheese omelette and cold tofu under spicy chives, with an after-work set of two drinks and two snacks. Run by the chef and a second cook; busy and cramped, so book. Cash only. Lunch and late dinner daily.

roles: Head chef and a second cook (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 1 May 2008, okonomiyaki and beta-yaki in an old-fashioned room; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe two men running the shop, the head chef and what seemed an apprentice (February and August 2026), strong drinks (June 2025) and Kyoto-style yakisoba with very thin noodles (January 2025–October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Thin-noodle yakisoba; negiyaki.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 regular comes here after almost every after-party in Kyoto and calls the thin-noodle yakisoba the best of the Kyoto yakisoba tried.
A March 2025 traveller liked the yakisoba so much that a second plate followed.
A February 2026 diner with presbyopia struggled to read the menu on the wall, and noted the house custom of ordering the quick dishes first.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・居酒屋、中京区二条通高倉西入ル松屋町48-1、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、毎日 11:30〜16:30 (L.O.16:00)・18:00〜翌2:00 (料理L.O.1:00、ドリンクL.O.1:30)、第2・第4水曜は夜休み (昼は営業)、予約可、サービス料無し、現金のみ、14席、小上がり、禁煙、子ども可 (ベビーカー不可)、2008年5月1日オープン、昔ながらの空間でお好み焼きとべた焼き。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 店主と若い料理人の男性二人、壁のメニュー、京都のべた焼き、ねぎ焼き950円 (すじ)、じゃがチーズチヂミ、極細麺の焼きそば (すじ、揚げた豚の脂)、とん平焼き、海鮮の「Umihira-yaki」、チーズオムレツ、げそ焼き、ほうれん草とベーコン、和牛のハラミ、砂肝、コーンバター、ニラの冷奴「Jin Yakko」、2ドリンク2品の「Otsukaresama」セット1,650〜1,800円、濃いハイボール、「Aka」、予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu on the wall in Japanese; dishes served on your table griddle; book; cash only.

places.name: 土鍋彩膳 とよあけ (Donabe Saizen Toyoake)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list ticks gluten-free options, but no detail is given; the course is clay-pot rice, tofu, vegetables and dashimaki in dashi, with soy-based seasonings likely (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog ticks vegan and vegetarian options, but the set course uses dashi throughout, a dashimaki omelette, and fish, crab or beef rice (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 7:00–15:00, seatings from 7:00; closing days may vary (Tabelog; October 2026). Reservation only, online via TableCheck or Instagram — there is no phone (Tabelog remarks; September 2026). No cover charge (Tabelog original チャージ料なし). Children only if able to eat the adult menu; no kids menu (Tabelog). 6 counter seats around the kitchen; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 1F of the Daini Kinken building, Shogoin; 1 min from the Shinmanomachi Nijo bus stop, 8–15 min walk from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 1 April 2026 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shogoin, near the Shinmanomachi Nijo bus stop — 8–15 min walk from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Clay-pot rice breakfast and lunch course at a six-seat counter (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · the course: a vegetable surinagashi soup, the chef's vegetables, tofu from Kitayama with salt or wasabi, simmered eggplant, and a pale dashimaki from eggs of rice-fed hens (September–October 2026) · clay-pot rice cooked to order, about three bowls a pot: salmon, beef sukiyaki, crab (extra), seasonal rice such as matsutake, hamo or anago; plain rice option (August–October 2026) · toppings of ikura, mentaiko, egg and butter; leftover rice as dashi chazuke, or rice balls in bamboo leaf to take home; dessert (September 2026) · about ¥3,000–5,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Clay-pot rice breakfast · Shogoin, six seats from 7 a.m.] A tiny new counter where the owner-chef cooks a clay pot of rice to order for each guest — salmon, beef sukiyaki, crab or the season's matsutake or hamo — after a run of small dishes: vegetable soup, Kitayama tofu to eat with salt, simmered eggplant and a strikingly white dashimaki of rice-fed eggs. Finish with dashi chazuke or take rice balls home. Friendly English-speaking host. Book online only (no phone). Daily from 7:00.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who runs the counter alone
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 1 April 2026, reservation only, with English-speaking staff; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 describe a chef who manages everything alone (August and October 2026), explains each ingredient, recommends sharing pots (September 2026) and chats about Kyoto sights and clay pots.
chef_bio.specialty: Clay-pot rice; white dashimaki of rice-fed eggs.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 guest was told the Kitayama tofu has a cheese-like flavour, so salt or wasabi suits it better than soy sauce — and, not usually a wasabi fan, found the pairing a revelation.
Before cooking the dashimaki, the chef shows guests the eggs: from rice-fed hens, with yolks almost white (October 2026).
A September 2026 family shared crab, salmon and hamo pots on the owner's advice and stayed chatting about sights, local food and clay pots.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 釜飯、左京区聖護院蓮華蔵31 第二近建ビル 1F、京阪三条駅から徒歩10分、地下鉄東山駅から徒歩8分、市バスの Shinmanomachi Nijo 停留所から徒歩1分、毎日 7:00〜15:00、休みは変わることがある、完全予約制 (TableCheck か Instagram)、チャージ料なし、6席 (カウンター)、禁煙、Wi-Fi、英語対応、子どもは大人と同じ料理を食べられる場合のみ、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2026年4月1日オープン、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリー対応の記載。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 電話はなくネット予約のみ、店主一人で営む、すり流し、野菜、京都の Kitayama の豆腐 (塩かわさびで)、茄子の煮浸し、米で育てた鶏の白い卵のだし巻き、注文後に炊く土鍋ご飯 (鮭、牛すき焼き、蟹、松茸、鱧、穴子、白ご飯)、いくら・明太子・卵・バターのトッピング、だし茶漬け、残りは笹で包んだおにぎりに、デザート、3,000〜5,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking host; book online (TableCheck or Instagram), no phone; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: 味彩 のと与 (Ajisai no Toyo)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: eel grilled with a house tare (soy-based), served over rice; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel and river-fish restaurant (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30); closed Wednesday, or the next weekday when Wednesday is a holiday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; a booking is held 30 minutes (Tabelog); fills quickly at lunch, so book (August 2026). 22 seats: tables for up to 4 and a sunken kotatsu area for 8; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Menus in English, Chinese and Korean with photos; children and babies welcome — strollers left on the 1F (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 2F above the family river-fish shop in Nishiki Market, up the stairs beside it; 7 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Nishiki Market by Yanaginobanba, 2F — 7 min walk from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Kansai-style eel of a river-fish shop founded in 1912, grilled over binchotan with the house tare — crisp outside, fluffy inside (Tabelog) · unadon from ¥2,100; jo-unadon with more than half an eel ¥3,700 with liver soup; a whole-eel bowl ¥4,800; hitsumabushi (2026 reviews) · Ajisai Unagi Gozen sets of five items with small dishes, eel roll and dessert: half eel ¥4,500, two-thirds ¥5,000, whole ¥6,000 (Tabelog) · grilled eel liver ¥700; carp sashimi (August–October 2026) · eel and river fish to take away at the 1F shop (2025–2026 reviews) · about ¥3,000–5,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Eel · Nishiki Market, upstairs from the river-fish shop] A quiet townhouse-style room above a river-fish shop in busy Nishiki Market, serving its eel since 1912: Kansai-style, grilled over binchotan until the skin crackles, glazed with a sweetish house tare. Bowls from ¥2,100 by the portion (half, two-thirds, whole), hitsumabushi and gozen sets with eel roll and dessert. The kitchen and floor, grill master included, are all women. English menu. Lunch only; closed Wednesday.

roles: All-female team including the grill master (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: established in 1912 as an eel restaurant run by a river-fish specialist, grilling over binchotan with a house sauce; a cosy townhouse-style space upstairs staffed entirely by women, the grill master included, and welcoming to solo women diners; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe the river-fish shop on the 1F and eel to take away.
chef_bio.philosophy: A welcoming room for locals, families and travellers (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kansai-style grilled eel.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular came, as every year, for the Day of the Ox and was glad the prices had not changed since the year before.
A September 2026 diner who used to think of Kaneyo for eel in Kyoto now finds the grilling here more meticulous.
Through the window by the entrance, a June 2026 guest climbing the stairs could see the eel being grilled under the noren.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うなぎ、中京区錦小路通柳馬場東入東魚屋町173 2F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩約7分、11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、水曜定休 (祝日は営業し振替休み)、予約可 (30分を過ぎると取り消しの場合あり)、22席、掘りごたつ、貸切20名まで、禁煙、英語・中国語・韓国語の写真付きメニュー、子ども可 (ベビーカーは1階に)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。店の紹介: 1912年創業、川魚の専門店が営むうなぎ店、自家製のたれと備長炭、外はカリッと中はふんわり、町家風の空間、焼き手を含め女性スタッフのみ、「Ajisai Unagi Gozen」5品 (半身4,500円、3分の2 5,000円、1本6,000円)。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 1階は川魚の店で持ち帰り、2階が食事処、関西風のカリッとした鰻、甘めのたれ、うな丼2,100円、上うな丼3,700円 (肝吸い付き)、一本の丼4,800円、ひつまぶし、肝焼き700円、薄切りの鯉、土用の丑の日。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean picture menus; book for lunch; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: ブーランジェリー モリモリ (Boulangerie MoriMori)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: a wheat bakery — baguettes of Hokkaido wheat, croissants, pies and curry bread (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Baguettes and plain loaves may suit, but there is no ingredient information; most items use butter, cream, cheese or beef curry (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 7:30–18:00; closed Monday and some irregular days; hours may change (Tabelog). Bread can be reserved from a single item (Tabelog). Cash or PayPay only (Tabelog original 現金、PayPay払いのみ). Self-service, except chilled items; breads come bagged (March and August 2026). Takeaway only; a paid car park next door (Tabelog). Nijo-dori west of Higashinotoin; about 300 m from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 28 May 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo-dori west of Higashinotoin — a short walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Small neighbourhood bakery, mostly savoury breads at about ¥250–300 (May 2026) · baked (not fried) beef curry bread ¥250–260, featured on the TV show "Matsuko's Unknown World" (March–August 2026) · baguette of Hokkaido wheat ¥340; sliced loaf and round bread of the same dough (May and August 2026) · pain au chocolat ¥280, triangle chocolate pie ¥420, apple pie ¥420, canelé ¥320 (March–October 2026) · Gorgonzola with honey ¥230, cream cheese and honey raisin, chocolate orange, cream bread (March–August 2026) · under ¥1,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Bakery · Nijo Higashinotoin, south of Marutamachi] A small bakery with a big savoury range at everyday prices: its baked beef curry bread, as seen on TV, a chewy high-hydration dough, Hokkaido-wheat baguettes, Gorgonzola and honey, cream cheese and raisin, plus croissants, apple pie and canelés. Bread can be reserved by phone even one piece. Cash or PayPay only. Open from 7:30; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 28 May 2019; reservations taken from one bread. Reviewers in 2026 describe a charming small shop in an area thick with bakeries, a baked curry bread featured on "Matsuko's Unknown World" (May and June 2026), and a soft, chewy high-hydration dough (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Baked curry bread.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 bread tourist made this the second stop on a walk from Shio Pan Jiro to Nishiki Market, buying the baked curry bread seen on "Matsuko's Unknown World" and a Hokkaido-wheat baguette.
An August 2026 shopper found the sliced loaf and the round bread, made from the same dough, so different in texture as to seem like two products.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン、中京区二条通東洞院西入仁王門町11、丸太町駅から308m、火〜日 7:30〜18:00、月曜定休と不定休、パン1個から予約可、現金と PayPay のみ、禁煙、隣に有料駐車場、2019年5月28日オープン。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 小さなパン屋、惣菜パンが多い、250〜300円ほど、冷蔵品以外はセルフ、袋入り、テレビ「Matsuko’s Unknown World」で紹介された焼きカレーパン250〜260円、北海道産小麦のバゲット340円、食パンと丸パン、パン・オ・ショコラ280円、三角チョコパイ420円、アップルパイ420円、カヌレ320円、ゴルゴンゾーラとはちみつ230円、クリームチーズとはちみつレーズン、チョコオレンジ、クリームパン、加水の多いもちもちの生地。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-service bagged breads; pay in cash or PayPay; reserve by phone if needed.

places.name: 喫茶 六花 (Kissa Rokka)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a café menu of toast, sandwiches, quiche, tarts and French toast (June 2026 review).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A daily vegetable-soup lunch is offered, but nothing vegan is marked (June 2026 review).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; June 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 20 seats at tables, with red velvet sofas and chairs and a view of a small garden; non-smoking; quiet, with no background music (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). On a lane behind a white brick wall about 5 min from Higashiyama Stn (262 m), near Higashiyama-Sanjo; moved here from Shirakawa (Tabelog; August 2025).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama-Sanjo — 262 m from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Kissa with hand-drip coffee, one cup at a time (official site) · June 2026 menu: daily lunch ¥1,350 (e.g. mapo tofu set), quiche lunch ¥1,400, seasonal vegetable-soup lunch ¥1,400, curry rice ¥1,400, sandwiches from ¥1,300, butter toast ¥400, French toast ¥950, cake of the day from ¥700 (mostly tarts), Rokka parfait ¥1,200, hot coffee ¥650, apple juice ¥650 · also egg sandwich, hōjicha milk tea, banana milk (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kissa · Higashiyama-Sanjo, a quiet hand-drip coffee room] A calm, homely kissa behind a white brick wall a few minutes from Higashiyama Station, with red velvet seats, pretty tableware and a little garden. Coffee is hand-dripped cup by cup; lunch runs to quiche, soup or a daily plate (about ¥1,350–1,400), and tea time to fruit tarts, French toast and parfaits. Mostly locals, no music. Cash only. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: coffee hand-dripped carefully one cup at a time; site copyright from 2016. Tabelog notes a move from the Amenity Shirakawa building in Shirakawa to the present address.
chef_bio.specialty: Hand-drip coffee with a fruit tart.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 lunch guest was asked on arrival to confirm having cash, as payment is cash only.
An October 2025 visitor liked the café’s teacups so much that one went home with the visitor.
An April 2025 pair stopped in after cherry-blossom viewing at Maruyama Park for coffee and a kumquat and orange tart.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kissa-rokka.com): 喫茶 六花 (ROKKA)、京都・東山三条、コーヒーは一杯ずつハンドドリップで丁寧に、東山区稲荷町南組577-4、11:00〜18:00、火曜・水曜定休。食べログ: 喫茶店・カフェ、東山駅から262m、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、20席 (4人席1、2人席8)、禁煙、白川のアメニティ白川1階から移転。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 日替わりランチ1,350円、キッシュランチ1,400円、季節の野菜スープランチ1,400円、カレー1,400円、サンドイッチ1,300円〜、バタートースト400円、フレンチトースト950円、ケーキ700円〜 (タルトが中心)、六花パフェ1,200円、ホットコーヒー650円、現金のみ、BGM なし、赤いビロードの椅子、小さな庭。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; a quiet room favoured by locals.

places.name: 蕎麦手打ち たか橋 (Soba Teuchi Takahashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The soba is juwari (100% buckwheat), but it comes with dipping sauce, and the sets include tempura and mackerel sushi; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based dipping sauce, with tempura, chicken and mackerel sushi on the sets (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) daily except Wednesday and the 2nd and 4th Tuesday; dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 20:30) Thursday–Saturday (Tabelog). Bookings via Tabelog; tables are few, so book (March 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 38 seats over two floors of tatami rooms with tables, shoes off; a private room for 11–20 on the 1st floor; steep stairs and high entrance steps — not wheelchair accessible (Tabelog; June 2026). Cards, transit IC and other e-money, and QR including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). In a renovated Showa-era former teahouse (ochaya) in the old Gojo district by the Takase River, 256 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 27 May 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gojo, by the Takase River — 256 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Hand-made juwari (100% buckwheat) soba and seasonal Kyoto dishes from cooks trained in Gion (Tabelog) · monthly soba from different regions, e.g. Suwa (Nagano), Higashikagura (Hokkaido), Kagoshima and Yosano (Kyoto); a tasting of three zaru soba ¥1,500 (October–November 2026) · lunch sets A and B with mackerel sushi or soba-gaki dengaku; seasonal tempura zaru; a "salaryman set" with seasonal rice; free soba-yu and buckwheat mini doughnuts (2026 reviews) · evening set of soba-mae (three appetizers, two sashimi, chicken tempura) and soba ¥3,000 · nine-dish soba kaiseki ¥5,000, ¥7,500 with 90 minutes of drinks (Tabelog, tax included)
places.notes: [Soba · Gojo, juwari soba in an old teahouse] A hand-made soba house in a Showa-era former teahouse by the Takase River, where you take your shoes off and eat in small tatami rooms. Each month brings 100% buckwheat soba from three regions — taste all three side by side for ¥1,500, with salt. Lunch sets add mackerel sushi or soba-gaki; Thursday to Saturday evenings bring soba-mae snacks and soba kaiseki. Service can be slow when busy. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Cooks trained in Gion (Tabelog); not named; the invoice is registered to an individual proprietor
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: authentic hand-made soba and creative Japanese food by cooks trained in Gion, in a historic building at Gojo-Kawaramachi; 100% buckwheat soba; seasonal Kyoto ingredients for the dinner courses. Opened 27 May 2021 (Tabelog); a May 2026 reviewer saw its 5th-anniversary sticker. An October 2026 reviewer says the owner serves slightly smaller soba so guests can also enjoy seasonal dishes.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per an October 2026 review: the owner wants guests to enjoy seasonal dishes as well as soba.
chef_bio.specialty: Three-region juwari zaru soba tasting.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner recommended eating the juwari soba with salt to taste the buckwheat itself.
A June 2026 guest with a cane needed help with the high steps at the entrance and reports the inside is not wheelchair accessible.
A March 2026 diner waited about 30 minutes for food on a busy day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 蕎麦手打ち たか橋、そば、下京区平居町23、清水五条駅から256m、昼11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30、水曜と第2・4火曜休み)、夜は木〜土18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 20:30)、38席、1階に11〜20名の個室、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2021年5月27日オープン、インボイス登録は個人事業者。公式紹介: 五条河原町の歴史ある建物、祇園で修業した職人の本格手打ちそばと創作和食、十割そば、夜は京都の季節の食材のコース。コース: 秋のそば懐石9品5,000円、90分飲み放題付き7,500円、たか橋の夜定食3,000円 (税込)。口コミ (2026年3〜11月、英語): 元お茶屋の建物、靴を脱いで上がる、Suwa (Nagano)、Higashikagura (Hokkaido)、Yosano (Kyoto) などの十割ざるそば3種の食べ比べ1,500円、鯖寿司、そばがき田楽、そば湯とそば粉のミニドーナツ、車椅子不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests; shoes off; steep stairs.
