places.name: 若松家酒店 (Wakamatsuya Sakaten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seafood omakase and hot pots (fugu, hamo, sea bream) with ponzu and other seasonings; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood hot-pot courses (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Evenings 18:00–22:00, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). By day a sake shop; at night a reservation-only seafood hot-pot omakase. Very hard to book: Friday nights about six months out, and the winter fugu season months to over half a year ahead (February and September 2026). Drinks are self-service from the shop’s fridges and shelves at retail prices — tell the owner what you take; totals of about ¥12,000–15,000 a head with drinks are reported (2025–2026 reviews). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 20 seats; private hire possible; smoking allowed per Tabelog. On Shichijo-dori west of Karasuma, 438 m from Kyoto Stn, in a Showa-retro room (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Shichijo-Karasuma — 438 m from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: Sake shop’s seafood omakase built around a seasonal hot pot, served on big platters (2025–2026 reviews) · winter fugu courses (tetchiri, fugu skin, grilled fugu) with sashimi and abalone; spring sea-bream shabu-shabu with sweetfish tsukudani and young bamboo shoots; summer hamo hot pot with head, liver and roe in the broth; sweetfish and duck hot pot; crab or grouper depending on the catch · sake at retail prices from the shop (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · near Kyoto Station, a sake shop's secret hot-pot nights] A neighbourhood sake shop on Shichijo-dori that turns, by reservation only, into a Showa-retro room of seafood feasts: big platters of sashimi and abalone, then the season's hot pot — fugu in winter, sea bream in spring, hamo in summer. Help yourself to sake and beer from the shop fridges at retail prices and tell the owner. About ¥12,000–15,000 all in. Booked months ahead; cash only. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner not named; the shop is run as a sake retailer by day (reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per 2025–2026 reviews: a local sake shop near Kyoto Station that runs reservation-only seafood hot-pot evenings for regulars; drinks are sold at shop prices and taken from the fridges self-service; the course changes with the season’s fish.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal seafood hot pot — fugu, sea bream, hamo.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular was messaged the day before to choose between crab and grouper, depending on the catch.
A May 2026 party stood up to photograph each large platter on arrival.
A December 2025 first-timer got in only through a cancellation.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 若松家酒店、居酒屋・鍋、下京区七条通烏丸西入ル西境町166、京都駅から438m、月〜土18:00〜22:00、日祝定休、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、20席、貸切可、喫煙可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 昼は酒屋、夜は予約制の海鮮の鍋のおまかせ、酒は小売価格で冷蔵庫からセルフ、店主に申告、冬のてっちりなど河豚づくし、春の鯛しゃぶ、夏の鱧鍋、鮎と鴨の鍋、蟹かクエ、金曜は半年待ち、冬は数か月〜半年以上前に予約、飲んで1人12,000〜15,000円ほど、昭和レトロの店内。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation-only and booked months ahead; cash only; self-service drinks.

places.name: 酒呑気 びんご (Sakenonki Bingo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Simmered niku-dofu, sesame-miso sea bream, croquettes, spring rolls and akashiyaki; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A meat- and fish-led izakaya menu with a few vegetable dishes such as fried eggplant and myoga; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 16:00–23:00 daily (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30) (Tabelog). Reservations essential — walk-ins are often turned away (August–October 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 34 seats including a counter, in a renovated townhouse; non-smoking; cards (including UnionPay), transit IC, iD, QUICPay and QR including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Off Nishikikoji west of Karasuma, about 10 min from Karasuma or Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 4 September 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishikikoji west of Karasuma — 10 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Tokyo-style popular sakaba with Kyoto warmth (operator site) · signature niku-dofu of beef tendon and tofu, tanteki, sesame-miso sea bream; "drinking bottles" to mix at your own strength (Tabelog) · e.g. pork belly wrapped in lettuce, beef tongue, corned-beef potato salad, chorizo spring rolls, yam-and-octopus akashiyaki, unagi tamago, fried eggplant and myoga, peach mascarpone, "Tira Miso", coarse-ground ginger drinks; a wide sake list (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Nishikikoji, a lively townhouse sakaba] A buzzing, booking-only izakaya in an old townhouse west of Karasuma, with a cheerful crew at the counter. Order the famous niku-dofu (beef tendon and tofu), sesame-miso sea bream and pork belly wrapped in lettuce, then make your own highballs from a bottle at the strength you like. Good-value and strongly seasoned, built for drinking. Open daily from 16:00; book ahead.

roles: Run by 株式会社Atari (operator site); no chef named
chef_bio.background: Per the operator’s site: 株式会社Atari runs four Kyoto sakaba — 酒呑気びんご, the neo-bistro 六角ace, 酒ﾉみつぼし and ageru. — and describes びんご as a Tokyo-style popular sakaba blended with Kyoto warmth. Per Tabelog’s official introduction: a casual pub whose concept is "connecting people". Opened 4 September 2020 (Tabelog); a September 2026 reviewer attended its sixth-anniversary menu.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: "connecting people".
chef_bio.specialty: Niku-dofu; sesame-miso sea bream.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular on a sixth visit ate from a special anniversary menu of maki sushi, crab cream croquettes and pudding.
An August 2026 couple saw walk-ins turned away and advise booking.
A September 2026 guest at a 16:00 holiday slot found a sister shop’s card in the restroom.

roles: Staff (unnamed) of the chicken shop Torihisa
chef_bio.background: An April 2026 reviewer writes that the shop is run by “Torihisa,” a chicken specialty restaurant in Higashiyama; others describe a ramen counter attached to a butcher-style chicken shop that sells meat and kara-age bento, with friendly staff (March and September 2026).

places.neighborhood: Shimogyo between Shijo and Gojo, west of Karasuma — 7 min from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Egg sandwiches — “ninuki” is Kyoto dialect for a boiled egg (July 2026 review) · mashed boiled-egg or scrambled-egg sandwiches, or a double of both; scrambled ¥550 (August 2026) · ham and egg about ¥600 (November 2026); egg double and bacon-lettuce about ¥1,560 for two (February 2025) · fried egg with mayonnaise and ham; soft-boiled egg; tuna egg; teriyaki egg; mentaiko egg (April–May 2026) · omelette and egg-salad set; sandwiches around ¥450 each (October 2026) · coffee in egg-shaped cups (July 2026)
places.notes: [Egg sandwiches · Shimogyo, a yellow egg café] A tiny six-seat, all-yellow café — an egg song on the speakers, coffee in egg-shaped cups — making nothing but egg sandwiches: mashed boiled egg, scrambled, fried egg with ham, teriyaki or mentaiko, generously filled, from about ¥450–600. Eat in or take away; open 9:00–17:00. The name is Kyoto dialect for a boiled egg.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. A February 2025 reviewer found the service very pleasant but the bread a little dry; on a later visit (November 2026) the bread was moist. A July 2026 reviewer recalled a grandmother explaining that “ninuki” means the boiled egg served with morning coffee and toast.
chef_bio.specialty: Egg sandwiches.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor could not get the shop’s egg song out of the visitor’s head for the rest of the day.
An April 2026 restaurateur on a camper-van trip to Ise called the soft-boiled egg sandwich the best egg sandwich ever.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an oyster and seafood bar (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:30) daily; hours may vary (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし; the English page’s “a service charge may be added” is a mistranslation). Cards, IC, e-money and QR (Tabelog; PayPay per September 2026). 38 seats: 18 at the counter and two tables inside, plus a back garden with 4 counter seats and two tables (Tabelog). places.neighborhood: Nishiki Market east of Takakura — 4 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: An oyster shop founded in 1921: four kinds of raw oysters, all safety-tested, plus sashimi, obanzai and tempura (Tabelog shop text) · assorted four raw oysters ¥2,750 — e.g. Akkeshi “Maruemon” (Hokkaido), Kagoshima rock oysters, Kamaishi (Iwate) (August 2026); Kijima (Hiroshima) (October 2026); origins change with the season (September 2026) · grilled, steamed and fried oysters; oyster gratin (2026 reviews) · simmered isotsubu shellfish; grilled ginkgo nuts (September–October 2026) · a set of steamed oysters with a drink, three raw oysters and fried oysters (October 2026) · draft beer and sake
places.notes: [Oysters · Nishiki Market, since 1921] A long counter and a small back garden inside Nishiki Market where a fourth-generation oyster family shucks four kinds of raw oysters from around Japan — about ¥2,750 for an assortment of four — alongside fried and grilled oysters, gratin and sashimi. Multilingual menus; no reservations; quieter in mid-afternoon. No service charge.

roles: Owner (unnamed), fourth generation per the shop text
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text: founded in 1921, when the current owner’s great-grandfather began selling oysters from a boat at the foot of Shijo Ohashi, later setting up the shop in Nishiki Market. Reviewers praise friendly staff and an enthusiastic young woman calling in customers at the front (October 2026); an August 2026 first-timer found the system unclear until asking.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh oysters, rigorously tested for safety (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Raw oysters; oyster gratin.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 couple shared twenty raw oysters and ordered the gratin twice.
An October 2026 regular hopes the shop keeps its style as Nishiki fills with inbound-oriented stalls.

places.name: 菊水 (Restaurant Kikusui)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: bifkatsu, croquettes, beef stew with demi-glace, sandwiches, bread or rice with sets (official site; 2026 reviews). Ask for grilled dishes.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Western-style meat and seafood menu (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Ground floor café-restaurant 10:00–21:30; 2nd-floor French grill 11:00–20:00; rooftop beer garden in summer 16:30–22:00 (food L.O. 21:30; the 2026 season ran 7 May–17 October); open year-round (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). 10% service charge only for reserved use of the 3rd and 4th floors (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 400 seats over several floors; banquet halls on 3F–4F for up to 130; designated smoking area (Tabelog; official site). Children welcome, kids’ menu (Tabelog). Minami-za intermission bento ordered at the restaurant and collected at the theatre (October 2026). 10% off food and drink with the municipal Kamohigashi car park next door (Tabelog). At the east end of Shijo Ohashi, opposite Minami-za, by Gion-Shijo Stn exit 7 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: East end of Shijo Ohashi, opposite Minami-za — Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Gion’s old Western-style restaurant, founded 1916, in a registered cultural property (official site) · ground floor café and parlour: bifkatsu and beef stew are the favourites (official site) · lunch sets with soup, salad, rice or bread, dessert and coffee: hamburg steak (100% beef) ¥2,640, cream croquette ¥2,420 (September 2026); seafood croquette set; beef stew set (September 2026) · hamburg steak sandwich (September 2026) · 2nd-floor French grill: Gion dinner, braised lobster, steaks, crêpes Suzette flambéed at the table, wines chosen by the owner-sommelier; a winter tiger-fugu and beef course (official site) · autumn dinner course ¥4,400 with charcuterie, chilled mushroom consommé, steak or beef stew (September 2026) · summer rooftop beer garden with BBQ sets about ¥5,200 before tax, overlooking the Kamo (September 2026) · take-away dishes (official site)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Shijo Ohashi opposite Minami-za, since 1916] A landmark Western-style restaurant in a registered cultural-property building at the Gion end of Shijo Ohashi: a retro ground-floor parlour for bifkatsu, beef stew and hamburg sets (about ¥2,400–2,700 with soup, dessert and coffee), a French grill upstairs with crêpes Suzette flambéed at the table, banquet halls, and a rooftop beer garden over the Kamo in summer. Handy before or between Kabuki at Minami-za.

chef_bio.background: The official site: founded in 1916 (Taisho 5) at the foot of Shijo Ohashi; the building is a registered tangible cultural property that keeps its original retro atmosphere; the owner, 奥村洋史, chooses the wines as sommelier and holds a Kyoto Prefecture fugu-handling licence. A September 2026 reviewer adds that the site was a rice-cracker shop before Kojiro Okumura turned it into a Western restaurant after a visit to Shanghai. A September 2026 diner on the autumn course found the service “horrendous from start to finish”; others praised quick service between Kabuki performances (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Bifkatsu; beef stew; crêpes Suzette.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 Kabuki-goer ordered the “Gion” Western bento across from Minami-za and collected it at the theatre entrance in the first interval.
An October 2026 diner between afternoon and evening Kabuki performances had lunch on the table five minutes after ordering.

cultural_comfort.note: Large, easy-going restaurant by Minami-za; a name list at the door when busy (October 2026).

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream cakes, cheesecakes, custard puffs and pudding (reviews).

places.notes: [Cake shop & café · by Higashiyama Station, an old-school Western pâtisserie] A retro-lit cake shop with a little café a minute from Higashiyama Station, handy after Eikando or the Kyoto City art museum: Black Forest, Dobos torte, kugelhopf, honey mousse and a shortcake at ¥600. Regulars call the cakes "deliciously ordinary" — reliable rather than flashy. Cash only. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2023–2026 describe a Western-style pastry shop like the ones of their childhood, with a showcase on the left, about four tables, retro lighting, polite staff, a steady flow of customers, and cakes now mostly a little over ¥500 because of rising costs. A Sunday in April 2026 found a mothers’ tea party in the café.
chef_bio.specialty: Black Forest; Dobos torte; kugelhopf.

anecdotes.text: "I can’t help but feel that there are fewer and fewer cake shops like this one that serve 'deliciously ordinary' treats." — September 2023.
A regular comes back for the Black Forest, "which is hard to find at other bakeries" (November 2025).
March 2026: "when a cake costs more than a beef bowl, it better be delicious!" — a ¥600 shortcake.
A September 2025 regular found the kugelhopf’s liqueur "a bit milder than usual… Was it just my imagination?"

Lively with locals; one diner missed chairs with backs. Smoking area inside. No service charge. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Not named in a source; one of three bars run together with スモーク＆グリル ロータス and 炭火焼×ワイン チャコール (official site)
chef_bio.background: Opened 6 March 2023 (Tabelog). The shared official site presents it as the casual, drop-in sibling of two Italian bars in the Shijo-Karasuma back streets, Smoke & Grill LOTUS and Charcoal, with standing places for one-person drinking, a pre-party or a second or third stop. It joins a yearly Sake Day event with the sake bar 日本酒BAR ○△□ and a curry and craft ginger ale shop (2024–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「気軽に立ち寄れる酒場」 — a bar you can drop into easily.
chef_bio.specialty: Eel cream croquette; seasonal small plates.

anecdotes.text: "I arrived already tipsy and immediately thought, 'I should have come here first!'" — April 2026.
A July 2026 business traveller found it open past 11 pm when everything else was closing — "What I particularly loved was the fig butter."
"I think it would have been even better if the chairs had backrests." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (lotus0610.com): スモーク＆グリル ロータス、炭火焼×ワイン チャコール、スタンド酒場 ステムの3店、ステムは気軽に立ち寄れる酒場、小皿料理 (ハーフサイズもあり)、名物のウナクリームコロッケやお造り、1人飲み・0次会・2軒目3軒目に、下京区郭巨山町30 ホーリーハウス 2F、四条駅25番出口から徒歩4分、18:00〜2:00 (L.O. 1:00)、火曜休み、カード・電子マネー可。食べログ: 居酒屋・立ち飲み・バル、20席 (カウンター4、立ち10、2人テーブル5)、貸切20名、加熱式たばこ専用の喫煙所と店内の紙たばこの喫煙所、サービス料は原文で「なし」、2023年3月6日オープン、のりポテトサラダ、カウンターのおばんざい。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 蓮根のミモレット焼き、牛タンの低温調理とねぎ塩、鴨胸の醤油麹漬け ほうじ茶マスタード、鰹と柿のカルパッチョ、鱧だしのおでん、カレーコロッケ、鮎のコンフィ、無花果バター、燻製ポテトチップス、日本酒 (Jikon、Isojiman、Nabeshima など)、日本酒の日のイベント、飲み放題のコース、2階でわかりにくい、背もたれのない椅子、地元の常連でにぎやか。

cultural_comfort.note: Small plates you can point at; obanzai on the counter; lively with regulars.

places.name: アシェットデセール 未完 (Assiette Dessert Mikan)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: plated desserts with chiffon, puff pastry, tortellini, financiers and madeleines (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: ice creams, cream, mousse, panna cotta and butter pastries (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: reservations only, courses starting together — lunch 12:00 full course and 15:00 short course; dinner 19:30 course, à la carte 19:00–21:00 with petits fours; closes 22:00; irregular closing days (calendar on Instagram) (Tabelog lists 13:00, 15:00 and 19:30). May be closed when there are no bookings (Tabelog). A charge on top at lunch and dinner — ¥500 from August 2021 (official site); one drink per person (official site; Tabelog 「ワンドリンク制」). Cancellation: 50% within 48 hours, 100% within 24 hours (official site). 7 counter seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Opened 22 September 2017 (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: North of Kyoto City Hall — 10 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae or Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Plated desserts made in front of you at a seven-seat counter, as a course (official site) · full course ¥6,600 tax included: amuse, the day’s assiette dessert, a salty palate cleanser, mignardises, nine plates in all with a gift to take home (official site); short course ¥5,500 (April 2026; 5 plates, October 2026) · themed courses: citrus (March–April 2026), peach (August 2026), a three-day chestnut course once a year (November 2025) · seen: grape plates, Tanba chestnut with pear, pistachio chiffon, mango with fromage-blanc ice, chestnut tortellini, a chestnut parfait of a dozen parts, white-miso financier, ginger madeleine (2025–2026 reviews) · welcome herbal tea (reviews)
places.notes: [Dessert course · seven-seat counter, plated desserts made in front of you] A reservation-only dessert counter north of the Kyoto City Hall area, open since 2017: chef 大村 壮史 builds a course of plated desserts in front of seven guests — citrus, peach, or a once-a-year chestnut course — ending with mignardises and warm financiers. Full course ¥6,600, short course ¥5,500, plus a drink and a charge. 100% cancellation fee within 24 hours.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: made cream puffs and café desserts at Crème de la Crème (2004–2006); wedding and café cakes at スター株式会社 (2006–2008); restaurant desserts and take-out cakes at Il Ghiottone (2008–2013); chocolate café desserts at マリベル (2013–2014); wedding cakes and desserts at the Westin Miyako Hotel (2014–2017); then opened Mikan in September 2017 as an assiette-dessert shop. An April 2026 regular calls it a pioneer of dessert courses in Kyoto that has kept its prices modest.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: the name 未完 ("unfinished") means 「現状に満足せず、常に新しい技術やデザインを追求し続ける」 — never satisfied, always chasing new techniques and designs; desserts to enjoy with all five senses.
chef_bio.specialty: Assiette dessert course; seasonal parfait.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular: "When I try to find a similar dessert course in Tokyo, it can cost three to four times as much."
The once-a-year chestnut course ran three days in November 2025; its parfait alone had about a dozen components, from hojicha espuma to Tanba chestnut ice cream.
The same April 2026 regular found the short course good but felt "the true value of this restaurant shines through in their regular full course."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-mikan.jp): アシェットデセール 未完、完全予約制のデザートのコース、店名は「現状に満足せず、常に新しい技術やデザインを追求し続ける」という意味、カウンター席のみ、五感で楽しむ、シェフ 大村 壮史 (クレームデラクレーム、スター株式会社、イルギオットーネ、マリベル、ウェスティン都ホテルを経て2017年9月に開業)、コース 全9皿お土産付き 6,600円 (税込)、ワンドリンクオーダー、昼12:00フルコース・15:00ショートコース、夜19:30コース・アラカルト19:00〜21:00、22:00閉店、昼夜ともにチャージ料 (2021年8月から500円)、不定休、キャンセルは48時間以内50%・24時間以内100%。食べログ: ケーキ・カフェ、中京区御幸町通夷川上る松本町583-1 フォルム御幸町 1F、7席、ワンドリンク制、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2017年9月22日オープン、予約がない日は休みの場合あり。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): ウェルカムのハーブティー、ぶどう、丹波栗と洋梨、ピスタチオのシフォン、年に一度の栗のコース (3日間)、柑橘のコース、桃のコース、ショートコース5,500円、白味噌のフィナンシェ、生姜のマドレーヌ、東京なら3〜4倍の値段、京都のデザートコースの草分け。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; a set course explained at the counter.

places.name: 天ぷら だるきん (Tempura Darukin)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an omakase of wheat-batter tempura (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and seafood tempura, sea urchin, a dashi chazuke to finish (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: daily 18:00–23:00, reservation only, two seatings starting together at 18:00 and 20:00; closed irregularly. Cancellations or changes in numbers at least two days before. Payment by credit card only — no cash (Tabelog; official site; March 2024). No children except when the shop is booked privately (Tabelog). 7 counter seats (Tabelog; the official site also says six, one turn); non-smoking. Opened April 2019 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Near Shijo-Karasuma — 3 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn exit 15
places.cuisine: Omakase tempura of ingredients rarely fried elsewhere (official site) · signatures: a hand-passed nori crisp with scallop and sea urchin to open; Kita Akari potato aged 18 months, cooked about an hour and a half; chutoro tempura hand roll; zucchini with Parmigiano (official site; 2024–2026 reviews) · seen: Donchicchi horse mackerel from Shimane, nodoguro over rice with shiso and Nara pickles, sawara, masu brushed with soy, slow-fried carrot, lotus root with soy powder, Brussels sprouts with pecorino, firefly squid dashi chazuke, fruit tomato to finish (2024–2026 reviews) · sake pairings explained (February 2022) · about ¥10,000–20,000 a head (Tabelog; reviews)
places.notes: [Tempura · near Shijo-Karasuma, an oden master’s tempura] A seven-seat counter near Shijo-Karasuma opened in 2019 by the owner of the oden shop だるまときんぎょ, who asked why tempura always uses the same ingredients: 18-month-aged potatoes, chutoro hand rolls, zucchini with Parmigiano, a firefly-squid chazuke. Two seatings, 18:00 and 20:00, all start together. Cards only, no cash. No children unless booked privately.

roles: Owner-chef (official site); also runs the oden shop だるまときんぎょ
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the owner of the oden shop だるまときんぎょ opened Darukin in April 2019 out of a wish to widen what tempura can use, starting from the question of why tempura ingredients are always the same; it has become a word-of-mouth hideaway near Karasuma, with art on the walls and a mirror-finished frying station. A February 2022 diner saw the owner running everything alone while still explaining the sake; a March 2024 diner met the chef’s wife at the counter.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「なぜ天ぷらの食材はいつも同じなのか」 — why are tempura ingredients always the same?
chef_bio.specialty: 18-month-aged potato tempura; nori with scallop and sea urchin.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner asked other shops why they all fry the same things — "Because they are delicious" — and found Darukin "challenging that perspective."

March 2024: next to the diner sat a woman in red tights, tiger-print trousers, a red turtleneck and a red tiger cap, with red hair and eyebrows — "She was so charming, and it turned out she was the chef’s wife!"
"Although the owner was busy managing everything alone, he provided thorough explanations of the sake pairings during the meal." — February 2022.
August 2021: the course starts for everyone together, and the diners waited about 15 minutes for a late group — "That was a bit disappointing."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tempuradarukin.com): 天ぷら だるきん、京都・綾小路堺町、旬の素材の天ぷらのおまかせコース、一回転のみ6席のカウンター、「なぜ天ぷらの食材はいつも同じなのか」から出発した大将、18ヶ月熟成キタアカリ、どんちっちアジ、中トロ、のどぐろ、ズッキーニ×パルメジャーノ、海苔に貝柱と雲丹の手渡しの一品、7席、完全予約制・2部制 (18時と20時)、クレジットカード決済のみ、おでん屋「だるまときんぎょ」の大将が2019年4月に開業、伊藤 大輔、18ヶ月熟成じゃがいもを1時間半かけて調理、月〜日 18:00〜23:00、キャンセル・人数変更は2日前まで。食べログ: 天ぷら・日本料理、下京区堺町通綾小路下ル綾材木町198-5、阪急烏丸駅15番出口から徒歩3分、予約のみ、7席、カードのみ、子供は貸切時のみ、禁煙。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 揚げる音、軽い衣、鰆、人参、蓮根、芽キャベツとペコリーノ、ほたるいかの出汁茶漬け、フルーツトマト、一人で切り盛りしながら日本酒の説明 (2022年)、大将の奥さん (2024年)、遅れた組を15分待った (2021年)、1人1万〜2万円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Omakase only; book ahead; cards only.

places.name: Bistro&Wine espace
places.gf_detail: Ask. House brioche, pâté and hachis parmentier sit beside carpaccio, grilled fish and steak; no gluten information (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat and fish bistro, though dishes come with many vegetables (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–14:30 (last orders food 13:45, drinks 14:00) and 17:00–24:00 (last food order 23:00); closed Wednesday and 1–2 other days a month (Tabelog). Lunch is a course only (October 2026 review). Bookings taken, but not for 17:00–20:00 apéro visits; guests who do not drink alcohol pay a ¥500 seat charge (Tabelog). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「チャージなし」. Adults (20+) only. 9 counter seats; non-smoking; cards and IC cards (Tabelog). The owner-chef works alone, so dishes can take time (2025 reviews). 3 min from Sanjo Keihan Stn exits 1–2 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Sanjo Keihan Stn, east of the Kamo River
places.cuisine: Seasonal bistro cooking with natural wine: beef cheek braised four days in red wine, house sausages, beef with house sauce (Tabelog); fig butter and house brioche, pâté de campagne, persimmon and fish carpaccio, sardine confit, hachis parmentier, sautéed milt with burdock, smoked salmon with vegetable purée, grilled young tuna with tomato and basil, outside-skirt steak, carrot rapé, soups with espuma; house natural wine ¥4,000 a bottle (October 2026); a winery grape juice for non-drinkers (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Bistro & natural wine · Sanjo Keihan] A nine-seat counter where one chef cooks seasonal bistro plates — brioche with fig butter, pâté, sardine confit, beef cheek in red wine — and pours natural wines. Lunch is a course; dinner runs to midnight, about ¥6,000–9,000. Adults only; non-drinkers pay ¥500. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe the owner-chef working solo (January, March and November 2025); a June 2026 diner came from Gifu after a post by the chef's wife on Instagram.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal bistro dishes; natural wine.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 diner wrote of "a handsome owner" recommending red, white and orange wines at the counter.
A January 2025 table found ordering everything at once, course-style, a bit hectic with one person serving.
A November 2024 diner wished the solo owner-chef smiled a little more, but found the cooking meticulous and the value great.
An October 2026 lunch guest was disappointed that the house sausage was not preservative-free.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Bistro&Wine espace、ビストロ・ダイニングバー・居酒屋、東山区二町目50 サンラック東山 1F、三条京阪駅1・2番出口から徒歩3分、12:00〜14:30・17:00〜24:00、水曜休み (ほか月1〜2回不定休)、17〜20時のアペロ利用の予約不可、お酒を飲まない方は席料500円、チャージなし、20歳以上のみ、カウンター9席、2022年5月1日オープン、牛ほほ肉の4日漬け赤ワイン煮、自家製ソーセージ、自然派ワイン。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 店主シェフが一人で営む、ブリオッシュといちじくバター、パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、柿と魚のカルパッチョ、イワシのコンフィ、アッシ・パルマンティエ、昼はコースのみ、ハウスワインのボトル4,000円、ソーセージが無添加でないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter only, adults only; ask the chef for recommendations.

places.name: 屋台いなば (Yatai Inaba)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Soy-based oden broth with chikuwa, fu and gyoza among the items; kara-age and tempura are battered (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi broth, kara-age, fish cakes (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Thu 18:00–23:00; Fri and Sat 18:00–24:00; closed Sun–Wed; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken, advised — often full, and walk-ins get turned away (2025–26 reviews). 13 seats: 7 at the counter, tables for 2 and 4; you stand to let people pass to the restroom (Tabelog; January 2026 review). No cards; PayPay (Tabelog). Non-smoking. Late in the evening some dishes sell out (January 2026 review). 400 m from Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of Shijo-Karasuma — 6 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Oden in a gentle, slightly sweet broth: daikon, egg, atsuage, kurumafu, potato, tofu, chikuwa, octopus, cabbage roll, shirataki, gyoza, shrimp shumai, and the favourite battered pickled-ginger tempura; big soy-and-garlic thigh kara-age, enoki kara-age, maitake tempura, foil-grilled shiitake; potato salad made with oden potatoes and eggs, topped with mentaiko or squid shiokara; Sapporo Akaboshi, craft beer, sake (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Oden counter · south of Shijo-Karasuma] A tiny, cheerful oden bar open three nights a week: broth-soaked daikon and potatoes, battered pickled ginger, huge garlicky kara-age and a potato salad made from the oden pot. About ¥2,000–3,500. Thu–Sat from 18:00; book, it fills up.

chef_bio.background: A January 2026 reviewer writes that it began as Kyoto's oldest food stall, loved for 60 years, removed in 2023 despite a petition after a police request to vacate, and revived indoors by devoted fans.
chef_bio.specialty: Oden; kara-age; oden potato salad.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 regular called the owner always kind and the squid-shiokara potato salad good enough to copy at home.
When a party of three had to change its booking time in October 2025, the owner's flexibility touched the group.
A March 2026 regular has twice been turned away on full nights.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 屋台いなば、おでん、下京区東洞院通高辻下ル燈籠町592-1、四条駅から403m、木 18:00〜23:00、金土 18:00〜24:00、日月火水休み、予約可、13席 (カウンター7、テーブル2席・4席)、禁煙、カード不可、PayPay 可。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年7月、英語): やさしい少し甘い出汁のおでん (大根、玉子、厚揚げ、車麩、じゃがいも、豆腐、ちくわ、たこ、ロールキャベツ、しらたき、餃子、海老焼売)、紅しょうがの天ぷら、にんにく醤油のもも唐揚げ、えのきの唐揚げ、舞茸の天ぷら、おでんのじゃがいもと玉子のポテサラ (明太子・いかの塩辛)、Sapporo Akaboshi、クラフトビール、日本酒、京都最古の屋台が2023年に撤去され復活したという話、店主が親切、満席で断られることも。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny, busy oden counter for regulars; book ahead.

places.name: 九時五時 (Kuji Goji)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, bread and hot sandwiches beside omelettes, carpaccio and steamed chicken; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: whitebait omelette, carpaccio, chicken and clam dishes, though vegetables feature (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue, Wed, Fri and Sat 9:00–17:00; closed Mon, Thu and Sun; irregular days on Instagram (Tabelog). Drinkers only — Tabelog: "Not available if no alcohol is ordered. Non-alcoholic drinks are also not allowed." A June 2026 diner noted a sign at the entrance turning away those not drinking alcohol. No bookings: leave your name and phone number and the shop calls when a seat opens; people queue before 9:00 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog). 8 counter seats, a table for 4 and some standing room; children welcome (Tabelog; May 2026 review). 10 min from Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South-east of Gojo-Karasuma — 10 min from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Daytime-drinking Italian small plates that change with the seasons: shirasu omelette with sansho oil, steamed chicken with ginger "golden" sauce, isaki or seasonal carpaccio, lightly boiled conger eel with sansho oil, hard-bread hot sandwiches, appetizer bread, clam pasta, mentaiko-and-shiso pasta; bottled Sapporo Black Label only, wines, sangria and fruit drinks; house maple and walnut cookies to take away (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Daytime Italian & drinks · near Gojo] Named for its hours, nine to five: a bright counter for morning and afternoon drinking with seasonal Italian plates — shirasu omelette with sansho oil, ginger chicken, carpaccio, clam pasta. You must order alcohol; no bookings, leave your number and wait nearby. About ¥3,000–6,000; cash only. Open Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 December 2019 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Shirasu omelette with sansho oil; seasonal small plates.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 couple sharing one pasta found it already split into two plates, but felt the "no entry for those not drinking alcohol" sign might put some guests off, and the lunch prices a little high.
Ordering "two beers" in July 2026, a guest was asked, "Since it's bottled beer, shall I bring one for now?"
A September 2026 visitor was first in line 30 minutes before the 9:00 opening; three more groups queued soon after.

places.notes: [Wagyu hitsumabushi · beside Minamiza, Gion-Shijo] A bright third-floor room by the Minamiza theatre serving A5 wagyu hitsumabushi three ways — plain, with wasabi and shiso, then in kombu dashi — from ¥3,800 for 110 g of lean. Multilingual staff and menus; the operator states the wagyu is halal-certified (certifier not named). Open daily.

chef_bio.philosophy: Only the top 4% of A5 black wagyu, bought as whole cattle (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu hitsumabushi.

places.notes: [Gin bar · Kawaramachi Nijo, the KI NO BI distillery’s machiya] The Kyoto Distillery’s own bar in a renovated townhouse, with stills on display: taste three KI NO BI gins for ¥1,800, or try a matcha tonic, the bourbon-scented Edition K or a martini that brings out the yuzu and sansho. chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: the bar run directly by the Kyoto Distillery, maker of KI NO BI gin, opened 1 June 2020 in a renovated machiya, with distilling equipment on display (July 2026), a tasting counter, sofas and a standing area.

places.notes: [Café and dinner omakase · Rokkaku Shinmachi, a painter’s Taisho house] A 1914 residence, home of the painter 今尾景年 and now a registered cultural property, turned café: clear "hanawarabi" studded with edible flowers (¥2,000 with matcha), kakigori and duck porridge, with garden views and a short tour of the house if you book. roles: Head chef (unnamed), who finishes the dinner sukiyaki and nigiri in front of guests (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the house is the Kubo family residence (旧今尾景年宅), a registered tangible cultural property built in 1914 (大正3年) by 今尾景年, a Shijo-school painter of the Meiji and Taisho eras, who spent the later years of life there. The dinner omakase began on 10 March 2025. Opened 1 March 2023 (Tabelog).

Opened 20 June 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo Shirakawabashi — 3 min walk from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Minimal beer bar of carefully poured Sapporo draughts: five taps, e.g. SORACHI 1984, Edel Pils, Black Label, Kohaku Ebisu, Ebisu Premium Black, Ebisu Meister; half-and-half (2024–2026 reviews) · three sizes from 180 ml: SORACHI 1984 180 ml ¥550; half-and-half 300 ml ¥850; Edel Pils or SORACHI 500 ml ¥850–1,100 (2024–2025 reviews) · popcorn with pepper as the snack; curry from ひがしやま 司 upstairs on occasion (2025–2026 reviews) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Beer bar · Sanjo Shirakawabashi by Higashiyama Stn] A pared-back seven-seat counter with plaster walls and five gleaming taps, pouring Sapporo draughts — SORACHI 1984, Edel Pils, Ebisu black — with care, from small 180 ml glasses, plus a peppery popcorn that guests rave about. The owner, an architect and Kyoto native, chats about the neighbourhood and where to eat next. A ¥200 seat charge. Afternoons and evenings; closed Monday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), an architect and Kyoto native (as reviewers describe)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 20 June 2020. Reviewers describe a narrow bar designed by its architect owner (May 2026), taps cleaned thoroughly every day (December 2025), events and a collaboration with ひがしやま 司 on the floor above (December 2025), an owner who knows the nearby restaurants (August 2024), and a Kyoto-born master who shared festival stories (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Carefully poured Sapporo draught; pepper popcorn.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular turned up at 13:30, before opening, and was kindly let in anyway.
A July 2026 visitor heard from the Kyoto-born master that the Gion Festival really comes alive at night, and that the Abare Kannon is quite exciting.
A January 2026 guest asked how the pepper popcorn is made, and concluded it is best enjoyed at the bar.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビアバー・バー、東山区西町127 三条白川橋ビル 1F、地下鉄東山駅から徒歩3分、火〜日 14:00〜22:00、月曜定休、予約不可、チャージ200円/1名、7席 (カウンター、立ち飲みも)、禁煙、子ども可 (スマホの動画やゲーム機は不可)、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・PayPay・d払い・au PAY 可、2020年6月20日オープン。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年7月、英語): サッポロの生ビール5種 (SORACHI 1984、Edel Pils、Black Label、Kohaku Ebisu、Ebisu Premium Black、Ebisu Meister)、ハーフ&ハーフ、180ml から3サイズ、SORACHI 180ml 550円、ハーフ&ハーフ 300ml 850円、500ml 850〜1,100円、お通しのポップコーン (胡椒)、2階のひがしやま 司のカレー、毎日タップを洗浄、建築家の店主、京都出身のマスター、店主と客の会話、漆喰の壁、テラス。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; ¥200 charge with popcorn; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: 割烹 喜多 (Kappou Kita)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: tempura in wheat batter, dipped in a sauce of dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood tempura rice balls with a dashi sauce, and a fish-led evening kappo (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Wednesday–Monday 10:00–14:00 (tenmusu, lunch only) and 17:00–22:30 (kappo); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Lunch tenmusu are fried to order, three pieces minimum, and sell out — come early (May 2025; July 2024). Reservations accepted; private hire possible (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; non-smoking; takeaway in bamboo-leaf wraps and baskets (Tabelog). On the ground floor of an apartment building in the Matsubara Kyogoku shopping street near Gojo Tenjin Shrine; 9 min walk from Gojo Stn (Tabelog; August 2024). Opened 9 August 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Matsubara Kyogoku shopping street near Gojo Tenjin — 9 min walk from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style tenmusu by day and counter kappo by night, from a chef trained at a noted Gion restaurant (Tabelog; August 2024) · tenmusu: rice cooked in a hangiri, lightly battered tempura dipped in a sauce of dashi, soy, mirin and sugar, wrapped in nori — shrimp, sea bream, squid, anago, salmon, kisu, mentaiko, ayu, firefly squid; seasonal matsutake, autumn salmon, crab, bamboo shoot, sometimes beef fillet (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews) · tenmusu ¥300 each, three or more; dashimaki that sells out early (2024–2025 reviews) · evening: fig stew, mibuna salad, sashimi, smoked sardine, monkfish with ponzu, buri ham, house karasumi, simmered sea-bream roe, a tempura rice bowl; fish cooked low and slow to eat whole (2024–2025 reviews) · lunch ¥1,000–2,000, dinner ¥8,000–10,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Tenmusu and kappo · Matsubara Kyogoku near Gojo Tenjin] A seven-seat counter with two lives. From 10:00, Kyoto-style tenmusu fried to order — plump shrimp, sea bream, anago, seasonal matsutake or crab — dipped in a sweet-savoury dashi sauce, ¥300 each, three or more, with a dashimaki that sells out. At night, an unpretentious kappo of sashimi, house karasumi and seasonal plates from a Gion-trained chef. Takeaway in bamboo leaf. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), trained at a noted Gion restaurant (August 2024 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 9 August 2017; Kyoto-style tempura rice balls from a Japanese-cuisine chef, with rice cooked in a hangiri and a house sauce of dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar; registered as an official listing by the shop. An August 2024 reviewer writes that the owner trained at a prestigious Gion restaurant and runs the shop independently, serving tenmusu by day and kaiseki by night, and that the tenmusu was inspired by backstage visits to geisha.
chef_bio.philosophy: Light batter to bring out the ingredients (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Tenmusu; dashimaki.

anecdotes.text: An August 2024 reviewer titled the visit "Tenmusu inspired by backstage visits to geisha".
A Sunday in March 2026 saw several takeaway orders, likely for cherry-blossom picnics; a late-breakfast guest had firefly-squid tenmusu.
A December 2024 regular, coming often since the opening, ate monkfish with ponzu, buri ham, house karasumi and a tempura rice bowl.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おにぎり・天ぷら・日本料理、下京区天神前町340、五条駅から徒歩9分、水〜月 10:00〜14:00・17:00〜22:30、火曜定休、天むすは昼のみ、予約可、貸切可、カード・電子マネー不可、7席 (カウンター)、禁煙、テイクアウト、2017年8月9日オープン。店の紹介: 松原京極商店街の「Tenmusu Kita」、和食の料理人の京風の天むす、hangiri を使うご飯、素材を生かす薄衣、だしに醤油・みりん・砂糖の自家製のたれ、季節の天むす (秋は松茸と秋鮭、冬は蟹、春は筍)、ときに牛ヒレ、笹と籠の持ち帰り。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年3月、英語): 五条天神の近く、賃貸マンションの1階、祇園の名店で修業した店主、昼は天むす、夜は割烹、天むすは1個300円・3個から、注文後に揚げる、海老、鯛、いか、穴子、鮭、きす、明太子、鮎、ほたるいか、だし巻きはすぐ売り切れ、夜は無花果の煮物、Mibuna のサラダ、お造り、燻製のいわし、アンコウのポン酢、ぶりのハム、自家製のからすみ、鯛の子、天丼。

cultural_comfort.note: Order three or more tenmusu at the counter; takeaway wraps; cash only.

places.name: カーサビアンカ (Casa Bianca)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: the lunch and dinner courses centre on pasta, lasagna and bread (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses with seafood, horse tartare, veal, cheese and dairy desserts (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–21:30; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); walk-ins usually fine at weekday lunch (2025 reviews). 60 seats incl. a counter; non-smoking; parking (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). An old house with high ceilings, blue tablecloths and characterful chairs, on Imadegawa-dori west of Teramachi; about 570 m from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; August–September 2025).
places.neighborhood: Imadegawa-dori west of Teramachi — 10 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Italian in an old house near the Imperial Palace (2025–2026 reviews) · pasta lunch ¥2,600 with assorted antipasti, bread, pasta (e.g. carbonara, lasagna, cold tomato pasta), dessert and espresso; a fish lunch course (2025–2026 reviews) · dinner à la carte or courses: horse tartare, baked octopus, seafood arrabbiata (2025 reviews) · omakase: sea bream and karasumi carpaccio, scallops and shrimp, mushroom carbonara, sea bass in tomato or grilled veal, a dessert platter with herb ice creams, beet bread with refills (February 2026) · lunch about ¥3,000–4,000, dinner ¥10,000–15,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Italian · Imadegawa Teramachi, near the Imperial Palace] A spacious, high-ceilinged Italian in an old house, with blue tablecloths and quirky chairs, long a local favourite. The ¥2,600 pasta lunch is the draw — antipasti, bread, pasta such as carbonara or a cheesy lasagna, dessert and espresso — with omakase courses of carpaccio, pasta and veal or fish at night. Most praise the value and service; one 2025 guest felt rushed as plates were cleared. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a 60-seat Italian on Imadegawa-dori west of Teramachi with parking. Reviewers in 2025–2026 call it a popular, long-known Italian among Kyoto locals (July 2026), in an old building used to good effect (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Pasta lunch; lasagna.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 guest who returned for the lasagna felt hurried as plates — even the dessert fruit — were cleared before finishing, and vowed not to return.
A September 2026 visitor who stopped nearby to buy pickles ended up lunching here, and found the service attentive.
At a February 2026 family gathering the staff kept offering refills of four breads, one apparently made with beets.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン、上京区今出川通寺町西入ル大原口214、出町柳駅から572m、火〜日 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜21:30、月曜定休、予約可、60席、カウンター、禁煙、駐車場あり、カード可、電子マネー不可。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 御所の近く、古い建物、高い天井、青いテーブルクロス、パスタランチ2,600円 (前菜の盛り合わせ、パン、パスタ、デザート、エスプレッソ)、カルボナーラ、ラザニア、冷製のトマトのパスタ、魚のランチコース、馬肉のタルタル、たこのオーブン焼き、魚介のアラビアータ、おまかせ (鯛とからすみのカルパッチョ、帆立と海老、きのこのカルボナーラ、スズキのトマトソースか仔牛のグリル、デザートの盛り合わせ)、ビーツのパン、お皿を下げるのが早かったとの声 (2025年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Set lunches; book for dinner; cards; parking.

places.name: のと正 (Noto Sho)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: eel grilled with a sweet-savoury tare and river-fish dishes; no gluten information (2014–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a river-fish shop of eel, ayu, shijimi and dashimaki (2014–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 9:00–19:00; closed Sunday, Monday when a holiday, and occasionally (Tabelog). Takeaway only — no seats (Tabelog). Reservations (orders) accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On Matsubara-dori just west of Yamato-oji; 5 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn or the Kawaramachi Matsubara bus stop (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Matsubara-dori west of Yamato-oji — 5 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Family river-fish shop, eel first, with tanks of live ayu and fish mainly from Lake Biwa and Shiga (2014–2017 reviews) · Kansai-style eel grilled on site: kabayaki, a whole eel about ¥2,300 (2017), unagi bento — regular about ¥2,000 (May 2026) or built from any eel in the window plus rice — and unadon (2014–2026 reviews) · unagi-maki and egg rolls, Yawata-maki of eel and burdock, eel-liver and heart skewers (2014–2024 reviews) · grilled young ayu, honmoroko, shijimi, duck roast, chirimen sansho, dashimaki (2014–2024 reviews) · takeaway only (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Eel takeaway · Matsubara-dori near Kenninji] A small family river-fish shop, three generations in, grilling Kansai-style eel in the window: generous unagi bento and unadon to go, whole kabayaki, unagi-maki, Yawata-maki and dashimaki, plus Lake Biwa ayu and honmoroko when in season. A neighbourhood fish-market feel; locals buy for New Year and dinner at home. Takeaway only. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a takeaway shop of side dishes, delicatessen and eel on Matsubara-dori; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers describe a specialist in river fish with tanks of live ayu, mostly from Lake Biwa and Shiga (September 2014), a chef grilling eel at the front (May 2017), clear pricing for bento (February 2024), and a business run by three generations of one family (May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Unagi bento; Yawata-maki.

anecdotes.text: A December 2017 shopper, asked to buy a rolled dish for the New Year osechi, switched to the Yawata-maki here and made it a family New Year item.
A May 2026 visitor came after watching a drama about moving to Kyoto, and was impressed that three generations of one family run the shop.
A 2016 reviewer suggested tourists eat the bento on the stone steps near Kenninji — while admitting never having done so, as family lives nearby.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 惣菜・デリ・うなぎ、東山区弓矢町31、京阪清水五条駅から徒歩約5分、市バス河原町松原から東へ徒歩約5分、月〜土 9:00〜19:00、日曜定休 (月曜祝日も休み、ほか不定休)、持ち帰りのみ、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、松原通大和大路西入。口コミ (2014年9月〜2026年5月、英語): 川魚の専門店、琵琶湖と滋賀の魚、生きた鮎の水槽、関西風に店で焼く鰻、蒲焼き1本2,300円ほど (2017年)、鰻弁当、うな丼、う巻き、Yawata-maki、肝やハツの串、若鮎の塩焼き、本もろこ、しじみ、鴨ロース、ちりめん山椒、だし巻き、鰻弁当 並2,000円ほど (2026年5月)、三代続く家族の店。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the window; takeaway only; cards, e-money and QR.

places.name: 京都 鳥八 (Kyoto Torihachi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori seasoned with salt, tare or soy by cut, with fried dishes and a chicken curry to finish; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori counter (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–23:00; Sunday and holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). An early-evening course is offered roughly 17:00–19:00 (February–April 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 15 seats at a U-shaped counter; private hire up to 20; non-smoking, though grill smoke can cling to clothes (December 2025; March 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and transit IC (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley just south of Shijo-Muromachi, 214 m from Shijo Stn (Tabelog; November 2025). Opened 17 November 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Muromachi — 214 m from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori grilled over Kishu binchotan from Japanese brand chickens — 阿波尾鶏 (Awa-odori), Tanba jidori, Date-dori — with selected sake and wine (Tabelog) · omakase courses of about 13–14 dishes, including an all-you-can-drink course ¥7,000 launched for the third anniversary (October 2025–October 2026) · à la carte skewers: thigh, gizzard, heart, breast, neck, wings, ginkgo, zucchini, quail eggs, thick fried tofu · chicken curry or egg over rice to finish (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Shijo-Muromachi, binchotan skewers down an alley] A fifteen-seat U-shaped counter tucked down a narrow lane south of Shijo-Muromachi, grilling brand chickens over Kishu binchotan. Go for the omakase — about 13 skewers and small dishes ending in a chicken curry — or the ¥7,000 course with all-you-can-drink. Early-evening courses are a good deal. Reviews differ on seasoning (some find it mild), and grill smoke lingers. Closed Monday.

roles: Head chef and grill cook not named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: yakitori grilled carefully over Kishu binchotan from local and premium chickens including 阿波尾鶏, Tanba jidori and Date-dori. A November 2025 reviewer counted four staff — a young grill cook, a seasoned server and two others. Opened 17 November 2022 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan yakitori omakase.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner watched a young cook work the grill under the eye of the head chef.
An October 2025 visitor noted the all-you-can-drink ¥7,000 course launched for the third anniversary.
An October 2026 first-timer finished the ¥7,000 course with a chicken curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都 鳥八、焼き鳥・居酒屋、下京区月鉾町59-3、四条駅から214m、火〜土17:00〜23:00、日祝17:00〜22:00、月曜定休、カウンター15席、20名まで貸切可、禁煙、カード・交通系IC 可、2022年11月17日オープン。公式紹介: 紀州備長炭で丁寧に焼く焼き鳥、阿波尾鶏・丹波地鶏・伊達鶏などの地鶏や銘柄鶏、厳選の日本酒とワイン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 四条室町の南の細い路地、U字のカウンター、おまかせ13〜14品、3周年の飲み放題付き7,000円のコース、17時〜19時の早い時間のコース、締めのチキンカレー、味が薄いという声や煙が気になるという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Courses make ordering easy; counter seating only.

places.name: カプリ食堂 (Capri Shokudo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Lemon-seasoned kara-age, fried oysters, chicken cutlet, carbonara and pizza; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Meat- and seafood-led set meals; nothing vegan is marked (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00); dinner 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed irregularly (official site); Tabelog lists it as open year-round. Food can be slow at busy times, as it is often run by one person (October–December 2025). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 20 seats on the 1st floor (6 at the counter) plus a 2nd floor for parties of up to 15 seated or 20 standing; non-smoking; cards (JCB, VISA, Master); average spend about ¥2,000 (official site). Takeout and Uber Eats (official site). At the north-east corner of Karasuma-Manjuji, one block north of Gojo-Karasuma, 3 min from Gojo Stn (official site). Opened 17 December 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma-Gojo — 3 min from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Lemon-cuisine diner using domestic 瀬戸田 lemons in every dish (Tabelog; official site) · lunch set meals about ¥980 with soup, e.g. salt-lemon kara-age, fried oysters, chicken cutlet with tomato-lemon tartare, avocado-lemon hamburg steak, lemon carbonara with salad and appetizers, "Italian rice bowl" of avocado and egg, lemon steak (2024–2026 reviews) · dinner of lemon steak, lemon carbonara, ajillo, margherita, lemon ice macedonia; Christmas courses ¥4,980 and ¥5,980 (official site) · signature lemon mojito (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Italian · Karasuma-Gojo, everything with lemon] A small, cheerful corner diner one block north of Gojo-Karasuma where lemons from Setoda go into every dish. Lunch is a bargain plate of salt-lemon kara-age, fried oysters or lemon carbonara with soup for about ¥1,000; evenings bring lemon steak, ajillo and a showy lemon mojito. Often run single-handed, so lunch can be slow when it fills. Upstairs room for parties. Closed irregularly.

roles: Representative of カプリ食堂 (official site’s commercial-transactions notice)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a Kyoto lemon-cuisine restaurant with two shops — this Karasuma-Gojo original and カプリ食堂 LIMONE VERDE at Imadegawa-Karasuma; the commercial-transactions notice names 金森 陽平 as representative. Tabelog says it uses domestic 瀬戸田 lemons. Reviewers in October and December 2025 describe the Gojo shop as often run by one person. Opened 17 December 2016 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Salt-lemon kara-age; lemon carbonara; lemon mojito.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 lunch guest heard from the owner about a house seasoning made with salt and lemon.
A December 2025 couple paid ¥980 each for fried-oyster and lemon kara-age set meals with soup.
A January 2026 diner added prosciutto to the signature salt-lemon kara-age set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (capri.red): カプリ食堂、京都のレモン料理専門店、烏丸五条店 (下京区大堀町479 1階、五条駅から徒歩3分、烏丸万寿寺の北東角) と今出川御所店 カプリ食堂 LIMONE VERDE の2店、11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)、17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、不定休、1階テーブル8席とカウンター6席、2階は貸切 (着席15名・立食20名)、全席禁煙、カード可 (JCB・VISA・Master)、平均予算2,000円、テイクアウト・Uber Eats、クリスマスコース5,980円・4,980円 (レモンステーキ、レモンカルボナーラ、アヒージョ、マルゲリータ、レモンアイスマチェドニア)、特定商取引法の表記: 代表者 金森陽平。食べログ: イタリアン、国産の瀬戸田レモンを使ったレモン料理専門店、名物のレモンモヒート、20席、2016年12月17日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): ランチの定食980円ほど、塩レモン唐揚げ、カキフライ、トマトレモンタルタルのチキンカツ、アボカドレモンハンバーグ、レモンカルボナーラ、ワンオペで提供が遅いことも。

places.name: LAMARCK (ラマルク)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a French patisserie of cakes, cream puffs and tarts (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream, butter and eggs throughout the cakes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday, and some Mondays; hours may change (Tabelog). Cakes can sell out by late afternoon (June 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 6 seats at three small tables for eat-in, plus takeout; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; cards and e-money, no QR (Tabelog). About 6 min from exit 6 of Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 1 May 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: West of Imadegawa Stn — 6 min from exit 6
places.cuisine: Classic French patisserie (2026 reviews) · vanilla cream puff with almond crunch, filled to order with Tahitian-vanilla custard ¥390–398 · peach shortcake ¥880 · matcha tiramisu ¥860 · pistachio dacquoise with banana ¥860 · moelleux au chocolat · chocolat framboise ¥702 · iri-kyobancha and Japanese chestnut tart ¥715 · savarin in a glass · baked goods to order · coffee, Darjeeling and Earl Grey ¥620 for eat-in (March–October 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sweets · Imadegawa, a small French patisserie] A tiny patisserie a few minutes from Imadegawa Station, named after the Paris street where the chef once lived. The must-have is the cream puff, filled to order with Tahitian-vanilla custard under an almond crunch (about ¥390); the matcha tiramisu, pistachio dacquoise and a rare savarin also have fans. Three small tables for eating in with good coffee. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per an August 2026 review: chef Yoshida trained for five and a half years at Hotel Granvia Kyoto, worked at La Risata, spent two and a half years in France, then trained further at Ke Montebello in Osaka before opening LAMARCK in May 2019; the name comes from Rue Lamarck in Paris, where the chef lived. Tabelog gives the opening as 1 May 2019.
chef_bio.specialty: Vanilla cream puff filled to order; savarin.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor at 16:00 on a Thursday was told only one kind of cake was left, and enjoyed it with Darjeeling.
An April 2026 regular loves the glass savarin, rare for a cake shop, but came back for the cream puff.
A September 2026 visitor rated the matcha tiramisu above the dacquoise, both ¥860.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: LAMARCK (ラマルク)、ケーキ・カフェ、上京区弁財天町333-1、今出川駅から322m、月・木〜日11:00〜18:00、火水定休 (月曜不定休)、イートイン6席 (2人席×3)、禁煙、子供可、カード・電子マネー可、2019年5月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): シェフ Yoshida はホテルグランヴィア京都で5年半、La Risata、フランスで2年半、大阪の Ke Montebello を経て2019年5月に開業、店名はパリで住んでいた Rue Lamarck から。注文後に詰めるタヒチ産バニラのシュークリーム390〜398円、桃のショートケーキ880円、抹茶ティラミス860円、ピスタチオのダックワーズ860円、ショコラフランボワーズ702円、炒り京番茶と和栗のタルト715円、グラスのサバラン。

places.name: 肉家かぐら (Nikuya Kagura)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu with several sauces, simmered dishes, curry and cold noodles to finish; no gluten information is published (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku and meat-kaiseki house (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday, irregularly, and over Obon and New Year (Tabelog). À la carte orders carry a ¥3,300 starter (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「前菜3300円(単品注文のみ)」); courses avoid it. 28 seats: an 8-seat counter downstairs for meat kaiseki, and upstairs a 2-seat bar counter, semi-private rooms for 4 and 6 and a private room for 8, used for yakiniku and suki-shabu; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR including PayPay (Tabelog; July 2025). In a renovated machiya with a small front garden and white noren at Muromachi south of Oshikoji, 188 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 5 April 2012 as 肉家 桜真 in Kamitoba and moved here (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Muromachi-Oike — 188 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: A4 and A5 wagyu from the meat wholesaler Gyusho Kagura, as yakiniku, suki-shabu or meat kaiseki, à la carte or by course (Tabelog) · Kagura course of 13 dishes ¥10,000: seasonal soup, nine-item appetizer platter of wagyu and seasonal vegetables (wagyu nigiri, tongue stew, daikon in oxtail broth), roast beef, tongue and skirt sashimi, grilled top blade with grated daikon, a melon palate cleanser, curry or cold noodles to finish (2024–2026 reviews) · rotating wines and labelled shochu (Tabelog; March 2026)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Muromachi-Oike, a wholesaler's wagyu in a machiya] A meat wholesaler's own restaurant in a renovated townhouse off Muromachi, with a garden path and white noren. Downstairs is a counter for meat kaiseki; upstairs, private rooms for yakiniku and suki-shabu. The ¥10,000 Kagura course runs to 13 plates — wagyu nigiri, roast beef, tongue sashimi, grilled cuts and cold noodles — and is generous. À la carte adds a ¥3,300 starter. Closed Sunday.

roles: Run directly by the meat wholesaler Gyusho Kagura (Tabelog); no chef named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: run directly by the meat wholesaler Gyusho Kagura, serving A5 and A4 wagyu from à la carte to courses, with a regularly changing wine list; moved from Kamitoba to Muromachi-Oike. Tabelog gives the opening as 5 April 2012, under the former name 肉家 桜真.
chef_bio.specialty: Kagura course of wagyu yakiniku and meat kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 diner singled out the wagyu nigiri, tongue stew and daikon in oxtail broth on the appetizer platter.
A March 2026 regular comes back once a year and ends with the cold noodles.
A January 2026 guest found the course portions generous to the point of being overwhelming.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 肉家かぐら (旧店名 肉家 桜真)、焼肉・しゃぶしゃぶ、中京区室町通押小路下る御池之町309、烏丸御池駅から188m、月〜土17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、日曜定休・不定休・お盆と年末年始休み、前菜3,300円 (単品注文のみ)、28席 (1階カウンター8、2階カウンター2・半個室4名と6名・完全個室8名)、20名まで貸切可、禁煙、カード・QR 可、2012年4月5日オープン。公式紹介: 上鳥羽から室町御池に移転、精肉卸 Gyusho Kagura の直営、A5・A4の和牛をアラカルトからコースまで、ワインは定期的に入れ替え。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): かぐらコース13品10,000円、和牛握り、牛タンシチュー、テールスープの大根、ローストビーフ、タンとハラミの刺身、締めのカレーや冷麺、町家を改装、前庭と白い暖簾。

cultural_comfort.note: Courses avoid the ¥3,300 à la carte starter charge.

places.name: comorebi Ramen house
places.gf_detail: Ask: two diners name a gluten-free brown-rice salt ramen, "Shio Genmai Soba" (January and October 2026). The regular noodles and shoyu tare contain wheat, and it is one small open kitchen, so confirm when ordering.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and seafood broths, pork and chicken chashu, quail eggs; a venison ramen in summer (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sat 11:00–14:00; closed Sunday and Monday; hours may change. An April 2026 diner noted reduced opening days for a while. No reservations; queues before opening, with waiting seats inside (2026 reviews). About 8 counter seats facing an open kitchen; bowls are made one at a time, so service is unhurried (2026 reviews). Non-smoking. No cards; e-money and QR (Tabelog). Opened 3 February 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: West of Shijo-Karasuma — about 3 min walk from Shijo Stn exit 4
places.cuisine: A café-like ramen counter of clear, gentle chicken broths without chemical seasoning (2026 reviews) · shoyu ramen ¥1,000 (January 2026); shio ramen with sansho on the side; a gluten-free brown-rice shio ramen; large brown-rice shio with extra vegetables ¥1,700 (February 2026) · toppings: pork and chicken chashu, soft-boiled quail egg, thick menma, seasonal grilled vegetables (2026 reviews) · limited bowls: miso curry, sake-kasu miso, shrimp and tomato miso, chilled ramen, venison shoyu ¥1,600 (2026 reviews) · chicken chashu rice bowl; mushroom and niboshi soy mazesoba; bottled beer (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Ramen · west of Shijo-Karasuma, clear gentle broths] A bright, café-like eight-seat counter near Shijo Station where the owner, trained at the Shiga ramen shop Nikkou, makes each bowl to order: clear chicken shoyu or shio with seasonal vegetables and a gluten-free brown-rice version, plus limited bowls like venison shoyu. Lunch only, Tue–Sat. Some find it pricey or slow, and one found the shio too salty and oily (March 2026).

roles: Owner-chef, not named; trained at a well-known ramen shop in Shiga, "Nikkou" (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 February 2021 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 say the owner previously worked at the famous Shiga ramen shop Nikkou and has won awards; describe a clean, café-like counter with an open kitchen, kind staff, waiting seats placed so waiting guests do not face diners, and a ramen meant to be eaten every day, simple and free from chemical seasoning.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per an August 2026 diner: ramen you could eat every day, gentle on the body.
chef_bio.specialty: Clear shoyu and shio ramen with seasonal vegetables.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular’s limited venison shoyu came with three chashu: "the first slice was delicious—was it beef? The second slice was also delicious—not beef! And the third slice was venison!"
"The broth was quite salty, topped with fragrant chicken oil, but honestly, the strong flavors of the oil and salt made it difficult to appreciate the overall taste." — March 2026.
October 2026: ramen plus a chicken chashu bowl came to over ¥1,500, "a bit pricey for lunch," and the bowl took a while — better "for those who want to take their time."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: comorebi Ramen house、ラーメン、下京区綾小路通新町西入矢田町126 Bell Forme 平安 1F、四条駅から307m、火〜土 11:00〜14:00、日月休み、予約不可、禁煙、カード不可、電子マネー・QR可、2021年2月3日オープン。口コミ (2026年1月〜10月、英語): 店主は滋賀の有名店 Nikkou の出身、受賞歴、カフェのような店内、オープンキッチンのカウンター約8席、待ち席あり、一杯ずつ丁寧に作る、化学調味料なしの澄んだ鶏のスープ、醤油ラーメン1,000円、塩ラーメンに山椒、グルテンフリーの玄米塩ラーメン (Shio Genmai Soba)、玄米塩の大盛り野菜増し1,700円、豚と鶏のチャーシュー、うずらの味玉、太めのメンマ、季節の焼き野菜、限定の味噌カレー・酒粕味噌・海老トマト味噌・冷やし・鹿の醤油ラーメン1,600円、鶏チャーシュー丼、きのこと煮干しの醤油まぜそば、塩が強く油が多いという声、昼に1,500円超えは割高という声、営業日が減っていた時期。

cultural_comfort.note: Order before you sit; many foreign visitors (April 2026).

places.name: ドゥ コション (Deux Cochons)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: onion tart, pâté with country bread, and bread served alongside the cheese and ham (2022–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: charcuterie, pâtés, gizzard confit and cheese (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 18:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change. 12 seats, tables only, for groups of two or more (Tabelog); a November 2023 diner says the name, "two pigs", reflects that it takes parties from two. Non-smoking. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, Amex, Diners); no PayPay — card or cash (Tabelog; October 2025). Tabelog lists no service charge.
places.neighborhood: Near Shijo-Karasuma — 5 min walk from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: A natural-wine bistro bar in a renovated machiya: bottles to choose from the shelf, with a lean towards the Loire (2022–2023 reviews) · glasses from ¥950 (October 2025) · assorted cured ham (two kinds) ¥1,600; chicken-liver pâté with country bread ¥850; sautéed gizzard confit ¥800; grilled corn omelette ¥1,200 (August 2025) · caramelised onion tart, pâté de campagne, lentil and pumpkin salad, bonito carpaccio, French cheeses, seasonal Kyoto vegetables (2022–2025 reviews) · hot coffee and sweets (October 2025)
places.notes: [Natural-wine bistro · near Shijo-Karasuma, Loire bottles] A twelve-seat bistro bar in a machiya near Shijo-Karasuma, with records playing and a shelf of natural wines to pick from — many from the Loire — beside pâté de campagne, an onion tart and cured ham. Tables only, for two or more. Glasses from ¥950. Cards or cash, no PayPay. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner, not named; has a Loire connection per a September 2022 diner
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2019 to 2025 describe a natural-wine bistro in a renovated machiya near Shijo-Karasuma that feels like a Paris bistro, with French cheeses, bottles on the shelf to choose from, a strong showing of Loire wines (the owner seemed to have a Loire connection, September 2022), records in the background, and a small but wine-friendly menu with seasonal Kyoto vegetables.
chef_bio.specialty: Natural wine by the bottle; pâté de campagne; onion tart.

anecdotes.text: "It felt just like a bistro in Paris!" — August 2022.
"The owner seems to have a connection to the Loire Valley in France, and I was truly delighted by the abundance of Loire wines available." — September 2022.
"While the selection of dishes may not be extensive, it was more than enough for enjoying wine." — July 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ドゥ コション (Deux Cochons)、バル・ワインバー、中京区新町通蛸薬師下ル百足屋町372-3、烏丸駅から北西へ徒歩5分、18:00〜22:00、火曜休み、12席 (テーブルのみ、2名から)、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー不可。口コミ (2019〜2025年、英語): 町家を改装した自然派ワインのビストロ、棚から選ぶボトル、ロワールのワインが多い、店名は「2匹の豚」で2名から、グラス950円から、生ハム2種1,600円、鶏レバーパテとパン・ド・カンパーニュ850円、砂肝のコンフィ800円、焼きとうもろこしのオムレツ1,200円、玉ねぎのタルト、パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、レンズ豆とかぼちゃのサラダ、鰹のカルパッチョ、フランスのチーズ、京野菜、レコード、PayPay不可、パリのビストロのよう、料理の品数は多くない。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick a bottle from the shelf; tables for two or more.

places.name: 京都生ショコラ オーガニックティーハウス (Kyoto Nama Chocolat Organic Tea House)
places.gf_detail: Ask: the nama chocolate itself is not described as containing wheat, but the cakes (chocolate cake, apple-raisin cake, marble cheesecake) are not confirmed either way (2026 reviews). Ask the owners.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: nama chocolate is made with cream; cakes come with cream (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 12:00–19:00 (last order); closed irregularly; Tabelog remarks also say closed Tuesday but open on holidays, while the official site says closed on public holidays. Reservations through the official site, up to three groups at a time (Tabelog). 16 seats in two tatami rooms and on the engawa, with a garden view; no air-conditioning in summer 2026, a breeze and mosquito coils instead (reviews). Non-smoking; children welcome; cards (Visa, Master, Amex), e-money and QR (official site; Tabelog). Take-home nama chocolate packed with ice packs. Opened 17 September 2005 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, near Heian Shrine and the zoo — 3 min walk from the Okazaki-michi bus stop; 15 min from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: A tea house of nama chocolate in an old house with a garden, with organic coffee and drinks of pesticide-free juice (official site) · chocolate set with a drink ¥1,320: four nama chocolates — sweet, bitter, matcha and cranberry or berry (June and October 2026) · chocolate cake on a plate of fruit and herbs, apple-raisin cake, marble cheesecake, cold chocolate (2026 reviews) · organic Japanese black tea, dandelion coffee, a house blend of Japanese tea served on arrival (2026 reviews) · nama chocolate boxes to take away (official site)
places.notes: [Nama-chocolate tea house · Okazaki, an old house and garden] Down a narrow lane near Heian Shrine, a tea house in an old farmhouse-style home with two tatami rooms and an engawa over the garden, run by a couple — she explains in English, he in Japanese (June 2026). A ¥1,320 set of four nama chocolates with a drink, cakes plated with flowers, and boxes to take home. No air-conditioning in summer. Up to three groups booked at once.

roles: Run by a couple, not named (June 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 17 September 2005 (Tabelog), in a renovated old Kyoto house near Heian Shrine (official site). A June 2026 diner describes a couple: the wife, from overseas, serves mainly in English with detailed explanations, while the Japanese husband helps take-out customers in Japanese; they brought a cushion and moved the fan for comfort and dimmed the lights for the chocolate. An October 2026 diner found the owner running it alone that day. Earlier visitors (2016) met a dog and a cat.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: organic, body-friendly drinks and cakes; nama chocolate that melts in the mouth.
chef_bio.specialty: Nama chocolate set.

anecdotes.text: June 2026: "The wife is from overseas, while the husband is Japanese. The wife primarily handles the service in English… When takeout customers arrive, the husband assists them in Japanese."
A July 2026 diner ordered chocolate cake and got "a dessert plate that looked like a jungle on the plate" — watermelon and, it seemed, a mugwort sauce.
"Even in the middle of summer, there’s no air conditioning! The scent of mosquito coils fills the air." — September 2026.
October 2026: the worn menu made some prices hard to read, and "since no one came to check on me, I was able to relax and take my time."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都生ショコラ オーガニックティーハウス、平安神宮の近くの古民家を改装したティーハウス、オーガニックの飲み物やケーキ、生チョコレートは保冷袋でお土産に、オーガニックコーヒー、無農薬果汁のドリンク、ビター・スウィート・抹茶の生チョコ、2005年創業、月〜日 12:00〜19:00、祝日休み、駐車場なし、カード (VISA・Master・AMEX)・電子マネー・QR可、全席禁煙、左京区岡崎天王町76-15。食べログ: カフェ・チョコレート、予約は公式サイトから (3組まで)、16席、座敷、テラス、子供可、不定休 (火曜休みで祝日は営業とも)、2005年9月17日オープン。口コミ (2016年、2026年4月〜10月、英語): 海外出身の奥さんが英語で、日本人のご主人が日本語で接客、チョコレートセットとドリンク1,320円 (スウィート・ビター・抹茶・クランベリー)、チョコレートケーキ、りんごとレーズンのケーキ、マーブルチーズケーキ、コールドチョコレート、和紅茶、たんぽぽコーヒー、最初にブレンドの日本茶、生花の飾り、エアコンなしで蚊取り線香と扇風機、縁側の席、細い路地の奥、入口がわかりにくい、メニューが古く値段が読みにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Service in English and Japanese (June 2026).

places.name: FACTORY KAFE 工船 (Kafe Kosen)
places.gf_detail: Ask: coffee itself is fine, but the food is toast, cakes and bread (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: black coffee is plant-based; floats, cheesecake and banana toast are not (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 12:00–21:00; closed Tuesday, open when a holiday falls on Tuesday; hours may change; temporary closures posted on the roaster’s site (official site). No reservations; second floor, often full on weekend afternoons (2026 reviews). 7 counter seats per Tabelog; a September 2026 diner also saw tables. Smoking allowed inside (Tabelog; June and September 2026). No cards per Tabelog; e-money and QR; a September 2026 diner listed card, e-money, PayPay and cash. Take-out.
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-Imadegawa — 2 min walk from the Kawaramachi-Imadegawa bus stop; 5 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: The café of the Kyoto roaster オオヤコーヒ焙煎所: home-roasted, flannel-drip coffee (official site) · no blend: choose origin, roast and "rich" or "light" — Thailand, Indonesia, Brazil, Peru; served in a small pot (2026 reviews) · coffee float ¥1,200 with clove-and-orange-peel or Earl Grey ice cream (August–September 2026) · peach soda, banana toast, muscat rare cheesecake, desserts and bread (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Coffee house · Kawaramachi-Imadegawa, the Ooya roaster’s flannel-drip café] A second-floor café in a retro building near Demachiyanagi, run by the Kyoto roaster Ooya Coffee: no blends — pick the origin and say "rich" or "light", and it comes flannel-dripped in a little pot. Coffee floats with clove-and-orange ice cream, banana toast. Smoking is allowed inside. Busy with tourists on weekends. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Run by オオヤコーヒ焙煎所 (official site); a September 2026 diner names the roaster as "Minoru Ooya"
chef_bio.background: Per the official site of オオヤコーヒ焙煎所 (ooyacoffee associees, since 2007): the roaster’s directly run shops are this flannel-drip coffee house in Kyoto, a ten-days-a-month stand in Shirahama, Wakayama, and Café gewa in Kurashiki, Okayama; it also sells by contract and wholesale. Reviewers in 2026 describe a clean, calm second-floor room with a green view, friendly staff, a counter facing an open kitchen, and a crowd of couples, women and tourists.
chef_bio.specialty: Flannel-drip single origins; coffee float.

anecdotes.text: "It was also wonderful to find a stylish café that allows smoking, which is quite rare." — June 2026.
A September 2026 diner asked about the light roast’s strong aroma and learned "it can sometimes occur with freshly roasted beans."
August 2026: the clove-and-orange ice cream had run out; the Earl Grey one "didn’t have much of an Earl Grey flavor."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ooyacoffeeassociees.com): オオヤコーヒ焙煎所、直営店は自家焙煎ネルドリップコーヒー専門店の京都 KAFE工船、毎月10日間限定営業の和歌山・白浜STAND!、岡山・倉敷のカフェゲバ、家庭用の契約販売と業務用卸、2007年〜。食べログ: FACTORY KAFE 工船、カフェ、上京区河原町通今出川下ル梶井町448 清和テナントハウス2F G号室、河原町今出川バス停から徒歩2分、出町柳駅から徒歩5分、12:00〜21:00、火曜休み (祝日は営業)、予約不可、カウンター7席、喫煙可、カード不可、電子マネー・QR可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): ネルドリップ、ブレンドはなく産地と焙煎度と「濃い」「軽い」を選ぶ、タイ・インドネシア・ブラジル・ペルー、ポットで出る、コーヒーフロート1,200円 (クローブとオレンジピールのアイス)、アールグレイのアイス、桃のソーダ、バナナトースト、マスカットのレアチーズケーキ、2階、週末は満席、観光客が多い、店内で喫煙できる、焙煎家 Minoru Ooya。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff ask about taste and suggest beans; smoking allowed inside.

places.name: ギャルソン クレープ (Creperie GARCON)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Savoury galettes and sweet crepes; the batters are not described, and crepe batter is usually wheat (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter, caramel, cheese, ham and egg (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue, Wed, Fri–Sun 11:30–18:00; closed Mon and Thu; hours may change (Tabelog) — a July 2026 regular found it open by 10:30, opening as soon as everything was ready. No bookings; one order per person; no photos of the interior (menu and food photos are fine) (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 10 table seats in a long, narrow room; one crepe is cooked at a time, so it takes a while (Tabelog; July 2026 review). Near Yasui Konpira Shrine; 675 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: By Yasui Konpira Shrine, between Gion and Kiyomizu
places.cuisine: Crisp, fragrant galettes and crepes, toppings laid on top rather than wrapped: omakase galette with prosciutto, camembert, salad and fig; ham, cheese and mushroom galette; crepes with homemade caramel sauce, chocolate-orange with walnuts, fig and banana caramel, apple compote in January, seasonal fruit such as pineapple; fresh melon with caramel ¥1,780 and fresh lemon, sugar and butter (July 2026); crepes from over ¥1,000 (January 2026); coffee, cider, plum juice, a glass of wine (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Crêperie · by Yasui Konpira Shrine] A narrow, European-style crêperie where galettes and crepes come crisp and fragrant, one at a time: prosciutto-camembert-fig galette, then a crepe with house caramel or seasonal fruit. About ¥1,500–2,500. Cash only; no bookings; one order each. Closed Mon and Thu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 April 2015 (Tabelog). A June 2026 diner felt it was run like a family business.
chef_bio.specialty: Crisp galettes; caramel crepes.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 galette eater wished the savoury galettes were warmer and the egg cooked longer, and preferred the banana-caramel dessert.
In June 2026 the long room was full of Western tourists and some arrivals were turned away.
An October 2025 regular about to move away came once more for the fig caramel crepe, minus the banana.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ギャルソン クレープ (Creperie GARCON)、クレープ・ガレット・カフェ、東山区下弁天町53-3、祇園四条駅から675m、火水金土日 11:30〜18:00、月木休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、テーブル10席、禁煙、2015年4月10日オープン、注文はお一人様一品、店内の撮影不可 (メニューと料理は可)。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年7月、英語): Yasui Konpira Shrine の近く、パリッと香ばしい生地、生ハム・カマンベール・いちじくのガレット、自家製キャラメルソースのクレープ、チョコとオレンジ、いちじくとバナナ、1月のりんごのコンポート、生メロンのキャラメル1,780円、生レモンのシュガーバター、クレープは千円超から、一枚ずつ焼くので時間がかかる、欧米の観光客で満席の日も。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu displayed outside; no interior photos; cash only.

places.name: おばんざいと野菜 内儀家 (Obanzai to Yasai Kamiya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai and grilled dishes with soy-based seasoning; dumplings and salt yakisoba are wheat (2022–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables lead, but obanzai and oden use dashi and there is chicken (Tabelog; 2022–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–21:00; closed Tuesday; may close early without notice; see the website for closures (Tabelog). Bookings by phone or e-mail; a cancellation fee applies to no-shows (Tabelog). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「お通し代 あり」 — an appetizer charge. No cards; PayPay (Tabelog; official site). English menu (Tabelog). Children generally not allowed (Tabelog). 14 seats: 10 at the counter, 4 at tables; all non-smoking (official site). The shop notes its Tabelog page is not kept up to date. On the Kiyamachi riverside lane; 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn exit 2, 3 min from Sanjo Keihan (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi — 2 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Obanzai and Kyoto vegetables with sansho from the shop's own pesticide-free farm, using mainly produce from Miyama (official site): assorted obanzai, lotus-root and beef kinpira with sansho, grilled Miyama chicken, sansho uni tofu, grilled inari with Kujo green onion, yuzu inari, chicken with yuzu pepper, salt yakisoba, dumplings with tsukune, oden; sansho highballs; red sansho "Miyama Ruby" and sansho pepper to take home (official site; 2022–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Obanzai & sansho · Kiyamachi] A small adult counter bar on the Kiyamachi lane, with a tiny garden, built around sansho from its own farm: obanzai platters, grilled Miyama chicken, kinpira and highballs all tingling with it, and extra sansho on the table. About ¥4,000–8,000. Evenings only; cash or PayPay; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 25 January 2008 (Tabelog). Per the official site: a small, quiet adult drinking spot where one can unwind alone after work or sightseeing; sansho grown without pesticides on its own farm, and ingredients mainly from Miyama, Kyoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: Sansho dishes for their fresh aroma and distinctive tingle (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sansho dishes; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner praised dishes that gently bring out the ingredients, and above all the sansho ones.
An August 2026 traveller found the room homey and had fun adding the extra sansho on the table.
A February 2024 visitor went home with the red sansho and sansho pepper as souvenirs.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 内儀家 (かみや)、高瀬川沿い、上木屋町の閑静な佇まい、仕事帰りや観光後に一人でもほっと一息つける小さな大人の酒処、自家農園で無農薬栽培の山椒を使った山椒料理、京都・美山産を中心とした食材、全席禁煙、クレジットカード不可・PayPay 可、赤山椒「美山のルビー」の通販。食べログ: おばんざいと野菜 内儀家、居酒屋・野菜料理・焼き鳥、中京区木屋町通二条下ル上樵木町495-1 伊藤ビル1F、17:00〜21:00、火曜休み、お通し代あり、カウンター10席・テーブル4席、英語メニュー、子供は原則不可、メール予約可、無断キャンセルはキャンセル料、2008年1月25日オープン、食べログの情報は更新していない。口コミ (2022年2月〜2026年8月、英語): おばんざい盛り合わせ、山椒のきんぴら、美山の地鶏、山椒ハイボール、山椒の雲丹豆腐、焼き稲荷、卓上の山椒。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); counter seating; adults.
