places.name: 西角 (Saikaku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-based Kyoto cooking with soy, tempura and cha soba; no gluten information (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-centred Kyoto cuisine in dashi (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch Mon, Tue, Fri, Sun 12:00–13:30, booked by the day before; dinner Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday and the 3rd Tuesday (Tabelog). The official site gives 17:00–21:00. Bookings by phone; "a small shop — we would be glad if you booked" (official site). Course ¥12,000 or à la carte, plus consumption tax only (official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) (Tabelog). Counter, tables and a room with tatami (official site); 20 seats; children welcome (Tabelog). Tabelog lists parking; the official site says there is none, with coin parking in front (the street is one-way northbound). A short way into the Demachi shopping street, about 8 min from Demachiyanagi Stn or 5 min from the nearest city bus stop (official site; April 2024 review).
places.neighborhood: Demachi shopping street — 8 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Quiet seasonal Kyoto cuisine, as a ¥12,000 course or à la carte (official site): a seasonal appetizer platter, sashimi of sawara and sea bream, the seasonal steamed dish — chestnut with fish in October, green peas in March — guji (sweet sea bream) cooked as you choose: salt-grilled, sake-steamed, fried, simmered or agedashi; tempura of kuruma prawn, firefly squid and mountain vegetables; hamo in summer; to finish, rice with chirimen-jako and pickles or cha soba, then warabi mochi; a broad sake list (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Demachi shopping street] A calm little Kyoto restaurant off the Demachi arcade, by counter, table or tatami room: seasonal appetizers, a celebrated steamed dish of the season, and guji cooked whichever way you like. Course ¥12,000 or à la carte, plus tax only. Book ahead; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site, running since about 2008 (site copyright 2008–2026); its motto is 「ゆき過ぎず ひかえめに」 — never overdone, always restrained — following Kyoto's seasons in nourishing food. A July 2026 diner describes the owner and the hostess.
chef_bio.philosophy: Restrained cooking that follows the Kyoto seasons (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Guji prepared to order; the seasonal steamed dish.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 regular on a third visit had a favourite hotel's concierge book it, and likes that it serves à la carte.
A party of three in March 2026 shared one guji cooked three ways: head salt-grilled, middle simmered, tail fried.
An October 2026 diner ordered the chestnut steamed dish a second time.
A July 2026 diner called the owner and the hostess "true gentlemen and ladies".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 御料理 西角、上京区出町桝形、「ゆき過ぎず ひかえめに 京の四季の移ろいを 滋味あふれるお料理とともに」、コース12,000円〜・一品料理 (別途消費税のみ)、17:00〜21:00、毎週水曜・毎月第3火曜休み、カウンター・テーブル・お部屋 (畳、4名まで)、小さい店なので予約を、電話予約、駐車場なし (店の前にコインパーキング、北行き一方通行)、市バス河原町今出川から徒歩約5分、京阪出町柳駅から徒歩約8分。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本料理、上京区今出川通河原町西入ル三芳町134、ランチ (月火金日 12:00〜13:30、前日までに予約)、ディナー 17:00〜22:00、20席、カード可、子供可。口コミ (2023年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 八寸、季節の蒸し物 (栗、えんどう豆)、ぐじを焼き・酒蒸し・揚げ・煮付け・揚げ出しから選ぶ、天ぷら、ちりめんじゃこのご飯か茶そば、わらび餅、日本酒、ご主人と女将。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter, tables or a tatami room; book by phone.

places.name: お弐かいSECOND (Onikai SECOND)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-simmered vegetables, sashimi with soy, shrimp cutlet and tempura; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: vegetables are simmered in dashi; fish and beef dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily; closing days vary; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings via the website or by phone; full from opening on some nights (2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On the 2nd and 3rd floors of a renovated machiya — look for a small sign and stairs; a counter wraps the kitchen, private rooms upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Dishes come in single or two-person portions (2026 reviews). 2 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; September 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: South-east of Karasuma Oike — 2 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: New-style Kyoto izakaya of vegetables in good dashi: the signature simmered vegetables, each seasoned differently (eggplant, Kujo green onion, potato); beef rolls with egg; fresh and fried yuba; sea bream sashimi with shiso-eggplant wasabi soy; eggplant with hamo and ponzu; Kujo green onion and octopus nuta; anago simmered with sansho; shrimp cutlet of 100% shrimp; pear Caesar salad; silver clay-pot rice (salmon and green onion, wasabi greens) finished as chazuke with dashi (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kyoto vegetables & dashi · near Karasuma Oike] A young, upbeat counter upstairs in a renovated machiya: dashi-simmered seasonal vegetables, beef rolls with egg, an all-shrimp cutlet and a crisp-bottomed clay-pot rice you finish as chazuke. About ¥4,000–5,000. Daily from 17:00; book, it fills fast.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 April 2026 (Tabelog). Reviewers place it in the 五十家 (Isoya) group as the second お弐かい, after the Kawaramachi shop (October 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Simmered vegetables; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner liked that dishes come as individual portions, so nothing has to be shared, and found it packed from opening.
An October 2026 guest who called on spec got a 20:00 seat and found the young staff quick and efficient.
A group of four in October 2026 found the Kawaramachi お弐かい menu longer, but everything here just as good.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お弐かいSECOND、居酒屋、中京区姉小路通室町東入柿本町411 2F・3F、烏丸御池駅から134m、17:00〜23:00 (定休日不定)、予約可、個室あり、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2026年4月19日オープン。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): 五十家グループ、河原町のお弐かいの2号店、町家の改装、小さな看板と階段、厨房を囲むカウンター、若いスタッフ、名物の炊いた野菜 (なす、Kujo ねぎ、じゃがいも)、牛肉巻きと卵、生湯葉と揚げ湯葉、鯛のお造りに大葉なすのわさび醤油、なすと鱧のポン酢、ねぎとたこのぬた、穴子の山椒煮、海老100%の海老カツ、梨のシーザーサラダ、銀の土鍋ご飯を出汁で茶漬けに、一人前ずつの盛り付け。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter around the kitchen; staff explain dishes.

places.name: チャコール (Charcoal)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: pasta (penne, peperoncino), bread with the ajillo, macaroni salad (2025–26 reviews). Ask about the charcoal-grilled meat and vegetables.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, and the shop grills seasonal vegetables over charcoal (official site); most courses include meat and fish.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day cancellations are charged for the meals booked (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). 38 seats: a counter downstairs, sunken-kotatsu seating and private rooms upstairs; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; June 2025). Heated tobacco only in a designated area; smoking outside the entrance (Tabelog). Children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). In an alley between Shijo and Nishinotoin; 3 min from Shijo Karasuma Stn exit 24 (Tabelog; September 2026). One unisex restroom, with a queue on a busy night (October 2025).
places.neighborhood: Shijo Karasuma, an alley off Kamanza — 3 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal-grilled vegetables and meat with plenty of wine in a renovated machiya (official site) · five-item appetizer platter with mackerel macaroni salad (August 2026) · garlic-heavy ajillo with bread (April 2025; August 2026) · steak with mashed potatoes, carpaccio, smoked mackerel, avocado (May 2026) · grilled edamame, chicken with a tsukimi sauce (November 2026) · cheese penne, Gorgonzola cream penne, shirasu peperoncino (May–September 2026) · course with all-you-can-drink ¥5,500 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Charcoal grill and wine · Shijo Karasuma, a machiya in a back alley] A hidden machiya with a bar counter downstairs and sunken-kotatsu rooms upstairs, grilling seasonal vegetables and meat over charcoal to go with a long wine list — plus ajillo, appetizer platters and penne. Courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥5,500 suit groups; staff are lively, though big parties slow the kitchen. Open to midnight; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (lotus0610.com): one of three shops in the same Shijo Karasuma back alley — the Italian bar スモーク＆グリル ロータス, this machiya dining room 炭火焼×ワイン チャコール with private rooms and sunken-kotatsu seats upstairs, and the standing bar スタンド酒場 ステム.
chef_bio.philosophy: Vegetables chosen down to harvest time and size, and carefully selected meat, each grilled over charcoal (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled meat and vegetables; ajillo.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 group of nine had a ¥5,500 course with all-you-can-drink upstairs; one guest found the red wine served too warm, and the staff cheerfully took the group photo.
A May 2026 diner loved the mashed potatoes with the steak and found the sunken-kotatsu seats surprisingly cosy for an Italian place.
An October 2025 diner liked the meat but found the rest average and queued 15 minutes for the single restroom.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 四条烏丸の路地裏の3店 (スモーク＆グリル ロータス、炭火焼×ワイン チャコール、スタンド酒場 ステム)、チャコールは町屋を改装した隠れ家のようなイタリアン、旬の野菜と厳選した肉の炭焼きと豊富なワイン、2階に個室と掘りごたつ席。食べログ: イタリアン・バル・居酒屋、中京区釜座通炭之座町416、四条烏丸駅24番出口から徒歩3分、月〜土17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、日曜休み、予約可 (当日キャンセルは料理代)、カード・PayPay 可、38席、加熱式たばこの喫煙所、子供可、ベジタリアンメニューあり。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年11月、英語): アヒージョとパン、前菜5種盛り、ステーキとマッシュポテト、ペンネ、しらすのペペロンチーノ、飲み放題付きコース5,500円、明るい店員、トイレが一つ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book and order à la carte or a course; friendly, energetic staff (2025–26 reviews). No English evidence found.

places.name: 八坂 (Yasaka, Park Hyatt Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Teppanyaki courses cooked with French technique — beurre blanc and other sauces, an onion soufflé (2022–25 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; the courses centre on Omi and Kuroge wagyu, shrimp and fish (2022–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Two dinner sittings daily, 17:00–19:30 and 20:00–22:30; open all year (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). Service charge 15% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料15%」). Cards incl. UnionPay; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter seats around teppan stations facing the Yasaka Pagoda — 20 per Tabelog, 10 at two stations per a May 2022 review; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Guests aged 12 and over (Tabelog reservation notes; elsewhere Tabelog says 10 and over). No sleeveless sports tops, tank tops, sportswear or open-toed sandals; dress shorts are fine (Tabelog). Wheelchair accessible; hotel valet parking ¥2,000 for up to 4 hours with a restaurant visit (Tabelog). In Park Hyatt Kyoto, 6 min from the Higashiyama Yasui bus stop (Tabelog). Opened 30 October 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kodaiji, in Park Hyatt Kyoto — 6 min from Higashiyama Yasui bus stop
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki cooked with French technique at counters facing the Yasaka Pagoda — come for sunset (2022–26 reviews) · the Seiryu course with a 130 g Omi beef strip loin steak (May 2025); Kuroge wagyu, seasonal vegetables and seafood (October 2024) · Wakayama ashiaka shrimp and fish with beurre blanc, an onion soufflé (May 2022); fromage frais with caviar and cucumber, summer Kyoto ingredients (August 2025); sea urchin with cucumber (June 2024) · wine pairings from Ruinart Blanc de Blancs or Krug, and a non-alcoholic pairing (2022–25 reviews) · a ¥20,000 course plus a bottle came to ¥36,000 each (May 2022)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Kodaiji, the Park Hyatt’s counter facing the Yasaka Pagoda] Park Hyatt Kyoto’s main dining room: teppan counters with the Yasaka Pagoda and the roofs of Higashiyama filling the window, where chefs cook Omi beef, shrimp and seasonal Kyoto produce with French sauces. Book a sitting near sunset. Courses from about ¥20,000, plus 15% service and pricey wine; English explanations. Guests 12 and over; no sportswear.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the teppanyaki and French restaurant of Park Hyatt Kyoto, opened 30 October 2019. A May 2022 review called it the hotel’s main dining room and named Chef Kanpei Kuki, formerly Michelin-starred at La Truffière in Paris, as bringing French technique to the teppan; no current source confirms who leads the kitchen now. A March 2022 review places it on the 4th floor.
chef_bio.specialty: Teppanyaki with French technique; Omi beef.

anecdotes.text: A May 2022 diner booked an hour before sunset to watch the Yasaka Pagoda over champagne, and called the 15% service charge “a body blow”.
An August 2025 diner on the day after the Okuribi watched an evening shower and then the sunset over the pagoda through the window.
An August 2024 diner found many overseas guests and the English explanations well done.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鉄板焼・フレンチ・イノベーティブ、東山区高台寺桝屋町360、Park Hyatt Kyoto 内、東山安井バス停から徒歩6分、毎日17:00〜19:30・20:00〜22:30、予約のみ、サービス料15%、カード可 (銀聯含む)、カウンター20席、12歳以上 (別項では10歳以上)、ドレスコード (スポーツウェア・タンクトップ・サンダル不可)、車椅子可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、2019年10月30日オープン。口コミ (2022年3月〜2026年8月、英語): 八坂の塔を望むカウンター、夕日の時間がおすすめ、鉄板でフランス料理の技法、Omi の牛肉のステーキ130g、Wakayama の海老、ワインとノンアルコールのペアリング、英語の説明、料理長の名前は2022年5月の口コミのみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests and well-done English explanations (August 2024). Book a sitting; guests 12 and over; no sportswear or open-toed sandals.

places.name: 七条ふたば (Nanajou Futaba)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-cake sweets — mame mochi dusted with flour, daifuku, ohagi, dango, warabi mochi (2026 reviews); the dusting flour is not identified.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Mochi, red peas and bean paste, but no ingredient information.
places.hours_raw: Wed–Sun 9:00–17:00; closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). Take-away only. CASH ONLY — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; September 2026). Orders by phone (Tabelog). Goods may not be ready right at opening (September 2026), and by about 16:00 much has sold out (August 2026). On Shichijo east of Omiya; 2 min from the Shichijo Omiya bus stop (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shichijo east of Omiya — 2 min from Shichijo Omiya bus stop
places.cuisine: Mame mochi — soft mochi with salted red peas and smooth bean paste — ¥250 in September 2026 (¥200 in August 2024, ¥180 in December 2023) · mame daifuku, two for ¥500 (October 2026); black bean daifuku, chestnut daifuku that often sells out (October 2026) · chestnut steamed yokan (September and October 2026) · ohagi, tsukimi dango, warabi mochi (September 2026); inoko mochi (October 2026) · chestnut sekihan, small ¥450 (October 2026) · small boxed bento (September 2026)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Shichijo Omiya, the other Futaba mame mochi] A small shop on Shichijo selling mame mochi in the Futaba style — salted red peas and smooth bean paste in soft mochi, ¥250 — plus daifuku, ohagi, chestnut yokan and sekihan, with none of Demachi Futaba’s queues. Reviewers find it close to Demachi’s, a little different in texture and salt. Cash only; go early, as things sell out. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the link to 出町ふたば differently: an August 2026 reviewer researched it and found it is not a branch but a separate shop; a September 2026 reviewer calls it a spin-off; other September and October 2026 reviewers call it a branch. No official source was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Mame mochi.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor bought mame mochi like those a seminar professor used to bring to class, with four left at about 16:00.
A September 2026 Kyoto regular cycles here instead of queueing for Futaba at Takashimaya, and found the salt and bean paste balance unmistakably Futaba.
A September 2026 visitor ate the mame mochi and chestnut yokan while waiting for the dolphin show at the nearby Kyoto Aquarium.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和菓子・大福、下京区七条通大宮東入大工町120-2、七条大宮バス停から徒歩2分、水〜日9:00〜17:00、月火休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可。口コミ (2023年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 豆餅250円 (2024年8月は200円、2023年12月は180円)、豆大福2個500円、黒豆大福、栗大福、栗蒸し羊羹、おはぎ、月見団子、わらび餅、亥の子餅、栗赤飯 (小) 450円、夕方には売り切れも、出町ふたばとの関係は口コミにより「支店」「別の店」「暖簾分け」とさまざま。

cultural_comfort.note: Point and buy at the counter; cash only; pleasant staff (October 2026).

places.name: 洋食彩酒 アンプリュス (Yoshoku Saishu Anpurusu)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: crab cream croquette, fried shrimp, chicken and fillet katsu, demi-glace hamburg steak (2023–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, beef stew, duck, shrimp and crab dishes (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–13:30, dinner 18:00–21:30 (last order 20:30); closed Tuesday, Wednesday and irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and, per the shop, a must; lunch can be fully booked (Tabelog; October 2025). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「なし」). A few counter seats at the front, tables down a narrow passage at the back with a window onto a shrine approach (November 2025). 3 min from Hankyu Omiya and Randen Shijo-Omiya Stns (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo Omiya — 3 min from Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Yoshoku and bistro cooking with organic vegetables from producers, natural wine and champagne, with pairings (Tabelog, shop text) · Anpurusu lunch: amuse-bouches such as carrot mousse and a mushroom-walnut pâté canapé, salad, and a choice of five mains (November 2025; January 2026) · Anpurusu plate of demi-glace hamburg steak, fried shrimp and crab cream croquette, ¥1,870 (August 2024; 2025–26 reviews) · Ladies’ set ¥3,960, domestic beef tenderloin steak ¥4,400 (August 2024) · beef stew, shrimp gratin (September 2026) · chicken katsu with oriental sauce (August 2025) · homemade mini canelés and langue de chat with coffee (May 2025) · glasses of wine from ¥1,000 (August 2024)
places.notes: [Yoshoku bistro · Shijo Omiya, demi-glace and natural wine] A small neighbourhood yoshoku house where the owner-chef chats across the counter: a rich demi-glace hamburg steak, shrimp fry and crab cream croquette on the Anpurusu plate, beef stew and bistro à la carte at night, with natural wines and homemade canelés to finish. Regulars come back a dozen times; book, as lunch fills. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who talks with guests at the counter (Tabelog, shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): authentic bistro cooking at an affordable price, organic vegetables bought directly from producers, and natural wines and champagnes chosen to pair. An October 2025 first-timer felt it was a homey place run by a couple.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic flavours in a relaxed setting, for special occasions or an ordinary meal (Tabelog, shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Demi-glace hamburg steak; the Anpurusu plate.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 regular on an eighth visit asked for a fruity white and was poured a southern French wine with a summer-citrus nose — and found the milk for the tea properly warmed.
An October 2025 diner, turned away from a fully booked lunch the month before, booked dinner and was the only party there.
A January 2026 diner ate the fried shrimp whole, head and all.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食・フレンチ・ビストロ、中京区壬生賀陽御所町64-18 マキシムⅢ 1F、大宮駅・四条大宮駅から徒歩3分、昼11:30〜13:30、夜18:00〜21:30 (L.O. 20:30)、火水休み (不定休あり)、予約可、カード・PayPay 可、チャージなし。店の紹介 (英訳): 生産者直送の有機野菜、自然派ワインとシャンパーニュ、ペアリング、カウンターで店主と話せる、予約必須。口コミ (2023年11月〜2026年9月、英語): アンプリュスプレート (ハンバーグ、海老フライ、蟹クリームコロッケ) 1,870円、レディースセット3,960円、国産牛ヒレステーキ4,400円、ビーフシチュー、チキンカツ、自家製のカヌレとラングドシャ、昼は満席のことも。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; choose a main from the lunch set or order à la carte; the owner-chef talks with guests at the counter. No English evidence found.

places.name: 澄吉 (Sumiyoshi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A changing menu of skewers with wine sauces, doteyaki with demi-glace and Hatcho miso, gnocchi, spring rolls and baguette; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: liver, skirt steak, salsiccia, mussels, beef tendon and omelette dominate the menu (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 17:00–21:30 (food last order 21:00); closed Monday and some irregular days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, same day if seats are free (Tabelog); a solo walk-in may find it full (January 2026). A ¥500 otoshi of salad (Tabelog original 付き出し（サラダ）500円でご提供させていただきます。). 12 seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking inside, smoke outside (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On Muromachi-Oshikoji, northwest of Karasuma Oike; 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 2 (Tabelog; December 2025).
places.neighborhood: Northwest of Karasuma Oike — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Izakaya-bistro of Japanese wine, with the owner matching bottles to the dishes (December 2025) · signature doteyaki made with demi-glace and Hatcho miso, potato gnocchi (December 2025) · skewers with a red- or white-wine sauce (April 2025); assorted appetisers incl. a new, very smooth liver, Korean snacks and kimchi, mussels, a large omelette, outside skirt steak, salsiccia (May–September 2026); beef-tendon stew, spring rolls, mountain jellyfish, braised dishes from the sister restaurant 両川 (May and November 2026) · Japanese wines such as Zao Woody Farm Petit Manseng; sake, whisky, makgeolli, limoncello soda (2026 reviews) · about ¥4,000–8,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese wine izakaya · Karasuma Oike northwest] A twelve-seat, homely wine izakaya devoted to Japanese wines, poured with pairing tips from the owner: doteyaki in demi-glace and Hatcho miso, gnocchi, skewers with wine sauces, kimchi and Korean snacks, skirt steak and dishes sent over from sister shops nearby. Guests stay for hours and come back the next night. A ¥500 salad otoshi. Evenings; closed Monday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who selects Japanese wines and suggests pairings
Part of a small group with the restaurant 両川 (November 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya, pasta and wine bar by Karasuma Oike; registered as an official listing by the shop. A January 2026 reviewer writes that the restaurant paused after the previous owner died and has been revived by the current owner, with a creative use of spices; reviewers say dishes and drinks come from sister shops nearby (January 2026), and that it belongs to the 両川 group (November 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Japanese wine matched to the food (December 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Doteyaki with demi-glace and Hatcho miso; Japanese wine.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 guest, remembered from an earlier event visit down to the outfit worn, meant to stop for a quick bite and stayed six hours.
A January 2026 solo traveller, turned away elsewhere, phoned around until a counter seat came free here, and ended the night with whisky at the regulars' bar nearby.
A January 2026 visitor found a 2018 Petit Manseng from Zao Woody Farm here, and came back the following night.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・パスタ・ワインバー、中京区蛸薬師町291-3、烏丸御池駅2番出口から徒歩5分、二条城前駅2番出口から徒歩10分、火〜日 17:00〜21:30 (料理L.O.21:00)、月曜定休 (ほか不定休)、予約可 (当日も空きがあれば)、付き出し (サラダ) 500円、12席、貸切20名まで、店内禁煙 (外で喫煙)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2022年8月〜2026年11月、英語): 日本ワインの店、店主がワインを合わせる、名物のどて焼き (デミグラスと八丁味噌)、じゃがいものニョッキ、赤か白のワインソースの串、前菜の盛り合わせ (レバー)、韓国のつまみとキムチ、ムール貝、オムレツ、ハラミ、サルシッチャ、牛すじの煮込み、春巻き、山くらげ、両川の煮込み、Zao Woody Farm の Petit Manseng、日本酒、ウイスキー、マッコリ、前の店主が亡くなったあと今の店主が再開 (2026年1月の口コミ)、両川のグループ。

cultural_comfort.note: Ask the owner for wine pairings; ¥500 salad otoshi; book ahead; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: Le Cadeau
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking: the restaurant asks to be told of allergies in advance and may not manage on the day (Tabelog); a 2025 guest found allergy requests well handled. Courses include pies, pound cake and bread (2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses of venison, pork, wagyu, fish and shellfish, with dairy desserts (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Friday–Wednesday lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 20:00); a late-night dessert course 0:00–1:30; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Reservation only; tell the restaurant about allergies when booking (Tabelog). Courses: lunch ¥7,500 or ¥12,100, dinner ¥12,100, late-night dessert course ¥5,500, tax included, plus a 10% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料10％). 12 table seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 1F of the ミックマック building; 5 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: West of Jingu-Marutamachi — 5 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Creative French set courses changing with the seasons, by an owner-chef (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · lunch ¥7,500 or ¥12,100, dinner ¥12,100, late-night dessert course ¥5,500, plus 10% service (Tabelog) · e.g. amuse-bouches of venison blood with apple-cinnamon pie, or scrambled egg under truffle; mackerel, whelk and gribiche; ayu, clams and bouillabaisse; Basque pork with purple mustard; coconut, pineapple and lemongrass (February–July 2025) · Ezo venison, a tom yum-style seafood broth, eggplant and chicken mille-feuille, pan-seared Spanish mackerel, wagyu with cheek (+¥1,500) (December 2025–September 2026) · a pound cake to finish, as the name "the gift" suggests; birthday plates (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [French · near Jingu-Marutamachi, one chef, twelve seats] A calm twelve-seat French dining room where the owner-chef cooks and serves every course alone, with uncanny timing: seasonal, inventive plates such as venison-blood pie, ayu with bouillabaisse, Ezo venison or wagyu with cheek, ending with the house pound cake — and a late-night dessert course after midnight. Lunch from ¥7,500, dinner ¥12,100, plus 10% service. Reservation only; closed Thursday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who cooks and serves alone (June 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a reservation-only French restaurant "to enjoy with all five senses", with lunch, dinner and a late-night dessert course; registered as an official listing by the shop. A June 2025 reviewer writes that the owner-chef manages everything from cooking to serving alone, with warm, attentive service; a July 2025 guest was given an explanation of the name and a photo as a parting gift.
chef_bio.philosophy: A French restaurant to enjoy with all five senses (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal course; pound cake.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 couple left with an explanation of the restaurant's name and a photo as a gift.
A December 2025 lunch guest wondered how the timing of every dish could be so perfect.
For a daughter's birthday in February 2025 the staff handled allergy questions with care.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・洋食、中京区末丸町541-25 ミックマックビル 1F、京阪神宮丸太町駅から徒歩5分、地下鉄市役所前駅から徒歩10分、金〜水 12:00〜15:00 (L.O.13:00)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O.20:00)、深夜のデザートコース 0:00〜1:30、木曜定休、完全予約制、アレルギーは事前に知らせる (当日は対応できない場合あり)、ランチ7,500円・12,100円、ディナー12,100円、デザートコース5,500円 (税込、別にサービス料10%)、12席 (テーブル)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、五感で楽しむフレンチ。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年9月、英語): オーナーシェフが一人で調理も接客も、鹿の血とりんごとシナモンのパイ、トリュフのスクランブルエッグ、鯖とつぶ貝のグリビッシュ、鮎と蛤のブイヤベース、バスク豚、ココナッツとパイナップルとレモングラス、Ezo の鹿、トムヤムクンのようなスープ、茄子と鶏のミルフィーユ、鰆のポワレ、和牛と頬肉 (+1,500円)、パウンドケーキ、誕生日のプレート、アレルギーへの丁寧な対応。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; state allergies when booking; set courses; 10% service; cards.

staff_allergy_handling: Asks guests to state allergies when booking; may not manage same-day requests (Tabelog).
A February 2025 guest found allergy questions handled attentively (review).

places.name: イカリヤ食堂 (Ikariya Shokudo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A bistro menu of soufflé-like cocotte, pasta, tarts and bread alongside charcoal-grilled confit and steak; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken confit, beef, cheese cocotte and fish dominate the courses (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Thursday 12:00–14:30 and 17:30–22:00; Friday 17:30–22:00; Saturday–Sunday 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–22:00; last orders an hour before; closed Monday (open on holiday Mondays, closed the next weekday) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — book early for the riverside seats (Tabelog; August–September 2026). A dinner seat charge of ¥500 indoors or ¥800 on the kawadoko (Tabelog original ディナータイムのみ店内席500円/人 川床席800円/人). 36 table seats over two floors, plus an open-air kawadoko over the Kamo River in season; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). A renovated machiya over 100 years old on Kiyamachi south of Donguri-bashi — look for the blue flag with an anchor; 5 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Donguri-bashi, on the Kamo River — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Casual French and Italian bistro of charcoal-grilled confit and wine, with riverside kawadoko dining in summer (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · lunch course about ¥2,800 with appetisers and a choice of pasta or meat, e.g. Bolognese or charcoal-grilled chicken confit with white beans and spicy tomato; dessert +¥500 (August–September 2026) · the signature cocotte, a cheese soufflé baked in a pot (September–November 2026) · dinner: the Ikariya basic course, or à la carte such as sanma and shimeji pasta, beef outside skirt, five-nut tart (August–November 2026) · draft beer, roasted-green-tea gin and tonic, wine (November 2026) · lunch ¥2,000–4,000, dinner ¥6,000–8,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Bistro · Kiyamachi by the Kamo River, kawadoko in summer] A cosy two-floor bistro in a hundred-year-old machiya between Kiyamachi and the Kamo River, under a blue anchor flag: a cheese-soufflé cocotte, charcoal-grilled chicken confit, pasta and fair-priced courses, with river views upstairs and an open-air kawadoko in summer (expect the odd insect). Lunch from about ¥2,800; a ¥500 or ¥800 seat charge at dinner. Book ahead. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a charcoal-grilled confit and wine bistro on Kiyamachi, with seats indoors and on the riverside kawadoko; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 note that Ikariya has several locations, and that this one is a renovated machiya over 100 years old on the Kamo River (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Cocotte; charcoal-grilled chicken confit.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 kawadoko diner warned that insects land on the plates outdoors, and suggested indoor seats for the squeamish.
On a rainy September 2026 day the staff moved a riverside booking to a window table upstairs.
A September 2026 couple dined on the kawadoko under the moon while the next table celebrated a birthday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・ビストロ、下京区木屋町団栗橋下ル斎藤町138-2、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩7分、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩5分、高瀬川沿いの木屋町通を南へ、青い旗と錨のマーク、火〜木 12:00〜14:30・17:30〜22:00、金 17:30〜22:00、土日 11:30〜14:30・17:30〜22:00、月曜定休 (祝日は営業し翌平日休み)、予約可、ディナーのみ店内席500円/人・川床席800円/人、36席、貸切可、禁煙、オープンテラス、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、炭火焼きのコンフィとワイン。口コミ (2026年8月〜11月、英語): 鴨川沿い、築100年以上の町家、2階の窓際の席、夏の川床、虫が来ることも、ランチのコース2,800円ほど (前菜、パスタか肉、ボロネーゼ、鶏のコンフィと白いんげん豆)、デザート+500円、名物のココット (チーズのスフレ)、イカリヤの基本のコース、秋刀魚としめじのパスタ、牛ハラミ、5種のナッツのタルト、ほうじ茶のジントニック、誕生日のプレート。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (kawadoko in summer); dinner seat charge ¥500/¥800; cards, IC and PayPay.

places.name: 焼肉牛匠 新 (Yakiniku Gyusho Shin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Write allergies in the booking comments (Tabelog); grilled Omi beef with various seasonings, cold noodles and beef-tendon curry; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an Omi beef yakiniku restaurant; raw meat and raw fish may be served (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 18:00–23:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 18:00–23:00; food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30; irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; write allergies and preferences in the comments; raw meat or raw fish may be used (Tabelog). A private-room fee of ¥1,100 per room at dinner (Tabelog). 40 seats: a 12-seat counter on the 1F facing a dry-garden display, and private rooms for 2–8 upstairs; smoking allowed only in 2F private rooms at dinner (Tabelog; July 2026). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). A Kyoto townhouse on a Gion street of bars and clubs; 2 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; July 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gion, Sueyoshi-cho — 2 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Omi beef yakiniku specialising in lean cuts, in a Gion townhouse (Tabelog) · courses such as "Tatsumi" at lunch and "Shimizu" at dinner, with fresh-vegetable appetisers that change each visit, Omi beef grilled over charcoal by the chef at the counter, and clay-pot rice with small sides to finish (June–September 2026) · à la carte: yukhoe with egg yolk, meat sashimi, wagyu tongue, outside skirt, Omi beef chateaubriand, beef-tendon curry, sudachi cold noodles (December 2025–October 2026) · fresh lemon squash, wine (2026 reviews) · lunch about ¥3,000–4,000, dinner ¥10,000–20,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Gion townhouse, Omi beef] Omi beef yakiniku in a Gion townhouse: a counter facing a raked-sand garden where the chef grills over charcoal and coaches you on doneness, and private rooms upstairs. Courses open with fresh-vegetable plates and end with clay-pot rice; à la carte runs to yukhoe, tongue, chateaubriand and sudachi cold noodles. Prices feel high to some, and one guest found the cuts fatty. Lunch on weekends; dinner nightly.

roles: Chef at the counter grill (unnamed) and staff
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Gion Kyoto-townhouse yakiniku specialising in lean Omi beef; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 describe a counter where the chef grills over charcoal and advises on cooking (July 2026), private rooms upstairs, and courses whose appetisers change with each visit (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Lean Omi beef (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Omi beef; sudachi cold noodles.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner was uneasy walking down a street of cabaret clubs, then found a calm counter facing a dry-landscape garden of raked sand.
A July 2026 business diner found many cuts fatty and the à la carte prices high, perhaps lifted by inbound demand.
For a November 2026 birthday the closing plate was an assortment of fruit "resembling a work of art".

staff_allergy_handling: Asks guests to write allergies and food preferences in the booking comments; raw meat or raw fish may be used (Tabelog).

places.name: 焼肉ダイスケ (Yakiniku Daisuke)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu with a homemade secret sauce, salted tongue, yukhoe, kimchi and namul, Kujo green-onion tempura, clay-pot rice with shigure-ni; the sauce ingredients are not given (Tabelog shop text; 2024–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Wagyu yakiniku restaurant (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; call if more than 10 minutes late or the booking may be cancelled; families with small children are asked to phone ahead; baby food can be brought (tell the shop when booking); one high chair (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: 4 at the counter, 16 at tables, with sofas; a second floor for about 8 opened by January 2025; private room up to 20 (Tabelog; January 2025). Non-smoking; smoking area outside; wheelchair accessible; English menu (Tabelog). On Shijo-dori east of Aburanokoji, 5 min from Hankyu Karasuma and Omiya Stns (Tabelog). Opened 17 October 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori east of Aburanokoji — 5 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Wagyu yakiniku of A4 grade or higher with a homemade secret sauce; house seasonal sours and ice cream (Tabelog shop text) · today’s omakase assortment of five cuts ¥3,800; Wagyu yukhoe ¥1,300; kimchi assortment ¥650 (August 2025) · tongue in several styles — tongue yukhoe, tongue with Kujo green onion, thick-cut tongue (2025) · thick-cut strip loin, Chateaubriand, misuji, outside skirt, thigh with “snow sauce”, shiitake (2025) · Kujo green-onion tempura to wrap with grilled meat (May 2025) · courses and free-drink plans; clay-pot rice with shigure-ni to finish (2024–2025)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Shijo-Aburanokoji, a couple’s Wagyu grill] A stylish, family-feeling yakiniku room on Shijo-dori run by a friendly owner couple (who also have a YouTube channel), serving A4-and-up Wagyu with a house sauce: tongue three ways, yukhoe, thick-cut strip loin, a five-cut omakase platter (¥3,800), and Kujo green-onion tempura to wrap around the meat. English menu; staff speak English. About ¥6,000–10,000 a head. Closed Tuesdays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text says guests are “welcomed by our friendly owner couple”; a January 2024 reviewer describes a restaurant “run by a couple who also have a YouTube channel”, and another (January 2024) a warm, family-run atmosphere. A May 2025 visitor found that all the staff could communicate in English and that prices were not inflated for tourists.
chef_bio.philosophy: High-quality Wagyu at reasonable prices (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu tongue; omakase assortment; Kujo green-onion tempura.

anecdotes.text: A high-school club has held its year-end party here three years running (December 2024).
A May 2025 diner was shown how to spread the Kujo green-onion tempura, wrap it with green-onion paste, and grill it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉ダイスケ、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、下京区四条通油小路東入ル石井筒町518、阪急烏丸駅・大宮駅から徒歩5分、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、火曜定休、予約可 (10分以上遅れる場合は電話を)、小さな子ども連れは電話で相談、離乳食の持ち込み可、カード可、20席 (カウンター4、テーブル16)、個室は20名まで、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、車椅子可、英語メニュー、2018年10月17日オープン。店の紹介: A4ランク以上の和牛を自家製の秘伝のたれで、季節のサワーやアイスもオリジナル、気さくなオーナー夫婦。口コミ (2024〜2025年、英語): YouTube もしている夫婦の店、タンのユッケ、九条ねぎのタン、厚切りタン、おまかせ5種盛り3,800円、和牛ユッケ1,300円、キムチ盛り650円、九条ねぎの天ぷら、土鍋のしぐれ煮ご飯、スタッフは英語で対応できる。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); staff communicate in English (May 2025). Families welcome with notice.

places.name: 鳳城 (Hojo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Chinese dishes with soy sauce and wheat noodles — dandan noodles, chashu ramen, fried rice, bone-in kara-age, sweet-and-sour meatballs; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese meat and seafood dishes; broths not described (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), dinner 17:30–21:30 (food L.O. 20:30, drinks 21:00); closed Tuesday and irregular days (Tabelog; October 2026). Reservations accepted; online up to 6, larger parties by phone (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). Prices rose from 1 May 2026 (April 2026). 28 seats over two floors; private room up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; English menu; take-out; children welcome, one small chair (Tabelog). In a two-storey machiya on Oike-dori near Shinmachi, 5 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Established 1988 (Tabelog shop text).
places.neighborhood: Oike-dori near Shinmachi — 5 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style Chinese with a light, delicate touch, in a machiya renovated in 1988 (Tabelog shop text) · signature “Atari Goma” dandan noodles: mild heat, rich sesame, a light soy broth with spinach and thin noodles, ¥900 (shop text; 2026 reviews) · mini fried rice set ¥450 with any à la carte dish; fried rice with a hint of plum (February and October 2026) · Chinese-style sea bream sashimi with nuts ¥1,200 (October 2026) · mapo tofu set ¥990 (June 2026) · chashu ramen; bone-in kara-age; course of jellyfish and chicken, white-skinned meat rolls, tamagoyaki, sweet-and-sour meatballs, eight-treasure stir-fry (2026 reviews) · draft beer under ¥500 (February 2026)
places.notes: [Chinese · Oike near Shinmachi, a family machiya since 1988] A family-run Chinese restaurant in a two-storey machiya on Oike-dori with retro tables and a gentle, Kyoto-style touch. The draw is the sesame-rich, mildly spicy dandan noodles (¥900), with a mini fried rice set for ¥450; also sea bream sashimi Chinese-style, mapo tofu sets and old-school courses. Cash only; closed Tuesdays.

roles: Family-run (unnamed); now the son runs the restaurant (February 2026)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text: established in 1988 in a renovated townhouse, with Kyoto-style Chinese cooking refined after training at Sichuan restaurants and hotels. A February 2026 regular learned from the owner that the founder died about two years earlier and the son has taken over, and was shown a plaque explaining the name: 鳳城, from Du Fu’s poem “Night”, is an elegant name for Chang’an (Xi’an), chosen for the friendship between Xi’an — sister city of Kyoto since 1974 — and Kyoto. An October 2026 reviewer calls it a long-established restaurant “run by a family in a historic Kyoto townhouse”; an April 2026 diner found the owner very attentive.
chef_bio.specialty: Dandan noodles; fried rice.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 solo diner liked that any à la carte dish can come with a rice or mini fried rice set.
A January 2026 diner, put off by how greasy the half fried rice looked, found it delicious.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鳳城、中華料理・ラーメン、中京区西横町170、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、昼11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、夜17:30〜21:30 (料理L.O.20:30)、火曜定休、予約可 (ネットは6名まで)、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、28席、個室20名まで、禁煙、英語メニュー、テイクアウト、子ども可。店の紹介: 1988年創業、町家を改装した中華料理店、四川料理店やホテルで修業した京風のやさしい中華、名物の Atari Goma (担々麺)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 担々麺900円、ミニ炒飯セット450円、鯛の中華風刺身1,200円、麻婆豆腐定食990円、チャーシュー麺、骨付き唐揚げ、家族で営む、創業者は約2年前に亡くなり息子が継いだ、店名は杜甫の詩にちなむ長安の雅称で、西安と京都の友好にちなむ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); cash only; solo-friendly with set options.

places.name: 楽仙樓 (Rakusenro)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the specialty is boiled dumplings in wheat wrappers; noodle sets and fried dishes (official shop; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese meat and seafood dishes; hot pot with lamb courses (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 17:30–22:00; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, limited to two hours at busy times; cancel same-day by phone; full charge for no-shows on a booked course (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし; the English page’s “10% service charge” is a mistranslation). Cards, IC, e-money and many QR codes (Tabelog). Tablet ordering, with staff taking orders for anyone who prefers (September 2026). 38 seats: 10 at the counter, 12 at tables, two semi-private rooms for 6–8, 10 on the terrace; smoking only on the terrace; dogs welcome on the terrace (Tabelog; September 2026). Wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). On Higashinotoin south of Shijo, 1 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn exit 19 (Tabelog). Opened 1 August 1994 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin just south of Shijo — 1 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Long-running Chinese with chewy boiled dumplings (sui gyoza) as the specialty; sold also through an online shop (official site title; 2026 reviews) · weekday lunch sets ¥1,300–1,400: boiled dumplings with fried rice ¥1,400; sweet-and-sour pork set ¥1,400 (August–October 2026) · chilled Chinese noodles in summer (September 2025) · Chinese hot pot courses, including lamb, with refillable vegetables and a bar of condiments for dipping sauces; free-drink plans (August–October 2026) · shrimp balls; assorted three appetizers ¥1,200; stir-fried squid and peppers; pan-fried dumplings; Shaoxing wine by the bottle ¥3,200 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Chinese and hot pot · Higashinotoin-Shijo, since 1994] A busy, friendly Chinese restaurant a minute from Shijo Karasuma, known for chewy boiled dumplings. Weekday lunch sets around ¥1,400 (dumplings and fried rice, sweet-and-sour pork); at night Chinese hot pot courses — lamb included — with a condiment bar, plus classic plates and Shaoxing wine. A terrace takes dogs and smokers. Tablet ordering; no service charge.

roles: Operated by 楽仙樓株式会社
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T7130001028310 is registered to 楽仙樓株式会社 at the restaurant’s own address (NTA register); opened in August 1994 (Tabelog). The official online shop sells its boiled dumplings. Reviewers praise quick, friendly service (2026); an October 2026 diner came after seeing it on television.
chef_bio.specialty: Boiled dumplings; Chinese hot pot.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular brings a dog and sits on the terrace, which has a spot cooler and shade on hot days.
An October 2026 group of five ordered hot pot for the first time and never got to the noodles because the vegetables kept being refilled.

places.name: 京ダイニング八条 (Kyo Dining Hachijo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Creative Western dishes with Kyoto ingredients — steak set, hamburg steak with fried shrimp, beef-cutlet curry, yuba and tofu salad; no gluten information (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A fresh yuba and tofu salad is on the menu, but dressings and dashi are not described; most dishes are meat (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00) daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Mobile ordering (October 2026). Cards, e-money and QR, PayPay (Tabelog; September 2026). 68 seats with a counter; private hire possible; non-smoking (Tabelog). In the Kyoto Omotenashi Koji restaurant row of ASTY Road, steps from the Shinkansen Hachijo Exit of JR Kyoto Station (Tabelog). Opened 13 November 2009 (Tabelog); formerly called Hachijo Diner (August 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, ASTY Road by the Shinkansen Hachijo Exit
places.cuisine: Beer dining with creative Western dishes using local ingredients; exclusive drinks such as Hachijo Beer and a Kyoto Highball; lunch menu (Tabelog shop text) · handmade hamburg steak and fried shrimp lunch ¥2,380 (September 2026) · steak set meal; beef-cutlet curry (October 2026) · fresh yuba and tofu salad (August 2026) · Kyoto seasonal dishes with dashi (August 2026) · Premium Malts on draft (October 2026)
places.notes: [Beer dining · Kyoto Station Hachijo Exit, a pre-Shinkansen stop] A machiya-fronted beer restaurant right by the Shinkansen gates, open 11:00–23:00: house Hachijo Beer and a Kyoto Highball with Western plates using local produce — hamburg and fried shrimp, steak sets, beef-cutlet curry, a yuba and tofu salad. One reviewer calls it a private “Shinkansen lounge” for a last beer in Kyoto.

chef_bio.background: No operator or chef is named in the sources opened. An August 2026 regular remembers it under its old name, Hachijo Diner, and still takes the same counter seat.
chef_bio.specialty: Hachijo Beer; Western dishes with Kyoto ingredients.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 traveller, used to an airport-lounge beer, called it “my own little lounge” next to the Shinkansen ticket gate.
An August 2026 couple chose it for a proper dinner before an evening Shinkansen because it was not crowded.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京ダイニング八条、ビアホール・ビアバー・バー、下京区東塩小路高倉町8-3 JR京都駅構内アスティロードレストラン街1F、JR京都駅八条口から徒歩1分、毎日11:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、68席、貸切可、禁煙、2009年11月13日オープン。店の紹介: 京都駅新幹線八条口の Kyoto Omotenashi Koji のビアレストラン、町家風の外観と洋風の店内、地元の食材を取り入れた創作洋食、限定の Hachijo Beer と Kyoto Highball、ランチもある。口コミ (2026年、英語): 以前は Hachijo Diner、手ごねハンバーグとエビフライのランチ2,380円、ステーキ定食、ビーフカツカレー、生湯葉と豆腐のサラダ、新幹線の前の一杯。

cultural_comfort.note: Station restaurant with mobile ordering; easy for travellers.

places.name: BAR-CERVECERIA xativa (シャティバ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Paella and arroz, tapas, pinchos and bread-served ajillo; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A seafood- and meat-led Spanish menu; nothing vegan is marked (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 by reservation at least two business days ahead (phone preferred): a paella lunch ¥3,800 with ten tapas, paella, a drink and Basque cheesecake or chocolate cake, for 2–10 people upstairs. Dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); Sunday and holidays 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 20 seats: 6 at the counter and 14 at tables, with a 2nd floor for private parties including families with small children; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Nijo-dori just west of Kiyamachi, opposite The Ritz-Carlton, Kyoto, 272 m from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2022–2024 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi-Nijo, opposite The Ritz-Carlton — 272 m from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Spanish regional cooking and homemade tapas with seafood bought daily at the market (Tabelog) · arroz a banda (rice in fish stock), paella; paella lunch ¥3,800 by reservation (Tabelog) · e.g. pinchos, octopus carpaccio, grilled octopus, shrimp ajillo with bread, firefly squid in ink, oven-baked sea bream, fried cod roe with balsamic in winter, grilled beef; Spanish beers and a long wine list (2023–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Spanish · Kiyamachi-Nijo, tapas and arroz by the Ritz-Carlton] A friendly little Spanish bar on Nijo-dori opposite The Ritz-Carlton, with a counter downstairs and a room upstairs. Pick pinchos and tapas, then share an arroz a banda or paella made with the day's market seafood; Spanish beers and plenty of wine. A tapas-and-paella lunch (¥3,800) runs by reservation only. Food can be slow when it is full. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: authentic Spanish regional dishes and homemade tapas in a quiet spot at Kiyamachi-Nijo, with fresh seafood bought daily at the market; the 2nd floor takes private parties and families with small children.
chef_bio.specialty: Arroz a banda; tapas and pinchos.

anecdotes.text: A November 2024 guest was offered a blanket and had a coat taken before ordering, then chose the arroz a banda over the classic paella.
An April 2026 couple upstairs found the food good but the wait very long on a full night.
A September 2026 diner found the owner kind, with a wonderful smile.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: BAR-CERVECERIA xativa (シャティバ)、スペイン料理・バル、中京区木屋町二条西入ル樋之口町466-2、京都市役所前駅から272m、昼12:00〜14:00 (2営業日前までの予約制、パエリアランチ3,800円: タパス10種、パエリア、ドリンク、バスクチーズケーキかガトーショコラ、2階で2〜10名)、夜18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、日祝18:00〜22:00、火曜定休、20席 (カウンター6、テーブル14)、カード可、インボイス登録あり。公式紹介: スペインの郷土料理と自家製タパス、アロスアバンダ、市場で毎日仕入れる魚介。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): リッツ・カールトン京都の向かい、ピンチョス、タコのカルパッチョ、海老のアヒージョ、ホタルイカのイカ墨、鯛のオーブン焼き、スペインビール、提供が遅いという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book the lunch two business days ahead by phone.

places.name: 京都捏製作所 (Kyoto Tsukune Seisakujo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tsukune in many seasonings, kara-age and sake snacks; no gluten information is published (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken-tsukune izakaya (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–04:00 (last order food 03:00, drinks 03:30), Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 15 seats at a counter and tables; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed per Tabelog. Bookings recommended for early evening (April 2024). Hidden at the back of the 第二ふや町ビル on Fuyacho south of Nijo, 327 m from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 17 April 2008 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho-Nijo — 327 m from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Izakaya specialising in creative chicken tsukune (Tabelog; reviews) · an eight-kind tsukune platter, raw tsukune, tsukune served one by one in different styles; kara-age; a three-snack sake set · sake chosen with care, especially from the San’in region, served warm as kanzake; cheap beer and sours on some nights (2023–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Fuyacho-Nijo, creative tsukune until 4 a.m.] A dim little izakaya at the back of a building near City Hall, open until 4 a.m. and devoted to tsukune — try the eight-kind platter or the raw tsukune — with a careful list of San'in sake served warm. Often run single-handed, relaxed for solo drinkers, with Hanshin baseball on the TV. Cash only; smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner not named; often run by one person (February 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a tsukune-specialist izakaya opened 17 April 2008, with the owner’s blog as its website. A February 2025 reviewer describes it as run by a single person; other reviewers note the San’in sake list, warm sake and a Hanshin Tigers following.
chef_bio.specialty: Eight-kind tsukune platter; raw tsukune with kanzake.

anecdotes.text: A May 2023 late-night guest had the tsukune brought out one at a time, each in a different style, with warm Daigorei sake.
A February 2025 solo drinker found the one-person izakaya open until 4 a.m. just right.
A June 2025 passer-by came in for a sign offering ¥100 off drinks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都捏製作所 (きょうとつくねせいさくしょ)、居酒屋・鳥料理・日本酒バー、中京区麩屋町通二条下ル尾張町225 第二ふや町ビル1F、京都市役所前駅から327m、月〜土18:00〜翌4:00 (料理L.O. 3:00、ドリンクL.O. 3:30)、日曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、15席、20名まで貸切可、喫煙可、2008年4月17日オープン、ウェブサイトはアメブロ (tsukuneman)。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 創作つくね、つくね8種盛り、生つくね、山陰の日本酒、燗酒、ワンオペ、朝4時まで、阪神ファン、ビルの奥でわかりにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Hard to find at the back of a building; cash only.

places.name: 食工房 ひろさき (Shoku Kobo Hirosaki)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo-style Japanese cooking with soy, ponzu and dashi; no gluten information is published (reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seasonal fish-led kappo, e.g. fugu and crab in winter (reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00, last entry 20:30; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Bookings recommended. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 10 seats: a 6-seat counter and a semi-private tatami room for 4; non-smoking (Tabelog). Omakase about ¥27,000 (May 2023); recent reviewers spend ¥20,000–39,999 (2025–2026). On Takeya-machi-dori near Shinmachi, 191 m from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takeya-machi-Shinmachi — 191 m from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Simple, ingredient-led kappo cooking at the counter, omakase or by request (reviews) · e.g. in winter fugu sashimi with fresh shirako and skin, ponzu and spring onion, crab, and a crab clay-pot rice (February 2025); spring dishes in March 2026 · omakase about ¥27,000 (May 2023) · sake and wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kappo · Marutamachi, a veteran's quiet counter] A small, unfussy kappo counter near Marutamachi Station run by a chef who spent years as head chef of Kiyamachi's 桜川. No flourishes — just seasonal fish and vegetables cooked with deep skill: winter fugu with shirako, crab clay-pot rice, the first tastes of spring. Six counter seats and one small room; omakase runs about ¥20,000–30,000. Cash only. Book ahead.

chef_bio.chef_name: Hirosaki (family name per a May 2023 review)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: the chef went independent after many years — about 30, per a November 2015 reviewer — at 桜川 on Kiyamachi, including as its head chef (2011 and 2015 reviews). Reviewers in 2015 and 2017 said the restaurant had one Michelin star. A January 2025 regular has followed it for 25 years, since an earlier location. A May 2023 reviewer was welcomed by Mr. Hirosaki and a female member of staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per a 2011 review: cooking that brings out the natural flavour of seasonal ingredients with as little handling as possible.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal omakase; winter fugu and crab.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 regular had fugu sashimi mixed with fresh shirako and skin, and a crab clay-pot rice.
A February 2017 first-timer asked for extra dishes at the end and was happily obliged.
A January 2025 regular has been coming for 25 years, since the restaurant’s earlier location.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食工房 ひろさき、日本料理、中京区竹屋町通新町東相生町282、丸太町駅から191m、17:00〜22:00 (最終入店20:30)、不定休、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、10席 (カウンター6、半個室の座敷4)、禁煙。口コミ (2011〜2026年、英語): 木屋町の桜川で長年 (約30年) 料理長を務めた料理人が独立、ミシュラン一つ星とする2015年・2017年の口コミ、素材の味を生かす料理、おまかせ27,000円 (2023年5月)、冬の河豚と白子、蟹の土鍋ご飯、25年来の常連 (2025年1月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter, cash only; book ahead.

places.name: 創作料理と京野菜のびすとろ KIZANO (KIZANO)
places.gf_detail: Ask. French-based courses with bread or rice, soups, mousses and desserts; no gluten information is published (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Courses are built on Kyoto vegetables but the mains are fish, pork, duck or beef; nothing vegan is offered on the published menus (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last entry 13:30); dinner 18:00–22:00 (last entry 20:00); closed Monday and irregularly (official site). Course menus only for now; bookings of up to 6 people, about 2 hours a table; late cancellations or changes may be charged (official site). Cash only — no cards, cashless payments or local coupons (official site). Prices revised from 1 November (official site). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 16 seats per the official site (18 per Tabelog); non-smoking; children by prior arrangement; private hire for 15–20 (official site). On Karasuma-dori facing Higashi-Honganji, on the 1st floor of ベルセゾン京都駅前, about 7–10 min from JR Kyoto Stn (official site). Opened 26 March 2010 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Facing Higashi-Honganji on Karasuma-dori — 7–10 min from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: French-based creative cooking with Kyoto vegetables from contract farms and Kyoto seasonings, served on Japanese tableware with chopsticks (official site) · lunch: bistro lunch ¥3,850 (amuse, appetizer platter, soup, a main of the day’s fish, Kyoto mochi-pork with Saikyo-miso Chaliapin sauce or beef steak +¥990, bread or rice, desserts, drink); KIZANO lunch ¥5,280 · dinner: bistro course ¥5,830 (e.g. Kyoto leek and squash mousse, five-item seasonal appetizer platter, mushroom potage, duck breast rôti; marbled beef +¥1,980); KIZANO course ¥7,260 · anniversary course with a whole cake ¥8,800; party plan ¥8,250 (official site, tax included) · wines by the bottle from ¥4,620, by the glass ¥770 (official site)
places.notes: [French · facing Higashi-Honganji, Kyoto-vegetable bistro] A small bistro across Karasuma-dori from Higashi-Honganji, a short walk from Kyoto Station, run by a chef couple. Courses showcase Kyoto vegetables in French dress, eaten with chopsticks off Japanese plates: a pretty five-item appetizer platter, a seasonal potage, then fish, Kyoto pork or duck. Lunch ¥3,850–5,280, dinner ¥5,830–7,260. Cash only; groups up to six. Closed Monday.

roles: Run by a chef couple (official recruiting page); names not given
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: French-based creative cooking with Kyoto vegetables from contract farms and seafood sent direct from the producing areas; the most popular dish is the seasonal appetizer platter; the restaurant is run by a chef and spouse as a small, homely team. Opened 26 March 2010 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: Kyoto vegetables and local seasonings in Kyoto-style French, eaten with chopsticks from Japanese tableware.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal appetizer platter of Kyoto vegetables.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 visitor was told to mix the cold potato soup with the melon sorbet, and found it even better.
An August 2026 diner chose it from a book on business dining and found the room full of women at a Saturday dinner.
A December 2024 weekday lunch found every table taken by women enjoying wine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kizano.jp): 創作料理と京野菜のびすとろ KIZANO、京都駅すぐ東本願寺前、契約農家の京野菜と京都の調味料のフレンチベースの創作料理、和食器と箸で、一番人気は旬の前菜盛り合わせ、産地直送の魚介、下京区卓屋町66-1 ベルセゾン京都駅前1階、ランチ11:30〜15:00 (最終入店13:30)、ディナー18:00〜22:00 (最終入店20:00)、月曜定休・不定休、現金のみ、予約は6名まで・2時間程度、当面はコースのみ、11月1日から価格改定。ランチ: びすとろランチ3,850円、KIZANOランチ5,280円。ディナー: びすとろコース5,830円、KIZANOコース7,260円。記念日コース8,800円、パーティープラン8,250円。総席数16席、全面禁煙、子連れは事前連絡。求人: シェフ夫婦で経営。食べログ: 創作料理・フレンチ、18席、2010年3月26日オープン。

cultural_comfort.note: Course menus only; cash only; groups of up to six.

places.name: 円屋 三条小路店 (Enya Sanjo Koji)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles, shumai and wonton wrappers, kara-age (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken broths, chicken chashu, meat and shrimp shumai (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat lunch 11:30–15:30 and dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); Thu dinner only; closed Sunday (a March 2025 diner noted lunch as 11:00–14:00). 20 seats — 10 at the counter and three tables; picture menu; non-smoking; cards, transit IC and most QR (Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「なし」 (the English auto-translation wrongly says one is added). The entrance is on the alley side, easy to miss; look for the red lantern (2024–2026 reviews). Opened 4 December 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo back alley near Karasuma Oike — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: "Kyoto Chinese": light noodles and big steamed shumai, with drinks at night (2025–2026 reviews) · noodles ¥900: Kyoto white-miso noodles (the signature), Kyoto wonton noodles, spicy black-sesame mixed noodles, chilled noodles in summer; limited noodles ¥1,000 (2024–2026 reviews) · lunch set ¥1,300: noodles with shumai, a small dish and rice with pickled mustard greens, or with kara-age (2025–2026 reviews) · assorted appetizers ¥600, assorted shumai (meat and shrimp) ¥650, umeshu and water ¥550 (December 2024) · sesame dumplings, black shichimi on the table (reviews)
places.notes: [Chinese noodles & shumai · Sanjo alley near Karasuma Oike, white-miso noodles] A small "Kyoto Chinese" shop under a red lantern in a back alley, the sister of 円屋 near Shijo: the signature is a creamy Kyoto white-miso noodle soup, eaten with big, juicy steamed shumai, in a ¥1,300 lunch set. A December 2025 regular found the once-too-light broth much improved. No service charge. Closed Sunday; Thursday dinner only.

roles: Owner, not named; "cheerful, energetic, and very kind" (June 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 4 December 2024 (Tabelog), the second shop under the name 円屋 after the original near Shijo (Tabelog listing). Reviewers describe a counter around the kitchen, two or three tables in the back, a Taiwanese-looking front with a red lantern and a Japanese-modern interior, a friendly owner and manager, and set lunches where you pick the noodles.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto white-miso noodles; steamed shumai.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular had stayed away after the ramen "had become quite light," came back for the first anniversary, and found it "now has a richer depth and umami" — with a free sweet at the till.
The same regular, in August 2026, wished for a set without rice: "I’ve thought this since the restaurant opened and even mentioned it to them once."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 円屋 三条小路店、中華料理・居酒屋・麺類、中京区新町通六角上る三条町342、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、月火水金土 11:30〜15:30・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、木曜は夜のみ、日曜休み、20席 (カウンター10、テーブル3)、写真付きメニュー、禁煙、カード・交通系IC・QR可、サービス料は原文で「なし」、2024年12月4日オープン。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 京都の白味噌の麺が名物、京都のワンタン麺、黒胡麻の辛い混ぜ麺、夏の冷やし麺、麺は900円 (限定1,000円)、焼売セット・唐揚げセット1,300円 (ご飯と高菜)、前菜盛り合わせ600円、焼売盛り合わせ650円、梅酒の水割り550円、黒七味、胡麻団子、赤提灯、路地の奥、店主は明るく元気、開店当初より味が良くなったという声、ご飯なしのセットがほしいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Picture menu; order by telling the staff.

places.name: ビストロ ヴェルジュ (BISTRO Verjus)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: cutlets, fried shrimp, hamburg steak, pound cake, bread with the courses (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a bistro of beef, pork, chicken and fish (official site).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 12:00–14:30, dinner 18:00–22:00; Tuesday lunch only; Thursday dinner only; closed Wednesday; occasional closures posted in its news. 16 seats per the site (Tabelog: 20, five tables); private hire for 10–16; reservations advised, lunch often full (December 2024; April 2026). Non-smoking; children welcome; cards (JCB, Amex, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). One parking space nearby and a temple car park (Tabelog; April 2025).
places.neighborhood: Kawabata-Nijo — 2 min walk from the Kawabata-Nijo bus stop; 7–10 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: French bistro and old-style yoshoku, tax included (official site) · lunch: recommended lunch ¥1,100 (¥1,510 with soup), fresh-fish lunch ¥1,300, Verjus course ¥2,700, fish course ¥3,020, kuroge wagyu course ¥5,130; hamburg steak, hamburg and fried shrimp, Kyoto pork grill, pork or chicken cutlet ¥980–1,300, buckwheat galette ¥1,200; drink +¥220, dessert +¥200 (official site) · dinner courses A ¥4,200, B ¥6,000, C ¥7,000, petit course ¥2,900; kuroge wagyu steak sets 100–200 g ¥4,100–7,500; smoked chicken, Kyoto pork and camembert; bouillabaisse ¥2,400; lamb roast ¥2,900 (official site) · organic vegetables the chef grows, kuroge wagyu, fish sent by a fisherman friend in Miyazu (official site)
places.notes: [French bistro & yoshoku · Kawabata-Nijo, a couple’s neighbourhood bistro] A small bistro near the Kamo River at Nijo, run by chef 小川 潤 in the kitchen and his wife out front: ¥1,100 lunches of Kyoto pork or hamburg steak, ¥2,700 lunch courses, and French dinner courses from ¥4,200 with vegetables he grows himself. Regulars swap the main for the house hamburg steak and fried shrimp. Book lunch. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a small bistro serving traditional French technique at reasonable prices, from everyday lunch to special dinners, in a quiet residential area; the owner-chef grows organic vegetables himself, uses domestic kuroge wagyu, and gets fish direct from a fisherman acquaintance in Miyazu. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a couple — "The front of house is managed by the wife, and the chef is her husband" — chatting with regulars, sending postcards, and roses at the door in spring.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「シンプルに旬の素材の味を引き出すこと」 — simply drawing out the flavour of seasonal ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak with fried shrimp; Kyoto pork grill.

anecdotes.text: "The front of house is managed by the wife, and the chef is her husband, making it a lovely couple-run establishment." — July 2026.
A four-time regular in June 2026: "I enjoy chatting with the owner and his wife," and always swaps the main for the hamburg steak and fried shrimp.
April 2026: the fully booked room left the staff "a bit rushed," and the diner asked that the corner furniture be cleaned.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (bistro-verjus.com): BISTRO Verjus (ビストロ ヴェルジュ)、オーナーシェフ 小川 潤、本格フレンチをカジュアルに、オーナーシェフ自家栽培の有機野菜、国産の黒毛和牛、宮津の知人漁師から直送の魚、ランチ12:00〜14:30・ディナー18:00〜22:00、火曜はランチのみ、木曜はディナーのみ、水曜休み、16席、10〜16人で貸切、おすすめランチ1,100円 (スープ付き1,510円)、鮮魚ランチ1,300円、ヴェルジュコースランチ2,700円、お魚のコースランチ3,020円、黒毛和牛コースランチ5,130円、特製ハンバーグ、エビフライとハンバーグ、京都ポークグリル、そば粉のガレット、ドリンク220円・デザート200円、ディナーコースA 4,200円・B 6,000円・C 7,000円、プチディナーコース2,900円、黒毛和牛ステーキ100〜200g 4,100〜7,500円、スモーク料理、ブイヤベース2,400円、仔羊のロースト2,900円、税込。食べログ: フレンチ・洋食、左京区二条通川端東入ル難波町218、川端二条バス停から徒歩2分、20席、子供可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年7月、英語): 夫婦で営む、奥さんが接客でご主人がシェフ、常連はハンバーグとエビフライ、昼は満席が多い、温かい接客、ポストカード、入口のバラ、混んで慌ただしかった・隅の家具の掃除をという声。

cultural_comfort.note: A neighbourhood bistro; book ahead for lunch.

places.name: 2eme MAISON
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pasta, focaccia sandwiches, shrimp tempura, cutlets, chicken nanban and pies (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: steak, hamburg, chicken, clam chowder, rillettes, pudding (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–23:00, dinner from 17:00; hours may change. Reservations for dinner from 17:00 only; at lunch, queues form before opening (October 2026). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome; counter seating. An August 2026 diner found the Tabelog phone number out of service but the Google Maps number worked. Opened 20 July 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gojo — 3 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: A dim, antique-styled café and dining bar: café lunches by day, wine and small plates at night (2024–2026 reviews) · lunch plates with salad and bread: steak lunch, hamburg, mixed plate with shrimp tempura and hamburg, chicken nanban with lemon tartare, a weekly special such as Milanese cutlet, seasonal pasta, salmon and cream-cheese focaccia sandwich (2024–2026 reviews) · night: rillettes, pickles, vongole (August 2026) · sweets: cherry pie, fig and caramel pie, a large pudding, brandy cake (2024–2026 reviews) · lemon sour, lemon squash, iced tea (reviews)
places.notes: [Café & dining bar · Gojo, antique-styled lunch spot] A dim, antique-filled café three minutes from Kiyomizu-Gojo: hearty lunch plates — steak, hamburg with shrimp tempura, chicken nanban with lemon tartare — then wine, rillettes and vongole at night, with cherry or fig pie any time. Popular, with queues at opening and many visitors from abroad. One diner found lunch with a drink over ¥2,000 a bit much. Dinner bookings only.

chef_bio.background: Opened 20 July 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe a stylish café with an antique, overseas feel and a slightly dim, calming interior, busy at lunch with many customers from abroad, daily and weekly specials that change often, and a cosy night-bar mood after dark.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch plates; seasonal pies.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: the pudding "had lost its shape," so the staff "kindly offered a scoop of vanilla ice cream as a complimentary treat."
An October 2026 diner found two queues at opening — "they were keeping track of the order in which people lined up" — and a set with a drink "over JPY 2000, which seemed a bit much."
August 2026: the cold corn-soup pasta was good, but "as I ate, it felt a bit watery and the flavor gradually became lighter."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 2eme MAISON (ドゥージィエムメゾン)、カフェ・アジア・エスニック・ダイニングバー、下京区寺町通り五条上る西橋詰町794、清水五条駅から徒歩3分、毎日 11:30〜23:00 (ディナー17:00〜23:00)、予約は17時からのディナーのみ、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙、子供可、カウンター席、2022年7月20日オープン。口コミ (2024年2月〜2026年10月、英語): アンティークで海外のような雰囲気、少し暗く落ち着く、ステーキランチ、ハンバーグ、海老天とハンバーグのミックスプレート、チキン南蛮のレモンタルタル、週替わりのミラノ風カツ、季節のパスタ (冷たいコーンスープのパスタ)、サーモンとクリームチーズのフォカッチャサンド、クラムチャウダー、リエット、ピクルス、ボンゴレ、チェリーパイ、無花果とキャラメルのパイ、大きなプリン、ブランデーケーキ、開店前に行列、海外からの客が多い、食べログの電話番号は不通でGoogleマップの番号はつながった (2026年8月)、ドリンク付きで2,000円超は高めという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Many visitors from abroad; dinner bookings only.

places.name: 点邑 (Ten’yuu)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura in wheat batter, a tendon, and fresh wheat gluten among the dishes (official menu; 2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shrimp, conger eel and fish tempura; dashi dipping sauce; seasonal hamo, soft-shell turtle and fugu (official menu; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch from 11:30 (last order 13:00), dinner from 17:30 (last order 19:00); closed Tuesday plus two other days a month, listed in its monthly notices (Tabelog: Wednesdays are often irregular closures). Online booking via TableCheck. 22 seats — a 10-seat counter upstairs, private rooms of 4 and 6 (or 8) downstairs; private hire of either floor; corkage ¥3,300; no shorts or tank tops, no strong scent (Tabelog). Children welcome, private rooms suggested. Wheelchair accessible, with a lift (Tabelog; August 2025). Cards; no e-money or QR. Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「なし」 (the English auto-translation wrongly says one is added). Prices revised in September 2026 (official site). Opened 30 May 1994 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Fuyamachi, near Tawaraya Ryokan — 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Tempura fried lightly in cottonseed oil, from the people of Tawaraya Ryokan (official site) · lunch, tax included: tempura donburi ¥4,950 (three small dishes, tendon or a tempura plate, fruit); tenshin tempura ¥13,200 (three small dishes, 11 tempura, rice, fruit); kaiseki tempura "Hanamizuki" ¥18,700 (official menu, September 2026) · dinner kaiseki tempura: "Sazanka" ¥22,000 (12 tempura), "Tsubaki" ¥27,500 (four dishes, 12 tempura), "Botan" ¥33,000 (with a seasonal hot pot — hamo shabu, soft-shell turtle or fugu — and 13 tempura); hamo, suppon and fugu on request; boxed meals on set days (official menu) · seen: shrimp and shrimp heads, conger eel and its bones, eel wrapped in shiso, whiting, Kamo eggplant, corn, fuki-no-tou in spring; to finish, tendon, tempura chazuke or rice with chirimen (2025–2026 reviews) · dipping sauce with plenty of grated daikon and kabosu (September 2025)
places.notes: [Tempura · Fuyamachi near Tawaraya Ryokan, the inn’s tempura house] The tempura restaurant of Tawaraya Ryokan, close to the inn on the same street: an alley and garden lead to a ten-seat counter upstairs and private rooms below. Light, cottonseed-oil tempura — conger eel, shrimp, Kamo eggplant — from a ¥4,950 tendon lunch to kaiseki tempura at ¥22,000–33,000 (2026 prices). Two 2025 diners found the counter hectic because tempura for both floors is fried upstairs. No service charge. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Head chef not named; run by Tawaraya Ryokan, which its site calls the main house (本店)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Ten’yuu stands close to its main house, Tawaraya Ryokan; it uses Kyoto’s deep plots to make an alley so both the counter and the private rooms look onto their own gardens; it fries in cottonseed oil for a light finish. Its related facilities are Tawaraya Ryokan and Gallery Yukei (ギャラリー遊形). Opened 30 May 1994 (Tabelog). Two August 2025 diners call it a Michelin one-star tempura restaurant.
chef_bio.specialty: Kaiseki tempura; conger eel tempura.

anecdotes.text: October 2025: "I felt a bit rushed as the tempura for both the first and second floors was being fried on the second floor, creating a bustling atmosphere similar to a casual diner."
A September 2025 diner drank every drop of the dipping sauce; the owner said there was nothing special in it, but it had plenty of grated daikon and half a kabosu squeezed in.
March 2026: a walk-in on a weekday afternoon got fuki-no-tou tempura — "The flavors reminded me of Tawarayasan, with a careful and gentle taste."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ten-you.jp): 点邑 (てんゆう)、本店の俵屋旅館にほど近い麩屋町、京都の奥行きのある土地に路地を設け、カウンターからも個室からも庭を楽しめる、2階にカウンター10席、1階に4人と6人の個室、綿実油であっさり揚げた天ぷら、昼は天ぷらどんぶりやてんぷらコース、夜は懐石てんぷらコース、昼11:30から (L.O. 13:00)、夜17:30から (L.O. 19:00)、火曜休み・月2回の店休日、TableCheckで予約、2026年9月に価格改定、関連施設は俵屋旅館とギャラリー遊形。お品書き (2026年9月、税込): 昼 天ぷらどんぶり4,950円、点心てんぷら13,200円、懐石天ぷら はなみずき18,700円、夜 懐石天ぷら さざんか22,000円、つばき27,500円、ぼたん33,000円 (鱧しゃぶ・丸なべ・てっちりなど季節のお料理)、鱧・すっぽん・ふぐは相談、折詰。食べログ: 天ぷら・日本料理、中京区麩屋町三条上ル下白山町299、22席、個室、持ち込み料3,300円、服装と香りの注意、子供可、車椅子可、カード可、サービス料は原文で「なし」、1994年5月30日オープン。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年8月、英語): ミシュラン一つ星、俵屋旅館の天ぷら店、穴子、海老と海老の頭、大葉巻きの鰻、鱚、賀茂茄子、とうもろこし、ふきのとう、締めは天丼・天茶・じゃこご飯、大根おろしとかぼすの天つゆ、1階と2階の天ぷらを2階で揚げるので慌ただしいという声 (2件)、外国人客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu on the official site; online booking.

places.name: 喫茶いのん (Kissa Inon)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: the signature is an egg sandwich on soft bread (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Organic herbal teas, coffee and a ginger-muscat float appear, but food centres on egg sandwiches and coffee jelly with ice cream (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: From 10:30, lunch from 11:00; closing time not listed; closed Tuesday and some irregular days; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). 20 seats incl. a counter and a large shared table; terrace seats where pets are allowed; non-smoking (Tabelog; November 2025). Cash, and PayPay per an April 2026 review; no cards (Tabelog). Picnic sets for rent to take to the riverbank (June 2026). Inside a flower shop on Marutamachi-dori by the Kamo River, east of Higashi-Sanbongi; about 140 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Marutamachi by the Kamo River — near Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Café in a working flower shop, with fresh and dried flowers all around (2025–2026 reviews) · egg sandwich ¥880: a fluffy dashimaki in soft, lightly toasted bread with homemade grain mustard (November 2025–September 2026) · coffee jelly with ice cream; organic herbal tea ¥650 (tulsi); Earl Grey iced tea; a ginger and muscat sorbet float (October 2025–September 2026) · bouquets from about ¥2,000 made to your budget (September 2026) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Café · flower shop by the Kamo River, Marutamachi] A little café inside a flower shop a step from the Kamo River: watch walkers and joggers from the counter over an egg sandwich of fluffy dashimaki with crunchy homemade mustard, coffee jelly or a herbal tea, surrounded by fresh and dried flowers. Pick up a bouquet, or rent a picnic set for the riverbank. Pets welcome on the terrace. From 10:30; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a coffee shop with a flower shop on site, near Jingu-Marutamachi, with terrace seats open to pets. Reviewers describe a former flower shop that still sells flowers (November 2025), many regulars (July 2026), and staff who build bouquets around a guest's taste and budget (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Egg sandwich; coffee jelly.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor was served the egg sandwich untoasted that day because the bread was freshly baked and fluffy.
A June 2026 guest saw young people borrow picnic sets and carry takeaway food down to the Kamo River.
A September 2026 visitor ordered a bouquet, chatted while it was made, then took photos by the river.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 喫茶店・カフェ、上京区丸太町通東三本木東入ル俵屋町463、神宮丸太町駅から140m、10:30から、ランチは11:00から、火曜と不定休、予約不可、20席、カウンター、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、花屋を併設、テラス席はペット可。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 鴨川のそば、生花とドライフラワーに囲まれた店内、玉子サンド880円 (ふわふわのだし巻き、自家製の粒マスタード)、コーヒーゼリー (アイス添え)、オーガニックのハーブティー650円 (Tulsi)、アールグレイのアイスティー、生姜とマスカットのシャーベットのフロート、ピクニックセットの貸し出し、花束は2,000円ほどから予算に合わせて、PayPay 可 (2026年4月の口コミ)、常連が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; cash or PayPay; flowers sold too.
