places.name: 竹久 (Takehisa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. An omakase of hassun, sashimi, dobin-mushi, grilled ayu and clay-pot rice, seasoned with miso and soy; fried figs in spring-roll pastry appear (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led Japanese omakase — ayu, conger eel, sashimi, sweet shrimp (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–14:30 (last entry 13:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last entry 19:00); irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). No service charge or cover charge (Tabelog original サービス料、チャージ料なし). Omakase about ¥12,000–14,000 (2024–2025 reviews). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; shoes off at the entrance; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2024). On Takeyamachi-dori east of Muromachi; 3 min walk west from Marutamachi Stn exit 5 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takeyamachi-dori east of Muromachi — 3 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Japanese omakase at an eight-seat counter, strong on fish (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews) · omakase about ¥12,000–14,000, e.g. persimmon in white-miso dressing, a hassun of poached pear, black-bean edamame, ayu with roe and miso-cured egg yolk; sashimi with fresh-grated wasabi; dobin-mushi or a matsutake soup; large fluffy conger eel; grilled ayu (October 2024; September 2025) · figs fried in spring-roll pastry, simmered sanma, homemade simmered green plums (September 2025) · large Hyogo sweet shrimp, chestnut rice, a warm chestnut kinton to finish (December 2025; October 2026) · wild taranome the chef forages in the mountains each spring (March 2026) · sake; plum-wine soda; seasonal green-plum soda (2024–2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese omakase · Takeyamachi Muromachi near Marutamachi] A shoes-off, eight-seat counter cooking the Kyoto seasons into one omakase of about ¥12,000–14,000: grilled ayu with roe in late summer, matsutake and conger eel in autumn, chestnut rice and a warm chestnut kinton, and in spring wild taranome the chef gathers in the mountains. No service charge. Cash only; reservation only.

roles: Chef (unnamed), who forages wild mountain vegetables in spring (March 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a reservation-only, eight-seat counter for adults to enjoy seasonal ingredients; registered as an official listing by the shop. A March 2026 reviewer writes that the chef goes into the mountains to gather taranome, so some days there is none; an October 2024 reviewer notes summer heat had delayed both ayu and chestnuts that year; the summer noren is white (September 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: A hidden place for adults to savour seasonal ingredients (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Ayu with roe; chestnut rice.

anecdotes.text: One regular has logged over sixty visits on Tabelog, returning several times in October 2026 for the overlap of ayu with roe and chestnuts.
An October 2024 guest heard of the chestnut rice at a dinner a year earlier and waited a full season to try it.
A September 2025 guest was astonished to find matsutake at this price, the first of the year.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区竹屋町通室町東入亀屋町141-1、地下鉄丸太町駅5番出口から西へ徒歩約3分、12:00〜14:30 (最終入店13:00)、17:30〜22:30 (最終入店19:00)、不定休、完全予約制、サービス料・チャージ料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、8席 (カウンター)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、旬の食材を味わう大人の隠れ家。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 靴を脱いで上がる、おまかせ12,000〜14,000円ほど、柿の白和え、八寸 (洋梨のコンポート、黒豆の枝豆、子持ち鮎、黄身の味噌漬け)、お造り (おろしたてのわさび)、土瓶蒸し、松茸のお椀、鱧、鮎の塩焼き、無花果の春巻き揚げ、秋刀魚の煮物、青梅の甘露煮、兵庫の甘海老、栗ご飯、温かい栗きんとん、シェフが山で採る天然のたらの芽 (2026年3月)、夏は白いのれん、青梅のソーダ、梅酒ソーダ。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; shoes off; one omakase; cash only.

places.name: ルボンディー (REBONDIE)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: a wheat bakery of cornets, croissants, loaves and filled breads (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Country bread and baguettes may suit, but there is no ingredient information; most items use butter, cream, cheese, egg or meat (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Friday–Wednesday 7:00–18:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). The cornets often sell out by midday (2025–2026 reviews). Reservations (orders) accepted; reserved items are set aside (Tabelog; April 2026). No cards; e-money and QR incl. PayPay (Tabelog; March 2025). Takeaway; no parking — coin parking nearby (Tabelog; April and October 2026). A red-roofed shop on the 1F of North Point M in Ichijoji Umenoki-cho; near the Ichijoji Umenoki-cho bus stop, about 7 min from Ichijoji Stn on the Eizan line (Tabelog; June 2025, April 2026).
places.neighborhood: Ichijoji Umenoki-cho — 7 min walk from Ichijoji Stn (Eizan)
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood boulangerie (2024–2026 reviews) · signature cornet crisp ¥227, filled with fresh cream at the till — two of three creams can be mixed (November 2024; May 2026) · premium sliced loaf ¥443, croissant ¥216, anpan ¥205, French peanut bread ¥194, salted-butter bread ¥217, butter coupe (March 2025–February 2026) · fleur of stewed apple and custard ¥227, cream bun ¥227, kinako doughnut ¥119, twist doughnut ¥173 (2025–2026 reviews) · savoury: spinach and salmon quiche ¥410 (weekends), pizza bread ¥238, eggplant gratin ¥238, French spiced bacon, sausage French, frank doughnut, French egg sandwich with mentaiko (2025–2026 reviews) · under ¥1,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Bakery · Ichijoji, red roof] A red-roofed Ichijoji bakery known for its crisp cornet, filled with fresh cream at the till while you wait — come before noon or it is gone. Around it: a premium sliced loaf, croissants, salted-butter rolls, French peanut bread, weekend quiche and plenty of savoury breads such as spiced bacon, eggplant gratin and a mentaiko egg sandwich. PayPay but no cards. From 7:00; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bread and sandwich shop in Ichijoji with takeaway; orders by reservation. Reviewers describe the signature cornet filled at the register (November 2024), items set aside for reservations (April 2026), and breads fresh from the oven through the morning (July 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Cornet crisp.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 pair walked in at 9:30 just as the sausage French came out of the oven, and split one while it was hot.
A May 2026 visitor arriving around 13:00 grabbed one of the last cornets and had it filled with two creams.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン・サンドイッチ、左京区一乗寺梅ノ木町54-1 ノースポイントM 1F、叡山電鉄「茶山」か「一乗寺」、市バス「一乗寺梅ノ木町」、金〜水 7:00〜18:00、木曜定休、予約可、カード不可、電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、駐車場なし、テイクアウト。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 赤い屋根、名物のCorne Crisp 227円 (レジで生クリームを詰める、3種から2種のハーフ&ハーフも)、昼までに売り切れることが多い、プレミアム食パン5枚443円、クロワッサン216円、あんぱん205円、French Peanut 194円、塩バターパン217円、Butter Coupe、りんごとカスタードの Fleur 227円、クリームパン227円、きなこドーナツ119円、ツイストドーナツ173円、ほうれん草とサーモンのキッシュ410円 (週末)、ピザパン238円、茄子のグラタン238円、French Spiced Bacon、ソーセージフランス、フランクドーナツ、明太子の玉子サンド、PayPay 可。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick from the shelves; cornets filled at the till; PayPay or e-money, no cards.

places.name: 下鴨 大登龍 (Shimogamo Daitoryu)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: Chinese dishes in soy-based sauces, gyoza, spring rolls, fried rice and noodles alongside yakiniku with dipping sauces (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese, Korean and yakiniku dishes built on pork, beef, shrimp and egg (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Friday–Sunday 17:00–23:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised (Tabelog; December 2025, May 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter, tables and tatami rooms; non-smoking; children welcome; 3 parking spaces in front (Tabelog; December 2025). Shimogamo, near Shimogamo Shrine; about 380 m from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; January 2026). Leftovers can be taken home (June 2026).
places.neighborhood: Shimogamo, near Shimogamo Shrine — 5 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Long-running local Chinese restaurant that also serves Korean dishes, Hong Kong dishes and yakiniku (2025–2026 reviews) · Chinese: homemade spring rolls, gyoza, black fried rice, seafood fried rice with sauce, shrimp mayo, chicken with cashews, Sichuan steamed pork, sweet and sour pork, mapo tofu, clam noodles, stir-fried egg with pork and wood ear (2025–2026 reviews) · yakiniku: thick salted tongue, kalbi, wagyu upper belly, skirt, liver, an assorted lean platter (2025–2026 reviews) · Korean: tteok, kimchi, Chamisul soju; a dried-tofu salad (August 2025) · about ¥3,000–5,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Chinese and yakiniku · Shimogamo, local favourite] A busy, family-filled neighbourhood restaurant near Shimogamo Shrine that does three things at once: wok-loud local Chinese (black fried rice, homemade spring rolls, Sichuan steamed pork, mapo tofu), yakiniku of thick tongue and lean cuts, and Korean plates with soju. Fast, generous and cash only; one 2026 guest found the tongue tough and the steamed pork heavy. Book ahead. Evenings; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: Chinese, yakiniku and tripe near Demachiyanagi with tatami rooms and parking. Reviewers in 2025–2026 call it a long-established local Chinese restaurant that also offers Hong Kong and Korean dishes and yakiniku (August 2025; July 2026), with dishes served astonishingly fast to the sound of high-heat woks (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Black fried rice; thick salted tongue.

anecdotes.text: Every Obon a group of local classmates holds its reunion here — August 2025 and again in August 2026.
A June 2026 solo diner who over-ordered was offered a box for the leftovers.
A January 2026 visitor had long noticed the car park always full before finally coming for the fried rice and gyoza.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華料理・焼肉・ホルモン、左京区下鴨宮崎町123、出町柳駅から376m、月・火・金〜日 17:00〜23:00、水・木曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター、座敷、禁煙、子ども可、駐車場3台。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 下鴨神社の近く、昔からの町の中華、香港と韓国の料理も、焼肉も、自家製の春巻き、餃子、黒チャーハン、あんかけの海鮮チャーハン、エビマヨ、鶏とカシューナッツ、四川風の蒸し豚、酢豚、麻婆豆腐、あさりの麺、豚と木耳の卵炒め、厚切りの塩タン、カルビ、和牛の上バラ、ハラミ、レバー、赤身の盛り合わせ、トック、キムチ、Chamisul、干し豆腐のサラダ、提供が早い、残りは持ち帰り可、予約がおすすめ、タンが硬く蒸し豚が重いとの声 (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Long menu in Japanese; book ahead; cash only; parking for three cars.

places.name: 京やき肉よし田 (Kyo Yakiniku Yoshida)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: yakiniku sauces and soy-marinated cuts, warm noodles and cold noodles (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Monday. 20 seats including a private room (March 2026); non-smoking; cards (Visa, Master, JCB, Amex, Diners), no e-money. The shop says it revamped its menu for "better quality at a lower price," with an average spend of ¥4,500–5,900 a head (Tabelog); reviewers in 2024–2026 still found it pricey (¥6,000–15,000). Tabelog lists no service charge.
places.neighborhood: Karasuma-Gojo — by Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Wagyu yakiniku in a stylish machiya-like room (2024–2026 reviews) · thick-cut platter of three (special loin, kalbi, lean), sliced platters, wagyu harami ¥1,000 and kalbi ¥1,000 (October 2024), premium tongue, ichibo, grilled wagyu sirloin-cap "sashimi", special wagyu yaki-shabu, soy-marinated sliced beef with egg, mountain-chain tripe, salted colon (2024–2026 reviews) · Kyoto kimchi, namul, sanchu, Japanese-style warm noodles, cold noodles, homemade sours (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Karasuma-Gojo, wagyu in a stylish room] A calm, stylish wagyu yakiniku house by Gojo Station: thick-cut special loin and kalbi, grilled sirloin-cap "sashimi", yaki-shabu and a soy-marinated sliced beef that one diner rated above the pricier cuts. Most reviewers call it delicious but pricey; a 2023 diner found the menu far dearer than Tabelog showed, and a March 2026 family found the private room cold from the air duct. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe a clean, stylish, low-odour room near the Karasuma-Gojo crossing with a private room, kind staff, and high-grade wagyu. The shop’s Tabelog blurb says it reworked its menu and policy after guests asked for "better quality at a lower price."
chef_bio.specialty: Thick-cut wagyu platter; yaki-shabu.

anecdotes.text: August 2023: "Menu differs too much from the official one, and the price increase is outrageous!" — an assorted sliced platter at ¥4,900 and a thick-cut platter at ¥7,900.
March 2026: "The air from the duct was really strong and it was honestly quite cold (laughs)" — blankets were brought; no bibimbap, and only two cold-noodle soups.
April 2026: after the high-end dishes, "the most delicious item was the affordable marinated offcuts in soy sauce."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京やき肉よし田、焼肉・ホルモン、下京区横諏訪町313-1、地下鉄五条駅4番出口から、火〜日 17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、月曜休み、20席、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー不可、「より良い品質をより安く」の声に応えてメニューを改訂、平均予算1人4,500〜5,900円。口コミ (2023年8月〜2026年7月、英語): 厚切り3種盛り (特上ロース・特上カルビ・特上赤身)、切り落としの盛り合わせ、和牛ハラミ1,000円、カルビ1,000円、上タン塩、イチボ、和牛ランプの炙り刺し、特選和牛の焼きしゃぶ、切り落としの醤油漬けと卵、ミノ、シマチョウ塩、京キムチ、ナムル、サンチュ、和風温麺、冷麺、自家製サワー、おしゃれで落ち着いた店内、個室、値段は高めという声が多い、2023年には食べログのメニューより大幅に高いという声、個室の空調が寒かった (2026年3月)、ビビンバはない。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by the cut; book ahead.

places.name: ラ・プレーヌ・リュヌ (La Pleine Lune)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: courses come with bread and pastry desserts (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg starter, fish, wagyu, cheese and cream (official site; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday and one other irregular day a month. Course prices include tax and a 5% service charge (official site; Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料5％」). No cards at lunch (official site); cards (Visa, Master, JCB) at dinner. Groups of five or more get a set omakase course. 16 seats, counter and tables; non-smoking.
places.neighborhood: Karasuma-Nijo — 6 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Classic French cooking with Burgundy wine (official site) · lunch: Menu A ¥4,000 (egg, starter, potage, main, dessert, coffee and petits fours), Menu B ¥5,200 (adds the day’s fish), chef’s omakase ¥6,300 by the day before (official site) · dinner: Menu A ¥6,400, Menu B ¥8,600, chef’s omakase "Plaisir" ¥12,000 by two days before; kuroge wagyu rump roast +¥1,200, French cheeses +¥600; strawberry soup with coconut blanc-manger (official site) · seen: oeuf brouillé served in the shell, mushroom foam soup, smoked salmon and crab, sea bass in cream, slow-cooked ayu in olive oil, peach soups and desserts in summer (2018–2026 reviews) · the chef chooses the wine (December 2024)
places.notes: [French · Karasuma-Nijo, classic cooking and Burgundy] A sixteen-seat French restaurant founded in 2006 by owner-chef 西居 直映, at Karasuma-Nijo since 2016: classic dishes — the egg in its shell, foams, sea bass in cream — with Burgundy the chef pours for you. Lunch ¥4,000–6,300 and dinner ¥6,400–12,000 including tax and service. No cards at lunch. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: La Pleine Lune opened in 2006 at 烏丸綾小路 as a ten-seat restaurant, and moved to Karasuma-Nijo in its tenth year, 2016, to serve classic French cooking with the Burgundy wines the chef loves; it marked 20 years on 27 May 2026. Tabelog gives the current site’s opening as 10 September 2016. A May 2026 diner remembers a ¥2,000 French lunch at the old address.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「時代を超えて愛されるクラシカルなフランス料理」 with Burgundy, in a quiet room — to be a restaurant where people spend good time.
chef_bio.specialty: Oeuf brouillé in the shell; Burgundy pairings.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner who knew the old shop: the first dish, the egg, "is a dream food for us middle-aged folks—it’s the same as in Lupin III."
June 2024: flavours "comparable to a Michelin 1-star," but "there are many visible clutter around, and the cooking oil smoke can be a bit overwhelming."
A six-time regular at Christmas 2024: "The chef always selects the wine for us."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (la-pleine-lune.com): フランス料理とブルゴーニュワインのお店 ラ プレーヌ リュヌ、2006年に烏丸綾小路で10席の店として開業、2016年に烏丸二条へ移転、時代を超えて愛されるクラシカルなフランス料理とブルゴーニュワイン、オーナーシェフ 西居 直映、2026年5月27日で20周年、ランチ Menu A 4,000円・Menu B 5,200円・シェフお任せ6,300円 (前日まで)、ディナー Menu A 6,400円・Menu B 8,600円・プレジール12,000円 (2日前まで)、税とサービス料5%込み、黒毛和牛ランプのロースト+1,200円、チーズ+600円、苺のスープとココナッツのブランマンジェ、ランチはクレジットカード不可、5名以上はおまかせ、夏は桃のスープやデザート。食べログ: フレンチ、中京区二条通高倉西入ル松屋町55-1 西本ビル 2F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩約6分、昼12:00〜15:00・夜18:00〜23:00、水曜休みと月1回の不定休、16席、禁煙、カード (VISA・Master・JCB)、サービス料5%、2016年9月10日オープン。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): 殻に入った卵の料理、きのこの泡のスープ、スモークサーモンと蟹、スズキのクリームソース、鮎のコンフィ、シェフがワインを選ぶ、移転前は2,000円のランチ、ミシュラン一つ星並みの味だが店内に物が多く油煙が気になるという声 (2024年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses with a choice of main and dessert.

places.name: assemblages+
places.gf_detail: Ask: gelato and kakigori may be wheat-free, but toppings include meringue, tuile, macarons, cookie dough and baked sweets; lunch is pizza (2026 reviews). Tabelog says allergy information is available.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: milk gelato and milk-ice kakigori, custard, meringue (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat 12:00–21:00; Sun 12:00–18:00 (Monday holidays follow Sunday hours); closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Lunch and café 12:00–17:00, dinner 18:00–21:00, with different menus. 9 counter seats on the ground floor around a single wooden slab, and about 20 free seats upstairs for sweets (Tabelog; August 2026). Reservations taken; day-of changes by phone. Non-smoking; children welcome; allergy information available; cards, no e-money or QR. Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「無し」. Opened 6 November 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi-Nijo area — 7 min walk from Marutamachi Stn; 10 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae
places.cuisine: The casual sibling of the dessert restaurant Assemblages Kakimoto: a chef’s dishes on the ground floor, the pâtissier’s gelato and baked sweets upstairs (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · gelato with paired flavours — shiso-strawberry, banana-lemon-coconut, cardamom-chamomile, peach with sherry, cheese with black pepper, Joyo fig with white wine and anise, pistachio, chocolate; double ¥864, triple ¥972, special gelato with macarons and coffee espuma ¥1,650; a meringue bear on top (2025–2026 reviews) · monthly kakigori on vanilla milk ice — melon in July, peach in August (2026 reviews) · seasonal pizza ¥1,980 (fig and prosciutto), Bismarck ¥1,870, Margherita; fruit curry of Kameoka or Kumamoto beef, the full-size version of the mini curry at the end of the Kakimoto dinner course (2026 reviews) · mini pound cakes in the ¥800s; affogato (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Gelato & café · Kiyamachi, the Kakimoto pâtissier’s casual house] The casual sister of Assemblages Kakimoto: a nine-seat counter for small pizzas and the fruit curry that ends the Kakimoto course, and an upstairs room for gelato in unusual pairings — shiso-strawberry, cardamom-chamomile, peach with sherry — under a meringue bear, plus a monthly kakigori in summer. No service charge. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: A chef (food) and a pâtissier (sweets), not named for this shop; sister of Assemblages Kakimoto (kyoto_assemblages_kakimoto)
chef_bio.background: Opened 6 November 2023 (Tabelog). The shop blurb describes a hideaway in a Japanese-style space with the chef’s dishes on the first floor and the pâtissier’s sweets and gelato upstairs. An August 2026 diner calls it the place to eat the full-size version of the mini fruit curry served at the end of the dinner course at the main shop, Assemblages Kakimoto; another says the gelato shows the ingredient pairings Kakimoto is known for. The lunch set ended in June 2026 (June 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Paired-flavour gelato; monthly kakigori.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular: "you can enjoy the full-size version of the mini curry served at the end of the dinner course at the main branch."
A July 2026 diner skipped the August peach kakigori: "the gelato contains sherry, and since I’m not a fan of alcohol…"
September 2026: a triple scoop for ¥972 — "In Tokyo, I think this would cost around JPY 1,200."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: assemblages+、ケーキ・ジェラート・カフェ、中京区木屋町484、丸太町駅から徒歩約7分、月木金土 12:00〜21:00、日 12:00〜18:00、火水休み、ランチとカフェは12:00〜17:00、ディナーは18:00〜21:00でメニューが異なる、1階カウンター9席 (2階のフリースペース約20席)、予約可、禁煙、子供可、アレルギー表示あり、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、サービス料は原文で「無し」、2023年11月6日オープン、1階でシェフの料理、2階でパティシエのスイーツとジェラート。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年10月、英語): アッサンブラージュ カキモトのディナーの締めのミニカレーのフルサイズ版のフルーツカレー (Kameoka・Kumamoto の牛)、季節のピザ1,980円、ビスマルク1,870円、マルゲリータ、ジェラートのダブル864円・トリプル972円・スペシャル1,650円、赤紫蘇と苺、バナナとレモンとココナッツ、カルダモンとカモミール、桃とシェリー、チーズと黒胡椒、Joyo の無花果と白ワインとアニス、メレンゲのクマ、7月はメロン・8月は桃のかき氷、ミニパウンドケーキ800円台、アフォガート、ランチセットは6月で終了。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick gelato flavours at the counter; upstairs room for sweets.

places.name: 酒陶 柳野 (Shuto Yanagino)
places.gf_detail: Ask: drinks are mostly wine, cocktails and whisky; the snacks include kara-age and fried oysters (January 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: snacks of sashimi, fried oysters and cheese (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–24:00; hours may change. 14 seats — 8 at a long single-slab counter and 6 at tables with a garden view, usable as a private room for 8; non-smoking, ashtray in the garden (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, Amex, Diners), no e-money or QR. No drink menu — tell the bartender what you feel like (March 2025); food prices are not listed, and one diner’s bill came out higher than expected (October 2025). Moved from Teramachi to Sanjo-Shinmachi (Tabelog; April 2019 review).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-Shinmachi — about 5 min walk west of Karasuma-Sanjo
places.cuisine: A bar of antique vessels, wine and cocktails, with real food (2019–2026 reviews) · cocktails made to your mood, seasonal fruit cocktails, a Talisker highball, wine — often natural, two by the glass, a Cru Beaujolais ¥1,800 (June 2026) — whisky and brandy (2025–2026 reviews) · snacks with Kyoto vegetables: sashimi of yokowa and sea bream on ceramics by a favourite potter, ginkgo kara-age, fried oysters, fried sawara with shungiku and house tartar, Roquefort with honey; fish from a Nishiki fishmonger (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bar · Sanjo-Shinmachi, antique vessels and a garden room] A softly lit bar on Sanjo, open since 1997 by an owner who trained with an antique dealer: a long one-slab counter, a back room over a small garden, beautiful old glassware and ceramics, cocktails made to your mood and natural-leaning wine, plus proper snacks with Kyoto vegetables. No drink menu and no prices shown, so one diner found the bill higher than expected. Open nightly till midnight.

roles: Owner, not named; trained under an antique dealer (June 2026)
chef_bio.background: A June 2026 diner says the bar has run since 1997 and that the owner, who studied under an antique dealer, brings old vessels and tea-room culture into the space. Tabelog notes it moved from Teramachi-dori (Anekoji-nishi-iru) to its current place; a regular has come since the Teramachi days (April 2019). Reviewers describe a brick-walled entrance, a long wooden counter, a garden at the back, knowledgeable staff, and seasonal events.
chef_bio.specialty: Cocktails to order; antique glassware.

anecdotes.text: "There is no drink menu; instead, you can tell the bartender your mood or what you feel like drinking, and they will create something for you." — March 2025.
October 2025: "I was a bit nervous ordering since the prices weren’t listed. In the end, the final bill was higher than I expected."
June 2026: "I felt it might be a type of bar where evaluations vary depending on one’s compatibility with the establishment’s style."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒陶 柳野、バー・ワインバー、中京区三条新町西入ル、烏丸三条から西へ徒歩約5分、毎日 17:00〜24:00、14席 (カウンター8、庭が見えるテーブル6)、個室8名、禁煙 (庭に灰皿)、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR不可、寺町通姉小路西入ル南側から移転。口コミ (2019〜2026年、英語): 1997年から営業、骨董商に学んだ店主、古い器と茶室の文化、レンガの入口と一枚板の長いカウンター、奥に庭、ドリンクメニューはなく気分を伝えて作ってもらう、季節の果物のカクテル、タリスカーのハイボール、ワイン (グラスは白赤2種、クリュ・ボージョレ1,800円)、京野菜のつまみ、刺身、銀杏の唐揚げ、牡蠣フライ、鰆のフライと春菊、ロックフォールと蜂蜜、Nishiki の魚屋の魚、値段の表示がなく会計が予想より高かった (2025年10月)、相性で評価が分かれる店という声。

cultural_comfort.note: No drink menu or prices shown; you order by conversation with the bartender.

places.name: しぇりークラブ 京都･石塀小路 (Sherry Club Kyoto Ishibekoji)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Iberico ham, olives, marinated sardines, ajillo with bread, paella and venison; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; most dishes are ham, seafood or meat (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 15:00–24:00; Sat 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–24:00; Sun 12:00–23:00 (the official site gives Sun 12:00–22:00); closed Monday (Tabelog; official site). Bookings by phone, Tabelog or e-mail. Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「550円（付出代として）」 — ¥550 as an appetizer charge. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 21 seats per Tabelog — 9 at the counter, 8 at tables; a December 2025 diner counted six counter seats and two tables in a half-basement. Designated smoking area; children welcome (Tabelog). In a converted storehouse on the stone-walled Ishibe-koji lane, a short walk from Yasaka Shrine; 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Ishibe-koji lane by Yasaka Shrine — 10 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: A sherry specialist with Spanish food: a deep sherry list explained glass by glass, an omakase three-glass tasting from dry to sweet, rebujito in summer; Iberico ham (imports halted by African swine fever, September 2026), olives, marinated sardines, red prawn and mushroom ajillo, sautéed Ezo venison, seafood paella, cheese matched to sherry, dried Shine Muscat, vanilla ice cream with sherry; a four-dish course (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Sherry & Spanish · Ishibe-koji by Yasaka Shrine] A hideaway bar in an old storehouse on the stone-walled lane, where the owner talks you through sherries from bone-dry to sweet — try the three-glass tasting — with jamón, ajillo, sardines and paella. About ¥5,000–10,000. Open from mid-afternoon to midnight; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 October 2008 (Tabelog); the Kyoto shop of Sherry Club, whose other bar is in Ginza (official site). Reviewers describe the master guiding first-timers at the counter (2025–26).
chef_bio.philosophy: Sherry for every moment — aperitif, with food, and after (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sherry tastings; paella and ajillo.

anecdotes.text: A first-timer in August 2024 was told it was fine to ask anything; by July 2026, on a third yearly visit, nine sherries were tasted while listening to the chef across the counter.
An October 2025 visitor noted a "Silence" sign in the alley and wrote that "you won't find any foreign guests" here; the barman's performances of earlier years seemed to have ended.
When a March 2026 guest mentioned how hard sherry is to find back home, the staff looked up places to recommend.
A July 2026 regular of the Ginza shop heard that the soda in the rebujito differs between the two bars.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: しぇりークラブ、銀座店 (中央区銀座6-3-17) と京都店 (東山区下河原町489-2)、京都店は火〜金 15:00〜24:00、土 12:00〜15:00・17:00〜24:00、日 12:00〜22:00、シェリー酒は辛口から甘口まで食前・食中・食後に。食べログ (店舗会員): しぇりークラブ 京都･石塀小路、スペイン料理・バル・ヨーロッパ料理、祇園四条駅から徒歩10分、月曜休み、付出代550円、21席 (カウンター9・テーブル8)、分煙、カード可、子供可、2008年10月7日オープン、石塀小路の蔵、パエリアとアヒージョ。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年9月、英語): マスターのシェリーの説明、3種の飲み比べ、イベリコ豚の生ハム (アフリカ豚熱で輸入停止)、イワシのマリネ、えびときのこのアヒージョ、Ezo の鹿肉、魚介のパエリア、半地下の空間、外国人客はいないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: The master explains each sherry at the counter.

places.name: みまでり (Mimaderi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Skewers with sauce or salt, obanzai in dashi, kara-age, beef cutlet and kitsune udon (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and there are vegetable skewers and salads, but obanzai use dashi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon and Sat 17:30–23:00; Tue–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday, and the last day of long holidays (Tabelog). Bookings taken; all-you-can-drink courses; lunch queues form after 11:30 (Tabelog; July 2026 review). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「お一人様200円（コースの場合は除きます）」 — ¥200 per person, except with a course. English menu (Tabelog). 44 seats: counter and tables downstairs; tatami, sunken-kotatsu and terrace seats upstairs; parties of up to 30. Designated smoking area. Cards, e-money, PayPay (Tabelog). In a bright machiya with a lantern, two blocks along Anekoji from Karasuma-dori, then left; 3 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Karasuma Oike — 3 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: About 50 kinds of kushiyaki, classic and original, with obanzai (Tabelog): assorted three obanzai — simmered sardines, spinach in white sesame, simmered eggplant — sea bream carpaccio, a ten-vegetable salad, chicken breast with ume and shiso, prosciutto-wrapped mozzarella, five-skewer yakitori platter, kitsune udon with skewers; cheap lunch sets such as beef cutlet, kara-age, or the daily fish (mackerel in miso) with a small "Piccolo Curry"; courses about ¥4,900 ending in beef shigure rice (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kushiyaki & obanzai · near Karasuma Oike] A lantern-lit machiya izakaya with about fifty kinds of skewers, Kyoto obanzai and local sake, and tatami rooms upstairs for groups. Lunch sets are cheap and draw queues; dinner about ¥3,000–5,000, plus ¥200 per person. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a machiya izakaya of kushiyaki and obanzai; a September 2026 reviewer returning after more than ten years found the lantern still there.
chef_bio.specialty: Kushiyaki; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 lunch guest walked in at 11:30 and left to find a queue outside.
A September 2026 banquet guest praised the kind phone manner; the ¥4,900 course came to ¥4,570 with a coupon.
An October 2026 diner enjoyed the playful dish names and thought the place should promote itself more on Tabelog.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): みまでり、串焼き・居酒屋・日本料理、中京区姉小路間之町木之下町、烏丸御池駅から徒歩3分、月土 17:30〜23:00、火〜金 11:30〜14:00・17:30〜23:00、日曜休み (連休最終日も休み)、お一人様200円 (コースは除く)、44席 (2階に座敷・掘りごたつ・テラス、1階にテーブル・カウンター)、30名まで、分煙、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、英語メニュー、飲み放題、約50種の串焼きとおばんざい、提灯の町家。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): おばんざい3種盛り (いわしの煮付け、ほうれん草の白ごま和え、なすの煮浸し)、鯛のカルパッチョ、10種の野菜サラダ、鶏むねの梅しそ、生ハム巻きモッツァレラ、焼き鳥5種盛り、串付ききつねうどん、安いランチ (牛カツ、唐揚げ、鯖の味噌煮と小さなカレー)、4,900円のコースと牛しぐれご飯。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog).

places.name: 徳まる (Tokumaru)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi and soy-based kappo dishes, tempura and a menchi katsu; no gluten information (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and meat kappo cooking in dashi (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00 (last food order 22:00); closed Wednesday, over the New Year and on occasional other days (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Three omakase courses or à la carte from a long daily menu — a few dishes come first, then you order freely; a February 2024 diner found no prices on the menu (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews). Cards (Tabelog). 9 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). On a back street behind Kyoto City Hall; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; April 2025 review).
places.neighborhood: Behind Kyoto City Hall — 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal kappo by omakase or à la carte, with Kagoshima shochu and about ten sakes (Tabelog): omakase ¥14,000 (August 2026); grilled-meat potato salad, nodoguro with grilled eggplant, warm hamo with plum, fig simmered in sake with sesame vinegar (July 2025); black maitake tempura, grilled cod milt, matsutake, eel-tempura rice ball (November 2025); whelk and surf clam, eel with myoga, grouper (August 2026); Biwa trout and aburabouzu (August 2026); a menchi katsu of "Tsuki no Wa Kuma" (April 2025); bamboo-shoot dishes and warabi mochi in spring (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo counter · behind Kyoto City Hall] A white nine-seat counter where the chef cooks the season to order — omakase (about ¥14,000) or à la carte from a long list: nodoguro with eggplant, hamo, black-maitake tempura, an eel-tempura rice ball. About ¥10,000–20,000. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 November 2022 (Tabelog). A July 2025 reviewer says it was started by the head chef of "Oshikouji Yuuki", which served Kyoto cuisine à la carte; an August 2026 diner notes it runs mainly with a single chef.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal à la carte kappo.

anecdotes.text: In April 2024 the first dish a regular ordered turned out to be one the "playful" chef had forgotten to source.
A November 2025 diner wanted to take the eel-tempura rice ball home, but there were no containers — and asked the shop to consider takeout.
A diner of six visits came back at the end of summer 2026 for whelk, surf clam and grouper.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 徳まる、日本料理、中京区亀屋町406、京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分、17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、水曜休み (年末年始ほか不定休)、カウンター9席、禁煙、カード可、2022年11月19日オープン、旬の食材のおまかせコース3種と一品料理、鹿児島の焼酎と日本酒10種。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年8月、英語): 市役所裏の路地、白木のカウンター、おまかせ14,000円、肉じゃがサラダ、のどぐろと焼きなす、鱧の梅肉、いちじくの酒煮、黒舞茸の天ぷら、白子焼き、鰻天むす、grouper、ビワマス、アブラボウズ、Tsuki no Wa Kuma のメンチカツ、品書きに値段がないという声、Oshikouji Yuuki の料理長が始めた店、ほぼ一人の料理人。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese-only à la carte counter; the menu may not show prices.

places.name: ERUTAN RESTAURANT BAR
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wood-fired pizza and pasta are wheat; salads, fish and roast pork also served; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A salad bar with many vegetables and dressings at lunch, but most dishes have cheese, ham, fish or meat (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–10:00 (last order 9:30); lunch 11:30–14:00; café 14:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); dinner 17:30–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30); bar 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); irregular closures with the facility; closed 31 December–2 January (Tabelog). Bookings taken; same-day cancellations and no-shows are charged 100% (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay. 95 seats with a counter and sofas, two private rooms for 6–12; wheelchair accessible; children welcome with high chairs; non-smoking; parking in the building (Tabelog). Lunch buffet runs 90 minutes and is often full on weekdays — book (2026 reviews). 1F of GOOD NATURE STATION, just before Takashimaya on Kawaramachi; 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn exit 4 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi south of Shijo — 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: All-day Italian with a wood-fired oven and local ingredients (Tabelog): lunch buffet of a salad bar, three pizzas, prosciutto sliced to order, Miyama-milk cheese, sides and a pasta main; afternoon tea, in autumn 2026 with Kyoho and Shine Muscat grapes; dinner à la carte or the ERUTAN SPECIARE sharing course ¥5,000 (October 2026) — scallop zuppa, fried hamo with pesto, house tagliolini, shirasu or Kyoto duck and Kujo green onion pizza, Shimanto pork; sawara of the day, genovese; tiramisu and cakes in the café; bar till 23:00 (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian, pizza & bar · Kawaramachi-Shijo] The big, stylish ground-floor dining room of GOOD NATURE STATION, open from breakfast to the late bar: a lunch buffet of salad bar and wood-fired pizza, seasonal afternoon tea, and a ¥5,000 sharing course at night. Lunch ¥2,000–3,000; dinner ¥5,000–8,000. Wheelchair accessible.

roles: Restaurant of GOOD NATURE STATION (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 9 December 2019; renewed on 15 April (Tabelog). The ground-floor restaurant and bar of GOOD NATURE STATION, whose building also houses Hyssop, RAU, TAKAYAMA and VELROSIER.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients and authentic technique, with oven-baked pizza, in a casual setting (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wood-fired pizza; lunch buffet.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 buffet guest liked the Miyama-milk cheese with honey but felt hurried by the next person in the salad line.
Turned away by long queues elsewhere near Kawaramachi in October 2026, a visitor found a seat at once in the spacious café at the back.
A Friday-night diner in October 2026 found it full by 19:00 and paid just over ¥8,000 each with two glasses of wine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ERUTAN RESTAURANT BAR、イタリアン・ダイニングバー・パスタ、下京区河原町通四条下ル2丁目稲荷町318-6 GOOD NATURE STATION 1F、京都河原町駅4番出口から徒歩2分、朝食 7:00〜10:00、ランチ 11:30〜14:00、カフェ 14:00〜17:00、ディナー 17:30〜22:00、バー 18:00〜23:00、不定休 (施設に準ずる)、12月31日〜1月2日休み、当日キャンセルは100%、95席、個室2室、車椅子可、子供可 (キッズチェア)、禁煙、施設の駐車場、2019年12月9日オープン、4月15日リニューアル、薪窯のピッツァと地元の食材。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年11月、英語): ランチビュッフェ (サラダバー、ピッツァ3種、生ハム、美山の牛乳のチーズ、パスタ)、ぶどうのアフタヌーンティー、ERUTAN SPECIARE シェアコース5,000円、鰆、ジェノベーゼ、奥のカフェ。

cultural_comfort.note: Large hotel-complex restaurant; wheelchair accessible.

places.name: 洋食とワイン Ao (Yoshoku to Wine Ao)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yoshoku with breaded croquettes and cutlets, fried shrimp, sauces and baguette; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu-hamburg and seafood yoshoku menu (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00, last entry 20:30); Saturday 16:00–22:00; closed Sunday (open when Monday is a holiday) and two other days a month (Tabelog). Earlier reviews mention a lunch course (October–November 2025); Tabelog now lists dinner only. À la carte carries a ¥300 seat charge per person (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「アラカルトは席料としてお一人様300円(税込)」). 15 seats: a 9-seat wooden counter and 6 at tables; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay (Tabelog). An easy-to-miss street-level entrance on Sanjo-dori west of Karasuma, past NHK, 261 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; January 2026).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-Karasuma — 261 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Yoshoku with wine, as courses or à la carte, built around 100% Kuroge wagyu hamburg steak and seasonal ingredients (Tabelog) · hamburg in several sauces (salt is a favourite), foie-gras hamburg, uni cream croquette, "angel" fried shrimp with Saikyo-miso tartare, rare cutlet of Miyazaki wagyu sirloin cap, tuna and ratatouille tartare, sea bream with garlic butter, salmon cutlet, appetizer platters · authentic yoshoku course ¥10,800 with a six-glass wine pairing ¥6,600 (October 2026) (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Sanjo-Karasuma, wagyu hamburg and wine at the counter] A calm, grown-up yoshoku room behind an easy-to-miss door on Sanjo-dori, with a long wooden counter. The draw is a 100% Kuroge wagyu hamburg in several sauces — or with foie gras — plus uni cream croquettes and a rare-fried wagyu cutlet, matched with wine. Order à la carte (¥300 seat charge) or the ¥10,800 course. Dinner only; closed Sunday.

roles: Chef not named; operator 株式会社LINO DREAM WORKS (invoice holder), which also runs Lino
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: a cosy 15-seat restaurant at Karasuma-Oike serving Western dishes centred on 100% Kuroge wagyu hamburg and seasonal ingredients, as courses or à la carte, with wines to match. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社LINO DREAM WORKS, a Kyoto Italian-restaurant company that also operates Lino (a separate record).
chef_bio.specialty: 100% Kuroge wagyu hamburg steak.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 dinner guest was met outside by staff confirming the booking and shown in.
An October 2026 pair booked the ¥10,800 course for the uni cream croquette and foie-gras hamburg and were given a table for four.
A January 2026 diner tried the hamburg in several sauces and liked the salt version best.

places.notes: [Sweets · Kiyomizu-Gojo, year-round kakigori in a townhouse] A kakigori specialist that moved from Kashiwa, Chiba, to a quiet Kyoto townhouse near Kiyomizu-Gojo, with a counter looking onto a little garden. About ¥1,500 a bowl; a favourite of penguin fans. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a well-known kakigori shop from Kashiwa, Chiba, that relocated to Kyoto; Tabelog gives the Kyoto opening as 27 April 2024. Reviewers note large ice-shaving machines, seasonal limited bowls and attentive staff who pour warm tea.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fruit kakigori.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor who had queued for it years ago in the Tokyo area was surprised to find the shop had moved to Kyoto.
An August 2026 guest was offered a choice of warm tea or cold water with the ice.

places.name: そ/s/KAWAHIGASHI (So Kawahigashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese small plates, clay-pot rice, tempura, fried hamo and grilled fu with butter and soy; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-rich Kyoto-style dishes and earlier wild-herb vegetable broths, but fish and meat are served too; nothing vegan is marked (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Thursday dinner 17:30–21:00, à la carte without reservations, as 膳いぬい; Friday and Saturday lunch 12:00–14:00, an 8-course menu by reservation only, as 刻toki (Tabelog; official site). Closed Sunday and Monday. Bookings via TableCheck up to two months ahead (official site). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 9 seats at a U-shaped counter (13 with event tables); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). On Marutamachi-dori east of the Kamo River, about 3 min from exit 4 of Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (official site). Opened 25 October 2019 (official site; Tabelog). Lunch udon service ended with a renovation in January 2025 (March 2025 review).
places.neighborhood: Marutamachi east of the Kamo — 3 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: A nine-seat "culinary hub" sharing one counter between two cooks (official site) · 膳いぬい (Tuesday–Thursday): gentle Japanese dinners with sake and Japanese wine — one-soup-three or five-dish sets (e.g. ¥3,900 with clay-pot rice, June 2025), clay-pot rice, sashimi, roast beef, corn tempura, fried hamo, pickles, grilled fu with butter and soy; Kyoto sake and Japanese whisky · 刻toki (Friday–Saturday): an 8-course lunch (official site; Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese · Marutamachi by the Kamo, a nine-seat shared counter] A small U-shaped counter east of the Kamo River where two cooks take turns: Tuesday to Thursday evenings bring Inui's gentle Kyoto dinners — clay-pot rice, seasonal small plates, roast beef, with Japanese sake, wine and whisky — no booking needed; Friday and Saturday lunch is a reserved eight-course menu from the Nakahigashi side. Simple, careful seasoning. Closed Sunday and Monday.

roles: Owner chef and culinary director (刻toki, Friday–Saturday)
Kazuhiro Inui (いぬい) cooks Tuesday–Thursday as 膳いぬい
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: born in Kyoto into a family of restaurateurs, trained under the chef’s father at 草喰なかひがし from the age of 12, then worked at the vegan restaurant Kajitsu in New York from 2011; founded One Rice One Soup Inc. in the US in 2016 and One Rice One Soup株式会社 in Japan in 2019 (the invoice holder); based in New York and Kyoto; opened this counter on 25 October 2019. A December 2025 reviewer calls the chef the third son of Hisashi Nakahigashi of 草喰なかひがし. Kazuhiro Inui runs the Tuesday–Thursday dinners.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a flat, welcoming place for anyone who loves to eat and drink, where people keep coming back; per a December 2025 review, "so" stands for origin and essence and for the seasoning order sa-shi-su-se-so.
chef_bio.specialty: Clay-pot rice and seasonal small plates.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner on an Inui night ordered à la carte with Ichiro’s Malt whisky, and Inui came over to chat.
A June 2025 guest went back for seconds of the clay-pot rice.
A January 2025 visitor ate a New Year special: ramen made as Kyoto white-miso zoni, with Ohara vegetables and a round mochi.

places.neighborhood: Toji west gate — 644 m from Toji Stn
places.cuisine: Handmade ohagi in two kinds only: red-bean (tsubu-an over soft glutinous rice) and kinako (rice wrapped round bean paste, coated in unsweetened soybean flour), ¥200 each (up from ¥150; 2025–2026 reviews) · best eaten the same day (January 2026)
places.notes: [Sweets · Toji west gate, ohagi to take away] A tiny shop among the houses behind Toji, where a couple make just two kinds of ohagi each morning — chunky red bean, and kinako with bean paste hidden inside — at ¥200 apiece. The day's batch sells out, so come before lunch, especially on Toji market days. Takeaway only, cash only; best eaten the same day. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Run by a couple (March 2026 review); not named
chef_bio.background: Per 2025–2026 reviews: a handmade-ohagi shop by Toji’s west gate run by a couple, open from 10:00 until the day’s ohagi are gone; only red-bean and kinako are made; the price rose to ¥200 each.

chef_bio.background: An August 2026 regular chatted with the staff, “skilled bakers making bread for the next day right in front of me”. A June 2026 visitor found the bread decent but the prices high, and was bothered by guests passing the second-floor standing area on the way to the third floor.

places.notes: [Spanish · Sanjo-Nishinotoin, paella and tapas] A bright Spanish gastrobar with a counter, a semi-private room and a terrace, where a Barcelona-trained chef turns out paella in individual pans — squid ink, lobster, kinmedai seafood — plus ajillo, croquettes, cured ham and a tableside crème brûlée, with a sommelier’s list of Spanish wines. Paella lunches from about ¥2,500; dinner course ¥4,800. Book ahead; closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text: dishes by a chef trained in Barcelona, Spain, and a sommelier-selected list of Spanish wines. The official site’s title reads 「スペイン政府公認優良スペインレストラン」. Invoice T1130001034702 is registered to 株式会社カナルトレス (NTA register). A February 2026 diner returned after several decades away.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Restaurant-quality tapas” (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Paella; tapas.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 diner was told the paella would take about 30 minutes, so ordered it first.
A May 2026 guest watched the crème brûlée, hiding fruit and ice cream, caramelised at the table.

Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 250 seats: counter, tatami and sunken seating, five private rooms, two banquet halls and a wedding venue (Tabelog). Seven parking spaces, first come, height 1.9 m (official site). English menu; children’s meals from ¥1,100, baby beds and chairs (Tabelog). Non-smoking, smoking area outside (Tabelog). West of Heian Shrine north of the Biwa canal, 10 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Founded 1899 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, west of Heian Shrine — 10 min from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto cuisine famous for the teoke bento — seasonal dishes in a wooden tub of aged Kiso cedar, made by the Living National Treasure Kiyoshi Nakagawa (Tabelog shop text; official site) · November 2026 “momiji” course ¥8,800, tax included, service extra (official site) · Shichi-Go-San children’s celebration tray ¥3,850 (official site) · teoke bento with seasonal vegetables, hamo in summer and eel rice (July 2026) · teoke bento with added sashimi and Omi beef (October 2026) · limited SixTONES course ¥6,600: teoke bento, matsutake and hamo dobin-mushi, magnolia-leaf grill (October 2026) · private-room kaiseki; osechi “Miyabi” ¥64,800 and “Heian” ¥43,200 (official site) · Soufflé & Café 茶庭 in the afternoon (Tabelog; official site)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Okazaki by Heian Shrine, since 1899] A large old Kyoto restaurant west of Heian Shrine, known for its teoke bento — a cedar tub of seasonal small dishes, the tubs made by a Living National Treasure — at lunch (about ¥4,000–6,000), with kaiseki in private rooms, a soufflé café in the afternoon, and dinner by reservation only. A favourite before or after the KYOCERA Museum or a shrine visit. 10% service charge.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop note gives the founding year as 1899 and calls the teoke tubs the work of the Living National Treasure Kiyoshi Nakagawa, of Kiso cedar aged several years. The official site trademarks 「手をけ弁当」. A limited course was offered in October 2026 in connection with the group SixTONES, and an October 2026 guest was seated in a room the group had used.
chef_bio.specialty: Teoke bento.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 driver arrived before 11:00 for the first-come parking and found staff guiding cars in.
A July 2026 couple on a tour watched the Gion Festival from an air-conditioned room on the same tour itinerary that included lunch here.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京料理 手をけ弁当 六盛 (ろくせい)、十一月限定もみじコース8,800円 (税込サ別)、七五三祝膳3,850円、おせち「雅」64,800円・「平安」43,200円、11月の休み (2日、9日、16日、30日)、24日は昼のみ、夜は予約のみ、駐車場7台 (予約不可)、個室は会席料理で案内、スフレ＆カフェコーナー茶庭。食べログ: 日本料理、左京区岡崎西天王町71、東山駅から徒歩10分、昼11:30〜14:00、夜17:00〜21:00 (夜は予約のみ)、茶庭14:00〜18:00、月曜 (祝日は営業) と不定の水曜休み、サービス料10% (個室・貸切は15%)、カード可、250席、英語メニュー、子ども料理1,100円から、1899年創業。店の紹介: 人間国宝 Kiyoshi Nakagawa による、数年寝かせた Kiso の木の手桶に季節の京料理を盛る「手をけ弁当」。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 手をけ弁当、鱧、鰻ご飯、近江牛、SixTONES の限定コース6,600円。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and an English page (Tabelog; official site); large, family-friendly restaurant; dinner by reservation only.

places.name: 京豆冨 不二乃 (Kyoto Tofu Fujino)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tofu dishes — oboro tofu, yudofu, kuzu tofu, sesame tofu, yuba sashimi — are eaten with soy-based sauces and dashi; agedashi tofu, nama-fu dengaku and a soy-milk baumkuchen contain wheat (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly tofu, yuba and vegetables, but broths and sauces are not described and dashi is likely; the sets include pickles and seasoned rice (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:15); closures follow JR Kyoto Isetan (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, but not for the same day (Tabelog); walk-ins take a numbered ticket, with waits of 15–30 minutes at lunch (July–October 2026). Cards and QR codes; no e-money (Tabelog). 52 seats at tables, window seats with a view of the city; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Fujino tofu is also sold on Isetan B2F (July 2026). JR Kyoto Isetan 11F, directly connected to Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, JR Kyoto Isetan 11F
places.cuisine: Tofu restaurant of the Kitano tofu maker 京とうふ藤野, which uses only Japanese soybeans (official site) · Fujino colourful gozen: oboro tofu with free refills, kuzu tofu, agedashi tofu, simmered aburaage with seasonal vegetables, ginger and aburaage rice, soup, pickles, soy-milk baumkuchen and black-bean coffee (September–October 2026) · three courses at lunch, including all-you-can-eat oboro tofu or yudofu; eight dishes from appetizers to dessert (July 2026) · evening “enjoyment set” with warm oboro tofu, fried tofu and dengaku, seasonal rice to finish (September 2026) · à la carte yuba sashimi, kuzu tofu, sesame tofu, nama-fu dengaku (2026) · lunch about ¥2,970 with dessert (October 2026)
places.notes: [Tofu · Kyoto Station, Isetan 11F] The restaurant of the Kitano tofu maker Fujino, on Isetan’s restaurant floor with window views over Kyoto: tofu sets built around warm oboro tofu you can refill, with kuzu tofu, agedashi, yuba and a ginger-aburaage rice, about ¥3,000 at lunch, plus yudofu courses. Take a numbered ticket at lunch; no same-day bookings. Fujino tofu to take home is sold on B2F.

roles: Operated by 京とうふ藤野株式会社 (official site)
chef_bio.background: The Tabelog listing links to the site of 京とうふ藤野株式会社, a tofu maker in Kitano, Kyoto, that makes its tofu from 100% Japanese soybeans. A Tabelog Kyoto name search shows the company’s other listings: the main shop’s tea corner and TOFU CAFE FUJINO, and a counter at JR Kyoto Isetan. A September 2026 guest returned for dinner after about 25 years.
chef_bio.philosophy: Only domestic soybeans, 100% (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Oboro tofu; yudofu.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner asked for a second helping of the warm oboro tofu.
An October 2026 visitor took a number 20 minutes before opening and still missed the window seats.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 京とうふ藤野株式会社の公式サイト: 京都・北野のお豆腐屋さん、国産大豆100%。食べログ: 京豆冨 不二乃、豆腐料理・日本料理、下京区烏丸通塩小路下る東塩小路町901 ジェイアール京都伊勢丹11F、11:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:15)、伊勢丹に準じ不定休、予約可 (当日予約は不可)、カード・QR可、52席、禁煙、車椅子可。口コミ (2026年、英語): おかわりできるおぼろ豆腐、葛豆腐、揚げ出し、ごま豆腐、湯葉の刺身、生麩田楽、しょうがと油揚げのご飯、豆乳バウム、黒豆コーヒー、昼のコース3種、昼は整理券で15〜30分待ち、窓際の席から京都の眺め、地下2階で豆腐を販売。

cultural_comfort.note: Department-store restaurant by the station; numbered tickets at lunch; no same-day bookings.

places.name: KYOTO BISTRO (Park Hyatt Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Bistro menu with pasta, a katsu sandwich and cream puffs (2025–26 reviews); no gluten information. One July 2026 diner’s advance request to change sauces was not carried through, so confirm any request on the day.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; no vegan information.
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–17:00, dinner 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:00), daily; breakfast 7:30–10:30 is for hotel guests only (Tabelog). Seating limits: 90 min at lunch, 60 min for coffee, 120 min at dinner (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service or cover charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「なし」; October 2026). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 120 seats — 70 downstairs, 50 upstairs with private rooms at ¥20,000 (before tax) for 2 hours (Tabelog). Non-smoking; English menu; children, kids menu and strollers welcome; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). On the Ninenzaka side of Park Hyatt Kyoto, 6 min from the Higashiyama Yasui bus stop; hotel valet parking ¥2,000 for up to 4 hours (Tabelog; June 2025). Opened 30 October 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ninenzaka, in Park Hyatt Kyoto — 6 min from Higashiyama Yasui bus stop
places.cuisine: All-day bistro and café of Park Hyatt Kyoto (Tabelog) · cream puffs from the showcase — matcha, pear, pumpkin, vanilla — ¥770 each; seafood linguine arrabbiata ¥3,300 (October 2025) · a katsu sandwich of Daye pork with house mustard, gazpacho (August 2025; January 2026) · a seasonal sakura lunch set (March 2026) · cheesecake with soft-serve (September 2025); olive bread (July 2026) · breakfast for hotel guests: Western or Japanese set, the Japanese one by Kyoyamato, plus a buffet, ¥7,180 (September 2025) · a guest-chef dinner with Stéphane Pantel (January–February 2026)
places.notes: [Hotel bistro and café · Ninenzaka, Park Hyatt Kyoto’s casual room] The Park Hyatt’s all-day bistro looking onto Ninenzaka, with kimono-clad strollers outside: cream puffs (¥770), a Daye-pork katsu sandwich, seafood linguine and bistro plates, with no service charge. Most guests are from overseas and many staff speak English. Seating is timed — 90 min at lunch. Reviewers find it casual for the hotel, with strong flavours. 11:30–21:00 daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: Park Hyatt Kyoto’s bistro, café and bar, opened 30 October 2019, facing Ninenzaka. A February 2026 review describes a four-day collaboration dinner in January–February 2026 with the guest chef Stéphane Pantel, whose own restaurant had closed the previous summer.
chef_bio.specialty: Cream puffs; katsu sandwich.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 visitor counted about 80% overseas guests and many staff fluent in English or several languages, though a soft-serve arrived melted after waiting by the kitchen.
A January 2026 visitor rated the katsu sandwich above Maisen’s and called the price unbelievable next to Tokyo.
A July 2026 group arranged sauce changes in advance for a guest who dislikes onions, and found the request was not carried through on the day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビストロ・カフェ・バル、東山区高台寺桝屋町360 パーク ハイアット 京都、東山安井バス停から徒歩6分、朝食7:30〜10:30 (宿泊客のみ)、ランチ11:30〜17:00、ディナー17:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:00)、無休、利用時間 (ランチ90分、カフェ60分、ディナー120分)、予約可、チャージなし、カード可、120席 (1階70、2階50と個室)、禁煙、英語メニュー、ベジタリアンメニューあり、子供可、車椅子可、2019年10月30日オープン。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年10月、英語): Ninenzaka に面する、シュークリーム770円、シーフードのリングイネ3,300円、カツサンド、朝食7,180円、外国人の客が約8割、英語の話せる店員、味が濃いめとの声。

places.name: うえと (Ueto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A bar with a few snacks — pudding, a sansho tartar egg dog, dashimaki (2023–26 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Gin and tonics with sansho and herbs, natural wine and non-alcoholic cocktails; the snacks use egg (2023–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon 14:00–18:00; Wed–Sat 14:00–23:00; Sun 14:00–22:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reviewers note it opens in the afternoon (14:00 in February 2023 and January 2026; 15:00 in April 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards and QR, no e-money (Tabelog). 12 seats: 8 at the counter, 4 at a table, semi-private space; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). 1 min from Higashiyama Stn exit 1 (Tabelog). Opened 8 April 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama Sanjo — 1 min from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: A salon and bar open from the afternoon (February 2023) · gin and tonics with sansho infused into the gin — the sansho G&T, flower-sansho and kinome G&T, a new-ginger G&T, a Kajitani Farm herb G&T (2023–26 reviews) · fennel gin with water (November 2025) · mostly natural wines; hot wine in winter (February 2023; January 2026) · non-alcoholic cocktails such as strawberry and fig (April 2025) · pudding and a whisky "adult" pudding (February 2023), a sansho tartar egg dog (January 2025), dashimaki (January 2026) · drinks in antique glasses (September 2026)
places.notes: [Bar · Higashiyama Sanjo, sansho gin and tonics from 2 pm] A calm, tea-house-like bar a minute from Higashiyama Stn that opens in the afternoon (from 14:00). Gin and tonics with fresh sansho infused into the gin, flower-sansho and kinome, natural wines, a pudding and a sansho tartar egg dog. The owner is reserved: one April 2024 regular felt talked down to, a July 2026 visitor found the owner hard to read but easy-going with tourists. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bar, café and wine bar opened 8 April 2011. A February 2023 review calls it "Ueto salon & bar", with a tea-house-like interior and a woodworkers’ workshop space on the floor above.
chef_bio.specialty: Sansho gin and tonic.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor was shown the bottle of gin with fresh sansho steeping in it, giving the G&T its spicy kick.
A January 2026 visitor, caught in snow after the Heian Shrine, found it open at 14:00 and warmed up with hot wine and dashimaki.
An April 2024 visitor who had come several times found the owner’s service discriminatory and condescending that day.

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter from an intriguing drinks menu; the owner chats lightly with tourists (July 2026). No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Omurice of chicken rice with demi-glace (April 2026); the set adds macaroni salad (April 2026). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg-wrapped omurice with chicken rice, prosciutto salads and bistro meat dishes (2025–26 reviews).

Reservations accepted and usually needed: lunch is booked in slots at 11:30, 11:45, 12:00 or 12:45–13:30, with about an hour per table when busy; call outside business hours (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). Walk-ins may be asked to come back later (July and October 2025). No service or cover charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料、チャージ料なし」). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). 23 seats: 20 at tables, 3 at the counter; non-smoking with a smoking room (Tabelog). 2nd floor of しきさい河原町ビル, south of Shijo on Kawaramachi; 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 20 September 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi south of Shijo — 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Omurice at lunch, bistro dishes and wine at night (June 2025) · "white" omurice of white-yolked eggs that runs when cut, over chicken rice with demi-glace, ¥1,760, and the classic omurice ¥1,760 (August and October 2025; April 2026) · potage and soft-drink set +¥650 (October 2025); soup and salad set with potato and macaroni salads (April 2026) · a night omurice with cheese (July 2026) · evening blackboard of small plates and mains with a wide wine list (June 2025) · salad with prosciutto and grated cheese (December 2025)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Shijo Kawaramachi, booked-out white omurice] A bright second-floor room just south of Shijo whose "white" omurice — pale eggs that run over demi-glace chicken rice, ¥1,760 — fills every lunch slot, so book (calls go through outside opening hours). At night it turns bistro, with blackboard plates and wine. The chef trained in hotels in Kobe and Kyoto. No cover charge. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), trained at top hotels in Kobe and Kyoto (October 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2025 review: the owner-chef, who runs omurice lunches and a Western-style izakaya at night, trained at top hotels in Kobe and Kyoto. A March 2026 visitor saw a male chef and a female staff member running the room together. Opened 20 September 2020 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: White omurice.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 visitor arrived without a booking, was told to come back two hours later at 13:30, and did.
An October 2026 visitor could not get through by phone until finding an Instagram post on the best times to call, then booked a week ahead.
A January 2026 visitor loved the flowing yolk but found the plain ketchup rice, without chicken, a little monotonous.

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone outside opening hours and arrive on time — lunch runs in slots (2025–26 reviews). Overseas guests also come (October 2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: 千本玉壽軒 (Senbon Tamajuken)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wagashi — namagashi, wasanbon dry sweets, warabi mochi, fu senbei (wheat-gluten crackers) and chimaki (2024–26 reviews); no ingredient list found.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Bean-paste and sugar sweets made from natural ingredients (official site), but no ingredient list; one spring sweet uses yam (March 2026).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 8:30–17:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Take-away shop; the tea room 茶寮SENTAMA, one door along, serves freshly made sweets to eat in (official site; September 2025, March 2026). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). Seasonal namagashi are handmade in limited numbers and can sell out (official site). Orders by phone (Tabelog). On Senbon north of Imadegawa, 1 min from the Senbon Imadegawa bus stop (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Senbon Imadegawa, Nishijin — 1 min from Senbon Imadegawa bus stop
places.cuisine: Over 100 seasonal namagashi a year, made by hand for festivals, events and flower seasons (official site) · namagashi such as Chaku-matsu ¥540 and Akikaze ¥508 (September 2026), Harugasumi with kinako and yam (March 2026), Hojō for autumn (September 2025) · Nishijin Fumi, a confection modelled on Nishijin weaving — 5 pieces ¥1,404 (official site; September 2026) · Tsuki no Utage, wasanbon with bean paste, 6 for ¥972 (September 2024) · a gold-leafed wasanbon sweet sold at Kinkaku-ji (March 2026) · fu senbei, plain and brown sugar (April 2026) · at 茶寮SENTAMA: a Hina set ¥1,100 and matcha ¥700 (March 2026); kakigori in summer, kuzuyu and zenzai in winter (official site)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Senbon Imadegawa, a Nishijin confectioner since 1938] A wagashi house on the weaving streets of Nishijin, founded in 1938 and now run by the third generation, making over a hundred seasonal namagashi a year with the sweetness turned down for today’s tastes. Take home Nishijin Fumi or the day’s namagashi, or sit at the tea room 茶寮SENTAMA next door for a fresh sweet with matcha (¥700). Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the 玉壽軒 name began in the late-Edo Kansei era with 井筒屋, a tapestry weaver just below the present site that sold penny sweets on the side; in the mid-Taisho era road widening moved the old shop to Imadegawa Omiya. The previous owner, who trained at 本家玉壽軒, set up independently in 1938 (昭和13年) on the original site as 千本玉壽軒; the third generation now runs it, keeping traditional methods and natural ingredients while lowering the sweetness. The tea room 茶寮SENTAMA opened next door in October 2020.
chef_bio.philosophy: Traditional methods with natural ingredients, adjusted to modern tastes (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal namagashi; Nishijin Fumi.

anecdotes.text: A July 2024 regular praised the summer sweets inspired by the halberd (hoko).
A September 2024 buyer found the Tsuki no Utage wasanbon so hard it would not break in half, and let it dissolve instead.
A March 2026 visitor at 茶寮SENTAMA watched the sweets being made at the counter and found the renovated room spotless.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 千本今出川上ル 西陣の和菓子店、年間100種以上の季節の上生菓子 (手作りで数に限り)、玉壽軒の起こりは江戸後期の寛政年間の綴織の井筒屋の一文菓子、大正中頃に本家は今出川大宮へ、本家玉壽軒で修行した先代が昭和13年に独立し発祥の地で千本玉壽軒を創業、現在は三代目、自然素材と昔ながらの製法で甘さを控えめに、2020年10月に一軒挟んだ隣に茶寮SENTAMA、銘菓「西陣風味」。食べログ: 和菓子、上京区千本通今出川上ル上善寺町96、千本今出川バス停から徒歩1分、8:30〜17:00、水曜休み、テイクアウト、カード不可・QR 可。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年9月、英語): 上生菓子540円・508円、西陣風味5個1,404円、Tsuki no Utage 6個972円、Kinkaku-ji の和三盆、麩せんべい、茶寮のひな祭りセット1,100円と抹茶700円。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose from the case to take away, or sit in the tea room next door; cash or QR, no cards. No English evidence found.

places.notes: [Kissa · Karasuma Oike, a postwar family coffee shop] A red-awninged Showa coffee shop by the Manga Museum, run by a kind couple: ¥400 coffee and mixed sandwiches on multigrain bread, a ¥850 morning set. The sign famously lacks its "T." Smoking is allowed at every seat, and it is cash only. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Keizo (second-generation owner, per an October 2025 review)
roles: Run by a husband and wife (January 2025; October 2025; August 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2025 diner: founded in 1945 by Setsuko Taniguchi, who fled the air raids with her mother, moved from Kobe to Kyoto and opened the shop just after the war, first selling sweet red-bean soup made from black-market beans; she ran it for 58 years, and in 2011 her eldest son Keizo became the second-generation owner. The same diner relays the story that the wooden "Pocket" sign lacks its "T," to be added when the shop makes its mother proud. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a kind couple, red chairs and wooden tables, a television, and an elderly owner (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Mixed sandwich on multigrain bread.

anecdotes.text: "This charming, traditional coffee shop is run by a husband and wife team." — January 2025.
October 2025: the missing "T" in the wooden sign "symbolizes that when the café becomes a place that makes its mother proud, the 'T' will finally be added."
"The smell of tobacco hits my nostrils. Non-smokers might find it uncomfortable." — June 2024.

Courses around ¥10,000 or à la carte (April 2024). Tabelog lists no service charge. Opened 1 September 2020 (Tabelog; an April 2024 diner says August 2020).

places.cuisine: Charcoal yakiniku of long-fattened A5 heifers in a machiya: pure Tajima-Omi beef from Okazaki Farm and Kobe beef from Nishizawa, cows aged 38–50 months (Tabelog blurb) · seen: sea urchin and tongue yukhoe ¥2,900, premium salted tongue ¥2,200, special hanging tender ¥2,400, top sirloin 100 g ¥3,500 as steak, yaki-suki of special loin with egg and miso soy ¥2,200, liver ¥1,000, tripe with wasabi salt ¥1,100, kimchi trio ¥900 (April 2024) · a five-cut platter comparing Kobe, Omi and Matsusaka beef; outside-skirt yukhoe; beef sushi; choregi salad; seafood chige; Milky Queen rice (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishinotoin near Shijo-Karasuma, Omi beef over binchotan] A fourteen-seat machiya yakiniku grilling A5 Omi heifer — plus Kobe and Matsusaka for comparison — over binchotan at the table: sea-urchin tongue yukhoe, thick tongue, yaki-suki dipped in egg. Courses about ¥10,000. Diners call it good value for the beef; one found portions small, the room cramped and the service unsmiling (April 2024). Open nightly until 23:30.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 September 2020 (Tabelog). The shop’s Tabelog blurb calls it not a high-end place but a small one that never compromises on meat: A5 heifers fattened 38 to 50 months, from producers such as Okazaki Farm (pure Tajima-Omi beef) and Nishizawa (Kobe beef), grilled over binchotan in a quiet machiya. Reviewers note whole-cattle buying that brings rare cuts at fair prices, a Nishijin-woven exterior, and anniversary plates.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tabelog blurb: a small yakiniku that pursues the essence of long-term fattening.
chef_bio.specialty: Sea urchin and tongue yukhoe; Omi beef comparison platter.

anecdotes.text: April 2024: the meat was delicious but portions "might be a bit lacking," the room "quite cramped," and the female staff picked up plates "without a smile" — and the anniversary message was origami with marker pen.
An April 2025 diner compared Kobe, Omi and Matsusaka side by side: "The Matsusaka Beef was particularly delicious!"

Mostly one cook, so dishes can take 10–40 minutes; one diner felt regulars got more attention. Book early. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Not named; "mostly prepared by a single chef" (January 2026)
chef_bio.background: A May 2026 regular calls it an independent offshoot of the popular izakaya To in Karasuma Oike, and a July 2025 diner says it was renamed from syn in May 2025. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a stylish counter around an open kitchen in a building that does not look like a restaurant from outside, natural wines, warm staff, and slow but improving service.
chef_bio.specialty: Pasta; seasonal small plates.

anecdotes.text: July 2025: "The first dish was served in about 10 minutes, but the second one took over 40 minutes," and glasses were only refilled on request — "Tourists should be prepared for this experience."
A three-time regular, May 2026: "Every visit updates my definition of 'delicious.'"
June 2026: the fried Kamo eggplant with aged-potato sauce was "a bit on the salty side."

places.notes: [Bistro · Shichijo near Umekoji Park, from the Kawauzo Shokudo pop-up] A small à la carte bistro opened in 2025 by the people behind the shared-kitchen pop-up Kawauzo Shokudo: pasta lunch courses around ¥3,000, a biryani plate, game and natural wine at night, a firm pudding — and irregular ramen days that draw a crowd. One drink per person. Book by Instagram; days off posted there.

chef_bio.background: Opened 29 January 2025 (Tabelog). A February 2026 diner explains the name: the shared-space restaurant Kawauzo Shokudo became K七, from the initial of the old shop and its new street, Shichijo. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a stylish, calm room near Umekoji Park, à la carte so you order only what you like, house coffee "k.nana.coffee", and special days with a daily menu or limited ramen.
chef_bio.specialty: Pasta lunch; irregular ramen days; pudding.

anecdotes.text: "The shared space restaurant, Kawauzo Shokudo, has transformed into K七 (Kenana), combining the initials of the previous establishment with the newly chosen location on Shichijo Street." — February 2026.
A January 2026 lunch had a few groups waiting at noon — "this place is really popular!"

places.notes: [Café · Shogoin near Heian Shrine, breakfast to 6 p.m.] A sunny, spacious café with big windows a short walk from Heian Shrine, roasting its own coffee: the hearty dews Plate of omelette and colourful vegetables, a fully plant-based Buddha Plate, quiche, and a well-spiced carrot cake, with oat-milk lattes and chai. Good for a quiet solo hour; English menu, parking. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 1 September 2023, with a focus on vegetables, a health-conscious menu, breakfast and vegetarian options. An August 2026 regular writes that the café moved here from Kiyamachi, and is known for house-roasted coffee and its breakfast.
chef_bio.philosophy: Vegetables and wellness (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: dews Plate; carrot cake.

anecdotes.text: In April 2026 even the water came with cherry blossoms floating in it.
A January 2026 visitor phoned ahead to take away the carrot cake, and found its spice still tingling long after eating.
A March 2026 guest spent a slow breakfast studying and knitting over the vegetable plate.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、左京区聖護院円頓美町47-5 京都グランドハイツ 1F、神宮丸太町駅から753m、木〜火・祝 8:00〜18:00、水曜定休、予約不可、20席、ソファ席、禁煙、車椅子可、Wi-Fi・電源、英語メニュー、子ども・ベビーカー可、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、駐車場3台、2023年9月1日オープン、野菜にこだわる、ヘルシーメニュー、朝食、ベジタリアン対応。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): LA VOITURE の隣、大きな窓、dews プレート2,500円 (ふわふわのオムレツ、野菜、ハム、生姜とヨーグルトの冷製スープ、果物)、植物性の食材だけのブッダプレート (ヴィーガン)、キッシュのプレート、キャロットケーキ700円、苺のショートケーキ、チーズケーキ、アイシングクッキー、自家焙煎のコーヒー、キャラメルラテ・抹茶ラテ800円 (牛乳かオーツミルク)、チャイ850円、ハーブティー、和紅茶、木屋町から移転。

places.name: とりこ (Toriko)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Mostly salt-grilled skewers with yuzu pepper or homemade sansho miso, but tsukune with tare, chicken sashimi with a sweet soy sauce, pâté on toast and a ramen to finish (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori counter; grilled shiitake and salads are the only plant dishes reviewers mention (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00; closed on irregular days; other times possible by advance arrangement (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — often full (Tabelog; March and December 2024); some days bookings are limited when the chicken is not up to standard (January 2026). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). 11 seats along one long, narrow counter; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2023–2024 reviews). Chicken sashimi is served raw (2024 reviews). In a narrow building on Marutamachi-dori just east of Teramachi, by Kawaramachi Marutamachi; easy to miss the first time (Tabelog; September 2024).
places.neighborhood: Marutamachi-dori by Kawaramachi — 6 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal yakitori of Kousaka chicken, raised to be eaten raw, at a long counter (January 2026) · assorted chicken sashimi of five cuts with a sweet soy sauce, explained part by part (2024 reviews) · large skewers: neck, rump, gizzard with garlic, wings, heart, white liver, skin with onion, negima, skirt, two kinds of tsukune (chicken and duck), grilled chicken with Oita yuzu pepper (2024–2026 reviews) · white-liver pâté with small toasts; grilled Ehime shiitake; ginkgo; salads (2024–2026 reviews) · to finish: Toriko soba or a rich chicken-broth ramen, rice with raw egg; cake by the owner's wife (2019–2026 reviews) · bottled beer, sake, wine, Yakushima imo shochu · about ¥6,000–10,000 (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Marutamachi by Kawaramachi] A long, narrow eleven-seat counter grilling hefty, delicately seasoned skewers of Kousaka chicken over charcoal: chicken sashimi of five cuts, neck, rump, white liver, two tsukune and a must-order white-liver pâté on toast, finishing with a rich chicken-broth ramen. The owner runs it with warmth, with sansho from the wife's family and cakes baked by the wife for dessert. Book ahead; QR but no cards. Evenings.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who runs the counter alone (July 2026); the wife's family supplies sansho, and the wife bakes the desserts (2019, 2023)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakitori and kushiyaki counter of 11 seats on Marutamachi. Reviewers describe an owner of warm, sincere character (2024–2025), a one-person operation (July 2026), sansho from the wife's family (December 2019) and cakes baked by the wife (June 2023), sterile Kousaka chicken and shiitake from Ehime, where the owner has a connection (January 2026), and a regular of over seven years (March 2023).
chef_bio.philosophy: Bookings limited on days when the chicken does not meet the owner's standard (January 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken sashimi; white-liver pâté.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 group arrived at 17:00 and, apologising, stayed about three and a half hours.
A March 2023 regular has been coming for over seven years and never tires of it.
A December 2024 visitor arrived to find it fully booked — and came back.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼き鳥・串焼き、上京区丸太町通寺町東入ル信富町325-2 丸太町吉成ビル 1F、神宮丸太町駅から363m、毎日 17:00〜23:00、不定休、事前連絡で昼夜いつでも予約に応じる、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、11席 (カウンターのみ)、貸切20名まで、禁煙。口コミ (2019年12月〜2026年7月、英語): 河原町丸太町の北側、細長い建物、長いカウンター、炭火焼き、無菌の Kousaka 鶏、鶏刺し5種の盛り合わせ (甘い醤油)、大ぶりの串 (せせり、ぼんじり、砂肝のにんにく、手羽、ハツ、白レバー、皮と玉ねぎ、ねぎま、ハラミ、鶏と鴨のつくね)、大分の柚子胡椒、自家製の山椒味噌、白レバーのパテとトースト、愛媛の椎茸、銀杏、サラダ、とりこそば、鶏白湯のラーメン、卵かけご飯、奥さんの実家の山椒、奥さんのケーキ、店主一人で営む、仕入れに納得できない日は予約を絞る、Yakushima の芋焼酎、7年以上通う常連。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter only; book ahead; skewers are large, so share; QR but no cards.

places.name: 萬寿寺はくらん (Manjuji Hakuran)
places.gf_detail: Ask. An omakase with hand rolls, soups, fried dishes, Goto udon and Nagasaki sara udon, and a shrimp-toast hatoshi; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led omakase — abalone, sea urchin, conger eel, sea bream — with beef and pork courses (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–21:00; irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). Omakase ¥22,000 (May 2025); about ¥30,000–35,000 with drinks (July–August 2026). Cards incl. UnionPay; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: an 8-seat counter and a private room (Tabelog). In a renovated machiya on Manjuji-dori west of Karasuma; 3 min walk from Gojo Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 7 December 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Manjuji-dori west of Karasuma — 3 min walk from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Monthly omakase of seasonal Kyoto cooking built on Goto Islands fish, in the generous Noguchi style (2025 reviews) · omakase ¥22,000 (May 2025), e.g. abalone with hokkigai and mirugai, a namero hand roll with shiso and myoga, aburame soup with kinome, seared Tango nodoguro (May 2025) · later: grilled sesame-mackerel sushi roll, guji soup, Lake Biwa trout sashimi, fried matsutake, beef with Manganji pepper; cold chawanmushi with hairy crab, chutoro hand roll, kinmedai and onion soup, Amakusa isaki seared on the skin (September 2025–August 2026) · a Nagasaki hatoshi shrimp toast, Goto udon in Ise-lobster broth, and a run of small rice dishes — shirasu and takana, kakuni don, sara udon, tomato curry (2025–2026 reviews) · sake and wine pairings; about ¥20,000–35,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese omakase · Gojo Karasuma machiya, Goto Islands] A renovated machiya near Gojo Station where chef Yoshida, from Nagasaki's Goto Islands and once head chef in the Kyotenjin Noguchi group, cooks a generous monthly omakase: abalone, a three-way sea-urchin tasting, hand rolls, seared nodoguro or isaki, then Nagasaki touches — shrimp-toast hatoshi, Goto udon, sara udon — and a parade of small rice bowls. Reservation only; evenings.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 7 December 2024, a reservation-only Japanese restaurant using seasonal ingredients. Reviewers write that chef Yoshida, from the Goto Islands, trained at places such as Ginza Koju in Tokyo, became head chef at Noguchi Tsugu in the Kyotenjin Noguchi group, and opened a restaurant named by taking one character from the name of each parent (September and December 2025); a December 2025 reviewer congratulates the restaurant on a Michelin star.
chef_bio.philosophy: Goto Islands ingredients seasoned in a refined Kyoto style, with Noguchi-style generous portions (December 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase; Goto udon.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 reviewer explains the name: one character taken from each of the chef's parents' names, as a mark of respect.
A May 2026 visitor found the restaurant through a Bilibili video by "Japanese Gourmet Report" and tried sashimi with salt for the first time.
A July 2026 guest was too full to reach dessert after the run of rice dishes, and paid ¥34,000 with wine and beer.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: herring, dashi, chicken and egg (2026 reviews).
