places.notes: [Nishin soba · beside Minamiza, Gion-Shijo] The house that invented nishin soba in 1882: a bowl of soba hiding a whole sweet-simmered herring, about ¥1,900, eaten upstairs with a view over Shijo-dori. Theatre-goers pre-order for the Minamiza interval. Expect a queue at lunch; closed Wednesday.

roles: 株式会社 松葉 (representative director 松野 和代, official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official history: founded in 1861 when 初代 松野与衛門 opened a soba shop at 18; in 1882 the second generation, 松野与三吉, created nishin soba, moved to a corner of Minamiza and named the shop 松葉. 松野与三吉 died in 1940. In 1945 the wooden Meiji building was torn down in a forced wartime clearance to protect Minamiza from air raids; in 1946 松野貞雄 returned from the war and became owner, and in 1951 the first post-war building, four storeys, rose on the same plot. The present building dates from 1973–74; 北店 opened opposite in 1976; 松野貞雄 (third 松野与衛門) died in 1981; the Kyoto Station shop opened in 2003; 松野和代 became representative director in 2024.
chef_bio.specialty: Nishin soba.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 kabuki-goer who disliked sweet herring tried it, was moved to a window seat over Shijo-dori, and found it milder than feared.
Theatre-goers can book and pre-order to be served within minutes in Minamiza's longest interval, an October 2026 diner says, and recommends zaru soba over the broth dishes.
By 11:30 on a November 2026 morning the queue stretched from the 1st floor to the 3rd.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 総本家にしんそば・松葉、本店は東山区四条大橋東入ル川端町192、10:30〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、水曜休み (祝日は営業)、南座横、祇園四条駅6番出口すぐ。店舗は本店、北店 (休業中)、京都駅店 (新幹線コンコース)、嵐山の本社売店。株式会社松葉、代表取締役 松野和代、創業1861年 (文久元年)。沿革: 初代松野与衛門が18才でそば屋を開業、1882年二代目松野与三吉がにしんそばを発案し南座の一角に移って屋号を松葉に、1940年松野与三吉没、1945年南座を空襲から守るための強制疎開で店舗を取り壊し、1946年松野貞雄が復員して店主に、1951年同じ場所に戦後初の鉄筋ビル、1973〜74年に現在のビル、1976年北店開店、1981年三代目松野与衛門 (松野貞雄) 没、2003年京都駅店、2024年松野和代が代表取締役に。食べログ: 総本家にしんそば 松葉 本店、そば・食堂、10:30〜20:30、水曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー可。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): にしんそば1,870円、冷やしにしんそば2,090円、親子丼1,760円、鱧天せいろ、にしんのそぼろ、限定の酒「松葉」、窓から四条通、南座の幕間に事前注文、行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Busy, long-established soba house; lift to upper floors.

places.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–20:30 (last order 20:00); closed Monday, or Tuesday when Monday is a holiday; festival days can change this (Tabelog; official site). Bookings online — a group must all order the same course; walk-ins take a number by QR code or touch panel and wait, often 40–50 minutes at lunch (official site; 2026 reviews). Charges: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「お一人様550円（テラス席）、一部屋10,000円（個室）頂戴いたします。※本店2F「京都はなれ」室料はかかりません」 — ¥550 per person on the riverside terrace, ¥10,000 per private room (none for the 2F "Kyoto Hanare"). Preschool children only in a private room (Tabelog). Cards, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 28 seats; shoes off; free Wi-Fi; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026 review). In a machiya of over 100 years on the Shirakawa; 1 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: On the Shirakawa near Sanjo — 1 min from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: House stone-milled juwari (100% buckwheat) soba and duck hot pot, tempura fried in rice oil, natural wines and sake chosen by a sommelier (Tabelog): summer sudachi soba — sudachi tororo ¥1,750, nishin soba ¥1,530, kakiage ¥1,100 (October 2026); hamo sudachi soba and hamo tempura, corn tempura, duck-broth seiro soba, yuba soba, domestic duck-breast roast; soba gozen ¥4,500, +¥550 to switch to sudachi soba (September 2026) (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Juwari soba & duck · on the Shirakawa near Higashiyama Stn] A century-old machiya by the Shirakawa where you eat stone-milled 100% buckwheat soba on a riverside terrace — famous for summer sudachi soba floating with citrus — or duck hot pot indoors. About ¥2,000–5,000; ¥550 extra on the terrace. Take a queue number by QR; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog's shop text says the house was founded in 1861 (Bunkyū 1) and occupies a renovated machiya of over 100 years; the listing's opening day is 15 June 2012. The official site also sells 西京漬 and tsukudani at its own shop and at Kyoto Takashimaya and JR Kyoto Isetan.
chef_bio.philosophy: Stone-milled 100% buckwheat soba and an unhurried time (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Juwari soba; sudachi soba; duck hot pot.

anecdotes.text: Arriving at 11:30 in September 2026, a pair got a 13:00 terrace slot and explored the area until the slot came up.
A September 2026 visitor found the QR e-mail confirmation slow and advised using a Recruit ID instead.
A September 2026 diner noted many insects drawn to the terrace lights in the evening, and did not care for the citrus broth.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 三味洪庵 京都本店、自家製臼挽き十割蕎麦と鴨鍋、東山区石泉院町393、11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜20:30 (L.O. 20:00)、月曜休み (祝日は火曜)、ネット予約は1グループ同一コース、西京漬や佃煮は本店・京都タカシマヤ・ジェイアール京都伊勢丹で販売。食べログ (店舗会員): 三味洪庵 京都本店、そば・鍋・日本料理、三条通北裏白川筋西入ル、東山駅から徒歩1分、テラス席は一人550円、個室は一部屋10,000円 (2F「京都はなれ」は室料なし)、28席、未就学児は個室のみ、カード・PayPay・Alipay・WeChat Pay 可、2012年6月15日オープン、文久年間創業とする記載、築100年超の町家、白川の流れ、米油の天ぷら、ソムリエのワインと日本酒。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): すだちそば、すだちとろろ1,750円、にしん1,530円、かき揚げ1,100円、鱧のすだちそばと鱧天、とうもろこしの天ぷら、鴨汁せいろ、湯葉そば、鴨ロース、そば御膳4,500円、QR の順番待ち、靴を脱ぐ、夜のテラスは虫が多いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Online booking page in English (official site); QR queue system.

places.name: 茶亭 カエルノウタ (Chatei Kaerunouta)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee with pudding (including a cascara pudding), cheesecake, cinnamon-sugar toast and sweet-potato karinto; ingredients are not described (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee is plant-based; the sweets (pudding, cheesecake) use eggs and dairy (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Friday 11:00–22:30; Wednesday 9:00–19:00; Thursday, Saturday and Sunday 10:00–22:30 (Tabelog; hours may change). One drink per person (July 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 12 seats: counters and one table for four (Tabelog). Non-smoking; English menu; take-out; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). On the Gion Festival procession route, with standing coffee on festival day (July 2026). Near Okane Shrine, about 10 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 3 July 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: West of Karasuma near Oike and Okane Shrine — 10 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Coffee specialist with a health bent: blends gentle on the stomach, organic and decaf options (September 2026) · health blend ¥850 (April 2026); flannel-drip iced coffee steeped half a day ¥850 (February 2026) · several blends and many single origins, including rare Okinawan coffee at ¥5,300 a cup and Colombia Emerald Mountain ¥1,650 (February and August 2026) · cascara pudding, rich in polyphenols, ¥500 (2026) · cheesecake, cinnamon-sugar toast (March 2025) · sweet-potato karinto with coffee (July 2025)
places.notes: [Coffee · near Oike and Okane Shrine, health-minded kissa] A small, calm, plant-filled coffee room with a counter and one table, run by an owner particular about every detail: health blends, decaf and organic options, and a long list of single origins up to a ¥5,300 Okinawan cup, with a cascara pudding (¥500) on the side. One drink each; open late most nights.

chef_bio.background: An April 2025 reviewer writes that “the owner is very particular about the details”, and an August 2025 visitor received advice on which coffee to choose. A February 2026 reviewer noted little inbound-tourist influence here.
chef_bio.philosophy: Coffee that is kind to the body (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Health blend; cascara pudding.

anecdotes.text: On Gion Festival day in July 2026 the shop served standing coffee to people watching the procession from the cool room.
An August 2025 visitor found the advised coffee fruity enough to compare with a fine whisky.

places.name: からこ (Karako)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen, kara-age, tendon, curry and curry bread (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken-based ramen broth, chashu and kara-age; the free side dishes include vegetables but are not described (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:00 daily (Tabelog; hours may change). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 15 counter seats and a tatami room upstairs (Tabelog). Smoking allowed — ashtrays on the counter (Tabelog). Free “kuinige” side dishes at the counter: salad, pickles, cold tofu, garlic chives (2026 reviews). Coin parking next door, with ¥100 back (Tabelog). By the Higashiyama-Nijo bus stop, a short walk to ROHM Theatre Kyoto and Heian Shrine, 10 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama-Nijo, near ROHM Theatre — 10 min from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: A long-established Kyoto ramen counter (June 2026) · rich chicken-collagen ramen, lightly salted (January 2026); rich ramen ¥750 (September 2026); rich Chinese soba with chashu (June 2026) · kara-age set meal ¥990 with rice, two pieces of chicken-breast kara-age and ramen — the “most popular dish” (March and May 2026) · service sets with tendon, horumon rice bowl or curry rice (February and August 2026) · curry bread (August 2026) · free all-you-can-eat “kuinige” side dishes (2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Higashiyama-Nijo, old-school counter] A cheap, old-fashioned ramen counter by the Higashiyama-Nijo bus stop, handy after ROHM Theatre or Heian Shrine: a rich chicken ramen from ¥750, a kara-age set (¥990) and other combos, with free salad, pickles and cold tofu on the counter. Cash only; smoking allowed at the counter; one reviewer found it less than clean.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. A February 2026 diner was encouraged by the chef to try the small side dishes on the counter; a June 2026 reviewer found the food cheap and decent but the cleanliness “quite concerning”.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken ramen; kara-age set.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor deliberated about twenty seconds before switching from plain ramen to the kara-age set labelled “most popular”.
A September 2026 concert-goer stopped for the chef’s recommended rich ramen after a visit to ROHM Theatre.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 店のサイト: 東山二条のラーメン屋 からこ。食べログ: からこ、ラーメン・居酒屋、左京区岡崎徳成町12-3、東山駅から503m、毎日11:00〜14:00、17:00〜22:00、予約不可、現金のみ、カウンター15席と2階に座敷、喫煙可 (カウンターに灰皿)、隣のコインパーキングで100円キャッシュバック。口コミ (2026年、英語): 老舗のラーメン屋、鶏のコラーゲンのラーメン、こってりラーメン750円、唐揚げ定食990円、天丼やホルモン丼、カレーのセット、カレーパン、無料の「Kuinige」のおばんざい、清潔さが気になるとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter ramen; cash only; smoking allowed inside.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Ju-wari (100% buckwheat) soba is on the menu next to ni-hachi soba and udon, but the dipping sauce and broths are soy-and-dashi; tempura, katsudon and fried dishes share the kitchen (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based soba and udon, nishin soba, katsudon, sashimi, oyster rice (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–20:00; Saturday 11:00–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Same menu at lunch and dinner (September 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog, original 現金払いのみ). 36 seats: 4 at the counter and 8 tables for four; tatami area (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). On Yanagibaba just north of Sanjo, between Karasuma Oike and Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stns (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yanagibaba just north of Sanjo — between Karasuma Oike and Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stns
places.cuisine: A local soba and set-meal house with a long menu and more dishes posted on the walls (2026 reviews) · handmade soba, both ni-hachi and ju-wari; chilled nishin soba; zaru soba with seasonal vegetable tempura (July–October 2026) · katsudon, tendon, limited seafood bowls, miso-nabe udon, oyster rice in winter (2026) · sashimi set meal ¥1,300 with hamo tempura at ¥540 a piece (September 2026); hamo tempura set (August 2026); hamo tempura soba (September 2026) · mushroom takikomi rice, simmered herring (October 2026) · Japanese sake (2026)
places.notes: [Soba and set meals · Yanagibaba-Sanjo, a locals’ canteen] An office-like, always-busy soba house loved by Kyoto workers and regulars: handmade ni-hachi or ju-wari soba, nishin soba, katsudon and tendon, seasonal hamo tempura and winter oyster rice, from a long menu plus wall specials, mostly ¥1,000–2,000. Cash only; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a long-loved local restaurant with many regulars and office workers at lunch, kind staff, and few foreign customers (September–October 2026). A July 2026 diner found the soba dipping sauce too thin on two visits.
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade soba; set meals.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner had heard that upgrading to ju-wari soba was worth it.
A September 2026 regular recommends the oyster rice in winter.

cultural_comfort.note: A locals’ canteen with a Japanese menu booklet and wall specials; few foreign customers (September 2026); cash only.

places.name: 本家 田毎 三条本店 (Honke Tagoto, Sanjo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Soba of domestic buckwheat flour with kombu-and-katsuobushi dashi (Tabelog shop text); the buckwheat ratio is not stated, and the menu has udon, tempura and duck soba (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every broth and dipping sauce uses katsuobushi dashi (Tabelog shop text).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:15 (L.O. 14:45), dinner 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:20); no closing days in October–November 2026 (official site). Tabelog: 11:00–21:00 daily. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). 76 seats: 42 at tables and 34 on tatami overlooking the courtyard; a 2nd-floor room for up to 25 (Tabelog shop text). First floor non-smoking; smoking allowed on the second floor (Tabelog). On Sanjo-dori just east of Teramachi, 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Founded in the first year of Meiji (1868) (official site; Tabelog shop text).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-dori east of Teramachi — 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Soba since 1868, made with the finest domestic buckwheat flour, kombu and katsuobushi (Tabelog shop text) · duck soba ¥1,720 with yuzu pepper; duck seiro ¥1,720 (May and November 2026) · limited misogi soba ¥1,600 (May 2026) · nishin soba (May 2026) · weekday lunch service menu: konoha-don with cold oroshi soba (May 2026); daily special of soba with kinugasa-don (September 2026); “ten-toro” mini tororo bowl with mentaiko (June 2026) · yuba rolls (August 2026) · local-sake snack set for ¥400 extra with duck, kamaboko and tsukudani (June 2026) · Tateyama sake (July 2026) · the official menu opens with an “ebi-taishi” dish (official site)
places.notes: [Soba · Sanjo-Teramachi, since 1868] A spacious old soba house on the Sanjo arcade with tables and tatami looking onto a courtyard garden. Duck soba (¥1,720) is the summer favourite; also nishin soba, yuba rolls, weekday lunch sets of soba with a small rice bowl, and a sake set with snacks. Easy for solo diners; busy just before noon. Sake prices have risen, one regular notes.

chef_bio.background: Founded in the first year of Meiji (1868) (official site). An October 2026 reviewer lists notable past guests including Hara Tatsuhiro, Natori Yuko and the Emoto family. An August 2026 diner remembers a branch at Monte Mer in Ashiya; the official site lists the Sanjo-Teramachi main shop and a shop in front of the prefectural office.
chef_bio.philosophy: Keeping the flavours and traditions since the founding (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Duck soba; nishin soba.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular of six visits found the sake prices sharply higher than before.
An August 2026 diner came at 8:10 pm for a fourth dinner of the day, craving the yuba rolls remembered from the Ashiya shop.

cultural_comfort.note: Official site in English and Chinese as well as Japanese; spacious and easy for solo diners; a mix of overseas and Japanese guests (May 2026).

places.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase of small dishes and nigiri seasoned with soy; no gluten information is published (reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi omakase (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Friday: lunch from 11:30 (listed 11:30–13:00) and dinner 17:30–21:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays: lunch only, from 12:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations required for every sitting; omakase only, at lunch too, with extra pieces on request (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; private hire possible; non-smoking (Tabelog). On the 1st floor of 京都1号館ビル on Takatsuji-dori west of Muromachi, 355 m from Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takatsuji-Muromachi — 355 m from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Omakase sushi: several small dishes, then nigiri, with extra pieces on request (Tabelog; reviews) · e.g. crab, shirako, karasumi wrapped in mochi and nori, monkfish liver, oysters sent direct from fishermen, hairy crab, seaweed-wrapped sardines, tuna (2023–2026 reviews) · sake chosen by the owner to match; the course is thought to be about ¥16,000–17,000, about ¥18,000 a head with two drinks (April 2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Takatsuji-Muromachi, a friendly omakase counter] A ten-seat sushi counter south of Shijo where the chef's warmth is part of the draw. The omakase opens with a run of generous small dishes — crab, shirako, karasumi wrapped in mochi — before the nigiri, with sake picked by the owner to match. Expect roughly ¥15,000–19,000 with drinks; lunch is omakase too. Reservations required; cash only. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: reservations at all times and omakase only, lunch and dinner. Reviewers from 2023 to 2026 praise the owner’s personality and sake pairings and note the many small dishes served before the nigiri.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase of small dishes and nigiri.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 guest on a second visit had karasumi wrapped in mochi and nori.
An April 2026 regular had oysters sent direct from fishermen and hairy crab.
A March 2023 visitor rang on a whim for the seaweed-wrapped sardines and got a seat the same Sunday.

places.name: Agri (アグリ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dishes are cooked to order from the day’s ingredients, so ask; the lunch soup curry and hamburg are not marked gluten-free (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Dishes are made to order from a blackboard of ingredients with many vegetables, but pork and seafood dominate (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Weekday lunch 12:00–14:30 (last order 14:00); dinner from 17:30, last entry 24:00; no lunch at weekends and holidays; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Dinner carries a ¥330 seat charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「席料￥330(ディナータイムのみ）」). Bookings via Tabelog; it fills quickly, and late bookings such as 22:00 are taken (January–July 2026). Usually run single-handed, so food can take a while (January 2026). 10 counter seats; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 395 m from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn, on the 1st floor of クレール仲井 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae Stn — 395 m
places.cuisine: A bistro without a menu: pick ingredients from the blackboard and the chef suggests the cooking, Italian in a kappo style (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · signature aged roast of free-range Tokachi (Hokkaido) Dorobuta pork (Tabelog) · e.g. jamón, Akashi clams, whelk, shirako, pork terrine, plenty of vegetables, a truffle-topped cheesecake (2026 reviews) · weekday lunch: soup curry with a hamburg grilled to order ¥1,500 before toppings and drinks (April–October 2026)
places.notes: [Italian · near Kyoto City Hall, a no-menu counter] A ten-seat counter, guarded by little pig figurines, where there is no menu: choose from the blackboard of the day's ingredients and talk it through with the chef, who came from Yone-mura, before it is cooked your way. The aged Tokachi Dorobuta pork roast is the signature. Weekday lunch is soup curry (about ¥1,500). Open late for dinner; ¥330 seat charge. Book ahead.

roles: Owner-chef not named; usually works alone (January 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: free-range Dorobuta pork from Tokachi, Hokkaido, aged and grilled with care, and simple dishes of seasonal ingredients made to order from a blackboard. A July 2026 reviewer says the chef came from Yone-mura (よねむら) and describes it as Italian in a kappo style.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: a relaxed place where you need not watch the clock.
chef_bio.specialty: Aged Dorobuta roast; dishes cooked to order.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 guest booked online for 22:00, found the counter empty and talked dishes through with the chef.
A January 2026 pair chose jamón, Akashi clams, whelk and shirako from the blackboard and let the chef suggest the cooking.
An October 2026 regular came back after the winter break for the soup curry with a fresh-grilled hamburg.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Agri (アグリ)、バル・肉料理・ビストロ、中京区尾張町208 クレール仲井1F、京都市役所前駅から395m、平日ランチ12:00〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)、ディナー17:30〜最終入店24:00、土日祝はランチなし、不定休、席料330円 (ディナーのみ)、カウンター10席、カード可、インボイス登録あり。公式紹介: 豚の置物、十勝の放牧豚「どろぶた」の熟成ロースト、季節の食材のシンプルな料理、店内の黒板の食材から好みの料理に。口コミ (2026年、英語): メニューのないビストロ、割烹スタイルのイタリアン、よねむら出身のシェフ、ワンオペ、平日昼はスープカレー1,500円、トリュフのチーズケーキ。

cultural_comfort.note: No printed menu — ordering is a conversation with the chef.

places.name: にこみ 鈴や (Nikomi Suzuya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Oden in dashi, beef-tendon nikomi, spring rolls and curry; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi and beef-tendon stews (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 13:00–21:00, Wednesday–Sunday; closed Monday and Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings advised for evenings (July 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). A U-shaped counter round the kitchen; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog; June 2026). On Marutamachi-dori east of Sakaimachi, near the Imperial Palace, 369 m from Marutamachi Stn, in a townhouse-style building (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Moved from Oike-dori; open here since 12 August 2025 (Tabelog; June 2026).
places.neighborhood: Marutamachi-Sakaimachi, by the Imperial Palace — 369 m from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Day-drinking izakaya of oden in Kyoto-style dashi and nikomi stews (2026 reviews) · Omi beef-tendon nikomi ¥700, ago (jaw) meat with ponzu ¥700, namako ¥400 (June 2026) · oden with beef tendon; creamy shira-ae with crisp arare; salt-grilled skirt steak; katsuo salt tataki; hoya shiokara; shrimp and sansho spring rolls; chirimen-sansho fried rice; mapo-egg rice; curry to finish (2026 reviews) · sake suggested to match; reasonable drinks — about ¥5,000 with four drinks (July 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Marutamachi by the Imperial Palace, oden from 1 p.m.] A calm U-shaped counter near the Imperial Palace that opens at 1 p.m. for unhurried day drinking. Kyoto-dashi oden and Omi beef-tendon nikomi are the backbone, but don't miss the shrimp-and-sansho spring rolls, creamy shira-ae, katsuo tataki and a mapo-egg rice to finish. Good value — about ¥5,000 with drinks. Closes at 9 p.m.; closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: an oden and nikomi izakaya that moved from Oike-dori to a townhouse-style space on Marutamachi, keeping its U-shaped counter round the kitchen; the chef cooks alone, with staff serving (July and September 2026). Tabelog gives the opening at this address as 12 August 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Oden and Omi beef-tendon nikomi; shrimp-and-sansho spring rolls.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 regular from the old Oike-dori days found the U-shaped counter unchanged at the new address.
A September 2026 diner who came for oden was most surprised by the katsuo salt tataki — the spring rolls had sold out.
A July 2026 party spent about ¥5,000 each with four drinks and found it a bargain.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: にこみ 鈴や、居酒屋、中京区丸太町堺町東入鍵屋町74、丸太町駅から369m、水〜日13:00〜21:00、月火定休、カード可 (電子マネー・QR 不可)、2025年8月12日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 御池通から移転、町家の雰囲気、厨房を囲むU字カウンター、昼から飲める、京風の出汁のおでん、近江牛すじの煮込み700円、アゴ肉ポン酢700円、なまこ400円、白和え、ハラミの塩焼き、鰹の塩たたき、ほやの塩辛、海老と山椒の春巻、ちりめん山椒の炒飯、麻婆玉子ご飯、締めのカレー、4杯飲んで5,000円ほど、一人で料理。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly local regulars; book for the evening.

places.name: 香港飲茶 星街 (Hong Kong Yumcha Star Street)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dim sum wrappers, Hong Kong fried noodles and soy-based sauces; rice-flour cheung fun and turnip cake also appear; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shrimp-led dim sum and meat dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 daily except Thursday; dinner 17:30–20:30 Monday–Wednesday, 17:00–21:00 Friday–Saturday, 17:00–20:30 Sunday; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Lunch queues form soon after 11:30, especially on holidays (September and November 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 34 seats: a 9-seat counter downstairs and 25 at tables upstairs; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 347 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). Opened 27 November 2019 (Tabelog). A second shop, 河原町三条店, is a separate listing.
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Karasuma north — 347 m from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Hong Kong dim sum and Cantonese dishes (2026 reviews) · weekday lunch sets about ¥1,400–1,500: three steamed shrimp dumplings (plain shrimp, shrimp and spinach with dried scallop, shrimp and mushroom), congee, turnip cake, and Hong Kong fried noodles or char siu bao, dessert (June–August 2026) · a ¥3,300 course (September 2026) · à la carte: xiaolongbao, cheung fun, rice-flour noodles, radish cake with chilli bean sauce (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Chinese · Shijo-Karasuma, Hong Kong dim sum] A busy little Hong Kong dim sum house a few minutes north of Shijo-Karasuma, praised by a Cantonese regular for the real thing. Lunch is the bargain: about ¥1,500 for three plump shrimp dumplings, silky congee, turnip cake and Hong Kong fried noodles. The spinach-and-shrimp har gow is the standout. Queues form soon after 11:30; evenings bring à la carte and courses. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 27 November 2019. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe authentic Hong Kong dim sum, a Cantonese friend’s approval, and a lunch menu of dim sum, congee and Hong Kong fried noodles. A sister shop, 香港飲茶 星街 河原町三条店, is listed separately.
chef_bio.specialty: Shrimp har gow; congee and Hong Kong fried noodle lunch.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular on a ninth visit came with a Cantonese friend and found everything excellent.
A July 2026 diner rates the spinach-and-shrimp dumpling the most consistent of the three har gow.
A September 2026 walk-in just after 11:30 found the upstairs full and got a seat at the downstairs counter.

places.name: COMFY
places.gf_detail: Ask. Matcha and hojicha drinks, banana cake and frozen yogurt (2024–26 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Some: lattes can be made with oat milk (July 2025), and matcha soda and matcha tonic contain no dairy (2025–26 reviews). Ask about the sweetener and the cakes.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Fri–Sun 11:00–20:00; closed Tuesday–Thursday (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Mostly take-away: about 7 seats on a long bench and a small bench, no tables (Tabelog; January 2026), and you can drink inside if you ask (July 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a quiet residential street near Gojo; 491 m from Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 3 March 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gojo Muromachi, a residential lane — 491 m from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: A Japanese-tea stand: matcha whisked to order in an open kitchen, in regular, strong or double strength, sweetened or not (2025–26 reviews) · matcha latte ¥700 (January 2026); hojicha latte; oat milk on request (July 2025) · matcha tonic ¥650 (June 2025), hojicha tonic, matcha soda (July 2026), matcha banana juice (2024–25) · banana cake, frozen yogurt (2025–26 reviews) · the matcha is YUGEN’s Okumidori from Wazuka (January 2026)
places.notes: [Matcha stand · Gojo, two sisters’ tea counter in a quiet lane] A stone-and-concrete tea stand a few minutes from the busy streets, run by two sisters who whisk matcha to order — choose the strength and sweetness — for lattes (oat milk on request), matcha soda and tonic, plus banana cake. Mostly take-away, with a bench inside. Closed Tuesday to Thursday.

roles: Run by two sisters, named Sakuna and Nanami in a January 2026 review
chef_bio.background: Per a January 2026 review: the elder sister, Sakuna, worked in product development at BOOK AND BED TOKYO, and the younger, Nanami, is a pastry chef; the two opened the tea stand together on 3 March 2023. A March 2026 regular noted its third anniversary.
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha latte; matcha tonic.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 regular was served alone by "a stylish and beautiful lady", who made the matcha latte a little sweeter on request.
A July 2026 visitor walking in 39 °C heat had a matcha soda made with freshly whisked tea, and was drawn into easy conversation by the sisters.
An October 2025 visitor recommended it as a quiet place to taste matcha away from the crowded tourist tea shops.

places.gf_detail: Ask. The regular soba is 90% buckwheat and the juwari 100% (September 2026), but the dipping sauce and broths are soy-based, and tempura and chikuwa tempura are on the menu (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dipping sauce rich in bonito dashi (March 2026); herring and chikuwa on the menu.
places.hours_raw: Weekdays 11:00–14:00, closing when the soba sells out; closed Saturday, Sunday and holidays, with occasional extra closures (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); 8 counter seats fill fast, and the juwari can sell out by 12:20 (July and October 2026). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). Non-smoking; please do not bring children (Tabelog). 1 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog). Moved here from Kitayama (Tabelog, shop text).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma Oike — 1 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Thin handmade soba, 90% buckwheat, or 100% buckwheat juwari for +¥400; large +¥300 (September 2026) · juwari mori ¥1,000 (July and October 2026), eaten with salt or a bonito-rich dipping sauce, then thick soba-yu (2025–26 reviews) · ume soba with the plum on the side (January and August 2026), spicy grated-radish soba ¥1,000 (July 2026), tempura zaru soba (September 2026) · chikuwa tempura ¥800 (July 2026) · soba-tofu and herring with eggplant to go with sake, shochu or beer at lunch (July 2026) · no rice dishes (October 2026)
places.notes: [Soba · Karasuma Oike, a weekday-lunch counter] Eight counter seats a minute from Karasuma Oike Stn, open only on weekday lunchtimes until the soba runs out: thin 90% or 100% buckwheat noodles with salt or a bonito-rich sauce, then thick soba-yu, from ¥1,000. Chikuwa tempura and soba-tofu go well with a lunchtime sake. Arrive by noon — the juwari sells out. No children.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a soba and creative restaurant opened 17 June 2016, which moved from Kitayama to Karasuma Oike (shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Juwari mori soba.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner found the noodles beautifully even and the juwari a little crumbly, while the owner chatted with a regular throughout.
A July 2026 diner took one of the last three seats at 11:30; people arriving later were turned away.
An October 2026 diner saw the juwari mori sell out by 12:20 and noted there are no rice dishes.

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in early for a counter seat; order soba by type and size. Adults only. No English evidence found.

places.name: 割烹 たん義 (Kappo Tanyoshi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo cooking with soy-based sauces — the hamo-don sauce is a recipe kept for three generations (July 2022) — and tempura and kakiage on the menu (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dashi-based kappo — clear soups, simmered dishes, duck manju, hamo (official site; 2017–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–20:00; closed Friday and Sunday (Tabelog). The official site gives 12:00–21:00, closed Sunday and holidays — check by phone. Reservations by phone; lunch set menus and the summer hamo-don need a reservation (official site; 2023–24 reviews). Lunch prices include tax and service; dinner courses are plus tax and a 5% service charge (official site). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). A one-piece Kiso-cypress counter downstairs, tatami rooms upstairs (official site; July 2017). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Shinmonzen west of Hanamikoji, through the lane beside Tatsumi Daimyojin; a few minutes from Yasaka Shrine and Minamiza (official site). Take-away boxes by reservation (official site).
places.neighborhood: Gion Shinmonzen, by Tatsumi Daimyojin — 314 m from Sanjo Keihan Stn
places.cuisine: Old-style Gion kappo (official site) · summer hamo-don, June to about the end of September, ¥2,500 with pickles and clear soup — the hamo boned and grilled to order (official site; 2017–26 reviews) · lunch: たん義 bento, shokado bento, kakiage-don and other rice bowls (official site; July 2022, October 2024) · dinner kaiseki: full course ¥10,000 and mini course ¥7,500, both with sashimi, simmered dish, grilled dish, duck manju and more, ending in rolled sushi, soup, pickles and dessert (official site) · à la carte from kakiage and arataki to hamo somen, kumiage yuba, dengaku, dashimaki and duck loin (official site) · take-away: shokado ¥4,000, たん義 bento ¥3,000, hamo-don ¥2,500 (official site)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion Shinmonzen, three generations in a Kyoto-cypress counter] A family kappo in the Gion alleys since 1964, its founder trained in the たん熊 line, now run by the founder’s daughter as okami and the okami’s son as third-generation chef. Come in summer for the hamo-don (¥2,500), the hamo boned in front of you at the one-piece cypress counter; dinner kaiseki from ¥7,500. Reach it through the lane beside Tatsumi Daimyojin. Book ahead.

roles: Okami: 三津川 都, second generation (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (あゆみ, written by the okami 三津川 都): the founder 三津川 義夫, born in Otsu in 1926, apprenticed at the Kyoto restaurant 三田尻 in 1940, served in a navy air unit in the war, and trained again afterwards. In 1951 the founder’s elder brother, also a cook, was granted a noren by たん熊 and opened たん新 in Gion Shinbashi; in April 1964 the founder went independent and opened たん義. After the founder died in November 1998, aged 73, the founder’s only daughter, the okami 三津川 都 (born 1953), carried on the shop and its flavours; the okami’s son 三津川 義弘 took over as third generation in 2015. The one-piece counter was cut from a single Kiso cypress made to order at the opening.
chef_bio.philosophy: Passing on the good traditions of Kyoto kappo and the founder’s flavours (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Summer hamo-don; duck manju.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 diner at the counter watched the hamo being boned right in front of the seat.
A September 2025 diner, the only guest in the midday heat, chatted with the owner and the young chef, and was shown a little lane to Tatsumi Bridge on the way out.
An April 2025 diner has been coming for more than 30 years and calls it the one place Kyoto feels incomplete without.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 割烹 たん義、創業60年、初代 三津川義夫 (大正15年大津生まれ、昭和15年に京都料理店「三田尻」へ奉公)、昭和26年に実兄がたん熊からのれん分けで「たん新」を祇園新橋に開店、昭和39年4月に「たん新」から独立し「たん義」を開店、平成10年11月に初代が73才で亡くなり一人娘の女将 三津川都が継ぎ、平成27年に息子の義弘が三代目、木曽檜一枚板のカウンター、新門前通花見小路西入ル (辰巳大明神横の間道)、12:00〜21:00、日曜・祝日休み、昼の献立 (税・サービス料込み、要予約)、夏季限定の鱧丼2,500円、夜の会席 フルコース10,000円・ミニコース7,500円 (税・サービス料5%別)、一品料理、持ち帰りの松花堂4,000円・たん義弁当3,000円。食べログ: 日本料理、東山区西之町210-2、12:00〜14:00・17:00〜20:00、金日休み、予約可、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、禁煙。口コミ (2017年7月〜2026年6月、英語): 鱧丼、目の前の骨切り、かき揚げ丼、おまかせの会席、親切な店主と若い料理人。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone, and reserve the hamo-don ahead; counter or tatami. Friendly owner and staff (2025 reviews). No English evidence found.

An October 2026 party insisted on the mini curry gratin; guests aged 80 and 90 managed the tender steak easily.
For a mother's 60th birthday in March 2024, the staff prepared a dessert plate.

places.notes: [Fish lunch & dinner · Karasuma Oike] A small, quiet counter run by a couple, known for its ¥1,200 Asakinu lunch tray of fresh sashimi, tempura and obanzai — come at 11:30, it sells out. Dinner of seasonal fish and sake by reservation. Cash only.

places.notes: [Kyoto vegetables & yuba · Kyoto Station] A machiya-style izakaya inside the station building, handy between trains: basket salads and obanzai of Kyoto vegetables, yuba, fresh fu and seasonal kamameshi, with Kyoto sake. places.notes: [Solo café · Takeyamachi Aburanokoji, east of Nijo Castle] A signless café where you slip off your shoes and sit alone at a table facing the wall: it seats only solo diners. Order a meal — dried-cod gratin, omurice, cornbread with chili — or a dessert such as a strawberry or fig Eton mess under unsweetened cream, with chai or royal milk tea; no drinks-only. Often full right at 14:00 opening. Cash only. Tuesday–Friday afternoons.

roles: Café staff (unnamed); a baker of the skirt-shaped sweets sometimes present (January 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a cafeteria and Japanese-food listing for a house café, reopened 1 June 2011, with a website at culotteskirt.com. Reviewers in 2026 describe a café exclusively for solo visitors with no sign, shoes off at the door, tables facing the wall, and opening news shared on Instagram.
chef_bio.philosophy: A space for quality time alone (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Eton mess; gratin.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 guest arrived two minutes before opening and was waved in early — and the room was full right away.

places.name: 蛸安 岡崎本店 (Tako Yasu Okazaki)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat-batter takoyaki with tenkasu and a house sauce (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus takoyaki and octopus dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Wednesday–Friday 16:00–21:00; Saturday–Sunday 15:00–23:00; closed Monday and Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; takeaway (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 6 counter seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog). A stall-like room where small insects sometimes come in (July 2024). Okazaki Irie-cho, north of Marutamachi; locals pull up by car for takeaway (Tabelog; February 2026).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki Irie-cho, north of Marutamachi — 15 min walk from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Long-established Kyoto takoyaki shop, named alongside Tako Tora (January 2024) · large, irregular takoyaki, very crisp outside from tenkasu and soft inside, with a spicy house sauce; ask for "firm" for extra crunch; about ¥100 a piece, 8 for ¥800 (2024–2026 reviews) · versions with sauce, ponzu or a heap of green onion; "Seiko-chan salad" of takoyaki under shredded cabbage, octopus and green onion (2024 reviews) · tako-chinmi and tako-butsu with gochujang-style sauce; beer and sake (Tabelog; 2024 reviews) · under ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Takoyaki · Okazaki, a Kyoto classic] A six-seat, stall-like takoyaki counter in Okazaki: big, lumpy balls fried until shatteringly crisp, then sauced, ponzu'd or buried in green onion, with octopus bites in gochujang on the side and a beer. Most love the crunch; a January 2025 regular found reheated takeaway tough, and others recall a creamier style under the previous owner. Cash only; smoking allowed. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the Okazaki head shop of Tako Yasu, a takoyaki counter with takeaway. Reviewers call it a long-established Kyoto takoyaki shop (July 2024); a December 2025 reviewer who ate here as a child remembers a creamier style made by an older man, probably the previous owner, over fifteen years ago.
chef_bio.specialty: Crisp takoyaki; tako-chinmi.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 regular buys eight for ¥800 to eat in the car on the way home after dinner.
A January 2025 visitor saw takeaway balls being reheated, found the takoyaki tough, and noted the price had reached ¥100 a piece as octopus costs rose.
A December 2025 reviewer, who ate here as a child, brought a parent back and found the taste changed from the creamy style remembered from over fifteen years ago.

places.gf_detail: Ask: the restaurant asks to be told of allergies (Tabelog). A dashi-led omakase with tempura and soy-glazed eel among the courses (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led kappo omakase with eel, ayu, conger eel, crab and Kumamoto beef (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00; closing days vary (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, for one or more; tell the restaurant about allergies; children welcome with a kids menu on request (Tabelog; October 2026). One omakase course, ¥15,000 tax included with no service charge from September 2026 (2026 reviews); BYO drinks allowed per Tabelog (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats with a charcoal grill in front; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). In a quiet lane by Shijo Nishinotoin, west of Shijo Karasuma; 5 min walk from Shijo Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 5 February 2026 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Kappo omakase by a chef from Kikunoi and Gion Rohan, with charcoal grilling and clay-pot rice (2026 reviews) · one course, ¥15,000 from September 2026, e.g. scallops with yuba and dashi jelly; charcoal-grilled eel with young corn or ginkgo and chestnut; sashimi of Akashi octopus, kelp-cured flounder, seared chutoro; a soup of conger eel and matsutake; Lake Biwa ayu with roe over charcoal; crab in vinegar jelly; figs in white-miso or sesame sauce (September–October 2026) · Kumamoto black wagyu sirloin cap over charcoal; clay-pot rice of Tanba Koshihikari with dried sardines, homemade mentaiko, chirimen and shibazuke; red miso soup; almond tofu (2026 reviews) · sake such as Junraku Dai; shiso juice; Ippodo hojicha ¥400 · about ¥15,000–20,000 a head with drinks (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo omakase · Shijo Nishinotoin, opened 2026] A new eight-seat counter of wood and clay walls where Mr. Oomura, trained at Kikunoi and later head chef of Gion Rohan, cooks one seasonal course for ¥15,000 with no service charge: charcoal-grilled eel and Lake Biwa ayu, conger eel and matsutake soup, Kumamoto beef, and clay-pot rice with homemade mentaiko. Warm and cheerful at the counter, though one guest wanted more polish. Evenings; book ahead.

roles: Owner-chef (Mr. Oomura, as named by reviewers)
A couple runs the counter (September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 5 February 2026, a counter of Japanese cuisine using seasonal ingredients; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers write that Mr. Oomura worked at Kikunoi in Akasaka and Kyoto, then served four and a half years as head chef of Gion Rohan before going independent (September–October 2026), sourcing seafood and Kyoto vegetables each morning; a September 2026 reviewer notes it is just the couple running the place.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal seafood and Kyoto vegetables bought fresh each morning (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled eel and ayu; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: On a full night in September 2026 the three groups arrived at slightly different times, so the clay-pot rice was cooked three separate times.
A September 2026 guest wished the ¥400 Ippodo hojicha were brewed in a teapot and the soup bowl warmed first, allowing that a couple-run counter may be short-handed.
An October 2026 diner found the chef cheerful enough to lift the spirits, and two shared ¥39,000 with drinks.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Yudofu itself is tofu in kombu water, but courses add tempura, dengaku with miso, and soy-based dipping sauce; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A tofu and yuba restaurant with vegetable tempura and nama-fu, but courses include sashimi and dipping sauces are likely dashi-based; no vegan information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Thursday–Tuesday and holidays 11:00–15:30 (food last order 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (food last order 19:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations for Yudofu Shunsai Aoi up to a few days ahead; no seat-only bookings, and none for the Hana, Tsuki and Yuki courses — walk-ins are seated as space allows, in order (Tabelog). A priority online booking is offered (September–October 2026). A 10% service charge for private rooms (Tabelog original 個室のご利用でサービス料10％). 250 seats at tables and sunken kotatsu, private rooms for 2–15; non-smoking, smoking area outside; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). places.neighborhood: By Nanzenji Temple — 7 min walk from Keage Stn
places.cuisine: Yudofu and yuba restaurant set in a garden of the four seasons, with Kyoto specialities and rare sake (Tabelog) · Hana course ¥3,850: small dishes, an assortment, tofu dengaku, vegetable tempura, yudofu with green onion, rice and pickles (September–November 2026) · yuba courses; yuba sashimi; nama-fu dengaku; a monthly course; lunch courses with sashimi and simmered dishes; warabi mochi (September–November 2026) · draft beer ¥550; yuzu cider ¥605 (September 2026) · lunch ¥3,000–4,000, dinner ¥4,000–6,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yudofu · beside Nanzenji, garden setting] A big, long-established yudofu house beside Nanzenji, reached through a lavish, well-kept garden: the ¥3,850 Hana course runs from small dishes and tofu dengaku to vegetable tempura and a hot pot of rich tofu, with yuba courses for those who prefer it. Walk-ins seated in order as space allows, so expect a wait at lunch. Friendly service; photo menu. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a tofu, Japanese-cuisine and shabu-shabu restaurant by Nanzenji offering Kyoto specialities and rare sake in a garden of the four seasons, with reservations through its Yudofu Shunsai Aoi section and a website at to-fu.co.jp; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe a famous yudofu restaurant at the temple gate with a beautifully kept garden and a traditional house.
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto specialities and rare sake in a garden of the four seasons (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Yudofu; yuba.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 pair without a booking were told the wait would be about as long as a walk round Nanzenji — and came back to a ready table.
An October 2026 visitor was first in at opening, called by name from the waiting area, and led through the garden to the table.
An October 2026 diner was struck by how lavishly the garden uses its land, in an age of cost-cutting.

No service charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「なし」 — the English page wrongly says 10% is added). 50 seats; private hire for 20–50, parties up to about 40; non-smoking; cards including UnionPay, transit IC and other e-money, and QR including Alipay (Tabelog). In a renovated Kyoto machiya on Shijo-dori east of Nishinotoin, about 5 min from Shijo Stn (351 m) (Tabelog). Opened 1 December 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori, west of Karasuma — 5 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Thai cooking by a Thai chef trained in hotels, in a machiya filled with tableware and posters brought from Thailand (Tabelog) · lunch sets of several small dishes with jasmine rice, e.g. Bangkok Crunch ¥1,500, Chiang Mai set ¥1,700, Krungthep set (tom yum goong, green curry, gapao, yum woon sen, kara-age, fresh spring rolls), Phuket lunch · evening tom yum ramen set ¥1,800 with thin, medium or thick noodles · pad thai, khao man gai, cilantro kara-age, som tam with sticky rice, extra cilantro by the bowl (2026 reviews) · party course of nine dishes with all-you-can-drink from ¥2,980 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Thai · Shijo-dori, a Thai canteen in a machiya] A lively Thai eatery in an old Kyoto townhouse on Shijo-dori, decked out with tableware and posters from Thailand and run in the kitchen by a hotel-trained Thai chef. Lunch is a tray of small dishes — tom yum, green curry, gapao, herb kara-age — for about ¥1,500–1,700; at night try pad thai, khao man gai or tom yum ramen. Ask for extra cilantro by the bowl. Open daily.

roles: Thai chef, trained in hotels (Tabelog); not named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: a Thai eatery recreated in a Kyoto machiya with tableware, posters and furniture brought from Thailand, cooked by a Thai chef trained in hotels. Tabelog lists the operator’s website as green-curry.co.jp. A web article describes sister shops in Marutamachi and Sanjo (Retty lists the Sanjo shop as closed). Opened 1 December 2013 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Thai lunch sets; tom yum ramen.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 trio ordered a side bowl of cilantro and topped every dish with it.
A July 2026 visitor, drawn in by som tam on the board outside, had it with sticky rice.
A July 2026 diner trying cilantro for the first time after decades of wondering finally came in.

places.notes: [Yakiniku · Higashikujo, steamed pork and horumon] A Showa-era pork house in the backstreets south of Kyoto Station, packed with regulars. chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a long-running pork yakiniku house in Higashikujo known for steamed pork and offal, with a branch in Saiin; reviewers note young local staff, a retro Showa atmosphere and a no-photos rule inside.

places.name: マルミヤ亭 (Marumiya Tei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Steamed pork with chojang, marinated and salted grilled cuts, kimchi; no gluten information is published (official shop; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a pork and offal yakiniku house (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Saturday 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); Sunday 14:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); closed Wednesday, and occasionally for supply or maintenance (Tabelog). Bookings advised — often full even on weekdays (June 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 28 seats at seven tables for four with shichirin grills; parties up to 35; non-smoking; cards including UnionPay, and PayPay (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Hidden in the backstreets of Higashikujo, 499 m from Tofukuji Stn (Tabelog; June 2026). A neighbourhood taste loved for over half a century (official online shop). Sister shop マルミヤJr. is a separate listing.
places.neighborhood: Higashikujo — 499 m from Tofukuji Stn
places.cuisine: Steamed pork and pork yakiniku over shichirin (reviews) · mushi-buta steamed pork ¥650, plain pig’s trotters ¥600, trotter soup ¥600, pork belly with skin ¥750, boneless pork ¥690, marinated harami ¥1,300, beef heart sashimi ¥820, omasum sashimi, bon-no-kubo (pork neck), whole cucumber pickles ¥390 (September 2025–February 2026) · salt on request for cuts usually served with sauce (September 2026) · vacuum-packed mushi-buta, trotters and kimchi sold online (official shop)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Higashikujo, half a century of steamed pork] A busy, long-loved pork house in the backstreets of Higashikujo, grilling over shichirin at seven tables. The steamed pork (about ¥650) and trotters are the signatures; add pork belly with skin, rare neck cuts and very fresh offal sashimi. Good value — about ¥4,000–5,000 with drinks. Opens mid-afternoon on Sundays; closed Wednesday. Book ahead.

chef_bio.background: Per the official online shop: a downtown taste loved for over half a century, selling vacuum-packed steamed pork, pig’s trotters and kimchi. Reviewers describe a butcher-style pork yakiniku house with a loyal local following and a sister shop, マルミヤJr.
chef_bio.specialty: Mushi-buta steamed pork; pig’s trotters.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 group expecting a quiet Monday found the place almost full without a booking.
A September 2026 regular asked for the harami and kobukuro with salt instead of sauce, and the kitchen happily obliged.
A July 2026 regular struggles to visit because so many Kyoto get-togethers fall on Wednesday, the closing day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式オンラインショップ (marumiyatei.theshop.jp): むし豚・焼肉マルミヤ亭、半世紀以上愛され続けた下町の味、真空パックの豚足・むし豚・豚ミミ・キムチ。食べログ: 焼肉・ホルモン、南区東九条北松ノ木町13、東福寺駅から499m、月火木金土17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、日14:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、水曜定休、仕入れや設備で臨時休業あり、28席 (4人席×7)、35名まで、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 七輪、むし豚650円、豚足600円、豚足スープ600円、皮付きバラ750円、骨なし豚690円、牛ハツ刺し820円、センマイ刺し、ぼんのくぼ、ハラミ1,300円、きゅうりの一本漬け390円、姉妹店マルミヤJr.。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; grill at the table.

places.name: イル・ジェーコ (Il Geco)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: a long pasta list, focaccia, fried panelle (2024–26 reviews). Ask about the meat mains and antipasti.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: house pâté and ham, offal antipasti, tripe, lamb (2024–25 reviews); a November 2025 diner found no vegetable antipasto that night.
places.hours_raw: 18:00 to about midnight; closed Monday and irregularly (Tabelog). A pasta lunch runs one week a month — dates on Instagram (April 2025). Reservations accepted and advised at weekends (Tabelog; November 2025). No cover charge, but each guest is asked to order one drink and one dish, or a seat charge applies (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「なし ※おひとり様につきドリンク、お料理各一品のオーダーがない場合お席料を頂戴いたします」). Cards, no e-money (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, four tables for two; small groups up to 12 and private hire by phone (Tabelog). Non-smoking; smoking area outside (Tabelog). Children by arrangement (Tabelog). Basement of 光悦ビル on Nishinotoin south of Shijo; 5 min from Shijo and Karasuma Stns exit 26 (Tabelog). Opened 25 February 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishinotoin south of Shijo — 5 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Late-night Italian with over 50 wines; house pâté made to a different blend each time (Tabelog, shop text) · omakase antipasti of 6–7 dishes, ¥1,500 per person (April 2025) or ¥2,500 (May 2024), including gizzards and other offal · a long pasta list — fresh tomato and mozzarella spaghetti ¥1,800 (April 2025), penne with tripe and white beans (November 2025) · tagliata with fries (May 2024), lamb (November 2025), ayu (August 2026); mains take over 40 minutes, so order early (November 2025) · panelle, crema catalana (November 2025) · monthly lunch week: pasta lunch ¥1,870 with six small antipasti, salad, focaccia and coffee (April 2025)
places.notes: [Italian · Shijo Nishinotoin, a late basement trattoria] A basement counter and a few tables near Shijo Karasuma, open to about midnight: an omakase antipasti spread (¥1,500–2,500, offal included), house pâté, a long pasta list and over 50 wines. Solo diners are welcome at the counter; mains take 40 minutes, so order mains first. One drink and one dish each, or a seat charge. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian restaurant, pasta house and wine bar opened 25 February 2014, open late. An April 2025 review spells the name IL GECO.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase antipasti; house pâté; pasta.

anecdotes.text: A May 2024 diner who dislikes offal found the gizzards and other horumon in the ¥2,500 antipasti free of any smell and changed opinion.
An October 2024 solo diner asked if one person was all right and the chef replied, "We’ll make adjustments as much as possible!"
A March 2024 diner noted many regulars and advised going late with someone who knows the place.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ・ワインバー、下京区西洞院通四条下ル妙伝寺町720 光悦ビル B1F、四条駅・烏丸駅26番出口から徒歩5分、18:00〜24:00頃、月曜休み (不定休あり)、予約可、チャージなし (一人1ドリンク1品の注文がない場合は席料)、カード可、14席 (カウンター6、2人がけテーブル4)、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、2014年2月25日オープン、自家製パテ、ワイン50種以上。口コミ (2024年2月〜2026年8月、英語): おまかせ前菜 (砂肝やホルモン) 1,500円・2,500円、パスタが豊富、トマトとモッツァレラのスパゲッティ1,800円、タリアータ、パネッレ、カタラーナ、メインは40分以上かかる、月に一週間だけのランチ1,870円、常連が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seats suit solo diners; order a drink and a dish each; many regulars (2024–25 reviews). No English evidence found.

places.name: てんぷら 永春 (Tempura Eishun)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-batter tempura courses (2023–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of fish and shellfish tempura with tentsuyu (2023–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; closing days vary (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, including through Instagram, and advised at weekends (Tabelog; June 2023, July 2024). CASH ONLY — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「無し」; Tabelog’s English wrongly says a fee is added). 8 counter seats, 2 more chairs possible (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). About 10 min from Marutamachi and Karasuma Oike Stns (Tabelog). Opened 20 July 2019 (Tabelog). Two 2025–26 diners found the counter area untidy (July 2025, June 2026).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma Marutamachi area — 10 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Tempura courses fried piece by piece at an 8-seat counter by an owner who researches oils and flours (2024–26 reviews) · seasonal fish and vegetables — kisu, mushrooms, lotus root, amadai, eel, eggplant cut in cubes, shrimp, sweet potato — ending in a kakiage rice bowl and ice cream, all under ¥10,000 (February 2024) · anago, oysters, plump shrimp, crab dumplings (2024–25 reviews) · a little sushi within the course (July 2025) · finishes of tempura rice bowl, tempura soba (January 2025) or tempura ice cream (July 2024) · dips of salt, tentsuyu, wasabi, grated radish and plum sauce (March 2024; June 2026) · 7th-anniversary courses ¥3,300 and ¥5,500 (May 2026) · Japanese sake (July 2025)
places.notes: [Tempura · Marutamachi, a dedicated young fryer’s counter] Eight seats around a young owner-chef who experiments daily with oils and batter: seasonal fish and vegetables in a thin, crisp coat, a kakiage bowl to finish and tempura ice cream, for well under ¥10,000. A cheerful, chatty counter, though two diners found it untidy. Cash only; book via Instagram.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), described as young and dedicated (February 2024)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a tempura counter opened 20 July 2019. Reviewers describe an owner who researches oils and flours scientifically (July 2025), adjusts batter and oil by ingredient (June 2023), and has posted more than 1,300 Instagram updates on daily trials (May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal tempura course; anago; kakiage bowl.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 diner learned the batter uses frozen flour, and found the cubed, skinless eggplant fluffy — a first.
A May 2026 diner came for the 7th-anniversary lunch, a ¥3,300 course offered that month only.
A June 2026 diner was told about the oils and ingredients and given wasabi and plum sauce to match each piece.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 天ぷら、中京区亀屋町167-1 ディピュイ亀屋ビル 1F、丸太町駅・烏丸御池駅から徒歩10分、12:00〜14:00・18:00〜22:00、不定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、サービス料無し、カウンター8席、禁煙、子供可、2019年7月20日オープン。口コミ (2022年11月〜2026年6月、英語): 油と粉を研究する若い店主、季節の魚と野菜の天ぷら、締めはかき揚げ丼、天丼、天ぷら蕎麦、天ぷらアイス、塩・天つゆ・わさび・大根おろし・梅のソース、7周年の3,300円と5,500円のコース、カウンターが散らかっているとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: One course at the counter; the owner explains oils and dips (June 2026); cash only. No English evidence found.

places.name: 洋食屋 キッチンゴン 六角店 (Kitchen Gon Rokkaku)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pine rice is topped with a breaded pork cutlet and curry or demi-glace; fried shrimp, fish fry and Neapolitan pasta (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork cutlet, hamburg steak, beef cutlet, shrimp fry (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 10:00–14:30 and 17:00–20:30; Sat–Sun 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–20:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 40 seats incl. a counter; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children, kids menu and strollers welcome (Tabelog). One hour free at a partner car park with a ¥3,000 spend (Tabelog). Near Rokkaku Takakura; 459 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog). This branch opened 13 March 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Rokkaku Takakura — 459 m from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Yoshoku of the Kitchen Gon house, said by reviewers to have created pine rice: fried rice under a thin pork cutlet with curry or demi-glace (October 2026) · pine rice ¥1,350 (October 2026), aka-pine rice ¥1,100 (October 2026), cheese hamburg pine rice ¥1,650 (October 2026); an all-toppings version; small portions come with salad (September 2026) · Gon set A of hamburg steak, shrimp fry and white fish fry (September 2026); C-Gon lunch of three items with a mini pine rice ¥2,100 (October 2026); beef cutlet (October 2026) · omurice with spicy curry (August 2026); Neapolitan pasta (September 2026) · draft beer and wine (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Rokkaku Takakura, the home of pine rice] A branch of Kitchen Gon, the yoshoku house reviewers credit with pine rice — fried rice under a thin pork cutlet and curry sauce (from ¥1,100) — plus big combination plates of hamburg steak and fried shrimp, beef cutlet, omurice and Neapolitan. 70s American pop and many overseas guests; one diner found the cutlet too salty. Open from 10:00 on weekdays; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: this Rokkaku branch opened 13 March 2017; Tabelog also lists Kitchen Gon 西陣店 and 二条店. A September 2026 review says the house has been around since 1970, and an October 2026 review calls it the originator of pine rice.
chef_bio.specialty: Pine rice.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner swapped in a mini pine rice on the three-item C-Gon lunch to try the beef cutlet as well, with 70s American pop playing and overseas guests humming along.
A September 2026 diner liked the curry and nostalgic Neapolitan but found the tonkatsu so salty it took several glasses of water.
A September 2026 regular welcomed back the all-toppings pine rice but still did not know how to order the black version.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食、中京区堀之上町129 プラネシア六角高倉 1F、烏丸駅から459m、月火木金10:00〜14:30・17:00〜20:30、土日11:00〜14:30・17:00〜20:30、水曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー可、40席、禁煙、子供可・キッズメニュー、提携駐車場1時間無料 (3,000円以上)、2017年3月13日オープン。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): pine rice (焼き飯に薄いカツとカレーやデミ) 1,350円、aka-pine rice 1,100円、チーズハンバーグの pine rice 1,650円、全部のせ、ゴンセットA、C-ゴンランチ2,100円、ビーフカツ、カレーのオムライス、ナポリタン、1970年からの店 、pine rice の発祥、外国人の客が多い、カツが塩辛いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order from the menu; plenty of overseas guests (October 2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: INDÉPENDANTS (アンデパンダン)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: pasta lunches with baguette, coca (Spanish flatbread) (2026 reviews). Ask about the paella.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Paellas of squid ink, seafood or duck, charcuterie and pasta (2026 reviews); no vegan information.
places.hours_raw: Weekdays: lunch 12:00–14:30 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:00–23:00; weekends and holidays 12:00–23:00; food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30 (official site, from 21 August 2026; Tabelog). Lunch menu only from 12:00 to 14:00; seafood paella only at dinner (Tabelog; August 2026). Occasional closures are posted on the official site (e.g. 19–21 October 2026). Reservations accepted; walk-ins usually possible (Tabelog; July 2026). Private room ¥500 per person (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「個室ご利用の場合、1人500円頂きます。」). Cards, e-money and QR incl. PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). 70 seats, banquets to 90; QR-code ordering (Tabelog; July 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Basement of the 1928 Building on Sanjo east of Gokomachi; 9 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo Gokomachi, under the 1928 Building — 9 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Spanish dining bistro under an art-filled brick basement (Tabelog; official site) · paella: squid ink (July–October 2026), duck cooked from raw rice to order, seafood at dinner only (August–September 2026) · charcuterie platter, coca (September 2026) · clam vongole (July 2026); lunch pasta sets with salad and soup — Amatriciana, carbonara with baguette (August–October 2026) · beer and wine, glass ¥800 (July 2026) · live music events (official site)
places.notes: [Spanish bistro · Sanjo, the basement of the 1928 Building] A brick basement under 武田五一’s 1928 Building, revived by artists in 1998, now a dining bistro with Taizan tiles, art and live music. Come for squid-ink paella, duck paella cooked to order, charcuterie and coca, or a pasta lunch set. Easy to walk in; the house wine disappointed one diner. Open from noon to 23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: INDÉPENDANTS occupies the basement of the 1928 Building, a Kyoto City registered tangible cultural property designed by 武田五一, called the father of Kansai architecture; in 1998 a group of artists restored the long-derelict basement and gave it new life as INDÉPENDANTS, a place where food and art meet. The site has pages on its Taizan tiles, art and live events.
chef_bio.philosophy: A meal that satisfies all five senses in a historic space (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Squid-ink paella.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 tile enthusiast came for the Taizan tiles and recommended the charcuterie platter and the coca.
A November 2026 couple asked for paella at lunch, normally dinner only, and the staff kindly made it.
A July 2026 diner liked being able to walk in without a booking on a Friday, though the ¥800 glass of wine disappointed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都三条の食とアートが融合するダイニングビストロ、武田五一設計の京都市登録有形文化財「1928ビル」の地下、1998年に多くのアーティストが廃墟同然の地階を復元し「INDÉPENDANTS」に、Taizan のタイル、アート、ライブ、2026年8月21日からの営業時間 (平日 昼12:00〜14:30・夜17:00〜23:00、土日祝12:00〜23:00)、2026年10月19日〜21日休み。食べログ: スペイン料理・パブ、中京区三条通御幸町東入弁慶石町56 1928ビル B1F、京都市役所前駅3番出口から徒歩9分、予約可、個室は1人500円、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、70席、禁煙。口コミ (2026年7月〜11月、英語): イカ墨のパエリア、鴨のパエリア、魚介のパエリアは夜のみ、生ハムなどの盛り合わせ、コカ、ボンゴレ、ランチのパスタセット、QR で注文、予約なしでも入りやすい。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code at the table; walk-ins usually fine; chopsticks offered with pasta (August 2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: 日本酒BAR ○△□ (Maru Sankaku Shikaku)
places.gf_detail: Ask: sake itself is gluten-free, but snacks include a nori-butter sandwich, shuto pizza and fried dishes (2022–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: snacks of sea urchin, ray fin, karasumi, shuto, squid shiokara (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 17:00–24:00; Sat 15:00–24:00; Sun 18:00–24:00 (open on some Sundays only, per the shop blurb and an August 2026 diner). Book directly on the day — it gets crowded. Standing bar of about 10–12 places; only e-cigarettes inside (Tabelog). Cards, QUICPay and most QR. No service charge, cover or otoshi — Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料、チャージ、おとうし無し」. Opened 11 January 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishinotoin-Rokkaku, near Shijo-Karasuma — up a lane on the 2nd floor; 10 min walk from Shijo / Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: A standing sake bar of regional sake (Tabelog blurb): a flavour chart on the wall sorts sake by four types from dry to sweet (September 2025) · 90 ml glasses ¥600 (September 2025) or ¥700, rarer bottles priced apart (August 2026); tasting sets of three 30 ml ¥880 or 50 ml ¥1,500 (September 2025); all-you-can-drink of 15+ local sakes ¥3,000 for 50 minutes (August 2026); a Kyoto local-sake trio (April 2026) · labels seen include Jikon, Aramasa, Juyondai, Nabeshima, Senkin, Tazake (2022–2026 reviews) · snacks about ¥800 a plate: nori-butter sandwich, shuto pizza, grilled ray fin, karasumi, a trio of sake snacks, Yura sea urchin in season, grilled firefly squid over a spirit lamp (2022–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sake stand bar · Nishinotoin-Rokkaku, a flavour chart and a friendly master] A ten-odd-place standing bar up a lane near Shijo-Karasuma, pouring regional sake by the 90 ml glass (¥600–700), in tasting flights, or all-you-can-drink for 50 minutes at ¥3,000, with a wall chart to steer you and a master happy to recommend. Snacks like nori-butter sandwiches and shuto pizza. No cover charge. Open till midnight; afternoons from 15:00 on Saturdays.

roles: The master, not named; "friendly, kind, and attentive" (June 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 11 January 2019 (Tabelog), on the second floor of a lane of small eateries on Nishinotoin near Rokkaku and the Honnoji temple ruins (Tabelog blurb). It has been on TV Osaka and in a sake magazine, holds anniversary tastings each January, joins a yearly Sake Day event with Stand Sakaba Stem (kyoto_stand_sakaba_stem) and pops up at hotel markets (2022–2026 reviews). One reviewer has logged 27 visits since 2022.
chef_bio.specialty: Regional sake by the glass; nori-butter sandwich.

anecdotes.text: September 2025: "a large 'Flavor Chart' on the wall clearly displays the four types of sake… This thoughtful setup is friendly for first-time visitors."
An August 2026 regular: "Enjoy over 15 types of local sake with an all-you-can-drink option for 3,000 JPY for 50 minutes!"
January 2026: a 3 pm arrival found the 7th-anniversary event on, with rare sake at a fair price and talk with a regular from Osaka.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本酒BAR ○△□、居酒屋・日本酒バー・立ち飲み、中京区西洞院通六角下る池須町423-2 西洞院食彩ろぉじ六角の道 2F、四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩10分、月〜金 17:00〜24:00、土 15:00〜24:00、日 18:00〜24:00、当日予約は直接電話、立ち飲み12名、店内は電子たばこのみ、カード・QUICPay・QR可、サービス料・チャージ・おとうし無し、2019年1月11日オープン、本能寺跡近くの六角通、テレビ大阪や雑誌で紹介、全国の地酒、日曜は一部営業。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 4タイプの味のチャート、90ml 600円 (2025年9月)・700円 (2026年8月)、飲み比べ30ml×3で880円・50ml×3で1,500円、地酒15種以上の50分飲み放題3,000円、京都の地酒3種、Jikon・Aramasa・Juyondai・Nabeshima・Senkin・Tazake など、つまみ1皿800円ほど、海苔バターサンド、酒盗ピザ、エイヒレ、からすみ、珍味3種盛り、由良の雲丹、ほたるいかのアルコールランプ焼き、明るく親切なマスター、毎年1月の周年イベント、ステムとの日本酒の日のイベント。

cultural_comfort.note: A wall chart sorts the sake by style; the master recommends.

places.name: 手打 とおる蕎麦 (Teuchi Toru Soba)
places.gf_detail: Ask: the soba is handmade juwari (all buckwheat), and diners in April and June 2026 say gluten-free orders are taken, but the dipping sauce is soy-based and the shop has not published how it handles this. Ask the owner.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dipping sauce is bonito dashi (November 2025); tororo comes with egg (April 2026).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Thu–Sun 11:30–14:30; closed Monday to Wednesday; hours may change. The shop’s site posts closures — a holiday 9–18 November 2026 (Monday to Wednesday regular closing plus extra days off). No reservations; queues at noon, sometimes a 40-minute wait (November 2025), less after 13:30. 8 counter seats; non-smoking. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Run single-handed by the owner (2025–2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Gosho-minami residential street — 7 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Handmade juwari soba (all buckwheat) with an Edo-style dashi dipping sauce (2025–2026 reviews) · zaru soba ¥1,200 regular (August 2026), 1.5× and double portions; grated-daikon (oroshi) soba, spicy oroshi, yamakake, a small bowl of tororo (2025–2026 reviews) · soba-gaki zenzai (sweet red-bean soup with buckwheat dumplings), cold ¥900 (August 2026) · soba-yu in a pot with extra dipping sauce; sake, shochu and beer (2026 reviews) · toshikoshi soba at year end (official site)
places.notes: [Soba · Gosho-minami, handmade juwari by one man] An eight-seat counter on a quiet street near Karasuma Oike where the owner alone makes, boils and serves handmade juwari soba: firm, fragrant noodles with a bold bonito dip, big portions, and soba-gaki zenzai to finish. Lunch only, Thursday to Sunday; expect a queue at noon and many visitors from abroad. One diner found the dip too mild (April 2026). Cash only.

roles: Owner, not named; runs the shop alone (2025–2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe an eight-seat counter in a residential street of Gosho-minami where one owner handles everything — drinks, boiling, serving and clearing — with a quick rhythm, handmade juwari soba compared to Edo or Echizen styles, generous portions, and lately many foreign customers. The shop’s own site and Instagram (toru_soba) post holidays.
chef_bio.specialty: Juwari zaru soba; soba-gaki zenzai.

anecdotes.text: November 2025: "The restaurant has only eight counter seats and is run by a single master, which made the wait time unexpectedly long" — about 40 minutes in the rain.
An April 2026 diner found the soba short and the dipping sauce "quite subtle… Maybe it’s due to my hay fever."
A monthly regular, June 2026: "They also seem to accommodate gluten-free options."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (torusoba.wixsite.com): 手打 とおる蕎麦 (Teuchi Toru Soba)、Instagram toru_soba、年越しそば、11月9日〜18日は定休日と臨時休業でお休み、7月の夏休み。食べログ: とおる蕎麦、そば、中京区二条通東洞院東入ル松屋町35-1、烏丸御池駅から徒歩7分、木〜日 11:30〜14:30、月〜水休み、予約不可、カウンター8席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 手打ちの十割そば、店主が一人で切り盛り、昼は行列 (40分待ちも)、ざるそば並1,200円、1.5倍や大盛り、おろしそば、辛味おろし、山かけ、とろろ小鉢、冷たいそばがきぜんざい900円、そば湯はポットで、つゆは鰹の江戸風、量が多い、グルテンフリーにも対応しているようだという声、つゆが薄く感じたという声 (2026年4月)、外国人客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue outside; counter only; many visitors from abroad (2026).

places.name: 紅葉 Koyo (Dusit Thani Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask: teppanyaki steak and vegetables can avoid wheat, but courses include focaccia, an Akashi-yaki-style wagyu and sushi (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-centred teppanyaki courses (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: dinner 17:30–22:00 (last food order 20:00) Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun; closed Wednesday and Thursday; reviewers also describe lunch courses (June 2025 – May 2026). Service charge 15%, no cover (Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料：15％チャージ：なし」). 30 seats around the teppan, semi-private areas; sommelier; smart-casual dress code; no children under 6; wheelchair accessible; cards. In the basement of the Dusit Thani Kyoto hotel, entered from the garden side (May 2026).
places.neighborhood: Near Nishi Honganji — 12 min walk from Kyoto Stn (inside Dusit Thani Kyoto)
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki with a French-trained chef’s touch (June 2025), in a hotel basement overlooking a Japanese garden · lunch course with domestic beef fillet ¥6,000 (June 2025): green-pea and grilled Kyoto vegetable salad, wagyu in Akashi-yaki style, soup, house focaccia, fillet, matcha sorbet with Tanba black beans · Chef’s Table teppan omakase lunch (January 2026) · sushi added after a change of head chef (December 2025); sirloin, cauliflower spread with the focaccia (May 2026) · Thai beer and a sommelier’s wine pairings (reviews)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Dusit Thani Kyoto, a garden-view counter] The teppanyaki room of the Thai luxury hotel Dusit Thani Kyoto, near Nishi Honganji: thirty seats around the plate in a bright basement looking onto the garden, with Kyoto vegetables, wagyu fillet and house focaccia; lunch from about ¥6,000. 15% service charge, smart-casual dress, no children under 6. A new head chef and staff since late 2025.

roles: Head chef not named; a December 2025 diner says the head chef and staff were replaced
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 place it in the basement of Dusit Thani Kyoto, built on the site of a former elementary school, with a bright room facing a Japanese garden, warm wood design, and many staff from Southeast Asia; a June 2025 diner says the menu is by a chef with a French background. In December 2025 a regular noted a new head chef, renewed staff and newly added sushi. No hotel-wide record exists in the data.
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan wagyu fillet; house focaccia.

anecdotes.text: "The head chef has changed, and the staff has been completely renewed!!" — December 2025.
A May 2026 diner in a T-shirt, jeans and jacket worried about the dress code, "but it turned out to be acceptable!" — and warned that hotel drink prices add up fast.
"The flavors were a bit on the stronger side (perhaps because I have a Kyoto palate)." — September 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 紅葉Koyo、鉄板焼き、下京区西洞院通正面上ル西洞院町466、京都駅中央口から徒歩12分、月火金土日 17:30〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 20:00)、水木休み、サービス料15%・チャージなし、30席、半個室、ソムリエ、スマートカジュアル、6歳未満は利用不可、車椅子可、カード可、ホテルのレストラン、公式サイトはデュシタニ京都。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年5月、英語): デュシタニ京都の地下、旧小学校の跡地、日本庭園が見える明るい店内、フレンチ出身のシェフ、ランチコース6,000円 (グリーンピースと京野菜のサラダ、和牛の明石焼き風、スープ、自家製フォカッチャ、国産牛フィレ、抹茶のソルベと丹波黒豆)、シェフズテーブルの鉄板おまかせランチ、料理長とスタッフが替わり寿司も、サーロイン、カリフラワーのスプレッド、タイのビール、ソムリエのワイン、東南アジア出身のスタッフ、味は濃いめという声、ドレスコード、ホテル価格。

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel staff; dress code smart casual.
