places.name: アナザー シー (Another C)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: courses include tempura, sushi and a small burger to finish (2023–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the omakase leans on Satsuma kuroge wagyu, eel and fish with dashi (official site; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: 18:00–23:00, reservations only; closed irregularly. Booking via TableCheck or by e-mail; changes by the day before; say when booking if you bring children (school age and up) (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR. Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「なし」 (the English auto-translation wrongly says 10% is added). Experiences offered: a Maiko dinner with a maiko’s performance and games, a Nishiki market tour and cooking classes (official site; July 2025).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-Kiyamachi corner — 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn and Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (4th floor)
places.cuisine: Omakase-only modern Japanese at an eight-seat counter, joining New York freedom with Kyoto technique: Kyoto vegetables and local sake, chosen seafood, Satsuma kuroge wagyu (official site) · seen: Satsuma wagyu strip loin with yuba and mibuna sauce to open, Aichi eel sushi, young-ayu tempura, chicken takikomi-gohan, saba-zushi (July 2025); tomato and sake soup with oysters and clams, grilled eel, simmered octopus, a sushi-rice onigiri (March 2023); a mini burger to finish (December 2023) · Chef’s Special Dinner; Maiko Dinner ¥30,000–39,999 a head (official site; 2025 reviews) · spend ¥20,000–39,999 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Modern Japanese · Sanjo-Kiyamachi, a New York-raised chef’s counter] An eight-seat fourth-floor counter at Sanjo-Kiyamachi where chef 富永 暖, raised in New York and once head chef of MEGU in Tribeca, cooks an omakase of Kyoto produce and Satsuma wagyu — often starting with the meat — and chats across the counter. Popular with visitors from abroad; a Maiko Dinner can be booked. Reservations only; ¥20,000–40,000 a head. No service charge.

roles: Owner-chef (official site); cooks and serves alone (March 2023; November 2025)
chef_bio.origin: Grew up in New York (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: grew up around cooking, moved to New York at 10 and helped at his parents’ food shop; after high school he returned to Japan alone to train in Japanese cuisine in Kyoto, at Michelin-starred restaurants including 貴船ひろや and 日本料理櫻川; went back to New York in 2004 as head chef of MEGU in Tribeca; returned in 2009 to lead the kitchen of 多伽羅 in Nishijin; then opened Another C. A July 2025 diner gives the name as Dan Tominaga. An August 2023 diner met "the chef and his wife."
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: a hideaway where each guest is the star — borderless food and space, freer, more fun and more stylish.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase of Kyoto produce and Satsuma wagyu; the Maiko Dinner.

anecdotes.text: March 2023: "Although it’s a small space with counter and table seating, I was astonished to see it run by just one person!"
A birthday in June 2023: "When it came time for the birthday cake, everyone joined in to celebrate."
October 2025: "It was a bit unexpected to have a meat dish… served as the first course, but it was absolutely perfect to enjoy it when I was really hungry!!"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (another-c.com): Another C、京都モダンジャパニーズ、お客様が主役の隠れ家、カウンター8席のみ、シェフ 富永 暖、おまかせコースのみ、京野菜・地酒・厳選した海鮮・薩摩黒毛和牛の創作和食、舞妓ディナー・錦市場ツアー・料理教室、ニューヨークの自由な感性と京都の技、10歳でニューヨークへ移住し両親の食材店を手伝う、高校卒業後に単身帰国し京都で修業 (貴船ひろや、日本料理櫻川など)、2004年に再渡米しトライベッカの MEGU で Head Chef、2009年に帰国し西陣の多伽羅の料理長、18:00〜23:00 完全予約制、不定休、中京区中島町96-2 三条木屋町ビル4F。食べログ: 日本料理・創作料理・肉料理、8席、禁煙、ベジタリアン対応、子供は学童以上、カード・電子マネー・QR可、サービス料は原文で「なし」。口コミ (2023年3月〜2025年11月、英語): 一人で切り盛り、シェフと奥さん、海外からの客が多い、薩摩黒毛和牛のストリップロインと湯葉と壬生菜のソース、愛知の鰻寿司、稚鮎の天ぷら、鶏の炊き込みご飯、鯖寿司、牡蠣と蛤のトマトと酒のスープ、締めのミニバーガー、肉料理から始まるコース、舞妓ディナー、1人2〜4万円。

cultural_comfort.note: Chef raised in New York; many guests from abroad.

places.name: BUNGALOW (バンガロー)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Drinking food — yakitori, sashimi, kara-age, yakisoba, curry, spring rolls, fritters — alongside craft beer; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: yakitori, fish and meat plates; the vegetable dishes (cucumber pickles, fig with white sesame) are not described (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 17:00–23:00; Saturday and Sunday 15:00–23:00 (Tabelog; hours may change). A December 2023 reviewer gave weekday 15:00–22:00 and weekend 12:00–22:00 with irregular closures. No reservations (Tabelog; August 2023). Cards, IC, e-money and many QR codes (Tabelog). 15 seats at five tables with a standing counter on the ground floor, two standing tables upstairs with a large craft-beer fridge (Tabelog; September 2025). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). On Shijo-dori east of Horikawa, about 3–10 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog; December 2023). Opened 9 September 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori east of Horikawa — near Hankyu Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: “Craft beer, natural wine, junmai sake, good foods for drinkers” (official site title) · craft beer, much of it from Kyoto (Kyoto Brewing), in three sizes; warm kanzake (2023–2026) · yakitori including duck-and-leek and mixed chicken liver; tulip kara-age (2025–2026) · isaki laab-style sashimi, charcoal-grilled young sweetfish (July 2025) · octopus sashimi ¥980 (June 2024) · fig with white sesame, cucumber pickles, yakisoba, curry (August 2023) · pork-and-pepper spring rolls, maitake fritters, potato salad, roast pork (2025)
places.notes: [Craft beer and sake · Shijo-Horikawa, a standing-friendly bar] A stylish, airy bar on Shijo-dori with a standing counter and a beer fridge upstairs: Kyoto craft beers in three sizes, natural wine and warm junmai sake, with yakitori, laab-style sashimi, spicy tulip kara-age and other good drinking food. No bookings; fills up in the evening.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. A December 2025 visitor liked the beer but found the food disappointing; others rate the food highly (2023–2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Good food for drinkers (official site title).
chef_bio.specialty: Craft beer; kanzake; yakitori.

anecdotes.text: An August 2023 theatre-goer, back from Minami-za, came for a rare solo pre-dinner drink of craft beer and kanzake.
A February 2024 visitor arrived to a near-empty room early in the evening and left with it full.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイトの題: BUNGALOW - クラフトビール、ナチュールワイン、純米酒、飲む人のためのよい料理。食べログ: ダイニングバー・ワインバー・ビアバー、下京区四条堀川東入柏屋町15、阪急大宮駅・烏丸駅から徒歩10分、月〜金17:00〜23:00、土・日15:00〜23:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、15席 (1階テーブル5卓とスタンディング、2階に立ち飲みテーブル2卓)、禁煙、子ども可、2012年9月9日オープン。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 京都のクラフトビール、燗酒、焼き鳥、イサキのラープ風の刺身、稚鮎の炭火焼き、チューリップの唐揚げ、焼きそば、カレー、料理が残念だったとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual bar with standing room; English-titled site; no reservations.

places.name: タイカレーラーメン シャム (Thai Curry Ramen Siam)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: khao soi with wheat ramen noodles and crispy fried noodles (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Homemade curry pastes of fresh Thai herbs with coconut milk (official site), but proteins are chicken, pork or minced pork, and fish sauce is not addressed (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Saturday 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–21:30; Wednesday lunch only; closed Sunday (Tabelog); a December 2025 reviewer adds holidays as closed. No reservations (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; QR codes accepted (Tabelog). 12 seats at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). In Mibu, 7 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn and 3 min from the Shijo-Nakashindo bus stop (Tabelog). Opened 13 March 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Mibu, west of Shijo-Omiya — 7 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Khao soi (Thai curry ramen) specialist: the popular ramen of the Thai-curry restaurant シャム, revived as its own shop (official site) · homemade curry pastes of ground fresh Thai herbs, made weekly (official site) · khao soi regular ¥1,180 with green curry soup, double chicken and pork; extra meat +¥150, cheese +¥180 (December 2025) · soups: green, red and massaman curry; toppings such as spicy minced pork, moo yang, extra coriander; crispy fried noodles on top; a little jasmine rice to finish (2025–2026) · salad on the side (March 2026) · khao man gai thot, gai tod, summer tom yum kung cold noodles, coconut pudding (July–September 2026)
places.notes: [Khao soi · Mibu near Shijo-Omiya] A small, stylish shop devoted to khao soi, the northern-Thai curry noodle: choose green, red or massaman soup and your meat, top with crispy noodles and extra coriander, from about ¥1,180. Pastes made in-house from fresh Thai herbs. Also fried chicken, khao man gai and summer cold tom yum noodles. No bookings; Sundays closed.

roles: Staff (unnamed); offshoot of the Thai-curry restaurant シャム
chef_bio.background: The official site of the Thai-curry restaurant シャム describes its homemade curry pastes, ground from fresh Thai herbs and made weekly, and announces 「大人気ラーメンが専門店になって復活！”タイカレーラーメン専門店シャム”がオープンしました！」. A March 2026 visitor was greeted by “a lovely lady” with a warm smile.
chef_bio.philosophy: Curry pastes researched and ground from fresh Thai herbs, made weekly to keep the aroma (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Khao soi.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner came back after about twelve years and found the khao soi as good as remembered.
A September 2026 diner doubled the coriander on a red-curry pork bowl and still wanted more.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (タイカレー シャム): 研究を重ねた自家製のカレーペースト、タイの生ハーブをすりつぶし1週間ごとに仕込む、グリーンカレー・レッドカレー・イスラムカレー、「大人気ラーメンが専門店になって復活！”タイカレーラーメン専門店シャム”がオープンしました！」。食べログ: ラーメン・カレー・タイ料理、中京区壬生花井町23-4 1F、阪急大宮駅から徒歩7分、月・火・木〜土 11:30〜14:30、17:30〜21:30、水は昼のみ、日曜定休、予約不可、QR決済可、12席、禁煙、2013年3月13日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): カオソーイ並1,180円、グリーン・レッド・マッサマンのスープ、揚げ麺、パクチー増し、カオマンガイトート、ガイトート、夏のトムヤムクンの冷やし麺、ココナッツプリン。

cultural_comfort.note: Small table-only shop; choose soup, meat and toppings; QR or cash.

places.name: 竹邑庵太郎敦盛 (Chikuyuan Taro Atsumori)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dark whole-grain soba made with egg and yam (September 2026 review — “please be cautious if you have allergies”); wheat content not stated; the dipping sauce is sweet soy-and-dashi (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the soba dough contains egg, a raw egg goes in the dipping bowl, and the sauce is dashi-based (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–14:30, Monday–Saturday; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). No reservations; queues at opening (Tabelog; October 2026). Suitcases and carry carts are not allowed inside — use station lockers (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 30 seats, all on tatami: shoes off (Tabelog). Designated smoking area (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Tabelog’s English note on children is garbled — ask before bringing children. In an alley 1 min from Marutamachi Stn exit 2; no car or bicycle parking (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Alley off Sawaragi-cho west of Karasuma — 1 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Two dishes only: atsumori (hot steamed) soba and cold soba (October 2026) · atsumori soba ¥1,200; 1.5 servings ¥1,300 — dark, soft, medium-thick soba of buckwheat ground with the husk, steamed in a seiro, dipped in a bowl of raw egg, wasabi and heaps of Kujo green onion with hot sweet sauce poured over (September–November 2026) · cold “okkake” soba 1.5 servings ¥1,500 with tororo (September 2026); served in small plates like wanko soba (October 2026) · soba-yu to loosen the noodles (September 2026)
places.notes: [Soba · alley by Marutamachi Stn, steamed atsumori] A tatami-only soba house down an alley a minute from Marutamachi Station that serves just two things: hot, steamed atsumori soba in a bamboo seiro, dipped in raw egg, Kujo green onion and a sweet hot sauce (from ¥1,200), and a cold version with grated yam. The noodles contain egg and yam. Lunch only, cash only, shoes off, no suitcases; queues at 11:00.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. An October 2026 diner with a pregnant wife was guided to a comfortable seat by attentive staff; a September 2026 visitor praised the staff.
chef_bio.specialty: Atsumori soba.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 repeat visitor from Kyushu was surprised by steamed soba with wasabi hidden under the green onion and raw egg.
A September 2026 traveller from Tokyo arrived just before 11:00 on the way to a HIMARI concert.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 竹邑庵太郎敦盛、そば、上京区椹木町通烏丸西入養安町242-12、丸太町駅2番出口から徒歩1分、月〜土 11:00〜14:30、日・祝定休、予約不可、スーツケースやキャリーカートは持ち込み不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、30席 (すべて靴を脱ぐ座敷)、喫煙所あり、英語メニュー、車・自転車は停められない。口コミ (2026年、英語): 熱盛りそばと冷たいそばの2品だけ、熱盛り1,200円・1.5人前1,300円、殻ごと挽いた黒いそば、蒸籠で蒸す、生卵とわさびと九条ねぎに熱いつゆ、おっかけそば1.5人前1,500円 (とろろ)、そばに卵と山芋が入るのでアレルギーに注意との声、開店前から行列。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); tatami only with shoes off; no suitcases; cash only.

staff_allergy_handling.text: A September 2026 reviewer warns that the soba itself contains egg and yam — “Please be cautious if you have allergies.”

places.name: ラーメン いち喜 (Ramen Ichiki)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles in soy-based broth (2024–25 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chashu, egg and meat or shellfish broths (2024–25 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–19:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). No bookings; buy a ticket at the vending machine first (Tabelog; October 2024 review). Tabelog lists no cards, e-money or QR, but an April 2026 diner found payment options besides cash. 20 seats: 8 at the counter, 12 at tables; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Kara-age is sold at the shop front (October 2024 review). A few minutes past the lights from the Gojozaka bus stop, toward Kiyomizu-dera and Otani Honbyo (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Foot of Gojozaka, toward Kiyomizu-dera
places.cuisine: Shoyu ramen in a café-like room: the special Ichiki shoyu with chashu, seasoned egg, thick menma and white and Kujo green onions ¥1,200 (December 2025); plain shoyu with egg and chashu; shoyu chashu ramen; chilled duck ramen in summer (August 2024); pork rice bowl; kara-age (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Ramen · foot of Gojozaka near Kiyomizu] A clean, stylish ramen shop on the way up to Kiyomizu-dera, playing jazz: gentle shoyu ramen with chashu, egg and Kujo green onion, about ¥1,000–1,200 — reasonable for the tourist zone, reviewers say. Ticket machine; open daily 11:00–19:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 4 October 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Shoyu ramen.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner was grateful for honest prices in a tourist area: ¥1,200 for the fully topped special shoyu.
An April 2026 visitor expected instant-ramen flavour and found it "neither exceptional nor disappointing".
An August 2024 diner found the broth lukewarm, the noodles overcooked and the lunch staff slow to seat people.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラーメン いち喜、ラーメン、東山区遊行前町559-7、市バス五条坂から信号を渡ってすぐ、11:00〜19:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、20席 (カウンター8・テーブル12)、禁煙、子供・ベビーカー可、テイクアウト可、2021年10月4日オープン。口コミ (2023年12月〜2026年4月、英語): 券売機、特製いち喜醤油1,200円 (チャーシュー、味玉、太いメンマ、白ねぎと Kujo ねぎ)、醤油ラーメン、冷やし鴨ラーメン、豚丼、店頭の唐揚げ、カフェのようなきれいな店内、現金以外も使えたという声、ぬるくて麺がのびていたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine at the door.

places.name: 二寧坂ふたば (Ninenzaka Futaba)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a March 2025 diner found the soba more wheat than buckwheat; tempura and soy-based broths (2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi broths, herring, chicken and duck (2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only (February 2025 review). English menu (February 2025 review). 20 seats in two tatami rooms and at two tables; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog; November 2024 review). On Ninenzaka, the stepped lane below Kiyomizu-dera; about 1 km from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ninenzaka lane below Kiyomizu-dera
places.cuisine: Soba and simple Kyoto set meals: nishin soba with sweet-simmered herring (2025), the nishin soba set with jako rice, matcha soba (¥950 in 2022), tempura soba, chicken soba with Kujo green onion, niboshi soba, duck nanban soba, oyako-don; listed as a soba and Japanese-sweets café (Tabelog; 2022–25 reviews)
places.notes: [Soba · Ninenzaka below Kiyomizu] A small, old-fashioned soba house on the busy Ninenzaka lane, run by a couple, with tatami rooms: soft-noodled nishin soba, matcha soba and chicken soba with Kujo green onion, about ¥1,000–2,000. English menu; cash only; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: A February 2025 diner describes a small soba shop "run by a lovely couple"; a November 2024 diner found the owner very polite and kind.
chef_bio.specialty: Nishin soba; matcha soba.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 visitor called it a classic, uncommercial room in the tourist bustle — "like a cultural heritage" — for its herring soba.
A March 2025 diner found the soba more wheat than buckwheat, its flavour faint, though the broth was gentle.
A February 2025 diner noted the English menu for foreign tourists and soft noodles with tender Kujo green onion.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 二寧坂ふたば、そば・甘味処、東山区桝屋町351、祇園四条駅から1,013m、10:00〜17:00、木曜休み、20席、座敷、禁煙、子供可。口コミ (2022年7月〜2025年3月、英語): 夫婦で営む小さなそば屋、英語メニュー、現金のみ、座敷2部屋とテーブル2卓、にしんそば、にしんそば定食とじゃこご飯、茶そば950円 (2022年)、天ぷらそば、Kujo ねぎの鶏そば、煮干しそば、鴨南蛮、親子丼、そばは小麦が多いという声、店主が丁寧で親切。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (February 2025 review); cash only.

places.name: ワンタンメンの満月 京都拉麺小路店 (Wantanmen no Mangetsu Kyoto Ramen Koji)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles and wonton wrappers in soy broth (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: niboshi (dried sardine) broth, chashu and pork wontons (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–22:00 (last food order 21:30), daily; hours may change (Tabelog). No bookings; queues at peak, quieter than its neighbours at other times (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking. In Kyoto Ramen Koji, the ramen street on the 10th floor of the Kyoto Station building (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Ramen Koji, Kyoto Station building 10F
places.cuisine: Sakata (Yamagata) wonton ramen: a clear niboshi-and-soy broth with curly noodles and very thin, silky wontons — shoyu wantanmen with a soft-boiled egg ¥1,180 (September 2026), shoyu chashu ramen ¥1,290 (October 2026); gyoza, fried rice (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sakata wonton ramen · Kyoto Station Ramen Koji] The Kyoto outpost of a Sakata, Yamagata ramen house founded in 1960: a light niboshi-soy broth with gossamer-thin wontons, about ¥1,200. Opinions split — fans love the delicacy, some find it lukewarm or thin. Open daily 11:00–22:00 on the station's 10th floor.

roles: Operator: Mangetsu of Sakata (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1960 in Sakata, Yamagata; shops in Sakata (main), 三鷹 and Kyoto. The Kyoto shop opened 19 June 2024 (Tabelog). A sign inside calls it the best local ramen in Japan (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: A flavour loved by the community, kept and developed (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Wantanmen (wonton ramen).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 theatre-goer off the Nozomi found the clear niboshi broth soothing and the wontons "ultra-thin, fluffy" as promised.
An October 2026 visitor who had eaten it in Sakata the year before found the broth "absolutely terrible" and the chashu dry; only the noodles and wontons passed.
Another October 2026 diner found it lukewarm, wondered whether it was pitched at foreign visitors, and preferred the gyoza and beer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ラーメン・ワンタンメンの満月、山形県酒田市、1960年創業、酒田本店・三鷹店・京都店。食べログ: ワンタンメンの満月 京都拉麺小路店、ラーメン、下京区東塩小路町901 京都駅ビル 10F 京都拉麺小路、11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、2024年6月19日オープン。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): 煮干しの澄んだ醤油スープ、極薄のワンタン、縮れ麺、味玉ワンタンメン1,180円、醤油チャーシュー麺1,290円、餃子、チャーハン、日本一のご当地ラーメンという掲示、スープがひどいという声やぬるいという声、ほかの店より空いている時も。

cultural_comfort.note: Station ramen street; quick counter service.

places.name: 吉象咖哩 (Yoshizo Curry)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Japanese curry roux with breaded cutlets and fried toppings (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cutlet, kara-age and egg toppings; the sauce is not described as plant-based (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–20:00, until sold out; closed Sunday (Tabelog). No bookings; queues of up to a dozen at lunch, and curry can run out mid-afternoon (2026 reviews). Order and pay at once — exact change helps; AMEX and QR payments per Tabelog. Counter seats only; non-smoking (Tabelog). On the ground floor of Kyoto Avanti, entered from the street, 1 min from the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station (Tabelog; October 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Avanti, Kyoto Station Hachijo exit
places.cuisine: Cheap, fruity-then-spicy Japanese curry on a generous mound of rice: plain curry ¥390, kara-age curry ¥530 (September 2026), pork cutlet curry ¥550 with the cutlet fried to order, raw egg +¥50, cheese and large rice (pork cutlet curry with both ¥750, October 2026), shrimp fry topping; also a tomato curry (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Curry counter · Kyoto Station Hachijo exit] A tiny counter at Avanti serving some of Kyoto's cheapest curry — ¥390 plain, ¥550 with a freshly fried pork cutlet — sweet at first, then properly spicy, with plenty of rice. Expect a lunchtime queue; it can sell out. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 3 September 2018 (Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer says the Japanese owner previously ran a curry restaurant in Shanghai.
chef_bio.specialty: Pork cutlet curry.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 first-timer waited about 30 minutes in an unshaded queue of twelve for a ¥550 katsu curry with raw egg.
An October 2026 visitor ninth in line saw the curry run out just after ordering; later arrivals were turned away.
A regular since 2022 came back in September 2026 for kara-age and egg on top.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 吉象咖哩、カレー、南区東九条西山王町31 京都アバンティ 1F、京都駅八条口から徒歩1分、月〜土 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜20:00、日曜休み、売り切れ次第終了、予約不可、カード (AMEX)・QR 可、カウンター席、禁煙、2018年9月3日オープン。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): カレー390円、唐揚げカレー530円、カツカレー550円 (注文後に揚げる)、生卵 +50円、チーズと大盛りのカツカレー750円、海老フライのトッピング、トマトカレー、甘さの後に辛さ、ご飯が多い、注文と同時に支払い、昼は行列で売り切れも、上海でカレー店を営んでいた日本人の店主。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the counter; bring small change.

places.name: イル ポッツォ (il pozzo)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: handmade pasta, pizza, lasagna and focaccia (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream pastas, pork, chicken and seafood (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:30–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:15); closed Monday — when Monday is a holiday it opens and closes Tuesday instead; occasional other days off, posted on Instagram (Tabelog). 20 seats — 6 at the counter, tables and a sunken kotatsu room; parties up to 28; non-smoking, with a smoking spot in the courtyard; English menu; children welcome; cards and iD. Tabelog lists no service charge. Opened 2 May 2009 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishinotoin-Sanjo — 6–9 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: A machiya trattoria with a courtyard: handmade pasta in several shapes matched to the sauces, ingredients from Italy, everything made in-house (official site) · lunch "Pranzo A": salad, focaccia and the day’s pasta, oil, cream or tomato (August 2026) — e.g. sea grapes and karasumi, clams and zucchini · dinner courses including an anniversary course: antipasti, two pastas, grilled Yoro pork, dessert platter (September 2025); Tanba chicken and porcini cream pasta, corn lasagna, roast beef, pesto, oil sardines, pizza (2025–2026 reviews) · wine and cocktails; imported Italian jams sold online (official site)
places.notes: [Italian · Nishinotoin-Sanjo, a machiya trattoria with a courtyard] A warm-lit machiya trattoria near Karasuma Oike since 2009, with a counter, tatami kotatsu seats and a courtyard: handmade pastas, pizza and Italian-imported ingredients, with weekday lunch sets around ¥1,500. Reviewers like the room and food; some found dishes unexplained (September 2025) or the pasta less good than before (February 2026). Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 2 May 2009 (Tabelog). The official site describes a Kyoto machiya marked by warm lights near Karasuma Oike, ingredients bought from Italy, everything handmade, and its pride, handmade pasta in various shapes chosen for each sauce; it also sells Italian jams online. Reviewers in 2025–2026 note the courtyard, the sunken kotatsu tables, and a local rather than tourist crowd.
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade pasta.

anecdotes.text: September 2025: "I found it disappointing that there was almost no explanation of the dishes or drinks."
A returning diner after four years, February 2026: "I feel like the pasta has lost some of its deliciousness."
December 2025: no photos on the menu, so "I ended up Googling the types of pasta on my phone while ordering! Haha."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ilpozzo.jp): 京都烏丸のイタリアン「イル ポッツォ」、烏丸御池近くの京町家、イタリアから仕入れる食材、一つ一つ手作り、自慢の手打ちパスタはソースに合わせて様々な麺、ランチ11:30〜14:30・ディナー17:30〜22:00、月曜休み (祝日の場合は翌日)、イタリアのジャムを直輸入して販売、中京区西洞院通三条下る柳水町77-2。食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ・ピザ、20席 (カウンター6、テーブル、掘りごたつ)、28名まで、禁煙 (坪庭に喫煙所)、英語メニュー、子供可、カード・iD可、2009年5月2日オープン。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年8月、英語): 町家と坪庭、ランチの Pranzo A (サラダ、フォカッチャ、本日のパスタをオイル・クリーム・トマトから)、海ぶどうとからすみ、あさりとズッキーニ、記念日コース (前菜盛り合わせ、パスタ2種、養老豚の肩ロースのグリル、デザート盛り合わせ)、丹波の鶏とポルチーニのクリームパスタ、とうもろこしのラザニア、ローストビーフ、ジェノベーゼ、オイルサーディン、ピザ、料理や飲み物の説明がほとんどないという声、パスタが以前ほどではないという声、メニューに写真がない。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); no photos on the menu (December 2025).

places.gf_detail: Ask: coffee is fine, but the food is pizza toast, pound cake and biscuits (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: black coffee is plant-based; café au lait, cocoa and pizza toast are not (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Fri 9:00–18:00, Sat 9:00–17:00; closed Sunday, Monday and holidays. The shop’s own site (under renewal) says 9:00–17:00, closed Sunday, with irregular days off. No reservations. 14 seats, some by windows that open onto the Takase River (2026 reviews); non-smoking; cards (JCB, Amex), e-money and QR. Opened 22 November 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: On the Takase River at Shomen-dori — 10 min walk from Keihan Shichijo Stn
places.cuisine: A small riverside coffee stand and café (2026 reviews) · house blends: Murmur, Takase River, Kikuhama, and a "Marufuku" blend with 1.5× the beans (2026 reviews); coffee with a biscuit under ¥500 (July 2026); iced coffee, iced café au lait, cocoa · pizza toast; matcha and black-bean pound cake (2026 reviews) · coffee beans to take home (April 2026)
places.notes: [Coffee · Takase River at Shomen-dori, a riverside window seat] A tiny café on the Takase River, open from 9 am, with windows that fold open onto the water and trees and chairs made by art-university students. House blends named for the neighbourhood, pizza toast and pound cake, coffee and a biscuit under ¥500. One regular misses the cherry tree out front, replaced by young trees (May 2026). Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 22 November 2016 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a compact café on the Takase River near Hotel Marufuku, windows that open to the water and the birds, chairs designed by students of Kyoto University of Art and Design, friendly staff, and beans for sale. A May 2026 regular since opening notes that the cherry tree in front is gone and new young trees have been planted along the river.
chef_bio.specialty: Takase River blend; pizza toast.

anecdotes.text: "When you fully open the windows, you’re greeted by the sparkling water surface and a beautiful tree-lined street right in front of you." — February 2026.
A regular since opening, May 2026: "I was disappointed to see that the beautiful cherry tree in front is gone."
July 2026: the Kikuhama blend’s bitterness was milder than this lover of strong coffee hoped — next time, the Marufuku blend "which uses 1.5 times the usual amount of beans."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (murmur-coffee.com、リニューアル中): murmur coffee kyoto (マーマーコーヒー京都)、下京区正面通高瀬角、営業時間 9:00〜17:00、定休日 日曜 (不定休あり)。食べログ: カフェ、京阪七条駅から徒歩10分、火〜金 9:00〜18:00、土 9:00〜17:00、日月祝休み、予約不可、14席、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX)・電子マネー・QR可、2016年11月22日オープン。口コミ (2026年2月〜9月、英語): 高瀬川沿い、窓を開けると川と並木、Kyoto University of Art and Design の学生がデザインした椅子、Hotel Marufuku の近く、マーマーブレンド、高瀬川ブレンド、Kikuhama ブレンド、豆1.5倍の Marufuku ブレンド、コーヒーとビスケットで500円以下、アイスコーヒー、アイスカフェオレ、ココア、ピザトースト、抹茶と黒豆のパウンドケーキ、豆の販売、前の桜の木がなくなったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; a quiet riverside room.

places.name: SAGAN
places.gf_detail: Ask: the Japanese breakfast sets of rice, miso soup and pickles may suit, but muffins, bread, burgers and tiramisu are wheat-based (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg dishes, salmon, bacon, hamburg steak and dashi miso soup (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 8:00–21:00; hours may change. Reservations through its online booking page; at breakfast there can be a wait list (May 2026). Order by mobile, then pay in advance at the register (August 2026). 75 seats — 12 in the café, 12 in an inner room, 50 in a party room — plus a terrace; non-smoking; cards, transit IC and most QR. Run by 株式会社S (official site).
places.neighborhood: Rokuhara on Matsubara-dori, Higashiyama — 10 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: An all-day café in a renovated house with its own ceramics: Kyoto breakfasts and muffins (official site; reviews) · breakfast: rice-ball set with 西利 pickles ¥1,210, Japanese set ¥660 with rice, miso soup and pickles, plus sides — tamagoyaki ¥440, grilled salmon ¥495, fried egg, bacon; tamago-kake-gohan (September 2025; May and August 2026) · muffins ¥324 to take out (walnut, chocolate-chip banana, hojicha raisin, matcha white chocolate, salted kombu), muffin set ¥700 (2025–2026 reviews) · hamburg steak, a burger, namul and dashimaki set, hojicha tiramisu with Tanba black beans (2026 reviews) · fresh grape juice ¥700 (September 2025)
places.notes: [Café · Rokuhara on Matsubara-dori, Kyoto breakfasts and muffins] An airy all-day café in a renovated house near Kiyomizu-Gojo, open from 8 am, serving Kyoto breakfasts of rice, pickles and miso soup with a choice of sides, then burgers and hamburg steak, plus moist muffins to take away — on its own sturdy ceramics. Very popular with visitors from abroad; expect a wait at breakfast. One diner disliked the mobile-order-then-pay system and the clanking concrete chairs (August 2026).

roles: Run by 株式会社S (official site); chef not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "Kyoto Rokuhara CAFE SAGAN," run by 株式会社S under the line "less is more," with its own ceramics line (SABOTEN), kintsugi repairs, a news-paper-style menu and online booking; mobile ordering since April 2025. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a renovated house with an open entrance, terrace seats, glass tables and minimal walls, and a clientele that is about 80% visitors from abroad (May 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「LESS IS MORE」.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto breakfast set; muffins.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "after placing a mobile order, you have to go to the register to pay in advance" — and the concrete chairs "make a metallic sound" when people stand.
September 2026: the menu "reminiscent of an English newspaper," and a staff member who "was bright and had a charming smile."
At 9 am on a weekday in May 2026, six groups were ahead and the quoted wait was 40 minutes, but many did not answer the call, so it took about 15.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sagankyoto.com): 京都 六波羅 CAFE SAGAN、株式会社S、LESS IS MORE、フード・ドリンク・マフィンセット・パン、新聞風のメニュー、器の SABOTEN、金継ぎ、予約はオンライン、2025年4月からモバイルオーダー。食べログ: カフェ・パン、東山区松原通大和大路東入2丁目轆轤町93、清水五条駅から徒歩10分、毎日 8:00〜21:00、75席 (カフェ12、奥の部屋12、パーティールーム50)、テラス、禁煙、カード・交通系IC・QR可。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年11月、英語): 西利の漬物のおにぎりセット1,210円、和定食660円、だし巻き440円、焼き鮭495円、目玉焼き、ベーコン、卵かけご飯、マフィン324円 (くるみ、チョコチップバナナ、ほうじ茶レーズン、抹茶ホワイトチョコ、塩昆布)、マフィンセット700円、ハンバーグ、バーガー、ナムルとだし巻きの定食、丹波黒豆のほうじ茶ティラミス、ぶどうジュース700円、外国人客が8割ほど、朝は順番待ち、モバイルオーダーのあと先にレジで支払うのが面倒、コンクリートの椅子の音が気になる、笑顔の素敵なスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: English newspaper-style menu; mobile ordering; mostly visitors from abroad (2026).

places.name: 炭火串焼とりと (Sumibi Kushiyaki Torito)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tare-glazed skewers, kara-age and cucumber tempura (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken house — skewers, tsukune, ostrich, chicken rice (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed irregularly. Even when online booking shows full, call — seats may be free (Tabelog). 25 seats at the counter and tables; non-smoking; children welcome; cards, e-money and most QR. Otoshi ¥350, not charged with set menus (Tabelog, Japanese original 「お通し３5０円(セットメニューでは頂きません)」). Founded 10 December 2001 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawabata-Marutamachi — by Jingu-Marutamachi Stn exit 4
places.cuisine: Charcoal-grilled chicken skewers since 2001, focused on chicken, charcoal, sauces and salt (Tabelog blurb) · house tsukune, Kyoto hinadori, Kyo-jidori skewers, rare cuts, ostrich (Tabelog; official site) · kara-age, salads, tempura cucumber, soboro rice bowl, clay-pot rice to finish, grilled rice balls (2026 reviews) · a wide range of sake (August 2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Kawabata-Marutamachi, chicken over charcoal since 2001] A dim, stylish chicken house right at Jingu-Marutamachi Station: charcoal skewers with rare cuts, house tsukune, ostrich, and clay-pot rice to finish, with plenty of sake. Most 2026 diners were happy; one found the service rushed and the value poor (September 2026), another found new staff slow with drinks (November 2026). ¥350 otoshi.

roles: Owner not named; sister shops 炭火串焼とりと 四条烏丸店 and sumiyaki 燈 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Founded 10 December 2001 (Tabelog). The shop’s Tabelog blurb promises to keep exploring yakitori and chicken: special tsukune, Kyoto hinadori, rare skewers and ostrich, with attention to chicken, charcoal, sauces, salt and grilling. Its site links a second Torito at Shijo-Karasuma (26026431) and a sister shop, sumiyaki 燈. Reviewers in 2026 describe a clean, dim room for dates, and an owner attentive even behind the acrylic screen (November 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Tsukune; rare chicken skewers; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "The service was incredibly fast… but honestly, it felt too rushed, as if they wanted us to leave quickly… The cost-performance ratio is poor."
Before the Okuribi in August 2026, a diner loved the tempura cucumber, tried it at home, and "the batter fell off."
November 2026: "We waited a long time for our drinks, even though they were already prepared on the counter" — a new staff member, the diner guessed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sumibi-torito.jp): 炭火串焼きとりと、京都の焼き鳥・鳥料理、川端丸太町店と四条烏丸店、姉妹店 sumiyaki 燈、京地どり串。食べログ: 焼き鳥・鍋・居酒屋、左京区丸太町通川端東入東丸太町9-5 神原ビル 1F、京阪神宮丸太町駅4番出口すぐ、毎日 17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、不定休、ネット予約が満席でも電話で問い合わせを、25席、禁煙、子供可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、お通し350円 (セットメニューでは頂かない)、2001年12月10日創業、特製つくね、京都ひな鶏、希少部位、ダチョウ、鶏・炭・たれ・塩・焼きへのこだわり。口コミ (2026年3月〜11月、英語): 炭火の香り、希少部位、唐揚げ、サラダ、きゅうりの天ぷら、そぼろ丼、土鍋ご飯、焼きおにぎり、日本酒が豊富、薄暗くデート向き、急かされるようでコスパが悪いという声 (2026年9月)、新人で飲み物が遅いという声 (2026年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and tables; book online or by phone.

places.name: いっちゃんラーメン (Icchan Ramen)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles, gyoza and soy-based soups (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork and chicken soups with chashu and jerk chicken (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday lunch 11:30–14:00 and dinner 19:00–23:00; Sunday and holidays lunch only; closed Monday (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 11 seats: 8 at the counter and one table for 3; smoking allowed except 11:30–13:30, with an ashtray outside (Tabelog). Reggae on the sound system and a Rasta-coloured entrance that hides the inside (2025 reviews). Just above the Furukawa-cho shopping street off Sanjo, 98 m from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; October 2025). Opened 23 September 2008 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama-Sanjo, by Furukawa-cho — 98 m from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto ramen with a Jamaican twist (2024–2026 reviews) · jerk-chicken ramen, the most-reordered bowl, about ¥800–850; spicy-coconut ramen and spicy coconut jerk chicken ¥1,100 (August 2026); Icchan ramen, black ramen ¥900 (July 2025), garlic ramen, tomato cold noodles in summer, jerk sausage · lunch add-on sets of chashu rice with an egg, or gyoza with small rice · Jamaican beer (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Ramen · Higashiyama-Sanjo, jerk-chicken ramen to a reggae beat] A tiny, Rasta-painted ramen counter by Higashiyama Station where the house hits are jerk-chicken ramen and a creamy, green-curry-like spicy-coconut ramen (about ¥850–1,100); regular, black and garlic bowls too. Lunch sets add chashu rice and an egg for a little more. Reggae plays, the owner is warm, and it is open late. Cash only; smoking allowed outside lunch hours. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner known as Icchan (reviews); full name not given
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 23 September 2008. Reviewers describe a reggae-themed shop with a Jamaican feel, jerk-chicken and spicy-coconut ramen alongside classic bowls, and a warm owner nicknamed Icchan.
chef_bio.specialty: Jerk-chicken ramen; spicy-coconut ramen.

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 visitor tried the spicy-coconut ramen on the strong advice of a local gentleman met at a takoyaki shop, and agreed.
A March 2025 first-timer expected green curry from the spicy-coconut ramen and found it creamy rather than hot.
An August 2025 diner chose the summer tomato cold noodles with avocado on a hot day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: いっちゃんラーメン、ラーメン・餃子、左京区南門前町542-1 湯川ビル1F、東山駅から98m、火〜土11:30〜14:00・19:00〜23:00、日祝11:30〜14:00、月曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、11席 (カウンター8、3人席1)、喫煙可 (11:30〜13:30は禁煙、店前に灰皿)、2008年9月23日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): ジャマイカ風、レゲエ、ジャークチキンラーメン800〜850円、スパイシーココナッツ、スパイシーココナッツジャークチキン1,100円 (2026年8月)、いっちゃんラーメン、ブラック900円、トマト冷麺、昼の追加セット (チャーシューご飯と卵、餃子と小ライス)。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; smoking allowed outside lunch hours.

places.name: ビストロ ラマージュ (Bistro Ramaju)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Classic French courses with sauces, pastry-wrapped fish and bread; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: classic French courses of meat, game and fish with butter sauces (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00); dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday and Thursday (open on some holidays) (Tabelog). Reservations advised. No service charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料なし」). 12 seats, up to 15 for private hire; non-smoking, with an ashtray at the entrance; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Takakura-dori north of Oshikoji, between Karasuma-Oike and Kyoto City Hall, 352 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; June 2024). Open since 1990 (September 2025 review).
places.neighborhood: Takakura-Oshikoji — 352 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Traditional French with seasonal ingredients, classic technique and many sauces; a wine list centred on full-bodied Burgundy; game such as wild duck in season (Tabelog) · lunch course ¥3,080 with appetizer, soup, a meat or fish main and dessert (September 2025) · six-dish dinner course, e.g. pork rillettes, cauliflower mousse, shrimp and prosciutto salad, roast duck, sea bream in pastry, lamb (2024–2025 reviews)
places.notes: [French · Takakura-Oshikoji, a one-chef classic bistro since 1990] A small, long-standing bistro between Karasuma-Oike and City Hall, where a veteran chef cooks and serves single-handed. Expect classic French with proper sauces: rillettes, roast duck, sea bream in pastry, and wild duck in the hunting season, with Burgundy to match. The ¥3,080 lunch course is a quiet bargain. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per a September 2025 review: chef Hiroshi Ueda has more than 40 years in French cooking alone, trained at the long-established French restaurant Toyoken in Tokyo, and has run Bistro Ramaju since 1990. Per Tabelog’s official introduction: traditional French with seasonal ingredients, classic techniques and versatile sauces, Burgundy wines and game in season, supported by many well-known regulars. A January 2026 reviewer notes the chef manages everything alone.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: classic French technique and versatile sauces to bring seasonal ingredients to life.
chef_bio.specialty: Classic French courses; game in the hunting season.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 lunch guest found the relaxed pace natural, with the chef handling everything alone.
An April 2025 birthday diner had a six-dish course of shrimp and prosciutto salad, roast duck, sea bream and lamb.
A June 2023 visitor tired of kaiseki found the 33-year-old bistro easy to enjoy as a tourist.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビストロ ラマージュ、フレンチ・ビストロ・洋食、中京区高倉通押小路上ル瓦町555-1 西村良ビル1F、烏丸御池駅から352m、12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)、18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 21:00)、水木定休 (祝日は営業の場合あり)、サービス料なし、12席 (貸切15名)、禁煙 (入口に灰皿)、カード可。公式紹介: 季節の食材、古典的な技法と多彩なソースの伝統的なフランス料理、ブルゴーニュ中心のワイン、狩猟の季節は鴨などのジビエ、著名人にも支持される老舗。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 1990年から、シェフ Hiroshi Ueda はフランス料理一筋40年以上、東京の老舗 Toyoken で修業、一人で切り盛り、ランチコース3,080円、リエット、鴨のロースト、鯛のパイ包み、仔羊。

cultural_comfort.note: A one-chef room; relaxed pace.

places.name: いまから なかじん (Imakara Nakajin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses feature fried shrimp, chicken katsu, tempura and gratin; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses built on seafood, chicken and meat (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 and dinner 18:00–20:30, Monday and Thursday–Sunday; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). Mainly courses, with occasional à la carte days (September 2024). No service charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「なし」 — the English page says a fee may be added). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; private hire possible; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Moved to Karasuma-Imadegawa: from the crossing go 20 m north, turn west, fourth door on the north side behind the bicycle parking, 37 m from Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma-Imadegawa — 37 m from Imadegawa Stn
places.cuisine: Light, Japanese-style yoshoku — "Western cooking for those aged 45 and up" — using tempura and Japanese techniques, with fried shrimp as the main dish (Tabelog) · courses of seasonal small plates, e.g. clams, firefly squid, moroko fritters, tofu with salt and olive oil, bamboo-shoot and scallop gratin, tempura of fuki buds and aosa with house uni salt, roast beef, bonito, chicken katsu, a Chinese-noodle course midway (2024–2026 reviews) · sake and wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Karasuma-Imadegawa, light Western food the Japanese way] An eight-seat counter tucked behind a bicycle park just north of Karasuma-Imadegawa, run by a couple. The theme is 'Western cooking for those aged 45 and up': fried shrimp is the star, and the courses run through seasonal small plates, gratin, tempura with house uni salt and a feather-light chicken katsu. Lunch and early dinner; cash only. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef not named; run by a couple (March 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: moved to Karasuma-Imadegawa and changed format slightly, now themed "Western cuisine for those aged 45 and up", with fried shrimp as the main dish and plenty of tempura and Japanese technique for lighter yoshoku. Reviewers say the owner previously ran a soba shop (November 2022; May 2026) and that it is run by a couple (March 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: light Western dishes that won’t leave you feeling heavy.
chef_bio.specialty: Ebi fry; chicken katsu.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 first-timer, sent by another chef, had a tempura of fuki buds and aosa with house uni salt.
A May 2026 diner finished with three pieces of chicken katsu turned into a katsu-don and still felt fine the next morning.
A May 2026 visitor nearly missed the stylish door hidden behind the bicycle parking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: いまから なかじん、洋食・日本料理、上京区烏丸今出川上る岡松町262番3号、今出川駅から37m、月・木〜日12:00〜14:30・18:00〜20:30、火水定休、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー不可、カウンター8席、貸切可、禁煙、車椅子可。公式紹介: 烏丸今出川に移転、北へ20m・西へ入り北側4軒目の駐輪場の奥、テーマは「45歳からの洋食」、メインはエビフライ、天ぷらや和の技法で軽い洋食。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営む、以前はそば屋、コース、蛤、ホタルイカ、諸子のフリット、筍と帆立のグラタン、自家製の雲丹塩の天ぷら、ローストビーフ、チキンカツ、途中の中華そば。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter, courses, cash only; hard to find.

places.name: shibaF (シバフ)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the pizza bases are made of nama-fu, which is wheat gluten (official site; Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Nama-fu itself is plant-based, but the pizzas carry cheese, cream, fish, chicken or duck; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken, useful at holiday periods (August 2026). Pizzas come with a soup (September 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 25 seats over two floors of a renovated Kyoto machiya, with nama-fu for sale on the ground floor; non-smoking; cards, transit IC and other e-money, and QR (Tabelog). On Rokkaku-dori, about 10 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (511 m) (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Rokkaku-dori, west of Karasuma — 10 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Nama-fu specialist from a Kyoto fu maker, serving pizza on bases of fresh wheat gluten — chewy inside, crisp outside, high in protein (official site; Tabelog) · e.g. smoked duck and Kujo leek with yuzu-pepper cream and black shichimi; roast Kyoto red chicken with porcini sauce; herb-oil mackerel with chopped shibazuke; shiso, lemon and shirasu; duck and Kujo leek cream; chicken-wing fritters (2026 reviews) · the shop sells many kinds of nama-fu, from mochi-fu to yuzu, sansho and cheese fu (official site)
places.notes: [Pizza · Rokkaku, pizza on fresh wheat gluten] A stylish machiya café from an Edo-period Kyoto fu maker, where the pizza bases are nama-fu — chewy, crisp-edged and lighter than dough. Toppings lean Kyoto: smoked duck with Kujo leek and yuzu-pepper cream, mackerel with shibazuke, shirasu with shiso and lemon. A soup comes alongside; buy fu to take home downstairs. Daytime only; closed Tuesday.

roles: Run by the nama-fu maker 志場商店 (official site); no chef named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 志場商店, said to date from the late Edo period, began trading in Mibu and has made Kyoto nama-fu for four generations, building a wide range in answer to Kyoto chefs’ requests; it launched shibaF as a new nama-fu restaurant to make fu an everyday food. Per Tabelog: nama-fu pizza in a renovated Kyoto machiya with counter and table seating and a retail corner.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to explore and widen what Kyoto nama-fu can be.
chef_bio.specialty: Nama-fu pizza.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family tried mackerel-with-shibazuke and shiso-lemon-shirasu pizzas.
An August 2026 pair, searching for cheese, discovered the nama-fu crust and found it lighter than regular pizza.
An August 2026 diner noted the dough firms up as it cools, a texture of its own.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (shiba-f.com): shibaF KYONAMAFU、京生麩の可能性を探り広げる、京都で生麩を作り続けてきた志場商店が立ち上げた生麩料理専門店、志場商店は江戸時代後期の創業とされ初代が壬生で商いを始め現在4代目、京都の料理人の要望に応えて増えた多彩な生麩 (もち麩、あわ麩、よもぎ麩、柚子麩、実山椒麩、チーズ麩など)、中京区西六角町105。食べログ: ピザ・カフェ、烏丸御池駅から511m、11:00〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、火曜定休、25席 (1階カウンター7とテーブル、2階カウンター4とテーブル)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、町家を改装、1階に物販。口コミ (2026年、英語): 生麩ピザ、燻製鴨と九条ねぎの柚子胡椒クリーム、京赤地鶏とポルチーニ、鯖としば漬け、大葉とレモンのしらす、手羽のフリット、スープ付き。

cultural_comfort.note: Picture menu of pizzas; retail fu downstairs.

places.name: Un Son Doux pâtisserie
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: croissants, brioche, pies and cakes; the gâteau nantais uses almond flour but is not described as wheat-free (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter- and egg-rich pastries; the bean-to-bar chocolate is described as only cacao and sugar — ask (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat and holidays 8:00–18:00; closed Sunday and Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). One person bakes and serves, so items sell out by afternoon (June 2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Mainly take-away; 2 seats in a small café corner (Tabelog; September 2026 review). A sliding door, hard to see into, north of Nijo near Teramachi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: North of Nijo near Teramachi — Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: French regional baked goods and viennoiserie: croissant ¥300, pithivier ¥460, gâteau nantais ¥400, galette dufinois ¥400, alsacien ¥380 (August 2026); brioche à tête, Lorraine with custard and cherries, apricot danish, canelé, far breton, coquillage with anchovy, chocolat moelleux (marron ¥480, October 2026), sablés and petits fours; bean-to-bar chocolate bars from Peru, Colombia and Venezuela (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Pâtisserie · north of Nijo near Teramachi] A quiet, gallery-like shop where one pâtissier bakes French regional sweets and viennoiserie — gâteau nantais, pithivier, buttery croissants — plus bean-to-bar chocolate. Mostly ¥300–500 a piece; go early, things sell out. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 6 June 2024 (Tabelog). Reviewers say one person bakes everything (June and August 2026); a June 2026 diner read that the owner trained at Au Bon Vieux Temps.
chef_bio.specialty: Gâteau nantais; pithivier.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor buying caramel was given an ice pack to keep it cool.
An August 2026 croissant fan rated it above those of Kyoto's top-100 bakeries.
An August 2026 reviewer, writing in Japanese, found that day's bakes a little dark and wanted more custard in the far breton.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Un Son Doux pâtisserie、スイーツ、中京区麸屋町通二条上る布袋屋町495-1、京都市役所前駅から488m、火〜土・祝 8:00〜18:00、日月休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2席、禁煙、2024年6月6日オープン。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語と日本語): 店主一人で焼く、午後は品薄、クロワッサン300円、ピティヴィエ460円、ガトー・ナンテ400円、アルザシアン380円、ブリオッシュ・ア・テット、ロレーヌ、カヌレ、ファーブルトン、コキヤージュ、ショコラ・モワルー (マロン480円)、サブレやプティフール、Bean to Bar のチョコレート (ペルー、コロンビア、ベネズエラ)、Au Bon Vieux Temps で修業という話、焼き色が強かったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the baked goods; take-away.

places.name: お匙 京都 (Osaji Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-koji amazake smoothies are likely wheat-free, but toppings, vegetable cakes, muffins and scones are not described (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Amazake made from Kyoto rice and koji with fruit and vegetables; toppings include honey; baked goods not described (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Monday, or the next weekday when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 16 seats at the café counter at the back of the store; take-away possible (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Inside OSAJI's concept store in a machiya north of Nijo; 7 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: North of Nijo — 7 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Fermentation-themed drinks and sweets (Tabelog): amazake smoothies of Kyoto rice and rice koji blended with seasonal fruit or vegetables — cassis and mixed berry, pineapple, beet, kabosu and basil — with toppings such as honey ginger or dried apricot; vegetable cakes, muffins, black-rice scones, a summer ice sandwich (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Fermentation café · north of Nijo] The café counter at the back of skincare brand OSAJI's first concept store, a calm, incense-scented machiya: build your own amazake smoothie from Kyoto rice koji and fruit, with a vegetable cake or scone, then browse the cosmetics. About ¥1,000–1,500. Opened April 2026; closed Monday.

roles: Café of the cosmetics brand OSAJI (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 25 April 2026 (Tabelog) as what an October 2026 reviewer calls OSAJI's first global concept store, combining cosmetics, a product-trial space and the café.
chef_bio.philosophy: A concept store offering drinks and sweets centred on fermentation (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Amazake smoothies.

anecdotes.text: Unsure what to pick, an October 2026 visitor was given seasonal recommendations and tips on local Kyoto events by the staff.
An October 2026 visitor found the smoothies distinctive enough to divide opinion, but enjoyed choosing bases and toppings.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): お匙 京都、カフェ、中京区堺町通二条上ル亀屋町172、丸太町駅から421m、10:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:30)、月曜休み (祝日の場合は翌平日)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、16席、2026年4月25日オープン、発酵を軸にしたドリンクとスイーツのカウンターのあるコンセプトストア。口コミ (2026年10月、英語): OSAJI 初のグローバルコンセプトストア、町家、お香の香り、京都の米と米麹の甘酒スムージー (カシスミックスベリー、パイナップル、ビーツ、かぼすバジル)、はちみつ生姜や干し杏のトッピング、野菜のケーキ、マフィン、黒米のスコーン、夏のアイスサンド、化粧品の売り場と体験スペース、親切なスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff help choose smoothie bases and toppings.

places.name: 夷川餃子 なかじま 団栗店 (Ebisugawa Gyoza Nakajima Donguri)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat gyoza wrappers, fried rice and yakisoba with soy-based sauces (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork gyoza, chashu, pork miso soup (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30), daily (Tabelog; official site). Bookings taken, but may be refused in the cherry-blossom and autumn-leaf seasons (Tabelog); queues of about 20 minutes on busy nights (September 2026 review). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). 31 seats: counter in front of the kitchen and tables; order on a written slip; take-out and delivery (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). The building also houses "ぎょうざ湯", a bath and sauna by reservation only, built by the sauna-loving owner so guests can have gyoza and beer after a bath (official site). 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Donguri-dori by Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Light, crisp-bottomed Kyoto gyoza — with or without garlic, filled with Kyoto pork (September 2026) — fried in a special pan; the "black" fried rice; chashu with egg, shumai, yakisoba with sauce, pork miso soup, chilled Chinese noodles in summer, peach ice candy; a gyoza lunch set; highballs and sake (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Gyoza & fried rice · by Gion-Shijo Stn] A lively counter-and-table gyoza house a minute from the station, frying light, crisp gyoza to order with dark, chewy fried rice — about ¥1,500–2,500 — and a reservation-only sauna bath in the same building. Open daily to 23:00; cash only; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 21 July 2021 (Tabelog). Per the official site: one of three なかじま shops (本店, 団栗店, 西院店); 本店 and 団栗店 each have a reservation-only bath, ぎょうざ湯, which the sauna-loving owner built to enjoy gyoza and beer after a sauna.
chef_bio.philosophy: Light, easy-eating Kyoto gyoza (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Gyoza; black fried rice.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner who had given up several times because of long lines got straight in at 20:30 for gyoza and black fried rice.
July 2026 diners laughed at the drawings on the chopstick sleeves, one featuring a celebrity's eyes.
On the last day of Silver Week 2026 a diner waited about 20 minutes outside and noted many foreign customers.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都 夷川餃子 なかじま・餃子湯、本店 (中京区西洞院通夷川下る薬師町652-1)、団栗店 (東山区団栗通大和大路西入六軒町206-1、11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:00、無休)、西院店 (立ち飲み)、本店と団栗店に完全予約制の銭湯「ぎょうざ湯」、サウナ好きの店主がサウナ上がりの餃子とビールのために作った。食べログ: 夷川餃子 なかじま 団栗店、餃子・居酒屋・食堂、どんぐり会館1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩1分、予約可 (桜と紅葉の時期は断る場合あり)、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、31席、英語メニュー、テイクアウト・デリバリー、2021年7月21日オープン。口コミ (2026年7〜9月、英語): にんにくあり・なしの餃子、京都ポークの餡、黒チャーハン、チャーシュー玉子、焼売、ソース焼きそば、豚汁、冷やし中華、桃のアイスキャンディー、箸袋の絵、伝票に記入して注文、外国人客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); order on a slip; cash only.

places.name: 京町スタンド 若旦那 (Kyomachi Stand Wakadanna)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, beef tataki and dashimaki beside ham katsu, garlic toast and fries (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, beef, dashi obanzai (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:30; Sat–Sun 13:00–23:30; hours may change (Tabelog). Happy hour until 18:00 with highballs from about ¥200–220 (September–October 2026 reviews). No bookings. Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「テーブル席は席料３００円」 — ¥300 for table seats (a September 2026 reviewer paid ¥330); the standing counter has none. No cards or e-money; QR payments (Tabelog). Standing counter on the left, about 40 table seats on the right; non-smoking, ashtray outside (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). A little south of Shijo on Takakura; 4 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; September 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Takakura just south of Shijo — 4 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Cheap standing-bar food and drink: assorted obanzai (mentaiko shirataki, stewed okara and one changing dish), wagyu tataki ¥580, assorted sashimi ¥850, wagyu senmai ¥520, dashimaki ¥380 (August 2026), meat tartare, fatty tuna, wagyu steak, ham katsu, shrimp mayo, tsukune with green pepper, crab miso, garlic toast, fries, pork soup; kaku highball, lemon chuhai, hot sake, giant beer mugs (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Standing bar · Takakura near Shijo] A big, cheerful standing bar with tables to the side, from the いなせや group: ¥220 happy-hour highballs until 18:00, obanzai trios, wagyu tataki and very fresh sashimi for well under ¥1,000 a plate. Standing is free; tables cost ¥300. Open to 23:30 daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 11 November 2020 (Tabelog). Reviewers place it in the いなせや group (August and September 2026); the group's いなせや is run by Gallant, a Kyoto restaurant operator (kyoto_tachinomi_inaseya).
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai trio; wagyu tataki; happy-hour highballs.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular takes being served a giant "baka jokki" beer as the cue to go home.
An August 2026 diner, delayed by a JR accident, came in starving for wagyu tataki, sashimi and dashimaki — all well priced.
An October 2026 guest who knows いなせや in Osaka found the Kyoto flavours quite different, and dipped shrimp mayo in the tsukune sauce.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京町スタンド 若旦那、立ち飲み、下京区綾材木町188-2、烏丸駅から274m、月〜金 16:00〜23:30、土日 13:00〜23:30、予約不可、テーブル席は席料300円、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、カウンター20・テーブル40、禁煙 (入口前に灰皿)、2020年11月11日オープン。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年10月、英語): いなせやグループ、四条から高倉通を少し南、18時までのハッピーアワーで角ハイ220円ほど、おばんざい盛り (明太しらたき、おから、日替わり)、和牛たたき580円、刺身盛り850円、和牛生センマイ520円、だし巻き380円、ユッケ、ハムカツ、海老マヨ、つくねとピーマン、カニ味噌、ガーリックトースト、席料330円だったという声、バカジョッキ。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing counter or tables (¥300); no bookings.

places.name: 月と六ペンス (Tsuki to Rokupensu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee with toast, sandwiches and croque monsieur (2018–25 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Coffee, café au lait and hot milk, cheese and sardine sandwiches (2018–25 reviews); no vegan information.
places.hours_raw: MEMBERS ONLY: Tabelog states the café is now members-only and is not accepting new membership applications. Earlier, membership was open by registering a name (February 2025) or by Instagram message (May 2025). Wed–Sat 12:00–20:00; closed Sunday–Tuesday and holidays (Tabelog). No reservations; cash only (Tabelog). A stay of 1–3 hours cost ¥1,000 with one drink (April 2024). No talking and no computers (Tabelog; 2017–25 reviews). 17 counter seats, up a narrow stair on the 2nd floor of 杉野ビル on Nijo west of Takakura (Tabelog; October 2018). Opened 8 September 2008 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo Takakura — 392 m from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: A silent reading café with shelves of books (2017–25 reviews) · deep-roast coffee ¥480 (February 2017), café au lait, iced coffee, hot milk (2018–25 reviews) · fruit sandwich ¥600 (April 2024), Camembert and mushroom sandwich (October 2018), oil-sardine sandwich (February 2025), honey cinnamon toast (May 2025), croque monsieur and toast; drinks and toast at ¥400 a size (February 2025) · beer and wine (February 2025)
places.notes: [Reading café · Nijo Takakura, members only and silent] A book-lined second-floor counter where no one talks and laptops are banned: deep-roast coffee, café au lait and toast or sandwiches while you read. Now members-only, and Tabelog says no new members are being accepted, so most visitors cannot get in. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café opened 8 September 2008 that has since become members-only and no longer accepts new applications. A February 2025 visitor described an owner devoted to books and coffee who wants to keep the space undisturbed.
chef_bio.philosophy: A quiet space for reading and thinking alone (2017–25 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Coffee and toast in silence.

anecdotes.text: A November 2024 visitor, after years of finding it closed, asked about membership and was let in.
A November 2020 visitor found it quieter than a music café — even whispering felt awkward.
A February 2025 visitor praised a bookshelf full of titles worth picking up, unlike shallow "book cafés".

anecdotes.text: A January 2022 visitor arrived at 11:00 before the noren was up; the owner came out and opened up, then offered as much saba sushi as wanted while the steamed sushi cooked.
A December 2024 diner shared Osaka-style and saba sushi with a 91-year-old mother.
A March 2025 visitor, nervous at a sushi counter, relaxed on seeing locals and foreigners already there, and was moved by the nori in the rolls.

places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station Building East Zone — 1 min from Kyoto Stn

places.notes: [Soba izakaya · Kyoto Station Building, a big room by the Kyoto Theatre] A 200-plus-seat soba tavern a minute from the platforms: soba made daily from domestic buckwheat, tempura of Kyoto vegetables, fresh yuba and nama-fu dengaku, with private rooms for groups and plenty of sake. Open 11:00 to late every day — handy before a train. One diner found the soba dipping sauce ordinary.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a soba tavern in the Kyoto Station Building serving soba made in-house daily from domestic buckwheat, with the flour varied by season, and Kyoto dishes; about 220 seats with sunken tatami and table seating and private rooms for 6, 18, 36 and more. Opened 1 August 2015 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: House-made soba; yuba and nama-fu dishes.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner found the zaru soba dipping sauce tasted bought-in, but the soba good enough not to mind.
An October 2026 visitor, expecting little from a station restaurant at a quiet lunch, was won over by the rolled omelette and the kitsune soba.
An October 2026 group drank bottled beer from chilled aluminium cups whose blue line appears as the beer gets colder.

places.notes: [Edomae sushi · Karasuma Shichijo, an omakase counter by Kyoto Stn] A calm Edomae counter four minutes from Kyoto Stn, by a chef from an Akasaka Michelin-starred shop: corn tofu, yuzu-scented ikura rice, sea-bream shuto chawanmushi, then nigiri — lunch from ¥9,800, a weekday nigiri course at ¥14,000. chef_bio.specialty: Omakase nigiri course.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner found the chef friendly and chatting in English with overseas guests.
A July 2026 diner liked the ideas but found the masunosuke marinade a little dry and the corn tofu not quite smooth.
An October 2026 family booked a private room so a child could come along to the ¥9,800 lunch omakase.

places.notes: [Soba · Mibu by Shijo Omiya, 100% buckwheat] A twelve-seat soba shop where a single chef makes juwari soba by hand from freshly ground buckwheat: sweet, fragrant and firm, good even with just salt, with a sharp bonito tsuyu, real wasabi and a thick soba-yu. Try the soba-gaki or tororo soba, and sake in the evening. Some find the noodles a touch dry or short. Cash only; closed Monday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), who runs the shop alone (September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a soba shop with a sake list near Shijo Omiya; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 describe 100% buckwheat soba handmade from freshly ground flour by a single chef (June and September 2026), with more sake to pair in the evenings (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Juwari soba; soba-gaki.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor had assumed the name was read "Ju-an" before learning it is "Ki An".
A seven-time regular, craving something cold in the summer heat, chose Ki An over chilled ramen (July 2026).
After the lunch rush in September 2026, a second-lunch guest finally got the soba-gaki that is hard to order when busy.

places.notes: [Oyakodon · Kawabata Marutamachi, near Kyoto University] A long-loved machiya-front chicken shop by Jingu-Marutamachi, its walls hung with signed boards: a soft, rich oyakodon under a deep-orange yolk, with fine sansho to shake on, plus tsukune, chicken nanban, katsu and duck soba sets. Packed with locals at lunch. One November 2026 guest found the dashi light and the chicken sparse. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: chicken dishes, oyakodon and nabe near Jingu-Marutamachi. Reviewers in 2026 call it a long-established chicken restaurant cherished by locals and repeat customers, featured in the media, with signed boards on the walls — one bearing a Nobel laureate's name, given the nearby university (May 2026) — and a lore that renowned doctors from the university hospital were regulars (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Oyakodon; tsukune.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor spotted a Nobel Prize winner's name among the signed boards on the walls.
In July 2026 a card-terminal fault meant cash only for the day, posted clearly outside so guests could check before entering.
A September 2026 father, worn out after Byodoin and Fushimi Inari, found the chicken katsu set "looked like a golden meadow".

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain teas suit, but sweets and lattes use dairy, eggs and chocolate; no vegan information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); Saturday–Sunday 11:00–20:00 (last order 19:30); closed on irregular days; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and common (Tabelog; July and November 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Counter on the 1F, sofa seats upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; July 2026). Staff speak fluent English (May 2026). A Gion townhouse over 120 years old; about 6 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 11 January 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, south of Shijo — 6 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese tea café of the tea merchant Kitagawa Hanbee, founded 1861 (Tabelog) · the "Chayomi" tasting ¥2,900: five teas — matcha, sencha, hojicha, Japanese oolong, Japanese black tea — each with a paired bite such as chocolate, nuts or matcha cake (July and October 2026) · matcha kakigori with a drink, tea parfait, matcha and hojicha drinks, cake sets about ¥1,900 (pistachio-cacao, chocolate, matcha rare cheesecake), green-tea latte, ice cream (May–November 2026) · sencha brewed twice, at 70 and 90 degrees (+¥100) (October 2026) · tea leaves to buy from ¥1,300 per 50 g (July 2026) · about ¥2,000–3,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Tea café · Gion townhouse, open into the evening] A hushed, earthen-walled tea house in a 120-year-old Gion townhouse, run by an 1861 tea merchant: the Chayomi tasting of five teas, each with a paired sweet, matcha kakigori, tea parfaits, and sencha brewed at two temperatures; sofa seats upstairs and English-speaking staff. Lovely space; some find it pricey and the pairing cakes uneven. Open to 20:00 at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 11 January 2018, a Japanese café specialising in tea from Kitagawa Hanbee, a tea merchant established in 1861, offering Japanese tea and sweets. Reviewers in 2026 describe a townhouse over 120 years old (July 2026), attentive staff who refill water and adjust the air conditioning unasked, and fluent English (May 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Japanese tea paired with sweets (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Chayomi tea tasting.

anecdotes.text: In May 2026 a staff member, seeing guests fanning away the heat, offered more water and to turn down the air conditioning.
An October 2026 visitor found the iced teas noticeably weaker than the hot ones, and some pairing sweets too strong for the tea.
A November 2026 couple, diverted from a closed cake shop on Hanamikoji, found the ¥1,900 cake sets hard and not worth the price.

Reservations accepted, including online (Tabelog; August 2026). places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori east of Horikawa — 5 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Teppan yakiniku and teppan dishes (Tabelog) · signature koto-yaki: choose beef, chicken or seafood, steamed on the teppan with lots of cabbage, with a recommended sauce such as a sweet-spicy miso (July 2025) · koto-yaki of beef tendon and tracheal cartilage with rice (December 2024) · outside skirt, ajillo, yakisoba, kimchi fried rice (2024–2025) · cabbage omelette (June 2025) · offal soup, konnyaku dengaku, stir-fries (April 2025) · weekday lunch: yakisoba set with rice and miso soup (September 2025); daily set such as shrimp chilli with miso soup and a side, under ¥1,000; salted fries (August 2026)
places.notes: [Teppan yakiniku · Shijo-Horikawa, lively and good value] A big, cheerful teppan room on Shijo-dori where meat, offal or seafood is steamed with mounds of cabbage on the griddle (the house koto-yaki), alongside yakisoba, kimchi fried rice and cabbage omelette. Weekday lunch sets under ¥1,000; dinner about ¥4,000–6,000. Friendly, attentive staff; solo diners welcome; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Invoice T6130001051569 is registered to 株式会社いろはコーポレーション, of Kita-ku, Kyoto (NTA register). A December 2024 reviewer believed the shop used to be called “Arata” and had eaten at an Arata at Hachijo-guchi. Reviewers praise energetic, friendly staff who notice empty glasses (2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Koto-yaki; teppan yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 solo diner was surprised to find other solo diners, including foreigners, at the counter after work.
A September 2025 visitor came for the yakisoba after watching a TV special on it the day before.

places.name: Artisan TEPPAN RESTAURANT
places.gf_detail: Ask. A small-plate teppan course with Italian technique — gnocchi, tartine, zeppole, capellini, ravioli, puff pastry — so most courses contain wheat; meat and seafood plates may be adaptable (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of seafood, Omi beef and Wagyu consommé (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30, dinner 17:00–23:00 daily; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; guests with children are asked to book a private room (Tabelog); an August 2026 diner confirmed children are welcome. From 11 July 2026 a 10% service charge is added (Tabelog, original ※2026年7月11日以降、ご飲食代とは別途サービス料10％を頂戴いたします。). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 22 seats: 10 at the counter and two private rooms (one tatami for 4, one table room for 8); private rooms need a ¥40,000 minimum (Tabelog; August 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Ground floor of The Park Residence Kyoto Ekimae, 5 min from Shichijo Stn and 10 min from Kyoto Station (Tabelog). Opened July 2025 (July 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Near Shichijo-dori, between Kyoto Station and Shichijo Stn
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki served as many small dishes with Italian technique (2026 reviews) · Artisan Course ¥13,000: gnocchi, tartine and zeppole to start; spear squid with capellini; scallops and firefly squid; clams with new onion; shiitake and Kita Akari potatoes; ravioli in Wagyu consommé; puff pastry; a large herb salad; seasonal seafood such as abalone; Omi beef chosen by the chef from the producer (May–July 2026) · anniversary course (July 2026) · garlic rice as an extra (July 2026)
places.notes: [Teppan course · near Shichijo, Italian-trained chef] A white, calm teppan counter with two private rooms a short walk from Kyoto Station, where the chef cooks a long run of small plates with Italian technique — gnocchi, capellini, ravioli in Wagyu consommé, abalone, then Omi beef — for about ¥13,000. Good for anniversaries; children in the private rooms. 10% service charge since July 2026.

chef_bio.background: A July 2026 reviewer names the chef as Shinohara, who “trained for three years at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Italy”, and says the chef visited Omi beef producers to choose animals by lineage; the same reviewer dates the opening to July 2025. Invoice T3040001120567 is registered to 株式会社ｐａｎｇａｅａ of Minato-ku, Tokyo (NTA register). A July 2026 couple found the chef very kind and talkative.
chef_bio.philosophy: Italian technique blended with teppan-yaki, one small dish at a time (July 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Small-plate teppan course; Omi beef.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 guest celebrating a partner’s birthday on the anniversary course added garlic rice and called it exceptional.
A May 2026 family celebrated an anniversary in a private room and praised the timing of the service.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: liver, meat stew, sashimi, crab and oden (2026 reviews).

Standing places cannot be booked (Tabelog). Drinks may be brought when the second floor is reserved (October 2026). In a renovated machiya down an alley, 5 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn, near Nishiki Market and Daimaru (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 16 January 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Alley near Nishiki Market, east of Karasuma — 5 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Standing-bar snacks with care and style, and plenty of sake (2026 reviews) · grilled white liver ¥490, the most popular dish (September 2026) · four-appetizer platter for solo drinkers ¥790; solo platter with crab-miso pasta salad, nut salad and hamachi and yokowa sashimi (September 2026) · signature meat stew; luxurious crab-miso salad (September 2026) · charcoal-grilled chicken thigh with yuzu pepper (September 2026) · oden and grilled dishes; a wide range of Japanese sake (October 2026)
places.notes: [Standing bar · machiya off Nishiki near Karasuma] A popular standing bar in a renovated townhouse down an alley, with a U-shaped counter and young, energetic staff: grilled white liver (¥490), a four-snack solo platter (¥790), crab-miso salad, meat stew, oden and lots of sake. Opens at 15:00 and fills fast; the upstairs room is for booked banquet courses only. PayPay or cash.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. A September 2026 reviewer describes young staff running the bar with lots of energy; another was invited by a neighbouring shopkeeper.
chef_bio.specialty: Grilled white liver; meat stew.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 reviewer stopped in after the Omusubi Festival at Yoshida Shrine and a visit to a sake shop.
A September 2026 diner was still thinking about the grilled white liver the next day.

places.name: アポロプラス (Apollo+)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A wide izakaya menu — sashimi, Kyoto vegetable salad, mentaiko pasta, homemade gyoza, fried conger eel, agedashi, Wagyu cutlet and sirloin sandwich; no gluten information (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and meat dishes; the vegetable dishes (caprese, tomato and avocado, agedashi) are not described (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks 23:30), Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday, 31 December and 1 January, plus a monthly two-day break (27–28 October and 17–18 November 2026) (Tabelog). places.neighborhood: Sanjo-dori east of Sakaimachi — 6 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: An izakaya going beyond the usual: sashimi platter, Kyoto vegetable salad, mentaiko pasta, homemade gyoza; Kyoto and national sakes including an Ozeki junmai daiginjo namagenshu on keg (Tabelog shop text) · caprese ¥990, agedashi tofu ¥660, Kuroge Wagyu cutlet with cream sauce ¥3,900, homemade fruit sour ¥770, sashimi at market price (August 2026) · fried conger eel with tartar and plum, “The Only Pasta”, agedashi eggplant, tonkatsu, ume onigiri, assorted sweets (August 2026) · grilled conger eel, roast beef (September 2026) · tomato and avocado with breadcrumbs and balsamic (September 2026) · sirloin sandwich (October 2026) · free-drink courses of 120 minutes (September 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Sanjo-Sakaimachi, hideaway rooms] A two-floor creative izakaya with sofa corners and semi-private “hideout” rooms, run by a chef who trained at a high-end restaurant: sashimi, Wagyu cutlet in cream sauce, sirloin sandwich, homemade gyoza, mentaiko pasta, plus Kyoto sakes. About ¥6,000–8,000 a head. ¥390 service charge each; closed Mondays and two days a month.

chef_bio.background: An October 2026 regular writes that “the owner and chef, who trained at a high-end restaurant, creates dishes that are simply outstanding.” Invoice T9130002003657 is registered to 有限会社クロスポイント (NTA register). A September 2026 diner found the 120-minute free-drink limit ran out before the food; an October 2026 guest was handed a card slip instead of a receipt.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Uncompromising attention to detail, going beyond the typical izakaya fare” (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi; Wagyu cutlet; homemade gyoza.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 group of four booked a second-floor private room with sunken kotatsu seating for a night out.
A September 2026 diner ordered the grilled conger eel twice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: アポロプラス、居酒屋・魚介料理・ステーキ、中京区三条堺町東入ル桝屋町67 NEOD三条 2F・3F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩6分、火〜日 17:00〜24:00 (料理L.O.23:00、ドリンクL.O.23:30)、月曜定休、12月31日・1月1日休み、月に一度の連休 (10月27・28日、11月17・18日)、予約可、サービス料390円 (12月29日〜1月3日は590円)、カード・QR可、55席 (カウンター、ソファ、座敷、掘りごたつ)、個室4〜6名、20名までの宴会、禁煙、適格請求書 T9130002003657 (有限会社クロスポイント)。店の紹介: 刺身の盛り合わせ、京野菜のサラダ、明太子パスタ、自家製餃子、Ozeki の純米大吟醸生原酒の樽、京都と全国の地酒。口コミ (2026年、英語): 高級店で修業した店主兼料理人、黒毛和牛のカツとクリームソース3,900円、カプレーゼ990円、揚げ出し豆腐660円、穴子の唐揚げ、サーロインサンド、半個室が隠れ家のよう、個室へは階段のみ。

roles: Run by a couple, not named (October 2026); "the master" (July 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened at this address on 12 October 2023 (Tabelog); a June 2026 diner says it had moved and been renovated, now with ten counter seats and two tables on a wooden floor. chef_bio.specialty: Motsu nikomi; pork miso soup set.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: the raw egg for the tamago-kake-gohan arrived broken, and "the couple running the place seems friendly, but they don’t pay much attention to the customers and are more focused on chatting among themselves."
A July 2026 walk-in during the Gion Matsuri found "the master was out participating in the Gion Matsuri," so the menu was a little different — still delicious.
July 2026: the gyoza were "a bit tough; I wish the skin was thinner," but the closing curry "might even surpass the curry from a dedicated curry shop."
