places.name: 58DINER
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: burgers on house-baked buns and fries from a shared fryer are likely (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the menu is beef burgers, steak and bacon (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun and holidays 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Monday (or the next day after a Monday holiday); a February 2026 diner notes weekends and holidays sometimes run to 23:00. Orders by tablet (October 2025; February 2026). 32 seats over two floors; non-smoking; English and Chinese menus, English-speaking staff; children welcome; cards and PayPay. Busy at lunch and during events at Miyakomesse or ROHM Theatre; a wait when full (2025–2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, near Heian Shrine and ROHM Theatre — about 6 min walk from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: An American West Coast-style diner of burgers and steak (Tabelog blurb) · burgers of 100% beef on buns baked in-house each day, pickles with home-grown herbs: 58 cheeseburger, monthly burger set ¥1,680, craft bacon burger set ¥1,840, Hungry Burger about ¥1,500, a wagyu "Umami" burger with tororo kombu, avocado burger; drink with a set +¥400 (2025–2026 reviews) · spiced curry; large fries; Kyoto craft beer and draft beer in a mug (2025–2026 reviews) · dinner steak course from ¥2,200; BBQ course for 4–5 (Tabelog blurb)
places.notes: [Burgers · Okazaki near Heian Shrine, a West Coast diner] A two-floor American diner behind Heian Shrine, handy after the museums or a show at ROHM Theatre: thick 100%-beef burgers on house-baked buns, a monthly burger, a wagyu burger with tororo kombu, big plates of fries, and a steak course at night. Order by tablet; expect a wait at lunch. English menu. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: The shop’s Tabelog blurb promises American food made with "LOVE" near Heian Shrine: 100% beef patties, pickles marinated with herbs it grows, buns baked daily in-house, a steak course from ¥2,200 and BBQ courses. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a classic American-movie interior over two floors, tablet ordering, regulars mixed with tourists, and crowds when Miyakomesse or ROHM Theatre has an event.
chef_bio.specialty: House-bun burgers; monthly burger.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: a "Large French Fries" order "seemed perfect for sharing among several people" — too much for a pre-show snack alone; mobile signal was weak at the back.
February 2026: a diner who came for burgers tried the curry instead — "packed with spices and incredibly delicious!"

No service charge or cover — Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料、チャージ共に無し」. 26 seats — 16 at tables plus private rooms for 3 and 6; private hire for 10–16 by phone; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome with a kids’ menu; cards. Even when online booking shows full, call. Opened 1 December 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Tominokoji just south of Marutamachi, near the Imperial Palace — about 8 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: French courses in a Kyoto machiya built on organic vegetables from contract farmers in Sonobe (January 2026) · lunch course of six dishes ¥5,500 (January 2026); ¥5,000 with one drink via a booking site (August 2026); dinner course ¥11,000 (September 2026) · seen: Sonobe vegetable consommé, a "milk glass cocktail" of rice-koji milk jelly, goat’s-milk jelly with spinach and ikura, saffron and carrot potages, a taiyaki-shaped pastry filled with sea bream or akou with sauce américaine, low-temperature roast duck, charcoal-grilled pork shoulder in Bordeaux sauce, fruit cakes, canelés, French bread imported from France (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [French · Tominokoji near the Imperial Palace, organic Sonobe vegetables] A quiet machiya French restaurant just south of Marutamachi: chef Okumura’s colourful courses of Sonobe organic vegetables — a "meadow" in a cocktail glass, a taiyaki-shaped fish pie, roast duck — from ¥5,500 at lunch and ¥11,000 at dinner, with private rooms upstairs. Gluten-free and vegan requests listed on Tabelog. One diner found the fish sauce thin and salty (May 2026). No service charge. Closed Monday.

roles: Chef (named in a January 2026 review); a female staff member makes the desserts (March 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 December 2019 (Tabelog). A January 2026 diner describes a white-and-wood machiya, organic vegetables and seasonal ingredients from contract farmers in Sonobe, Kyoto, and chef Okumura plating each course with care. Other 2026 reviewers mention classical music, a friendly chef, a female staff member in charge of desserts, private rooms on the second floor, and French bread said to be imported from France.
chef_bio.specialty: Taiyaki-shaped fish pie; Sonobe vegetable consommé.

anecdotes.text: January 2026: the rice-koji "milk glass cocktail" — "It felt like a different world inside the glass."
May 2026: "The pie shaped like a tai (sea bream) was a bit disappointing as the fish was upside down…(^_^;)" and the sauce was thin and salty — but the roast duck was the highlight.
September 2026: "what stood out the most was the French bread. It is said to be directly imported from France."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 富小路 信、フレンチ、中京区富小路通丸太町下ル桝屋町337、丸太町駅1番出口から徒歩約8分、昼 11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 13:30)、夜 18:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、月曜休み、サービス料・チャージ共に無し、26席 (テーブル16、個室3名・6名)、10〜16名で貸切、禁煙、車椅子可、子供可 (お子様メニューあり)、カード可、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリー対応、2019年12月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年1月〜9月、英語): 町家、京都園部の契約農家の有機野菜、シェフ Okumura、ランチコース6品5,500円、一休でドリンク付き5,000円、ディナー11,000円、園部の野菜のコンソメ、米麹のミルクグラスカクテル、山羊乳のゼリーとほうれん草といくら、サフランや人参のポタージュ、鯛やアコウのたい焼き風パイ包み (アメリケーヌソース)、低温ローストの鴨、豚肩ロースの炭火焼きボルドーソース、果物のケーキ、カヌレ、フランスから取り寄せるパン、デザートは女性スタッフ、2階の個室、鯛が逆さで塩気の強いソースという声、味は普通という声。

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based dishes, sashimi, egg dishes, beef and pork (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30, last entry 13:00), dinner 17:30–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Wednesday; updates on Instagram. Lunch is one set only, booking advised (September 2026). Otoshi ¥600 (Tabelog, Japanese original 「おつきだしとして600円」). 25 seats — counter on the ground floor and tables upstairs, reached by steep machiya stairs; non-smoking; menus in English, Chinese and Korean with photos; children welcome; cards, transit IC and most QR. Opened 14 May 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Gojo Stn — 5 min walk
places.cuisine: Japanese cooking and sake in a renovated machiya (2026 reviews) · lunch "Ichirin Gozen" ¥2,500: five obanzai, dashimaki, grilled fish, sashimi, tempura, chawanmushi, chirimen-sansho rice with refills, miso soup (2026 reviews) · dinner: sashimi platter of five or six fish, hamo tempura, Saikyo-miso potato salad, braised pork, 尾崎牛, clay-pot rice, water eggplant and Manganji peppers in season (2025–2026 reviews) · a wide range of regional sake (July 2026)
places.notes: [Japanese & sake · near Gojo Station, a machiya with a ¥2,500 lunch] A machiya near Gojo Station opened in 2025: a ¥2,500 lunch tray of obanzai, sashimi, tempura and chawanmushi with refillable jako rice, and at night sashimi, hamo tempura, 尾崎牛 and a Saikyo-miso potato salad people rave about, with plenty of sake. One diner found the otoshi and sake a little dear; mind the steep stairs. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef, not named; previously worked at a shop called Tsugu (August 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 14 May 2025 (Tabelog). An August 2026 regular says it was opened by someone who used to work at a place called Tsugu, "a very warm and kind person." Reviewers describe a renovated Kyoto machiya with a counter in front of the kitchen, tables upstairs, an owner directing young staff who work efficiently (July 2026), and a chef one diner called kind and handsome (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Ichirin Gozen lunch; Saikyo-miso potato salad.

anecdotes.text: A five-time regular, September 2026: "Those steep stairs in a traditional Kyoto townhouse... be careful when using the second-floor seating on your way out! (laughs)"
July 2026: the owner gave precise instructions to young staff who moved efficiently — but "the prices for the appetizers and Japanese sake were a bit high."
"The chef seemed like a kind and handsome guy!" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 一凛、日本料理、下京区室町新町之間松原下ル徳万町209-2、五条駅から徒歩5分、昼 11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30、最終入店13:00)、夜 17:30〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00、ドリンク L.O. 22:30)、水曜休み、Instagram で告知、おつきだし600円、25席、禁煙、英語・繁体字・簡体字・韓国語のメニュー、写真付き、子供可、カード・交通系IC・QR可、2025年5月14日オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 町家、1階カウンターと2階のテーブル、急な階段、昼は一凛御膳2,500円のみ (おばんざい5種、だし巻き、焼き魚、お造り、天ぷら、茶碗蒸し、ちりめん山椒のご飯おかわり可、味噌汁)、夜はお造りの盛り合わせ、鱧の天ぷら、西京味噌のポテトサラダ、豚の角煮、尾崎牛、土鍋ご飯、水茄子、万願寺とうがらし、日本酒が豊富、Tsugu という店で働いていた人が開いた、若いスタッフへの的確な指示、つきだしと日本酒はやや高めという声、優しくてかっこいい料理人という声。

places.name: 琥珀 (Kohaku, Park Hyatt Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail and whisky bar with light food; no gluten information is published (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A cocktail bar; no food or vegan information is published (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: 16:00–24:00 daily (last order 23:30); closed when the hotel requires (Tabelog). Service charge 15% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料15％」). Non-staying guests pay a cover charge of about ¥2,750–2,850 per person and a minimum spend of about ¥6,000–6,600; hotel guests pay no table charge (2025–2026 reviews). Bookings recommended; it fills with overseas visitors (September 2026). 16 seats at a U-shaped counter facing the view; non-smoking, smoking area in the hotel; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); hotel valet parking ¥2,000 for up to 4 hours with a restaurant visit (Tabelog). On the 4th floor of Park Hyatt Kyoto, on the hill near Kodaiji, 964 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama, Park Hyatt Kyoto — near Kodaiji and the Yasaka pagoda
places.cuisine: Hotel bar with original cocktails by skilled bartenders, rare Japanese whiskies and the house craft gin "KI NO BI Seiryu" made with The Kyoto Distillery (Tabelog) · selections from the hotel’s wine bar, e.g. the "Kyoto Tradition" cocktails (December 2023) · from about ¥10,000–15,000 a head for non-staying guests with the cover and minimum (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bar · Higashiyama, Park Hyatt Kyoto's view of the Yasaka pagoda] The Park Hyatt's 16-seat U-shaped bar, high on the Higashiyama slope, where the floodlit five-storey Yasaka pagoda fills the window — come at sunset. Cocktails, rare Japanese whiskies and a house KI NO BI gin. Outside guests pay a cover (about ¥2,800) and a minimum spend (about ¥6,000) plus 15% service, so expect ¥10,000+. Book ahead.

roles: Hotel bar of Park Hyatt Kyoto; bartenders not named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: the bar of Park Hyatt Kyoto, with views of the city and the historic five-storey pagoda, original cocktails from skilled bartenders, rare Japanese whiskies and an original craft gin made with The Kyoto Distillery. The hotel’s 八坂 and KYOTO BISTRO are separate records.
chef_bio.specialty: Cocktails with a view of the Yasaka pagoda.

anecdotes.text: A November 2022 visitor recommends coming at sunset, when the bar opens.
An August 2026 guest found the bar fully booked with mostly overseas visitors and only one bartender, so drinks came slowly.
A January 2026 visitor noted that the cover charge and minimum spend push a visit past ¥10,000 but make booking easier.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 琥珀、バー、東山区高台寺桝屋町360 パークハイアット京都4F、祇園四条駅から964m、16:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、ホテルの営業に準じた休み、サービス料15%、16席 (カウンター)、禁煙 (ホテル内に喫煙所)、カード可、バレーパーキング (レストラン利用で4時間2,000円)。公式紹介: 街並みと五重塔を望む眺め、熟練のバーテンダーのオリジナルカクテル、希少なジャパニーズウイスキー、京都蒸溜所と造ったオリジナルクラフトジン。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 八坂の塔の眺め、夕暮れがおすすめ、U字カウンター、宿泊者以外はカバーチャージ2,750〜2,850円と最低6,000〜6,600円、海外からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel bar; mostly overseas guests.

places.name: lapintaika (ラピンタイカ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta-centred Italian with appetizer platters and braises; no gluten information is published (reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Meat and seafood dominate; nothing vegan is marked (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Dinner 18:00–22:00, Tuesday–Sunday; lunch on Saturday and Sunday by reservation only; closed Monday (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 18 seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). An easy-to-miss entrance on Higashioji near Sanjo, 265 m from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; December 2023). Opened 21 November 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashioji near Sanjo — 265 m from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: Pasta-focused Italian à la carte with a natural-wine list, run by one chef (2023–2026 reviews) · generous appetizer platters in two rounds (meat, then seafood and salads), roast pork, acqua pazza, braised beef cheek, squid-ink pasta with oysters and shungiku, shirasu and cabbage aglio e olio, gorgonzola pasta · weekend lunch of appetizers, pasta, dessert and coffee ¥2,200 (April 2025) (reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Higashioji near Sanjo, one chef, pasta and natural wine] A calm, easy-to-miss Italian room on Higashioji, near the Rohm Theatre, where one chef cooks a long à la carte list and pours natural wine. The appetizer platters are generous — ask before over-ordering — and the pastas shine, from squid ink with oysters to shirasu-and-cabbage aglio e olio. Dinner from 18:00; weekend lunch by reservation. Cash only. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef not named; runs it single-handed (May 2025)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 21 November 2017. A December 2023 reviewer says it was listed as a Michelin Bib Gourmand in the 2023 guide; a May 2025 reviewer says it is run by a single person with a long à la carte menu and quick service.
chef_bio.specialty: Pasta; appetizer platters with natural wine.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 pair were warned by the owner that four dishes would be too many for two — and the two-round appetizer platter proved it.
A February 2026 diner arriving after a show at the ROHM Theatre found the tuna salad gone but loved the shirasu and cabbage aglio e olio.
An October 2024 regular booked the whole room for about ten people after dinner hours.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: lapintaika (ラピンタイカ)、イタリアン、左京区北門前町499、東山駅から265m、火〜日18:00〜22:00、土日の昼は予約制、月曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、18席、20名まで貸切可、禁煙、2017年11月21日オープン。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 東大路通の三条近くで入口がわかりにくい、ミシュランのビブグルマン (2023年)、一人で切り盛り、アラカルトが豊富、ナチュラルワイン、2回に分けて出る前菜の盛り合わせ、ローストポーク、アクアパッツァ、牛ほほ肉の煮込み、牡蠣と春菊のイカ墨パスタ、しらすとキャベツのペペロンチーノ、ゴルゴンゾーラ、昼のコース2,200円 (2025年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: One chef; portions are generous — ask before ordering many dishes.

places.name: 月ヶ瀬 堺町店 (Tsukigase)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Anmitsu of agar, bean paste and fruit with syrups, plus kakigori; no ingredient or gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Agar, red beans and fruit are plant-based, but several bowls add ice cream or condensed milk (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Wednesday and Thursday per Tabelog’s schedule (its note gives Thursday, or the next day after a holiday); hours may change (Tabelog). Queues of a few groups on busy afternoons (August 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 24 seats at tables and a large table; non-smoking; JCB and AMEX, and QR (Tabelog). Down a side path beside an apartment building on Sakaimachi south of Oike, 306 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 17 November 2006 (Tabelog); the brand’s other shop is a counter in Takashimaya Kyoto (official site).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi-Oike — 306 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kanmidokoro of anmitsu and mitsumame (official site; reviews) · seasonal anmitsu, e.g. peach anmitsu with peach sauce, bean paste and vanilla ice cream ¥1,630 (August 2026), chestnut anmitsu in autumn · agar jelly with smooth bean paste and matcha set · kakigori in summer, including a "shirokuma" bowl (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sweets · Sakaimachi-Oike, a hidden anmitsu parlour] A calm Kyoto kanmidokoro tucked down a path off Sakaimachi near Oike, beloved by regulars for its anmitsu — agar, gentle bean paste and seasonal fruit such as peach (about ¥1,600) or chestnut — and, in summer, fluffy kakigori. A quiet sweet stop between sights. Afternoons only; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 京都甘味処 月ヶ瀬, with this Sakaimachi shop and a counter in Takashimaya Kyoto. Tabelog gives the Sakaimachi opening as 17 November 2006. A July 2026 reviewer has come for years for anmitsu and mitsumame.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal anmitsu.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular on a tenth visit came for the seasonal chestnut anmitsu.
An August 2026 visitor waited about 10–15 minutes and ordered both anmitsu and kakigori.
An August 2026 walker was drawn in by the kakigori sign and had a "shirokuma" bowl.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (tsukigase.jp): 京都甘味処 月ヶ瀬、堺町店と髙島屋店 (髙島屋京都店5階)。食べログ: 月ヶ瀬 堺町店 (ツキガセ)、甘味処・カフェ・かき氷、中京区堺町通御池下ル丸木材木町675 アーバンライフフォルムズ烏丸御池103、烏丸御池駅から306m、12:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:30)、水木定休 (備考では木曜、祝日の場合は翌日)、24席、禁煙、JCB・AMEX・QR 可、2006年11月17日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 桃のあんみつ1,630円、栗のあんみつ、寒天とこし餡と抹茶のセット、夏のかき氷 (白くま)、入口がわかりにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Picture menu; afternoons only.

places.name: フリアンディーズ 烏丸店 (BOULANGERIE FRIANDISE)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery of breads, Danish pastries and sandwiches (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Many pastries use butter, eggs, cheese or meat; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 7:00–19:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). Takeaway only — no eat-in (Tabelog). Cash, e-money and QR; no cards (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). Near Karasuma-Marutamachi, a short walk from Marutamachi Stn (189 m), handy for a picnic in the Imperial Palace grounds or by the Kamo (Tabelog; March 2026). One of a small local chain whose main shop is at Kitakujo (March 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma-Marutamachi — 189 m from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood boulangerie from 7 a.m. (2026 reviews) · croissants and chocolate croissants, Danish pastries such as pear Danish ¥250 (October 2026), sweet potato ¥230 (September 2026), quiche Lorraine with edamame, curry bread, potato and crispy sausage bread · sandwiches: katsu mix, avocado-cheese-tomato, crust-on sandwiches (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bakery · Karasuma-Marutamachi, a 7 a.m. local boulangerie] A green-fronted neighbourhood bakery near Marutamachi Station, open from 7:00 every day — pick up croissants, a pear Danish (about ¥250), curry bread or a katsu sandwich for a picnic in the Imperial Palace grounds or by the Kamo River. Takeaway only; cards not taken, but e-money and QR are.

chef_bio.background: Per a March 2026 review: a beloved local bakery whose main branch is at Kitakujo. Reviewers describe a wide range of savoury and sweet breads and sandwiches.
chef_bio.specialty: Danish pastries; sandwiches.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 cyclist bought bread here for lunch by the Kamo River, noting the bike parking out front.
An October 2026 regular on a fourth visit took home a pear Danish for ¥250.
A July 2026 customer returned after a long gap for the crust-on sandwiches remembered fondly.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フリアンディーズ 烏丸店 (FRIANDISE)、パン・サンドイッチ・ベーグル、中京区少将井御旅町335-2、丸太町駅から189m、7:00〜19:00、カード不可・電子マネーと QR 可、イートインなし。口コミ (2026年、英語): 地元で愛されるパン屋、本店は Kitakujo、クロワッサン、パン・オ・ショコラ、洋梨のデニッシュ250円、さつまいも230円、枝豆のキッシュ・ロレーヌ、カレーパン、カツサンド、アボカドとチーズとトマトのサンド、耳付きのサンドイッチ、自転車を停めやすい。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-serve bakery; point and pay.

places.name: あなご料理 大金 (Anago Ryori Oogane)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Anago sashimi, salt-grilled anago and shabu-shabu in bone broth beside tempura, fries and sauce-glazed eel (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a conger-eel restaurant (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Lunch Wed, Thu and Sat 11:45–14:00 (last order 13:30); dinner Mon–Sat 18:00–22:00 (last seating 20:00); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; a ¥2,000 fee for same-day cancellations (Tabelog). Tabelog lists cards (VISA, Master, AMEX); an October 2026 lunch guest was told cash only. Lunch is all non-smoking; separate smoking hours otherwise (Tabelog). 12 seats: 6 at the counter, tables for 2 and 4 (Tabelog). The owner cooks alone at the counter, with a partner front of house (2025–26 reviews). At Takatsuji and Nishinotoin; 5–7 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; November 2025 review).
places.neighborhood: Takatsuji-Nishinotoin, south of Shijo-Karasuma
places.cuisine: Conger eel every way, with anago from Tsushima (Tabelog): anago sashimi, salt- or sauce-grilled premium anago sold by weight, shabu-shabu in a broth of over 250 anago bones with seri, live anago tempura from the tank, fried bones, anago kamameshi; lunch sets — the Anago Zen (Ume) ¥1,500 (June 2026), the daily gozen (Take) ¥2,300 with kamameshi and sashimi (November 2025), simmered or grilled anago rice bowls, anago fry; omakase dinners about ¥10,000–15,000; sake (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Anago (conger eel) · Takatsuji-Nishinotoin] A small counter devoted to conger eel, rare in Kyoto: sashimi, grilled anago, shabu-shabu in a deep bone broth, tempura from the tank and anago kamameshi. Lunch sets ¥1,500–2,300 three days a week; omakase dinner ¥10,000–15,000. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), with a partner front of house
chef_bio.background: Opened 20 October 2014 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe the owner working alone at the counter (December 2025, May 2026) and a couple running the restaurant (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: To change the fixed idea of conger eel (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Anago shabu-shabu; live anago tempura; anago kamameshi.

anecdotes.text: Lunch days grew to Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday, a regular of five visits noted in November 2025.
A December 2025 diner found the anago fry served a little cold and wondered whether that was deliberate.
On a second visit in October 2026, a guest was remembered by the chef.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): あなご料理 大金、あなご・魚介料理・居酒屋、下京区高辻西洞院町801-5、四条駅・烏丸駅から徒歩5分、ランチは水木土 11:45〜14:00、ディナーは月〜土 18:00〜22:00 (最終入店20:00)、日曜休み、当日キャンセルは2,000円、12席 (カウンター6、テーブル2・4)、カード可、昼は全席禁煙、2014年10月20日オープン、対馬の穴子、250尾以上の骨の出汁のしゃぶしゃぶ、生け簀の穴子の天ぷら。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 刺身、白焼きとたれ焼き (量り売り)、骨せんべい、穴子の釜飯、穴子膳 梅1,500円、日替わり御膳 竹2,300円、煮穴子丼と焼き穴子丼、穴子フライ、おまかせコース、店主一人で調理、夫婦で営む、現金のみという声、フライが冷たかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; the chef explains sizes and prices of anago sold by weight.

places.name: Karasumaoike UI
places.gf_detail: Ask. French bistro courses with pasta and baguette; meat and fish mains also offered (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of fish, lamb and beef; cheese terrine (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:20) and 18:00–22:30 (last order 21:00); Sun 11:30–15:00; closed Monday (when Monday is a holiday, closed Monday evening and Tuesday) (Tabelog). Bookings taken; the dinner course needs a reservation for two or more a few days ahead; à la carte orders by phone only (Tabelog; March 2026 review). One drink per person (March and July 2026 reviews). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「チャージ料なし」 — no cover charge. Cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 18 seats at the counter and tables, some facing a small garden; non-smoking, smoking spot in the garden (Tabelog; July 2026 review). In a renovated machiya entered from the west side of Ryogaemachi-dori; 3 min from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 2 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: West of Karasuma Oike — 3 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Delicate French bistro cooking, eaten with chopsticks (Tabelog; March 2026 review): prix-fixe lunch from ¥2,800 with pasta as the base main and supplements for others (July 2026) — sweetfish confit, bavette steak, Angus beef, roast lamb, the signature palette salad with edible flowers, house baguette; a ¥10,000 dinner course; à la carte such as sweet sea bream, beef heart and bouillabaisse rice with a crisp crust; cheese terrines, including a blue-cheese one, to finish or take away; sake and wine pairings (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [French bistro · Karasuma Oike] A stylish renovated machiya with a small garden, serving delicate, flower-strewn French plates you can eat with chopsticks: prix-fixe lunches from ¥2,800, a ¥10,000 dinner course, and a much-praised cheese terrine. One drink per person; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a French bistro in a renovated Kyoto machiya using seasonal ingredients for delicate, gentle flavours.
chef_bio.philosophy: To give guests inspiration and joy through seasonal French cooking (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Cheese terrine; seasonal course.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner found the pasta salty and the dressing divisive, and cost performance average with the one-drink rule — but loved the room.
On a near-40°C July 2026 day, a garden-side table grew hot through the glass, and hot soup spaghetti felt out of season.
An April 2026 lunch guest found most mains carried a supplement and only one was included in the base price.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Karasumaoike UI、ビストロ・フレンチ・創作料理、中京区押小路通両替町西入金吹町459、烏丸御池駅2番出口から徒歩3分、火〜土 11:30〜15:00・18:00〜22:30、日 11:30〜15:00、月曜休み、チャージ料なし、アラカルトは電話予約のみ、18席、禁煙 (坪庭に喫煙スペース)、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、京町家を改装、1万円のコース、日本酒やワインのペアリング。口コミ (2026年2〜10月、英語): 箸で食べるフレンチ、2,800円からのプリフィクスランチ (パスタが基本で追加料金のメイン)、鮎のコンフィ、バヴェットステーキ、アンガス牛、仔羊のロースト、パレットサラダ、自家製バゲット、チーズのテリーヌ (ブルーチーズも)、ブイヤベースのごはん、ワンドリンク制、塩気が強いという声、夏の庭側の席は暑いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Prix-fixe menu with supplements; one drink per person.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Corn tortillas are not confirmed; soft and hard tacos, nachos and rotisserie chicken with rice (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: rotisserie chicken, lamb and fish tacos (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 18:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Monday, or Tuesday after a Monday holiday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; same-day no-shows are charged 100% for courses or ¥4,000 per person for tables (Tabelog). An hour's wait at Saturday lunch in September 2026. Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 40 seats with private rooms for 4–25; non-smoking (Tabelog). On a narrow street just east of Karasuma above Takatsuji; 10 min from Shijo or Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; November 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Just east of Karasuma above Takatsuji — 10 min from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Rotisserie chicken and Mexican tacos (Tabelog): lunch plates of roast chicken with tacos — "Dos" two-taco plate ¥1,980 (September 2026), the Quattro tacos set, chicken over rice ¥1,430 (November 2026) — tacos of grilled chicken, spicy lamb stew and fish, soft or hard by filling; guacamole, salsa, nachos, Kyoto water eggplant; Corona, sweet cocktails, sparkling wine; the all-you-can-drink "Jackie Course" for parties (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Rotisserie chicken & tacos · near Shijo-Karasuma] A bright, resort-like Mexican room on a back street: lunch plates of cinnamon-scented roast chicken with tacos (about ¥1,400–2,000), and at night tacos, nachos and cocktails, with party rooms. Popular at weekend lunch; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 22 December 2014 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Rotisserie chicken; tacos.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 regular on a sixth lunch visit was asked whether cilantro was all right before the chicken over rice came.
An August 2026 diner found the tortillas too crumbly to wrap, though the fillings were tasty.
A September 2026 diner found the chairs uncomfortable and wished the roast chicken more seasoned, but liked the generously poured sparkling wine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ロティー チキン アンド ジャッキー タコス、メキシコ料理・居酒屋・バー、下京区高辻通烏丸東入ル匂天神町642-3、烏丸駅・四条駅から徒歩10分、火〜日・祝 11:30〜15:00・18:00〜23:00、月曜休み (祝日は営業し翌火曜休み)、当日無断キャンセルはコース100%・席のみ一人4,000円、40席、個室あり (4〜25名)、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、2014年12月22日オープン、飲み放題の「ジャッキーコース」。口コミ (2026年7〜11月、英語): ローストチキンとタコスのランチプレート (タコス2つの「Dos」1,980円、クアトロ)、チキンオーバーライス1,430円、グリルチキン・ラムの煮込み・魚のタコス、ワカモレ、サルサ、ナチョス、水なす、コロナ、甘いカクテル、土曜昼は1時間待ち、トルティーヤが崩れるという声、椅子が座りにくいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff check whether you eat cilantro.

places.notes: [Wine bar & roast beef · by Nishiki Market] A wood-panelled wine bar open from mid-afternoon (noon at weekends), with 160 wines picked by an importer-turned-owner and oven-roasted black-wagyu beef. About ¥4,000–6,000; ¥380 appetizer. Book at weekends; no minors after 18:00; open daily.

roles: Owner (unnamed), formerly a wine importer; manager and staff
chef_bio.background: Opened 2 February 2012 (Tabelog). A May 2026 reviewer says the owner, with a background as an importer, chose the 160 bottles.
chef_bio.philosophy: Good wine at fair prices with grilled dishes (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Black-wagyu roast beef; wine.

A May 2026 couple on a date found the staff were fellow Hanshin fans and made friends.
An August 2026 diner was warned that some dishes take about an hour, so order early.

No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). 18 seats incl. a counter, mixed chairs and sofas; non-smoking (Tabelog; May 2024). A morning set is served (Tabelog; January 2024). places.notes: [Café · near the Prefectural Office, Taiwanese noodles] A plant-screened old house turned café, full of tiger decor and books: "tiger noodles" and dry tantan with minced meat and a soft egg, lu rou fan, a generous Napolitan, and a morning set, with salad and soup at lunch. Pick your spice level — level 3 of 4 is fiery. QR payment, no cards. Open daily from 11:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café opened 27 October 2016, with breakfast. Reviewers describe a renovated private house with antique interiors among government offices and a hospital (July 2019), tiger-themed decorations, books, blankets and a small heater at the seats (January 2024), and Taiwanese dishes alongside pasta and doria (2024–2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Tiger noodles; lu rou fan.

anecdotes.text: A June 2024 diner overheard a neighbour ask for a smaller portion of Napolitan — and, when it arrived, understood why.
A December 2025 regular chose spice level 3 of 4 on the lu rou noodles and struggled to finish.
A May 2026 regular from a nearby office orders dry tiger noodles extra-large and spicy, then mixes in rice at the end.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. The cooking centres on organic vegetables, but dashi, fish, duck and egg run through the set and the evening dishes (2024–2025 reviews).

Yoshida-Shimoadachi-cho, near Kojinbashi; 5 min from the Kojinbashi or Konoe-dori bus stops, 10 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yoshida near Kojinbashi — 10 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese izakaya-café of seasonal flavours, centred on organic vegetables (Tabelog; May 2024) · lunch: one set only, ichiju hassai ¥1,500 — eight small obanzai such as carrot tartare, roast duck, cold tamagoyaki and kelp tsukudani with sansho, clay-pot rice and a sake-lees soup; extra rice ¥150 (April 2024–September 2025) · evening: three-obanzai platter, namero, sashimi such as usukawa-hagi, fried winter melon, fig and cheese spring rolls, herb-crusted Spanish mackerel, pumpkin tempura with minced meat, a "staff meal" curry (December 2024; October 2025) · a broad sake list; organic-ginger ginger ale (May 2024) · lunch ¥1,000–2,000, dinner ¥4,000–5,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Obanzai · Yoshida near Kojinbashi, organic vegetables] A calm, stylish izakaya-café west of the Kamo River devoted to organic vegetables: at lunch a single ¥1,500 set of eight small obanzai, clay-pot rice and sake-lees soup; at night shareable plates, fresh fish and a good sake list. Portions run small, and one guest found a fish overcooked. ¥400 dinner charge. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese izakaya-café of seasonal flavours with vegetable and seafood dishes; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers describe plenty of organic vegetables and Kyoto produce (May 2024; January 2025), a wide sake list (May 2024), and small, carefully made portions (2024–2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal flavours, organic vegetables (Tabelog; May 2024 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Ichiju hassai lunch set.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 business traveller from Tokyo found the vegetable set exactly what a tired body needed.
An October 2025 regular praised fried winter melon and fig-and-cheese spring rolls, but found the herb-crusted mackerel burnt and bitter.
A December 2024 diner, once no fan of carrots, came round to carrots here.

places.name: 五燠堂 (gooudo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wood-fired vegetables and meats, but sauces such as Kanazawa miso and a creamy potato salad vary; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Grilled vegetables from the group's own farm are central, but one lotus-root dish is finished with venison fat, and many plates use meat, fish or dairy (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, online via the restaurant's website, and advised — full on holidays (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Counter around a central wood-fire kitchen, and Japanese-style private rooms upstairs; smoking allowed (Tabelog; August 2026). Courses with self-serve all-you-can-drink from the fridge in private rooms (October 2026). About 5 min walk from Kyoto Station Hachijo exit (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 13 December 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of Kyoto Station — 5 min walk from the Hachijo exit
places.cuisine: Wood-fire cooking of vegetables from the group's own farm and selected meats (2026 reviews) · grilled okra, asparagus and fresh octopus; lotus root with Kanazawa miso and venison fat; Kyoto vegetables over open flame; salads (2025–2026 reviews) · venison steak and venison sausage, outside skirt, ichibo steak, wagyu, "kamenoko" (2025–2026 reviews) · eel carpaccio, conger eel and white celery carpaccio ¥1,350, peach and fresh yuba with white miso ¥900, Kamo eggplant with cream cheese, bonito with Kujo negi sauce, a potato salad (2025–2026 reviews) · wines, Kirin Lager ¥650, ISOHAGAN highball ¥800; courses with all-you-can-drink (2025–2026 reviews) · about ¥4,000–8,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Wood-fire dining · Kyoto Station Hachijo side] A stylish counter around a central firewood grill, five minutes from Kyoto Station's south exit: farm-fresh vegetables and venison, skirt or ichibo cooked over the embers, with carpaccios of eel or conger eel, white-miso yuba with peach, and a good wine list; private tatami rooms upstairs. One October 2026 regular felt the menu had shrunk and some sauces grown heavy. Book ahead. Smoking allowed. Evenings, daily.

roles: Kitchen staff at the wood-fire grill (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a dining bar opened 13 December 2023 near Kyoto Station. Reviewers in 2026 describe a restaurant of a well-known Kyoto group that runs its own farm and delivers vegetables to each location (the group name is written in several ways), cooking over firewood in a central kitchen (August 2026), seen on TV (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Vegetables from the group's own farm, cooked over firewood (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Wood-fired vegetables; venison.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 guest had wanted to come for over two years after seeing it on TV, and finally booked during Obon.
An August 2026 guest who arrived ten minutes early was asked to wait outside while earlier diners finished.
An October 2026 regular found the once-hollandaise potato salad now a soupy meat-and-potato dish, and the menu shorter than before.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, steak, fried seafood and egg-wrapped omurice (2023–2026 reviews).

No reservations (Tabelog); lunch can fill just after 11:30 (March 2025). Cash only (Tabelog). Counter and tables; non-smoking (Tabelog; June 2025). places.neighborhood: Kamishichiken near Kitano Tenmangu — 10 min walk from Kitano-Hakubaicho Stn
places.cuisine: Classic yoshoku in Kamishichiken (2023–2026 reviews) · lunch: hamburg steak, today's lunch ¥1,800 (e.g. mochi-pork loin with cheese and breadcrumbs), omurice of butter pilaf with demi-glace ¥1,800 with soup and salad, steak lunch (2023–2026 reviews) · fried shrimp and hamburg steak combination, fried salmon and crab-cream croquettes, teriyaki chicken set (2025–2026 reviews) · an "omakase" yoshoku course of salmon starter, fried scallops, shrimp, hamburg and omurice, with wine (July 2025) · corn potage and a creamy-dressed salad to start · lunch ¥1,000–2,000, dinner ¥3,000–4,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Kamishichiken by Kitano Tenmangu] A small, classic Western-style grill on a quiet Kamishichiken street, run by the master and the master's wife: rich corn potage, crisp fried shrimp, tender hamburg under demi-glace, and a fluffy omurice over butter pilaf, with a short wine list and an omakase course by evening. Friendly chats at the counter. Portions run modest. Cash only; closed Monday.

roles: The owner's wife, at front of house (April 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yoshoku restaurant in Kamishichiken. Reviewers describe a popular, classic Western-style restaurant with regulars from nearby (March 2025), a master who serves an omakase course (July 2025), and an owner's wife who chats with guests (April 2026); an August 2026 guest talked with the owner after the meal.
chef_bio.specialty: Fried shrimp; hamburg steak; omurice.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 couple noticed a Mucha-collaboration coaster under the beer glass, and the owner's wife joined in to share stories.
A March 2025 guest got the last table at a lunch that filled just after 11:30.
An October 2026 diner, watching kimono-clad passers-by, found the croquettes authentic but warned that students would not leave stuffed.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Tacos on homemade tortillas (corn or wheat not stated), chicken over rice with butter rice, Sri Lankan curry, fried chicken and fries (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A “Kyoto vegetable original” taco is on the menu, but fillings and tortillas are not described; most dishes are chicken or pork (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00, dinner 18:00–1:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Lunch is a set menu only, paid in advance, ordered downstairs before going up to the second floor (April–May 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, IC, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 30 seats: 10 at the counter and five tables for four; the second floor can be hired for 20–30 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed on the first floor (Tabelog; August 2026). Free Wi-Fi; sports viewing (Tabelog). A small shrine inside; guests may write on ema plaques (April and October 2026). 3 min from Keihan Shichijo Stn, 7 min from Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Shichijo-dori, between Kyoto Station and Shichijo Stn
places.cuisine: Chicken and tacos: nine kinds of tacos — Kyoto vegetable original, pork guacamole, pork beans, carnitas, chipotle — on homemade tortillas (January and April 2026) · chicken over rice with breast or thigh, butter rice or tortillas, yogurt sauce (February–April 2026) · lunch A: chicken with Sri Lankan curry or tortilla and a large salad (May 2026) · crispy chicken thigh with fries, cut with scissors (May 2026); tulip chicken (October 2026) · pink potato salad (January 2026) · stamped boiled eggs (October 2026)
places.notes: [Chicken and tacos · near Shichijo, a shrine inside] A cheerful, graffiti-walled chicken-and-taco bar near Keihan Shichijo with its own little shrine and ema to write on: nine kinds of tacos on homemade tortillas, chicken over rice, crisp chicken thigh with fries, and a spicy Sri Lankan curry at lunch. Open late (to 1:00); smoking allowed downstairs. Closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Invoice T1130001051904 is registered to 株式会社ＡＦＬＯ・ＸＬ (NTA register). Reviewers describe friendly staff and a homey atmosphere (2026); a January 2026 diner found the fillings mild, as if tailored for Japanese tastes, but praised the tortillas.
chef_bio.specialty: Tacos; chicken over rice.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner was surprised to find a shrine inside the restaurant.
An October 2026 first-timer at a Mexican restaurant was allowed to write on an ema plaque.

places.name: ブランブリュン (BRUNBRUN)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Chocolates, cakes (New York cheesecake, Mont Blanc, apple cake) and baked goods made upstairs, a weekday lunch, and chocolate kakigori in summer; ingredients are not described (Tabelog shop text; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Cakes and kakigori use dairy (cream cheese, condensed milk); the chocolates are not described (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 10:00–17:30 (L.O. 17:00); holidays 10:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:00); closed Sunday and Monday; lunch 11:30–13:30 (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats with sofas in an eat-in area behind the shop (Tabelog; July 2025). Non-smoking; strollers welcome (Tabelog; May 2025). On the corner of Higashinotoin and Takeyamachi, 2 min from Marutamachi Stn exit 5 (Tabelog). Founded 10 April 1935 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin at Takeyamachi, south of the Imperial Palace — 2 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: A chocolate maker since 1935 — making chocolate before the war, when it was still rare — with cakes and baked goods made one by one in the workshop upstairs, and a café with classical music (Tabelog shop text) · cake set, choosing from the showcase: Mont Blanc, apple cake (May 2025); dense New York cheesecake (July 2025) · chocolate kakigori, May–September: chocolate-laced ice with fresh chocolate, chocolate bars and sauce, condensed milk (2025) · a weekday lunch (March 2025)
places.notes: [Chocolate and café · south of the Imperial Palace, since 1935] An old Kyoto chocolatier — making chocolate since before the war — with a showcase of cakes made upstairs and a quiet sofa café at the back with classical music. Locals come for a cake set or, May to September, a towering chocolate kakigori. A short lunch too. Cash only; closed Sundays and Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text: established in 1935 (Showa 10) and making and selling chocolate since before the war, when chocolate was still uncommon; cakes and baked goods are made one by one in the factory on the building’s second floor. A February 2026 regular returned after years and found the same comforting flavours, with a room full of locals.
chef_bio.specialty: Chocolate; chocolate kakigori.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 passer-by, ducking in from the heat for shaved ice, only then learned the shop is famous for chocolate.
A May 2025 visitor wanted the Mont Blanc, found it sold out, and chose the apple cake from the showcase.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ブランブリュン、チョコレート・ケーキ・喫茶店、中京区竹屋町通東洞院西入ル三本木町462、丸太町駅5番出口から東へ徒歩2分、火〜土 10:00〜17:30 (L.O.17:00)、祝日 10:00〜17:00、日・月定休、ランチ11:30〜13:30、予約不可、現金のみ、20席 (ソファ席)、禁煙、1935年4月10日創業。店の紹介: 昭和10年創業、戦前のチョコレートが珍しかった頃からチョコレートを製造販売、ケーキと焼き菓子は2階の工房でひとつずつ手作り、クラシック音楽の流れるカフェ。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ケーキセット、モンブラン、りんごのケーキ、ニューヨークチーズケーキ、5〜9月のチョコレートのかき氷、地元の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick cakes from the showcase; cash only; a quiet local café.

places.name: 豆腐料理とおばんざい まるたけえびす豆八 京都 先斗町 (Marutakeebisu Mamehachi, Pontocho)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tofu and yuba dishes with dashi and soy, soy-milk white-miso oden, nama-fu dengaku (wheat gluten), yuba tempura and fried tofu, koji-marinated meat and fish (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Much of the menu is tofu, yuba and vegetables, but dashi is used (fried eggplant and yuba in dashi) and fish, chicken and sake-lees fish appear in the courses (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); irregular closures for maintenance days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Otoshi ¥550 per person (Tabelog, original お通し代として550円頂いております。). Cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay); no e-money (Tabelog). 36 seats: counter, tables and private rooms for 4–8; parties up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Pontocho, just north of Shijo on the west side, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 1A (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, just north of Shijo — 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Tofu dishes and obanzai, Kyoto style (Tabelog) · Marutake Course ¥5,500 (September 2026); Marutake lunch with a soy-milk hot pot and dessert; obanzai lunch (August and November 2026) · fresh yuba sashimi, five kinds of tofu, fried eggplant and yuba in dashi, yuba tempura, burdock with black honey, two-colour nama-fu dengaku, sake-lees grilled fish, soy-milk white-miso oden, chirimen-sansho chazuke (September 2026) · crispy thick fried tofu (July 2026) · koji-marinated mackerel and chicken (October 2026) · sake from Sasaki Shuzo, the family brewery of actor Kuranosuke Sasaki, served since autumn 2025 (June 2026)
places.notes: [Tofu and obanzai · Pontocho by Shijo] A small tofu restaurant at the Shijo end of Pontocho with a counter and private rooms: yuba sashimi, soy-milk white-miso oden, nama-fu dengaku, yuba tempura and obanzai, as a ¥5,500 course or lunch sets with a soy-milk hot pot. Gentle flavours that suit older guests; sake from Sasaki Shuzo. ¥550 otoshi. Staff are largely students; service can be slow when busy.

chef_bio.background: Invoice T5130002012752 is registered to 有限会社プロスパー (NTA register). Tabelog also lists 豆八 本店 and MAMEHACHI CHAYA. Reviewers note the staff were largely university students (September–October 2026) and that a young server from abroad was attentive (July 2026); a June 2026 diner found dishes came slowly but was satisfied.
chef_bio.specialty: Yuba sashimi; soy-milk white-miso oden.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner in the forties brought a mother in the seventies, who left very happy.
A May 2026 host used a private room for guests from afar, and even the older guests ate heartily.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 豆腐料理とおばんざい まるたけえびす豆八 京都 先斗町、日本料理・豆腐料理・居酒屋、中京区四条通先斗町上ル西側22、阪急河原町駅1A出口から徒歩3分、昼11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、夜17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、不定休、予約可、お通し代550円、カード・QR可、36席 (カウンター、テーブル、個室4〜8名)、禁煙、適格請求書 T5130002012752 (有限会社プロスパー)。口コミ (2026年、英語): まるたけコース5,500円、豆乳鍋のまるたけランチ、おばんざいランチ、汲み上げ湯葉の刺身、豆腐5種、湯葉の天ぷら、二色の生麩田楽、粕漬けの焼き魚、豆乳白味噌のおでん、ちりめん山椒の茶漬け、麹漬けの鯖と鶏、佐々木酒造の酒、スタッフは大学生が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Pontocho restaurant with many overseas visitors on the street; private rooms; ¥550 otoshi.

places.name: 肉もん 河原町竹屋町店 (NIKUMON Kawaramachi Takeyamachi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu yakiniku with table sauces and rock salt, offal, motsunabe, bibimbap, steak bowls; sauce ingredients not given (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Wagyu yakiniku and offal restaurant (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30) daily; closed the second and fourth Thursdays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 36 seats including counter and sofa seating; private rooms from 2 to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome, birthday plates, take-out (Tabelog). “Meat Day” specials on the 29th (October 2026). In a 100-year-old townhouse on Kawaramachi north of Takeyamachi, 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi and Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stns (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 5 March 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi north of Takeyamachi — 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Carefully chosen Kuroge Wagyu yakiniku and offal; Manyo beef (2026 reviews) · special Wagyu assortment ¥2,980; thick-cut assortment ¥3,580; outside skirt for two ¥1,280; white omasum ¥780; premium yukhoe ¥1,580; Omi beef hoso with spicy noodles ¥1,180; kimchi assortment ¥880; matcha crème brûlée ¥480 (September 2026) · premium tongue; Wagyu sashimi with kombu (August 2026) · thin-sliced hosomaki with a dipping sauce (November 2026) · motsunabe in season (November 2026) · lunch: Wagyu rice bowl, yakiniku set, bibimbap, spicy onsen-egg sauce with rice; “Ran Ichi” or top-sirloin steak bowl on the 29th (2026)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Kawaramachi-Takeyamachi, a machiya grill] The second shop of the Shijo-Omiya yakiniku NIKUMON, in a 100-year-old townhouse on Kawaramachi: Kuroge Wagyu and Manyo beef, offal such as omasum and Omi beef hoso, yukhoe and a premium tongue, with good-value lunch bowls and bibimbap and motsunabe in the cold months. Open 11:00–23:00; meat-day specials on the 29th. About ¥5,000–8,000 at dinner.

chef_bio.background: An October 2026 reviewer calls this the second branch of NIKUMON, “thriving in Shijo Omiya for 10 years”, opened in March 2024 in a 100-year-old traditional house. Another October 2026 diner found the young staff polite and efficient.
chef_bio.specialty: Kuroge Wagyu; Omi beef offal.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular came back nine days after a visit for the 29th “Meat Day” steak bowl and found rock salt the best match.
A September 2026 regular on an eighth visit chose the spiciness of the overflowing onsen-egg sauce at lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 肉もん 河原町竹屋町店、焼肉・もつ鍋・ホルモン、中京区河原町通竹屋町上ル大文字町242-3、神宮丸太町駅・京都市役所前駅から徒歩約5分、11:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、第2・第4木曜休み、予約可、カード・QR可、36席、個室2〜20名、禁煙、車椅子可、子ども可、2024年3月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 四条大宮で10年の「肉もん」の2号店、築100年の町家、黒毛和牛と Manyo 牛、特選和牛盛り2,980円、厚切り盛り3,580円、ハラミ1,280円、白センマイ780円、特上ユッケ1,580円、近江牛ホソと辛い麺1,180円、ほそ巻き、もつ鍋、昼の和牛丼やビビンバ、29日の肉の日。

cultural_comfort.note: Family-friendly yakiniku with private rooms; lunch sets.

places.name: izon
places.gf_detail: Ask: courses centre on spices, basmati rice and biryani, but include pastry-style starters, potages and desserts whose make-up is not published (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: eel, seafood fumet, salmon, lamb and dairy (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: reservation-only courses starting together — lunch 12:00 and dinner 18:30 (Tabelog: lunch Fri–Sun, dinner Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun; closed Wednesday and irregularly). Book by the day before via TableCheck or phone; at most 4 guests per sitting, and 3 or more take the whole house; private bookings can start earlier for guests catching a late train. 4 seats at the counter and sofa; non-smoking; no perfume; children only if eating the adult course; English menu; cards, e-money and most QR (Tabelog). In a 100-year-old machiya at the end of a narrow alley (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Gosho-minami, down an alley south of the Imperial Palace — 8 min walk from Marutamachi or Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: "Innovative spice gastronomy": a course that crosses a border with each plate, pairing Kyoto’s season with spices, aroma over heat, light on oil (official site) · omakase course ¥16,500 (official site); lunch courses themed on a country that changes about every three months — casual ¥2,480, standard ¥3,580 with a ¥2,100 pairing (Denmark and Greenland, early 2026; Tunisia, July 2026) (reviews) · signatures: a ring-moulded hors d’oeuvre built on India’s six tastes; eel dolma, a boned eel stuffed with seasonal vegetables and charcoal-grilled; bamboo biryani of seafood, Ohara vegetables and basmati steamed in bamboo (official site) · seen: iceberg-shaped potato and cheese, spice potage, gravlax, lamb, cardamom and nut ice terrine, homemade chai (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Spice gastronomy · an alley south of the Imperial Palace, four seats] A four-seat dining room in a hundred-year-old machiya at the end of a Gosho-minami alley, cooking "innovative spice" courses that travel to a new country every few months — Denmark and Greenland, Tunisia — with Kyoto produce and signatures like eel dolma and bamboo biryani. Run by a chef and a childhood friend, per a regular. Omakase ¥16,500; lunch courses from about ¥2,500 in 2026 reviews. Book by the day before.

roles: Chef not named; "run by a chef and a childhood friend" (July 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a reservation-only restaurant in a 100-year-old machiya at the back of an alley south of the Imperial Palace, weaving stories from world history and culture into courses that combine Kyoto’s seasons and spices, valuing aroma over heat and keeping oil and aromatics light. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe thorough explanations of each dish, a quarterly country theme, and an earlier Indian-French fusion lunch (September 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「スパイスの刺激よりも香りを大切に、オイルや香味野菜は控えめに、体に優しく、美しいコース料理を」.
chef_bio.specialty: Eel dolma; bamboo biryani.

anecdotes.text: March 2026, the Denmark and Greenland theme: mashed potato and cheese shaped like an iceberg, its base dyed blue with butterfly pea, with seaweed on top "to symbolize the land exposed due to global warming."
February 2026: the usual choice of two soups was not offered that day — "That was a bit disappointing."
March 2026: the homemade chai was ordered, then "I was informed later that it wasn’t available."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (izon-kyoto.jp): izon、京都御所南、スパイス・ガストロノミー、一皿ごとに国境を越える食の世界旅行、世界の歴史や文化から物語を紡ぎ京都の旬とスパイスを掛け合わせるイノベーティブ、香りを大切に、オイルや香味野菜は控えめ、京都御所南のろうじの奥の築百年の京町家、完全予約制、セルクル仕立てのオードブル (インドの6つの味)、鰻のドルマ、バンブービリヤニ (大原野菜、バスマティライス)、イノベーティブ・スパイスのおまかせコース16,500円、昼12:00・夜18:30一斉スタート、各回最大4名 (3名以上で一棟貸切)、前日までに予約、不定休。食べログ: イノベーティブ、中京区毘沙門町556-1、4席、香水は控えて、子供は大人と同じ料理を食べる場合のみ、英語メニュー、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年8月、英語): シェフと幼なじみで営む、季節ごとに国のテーマ (デンマークとグリーンランド、チュニジア、次はモロッコ)、カジュアルコース2,480円、スタンダード3,580円とペアリング2,100円、大原の野菜のサラダ、スパイスのポタージュ、グラブラックス、ラム、カルダモンとナッツのアイステリーヌ、氷山の形のポテトとチーズ、料理の説明が丁寧、スープの選択がなかった・チャイがなかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and site; dishes explained in detail.

places.name: 路地奥Garden168 (Rojioku Garden 168)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: hamburg steak, burgers, shepherd’s pie, fried chicken and bread sides (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature is a six-egg dashimaki; other mains are chicken, lamb, pork and beef (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 11:30–15:00 (Mon, Wed–Sun); dinner 18:00–23:00 Wed, Thu, Sun and holidays, to midnight Fri and Sat; Monday is lunch only, and Tuesday is the day off. Lunch seats 1.5 hours; parties of three or more book by phone; the whole party must arrive together, bookings lapse after 10 minutes, and same-day cancellations cost ¥1,000 a person. Dinner from 18:00: one drink and one food per person to start, no one under 20. 12 seats; no smoking inside, smoking in the courtyard and on the terrace. No service charge or cover — Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料・チャージ料 無し」. Cards and PayPay. Opened 16 March 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ogawa-dori south of Oike, at the back of the Marumasu Nishimura-ya alley — 5 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: A café-bar at the end of a stone alley in a 300-year-old townhouse with dyeing and leather workshops (2026 reviews) · lunches all ¥1,600, drinks extra (August and October 2026): dashimaki tamago lunch made with six eggs, with grated daikon; a limited daily "Garden lunch" (e.g. plum-and-shiso fried chicken breast, ginger pork, simmered chicken); hamburg steak; special beef hamburger; shepherd’s pie of lamb; each with salad, three obanzai, three pickles and a hearty miso soup, rice or bread (2026 reviews) · cocktails, sake, shochu and wine at night (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Café & bar · Ogawa-Oike, at the end of a stone alley] A twelve-seat café-bar down a stone alley in a 300-year-old townhouse of craft workshops near Nijo Castle: ¥1,600 lunches of a six-egg dashimaki, hamburg steak or the limited daily plate with obanzai and pickles, and cocktails at night. Book ahead — it fills within minutes of opening. Tight aisles; ¥1,000 same-day cancellation fee. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 16 March 2017 (Tabelog), at the back of an alley in the Marumasu Nishimura-ya building on Ogawa-dori. Reviewers in 2026 describe a historic townhouse said to be over 300 years old, home to a dyeing workshop and leather workshop, a small room of four two-seat tables and one four-seat table, and lunches that fill up soon after 11:30.
chef_bio.specialty: Six-egg dashimaki tamago lunch.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "After placing my order, I overheard another table mentioning that the dashimaki is made with six large eggs… Six eggs!?"
November 2026: "The atmosphere isn’t particularly relaxing, but the food is delicious!" — and the narrow path to the back table was hard with large bags.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 路地奥Garden168、カフェ・バー、中京区小川通御池南下ル壺屋町 丸益西村屋 路地奥、二条城前駅から徒歩5分、昼11:30〜15:00 (月・水〜日)、夜18:00〜23:00 (水木日祝)・〜24:00 (金土)、月曜夜と火曜休み、昼は1時間半制、3名以上は電話予約、全員揃って来店、10分過ぎると自動キャンセル、当日キャンセルは1人1,000円、夜は最初にワンドリンク・ワンフード、20歳未満不可、12席、店内禁煙 (中庭とテラスで喫煙可)、サービス料・チャージ料 無し、カード・PayPay可、2017年3月16日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜11月、英語): 築300年以上の町家、染色や革の工房、ランチはすべて1,600円 (飲み物別)、卵6個のだし巻き定食と大根おろし、数量限定のガーデンランチ (梅しその鶏むね唐揚げ、生姜焼き、鶏の煮物)、ハンバーグ、特製牛100%ハンバーガー、ラムのシェパーズパイ、サラダ、おばんざい3種、漬物3種、具だくさんの味噌汁、ご飯かパン、すぐ満席、通路が狭い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; the entrance is down a stone alley with a small lantern sign.

places.name: 京極かねよ (Kyogoku Kaneyo)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: eel glazed in a soy-based tare, served over rice (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: eel, egg, liver soup, carp (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:30–15:30 (last order 15:00) and 17:00–20:30 (last order 20:00); closed Wednesday (monthly closures on the official site); may close in typhoons; phone after 14:00. Foreign-booking policy (Tabelog, English auto-translation): "For inbound customers, please make reservations for seats only through our website, rather than for course meals." Cancellation policy (official site): sets and courses 100% on the day, 50% the day before; seat-only bookings ¥3,000 a person on the day. Unannounced lateness over 30 minutes counts as a cancellation. 40 seats — tables downstairs, tatami upstairs (where families with small children are seated; no children’s chairs); non-smoking; cards and PayPay; take-out and delivery.
places.neighborhood: Rokkaku-Shinkyogoku — 7 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn; 10 min from Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: A Meiji-era eel house grilling Edo-style — split down the back, white-grilled, steamed, then glazed in a tare topped up since the founding — with eel from Shizuoka and Kyushu (official site) · the signature kinshi-don: an unadon under a huge Kyoto-style dashimaki that spills over the bowl, regular ¥3,000 (October 2026) · liver soup, egg soup ¥450, eel chawanmushi with two big pieces, grilled liver, carp sashimi (October 2026) · loach dishes (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Unagi · Rokkaku-Shinkyogoku, a Meiji-era eel house] A Meiji-founded eel restaurant off Shinkyogoku with a Taisho-era interior, famous for its kinshi-don — eel over rice buried under a dashimaki that overflows the bowl (¥3,000). Listed in the Michelin Guide Kyoto-Osaka 2026; rakugo nights upstairs each month. Overseas guests are asked to book seats only, through its website. Strict cancellation fees. Some find the egg overwhelms the eel. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in the Meiji era, an eel specialist whose craftsmen grill Shizuoka and Kyushu eel Edo-style with a secret tare topped up since the founding; the kinshi-don with Kyoto-style dashimaki is the favourite; the retro interior is unchanged since the Taisho era, and the upstairs tatami room hosts a monthly rakugo night (かねよ寄席). It notes selection for the Michelin Guide Kyoto-Osaka 2026, ten straight years in the Michelin Guide, a 2024 Trip.Gourmet award, and a JAPAN FOOD SELECTION gold for its kabayaki.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「100年続く変わらぬ味を守り続けてまいる」 — keeping a taste unchanged for a hundred years.
chef_bio.specialty: Kinshi-don.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "The egg was so large that it overflowed from the bowl, and its firm texture made it quite satisfying. However, this meant that the flavor of the eel was somewhat overshadowed."
A family regular, October 2026: "They are also very child-friendly, and we received origami souvenirs as a gift."
A diner who had passed it since primary school on the way to a nearby cemetery finally ate there in October 2026, over carp sashimi, grilled liver and beer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyogoku-kaneyo.co.jp): 日本一の鰻・京極かねよ、創業明治の老舗のうなぎ料理専門店、静岡と九州産のうなぎ、創業からつぎ足しの秘伝のタレ、きんし丼 (京風だし巻きのせ) が人気、大正時代から変わらないレトロな店内、2階座敷で毎月落語の「かねよ寄席」、ミシュランガイド京都・大阪2026に選出、ミシュランに10年連続掲載、2024年 Trip.Gourmet アワード、鰻蒲焼き (上) が JAPAN FOOD SELECTION 金賞、江戸流 (背開き、白焼き、蒸してタレで本焼き)、キャンセルポリシー (セット・コース 当日100%・前日50%、席のみ予約 当日1名3,000円)、英語・中国語の予約ページ。食べログ: うなぎ・丼・どじょう、中京区六角通新京極東入ル松ヶ枝町456、京都市役所前駅から徒歩7分、11:30〜15:30 (L.O. 15:00)・17:00〜20:30 (L.O. 20:00)、水曜休み、電話は14時以降、40席 (1階テーブル、2階座敷)、子供用の椅子なし (子連れは2階座敷へ)、海外からの客は公式サイトから席のみの予約を、禁煙、カード・PayPay可、テイクアウト・デリバリー。口コミ (2026年10月、英語): きんし丼 並3,000円、玉子が丼からあふれる、肝吸い、玉子のお吸い物450円、鰻入りの茶碗蒸し、肝焼き、鯉の洗い、家族連れに親切で折り紙のお土産、玉子で鰻の味が負けるという声、雨でも行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Policy for overseas guests: "please make reservations for seats only through our website, rather than for course meals" (Tabelog, English auto-translation). English and Chinese booking pages and menus on the official site.

places.name: 権太呂 四条本店 (Gontaro Shijo Honten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon and blended soba, tempura, and a soy-and-dashi broth (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is kombu and bonito (official site); udon-suki has chicken, shrimp and clams.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:00–21:30 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday, with occasional changes posted on the official site. Reservations only for the Gontaro nabe (udon-suki) courses, not seats only. 110 seats over several floors — tables on the ground floor, sunken kotatsu on the 2nd, banquet rooms above, a tea room on the 4th; private rooms for 10–48; non-smoking; English and picture menus; children welcome; cards, e-money and most QR. Service charge: none — Tabelog’s Japanese original says 「なし」 (the English auto-translation wrongly says one is added). Prices revised in September 2026 (official site). Opened 14 December 1960 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Fuyacho, next to Nishiki Market — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Udon, soba and udon-suki built on a golden kombu-and-bonito dashi drawn each morning (official site) · Gontaro nabe (udon-suki course) with clams, chicken, vegetables, shrimp and udon (October 2026) · keiran udon ¥1,300 (September 2026), nabeyaki udon ¥2,000 (October 2026), zaru soba ¥1,000 and inaka soba with grated daikon ¥1,000 (2026), tempura with grated daikon ¥1,850 (September 2026), tempura-soba gozen with soba-mame tofu and kayaku rice (October 2026) · small potatoes simmered in the broth then fried ¥700, soba-miso tofu ¥400 (October 2026)
places.notes: [Udon & soba · Shijo-Fuyacho by Nishiki Market, since 1960] The main shop of Kyoto’s Gontaro, a five-storey sukiya-style house beside Nishiki Market, serving udon and soba in its "golden" morning dashi — keiran udon, nabeyaki, zaru soba from ¥1,000 — and the Gontaro nabe udon-suki for groups (the only thing you can book). One of three Gontaro shops with Okazaki and Kinkakuji. One diner found the dashi under the grated daikon weak (September 2026). Closed Wednesday.

roles: Run by 株式会社権太呂 (president 藤本和洋, official site)
chef_bio.background: Opened 14 December 1960 (Tabelog). Per the official site: Gontaro runs three shops in Kyoto — this Shijo main shop, Okazaki and Kinkakuji — plus mail order; the main shop next to Nishiki Market is a modern five-storey building with a full sukiya-style interior; the "golden" dashi starts each morning with water and kombu, then bonito flakes. The site carries a monthly blog by the president, 藤本和洋.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「味は心 料理は心の表現」 — flavour is heart; cooking shows the cook’s heart.
chef_bio.specialty: Gontaro nabe (udon-suki); keiran udon.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: a la carte prices "a bit on the higher side," and the dashi under the grated daikon "tasted weak."
October 2026: the nabeyaki udon at ¥2,000 "may seem pricey," but "I found it completely justified after tasting it."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gontaro.co.jp): 株式会社権太呂、京都市内に3店舗 (四条本店、岡崎店、金閣寺店) と通信販売、本店は錦市場のすぐ隣で地上5階・地下1階の近代建築ながら内装は本格的な数寄屋づくり、「黄金の一汁」(早朝から水と昆布、削り節)、味は心、社長 藤本和洋のブログ、2026年9月に全店価格改定。食べログ: うどんすき・そば・うどん、中京区麸屋町通四条上ル桝屋町521、11:00〜21:30 (L.O. 21:00)、水曜休み、予約は権太呂なべのみ、110席、個室10〜48名、禁煙、英語・写真付きメニュー、子供可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、サービス料は原文で「なし」、1960年12月14日オープン。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): けいらんうどん1,300円、鍋焼きうどん2,000円、ざるそば1,000円、田舎そばのおろし1,000円、おろし天ぷら1,850円、天ぷらそば御膳 (そば豆腐、かやくご飯)、小芋の唐揚げ700円、そば味噌豆腐400円、権太呂なべのコース (蛤、鶏、野菜、海老、うどん)、1階テーブル・2階掘りごたつ・3〜4階宴会、4階に茶室、卓上に原了郭の黒七味、アラカルトはやや高め、おろしで出汁が薄く感じたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English and picture menus (Tabelog).

places.name: NEW 大宝 (NEW Taiho)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles and mazesoba, gyoza (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tonkotsu-shoyu broth with back fat, chashu, beef tendon (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–23:00 daily (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Quick at lunch — about 15 minutes in and out (July 2026). 134 m from Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 7 July 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gojo Karasuma — 134 m from Gojo Stn
places.cuisine: Ramen of a rich tonkotsu-shoyu broth with back fat but a clean finish, thin straight noodles with a choice of firmness, thin chashu and green onions (July–September 2026) · Taiho ramen, a red, spicy bowl in mild, medium or hot (July–November 2026) · shio ramen with yuzu (July and September 2026) · chashu ramen, beef tendon ramen (September–October 2026) · mazesoba in a choice of sizes with garlic on the table (July and September 2026) · gyoza, chashu rice ball, rice sets, bottled beer (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Ramen · Gojo Karasuma, all day from 11 to 11] A neighbourhood ramen shop open straight through: back-fat tonkotsu-shoyu with thin straight noodles, the spicy red Taiho ramen in three heats, a yuzu shio ramen, beef tendon ramen and mazesoba, with gyoza and rice sets. Quick at lunch, busy with overseas visitors at night. PayPay or cash.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a ramen, abura-soba and mazesoba shop opened 7 July 2020. A July 2026 reviewer thought it once traded under another name. Ramen block not given: the sources do not cover all six ramen dimensions.
chef_bio.specialty: Taiho ramen (spicy); chashu ramen.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 lunchtime regular avoids the spicy bowls at work for fear of sweating off foundation, and finds the regular ramen balanced rather than heavy.

A November 2026 visitor during Kyoto’s modern architecture festival ordered the spicy Taiho ramen with firm noodles, extra green onions and a chashu rice ball, and was charmed by the cheerful young woman serving.
An October 2026 regular came back for the chashu ramen and found it still full of overseas visitors.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラーメン・油そば・まぜそば、下京区大坂町404、五条駅から134m、11:00〜23:00、無休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可・PayPay 可、禁煙、2020年7月7日オープン。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年11月、英語): 背脂の豚骨醤油、細いストレート麺 (硬さを選べる)、薄いチャーシュー、ねぎ、辛い大宝ラーメン (控えめ・少し辛い・辛い)、柚子の塩ラーメン、チャーシュー麺、牛すじラーメン、まぜそば、餃子、チャーシューおにぎり、外国人の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; choose spice level and noodle firmness. Many overseas visitors (October 2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: 夷川 鮨 すずか (Ebisugawa Sushi Suzuka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae omakase with red-vinegar rice, marinated and soy-brushed fish, anago with sauce and a kanpyo roll (2024–25 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish omakase with chawanmushi, a soup and red miso soup (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; a booking two weeks ahead is wise, though Friday seats were free in March 2024 (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews). Cards accepted (Tabelog). Omakase only — Tabelog lists a fixed course at ¥12,000 before tax from February 2019; reviewers paid about ¥17,000 (December 2023) and ¥20,000–29,999 (2025–26). 8 counter seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Ground floor of FORUM夷川 on Ebisugawa, among furniture shops; 7 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; December 2023). Opened 29 November 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ebisugawa furniture street — 7 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Edomae omakase at an 8-seat counter: red-vinegar rice in small portions, aged and marinated fish (2023–26 reviews) · a starter, sashimi and chawanmushi (plum-flavoured in March 2024), then about 10 nigiri with a soup between, red miso soup and dessert (May 2026) · nigiri such as kinmedai and nodoguro, aged tuna and toro, swordtip squid, kohada, akagai, shima-aji, uni, anago; shinko in summer (2023–25 reviews) · lotus-root manju in broth, simmered firefly squid, hojicha pudding (2024 reviews) · extra orders such as negitoro or a kanpyo roll (2025) · sake and wine pairings, Sapporo Lager and Heartland, non-alcoholic drinks (May 2026)
places.notes: [Edomae sushi · Ebisugawa, a couple’s eight-seat counter] A brass door among Ebisugawa’s furniture shops opens on a calm counter where a chef trained in the Kanto region serves aged, red-vinegar Edomae nigiri — kinmedai, nodoguro, aged tuna, swordtip squid — with warm hospitality from the chef and the proprietress. One omakase in the evening, about ¥17,000–25,000.

roles: Head chef (unnamed), trained in the Kanto region (September 2017); runs the shop with the proprietress (2023–25 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Edomae sushi counter opened 29 November 2016. A September 2017 review says the head chef trained in the Kanto region and sourced fish from Tsukiji; a May 2025 review calls it Edomae sushi by a chef who came back to Kyoto from Tsukiji, run by a couple.
chef_bio.specialty: Edomae nigiri with aged fish.

anecdotes.text: A December 2023 diner found the brass door intimidating but the room calm, with glass as well as ceramic tableware.
An August 2024 regular wrote of the thick-cut tuna, a shima-aji with a secret, and squid cut and salted just so.
A July 2023 diner felt the gentle flow of the sushi reflected the personalities of the chef and the proprietress.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Some vegetable dishes — mizunasu eggplant, mushroom carpaccio (with cheese), fresh yuba — but most plates use meat or fish (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 15:00–23:00; Wed 17:00–22:00; Sat–Sun 13:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「なし」; Tabelog’s English wrongly says one is added). Cards only for bills of ¥5,000 or more; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 36 places, standing (Tabelog). Non-smoking with a smoking area (Tabelog). The menu is limited early in the day until the manager arrives (August 2026). 4th floor of a building on Muromachi south of Kizuyabashi, by Kyoto Stn’s Karasuma exit; 3 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: North of Kyoto Stn, Karasuma exit — 3 min from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: A standing bar with Japanese, Western-leaning and Sichuan-style Chinese dishes, from sashimi to mapo tofu (Tabelog, shop text) · handwritten daily specials with seasonal ingredients and an Italian slant (August–September 2026) · fresh yuba, mizunasu eggplant, mushroom carpaccio with cheese, shrimp mayo, clam salad, fries, changja (2026 reviews) · a quick-drink set of ume liquor, sashimi and beer (August 2026) · beer — medium bottle ¥580 (April 2026), Sapporo Lager — Japanese sake, Black Nikka highball, oolong tea ¥400 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Standing bar · Kyoto Stn north, a fourth-floor counter with big windows] A hard-to-find standing bar a few minutes from the Karasuma exit, cooking well above standing-bar level — fresh yuba, mushroom carpaccio, shrimp mayo, Sichuan mapo tofu, seasonal specials — with beer, sake and highballs. Good for a drink before the Shinkansen. Cards only over ¥5,000.

roles: Owner/manager (unnamed) who cooks the full menu (August–September 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (shop text): a standing bar on the 4th floor of a building almost connected to Kyoto Station, serving authentic Western dishes, sashimi and Japanese dishes, and Sichuan mapo tofu and Chinese dishes. An August 2026 review notes the menu is limited until the manager arrives.
chef_bio.philosophy: Familiar ingredients prepared in ways you have not tried (Tabelog, shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal specials; mapo tofu.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor before a Shinkansen found one young man running the place alone and handling everything well.
A September 2026 visitor was warmly welcomed by the owner and noticed drinks and dishes timed to go together.
An August 2026 visitor came early, when only a short menu is served before the manager arrives, and found it average for the price.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Fries with house mayonnaise sauces, cheese and truffle toppings (2026 reviews); the frying fat is not stated.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00; closing days vary (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); a queue at busy times, shorter for take-away (September and October 2026). CASHLESS — cash is not accepted; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; August–November 2026). Opened 10 September 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinkyogoku — 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Belgian fries: thick, skin-on, pre-fried then fried again to order — crisp outside, fluffy inside (August and October 2026) · Classic Frites single ¥1,155 with one dip, such as Andalouse (house mayonnaise with tomato) or alioli; Gouda cheese topping ¥330; truffle mayonnaise (August–November 2026) · even a small portion feeds two (September–November 2026) · Stella Artois and other beers, ginger ale; no coffee (August–November 2026)
places.notes: [Belgian fries · Shinkyogoku, fries and a beer] A narrow Belgian frites bar off Shinkyogoku: thick skin-on fries double-fried to order (single ¥1,155) with house mayonnaise dips — Andalouse, alioli, truffle — and Gouda on top, with Stella Artois. A small serving is plenty for two. One drink each to eat in; cashless only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a beer bar opened 10 September 2023; Tabelog also lists DE FRITES STAAN HARAJUKU in Tokyo.
chef_bio.specialty: Belgian frites with house mayonnaise.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor found the regular size generous and the tomato mayonnaise sharp and clearly homemade.
An October 2026 visitor came back for the fluffy potatoes, arriving five minutes before opening to be first in line.
A September 2026 visitor found the fries average and the alioli just okay.

places.hours_raw: Shop 11:00–20:00 (Saturday, Sunday and holidays to 19:30), closing days shown on the official calendar (official site). Tabelog lists the upstairs café 11:00–17:00 on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday and closed Wednesday. A "sweets course" runs on set days in two sittings, 13:00 and 15:00, eight guests each; in 2026 it ends with November and resumes in January (official site; Tabelog). At the corner of Sanjo and Shinmachi, 3 min from exit 6 of Karasuma-Oike Stn (official site).

places.notes: [Sweets · Sanjo-Shinmachi, a pastry chef's shop and café] A long-running French cake shop on a corner of Sanjo-dori, with a café upstairs, where Chef Tsutsui — trained at patisseries abroad and in Kyoto hotels — makes additive-free tarts, cakes and chocolates. On set days a 'sweets course' wheels small cakes to just eight guests per sitting. Takarazuka photos on the walls. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: handmade cakes by Chef Tsutsui, who trained at renowned patisseries overseas and at Kyoto hotels, with cakes, chocolates and baked goods free of additives; a second-floor café with a weekend sweets service from a cart, and birthday cakes to order. The official site (Tous Les Deux) lists the shop’s hours and the sweets-course dates.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: carefully made sweets without additives.
chef_bio.specialty: Cake course from the cart; fruit tarts.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 guest found the sweets course like being invited to a party, with eight groups per sitting.
A March 2026 visitor noticed photos of the Takarazuka Revue all over the interior.
A July 2026 visitor came on Gion Festival Yoiyama for the Yamaboko parfait missed the year before.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori counter (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–01:00 (last order 24:00); closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations recommended (June 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 14 seats: 8 at the counter and 6 in private rooms; smoking allowed per Tabelog; VISA and PayPay (Tabelog). On the west side of Kawaramachi-dori just north of Ebisugawa, 457 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; July 2024). Opened 31 October 2021 as a yakitori-and-soba collaboration; reviewers say the soba chef left in March 2024 and soba is no longer served (June 2024).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-Ebisugawa — 457 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori of Kyo-akaji chicken grilled over Kishu binchotan (January 2025 review) · skewers ¥180–280 (February 2025): thigh, negima, seseri, yagen cartilage, tsukune, back liver, sasami, overnight-dried crispy wings, quail eggs, thick fried tofu · small plates: chicken yukhoe ¥780, wasabi-greens ohitashi ¥400, vinegar-miso chicken and lotus root ¥550, spicy cartilage ¥700, chicken-soboro potato salad ¥550 · finish with chicken-and-egg Handa nyumen ¥850 or rice with raw egg (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Kawaramachi-Ebisugawa, binchotan skewers till 1 a.m.] A small counter and two private rooms on Kawaramachi north of Ebisugawa, grilling Kyo-akaji chicken over Kishu binchotan into the small hours. Skewers run about ¥180–280 — don't miss the overnight-dried crispy wings — and the side dishes are as good as the skewers. Finish with Handa nyumen or egg on rice. Book ahead; smoking allowed. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 31 October 2021 as a yakitori-and-soba restaurant, a collaboration between a soba cook from a soba-restaurant family and a yakitori chef. A June 2024 reviewer reports the soba chef left in March 2024 and soba was dropped; it continues as a yakitori counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyo-akaji yakitori over binchotan; crispy dried wings.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor recommends the overnight-dried crispy chicken wings above all.
A May 2026 diner finished with rice, raw egg and mustard-dressed cartilage.
A December 2024 regular comes back about every three months.
