places.name: Sekki (Six Senses Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Some options: the restaurant offers a gluten-free afternoon tea (Tabelog official introduction; August 2026 review). Other dishes are not marked; ask about cross-contact.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A plant-based dinner course was served to a vegan guest in September 2026; the regular menus use fish and meat (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–10:30; lunch 12:00–14:30 (Sunday brunch 12:00–14:30); afternoon tea 12:00–17:30 Monday–Saturday and 15:00–17:30 Sunday; dinner 18:00–21:30 (Tabelog). Service charge 15% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料金 15％」). 52 seats including sofas and an open terrace facing a garden; a private room for 8 (¥6,000 for 2 hours); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; cards (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On basement level 2 of Six Senses Kyoto, near Sanjusangendo, 599 m from Shichijo Stn (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 23 April 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Six Senses Kyoto, near Sanjusangendo — 599 m from Shichijo Stn
places.cuisine: All-day contemporary cooking inspired by the 24 solar terms (sekki): local vegetables, sustainable seafood, house-fermented ingredients; the menu changes about every two weeks (Tabelog) · afternoon tea by solar term, gluten-free and without refined sugar, e.g. Shine Muscat in autumn (August–October 2026) · lunch and dinner courses and a buffet; a cake-and-drink set ¥2,600 (July 2026); a plant-based dinner course on request (September 2026) (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Hotel dining · Higashiyama-Shichijo, Six Senses' solar-term kitchen] The all-day restaurant of Six Senses Kyoto, two floors down yet opening onto a bright garden. The menu follows the 24 solar terms with local vegetables, sustainable fish and house ferments, changing every fortnight. The afternoon tea is gluten-free and refined-sugar-free; a plant-based dinner course has been served on request. 15% service. Near Sanjusangendo.

roles: Hotel restaurant of Six Senses Kyoto; chef not named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: contemporary cuisine inspired by the 24 solar terms of the traditional calendar, with fresh local vegetables and sustainable seafood presented in a modern style rooted in Japanese food culture; homemade fermented ingredients and a gluten-free afternoon tea designed with guest wellness in mind; the menu changes about every two weeks. Opened 23 April 2024 (Tabelog). The hotel’s Cafe Sekki is a separate listing.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: guest wellness and the blessings of each season.
chef_bio.specialty: Solar-term afternoon tea.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner with a vegan friend chose the plant-based course and found the herbs and spices excellent.
An August 2026 guest appreciated that the seasonal afternoon tea was gluten-free and free of refined sugar.
A July 2026 family found some dishes, such as the meat sauce, too grown-up for a five-year-old.

places.gf_detail: Ask: coffee is fine; the food is a castella, toast and an ice sandwich (2021–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: black coffee and tea are plant-based; the castella comes with butter (2021 review).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Fri 8:00–16:30; Thu, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–16:30; closed Wednesday; latest hours on Google Maps. Smoking allowed on the ground floor, so no entry for under-20s (Tabelog); a non-smoking tatami room upstairs looks onto the Imperial Palace trees (2020–2021 reviews). One-hour limit and no laptops (June 2022). 6 seats; take-out; cash only. No espresso and no food menu beyond the castella and toast (Tabelog; reviews).
places.neighborhood: Marutamachi-dori facing the Kyoto Imperial Palace — next to the soba shop Hanamomo; about 7 min walk from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: A tiny coffee house of carefully roasted, hand-brewed coffee (2020–2026 reviews) · medium-roast mocha ¥690 (October 2026); rich blend ¥500 (April 2021); dark-roast Ethiopian mocha; aged coffee with a fruity aroma (January 2025); coffee soda (August 2020) · the "Kawa castella," served hot and pancake-like with butter, also to take away (2021–2025 reviews); toast lunch with a drink ¥1,200 (December 2022); ice sandwich (July 2023)
places.notes: [Coffee · Marutamachi facing the Imperial Palace, a leather-maker’s coffee house] A six-seat coffee house on Marutamachi opposite the Imperial Palace trees, run by a leather craftsman per a 2020 visitor: hand-brewed roasts and aged coffee, and a hot, fluffy "Kawa castella." Smoking downstairs (so no under-20s), a non-smoking tatami room upstairs. One-hour limit, no laptops, cash only. Closed Wednesday.

roles: The master, not named; a leather craftsman whose handmade work is shown upstairs (August 2020)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2020 to 2026 describe a small two-floor coffee house beside the soba shop Hanamomo on Marutamachi: smokers downstairs, a non-smoking tatami room and gallery of the owner’s handmade leather goods upstairs, with a view of the Imperial Palace greenery. An October 2026 visitor enjoyed talking with the master during the careful brewing.
chef_bio.specialty: Kawa castella; aged coffee.

anecdotes.text: March 2023: waiting two minutes for a take-away castella in the cold, "even though there was no one in the store, I was asked to wait outside."
"I was surprised by how fruity and sweet the aroma of the aged coffee was!" — January 2025.
October 2026: "The master brewed it with great care and attention. During that time, we engaged in various conversations."

places.gf_detail: Ask: tea and tofu shiratama (rice-flour dumplings) may suit, but chiffon and pound cakes are served too (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: tea and agar jellies may be plant-based; cakes and the vanilla ice cream are not (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu, Fri 11:00–16:30 (last order 16:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–17:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; seasonal breaks announced (e.g. 10 June to early July). Reservations by phone. No preschool children, to keep the room quiet (Tabelog). 6 chair seats downstairs and a tatami room for 10 upstairs; non-smoking; cash or PayPay only.
places.neighborhood: Shichijo-Takakura — about 8 min walk from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: A Japanese-tea café in a Taisho-era machiya with a small courtyard (2025–2026 reviews) · teas served in a pot with hot water for several brews: kabusecha from Wazuka ¥1,400, hojicha, sencha, karigane, Japanese black tea, Chinese tea (2025–2026 reviews) · homemade sweets: tofu shiratama in three flavours ¥400, yuzu-honey agar with sea-salt vanilla ice cream (with karigane ¥1,600), chiffon cake, hojicha pound cake (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Tea café · Shichijo-Takakura near Kyoto Station, a quiet machiya] A quiet tea room in a Taisho machiya ten minutes from Kyoto Station: a pot of Wazuka kabusecha or hojicha with hot water for three or more brews (the first poured by the owner), with tofu shiratama or yuzu-honey agar, looking onto a tiny courtyard. No young children. One diner found the staff tense (November 2025); another noted mosquito coils and hard chairs. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner, not named; pours the first cup (May 2026)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe an easily missed old house on Takakura near Shichijo, a Taisho-era machiya with old wooden floors and hanging scrolls, one table for four and one for two downstairs, a tatami room upstairs, a courtyard, homemade tea sweets, and a strong focus on brewing each tea well.
chef_bio.specialty: Pot-brewed Japanese tea; tofu shiratama.

anecdotes.text: "The space is quite small, and the staff’s tense demeanor made me feel a bit uneasy" — and no matcha (November 2025).
April 2026: "the prices on the menu might make you think, 'Is this for just one cup?' But they provide a teapot and hot water… about 4 or 5 cups in total."
May 2026: mosquito repellent burning at the entrance, "so there were definitely some bugs around," and an average hojicha pound cake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: aotake、カフェ・甘味、下京区七条通高倉材木町485、JR京都駅・京阪七条駅から徒歩8分、月木金 11:00〜16:30 (L.O. 16:00)、土日祝 11:00〜17:00、火水休み、6月10日〜7月上旬は休業など、予約可、未就学児は入店不可、1階椅子席6・2階座敷10、禁煙、現金かPayPayのみ。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年8月、英語): 大正時代の町家、坪庭、急須とお湯で何煎も、和束のかぶせ茶1,400円、ほうじ茶、煎茶、雁ヶ音、和紅茶、中国茶、豆腐白玉3種400円、柚子蜂蜜の寒天と海洋深層水のバニラアイス (雁ヶ音付き1,600円)、シフォンケーキ、ほうじ茶のパウンドケーキ、一煎目は店主が淹れる、店が狭くスタッフが緊張気味・抹茶がないという声、入口の蚊取り線香と虫、椅子が硬い。

cultural_comfort.note: Quiet room; no preschool children; shoes off upstairs.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura comes with the sets, and the shop says it cannot adjust dishes for allergies (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: temari sushi of fish and roe, chawanmushi, wagyu at dinner (reviews); no individual requests (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:00) Mon and Wed–Sun; dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:30) Wed–Sun; closed Tuesday (and Monday dinner), open on holidays. Reservations: parties over five by phone; changes and cancellations by 16:00 the day before; at least one set per person (preschool children excepted); no individual requests for allergies or dislikes. 30 seats at the counter and tables, a small garden; non-smoking; cards and PayPay; children welcome with notice. Bento to take away (official site). Opened 3 April 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi-Sanjo — 6 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Bite-size temari sushi, each with its own topping, sauce and garnish, with Japanese tea (official site; reviews) · lunch sets: weekday "Enman" set of thirteen temari, a set with tempura and chawanmushi ¥4,800 (+¥300 for a parfait) (August–September 2026); tea tasting set of gyokuro, karigane and more · dinner "Hanakagari" kaiseki: smoked sashimi, katsuo cutlet, guji matsukasa-age, charcoal-grilled wagyu with black-tea miso, temari of shrimp and caviar, ikura, egg with truffle (September 2026) · seen: sea bream with its roe, marinated mackerel, scallop with black olive and basil cheese, buri with miso (July 2026)
places.notes: [Temari sushi & tea · Shinmachi-Sanjo, a counter by a small garden] A calm, stylish room with a hearth and a garden where water runs over rock, serving trays of jewel-like temari sushi — each piece its own topping and sauce — with Japanese tea tastings, and a temari kaiseki at night. Lunch around ¥4,800. Some find it more about looks than flavour: one diner thought the sushi pre-made (October 2026). No allergy adjustments. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Not named; operated by 有限会社ミレニアムテクノロジーインク (NTA invoice register for Tabelog’s number T3120002028537)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 April 2018 (Tabelog). The official site presents temari sushi and Japanese tea at Shinmachi-Sanjo in four languages, with bento of the same temari to take home. Reviewers in 2026 describe roomy tables and counter, a small garden with spring water, a hearth where tea is prepared, and attentive staff who checked when a diner slowed down (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Temari sushi set; Japanese tea tasting.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: the sushi came within two minutes and "it seemed like the sushi had been pre-made, so it lacked freshness and felt more focused on presentation than flavor."
September 2026: a dozen inventive pieces, but "I felt a bit of palate fatigue towards the end" — and the staff asked kindly whether something was wrong when the diner slowed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (souden-kyoto.jp): 手鞠鮨と日本茶 宗田、京都・新町三条、昼の部・夜の部、お弁当 (宗田の手鞠鮨を持ち帰りで)、日本語・英語・繁体字・簡体字、食材が多いので個別の対応は不可。食べログ: 寿司、中京区町頭町110-1、烏丸御池駅から徒歩約6分、昼11:00〜16:00 (L.O. 15:00) 月・水〜日、夜18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30) 水〜日、火曜休み (月曜は夜休み)、祝日は営業、6名以上は電話予約、変更・キャンセルは前日16時まで、1人1セット以上、アレルギー・苦手な食材の個別対応不可、30席、禁煙、カード・PayPay可、2018年4月3日オープン、インボイスは有限会社ミレニアムテクノロジーインク。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 平日限定の円満十三手鞠、天ぷらと茶碗蒸し付きのランチ4,800円 (パフェ+300円)、日本茶の飲み比べ (玉露、雁ヶ音)、夜の花篝会席 (燻製の刺身、鰹カツ、ぐじの松笠揚げ、和牛と紅茶味噌の炭火焼き、海老とキャビア・いくら・卵とトリュフの手鞠)、鯛と鯛の子、しめ鯖、帆立と黒オリーブとバジルチーズ、鰤と味噌、庭と湧き水、囲炉裏、作り置きのようで新鮮さに欠けるという声、終盤に味が重なり疲れるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Official site in English and Chinese; online booking.

places.name: みます屋 おくどはん (Mimasuya Okudohan)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, spring rolls and soy-seasoned obanzai (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based obanzai, fish, meat (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sat 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Monday. Same-day phone bookings and Tabelog online booking (2026 reviews). 50 seats — 20 downstairs incl. a counter by the open kitchen, 30 upstairs, private rooms for 3–16; non-smoking with a smoking area; children welcome; cards, transit IC, e-money and PayPay. Tabelog lists no service charge.
places.neighborhood: Sanjo near Kyoto City Hall — 3 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn
places.cuisine: An obanzai izakaya in a machiya, named for the Kyoto word for a kamado stove: rice, obanzai and local sake (October 2026) · assorted obanzai of nine kinds ¥1,100 (October 2026), grilled fish of the day in Saikyo miso ¥880, sashimi, agedashi tofu, rice balls, tsukune wrapped in yuba as tempura, spring rolls of mochi, mozzarella and mentaiko, a pork-beef-chicken platter (2026 reviews) · lunch: grilled saba-miso and dashimaki set ¥1,280; Saikyo-yaki with a dessert set and homemade ohagi (October 2026) · courses ¥2,980 and ¥3,980 (October 2026) · Fushimi sake and local beer (reviews)
places.notes: [Obanzai izakaya · Sanjo near City Hall, a machiya named for its kamado] A two-floor machiya near Kyoto City Hall serving obanzai with Fushimi sake: a nine-kind obanzai platter for ¥1,100, Saikyo-miso grilled fish, yuba-wrapped tsukune tempura, and ¥1,280 lunch sets with homemade ohagi. Courses from ¥2,980. A sister of The みます屋 on Pontocho. One solo diner at the counter felt in the way of the busy kitchen (September 2026). Closed Monday.

roles: Not named in a source; sister shop The みます屋 (Pontocho, 26004114)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm machiya restaurant on Sanjo near Kyoto City Hall, its name the Kyoto dialect for a kamado, with a counter facing an open kitchen, partitions upstairs, bright and attentive staff, and a crowd of both tourists and locals. Its name is shared with The みます屋 on Pontocho (26004114 in the crawl).
chef_bio.specialty: Nine-kind obanzai platter; Saikyo-miso grilled fish.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: at the counter "it felt like I was eating in a corner of the busy kitchen, and I felt bad about placing my orders."
"The name 'Okudohan' refers to a 'kamado' in the Kyoto dialect." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: みます屋 おくどはん、居酒屋・創作料理・日本料理、中京区三条御幸町通上ル丸屋町318-3、京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分、火〜土 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、日祝 11:30〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、月曜休み、50席 (1階20、2階30)、個室3〜16名、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、子供可、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・PayPay可。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月、英語): 店名は京言葉のかまど、おばんざい9種盛り1,100円、本日の西京焼き880円、お造り、揚げ出し豆腐、おにぎり、つくねの湯葉巻き天ぷら、餅とモッツァレラと明太子の春巻、豚・牛・鶏の盛り合わせ、ランチの鯖味噌焼きとだし巻きの定食1,280円、西京焼きとデザートのセット、手作りのおはぎ、コース2,980円・3,980円、伏見の日本酒、地ビール、カウンターは忙しい厨房の隅のようで注文しづらかったという声、明るく丁寧なスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Obanzai platters to point at; counter or upstairs rooms.

places.name: TRATTORIA M KYOTO (Mercure Kyoto Station)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Fresh pasta, lasagna, pizza and bread refills dominate; risotto is among the lunch mains; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: prosciutto, smoked salmon, Tanba chicken, cheese and meat-sauce lasagna (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 6:30–10:00 (breakfast), 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed on irregular days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). A 10% service charge since 1 April 2024 (Tabelog original 2024年4月1日以降サービス料10％頂戴いたします。). Half-price drinks at lunch during happy hour (May 2026). 80 seats: restaurant counter 8 and tables 24, bar counter 8 and tables 14; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards, transit IC and iD; no QR (Tabelog). 1F of the Mercure Kyoto Station hotel, in front of Nishi Honganji; 7–10 min walk from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: By Nishi Honganji, Mercure Kyoto Station 1F — 10 min walk from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: Hotel trattoria proposing "Kyoto Italian" cooking, with a bar (Tabelog) · M Lunch ¥2,300: two appetisers, soup of the day such as consommé, and a fresh pasta or risotto; lasagna for a supplement; meat course add-on; bread refills (May–September 2026) · à la carte: prosciutto with Grana Padano, a Bismarck pizza with saikyo miso and mushrooms, smoked salmon with fresh yuba, Tanba chicken with panzanella, lasagna, Margherita, chocolate cake (May–August 2026) · casual dinner courses and Kyoto craft gin (August–October 2026) · lunch about ¥3,000–4,000, dinner ¥10,000–15,000 with drinks (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Hotel Italian · by Nishi Honganji, Mercure 1F] The spacious, Japanese-accented trattoria and bar of the Mercure hotel near Kyoto Station: a good-value M Lunch of appetisers, soup and fresh pasta for ¥2,300, and by night Kyoto-tinged dishes such as a saikyo-miso Bismarck pizza or salmon with fresh yuba, with Kyoto gin. Calm even at lunch; service sometimes slow or new. Plus 10% service. Breakfast from 6:30.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the Italian restaurant and bar of the Mercure Kyoto Station hotel, proposing a new "Kyoto Italian cuisine"; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe a large, stylish room with a Japanese aesthetic and sofa seats on the hotel's first floor, opposite Nishi Honganji.
chef_bio.philosophy: A new "Kyoto Italian cuisine" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: M Lunch; Bismarck with saikyo miso.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 guest had to ask for the coffee long after dessert, and found the bill arriving before the drink was finished.
An August 2026 family with children found the staff friendly and enjoyed mixing Kyoto craft gin into cocktails after a hot day of sightseeing.
An October 2026 diner thought a new staff member mixed up the wine orders, and suggested reading from notes when unsure.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・バー・ピザ、下京区油小路町288 メルキュール京都ステーション、地下鉄・JR京都駅から徒歩7分、毎日 6:30〜10:00・11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)・17:30〜22:00 (料理L.O.21:00、ドリンクL.O.21:30)、不定休、予約可、2024年4月1日からサービス料10%、80席 (レストラン カウンター8・テーブル24、バー カウンター8・テーブル14)、禁煙、車椅子可、Wi-Fi、カード・交通系IC・iD 可、QR 不可、新しい「京都イタリアン」の提案。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): ホテルの1階、西本願寺の前、M ランチ2,300円 (前菜2種、本日のスープ、生パスタかリゾット)、ラザニアは追加料金、肉の追加、パンのおかわり、ランチのハッピーアワーでドリンク半額、生ハムとグラナ・パダーノ、西京味噌のビスマルク、スモークサーモンと生湯葉、Tanba の鶏とパンツァネッラ、ラザニア、マルゲリータ、チョコレートケーキ、京都のクラフトジン、コーヒーが遅れた・注文の取り違えとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: International hotel restaurant; 10% service; cards and IC.

places.name: GOOD TIME COFFEE
places.gf_detail: Not GF: the food is toasted sandwiches and mochi toast on wheat bread (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and juices suit, but both sandwiches use duck or sweet toppings with miso sauce, and no vegan information is given (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–17:00; closed over the New Year holidays (Tabelog). No reservations; order and pay at the counter first, then sit (Tabelog; March and July 2026). Cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog; March 2026). 16 seats incl. a counter and a courtyard terrace; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; takeaway; coffee beans for sale (Tabelog; March 2026). A renovated old house down a side lane in a residential area near Shimabara; 2 min from the Shimabaraguchi bus stop, about 12 min walk from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Shimabara, a residential lane — 2 min from the Shimabaraguchi bus stop
places.cuisine: Coffee stand and café in a renovated house (2026 reviews) · kamo-negi hot sandwich ¥990–1,045: duck breast, Kujo negi and Tanba shimeji in a white-miso sauce (February–October 2026) · white peach mochi toast and other sweet toasts (August 2025; September 2026) · drip coffee from a choice of beans, e.g. Tanzania, East Timor, Brazil ¥660; café latte, iced caramel latte; apple juice ¥605 (2026 reviews) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Coffee · Shimabara back lane, renovated house] A quiet coffee stand tucked into a residential lane near Shimabara, with a courtyard terrace: order at the counter, choose your beans, then sit with a duck, Kujo negi and white-miso hot sandwich, or a white-peach mochi toast. No background music, coffee beans to take home. Self-service, so no table service. Open daily 9:00–17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café and sandwich shop near Shimabara with takeaway; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe a slightly renovated old building in a hidden lane, beans to choose and buy, early opening, and many overseas visitors (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Kamo-negi hot sandwich.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor waited here for the Setsubun event at nearby Renkyuji temple.
A March 2026 guest thought the place was takeaway only from outside — and, on asking, sat inside.
A July 2026 visitor wondered why so many inbound tourists find the lane, and noted there is no table service.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・サンドイッチ、下京区突抜2-357、JR梅小路京都西駅から徒歩12分、JR Tanbaguchi 駅から徒歩13分、市バス島原口から徒歩2分、毎日 9:00〜17:00、年末年始休み、予約不可、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・PayPay 可、16席、テラス、禁煙、子ども・ベビーカー可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 住宅街の路地、改装した古い建物、先にカウンターで注文と支払い、鴨ねぎのホットサンド990〜1,045円 (鴨むね、九条ねぎ、Tanba のしめじ、白味噌のソース)、白桃のもちトースト、豆を選べるドリップコーヒー (タンザニア、東ティモール、ブラジル660円)、カフェラテ、キャラメルラテ、りんごジュース605円、BGM なし、豆の販売、中庭、外国人客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the counter first; cards, IC and PayPay.

places.name: スパイシーマサラ (Spicy Masala)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: a roux-style curry with breaded cutlet toppings (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetable curry ¥950 is on the menu, but the base sauce's ingredients are not stated; the beef curry uses meat (October 2026).
places.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–21:00 (last order 20:30) (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Buy a ticket from the machine at the entrance; cutlets fried to order, served in about 5 minutes (2026 reviews). Cards and transit IC; no QR or PayPay; contactless cards not supported (Tabelog; October 2026). Counter seats only; non-smoking (Tabelog). On the 2F of JR Kyoto Station, next to the JR ticket office left of the Shinkansen central gate, with an entrance also from inside the ticket gates on the Nara Line side (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Inside JR Kyoto Station 2F, by the Shinkansen central gate
places.cuisine: Quick curry counter for travellers (2026 reviews) · a smooth original curry and a beef curry with finely chopped meat; "premium beef curry" said to recall the old Shinkansen dining car (October 2026) · toppings and plates: cheese menchi katsu curry ¥920, premium thick-cut pork cutlet curry ¥1,040, chicken katsu, katsu topping (September–October 2026) · vegetable curry with chunky vegetables ¥950; cabbage side ¥150 with refills (September–October 2026) · fukujinzuke and rakkyo on the counter · under ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Curry · inside JR Kyoto Station, by the Shinkansen gate] A fast, cheap ticket-machine curry counter beside the Shinkansen central gate, reachable from both sides of the ticket barrier: freshly fried pork or chicken cutlets on a European-leaning curry, a cheese menchi katsu, a chunky vegetable curry, and a ¥150 cabbage side with refills. Ideal before a train; quick turnover even at noon. Daily 9:00–21:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a curry counter in the JR Kyoto Station building, next to the JR ticket office; registered as an official listing by the operator, with a page on the Kyoto Station Building website. Reviewers in 2026 describe frequent use by Shinkansen travellers changing trains.
chef_bio.specialty: Katsu curry; vegetable curry.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a sixth visit eats here whenever there is time before the Shinkansen.
A September 2026 diner went back for the ¥150 cabbage four times.
An October 2026 business traveller admits coming not for the taste but out of habit, between Shinkansen and local train.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カレー・インドカレー、下京区東塩小路町657 JR京都駅 2F、新幹線中央口の左、JR きっぷうりばの隣、毎日 9:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、予約不可、カード・交通系IC 可、QR 不可、カウンター席のみ (奈良線側の改札内からも入れる)、禁煙。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月、英語): 入口の券売機、カツは揚げたて、約5分で出る、オリジナルのさらっとしたカレー、細かい肉の牛カレー、新幹線の食堂車を思わせる「プレミアム牛カレー」、チーズメンチカツカレー920円、厚切りロースカツカレー1,040円、チキンカツ、野菜カレー950円、キャベツ150円 (おかわり自由)、福神漬けとらっきょう、PayPay とタッチ決済は不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine; counter only; cards and IC, no QR.

places.name: 隈本総合飲食店 MAO (Kumamoto Sogo Inshokuten MAO)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: the signature is wheat-coated kara-age; lunch also has curry and pork kimchi (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fried chicken, pork curry and pork kimchi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); Friday, Saturday and the day before a holiday 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sunday and holidays 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:30), with dinner to 23:00 on a Sunday before a holiday; closed on irregular days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, advised on holidays; one-hour limit at lunch (Tabelog; September 2026). Smartphone ordering, staff take orders if needed (October 2026). 80 seats, private rooms for 6–30+, banquets up to 60 seated (Tabelog). Cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). A high-ceilinged renovated machiya on Higashinotoin just north of Nishikikoji; 4 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin north of Nishikikoji — 4 min walk from Shijo Karasuma
places.cuisine: Izakaya and lunch canteen in a machiya (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · lunch: all-you-can-eat kara-age set ¥1,200–1,300, choose your starting count, rice refills free, small sides and miso soup; daily special; daily special and kara-age set (September–November 2026) · paid flavour changers: ponzu, sweet chili, green-onion salt, shichimi mayo, shiba-zuke tartare ¥50 (2026 reviews) · coarse-ground pork and Kujo negi dashi curry; pork kimchi (October 2026) · evening izakaya and banquet courses (Tabelog) · lunch ¥1,000–2,000, dinner ¥2,000–4,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kara-age · Higashinotoin by Shijo Karasuma, all you can eat at lunch] A lofty renovated machiya near Nishiki Market whose lunch is famous for all-you-can-eat kara-age with free rice refills for about ¥1,300 — crisp, juicy and freshly fried, with ponzu, green-onion salt or shiba-zuke tartare to change it up — plus a daily special and a Kujo negi pork curry. Phone ordering; one-hour limit; book on holidays. Izakaya at night.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya, beer hall and canteen with private rooms for banquets; registered as an official listing by the operator. A sister concept, 隈本ハイカラ万遍飯店, appears in our crawls. Reviewers in 2026 describe a renovated Kyoto machiya with high ceilings like a lodge and a lunch crowd of office workers.
chef_bio.specialty: All-you-can-eat kara-age lunch.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 regular has logged 23 visits, mostly for the kara-age lunch.
An October 2026 guest managed eleven pieces in three orders of five, four and two.
An October 2026 diner whose phone would not connect ordered from the staff, and chose the Kujo negi pork curry over the kara-age.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・ビアホール・食堂、中京区東洞院通り錦小路上る元竹田町644、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩4分、月〜木 11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、金・土・祝前日 11:00〜15:00・18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日・祝 11:00〜16:00 (L.O.15:30)、祝前の日曜は23時まで、不定休、定食は昼のみ、予約可、80席、個室、宴会 着席60名・立食100名、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・PayPay 可。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): 天井の高い京町家、唐揚げ食べ放題1,200〜1,300円 (最初の個数を選ぶ、ご飯おかわり自由)、日替わり、日替わりと唐揚げのセット、味変 (ぽん酢、スイートチリ、ねぎ塩、七味マヨ、柴漬けタルタル50円)、粗挽き豚と九条ねぎのだしのポークカレー、豚キムチ、スマホで注文、昼は1時間制、休日は予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Smartphone ordering (staff can take orders); one-hour lunch limit; cards, IC and PayPay.

places.name: 茶と糀つきあかり (Cha to Koji Tsuki Akari)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Koji- and miso-marinated grilled fish and chicken, sashimi with soy, curry; koji and miso can contain barley or wheat (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but set meals centre on fish or chicken (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Thu 11:00–15:00; Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–20:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). No cards; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 17 seats with a counter; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Facing Nijo-dori just west of Higashidori-Nijo in Okazaki, near Heian Shrine; 2 min from the Higashiyama-Nijo bus stop, 10 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki near Heian Shrine — Higashiyama-Nijo bus stop
places.cuisine: Japanese set meals built on koji: grilled-dish gozen with a choice of koji-marinated fish of the day (mackerel ¥1,800, June 2026; yellowtail, sawara, hamachi) or chicken, half-and-half +¥400, with three-kind sashimi, tofu and miso soup; seafood and tuna nakaochi rice bowls, the "Umiyama" bowl with koji natto; curry; in winter herring in koji amazake and miso with sake-lees soup; hojicha desserts and tea from the owner's home region, homemade shiso juice ¥350 with a set (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Koji set meals · Okazaki near Heian Shrine] A café-like room on Nijo-dori serving gentle Japanese set meals: fish or chicken marinated in koji and grilled, with sashimi of the day, tofu and miso soup, about ¥1,800, plus hojicha sweets and koji natto to take home. Lunch daily but Wednesday; dinner Fri–Sun.

chef_bio.background: Opened 4 March 2020 (Tabelog). A December 2025 reviewer says the owner serves tea from the owner's home region ("Maruyoshi Omi tea").
chef_bio.specialty: Koji-marinated grilled fish.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 return visitor came back for the hojicha and bought the koji natto to eat at home.
A September 2026 diner noted many regulars and a warm atmosphere from opening.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 茶と糀つきあかり、日本料理、左京区正往寺町462-2 インペリアル岡崎 1F、東山駅から徒歩10分、市バス東山二条から徒歩2分、月火木 11:00〜15:00、金土日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜20:00、水曜休み、予約可、カード不可・電子マネー・QR 可、17席、禁煙、子供可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、2020年3月4日オープン。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年9月、英語): 糀に漬けた魚や鶏の焼き物御膳 (鯖1,800円、ぶり、鰆、はまち)、魚と鶏のハーフ +400円、刺身3種、豆腐、海鮮丼、まぐろの中落ち丼、糀納豆の「海山丼」、カレー、冬は糀甘酒と味噌のにしんと粕汁、ほうじ茶のデザート、店主の故郷のお茶、自家製しそジュース350円、常連が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Daily fish listed on a blackboard.

places.name: 喫茶 喜心 kyoto (Kissa Kishin Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breakfasts centre on koji bread, Danish and French toast (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: omelettes, French toast, chirimen-sansho and dairy soups (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon and Thu–Sun 7:30–13:30 (last order 13:00); closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). No bookings; full from opening on some mornings (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews). Cards (AMEX), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 18 seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). In a renovated house with big windows onto greenery, in front of Toyokuni Shrine near the old Great Buddha Hall site; 10 min from Shichijo Stn (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews).
places.neighborhood: In front of Toyokuni Shrine — 10 min from Shichijo Stn
places.cuisine: Western-style breakfast from the Kishin project: "Kishin's Western Breakfast" of seasonal soup (pumpkin, pea, corn and white-miso), koji bread and an omelette plate with roasted vegetables, salad, chirimen-sansho and pickles ¥2,800 (December 2024); Kishin omelette ¥2,400 (August 2025), also tomato-mushroom style (July 2026); French toast, mibuna quiche, chocolate gateau; coffee with coffee ice cubes (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Breakfast café · by Toyokuni Shrine] The Western-breakfast sister of Gion's 朝食 喜心: a bright room with greenery outside, serving fluffy omelettes, seasonal soups and koji bread from 7:30 — about ¥2,400–2,800 with a drink extra. Fills fast with travellers; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 2 September 2022 (Tabelog). Per the official site: the Kishin project runs 朝食 喜心 breakfasts in Kyoto (Gion) and Kamakura; the name comes from a Zen teaching that cooking and eating are training and a joyful act. Reviewers call this the Western-style sister of the Gion breakfast (December 2024, June 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: A hearty breakfast with Japanese spirit, inspired by home cooking (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Omelette breakfast with koji bread.

anecdotes.text: At 9:00 on a May 2026 weekday the room was full, and every other guest was a foreign visitor.
A June 2026 diner found one server struggling with orders, but loved the mibuna quiche.
An August 2025 visitor looked out on the site of Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Great Buddha Hall while eating the Kishin omelette.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 朝食 喜心、喜心とは「人を良くする」と書く食、禅の教え、京都 (祇園) と鎌倉の朝食、喫茶。食べログ (店舗会員): 喫茶 喜心 kyoto、喫茶店、東山区妙法院前側町427-18 Maana Kiyomizu、七条駅から564m、月木金土日 7:30〜13:30 (L.O. 13:00)、火水休み、予約不可、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、18席、禁煙、子供可、2022年9月2日オープン。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年7月、英語): Toyokuni Shrine の前、祇園の朝食喜心の姉妹店、喜心の洋朝食2,800円 (かぼちゃやえんどう豆のスープ、糀パン、オムレツ、焼き野菜、ちりめん山椒、漬物)、喜心オムレツ2,400円、トマトときのこのオムレツ、フレンチトースト、壬生菜のキッシュ、チョコレートガトー、コーヒーの氷のアイスコーヒー、外国人客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Official site in English; many international guests (2024–26 reviews).

places.name: 料庭 八千代 (Ryotei Yachiyo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yudofu and yuba with soy-based dipping sauce, shojin tempura and sesame tofu (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options, and yudofu sets include shojin tempura, but broths may use dashi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 (last orders food 14:00, drinks 14:45) and 17:00–21:00 (last orders food 19:30, drinks 20:45), daily; Tabelog also notes lunch to 16:00 (last order 15:00) (Tabelog). Bookings taken; kaiseki from ¥6,000 must be booked ahead; seat-only bookings may limit the menu (Tabelog). Private garden rooms (8) add 10% service up to ¥5,500 per person and 15% on kaiseki above (Tabelog). Cards incl. UnionPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 80 seats: tatami, sunken seats and tables facing the garden, two terrace seats; children welcome with a kids' menu; non-smoking; parking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On the Nanzenji approach by the Incline; 5 min from Keage Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nanzenji approach — 5 min from Keage Stn
places.cuisine: Nanzenji yudofu and Kyoto kaiseki by a garden (Tabelog): yudofu gozen "Ume" with seasonal hassun, sesame tofu, shojin tempura, soup, rice and pickles; the "Take" tray with fresh yuba ¥4,000 (August 2026); a ¥3,500 course (September 2026); yuba shabu-shabu gozen with yuba rice bowl; chilled oboro-dofu and chilled tofu sets in summer; sukiyaki; kaiseki from ¥6,000 by reservation (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yudofu & kaiseki · Nanzenji approach] A long-established garden restaurant on the way to Nanzenji, with tatami and table rooms looking onto a koi pond: Nanzenji yudofu sets with yuba, sesame tofu and shojin tempura (about ¥3,500–4,000), summer chilled tofu, or kaiseki by reservation. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 24 December 1950 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Kyoto cuisine and Nanzenji yudofu in a calm Japanese setting (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Nanzenji yudofu; yuba.

anecdotes.text: Watching the koi in August 2026, a child was invited by staff to feed them.
An October 2026 guide bringing honeymooners from New York found the couple satisfied, but felt an air of superiority bordering on over-politeness in the service.
A September 2026 diner enjoyed the ¥3,500 course but felt that much tofu was a one-time experience.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 料庭 八千代、日本料理・豆腐料理・すき焼き、左京区南禅寺福地町34、蹴上駅1番出口から徒歩5分、11:00〜15:00・17:00〜21:00 (ランチは16:00まで L.O. 15:00 とも)、無休、予約可 (6,000円以上の会席は要予約)、庭園個室8室はサービス料10% (5,500円まで) または15% (5,500円超の会席)、80席 (座敷、掘りごたつ、庭に面したテーブル)、子供可・キッズメニュー、禁煙、駐車場、カード・PayPay 可、1950年12月24日オープン、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアンメニューあり、インクラインと南禅寺参道に面する。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 南禅寺名物湯豆腐、竹 (生湯葉付き) 4,000円、3,500円のコース、湯葉しゃぶ御膳、冷やしおぼろ豆腐、ごま豆腐、精進揚げ、八寸、鯉の池の庭、テラス席、サービスが慇懃すぎるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Set menus; garden rooms by reservation.

places.name: 錦 平野 (Nishiki Hirano)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dashimaki, grilled fish and obanzai beside tempura, udon and soba; soy-based dashi (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashimaki with dashi, fish, beef (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 8:30–10:30 (last order 10:15) and lunch 11:00–16:30 (last food order 16:00), daily except New Year and occasional closures; Tabelog also gives eat-in 10:00–19:00 (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 50 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; take-out of dashimaki and obanzai (Tabelog). Inside Nishiki Market; 6 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Nishiki Market — 6 min from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: The restaurant of an obanzai shop famed for hand-grilled dashimaki (official site): breakfast gozen of freshly made dashimaki with apple-smoked silver salmon ¥2,750 (October 2026) or smoked mackerel ¥1,980 (August 2026), obanzai, rice refills and dashi chazuke to finish; lunch wagyu-and-dashimaki gozen ¥2,300 (July 2026), special tempura and zaru soba gozen, tempura udon, inari sushi with sansho (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Dashimaki breakfast · Nishiki Market] The dining room of a century-old Nishiki obanzai shop: from 8:30, trays of freshly rolled dashimaki with thick smoked salmon or mackerel, obanzai and a dashi chazuke finish, about ¥2,000–2,750; tempura and soba sets at lunch. Busy with visitors; book ahead.

roles: Company representative 岡 篤 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: an obanzai specialist in Nishiki Market, "raised by customers particular about flavour", hand-grilling dashimaki daily and selling wholesale; a July 2026 reviewer calls it over 100 years old.
chef_bio.philosophy: The unchanging taste of Kyoto, handmade daily (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Dashimaki tamago.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 breakfast guest found the ¥1,800 dashimaki gozen unavailable and settled for smoked mackerel; plenty of foreigners were eating too.
An October 2026 diner found the dashimaki thinner than in photos and too wet with dashi, though the salmon was generous.
A September 2026 solo diner expected something more traditional and found it geared to international visitors, many buying dashimaki to eat in.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 錦 平野、京都・錦市場のお惣菜専門店、変わらぬ京都の味を毎日手作り、出汁を大切に一本一本手焼きのだし巻き、業務用商品、レストラン、中京区錦堺町東入、代表 岡 篤。食べログ (店舗会員): 錦 平野、日本料理・揚げ物、中京区錦小路通堺町東入ル中魚屋町489-1、烏丸駅から徒歩6分、朝 8:30〜10:30 (L.O. 10:15)、昼 11:00〜16:30 (L.O. 16:00)、イートイン 10:00〜19:00 とも、年末年始ほか不定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、50席、禁煙、子供可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 百年以上の老舗、焼きたてだし巻きとりんごで燻した銀鮭の御膳2,750円、鯖の燻製の朝食1,980円、おばんざい、ご飯のおかわり、出汁茶漬け、和牛とだし巻きの御膳2,300円、天ぷらとざるそば、天ぷらうどん、山椒の稲荷寿司、外国人客が多い、だし巻きが薄いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Set menus with photos; busy with international visitors.

places.name: CONTO
places.gf_detail: Ask. The waffles are homemade and gluten-free (August 2026) and the cone is made to an original rice-flour recipe (September 2026), but the bomboloni are fried dough and one ice cream has baked rice granola; no information on shared equipment.
places.vegan_detail: Some: the ice cream is vegan — caramel, kinako, hojicha and brown sugar, yuzu soy milk, carrot cake and other seasonal flavours (July–September 2026 reviews). Ask about the bomboloni.
places.hours_raw: 7:30–19:00 daily, sometimes to 21:00 (Tabelog). Bomboloni from 10:30 (August 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (JCB), Suica-type e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「なし」; Tabelog’s English wrongly says one may be added). Tiny: standing room for 2–3 and a bench outside shared with the queue (Tabelog; June 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Oike west of Koromonotana; 225 m from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog). Opened 10 April 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Oike Koromonotana — 225 m from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Vegan ice cream in unusual flavours — salted-koji caramel coffee, ripe plum, kinako with cacao nibs, hojicha and brown sugar, salted-koji vanilla with baked rice granola, carrot cake, grapefruit and cucumber, yuzu soy milk, pumpkin (2026 reviews) · large single ¥650, three scoops ¥1,100 (July–August 2026) · bomboloni, Tunisian-style doughnuts fried to order — sugar, coconut sugar, limited flavours; mini bombolone ¥330 (July–August 2026) · homemade gluten-free waffles (August 2026); rice-flour cones (September 2026) · coffee (August 2026)
places.notes: [Ice cream and doughnuts · Karasuma Oike, a tiny vegan scoop shop] A stand-up shop on Oike run by two women, scooping vegan ice cream in flavours like salted-koji caramel coffee, kinako with cacao nibs and grapefruit with cucumber (from ¥650), in a rice-flour cone or with gluten-free waffles, plus bomboloni fried to order from 10:30. Open from 7:30; eat on the bench outside.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a doughnut shop opened 10 April 2025. Reviews describe vegan ice cream, Tunisian bomboloni, homemade gluten-free waffles and rice-flour cones.
chef_bio.specialty: Vegan ice cream; bomboloni.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor said one would never guess the kinako ice cream was vegan, and paired it with the gluten-free waffle.
A July 2026 visitor called the carrot-cake ice cream genius-level, in a three-scoop cup for ¥1,100.
A September 2026 visitor saw couples and overseas visitors arriving in search of vegan options.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ドーナツ、中京区御池通衣棚西入西横町174-1 1F、烏丸御池駅から225m、7:30〜19:00 (21:00まで延長あり)、予約不可、カード (JCB)・交通系電子マネー・PayPay 可、チャージなし、立ち席2〜3名と外のベンチ、禁煙、2025年4月10日オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年9月、英語): ヴィーガンのアイス (塩麹キャラメルコーヒー、完熟梅、きな粉とカカオニブ、ほうじ茶と黒糖、塩麹バニラと焼き米グラノーラ、キャロットケーキ、グレープフルーツと胡瓜、柚子豆乳、かぼちゃ)、シングル大650円、3種1,100円、ボンボローニ (10時半から、ミニ330円)、自家製のグルテンフリーのワッフル、米粉のコーン、女性二人で営む。

cultural_comfort.note: Point and order at the counter; many overseas visitors come for the vegan ice cream (September 2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: HiTOHi
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wood-fired plates with homemade bread and focaccia, pasta at lunch (2025–26 reviews); the shop asks for allergies to be told in advance (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Seasonal vegetables, hummus and soups, but breakfast is bacon, eggs and cheese and mains include fish and pork (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Wed–Sat and holidays 11:30–18:00 (last order 17:00); Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30); closed Monday and Tuesday; dinner in two sittings at 18:00 and 19:30 (Tabelog). Breakfast is also served (November 2025, April 2026) — check times when booking. Reservations recommended for breakfast and lunch, same-day seating possible; tables may be shared; more than 30 minutes late without word counts as a cancellation (Tabelog). One drink per person (October 2025, April 2026). Service charge 10% at dinner only (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「ディナーのみサービス料10％」). Cards (incl. UnionPay) and QR, no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). In a residential street, 5 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog). Opened 26 March 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama Sanjo, a residential lane — 5 min from Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: All-day dining over an open wood fire in a 120-year-old machiya: oven-baked breakfast plates, seasonal Kyoto à la carte at lunch, and an eight-course omakase at dinner (Tabelog, shop text) · breakfast set ¥2,800 — homemade bacon, eggs, sausage, seasonal vegetables, cheese, pumpkin soup and homemade focaccia (November 2025–April 2026) · lunch short course: choice of salad, starter and main, with soup, bread and dessert; pork main +¥1,000; up to about ¥8,900 with every option (October 2025; January 2026) · sea bass tartare, pasta (October 2025); hummus, potato bread, whole grilled fish from ¥3,900 (April 2026) · a wide drinks list explained by staff (October 2025)
places.notes: [Wood-fired dining · Higashiyama, a Meiji machiya from breakfast to dinner] A restaurant in a 120-year-old townhouse a short walk from the Okazaki museums, cooking everything over a wood fire: a ¥2,800 breakfast of homemade bacon, eggs and focaccia, choose-your-own lunch courses, and an eight-course dinner. Lovely room and staff; some found lunch pricey for what it was, with one drink each required. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (shop text): an all-day restaurant in a 120-year-old machiya, with oven-baked breakfast plates, seasonal Kyoto à la carte cooked over an open fire at lunch, and an eight-course omakase at dinner; opened 26 March 2025. Tabelog links it to Com-ion, a building that describes itself as a place for people to eat, shop, rest and gather (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: The seasons of Kyoto cooked over an open fire (Tabelog, shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Wood-fired breakfast plate.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 breakfast guest found the bacon crisp and light thanks to the wood fire, though the pumpkin soup arrived cool, and noticed the staff sweating in short sleeves by the fire.
An April 2026 diner in the food trade found the one-drink rule, a hummus served without bread, and fish from ¥3,900 explained in a single line too many issues.
A June 2026 group came on from the Kyocera Museum and shared dishes under the original Meiji-era beams.

Reservations accepted and advised; booked about two weeks ahead in September 2026 (Tabelog; September 2026). Seasonal wagashi sell out by mid-afternoon (June and December 2025). Cards, IC, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 11 counter seats, high chairs — children welcome but warned of the chair height (Tabelog; December 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Gallery and shop on the 2nd and 3rd floors, shoes changed to enter (December 2025). 1 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: By Marutamachi Stn, south of the Imperial Palace
places.cuisine: A Japanese tea specialist pairing seasonal teas — sencha, hojicha (three brewing styles), black tea, matcha — with wagashi (August 2025) · tea and wagashi of the day; choose your matcha bowl from a display (January 2026) · sencha brewed in three infusions in front of you (May–June 2026) · minazuki and tea ¥2,000 (June 2026); seasonal yokan with sudachi sauce and yam with matcha ¥1,600 (September 2026) · shojin sesame dumplings with oat-milk gelato and tea ¥2,100, up to three cups (December 2025) · fig ohagi (September 2026) · kakigori with red-bean soup (June 2026) · tea to take home, e.g. a New Year daifuku tea (December 2025)
places.notes: [Japanese tea · by Marutamachi Stn, a tea counter with a gallery] An elegant 11-seat counter where tea is brewed in front of you over several infusions and matcha is whisked in a bowl you choose, paired with seasonal wagashi (about ¥1,600–2,100). Pottery gallery and shop upstairs. Book ahead; seasonal sweets sell out. Featured on NHK’s “Bi no Tsubo”; English explanations given.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. Reviewers note English explanations for overseas guests (December 2025), about half of the guests from abroad (September 2026), and a feature on NHK’s “Bi no Tsubo” (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Japanese tea in several infusions; matcha; seasonal wagashi.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor was surprised that the first infusion tasted almost like dashi and each later one differed.
A September 2025 visitor came for the pottery and stayed for matcha and a walnut wagashi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: YUGEN、カフェ、中京区亀屋町146、丸太町駅から徒歩1分、11:00〜18:00 (L.O.17:30)、木曜と不定休 (インスタグラムで案内)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、11席、子ども可だが椅子が高い、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 日本茶と和菓子、煎茶、ほうじ茶 (3種の淹れ方)、紅茶、抹茶、選べる抹茶碗、3煎まで、水無月とお茶2,000円、季節の羊羹と抹茶1,600円、精進の胡麻団子とオーツミルクのジェラート2,100円、いちじくのおはぎ、かき氷、2・3階はギャラリーと販売、NHK の Bi no Tsubo で紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain in English (December 2025); counter only with high chairs; book ahead.

places.name: おが和 (Ogawa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Japanese courses with soy-seasoned dishes, sushi and donabe rice with condiments; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led Japanese courses with dashi (official site; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch Monday–Saturday from 12:00 (all start at 12:00, closing 14:00); dinner Monday–Saturday, arrival 18:00–19:00, closing 21:30; closed Sunday (official site). No service charge (official menu; Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「無し」 — the English page wrongly says 10%). Lunch is cash only; dinner takes cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, Discover) (official site). Cancellation or changes on the day or the day before are charged 100% (official site). Smart casual, no perfume; children from junior-high age, eating the adult menu; BYO by arrangement (official site). 11 counter seats; private hire possible; non-smoking (official site; Tabelog). About 10 min from Karasuma-Oike or Karasuma Stn (official site). Opened 2010; at the present Karasuma address since 2024 at the latest (official site; September 2024 review).
places.neighborhood: West of Karasuma-Oike — 10 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Japanese cuisine from Kyoto and the best of Japan: vegetables bought direct from farmers, market fish, rice cooked in a donabe, Kansai sake (Tabelog official introduction) · lunch courses ¥5,500 and ¥12,100; dinner course ¥28,000 (official site, tax included) · e.g. an eight-item seasonal platter, hot appetizers, corn soup, the chef’s sushi, sashimi, and donabe rice with many accompaniments to finish; melon-soda dessert (2024–2025 reviews) · tsukudani gift set ¥5,000 plus tax to order (official site)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · west of Karasuma-Oike, a Sasaki-trained chef's counter] An eleven-seat counter where chef 小川洋輔 (Ogawa), trained at Kyoto Kitcho and Gion Sasaki, cooks seasonal Kyoto cuisine with farm-direct vegetables and market fish, ending with rice from the donabe and plenty to go with it. Lunch courses from ¥5,500 (cash only) are the gentle way in; dinner is ¥28,000. Michelin one star per the restaurant. Junior-high age and up. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: born in 1976 in Chiba Prefecture; trained from 1996 at 京都吉兆 and from 2002 at 祇園さゝ木 (listed as Michelin three stars); opened おが和 in 2010 (listed as Michelin one star). Tabelog’s official introduction names the owner as Ogawa, combining traditional technique with new ideas; reviewers note a move to the present Karasuma address by September 2024. Tabelog gives the surname in English as Ogawa.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: on choosing to cook, the chef’s father said "study Japanese cuisine", words the chef is still grateful for; "SHARE FROM KYOTO" — cherishing the bounty of Kyoto and Japan for the next generation.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal course ending in donabe rice.

anecdotes.text: An August 2024 diner loved the corn soup’s texture and the melon-soda dessert, and found the chef’s smile charming.
A November 2025 lunch guest found the donabe rice with its many accompaniments the real highlight.
A May 2024 first-timer found the food delicious but the kitchen uncommunicative.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-ogawa.com): おが和、京都烏丸の日本料理店、シェフ 小川洋輔、1976年 千葉県出身、1996年 京都吉兆、2002年 祇園さゝ木 (ミシュラン三つ星)、2010年 おが和 OPEN (ミシュラン一つ星)、父の「日本料理を学びなさい」という言葉、SHARE FROM KYOTO。昼のコース5,500円・12,100円 (税込、カード不可、サービス料なし)、夜のコース28,000円、佃煮3種のお土産5,000円 (税別、要予約)。中京区姉西洞院町515、地下鉄烏丸御池・阪急烏丸から徒歩10分、昼 月〜土12:00〜14:00、夜 月〜土18:00〜21:30 (入店18:00〜19:00)、日曜定休、カウンター11席、当日・前日のキャンセルは100%、スマートカジュアルで香水は控えて、中学生以上、持ち込み相談可、全面禁煙。食べログ: 日本料理、サービス料無し、11席、貸切可、公式紹介: 京都と全国の食材、農家直送の野菜、市場の魚、土鍋ご飯、関西の日本酒、店主 Ogawa。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 烏丸への移転、八寸、とうもろこしのスープ、握り、土鍋ご飯、メロンソーダのデザート。

cultural_comfort.note: English website; lunch is cash only.

places.name: 食堂エンドウ (Shokudo Endo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tuna bowls dressed with a gochujang-based marinade, miso soup and sides; no gluten information is published (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tuna bowls (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 daily; closed irregularly; hours may change (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 10 seats — a few at the counter and two tables for four, on uneven floors with steps; cards accepted (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews). Busy with tourists and school trips in season (September 2025). A red-fronted house in a residential lane off Sannenzaka, about 5 min from Kiyomizu-dera; take the left path at the steps from Ninenzaka to Sannenzaka (2025 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Sannenzaka, near Kiyomizu-dera
places.cuisine: Lunch counter specialising in tuna bowls (reviews) · tuna rice bowl of lean tuna marinated Korean-style with gochujang, ¥1,200 (September 2024) · the Oome and Nishiki bowls, with miso soup, a small side and tea in a little pot (May 2026) · beer (September 2025)
places.notes: [Seafood bowls · Sannenzaka, a quiet tuna-bowl lunch near Kiyomizu] A small red-fronted canteen tucked off the crowds of Sannenzaka, with a homely, slightly Ghibli-like interior. The draw is a generous bowl of lean tuna marinated Korean-style with gochujang — about ¥1,200, with miso soup and a pot of tea — and a few other donburi. A welcome escape from the Kiyomizu crowds. Lunch only; closed irregularly.

chef_bio.background: Per 2023–2026 reviews: a small lunch canteen off Sannenzaka that, despite its name, focuses on tuna, especially a gochujang-dressed tuna bowl; it attracts locals, overseas visitors and school groups.
chef_bio.specialty: Gochujang-marinated tuna bowl.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 parent and child escaping the crowds had the Oome and Nishiki bowls, each with miso soup and tea in a little pot.
A May 2024 visitor hesitated at the residential setting but found a quirky, Ghibli-like interior inside.
A September 2025 diner found it lively with overseas visitors and school-trip students.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂エンドウ、海鮮丼・豆腐料理・食堂、東山区清水2-241-4、11:30〜15:00、不定休、10席、カード可。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 三年坂から少し入った住宅街、赤い外観、清水寺から徒歩5分、店内はジブリのような雰囲気で段差あり、コチュジャンで和えた鮪の丼1,200円 (2024年9月)、オオメ丼と錦丼に味噌汁と小鉢と急須のお茶 (2026年5月)、観光客や修学旅行生でにぎわう。

cultural_comfort.note: Small and busy in season; steps inside.

places.name: MAISON TANUKI (メゾン タヌキ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Afternoon tea, plated desserts, parfaits and baked goods; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Cream- and dairy-rich desserts; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00 daily (last order 17:30) (Tabelog). Bookings recommended, especially for afternoon tea; walk-ins join a smartphone waiting list (July 2026). No cover charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「チャージ料なし」). 60 seats over two floors, including sofas; groups up to 8; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; cards, transit IC and other e-money, and QR (Tabelog). In a renovated machiya more than 100 years old, about 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (256 m) (Tabelog; press reports). Opened May 2023 by モンテステリース有限会社 (press release; invoice).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma-Oike, west — 256 m from Karasuma-Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Salon-style café of plated-dessert courses and afternoon tea by a pâtissier, playing on texture, temperature and aroma (Tabelog) · seasonal afternoon tea with free-flow drinks, e.g. peach (August 2026) and Shine Muscat (from 9 September 2026) · matcha Mont Blanc with matcha-hōjicha syrup, pumpkin brûlée Basque cheesecake, seasonal ice cream, strawberry-pistachio kakigori, salted-lemon milk kakigori ¥1,900 · baked goods to take away (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Café · Karasuma-Oike, afternoon tea in a century-old machiya] A salon-style café spread over two floors of a renovated hundred-year-old townhouse west of Karasuma-Oike. The draw is a seasonal afternoon tea with free-flow drinks — peach in summer, Shine Muscat in autumn — and plated dessert courses built on contrasts of texture and temperature; parfaits and kakigori too. Book for afternoon tea. Open daily.

roles: Pâtissier not named; operator モンテステリース有限会社
chef_bio.background: Per press releases: a salon-style café opened in May 2023 by モンテステリース有限会社 (Kyoto) in a renovated Kyoto machiya more than 100 years old, serving afternoon tea, seasonal parfaits and dessert courses; in April 2024 it ran a charity night opening and sold maqaw-pepper cookies in aid of disaster relief. Per Tabelog: plated desserts and afternoon tea by a skilled pâtissier.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: special sweets that highlight texture, temperature, aroma and appearance.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal afternoon tea.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 walk-in checked in by smartphone with six groups ahead.
An August 2026 guest celebrating a friend’s birthday had the new peach afternoon tea.
An August 2026 visitor singled out the free-flow milk tea and kept reordering it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: プレスリリース (2023〜2024年): 京都烏丸の町家カフェ MAISON TANUKI、2023年5月開業、築100年超の京町家を改装したサロンスタイルのカフェ、アフタヌーンティー、季節のパフェ、スイーツコース、モンテステリース有限会社、2024年4月に馬告のクッキーサレと夜の特別営業の売上の一部を寄付。食べログ: カフェ・スイーツ、中京区長浜町143-3、烏丸御池駅から256m、11:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:30)、無休、チャージ料なし、60席、禁煙、Wi-Fi、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、インボイス T5130002022628 (モンテステリース有限会社)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 桃やシャインマスカットのアフタヌーンティーとフリードリンク、抹茶モンブラン、かぼちゃのブリュレバスクチーズケーキ、苺とピスタチオのかき氷、塩レモンミルクのかき氷1,900円、スマホで順番待ち。

cultural_comfort.note: Book afternoon tea ahead; smartphone waitlist for walk-ins.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Italian with pasta, fried dishes and sauces; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Wagyu and seafood lead the menu; nothing vegan is marked (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order food 14:00, drinks 14:30); dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); open daily (Tabelog). No service or cover charge (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料、チャージ料0円いただいていません」). 24 seats: 8 at the counter and 16 at tables; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards including UnionPay, transit IC and other e-money, and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Hidden at the back of the SPACEしんばし building on Nawate-dori by Shinbashi in Gion, 266 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Formerly Youshoku Haru Gion (Tabelog). Operator エフ・シー・ジャパン株式会社, registered at this address (invoice).
places.neighborhood: Gion, Nawate-Shinbashi — 266 m from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Italian with seasonal ingredients and a signature bistecca of top-grade Kuroge wagyu, "ordered by 120% of tables" (Tabelog) · courses ¥6,000; ¥6,500 and ¥8,500 with all-you-can-drink (the latter a Tabelog plan of 12 dishes with the wagyu bistecca) (2026 reviews) · à la carte: appetizer platters, seared kinmedai carpaccio, pastas, pork mains (2026 reviews) · wines chosen to match (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Italian · Gion Nawate, wagyu bistecca by Shinbashi] A calm Italian room hidden at the back of a building on Nawate-dori by the Shinbashi bridge. The signature is a Kuroge wagyu bistecca; around it come seasonal antipasti, pastas and wine. Courses from ¥6,000, with all-you-can-drink options popular with groups before or after the Minami-za. No service or cover charge. Open daily, late.

roles: Chef not named; operator エフ・シー・ジャパン株式会社 (invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: Italian in the streets of Gion built around top-grade Kuroge wagyu bistecca and seasonal ingredients, paired with selected wines; formerly listed as Youshoku Haru Gion. The invoice holder エフ・シー・ジャパン株式会社 is registered at the restaurant’s address.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: dishes that bring out each ingredient’s own flavour.
chef_bio.specialty: Kuroge wagyu bistecca.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 theatregoer came before Kabuki at Minami-za for the ¥8,500 Tabelog course with all-you-can-drink and wagyu bistecca.
An October 2026 party that had booked the wrong date was still given a table.
An August 2026 diner on the ¥6,500 drinks course found nothing memorable.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: OSTERIA IS -祇園- (旧店名 Youshoku Haru Gion)、イタリアン・ステーキ・パスタ、東山区祇園縄手新橋西側 SPACEしんばし1F、祇園四条駅から266m、12:00〜15:00、17:00〜23:00、無休、サービス料・チャージ料0円、24席 (カウンター8、テーブル16)、20名まで貸切可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、インボイス T9130001081522 (エフ・シー・ジャパン株式会社、所在地は店舗と同じ)。公式紹介: 注文率120%の極上黒毛和牛のビステッカ、季節の食材、厳選ワイン。口コミ (2026年、英語): ビルの奥でわかりにくい、6,000円のコース、飲み放題付き6,500円・8,500円 (食べログ限定、12品)、金目鯛の炙りカルパッチョ、南座の前後に。

cultural_comfort.note: Hard to find inside the building; courses make ordering easy.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef yakiniku and offal house (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 17:30–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Wednesday. Booking advised — near full at peak (December 2025); Hot Pepper booking (May 2026). Ground floor 15 seats: a 6-seat counter and two small tables (for 2 and 4); the 2nd floor (25 seats, larger tables) is for members only, or reserved use by members (Tabelog; August 2026); members also get rooftop events (January 2026). Non-smoking; cards, no e-money. Opened 7 July 2015; moved and reopened 26 July 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma-Marutamachi — 1 min walk from Marutamachi Stn exit 3
places.cuisine: A small local yakiniku known for fresh tongue and offal (2025–2026 reviews) · beef-tongue platter and tongue sashimi, negi-salt tongue, special outside skirt, special premium loin (under ¥2,000 for the special cuts, October 2026), thin-sliced premium tripe, liver, "legal" yukhoe, thigh with green onion (2025–2026 reviews) · choregi salad, octopus kimchi, a set course, free-refill oolong tea; lemon ¥50 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Karasuma-Marutamachi, fresh tongue by the station] A cosy, cramped yakiniku a minute from Marutamachi Station, prized for fresh tongue — as sashimi or grilled — and tender outside skirt at fair prices. The upstairs room is for members only. One group of four was squeezed by the cold entrance (March 2026); another diner tasted something like chemical seasoning in the broth (August 2026). Open till midnight; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 July 2015 and reopened at this address on 26 July 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a small ground floor of six counter seats and two little tables, an upstairs for members with larger tables, membership perks including rooftop events, and a crowd of locals.
chef_bio.specialty: Beef tongue; special outside skirt.

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "I wish they had told me there were no tables for four" — the group was seated at a cramped table by the entrance, "and it was freezing," and the group left before getting full.
August 2026: "there was something lingering in my mouth... (perhaps it was a chemical seasoning?) Especially noticeable in the broth."
January 2026: "It seems that if you become a member, there are special activities available on the rooftop."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉 にくしま、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、中京区烏丸通丸田町下る大倉町207-2、丸太町駅3番出口から徒歩約1分、17:30〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、水曜休み、15席 (2階25席は会員限定・会員の貸切利用)、禁煙、カード可、電子マネー不可、2015年7月7日オープン、2019年7月26日移転リニューアル。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 牛タンの盛り合わせとタン刺し、ネギ塩タン、特選ハラミ、特上ロース (特選部位でも2,000円以下)、上ミノの薄切り、レバー、ユッケ、ネギ付きのもも、チョレギサラダ、タコキムチ、おすすめコース、烏龍茶はおかわり自由、レモン50円、1階はカウンター6席と小さなテーブル2つ、会員は屋上のイベントも、4人で狭い入口の席で寒かったという声、化学調味料のような後味という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Small local room; the upstairs is members-only (Tabelog).

places.name: 冬夏 (tearoom toka)
places.gf_detail: Ask: organic tea is the point; the sweets (chocolate, wagashi, cake) are not described for wheat (2022–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options; teas are plant-based, sweets vary (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Tuesday; hours may change. Booking via TableCheck — choose date, time, guests and course (March 2024; March 2025). 6 counter seats; shoes off at the entrance; no photographs in the tea room (2022–2025 reviews); non-smoking; English menu; children welcome; cards (Visa, JCB) and QR. No coffee or food — tea and sweets only; tea leaves and cocoa for sale (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: East of the Kyoto Imperial Palace — 7 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn; 3 min from the palace’s southeast corner
places.cuisine: A tea room of single-origin organic Japanese tea, served brew by brew at a counter (2022–2025 reviews) · courses of one tea and one sweet ("Hajime") or two of each (2022 reviews); about thirteen teas to smell from test tubes before choosing — single-origin sencha from Wazuka, kamairicha from Gokase in Miyazaki, gyokuro, yabukita kabuse (2022–2024 reviews) · sweets: chocolates of rare cocoa, fresh wagashi, red-bean sweets, a cake for +¥300 (2020–2025 reviews) · sencha, roasted tea, herbal tea; tea leaves and cocoa to take home (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Tea room · east of the Imperial Palace, single-origin organic tea] A six-seat counter tea room inside the gallery nichinichi, in a Taisho-era house that was once a Nihonga painter’s home: smell a dozen single-origin organic teas from test tubes, then take each one brew by brew with a chocolate or wagashi. Book online; shoes off; no photos in the tea room. Allow about an hour. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Run by food director Fumie Okumura, per a June 2022 review
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2020 to 2025 describe a tea room sharing a roughly 100-year-old Taisho-era house with the gallery nichinichi, once the home of the Nihonga painter Go Un Nishimura (June 2022), east of the Kyoto Imperial Palace; a June 2022 diner says it is owned by food director Fumie Okumura. Tea leaves, tea tools and cocoa are sold in the same space; the paper bag reads "tea is a work of art" (March 2024).
chef_bio.philosophy: From its shop bag (March 2024): "tea is a work of art."
chef_bio.specialty: Single-origin organic sencha tasted brew by brew.

anecdotes.text: March 2024: "This time, I chose from 13 types of tea. The tea leaves were presented in test tubes, allowing me to smell them before placing my order."
"No photography is allowed inside the tearoom. It’s a rule, so there’s nothing we can do about it, but it’s a shame." — March 2025.
December 2022: tea and sweets take time — "plan for about an hour… but it’s also fine to stay for over two hours if you wish."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: tearoom toka (冬夏)、カフェ・チョコレート、上京区信富町298 gallery nichinichi、神宮丸太町駅3番出口から徒歩約7分、京都御苑の南東角から徒歩約3分、11:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:30)、火曜休み、カウンター6席、玄関で靴を脱ぐ、禁煙、英語メニュー、子供可、カード (VISA・JCB)・QR可、ベジタリアン対応、煎茶・焙じ茶・ハーブティーと菓子のセット、茶葉とカカオの販売、コーヒーと食事はなし。口コミ (2020年12月〜2025年3月、英語): フードディレクターの Fumie Okumura さんの店、大正時代の築約100年の家、日本画家 Go Un Nishimura の旧宅、TableCheck で予約、茶室内は撮影不可、試験管で香りを確かめて選ぶ約13種、和束のシングルオリジンの煎茶、宮崎五ヶ瀬の釜炒り茶、玉露、やぶきたのかぶせ、一煎目は少量の熱めの湯で、1茶1菓の「はじめ」コース、希少なカカオのチョコレート、生菓子、ケーキ+300円、「tea is a work of art」、1時間ほどかかる。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; online booking; shoes off; no photos in the tea room.

places.name: ベトナム料理コムゴン 京都 (Com Ngon Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask: pho and bun are rice noodles, but fried spring rolls, soy-based sauces and shrimp chips are shared kitchen items (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef and chicken broths, pork, shrimp, fish sauce (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–15:30 (last order 15:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last orders food 21:30, drinks 22:00); open all year. Reservations through the official site. 40 seats including a counter and upstairs; non-smoking; children welcome; cards, e-money and QR. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「無し」. Opened 16 December 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Karasuma — 3 min walk from Shijo / Hankyu Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Vietnamese, with about twelve lunch sets (2026 reviews) · pho bo set with braised pork rice and shrimp-chip salad; pho ga ¥1,000; bun cha ¥1,100 (April 2026) and ¥1,250 (September 2026); bun bo Hue; hu tieu and dry hu tieu kho with egg soup; "Com lunch" with fried and fresh spring rolls (2026 reviews) · coriander served on the side; fresh chillies and lime (2026 reviews) · dinner of small plates and drinks (September 2026)
places.notes: [Vietnamese · Shijo-Karasuma, pho and bun cha lunches] A popular Vietnamese restaurant near Shijo-Karasuma since 2011, open every day: pho bo and pho ga, bun cha and bun bo Hue in lunch sets with spring rolls and salad, coriander on the side for the shy. One diner noted rising prices (November 2026); another found the bun bo Hue’s heat fixed and mild (August 2026). No service charge.

chef_bio.background: Opened 16 December 2011 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a quiet, popular lunch spot with many solo women diners, seats upstairs, Bat Trang pottery, welcoming staff, coriander served separately, and a lunch menu of about a dozen noodle and rice sets.
chef_bio.specialty: Pho bo; bun cha.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: the bun bo Hue was milder than promised; "I was informed that the spiciness of the broth couldn’t be adjusted," and the bottled chilli sauce changed the flavour instead.
A returning diner in November 2026: "It was obvious that prices have increased since my last visit."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ベトナム料理コムゴン 京都、ベトナム料理、中京区一蓮社町304、四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩3分、毎日 11:30〜15:30 (L.O. 15:00)・17:30〜22:30 (料理 L.O. 21:30、ドリンク L.O. 22:00)、年中無休、予約は公式サイトから、40席、禁煙、子供可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、サービス料は原文で「無し」、2011年12月16日オープン。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年11月、英語): フォーボーのセット (豚の甘辛煮のご飯、海老せんのサラダ)、フォーガー1,000円、ブンチャー1,100円・1,250円、ブンボーフエ、フーティウ、汁なしのフーティウコー と卵スープ、揚げ春巻と生春巻、パクチーは別皿、生唐辛子とライム、ランチは12種ほど、2階席、バッチャン焼きの器、女性の一人客が多い、値上がりしたという声、ブンボーフエの辛さは調整できないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Online booking; coriander on the side.

places.name: 萬重 ポルタ店 (Manshige Porta)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried nama-fu (wheat gluten), nama-fu dengaku and soy-seasoned dishes (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi soups, sashimi, duck, fish (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–22:00, closing days follow the Porta underground mall. No reservations — full by about 11:30 on a weekday (September 2026), so arrive at opening. Counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome; cards, transit IC, e-money and most QR. Branch of the Nishijin Kyoto-cuisine house 萬重 (26001533) in the Porta mall under Kyoto Station.
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, Porta underground mall — 5 min walk
places.cuisine: Kyoto cuisine sets from a long-established Nishijin house, in the station mall (2026 reviews) · Manshige bento ¥2,200: duck roast with sansho, sashimi, yuba tofu, nama-fu dengaku, clear soup with yuba and fu (October 2026); Kyoto yuba set ¥2,200 with a yuba rice bowl and yuba salad (October 2026); "Orihime" and "Nishijin" ¥3,300 sets (September–October 2026); matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn, +¥660 as an upgrade · à la carte: yuba noodle soup, Kyoto-style fried nama-fu in four colours, three-colour nama-fu dengaku ¥500 (2026 reviews) · a sake flight from the Kyoto brewer 佐々木酒造, including Jurakudai (October 2026)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Kyoto Station Porta, a Nishijin house’s station branch] The Porta-mall outpost of the Nishijin Kyoto-cuisine house Manshige: ¥2,200 bento of duck, sashimi, yuba and nama-fu, a yuba set, matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn, and a sake flight from Sasaki brewery — a calm Kyoto lunch under the station. No bookings; it fills by 11:30. One diner’s dessert bean paste had melted (September 2026).

roles: Not named in a source; a branch of 萬重, a long-established Nishijin Kyoto-cuisine house (October 2026 review; crawl)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm room with a counter in the Porta mall under Kyoto Station, staff who greet guests in Kyoto dialect, quick service and tea refills, and a mix of tourists, solo diners and local regulars; one local has known Manshige since childhood as the family’s place for gatherings and memorials (October 2026). The main restaurant, 萬重, is in Nishijin.
chef_bio.specialty: Manshige bento; yuba set.

anecdotes.text: "I was also comforted by the staff’s warm greeting of 'O-koshi-yasu~' which is typical of Kyoto." — October 2026.
September 2026: "Unfortunately, the red bean paste in the dessert had melted, but the flavors of the dishes and the hospitality were great."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 萬重 ポルタ店、日本料理、下京区東塩小路町902 京都駅前地下街ポルタ内、京都駅から徒歩5分、毎日 11:00〜22:00、休みはポルタに準じる、予約不可、カウンター席、禁煙、子供可、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR可、公式サイトは京料理 萬重。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 萬重弁当2,200円 (鴨ロースの山椒、お造り、湯葉豆腐、生麩田楽、湯葉と麩のお吸い物)、京ゆば膳2,200円 (湯葉丼、湯葉サラダ)、織姫、西陣3,300円、秋の松茸の土瓶蒸し (+660円で変更)、湯葉の煮麺、京風の生麩の揚げ物4色、三色生麩田楽500円、佐々木酒造の飲み比べ (聚楽第)、西陣の老舗、京言葉の「おこしやす」、11時半には満席、デザートの餡が溶けていたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: No reservations; arrive at opening.

places.name: トマトさん (Tomato San)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: curry roux, breaded cutlets and fritters, spaghetti and yakisoba (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu mince curry, hamburg steak, chicken and shrimp dishes, omelettes (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Thursday–Sunday 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–20:30 (last order 19:30); closed Tuesday and Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; July 2024). 10 counter seats; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog). The menu has varied: curry only for a time in 2024, set lunches again by 2025–2026 (2024–2026 reviews). A red-tomato noren on a white ground in the Shimabara shopping street, a 150-year-old building near the Kyoto Aquarium; about 500 m from Tanbaguchi Stn (Tabelog; January and October 2024).
places.neighborhood: Shimabara shopping street — near the Kyoto Aquarium, 7 min walk from Tanbaguchi Stn
places.cuisine: Homely yoshoku and curry from a couple who once ran a French restaurant (January 2024) · lunches ¥1,000–1,700 with salad and its homemade dressing, rice and sometimes miso soup: special lunch of shrimp fritters and chicken cutlet ¥1,300, braised hamburg ¥1,200, teriyaki chicken set ¥1,000, luncheon of hamburg and ebi fry with dashimaki (January 2024–March 2026) · the "Spielberg": a cheese-filled hamburg inside an omelette (January 2024) · curries ¥980: wagyu mince, grilled chicken, shrimp, with a spicy sauce on the side; large +¥200; homemade iced coffee (July–October 2024) · spaghetti and yakisoba on the menu too (January 2024) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Shimabara, couple-run for over 40 years] A ten-seat counter under a red-tomato noren in old Shimabara, run by a cheerful couple who chat with every guest: crisp shrimp fritters and chicken cutlet, braised mini hamburgs, the cheese-in-hamburg omelette called the Spielberg, and a wagyu mince curry, all with a salad in homemade dressing. The menu shifts over time. Cash only; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner couple (unnamed), together for over 40 years, formerly running a French restaurant (January 2024 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yoshoku counter in Shimabara. Reviewers in January 2024 describe a couple who previously owned a French restaurant and have run this place for over 40 years in a 150-year-old building; later reviewers note a curry-only period in 2024 and a broader lunch menu again by 2025–2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Spielberg (cheese hamburg omelette); curry.

anecdotes.text: A January 2024 guest found everyone else at the counter was a regular chatting happily with the owner.
A July 2024 diner ordered the curry large for ¥200 more — and regretted it, the portion was so big.
A July 2024 returnee, back after over a decade, was served a homemade iced coffee after the ¥980 curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食、下京区二人司町2、Tanbaguchi 駅から486m、月・木〜日 11:30〜14:30 (L.O.13:30)・17:00〜20:30 (L.O.19:30)、火・水定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、10席、禁煙、テイクアウト。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年3月、英語): 島原、京都水族館の近く、白地に赤いトマトののれん、築150年の建物、元フレンチの店の夫婦が40年以上営む、手作りドレッシングのサラダ、ランチ1,000〜1,700円、スペシャルランチ1,300円 (海老フリッターとチキンカツ)、煮込みハンバーグ1,200円、照り焼きチキン1,000円、ハンバーグと海老フライとだし巻き、チーズ入りハンバーグのオムレツ「Spielberg」、カレー980円 (和牛ミンチ、焼きチキン、海老)、大盛り+200円、自家製アイスコーヒー、スパゲティと焼きそば、一時はカレーのみ、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter only; friendly owners; cash only.
