places.name: 懐石フランス料理 グルマン橘 (Gourmand Tachibana, RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses of French dishes with Japanese ingredients and tea, plus walnut bread, cutlets and desserts; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of salmon, sea bream, Tanba chicken and pork, wagyu, foie gras and eel (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 12:00–15:30 and 17:00–21:30; Saturday–Sunday 11:30–15:30 and 17:00–21:30; last orders 14:30 and 20:00; irregular closing days, see the hotel website (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, online too (Tabelog; May 2026). A 15% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料１5％). Courses such as Miyako, Mai, Tokyo and Tachibana at lunch from about ¥5,000, with member prices (2025–2026 reviews). 28 seats, mainly a counter facing the chef, and private rooms for 4–30 (fee) (Tabelog; May 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). B1F of RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto; hotel parking free for 3 hours with a ¥4,000 spend from 1 April 2026; 7 min walk west of Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto B1F — 7 min walk west of Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: French courses in a kaiseki style at a counter, with Japanese ingredients and tea through the dishes (2025–2026 reviews) · lunch courses from about ¥5,000 with appetiser, special dish, soup, fish, meat, rice, dessert and coffee; upgrades such as wagyu strip loin or fillet (September 2025–June 2026) · e.g. salmon tartare with celeriac mousse, shiitake stuffed with chicken and chestnut, sea bream with white-wine mushroom sauce, parrotfish, mozzarella tonkatsu, Tanba pork in shiso with plum sauce (September 2025) · dinner with wine pairing: eel and foie gras, smoked managatsuo, walnut bread with hojicha butter and yuzu marmalade (April 2026) · a five-dessert finish (September 2025) · lunch ¥6,000–8,000, dinner ¥10,000–15,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kaiseki French · RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto B1F] A counter of French cooking in kaiseki rhythm at the RIHGA Royal near Kyoto Station: seasonal Japanese ingredients and tea woven into salmon tartare, chestnut-stuffed shiitake, sea bream and wagyu, with good-value lunch courses and a sommelier-led wine pairing at dinner. Private rooms suit family occasions. Plus 15% service. Hotel parking deal.

roles: Hotel kitchen at the counter (chef unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the kaiseki-style French restaurant of RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto; registered as an official listing by the operator. An April 2026 reviewer recalls monthly wine events here over ten years ago hosted by sommelier Yoshinaga, who has since moved up but still served as sommelier that night, and notes the chef has changed since then.
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto ingredients with the richness of French cuisine (April 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Kaiseki-style French course.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 couple, celebrating the second of two yearly anniversaries, received complimentary ice cream and flowers.
In September 2025 a family chose a private room here for the formal meeting of both sides before a wedding.
An April 2026 guest, back after a decade, was served by sommelier Yoshinaga, who had hosted monthly wine evenings years before.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・洋食、下京区松明町1 リーガロイヤルホテル京都 B1F、JR京都駅から西へ徒歩約7分、月〜金 12:00〜15:30・17:00〜21:30、土日 11:30〜15:30・17:00〜21:30 (L.O.14:30・20:00)、不定休、予約可、サービス料15%、28席、個室 (4〜30名、別料金)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、ホテルの駐車場は2026年4月1日から4,000円以上の利用で3時間無料。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年9月、英語): カウンターが中心、日本の食材とお茶を使うフレンチ、ランチのコース (Miyako、Mai、Tokyo、Tachibana など) 5,000円ほどから、会員価格、和牛のサーロインやフィレへの変更、サーモンのタルタルとセロリアックのムース、鶏と栗の椎茸、鯛の白ワインときのこのソース、ブダイ、モッツァレラのとんかつ、Tanba の豚の大葉とチーズ巻き、夜はワインペアリング、鰻とフォアグラ、まながつおの燻製、胡桃のパンとほうじ茶バター、5種のデザート、ソムリエの Yoshinaga さん、両家の顔合わせ、記念日のサービス。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; book online; 15% service; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: 奥丹 清水 (Okutan Kiyomizu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yudofu in kombu water is simple, but the dipping sauce is soy-based and the set includes tempura and miso dengaku; ramen is served from 14:30 (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The set is tofu, sesame tofu, dengaku, tempura and tororo with a kombu broth, but the dipping sauce's base is not stated and no vegan information is given (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday and Friday 11:00–16:00; Saturday–Sunday 11:00–17:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised at weekends (Tabelog; October 2026). Ramen from 14:30 (September 2026). Cash only (Tabelog; March and August 2026). 120 seats on tatami, shoes off, with private rooms facing the garden; designated smoking area (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On the approach to Kiyomizu-dera, Kiyomizu 3-chome; about 15 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; June 2026).
places.neighborhood: On the approach to Kiyomizu-dera — 15 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Long-established yudofu restaurant in an old building with a garden (2026 reviews) · Okimari set ¥4,400: yudofu of silken tofu in kombu dashi, sesame tofu, dengaku, vegetable tempura, tororo (March–October 2026) · Mukashi tofu set ¥5,500, with a firmer old-style tofu (March and August 2026) · ramen from 14:30 (September 2026) · sake (Tabelog) · about ¥4,000–5,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yudofu · on the slope to Kiyomizu-dera, garden rooms] A historic tofu house on the Kiyomizu approach, calm inside despite the crowds: a set of silky yudofu in kombu broth with sesame tofu, dengaku, tempura and tororo for ¥4,400, or a firmer old-style tofu for ¥5,500, eaten on tatami with views of the garden — glorious in cherry and maple seasons. Some find it pricey for what it is. Cash only; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a tofu and Japanese-cuisine restaurant near Kiyomizu-dera with tatami and private rooms; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 call it a long-established yudofu restaurant in a historic building with a well-kept garden; a March 2026 reviewer was told one private room has been visited by the Emperor.
chef_bio.specialty: Yudofu; mukashi tofu.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 party of three generations was shown to a private room said to have been visited by the Emperor.
A September 2026 repeat visitor was surprised to find ramen served from 14:30.
A May 2026 guest found the food underwhelming for ¥4,400 with no dessert, and the new ramen out of keeping with a yudofu house.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 豆腐料理・日本料理、東山区清水3-340、祇園四条駅1番出口から徒歩約15分、月〜水・金 11:00〜16:00、土日 11:00〜17:00、木曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、120席、座敷、個室、分煙、テイクアウト、日本酒にこだわる。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 清水寺の参道、歴史ある建物、庭、靴を脱ぐ、「Okimari」のセット4,400円 (絹ごしの湯豆腐、昆布だし、胡麻豆腐、田楽、天ぷら、とろろ)、「Mukashi tofu」のセット5,500円 (固めの豆腐)、14時半からラーメン、現金のみ、週末は予約がおすすめ、天皇が訪れた個室という話 (2026年3月)、割高との声。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off, tatami; set courses; book at weekends; cash only.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. A shojin (vegetarian) tempura with tororo soup was served in October 2026, and Kyoto vegetables appear at breakfast, but most of the buffet uses meat, fish, eggs and dairy (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday and around holidays 6:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); Friday–Sunday and holidays 6:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); open year-round; from 7 May to 31 August 2026, 6:30–22:00 daily with dinner buffets of 120 minutes (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; holiday prices differ (Tabelog). A 15% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料15％). Lunch buffet 90 minutes (September 2026). 164 seats (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 2F of Hotel Granvia Kyoto, right of the JR Kyoto Station central gate; 2 hours' parking at the station building east car park with a meal (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Hotel Granvia Kyoto 2F, in JR Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: Hotel buffet café from breakfast to dinner (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · breakfast buffet: grilled Kyoto vegetables, obanzai, sea bream chazuke, roast wagyu, hash browns, omelettes made to order with five fillings (August–October 2026) · lunch and dinner buffets of Japanese and Western dishes incl. sushi, tempura, roast beef, salads, pizza, pasta, curry, fried rice, shumai (September–October 2026) · seasonal sweets buffets, e.g. autumn with muscat, pear, Tanba chestnut and hojicha, and Halloween (September–October 2026) · café use with cakes from the showcase; cakes to take away (October 2026) · about ¥5,000–10,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Hotel buffet · Hotel Granvia, inside Kyoto Station] The bright, roomy buffet café of the Granvia over Kyoto Station: a lavish breakfast with omelettes to order and roast wagyu from 6:30, Japanese and Western buffets at lunch and dinner, seasonal sweets buffets, and cakes for a quiet tea. Busy at opening; one guest found drink service slow. Plus 15% service. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the café restaurant of Hotel Granvia Kyoto, directly connected to JR Kyoto Station; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe a popular buffet with many overseas guests, a line at the 6:30 opening (September 2026), and a live kitchen for omelettes (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Breakfast buffet; sweets buffet.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor arriving at the 6:30 opening found about ten people already in line.
An October 2026 guest choosing between this and the Hilton buffet came here for the reviews, and found the meat and tempura strong but the drink service slow.
A September 2026 diner with food allergies had to pick carefully across the buffet.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビュッフェ・カフェ・ケーキ、下京区烏丸通塩小路下ル JR京都駅中央口 ホテルグランヴィア京都 2F、JR京都駅中央改札の右、月〜木・祝前日・祝翌日 6:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、金土日祝 6:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、無休、2026年5月7日〜8月31日は6:30〜22:00、ディナーブッフェは120分制、予約可、年末年始は料金が変わる、サービス料15%、164席、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 京野菜の焼き物、おばんざい、鯛茶漬け、黒毛和牛のロースト、ハッシュドポテト、5種から選べるオムレツ、寿司、天ぷら、ローストビーフ、ピザ、パスタ、カレー、焼売、季節のスイーツブッフェ (秋、ハロウィン)、ショーケースのケーキでカフェ利用、ケーキの持ち帰り、精進天ぷらととろろ汁、ランチは90分、朝6時半から行列、外国人客が多い、駐車場2時間無料、ドリンクが遅いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel buffet; book ahead at weekends; 15% service; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: 両川 (RYOSEN)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi and soy-seasoned dishes, a kombu soy for sashimi, mapo tofu and pasta at lunch (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cooking built on dashi, with mackerel, eel, beef and chicken. The course has included a vegan tom yum soup (September and October 2026), so ask.
places.hours_raw: Lunch Tue–Fri 11:30–13:30, no lunch reservations; dinner Mon–Fri 18:00–22:00, Sat, holidays and the days before and after holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday, and dinner is closed on the 1st and 3rd Monday; may close early when food runs out (Tabelog). Dinner is hard to book — reserve through the website, Ikkyu or Instagram (March and June 2026); call for parties of 5 or more (Tabelog). Tabelog’s reservation notes say ¥200 is added to the course fee as a service charge. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: tables for 8, a counter for 6 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children 10 and over only (Tabelog). Dish photos may not be posted on social media (September 2026). In a townhouse on Oshikoji west of Muromachi, behind the Kyoto International Manga Museum; 225 m from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 November 2004 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Oshikoji Muromachi, behind the Manga Museum — 225 m from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Simmered dishes and seasonal cooking built on a carefully made dashi, with sake and wine (Tabelog, shop text; March 2026) · the "Netflix course" of dishes from the show — chicken and vegetable soup, kanpachi sashimi with house kombu soy, the signature stew, squid with yomogi miso, a vegan tom yum, eel, beef, RYOSEN mapo tofu, simmered mackerel — about ¥9,000 (July and October 2026) · saba-ni (simmered mackerel), praised by the actor Yutaka Matsushige (February 2026) · weekday lunch: oyakodon set, curry with obanzai sides (April–October 2026) · Japanese sake and craft beer (October 2026)
places.notes: [Small kitchen · Karasuma Oike, the actor’s Kyoto favourite] A townhouse restaurant behind the Manga Museum where the owner explains every dashi: simmered mackerel, kanpachi with kombu soy, mapo tofu and a vegan tom yum on a course of about ¥9,000. Long a favourite of the actor Yutaka Matsushige, who brought it to a Netflix series, so dinner is hard to book; weekday lunch (oyakodon, curry) is walk-in. Over-10s only; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who explains the dashi at the table (March 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (shop text): a small restaurant in a townhouse on Oshikoji Muromachi, open since 2004, prizing its simmered dishes and seasonal cooking with sake and wine. Reviews from February–October 2026 say it is a long-time favourite of the actor 松重豊 (Yutaka Matsushige), who featured it on a Netflix series; a June 2026 review says the actor has been coming since the owner’s mother ran a small restaurant called "Ichiraku".
chef_bio.specialty: Simmered dishes; dashi; saba-ni.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 couple was served a dashi vegetable soup while the owner explained how the dashi is made.
A September 2026 diner asked about social media and was told the menu may be posted but not the dishes; the vegan tom yum, made after much trial and error, impressed.
An eighth-visit regular in September 2026 brought colleagues and finally got the simmered dish again; in July the same regular had a Doyo-no-Ushi eel bento.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、中京区室町通押小路西入ル蛸薬師町293、烏丸御池駅から225m、昼 火〜金11:30〜13:30 (予約不可)、夜 月〜金18:00〜22:00・土祝17:00〜22:00、日曜休み、夜は第1・第3月曜休み、予約はコース料金に200円のサービス料 (英訳)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、14席、禁煙、10歳以上、2004年11月25日オープン、炊き物と季節の料理、日本酒とワイン。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): 松重豊が長年通う店、Netflix の番組、Netflix コース約9,000円 (鶏と野菜のスープ、カンパチの刺身と昆布醤油、看板の煮込み、いかのよもぎ味噌、ヴィーガンのトムヤム、鰻、牛肉、麻婆豆腐、鯖の煮付け)、鯖煮、昼の親子丼やカレー、出汁を説明する店主、料理の写真の SNS 投稿は不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Book dinner well ahead online or via Instagram; lunch is walk-in on weekdays; children 10 and over. No English evidence found.

places.name: Restaurant 信 (Restaurant Shin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. French courses opening with a mini burger, with sauces, mousses and plated desserts (2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-led courses from contracted Kyoto farms, but fish and meat mains and dairy desserts (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30, dinner 18:00–21:00; closed Monday; open over New Year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, and dinner can be hard to book (Tabelog; May 2025). No service or cover charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料、チャージ料なし」). Cards, Rakuten Edy and QR (Tabelog). 12 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Children, a kids menu and strollers welcome (Tabelog). In a machiya-style room on Teramachi south of Takeyamachi, near the Imperial Palace; 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 18 July 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi Takeyamachi, by the Imperial Palace — 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: French cooking around freshly picked organic Kyoto vegetables (Tabelog, shop text) — pesticide-free produce from contracted farms in Sonobe (October 2026) · courses that open with a mini burger amuse-bouche (2025–26 reviews) · lunch with a double main of fish and meat (November 2025); chef’s recommended dinner course and anniversary courses (June 2025) · fish and mussels with sakura-shrimp mousse and ratatouille (March 2026) · a dessert where warm sauce melts a white-chocolate dome over fruit (August 2025) · caffeine-free drinks on request (March 2026)
places.notes: [French · Teramachi by the Imperial Palace, a couple’s 12-seat room] A warm little French restaurant in a white-and-wood machiya, run by a couple, cooking pesticide-free vegetables from Sonobe farms into colourful courses — a mini-burger amuse, sakura-shrimp mousse, a melting white-chocolate dessert. Lunch and dinner courses suit anniversaries; children welcome. Closed Monday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), running the restaurant with a partner as a couple (April 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: not a high-end image of French dining but a warm, comfortable French restaurant full of the chef’s care for ingredients, flavour and hospitality. Per Tabelog: opened 18 July 2011. An October 2026 review notes pesticide-free vegetables from contracted farms in Sonobe; an April 2026 review describes it as run by a couple.
chef_bio.philosophy: Special encounters through ingredients, flavour and hospitality (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable-led French courses.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 couple celebrated a wedding anniversary at a place passed many times without realising it was French.
A March 2026 party arrived very late, and the staff stayed calm and even arranged caffeine-free drinks.
A May 2025 family found out only afterwards that it is hard to book, and enjoyed every dish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 高級フレンチのイメージではなく、素材、味、おもてなしにシェフの想いがあふれる温かく心地よいフレンチ。食べログ: フレンチ・ヨーロッパ料理・野菜料理、中京区寺町竹屋町下る久遠院前町667-1、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩8分、昼11:30〜14:30・夜18:00〜21:00、月曜休み、予約可、サービス料・チャージ料なし、カード・楽天Edy・QR 可、12席、禁煙、子供可・キッズメニュー、2011年7月18日オープン、京都の採れたての有機野菜。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年10月、英語): ミニバーガーのアミューズ、魚と肉のダブルメインの昼のコース、記念日コース、桜海老のムースと魚とムール貝、ラタトゥイユ、白いチョコレートが溶けるデザート、園部の契約農家の無農薬野菜、夫婦で営む、予約が取りにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a lunch or dinner course; family-friendly with a kids menu. No English evidence found.

places.name: 京料理 先斗町 富美家 (Kyoryori Pontocho Fumiya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki with tofu and yuba dishes, hamo and ayu, soy-based broths (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based Kyoto cooking with hamo, ayu, sashimi and beef; even the soy-milk yuba hot pot comes in a course (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); open daily May–September, irregular closures October–April; open over New Year (Tabelog; official site). Kawadoko (river-terrace) seating from 1 May, moved indoors in rain (official site). Reservations by phone or online; the cheapest course is often the Tabelog plan (September 2026). Service charge 10% at dinner, none at lunch, and no kawadoko seat charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「ディナー:10% ランチ:なし 共に床席料は頂いておりません。」). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 40 seats with private rooms; smoking in the courtyard only (Tabelog). Two doors south of the Pontocho Kaburenjo on the Shijo side; 5 min from Sanjo, Gion-Shijo and Kawaramachi Stns (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, by the Kaburenjo — 5 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto cuisine and tofu dishes on Pontocho, with kawadoko dining over the Kamo River from May (Tabelog; official site) · soy-milk yuba hot-pot lunch set ¥5,500 (April 2026) · hamo courses — hamo shabu-shabu, grilled ayu (May–September 2026); kawadoko course (June 2026) · a lunch with a tasting of three sakes (May 2026) · a Tabelog-booked course with a drink, sashimi and meat ¥8,800 (September 2026) · lunch around ¥5,000 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Pontocho, yuba and hamo by the Kamo River] An old Pontocho house next to the Kaburenjo with a summer kawadoko and window rooms over the Kamo River: yuba hot pot, hamo shabu-shabu, grilled ayu and Kyoto kaiseki, from about ¥5,000 at lunch. Reviews are mixed — the setting wins, but some September 2026 diners found insects on the terrace, little hamo and patchy service. 10% service at dinner only.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a Pontocho Kyoto-cuisine restaurant with a summer kawadoko, open over New Year, which notes on its site a 75th anniversary (year not stated). Per Tabelog: Kyoto cuisine and tofu dishes, two doors south of the Pontocho Kaburenjo.
chef_bio.specialty: Yuba hot pot; hamo dishes; kawadoko dining.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor was led to a private second-floor room with the Kamo River right in front for a hamo lunch.
A September 2026 diner asked to move indoors because of insects on the terrace, and found little hamo in a hamo course.
An August 2026 diner watched the staff mop the terrace dry when the rain stopped so the kawadoko could open.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都 先斗町 富美家 (川床・納涼床)、5月1日から納涼川床、雨天は店内、年末年始も営業、75周年 (年の記載なし)、ネットと電話で予約。食べログ: 日本料理・豆腐料理、中京区先斗町歌舞練場南隣2軒目、三条駅などから徒歩5分、昼11:30〜15:00・夜17:00〜23:00、5〜9月は無休、10〜4月は不定休、予約可、ディナーはサービス料10%、ランチはなし、床席料なし、カード可、40席、個室、喫煙は中庭。口コミ (2026年3月〜9月、英語): 豆乳湯葉鍋の昼のセット5,500円、鱧のしゃぶしゃぶ、焼いた鮎、川床のコース、日本酒3種の飲み比べ、食べログ予約の8,800円のコース、鴨川の眺め、虫や鱧が少ないとの不満も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course (the kawadoko in season); ask for a river-view room. No English evidence found.

places.name: 先斗町 四季 よし菜 (Pontocho Shiki Yoshina)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-style kaiseki with tofu, yuba, dengaku and obanzai (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based kaiseki with hamo, ayu and fish (2026 reviews); tofu and yuba dishes are part of courses.
places.hours_raw: BOOKINGS FROM OUTSIDE JAPAN ARE NOT ACCEPTED. The official site says: 「日本国外からまたはホテルの電話番号や直接ご連絡の取れないお電話番号、メールアドレスでのご予約は出来ません。日本語のみ対応可」 — no reservations from outside Japan, or from hotel phone numbers or numbers and emails that cannot be reached directly; Japanese only. Dinner 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:15); special lunches 12:30–14:30 on set days, for 4 or more, courses only, booked 3 days ahead; closed irregularly — see the official site (Tabelog; official site). Phone bookings 13:00–15:00 (Tabelog). Kaiseki and the winter hot-pot course need booking 3 days ahead (official site). Seat requests (river view, private room for two, terrace position) are not taken (Tabelog). Kawadoko from May to 15 October, indoors in bad weather (Tabelog). Service charge 5%, included in course prices (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料５％頂いております。※コース料金には含まれております。」). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 60 seats: counter, tables, private rooms, an 11-seat kawadoko (Tabelog). Entirely non-smoking; children under 10 by arrangement (Tabelog). Fourth house past Pontocho Park toward Sanjo, river side; 5 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, by Pontocho Park — 5 min from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style kaiseki with a monthly menu, and a winter hot-pot course (official site) · seasonal courses with hamo, ayu and dengaku (August 2026) · tofu, yuba, fish and obanzai dishes with Kyoto sake (September 2026) · a counter where the chefs cook in front of you (August and September 2026) · kawadoko dining over the Kamo River from May to mid-October (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Pontocho, tofu and a river terrace — no bookings from outside Japan] A Pontocho house with a live-kitchen counter, private rooms and a kawadoko over the Kamo River, serving monthly Kyoto kaiseki, tofu and yuba dishes and a winter hot pot. The official site states that it does not accept reservations from outside Japan or from hotel phone numbers, and handles bookings in Japanese only. Dinner from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site and Tabelog: a Pontocho Kyoto-cuisine restaurant with a kawadoko, monthly Kyoto-style kaiseki and a winter hot-pot course; it does not take reservations from outside Japan or from hotel phone numbers, and bookings are in Japanese only.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-style kaiseki; tofu and yuba.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner enjoyed the stylish chef’s live cooking at the counter and found the prices reasonable for the setting.

places.cuisine: Café and bar of 森田氷室本店, Kyoto’s oldest ice maker, serving kakigori all year in bowls hand-carved from blocks of ice (official site) · ice frozen slowly over 72 hours for clarity (official site) · e.g. Uji kintoki ¥1,500, Uji ¥1,400 by day (¥300 more at night), fresh strawberry ¥1,200, freshly squeezed orange, lemon, milk with fresh strawberry or green apple (2025 reviews) · cocktails from ¥900, draft beer ¥850 (August 2025)
places.notes: [Sweets & bar · Gion Shimogawara, kakigori in a bowl of ice] The café-bar of 森田氷室本店, Kyoto's oldest ice maker, just south of Yasaka Shrine. Its crystal-clear ice, frozen over 72 hours, is shaved into kakigori — Uji kintoki, fresh strawberry, squeezed orange — and served in bowls carved from the ice itself, all year round. From 18:00 it becomes a cocktail bar with a ¥300 table charge. Open till midnight; closed Wednesday.

roles: Run by the fifth-generation brothers of 森田氷室本店 (official site); not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 森田氷室本店, in its 133rd year and Kyoto’s oldest ice maker, freezes purified water for more than 72 hours for hard, clear ice; page one was started by the brothers of the fifth generation to add a new page to that history, serving ice in hand-carved ice bowls; featured on many TV programmes since 2013.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: good ice is enjoyed three times — with the eyes, the ears and the mouth.
chef_bio.specialty: Kakigori in a carved ice bowl.

A March 2026 visitor, planning only a rice ball before a live show, was greeted with “We’re open!” and stayed for kitsune udon.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ときわ、うどん・食堂、左京区聖護院山王町43、神宮丸太町駅から553m、11:00〜18:00、火曜定休 (最新の営業時間は要確認)、予約不可、現金のみ、18席、禁煙。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 熊野神社前、京大病院の南東の角、昭和の老舗、やわらかいうどんとほんのり甘い京都の出汁、しっぽくうどん780円 (蒲鉾2種、生麩、湯葉、ほうれん草、椎茸)、天ぷらうどんとミニ玉子丼1,150円、きつねうどん、鍋焼きうどん、親子丼、肉カレー丼1,000円、肉丼とミニうどん1,300円、夏はそうめん、そばや中華そばも。

cultural_comfort.note: Old neighbourhood noodle shop; cash only.

places.name: 旬菜 あだち (Shunsai Adachi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese set meals — grilled and simmered fish, dashimaki, yudofu, obanzai — but fried oysters, tonkatsu and vegetable tempura sets contain wheat; no gluten information (2021–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable tempura and yudofu sets are offered, but the dashi, sake-lees soup and miso soup are not described (2023–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00, dinner 17:00–21:30; closed Tuesday (Tabelog; hours may change). Set meals at dinner at lunch prices (April 2024; March 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: 10 at the counter, 10 at tables; smoking area (Tabelog). About 100 m north of the Kawaramachi-Marutamachi crossing, 4 min from the Kawaramachi-Marutamachi bus stop and 6 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2023).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi just north of Marutamachi — 6 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Home-style Kyoto set meals (teishoku) at lunch and dinner for about ¥1,000–1,500 (2021–2026 reviews) · simmered flounder set ¥1,300 (March 2025); grilled sardine set (March 2025); grilled saury (September 2026); grilled horse mackerel; pork cutlet set (March 2026) · fried oysters fried to order (February 2025) · dashimaki tamago set; vegetable tempura set (April 2024) · obanzai set ¥1,000: two small dishes chosen from the counter, rice and miso soup (November 2021; September 2025) · winter yudofu lunch with sake-lees soup and pickles (January 2023)
places.notes: [Set meals · Kawaramachi-Marutamachi, home cooking at lunch prices] A counter-and-table Japanese kitchen just north of Kawaramachi-Marutamachi serving honest teishoku — simmered flounder, grilled saury or sardine, fried oysters, dashimaki, yudofu in winter — with obanzai picked from the counter, at about ¥1,000–1,500 day and night. The chef looks stern but is friendly.

chef_bio.background: An April 2024 reviewer describes a chef with a stern expression who is nonetheless friendly; the restaurant serves dinner set meals at lunch prices. A March 2025 diner valued the orthodox, homemade cooking.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto set meals; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular, drawn in by the smell of grilling fish, was pleased the saury set price had not risen despite costly saury.
A February 2025 diner watched the year’s first fried oysters being fried right in front of the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 旬菜 あだち、日本料理、上京区上生洲町247、市バス河原町丸太町から徒歩4分、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩6分、昼12:00〜14:00、夜17:00〜21:30、火曜定休、予約可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、20席 (カウンター10、テーブル10)、喫煙所あり。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 夜も昼と同じ値段の定食、カレイの煮付け定食1,300円、いわしの塩焼き、さんま、あじの塩焼き、とんかつ定食、カキフライ、だし巻き、野菜天ぷら、カウンターから選ぶおばんざい定食1,000円、冬は湯豆腐と粕汁、店主は強面だが気さく。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter set-meal shop; pick obanzai at the counter.

places.name: バーヤナギ (Bar Yanagi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A whisky and cocktail bar; snacks such as mixed nuts (2025 review).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A bar; cream-free cocktails noted in an older review (2018); snacks such as nuts (2025 review).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken; often full — a June 2025 visitor phoned ahead (Tabelog; June 2025 review). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; May 2026 review). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 15 counter seats (Tabelog). On Ebisugawa east of Takakura, in a residential area south of the Imperial Palace; 5 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; 2023–24 reviews). Relocated from Kita-ku long ago (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ebisugawa south of the Imperial Palace — 5 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: A whisky-focused authentic bar playing vinyl records: a wide whisky selection (Super Nikka, Bunnahabhain 12, Caol Ila 12 as highballs, June 2025), the master's recommendations to suit your mood, gin and tonic, gimlet with fresh lime, improvised cocktails; mixed nuts (2018–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Whisky bar · Ebisugawa near the Imperial Palace] A quiet, moody counter bar of over 40 years, records on the turntable and a deep whisky shelf; tell the calm master your mood and get a recommendation. About ¥2,000–5,000. Smoking allowed. Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 reviewer says the bar has been running for over 40 years; Tabelog notes it moved from Shichiku in Kita-ku.
chef_bio.specialty: Whisky.

anecdotes.text: Turned away several times when full, a June 2025 visitor phoned ahead and finally got in, finding the owner calm and pleasant.
A May 2026 visitor saw the friendly master serving many international guests with care, and warned that smoking is allowed.

cultural_comfort.note: The master serves many international guests (May 2026 review); smoking allowed.

places.name: 手打ち蕎麦みながわ 京・御池 (Teuchi Soba Minagawa Kyo Oike)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Coarse-ground seiro is 100% buckwheat (September 2026 review); other soba not described; soy-based tsuyu, tempura (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based tsuyu, chicken and duck nanban, tempura (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Fri 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last order 22:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–20:30 continuous (last order 20:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings by phone only; queues at lunch; soba can sell out (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし" (its English says a fee may be added). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026 review). No photos inside (October 2026 review). 19 seats: 9 at the counter, 10 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Facing Oike-dori; 4 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Oike-dori west of Karasuma — 4 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Hand-made soba from the Kitashirakawa みながわ, with sides and sake (Tabelog): zaru, inaka and coarse-ground 100% buckwheat seiro, chilled kake soba, summer cold ume-oroshi soba ¥1,700 (July 2026), dipping ume-oroshi, tempura seiro, tempura with grated daikon, Tanba chicken or duck nanban; a lunch set with seasonal rice, salted tofu and fried soba; sake and soba shochu with soba-yu (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Hand-made soba · Oike-dori] The Oike branch of a long-loved Kitashirakawa soba house: fine, fragrant hand-cut soba — try the coarse 100% buckwheat seiro or summer ume-oroshi — with tempura, duck nanban and sake in the evening. About ¥1,200–2,000 at lunch. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 5 April 2017 (Tabelog) as the Oike branch of みながわ, long loved in Kitashirakawa, "so more customers can enjoy our handmade soba" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Hand-made soba with sides to enjoy with sake and shochu (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Hand-cut soba.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner who joined a queue at opening found the soba thin and mild in aroma, and the tsuyu and wasabi a little scant.
A September 2026 regular noticed prices well up on a few years before, and wondered whether inbound tourism was the cause.
A family arriving late in Silver Week 2026 got the last soba before it ran out.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 手打ち蕎麦みながわ 京・御池、そば・居酒屋・日本料理、中京区橋之町755、烏丸御池駅から徒歩4分、月水木金 11:30〜14:30・17:30〜22:30、土日祝 12:00〜20:30 (通し営業)、火曜休み、電話予約のみ、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー不可、19席 (カウンター9、テーブル10)、禁煙、2017年4月5日オープン、北白川で愛されてきたみながわの御池店。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): ざる、田舎そば、粗挽き十割のせいろ、冷やかけ、夏の冷やし梅おろし1,700円、つけ梅おろし、天せいろ、天おろし、丹波鶏や鴨の南蛮、旬のご飯と小鉢2品のランチセット、蕎麦焼酎の蕎麦湯割り、現金のみ、店内撮影不可、昼は行列、売り切れも、値上がりしたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seats facing the kitchen; no photos inside; cash only.

places.name: 本鮪と創作和食 吟醸くらうど 丸太町本店 (Ginjo Kuraudo Marutamachi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Bluefin tuna sashimi with soy beside menchi katsu, tempura and dan dan noodles (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a tuna and fish izakaya (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:30 daily (Tabelog). Bookings taken; seats cannot be specified; private rooms for 3 or more; course bookings have a time limit (Tabelog; August 2026 review). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「単品のお客様のみチャージ料（付きだし）380円 コースのお客様はかかりません。」 — ¥380 for à la carte guests, none with a course. Cards, e-money, PayPay (Tabelog). 48 seats: counter and tables downstairs, a shoes-off sunken-kotatsu room upstairs; parties up to 26–28 (Tabelog; November 2026 review). A two-storey house on the corner of Ebisugawa and Muromachi; 3 min from Marutamachi Stn exit 6 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ebisugawa-Muromachi — 3 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Bluefin tuna and about 40 seasonal local sakes at ¥580 a glass (Tabelog): the "Tuna Treasure Box" of ten bluefin cuts ¥980 per person (Tabelog), toro-taku, grilled tuna skin; courses such as the "Akagumo" with all-you-can-drink, from about ¥7,000 (November 2026) — taro potato salad, soy-milk dashimaki sandwich, grilled fatty mackerel, menchi katsu, sushi; fig tempura, taro kara-age, aosa omelette, eel, duck, fiery dan dan noodles (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Tuna & sake izakaya · Marutamachi] A lively two-storey corner house, the main shop of a small Kyoto group: a ten-cut bluefin "treasure box" for ¥980, creative small plates and some 40 local sakes by the glass, or all-you-can-drink courses. About ¥5,000–7,000. Open daily to 23:30; packed on Fridays.

chef_bio.background: Opened 9 May 2019 (Tabelog); the main shop of 吟醸くらうど, with にしき雲 and 京都駅前店 (Tabelog crawl).
chef_bio.specialty: Bluefin tuna; local sake.

anecdotes.text: On a packed Friday in August 2026, a diner's only complaint was being asked to leave at the set time.
Seated upstairs beside a banquet in November 2026, a party of four was asked first whether the noise was all right.
A September 2026 diner warned that the extra-spicy dan dan noodles are hotter than most.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 本鮪と創作和食 吟醸くらうど 丸太町本店、居酒屋・魚介料理・日本酒バー、中京区鏡屋町50-2、丸太町駅6番出口から徒歩3分、夷川通と室町通の角の二階建て、17:00〜23:30、無休、予約可 (席の指定不可)、単品のお客様のみチャージ料 (付きだし) 380円・コースはなし、48席 (カウンター8、テーブル16、掘りごたつ24)、個室、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、2019年5月9日オープン、本鮪の玉手箱 (10種) 一人980円、地酒約40種を580円。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年11月、英語): 赤雲コース、飲み放題、里芋のポテサラ、豆乳だし巻きサンド、鯖の塩焼き、メンチカツ、寿司、いちじくの天ぷら、里芋の唐揚げ、あおさの卵焼き、トロたく、担々麺、時間制、2階の掘りごたつ。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off upstairs; course time limits.

places.name: Wine蔵しおり (Wine Gura Shiori)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan dishes, gyoza in tomato sauce, pizza and pasta beside grilled squid and vegetables (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood, beef tendon, cheese dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 16:00–23:00 daily (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed 31 December–1 January (Tabelog). Bookings taken; seat-only bookings need one drink and one dish each; stays capped at 3 hours (Tabelog). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「■先付：480円／コース時は除く」 — a ¥480 appetizer, not with courses. Unlimited all-you-can-drink ¥3,200; courses of 8 dishes ¥6,600 or 9 dishes ¥7,700 with drinks (Tabelog). Cards incl. UnionPay, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 42 seats: counter, private tables and sunken-kotatsu rooms for 3–8, a hall for 30; non-smoking (Tabelog). Order by wine number; call button at tables (2026 reviews). On Shichijo-dori; 5 min from Kyoto Stn, reachable by the underground walkway (Tabelog; September 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Shichijo-dori near Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: Creative teppan cooking with wine — about 13 wines on the all-you-can-drink list, sparkling to red, ordered by number (2026 reviews): teppan squid, eggplant and zucchini baked with cheese, gyoza in tomato sauce, omelette topped with braised beef tendon, pizza, pasta, fried scallops, quail egg and cherry tomato pinchos, cheese aligot, smoked nuts; courses of 8–9 dishes with drinks ¥6,600–7,700 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Teppan & wine · near Kyoto Station] A Japanese-style room full of wine bottles, popular for group dinners: creative teppan plates and around 13 all-you-can-drink wines ordered by number, with private kotatsu rooms. Courses with drinks ¥6,600–7,700; ¥480 appetizer à la carte. Open daily from 16:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a creative teppan restaurant and wine bar 5 minutes from Kyoto Station.
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan dishes; wine all-you-can-drink.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 banquet host found the drinks so slow to come that the toast was delayed, and the call button went unanswered — "not suitable for banquets".
A September 2026 regular who brings mostly female groups praised ordering wine by number and fast glass changes.
An October 2026 company party found it quiet and free of tourist crowds, but went for ramen afterwards as the food was limited.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Wine蔵しおり、居酒屋・鉄板焼き・ダイニングバー、下京区七条通新町東入ル西境町158、JR京都駅から徒歩5分、16:00〜23:00、12月31日・1月1日休み、先付480円 (コース時は除く)、席のみ予約はワンドリンク・ワンオーダー、最長3時間、飲み放題3,200円、コース8品6,600円・9品7,700円、42席 (カウンター、個室テーブル、掘りごたつ個室、30名の大広間)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可。口コミ (2026年7〜11月、英語): ワイン13種の飲み放題 (番号で注文)、鉄板のいか、なすとズッキーニのチーズ焼き、トマトソースの餃子、牛すじのオムレツ、ピザ、パスタ、ホタテフライ、うずらとミニトマトのピンチョス、アリゴ、宴会には向かないという声、店員の声が大きいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order drinks by number; private rooms.

places.name: チャンダー 丸太町店 (CHANDER Marutamachi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: naan-led sets; samosas; rice and biryani exist, but a shared tandoor and fryer are likely — no allergen information in the sources (2022–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options and a vegetable set with two vegetable curries (2022–2023), but ghee, cream and cheese are not ruled out.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; hours may change. Basement of the Palestate Nissei building, across the road from Kumano Shrine. 35 seats, about eight tables for four (2022–2023 reviews); private hire possible. Tabelog lists smoking as allowed (check on arrival). No e-money or QR; cards not listed — one diner saw no card signs and paid cash (October 2022). Spice level 1–5 chosen when ordering.
places.neighborhood: Kumano Shrine, Higashiyama-Marutamachi — 529 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Indian curry sets with large naan, run by Indian staff (2022–2026 reviews) · lunch sets with a choice from five or more curries, naan and rice, salad and a drink (chai or lassi); a Lurki set with tandoori chicken, seafood and spinach curries ¥1,460 (July 2023); "D" lunch with chicken tikka ¥1,280 (October 2022); naan-curry set ¥850 (April 2022); vegetable set with samosas (2022–2023) · twelve naans to upgrade to, cheese naan +¥320 (October 2022); chicken biryani (March 2026) · spice level 1–5; leftover naan can be taken home (June 2023); all-you-can-eat naan for students (March 2026)
places.notes: [Indian · Kumano Shrine, big naan and student lunches] A basement Indian restaurant across from Kumano Shrine, packed with students at lunch: curry sets with huge naan (the cheese naan is the favourite), biryani, a five-step spice scale and free naan refills for students. Food can be slow at peak (2022); one diner suspected the fancier naans were never made (October 2022). One of at least three Chander shops in Kyoto.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2019 to 2026 describe a half-basement room with Ganesha decorations, Indian staff who speak fluent Japanese and talk among themselves in another language, a manager who asks whether the food was spicy enough, and a lunch crowd of students. Other Chander shops are listed by Tabelog near Kitayama Station and in front of Kyoto University's main gate.
chef_bio.specialty: Cheese naan; curry lunch sets.

anecdotes.text: October 2022: asked for fruit naan, "they informed me that it was sold out, but they had cheese and butter naan available… I suspected that they might not have prepared the less popular items."
March 2026: "The cheerful Indian staff welcomed me and helped me navigate through the extensive menu with their fluent Japanese," and a lassi came free.
June 2022: a diner had stayed away "because I heard it took a long time for the food to arrive."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: CHANDER 丸太町店、インド料理、左京区聖護院山王町43-2 パレステート日生ビル B1F、市バス熊野神社前、神宮丸太町駅から529m、毎日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜23:00、35席、貸切可、喫煙可、電子マネー・QR不可、ベジタリアン対応。口コミ (2019年11月〜2026年3月、英語): 熊野神社の向かいの半地下、ガネーシャの飾り、インド人のスタッフ、テーブル4人席が8つほど、辛さは5段階、ナンカレーセット850円 (2022年)、ポークサグ1,020円、Dランチ1,280円、Lurki セット1,460円 (2023年)、野菜セットとサモサ、チーズナンは+320円、ナンは12種類、チキンビリヤニ、学生はナン食べ放題、昼は学生で混む、ナンが大きく持ち帰りも可、料理が出るのが遅いという噂、フルーツナンは品切れと言われたという声、カードの表示がなく現金で払ったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Indian staff with fluent Japanese; choose a spice level 1–5.

places.name: 鉄板焼 二条 (Teppanyaki Nijo, ANA Crowne Plaza Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask: teppan beef, seafood and vegetables, but soy sauce, ponzu and miso are among the steak condiments (July 2018) and garlic rice is cooked on the same plate; no allergen information in the sources.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef, foie gras and seafood courses (2018–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog and hotel site: lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:00–21:30 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday, open when Wednesday is a public holiday. Booking advised. Service charge 10%, no cover charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料10%、チャージ料なし」. 19 seats: a 13-seat counter and one private room for 6. Non-smoking; English menu; birthday plates; cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), QUICPay, PayPay. Hotel parking (4 hours free when dining); shuttle bus from Kyoto Station. Opened 25 June 1986 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo Castle — basement of the ANA Crowne Plaza Kyoto, 1 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn exit 2
places.cuisine: Old-school hotel teppanyaki at a counter, without the showmanship (2018–2026 reviews) · lunch courses named for nearby streets — "Oike" with foie gras steak, seafood of the day and 100 g domestic beef fillet (¥5,300 via Ikkyu, October 2021), "Horikawa" A with the fillet (¥5,464 incl. tax, July 2018), "Mibu" seafood and 100 g fillet ¥6,655 (July 2022) · abalone and black-haired wagyu upgrades; garlic rice instead of plain rice with red miso soup; white fish with tomato-basil sauce (2018–2025 reviews) · Chen Kentaro's mapo tofu from the hotel's Sichuan restaurant as a +¥900 add-on (July 2022) · dinner from about ¥15,000–20,000 a head (2022–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Nijo Castle, a 1986 hotel counter] The ANA Crowne Plaza's basement teppanyaki counter since 1986: foie gras, the day's seafood and domestic beef fillet grilled in front of you, garlic rice to finish — a quiet, unflashy family-celebration place with lunch courses far cheaper than dinner. One diner found the dishes other than the meat forgettable (September 2022); another wished the chef said where the abalone and beef came from (June 2026). 10% service charge. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Not named in a source; restaurant of the ANA Crowne Plaza Kyoto
chef_bio.background: Opened 25 June 1986 in the basement of the hotel by Nijo Castle (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2017 to 2026 describe a spacious counter where the chef cooks and chats, a family that has marked birthdays here for years with special plates, and a "traditional" teppan style without flambé or show.
chef_bio.specialty: Domestic beef fillet; garlic rice.

anecdotes.text: July 2022: "If you're looking for a flashy Teppan-yaki, look elsewhere" — the reviewer came for "the traditional Teppan-yaki style that is slowly fading away."
"For years, it has been our family's go-to place for celebrations, including birthdays where they always prepare a special plate for us." — December 2018.
September 2022: "delicious meat, but unfortunately, the other dishes didn't leave a lasting impression."
June 2026: "I would have loved more information about the ingredients… For example, where the abalone and meat are sourced from."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 二条、鉄板焼・ステーキ、中京区堀川通二条下ル土橋町10 ANAクラウンプラザホテル京都 B1F、二条城前駅2番出口から徒歩約1分、11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜21:30 (L.O. 21:00)、水曜休み (祝日は営業)、原文で「サービス料10%、チャージ料なし」、19席 (カウンター13席、6名の個室1室)、禁煙、英語メニュー、カード・QUICPay・PayPay可、ホテル駐車場、京都駅からシャトルバス、1986年6月25日オープン。ホテルの公式サイト: 鉄板焼 二条、水曜定休 (祝日を除く)。口コミ (2017年6月〜2026年6月、英語): 御池・堀川・壬生のランチコース、フォアグラのステーキ、本日の魚介、国産牛フィレ100g、焼野菜、ガーリックライスと赤だし、白身魚のトマトバジルソース、あわびと黒毛和牛への変更、隣の四川料理店の Chen Kentaro の麻婆豆腐 (+900円)、誕生日のプレート、派手さのない昔ながらの鉄板焼、肉以外は印象に残らないという声、食材の産地の説明がほしいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; English menu; 10% service charge.

places.name: 京料理・本家生ゆば料理 松山閣 松山 JR京都伊勢丹店 (Shozankaku Matsuyama, JR Kyoto Isetan)
places.gf_detail: Ask: Tabelog says allergy information is available; yuba and soy milk are naturally wheat-free, but yuba tempura, fu and ponzu are on the courses (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi throughout; sashimi, fish, shrimp and conger eel in the courses (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:15); closed on JR Kyoto Isetan's closing days. Reservations taken (private rooms by phone); seating about 2 hours. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「無」. 42 seats; private rooms for 8 and for 10–20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu with photos; allergy information available; children welcome with a kids' menu. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR. On the 11th floor of JR Kyoto Isetan, with views of Kyoto Tower and the mountains (2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station — JR Kyoto Isetan 11F, 1 min walk from JR Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: Yuba kaiseki from a Kyoto yuba house, in the station department store (2026 reviews) · the signature homemade yuba served warm in a wooden tub ("yuba-oke") with ponzu, with the soy milk to drink (2026 reviews) · seasonal Kyo bento with the yuba tub ¥4,070: yuba, ginkgo tofu, rolled omelette, simmered dishes, mushroom rice with refills, yuba baumkuchen (October 2026); "Miyabi" course ¥5,500 (September 2026); "Sakae" kaiseki with matsutake dobin-mushi, grilled Spanish mackerel and lotus-root manju (October 2026) · à la carte yuba sashimi, yuba tempura, tofu dengaku (October 2026) · a range of Kyoto sake (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yuba kaiseki · Kyoto Station Isetan 11F, warm yuba in a tub] The station branch of a Kyoto yuba-cuisine house: warm, freshly made yuba scooped from a wooden tub with ponzu, yuba sashimi and tempura, and seasonal courses, with a view toward Kyoto Tower — convenient before a train. Diners in 2026 praise the yuba; some found the service stiff or harried (September and October 2026) and one found the seasoning salty (October 2026). No service charge.

roles: Not named in a source; branch of the yuba-cuisine house 松山閣 松山, whose main restaurant is elsewhere in Kyoto (Gurunavi)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm restaurant on the department-store restaurant floor with views of the mountains and Kyoto Tower, kimono-clad servers, rice crackers and hot water on arrival, and yuba that a September 2026 diner was told is made at a shop near Kinkaku-ji.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade yuba in a wooden tub (yuba-oke).

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "the service felt a bit disorganized, possibly due to being busy. The staff could have been a bit more friendly."
October 2026: "I found the saltiness to be quite pronounced, despite the presentation" — and the "matsutake rice" turned out to be mushroom rice.
October 2026: "the signature homemade yuba bucket was exquisite; I almost drank all the soy milk without realizing it."
October 2026: "the service from the most experienced-looking woman in a kimono was a bit intimidating."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京料理・本家生ゆば料理 松山閣 松山 JR京都伊勢丹店、日本料理・豆腐料理、下京区烏丸通塩小路下る東塩小路町901 ジェイアール京都伊勢丹 11F、JR京都駅から徒歩1分、毎日 11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:15)、休みはJR京都伊勢丹に準じる、予約可 (個室は電話で)、利用は2時間ほど、原文でサービス料「無」、42席、個室 (8名、10〜20名)、禁煙、車椅子可、英語と写真のメニュー、アレルギー表示あり、子供可・子供メニュー、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 自家製の湯葉桶をポン酢で、豆乳、湯葉刺し、湯葉の天ぷら、豆腐の味噌田楽、季節の京弁当4,070円 (湯葉桶付き、きのこご飯はおかわり可、湯葉バウムクーヘン)、「Miyabi」コース5,500円、「Sakae」の会席 (松茸の土瓶蒸し、鰆の幽庵焼き、蓮根饅頭)、京都タワーや山の眺め、湯葉は金閣寺の近くの店で作るとの説明、サービスが慌ただしいという声、塩気が強いという声、年長の着物の女性の接客が怖かったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with photos; allergy information available.

places.name: 三木鶏卵 (Miki Keiran)
places.gf_detail: Ask: the dashimaki dashi is kombu with urume, soda-katsuo and mackerel flakes (official site), but soy seasoning is not stated; the sandwiches, buns and cream puffs are wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg dishes in a fish dashi (official site).
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 9:00–17:00 daily; closed only at New Year. Take-away counter with a small standing eat-in space and a bin; staff will cut a dashimaki for eating on the spot (2024–2025 reviews). No reservations. Tabelog lists no cards, e-money or QR, but a March 2026 diner paid with PayPay. Popular items (pudding) sell out; a sold-out dashimaki can be made fresh if you wait (October 2025).
places.neighborhood: Nishiki Market, near the Tominokoji end — 10 min walk from Karasuma / Kawaramachi / Shijo Stns
places.cuisine: Dashimaki tamago specialist in Nishiki Market since 1928, hand-rolled by craftsmen (official site) · dashimaki small ¥690, medium ¥1,050, large ¥1,700, special ¥1,950; Kujo green-onion roll ¥1,190; kayaku (mixed-vegetable) roll ¥1,600; umaki (eel) ¥2,800; fukusa-yaki ¥580 (official site, November 2026) · from the sister bakery: dashimaki sandwich, yolk anpan, custard cream bun, cream puffs, bottled pudding with separate caramel (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Dashimaki · Nishiki Market, since 1928] A Nishiki Market egg shop since 1928 where craftsmen hand-roll dashi-heavy dashimaki in custom copper pans: buy a small roll to eat at the stand, a green-onion or eel roll, or the dashimaki sandwich and pudding. One diner expected it hot and got it cold (September 2026). Open daily 9:00–17:00.

roles: Not named in a source; Miki Keiran Co., Ltd. (official site)
chef_bio.background: Founded in Showa 3 (1928), with its main shop near the middle of Nishiki Market (official site). The dashi uses Nishiki well water and Rishiri kombu simmered slowly, with urume, soda-katsuo and mackerel flakes; every roll is still hand-cooked, rolled front to back in the "Kyo-maki" style over high heat in long, heavy copper pans made to order by Aritsugu, a craftsman working three pans at once (official site). Counters at Takashimaya Kyoto and JR Kyoto Isetan, and a bakery of egg breads and sweets, mikikeirando (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: From its site: "創業以来、伝承の技法で変わらぬ味を守っています" (since its founding, keeping the same taste with handed-down techniques).
chef_bio.specialty: Dashimaki tamago.

anecdotes.text: January 2024: in a Nishiki now full of bar-like eateries, "the traditional ambiance still remains at a place called Miki Keiran."
May 2024: "If you want to eat it now, I'll cut the dashimaki for you," said the staff — "They even gave me three chopsticks."
September 2026: "I expected it to be freshly made, but it was cold, which was a bit disappointing."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 昭和三年創業のだし巻玉子専門店、錦市場のほぼ真ん中に本店、錦の井戸水と利尻昆布、うるめ節・宗田鰹・さば節の出汁、職人が一本ずつ手焼き、有次の特注の銅の玉子焼鍋、手前から奥へ巻く「京巻き」、三本の鍋を同時に使う、だし巻 (小690円・中1,050円・大1,700円・特上1,950円)、九条ねぎ巻1,190円、かやく巻1,600円、う巻2,800円、ふくさ焼580円、錦本店は9:00〜17:00で年始以外無休、高島屋京都店とJR京都伊勢丹店、パンと菓子の三木鶏卵堂 (mikikeirando)。食べログ: 三木鶏卵、日本料理・パン、中京区錦小路通富小路西入東魚屋町182、予約不可、持ち帰り、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年9月、英語): だし巻、九条ねぎ巻、う巻、だし巻サンド、黄身あんぱん、クリームパン、シュークリーム、瓶のプリン、店の前で立って食べられる、PayPayで払えたという声、冷めていたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Take-away counter in Nishiki Market; small standing space.

places.name: 中国料理 皇家龍鳳 (Koka Ryuho, RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Cantonese courses of dim sum, sauces with soy and bean paste, fried rice and noodles; staff help tailor orders (2023–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shark-fin soup, seafood, beef and chicken courses (2023–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–21:30 (last order 20:00); irregular closing days, see the hotel website (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). A 10% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料10%). 78 seats with private rooms for 4 to over 30 (room fee); stroller-friendly (Tabelog; December 2023). À la carte in small or medium plates (December 2023). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). B1F of RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto; hotel parking free for 3 hours with a ¥4,000 spend from 1 April 2026; 7 min walk west of Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto B1F — 7 min walk west of Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: Cantonese hotel restaurant with dim sum (Tabelog) · lunch courses such as the Kofuku lunch: Cantonese appetisers, shark-fin soup, dim sum (har gow, squid shumai), steamed sea bream with XO sauce, beef in sweet bean sauce with crepes, seafood fried rice with sauce, dessert (2023–2025 reviews) · casual lunch with steamed scallops and chicken in chao tian chili; shrimp chili two ways in small portions (2023–2024 reviews) · dinner courses with crab-enriched shark-fin soup (August 2024) · à la carte in small or medium plates · lunch ¥6,000–8,000, dinner ¥10,000–15,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Cantonese · RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto B1F] The hotel's calm Cantonese room near Kyoto Station: lunch courses of appetisers, shark-fin soup, dim sum, XO-steamed sea bream and seafood fried rice, à la carte in small portions, and private rooms often used for family gatherings and memorials. Attentive service; one 2024 dinner guest found it merely average. Plus 10% service. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the Chinese restaurant of RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto, with dim sum and private rooms; registered as an official listing by the operator. An October 2025 reviewer recalls the building was once the Kyoto Grand Hotel.
chef_bio.specialty: Cantonese lunch course; dim sum.

anecdotes.text: For the hotel's 55th-anniversary lunch in December 2024, staff set the table to match what the guest had mentioned when booking.
After a memorial service in November 2025, a family gathered in a private room here around the late uncle's portrait.
An October 2023 diner could not find any shark fin in the shark-fin soup, but still found it very good.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華料理・飲茶、下京区東堀川通り塩小路下ル松明町1 リーガロイヤルホテル京都 B1F、JR京都駅から西へ徒歩約7分、毎日 11:30〜15:30 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜21:30 (L.O.20:00)、不定休、予約可、サービス料10%、78席、個室 (4名〜30名以上、別料金)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2026年4月1日から4,000円以上の利用でホテルの駐車場3時間無料。口コミ (2023年4月〜2025年11月、英語): 広東料理、「Kofuku」ランチ (前菜、ふかひれスープ、点心、XO 醤の鯛の蒸し物、牛肉の甜麺醤炒めとクレープ、海鮮のあんかけチャーハン、デザート)、カジュアルランチ (帆立の蒸し物、朝天唐辛子の鶏)、海老チリ2種、蟹入りのふかひれスープ、小皿と中皿のアラカルト、ベビーカーで個室へ、ホテル55周年のランチ、法事のあとの会食、平凡との声 (2024年8月)、昔の京都グランドホテル。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; 10% service; private rooms; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: カンティーナ・ロッシ (Cantina Rossi)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: handmade fresh pasta is the heart of every course, with crostini, cutlets and tiramisu (2021–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream and Gorgonzola pastas, nduja, lamb and beef cutlets, cheese and ham (2021–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–21:30; Monday, Wednesday and Friday 18:00–21:30; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — about three groups fit at once (Tabelog; February 2024, August 2026). No e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). An iron sculpture marks the door, down a narrow residential lane; 7 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; February 2024).
places.neighborhood: Yoshida, a residential lane — 7 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Small Italian on the ground floor of a house, run by a couple (June 2024; April 2025) · PRANZO pasta lunch from ¥2,670: three crostini or assorted appetisers, a choice of five or six pastas, and a drink; mixed-vegetable antipasto ¥1,300 (October 2025; August 2026) · fresh pasta: Gorgonzola cream, Amatriciana, nduja tomato cream, mushroom-lemon tagliatelle, eggplant and tomato; pasta split into half plates to share (2021–2026 reviews) · dinner omakase in the ¥4,800 range: bread, appetisers, two pastas, a choice of meat such as lamb or beef cutlet, dessert and coffee (June 2024) · tiramisu; Italian wines (2023–2025 reviews) · lunch ¥1,000–2,000, dinner ¥6,000–8,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Italian · Demachiyanagi back lane, couple-run] A ten-seat Italian tucked in a residential lane behind an iron sculpture, run by a friendly couple: handmade pastas such as Gorgonzola cream or Amatriciana, crostini, lamb or beef cutlet, tiramisu and Italian wine, at prices reviewers call remarkable — lunch from ¥2,670, a dinner omakase near ¥4,800. Pastas can be split to share. Book; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian restaurant near Demachiyanagi with a website at cantinarossi.com. Reviewers describe a couple running the ground floor of a house in a residential area (June 2024; April 2025), and say it was listed as a Michelin Bib Gourmand in 2021 and 2022 (September 2021; March 2022).
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade pasta; cream pastas.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 pair, waiting outside before noon, were waved in three minutes early with a "Please come in".
A September 2021 diner who mentioned a birthday found a surprise on the plate.
A January 2026 couple, the only guests that evening, had the pasta served divided onto two plates.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン、左京区吉田泉殿町57-1、京阪出町柳駅から徒歩7分、火・木・土 12:00〜14:30・18:00〜21:30、月・水・金 18:00〜21:30、日曜定休、予約可、電子マネー・QR 不可、10席、禁煙。口コミ (2021年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 住宅街の路地、鉄のオブジェ、家の1階、夫婦で営む、3組ほどで満席、ランチ PRANZO 2,670円から (クロスティーニ3種、5〜6種から選ぶパスタ、ドリンク)、野菜の前菜の盛り合わせ1,300円、生パスタ (ゴルゴンゾーラのクリーム、アマトリチャーナ、ンドゥイヤのトマトクリーム、きのことレモンのタリアテッレ、茄子とトマト)、取り分けて半量ずつ、夜のおまかせ4,800円台 (パン、前菜、パスタ2種、羊や牛のカツレツ、デザート、ドリンク)、ティラミス、イタリアワイン、ミシュランのビブグルマン (2021年・2022年) との声、誕生日のサプライズ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (10 seats); pasta can be split to share; no e-money or QR.

places.gf_detail: Not GF: demi-glace hamburg, omurice with hayashi or demi-glace, tonkatsu and beef cutlet (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg, ginger pork, steak, cutlets and pork miso soup (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–15:00 (last entry 14:15) and 18:00–22:00 (last entry 21:00); closed Monday (open on holiday Mondays, closed the next Tuesday) plus further posted days — in November 2026 the 2nd, 9th, 10th, 16th, 24th and 30th (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; tatami seats by phone request; change times by phone (Tabelog). At dinner, a ¥500 charge if you do not order food (Tabelog original ディナー時間帯は食事をされない場合はチャージ料￥５００). 37 seats: 9 at the counter and 28 at tables incl. 8 on tatami; private room (Tabelog). Cards; PayPay per a July 2026 review (Tabelog; July 2026). A machiya with a Jizo shrine; 8 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Fudo-cho, west of Shijo Karasuma — 8 min walk from Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Yoshoku with Kyoto vegetables and meats in a machiya (Tabelog; October 2026) · set meals with plenty of grilled vegetables, rice and pork miso soup: "adult" hamburg with tomato sauce or demi-glace, ginger pork with a caper sauce, beef cutlet, tonkatsu, strip loin steak (2026 reviews) · fluffy soufflé omurice with demi-glace or hayashi (August–October 2026) · courses with a Kyoto-vegetable salad, two appetisers, a main, rice and tonjiru, dessert (October 2026) · pickles to buy on the way out (August 2026) · lunch ¥2,000–3,000, dinner ¥6,000–8,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · machiya west of Shijo Karasuma, Kyoto vegetables] A calm machiya with a Jizo shrine serving yoshoku built around Kyoto produce: demi-glace or tomato hamburg, caper-sauced ginger pork, beef cutlet and a soufflé omurice, each with a heap of grilled vegetables and pork miso soup. Some find the flavours unusual — one guest tasted liver in the hamburg. Book; closed Monday and posted days.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a machiya-style yoshoku restaurant with a Jizo shrine, using Kyoto vegetables and meats; registered as an official listing by the shop, which offers message plates with dessert by phone request. Reviewers in 2026 describe a popular, calm restaurant with reservations streaming in at opening (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto vegetables and meats in yoshoku (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak; omurice.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner found pink peppercorns piled on the salad and a hamburg tasting strongly of liver, almost like pâté.
An October 2026 mother and daughter, put off the hamburg by reviews mentioning liver, chose the demi-glace omurice and loved it.
A fourth-visit regular in August 2026 always orders the adult hamburg with tomato sauce.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食・ビストロ・ステーキ、中京区不動町171-4、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩8分、火〜日 11:30〜15:00 (最終入店14:15)・18:00〜22:00 (最終入店21:00)、月曜定休 (祝日は営業し翌火曜休み)、ほかの休み (11月: 2・9・10・16・24・30日)、予約可 (座敷は電話で、時間変更は電話で)、ディナー時間帯は食事をされない場合はチャージ料500円、37席 (カウンター9、テーブル28、うち座敷8)、個室、カード可、メッセージプレートはデザート注文時に電話で、お地蔵さんのある町家風の洋食店。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 京野菜と京都の肉、焼き野菜たっぷり、豚汁、トマトソースのハンバーグ、デミグラスのハンバーグ (レバーの味がするとの声)、ケッパーのソースの生姜焼き、牛カツ、とんかつ、ステーキ、スフレのオムライス (デミグラス、ハヤシ)、京野菜のサラダと前菜2種のコース、帰りに漬物を買える、PayPay 可 (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; phone for tatami or time changes; ¥500 charge at dinner without food; cards.

places.name: ビヤレストラン ミュンヘン (Beer Restaurant munchen)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: kara-age, tonkatsu with demi-glace, fries, tacos and beer (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fried chicken, pork cutlet, sausages, roast beef and smoked salmon (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–23:00 (last order 22:00), open straight through (Tabelog; August 2026). Reservations accepted; banquet courses for 4 or more by the day before; call for 11 or more (Tabelog). 289 seats: 1F with 66 in the Ohenback area and 23 standing, 2F with 200; private rooms; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; karaoke and projector (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). In the first lane east off Kawaramachi north of Shijo; 3 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Off Kawaramachi north of Shijo — 3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Beer hall with nostalgic yoshoku and beer delivered fresh from the brewery (Tabelog) · draught in many sizes up to a 1 L mug; Hoegaarden on tap; pitchers; dark and half-and-half (2026 reviews) · signature kara-age of chicken breast, large and crisp (September–October 2026) · lunch sets: tonkatsu with demi-glace ¥1,250, plain omelette set ¥1,050 (May–October 2026) · "quick drink set" of a beer and two small plates ¥1,250 (e.g. omelette, seafood salad, roast beef, smoked salmon) (August–October 2026) · sausage platter, fries, popcorn; banquet courses with all-you-can-drink, tacos, mini steak, mini curry (August 2026) · about ¥2,000–4,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Beer hall · Shijo Kawaramachi lane, open all day] A big, old-school beer restaurant just off Kawaramachi, open from 11:30 straight to 23:00: brewery-fresh draught in sizes up to a litre, Hoegaarden on tap, a famous crisp kara-age of chicken breast, demi-glace tonkatsu sets at lunch and a ¥1,250 beer-and-two-plates afternoon set. Families at lunch, parties at night. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a beer hall serving nostalgic yoshoku with freshly brewed beer delivered from the brewery; registered as an official listing by the operator. Our crawls also list ビヤレストラン ハウスミュンヘン at the same address.
chef_bio.philosophy: Nostalgic yoshoku with brewery-fresh beer (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kara-age; draught beer.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a sixth visit had the tonkatsu set — "It's a shame I can't drink beer, though," noted on an earlier visit in May.
An October 2026 group booked at 17:00 the day before and stayed four hours over a one-litre mug.
An October 2026 wedding party found it one of the few places open for drinks at 14:30 on a Sunday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビアホール・洋食・唐揚げ、中京区河原町通四条上ル一筋目東入ル、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日 11:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、予約可 (宴会コースは4名以上・前日まで、11名以上は電話で)、289席 (1階 66席と立ち飲み23、2階200席)、個室、禁煙、車椅子可、カラオケ、プロジェクター、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、醸造所直送の生ビールと懐かしい洋食。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): ビールのサイズが豊富 (1L のジョッキも)、ヒューガルデンの生、ピッチャー、黒とハーフ&ハーフ、名物の胸肉の唐揚げ、とんかつ定食1,250円 (デミグラス)、プレーンオムレツの定食1,050円、「quick drink」のセット1,250円 (ビールと2品)、ソーセージの盛り合わせ、フライドポテト、ポップコーン、飲み放題の宴会コース、昼から夜まで通し営業、家族連れも。

cultural_comfort.note: Big hall, easy to walk in; banquet courses by the day before; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: フロマージェリー アルモニー (FROMAGERIE Harmonie)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Cheesecakes; crusts are not described (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a cheese shop and cheesecake café (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Sat–Mon 11:00–17:30 (last order 17:00); Tue, Wed and Fri 11:00–16:30 (last order 16:00); closed Thursday (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats in a small basement room, often full; take-away cheesecakes and cheeses (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Non-smoking. In the basement of a narrow building on Nijo-dori in Okazaki, near Miyako Messe and Heian Shrine; 7 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, Nijo-dori near Heian Shrine — Higashiyama Stn
places.cuisine: A cheese shop with a cheesecake café: six kinds of cheesecake — ricotta, mascarpone, Gorgonzola with half the usual sugar, fresh caramel and Gouda ¥650 (December 2025) — in a cake set with a drink for ¥1,100; Ronnefeldt teas such as cream orange, served in a pot ¥490; cheeses to take home (2024–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Cheese shop & cheesecake · Okazaki] A tiny basement cheese shop off Nijo-dori with eight counter seats: six rich cheesecakes — try the Gorgonzola or ricotta — with Ronnefeldt tea for ¥1,100, and cheeses to take away. Handy after the museums. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: one of the few cheese specialists in Kyoto, with a cheesecake counter in the basement.
chef_bio.specialty: Cheesecake.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 visitor was told a ricotta cheesecake and cream orange tea "work well together" — and found the pairing worked.
Finding the eight seats full in September 2025, a visitor was about to leave when someone vacated a seat.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): FROMAGERIE Harmonie (フロマージェリー アルモニー)、カフェ・ケーキ、左京区岡崎成勝寺町1-8 B1F、東山駅から443m、土〜月 11:00〜17:30 (L.O. 17:00)、火水金 11:00〜16:30 (L.O. 16:00)、木曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、8席、禁煙。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年6月、英語): 京都でも数少ないチーズ専門店、地下の小さなカウンター、チーズケーキ6種 (リコッタ、マスカルポーネ、甘さ半分のゴルゴンゾーラ、生キャラメルとゴーダ650円)、ケーキセット1,100円、ロンネフェルトの紅茶490円、持ち帰りのチーズ、満席になることも。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; staff suggest tea pairings.

places.name: イマヤ ホステルキョウトプラスコーヒー (IMAYA Kyoto &COFFEE)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breakfast is toast or a hot sandwich (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: breakfast with egg, chicken, cheese and yogurt; milk coffees (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 6:00–13:00 and 16:00–20:00; Sat–Sun 6:00–13:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 15 seats with counter and sofas; non-smoking (Tabelog). Some staff speak English (November 2025 review). The café of the IMAYA guesthouse, in a renovated machiya near Okine Shrine; 5 min from Karasuma Oike Stn, near Nijojo-mae (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Near Okine Shrine — between Karasuma Oike and Nijojo-mae
places.cuisine: Neapolitan-style café: cappuccino ¥620 (March 2026) in Passalacqua cups, espresso; one breakfast set — a hot sandwich of chicken, cheese and lettuce with a soft-boiled egg ¥1,040 (June 2026), earlier toast, egg and yogurt; fresh orange juice from a Zummo press; Italian craft beers such as KBIRR's PullicenHell and still waters (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Neapolitan café · near Oike] A bright machiya café attached to a guesthouse, open from 6:00: a creamy cappuccino reviewers call the best ever, a hot-sandwich breakfast (about ¥1,000), fresh orange juice and Neapolitan craft beer. Popular with Italian and other foreign visitors; English spoken.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who also runs a guesthouse
chef_bio.background: A June 2026 reviewer says the owner, passionate about coffee, also runs a guesthouse; an August 2026 regular of four years says the café was featured in the southern Italian paper Il Mattino and on Italian media, and draws ever more Italian visitors.
chef_bio.specialty: Cappuccino.

anecdotes.text: A couple who loved this coffee in Naples came in July 2026 on a friend's tip and found the room full of the city's atmosphere.
A September 2026 guest who dislikes soft-boiled eggs had the egg cooked through on request.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: IMAYA Kyoto &COFFEE (イマヤ ホステルキョウトプラスコーヒー)、カフェ、中京区釜座通御池上ル下松屋町726-4、烏丸御池駅から357m、月〜金 6:00〜13:00・16:00〜20:00、土日 6:00〜13:00、予約可、カード・PayPay 可、15席、禁煙。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): ナポリ風のカフェ、カプチーノ620円 (Passalacqua のカップ)、朝食セット (鶏とチーズのホットサンドと半熟卵1,040円)、Zummo の生オレンジジュース、イタリアのクラフトビール、ゲストハウスも営む店主、Il Mattino に掲載、外国人客やイタリア人客が多い、英語を話すスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Some English-speaking staff (November 2025 review); many international guests.

places.name: オールデイダイニング ラジョウ (All Day Dining Rajou)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A buffet of Japanese, Western and Chinese dishes, grilled meats and desserts; dish labelling not described (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Salads and vegetables among many meat, fish and dairy dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 daily; dinner 17:30–21:30 on weekdays, 17:30–21:00 at weekends and holidays (Tabelog); a breakfast buffet also runs (September 2026 review). Bookings taken; 100% cancellation charge from two days before (Tabelog). Service charge: 15% — Tabelog's Japanese original says 「サービス料15%※2025年4月1日のご利用よりサービス料をご利用額（税抜）の15%に改定させていただきます。」. Cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). 90 seats under a six-storey atrium; non-smoking; parking 50 cars, ¥800 per 30 min with restaurant benefits (Tabelog). 2F of the Kyoto Century Hotel, 2 min east of Kyoto Station's central gate (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Century Hotel, east of Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: Hotel buffets under an atrium (Tabelog): "THE THEATER BUFFET" with a live kitchen — the "Meat Theater" rotating nine meat dishes in sets of three every 30 minutes, wagyu roast beef, wagyu yuan-yaki, meat pie — plus Japanese, Western and Chinese dishes, curry, pumpkin potage and desserts such as freshly shaved Mont Blanc; lunch with all-you-can-drink; a morning buffet with omelettes, Kyoto pickles, tofu and sake; seasonal sweets buffets, e.g. HELLO KITTY RIBBON RIBBON ¥7,200–8,500 (September–November 2026) (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Hotel buffet · Kyoto Century Hotel by Kyoto Station] The hotel's bright atrium restaurant, two minutes from the station: a theatre-style buffet whose live kitchen rotates wagyu roast beef and other meats every half hour, plus breakfast and seasonal sweets buffets. Dinner about ¥6,000–9,000 before the 15% service charge.

roles: Restaurant of the Kyoto Century Hotel (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 11 August 2012 (Tabelog), in the Kyoto Century Hotel of Keihan Hotels & Resorts (official site). A long-time regular notes a significant renovation in 2026 (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Theatre-style buffet with live meat kitchen.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 guest found the buffet tasty but narrow for a hotel, with meats ordered and grilled in turns so one could not eat much, and the value not great.
A September 2026 lunch guest found the all-you-can-drink service a little slow.
Before an October 2026 Shinkansen, a visitor enjoyed the weekday lunch with well-spaced tables.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): オールデイダイニング ラジョウ、レストラン・カフェ・洋食、下京区東塩小路町680 京都センチュリーホテル 2F、JR京都駅中央口から東へ徒歩2分、平日 11:30〜15:00・17:30〜21:30、土日祝 11:30〜15:00・17:30〜21:00、2日前から当日のキャンセルは100%、サービス料15% (2025年4月1日から税抜額の15%に改定)、90席、禁煙、駐車場50台、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2012年8月11日オープン、6層吹き抜け、ライブキッチン「THE THEATER BUFFET」。公式サイト: 京阪ホテルズ&リゾーツの京都センチュリーホテル。口コミ (2026年7〜11月、英語): ミートシアター (9種の肉料理を30分ごとに3種ずつ)、和牛ローストビーフ、和牛の幽庵焼き、ミートパイ、和洋中、カレー、デザート、モンブラン、昼の飲み放題、朝食ブッフェ (オムレツ、京漬物、豆腐、日本酒)、HELLO KITTY のスイーツブッフェ7,200〜8,500円、品数が少なくコスパが良くないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel buffet; point and serve.

places.name: blend kyoto (ブレンド キョウト)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A coffee stand; no food or gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee is plant-based; ask about milk drinks (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 12:00–17:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 9:00–17:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 2 seats — mostly a stand; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On Takeyamachi-dori east of Fuyacho, on the way to the Imperial Palace grounds, 578 m from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2025).
places.neighborhood: Takeyamachi-Fuyacho — near the Imperial Palace grounds
places.cuisine: Light-roast specialty coffee stand where you smell the beans (labelled a to i) and pick two to blend into your own cup (2024–2026 reviews) · e.g. a blended coffee ¥1,210 (May 2025); spiced options such as a cinnamon coffee (March 2026) · prices on the higher side (March 2026)
places.notes: [Coffee · Takeyamachi, blend your own cup] A tiny, stylish specialty-coffee stand on the way to the Imperial Palace grounds, run by a barista from Tokyo's GLITCH COFFEE & ROASTERS. Sniff your way through jars of light-roast beans labelled a to i, choose two, and the barista blends and brews your cup — about ¥1,200 a cup. Just two seats, so plan to stroll with it. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per an April 2026 review: the owner trained at the renowned GLITCH COFFEE & ROASTERS in Tokyo before opening this shop in Kyoto. Reviewers describe a wide choice of light-roast beans from which guests pick two for a custom blend.
chef_bio.specialty: Two-bean custom blend.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor chose beans by smelling jars labelled a through i.
A November 2025 regular rates it a top pick in Kyoto for light-roast specialty coffee.
A March 2026 visitor found it busy and tried a cinnamon-flavoured coffee.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: blend kyoto (ブレンド キョウト)、コーヒースタンド、中京区竹屋町通麸屋町東入笹屋町447、丸太町駅から578m、月火木金12:00〜17:00、土日祝9:00〜17:00、水曜定休、2席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 浅煎りのスペシャルティコーヒー、豆の香りを嗅いで a〜i から2種を選んでブレンド、ブレンドコーヒー1,210円 (2025年5月)、シナモンのコーヒー、東京の GLITCH COFFEE & ROASTERS で修業した店主、値段は高め。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the bean jars; two seats only.

places.name: 京都ビアラボ (Kyoto Beer Lab)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a brewpub of malt beers, with fried snacks (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Snacks such as edamame and fries alongside kara-age and salmon jerky; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 13:00–23:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). Order and pay at the counter after taking a seat (June 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 15 seats; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX, Diners, transit IC and QR (Tabelog). Beside the Takase River, 245 m from Shichijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 30 March 2018; first batch and grand opening 27 April 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takase River near Shichijo — 245 m from Shichijo Stn
places.cuisine: Brewpub pouring its own craft beers, half (US-style) or pint (2026 reviews) · e.g. Yakima Valley IPA ¥1,200 a pint, hōjicha stout ¥1,200, kabusecha white ale ¥700 a half, macadamia brown ale, fruit sours from ¥800 a half, Sudachi Mint Seltzer ¥500 (May–June 2026) · snacks: house kara-age ¥850, edamame ¥450, fried cheese with black pepper ¥600, fries, salmon jerky (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Craft beer · Shichijo, a brewpub by the Takase River] A small brewery-bar beside the Takase River near Shichijo, pouring its own beers — from a Yakima Valley IPA to Kyoto-tea brews like hōjicha stout and kabusecha white ale — by the half (about ¥700–800) or pint (about ¥1,100–1,200). Order at the counter, sit by the water, add kara-age or fried cheese. Open daily 13:00–23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 30 March 2018, with its first batch and grand opening on 27 April 2018. Reviewers describe a brewpub by the Takase River with a long rotating list of house beers, including Kyoto green-tea styles.
chef_bio.specialty: House beers including hōjicha stout and kabusecha white ale.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor arrived on the anniversary and found about eight special beers on tap.
A March 2026 guest came straight from the sauna at Ume-yu nearby.
A May 2026 regular on a tenth visit dropped in just before 22:00 on a Friday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都ビアラボ、ビアバー・カフェ・バル、下京区十禅師町201-3、七条駅から245m、13:00〜23:00、無休、15席、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・交通系IC・QR 可、2018年3月30日オープン、2018年4月27日に初仕込み・グランドオープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 高瀬川沿いのブルーパブ、ハーフと US パイント、ヤキマバレーIPA 1,200円、ほうじ茶スタウト1,200円、かぶせ茶ホワイトエール700円 (ハーフ)、マカダミアブラウンエール、サワー800円 (ハーフ)、すだちミントセルツァー500円、自家製唐揚げ850円、枝豆450円、黒胡椒のフライドチーズ600円、席についてからカウンターで注文と会計、海外からの客。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the counter; many overseas visitors.
