places.name: そうげんカフェ (Sogen Cafe)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Curries with rice, carrot cake, parfaits and pudding; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Chicken and pork curries and dairy sweets; nothing vegan is marked (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); closed Saturday, Sunday and holidays (official site; Tabelog). Online reservations taken (March 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 at the counter, 12 at tables; non-smoking; no pets; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). On Shirakawa-dori in Kitashirakawa, across from Kyoto University of the Arts, 657 m from Chayama Stn (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Opened 1 August 2005 (Tabelog); run by the Kyoto antiques and design business SOWGEN, whose Shijo café has merged into this one (official site).
places.neighborhood: Kitashirakawa, across from Kyoto University of the Arts
places.cuisine: Café of curries and homemade sweets among plants and old furniture (official site; reviews) · combination curry with soft-boiled egg about ¥1,200 (June 2025), butter chicken curry, pork keema and chicken curry · carrot cake with cream cheese and walnuts, seasonal pudding à la mode ¥990, chocolate-and-berry parfait ¥890 (September 2025), iced café au lait, herbal tea (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Café · Kitashirakawa, curry and parfaits among old furniture] A leafy, quietly stylish café run by the antiques shop SOWGEN, opposite Kyoto University of the Arts on Shirakawa-dori. Lunch is a gentle, vegetable-rich curry — the combination plate is about ¥1,200 — and the sweets are worth the trip: carrot cake, pudding à la mode (¥990) and small parfaits. Weekdays only; online bookings taken.

roles: Run by SOWGEN (antiques, plants and design); staff not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: SOWGEN deals in antiques, brocante, plants and interior design; そうげんカフェ is its Kitashirakawa café, which absorbed the café of its Shijo shop. Tabelog gives the opening as 1 August 2005; a June 2025 reviewer calls it a local staple of more than 15 years.
chef_bio.specialty: Combination curry; pudding à la mode.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 guest who arrived just after last order was still welcomed in.
A December 2025 diner had long missed it because it opens only on weekdays, and named it a favourite café of the year.
A June 2025 visitor came after being turned away from a nearby ramen shop and stayed for the curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sowgen.com): SOWGEN、古道具・古家具・植物・デザイン、北白川店 そうげんカフェ (月〜金11:00〜17:00、L.O. 16:30、土日祝休み、左京区北白川上終町10-2)、四条店のカフェは北白川そうげんカフェへ統合、北白川 sowgen brocante は2026年3月で閉店。食べログ: カフェ・ケーキ・洋食、茶山・京都芸術大学駅から657m、20席 (カウンター8、テーブル12)、禁煙、ペット不可、カード・PayPay 可、2005年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 京都芸術大学の向かい、2種のカレー1,200円ほど、バターチキンカレー、ポークキーマ、キャロットケーキ、季節のプリンアラモード990円、チョコとベリーのパフェ890円、ネット予約可。

cultural_comfort.note: Weekdays only; book online.

places.name: 炭蔵 (Sumizo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu yakiniku with sweet-savoury marinades and tare; no gluten information is published (reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house (reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00, Monday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday; closed Tuesday–Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings recommended. JCB, AMEX and Diners; no e-money (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). In a residential street off Aburanokoji north of Nakadachiuri, easy to miss; about 13 min from Imadegawa Stn (742 m) and near Hotel Brighton Kyoto (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Aburanokoji-Nakadachiuri — 13 min from Imadegawa Stn
places.cuisine: Kuroge wagyu yakiniku (reviews) · owner’s recommended thick-cut harami and horumon in a sweet-savoury marinade; wagyu tongue; kalbi; an assorted Kuroge wagyu platter with cubed fillet steak; chateaubriand off the menu; chirimen rice bowl; vegetables (2024–2026 reviews) · about ¥5,500 with two drinks for a light meal (December 2024); typically ¥6,000–10,000 a head (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishijin-south, a neighbourhood wagyu house] A well-loved yakiniku shop tucked in a residential street west of the Imperial Palace, where the friendly owner talks you through the cuts. Try the thick-cut harami and marinated horumon, wagyu tongue, and ask about the off-menu chateaubriand; a chirimen rice bowl rounds things off. Most spend ¥6,000–10,000. Open only Monday and Friday to Sunday evenings.

chef_bio.background: Per 2024–2026 reviews: a long-regarded yakiniku restaurant in the Imadegawa area known for fresh Kuroge wagyu, a generous owner full of grilling tips, and an off-menu chateaubriand.
chef_bio.specialty: Thick-cut harami; off-menu chateaubriand.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 diner who arrived around 20:00 found it quiet and got plenty of tips from the generous owner.
A November 2025 guest rated the cubed fillet steak in the Kuroge wagyu platter beyond expectations.
An August 2026 visitor staying at a nearby hotel struggled to find the hidden entrance.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 炭蔵、焼肉、上京区油小路通中立売上る油橋詰町94-1、今出川駅から742m、月金土日17:30〜22:00、火水木定休、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー不可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 今出川エリアの名店、住宅街でわかりにくい、店主おすすめの厚切りハラミと甘辛いたれのホルモン、和牛タン、カルビ、黒毛和牛の盛り合わせとヒレのサイコロステーキ、メニューにないシャトーブリアン、ちりめん丼、2杯飲んで5,500円ほど (2024年12月)、ブライトンホテルの近く。

cultural_comfort.note: Hard to find; book ahead.

places.name: 湯葉料理 かめや本家 (Yuba Ryori Kameya Honke)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yuba and tofu kaiseki served with soy sauce, nama-fu (wheat gluten), shojin tempura and yuba-and-shrimp spring rolls; no gluten information (official menu; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: the shojin kaiseki “Rokujo” (¥5,000 plus tax) is made without fish, shrimp, crab, meat, shellfish, egg, dairy, green onion, garlic, nira, rakkyo, onion or fish dashi, per the official menu. The yuba kaiseki courses include yuba-and-shrimp spring rolls. Book the Rokujo course ahead.
places.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–21:30 (food L.O. 20:00, drinks 20:30), Tuesday–Saturday; Sunday 17:00–21:00; closed Monday; lunch on Saturdays and Sundays by reservation made the day before (Tabelog). Reservation only; parties of six or more by enquiry; cancellation policy applies (Tabelog). Strollers and wheelchairs are not allowed; the dining room is upstairs (Tabelog; August 2025). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 26 seats at tables with screens; private rooms; no smoking inside or in front (Tabelog; official site). Shoes off at the entrance (November 2025). Three doors from Hankyu Omiya Stn exit 1, 2 min from Randen Shijo-Omiya Stn (Tabelog). A yuba restaurant since the Taisho era (March 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Omiya just north of Shijo — 1 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Yuba and tofu kaiseki in a townhouse, with the popular yuba hot pot, yudofu and nama-fu (official site) · shojin kaiseki “Rokujo” ¥5,000 plus tax: sakizuke, appetizers, yudofu, sesame tofu, fresh yuba sashimi, dengaku, small dish, simmered dish, shojin tempura, steamed dish, rice, soup, pickles and dessert — fully plant-based (official menu) · yuba kaiseki: fresh yuba sashimi, three-flavour dengaku, yuba-and-shrimp spring rolls, crispy fried yuba edges, yuba hot pot in a sweet soy-milk broth, Japanese sweet (November 2025) · shojin kaiseki ¥4,600 in March 2026 · grilled nama-fu (July 2026) · Kyoto sake; Yoshino umeshu (2025–2026)
places.notes: [Yuba · Shijo-Omiya, a Taisho-era yuba house with a vegan course] An old townhouse yuba restaurant by Hankyu Omiya Station: fresh yuba sashimi, dengaku, the soy-milk yuba hot pot, and a fully plant-based shojin kaiseki (no fish dashi, egg, dairy or alliums) for ¥5,000 plus tax. Reservation only; dining room upstairs, shoes off; no strollers or wheelchairs. Weekend lunch by advance booking.

chef_bio.background: A March 2026 reviewer calls it a long-established yuba restaurant dating from the Taisho era. Photos of Showa-era stars line the walls (November 2025). Reviewers describe friendly women staff (November 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Yuba hot pot; fresh yuba sashimi; shojin kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 diner on the vegan “Rokujo” course was told the crispy fried yuba was made from the edges scooped up while making yuba.
A November 2025 guest was quizzed by the staff on how to read “hiryozu”.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 湯葉料理 かめや本家、中京区大宮通四条上ル錦大宮町135、町家で湯葉料理、ゆば鍋、湯豆腐、生麩の懐石、全席椅子・テーブル席、阪急大宮駅から3軒目、精進懐石 (六条) 5,000円 (税別): 先附け、前菜、湯豆腐、胡麻豆腐、生湯葉刺身、田楽、小鉢、煮物、精進揚げ、蒸し物、ご飯、汁物、漬物、デザート、「魚、海老、蟹、肉、貝、卵、乳製品、ネギ、ニンニク、ニラ、ラッキョウ、タマネギ、魚の出汁等は使用しておりません」。食べログ: 豆腐料理、火〜土 17:00〜21:30、日 17:00〜21:00、月曜定休、土日の昼は前日までに予約、完全予約制、ベビーカー・車椅子不可、26席、禁煙 (店の前も)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 大正からの老舗、生湯葉の刺身、田楽、湯葉と海老の春巻き、湯葉鍋、焼き生麩、2階の席、靴を脱ぐ。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; upstairs, shoes off; no strollers or wheelchairs.

vegan_cross_contact.text: The plant-based Rokujo course is cooked in the same kitchen as yuba courses that include shrimp spring rolls; whether pans or fryers are separated is not stated.

positives.text: Official shojin kaiseki “Rokujo” uses no fish, shellfish, meat, egg, dairy, alliums or fish dashi (official menu).

places.name: ミーミーミー (ME ME ME)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: pancakes (including cornmeal pancakes, flour not stated), French toast, toast (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: breakfast plates with bacon, eggs and dairy (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 8:30–15:00 daily; irregular closures (Tabelog; hours may change). No reservations; order and pay at the register first (Tabelog; February 2026). Fills by mid-morning, waits of 15–20 minutes around 10:00 (November 2025; March 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 16 seats with a counter; non-smoking (Tabelog). Original merchandise (August 2026). Down an alley near the Kamo River, 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; December 2025).
places.neighborhood: Near Kawaramachi-Marutamachi by the Kamo River — 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: American-style breakfast café, said “Mi Mi Mi” (September 2025) · pancake set with bacon, sunny-side-up egg, salad, fruit and a drink ¥1,800 (November 2025) · cornmeal pancakes with bacon, eggs, fruit and salad (December 2025; February 2026) · French toast (March 2026) · coffee and toast breakfast about ¥1,400 (August 2026) · café latte, chai latte, straightforward coffee (2025–2026)
places.notes: [Breakfast café · near the Kamo River at Marutamachi] A small retro, American-feeling café in an alley off the Kamo, open from 8:30 for pancake plates — cornmeal pancakes with bacon and eggs, French toast — and good coffee or chai. Order at the register; queues by 10:00. Some reviewers found the service brusque.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. Two 2026 reviewers found the service cold, one describing food and napkins being tossed onto the table (April 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Cornmeal pancakes; breakfast plates.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 guest staying near Kyoto University walked along the Kamo River to breakfast and tried cornmeal pancakes for the first time.
A November 2025 visitor got in at 8:30 on a Sunday and watched it fill up right after.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ミーミーミー (ME ME ME)、カフェ・パン、上京区上生州町210、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩5分、毎日8:30〜15:00、不定休、予約不可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)・電子マネー可、16席、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 「ミーミーミー」と読む、アメリカ風の朝食カフェ、パンケーキのセット (ベーコン、目玉焼き、サラダ、果物、ドリンク) 1,800円、コーンミールのパンケーキ、フレンチトースト、トーストとコーヒーの朝食約1,400円、チャイラテ、先に会計、10時頃は待つ、接客が冷たいとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the register; busy mornings.

places.name: 食と森 (Shoku to Mori)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A single plate lunch that changes — sawara and vegetable tempura, tofu hamburg steak — plus pudding; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Seasonal Kyoto-vegetable plate lunches, sometimes with a tofu hamburg, but most days include fish, and dashi and seasonings are not described (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) daily, closing early when food runs out; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, including same-day; walk-ins wait for the second sitting (Tabelog; March and May 2026). One lunch menu, different on weekdays and holidays (September 2026). Cash only (Tabelog; September 2026). 20 seats on tatami and at low tables over two floors; shoes off; kotatsu-style chairs on request (Tabelog; May–June 2026). Children welcome (Tabelog). Down narrow alleys between Higashi Hongan-ji and Nishi Hongan-ji, about 13 min from Gojo Stn, 15 min from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 8 June 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Between Higashi and Nishi Hongan-ji — 15 min on foot from Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: A café in a Taisho-era townhouse with seasonal Kyoto-vegetable plate lunches by an experienced chef (Tabelog shop text) · one plate lunch, different on weekdays and holidays: sawara and assorted vegetable tempura (March and September 2026); tofu hamburg steak plate (March 2026) · firm, old-fashioned pudding; tea (February 2026)
places.notes: [Plate lunch · between the Hongan-ji temples, a one-person machiya café] A 100-year-old townhouse café down narrow alleys, with tatami and low tables over two floors, where a single cook turns out one carefully made plate lunch a day — crisp sawara and vegetable tempura, a tofu hamburg — and a firm Showa-style pudding. Book (even same-day) to avoid waiting; slow but worth it. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes dishes by an experienced chef in a converted Taisho-era townhouse. An April 2026 reviewer found the café “being managed by just one person”, cooking at the entrance kitchen; a February 2026 guest marvelled at one staff member covering both floors. A March 2026 reviewer wondered whether a couple runs it. A May 2026 guest found the building’s age and a restroom without a hand basin unsettling, though the food was outstanding.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal plate lunch; pudding.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 guest with leg trouble was seated on a kotatsu chair with a view of the courtyard.
An October 2026 holiday visitor waited about 30 minutes; the reviewer advises coming with time to spare.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食と森、カフェ、下京区蛭子水町605、五条駅から徒歩13分、毎日11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、売り切れ次第終了、不定休、予約可、現金のみ、20席、座敷、子ども可、2022年6月8日オープン。店の紹介: 大正時代の町家を改装したカフェ、経験のある料理人の料理、京野菜の季節のプレートランチ。口コミ (2026年、英語): ランチは平日と休日でひとつずつ、鰆と野菜の天ぷら、豆腐ハンバーグのプレート、固めのプリン、ひとりで切り盛り、靴を脱いで座敷、待つこともある。

cultural_comfort.note: One set lunch; shoes off on tatami; cash only; reservations advised.

places.name: 無鄰菴 (Murin-an)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A tea-and-sweets set — matcha, dorayaki, monaka ice, dry sweets, Russian cakes from Murakami Kaishindo — none described for gluten (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Matcha and juices are plant-based; the sweets are not described (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: April–September 9:00–18:00, October–March 9:00–17:00; last entry 30 minutes before closing; reservations given priority (Tabelog). Garden admission ¥600 plus a café set ¥1,200 — any drink with any sweet; items are not sold singly (July–September 2026); entry and café can be booked together online (August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 20 seats, mostly tatami, facing the garden (Tabelog). Inside the garden villa of Yamagata Aritomo by Nanzen-ji, 7 min from Keage Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nanzen-ji approach, Okazaki — 7 min from Keage Stn
places.cuisine: Tea in the house of Yamagata Aritomo’s villa, overlooking the garden by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei (Tabelog shop text) · café set ¥1,200, any combination of seven or eight drinks and sweets (July–October 2026): matcha (hot or chilled) with dorayaki or Kyo-azuki dorayaki; monaka ice of matcha and red bean; Japanese white peach juice; dry sweets; Russian cakes from Murakami Kaishindo; Kyoto Beer Room’s “Muromachi Saison” beer (2026)
places.notes: [Garden café · Nanzen-ji, Yamagata Aritomo’s villa] Tea on the tatami of a Meiji-era villa looking over one of Kyoto’s great modern gardens, laid out by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei for Yamagata Aritomo. Pay the ¥600 garden entry, then a ¥1,200 set of matcha or juice with a sweet (dorayaki, monaka ice, Murakami Kaishindo Russian cake). Book ahead; open from 9:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text: the villa was built for the politician Yamagata Aritomo between 1894 and 1896, and the garden was made by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei on Yamagata’s instructions. Reviewers note an explanation of the garden before tea (August and October 2026) and its role in pre–Russo-Japanese War diplomatic talks (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha and sweets with the garden view.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor booked a combined entry-and-café ticket online for a 17:00 slot.
A September 2026 visitor finally tried the Russian cakes of Murakami Kaishindo here, never having managed to visit the shop.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 無鄰菴、カフェ、左京区南禅寺草川町31、蹴上駅から徒歩約7分、4〜9月 9:00〜18:00、10〜3月 9:00〜17:00、最終入場は閉場30分前、予約優先、カード・電子マネー・QR可、20席。店の紹介: 明治27〜29年にYamagata Aritomo が造営した別荘、七代目 Ogawa Jihei が作庭した近代日本庭園の名作を眺めながら抹茶を。口コミ (2026年、英語・日本語): 入場料600円とカフェのセット1,200円 (飲み物と菓子を自由に組み合わせ、単品不可)、抹茶とどら焼き、最中アイス、白桃ジュース、干菓子、村上開新堂のロシアケーキ、京都ビアルームの室町セゾン、事前予約がよい。

cultural_comfort.note: Garden admission ¥600 plus a ¥1,200 café set; many overseas visitors (September 2026); book ahead.

places.hours_raw: Monday, Thursday and Friday 11:00–20:30; Tuesday, Saturday and Sunday 11:00–18:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations at lunch, but takeaway orders can be booked (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX) and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 at the counter and 12 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). On the west side of Teramachi-dori, 50 m south of Imadegawa; a paid car park 30 m south; 7 min walk from Demachiyanagi or Imadegawa stations (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi south of Imadegawa — 7 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Handmade burger café, also pancakes (Tabelog) · burgers: the GRAND BURGER, bacon cheeseburger, avocado burger, avocado with two cheeses, bacon burger, egg topping; juicy thick patties, lightly seasoned (2025–2026 reviews) · fish and chips with tartare sauce; sets with coleslaw, salad, fries of two cuts and a drink, just under ¥2,000 (June 2025; August 2026) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Burgers · Teramachi south of Imadegawa] A small burger café by the Imperial Palace side of Teramachi: thick, juicy handmade patties with bacon, cheese, plenty of avocado or a fried egg, fish and chips with tartare, and hot fries — a set comes to just under ¥2,000. Lightly seasoned, with no signature sauce; busy with takeaway and visitors from abroad. One February 2026 guest found it soggy and pricey. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a hamburger, café and pancake shop on Teramachi south of Imadegawa. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe carefully handmade burgers, many takeaway orders and overseas visitors, and a small room that fills quickly.
chef_bio.specialty: Bacon cheeseburger; avocado burger.

anecdotes.text: On a holiday morning in June 2025 a guest craving "a carefully handmade burger" rather than fast food came at opening, and watched takeaway orders pile up by early afternoon.
An August 2026 burger fan called it one of the best ever, after a bacon cheeseburger with egg and fish and chips.
A July 2026 diner found meat juices pooled at the bottom of the bacon burger by the last bite.

cultural_comfort.note: Burger café popular with visitors; order at the counter; cards (JCB, AMEX) and e-money.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, obanzai, tempura, fried fish and somen with soy and dashi; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led set meals and izakaya plates, beef-tendon stew, dashi throughout (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; irregular closing days posted on Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — walk-ins turned away when full at lunch (Tabelog; July 2026). The owner may run lunch alone, so dishes come in order (April 2026). Rice refills appear to be free (April 2026). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 17 seats incl. a counter in a renovated townhouse (Tabelog; August 2026). 3 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 13 March 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Tanaka, by Demachiyanagi Stn — 3 min walk
places.cuisine: Townhouse izakaya with Japanese set lunches (2025–2026 reviews) · lunch sets ¥1,200–2,000 with five small obanzai and rice: sashimi of fish said to come from Kochi, thick-cut; tempura; kaisendon of kanpachi; fried oyster or fried fugu with sashimi; the ¥2,000 Shunsai set with both tempura and sashimi (2025–2026 reviews) · evening: assorted sashimi, eight obanzai, agedashi tofu, saikyo-yaki of sawara, conger eel over shaved ice with plum, fresh yuba dengaku, beef-tendon stew, somen to finish (July–October 2025) · a line of sake (2025–2026 reviews) · lunch ¥1,000–2,000, dinner ¥3,000–4,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Japanese set meals and izakaya · by Demachiyanagi Stn] A renovated townhouse near Demachiyanagi that one reviewer likens to a kaiseki kitchen: lunch sets of thick-cut sashimi, tempura or fried fugu with five small obanzai for ¥1,200–2,000, and evenings of obanzai, saikyo-yaki and beef-tendon stew with sake. Popular with locals, so book; when the owner works lunch alone, expect a wait and brisk manners. Irregular closures on Instagram.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya opened 13 March 2023 near Demachiyanagi; registered as an official listing by the shop. A July 2025 reviewer calls it the lunch of a Japanese kaiseki restaurant; reviewers in 2026 note fish said to be shipped from Kochi (August 2026) and an owner handling a full room alone at lunch (April 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi set lunch; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 lunch guest found the owner, handling everything alone, curt under the workload.
Another April 2026 diner was told dishes would come in order and chose the fried fugu and sashimi set — with firefly squid on the plate.
A March 2026 newcomer, drawn by the older regulars filing in, had a ¥1,200 fried-oyster set and noticed the cat-shaped chopstick rests.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、左京区田中下柳町13-6、出町柳駅から徒歩3分、毎日 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:00、不定休 (Instagram で告知)、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、17席、カウンター、貸切可、2023年3月13日オープン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年8月、英語): 改装した町家、昼の定食1,200〜2,000円 (小鉢5品とご飯)、高知から届くという魚の厚切りのお造り、天ぷら、かんぱちの海鮮丼、牡蠣フライやふぐの唐揚げとお造り、天ぷらとお造りの旬菜定食2,000円、ご飯のおかわりは無料らしい、夜はお造りの盛り合わせ、おばんざい8品、揚げ出し豆腐、鰆の西京焼き、鱧のかき氷と梅肉、生湯葉の田楽、牛すじの煮込み、締めのそうめん、日本酒、店主一人の昼は待つ・愛想がないとの声、猫の箸置き、予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; Japanese set menus; cards.

places.gf_detail: Not GF: demi-glace hamburg, ebi fry in homemade breadcrumbs, crab cream croquette and beef curry (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg, pork sauté, fried shrimp, croquettes and beef curry (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog lists 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30), closed Thursday, with lunch and dinner both until sold out; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted — weekday same-day bookings possible; lines at weekend lunch (Tabelog; May and August 2026). The menu can be limited on some days (July 2026). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). 27 seats: seven tables for two and two for four; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog; May 2026). 1F of the research-institute building on Shimogamo Morimoto-cho, by Shimogamo Shrine; Tadasu-no-Mori bus stop; paid parking to the south (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Shimogamo, by Shimogamo Shrine — Tadasu-no-Mori bus stop
places.cuisine: Long-established yoshoku of over 60 years (August 2026) · value lunch ¥1,500 of a 140 g hamburg and two ebi fry; special lunch ¥1,900 with hamburg, ebi fry in homemade breadcrumbs and crab cream croquette (May–October 2026) · hamburg steak with a fruity demi-glace; pork sauté; spicy beef curry with slow-cooked beef; potage soup +¥400; potato salad, pickled cucumber and shallots (2026 reviews) · the beef cutlet, once a speciality, is off the menu for now because of beef prices (October 2026) · about ¥1,500–2,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Shimogamo, by the shrine] A yoshoku restaurant of over sixty years in a research-institute building beside Shimogamo Shrine: a hearty special lunch of demi-glace hamburg, ebi fry in homemade crumbs and a crab cream croquette for ¥1,900, a spicy slow-cooked beef curry, and potage on the side. Lines at weekend lunch; the beef cutlet is paused while beef is dear. QR, no cards. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yoshoku, hamburg and curry restaurant on the ground floor of a research-institute building in Shimogamo. Reviewers in 2026 describe a long-established restaurant of over 60 years (August 2026), lines at weekend lunch, a broad age range of guests, and a beef cutlet withdrawn because of rising beef prices (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Special lunch; hamburg steak.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular says many guests ask for the beef cutlet, the old speciality, which is off the menu while beef prices are high.
A May 2026 guest arriving just after noon on a weekend found six groups waiting.
An October 2026 visitor found the croquette and shrimp very good but the hamburg disappointing and the portion modest.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食・ハンバーグ・カレー、左京区下鴨森本町15 生産開発科学研究所ビル1F、バス停 Tadasu-no-Mori、出町柳駅から726m、12:00〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)、木曜定休、昼も夜も売り切れまで、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、27席、禁煙、子ども可、南に有料駐車場 (1日600円)。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): 下鴨神社のそば、60年以上の老舗の洋食、週末の昼は行列、平日は当日予約も、お得なランチ1,500円 (140g のハンバーグと海老フライ2本)、スペシャルランチ1,900円 (ハンバーグ、自家製パン粉の海老フライ、蟹クリームコロッケ)、フルーティーなデミグラス、ポークソテー、辛口の牛肉のカレー、ポタージュ+400円、ポテトサラダ、ピクルスとらっきょう、名物だったビーフカツは牛肉の高騰で休止中、ハンバーグがいまひとつとの声。

places.name: アモーレ 木屋町 (Amore Kiyamachi)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: a trattoria-pizzeria of pizza, pasta and lasagna (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: prosciutto, seafood carpaccio and ajillo, meat lasagna, carbonara and cheese pizzas (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Thursday–Tuesday 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Wednesday since 18 June 2025 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, and advised for the terrace; same-day cancellations are charged the full meal price; groups of 10–20 by phone, three days ahead (Tabelog; September 2026). During the Kamogawa summer-deck season, a table charge of ¥350 per person for à la carte dinners (Tabelog original 鴨川納涼床期間中のディナータイム時アラカルトご注文の場合はテーブルチャージとしてお一人様350円(税込)頂戴致します。). 120 seats in four rooms, plus a riverside terrace and a summer noryo-doko deck; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Kiyamachi south of Bukkoji, on the Kamo River; 5 min walk from Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo stations (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Bukkoji, on the Kamo River — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Trattoria-pizzeria and bar on the Kamo River (Tabelog) · pizzas such as prosciutto Margherita, quattro formaggi, pork belly and Kujo negi (September–October 2026) · pastas: thin-noodle Bolognese, karasumi, classic carbonara; meat lasagna (2025–2026 reviews) · shrimp and mushroom ajillo, tomato salad, prosciutto, tuna and white-fish carpaccio (August–October 2026) · an artful dessert plate (September 2026) · wine on the riverside terrace (August 2026) · lunch ¥4,000–5,000, dinner ¥6,000–8,000 by reviews (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Italian · Kiyamachi on the Kamo River, terrace and summer deck] A big, casual trattoria-pizzeria between Kiyamachi and the Kamo River: pizzas such as quattro formaggi or pork belly with Kujo negi, karasumi pasta, ajillo and carpaccio, enjoyed best on the riverside terrace or the summer noryo-doko deck. Book for the terrace. Some find portions small for the price, and one August 2026 table waited for water and food. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a trattoria-pizzeria, bar and pasta restaurant on Kiyamachi with a Kamogawa summer deck; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe terrace or indoor seating chosen at booking, a quick fill on holidays, and a regular who works nearby.
chef_bio.specialty: Pizza; terrace dining by the Kamo River.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family wanted riverside dining but thought Japanese food too early for the children, and booked the Italian terrace instead.
An August 2026 friend from Kyoto booked the riverside terrace for a visitor who asked to drink by the Kamo River.
An August 2026 table was never brought water, though a group seated later was, and the food was slow.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・バル・パスタ、下京区木屋町通仏光寺下ル和泉屋町161、阪急河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、木〜火 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、2025年6月18日から水曜定休、予約可 (当日キャンセルは料金全額、10〜20名は電話、大人数は3日前まで)、鴨川納涼床期間中のディナーのアラカルトはテーブルチャージ1人350円 (税込)、120席 (4つのエリア)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年10月、英語): 鴨川沿い、テラス席と川床、プロシュートのマルゲリータ、クアトロフォルマッジ、豚バラと九条ねぎのピザ、細麺のボロネーゼ、からすみのパスタ、カルボナーラ、ラザニア、海老ときのこのアヒージョ、トマトサラダ、生ハム、まぐろと白身のカルパッチョ、デザートの盛り合わせ、ワイン、量が少なめとの声、水が出てこなかった・料理が遅いとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book the terrace; full charge for same-day cancellation; summer-deck table charge; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: 日本料理と日本酒 惠史 (Satoshi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki-style courses with miso-cured and soy-seasoned dishes, sashimi, and charcoal-grilled seafood (official site; 2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Japanese kitchen built on katsuo dashi, with charcoal-grilled Ise lobster, eel and fish (official site; 2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (reservation only, last entry 13:00), dinner 17:30–23:00 (last entry 21:00); closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Reservations accepted; cancellations the day before or on the day cost ¥10,000 per person, or 100% of a kaiseki course, also for reduced numbers (official site). Service charge 5%, or 10% for arrivals after 20:00 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料一律5％、20時以降の入店は10%頂戴いたします。」). Cards (VISA, Master); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 11 seats: a 7-seat counter and a table for 4; private hire for 5 or more (official site). Non-smoking; children welcome — give ages when booking (Tabelog). In a renovated old house on Ogawa south of Aneyakoji; 5 min from Karasuma Oike and Nijojo-mae Stns (Tabelog; January 2025). Opened June 2020 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Ogawa Aneyakoji, between Nijojo-mae and Karasuma Oike — 5 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese cooking and sake: seasonal produce such as Ise lobster, eel and Kyoto vegetables grilled on a dedicated hearth over binchotan, with red miso soup made from the lobster shells (official site) · every sake in the shop can be bought to take home (official site) · omakase three-course meals ¥5,500 (April 2025) and ¥6,000 (November 2025), opening with many small appetizers — fuki miso, miso-cured egg and tofu, saba heshiko — then sashimi and soup (2025–26 reviews) · à la carte such as grilled fugu (November 2025) · sake events: an all-you-can-drink of 15 sakes including Aramasa with a mini kaiseki ¥13,000 (August 2025); Fukushima produce and sake (January and March 2026) · drinks are pricey — small beer ¥1,300, highballs from ¥1,200 (January 2025)
places.notes: [Japanese cuisine and sake · Nijo, a former Wakuden head chef’s counter] An 11-seat renovated townhouse where the owner, 17 years at Wakuden, cooks almost single-handed: a run of small sake snacks, sashimi, and seasonal fish, Ise lobster or eel over binchotan, from a ¥5,500 three-course omakase. Strong on sake, with frequent sake events; drinks are pricey and late arrivals pay 10% service. Strict cancellation fees.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed on the site’s pages read; "Tomofumi Hoshina" in a January 2025 review), formerly head chef of Murasakino Wakuden’s bento kitchen (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (店主紹介): born 28 June 1975; worked at 鶴清 from 1997 and joined Wakuden in April 1999, rising through the grill, the cutting board and the simmering station at Kyoto Wakuden in Kyoto Isetan, then becoming head chef of the Murasakino Wakuden bento workshop in the owner’s thirties, with further kaiseki work at Kodaiji, Nagoya and Osaka Wakuden; left in September 2016 after 17 years and opened 日本料理と日本酒 惠史 in June 2020. Some furniture and tableware date from the Edo period.
chef_bio.philosophy: To work worthy of the Wakuden name, in gratitude to the okami and seniors there (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled seasonal dishes; sake.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 first-timer was impressed by the variety of appetizers and how well the chef ran almost everything alone, with international staff and guests.
A January 2026 regular came for a Fukushima recovery dinner, for which the owner travelled to Fukushima to source the ingredients.
An April 2025 couple found some starters a bit salty and the five slices of seared kinmedai sashimi a little slight for the ¥5,500 course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 古民家を改装した隠れ家、日本料理と日本酒 惠史 (さとし)、伊勢海老・鰻・京野菜などを専用の炉と備長炭で焼く炭焼料理、伊勢海老の殻の赤だし、店内の日本酒はすべて購入可、江戸時代からの家具や器、店主は老舗料亭 和久傳で料理長も務めた (1975年生まれ、1997年鶴清、1999〜2016年 和久傳、京都和久傳、紫野和久傳の弁当工房の料理長、高台寺・名古屋・大阪の和久傳)、2020年6月開業、12:00〜14:00 (予約のみ)・17:30〜23:00、不定休、11席 (カウンター7、テーブル4)、前日・当日キャンセルは一人一万円、懐石は100%。食べログ: サービス料一律5%、20時以降の入店は10%、カード (VISA・Master)。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年3月、英語): おまかせ3品5,500円・6,000円、蕗味噌、味噌漬けの卵や豆腐、鯖のへしこ、焼き河豚、日本酒の飲み放題13,000円 (新政など15種)、福島の食材と酒の会、飲み物は高め。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (cancellation fees apply); counter seats watch the cooking. International staff and guests (April 2025). No English evidence found.

places.notes: [Udon · Shogoin, breakfast udon from 6 am] A plastic-curtained shed beside a Shogoin noodle factory serving udon from 6:00: kitsune, tempura or curry udon for ¥600–800, and cold tub udon — up to three servings for ¥1,000. Soft noodles in a gentle broth; order, collect and pay yourself. Popular with early travellers, cyclists and walkers. Cash only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an udon shop in a simple space beside 谷口製麺所 (Taniguchi noodle factory). A November 2025 review says the noodles and broth are made with water from a well 70 m beneath the factory.
chef_bio.specialty: Morning udon; cold oke udon.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 traveller off an overnight bus came at 6:30 and chose an outside table to wake up.
A December 2025 regular shared the room with a cycling tour, elderly couples out for a morning walk and office workers.
A November 2025 visitor found the thin, very soft noodles not to personal taste.

places.notes: [Horse meat · Kiyamachi Shijo, sashimi to yakiniku until late] A lively, smoky horse-meat specialist off Kiyamachi: mixed horse sashimi, sweet raw liver, yukhoe bowls, horse yakiniku and sakura nabe, with friendly young staff who explain the cuts. Open to 1:00, or 3:00 at weekends; smoking at every seat; ¥400 appetizer charge. Book for Friday and Saturday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a horse-meat specialist (yakiniku, shabu-shabu, horse dishes) opened 21 September 2012. Tabelog also lists 馬肉酒場 金山 馬野郎 in Nagoya. An August 2026 reviewer chose it as a regular entry in Tabelog’s top-100 lists that allows smoking at all seats.
chef_bio.specialty: Assorted horse sashimi; horse liver.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 group booked the Sakura yakiniku course, saw the sakura nabe next door, asked to switch, and were happily allowed to.
An August 2026 diner liked the assorted sashimi so much it was ordered twice, with different cuts the second time.
An October 2026 diner found the sashimi assortment underwhelming but the horse liver outstanding.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・しゃぶしゃぶ・馬肉料理、中京区四条通木屋町二筋上ル西紙屋町368-1 SAKIZOビル 1F、京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、16:30〜翌1:00 (金土・祝前日は翌3:00まで)、ほぼ無休、予約可、お通し代400円、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、56席、全席喫煙可、2012年9月21日オープン、名古屋に 馬肉酒場 金山 馬野郎。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 馬刺し5種盛り、生レバー、ユッケとユッケ丼、馬焼肉、さくら鍋、桜焼肉コース、ビビンバ、自家製バター、さつまいものデザート、ソフトドリンク飲み放題600円、若い店員が親切、席が狭い。

Book dinner; cash or PayPay. Closed Thursday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), formerly head chef at a four-star hotel in China (September 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per a September 2026 review: the chef was formerly head chef at a four-star hotel in China and offers over 50 dishes of Shanghai, Guangdong, Beijing and Sichuan home cooking with authentic spices. Tabelog notes closures at New Year and over the Chinese Spring Festival.
chef_bio.specialty: Mapo tofu; dim sum.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 visitor was served tea instead of water by a staff member in a cute outfit, and had the ¥1,100 daily mapo tofu set with a rice refill.
An October 2026 regular always orders the Taiwanese century egg and noticed new and off-menu dishes.
A September 2026 family was glad to have booked during the holiday week — it was full.

roles: Owner-cook, not named in a source

anecdotes.text: April 2024: "Since it's a one-person operation, it takes a while to serve when it gets crowded."
September 2025: there was a sign saying "Enjoy wine at night," but "there was no wine bottle menu available… I simply asked for a 'reasonable option'."
March 2026: "The pasta was fresh, but I personally prefer dried pasta" — and "I wish they had a wider selection of soft drinks."

places.notes: [Sushi · Shijo-Omiya, an everyday counter by the station] A 13-seat counter beside Hankyu Omiya Station for casual, reasonably priced sushi and sashimi with a drink — omakase nigiri around ¥2,000, an English menu and chefs who speak English to the tourists now staying nearby. roles: Sushi chefs, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: A regular on a 33rd visit (July 2023) says the shop moved into the present building, across from where it used to be, and is now cleaner and larger. Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe two chefs — one relatively young — and a young man serving drinks, many regulars, and more foreign tourists as hotels and holiday rentals have spread around Omiya.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase nigiri; sashimi platter.

anecdotes.text: January 2022: "The only downside is that I'm not a fan of the chef's attitude."
December 2024: "The sushi pieces were quite small… and the iconic seafood chawanmushi only had two small pieces of what seemed to be leftover fish, not properly set."
March 2025: at a counter of American, Russian and Indian families, a regular "recommended them the warm Kikumasamune sake."

Courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥5,500 for 4 or more, booked by the day before (official site). Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money.
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Karasuma — a narrow alley off Yanaginobanba, 5 min walk from Karasuma / Shijo Stns
places.cuisine: Yakitori and seasonal Kyoto plates in a townhouse izakaya down an alley (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · large skewers of Kyoto Akadori jidori chicken; charcoal-grilled offal; grilled vegetable platter with tamami miso; homemade pizza (official site) · sashimi platter of four fish from the morning market ¥2,500; kumiage yuba with ikura ¥950; lotus-root tsukune ¥500 (February 2026); bagna cauda, hamo tempura, whelk with wasabi, nama-fu dengaku, dashimaki, clay-pot rice (2025–2026 reviews) · courses with all-you-can-drink: ¥5,500 (8 dishes, 90 min), ¥6,600 (9 dishes, 120 min), ¥7,700 (with wagyu shabu-shabu and ayu) (official site) · Kyoto and national sake
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma, yakitori in an alley townhouse] A renovated townhouse at the end of a narrow alley off Yanaginobanba: big Kyoto-chicken skewers, grilled offal, Kyoto vegetables, yuba with ikura and a homemade pizza, with a long sake list — popular for dates and parties, so book. One diner found the yakitori salty and the corn tempura heavy (August 2026). One drink each. Closed Sunday.

roles: Not named in a source; run by 株式会社 京色 (official site)
chef_bio.background: One of five Kyoto restaurants run by 株式会社 京色, founded by a president and two chefs who studied together at a cooking school and trained in Japanese, Western and creative cooking (official site); its sisters are うらやま京色 (kushiage), 祇園 晩餐 京色, 祇園天ぷら晩餐 and 角打ちと麺 ばんさん (official site). Reviewers in 2026 describe a stone-paved approach, a counter downstairs and sunken seating upstairs, individually plated course dishes, and fish from the central market each morning.
chef_bio.philosophy: From the site: particular about ingredients such as Kyoto Akadori chicken and fresh vegetables, for "bold dishes with delicate technique hidden in them" (official site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto Akadori yakitori; grilled vegetable platter.

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "I made a reservation for an early time, but the place was already fully booked. They were turning away customers without reservations."
August 2026: "The yakitori was a bit salty… The tempura corn had a bit too much batter, resembling a fritter, but it was delicious."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: BANSAN 京色、焼鳥・居酒屋・海鮮、中京区柳馬場通四条上ル瀬戸屋町473-1、烏丸駅・四条駅から徒歩5分、17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、日曜休み (翌日が祝日なら日曜営業・翌日休み)、利用は2.5時間、原文で「当店全てのお客様にワンドリンク制」、38席、個室 (1階は喫煙可で子供不可、2階の掘りごたつは最大20名)、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可。公式サイト: 京赤地鶏の大ぶりの焼き鳥、ホルモン炭焼、焼野菜、自家製ピザ、日本酒、宴会コース5,500円 (90分飲み放題、8品)、定番コース6,600円 (120分、9品)、接待・観光向け7,700円、4名から前日までに予約。株式会社 京色は、うらやま京色、BANSAN、祇園晩餐、天ぷら晩餐、角打ちと麺 ばんさんを運営、食の専門学校で共に学んだ社長と料理人2人が立ち上げた。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 細い路地の奥の町家、スマホで注文、刺身の盛り合わせ2,500円、汲み上げ湯葉のいくらのせ950円、蓮根のつくね500円、バーニャカウダ、鱧の天ぷら、つぶ貝のわさび和え、生麩田楽、だし巻、土鍋ご飯、早い時間でも満席で予約なしは断っていた、焼き鳥が塩辛くとうもろこしの天ぷらの衣が厚いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; one drink per guest; smartphone ordering.

places.name: 純米酒粕 玉乃光 (Junmai Sakekasu Tamanohikari)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: salt-koji karaage, fried horse mackerel and sea bream, soy- and miso-seasoned obanzai (2026 reviews). Allergy requests must be made by the day before a booking (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish namerou, karaage, pork and fish set meals; kasujiru (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site: tasting bar (1F) and restaurant (2F) 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); shop 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:30; closed irregularly and 31 December–3 January. Shaved ice in summer (July–September) 11:30–17:00. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「なし」 (the English page says one is added). Allergy needs and booking changes by the day before (Tabelog). 60 seats: 1F bar 16, 2F 34, an annex room for 10; private hire with minimum spends. Non-smoking. Cards, transit IC and e-money, many QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay). Opened 1 March 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: South of Shijo-Karasuma (Inabado-cho) — 3 min walk from Shijo Stn exit 5
places.cuisine: The restaurant, tasting bar and shop of the Fushimi sake brewer Tamanohikari, cooking with its junmai sake lees and koji (official site; 2026 reviews) · 1F bar: 30 minutes of self-pour from about fifteen Tamanohikari sakes ¥1,500, with snacks such as sea bream namerou with sake lees and sake-lees curry (Tabelog; August 2026) · 2F lunch sets with amazake, kasujiru (sake-lees soup) and small obanzai: fermented Kyoto obanzai, salt-koji karaage, namerou with fried horse mackerel, pork loin; a ¥500 sake set (2026 reviews) · dinner courses with all-you-can-drink sake about ¥5,000–5,200 (August–September 2026) · soft serve; natural-ice shaved ice in summer
places.notes: [Sake-lees cooking · Shijo-Karasuma, Tamanohikari brewery's townhouse] Fushimi brewer Tamanohikari's own townhouse: a ground-floor bar where ¥1,500 buys 30 minutes of self-pour from about fifteen of its sakes, and an upstairs dining room of gentle sake-lees and koji lunches with amazake and kasujiru, and sake-paired courses at night. Some found portions small and service slow (September 2026). No service charge.

roles: Not named in a source; run directly by 玉乃光酒造 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Run directly by the sake brewer 玉乃光酒造 of Fushimi, which began brewing in 1673 in Wakayama and is now in its 13th generation (official site); opened 1 March 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a renovated townhouse with a bar on the ground floor, a dining room upstairs, staff in Tamanohikari T-shirts, and sake events such as a September 2026 sanma night.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per its site, a place to eat dishes made with the brewery's junmai sake lees with its sake, and a showcase of ideas for using them at home (official site, paraphrased).
chef_bio.specialty: Sake-lees and koji cooking; self-pour sake bar.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: for ¥1,500 "They handed me a wine glass, and I could fill it with any of the 15 varieties of Tamano Hikari sake in any amount I wanted."
September 2026: "the portion size would feel quite small… Additionally, the service takes some time."
August 2026: "the sea bream had a bit of a fishy taste… The pork set meal was a bit on the smaller side and felt rather bland."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都・伏見の玉乃光酒造の直営のレストランとショップ、純米酒粕を使った料理と玉乃光の酒、延宝元年 (1673年) に和歌山で創業し現在は13代目、1階テイスティングバーと2階レストランは11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、ショップは11:30〜15:00・17:30〜21:30、不定休、12月31日〜1月3日休み、夏のかき氷。食べログ: 純米酒粕 玉乃光、日本料理・居酒屋・おでん、下京区因幡堂町658-1、四条駅5番出口から徒歩3分、1階バーは30分飲み放題1,500円、原文でサービス料「なし」、アレルギーは前日までに、60席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2022年3月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): 約15種の玉乃光の自分で注ぐ飲み放題、酒粕の鯛のなめろう、酒粕カレー、京の発酵おばんざいランチ、塩麹の唐揚げ、なめろうとアジフライ、豚ロースの定食、甘酒、粕汁、500円の日本酒セット、5,000〜5,200円の飲み放題付きコース、ソフトクリーム、天然氷のかき氷、量が少なく提供が遅いという声、鯛が生臭く豚の定食が物足りないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-pour sake bar downstairs; allergy requests by the day before.

places.name: タンブリーノ (Tamburino)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: a spaghetti and pizza counter, with focaccia and bruschetta in the sets (2023–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. An aglio e olio and tomato pastas appear, but most pastas use bacon, sausage, fish or cream; no vegan information (2023–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Friday 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:30; Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cards; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and two tables of 4; smoking allowed, except at weekend and holiday lunch (Tabelog). On Imadegawa-dori east of the Kawabata crossing, by a bus stop; 5 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; January and August 2024).
places.neighborhood: Imadegawa-dori east of Kawabata — 5 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood spaghetti and pizza counter, "feel free to come alone" (May 2023) · about ten pastas from ¥750, sets from ¥800 with a mini salad or focaccia; special lunch of carbonara, bruschetta, mini salad and tea (January 2024–May 2025) · e.g. mentaiko spaghetti, wiener arrabbiata, takana and tuna, spinach Bolognese, aglio e olio, chilled tomato soup pasta with salmon and avocado, a carbonara-style cream pasta with bacon, asparagus and a fried egg (2023–2025 reviews) · pizza Margherita and octopus pizza; a mini curry-flavoured butter rice (2023–2025 reviews) · under ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Spaghetti · Imadegawa by Demachiyanagi, couple-run] A homely sixteen-seat spaghetti counter by a bus stop on Imadegawa, run by a friendly couple to a Beatles soundtrack, with album covers regulars have brought in: about ten pastas from ¥750, such as mentaiko or takana and tuna, cheap lunch sets, and Margherita or octopus pizza. Student-friendly prices. Smoking allowed except at weekend lunch. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a pasta and café counter near Demachiyanagi. Reviewers describe a couple running it (August 2024), a Beatles-loving owner with music and memorabilia on display, some brought in by regulars (August 2024; November 2025), and student-friendly prices near the university (February 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Feel free to stop by even if you're alone" (May 2023 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Mentaiko spaghetti; set lunches.

anecdotes.text: An August 2024 diner, tempted in by the bus stop out front, chatted with the couple over a chilled tomato soup pasta, under Beatles records some say regulars brought in.
A November 2025 guest spotted a sign about yellow tomatoes that recalled the ones from Ryukoku.
A December 2025 reviewer loved the tomato sauce but thought the pizza dough an overlooked weak point.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パスタ・カフェ、左京区田中下柳町8-12、京阪出町柳駅から徒歩5分、月・火・金 11:00〜15:00・17:30〜22:30、水・土・日 11:00〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、木曜定休、予約可、カード不可、電子マネー・QR 可、16席 (カウンター8、4人がけテーブル2)、喫煙可 (土日祝の昼は禁煙)。口コミ (2023年5月〜2025年12月、英語): 「一人でも気軽に」、今出川通沿い、川端の東、バス停の前、夫婦で営む、ビートルズの音楽とレコードジャケット、パスタは約10種で750円から、セットは800円から (ミニサラダやフォカッチャ)、カルボナーラ・ブルスケッタ・ミニサラダ・お茶のスペシャルランチ、明太子スパゲティ、ウインナーのアラビアータ、高菜とツナ、ほうれん草のボロネーゼ、アーリオ・オーリオ、鮭とアボカドの冷製トマトスープパスタ、ベーコンとアスパラのカルボナーラ風 (目玉焼き)、マルゲリータ、たこのピザ、カレー風味のミニバターライス、学生向けの値段、生地がもう一歩との声。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and two tables; e-money and QR, no cards; smoking allowed except weekend lunch.

places.name: 出町カラビンカ (Demachi Karabinka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Spice curries on rice with fried onion and crisp toppings; the roux and toppings are not described for gluten (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature black curry uses beef tendon; specials use chicken or anchovy; egg and cheese toppings (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Sunday–Friday and holidays 11:30–15:00; closed Saturday and occasionally on other days, posted monthly on Instagram; rarely an evening 17:00–21:00 (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); a short wait outside at lunch (March 2026). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). 6–8 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). At the corner of Teramachi just west of Kawaramachi-Imadegawa; 2–3 min from the Kawaramachi-Imadegawa bus stop, 10 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; May 2026).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi west of Kawaramachi-Imadegawa — 10 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Small spice-curry counter (2025–2026 reviews) · black curry of black sesame and beef tendon ¥1,000, mild, creamy and sweet-sesame rich, with crisp flakes, fukujinzuke and a hint of honey (October 2025–May 2026) · "kimagure" curry of the day, changing twice a month, e.g. anchovy chicken ¥1,100, ginger chicken, plum curry (March–September 2026) · toppings: spice egg, runny egg, grilled cheese; fried lotus root and pickled onions (2025–2026 reviews) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Spice curry · Kawaramachi-Imadegawa, six seats] A tiny counter at the corner of Teramachi where the young owner cooks each plate alone: a mild, deeply sesame-rich black curry of beef tendon for ¥1,000, and a "kimagure" curry of the day that changes twice a month — ginger chicken, plum, anchovy chicken. Add a spice egg. Expect a short wait. QR, no cards. Lunch only; closed Saturday.

roles: Owner (unnamed, described as young), who cooks alone (June and September 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a curry counter at Teramachi-Imadegawa, with closing days posted on Instagram and occasional evening service. Reviewers in 2026 describe an owner who prepares each plate with care alone (March and June 2026); an August 2025 reviewer mentions a Saturday evening pop-up run by another curry cook.
chef_bio.specialty: Black curry; kimagure curry.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 walker on the Kamo River path from Sanjo was drawn in by the smell of spices.
A June 2026 three-time regular compares the limited ginger chicken curry with another shop's ginger dish.
An August 2025 dinner guest met a woman running a Saturday pop-up here and called that cook an artist of curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カレー、上京区真如堂前町98-3 アクアビル 1F、出町柳駅から徒歩10分、市バス・京都バス河原町今出川から徒歩2〜3分、日〜金・祝 11:30〜15:00、土曜定休 (ほかの休みは毎月 Instagram で告知、まれに17:00〜21:00の夜営業)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、8席 (カウンター)、禁煙。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 寺町の角、カウンター6席、店主一人で営む、黒カレー (黒ごまと牛すじ) 1,000円、マイルドでクリーミー、カリカリのトッピング、福神漬け、はちみつ、月2回替わる気まぐれカレー (アンチョビのチキン1,100円、生姜のチキン、梅)、スパイスエッグ、半熟卵、焼きチーズ、揚げ蓮根、玉ねぎのピクルス、土曜の夜に別の作り手のポップアップがあったとの声 (2025年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Six counter seats, wait outside if full; QR, no cards; check Instagram for closures.

places.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat udon and soba with a sweet dipping sauce, tempura; oyakodon in a dashi-soy broth (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based broths, oyakodon, egg dishes and tempura (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday and Friday 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–20:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 11:30–20:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). Tatami seating, shoes off, plus some tables; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). A historic townhouse with a right-to-left signboard on Gion-machi Kitagawa; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gion, north of Shijo — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Long-established Gion noodle house, founded in 1927 per an October 2026 review · oyakodon ¥1,900 with soft, creamy egg in a savoury, unsweetened dashi and a pinch of sansho (September–October 2026) · keiran udon with ginger-thickened broth and fluffy egg; kitsune udon; egg rice bowl (September–October 2026) · tororo soba ¥2,100; tempura zaru soba (August–October 2026) · sake (Tabelog) · about ¥1,000–3,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Udon and oyakodon · Gion, a 1927 townhouse] A historic Gion noodle house up on tatami, once named in a magazine as serving Japan's best oyakodon: soft, creamy egg in a deep, unsweetened dashi with sansho, a ginger-laced keiran udon and kitsune udon, plus soba. Reviewers say kabuki actors and geisha have long come here. Prices feel high for the portions to some. Cash only; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an udon, soba and oyakodon restaurant in Gion. An October 2026 reviewer writes that it was founded in 1927 and is frequented by kabuki actors and geisha; a September 2026 reviewer recalls a food magazine long ago naming its oyakodon the best in Japan, and finds the restaurant unchanged.
chef_bio.specialty: Oyakodon; keiran udon.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 lunch party of three paid ¥9,600 in cash — and the payer, with only ¥10,000 on hand, called it a close call.
A September 2026 parent, arriving from Niigata, made a Gonbee oyakodon the first meal back in a city of student days.
An October 2026 traveller was sent here by a staff member at a well-known yatsuhashi shop.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うどん・そば・親子丼、東山区祇園町北側254、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜水・金 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜20:00、土日祝 11:30〜20:00、木曜定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、座敷とテーブル、禁煙、日本酒。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 祇園の老舗、1927年創業 (2026年10月の口コミ)、右から読む看板、町家、靴を脱いで座敷へ、歌舞伎役者や芸妓が通う店との声、昔の料理雑誌で日本一の親子丼と紹介された、親子丼1,900円 (ふわとろの卵、甘くないだし、山椒)、生姜のあんの「けいらん」、きつねうどん、玉子丼、とろろそば2,100円、天ざるそば、そば湯がなかった、現金のみ、祇園らしく高め・量が少なめとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off, tatami; no reservations; cash only.

places.cuisine: Fresh-pasta Italian with an "authentic Italian atmosphere", the main shop of a small Kyoto group (Tabelog; October 2026) · lunches about ¥1,200–2,900: a business lunch of salad, fresh pasta and focaccia ¥1,200; the recommended pasta lunch ¥2,070 with an appetiser platter (quiche, pumpkin salad, pâté), pasta, focaccia, panna cotta and coffee; the Bon Appetit lunch ¥2,900; specials +¥600 (September–November 2026) · pastas such as Shinshu pork in tomato cream, pumpkin cream, mushroom tomato, chestnut and bacon, conger eel and edamame in shiso pesto (September–October 2026) · dinner with seasonal fish and meat, wine and champagne; birthday lunch plans (September–October 2026) · lunch ¥2,000–3,000, dinner ¥6,000–8,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Italian · Nishikikoji behind Daimaru, fresh pasta] The bright, picture-hung main shop of Kyoto's Daniel's, up a floor on Nishikikoji: generous lunch sets of an appetiser platter, chewy fresh pasta, hot focaccia, dessert and coffee from about ¥2,000 (a ¥1,200 business lunch too), sparkling water on the table, and wine-friendly dinners. Lines before opening — book. Some find it ordinary for the price. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian with an authentic Italian atmosphere and a 3F private room; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in October 2026 note several sister restaurants, call this the main branch, and describe sparkling water served at every Daniel's.
chef_bio.philosophy: An authentic Italian atmosphere (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh pasta lunch.

anecdotes.text: Two university classmates, from Kanto, reunited here in October 2026 for the first time in five years, after a conference.
A September 2026 group of three, turned away once when full, booked ahead and had the pasta split into three plates.
A September 2026 diner found the ¥2,900 Bon Appetit lunch good but no better than ordinary, and the room cramped.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ・ピザ、中京区錦小路通高倉西入ル西魚屋町596 グラマラスフードビル 2F (1階は Momoya)、大丸京都店の錦小路口から東へ、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅18番出口から、火〜日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、月曜定休 (祝日なら翌火曜)、予約可、46席、宴会 着席30名・立食50名、3階に個室 (8〜20名)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、本格的なイタリアの雰囲気。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): 本店、姉妹店がいくつか、開店前から行列、炭酸水のサービス、ビジネスランチ1,200円 (サラダ、生パスタ、フォカッチャ)、おすすめのパスタランチ2,070円 (前菜の盛り合わせ、パスタ、フォカッチャ、パンナコッタ、コーヒー)、ボナペティランチ2,900円、スペシャルは+600円、Shinshu の豚のトマトクリーム、かぼちゃのクリーム、きのこのトマト、栗とベーコン、鱧と枝豆の大葉のペスト、夜は季節の魚と肉、ワイン、誕生日のランチプラン、普通・狭いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (lines at opening); set lunches; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: ポコ (Poco)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: toast and sandwich breakfasts; omurice and dry curry are not described for wheat (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg, ham and butter breakfasts, omurice (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 6:00–19:30; breakfast 6:00–11:00. No reservations. Smoking allowed — ashtrays on every table (Tabelog; February 2026). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; July 2025). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, 8 at tables. Across from the Kyoto Station bus rotary, 2 min walk (Tabelog; reviews).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, central exit — 2 min walk, across from the bus rotary
places.cuisine: A Showa-era kissaten opposite Kyoto Station, open from 6 a.m. (2024–2026 reviews) · four breakfast sets: toast and boiled egg ¥650; B set ¥600; C set of toast, salad (with banana), boiled egg and coffee ¥700; ham-egg-cucumber sandwich set ¥750 (December 2025–June 2026) · home-style omurice wrapped in a thin, not-sweet omelette; dry curry ¥750 (February 2026) · iced coffee ¥500, mixed juice, coffee jelly (2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kissaten · Kyoto Station, 6 a.m. breakfasts with smoking] A narrow, Showa-era coffee shop across from the Kyoto Station bus rotary that opens at six: toast-and-egg breakfast sets from ¥600, a grandmotherly omurice and dry curry for lunch, plain coffee. Smoking is allowed throughout — a non-smoker found it hard going (March 2026). Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe a long, narrow room kept as it was in the Showa era, a master, an older couple who "seemed to be running the place" (February 2026), local regulars, and a smell of tobacco and coffee.
chef_bio.specialty: Omurice; morning sets.

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "I entered without knowing it was a smoking establishment… the environment was not ideal for me since I don't smoke. However, the service from the lady… was excellent."
"I hope places like this continue to exist forever." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ポコ、喫茶店・オムライス、下京区東洞院通塩小路上る東塩小路町550、JR京都駅から徒歩2分、毎日 6:00〜19:30 (モーニング 6:00〜11:00)、予約不可、14席 (カウンター6、テーブル8)、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2024年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 京都駅前のロータリーの向かい、昭和の喫茶店、全席に灰皿、モーニングは4種 (トーストとゆで卵650円、Bセット600円、Cセット700円、サンドイッチセット750円)、甘くない薄焼き卵のオムライス、ドライカレー750円、アイスコーヒー500円、ミックスジュース、コーヒーゼリー、現金のみ、年配の夫婦が切り盛りしているようだという声、たばこが苦手な人にはつらいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking allowed throughout; cash only.

places.name: たかひとり (Takahitori)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: ponzu, homemade soy-sauce koji, white-miso and dashi dishes (2025 reviews); no allergen information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a duck restaurant — duck meat, offal and duck broth (official site; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 17:00–23:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday. 7 counter seats, run by the owner alone (official site) — phone ahead to check for a seat (official site); fully booked nights (November 2025). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking throughout. Basement of the House 24 building, beneath the coffee shop MIWAKU, on the southwest side of Yodobashi Camera (Tabelog). Opening: Tabelog says 16 June 2014; the official site says June of Heisei 27 (2015).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station (north), behind Kyoto Tower — basement near Yodobashi Camera
places.cuisine: A seven-seat counter for Kyoto sake and Kyo-Tamba duck (official site; 2024–2026 reviews) · sake from all 40 of Kyoto Prefecture's breweries, from Joyo in the south to the Tango peninsula in the north (official site), poured in 90 ml measures with the brewers' stories (November 2025) · duck: grilled tenderloin ¥770, gizzard ¥660, air-dried duck ¥1,320, loin, seared breast with three-year-aged yuzu ponzu, thigh, tongue, liver, tsukune, duck-and-leek tofu, duck-and-egg rice bowl (2025 reviews) · Kyoto greens with homemade soy-sauce koji, turnip in white miso ¥660, homemade tofu (2024–2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Kyoto sake and duck · Kyoto Station, a one-man basement counter] A seven-seat basement counter by Kyoto Station where the owner, alone, pours sake from every one of Kyoto Prefecture's 40 breweries in small measures with the story of each, alongside Kyo-Tamba duck from tongue to tenderloin. Portions are small (August 2026); a little hard to find and to walk into. Call ahead. Cash only. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Owner, running the shop alone (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, owner 川嶋隆徳 runs the seven-seat counter alone, pairing Kyoto sake with Kyo-duck raised in Kyotamba, and stocks sake from all 40 breweries in Kyoto Prefecture, large and small. Diners in 2024–2026 describe a basement counter close to the owner, careful explanations of each brewery, rare duck cuts, and mostly solo guests.
chef_bio.philosophy: From the official site: Kyoto sake for visitors and locals alike — "京都の日本酒にこだわり" (particular about Kyoto sake).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyo-Tamba duck with Kyoto sake.

anecdotes.text: November 2025: a sake from the Shotoku brewery in Fushimi "available only at this restaurant, filled with nitrogen" — and when the guest ordered a second glass of the same sake, the owner "kindly changed the sake cup."
May 2025: "Since the owner operates the restaurant solo, I want to be a considerate customer who can read the room… and not linger unnecessarily."
August 2026: "The portions are small, but they are unique delicacies that pair perfectly with drinks."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都地酒・鴨料理、カウンター7席、17時〜23時、火曜・水曜休み、店主の川嶋隆徳がひとりで営む、京都駅前のビル地下1階、京丹波で育てられた京鴨、平成27年6月開店、京都の大小全40蔵の日本酒 (南は城陽市から北は丹後半島まで)、満席で断ることがないよう電話で空席の確認を。食べログ: たかひとり、居酒屋・日本酒バー・鶏料理、下京区東塩小路町579-24 B1F、ヨドバシカメラの南西角の南側、喫茶店 MIWAKU の地下、月・木〜日 17:00〜23:00、火・水休み、7席、全面禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、2014年6月16日オープン。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年8月、英語): 鴨ささみ炙り770円、鴨砂ずり660円、鴨の一夜干し1,320円、鴨ロース焼き、3年熟成の柚子ポン酢、もも、鴨タン、レバー、つくね、鴨ねぎ豆腐、鴨と卵の丼、壬生菜と自家製醤油麹、かぶの白味噌煮660円、自家製豆腐、酒は90mlずつ、伏見の Shotoku の店限定の窒素充填の酒、店主ひとりなので長居しない配慮を、量は少なめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Seven-seat counter run by one person; phone ahead; cash only.

places.name: 京もつ鍋 亀八 本店 (Kyo Motsu-nabe Kamehachi Honten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: miso and soy broths; the finishing noodles are domestic wheat with tapioca; nama-fu, chijimi and karaage on the menu (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-offal hot pot in dashi; horse sashimi, smoked mackerel (official site).
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 17:00–24:00 (last orders food 23:00, drinks 23:30); open all year except irregular days (New Year, staff training). Two-hour limit when busy. Book through the official site (24 hours; the phone is often busy); weekends fill up, and winter is hard to book (official site). Table charge ¥380 incl. tax, an otoshi of smoked mackerel — Tabelog, Japanese original 「チャージ料 税込380円（付出し）」. 30 seats: counters, tables and tatami rooms; upstairs for groups to 20. Non-smoking (and no smoking outside). Children welcome. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR. Down the alley east of Kiyamachi Rokkaku, halfway along Pontocho 5th alley. Opened 1 April 2008 (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho / Kiyamachi-Sanjo — an alley between them, 4 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style motsu-nabe in a Kyoto dashi broth (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · Kyo motsu-nabe ¥1,880 a portion: "white" (Kyoto white miso, the signature), "golden soy", "spicy red", "yellow" (this shop only); mentaiko motsu-nabe ¥2,400; summer "kara-nabe" ¥2,100 (official site) · toppings: Omi beef offal ¥1,100, pork belly ¥880, Daisen chicken ¥770, honeycomb tripe, Hanbei three-colour nama-fu ¥500; finish with stone-ground Kyoto noodles ¥660 or egg zosui ¥660, tomato-cheese risotto ¥770 (official site) · horse sashimi, chijimi, motsu karaage, smoked mackerel otoshi · courses with 90-min all-you-can-drink: ¥5,000 (5 dishes), ¥6,000 (8 dishes), ¥7,000 (10 dishes) (official site)
places.notes: [Motsu-nabe · Pontocho alley, Kyoto white-miso hot pot] The original shop (2008) of a three-shop Kyoto motsu-nabe house, tucked in an alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho: Omi beef offal in a Kyoto dashi broth — the white-miso version is the one to order — finished with stone-ground noodles or egg zosui, and all-you-can-drink courses from ¥5,000. Book on the website; winter fills. ¥380 table charge.

roles: Second-generation manager known in the shop as "Pe-san" (official site); owner not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, 亀八 本店 opened in April 2008 as the first shop; the name pairs 亀 (turtle, for luck) and 八 (eight, for endless happiness). Early on the first manager stood outside every day calling in customers; word of mouth made it so busy that winter tables could not be booked, without spending on advertising. The second-generation manager, a regular of a sister shop since university who joined in 2009 and worked at the annex 亀八別館 first, keeps the founding recipe (official site). Sister shops: 亀八別館 (Pontocho) and 亀八 山科店 (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: From the site: a hot pot that starts from taking dashi, the heart of Kyoto cooking — "a hot pot made for drinking the soup" (official site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyo motsu-nabe "white" (white miso).

anecdotes.text: August 2026: at the counter, "the manager and staff shared delicious ways to enjoy the food," and the white broth used a Kyoto ginjo white miso.
July 2026: the "ultimate noodles" "had a slightly junky flavor."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都先斗町 京もつ鍋亀八、京出汁のあっさりまろやかな京もつ鍋、スープを飲むための鍋、国産小麦にタピオカ粉を混ぜた石臼挽きの麺、2008年4月に1号店の亀八本店がオープン、屋号は縁起の良い「亀」と無限の幸せの「八」、初代店長が毎日呼び込み、口コミで冬は予約が取れない人気店に、広告費を使わない、二代目店長「ぺーさん」(2009年入社、姉妹店の常連から入社、亀八別館を経て本店へ)、京もつ鍋「自慢の白」「黄金の醤油」「旨辛の赤」「やみつきの黄」(本店限定) 各1,880円、明太子もつ鍋2,400円、夏の辛鍋2,100円、近江牛もつ1,100円、半兵衛麩の三色京生麩500円、京都石臼挽き麺660円、たまご雑炊660円、トマトチーズリゾット770円、馬刺し、チヂミ、もつの唐揚げ、飲み放題90分のコース5,000円・6,000円・7,000円、本店・亀八別館・亀八山科店、営業 17:00〜24:00、不定休。食べログ: 京もつ鍋 亀八 本店、中京区木屋町通三条下ル材木町185-3、原文で「チャージ料 税込380円（付出し）」、30席、禁煙、子供可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、2008年4月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年11月、英語): 白味噌のもつ鍋、近江牛のもつ、しめ鯖の付出し、締めの麺と雑炊、5,000円の飲み放題コース、細い路地で見落とす、スタッフが鍋を作ってくれる、究極麺は少しジャンクな味という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Online booking; staff prepare the hot pot; ¥380 table charge.

places.name: 微風台南 TEARSⅡ (Bifuu Tainan TEARS II)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles, scallion pancakes, dan bing, fried pork chop; soy-braised dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: lu rou fan, beef noodle soup, pork rib and chicken bento (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Monday. Rurubu gives 12:00–14:30 (last order 14:15) and 18:00–21:30 (last order 21:00), closed Monday (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday) and the first Tuesday. No reservations — queues form before opening on Saturdays (April and October 2026); orders are taken from whoever calls first, not in queue order, and food can be slow at peak (2026 reviews). 28 seats: a dirt-floor front room and a tatami room at the back of a townhouse. Non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; take-away. No cards; e-money and PayPay.
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-Marutamachi, just north of the crossing — 5 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Tainan home cooking in a retro townhouse, staffed mostly by Taiwanese students (Rurubu; 2024–2026 reviews) · lu rou fan in three sizes (medium ¥700); braised beef noodle soup with or without broth ¥900; pork-chop fried rice; shrimp fried rice; pork rib bento with five sides; meat noodles (2025–2026 reviews) · scallion pancakes, dan bing, stir-fried greens (2026) · douhua ¥600 (all toppings +¥165), almond jelly, shaved ice, passion-fruit smoothie; Taiwan Beer in honey and pineapple (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Taiwanese · Kawaramachi-Marutamachi, Tainan diner in a townhouse] A retro Tainan-style diner in an old townhouse just north of Kawaramachi-Marutamachi, run largely by Taiwanese students: lu rou fan, beef noodle soup, pork-chop fried rice, rib bento and douhua at under ¥1,000 a dish. It fills within minutes of opening; orders go to whoever calls first and can be slow (2026); portions are on the small side (April 2026). No bookings, no cards. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A 2017 nippon.com column describes a small, plain sign reading 微風台南 near the Imperial Palace, a blackboard of Taiwanese bento, Taiwanese soft drinks on old wooden tables, a red lantern and a Tainan shop sticker on the door. Rurubu says nearly all the part-time staff are Taiwanese students. Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe a townhouse with an earth-floored front and a tatami room at the back, Taiwanese-accented staff and many Taiwanese customers.
chef_bio.specialty: Lu rou fan; braised beef noodle soup.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: by 11:55 "there were already 6 to 7 groups lined up… be aware that they don't take orders in the order of the line… They take orders based on who calls the staff first."

November 2026: "The seasoning was neither particularly good nor bad… more like the flavor level you'd find in a student area!" — but the bai tang guo tasted "almost exactly like what I had for breakfast near National Taiwan University."
April 2026: "Each dish was a bit on the smaller side."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 微風台南 TEARSⅡ、台湾料理、上京区桝屋町359、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩5分、12:00〜15:00・18:00〜22:00、月曜休み、予約不可、28席、座敷、禁煙、子供・ベビーカー可、カード不可、電子マネー・PayPay可。るるぶ: 河原町丸太町の台湾料理店、12時〜14時30分・18時〜21時30分、月曜 (祝日なら翌日) と第1火曜休み、アルバイトはほぼ全員が台湾の留学生、魯肉飯は大中小。nippon.com のコラム (2017年): 京都御苑の近く、控えめな「微風台南」の看板、黒板の弁当のメニュー、台湾の飲み物、赤い提灯。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年11月、英語): 魯肉飯 (中) 700円、牛肉麺900円、排骨炒飯、海老炒飯、排骨弁当、肉そば、ネギ餅、蛋餅、青菜炒め、豆花600円 (トッピング全部+165円)、杏仁豆腐、かき氷、台湾ビール、開店前から行列、注文は呼んだ順で列の順ではない、料理が遅いことも、量が少なめという声、炒飯が油っぽい日もという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Picture menu with descriptions; Taiwanese staff; no bookings.

places.name: DOLCH
places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses with fresh pasta, focaccia and bread beside meat and fish mains (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: house ham, pâté, fish and meat mains (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Wed–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 (last orders food 14:00, drinks 14:30) and 18:00–21:30 (last orders food 19:30, drinks 20:00); closed Monday and Tuesday; dinner by reservation only since 2024 (Tabelog). Lunch often fully booked — book ahead (2025–26 reviews). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats incl. a counter; non-smoking (Tabelog). Takeout, catering and private hire (Tabelog). places.notes: [French bistro · near the Imperial Palace] A cosy hidden bistro whose chef once cooked at Japan's embassy in Romania: generous lunch courses from about ¥1,900–2,750 with house ham, pâtés, fresh pasta and braises, and dinner by reservation. Book lunch ahead; closed Monday and Tuesday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), former cook at the Japanese Embassy in Romania (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a French restaurant near the Imperial Palace whose chef formerly cooked at the Japanese Embassy in Romania, blending many countries into home-style French cooking.

chef_bio.specialty: Lunch courses; house ham and pâté.

For an aunt's birthday in April 2026, the kitchen wrote "Happy Birthday" on the dessert.
For Christmas 2025 DOLCH offered take-away dinners with two pickup times.

Lunch about ¥1,500–2,500; dinner ¥4,000–5,000. Closed Monday.

In the おもてなし小路 dining area on the 1F of the JR Central Shinkansen side of Kyoto Station, Hachijo exit — outside the ticket gates (official site; Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, Hachijo exit (Shinkansen side)
places.cuisine: Udon, curry and ramen seasoned with the house's own spices — black shichimi and sansho on every table (Tabelog; 2026 reviews): curry udon with spices, beef sukiyaki udon, warm or chilled hamo tempura udon, chilled hiyashi udon with bonito, daikon and ume ¥1,595 (September 2026), Japanese-style tantanmen with yuzu pepper, "Gion Black" soy ramen with black pepper; beer ¥770 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Udon & curry · Kyoto Station Hachijo exit] The only place to eat at Hara Ryokaku, the Gion spice house famed for black shichimi: curry udon, sukiyaki udon and hamo tempura udon, with the house shichimi and sansho on every counter. About ¥1,200–1,800; handy before the Shinkansen. Open daily.

roles: Restaurant of 株式会社原了郭 (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 8 August 2015 (Tabelog). Per the official site: the eat-in corner at the Gion 本店 closed on 29 February 2016, and this is now the house's only place to eat. An August 2026 reviewer calls Hara Ryokaku a long-established house founded in the Edo period.
chef_bio.specialty: Curry udon with black shichimi.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner found yuzu pepper surprisingly good on the tantanmen, but the "Gion Black" broth ordinary.
An October 2026 traveller found the sukiyaki udon "not beyond expectations, but not bad" for a pre-Shinkansen bowl.

places.notes: [Sweets café · Kawaramachi-Shijo] The 2F café of a Kyoto confectioner right on Kawaramachi: lemon-and-cream-cheese or hojicha-kinako kakigori in summer, matcha parfaits with gyokuro ice cream, warabi mochi made to order; shop for sweets downstairs. About ¥1,000–2,000; no service or cover charge.

roles: Confectioners of 永楽屋 (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the 本店 on Kawaramachi-Shijo, with a 室町店, a factory shop and counters in Daimaru and Takashimaya Kyoto; the 本店 sells sweets and tsukudani and has the café.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal sweets from carefully chosen ingredients (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kakigori; matcha parfait.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular came back for the Lemon Shizuku kakigori, which had sold out by evening on another visit.
A September 2026 visitor found a single chofu filling and the matcha on the light side.
An October 2026 diner felt the hojicha parfait could use a little less red bean paste.

places.notes: [Café and BBQ · Okazaki, a terrace in Miyako Messe] The café on the ground floor of Miyako Messe, between the Heian Shrine and the Okazaki museums and zoo: plain-value lunches around ¥1,100–1,500 (Bolognese, fried chicken, curry), coffee and cake, and terrace BBQ booked ahead into the evening. Wheelchair-friendly, roomy and rarely crowded. Hours follow the building.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café, dining bar and BBQ terrace on the first floor of Miyako Messe (Kyoto City Industry Hall), opened 3 July 2021. A June 2026 visitor found it much changed after a renovation.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch plates; terrace BBQ.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 wheelchair user recommended it as a good-value lunch near Okazaki Park, where many places are pricey, crowded or hard to reach.
A March 2026 visitor often lunches here when going to the zoo, finding it reasonable for the area.
An August 2026 visitor found the ¥600 90-minute drinks deal with soup a better buy than the famous coffee shop across the street.

places.notes: [Meat bistro · Higashi Honganji, shared tables and natural wine] A dim, stylish bistro near Kyoto Station with two big shared tables and the smell of baking bread: a charcuterie platter, burrata with seasonal fruit, duck, lamb and wagyu, with natural wines poured with the bottle and its tag beside you. No children 7 and under and no strong perfume. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bistro specialising in meat, opened 17 October 2024, with all seating at shared tables and rules against young children and strong fragrance.
chef_bio.specialty: Meat appetizer platter; burrata with seasonal fruit.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 solo guest walked in without a booking on a rainy weekday and found the shared tables comfortable.
A November 2025 couple had the ¥12,000 anniversary course and liked having each glass’s bottle and tag left on the table.
A June 2026 regular wants to come every month for the appetizers, seasonal fruit and burrata.

places.notes: [Pizza and Italian · Kamitoba near Jujo, a wood-fired local favourite] A busy Italian among warehouses south of Kyoto Station, worth the walk for wood-fired pizza with a chewy crust — the signature Gori’s margherita, honey pizza, half-and-half for ¥300 more — anchovy carbonara and homemade focaccia. chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a pizza, Italian and izakaya restaurant opened 5 May 2016. An August 2026 reviewer remembered the food from an earlier food truck.
chef_bio.specialty: Gori’s Pizza (margherita); anchovy carbonara.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner had loved the food from the shop’s food truck and found everything at the restaurant just as good.
A September 2026 diner who walked 20 minutes at 9 pm was told much was sold out but was glad to order what was left.
An October 2026 lunch guest found that drinks and sides are extra even at lunch, so a pizza alone is just the pizza.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ピザ・イタリアン・居酒屋、南区上鳥羽菅田町65、近鉄十条駅から徒歩約7分、昼 月11:30〜14:00・火〜金11:30〜13:45・土日祝11:30〜14:15、夜17:30〜22:00、食材がなくなり次第終了、不定休、予約可、カードは夜のみ (昼は現金か PayPay)、34席 (カウンター6、テーブル16、座敷12)、奥に半個室、禁煙、駐車場あり、2016年5月5日オープン。公式サイト: 年中無休 (臨時休業あり)。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 薪窯のピザ (ゴリーズピザ、はちみつ、日替わり、ハーフ&ハーフ300円増し)、アンチョビのカルボナーラ、桜海老や海老と枝豆のオイルパスタ、サラダとスープ付きの昼のセット、自家製フォカッチャ、以前のキッチンカー、夜は満席も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book dinner; pay by cash or PayPay at lunch; family-friendly with high chairs. No English evidence found.
