places.name: 漁港直送 海鮮酒場 あんじ 烏丸六角店 (Anji Karasuma Rokkaku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seafood izakaya with sashimi, soy-simmered fish, ebi mayo and fried oysters (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya — sashimi, simmered fish heads, grilled shellfish (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 17:00–1:00 (last order 0:00), every day except 31 December–3 January and 11 February (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; no outside food or drink (Tabelog). Late-night charge ¥418 per person after 22:00 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「22時以降は深夜料金418円（税込）が発生いたします」). Cards incl. UnionPay; PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 75 seats; the front counter is quieter than the back (September 2026). Non-smoking with a smoking room (Tabelog). 2nd floor of 星の子六角ビル east of Karasuma on Rokkaku; 3 min from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 5 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Rokkaku Karasuma, by Rokkakudo — 3 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Seafood shipped straight from fishing ports with sake (Tabelog name; June 2026) · simmered sea-bream head, steamed fish head, assorted sashimi in thick cuts (July and September 2026) · grilled shellfish, squid and mirin-dried fish (September 2026) · oysters and matsutake in season; from about ¥3,000 per person (August 2026) · lunch: seafood rice bowl ¥1,300 (April 2026), sashimi set meal (July–September 2026), ebi mayo or yukhoe bowl (May 2026), fried oysters (October 2026)
places.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Karasuma Rokkaku, fish till 1 am] A big second-floor seafood tavern by Rokkakudo, fish sent direct from the ports: thick-cut sashimi, simmered sea-bream head, grilled shellfish and seasonal oysters with sake, from about ¥3,000 a head. Good-value seafood lunches (bowl ¥1,300) every day. Open to 1:00 with a ¥418 charge after 22:00. Sit at the front counter for quiet.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a seafood izakaya ("fishing-port direct") open all year except New Year and 11 February. Tabelog lists two other Anji in Kyoto (麩屋町綾小路店, 府庁前店).
chef_bio.specialty: Port-direct sashimi; simmered fish heads.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular of many years calls it the best fish izakaya in Kyoto and ordered oysters and matsutake that night.
A July 2026 visitor praised the simmered sea-bream head for its balance of soy, sake, mirin and ginger.
An October 2026 lunch guest found the fried oysters small and mostly batter, though the sides and salad were good.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・日本料理、中京区六角通烏丸東入ル堂之前町231 星の子六角ビル 2F、烏丸御池駅5番出口から徒歩3分、昼11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)、夜17:00〜翌1:00 (L.O. 0:00)、12月31日〜1月3日と2月11日以外は無休、予約可、持ち込み不可、22時以降は深夜料金418円、カード・PayPay・Alipay・WeChat Pay 可、75席、禁煙 (喫煙室あり)、京都に麩屋町綾小路店と府庁前店も。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 鯛のあら炊き、兜蒸し、厚切りの刺身盛り、貝やいかの焼き物、みりん干し、牡蠣、松茸、一人3,000円から、昼の海鮮丼1,300円、刺身定食、海老マヨやユッケ丼、カキフライ、手前のカウンターは静か。

cultural_comfort.note: Big menu of seafood; counter seats are quieter; ¥418 charge after 22:00. No English evidence found.

places.name: じじばば第三酒場 (Jijibaba Daisan Sakaba)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A Chinese-leaning izakaya — mapo tofu, gyoza, spring rolls, fried rice, mapo noodles, sweet-and-sour pork; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: mapo dishes, chashu, gyoza and pork dishes; a glass-noodle salad and mushroom stir-fries appear, but sauces are not described (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday and Saturday 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); Friday 18:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed Sundays, holidays and the first and third Mondays (Tabelog). Reservations by phone only — AI and third-party bookings are not accepted; book or check for seats, as it fills (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Otoshi ¥440 (Tabelog, original お通し440円). Cash only (Tabelog). 15 seats (Tabelog). Down an alley about 7–10 min from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; June 2025).
places.neighborhood: Alley about 7 min on foot from Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: A Chinese izakaya run by a chatty master (2025–2026 reviews) · mapo tofu, the house skill; mapo tofu rice; mapo noodles with wood-ear mushrooms (2025–2026) · gyoza, special potato salad, chashu (served with the potato salad), spring rolls from the revival menu, fried rice, sweet-and-sour pork, bacon (2025–2026) · shiitake, stir-fried tomato and wood ear (September 2026) · glass-noodle salad as the otoshi (December 2025)
places.notes: [Chinese izakaya · alley near Kyoto Station, the master’s mapo tofu] A cramped, cheerful 15-seat izakaya in an alley near Kyoto Station, full of regulars and a talkative master who cooks very good Chinese-style food: mapo tofu and mapo noodles, gyoza, a special potato salad with chashu, spring rolls and fried rice. Phone to book; cash only; ¥440 otoshi. Part of the local じじばば group.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T3130001048832 is registered to 株式会社じじばば (NTA register), which also runs 酒肴屋 じじばば and じじばば木馬亭. Reviewers describe “the chatty owner” (September 2026), “the quirky owner and regulars” (February 2026) and a master whose warm personality is “almost frustrating to praise” (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Mapo tofu; chashu and potato salad.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular, back after a few years, was glad the master remembered.
A January 2025 visitor drops in for one more drink before the last train when a table is free.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: じじばば第三酒場、居酒屋・バル・中華料理、下京区新シ町138、京都駅から徒歩7分、月〜木・土 18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、金 18:00〜23:30、日・祝と第1・第3月曜休み、予約は電話のみ (AIや外部サービス経由は不可)、お通し440円、現金のみ、15席、適格請求書 T3130001048832 (株式会社じじばば)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 中華の居酒屋、おしゃべりなマスター、麻婆豆腐、麻婆麺、麻婆丼、餃子、特製ポテサラ、チャーシュー、春巻き、炒飯、酢豚、春雨サラダのお通し、常連が多く満席になりやすい。

cultural_comfort.note: A regulars’ bar; phone bookings only; cash only; ¥440 otoshi.

places.name: 京町家いづも 花のか (Kyomachiya Izumo Kanoka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Lunch with nine obanzai and a choice of main — rice-flour udon, chicken yuzu-pepper bowl, Wagyu — plus cheesecake; afternoon tea of sweets, quiche and savouries; the udon is made with rice flour (official site), but nothing else is described (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Nine obanzai with each lunch and a pickle rice bowl, but dashi and dairy in the sweets are not described (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Thursday; on weekdays reservation only, and the café stays closed if no one has booked (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire by phone (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, original サービス10％). Cash only (Tabelog). 28 table seats; private rooms upstairs for up to 15 (Tabelog). Room and whole-house rental, and a photographer from ¥50,000, booked by LINE (official site). In a residential lane on Higashinakasuji north of Kitakoji, 12 min from Kyoto Station; staff will meet guests who get lost (Tabelog; May 2026).
places.neighborhood: Residential lane south of Shichijo, west of Karasuma — 12 min from Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: Lunch and afternoon tea in a 130-year-old machiya built in 1896 (official site) · lunch of nine obanzai with a main — rice-flour udon, chicken yuzu-pepper bowl, pickle rice bowl, premium Wagyu steak or sukiyaki — ¥3,500, with a dessert or drink (official site; 2026 reviews) · seasonal trunk-box afternoon teas: rose (¥4,000, June 2026), “Sunflower Summer” (¥9,000, July 2026), autumn fruits and roses (September 2026) · photo-shoot afternoon tea course (May 2026) · cheesecake (May 2026)
places.notes: [Machiya café · near Kyoto Station, afternoon tea in a trunk] A deep-red 1896 townhouse tucked in a residential lane, serving a nine-obanzai lunch with rice-flour udon, Wagyu or rice bowls (¥3,500) and seasonal afternoon teas presented in a trunk box. Weekdays by reservation only; 10% service charge; cash only. The house can also be rented, with a photographer.

chef_bio.background: The official site describes a 130-year-old machiya dating from 1896 (Meiji 29) and offers rooms for rent. A May 2026 visitor who got lost was met by a staff member; reviewers found the staff kind (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Trunk-box afternoon tea; obanzai lunch.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 guest booked for 16:30 on a Saturday and had the rose afternoon tea as the only guest, in a room that felt set for a proposal.
A May 2026 visitor got lost on the way, phoned, and was met nearby by the staff.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京町家いづも 花のか、百年の歴史ある京町家、130年の町家 since 1896 (明治29年)、9種のおばんざいランチ (鶏ゆず胡椒丼、米粉うどん、特選和牛)、トランクのアフタヌーンティー、レンタル・貸切あり (個室3,300円/2時間ほか)、カメラマン50,000円から、予約はLINE。食べログ: カフェ・スイーツ、下京区東中筋通北小路上がる紅葉町364、京都駅から徒歩12分、11:00〜18:00、木曜定休、平日は予約制で予約がなければ休み、サービス10%、現金のみ、28席、2階の個室は15名まで。口コミ (2026年、英語): 3,500円のランチ、薔薇のアフタヌーンティー4,000円、ひまわりの夏のトランクのアフタヌーンティー9,000円、秋のアフタヌーンティー、写真撮影付きのアフタヌーンティー、チーズケーキ、場所がわかりにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Weekdays by reservation only; hard to find — staff will guide you; cash only; 10% service charge.

places.name: らんたん (Lantan)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade wheat noodles in a soy-sauce broth (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is meat-based (one reviewer calls it tonkotsu shoyu); even the “meatless” ramen is served in the same broth (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–14:00; closed Wednesday and the second and fourth Tuesdays (Tabelog; hours may change). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 23 seats: 8 at the counter and tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Near the entrance of Kyoto University Hospital in Shogoin, about 600 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2026). Founded in 1964 (May 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Shogoin, by Kyoto University Hospital — 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: A Showa-era ramen shop since 1964 with a light, gently sweet soy broth and homemade thin noodles (2026 reviews) · a simple menu: regular ramen, chashu ramen, and a meatless ramen ¥720 (February and May 2026) · large ramen ¥1,030 (October 2025) · bean sprouts, wide menma, green onion; garlic on the table (2026) · rice and kimchi but few side dishes (March 2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Shogoin by Kyoto University Hospital, since 1964] A lantern-lit, Showa-era ramen shop serving a light, slightly sweet soy ramen with homemade thin noodles — regular, chashu or a cheaper meatless bowl — to regulars and hospital visitors. Lunch only, 11:00–14:00; cash only.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 reviewer dates the shop to 1964 and mentions a famous actor among the regulars; another May 2026 visitor counts 62 years in business. A September 2026 regular finds it “not delicious, but not bad either”, a taste from before ramen became a luxury.
chef_bio.specialty: Light soy ramen.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor chose the ¥720 meatless ramen because a second ramen stop was planned later that day.
A May 2026 family’s children loved the gentle broth.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: らんたん、ラーメン、左京区聖護院西町12、神宮丸太町駅から591m、11:00〜14:00、水曜と第2・第4火曜休み、予約不可、現金のみ、23席、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 1964年創業、昭和の店、あっさりほんのり甘い醤油のスープ、自家製の細麺、並、チャーシュー麺、肉なしのラーメン720円、大盛1,030円、もやし、平たいメンマ、卓上のにんにく、ご飯とキムチ、Kyoto University Hospital の入口近く。

cultural_comfort.note: Old local ramen shop; cash only; lunch only.

places.name: ブリュレ キョウト (Brulee Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: yeast doughnuts filled with custard (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: custard-filled doughnuts (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00 daily (Tabelog; hours may change). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). Mostly takeaway, with 6 seats listed (Tabelog; September 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In the Sanjo shopping arcade, about 10 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). A second shop opened at Karasuma-Gojo (September 2025 review).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo shopping arcade west of Horikawa — 10 min from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Crème-brûlée doughnuts: a custard-filled doughnut sugared and torched to order, ¥350 (June 2025) to ¥400 (September 2026) · matcha doughnut (December 2025) · limited fresh-caramel brûlée doughnut ¥400 (May 2026)
places.notes: [Doughnuts · Sanjo shopping arcade] A tiny doughnut stand in the long Sanjo arcade that does one thing: a soft doughnut stuffed with custard, sugared and torched in front of you so the top cracks like crème brûlée (about ¥400). Eat it on the spot or carry it home carefully. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. A September 2025 reviewer reports a second shop opened at Karasuma-Gojo.
chef_bio.specialty: Crème-brûlée doughnut.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 passer-by asked if the doughnut could be eaten right away; the staff torched it on the spot.
A December 2025 buyer warns that the matcha coating comes off on the way home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ブリュレ キョウト、ドーナツ、中京区上瓦町69、二条城前駅から413m、毎日10:00〜17:00、予約不可、現金のみ、6席、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 三条の商店街、注文後にバーナーで焼くクリームブリュレのドーナツ (2025年6月350円、2026年9月400円)、抹茶のドーナツ、期間限定の生キャラメルブリュレ400円、ほぼ持ち帰り、烏丸五条に2号店とのこと。

cultural_comfort.note: Point-and-pay doughnut stand; cash only.

places.name: 鴨弘 (Kamo Hiro)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Duck hot pot in a soy-based broth, beef tongue stew, hayashi rice and tempura; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: duck hot pot and meat stews (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–13:30 and dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order food 20:30); closed Thursday and at lunch on Sundays and holidays; may close for catering jobs — phone ahead (official site; Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog; the shop’s site has quoted the duck hot pot as tax and service included. 18 seats: a 6-seat counter facing the Kamo River and tatami seating; private hire; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; official site). On Reizen-dori just west of Kawabata in Okazaki-Shogoin, 515 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; April 2025). Opened 1988 as a kappo (official site).
places.neighborhood: Shogoin, by the Kamo River — 515 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: "Kyoto-people’s cooking" (京人料理) kappo, known for duck hot pot (official site) · duck hot pot course ¥6,000 (February 2026) with generous cuts of duck · seasonal omakase menus updated each season · lunch: hayashi rice, beef tongue stew ¥1,200 (April 2024), tempura zaru soba set, a 100%-duck simmered hamburg (official site 2024) · New Year osechi to order (official site; reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · Shogoin by the Kamo, duck hot pot since 1988] A long-running neighbourhood kappo with a six-seat counter looking out over the Kamo River toward Mt. Hiei. Its fame is duck hot pot, with thick cuts of duck (course about ¥6,000); lunch is homely yoshoku — hayashi rice and a tender beef tongue stew for about ¥1,200. The owner likes a chat across the counter. Closed Thursday and Sunday lunch.

roles: Owner-chef (店主) not named; born and raised in Kyoto (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in 1988 as a kappo in Okazaki-Shogoin; the owner, born and raised in Kyoto, calls the cooking 京人料理 — Kyoto cooking shaped by its people — and serves tongue stew, hayashi rice and duck hot pot as easy introductions to kappo; seasonal omakase menus are posted each season (latest November 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: kappo is about conversation across the counter — "won’t you stretch a little and talk with us?"
chef_bio.specialty: Duck hot pot.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 diner had duck hot pot by the river with the cherry blossoms in full bloom.
A February 2026 first-timer for duck hot pot was disappointed by the service.
A May 2025 regular came back for the hayashi rice with its rich demi-glace and crunchy onions.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京人料理 鴨弘 (かもひろ)、京都 平安神宮 鴨鍋、1988年に割烹料理の店として岡崎・聖護院にオープン、カウンターの先に鴨川、背に比叡山、京都で生まれ育った店主の「京人料理」、昼のタンシチュー・ハヤシライス・鴨鍋は割烹の入門に、木曜定休と日祝の昼休み、出張料理などで臨時休業あり、季節のおまかせ料理を更新 (2026年11月5日に冬)、2024年に鴨肉100%の煮込みハンバーグ、鴨鍋は税・サ込で掲載された時期も。食べログ: 鍋・日本料理・揚げ物、左京区聖護院蓮華蔵町21-5、神宮丸太町駅から515m、11:30〜13:30、17:00〜22:00 (料理L.O. 20:30)、18席 (カウンター6、座敷)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2019〜2026年、英語): 鴨鍋コース6,000円 (2026年2月)、ハヤシライス、タンシチュー1,200円、天ざるのセット、冷泉通、桜の頃。

cultural_comfort.note: A conversational kappo counter; phone ahead.

places.name: つけものダイニング おぎひろ家 (Tsukemono Dining Ogihiroya)
places.gf_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists gluten-free options, and reviewers mention rice-flour kara-age fried in rice oil and brown-rice udon. A gluten-intolerant diner found the take-home pickles contain wheat (grain vinegar), so ask about each pickle (Tabelog; March and July 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Pickles and rice are plant-based, but the soups, kara-age, dashimaki and side dishes are not; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday, Friday and the days around holidays 10:00–16:00 (last order 15:30) and dinner 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30, reservation only); Saturday, Sunday and holidays breakfast 7:30–10:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Lunch-only pickle buffet; weekend-only pickle breakfast; set meals at all hours from July 2026; hot-pot banquets for up to 16 with 3 days’ notice (official site). Prices revised from 7 January 2026 (official site). No service charge or other fees (Tabelog). 9 seats; cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). On Sanjo-dori just east of Horikawa, about 6 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 26 November 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-Horikawa — 6 min from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Dining room of a Kyoto pickle maker, serving additive-free, colour-free Kyoto-vegetable pickles (Tabelog; official site) · lunch-only Kyoto-vegetable pickle buffet with rice (white rice overseen by the eighth-generation Gihei, or 16-grain rice), a dish of the day, clear soup and dessert ¥1,800 (official site) · weekend Kyoto-vegetable pickle morning: four pickles, monthly congee, dashimaki, a dish of the day, warabi-mochi and coffee ¥1,000 (official site) · rice-flour kara-age, shibazuke-simmered hamburg, brown-rice udon, set meals (official site; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese · Sanjo-Horikawa, an all-you-can-eat pickle lunch] A rustic little dining room of a Kyoto pickle maker near Nijo Castle. At lunch, help yourself to a buffet of additive-free Kyoto-vegetable pickles — shibazuke, red turnip, burdock, seasonal picks — with fresh rice and soup (¥1,800); weekend mornings bring a ¥1,000 pickle-and-congee breakfast. Rice-flour kara-age appeals to gluten-avoiders, but check the pickles. Closed Thursday.

roles: Operator 株式会社アシスト (invoice holder); staff not named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: traditional flavours handed down since the business was founded, Kyoto-vegetable pickles served in a rustic setting, and rice supervised by the eighth-generation Gihei with a 16-grain mix. Opened 26 November 2023 (Tabelog). The invoice number belongs to 株式会社アシスト, registered in Takatsuki, Osaka.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: Kyoto vegetables chosen to bring out the umami of each, in pickles made to a recipe handed down since the founding.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-vegetable pickle buffet.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner with gluten intolerance found the pickles on the buffet tasty but discovered wheat in the take-home pickles’ ingredients, and suggests brown-rice udon, kara-age or dashimaki for wheat-allergic guests.
A July 2026 visitor loved the rice-flour kara-age fried in rice oil.
A March 2026 couple had the weekend pickle breakfast with seasonal pickles such as zucchini and bamboo shoot.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ogihiroya-sanjo.com): つけものダイニングおぎひろ家、京野菜の素材にこだわり創業より受け継がれた伝統の味、2026年1月7日から一部価格改定、土日祝限定の京野菜つけものモーニング1,000円 (日替わりの京野菜つけもの4種、月替わりのお粥、出汁巻き、日替わりの一品、わらび餅、コーヒー)、ランチ限定の京野菜つけものビュッフェ1,800円 (つけもの、ごはん、日替わりの一品、吸い物、デザート、食べ放題)、7月3日から定食4種、鍋宴会 (3日前までの予約で最大16名)、しば漬けの煮込みハンバーグ、玄米うどん。食べログ: 惣菜・デリ、中京区三条通堀川東入橋東詰町13-2、二条城前駅から徒歩6分、月火水金・祝前日・祝後日10:00〜16:00 (L.O. 15:30)・17:00〜21:00 (夜は予約のみ)、土日祝7:30〜10:00、木曜定休、サービス料・追加料金なし、9席、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、グルテンフリーメニューあり、2023年11月26日オープン、インボイス T3120901010330 (株式会社アシスト、大阪府高槻市)。公式紹介: 無添加・無着色の京漬物、八代目儀兵衛監修の白米と十六穀米。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 米粉の唐揚げを米油で、持ち帰りの漬物に小麦 (穀物酢) が入っていたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Buffet at lunch; dinner by reservation only.

gf_cross_contamination.text: A March 2026 gluten-intolerant diner found wheat (likely grain vinegar) listed in the take-home pickles, and was unsure whether the buffet pickles also contain it.

positives.text: Tabelog lists gluten-free options; reviewers mention rice-flour kara-age fried in rice oil and brown-rice udon.
A July 2026 reviewer describes the kara-age as gluten-free, coated in rice flour and fried in rice oil.

places.name: 山入り イタリア料理 ろくそう (Rokusou)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Italian courses with pasta and bread; no gluten information is published (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetarian course is offered with three days’ notice (lunch 7 dishes ¥8,250, dinner 9 dishes ¥14,850); ask whether it can be made vegan (official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order food 12:30); dinner 18:00–21:30 (last order food 19:30); closed Wednesday and the 2nd Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings via TableCheck or phone (official site). Courses change monthly; vegetarian course with 3 days’ notice (official site). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 8 seats at a single-board counter, plus a sunken table, in a renovated townhouse where shoes come off; non-smoking; cards and QR (Tabelog; October 2025). Near the north-east corner of the Imperial Palace, about 10 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (601 m) (official site; Tabelog). The invoice is registered to 永谷六方.
places.neighborhood: North-east of the Imperial Palace — 10 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: "Mountain" Italian rooted in the chef’s home of Hanase: seasonal ingredients from across Japan in a monthly course, with Japanese touches (official site) · lunch: light course of 5 dishes ¥6,600; recommended 7 dishes ¥9,350; seasonal specialty 11 dishes ¥12,650 · dinner: light 7 dishes ¥12,650; recommended 9 dishes ¥17,050; special 11 dishes ¥22,550 · vegetarian course, lunch ¥8,250, dinner ¥14,850 (official site, tax included) · e.g. pickled daikon with cheese, yellowtail and daikon salad, homemade sausage with Kujo leek; wine pairings (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · north-east of the Imperial Palace, a Hanase chef's mountain Italian] An eight-seat counter in a renovated townhouse near Demachiyanagi, where chef 永谷六方 — raised among the mountains of Hanase — turns seasonal produce into quiet, aromatic Italian with Japanese touches; the course changes monthly. Lunch from ¥6,600, dinner from ¥12,650; vegetarian courses with three days' notice. Shoes off at the door. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: born 30 June 1980 and raised in Hanase among the mountains, whose seasons and nature remain the foundation of the cooking and the décor; trained at La Barcarola in Niigata, Ristorante Acqua Pazza in Tokyo and Chourakukan Coral in Kyoto; now blends Hanase sensibility with Italian technique to express each season on the plate. The invoice is registered in the owner’s name.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: each plate expresses the season, from the food to the tableware and quiet time at the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly seasonal Italian course.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular on a fourth visit describes the chef as modest and quiet, with the cooking reflecting that personality.
An October 2025 lunch guest took off shoes at the entrance and sat by the window at the counter.
An August 2026 visitor paired the lunch course with wine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (rokusou2019.com): 山入り イタリア料理 ろくそう、京都出町柳駅近くの8席の小さなレストラン、花脊の自然と季節の恵み、一枚板のカウンター、月替わりの旬のコース。軽めのランチコース5品6,600円、ランチのおすすめ7品9,350円、ランチのスペシャリテ11品12,650円、夜の軽めのコース7品12,650円、夜のおすすめ9品17,050円、特別コース11品22,550円、ベジタリアンコース昼7品8,250円・夜9品14,850円 (3日前までに予約)。店主 永谷六方、1980年6月30日京都花脊出身、新潟『ラ・バルカローラ』、東京『リストランテ・アクアパッツア』、京都『長楽館コーラル』。食べログ: イタリアン、上京区革堂内町522-1、出町柳駅から601m、11:30〜14:00、18:00〜21:30、水曜・第2火曜休み、8席、禁煙、カード・QR 可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、インボイス T3810771647792 (永谷六方)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 町家を改装、靴を脱ぐ、たくあんとチーズ、鰤と大根のサラダ、九条ねぎの自家製ソーセージ、ワインペアリング。

cultural_comfort.note: Book via TableCheck; shoes off.

places.name: 御料理 山上 (Oryori Yamagami)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo dishes, tempura and juwari (100% buckwheat) soba with dipping sauce; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led kappo with dashi (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–14:00 (soba; only on days a sign is out — irregular); dinner 17:00–23:00; closed Thursday, and 29–31 December; no lunch 29 December–3 January, reservations required 1–3 January (Tabelog; January 2024). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 18 seats: a 10-seat counter and a private room for 6–8; private hire; smoking allowed per Tabelog. In a narrow lane near Keihan Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (162 m), near Kyoto University Hospital (Tabelog; November 2025).
places.neighborhood: Jingu-Marutamachi — 162 m from the station
places.cuisine: Authentic Japanese cooking until late, with the owner’s juwari soba (Tabelog) · dinner courses made to a budget, e.g. ¥5,000 and ¥10,000 (2022–2025 reviews), with seasonal fish such as grilled sweetfish, matsutake and eel on request (October 2024–October 2025) · lunch soba gozen with tekka-don, tempura, pickles, soba-yu and sesame pudding ¥1,430 (January 2024) · extremely thin juwari soba, good with just salt (November 2025) · sake such as Kubota (reviews)
places.notes: [Kappo · Jingu-Marutamachi, late-night kappo with hand-made soba] A hidden kappo down a lane by Jingu-Marutamachi Station, loved by professors and fellow chefs, serving classic seasonal dishes until 23:00 and ending with the owner's fine juwari soba. Dinner is made to your budget (about ¥5,000–10,000); on days a sign is out, lunch is a soba set with a tekka-don (about ¥1,400). Cash only; smoking allowed. Closed Thursday.

roles: Owner-chef not named; works with a hostess (October 2024)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: a hidden shop on a narrow street near Jingu-Marutamachi Station, loved by university professors and other restaurant owners, serving authentic Japanese cuisine until late; lunch was started at regulars’ request, with 100% buckwheat soba made by the owner, who even travels to Shinshu for soba tools.
chef_bio.specialty: Juwari soba to close a kappo dinner.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 regular booked lunch ahead to ask for matsutake and eel.
A November 2025 visitor after a hospital appointment came for the lunch-only soba and found it excellent with salt alone.
A December 2025 guest was introduced by a Kyoto University professor.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 御料理 山上、日本料理・そば、左京区下堤町、神宮丸太町駅から162m、11:00〜14:00、17:00〜23:00、木曜定休、年末12月29〜31日休み、12月29日〜1月3日は昼休み、1月1〜3日は要予約、カード・電子マネー不可、18席 (カウンター10、個室6〜8名)、貸切可、喫煙可。公式紹介: 京阪神宮丸太町駅近くの細い路地の隠れ家、大学教授から同業の店主まで愛される本格日本料理を深夜まで、常連の要望で始めた昼は店主手打ちの十割そば、信州まで道具を買いに行くほど。口コミ (2016〜2025年、英語): 予算に合わせたコース (5,000円、10,000円)、鮎の塩焼き、松茸と鰻、昼のそば御膳1,430円 (鉄火丼、天ぷら、漬物、そば湯、胡麻プリン、2024年1月)、昼は看板が出ている日のみ、店主と女将。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; smoking allowed; lunch only when the sign is out.

places.name: FUTURE TRAIN KYOTO DINER & CAFE
places.gf_detail: Ask. Themed courses and plates with crepes, chiffon cake and fried dishes; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Courses feature chicken and local meats with sweets; no vegan information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); Saturday, Sunday and holidays 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); hours change over New Year and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Entrance fee on a first visit: adults ¥700, children up to sixth grade ¥300, under-3s free; a 5% service charge at dinner only (Tabelog original 入場料（初回来店時のみ） 大人 700円／お子様 300円（小学6年生まで／3歳まで無料）、ディナーのみサービス料5％). Some reservations and a Railway Museum ticket waive the entrance fee (August 2026). Fully cashless — no cash accepted; cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 80 seats over three train cars; children welcome (Tabelog; August 2026). On the Umekoji High Line in Umekoji Park, opposite the Kyoto Railway Museum; 1 min walk from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn (Tabelog; October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Umekoji Park by the Kyoto Railway Museum — 1 min walk from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn
places.cuisine: "Japan's first elevated restaurant & café" in a pink-wrapped Thunderbird limited-express car on a disused line, with sound and light shows (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · weekend dinner course NIGHTPARADE DINNERPARTY of 15 small courses with character fortune slips and optional free-flow drinks (July 2026) · ¥6,000 course with welcome drink, salad crepe, afternoon-tea-style appetisers, chicken main and chiffon cake (August 2026) · seasonal regional courses, e.g. a Shiga tour dinner (November 2026) · pink-coloured dishes, potatoes and chicken (August–September 2026) · lunch ¥2,000–3,000, dinner ¥4,000–6,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Themed dining · Umekoji High Line, a train car opposite the Railway Museum] A real Thunderbird express car, painted pink and set on an old elevated track, turned into a kawaii entertainment restaurant: light-and-sound shows, chick mascots, character parades and multi-course meals that reviewers find better than expected. Great with children after the Railway Museum. First-visit entrance fee ¥700; 5% service at dinner; cashless only. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: billed as Japan's first elevated restaurant and café, on the Umekoji High Line; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe a front car from the former Thunderbird express between Kyoto and Hokuriku, with replica cars and a platform behind (November 2026), and a concept produced by Sebastian Masuda, likened to Harajuku's Kawaii Monster Cafe (August 2026); an October 2026 reviewer says it opened the year before.
chef_bio.philosophy: A future-train entertainment restaurant of food and art (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Themed dinner courses.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 parent came after the Railway Museum and found the museum ticket waived the entrance fee; Car 3 is the roomiest for children.
A July 2026 guest expected style over substance at the 15-course weekend dinner and was surprised by the cooking.
An October 2026 birthday trip ended here, a year after the restaurant opened.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・カフェ・洋食、下京区観喜寺町3-7 梅小路ハイライン、JR梅小路京都西駅から徒歩1分、JR京都駅から徒歩15分、月〜金 11:00〜16:00 (L.O.15:00)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、土日祝 11:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、年末年始と祝日は変更あり、予約可、入場料 (初回のみ) 大人700円・子ども300円 (小学6年生まで、3歳まで無料)、ディナーのみサービス料5%、完全キャッシュレス、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、80席、日本初の高架上のレストラン&カフェ。口コミ (2026年7月〜11月、英語): 梅小路公園、京都鉄道博物館の前、ピンクに塗った元「サンダーバード」の先頭車両、2両目からはレプリカ、音と光の演出、ひよこのキャラクター、週末のディナー「NIGHTPARADE DINNERPARTY」15品、6,000円のコース、滋賀のツアーディナー、鉄道博物館のチケットで入場無料、3号車が広い、Sebastian Masuda のプロデュース、家族連れや誕生日に。

cultural_comfort.note: Cashless only; ¥700 first-visit entrance fee; 5% service at dinner; family-friendly.

places.name: ふく吉 (Fuku Yoshi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi with soy and nikiri, a clear soup and dashimaki in the course; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi omakase of fish and shellfish (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Sunday 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Wednesday and the first and third Thursdays (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). A 20% service charge in the tatami rooms only (Tabelog original 座敷のみサービス料20％). The ¥27,500 course is for private bookings, up to 12 guests (Tabelog). 7 counter seats and private tatami rooms for 2–8 (Tabelog). Cards, transit IC, iD and QUICPay; no QR (Tabelog). In a townhouse on Nakadachiuri-dori east of Kuromon, in Nishijin; no parking; about 18 min walk from Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog; March 2024).
places.neighborhood: Nakadachiuri east of Kuromon, Nishijin — 18 min walk from Imadegawa Stn
places.cuisine: Sushi counter of an owner-chef in a Nishijin townhouse, with rice cooked over a wood fire in a kamado (January 2025; October 2026) · omakase of sashimi and nigiri, e.g. cod-roe tataki, clear soup, conger eel with eggplant, katsuo, squid, mackerel, hairy crab, marinated tuna, nodoguro, kohada, sweet shrimp, Biwa trout, ikura, anago (August 2023) · yellowtail with green onion; salt-grilled anago; uni; onigiri of fresh kamado rice with ikura and anago (2025–2026 reviews) · a lunch set with dashimaki and sashimi (April 2023) · lunch ¥10,000–15,000, dinner ¥20,000–30,000; a ¥27,500 course (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Nishijin townhouse, Nakadachiuri] A seven-seat counter and private tatami rooms in a beautifully kept Nishijin townhouse, where the chef works alone over sushi made with kamado-cooked rice: hairy crab, nodoguro, kohada, salt-grilled anago, uni, and onigiri of the fresh rice. Calm and quiet — one 2026 guest wanted more chat. Reservation only; 20% service in tatami rooms. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who prepares the dishes alone (April 2023 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a reservation-only sushi and Japanese restaurant in Nishijin with a counter and private tatami rooms; registered as an official listing by the shop. An August 2023 reviewer calls the building a nationally designated Important Cultural Property; June and September 2025 reviewers mention a sister shop in Nishitenma, Osaka, and a bar next door.
chef_bio.specialty: Kamado-rice sushi.

anecdotes.text: An August 2023 guest headlined the visit "A sushi restaurant in a National Important Cultural Property".
A March 2024 lunch guest, given a private counter at the back, did not realise from the townhouse front that it was a restaurant.
An October 2026 diner, invited through a dining credit card, found the room beautiful but missed the chatty style of other sushi counters.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司・日本料理、上京区中立賣通黒門東入役人町、地下鉄今出川駅から徒歩18分、月・火・木〜日 12:00〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)・18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、水曜と第1・第3木曜定休、完全予約制、座敷のみサービス料20%、27,500円のコースは貸切のみ (最大12名)、7席 (カウンター)、個室 (2〜8名)、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay 可、QR 不可。口コミ (2023年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 西陣の町家、国の重要文化財の建物との声 (2023年8月)、大将が一人で調理、かまどで炊くご飯、おまかせ (たらこのたたき、お椀、鱧と茄子、鰹、いか、鯖、毛蟹、漬けまぐろ、のどぐろ、こはだ、甘海老、ビワマス、いくら、穴子)、ぶりとねぎ、穴子の塩焼き、雲丹、炊きたてのご飯のおにぎり、昼のだし巻きとお造りの定食、大阪の Nishitenma にも店があるとの声、隣にバー、静かで会話が少ないとの声 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; one omakase; 20% service in tatami rooms; cards and IC.

places.name: 京都駅前酒場 聚楽第 (Kyoto Ekimae Sakaba Jurakudai)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto dashi dishes, miso dengaku, sashimi, cutlets and a sake-lees hot pot with soba to finish; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, duck, wagyu and a sake-lees hot pot; Kyoto dashi throughout (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday and the day before holidays 16:00–23:30; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 14:00–23:30; last order 23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). A charge of ¥420 per person, tax included (Tabelog original 420円（税込）), which brings a small cup of sake as otoshi (September 2026). 82 seats incl. counter, sofas, tatami and sunken seating; private room for 20–30; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). Next to Higashi Honganji, 3 min walk from Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: By Higashi Honganji — 3 min walk from Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style izakaya of the Sasaki Shuzo brewery's sake (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · Jurakudai Cho Karakuchi, Koto Ginmeisui Karakuchi and other house sakes, tasting flights, and a ¥4,980 all-you-can-drink course with +¥500 for 13 Sasaki sakes (September–October 2026) · six-kind sashimi platter, Kamo eggplant with duck-miso dengaku, fresh Miyama yuba, grilled duck skewers, rare wagyu cutlet with demi-glace, beef cutlet (September–October 2026) · sake-lees hot pot finished with soba (October 2026) · "Jurakudai Sonic" and matcha sour (October 2026) · about ¥4,000–8,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sake izakaya · by Higashi Honganji, near Kyoto Station] A roomy, newly opened izakaya from the Sasaki Shuzo brewery, three minutes from Kyoto Station: house sakes such as Jurakudai, flights and an all-you-can-drink sake course, with Kyoto-flavoured plates — sashimi, Kamo eggplant dengaku, Miyama yuba, wagyu cutlet and a sake-lees hot pot. A sake cup comes as the ¥420 otoshi. Service can be uneven when busy. Evenings, from 14:00 at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Kyoto-style Japanese izakaya serving Sasaki Sake Brewery's sake; registered as an official listing by the operator. October 2026 reviewers call it a newly opened izakaya produced by the historic Sasaki Shuzo, the family business of actor Kuranosuke Sasaki.
chef_bio.philosophy: Sasaki Sake Brewery's sake with Kyoto-style dishes (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sasaki Shuzo sake; Kyoto plates.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 sake fan, with only an hour, came to drink Sasaki Shuzo sake — the family business of actor Kuranosuke Sasaki — and found a hand-shaped dish with painted nails on the menu tableware.
An October 2026 pair reserved tatami for two after seeing photos, but were seated at a small table on a crowded night.
A September 2026 guest liked the sake otoshi but found the dishes arrived unevenly.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮、下京区中居町112-2・114-4、京都駅から徒歩3分、東本願寺のすぐそば、月〜金・祝前日 16:00〜23:30、土日祝 14:00〜23:30、L.O.23:00、予約可、チャージ420円 (税込)、82席、カウンター、ソファ、座敷、掘りごたつ、個室 (20〜30名)、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、Sasaki Shuzo の日本酒と京風の和の居酒屋。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月、英語): Sasaki Shuzo (俳優の Kuranosuke Sasaki さんの実家) が手がける新しい居酒屋、お通しに日本酒の小さな杯、「Jurakudai Cho Karakuchi」、「Koto Ginmeisui Karakuchi」、飲み比べ、4,980円の飲み放題コース、+500円で Sasaki Shuzo の日本酒13種、刺身の6種盛り、賀茂茄子と鴨味噌の田楽、Miyama の生湯葉、鴨の串焼き、和牛のレアカツ (デミグラス)、牛カツ、酒粕の鍋と締めのそば、「Jurakudai Sonic」、抹茶サワー、提供にむらがあるとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; ¥420 charge with a sake otoshi; cards and PayPay.

places.name: 魏飯餃子 (Gi Han Gyoza)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat-wrapper gyoza and Chinese dishes in soy-based sauces (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork gyoza, saliva chicken, mapo tofu with meat, sweet and sour pork, shrimp (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); Saturday and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday; bar service from 22:30 on Thursday–Saturday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; seat-only bookings limited to 1 hour at lunch and 1.5 hours at dinner when busy (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog original チャージ料なし). Lines at the 17:30 opening (September 2026). 60 seats with a private room (Tabelog; May 2026). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay (Tabelog). On Sakaimachi south of Aneyakoji; 7 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi south of Aneyakoji — 7 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Gyoza and authentic Chinese bar, supervised by 創作中華 一之船入 per reviewers (Tabelog; August and October 2026) · lunch sets ¥1,200–1,400 with salad, small dish, main, soup, rice and almond tofu: weekly special (e.g. salt mapo tofu), monthly special (e.g. yurinchi), gyoza set, tantanmen (cold in summer); a ¥2,500 lunch course (2024–2026 reviews) · gyoza: Gi Han, shrimp and green onion, ginger, cilantro (November 2026) · pickled mustard greens, saliva chicken, mapo tofu, sweet and sour pork, dried-tofu salad, shrimp chili with egg, pork and green pepper, fried rice, lu rou fan (2026 reviews) · courses with all-you-can-drink incl. Shaoxing wine (October 2026) · lunch ¥1,000–2,000, dinner ¥2,000–3,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Gyoza and Chinese · Sakaimachi near Karasuma Oike] A busy, good-value Chinese bar overseen by the creative-Chinese 一之船入: several gyoza (shrimp and green onion, ginger, cilantro), saliva chicken, mapo tofu and lu rou fan, ¥1,200 lunch sets with almond tofu, and courses with Shaoxing wine on the free-flow list. Queues at opening; time limits when busy. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a gyoza and dumpling restaurant serving authentic Chinese food; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe it as part of the group with the Sanjo shop and 創作中華 一之船入, which supervises it (August–October 2026), popular with solo women at lunch and with overseas visitors at night.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Chinese food (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Gyoza; lunch sets.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 six-time regular came after a film at Uplink Kyoto and noted the lunch had risen from ¥1,100 to ¥1,200 — still a good deal.
A September 2026 guest found the ¥2,500 lunch course huge and tasty, but warned against expecting the level of the famous parent.
An October 2026 diner found the Pu-erh tea tasted and smelled strange.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 餃子・居酒屋・バル、中京区堺町通姉小路下ル大阪材木町697、烏丸御池駅から徒歩7分、月〜金 11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)・17:30〜22:00 (料理L.O.21:00、ドリンクL.O.21:30)、土・祝 11:30〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、日曜定休、木〜土は22:30からバー営業、予約可 (混雑時は席のみの予約は昼1時間・夜1.5時間)、チャージ料なし、60席、個室、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、本格中華の餃子の専門店。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年11月、英語): 一之船入の監修、三条の店と同じグループ、ランチ1,200〜1,400円 (サラダ、小鉢、メイン、スープ、ご飯、杏仁豆腐)、週替わり (塩麻婆豆腐)、月替わり (油淋鶏)、餃子、担々麺 (夏は冷やし)、2,500円のランチコース、魏飯餃子、海老とねぎ、生姜、パクチーの餃子、搾菜、よだれ鶏、麻婆豆腐、酢豚、干し豆腐のサラダ、海老チリの卵、青椒肉絲、チャーハン、魯肉飯、紹興酒も飲み放題、開店前から行列、プーアル茶が変な味との声。

cultural_comfort.note: Popular with visitors; time limits when busy; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: ととや (Totoya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi and seafood bowls are served with soy; fried dishes such as conger eel, tuna cutlet and tempura are on the menu; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fishmonger's seafood restaurant; the miso soup is a red-miso fish-based soup (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Thursday and Friday 11:30–14:30 and 16:00–20:30; Tuesday lunch only 11:30–14:30; Saturday 11:00–14:30 and 16:00–20:30; food last order 20:00; closed Wednesday, Sunday and holidays, and on Kyoto Central Wholesale Market closing days (Tabelog). Retail counter 11:00–20:00 (to 18:00 on Tuesday) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; 45-minute limit at breakfast and lunch (Tabelog). Prices exclude tax (Tabelog original すべて外税となっております。). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). About 20 seats: set meals at the back, standing izakaya at the front where you pick drinks and fish yourself (2026 reviews). West of the entrance to the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market; 3 min walk from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: By the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market — 3 min walk from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn
places.cuisine: Fishmonger with a set-meal room and a standing bar beside the central market (2026 reviews) · lunch: sashimi set of five or six kinds with red miso soup; tuna two-colour bowl ¥1,000; seafood bowl; mixed fry set with tuna cutlet; fried conger eel with tartare; shrimp tempura set (May–October 2026) · evenings: pick-your-own sashimi such as otoro, chutoro, conger eel and eel, dashimaki, sardine, aji tempura, with sake such as Jozen Mizunotai junmai ginjo from Niigata (June–July 2026) · tekka maki and sashimi to take away from the shop front (2026 reviews) · about ¥1,000–3,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Seafood · by the Central Wholesale Market, Umekoji] A fish shop at the market gate with a busy set-meal room behind: thick sashimi sets with a rich red miso soup, a ¥1,000 two-tuna bowl, crisp fried conger eel. In the evening the front turns into a standing bar where you choose your fish and drinks. Closes with the market. A few find it ordinary. Closed Wednesday, Sunday and holidays.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a sushi, eel and standing-bar listing beside the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market, with retail sales, lunch and izakaya hours; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 describe a fish market with a dining area at the back, daily dishes that change with the market's catch, and an evening standing bar.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi set; tuna bowl.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 guest came for fried conger eel, worried it would be gone, and was told to ask for more tartare sauce.
An August 2026 family stopped in after playing in Umekoji Park, and found it good but not distinctive.
An October 2026 diner praised the savvy service of the woman at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司・うなぎ・立ち飲み、下京区朱雀北ノ口町64番地、JR梅小路京都西駅から徒歩3分、京都市中央卸売市場の入口の西側、月・木・金 11:30〜14:30・16:00〜20:30、火 11:30〜14:30、土 11:00〜14:30・16:00〜20:30、料理L.O.20:00、水・日・祝休み (市場の休みに準ずる)、小売は11:00〜20:00 (火曜は18:00まで)、予約可 (朝と昼は45分制)、すべて外税、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): 魚屋の奥の食事処、約20席、市場の仕入れで日替わり、お造り定食 (5〜6種、赤だし)、まぐろの二色丼1,000円、海鮮丼、ミックスフライ定食 (まぐろカツ)、鱧フライとタルタル、海老天定食、夜は前の立ち飲みで魚と飲み物を選ぶ、大トロ、中トロ、鱧、鰻、だし巻き、いわし、あじの天ぷら、日本酒、鉄火巻きの持ち帰り、平凡との声。

cultural_comfort.note: Set meals at the back, standing bar at the front; 45-minute limit at lunch; prices plus tax; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: ジェルメ (Germer)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: a bakery of croissants, pain de mie, campagne and Danish, with pastry-wrapped terrines at dinner (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: buttery viennoiserie, bacon épi, crab-cream Danish and a game and foie-gras dinner course (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday 12:00–22:00; Friday 13:00–22:00; closed Monday and Tuesday; bread sales 12:00–21:00 until sold out, restaurant from 18:00; hours may change (Tabelog). The dinner course is by reservation only (August 2026). A small shop — reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 seats: 4 at the counter and 4 at a table; non-smoking, ashtray outside (Tabelog). Just off Shirakawa-dori near Ginkakuji; Ginkakuji-michi bus stop, 15 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Jodoji near Ginkakuji, off Shirakawa-dori — Ginkakuji-michi bus stop
places.cuisine: Bakery by day and a small bistro and wine bar by night, run by a couple (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews) · bread: moist, buttery croissant ¥330, pain de mie and raisin pain de mie, whole-wheat campagne, French bread, bacon épi ¥330, seasonal Danish such as crab cream, granola, cheesecake (2024–2026 reviews) · dinner: a reservation-only course of about seven dishes with rare ingredients — foie gras from Maison Mito, ikejime fish, game from Miyama, local farm produce — incl. a pâté en croûte of venison, boar, pork and foie gras (August 2026) · bread from about ¥330, dinner ¥20,000–30,000 (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bakery and bistro · near Ginkakuji, couple-run] A tiny bakery off Shirakawa-dori whose croissant some call the best in Kyoto — moist, buttery, crisp — with pain de mie, campagne and Danish that sell out fast; prices are not always posted, and some find prices high. By night, the chef and wife serve an eight-seat, reservation-only course of rare ingredients, from Maison Mito foie gras to Miyama game. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

roles: Chef and baker, Mr. Okamoto (as named by reviewers)
The wife of the chef, who runs the shop together (May 2024; August 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bread, bistro and wine-bar shop near Ginkakuji with bread sales from midday and a restaurant from 18:00. Reviewers describe the couple who run it, chef Okamoto, called a bread artist after a TV feature (February 2025), and a dinner course built on carefully sourced ingredients such as foie gras from Maison Mito, nerve-killed fish and game from Miyama (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Carefully sourced, rare ingredients (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Croissant; pâté en croûte.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 eleven-time regular advises buying bread a few times and asking about the ingredients before booking the dinner course, to build trust with the couple.
A February 2025 visitor, drawn by a TV feature, watched the croissants sell out through the window and settled happily for a bacon épi and a crab-cream Danish.
A November 2025 shopper found no prices posted and paid ¥780 for one loaf.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン・ビストロ・ワインバー、左京区浄土寺西田町3、市バス銀閣寺道、叡山電鉄出町柳駅から徒歩15分、水・木・土・日 12:00〜22:00、金 13:00〜22:00、月・火定休、パンの販売は12:00〜21:00 (売り切れまで)、レストランは18:00から、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、8席 (カウンター4、テーブル4)、禁煙 (外に灰皿)。口コミ (2024年5月〜2026年8月、英語): 銀閣寺の近く、白川通から少し入る、夫婦で営む、パンの職人の Okamoto シェフ (テレビで紹介)、しっとりしたバターのクロワッサン330円、食パン、レーズンの食パン、全粒粉のカンパーニュ、バゲット、ベーコンエピ330円、季節のデニッシュ (蟹クリーム)、グラノーラ、チーズケーキ、値札がなく1個780円との声、夜は予約のみのコース約7品 (Maison Mito のフォアグラ、神経締めの魚、Miyama のジビエ、地元の野菜、鹿と猪と豚とフォアグラのパテ・アン・クルート)。

cultural_comfort.note: Bread from midday, sells out; dinner by reservation only; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners).

places.name: ディス イズ シゼン ((THISIS)SHIZEN)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Anko (sweet bean paste) flowers over ice cream; no information on cones, toppings or gluten (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The flowers are shaped from bean paste, but sit on dairy ice cream (vanilla or matcha); no vegan information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–19:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; queues at weekends (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Limited seating with a view of the courtyard; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). 1F of Shinpuhkan, on Karasuma-dori south of Aneyakoji; about 165 m from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinpuhkan 1F, Karasuma — 2 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Café of "ice bouquets": flowers piped from coloured sweet bean paste over ice cream, finished in front of you (2026 reviews) · ROSE MIX ¥1,950, choose three of seven or eight bean-paste flavours such as coffee, beet or ramune (August–September 2026) · seasonal AJISAI hydrangea ¥1,850, with vanilla or matcha ice cream (September–October 2026) · WANKO BOUQUET dog ¥1,350, e.g. caramel (September 2026) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Sweets · Shinpuhkan, Karasuma Oike] A museum-like café of plants and art where bean paste is piped into roses, hydrangeas or a puppy over ice cream, finished leaf by leaf before your eyes — a photo first, a dessert second. Flavours run from coffee to beet and ramune. Around ¥1,350–1,950; queues on weekends and many visitors from abroad. Some find the taste ordinary or very sweet. Open daily.

roles: Café staff (unnamed), who finish each bouquet at the counter
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café in Shinpuhkan with a website at thisis.website/shizen. Reviewers in 2026 describe an interior of plants, art and tableware like a museum or botanical garden, seasonal flower designs, and staff who finish the leaves of each order in front of the guest.
chef_bio.specialty: Ice bouquet of bean-paste flowers.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor who expected ice cream found the rose was made of bean paste — and the ramune flavour a revelation.
A September 2026 guest photographed the staff adding the front paws to a caramel dog bouquet.
A September 2026 visitor found the taste average but the presentation worth nearly ¥2,000.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、中京区烏丸通姉小路下ル場之町586-2 新風館 1F、烏丸御池駅から165m、毎日 10:00〜19:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): あんこの花を目の前で仕上げるアイスのブーケ、ROSE MIX 1,950円 (7〜8種のあんから3種、コーヒー、ビーツ、ラムネなど)、季節の AJISAI 1,850円 (バニラか抹茶のアイス)、WANKO BOUQUET 1,350円 (キャラメルの犬)、植物とアートの美術館のような店内、中庭の見える席、週末は行列、外国人客が多い、味は普通・甘いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; queues at weekends; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: やぐ羅 本店 (Yagura Honten)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat udon and soba in soy-dashi broths, tempura, and a thickened curry broth (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi broths, herring, chirimen, chicken and egg (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:30–21:00; Saturday and Sunday 11:00–21:00; irregular closing days (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); usually a quick table even at lunch (October 2026). Prices exclude tax (Tabelog original すべて外税となっております。). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 34 seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). On Shijo-dori opposite the Minamiza, by the north-east corner of Kawabata-Shijo; 1 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; July 2026).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-dori opposite the Minamiza — 1 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Long-established soba and udon shop on Shijo (2026 reviews) · nishin soba ¥1,580, with chirimen-sansho rice +¥400 (March 2026) · yuba ankake soba ¥1,480 and yuba ankake udon (March–April 2026) · Kyoto tanuki udon of chopped fried tofu and Kujo negi in thick sauce; ankake curry soba; tempura zaru soba with chirimen-sansho rice; oyakodon (March–October 2026) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Soba and udon · Shijo opposite the Minamiza] A long-established noodle shop a minute from Gion-Shijo Station, playing old festive koto music: famous nishin soba with sweet-simmered herring, silky yuba ankake soba, Kyoto-style tanuki udon in a thick sauce with Kujo negi, curry udon and a rich oyakodon. Usually easy to get in even amid the crowds. Cash only; prices plus tax.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a soba, udon and curry shop on Shijo near Gion with a website at yagura-net.com; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 call it a long-established soba shop famous for nishin soba, across from the Kyoto Minamiza.
chef_bio.specialty: Nishin soba; yuba ankake.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner learned that in Kyoto "tanuki" means chopped fried tofu in a thick sauce, not tempura bits.
A March 2026 first-timer had yuba ankake soba to traditional New Year-style music, the room nearly full at 17:30.
An October 2026 guest got a table quickly at lunch despite the station-side location.

places.notes: [Mazemen · Kawaramachi Marutamachi, Kyoto flavours on noodles] A clean, stylish counter near the Kamo River making soupless mazemen with Kyoto twists — white miso and yuzu dashi, sudachi soy dashi with an onsen egg — plus inventive seasonal bowls such as fig with sakura-smoked chashu. Prices are a little high, so many guests are overseas visitors. Book for weekend lunch. No ramen block: the sources do not cover all six dimensions.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an abura-soba, mazesoba and ramen shop opened 8 December 2016, with vegetarian options. Ramen block not given: the sources do not cover all six ramen dimensions.
chef_bio.specialty: White-miso yuzu dashi mazemen; seasonal mazemen.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular came back on purpose for the mizunasu mazemen, missed on its last day the year before.
A September 2026 visitor arrived 15 minutes after opening to be first for the fig and sakura-smoked chashu mazemen.
A July 2026 diner noted the higher prices and the many overseas guests.

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; many overseas guests (July 2026); book for weekend lunch. No English evidence found.

places.hours_raw: Sun, Mon, Wed, Thu and holidays 17:30–23:00; Fri, Sat and days before holidays 17:30–24:00; closed Tuesday and the 3rd Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations by form; 2-hour seating; overseas guests are asked to give a mobile number that works in Japan or the name of the hotel (Tabelog). Online bookings are paid in cash only; otherwise cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog; January 2026). Service charge 20% from 26 December to 5 January (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「12/26~1/5迄はサービス料20%を頂戴致します。」). 13 seats: 7 at the counter and one tatami room for 6 (Tabelog). Dogs welcome in a bag or cart (Tabelog; 2023–25 reviews). Non-smoking; smoking in the courtyard, or inside if hired privately (Tabelog). In a 100-year-old house at the Kawaramachi Shichijo bus stop; 5 min from Shichijo Stn, 10 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; November 2024). Opened 30 June 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi Shichijo — 5 min from Shichijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto vegetables and fresh seafood in a renovated old house (June 2025) · marbled roast beef, salted grilled Kyoto asparagus, salmon sashimi, thick-cut bacon salad, a pork-and-cabbage omelette with green onion and bean sprouts, bite-size gyoza, fried corn (August 2024) · oden of young corn and bamboo shoot (November 2024), oden with red konnyaku (January 2026); Kyoto vegetable sticks (November 2024) · buri sashimi eaten with senmaizuke; soba (March 2025) · boiled hamo (August 2026) · fresh-squeezed grapefruit sours and sake (2024–25 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kawaramachi Shichijo, dogs welcome in a century-old house] A 13-seat izakaya in a 100-year-old townhouse by the Kawaramachi Shichijo bus stop where dogs can join you at the counter: Kyoto vegetables, sashimi, oden with red konnyaku and homely plates like a pork-and-cabbage omelette. Regulars fill half the counter, and one August 2026 newcomer found the service slow and cool. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya with seafood and creative dishes, opened 30 June 2022, in a renovated house that a November 2024 review puts at about 100 years old.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto vegetables; oden; dog-friendly dining.

anecdotes.text: An October 2023 guest came for the dog-friendly counter and swapped dog stories with overseas visitors over appetizers, without a common language.
A March 2025 couple tried buri sashimi with senmaizuke for the first time and were served one shared soba on two plates.
An August 2026 visitor felt regulars came first and found the staff unfriendly to newcomers and the dishes slow.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian, French and pasta restaurant in Asty Kyoto, opened 7 August 2015. Tabelog also lists Pasta More Ueno (Tokyo) and Kyoto Pastamore at AEON Mall Rinku Sennan (Osaka); the operator is not named in the sources found.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, picking it by elimination before a Shinkansen, was won over by a thin, tangy Napolitan unlike the usual ketchup kind.
An October 2026 diner chose the regular size, found it smaller than expected, and wished for the free large.
A November 2026 diner found that day’s pasta almost unsalted.

places.notes: [Obanzai izakaya · Kyoto Stn north, oden and obanzai by the piece] A busy basement izakaya near Kyoto Station where you take your shoes off and pick oden from the pot at the counter, alongside Kyoto obanzai, miso dengaku and a surprising tomato-and-yuba gratin, with sake. Book — there is a queue at opening. ¥418 seating charge. Open daily from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the Safari Group site: one of the group’s two brands (六角や and 石庵), with this Kyoto shop listed as the 六角や location. Opened 17 January 2013 (Tabelog).

An August 2026 visitor called the tomato-and-yuba gratin the biggest surprise of the night.

No reservations at lunch; book for dinner if possible. A short queue at weekday lunch peaks (November 2025). places.neighborhood: Okazaki — an alley near Heian Shrine, 3 min walk from the Dobutsuen-mae bus stop
places.cuisine: A long-standing neighbourhood sushi counter in an Okazaki alley, best known for cheap lunch bowls (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews) · lunch: tuna nakaochi don ¥1,000 (limited), anago don ¥1,350, seafood don ¥1,500, chirashi, an "Okazaki" nigiri set with soup, all with a bonito-broth soup (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews) · evenings: sashimi, nigiri (toro, salmon, uni), kizushi (cured mackerel), fried scallops, hamo, uzaku (2024–2025 reviews) · maki to take away
places.notes: [Sushi · Okazaki, the ¥1,000 tuna bowl near Heian Shrine] A long-established little sushi counter down an alley near Heian Shrine, a lunch refuge from the museum and temple crowds: a limited ¥1,000 tuna nakaochi bowl, anago and seafood bowls and chirashi with a fine bonito-broth soup, and nigiri and sashimi with sake in the evening. Friendly, family-welcoming staff and an English menu. No service charge; no cards.

roles: Owner-chef, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Tabelog's shop text calls it a long-established sushi shop by Heian Shrine where the owner serves carefully chosen fish at reasonable prices. Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe a solid wooden counter, a smiling chef, older regulars, a growing share of foreign visitors and locals collecting maki to take home.
chef_bio.specialty: Tuna nakaochi don.

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "A woman, likely a local resident, came to pick up her ordered maki sushi, and it was nice to see the chef smiling as he handed it to her."
May 2024: "Maybe it's just the right portion for the seniors, but it left me wanting a bit more."
August 2026: "I brought my 5-month-old baby, and they kindly allowed us in."

places.cuisine: Ramen with hand-kneaded, house-made thick curly noodles, from the owner of a popular Kyoto ramen shop (2026 reviews) · shoyu ramen ¥1,100 in a black-pork-and-chicken broth (August 2026); niboshi shoyu with Rausu kombu and pork back fat ¥1,150; ajitama white-shoyu ramen ¥1,250; tonkotsu shoyu (October 2026) · thick, flat mochi-wheat abura soba (250 g / 300 g); chilled niboshi ramen with ginger ¥1,300 in summer (August–September 2026) · wontons (3) ¥330; shime-meshi of rice with Rausu kombu tsukudani ¥150; karaage and rice sets; pork-stew rice ¥500 (2026 reviews) · two kinds of chashu (thigh and belly) on most bowls
places.notes: [Ramen · Sanjo-kai arcade, house-made thick noodles] A year-old ramen shop on the Sanjo-kai shopping street whose point is its own hand-kneaded noodles — thick, curly and chewy in shoyu, niboshi and white-shoyu bowls, flat mochi-wheat in the abura soba — with two kinds of chashu and a free large size. One diner did not take to the chilled summer ramen (August 2026); a morning bowl was on the salty side (September 2026). Closed Thursday.

roles: Not named in a source; per reviewers, a new shop from the owner of the ramen shop "Hebinoya"
chef_bio.background: Opened 21 October 2025 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 call it a new venture from the owner of the popular ramen shop "Hebinoya" (August 2026) and the Daitetsu group's fourth shop (September 2026), with a noodle machine in the shop for irregular, hand-kneaded noodles. For its first anniversary in October 2026 it served a collaboration bowl with an Ichijoji tonkotsu shop. Featured on the KBS Kyoto programme "太陽、京都で麺食らう。" broadcast 3 September 2026 (web listing).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the programme listing, the owner wants to grow a "みんなの味" (everyone's flavour) that the neighbourhood should have.
chef_bio.specialty: House-made thick noodles; niboshi shoyu ramen.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "This is not a direct spin-off from the popular 'Hebinoya,' but rather a new proposal from the same owner."
August 2026: the chilled ramen — "honestly, the flavor didn't quite match my preferences this time. However, the handmade noodles were impressive."
September 2026, a limited morning bowl called "kishima": "The broth was on the saltier side, the offal was tender."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイテツ食堂、ラーメン、中京区三条通神泉苑西入今新在家西町3-1、JR二条駅・二条城前駅、11:30〜15:30・18:00〜20:30、木曜休み、予約不可、奥にテーブル8席、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、2025年10月21日オープン。京都三条会商店街の店舗ページ: 黒豚と鶏のスープ、手打ち式の自家製麺。KBS京都「太陽、京都で麺食らう。#16」(2026年9月3日放送): 店主は地域に「みんなの味」を育てたい。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): 人気店の店主の新しい店、ダイテツグループの4店目、店内の製麺機で手もみ風の不揃いな太麺、醤油ラーメン1,100円、煮干醤油1,150円 (煮干と羅臼昆布、黒豚の背脂)、味玉白醤油1,250円、豚骨醤油、もち小麦の平打ち太麺の油そば (250g・300g)、冷やし煮干ラーメン1,300円、ワンタン3個330円、羅臼昆布の佃煮の〆めし150円、唐揚げとご飯のセット、モモとバラの2種のチャーシュー、並盛と大盛が同じ値段、朝ラーメン (7〜10時) の限定の一杯、1周年に一乗寺の豚骨店とのコラボ、PayPay可に、冷やしは好みでなかったという声、朝の一杯は塩気が強めという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Local ramen counter; menu board outside.

places.name: 焼き肉家 益市 堺町錦店 (Yakinikuya Masuichi Sakaimachi Nishiki)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: marinated yakiniku with soy-based tare, cold noodles (2026 reviews); no allergen information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef yakiniku house (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Sun–Thu 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); Fri–Sat 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); holidays posted on Instagram and the website. Book (phone from 14:00); 2-hour limit for reserved seats, 3 hours in private rooms; online bookings cannot choose seat type. Private-room fee for room bookings — Tabelog, Japanese original 「個室のご予約は個室料いただいております。」 77 seats over two floors, private rooms for 1–8, sunken seating. Non-smoking. Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; children welcome, kids' menu. Cards (incl. UnionPay), PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay; no e-money.
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi, just north of Nishiki-koji — 10 min walk from Karasuma / Shijo Stns (Shijo underground exit 14)
places.cuisine: A Kyoto-styled yakiniku house of thin-sliced, creatively plated beef, from a Kyoto group (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · courses including "Kiwami" and a premium course with Omi beef yukhoe, kalbi and choice cuts (April–May 2026); a celebration "meat cake" (August 2026) · thick-cut tongue with coarse salt, outside skirt, loin fresh enough to eat raw, thick-cut maruchin (thigh) (2026 reviews) · cold noodles to finish (May 2026)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Sakaimachi near Nishiki, Kyoto-styled grill house] A stylish two-floor yakiniku by Nishiki Market from the local Masuichi group: thin-sliced, prettily plated beef, thick-cut tongue, Omi beef yukhoe and good-value courses, with private rooms and multilingual menus. Courses can run small (April 2026); it closes at 22:00 most nights (August 2026). Private-room fee.

roles: Not named in a source; part of the 益市 group (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, sister shops are 焼き肉家 益市 八条口店 (Kyoto Station), 益市 本店 (Kisshoin), 益市 東店 (near Toji), and three other-named restaurants around Shijo (Yakiniku Soya, Fubito Suuro, Kyoto Meat Dining). Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm, Kyoto-style interior, adults downstairs and families upstairs, energetic and attentive staff, and frosted beer mugs.
chef_bio.specialty: Thick-cut tongue; Omi beef yukhoe.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "Overall, the portions were a bit smaller than we expected, so we ended up ordering a little extra, resulting in a bill similar to what we usually pay."
August 2026: for a birthday course "We were able to take home the flower that came with the meat cake," though "the operating hours ended at 10 PM, so we couldn't stay late."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼き肉家 益市 堺町錦店、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、中京区堺町錦小路上ル東側、烏丸駅・四条駅から徒歩10分 (地下道14番出口)、日〜木 17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)・金土 17:00〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、休みはInstagramとサイトで、電話は14時から、予約席は2時間・個室は3時間、原文で「個室のご予約は個室料いただいております。」、77席、個室 (1〜8名)、掘りごたつ、禁煙、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、子供可・子供メニュー、カード・PayPay・Alipay・WeChat Pay可、電子マネー不可、姉妹店は益市 八条口店・本店 (吉祥院)・東店 (東寺近く)・焼肉 soya、Fubito Suuro、Kyoto Meat Dining。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年8月、英語): 京都らしい店内と器、薄切りの肉、近江牛のユッケ、厚切りタン、ハラミ、生で食べられるほどのロース、厚切りのマルチョウ、極みコースとプレミアムコース、肉ケーキ、冷麺、コースの量が少なめという声、22時で閉まるのが残念という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; private-room fee.

places.name: 寿しのむさし 京都駅八条口店 (Sushi no Musashi, Kyoto Station Hachijo Exit)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soy sauce, creative and fried sushi, yuba sweets (Tabelog; 2026 reviews); no allergen information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish conveyor-belt sushi shop (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 10:30–21:45 (last entry 21:20, last order 21:30); open all year. Take-away 9:00–21:45, bookable for same-day pickup from an hour ahead (official site). No reservations; queues at peak, quick turnover (2026 reviews). 31 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair access; children welcome. Japanese and English menus; order from the chefs as well as off the belt (June 2026). Cards, transit IC and e-money, QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay). In Asty Road (Kyoto omotenashi-koji), 1 min from the Hachijo Exit Shinkansen gates.
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, Hachijo Exit — Asty Road, by the Shinkansen gates
places.cuisine: Kyoto's own conveyor-belt sushi, founded 1977 at Kawaramachi-Sanjo, hand-formed by chefs (official site; Tabelog) · about 50 kinds always on, plates from ¥146 before tax (Tabelog) · Kyoto touches: hamo oshi-zushi (and hamo sugata-zushi to order at this shop), yuba sweets; straw-seared bonito, toro, tamago, horse sashimi (Tabelog; official site; 2026 reviews) · take-away sushi boxes
places.notes: [Conveyor sushi · Kyoto Station Hachijo Exit, a local since 1977] The station branch of Kyoto's own Kawaramachi-Sanjo conveyor-belt sushi, by the Shinkansen gates: chef-made plates from ¥146, straw-seared bonito, hamo oshi-zushi in season, and take-away boxes for the train, open 10:30 to 21:45 every day. Expect queues and a mostly tourist crowd; some found it ordinary for the price (July–August 2026), and popular fish sells out late (June 2026).

roles: Not named in a source; branch of 寿しのむさし (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, 寿しのむさし opened in 1977 at Kawaramachi-Sanjo and has run for over forty years, particular about fish, rice, vinegar, tea, soy sauce, wasabi and nori; current shops are the Sanjo main shop, this Hachijo Exit shop, and a take-away-only shop at Kamihorikawa. Reviewers in 2026 describe sushi on the belt plus orders straight to the chefs, quick service, and a crowd that is about half foreign visitors.
chef_bio.philosophy: From the site: "真心も 美味しさも 特上です" (sincerity and flavour, both top grade).
chef_bio.specialty: Straw-seared bonito; hamo oshi-zushi.

anecdotes.text: June 2026: "When I visited about an hour before the last order, I found that items like hamachi and aji were sold out."
July 2026: "I couldn't understand what this restaurant's appeal was… While it is indeed affordable, there are also some expensive items, so be cautious."
July 2026: a former regular of the Sanjo main shop "usually avoid[s] this location because it's always crowded."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都の寿しのむさし、職人が握る地魚の回転寿司、1977年に京都の河原町三条で開店、四十余年、ネタ・米・酢・お茶・醤油・わさび・海苔・清潔さ・気配りにこだわる、店舗は三条本店・京都駅八条口店・上堀川店 (ネット予約テイクアウト受取専用)、京都駅八条口店限定のはも姿寿司の予約、持ち帰りは当日最短1時間後の予約可。食べログ: 寿しのむさし 京都駅八条口店、回転寿司、下京区東塩小路高倉町8-3 JR京都駅構内アスティ1F、新幹線側の八条口から徒歩1分、毎日 10:30〜21:45 (最終入店21:20、L.O. 21:30)、持ち帰り9:00〜21:45、年中無休、予約不可、31席、禁煙、車椅子可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、常時約50種、1皿146円 (税抜) から、鱧の押し寿司、京ゆばのスイーツ。口コミ (2026年5〜9月、英語): 藁焼きの鰹、トロ、玉子、馬刺し、日本語と英語のメニュー、職人に直接注文、外国の客が半分ほど、行列、遅い時間は品切れ、普通の回転寿司で割高な皿もという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; conveyor belt plus ordering from the chefs.

places.name: ALKAA
places.gf_detail: Ask. A wine bar with small plates and sweets — salami, charcuterie, quiche, gougères, canelés, financiers, Basque cheesecake, salt sablés; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Wine is the focus; the food is charcuterie, cheese-based and baked sweets, and nothing plant-based is described (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday, Saturday and Sunday 15:00–24:00; Friday 18:00–24:00; days off vary — check Instagram; after a day off it opens 18:00–24:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; a reservation is advisable (Tabelog; June 2025). Charge ¥500 including tax (Tabelog, original チャージ料500円（税込）). Cards, QUICPay, PayPay and Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). 15 seats: a counter downstairs and a private room upstairs (Tabelog; November 2025, April 2026). Wine is the only drink served, and the bar asks people who do not drink alcohol not to visit; guests wearing strong perfume may be refused entry (Tabelog). Two minutes on foot from the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Quiet lane by the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station — 2 min on foot
places.cuisine: A wine bar for natural and French wines by the glass, from about ¥1,300–1,400 (May and August 2025) — champagne, orange, white and red, poured in Zalto glasses (April 2026); more Japanese wines lately (April 2026) · three-salami plate ¥1,000; canelé ¥300 (May 2025) · gougères (November 2025) · salted-chocolate financier and Basque cheesecake (October 2025) · charcuterie platter, quiche, salt sablé (July 2026) · sweets from atelier ALKAA, the pastry shop of the owner’s wife (May and November 2025)
places.notes: [Wine bar · Kyoto Station Hachijo exit, natural wine and canelés] A calm, stylish wine bar two minutes from the Shinkansen side of Kyoto Station, open from 15:00 most days: natural and French wines by the glass, salami and charcuterie, and sweets such as canelés and Basque cheesecake from the owner’s wife’s pastry shop. Wine only — non-drinkers are asked not to come; ¥500 charge.

chef_bio.background: A five-time regular noted the bar’s fourth anniversary in April 2026, and in June 2025 found the master seemingly running the evenings alone; a December 2025 visitor also thought the master handled everything single-handedly. The sweets come from atelier ALKAA, run by the owner’s wife (May 2025), whose canelés another reviewer praised (November 2025). An April 2026 visitor heard the floor had been rebuilt to make a wine cellar.
chef_bio.specialty: Natural and French wine by the glass; canelés.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor, back after three years, drinks here until the last minute before the Shinkansen — the bar is that close to the platforms.
An April 2026 group of four phoned at about 19:30 and got the upstairs private room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ALKAA、ワインバー、南区東九条西山王町15-7、京都駅八条口から徒歩2分、月〜木・土・日 15:00〜24:00、金 18:00〜24:00、定休日はインスタグラムで告知、休みの翌日は18:00〜24:00、予約可、チャージ料500円 (税込)、カード可、15席、ワイン以外の飲み物はなく、お酒を飲めない方の来店は遠慮してもらう、強い香水は入店を断ることがある。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 自然派とフランスのワインをグラスで1,300〜1,400円ほど、サラミ3種1,000円、カヌレ300円、グジェール、塩チョコのフィナンシェ、バスクチーズケーキ、シャルキュトリー、キッシュ、塩サブレ、甘味は店主の妻の atelier ALKAA から、2階に個室、4周年 (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Wine only — non-drinkers are asked not to come; no strong perfume; ¥500 charge.

places.name: ダイニングカフェ＆バー ロンド (Dining Cafe & Bar Rondo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wheat is one of the allergens the restaurant marks on each dish’s name card, so wheat-containing dishes can be spotted; but everything is cooked in one kitchen with shared utensils, trace contamination is possible, and no substitute dishes are made (Tabelog). The official site asks guests with food allergies to say so in advance.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The lunch buffet is heavy on vegetables (July and October 2026) and Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but no vegan dish is described.
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. courses and sets 13:30, others 14:30); dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O. courses, sets and gozen 20:30, others 21:00); café time 15:00–17:00 on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays only (official site). Breakfast 6:30–9:00 — days vary, ask the staff (official site). Open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, without seat choice (Tabelog). Service charge included in prices (Tabelog, original サービス料は料金に含む). Cards and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). 140 seats, ground floor of the main building (official site). Hotel parking free for 2 hours with ¥2,000 spent, 3 hours with ¥3,000 (Tabelog). Two minutes on foot from the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Miyako Hotel Kyoto Hachijo, ground floor — 2 min from the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: Hotel-style Western food and a café (Tabelog) · lunch choice buffet “ERANDE”: appetizers, soups, salads, bread, juice and desserts with one of five mains, ¥4,900, free-flow wine and sparkling wine +¥1,500 (Tabelog); machine-made mini pancakes (Tabelog; July–August 2026) · Rondo lunch course, six dishes, ¥5,500 — e.g. salmon gratin with tapenade, roast beef with red-wine sauce (Tabelog, September–November) · course with appetizer, soup, monthly pasta and meat or fish (July–August 2026) · kids’ meal ¥1,900 with fried shrimp, hamburg steak and omurice (August 2026) · Japanese-Western breakfast buffet ¥4,000 (hotel guests ¥3,300), children ¥2,000; American breakfast ¥4,000 (official site) · cakes to take away (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Hotel dining · Kyoto Station Hachijo exit, lunch buffet with a main] The big all-day restaurant of Miyako Hotel Kyoto Hachijo, two minutes from the station: a half-buffet lunch of salads, soups and desserts with a choice of main (¥4,900), set courses with pasta and roast beef, breakfast buffets and cakes. Attentive hotel service and no rush to leave. Service included.

chef_bio.background: The restaurant of Miyako Hotel Kyoto Hachijo (Tabelog; official site). Tabelog’s invoice number T8010003050331 is registered to 合同会社京都八条ホテルアセット, Tokyo (NTA register). The official site mentions only “the Rondo chef”.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch choice buffet with a main dish.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family of three generations chose a course over the buffet; the ¥1,900 kids’ meal was bigger than expected.
A May 2026 guest who found the lunch on Ozmall stayed from 11:30 to 15:00 with no time limit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ダイニングカフェ&バー「ロンド」、140席・本館1F、朝食6:30〜9:00 (営業日は日によって異なる)、ランチ11:30〜15:00、ディナー17:00〜22:00、カフェタイム15:00〜17:00 (土日祝のみ)、和洋朝食ブッフェ4,000円 (宿泊客3,300円)、小学生2,000円、アメリカンブレックファスト4,000円、ランチチョイスブッフェ ERANDE、食物アレルギーは予め申し出を。食べログ: 洋食・カフェ・ケーキ、南区西九条院町17 都ホテル京都八条 1F、京都駅八条口から徒歩2分、年中無休、予約可 (席の指定不可)、サービス料は料金に含む、カード可、電子マネー不可、適格請求書 T8010003050331 (合同会社京都八条ホテルアセット)、ERANDE 4,900円、ロンドランチコース5,500円、特定原材料の8品目 (9月から9品目) を料理の札に表示、同じ厨房と調理器具を使うため混入の可能性あり、代替メニューはない。口コミ (2026年、英語): 野菜の多いブッフェ、ミニパンケーキの機械、月替わりのパスタ、お子様ランチ1,900円、時間制限なしのランチ、ホテルの丁寧なサービス、朝食ブッフェ。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; reservations online; allergen cards on the buffet.

gf_cross_contamination: All dishes are made in the same kitchen with the same utensils and cleaning equipment as allergen-containing dishes; trace contamination is possible (Tabelog).
staff_allergy_handling: Eight (from September, nine) specified allergens, including wheat, are shown on each dish’s name card; other allergies are not handled and no substitute dishes are made (Tabelog). Tell the restaurant in advance (official site).
