places.name: 食道 萬きち (Shokudo Mankichi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi and Japanese dishes — sashimi, nigiri, tempura, miso-grilled fish, pork kakuni, tsukune; soy sauce and miso are not described (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-sushi kitchen; the course soup is made with Rishiri kombu and honkarebushi (bonito) dashi (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday and holidays 17:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; one order per person; seat-only bookings and à la carte on the day also possible (Tabelog). Junior-high age and older only (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 16 seats, counter and tables; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Opened 29 February 2024 (Tabelog). About 7–8 min on foot from the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station (Tabelog; October 2026).
places.neighborhood: South of Kyoto Station — 7 min from the Hachijo exit
places.cuisine: Sushi and modern Japanese food from a chef with about 30 years in kaiseki kitchens (Tabelog) · Mankichi Japanese course, 14 dishes, with a seasonal soup of Rishiri kombu and honkarebushi dashi, ¥8,800 (Tabelog) · sushi and à la carte course, 15 dishes — about ten nigiri and four or five plates — ¥8,800 (Tabelog; January and October 2026) · “Extreme” course with sea urchin, lobster, Wagyu and foie gras, made with the group restaurant Buta Otoko, ¥17,600 (Tabelog) · à la carte: chef’s-choice sashimi, grilled squid, ayu tempura, miso-grilled Spanish mackerel, chicken tsukune, fried oysters, pork kakuni, sardine-and-tomato spring rolls, grilled soft roe, karasumi (2025–2026 reviews) · sake, e.g. Harushika and Isojiman (2026)
places.notes: [Sushi and Japanese · near the Hachijo exit, kaiseki-trained chef] A small counter south of Kyoto Station where a chef with three decades in kaiseki serves ¥8,800 sushi or Japanese courses — the mid-course soup is made in front of you — plus à la carte sashimi, grilled fish and sake. Adults and teens only; closed Monday. Part of the local らくちん restaurant group.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog says the chef trained for 30 years in a kaiseki restaurant and makes the course dashi personally. Tabelog’s website link is the company page of 有限会社らくちん, and the invoice number T5130002022652 is registered to 有限会社らくちん (NTA register); the company page lists 11 shops (8 run directly, 3 franchised), led by 大衆酒場フレンチマン, with izakaya, yakiniku, yakitori, French and Thai restaurants, under representative director 渡辺 哲也. Reviewers praise the chef’s timing (August 2025, January 2026) and the friendly staff (December 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi with Japanese course dishes; seasonal soup.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 birthday table got a surprise birthday plate; the reviewer called the chef the best.
An October 2026 guest filled up on sashimi, soft roe, karasumi and crab and never got to the sushi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食道 萬きち、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、南区東九条西山王町1-5、京都駅八条口から徒歩7分、火〜日・祝 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、月曜定休、予約可、1人1オーダー、中学生以上、カード可、16席、貸切20名まで、2024年2月29日オープン、懐石で30年修業した料理人、萬きち日本料理コース14品8,800円 (利尻昆布と本枯節の出汁)、寿司と一品のコース15品8,800円、Buta Otoko とのコラボの極みコース17,600円、適格請求書 T5130002022652 (有限会社らくちん)。会社概要: 有限会社らくちん、代表取締役 渡辺 哲也、11店舗 (直営8、FC3)、大衆酒場フレンチマンほか。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 刺身、握り、鮎の天ぷら、鰆の味噌焼き、つくね、カキフライ、豚の角煮、春巻き、白子、からすみ、日本酒。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter sushi; junior-high age and older only; one order per person.

places.name: 鳥茂 (Tori Shige)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori with salt or sauce, chicken mizutaki hot pot, oyakodon, karaage and chicken cutlet; seasonings are not described (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant — yakitori, chicken-bone mizutaki broth, oyakodon in dashi (official site; reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sundays and Mondays, Mondays even on holidays (Tabelog; official site). Chicken mizutaki needs a reservation by the day before and is served from November to the end of March; the milky chicken soup is available all year (Tabelog; official site). Yakitori orders: at least two skewers of each kind for parties of two or more (official site). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at the counter, 8 on sofas (Tabelog). Children welcome, with one free soft drink each up to high-school age (Tabelog). About 6 min on foot from JR Tambaguchi Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Residential Mibu — 6 min from JR Tambaguchi Stn
places.cuisine: A chicken restaurant founded in Kyoto in 1973 (official site) · yakitori ¥220 a skewer for most kinds (official site) — e.g. yagen cartilage, tsukune, Daisen chicken, wings (August 2025); five-skewer yakitori set with an appetizer and draft beer ¥2,000 (official site) · chicken mizutaki with zosui ¥4,700 a portion, November–March, by reservation; mizutaki course with yakitori ¥6,000 (official site) — kudzu noodles and tofu in the pot, egg zosui to finish (November 2026) · oyakodon ¥850 (official site) · karaage ¥830, salt-grilled wings ¥770, tamagoyaki ¥700 (official site) · chicken cutlet, natto omelet, duck breast, grilled shiitake (2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakitori and mizutaki · Mibu, since 1973] A homey 15-seat chicken restaurant in a residential street, run by a friendly couple: ¥220 yakitori skewers, a much-praised oyakodon, and from November a milky chicken mizutaki hot pot (book the day before) finished with egg zosui. Family-friendly and non-smoking; closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: The official site says the restaurant was founded in Kyoto in 1973 (Showa 48). Tabelog’s invoice number T8810019048857 is registered to the individual 松尾 茂 (NTA register). Reviewers describe a family-run shop with a warm hostess (May 2024), welcomed by “a very pleasant couple running the restaurant” (May 2025) and “the couple running the restaurant” who were friendly (November 2025); a December 2025 visitor found “both the chef and the owner incredibly kind”.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken mizutaki; oyakodon; yakitori.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor, there near closing time, was told to take as long as needed anyway.
A November 2026 family with children were given snacks on the way out.

cultural_comfort.note: Neighbourhood chicken restaurant; book mizutaki the day before; families welcome.

places.name: ローヌ (Rhone)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: toast, French toast, spaghetti napolitan and cakes (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg toast, pudding, French toast with ice cream (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 7:00–16:30; Fri and Sat 7:00–16:30 and 18:00–22:00; Sun 7:00–17:00 (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). One drink per person, even with a meal such as spaghetti — Tabelog's Japanese original: 「食事(スパゲティなど)でも、ワンドリンク制」. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) (Tabelog). 16 seats at a counter and tables, in a retro room converted from a dyeing workshop (Tabelog; December 2025 review). Run by a couple; at weekday lunch one person works alone, so food can take a while (April and February 2026 reviews). Just off the Sanjo shopping street; 6 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Off the Sanjo shopping street — 6 min from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Paris-bistro-style kissa from breakfast (Tabelog): toasts such as ham and egg with mustard (extra egg on request), café au lait, French toast with vanilla ice cream, firm retro pudding, coconut cheesecake, napolitan; at night French home cooking with seasonal ingredients and wine, mushroom salad and beer (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Retro café-bistro · off the Sanjo shopping street] A calm, Showa-signed café in a former dyeing workshop, run by a couple: breakfast toast and coffee from 7:00, firm pudding and French toast by day, and French home cooking with wine on Friday and Saturday nights. About ¥1,000–2,000 by day. One drink each.

chef_bio.background: Opened in April 2018 (October 2026 review). Reviewers describe a small shop run by a couple (April 2026), with one person on duty at weekday lunch (February 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: The charm of a Parisian bistro, from morning to bistro time (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Breakfast toast; retro pudding.

anecdotes.text: A traveller who usually breakfasts at a Sanjo standby tried Rhone in January 2026 for its firm pudding.
A February 2026 visitor found the food slow with one person working, but the coffee and coconut cheesecake delicious.
An April 2026 working traveller valued the 7:00 opening for breakfast before work.

cultural_comfort.note: One drink per person; small couple-run room.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone broth and chashu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon and Sun 11:00–22:00; Wed and Thu 11:00–23:00; Fri and Sat 11:00–24:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No bookings; buy a ticket at the machine (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). No cards or e-money; PayPay (Tabelog). 17 counter seats over two floors; smoking allowed except at lunch (11:00–14:00) (Tabelog). On the Shijo-Omiya rotary next to McDonald's; 1 min from Omiya Stn (Tabelog; March 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Omiya rotary — 1 min from Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Tonkotsu ramen with thin straight noodles: the "Hakuryu" — chashu, wood ear, menma, green onion — rich or lighter by account; a back-fat ramen; extra noodles; gyoza, moist fried rice, a late-night set of fried rice, gyoza and ramen; takana, beni shoga and garlic on the counter (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Tonkotsu ramen · Shijo-Omiya] A small, old two-floor counter by the Omiya rotary serving late into the night: the "Hakuryu" tonkotsu with thin noodles, spicy takana on the counter, and gyoza and fried rice sets — under ¥1,500. Ticket machine; smoking after lunch; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 July 2011 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Hakuryu tonkotsu ramen.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner's friend called it the best ramen around Shijo-Omiya, and the broth went down easily even after drinks.
A March 2026 first-timer found it quite good but did not plan to return.
At 21:00 in September 2026 a diner was put off by the narrow, cluttered entrance but found the ramen good.

places.name: 京都洋食 ムッシュいとう (Kyoto Yoshoku Monsieur Ito)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A buffet of omelettes, curry rice, pasta, breaded cutlets, shrimp tempura, pizza and bread; dish labelling not described (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Bean, macaroni and green salads among egg, meat and fried dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–10:00; lunch 11:30–15:00 (last entry 14:00); dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); open every day (Tabelog). Bookings taken; table bookings at lunch are limited to 90 minutes (Tabelog). No whole celebration cakes (Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says 「サービス料・チャージ料なし」. Cards and QR (Tabelog). No hotel parking for the restaurant (May 2026 review). B1F of The Royal Park Hotel Kyoto Sanjo, 3 min from Sanjo Keihan or Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo east of Kawaramachi — Royal Park Hotel Kyoto Sanjo B1F
places.cuisine: Kyoto yoshoku of the 円居 (Madoi) group, founded 1961 (Tabelog): a 90-minute lunch buffet, ¥1,900 on weekdays and ¥2,200 at weekends and holidays, soft drinks +¥200 (Tabelog) — omelettes made in a live kitchen, curry rice, minestrone, two pastas, chicken katsu, shrimp tempura, white-fish fritters, pizza, French toast with jam, black syrup and cream, salads and bread; omurice set +¥800 (November 2026); curry to take home ¥540 (August 2026); glass wine from ¥500 and a cellar list at dinner (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yoshoku buffet · Royal Park Hotel Kyoto Sanjo] The basement yoshoku of a Kyoto group born as a 1961 music café: a 90-minute lunch buffet (¥1,900–2,200) of omelettes from the live kitchen, curry, pasta and fried classics, plus breakfast and a wine-friendly dinner. No service or cover charge. Open daily.

roles: Restaurant of the 円居 (Madoi) group (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 8 October 2011 (Tabelog). Per Tabelog and the hotel's dinner leaflet: part of the 円居 (Madoi) group, founded in 1961 as a classical-music café at Hyakumanben, which grew into yoshoku and French restaurants.
chef_bio.philosophy: Nostalgic, heartfelt yoshoku passed down since the founding (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Omelettes; yoshoku buffet.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 family enjoyed watching the chef make omelettes and French toast in front of the children.
An August 2026 diner found the potatoes a little salty but grew used to them.
A November 2026 holiday guest noted the drink bar costs ¥200 extra and the omurice set ¥800 more.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat bar; seafood and cheese dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:00–5:00 (last orders food 4:00, drinks 4:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 18:00–3:00 (last orders food 2:30, drinks 3:00); irregular closures (Tabelog). Bookings taken; seat-only bookings need one drink each; all-you-can-drink course ¥5,000 (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「T.C 500yen ※0:00以降入店1000yen」 — a ¥500 table charge, ¥1,000 for arrivals after midnight. places.neighborhood: Shirakawa riverside, Gion — 2 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Meat bar of handmade dishes (Tabelog): roast beef, a "steak mountain", coarse sausage with mash, duck with W's sauce, burrata with seasonal fruit, salmon carpaccio with yogurt mousse, tuna tartare, cream-cheese bruschetta, prosciutto and strawberry salad, house "ITTAN" Genovese and rich uni carbonara, pizza; gin and tonic, a tea-based house cocktail, wine, Guinness (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Meat bar & karaoke rooms · Shirakawa, Gion] A glossy late-night dining bar by the Shirakawa, open till 3–5 a.m.: roast beef, burrata, uni carbonara and cocktails at a gold-marble counter, on the river terrace or in private karaoke rooms. About ¥5,000–8,000 plus a ¥500 table charge (¥1,000 after midnight).

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 April 2015 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Carefully chosen ingredients and handmade meat dishes, from appetizers to desserts (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Roast beef; uni carbonara.

anecdotes.text: For a girlfriend's birthday in September 2026, the staff moved a couple to the riverside terrace on request.
An October 2026 karaoke-room party noted a handsome staff member with a butler-like manner.
A September 2026 diner cut the house Genovese at the table and noted the one-drink rule and cover charge.

places.name: 和牛らーめん 笑門 (Wagyu Ramen Shomon)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thin wheat noodles with whole-wheat flour from the Kyoto noodle maker 棣鄂 (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a broth of Matsusaka beef alone, with wagyu toppings (official site).
places.hours_raw: Regular hours: lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:00–20:30 (last order 20:00); closed Sunday (official site). Autumn extended hours 1 October–30 November 2026: 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); regular hours again from 1 December (official site). No reservations; cards accepted, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 12 seats: 4 at the counter and two sunken-kotatsu tables for 4; non-smoking; English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog; official site; March 2025). 64 m from Marutamachi Stn, Exit 5 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gosho-minami, by Marutamachi Stn (Karasuma) — 64 m from Exit 5
places.cuisine: Matsusaka-beef ramen: a creamy broth of Matsusaka beef alone, simmered 10 hours with no added chemical seasonings and combined with Kyoto dashi (official site) · Kyoto shio ¥1,500, Kyoto shoyu ¥1,600, Kyoto miso ¥1,700 from 1 October 2026, with a large slice of rare A5 wagyu chashu; one free extra noodle serving per bowl (official site) · special sukiyaki-don set with A5 BMS 12 sirloin and Kyoto egg (official site) · rice ¥200 (December 2025); fried chicken wings (September 2026) · sake and wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Ramen · Marutamachi, Matsusaka-beef ramen] A small, polished ramen shop thirty seconds from Marutamachi Station, simmering Matsusaka beef for ten hours into a milky, creamy broth set with Kyoto dashi. Shio, shoyu or Kyoto miso (¥1,500–1,700) come with rare A5 wagyu slices, a soft egg and a free extra serving of noodles. Pricey for ramen, and many diners are tourists, but even sceptical locals came away impressed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a wagyu-ramen specialist in Gosho-minami, Kyoto, named for the proverb 笑う門には福来る ("fortune comes to a house of laughter"); the broth is Matsusaka beef only — no beef-bone extract or other meat — simmered for 10 hours, skimmed of fat and scum, and made without chemical seasonings; noodles are ordered from 棣鄂 (founded 1931); A5 wagyu chashu is cooked at low temperature and rested, 24 hours in all. Opened 15 August 2024 (Tabelog). A May 2025 reviewer notes the premises were once a kaiseki restaurant.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: through ramen, to bring happiness into people’s lives, as the proverb on laughter and fortune promises.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto shoyu, the first bowl the shop perfected, recommended to first-timers (official site).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 local had avoided the place for its ¥1,500 tourist-level price, then found it a fine regular lunch: thin firm noodles, a frothy white broth and very tender Matsusaka chashu.
A March 2025 diner found the rare wagyu chashu ramen good but the salty shio broth monotonous halfway through; all the other customers were foreign visitors.
An August 2026 visitor read the "aimed at tourists" comments but found the price fair with the beef, egg and free extra noodles.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (syomon.jp): 和牛らーめん 笑門 (しょうもん)、京都・丸太町の和牛らーめん専門店、「笑う門には福来る」から、松阪牛のみを10時間煮込んだ濃厚スープ (牛骨エキスや他の肉は加えない)、脂やアクを取り除き化学調味料に頼らない無添加、昭和6年創業の京都の製麺所「棣鄂」の全粒粉入り中加水細麺 (切刃22番)、A5和牛のチャーシューは低温調理と寝かせで計24時間、特選すき焼き丼セット (A5 BMS12 サーロイン、京都の卵)、京都しお1,500円・京都しょうゆ1,600円・京都みそ1,700円 (2026年10月1日から京みそと京しょうゆが100円値上げ)、ラーメン1杯につき替え玉1つ無料、初めてなら京都しょうゆ、通常は昼11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)・夜17:00〜20:30 (L.O. 20:00)、2026年10月1日〜11月30日は秋季特別営業で11:00〜15:00・17:00〜21:00、日曜定休、全12席 (お座敷2つ、カウンター4席)、中京区清水町381 Kスタジオ1F、丸太町駅5番出口から徒歩30秒。食べログ: ラーメン、2024年8月15日オープン、予約不可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙、英語メニュー、英語を話すスタッフ。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): もとは懐石料理店の建物、白く泡立つクリーミーなスープ、細いストレート麺、レアの和牛チャーシュー、味玉、キャベツ、紫玉ねぎ、ごぼうチップ、すき焼き丼セット、ライス200円、手羽先の唐揚げ、外国人客が多い。

noodles.notes: Thin straight medium-hydration noodles with whole-wheat flour from the Kyoto maker 棣鄂, cut with a no. 22 blade (official site); firm, with a strong wheat flavour (May 2025).

ramen.signature_bowl: Matsusaka-beef ramen, Kyoto shoyu — ¥1,600 from 1 October 2026 (official site).
ramen.chashu: Rare A5 wagyu, cooked low and rested 24 hours in all, served like roast beef (official site; February 2026).

gf.note: Wheat noodles.

vegan.note: Matsusaka-beef broth.

ramen.pantheon: Ten hours of Matsusaka beef and nothing else in the pot, frothed white and cut with Kyoto dashi, under a slice of rare A5 wagyu — a beef-bone-free bowl thirty seconds from Marutamachi.

richness: "The broth was creamy and rich, providing a strong flavor" (August 2026); "rich and creamy" (B502571496); the shop: rich yet not heavy (https://syomon.jp/about/).
oiliness: The shop removes fat and scum with care so the rich broth stays light enough to finish (濃厚なのに重くない).
clarity: "The overall appearance was a milky white … the broth was creamy, slightly frothy, and white" (May 2025); "espuma soup" (B534116091).
tare_strength: "The thick, creamy broth had a strong salty flavor" (shio, March 2025); "a delightful balance of umami and soy sauce" (shoyu, B536017355).
noodle_firmness: "The noodles were thin, straight, and had a firm texture" (May 2025); "straight, chewy noodles" (B502571496); the shop: しっかりとしたコシ (https://syomon.jp/about/).
aroma_punch: The shop’s Tabelog introduction praises "the exquisite aroma and deep flavor"; reviewers note a black-pepper accent (B507133992) rather than a strong aroma.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff; most diners are visitors (Tabelog; March 2025).

places.name: 鰻山椒 五行 (Unagi Sansho Gogyo)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: eel glazed with a sweet soy-based tare, and the shop says it offers no allergy accommodation (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel specialist; the shop says it has no vegetarian or vegan menu (official site).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–15:00 (last order 14:30), daily; no regular closing day, sudden closures posted on Instagram (official site; Tabelog). Bookings online through ebica; tables are generally limited to one hour, and arriving more than 10 minutes late cancels the booking (Tabelog; official site). No service charge or additional fees (Tabelog). 17 seats: a 9-seat wooden counter and two semi-private tables for 4 (private room for 6–8); wheelchair and strollers welcome; non-smoking; English, Chinese and Korean menus (Tabelog; official site). Cards, e-money and QR; no PiTaPa (official site). On Oike-dori at Horikawa, 3 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Horikawa-Oike, by Nijo Castle — 3 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Eel, sansho, rice and tare (official site) · Japanese-species eel raised at overseas eel farms (official site), steamed then grilled Kanto-style (July and September 2026 reviews) · hitsumabushi: regular ¥4,000, one whole eel ¥5,000, two eels ¥7,000; unaju: regular ¥3,800, one whole eel ¥4,800, two eels ¥6,800 (official menu) · rice from the Kyoto rice dealer 八代目儀兵衛; grape sansho from Wakayama, ground at the table; tare built on soy sauce from a century-old Kochi brewer (official site; Tabelog) · two kinds of unaju bento to take out, by phone (official site) · sake, highballs, Kyoto craft beer (official site; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Unagi · Horikawa-Oike, eel and grape sansho] A calm, modern eel house a short walk from Nijo Castle, built around four things: steamed-then-grilled Japanese-species eel, rice from a famous Kyoto rice dealer, a soy-based tare and fragrant Wakayama grape sansho, ground at the table. A whole-eel hitsumabushi (¥5,000) spills over its box; eat it plain, then with condiments, then with dashi. Lunch only, 10:00–15:00 daily; book ahead. No allergy accommodation.

roles: Chef not named; operated by 株式会社京都丸餅家 (invoice register)
chef_bio.background: Opened 31 March 2024 (Tabelog). The qualified-invoice register lists 株式会社京都丸餅家 of Yamashina, Kyoto, registered 1 October 2023 (NTA). Per the official site: Japanese-species eel (ニホンウナギ) raised at overseas eel farms, rice from 八代目儀兵衛 in Kyoto, a sweet-savoury tare and Wakayama grape sansho; Tabelog’s introduction names Hirano Seijouan as the sansho supplier and a century-old Kochi soy sauce.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "First the eel. Then the sansho" — eel, rice and tare, layered with the scent of sansho.
chef_bio.specialty: Hitsumabushi with one whole eel.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular came back after four months for the hitsumabushi and regretted not ordering the two-eel size again.
An August 2026 guest found the tea cup tasted of fish and the young staff hard to hear, and the eel a little bland.
An August 2026 diner’s wife called it the best eel of a lifetime.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sansyogogyo.com): 鰻山椒五行、京都・二条城前のひつまぶし・うな重、まずは鰻、次は山椒、海外の養鰻場で育てられたニホンウナギ、和歌山県産ぶどう山椒、京都「八代目儀兵衛」の米、甘辛いタレ、日本酒やハイボール、ひつまぶし並4,000円・一本5,000円・二本7,000円、うな重並3,800円・一本4,800円・二本6,800円、うな重弁当2種類 (受取は電話で相談)、昼10:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)、定休日なし、エビカで予約、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、子ども用の椅子あり、アレルギー対応およびベジタリアン・ヴィーガンメニューはなし、車椅子・ベビーカー可、荷物置きあり、中京区式阿弥町137-3 御池ロイヤルマンション1階、二条城前駅から徒歩約3分。食べログ: うなぎ、2024年3月31日オープン、17席 (カウンター9、半個室テーブル4名×2)、席は原則1時間、10分以上の遅刻はキャンセル扱い、サービス料・チャージ料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙、車椅子可、テイクアウト、インボイス T6130001048598 (株式会社京都丸餅家、京都市山科区)。公式紹介: Hirano Seijouan のぶどう山椒、高知の百年続く醤油蔵の醤油、京都の地ビールとスパークリング日本酒。口コミ (2026年、英語): 関東風に蒸してから焼く、山椒をその場で挽く、テーブルに追いダレ、薬味はねぎ・わさび・海苔、外国人客も多い、予約必須。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus; online booking (official site).

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The eel tare is a secret recipe built on soy sauce from a century-old Kochi brewer (July 2026 review; Tabelog introduction).

staff_allergy_handling.text: The FAQ says the shop has no allergy accommodation and no vegetarian or vegan menu (アレルギー対応およびベジタリアン・ヴィーガンメニューのご用意はありません).

places.name: HOO
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: yeast-raised wheat donuts (Leaf KYOTO; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: custard and cream-filled donuts, a sausage "donut dog" and milk lattes (Leaf KYOTO; reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00 daily per Tabelog; irregular closures (Leaf KYOTO, June 2023) — check Instagram @hoo_kyoto. No reservations (Tabelog; June 2026). Order downstairs; eat-in seats on the first floor and a larger room upstairs; takeout too (2026 reviews). Non-smoking (Leaf KYOTO). Cash, cards and PayPay (June and September 2026 reviews; Tabelog lists cards only). On Takeya-machi-dori west of Aburanokoji, 7–8 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn (Leaf KYOTO; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Takeya-machi, east of Nijo Castle — 7 min walk from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Coffee and small yeast donuts, filled with cream to order (Leaf KYOTO; July 2026) · hojicha cream ¥480, matcha cream ¥480, custard, coffee cream, kinako cream, Earl Grey cream; seasonal fig, red bean and mascarpone ¥540 (September 2026) · donut dog with a sausage grilled to order ¥580 (September 2026) · house-roasted blends and single origins: Americano ¥600, matcha latte ¥750, hojicha latte ¥700, iced Japanese black tea ¥700, cold brew (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Café · Takeya-machi near Nijo Castle, donuts and coffee] The second shop of the Kiyomizuzaka coffee stand loose kyoto, run by brothers, in an old townhouse with earthen walls and beams. Small, soft and chewy yeast donuts are filled to order — hojicha, matcha, custard, about ¥480 — with house-roasted coffee or an unsweetened matcha latte in the upstairs room. The name is the sigh of relief the brothers want you to breathe. Open daily 10:00–17:00.

roles: Run by the brothers behind loose kyoto (Leaf KYOTO); not named
chef_bio.background: Per Leaf KYOTO (June 2023): the second shop of loose kyoto, the popular Kiyomizuzaka coffee stand run by brothers, opened 13 May 2023 with queues before opening from the first days; the townhouse keeps its earthen walls and beams, and the name carries the wish for a shop where you can breathe out (ふぅとひと息). The donuts here, unlike at loose kyoto, are yeast-raised; the coffee is roasted in-house.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Leaf KYOTO: a shop where you can stop and breathe out.
chef_bio.specialty: Cream-filled yeast donuts with house-roasted coffee.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor meant to go to the solo-only café next door, could not get in, and liked the donuts here enough to look up the designer afterwards.
An October 2026 diner found the sausage donut too oily, though the townhouse felt like a secret base.
A July 2026 visitor found the upstairs nearly full an hour before Saturday closing, and the donuts filled with cream after ordering.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Leaf KYOTO (2023年6月): 兄弟で営む清水坂の人気コーヒースタンド［loose kyoto］の2号店、2023年5月13日オープン、連日開店前から行列、古民家の土壁や梁を活かした空間、「ふぅとひと息つけるような店に」との思いを店名に、イースト生地のふんわりもっちりした小ぶりのドーナツ、カスタードドーナツ350円、ラテ600円、自家焙煎のブレンドやシングルオリジン、2Fのカフェスペース、中京区竹屋町通油小路西入ル橋本町467-3、二条城前駅から徒歩7分、10:00〜17:00、不定休、全席禁煙。食べログ: カフェ、予約不可、カード可、10:00〜17:00。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ほうじ茶クリーム480円、抹茶クリーム480円、いちじくとあんこのマスカルポーネ540円、ドーナツドッグ580円、抹茶ラテ750円、ほうじ茶ラテ700円、アメリカーノ600円、1階で注文して2階で食べる、現金・カード・PayPay、隣はひとり客専用のカフェ。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter downstairs, then sit upstairs.

places.name: 逃現郷 (Togenkyo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Curry, omurice, Neapolitan spaghetti, a hamburg sandwich and cakes; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat curry, egg dishes and dairy desserts (reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No reservations. 21 seats: 7 at the counter and 14 at tables; smoking allowed at every seat, with ashtrays on the tables (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Power outlets at every seat and free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). 1 min walk from the Imadegawa-Omiya bus stop in Nishijin; 958 m from Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishijin, just north of Imadegawa-Omiya — 958 m from Imadegawa Stn
places.cuisine: Retro coffee house food until late: the house curry, generous and spicy, with a fried egg or other toppings (2025–2026 reviews) · omu-curry with pilaf ¥1,000 (November 2025); classic omurice with homemade pickles; Neapolitan spaghetti; a thick hamburg sandwich (2025–2026) · siphon coffee such as Brazil ¥600, a dark-roast blend ¥600, Mandheling and Bourbon Amarelo (2025–2026) · Mont Blanc, cheesecake, pudding, coffee jelly, a "petit dessert" of ice cream and cinnamon apples ¥650; Haruka juice, coffee cocktails (2025–2026)
places.notes: [Kissaten · Nishijin, a late-night escape] A dim, retro coffee house at Imadegawa-Omiya, open from noon to midnight, with jazz, shelves of CDs, wooden furniture and a bowl of medaka fish at the door. Locals and students come for the hearty house curry or omu-curry (about ¥1,000), siphon coffee and small cakes. Smoking is allowed at every seat — a deal-breaker for some. Cash only; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 8 July 2010 (Tabelog). A November 2025 reviewer describes soft lighting, a bowl of medaka at the entrance and a ryokan-style washroom with a note not to step on the moss; a July 2026 reviewer notes jazz and shelves of CDs.
chef_bio.specialty: House curry.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 guest came after drinks for a late curry with a fried egg, among young regulars at the smoking tables.
A March 2026 diner found the curry sauce so plentiful it outlasted the rice.
A June 2026 visitor nearly left on seeing the ashtrays, then stayed for siphon-brewed Bourbon Amarelo and a small chestnut Mont Blanc.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 逃現郷 (Togenkyo)、カフェ、上京区今出川通大宮上ル観世町127-1、市バス「今出川大宮」から徒歩1分、今出川駅から958m、12:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、木曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、21席 (カウンター7、テーブル14)、喫煙可、全席に電源と無料Wi-Fi、2010年7月8日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): オムカレー (ピラフ) 1,000円、スパイスの効いたカレーに目玉焼き、オムライスと自家製の漬物、ナポリタン、ハンバーグサンド、サイフォンのコーヒー (ブラジル600円、深煎りブレンド600円、マンデリン、Bourbon Amarelo)、モンブラン、チーズケーキ、プリン、コーヒーゼリー、プチデザート650円、ジャズとCDの棚、入口のメダカの鉢、全席喫煙可、学生や常連客、深夜11時まで開いている珍しい喫茶店。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; smoking at every seat.

places.name: スゥレッド カフェ (thread cafe)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Plates of multigrain rice, vegetable marinades, spreads, dumplings and soup, plus campagne sandwiches and toast; no gluten information (2022–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Some options: reviewers describe the lunch plate as vegan, with no animal protein, and soy-milk ice cream (2022–2025 reviews); Tabelog lists vegetarian options. A Camembert toast with honey and cheesecake are also served (2019; May 2022).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog lists Sunday and alternate Mondays 9:00–19:00; Thursday breakfast 8:30–11:00 and 14:30–18:00; Wednesday and Saturday lunch 12:00–14:30; and closed Tuesday, Friday, Sunday and alternate Mondays — the listing contradicts itself, so check Instagram for current days (Tabelog; June 2024). Reservations accepted, advised for lunch (Tabelog; 2022–2025 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 15 seats incl. a counter and a terrace; non-smoking; self-service water (Tabelog; October 2024). Down a narrow passage on the right of the building facing Ogawa Children's Park, in a former house; about 500 m from Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog; October 2024).
places.neighborhood: Kamidachiuri by Ogawa-dori, near Seimei Shrine — 7 min walk from Imadegawa Stn
places.cuisine: Hidden café of vegetable-led, mostly plant-based plates (Tabelog; 2022–2025 reviews) · lunch: multigrain rice and vegetarian plate ¥1,200 with herbal tea and soy-milk ice cream, the only lunch dish, small dumplings and many small vegetable dishes (2022–2024 reviews) · breakfast plate of salad, vegetable marinades, spreads, soup and yogurt; campagne sandwiches (June 2024) · Camembert toast with honey; chestnut cheesecake; dessert cakes; Earl Grey; craft beer (2019–2025 reviews) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Café · near Seimei Shrine, hidden courtyard] Found down a dark, narrow passage beside Ogawa Children's Park, a bright, plant-filled café in an old house serving one lunch — a vegan-leaning plate of multigrain rice and many small vegetable dishes, with herbal tea and soy-milk ice cream — and breakfast plates on some days. Days and hours shift; check Instagram and book for lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café with vegetarian options and breakfast. Reviewers describe a stylish, deliberately cluttered room with a small Jizo (April 2022), many vegan options (May 2022), healthy plates without animal protein (May 2025), limited hours posted on Instagram (June 2024), and a building that was once a private house (May 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Healthy, carefully made vegetable plates (2021–2025 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Multigrain rice and vegetarian plate.

anecdotes.text: An April 2022 visitor wandering from Seimei Shrine found the café down an alley and called it "stylishly chaotic".
An October 2024 guest explains the way in: the right side of the building opposite Ogawa Children's Park, then a narrow passage to the courtyard.
A May 2025 weekday lunch was fully booked; the guest paired the plate with a craft beer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、上京区上立売道小川東入ル西大路町58、今出川駅から494m、日曜と隔週月曜 9:00〜19:00、木曜 朝食8:30〜11:00・14:30〜18:00、水・土 ランチ12:00〜14:30、休み: 火・金・日・隔週月曜 (表記が食い違う)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、15席、カウンター、テラス、禁煙、野菜にこだわる、朝食、ベジタリアン対応。口コミ (2018年7月〜2025年5月、英語): 小川児童公園の前の建物の右の細い通路の奥、元民家、お地蔵さん、昼は雑穀ご飯とベジタリアンのプレート1,200円のみ (ハーブティー、豆乳アイス付き)、ヴィーガンのメニューが多い、動物性のたんぱく質なし、朝のプレート (サラダ、野菜のマリネ、スプレッド、スープ、ヨーグルト)、カンパーニュのサンド、カマンベールのトースト、栗のチーズケーキ、アールグレイ、クラフトビール、営業日は Instagram で、水はセルフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Hard to find; book lunch; check Instagram for days; cards, IC and QR.

positives: Lunch plate described as vegan, without animal protein (2023 and 2025 reviews); Tabelog lists vegetarian options.

places.notes: [Coffee · Mototanaka, a former art-school building] A calm specialty roastery in an old art-school building, with a Fuji Royal roaster by the door: hand-drip coffees from a nutty light Myanmar to a dark Mandheling, staff happy to talk beans, and small sweets — Basque cheesecake, pudding, an unusual white-miso lemon toast. Some find prices high. Open daily 12:00–18:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a coffee roastery and café in Tanaka, with beans and takeaway. Reviewers describe a renovated warehouse or former art-school classroom (January and December 2025–2026), staff who explain beans and roasting (May 2025), and one-person service at times (May 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Hand-drip single origins.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 coffee lover compared light and medium roasts of the same Yirgacheffe, and hoped to see the roaster running next time.
A February 2026 visitor after an exhibition at Kyoto University of the Arts found a friend's white-miso lemon toast the most interesting dish.
A December 2025 group found prices on the high side, and decided a latte had been the wrong choice at a hand-drip specialist.

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; staff explain beans; cards and PayPay.

places.neighborhood: Teramachi north of Imadegawa, by Demachi Masugata — 12 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn

places.notes: [Soba · Teramachi Imadegawa, by Demachi Masugata] A traditional-looking soba shop that has gone self-service: tablet ordering, a buzzer to collect and a Pepper robot by the door. Generous zaru soba, a duck zaru with a sharp, Kanto-style dip, tempura zaru and oroshi soba at old-fashioned prices. Busy at lunch. Closed Tuesday; Monday lunch only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a soba, donburi and udon shop on Teramachi north of Imadegawa. Reviewers in 2026 describe a historic exterior and a modern self-service system with tablets, buzzers and a Pepper robot (August–October 2026); an October 2026 regular returning after about twenty years was surprised by the change.
chef_bio.specialty: Kamo zaru soba.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, back after about twenty years, found the shop had become self-service.
An August 2026 visitor was surprised to find a Pepper robot inside the historic-looking shop.
An April 2026 guest noted the kamo zaru dip is Kanto-style — sharp soy, little sweetness — unlike most in Kansai.

cultural_comfort.note: Tablet ordering and buzzer pickup; sit anywhere; QR.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Courses of sashimi, conger eel, tempura, duck hot pot and clay-pot rice, seasoned with soy and dashi; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, conger eel, sweetfish, duck, oysters and meat courses (2026 reviews).

Reservations accepted; children under 5 in private rooms only (Tabelog). A 5% service charge, a private-room fee of ¥550 per person, and a New Year charge of ¥880 per person from 31 December to 4 January (Tabelog original サービス料５％、個室料550円（お一人様）、12月31日から1月４日までの正月期間は正月料金として昼夜ともにお一人様880円の正月料金をいただきます。). 50 seats at tatami tables with chairs; private rooms; a summer kawadoko deck over the Kamo River and second-floor window seats facing Higashiyama (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards and QR incl. PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). A 170-year-old machiya on Pontocho; 5 min walk from Sanjo or Kawaramachi stations (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, on the Kamo River — 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese courses, oysters and seafood in a 170-year-old Kyoto machiya (Tabelog) · summer kawadoko courses, e.g. ¥15,000, of sashimi, sweetfish, conger eel, tempura, meat and a hot pot, ending with eel clay-pot rice — leftovers made into onigiri to take home (July–August 2026) · duck hot pot course (August–October 2026) · à la carte extras such as matsutake dobin-mushi and steamed oysters (October 2026) · sake such as sparkling Dassai; red snapper or sanma mixed rice (August 2026) · lunch and dinner ¥10,000–15,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Japanese · Pontocho machiya, Kamo River deck] A 170-year-old Pontocho townhouse with private rooms, second-floor windows on Daimonji and a summer kawadoko deck over the Kamo River: seasonal courses of conger eel, sweetfish and sashimi, a duck hot pot, and clay-pot rice to finish. Warm, English-capable service. 5% service plus room fees; some find it pricey for the food. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: authentic Japanese meals in a 170-year-old Kyo-machiya on Pontocho, with private rooms and a riverside deck in summer; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 praise efficient, warm service, staff who speak English to overseas guests and take photos for celebrations.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Japanese meals in a 170-year-old machiya (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kawadoko course; duck hot pot.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 kawadoko booking met a thunderstorm; the pair dined by an indoor window over the Kamo River instead.
An August 2026 couple dining on the riverside deck for a birthday spotted a nutria in the river.
An October 2026 diner found the extra steamed oysters small and the value only middling, though the duck hot pot was good.

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff; book the deck in summer; 5% service and room fees; cards and QR.

places.notes: [Cake shop and tearoom · Nishinotoin Gojo, a 30-year neighbourhood favourite] A small, old-fashioned cake shop in a residential lane near Gojo, run by an elderly couple for over 30 years: moist shortcake, banana pound cake, a tea bavarois, eaten in the retro tearoom with coffee for a few hundred yen more. Open until 21:00, handy when everywhere else has shut. Smoking allowed. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a cake shop in business for over 30 years (July 2026), run by an elderly couple (April 2026), with a retro tearoom popular with local women (April 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Shortcake; banana pound cake.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor, a former neighbour, found the same cakes still on sale and the owner’s familiar face behind the counter.
A March 2026 visitor craving cake late in the day found most places closed and this one open until 21:00.
An April 2025 driver finally visited after decades of curiosity, glad of the parking in front.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled rice-dumpling mitarashi dango with black-sugar syrup and kinako; dorayaki contains wheat (2024–25 reviews); no ingredient list.

On Shichijo a minute west of Sanjusangendo — look for the mitarashi dango sign; 2 min from Keihan Shichijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shichijo by Sanjusangendo — 2 min from Shichijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto mitarashi dango grilled to order — five small dumplings on a skewer with a black-sugar syrup from Hateruma and plenty of kinako, the Kyoto style; take-away 5 for ¥500, 1 for ¥100; in-store sets with Uji tea or matcha (Tabelog, shop text; 2024–25 reviews) · homemade Japanese-style ice cream, dorayaki ice cream (Tabelog; May 2024) · Kyo-zenzai with grilled mochi ¥650 (November 2025) · kakigori in summer (July 2024)
places.notes: [Mitarashi dango · Shichijo by Sanjusangendo, grilled to order] A small dango shop a minute from Sanjusangendo, grilling Kyoto mitarashi dango over the fire, finished with black-sugar syrup and a snowfall of kinako — ¥100 a stick, or with Uji tea at the one big table. Zenzai in winter, kakigori in summer. Cash only; watch the kinako in the wind.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (shop text): Kyoto mitarashi dango with black-sugar syrup from Hateruma and kinako, freshly grilled and sold by the skewer, with Uji tea sets in store and homemade Japanese-style ice cream.
chef_bio.specialty: Mitarashi dango with kinako.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 passer-by from Chishaku-in, drawn in by the smell, ate the dango by the Kamo River and warned that wind blows the kinako about.
A July 2024 visitor found the kakigori a bargain next to prices elsewhere in Kyoto.
A November 2025 visitor warmed up with the Kyo-zenzai of grilled mochi.

Reservations accepted and advised in the evening (Tabelog; June 2026). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). 35 seats: a counter around the teppan, high tables by the entrance, sofa and table seats (Tabelog; June 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Ground floor of the 文椿ビルヂング on Sanjo west of Karasuma; 2 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog). The Tabelog address has no lot number.
places.neighborhood: Sanjo Karasuma, in the 文椿ビルヂング — 2 min from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Italian-leaning bar food with vegetables grilled on the teppan (June 2026) · the "Greedy Plate" lunch ¥1,300 — grilled chicken thigh with pink shibazuke tartar, a half oil pasta, roasted vegetables, salad, carrot or potato soup, focaccia and a drink (June–October 2026) · omurice and hamburg-steak plate lunch (August–September 2026) · a two-person lunch course with seasonal potage, four appetizers, grilled chicken or teppan hamburg steak (September 2026) · a big grilled-vegetable platter at dinner (August 2026) · homemade ginger ale, wine and cocktails (July 2026; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Teppan Italian · Sanjo Karasuma, vegetables off the griddle] A bar-bistro in the old 文椿ビルヂング on Sanjo with a counter around a teppan: the ¥1,300 "Greedy Plate" lunch of grilled chicken with shibazuke tartar, half pasta, roast vegetables, soup and a drink fills the room at noon, and evenings bring big platters of griddled vegetables with wine. One reviewer called the omurice the best of a lifetime. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bar, Italian and izakaya on the ground floor of the 文椿ビルヂング, with counter seats around a teppan. Reviews in 2026 describe a lunch crowd for the plate sets and vegetable-led dinners.
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan-grilled vegetables; Greedy Plate lunch.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor came two days running for the Greedy Plate, hooked on the pink shibazuke tartar on the chicken.
A September 2026 lunch guest called the omurice the best of a lifetime.
A July 2026 diner discovered the soup was carrot, not corn, and liked the spicy homemade ginger ale.

Handy for groups and business dinners; smoking allowed in the rooms. One October 2026 diner found the food ordinary and a rice dish clearly pre-cooked.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a private-room izakaya with regional cooking and seafood, opened 8 August 2024. An October 2026 review calls it a collaboration of Kyoto and Niigata and says it was chosen for Tabelog’s Hot Restaurants 2026. Tabelog also lists 全席個室 はんなり邸 八重洲店 in Tokyo; the operator is not named in the sources found.
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh yuba sashimi; hegi soba.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 group of business travellers from Tokyo chose it for being smart and close to the Shinkansen exit, and finished with hegi soba.
A November 2026 diner found a private-room date with night views a minute from the Hachijo exit.
An October 2026 diner found nothing especially tasty and the uni-and-ikura rice served within ten minutes, seemingly pre-cooked.

UnionPay) and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay); no e-money. Opened 25 September 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Mibu, near Mibu-dera — 8 min walk from Shijo-Omiya / Hankyu Omiya Stns
places.cuisine: A small neighbourhood trattoria with house-made pasta and Italian wines (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · signature hand-rolled tagliatelle Bolognese; a cutlet of sweet Kyoto pork (Tabelog) · generous meat and vegetable antipasti platters; carpaccio; Insalata Russa with herbs and anchovies; shine-muscat with mozzarella and yogurt (2025–2026 reviews) · pasta: linguine vongole bianco, shrimp-cream tagliatelle, tagliolini with lemon cream, penne gorgonzola, lasagna; lamb meatballs with porcini; sautéed swordfish (2025–2026 reviews) · lunch "Pranzo" sets with an appetizer plate and focaccia, about ¥1,500 (2025)
places.notes: [Italian · Mibu, house-made pasta near Mibu-dera] A ten-year-old 16-seat trattoria in the backstreets near Mibu-dera, booked up by locals for heaped antipasti platters, hand-rolled tagliatelle Bolognese, a Kyoto-pork cutlet and a chef-picked bottle of Italian wine; lunch sets on some days. Gentle seasoning; good value. Book. Closed Wednesday and Sunday.

roles: Chef-owner, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Opened 25 September 2016 (Tabelog); a regular marked its tenth anniversary in September 2026 (June 2026 review). Reviewers describe a warm wooden room, an independent owner-chef, a family-run feel (September 2025), and nights handled smoothly by a single staff member (February 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Hand-rolled tagliatelle Bolognese.

anecdotes.text: February 2026: "I usually find Italian restaurants to be too salty or garlicky, but this place had such a gentle taste… they happened to be operating with just one staff member… everything was handled smoothly."
June 2026: "It's a popular spot, and it's quite difficult to get in without a reservation."

places.name: カタパン屋 (Kata Pan Ya)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-dough griddle breads (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the sankaku is filled with a custard-like cream; the dough is pancake-like (2023–2026 reviews). The kata-pan is said to use no butter (March 2026), but its other ingredients are not stated.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 10:00–16:00, until sold out; closed Sunday. One reviewer found it closed on several tries (May 2026); queues at times (October 2026). Take-away only, with three chairs for waiting. No photos or video inside, for safety (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 1 min from the Kawaramachi-Hachijo bus stop, 8 min walk from Kyoto Station; near teamLab Kyoto (2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Higashikujo — 8 min walk south-east of Kyoto Station, near teamLab Kyoto
places.cuisine: A tiny, old griddle-bread shop in Higashikujo making just three things, baked on a teppan in front of you (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews) · maru-pan, a round, soft, pancake-like bread ¥170; sankaku, a triangle oozing warm custard-like cream ¥170; kata-pan, a rock-hard square that keeps for months ¥180 (December 2023 prices) · kata-pan sold in packs of five (October 2026)
places.notes: [Old-time bakery · Higashikujo, three breads off the griddle] A tiny family shop near Kyoto Station and teamLab that bakes only three things on an iron griddle as you wait — a soft round maru-pan, a cream-filled sankaku and a rock-hard kata-pan that keeps for months — each under ¥200. Until sold out; sometimes shut. No photos inside. Cash only. Closed Sunday.

roles: Not named in a source; run by a couple and their daughter (January 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: A January 2026 reviewer calls it the long-established Kata Pan Ya Kamei Shoten, "said to have been around since the Edo period," with a Showa-retro shopfront; another describes a family shop run by a couple and their daughter (January 2026), and a third an elderly couple (January 2026). Bread is baked to order on a traditional teppan; the kata-pan is made ahead (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Kata-pan (hard bread); sankaku.

anecdotes.text: March 2026: outside the shop a truck driver called out "It's delicious here!", broke open a bag and shared some, then drove off.
May 2026: "Every time I tried to go, it was closed, so I could never buy anything. But on this day, it was open!"

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sets come with dashi-based dishes, sashimi or meat; the steamed vegetables are the closest option — ask (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–22:00; the store page gives last order 21:15, and closing days follow JR Kyoto Isetan. Reservations taken. 56 seats (store page); private rooms. Non-smoking; children welcome. Cards, e-money and QR. Average spend about ¥1,900 at lunch and ¥2,500 at dinner (store page). On JR Kyoto Isetan's 11th-floor restaurant floor, just outside the station's central gate; often a seat without a wait (2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station — JR Kyoto Isetan 11F, by the central gate
places.cuisine: Seiro-steamed Kyoto vegetables with meat or fish, kept hot at the table, in set meals (store page; 2026 reviews) · meat seiro of Bichu Kogen chicken and Satsuma Chami pork over vegetables ¥1,540 with ponzu and sesame sauce (June 2026) · "Tachibana" steamed-vegetable gozen with obanzai, sashimi, seasonal mixed rice and miso soup (September–October 2026) · a summer hamo course ¥3,520: hamo tempura, hamo in broth, chilled soba with grilled hamo, rice with shirasu and sansho (August 2026) · seasonal clam or chestnut rice; Kyoto sake such as Jurakudai ¥803 (June 2026)
places.notes: [Steamed Kyoto vegetables · Kyoto Station Isetan 11F, a light set meal] A calm restaurant on JR Kyoto Isetan's 11th floor where Kyoto vegetables with chicken, pork or fish come steaming in a bamboo seiro at the table, with ponzu and sesame sauce, rice and obanzai — a light meal off the train at about ¥1,500–3,500, often without a queue. One diner found the rice mushy (June 2026), another some dishes salty (August 2026).

chef_bio.background: The Isetan store page describes table-top seiro steaming and set meals of Kyoto-grown vegetables with meat and seafood, 56 seats. Reviewers in 2026 describe a quiet, Japanese-style room that is easier to get into than its neighbours, attentive staff, seasonal rice and many older guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Seiro-steamed Kyoto vegetables.

anecdotes.text: June 2026: "The steamed vegetables were plentiful… The rice was a bit mushy, but overall, it was delicious."
August 2026: "Some dishes were saltier than I expected, but overall, I had a delightful and visually pleasing lunch."

chef_bio.background: Per its site, a shop at the foot of Kiyomizu-dera serving handmade sweets and house-roasted coffee "between moments of travel"; the same site lists sister shops by Ginkaku-ji — 銀閣寺 まつばや, 銀閣寺 京阿弥, 銀閣寺 御米司ふみや and 銀閣寺 kiharu. chef_bio.specialty: Yatsuhashi cream puff.

July 2026: "They fill the choux pastry with matcha cream right on the spot, and the pastry has a hint of cinnamon."

places.notes: [Plated desserts · near Kawaramachi-Imadegawa, dessert courses and parfaits] A seven-seat counter with antique fittings and dried flowers where the owner, who has a French cooking background, assembles seasonal dessert courses and parfaits in front of you — vegetables, miso and herbs alongside the fruit. Reservation only through TableCheck, and slots go fast.

chef_bio.background: An April 2025 reviewer says the owner has French culinary experience and pairs seasonal fruit with vegetables and other ingredients. An April 2026 visitor found one woman, the owner, running the shop alone.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 guest came back the very next day because the cherry-and-chocolate parfait had been too good.
A July 2025 visitor who found a free slot arrived early and watched a queue form before opening.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Coffee, green tea, matcha, shiso juice and homemade ume juice are plant-based; the toast comes with butter and the New Year zoni with bonito flakes (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:30–18:00; closed Sunday (official site; Tabelog); some exhibitions open on a Sunday (official site, June 2026). No reservations (Tabelog), though a table for a family with children can be booked by phone (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and QR payments (Tabelog). 11 seats: 5 in the coffee room, 6 in the tatami room; all seating is Japanese-style, shoes off, with floor chairs on request (Tabelog; April 2025). Children welcome — no order needed for a child; milk and baby food may be brought in (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley about 5 min from the Horikawa-Nakadachiuri bus stop (Tabelog). Opened 1 December 2018 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: A café and gallery in a Meiji-era townhouse that was once a kimono dyeing and cleaning shop, with a small garden and tatami rooms (April 2025) · hand-drip coffee ¥600 and anko toast ¥350 (January 2025); butter toast ¥250, drinks from ¥650, homemade ume juice with soda (September 2025) · matcha latte ¥650 (March 2025); green tea in a glass pot, nerikiri, anko-butter toast (January 2025); usucha with the day’s wagashi (October 2025) · New Year white-miso zoni ¥700 and a hanabira-mochi set ¥1,300 (January 2026) · cakes from OHAYO biscuit nearby may be brought in with a drink (2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Café and gallery · Goshonishi, an old townhouse down an alley] A quiet tatami café at the end of a narrow alley west of the Imperial Palace, in a Meiji-era townhouse with a small garden and changing craft exhibitions. Coffee, matcha and green tea with anko toast or the day’s wagashi, and you may bring cakes from OHAYO biscuit nearby. Shoes off; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: The official site calls it a café and gallery west of the Imperial Palace. An April 2025 reviewer describes a Meiji-era townhouse once used as a kimono dyeing and cleaning shop, with an alcove, antiques and works by Kyoto-linked artists for sale; the owner took orders (April 2025) and shared banana chips from a friend’s antique shop (September 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Anko toast; green tea and matcha.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 visitor called the glass-pot green tea the best tea of a lifetime.
An April 2025 guest, sent down the street by the staff at OHAYO biscuit, almost missed the noren-hung entrance.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a pasta restaurant — wheat pasta with bread and salad at lunch, pizza at dinner (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Two to four pastas a day, mostly oil- or tomato-based; most described pastas have bacon, sausage, fish or cheese, and nothing is described as vegan (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 (L.O. 14:00); dinner 18:00–21:30 (L.O. food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Tuesday and public holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR payments (Tabelog). 18 seats: 6 at the counter, 12 at tables (Tabelog). On the west side of Senbon-Oshikoji, under 10 min north of Nijo Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Senbon-Oshikoji — under 10 min north of Nijo Stn
places.cuisine: A neighbourhood pasta and Italian restaurant — once a thick-noodle pasta shop, Italian under a new chef for more than ten years (October 2026) · lunch sets of the day’s pasta with salad and bread, about ¥1,000 (June 2026); special pasta lunch with a soufflé omelette ¥1,300, large +¥300 (October 2026) · pastas such as amatriciana (March 2026), carbonara and tomato cream (February 2025), bacon and spring cabbage in butter-cheese sauce (May 2025), shirasu and oil sardine (October 2026) · famous fluffy cheese omelette in a cocotte ¥780 (October 2026) · grilled meat of the day, such as venison or Iberico pork (October 2026) · small dinner course with salad, omelette, pasta and pizza (October 2024)
places.notes: [Pasta · north of Nijo Station, the fluffy cheese omelette] A casual local Italian a short walk north of Nijo Station: a few pastas of the day served as a cheap lunch set with salad and bread, a much-loved soufflé-style cheese omelette baked in a cocotte, and grilled meats at night. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A longtime regular (October 2026) remembers Menya opening as a pasta shop with homemade thick noodles; the name stayed, the chef changed, and it has been an Italian restaurant for more than ten years. A March 2025 regular calls the manager handsome, polite and friendly, and thanks at the register despite the rush.
chef_bio.specialty: Pasta of the day; soufflé cheese omelette.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 regular who skips the salad sometimes gets a little extra pasta instead.
An October 2026 regular never orders pasta when alone — just the omelette and the meat of the day.

Children welcome, counter only (Tabelog). About 7 min on foot from JR Tambaguchi Station (Tabelog). Opened 12 September 2024 (Tabelog).

places.notes: [Tonkatsu · near Tambaguchi, a five-seat counter] A tiny counter, the Kyoto branch of a Shiga tonkatsu shop, frying tender, low-temperature pork cutlets — loin, tenderloin, rib roast and a much-loved Spencer roll — as ¥2,200–2,680 sets with free rice and cabbage, pork-miso soup and a yuzu sorbet. Book ahead; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers call it a branch of a famous Shiga restaurant (July 2026) and of what one thought the best tonkatsu in Otsu (January 2026); Tabelog’s name search lists Taku shops at Shiyakushomae, Kyoto Gojo and Seta. An August 2025 regular praises the service of the owner and the owner’s wife; an October 2026 regular says the chef remembers past conversations.
chef_bio.specialty: Spencer roll; loin and tenderloin cutlets.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular who had once mentioned loving tamago kake gohan found the chef still remembered it.
An October 2025 diner asked for a third cabbage refill and got it without hesitation.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: hand-made wheat udon in dashi, tempura, kara-age and creative udon dishes (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based udon, mentaiko, bacon, eggs and fried chicken (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Sunday, and on Monday after a long holiday; may close early when the noodles run out (Tabelog). No lunch reservations; dinner bookings by phone (Tabelog). Weekday daily lunch only — none on Saturday (July 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge or additional fees (Tabelog). 18 seats: 8 at tables and 10 in a tatami room; private hire up to 20; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking; English menu (Tabelog). places.neighborhood: Shijo-Omiya — 135 m from Hankyu Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Hand-made udon and a creative udon izakaya with Italian touches (Tabelog) · weekday daily lunch ¥1,030 with udon (150 g, 300 g or 450 g at the same price), rice, pickles, two small sides and a main such as fried mackerel (April 2026) · chicken tempura bukkake udon ¥1,180 (July 2026); udon with mentaiko sauce and fluffy omelette; Rurio Bomb Udon, tomato-based with bacon; carbonara udon; shrimp, scallop and new-onion udon in plum olive oil (2025–2026) · izakaya plates: potato salad, kara-age, sautéed scallops and mushrooms, fried mochi with mentaiko and cheese, cheese rice croquettes, tomato-braised tripe (2025–2026) · about 60 umeshu from Kyoto and across Japan (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Udon · Shijo-Omiya, creative udon izakaya] A quiet udon house a block from Hankyu Omiya, where a cook with an Italian background pulls firm, chewy noodles by hand. At lunch the weekday set (about ¥1,000) lets you pick 150, 300 or 450 g of udon for the same price; the menu runs from classic dashi udon to a tomato-and-bacon Bomb Udon and carbonara udon. At night it is an izakaya with about 60 umeshu. Cash only; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef not named; described as an Italian chef (April 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: homemade noodles in classic dashi udon alongside dishes that break the mould with Italian flavours, and about 60 umeshu from Kyoto and across Japan. An April 2026 reviewer says the place is run by an Italian chef; a June 2024 Retty reviewer says the owner used to run an Italian izakaya.
chef_bio.specialty: Hand-made udon, classic and creative.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular took the ¥1,030 daily lunch with thick fried mackerel and wished afterwards for the 300 g udon.
A November 2025 diner found the udon firmer than soft Kyoto-style udon, with a free upgrade to a large portion.
A July 2026 Saturday-night diner liked the light carbonara udon but found the tomato-braised tripe too pungent.

places.name: DAVADA COFFEE&RECORDS
places.gf_detail: Ask. Espresso drinks, drip coffee, tea and juice, with canelés, scones and other baked sweets; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Soy milk is offered for coffee drinks (official site); the baked sweets are not described.
places.hours_raw: 11:00–19:00; the shop’s own site says closed Friday, Tabelog lists every day — check before a Friday visit (official site; Tabelog). No reservations. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB), transport IC, iD, QUICPay and d Barai (Tabelog). 10 seats, including 4 smoking seats on the terrace; counter seats by the window (Tabelog; October 2025). Takeout. Records and CDs for sale; the shop also buys records, CDs and instruments (official site). At Shichijo-Kawaramachi, 5 min walk from Keihan Shichijo Stn and 10 min from JR Kyoto Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Shichijo-Kawaramachi — 5 min walk from Keihan Shichijo Stn
places.cuisine: Specialty coffee in a record shop (official site) · single-origin drip, espresso, latte, cappuccino ¥580 (April 2025), Americano, macchiato, cafe mocha, cold brew, matcha latte, hot chocolate, lemonade, juice, beer; soy milk (official site) · canelé ¥390 and chocolate-chip scone ¥390 (August 2025)
places.notes: [Café · Shichijo-Kawaramachi, coffee and records] A small, Brooklyn-style coffee bar lined with records and CDs between Kyoto Station and the Kamo River, with "music & coffee is the healing force" on the wall. Coffee is brewed carefully to order — a cappuccino is about ¥580 — with a crisp canelé or a scone, at the window counter or to go. Popular with foreign visitors. 11:00–19:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a specialty coffee and record shop opened at Shichijo-Kawaramachi on 7 November 2019; it sells and buys records and CDs (rock, indie, jazz, soul, Brazilian, electronica, hip hop, reggae and more) and buys instruments and music gear.
chef_bio.philosophy: A wall in the shop reads "music & coffee is the healing force" (October 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Specialty coffee with records.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 passer-by found every seat taken by foreign visitors and left with a cappuccino brewed carefully to order.
A January 2026 regular always orders the light roast, and was the only customer that day.
A January 2025 traveller killing time before the Shinkansen liked the matcha latte, hot chocolate and canelé.

Non-smoking. Takeout downstairs; claim a seat in the high-ceilinged upstairs café first, then order at the register — a buzzer calls you to collect; two seats downstairs; no strollers upstairs (Tabelog; September 2026). On Takoyakushi-dori east of Yanaginobamba, 460 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takoyakushi-Yanaginobamba, near Nishiki Market — 460 m from Karasuma Stn
places.cuisine: Machiya bakery café with drinks from 8 a.m.; dough made with spent malt from craft-beer brewing (macaroni; reviews) · salt bread with fermented butter, the most popular; domestic fermented-butter croissant ¥294; mentaiko French bread; croque monsieur; cinnamon roll; salmon tartine; apple custard bread; bacon épi with shiso; cashew-nut melon bread ¥325; beef-tendon curry bread ¥407; mushroom focaccia ¥479 (2026 reviews) · weekday breakfast: add a drink and soup for ¥800 (August 2026) · Basque cheesecake ¥800, Americano ¥600, chai, apple juice ¥500; Nishinari craft beer ¥1,250, craft gin soda ¥700 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Bakery café · Takoyakushi near Nishiki, bread and craft beer] A bright, renovated machiya bakery run by a craft brewery from Osaka's Nishinari, folding spent brewing malt into its dough. The warm fermented-butter salt bread is the hit; breads run about ¥300–500, and from 8 a.m. you can add soup and a drink. Take a seat upstairs under the high ceiling with coffee, chai or a Nishinari craft beer. Busy, often with visitors.

roles: Run by a Nishinari (Osaka) craft-beer brewery (August 2026 review); people not named
chef_bio.background: Opened 29 October 2024 (Tabelog). Per macaroni (March 2025): a bakery café whose main feature is bread dough made with 麦芽粕 (spent malt), a by-product of craft-beer brewing; the second floor is a café space with an open ceiling. Reviewers (June and August 2026) say it is run by a craft brewery from Nishinari, Osaka, and pours its beer.
chef_bio.specialty: Fermented-butter salt bread.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 repeat visitor paired a mushroom focaccia with a ¥1,250 Nishinari craft beer and winced at the beer price.
A September 2026 visitor found it cramped and noisy at 2 p.m. and the breads small for the price, though the salt bread was good.
An August 2026 breakfast guest had a crisp fermented-butter croissant with the ¥800 morning set of tartine, corn soup and iced tea.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: macaroni (2025年3月更新): OUI. (ウイ)、2024年オープンのベーカリーカフェ、クラフトビールの醸造過程で生まれる副産物「麦芽粕」をパン生地に活用、食事パン・甘いパン・惣菜パン、2階は吹き抜けのカフェスペース。食べログ: パン・カフェ、中京区蛸薬師通柳馬場東入油屋町121-1、烏丸駅から460m、月〜木 8:00〜18:00、金〜日 8:00〜19:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙、2024年10月29日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 西成のクラフトビール醸造所が営む、京町家を改装、1階で販売・2階でイートイン、塩パン、発酵バターのクロワッサン294円、明太フランス、クロックムッシュ、シナモンロール、サーモンのタルティーヌ、カシューナッツのメロンパン325円、牛すじカレーパン407円、きのこのフォカッチャ479円、モーニングセット800円、バスクチーズケーキ800円、西成のクラフトビール1,250円、平日のみの朝食セット、外国人客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-service: claim a seat upstairs, order downstairs.

places.name: みなとや幽霊子育飴本舗 (Minatoya Yurei Kosodate Ame Honpo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. One hard candy made from malt syrup and sugar; one reviewer read the label as malt sugar from sweet potato and corn, but no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A candy of malt syrup and granulated sugar, and loose Uji tea; ingredients beyond that are not published (reviews; official site).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–16:00, every day of the year; open later during Rokudo Mairi (Tabelog); may close for sudden events (official site, January 2026). Takeaway only — a small counter shop with no seating. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). The small 75 g bag often sells out early; ask the shop to hold one (official site). On Matsubara-dori east of Yamato-oji, at Rokudo no Tsuji, 2 min walk from Rokuharamitsu-ji, 10 min from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Rokuhara, at Rokudo no Tsuji — 2 min walk from Rokuharamitsu-ji
places.cuisine: A single candy with a ghost story: 幽霊子育飴, hard amber malt-syrup candy, broken into rough pieces, gently sweet (official site; reviews) · from 1 October 2026: 150 g bag ¥700, 75 g bag ¥400 (official site) · loose Uji tea — gyokuro 40 g, sencha 70 g, hojicha 150 g, matcha 20 g — ¥800 each from 1 October 2026 (official site)
places.notes: [Candy shop · Rokuhara, by Rokuharamitsu-ji] A tiny shop that sells one thing: amber malt-syrup candy, broken by hand, tied to a 1599 legend of a dead mother whose ghost came nightly to buy candy for the baby born in the grave. The shop calls itself Japan's oldest candy maker, over 450 years old. A bag is ¥700 (¥400 small), with Uji teas beside it — a gentle sweetness and a story to take home. Open daily 10:00–16:00; cash only.

roles: Family shop, people not named (official site signs as みなとや一同)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Japan’s longest-established candy shop, over 450 years old; the legend: in Keicho 4 (1599) a wife of the 江村 family was buried, and days later a baby’s cry was heard from the grave — the child of the dead wife; a woman had come every night to buy candy and stopped once the child was dug out; the child became a monk at eight and a renowned priest, dying at 68 in 1666; the candy came to be called the ghost’s child-rearing candy. The shop has supplied its candy to はぐくみハッピーギフト, a Higashiyama ward gift for new parents, and received a letter of thanks (official site, March 2021). Candy and tea are made by hand (official site, September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to keep passing on the story of “the candy that carried a life”.
chef_bio.specialty: Yurei kosodate ame.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 first-timer was told by the staff that the ghost first came 426 years ago.
A December 2025 regular notes the legend is said to have inspired GeGeGe no Kitaro.
A September 2025 visitor bought a bag as a gift for a couple expecting a baby.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kosodateame.com): みなとや幽霊子育飴本舗、500年以上続く日本一歴史ある飴屋 (由来のページでは450年以上)、命をつないだ飴の由来 (慶長四年、江村氏の妻を葬った後、土中から幼児の泣き声、夜な夜な飴を買いに来た婦人、その子は八才で僧となり高名な僧に、寛文六年に六十八歳で遷化)、店頭販売は幽霊子育飴と宇治茶、2026年10月1日から子育飴150g 700円・75g 400円、宇治茶 (玉露40g、煎茶70g、ほうじ茶150g、抹茶20g) 一律800円、75gは早い時間に品切れの場合あり・取り置き可、手づくりで製造・販売、年中無休 10:00〜16:00、急な予定で休業あり、東山区松原通大和大路東入2丁目轆轤町80番地の1、六波羅蜜寺から徒歩2分、清水五条駅から徒歩10分、東山区の「はぐくみハッピーギフト」に子育飴、感謝状 (2021年)。食べログ: 和菓子、10:00〜16:00、六道まいりの期間は延長、年中無休、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙、テイクアウト。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 琥珀色の硬い飴、麦芽水飴の素朴な甘さ、水飴とグラニュー糖だけ、試食あり、ゲゲゲの鬼太郎のもとになったという話、六道の辻、宇治茶も販売。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway counter; cash only.

places.name: 酒と旬 五郎 (Sake to Shun Goro)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura is a house specialty; soy-seasoned izakaya dishes (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish restaurant — sashimi, grilled fish and shellfish, chawanmushi (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 18:00–24:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Bookings taken, and reviewers say they are a must; a July 2026 first-timer saw a line of booked guests before opening (Tabelog; February and July 2026 reviews). Table charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「お通し代あり、たぶん500円」 — an otoshi charge, "probably ¥500"; one reviewer's otoshi was a fish head, another's included nigiri (December 2025, March 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a long counter of 10 and 10 at tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog; July 2026 review). JIN四条大宮 1F, in an alley 4 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog; May 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Omiya — 4 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal fish and sake (Tabelog): a 12-kind sashimi platter to book ahead — sawara, ama-ebi, bluefin tuna, sea bream, horse mackerel and more; bluefin toro with sweet shrimp and squid in fresh uni, wrapped in nori; grilled sweet shrimp; grilled oysters; kinmedai collar; chawanmushi with crab miso, uni, ikura, shirako and oysters; tempura fried a piece at a time; simmered bamboo shoots; a handwritten menu; selected sake (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Fish & sake izakaya · Shijo-Omiya] A busy alley izakaya opened in 2023, loved by regulars for very fresh fish: a 12-kind sashimi platter (order it when you book), grilled sweet shrimp, a loaded chawanmushi and tempura one piece at a time, with chosen sake. About ¥5,000–8,000. Book ahead; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Opened 26 February 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; seasonal fish with sake.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular booked the 12-kind sashimi platter for two friends, who were left speechless when it arrived.
In March 2026 a regular hoped to have tempura, but it was not on the menu that night.
A July 2026 first-timer saw booked guests lining up before opening; the food came out slowly, timed to each course.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: gyoza, ramen and tantanmen, fried chicken with soy-based sauces (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fried chicken, chashu, shrimp and egg fried rice, meat gyoza (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00; irregular closures (Tabelog). No bookings (Tabelog). A counter in the Kyoto Tower Sando food court, B1F: pay at the register or order by mobile from your table, then wait for the buzzer; shared food-court seating (9 seats listed) (Tabelog; July–November 2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). 2 min from Kyoto Stn central exit (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station — Kyoto Tower Sando B1F food court
places.cuisine: Casual Chinese and Taiwanese supervised by the 一之船入 chef (Tabelog; 2026 reviews): five-ingredient fried rice with soup (¥818, August 2026), Yangzhou fried rice, yurinchi fried chicken (¥1,000) and its set with takana and sesame dumplings, garlic-soy fried chicken set with a drink (¥1,500), tantanmen set with rice, pickles and sesame dumplings, chashu ramen and gyoza set (about ¥1,500), gyoza (2 servings ¥1,500), a quick-drink set of gyoza and beer (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Chinese food-court counter · Kyoto Tower Sando] A quick Chinese counter under Kyoto Tower from the group behind 創作中華 一之船入 and 魏飯夷堂: big yurinchi fried chicken, tantanmen and fried-rice sets, gyoza and beer, mostly ¥1,000–1,500. Order at the counter or on your phone, then find a food-court seat. Open daily till 23:00.

roles: Food-court counter of the 一之船入 group; menu supervised by the group's chef
chef_bio.background: Opened 14 April 2017 (Tabelog). The Tabelog shop text calls it the sister restaurant of 魏飯夷堂, opened in the Kyoto Tower Sando food court, with dishes supervised by Chef Wei Xizhi (Tabelog English); an August 2026 regular credits the chefs of 一之船入. A November 2026 diner noted the kitchen staff seemed to be from outside China.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Chinese with fine ingredients, made easy to try (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Yurinchi fried chicken; fried rice.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular orders the five-ingredient fried rice here with grilled gyoza from a neighbouring counter, calling it the best fried rice ever.
A July 2026 diner came after trying the gyoza at the Sanjo sister shop.
An October 2026 diner found the five-flavor fried rice bland and the draft beer poor, among mostly overseas guests.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 魏飯吉堂 京都タワーサンド店、中華料理・台湾料理、下京区烏丸通七条下ル東塩小路町721-1 KYOTO TOWER SANDO B1F、毎日 11:00〜23:00、不定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、9席、禁煙、2017年4月14日オープン、魏飯夷堂の姉妹店として京都タワーサンドのフードコートに開店、魏禧之シェフの監修。口コミ (2026年7〜11月、英語): 一之船入のシェフたちによる気軽な中華、五目炒飯とスープ818円、揚州炒飯、油淋鶏1,000円とそのセット、ニンニク醤油の唐揚げのセット1,500円、担々麺のセット、チャーシュー麺と餃子のセット約1,500円、餃子2人前1,500円、ちょい飲みセット、レジで支払いブザーで受け取り、テーブルからモバイル注文、三条の姉妹店、海外の客が多い、炒飯の味が薄いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Food-court counter with picture menu and mobile ordering.
