places.name: 進々堂 京大北門前 (Shinshindo Kyodai Kitamonmae)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bakery café — rolls, sandwiches, toast, cream puffs and curry (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg sandwiches, meat curry, cakes and coffee with milk (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). rurubu also lists 10:00–18:00, closed Tuesday. Order at the counter, then sit (May 2026 review). No bookings; cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No photos inside: signs on the door and in the room (Tabelog; November 2025–August 2026 reviews). 100 seats at long wooden tables, with tables kept for students and a student discount on coffee with a university ID (November 2025 and February 2026 reviews; a May 2026 diner was told the discount needs the whole party to be university students). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Facing Kyoto University's north gate; 10 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto University north gate, Kitashirakawa — 10 min from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Old-style bakery café (Tabelog; serai.jp): one house blend coffee served with a sugar cube, French bread and soft French rolls from the founding recipe, butter toast, ham toast, egg and mixed sandwiches, roll-bread brunch set, homemade curry rice set with coffee or tea and a small salad (¥950, May 2026), cake sets with cream puffs, pancakes (serai.jp; 2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [1930 student café · Kyoto University north gate] Kyoto's "second university library": a Paris-inspired café opened in 1930, with massive wooden tables by the craftsman Kuroda Tatsuaki, a courtyard, and students reading over a single blend coffee, curry or a sandwich. About ¥1,000. Cash only; no photos inside; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in 1930 as a French-style café by the bakery 進々堂, which began in 1913 and was the first in Kyoto to sell French bread; the founder, 続木斉, had studied bread-making in Paris and modelled the café on those in the Latin Quarter, hoping Japanese students would also learn Western esprit (serai.jp). The long one-piece tables and benches were commissioned from the woodworker 黒田辰秋 so many students could sit at once (serai.jp; rurubu; November 2025 review). The fourth-generation proprietor 川口聡 says the café's atmosphere stays the same because of the founding ideals (serai.jp, undated). Operator: rurubu says the café is now a separate corporation from the 進々堂 bakery, and the bakery's own shop list does not include it; 2026 reviewers still call it a branch of the Kyoto bakery chain (May and September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "The air of the shop stays the same even as the times and the town change, because of the founding ideals" (川口聡, serai.jp).
chef_bio.specialty: Blend coffee; curry rice set; sandwiches.

anecdotes.text: In October 2025 a visitor returned after about 50 years, reading a maths and physics book bought at a nearby bookshop over black coffee.
A November 2025 visitor on the way to Ginkaku-ji found the sandwiches sold out, took the roll-bread brunch set, and found the staff's indifference very Kyoto.
A November 2025 visitor was told that lingering was not allowed before noon, and felt the many notices spoiled the calm.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 進々堂 京大北門前、カフェ・パン・サンドイッチ、左京区北白川追分町88、出町柳駅から徒歩10分、月・水〜日 10:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:30)、火曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、100席、禁煙、テイクアウト可、店内撮影禁止の掲示。るるぶ: 京都発祥のベーカリー「進々堂」が昭和5年 (1930) に開いたカフェ、現在はベーカリー進々堂とは別法人、「京大第二の図書室」、パリのカフェを手本にした店構え、黒田辰秋の机、ミックスサンドイッチ、カレーライスセット、ブレンドコーヒー。serai.jp: 大正2年にパン屋として始まり京都で初めてフランスパンを提供、昭和5年にフランス風カフェを開店、創業者・続木斉がパリのカルチエ・ラタンのカフェを手本に、黒田辰秋の一枚板の大机と長椅子、4代目の川口聡さん、ブレンド一本のコーヒー、フランスパンとフレンチロール、バタートースト、ハムトースト、自家製カレーライスセット。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年9月、英語): 角砂糖のコーヒー、シュークリームのケーキセット、ロールパンのブランチセット、卵サンド、カレーライスセット950円、パンケーキ、学生用の勉強席、学生証で割引、中庭、注文してから席へ、京都のベーカリーの支店とする声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; cash only; no photos inside.

places.name: ITALIAN QUATRO 京都駅前店 (Italian Quatro, Kyoto Ekimae)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fresh pasta, pizza, gnocchi gratin and cheese tortillas (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Arrabbiata and salads are on the menu, but most dishes have cheese, ham or seafood (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); irregular closures (Tabelog). Bookings taken, lunch included, even on Sundays; fully booked on a holiday lunch (Tabelog; September and October 2026 reviews). Charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「アミューズ料金として380円を頂戴いたします。」 — a ¥380 amuse charge. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 75 seats with counter, sofas and semi-private tables; private rooms for 2 or 4; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Order by QR code (November 2026 review). Shin-Kyoto Center Bldg 1F, 5 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station north (Karasuma side) — 5 min from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: Italian bar-restaurant (Tabelog): pasta made to order — carbonara with snowy parmesan, shirasu, arrabbiata, octopus puttanesca linguine, walnut-and-mozzarella cacio e pepe tagliolini — paella, meat dishes, Diavola pizza with jalapeños, Margherita, gnocchi gratin, Caesar salad with roast beef, mixed antipasti on a large plate; "Quattro Lunch" of appetizers, cheese tortilla, pasta, main, dessert and drink from ¥2,288; lunch sets from about ¥1,000; soft drinks ¥300; wine, cocktails and an all-you-can-drink plan (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian bar · Kyoto Station] A roomy, relaxed Italian a few minutes from Kyoto Station that takes lunch bookings: fresh pasta, paella, pizza and a big antipasti plate, with lunch sets from about ¥1,000 and dinner around ¥4,000–5,000 with an all-you-can-drink option. ¥380 amuse charge.

roles: Restaurant of バル・コーポレーション (Kyoto) (no person named)

anecdotes.text: Two friends ate antipasti, pasta and dessert in August 2026 before an evening bus tour from Kyoto.
An October 2026 diner booked a Sunday lunch, though the pre-ordered "Quattro Lunch" message did not get through; a friend found the carbonara salty.
In November 2026 a diner saw groups of nearly 20 and many overseas guests.

CASH ONLY — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; April 2025). 8 seats: 4 at the counter, 4 at a table (Tabelog). Run by one person (May 2024; March 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). By the canal on the ground floor of M&M’s apartment, Okazaki; 3 min from the Okazaki Park bus stops, 11 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog). Opened 14 May 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, by the canal — 11 min from Higashiyama Stn

places.notes: [Café · Okazaki canal, a one-person weekend lunch plate] An eight-seat café by the Okazaki canal, open only Friday to Sunday, where one person cooks a gentle daily plate of small Japanese and Western dishes (about ¥1,500, limited and often sold out), with coffee and cake. Cherry blossom fills the window in spring. Cash only — come early or book.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who runs the café alone (May 2024; March 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café opened 14 May 2011, now open Friday to Sunday. Reviews from May 2024 and March 2026 describe one person running it.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 visitor found the cherry blossom view over the canal stunning but had to give up the rice plate for lack of cash.
A September 2024 group arrived at 11:45 and booked a table for 13:30 to get the limited plate.
A May 2024 first-timer, after pandemic-era irregular hours, found the gentle food and kind solo service worth the wait.

cultural_comfort.note: Book or come early for the limited plate; cash only; small and quiet. No English evidence found.

places.neighborhood: Higashioji Marutamachi, facing Kumano Shrine — 558 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn

places.notes: [Diner · Higashioji Marutamachi, home cooking from 6 am] A long-running diner facing Kumano Shrine, open from dawn: order a pork miso soup, sake-lees soup or udon, then pick a couple of home-style sides — grilled mackerel, chilled tofu, rolled egg — from the trays, for under ¥1,000. Cash only; no children; closed Saturday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who serves from the side-dish trays (February 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a cafeteria-style diner at the Higashioji Marutamachi crossing. A December 2025 reviewer read online that it has been in business for over 70 years.
chef_bio.specialty: Pork miso soup set; pick-your-own sides.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 morning jogger stopped for a kitsune udon set with simmered mackerel, ¥900 in all.
A November 2025 visitor hunting for an early-opening breakfast found it and parked behind Kumano Shrine.
An October 2026 visitor noted how hard it is to find ordinary home cooking out, and why regulars might come daily.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki with sashimi, hamo, Omi beef sukiyaki and dashi; tofu and yuba are part of mixed courses (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 (last order 13:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 20:30), daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; guests with preschool children are seated only in private rooms, if one is free (Tabelog). The kawadoko (river terrace) moves indoors if rain is likely, and wet terrace or kotatsu-terrace seats move indoors (Tabelog); terrace seating ran to the end of October in 2026 (October 2026). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料10％」). Cards incl. UnionPay; QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). 60 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). The eighth house on the east side of Pontocho north of Shijo; 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). No children’s menu (September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho north of Shijo — 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto kaiseki with tofu, yuba and sukiyaki, on a river terrace over the Kamo (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · lunch: mini kaiseki with Omi beef sukiyaki and saikyo-grilled sawara ¥4,840 (June and October 2026); a lunch set around ¥4,000 with tempura (September 2026) · lunch kaiseki with fresh yuba, hamo and tuna sashimi and a hamo tempura hot pot (July 2026) · summer kaiseki ¥6,600 — appetizers, sashimi, saikyo-yaki, yudofu, fried dish, chirimen rice, miso soup, dessert (August 2026) · seasonal kawadoko kaiseki at dinner (August–September 2026)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Pontocho, kaiseki on the river terrace] A Pontocho house with a kawadoko over the Kamo River that stays open to the end of October: a ¥4,840 mini kaiseki with Omi beef sukiyaki at lunch, summer kaiseki (¥6,600) with yuba, hamo and yudofu, or indoor seats with a river view. 10% service. Preschool children only in private rooms; no kids menu.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese, tofu and sukiyaki restaurant on Pontocho with river-terrace and kotatsu-terrace seating.
chef_bio.specialty: Kawadoko kaiseki; yuba and tofu.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner was glad the terrace was still open at month’s end, when neighbours had closed theirs by mid-October.
An October 2026 overseas visitor was glad a first taste of Kyoto cuisine came here, and the friends all loved it.
A September 2026 parent noted there is no children’s menu, calling the terrace kaiseki a place for adults.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・豆腐料理・すき焼き、中京区先斗町通四条上ル東側8軒目鍋屋町232-10、京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、昼12:00〜14:30 (L.O. 13:30)、夜17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 20:30)、予約可、未就学児は個室のみ、雨の予報で納涼床は店内に、サービス料10%、カード・QR 可、60席、禁煙。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): Omi の牛のすき焼きと鰆の西京焼きのミニ懐石4,840円、天ぷらの昼のセット約4,000円、生湯葉と鱧と鮪の刺身、鱧の天ぷら鍋、夏の懐石6,600円 (先付、刺身、西京焼き、湯豆腐、揚げ物、ちりめんご飯、味噌汁、デザート)、川床の懐石、10月末まで床あり、子供のメニューはない。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a kaiseki course and request the river terrace in season; 10% service. No English evidence found.

places.neighborhood: Nanzen-ji, by the main gate — 9 min from Keage Stn

places.notes: [Udon and café · Nanzen-ji, a garden view with lunch] A restaurant a minute from Nanzen-ji’s gate whose counters look out on a Japanese garden: homemade udon with Awa-chicken or burdock tempura (¥1,600–1,700), dango you toast yourself and matcha latte. Very popular — a numbered queue forms before 11:30. Dinner is courses only, by reservation. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a restaurant with a seasonal Japanese garden view and homemade udon, which marked its first anniversary in January 2025 with maiko dances; dinner reservations are for courses only. An October 2026 reviewer says the garden was designed by an 11th-generation gardener of the Ogawa line.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade tempura udon; garden view.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor arrived at 11:00 and saw a queue form quickly; only courses could be booked.
A September 2026 café visitor enjoyed toasting dango at the table with a choice of toppings.
A November 2026 visitor arriving five minutes before opening was the 15th group in line.

places.neighborhood: Takano, at Kitaoji and Higashioji — Takano bus stop
places.cuisine: Additive-free takoyaki of domestic wheat and a dashi-rich batter, fluffy and creamy inside with large octopus (2024–2025 reviews) · six for ¥700 in flavours such as sauce, Kyoto-style sesame sauce, negi-dashi soy sauce, salt and sesame oil, salsa and pesto; orders from three pieces (2024–2025 reviews) · about ¥1,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Takoyaki · Takano, by Kitaoji-Higashioji] A stylish little stand making additive-free takoyaki with domestic wheat and a dashi-rich batter — fluffy and creamy, with big pieces of octopus — in flavours from classic sauce and Kyoto sesame to negi-dashi soy, salsa and pesto. Order as few as three. One August 2026 visitor found the balls seemingly pre-cooked, with a hard skin. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a takoyaki shop at Takano with a website at takoyaki-kohaku.com; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers describe an owner who chooses ingredients carefully, additive-free takoyaki of domestic wheat (2024–2025), and a kitchen car at an organic market event (May 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Additive-free, carefully chosen ingredients (2024–2025 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Takoyaki with Kyoto sesame sauce.

anecdotes.text: In May 2025 the shop ran a kitchen car at an organic-store anniversary event, with about fifteen people queuing.
A July 2024 fan called it the best takoyaki ever and pleaded for a Tokyo branch.
An August 2026 visitor ordering salt and sesame oil found the balls seemingly pre-cooked, with a hard skin.

places.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat ramen and tsukemen, curry ramen, fried chicken (2024–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat broths, chashu, shumai and meat-wrapped rice balls (2024–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Inside Toei Kyoto Studio Park (Toei Uzumasa Eigamura) — park admission is needed, and re-entry is not allowed (Tabelog; February 2025). 9:00–17:00 from 1 March to 30 November, 9:30–16:00 from 1 December to 28 February; closed 24–31 December; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations for groups only (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 52 seats; non-smoking; parking at the park (Tabelog). 5 min walk from Uzumasa-Koryuji Stn, 13 min from JR Uzumasa Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Inside Toei Kyoto Studio Park, Uzumasa — 5 min walk from Uzumasa-Koryuji Stn
places.cuisine: Ramen canteen inside the film-set theme park, cheaper than other park eateries (2024–2025 reviews) · Uzumasa curry ramen ¥900, said to be praised by celebrities; Mito-han ramen ¥880 with green onion, chives, pickled shallot, garlic and ginger to add; miso ramen ¥800; cold tsukemen (2024–2025 reviews) · sets: ramen and seiro soba, fried chicken set meal, a Chinese steamed set of noodles, shumai and chimaki; kids ramen set ¥800; meat-wrapped rice balls (2024–2025 reviews) · collaboration menus with events such as Evangelion and Mito Komon (2024–2025 reviews) · under ¥1,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Ramen · inside Toei Kyoto Studio Park, Uzumasa] A family-friendly ramen canteen inside the Edo-period film-set park — you need a park ticket to eat here, with no re-entry. Curry ramen, Mito Komon-themed ramen with garlic and ginger to stir in, cold tsukemen, kids sets and collaboration specials, at prices lower than the park's other restaurants. One guest found the miso broth watery. Daytime only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a ramen and tsukemen restaurant inside Toei Uzumasa Eigamura, with seasonal hours. Reviewers describe one of several eateries in the park, cheaper than the rest, with collaboration menus tied to park events (2024–2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Uzumasa curry ramen; Mito-han ramen.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 family, finding other park restaurants priced at ¥1,500–2,000 a set and unable to leave and re-enter, settled here for an ¥800 miso ramen.
A February 2024 Setsubun visitor with family found the curry ramen mild enough for children.
A February 2024 guest found the outside menu display did not match the sets offered inside.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラーメン・つけ麺、右京区太秦東蜂ヶ岡町10 東映太秦映画村内、JR太秦駅から徒歩13分、太秦広隆寺駅から徒歩5分、3月1日〜11月30日 9:00〜17:00、12月1日〜2月28日 9:30〜16:00、12月24日〜31日休み、団体のみ予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、52席、禁煙、駐車場あり。口コミ (2024年2月〜2025年10月、英語): 映画村の中 (入村料が必要、再入場不可)、ほかの店より安い、太秦カレーラーメン900円、水戸藩ラーメン880円 (ねぎ、にら、らっきょう、にんにく、生姜)、味噌ラーメン800円、冷やしつけ麺、ラーメンとせいろのセット、唐揚げ定食、中華蒸し物の定食 (中華そば、焼売、ちまき)、お子様ラーメンセット800円、肉巻きおにぎり、エヴァンゲリオンや水戸黄門のコラボメニュー、味噌のスープが薄いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Inside a theme park — park ticket needed, no re-entry; picture menu outside; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: M&Maison KYOTO
places.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese breakfast sets of grilled fish, small vegetable dishes, tamagoyaki, sesame tofu, miso soup and rice; side dishes are not explained in detail (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sets centre on grilled or raw fish, tamagoyaki and dashi-based miso soup (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 8:00–15:00; Saturday–Sunday 7:30–15:00; last order 14:30; irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, online; advised for holiday mornings (Tabelog; September 2026). English menu (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 22 seats: 6 at the counter and one table on the 1F, three tables on the 2F; non-smoking; coin parking next door (Tabelog). A tiled roof and a wooden sign with a fish mark on Rokujo-dori; 5 min walk from Gojo Stn, 10 from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Rokujo-dori by Gojo Stn — 10 min walk from Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: Breakfast and lunch sets of seasonal Kyoto food, born as a Kyoto version of the New York Japanese restaurant OKONOMI (Tabelog; November 2026) · ichiju sansai ¥1,870 and ichiju gosai ¥2,310: miso soup, grilled fish such as mackerel or horse mackerel (or sashimi), and small dishes like beet potato salad, sesame tofu and tamagoyaki (July–November 2026) · rice upgradable to corn rice or onigiri for a charge (July 2026) · about ¥2,000–3,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese breakfast · Rokujo by Gojo Stn] A tiled-roof restaurant near Kyoto Station serving a ryokan-style Japanese breakfast from 7:30 at weekends: grilled fish with miso soup and three or five seasonal small dishes, and a praised corn rice. A reviewer calls it the New York eatery OKONOMI brought back to Kyoto; English menu. Some find it a little pricey or average; one found the miso soup lukewarm. Book for holidays.

roles: Kitchen at the open counter and floor staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a breakfast set restaurant to experience the seasons of Kyoto; registered as an official listing by the operator. A November 2026 reviewer says it was born from bringing the New York Japanese eatery OKONOMI back to Kyoto; July 2026 reviewers note its popularity for breakfast.
chef_bio.philosophy: Experience the seasons of Kyoto at breakfast (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Ichiju gosai breakfast; corn rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 guest wished the grilled corn rice were sold as onigiri, and likened the meal to a ryokan breakfast.
A September 2026 couple found the service attentive but the first miso soup lukewarm.
An October 2026 diner thought it aimed at inbound tourists, with no explanation of the side dishes and nothing especially Kyoto about it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 海鮮・カフェ・イノベーティブ、下京区橋詰町143、地下鉄五条駅から徒歩5分、JR京都駅から徒歩10分、月〜金 8:00〜15:00、土日 7:30〜15:00、L.O.14:30、不定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、22席 (1階 カウンター6・テーブル1、2階 テーブル3)、禁煙、隣にコインパーキング、京都の四季を感じる朝食の定食の店。口コミ (2026年7月〜11月、英語): 六条通、瓦屋根と魚の印の木の看板、ニューヨークの和食店「OKONOMI」を京都に逆輸入、一汁三菜1,870円、一汁五菜2,310円、焼き魚 (鯖、鯵) かお造り、ビーツのポテトサラダ、胡麻豆腐、卵焼き、とうもろこしご飯、旅館のような朝食、外国人客も、ご飯はおにぎりやとうもろこしご飯に追加料金で変更可、価格はやや高め・味噌汁がぬるかった・小鉢の説明がない・味は普通との声、人気なので予約を。英語メニューあり (食べログ)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); some overseas guests; book for holidays; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: すしてつ 先斗町店 (Sushi Tetsu Pontocho)
places.gf_detail: Ask. À la carte nigiri with soy; small cooked dishes such as kinpira and ganmodoki as otoshi; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi bar; natto and egg are on the nigiri list, but most items are fish and shellfish (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 17:00–24:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 12:00–24:00; last order 23:30; closed 31 December–1 January; hours can change with supply (Tabelog). Reservations only for tatami seating for 4 or more; otherwise write your name on the board and queue — a line of about 30 at 19:00 one September evening; a 60-minute last order (August 2026) or a 90-minute limit (October 2026). A seat fee of ¥324 (Tabelog original (御席料)324円); an appetizer (otoshi) is served (June and October 2026). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 52 seats with counter, tables and tatami, some with a Kamo River view; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). 1F of the Karafuneya Pontocho building, Pontocho south of Sanjo; 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho south of Sanjo, on the Kamo River — 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Value à la carte sushi by the Kamo River, two pieces a plate (2026 reviews) · nigiri plates about ¥280 for two, with chutoro priced like the rest; wagyu sushi ¥500 for two (October 2026) · e.g. shime saba, akami, chutoro, akagai, engawa, tsubugai, uni, aji, kanpachi, scallop, white fish, gunkan, natto and egg (2026 reviews) · sashimi; an otoshi such as kinpira or aosa ganmodoki (June and October 2026) · about ¥3,000–3,999 (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Pontocho on the Kamo River, queue and eat] A busy, cheerful sushi bar by the river where most nigiri — chutoro included — cost about ¥280 for two, plus wagyu sushi and fresh akagai; most reviewers spent ¥3,000–3,999. No bookings except tatami for four or more: write your name and wait, with time limits when busy. Table service can lag behind the counter. ¥324 seat fee. Open till midnight.

roles: Sushi chefs at the counter and floor staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a sushi bar in the Karafuneya Pontocho building, with hours that change with supply. Reviewers in 2026 describe long queues, a mix of Japanese and overseas guests, a pleasant chef, and prices only a little above conveyor-belt sushi.
chef_bio.specialty: Value nigiri; wagyu sushi.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner noted that chutoro costs the same as natto and joked that this was unfair to the natto.
A September 2026 repeat visitor arrived 30 minutes before opening and was the seventh group in line.
At 19:00 in September 2026 there was a line of about thirty, half Japanese and half overseas visitors.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、中京区先斗町三条下ル石屋町133-1 からふね屋先斗町ビル 1F、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、阪急河原町駅から徒歩10分、月〜金 17:00〜24:00、土日祝 12:00〜24:00、L.O.23:30、12月31日・1月1日休み、仕入れで営業時間が変わることあり、予約は座敷4名以上のみ、御席料324円、52席、禁煙、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 鴨川沿い、名前を書いて順番待ち、開店前から行列、夜7時に約30人、60分または90分の制限、2貫で1皿、280円ほど、中トロもほかと同じ値段、和牛の寿司2貫500円、しめ鯖、赤身、赤貝、えんがわ、つぶ貝、雲丹、鯵、かんぱち、帆立、軍艦、納豆、玉子、お通し (きんぴら、あおさのがんもどき)、テーブルはカウンターより提供が遅いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Write your name and queue; time limits when busy; ¥324 seat fee; cards and QR.

places.name: 美菜莉 JR京都伊勢丹店 (Minari, JR Kyoto Isetan)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: chijimi, cold noodles, japchae and gochujang- and soy-based sauces in the sets (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the menu is vegetable-led, but sets include meat soups, eggs and kimchi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed on JR Kyoto Isetan's closing days. Online booking only for up to 4, until the day before and for times up to 18:00; 5 or more by phone. Busy at weekend lunch — check the wait by QR code (May 2026). 45 seats (41 at tables, 4 on sofas), semi-private seating; non-smoking; wheelchair access; children welcome. Cards accepted; e-money only Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station — JR Kyoto Isetan 11F
places.cuisine: Vegetable-forward Korean home cooking in set meals (2026 reviews; Tabelog) · sets with kimchi, a small chijimi, quail eggs and side dishes: stone-grilled bibimbap; bibimbap with sundubu ¥2,180; Minari cold-noodle set ¥1,958; samgyetang (half chicken); bossam of steamed pork to wrap in perilla; chadolbagi brisket stir-fry with barley rice (May–October 2026) · à la carte seafood japchae (June 2026); a summer cold-noodle fair (August 2026)
places.notes: [Korean · Kyoto Station Isetan 11F, vegetable-heavy set meals] A calm Korean home-cooking room on JR Kyoto Isetan's restaurant floor: bibimbap, sundubu, samgyetang and bossam in sets of kimchi and little side dishes, mildly spiced and full of vegetables — easy off the train or with children. Diners found the set chijimi small or cold (June, September 2026) and the bossam pork tough (October 2026).

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a spacious, semi-private room on the department store's restaurant floor, sweeter, mild seasoning that suited children, solo women and small groups, and fewer tourists than other Kyoto Station spots (June 2026). A 美菜莉 also runs on Ginza Mitsukoshi's 11th floor (LINE notice); an August 2026 diner mentions a popular Tokyo branch.
chef_bio.specialty: Stone-grilled bibimbap; samgyetang.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "the pork was tougher than I expected, making it a bit difficult to chew… Also, the vegetables were unseasoned, so a little dipping sauce would have been appreciated."
June 2026: "I was surprised by the small size of the chijimi in the set."
June 2026: "overall, the flavors were on the sweeter side, which was comforting since we had elementary school kids with us."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 美菜莉 JR京都伊勢丹店、韓国料理・焼肉・バル、下京区烏丸通塩小路下ル東塩小路町 ジェイアール京都伊勢丹 11F、毎日 11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、休みはJR京都伊勢丹に準じる、ネット予約は4名まで前日までで18時までの時間、5名以上は電話、45席 (テーブル41、ソファ4)、個室、禁煙、車椅子可、子供可、野菜にこだわり・ベジタリアン対応、カード可、電子マネーは Alipay と WeChat Pay のみ。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): 石焼ビビンバ、ビビンバとスンドゥブのセット2,180円、美菜莉冷麺セット1,958円、参鶏湯、ポッサム、チャドルバギ炒め、海鮮チャプチェ、キムチ・小さなチヂミ・うずら卵のおかず、QRコードで待ち時間を確認、甘めでやさしい味、チヂミが小さい・冷たいという声、ポッサムの豚が硬いという声、東京にも店があるという声。三越銀座店の11階にも美菜莉 (LINEのお知らせ)。

cultural_comfort.note: Department-store restaurant floor; mild spice; online booking for up to 4.

places.name: 二条 えん (Nijo En)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura izakaya; oden, miso and soy dishes (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options and plenty of vegetables, but the house pride is its dashi (oden, soups) (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); Wed 17:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30); Sun 17:00–22:00; closed Thursday and some other days. Book for evenings (August 2026); next-day or same-day course bookings by phone. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「無し」 (the English page says a fee is charged). 26 seats: a 6-seat counter and a sofa table downstairs, 3 tables upstairs (upstairs for 8 or more; projector, families welcome). Non-smoking; children welcome, kids' menu; BYO drinks allowed; sommelier. Cards, e-money, QR (PayPay, Alipay). Opened 9 April 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nijo Station — 5 min walk, Nishinokyo backstreets
places.cuisine: A small tempura-and-oden izakaya near Nijo Station that prides itself on its dashi (2023–2026 reviews) · ten-kind tempura platter, with salt or a separate dashi; summer ayu fry (2024–2026) · oden and oden meatballs in house dashi; Kujo leeks with vinegared miso; yuba gratin with white miso and cheese; pork kakuni; nut salad; duck with green onion; amberjack or sea bream carpaccio in ponzu (2023–2026 reviews) · chirimen-sansho rice, meat-miso rice, white-miso soup to finish; uncommon Japanese sake (2024–2026)
places.notes: [Tempura and oden · Nijo Station, a dashi-proud izakaya] A cosy two-floor izakaya by Nijo Station: a ten-kind tempura platter, oden in the house dashi, Kyoto vegetables with white miso, and a good list of less-common sake, with the owner chatting across the counter. Some found portions small and prices high (June, August 2026), and late in the evening much sells out. No service charge. Closed Thursday.

roles: Owner, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Opened 9 April 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2023 to 2026 describe a cosy room where solo diners chat with the owner across the counter, staff who say "we pride ourselves on our dashi" (January 2024), attentive service, and an upstairs room used by families and groups.
chef_bio.specialty: Ten-kind tempura platter; oden.

anecdotes.text: January 2024: on the staff's recommendation — "We pride ourselves on our dashi" — the family chose oden.
June 2026: "while the portions were on the smaller side, the overall flavor of the dishes was quite sweet… many items were sold out" at 9 p.m.
August 2026: "the cost-performance is not great. The prices are higher than expected, and the portion sizes are not very large."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 二条 えん、天ぷら・日本料理・居酒屋、中京区西ノ京職司町4-9、JR二条駅から徒歩5分、月火金土 17:00〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)・水 17:00〜22:00・日 17:00〜22:00、木曜休み、不定休あり、原文でサービス料「無し」、26席 (1階カウンター6席とソファ1卓、2階3卓)、2階は8名から、プロジェクター、禁煙、子供可・子供メニュー、持ち込み可、ソムリエ、カード・電子マネー・QR可、ベジタリアン対応、2019年4月9日オープン。口コミ (2023年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 天ぷら10種盛り、出汁が自慢のおでん、おでんの肉団子、九条ねぎの酢味噌、湯葉の白味噌チーズグラタン、豚の角煮、ナッツのサラダ、鴨とねぎ、カンパチや鯛のカルパッチョ、鮎の天ぷら、ちりめん山椒ご飯、肉味噌ご飯、白味噌汁、珍しい日本酒、店主とカウンター越しに話せる、量が少なめで甘めという声、割高という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Small local izakaya; book for evenings.

places.name: 中国料理 青冥 祇園店 (Ching-Ming Gion)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: yakisoba, ramen, karaage, sweet-and-sour pork and soy-based sauces (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Cantonese-leaning meat and seafood dishes and set meals (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:30–15:45 and 17:00–21:30 (last order 21:00); closed irregularly; hours may change — see the official site. Book for lunch: near-full by noon (June, August, October 2026). Service charge 10% after 17:00 — Tabelog, Japanese original 「17時以降はご飲食代の10％をサービス料として頂戴しております」. 70 seats with semi-private areas; groups over 50; tablet ordering. Non-smoking (including heated tobacco). English menu; children welcome. Cards, transit IC and e-money, QR. 5th floor of the Yasaka Gion Building beside Yojiya; the entrance is behind a coffee shop (October 2026); window views over Hanamikoji.
places.neighborhood: Gion, Shijo-dori at Hanamikoji — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Cantonese-leaning Chinese from an Osaka house founded in 1967, with a view over Gion (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · lunch: "Hanami gozen" of shrimp chili, sweet-and-sour pork and karaage with small dishes, corn soup and dessert ¥1,600; sweet-and-sour pork set with mapo tofu and yakisoba; daily set under ¥1,500 (August–October 2026) · à la carte: stir-fried beef with peppers, salt-stir-fried scallops and shrimp, eggplant with minced meat, shrimp mayonnaise, eight-treasure yakisoba, shark-fin paitan ramen, cold jellyfish ¥2,400, almond jelly (2026 reviews) · all-you-can-drink courses and private parties
places.notes: [Chinese · Gion, a 5th-floor view over Hanamikoji] The Kyoto branch of Osaka's 1967 Chinese house Ching-Ming, five floors above the Gion crossing with windows over Hanamikoji: a good-value ¥1,600 lunch gozen, eight-treasure yakisoba and shark-fin ramen at night. Regulars note shrinking portions (July–August 2026); some found the pre-made side dishes just okay (August 2026) and the room too cold. 10% service charge after 17:00.

roles: Not named in a source; branch of 青冥 (Ching-Ming)
chef_bio.background: 青冥 was founded in 1967 with its main shop in Dojima, Osaka (Ikyu listing); a 2026 recruiting page for 株式会社ミヨシコーポレーション lists 青冥 堂島本店, 祇園店, 阪急池田店 and 大丸梅田店. Reviewers in 2026 describe a classic, spacious room of local regulars and lunching women, tablet ordering, and a menu more Cantonese than Sichuan; one diner came for the eight-treasure yakisoba remembered from visits to the Umeda shop with a late father (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Eight-treasure yakisoba; shark-fin paitan ramen.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "My late father often took me to the Chinmin in Umeda… He always ordered the Eight Treasure Yakisoba. This Kyoto branch was also incredibly delicious."
July 2026, a regular: "it seems like the portion sizes have decreased compared to before."
August 2026: "The freshly made sweet and sour pork was delicious, but the pre-made mapo tofu and stir-fried noodles with sauce were just okay."

places.name: ビストロ・スリージェ (Bistro Cerisier)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Regional French plates — pâtés, salads, quenelles with Nantua sauce, cassoulet, choucroute, braised beef cheek, game; bread is served at every table and gluten is not mentioned (Michelin Guide; 2025–2026 reviews).

Payment: the shop’s own note on Tabelog says cash only, though Tabelog’s payment field says cards are accepted — bring cash. places.neighborhood: Demachiyanagi — 2 min from the Keihan station
places.cuisine: A countryside-style French bistro of regional dishes, listed in the Michelin Guide: fish soup, goat-cheese salad, sautéed frog legs, choucroute and cassoulet in generous portions (Michelin Guide) · pâté de campagne ¥1,925 (September 2025); Périgord salad with smoked duck, confit gizzards, foie gras and figs ¥4,180 (September 2025); piquillos stuffed with brandade ¥2,420 (September 2025) · smoked salmon, Champagne-style gratinéed oysters, Lyon quenelle with Nantua sauce, Castelnaudary cassoulet (January 2026) · braised beef cheek (December 2025); roast Ezo venison, boudin noir terrine, Roquefort salad (December 2025) · game pâté en croûte, river-fish mousse with crayfish sauce, nougat glacé (December 2025) · Wagyu tail, pork head (May 2026); white asparagus, smoked herring, mussels, anago, frog (March and July 2026) · a long wine list arranged by region (December 2025)
places.notes: [French bistro · Demachiyanagi, regional classics to share] A small, antique-filled bistro by Demachiyanagi Station, listed in the Michelin Guide, cooking hearty French regional dishes — pâtés, quenelles, cassoulet, choucroute, game — in big portions meant for sharing, with a long regional wine list. Book by phone a month ahead; à la carte at dinner; bring cash.

chef_bio.background: The Michelin Guide says the bistro is the work of a madame captivated by French cuisine who gave shape to a longing for the real thing, in an antique interior with the feel of a country bistro. Reviewers describe a sommelier lady running the dining room (September 2025) and two women serving (December 2025); a regular’s first review dates from February 2011.
chef_bio.specialty: Regional French dishes — quenelles, cassoulet, choucroute.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 party of three booked a holiday dinner a month ahead and found the house full that night.
A July 2026 regular, turned away from the mussels on the previous visit, finally got the mussels.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular of ten years celebrated the reopening with five extra seats and praised the charming owner.
A February 2026 pair got two seats after every other shop in the alley was full, then waited twenty minutes for the first skewer with one person working.
A September 2023 diner found the batter light and the shochu highball poured strong.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 串揚げ・居酒屋、下京区七条通烏丸西入ル東境町180 リド飲食街 1号室、京都駅から徒歩5分、18:00〜翌1:00、不定休、予約不可、カード可、カウンター14席、喫煙可。口コミ (2023年8月〜2026年5月、英語): 昭和レトロなリド飲食街の角、一口の串カツ、軽い衣、牛・ししゃも・蓮根・アスパラ・紅生姜の串、焼き揚げ、Manganji の唐辛子の焼き物、赤星 (瓶ビール)、濃いめの焼酎ハイボール、2025年11月に5席増やして再開、一人で回すので時間がかかることも。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in and take a counter seat; smoking allowed; order skewers one at a time. No English evidence found.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat-and-egg bistro menu (reviews).

Run by two people (October 2026). Near Kumano Shrine, 423 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Marutamachi by Kumano Shrine — 423 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Wine bistro with many natural wines, poured by the glass to your taste (2025–2026 reviews) · menu on a blackboard: pâté de campagne, the signature gratin, a creamy omelette, hummus, prosciutto, peach with mozzarella, swordtip squid with bitter melon, Thai-style fried jidori chicken (2025–2026) · steak, e.g. beef inside round with rock salt — order it early, it takes time (August 2025; January 2026) · bread baked to order, about 20 minutes (April 2026) · desserts
places.notes: [Wine bistro · by Kumano Shrine, natural wine and blackboard plates] A candle-lit bistro with European antiques, a long counter and a tatami back room, where two people run the whole show from 4 p.m. to midnight. Say what you like and a natural wine is poured to match; eat pâté, the house gratin, a molten omelette and a well-rested steak (order it first). About ¥5,000–10,000 a head. Phone to book; cash only; closed Sunday and Monday.

roles: Chef and staff not named; run by two people (October 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 4 January 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe European antique décor, candles after dark, a blackboard menu and wines kept in a back room (2025–2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Natural wine with bistro plates; steak and gratin.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 counter guest was told "then let me choose something wonderful for you" and was poured glass after glass.
An April 2026 group of four, sent by a Kyoto University friend, found a tatami room behind the "Wine House" sign and waited 20 minutes for the bread.
An August 2025 diner rated the inside-round beef steak — crisp outside, medium-rare within — the best of the night.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: くまのワインハウス、ワインバー・ビストロ、左京区東丸太町41-7、京阪神宮丸太町駅から徒歩6分 (423m)、火〜土 16:00〜24:00、日月定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、16席、個室あり、貸切可、禁煙、2019年1月4日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 熊野神社のそば、ヨーロッパのアンティーク調、ろうそく、黒板のメニュー、自然派ワインを好みに合わせてグラスで、パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、名物のグラタン、オムレツ、フムス、生ハム、桃とモッツァレラ、剣先イカとゴーヤ、地鶏のタイ風唐揚げ、ステーキ (牛の内もも、時間がかかるので早めに注文)、焼くのに20分のパン、座敷の個室、予約は電話のみ、二人で切り盛り、日曜休み。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone bookings only; blackboard menu; cash only.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen in soy-based broth, gyoza and sauced kara-age; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat-based ramen broth with chashu; kara-age (reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–22:00 Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog); open through Obon (August 2026). No reservations. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats with a counter; smoking allowed (Tabelog; March and September 2026). On the south-east corner of Karasuma-Marutamachi, 72 m from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma-Marutamachi, south-west of the Imperial Palace — 72 m from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Old-style ramen and town Chinese (2024–2026 reviews) · ramen ¥800: a soy-sauce broth with a hint of sweetness, straight noodles, chashu, menma and green onion (August 2026) · spicy miso ramen; vegetable ramen; set meals ¥1,000 with ramen, rice and a side such as three kara-age in sweet chilli sauce (2026) · fried rice set; gyoza; kimchi; kara-age with shrimp-chilli sauce (2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Karasuma-Marutamachi, an old-school town Chinese] A long-standing ramen and Chinese counter on the corner across from Marutamachi Station, run by older cooks who look stern and turn out kind. The ramen (about ¥800) is a light, faintly sweet soy broth; the ¥1,000 set adds rice and kara-age in sweet chilli sauce. Spicy miso, vegetable ramen and fried rice too. Smoking allowed; cash only; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner not named; two older cooks in the kitchen (October 2026)
chef_bio.background: A long-established ramen shop at the Karasuma-Marutamachi crossing, per August and October 2026 reviewers. Tabelog names seiwa-horin.co.jp as the website, which did not respond on 6 November 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Soy-sauce ramen with a set of kara-age and rice.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner was put off by the cook’s stern look, then found the cook polite and kind; the noodles were very soft.
An August 2026 lunch guest was offered a shelf for bags and liked the moist, toasty fried rice.
An October 2026 first-timer had passed the corner shop for years before trying the salty-sweet shoyu ramen.

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; smoking allowed.

places.name: 魏飯夷堂 三条店 (Gihan Ebisudo Sanjo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Xiaolongbao, gyoza and other wheat dim sum, noodles and soy-seasoned stir-fries; congee and fried rice also on the menu; no gluten information is published (reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat dumplings, seafood congee, fried chicken and mapo tofu (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30; dinner 17:30–22:00 Monday, Wednesday–Friday and 17:00–22:00 Saturday, Sunday and holidays; closed Tuesday, other closures irregular (Tabelog). Bookings online; when busy, tables are limited to 1 hour at lunch and 1.5 hours at dinner (Tabelog). Cards, e-money, PayPay and Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). 45 seats: a 5-seat counter and spacious tables; children welcome; non-smoking; takeout and delivery (Tabelog). In a century-old townhouse that was once a miso shop, its old miso sign still up, on the Sanjo-kai shopping arcade near TOHO Nijo; 365 m from Nijojo-mae Stn (official site; 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Sanjo-kai shopping arcade, south of Nijo Castle — 365 m from Nijojo-mae Stn
places.cuisine: Dim sum and Chinese from the 創作中華 一之船入 group (official site) · xiaolongbao, pan-fried xiaolongbao, gyoza, shumai, shrimp dumplings, spring rolls, fried rice cakes; vinegared jellyfish; yurinchi fried chicken; mapo tofu; shrimp chilli; dan dan noodles; seafood congee; sesame balls and almond jelly (2025–2026 reviews) · weekly-changing lunch sets, e.g. sweet-and-sour chicken with rice, soup and pickled mustard greens ¥1,200; add two xiaolongbao and almond jelly for ¥300 (September 2026) · dim sum set; yum cha lunch (October 2026) · shochu and cocktails (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Chinese · Sanjo-kai arcade near Nijo Castle, dim sum in an old miso shop] The casual dim sum house of Kyoto's 一之船入 group, opened in 2010 in a century-old townhouse that still wears a miso shop's sign under red lanterns. Thin-skinned xiaolongbao, crisp pan-fried dumplings, dan dan noodles and seafood congee; weekly lunch sets run about ¥1,200, with dumplings and almond jelly for ¥300 more. Queues at lunch; book for dinner. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner-chef of the 一之船入 group (official site); kitchen staff at Sanjo not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 魏 禧之 (ぎ・よしゆき) was born in Yokohama and from age 11 worked in the kitchen of the family’s Hunan restaurant in Yokohama Chinatown; trained from 18 at well-known Chinese restaurants across Japan, then in China, qualifying as a special-grade cook; trained at 萬珍楼 in Yokohama Chinatown; opened 創作中華 一之船入 in Kyoto in 1996; bronze at the Taiwan culinary exhibition’s world Chinese cuisine contest (2009); opened 魏飯夷堂 三条店 in 2010 and 魏飯夷堂 北新地 in Osaka in 2013 (closed about four years ago, per an October 2026 reviewer); Kyoto tourism ambassador (2015); China’s highest cook grade (2018); Kyoto Prefecture’s Contemporary Master Craftsman (2020); head of the Kyoto branch of the Japan Chinese Cuisine Association. The group follows 医食同源 (food as medicine) and uses pesticide-free vegetables from contract farms.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: 医食同源 — preventing illness through food, cooking that is delicious and good for the body, shared by all the group’s shops.
chef_bio.specialty: Xiaolongbao.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor came back after seven years for the xiaolongbao, at ¥200 off in a campaign.
An October 2026 diner, a regular at the Kitashinchi branch before it closed, found the xiaolongbao just as good.
An October 2026 lunch guest was told the vinegared jellyfish had the "highest order count in history".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ichinohunairi.com): 一之船入グループ (創作中華 一之船入、イチノフナイリ・ザ ショップ、魏飯夷堂 三条店、魏飯吉堂、魏飯餃子)、医食同源、契約農園の無農薬野菜、シェフ 魏 禧之 (ぎ・よしゆき): 横浜市生まれ、11歳から実家の横浜中華街の湖南料理店の厨房に、18歳から全国の有名中華料理店で修業、中国で特級調理士、横浜中華街「萬珍楼」で修行、1996年 京都に「創作中華 一之船入」、2009年 台湾美食展世界中国料理大会銅賞、2010年 飲茶と中華の店「魏飯夷堂 三条店」、2013年「魏飯夷堂 北新地」、2015年 京都国際観光大使、2018年 中国の最高級調理士、2020年 京都府「現代の名工」、日本中国料理協会 京都支部 支部長。三条店: 京都三条会商店街、元・老舗の味噌店の京町家、週替わりのランチセット、火曜定休。食べログ: 中華・居酒屋・バル、中京区三条岩上西入る橋西町661、二条城前駅から365m、昼11:30〜14:30、夜17:30〜22:00 (土日祝は17:00〜)、火曜定休、混雑時は昼1時間・夜1.5時間、カード・電子マネー・QR可、45席 (カウンター5、テーブル40)、禁煙、テイクアウト・デリバリー、2010年9月14日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 小籠包、焼き小籠包、焼き餃子、春巻き、くらげの酢の物、油淋鶏、麻婆豆腐、エビチリ、担々麺、海鮮粥、ごま団子、杏仁豆腐、酢鶏のランチ1,200円、+300円で小籠包2個と杏仁豆腐、飲茶ランチ、味噌屋の看板と赤い提灯、昼は行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Online booking; several reviewers (August 2026) note foreign visitors at lunch.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Prosciutto, rillettes, steaks with sauces, cream croquettes, omurice, shumai and pasta, with free baguette; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat-led French bar menu (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday 11:00–22:00 (last food order 21:00); Friday and the day before a holiday 11:00–22:30; Saturday 11:00–22:30; Sunday and holidays 11:00–22:00; lunch menu until 16:00 on weekdays and 14:00 at weekends; closed 31 December with the building (Tabelog). ¥396 cover charge (Tabelog). Bookings accepted. Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 66 seats with a counter; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). In Kyoto Porta B1F west area under Kyoto Station, 2 min walk from JR Kyoto Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, Porta underground mall B1F
places.cuisine: Casual French bar: plates from ¥280 and wine by the glass from ¥350 (Tabelog) · paper-thin prosciutto, the specialty; rillettes; a plate of about ten GOLD appetisers (Tabelog; October 2026) · beef outside-skirt steak with truffle butter, with cream croquette and rice ¥1,580 at lunch; "forbidden" shumai with truffle butter and red wine; omurice and hamburg omurice with salad (2026 reviews) · bistro set with one drink ¥1,280 from 14:00 to 17:00; one-hour all-you-can-drink ¥1,000 at lunch; banquet course with drinks ¥5,000 (Tabelog; October–November 2026)
places.notes: [French bar · Kyoto Station Porta, wine and plates from lunch] A busy, casual French bar under Kyoto Station, open from 11:00: paper-thin prosciutto, rillettes, truffle-butter skirt steak and cheap glasses of wine, with free refills of baguette. A ¥1,000 hour of all-you-can-drink at lunch makes it a favourite Shinkansen send-off. Cramped and lively; ¥396 cover. One of three GOLD bars, with two in Osaka.

roles: Chef not named; one of three フレンチ酒場GOLD shops (Kyoto Porta, お初天神, 大阪梅田)
chef_bio.background: Opened 26 August 2022 (Tabelog). Tabelog’s introduction calls it a French tavern serving high-end French cuisine casually, with dishes from ¥280 and wine from ¥350; a Kyoto Porta-only French lunch.
chef_bio.specialty: Ultra-thin prosciutto.

anecdotes.text: A five-time November 2026 regular drank the ¥1,000 lunch free-flow while waiting an hour for the Shinkansen, then napped all the way to Tokyo.
An October 2026 guest found the grilled dishes not served piping hot.
A November 2026 lunch diner booked from the Shinkansen to be sure of a seat, and took an extra slice of the free baguette.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ酒場 GOLD 京都ポルタ店、ダイニングバー・バル、下京区東塩小路町902 京都ポルタ B1F 西エリア、JR京都駅から徒歩2分、月〜木 11:00〜22:00、金・祝前日 11:00〜22:30、土 11:00〜22:30、日祝 11:00〜22:00、12月31日は館休業、チャージ料396円、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、66席、禁煙、子ども可、2022年8月26日オープン。公式紹介: 本格フレンチをカジュアルに、料理280円から、グラスワイン350円から、京都ポルタ店限定のフレンチランチ、極薄の生ハム、14時〜17時のビストロセット1,280円 (前菜約10種とドリンク1杯)、飲み放題付きコース5,000円。口コミ (2026年、英語): ランチの1時間飲み放題1,000円、生ハムとポテト、オムライス、ハンバーグオムライス、リエット、牛ハラミのトリュフバターとクリームコロッケのセット1,580円、禁断のシュウマイ、バゲットのおかわり、新幹線前に。

cultural_comfort.note: Station-mall bar; bookable online.

places.name: Da.uchi Curry
places.gf_detail: Ask. Roux-style curries from French stews, a bisque curry and a minced cutlet curry; flour use not described (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu, duck, pork, chicken and shrimp curries (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu and Sat 11:30–15:00; Fri 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Leaf Kyoto (June 2022) gave dinners on Friday and Saturday and said lunch ends when sold out; an August 2026 reviewer came for Friday dinner. Bookings taken (Tabelog); fills up soon after opening (April 2026 review). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 15 seats with a counter; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). About 1 min from the Kojinguchi city-bus stop, 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn; coin parking nearby (Tabelog; July 2025 review).
places.neighborhood: Kojinguchi, west of the Kamo River — 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Spice curry built on French stews by a sommelier-turned-chef (Leaf Kyoto; 2026 reviews): since a March 2026 revamp, combination plates of two to four from four curries — wagyu neck in red wine like boeuf bourguignon, sansho pork or chicken keema, red-shrimp Americaine with chicken breast, duck keema, lamb-tongue confit — with a small salad, from ¥2,000–2,400 (April and September 2026), spiced egg +¥200, eggplant and sanma biryani +¥500 (August 2026); veal and shellfish bisque curry ¥2,800 (January 2026); bonito curry with tapenade when the first bonito lands; glass of white wine ¥1,000 (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [French-style curry · Kojinguchi] A sommelier who became a chef makes curry from French stews: wagyu neck braised in red wine, sansho keema, red-shrimp Americaine, served two to four to a plate with salad for about ¥2,000–2,800. Wine by the glass. Lunch most days, dinner on Friday; closed Wednesday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A sommelier-turned-chef who served curry in a rented space for about two and a half years before fans helped open this shop on 21 April 2022 (Leaf Kyoto, June 2022; Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer places that earlier counter in the sake bar "Sake no Nishikawa" on Marutamachi, since moved to Kawaramachi-Gojo, and describes a background in French cooking (also April 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Curry pursued as an evolution of French stewed dishes (Leaf Kyoto).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu neck curry; sansho keema.

anecdotes.text: A regular noted in March 2026 that the menu had been revamped to combination plates of four curries, and the desserts had gone.
A January 2026 visitor found the shop open just after New Year and called the ¥2,800 veal and shellfish bisque curry bold but worth it.
At a Friday dinner in August 2026 the staff suggested squeezing lime over the biryani.

places.cuisine: The hotel Kyoto-cuisine restaurant in a modern machiya-style room, opened September 1997 (Tabelog) · Kyo no Asagohan breakfast: dashi and juice to start, six small dishes such as yuba tofu, Kyoto beef and sashimi, dashimaki of Kyoto eggs, saikyo-miso black cod, yudofu, rice or rice porridge, pickles, chirimen sansho and a matcha warabi-mochi pudding (May and September 2026) · Hanakago lunch sets of seasonal small dishes with corn rice or chirimen sansho rice, and kaiseki lunches (April–August 2026) · kids menu (October 2026) · dinner about ¥6,000–10,000, lunch about ¥3,000–6,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Hotel Granvia, inside Kyoto Station] The Granvia hotel Japanese restaurant, a calm machiya-style room with kimono-clad staff and views of Kyoto Tower. Its set Kyoto breakfast — saikyo-miso cod, yudofu, dashimaki, porridge — is open to non-guests, plus seasonal lunch sets and kaiseki. One breakfast guest found it decent but short of the high price. 15% service charge; smart casual.

roles: Hotel kitchen and kimono-clad floor staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant of Hotel Granvia Kyoto (in the JR Kyoto Station building), opened 11 September 1997, offering seasonal Kyoto ingredients in a machiya-style space for anniversaries, meetings and family occasions; registered as an official listing by the hotel.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal Kyoto ingredients and hotel hospitality (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyo no Asagohan breakfast.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 hotel guest had the Western buffet at Le Temps one morning and the Kyo no Asagohan here the next, choosing rice porridge with a sweet bekko-an glaze.
A July 2026 family meeting found the private rooms quiet, with small cloakrooms, and noted that allergies were checked in advance.
An October 2026 drop-in breakfast guest found one set on offer, decent but not matching the high price.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・寿司、下京区烏丸通塩小路下ル JR京都駅中央口 ホテルグランヴィア京都 M3F、JR京都駅中央改札から徒歩1分、毎日 7:00〜10:00、11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)、17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、年中無休、サービス料15％、スマートカジュアル (男性はノースリーブとサンダル不可)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、94席 (カウンター40、ダイニング22、個室4)、禁煙、車椅子可、JR京都駅ビル駐車場の割引、1997年9月11日開店。アレルギー: 特定原材料8品目 (小麦を含む) に対応、同じ厨房と器具で調理するため完全な除去は保証できず、提供を断ることもある、事前に伝えれば持ち込み可。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 京の朝ごはん (だしとジュース、小鉢6品、京都の卵のだし巻き、銀だらの西京焼き、湯豆腐、白ご飯かお粥、べっこうあん、ちりめん山椒、漬物、抹茶のわらび餅プリン)、花かごの昼の御膳、とうもろこしご飯、懐石の昼、着物の店員、京都タワーが見える、個室、子ども用メニュー、朝食は値段のわりに期待ほどではなかったとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; smart casual; 15% service charge; cards, IC and QR.

gf_cross_contamination.text: The hotel notice says food is prepared in the same kitchen as allergens, with shared utensils and cleaning equipment, so cross-contamination is possible.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The hotel says it handles the eight labelled allergens (egg, milk, wheat, buckwheat, peanut, shrimp, crab, walnut), cannot guarantee complete removal, may decline to serve, and allows guests to bring food from home with advance notice.
A July 2026 reviewer notes that food allergies were checked thoroughly in advance of a private-room course.

places.name: 輝庭 (Kagayaki Tei)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: kara-age, kushiage, tempura, chicken nanban and soy-seasoned dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-centred Japanese izakaya with dashi, fried chicken and sashimi (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; 2-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥380, ¥418 incl. tax (Tabelog original お通し380円(税込418円)). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 126 seats with counter, sofa seats and many private rooms for 2 to 16; parties up to 44; non-smoking with smoking rooms; free Wi-Fi; English and Simplified Chinese menus; kids meals at lunch only (Tabelog). B1F of the Shijo Karasuma Building, directly linked to Hankyu Karasuma Stn exit 23 and Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo Karasuma — B1F, directly linked to Shijo and Karasuma stations
places.cuisine: Large Japanese izakaya for groups and set lunches, with fish and produce bought direct from growing areas (operator site; 2025–2026 reviews) · lunch from ¥1,000 with rice, miso soup and a side: kara-age, chicken nanban, daily specials, a seafood bowl (September–November 2026) · weekend and holiday mini kaiseki lunch ¥2,800 (August 2026) · evening dishes such as sashimi, nasu dengaku, kushiage, Kujo negi dashimaki, lotus-root manju, kara-age, seasonal tempura and saba oshizushi (October 2025) · courses with all-you-can-drink ending in bara-zushi (September 2026) · lunch about ¥1,000–2,000, dinner about ¥4,000–8,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo Karasuma, underground] A big, calm Japanese izakaya below the Shijo Karasuma crossing, reached without going outside, with semi-private rooms for groups and banquets. Value set lunches of kara-age or chicken nanban from ¥1,000, a weekend mini kaiseki, and fish-led dishes and courses at night. One August 2026 group found the kaiseki portions small and some drinks never came. Open till 22:30.

roles: Cooks at an open kitchen and floor staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator, 株式会社バル・コーポレーション (Bal Corporation): a Kyoto-style seasonal restaurant with an open kitchen, a banquet hall for up to 42 and semi-private rooms; fish and mountain produce are bought direct from producing areas and the cooks judge freshness and flavour (鮮度、旨みは料理人が目利きしております). The operator lists five restaurants. A reviewer notes the menu changed over six years (October 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Freshness and flavour judged by the cooks (operator site).
chef_bio.specialty: Set lunches; banquet courses.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 organiser of social gatherings relies on it as one of few Kyoto places that take large groups, and liked that draft beer came in individual mugs.
An August 2026 weekend mini kaiseki lunch (¥2,800) was fish-centred and tasty, but the portions were small and some drinks ordered were never served.
A September 2026 work party was glad not to need an umbrella on a rainy day, thanks to the direct station link.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、下京区水銀屋町612 四条烏丸ビル B1F、阪急烏丸駅23番出口・地下鉄四条駅に直結、毎日 11:00〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)、17:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、予約可、混雑時は2時間制、お通し380円 (税込418円)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、126席、個室多数、最大44名、禁煙 (喫煙室あり)、無料 Wi-Fi、英語・中国語 (簡体字) メニュー、お子様ランチは昼のみ。運営: 株式会社バル・コーポレーション (公式サイト、5店舗)、産地直送の魚と山の幸、オープンキッチン、宴会場は42名まで。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年11月、英語): 昼は1,000円から (唐揚げ、チキン南蛮、日替わり、ご飯・味噌汁・小鉢付き)、海鮮丼、土日祝のミニ懐石2,800円、夜は刺身、なす田楽、串揚げ、九条ねぎのだし巻き、れんこん饅頭、季節の天ぷら、鯖の押し寿司、飲み放題付きのコースとばら寿司、大人数の宴会に便利、量が少なめで頼んだ飲み物が来なかったとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese menus (Tabelog); private rooms; ¥418 appetizer charge; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: VIETNAM FRENCH XUAN (スアン)
places.gf_detail: Ask: rice-noodle pho and rice-paper spring rolls, but fried spring rolls, sauces and desserts are not described for wheat (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the shop says it cannot take vegetarian or vegan requests, and meat is used in the broth so it cannot be removed (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–21:30 (last order 21:00); closed Tuesday, with some Mondays and Wednesdays off and closures for sourcing or family events — monthly closing days on the official site and Instagram. Booking advised (July 2026); à la carte orders, groups of 7+ and private hire by phone; 30 minutes late without notice counts as a cancellation, with a fee. No vegetarian or vegan requests. Children 1 and over order a kids' set or a drink; call ahead with small children (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at the counter, 8 at tables; private room up to 20. Non-smoking. Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money, QR. A white three-storey house with greenery, two blocks along the Shirakawa canal from Shirakawa-Imadegawa; 3 min from the Ginkakuji-michi bus stop. Moved here 20 April 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kitashirakawa, by the Shirakawa canal — 3 min from Ginkakuji-michi bus stop
places.cuisine: Southern Vietnamese cooking with French touches and Kyoto vegetables, in a house by the Shirakawa canal (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · "Enjoy" 11-dish lunch ¥2,860: a leaf-shaped platter of six starters — fresh and fried spring rolls, green-papaya salad, marinated salmon, water spinach, bitter melon with chicken, pickled lotus stems — then pho (chicken or chashu; shrimp or beef +¥100–150), desserts and Vietnamese coffee or lotus tea (2025–2026 reviews) · coriander served on the side · dinner courses, banh xeo, seasonal "Vietnamese pho hot pot" from mid-November 2026 (official site)
places.notes: [Vietnamese · Kitashirakawa, Vietnamese-French in a canal-side house] A small Vietnamese-French restaurant in a white house by the Shirakawa canal, near the Philosopher's Path: an 11-dish lunch of six pretty starters, a gentle collagen-rich pho and desserts for about ¥2,900, made with Kyoto farm vegetables, and warm hosts who talk about Vietnam. No vegetarian or vegan requests. Book; closed Tuesday and some other days.

roles: Producer: フォン (named on the official site); the chef is not named
chef_bio.origin: Southern Vietnam (the producer's home cooking, per the official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, XUAN began in Tokyo's Nihonbashi in 1997, opened as VIETNAM FRENCH XUAN on Gokomachi in Nakagyo-ku in 2001, and moved to Kitashirakawa in 2014. Its cooking is based on the southern Vietnamese food the producer, フォン, grew up with, using produce from Kyoto farms and fishing ports, Asuka in Nara, and ingredients sourced in Vietnam; it also runs a sweets and ao dai brand, リンホア, and Vietnam tours. Reviewers in 2026 describe a chef and a lady who explain each dish and chat with guests, and the mezzanine sells made-to-order ao dai (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: From the site: using fresh ingredients as they are, cooked in the way of Vietnamese daily life (official site, paraphrased).
chef_bio.specialty: Eleven-dish lunch; chicken pho.

anecdotes.text: January 2026: "the hospitality from the chef and the lady was wonderful… We ended up diving into some interesting conversations about hobbies."
April 2026: "I used to visit Xuan several times before it moved, and I had no idea it had relocated to such a lovely house!"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京野菜で彩るベトナムフレンチレストラン、1997年に東京日本橋で誕生、2001年に京都市中京区御幸町で「VIETNAM FRENCH XUAN－スアン－」として開店、2014年に京都北白川へ移転、プロデューサーのフォン氏が育ったベトナム南部の料理がベース、京都の農園と漁港や奈良明日香村などの食材と現地調達の素材、スイーツとアオザイのブランド「リンホア」、ベトナムツアー、2026年11月中旬頃から「越南フォー鍋」、今月の休業日。食べログ: VIETNAM FRENCH XUAN、ベトナム料理、左京区北白川久保田町56-1、銀閣寺道バス停から徒歩3分、11:30〜15:00・18:00〜21:30 (L.O. 21:00)、火曜休み (月・水も不定)、ベジタリアン・ヴィーガン対応不可・出汁に肉を使うため肉抜き不可、7名以上と貸切は電話、30分以上の無断遅刻はキャンセル料、1歳以上は子供セットか飲み物を、15席 (カウンター7、テーブル8)、個室 (20名まで)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、中二階でアオザイのオーダーとベトナム雑貨、2014年4月20日オープン。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 11品のランチ (2,860円)、生春巻・揚げ春巻・青パパイヤのサラダ・サーモンのマリネ・空芯菜・ゴーヤと鶏の炒め・蓮の茎の前菜6種、フォーは鶏かチャーシュー (海老・牛は+100〜150円)、デザート、ベトナムコーヒーか蓮茶、パクチーは別添え、シェフと女性のもてなし、予約が必要。

cultural_comfort.note: Hosts explain each dish; no vegetarian or vegan changes; book ahead.

places.name: 日本料理 藤井 (Nihon Ryori Fujii)
places.gf_detail: Ask: the shop asks for allergies and dislikes at booking (official site); courses include tempura (sesame-tofu tempura is a signature) and soy- and dashi-based dishes (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every meal starts from a kombu-and-bonito dashi (official site; January 2025); fish courses such as hamo and sea bream.
places.hours_raw: Official site: last entry 11:30–13:30 for lunch and 17:00–20:00 for dinner (Tabelog: 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:00); closed Wednesday. Book online or by phone; tell the shop about allergies, dislikes and wishes when booking. Kaiseki at three prices — ¥8,000, ¥15,000 and ¥20,000+ — plus consumption tax and a 10% service charge (official site). Cancellation fees: 30% two days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day (official site). 18 seats: counter and private rooms (one for 4; up to 20). Non-smoking. Cards (Visa, Master) and QR; no e-money. No parking. A renovated old house a minute from the Philosopher's Path; 7 min walk from Honen-in, 8 min from Ginkaku-ji (official site).
places.neighborhood: Philosopher's Path, below Ginkaku-ji — 1 min from the Minamidacho bus stop
places.cuisine: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki that begins with a cup of dashi, in an old house by the Philosopher's Path (official site; 2023–2026 reviews) · no fixed menu — courses change monthly at ¥8,000, ¥15,000 and ¥20,000+ (plus tax and 10% service) (official site) · signature fried sesame tofu; hamo and eel in summer; firefly squid, bamboo shoots and cherry salmon in spring; sea bream rice with sesame sauce; a New Year appetizer platter (2024–2026 reviews) · house shibazuke pickles for sale (July 2026); a separate pudding shop, 日本料理 藤井のぷりん, on Shijo-Teramachi (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Philosopher's Path, dashi first] A calm kaiseki restaurant in a renovated house a minute from the Philosopher's Path, where every meal opens with a cup of dashi: monthly courses from ¥8,000 at lunch, with fried sesame tofu and summer hamo the dishes people remember, at a counter facing the chef or in rooms overlooking maples. Reviewers mention a Michelin star (2024–2025). Plus 10% service; cancellation fees. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site, 藤井 孝之輔 trained at 高台寺 和久傳 and 櫻川, became head chef of 水円 in Gion-Yasaka, and opened 日本料理 藤井 near Ginkaku-ji in February 2018; the hobbies listed are skiing, futsal and driving. The site describes the cooking as "質実、枯淡" — plain and austere — for newcomers to Japanese food and connoisseurs alike. Reviewers from 2023 to 2026 describe a stylishly renovated old house where every table looks onto seasonal plants, a counter facing the chef, careful tableware, and a one-Michelin-star rating (February 2024; January 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: From the site: "日本料理 藤井での食事のはじまりは、出汁から。全ての料理の礎です。" (a meal here begins with dashi — the foundation of every dish).
chef_bio.specialty: Fried sesame tofu; hamo.

anecdotes.text: January 2025: "Upon sitting down, I was first served today's dashi (broth), which I believe was made with kombu kelp and katsuo (bonito)."
February 2024: "Points were deducted for not accepting invoices and phone responsiveness, but the taste is undoubtedly exceptional."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 日本料理 藤井、食事のはじまりは出汁から、全ての料理の礎、おしながきはなく月ごとに内容をかえる、苦手なもの・アレルギー・要望は予約時に、質実・枯淡、銀閣寺・哲学の道の近く、左京区浄土寺上南田町九十一、水曜定休、最終入店 11:30〜13:30・17:00〜20:00、会席は8,000円・15,000円・20,000円〜、別途消費税とサービス料10%、キャンセル料 (2日前30%、前日50%、当日100%)、駐車場なし、哲学の道より徒歩1分、店主 藤井 孝之輔は「高台寺 和久傳」「櫻川」などで修行し祇園・八坂「水円」の料理長を経て2018年2月に開店、趣味はスキー・フットサル・ドライブ。食べログ: 日本料理 藤井、18席、個室 (4名、20名まで)、禁煙、カード (VISA・Master)・QR可、電子マネー不可、姉妹店に日本料理 藤井のぷりん (四条寺町)。口コミ (2023年10月〜2026年7月、英語): 最初に昆布と鰹の出汁、胡麻豆腐の天ぷら、鱧、鰻、ホタルイカ、筍、桜鱒、鯛の胡麻だれご飯、お正月の八寸、紅葉の見える個室、ミシュラン一つ星という声、柴漬けの販売、インボイスと電話対応で減点という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; state allergies when booking; 10% service; cancellation fees.

places.name: レストラン ディディ (DiDi)
places.gf_detail: Ask: Indian-style curries with white or brown rice, but roux, cakes and the Thai and green curries are not described for wheat (2022–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: a vegetable curry set is on the menu (May 2023), but the korma uses fresh cream and other curries are chicken (2022–2023 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Wednesday and Thursday (the next day when either is a public holiday). No reservations. 18 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; take-away. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 1 min walk from Eizan Railway Mototanaka Stn.
places.neighborhood: Mototanaka — 1 min walk from Eizan Railway Mototanaka Stn
places.cuisine: A long-standing neighbourhood curry house by Mototanaka Station, Indian-leaning with a few Thai curries (2016–2025 reviews) · chicken curry; North Indian korma of coconut and fresh cream, regular ¥1,100, large ¥1,200 (September 2022); vegetable curry set ¥1,000 with achaar (May 2023); Thai curry; green curry with konjac (April 2025) · white or brown rice; a meat-and-potato side; flowers on every table (2023) · home-made cakes: carrot cake with nuts, apple crumble (April 2025)
places.notes: [Curry · Mototanaka, a decades-old neighbourhood curry house] A small curry house a minute from Mototanaka Station on the Eizan line: well-balanced Indian-style chicken, korma and vegetable curries with white or brown rice, a green curry with konjac, and home-made carrot cake and apple crumble. A diner back after 20 years found the taste and staff unchanged (October 2025); another found it just okay (October 2023). Cash only; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2016 to 2025 describe a long-running local curry house with flowers on each table and the same staff over decades; one diner returning after about 20 years found it unchanged (October 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken curry; korma.

anecdotes.text: October 2025: "I visited after about 20 years… It's spicy, but the heat dissipates quickly… The pleasant spiciness and the familiar atmosphere created by the same staff made me emotional."
September 2022: "The balance of spices is excellent; nothing stands out excessively, yet the spices are aromatic."
October 2023: "It's just okay."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: レストラン ディディ (DiDi)、インドカレー・インド料理、左京区田中大久保町22、叡山電鉄元田中駅から徒歩1分、11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、水・木休み (祝日なら翌日)、予約不可、18席、禁煙、子供可、持ち帰り可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2016年5月〜2025年10月、英語): チキンカレー、北インドのコルマ (ココナッツと生クリーム、並1,100円・大1,200円)、野菜カレーのセット1,000円とアチャール、タイカレー、こんにゃく入りのグリーンカレー、白米か玄米、肉じゃがのような付け合わせ、テーブルに花、キャロットケーキ、アップルクランブル、20年ぶりでも同じ味と同じスタッフという声、まあまあという声、アチャールが酸っぱいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Small local curry house; cash only.

places.name: ポンジーズテーブル (Pongee's Table)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pancakes, fried shrimp, aji and oyster fry, karaage, gratin and demi-glace (2022–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, fried meat and fish, omurice, custard pancakes (2022–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu, Sat, Sun 11:30–21:00; Wed 11:00–21:00; closed Friday and irregular days (see the blog). Lunch 11:30–15:00; tea time 11:30–21:00 and dinner 18:00–21:00 (last orders 20:00). Reservations taken. 18 seats: a 4-seat counter, tables and two low tatami tables. No smoking until 15:00, then a designated smoking area. Children welcome. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Waits at busy times (July 2024). On Senbon-dori just north of Imadegawa, at the Senbon-Kamidachiuri bus stop.
places.neighborhood: Senbon-Kamidachiuri, north of Kitano Tenmangu — at the bus stop
places.cuisine: A yoshoku-and-pancake café in a renovated Kyoto townhouse, about 15 years on Senbon-dori (2022–2026 reviews) · combination plates — pick two or three of about ten: demi-glace hamburg, fried shrimp, ginger pork, karaage, aji fry, oyster fry, chicken with green-onion ponzu — with miso soup and multigrain rice, about ¥1,400 (May 2026); a "night lunch" version in the evening (July 2026) · hamburg omurice with demi-glace and cheese; curry and tomato gratin; shiso pasta (2023–2026) · pancakes such as custard brûlée; hojicha latte +¥200 with a meal (2023–2024)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Senbon-Imadegawa, pick-your-own plates and pancakes] A homely yoshoku café in a renovated townhouse on Senbon-dori near Kitano Tenmangu: pick two or three of hamburg, fried shrimp, ginger pork or karaage with rice and miso soup for about ¥1,400, or hamburg omurice and pancakes. Diners mention waits and hard-to-flag service (March 2023, July 2024) and so-so coffee (November 2023). Cash only; closed Friday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2022 to 2026 describe a renovated Kyoto townhouse with chair and tatami seating, a home-like feel, and a fifteenth anniversary in July 2026. A regular has logged 17 visits since 2015 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Choose-your-sides plate; hamburg omurice.

anecdotes.text: July 2024: "I had to wait quite a while outside the restaurant, and even after entering, I had to wait to place my order and for the food to arrive."
July 2026: the "night lunch" of kara-age, ebi fry and hamburg "felt like an adult version of a kids' meal, which was fun… It seems they are celebrating their 15th anniversary!"
March 2023: "The taste and presentation were good, but the service was lacking. It was hard to get their attention."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ポンジーズテーブル、パンケーキ・洋食、上京区千本通五辻上る牡丹鉾町567-1、市バス千本上立売すぐ、月火木土日 11:30〜21:00・水 11:00〜21:00、金曜休み、不定休はブログで、ランチ11:30〜15:00、ティータイム11:30〜21:00、ディナー18:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:00)、予約可、18席 (カウンター4、テーブル、座卓2)、15時まで禁煙・以降は喫煙所、子供可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2022年3月〜2026年7月、英語): 10種ほどから2〜3品選ぶ盛り合わせ (デミのハンバーグ、海老フライ、生姜焼き、唐揚げ、アジフライ、カキフライ、鶏のねぎポン酢) と味噌汁と雑穀米で約1,400円、夜の「夜ランチ」、デミのハンバーグオムライスとチーズ、カレーとトマトのグラタン、大葉のパスタ、カスタードブリュレのパンケーキ、ほうじ茶ラテ+200円、京町家を改装、15周年、待ち時間が長いという声、店員を呼びにくいという声、コーヒーはいまひとつという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Homely local café; cash only.

places.name: アオゾラ (Aozora)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Thai curries with rice — green, red, yellow, peanut — plus khao man gai, karaage and spring rolls; fish sauce is used and no gluten information is given (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the curries carry chicken or shrimp and fish sauce (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Irregular days off are posted on a board out front each month (October 2024). Reservations accepted; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 16 seats with a counter (Tabelog). Up a steep stair to the second floor of the K-SIDE building (Tabelog; October 2024). About 7 min on foot from Keihan Demachiyanagi Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Kyoto University — 7 min from Demachiyanagi
places.cuisine: A Thai curry café of about twenty years’ standing (August 2024) · green, red, yellow and peanut curries and the house Aozora curry (2024–2026); the peanut curry is a regulars’ favourite (2025–2026) · daily lunch curry with a mini drink, salad and egg (October 2024); lunch set ¥1,200 (February 2026) · mini curry set with khao man gai ¥1,650 (July 2026) · spicy shrimp curry, spring rolls, chicken-skin karaage (2024–2025) · lassi, coconut-milk pudding (2026) · even “medium” is quite hot (May 2026)
places.notes: [Thai curry · near Kyoto University, the peanut curry] A long-running, cosy Thai curry café up a steep staircase near Kyoto University: coconut-rich green, yellow and red curries, a much-loved peanut curry, and khao man gai sets around ¥1,200–1,650 with lassi. Cash only; closed Thursday, with extra days off posted out front.

chef_bio.background: A longtime customer dates the shop to the mid-2000s, about twenty years in business (August 2024); another returned after more than ten years (October 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Peanut curry; green curry.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor who avoids spicy food came for the peanut curry, then returned in May because it was unforgettable.
A July 2026 regular chose Aozora over a sake-brewery stop, reasoning that Thai curry wins in the heat.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: アオゾラ、カレー・タイ料理、左京区田中門前町23 K-SIDEビル2F、京阪出町柳駅から徒歩7分、12:00〜15:00、17:30〜21:00、木曜定休、予約可、現金のみ、16席、貸切20名まで。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 20年ほど続くタイカレーの店、グリーン・レッド・イエロー・ピーナッツのカレー、アオゾラカレー、日替わりのランチカレー、ランチセット1,200円、カオマンガイとミニカレーのセット1,650円、エビのカレー、春巻き、鶏皮の唐揚げ、ラッシー、ココナッツミルクのプリン、店の前の板に月の休みを掲示、急な階段。

cultural_comfort.note: Small upstairs café; cash only; steep stairs.

places.name: zushi curry ＆ ぱん屋LeuCocoRyne
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a croissant bakery; the curry comes with rice or as a doria, but the kitchen is built around wheat pastry and no gluten information is given (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter croissants, and the curry is made with Omi beef tendon (official site).
places.hours_raw: 8:00–18:00 (December–February L.O. 17:00) (official site); closed Tuesday (Tabelog); hours may change (Tabelog). Breakfast from 8:00 to 10:30 with a croissant of your choice (December 2025). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 13 seats with a counter (Tabelog). One minute on foot from the Jodoji bus stop, near the Philosopher’s Path and Ginkakuji (Tabelog; reviews).
places.neighborhood: Jodoji, near the Philosopher’s Path — 1 min from the Jodoji bus stop
places.cuisine: A croissant bakery that also serves curry (official site; reviews) · zushi curry with a mini salad ¥950 — Omi beef tendon simmered in red wine with Awaji onions, cooked without added water, mild (official site) · croissants, the shop’s draw (December 2025); a croissant sandwich of Kyoto ice cream and anko is popular (official site); vanilla and matcha croissant sandwiches (June 2024) · breakfast 8:00–10:30 with a croissant of your choice and coffee (December 2025) · curry doria and keema dishes (2022–2023) · the French AOP-butter croissant has been discontinued for lack of supplies (official site)
places.notes: [Croissants and curry · Jodoji, near the Philosopher’s Path] A small bakery-café a minute from the Jodoji bus stop, known for its butter croissants — at breakfast from 8:00 or as ice-cream-and-anko sandwiches — and for a mild Omi-beef-tendon “zushi curry” (¥950). Cash only; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Earlier reviewers describe one young man running the shop alone (November 2022) and an owner who imports goods from places such as Turkey for sale in the shop (January 2023).
chef_bio.specialty: Croissants; zushi curry.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 visitor called the croissants alone worth the trip.
A June 2024 hiker came down from Mount Daimon for a matcha croissant sandwich with additive-free Kyoto ice cream.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: zushi curry & ぱん屋LeuCocoRyne、左京区浄土寺下南田町23、営業時間8:00〜18:00 (12〜2月は17:00 L.O.)、ずしかれー (ミニサラダ付き) 950円、近江牛のすじを赤ワインで煮込み淡路島の玉ねぎ、水や調味料を加えずに作るまろやかなカレー、京都のアイスとあんこのクロワッサンサンド、AOPバターのクロワッサンは原材料不足のため終売。食べログ: カレー・パン・カフェ、浄土寺バス停から徒歩1分、火曜定休、予約不可、現金のみ、13席。口コミ (2024〜2025年、英語): クロワッサンが名物、8:00〜10:30の朝食は好きなクロワッサンを選べる、バニラと抹茶のクロワッサンサンド。

cultural_comfort.note: Small bakery-café; cash only.
