places.name: 京湯どうふ 喜さ起 (Kyoyu Dofu Kisaki)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog tags gluten-free options, but no dish is described as gluten-free; the yudofu comes with a soy-based dipping sauce, the sets include tempura, and awafu dengaku is made with wheat gluten (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog tags vegan and vegetarian options, but the yudofu uses the shop’s traditional dashi and comes with bonito flakes, and the sets include shrimp tempura (Tabelog; April 2026).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–19:15 (L.O. food 18:00, drinks 18:45); closed Wednesday; in February and on weekdays from June to September it may close at 16:00 when there are no reservations (Tabelog). Reservations accepted — tatami seating unless a table is requested; in autumn-leaf season large tables may be shared and groups over 11 should phone (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし — the English translation is wrong). Cards, IC cards, e-money, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 82 seats in tatami rooms and an annex with tables; private rooms (Tabelog). Smart-casual dress requested (Tabelog). English, Traditional Chinese and Korean menus; English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Free parking for 5 cars (Tabelog). Two minutes on foot from the Minamida-cho bus stop, 6 min from the Jodoji stop (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Near Honen-in and Ginkakuji — 2 min from the Minamida-cho bus stop
places.cuisine: A yudofu restaurant of about 50 years with a stone-garden view (Tabelog) · Kyoyu Dofu set ¥2,618: yudofu with dipping sauce and ginger, green onion, bonito flakes and nori, goma-dofu, and tempura of shrimp, yuba and vegetables, with rice and pickles (March–April 2026) · premium yudofu set with two shrimp tempura ¥3,600 (August 2026) · awafu dengaku ¥825; fresh yuba sashimi ¥935 (April 2026) · seasonal set meals (Tabelog) · sake, and bottled beer only (May 2026)
places.notes: [Yudofu · near Honen-in and the Philosopher’s Path, about 50 years] A long-established tofu restaurant in a quiet Japanese house with tatami rooms and a stone-garden view: smooth yudofu in the house dashi, rich goma-dofu and yuba tempura in sets from ¥2,618. English menu and staff; free parking; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T7810562887990 is registered to the individual 折田 真人 (NTA register). The shop’s Tabelog text says it has been open about 50 years and that its yudofu dashi is unchanged since it was founded; an August 2026 guest returned after 40 years and found the tofu unchanged.
chef_bio.philosophy: The yudofu dashi has not changed since the founding (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Yudofu; goma-dofu.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 group of seven came down from Daimonji on a near-30-degree day and recovered over yudofu.
A May 2026 visitor was given a window seat cleared specially for the view.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京湯どうふ 喜さ起、豆腐料理・日本料理・鍋、左京区浄土寺南田町173-19、南田町バス停から徒歩2分、11:00〜19:15 (L.O.料理18:00、ドリンク18:45)、水曜定休、2月と6〜9月の平日は予約がなければ16時まで、予約可 (座敷優先)、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー可、82席、個室あり、スマートカジュアル、英語・繁体字・韓国語のメニュー、無料駐車場5台、創業50年、創業以来変わらない湯豆腐の出汁、枯山水の見える座敷、ベジタリアン・ヴィーガン・グルテンフリー対応のタグ、適格請求書 T7810562887990 (折田 真人)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 京湯どうふのセット2,618円 (湯豆腐、胡麻豆腐、エビ・湯葉・野菜の天ぷら)、上のセット3,600円、粟麩田楽825円、生湯葉の刺身935円、薬味にかつお節、瓶ビールのみ、40年ぶりの再訪。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); shoes off in tatami rooms; smart casual.

places.name: La Part Dieu
places.gf_detail: Ask. Vegetable-led French courses — potages, the “flower crown” vegetable starter, fish and meat mains with several sauces, bread on the side; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the courses are rich in vegetables (the flower crown uses dozens of kinds, May 2024), but the mains are fish or meat and nothing is described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–20:30; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 10 seats (Tabelog). BYO drinks allowed (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). Run by one person (March, May and December 2025). About 180 m from Eizan Mototanaka Station (Tabelog). Opened 21 February 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Tanaka, near Eizan Mototanaka Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal French courses with a focus on vegetables (Tabelog; reviews) · the signature “flower crown” starter of many vegetables and edible flowers (2024–2025) · A dinner course ¥5,940: amuse, a starter and main of your choice, a seasonal vegetable dish, dessert, kuromoji tea (October 2026) · potages such as new onion with shichimi or a walnut-topped soup (May–June 2025); three-hour-roasted Ohara carrots with orange purée (June 2025); pan-fried anglerfish with spicy tomato sauce; sea bream with root-on spinach; beef with nasturtium (2025) · mains split half-and-half when two people order differently (June 2025) · tea chosen by the owner to finish (December 2023)
places.notes: [French · Tanaka near Mototanaka, the vegetable flower crown] A ten-seat French restaurant with a green wall and a dark, calm room, cooked and served by one person: seasonal courses built around vegetables — the signature “flower crown” starter, rich potages, fish and meat with several sauces — from about ¥5,940 at dinner. Cash only; BYO allowed; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers say the restaurant is run by one person, who cooks and serves with good timing (March, May and December 2025), and who chooses the tea served at the end (December 2023).
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable “flower crown”; seasonal French courses.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 student plans to bring family here before graduating.
Two university friends reunited after 18 years over a Saturday lunch here (May 2025).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: La Part Dieu、フレンチ、左京区田中里ノ前町59、叡電元田中駅から179m、火〜日 12:00〜14:00、18:00〜20:30、月曜定休、予約可、現金のみ、10席、持ち込み可、ベジタリアン対応のタグ、2015年2月21日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ひとりで営む店、名物の野菜の「花の冠」、Aディナーコース5,940円 (アミューズ、選べる前菜とメイン、季節の野菜、デザート、クロモジ茶)、新玉ねぎのポタージュ、大原の人参、アンコウ、鯛、根付きのほうれん草、牛肉、緑の壁の落ち着いた店内。

cultural_comfort.note: Ten seats, one person cooking and serving — book; cash only.

places.name: 京のSAKESORA (Kyo no SAKESORA)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai small plates, kara-age, onigiri and pasta alongside beer (2026 reviews); kara-age and pasta contain wheat; no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based obanzai, grilled mackerel, octopus, kara-age (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00; Sat–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 15:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30) (Tabelog). The official site also advertises breakfast and lunch from 11:00 and, from June, no fixed closing day — check before a weekday lunch. Reservations accepted; lunch sets are limited to 15 a day and sell out, so book (Tabelog; March and May 2026). Appetizer ¥300 after 17:00 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「17:00以降つきだし300円」). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at the counter, a table for 4 and standing room (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). 5 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog). Listed opening date 1 February 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Stn north, west of Karasuma — 5 min from Kyoto Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto craft beer (6–8 on tap plus bottles) and 20–30 Kyoto sakes, with tasting sets of three (shop; 2026 reviews) · lunch of chosen obanzai and onigiri ¥2,000 (shop; October 2026) · obanzai such as pumpkin with white miso, octopus and cucumber, grilled mackerel, simmered egg with green pepper (July 2026) · kara-age, anchovy potatoes (April 2026), Kyoto green-onion peperoncino (March 2026) · hojicha beer (July 2026) · seven-dish course with a tasting set ¥6,000 (shop)
places.notes: [Craft beer and sake bar · Kyoto Stn, Kyoto drinks with obanzai] A small counter bar a few minutes from Kyoto Station pouring Kyoto craft beers and a wide range of Kyoto sake in tasting flights, with colourful obanzai lunches and evening small plates. Weekend daytime opening; lunch sets are limited, so book. ¥300 appetizer after 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and the official site: a café and dining bar devoted to Kyoto craft beer and sake, with obanzai and set lunches. A September 2026 review describes a young, casually dressed team of three.
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto beer and sake with Japanese food — the site says craft beer suits washoku as well as fish and chips.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto craft beer and sake tasting sets; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor came in out of the rain, had the staff suggest sakes to taste one after another, and came back the next night for the hojicha beer.
A March 2026 weekend lunch booked just after 13:00 found the popular lunch set already sold out.
An October 2026 pair took the beer and sake tasting courses on a busy Saturday and praised the timing and the explanation of each dish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー、下京区西境町162 日々是好日 1F 東、京都駅から徒歩5分、月〜金17:00〜23:00、土日11:00〜15:00と15:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、予約可、17時以降つきだし300円、カード・PayPay 可、15席 (カウンター7、テーブル4、立ち席)、禁煙、オープン日2024年2月1日。公式サイト: 京都のクラフトビールと日本酒、おばんざい、モーニング・ランチ・ダイニングバー、6月から定休日なし。口コミ (2026年1月〜10月、英語): ビールと日本酒の飲み比べ、おばんざいとおにぎりのランチ2,000円、唐揚げ、ほうじ茶のビール、ランチは売り切れることも。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seats suit solo drinkers; staff suggest beers and sakes to taste; book lunch. No English evidence found.

places.name: 智積院茶寮 桔梗 (Chishakuin Saryo Kikyo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Set meals include tempura and fried dishes, soy-seasoned simmered dishes and udon or soba (official menu); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: The Shojin Gozen is marked vegetarian and vegan, made with plant ingredients and a kombu and shiitake dashi (official site, Japanese text: 「植物性食材と昆布・椎茸の出汁で仕立てた、ベジタリアン・ヴィーガン対応の精進御膳」). Other sets, such as the dashimaki and tempura sets, are not marked vegan. Reviews also describe a limited shojin afternoon tea (July 2026).
places.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–20:00: café 10:00–20:00, lunch 11:00–14:30, dinner 17:00–20:00 (last order 19:30) (Tabelog). Breakfast is served to guests of the temple lodge (May 2026). Reservations accepted; call for 10 or more (Tabelog). Occasional temporary closures are posted on the official site. Cards incl. UnionPay; e-money; QR incl. PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 36 seats incl. a round counter (Tabelog; February 2026). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Ground floor of Chishakuin Kaikan, the temple lodge of Chishakuin; 10 min from Keihan Shichijo, 5 min from the Higashiyama Shichijo bus stop (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama Shichijo, inside Chishakuin temple — near Sanjusangendo
places.cuisine: Temple shojin cuisine and Kyoto set meals (official site) · Shojin Gozen ¥3,520: seasonal dressed dish, simmered dishes, fried dish, rice, pickles, Negoro-jiru soup, dessert — marked vegan (official menu) · Dashimaki Gozen ¥2,530 with fresh yuba; Tempura Gozen ¥2,750; tempura rice bowl set ¥1,760; yuba udon or soba ¥1,650 (official menu) · dinner box Kikyo ¥3,630 (official menu) · limited shojin afternoon tea by reservation (July 2026) · yuba rice bowl set (October 2026)
places.notes: [Shojin and Kyoto set meals · Higashiyama Shichijo, inside Chishakuin temple] The restaurant and café of the Chishakuin temple lodge, near Sanjusangendo, with a round counter and garden views. The Shojin Gozen is plant-based with a kombu and shiitake dashi and marked vegan by the restaurant; dashimaki, yuba and tempura sets too, plus a limited shojin afternoon tea. Open daily 10:00–20:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the tearoom (saryo) of Chishakuin, the head temple of the Shingon Chisan school, serving the temple's shojin cuisine and Kyoto dishes, on the ground floor of Chishakuin Kaikan. Operated by 株式会社ハトヤ瑞鳳閣 (official company page). Reviews in 2026 describe the lodge renovated to hotel standard.
chef_bio.philosophy: Shojin cuisine as practised at the temple: no meat or fish, seasonal plant ingredients (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Shojin Gozen with Negoro-jiru soup; dashimaki and yuba sets.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 regular of Chishakuin chose the dashimaki set over the shojin set and noted the tearoom had been remade, smaller, with a round counter suited to solo diners.
A July 2026 visitor had the newly launched shojin afternoon tea, limited to 10 a day, and could not finish it.
An August 2026 diner was surprised that the clear soup used a shiitake dashi, and missed meat and fish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 総本山智積院の茶寮、智積院会館内、精進料理と京料理、精進御膳3,520円 (ベジタリアン・ヴィーガン対応、植物性食材と昆布・椎茸の出汁)、だし巻き御膳2,530円、天ぷら御膳2,750円、天丼セット1,760円、湯葉のセット1,650円、お重「ききょう」3,630円、根来汁700円、運営は株式会社ハトヤ瑞鳳閣。食べログ: 日本料理、東山区東大路通り七条下ル東瓦町964 智積院会館 1F、毎日10:00〜20:00 (ランチ11:00〜14:30、ディナー17:00〜20:00、カフェ10:00〜20:00)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、36席、禁煙。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 精進のアフタヌーンティー、湯葉丼、丸いカウンター、宿坊の朝食。

cultural_comfort.note: Temple setting but a café-style room with a round counter; the vegan shojin set is named on the menu; Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted. No English evidence found.

places.name: 焼鳥をのじ (Yakitori Onoji)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Mostly salt-grilled skewers (2025 reviews); a tare sauce is also used (June 2025); no gluten information.

places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 17:30–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30; last entry 22:00); closed Sunday, with occasional extra closures — call ahead (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised; often full (Tabelog; October 2025, February 2026). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). No appetizer charge (July 2025 review). 15 seats: 11 at the counter and a table for 4 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children who can sit at a seat welcome (Tabelog). On Marutamachi between Karasuma and Horikawa, 5 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; November 2025).
places.neighborhood: Marutamachi, between Karasuma and Horikawa — 5 min from Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori grilled over Tosa binchotan, mostly with salt: local jidori chicken, young chicken, rare cuts and organic vegetables (Tabelog) · skewers from ¥240 — heart, neck, liver, bonjiri; wings and salt tsukune ¥310 (July 2025) · omakase skewers on request (Tabelog; September 2026) · grilled Kamo eggplant (October 2025), blue-cheese potato salad, grilled skirt with ponzu (February 2026) · grilled rice ball with fermented butter (2025–26 reviews); chicken rice bowl (December 2025)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Marutamachi, salt-grilled skewers over binchotan] A 15-seat counter on Marutamachi where an owner with over ten years in yakitori grills local jidori, rare cuts and seasonal vegetables over Tosa binchotan, mostly with salt; finish with the grilled rice ball with fermented butter. Rare cuts sell out — book and come early. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the owner has over ten years of yakitori experience. A July 2025 review says the owner trained at a well-known yakitori restaurant and that the shop had been open for about two years.
chef_bio.specialty: Salt-grilled jidori and rare cuts over Tosa binchotan.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 student phoned at 19:30 after a part-time shift, got one of the last counter seats, and named the grilled rice ball with fermented butter as the dish to end on.
A December 2025 regular on a sixth visit always finishes with the yakitori rice bowl.
A June 2025 diner liked the salt skewers but not the tare, and wished sold-out items were flagged when ordering.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼鳥、中京区玉植町227-1、地下鉄丸太町駅から徒歩5分、月〜土・祝17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30、最終入店22:00)、日曜休み、不定休あり、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、15席 (カウンター11、4人テーブル1)、禁煙。店の紹介: 焼鳥歴10年以上の店主が、土佐備長炭で地鶏、若鶏、希少部位、有機野菜を焼く、おまかせも可、希少部位は早めに。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 塩が中心、串240円から、手羽とつくね310円、焼きおにぎりに発酵バター、Kamo のなす、売り切れが早い、いつも満席に近い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; ask for omakase and say which cuts to leave out; order rare cuts early. No English evidence found.

places.notes: [French · Kojinguchi, a one-chef lunch bistro] A long-running French bistro on Kawaramachi where one cheerful chef cooks, serves and clears alone: salad or terrine, soup, sea bream or beef, and homemade breads brought round again and again, from about ¥2,000. Cash only; a line can form at 11:30. Dinner by reservation only.

roles: Chef-owner (unnamed), cooking and serving alone (2022–25 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a French restaurant serving seasonal ingredients and homemade natural-yeast bread. Reviews from 2022 to 2025 describe one chef running the room alone; a February 2020 review noted it had reopened after a break.
chef_bio.philosophy: Credits the quality of the ingredients for the taste (June 2024 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Set French lunch with homemade breads.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor found a line before opening; at 11:30 the chef came out to check reservations, then ran the whole room alone.
A June 2024 regular marvelled at how one person kept every table in order without ever seeming rushed.
A February 2025 diner kept reaching for a rare sansho bread despite being full.

places.notes: [Indian and Nepalese · Nishijin, cheese-naan lunch] A big, cheerful Indian-Nepalese restaurant on Imadegawa near Omiya, open every day 11:00–22:00: ¥790 daily curry lunches with a huge naan, a much-loved cheese-naan set, biryani and Nepalese thukpa. Staff greet everyone with a warm “Namaste!”.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text promotes authentic Indian and Nepalese food by a Nepalese chef. Reviewers note a cheerful greeting of “Namaste!” at the door (December 2025) and smiling staff who thank guests all the way out (February 2026). Tabelog’s name search lists a second shop, at Senbon-Kitaoji.
chef_bio.specialty: Cheese naan; biryani.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 pair found the ¥3,850 pair set too much for two, and the staff offered to pack the leftovers.
A February 2026 group gave up on a long queue at a nearby ramen shop and called the spinach curry the best curry of a lifetime.

On the south side of JR Enmachi Station, about 150 m away (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 14 February 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Enmachi — south side of JR Enmachi Station

places.notes: [Curry · Enmachi Station, tandoor-grilled toppings] A small curry counter by JR Enmachi Station where one person grills chicken and seafood over charcoal in a tandoor to top smooth, coconut-and-tomato curries — tandoori seafood or lamb keema for ¥950. Order and pay first; cash only; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a shop run by one person (September 2025; February and May 2026). A sign at the entrance explains the name — “reverb”, the aftertaste — and the charcoal tandoor (February 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: A lingering aftertaste — “reverb” — and charcoal-grilled tandoor meat and fish (sign at the entrance, February 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Tandoori seafood curry; tandoori chicken curry.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 regular plans visits for days with time to wait, since one person does everything.
A September 2026 visitor, back after about eight years, arrived before the 11:30 opening and waited ten minutes.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a long-running taco shop by Mototanaka Station (December 2023), with books and a record player that suit a slow afternoon (October 2025).

An October 2025 regular recommends bringing a paperback rather than a phone — taco rice and a mojito on a hot afternoon.

places.cuisine: Italian with stone-oven pizza and craft beer; the name joins “novità” and “vecchio” (Tabelog) · lunch ¥1,200 with salad and bread and a pasta or pizza; course ¥2,400 with a main, dessert and drink; dessert trio +¥300 (October 2026) · full lunch course — appetizer, soup, pasta, pizza, fish, meat, dessert — ¥3,000 (October 2026) · salad with pomegranate-vinegar foam (2026) · pizzas such as quattro formaggi and Margherita with a chewy crust; carbonara with egg, pumpkin cream pasta (2026) · rice croquettes, gratin, ajillo, marinated salmon, Kuroge Wagyu steak (2026)
places.notes: [Italian · Enmachi Station, stone-oven pizza] A bright, high-ceilinged Italian on a second floor a minute from JR Enmachi Station: chewy stone-oven pizzas, pastas and good-value lunches from ¥1,200 to a ¥3,000 seven-part course, with craft beer at night. No service or cover charge; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text explains the name as a blend of the Italian “novità” (newness, creativity) and “vecchio” (old, well aged, like wine). Tabelog’s name search lists a second shop, at Saiin.
chef_bio.philosophy: Something new and something well aged (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Stone-oven pizza.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 group of four classmates around fifty ordered more pizza and pasta after the first round.
An October 2026 party of five liked that staff took orders in person instead of by QR code.

places.notes: [Takoyaki bar · Shogoin] A small octopus-themed counter where the owner makes big takoyaki to order in dozens of oddly named flavours — Kujo green onion, potato, mentaiko and lotus root — with octopus salad, rice and soup, and beer or sake. About ¥1,000–2,000. No cards; smoking allowed.

roles: Owner (given name, per reviews and the shop name)
chef_bio.background: Opened 17 September 2010 (Tabelog). A May 2026 regular had visited the earlier shop on Niomon-dori, event stalls and a second shop at Demachiyanagi before this Yoshida location. The shop runs a recurring music event, "Octopus Night" (vol. 6 on 10 January 2026, Kyoto City tourism site).
chef_bio.philosophy: A passionate octopus lover's menu of original takoyaki (March 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Kujo green onion takoyaki.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 regular of the old Niomon-dori shop sat at the counter with chilled tofu and two bottles of beer, watching eight Kujo green-onion takoyaki being made.
A May 2026 goshuin pilgrim stopped for lunch and had takoyaki, octopus rice, octopus salad and octopus soup.
In March 2025 a returning visitor started with the octopus salad, then tacos takoyaki and mentaiko-and-lotus-root takoyaki.

places.notes: [Korean home cooking · Higashikujo] A bright, recently renovated Korean spot south of Kyoto Station known for big portions: thick samgyeopsal sets wrapped in perilla, seafood jeon, tteokbokki and stews, and an all-you-can-eat-and-drink samgyeopsal plan at ¥4,500. Cards not taken (QR yes); closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Not stated on Tabelog. A July 2025 regular returning after a long gap found it renovated.
chef_bio.specialty: Samgyeopsal.

anecdotes.text: After visiting the new teamLab in Kyoto in October 2025, two friends had the ¥1,800 samgyeopsal set; the staff brought new chopsticks with a smile each of the three times one dropped them.
A September 2025 diner compared the seafood jeon and tteokbokki to food eaten in Seoul.
A pair of July 2026 diners sheltering from rain could not finish a shared stone-grilled bibimbap, bibim noodles and miso chige.

places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station Hachijo side — Kintetsu Meitengai Miyakomichi

places.notes: [Sushi & seasonal fish · Kyoto Station] A sushi counter in the Miyakomichi arcade, right by the Hachijo gates: quick lunch sets and seafood bowls for about ¥1,200–2,500 before a train, and seasonal dinners — returning bonito, big oysters, matsutake dobin-mushi — with sake for about ¥8,000–15,000. Open daily.

roles: Chefs (unnamed); run by 株式会社AYT (job listing)
chef_bio.background: Run by 株式会社AYT, per a public job listing that gives the shop as 「株式会社 AYT すし昌」 in Miyakomichi. Tabelog's shop text describes seasonal seafood from skilled chefs and an omakase course.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal seafood and chef's-choice sushi right at Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood bowl; seasonal fish.

anecdotes.text: With little time before a Shinkansen in March 2026, a returning diner asked for something quick and got a thick-cut seafood bowl that beat expectations.
An October 2026 party celebrated a mentor's retirement over seasonal dishes, matsutake dobin-mushi and sake, finishing with nigiri.
A January 2025 lunch diner found the recommended set ordinary and the staff's teamwork in need of work, though the red miso soup was good.

places.notes: [Custom-pizza diner · Kyoto Aquarium] A bright American-style diner a minute from the Kyoto Aquarium bus stop: build-your-own pizzas, Margherita from about ¥1,000, BBQ beef, buffalo wings and onion rings, and half-pizza lunch sets. English and kids' menus; family-friendly. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 9 January 2023 (Tabelog). An October 2025 reviewer lists sister restaurants — Apitt Burger (Arashiyama, Minami-Kusatsu, Kinugasa), Craft Dining Apitt (Sanjo) and Rice Overalls (Seika) — and says the shop supports urban sports such as BMX and breaking, with many staff experienced in double dutch, shown on the in-shop screens. The name is Greek for "leisure" (same review).
chef_bio.specialty: Custom pizza.

anecdotes.text: A family of four in December 2025 made a custom pizza with Kujo green onion and shirasu on the son's suggestion; the parents liked it best.
An August 2025 organiser booked a 2–4 p.m. private lunch for about 15 before a match, on the ¥4,000 party course.
A March 2026 diner was charmed to get ginger ale in the old green Canada Dry bottle with a chilled glass.

places.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options; lentil-and-vegetable and chickpea curries, and a mixed-vegetable black curry, are on the menu, but butter and ghee are not ruled out (2020–2023 reviews).

Behind 天下一品 総本店 in Ichijoji; a car park next door (January 2025). Opened 24 July 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ichijoji / Kitashirakawa — 10 min walk from Eizan Chayama or Ichijoji Stns
places.cuisine: A tiny spice-curry counter run by a couple, behind Tenkaippin's main shop (2020–2026 reviews) · "double curry" of two from: very hot spicy black curry (chicken, pork, lamb or mixed vegetables), spicy keema, lentil-and-vegetable, mild chickpea, or the day's special such as butter chicken or butter shrimp; with papad and a salad (¥1,000 in August 2022, ¥1,100 in February 2023; single and double the same price, April 2026) · coriander on the side; lassi (2025) · spice level can be adjusted on request (January 2025)
places.notes: [Spice curry · Ichijoji, a couple's ten-seat counter] A tiny counter behind Tenkaippin's main shop where a couple cook each curry to order: a two-curry plate pairing the fierce black curry with keema, lentils or mild chickpeas, with papad and salad, at the same price as a single. Expect a wait and real heat. Cash only; closed Thursday.

roles: Run by a couple, not named (April 2023 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 24 July 2014 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2017 to 2026 describe a snack-bar-like counter with an Indian-style interior, a couple who recommend the double curry, curries cooked fresh after ordering, and a salad from the owner while you wait.
chef_bio.specialty: Spicy black curry; keema.

anecdotes.text: April 2023: "The couple running the restaurant recommended trying the double curry… the extremely spicy black curry was the hottest I've ever tasted."
January 2025: "While you can adjust the spice level upon request, I won't say anything because it's already quite spicy here."
April 2026: "I appreciated that both the single and combination curry were priced the same."

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef, fish and croquette mains; consommé (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: weekdays 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; weekends and holidays 11:00–16:00 and 17:00–22:00 (last order 20:40); closing days follow Takashimaya Kyoto. Reservations taken; often a table without one on weekdays (2026 reviews). 86 seats; a private room for 8. No smoking until 17:00, smoking seats after (Tabelog). Strollers manageable — wide spacing (August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR. Take-away. Takashimaya Kyoto 7F, connected to Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn.
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Kawaramachi — Takashimaya Kyoto 7F
places.cuisine: The casual department-store branch of the old Kyoto French house 萬養軒 (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · lunch set of salad, potage, bread or rice and a main — snow-crab cream croquettes, braised beef cheek, breaded pork cutlet — about ¥2,400 (¥2,420 in May 2026) · "Recommended course" ¥4,950 with consommé jelly, appetizers, strip-loin steak or pan-seared sea bream and dessert (January 2026); "Rose" course of turnip mousse with seafood, corn potage, sea bream, beef steak and dessert (2024–2026) · onion spumante; coffee (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [French · Takashimaya Kyoto 7F, the old house's casual branch] The department-store branch of 萬養軒, which reviewers date to 1904: lunch sets of potage, salad and a crab-croquette or beef-cheek main for about ¥2,400, and good-value courses with steak or sea bream, in a quiet, roomy dining room. One diner found the courses came too fast (November 2025); another thought the pork cutlet just okay (August 2026). Smoking seats after 17:00.

roles: Not named in a source; branch of ぎをん 萬養軒 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the group is ぎをん 萬養軒 (the French restaurant on Hanamikoji, opposite the Gion Kaburenjo; lunch ¥7,000 and ¥9,000, dinner ¥15,000 and ¥19,000 from April 2025) and this MANYOKEN style shop in Takashimaya Kyoto, and it takes 萬養軒 to department-store Kyoto fairs. Two September 2026 reviewers say 萬養軒 was founded in 1904 as Kyoto's first French restaurant, formerly on Shijo-dori, and one recalls Princess Diana dining there and the writer Shotaro Ikenami as a regular.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets; crab cream croquettes; beef-cheek stew.

anecdotes.text: November 2025: "It felt like the dishes were coming out so quickly that I finished my meal in no time… Next time, I will make sure to request a slower pace."
September 2026: "When I was younger, I admired Manyoken on Shijo Street and visited it alone, nervously trying the consommé."
August 2026: the breaded pork cutlet "was delicious, but I felt it was just okay."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ぎをん 萬養軒、フランス料理、本店は東山区祇園町南側570-120 2F (花見小路四条下ル、祇園歌舞練場前、火・水定休)、MANYOKEN style 京都 高島屋店 (定休日は百貨店と同じ)、2025年4月からランチ7,000円・9,000円、ディナー15,000円・19,000円 (税・サービス料込、本店)、京都展の催事に出店。食べログ: MANYOKEN style 京都高島屋店、フレンチ、下京区四条通河原町西入ル真町52 京都タカシマヤ 7F、平日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、土日祝 11:00〜16:00・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 20:40)、休みは高島屋に準じる、予約可、86席、個室 (8名)、17時まで禁煙・以降は喫煙席あり、カード・電子マネー・QR可、持ち帰り可。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): サラダ・ポタージュ・パンかご飯とメインのランチ (ズワイガニのクリームコロッケ、牛ほほ肉、豚のカツレツ) 2,420円、おすすめコース4,950円 (コンソメのジュレ、前菜、ロースのステーキか鯛のポワレ、デザート)、ローズコース、玉ねぎのスプマンテ、1904年創業の京都初のフランス料理店という声、ダイアナ妃や池波正太郎の話、料理が出るのが早すぎたという声、カツレツはまあまあという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Department-store restaurant floor; reservations taken.

places.name: 村上重本店 (Murakami Ju Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask: senmaizuke is turnip, kombu and salt per Takashimaya's description, but other pickles may use soy sauce; check labels (Takashimaya; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: vegetable pickles (senmaizuke, shibazuke, Mibuna, takuan) are plant-based in principle, but seasonings such as bonito extract are not described; check labels (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 9:00–18:00; closed 1–3 January. A pickle shop with no eating or drinking space — take-away and shipping only (Tabelog; January 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX), transit IC, QUICPay, QR. Senmaizuke is seasonal (winter; sold out by early March 2026). In a lane behind Edion, south-east of the Shijo-Kawaramachi crossing, by the Takase river (Tabelog; reviews).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Kawaramachi, Nishikiyamachi — 2 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: A Kyoto pickle maker founded in 1832, its main shop by the Takase river (Takashimaya) · take-away only: winter senmaizuke of Shogoin turnip with thick kombu, not sweet; shibazuke (year-round bestseller); tsubozuke takuan; Mibuna; yuzu daikon; nanohana; Kyo Takase; mustard pickles (Takashimaya; 2024–2026 reviews) · main-shop-only items: mushrooms simmered with sansho, hime-shoga (young ginger) with a short shelf life (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kyoto pickles · Shijo-Kawaramachi, an 1832 pickle house] The main shop of a pickle maker dating from 1832, in a lane by the Takase river just off Shijo-Kawaramachi: winter senmaizuke heavy with kombu, shibazuke all year, and shop-only sansho mushrooms and young ginger that keep only days. A shop, not a restaurant — no eating space. Open daily 9:00–18:00.

chef_bio.background: Takashimaya's food column describes 村上重本店 as a pickle maker founded in Tenpo 3 (1832) in Sendo-cho, Shimogyo-ku, making pickles that bring out the vegetables' own taste, with senmaizuke of Shogoin turnip and shibazuke its best-known items; Takashimaya stocks it in eight stores. Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe a handsome old shopfront, tasting samples, and items sold only at the main shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Senmaizuke; shibazuke.

anecdotes.text: December 2025: senmaizuke "packed with thick slices of kombu kelp… Once you get used to this flavor, you won't be able to go back to sweet senmai."
March 2026: in early March "I found a notice in the store saying that the season had ended" for senmaizuke.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 村上重本店、その他、下京区西木屋町四条下る船頭町190、四条河原町の南東、毎日 9:00〜18:00、1月1日〜3日休み、予約不可、漬物店で飲食スペースなし、持ち帰り、カード (JCB・AMEX)・交通系IC・QUICPay・QR可。高島屋のコラム: 1832 (天保三) 年創業、下京区船頭町、野菜本来の味をいかす漬物、聖護院かぶと昆布と塩の千枚漬、通年のいちばん人気はしば漬、高島屋の8店で取り扱い。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年6月、英語): 甘くない昆布たっぷりの千枚漬 (冬季、3月初めに終了)、しば漬、つぼ漬たくあん、壬生菜、柚子大根、菜の花、Kyo Takase、からし漬、本店限定のきのこの山椒煮と姫しょうが、試食、エディオンの裏の路地。

cultural_comfort.note: Shop only — no eating space; tasting samples.

places.name: お酒とごはんと たか (Osake to Gohan to Taka)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, fried pork, spring rolls, keema curry, soy-based dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led izakaya — sashimi, cured mackerel, dashi tofu (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 16:00–23:00; closed Tuesday. Book on weekends (April 2025). Appetiser charge ¥1,000 — Tabelog, Japanese original 「お通し代1,000円」 (reviewers paid ¥700–800 in 2024–2025). 12 seats: an 8-seat counter at the open kitchen and one table for 4. Non-smoking. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money. In the Marunaka Building on Ura-dera-machi, behind OPA, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn. Opened June 2024 (July 2024 review).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Kawaramachi — Ura-dera-machi, behind OPA
places.cuisine: A small creative izakaya of seasonal fish and Kyoto vegetables with sake, opened in 2024 (2024–2026 reviews) · seasonal appetiser plate of about four small dishes (¥700–800) · cured mackerel with gari ¥750; swordfish sashimi ¥1,050; dashi tofu ¥700 (March 2025); sea bream in kombu; bonito with shungiku and pomelo (2025) · toro-taku fresh spring rolls; hamo and corn tempura; sliced water eggplant; fried pork; Lake Biwa ayu; potato salad; omelette (2024–2026) · keema curry to finish (September 2024) · sake such as Kaishun; imo shochu Daiyame
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Kawaramachi, a 2024 counter of fish and Kyoto vegetables] A clean, wood-scented 12-seat counter on Ura-dera-machi opened in 2024 by a cook with two decades in Kyoto kitchens: cured mackerel with gari, toro-taku spring rolls, hamo tempura, seasonal vegetables and a keema curry to finish, with a good sake list. One diner balked at the ¥700 otoshi (March 2025); Tabelog now lists ¥1,000. Open from 16:00; closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner-cook, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Per a July 2024 reviewer, the owner went independent in June 2024 after about 20 years in restaurants; a September 2024 reviewer says the owner seems to have come from "Manzara-tei". Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a calm, clean room with an open kitchen, an owner who comes out to chat, and what looked to one diner like a couple running it (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Cured mackerel with gari; toro-taku spring rolls.

anecdotes.text: March 2025: "Otoshi... JPY 700, huh? Hmm."
April 2025: on a Saturday night "every place I called was fully booked and turned me away… I found out that Taka had an opening."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お酒とごはんと たか、居酒屋・海鮮、中京区四条裏寺通上ル中之町576 丸仲ビル 1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、16:00〜23:00、火曜休み、原文で「お通し代1,000円」、12席 (オープンキッチンのカウンター8席、4名のテーブル1卓)、禁煙、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年8月、英語): 2024年6月オープン、約20年飲食店で働いた店主が独立、Manzara-tei 出身らしいという声、木の香り、季節の前菜の盛り合わせ (700〜800円)、ガリしめ鯖750円、メカジキの刺身1,050円、だし豆腐700円、昆布締めの鯛、鰹と春菊と文旦、トロたく生春巻、鱧ととうもろこしの天ぷら、水なす、豚の唐揚げ、琵琶湖の鮎、ポテトサラダ、だし巻、締めのキーマカレー、日本酒 (Kaishun など)、芋焼酎だいやめ、夫婦で営んでいるようだという声、お通し700円は高いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter izakaya; ¥1,000 otoshi.

places.name: 京の焼肉処 蓮蔵 (Kyo no Yakiniku Dokoro Renzou)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: yakiniku with soy-based sauces, cold noodles, bibimbap and set meals (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; booked stays have a time limit, but guests may stay until the next booking arrives (Tabelog). One October 2026 visitor could not book a course on the day and booked a table instead. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 84 seats over two floors, with counter, tables, sofas and private rooms; 1F non-smoking, 2F heated tobacco only; the floors can be booked separately (Tabelog). Coin parking nearby (October 2026). 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sakaimachi south of Sanjo — 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn
places.cuisine: Wagyu yakiniku in a calm Japanese-style house, opened December 2023 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · lunch: three-cut yakiniku set with salad, soup and rice ¥2,200, or a five-cut set with two kinds of tongue (May and October 2026) · courses: Kyo no Nihon Teien ¥4,500 with kimchi, small dishes, salt and sauce cuts, horumon, rice and hojicha panna cotta; a ¥6,500 course; the photogenic Kyo no Kaidan Mori staircase platter ¥7,980 (September–October 2026) · à la carte: salted tongue, premium wagyu loin, harami, Chateaubriand, tongue sashimi, yukhoe, namul, cold noodles, oxtail soup, meat sushi (2026 reviews) · lunch about ¥1,000–3,000, dinner about ¥5,000–10,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Sakaimachi-Sanjo, wagyu in a quiet Japanese house] A calm, screened yakiniku house serving tender wagyu tongue, harami and loin, a ¥2,200 lunch set and courses up to the photogenic staircase platter, with birthday plates on request. Some found side dishes and finishers weaker than the meat; one October 2026 guest was promised a dessert for posting a review that never came. Open till 23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakiniku restaurant opened 15 December 2023 on two floors near Sakaimachi-Sanjo. Gurunavi lists a second Renzou shop in Shimamoto, Osaka Prefecture. Reviewers in 2026 describe attentive staff who explain the cuts, and screens that keep tables private.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyo no Kaidan Mori staircase platter; salted tongue.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner who doubted the staircase platter found it ordered from light tongue up to richer cuts, with not one tough piece.
An October 2026 visitor was told a review would earn a dessert; after showing the review and waiting 15 minutes the dessert never came, and an unordered soup arrived at the bill.
A September 2026 solo birthday diner loved the meat but found the bibimbap, oxtail soup and dessert platter disappointing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・居酒屋・日本料理、中京区大阪材木町690、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、毎日 11:30〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、予約可 (時間制だが次の予約まではゆっくりできる)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、84席、個室あり、1階禁煙・2階は加熱式たばこのみ、1階と2階は別々に貸切可、2023年12月15日開店。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): 落ち着いた和の内装、ついたて、昼の焼肉3種盛り定食2,200円、5種盛り、京の日本庭園コース4,500円、6,500円のコース、京の階段盛り7,980円、塩タン、和牛上ロース、ハラミ、シャトーブリアン、タン刺し、ユッケ、ナムル、冷麺、テールスープ、肉寿司、誕生日のプレート、店員が忙しそうとの声、口コミを書くとデザートと言われたが来なかったとの声 (2026年10月)、ビビンバやテールスープは物足りないとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain the cuts; private rooms; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: さるぅ屋 (Saruuya)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: burgers on bakery buns, sandwiches on country bread, curry (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef burgers, chicken and bacon-egg sandwiches; herbal teas and lemonade are the plant-based options seen (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closing days may vary (Tabelog). No table reservations — only course bookings (2 hours, from ¥3,500) (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 34 seats with counter, sofas, tatami and a loft upstairs; non-smoking inside, smoking area in the garden; the toilet is out in the back yard (Tabelog; May 2026). The front looks like a bicycle shop (November 2025). By Keihan Demachiyanagi Stn exit 2 and a bus stop (Tabelog; January 2026).
places.neighborhood: Tanaka by Demachiyanagi Stn — on the way to Shimogamo Shrine
places.cuisine: Burger and sandwich cafe in a renovated old house, with antique furniture and many herbal teas (2025–2026 reviews) · large burgers on bakery-style buns: hamburger, cheeseburger, double cheeseburger with a hint of spicy sausage, avocado burger; a burger and drink set ¥1,500 (October 2025–June 2026) · sandwich sets on country bread such as mustard chicken or bacon, egg and cheese, with spiced pumpkin soup as an extra (January 2026) · curry, weekday specials with salad, lemonade, coffee (2025–2026 reviews) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Cafe · Demachiyanagi, burgers in an old house] A dim, homey cafe in a renovated old house by Demachiyanagi Stn — sink into a sofa or the upstairs loft for big burgers on bakery buns, country-bread sandwiches, curry and herbal tea. Easy to miss: the front looks like a bicycle shop. Some found portions generous, one found the dishes small for the price; it can be chilly in winter. Cash only; open till 22:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a cafe and burger shop by Demachiyanagi with course bookings for groups. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a renovated old house of two floors with a loft, antique decor, assorted sofas and accessories for sale at the entrance.
chef_bio.specialty: Double cheeseburger; herbal teas.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor hesitated at the door because the front looks just like a bicycle shop.
An October 2025 lunch guest thought two burgers had arrived, so large was the single burger ordered.
A January 2026 visitor on the way to Shimogamo Shrine found the cafe a little chilly and warmed up with the pumpkin soup.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・ハンバーガー、左京区田中下柳町14、京阪出町柳駅2番出口、毎日 11:30〜22:00 (L.O.フード21:00、ドリンク21:30)、定休日は変わることあり、席のみの予約不可 (コースのみ、2時間制、3,500円から)、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、34席、カウンター・ソファ・座敷、禁煙 (庭に喫煙所)。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年6月、英語): 古い家を改装、2階はロフト、アンティーク、自転車屋のような外観、大きなハンバーガー、パン屋のようなバンズ、ダブルチーズバーガー、アボカドバーガー、ハンバーガーとドリンクのセット1,500円、田舎パンのサンドイッチ (マスタードチキン、ベーコンエッグチーズ)、かぼちゃのスープ、カレー、ハーブティー、レモネード、トイレは裏庭、量が多いとの声と、値段のわりに少ないとの声、冬は少し寒い。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; toilet in the back yard; sofas and a loft.

places.name: Panel Cafe 京都店 (Panel Cafe Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: souffle pancakes, burgers and chips (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg-rich souffle pancakes with soft serve, bacon-and-egg pancakes, burgers (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–17:30, last order 16:00; irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, but not same-day at weekends and holidays (Tabelog). Waits of 30 minutes to an hour at busy times (2024–2026 reviews). Order and pay at the register before being seated; one food order per person (September 2026). No toilet inside — guests are sent to a public toilet (August and September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 80 seats inside and on a dog-friendly river terrace; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews). In the evenings the space runs as Dining Bar W (Tabelog). 2 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion Shijo, by the river — 2 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Souffle pancake cafe with a river terrace, opened January 2020 (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews) · wobbly brulee pancakes with vanilla soft serve: chocolate brulee ¥1,570, creme brulee, matcha brulee, caramel banana (2025–2026 reviews) · savory bacon-and-egg pancakes ¥1,650–1,860 (August–September 2026) · burgers, chips, house-roasted coffee ¥275 in a set, lemonade, hojicha latte (2024–2026 reviews) · about ¥1,000–3,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Pancakes · Gion Shijo, river terrace, dogs welcome] A chic cafe known for wobbly, pudding-soft souffle pancakes topped with brulee and soft serve, plus burgers, with a riverside terrace where dogs are welcome. Order and pay first; expect a queue, and book on weekdays. Several 2026 reviewers note it is popular with overseas visitors; some found the pancakes average or pre-cooked. No toilet inside.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a cafe opened 20 January 2020 near Kawaramachi, known for souffle pancakes and burgers, with a pet-friendly terrace; registered as an official listing. In the evening the space operates as Dining Bar W.
chef_bio.specialty: Creme brulee pancakes.

anecdotes.text: A reviewer who returns with a dog chooses it for the riverside terrace, and waited about an hour on a May 2025 visit.
An August 2026 visitor found the pancakes average, seemingly pre-cooked and thin, and was disappointed by the lack of a toilet.
Several 2026 reviewers mention that many of the guests are overseas visitors (August–October 2026).

places.name: 京都 鮨 もと樹 (Kyoto Sushi Motoki)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae nigiri seasoned before serving, a foam soy sauce with bonito, tempura and chawanmushi in the courses; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi omakase courses (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 16:00–23:00; irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised; same-day cancellations are charged 100%, and phone cancellations are not taken outside opening hours (Tabelog; October 2026). Service charge 10% (Tabelog original サービス料10%). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 25 seats: a counter of about 8 with backrests and private rooms for 2–6; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). B1F of the Bouquet Garni building at the northeast corner of Shichijo and Karasuma, easy to miss; 4 min walk from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma Shichijo, north of Kyoto Station — 4 min walk
places.cuisine: Edomae sushi courses on red-vinegar Kinu Hikari rice, opened August 2023; an October 2026 reviewer calls it a sister of まつもと (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews) · courses of about ¥10,000–12,000: appetizers such as whale bacon with komatsuna, mozuku, fresh yuba and roast chicken; sashimi with a foam soy sauce; tempura; chawanmushi; about 8–9 nigiri such as squid, flounder, engawa, aged and marinated tuna, toro, shime saba, kohada, steamed anago; a negitoro hand roll; ikura rice; pudding-style tamago; dessert (2023–2026 reviews) · lunch about ¥5,000–8,000, dinner about ¥10,000–15,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sushi · Karasuma Shichijo, by Kyoto Station] A calm basement Edomae counter with private rooms near Kyoto Station, serving seasoned nigiri on red-vinegar rice in courses of about ¥10,000–12,000 — fresh yuba, foam soy with bonito, melting toro and soft steamed anago. A sister of the nearby Kyoto Sushi Matsumoto, per a reviewer. Critics noted clumsy service one night and rice undercooked at the centre. 10% service; same-day cancellations charged in full.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a sushi and seafood restaurant opened 22 August 2023 on the B1F of the Bouquet Garni building, at the same address as 京都 鮨 まつもと. An October 2026 reviewer learned it is a sister establishment of Matsumoto; another October 2026 reviewer writes that the chef comes from Nagasaki Prefecture and grew up eating fresh fish. One October 2026 visitor counted one chef, one kitchen assistant and one server for about 20 seats.
chef_bio.philosophy: Each nigiri seasoned so no soy sauce is needed (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Red-vinegar Edomae nigiri; steamed anago.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 birthday couple found the sushi delicious but the service poor: a server reached across guests with an elbow on the counter and set dishes down with a thud.
An October 2026 diner liked the fluffy anago but found the red-vinegar rice a little undercooked at the centre, the kohada over-vinegared and only four sakes on offer.
A July 2026 pair paid ¥15,000 in total for two courses and drinks on a quiet holiday, and the chef started a conversation with the pair.

places.name: 七番館 (Restaurant Nanabankan)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Fried and sauced yoshoku — chicken katsu, fried prawns, curry, demi-glace hamburg, gratin — plus grilled fish and salads; no gluten information is published (official menu; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the shop uses vegetables from contract farms in Yagi, but the menu is meat- and fish-led (Tabelog; official site).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–13:30, dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Sunday, except for private bookings (official site). Cash only (official site; Tabelog; October 2026). Bookings online or by phone, with a cancellation fee (official site). 30 seats per the official site, 35 per Tabelog (28 at tables, 7 at the counter); a private room and a semi-private room for 2–6; parties up to 30 seated or 40 standing; heated tobacco only at some tables (official site; Tabelog). Vegetables from the contract farmers are sometimes on sale in the shop (Tabelog). On Shichijo-dori east of Karasuma, 5 min walk from Kyoto Station Exit 1 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma-Shichijo, 5 min walk north of Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: French-based yoshoku bistro (official site) · lunch, each with salad, miso soup, rice and a self-service coffee: A (meat of the day) or B (fish of the day) ¥1,000, C (both) ¥1,400; homemade curry ¥1,000 (10 a day), with chicken kara-age ¥1,300, pork katsu ¥1,500, wagyu hamburg ¥1,900; wagyu hamburg steak with demi-glace ¥2,100; two 20 cm fried prawns with tartar ¥2,100; beef-rib stew ¥2,800 (official menu) · dinner à la carte: hors d’oeuvres, Caesar salad with prosciutto, seared-salmon carpaccio with mango-chilli sauce, prawn and mushroom ajillo, curry poutine, aubergine and meat-sauce gratin, fish, meat and pasta; courses from ¥5,300 (official menu; December 2025) · several dozen wines (official site)
places.notes: [Yoshoku bistro · Karasuma-Shichijo by Kyoto Station, a hotel-trained chef's Showa-style diner] A retro, Showa-style restaurant five minutes from Kyoto Station, on a plot the owner-chef's family has held for three generations. The ¥1,000 lunch — a daily meat or fish plate such as chicken katsu with tomato sauce, with rice, miso soup and a self-serve coffee — is one of the best deals near the station. At night it turns French-leaning bistro with wine and courses from about ¥5,300. Cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: owner-chef 折橋正明 trained for 17 years in French cooking at a well-known Kyoto hotel, then opened a bistro-style “French-based yoshoku restaurant” on this plot in front of Kyoto Station, held by the family since the grandfather’s generation; the restaurant marked its 21st anniversary on 15 March 2023. Vegetables come from contract farmers in Yagi, Kyoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: “good to look at, delicious to eat, and something you want to eat again” — so that diners of every age can eat favourite dishes to the full.
chef_bio.specialty: Daily lunch plates and homemade curry.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 couple found a Showa-era yoshoku place in front of the station that had not changed for the tourists.
A December 2025 party guest wished the curry served at the end of the course came on its own.
A December 2025 traveller on Course A was told at 21:00 that the kitchen was closing.

The lunch can sell out by 12:30. Cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 22 February 2017 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2025–2026) describe a daily set built around five vegetable obanzai, with specials posted on Instagram.
chef_bio.specialty: Daily set with five obanzai.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner ate all the vegetables before touching the aonori chicken tempura.
A November 2025 visitor arrived at 12:30 to find the day’s set sold out and lunch over.
A December 2025 guest near the hospital liked the quick set but went home smelling of the fryer.

places.notes: [Hamburg steak · Shijo-Nishinotoin, teppan-finished patties] A calm, polished hamburg-steak house where each patty — pork, beef-and-pork or wagyu — is steamed, then seared on the teppan in front of the counter, and dressed with demi-glace, teriyaki or toppings like avocado and camembert. Juicy and generous; many reviewers find it pricey (lunch about ¥2,000–3,000, dinner more). Tatami rooms for families. Closed Wednesday and the 2nd and 4th Thursday.

roles: Chef not named; one of three HAMBURG LABO shops in Kyoto
chef_bio.background: Opened 12 July 2007 (Tabelog). Tabelog’s introduction: carefully made hamburgers and wagyu steaks; steamed-and-grilled hamburgers cooked one by one on a hot plate; an original hamburger of 100% domestic pork and wagyu; trimmings from preparation are used in dishes to reduce waste. Other shops: Pontocho (Tabelog 26038824) and HAMBURG LABO PREMIUM in Sakaimachi-Rokkaku (Gurunavi).
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan-finished hamburg steak.

anecdotes.text: An eight-time August 2025 regular noticed the à la carte menu had gone and the focus was now all hamburg.
A December 2025 lunch guest balked at the prices, then found the cheese hamburg "simply amazing" as the juices ran.
A March 2026 family booked a tatami room but found the food not worth the price and a staff answer condescending.

places.cuisine: Xiaolongbao made to order — dough rolled from scratch and steamed at the table — with Taiwanese dishes (official site) · plain xiaolongbao with a 7-hour stock, 4 pieces ¥640; shiitake, crab miso, scallop, oyster, truffle and shungiku versions (official site; 2026 reviews) · yodare chicken ¥860, lu rou fan ¥690, spicy chicken, bang bang chicken, steamed fish, crab-miso mapo aubergine, daikon cake, steamed gyoza, spring rolls, Kyoto mochi-pork spare ribs, sesame balls, almond tofu (official site; 2026 reviews) · courses ¥5,500–7,500 with drinks (official site) · Tsingtao ¥730, Taiwan beer ¥710, 12-year Shaoxing ¥690 a glass, osmanthus wine (official site; September 2026)
places.notes: [Xiaolongbao · Higashi Hongan-ji by Kyoto Station, Taiwan-style dumpling bar] A lively, Taiwan-styled xiaolongbao bar five minutes from Kyoto Station, linked to a Tokyo Bib Gourmand shop: wrappers are rolled to order and steamed at your table, so the soup stays in. Try plain, truffle, scallop or shungiku (four for about ¥640 plain), with yodare chicken and lu rou fan. Book — it fills fast. Cash or PayPay only; ¥480 zha cai charge.

roles: Chefs not named; run by 株式会社big nose (invoice register; official site)
chef_bio.background: Opened 8 February 2021 (Tabelog). Per the official site: the first Kyoto shop of an affiliate of a Tokyo restaurant listed as Michelin Bib Gourmand 2019; Tabelog Hot Restaurant two years running; every xiaolongbao is rolled from scratch after ordering, wrapped thin enough to hold the soup; interior imported from Taiwan. Operator 株式会社ｂｉｇ ｎｏｓｅ, registered at the shop’s address (NTA invoice register); its site lists this one brand and one shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Xiaolongbao steamed at the table.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner thought the name silly, then found the xiaolongbao "incredibly delicious".
A September 2026 guest waited by the entrance counter, watching the staff wrap the dumplings, and struggled with the QR ordering.
An October 2026 diner booked a month ahead and ordered the shungiku xiaolongbao twice.

places.name: 京都タワーサンドバル (Kyoto Tower Sand Bar)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A beer-led bar (beer contains gluten) with small snacks such as smoked quail eggs and canapés (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks plus a few snacks — smoked quail eggs, smoked salmon, mascarpone canapés (2026 reviews); no vegan information.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); open all year (Tabelog). Order at the register or by phone at the table; mobile orders take only cards, PayPay or Rakuten Pay (May and July 2026). Cards (JCB) and QR incl. PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). A U-shaped counter of 12 seats plus standing room for 14, with food-hall tables around it; food from other stalls can be brought in (Tabelog; April and August 2026). Non-smoking; smoking area outside (Tabelog). B1F of the Kyoto Tower Building, straight in from the underground passage from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 14 April 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Tower basement food hall — Kyoto Stn north
places.cuisine: Craft beer, Kyoto sake and wine at a counter in the Kyoto Tower food hall (2026 reviews) · SORACHI 1984 ¥780, Sapporo Black Label in "sharp" or "mild" pours ¥680, sansho ale ¥1,050 (April–October 2026) · Kyoto Brewing on tap (June 2026); Kyoto whisky on the rocks ¥950 (August 2026) · smoked quail eggs ¥500, quick-smoked salmon carpaccio ¥780, sansho and mascarpone canapés ¥880 (June and October 2026)
places.notes: [Bar · Kyoto Tower basement, craft beer by the station] A U-shaped bar in the food hall under Kyoto Tower, reached straight from the station underpass: Kyoto craft beer, Sorachi and Sapporo on tap with a choice of pour, Kyoto sake and whisky, and smoked snacks — or bring food from the other stalls. Open daily 11:00–23:00; a handy wait for the Shinkansen.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bar, café and standing bar in the B1F food hall of Kyoto Tower Sando, opened in April 2017, with sake and wine. Kyoto Tower Sando itself is run by 京阪流通システムズ (2021 press release); no operator is given for the bar.
chef_bio.specialty: Craft beer and Kyoto drinks.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 office worker stops in after work for a SORACHI 1984 schooner and liked the seasonal flowers on the counter.
An August 2026 visitor enjoyed a Kyoto whisky but found the glass still wet from washing.
An October 2026 traveller with 30 minutes before a train had a sharp-pour Black Label and found more seating than expected.

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the register or by phone at the table; seat yourself anywhere in the food hall. No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Biryani, rice sets, kebabs and curries alongside naan (2025–26 reviews); naan contains wheat; no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; lunch sets include a vegetable curry and lassi (November 2025, June 2026); no vegan information.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:30), closed irregularly (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; party plans; take-away and delivery (Tabelog; official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money (Tabelog). 42 seats incl. a private room for 10–12 per Tabelog (the official site says 62). Non-smoking; wheelchair access; free Wi-Fi; children welcome with a kids' menu (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Northeast corner of the Kojinguchi crossing, 1 min from the Kojinguchi bus stop, 7 min from Jingu-Marutamachi (Keihan) (official site; Tabelog). The English site says the Islamic Culture Center mosque is a 2-minute walk.
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi Kojinguchi — east of the Imperial Palace
places.cuisine: Halal Indian, Arab, Turkish and Persian cooking (official site) · chicken dum biryani ¥1,690 with a boiled egg and two sauces (February and October 2026); mutton biryani (February 2026) · lunch sets with two or three curries, tandoori chicken, naan or rice, salad and lassi (November 2025; June 2026) · kebab mix of lamb and chicken with basmati rice, hummus, chicken Manchurian (May 2026) · mutton bhuna, mutton vindaloo, South Indian chicken curry (November 2025 – October 2026) · Afghan-style rice, grilled fish, Kashmiri naan with pomegranate and coconut, spice lassi (April 2026)
places.notes: [Halal Indian, Arab and Turkish · Kojinguchi, by the Kamo river] A bright, roomy halal restaurant by the Kojinguchi crossing whose own site states "ALL HALAL FOODS": fragrant dum biryani, curry lunch sets with naan, lamb and chicken kebabs, hummus and Afghan-style rice. Wine is also served (Tabelog). Open daily to 23:00; English menu; take-away and delivery.

chef_bio.chef_name: アリ セック シラジ
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the chef opened the restaurant to serve authentic Indian, Persian and Arab food in Kyoto, cooked with carefully chosen ingredients that meet halal standards; the site was published in December 2020. A November 2025 review mentions a chef trained in hotel restaurants.
chef_bio.philosophy: Halal food is a Muslim food-safety standard that anyone can eat with confidence (official site greeting).
chef_bio.specialty: Dum biryani; Indian, Arab and Turkish dishes.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular on an eighth visit tried a new Afghan rice dish and ordered the Kashmiri naan by mistake, which came with pomegranate and coconut.
A February 2026 diner was surprised how quickly the mutton biryani arrived, with attentive service.
A June 2026 visitor found the mutton vindaloo closer to a mutton butter chicken and the meat a little tough.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog) and an English page on the official site; staff speak limited Japanese (October 2026). Several reviews describe many Muslim and international diners (November 2025, October 2026).

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat and fish set meals with miso soup (2023–25 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Hours not listed on Tabelog; reviews describe lunch visits (2023–25). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats: four tables for 4, one for 2 and a counter of 5 (Tabelog; August 2023). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In the residential streets east of the Kamo river, across from the Kyoto University pharmacy campus, about 5 min from the Konoe-dori bus stop (June 2023, December 2024).
places.neighborhood: Yoshida, by the Kyoto University medical and pharmacy campuses
places.cuisine: Home-style yoshoku set meals (2023–25 reviews) · omakase lunch of two daily mains with rice, salad, a side and miso soup ¥980 (August 2023, March 2024); daily special ¥1,100 (June 2025) · signature pork-belly kakuni "toro katsu" ¥1,200, limited (May 2024) · Set A of beef cutlet, shrimp, fish and squid fries (December 2025); sets A ¥1,450, B ¥1,100, C ¥1,200 (August 2023) · hamburg steak with demi-glace (November 2023), chicken nanban (June 2024) · Shiga Koshihikari rice (June 2024)
places.notes: [Yoshoku diner · Yoshida, by the Kyoto University hospital] A family-run neighbourhood diner across from the university pharmacy campus, feeding locals, medical students and doctors: the signature melt-tender pork-belly toro katsu, hamburg steak with demi-glace and big fried-food sets from about ¥1,000. Cash only; hours not published — go at lunch.

roles: Grandmother of the family, front of house
chef_bio.background: A June 2024 review describes a family business: the chef is the son of the family, and the grandmother — who has eight grandchildren — works in the shop. An August 2023 review saw several generations in the kitchen.
chef_bio.specialty: Pork-belly kakuni toro katsu.

anecdotes.text: A June 2024 family stopping between appointments at the nearby immigration office found the whole family who run it wonderfully kind to the visiting couple’s four-month-old son.
A May 2024 diner caught the limited pork-belly toro katsu at noon on a weekday and praised its thin batter.
A December 2025 diner could not finish the Set A of beef cutlet and three kinds of fry.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Matcha, zenzai and anmitsu can be plant-based, but ice cream, lattes and cakes are dairy and nothing is described as vegan (reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:30–17:00; days off not fixed; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 20 seats, tables inside and on a terrace; pets reportedly allowed on the terrace (Tabelog; March 2024). On the approach to Ginkakuji, about 2 min from the temple (Tabelog; reviews).
places.neighborhood: Ginkakuji approach — 2 min from the temple
places.cuisine: A small Japanese-sweets café on the Ginkakuji approach (reviews) · matcha, hot or as a set with sweets (2026) · zenzai with tea ¥700 (December 2022); zenzai on a snowy day (February 2026) · anmitsu and matcha set (May 2026) · shiratama with red-bean ice cream (June 2026) · matcha Mont Blanc, matcha float, café au lait, iced latte (2024) · cakes in the case (February 2026)
places.notes: [Japanese sweets · on the Ginkakuji approach] A calm little tea café a couple of minutes from Ginkakuji, with tables inside and a terrace: matcha with anmitsu, warm zenzai, shiratama with red-bean ice cream and a matcha Mont Blanc — a good stop after the Philosopher’s Path. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a café on the path to Ginkakuji, set among the approach shops, with attentive staff (March 2024) and terrace seats (2024–2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha with Japanese sweets.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor was grateful it stayed open on a cold, snowy day, and warmed up with zenzai and matcha.
A May 2026 walker stopped in after the Philosopher’s Path from Nanzenji for anmitsu and matcha.

places.name: Le temps du gout
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a pâtisserie of choux, feuilletés, tarts, madeleines, fruit cake and cookies (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: custard, caramel cream, vanilla ice cream, meringue and butter pastries (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00; closed Thursday, with other days off announced monthly on Instagram; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 10 seats: 3 at the counter, one table for 3 and two for 2 (Tabelog). Baked goods to take away; the choux and Chantilly caramel are eat-in only (Tabelog; December 2025). About 6–7 min on foot from Chayama–Kyoto University of the Arts Station (Tabelog; January 2026). Opened 6 June 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ichijoji, near Chayama Stn — residential street
places.cuisine: A pâtisserie-café of baked sweets and plated desserts with a French base (January 2026) · eat-in only: choux à la crème ¥500, filled to order; Chantilly caramel ¥500 — crisp choux with custard and caramel cream (December 2025, January 2026) · seasonal plates: black-fig feuilleté with black-beer ice cream ¥1,500 (October 2025); vacherin, lime tart, peach crêpe (2026) · baked goods: fruit cake ¥500, madeleines, canelés, langues de chat, cookies, Earl Grey and raspberry, marron glacé (2025–2026); some use Amazonian cupuaçu and macambo (January 2026) · herbal tea ¥700, chai ¥700, coffee (2025)
places.notes: [Pâtisserie café · Ichijoji near Chayama, choux filled to order] A small, calm pâtisserie-café on a residential street, where the owner bakes in the open kitchen: crisp choux and a much-loved Chantilly caramel filled only when you order (¥500, eat-in only), seasonal plated desserts, and a case of madeleines and cakes to take home. Closed Thursday; other days off on Instagram.

chef_bio.background: A January 2026 reviewer says the owner trained as a pastry chef in Kyoto restaurants and Tokyo pâtisseries, works from a French base without limiting the menu to French classics, and uses ingredients such as cupuaçu and macambo from the Amazon; the owner bakes in the kitchen behind the counter.
chef_bio.philosophy: A French base, open to influences from other countries (January 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Chantilly caramel; choux à la crème.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular comes back just for the Chantilly caramel and would order three if not for embarrassment.
A December 2025 visitor waited about 15 minutes at 15:00 for a seat.

Opened at this site 13 December 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Kawaramachi — Kyoto Takashimaya 7F
places.cuisine: Kyoto soba from a house founded in Pontocho in 1929, using 100% domestic buckwheat flour; juwari and ni-hachi soba (official site; August 2026) · ni-hachi tempura zaru or seiro with salt and soba-yu (2025–2026) · tororo zaru with quail egg ¥1,600 (September 2026); Ukiya soba with whipped natto and tempura bits, a house original (August 2026) · warm soba: torinamba, yuba with egg, Kujo green onion, shrimp-tempura curry soba (2025–2026) · sets with tempura, kayaku rice and pickles; oyakodon, gyudon with egg (2024–2025) · soba miso with a sake (Kamizake 180 ml ¥1,100) (September 2026)
places.notes: [Soba · Takashimaya 7F, a Pontocho soba house since 1929] The department-store branch of a Kyoto soba house founded in 1929, serving thin juwari and ni-hachi soba made from domestic buckwheat — cold zaru with crisp tempura, warm torinamba or yuba soba, and the house “Ukiya soba” with whipped natto. Easy to get into, open daily until 21:30.

chef_bio.background: The official site says Ukiya was founded in Pontocho in 1929 (Showa 4) and names 三嶋吉晴, the third-generation owner, as head of its soba-making school; it lists four shops — 先斗町本店, 清水吉晴庵, ホテルオークラ京都店 and this 京都高島屋店 — plus one noren-wake shop. A reviewer notes the flour comes from Toshima Seifun (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto soba with real flavour — “ほんまもんの美味しさ” — through ingredients and technique (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Juwari and ni-hachi soba; Ukiya soba.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family found it easy with children — baby chairs, and soba swapped for udon on request.
A September 2026 diner was served a crunchy ball of soba miso with the first sake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都 有喜屋 (うきや)、昭和4年に京都先斗町で創業、100%国内産のそば粉、十割と二八、三代目 三嶋吉晴、店舗は先斗町本店・清水吉晴庵・ホテルオークラ京都店・京都高島屋店、のれんわけ店 和蕎庵。食べログ: そば・うどん・丼、下京区四条通河原町西入真町52 京都高島屋S.C. 7F ダイニングガーデン京回廊、11:00〜21:30 (L.O.20:30)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、2023年12月13日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 二八の天ざる・天せいろ、そば湯、とろろざる1,600円、納豆と天かすの有喜屋そば、鳥なんば、湯葉と卵とじ、九条ねぎ、えび天カレーそば、かやくご飯、親子丼、そば味噌、Kamizake 180ml 1,100円、十割そば、うどんにも替えられる、ベビーチェア。

cultural_comfort.note: Department-store dining floor; usually little wait; family-friendly.

places.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Kawaramachi, open till 2 a.m.] A roomy second-floor seafood izakaya at the Kawaramachi station exit, open into the small hours: sashimi, grilled collar and Thai mackerel, Kyoto nama-fu dengaku and party courses with two hours of drinks from ¥4,500, in semi-private booths. ¥480 appetiser charge; smoking allowed per Tabelog. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 29 May 2014 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2022 to 2025 describe a spacious stylish room with semi-private seating, prompt staff who remembered a guest's booking by name (November 2024), and quick drinks service.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi; nama-fu dengaku.

anecdotes.text: November 2024: "when I arrived, the staff warmly welcomed me by name and were completely aware of my booking details."
November 2023: "I worried the food might be frozen... but my concerns were unfounded."

places.notes: [Sukiyaki · Kiyamachi-Shijo, a new A5-wagyu room] A sukiyaki restaurant that opened in July 2026 on the fourth floor of a Kiyamachi building by the Kamo River, serving A5 wagyu cooked at the table with egg and seasonal vegetables, and truffle egg over rice to finish; an English picture menu and a terrace for smoking. Only two reviews so far (August, October 2026). Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 July 2026 (Tabelog). Two 2026 reviewers describe A5 wagyu with beautiful marbling cooked in front of the guest, a quiet room in Kiyamachi, and a bar and rooftop in the same venue. It shares the RAKUAS Kiyamachi building (斎藤町123) with 隠れ酒場ともしび3rd (2F) and 京鴨 鴨蔵.
chef_bio.specialty: A5 wagyu sukiyaki.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "One standout for me was the truffle egg over rice served at the end of the meal."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: WAGYU SUKIYAKI 祇園、日本料理・肉料理・すき焼き、下京区斎藤町123 RAKUSA木屋町 4F、京阪祇園四条駅3番出口から徒歩5分、阪急河原町駅2B出口から徒歩3分、火〜土 11:45〜14:15・17:00〜22:00、日・月休み、予約可 (貸切は電話)、33席 (テーブル10、カウンター8、テラス14は飲食不可で喫煙可)、英語と写真のメニュー、子供・赤ちゃん・ベビーカー可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、2026年7月15日オープン。口コミ (2026年8月・10月、英語): A5ランクの和牛のすき焼き、目の前で焼く、季節の野菜、締めのトリュフの卵かけご飯、同じ建物にバーと屋上。

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and charcoal-grilled chicken izakaya (Tabelog; reviews).

Happy hour until 19:00: highballs ¥100 and draft beer ¥250 with one dish from a set list (November 2025; February 2026; September 2026). All-you-can-drink ¥1,680 (December 2025); all-you-can-eat-and-drink plans. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「無し」 (the English page says one is added). 50 seats; private rooms for 20 or more. Smoking allowed (Tabelog; September 2026). English menu; tablet ordering. Cards, e-money, QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay). 2F of RAKUAS Kiyamachi, 1 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi. Opened 3 March 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Ishigaki, Shijo-Kawaramachi — 1 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: A lively seafood-and-charcoal-chicken izakaya, the third of the ともしび shops (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · sashimi platter of three ¥990; seafood yukhoe ¥680; smoked mackerel ¥680; yokowa tuna tataki; grilled nodoguro; butter-steamed clams ¥880; abalone with butter (2025–2026) · charcoal-grilled chicken, neck, tsukune ¥350, "Tomoshibi chicken" tulip wings ¥550, cartilage karaage ¥580 (2025–2026) · Kyoto dashimaki ¥680, thick fried tofu with Kujo leeks ¥580, beef-tendon stew ¥680, oden, potato salad; a free small dish, and red miso soup with the bill (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi-Shijo, ¥100 highball happy hour] A busy second-floor izakaya by Hankyu Kawaramachi, opened in 2025: sashimi, charcoal-grilled chicken and cheap snacks, a ¥100-highball happy hour until 19:00, cheerful young staff, free extra dishes and smoking allowed. One diner waited so long that a tsukune order was cancelled (February 2026). No service charge.

chef_bio.background: Opened 3 March 2025 (Tabelog). The same name runs four shops in the Kyoto crawl — 隠れ酒場 ともしび (Karasuma-Takoyakushi), 肴と海鮮 ともしびセカンド, this 3rd and お酒とまるまる ともしびzero — none yet in this app. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe energetic young staff who remember regulars, complimentary small dishes, and tablet ordering. It shares the RAKUAS Kiyamachi building with WAGYU SUKIYAKI 祇園 (4F).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi; charcoal-grilled chicken.

anecdotes.text: February 2026: "the food takes an incredibly long time to arrive. In the end, I had to cancel my order for the tsukune because it still hadn't come."
February 2026: "When I asked for the bill, they served a bowl of red miso soup as well."
November 2025: "The JPY 100 highball is generously filled to the brim."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 隠れ酒場ともしび3rd 海鮮と炭火鶏焼、居酒屋・海鮮・焼鳥、下京区西石垣通四条下る斎藤町123 RAKUAS木屋町 2F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩1分、日〜木・祝 16:30〜24:00・金土・祝前日 16:30〜翌1:00、休みは変動、予約可、原文でサービス料「無し」、50席、20名以上の個室、喫煙可、英語メニュー、カード・電子マネー・QR可、飲み放題・食べ放題、ハッピーアワー、2025年3月3日オープン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年9月、英語): 19時までのハッピーアワー (指定の1品でハイボール100円・生ビール250円)、飲み放題1,680円、刺身3種盛り990円、海鮮ユッケ680円、炙りしめ鯖680円、よこわのたたき、のどぐろの塩焼き、あさりのバター蒸し880円、鮑のバター、ともしびチキン550円、つくね350円、軟骨の唐揚げ580円、京風だし巻680円、九条ねぎの厚揚げ580円、牛すじ煮込み680円、おでん、サービスの1品、会計時の赤だし、タブレットで注文、料理が来るのがとても遅かったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; tablet ordering; smoking allowed.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, beef, shrimp and egg teppan dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Fri 18:00–1:00; Sat and Sun 18:00–2:00; closed Monday and the day after a public holiday. Reservations advised — nearly always full late at night (March 2026); seat type may change. No cover charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「無し」. 40 seats: an 8-seat counter at the open teppan, two tables for 2, a small raised area for 6, and a 20-seat tatami room upstairs. places.cuisine: A late-night creative teppan izakaya with natural wine (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · fresh-shrimp chili, the house favourite; "Futaba-yaki"; okonomiyaki; spicy Sichuan-style yakisoba; tonpei; grilled beef tendon with egg; mackerel toast; yukhoe sandwich (2025–2026) · appetiser of low-temperature beef tongue; beef carpaccio; gizzard confit; fried hoso and shrimp ajillo; kara-age; potato salad; prosciutto; cheese platter (2025–2026) · natural wines chosen to your taste, including orange wine; weekly specials
places.notes: [Teppan izakaya · Nishikiyamachi, okonomiyaki and natural wine till 2 a.m.] A stylish, wine-minded teppan izakaya off Shijo-Kiyamachi where the owner pairs natural wines with fresh-shrimp chili, Futaba-yaki okonomiyaki, spicy yakisoba and beef-tendon teppan, open till 1–2 a.m. Diners note a 30-minute wait for the first dish and a cold counter (January 2026), strong flavours (November 2025) and a cramped room (April 2026). Smoking allowed. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Opened 30 April 2023 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a modern Japanese room with an open-kitchen counter downstairs and tables upstairs, an owner who loves wine and explains each bottle, weekly changing specials, and a crowd that keeps arriving late at night.
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh-shrimp chili; Futaba-yaki.

anecdotes.text: January 2026: "the service was quite slow; it took about 30 minutes for the first dish to arrive… The back of the counter felt very cold."
July 2025: "The owner loves wine and provides detailed explanations."
November 2025: "The yakisoba and okonomiyaki were just okay. The flavors were quite strong."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鉄板居酒屋 双葉、居酒屋・お好み焼き・創作料理、中京区紙屋町西木屋町通四条上る373、京都河原町駅から徒歩5分、火〜金 18:00〜翌1:00・土日 18:00〜翌2:00、月曜と祝日の翌日休み、予約可 (席の指定は変わることも)、原文でチャージ「無し」、40席 (カウンター8、2人席2、小上がり6、2階座敷20)、喫煙可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、2023年4月30日オープン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年5月、英語): 生海老のチリソース、双葉焼き、お好み焼き、四川風の辛い焼きそば、とん平焼き、牛すじと卵の鉄板焼き、さばトースト、ユッケサンド、低温調理の牛タンのお通し、牛のカルパッチョ、砂肝のコンフィ、ホソの揚げ物、海老のアヒージョ、唐揚げ、ポテトサラダ、生ハム、チーズの盛り合わせ、ナチュラルワイン、ワイン好きの店主、毎週変わるおすすめ、深夜も満席に近い、最初の料理まで30分待ったという声、カウンターが寒いという声、味が濃いという声、狭いという声。
