places.name: 京都氷屋 万年雪 (Kyoto Koriya Mannen Yuki)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Shaved ice with fruit syrups, but many bowls are built with pie, tart, cake or daifuku elements (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: house condensed milk, custard, cream and mascarpone (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 12:00–18:00; closed Wednesday; closing days may vary (Tabelog). Bookings through Air Reserve (airrsv.net/mannenyuki) (Tabelog); a September 2026 visitor found it easy to book. Order and pay at the entrance; cash or PayPay/Alipay, no cards or e-money (Tabelog; September 2026 review). Regular or mini size (about ¥100 less) (September–October 2026 reviews). Free self-serve hojicha at the back to warm up (September 2026 review). 20 seats in a long, narrow room; non-smoking; strollers welcome; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog; September 2026 review). 1 min from the Kyoto Aquarium-mae bus stop, 5 min from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Umekoji Park / Kyoto Aquarium — 5 min from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn
places.cuisine: Year-round kakigori of pure ice frozen over three days, with homemade fruit syrups, condensed milk and white syrup (Tabelog): strawberry custard pie ¥1,750 (the most popular), matcha custard daifuku ¥1,750, freshly squeezed kiwi with almond jelly ¥1,600, kiwi milk, strawberry shortcake, strawberry tart, strawberry mascarpone; limited seasonal-fruit bowls; very large portions (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Kakigori · Umekoji Park] A shaved-ice shop open all year, a minute from the Kyoto Aquarium bus stop: fluffy, very large bowls of three-day pure ice with fresh-fruit syrups — strawberry custard pie, kiwi with almond jelly, matcha custard daifuku — about ¥1,600–1,750 (mini sizes cheaper). Book online; no cards. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 April 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Pure ice shaved fluffy, enhanced by homemade syrups that concentrate fresh fruit (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Strawberry custard pie kakigori.

anecdotes.text: In September 2026 a friend failed to book a famously hard-to-reserve kakigori shop, so the pair came here instead and shared a strawberry custard pie and a matcha custard daifuku.
On a rainy 26 September 2026 a visitor was offered mini sizes but chose regular, and was surprised how big they were.
An August 2026 visitor loved the kiwi ice but shivered in the strong air conditioning while eating it.

places.cuisine: Charcoal yakitori of Okutanba chicken (June 2026 review; Tabelog matome): thigh, tsukune with tare, wings, heart, bonjiri, neck with wasabi, garlic gizzards; green onion, zucchini, baby corn in the husk and lotus root skewers; potato salad, avocado and cream cheese, yam kara-age, young-chicken kara-age, braised beef tendon, a dobin-steamed dish; shibazuke fried rice and a yakitori rice bowl to finish; selected sake and highballs (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Charcoal yakitori · Nijo] A calm 11-seat yakitori counter near Nijo Station grilling Okutanba chicken over charcoal: crisp-juicy thigh, tsukune, garlic gizzards and seasonal vegetables by the single skewer, with shibazuke fried rice to finish. chef_bio.background: Opened 30 September 2023 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner phoned the same day and was told to come in an hour; the thigh and fluffy tsukune were the highlights.
A March 2026 diner was seen off at the door by the manager at the end of the meal.
An October 2026 regular says one serving of shibazuke fried rice is never enough, so the group now orders one each.

Bookings taken; the small team may not always answer the phone (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「なし」 (none). places.notes: [Pâtisserie & café · Senbon-dori] A tiny cake shop with six seats north of Nijo Station, known for rich custard: cream puffs that sell out by evening (¥350), crème brûlée torched as you buy it, salty-rich baked cheesecake and banana roll cake, with lattes. chef_bio.specialty: Custard cream puff; crème brûlée.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 local was surprised to have missed the shop for ten years, then loved the cream puff, fraisier, lemon tart and roll cake.
A May 2026 visitor came for cream puffs, found them sold out on a weekday evening, and vowed a cream-puff revenge after the banana roll cake.
In August 2026 the reviewer’s partner brought home a whole gâteau chocolat to thank the family for quickly helping recover a dropped suit jacket.

places.name: 仏男 (French Man)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Bistro plates — pâté, carpaccio, gratins, risotto, pasta, roast meats — and courses; no gluten information is published, though staff swapped a course dish on request (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat- and seafood-led bistro (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–23:00 (last food order 22:00, drinks 22:30) Tuesday–Sunday; lunch 11:30–14:00 on Saturday, Sunday and holidays, by reservation only; closed Monday (Tabelog). Call after 16:00 to book; tables limited to 3 hours when busy (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 18 seats with a counter; private hire up to 20; non-smoking with a smoking area inside (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor of a building on Higashinotoin just south of Shichijo, 3 min walk from Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashinotoin-Shichijo, 3 min walk north of Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: Casual French bistro, the origin of the 大衆酒場フレンチマン bars (Tabelog) · signature cold pasta with sea urchin and salmon roe (Tabelog) · courses with all-you-can-drink ¥6,000 and ¥8,000: assorted appetisers, fish carpaccio, seasonal soup, fish, meat and dessert (April–October 2026) · weekend lunch course with a drink ¥4,400: five appetisers (pâté, frittata, carrot râpée, red cabbage), sea-bream carpaccio and more (July 2026) · à la carte: duck with orange, roast chicken with yuzu-pepper sauce, shirasu pasta, taro and blue-cheese gratin, foie gras and porcini cream risotto, chilled chawanmushi (2026 reviews) · wine and cocktails (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Bistro · Higashinotoin by Kyoto Station, casual French with free-flow] A lively second-floor bistro a few minutes from Kyoto Station — the original of the local French Man bar group — with no dress code and a counter facing the kitchen. Courses with all-you-can-drink run ¥6,000–8,000; à la carte stars include taro and blue-cheese gratin and a foie-gras porcini risotto. Busy and noisy at peak, and staff adapt dishes on request. Closed Monday; weekend lunch by reservation.

roles: Chef not named; operated by 有限会社らくちん (Kyoto; representative 渡辺 哲也)
chef_bio.background: Opened 13 July 2015 (Tabelog). Tabelog’s introduction calls it a bistro tucked into a corner of a building near Kyoto Station, French-centred but free of dress codes and table manners, and the origin of 大衆酒場フレンチマン. Per the company page: 有限会社らくちん, founded 2001, runs izakaya, yakiniku, yakitori, French and Thai concepts — 11 shops (8 direct, 3 franchised) — and opened its first 大衆酒場フレンチマン in Osaka in 2020.
chef_bio.philosophy: The shop’s motto (Tabelog; company page): life is a way to pass the time — who will you spend it with, and doing what?
chef_bio.specialty: Cold pasta with sea urchin and salmon roe.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 regular, stranded by a Shinkansen suspension, made a fourth visit for duck with orange.
An October 2026 diner who avoids raw food had the carpaccio swapped for a bacon salad.
A September 2026 guest called it a cozy place for a date but too lively for serious talks.

places.name: himeru
places.gf_detail: Ask. Spice curries with turmeric rice and vegetable sides; one curry is butter-and-soy-sauce based; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: The sesame tantan keema curry is made vegan with soy meat (official site); the other curries use chicken, butter or fish, and cross-contact is not described.
places.hours_raw: 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); the official site says closing days are irregular, Tabelog lists Tuesday as closed (official site; Tabelog). Bookings accepted online (official site). Order by smartphone QR code (December 2025–January 2026). Tabelog lists cards accepted; one January 2026 reviewer paid cash only — check. 19 seats: counter seats screened from neighbours, and tables (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Non-smoking. 4 min walk from the Kawaramachi-Marutamachi bus stop, 7 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-Marutamachi, south-east of the Imperial Palace — 7 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: Spice curry built on off-spec vegetables that would otherwise be thrown away (official site) · butter-soy chicken curry, mild and the house standard; sesame tantan keema with soy meat, vegan and Sichuan-peppery; a monthly seasonal curry, e.g. Kochi ginger and spiced chicken bean keema (November 2026), sudachi and grilled salmon cream curry; mackerel miso and Kishu plum dashi curry (March 2025) (official site; reviews) · two- or three-curry combinations with turmeric rice, achaar and a ring of vegetable sides; medium chicken butter curry ¥1,200 (March 2025); toppings such as spiced chicken, grilled cheese, a spicy egg; smoked oil-sardine potato salad (2025) · chai and lassi ¥500, homemade lemonade, crème brûlée ¥450, Kirin draught ¥500, craft beer ¥700 (official site)
places.notes: [Spice curry · Kawaramachi-Marutamachi, curry that rescues vegetables] A small, jazz-playing curry shop whose name comes from 日の目を見る, "to see the light of day": oversized or blemished vegetables that farms would discard ring every plate. Pick two or three curries — mild butter-soy chicken, a vegan sesame tantan keema, a monthly special — over turmeric rice, about ¥1,200–2,000. Open 11:00–22:00.

roles: Owner not named; a young owner (February 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a spice-curry shop that cooks and sells vegetables of perfectly good quality that are discarded for being too big or slightly blemished — about 1.9 million tonnes a year in Japan — to make customers and growers happy; the name himeru (ひめる) shortens 日の目を見る, vegetables that would have been thrown away reaching the table.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to save vegetables that would be thrown away and make both customers and producers happy.
chef_bio.specialty: Butter-soy chicken curry.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 theatregoer came after Bunraku at the nearby prefectural arts centre for the mackerel-miso and plum dashi curry.
A June 2025 yearly visitor never gets bored because the seasonal curry changes, and the stamp card keeps piling up at home.
A September 2025 diner said the three-curry set changed a view of spice curry: the vegetables and chicken were not drowned by spice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (himeru-spicecurry.com): himeru、規格外野菜を使用したスパイスカレー屋、品質に問題はないが形が大きすぎたり少し傷があるだけで捨てられる野菜を調理・販売、日本では年間約190万トン、名前の由来は「日の目を見る」の略、バター醤油チキンカレー (辛くない当店オリジナル)、胡麻坦々キーマカレー (大豆ミートを使用したビーガンカレー、ホアジャオ)、季節のスパイスカレー、2種あいがけカレー、付け合わせの野菜は日による、チャイ500円、ラッシー500円、生ビール500円、クラフトビール700円、クリームブリュレ450円、11月の季節限定は高知生姜とスパイス鶏の豆キーマカレー、すだちと焼鮭の濃厚クリームカレー、上京区上生洲町248-4、11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、不定休、ネット予約。食べログ: カレー、神宮丸太町駅から324m、火曜定休、カード可、19席、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 若い店主、3種のあいがけ、ターメリックライス、アチャール、チキンバターカレー中盛り1,200円、鯖味噌と紀州南高梅の出汁カレー (2025年3月)、スパイスチキンや焼きチーズのトッピング、スモークオイルサーディンのポテトサラダ、スマホのQRで注文、ジャズ、隣を気にしないカウンター。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering on your phone.

places.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–20:30 (last order 20:00); closed Monday, or Tuesday when Monday is a holiday (official site). Tabelog lists 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–20:00. No reservations — first come, first served; queues at lunch and at weekends (official site; several 2026 reviews). Cards, transport IC, iD, QUICPay and QR payments (official site). 26 seats; non-smoking; strollers fine; not barrier-free (official site; Tabelog). Takeout of omurice, salads and soup by phone (official site). 159 m from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Demachiyanagi — 159 m from the station
places.cuisine: Creative Kyoto-style omurice, the first omurice specialist in Kyoto (official site) · three LL Sakura eggs per serving over rice cooked with 30% pressed barley, with sweet Awaji onions and celery (official site) · tororo-yuba omurice over hijiki rice with dashi sauce and wasabi, the most popular, ¥2,000; hayashi with melting cheese ¥1,600; chicken ¥1,300; curry, Japanese-style (wild vegetables, miso-sansho chicken mince), tofu ¥1,600; seafood, salad, meat, shrimp, mentaiko ¥1,700; mushroom ¥1,900; oyako ¥2,000; children’s ¥850 (official menu) · omelette-wrapped potato salad ¥1,200, yuba salad, salmon salad; set for two ¥5,000; 1.5× and 2× portions for a fee (official site) · pumpkin soup (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Omurice · Demachiyanagi, Kyoto's original omurice specialist] A cosy, Beatles-playing omurice house by Demachiyanagi with long lunch queues. Each plate uses three eggs over barley rice; the favourite is silky tororo-yuba on hijiki rice with dashi and wasabi (¥2,000), alongside hayashi with cheese and a dozen more (¥1,300–2,000). No bookings; cards and QR. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner not named; a former itamae (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Kyoto’s first omurice specialist, opened by an omurice-loving owner who found none to suit and drew on experience as an itamae; every sauce is handmade; three LL Sakura eggs per plate, barley rice and Awaji onions; sister shops are おむらはうす 金閣寺店 and おむら家 百万遍店. A May 2026 reviewer gives the opening year as 1994.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: good ingredients make good food — care over rice and eggs, all sauces made by hand.
chef_bio.specialty: Tororo-yuba omurice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 family coming from the Mitarashi Festival at Shimogamo Shrine waited about 50 minutes; the shop was there when one parent started university nearby over 20 years earlier.
A September 2026 walker joined the queue before noon for the silky yuba omurice on hijiki rice, with the Beatles playing.
An October 2026 diner thought the prices high until the hayashi omurice arrived with plenty of beef.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (omurahouse.com): おむらはうす、京都に誕生した初めてのオムライス専門店、オムライス好きの店主が自分好みのものを作ろうと板前の経験を生かして開店、ソースは全て手作り、京風の創作オムライス、押し麦を3割混ぜた麦ご飯、淡路産の玉ねぎ、セロリ (抜きも可)、LLサイズの桜卵3個、とろ湯葉オムライス2,000円 (ヒジキごはん、出汁ソース、ワサビ)、ハヤシオムライス1,600円、チキン1,300円、カレー・和風・豆腐1,600円、シーフード・サラダ・ミート・エビ・明太子1,700円、キノコ1,900円、親子2,000円、お子様850円、2人deセット5,000円、玉子焼とポテトのサラダ1,200円、店舗は金閣寺店・出町柳店・おむら家 百万遍店、出町柳店は11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜20:30 (L.O. 20:00)、月曜定休 (祝日は営業し翌日休み)、左京区田中関田町22-75、予約不可、全席禁煙、キャッシュレス可、テイクアウト可、小麦粉アレルギーはドレッシングにも小麦粉を含むため対応できない場合あり、バターはサラダ油に替えられる、卵を使わないのはチキンライスとサラダ、大盛り1.5倍・特盛2倍は有料。食べログ: オムライス、出町柳駅から159m、26席。口コミ (2026年、英語): 1994年オープン、行列、ビートルズ、かぼちゃのスープ、ハヤシにとろけるチーズ、和風は山菜と味噌山椒の鶏そぼろ、明太子とクリームソース。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue at the door; no bookings.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The FAQ says that for a wheat-flour allergy even the dressings contain flour, so the shop may not be able to cater; butter can be swapped for salad oil; other allergies may also not be manageable — ask staff when ordering.

places.name: キッチンごりら (Kitchen Gorilla)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Breaded cutlets and fried prawns, sauced hamburg steaks and grilled pork, beef and venison steaks; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat-led yoshoku menu (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:15 (Saturday from 11:00); dinner 17:30–21:00 Monday–Wednesday, Friday and Saturday; Thursday lunch only; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings accepted. Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog original text: なし). 20 seats: a 6-seat counter and tables; two parking spaces in front; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). Cutlets are fried slowly — about 20–30 minutes for a cutlet or pork steak (July and September 2026). In a converted house east of Mototanaka Stn, 256 m away (Tabelog; July 2026).
places.neighborhood: Tanaka, east of Mototanaka Stn (Eizan line), near Kyoto University
places.cuisine: Meat-led yoshoku set meals with vegetable sides, miso soup and rice (2026 reviews) · pork hamburg steak with almost no filler, firm like a large sausage, 150 g to 300 g, with ketchup or other sauces; beef hamburg (2026) · thick pork steak 250 g or 300 g with balsamic or garlic sauce; thick pork-loin cutlet cut, breaded and fried to order; bite-sized pork cutlets; fried prawns (2025–2026) · T-bone steak; Honshu venison leg steak (August–September 2026) · wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Mototanaka near Kyoto University, a meat-lover's set-meal house] A converted house in the student quarter east of Mototanaka, serving generous, meat-first yoshoku: a pure-pork hamburg steak with almost no filler, firm as a big sausage; thick pork steaks with balsamic or garlic; slow-fried loin cutlets; even venison. Sets about ¥1,000–2,000, with sides, soup and rice. Expect a wait for fried dishes. Closed Sunday; Thursday lunch only.

chef_bio.background: A neighbourhood yoshoku house in a residential street east of Mototanaka Station, with several reviewers on a 7th to 15th visit (2024–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Filler-free pork hamburg steak; thick pork steak.

anecdotes.text: A fifteen-visit regular (July 2026) tried the beef for the first time after years of the meaty hamburg steaks.
A September 2026 diner watched the loin cut, breaded and fried on low heat for about 20 minutes.
A June 2026 hiker came down from Enryaku-ji for the pork steak and fried prawns.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: キッチンごりら、洋食・豚肉料理・牛肉料理、左京区田中樋ノ口町17-3、叡山電鉄元田中駅から徒歩10分 (256m)、月火水金 11:30〜14:15・17:30〜21:00、木 11:30〜14:15、土 11:00〜14:15・17:30〜21:00、日曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、サービス料なし、20席 (カウンター6、テーブル14)、駐車場2台、禁煙。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): つなぎのほとんどない豚のハンバーグ (ソーセージのよう)、150g〜300g、牛ハンバーグ、厚切りの豚ステーキ250gか300gでバルサミコかガーリック、注文後に切って揚げる厚切りのロースカツ (約20分)、ひと口カツ、海老フライ、Tボーンステーキ、本州鹿のもも肉のステーキ、野菜の付け合わせ・味噌汁・ご飯の定食、民家を改装した店、常連客。

cultural_comfort.note: Neighbourhood yoshoku; parking for two cars.

places.name: 文の助茶屋 本店 (Fuminosuke Chaya Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Warabi mochi of warabi starch and wasanbon sugar with kinako, zenzai, anmitsu and kakigori; mitarashi dango is glazed with a soy-based sauce; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Warabi mochi and zenzai look plant-based, but some sets come with matcha ice cream or soft serve; no ingredient information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–17:00; irregular closing days (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 28 seats; shoes off at the entrance; tables on the 1F, a tatami room upstairs and an engawa facing a small garden; non-smoking inside (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Kakigori is one order per person (May 2026). Takeaway warabi mochi and zenzai (2006 and 2026 reviews). On the lane from Yasaka toward Kiyomizu-dera, near Ninenzaka (Tabelog; February 2026).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama, between Yasaka and Kiyomizu-dera — near Ninenzaka
places.cuisine: Old tea house of Japanese sweets, founded 1909 per 2026 reviews (1910 per a 2006 review) · warabi mochi of warabi starch and wasanbon with a hint of cinnamon and kinako, also to take away (2026 reviews) · anmitsu, matcha anmitsu with shiratama and matcha ice cream, mitarashi dango, tokoroten (2026 reviews) · zenzai: manpuku zenzai with chestnut and shiratama in winter, strawberry zenzai around New Year (January–February 2026) · kakigori in summer, e.g. Uji no Sato ¥1,500 (May 2026) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese sweets · Higashiyama, on the way to Kiyomizu-dera] A long-established tea house in a renovated Kyoto house where you slip off your shoes for wobbly, cinnamon-scented warabi mochi, anmitsu, zenzai and summer kakigori, upstairs on tatami or by a little garden. Founded in the late Meiji era by a retired rakugo performer, per reviewers. Several 2026 reviewers note many tourists, including overseas visitors. Daytime only.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a tea house founded in 1909 (2026 reviews) — a 2006 reviewer gives 1910 and writes that it was started by a rakugo performer of the Katsura line after retiring from the stage, with amazake as the original specialty. Renovated before January 2026. Tabelog lists an online shop at ecstore.bunnosuke.jp and a JR Kyoto Isetan counter appears in our crawls.
chef_bio.specialty: Warabi mochi.

anecdotes.text: A 2006 reviewer recorded that the tea house was founded by a retired rakugo performer and that sweet amazake was its original specialty.
An October 2026 regular calls the warabi mochi so soft it could almost be drunk, best eaten slowly on the engawa looking at the small garden.
Several 2026 reviewers note the shop is busy with tourists, including many overseas visitors (January–May 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 甘味処・和菓子、東山区下河原通東入八坂上町373、毎日 11:00〜17:00、不定休、予約不可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・電子マネー・QR 可、28席、店内禁煙。口コミ (2006年3月、2026年1月〜10月、英語): 1909年創業 (2006年の口コミでは1910年、落語家が引退後に始め、甘酒が名物)、清水寺への道、二年坂の近く、改装済み、靴を脱いで上がる、2階は座敷、縁側と小さな庭、わらび餅 (本わらび粉と和三盆、シナモンの香り、きな粉)、抹茶あんみつ、みたらし団子、ところてん、まんぷくぜんざい (栗と白玉、冬)、いちごぜんざい (正月ごろ)、かき氷 宇治の里1,500円 (1人1つ)、持ち帰りのわらび餅、観光客や外国人客が多いとの声が複数。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off; tatami upstairs; many tourists (several 2026 reviews); cards, IC and QR.

places.name: 京都 たらこパスタ LABO (Kyoto Tarako Pasta LABO)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: fresh wheat pasta from Awaji in every dish (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every pasta is made with tarako (cod roe), many with cream, cheese or dashi (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:30, last order 21:00; hours vary by season and follow the Kawaramachi Garden building (Tabelog; May 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog original なし). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 20 seats at ten tables for two; non-smoking; takeaway for some dishes; no children's chairs (Tabelog). Tabelog asks for smart casual dress. 7F of Kyoto Kawaramachi Garden, directly linked to Hankyu Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 5 March 2026 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo Kawaramachi — 7F of Kawaramachi Garden, linked to Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Tarako pasta specialist with Hokkaido tarako and thick, chewy fresh pasta from Awaji, opened March 2026 as a sister of 京都北山洋食パセリカフェ (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · signature aburi tarako dashi spaghetti ¥1,485, topped with sesame, shibazuke and hijiki and finished with a pour of ago and kombu dashi (March and May 2026) · e.g. squid and tarako, root-vegetable kinpira, white miso and mushroom, citrus tarako mayo, roast beef, ikura, a cheese mountain, tororo; grilled tarako rice (2026 reviews) · lunch set ¥1,380 with soup, salad, small side and dessert; drink set +¥300 (March–April 2026) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Pasta · Shijo Kawaramachi, tarako specialist] A small food-hall shop serving nothing but tarako pasta on chewy Awaji fresh noodles — try the aburi tarako dashi spaghetti, finished like ochazuke with a pour of dashi — plus a ¥1,380 lunch set. One April 2026 evening guest waited 40–50 minutes outside with half the seats empty for lack of staff; others found it average or a little pricey. Open all day.

chef_bio.background: Per the Kawaramachi Garden food hall page: a tarako pasta shop whose concept is creative tarako pasta and new ways to change its flavour (創作、味変と新しいたらこぱすたの楽しみ方). Opened 5 March 2026 (Tabelog). Reviewers in March–May 2026 call it a sister of 京都北山洋食パセリカフェ, which has a branch on the same floor.
chef_bio.philosophy: Creative tarako pasta with flavour changes (food hall page).
chef_bio.specialty: Aburi tarako dashi spaghetti.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner was told the dashi was ago (flying fish) and kombu, and poured it on like ochazuke until the dish became almost a soup pasta.
An April 2026 weekday-evening guest waited 40–50 minutes outside while more than half the seats stood empty for lack of staff.
A May 2026 lunch guest found it a very standard tarako pasta, like something to make at home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パスタ、下京区四条通り河原町東入真町68 河原町ガーデン 7F、阪急京都河原町駅直結、毎日 11:00〜21:30 (L.O.21:00)、季節で営業時間が変わる、予約不可、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、20席 (2人席10卓)、禁煙、一部テイクアウト可、子ども用椅子なし、スマートカジュアル、2026年3月5日開店。フードホールの紹介: 「日々たらこ」、創作、味変と新しいたらこぱすたの楽しみ方。口コミ (2026年3月〜9月、英語): 京都北山洋食パセリカフェの姉妹店、北海道のたらこ、淡路の生パスタ、炙りたらこのだしスパゲッティ1,485円 (ごま、柴漬け、ひじき、あごと昆布のだし)、いかとたらこ、根菜のきんぴら、白味噌ときのこ、柑橘のたらこマヨ、ローストビーフ、いくら、チーズ、とろろ、焼きたらこご飯、ランチセット1,380円、ドリンクセット300円、人手不足で空席があっても40〜50分待ったとの声 (2026年4月)、普通・やや高いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Food-hall shop; no reservations; cards, IC and PayPay.

places.name: サムギョプサル専門店 豚星 (Samgyeopsal Senmon Ten Butaboshi)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: Korean sauces and marinades, crepes for wrapping and banchan; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a pork samgyeopsal specialist (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00, last order 22:30 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog original 無し). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 32 seats: 6 at the counter, tables, and a private room for 5–8 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; February 2025 and May 2026). 2F, 1 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo Kawaramachi, east side — 1 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Samgyeopsal specialist built around set courses, with staff grilling and cutting the thick pork at the table (2026 reviews) · courses with banchan, kimchi, unlimited wrapping vegetables and soft drinks, e.g. a 200 g meat course and a course with dessert and 90 minutes of soft drinks (March 2026) · wrap it with tomato kimchi, natto and cheese in brown-rice crepes; moksal; yuzu sorbet (2025–2026 reviews) · alcohol all-you-can-drink, makgeolli included, about ¥500 extra (March–July 2026) · about ¥3,000–5,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Korean · Shijo Kawaramachi, samgyeopsal] A small second-floor samgyeopsal specialist where cheerful staff grill thick pork belly for you and show how to wrap it — tomato kimchi, natto, cheese and brown-rice crepes — in good-value courses with free-flowing vegetables, plus cheap all-you-can-drink with makgeolli. Smoking allowed. Book ahead; open till 23:00.

roles: Staff who grill at the table (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a samgyeopsal specialist on a second floor by Kawaramachi Stn. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a course-only style, staff who grill and cut the meat and explain how to eat it, and generous portions.
chef_bio.philosophy: Course-only, fixed price (April 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Samgyeopsal course.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 and May 2026 regular liked that the staff grill while chatting, and noted that smoking is allowed.
An April 2026 reviewer praised the course-only style for removing the worry of add-ons.
A July 2026 diner ran out of kimchi, ordered more à la carte, and switched dessert to a yuzu sorbet.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・韓国料理・豚料理、下京区真町98-3 2F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩1分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、予約可、サービス料無し、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、32席 (カウンター6、テーブル、個室5〜8名)、喫煙可、飲み放題あり。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年7月、英語): コース中心、店員が焼いて切ってくれる、厚い豚肉、ナムルなどのおかず、キムチ、包む野菜とソフトドリンクが食べ放題・飲み放題、肉200gのコース、デザート付きのコース、トマトキムチ、納豆、チーズ、玄米のクレープ、モクサル、ゆずのシャーベット、マッコリも含む飲み放題は約500円追加。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff grill and explain; smoking allowed; cards only (no IC or QR).

places.name: GOOD morning record bar
places.gf_detail: Not GF: the food is mainly wheat donuts; a salted plate of sausages, olives and achar is the savoury snack (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: donuts with butter, cream or ice cream; sausages (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–23:30; hours may change (Tabelog). A cafe by day and a bar at night, with occasional DJ events (2026 reviews). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). A few counter seats and two tables, standing room at night, no space for bags; when full, guests spill onto the riverside or sit on the stairs (April and September 2026). One drink per person for solo guests (May 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On the Takase River, 1 min walk from Hankyu Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; August 2025). Opened 12 December 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi on the Takase River — 1 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Record cafe-bar with LPs and a DJ booth by the Takase River (2025–2026 reviews) · warm, chewy donuts from the nearby bakery kurs with whipped cream, ice cream and maple, or red bean butter: donut with whipped cream ¥900, coffee ¥400 (September 2025); donut and drink ¥1,550 (May 2026) · espresso tonic, yuzu soda, juices; at night beer, gin and tonic and highballs ¥800 (2025–2026 reviews) · salted plate of sausages, olives and achar (August 2025) · about ¥1,000–3,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Record bar · Kiyamachi by the Takase River] A tiny record cafe-bar where LPs spin by the door (requests welcome): warm, chewy donuts from the nearby kurs bakery with cream or red bean butter by day, highballs and gin and tonics at night, when the crowd spills onto the riverside. Several reviewers note many overseas guests. Loud music, no room for bags, plastic cups. Cash only; till 23:30.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bar and cafe opened 12 December 2021 by the Takase River. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a record collection with a DJ booth facing the street, record requests taken, and donuts supplied by the nearby bakery kurs.
chef_bio.specialty: Warm donuts from kurs; espresso tonic.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 regular recommends the espresso tonic and notes that record requests are taken.
On a full Wednesday night in September 2026, a visitor about to leave was offered a seat on the stairs inside, with a highball in a soft plastic cup.
Several reviewers note many overseas guests (November 2025–September 2026).

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests (several reviews); cash only; small and loud; standing at night.

places.notes: [Local Chinese · Horikawa Marutamachi, fried rice with everything] A neighbourhood Chinese diner whose gimmick is a side of fried rice with any dish — ramen, mapo, even fried rice — plus curry and shrimp fried rice, a numbing Sichuan mapo bowl and a summer chilled tantanmen. Cheap, quick and local; QR payment but no cards. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Chinese and ramen restaurant on Marutamachi with a second shop in Imadegawa. A January 2026 review notes signed photos from visiting celebrities on the walls; a December 2025 regular who mostly orders take-away recalls the fried-rice add-on once costing ¥200.
chef_bio.specialty: Fried rice; Sichuan mapo rice bowl.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor came in because of the sign promising fried rice with fried rice, and ordered stir-fried vegetables with it instead.
A June 2026 diner suspected a secret sweet ingredient in the fried rice and could not pin it down.
An August 2026 first-timer loved the chilled tantanmen but found the fried rice a little dry.

Dinner only; closed Tuesday; book for groups.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: run by a chef from Northeast China, formerly Manchuria; open since 2000 as a local Chinese restaurant. An April 2025 review describes a Chinese family running it; reviews in 2024 and 2026 say it once had other branches, including one on Horikawa, now closed.
chef_bio.specialty: Authentic mapo tofu; Northeast Chinese dishes.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 regular returned for the Sara Udon remembered from the old lunch menu and found it as good as ever, at ¥1,480 for the evening set.
For an April 2025 group it is the usual second stop after yakiniku in Omiya, for mapo tofu and spicy eggplant with Shaoxing wine.
An April 2026 diner loved the Guo Bao Rou but called the fried rice burnt and unsalted.

places.cuisine: Traditional Puglian cooking from the heel of Italy (official site) · lunch course from ¥3,850 incl. tax: chef's antipasti, then a choice of pasta or main (official menu) · orecchiette with tomato and cacioricotta, chickpea pasta, burnt-wheat orecchiette with cima di rapa and anchovy (official menu) · Sagne Incannulate with hairy crab, orecchiette with fresh tuna, grilled horse skirt, seaside fritto misto (May 2025) · four antipasti, homemade pasta chosen from samples shown at the table (November 2024; May 2025) · tiramisu and espresso (January 2025); natural wines and wine by the glass (2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Italian · Shogoin, a one-person Puglian osteria] A 14-seat osteria in a quiet residential street serving the rustic cooking of Puglia: handmade orecchiette and other pasta shown to you before you choose, generous antipasti, fritto misto and grilled mains, with a strong natural-wine list. Lunch courses from ¥3,850. Book by phone; ¥300 cover at dinner; open days vary.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: an osteria of typical Puglian cooking, with thanks to the Colucci family, and Stefano in particular. A June 2026 review says the owner runs everything alone.
chef_bio.philosophy: Simple, strong and somehow comforting food in the spirit of Puglia (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Puglian handmade pasta; orecchiette.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 business traveller started with a pretzel-like nibble and named the Sagne Incannulate with hairy crab a new favourite.
A June 2026 diner phoned just before arriving, found lunch was courses only, and watched the room fill up soon after.
A March 2025 solo diner took a last-minute table, ordered an Aperol at once, and felt transported to Italy.

places.notes: [Izakaya · Mibu, a couple-run local with Kochi fish] A 13-seat neighbourhood izakaya, open since 2007 and run by a friendly couple, with a tiny courtyard garden and fish shipped straight from Sukumo in Kochi: sashimi, namero, crisp fried dishes and a long list of homely small plates, with shochu and sake. Closed Sunday and Monday.

Reviews from 2020 to 2023 describe a friendly couple running it; a February 2022 neighbour learned the couple are not from Kochi but take part in a project supporting fish from Kochi's ports.

anecdotes.text: An August 2020 party of two adults and two first-graders could not finish the ¥2,000 course.
A March 2024 regular gets the first beer poured before ordering and extra vegetables because the sides always come back empty.
A November 2023 visitor of many years singled out the namero.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 first-timer at monjayaki was reassured when the staff cooked it at the table.
A March 2025 group came after a show at Gion Kagetsu and took an okonomiyaki home as well.

places.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishikiyamachi on the Takase River, thick-cut negi-tan] A small, modern yakiniku room with tables looking onto the Takase River, a minute from Hankyu Kawaramachi: hand-cut A5 Wagyu — thick negi-tan, Kobe kalbi, harami — with a light dipping sauce, and courses that end with a Wagyu-and-egg rice pot. 90-minute seating; weekend lunch.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes carefully selected A5 Wagyu and a signature thick-cut negi-tan. Reviewers mention attentive staff (July 2026) and a friendly owner (July 2026).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular brought friends back for dinner after a first visit at lunch, insisting on the special tongue first.

places.name: ココロ (Kokoro)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Small plates that change monthly — sashimi, tamagoyaki, teppan egg, stuffed peppers with meat miso, a teppan hamburg, fried oysters, conger tempura; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-meat standing bar — sashimi, chicken, hamburg, oysters (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday 15:00–23:00; Tuesday–Saturday 15:00–23:30; Sunday 13:00–22:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash or PayPay; no cards (Tabelog). A standing bar for about 40, with a large L-shaped counter and round tables (Tabelog; September 2026). Smoking outside the entrance (Tabelog). places.notes: [Standing bar · Kawaramachi back alley, monthly small plates] A roomy, neon-lit standing bar down an alley off Kiyamachi, open from mid-afternoon: ¥480 draft beer and a monthly-changing list of more than fifty small plates — sashimi, peppers with meat miso, chicken-liver sashimi, a teppan egg you mix yourself. Cash or PayPay; no bookings.

chef_bio.background: Regulars praise food a level above a typical standing bar and a menu that changes every month (October and November 2026). A November 2026 reviewer calls it a sister shop of “Momiji”; reviewers describe a cheerful owner (October 2026) and four or five lively staff (August and September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly small plates; sashimi.

anecdotes.text: A first-time solo visitor in August 2026 felt at ease among the regulars thanks to the cheerful staff, and resolved to return on every Kyoto trip.
An October 2026 visitor, whose usual standing bar was closed, ducked in out of the rain and stayed.

places.notes: [Izakaya · Kawaramachi 5F, Kyoto vegetables for groups] A large upstairs izakaya a minute from Hankyu Kawaramachi, with private rooms and all-you-can-eat-and-drink plans from ¥2,400: Kyoto vegetables, a whole Kamo eggplant stuffed with minced meat, nama-fu pizza and yuba. Open late — until 2:00 on Fridays and Saturdays. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text pitches cheap all-you-can-eat-and-drink plans with private rooms for parties. Reviewers mention young, energetic staff (November 2025) and a slight smell of tobacco (February 2026).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner on the Kyoto cuisine course added meat sushi at ¥99 and called it a bargain.
A February 2025 guest chose it for the fully private rooms where smoking was allowed.

places.notes: [Neighbourhood Chinese · Horikawa-Nakadachiuri] A family-run local Chinese shop serving big, cheap set meals to workers and students: "Chuben" bento sets, yakiniku and kara-age sets, dan dan noodles and ramen, mostly ¥750–1,000. No cards (QR yes); closed Saturday.

chef_bio.background: A family-run Chinese restaurant (February 2025 review). Two reviewers describe a lunch crowd of local workers and students (April 2025, June 2026).

anecdotes.text: On Kyoto Marathon day in February 2025, a walker cut off by road closures ordered wakame ramen and found it piled with vegetables like tanmen.
A November 2025 regular cycled old batteries to the junkyard across the road, then rewarded the effort with the ¥750 yakiniku set.
A June 2026 visitor sought out the ¥800 Chinese bento set, a style now rare.

places.name: Bisan 京都店 (Bisan Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Falafel, hummus and stews, but sandwiches come in pita and desserts include a nut pie (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; falafel, hummus and an okra-tomato stew sit beside chicken dishes and goat cheese (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).

places.cuisine: Palestinian home cooking (2026 reviews): falafel stuffed into pita with vegetables, sauces and pickles, hummus, sabaneh (spinach and chicken), okra and tomato stew with rice, fasoulia hamra with soup, eggplant and okra stew, goat cheese, a warm dessert, a nut-filled pie, Turkish-style ice cream; a value pair set and a tasting course; sage tea, rooibos mint tea, Arabic tea, pomegranate juice; wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Palestinian · Demachi Masugata arcade] A rare Palestinian kitchen at the mouth of the Demachi arcade, the Kyoto branch of Bisan in Tokyo: falafel in pita, hummus, spinach-and-chicken sabaneh and okra stew, with sage tea or pomegranate juice. About ¥2,000–3,000. Dinner Friday to Sunday; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 29 November 2024 (Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer heard the main shop is in Jujo, Tokyo — the Bisan there opened in January 2011 under owner-chef Sudqi Mansour (Arab News). Reviews differ on the Kyoto kitchen: "run by someone from Palestine" (April 2026) and "the Palestinian chef" (August 2026), but "the staff were Japanese" (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Falafel; sabaneh.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor who had been reading about Palestine came here and was struck by the goat cheese, a warm dessert and sage tea.
On a value pair set in April 2026, a first-timer liked the falafel in pita and the okra and tomato stew, and planned to visit the Tokyo shop too.
A March 2026 fan of Middle Eastern food loved the flavours but found the portions small for the price.

places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30); dinner 17:00–19:00 (last order 18:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Tabiiro (undated) gives 11:30–19:00, open daily. Bookings taken; private room for 8; lunch hire for 7+ (Tabelog). Check in at the first-floor pickle shop, then go up to the second-floor dining room (March 2026 review). places.cuisine: Kyoto set meals from a pickle and miso house (Tabiiro; 2025–26 reviews): Kyoto pickle sushi with nama-fu gozen (limited), assorted Kyoto pickle gozen with tofu and several misos, Saikyo-miso-grilled silver cod or mackerel gozen with rice, miso soup, tofu and a long plate of pickles, Iberico pork grilled on a magnolia leaf with leaf miso, white-miso chazuke; rice refills; pickle and miso bento and a special Tanabe So kaiseki (Tabiiro); sake (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Pickle-house set meals · Demachi] The upstairs dining room of 田辺宗, a Kyoto pickle and miso maker founded in 1875, in a converted miso storehouse: Kyoto pickle sushi, long plates of house pickles with tofu and miso, and Saikyo-grilled fish with free rice refills. About ¥2,000–3,000. Pickles to buy downstairs. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Restaurant of the pickle and miso maker 田辺宗 (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Run directly by 田辺宗, a Kyoto pickle and miso house founded in 1875 (Meiji 8), in a renovated miso storehouse (Tabiiro). Formerly named 葵匠 (Tabelog). The pickle shop is on the first floor (2025–26 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto pickle sushi; Saikyo-yaki.

anecdotes.text: Two friends in April 2026 just made the limited pickle-sushi and nama-fu gozen, bought pickles downstairs, then walked to Kawai and Shimogamo shrines under the Kamo River cherry blossoms.
In March 2026 the first taste of the Saikyo-grilled silver cod made a pair exchange surprised looks.
A late, unbooked traveller in September 2026 was seated at once for a Saikyo-yaki gozen of mackerel.

A Doshisha regular between classes in June 2026 liked the free spicy bean sprouts as a palate cleanser.

places.name: マハヤーナ (MAHAYANA)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: toast-based morning sets and cinnamon toast (2023 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: siphon coffee and fresh fruit juices are plant-based; milk drinks and toast are not (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 8:30–18:00; closed Wednesday. No reservations. About 10 seats around a U-shaped counter (May and August 2025). Smoking allowed at every seat — cigarettes and e-cigarettes, but no cigars, pipes or kretek (August 2025; April 2026). No cards (Tabelog). On Teramachi just south of Shijo, by a Takashimaya entrance (2016 review).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi, just south of Shijo — 2 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: A small regulars' coffee counter of about 40 years, with siphon coffee (2016–2026 reviews) · siphon-brewed blend; iced café latte ¥550 (May 2025) · the master's mixed juice; banana juice ¥600 (2023–2025) · morning sets; thick cinnamon toast (2023)
places.notes: [Kissa · Teramachi-Shijo, siphon coffee among the regulars] A white-tiled, glass-fronted coffee counter just south of Shijo on Teramachi, around for about 40 years: siphon coffee, fresh banana or mixed juice, thick cinnamon toast and morning sets, with regulars greeted by name. Smoking allowed at every seat (no cigars or pipes). Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2016 to 2026 describe a small café with a white tiled front and black-framed glass windows, a U-shaped counter of about ten seats, the same regulars every morning, a skilled, friendly owner who chats with guests — in English with visitors (May 2025) — and a nostalgic feel; a May 2026 reviewer puts its age at about 40 years.
chef_bio.specialty: Siphon coffee; mixed juice.

anecdotes.text: May 2016: "Every morning, the same customers greet each other at the same time and place the same order to start their day."
April 2026: "Smoking is allowed, but I noticed a sign stating, 'No cigars, pipes, or Garam!'"
May 2025: the owner "was actively engaging with customers in English… the regulars were greeted with 'Take care' as they left."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: マハヤーナ (MAHAYANA)、喫茶店、下京区寺町通四条下ル貞安前之町619、京都河原町駅から170m、8:30〜18:00、水曜休み、予約不可、喫煙可、カード不可。口コミ (2006年2月〜2026年5月、英語): 白いタイルの外観と黒い木枠のガラス窓、寺町の高島屋の入口の角、U字のカウンター約10席、全席喫煙可 (葉巻・パイプ・ガラムは不可)、サイフォンのブレンド、アイスカフェラテ550円、バナナジュース600円、マスターのミックスジュース、厚切りのシナモントースト、モーニング、毎朝同じ常連、英語でも話す店主、約40年続く店。

cultural_comfort.note: Owner chats in English; smoking at every seat.

places.name: ラホンバン マーラータン 京都河原町店 (Rahoban Maratan)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a peanut-cream mala broth with wheat dumplings, buns, fried dough and noodles; the free corn noodles are a separate choice (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: you pick your own vegetables, tofu and noodles, but the broth is not described (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–21:30, open through New Year. No reservations — call to ask how busy it is; queues of up to 30 minutes in the evening (May 2026), benches downstairs. Pick ingredients from a self-service display and pay by weight; corn noodles free on orders over ¥1,000; aprons and one free ice cream (2026 reviews). Spice levels from 0.5 to 4, non-spicy soups for children, a dry mala xiang guo option, a sauce bar. Non-smoking; children welcome. Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money, QR (incl. Alipay). Basement of the Ishizumi Building. Opened 12 December 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-Sanjo side — 177 m from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Korean-style malatang by weight, from a brand with a shop in Osaka (2026 reviews) · choose vegetables, meats (lamb), tofu, noodles and novelty items — panda- and pig-shaped buns and mochi, custard and red-bean buns — then a mild, creamy peanut broth at spice 0.5–4; about ¥1,080–1,300 a bowl (April, July 2026) · dry "mala xiang guo" · fried rice and kara-age; ice cream (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Malatang · Kawaramachi, Korean-style mala by weight] A bright basement malatang shop near Kawaramachi, opened December 2025: fill a bowl from the self-service display, pay by weight, and pick a heat from 0.5 to 4 in a mild peanut-cream broth, with free corn noodles over ¥1,000 and cute panda buns. Two reviewers say it is popular with women (May, July 2026). Queues at dinner; some found the broth sweet and peanutty (April 2026).

chef_bio.background: Opened 12 December 2025 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a Korean-influenced, clean and spacious room with friendly staff, a sauce bar, and a sister shop in Osaka that one diner had tried first (May 2026). The operator and full number of shops were not found.
chef_bio.specialty: Peanut-cream malatang.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "the soup had a strong peanut flavor, and the sweetness was quite pronounced."
May 2026: "I had to go out of my way to get a ladle since they didn't provide one, though! Haha."
May 2026: "I arrived around 7 PM and had to wait about 30 minutes in line."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラホンバン マーラータン 京都河原町店、中華料理、中京区下大阪町349-6 イシズミビル B1F、京都河原町駅から177m、毎日 11:00〜21:30、年末年始も営業、予約不可 (混雑は電話で)、禁煙、子供可 (辛くないスープあり)、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2025年12月12日オープン。口コミ (2026年4〜7月、英語): 韓国風のマーラータン、具材を自分で選び重さで会計、1,000円以上でとうもろこし麺が無料、エプロン、アイス1つ無料、辛さ0.5〜4、ピーナッツのクリーミーなスープ、汁なしの麻辣香鍋、パンダや豚の形の饅頭や餅、カスタードやあんこの揚げ饅頭、ラム肉、炒飯、唐揚げ、タレのバー、大阪にも店、夜は30分待ち、女性客が多いという声が2件、ピーナッツが強く甘いという声、お玉がなかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-service by weight; choose a spice level.

places.name: とんかつ きんとん 京都店 (Tonkatsu Kinton Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breaded tonkatsu, minced cutlets and fried shrimp (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork cutlets and fried shrimp (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–21:00; closed Tuesday and some Wednesdays (open when a holiday falls on a closing day); open at New Year (January 2026). Reservations taken. 20 seats (three tables for 4, four for 2). Non-smoking. Menus in English, Chinese and Korean, with photos; children, babies and strollers welcome. Cards (incl. UnionPay), transit IC and e-money, QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay). Just inside Pontocho, 2 min from Kawaramachi and Gion-Shijo. Opened 29 August 2025 (Tabelog), in the former premises of a tonkatsu shop (January 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, south end — 2 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi and Gion-Shijo
places.cuisine: The Kyoto branch of a Sannomiya, Kobe tonkatsu shop listed in Tabelog's top 100 (2025–2026 reviews; web listing) · "Chateaubriand" (tenderloin) cutlet ¥2,800; large loin set ¥2,000; hand-ground minced cutlet set ¥1,200; set meals around ¥2,100 (October 2025–February 2026) · "Luxurious three" set of tenderloin, large fried shrimp and vegetable minced cutlet; "Golden" sampler set (2026) · refillable rice, miso soup, cabbage and salad; rock salt, wasabi, a sweet Nagasaki soy sauce and house sauce; katsu chazuke to finish (2026)
places.notes: [Tonkatsu · Pontocho, a Kobe top-100 shop's Kyoto branch] The Kyoto branch, opened August 2025 at the south end of Pontocho, of a Kobe tonkatsu shop on Tabelog's top-100 list: pink-centred loin and Chateaubriand cutlets with rock salt or Nagasaki soy, minced cutlets, big fried shrimp, refillable rice and miso, and katsu chazuke to finish. Some found prices a bit high (January 2026) and the chazuke broth light (February 2026). Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 29 August 2025 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2025–2026 say the main shop is in Sannomiya, Kobe, and is listed among Tabelog's top 100 tonkatsu restaurants; a Kobe Sannomiya とんかつ きんとん is also listed online. A January 2026 reviewer notes it took over and renovated the premises of a former tonkatsu shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Chateaubriand cutlet; loin cutlet.

anecdotes.text: January 2026: "The prices are a bit high, but the meat was delicious, and the rice and miso soup, which you can refill, were also very tasty."
February 2026: "The tea-flavored broth for the ochazuke might be a bit on the lighter side."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: とんかつ きんとん 京都店、中京区柏屋町169-4、阪急京都河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩2分、11:30〜14:30・17:30〜21:00、火曜休み (水曜は不定)、祝日は営業、予約可、20席、禁煙、英語・中国語・韓国語の写真付きメニュー、子供・赤ちゃん・ベビーカー可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2025年8月29日オープン。神戸三宮のとんかつ きんとん (ネットの掲載)。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 本店は三宮で食べログのとんかつ百名店、シャトーブリアン2,800円、手ごね メンチカツ定食1,200円、上ロースカツ定食2,000円、定食2,100円ほど、ヒレ・大海老フライ・野菜メンチの贅沢三種、ゴールデンセット、ご飯・味噌汁・キャベツ・サラダはおかわり自由、岩塩・わさび・長崎の甘い醤油・ソース、締めのかつ茶漬け、先斗町の入口、以前のとんかつ店の跡を改装、値段が少し高いという声、茶漬けの出汁が薄いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese and Korean with photos.

places.name: 創作料理 壮樹 (Creative cuisine SOJU)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pizza, oyster tempura, mapo tofu, shrimp mayonnaise and soy-based dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, chicken liver, wagyu and seafood dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Thu 18:00–24:00; Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 18:00–1:00 (last food order 24:00); Wednesday open only if booked by 17:00 that day; days off on the online booking calendar. Lunch by reservation only (since April 2025). Dinner is hard to book (April 2025) and fills at opening (May 2025). 22 seats: counter, tatami and tables; private room up to 20. Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards, transit IC and e-money, QR. 1F of the Iyasaka Building on Kiyamachi north of Shijo. Opened 1 April 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi, north of Shijo — 5 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: A creative izakaya mixing Japanese, Western and Chinese ideas (2024–2026 reviews) · sashimi platters (bluefin tuna, sea bream); fresh-fish carpaccio; grated octopus with ponzu; chicken liver sashimi; chicken tataki (2024–2025) · yuzu-pepper mapo tofu; large shrimp with mayonnaise; oyster tempura; black-wagyu steak; pizza; Caesar salad (2024–2025) · freshly made kamaboko with caramel ice cream; cheesecake (2024–2025) · reservation-only lunch: special seafood bowl, black-wagyu steak lunch (April 2025)
places.notes: [Creative izakaya · Kiyamachi, a hard-to-book local favourite] A dim, relaxed creative izakaya on Kiyamachi that fills at opening: sashimi and carpaccio, yuzu-pepper mapo tofu, oyster tempura, wagyu steak, pizza and an unexpected kamaboko-and-caramel ice cream, with a reservation-only lunch. One diner found it ordinary and the service very slow (February 2026). Smoking allowed. Open till midnight or 1:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 April 2020 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe a calm, dimly lit room on lively Kiyamachi with counter, tatami and table seats, attentive staff, a menu that changes with each visit, and dinner that is hard to book; lunch by reservation began in April 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Yuzu-pepper mapo tofu; sashimi.

anecdotes.text: February 2026: "No plans to return. The food was at an izakaya level… the sashimi was on the smaller side. Above all, the service was way too slow."
December 2024: "I tried the freshly made kamaboko (steam-cooked fish cake) caramel ice cream for the first time."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 創作料理 壮樹、創作料理・居酒屋・海鮮、中京区四条木屋町上ル鍋屋町217 弥栄ビル 1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分、月〜木 18:00〜24:00・金日祝 18:00〜翌1:00・土 18:00〜翌1:00 (料理 L.O. 24:00)、昼は予約のみ、水曜は17時までに予約がなければ休み、休みはネット予約のカレンダーで、22席、個室 (20名まで)、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2020年4月1日オープン。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年5月、英語): 刺身の盛り合わせ (本鮪、鯛)、鮮魚のカルパッチョ、たこのおろしポン酢、鶏レバー刺し、鶏のたたき、柚子胡椒の麻婆豆腐、大海老のマヨネーズ、牡蠣の天ぷら、黒毛和牛のステーキ、ピザ、シーザーサラダ、できたてかまぼことキャラメルアイス、チーズケーキ、予約制のランチ (特製海鮮丼、黒毛和牛ステーキ、2025年4月から)、夜は予約が取りにくい、居酒屋レベルで提供が遅いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; smoking allowed.

places.name: 食堂マルシン (Shokudo Marushin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Three set meals — young-chicken kara-age, ginger pork and sweet-savoury beef belly — with sides, miso soup and rice; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every main is chicken, pork or beef (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00, dinner 18:00–20:00, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). The same three sets at dinner (October 2026). Bookings accepted (Tabelog); fills up soon after 11:30 and dishes are cooked to order, so it can be slow when busy (February and July 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats: a 5-seat counter and three tables; wooden interior; non-smoking (Tabelog; January 2026). On Higashi-oji just north of Higashiyama-Marutamachi, near Kyoto University Hospital and Kumano Shrine; 579 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; June 2026).
places.neighborhood: Higashiyama-Marutamachi, by Kyoto University Hospital — 579 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn
places.cuisine: A three-dish set-meal diner (2025–2026 reviews) · young-chicken kara-age (five big pieces), ginger pork, or beef belly grilled with onions in a sweet-savoury sauce, each with two small sides (such as simmered daikon, white-sesame tofu salad, potato and cabbage salads), miso soup and rice · ¥1,200 at lunch (July 2025–April 2026); large kara-age set ¥1,350 (February 2026); ginger pork set ¥1,300 at dinner (October 2026) · large rice +¥50; refills ¥50–150 (July 2025)
places.notes: [Set-meal diner · Higashiyama-Marutamachi by Kyoto University Hospital] A small, wooden, privately run diner with just three choices — crisp young-chicken kara-age, ginger pork, or sweet-savoury beef belly with onions — each with two homemade sides, miso soup and piping-hot rice for about ¥1,200–1,300. Everything is cooked to order, so come early: it fills soon after 11:30. Same menu at night. Cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 6 February 2019 (Tabelog). A small, privately owned diner, unrelated to the well-known マルシン飯店 (April 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Young-chicken kara-age set.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 pair waited five minutes outside, and the staff moved a counter seat so the two could sit together.
A July 2026 regular came back for the beef-belly set and blew on the piping-hot rice.
A February 2026 visitor at 11:30 sharp watched the place fill before the food arrived.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂マルシン、食堂、左京区聖護院山王町11-1、京阪神宮丸太町駅4番出口から徒歩9分 (579m)、月〜土 11:30〜14:00・18:00〜20:00、日曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、15席 (カウンター5、4人掛け2、2人掛け1)、禁煙、2019年2月6日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 若鶏の唐揚げ、豚の生姜焼き、牛バラ焼きの3種の定食、小鉢2品 (大根の煮物、白胡麻豆腐のサラダ、ポテトサラダ、キャベツのサラダ)、味噌汁、ご飯、昼1,200円、唐揚げ大盛り1,350円、夜の生姜焼き定食1,300円、ご飯大盛り+50円、おかわり50〜150円、注文後に調理、11時半すぎに満席、木の内装、京大病院と熊野神社の近く、有名なマルシン飯店とは無関係。

cultural_comfort.note: Three set meals; cash only.

places.name: じじばばDOS (Jijibaba DOS)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Small plates — prosciutto, mapo tofu, tacos, Napolitan spaghetti, fried gizzards, beef-tripe stew — with no gluten information published (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: ham, meat and fish plates (reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:30–1:00 Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings by phone. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Otoshi ¥500 (June 2024). 8 counter seats only (Tabelog; reviews mention about ten); smoking allowed (Tabelog). In the Rido dining alley (リド飲食街) off Shichijo-Karasuma, two doors from the original じじばば, 438 m from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; May 2024).
places.neighborhood: Rido dining alley, Shichijo-Karasuma — 438 m from Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: Counter bar of the じじばば group with wine and sake (Tabelog; reviews) · Spanish prosciutto (serrano) ¥1,000 for a full plate; mapo tofu ¥780; tako-butsu ¥650; Napolitan spaghetti ¥1,000; tacos; ham-hock ajoarriero; kiwi caprese; miso-marinated pork belly; kombu-cured sea bream; freshly fried gizzards; beef-tripe stew; carp kara-age (2024–2026 reviews) · otoshi such as blue-cheese potato salad, honeyed blue cheese with baguette, japchae (2024–2026) · sake such as Ine Mankai (red rice) and Shinkame, Sapporo Sorachi draught (2024)
places.notes: [Counter bar · Rido dining alley by Kyoto Station, じじばば's second shop] A tiny, smoky eight-seat counter in the retro Rido alley, two doors from the original じじばば and often where its overflow lands. Eclectic small plates — serrano ham, mapo tofu, tacos, Napolitan — with good sake and wine, about ¥3,000–5,000. Opens 18:30 till 1:00. Cash only; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner not named; じじばば group
chef_bio.background: The second shop of the izakaya じじばば, two doors from the original in the Rido dining alley (January and May 2024 reviews). Group shops in data: kyoto_sakenoateya_jijibaba, kyoto_jijibaba_mokubatei, kyoto_jijibaba_daisan_sakaba.
chef_bio.specialty: Small plates with sake and wine.

anecdotes.text: A May 2024 guest turned away from a full じじばば walked two doors down and found it was じじばば too.
A July 2024 visitor found the owner’s Kuraki Mai playing and ordered tacos with a Sapporo Sorachi.
A March 2025 diner watched the ¥1,000 Napolitan vanish between drinks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: じじばばDOS、ダイニングバー・バル・ワインバー、下京区東境町180、京都駅から徒歩10分 (438m)、月〜土 18:30〜翌1:00、日祝定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、カウンター8席、喫煙可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): リド飲食街、じじばばの2号店、本店の2軒隣、お通し500円、生ハム (ハモンセラーノ) 1,000円、麻婆豆腐780円、たこぶつ650円、ナポリタン1,000円、タコス、アホアリエロ、キウイのカプレーゼ、豚バラの味噌漬け焼き、鯛の昆布締め、砂肝の唐揚げ、もつ煮、鯉の唐揚げ、ブルーチーズのポテトサラダ、伊根満開、神亀、サッポロ ソラチ。

places.name: レストラン キエフ (Restaurant Kiev)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pirozhki, borscht, beef stroganoff, cabbage rolls, mushroom stews, pilaf and bakes; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat-based borscht, stroganoff, cabbage rolls and cream stews (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Weekdays 12:00–15:30 (last food order 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (last food order 20:00); weekends and holidays 12:00–21:00; closures on a calendar; year-end closure 30 December–2 January (Tabelog). Rooftop beer garden 14 May–30 September, its terrace the only smoking area (Tabelog). Bookings online; 9 or more by phone; ask for a window table (Tabelog; August 2026). No service charge (Tabelog original text: なし). Cards, transport IC and PayPay (Tabelog). 80 seats, private rooms for 6–20, live stage; English menu and English-speaking staff; wheelchair accessible; children welcome with a kids’ menu (Tabelog). On the 6th floor of the Kamoto Building on Nawate just north of Shijo, overlooking the Kamo, 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion-Shijo, Nawate — 1 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Ukrainian, Georgian and Russian cooking with a view of the Kamo River and Kyoto Tower (Tabelog; reviews) · weekday lunch A ¥1,650 and B (golubtsy cabbage rolls) ¥1,880, with pirozhki, borscht, cabbage salad, the main and Russian tea (August–October 2026) · holiday and dinner courses about ¥3,000–4,000 and up, e.g. griby (mushrooms), pirozhki, beef stroganoff, stews and pilaf (2026 reviews) · summer rooftop beer garden with all-you-can-drink including craft beers (July–September 2026) · celebration dessert plates; online shop (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Ukrainian–Russian · Gion-Shijo above the Kamo, since 1972] A long-loved sixth-floor dining room at Gion-Shijo with big windows over the Kamo River and Kyoto Tower, serving borscht, crisp pirozhki, cabbage rolls and beef stroganoff. Weekday lunch sets run about ¥1,650–1,900; in summer the rooftop becomes a beer garden. Book and ask for a window table.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s introduction: open since 1972, serving traditional Ukrainian, Georgian and Russian dishes with views of Kyoto through large windows; private rooms and a live stage. The official site describes it as loved in Gion-Shijo for over 50 years. An October 2026 reviewer understood it to be linked to Sungari, a Russian restaurant with two branches in Shinjuku, Tokyo.
chef_bio.specialty: Borscht and pirozhki.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 couple shared lunches A and B — borscht, freshly fried pirozhki, cabbage rolls and a mushroom cream stew — and advised asking for a window table.
An October 2026 solo diner before a Danjuro show was given a table turned towards the river.
A September 2026 visitor had a second helping of pirozhki while thinking of far-off Russia and Ukraine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都・祇園四条で50年以上愛される、ロシア・ウクライナ・ジョージア料理のレストラン。食べログ: ロシア料理・洋食・ビアガーデン、東山区廿一軒町236 縄手通四条上ル 鴨東ビル6F、祇園四条駅7・8番出口から徒歩1分、平日12:00〜15:30・17:00〜21:00、土日祝12:00〜21:00、休業日はカレンダー、年末年始12月30日〜1月2日、9名以上は電話予約、サービス料なし、カード・交通系IC・PayPay可、80席、個室 (6〜12名、12〜20名)、ライブステージ、禁煙 (ビアガーデンのテラスは喫煙可)、英語メニュー・英語を話すスタッフ、車椅子可、子どもメニュー、1972年創業、大きな窓から京都の景色、屋上ビアガーデン (5月14日〜9月30日)、オンラインショップ。口コミ (2026年、英語): 平日のAランチ1,650円、Bランチ (ロールキャベツ) 1,880円、ピロシキ、ボルシチ、キャベツのサラダ、ロシアンティー、休日のコース3,000〜4,000円、きのこ料理 (griby)、ビーフストロガノフ、ピラフ、窓際の席、鴨川と京都タワーの眺め、ビアガーデンの飲み放題にクラフトビール、新宿の Sungari と系列という口コミ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog).

places.name: 京都おぶや 京都駅店 (Kyoto Obuya, Kyoto Station)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi chazuke — rice with bonito-and-kombu dashi — topped with seafood, some dishes soy- or butter-soy-seasoned, with arare crackers among the condiments; Tabelog notes allergy information is available (official site; Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito-and-kombu dashi and bonito, tuna and mackerel flakes on every bowl (official site).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:15); closing days irregular, following JR Kyoto Isetan (official site; Tabelog). No reservations — take a numbered ticket and pay first; waits of 20–50 minutes at peak are common, the wait can be tracked by QR code (2026 reviews). Cards, ICOCA, WeChat Pay and Alipay; no QR codes (Tabelog). 27 seats at counters and tables; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). In Eat Paradise in front of the JR west exit gate, JR Kyoto Isetan restaurant floor, 60 m from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, JR west exit gate (JR Kyoto Isetan Eat Paradise)
places.cuisine: Kyoto dashi chazuke (official site) · every bowl comes with the house shaved bonito, tuna and mackerel flakes and pickles; rice cooked with kombu from a near-century-old Kyoto rice dealer; light bonito-and-kombu dashi; toppings chosen by a fishmonger of over 90 years (official site) · Obuya luxury chazuke with nine seafoods and sea urchin ¥1,990; kombu and plum ¥880; scallop and mentaiko in butter-soy ¥1,300; salmon four ways ¥1,300; marinated tuna with negitoro ¥1,200; sea bream with sesame sauce ¥1,400; Kyoto beef and Kujo leek ¥1,800; saikyo-grilled fish ¥1,800 (official menu) · small, medium or large rice (2026 reviews) · winter takeaway "cup de odashi" (official site)
places.notes: [Dashi chazuke · Kyoto Station west gate] A calm counter steps from the JR west gate pouring house bonito-and-kombu dashi over kombu-cooked rice and fishmonger-chosen toppings — sea bream with sesame, salmon four ways, a nine-seafood luxury bowl with urchin (¥880–1,990). Eat it plain, then with condiments and the house bonito flakes. Expect a queue at mealtimes; ticket first, pay first. Open 11:00–22:00.

roles: Operator not named; toppings chosen by a fishmonger founded over 90 years ago (official site)
chef_bio.background: Opened 31 August 2022 (Tabelog), described as Japanese fast food with a calm air (Tabelog introduction). Per the official site: rice from a Kyoto rice wholesaler of nearly 100 years, cooked with kombu as "obu-zuke mai"; a light homemade bonito-and-kombu dashi; a house blend of thinly shaved bonito, tuna and mackerel flakes; a second shop at Shijo-Karasuma opened and then closed on 15 March 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: enjoy the dashi and toppings plain first, then add condiments, then the house flakes for a richer bowl.
chef_bio.specialty: Sea bream with sesame sauce chazuke.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner came after a gyoza festival for something light and found about 20 groups already waiting.
An October 2026 visitor waited about 50 minutes at lunch but could track the queue by QR code.
A September 2026 guest with an upset stomach chose the saikyo-grilled fish and takana chazuke.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-obuya.jp): 京だし茶漬け専門店「京都おぶや」、すべてのだし茶漬けに「おぶや特製 けずり節」と「漬物」付き、おぶやの贅沢茶漬け1,990円 (9種の海の幸と雲丹)、昆布と梅880円、帆立と明太子のバター醤油1,300円、鮭尽くし1,300円、漬鮪と葱とろろ1,200円、鯛と胡麻だれ1,400円、京都牛と九条ネギ1,800円 (亀岡牛)、西京焼き茶漬け1,800円、京都で100年近い米問屋の国産米を昆布と炊いた「おぶ漬け米」、鰹と昆布の自家製だし、鰹節・鮪節・さば節の特製けずり節、創業90余年の魚屋が選んだ具材、京都駅店は11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:15)、不定休、席の予約不可、四条烏丸店は2026年3月15日で営業終了、冬季限定「カップdeおだし」。食べログ: お茶漬け・日本料理、ジェイアール京都伊勢丹 レストラン街 JR西口改札前イートパラダイス、京都駅から60m、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、27席、禁煙、アレルギー表示あり、2022年8月31日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 発券機で番号札、先払い、20〜50分待ち、QRで待ち状況、ご飯は小・中・大、あられ・胡麻・わさびの薬味。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine and pay-first counter; queue at mealtimes.

places.name: カルド (Card)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: a spaghetti house; sets come with bread (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream, carbonara, seafood and bacon sauces dominate; a tomato sauce and a mushroom special exist but no ingredient information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday 11:00–15:00 (lunch service until 14:00) and 18:00–21:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No table reservations; parties can be booked (Tabelog). One order per person (March 2026). Cash only — no cards (Tabelog). No charge (Tabelog original なし). 25 seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Queues at weekday and weekend lunch (March and June 2026). Dim, retro interior; the toilet at the back looks onto the river (July 2026). Down a narrow alley off Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Shijo, east of Hankyu; 2 min walk from Shijo Kawaramachi (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Shijo — 2 min walk from Shijo Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: Long-running spaghetti house, established 1988 per a March 2026 review, with a long menu of sauces plus toppings (2026 reviews) · scallop and spinach cream ¥1,450; shrimp tomato ¥1,250, mozzarella topping ¥300 (March 2026) · carbonara, clam-bacon-spinach cream, mentaiko and natto, tarako and squid, Genovese, mushroom special, tomato (2026 reviews) · lunch and dinner sets with salad, bread and a drink (2026 reviews) · about ¥1,000–3,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Pasta · Nishi-Kiyamachi, a retro alley spaghetti house] A dim, antique-filled pasta house down a narrow alley by the Takase River, serving a huge menu of spaghetti — the scallop, bacon and spinach cream is the signature — with value lunch and dinner sets. Expect a queue at lunch. One August 2026 guest found the pasta ordinary and the service unfriendly. Cash only; smoking allowed; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a pasta and dining bar of 25 seats taking party bookings. A March 2026 reviewer gives 1988 as its founding year; reviewers describe freshly boiled pasta, an extensive menu and a retro, dim interior.
chef_bio.philosophy: Freshly boiled original spaghetti (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Scallop, bacon and spinach cream spaghetti.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor added cut baguette to scoop up the plentiful white sauce of the scallop and spinach cream.
An August 2026 diner whose Genovese was sold out read the menu five times, then ordered the first item on the first page — tomato spaghetti.
An August 2026 guest found the oil and carbonara pastas ordinary, the room too dark and an older staff member off-putting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パスタ・ダイニングバー、下京区西木屋町通四条下ル阪急百貨店東入ル、四条河原町から徒歩2分、月火木〜日 11:00〜15:00 (サービスランチは14:00まで)、18:00〜21:00、水曜休み、予約不可 (宴会は予約可)、カード不可、チャージなし、25席、喫煙可。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 1988年創業、路地の奥、レトロで薄暗い店内、奥のトイレから川が見える、1人1オーダー、昼は行列、ソースとトッピングを選ぶ、ホタテとほうれん草のクリーム1,450円、エビのトマト1,250円、モッツァレラ300円、カルボナーラ、あさりとベーコンとほうれん草のクリーム、明太子納豆、たらことイカ、ジェノベーゼ、きのこ、サラダ・パン・ドリンク付きのセット、普通・暗い・店員の態度がよくないとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; one order each; smoking allowed; many dishes are named only by ingredients.

places.name: GINZA MUSIC BAR KYOTO
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists gluten-free options; the menu also has brioche burgers, lasagna, tacos and fugu fish and chips (Tabelog; February 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options; most signature dishes are wagyu, eel or fish (Tabelog; February 2026).
places.hours_raw: Monday 17:00–1:00; Tuesday–Sunday and holidays 12:00–1:00; last orders food 24:00, drinks 0:30 (Tabelog). Pia (August 2025 opening) gave 12:00–24:00 with Monday closed — Tabelog is newer. Reservations accepted; the 6-seat THE OMAKASE sushi counter is reservation-only (Tabelog; Pia). No charge (Tabelog original チャージ料なし). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 45 seats: 11 at the counter, 34 at tables; up to 50 standing; non-smoking (Tabelog). 2F of the Murakamiju building on Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Shijo — cross the little bridge, go through the cafe and take the lift (Tabelog; February 2026). Loud music, especially at the counter and at night (March and May 2026).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Shijo — 2–3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Listening bar with records, a DJ booth and custom speakers, serving bar food and cocktails, plus a reservation-only 6-seat omakase sushi counter (Pia; 2026 reviews) · e.g. unagi sandwich, wagyu tacos, Tajima beef lasagna (Tabelog); wagyu burger on brioche, tuna and avocado tacos, wagyu steak with creamy potatoes, fugu fish and chips, Basque cheesecake, matcha gateau chocolat (February 2026) · gins such as Monkey 47, Japanese whisky, a gin and tonic; coffee by day, with a Toriba Coffee pop-up in October 2026 (2026 reviews) · about ¥2,000–8,000; sushi course higher (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Music bar · Nishi-Kiyamachi, records and cocktails] The Kyoto sister of Ginza's listening bar: vintage turntables and custom speakers loud enough to make the music the main event, with cocktails, wagyu tacos and a brioche wagyu burger — and, behind it, a six-seat omakase sushi counter by reservation. Quieter by day. Several reviewers note many overseas guests and find it pricey for the portions. Till 1 a.m.

roles: Sushi chef of THE OMAKASE (unnamed; trained at a Michelin three-star restaurant, per Pia)
chef_bio.background: Per Pia: GINZA MUSIC BAR was born in Ginza in 2014, created by Shinichi Osawa and the producer of the brand COFFEE; its first official second shop, GINZA MUSIC BAR KYOTO, opened at Shijo-Kiyamachi in August 2025, with original speakers of its own acoustic design, vintage turntables and amplifiers, and a reservation-only 6-seat sushi counter, THE OMAKASE, run by a craftsman trained at a Michelin three-star restaurant (ミシュラン三つ星店で修行した職人).
chef_bio.philosophy: Food, drink and music for all five senses (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu tacos; THE OMAKASE sushi counter.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 father and daughter found the fish and chips made with fugu, and the room turned to Sonny Clark's "Cool Struttin'" once a large table left.
A March 2026 counter guest could barely hold a conversation over the volume, and the gin and tonic arrived watery and flat.
Several reviewers note that many of the guests are from overseas (February–May 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー、下京区西木屋町四条下ル船頭町194 村上重ビル 2F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、京都河原町駅から徒歩2〜3分、月 17:00〜翌1:00、火〜日・祝 12:00〜翌1:00 (L.O.フード24:00、ドリンク0:30)、予約可、チャージ料なし、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、45席 (カウンター11、テーブル34)、立食50名、禁煙、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーの選択肢あり、おすすめは鰻サンド、和牛タコス、但馬牛のラザニア。ぴあ: 2014年に大沢伸一と「COFFEE」プロデューサー・鳥羽伸博が銀座に開いた GINZA MUSIC BAR の初のオフィシャル2号店として2025年8月に四条木屋町にオープン、オリジナルスピーカーとヴィンテージのターンテーブルとアンプ、ミシュラン三つ星店で修行した職人の完全予約制6席の寿司カウンター「THE OMAKASE」。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): 入口がわかりにくい、小さな橋を渡りカフェからエレベーター、音量が大きく会話しにくい、量のわりに高い、和牛バーガー、ツナとアボカドのタコス、和牛ステーキ、ふぐのフィッシュアンドチップス、バスクチーズケーキ、Monkey 47、昼は静か、Toriba Coffee のポップアップ (2026年10月)、外国人客が多いとの声が複数。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests (several 2026 reviews); loud music at night; no cover charge; cards and QR.

places.name: SOUL&FOOD Mookie
places.gf_detail: Not GF: sandwiches, tacos, fried chicken, onion rings, nachos and fries (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Avocado tacos and an acai bowl are on the menu, but no ingredient information; most dishes are chicken, pork or cheese (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday and the day before a holiday 17:30–3:00 (last order 2:00); Sunday 17:30–1:00 (last order 24:00); holidays 17:30–3:00; open all year (Tabelog). Reviews from 2023–2024 describe lunch service too. Reservations accepted; private hire for 10 or more (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 20 table seats, up to 40 standing; smoking allowed except at lunch (Tabelog). Order at the counter first (September 2023). Events and parties held often (October 2026). 1F of the Shikisai Kawaramachi building by the Takase River; 3 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi south of Shijo, by the Takase River — 3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: American soul-food diner and bar, open till 3 a.m. (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews) · chicken over rice and pulled pork, a chicken-and-pork combo with fries ¥1,280 (June 2024); taco rice, steak sandwich, fried chicken, mac and cheese (2023–2026 reviews) · tacos by the piece — chicken, pork or avocado; onion rings with cheese; nachos; pickles (2024–2026 reviews) · desserts: acai bowls, banana splits (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews) · many beers (February 2025) · about ¥2,000–3,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [American diner · Kawaramachi by the Takase River, till 3 a.m.] A laid-back American diner-bar with original art and films on screen: chicken over rice, pulled pork, tacos by the piece, cheesy onion rings and banana splits, plus plenty of beer — a late second or third stop. Several reviewers note many overseas guests. Some found the service muddled. Smoking allowed at night.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an American-culture restaurant near the Takase River serving soul-food classics such as pulled pork sandwiches and chicken over rice, with acai bowls and banana splits, open for private bookings. Reviewers in 2023–2026 describe original art, foreign films on screen, events and a stall at outside events.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic American flavours, careful preparation of the meat (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken over rice; pulled pork.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 pair received one shared portion of fries without explanation, and a machine coffee arrived instead of the drip coffee ordered.
A regular of four visits recommends it as a late second or third stop and enjoys the events and parties (October 2026).
Several reviewers note many overseas guests (February 2024–April 2025).

places.notes: [Udon · Yoshida, a student-priced Sanuki udon shop] A small udon shop in a converted house by the Kyoto University medical campus, making its own Sanuki-style noodles: one or two servings for the same price, set meals named after Kyoto places, curry udon and a gentle, sweet-soy dashi. Under ¥1,000 for most sets. Cash only; lunch Monday to Saturday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an udon shop with homemade noodles, opened in December 2012. A May 2023 review describes a friendly older man boiling the noodles; reviews from 2023 to 2026 describe a lunchtime crowd of Kyoto University students and staff.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade Sanuki-style udon; Kyoto-named sets.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 regular on a sixth visit found it quiet during the Kyoto University entrance exams and tried the tempura with grated daikon in the hot broth.
An October 2024 couple returning after eight years found prices a little higher but still good value.
A December 2024 diner finished the Saga no curry udon by pouring the leftover curry over the rice.

places.notes: [Ramen · Umekoji, morning ramen in an old townhouse] A new ramen shop in a renovated townhouse near Kyoto Aquarium, opening at 7:00 with a light mackerel-based shoyu ramen for ¥540 — pick mackerel, chicken or chili oil — then switching to a rich sesame mazesoba at lunch. Cash only; order on a slip; closes when the noodles run out.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a ramen shop opened in November 2025 serving morning ramen and lunchtime mazesoba, in a renovated townhouse with a tatami room. Reviews in March and May 2026 describe one person running it; an August 2026 review mentions more staff.
chef_bio.specialty: Morning shoyu ramen; sesame mazesoba.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 early riser found it newly opened with an introductory discount and has been back several times for a large bowl with egg and chashu.
A February 2026 visitor to Kyoto Aquarium discovered mazesoba here and finished it with rice, as the shop recommends.
A May 2026 diner read a book while the single cook worked through orders, and found the ¥540 bowl a full, authentic shoyu ramen.
