places.neighborhood: Shimabara, through the old gate — under 10 min from Tanbaguchi
places.cuisine: Morning bagel sandwiches and coffee in a historic building (official site; 2024–26 reviews) · bacon, cheese and honey bagel sandwich ¥1,200; café au lait ¥700 (November 2025) · Kujo green-onion cream cheese and marinated mushroom bagel ¥800; coffee ¥600 (December 2025) · hummus and bacon bagel (November 2024); herbed potato salad bagel (March 2025) · café au lait with soy milk, milk tea (2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Café · Shimabara, breakfast in a former ageya] A morning café on the ground floor of a building that served as an ageya — a house where geisha entertained at banquets — and then as a ryokan until the early 1990s, with Taisho-era stained glass, high ceilings and a patchwork floor. Crisp warm bagel sandwiches and café au lait from 7:00. Closed Thursday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the building was first an ageya where geisha entertained at dinner parties and banquets, then a ryokan until the early 1990s; it reopened in 2012 with Cafe AUSGANG on the main floor and a private guest suite upstairs, and also hosts ikebana workshops and live music. Tabelog lists 20 December 2009 as the opening day.
chef_bio.specialty: Bagel sandwiches; the historic interior.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 visitor said "wow" three times on walking in under the stained glass and high ceiling.
A May 2024 visitor recognised the room from a favourite photo book and met the house cats.
An October 2025 early visitor waited a little because one person was working alone, and found the room hushed around the big shared table.

Concerts and a gallery, Gallery Sumomo (official site).
places.neighborhood: Demachiyanagi, west of the Kamo river
places.cuisine: A small Joseon-style tearoom (李朝喫茶) furnished with Korean antiques and crafts, serving an original coffee blend, traditional teas, desserts and a few light meals (official site) · Korean cold noodles ¥1,400 with chashu, egg, seaweed, kimchi and shiso (August 2025 – August 2026) · Friday-only kimbap lunch (October 2025; May 2026) · Korean rice-cake soup ¥1,400 (November 2025) · kalbi salad (June 2026); soy-milk noodles in spring and summer, tteok in autumn and winter (Tabelog) · jujube tea ¥800, Korean soy-milk latte ¥900, mugwort and red-bean rice cake ¥600 (March 2026)
places.notes: [Korean tearoom · Demachiyanagi, Joseon antiques and cold noodles] A quiet 15-seat tearoom filled with Korean antique furniture and crafts, serving traditional teas, a jujube latte and rice cakes, plus a much-praised bowl of Korean cold noodles and a Friday-only kimbap lunch. Featured on TV by the actor 松重豊 (June 2026 review). Cash only; Wednesday to Saturday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 李朝喫茶 李青, a small tearoom in a residential street near Demachiyanagi, showing Korean furniture and crafts and hoping guests will experience the culture of a neighbour with deep ties to Kyoto; it also runs a gallery and holds concerts. A June 2026 review says the actor 松重豊 introduced it on television the previous winter.
chef_bio.philosophy: To let guests taste, with all five senses, the culture of a neighbouring country closely tied to Kyoto (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Korean cold noodles; traditional teas.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor waited for warm weather to try the cold noodles seen on TV, booked through Instagram, and rated these the best cold noodles ever.
A February 2026 visitor found a note on each table asking for quiet voices, and other guests reading books.
A November 2025 visitor chose the Korean rice-cake soup on a cold day and found it gentle and full of ingredients.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 李朝喫茶 李青 (リセイ)、出町柳近くの住宅地の小さな喫茶店、韓国・朝鮮の家具や工芸品、オリジナルブレンド珈琲、伝統茶、デザート、軽食、ギャラリーすもも、イベント (2026年11月29日に箏とフルートの二重奏)。食べログ: カフェ、上京区梶井町448-16、水〜土11:00〜16:00 (L.O. 15:30)、日月火と夏冬の休み、予約不可、現金のみ、15席、禁煙、韓国冷麺、トック (秋冬)、豆乳麺 (春夏)、金曜限定のキンパのセット。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年8月、英語): 冷麺1,400円、韓国の雑煮1,400円、なつめ茶800円、豆乳ラテ900円、よもぎと小豆の餅600円、カルビサラダ、テレビで松重豊が紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: A quiet room: keep voices low; cash only; come Friday for kimbap. No English evidence found.

places.name: 僧伽小野 京都浄教寺 (Sanga Ono, Kyoto Jokyoji)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese set meals — sashimi, tempura, grilled fish, unaju, tai chazuke, chirashi — with soy-based seasoning; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A “Jokyoji veggie burger” with chickpea tomato sauce is one lunch main (December 2025, February 2026), and there is a salad buffet, but the miso soup is made with sake lees and dashi is not described.
places.hours_raw: Breakfast 6:30–11:00 (L.O. 10:30); lunch 11:30–15:30 (L.O. 14:30); dinner 17:00–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private rooms (Tabelog; April 2026). Cards, iD and QUICPay (Tabelog). 70 seats (Tabelog; Mitsui Fudosan release). On the 2nd floor of Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Kawaramachi Jokyoji, built together with Jokyoji temple; a minute from exit 10 of Hankyu Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station (Tabelog). Opened 28 September 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi south of Shijo — Mitsui Garden Hotel Jokyoji, 2F
places.cuisine: Seasonal Japanese food in a temple hotel (Tabelog) · lunch: choose two to five mains from about twenty — e.g. eight-kind sashimi with seared battera, roasted salmon with brown-butter soy, chicken tempura with conger simmered in egg, the Jokyoji veggie burger — with a half buffet of rice from a hagama pot, chirashi sushi, salad, sake-lees miso soup and coffee; ¥2,800 for two mains (December 2025 – April 2026) · tai chazuke gozen ¥2,780 at lunch; unaju ¥3,980 (Tabelog; August 2026) · kaiseki for groups and business dinners, served by staff (December 2025, April 2026) · breakfast from 6:30 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Japanese · Mitsui Garden Hotel Jokyoji, half-buffet lunch] A calm, roomy restaurant on the second floor of the temple hotel off Teramachi: a generous lunch of two to five mains — sashimi, tempura, grilled fish — with a buffet of hagama rice, chirashi and salad from ¥2,800, unaju and tai chazuke, and kaiseki with private rooms at night. Open from breakfast.

chef_bio.background: A Mitsui Fudosan release (2020) says the restaurant was opened by ONO GROUP, which runs several food businesses in Fukuoka, as the second shop of the Michelin-listed 僧伽小野 一秀庵 in Itoshima and its first outside Fukuoka. Tabelog’s name search also lists a Kyoto Shinmachi Bettei.
chef_bio.specialty: Half-buffet lunch; unaju.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor returns every January for lunch, and this time chose three mains — one too many.
An April 2026 diner booked a business kaiseki and was glad the staff plated each course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 三井不動産のリリース (2020年): 三井ガーデンホテル京都河原町浄教寺の2階、福岡県内で飲食事業を展開するONO GROUPの僧伽小野 一秀庵の2号店で県外初出店、日本料理、70席。食べログ: 日本料理、下京区寺町通四条下る貞安前之町620、阪急京都河原町駅10番出口から徒歩1分、朝食6:30〜11:00、昼11:30〜15:30、夜17:00〜21:30、年中無休、予約可、カード可、70席、2020年9月28日オープン、鯛茶漬け御膳2,780円、鰻重3,980円。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 20種ほどから主菜を2〜5品選ぶ昼のハーフビュッフェ (羽釜ご飯、ばらちらし、サラダ、酒粕の味噌汁、コーヒー)、主菜2品で2,800円、刺身8種、浄教寺ベジバーガー、サーモン、穴子の卵とじ、個室での会席。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; easy to get in at lunch.

Otoshi charge ¥330 including tax (Tabelog, original お突き出し料として330円(税込み)). Cards, IC cards and e-money (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at the counter, 8 at tables (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (September 2026). On the 2nd floor of the Kawaramachi Apex Building 2, about 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Station (Tabelog). Opened 6 September 2024 (Tabelog).

places.notes: [Sausage bar · Kawaramachi 2F, craft beer late] A small garage-style bar a few minutes from Hankyu Kawaramachi, making its own sausages with Miyama ingredients and pouring craft beer and craft shochu until 2:00. ¥330 otoshi; smoking allowed; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes homemade sausages and dishes using ingredients rooted in Miyama, Kyoto, in a room modelled on an old country garage. A September 2026 reviewer says the same people run a craft-beer shop in Pontocho.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade sausages; craft beer.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 reviewer praised the shochu range and the occasional fish dish alongside the sausages.

places.name: ちりとり鍋 いその (Chiritori Nabe Isono)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Chiritori hot pot of Wagyu offal and vegetables in a sweet-spicy sauce, finished with noodles or rice; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Wagyu-offal hot pot restaurant (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); Sunday and holidays 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Monday (Tabelog; September 2026). Reservations accepted; a table booking may be moved to the counter when busy (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし — the English translation is wrong). Cards including UnionPay; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 27 seats: a U-shaped counter of 19 around an open kitchen and two tables (Tabelog; 2026). No takeaway (September 2026). Two minutes from Hankyu Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station, on the Jukkencho-bashi street just west of the Takase River (Tabelog; 2026). Opened 20 June 2025 (September 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi north of Shijo, west of the Takase River
places.cuisine: Chiritori nabe — Osaka-style hot pot in a shallow square pan — of carefully chosen Wagyu offal from across Japan (Tabelog) · horumon nabe; premium horumon nabe with neck and short rib, ¥2,780 a person for two or more (2026); noodles, ramen or fried rice to finish (2026) · a 2026 limited offer: a Kumamoto A5 strip-loin steak grilled at the counter with a chiritori set for two or more (September–November 2026) · grilled Wagyu loin yukke, today’s sashimi, cream cheese kimchi, cheese risotto (September 2026) · the staff cook the hot pot for you (2026)
places.notes: [Chiritori hot pot · Kawaramachi by the Takase River, Wagyu offal] A lively counter around an open kitchen two minutes from Hankyu Kawaramachi, where staff cook Osaka-style chiritori hot pots of Wagyu offal and vegetables in a sweet-spicy sauce (¥2,780 a person), finished with noodles. Open since June 2025; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T3130001055762 is registered to 株式会社８８, Kyoto (NTA register). A September 2026 reviewer lists two sister shops in Kawaramachi, Taishu Sakaba Momiji and Marufuku. Reviewers note the manager grilling the steak at the counter (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Premium horumon chiritori nabe.

anecdotes.text: A first-time pair in September 2026 skipped the meat version and found the offal-only hot pot plenty, then added ramen.
An October 2026 regular came back a year after a first chiritori nabe here, hooked on the broth.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter hot pot; staff cook for you.

places.name: 炭火焼 こてっぱん (Sumibi-yaki Kotepan)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal yakitori with a house tare, chicken wings, fried drumsticks and karaage; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori restaurant (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; a 2-hour limit may apply (Tabelog; July 2025). Cards (Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). 32 seats over two floors, counter and tables; groups up to 18 (Tabelog; 2025–2026). Self-ordering from your seat (Tabelog). Down a back alley, two minutes from Hankyu Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station (Tabelog; June 2026). Opened 3 March 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi north of Shijo — back alley, 2 min from Hankyu
places.cuisine: Charcoal yakitori of fresh chicken from Fushimi, Kyoto, with a homemade secret tare, in a Kyoto townhouse (Tabelog) · skewers such as thigh, tsukune, garlic chicken and shishito; fried eggplant with sauce (December 2025) · chicken wings and fried drumsticks (September 2026) · karaage and fries, easy for children (June 2026) · potato salad, oyakodon (December 2025) · a wide sake and drink list; all-you-can-drink courses (Tabelog; May 2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Kawaramachi back alley, charcoal and Fushimi chicken] A two-storey townhouse yakitori bar down an alley by Hankyu Kawaramachi, grilling Fushimi chicken over charcoal with a house tare — wings and fried drumsticks are favourites — with a long drink list and self-ordering. Open every evening until midnight.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes chicken from Fushimi, Kyoto, grilled over high-quality charcoal with a homemade sauce, in a Kyoto townhouse. A December 2025 reviewer calls it the second branch of a main shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal yakitori; chicken wings.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 group of eight with children found a same-day table upstairs, with karaage and fries for the kids.
A September 2026 wing enthusiast came back for the charcoal tebasaki and fried drumsticks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 炭火焼 こてっぱん、焼き鳥・居酒屋・鶏料理、中京区河原町通四条上ル紙屋町367-1、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、毎日17:00〜24:00、予約可、カード・QR決済可、32席、18名まで、セルフオーダー、2024年3月3日オープン、京都伏見の鶏を備長炭で焼き自家製の秘伝のたれ、京町家。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): もも、つくね、にんにく、ししとう、揚げなすのたれ、手羽先、手羽元の唐揚げ、唐揚げ、フライドポテト、ポテトサラダ、親子丼、日本酒、2時間制、2階席、本店の2号店 (2025年12月の口コミ)。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-ordering; 2-hour limit when busy.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken broth and charcoal-grilled pork chashu (2025–26 reviews).

Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Students get a free extra serving of noodles with ID (March 2025 review). 3 min from Imadegawa Stn and the Kamigyo-ku Sogochosha-mae bus stop (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Imadegawa, south of Kamigyo ward office — 3 min from Imadegawa Stn
places.cuisine: Chicken-and-soy ramen with a sweet edge and flat noodles, in a square bowl, topped with five or six slices of charcoal-grilled rare chashu laid like petals (2025–26 reviews): charcoal chashu ramen ¥1,100, extra noodles ¥100 (August 2025), regular ramen, tsukemen, chicken-fat mazesoba; torch-grilled butter rice and chashu rice bowl
places.notes: [Charcoal chashu ramen · Imadegawa] A seven-seat lunch-only counter serving sweet-leaning chicken soy ramen on flat noodles in a square bowl, crowned with petals of smoky charcoal-grilled chashu (¥1,100), plus mazesoba and torched butter rice. Ticket machine; cash only; 11:30–15:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 14 September 2020 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled chashu ramen.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner put the charcoal chashu ramen in a personal top five and paired it with the grilled butter rice.
A March 2026 diner had long passed the shop over because of its quirky name, then found the sweet soy broth and charcoal aroma delicious.
A July 2026 first-timer thought the regular ramen too sweet at first, then found it addictive.

places.name: 豆生庵 (Tosei An)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tofu and yuba dishes, but with red miso soup, soy-based broths, fried tofu and optional tempura (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tofu-centred sets include sashimi, and the dashi is not described (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue, Wed and Fri–Sun lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Monday and Thursday, holidays included (official site; Tabelog). Bookings taken and advised — about 10 counter seats only (Tabelog; November 2024 review). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Rice refills free (July 2026 review). Coin parking to the north (July 2026 review). About 2 min from the Omiya-Nakadachiuri bus stop and 3 min from Ichijo-Modoribashi/Seimei-jinja-mae, about 10 min on foot from Seimei Shrine (Tabelog; January 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Nishijin, near Seimei Shrine — 2 min from Omiya-Nakadachiuri bus stop
places.cuisine: Tofu and yuba from soybeans chosen for natural sweetness (official site): Take gozen ¥1,600 — yudofu or hiyayakko, tofu salad with sesame and shibazuke, sashimi, kinuage, yuba stew, red miso soup, rice and pickles (September 2025, October 2026); Matsu and Ume gozen; yuba rice bowl +¥700 (July 2026); yudofu lunch with or without tempura; thick fried tofu finished in front of you; tofu ice cream with kuromitsu ¥100 at lunch (October 2026); dinner menu ¥3,600 with fresh yuba and fried tofu (July and October 2025); 勝手豆腐, 生湯葉, 豆腐よう (official site); the owner's homemade fruit liqueurs and umeshu (October 2025)
places.notes: [Tofu & yuba · Nishijin] A small counter of tofu and yuba near Seimei Shrine, family-run with a warm welcome: the ¥1,600 Take gozen of yudofu or cold tofu with tofu salad, kinuage and yuba stew, fresh yuba at dinner, and the owner's homemade fruit liqueurs. Book ahead; no cards (QR yes). Closed Monday and Thursday.

roles: Owner, a head chef and a young chef (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: A family-run tofu restaurant (May 2024 review); a July 2026 diner was welcomed by the head chef and a young chef. The official site says each guest is served individually, hence counter seats only, and offered a yuba-scooping experience for groups of two or more by booking (ended 1 November).
chef_bio.philosophy: Tofu and yuba made for the natural sweetness of living soybeans (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Yudofu; fresh yuba.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 regular chose summer-orange liqueur and two kinds of umeshu — white-liquor and brandy — from the owner's homemade fruit liqueurs.
After visiting Seimei Shrine in January 2026, a diner walked about 10 minutes for the nearest tofu lunch and watched the thick fried tofu finished at the counter.
A July 2026 diner was lucky to find the yuba rice bowl newly available as a ¥700 upgrade.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 豆生庵 (とうせいあん)、西陣の豆腐料理・湯葉料理専門店、生きた大豆の自然な甘み、一人ひとりに出すためカウンターのみ、昼 11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)、夜 17:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:00)、月・木曜休み (祝日も)、勝手豆腐、生湯葉、豆腐よう、湯葉すくい体験 (2名から要予約、11月1日で終了)。食べログ: 上京区大宮通一条下ル下石橋南半町50、市バス Omiya-Nakadachiuri から徒歩2分、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、カウンター10席、禁煙。口コミ (2024年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 家族経営、Take 御膳1,600円 (湯豆腐か冷奴、豆腐サラダ、刺身、絹揚げ、湯葉の煮物、赤だし、ご飯、漬物)、Matsu・Ume 御膳、湯葉丼 +700円、目の前で仕上げる厚揚げ、昼だけの豆腐アイス100円、夜は3,600円の献立と生湯葉、店主の自家製果実酒と梅酒、ご飯のおかわり無料。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; staff help choose a set.

places.name: Beer&Pasta スケルツォ (Beer & Pasta Scherzo)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fresh wheat pasta is the house specialty (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and an egg-free pasta is offered, but most sauces have cream, cheese, meat or seafood (Tabelog; January 2026 review).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00; Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00 (course dinners after 17:00 by booking — see the official calendar); open year-round (Tabelog). Bookings taken; since April 2026 dinner bookings by phone only (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「チャージ料なし」 (no charge). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 23 seats (counter 3, tables 20), a private room for 4, hire for 15–26; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Busy with Doshisha University students at lunch, especially right after second period (12:15) (May 2025, January 2026 reviews). On Karasuma-dori, 3 min north of Imadegawa Stn exit 1 (Tabelog; April 2025 review).
places.neighborhood: Imadegawa, north of Doshisha University — 3 min from Imadegawa Stn
places.cuisine: Craft beer and chewy fresh pasta: about 19–20 sauces with six fresh pastas, including short shapes and an egg-free one (Tabelog; January 2026): lunch sets from ¥1,000 with salad, B set with drink ¥1,200 (2025–26 reviews), extra pasta +¥600 (April 2025); octopus and anchovy oil pasta ¥1,400, shrimp tomato cream ¥1,300, Italian salad with prosciutto ¥900 (July 2026); carbonara, Bolognese, arrabbiata, yuzu cream with bacon, wasabi cream, firefly squid and broccoli, green bean and shrimp Genovese; stuffed pasta, chitarra; Sicilian white beans with tuna, Neapolitan chicken and chickpea stew, fried chicken; draft and craft beer, wine (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Fresh pasta & craft beer · Imadegawa] An independent pasta shop north of Doshisha, packed with students at lunch: pick from about 20 sauces and six chewy fresh pastas, with lunch sets from ¥1,000 and evening plates around ¥1,300–1,400 alongside good draft beer. No cover charge.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 October 2017 (Tabelog). The shop describes itself on Tabelog as an independent store, not a franchise, able to arrange plans on request.
chef_bio.philosophy: Craft beer and chewy fresh pasta (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh pasta; carbonara.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular tried the Sicilian white beans with tuna and a Neapolitan chicken and chickpea stew, and called the stuffed-pasta carbonara a rare find.
A January 2026 diner chose the egg-free pasta with tomato sauce, then decided the draft beer was even better than the pasta.
An August 2026 traveller at a late Obon lunch tasted shrimp tomato cream, Bolognese and carbonara and vowed to return.

An April 2026 visitor walked into the café next door by mistake before finding the passage.
An October 2026 regular finally got the long-awaited Chiba coriander with a Pakistani chicken and beef-tendon pair.

places.name: 自然酒菜 一瞬 (Shizen Shusai Ichishun)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto vegetables and fish — obanzai, tempura, saikyo-grilled fish, lava-stone grills, rice bowls — with no gluten information published; Tabelog lists vegetarian options (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and many vegetable dishes from contract farms, but dashi and fish are used throughout (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 daily; dinner 17:00–23:00 (Friday and Saturday to 23:30) (Tabelog). Bookings accepted. Otoshi ¥300 (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 74 seats on three floors (lift): an 8-seat counter, tables and party floors for 20–50; non-smoking, with smoking on each floor’s balcony; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). English-speaking staff (December 2025). On Shichijo-dori west of Karasuma, 472 m from Kyoto Station, after a move (Tabelog; April 2025).
places.neighborhood: Shichijo, west of Karasuma — 472 m from Kyoto Station
places.cuisine: Seasonal Kyoto vegetables from contract farms in Yawata (reduced-pesticide or organic) and fish from Kameoka and Yawata, with a lava-stone grill for meat and vegetables (Tabelog) · lunch: daily set ¥1,000 such as simmered mackerel with daikon, buri daikon with cream croquette, beef-tendon doteyaki; tempura bowl with large prawns; "sanbaba" bowl of kara-age, tempura and seafood ¥1,500; obanzai plate of nine vegetable dishes (2025–2026) · dinner: Kujo-leek salad, grilled meat miso with Kujo leek, rock oysters, saikyo-grilled sablefish (2025–2026) · about eight sakes with a tasting set, shochu, Kyoto craft beer (Tabelog; December 2025)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shichijo near Kyoto Station, Kyoto vegetables and fish] A roomy three-floor izakaya on Shichijo built around Yawata farm vegetables and fish from Kameoka: obanzai, Kujo-leek dishes, saikyo-grilled sablefish and a lava-stone grill, with a sake tasting set. Lunch is a bargain ¥1,000 daily set or a big tempura bowl. English-speaking staff. Open daily; ¥300 otoshi at night.

roles: Chef not named; operated by 万州国際株式会社 (invoice register)
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 March 2023 at this address (Tabelog); an April 2025 reviewer’s first visit since a move. The qualified-invoice holder 万州国際株式会社 is registered at the shop’s address (NTA). Tabelog’s introduction: seasonal Kyoto vegetables from contracted farmers in Yawata using reduced-pesticide or organic methods, fish from Kameoka and Yawata, a lava-plate grill, craft beer and Kyoto sake.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto vegetables; lava-stone grill.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 pair ordered the grilled meat miso with Kujo leek twice at a ¥14,000 lunch for two.
An October 2026 visitor passed up tantanmen next door for a nine-dish obanzai lunch and loved the taro tempura.
A December 2025 guest recommended the sake tasting set and wished for more Japanese gin.

places.name: TSUMU CAFE
places.gf_detail: Ask. Toasts, granola, cakes, cookies, financiers and gelato; no gluten information is published (reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter and egg toasts, cheesecake, dairy gelato and lattes (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 8:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); Saturday, Sunday and holidays 8:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); closed New Year’s Day (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC, iD and QUICPay; no QR codes (Tabelog). 28 seats with sofas, high counters, a terrace (dogs allowed there, non-smoking), power outlets and free Wi-Fi; wheelchair accessible; English menu (Tabelog; September 2026). Several 2026 reviewers note many foreign visitors from opening (July–October 2026). 5 min walk from the Karasuma exit of Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, Karasuma exit side — 5 min walk
places.cuisine: All-day café from 8 a.m. (Tabelog) · signature Green Tea Latte Presso, layered espresso, milk and matcha; a monthly menu (Tabelog) · toasts: honey butter ¥600, avocado and basil, banana, cheese with a hidden soft-boiled egg; caprese salad; granola and yogurt (2026 reviews) · Basque cheesecake ¥700; double gelato ¥950 (pistachio, salted caramel); cookies and financiers to take away (2026) · café latte ¥650, Kochi yuzu tea ¥600, bergamot peach tea, yuzu soda (2026)
places.notes: [Café · Kyoto Station, Karasuma side, breakfast to gelato] A big, airy café five minutes from Kyoto Station (formerly tsumugi cafe), open from 8:00 with sofas, a dog-friendly terrace and outlets at every seat. Come for toast breakfasts, the three-layer matcha-espresso latte, Basque cheesecake or a double gelato (about ¥600–1,000). Busy from morning; no bookings.

roles: Operated by 株式会社レ・コネクション (representative 奥田久雄; press release)
chef_bio.background: Opened 29 August 2020 (Tabelog), formerly named tsumugi cafe (September 2026 review). Per a February 2025 press release: run by 株式会社レ・コネクション of Shimogyo, Kyoto, which deals in real estate and runs lodging and food businesses; the café hosted an art student’s exhibition beside the register and has done collaborations such as a Ninna-ji drink. An October 2026 reviewer notes a hotel above.
chef_bio.specialty: Green Tea Latte Presso.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 breakfast guest found two groups ahead at 9:00 and the avocado-basil toast tasty but small for the price.
An August 2026 visitor avoids the dangling-leg high counter chairs and was glad to get a sofa.
An October 2026 diner found a soft-boiled egg hidden under the melted cheese on the toast.

places.name: 鯖街道 花折 下鴨店 (Saba Kaido Hanaore Shimogamo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Pressed mackerel sushi — regular, seared, kombu-wrapped — with vinegared rice, tsukudani and clear soup; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: mackerel, sea bream, eel and conger sushi (official site).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00 Monday–Friday, 10:00–18:00 Saturday and Sunday (Tabelog); the official site says the shop and workshop close every Wednesday and on the 1st and 3rd Tuesday. Eat-in until 15:30 (June 2026). Takeaway and online orders (official site). Bookings accepted. Cards, transport IC, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: three tables for four and a short counter, with a tatami area; non-smoking (Tabelog). A May 2026 reviewer found no working restroom; a June 2026 reviewer describes one off a courtyard. Near the Shimogamo Shrine entrance, 10 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Shimogamo, by the shrine entrance — 10 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn
places.cuisine: Saba-zushi from one-salted mackerel by a traditional method, at the Kyoto end of the old Mackerel Road (official site; reviews) · to eat in: Tomoe-zen with two pieces each of regular, seared and kombu-wrapped saba-zushi ¥2,700 (April 2026); Hanaore-zen of regular and seared; seared saba-zushi set; each with vinegared vegetables, tsukudani, karasumi and clear soup (2025–2026 reviews) · to take away (official site): saba-zushi ¥5,670, premium ¥7,560, select ¥10,530; 龍飛巻 ¥5,940; 巴巻 ¥5,400; seared saba ¥3,780; Kyo saba-zushi ¥3,650; guji (amadai) ¥8,000; eel ¥7,500; seared conger ¥2,980
places.notes: [Saba-zushi · Shimogamo Shrine, the end of the Mackerel Road] The shop and dining room of a saba-zushi maker by the gate of Shimogamo Shrine, where the old Mackerel Road from the Japan Sea ends: thick slabs of lightly salted mackerel on mellow vinegared rice. Eat in until 15:30 — the Tomoe-zen of three styles is about ¥2,700 — or take a whole roll home (from about ¥3,650). Closed Wednesday and the 1st and 3rd Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Saba Kaido Hanaore keeps to one-salted mackerel and a handed-down method; the Shimogamo shop and its workshop close on Wednesdays and the 1st and 3rd Tuesday; online sales of saba, guji, eel and conger sushi. Reviewers (2025–2026) note the shop sits near the Shimogamo end of the Saba Kaido.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: care over one-salted mackerel and keeping to the traditional method.
chef_bio.specialty: Saba-zushi.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 repeat visitor called it a favourite place in Kyoto for the thick mackerel and melting rice of the Tomoe-zen.
A September 2025 diner from Kyushu learned that Mackerel Road fish once ended its journey in Shimogamo.
An April 2026 book-club guest found the older ladies serving efficient and pleasant.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hanaore.co.jp): 一汐のサバにこだわり伝承の製法を守りつづける鯖街道 花折、下鴨店・工房とも毎週水曜日のほか第一・第三火曜日が定休、吟撰鯖寿し10,530円、上鯖寿し7,560円、鯖寿し5,670円、龍飛巻鯖寿し5,940円、巴巻5,400円、鯖あぶり寿し3,780円、京鯖寿し3,650円、ぐじ (甘鯛) 寿し8,000円、うなぎ寿し7,500円、炙り穴子寿し2,980円、お歳暮のセット、ネット注文。食べログ: 日本料理・寿司、左京区下鴨宮崎町121、出町柳駅から徒歩10分、新葵橋のバス停、月〜金 10:00〜17:00、土日 10:00〜18:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、16席 (4人掛け3卓、カウンター)、座敷、禁煙、テイクアウト。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 巴膳2,700円 (鯖寿し・炙り・昆布巻き各2切れ)、花折膳、炙り鯖寿しのセット、酢の物、佃煮、からすみ、すまし汁、イートインは15時半まで、下鴨神社のそば、鯖街道の終点。

cultural_comfort.note: Small dining room; takeaway counter.

places.name: ミリネヤンコプチャン (Millennium Gopchang)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tare-marinated offal and galbi, cold noodles, fried rice (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef and pork offal, pork galbi, octopus (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00; Sat and Sun 11:30–23:00. Reservations taken — mostly full with bookings even on weekdays (June 2026). Staff grill everything at the table (2026 reviews). Counter seating; smoky from the grills (August 2026); non-smoking (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). About 8–10 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi exit 9.
places.neighborhood: South of Shijo, Teramachi–Kawaramachi — 8–10 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: A Busan-style gopchang (offal) grill that looks and feels like a Korean street stall, part of a restaurant group (2026 reviews) · beef and pork horumon grilled on the teppan with tare; bone-in pork shoulder galbi; beef tongue (2026) · baby octopus (nakji) when available; perilla and lettuce wraps; several dipping sauces (2026) · cold noodles and fried rice to finish; Chamisul soju (2026)
places.notes: [Korean offal grill · south of Shijo, a Busan gopchang stall] A loud, smoky Korean horumon grill near Teramachi that feels like a Busan street stall: staff grill beef and pork offal, bone-in pork galbi and baby octopus at your table, with perilla wraps, cold noodles and soju. Usually full of bookings. One diner found the kimchi sour and the cold-noodle broth too salty (May 2026). Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a Korean-styled room and staff, a lively full house, smoke from the grills, and staff who do all the grilling; a May 2026 reviewer calls it a restaurant "from the group", and a September 2026 visitor says it faithfully recreates a Busan gopchang spot. The group and its other shops were not identified.
chef_bio.specialty: Beef and pork horumon; bone-in pork galbi.

anecdotes.text: May 2026: "the kimchi was not good. It was sour and salty… The cold noodles… It was salty. More like saltwater than broth."
September 2026: "This restaurant perfectly recreates a gopchang (grilled intestines) spot from Busan."
May 2026: "The staff grills everything for you, which adds to the overall atmosphere."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ミリネヤンコプチャン、韓国料理・焼肉・ホルモン、下京区中之町558、京都河原町駅から徒歩10分、月〜金 16:00〜23:00・土日 11:30〜23:00、予約可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2026年5〜9月、英語・日本語): 韓国の屋台のような焼肉店、いつも満席で活気、店員がすべて焼く、牛と豚のホルモン (タレ)、骨付き豚肩ロース、牛タン、テナガダコ、エゴマの葉、つけだれいろいろ、冷麺と炒飯、チャミスル、グループの店、釜山のコプチャン屋の再現、キムチが酸っぱくしょっぱく冷麺のスープが塩辛いという声、骨付き肉を生焼けで先に切られて残念という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff grill at the table; cash only; book.

places.name: 花おおぎ (Hana Oogi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: mochi dishes with tempura bits, soy-based sauces and zoni soups (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, cod-roe mochi, dashi zoni (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Wed–Sat and nights around holidays 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sun and holidays 17:30–22:00; closed Tuesday (open on Mondays in long holidays). Reservations taken; 30 minutes late without word counts as a cancellation; course bookings cannot be switched to à la carte on arrival. Seat charge ¥700 and 10% service — Tabelog, Japanese original 「席料700円 サービス料10%」. 24 seats: 4 at the counter, 20 at tables; an upstairs tatami room (courses only, room fee) for 10–20. Non-smoking. Menus in English and Chinese; children and strollers welcome; BYO for a fee. Cards, transit IC, QR. In a townhouse by the Takase river on Kiyamachi above Bukkoji.
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi above Bukkoji, by the Takase river — 10 min walk from Shijo-Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: Freshly made mochi dishes and Kyoto small plates in a townhouse by the Takase river (2024–2026 reviews) · mochi in many flavours: cod-roe mochi; natto mochi with tempura bits; zoni to finish in clear soup or white miso (2024–2026) · sashimi platters (squid, salmon), grilled dishes, ochazuke with rice crackers (2024–2026) · a wide drinks list
places.notes: [Mochi and Kyoto cooking · Kiyamachi by the Takase, a mochi family's successor] A townhouse on the Takase river run by a grandson of the old mochi restaurant Kitamura, keeping its freshly pounded mochi — cod-roe, natto, and zoni in clear or white-miso soup — alongside sashimi and seasonal plates. A reviewer met a Shimabara tayuu at the table (October 2026). ¥700 seat charge and 10% service. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Not named in a source; run by a grandson of the former Kitamura (August 2024 review)
chef_bio.background: Per an August 2024 reviewer, it is run by the son of the eldest daughter of the former mochi restaurant "Kitamura", carrying on its flavours; an April 2026 diner's family had been regulars there. An October 2026 reviewer, invited by a regular, describes a townhouse by the Takase river where a long-serving Shimabara tayuu, Hanaogi, joined the table to talk about the old customs, and staff who asked about dislikes in advance.
chef_bio.specialty: Freshly made mochi; zoni.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "When I mentioned that I wasn't fond of cucumbers, they made sure to set aside the cucumbers from the appetizer."
December 2024: "Choosing between clear soup and white miso for the zoni soup at the end was quite difficult, so I ended up trying both."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 花おおぎ、日本料理、下京区木屋町通仏光寺上る天王町157-8、祇園四条・河原町から徒歩10分、月水木金土・祝前日・祝後日 18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)・日祝 17:30〜22:00、火曜休み (連休中の月曜は営業)、予約可、30分連絡なしはキャンセル、コース予約は来店後の変更不可、原文で「席料700円 サービス料10%」、24席 (カウンター4、テーブル20)、2階の座敷 (コースのみ、部屋代別)、禁煙、英語・中国語メニュー、子供・ベビーカー可、持ち込み料あり、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 元の餅料理の店 Kitamura の長女の息子が営む、つきたての餅、たらこ餅、納豆餅と天かす、締めのお雑煮 (すまし・白味噌)、刺身の盛り合わせ (いか、サーモン)、焼き物、あられの茶漬け、飲み物が豊富、高瀬川沿いの町家、島原の Hanaogi 太夫が席で話をしてくれたという声、苦手なものを事前に聞く。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese menus; ¥700 seat charge and 10% service.

places.name: 藁焼きと水炊き 葵 (Warayaki to Mizutaki Aoi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: ponzu and soy-based warayaki, yuba rolls, course dishes (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken mizutaki, straw-seared fish and beef, duck (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Sun–Thu 17:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Fri and Sat 17:00–24:00; open all year. Reservations taken; select a kawadoko (summer river-terrace) seat when booking — 1 May to 30 September, ¥1,000 extra a seat, moved indoors if it rains. Appetiser charge ¥500 (plus a ¥500 seat charge 28 December–3 January) — Tabelog, Japanese original 「お通し代 500円 ※(年末年始12/28~1/3は席料+500円)」. 64 seats; private rooms for 2–8; a floor for up to 20. Non-smoking. Cards and e-money; no QR. On Pontocho with a view of the Kamo River. Opened 5 October 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, Kamo-River side — 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo / Hankyu Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: Straw-seared warayaki and chicken mizutaki with Kyoto vegetables, overlooking the Kamo River (2026 reviews) · warayaki three-kind platter; seared beef sashimi; a grilled-beef appetiser seared at the table; negitoro yuba rolls (2026) · chicken mizutaki hot pot; obanzai; duck dishes; chilled tofu (2026) · "Aoi" course ¥7,500 (April 2026) and courses with all-you-can-drink; summer kawadoko seats over the river
places.notes: [Warayaki and mizutaki · Pontocho, river views and a summer kawadoko] A Pontocho izakaya with Kamo River views and a summer river terrace: straw-seared fish and beef, chicken mizutaki and Kyoto obanzai, in reasonably priced courses for the area. Reviewers split on the mizutaki (rich, May and June 2026; no umami, April 2026); portions run small and the terrace can be buggy or rained off. ¥500 appetiser charge; ¥1,000 extra for a kawadoko seat.

chef_bio.background: Opened 5 October 2020 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm, Kyoto-feeling restaurant with window seats and a private room on the Kamo River, a summer kawadoko, smooth moves indoors when it rains, and modest portions at prices reasonable for Pontocho.
chef_bio.specialty: Warayaki; chicken mizutaki.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "Everything was delicious except for the Mizutaki… I couldn't taste the umami at all."
August 2026: "I originally booked a seat by the river, but it was infested with bugs, so I switched to an indoor table… the service was a bit disappointing."
September 2026: "I recommend choosing a la carte drinks over the all-you-can-drink option, as there are many varieties available."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 藁焼きと水炊き 葵、居酒屋・日本料理・郷土料理、中京区河原町通四条上る松本町166、祇園四条駅・阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、日〜木 17:00〜23:00・金土 17:00〜24:00、年中無休、予約可、納涼床は予約時に選択 (5月1日〜9月30日、席料1,000円、雨天は店内)、原文で「お通し代 500円 ※(年末年始12/28~1/3は席料+500円)」、64席、個室 (2〜8名)、20名までのフロア貸切、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、2020年10月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年2〜10月、英語): 藁焼きの3種盛り、牛の炙り刺し、卓で炙る牛のお通し、ねぎとろの湯葉巻き、鶏の水炊き、おばんざい、鴨、冷奴、葵コース7,500円、飲み放題付きのコース、鴨川の見える席と個室、納涼床、水炊きにうまみがないという声、床は虫が多く接客が残念という声、量は少なめ、先斗町にしては手頃。

cultural_comfort.note: River views; kawadoko seats ¥1,000 extra in summer; ¥500 appetiser charge.

places.name: ふじ寅 (Gion Fujitora)
places.gf_detail: Ask: seiro-steamed vegetables, Kyoto pork and rice are wheat-free in themselves, but seven condiments, steamed buns and sweets come with them (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: steamed sets include Kyoto pork, salmon or other meat (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–16:30 and 17:00–22:00; Tue and Thu 11:00–17:30; closed Wednesday (open if a holiday). Lunch from 11:00, tea from 14:00, dinner from 17:00. Book through TableCheck (Instagram or Google Maps links) or by phone — often full (July 2026). 25 seats on tatami, with private rooms and a courtyard. Non-smoking. Children welcome — kids' menu, children's utensils, stroller storage. Cards (incl. UnionPay), transit IC and e-money; no QR. In a renovated 100-year-old townhouse on Kawabata-dori, 1–2 min from Gion-Shijo Stn. Opened 7 July 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawabata-dori, Gion-Shijo — 1–2 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Seiro-steamed Kyoto vegetables and pork in a 100-year-old townhouse, plus matcha sweets (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · lunch: "seasonal vegetable seiro" of meat, vegetables and rice with seven condiments, ¥2,750 (September 2026) · dinner: seiro courses of seasonal vegetables and Kyoto pork, salt-koji salmon; local sake and craft beer (Tabelog; July–August 2026) · tea time: "Tora parfait", Tora monaka with salted bean paste, yuzu and matcha mousse, steamed buns (2026)
places.notes: [Seiro steaming · Gion-Shijo, a townhouse by the Kamo] A renovated century-old townhouse on Kawabata-dori, a minute from Gion-Shijo Station: bamboo-steamed seasonal vegetables and Kyoto pork with seven condiments at lunch and dinner, then tiger-themed parfaits and monaka at tea time, in tatami rooms around a courtyard. Book — often full. One diner felt rushed as steamers were cleared mid-meal (July 2026). Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 July 2022 (Tabelog); per its Tabelog text, a renovated 100-year-old townhouse serving seiro-mushi courses of high-quality seasonal vegetables and Kyoto pork, with tatami seats, private rooms and a courtyard. Reviewers in 2026 say it began as a lunch spot and later added dinner, with hand-drawn menus and family-friendly service.
chef_bio.specialty: Seiro-steamed vegetables; Tora parfait.

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "they cleared the steamer while I was still eating. While the cost performance isn't great, I think this place is more about enjoying the atmosphere."
July 2026: "When I mentioned that I liked the drawing on the back that wishes for happiness, they told me that each one is handwritten."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ふじ寅 (Gion Fujitora)、カフェ・甘味処・日本料理、東山区宮川筋1-231-1、京阪祇園四条駅から川端通を徒歩1〜2分、月金土日祝 11:00〜16:30・17:00〜22:00・火木 11:00〜17:30、水曜休み (祝日は営業)、ランチ11時〜・甘味14時〜・ディナー17時〜、TableCheck か電話で予約、25席、座敷、個室、禁煙、子供可 (子供メニュー・食器・ベビーカー置き場)、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、2022年7月7日オープン、築100年の京町家で季節の野菜と京都ポークのせいろ蒸しのコース、地酒とクラフトビール、抹茶の甘味と蒸しまんじゅう。口コミ (2026年6〜11月、英語): 季節野菜のせいろ蒸しランチ2,750円 (肉・野菜・ご飯、薬味7種)、夜の塩麹の鮭、手描きのメニュー、とらパフェ、とら最中、柚子と抹茶のムース、中庭、満席が多い、蒸籠を食べている途中で下げられたという声、割安ではないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book via TableCheck; tatami rooms; family-friendly.

On Teramachi-dori south of Imadegawa, on the east side of the street to the Imperial Palace (Tabelog; November 2023).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi Imadegawa, by the Imperial Palace — Demachiyanagi
places.cuisine: Homemade sausages, British-style breakfast and café lunches (2023–26 reviews) · homemade sausage with mashed potatoes, salad and bread ¥1,400 (April 2023); basil sausage with a baguette sandwich of spicy chicken, eggplant and lemon (December 2024) · homemade sausage hot dog with chili con carne or salsa, with chips (March and October 2026) · full English breakfast, large portions (February 2024) · hot dog and ginger ale (August 2020)
places.notes: [Café · Teramachi Imadegawa, homemade sausages and English breakfast] A small café by the Imperial Palace with a punk-and-art London feel, known for juicy homemade sausages with a mound of mashed potato, chili or salsa hot dogs with chips, and a big English breakfast from 8:30. Cash only; closed Wednesday — check Instagram for opening days.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café and European restaurant near the Imperial Palace. An August 2024 review describes a 1970s–80s London punk and art atmosphere and a pub brunch.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade sausages; English breakfast.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 visitor came for the English breakfast and warned that the portion is big.
A March 2026 walker by the Imperial Palace had the chili con carne hot dog and recommends checking Instagram before going.
A May 2025 diner expected a fatty sausage and found it was not, and called the mashed potatoes irresistible.

On Imadegawa-dori, 4 min west of Imadegawa Stn, opposite the Kamigyo ward office (Tabelog; May 2023).
places.neighborhood: Imadegawa-dori, west of Karasuma — 4 min from Imadegawa Stn
places.cuisine: A long menu of pasta, pizza and small plates, plus coffee and sweets (2023–26 reviews) · tomato cream pasta with blue crab; monthly pastas such as arrabbiata, meat sauce, and Kujo green onion and oyster peperoncino (December 2024) · chilled Genovese pasta in summer; seafood salad (September 2025) · octopus carpaccio, risotto, pizza (November 2024) · coffee and sweets (May 2026)
places.notes: [Italian café · Imadegawa-dori, a couple-run neighbourhood favourite] A cosy 16-seat café-trattoria on Imadegawa-dori run by a couple, with sofa seats behind a glass front: a long list of pasta — monthly specials with Kyoto ingredients, a summer chilled Genovese — pizza, carpaccio and risotto, and coffee and sweets in between. Cash only; check the door calendar for open days.

chef_bio.background: A May 2023 review describes an Italian café run by a couple, then nearly twelve years in business. Reviews from 2024 and 2026 also describe it as couple-run.
chef_bio.specialty: Pasta; monthly specials.

anecdotes.text: A May 2023 diner came for dinner with family of four and came back alone four days later.
A September 2025 regular on about a fifth visit ordered the chilled Genovese pasta three times that summer.
A May 2026 first-timer wanted to try everything on the menu and warmed to both owners.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork miso soup, chashu ramen, crab omelette, fried chicken (2022–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–20:30; closed Sunday and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Noodles can sell out by 13:00 (November 2023). On Karasuma-dori north of Kamidachiuri, next to Doshisha University and near Shokokuji, about 4 min from Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog; 2017–23 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Karasuma Imadegawa, next to Doshisha University
places.cuisine: Chinese-style set meals at student prices (2022–26 reviews) · fried-rice set of shoyu ramen and a small fried rice ¥900–950 (January 2022 – February 2023) · pork miso soup set, large with egg ¥880 (January 2026) · fried chicken set ¥820 (November 2023) · mapo tofu set, curry fried rice (September 2024) · crab omelette set (June 2025) · cold noodles with chashu, egg and cucumber in summer (July 2026)
places.notes: [Chinese set meals · Karasuma Imadegawa, the Doshisha canteen] A long-running, remodelled Chinese-style diner beside Doshisha University, full at lunch with students, staff and office workers: ramen with fried rice, a big bowl of pork miso soup with rice, fried chicken, mapo tofu and summer cold noodles, mostly under ¥1,000. Staff say no chemical seasonings are used. Cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A January 2022 review recalls eating here some 30 years earlier and notes the shop has since been remodelled. A June 2025 visitor heard the staff tell a customer that the kitchen uses natural flavours and no chemical seasonings.
chef_bio.philosophy: Natural flavours, no chemical seasonings (staff, as heard in June 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Fried-rice and ramen sets; pork miso soup set.

anecdotes.text: A January 2022 visitor returning after 30 years ordered the old fried-rice set — about ¥650 then, ¥900 now.
A January 2026 office worker was surprised the large pork miso soup came in a rice bowl.
A July 2026 regular came back for the cold noodles in the heat and was served within ten minutes despite a full room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂・ラーメン、上京区烏丸通上立売上ル柳図子町334、今出川駅から約260m、月〜土11:30〜14:00と17:00〜20:30、日祝休み、現金のみ、禁煙。口コミ (2017年12月〜2026年7月、英語): 同志社大学の隣、中華の定食、炒飯セット (醤油ラーメンと小さな炒飯) 900〜950円、豚汁定食の大盛りと卵880円、唐揚げ定食820円、麻婆豆腐の定食、カレー炒飯、かに玉の定食、夏の冷麺、昼は学生や教職員で満席、改装済み、化学調味料を使わないと店の人が話していた。

cultural_comfort.note: Share a table at lunch; noodles can sell out by 13:00; cash only. No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: dim sum wrappers, buns, dandan noodles and battered sweet-and-sour pork (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shrimp and pork dim sum, char siu buns, chicken congee (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; courses by reservation (Tabelog; April 2024). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR incl. PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). 13 seats: a counter of 5 and tables for 8 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Restroom in the building, not in the shop (October 2024). Nijo Plaza 1F, 5 min from JR Enmachi, 7 min from Nishioji-Oike (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Enmachi, between Enmachi and Nishioji-Oike
places.cuisine: Cantonese dim sum and Chinese set meals from one chef (2024–26 reviews) · lunch sets with three dim sum, soup and rice: beef with oyster sauce ¥950, sweet-and-sour pork ¥1,000 (November 2025) · dim sum set ¥1,200: four steamed dim sum, a daily dish, century-egg and chicken congee and two desserts (May 2026) · dandan noodle set, fried rice instead of rice +¥250 (March and June 2026) · shrimp and chive dumplings, ham sui gok, radish cake, spring rolls (May 2024); shrimp shumai (August 2026) · Cantonese buns made with a fermented "Lao Mian" dough: char siu bao, meat bun (dinner menu, May 2026) · courses and a Shaoxing wine tasting set (April 2024)
places.notes: [Cantonese dim sum · Enmachi, a one-chef local] A 13-seat Chinese restaurant in a small building near Enmachi where the owner-chef cooks alone at the wok: lunch sets of a main dish with three dim sum from about ¥1,000, a ¥1,200 dim sum set with congee, and at night Cantonese buns, shumai and courses with Shaoxing wine. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviews from May 2024 to April 2026 describe the owner-chef running the restaurant alone, sometimes joined by one more staff member, cooking dim sum and wok dishes in view of the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Cantonese dim sum and buns.

anecdotes.text: A May 2024 diner listened to the clang of wok and ladle as the head chef worked alone, and found the appetisers worthy of a high-end Chinese restaurant.
An August 2026 regular makes it the usual second stop after drinks in Enmachi; the yakisoba was a little oily but the shrimp shumai outstanding.
A May 2026 lunch visitor found the dinner menu promising Cantonese buns on a fermented dough and vowed to come back at night.

cultural_comfort.note: Sit at the counter to watch the wok; lunch sets are the easy order; book courses ahead. No English evidence found.

places.name: 和食 まこたろう (Washoku Makotaro)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese courses seasoned with soy-sauce koji, salt koji and miso, plus tempura and spring rolls; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every course opens with a kombu-and-bonito dashi, and the dishes are fish and Wagyu (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations for courses only (Tabelog). Cards including UnionPay, IC cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 28 seats: 8 at a single-slab counter and 20 at tables; private rooms (Tabelog; January and June 2026). places.neighborhood: Alley west of the Takase River, north of Shijo — 2 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: Creative Japanese courses built on charcoal grilling, dashi and fermentation, with sake and wine pairings by a sommelier (Tabelog; 2026) · the course opens with a first dashi of Hokkaido kombu and Yaizu or Shizuoka bonito (2026) · monthly courses from about ¥8,000–8,800 (January and April 2026): hassun with sesame miso and salt-koji shrimp, yuba, sakura-shrimp and bamboo-shoot spring rolls, Wagyu, kinmedai with fava-bean sauce, charcoal young corn, ayu, hamo, mackerel namero (2026) · clay-pot rice of Sado Koshihikari, leftovers made into onigiri to take home (April–October 2026) · rare sake in small lots (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Japanese courses · alley off the Takase River, dashi and fermentation] A sign-less restaurant down a quiet alley near Hankyu Kawaramachi, opened in October 2025: a young chef’s monthly courses built on a golden first dashi and koji and miso seasonings, served at a handsome single-slab counter, with sake pairings and clay-pot rice to finish. Courses only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes healthy Japanese courses that cherish Kyoto tradition, rare sake in limited quantities and pairings by a sommelier. A June 2026 reviewer mentions a young chef at the counter; an August 2026 reviewer heard the restaurant has sister shops of other kinds.
chef_bio.philosophy: Origin, fermentation and freshness (January 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: First dashi; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 guest during the Gion Matsuri had the counter alone on a stormy night and took leftover rice home as onigiri.
An August 2026 diner found it while looking for a wife’s birthday dinner.

cultural_comfort.note: Courses only; no sign outside; book ahead.

places.name: 月彩 (Kassai)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese courses — sashimi, hamo shabu-shabu, grilled fish, soups and fried dishes, seasonal rice; no gluten information. A March 2025 guest’s food preferences were met with substitutes when stated at booking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led Japanese courses with soups, hamo and house-marinated ikura (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 17:00–24:00; Saturday and Sunday 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–24:00 (Tabelog). Appetizer fee ¥800 (Tabelog remarks). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 46 seats: a counter downstairs and private rooms upstairs for 8 or 20–30; a riverside kawadoko deck in season (Tabelog; 2024–2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; September 2026). About 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi, on Kiyamachi (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Shijo — riverside, 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: Creative Japanese food in a modern machiya, with summer kawadoko seating over the Kamo River (Tabelog; 2024–2026) · fish from the Seto Inland Sea and Kamijo satoimo from Fukui; the owner’s own soy-marinated ikura from Hokkaido salmon (Tabelog) · hamo full course in summer — hamo shabu-shabu and grilled hamo, the chef boning it at the counter (July–September 2026) · courses with sashimi, soups, grilled and fried dishes (November 2025) · saikyo-miso grilled masu salmon; monthly rice such as corn or sea bream (March–May 2025) · a strong sake list (2026)
places.notes: [Japanese · Kiyamachi on the Kamo, summer kawadoko] A Japanese restaurant in a modern machiya on Kiyamachi with a riverside deck in season: courses of Seto Inland Sea fish, the owner’s own marinated ikura, and in summer a full hamo course boned at the counter, with a good sake list. Counter downstairs, private rooms upstairs; ¥800 appetizer fee; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text says the owner personally takes the roe from Hokkaido salmon for the house-marinated ikura, and that the kitchen chooses Seto Inland Sea fish and Kamijo satoimo from Fukui. Reviewers watched the chef bone hamo at the counter (July and September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Bringing out the umami of seasonal ingredients (Tabelog; May 2024 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Hamo full course; house-marinated ikura.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 traveller chose the counter over the hot riverside deck and was made welcome among the locals.
A March 2025 guest mentioned food dislikes when booking and found substitutes ready.

places.name: ペッパー (Pepper)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Okinawan dishes — champuru, rafute, umibudo, mozuku, jimami tofu, Okinawa soba, taco rice — plus risotto and pasta; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Umibudo, mozuku in vinegar, island shallots and jimami tofu appear, but sauces and dashi are not described, and most champuru include pork or egg (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: 18:00–3:00 (L.O. 2:00); days off not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; for 4 or more, an 8-dish course with 120 minutes of free-flow drinks for ¥5,000, booked a day ahead (Tabelog). Otoshi and seat charge ¥350 (Tabelog, original お通し・お席料350円). Cards (Visa, Master, AMEX) (Tabelog). 24 seats: 12 at the counter, 12 at tables (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (December 2024). Third floor of the Matsuya Building, stairs only (March 2026). About 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog). Opened 13 April 2000 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishikiyamachi north of Shijo — 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: An Okinawan dining bar since 2000: Orion draft beer and a long awamori list (Tabelog; 2025–2026) · fresh umibudo from Miyako Island kept in a tank, ¥900 (August 2025) · goya champuru ¥850 (August 2025); somen champuru; rafute; pork ears with ponzu (2024) · mozuku vinegar and mozuku tempura; jimami tofu; shima-dofu with tororo; Okinawa soba; taco rice (2024–2026) · purple-sweet-potato and cream-cheese potato salad (2024–2026) · Ishigaki beef and island vegetables from contracted farms (Tabelog) · risottos and pastas from a chef with Italian experience (July 2025)
places.notes: [Okinawan · Nishikiyamachi 3F, open to 3:00] A long-running Okinawan dining bar up three flights of stairs off Kiyamachi: fresh Miyako umibudo from a tank, goya and somen champuru, rafute, mozuku and Okinawa soba with Orion draft and awamori — and, from a chef with Italian training, risotto and pasta. ¥350 seat charge; smoking allowed; open until 3:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes an Okinawan dining bar with Orion beer, umibudo shipped from Miyako Island and kept in a temperature-controlled tank, and Ishigaki beef. A December 2024 reviewer was served by the couple who run it; a July 2025 reviewer says the chef has worked as an Italian chef.
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh umibudo; champuru.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular asked for a pork-and-egg dish not on the menu, and the kitchen made it.
An August 2026 visitor found some ingredients short after a typhoon but filled up on jimami tofu, mozuku and Okinawa soba.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Stir-fried greens with Kyoto yuba and local Chinese vegetables are on the menu (Tabelog; April 2024), but sauces and stocks are not described.

Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (Visa, Master) (Tabelog). 32 seats, 16 on each floor; parties up to 20 upstairs (Tabelog; January 2026). On Pontocho, about 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi; moved here from an alley off Pontocho (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho north of Shijo — 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: Light, Kyoto-style Chinese small plates for two or more, with Kyoto yuba, seasonal and locally grown Chinese vegetables (Tabelog) · lunch A set: three small dishes and rice with a main — ankake yakisoba or ramen, tantan noodles, shrimp chili, mapo tofu, greens with Kyoto yuba — ¥1,100 (April 2024); cold-cut appetizers of pork, chicken and beef with garlic sauce (October 2025) · dim sum course of 10 dishes ¥2,980 (June 2025) · party course with free-flow drinks including Shaoxing wine ¥5,000 (January 2026) · blue crab with Kujo onion in black-bean sauce in season; shrimp mayonnaise; almond tofu (2023–2024)
places.notes: [Chinese · Pontocho, light Kyoto-style small plates] A two-floor Chinese restaurant on Pontocho with gentle, Kyoto-style cooking at fair prices: a ¥1,100 lunch set of three small dishes plus mapo tofu or shrimp chili, a ¥2,980 dim sum course, greens with Kyoto yuba, and party courses with Shaoxing wine upstairs. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes light flavours typical of Kyoto cooking, classic dishes made with Kyoto yuba and local vegetables, and some creative twists; the restaurant moved to its present site from an alley off Pontocho.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-style Chinese small plates.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 group of four expected Pontocho prices and were surprised by a ¥2,980 ten-dish dim sum course.
An October 2025 lunch guest could not stop eating the three cold cuts with garlic sauce before the main arrived.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried chicken and cutlet sets, tempura, udon and soba (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken, pork cutlet and oyakodon; dashi-based curry and noodles (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Wed–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–19:30; Sat and Sun 11:00–19:30; closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). A long temporary closure ended by September 2026 (September and October 2026 reviews). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cash only, paid after eating (Tabelog; October 2026 review). 20 seats — tables and a 4-seat counter; non-smoking; 4 parking spaces (Tabelog). 5 min from JR Nishioji Stn and from Umekoji Park / the Kyoto Railway Museum; use the address, not the phone number, in car navigation (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: West of Umekoji Park — 5 min from JR Nishioji Stn
places.cuisine: Showa-style shokudo set meals, rice bowls and noodles with a good dashi (2026 reviews): the most popular crispy-fried chicken set ¥1,150 with salad, miso soup and rice (May and October 2026), a "refreshing" fried set ¥1,150 (September 2026), tonkatsu set, bite-size "korokoro" cutlet set, jumbo chicken set; katsu curry rice bowl with a spicy dashi curry thickened with potato starch, tempura rice bowl, oyakodon; soba and udon including kizami kitsune and tempura udon; beer (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Showa shokudo · near Umekoji Park] A long-running neighbourhood diner west of Umekoji Park, back after a long break: a big crispy-fried chicken set with salad for ¥1,150, a spicy dashi katsu-curry bowl, oyakodon and soba or udon with good dashi. Cash only; closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A family-run shokudo. Reviewers describe an elderly couple — the woman cooking, the man at the register (July and October 2026); after the shop reopened in September 2026, a regular saw the owner at the register and, it seemed, the owner’s son cooking.
chef_bio.specialty: Crispy-fried chicken set.

anecdotes.text: A regular who feared the closure was permanent, given the owner's age, returned in September 2026 to find the shop busy and prices slightly up.
In July 2026, with the jumbo chicken and tempura udon sold out, the staff suggested a bite-size cutlet set and kizami kitsune udon instead.
An October 2026 diner, still hungry after a tonkatsu set, ordered and finished a crispy-fried chicken set too.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tarts, crumbles, brownies and cookies (Tabelog reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cheesecake, cream cakes and butter pastries (Tabelog reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:00–20:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Whole birthday cakes need booking at least two days ahead (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Two counter seats for eating in; coffee, tea and jasmine tea ¥200 each; takeaway; non-smoking (Tabelog). Right by Eiden Mototanaka Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Mototanaka Stn, Eiden — Tanaka

places.notes: [Cake shop · Mototanaka Stn] A tiny, cheap neighbourhood cake shop by Eiden Mototanaka Station with two seats: simple homemade slices around ¥300 — lemon tart, baked cheesecake, clafoutis — and whole cakes to order. Cash only; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A small neighbourhood cake shop; reviewers since 2018 describe its homemade feel. Recent detail is thin: two 2026 visits (January and March).
chef_bio.philosophy: Snacks for every day, with moderate butter and sugar and few additives (October 2024 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Lemon tart; baked cheesecake.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor found the eat-in space would be cramped with more customers, so took a lemon tart outside and called it easy to finish.
An October 2024 customer bought a whole lemon tart.

places.cuisine: Showa-era ramen and kara-age (2025–26 reviews): soy-sauce pork-bone ramen with thin straight noodles, thin chashu, bean sprouts, green onion and menma ¥800 (December 2025), a Hakata-style ramen and a special soy ramen, chashu ramen; ramen set with two kara-age, pickles and rice ¥1,000 (July and November 2025), lunch kara-age set +¥200 (December 2025); kara-age of thigh or drumstick ¥750 (January 2026), chicken wings, gyoza, shumai; beer and sake (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Showa ramen & kara-age · Nishioji-Hachijo] A long-running ramen shop under a yellow "kara-age" sign, run by an elderly couple: nostalgic soy pork-bone ramen from ¥800, a ¥1,000 set with kara-age and rice, and juicy thigh kara-age with beer. Cash only; smoking allowed; closed Thursday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A Showa-era ramen shop, "run by an elderly couple" (August 2025) and described as family-run and long popular (July 2025). Signed cards from celebrities, including Hiroshi Tamaki and Yokohama BayStars players, hang inside (November 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Kara-age; soy ramen.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 diner who had wondered for 20 years whether this shop is related to a Tenryu at Kitaoji found it full and the owner friendly.
A January 2026 diner rated the ¥750 thigh kara-age the perfect partner for beer.
Regulars drink beer or sake with the kara-age, an October 2026 diner noticed, and the chef's warm hospitality stood out.

places.name: あふひ (aoi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The soba is juwari — 100% buckwheat (October 2026 review) — but the dipping sauce and tempura usually contain wheat; not confirmed.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; yuba and wild-vegetable soba are offered, but the broth is not described (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–16:00 or until sold out; irregular closures (Tabelog). An October 2026 visitor found a handwritten sign moving opening to 12:30. No bookings; people queue before 12:00, and tables are mostly for two (Tabelog; May 2026 review). Order by QR code; self-service water (May and August 2026 reviews). Soba can take a long time — up to about 40 minutes, two 2026 reviewers note. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR payment (Tabelog). 30 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu; free Wi-Fi; dogs on the two terrace tables only (Tabelog; October 2026 review). 1 min from the Shimogamo-jinja-mae bus stop (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shimogamo Shrine — 1 min from Shimogamo-jinja-mae bus stop
places.cuisine: Homemade juwari soba of domestic buckwheat, thin but firm (2026 reviews): fluffy whipped tororo soba crowned with an egg yolk, cold yuba bukkake soba, wild-vegetable and grated daikon soba, yuba soba, zaru soba; sets of soba with mini tempura or tuna-bonito rice ¥1,600 (March 2026); tempura of about five items, oyakodon, maguro katsuo rice; soba-yu (2026 reviews); sake and shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Juwari soba · Shimogamo Shrine] A modern, café-like soba house a minute from Shimogamo Shrine, with a dog-friendly terrace: thin juwari soba under fluffy whipped tororo, cold yuba soba, and tempura or tuna-bonito rice sets around ¥1,600. Expect a queue at 12:00 and a slow kitchen. Cash only; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 27 August 2018 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Homemade 100% buckwheat soba from domestic ingredients (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Fluffy tororo soba.

anecdotes.text: After the Mitarashi pond ritual at Shimogamo Shrine in July 2026, a diner was asked by a Fuji TV crew filming there for permission to photograph the soba.
A March 2026 family on a drive to Shimogamo Shrine were the first customers, with wild-vegetable soba and yuba soba with mini tempura.
In August 2026 the tempura came so quickly, and the soba so slowly, that it was gone before the noodles arrived.

places.name: 大詔閣 四条店 (Daisho Kaku Shijo)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: house yangnyeom and miso sauces, marinated meats, bean-sprout soup (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku restaurant with raw beef dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Wednesday–Monday 17:00–1:00 (last order 0:40); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, online too, and usually needed — often full, nearly full at 19:00 on a Saturday (Tabelog; December 2025 and September 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 40 seats: 10 at the counter, tables for 4 and 6; non-smoking (Tabelog). Grill-it-yourself roasters with water underneath and flames at the sides (August 2026). Off a narrow alley in Nishi-Kiyamachi north of Shijo, next to a horse-meat restaurant; 3 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; July and October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi north of Shijo — 3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Long-established yakiniku, a branch of a shop at Senbon-Nakadachiuri that a reviewer has visited for 48 years (December 2025) · grill-it-yourself cuts: premium tongue, special premium loin, harami, kalbi, cheek, liver, with the house yangnyeom and a recommended miso sauce (2025–2026 reviews) · raw dishes: omasum sashimi, beef tongue sashimi ¥1,530, yukhoe ¥1,530, a sashimi platter (December 2025–September 2026) · a mountain of salad; bean-sprout soup to finish (December 2025) · about ¥3,000–8,000 (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishi-Kiyamachi, open till 1 a.m.] A lively, good-value yakiniku off a Kiyamachi alley, grilled yourself over water-tray roasters that keep flames low and grease down: tongue, harami and loin with the house yangnyeom, plus omasum and tongue sashimi and yukhoe. One 48-year regular follows it from the Senbon main shop. One Tokyo visitor found the taste average but the price very low. Book ahead; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per a December 2025 review: the reviewer first went to the main branch at Senbon-Nakadachiuri 48 years earlier and moved to the Shijo branch after the Sanjo branch closed; every branch is described as clean, with young, energetic staff. Tabelog lists the Shijo shop as a 40-seat yakiniku open late.
chef_bio.specialty: Omasum sashimi; house yangnyeom.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 reviewer has eaten at Daisho Kaku for 48 years, starting at the Senbon main shop, and finishes with bean-sprout soup spiked with yangnyeom.
A February 2026 Tokyo visitor found the taste average, but two large beers and four cuts for about ¥3,000 remarkably cheap.
An August 2026 group of six liked how the water-tray roaster keeps flames low and the meat from turning greasy.

places.name: かしわ 木屋町店 (Kashiwa Kiyamachi)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: red marinade sauce, garlic yakiniku-style sauce, soy and ponzu; chicken-skin crackers (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken and pork grill (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); 17:30 start on the day before a holiday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; courses must be ordered for the whole party; 2-hour limit at weekends and busy times; bookings released after 15 minutes without notice (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥200 per person (Tabelog original お通し代：お一人様200円(税込)). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 24 seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Seating that one reviewer found hard on the legs and back (September 2025). 1 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 5 (Tabelog). Opened 23 November 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Shijo, by Pontocho — 1 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Grill-it-yourself chicken and pork from named farms — the shop calls it Kyoto-style toriyaki (Gurunavi; 2025–2026 reviews) · chicken tataki of thigh and breast, e.g. Satsuma Chiran ¥1,980; chicken sashimi platters (2025–2026 reviews) · cuts to grill: neck, thigh of Daisen, Omi black, Amakusa Daisuke and Mukashi chicken, heart, gizzard, liver, sekin, harami ¥600, red-sauce meat and horumon platter ¥1,600, chicken sausage ¥400 (August 2025–May 2026) · kimchi salad ¥680, chicken-skin crackers, grilled vegetables, rice ¥300 (2025–2026 reviews) · Sapporo Akaboshi ¥680, Kaku highball ¥620 (August 2025) · about ¥3,000–5,000 (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Chicken grill · Kiyamachi by Pontocho] A small, smoky shop where you grill your own skewers of named-farm chicken and pork — neck, thigh, sekin, horumon in red sauce — after a plate of chicken tataki or sashimi. Garlic powder and house salt on the side. Some found the service slow or muddled, with a wrong order and a 15-minute wait despite empty tables. Smoking allowed; till midnight.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakitori and chicken shop opened 23 November 2011 at Kiyamachi; Gurunavi lists it as 鶏豚専門店 かしわ 木屋町店 offering Kyoto-original toriyaki. A November 2025 visitor arrived on its 15th-anniversary special. A May 2026 reviewer praised the owner's service and the many rare cuts, as if a whole bird were butchered in the shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken tataki; grill-it-yourself neck and sekin.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 walk-in ordered heart and harami, received gizzard instead (given free for the mix-up), and the thigh never arrived.
A January 2026 party waited about 15 minutes to be seated though tables were empty, and a couple ahead gave up and left.
A November 2025 visitor happened in on the 15th-anniversary special prices.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, seafood and egg teppan dishes; grilled shiitake and shishito are the vegetable plates seen (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog lists 18:00–11:00 — overnight into the next morning — on Monday–Wednesday and Friday–Sunday; closed Thursday and the third Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reviewers describe it as open until morning (March 2025 and October 2026); one went in at 7:30 a.m. (March 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). Counter and tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog; September 2026). Packed by 18:30 on a Saturday (March 2026). On the Takase River in Nishi-Kiyamachi (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi on the Takase River, north of Shijo
places.cuisine: Long-running teppan izakaya, open all night (2025–2026 reviews) · okonomiyaki such as buta-tama; tonpei-yaki with mustard; pork kimchi yakisoba ¥1,020; squid yakisoba ¥830 (2025–2026 reviews) · oyster steak, beef tongue steak, cheese egg, pon-kara, chicken breast sashimi, grilled shiitake and shishito (March 2025–March 2026) · highball ¥750, shochu soda ¥500, imo shochu, lemon sour (February–September 2026) · about ¥2,000–4,000 (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Teppan izakaya · Takase River, all night] A long-standing Kiyamachi teppan bar by the Takase River, where the night ends — or never does: okonomiyaki, tonpei-yaki, squid yakisoba and oyster steak sizzle on the griddle until the next morning, with the river murmuring outside. One February 2026 pair found the drinks a little pricey. Smoking allowed; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews (2025–2026): a teppan izakaya that has long stood in Nishi-Kiyamachi on the Takase River, open until morning and a favourite last stop after a night out. Tabelog lists overnight hours of 18:00–11:00.
chef_bio.specialty: Okonomiyaki; tonpei-yaki.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner who heard it stayed open until 11 a.m. went in at 7:30 a.m. for chicken-breast sashimi and a large-oyster steak.
A March 2026 pair stayed almost four hours on a Saturday for under ¥5,000 each, the room full within 30 minutes of an 18:00 arrival.
A February 2026 second-stop pair spent ¥7,200 on snacks and drinks and thought the ¥750 highball a little pricey.

places.notes: [Ochazuke bar · Takase River, till 5 a.m.] A tiny bar over a bridge on the Takase River where the night ends with a soothing bowl of ochazuke — ume, nozawana, salmon and uni — or curry udon, served by a friendly owner in samue. A heron that the owner feeds often drops by at the window. One-person service, so be patient. Smoking allowed; cash or QR only; closed Monday.

roles: Owner, who runs the bar alone (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews (2023–2026): an ochazuke bar on the Takase River run by one person, a friendly owner in samue; in 2024 the upstairs also ran as a daytime cafe. A September 2024 reviewer writes that an Ochazuke Bar Eiraku opened in Sendai's Kokubuncho, whose owner the Kyoto owner messaged during the visit.
chef_bio.specialty: Ochazuke.

anecdotes.text: In August 2024 the owner explained that a heron which visits the window is a regular, fed fresh fish, and that several herons come one at a time.
A September 2024 visitor who had first found the Sendai Kokubuncho shop came to see the original, and the owner messaged the Sendai owner about the visit.
A May 2026 diner was unsure the salmon and uni ochazuke was outstanding, but was comforted by the riverside view and the friendly owner.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu sukiyaki in a sweet soy broth with nama-fu, steaks with several sauces, shabu-shabu and roast-beef bento; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu sukiyaki and steak house (official site).
places.hours_raw: 11:00–22:00 daily (last food order 21:30) (official site; Tabelog). Bookings by phone or online; no lunch bookings for the weekday steak set (September 2026). No service charge (Tabelog original text: なし). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 44 seats: an 8-seat counter and tables on the ground floor, semi-private and private rooms upstairs for 2–20; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). In a renovated 150-year-old townhouse on Ryoma-dori, one street south of Sanjo, behind Rokuyosha; 5 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn (official site; August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi-Sanjo, Ryoma-dori — 5 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn
places.cuisine: Kuroge wagyu bought whole, in a renovated 150-year-old townhouse (official site) · weekday steak lunch ¥1,200 with 150 g of beef, rice, salad and a side, garlic chips or butter and about six sauces (August–September 2026); outside-skirt steak lunch (October 2026) · sukiyaki courses: kuroge wagyu ¥5,800 (September 2026), Matsusaka beef course, with grated yam as well as egg for dipping (2026 reviews) · Kyoto-style shabu-shabu of Matsusaka beef and Japanese pork in a special broth; teppan steaks à la carte (Tabelog) · private-room lunch bento of wagyu sukiyaki and ichibo roast beef on sushi rice (Tabelog) · sake, shochu and wine
places.notes: [Wagyu sukiyaki and steak · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, a 150-year-old townhouse] A stylishly renovated machiya with a little garden on Ryoma-dori behind Rokuyosha: steaks on the teppan downstairs, sukiyaki in private rooms upstairs. Whole-carcass kuroge wagyu; the sukiyaki comes with grated yam as well as egg (courses about ¥5,800, Matsusaka higher). A weekday steak lunch for about ¥1,200 fills by 11:30. Open daily 11:00–22:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2016 (Tabelog). Per the official site: a Kyoto dining room on Ryoma-dori in a renovated 150-year-old townhouse mixing Japanese and Western antiques; kuroge wagyu chosen by craftsmen and bought as whole animals, served in private rooms.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: whole-animal purchasing for fine marbling and the meat’s true depth of flavour, served the way each guest likes it.
chef_bio.specialty: Kuroge wagyu sukiyaki.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 lunch guest returning after years found every seat taken at 11:30 for the ¥1,200 steak.
A September 2026 diner dipped sukiyaki in grated yam for the first time and might prefer it to egg.
An October 2026 lunch guest in the food trade was served ten minutes after later arrivals.
