Lunch served late into the afternoon on weekdays (January 2026 review). No bookings per Tabelog, though one January 2026 reviewer booked. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 38 seats: an open-kitchen counter downstairs and tables upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog). Prices rose in April 2026 (May 2026 review). In an alley just off Shinkyogoku, a block north of Shijo; 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; February and May 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Shinkyogoku, just north of Shijo — 3 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Classic yoshoku with plenty of salad (2026 reviews): daily lunch special ¥1,150 — sautéed chicken and mushrooms with wasabi ponzu, pork and vegetable yakiniku, pork and bell pepper ponzu stir-fry, chicken and zucchini peperoncino (January–August 2026); hamburg steak and shrimp fry set ¥1,540 with tartar sauce (May 2026); hamburg steak with shrimp cream croquette; teriyaki steak; chicken katsu; roast beef; fried shrimp with tomato sauce; salads with balsamic; corn soup; wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Shinkyogoku] A small two-floor yoshoku in an alley off Shinkyogoku, from a chef who long ran a Western-style restaurant: hamburg steak with demi-glace, shrimp cream croquette, teriyaki steak and a daily lunch for about ¥1,150–1,550, with generous salads, served all afternoon. Cash only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 25 June 2015 by a chef who for many years managed a Western-style restaurant (Tabelog). A regular (January and August 2026) says the owner comes from the well-known salad-and-yoshoku shop Sancho, and the flavours are similar.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak; daily lunch.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner who missed lunch elsewhere after 14:00 was glad the shop still served lunch.
A January 2026 yoshoku lover noted the retro room's scattered Hanshin Tigers goods.
A neighbour working from home over Obon 2026 walked over at 11:40 rather than cook, and was warned upstairs that food would take a while.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食屋 キッチン 秀、洋食・コロッケ・スープ、中京区新京極通四条上る中之町565-10、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、月・火・木〜日 11:30〜15:00・15:00〜21:00、水曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、38席 (1階カウンター、2階テーブル)、禁煙、2015年6月25日オープン、長年洋食店の店長を任されたシェフが開いた店、1階はオープンキッチンのカウンター。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): 店主はサラダの有名店サンチョ出身という声、日替わりランチ1,150円、ハンバーグとエビフライのセット1,540円とタルタル、ハンバーグとエビクリームコロッケ、照り焼きステーキ、チキンカツ、ローストビーフ、トマトソースのエビフライ、バルサミコのサラダ、コーンスープ、2026年4月に値上げ、平日も遅くまで昼のメニュー、阪神グッズ。

places.name: くりた (Kurita)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto courses with yuba, sashimi and dashi dishes, but nama-fu (wheat gluten), tempura-style items and soy seasonings appear (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-centred courses with dashi throughout (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「2階席のみ別途奉仕料が必要」 — a separate service charge for second-floor seats only. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter of 8 and a table for 4 downstairs, up to 8 upstairs; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). By the Takase River south of Shijo; 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 1B (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takase River, Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Shijo — 3 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Kyoto cuisine, one monthly course (a regular's July–October 2026 reviews): freshly scooped yuba to start; a long hassun of seasonal bites — hamo, ayu, whelk, maple-leaf nama-fu, spicy lotus root, manganji pepper, wing tips; sashimi such as sawara, spear squid and guji; matsutake dobin-mushi; kizushi; grilled ayu with roe; furofuki turnip; hamo sushi; sea urchin rice; clam soup; seasonal fruit and wagashi; draft beer and chilled sake. Lunch of about seven dishes with Kyoto vegetables (August 2024)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Takase River] A small counter restaurant by the Takase River run by a friendly couple, serving one generous seasonal Kyoto course a month — fresh yuba, a long hassun, matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn, hamo in summer — about ¥20,000–30,000 at night, around ¥5,000 at lunch. Service charge upstairs only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A Kyoto-cuisine restaurant "run by a friendly couple" (August 2024). Recent detail comes chiefly from one regular who has posted each month's course through 2026 (19–22 visits by July–October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly Kyoto course; fresh yuba.

anecdotes.text: A regular's October 2026 course ran from fresh yuba and a hassun of ginkgo, chestnut crackers and maple-leaf fu to sea bream with turnip and sea-urchin rice.
In September 2026 the same regular marked matsutake season with dobin-mushi, kizushi and hamo ginkgo rice.

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; one course per month.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly drinks; coffee, kombu tea and spirits (2026 reviews).

Drinks from about ¥500, coffee ¥500 (March and July 2026 reviews); evenings lean to alcohol (July 2026 review). Up a stair to a second-floor door covered in stickers and posters (January 2024 and September 2026 reviews). On Kiyamachi-dori south of Shijo, near Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).

places.notes: [Jazz kissa & bar · Kiyamachi] A worn, record-lined jazz room up a stair on Kiyamachi, open from mid-afternoon to 2:00: coffee or kombu tea for about ¥500 by day, rum or umeshu soda by night, vintage amps and requests from the owner's collection. Cash only; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: A long-running jazz café on Kiyamachi (2024–26 reviews); 2024 reviewers praise the owner's ear for jazz, new releases included.
chef_bio.specialty: Jazz records; inexpensive drinks.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor found it nothing like a refined jazz café — more a worn bar open almost till dawn — and had kombu tea for about ¥500.
Waiting for someone in July 2026, a visitor had a ¥500 coffee among walls of jazz records.
A September 2026 visitor climbed the stairs behind a sticker-covered door to a room of vintage amplifiers and speakers.

places.notes: [Yakiniku · Kiyamachi] A late-opening yakiniku in a small alley off Kiyamachi, open till 1:00: Kobe and kuroge wagyu, salted tongue and a broad offal list, with frosted-mug draft beer and a party floor upstairs. About ¥3,000–5,000. Smoking allowed; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 26 September 2013 (Tabelog). Run by the T's pound group (ts-pound.com), which also operates 熟成焼肉 听 京都駅前店 (TableCheck).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kobe beef and kuroge wagyu, with beef raised from the pasture up, paired with wine and sake (TableCheck).
chef_bio.specialty: Horumon; salted tongue.

anecdotes.text: On the last night of a January 2026 trip, a diner came for horumon after yakitori and a course meal, and ordered salted tongue, an offal platter and ume kimchi.
A June 2026 visitor with two smoker friends was glad smoking is allowed, and was steered to the garlic ponzu.

places.gf_detail: Ask. White oden in chicken and bonito broth, saba sushi, sashimi, obanzai and tonjiru; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the oden broth is chicken stock with bonito dashi, and the menu is fish-led (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; recommended, as seats fill (Tabelog; October 2025). Otoshi ¥400 including tax, not charged with a course (Tabelog, original お通し代400円（税込）※コースの場合お通しいただいておりません). Ordering by QR code (January and March 2026). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 50 seats with private rooms (Tabelog). Smoking outside only (Tabelog). Half portions for solo diners (August 2026). Just off Nishiki Market, about 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi; wheelchair-accessible enough for an October 2025 group (Tabelog; reviews). Opened 6 December 2010 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gokomachi just off Nishiki Market — 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: An izakaya of Kyoto vegetables and local sake from Kyoto and Shiga (Tabelog; August 2026) · white oden of Kyoto vegetables in chicken and bonito broth, even in summer — lettuce and broccoli among the pieces (Tabelog; 2025–2026) · saba sushi with thick, fatty mackerel (Tabelog; January–June 2026) · generous sashimi platters; smoked daikon with blue cheese; tonjiru (2026) · quick-drink set until 20:00 with a drink, small appetizer, sashimi and one dish (September 2026) · Oheso course ¥6,000 with free-flow drinks, 8 dishes including homemade yuba and oden (August 2026)
places.notes: [Oden and saba sushi · off Nishiki Market, Kyoto vegetables] A friendly izakaya a step from Nishiki Market, known for white oden of Kyoto vegetables in a chicken-and-bonito broth and a hefty saba sushi, with big sashimi platters, local sake and a good-value quick-drink set before 20:00. ¥400 otoshi; QR ordering.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes dishes made with Kyoto vegetables and signature saba sushi and white oden. Reviewers mention a knowledgeable owner (March 2026) and an attentive head chef (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: White oden; saba sushi.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 group with a wheelchair user, sheltering from the Nishiki crowds and rain, were drawn in by the welcoming staff.
A June 2026 drop-in without a booking took a counter seat for summer oden, sashimi and saba sushi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京のおへそ、居酒屋・海鮮・おでん、中京区御幸町通蛸薬師下ル船屋町386、阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分ほど、毎日17:00〜23:00、お通し代400円 (税込、コースは不要)、カード・PayPay可、50席、個室あり、店外で喫煙、2010年12月6日オープン、京野菜の料理、名物の鯖寿司と鶏ガラと鰹出汁の白いおでん。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 錦市場のすぐそば、QRコードで注文、白おでん (レタス、ブロッコリー)、鯖寿司、刺身の盛り合わせ、いぶりがっこのブルーチーズ、豚汁、20時までのちょい飲みセット、飲み放題付きのおへそコース6,000円 (自家製湯葉など8品)、京都と滋賀の地酒、ハーフサイズあり、物知りな店主、気の利く料理長。

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tuna sushi, yakitori, beef dishes and kushikatsu (2026 reviews).

All-you-can-eat-and-drink courses from ¥2,480; the 2-hour course of about 270 items with chutoro sushi ¥5,480, or ¥4,980 when booked for the 17:00 slot (2026 reviews). places.cuisine: An all-you-can-eat-and-drink izakaya of sushi, kushikatsu, yakitori and gyoza — 30 kinds of sushi and over 200 menu items (Tabelog) · 2-hour course of about 270 items with hon-maguro chutoro sushi on red-vinegar rice, ¥5,480 (2026) · freshly fried kushikatsu; teppan gyoza with cheese, green-onion salt or kimchi; Imabari-style yakitori (2026) · domestic beef yukhoe and tataki, harami steak, roast beef; potato salad; chorogi salad (2026) · lighter courses from ¥2,480 (August 2026)
places.notes: [All-you-can-eat izakaya · Kawaramachi 8F, chutoro sushi and kushikatsu] A big eighth-floor izakaya with a city view and private rooms, running two-hour all-you-can-eat-and-drink courses of around 270 items — chutoro sushi, kushikatsu, teppan gyoza, yakitori and beef — for about ¥5,000, or from ¥2,480 for lighter plans. QR ordering.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T4120001183828 is registered to 株式会社ＷＩＬＬ of Osaka (NTA register), whose website gives no shop list. A July 2026 reviewer notes it is not related to the Kushikatsu Daruma chain.
chef_bio.specialty: All-you-can-eat chutoro sushi.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner booked the 17:00 slot and got the ¥5,480 course for ¥4,980.

Leaves to take home; no cards.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe knowledgeable, friendly staff who suggest teas and brew samples (March and November 2025, May 2026), and a shop laid out like a laboratory with petri dishes of tea leaves (November 2025, September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Oat-milk matcha latte; tea tasting.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor came in for gelato, forgot about it among the dishes of tea leaves, and was matched to a tea with remarkable precision.
A March 2026 guest was struck by a grape-leaf tea from a winery among the world teas.

places.notes: [Kissaten · Kawaramachi-dori, siphon coffee and smoking] A deep, retro coffee house on Kawaramachi with jazz playing and menus under the table glass, brewing each cup by siphon — blends, single origins, whipped-cream lattes and floats. One of the few cafés left where every seat allows smoking; cash only; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a retro, jazz-filled coffee house with a deep room and a striking storefront and sign (August 2026), and note that it is one of the few remaining cafés where smoking is allowed throughout (2025–2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Siphon coffee.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 passer-by was drawn in by the lettering of the sign and ordered an unusual Java coffee.
A December 2025 pair stopped in after a Chinese lunch for an iced coffee and a Guatemala on an unseasonably warm day.

places.notes: [Retro Western bar · Kiyamachi alley, since 1922] A sepia-toned Western-style bar founded in 1922, hidden at the end of a twisting alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, with a polished counter and shelves of Nikka whisky. The kitchen — once known for shrimp coquille and oyster fry — closed at the end of 2025, so it now serves drinks only. Closed Thursday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), long-serving; stopped cooking at the end of 2025 (April 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: A February 2017 review says the restaurant was founded in 1922; reviews from 2010 to 2019 describe regulars of 15 to over 20 years. An April 2026 review reports that the chef stopped serving food at the end of 2025 and that only drinks are now served.

anecdotes.text: A regular since 1994 marked the arrival of winter by the oyster fry, served from mid-November to mid-March (December 2010).
An April 2016 couple found it after cherry-blossom viewing, deep in an alley you would not find without knowing it.
An April 2026 visitor reported that food has ended and drinks remain.

places.notes: [Café-bar · Pontocho, a tea house on the Kamo river] A renovated former tea house on Pontocho opening onto a riverside terrace: a café with cake sets and a simple mackerel lunch by day, and a bar for drinks with a river view, salads and pizza at night. ¥500 charge at dinner; smoking allowed. Dogs welcome on the deck.

An August 2026 pair booked the 18:00 river-edge seats on a cloudy evening and found the portions too big to order more.
A May 2025 visitor had hoped to sit closer to the water and found the terrace less cool than expected.

Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners) and e-money; Tabelog says no QR, a June 2026 reviewer used PayPay. 75 seats with kamakura-like semi-private booths; private hire for 25–50 (Tabelog; December 2024). Smoking allowed (October 2025). On Higashi-Kiyamachi north of Shijo; 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi north of Shijo — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Casual yakitori and kushikatsu izakaya, open till 3 a.m. at weekends (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews) · clam soup as the appetizer; thick-cut sashimi platters; tsukune with raw egg, liver and other skewers; kushikatsu; dashimaki; beef tofu; fries (2024–2026 reviews) · Kirin draft, bakudan lemon sour and mega-size sours (2024–2026 reviews) · about ¥2,000–5,000 (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi north of Shijo, late at weekends] A roomy, casual skewer izakaya with snow-hut-style booths, easy to book on a busy night: a warming clam soup to start, thick-cut sashimi, tsukune with raw egg, kushikatsu and big sours, open till 3 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays. Some found the skewer choice thin and à la carte pricey. Smoking allowed; ¥330 appetizer.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakitori, kushikatsu and izakaya of 75 seats on Higashi-Kiyamachi, open late at weekends. Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe friendly staff and semi-private rooms shaped like kamakura snow huts.
chef_bio.specialty: Clam soup appetizer; thick-cut sashimi.

anecdotes.text: An April 2024 pair celebrating small wins at the Tenno Sho were surprised by a clam soup appetizer and ordered a second bakudan lemon sour.
A January 2026 Saturday-night diner, turned away elsewhere, booked by phone and was seated at once — but found the skewer choice limited, with no chicken skin.
A June 2026 pair spent about ¥10,000 and found the drink cups small and à la carte prices high.

cultural_comfort.note: Casual and lively; smoking allowed; ¥330 appetizer charge.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Smoked black edamame and other vegetable dishes exist, but butter, meat miso and fish are common (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday and holidays 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); Sunday 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; busy at weekends (Tabelog; May 2026). The appetizer is a smoked snack served with a small glass of sake (2026 reviews). First drink ordered with staff, then by QR code (September 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 32 seats: 7 at the counter, tables and high tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). In front of the south exit of the BAL building, off Kawaramachi south of Sanjo; 4 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 6 December 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi south of Sanjo, by the BAL building
places.cuisine: Izakaya of smoked dishes and Japanese sake, with a monthly sake list, tasting flights and a choice of sake cups (2026 reviews) · smoked potato with butter, corn and garlic; smoked black edamame; smoked potato salad; smoked salmon with iburi-gakko tartar under a smoke-filled glass lid; meat miso; vanilla ice cream with sansho (July–October 2026) · sake by the glass or flight, e.g. Senkin; whisky; all-you-can-drink available (May–October 2026) · about ¥3,000–8,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Sake izakaya · Kawaramachi by BAL, smoked dishes] A bright, sake-mad izakaya where even the appetizer — smoked salmon with iburi-gakko under a smoky glass dome — comes with a little sake. Smoked potato with butter and corn, smoked edamame and a long list of sake by the glass or in flights, with your pick of cup. One May 2026 guest was steered to whisky instead of sake. Non-smoking.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya, sake bar and Japanese restaurant opened 6 December 2015 by the BAL building. Reviewers in 2026 describe smoked dishes paired with Japanese sake, staff who recommend sake to taste, and 80s–90s music.
chef_bio.philosophy: Smoked dishes paired with sake from the first drink (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Smoked potato with butter and corn; sake flights.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 first-timer opened the glass lid on the appetizer — smoked salmon with iburi-gakko tartar, with a sake — to a burst of smoky aroma.
A September 2026 group of six enjoyed picking a sake cup each.
A May 2026 guest who came for sake was recommended whisky instead.

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering after the first drink; staff help choose sake; cards, IC and QR.

places.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi north of Shijo, kamameshi and obanzai] A big, easy-to-get-into Kyoto izakaya over several floors with tatami rooms for groups: obanzai, yuba sashimi, Kujo-negi tempura, yakitori, and kamameshi cooked at the table — order early, it takes 30 minutes. Some found it chain-like and not especially Kyoto. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the main shop of いろはかるた, an izakaya of 206 seats on Higashi-Kiyamachi; a second shop by Kyoto Station is in our crawls. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a Kyoto-only chain with Kyoto touches, friendly staff and quick seating.
chef_bio.specialty: Kamameshi; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 business traveller waited about 30 minutes, timer in hand, for bamboo-shoot and salmon-and-ikura kamameshi cooked at the table.
A December 2025 first-timer liked the variety and prices but found it not very Kyoto.
A September 2026 regular since the Kyoto Station shop ten years earlier came in late just for zaru soba and was welcomed with a smile.

cultural_comfort.note: Large and easy to get into; tatami rooms for groups; cards, IC and QR.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant (2023–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Friday and the day before or after a holiday 17:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Saturday, Sunday and holidays also 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30); other irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; courses cancelled after 15:00 on the day are charged 50%, table bookings cancelled after 17:00 ¥1,500 per person (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥250, none with a course (Tabelog original お通し：250円（コースはお通し料無し）). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Counter on the 1F, tables on the 2F and 3F; strong ventilation (2023–2025 reviews). places.neighborhood: Off Pontocho north of Shijo — 4 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Wagyu yakiniku in a calm, dim townhouse with a meat showcase at the door (2023–2026 reviews) · e.g. premium salted tongue ¥1,380, premium kalbi ¥1,080 (February 2025); rare cuts; Chateaubriand; meat sushi (2024–2026 reviews) · courses, e.g. ¥8,000 (September 2023); 200 g of tenderloin with vegetables grilled in oil in an iron pot (September 2024) · Chita highball (February 2024) · about ¥6,000–10,000 (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · off Pontocho, wagyu in a quiet townhouse] A dim, elegant yakiniku down a lane off Pontocho, with good extraction so the smoke stays off your clothes: salted tongue, kalbi, rare cuts, Chateaubriand and meat sushi, or courses with oil-grilled tenderloin. Some found it average, with rare cuts sold out, or service slow at the far tables. Weekend lunch too.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakiniku, Korean and horumon restaurant opened 20 August 2021 off Pontocho, over three floors. Reviewers describe a calm, upscale room and staff who invite passers-by in (2023–2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Premium salted tongue; meat sushi.

anecdotes.text: A September 2023 birthday couple on the ¥8,000 course found the ventilation kept the smell out of clothes and hair.
An October 2025 diner at a far table never got the drinks or the sauce.
An October 2025 business group led up to the third floor found the yakiniku average and many rare cuts out of stock.

places.name: 京のかわば田 (Kyo no Kawabata)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, ponzu and sesame dipping sauces, sukiyaki sauce and saikyo-miso grilled fish (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Wagyu shabu-shabu and sukiyaki, sashimi and dashi-cooked kamameshi; the daily obanzai lunch is vegetable-led but not described as vegan (Tabelog; 2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closing days may vary. A June 2025 review gives lunch 11:00–16:00 (last order) and dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order). Reservations taken; the few river-view counter seats go first (November 2025). 22 seats: a counter facing the Kamo River and sunken-kotatsu private rooms for 4–8; private hire up to 50. Tabelog says non-smoking; an August 2025 review says all seats allowed smoking — ask. Multilingual menu (English, Chinese, Korean); smartphone ordering (September 2026). Cards, transit IC, e-money and QR (PayPay and others). 5th floor of the 鴨東四条ビル on the east bank at Shijo; a reviewer warns not to confuse it with a similarly named building just south (September 2026).
places.neighborhood: East bank of the Kamo River at Shijo — 2–3 min walk from Gion-Shijo
places.cuisine: A Japanese izakaya on a 5th floor with a counter overlooking the Kamo River (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · Beef Shabu Gozen with Miyazaki Wagyu, ponzu and sesame sauce ¥4,000 (June and August 2025); Wagyu Sukiyaki Gozen ¥4,500 (November 2025) · kamameshi cooked at the table — sea bream, salmon and ikura, chicken and burdock, or clams — as a +¥500 upgrade to the set rice (2025) · daily Obanzai Gozen of seasonal Kyoto vegetables ¥1,980 at lunch (May 2025) · an 8-dish Kawabata course with three small dishes, three kinds of sashimi, saikyo-miso grilled Spanish mackerel and tempura (Tabelog) · cocktails, about 10 whiskies and sake (Tabelog; December 2025)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kamo riverbank at Shijo, Wagyu shabu-shabu with a river view] A calm 5th-floor izakaya whose counter looks straight down on the Kamo River: Miyazaki Wagyu shabu-shabu or sukiyaki sets with kamameshi cooked at the table, and a daily obanzai lunch. Ask for a river seat when booking — one July 2026 diner at the inner counter saw no river. Open daily 11:00–23:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists it as a corporate member, but no source names the operator or says whether it has sister shops. Reviewers from April 2025 to September 2026 describe a calm, bar-like room with a traditional Japanese feel and subdued lighting, Miyazaki Wagyu shabu-shabu and sukiyaki sets, and a counter facing the river; one compares it with Pontocho, saying it lets you "quietly enjoy the river view from indoors" (November 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu shabu-shabu and sukiyaki sets; kamameshi.

anecdotes.text: August 2025: "In the evening, the setting sun created a backlight that made it difficult to take photos of the dishes, so they kindly closed the curtains just for the photo session."
April 2026: "The portion of rice was a bit small, but it might be just the right amount if you order some udon as a finishing touch."
September 2026: "The counter seats offer a view of the Kamo River, and while the reflections can be distracting at night, the lights from the riverside restaurants create a beautiful scene."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京のかわば田、居酒屋・しゃぶしゃぶ・すき焼き、東山区常盤町173-2 鴨東四条ビル 5F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩2〜3分、毎日 11:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、休みは不定、予約可、22席、個室 (4〜8名)、貸切可、禁煙、多言語メニュー、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR可、法人会員、鴨川を望むカウンター、和牛しゃぶしゃぶと5種の釜飯、8品のコース (小鉢3種、刺身3種、鰆の西京焼き、天ぷら)、カクテルとウイスキー10種。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年9月、英語): 宮崎県産和牛の牛しゃぶ御膳4,000円、和牛すき焼き御膳4,500円、釜飯への変更500円 (鯛、鮭いくら、鶏ごぼう、あさり)、おばんざい御膳1,980円、Daiyame 800円、落ち着いた和の空間、夜はガラスの映り込み、全席喫煙可との記述 (2025年8月)、内側のカウンターでは川が見えない (2026年7月)、ご飯が少なめ (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Multilingual menu (English, Chinese, Korean); smartphone ordering.

places.name: 北海道直送貝魚バル ざんぐり (Zanguri)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pasta, cured squid and soy-seasoned delicacies; sashimi and grilled fish may be possible — ask (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Hokkaido seafood and game bar (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 13:00–16:00 (last order 15:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed on the third Sunday and Monday of the month — the third Monday may open, so call. Reservations taken; seafood can run out with the weather. 500-yen appetizer charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「突き出し（お通し）500円頂戴いたします」. 6 counter seats; non-smoking. Cards (incl. UnionPay), transit IC, QUICPay and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay and others). Ground floor of 四富会館, the Showa-era bar arcade on Shijo at Tomikoji.
places.neighborhood: Shitomi Kaikan bar arcade, Shijo at Tomikoji — 5 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: A six-seat counter in the Shitomi Kaikan arcade serving seafood and meat shipped from Hokkaido, cooked by a chef with French and Italian experience in Kitashinchi (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews) · raw hokke sashimi ¥1,200 and seiko crab ¥1,000 (October 2023); hatahata sashimi (2023); crab — seiko, koppe and kobako (November 2024) · cured squid from Hakodate; Shiretoko icefish ¥1,200; a three-item Hokkaido platter (herring, cod sashimi, salted sea squirt) ¥1,200 (February 2026) · Ezo deer steak with cassis sauce; squid and canola-flower tomato spaghetti (March 2026) · Hokkaido sake, wine and whisky (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Hokkaido seafood bar · Shitomi Kaikan, six seats and a chatty chef] A six-seat counter in the retro Shitomi Kaikan bar arcade where a former French and Italian cook serves fish, crab and game shipped from Hokkaido — hokke sashimi, Ezo deer with cassis — with Hokkaido sake, and pasta off the menu if you ask. Pricier than its neighbours, and a ¥500 appetizer charge. Third Sunday and Monday closed.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog's own listing says the chef worked in French and Italian cooking in Kitashinchi (Osaka) and improvises with the day's Hokkaido catch. Reviewers call him the master; one heard he comes from a French background (February 2026), others an Italian one (February 2026), and several describe lively talk that draws the whole counter in. One September 2025 reviewer, however, left after an appetizer and a highball, saying no chance came to order and the owner never asked.
chef_bio.specialty: Hokkaido seafood; hokke sashimi.

anecdotes.text: October 2023: "The friendly owner casually asked where I was from—am I a tourist? He has a great personality."
February 2026: "the master has an Italian background. So, if you ask nicely, he might whip up some pasta or Italian dishes that aren't on the menu."

December 2025: "The quiet master, the soft jazz playing in the background, and the sound of fish sizzling on the grill created a perfect ambiance." The same reviewer found sake and grilled fish dearer than elsewhere.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 北海道直送貝魚バル ざんぐり、魚介料理・居酒屋、中京区四条通富小路上がる西大文字町615 四富会館 1F、月〜金 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、土日祝 13:00〜16:00 (L.O. 15:30)・17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、毎月第3日曜・月曜休み (第3月曜は営業することもある)、予約可、天候で魚介がないことも、原文で「突き出し（お通し）500円頂戴いたします」、6席、禁煙、カード・交通系IC・QR可、北新地でフレンチとイタリアンを経験した料理人が北海道直送の魚介と肉を、エゾシカのカシスソース、豚のバルサミコソース。口コミ (2023年10月〜2026年11月、英語): ホッケの刺身1,200円、セイコガニ1,000円、ハタハタの刺身、カニ、函館のいかの塩辛、北海道の珍味1,200円、北海道の珍味3種盛り1,200円、エゾシカのステーキ、パスタ、北海道の地酒、気さくでよく話すマスター、値段はやや高め、注文の機会がなく帰った客も (2025年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Six-seat counter; conversation with the chef is part of it.

places.gf_detail: Ask: naan, cheese naan and curry udon contain wheat; rice and biryani exist, but no source says whether the curries are thickened with flour (Tabelog; 2021–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: a vegetable curry with carrots, green beans and eggplant (January 2026), but no source says whether ghee, butter or cream go in; the naan is generously buttered (May 2024).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:45) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:45); closed Monday. No reservations. 32 seats: 8 at the counter, 16 at tables and 8 on the terrace; smoking allowed on the terrace only; pets allowed on the terrace. English menu; kids' menu; children and strollers welcome; free Wi-Fi; take-away. Cash only per Tabelog (no cards, no e-money). On Ayanokoji west of Fuyacho, 2 min from Kawaramachi exit 11. Opened 15 July 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ayanokoji at Fuyacho — 2 min walk from Kawaramachi exit 11
places.cuisine: A Nepalese-run curry café with a tandoor and a terrace (Tabelog; 2021–2026 reviews) · lunch set of chicken curry, naan, chicken tikka, salad and a drink ¥900 before tax; a beer instead of the drink +¥300 (June 2023) · chicken, butter chicken, white, cashew-nut, spinach-chicken and vegetable curries, with five spice levels (Tabelog; 2023–2026) · huge tandoor naan — leftovers can go home (June 2023) — and cheese naan; tandoori chicken (2024–2025) · mutton biryani; anko cheese naan (October 2026) · lassi, masala chai, Nepalese beer (Tabelog; May 2024)
places.notes: [Nepalese curry · Ayanokoji near Kawaramachi, giant naan and a dog-friendly terrace] A bright Nepalese-run curry café a block from Kawaramachi: good-value lunch sets with chicken tikka, naan bigger than your plate from the tandoor, cheese naan, biryani and a vegetable curry, with five spice levels. Friendly staff are the most-praised thing here; some find the curries mild. Dogs welcome on the terrace. Cash only. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 July 2020 (Tabelog), with curry "made by a chef from Nepal" per its Tabelog highlights. Retty, Uber Eats and a Kyoto curry guide list it in Latin as "raicha Spice Cafe Restaurant"; Tabelog's English page renders the name "Righteous". Reviewers from 2021 to 2026 praise a Nepalese manager "fluent in Japanese" (May 2024), cheerful staff and tandoor-baked naan; a few found the curries milder than hoped (November 2022; September 2023).
chef_bio.specialty: Tandoor naan; spice curries.

anecdotes.text: June 2023: "I was blown away by the size of the naan that came out of the tandoor right in front of me! It's huge! … And apparently, you can take home any leftovers."
September 2023: "I chose the butter chicken curry, but it wasn't quite what I expected; it was quite mild."
April 2025: "I visited this place at the end of my trip to Kyoto with my dog. The terrace seating is dog-friendly, so we enjoyed our meal outside."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ライチャスパイスカフェレストラン、ネパール料理・インドカレー・カフェ、下京区綾小路通麩屋町西入塩屋町72 グランシャトレー 1F、河原町駅11番出口から徒歩2分、火〜日 11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:45)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:45)、月曜休み、予約不可、32席 (カウンター8、テーブル16、テラス8)、テラスのみ喫煙可、テラスはペット可、英語メニュー、キッズメニュー、子供・ベビーカー可、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー不可、2020年7月15日オープン、ネパール出身のシェフのスパイスカレー、辛さは5段階、炭火で焼くナンとチキンティッカのセット。他の掲載 (Retty、Uber Eats): raicha Spice Cafe Restaurant。口コミ (2021年12月〜2026年10月、英語): ランチセット900円 (税抜)、ビールに変更300円、大きなナンは持ち帰り可、チーズナン、タンドリーチキン、ほうれん草チキンカレー、野菜カレー、マトンのビリヤニ、あんこチーズナン、ネパールのビール、日本語が上手なネパール人の店長、明るいスタッフ、カレーがマイルドすぎるとの声 (2022年、2023年)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; pets on the terrace; cash only.

places.name: もつ鍋・すき焼き いっしん (Isshin)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soy-sauce and miso motsu-nabe broths, sukiyaki sauce, udon and champon noodles to finish, kushikatsu and tempura (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef offal hotpot, Wagyu sukiyaki and horse sashimi (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); closing days not fixed. Reservations taken. Table charge ¥330 a person — Tabelog, Japanese original 「テーブルチャージ330円/人」. A January 2026 reviewer reports prices 20% higher over the New Year holiday. 80 seats: 18 at the counter and 62 at tables, including a tatami area; private rooms for 10–20. Smoking allowed. QR-code ordering (January 2025). Cards and QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay); no e-money. 2nd floor of 木屋町会館, west side of Kiyamachi one street below Takoyakushi. Opened 1 May 2019 (Tabelog). Some listings give the name as もつ鍋・地鶏工房 いっしん at the same address and phone number.
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi below Takoyakushi — 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi or Keihan Sanjo
places.cuisine: A large Kiyamachi izakaya for beef-offal motsu-nabe and Wagyu sukiyaki (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews) · motsu-nabe in soy-sauce or miso broth with garlic and cabbage, then udon, champon noodles or rice porridge to finish (2024–2026) · Wagyu sukiyaki sets and courses (2025) · Kumamoto horse sashimi and, some days, off-menu horse liver (June and October 2025) · kushikatsu, vinegared dishes and tempura (December 2024–2025) · an omakase course with all-you-can-drink for 2 hours ¥5,000 (Tabelog course page)
places.notes: [Motsu-nabe and sukiyaki · Kiyamachi, a busy second-floor hotpot izakaya] A big second-floor izakaya above Kiyamachi for beef-offal hotpot — soy-sauce or miso, with no off-smell, reviewers stress — Wagyu sukiyaki and Kumamoto horse sashimi, with udon or champon to finish. Busy, with smoking allowed; service can lag at peak times, and the music is loud for some. ¥330 table charge. Open nightly to midnight.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2019 (Tabelog). No source names the operator or says whether it has sister shops; other listings show it at the same address under the name もつ鍋・地鶏工房 いっしん. Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 praise offal "without any unpleasant odor" (November 2024), a broth that is "not overly salty or heavy" (February 2025) and bright, quick staff (January 2025); criticism covers slow service in the year-end rush (December 2024), sukiyaki that was "somewhat average" (April 2025) and loud background music (February 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Beef-offal motsu-nabe; Wagyu sukiyaki.

anecdotes.text: November 2024: "I believe there were about 8 pieces of motsu even for two people, which was a perfect amount considering my age and a sensitive stomach."
October 2025: "I was shocked that I could eat the liver without any unpleasant smell" — of the horse sashimi.
February 2026: "I had sukiyaki, but it wasn't the grilled type, which surprised me a bit… However, the loud background music was a downside."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: もつ鍋・すき焼き いっしん、居酒屋・もつ鍋・すき焼き、中京区南車屋町287 木屋町会館 2F、阪急河原町駅・京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、木屋町蛸薬師一筋目西側、毎日 17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、不定休、予約可、原文で「テーブルチャージ330円/人」、80席 (カウンター18、テーブル62)、座敷、個室 (10〜20名)、喫煙可、カード・QR可、電子マネー不可、2019年5月1日オープン、おまかせコースと2時間飲み放題5,000円。他の掲載: もつ鍋・地鶏工房 いっしん (同じ住所・電話)。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年2月、英語): 醤油と味噌のもつ鍋、にんにく、キャベツ、締めのうどん・ちゃんぽん・雑炊、すき焼き、熊本の馬刺し、馬レバー、串カツ、天ぷら、QRで注文、明るいスタッフ、年末の混雑でサービスが不十分 (2024年12月)、すき焼きは普通 (2025年4月)、正月は2割増し (2026年1月)、BGMが大きい (2026年2月)。

places.name: 味浪漫いしがま亭 (Aji Roman Ishigama Tei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Duck shabu-shabu in a white broth, but tempura, ramen to finish and soy seasonings are part of the meals (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Kyoto-duck restaurant; hamo and eel dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 (food last order 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (food last order 21:00, last entry 20:30); irregular closures (Tabelog). Bookings taken; for courses the whole table orders the same course (Tabelog). People queue before opening on holidays (September 2026 review). Table charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「チャージ660円(コースご注文の場合はいただきません)」 — ¥660, not charged with a course. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 52 seats — counter, tables, tatami and 6-seat tatami private rooms — plus riverside seats on the Kamo River after a move to this site (August–October 2026 reviews); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). On Nishi-Ishigaki south of Shijo, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Ishigaki on the Kamo River, south of Shijo — 3 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto duck and seasonal Kyoto cooking (job listing; 2026 reviews): Kyoto duck shabu-shabu in a white broth with pepper and a house chilli oil, finished with thin ramen or rice porridge; roast duck; duck tempura; hamo tempura set and a hamo-shabu course; eel; fresh yuba salad, fried taro, eggplant like agedashi; lunch gozen ¥2,200 with duck tempura, yuba and miso soup (September 2026); duck shabu-shabu set at lunch; Kyoto duck shabu-shabu course at night; sake a focus (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kyoto duck · Kamo riverside] A Kyoto-duck restaurant in a renovated townhouse on the Kamo River, now with riverside tables: duck shabu-shabu in a white broth finished with ramen, roast duck, hamo in season, and a ¥2,200 lunch gozen. Courses about ¥6,000–8,000. ¥660 charge without a course.

chef_bio.background: Opened in 2000 with Kyoto duck and hamo; new ownership from 2018, keeping Kyoto-duck kaiseki (job listing, careermap.jp). A long-time regular noted in August 2026 that the restaurant had moved to its present riverside site.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto duck shabu-shabu.

anecdotes.text: A long-time regular's first visit since the move, in August 2026, was a course of duck shabu-shabu finished with ramen.
Arriving at opening on a September 2026 holiday, a returning diner found about six groups waiting and ordered the ¥2,200 gozen again.
A September 2026 diner who booked 17:30 got a riverside seat for an autumn course, but found the finishing rice porridge one dish too many.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 味浪漫いしがま亭、居酒屋・しゃぶしゃぶ・日本料理、下京区西石垣通四条下ル斎藤町140-29、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、毎日 11:30〜14:30 (料理 L.O. 13:30)・17:30〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 21:00、最終入店20:30)、不定休、予約可 (コースは全員同じコース)、チャージ660円 (コースの場合なし)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、52席 (カウンター4、テーブル18、座敷24、座敷の個室6)、禁煙、車椅子可、テラス。求人 (careermap): 2000年開業、京鴨や鱧、2018年にオーナーが交代、京鴨中心の会席。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 移転して鴨川沿いの席、京鴨のしゃぶしゃぶ (白いスープ、胡椒と自家製のラー油、締めのラーメンや雑炊)、鴨ロース、鴨の天ぷら、鱧の天ぷらの定食、鱧しゃぶのコース、鰻、生湯葉のサラダ、里芋の揚げ物、茄子の揚げ出し風、昼の御膳2,200円、祝日は開店前に行列。

places.name: 京料理 多から (Kyoryori Takara)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki with sashimi and soups, but soy-seasoned sukiyaki and nabe appear (reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses, suppon (soft-shell turtle) nabe and sukiyaki (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 12:00–14:30 (last entry 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last entry 21:00); closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 50 seats with tatami rooms overlooking the Kamo River, a kawadoko deck in season and a tatami hall for about 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2024 review). On Pontocho just north of Shijo, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi and Keihan Gion-Shijo Stns (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, just north of Shijo — on the Kamo River
places.cuisine: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki with a river view (Tabelog; reviews): courses of hamo soup, sashimi of hamo, toro, sea bream and squid, saba sushi and grilled ayu (August 2022); suppon (soft-shell turtle) hot pot, a signature (Hitosara; 2022–23 reviews); clam soup and strawberry jelly (April 2024); a limited-time sukiyaki on the river (September 2026); seasonal dishes in the tatami hall (September 2024)
places.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Pontocho, Kamo River] A Pontocho kaiseki house of more than 120 years, now with its fourth-generation owner: tatami rooms over the Kamo River and a kawadoko deck in season, seasonal Kyoto courses, suppon hot pot and a riverside sukiyaki. About ¥10,000–15,000 at night. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A traditional Kyoto-cuisine restaurant of more than 120 years, run by the fourth generation (Tabelog shop text). Hitosara describes it as a long-established ryotei whose specialty is suppon (soft-shell turtle), with kawadoko dining on the Kamo River.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal kaiseki of fine ingredients, with the river view (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Suppon nabe; seasonal kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner had the limited-time sukiyaki overlooking the river and found it worth the price, ordering more rice.
A November 2025 diner praised the view, the attentive staff and dishes that came promptly.
A regular, back again in May 2026, had described an autumn 2024 meal in a tatami hall for about twenty over the river.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京料理 多から、日本料理・ふぐ・鍋、中京区先斗町通四条上ル柏屋町173-2、阪急河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、火〜日 12:00〜14:30 (最終入店14:00)・17:00〜22:00 (最終入店21:00)、月曜休み、予約可、カード可、50席、座敷、禁煙、創業120年余りの老舗の京料理、鴨川の眺め、季節の川床、4代目の店主。ヒトサラ: 先斗町 多から、老舗の料亭、名物はすっぽん、川床。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 鱧の吸い物、鱧・トロ・鯛・いかの刺身、鯖寿司、鮎の塩焼き、すっぽん鍋、はまぐりの吸い物、いちごのゼリー、川を眺める期間限定のすき焼き (2026年9月)、20人ほどの座敷の広間 (2024年9月)、景色と細やかな接客 (2025年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Tatami rooms; book for the kawadoko.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Nama-fu, yuba, tofu and Kyoto vegetables feature, but dashi and fish dishes are likely; not described (Tabelog; reviews).

Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and e-money (Tabelog). 40 seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Staff invite passers-by in from the street (2021–24 reviews). On Pontocho just north of Shijo, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, just north of Shijo — 3 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Obanzai and Kyoto-kaiseki courses with nama-fu and nama-yuba from the old maker 半兵衛麸, courses from ¥2,980 (Tabelog shop text); à la carte Kyoto dishes such as tofu shumai, okra and yuba salad, hot pots including anglerfish in winter, fried chicken, sashimi (2017–24 reviews); draft beer, sake and shochu, all-you-can-drink plans (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Obanzai & nama-fu · Pontocho] An easy-going Pontocho restaurant open from late afternoon (and lunch at weekends) with obanzai and Kyoto courses from ¥2,980 using nama-fu and yuba from 半兵衛麸, plus hot pots and drink plans. Reviews are mixed on value. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog's shop text says it uses fresh nama-fu and nama-yuba from the long-established maker 半兵衛麸. An older group website (kyo-sakusaku.com) no longer resolves. Reviews are mixed: several from 2021–23 found portions small or prices high for Pontocho; 2024–25 reviewers found it good value and friendly.
chef_bio.philosophy: Obanzai and Kyoto kaiseki at reasonable prices (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Nama-fu and yuba courses.

anecdotes.text: Arriving after most nearby places had closed for lunch in May 2025, a diner liked the retro room, friendly staff and well-chilled draft beer.
A January 2025 diner dropping in for a drink found the food decent but unremarkable.
A May 2024 holiday visitor before 16:00 found the room busy with late lunches and early dinners, and tofu shumai on a wide menu.

Bookings taken; day-before or same-day cancellations are charged 100% for courses and ¥5,000 per person for table bookings (Tabelog). About ¥5,000–8,000. Strict cancellation charges; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A teppanyaki restaurant in the basement of 紫光會館 on Pontocho (Tabelog). A June 2024 reviewer describes a hard-working master overseeing younger staff.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu teppanyaki; garlic rice.

anecdotes.text: Visiting on a wedding anniversary in November 2025 without a booking, a couple went down on the strength of a flyer and were warmly welcomed.
A December 2025 year-end traveller who booked ahead tried yuba topped with caviar for the first time.
Two friends at the counter in July 2026 had a clear view of the grill on the ¥4,800 course.

The shop’s old website now carries unrelated advertising and is not used here.
places.neighborhood: Okazaki, near Heian Shrine — 1 min from the Okazakimichi bus stop
places.cuisine: A small house café (Tabelog; reviews) · bean spice curry lunch with plenty of vegetables and house pickled napa cabbage; curry to take away (May–June 2025) · ohagi with sesame or bean paste and an unsweetened matcha latte (April and October 2025); cheesecake; pumpkin cake; a sweet-potato dessert (2023–2025) · shaved ice such as rich Uva tea or ginger milk with ice cream (2020–2023) · iced coffee
places.notes: [Café · Okazaki near Heian Shrine, a quiet house café with a cat] A tiny café in an old house among greenery on Marutamachi, filled with antique furniture and a resident cat. Come for a bean spice curry lunch with pickles, or ohagi with a matcha latte, after the Kyocera Museum or Heian Shrine. Short hours: afternoons only, closed Monday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 October 2011 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2022–2026) describe a calm traditional house with antique furniture, greenery, a goods corner and a cat.
chef_bio.specialty: Bean spice curry; ohagi.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 visitor dropped in for curry to take away and also bought the cat-shaped cookies.
A June 2025 diner nearly finished a whole jar of the pickled napa cabbage served with the curry.
A July 2026 guest walking from the Okura Bettei stopped for a 3 p.m. snack with no other customers there.

places.notes: [Asian diner · Sanjo-kai arcade near Nijo, set meals all day] A stylish little diner-café on the covered Sanjo-kai arcade serving Asian-leaning set meals from lunch to evening: ethnic-spiced kara-age, Sichuan boiled pork, khao man gai, coriander-and-lime soup noodles, each with small sides and soup, plus a cake set for about ¥800. Quick and good value. Cash only; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 6 June 2014 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2025–2026) describe a small, deep shop on the Sanjo-kai arcade that works as café, diner and restaurant in one, with set meals into the evening.
chef_bio.specialty: Ethnic-spiced kara-age set.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 diner seasoned the kara-age set with the pickled chillies and nam pla on the table.
A March 2026 first-timer found a ¥800 cake set — apple pie and café au lait — rare these days.
A December 2025 visitor at an odd hour was looked after with great care.

places.notes: [Café-dining · Shichijo-Shinmachi near Kyoto Station, plate lunches and Chicago pizza] A cosy second-floor café-dining room five minutes from Kyoto Station: vegetable-heavy plate lunches (shiba-zuke tartar chicken nanban is a favourite), chewy soup pasta and big griddle crêpes by day; Chicago deep-dish pizza and free-flow courses at night. Lunch fills with bookings — reserve. Open daily till 22:30.

roles: Operated by 有限会社アユム (invoice register)
chef_bio.background: The qualified-invoice holder is 有限会社アユム of Kita-ku, Kyoto (NTA). Our crawl also lists a sister café, きわみ saredoフレンチトーストかふぇ. Tabelog’s introduction: a café and dining spot five minutes from Kyoto Station with Chicago-style pizza, soup pasta and drinks for celebrations.
chef_bio.specialty: Shiba-zuke tartar chicken nanban plate; Chicago pizza.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 solo business traveller found a line on the stairs before opening even in the rain.
A September 2026 holiday diner was told the food would take about 40 minutes and warned others about the steep stairs.
An October 2026 visitor drawn in by the pizza sign learned it is served only at night.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soft serve, cream and parfaits (reviews).

places.notes: [Matcha sweets · Gion on Shijo, a rice-cracker maker's tea room] The Gion flagship of a Kyoto rice-cracker maker: senbei and soft serve downstairs, a calm tea room upstairs serving a towering matcha parfait (about ¥1,500, upgradeable to matcha everything), warabi mochi and a matcha mille-feuille. chef_bio.specialty: Uji matcha parfait.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor rated the warabi mochi above the famous matcha parfait.

An August 2026 guest arrived five minutes before opening and was the first customer.

places.notes: [Mizutaki · Kiyamachi over the Kamo, an old house] A long-established chicken hot pot restaurant in a house said to be over a century old on Kiyamachi, with tatami rooms and a summer deck over the Kamo: staff tend a rich, creamy mizutaki at the table, finished with rice porridge. places.notes: [Izakaya · Nishikiyamachi by the Takase, Kyoto vegetables] A quiet, Japanese-style izakaya on the Takase River near Sanjo with semi-private sunken-kotatsu booths, cooking seasonal Kyoto vegetables and seafood, with a ¥5,000 nine-dish course with free-flow drinks. ¥450 otoshi à la carte; open until 1:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes vegetables from contract farmers in Kyoto and seasonal seafood, a calm traditional room, and semi-private seating for 2 to 4.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Kyoto vegetables and seafood.

A July 2026 couple, called in by a staff member outside, cooled off with beer before ramen.

places.notes: [Hamo and fugu · Tominokoji near Shijo, family-run] A family-run, Showa-feeling restaurant a short walk from Shijo-Kawaramachi that specialises in hamo — shabu-shabu with a rice-porridge finish, sashimi, a ¥2,000 drinking set — and fugu, even out of season. ¥450 charge; weekend lunch; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A January 2026 diner learned from the owner that the restaurant is family-run. The shop’s Tabelog note mentions an earlier site on Nishikikoji at Muromachi (Hirata Building 1F).
chef_bio.specialty: Hamo shabu-shabu.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 caller was surprised to find hamo in winter and booked the ¥8,800 course straight away.
A July 2026 visitor, on a second stop, took the ¥2,000 set with hamo sashimi and added boiled fugu.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Spanish dishes — ajillo, paella, tortilla, garlic soup, wine-braised beef, tapas — served with bread; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).

places.notes: [Spanish · Gion on Nawate, a 30-year bar] A cosy Spanish bar up narrow stairs on Nawate in Gion, open for over three decades: ajillo, paella, garlic soup, wine-braised beef, prosciutto and potato bread, with good-value wines and courses from ¥4,400. Smoking allowed; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text calls it an authentic Spanish bar in Gion with over 30 years of history. Tabelog’s invoice number T2130001031665 is registered to 株式会社ＭＩＵＲＡ, at the restaurant’s own address (NTA register); Tabelog also lists a Figueras Karasuma.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 birthday party on a free-flow course had sparkling wine poured from a glass decanter and a dessert made for the occasion.
A June 2026 regular was glad the prices had not crept up like elsewhere.

places.neighborhood: Pontocho, north of Shijo
places.cuisine: Kyoto-style oden and obanzai with seasonal Kyoto ingredients and creative Japanese dishes, about 20 years in Pontocho (Tabelog) · oden of daikon, egg, hirousu, red konnyaku and oboro tofu in a refined dashi (October and December 2025) · conger-eel tempura (December 2025) · simmered sea bream, grilled miso-marinated meat (May 2024) · simmered dishes and a warm sake soup (February 2025) · sake (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kyoto oden · Pontocho, a small counter of about 20 years] A 13-seat counter and tatami room tucked inside a Pontocho building, serving delicate Kyoto oden soaked in a fine dashi — daikon, hirousu, red konnyaku, oboro tofu — alongside obanzai, simmered fish and seasonal plates with sake. Food prices are not listed; ¥800–1,000 appetizer charge. Smoking allowed; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a long-established Japanese restaurant in a corner of Pontocho, about 20 years old, where the chef chooses seasonal Kyoto ingredients for obanzai and creative dishes. Reviews in 2025 describe a proprietress and a head chef.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto oden; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor wandering Pontocho for oden was welcomed by the proprietress and head chef with simmered dishes and a warm sake soup.
A May 2024 group came after the Kamogawa Odori on a friend's recommendation for oden and simmered sea bream.
A December 2023 diner loved the food but found unpriced items hard to judge for value.

places.notes: [Korean · Kawaramachi, samgyeopsal grilled for you] A big, playful basement Korean restaurant — you enter through a fridge door — where staff grill aged, extra-thick pork belly at the table with perilla, kimchi and namul; plus yukhoe, cheese kimbap, honey garlic chicken and all-you-can-eat courses from about ¥3,700. Open from noon at weekends. ¥350 table charge à la carte.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the Kyoto Kawaramachi shop of Kogi Seoul, opened in August 2025, specialising in aged thick-cut samgyeopsal; Tabelog also lists shops in Umeda, Tennoji and Namba.
chef_bio.specialty: Aged thick-cut samgyeopsal.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor needed a photo to work out how to open the fridge-door entrance.
A September 2026 diner warned that the floor is slippery with oil, and noted the big bags provided for belongings.
An August 2026 visitor recommends asking about spice levels: the seasoning runs mild.

places.cuisine: Pizza and drinks in a room of dried flowers and old films (2026 reviews) · signature FULL MOON pizza: Bismarck with prosciutto and plenty of cheese; half-and-half pizzas (Tabelog; February and April 2026) · Caesar salad with prosciutto and soft-boiled egg, potato salad, flap steak, carbonara (February–April 2026) · fresh-fruit drinks and sours; all-you-can-drink (February–June 2026) · ¥6,000 course (June 2026)
places.notes: [Pizza bar · Shijo, dried flowers and old films] A third-floor pizza and drinks bar decorated with dried flowers, with black-and-white films projected on the wall: the signature Bismarck pizza heaped with prosciutto and cheese, half-and-half pizzas, steak and fruit-loaded sours, with good-value all-you-can-drink. No cover charge. Popular for birthdays and dates.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a pizza Italian restaurant opened in February 2024 near Shijo. A February 2026 review describes it as the sister of a restaurant the reviewer had visited before.
chef_bio.specialty: FULL MOON pizza (Bismarck with prosciutto).

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 couple chose it for an anniversary after several visits to the sister restaurant, and found this one brighter.
An April 2026 visitor had read reviews about slow service but found it prompt, and named the FULL MOON pizza the standout.
A June 2026 diner on the ¥6,000 course enjoyed it but found too many dishes featured prosciutto.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・居酒屋・バル、下京区奈良物町361 SAKIZO SEED ビル 3F、地下鉄四条駅12番出口から徒歩2分、月〜金17:00〜23:00、土日祝16:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、定休日は変動、予約可、サービス料・チャージ料金なし、カード・QR 可、52席、2024年2月19日オープン、生ハムとチーズのピザ、ハーフ&ハーフ、果物たっぷりのドリンク。口コミ (2026年2月〜6月、英語): ドライフラワーと白黒の映画、FULL MOON ピザ (生ハムとチーズのビスマルク)、生ハムと半熟卵のシーザーサラダ、ポテトサラダ、ハラミのステーキ、カルボナーラ、飲み放題、6,000円のコース。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead at weekends; call to request counter or table; no cover charge. No English evidence found.

places.name: ANGEL LIBRARY
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: brownies, tiramisu, quiche and cookie gelato (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chocolate desserts with mascarpone, cream and gelato (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Wed–Sun 11:00–17:30; closed Monday and Tuesday; hours may change. No reservations. You order and pay at the register of CACAO MARKET by MarieBelle on the ground floor, receive a PIN code, and let yourself in through a coded door at the back, down to a semi-basement room (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Non-smoking; counter and sofa seats; windows at river level. Cards, e-money and QR (PayPay, December 2025). Opened 10 July 2014 (Tabelog). A July 2026 reviewer waited about 15 minutes at 14:30 on a Sunday.
places.neighborhood: Kawabata-dori by the Kamo River, north of Shijo — 1–3 min walk from Gion-Shijo
places.cuisine: A hidden chocolate café below the CACAO MARKET by MarieBelle shop, styled as a library where angels study chocolate (2020–2026 reviews) · Ice Brownie with a choice of gelato ¥1,430, drink set +¥330 (February 2025); with drink set ¥1,760 (July 2026) · Tiramisu Diary — a book-shaped tiramisu of Hokkaido mascarpone and cream soaked in espresso; Triple Angel Gelato with brownie (July 2025) · 12 gelato flavours, e.g. matcha cookie, raspberry, strawberry millefeuille (2025–2026) · Cacao Market Plate with a drink (May 2025); quiche (March 2025); fondant chocolate (September 2026) · iced chocolate white mocha with pecans (September 2025); chocolate rose tea (February 2025)
places.notes: [Hidden chocolate café · Kamo riverside at Shijo, a coded door to an angels' library] Order at the CACAO MARKET by MarieBelle chocolate shop, get a PIN code, and go down through a secret door to a dim, book-lined room with river-level windows: brownies with gelato, a book-shaped tiramisu and rich chocolate drinks. One June 2026 diner found the taste only average for the price. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 July 2014 (Tabelog) beneath CACAO MARKET by MarieBelle, the Gion shop of the New York chocolatier whose Kyoto main shop is already listed separately. Reviewers describe the ritual of ordering upstairs, getting a code and a seat card named after an angel, and a room with Western books, classical music and the river outside; one says it appears in the manga "Kyoto Teramachi Sanjo no Holmes" (May 2025). Criticism: "a bit pricey" (March 2025), and in June 2026 "the taste was just average" and the cups did not match the theme.
chef_bio.specialty: Ice Brownie; Tiramisu Diary.

anecdotes.text: July 2025: "The setting is that of a hideaway for angels studying to make delicious chocolate."
July 2026: "There are windows in the café, and outside flows a river at almost eye level, creating a strangely enchanting scene."
March 2025: "It can be a bit pricey, but it's a hidden gem where you can find a seat even during busy seasons, as the entrance is somewhat tricky."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ANGEL LIBRARY、カフェ、東山区常盤町165-2 B1F、祇園四条駅から185m、水〜日 11:00〜17:30、月・火休み、営業時間は変わることがある、予約不可、禁煙、カウンター・ソファ席、カード・電子マネー・QR可、サイト cacaomarket.jp、2014年7月10日オープン、入口は暗証番号で開くので CACAO MARKET by MarieBelle で番号を受け取る。口コミ (2020年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 1階で注文と支払いをして番号をもらい地下へ、天使が勉強する図書館という設定、天使の名前の席札、川が目の高さに見える窓、アイスブラウニー1,430円・ドリンクセット330円増し、ドリンクセット付き1,760円、ティラミス、ジェラート12種、プレート、キッシュ、フォンダンショコラ、チョコレートのドリンク、やや高め、味は普通との声 (2026年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the shop upstairs to get the door code.

places.name: 一豊亭 四条店 (Kazutoyo Tei Shijo)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kabayaki eel with a soy-based sauce; ask about shirayaki (plain-grilled) eel (2023–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:15) and 17:00–20:30 (last order 20:15); summer break 16–18 August 2026. Reservations taken; bookings more than 10 minutes late are cancelled. No charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「なし」. 44 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair access; free Wi-Fi. English menu; English-, Chinese- and Korean-speaking staff. Take-away and delivery. Cards, transit IC, e-money and QR (incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay). On Tomikoji just above Shijo, near Nishiki Market. Opened 15 April 2021 (Tabelog). Reviewers up to August 2026 call it Unagi Sora (うなぎ昊); the operator's old domain unagisora.co.jp now redirects to the 一豊亭 site, which lists this 四条店 and a 河原町店.
places.neighborhood: Tomikoji just north of Shijo, by Nishiki Market — 5 min walk from Kawaramachi exit 11
places.cuisine: An eel restaurant offering named farmed-eel brands beside domestic eel (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews) · brands on the menu: Tenku no Unagi, Tosa no Igossou, Chikushi Kin Unagi, and wild Lake Biwa eel ¥12,000 (March 2023; April 2026) — but several reviewers found only Kagoshima eel or two kinds available (2023; November 2025; January, March, May and July 2026) · Tenku unaju ¥6,700 (August 2026); unaju (upper) ¥5,500 (August 2026); served in a two-tier box with sauce on the side · liver soup +¥150 (November 2025) or +¥200 (August 2026); clear soup with yuba; eel chawanmushi; unagi tamago; hitsumabushi; uzaku (2023–2026) · rice blended with the Kyoto rice shop Hachidaime Gihei (April and August 2026)
places.notes: [Unagi · Tomikoji by Nishiki, branded eels in a two-tier box] A calm, wood-panelled eel house a step from Nishiki Market, serving unaju in a two-tier lacquer box with the sauce on the side, and branded eels like Tenku no Unagi when in stock — often only Kagoshima eel is available. Opinion splits: some praise fluffy, fatty eel, others call it pricey and average, aimed at tourists. Open daily, lunch and early dinner.

chef_bio.background: Opened 15 April 2021 (Tabelog) and known to reviewers as Unagi Sora; a June 2026 reviewer had backed its crowdfunding campaign as a new restaurant during the pandemic. Tabelog and the operator's site now give the name 一豊亭 (KAZUTOYOTEI), with a second shop in Kawaramachi. Reviews split: praise for fluffy, fatty eel and good liver soup (2026), against "just an average eel restaurant, benefiting mainly from its good location" (November 2025), a "soggy texture" (January 2026) and a sauce "lacking depth" (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Unaju with branded eel.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "Currently, if you book through Tabelog, there's a drink coupon available… When I mentioned I hadn't used it, they kindly offered me a drink worth ¥550 for free."
June 2026: "After connecting through a crowdfunding campaign for a new restaurant during the COVID-19 pandemic, I finally had the opportunity to visit Unagi Sora for lunch after five years."
May 2026: "The menu listed 5 to 6 types of eel, but only 2 were available…"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 一豊亭 四条店、うなぎ・日本料理、中京区富小路通四条上ル西大文字町602、河原町駅11番出口から徒歩5分、毎日 11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:15)・17:00〜20:30 (L.O. 20:15)、2026年8月16〜18日は夏休み、予約可 (10分遅れで取消)、原文でチャージ「なし」、44席、禁煙、車椅子可、英語メニュー、英語・中国語・韓国語のスタッフ、テイクアウト・デリバリー、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR可、2021年4月15日オープン、法人会員。公式サイト: 一豊亭 (KAZUTOYOTEI) 四条店と河原町店、旧ドメイン unagisora.co.jp から転送。口コミ (2023年3月〜2026年8月、英語): うなぎ昊 (Unagi Sora) として、天空のうなぎなどのブランドうなぎと国産うなぎ、品切れで鹿児島産のみの日が多い、天空うなぎのうな重6,700円、うな重 上5,500円、肝吸い150円・200円、湯葉のお吸い物、う巻き、茶碗蒸し、ひつまぶし、うざく、ご飯は Hachidaime Gihei と共同開発、たれは別添え、評価は分かれる (ふっくら、値段が高い、普通、べちゃっとした食感)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; English, Chinese and Korean-speaking staff.

places.name: とり処 山本 (Tori Dokoro Yamamoto)
places.gf_detail: Ask: salted yakitori and chicken sashimi may suit, but tsukune, fried gizzards and soy dips may not; one-man counter, so ask when booking (2016–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken sashimi and yakitori (2016–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:00–23:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change. Reservations taken — book by 20:00 (Tabelog). Reviewers say it closes early in the evening (March 2024) and that the chef "tends to get sleepy around 8 PM" (July 2026), so book and go early. About 5–6 counter seats. Smoking allowed. Cash only (no cards, no e-money). On the west side of Tomikoji below Ayanokoji. No rice dishes; the owner said bringing your own food is fine (March 2024). Raw chicken (sashimi) is served.
places.neighborhood: Tomikoji below Ayanokoji — 5 min walk from Shijo / Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: A tiny counter run by one man for chicken sashimi and yakitori (2016–2026 reviews) · chicken sashimi — breast, heart, neck as yukhoe, rare liver when in stock; a three-kind sashimi platter (2016–2026) · yakitori: neck, negima, wings, tsukune, gizzard (March 2025) · omakase ¥2,000 plus appetizer (March 2025); a recommended course ¥2,500 (March 2024) · two skewers about ¥700, fried gizzards about ¥550, three drinks about ¥1,500 (September 2022); bottled beer ¥500 (March 2025) · no rice dishes; hotpot for regulars on request (March 2024)
places.notes: [Chicken sashimi & yakitori · Tomikoji at Ayanokoji, a one-man counter] A handful of counter seats where one veteran owner serves very fresh chicken sashimi and generous yakitori, with omakase from about ¥2,000. No rice — he lets you bring your own. Book ahead and go early: reviewers say the evening winds down around 8 PM. Cash only; smoking allowed. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers since 2016 say the owner runs the shop alone ("It seems the owner runs the place all by himself", October 2016). In March 2024 a reviewer wrote that he "appears young, but he has been working in Gion and has now been at this shop for around 25 years"; a July 2026 reviewer describes "the chef, who is over 80 years old", running it by himself. Reviewers praise a gentle, friendly host and chat at the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken sashimi.

anecdotes.text: March 2024: "I learned that they don't serve rice dishes, so I asked the owner, and to my surprise, he said bringing in food is allowed!"
July 2026: "Just keep in mind that the chef tends to get sleepy around 8 PM, so plan accordingly."
October 2016: "Since I arrived early, he kindly let me use one seat for my bags, which ended up occupying half the space."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: とり処 山本、鶏料理・焼き鳥、中京区富小路通綾小路下ル西側、月・火・木〜日 17:00〜23:00、水曜休み、時間は変わることがある、予約可 (20時まで)、6席、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー不可。口コミ (2016年10月〜2026年7月、英語): 店主がひとりで営む小さなカウンター、鶏刺し (むね、ハツ、首のユッケ風、レバー)、刺身3種盛り、焼き鳥 (首、ねぎま、手羽、つくね、砂肝)、おまかせ2,000円とお通し、おすすめコース2,500円、串2本約700円、砂肝の唐揚げ約550円、瓶ビール500円、ご飯ものはなく持ち込み可、祇園で働いたのち約25年この店に (2024年3月)、80歳を超える店主 (2026年7月)、夜8時ごろには眠くなる (2026年7月)、予約して早めに。

cultural_comfort.note: One-man counter; cash only; smoking allowed; book ahead.

places.name: 京旬 いちえ (Kyoshun Ichie)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, horse-mackerel fry, karaage and saikyo-miso fish on the menu; dashi-based dishes may still be possible — ask (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: everything builds on a bonito-and-Rishiri-kombu dashi (official site).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00; closed Sunday and holidays; dinner only for now; same-day bookings until 22:00. The official site gives dinner 18:00–25:00, closed Sunday. Appetizer ¥1,000 a person and one drink each — Tabelog, Japanese original 「お通し お一人様1000円、ワンドリンクオーダー制」. Seat-only bookings may be asked to choose about three à la carte dishes in advance. 16 seats: counter, tables and a private room (up to 10). Non-smoking. English, Chinese and Korean menus; English-speaking staff; children welcome. Cards, transit IC, e-money and QR. 2nd floor of UEDA BLD. II on Yamatooji above Shijo. Opened here 25 April 2026 (Tabelog) after a move; a July 2026 regular had come "since before the relocation".
places.neighborhood: Yamatooji just north of Shijo, Gion — 1 min walk from Gion-Shijo exit 7
places.cuisine: A Gion kappo of Kyoto seasonal food and charcoal grilling, à la carte or by course (official site; Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · ¥11,000 course of nine parts — otoshi, sashimi, a warm dish, grilled fish, a fried dish, Kujo leek and mushroom ohitashi, charcoal-grilled meat, rice and dessert; book two days ahead (official menu) · sashimi: bluefin nakaochi and wild hirame ¥1,600; wild hiramasa and octopus ¥1,400; mixed platter from ¥1,800 (official menu) · charcoal-grilled A4-plus Kuroge Wagyu sirloin ¥4,800, ichibo ¥3,800; tuna cheek ¥1,800; saikyo-miso Spanish mackerel ¥1,300 (official menu) · wakatake-ni with Kyoto bamboo shoots ¥2,000; dashimaki ¥900–1,100; horse-mackerel fry with house Kyoto-pickle tartar ¥1,600; shrimp and seasonal vegetable tempura ¥2,000 (official menu) · fried shrimp with a pickle tartar, a favourite of one regular (July 2026) · Tango Koshihikari rice; hamo yakishimo in summer, kabura-mushi in winter (official site) · fig spring rolls and steak (October 2026)
places.notes: [Kappo · Gion above Shijo, charcoal and Kyoto seasons] A 16-seat second-floor kappo, newly moved, pairing Kyoto vegetables and a golden kombu-bonito dashi with charcoal-grilled Wagyu and fish, à la carte or as an ¥11,000 course. A long-time regular singles out the fried shrimp with pickle tartar. ¥1,000 appetizer charge plus one drink each. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reopened at this address on 25 April 2026 (Tabelog) after a relocation; the previous location is not given. The official site says the owner makes a clear golden dashi from bonito and Rishiri kombu every day, buys only A4-plus Kuroge Wagyu, uses Sea of Japan fish for sashimi and Nagasaki fish for grilling, takes Kyoto vegetables from a long-standing greengrocer, and chose Tango Koshihikari rice after tasting many kinds. A July 2026 diner praised "the hospitality from the owner and his wife".
chef_bio.philosophy: Daily dashi as the base of everything (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled Wagyu; seasonal Kyoto dishes.

anecdotes.text: July 2026, a regular: "A standout dish is the fried shrimp, which leaves a lasting impression. The accompanying tartar sauce is infused with pickles, providing a unique flavor and texture that can only be found here."
July 2026: "I dined alone at the counter. The hospitality from the owner and his wife was very warm and attentive."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京旬いちえ、東山区大和大路通四条上る富永町144 UEDA BLD. II 2階、ディナー 18:00〜25:00 (当面の間、ディナー営業のみ)、日曜休み、良質な鰹と利尻昆布の黄金色の出汁、A4ランク以上の国産黒毛和牛、造りは日本海、焼きもの・出汁ものは九州長崎産、京野菜、丹後の特A米「コシヒカリ」、11,000円コース (二日前までに予約)、本マグロ中落ち1,600円、天然平目1,600円、黒毛和牛炭焼きサーロイン4,800円、イチボ3,800円、若竹煮2,000円、アジフライ 自家製京つけものタルタル1,600円、店主お任せ エビと季節野菜の天盛り2,000円、鱧の焼霜、かぶら蒸し。食べログ: 京旬 いちえ、日本料理・居酒屋・創作料理、月〜土 18:00〜23:00、日祝休み、原文で「お通し お一人様1000円、ワンドリンクオーダー制」、16席、個室 (10名まで)、禁煙、多言語メニュー、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR可、2026年4月25日オープン、法人会員。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 店主と奥さんの温かいもてなし、移転前からの常連、漬物入りのタルタルのフライ、いちじくの春巻き、ステーキ、親しみやすいスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus; English-speaking staff.

places.name: 炭火やきとり 恒 (Sumibi Yakitori Ko)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled skewers, some with a fairly strong seasoning; salt can be requested; no gluten information (2022–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori shop with few side dishes (2022–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:30–24:00, last order 23:30; irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and often needed (Tabelog; November 2023). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 23 seats: a counter and tatami seating, shoes off at the entrance; smoking allowed (Tabelog; January 2024). On Fuyacho south of Ayanokoji, marked by lanterns; 8 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; May 2025). Opened 10 March 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Fuyacho south of Ayanokoji — 8 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori grilled by the owner over Kishu binchotan, of Ohyama jidori and Kyoto red jidori, ordered by the skewer (2022–2026 reviews) · basic skewers from ¥220, chicken skin ¥150 (December 2022); white liver; neck; rare cuts such as kokorokori and seikan; chicken tataki; original creations (2022–2025 reviews) · a wide drink list, e.g. a pomegranate highball (November 2023) · about ¥3,000–5,000 (Tabelog; 2022–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Fuyacho south of Ayanokoji] A small lantern-lit yakitori shop where the owner grills Oyama and Kyoto red jidori over Kishu binchotan: creamy white liver, neck, rare cuts like kokorokori, and tataki, by the single skewer from about ¥220. Shoes off for the tatami. Seasoning runs strong — ask for salt; one 2026 couple found it pricey, another few snacks beyond skewers. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakitori and izakaya opened 10 March 2012 on Fuyacho. Reviewers in 2022–2026 describe the owner grilling over Kishu binchotan, Ohyama jidori and Kyoto red jidori, and an active, skilled staff.
chef_bio.specialty: White liver; kokorokori.

anecdotes.text: A December 2022 regular found the chicken liver as white as foie gras, and noted prices had risen with ingredient costs — skewers from ¥220.
A February 2026 couple found the seasoning strong with no preference asked, and the partner thought it a bit pricey.
A May 2026 first-timer enjoyed the charcoal aroma but found few snacks beyond the skewers.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼鳥・居酒屋、下京区麩屋町通綾小路下ル俵屋町297-1、阪急河原町駅から徒歩8分、毎日 17:30〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、不定休、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、23席、喫煙可、2012年3月10日開店。口コミ (2022年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 提灯が目印、靴を脱いで座敷とカウンター、店主が紀州備長炭で焼く、Ohyama jidori と Kyoto Akajidori、1本から注文、串は220円から・皮は150円 (2022年12月)、白レバー、せせり、kokorokori、seikan、鶏のたたき、創作の串、ざくろのハイボール、味が濃いめで好みを聞かれないとの声・やや高いとの声 (2026年2月)、串以外のつまみが少ないとの声 (2026年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off for the tatami; order by the skewer; smoking allowed; cards.

places.name: 焼肉飛鳥 (Yakiniku Asuka)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: yakiniku with sauces, wagyu rice bowls, kimchi (2024–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant (2024–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Sunday and holidays 14:00–22:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). In 2024 it opened at 11:30 for lunch (April 2024). Reservations accepted; call if more than 10 minutes late or the booking may be cancelled (Tabelog). A 100-minute limit with last order at 70 minutes (December 2024). No service or seat charge (Tabelog original サービス料・席料はありません。). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 22 seats: a 10-seat counter on the 1F, tables upstairs (Tabelog; 2024 reviews). Next to Nishiki Market; 3 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 15 September 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Beside Nishiki Market — 3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Wagyu yakiniku at a registered Kobe beef shop (No. 2041), grilling Kobe beef and A5 wagyu from female cattle yourself, also as steak and sukiyaki (Tabelog) · today's assorted platter, premium salted tongue, harami, kimchi platter with yam kimchi; special rice (2024–2025 reviews) · lunch, when offered: wagyu rice trio ¥1,800, A5 black wagyu bowl with egg (April–August 2024) · about ¥6,000–10,000 at dinner (Tabelog; 2024 reviews)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · beside Nishiki Market, Kobe beef] A small Kobe-beef-registered yakiniku by Nishiki Market: grill A5 and Kobe wagyu yourself at the counter, from tongue to harami. Several reviewers note many overseas guests. Criticisms: a 100-minute limit with slow service, cuts not explained, lukewarm beer, and one cold reception in March 2025. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and its website: a wagyu yakiniku opened 15 September 2023 beside Nishiki Market, a registered Kobe beef establishment (No. 2041) using carefully selected female A5 wagyu, for yakiniku, steak and sukiyaki.
chef_bio.philosophy: Kobe beef and female A5 wagyu (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kobe beef yakiniku.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 pair spent about ¥30,000 and found the meat top-notch, but the 100-minute limit with slow service left too little time.
A March 2025 guest with an overseas companion was handed only the yakiniku menu, got the lunch menu reluctantly, and called the service exceptionally poor.
Several reviewers note many overseas guests (April 2024–March 2025).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・ホルモン・肉バル、中京区梅屋町500-1、京都河原町駅から徒歩3分、錦市場のすぐそば、月・火・木〜日・祝 14:00〜22:00、水曜休み、予約可 (10分以上遅れる場合は電話を)、サービス料・席料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、22席 (カウンター10、テーブル)、2023年9月15日開店、神戸ビーフ指定登録店 (No.2041)、厳選した雌のA5和牛、焼肉・ステーキ・すき焼き。口コミ (2024年4月〜2025年3月、英語): 2024年は11時半から昼営業、和牛の三色丼1,800円、A5黒毛和牛の丼、本日の盛り合わせ、上塩タン、ハラミ、山芋キムチのキムチ盛り合わせ、2階はテーブル、100分制でL.O.70分、外国人客が多いとの声が複数、部位の説明がない・ビールがぬるかったとの声 (2024年10月)、接客がひどかったとの声 (2025年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests (several reviews); 100-minute limit; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: 傘 (Kasa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Shochu and other drinks with small dishes — pickles, braised pork, oden, chijimi, dashimaki, gyoza; no gluten information (2022–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. ¥100 small dishes include pickled shallots and potato salad, but no ingredient information (2023–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–2:00; closed Sunday, though open on some Sundays; closed for the first three days of the New Year and staff trips (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash on delivery — put money in the bowl and staff take from it as you order; no cards or e-money, QR accepted (Tabelog; September 2026). Standing bar; smoking allowed (Tabelog). 1F of the Kiyamachi Kaikan, Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Sanjo; 10 min walk from Sanjo, Gion-Shijo and Kawaramachi Stns (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Sanjo — Kiyamachi Kaikan 1F
places.cuisine: Casual standing bar centred on shochu, ¥400–800 a glass, with staff happy to explain (December 2025) · small dishes from ¥100 off a tray, e.g. pickled shallots, potato salad; braised pork belly ¥500; oden, chijimi, dashimaki, gyoza; toro-taku, shime-saba, jaga-butter (2022–2025 reviews) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Standing bar · Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, shochu] A lively cash-on standing bar in the Kiyamachi Kaikan: drop money in the bowl, pick a shochu from a long list (staff will guide you), and graze ¥100 small dishes or braised pork. Good for one last drink. One December 2024 visitor found the ¥100 dishes little better than supermarket fare. Smoking allowed; closed most Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a standing bar in the Kiyamachi Kaikan, open late, closed for the New Year and company trips. Reviewers in 2022–2025 describe a friendly owner, a shochu-focused list and a cash-on system; a December 2022 reviewer mentions a sit-down sister bar next door.
chef_bio.specialty: Shochu; ¥100 small dishes.

anecdotes.text: A December 2022 visitor was surprised to find Murao shochu at a standing bar, alongside toro-taku, a dish more often seen in Kanto.
A December 2024 New Year's Eve visitor found the ¥100 dishes much like convenience-store items, though the dashimaki was good.
A November 2025 visitor back after about ten years was relieved to find the interior hardly changed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 立ち飲み、中京区西木屋町通三条下ル南車屋町287 木屋町会館 1F、京阪三条駅・祇園四条駅・阪急河原町駅から徒歩10分、月〜土 18:00〜翌2:00、日曜休み (開ける日もある)、正月三が日と社員旅行は休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、喫煙可。口コミ (2022年12月〜2025年12月、英語): キャッシュオン (器にお金を入れて注文ごとに引いてもらう)、焼酎が中心で400〜800円、店員が説明してくれる、100円の小皿 (らっきょう、ポテトサラダなど)、豚の角煮500円、おでん、チヂミ、だし巻き、餃子、とろたく、しめ鯖、じゃがバター、Murao、隣に姉妹店、気さくな店主、100円の小皿はスーパーの惣菜のようとの声 (2024年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing; cash-on bowl system or QR; smoking allowed.
