places.name: イザカヤ ルツボ (Izakaya Rutubo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Smoked dishes, tempura and fritters, gnocchi, beef-tendon noodles; smoked soy and miso sauces; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Smoked olives, nuts and edamame and stir-fried greens appear, but smoked soy sauce, egg and fish are common; no ingredient information (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–24:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Day drinking from noon, with a senbero (cheap drinks and snacks) option (February and July 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter, standing room and barrel seats; smoking allowed inside after 21:00 (Tabelog; August 2026). A Showa-retro shop in a back street off Shijo east of the Kamo River, near Miyagawacho; 3 min walk from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn exit 1 (Tabelog; June 2026).
places.neighborhood: Off Shijo east of the Kamo, near Miyagawacho — 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Dining bar of smoked dishes and Japanese-Western small plates, part of a small group with a Shijo-Omiya sister (2026 reviews) · assorted smoked plate ¥1,500 (cheese, nuts, gizzard, edamame, octopus, quail egg); smoked roast beef, bacon, egg, olives, mentaiko and gizzard (2026 reviews) · homemade fries ¥700, ufu-mayo potato salad ¥800 (April 2026); salsiccia with white ragù and gnocchi; fried figs or persimmon with white sesame; conger and sea bream tempura with smoked salt; bonito katsu; beef-tendon noodles with tomato and sansho (2026 reviews) · highballs, wine, sake, shochu (2026 reviews) · about ¥3,000–6,000 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Smoked-food bar · off Shijo near Miyagawacho, from noon] A small, Showa-retro dining bar where nearly everything meets the smoker — cheese, gizzards, roast beef, potato salad — alongside inventive plates like bonito katsu, fig fritters and beef-tendon noodles, with highballs and wine from noon. Barrel stools are snug. One September 2026 diner found the bacon tough and the persimmon bland. Smoking after 21:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a dining bar run by RUTUBO (website rutubo-kyoto.com, Instagram rutubo_inc) near Gion-Shijo; our crawls also list ルツボ and RUTUBO 第2燻製工場, and an October 2026 reviewer mentions a Shijo-Omiya sister. Reviewers in 2026 describe homemade smoked dishes and condiments and friendly staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: Smoked dishes made in-house (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Assorted smoked plate; smoked roast beef.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular loves it despite the slightly uncomfortable barrel seats, for fried figs with white sesame and smoked-salt tempura.
An August 2026 diner was most surprised by beef-tendon noodles with tomato, sansho and garlic, mixed at the table.
A September 2026 visitor loved the smoked egg but found the smoked bacon tough and the fried persimmon bland.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー、東山区亀井町54-1 ウィッシュ河原町 1F、京阪祇園四条駅1番出口から徒歩3分、毎日 12:00〜24:00、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター・立ち飲み、21時以降は店内喫煙可、公式サイト rutubo-kyoto.com。口コミ (2026年2月〜11月、英語): 宮川町の近く、昭和レトロ、樽の椅子、昼から飲める、せんべろあり、燻製の盛り合わせ1,500円 (チーズ、ナッツ、砂肝、枝豆、たこ、うずら卵)、燻製のローストビーフ・ベーコン・卵・オリーブ・明太子、自家製フライドポテト700円、ウフマヨのポテトサラダ800円、白いラグーのサルシッチャとニョッキ、いちじくや柿のフライの白ごまソース、魚の天ぷら (燻製塩)、かつおのカツ、トマトと山椒の牛すじ麺、四条大宮に姉妹店との声、ベーコンが硬い・柿のフライが味気ないとの声 (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and barrel stools; smoking after 21:00; cards.

places.name: 京都芋屋 芋と野菜 四条河原町店 (Kyoto Imoya Imo to Yasai)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Baked sweet potatoes are naturally wheat-free, but the sandwiches, crepes and baked sweet-potato pastries contain or may contain wheat (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain baked sweet potatoes, but the "super rich" sweet potato uses butter and egg yolk, and sandwiches use cream (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 13:00–21:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Takeaway; no bookings (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Wrap the baked sweet potatoes in a plastic bag — the syrup can leak (November 2026 review). About 4 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shijo-Kawaramachi, north of Shijo — 4 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Sweet-potato sweets from a Kyoto farming and confectionery company (press release; 2025–26 reviews): baked sweet potatoes (Akane, Kanmitsu), the "super rich" sweet potato of baked potato mixed with butter and egg yolk ¥962 (December 2025), salt-butter sweet potato, sweet-potato sandwiches of Benihonoka or Satsuma potato with cream just under ¥600 (September 2026), sweet-potato crepe, sweet-potato chips; a sweet-potato soft serve ¥500 at the Nishiki Market counter (May 2026)
places.notes: [Sweet potato · Shijo-Kawaramachi] A takeaway sweet-potato shop by a Kyoto farm-and-confectionery company: syrupy baked sweet potatoes, a buttery "super rich" sweet potato (¥962), cream-filled sweet-potato sandwiches and crepes. Mostly ¥500–1,000. Open daily 13:00–21:00.

roles: 株式会社CRAFTMAN (no person named in reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 15 July 2022 (Tabelog; press release). Run by 株式会社CRAFTMAN, a Kyoto company in farming, confectionery and restaurants, founded June 2022, which sells its factory-made baked sweet potatoes and sweet-potato pastries mainly at department-store and station events (press release; job listing).
chef_bio.specialty: Super rich sweet potato; baked sweet potatoes.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 passer-by bought the ¥962 super rich sweet potato and was told to warm it in a microwave.
A December 2025 customer compared the Akane and Kanmitsu baked sweet potatoes and preferred Akane.
In November 2026 a buyer of the ultra-dense baked sweet potato found the syrup leaked through the waxed bag on a long trip.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都芋屋 芋と野菜 四条河原町店、スイーツ、中京区東側町511-2、京都河原町駅から261m、毎日 13:00〜21:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、2022年7月15日オープン。プレスリリース: 京都で農業・菓子製造・飲食店運営の株式会社CRAFTMAN。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年11月、英語): 焼き芋 (Akane、Kanmitsu)、焼き芋にバターと卵黄を混ぜた超極蜜スイートポテト962円、塩バタースイートポテト、Benihonoka やさつまいもと生クリームの芋サンド600円弱、芋のクレープ、芋チップス、錦市場の Imoya Soft 500円、蜜が漏れるので袋に。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway counter.

places.name: のとよ (Notoyo)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: eel and sparrow are glazed with a soy-based tare (reviews; Nishiki Market site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a river-fish shop — eel, ayu, carp and grilled sparrow (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–18:00; irregular closures (Nishiki Market site; Tabelog). No bookings (Tabelog). Cards: AMEX only; e-money accepted (Tabelog). A takeaway stall in the market: no eating while walking — eat standing at the shop, or take it away (May 2026 and September 2025 reviews). Tabelog lists 25 seats, but a September 2025 visitor found no eat-in here and was pointed to a nearby sister restaurant for that. In Nishiki Market west of Gokomachi, about 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishiki Market — 5 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: River fish from one of only three river-fish specialists in Nishiki Market (Nishiki Market site): eel kabayaki grilled over binchotan with a secret tare, the signature; grilled eel liver; salt-grilled ayu (roe-filled in season) from a live tank; small boiled ayu from Lake Biwa; carp simmered with roe and carp sashimi; grilled sparrow in a sweet-spicy glaze (2021–26 reviews); it also prepares fish for kaiseki restaurants (Nishiki Market site)
places.notes: [River fish · Nishiki Market] One of the market's last river-fish specialists, grilling eel over binchotan with a secret tare, salt-grilled ayu from a live tank, carp with roe and even sparrow on skewers. Buy and eat at the stall or take away. About ¥1,000–2,000. Open 9:00–18:00.

roles: Family members at the grill and counter (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: A river-fish shop that also supplies kaiseki restaurants (Nishiki Market site); a September 2025 visitor read it as established in 1912. In September 2023 an older man was grilling the ayu while an older woman recommended them.
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan eel kabayaki; salt-grilled ayu.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 visitor bought boiled Lake Biwa ayu, salt-grilled ayu and grilled sparrow and took them, with a beer, to the Kamo River near Sanjo.
On a May 2026 date, a couple tried the sweet-spicy grilled sparrow, eaten standing at the shop since eating while walking is not allowed.
A May 2026 first-timer called the binchotan eel too aromatic to describe.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 錦市場の公式サイト: のとよ、京都市内でも少なく錦市場でも3軒しかない川魚の専門店、備長炭で焼き秘伝のタレのうなぎの蒲焼が看板、懐石料理店への「奥の商売」、9:00〜18:00、不定休。食べログ: 中京区錦小路通御幸町西入鍛治屋町216-2、阪急河原町駅から徒歩約5分、毎日 9:00〜18:00、予約不可、カードは AMEX のみ、電子マネー可、25席、禁煙。口コミ (2019年〜2026年5月、英語): 1912年創業と読める、鰻の肝焼き、生け簀の鮎の塩焼き (子持ち)、Lake Biwa の小鮎の煮物、子持ちの鯉の煮物と鯉の刺身、すずめの焼き物、食べ歩き禁止で店先で食べる、ここでは食事できず近くの系列店へという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Market stall; point and buy.

places.name: 肉居酒屋 大 (Niku Izakaya Dai)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: marinated yakiniku, yukgaejang soup and seasoned meat dishes (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat izakaya (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–2:00 (food last order 1:00, drinks 1:30); Sun 17:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00); closing days may vary (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「なし」 (none). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 11 seats — a counter of 7 and one table; smoking allowed; sports on screen; free Wi-Fi; coin parking next door (Tabelog). The yakiniku is grilled by staff and brought to you (January and April 2026 reviews). In a narrow alley off Kiyamachi, 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 1 (Tabelog; April 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi alley, north of Shijo — 5 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Meat izakaya with yakiniku grilled for you (2025–26 reviews): thick-cut tongue, beef tataki, meat sashimi, chicken neck, yakiniku of the day (chicken and lamb when supplied), yukgaejang soup to finish; assorted pickles and potato salad; shochu and wine, all-you-can-drink plans (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Meat izakaya · Kiyamachi alley] An 11-seat meat izakaya in a Kiyamachi alley, opened in 2025 by the owner of the previous shop here: thick tongue, beef tataki and meat sashimi, yakiniku grilled by the staff, and yukgaejang to finish. About ¥4,000–5,000. Open till 2:00; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 October 2025 (Tabelog). A November 2025 regular says the owner previously ran a restaurant at the same spot and reopened independently; an October 2026 regular marked its anniversary.
chef_bio.specialty: Thick-cut tongue; meat sashimi.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular of the previous restaurant came back for the thick-cut tongue and beef tataki.
A January 2026 diner was glad to have the meat grilled by a professional, though chicken and lamb were off for supply reasons, and reordered the pickles.
An October 2026 regular celebrated the shop's anniversary over meat dishes.

places.notes: [Kyoto izakaya · off Shijo-Kawaramachi] A calm, non-smoking izakaya with homemade tofu, white-miso oden, dashimaki tempura, sweet kakuni and seasonal hamo, plus plenty of sake and a ¥7,000 course. About ¥4,000–8,000. Lunch too; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 August 2020 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade tofu; white-miso oden.

anecdotes.text: A diner returning in March 2026 after two years found the ¥7,000 fish-centred course filling.
A September 2026 business traveller liked the hamo so much it was ordered twice, and noted prices were not inflated for tourists.
An October 2026 first-timer found the homemade tofu opener so creamy it needed no salt.

In the Kintetsu Meitengai "Miyakomichi" mall at Kyoto Station’s Hachijo side, 1 min from Kintetsu Kyoto Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kyoto Station, Hachijo side — Miyakomichi mall
places.cuisine: Italian bar-trattoria: wine and seasonal tapas at night, pizza and pasta at lunch (Tabelog) · signature overflowing "kobore" sparkling wine (Tabelog; June 2026) · pizza with Caputo flour, e.g. Margherita, Bismarck; fresh pasta — salmon genovese, ragù bianco, basil, prawn pescatore; gnocchi gratin; warm oil sardines; baby octopus; green salad (2025–2026) · pasta or pizza lunch with salad and bread (2025–2026) · standard dinner course of six dishes with domestic beef steak ¥4,500 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Italian · Kyoto Station Miyakomichi, pizza, pasta and overflowing sparkling] A wood-toned Italian bar-trattoria in the mall on the Hachijo side of Kyoto Station: lunch sets of fresh pasta or crisp pizza with salad and bread, and at night tapas — warm house sardines, baby octopus — with glasses of sparkling poured to overflowing. A six-dish course with steak is ¥4,500. Child-friendly; open daily 11:00–22:00.

roles: Operated by 株式会社オートアンドハウス (invoice register); chefs not named
chef_bio.background: The qualified-invoice holder is 株式会社オートアンドハウス of Sakyo, Kyoto (NTA); a job listing describes it as running the Italian restaurant alongside car sales and property businesses (careermap.jp). Our crawl also lists a セレーノ. Tabelog’s introduction: a bar-style evening with wine and the signature "kobore sparkling", seasonal tapas, hot pizzas and pasta to finish, and good-value lunches.
chef_bio.specialty: Pizza and fresh pasta; "kobore" sparkling wine.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 sightseer stopped at 5 p.m. for a beer and antipasti — warm, freshly cooked sardines — and stayed for dinner.
An August 2025 parent was glad to find a child-friendly lunch at Kyoto Station.
A repeat visitor (April 2026) stops in every time on the way back from Kyoto.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and fish omakase (Tabelog).

Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 10 seats at a U-shaped counter upstairs; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; March 2025). Up the stairs on the 2nd floor, 7 min walk from the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station (Tabelog; May 2025).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Kujo, south of Kyoto Station Hachijo exit — 7 min walk
places.cuisine: Sushi and dishes by a kaiseki-trained chef, an omakase course (Tabelog) · seasonal appetisers with fine knife work — e.g. sanma and matsutake in autumn (August 2025) · Edomae-style nigiri with soy sauce served on the side (March 2025) · sashimi, tempura and grilled fish within the course (Tabelog) · an ¥8,000 course (March 2025); typical spend ¥10,000–15,000 (2025 reviews) · sake chosen to taste (March 2025)
places.notes: [Sushi · Kyoto Station Hachijo side, kaiseki-trained omakase] A bright ten-seat U-shaped counter upstairs a short walk south of Kyoto Station, where a kaiseki-trained chef paces sushi and seasonal small dishes to your drinking — beautiful appetisers, Edomae nigiri, sake chosen to taste. Omakase only, about ¥8,000–15,000. Open till midnight; closed Wednesday. Moved here from Shijo-Karasuma in 2024.

roles: Chef not named; trained in kaiseki (Tabelog); operator 有限会社らくちん per the website Tabelog lists
chef_bio.background: Opened here 22 July 2024 after moving from Shijo-Karasuma (Tabelog). Tabelog lists frenchman-rakuchin.jp, the site of 有限会社らくちん, a Kyoto group of 11 shops (8 direct, 3 franchised) that also runs 仏男 and 食道 萬きち (in the same building). Tabelog’s introduction: a counter-only hideaway where the chef makes sushi before you, with sashimi, tempura and grilled fish across rich courses.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase of sushi and seasonal dishes.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 regular from the Shijo-Karasuma days found the craft unchanged after the move.
A February 2026 diner arriving at 21:30 after work was still warmly welcomed.
A May 2025 guest booked for 17:00 climbed a pitch-dark staircase as the staff were still getting ready.

places.neighborhood: Tanaka, near Kyoto University — 8 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn

places.notes: [Sri Lankan · near Kyoto University, rice-and-curry plates] A small, bright Sri Lankan kitchen tucked into a residential lane by Kyoto University: fragrant rice ringed with about five spiced vegetable sides and your curry — chicken, mutton, mackerel, seasonal firefly squid — to mix as you go, about ¥1,200–1,550. Lighter than Indian curry. Open Tuesday–Friday only; no cards.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 November 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2023–2026) describe authentic Sri Lankan curry suited to Japanese tastes, served with several vegetable sides, near the YMCA dormitory off the Kyoto University campus.
chef_bio.specialty: Rice and curry with vegetable sides.

anecdotes.text: A January 2024 diner tried the mackerel curry with a cutlet and found the portion generous.
A March 2025 visitor paired a seasonal firefly-squid curry with chicken curry.
A July 2026 first-timer regretted not coming sooner — the vegetable sides were as good as the curry.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu offal, pork and chicken teppan dishes (reviews).

places.notes: [Teppan · Nishijin, horumon yaki udon by a former French chef] A calm, polished teppan counter in Nishijin run by a couple, the husband once a French-restaurant chef: wagyu offal and udon stir-fried before you and dipped tsukemen-style in a special sauce (about ¥1,500–1,700), plus fluffy teppan dashimaki and wagyu. Dinner only, till midnight; closed Monday and Tuesday.

roles: Run by a couple; the chef formerly cooked French (June 2024 review); not named
chef_bio.background: Opened 12 December 2013 (Tabelog), which bills it as the first place in Kyoto for horumon yakisoba with a special dipping sauce. Reviewers (2024) describe a teppan-yaki restaurant run by a friendly couple, the chef formerly at a French restaurant.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu horumon yaki udon, tsukemen style.

anecdotes.text: A June 2024 regular praised the casual but refined plates from the former French chef.
A September 2024 walk-in at 18:00 found every table full.
A September 2026 first-timer, sent by another restaurant, heard the yaki udon inherited the taste of a well-known shop.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Matcha drinks can be ordered unsweetened (May 2026); lattes, cream and soft serve contain dairy (2025–26 reviews).

PayPay (Tabelog). 26 seats upstairs, with counter seating; take-away downstairs (Tabelog; November 2025; May 2026). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). On Rokkaku near Teramachi, 4 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog). Opened 5 March 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Rokkaku, near Teramachi and Nishiki Market — Kyoto-Kawaramachi

places.notes: [Matcha café · Rokkaku near Nishiki, open into the evening] A two-floor matcha stand and café a few minutes from Nishiki Market, serving stone-milled matcha as a foamy espuma latte, fluffy matcha kakigori, soft serve with shiratama and red bean, and Mont Blanc ice cream — sweet or unsweetened, to take away or upstairs. Open until 21:00 daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a matcha café and soft-serve shop opened in March 2024, with a second shop at Fuji-Q Highland. A March 2026 review describes it as a new concept from a Kyoto matcha shop known for espuma kakigori.
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha espuma; matcha kakigori.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular of the parent shop's kakigori found its matcha espuma reborn in a ¥800 foam latte.

chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu yaki-shabu; thick-cut tongue.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular came in on a third stop of the night for heart and makgeolli.
An October 2026 trio chose it for the private rooms, to talk in peace.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: sukiyaki warishita, shabu-shabu dipping sauces and udon in the sets; Tabelog notes allergy information is available — ask (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Wagyu sukiyaki and shabu-shabu sets with raw egg (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00). Reservations taken; 120-minute limit; same-day cancellations or changes may incur a fee; more than 10 minutes late may be treated as a cancellation. 21 counter seats; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi. Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; English-speaking staff; children welcome. Cards, e-money and QR. Opened 1 September 2025 (Tabelog). One of four 富之上 shops (official site: 祇園本店, 三条河原町店, 祇園八坂店, 匠 祇園四条店).
places.neighborhood: Kawabata at Shijo, east bank of the Kamo — 4 min walk from Gion-Shijo exit 7
places.cuisine: A counter-only Wagyu sukiyaki and shabu-shabu house where staff slice the meat from the block in front of you (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · sets from ¥3,300 (September 2025); Kuroge Wagyu chuck eye roll 140 g, sukiyaki or shabu-shabu ¥4,400 (September 2025; February 2026); Kobe beef chuck eye roll 140 g ¥6,600 (September 2026) · sets come with vegetables, grilled tofu, rice and egg; extra domestic beef 100 g ¥1,600 (September 2026) · one pot per person; free rice refills, a second egg for sukiyaki, udon to finish (2025–2026) · rice cooked in a pot (September 2025); a free printed photo (2025–2026)
places.notes: [Wagyu sukiyaki & shabu-shabu · Kamo riverbank at Shijo, meat carved at the counter] A modern 21-seat counter where staff carve Wagyu off the block in front of you for one-person sukiyaki or shabu-shabu pots, from about ¥3,300 to ¥6,600 for Kobe beef, with free rice refills. Reviewers call it good value; some find it tourist-oriented and average. Open daily 11:00–23:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 September 2025 (Tabelog) as the first of four 富之上 shops; the group opened its second shop in December 2025 and its third in April 2026 (official site). Reviewers praise the theatre of slicing at the counter, cheerful staff and the price; criticism covers early operations that "were still a bit lacking" (September 2025), "a very average impression" (March 2026), meat "a bit too fatty" and an inbound-tourist feel (May 2026), and in September 2026 a group "Yoi Sho!" call at the carving, staff who struggled to follow requests, and dry rice.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu sukiyaki and shabu-shabu sets.

anecdotes.text: February 2026: "I had actually made a reservation at another location, but I mistakenly came to this restaurant. They kindly contacted the other branch and changed my reservation for me."
September 2026: "During the performance of cutting the meat, the whole restaurant was encouraged to say 'Yoi Sho!' together, but I wondered if that was really necessary."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都和牛すき焼きしゃぶしゃぶ 富之上 祇園本店、すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ・鍋、東山区常盤町161-1、京阪祇園四条駅7番出口から徒歩4分、毎日 11:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00)、予約可、120分制、当日のキャンセル料あり、10分遅れで取消のことも、21席 (カウンター)、禁煙、多言語メニュー、英語のスタッフ、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2025年9月1日オープン。公式サイト: 祇園本店、三条河原町店、祇園八坂店、匠 祇園四条店。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 目の前で塊から切る和牛、3,300円から、黒毛和牛140gのすき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ4,400円、神戸牛140g 6,600円、国産牛100g追加1,600円、ひとり鍋、ご飯おかわり無料、すき焼きは卵1個追加可、締めのうどん、写真のプリントの無料サービス、開店直後は運営が不慣れ、普通、脂が多い、インバウンド向け、掛け声、ご飯がかたい (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; English-speaking staff.

places.name: まとゐ鮨 (Matoi Zushi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soy-marinated tuna and ikura, soy and ponzu throughout, glazed conger and eel (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish sushi bar (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 17:00–26:30 (2:30 am); delivery 16:30–26:30; closed Sunday, public holidays, New Year and Obon. Reservations taken. 36 seats: a counter downstairs and a tatami room upstairs for groups; private rooms. Smoking allowed — an October 2026 reviewer calls this "the big issue". Cards; no e-money. Take-away. Down a narrow lane off Shijo above Nawate, east of the first turning. The official site (gionmatoi.jp) was under maintenance on 7 November 2026.
places.neighborhood: Lane off Shijo above Nawate, Gion — 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo exit 7
places.cuisine: A decades-old Edo-mae sushi bar in a Gion lane, open until 2:30 am (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · omakase: jellyfish with ponzu; sashimi of sea bream, striped jack, sardine, seared bonito and squid; grilled conger; nigiri of sea bream, mackerel, sweet shrimp, soy-marinated ikura, Nemuro bafun uni, chu-toro; toro-taku and Matoi rolls; chawanmushi and clear soup (June 2026) · marinated tuna, seared red snapper, white shrimp (December 2025); fatty mackerel, octopus, colourful futomaki (April 2026); herring roe (September 2026) · take-away rolls (December 2025) · banquets upstairs with self-serve sake and shochu (October 2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Gion lane off Shijo, Edo-mae till 2:30 am] A long-running, lively Edo-mae sushi counter tucked down a lane by Shijo-Nawate, where chatty chefs keep the nigiri coming until 2:30 am — a Gion after-party favourite at fair prices for the area. Smoking is allowed, which a 2026 diner calls the big drawback. Closed Sundays and holidays.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a sushi shop that "has been in Gion for decades" (May 2026), "a long-established Edo-mae sushi restaurant embodying the essence of the geisha district" (June 2026), with lively chefs who chat with regulars and keep making sushi "without missing a beat" late at night (November 2026). Prices are not shown on the sushi menu (June 2026); reviewers still call them reasonable for Gion.
chef_bio.specialty: Edo-mae nigiri, late at night.

anecdotes.text: May 2026: "Rather than the quiet, tense atmosphere of high-end sushi, it gives off the vibe of a lively, traditional sushi shop."
May 2026: "As the rain got heavier, they kindly offered me an umbrella."
October 2026: "While the food was decent, the big issue was that smoking was allowed in a sushi restaurant."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: まとゐ鮨、寿司、東山区四条通縄手上ル一筋目東入ル、京阪祇園四条駅7番出口から徒歩3分、月〜土 17:00〜翌2:30、出前 16:30〜翌2:30、日曜・祝日・正月・お盆休み、予約可、36席、個室あり、喫煙可、カード可、電子マネー不可、テイクアウト、サイト gionmatoi.jp (2026年11月7日はメンテナンス中)。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年11月、英語): 祇園で何十年も続く江戸前鮨、にぎやかな板前と常連の会話、深夜まで営業で二次会向き、くらげのポン酢、刺身 (鯛、しまあじ、いわし、かつおのたたき、いか)、焼き穴子、にぎり (鯛、さば、甘えび、いくら醤油漬け、根室のエゾバフンウニ、中トロ)、トロたく巻、まとゐ巻、茶碗蒸し、お吸い物、づけまぐろ、たこ、太巻き、数の子、持ち帰りの巻き寿司、2階の座敷で宴会、すし屋で喫煙可なのが問題 (2026年10月)、値段の表示なし (2026年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Lively counter; smoking allowed; no prices on the sushi menu.

places.name: とらふぐ茶屋 山福 (Torafugu Chaya Yamafuku)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fugu karaage, tempura and ponzu-dipped tetchiri; fugu sashimi with ponzu — ask (official menu; 2022–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a tiger-pufferfish restaurant (official site).
places.hours_raw: Official site: 16:00–22:00 (last order 21:00) all year since 15 January 2025; closing days irregular. Tabelog still lists 16:00–23:00, closed Tuesday. Reservations taken. 32 seats in tatami and sunken-kotatsu rooms; private rooms; private hire. Non-smoking. Cards (Mastercard, UC, Amex, JCB, Visa); no e-money or QR. On the Seseragi path along the Kamo River above Shijo (Kawabata Shijo-agaru), ground floor of ゼラジオ鴨川; a tank of live fugu by the entrance.
places.neighborhood: Seseragi path by the Kamo River, north of Shijo — 2 min walk from Gion-Shijo
places.cuisine: A tiger-fugu specialist by the Kamo River serving fish live from its tank (official site; 2022–2026 reviews) · courses (official menu, tax included): chunky-cut tessa course ¥6,600; large-platter tessa course ¥7,150; fugu zanmai course with charcoal-grilled fugu ¥9,240; Dai-ara VIP course with fugu shabu and fugu sushi ¥11,440 — each with appetizer, tetchiri, karaage, zosui and dessert · fugu grilled yourself over charcoal; tetchiri with fish "still moving" (2025–2026) · fugu skin with ponzu; fin sake; soft roe for the hotpot; yuzu sorbet (2023–2025) · an older ¥5,500 course (February 2023)
places.notes: [Fugu · Kamo riverside above Shijo, live tiger fugu and big portions] A tatami-room fugu house on the riverside Seseragi path, with live tiger fugu from the tank at the door served as sashimi, charcoal-grilled and in tetchiri, then zosui. Courses ¥6,600–11,440; one November 2025 reviewer calls the portions the biggest of any fugu course tried. Farmed fugu, per one reviewer. Open daily from 16:00.

chef_bio.background: The official site calls it a specialist in tora-fugu, the highest grade of pufferfish eaten in Japan. Reviewers from 2022 to 2026 praise fresh fish from the live tank, good value and attentive, mostly young staff; one November 2025 diner notes the fugu is farmed and calls the portions "the largest portions by far" of any fugu course tried. Criticism: dust on the walls and picture frames (June 2025), and staff "quite eager to clear as many dishes as possible" (October 2026). No source links it to the あごつゆしゃぶしゃぶ 山福 shabu-shabu house on Kiyamachi.
chef_bio.specialty: Tiger-fugu tetchiri; charcoal-grilled fugu.

anecdotes.text: November 2025: "We decided to share one serving of zosui, which was also quite large, equivalent to about four bowls of rice, so we ended up leaving quite a bit behind."
October 2025: "To my surprise, the very fugu that had been swimming energetically in the tank just moments ago was now served on my plate… I offered a moment of respect."
July 2023: for a mother's birthday, "many restaurants switch to dishes featuring sweetfish in the summer, so Yamafuku is a rare gem that still serves fugu."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: とらふぐ茶屋 山福、京都市東山区大和大路通三条下る弁財天町6-6-1 (川端通り四条上る・せせらぎの道沿い)、16:00〜22:00 (L.O 21:00、2025年1月15日から通年)、不定休、32席、カード可、とらふぐの専門店、山福ぶつ切りてっさコース6,600円、山福大皿てっさコース7,150円、特選山福ふぐ三昧コース9,240円、特選山福大アラＶＩＰコース11,440円 (税込)。食べログ: 山福、ふぐ、ゼラジオ鴨川 1F、16:00〜23:00、火曜休み、予約可、座敷・掘りごたつ、個室、貸切可、禁煙、電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2022年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 入口の生け簀、泳ぎてっちり、炭火焼きふぐ、てっさ、唐揚げ、ひれ酒、白子、雑炊、柚子シャーベット、量が多い、養殖のとらふぐ (2025年11月)、壁のほこり (2025年6月)、皿を下げるのが早い (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Tatami rooms; courses; book ahead.

places.name: 京いざかや くぼ田 (Kyo Izakaya Kubota)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura and udon in the sets, and white-miso and red-miso dishes in the courses (official menu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, temari sushi with fish, chicken jibu-ni and dashi throughout; some temari use mushroom, myoga or yuba (official menu; October 2026).
places.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: daily 11:00–14:30 (food last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (food last order 21:00); closing days irregular. Reservations taken. Riverside noryo-doko (summer deck) seats carry a ¥1,000-a-person service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「・納涼床席の場合：サービス料 一人1,000円」; the deck is for middle-schoolers and up, indoors if it rains. Children under school age only in private rooms. 91 seats: counter, tatami, private rooms for 2–8. Non-smoking. Cards and PayPay; no e-money. A renovated townhouse in Pontocho south of Sanjo, facing the Kamo River and Higashiyama. Opened 2 June 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho south of Sanjo, on the Kamo River — 5 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: A Pontocho townhouse izakaya by the Kamo River for temari sushi and Kyoto tempura, with a summer noryo-doko deck (official site; 2026 reviews) · lunch (official menu, tax included): obanzai, 15 temari sushi and udon ¥3,300; plus Kyoto tempura ¥4,400; plus three kinds of sashimi ¥5,500 · dinner courses ¥6,050 (Ume), ¥7,700 (Take) and ¥9,350 (Matsu): obanzai, sashimi, jibu-ni of Kyoto red jidori chicken, low-temperature Spanish mackerel with white-miso espuma, five to eight kinds of tempura, a vinegared dish, temari sushi, red miso soup, sweets; Matsu adds Kyoto beef stew (official menu) · temari with hamo, yuba, mushroom and myoga, seasoned so no soy is needed (July–October 2026); hojicha pudding (August 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Pontocho on the Kamo River, temari sushi and tempura] A renovated Pontocho townhouse with a summer deck over the Kamo River, serving pretty 15-piece temari sushi sets with Kyoto tempura at lunch (¥3,300–5,500) and fuller courses at night. The deck costs ¥1,000 extra a head. Some diners found service slow or shaky (2026). Open daily, lunch and dinner.

chef_bio.background: Opened 2 June 2025 (Tabelog) in a Kyoto townhouse in Pontocho; the official site promises temari sushi and Kyoto tempura with views of the Kamo River and the Higashiyama hills. No source names the operator or says whether it has sister shops. Reviewers in 2026 praise the jibu-ni, the white-miso espuma and the temari; criticism covers slow drinks and so-so service (July 2026), a refusal to split receipts for a group until they protested (September 2026), a new staff member's thin menu explanations (September 2026) and more food than one diner could finish (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Temari sushi; Kyoto tempura.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "As October has arrived and the nights have become a bit chilly, I appreciated the thoughtful gesture of providing knee blankets for the women."
August 2026: "A reservation at 18:30 is ideal, allowing you to enjoy both the bright Kamo River and its evening ambiance."
September 2026: "when we requested separate receipts, they insisted they could only provide one receipt for the total amount… After some protest, they finally agreed to issue separate receipts."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京いざかや くぼ田、京都市中京区先斗町三条下ル若松町141、11:00〜14:30 (L.O.料理 14:00)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.料理 21:00)、不定休、京町屋、鴨川と東山の眺め、手毬寿司と京天ぷら、納涼床、コース「梅」税込6,050円・「竹」7,700円・「松」9,350円 (おばんざい盛合せ、お造り盛合わせ、京赤地鶏の治部煮、鰆の低温焼き 白味噌のエスプーマ、天ぷら、酢肴、手毬寿司、赤出汁、甘味、松は京都牛のビーフシチュー)、ランチ税込3,300円・4,400円・5,500円 (手毬寿司15貫、おうどん)。食べログ: 天ぷら・寿司、原文で「・納涼床席の場合：サービス料 一人1,000円」、91席、個室、禁煙、カード・PayPay可、2025年6月2日オープン、法人会員。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 納涼床、鱧や湯葉の手毬寿司、治部煮、ほうじ茶プリン、ひざ掛け、飲み物が遅い、領収書の分割を断られた (2026年9月)、新人の説明不足、量が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Riverside deck in summer (¥1,000 service); courses; young children in private rooms only.

places.name: ヤキニク 七七四 (Yakiniku Nanashi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: sauce-marinated cuts, beef-tendon stew and wagyu sushi (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant (2025–26 reviews); Tabelog lists vegetarian options, not described.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Japan Food Guide gives 17:00–24:00 with 120-minute seatings for courses. Bookings taken; call for private hire (Tabelog). Cards and iD/QUICPay; no QR (Tabelog). 48 seats: a counter and standing bar downstairs, tables and sunken tatami upstairs; heated-tobacco area downstairs, upstairs non-smoking; terrace; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog; August 2025 review). Solo diners welcome at the counter (August 2025 review). Off Pontocho/Kiyamachi north of Shijo, 4 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 1A (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi–Pontocho, north of Shijo — 4 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Good-value wagyu yakiniku from a Kyoto wagyu wholesaler (Japan Food Guide): courses — 774 recommended ¥5,000, The Best ¥8,000 with chateaubriand and sirloin, 774 Kobe beef ¥10,000 (Japan Food Guide); a set of kimchi, Nanashi salad, heart with ponzu, outside-skirt yukhoe, premium salted tongue, kalbi, wagyu sushi, aged jumbo frankfurter and horumon (August 2025); ribeye, beef-tendon stew, horumon platter; all-you-can-drink course ¥5,000 (August 2025)
places.notes: [Wagyu yakiniku · Kiyamachi] A lively two-floor yakiniku off Kiyamachi from a Kyoto wagyu wholesaler: good-value courses from ¥5,000 with salted tongue, yukhoe, horumon and wagyu sushi, up to a Kobe-beef course, and a counter for solo diners. About ¥4,000–6,000. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Run by a well-known Kyoto wagyu wholesale company, per Japan Food Guide. Reviewers also call it "Tachiyaki Niku Nanashi" (August–October 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: High-value yakiniku from a wagyu wholesaler (Japan Food Guide).
chef_bio.specialty: Yukhoe; horumon platter.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 regular who comes at least monthly always orders the horumon platter and wishes for a whole plate of yukhoe.
An August 2025 first-timer having yakiniku alone at the counter found the staff friendly and chatty.
An April 2026 diner was disappointed that the tongue came frozen and found the prices a little high.

cultural_comfort.note: Course menus; counter for solo diners.

places.name: ハラールマラータン (Halal Malatang)
places.gf_detail: Ask. You choose the ingredients and noodles — sweet-potato noodles and vermicelli are offered — but broths and sauces are not described (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Build your own bowl from vegetables and tofu, but the broths (beef bone, mala, tomato) are not described as vegan (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Sun–Thu 11:00–23:00; Fri and Sat 11:00–3:00 (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「なし」 (none). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 26 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Choose ingredients into a bowl and pay by weight — about ¥400 per 100 g (March 2026) — then pick one of about four broths; 80 g of noodles free when the bill passes ¥1,000 (March–August 2026 reviews). Sauces and toppings — sesame sauce, chilli oil, Sichuan pepper oil, nuts — are self-service (March 2026 review). At the end of a narrow side alley off Kiyamachi, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; August 2026 review). The name advertises halal; no certification was found.
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi alley, north of Shijo — 3 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Build-your-own malatang (2026 reviews): pick vegetables, tofu, meat balls and more by weight, choose a broth — classic mala, beef bone, tomato — and noodles including sweet-potato noodles and vermicelli; salted-egg dumplings and fried bread as sides
places.notes: [Malatang · Kiyamachi alley] A build-your-own malatang shop opened in 2026 at the end of a Kiyamachi alley: fill a bowl by weight (about ¥400 per 100 g), pick a mala, beef-bone or tomato broth, and get free noodles over ¥1,000. Open late on weekends. The name advertises halal.

chef_bio.background: Opened 14 February 2026 (March 2026 review). Two 2026 reviewers note a largely international clientele and staff.
chef_bio.specialty: Malatang.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner added shrimp to the bowl and enjoyed the self-service sesame sauce, chilli oil and Sichuan pepper oil.
A June 2026 diner called it the most authentic malatang tried, praising the salted-egg dumplings and fried bread.
An August 2026 diner found some ingredients unlabelled and noted a steady stream of delivery orders.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ハラールマラータン、中華料理・中華鍋、中京区下樵木町199-6、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、日〜木 11:00〜23:00、金土 11:00〜翌3:00、予約可、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、26席、禁煙。口コミ (2026年3〜8月、英語): 2026年2月14日オープン、具材を選んで量り売り (100gで約400円)、スープは4種ほど (麻辣、牛骨、トマトなど)、会計1,000円以上で麺80g無料、さつまいも麺や春雨、ごまだれ・ラー油・花椒油・ナッツはセルフ、塩卵の餃子、揚げパン、木屋町の細い路地の奥、店名はハラールを掲げる (認証は確認できず)。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-service bowl; English and Chinese spoken.

places.name: 渡半 (Watahan)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Raw oysters and sashimi are naturally wheat-free, but fried fugu and soy for dipping are served (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish shop (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 9:00–17:30; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). A shop card quoted in a December 2025 review gives 11:00–18:00, closed Tuesday. Takeaway; a few seats (5 per Tabelog) to eat sashimi and oysters on the spot with a drink (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews). No bookings (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In Nishiki Market at Fuyacho, about 4 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishiki Market at Fuyacho — 4 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: A Nishiki fish shop specialising in fugu, hamo and oysters (December 2025 review): raw oysters to compare from Hokkaido, Miyagi and Mie, sashimi packs of wild sea bream, kampachi, akagai and hamo, sea urchin, fried fugu, fugu fins for hire-zake to take home; canned beer and hot sake to drink on the spot (2023–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Fish shop · Nishiki Market] A fishmonger in Nishiki Market since 1897, now in its fourth generation, specialising in fugu, hamo and oysters: pick big raw oysters, sea urchin or a sashimi pack at the front and eat them on the spot with beer or hot sake. About ¥1,000–3,000. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Founded in 1897 as a fresh-fish retailer by Watanabe Hanshichi; now run by the fourth generation and focused on preparing and selling fugu, hamo and oysters (December 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Raw oysters; fugu.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 visitor compared plump raw oysters from Hokkaido and Miyagi.
Invited in by the staff at the corner in February 2026, a visitor had hot sake, oysters from Hokkaido and Mie, and akagai sashimi.
A May 2025 visitor liked choosing sashimi and a drink at the entrance and eating outside, though prices felt touristy.

places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi, north of Shijo — DECK by COAST 5F

places.notes: [Crab buffet · Kawaramachi] A big all-you-can-eat crab restaurant on the 5th floor of DECK by COAST: snow crab and red snow crab, grill-your-own crab, sushi and hot dishes, 63 items in 100 minutes for about ¥9,349. Weekend lunch too. Sister shops in Nagoya and Namba.

chef_bio.background: Part of the Kanigin crab-buffet shops, with others at Nagoya Station and in Namba (Gurunavi; HotPepper).
chef_bio.specialty: Snow crab buffet.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner found the 100-minute limit flew by peeling crab.
An October 2026 diner focused on the genuine snow crab, packed with meat, over the red snow crab.
A diner bringing an American friend in October 2026 for crab in Japan found many European and American guests there.

Reservations accepted; one course per person; 90-minute limit when busy (except the special course); pork offered instead of beef on request, except for the steak course (Tabelog). No charge (Tabelog original チャージ料なし). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats (Tabelog). 1 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn, on Nawate south of Shijo (Tabelog). Opened 7 July 2026 (Tabelog).

places.notes: [Sukiyaki · Gion, Nawate south of Shijo] A small new wagyu restaurant built for the camera: a cloud of cotton candy melts into the sukiyaki or shabu-shabu pot as the sauce goes on, over A5 certified Omi beef, after five seared-meat appetizers — courses about ¥9,900. Pork on request. One course each; 90 minutes when busy. Lunch and dinner daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a sukiyaki, shabu-shabu and sushi restaurant of 16 seats opened 7 July 2026 near Gion-Shijo. Reviewers in September–October 2026 describe A5 certified Omi beef from female cattle (some mention Kobe beef too), cotton-candy sukiyaki and dry-ice presentation.
chef_bio.specialty: Cotton-candy sukiyaki with Omi beef.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner on the ¥9,900 shabu-shabu course paired the meat with Hachidaime Gihei rice and Ranou eggs.
An October 2026 visitor found the sauce poured over the cotton candy neither too sweet nor too salty.
An October 2026 lunch guest noted the course in 150 g (¥9,900) and 200 g (¥11,440) sizes.

places.gf_detail: Not GF: muffins, cheesecake, toast, sata andagi, sandwiches and fried foods (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Coffee and fruit smoothies; dairy and egg in most bakes; no ingredient information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–18:00; irregular closing days; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Order and pay on the 1F, then sit on either floor (September 2025; July 2026). On Takatsuji, about 15 min walk from Kawaramachi or Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn; bicycle parking on the east side (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Takatsuji between Kawaramachi and Karasuma
places.cuisine: Spacious two-floor cafe with an Okinawan touch, one of three KAMEE COFFEE shops in Kyoto (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · café latte, blend coffee, fruit smoothies, iced milk ¥540 (2025–2026 reviews) · sata andagi (2 for ¥90), kame sablé ¥280, muffins, carrot cake, Oreo cheesecake; sandwiches and fried snacks (2025–2026 reviews) · breakfast set with toast, fried egg, sausage, hash browns, salad and yogurt ¥1,050 (July 2026) · about ¥1,000–2,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Cafe · Takatsuji, two airy floors] A bright, roomy cafe with a laid-back Okinawan streak: order downstairs, then take a sofa or window seat upstairs with a latte, sata andagi or carrot cake — or the ¥1,050 breakfast set. Power outlets and Wi-Fi make it a good work stop. Vintage clothes for sale on site.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: KAMEE COFFEE has three shops in Kyoto — the main shop on Kamikawaramachi, Nishinotoin and Takatsuji — plus vintage clothing stores. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe Okinawan sweets such as sata andagi and a spacious, work-friendly space.
chef_bio.specialty: Sata andagi; café latte.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 visitor, back after finding it under construction, ordered downstairs and had a hot latte brought up to the second floor.
A July 2026 guest took the ¥1,050 breakfast set — "a place to take your time, like a turtle".
A July 2026 visitor watched the city from the window with a kame sablé and two sata andagi for ¥90.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dessert courses with cream, butter and eggs (reviews).

At least one drink per person (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog). places.neighborhood: Umekoji, 2 min walk from Umekoji Kyoto-Nishi Stn
places.cuisine: Plated-dessert courses with wine pairings at a counter (2023–2026 reviews) · short course of five dishes ¥3,200 (November 2023); ¥4,000 course with a choice of strawberry tart or crêpe chocolat; eight-dish course ¥6,000 with a half wine pairing (March 2025); courses A and B with a seasonal main such as rose and peach with mini watermelon shaved ice, or strawberry and amaretto (2025–2026) · savoury starts: shichimi almonds, a savoury cake with Mibuna and Nara pickles, sansho meringue; petits fours (2023–2025) · strawberry shortcake; kakigori (2026) · wine pairings, half sizes available
places.notes: [Dessert course · Umekoji, a five-seat dessert-and-wine counter] A chic five-seat counter near Umekoji where a pastry chef plates a dessert course in front of you — salty-sweet starters like a pickle savoury cake and sansho meringue, a seasonal main such as rose and peach, then petits fours — with matched wines, half glasses if you like. Courses about ¥3,200–6,000. Booking only, three seatings; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Pastry chef and sommelier, called Chef Yamamoto by a November 2023 reviewer; first name not given
chef_bio.background: Per a November 2023 reviewer: Chef Yamamoto, a pastry chef who won a Silver Egg at the 2022 RED competition and is also a sommelier. Other reviewers (2024–2026) describe desserts made and explained before you, not overly sweet, with pairings.
chef_bio.specialty: Plated-dessert course with wine pairing.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 pair found no other bookings that day and watched each dessert made and explained.

A February 2025 visitor dropped in at 2 am on a Sunday and found it nearly full.
A February 2020 group of old university friends compared the entrance art to Aboriginal painting, Van Gogh or Munch.

Off Yamato-oji south of Shijo in Gion, near Keihan Gion-Shijo; moved here in August 2010 after earlier sites in Gion and on Teramachi (Tabelog). Real wasabi (June 2025).

Cash only; closed Sunday.

anecdotes.text: A couple come every year at the end of December; in 2025 it was packed and lively.
A June 2025 guest, a fan of individually run places, found the anago melted in the mouth.

places.notes: [Yakiniku · Kiyamachi alley, A5 Wagyu until 3:00] A calm, modern yakiniku room in a quiet alley off Kiyamachi serving hand-cut A5 Wagyu — yukhoe, thick tongue, yaki-shabu, harami — with namul and kimchi, at lunch and until 3:00. Sister of BISTRO MAUMU and the Gion Yakiniku Maumu. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T6130001067887 is registered to 株式会社ＧＭＩ (NTA register), the operator also recorded for BISTRO MAUMU in our data, which runs 焼肉マウム in Gion and 居酒屋 マウム. Tabelog’s shop text describes female-cattle A5 Wagyu hand-cut by skilled staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: Additive-free house sauce to bring out the meat (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu yukhoe; premium tongue.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular of the Gion branch tried this one with friends as the first stop of a night out.
An October 2026 family found space between tables for a stroller and let the staff season the meat.

places.notes: [Japanese izakaya · Kiyamachi 2F, fish and suppon until 5:00] A tatami-floored izakaya up a steep stair on Kiyamachi, where a chef with French training cooks seasonal fish, tempura, kappo dishes and year-round soft-shell turtle courses, with plenty of sake and free-flow plans. ¥550 otoshi; open until 5:00.

Tabelog’s invoice number T4130001063137 is registered to 株式会社いさむ at the shop’s address (NTA register). A February 2026 reviewer mentions a one-person operation that night.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 first-timer at soft-shell turtle got through the fried suppon but left half the porridge, too full to finish.
An August 2026 pair chose it for fish on a second stop and booked a 90-minute free-flow plan with a coupon.

places.name: おづkyoto‐maison du sake plus Cafe‐ (Ozu Kyoto)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: parfaits with cookies and sponge cake, pancake sandwiches and cheesecake (2020–2025 reviews); ask about rice balls and amazake.
places.vegan_detail: Ask: amazake and plum shaved ice may suit, but parfaits use cream and ice cream, and no source says what goes into the sake-lees soup (2021–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Fri–Sun 11:30–19:30 (food last order 18:30, drinks 19:00); closed Monday to Thursday. The operator's page gives weekdays 11:30–18:00 and weekends and holidays 10:30–18:00 — check before going. Reservations taken; about 9–10 seats (one table for four and a short counter), so groups may be turned away (August 2024). Pay first; cash, cards, transit IC, PayPay and other QR. Take-away sweets. Non-smoking; children welcome. Ground floor of a small hotel on Yamatooji below Shijo (Tabelog: ホテルRinn; operator: ホテル鈴). Opened here 2 October 2020 (Tabelog) after a move (November 2020 review).
places.neighborhood: Yamatooji below Shijo, near Kenninji — 3–5 min walk from Gion-Shijo
places.cuisine: A small machiya-style café and sake bar run by a Kyoto kaiseki company with sake-brewery ties (operator site; Tabelog; 2020–2026 reviews) · deer parfait with deer-shaped cookies — Gion matcha ¥894 (March 2025); with peach ¥990 (August 2024) · matcha shiratama shaved ice ¥990 (summer 2024); plum shaved ice (September 2023) · Chocopa chocolate parfait ¥1,000 (November 2020); amazake apple parfait and warm amazake (January 2021); pancake sandwich (July 2023); cheesecake made with daiginjo sake (August 2024) · sake-lees soup with miso rice balls (October 2024; February 2026); shark-fin rice bowl by the chefs of the sister kaiseki restaurant (Tabelog) · a good choice of Japanese sake (October 2024)
places.notes: [Café & sake bar · Yamatooji near Kenninji, deer parfaits and sake-lees soup] A tiny wood-toned café on the ground floor of a Gion hotel, run by a Kyoto kaiseki company: deer-cookie matcha parfaits, summer shaved ice, sake-lees soup with miso rice balls, and sake by the glass. One person often makes everything, so expect a wait. Open Friday–Sunday per Tabelog — check hours.

chef_bio.background: Run by Tatsuuma Corporation (辰馬コーポレーション), which also runs the Kyoto kaiseki house せんしょう in Ukyo and, since June 2025, おづ おむすびカフェ at Bivi Nijo (operator site). Reviewers tie the café to a Nishinomiya sake brewery through the president's family and note sweets made with its daiginjo (2023–2025). It moved to this hotel ground floor in 2020 (November 2020 review). An August 2024 reviewer warns that "one staff member prepares everything in sequence, which does result in a wait time".
chef_bio.specialty: Deer parfaits; sake-lees soup.

anecdotes.text: January 2021: "The parfait came with a deer-shaped cookie! It's adorable, but the cookie is quite large (laughs)."
August 2024: "During our stay, two groups were turned away due to being full."

places.name: バー サイレント サード (Bar Silent Third)
places.gf_detail: Ask: a whisky and cocktail bar with no food described; check beer and liqueurs (2016–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: drinks only in the sources; some cocktails use cream, egg or honey (2016–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 14:00–24:00; closing days not fixed. Call ahead for space (May 2026). Smoking allowed. Cards (JCB, Amex, Diners per Tabelog). A Y- or L-shaped counter and one sofa table for four (July 2022; July 2024). 2nd floor of 伽羅ビル on Gokomachi below Rokkaku. Open since about 2014 ("four years" in November 2018).
places.neighborhood: Gokomachi below Rokkaku — 6 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: A whisky and cocktail bar that opens at 2 pm (2016–2026 reviews) · the house cocktail "Silent Third", made on a whisky of your choice — Glenmorangie, or peaty Caol Ila (2018; 2019; May 2026) · gin and tonic on Star of Bombay (November 2018) · rare and high-proof whiskies, e.g. Old Ezra 7 Barrel Strength and Old Grand-Dad 114 as highballs; Yoichi; an original-label Speyside (2016; 2019; May 2026) · classic cocktails — Singapore Sling, Martini, Cosmopolitan (July 2024)
places.notes: [Whisky & cocktail bar · Gokomachi near Rokkaku, open from 2 pm] A moody second-floor bar with a long counter and walls of bottles, pouring from 2 pm: the namesake Silent Third cocktail built on the whisky you like, sharp gin and tonics and rare bourbons. Some reviewers find the welcome cool at first. Smoking allowed. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers say it opened around 2014 and comes from the Bar K6 line (November 2018; July 2022); one in July 2022 thought it "appears to be run by a single person", with paintings by the same hand on the walls, while a July 2024 group met the owner and female staff. Reviews praise skill and knowledge; criticism: "the service to be somewhat off-putting" (September 2022) and an atmosphere that is "just okay" (July 2022).
chef_bio.specialty: The Silent Third cocktail; whisky.

anecdotes.text: January 2019: "When I ordered at Silent Third, they asked me what base whisky I preferred, and I requested something peaty. It turned out to be Caol Ila."
July 2024: "The staff were wonderful; they looked a bit cold at first, but were very kind."

places.gf_detail: Ask: cocktails and spirits may suit; the food includes pasta, omurice and baguette (official site; 2024–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: fresh-fruit cocktails and juices (2025–2026 reviews); the food includes cream pasta and omurice.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog and official site: Tue–Sun 17:00–24:00; closed Monday. Reservations taken; group bookings 21:00–23:00 by arrangement; private hire for 12–30 by phone. Table charge ¥500 — Tabelog, Japanese original 「500円」. 29 seats: counter, sofas and an open terrace (smoking on the terrace only). Pets welcome; English menu; wheelchair access; free Wi-Fi. Cards and e-money (Edy, QUICPay); no QR. Ground floor of a small hotel (MYK HOUSE, March 2018) on a back street west of the Kamo River near Shimizucho. Opened 23 February 2018 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: A terrace cocktail bar with food, on a quiet back street (official site; 2018–2026 reviews) · cocktails made to your taste; gin and tonic; seasonal fresh-fruit cocktails; fresh juice for non-drinkers (2018–2026) · whiskies — Laphroaig 10, Yamazaki, Harper 12; Manhattan, Margarita (2018; December 2025) · food: omurice and pasta (official site); tomato and cream pastas, made on request when off the menu (December 2025); baguette (September 2024)
places.notes: [Cocktail bar · back street by the Kamo below Shijo, terrace and a Hokkaido master] A roomy bar with sofas and an open terrace on the ground floor of a small hotel, run by a friendly master from Hokkaido: cocktails made to your taste, fresh-fruit drinks, good whisky and, on request, pasta. ¥500 charge. Smoking on the terrace only; pets welcome. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 February 2018 (Tabelog) on the ground floor of a hotel guests often use for long stays (July 2020). Reviewers describe the master as "from Hokkaido" (July 2020) and "friendly and engaging" (December 2025), with other staff who explain the drinks in detail (April 2024). Pasta was dropped from the menu, "possibly due to staffing issues", but was made on request in December 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Cocktails made to order.

anecdotes.text: July 2020: "The master was so cool while shaking the cocktails that I went home the next day and bought a cocktail shaker myself!"
December 2025: "My wife, who doesn't drink alcohol, always requests fresh juice made from fruits."

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; pets welcome; terrace.

places.name: 炭焼 みや沢 (Sumiyaki Miyazawa)
places.gf_detail: Ask: salt-grilled skewers may suit, but the secret tare, meat miso, ramen and curry do not (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori counter; vegetable skewers exist, but nothing is described as vegan (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: from 18:00 until sold out; closed Sundays and public holidays; hours may change. Reservations strongly advised — 10 counter seats, often full (2024–2026 reviews). Non-smoking; children welcome. Cards (JCB, Amex, Diners per Tabelog); no e-money or QR. Ground floor of ユニバース会館 on Tominaga-cho east of Nawate, south side.
places.neighborhood: Tominaga-cho east of Nawate, Gion — 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo
places.cuisine: A 10-seat Gion counter for Kyoto akajidori grilled over binchotan, ordered skewer by skewer or omakase (2020–2026 reviews) · skewers: tsukune, rare chicken breast, sasami, seseri, heart, quail eggs, Manganji peppers and other vegetables (2024–2026) · Akane salt or the house tare (September 2026) · starters: cabbage with miso; lettuce with meat miso; potato salad; tataki and yukhoe; chicken sashimi (2020–2026) · to finish: rice with raw egg, grilled rice-ball chazuke, ramen or curry (2025–2026) · sake, shochu, awamori and house umeshu (September 2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Gion Tominaga-cho, binchotan-grilled Kyoto akajidori] A snug 10-seat counter off Nawate where Kyoto akajidori goes over binchotan: rare breast, smoky tsukune, soft quail eggs and good vegetable skewers, with egg-over-rice or curry to finish. Prices are clear for Gion — about ¥10,000 for a big meal with drinks (March 2026). Book ahead. Closed Sundays and holidays.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2020 to 2026 call it a hidden gem and a favourite, praising precise grilling, the freedom to order skewer by skewer, and clear pricing; one March 2026 diner paid ¥10,164 for 11 skewers, sides, a rice finish and several shochu sodas. The September 2026 reviewer took the omakase, "allowing the chef to serve me his recommendations".
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan-grilled akajidori.

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "Even in Gion, this place offers clear pricing and is a great restaurant."
January 2025: "The grilled tsukune may look burnt, but it wasn't bitter at all and was delicious!"
September 2024: "Seating is at the counter with a bit of a tight space, so it's best to bring minimal belongings."

cultural_comfort.note: 10-seat counter; book ahead.

places.name: まんざら亭 先斗町店 (Manzara Tei, Pontocho)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, sashimi and grilled fish, but nama-fu (wheat gluten), udon and soy- or miso-seasoned dishes are on the menu (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, duck and dashi-based Kyoto dishes (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); irregular closures (Tabelog). Bookings taken; walk-ins seated when there is room (Tabelog; March and May 2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 50 seats (up to 70) — counter, tables and a second-floor tatami room; non-smoking (Tabelog; June 2026 review). In Pontocho north of Shijo, 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi and Keihan Gion-Shijo Stns (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, north of Shijo — 5 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto obanzai and seasonal dishes with Kyoto sake (2026 reviews): assorted "omazai" plates of 3 or 5 kinds (5 for ¥2,000 — duck breast, hamo with new onion, octopus, jako with manganji peppers; extra duck ¥950, June 2026), aburi heshiko, sashimi for two, hamo sashimi, Kamo eggplant agedashi, furofuki daikon, daikon cake, Saikyo-grilled fish, nama-fu dengaku, saba sushi, Kyoto pickles, chirimen-jako rice and udon to finish, ice cream; Yamazaki umeshu soda, Kyoto white wine; courses and all-you-can-drink (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kyoto obanzai · Pontocho] A calm, non-smoking Pontocho izakaya from a Kyoto group: small plates of Kyoto obanzai, aburi heshiko, hamo and Kamo eggplant in summer, Saikyo-grilled fish and saba sushi with plenty of Kyoto sake, at a counter or upstairs on tatami. About ¥4,000–6,000.

roles: Restaurant of 株式会社ステップ (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Run by 株式会社ステップ of Kyoto, founded in 1988, which also runs まんざら亭 錦店 and ぎをん まんざら (PR TIMES release; Gurunavi). A March 2026 reviewer had been to other shops of the chain before this one.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai; Kyoto sake.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 couple seated by the window had aburi heshiko, sashimi for two, furofuki daikon and three kinds of "omazai", and found the portions small enough for a first or last stop.
Kept in Kyoto by a double typhoon in June 2026, a family with three small children called ahead and found the second-floor tatami room otherwise empty; the children loved the duck breast.
A solo June 2026 diner marked summer with hamo sashimi and Kamo eggplant agedashi over a draft beer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: まんざら亭 先斗町店、居酒屋・日本料理・海鮮、中京区下樵木町198-1、阪急河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00、ドリンク L.O. 22:30)、不定休、予約可、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、50席 (最大70名、テーブル・カウンター・座敷)、禁煙、日本酒・ワインにこだわる、コース、飲み放題。PR TIMES: 株式会社ステップ (京都市、1988年設立) がまんざら亭を運営。ぐるなび: 錦店、ぎをん まんざら。口コミ (2026年1〜6月、英語): Omazai 3種・5種 (5種2,000円、鴨ロース、鱧と新玉ねぎ、たこ、じゃこと万願寺)、鴨の追加950円、へしこの炙り、刺身の盛り合わせ、鱧の落とし、賀茂なすの揚げ出し、ふろふき大根、大根餅、西京焼き、生麩田楽、鯖寿司、京漬物、ちりめんじゃこご飯、締めのうどん、Yamazaki 梅酒のソーダ、京都の白ワイン、2階の座敷、同じチェーンの他の店という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter or tatami; staff welcome walk-ins when there is room.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. A whisky bar; no food described (2025–26 reviews).

Tucked into an alley behind a hotel off Pontocho, about 5 min from Gion-Shijo, Kawaramachi and Sanjo Stns (Tabelog; August 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, north of Shijo — 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese whisky only — more than 300 bottlings from Yamazaki, Hakushu and Hibiki to discontinued rarities, with tasting sets by age (February 2026): Hakushu 12 ¥3,200 and discontinued Taketsuru 17 ¥5,000 (February 2026); a three-Yamazaki tasting (non-age, 12, 18) ¥9,000 (April 2026); served in glasses with a Mount Fuji image (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Japanese whisky bar · Pontocho] A bright, friendly bar off Pontocho pouring only Japanese whisky — 300-plus bottlings, rare and discontinued ones included, and tasting flights such as three Yamazakis for ¥9,000. Staff recommend by taste. About ¥4,000–10,000. Open till 2:00; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A Japanese-whisky bar reviewed from October 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Japanese whisky tasting sets.

anecdotes.text: A brandy lover in April 2026 was won over to whisky by the ¥9,000 tasting of three Yamazakis.
A March 2026 visitor talked whisky with the friendly master and was given a kimono-fabric coaster as a souvenir.
A February 2026 visitor tried Hakushu 12 straight and on the rocks and the discontinued Taketsuru 17.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Japanese Whisky Bar seven KYOTO、バー、中京区下樵木町196、京阪祇園四条駅・阪急河原町駅・京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、火〜日・祝 17:00〜翌2:00 (L.O. 1:30)、月曜休み、予約可、カード・QUICPay・QR 可、24席 (カウンター12、テーブル8、立ち4)、禁煙。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年8月、英語): 300種以上の日本のウイスキー、Yamazaki・Hakushu・Hibiki から終売の希少品まで、年数別の飲み比べ、Hakushu 12年3,200円、終売の Taketsuru 17年5,000円、Yamazaki 3種の飲み比べ9,000円、富士山の絵の入ったグラス、着物の生地のコースター、気さくなマスター、好みを伝えると勧めてくれる、ホテルの裏の路地、少し高めという声。

places.name: SILK (Kyoto Pound Cake Silk)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat pound cakes (reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter-rich pound cakes, some with cheese (reviews).
places.hours_raw: 10:00–18:30; closed Tuesday, open on holidays (official site; Tabelog). Takeaway only (official site). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Also an online shop and pop-up counters at department stores around Japan (official site). On Gokomachi south of Takoyakushi, near Nishiki Market, about 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (official site).
places.neighborhood: Gokomachi near Nishiki Market — 5 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Pound cakes in large, small and cut sizes (2023–26 reviews): the signature Lemon Sweet with a sugar glaze, browned butter and lemon ¥1,400 (January 2025); mini cakes such as blueberry cheese ¥486, pistachio and cherry ¥562 and honey lemon ¥497 (March 2025); vanilla, hojicha, Kyoto matcha with bean paste, apple in winter, sakura in spring (April 2026); a premium chestnut and roasted sweet-potato cake in a paulownia box (2024)
places.notes: [Pound cake · Gokomachi] A takeaway pound-cake specialist near Nishiki Market with an arched door: glazed Lemon Sweet, mini cakes of pistachio-cherry or blueberry-cheese around ¥500, and seasonal sakura or apple, in pretty Kyoto gift bags. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 29 April 2022 (Tabelog). The official site lists this Gokomachi main shop as the only permanent shop, with an online shop and pop-up events at department stores across Japan.
chef_bio.philosophy: Pound cakes pursuing a smooth, rich sweetness, for a luxurious moment (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Lemon Sweet.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 visitor thought the shopfront looked like a nail salon, then chose blueberry, pistachio and lemon mini cakes from more than ten kinds.
An April 2026 buyer of three cakes, including a spring Sakura Pound, was taken with the Kyoto-styled shopping bag.
A January 2025 reviewer found the Lemon Sweet's glaze stronger than its lemon.

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway counter.

places.name: りゅう庵 (Ryu An)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled wagyu with salt or ponzu is possible, but sauces, a hamburg steak and soups are on the menu (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Wed and Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:30; Sat and Sun 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:30; holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Lunch walk-ins at weekends and holidays; weekday lunch by booking (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「なし」 (none). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 30 seats with semi-private and private rooms for 2 to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; January and February 2026 reviews). On Kawabata just north of Shijo, 1 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn exit 9 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawabata-Shijo, by the Kamo River — 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Wagyu yakiniku, including Kobe and Omi beef (2025–26 reviews): at lunch, a yaki-shabu set with rice, soup, pickles, salad and dessert ¥1,600 (June 2025), a grilled-meat set and a limited raw hamburg steak (five a day, January 2026); at night tongue in three to five cuts, outside skirt, short rib, zabuton, liver in a hot stone pot, yukhoe, Kobe beef carpaccio, tongue soup, a special Kobe and Omi set with chateaubriand for +¥3,000 (January 2026), courses around ¥25,000 (October 2026)
places.notes: [Wagyu yakiniku · Gion-Shijo] A calm yakiniku of private and semi-private rooms by the Kamo River at Gion-Shijo: good-value yaki-shabu lunches around ¥1,600 and, at night, Kobe and Omi wagyu — tongue in several cuts, chateaubriand, stone-pot liver — from about ¥10,000. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: A Gion-Shijo yakiniku restaurant (official site; Tabelog) whose menu opens by promising "the best meat of your life" (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Kobe and Omi wagyu; tongue.

anecdotes.text: Starting a meat trip in January 2026, a diner had the Kobe and Omi special set and added a thick Omi chateaubriand for ¥3,000.
A January 2026 lunch guest caught one of the five daily raw hamburg steaks, tender enough to eat with a spoon.
An October 2026 diner called the ¥25,000 course not expensive, from Kobe beef carpaccio to three cuts of tongue.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: りゅう庵、焼肉・日本料理・居酒屋、東山区川端四条上ル常盤町169、京阪祇園四条駅9番出口から徒歩1分、月〜水・金 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜22:30、土日 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:30、祝日 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、木曜休み、平日の昼は予約制、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、30席、個室 (2〜20名)、禁煙。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 昼の焼きしゃぶ定食1,600円 (ご飯、汁、漬物、サラダ、小鉢、デザート)、焼肉の定食、1日5食の生ハンバーグ、神戸牛と近江牛の特選盛りとシャトーブリアン +3,000円、石鍋のレバー、ざぶとん、5種のタン、神戸牛のカルパッチョ、タンのスープ、約25,000円のコース、半個室。

places.notes: [Izakaya · Nishi-Kiyamachi, midnight to 8 a.m.] A long-running izakaya that only opens at midnight, the last stop after Kiyamachi's bars: fresh daily sashimi, fried horse mackerel, simmered shellfish, tempura and dashimaki, finishing with kitsune udon or a rice bowl. chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a long-established counter izakaya on Nishi-Kiyamachi open from midnight until 8 a.m., a regular last stop for people coming off a night out (2018–2026).

anecdotes.text: A June 2018 group, flagging at 4 a.m., shared kitsune udon, hoya with ponzu and grilled thick tofu — the tofu a little underdone.
A July 2022 regular who comes after drinking calls the fried horse mackerel exceptional and the sashimi always fresh.
A June 2026 visitor on the last night of a trip found it more of a proper izakaya than expected, with a ¥900 conger and negi tempura.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sashimi and fish izakaya (2024–2026 reviews).

places.notes: [Fish izakaya · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, sashimi] A quiet, tucked-away izakaya true to its name: a platter of eight kinds of sashimi, two pieces each, then the head of the day's fish grilled or braised as you like, kinmedai, guji and ankimo, with sake. A May 2026 reviewer saw a sign saying only Japanese speakers are served. One found the simmered fish bony, another the sake list short. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a seafood izakaya of 25 seats east of the BAL building. Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe very fresh sashimi, fish heads of the day prepared to order, reasonable prices and a quiet room with few tourists.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; fish head of the day.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor saw a sign at the entrance saying the shop only accommodates those who can communicate in Japanese.
A May 2026 business group found the braised kijihata head the highlight — the speciality is the day's fish head done as you like.
A May 2025 pair loved the sashimi but found the simmered fish bony and hard to eat.

places.name: babele
places.gf_detail: Ask. Daily obanzai and ethnic small plates — yum woon sen, simmered and fried vegetables — but also pasta, yakisoba and fries; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Several vegetable obanzai (eggplant in broth, red konnyaku, Jerusalem artichoke salad), but dashi, egg and fish are common; no ingredient information (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Wednesday–Friday 18:00–2:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 15:00–24:00; closed Monday and Tuesday, and Sunday and Monday in the last week of the month; hours may change (Tabelog). Tabelog notes the menu has moved from Italian to obanzai and ethnic dishes. 1F of the Gion Nawate White building, down a narrow alley north of Shijo off Yamato-oji; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; September 2025).
places.neighborhood: Gion, off Nawate north of Shijo — 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Homely small bar of daily obanzai and ethnic dishes, cooked by hand by the woman who runs it, plus wine and sake (2024–2026 reviews) · e.g. a pouch of grated yam and egg white with yolk, simmered red konnyaku, fried eggplant in broth, yum woon sen with adjustable heat, squid shiokara with cabbage and butter (July–November 2024) · potato salad with pepper, pasta of the day such as mackerel, yakisoba, Jerusalem artichoke salad, fries (2025–2026 reviews) · about ¥3,000–6,000 (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Obanzai bar · Gion, off Nawate] A warm little bar at the end of a narrow alley near Shinbashi, where the owner cooks a changing spread of gently seasoned obanzai and ethnic plates — eggplant in broth, yam pouches, yum woon sen, squid shiokara with butter cabbage — plus pasta and yakisoba, with wine or sake at a big shared table. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a wine bar first listed as Italian that has moved to obanzai and ethnic dishes. Reviewers in 2024–2026 describe hand-made dishes by the woman who runs it, subtle seasoning, warm conversation and a homely feel.
chef_bio.specialty: Daily obanzai.

anecdotes.text: A July 2024 diner was struck by obanzai seasoned far more gently than at tourist-facing places, and by yum woon sen with adjustable heat.
A November 2024 fan tried to recreate the squid shiokara with cabbage and butter at home and could not match it.
An October 2026 regular orders the Jerusalem artichoke salad whenever it appears.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a dining and wine bar opened 11 July 2019 in Gion, with wines, Champagne and whisky chosen by the owner-sommelier. A December 2021 reviewer knew it as Dining bar MO-JI; a November 2024 reviewer refers to the owner as the mama.

anecdotes.text: An October 2022 birthday pair took a private room on a course of about ¥5,000, added pasta and cheese, and found sparkling wine only by the half bottle — about ¥24,000 for two with a surprise plate.
An August 2026 regular who usually comes just to drink had the steak of the day — lean, high-quality red meat.
A December 2021 guest, taken there by a friend, had walked past the narrow entrance many times without noticing it.

places.notes: [Sushi · north of the Imperial Palace, a couple's nine-seat omakase] A quiet, dimly lit nine-seat counter near Demachiyanagi run by a sushi master and wife: a pure, restrained omakase — sugar-free rice, barely seasoned gari, clear bonito soup — with nodoguro, anago and uni among the pieces, and sake or Swiss wine. Listed by Michelin six years running, per the shop. About ¥20,000–40,000; booking only; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Owner-chef, with the owner’s wife front of house (2021 reviews); names not given
chef_bio.background: Opened 6 May 2019 (Tabelog). Tabelog’s introduction: listed in the Michelin Guide for six consecutive years; sushi and seasonal appetisers made with fresh ingredients sourced directly from the area; two omakase courses at lunch and one at dinner. Reviewers (2021) describe a friendly owner and the owner’s wife running it together.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase sushi with sugar-free rice.

anecdotes.text: A December 2021 first-timer, after years of wanting to come, found the hostess’s smiles soothing.
An October 2021 guest came for the Swiss wine and ordered the dinner course at lunch.
A May 2025 diner found the fatty tuna surprisingly light and the style "transparent", with nothing superfluous.

places.notes: [Café · Demachi, seasonal shortcakes upstairs] A calm second-floor café just off the Demachi shopping street, with a blackboard lunch — a Greek-style hamburg or chicken plate with soup and rice for about ¥1,100 — and beautiful seasonal cakes: towering strawberry or peach shortcake, tarte Tatin, cheesecake. chef_bio.background: Opened 14 October 2010 (Tabelog). A March 2026 reviewer says it is run by one person; an October 2026 reviewer was welcomed by two women.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal shortcakes; tarte Tatin.

anecdotes.text: A three-time visitor (November 2024) came back for the Jonathan-apple tarte Tatin.
An August 2026 visitor finally made it after three or four years of meaning to, for the peach shortcake.
A March 2025 couple after cherry-blossom viewing were seated at once; a queue had formed by the time of leaving.

cultural_comfort.note: Blackboard menu; cash only.

places.gf_detail: Ask. Soft serve, milk-pudding soft serve, smoothies and juices; cones and toppings not described (reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dairy company’s milk soft serve; the fruit smoothies may be milk-free but are not described (reviews).
places.hours_raw: Hours are not listed on Tabelog, and the shop website (greenfarm.link) did not respond (2026-11-07) — check before going. 10 seats per Tabelog; a few seats inside (about four) and terrace seating outside (November 2025); non-smoking (Tabelog). On Yanagi-dori, about 5 min walk from Keihan Demachiyanagi Stn, near the Hyakumanben handmade market at Chion-ji (Tabelog; 2023–2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Demachiyanagi, Yanagi-dori — 5 min walk from the station
places.cuisine: Milk sweets from a dairy company dating to the Taisho era (2023–2024 reviews) · soft serve of Miyama milk; "Miyama Soft", a soft milk pudding of non-homogenised milk; Miyama Special Soft, e.g. strawberry (2023–2026) · fruit smoothies such as kale green and fig; banana juice (2024–2025) · a milk tasting of different milks (July 2026)
places.notes: [Soft serve · Demachiyanagi, a dairy's milk-and-smoothie stand] A small shop on Yanagi-dori run by a long-established dairy, pouring soft serve and a soft milk pudding made with Miyama milk, fruit smoothies and a milk tasting. Most people take a cone outside or to the terrace. Handy after the Hyakumanben handmade market. Hours aren't published — check before going.

roles: Run by a dairy company dating to the Taisho era (2023–2024 reviews); not named
chef_bio.background: Opened 23 November 2014 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2023–2024) describe a shop run by a milk company dating back to the Taisho era, serving Miyama milk soft serve and smoothies; a July 2026 reviewer did a milk tasting.
chef_bio.specialty: Miyama milk soft serve.

anecdotes.text: An October 2023 visitor came on the Hyakumanben handmade-market day and chose from several milks.
A March 2024 diner found the taste ordinary for the price.
A self-described regular (August 2025) waits each year for the fig smoothie.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: GREEN FARM、洋菓子・カフェ、左京区田中大堰町92、出町柳駅から361m、営業時間の記載なし、10席、禁煙、2014年11月23日オープン、ウェブサイト greenfarm.link (2026年11月7日は応答なし)。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 大正時代から続く牛乳の会社が営む、Miyama 牛乳のソフトクリーム、ノンホモ牛乳のやわらかいプリンの「Miyama Soft」、いちごのMiyama Special Soft、ケールのグリーンスムージー、いちじくのスムージー、バナナジュース、牛乳の飲み比べ、テラス席、店内は4人ほど、百万遍の手づくり市の近く、柳通、出町柳駅から徒歩5分。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; mostly takeaway.
