places.name: ル・シュクリエ (Le Sucrier)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A patisserie of cream puffs, shortcakes, chestnut cakes, cheesecake and pudding; no gluten information is published (reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg, butter and cream pastries (reviews).
places.hours_raw: 11:30–18:30 Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday; Sunday café from 14:00; closed Tuesday and Friday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). A small café area behind the cake counter, 15 seats; non-smoking; takeout (Tabelog; March 2025). On Teramachi just north of Imadegawa, on the way to the Masugata shopping street, 8 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; March 2026).
places.neighborhood: Teramachi-Imadegawa, near Demachi Masugata shopping street
places.cuisine: A long-established patisserie with a café, founded 1990 (September 2024 review) · cream puffs in several flavours, one with a rich citrusy cream (2022–2025) · Mon Carré of candied chestnuts and rum chestnut cream (March 2026); spice caramel; cheesecake; berry shortcake; pudding (2025–2026) · deep-roast iced coffee (August 2025)
places.notes: [Patisserie · Teramachi-Imadegawa, a 1990 neighbourhood cake shop] A slightly dim, antique-styled cake shop just north of Imadegawa, with a showcase of carefully made cakes and a small café behind: cream puffs, a chestnut-and-rum Mon Carré, spice caramel, cheesecake and pudding with a deep-roast coffee. Many take cakes to the Kamo delta. Cash only; closed Tuesday and Friday.

chef_bio.background: Per a September 2024 reviewer, established in 1990 and loved by locals. Reviewers (2021–2026) describe an antique-feeling shop with a cake case at the front and a café at the back.
chef_bio.specialty: Cream puffs; chestnut Mon Carré.

anecdotes.text: A May 2022 visitor took cream puffs to the Kamo delta, remembering a hawk that once snatched a snack there.
An August 2025 guest smelled eggs and butter on entering and paired a cream puff and pudding with iced coffee.
A March 2026 regular struggled to put into words how good the chestnut Mon Carré was.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ル・シュクリエ、ケーキ・カフェ、上京区寺町通今出川上ル表町21 市川ビル1F、出町柳駅から徒歩約8分、月水木土 11:30〜18:30、日曜はカフェ14時から、火金定休、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、15席、禁煙、テイクアウト。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 1990年創業、地元に愛される洋菓子店、店の奥のカフェ、何種類かのシュークリーム、柑橘のクリーム、砂糖漬けの栗とラムのマロンクリームの Mon Carré、スパイスキャラメル、チーズケーキ、ベリーのショートケーキ、プリン、深煎りのアイスコーヒー、アンティークな雰囲気、出町桝形商店街への途中、鴨川デルタで食べる人も。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; small café at the back.

places.name: 京町 (Kyo Machi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto courses with sashimi, grilled ayu, eel dishes and sukiyaki (2022–25 reviews); the restaurant asks about food preferences (December 2023). No gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based Kyoto courses with eel, ayu and beef sukiyaki (2023–25 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed Sunday (some Sundays) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; walk-ins have been seated if ordering a course (Tabelog; June 2011). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). Private tatami rooms for 2–6, some looking over the Kamo river (Tabelog; March 2024). Designated smoking area (Tabelog). An old townhouse on Pontocho north of Shijo (Tabelog; 2010–25 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, north of Shijo — on the Kamo river
places.cuisine: Kyoto courses and sukiyaki in an old Pontocho townhouse (2010–25 reviews) · an eel-themed course: Arima-yaki, sashimi, clear soup with eel and radish cake, grilled ayu, ginger rice, vinegared eel and cucumber (June 2025) · course with sukiyaki (October 2025; December 2023) · steamed turnip, about ¥4,000 per person (December 2022)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Pontocho, an old townhouse on the river] A long-standing Pontocho townhouse with private tatami rooms, some looking over the Kamo river, serving delicate Kyoto courses — eel-themed in summer, with grilled ayu and ginger rice — and sukiyaki, at fair prices for Pontocho. A guest of 40 years (2014 review) recalls koto music playing throughout. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant in a townhouse on Pontocho. An August 2014 review comes from a guest of 40 years; a December 2022 review describes an attentive owner, decorative roofs, punched walls and an antique telephone.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto courses; sukiyaki.

anecdotes.text: An August 2014 guest of 40 years remembered the koto playing throughout the house.
A June 2025 diner had an eel-themed course by the river, from Arima-yaki to vinegared eel and cucumber.
A December 2022 visitor came for the steamed turnip on the menu and praised the ring of sake poured from the tokkuri.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区先斗町通四条上ル梅之木町156、月〜土17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、日曜休み (一部)、予約可、カード可、個室 (2〜6名)、座敷、分煙、鴨川の眺め、町家。口コミ (2010年2月〜2025年10月、英語): 40年来の客、琴の音、鰻づくしのコース (Arima-yaki、刺身、鰻と大根餅の吸い物、鮎の焼き物、生姜ご飯、鰻ときゅうりの酢の物)、すき焼きのコース、蒸したかぶ、1人約4,000円、川の見える個室、好みを聞いてくれる。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course and ask for a river-view room; tell the staff about food preferences. No English evidence found.

places.name: 三汁五菜 天心 (Sanju Gosai Tenshin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, yuba and hot pots of duck, beef, hamo or anko (2022–25 reviews); no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based obanzai with fish, beef tendon, duck and beef hot pots (2022–25 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 16:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 35 seats incl. a counter; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Designated smoking area (Tabelog). Service can be slow when busy (November 2022; November 2023). On Pontocho north of Shijo, 3 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog). Opened 8 April 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho, north of Shijo — Kyoto-Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: Healthy obanzai and hot pots mixing Japanese, Western, Chinese and Korean ideas with fresh vegetables, fish and meat (Tabelog) · three obanzai with a choice of hot pot — duck, beef or hamo — with rice and pickles, about ¥1,780–1,800 at midday (September 2022; May 2023) · yuba; braised beef tendon (October 2025) · anko hot pot with three obanzai and sake (December 2025) · sukiyaki and shabu-shabu (June and November 2023) · sake such as Marutake Ebisu, Joyo and Tamano Hikari (December 2025)
places.notes: [Obanzai and hot pots · Pontocho, open from 4 pm] A relaxed Pontocho izakaya serving trios of obanzai with a one-person hot pot — duck, beef, hamo or anko — plus yuba, braised beef tendon and Kyoto sake, from mid-afternoon. Casual by Pontocho standards; service can be slow at busy times.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant opened in April 2011 serving healthy dishes of fresh vegetables, chosen seafood and meat, blending Japanese, Western, Chinese and Korean styles.
chef_bio.philosophy: Healthy, nutritious dishes from fresh vegetables, fish and meat (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai with one-person hot pots.

anecdotes.text: A September 2022 visitor who missed out on riverside dining found a set of three obanzai with hamo and duck hot pots for ¥1,780.
A December 2025 diner was invited in from the street and had a anko hot pot with three sakes.
A November 2023 group waited over 15 minutes for menus and never received the shabu-shabu ladle.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区先斗町四条上ル下樵木町200-3、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、毎日16:00〜23:00、予約可、カード可、35席、カウンター、貸切20〜50名、分煙、2011年4月8日オープン、新鮮な野菜と魚介と肉の和洋中韓の健康的な料理。口コミ (2022年4月〜2025年12月、英語): おばんざい3品と選べる鍋 (鴨、牛、鱧) にご飯と香の物で約1,780〜1,800円、湯葉、牛すじの煮込み、anko の鍋、すき焼き、しゃぶしゃぶ、日本酒、混むと提供が遅い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order an obanzai trio with a hot pot; open from mid-afternoon. No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an all-you-can-eat izakaya with fried dishes, yakitori in tare, sushi and hot pots (2024–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: yakitori, sushi, seafood and offal hot pots (2024–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). 155 seats, with semi-private rooms; shares the floor with the crab-buffet restaurant Kani Gin (Tabelog; October 2025; February and April 2026). Order by QR code, with the remaining time shown (February 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). No sign at street level — take the lift to 5F of Kawaramachi DECK by COAST, 3 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 1 August 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kawaramachi, north of Takoyakushi — Kyoto-Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: All-you-can-eat-and-drink yakitori, sushi, seafood and hot pots from about ¥3,000 (2024–26 reviews) · most popular course ¥3,500 (December 2024; April 2026); beer and highball add-on +¥500 (August 2026) · yakitori by the skewer and sushi by the piece (February 2026) · hot pots: chanko, motsu and chige; a chicken hot pot (February and April 2026)
places.notes: [All-you-can-eat izakaya · Kawaramachi, yakitori, sushi and hot pots] A 155-seat izakaya on the fifth floor of a Kawaramachi building, sharing the floor with the crab buffet Kani Gin: all-you-can-eat-and-drink courses from about ¥3,000 with yakitori by the skewer, sushi by the piece and chanko, motsu or chicken hot pots, ordered by QR code. Mixed reviews on how freshly the food is made.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an all-you-can-eat izakaya opened in August 2024, with sister shops in Nagoya Kanayama, Umeda and Kobe Sannomiya; the official site belongs to 株式会社WILL, which also runs Kani Gin (on the same floor and already listed).
chef_bio.specialty: All-you-can-eat yakitori, sushi and hot pots.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor liked that the QR menu shows the time left on the all-you-can-eat plan.
A March 2025 diner found the dishes reheated and the salt yakitori cold.
An April 2026 visitor recommends the chicken hot pot on the ¥3,500 course.

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code; take the lift to 5F (no street sign). No English evidence found.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef tongue, wagyu offal, shrimp mayo, dashimaki (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–0:00 (last order 23:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (last order 22:00) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; seat type cannot be guaranteed (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). 34 seats incl. a counter and sofas (Tabelog). Heated tobacco only inside; ashtrays outside for cigarettes (Tabelog). Appetizer ¥350 (April 2026). Weekend happy hour 12:00–16:00 with drinks from ¥298 (February 2026); all-you-can-drink, also for solo diners (September 2026). Medina Shijo Tominokoji 1F, 1 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi exit 12 (Tabelog). Opened 27 August 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Tominokoji, just north of Shijo — Kyoto-Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: Seasonal teppan dishes and sake, with a signature teppan dashimaki filled to your choice (Tabelog) · thick-cut beef tongue with green onion and salt ¥1,100, wagyu offal ¥980, dashimaki ¥880, shrimp mayo ¥600, thick shiitake with bonito ponzu ¥520 (April 2026) · corn kara-age, cheese teppan gyoza (August 2026) · salmon cutlet, fried taro (May 2026) · shumai and fried spring rolls (September 2026) · a dice game, "chinchiro", for drinks (May and June 2026)
places.notes: [Teppan izakaya · Shijo Tominokoji, dashimaki your way] A friendly 34-seat teppan izakaya a minute from Kawaramachi exit 12, known for a build-your-own teppan dashimaki, thick salted beef tongue and wagyu offal, with a weekend afternoon happy hour from ¥298, all-you-can-drink even for one, and a dice game for drinks. ¥350 appetizer.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a teppan izakaya, "an adult tavern of seasonal ingredients, teppan and sake", opened in August 2022; a sister shop, 農家野菜 フタゴヤ, is in Pontocho. A September 2026 regular reports a recent renovation and a new menu.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients and dishes that go with drinks (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan dashimaki.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular on an eighth visit was offered free snacks while new dishes took time, after a renovation.
An August 2026 solo diner found a message written on the oshibori.
A September 2026 former regular found the menu halved and prices higher, and the kamameshi soggy.

cultural_comfort.note: Try the build-your-own dashimaki; heated tobacco only inside. No English evidence found.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: prosciutto, roast beef, duck and Bolognese in the courses (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); lunch suspended for now; open all year. Reservations taken. Charge ¥300 a person — Tabelog, Japanese original 「お一人様につき300円」; riverside seats on the summer deck (kawayuka) cost ¥1,000 a person more (September 2026). 90 seats: sofas, a terrace over the Kamo River and a second floor used in rain. Non-smoking. English menu; children and strollers welcome; free Wi-Fi. Cards, e-money and PayPay. Pontocho south of Sanjo. Formerly みます屋 イタリアーノ (Tabelog); its listed website is on the same domain as The みます屋 in Pontocho.
places.neighborhood: Pontocho south of Sanjo, on the Kamo River — 5 min walk from Sanjo
places.cuisine: A large Pontocho Italian with a summer deck over the Kamo River (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · courses with all-you-can-drink: five antipasti, garlic baguette, prosciutto salad, arancini with shrimp sauce, roast beef, Bolognese, mango pudding with grapefruit jelly (May 2026) · kawayuka course during Gion Matsuri, antipasto to dolce (July 2026) · duck, pasta and appetizers; a celebration plate on request (October 2026) · a wide wine list; cocktails off the menu on request (May and October 2026)
places.notes: [Italian · Pontocho on the Kamo River, a riverside deck at fair prices] A big, friendly Italian on Pontocho with a summer deck over the river and a covered upstairs for rain: course menus with free-flow drinks, pasta, roast beef and duck. Reviewers call it good value for the location; some found pasta salty or courses served out of order. ¥300 charge, plus ¥1,000 for deck seats. Dinner only, daily.

chef_bio.background: Formerly みます屋 イタリアーノ (Tabelog), it shares its listed web domain (the-la-mart.com) with The みます屋 in Pontocho, which is already in data. Reviewers in 2025–2026 praise attentive staff and value; criticism covers slow service at Christmas (December 2025), slightly salty spaghetti (February 2026) and a main course served before the pasta "due to kitchen constraints" (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Italian courses on the riverside deck.

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "we encountered a sudden thunderstorm during our meal, but the staff promptly assisted us in moving to a second-floor seating area… they even remade the dishes we had already started eating."
October 2026: "I appreciated that the prices were not inflated like many tourist spots."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: IL BUCO (旧店名 みます屋 イタリアーノ)、イタリアン・日本料理・創作料理、中京区若松町140-2、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、ランチは当面休み、無休、予約可、原文で「お一人様につき300円」、90席、ソファ、テラス、禁煙、英語メニュー、子供・ベビーカー可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、法人会員。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 鴨川の納涼床、飲み放題付きのコース、前菜5種、ガーリックバゲット、生ハムのサラダ、アランチーニ、ローストビーフ、ボロネーゼ、マンゴープリン、鴨、ワイン、床席は追加で1人1,000円 (2026年9月)、雨の日は2階へ、パスタが少し塩辛い (2026年2月)、料理の順番違い (2026年7月)、提供が遅い (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; summer riverside deck.

places.name: UFO
places.gf_detail: Ask: some ice creams contain meringue, cookie or cheesecake pieces; one reviewer saw allergy notes (March 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: milk ice creams and cheesecake (2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–23:00; hours may change. Reservations advised — often full even on weekdays (March 2026; July 2026); one drink per person (July 2026). Table, counter and standing spots along the wall, plus a terrace (June 2026). Non-smoking. Cards, e-money and QR (PayPay). 5th floor of 御幸町ビル on Gokomachi, between Shijo and Oike; no prominent sign (October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Gokomachi between Shijo and Oike — 5–6 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: A night ice-cream bar on a 5th floor, with homemade ice cream, coffee, wine and mead (2026 reviews) · homemade ice cream ¥660, flavours that change — salt and olive-oil vanilla, strawberry rosemary, Sichuan pepper and cream cheese, chai chocolate, caramel baked meringue, brown-sugar banana, pineapple lime, chocolate cardamom (2026) · oolong Basque cheesecake (2026) · celebration plates to order, e.g. chocolate-and-strawberry Eton mess (March 2026) · coffee brewed to order; wine and mead (2026)
places.notes: [Ice-cream bar · Gokomachi, homemade scoops till 11 pm] A dim, stylish 5th-floor night café where young crowds book ahead for homemade ice cream in odd flavours — salt and olive oil, strawberry rosemary, Sichuan pepper and cream cheese — with wine, mead or a latte. One drink each. A June 2026 terrace guest found the service hard to flag down. Open daily from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from February to October 2026 describe a popular ice-cream and drinks bar, almost full by 20:30 even on weekdays, with a changing list of homemade ice creams and coffee made to order. Criticism: the ice cream is "a bit pricey" (July 2026), the oolong cheesecake "a bit dry" (March 2026), and on the windy terrace it was hard to call staff (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade ice cream.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "Located on the top floor, there's a slight chance of being abducted by aliens, but it's the 5th floor."
June 2026: "The coffee is brewed fresh from the machine after you order, filling the elevator with a wonderful aroma."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: UFO、カフェ・バー、中京区伊勢屋町346 御幸町ビル 5F、京都河原町から404m、毎日 17:00〜23:00、時間は変わることがある、予約可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): 夜のアイスクリームとお酒の店、自家製アイス660円、塩とオリーブオイルのバニラ、いちごとローズマリー、花椒とクリームチーズ、チャイチョコレート、キャラメルの焼きメレンゲ、黒糖バナナ、パイナップルライム、チョコレートとカルダモン、烏龍茶のバスクチーズケーキ、お祝いのプレート、コーヒー、ワイン、ミード、ワンドリンク制、予約がおすすめ、テラス席、アイスはやや高め。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; one drink per person.

places.name: きはる (Kiharu)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura and fries in every course, homemade hishio (a soy-type sauce) for sashimi and soy-grilled dishes (2022–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led Kyoto cooking with dashi throughout (2021–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu, Sat, Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); Wed and Fri dinner only; closed Tuesday. Reservations taken; a May 2026 reviewer says all seats are by reservation. 18 seats: 6 at the counter, 3 at a table downstairs and a private room upstairs for 4–8, one group a day. Non-smoking (smoking spot outside). Cards in the evening only; no e-money or QR. Down a long narrow passage off Yanaginobanba below Ayanokoji. Opened 22 May 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Yanaginobanba below Ayanokoji — 6–7 min walk from Shijo / Karasuma
places.cuisine: A hidden alley restaurant for Kyoto cooking, with a counter of small plates (mamezara) and a private room for kaiseki or hotpot courses (Tabelog; 2021–2026 reviews) · lunch about ¥3,400 (2022), ¥3,800 (May 2024), bento ¥4,300 (May 2026): sashimi, roast beef with white-sesame dressing, simmered dish, tempura, clay-pot rice with refills, homemade ice cream · mamezara course: dozens of bite-size dishes until you say stop — isaki sushi, hamo with bone broth, Akashi squid, ayu salt-grilled after you see it live, soy-grilled eggplant (June 2024; September 2026) · homemade hishio for sashimi; very rich homemade tofu; hamo shabu-shabu; tai chazuke (2022–2026) · sake by omakase, fruit liqueurs, fig soda (2022; 2026)
places.notes: [Kyoto cooking · Yanaginobanba alley, small plates and homemade hishio] A tucked-away alley restaurant where a chatty counter serves a stream of tiny seasonal plates — hamo, Akashi squid, live-grilled ayu, rich homemade tofu — with house hishio for the sashimi, and good-value lunches with clay-pot rice. Booking needed; cards at night only. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 22 May 2018 (Tabelog). A September 2023 reviewer explains the name: one character from Kikuya in Miyagawa-cho, where the owner had worked, and the welcome "Kiharu" ("come in"). Reviewers since 2021 praise careful seasonal cooking, generous portions for the price and lively talk at the counter; one August 2026 diner found a tough piece in the fish tempura.
chef_bio.specialty: Mamezara small plates; homemade hishio.

anecdotes.text: September 2022: "any leftovers could be made into onigiri (rice balls) to take home as a souvenir."
June 2024: "Salt-grilled sweetfish (we were shown live sweetfish before cooking!)."
April 2026: friends from Nara "jokingly said, 'Please guide us when we come again; we wouldn't be able to find it ourselves.'"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: きはる、日本料理、下京区柳馬場綾小路下る永原町147-2、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩6分、月・木・土・日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、水・金は夜のみ、火曜休み、予約可、18席 (カウンター6、テーブル3、2階の個室8)、個室は1日1組、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、カードは夜のみ、電子マネー・QR不可、2018年5月22日オープン、カウンターで豆皿料理、2階で会席や鍋のコース、法人会員。口コミ (2021年3月〜2026年9月、英語): 路地の奥の隠れ家、自家製のひしお、土鍋ご飯のおかわりと持ち帰りのおにぎり、昼3,400円 (2022年)・3,800円 (2024年)・弁当4,300円 (2026年5月)、鱧、明石のいか、目の前で見せる鮎の塩焼き、濃い自家製豆腐、鱧しゃぶ、鯛茶漬け、自家製アイス、日本酒のおまかせ、店名は宮川町の Kikuya から一字と「来はる」(2023年9月)、魚の天ぷらに硬い部分 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Hidden alley; book ahead; cards at dinner only.

places.name: バー プレジャー (Bar Pleasure)
places.gf_detail: Ask: cocktails and tequila may suit; the cover snacks are not described (Tabelog; 2016–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask: cocktails, including non-alcoholic ones made to your taste (February 2025); snacks not described.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Thu 18:00–23:00; Fri 18:00–01:00; Sat 15:00–01:00; Sun and holidays 15:00–23:00; closed Monday (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday). Reservations taken; private hire up to 20; event nights sometimes fill it (March 2019). Charge ¥300 with snacks; stays over an hour need another order — Tabelog, Japanese original 「チャージ料￥300（スナック付き） 1時間以上の滞在の場合、追加オーダーを頂戴します。」. 20 seats (12 counter, 8 table) and standing room. Smoking allowed. English menu; projector; free Wi-Fi. Cards; no e-money. 3rd floor of 洋燈館ビル. Opened 19 April 2012 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Aburaya-cho, Nakagyo — 10 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: A music bar devoted to B'z: their songs and live videos play all night and the cocktails are named after their songs (2016–2025 reviews) · song-titled cocktails, e.g. "Giri Giri chop" (white wine and muscat) and "Love Me, I Love You" (gin and muscat), from ¥800 plus 10% service and tax (February 2016) · a HINOTORI cocktail; a fixed-price first drink with retro snacks, about ¥1,500 (March 2019) · original cocktails, alcoholic or not, made to your taste; tequila from a certified tequila maestro (December 2023; February 2025)
places.notes: [B'z music bar · Aburaya-cho, songs, videos and cocktails by title] A third-floor bar for fans of the rock duo B'z — their music and concert videos all night, merchandise on the walls and cocktails named after their songs, mixed by a master who will also make anything (alcohol-free too) to your taste. ¥300 cover with snacks. Smoking allowed. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 19 April 2012 (Tabelog). Reviewers since 2016 describe a "second hometown for B'z fans" (May 2017) where strangers bond over the band; the master holds a tequila certification (December 2023) and makes original cocktails, including non-alcoholic ones, from a described flavour or mood (February 2025). One February 2016 reviewer found the drinks heavy on ice for the price.
chef_bio.specialty: B'z-titled cocktails.

anecdotes.text: February 2025: "I left my drink choice to the master and opted for something refreshing… he can create original cocktails (including non-alcoholic options) based on the flavors I describe."
May 2017: "This place is like a second hometown for B'z fans! It's the perfect spot to quickly make friends with fellow fans inside the bar."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー プレジャー、バー・ワインバー・ダイニングバー、中京区油屋町145 洋燈館ビル 3F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩10分、火〜木 18:00〜23:00、金 18:00〜翌1:00、土 15:00〜翌1:00、日祝 15:00〜23:00、月曜休み (祝日なら翌日)、予約可、貸切20名まで、原文で「チャージ料￥300（スナック付き） 1時間以上の滞在の場合、追加オーダーを頂戴します。」、20席 (カウンター12、テーブル8)、立ち飲み、喫煙可、英語メニュー、プロジェクター、カード可、電子マネー不可、2012年4月19日オープン、法人会員。口コミ (2016年2月〜2025年11月、英語): B'z のバー、曲とライブ映像、グッズ、曲名のカクテル (800円から、サービス料10%と税、2016年)、HINOTORI カクテル、1杯目は定額で駄菓子付き (2019年)、テキーラの資格を持つマスター、好みで作るオリジナルカクテルとノンアルコール、氷が多いという声 (2016年)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; fan bar for B'z; smoking allowed.

places.name: 祇園おばんざい ぎんや (Gion Obanzai Gin'ya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, sashimi, oden, saba sushi, tempura and sukiyaki, seasoned with soy and dashi; no gluten information (official site; 2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based obanzai with fish and meat dishes (official site; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). The shop’s own site gives 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30). Reservations essential — walk-ins not accepted (March 2025). Otoshi charged (Tabelog, original お通し代あり). Cards, IC cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: 8 at the counter and a tatami room for 4–6 (Tabelog). In Gion Shirakawa facing the Kamo River, 2 min from exit 9 of Gion-Shijo Station (Tabelog; March 2025). Opened 18 January 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion Shirakawa by the Kamo — 2 min from Gion-Shijo exit 9
places.cuisine: An obanzai counter run by a proprietress, with a head chef in the kitchen (March 2025) · obanzai such as spicy konnyaku, simmered okara, braised shellfish, potato salad, kinpira, nanohana with mustard, simmered shrimp-yam (2025) · sashimi platters including sardine rolls; yokowa tataki; jidori and beef sashimi (2025) · saba sushi, sardines simmered with ume, assorted oden (official site) · dashimaki, shirauo tempura, fried oysters, venison steak, A5 Wagyu sukiyaki with udon (2025) · sake mostly from Yamagata, chosen for dryness (February 2025)
places.notes: [Obanzai · Gion by the Kamo, a proprietress’s counter] A cosy obanzai counter facing the Kamo River in Gion, where the proprietress chats in Kyoto dialect and the head chef sends out platters of obanzai, sardine-roll sashimi, oden, saba sushi and sukiyaki, with dry Yamagata sake. Reservations essential; closed Sundays and holidays.

chef_bio.background: The official site refers to the okami (proprietress). Reviewers describe a friendly owner with charming Kyoto dialect and a head chef in charge of the food (March 2025); one calls the owner beautiful and a joy to talk to (March 2025). The owner explained that the sake is mostly from Yamagata because guests prefer dry sake (February 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai; sardine rolls.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 guest on a second visit was remembered by name.
A January 2025 diner ordered every obanzai on the board and stayed from 18:00 to about 21:00.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 祇園おばんざい ぎんや、18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日曜・祝日休み、鯖寿司、いわしの梅煮、おでんの盛り合わせ、カウンターと個室、女将。食べログ: 日本料理、東山区弁財天町14 エクセタコート1F、祇園四条駅9番出口から徒歩2分、月〜土 17:30〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、日祝休み、お通し代あり、カード・電子マネー可、14席 (カウンター8、座敷4〜6)、2024年1月18日オープン。口コミ (2025年、英語): 予約必須で飛び込み不可、ピリ辛こんにゃく、おから、貝の煮物、ポテサラ、きんぴら、菜の花の辛子和え、海老芋の炊いたん、いわしの巻物の刺身、よこわのたたき、地鶏や牛の刺身、だし巻き、白魚の天ぷら、カキフライ、鹿のステーキ、A5和牛のすき焼きとうどん、山形の辛口の日本酒、京ことばの女将、料理長。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; counter chat in Kyoto dialect; otoshi charged.

places.name: 京料理 旬味旬彩 太一 (Kyoryori Shunmi Shunsai Taichi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki courses — sashimi, soups, grilled fish, fugu and game dishes, tempura; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, fugu and game courses built on dashi (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (L.O. food 12:30); dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O. food 20:00, drinks 21:30); open daily; Japanese-style afternoon tea from 13:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; requests for celebrations taken (Tabelog; 2025–2026). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, original 席料10％). Cards and Edy (Tabelog). 40 seats: 5 at the counter, tables on the ground floor overlooking a garden, and private rooms upstairs (Tabelog; May 2025). On Ayanokoji east of Yanaginobamba, 6–7 min from Shijo or Karasuma stations (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Ayanokoji-Yanaginobamba, south of Shijo — near Shijo-Karasuma
places.cuisine: Kaiseki in a Kyoto machiya with private rooms and a courtyard garden; Kyoto vegetables and game from Rakuhoku (Tabelog; August 2026) · seasonal courses themed on events — the Gion Matsuri (July 2025), the Daimonji fire festival (August 2026); menus personalised for celebrations (June 2026) · fugu course with grilled fugu, tecchiri hot pot and porridge, free-flow drinks available (November 2025) · Shogoin daikon, fugu monaka, boar (January 2026) · grilled ayu (June 2026) · à la carte on the ground floor; Japanese afternoon tea from 13:00 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Ayanokoji near Shijo-Karasuma, private rooms] A machiya kaiseki restaurant with private rooms upstairs and a courtyard garden, serving seasonal courses themed on Kyoto’s festivals — plus fugu, Rakuhoku game and Kyoto vegetables — and personalising menus for birthdays and business dinners. Lunch, dinner and afternoon tea; 10% service charge.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T4810587676802 is registered to the individual 横井 勇一郎 (NTA register). A May 2025 diner was pleased that the head chef came to explain the dishes; reviewers describe courses themed on the season and menus printed with guests’ names for celebrations (2025–2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; fugu.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 family birthday was given a menu bearing the family’s names and the occasion.
An October 2026 visitor staying in Namba for the Osaka Expo came to Kyoto for the kaiseki and plans to return on every Kansai trip.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京料理 旬味旬彩 太一、日本料理・ふぐ・天ぷら、下京区綾小路柳馬場東入ル塩屋町43、地下鉄四条駅から徒歩6分、昼11:30〜14:30、夜17:00〜22:00、無休、13時からの和のアフタヌーンティー、席料10%、カード可、40席 (カウンター5)、個室あり、京町家、京野菜と洛北のジビエ、ふぐのコース、適格請求書 T4810587676802 (横井 勇一郎)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 祇園祭や五山送り火に見立てた献立、名前入りのお祝いの献立、料理長が料理を説明、ふぐのコース (焼きふぐ、てっちり、雑炊、飲み放題)、聖護院大根、ふぐの最中、猪、鮎の塩焼き、中庭。

cultural_comfort.note: Private rooms; 10% service charge; celebrations catered for.

places.name: うなぎと串料理 うなたま (Unagi to Kushi Ryori Unatama)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled eel with tare over rice and dashimaki, eel skewers, fried eel and kushi-age; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel and skewer restaurant (Tabelog; reviews).
places.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00) daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 40 seats — counter, tables and a tatami room at the back; private rooms for 4 and 6 (Tabelog; June 2026). Leftover rice from the big bowl can be taken home as onigiri (June 2026). On the ground floor of the 原正ビル near Kiyamachi, 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog). Opened 1 June 2026 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kiyamachi south of Sanjo — 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi
places.cuisine: An eel-and-skewer izakaya opened June 2026 (Tabelog) · towering unatama-don: grilled eel on a thick dashimaki over 600 g of tare-soaked rice, ¥3,280 (June–August 2026) · eel skewers ¥380 each; eel liver skewers; a three-skewer eel platter (June–July 2026) · dashimaki topped with sweet-spicy beef ¥480; fried eel with eggplant ¥880 (June 2026) · shirayaki and kabayaki eel; unaju (July–August 2026) · kushi-age (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Eel izakaya · Kiyamachi, the towering unatama-don] A new eel-and-skewer izakaya near Kiyamachi, built around a photogenic bowl of grilled eel stacked on a thick dashimaki over 600 g of rice (¥3,280) — leftovers go home as onigiri — with eel skewers, liver and kushi-age. Open every evening until midnight.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text pitches the towering unatama-don as the signature. Reviewers describe friendly staff (July 2026); one August 2026 diner wondered whether the eel was charcoal-grilled, given its soft skin.
chef_bio.specialty: Towering unatama-don.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor who could not finish the 600 g bowl took the rest home as onigiri.
A July 2026 diner, having ordered shirayaki, kabayaki, liver and dashimaki, admitted to perhaps over-ordering.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うなぎと串料理 うなたま、うなぎ・串揚げ・居酒屋、中京区山崎町258-23 原正ビル1F、河原町駅から徒歩5分、毎日17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、40席、4名・6名の個室、2026年6月1日オープン、名物の盛り盛りうなたま丼。口コミ (2026年、英語): うなたま丼3,280円 (だし巻きに鰻、ご飯600g)、残りはおにぎりで持ち帰り、うなぎ串380円、肝串、うなぎ串3種盛り、甘辛牛のせだし巻き480円、うなぎと茄子の揚げ物880円、白焼きと蒲焼き、うな重、カウンター・テーブル・奥の座敷。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual izakaya; leftovers can be taken home.

places.name: 御菓子司 かぎ甚 (Okashi Tsukasa Kagijin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Wagashi — Ebisu-yaki of chofu dough (egg and flour) with red-bean paste, ayu of mostly rice flour with mochi, sakura mochi, mizu-yokan; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Many wagashi are bean, rice and sugar, but the Ebisu-yaki dough contains egg and nothing is labelled vegan (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday, Thursday–Sunday 9:00–17:00; Tuesday 9:00–16:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Takeaway shop. No cards; e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). During the Toka Ebisu festival in January the shop bakes Ebisu-yaki at a stall out front, and queues form (January 2025 and 2026). On Yamato-oji south of Shijo near Kyoto Ebisu Shrine (Tabelog; reviews).
places.neighborhood: Yamato-oji south of Shijo — by Kyoto Ebisu Shrine
places.cuisine: A wagashi shop founded in 1921, a reviewer notes (January 2025) · Ebisu-yaki, chofu-style cakes of red-bean paste stamped with Ebisu’s face, sold at New Year’s Toka Ebisu (¥250 each, January 2026) and around the Ebisu festival in October (2025–2026) · ayu, a pale, chewy rice-flour sweet with mochi, in early summer (June 2025) · sakura mochi in white and sakura versions for Hinamatsuri (March 2026) · white-miso mizu-yokan with sansho, ¥1,080 (May 2026) · minazuki in June (July 2026)
places.notes: [Wagashi · Yamato-oji by Ebisu Shrine, since 1921] An old neighbourhood wagashi shop beside Kyoto Ebisu Shrine, famous for the Ebisu-yaki it bakes out front during the New Year Toka Ebisu (¥250), with seasonal sweets through the year — chewy rice-flour ayu, sakura mochi, white-miso mizu-yokan. Takeaway; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A January 2025 reviewer calls it a wagashi shop founded in 1921 that now styles its name “Kagi Jin”, with live demonstrations of Ebisu-yaki at the festival stall.
chef_bio.specialty: Ebisu-yaki.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 worshipper lined up before opening after returning the old lucky bamboo at Toka Ebisu.
An October 2025 passer-by caught the Ebisu-yaki on sale out of season for the Ebisu festival.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 御菓子司 かぎ甚、和菓子、東山区大和大路通四条小松140、祇園四条駅から318m、月・木〜日 9:00〜17:00、火 9:00〜16:00、水曜定休、カード不可、電子マネー・QR決済可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 1921年創業、十日ゑびすのEbisu-yaki (1個250円、店先で実演販売、行列)、10月の Ebisu festivalにも、初夏の鮎 (米粉が多くもちもち)、ひな祭りの桜餅 (白と桜)、白味噌の水ようかん (山椒付き) 1,080円、水無月、京都ゑびす神社のそば。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway counter; no cards; long queues during Toka Ebisu.

places.name: プラチナビーフ (Platinum Beef)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled steak, but pasta, a katsu sandwich and sauces are also served (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu steak bar (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–15:00 (lunch by booking by 22:00 the day before) and 18:00–24:00; may close early when sold out; irregular closures — call ahead (Tabelog). Bookings taken, with cancellation fees: ¥5,000 the day before; ¥10,000 same day with notice; ¥100,000 for a same-day no-show (Tabelog). Table charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「チャージあり 1名/490円(税別)」 — ¥490 per person plus tax. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). The owner speaks English (August 2025 review). 2F of the Gion Moriya building, above a well-known steakhouse, on Yamatooji south of Shijo; 3 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; July 2025 review).
places.neighborhood: Yamatooji south of Shijo, Gion — 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Lean wagyu steak bar (2025–26 reviews): the chef's choice of three beef cuts — 600 g for three in October 2026 — a steak omakase and a tasting course; assorted appetizers with yukhoe, roast-beef salad, prosciutto, pasta; a katsu sandwich to take away; wine and fruit-laden cocktails (2025–26 reviews)
places.notes: [Steak bar · Gion] A calm second-floor steak bar off Yamatooji serving tender lean wagyu — three cuts chosen by the chef — with yukhoe, roast-beef salad and pasta, and wine; the owner speaks English. About ¥10,000–15,000 at night. ¥490 charge; strict cancellation fees.

chef_bio.background: A Gion steak bar; reviewers describe a kind owner who speaks English (July and August 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Lean wagyu steak.

anecdotes.text: Three men aged 50 to 69 planning a trip in October 2026 expected tough lean beef from the price and found the chef's 600 g of three cuts juicy and tender.
A regular since 2023 calls it a choice for special days: lean meat that never feels heavy (July 2026).
A May 2025 diner had the three-cut steak omakase and planned to try the takeaway katsu sandwich next.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: プラチナビーフ、鉄板焼き・ステーキ・バル、東山区大和大路通四条下ル大和町7 祇園モーリヤビル 2F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、毎日 12:00〜15:00 (昼は前日22時までに予約)・18:00〜24:00 (品切れで早じまいあり)、不定休、予約可、キャンセル料 (前日5,000円、当日連絡あり10,000円、当日無連絡100,000円)、チャージ1名490円 (税別)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 赤身の和牛、おまかせのステーキ3種 (3人で600g)、テイスティングコース、ユッケ入りの前菜の盛り合わせ、ローストビーフのサラダ、生ハム、パスタ、持ち帰りのカツサンド、ワイン、果物たっぷりのカクテル、英語の話せる店主、有名なステーキ店の上の階。

cultural_comfort.note: The owner speaks English.

places.name: pua'a (プアア)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-wrapper dumplings (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork and shrimp dumplings, saliva chicken (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 16:00–23:00; closed Sunday, Monday and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). No bookings; no cards (Tabelog). A tiny standing counter for about five, lively with regulars who make room for newcomers (August 2025, February and April 2026 reviews). In 四富会館, the old drinking arcade at Tominokoji-Shijo, about 4 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; April 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Shitomi Kaikan, Tominokoji north of Shijo — 4 min from Kawaramachi Stn
places.cuisine: Gyoza and Chinese snacks at a standing bar (2025–26 reviews): boiled dumplings, shrimp dumplings with chives, pan-fried gyoza, mapo tofu, spicy shredded potato, saliva chicken
places.notes: [Gyoza standing bar · Shitomi Kaikan] A five-person standing counter in the Shitomi Kaikan drinking arcade, where regulars squeeze up for newcomers: plump boiled and shrimp dumplings, pan-fried gyoza, mapo tofu and saliva chicken from 16:00. About ¥2,000–3,000. No cards.

chef_bio.background: Opened 13 October 2022 (Tabelog). "pua'a" is Hawaiian for pig (November 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Boiled dumplings.

anecdotes.text: Ending a Nagoya-Osaka tour in November 2025, a returning visitor came back after two and a half years for the owner's dedicated gyoza.
A nervous first-timer in August 2025 was soon chatting with the staff and regulars over boiled dumplings.
Dropping in at 16:00 in February 2026 for an early drink, a visitor squeezed in and had boiled and pan-fried dumplings and mapo tofu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: pua'a、餃子、中京区富小路通四条上る西大文字町615 四富会館、京都河原町駅から333m、火〜土 16:00〜23:00、日月祝休み、予約不可、カード不可、2022年10月13日オープン。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年4月、英語): 5人ほどの立ち飲みのカウンター、常連と店の人が温かい、水餃子、エビとニラの水餃子、焼き餃子、麻婆豆腐、辛い細切りじゃがいも、よだれ鶏、pua'a はハワイ語で豚。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny standing bar of regulars.

places.name: 和 藤たて (Wa Fujitate)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Simmered and grilled fish, but tempura bowls and fried fish are central; tempura can be eaten with salt (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, eel and tempura with dashi (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX) and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). About 8 counter seats and a table for 4 downstairs, a tatami room for about 8 upstairs (June 2025 and August 2026 reviews). A little west of Hanamikoji, south of Shijo (February 2025 review).
places.neighborhood: South of Shijo, west of Hanamikoji — Gion
places.cuisine: Japanese set lunches and evening dishes with sake (2025–26 reviews): shrimp tempura rice bowl ¥1,100 with miso soup (February 2025), sea-bream head simmered in a set ¥1,100 (October 2026), fried flatfish set, lunch sets with tempura; at night grilled ayu, fig tempura, steamed eel rice and seasonal dishes with a wide sake choice
places.notes: [Japanese set lunches · Gion] A clean little Japanese restaurant just south of Shijo with good-value lunches — a shrimp tempura bowl or simmered sea-bream set for about ¥1,100 — and seasonal dishes like grilled ayu and steamed eel rice with sake at night, upstairs on tatami for groups. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A Japanese restaurant near Gion-Shijo, reviewed from 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura rice bowl; sea-bream set.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 lunch guest had a large rice with the ¥1,100 shrimp tempura bowl and asked for more miso soup.
In July 2025 a diner asked to eat the set's tempura with salt rather than dipping sauce, and the kitchen obliged.
A group of seven on a hot August 2026 night had the upstairs tatami room, extra fans and steamed eel rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和 藤たて、日本料理・海鮮・天ぷら、東山区亀井町59、祇園四条駅から186m、月・火・木〜日 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、水曜休み、予約可、カード (JCB、AMEX)・QR 可、電子マネー不可。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年10月、英語): Hanamikoji の少し西、海老天丼1,100円と味噌汁、鯛のあら煮の御膳1,100円、カレイの唐揚げの定食、天ぷら付きの昼の定食、塩で食べる天ぷら、鮎の塩焼き、いちじくの天ぷら、鰻の蒸しご飯、日本酒が豊富、1階はカウンター約8席と4名テーブル、2階は8名ほどの座敷。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and upstairs tatami.

places.name: Cest La Vie
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried shrimp, chicken katsu, cream sauces and spaghetti (2025–26 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: omurice, hamburg steak, ham and sausage plates (2025–26 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Wed, Fri and Sat 10:00–19:00; Sun 10:00–18:00; holidays 10:00–18:30; last order 30 minutes before closing; closed Thursday and the 2nd and 4th Sundays; may close early when the rice runs out (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats — a counter, tables and sofa seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog; October 2025 review). In the 鴨東ビル just north of Shijo, 1 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: North of Shijo by the Kamo River, Gion — 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Old-style café-yoshoku with a long menu (2025–26 reviews): shrimp omurice in a thin omelette ¥1,000, with cream sauce ¥1,050 (June 2026), hamburg steak and fried shrimp set just under ¥2,000, mushroom cream spaghetti ¥950, the "three-colour set" of sausage, bacon, ham and fried egg ¥1,550 (October 2025), chicken katsu set with three dressings, salad set with a drink ¥750 (June 2026); coffee
places.notes: [Café-yoshoku · Gion-Shijo] A small, smoky old-style café-yoshoku a minute from Gion-Shijo Station: shrimp omurice in a thin omelette, hamburg steak with fried shrimp, chicken katsu and a sausage-and-egg plate, about ¥1,000–2,000, served with chopsticks and three dressings. Cash only; smoking allowed; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: A Gion café-yoshoku known for its shrimp omurice (April 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Shrimp omurice.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 lunch guest was pleased to get chopsticks and three dressings with the hamburg and fried shrimp set.
On a second stop in October 2025, a diner ordered shrimp omurice, mushroom cream spaghetti and the three-colour set.
A June 2026 diner thought ¥1,800 for cream-sauce omurice, salad and a drink was a fair Gion-Shijo price for the homey taste.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Cest La Vie、洋食・カフェ、東山区廿一軒町236 鴨東ビル 1F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩1分、月〜水・金・土 10:00〜19:00、日 10:00〜18:00、祝 10:00〜18:30、L.O. は閉店30分前、木曜・第2第4日曜休み、ご飯がなくなり次第終了、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、18席 (カウンター、テーブル、ソファ)、喫煙可。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年6月、英語): 薄焼き卵の海老オムライス1,000円、クリームソースの海老オムライス1,050円、ハンバーグとエビフライのセット2,000円弱、きのこのクリームスパゲティ950円、ソーセージ・ベーコン・ハム・目玉焼きの Three-Color セット1,550円、チキンカツ定食と3種のドレッシング、ドリンク付きのサラダセット750円、箸も出る、喫煙可。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking allowed; cash only.

places.name: 祇園 八軒 (Gion Hakken)
places.gf_detail: Ask. A set Kyoto-cuisine course of hassun, sashimi, simmered, grilled and fried dishes, tempura and a beef and mushroom shabu-shabu in dashi; no gluten information (2024–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish- and beef-based course cooked with dashi (2024–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). Omakase course only (December 2024). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Private rooms for 2 to 20 and tatami seating; smoking allowed (Tabelog). In a Kyoto-style building just off the Kawabata side of Yamato-oji south of Shijo, easy to miss; 2 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 1 (Tabelog; December 2024–March 2025).
places.neighborhood: Gion, Yamato-oji south of Shijo — 2 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Kyoto cuisine served as one omakase course in private rooms, used for entertaining and company dinners (2024–2025 reviews) · a hassun box of sashimi and small dishes opened at the table; simmered, grilled and fried dishes; eel; tempura; a mini hot pot of Omi beef and mushrooms shabu-shabu in dashi; rice; dessert (December 2024–November 2025) · a wide sake list (2025 reviews) · about ¥8,000–15,000 (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Gion, private rooms, reservation only] A discreet, easy-to-miss Kyoto-cuisine house off Yamato-oji where a single omakase course is served in private rooms: a lidded box of sashimi and seasonal bites, gently seasoned simmered and grilled dishes, tempura, and a much-praised Omi beef and mushroom shabu-shabu in dashi. Popular for business dinners. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a reservation-only Japanese restaurant and izakaya with private rooms off Yamato-oji in Gion. Reviewers in 2024–2025 describe one omakase course in subtle Kyoto seasoning, attentive hospitality and use for business entertaining.
chef_bio.specialty: Omi beef and mushroom shabu-shabu.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 guest noted the course is omakase only, beginning with sashimi and side dishes drawn from a box in a very Kyoto presentation.
A December 2024 diner traced the course from hassun to dessert and called it an incredible value, the seasoning subtle and of a piece.
A September 2025 work gathering singled out the Omi beef and mushroom shabu-shabu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、東山区大和大路通四条下る3-博多町82、京阪祇園四条駅1番出口から徒歩2分、毎日 17:00〜23:00、営業時間は変わることあり、完全予約制、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、個室 (2〜20名)、座敷、喫煙可。口コミ (2024年12月〜2025年11月、英語): 川端通から少し入った見落としやすい場所、京都らしい建物、おまかせのコースのみ、個室、接待や会社の集まりに、箱から取り出す八寸と刺身、煮物、焼き物、揚げ物、うなぎ、天ぷら、近江牛ときのこのしゃぶしゃぶの小鍋 (だし)、ご飯、デザート、やさしい京都の味付け、日本酒が豊富。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; one omakase course; private rooms; smoking allowed.

places.name: Pizza Strada 京都祇園店 (Pizza Strada Kyoto Gion)
places.gf_detail: Not GF: wood-fired wheat-dough pizza (2025–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable antipasti such as marinated mushrooms and broccoli with anchovy-garlic; most pizzas carry cheese; no vegan option confirmed (2025–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:30, last order 22:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — queues and a full counter soon after opening (Tabelog; December 2025, March 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 50 seats: an 11-seat counter facing the oven and tables upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; December 2025). On Yamato-oji south of Shijo; 6 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 22 October 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, Yamato-oji south of Shijo — 6 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Second shop of the Azabu-Juban pizzeria, with a stone oven and dough made in view (2025–2026 reviews) · pizzas with a thin, chewy, crisp crust: Margherita, smoked-mozzarella Margherita ¥2,880, Bismarck, Romana, tomato pizzas (November 2025–March 2026) · antipasti: marinated octopus with celery, marinated mushrooms, ham, broccoli with anchovy and garlic ¥1,180; Caesar salad (2025–2026 reviews) · Aperol spritz ¥980, Italian lemon soda ¥980 (March 2026) · about ¥4,000–6,000 (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Pizza · Gion, Yamato-oji south of Shijo] The Kyoto branch of Azabu-Juban's Pizza Strada: a stone oven at the counter turning out thin, chewy, crisp-edged pizzas — Margherita, smoked mozzarella, Bismarck — with marinated antipasti and an Aperol spritz. Busy; book ahead. Some found it pricey, and one February 2026 guest was moved seats twice and found the pizza average. Open all day.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: the Kyoto Gion branch, opened 22 October 2025, of the Pizza Strada pizzeria from Azabu-Juban, Tokyo, with a stone oven by the counter. Website pizzastrada.jp (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Margherita.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner who had checked the site during construction arrived at opening, filled the counter seats with the first wave, and found it delicious but pricey.
A February 2026 guest who booked a table was asked twice to move to the counter, found the pizza average, and would not return because of the service.
A March 2026 visitor enjoyed watching the dough being made at the counter and called the crust authentically Neapolitan.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ピザ・イタリアン、東山区大和大路通四条下ル四丁目小松町557-6、祇園四条駅から徒歩6分、毎日 11:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、50席 (カウンター11、テーブル39)、禁煙、2025年10月22日開店、公式サイト pizzastrada.jp。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 麻布十番の人気店の京都2号店、石窯、目の前で生地を作る、薄くもちもちでパリッとした生地、マルゲリータ、燻製モッツァレラのマルゲリータ2,880円、ビスマルク、ロマーナ、タコのマリネとセロリ、きのこのマリネ、ハム、ブロッコリーのアンチョビガーリック1,180円、シーザーサラダ、アペロールスプリッツ980円、イタリアンレモンソーダ980円、行列ができ予約がおすすめ、高いとの声、席を2回移るよう言われピザは普通だったとの声 (2026年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; counter by the oven; cards, IC and QR.

places.name: Peek a boo Cafe
places.gf_detail: Not GF: oven pizza, katsu and steak sandwiches, egg sandwiches (2016–2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Fresh seasonal fruit juices and smoothies; most food is cheese, meat or egg (2019–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 19:00–4:00, last order 3:00; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations by phone, Monday–Saturday 17:00–4:00 (Tabelog). No charge and no service fee (Tabelog original チャージ料なし サービス料なし). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). 24 seats: a 12-seat counter and private rooms for up to 12, including a sunken-table room with karaoke at ¥5,000 for two hours (Tabelog; June 2026). 4F of the Gion Sun building, on Tominaga-cho just east of Nawate; 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 July 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Gion, Tominaga-cho east of Nawate — 3 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn
places.cuisine: Late-night Italian dining bar and cafe with a pizza oven (Tabelog; 2016–2026 reviews) · water-buffalo mozzarella Margherita, oven-baked dessert pizza with marshmallows (2019 reviews) · a wagyu katsu sandwich, steak sandwich, egg sandwich, omurice, crema catalana (Tabelog; 2019–2026 reviews) · fresh seasonal fruit juice, smoothies, sangria, gin and tonic (2017–2025 reviews) · about ¥3,000–5,000 (Tabelog; 2017–2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Dining bar · Gion, till 4 a.m.] A hidden fourth-floor bar-cafe off Nawate, open till 4 a.m., with a pizza oven: buffalo-mozzarella Margherita, a wagyu katsu sandwich, omurice and egg sandwiches, fresh fruit juices and cocktails, and a back room with karaoke. A charming master; no cover charge. Some found it fairly standard, one the katsu sandwich too rare. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian dining bar opened 1 July 2016 in Gion, with an oven for pizza, buffalo mozzarella and a wagyu katsu sandwich, and private rooms with karaoke. Reviewers from 2016 to 2026 describe a late, relaxed place with a charming master.
chef_bio.specialty: Buffalo-mozzarella Margherita; katsu sandwich.

anecdotes.text: A March 2019 fan always has the seasonal fresh juice, and came this time for the oven-baked marshmallow dessert pizza.
A December 2025 second-stop visitor found it quite standard for a Gion bar, though fairly priced.
A June 2026 guest enjoyed the steak sandwich but found the katsu sandwich too rare to bite through, and noted karaoke in the back room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・バー・カフェ、東山区八坂新地冨永町139番地2 ギオンサンビル4階、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、月〜土 19:00〜翌4:00 (L.O.3:00)、日・祝休み、予約可 (電話は月〜土17時〜翌4時)、チャージ料なし・サービス料なし、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー不可、24席 (カウンター12、個室12)、掘りごたつの個室にカラオケ (2時間5,000円)、2016年7月1日開店、ピザ窯、水牛モッツァレラ、和牛のカツサンド。口コミ (2016年10月〜2026年6月、英語): 深夜まで、水牛モッツァレラのマルゲリータ、マシュマロのデザートピザ、ステーキサンド、たまごサンド、オムライス、カタラーナ、季節の生フルーツジュース、スムージー、サングリア、ジントニック、気さくなマスター、普通だったとの声 (2025年12月)、カツサンドがレアすぎて噛み切りにくいとの声 (2026年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Upstairs bar; no cover charge; karaoke room; cards.

places.name: 先斗町 華楽 (Pontocho Karaku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, sashimi, yudofu and sesame tofu, but also tempura and seasoned simmered dishes; no gluten information (2022–2025 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Spicy konnyaku, sesame tofu and yudofu appear, but dashi and fish are common (2022–2025 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday and Sunday 18:00–23:00; Friday–Saturday 18:00–24:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; often full at weekends (Tabelog; March 2023). Food takes a while — staff warn of a wait from order to plate (August 2022). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR; non-smoking (Tabelog). Upstairs, down a narrow alley in Pontocho south of Sanjo; 5 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; August 2022, March 2023).
places.neighborhood: Pontocho south of Sanjo — upstairs off an alley
places.cuisine: Small upstairs Kyoto restaurant of obanzai and seasonal dishes with Kyoto sake (2022–2025 reviews) · assorted obanzai such as spicy konnyaku, eggplant with herring and sesame tofu; sashimi; hamo shabu-shabu in summer (2022–2024 reviews) · a Pontocho course: four obanzai, sashimi, a small dish, yudofu, black wagyu on a hot plate, seasonal tempura, rice, pickles and dessert (October 2024) · Kyoto sake such as Sawaya Matsumoto, served in a choice of kiriko cups; shochu (2023–2025 reviews) · about ¥3,000–8,000 (Tabelog; 2022–2025 reviews)
places.notes: [Obanzai · Pontocho south of Sanjo, upstairs] A tucked-away second-floor restaurant down a Pontocho alley where a gentle chef serves gently seasoned obanzai, sashimi, summer hamo shabu-shabu and a Pontocho course with yudofu and wagyu, with Kyoto sake in cut-glass cups. Welcoming to solo diners. Expect a wait for dishes — come unhurried.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews (2022–2025): a regional-cuisine restaurant upstairs in a Pontocho alley, with a gentle chef, friendly staff and an owner who chooses the sake and shochu; recommended by local bar owners.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai; Pontocho course.

anecdotes.text: An August 2022 visitor, sent by the owner of a nearby bar, was warned on arrival to expect a long wait between ordering and the food.
An August 2024 guest back after the Okuribi fires for a second year was greeted by the same server as the year before.
A November 2023 diner chose a kiriko cup for Sawaya Matsumoto sake after a little of every obanzai.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 郷土料理、中京区先斗町三条下る材木町188-7、月〜木・日 18:00〜23:00、金・土 18:00〜24:00、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙。口コミ (2022年8月〜2025年12月、英語): 先斗町の細い路地の奥の2階、近くのバーの店主の紹介、注文から料理まで時間がかかると最初に言われる、やさしい料理人、おばんざいの盛り合わせ (ピリ辛こんにゃく、なすとにしん、胡麻豆腐)、刺身、夏のはもしゃぶ、先斗町コース (おばんざい4種、刺身、小鉢、湯豆腐、黒毛和牛の鉄板焼き、季節の天ぷら、ご飯、漬物、デザート)、京都の地酒 (Sawaya Matsumoto)、切子のおちょこを選べる、焼酎、1人でも入りやすい。

cultural_comfort.note: Small upstairs room; slow-paced; cards, IC and QR.
